English: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
Kiswahili: Hapo mwanzo Mungu aliumba mbingu na dunia.
Ekegusii: Agwo omochakano Nyasae agatonga igoro na ense,

English: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu dunia ilikuwa haina umbo, tena ilikuwa tupu. Giza lilikuwa juu ya uso wa vilindi vya maji, naye Roho wa Mungu alikuwa ametulia juu ya maji.
Ekegusii: Bono ense tiyarenge na kieni kende, gose kende gionsi tikiareengeo, n’omosunte ekerima nigo oyetubete, na Omoika o Nyasae ogatoeerera igoro y’amaache.

English: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo nuru,” nayo nuru ikawepo.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agachiika: “Tiga oborabu bobeo,” erio kegima oborabu bokabao.

English: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
Kiswahili: Mungu akaona ya kuwa nuru ni njema, ndipo Mungu akatenganisha nuru na giza.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akagokigwa na keria aroche. Erio agaatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte,

English: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
Kiswahili: Mungu akaiita nuru “mchana,” na giza akaliita “usiku.” Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: akaroka oborabu boria omobaso, na omosunte akayoroka obotuko. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bokaba maambia, rituko rie ritang’ani.

English: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo nafasi kati ya maji igawe maji na maji.”
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga oboiko bobe egati‐gati y’amaache, erio bwatanane amaache korwa ase amaache ande.”

English: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akafanya nafasi, akatenganisha maji yaliyo chini ya hiyo nafasi na maji yaliyo juu yake. Ikawa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Igo Nyasae agakora oboiko boria, bogaatanana amaache ayare inse y’eaanga korwa ase amaache ayare igoro y’oboiko; ayio akaba boigo.

English: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
Kiswahili: Mungu akaiita hiyo nafasi “anga.” Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya pili.
Ekegusii: Akaroka oboiko boria igoro. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria kabere.

English: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Maji yaliyopo chini ya anga na yakusanyike mahali pamoja, pawepo na nchi kavu.” Ikawa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga amaache ayare inse y’erioba asangererekane aase aamo, egere ense enyomo erorekane;” ayio akaba boigo.

English: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
Kiswahili: Mungu akaiita nchi kavu “ardhi,” nalo lile kusanyiko la maji akaliita “bahari.” Mungu akaona kuwa ni vyema.
Ekegusii: Akaroka aase aria aomo ense, na amaache aria asangererekanete amo akayaroka chinyancha. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.

English: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mungu akasema, “Ardhi na itoe mimea: miche itoayo mbegu, miti juu ya nchi itoayo matunda yenye mbegu ndani yake, kila mmea kulingana na aina zake mbalimbali.” Ikawa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Erio agachiika agateeba: “Tiga ense emere ebimeri bigokina, buna ebimeri bikorua na emete ekwama amatunda are ne chimbusuro chire imeo, kera oyomo ase egesaku kiaye ekenyene” ayio akaba boigo.

English: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
Kiswahili: Ardhi ikachipua mimea: Mimea itoayo mbegu kulingana na aina zake, na miti itoayo matunda yenye mbegu kulingana na aina zake. Mungu akaona ya kuwa hili ni jema.
Ekegusii: Na ense ekamera ebimeri bionsi, na Nyasae akarora ng’a ayio namaya.

English: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
Kiswahili: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya tatu.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatato.

English: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo mianga kwenye nafasi ya anga ili itenganishe usiku na mchana, nayo iwe alama ya kutambulisha majira mbalimbali, siku na miaka,
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agachiika “Tiga emebaso ebe ase oboiko bw’aaria igoro, bwatanane omobaso korwa ase obotuko; erio ebe ebimanyererio bikworokia ebiro bi’amatuko, ne chingaki, n’emiaka,

English: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
Kiswahili: nayo iwe mianga kwenye nafasi ya anga ya kutia nuru juu ya dunia.” Ikawa hivyo.
Ekegusii: ebe emebaso ase oboiko aaria igoro, boyee ense omobaso na oborabu,” ayio onsi akaba boigo.

English: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
Kiswahili: Mungu akafanya mianga miwili mikubwa: mwanga mkubwa utawale mchana, na mwanga mdogo utawale usiku. Pia Mungu akafanya nyota.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agakora emebaso ebere emenene, Risase rigaambere ekero kia mobaso n’omotienyi ogaambere ekero kia botuko; agakora ne ching’enang’eni boigo.

English: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
Kiswahili: Mungu akaiweka katika nafasi ya anga iangaze dunia,
Ekegusii: Akayebeka ase eanga aaria igoro, eyee ense oborabu,

English: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
Kiswahili: itawale usiku na mchana, na ikatenganishe nuru na giza. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.
Ekegusii: egaambere omobaso na obotuko, na gwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.

English: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
Kiswahili: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya nne.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria kane.

English: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Kuwepo na viumbe hai tele kwenye maji, nao ndege waruke juu ya dunia katika nafasi ya anga.”
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga amaache atware obonge bw’ebitongwa bire moyo, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka igoro ase ense, chigoetanana inse y’eaanga ya igoro.”

English: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akaumba viumbe wakubwa wa baharini na kila kiumbe hai kiendacho majini kulingana na aina zake, na kila ndege mwenye mabawa kulingana na aina yake. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agatonga ebitongwa ebinene bire ase amaache ime, amo n’ebitongwa binde bionsi bimenyete ase amache ime, boigo agatoonga chinyoni. Nyasae akarora ng’a ayio namaya.

English: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akavibariki, akasema, “Zaeni mwongezeke, mkayajaze maji ya bahari, nao ndege waongezeke katika dunia.”
Ekegusii: Erio akabisesenia bionsi, agateeba ebitoongwa biria bimenyete amaache ime bisaraare biichore ime ase chinyancha, naende agateebia chinyoni chisaraare ase ense.

English: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
Kiswahili: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya tano.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatano.

English: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Ardhi na itoe viumbe hai kulingana na aina zake: wanyama wa kufugwa, viumbe vitambaavyo ardhini na wanyama pori, kila mnyama kulingana na aina yake.” Ikawa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga ense etware ebitongwa bire moyo, kera egesaku n’engencho yaye. Ching’iti chigotugwa, n’echikwagura, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, kera egesaku nengencho yaye” ayio akaba boigo.

English: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
Kiswahili: Mungu akafanya wanyama pori kulingana na aina zake, wanyama wa kufugwa kulingana na aina zake, na viumbe vyote vitambaavyo juu ya ardhi kulingana na aina zake. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Nyasae agakora ching’iti chi’orosana, Nyasae akarora ng’a ayio namaya.

English: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akasema, “Tufanye mtu kwa mfano wetu, kwa sura yetu, wakatawale juu ya samaki wa baharini na ndege wa angani, juu ya mifugo, juu ya dunia yote, na juu ya viumbe wote watambaao juu ya nchi.”
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateeba: “Bono tiga tokore omonto; ase omogwekano oito, otobwekaine. Nigo arabe n’echinguru agaambere chinswe chia nyancha, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka igoro, ne ching’iti chigotugwa, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana, na ense yonsi, ne ching’iti chionsi chinene n’echinke.”

English: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akamuumba mtu kwa mfano wake mwenyewe, kwa mfano wa Mungu alimuumba; mwanaume na mwanamke aliwaumba.
Ekegusii: Nabo Nyasae agatonga Mwanyabaanto ase omobwekano oye omonyene; ase omobwekano o Nyasae ere akamotonga. Agatonga omosacha na omokungu,

English: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akawabariki na akawaambia, “Zaeni na mkaongezeke, mkaijaze tena dunia na kuitiisha. Mkatawale samaki wa baharini, ndege wa angani, na kila kiumbe hai kiendacho juu ya ardhi.”
Ekegusii: akabasesenia, akabateebia: “Moibore, mosarare, moichore ase ense, na moyegaambere. Ngokobeeka inde ogaambere chinswe, ne chinyoni, n’echingiti chionsi chi’orosana.

English: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mungu akasema, “Nimewapa kila mche utoao mbegu juu ya uso wa dunia yote, na kila mti wenye matunda yenye mbegu ndani yake. Vitakuwa chakula chenu.
Ekegusii: Nabaeire kera ekemeri gekwama chimbusuro, na kera omote okwama amatunda ebio nabio biraabe endagera yaino.

English: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
Kiswahili: Nao wanyama wote wa dunia, ndege wote wa angani, na viumbe vyote viendavyo juu ya ardhi: yaani kila kiumbe chenye pumzi ya uhai, ninawapa kila mche wa kijani kuwa chakula.” Ikawa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Korende ching’iti chi’orosana ne chinyoni chionsi nachieire ebimeri ebibese bionsi bibe endagera yabo.” Ayio onsi akaba boigo.

English: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
Kiswahili: Mungu akaona vyote alivyoumba, na tazama, ilikuwa vizuri sana. Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya sita.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akarora ebinto ebio bionsi akorete, na birobio nigo biareenge ebiya mono. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatano na rimo.

English: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mbingu na dunia zikakamilika, pamoja na vyote vilivyomo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo igoro na ense bigaikeranigwa.

English: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya saba Mungu alikuwa amekamilisha kazi aliyokuwa akiifanya, hivyo siku ya saba akapumzika kutoka kazi zake zote.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Nyasae agaikerania emeremo yaye yonsi; erio agatimoka.

English: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
Kiswahili: Mungu akaibariki siku ya saba akaifanya takatifu, kwa sababu katika siku hiyo alipumzika kutoka kazi zote za kuumba alizokuwa amefanya.
Ekegusii: Nyasae agasesenia rituko ria gatano na kabere, akariatanana, akarikora richenu, ekiagera erio nario rituko atimogete korwa ase emeremo yaye yonsi y’obotongi, eyio konya akorire.

English: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh God made the earth and the heavens.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maelezo ya mbingu na dunia wakati zilipoumbwa. Bwana Mungu alipoziumba mbingu na dunia,
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omogano igoro y’ense, na bionsi ebire imeo buna biatongetwe.

English: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,
Kiswahili: hapakuwepo na mche wa shambani uliokuwa umejitokeza ardhini, wala hapakuwepo na mmea wa shamba uliokuwa umeota, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu alikuwa hajanyeshea mvua juu ya nchi, na hapakuwepo mtu wa kuilima ardhi,
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria’Omonene atongete igoro na ense, kemeri kende tikiarenge komera korwa ase riroba, gose nyeni chinde, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae konya taratoma embura etwe ase ense, nonya ’monto onde tarengeo ore korema riroba.

English: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.
Kiswahili: lakini umande ulitokeza kutoka ardhini na kunyesha uso wote wa nchi:
Ekegusii: Korende obotooru nigo bware gotiira korwa inse na konyiyia riroba ri’ense yonsi.

English: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu alimuumba mtu kutoka mavumbi ya ardhi, akampulizia pumzi ya uhai puani mwake, naye mtu akawa kiumbe hai.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akaimokia amaroba korwa inse akabomba na koroisia omonto korwa ase orotu rwe riroba, akamoutera omoika bw’obogima ase chimioro chiaye, erio omonto akaba n’obomooyo.

English: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana Mungu alikuwa ameotesha bustani upande wa mashariki, katika Edeni, huko akamweka huyo mtu aliyemuumba.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae agasimeka ebimeri ase omogondo aaria Edeni, ensemo ya moocha, erio akabeeka omonto aroro, oria abombete na koroisia.

English: Out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu akafanya aina zote za miti ziote kutoka ardhini, miti yenye kupendeza macho na mizuri kwa chakula. Katikati ya bustani ulikuwepo mti wa uzima na mti wa kujua mema na mabaya.
Ekegusii: Akameria emete korwa ase riroba, emete yonsi ekororwa yasanerwa kegima, eyio yarenge endagera engiya. Nyasae akabeeka omote bw’obogima gati‐gati y’omogondo oria, naende omote onde oyo bw’okomanyera amaya na amabe.

English: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.
Kiswahili: Mto wa kunyeshea bustani ulitiririka toka Edeni, kuanzia hapa ukagawanyika kuwa mito minne.
Ekegusii: Orooche rogatuboka korwa ase omogondo o Edeni na rokayobekera amaache. Korwa agwo rokagabekana, rokaba chindooche inye.

English: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
Kiswahili: Mto wa kwanza uliitwa Pishoni, nao huzunguka nchi yote ya Havila ambako kuna dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Orooche rwe ritang’ani rokarokwa Pisoni, orwo narwo roetanaine ense yonsi ya Havila.

English: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.
Kiswahili: (Dhahabu ya nchi hiyo ni nzuri, bedola na vito shohamu pia hupatikana huko.)
Ekegusii: Aa noo Etaabu engiya kegima egotoka boigo namagena ande ye rigori rinene.

English: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.
Kiswahili: Jina la mto wa pili ni Gihoni, ambao huzunguka nchi yote ya Kushi.
Ekegusii: Na orooche rwa kabere rokarokwa Gihoni, orwo narwo roetanaine ense yonsi ya Kusi.

English: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
Kiswahili: Jina la mto wa tatu ni Tigrisi, unaopita mashariki ya Ashuru. Mto wa nne ni Frati.
Ekegusii: Na orooche rwa gatato rokarokwa Tigirisi, orwo rogoeta moocha y’Asuri. Na orooche rwa kane narororwo rokarokwa Eufarati.

English: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu akamchukua huyo mtu, akamweka kwenye Bustani ya Edeni ailime na kuitunza.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akaira omonto oria, akamobeka ase omogondo o Edeni, ayoroiserie na koyorenda.

English: Yahweh God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu akamwagiza huyo mtu, akamwambia, “Uko huru kula matunda ya mti wowote katika bustani,
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia omonto oria, “Amatunda a kera omote ore ase omogondo oyo nonyare koyaria,

English: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
Kiswahili: lakini kamwe usile matunda ya mti wa kujua mema na mabaya, kwa maana siku utakapokula matunda yake, hakika utakufa.”
Ekegusii: gotatiga amatunda y’omote bw’okomanyera amaya na amabe toyaria, ekiagera rituko riria orayarie goika okwe.”

English: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu akasema, “Si vyema huyu mtu awe peke yake. Nitamfanyia msaidizi wa kumfaa.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae agateeba: “Tai buya omonto oyo abe bweka, nimokorere omokonyi oramokoonye.”

English: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana Mungu alikuwa amefanyiza kutoka ardhi wanyama wote wa porini na ndege wote wa angani. Akawaleta kwa huyu mtu aone atawaitaje, nalo jina lolote alilokiita kila kiumbe hai, likawa ndilo jina lake.
Ekegusii: Erio akaimokia amaroba korwa inse akaroisia kera eng’iti, ne chinyoni chionsi. Erio agachirenta ase omonto oria, arore buna agochiroka; naboigo kera egetongwa kianyorete erieta riaye.

English: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Adamu akawapa majina wanyama wote wa kufugwa, ndege wa angani, na wanyama wote wa porini. Lakini kwa Adamu hakupatikana msaidizi wa kumfaa.
Ekegusii: Ase igo omonto oyio akaroka chinyoni chionsi n’echingiti chionsi; korende ase ebio bionsi ebiatongetwe, tarorekana mokonyi onde oye.

English: Yahweh God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bwana Mungu akamfanya Adamu kulala usingizi mzito, naye alipokuwa amelala akachukua moja ya mbavu zake, akapafunika mahali pale kwa nyama.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akabeekera omonto oria chitoro chindito mono kegima, ekero araire akamorusia orobaru rwaye oromo, na akairaneria chinyama aase aria.

English: Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana Mungu akamfanya mwanamke kutoka kwenye ule ubavu aliouchukua kutoka kwa huyo mwanaume, akamleta huyo mwanamke kwa huyo mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia omokungu korwa ase orobaru akamoirera omonto oria.

English: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanaume akasema, “Huyu sasa ni mfupa wa mifupa yangu na nyama ya nyama yangu, ataitwa ‘mwanamke,’ kwa kuwa alitolewa katika mwanaume.”
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agateeba, “Omoerio oyombwekaine oyo aa Oyo neriuga korwa ase amauga aane, ne chinyama korwa ase chinyama chiane. Oyo nigo ararokwe omokungu, ekiagera oyo nigo arusigwe ase omosacha.”

English: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake na kuambatana na mkewe, nao watakuwa mwili mmoja.
Ekegusii: Ekio nakio gekogera omonto agotiga ise na ng’ina obwatana na mokaye, na abwo babere baba omobere oyomo.

English: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
Kiswahili: Adamu na mkewe wote wawili walikuwa uchi, wala hawakuona aibu.
Ekegusii: Omosacha na omokungu nigo baarenge getirianda, na tibaare kororerana obosooku.

English: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”
Kiswahili: Basi nyoka alikuwa mwerevu kuliko wanyama wote wa porini ambao Bwana Mungu aliwafanya. Nyoka akamwambia mwanamke, “Ati kweli Mungu alisema, ‘Kamwe msile matunda ya mti wowote wa bustanini’?”
Ekegusii: Bono eng’iti engenda inse nigo yarenge eng’aini kobua ching’iti chinde chionsi, echi Omonene Nyasae akorete. Engiti ekaboria omokungu: “Inee! Namaene ng’a Nyasae nigo abakanetie ng’a timoria amatunda ’omote onde bwonsi ore mogondo?”

English: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
Kiswahili: Mwanamke akamjibu nyoka, “Tunaweza kula matunda ya miti iliyoko bustanini,
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akairaneria eng’iti eria: “Amatunda a kera omote ore ase omogondo ’natonyare koyaria

English: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”
Kiswahili: lakini Mungu alisema, ‘Kamwe msile tunda la mti ulio katikati ya bustani, wala kuugusa, la sivyo mtakufa.’ ”
Ekegusii: otatiga amatunda y’omote ore mogondo gati-gati. Nyasae nigo atokanetie titoria amatunda korwa ase omote oria gose koyakuna, toise gokora bo nigo torakwe.”

English: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,
Kiswahili: Lakini nyoka akamwambia mwanamke, “Hakika hamtakufa.
Ekegusii: Eng’iti eria ekairaneria omokungu oria “Ayio tari bo ogokwa, timogokwa.

English: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu anajua ya kuwa wakati mtakapoyala, macho yenu yatafumbuliwa, nanyi mtakuwa kama Mungu, mkijua mema na mabaya.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akwanete bo akiagera amanyete ng’a ekero moraarie amatunda y’omote oyio nigo morabwekane Nyasae mobe mokomanya amaya na amabe.”

English: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke alipoona ya kuwa tunda la mti huo lilikuwa zuri kwa chakula na la kupendeza macho, tena linatamanika kwa kujipatia hekima, basi akachuma katika matunda yake, akala, pia akampa mumewe, aliyekuwa pamoja naye, naye akala.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria agachia korora omote oria buna ore omuya okoriegwa na okogwenera amaiso, na omote oria noyo bw’okoganigwa, ekiagera okobaa okomanya, agatwa amatunda aye, akaria. Erio agwo akairera omosacha oye amatunda ande nere akaria.

English: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
Kiswahili: Ndipo macho yao wote wawili yakafumbuliwa, wakajiona kwamba walikuwa uchi; hivyo wakashona majani ya mtini, wakajifunika.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo nyuma ko barire, bakaegwa okomanya bakamanya ng’a ngetirianda bare; erio bagatabora amato y’omoko, bakayasonerania, erio bakeboyia.

English: They heard Yahweh God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule mwanaume na mkewe, waliposikia sauti ya Bwana Mungu alipokuwa akitembea bustanini jioni, wakajificha kutoka mbele za Bwana Mungu katikati ya miti ya bustani.
Ekegusii: Emogoroba eria bakaigwa eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae ogotaara ase omogondo, erio barabwo bakebisa mogondo gati y’emete.

English: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana Mungu akamwita Adamu, “Uko wapi?”
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene Nyasae akarangeria omonto oria, akamobooria: “Ng’ai ore?”

English: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
Kiswahili: Naye akajibu, “Nilikusikia katika bustani nikaogopa kwa sababu nilikuwa uchi, hivyo nikajificha.”
Ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria: “Nigo naigwa eriogi riao ase omogondo, noboa ase ayio nebisa ekiagera igo nde getirianda.”

English: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
Kiswahili: Mungu akamuuliza, “Ni nani aliyekuambia ya kuwa ulikuwa uchi? Je, umekula matunda ya mti niliokuamuru usile?”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamobooria: “Ing’o ogoteebia ng’a ngetirianda ore? Inee! Nkwarire amatunda y’omote oria nagokanetie ng’a toria?”

English: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
Kiswahili: Adamu akasema, “Huyu mwanamke uliyenipa awe pamoja nami alinipa sehemu ya tunda kutoka kwenye huo mti, nami nikala.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akamoiraneria: “Omokungu oyo kwang’ete ng’a abe amo nainche, nere ong’ete amatunda y’omote oyio, na inche nkaria.”

English: Yahweh God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana Mungu akamuuliza mwanamke, “Ni nini hili ambalo umelifanya?” Mwanamke akajibu, “Nyoka alinidanganya, nami nikala.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akabooria omokungu oria: “Ninki kiagera gwakora aya?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria: “Neng’iti yang’ainete, nkaria.”

English: Yahweh God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bwana Mungu akamwambia nyoka, “Kwa kuwa umefanya hili, “Umelaaniwa kuliko wanyama wote wa kufugwa na wa porini! Utatambaa kwa tumbo lako na kula mavumbi siku zote za maisha yako.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae agateebia eng’iti eria, “Ekiagera gwakorire aya, aye bweka kwaragererigwe kobua ching’iti chionsi; aye nenda oragendere, na orotu orarie buna endagera ase obogima bwao bwonsi.

English: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”
Kiswahili: Nami nitaweka uadui kati yako na huyo mwanamke, na kati ya uzao wako na wake, yeye atakuponda kichwa, nawe utamuuma kisigino.”
Ekegusii: Inche nimbeeke obobisa ase egati yao na omokungu oyo, na ase egati y’oroiboro rwao na oroiboro rwaye; noroiboro orwo narogosenyente omotwe oo, na aye nomoorome egetingiro kiaye.”

English: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
Kiswahili: Kwa mwanamke akasema, “Nitakuzidishia sana utungu wakati wa kuzaa kwako; kwa utungu utazaa watoto. Tamaa yako itakuwa kwa mumeo naye atakutawala.”
Ekegusii: Akaonchokera omokungu, akamoteebia, “Ninkomentere emechando emeenge ekero okoba morito, na ekero okoibora abana nonyore obororo; nonya nabo okogania kwao nigo korabe ase omosacha oo, na ere nakogaambere.”

English: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.
Kiswahili: Kwa Adamu akasema, “Kwa sababu umemsikiliza mke wako na ukala kutoka kwenye mti niliokuamuru, ‘Msile tunda lake,’ “Ardhi imelaaniwa kwa sababu yako, kwa kazi ngumu utakula chakula kitokacho humo siku zote za maisha yako.
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia Omosacha oria, “Ekiagera kwaigwerete mokao na okaria amatunda ’omote oria nagokanetie ng’a toria, riroba riaragererigwe ase engencho yao. Ase ogwechanda kwao norie okwama kwaeriroba amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwao.

English: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.
Kiswahili: Itazaa miiba na mibaruti kwa ajili yako, nawe utakula mimea ya shambani.
Ekegusii: Riroba narikwamere amagwa na amageri, na aye norie okwama kw’ebimeri bi’orosana.

English: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”
Kiswahili: Kwa jasho la uso wako utakula chakula chako hadi utakaporudi ardhini, kwa kuwa ulitwaliwa kutoka humo, kwa kuwa wewe u mavumbi na mavumbini wewe utarudi.”
Ekegusii: Goika okore omokia na goitera ebigeri gokora riroba riame kende gionsi omanye konyora endagera orie; goika oirane ase riroba, ekiagera agwo nao kwarwete. Naki aye norotu, naende noirane ase orotu.”

English: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.
Kiswahili: Adamu akamwita mkewe Eva, kwa kuwa atakuwa mama wa wote walio hai.
Ekegusii: Adamu akaaroka mokaye Hawa, ekiagera ere nere ng’ina bw’abare moyo bonsi.

English: Yahweh God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu akawatengenezea Adamu na mkewe mavazi ya ngozi, akawavika.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akaroiseria Adamu na mokaye chingobo chi’amasankwa, erio agwo akababoyia.

English: Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana Mungu akasema, “Sasa mtu huyu amekuwa kama mmoja wetu, kwa kujua mema na mabaya. Sharti asiruhusiwe kunyoosha mkono wake na kuchuma pia kutoka mti wa uzima akala, naye akaishi milele.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae agateeba: “Rora, omonto oyo obeire buna oyomo oito ase okomanya amaya na amabe. Tabaisa gwancherwa gochia korambora okoboko kwaye atwe amatunda ’omote bw’obogima arie, erinde abe moyo kare na kare.”

English: Therefore Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bwana Mungu akamfukuzia mbali kutoka Bustani ya Edeni, akalime ardhi ambamo alitolewa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae akamoseeria korwa ase omogondo o Edeni, akamobeka areme riroba agwo ase arwete.

English: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumfukuzia mbali Adamu, Mungu akaweka makerubi mashariki ya Bustani ya Edeni, pamoja na upanga wa moto ukimulika huku na huko kulinda njia ya kuuendea mti wa uzima.
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya moocha y’omogondo o Edeni akabeeka ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, n’omoyio o birende ogwoka omorero okona‐koonchaonchoka chinsemo chionsi. Erio korenda onde bwensi tacha ase omote bw’obogima.

English: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with Yahweh’s help.”
Kiswahili: Adamu akakutana kimwili na mkewe Eva, naye akapata mimba, akamzaa Kaini. Eva akasema, “Kwa msaada wa Bwana nimemzaa mwanaume.”
Ekegusii: Bono Adamu akaba na mokaye Hawa, na ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Nanyorire omwana omomura ase ogokonywa kw’Omonene.” Ase igo akamoroka Kaini.

English: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
Kiswahili: Baadaye akamzaa Abeli ndugu yake. Basi Abeli akawa mfugaji, na Kaini akawa mkulima.
Ekegusii: Naende akaibora omwana onde Abeli. Abeli akaba omorisia bwe ching’ondi, na Kaini akaba omoremi bw’omogondo.

English: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to Yahweh from the fruit of the ground.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda Kaini akaleta baadhi ya mazao ya shamba kama sadaka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Engaki egaika Kaini akarenta okwama kw’omogondo oye erio kobe ekengwanso ase Omonene.

English: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,
Kiswahili: Lakini Abeli akaleta fungu nono kutoka baadhi ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wa mifugo yake. Bwana akamkubali Abeli pamoja na sadaka yake,
Ekegusii: Abeli nere akareenta emanwa entangi enoru korwa ase riicho riaye. Na Omonene aganchera ekengwanso ki’Abeli,

English: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.
Kiswahili: lakini Mungu hakumkubali Kaini pamoja na sadaka yake. Kwa hiyo Kaini akakasirika sana, uso wake ukawa na huzuni.
Ekegusii: korende tagogetigwe nekengwanso gia Kaini. Ase igo, ayio akagera Kaini akagechigwa mono kegima, na obosio bwaye bokaonchoka, bokairura.

English: Yahweh said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Kaini, “Kwa nini umekasirika? Kwa nini uso wako una huzuni?
Ekegusii: Na Omonene akamobooria: “Kaini, nase ki okobeera nendamwamu na obosio bwao bwairurire?

English: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”
Kiswahili: Ukifanya lililo sawa, je, hutakubalika? Lakini usipofanya lililo sawa, dhambi inakuvizia mlangoni mwako, inakutamani wewe, lakini inakupasa uishinde.”
Ekegusii: “Onye ndiria gwakora buya anga nigo agogete; korende bono aye gwakorire ebibe, ebibe nigo bikoganyererete gesieri; na birobio nigo bikoganetie. Korende nekogwenerete obibue kegima.”

English: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.
Kiswahili: Basi Kaini akamwambia ndugu yake Abeli, “Twende shambani.” Walipokuwa shambani, Kaini akamshambulia Abeli ndugu yake, akamuua.
Ekegusii: Erio Kaini agateebia Abeli omwabo: “Inchuo, togende getii.” Ekero baare agwo getii, Kaini akaimokera Abeli momura omwabo, akamoita.

English: Yahweh said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamuuliza Kaini, “Ndugu yako Abeli yuko wapi?” Akamjibu, “Sijui, je, mimi ni mlinzi wa ndugu yangu?”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akabooria Kaini: “Ng’ai Abeli momura omino are?” Kaini akamoiraneria: “Inche tinkomanya. Inee! Ninche nkorenda oyominto?”

English: Yahweh said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Umefanya nini? Sikiliza! Damu ya ndugu yako inanililia mimi kutoka ardhini.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamoteebia: “Inki gekogera gwakora egookoroo eke ekebe iga? Eriogi ri’amanyinga a momura omino riarure ase riroba, riang’ikeire buna eriogi rikorigia egesiomba.

English: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
Kiswahili: Sasa umelaaniwa na umehamishwa kutoka ardhi, ambayo imefungua kinywa chake na kupokea damu ya ndugu yako kutoka mkononi mwako.
Ekegusii: Bono aye kwaragererigwe na tokogenderera korema korwa ase riroba. Rirorio nigo riaasamirie omonwa oye na konywa amanyinga y’omwana omino korwa ase okoboko kwao.

English: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”
Kiswahili: Utakapoilima ardhi, haitakupa tena mazao yake. Utakuwa mtu wa kutangatanga duniani asiye na utulivu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero orabe gokorema riroba tirigokwamera endagera nonya ng’ake. Igo orabe omoomboganu na omoetanani ase ense.”

English: Cain said to Yahweh, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
Kiswahili: Kaini akamwambia Bwana, “Adhabu yangu ni zaidi ya niwezavyo kustahimili.
Ekegusii: Erio Kaini agateebia Omonene: “Egesusuro kiane nekerito, tinkonyara gokebogoria.

English: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”
Kiswahili: Leo unanifukuza kutoka nchi, nami nitafichwa mbali na uwepo wako. Nitakuwa mtu wa kutangatanga asiyetulia duniani na yeyote anionaye ataniua.”
Ekegusii: Rora, reero gwanseririe korwa ase riroba eri, nimbiseke korwa ase obosio bwao, timborora naende. Nimbe omoomboganu na omoetanani ase ense, na onde bwensi orang’umere nigo arang’ite.”

English: Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia, “La sivyo, ikiwa mtu yeyote atamuua Kaini atalipizwa kisasi mara saba zaidi.” Kisha Bwana akamwekea Kaini alama ili mtu yeyote ambaye angemwona asimuue.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoteebia: “Taibo! Onde bwensi oraite Kaini nigo araakanigwe egesiomba ara gatano na kabere.” Na Omonene akabeekera Kaini ekemanyererio ng’a onde bwensi oramoumere tabaisa komoita.

English: Cain left Yahweh’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Kaini akaondoka mbele za Bwana akaenda kuishi katika nchi ya Nodi, iliyoko mashariki ya Edeni.
Ekegusii: Erio Kaini akarwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, akageenda, akamenya ase ense ekorokwa okoombogana ere moocha ya Edeni.

English: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
Kiswahili: Kaini akakutana kimwili na mkewe, naye akapata mimba na akamzaa Enoki. Wakati huo Kaini alikuwa anajenga mji, akauita Enoki jina la mtoto wake.
Ekegusii: Kaini akaba na mokaye, na ere akaba morito, akaibora Enoku; na Kaini akaagacha omochie, akayoroka Enoku, erieta ri’omwana oye.

English: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.
Kiswahili: Enoki akamzaa Iradi, Iradi akamzaa Mehuyaeli, Mehuyaeli akamzaa Methushaeli, na Methushaeli akamzaa Lameki.
Ekegusii: Enoku akaibora Iradi, Iradi akaibora Metusaeli, Metusaeli akaibora Lameki.

English: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.
Kiswahili: Lameki alioa wanawake wawili, mmoja aliitwa Ada, na mwingine Sila.
Ekegusii: Lameki akanyuoma abakungu babere. Omokungu oyomo nigo are korokwa Ada, n’oyonde Zila.

English: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
Kiswahili: Ada akamzaa Yabali ambaye ni baba wa wale walioishi katika mahema na kufuga wanyama.
Ekegusii: Ada akaibora Yabeli; oyo nere sokoro y’abare komenya ase ebigutu na babwate ching’iti chigotugwa.

English: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
Kiswahili: Kaka yake aliitwa Yubali, aliyekuwa baba wa wote wapigao zeze na filimbi.
Ekegusii: Na momura omwabo nigo are korokwa Yubali; oyio nere sokoro y’abanto baria baare kobugia amakano na ebiroria.

English: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.
Kiswahili: Pia Sila alikuwa na mtoto wa kiume aliyeitwa Tubali-Kaini ambaye alifua vifaa vya aina mbalimbali vya shaba na chuma. Naama alikuwa dada wa Tubali-Kaini.
Ekegusii: Zila akaibora Tubali‐Kaini. Ere nigo areenge omoturi bw’ebinto bi’ebioma na ebie chitaai. Na omosubati omwabo nere Naama.

English: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.
Kiswahili: Lameki akawaambia wake zake, “Ada na Sila nisikilizeni mimi; wake wa Lameki sikieni maneno yangu. Nimemuua mtu kwa kunijeruhi, kijana mdogo kwa kuniumiza.
Ekegusii: Lameki agateebia abakungu baye, inwe “Ada na Zila, igwa eriogi riane, inwe abakungu ba Lameki, tegerera buya moigwe buna ngoteeba, naitire omomura omoke ekiagera ong’akire na kombeeka rioote.

English: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”
Kiswahili: Kama Kaini atalipizwa kisasi mara saba, basi Lameki itakuwa mara sabini na saba.”
Ekegusii: Onye Kaini ogoakanerwa egesiomba ara gatano na kabere, amaene, Lameki ere naakanerwe ara emerongo etano na ebere, na gatano na kabere.”

English: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”
Kiswahili: Adamu akakutana kimwili na mke wake tena, akamzaa mwana, akamwita Sethi, akisema, “Mungu amenijalia mwana mwingine badala ya Abeli, kwa kuwa Kaini alimuua.”
Ekegusii: Adamu na mokaye bakaibora omwana onde omomura, erio Hawa akamoroka Seti, agateeba: “Bono Nyasae ong’eire omwana onde omomura ribaga ri’Abeli, oria Kaini aitete”. Erio akamoroka Seti.

English: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: Naye Sethi akamzaa mwana, akamwita Enoshi. Wakati huo watu wakaanza kuliitia jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Seti nere akaibora omwana omomura, akamoroka Enosu. Erio agwo abanto bagachaaka korangeria erieta ri’Omonene ase okomosasiima.

English: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
Kiswahili: Hii ni orodha iliyoandikwa ya vizazi vya Adamu. Wakati Mungu alipomuumba Adamu, alimfanya kwa sura ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeeria rw’Adamu. Ekero keria Nyasae atongete Mwanyabaanto, akabaroisia ase omogwekano oye omonyene.

English: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.
Kiswahili: Aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke, akawabariki. Walipokwisha kuumbwa, akawaita “mwanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Ere akabatonga omosacha na omokungu, akabasesenia, akabaroka Mwanyabaanto.

English: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
Kiswahili: Adamu alipokuwa ameishi miaka 130, alikuwa na mwana aliyekuwa na sura yake, mwenye kufanana naye. Akamwita Sethi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Adamu konya amenyire emiaka rigana erimo na emerongo etato (130), akaba ise bw’omwana omomura omobwekaine, ore ekieni kiaye ere omonyene, akamoroka Seti.

English: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Sethi kuzaliwa, Adamu aliishi miaka 800, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Seti, Adamu akagenderera komenya goika emiaka ende amagana atano na atato (800), erio akaba ise bw’abana baabande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Adamu aliishi jumla ya miaka 930, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo Adamu nigo amenyete, emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etato (930), erio agakwa.

English: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
Kiswahili: Sethi alipokuwa ameishi miaka 105, akamzaa Enoshi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Seti konya amenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na etano (105), akaibora Enosu.

English: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Enoshi, Sethi aliishi miaka 807, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Enosu, Seti akamenya naende emiaka ende amagana atano na atato, na etano na ebere (807), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Sethi aliishi jumla ya miaka 912, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Seti nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi na ebere (912), erio agakwa.

English: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
Kiswahili: Enoshi alipokuwa ameishi miaka tisini, akamzaa Kenani.
Ekegusii: Ekero Enosu amenyire emiaka emerongo kianda (90), akaba ise Kainani.

English: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Kenani, Enoshi aliishi miaka 815, naye alikuwa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Kainani, Enosu nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na etano (815), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Enoshi aliishi jumla ya miaka 905, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Enosu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na etano (905), erio agakwa.

English: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
Kiswahili: Kenani alipokuwa ameishi miaka sabini, akamzaa Mahalaleli.
Ekegusii: Ekero Kainani konya emenyire emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, (70), akaibora Mahalaleli.

English: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Mahalaleli, Kenani aliishi miaka 840, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Mahalaleli, Kainani nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo ene (840), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Kenani aliishi jumla ya miaka 910, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Kainani nigo amenyete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi (910), erio agakwa.

English: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
Kiswahili: Mahalaleli alipokuwa ameishi miaka sitini na mitano, akamzaa Yaredi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Mahalaleli emenyire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano (65), akaibora Yaredi.

English: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Yaredi, Mahalaleli aliishi miaka 830, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Yaredi, Mahalaleli nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo etato (830), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Mahalaleli aliishi jumla ya miaka 895, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Mahalaleli nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo kianda, na etano (895), erio agakwa.

English: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
Kiswahili: Yaredi alipokuwa ameishi miaka 162, akamzaa Enoki.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yaredi amenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano nomo, na ebere (162), akaibora Enoku.

English: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Enoki, Yaredi aliishi miaka 800, naye akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Enoku, Yaredi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato (800), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Yaredi aliishi jumla ya miaka 962, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Yaredi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na ebere (962), erio agakwa.

English: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
Kiswahili: Enoki alipokuwa ameishi miaka sitini na mitano, akamzaa Methusela.
Ekegusii: Ekero Enoku amenyire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano (65), akaibora Metusela.

English: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Methusela, Enoki alitembea na Mungu miaka 300, na akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Metusela, Enoku akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae ase emiaka amagana atato (300), erio akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
Kiswahili: Enoki aliishi jumla ya miaka 365.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Enoku akamenya nemiaka amagana atato, na emerongo etano nomo, ne etano (365),

English: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
Kiswahili: Enoki akatembea na Mungu, kisha akatoweka, kwa sababu Mungu alimchukua.
Ekegusii: akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae. Erio tachikororekana naende, ekiagera Nyasae nigo amoirete.

English: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
Kiswahili: Methusela alipokuwa ameishi miaka 187, akamzaa Lameki.
Ekegusii: Ekero Metusela amenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na etato, na etano na ebere (187), akaibora Lameki.

English: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Lameki, Methusela aliishi miaka 782, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Lameki, Metusela nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na ebere, (782), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Methusela aliishi jumla ya miaka 969, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Metusela nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na kianda (969), erio agakwa.

English: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
Kiswahili: Lameki alipokuwa ameishi miaka 182, alimzaa mwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero Lameki amenyire emiaka rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato, na ebere (182), akaba ise omwana omomura,

English: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”
Kiswahili: Akamwita jina lake Noa, akasema, “Yeye ndiye atakayetufariji katika kazi na maumivu makali ya mikono yetu yaliyosababishwa na ardhi iliyolaaniwa na Bwana.”
Ekegusii: akamoroka Nuhu agateeba: “Oyo nere oratoremie intwe ase emeremo yaito, na obokong’u bwaito, ase riroba eri Omonene aragereretie.”

English: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Noa kuzaliwa, Lameki aliishi miaka 595, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Nuhu, Lameki akamenya emiaka amagana atano, na emerongo kianda, na etano (595), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
Kiswahili: Lameki aliishi jumla ya miaka 777, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Lameki akamenya emiaka amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na etano na ebere (777), erio agakwa.

English: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Noa kuishi miaka 500, aliwazaa Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Nuhu amenyire emiaka amagana atano (500), akaba ise bw’abana abamura, nabwo Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.

English: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,
Kiswahili: Watu walipoanza kuongezeka idadi katika uso wa dunia na watoto wa kike wakazaliwa kwao,
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto bakagenderera komentekana ase ense, na abana abaiseke bakaiborwa agwo ase baare.

English: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
Kiswahili: wana wa Mungu wakawaona kuwa hao binti za wanadamu walikuwa wazuri wa sura, wakaoa yeyote miongoni mwao waliyemchagua.
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Nyasae bakarora abaiseke ba Mwanyabaanto ng’a nigo baare nebieni ebiya, bakanyuoma ase ogwechorera abakungu korwa ase abaiseke baria koreng’ana buna baabagogetie.

English: Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akasema, “Roho yangu haitashindana na mwanadamu milele, kwa kuwa yeye ni wa kufa, siku zake zitakuwa miaka 120.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba: “Omoika one tokonyara komenya ime ase Mwanyabaanto kare na kare, ekiagera ere nomobere ogokwa. Ase ayio emiaka yaye nigo erabe rigana erimo na emerongo ebere yoka.”

English: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.
Kiswahili: Wanefili walikuwako duniani siku hizo, na baadaye, hao wana wa Mungu walipoingia kwa binti za wanadamu na kuzaa nao. Wanefili walikuwa mashujaa na watu waliojulikana wa zamani hizo.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio, na kogenderera, amamonto namenyete ase ense, ekero abana abamura ba Nyasae baare konyuoma abaiseke ba Mwanyabaanto na koibora abana. Abwo nabwo baarenge amamonto yogokumia, are gotogigwa agwo kare.

English: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.
Kiswahili: Bwana akaona jinsi uovu wa mwanadamu ulivyokuwa mkubwa duniani, na ya kuwa kila mwelekeo wa mawazo ya moyo wake wakati wote ulikuwa mbaya tu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akarora ng’a obobe bwa Mwanyabaanto bwabeire obonge ase ense, na kera okoroberia na okorengereria gwe chinkoro chiabo nokobe botambe.

English: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasikitika kwamba alimuumba mwanadamu duniani, moyo wa Mungu ukajaa masikitiko.
Ekegusii: Ase ayi’Omonene akairianyeka, ekiagera atongete Mwanyabaanto ase ense, agaichana ase omoyo oye.

English: Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akasema, “Nitamfutilia mbali mwanadamu niliyemuumba kutoka kwenye uso wa dunia, wanadamu na wanyama, pamoja na viumbe vitambaavyo na ndege wa angani. Kwa maana nasikitika kuwaumba.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba: “Ninsirie Mwanyabaanto abwo natongete mbarusie ase ense, gose tari Mwanyabaanto boka, korende ne ching’iti, na ebitongwa bikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro. Neitirie ekiagera natongete abanto abwo na ching’iti echio.”

English: But Noah found favor in Yahweh’s eyes.
Kiswahili: Lakini Noa akapata kibali machoni pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende Nuhu akanyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Noa. Noa alikuwa mtu wa haki, na mkamilifu miongoni mwa watu wa wakati wake, tena alitembea na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Nuhu. Ere nigo areenge omonyaboronge na omoikeranu ase ekiaare kiaye; ere akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae.

English: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Kiswahili: Noa alikuwa na wana watatu: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi.
Ekegusii: Ere nabwate abana abamura batato, nabwo Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.

English: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu dunia ilikuwa imejaa uharibifu na ukatili machoni pa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ense ekaba yasarekire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, egaichorwa nobotindi na okoregana kwegeitano.

English: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
Kiswahili: Mungu akaona jinsi dunia ilivyoharibika, kwa maana watu wote duniani walikuwa wameharibu njia zao.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akarora ng’a ense yatutukanire, ekiagera kera omonto obwatirie chinchera chi’obotutukanu ase ense.

English: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akamwambia Noa, “Nitawaangamiza watu wote, kwa kuwa dunia imejaa ukatili kwa sababu yao. Hakika mimi nitaangamiza watu pamoja na dunia.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateebia Nuhu: “Narorire ng’a ninsirie Mwanyabaanto, ekiagera baichoirie obotindi na oboregani ense, ase igo nimbasirie amo nense yonsi.

English: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo jitengenezee safina kubwa kwa mbao za mvinje, tengeneza vyumba ndani yake na uipake lami ndani na nje.
Ekegusii: Eroiserie obwato obonene bw’emete y’ebirobo; obonachane nechitoto ime ebinyomba, na oboome eramu ime na isiko.

English: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo utakavyoitengeneza: Safina iwe na urefu wa dhiraa 300, upana wake dhiraa hamsini na kimo chake dhiraa thelathini.
Ekegusii: Obwato obwo nigo oraboroisie iga: Obotambe bwaye nigo borabe obw’ebirengo bi’amaboko amagana atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.

English: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.
Kiswahili: Itengenezee paa na umalizie safina kwa kuacha nafasi ya dhiraa moja juu. Weka mlango ubavuni mwa safina, na uifanye ya ghorofa ya chini, ya kati na ya juu.
Ekegusii: Inse y’ekerama otige ribaga ri’okorenta oborabu ase obwato obwo, orikore obotambe gochia igoro obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, obeke egesieri rikere ensemo. Onachane obwato obwo ase amarongo atato.

English: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is on the earth will die.
Kiswahili: Nitaleta gharika ya maji juu ya nchi ili kuangamiza uhai wote chini ya mbingu, kila kiumbe chenye pumzi ya uhai ndani yake. Kila kitu juu ya nchi kitaangamia.
Ekegusii: Naki rora, nindete etoigo igoro y’ense, ninsirie Mwanyabaanto na binde bionsi bire moyo; kera egento kere moyo ase ense goika gekwe.

English: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mimi nitaweka Agano langu na wewe, nawe utaingia ndani ya Safina, wewe pamoja na mke wako, wanao na wake zao.
Ekegusii: Korende ninkore egeteebanio kiogotianania naye; aye nosoe ase obwato ime amo nabamura bao, na mokao, na baka bamura bao.

English: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.
Kiswahili: Utaingiza ndani ya Safina kila aina ya kiumbe hai wawili wawili, wa kiume na wa kike, ili kuwahifadhi hai pamoja na wewe.
Ekegusii: Na orente ching’iti ase obwato ime, na chinde chionsi chire moyo, korwa ase kera egesaku, ibere ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu, chibe moyo amo naye.

English: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.
Kiswahili: Wawili wa kila aina ya ndege, wa kila aina ya mnyama na wa kila aina ya kitambaacho ardhini watakuja kwako ili wahifadhiwe hai.
Ekegusii: Ase kera egesaku gie chinyoni, ne ching’iti chionsi, na echikwagura igoro ase ense, ochirente ibere ibere amo naye, erinde chibe moyo.

English: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”
Kiswahili: Utachukua kila aina ya chakula kitakacholiwa, na ukiweke akiba kama chakula kwa ajili yako na yao.”
Ekegusii: Oire endagera egochia koriegwa, oyegache erio eyio nebe endagera yaino na ey’echingi’ti ne chinyoni.”

English: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.
Kiswahili: Noa akafanya kila kitu kama vile Mungu alivyomwamuru.
Ekegusii: Nuhu nabo akorete igo; agakora ayio onsi koreng’ana buna Nyasae amochigeete.

English: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Noa, “Ingia katika safina wewe na jamaa yako yote, kwa sababu katika kizazi hiki nimeona ya kuwa wewe ni mwenye haki.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Nuhu: “Soa ase obwato ime amo nabaanto bao, ekiagera buna nakorigereirie, narorire ng’a ase ekegori eke naye bweka ore omonyaboronge ase obosio bwaane.

English: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.
Kiswahili: Uchukue wanyama saba walio safi wa kila aina, wa kiume na wa kike, na wanyama wawili wawili wa kila aina walio najisi wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Ekero ogosoa, oirane amo naye ching’iti chichenegete, isano na ibere isano na ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu; na ase kera eng’iti etachenegeti, ibere ibere, ensacha na enkuungu.

English: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
Kiswahili: Pia uchukue ndege saba walio safi wa kila aina, wa kiume na wa kike, ili kuhifadhi aina zao mbalimbali katika dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Naende oirane ne chinyoni chikoiruruka, isano na ibere isano na ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu. Okore ayio ase engencho y’okorenda kera egesaku erio kegenderere koba moyo ase ense.

English: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”
Kiswahili: Siku saba kuanzia sasa nitaleta mvua juu ya nchi kwa siku arobaini usiku na mchana, nami nitafutilia mbali kutoka uso wa nchi kila kiumbe hai nilichokiumba.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atano na abere nindete embura ase ense etwe amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, na kende gionsi nakorete kere moyo ase ense ningesirie kegima.”

English: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.
Kiswahili: Noa akafanya yote kama Bwana alivyomwamuru.
Ekegusii: Na Nuhu agakora ayio onsi buna Omonene amochiigete.

English: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.
Kiswahili: Noa alikuwa na miaka 600 gharika ilipokuja juu ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Nuhu konya okorire emiaka amagana atano na rimo (600) engaki eyio etoigo yachete ase ense.

English: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.
Kiswahili: Noa na mkewe na wanawe na wake zao wakaingia katika safina ili waepuke ile gharika.
Ekegusii: Nuhu agasoa ase obwato ime amo nabana baye abamura, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye, ase ogwetooria korwa ase etoigo eria.

English: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
Kiswahili: Jozi ya wanyama walio safi na walio najisi, ndege na viumbe vitambaavyo,
Ekegusii: Na ase ching’iti chichenegete, ne ching’iti chitachenegeti, ne chinyoni na ebitongwa bionsi ebikwagura igoro ase ense,

English: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
Kiswahili: wa kiume na wa kike, walikuja kwa Noa wakaingia katika safina kama Mungu alivyomwamuru Noa.
Ekegusii: chigasoa ase obwato amo na Nuhu ibere ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu, buna Nyasae achiigete Nuhu.

English: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku saba, maji ya gharika yakaja juu ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Erio magega y’amatuko atano na abere, etoigo egacha ase ense.

English: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kumi na saba ya mwezi wa pili mwaka wa 600 wa kuishi kwake Noa, siku hiyo ndipo chemchemi zote hata zilizo chini sana ya ardhi zilibubujika kwa nguvu, na malango ya mafuriko ya mbinguni yakafunguliwa.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria ekero konya Nuhu aikire emiaka amagana atano na rimo (600), ase rituko ria ikomi, na gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi o kabere, chinsoko chionsi chi’amaache chikabera ne chinguru korwa inse, na ebibao bia igoro bikaigoka,

English: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.
Kiswahili: Mvua ikanyesha juu ya nchi siku arobaini usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: na embura egatwa igoro ase ense, rioka rioka ase amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.

English: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo Noa, na mkewe, na wanawe Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi pamoja na wake zao wakaingia katika ile safina.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Nuhu agasoa ase obwato ime amo na Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti, bamura baye, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye batato.

English: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
Kiswahili: Nao walikuwa pamoja na kila mnyama wa mwituni kufuatana na aina yake, wanyama wote wafugwao kufuatana na aina zao, kila kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi kwa aina yake, na kila ndege kufuatana na aina yake, naam kila kiumbe chenye mabawa.
Ekegusii: Amo nabarabwo, chigasoa ching’iti chi’orosana echia kera egesaku, ne ching’iti chigotugwa echia kera egesaku, na echikwagura echia kera egesaku, na kera enyoni y’egesaku kende gionsi.

English: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.
Kiswahili: Viumbe vyote vyenye pumzi ya uhai ndani yake vikaja kwa Noa viwili viwili, vikaingia katika safina.
Ekegusii: Na chirochio chionsi echiare moyo chigasoa ibere ibere ase obwato amo na Nuhu.

English: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.
Kiswahili: Wanyama walioingia katika safina walikuwa wa kiume na wa kike, wa kila kiumbe chenye uhai kama Mungu alivyomwamuru Noa, ndipo Bwana akamfungia ndani.
Ekegusii: Ching’iti ne chinyoni chionsi chiasoete, chinsacha ne chinkuungu chire moyo chia kera egesaku, chigasoa buna Nyasae achiigete Nuhu, eri’Omonene akamosiekera egesieri.

English: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa siku arobaini mafuriko yaliendelea kujaa duniani na maji yalivyozidi kuongezeka, yaliinua safina juu sana kutoka kwenye uso wa nchi.
Ekegusii: Etoigo eria ekagenderera igoro y’ense ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, ekagera amaache akamentekana mono, erio agacheng’enenia obwato na koboimokereria igoro mono kegima korwa ase ense.

English: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.
Kiswahili: Maji yakajaa na kuongezeka sana juu ya nchi, na safina ikaelea juu ya uso wa maji.
Ekegusii: Amache aria akaba nechinguru, na akamenteka mono igoro y’ense, na obwato boria bogacheng’enena ase amaache ayio igoro.

English: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.
Kiswahili: Maji yakazidi kujaa juu ya nchi, yakaifunika milima yote mirefu chini ya mbingu yote.
Ekegusii: Amache ayio akagenderera komenteka mono na akaba nechinguru chinene, erio agoichora igoro ase ense goika ebitunwa bionsi ebitambe mono kegima, biareenge kera ase inse y’erioba, bikarimera amaache ime.

English: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
Kiswahili: Maji yakaendelea kujaa yakaifunika milima kwa kina cha zaidi ya dhiraa kumi na tano.
Ekegusii: Amache ayio akamenteka rioka rioka agoichora, agatiira goika ebirengo bi’amaboko ikomi na atano igoro y’ebitunwa bionsi.

English: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
Kiswahili: Kila kiumbe hai kitambaacho juu ya nchi kikaangamia: Ndege, wanyama wa kufugwa, wanyama pori, viumbe vyote juu ya nchi na wanadamu wote.
Ekegusii: Ne ching’iti chiria ne chinyoni chionsi echiare moyo, chiare gotaara ase ense, chigakwa; chinyoni, ne ching’iti chiatugire, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, na echikwagura, amo na Mwanyabaanto bonsi bagakwa.

English: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.
Kiswahili: Kila kiumbe juu ya nchi kavu chenye pumzi ya uhai kikafa.
Ekegusii: Ebitongire bionsi biare koeyanera chimioro na bire moyo, na bionsi ebiareenge ase ense enyomo bigakwa.

English: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.
Kiswahili: Kila kitu chenye uhai juu ya uso wa nchi kilifutiliwa mbali, watu, wanyama, viumbe vitambaavyo na ndege warukao angani wakafutiliwa mbali toka duniani. Waliobaki ni Noa peke yake na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye ndani ya safina.
Ekegusii: Nyasae agasiria ebinto bionsi biare moyo, ebiareenge igoro ase ense, Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti chigotaara na amoogoro, na echikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro; na bionsi bigasirigwa korwa ase ense engima; Korende Nuhu bweka agatoorigwa amo nabwo baareenge amo nere ase obwato ime.

English: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
Kiswahili: Maji yakaifunika dunia kwa siku 150.
Ekegusii: Amache ayio akagenderera koyaaba igoro ase ense, ase engaki y’amatuko rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150).

English: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamkumbuka Noa na wanyama wote wa porini na wa kufugwa waliokuwa naye ndani ya safina, akatuma upepo ukavuma katika dunia, nayo maji yakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoinyora Nuhu ne ching’iti chionsi, echi’orosana, na echiatugire, echiareenge amo nere ase obwato ime. Erio agwo Nyasae akagusia omwaga ase ense, na amaache aria agakea.

English: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
Kiswahili: Zile chemchemi zilizo chini sana ya ardhi pamoja na malango ya mafuriko ya mbinguni yakawa yamefungwa nayo mvua ikawa imekoma kunyesha kutoka angani.
Ekegusii: Chinsoko chia amaache chiare kobera korwa inse amo na ebibao bia igoro bigasiekwa, na embura yaare gotwa egasira,

English: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.
Kiswahili: Maji yakaendelea kupungua taratibu katika nchi. Kunako mwisho wa siku ya 150, maji yalikuwa yamepungua,
Ekegusii: na amaache akana gokeea ng’ora ng’ora korwa ase ense, na ekero amatuko rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150) aerete, amaache aria agakea.

English: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.
Kiswahili: katika siku ya kumi na saba ya mwezi wa saba, safina ikatua katika milima ya Ararati.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, rituko ria ikomi na gatano na kabere, ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, obwato bogeeterekerera igoro ase egetunwa egetambe ki’Ararati.

English: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.
Kiswahili: Maji yakaendelea kupungua hadi mwezi wa kumi, na siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi, vilele vya milima vikaonekana.
Ekegusii: Na amaache akagenderera gokea goika omotienyi o ikomi. Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi ebichuria bi’ebitunwa bikarorekana.

English: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku arobaini Noa akafungua dirisha alilokuwa amelifanya katika safina
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko emerongo ene kaerire Nuhu akaigora ekebao keria akorete ase obwato,

English: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.
Kiswahili: na akamtoa kunguru, akawa akiruka kwenda na kurudi mpaka maji yalipokwisha kukauka juu ya nchi.
Ekegusii: agatoma ekegonkoru, na kerokio gekairuruka gochia aaria na aaria goika amaache agakama korwa ase ense.

English: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,
Kiswahili: Kisha akamtoa hua ili aone kama maji yameondoka juu ya uso wa ardhi.
Ekegusii: Erio Nuhu agatoma riruma, egere arore gose amaache akamire korwa ase ense,

English: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.
Kiswahili: Lakini hua hakupata mahali pa kutua kwa kuwa maji yalienea juu ya uso wa dunia yote, kwa hiyo akarudi kwa Noa ndani ya safina. Noa akanyoosha mkono akamchukua yule hua akamrudisha ndani ya safina.
Ekegusii: korende riruma riria tirianyora aase rikogwa, ase igo rikairana ase obwato, ekiagera amaache nao areenge igoro y’ense engima. Ase igo, Nuhu akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabwata riruma riria akarisoyia obwato ime ase areenge.

English: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.
Kiswahili: Noa akangojea siku saba zaidi kisha akamtoa tena hua kutoka safina.
Ekegusii: Erio akaganya amatuko ande atano na abere, naende ase egeka giakabere, agatoma riruma riria korwa ase obwato.

English: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.
Kiswahili: Wakati hua aliporejea kwa Noa jioni, alikuwa amechukua katika mdomo wake jani bichi la mzeituni, lililochumwa wakati ule ule! Ndipo Noa akajua ya kuwa maji yameondoka juu ya uso wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Riruma riria rikairana chinsa chia mogoroba, ribogoretie rito ribese ri’omozeituni ase omonwa oye. Ase ayio Nuhu akamanya ng’a amaache akeanire korwa ase ense.

English: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.
Kiswahili: Akangojea siku saba zaidi na akamtuma tena hua, lakini wakati huu hua hakurudi tena kwa Noa.
Ekegusii: Naende akaganya amatuko ande atano na abere, agatoma riruma riria, korende rirorio tirichieti koirana asare naende.

English: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza ya mwaka 601, wa kuishi kwake Noa, maji yalikuwa yamekauka duniani. Kisha Noa akafungua mlango wa safina akaona ya kuwa uso wa ardhi ulikuwa umekauka.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’amagana atano na rimo, na oyomo (601), rituko rie ritangani ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, amaache agakama kegima korwa ase ense. Nuhu akarusia ekerama ki’obwato, akarigereria, akarora ng’a ense yakamokire.

English: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na saba ya mwezi wa pili dunia ilikuwa imekauka kabisa.
Ekegusii: Rituko ri’emerongo ebere, na gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi o kabere, ense ekaba yakamokire kegima.

English: God spoke to Noah, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akamwambia Noa,
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateebia Nuhu,

English: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.
Kiswahili: “Toka ndani ya safina, wewe na mkeo na wanao na wake zao.
Ekegusii: “Soka korwa ase obwato, aye na mokao, na abana bao abamura, na abakungu babo.

English: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”
Kiswahili: Utoe nje kila aina ya kiumbe hai aliye pamoja nawe: Ndege, wanyama na viumbe vyote vitambaavyo juu ya ardhi, ili wakazae, na kuongezeka na kuijaza tena dunia.”
Ekegusii: Osooke amo na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo naye: chinyoni, ne ching’iti chigotaara, na echikwagura igoro ase ense, erinde chibiare chimenteke, chiichore ase ense.”

English: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Noa akatoka nje pamoja na mkewe, wanawe na wake zao.
Ekegusii: Erio Nuhu agasoka amo na bamura baye, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye.

English: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.
Kiswahili: Wanyama wote na viumbe vyote vitambaavyo juu ya ardhi na ndege wote, kila kitu kiendacho juu ya nchi, aina moja baada ya nyingine vikatoka katika safina, kila aina ya kiumbe, kimoja baada ya kingine.
Ekegusii: Na kera eng’iti, na kera eyekwagura, na kera enyoni, na ebitongwa binde bionsi bigotaara ase ense bigasoka amo noroiboro rwabo, korwa ase obwato.

English: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
Kiswahili: Kisha Noa akamjengea Bwana madhabahu, akachukua baadhi ya wale wanyama na ndege wote walio safi, akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio Nuhu akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero, akarusia eyemo ase kera eng’iti, na ase kera enyoni echenegete, agachirua buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa igoro ase egesasiimero keria.

English: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasikia harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, naye akasema moyoni mwake, “Kamwe sitailaani tena ardhi kwa sababu ya mwanadamu, hata ingawa kila mwelekeo wa moyo wake ni mbaya tangu ujana. Kamwe sitaangamiza tena viumbe hai vyote kama nilivyofanya.
