Ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene aigwete rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera, agateeba ase omoyo oye ime: “Tinkoragereria ense naende nonya ng’ake ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, naki ebirengererio bie chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto nebibe korwa obwana bwabo; nonya nebitongwa bionsi bire moyo tingocha kobisiria naende buna nakorete.

English: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
Kiswahili: “Kwa muda dunia idumupo, wakati wa kupanda na wa kuvuna, wakati wa baridi na wa joto, wakati wa kiangazi na wa masika, usiku na mchana kamwe havitakoma.”
Ekegusii: Engaki ense egendererete kobao, nebe engaki y’ogosimeka na ey’okogesa, engaki y’obokendu na ey’omobaso omoororo, engaki y’etoigo na ey’egurugura, omobaso na obotuko, tichikoera nonya ng’ake.”

English: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akambariki Noa na wanawe, akiwaambia, “Zaeni mkaongezeke kwa idadi na mkaijaze tena dunia.
Ekegusii: Nyasae agasesenia Nuhu amo nabamura baye, akabateebia: “Moibore, momeneteke, moichore ase ense.

English: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.
Kiswahili: Wanyama wote wa duniani, ndege wote wa angani, kila kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi, na samaki wote wa baharini wamekabidhiwa mikononi mwenu, nao watawaogopa na kuwahofu.
Ekegusii: Ching’iti chionsi chire ase ense chibooboe na kobairoka inwe; chinyoni chia igoro, ne ching’iti chikwagura igoro ase ense, ne chinswe chionsi chi’enyancha; echio chionsi chiabekirwe ase amaboko aino.”

English: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
Kiswahili: Kila kitu chenye uhai kiendacho kitakuwa chakula chenu. Kama vile nilivyowapa mimea mbalimbali, sasa nawapa kila kitu.
Ekegusii: Kera egetongwa kere moyo na gekwagura inakebe endagera yaino; buna nabaete chinyeni na ebimeri binde bigokina, naboigo nabaeire nebio bionsi.

English: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.
Kiswahili: “Lakini kamwe msile nyama ambayo bado ina damu ya uhai wake, kwa maana damu ni uhai.
Ekegusii: Korende timoria chinyama chire nobomoyo, engencho yaye echire namanyinga ime yabo.

English: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.
Kiswahili: Hakika damu ya uhai wenu nitaidai. Nitaidai kutoka kwa kila mnyama. Kutoka kwa kila mwanadamu pia nitaidai kwa ajili ya uhai wa mtu mwenzake.
Ekegusii: Amaene, amanyinga y’obogima bwaino ninyaganie ’nyaakanwe; korwa ase kera eng’iti ninyaganie, na korwa ase kera omonto oyogoita oyomwabo ninyaganie ’nyaakanwe obogima bw’omonto oyio.

English: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote amwagaye damu ya mwanadamu, damu yake itamwagwa na mwanadamu, kwa kuwa katika mfano wa Mungu, Mungu alimuumba mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oraitere amanyinga a Mwanyabaanto, amanyinga y’omonto oyio neere naiterwe na Mwanyabaanto, ekiagera Nyasae nigo atongete Mwanyabaanto ase omobwekano oye ere omonyene.

English: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly on the earth, and multiply in it.”
Kiswahili: Kuhusu ninyi, zaeni mwongezeke kwa wingi, mzidi katika dunia na kuijaza.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae agateeba: “Na inwe moibore, momenteke, mosaraare, na mobe abange ime ase ense.”

English: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akamwambia Noa na wanawe pamoja naye:
Ekegusii: Erio naende Nyasae agateebia Nuhu amo nabamura baye,

English: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,
Kiswahili: “Sasa mimi ninaweka Agano langu nanyi, pamoja na uzao wenu baada yenu,
Ekegusii: “Rora, inche ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, amo na ororeeria rwaino roraiborwe korwa magega yaino;

English: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.
Kiswahili: pia na kila kiumbe hai kilichokuwa pamoja nanyi: Ndege, wanyama wa kufugwa na wanyama wote wa porini, wale wote waliotoka katika safina pamoja nanyi, kila kiumbe hai duniani.
Ekegusii: naende na kera egetongwa kere moyo kere amo nainwe, chinyoni chionsi ne ching’iti chigotugwa, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana echio chire amo nainwe, chionsi echiasokire korwa ase obwato ime.

English: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
Kiswahili: Ninaweka Agano nanyi: Kamwe uhai hautafutwa tena kwa gharika, kamwe haitakuwepo tena gharika ya kuangamiza dunia.”
Ekegusii: Ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, ng’a kende gionsi kere moyo tigekomerwa naende n’amaache y’etoigo, gose etoigo tegocha koba naende egosaria ense magega y’ayio.”

English: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Hii ni ishara ya Agano ninalofanya kati yangu na ninyi na kila kiumbe hai kilicho pamoja nanyi, Agano kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo:
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateeba: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nakorire egati yane nainwe, na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo nainwe, na ase ebiaare bigochiagocha.”

English: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
Kiswahili: Nimeweka upinde wangu wa mvua mawinguni, nao utakuwa ishara ya Agano nifanyalo kati yangu na dunia.
Ekegusii: Erio naende Nyasae agateeba: “Inche nabekire omokubinyongo one ase amare, noro nobe ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana oko egati yane na ense.

English: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
Kiswahili: Wakati wowote ninapotanda mawingu juu ya dunia na upinde wa mvua ukijitokeza mawinguni,
Ekegusii: Ekero nkwara amare igoro y’ense, na omokubinyongo nobe okororekana ase amare.

English: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
Kiswahili: nitakumbuka Agano langu kati yangu na ninyi na viumbe vyote vilivyo hai vya kila aina. Kamwe maji hayatakuwa tena gharika ya kuangamiza uhai wote.
Ekegusii: Erio nimbe nkoinyora okobwatana kwane, okwo nakorire egati yane nainwe, amo na kera egetongwa kere moyo. Amache takoba naende etoigo egoita ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo.

English: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”
Kiswahili: Wakati wowote upinde wa mvua unapotokea mawinguni, nitauona na kukumbuka Agano la milele kati ya Mungu na viumbe vyote vilivyo hai vya kila aina duniani.”
Ekegusii: Ekero omokubinyongo okoba ase amare, na inche nkoyorigereria, ning’inyore okobwatana kwane gwa kare na kare, okwo nakorire egati yane, buna inche Nyasae na kera egetongwa kere moyo ase ense.”

English: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mungu akamwambia Noa, “Hii ndiyo ishara ya Agano ambalo nimelifanya kati yangu na viumbe vyote vilivyo hai duniani.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae agateebia Nuhu: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana okwo nakorire egati yane na ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo ase ense.”

English: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Noa waliotoka ndani ya safina ni: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi. (Hamu ndiye alikuwa baba wa Kanaani.)
Ekegusii: Abana ba Nuhu abarwete ase obwato nabwo aba: Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. Hamu nere ise Kaanani.

English: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana watatu wa Noa, kutokana nao watu walienea katika dunia.
Ekegusii: Aba batato nabwo baareenge abana ba Nuhu, na korwa ase abwo Mwanyabaanto bakaranda ase ense engima.

English: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.
Kiswahili: Noa akawa mkulima, akawa mtu wa kwanza kupanda mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Nuhu akaba omoremi, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani gosimeka emesabibu, nero ekoroisigwa edivai.

English: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.
Kiswahili: Alipokunywa huo mvinyo wake akalewa na akalala uchi kwenye hema lake.
Ekegusii: Ere akanywa edivai; erio agatinda, akaraara ore getirianda ase eema yaye ime.

English: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
Kiswahili: Hamu, baba wa Kanaani, akauona uchi wa baba yake na kuwaeleza ndugu zake wawili waliokuwa nje.
Ekegusii: Hamu, ise Kaanani, akamorora ore getirianda, agateebia bamura bamwabo babere baareenge isiko amang’ana aya arooche.

English: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.
Kiswahili: Lakini Shemu na Yafethi wakachukua nguo wakaitanda mabegani mwao wote wawili, kisha wakaenda kinyumenyume, wakaufunika uchi wa baba yao. Nyuso zao zilielekea upande mwingine ili wasiuone uchi wa baba yao.
Ekegusii: Erio Shemu na Yafeti bakabogoria engobo, bakayebeeka amareko abo igoro, bakagenda kemagega‐magega, bakabisia ise obogetirianda bwaye. Amaiso abo nigo arigereretie aase bakorwa, na tibarora obogetirianda bwa ise.

English: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.
Kiswahili: Noa alipolevuka kutoka kwenye mvinyo wake na kujua lile ambalo mwanawe mdogo kuliko wote alilokuwa amemtendea,
Ekegusii: Ekero Nuhu atindokire korwa ase okonywa kwaye kw’edivai, akamanya eke omwana oye omoke amokoreire,

English: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”
Kiswahili: akasema, “Alaaniwe Kanaani! Atakuwa mtumwa wa chini sana kuliko watumwa wote kwa ndugu zake.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Kaanani aragererigwe; nigo arabe omosomba bw’abasomba ase abamwabo.”

English: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.
Kiswahili: Pia akasema, “Abarikiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Shemu! Kanaani na awe mtumwa wa Shemu.
Ekegusii: Naende agateeba, “Omonene, Nyasae o Shemu, nasesenigwe, na Kaanani abe omosomba oye.

English: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”
Kiswahili: Mungu na apanue mipaka ya Yafethi; Yafethi na aishi katika mahema ya Shemu, na Kanaani na awe mtumwa wake.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae amentere Yafeti obomenyo, tiga amenye ase chiema chia Shemu, na Kaanani abe omosomba oye.”

English: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.
Kiswahili: Baada ya gharika Noa aliishi miaka 350.
Ekegusii: Magega y’etoigo eria Nuhu akamenya naende emiaka amagana atato, na emerongo etano (350).

English: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
Kiswahili: Noa alikuwa na jumla ya miaka 950, ndipo akafa.
Ekegusii: Nuhu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano (950), erio agakwa.

English: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wazao wa Noa: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi, ambao walizaa wana baada ya gharika.
Ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeeria rw’abana ba Nuhu: Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. Na aba batato bakaibora abana abamura magega y’etoigo eria.

English: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yafethi walikuwa: Gomeri, Magogu, Madai, Yavani, Tubali, Mesheki na Tirasi.
Ekegusii: Abana ba Yafeti nabwo aba: Gomeri, na Magogu, na Madai, na Yavani, na Tubali, na Mesheki, na Tirasi.

English: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Gomeri walikuwa: Ashkenazi, Rifathi na Togarma.
Ekegusii: Na abana ba Gomeri nabwo aba: Asikenasi, na Rifati, na Togama.

English: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yavani walikuwa: Elisha, Tarshishi, Kitimu na Rodanimu.
Ekegusii: Na abana ba Yavani nabwo aba: Elisha, na Tarisisi, na Kitimu, na Rodani.

English: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
Kiswahili: (Kutokana na hawa mataifa ya Pwani yalienea katika nchi zao, kwa koo zao katika mataifa yao, kila moja kwa lugha yake.)
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo chisokoro chi’abaanto abwo bamenyete mbarabare ye nyancha na as’ebisinka. Barabwo nororeeria rwa Yebita abwo bamenyete kera oyomo ase egesaku kiaye, ne chingongo chiabo na kera oyomo ase omonwa oye areenge gokwana.

English: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hamu walikuwa: Kushi, Misraimu, Putu na Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Na abana ba Hamu nabwo aba: Kusi, na Misiri, na Putu, na Kaanani.

English: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kushi walikuwa: Seba, Havila, Sabta, Raama na Sabteka. Wana wa Raama walikuwa: Sheba na Dedani.
Ekegusii: Na abana ba Kusi nabwo aba: Seba, na Havila, na Sabuta, na Raama, na Sabiteka. Na abana ba Raama nabwo aba: Seba na Dedani.

English: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.
Kiswahili: Kushi akamzaa Nimrodi, ambaye alikua akawa mtu shujaa duniani.
Ekegusii: Kusi akaibora Nimurodi. Nimurodi akaba omonto bw’eritang’ani oyorenge nokobua ase ense.

English: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa mwindaji hodari mbele za Bwana. Ndiyo sababu watu husema, “Kama Nimrodi, hodari wa kuwinda mbele za Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ere nigo areenge omotwari omokong’u bwe ching’iti, ase obosio bw’ Omonene. Ase ayio, igo abanto banarete goteeba igoro y’omonto: “Igo anga buna Nimurodi, omotwari omokong’u bwe ching’iti, ase obosio bw’ Omonene.”

English: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
Kiswahili: Vituo vyake vya kwanza katika ufalme wake vilikuwa Babeli, Ereki, Akadi na Kalne katika Shinari.
Ekegusii: Omochakano bw’obogaambi bwaye nigo bware Babiloni, na Ereku, na Akadi, (na Kaline); eyio yonsi nigo yaare ase ense ya Sinari.

English: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
Kiswahili: Kutoka nchi ile alikwenda Ashuru, ambako alijenga Ninawi, Rehoboth-iri, Kala,
Ekegusii: Akarwa ase ense eria, akagenda goika Asuri, akaagacha Ninawi, na Rehoboti‐Iri, na Kala,

English: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
Kiswahili: na Reseni, iliyo kati ya Ninawi na Kala; huo ndio mji mkubwa.
Ekegusii: na Reseni, omochie omonene oyorenge egati ya Ninawi na Kala.

English: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
Kiswahili: Misraimu alikuwa baba wa: Waludi, Waanami, Walehabi, Wanaftuhi,
Ekegusii: Misiri neere esokoro ya Abaludi, na Abanami, na Abalehabi, na Abanafutu,

English: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
Kiswahili: Wapathrusi, Wakasluhi (hao ndio asili ya Wafilisti), na Wakaftori.
Ekegusii: na Abapaturusi, Abakasiluhi, (korwa ase bare nao Abafirisiti barwete), na Abakafitori.

English: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
Kiswahili: Kanaani alikuwa baba wa: Sidoni mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Hethi,
Ekegusii: Kaanani akaibora Sidoni, omwana oye omotangi, na Heti,

English: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
Kiswahili: Wayebusi, Waamori, Wagirgashi,
Ekegusii: na Abayebusi, na Abaamori, na Abagirigasi,

English: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
Kiswahili: Wahivi, Waariki, Wasini,
Ekegusii: na Abahivi, na Abaarikiti, na Abasini,

English: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
Kiswahili: Waarvadi, Wasemari na Wahamathi. Baadaye koo za Wakanaani zilitawanyika,
Ekegusii: na Abaarivadi, na Abaseremari, na Abahamati. Erio magega y’ayio eamate ya Kaanani egesiarera.

English: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
Kiswahili: na mipaka ya Kanaani ilienea kutoka Sidoni kuelekea Gerari hadi Gaza, kisha kuelekea Sodoma, Gomora, Adma na Seboimu, hadi kufikia Lasha.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rw’Abakaanani rogachaka korwa ase Sidoni, rokagenda enchera ya Gerari, rogaika Gasa, naende ase enchera ya Sodomu, na Gomora, na Adima, na Seboimu, rogaika Lasa.

English: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
Kiswahili: Hawa ni wana wa Hamu kwa koo zao na lugha zao, katika nchi zao na mataifa yao.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Hamu, buna bareenge ase chiamate chiabo, na emenwa yabo, ne chinse chiabo, na ebisaku biabo.

English: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
Kiswahili: Shemu ambaye ni ndugu mkubwa wa Yafethi, kwake kulizaliwa wana pia. Shemu alikuwa baba wa wana wote wa Eberi.
Ekegusii: Shemu, oyorenge sokoro y’abana b’Eberi, naende oyio neere orenge omomura omonene omwabo Yafeti, akaiborerwa abana.

English: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shemu walikuwa: Elamu, Ashuru, Arfaksadi, Ludi na Aramu.
Ekegusii: Abana ba Shemu nabwo aba: Elamu, na Asuri, na Arifakisadi, na Ludi, na Aramu.

English: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Aramu walikuwa: Usi, Huli, Getheri na Mesheki.
Ekegusii: Na abana ba Aramu nabwo aba: Usi, na Huli, na Geteri, na Masi.

English: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
Kiswahili: Arfaksadi alikuwa baba wa Shela, naye Shela akamzaa Eberi.
Ekegusii: Arifakisadi akaibora Sela, na Sela akaibora Eberi.

English: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
Kiswahili: Eberi akapata wana wawili: Mmoja wao aliitwa Pelegi, kwa kuwa wakati wake ndipo dunia iligawanyika; nduguye aliitwa Yoktani.
Ekegusii: Eberi akaibora abana babere abamura. Omomura omotangi nigo aare korokwa Pelegi, ekiagera ase amatuko aye nario ense yaatananegete, na oyomwabo nigo aare korokwa Yokitani.

English: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Kiswahili: Yoktani alikuwa baba wa: Almodadi, Shelefu, Hasarmawethi, Yera,
Ekegusii: Yokitani akaibora Alimodadi, na Selefu, na Hasarmaweti, na Yera,

English: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Kiswahili: Hadoramu, Uzali, Dikla,
Ekegusii: na Hadoramu, na Usali, na Dikila,

English: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
Kiswahili: Obali, Abimaeli, Sheba,
Ekegusii: na Obali, na Abimaeli, na Seba,

English: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
Kiswahili: Ofiri, Havila na Yobabu. Hawa wote walikuwa wana wa Yoktani.
Ekegusii: na Ofiri, na Havila, na Yobabu. Abwo bonsi nabwo abana ba Yokitani.

English: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
Kiswahili: Nchi waliyoishi ilienea toka Mesha kuelekea Sefari kwenye nchi ya vilima iliyoko mashariki.
Ekegusii: Ensemo eria bamenyete nigo yachakerete Mesa gochia Sefari, ase ebitunwa bia moocha.

English: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.
Kiswahili: Hao ndio wana wa Shemu kwa koo zao na lugha zao, katika nchi zao na mataifa yao.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Shemu, buna baareenge ase chiamate chiabo, na emenwa yabo, ne chinse chiabo, na ebisaku biabo.

English: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo koo za wana wa Noa, kufuatana na vizazi vyao, katika mataifa yao. Kutokana na hawa mataifa yalienea duniani kote baada ya gharika.
Ekegusii: Echio nachio chiamate chi’abana ba Nuhu, koreng’ana na ororeeria rwabo ase ebisaku biabo; na korwa ase bare ebisaku bigesiarera ase ense yonsi magega y’etoigo.

English: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo dunia yote ilikuwa na lugha moja na msemo mmoja.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ense engima nigo baarenge nomonwa oyomo na amang’ana abwekaine.

English: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
Kiswahili: Watu walipoelekea upande wa mashariki, wakafika kwenye tambarare katika nchi ya Shinari nao wakaishi huko.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaimoka kogenda orogendo gochia ensemo ya moocha, bakanyora ense omweya ase ense ya Shinari, bagachaaka komenya aroro.

English: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
Kiswahili: Wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Njooni, tufyatue matofali na tuyachome vizuri kwa moto.” Walitumia matofali badala ya mawe, na lami kwa ajili ya kushikamanishia hayo matofali.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania: “Inchuo, toroisie amatobori na toyasambe nomorero.” Igo bakanyora amatabori ribaga ri’amagena, na bakore esike gete ase okoyabwaterania.

English: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakasema, “Njooni, tujijengee mji wenye mnara ambao utafika hadi mbinguni, ili tujipatie jina tusije tukatawanyika usoni pa dunia yote.”
Ekegusii: Erio bagateeba: “Inchuo tweagachere omochie na omoorobiri, na obotambe bwaye boike erioba igoro, tweekorere erieta rinene, titobaisa gocha goserebanigwa ase ense yonsi.”

English: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akashuka ili auone mji na mnara ambao wanadamu waliokuwa wanaujenga.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agaika goocha inse, erinde arore omochie na omoorobiri oyio abana ba Mwanyabaanto konya baagachire.

English: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Ikiwa kama taifa moja wanaozungumza lugha moja wameanza kufanya hili, basi hakuna lolote watakalopanga kufanya ambalo halitawezekana kwao.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateeba: “Rora, abanto aba negesaku ekemo, na bagokwana omonwa oyomo bonsi na amang’ana abwekaine. Na bono rora, aya naro bachakire gokora, eyio ekworokia ng’a magega y’ayio tibagosinywa gento kende gionsi baraarengererie gokora.

English: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”
Kiswahili: Njooni, tushuke tuvuruge lugha yao ili wasielewane wao kwa wao.”
Ekegusii: Eta togende toike inse ase bare, tobatantanie ase omonbwa obo tibaigwana ase chinkwana chiao barabwo ase barabwo.”

English: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bwana akawatawanya kutoka mahali pale kwenda katika dunia yote, nao wakaacha kuujenga huo mji.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Omonene akabaserebania korwa agwo, bagesiarera ase ense yonsi, na abamenyeo. Erio bagatiga koagacha omochie oria.

English: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo maana pakaitwa Babeli, kwa sababu hapo ndipo Bwana alipoivuruga lugha ya dunia nzima. Kutoka hapo Bwana akawatawanya katika uso wa dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Aase ayio baare koagacha akarokwa Babiloni, ekiagera Omonene atantanetie omonwa bw’abaanto b’ense yonsi, na korwa agwo Omonene akabaserebania erio bagende ense yonsi, bayemenye.

English: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Shemu. Miaka miwili baada ya gharika, Shemu alipokuwa na miaka 100, akamzaa Arfaksadi.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Shemu. Ekero konya Shemu aikire emiaka rigana erimo (100), akaibora Arifakisadi; ekaba emiaka ebere magega y’etoigo eria.

English: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumzaa Arfaksadi, Shemu aliishi miaka 500, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Arifakisadi, Shemu naende akamenya emiaka amagana atano (500), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
Kiswahili: Wakati Arfaksadi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na mitano, akamzaa Shela.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Arifakisadi aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na etano (35) akaibora Sela.

English: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Arfaksadi kumzaa Shela, aliishi miaka 403, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Sela, Arifakisadi nigo kakoorete emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), akamanya akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.
Kiswahili: Shela alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Eberi.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Sela akoorire emiaka emerongo etato (30), akaibora Eberi.

English: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Shela baada ya kumzaa Eberi, aliishi miaka 403, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Eberi, Sela agaika emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), erio akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.
Kiswahili: Eberi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na minne, akamzaa Pelegi.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Eberi aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na ene (34), akaibora Pelegi.

English: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Eberi kumzaa Pelegi, aliishi miaka 430, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Pelegi, Eberi agakoora emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etato (430), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.
Kiswahili: Pelegi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Reu.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Pelegi aikire emiaka emerongo etato (30), akaibora Reu.

English: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Pelegi kumzaa Reu, aliishi miaka 209, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Reu, Pelegi gaikire emiaka amagana abere, na kianda (209), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.
Kiswahili: Reu alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na miwili, akamzaa Serugi.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Reu aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na ebere (32), akaibora Serugi,

English: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Reu kumzaa Serugi, aliishi miaka 207, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Serugi, Reu gaikire emiaka amagana abere, na etano na ebere (207), akaibora abana abamura na abaiseke.

English: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
Kiswahili: Serugi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Nahori.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Serugi aikire emiaka emerongo etato (30) akaibora Nahori.

English: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Serugi kumzaa Nahori, aliishi miaka 200, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Nahori, Serugi agaika emiaka amagana abere (200), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.
Kiswahili: Nahori alipokuwa na miaka ishirini na tisa, akamzaa Tera.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Nahori aikire emiaka emerongo ebere, na kianda (29), akaibora Tera.

English: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Nahori kumzaa Tera, aliishi miaka 119, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Tera, Nahori gaikire emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi na kianda (119), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
Kiswahili: Tera alipokuwa na miaka sabini, akamzaa Abramu, Nahori na Harani.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya Tera aikire emiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70), akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani.

English: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wazao wa Tera. Tera aliwazaa Abramu, Nahori na Harani. Harani akamzaa Loti.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Tera. Tera akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani. Harani akaibora Loti.

English: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.
Kiswahili: Tera alipokuwa bado hai, Harani akafa huko Uru ya Wakaldayo, nchi alimozaliwa.
Ekegusii: Harani agatanga gokwa, agatiga Tera ise ore moyo, ase ense eria aiboreretwe, ase Uru y’Abakalidayo.

English: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.
Kiswahili: Abramu na Nahori walioa. Mke wa Abramu aliitwa Sarai, na mke wa Nahori aliitwa Milka; Milka na Iska walikuwa watoto wa Harani.
Ekegusii: Aburamu na Nahori bakanyuoma abarugi. Moka Aburamu nigo areenge korokwa Sarai, na moka Nahori Milka, omwana omosubati o Harani; oyio nere orenge ise Milka na Isika.

English: Sarai was barren. She had no child.
Kiswahili: Sarai alikuwa tasa, hakuwa na watoto.
Ekegusii: Korende Sarai igo areenge omogomba, tabwate mwana.

English: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.
Kiswahili: Tera akamchukua Abramu mwanawe, Loti mwana wa Harani mwanawe, na Sarai mkwewe, mke wa Abramu mwanawe, wakatoka kwa pamoja katika Uru ya Wakaldayo kwenda nchi ya Kanaani. Lakini walipofika Harani, wakaishi huko.
Ekegusii: Tera akaira Aburamu omwana oye, na Loti omochokoro oye, omwana o Harani, amo na Sarai, moka momura oye Aburamu; bakagenda komo gochia Uru y’Abakalidayo, bakagenda goika ense ya Kaanani. Korende ekero baigete omochie o Harani, bakamenya aroro.

English: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
Kiswahili: Tera alikufa huko Harani akiwa na miaka 205.
Ekegusii: Tera agaika emiaka amagana abere, na etano (205); erio agakwera aaria Harani.

English: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
Kiswahili: Bwana akawa amemwambia Abramu, “Ondoka kutoka nchi yako, uache jamii yako na nyumba ya baba yako, uende hadi nchi nitakayokuonyesha.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Aburamu, akamoteebia: “Karwe ase ense eye yao, na ase eamate yao, na ase omochie o iso bwonsi, ogende goika ense ndakworokie.

English: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
Kiswahili: “Mimi nitakufanya taifa kubwa na nitakubariki, Nitalikuza jina lako, nawe utakuwa baraka.
Ekegusii: Ningokore obe egesaku ekenene, ningosesenie, ninkore erieta riao ribe rinene, na aye nobe omosesenigwa.

English: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
Kiswahili: Nitawabariki wale wanaokubariki, na yeyote akulaaniye nitamlaani; na kupitia kwako mataifa yote duniani yatabarikiwa.”
Ekegusii: “Nimbasesenie abwo baragosesenie, nere oyogochecheria erieta riao nimoragererie, na goetera asore aye nimbisesenie ebisaku bionsi bi’ense.”

English: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Abramu akaondoka kama Bwana alivyokuwa amemwambia; naye Loti akaondoka pamoja naye. Wakati Abramu alipoitwa aondoke Harani, alikuwa na miaka sabini na mitano.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akaimoka, akagenda buna Omonene amoteebetie, na Loti akagenda amo nere. Aburamu nigo areenge omomura bw’ekegori kiemiaka emerongo etano na ebere, na etano (75), ekero are kong’anya korwa Harani.

English: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Abramu akamchukua Sarai mkewe pamoja na Loti mwana wa ndugu yake, mali zote walizokuwa nazo pamoja na watu aliokuwa amewapata huko Harani, wakasafiri mpaka nchi ya Kanaani, wakafika huko.
Ekegusii: Aburamu akaira Sarai mokaye, na Loti, omwana omomura omwabo, na ebinto bionsi ebi babwate, ebio konya benyoreire abanyene, na abasomba babo bonsi babwate agwo Harani, bakaimoka, bakagenda ense ya Kaanani.

English: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.
Kiswahili: Abramu akasafiri katika nchi hiyo akafika huko Shekemu, mahali penye mti wa mwaloni ulioko More. Wakati huo Wakanaani walikuwa wanaishi katika nchi hiyo.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigeteo, Aburamu agaeta gati y’ense eria goika Shekemu, aase aachenu, aase omote okorokwa omwaloni orenge, agwo More. Ase engaki eyio Abakaanani nabwo bamenyete ase ense eyio.

English: Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to Yahweh, who had appeared to him.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamtokea Abramu, akamwambia, “Nitawapa uzao wako nchi hii.” Hivyo hapa akamjengea madhabahu Bwana aliyekuwa amemtokea.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoorokera Aburamu, akamoteebia: “Ning’ee ororeeria rwao ense eye ebe omwando obo.” Ase igo, Aburamu akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero agwo, Omonene oyo omoorokerete.

English: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to Yahweh and called on Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: Kutoka huko Abramu akasafiri kuelekea kwenye vilima mashariki ya Betheli, naye akapiga hema huko, Betheli ikiwa upande wa magharibi na Ai upande wa mashariki. Huko alimjengea Bwana madhabahu na akaliitia jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio akarwa agwo, akagenda goika ebitunwa bire ensemo ya moocha ya Beteli, agatenenia eema yaye aroro. Korwa aase agwo Beteli nigo orenge ensemo ya bosongo, na Ai ensemo ya moocha. Na agwo akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero, erio akarangeria erieta ri’Omonene.

English: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.
Kiswahili: Kisha Abramu akasafiri kuelekea upande wa Negebu.
Ekegusii: Na Aburamu akabwatia orogendo akagenderera bosio gochia ensemo ya Negebu.

English: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.
Kiswahili: Basi kulikuwako na njaa katika nchi, naye Abramu akashuka kwenda Misri kukaa huko kwa muda, kwa maana njaa ilikuwa kali.
Ekegusii: Bono enchara egasoa ase ense eria, na ase engencho enchara eria yareenge enene mono, ekagera Aburamu agatirimboka gochia Misiri achi kobeera aroro

English: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa karibu kuingia Misri, akamwambia Sarai mkewe, “Ninajua ya kwamba wewe ni mwanamke mzuri wa sura.
Ekegusii: Kobaikire aang’e gosoa Misiri, agateebia Sarai mokaye iga: “Nimanyete ng’a nigo ore omokungu omonyakieni ase okororekana;

English: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.
Kiswahili: Wakati Wamisri watakapokuona, watasema, ‘Huyu ni mke wake.’ Ndipo wataniua, lakini wewe watakuacha hai.
Ekegusii: aande gose Abamisiri, ekero barakorore, nigo barateebe: Oyo mokaye; erio bang’ite inche, korende aye bagotige moyo.

English: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”
Kiswahili: Sema wewe ni dada yangu, ili nitendewe mema kwa ajili yako, na maisha yangu yatahifadhiwa kwa sababu yako.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bagokoboria igo, obateebie ng’a aye mosubati ominto ore, erinde ebe buya ase ’nde, na ase engencho yao imbe moyo.”

English: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
Kiswahili: Abramu alipoingia Misri, Wamisri wakamwona Sarai kuwa ni mwanamke mzuri sana wa sura.
Ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu asoete Misiri, Abamisiri bakarora omokungu oyio ng’a nigo areenge omonyakieni mono.

English: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa Farao walipomwona, wakamsifia kwa Farao; ndipo Sarai akapelekwa kwa nyumba ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ekero abagaambi baaria abaarenge inse ya Farao bachia korora omokungu oria, bakamotogia mono ase obosio bwa Farao. Na omokungu oria akairwa komenya mwa Farao.

English: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya Sarai, Farao akamtendea Abramu mema, naye Abramu akapata kondoo, ngʼombe, punda, ngamia na watumishi wa kiume na wa kike.
Ekegusii: Farao agakorera Aburamu buya ase engencho ya Sarai, na Aburamu nigo anyorete ching’ondi, ne chieeri chi’okorema, ne chitigere, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke, ne chitigere chiaberi, ne chingamia.

English: Yahweh afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamwadhibu Farao na nyumba yake kwa maradhi ya kufisha kwa sababu ya kumchukua Sarai, mke wa Abramu.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akarenta amaakwa amanene ase Farao amo na abanto baye ase engencho ya Sarai, moka Aburamu.

English: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Farao akamwita Abramu, akamuuliza, “Umenifanyia nini? Kwa nini hukuniambia ni mke wako?
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Aburamu, akamobooria: “Inki eke gwankoreire iga, otaare gonteebia ng’a oyo Sarai mokao?

English: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini ulisema, ‘Yeye ni dada yangu,’ hata nikamchukua kuwa mke wangu? Sasa basi, mke wako huyu hapa. Mchukue uende zako!”
Ekegusii: Naki gwakorete iga, ogateeba ng’a oyo mosubati omino, erio ekagera na inche nkamoira akaba mokane? Bono mokao oyio moire, ogende nere.”

English: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.
Kiswahili: Kisha Farao akawapa watu wake amri kuhusu Abramu, wakamsindikiza pamoja na mke wake na kila alichokuwa nacho.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao agachiika abanto bakoobe Aburamu amo na mokaye na kende gionsi abwate.

English: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Abramu akakwea kutoka Misri kwenda Negebu, yeye na mkewe na kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, pia Loti akaenda pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Aburamu akarwa Misiri, akagenda gochia Negebu, ere amo na mokaye na ebi bionsi abwate, na Loti akageenda amo nere.

English: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Abramu alikuwa tajiri sana wa mifugo, fedha na dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Nabo Aburamu areenge omotenenku mono, nigo abwate etugo enyinge, ne chifeta, ne chitaabu.

English: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
Kiswahili: Kutoka Negebu, akapita mahali hadi mahali, hadi akafika Betheli, mahali hapo ambapo mwanzoni alipiga hema lake kati ya Betheli na Ai
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Negebu, akageenda agaika Beteli, agwo aase atenenetie eema yaye ritang’ani kegima, gati ya Beteli na Ai,

English: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: hapo ambapo alikuwa amejenga madhabahu ya kwanza. Huko Abramu akaliitia jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: agwo nao aase Aburamu aagachete egesasiimero kie ritang’ani kegima na korirangeria erieta ri’Omonene.

English: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.
Kiswahili: Basi Loti, ambaye alikuwa anafuatana na Abramu, alikuwa pia na makundi ya mbuzi, kondoo, ngʼombe na mahema.
Ekegusii: Na Loti, oyogendete amo n’Aburamu, nigo abwate ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chiema.

English: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.
Kiswahili: Lakini nchi haikuwatosha kukaa pamoja kwa ajili ya wingi wa mali zao.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, ense eria tiyabaisana banyare komenya amo bonsi babere, ekiagera chinibo chiabo nechinyinge chiarenge, goika tibanyara komenya amo.

English: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.
Kiswahili: Ukazuka ugomvi kati ya wachunga mifugo wa Abramu na wale wa Loti. Wakati huo, Wakanaani na Waperizi ndio waliokuwa wenyeji wa nchi hiyo.
Ekegusii: Agwo eriomana rigatuboka egati y’abarisia b’Aburamu, na abarisia ba Loti. Ase engaki eyio Abakaanani na Abaperisi nabwo bamenyete ase ense eria.

English: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Abramu akamwambia Loti, “Pasiwe na ugomvi wowote kati yangu na wewe, wala kati ya wachungaji wangu na wako, kwa kuwa sisi ni ndugu.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburamu agateebia Loti, “Tari buya twomane inche naye, gose abarisia baane na abao, ekiagera intwe nabaanto abamo tore.

English: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”
Kiswahili: Je, nchi yote haiko mbele yako? Tutengane. Kama ukielekea kushoto, nitakwenda kulia; kama ukielekea kulia, mimi nitakwenda kushoto.”
Ekegusii: Inee! Ense eye yonsi teri ase obosio bwao? Tigango twatananeke. Koragende ensemo ya bomosi, inche ningende eya borio; koragende ensemo ya borio, inche ningende eya bomosi.”

English: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Yahweh, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.
Kiswahili: Loti akatazama akaona lile bonde lote la Yordani kuwa lilikuwa na maji tele, kama bustani ya Bwana, kama nchi ya Misri, kuelekea Soari. (Hii ilikuwa kabla Bwana hajaharibu Sodoma na Gomora.)
Ekegusii: Loti akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro akarigereria, akarora ense omweya bw’erikura ria Yorodani, ng’a in’yarenge n’amaache amange kera aase, na igo orenge buna omogondo Omonene, na buna ense ya Misiri; gochia ensemo ya Soari. Nabo yarenge ritang’ani Omonene atarasaria Sodomu na Gomora.

English: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Loti akajichagulia bonde lote la Yordani, akaelekea upande wa mashariki. Watu hao wawili wakatengana:
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Loti agechorera bweka ense omweya yonsi ya Yorodani. Barabwo bagatananekana. Igo Loti akamanora kogenda gochia moocha.

English: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
Kiswahili: Abramu akaishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, wakati Loti aliishi miongoni mwa miji ya lile bonde na kupiga mahema yake karibu na Sodoma.
Ekegusii: Aburamu akamenya ase ense ya Kaanani, na Loti nere akamenya egati y’emechie agwo ase ense eria y’omweya, akang’anyia eema yaye gochia Sodomu.

English: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Basi watu wa Sodoma walikuwa waovu, wakifanya sana dhambi dhidi ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Sodomu nigo barenge ababe, barenge gokora ebibe ebinge ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Yahweh said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,
Kiswahili: Baada ya Loti kuondoka Bwana akamwambia Abramu, “Ukiwa hapo ulipo, inua macho yako utazame kaskazini na kusini, mashariki na magharibi.
Ekegusii: Magega Loti na Aburamu kobaatananekire, Omonene agateebia Aburamu: “Imokereria amaiso ao igoro, origererie korwa agwo aase ore, origererie ensemo ya sugusu, na Irianyi, na moocha, na bosongo;

English: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.
Kiswahili: Nchi yote unayoiona nitakupa wewe na uzao wako hata milele.
Ekegusii: naki ense eye yonsi orooche ninkoyee aye na ororeeria rwao goika kare na kare.

English: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.
Kiswahili: Nitaufanya uzao wako uwe mwingi kama mavumbi ya nchi, hivyo kama kuna yeyote awezaye kuhesabu mavumbi, basi uzao wako utahesabika.
Ekegusii: Ningokore aye n’ororeeria rwao robe buna orotu rw’ense rotanyare kobareka; onye omonto okonyara kobara orotu rw’ense, rirorio nanyare boigo kobara ororeeria rwao narororwo.

English: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”
Kiswahili: Ondoka, tembea katika marefu na mapana ya nchi, kwa maana ninakupa wewe.”
Ekegusii: Bono imoka, otaare ense eye, orore obotambe na oboagare bwaye, ekiagera ninkoe aye ense eyio.”

English: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Basi Abramu akaondoa mahema yake, akaenda kuishi karibu na mialoni ya Mamre huko Hebroni, huko akamjengea Bwana madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akang’anyia eema yaye, agacha akamenya ebitutu bw’emete ekorokwa emialoni agwo Mamure, ang’e na Heburoni. Akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero aroro.

English: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Amrafeli mfalme wa Shinari, Arioko mfalme wa Elasari, Kedorlaoma mfalme wa Elamu, na Tidali mfalme wa Goimu
Ekegusii: Ekaba ase amatuko ’Amurafeli, omorwoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omorwoti o Eleasari, na Kedorilaoma, omorwoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omorwoti o Goiimu,

English: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).
Kiswahili: kwa pamoja walikwenda kupigana vita dhidi ya Bera mfalme wa Sodoma, Birsha mfalme wa Gomora, Shinabu mfalme wa Adma, Shemeberi mfalme wa Seboimu, na mfalme wa Bela (yaani Soari).
Ekegusii: abarwoti aba bagakora esegi na Bera, omorwoti o Sodomu, na Birisa, omorwoti o Gomora, na Shinabu, omorwoti o Adima na Shemeberi, omorwoti o Seboimu, na omorwoti o Bela noro Soari.

English: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).
Kiswahili: Hawa wote waliotajwa mwishoni waliunganisha majeshi yao kutoka Bonde la Sidimu (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi).
Ekegusii: Abarwoti abwo bonsi bakabwatana, bagasangererekana ase ense omweya ya Sidimu, agwo nao Enyancha y’omonyo ere.

English: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wametawaliwa na Mfalme Kedorlaoma kwa miaka kumi na miwili, lakini mwaka wa kumi na tatu waliasi.
Ekegusii: Konya bamokoreire Kedorilaoma emeremo ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, korende omwaka o ikomi na gatato bakaenena, tibamokorera naende.

English: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
Kiswahili: Mnamo mwaka wa kumi na nne, Mfalme Kedorlaoma na wafalme waliojiunga naye walikwenda kupigana na kuwashinda Warefai katika Ashtaroth-Kanaimu, Wazuzi katika Hamu, Waemi katika Shawe-Kiriathaimu,
Ekegusii: Na omwaka o ikomi na kane Kedorilaoma na abarwoti baria babwataine nere bagacha, bakarwania na kobua Abarefai ase Asteroti‐Karinaimu, na Abasusi ase Hamu, na Abaemi ase Shawe‐Kiriataimu,

English: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
Kiswahili: na Wahori katika nchi ya kilima cha Seiri, hadi El-Parani karibu na jangwa.
Ekegusii: n’Abahori ase egetunwa Edomu goika Eli-Parani ore ang’e nerooro.

English: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakarudi wakaenda En-Misfati (yaani Kadeshi), wakashinda nchi yote ya Waamaleki, pamoja na Waamori waliokuwa wakiishi Hasason-Tamari.
Ekegusii: Erio bakairana goika bagaika Enimisifati, noro okorokwa Kadeshi, bagasaria ense yonsi y’Abaameleki, na eya Abaamori abwo bamenyete Hasasoni-Tamari.

English: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme wa Sodoma, mfalme wa Gomora, mfalme wa Adma, mfalme wa Seboimu, na mfalme wa Bela (yaani Soari) wakatoka kupanga majeshi yao kwenye Bonde la Sidimu
Ekegusii: Agwo omorwoti o Sodomu, na oyo o Gomora, na oyo bw’Adima, na oyo o Seboimu, na oyo o Bela, noro Soari, bakageenda, bakabwatarena korwana esegi ase ense omweya ya Sidimu,

English: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
Kiswahili: dhidi ya Kedorlaoma, mfalme wa Elamu, Tidali mfalme wa Goimu, Amrafeli mfalme wa Shinari, na Arioko mfalme wa Elasari, yaani wafalme wanne dhidi ya wafalme watano.
Ekegusii: barwane na Kedorilaoma, omorwoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omorwoti o Goimu, na Amurafeli, omorwoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omorwoti o Eliesari. Abarwoti abwo baane bakarwania baria batano.

English: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.
Kiswahili: Basi Bonde la Sidimu lilikuwa limejaa mashimo ya lami, nao wafalme wa Sodoma na wa Gomora walipokimbia, baadhi ya watu walitumbukia huko na wengine wakakimbilia vilimani.
Ekegusii: Na ense omweya ya Sidimu nigo yaichire amabwago y’esike gete, na abarwoti abwo ba Sodomu na Gomora ekero baarenge gotama, bakagwa ase amabwago ayio ime, na baria batigarete bagatama gochia ebitunwa igoro.

English: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.
Kiswahili: Wale wafalme wanne wakateka mali yote ya Sodoma na Gomora pamoja na vyakula vyao vyote, kisha wakaenda zao.
Ekegusii: Erio ababisa bagasakora chinibo chionsi chia Sodomu na Gomora, na endagera yabo yonsi bakaira chinsobo.

English: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
Kiswahili: Pia walimteka Loti mwana wa ndugu yake Abramu pamoja na mali zake, kwa kuwa alikuwa akiishi Sodoma.
Ekegusii: Naboigo bagoosa Loti, omwana omomura omwabo Aburamu, oyomenyete agwo Sodomu, bakamoira amo nenibo yaye.

English: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja aliyekuwa ametoroka akaja kumpa Abramu Mwebrania taarifa. Wakati huu Abramu alikuwa anaishi karibu na mialoni ya Mamre Mwamori, aliyekuwa ndugu yake Eshkoli na Aneri, ambao wote walikuwa wameungana na Abramu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo, oyotamete korwa ase abooswa, akagenda agateebia Aburamu Omoiberania, oyomenyete ase akaanani k’emete enga buna Emealuni ka Mamure, oria Omoamori, momura omwabo Esikoli na Aneri. Abwo konya bakorire okobwatana na Aburamu.

English: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.
Kiswahili: Abramu alipopata habari kwamba jamaa yake amechukuliwa mateka, akawaita watu 318 wa nyumbani mwake waliokuwa wamefunzwa kupigana vita, wakawafuatilia hadi Dani.
Ekegusii: Aburamu agachia koigwa ng’a oyomwabo osakoirwe na gwoswa, agatoma abamura baye abakong’u, abaiboire bwoye, abamanyire korwana esegi, babwatie ababisa goika Dani. Abarwani aba nigo baarenge amagana atato, na ikomi na batano na batato.

English: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa usiku Abramu aliwagawa watu wake katika vikosi ili awashambulie, na akawafuatilia, akawafukuza hadi Hoba, kaskazini ya Dameski.
Ekegusii: Bwachia koba botuko, Aburamu agaatanana abanto baye, erinde barwanie ababisa babo, akababua akabaseria goika Hoba, sugusu ya Damesiki.

English: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.
Kiswahili: Akarudisha mali zote, na akamrudisha Loti jamaa yake na mali zake, pamoja na wanawake na watu wengine.
Ekegusii: Erio akairania enibo yonsi, na akairania boigo Loti omwabo amo nenibo yaye, na abakungu, na abanto bande abasakoretwe.

English: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
Kiswahili: Abramu aliporudi baada ya kumshinda Mfalme Kedorlaoma na wale wafalme waliojiunga naye, mfalme wa Sodoma akatoka kwenda kumlaki katika Bonde la Shawe (yaani Bonde la Mfalme).
Ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu are koirana korwa ogoita Kedorilaoma amo n’abarwoti baria baarenge amo nere, omorwoti o Sodomu agasooka akamoorototera Aburamu ase ense omweya ya Shawe, eyio n’Ense omweya y’Omorwoti.

English: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Melkizedeki mfalme wa Salemu alipoleta mkate na divai. Alikuwa kuhani wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana.
Ekegusii: Erio Melkizedeki, omorwoti o Salemu, akareenta omogati na edivai; ere nigo areenge Omokuani o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono.

English: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.
Kiswahili: Naye akambariki Abramu, akisema, “Abarikiwe Abramu na Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, Muumba wa mbingu na nchi.
Ekegusii: Akamosesenia, akabora, “Aburamu asesenigwe na Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, oyotongete igoro na ense;

English: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.
Kiswahili: Abarikiwe Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, ambaye amewaweka adui zako mkononi mwako.” Ndipo Abramu akampa Melkizedeki sehemu ya kumi ya kila kitu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono atogigwe, oyo obekire ababisa bao inse y’amaboko ao!” Aburamu akamoa ensemo ya ikomi ya kera egento ekiabwate.

English: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Sodoma akamwambia Abramu, “Nipe hao watu na hizo mali uchukue wewe mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti o Sodomu agateebia Aburamu: “Ing’a abanto baane, korende enibo ero oire aye.”

English: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
Kiswahili: Lakini Abramu akamwambia mfalme wa Sodoma, “Nimeinua mkono wangu kwa Bwana, Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia, na nimeapa
Ekegusii: Korende Aburamu agateebia omorwoti o Sodomu: “Naimokirie okoboko kwane na gotiana ase Omonene Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, oyotongete igoro na ense,

English: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
Kiswahili: kwamba sitapokea kitu chochote kilicho chako, hata kama ni uzi au gidamu ya kiatu, ili kamwe usije ukasema, ‘Nimemtajirisha Abramu.’
Ekegusii: ng’a tinkoira nonya ng’ake eusi, gose enuga y’egekoroto kiao, gose kende gionsi kiao, obaise gocha goteeba: Ninche natenenkirie Aburamu.

English: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”
Kiswahili: Sitapokea chochote, ila kile tu watu wangu walichokula na sehemu ambayo ni fungu la watu waliokwenda pamoja nami, ambao ni Aneri, Eshkoli na Mamre. Wao na wapewe fungu lao.”
Ekegusii: Tinkoira gento kende gionsi otatiga endagera eyio abamura abwo bariete, na ensemo y’abwo bagendete amo nainche; tiga Aneri, na Esikoli, na Mamure, barabwo baire ebiabo.”

English: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya jambo hili, neno la Bwana likamjia Abramu katika maono: “Usiogope, Abramu. Mimi ni ngao yako, na thawabu yako kubwa sana.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’amang’ana ayio, naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigachiera Aburamu ase endooto, rigoteeba: “Aburamu, toiroka, Inche nenguba yao, na eng’eria yao nebe enene mono.”

English: Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Abramu akasema, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, utanipa nini na mimi sina hata mtoto na atakayerithi nyumba yangu ni huyu Eliezeri Mdameski?”
Ekegusii: Aburamu akamobooria: “Inee! Omonene, ninki gose orang’e, egekogera nigo nde aang’e gokwa ntari na mwana, na oyorache koira omwando one n’Eliezeri, oyo Omodamesiki?”

English: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”
Kiswahili: Abramu akasema, “Hukunipa watoto, hivyo mtumishi katika nyumba yangu ndiye atakuwa mrithi wangu.”
Ekegusii: Aburamu akabora naende: “Rora, tong’eti abana, na omosomba oyoiboirwe aa bwone, nere oraire omwando one!”

English: Behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana lilipomjia: “Mtu huyu hatakuwa mrithi wako, bali mwana atakayetoka katika viuno vyako mwenyewe ndiye atakayekuwa mrithi wako.”
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rikamochiera Aburamu naende, rigateeba: “Omonto oyio, tari ere oraire omwando oo, otatiga omwana oo bori, orarwe ase enda yao, nere oraire omwando oo.”

English: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”
Kiswahili: Akamtoa nje na kusema, “Tazama juu kuelekea mbinguni na uhesabu nyota, kama hakika utaweza kuzihesabu.” Ndipo akamwambia, “Hivyo ndivyo uzao wako utakavyokuwa.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamosokia isiko, akamoteebia: “Rigereria gochia igoro, na obare ching’enang’eni, gose nonyare gochinchera.” Erio akamoteebia: “Ororeeria rwao naboigo rorabe.”

English: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.
Kiswahili: Abramu akamwamini Bwana, naye kwake hili likahesabiwa kuwa haki.
Ekegusii: Aburamu nigo amwegenete Omonene, na ase engencho eyi’Omonene akagokigwa nere erio akamobara koba omonyene oboronge.

English: He said to Abram, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
Kiswahili: Pia akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Bwana, niliyekutoa toka Uru ya Wakaldayo nikupe nchi hii uimiliki.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Omonene, nakorusetie korwa ase Uru y’Abakalidayo, ninkoe ense eye ebe omwando oo bori.”

English: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Abramu akasema, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, nitawezaje kujua kwamba nitapata kuimiliki?”
Ekegusii: Aburamu akamobooria: “Inee! Aye Omonene, naki ndakore imanye ng’a nebe omwando one bori?”

English: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, “Niletee mtamba wa ngʼombe, mbuzi na kondoo dume, kila mmoja wa miaka mitatu, pamoja na hua na kinda la njiwa.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria: “Ndetera emori ritororo y’emiaka etato, na embori esubeni y’emiaka etato, na emingichi y’emiaka etato, ne riruma ne riige rie riruma.”

English: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
Kiswahili: Abramu akamletea hivi vyote, akampasua kila mnyama vipande viwili, akavipanga kila kimoja kuelekea mwenzake, lakini hata hivyo ndege, hakuwapasua vipande viwili.
Ekegusii: Akamorentera echio chionsi, agatandora kera eyemo chimbaara ibere, akabeeka kera orobaara rogachikana norwamwabo, korende chinyoni chirochio tachitandora.

English: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
Kiswahili: Kisha ndege walao nyama wakatua juu ya mizoga, lakini Abramu akawafukuza.
Ekegusii: Na ekero chinsoti chiachia kogwa ase amabego aria, Aburamu agachiseria.

English: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
Kiswahili: Wakati jua lilipokuwa linatua, Abramu akashikwa na usingizi mzito, giza nene na la kutisha likaja juu yake.
Ekegusii: Erioba ko riabeire ang’e kogwa, Aburamu akabwatwa ne chitoro chindito, na obwoba obonene mono bokamosoa.

English: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Ujue hakika kwamba wazao wako watakuwa wageni kwenye nchi ambayo si yao, nao watafanywa watumwa na kuteswa kwa miaka mia nne.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Aburamu: “Manya amaene kegima ng’a ororeeria rwao inarooche koba abamenyi ase ense etari eyabo, na barabwo inababe abasomba b’abaanto b’agwo, na abwo inababachaande mono ase engaki y’emiaka amagana ane.

English: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;
Kiswahili: Lakini nitaliadhibu taifa lile watakalolitumikia kama watumwa, na baadaye watatoka huko na mali nyingi.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku keria, barabakore babe abasomba babo, nimbagambie, na magega y’ayio nabarweo bare nenibo enyinge mono.

English: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
Kiswahili: Wewe, hata hivyo utakwenda kwa baba zako kwa amani na kuzikwa katika uzee mwema.
Ekegusii: Korende aye nogende ase chisokoro chiao ase omorembe. Igo oratindekwe ase obogotu obuya.

English: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
Kiswahili: Katika kizazi cha nne wazao wako watarudi hapa, kwa maana dhambi ya Waamori bado haijafikia kipimo kilichojaa.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagoika ase ekiaare gia kane inabairane gocha aa, ekiagera obobe bw’Abaamori tiboraikerana goika bono.”

English: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
Kiswahili: Wakati jua lilipokuwa limezama na giza limeingia, tanuru la moshi na mwali wa moto unaowaka vikatokea na kupita kati ya vile vipande vya nyama.
Ekegusii: Ekero erioba riagure, na omosunte osoire, eriko rigosokia erioki amo nekieri kere nomorero ekebemberi, bigaeta gati-gati ye chinyama chiria.

English: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo Bwana akafanya Agano na Abramu, na kumwambia, “Nitawapa wazao wako nchi hii, kuanzia Kijito cha Misri hadi mto ule mkubwa, Frati,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko eri’Omonene agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Aburamu, agateeba: “Ororeeria rwao naroire ense eye gochakera ase orooche orwo oronene rokorokwa Eufarati,

English: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
Kiswahili: yaani nchi ya Wakeni, Wakenizi, Wakadmoni,
Ekegusii: ase ense y’Abakeni, na Abakenisi, na Abakadimoni,

English: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
Kiswahili: Wahiti, Waperizi, Warefai,
Ekegusii: na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abarefai,

English: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
Kiswahili: Waamori, Wakanaani, Wagirgashi na Wayebusi.”
Ekegusii: na Abaamori, na Abakaanani, na Abagirigasi, na Abayebusi.”

English: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
Kiswahili: Basi Sarai, mkewe Abramu, alikuwa hajamzalia watoto. Lakini alikuwa na mtumishi wa kike Mmisri jina lake Hagari,
Ekegusii: Bono Sarai, moka Aburamu, tamoiborerete bana. Sarai nareenge nomoiseke omosomba Omomisiri, ore korokwa Hagari.

English: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
Kiswahili: hivyo Sarai akamwambia Abramu, “Bwana amenizuilia kupata watoto. Nenda, ukakutane kimwili na mtumishi wangu wa kike, huenda nitaweza kupata watoto kupitia kwake.” Abramu akakubaliana na lile Sarai alilosema.
Ekegusii: Sarai agateebia Aburamu: “Norooche bono ng’a Omonene ontangire tinyora abana, menyana nomoiseke oyo one omosomba; aande nabo ndanyore abana korwa asare.” Aburamu akaigwera ogokwana gwa Sarai.

English: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
Kiswahili: Hivyo baada ya Abramu kuishi katika nchi ya Kanaani miaka kumi, Sarai akamchukua mtumishi wake wa kike wa Kimisri, Hagari na kumpa mumewe awe mke wake.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, magega Aburamu kamenyire ense ya Kaanani ase emiaka ikomi, Sarai akaimokia Hagari, omosomba oye Omomisiri, akamomoa Aburamu, omosacha oye, ng’a abe buna mokaye.

English: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
Kiswahili: Akakutana kimwili na Hagari, naye akapata mimba. Hagari alipojua kuwa ana mimba, alianza kumdharau Sarai.
Ekegusii: Erio bakamenyana na Hagari, na ere akaba morito. Ekero Hagari achia korora ng’a obeire morito, agachaaka gochaaya Sarai moibori omwabo.

English: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May Yahweh judge between me and you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sarai akamwambia Abramu, “Unawajibika na manyanyaso ninayoyapata. Nilimweka mtumishi wangu mikononi mwako, sasa kwa vile anajua kwamba ana mimba, ananidharau mimi. Bwana na aamue kati yako na mimi.”
Ekegusii: Sarai agateebia Aburamu: “Obobe obo bwanyorete, tiga naye bokonyore! Inakoa omoiseke one omosomba koboko kwao; ere, ekero achia korora ng’a obeire morito, onchayire. Tiga Omonene atwatanane inche naye!”

English: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
Kiswahili: Abramu akamwambia, “Mtumishi wako yuko mikononi mwako. Mtendee lolote unalofikiri ni bora zaidi.” Ndipo Sarai akamtesa Hagari, hivyo akamtoroka.
Ekegusii: Aburamu nere agateebia Sarai: “Rora, omosomba oo oyio nase amaboko ao are; moonchie buna oranche.” Erio Sarai akamochanda bobe, na ere agatama korwa asare.

English: Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana akamkuta Hagari karibu na chemchemi huko jangwani; ilikuwa chemchemi ile iliyokuwa kando ya barabara iendayo Shuri.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene akarora Hagari ase erooro ase ensoko y’amaache yareenge ase enchera ekogenda Suri.

English: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”
Kiswahili: Malaika akamwambia, “Hagari, mtumishi wa Sarai, umetokea wapi, na unakwenda wapi?” Akamjibu, “Ninamkimbia bibi yangu Sarai.”
Ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Aye omosomba o Sarai, ng’ai okorwa, naende ng’ai okogenda?” Akamoiraneria: “Nigo ngotama korwa ase moibori ominto Sarai.”

English: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana akamwambia, “Rudi kwa bibi yako ukajishushe chini yake.”
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia: “Irana gochia ase moibori omino, na bwekeyie asare.”

English: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
Kiswahili: Malaika akaendelea akasema, “Nitazidisha wazao wako, hivi kwamba watakuwa wengi mno wasiohesabika.”
Ekegusii: Naende omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia: “Nimentekanie ororeeria rwao, na omobaro obo tokonyara kobareka, ekiagera nigo barabe abange mono.”

English: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.
Kiswahili: Pia malaika wa Bwana akamwambia: “Wewe sasa una mimba nawe utamzaa mwana. Utamwita jina lake Ishmaeli, kwa sababu Bwana amesikia juu ya huzuni yako.
Ekegusii: Naende Omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia, “Rora, morito ore, noibore omwana omoisia; nomooroke Isumaeli, ekiagera Omonene oigure ekerero ki’emechando yao.

English: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”
Kiswahili: Atakuwa punda-mwitu katikati ya wanadamu, mkono wake utakuwa dhidi ya kila mtu na mkono wa kila mtu dhidi yake, naye ataishi kwa uhasama na ndugu zake wote.”
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arabe buna etigere y’orosana ase egati y’abanto, na okoboko kwaye nigo korabe igoro y’abanto bonsi, na amaboko ’abaanto bonsi nigo arabe igoro yaye; ere nigo aramenye bosio bw’abamwabo bonsi.”

English: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”
Kiswahili: Hagari akampa Bwana aliyezungumza naye jina hili: “Wewe ndiwe Mungu unionaye mimi,” kwa maana alisema, “Sasa nimemwona yeye anayeniona mimi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Hagari Akaroka Omonene oyo okwanete nere Eli‐Roi, engencho yaye “Aye naye Nyasae bw’okorora”; naki akebooria: “Inee! Amaene, narorire Nyasae, na ere ontiga inde moyo magega konamororire?”

English: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu kisima kile kikaitwa Beer-Lahai-Roi, ambacho bado kipo huko hata leo kati ya Kadeshi na Beredi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ensoko eria ekarokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi; ero nigo ere egati ya Kadeshi na Beredi.

English: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Hagari akamzalia Abramu mwana, naye Abramu akamwita huyo mwana Hagari aliyemzalia, Ishmaeli.
Ekegusii: Erio Hagari akaiborera Aburamu omwana omoisia; nere Akaroka omwana oria oye, Isumaeli.

English: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
Kiswahili: Abramu alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na sita wakati Hagari alipomzalia Ishmaeli.
Ekegusii: Aburamu konya obeire nemiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etano nomo (86), ekero Hagari amoiborerete Isumaeli.

English: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.
Kiswahili: Abramu alipokuwa na miaka tisini na tisa, Bwana akamtokea akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Mungu Mwenyezi; enenda mbele zangu na uishi kwa unyofu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu amenyire emiaka emerongo kianda, na kianda (99). Omonene akamoorokera, akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Nyasae Omobui; genderera ase obosio bwane, na obe omoikeranu.

English: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
Kiswahili: Nami nitafanya Agano langu kati yangu na wewe, nami nitakuzidisha sana sana.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati yane naye, ninkomentekanie mono.”

English: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
Kiswahili: Abramu akaanguka kifudifudi, naye Mungu akamwambia,
Ekegusii: Erio Aburamu agatugama inse akaumama, na Nyasae akamoteebia,

English: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
Kiswahili: “Kwa upande wangu, hili ndilo Agano langu na wewe: Wewe utakuwa baba wa mataifa mengi.
Ekegusii: “Rora, okobwatana kwane nabwatanire naye nakwo oko: Aye nobe sokoro bw’ebisaku ebinge.

English: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
Kiswahili: Jina lako hutaitwa tena Abramu, bali jina lako litakuwa Abrahamu, kwa maana nimekufanya wewe baba wa mataifa mengi.
Ekegusii: Bono erieta riao tirikoba naende Aburamu, korende nigo orarokwe Aburaamu, ekiagera nagokorire obe sokoro bw’ebisaku ebinge.

English: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
Kiswahili: Nitakufanya uwe na uzao mwingi sana, kwako yatatoka mataifa nao wafalme watatoka kwako.
Ekegusii: Ninkomente obe na ororeeria oronge mono, ninkore ebisaku ebinge birue asore, na abarwoti nabarue asore boigo.

English: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.
Kiswahili: Nitalithibitisha Agano langu kama Agano la milele kati yangu na wewe na wazao wako baada yako na vizazi vijavyo niwe Mungu wako na Mungu wa wazao wako.
Ekegusii: “Ning’ikeranie okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati yane naye, na ororeeria rwao korwa magega yao, kogenderera ekiaare ase ekiaare, kobe okobwatana gwa kare na kare; imbe Nyasae oo, na oyo bw’ororeeria rwao korwa magega yao.

English: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
Kiswahili: Nchi yote ya Kanaani, unakoishi sasa kama mgeni, nitakupa kuwa milki yako milele, na uzao wako, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninkoe aye, na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao, ense eye omenyete bono buna omomenyi, ense yonsi ya Kaanani, ebe eyaino kare na kare, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.”

English: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akamwambia Abrahamu, “Kwa upande wako, lazima ushike Agano langu, wewe na wazao wako kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae agateebia Aburaamu: “Aye goika obwate okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, aye na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao, ekiaare ase ekiaare.

English: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
Kiswahili: Hili ni Agano langu na wewe pamoja na wazao wako baada yako, Agano mtakalolishika: Kila mwanaume miongoni mwenu atatahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo okobwatana kwane, orabwate egati yane naye, na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao: Kera omosacha ore ase more arokigwe.

English: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.
Kiswahili: Mtafanyiwa tohara na hii itakuwa ni alama ya Agano kati yangu na ninyi.
Ekegusii: Goika mwarokigwe risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaino ki’obosacha, na ayio nabe ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana egati yane nainwe.

English: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.
Kiswahili: Kwa vizazi vijavyo, kila mwanaume miongoni mwenu mwenye siku nane ni lazima atahiriwe, pamoja na watakaozaliwa nyumbani mwako au walionunuliwa kwa fedha kutoka kwa mgeni, wale ambao sio watoto wako.
Ekegusii: Ekiaare ase ekiaare kera omwana omoisia ore ase egati yaino goika arokigwe ekero akoorire amatuko atano na atato, omobiare o inka amo nomogorwa chitaabu korwa ase abanto ba isiko, otari bw’ororeeria rwao.

English: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
Kiswahili: Awe amezaliwa nyumbani mwako au amenunuliwa kwa fedha yako, ni lazima watahiriwe. Agano langu katika mwili wako litakuwa ni Agano la milele.
Ekegusii: Omobiare o inka na omogorwa chitaabu, bonsi goika barokigwe. Ase igo, ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana kwane inakebe ase emebere yaino goika kare na kare.

English: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume asiyetahiriwa, ambaye hajapata tohara ya mwilini, atatengwa na watu wake, amelivunja Agano langu.”
Ekegusii: Omosacha onde bwensi otarokirie risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto bamwabo, aserigwe gochia isiko, ekiagera osaririe okobwatana kwane.”

English: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.
Kiswahili: Pia Bwana akamwambia Abrahamu, “Kwa upande wa Sarai mkeo, hutamwita tena Sarai bali jina lake litakuwa Sara.
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateebia Aburaamu: “Sarai mokao, tobaisa komooroka naende Sarai, korende erieta riaye nigo rirabe Sara.

English: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
Kiswahili: Nitambariki na hakika nitakupatia mwana kwake. Nitambariki na kwamba atakuwa mama wa mataifa, wafalme wa mataifa watatoka kwake.”
Ekegusii: Nimosesenie, nkonyorere omwana omomura korwa asare, nimosesenie, abe ng’ina bw’ebisaku; na abarwoti b’abaanto inabaiborwe korwa asare.”

English: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akaanguka kifudifudi, akacheka na kusema moyoni mwake, “Je, mtu wa miaka mia moja aweza kuzaa mwana? Je, Sara atazaa mtoto katika umri wa miaka tisini?”
