Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agatugama inse, agaseka, akabora ase omoyo oye ime: “Inee! Omonto ore nemiaka rigana nanyare koibora omwana?” Sara nere oyo ore nemiaka emerongo kianda aibore omwana?

English: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akamwambia Mungu, “Laiti Ishmaeli naye angeshiriki baraka yako!”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu agateebia Nyasae: “Koranche, Isumaeli abe moyo ase obosio bwao!”

English: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akasema, “Ndiyo, lakini mkeo Sara atakuzalia wewe mwana, nawe utamwita jina lake Isaki. Nitalithibitisha Agano langu naye kama Agano la milele kwa ajili yake na wazao wake baada yake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamokania, akamoteebia: “Taibo, Sara mokao nakoiborere omwana omomura, na aye nomooroke Isaka. Inche ning’ikeranie nere okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, kobe okobwatana gwa kare na kare ase ororeeria rwaye rorache korwa magega yaye.

English: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande wa Ishmaeli, nimekusikia: hakika nitambariki, nitamfanya awe na uzao mwingi na nitaongeza sana idadi yake. Atakuwa baba wa watawala kumi na wawili, nami nitamfanya awe taifa kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana igoro ya Isumaeli nakoigure, rora, nimosesenie nimomentekanie mono, naibore abagaambi ikomi na babere; ninkore egesaku ekenene kerwe asare.

English: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Agano langu nitalithibitisha kwa Isaki, ambaye Sara atakuzalia mwaka ujao majira kama haya.”
Ekegusii: Korende ning’ikeranie okobwatana kwane na Isaka, oyo Sara araibore ase engaki buna eye iga, ase omwaka ogocha.”

English: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
Kiswahili: Wakati alipomaliza kuzungumza na Abrahamu, Mungu akapanda juu akaondoka kwa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ekero akoorire gokwana na Aburaamu, akairana korwa asare, akagenda.

English: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.
Kiswahili: Siku ile ile, Abrahamu akamchukua Ishmaeli mwanawe na wote waliozaliwa nyumbani mwake pamoja na walionunuliwa kwa fedha zake, kila mwanaume wa nyumbani mwake, akawatahiri, kama Mungu alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akabwata Isumaeli omwana oye, na abasomba aba baiboire ase enka yaye, na abagorwa chitaabu, kera omonto omosacha ore ase abanto b’enka ya Aburaamu, akabarokia risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiabo ki’obosacha, ase rituko riria riria, buna Nyasae amotebetie.

English: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu alikuwa na umri wa miaka tisini na tisa alipotahiriwa,
Ekegusii: Aburaamu konya oikire nemiaka emerongo kianda, na kianda (99), ekero arogetigwe.

English: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
Kiswahili: naye Ishmaeli mwanawe alitahiriwa akiwa na umri wa miaka kumi na mitatu.
Ekegusii: Na Isumaeli, omwana oye, nigo konya aikire emiaka ikomi, na etato, ekero arogetigwe.

English: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu na Ishmaeli mwanawe walitahiriwa siku ile ile,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Aburaamu akarokigwa amo na omwana oye Isumaeli.

English: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume nyumbani mwa Abrahamu, pamoja na wote waliozaliwa nyumbani mwake au aliyenunuliwa kwa fedha kutoka kwa mgeni, alitahiriwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi baiboire ase enka yaye, na abagorwa chitaabu korwa ase abanto ba isiko, bakarokigwa amo nere.

English: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamtokea Abrahamu karibu na mialoni ya Mamre wakati alipokuwa ameketi kwenye ingilio la hema lake wakati wa adhuhuri.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaorokera Aburaamu ase emete enga buna Emealuni agwo Mamure, ekero Aburaamu aikaransete gesieri ki’eema yaye, engaki y’omobaso omoororo.

English: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akainua macho akaona watu watatu wamesimama karibu naye. Alipowaona, aliharakisha kutoka kwenye ingilio la hema lake kuwalaki na kuwasujudia hadi nchi.
Ekegusii: Agwo akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora abanto batato bateneine bosio bwaye. Ekero abarora, akaminyoka korwa gesieri ki’eema, agachia kobarotota, agatung’ama inse,

English: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Kama nimepata kibali machoni penu, ee bwana wangu, usimpite mtumishi wako.
Ekegusii: akabora: “Omonene one, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, tong’etaania inche, omosomba oo.

English: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
Kiswahili: Acha yaletwe maji kidogo, kisha ninyi nyote mnawe miguu yenu na mpumzike chini ya mti huu.
Ekegusii: Tiga morenterwe amaache make, mwesibie amagoro, na motimokere aa ase ekiriiri ki’omote oyo.

English: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”
Kiswahili: Niruhusuni niwapatie chakula kidogo mle, ili mpate nguvu mwendelee na safari yenu, kwa kuwa mmekuja kwa mtumishi wenu.” Nao wakamjibu, “Vema sana, fanya kama unavyosema.”
Ekegusii: Inche imbarentere endagera inke morie, erio monyore chinguru; erio momanye kogenderera gochia ase mware kogenda, naki aase aiga mwaeta mbwone, inche omosomba oino.” Bakamoteebia: “Gaki, kora buna gwateeba.”

English: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Abrahamu akaharakisha akaingia hemani kwa Sara, akamwambia, “Chukua vipimo vitatu vya unga laini haraka, ukande na uoke mikate.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Aburaamu akaayerera, agasoa eema ime agwo ase Sara arenge, akamoteebia: “Renta bwango obosie, ebirengo bitato, obokonye, oroisie emegati.”

English: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.
Kiswahili: Kisha Abrahamu akakimbia kwenda kwenye kundi, akachagua ndama mzuri, laini na akampa mtumishi, ambaye aliharakisha kumtayarisha.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaminyoka getii ase riicho riaye, akarenta emori engiya, enoru, enterere, akayea omosomba oye, akamoteebia: “Yeroisie bwango, orente.”

English: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaleta jibini, maziwa na nyama ya yule ndama iliyoandaliwa, akaviweka mbele ya wageni. Walipokuwa wakila, alisimama karibu nao chini ya mti.
Ekegusii: Akabogoria amaguta, na amabeere, ne chinyama chi’emori eria aroisetie, agaterekera abageni baria. Ere agatenena ase bare ensemo ase ekiriiri ki’omote, ekero baare koragera.

English: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Yuko wapi Sara mkeo?” Akasema, “Yuko huko, ndani ya hema.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobooria: “Ng’ai Sara mokao are?” Ere akabairaneria: “Neema ime are.”

English: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akasema, “Hakika nitakurudia tena majira kama haya mwakani na Sara mkeo atakuwa ana mwana.” Sara alikuwa akiwasikiliza kwenye ingilio la hema, lililokuwa nyuma yake.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Amaene, inche ning’irane asore omwaka ogocha engaki enga buna eye, na ninyore ng’a Sara mokao onyorire omwana omoisia.” Ko erio Sara nigo ategererete gesieri ki’eema yareenge magega y’Omonene.

English: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu na Sara walikuwa wazee tena waliosogea miaka, naye Sara alikuwa amekoma katika desturi ya wanawake.
Ekegusii: Bono Aburaamu na Sara konya bagotire mono, baetanirie emiaka y’obosae, na Sara konya oeteire emiaka y’okonyora abana.

English: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Sara akacheka kimoyomoyo alipokuwa akiwaza, “Baada ya mimi kuwa mkongwe hivi na bwana wangu amezeeka, je, nitaweza kufurahia jambo hili?”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Sara agaseka ase omoyo oye ime, ogoteeba: “Buna inde omogotu iga, na omosacha one nere ogotire, naki eranyarekane inyore omogooko oyio?”

English: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Abrahamu, “Kwa nini Sara amecheka na kusema, ‘Kweli nitazaa mtoto nami sasa ni mzee?’
Ekegusii: Omonene akabooria Aburaamu: “Ninki Sara agosekera, ogoteeba: Inche amaene ninyibore omwana buna nagotire iga?

English: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”
Kiswahili: Je, kuna jambo lolote gumu lisilowezekana kwa Bwana? Nitakurudia mwakani majira kama haya, naye Sara atakuwa na mwana.”
Ekegusii: Ing’ana ki rire rikong’u igo riramosinye Omonene? Engaki ndairane asore ase omwaka ogocha, engaki enga buna eye, ninyore ng’a Sara onyorire omwana omoisia.”

English: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”
Kiswahili: Sara akaogopa kwa kuwa alidanganya na kusema, “Mimi sikucheka.” Lakini Bwana akasema, “Ndiyo, ulicheka!”
Ekegusii: Sara agakana, agateeba: “Inche tinsegeti,” naki nigo noboete. Omonene akamoteebia: “Taibo; korende aye ngwaseka.”

English: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.
Kiswahili: Wakati watu hao waliposimama ili waondoke, walielekeza nyuso zao Sodoma, Abrahamu akawatoa kitambo kidogo ili awasindikize.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakaimoka korwa agwo, bakagenda, bakaba barigereretie gochia Sodomu, na Aburaamu akagenda amo nabarabwo, akabakooba.

English: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akasema, “Je, nimfiche Abrahamu jambo ninalokusudia kufanya?
Ekegusii: Omonene agateeba: “Inee! Imobise Aburaamu ring’ana ngochia gokora,

English: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?
Kiswahili: Hakika Abrahamu atakuwa taifa kubwa na lenye nguvu, kupitia kwake mataifa yote ya dunia yatabarikiwa.
Ekegusii: ekero ndoche ng’a ngochia are koba egesaku ekenene gie chinguru, na ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe goetera asare?

English: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nimemchagua yeye, ili awaongoze watoto wake na jamaa yake kufuata njia ya Bwana, kwa kuwa waadilifu na kutenda haki, ili Bwana atimize ahadi yake kwa Abrahamu.”
Ekegusii: Naki namochorire, ng’a ere arue ogochika gochia ase abana baye na bonsi abagotoka enka yaye, na baria abarache koiborwa korwa magega yaye, babwatie enchera y’Omonene, bakore oboronge na ekeene, erinde Omonene aikeranerie Aburaamu, onsi aya amorierete eira.”

English: Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana akasema, “Kilio dhidi ya Sodoma na Gomora ni kikubwa sana na dhambi yao inasikitisha sana,
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateeba: “Ekiagera ekerero gia Sodomu na Gomora nekenene, na ebibe biabo biamentekire mono,

English: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
Kiswahili: kwamba nitashuka nione kama waliyoyatenda ni mabaya kiasi cha kilio kilichonifikia. Kama sivyo, nitajua.”
Ekegusii: nigo ndaike gochia inse, indore onye bakorire amabe amange buna ekerero eke kiang’ikeire kegoteeba; onye taibo, nimanye ayio.”

English: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Basi wale watu wakageuka wakaenda kuelekea Sodoma, lakini Abrahamu akabaki amesimama mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto baria bakarwa agwo, bakagenda gochia Sodomu, korende Aburaamu agatigara oteneine agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akamsogelea akasema: “Je, utawaangamiza wenye haki na waovu?
Ekegusii: Aburaamu agasuka gochia ase Omonene, akamobooria: “Inee! Amaene, nigo orasirie abanyene oboronge amo nabakori amabe?

English: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?
Kiswahili: Je, ikiwa watakuwepo watu wenye haki hamsini katika mji huo, hivi kweli utauangamiza na wala hutauacha kwa ajili ya hao watu hamsini wenye haki waliomo ndani yake?
Ekegusii: Aande ase omochie oria abanyene oboronge emerongo etano mbakareo, nigo orayosirie, gose noyororere amaabera ase engencho y’abwo abanyene oboronge emerongo etano?

English: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”
Kiswahili: Hilo na liwe mbali nawe, kufanya jambo kama hilo, kuwaua wenye haki pamoja na waovu, kuwatendea wenye haki sawasawa na waovu. Iwe mbali nawe! Je, Mwamuzi wa dunia yote hatafanya lililo sawa?”
Ekegusii: Yaya gaki teeba boigo, ekeene, nosirie abanyene oboronge nabakori amabe amo? Omonyene oboronge tagokorerwa buna abakori amabe! Inee! Aye Omogambi omonene bw’ense engima notige gokora ayare y’oboronge!”

English: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Kama nikipata watu hamsini wenye haki katika mji wa Sodoma, nitausamehe huo mji wote kwa ajili yao.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Inse konyora abanyene oboronge emerongo etano ase omochie oria o Sodomu, rirorio nigo ndatige gosiria omochie aria ase engencho y’abwo, abaronge.”

English: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
Kiswahili: Kisha Abrahamu akasema tena: “Sasa kwa kuwa nimekuwa na ujasiri wa kuzungumza na Bwana, ingawa mimi si kitu bali ni mavumbi na majivu;
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akairaneria: “Rigereria, ningendererete gokwana n’Omonene, nonya inche inde orotu rw’amaroba, na eriibu bosa.

English: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”
Kiswahili: je, kama hesabu ya wenye haki imepungua watano katika hamsini, utauangamiza huo mji wote kwa ajili ya hao watano waliopungua?” Bwana akamwambia, “Kama nikiwakuta huko watu arobaini na watano, sitauangamiza.”
Ekegusii: Aande ase baria emerongo etano baise koba batano tibaiyo, abanyene oboronge, Inee, nosarie omochie ekiagera batano tibaiyo?” Nyasae akairaneria: “Tingosaria omochie, kondarore agwo emerongo ene, na batano.”

English: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akazungumza naye kwa mara nyingine, “Je, kama huko watapatikana watu arobaini tu?” Akamjibu, “Kwa ajili ya hao arobaini, sitauangamiza.”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akagenderera naende gokwana nere: “Aande baraisa kororekana rende emerongo ene?” Nyasae akairaneria: “Ase engencho y’abwo emerongo ene, tingosaria omochie.”

English: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo akasema, “Bwana na asikasirike, lakini niruhusu nizungumze. Je, kama huko watakuwepo thelathini tu?” Akajibu, “Sitapaangamiza ikiwa nitawakuta huko watu thelathini.”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: “Omonene, koranche, tobaisa kombea nainche, ningendererete gokwana naye. Aande barabaisa konyorekana rende emerongo etato?” Omonene akairaneria: “Tingosaria omochie oria, inse konyora mbare emerongo etato aroro.”

English: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akasema, “Sasa kwa kuwa nimekuwa na ujasiri sana kuzungumza na Bwana, je, kama wakipatikana huko watu ishirini tu?” Bwana akajibu, “Kwa ajili ya hao ishirini, sitauangamiza.”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: “Rora, ningendererete gokwana n’Omonene. Baise konyorekana rende emerongo ebere?” Omonene akairaneria: “Ase engencho y’abwo emerongo ebere, tingosaria omochie.”

English: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akasema, “Bwana na asikasirike, lakini niruhusu nizungumze tena mara moja tu. Itakuwaje kama watapatikana huko watu kumi tu?” Bwana akajibu, “Kwa ajili ya hao kumi, sitauangamiza.”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akamobooria naende: “Omonene, tobaisa kombea, bono ndimo rioka ngokoboria, barachia konyorekana rende ikomi boka?” Nyasae akairaneria: “Tingosaria omochie, inse konyora agwo ikomi boka.”

English: Yahweh went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
Kiswahili: Bwana alipomaliza kuzungumza na Abrahamu, akaondoka, naye Abrahamu akarudi nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoorete gokwana na Aburaamu, akagenda; na Aburaamu akairana bwoye.

English: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,
Kiswahili: Malaika wale wawili wakafika Sodoma wakati wa jioni, naye Loti alikuwa ameketi kwenye lango la mji. Wakati alipowaona, aliondoka kwenda kuwalaki na kuwasujudia hadi chini.
Ekegusii: Abamalaika baria babere bakagenda, bagaika Sodomu mogoroba, na Loti nigo areenge oikaransete geita gia Sodomu. Ekero Loti abarooche, akaimoka kobarotota, agatugama inse, akaumama,

English: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Bwana zangu, tafadhali karibuni kwenye nyumba ya mtumishi wenu. Mnaweza kunawa miguu na kulala hapa kisha asubuhi na mapema mwendelee na safari yenu.” Wakamjibu, “La hasha, tutalala hapa nje uwanjani.”
Ekegusii: akabora: “Abaanene baane, gobera gocha aa, mosoe mw’omosomba oino, monyore amaache mwesibie amagoro aino, moraare goika mambia bokie; erio moche moimoke mambia, mogende.” Barabwo bagakana, bagateeba: “Yaya, nigo tokoba aa inchera obotuko obo bwonsi.”

English: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
Kiswahili: Lakini akasisitiza kwa nguvu kwamba waingie pamoja naye nyumbani kwake. Akawaandalia chakula, mikate isiyotiwa chachu, nao wakala.
Ekegusii: Korende akabasorora mono, na barabwo bakagobera, erio bagasoa nyomba mwaye. Erio akabaroiseria endagera, na emegati etabekiri memera, na barabwo bakaria.

English: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
Kiswahili: Kabla hawajaenda kulala, watu wote kutoka kila sehemu ya mji wa Sodoma, vijana kwa wazee, waliizunguka nyumba.
Ekegusii: Ritang’ani batarachia korara, abanto bonsi b’omochie oria o Sodomu, abamura na abagaaka, bagacha bagaetanana enyomba,

English: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwita Loti wakisema, “Wako wapi wale watu ambao walikuja kwako jioni hii? Watoe nje kwetu ili tuweze kuwalawiti.”
Ekegusii: bakarangeria Loti, bakamobooria: “Abanto abwo bacha mwao bono botuko, ng’ai bare? Basokie isiko aa, tobakore abakungu.”

English: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.
Kiswahili: Loti akatoka nje kuonana nao, akaufunga mlango nyuma yake,
Ekegusii: Loti agasoka isiko ase abanto baria, agasieka egesieri korwa magega yaye,

English: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.
Kiswahili: akasema, “La hasha, rafiki zangu. Msifanye jambo hili ovu.
Ekegusii: akabateebia: “Baminto, nabasoroire, timokora obosooku buna obo.

English: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”
Kiswahili: Tazama, ninao binti wawili ambao kamwe hawajakutana kimwili na mwanaume. Acha niwatoe nje kwenu, nanyi mnaweza kuwafanyia lolote mnalotaka. Lakini msiwafanyie chochote watu hawa, kwa sababu wako kwenye ulinzi chini ya dari langu.”
Ekegusii: Rora, nimbwate abaiseke baane babere abekungi; tiga mbaabarentere, na mobakorere buna moranche, korende abanto aba iga timobakorera ing’ana rinde rionsi, ekiagera basoire nyomba mwane ime na nigo bare inse y’oborendi bwane.”

English: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Tuondokee mbali.” Wakaendelea kusema, “Huyu mtu alikuja hapa kama mgeni na sasa anataka kuwa mwamuzi wetu! Tutakutenda vibaya kuliko wao.” Waliendelea kumlazimisha Loti na kusonga mbele ili kuvunja mlango.
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoteebia: “Torwereo!” Naende bagateebania: “Omonto oyo nomomenyi are aa seito, na bono nigo arigetie gototeebereria! Bono nigo toragokorere bobe mono kobua buna nanga tware gokorera abanto abwo.” Erio bagatwoma‐twoma Loti mono, bakarigia kobuna egesieri.

English: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wale waliokuwa ndani wakanyoosha mkono wakamvuta Loti ndani ya nyumba na kufunga mlango.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto baria baarenge ime bakarambora amaboko abo, bakang’usa Loti gochia nyomba ime, na erio kegima bagasieka egesieri.

English: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakawapiga kwa upofu wale watu waliokuwa mlangoni mwa ile nyumba, vijana kwa wazee, hivyo hawakuweza kuupata mlango.
Ekegusii: Erio bagaukoria abanto baria baarenge korwa isiko, erinde bagasinywa konyora egesieri.

English: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:
Kiswahili: Wale watu wawili wakamwambia Loti, “Una mtu mwingine yeyote hapa, wakwe zako, wana au binti, ama yeyote mwingine aliye wako katika mji huu? Waondoe hapa,
Ekegusii: Erio abasacha baria babere bakabooria Loti: “Nore nonde omino aa? Nobwate abana bao banyuomete abaiseke bao, gose abamura na abaiseke bao, gose kobwate bande bamino ase omochie oyo, barusie korwa aase aa.

English: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”
Kiswahili: kwa sababu tunapaangamiza mahali hapa. Kilio kwa Bwana dhidi ya watu wa hapa ni kikubwa kiasi kwamba ametutuma kupaangamiza.”
Ekegusii: Naki intwe nigo twachire gosaria aase aa, ekiagera ekerero kiaye kiamentekire ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio Omonene ototoomire tosarie aase aa.”

English: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Loti alitoka ili kuzungumza na wakwe zake, waliokuwa wamewaposa binti zake. Akawaambia, “Fanyeni haraka kuondoka mahali hapa, kwa kuwa Bwana yu karibu kuangamiza mji huu!” Lakini wakwe zake walifikiri kwamba alikuwa akitania.
Ekegusii: Erio Loti agasooka, agateebia abamura aba konya bariereire abaiseke baye boko: “Imoka bwango, morue aase aa, ekiagera Omonene ngocha are gosaria omochie oyo,” Korende barabwo bagakaga ng’a negosori akobakorera.

English: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”
Kiswahili: Kunako mapambazuko, malaika wakamhimiza Loti, wakamwambia, “Fanya haraka! Mchukue mke wako na binti zako wawili walioko hapa, la sivyo utaangamizwa wakati mji utakapoadhibiwa.”
Ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, abamalaika baria bakaayereria Loti, bakamoteebia: “Imoka bwango, ira mokao na abaiseke bao babere abare aa amo naye, tobaisa gosirigwa ase egesusuro keria omochie oyo ogochia konyora.”

English: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.
Kiswahili: Alipositasita, wale watu wakamshika mkono wake na mikono ya mke wake na binti zake wawili na kuwaongoza salama nje ya mji, kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa na huruma kwao.
Ekegusii: Ekero abeete ogoteebana, abanto abwo bakamobwata okoboko, bakabwata na mokaye na abaiseke baye, ekiagera Omonene amororerete amaabera, akamosokia isiko y’omochie.

English: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”
Kiswahili: Mara walipokwisha kuwatoa nje, mmoja wao akawaambia, “Mkimbie kwa usalama wenu! Msitazame nyuma, wala msisimame popote katika nchi tambarare! Kimbilieni milimani, ama sivyo mtaangamizwa!”
Ekegusii: Ekero baabasookirie isiko, oyomo obo akabateebia: “Tama, motoorie obogima bwaino; timorigereria magega, gose timotenena aande onsi ase ense eraire. Motame gochia ase ebitunwa, timobaisa gosira.”

English: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.
Kiswahili: Lakini Loti akawajibu, “La hasha, bwana zangu, tafadhalini!
Ekegusii: Loti akabakania, akabateebia: “Taibo, Omonene one;

English: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
Kiswahili: Mtumishi wenu amepata kibali mbele ya macho yenu, nanyi mmeonyesha wema mkubwa kwangu kwa kuokoa maisha yangu. Lakini siwezi kukimbilia milimani, janga hili litanikumba, nami nitakufa.
Ekegusii: rora omosomba oo onyorire ogwancherwa ase amaiso ao, kwamentire amaabera ao ase ’nde ase ogotooria obogima bwane; korende inche tinkonyara gotama ng’ikeere ebitunwa; amabe abaise konyora, ang’ite.

English: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”
Kiswahili: Tazama, hapa kuna mji karibu wa kukimbilia, nao ni mdogo. Niruhusuni nikimbilie humo, ni mdogo sana, ama sivyo? Ndipo maisha yangu yatasalimika.”
Ekegusii: Rora omochie oyo ore ang’e aiga, omochie omoke, noro ndaike bwango. Tiga ntame gochia ase omochie oria, ore omoke iga, ntoorie obogima bwane.”

English: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Vema sana, nitalikubali hili ombi pia, sitauangamiza mji ulioutaja.
Ekegusii: Ere akamoteebia: “Rora, nagwancheire ase ring’ana erio boigo. Tingosaria omochie oyio gwateeba.

English: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
Kiswahili: Lakini ukimbilie huko haraka, kwa sababu sitaweza kufanya lolote mpaka ufike huko.” (Ndiyo maana mji huo ukaitwa Soari.)
Ekegusii: Ayerera, bwetoorie, ekiagera tingokora ing’ana rinde rionsi goika gwasoire omochie oria ime.” Ase ayio, omochie oyio okarokwa Soari.

English: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
Kiswahili: Wakati Loti alipofika Soari, jua lilikuwa limechomoza katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Erioba konya riaorokire ekero Loti asoete Soari.

English: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akanyesha moto wa kiberiti uliotoka mbinguni kwa Bwana juu ya Sodoma na Gomora.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaruta amagena ’omorero korwa igoro akonyititoka na omorero igoro ya Sodomu na Gomora,

English: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akaiteketeza miji ile na eneo lote la tambarare, pamoja na wote waliokuwa wanaishi katika miji, hata pia mimea yote katika nchi.
Ekegusii: agasamba emechie eyio, amo nense eyio yonsi eraire, na agasiria bonsi abamenyete imeo, na ebinto bionsi biare gokina ase ense eria.

English: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
Kiswahili: Lakini mke wa Loti akatazama nyuma, hivyo akawa nguzo ya chumvi.
Ekegusii: Korende moka Loti nigo areenge korwa magega, akarigereria magega, akaonchoka, akooma, akaba buna rigena ri’omonyoo.

English: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, Abrahamu akaamka na kurudi mahali pale aliposimama mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Mambia kobwakia, Aburaamu akagenda aase aria atenenete ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
Kiswahili: Akatazama upande wa Sodoma na Gomora, kuelekea nchi yote ya tambarare, akaona moshi mzito ukipanda kutoka kwenye nchi, kama moshi utokao kwenye tanuru.
Ekegusii: Ere akarigereria maate gochia ensemo ya Sodomu na Gomora, na ense yonsi eraire, na agwo akarora erioki rigotiira korwa inse, buna erioki rikorwa ase eriko rinene.

English: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu alipoiangamiza miji ya tambarare alimkumbuka Abrahamu, akamtoa Loti kutoka kwenye lile janga lililoharibu miji ile ambamo Loti alikuwa ameishi.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Nyasae asaretie emechie eyio y’ense eraire, akaba okoinyora Aburaamu, akarusia Loti ase ogosarigwa koria, ekero asambete emechie eyio ase Loti amenyete.

English: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.
Kiswahili: Loti na binti zake wawili waliondoka Soari na kufanya makao yao kule milimani, kwa maana aliogopa kukaa Soari. Yeye na binti zake wawili waliishi katika pango.
Ekegusii: Loti agatiira korwa Soari, agacha akamenya ase ebitunwa amo nabaiseke baye babere, ekiagera nigo oboete komenya Soari; akamenya ase rikuruma amo nabaiseke baye babere.

English: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man on the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.
Kiswahili: Siku moja binti mkubwa akamwambia yule mdogo, “Baba yetu ni mzee na hakuna mwanaume mahali hapa atakayekutana na sisi kimwili, kama ilivyo desturi ya mahali pote duniani.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke oye omotangi agateebia oyomwabo omoke: “Tata ogotire, gose monto onde tari ase ense oyorache gotonyuoma buna engencho y’ense yonsi ere.

English: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
Kiswahili: Tumnyweshe baba yetu mvinyo kisha tukutane naye kimwili ili tuhifadhi uzao wetu kupitia baba yetu.”
Ekegusii: Bono, tiga toe tata edivai anywe, atinde, toraare nere, erinde tomotenenerie egesaku kiaye, tigesira.”

English: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule walimnywesha baba yao mvinyo, alipolewa binti yake mkubwa akaingia na kukutana naye kimwili. Baba yao hakujua wakati binti yake alipoingia kulala naye wala alipotoka.
Ekegusii: Bakanyoinsia ise edivai ase obotuko boria; omoiseke oria omotangi agachia, akaraara nere, ise tamanya ekero araara, gose ekero aboka.

English: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata binti mkubwa akamwambia yule mdogo, “Usiku uliopita mimi nilikutana kimwili na baba yangu. Tumnyweshe divai tena, usiku huu nawe ukutane naye kimwili ili tuweze kuhifadhi uzao wetu kupitia baba yetu.”
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia omoiseke oria omotangi agateebia oria omoke omwabo: “Rora, obotuko bwa igoro nigo naraire na Tata; tomonyooinsie naende edivai ase obotuko obo, erio naye ochie, oraare nere, erinde tomotenenerie egesaku kiaye, tigesira.”

English: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakamnywesha baba yao mvinyo tena usiku ule, naye binti yake mdogo akaingia, akakutana naye kimwili. Kwa mara nyingine baba yao hakujua binti yake alipolala naye wala alipoondoka.
Ekegusii: Bakamonyoinsia naende edivai ase obotuko obwo. Omoiseke oria omoke akaimoka, akaraara nere, ise tamanya ekero araara, gose ekero aboka.

English: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.
Kiswahili: Hivyo binti wawili wa Loti wakapata mimba kwa baba yao.
Ekegusii: Naboigo abaiseke abwo babere ba Loti bakorete iga, ekagera bakaba barito korwa ase ise.

English: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
Kiswahili: Binti mkubwa akamzaa mwana, akamwita jina lake Moabu; ndio baba wa Wamoabu hata leo.
Ekegusii: Ase igo omoiseke oria omotangi akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Moabu; oyio nere sokoro bw’Abamoabu goika reero iga.

English: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
Kiswahili: Binti mdogo naye pia akamzaa mwana, naye akamwita Benami; ndiye baba wa Waamoni hata leo.
Ekegusii: Na moiseke oria omwabo omoke, nere akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Ben‐Ami; oyio nere sokoro bw’Abaamoni goika reero iga.

English: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.
Kiswahili: Basi Abrahamu akaendelea mbele kutoka huko hadi nchi ya Negebu na akaishi kati ya Kadeshi na Shuri. Kwa muda mfupi alikaa Gerari kama mgeni,
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimoka korwa agwo mamure, akagenda gochia ensemo y’ense ya Negebu, akaroisia obomenyo bwaye, egati ya Kadeshi na Suri agwo Gerari.

English: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
Kiswahili: huko Abrahamu akasema kuhusu Sara mkewe, “Huyu ni dada yangu.” Kisha Abimeleki mfalme wa Gerari akatuma Sara aletwe, naye akamchukua.
Ekegusii: Ekero are agwo, Aburaamu agakwana igoro ya Sara mokaye ogoteeba: “Oyo mosubati ominto.” Abimeleki, omorwoti o Gerari agatoma abanto kwoyia Sara.

English: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu akamjia Abimeleki katika ndoto wakati wa usiku na kumwambia, “Wewe ni kama mfu kwa sababu ya huyu mwanamke uliyemchukua; yeye ni mke wa mtu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaorokera Abimeleki botuko ase okorota, akamoteebia: “Aye goika okwe, ekiagera omokungu oyo kwarentire nomokuungu bw’omonto onde.”

English: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Abimeleki alikuwa bado hajamsogelea, kwa hiyo akasema, “Je, Bwana utaliharibu taifa lisilo na hatia?
Ekegusii: Abimeleki konya ataraba nere, akabora: “Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo oraite nonya nabanyaboronge?

English: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”
Kiswahili: Hakusema kwangu, ‘Huyu ni dada yangu,’ naye Sara pia hakusema, ‘Huyu ni kaka yangu’? Nimefanya haya kwa dhamiri njema na mikono safi.”
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto oyio tantebeetie ere omonyene ng’a oyo mosubati omwabo? Na omokungu nere aganteebia ng’a oyo momura omwabo? Ase enkoro etari na komocha konde, na ase amaboko amarabu nakorire ayio.”

English: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia katika ndoto, “Ndiyo, najua ya kwamba umefanya haya kwa dhamiri safi, kwa hiyo nimekuzuia usinitende dhambi. Ndiyo sababu sikukuacha umguse.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akamoteebia ase okoroota: “Inche namanyire ng’a ase enkoro etari na komocha gwakorire aya, na inche nkagotanga tigwankorera ebibe. Ase ayio, tinakoa ribaga omokune.

English: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”
Kiswahili: Sasa umrudishe huyo mke wa mtu, kwa maana ni nabii, naye atakuombea nawe utaishi. Lakini kama hutamrudisha, ujue kwa hakika kuwa wewe na watu wako wote mtakufa.”
Ekegusii: Bono moiranerie omonto oria mokaye, ekiagera ere n’omobani, nagosabere onyare koba moyo. Korende otamoiranereti, manya amaene, goika okwe, aye amo na abanto bao bonsi ore nabarabwo.”

English: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema Abimeleki akawaita maafisa wake wote, na baada ya kuwaambia yote yaliyotokea, waliogopa sana.
Ekegusii: Abimeleki akaimoka mambia chuni akarangeria abasomba baye bonsi, akabateebia amang’ana aya onsi, na abanto abwo bakaondoka mono.

English: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”
Kiswahili: Kisha Abimeleki akamwita Abrahamu na kumwambia, “Wewe umetufanyia nini? Nimekukosea nini hata ukaleta hatia kubwa namna hii juu yangu na ufalme wangu? Umenifanyia mambo ambayo hayakupasa kufanyika.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarangeria Aburaamu, akamobooria: “Inki eke gwatokoreire iga? Inki nakomocheire goika kwarentire igoro yane na igoro y’oborwoti bwane ebibe ebinene buna ebi? Gwankoreire amang’ana atagwenereti gokorwa.”

English: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”
Kiswahili: Abimeleki akamuuliza Abrahamu, “Ulikuwa na kusudi gani kufanya hivi?”
Ekegusii: Naende Abimeleki akabooria Aburaamu: “Inki kwareengereretie goika ogakora ring’ana eri?”

English: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akajibu, “Niliwaza kwamba, ‘Hakika hakuna hofu ya Mungu mahali hapa, nao wataniua kwa sababu ya mke wangu.’
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Nabo nakorete igo, ekiagera narooche ng’a abamoirogete Nyasae tibari aase aa, na barabwo nigo barang’ite ase engencho ya mokane.

English: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hayo, ni kweli kwamba yeye ni dada yangu, binti wa baba yangu ingawa si mtoto wa mama yangu; basi akawa mke wangu.
Ekegusii: Ere amaene nomoiseke ominto, tata noyomo, korende ng’ina nomoao, na inche nkamonyuoma.

English: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”
Kiswahili: Wakati Bwana aliponifanya nisafiri mbali na nyumbani mwa baba yangu, nilimwambia, ‘Hivi ndivyo utakavyoonyesha pendo lako kwangu: Kila mahali tutakapokwenda, kuhusu mimi sema, “Huyu ni kaka yangu.” ’ ”
Ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae andusetie korwa ase omochie o tata kogenda gochia aaria na aaria ngateebia mokane: Obwo nabwo obwanchani orankorere: kera aase toragende oteebe igoro yane ng’a inche momura omino.”

English: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Abimeleki akatwaa kondoo na ngʼombe, na watumwa wa kiume na wa kike akampa Abrahamu, akamrudisha Sara kwa mumewe.
Ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akaimokia ching’ondi ne chiombe, amo nabasomba, abamura na abaiseke, akaa Aburaamu, akamoiraneria na Sara mokaye.

English: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”
Kiswahili: Abimeleki akasema, “Nchi yangu iko mbele yako, ishi popote unapotaka.”
Ekegusii: Abimeleki akamoteebia: “Rora, ense yane nigo ere ase obosio bwao; menya aande onsi ase oranche komenya.”

English: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”
Kiswahili: Akamwambia Sara, “Ninampa kaka yako shekeli elfu moja za fedha. Hii ni kufidia kosa lililofanyika dhidi yako mbele ya wote walio pamoja nawe; haki yako imethibitishwa kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Ere agateebia Sara: “Rora naeire momura omino chisekeli chi’echifeta elifu eyemo, chibe entorobi yao ase amaiso ’abaanto bonsi abare amo naye, erio omanyekane ng’a nomonto omooronge ore.”

English: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.
Kiswahili: Kisha Abrahamu akamwomba Mungu, naye Mungu akamponya Abimeleki, mke wake, na watumwa wake wa kike kwamba waweze kupata watoto tena,
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agasaba Nyasae; na Nyasae akagwenia Abimeleki amo na mokaye, na abasomba baye abakungu, na barabwo bakaibora abana.

English: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa ameyafunga matumbo ya wote katika nyumba ya Abimeleki kwa sababu ya Sara, mke wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Naki Omonene konya okorire abakungu b’enka y’Abimeleki koba abagomba, erio tibaibora, ase engencho ya Sara moka Aburaamu.

English: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Bwana akamrehemu Sara kama alivyokuwa amesema, naye Bwana akamtendea Sara kile alichokuwa ameahidi.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamotaarera Sara, akamokorera buna konya amoriereire eira.

English: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
Kiswahili: Sara akapata mimba, akamzalia Abrahamu mwana katika uzee wake, majira yale ya Mungu aliomwahidi.
Ekegusii: Erio Sara akaba morito, akaiborera Aburaamu omwana omoisia ase obogotu bwaye, ase engaki eria Nyasae amotebeetie.

English: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akamwita Isaki yule mwana ambaye Sara alimzalia.
Ekegusii: Omwana oyio Sara aiborete, Aburaamu ise akamoroka Isaka.

English: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
Kiswahili: Isaki alipokuwa na umri wa siku nane, Abrahamu akamtahiri, kama Mungu alivyomwamuru.
Ekegusii: Ekero Isaka akoorire amatuko atano na atato, Aburaamu akamwarokia, buna Nyasae konya amochikiire.

English: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu alikuwa na miaka 100 wakati Isaki mwanawe alipozaliwa.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu nigo areenge nemiaka rigana erimo ekero Isaka, omwana oye, aiboretwe.

English: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”
Kiswahili: Sara akasema, “Mungu ameniletea kicheko, kila mmoja atakayesikia jambo hili atacheka pamoja nami.”
Ekegusii: Sara akabora: “Nyasae onkoreire amaseko, na onde bwensi orayaigwe nansegisie.”

English: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
Kiswahili: Akaongeza kusema, “Nani angemwambia Abrahamu kuwa Sara angenyonyesha watoto? Tena nimemzalia mwana katika uzee wake.”
Ekegusii: Naende agateeba: “Ning’o nanga ore komoteebia Aburaamu ng’a Sara nagonkie abana? Na bono namoiboreire omwana ase obogotu bwaye.”

English: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
Kiswahili: Mtoto akakua, akaachishwa kunyonya. Siku hiyo Isaki alipoachishwa kunyonya, Abrahamu alifanya sherehe kubwa.
Ekegusii: Omwana oria agakina, agatiga okogonka. Ase rituko riria Isaka atigete kogonka, Aburaamu agakora omoyega omonene.

English: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
Kiswahili: Lakini Sara aliona kuwa mwana ambaye Hagari, Mmisri, aliyemzalia Abrahamu alikuwa anadhihaki,
Ekegusii: Korende Sara akarora omwana oria o Hagari Omomisiri, oyio aiborerete Aburaamu, ogochecheria Isaka, omwana oye.

English: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
Kiswahili: Sara akamwambia Abrahamu, “Mwondoe mwanamke huyo mtumwa pamoja na mwanawe, kwa kuwa mwana wa mwanamke mtumwa kamwe hatarithi pamoja na mwanangu Isaki.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio agateebia Aburaamu: “Moserie omokungu oyo omosomba amo nomwana oye, ekiagera omwana bw’omokuungu oyo omosomba takoria omwando amo nomwana one Isaka.”

English: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.
Kiswahili: Jambo hili lilimhuzunisha sana Abrahamu kwa sababu lilimhusu mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana erio tiriamogwenera Aburaamu nonya ng’ake, ase engencho y’omwana oye.

English: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu akamwambia, “Usihuzunike hivyo kwa sababu ya kijana na mtumishi wako wa kike. Sikiliza lolote Sara analokuambia, kwa sababu uzao wako utahesabiwa kupitia kwake Isaki.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agateebia Aburaamu: “Ring’ana eri tiriba riibe asore, ase engencho y’omwana oyo, na ase engencho y’omokuungu oyo, omosomba oo. Rinde rionsi Sara akogoteebia, riigwere, ekiagera korwa ase Isaka ororeeria rwao narwatorwe.

English: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”
Kiswahili: Nitamfanya huyu mwana wa mtumishi wako wa kike kuwa taifa pia, kwa sababu naye ni uzao wako.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo, omwana bw’omokuungu oyo omosomba nimokore abe egesaku ekenene, ekiagera nere oyio nomwana oo.”

English: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema, Abrahamu akachukua chakula na kiriba cha maji, akampa Hagari. Akaviweka mabegani mwa Hagari, akamwondoa pamoja na kijana. Hagari akashika njia, akatangatanga katika jangwa la Beer-Sheba.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimoka mambia chuni, akaimokia omogati na ebirandi biroiseirie amasankwa, bire n’amaache, akabiaa Hagari, akamobibekera mareko. Akamorentera na omwana, akamoteebia agende amo nere. Akagenda, akana‐koong’anya ase erooro ya Beeri‐Seba.

English: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.
Kiswahili: Maji yalipokwisha kwenye kiriba, akamwacha kijana chini ya mojawapo ya vichaka.
Ekegusii: Ekero amaache aria areenge ebirandi ime aerire, akaareria omwana inse y’egetutu.

English: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
Kiswahili: Kisha akajiendea zake akaketi karibu, umbali wa kutupa mshale, akawaza, “Siwezi kumwangalia kijana akifa.” Ikawa alipokuwa ameketi pale karibu, akaanza kulia kwa huzuni.
Ekegusii: Erio akagenda, agaikaransa are ake, ase oboare bw’okoruta ensara, ekiagera nigo atebeete: “Tinkonyara korigereria omwana one ekero ogokwa.” Ekero aikaransete omorigereretie, agaaka eriogi riaye, akareera.

English: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamsikia kijana akilia, malaika wa Mungu akamwita Hagari kutoka mbinguni na kumwambia, “Kuna nini Hagari? Usiogope, Mungu amesikia kijana analia akiwa amelala pale.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa okoreera kw’omwana, na omomalaika o Nyasae akarangeria Hagari korwa igoro, akamoteebia: “Hagari, inki okoreera? Tibwoboa, ekiagera Nyasae oigure okoreera kw’omwana agwo ase araire.

English: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”
Kiswahili: Mwinue kijana na umshike mkono, kwa maana nitamfanya kuwa taifa kubwa.”
Ekegusii: Tenena, oimokie omwana, omobwate koboko kwao; naki nimokore abe egesaku ekenene.”

English: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akamfumbua Hagari macho yake naye akaona kisima cha maji. Hivyo akaenda akajaza kiriba maji na kumpa kijana anywe.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akaramokia Hagari amaiso, na ere akarora ensoko y’amaache, akagenda, akabuucha, agaichoria ekerandi amaache, akaa omwana oria erio akanywa.

English: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.
Kiswahili: Mungu akawa pamoja na huyu kijana alipokuwa akiendelea kukua. Aliishi jangwani na akawa mpiga upinde.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akaba amo nomwana oria. Ere akamenya ase erooro, akaba omomanyi bw’okorasa nemegwe.

English: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akiishi katika Jangwa la Parani, mama yake akampatia mke kutoka Misri.
Ekegusii: Akamenya ase erooro ya Parani, na ng’ina akamonyuomeria omokungu korwa ase ense ya Misiri.

English: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Abimeleki na Fikoli mkuu wa majeshi yake wakamwambia Abrahamu, “Mungu yu pamoja nawe katika kila kitu unachofanya.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abimeleki na Pikoli, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani baye, bagateebia Aburaamu: “Nyasae nare amo naye ase ande onsi ogokora.

English: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”
Kiswahili: Sasa niapie hapa mbele za Mungu kwamba hutanitenda hila mimi, watoto wangu wala wazao wangu. Nitendee mimi na nchi ambayo unaishi kama mgeni wema ule ule ambao nimekutendea.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono karie eira na gotiana ase Nyasae ng’a togonkorera obong’ainereria inche, na abana baane, na abachokoro baane, korende koreng’ana buna inche nagokorerete aye, obwanchani obo naye onkorere nainche boigo, amo nense eye aye omenyete ime.”

English: Abraham said, “I will swear.”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akasema, “Ninaapa hivyo.”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu agateeba: “Ee, ninkoriere eira.”

English: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akalalamika kwa Abimeleki kuhusu kisima cha maji ambacho watumishi wa Abimeleki walikuwa wamekinyangʼanya.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akamwemurunganeria Abimeleki ase engencho y’ensoko eria abasomba b’Abimeleki bamourete.

English: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Abimeleki akasema, “Sijui ni nani ambaye amefanya hili. Hukuniambia, leo tu ndipo ninasikia habari zake.”
Ekegusii: Abimeleki akamoteebia: “Inche timanyeti ning’o okorete ring’ana erio, gose tikwana gonteebia; nonya nokoigwa, tinana koyaigwa otatiga reero rioka.”

English: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Abrahamu akaleta kondoo na ngʼombe, akampa Abimeleki, nao watu hawa wawili wakafanya mapatano.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimokia etugo yaye, ching’ondi ne chiombe, akaa Abimeleki, na barabwo babere bagakora okobwatana gati yabo.

English: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akatenga kondoo wa kike saba kutoka kwenye kundi,
Ekegusii: Aburaamu agaatanana chimanwa chisigiti isano na ibere, agachibeeka ensemo.

English: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”
Kiswahili: Abimeleki akamuuliza Abrahamu, “Ni nini maana ya hawa kondoo wa kike saba uliowatenga peke yao?”
Ekegusii: Abimeleki akabooria Aburaamu: “Inee, chimanwa echi chisigiti isano na ibere gwatanana, engencho yaye inki?”

English: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akamjibu, “Upokee hawa kondoo wa kike saba kutoka mkononi mwangu kama ushahidi kuwa nilichimba kisima hiki.”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Chimanwa echi chisigiti isano na ibere nigo nagochieire korwa ase okoboko kwane, erinde chibe kirori ase ’nde, ng’a ensoko eye ninche nayeremete.”

English: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mahali pale pakaitwa Beer-Sheba, kwa sababu watu wawili waliapiana hapo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakaaroka ase agwo Beeri‐Seba, ekiagera barabwo babere mbariereranete emuma aroro.

English: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mapatano kufanyika huko Beer-Sheba, Abimeleki na Fikoli mkuu wa majeshi yake wakarudi katika nchi ya Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Ekero bakorire okobwatana aria Beeri‐Seba, Abimeleki na Pikoli, oria omochiki omonene bw’abarwani baye, bakaimoka korwa agwo, bakairana ase ense y’Abafilisti.

English: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akapanda mti wa mkwaju huko Beer-Sheba, na hapo akaliitia jina la Bwana, Mungu wa milele.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu agasimeka omote onga buna ekerachuoki aria Beeri‐Seba, na agwo akarangeria erieta ria Nyasae Omonene o kare na kare ase okomosasiima.

English: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
Kiswahili: Naye Abrahamu akakaa katika nchi ya Wafilisti kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akamenya buna omomenyi ase ense y’Abafilisti amatuko amange.

English: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
Kiswahili: Baadaye Mungu akamjaribu Abrahamu. Akamwambia, “Abrahamu!” Abrahamu akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”
Ekegusii: Ekaba magega y’amang’ana ayio, Nyasae akabeekera Aburaamu ogoteemwa. Akamorangeria: “Aburaamu!” Na Aburaamu akamoitabeera. “Nao inde aa.”

English: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia, “Umchukue mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee, Isaki umpendaye, uende katika nchi ya Moria. Mtoe huko kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya mlima mmojawapo nitakaokuambia.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoteebia: “Moire Isaka, omwana oyo oo omomoima, oyobwanchete, ogende nere goika ense ya Moria. Agwo omorue abe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase egetunwa ekemo ki’ebio ndakworokie.”

English: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akaamka asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, akamtayarisha punda wake. Akawachukua watumishi wake wawili pamoja na Isaki mwanawe. Baada ya kuchanja kuni za kutosha kwa ajili ya hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa, akaondoka kuelekea mahali Mungu alipokuwa amemwambia.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka mambia chuni, akabeeka ebinto ase etigere yaye, akairana abamura babere amo nere, na Isaka omwana oye. Agaatia chinko agochia gosambera ekeng’wanso, akaimoka, akagenda gochia aase aria ateebetigwe na Nyasae.

English: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.
Kiswahili: Siku ya tatu Abrahamu akainua macho, akapaona mahali pale kwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Aburaamu akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora aase aria korwa aare.

English: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia watumishi wake, “Kaeni hapa pamoja na punda, wakati mimi na kijana tunakwenda kule. Tutakwenda kuabudu na kisha tutawarudia.”
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agateebia abamura baria abaarenge komo: “Ikaransa inwe aiga amo netigere eye! Inche amo nomwana oyo one nkogenda tore gochia aria, tosasime, erio toirane ase more naende.”

English: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akachukua kuni kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, akamtwika Isaki mwanawe, yeye mwenyewe akachukua moto na kisu. Walipokuwa wakienda pamoja,
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimokia chinko echi areenge gochia gosambera ekeng’wanso, agatweka Isaka omwana oye, na ere omonyene akaimokia omorero na omoyio. Bakagenda amo bonsi babere.

English: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”
Kiswahili: Isaki akanena akamwambia Abrahamu baba yake, “Baba yangu!” Abrahamu akaitika, “Mimi hapa, mwanangu.” Isaki akasema, “Moto na kuni zipo, Je, yuko wapi mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa?”
Ekegusii: Isaka agakwana na Aburaamu ise, agateeba: “Tata!” Ise agoitaba ogoteeba: “Nao inde aa, omwana one.” Isaka akamobooria: “Rora, omorero ne chinko ntobwate, korende ng’ai emaanwa y’eng’ondi ere togochia gokorera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa?”

English: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akajibu, “Mwanangu, Mungu mwenyewe atajipatia mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa.” Nao hawa wawili wakaendelea mbele pamoja.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Omwana one, Nyasae nenyorere emaanwa y’eng’ondi ase ekeng’wanso eke.” Erio bakagenderera amo bonsi babere.

English: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.
Kiswahili: Walipofika mahali pale alipokuwa ameambiwa na Mungu, Abrahamu akajenga madhabahu hapo, akaziweka kuni juu yake. Akamfunga Isaki mwanawe na akamlaza kwenye madhabahu, juu ya zile kuni.
Ekegusii: Kobaikire aase aria ateebetigwe na Nyasae, Aburaamu akaagacha egesasiimero agwo, akaara chinko igoro yaye, agasiba Isaka omwana oye, akamwareria igoro ye chinko chiria.

English: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
Kiswahili: Kisha akanyoosha mkono wake na akachukua kisu ili amchinje mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabogoria omoyio anyenye omwana oye.

English: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
Kiswahili: Lakini malaika wa Bwana akamwita kutoka mbinguni, akamwambia, “Abrahamu! Abrahamu!” Akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”
Ekegusii: Korende omomalaika Omonene akamorangeria korwa igoro, akabora: “Aburaamu, Aburaamu!” Ere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”

English: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Usimdhuru kijana, wala usimtendee jambo lolote. Sasa ninajua kwamba unamcha Mungu, kwa sababu hukunizuilia mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee.”
Ekegusii: Omomalaika oria akamoteebia: “Torambora okoboko kwao igoro ase omwana oo, gose tomokorera ing’ana rinde rionsi riibe. Bono namanyire ng’a nomoirogete Nyasae, naende narorire ng’a tondineti omwana oo omomoima.”

English: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akainua macho yake, akaona kondoo dume amenaswa pembe zake nyuma yake katika kichaka. Akaenda akamchukua huyo kondoo dume, akamtoa awe sadaka ya kuteketezwa badala ya mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimokerereria amaiso aye igoro, akaonchora ebigoti gochia aa anaaria, akarora eng’ondi emingichi ebwatire ching’unchara ase orosana nemerande. Aburaamu akagenda, akarusia eng’ondi eyio, akayerua, ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase ribaga ri’omwana oye.

English: Abraham called the name of that place “Yahweh Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akapaita mahali pale Yehova-Yire. Mpaka siku ya leo inasemekana, “Katika mlima wa Bwana itapatikana.”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu Akaaroka aase aria “Omonene nayaroke” (Yahwe‐Yire); buna abanto bagokwana goika reero iga: “Ase egetunwa ki’ Omonene, nao ekonyorekana.”

English: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
Kiswahili: Basi malaika wa Bwana akamwita Abrahamu kutoka mbinguni mara ya pili,
Ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene akarangeria Aburaamu korwa igoro eria kabere, akamoteebia:

English: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says Yahweh, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
Kiswahili: akasema, “Ninaapa kwa nafsi yangu, asema Bwana, kwamba kwa sababu umefanya jambo hili na hukunizuilia mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee,
Ekegusii: “Omonene oteebire: Netianirie inche omonyene, ekiagera gwakorire ring’ana eri, gose tondineti omwana oo omomoima.

English: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.
Kiswahili: hakika nitakubariki, na nitauzidisha uzao wako kama nyota za angani na kama mchanga ulioko pwani. Wazao wako watamiliki miji ya adui zao,
Ekegusii: Ase ogosesenia ningosesenie, na ase okomenta nimente ororeeria rwao, robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro na buna omokenye ore engegu y’enyancha, na ororeeria rwao inarobue emechie y’ababisa babo,

English: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”
Kiswahili: na kupitia uzao wako mataifa yote duniani yatabarikiwa, kwa sababu umenitii.”
Ekegusii: na ase ororeeria rwao ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe, ekiagera kwanyigwereire.”

English: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akawarudia watumishi wake, wakaondoka wakaenda wote pamoja mpaka Beer-Sheba. Abrahamu akaishi huko Beer-Sheba.
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akairana gochia ase abamura baria baarenge komo; bonsi bakaimoka, bakagenda amo gochia Beeri‐Seba; na Aburaamu akaba okomenya agwo Beeri‐Seba.

English: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, Abrahamu akaambiwa, “Milka pia amepata watoto, amemzalia ndugu yako Nahori wana:
Ekegusii: Magega y’amang’ana ayio kaerire Aburaamu agateebigwa ng’a, “Milka oiboreire momura omino Nahori abana.

English: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
Kiswahili: Usi mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Buzi nduguye, Kemueli (baba wa Aramu),
Ekegusii: Abana abwo nabwo aba: Usi, omwana oye omotangi, na Busi omwabo, na Kemueli, ise Aramu,

English: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
Kiswahili: Kesedi, Hazo, Pildashi, Yidlafu na Bethueli.”
Ekegusii: na Kesedi, na Haso, na Pilidasi, na Yidilafu, na Betueli.”

English: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
Kiswahili: Bethueli akamzaa Rebeka. Milka alimzalia Nahori nduguye Abrahamu hao wana wanane.
Ekegusii: Betueli nere omoiborete omoiseke ore korokwa Rebeka. Abwo batano na batato nabwo Milka aiborerete Nahori, momura omwabo Aburaamu.

English: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
Kiswahili: Suria wake Nahori aliyeitwa Reuma pia alikuwa na wana: Teba, Gahamu, Tahashi na Maaka.
Ekegusii: Naende omokungu oye o sere‐sere, ore korokwa Reuma, akamoiborera Teba, na Gahamu, na Tahasi, na Maaka.

English: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.
Kiswahili: Sara aliishi akawa na umri wa miaka mia na ishirini na saba.
Ekegusii: Sara nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere (127); eye nero emiaka y’obogima bwa Sara.

English: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
Kiswahili: Sara akafa huko Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni) katika nchi ya Kanaani, Abrahamu akamwombolezea na kumlilia Sara.
Ekegusii: Sara agakwera ase Kiriati‐Ariba, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kaanani. Aburaamu akagenda komoreera Sara na okweumia okonene, na akaroberia omoyega bw’ogotindekwa kwaye.

English: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akainuka kutoka pale penye maiti ya mke wake. Akazungumza na Wahiti, akasema,
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka korwa ase egetondo kiaye, agateebia Abahiti,

English: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
Kiswahili: “Mimi ni mpitaji na mgeni miongoni mwenu. Niuzieni sehemu ya ardhi yenu ili niweze kumzika maiti wangu.”
Ekegusii: “Inche nomomenyi inde, imenyete ase egati yaino; komoranche mong’e aase ntindeke omokungu one onkwereire, imorusie ase obosio bwane.”

English: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
Kiswahili: Wahiti wakamjibu Abrahamu,
Ekegusii: Abahiti bakairaneria Aburaamu, bakamoteebia,

English: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”
Kiswahili: “Bwana, tusikilize. Wewe ni mtawala mkuu sana miongoni mwetu. Zika maiti wako katika kaburi unalolipenda kati ya makaburi yetu. Hakuna mtu wa kwetu atakayekuzuia kaburi lake ili kuzika maiti wako.”
Ekegusii: “Omonene, totegerere! Aye nigo ore omonto omonene o Nyasae ase egati yaito. Tindeka omokungu oo ase embeera ende yonsi engiya orachoore. Onde tari ase egati yaito orakorine embeera yaye gose agotange totindeka omokungu oo.”

English: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akainuka na akasujudu mbele ya wenyeji wa nchi, yaani Wahiti.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka, agatugama inse ase amasio ’Abahiti, abanto b’ense eria.

English: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Kama mnaniruhusu kumzika maiti wangu, basi nisikilizeni mkamsihi Efroni mwana wa Sohari kwa niaba yangu
Ekegusii: Ere agakwana nabarabwo, akabora: “Komoranche mong’e ribaga ntindeke omokungu one, imorusie ase obosio bwane, monyigwe na monsabere ase Efuroni, omwana o Sohari,

English: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”
Kiswahili: ili aniuzie pango la Makpela, lililo mali yake, nalo liko mwisho wa shamba lake. Mwambieni aniuzie kwa bei kamili atakayosema ili liwe mahali pangu pa kuzikia miongoni mwenu.”
Ekegusii: ang’e rikuruma riaye, erio rire agwo Makipela, ase ensinyo y’oboremo bwaye. Ase rigori riikeranu tiga ang’ere ase amasio aino, togoranereo, ribe aase aane ndabe ngotindeka abakuure.”

English: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,
Kiswahili: Efroni Mhiti alikuwa ameketi miongoni mwa watu wake, akamjibu Abrahamu mbele ya Wahiti wote waliokuwepo katika lango la mji.
Ekegusii: Bono Efuroni nigo areenge oikaransete agwo ase egati y’Abahiti. Ere Efuroni, Omohiti, akairaneria Aburaamu ekero Abahiti bonsi, abaare goetera egeita ki’omochie oye, bamotegererete,

English: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”
Kiswahili: “La hasha, bwana wangu, nisikilize, nakupa shamba, pia nakupa pango lililomo ndani yake. Nakupa mbele ya watu wangu. Uzike maiti wako.”
Ekegusii: agateeba: “Yaya, omonene one, ntegerera. Oboremo boria nakoeire amo ne rikuruma riria rire imeo, ase amaiso ’abaanto baminto nakobieire; otindeke mokao aroro.”

English: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akasujudu tena, mbele ya wenyeji wa nchi,
Ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agatugama inse ase amasio ’abaanto b’ense eria.

English: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”
Kiswahili: akamwambia Efroni wale watu wakiwa wanasikia, “Tafadhali nisikilize. Nitakulipa fedha za hilo shamba. Kubali kuzipokea ili niweze kumzika maiti wangu.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia Efuroni ekero abanto b’ense eria bamotegererete: “Koranche, ntegerera! Inche nindue rigori ri’oboremo; naye obogorie chifeta korwa ase ’nde, na inche nintindeke mokane aroro.”

English: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
Kiswahili: Efroni akamjibu Abrahamu,
Ekegusii: Efuroni akairaneria Aburaamu,

English: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”
Kiswahili: “Nisikilize, bwana wangu, thamani ya ardhi hiyo ni shekeli 400 za fedha, lakini hiyo ni nini kati yako na mimi? Mzike maiti wako.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia: “Omonene one, ntegerera! Oboremo obwo bw’erigori rie chisekeli chi’efeta amagana ane, ngento ki toengereranie inche naye? Tindeka mokao agwo.”

English: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akakubali masharti ya Efroni, akampimia ile fedha aliyotaja masikioni mwa Wahiti: Shekeli 400 za fedha kulingana na viwango vya uzito vilivyokuwa vikitumika wakati huo na wafanyabiashara.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu bagaancherana na Efuroni; na Aburaamu akarengera Efuroni chifeta chiria ateebete Abahiti kobaigwete, chisekeli chi’echifeta amagana ane, koreng’ana nekerengo giancheranire nabaonchoreria.

English: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded
Kiswahili: Hivyo shamba la Efroni huko Makpela karibu na Mamre, yaani shamba pamoja na pango lililokuwamo, nayo miti yote iliyokuwamo ndani ya mipaka ya shamba hilo, vilikabidhiwa,
Ekegusii: Oboremo bw’Efuroni obwo bware agwo Makipela moocha ya Mamure, oboremo amo ne rikuruma riria riare imeo na emete yonsi yareengeo, ensemo eria yonsi Aburaamu akayeegwa.

English: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.
Kiswahili: kwa Abrahamu kuwa mali yake mbele ya Wahiti wote waliokuwa wamekuja kwenye lango la mji.
Ekegusii: Igo ayeetwe ase amasio ’Abahiti, abwo bonsi baare gosoera egeita kiaye.

English: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo Abrahamu akamzika Sara mkewe kwenye pango ndani ya shamba la Makpela karibu na Mamre (huko Hebroni) katika nchi ya Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Aburaamu agatindeka Sara mokaye ase rikuruma ri’oboremo bware agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kaanani.

English: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Wahiti wakamkabidhi Abrahamu shamba pamoja na pango lililokuwa humo kuwa mahali pa kuzikia.
Ekegusii: Nabo oboremo boria, ne rikuruma riria riare imeo, Aburaamu akabinyora korwa ase Abahiti bibe aase kwaye agwo ase agotindeka abakuure.

English: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Abrahamu alikuwa mzee mwenye miaka mingi, naye Bwana alikuwa amembariki katika kila njia.
Ekegusii: Bono Aburaamu konya obeire omogotu, akoorire emiaka emenge; n’Omonene konya omosesenirie ase amang’ana onsi.

English: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia mtumishi wake mkuu wa vitu vyote katika nyumba yake, yule aliyekuwa msimamizi wa vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo, “Weka mkono wako chini ya paja langu,
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akarangeria omosomba oye oyo konya omokoreire ase emiaka emenge mono, na omorenderete enibo yaye yonsi, akamoteebia: “Beka okoboko kwao inse y’ebinama biane,

English: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.
Kiswahili: Ninataka uape kwa Bwana, Mungu wa mbingu na Mungu wa nchi, kwamba hutamtwalia mwanangu mke kutoka binti za Wakanaani, ambao ninaishi miongoni mwao,
Ekegusii: na inche ninkoboorie otiane ase Omonene Nyasae o igoro na ense, ng’a tokorigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b’Abakaanani, aba imenyete ase egati yabo.

English: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
Kiswahili: bali utakwenda katika nchi yangu na jamaa zangu umpatie Isaki mwanangu mke.”
Ekegusii: Korende ogende ase ense yane na ase eamate yane, orentere omwana one Isaka omokungu korwa aroro abe mokaye.”

English: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”
Kiswahili: Yule mtumishi akamuuliza, “Je, kama huyo mwanamke atakataa kuja nami katika nchi hii? Je, nimpeleke mwanao katika hiyo nchi uliyotoka?”
Ekegusii: Omosomba oria akamoiraneria: “Aande, omokungu oria atancheraneti gocha amo nainche goika ase ense eye; Inee, nigo ndaire omwana oo goika ase ense eria kwarwete?”

English: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu akasema, “Hakikisha kwamba hutamrudisha mwanangu huko.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Bwerende, tobaisa koira omwana one aroro.

English: Yahweh, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
Kiswahili: Bwana, Mungu wa mbingu, aliyenitoa nyumbani kwa baba yangu na nchi yangu niliyozaliwa na aliyesema nami na akaniahidi kwa kiapo, akisema, ‘Nitawapa watoto wako nchi hii,’ atatuma malaika wake akutangulie ili umpatie mwanangu mke kutoka huko.
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae o igoro na ense, oyondusetie o tata korwa ase ense eria naiboreretwe, ere nigo akwanete nainche na gotiana, ogoteeba: Ning’ee ororeeria rwao ense eye, ere natome omomalaika oye agotang’ane; aye norentere omwana one omokungu korwa aroro.

English: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”
Kiswahili: Kama huyo mwanamke asipokubali kufuatana nawe, basi utafunguliwa kutoka kiapo nilichokuapisha. Ila usimrudishe mwanangu huko.”
Ekegusii: Na omokungu oria atancheti moche komo, rirorio nosiborwe korwa ase eira eye okoria ase ’nde, korende tobaisa koira omwana one gochia aroro.”

English: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
Kiswahili: Basi yule mtumishi akaweka mkono wake chini ya paja la bwana wake Abrahamu akamwapia kuhusu shauri hili.
Ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria ababeeka okoboko kwaye inse y’ekebono kia Aburaamu, omonene oye, akerama ase ring’ana erio.

English: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
Kiswahili: Ndipo huyo mtumishi akachukua ngamia kumi miongoni mwa ngamia za bwana wake, akaondoka, akiwa amechukua aina zote za vitu vizuri kutoka kwa bwana wake. Akaelekea Aramu-Naharaimu na kushika njia kwenda mji wa Nahori.
Ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akarusia chingamia ikomi chi’omonene oye, akaimokia na ebiegwa ebinge ebiya; akaimoka, akagenda gochia Mesopotamia, agaika omochie oria Nahori amenyete.

English: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
Kiswahili: Akawapigisha ngamia magoti karibu na kisima cha maji nje ya mji, ilikuwa inaelekea jioni, wakati ambapo wanawake wanakuja kuteka maji.
Ekegusii: Agwo agatimokeria chingamia isiko y’omochie ang’e nensoko y’amaache engaki ya mogoroba, ekero abakungu bagocha kobuucha amaache.

English: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaomba, “Ee Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, nipatie ushindi leo, uonyeshe huruma kwa bwana wangu Abrahamu.
