Kiswahili: Yakobo aliwauliza wachungaji, “Ndugu zangu, ninyi mmetoka wapi?” Wakamjibu, “Tumetoka Harani.”
Ekegusii: Yakobo akababooria: “Baminto, ng’ai seino?” Abarisia baria bakamoiraneria: “Seito naiga Harani.”

English: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”
Kiswahili: Aliwaambia, “Je, mnamjua Labani, mjukuu wa Nahori?” Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo, tunamfahamu.”
Ekegusii: Naende akababooria: “Inee! Momanyete Labani, mochokoro o Nahori?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Ee, ntomomanyete.”

English: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yakobo akawauliza, “Je, yeye ni mzima?” Wakasema, “Ndiyo, ni mzima, na hapa yuaja Raheli binti yake akiwa na kondoo.”
Ekegusii: Naende akababooria: “Mbuya are?” Abarisia bakamoiraneria: “Ee, mbuya are; na rigereria, Raeli, omoiseke oye oyio ogocha ne ching’ondi!”

English: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Tazama, jua bado liko juu, si wakati wa kukusanya mifugo. Nywesheni kondoo na mwarudishe malishoni.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Rigereria, bono mobaso, chinsa chi’ogosangereria amaicho tichiraika, nyoinsia ching’ondi, naende mochiire korisia.”

English: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”
Kiswahili: Walijibu, “Haiwezekani, mpaka kondoo wote wakusanyike na jiwe liwe limevingirishwa kutoka mdomo wa kisima. Ndipo tutanywesha kondoo.”
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Titokonyara gokora bo goika ekero amaicho onsi arache asangererekane amo, erinde abarisia bamanye gotigeria rigena korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko; erio tomanye konyoinsia ching’ondi.”

English: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akizungumza nao, Raheli akaja pamoja na kondoo wa baba yake, kwa maana alikuwa mchunga kondoo.
Ekegusii: Ekero areenge ogendererete gokwana nabarabwo, Raeli agacha obwate ching’ondi chia ise, naki nere orenge gochirisia.

English: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
Kiswahili: Yakobo alipomwona Raheli binti Labani, ndugu wa mama yake, pamoja na kondoo wa Labani, alikwenda na kulivingirisha jiwe kutoka mdomoni mwa kisima na kuwanywesha kondoo wa mjomba wake.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero Yakobo achia korora Raeli, omoiseke o Labani, ng’ina rome, okorenta riicho ria Labani, akaimoka, agatigeria rigena riria korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko, akanyoinsia ching’ondi chia Labani, ng’ina rome.

English: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yakobo akambusu Raheli na akaanza kulia kwa sauti.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaagata Raeli, akarera na koiyeria amariga.

English: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.
Kiswahili: Yakobo alikuwa amemwambia Raheli kuwa yeye alikuwa jamaa ya baba yake, na kwamba ni mwana wa Rebeka. Basi Raheli alikimbia na kumweleza baba yake.
Ekegusii: Agateebia Raeli, “Inche nomoigwa o iso, omwana o Rebeka.” Raeli akaminyoka, agateebia ise amang’ana ayio.

English: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.
Kiswahili: Mara Labani aliposikia habari kuhusu Yakobo, mwana wa ndugu yake, aliharakisha kwenda kumlaki. Akamkumbatia na kumbusu, halafu akamleta nyumbani kwake, kisha Yakobo akamwambia mambo yote.
Ekegusii: Ekero Labani achia koigwa amang’ana a Yakobo, omoigwa oye, akaminyoka gochia komoorotota, akamoagata n’amaiga amanene, akamoira gochia nka bwoye. Yakobo agateebia Labani amang’ana onsi.

English: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Labani akamwambia, “Wewe ni nyama yangu na damu yangu mwenyewe.” Baada ya Yakobo kukaa kwa Labani mwezi mzima,
Ekegusii: Erio Labani akamoteebia: “Amaene, aye namanyinga omobere one.” Ere akamenya bwoye ase engaki y’omotienyi oyomo.

English: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”
Kiswahili: Labani akamwambia, “Kwa vile wewe ni jamaa yangu, ndiyo sababu unifanyie kazi bila ujira? Niambie ujira wako utakuwa nini.”
Ekegusii: Labani agakwana na Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Nonya kore omoigwa one, tegwenereti onkorere emeremo bosa. Nteebia eng’eria yao ninki ndakoe!”

English: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
Kiswahili: Labani alikuwa na binti wawili, binti mkubwa aliitwa Lea na binti mdogo aliitwa Raheli.
Ekegusii: Bono Labani nigo abwate abaiseke babere; omoiseke oria omonene nigo are korokwa Lea, na oria omoke Raeli.

English: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
Kiswahili: Lea alikuwa na macho dhaifu, lakini Raheli alikuwa na umbo la kupendeza na mzuri wa sura.
Ekegusii: Lea amaiso aye nigo areenge amatu, korende Raeli nigo areenge omonyakieni, naende omwasioku.

English: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
Kiswahili: Yakobo akampenda Raheli, akamwambia Labani, “Nitakutumikia kwa miaka saba kwa ajili ya kumpata Raheli binti yako mdogo.”
Ekegusii: Yakobo konya omwanchire Raeli, na ase ayio agateebia Labani, “Ningokorere emiaka etano na ebere, erinde ong’e Raeli, omoiseke oo omoke.”

English: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
Kiswahili: Labani akasema, “Ni bora zaidi nikupe Raheli kuliko kumpa mtu mwingine yeyote. Kaa pamoja na mimi hapa.”
Ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria, “Ayio mbuya. Tiga nkomoe aye kobua ’nkomoa omonto onde; menya aa bwone.”

English: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo akatumika miaka saba ili kumpata Raheli, lakini ilionekana kwake kama siku chache tu kwa sababu ya upendo wake kwa Raheli.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akamokorera emiaka etano na ebere aegwe Raeli. Emiaka eyio ekarorekana asare buna namatuko makeigo, ekiagera nigo amwanchete Raeli mono.

English: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yakobo akamwambia Labani, “Nipe mke wangu. Muda wangu umekamilika, nami nataka nikutane naye kimwili.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia Labani: “Bono naikeranirie engaki yane, ing’a mokane, tobe nere.”

English: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
Kiswahili: Basi Labani akaalika watu wote wa mahali pale na akafanya karamu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Labani akarangeria abanto bonsi b’ensemo eria, agakorera omoyega.

English: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.
Kiswahili: Lakini ilipofika jioni, akamchukua Lea binti yake akampa Yakobo, naye Yakobo akakutana naye kimwili.
Ekegusii: Rigachia koba mogoroba Labani akaimokia Lea, omoiseke oye omonene, akamorentera Yakobo, erio Yakobo akaba nere.

English: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
Kiswahili: Naye Labani akamtoa Zilpa, mtumishi wake wa kike, kuwa mtumishi wa Lea, binti yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero ekio Labani akarua omosomba oye omoiseke okorokwa Silpa, abe omokoreri o Lea, omwana oye.

English: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”
Kiswahili: Kesho yake asubuhi, Yakobo akagundua kuwa amepewa Lea! Basi Yakobo akamwambia Labani, “Ni jambo gani hili ulilonitendea? Nilikutumikia kwa ajili ya Raheli, sivyo? Kwa nini umenidanganya?”
Ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, Yakobo akanyora ng’a ’Lea aetwe. Erio akabooria Labani: “Inki eke gwankorerete? Tinagokorerete, erinde ong’e Raeli? Naki gwakorete okang’aina?”

English: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
Kiswahili: Labani akajibu, “Si desturi yetu kumwoza binti mdogo kabla ya kumwoza binti mkubwa.
Ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria: “Aiga seito intwe titori gokora bo, gosokia omoiseke omoke, na gotiga omonene.

English: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”
Kiswahili: Maliza juma la arusi ya binti huyu, kisha pia nitakupa huyu binti mdogo, kwa kutumika miaka mingine saba.”
Ekegusii: Tiga omoyega oyo bw’amatuko aya atano na abere oraera bw’oyio omonene, erio noegwe na oria omoke, naende aye onkorere emeremo emiaka ende etano na ebere.”

English: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.
Kiswahili: Naye Yakobo akafanya hivyo. Akamaliza juma na Lea, kisha Labani akampa Raheli binti yake kuwa mke wake.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agancha ebe boigo, erio agaikerania amatuko ayio atano na abere. Erio Labani akamomoa Raeli, omoiseke oye omoke, abe mok’aye.

English: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.
Kiswahili: Labani akamtoa Bilha mtumishi wake wa kike kwa Raheli ili kuwa mtumishi wake.
Ekegusii: Labani akamoa Raeli, omwana oye, omokoreri, nere Bilia, omosomba oye omoiseke.

English: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.
Kiswahili: Pia Yakobo akakutana na Raheli kimwili, naye akampenda Raheli zaidi kuliko Lea. Yakobo akamtumikia Labani kwa miaka mingine saba.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akaba na Raeli; na agancha Raeli mono kegima kobua Lea. Erio Yakobo naende agakorera Labani emiaka ende etano na ebere.

English: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
Kiswahili: Bwana alipoona kwamba Lea hapendwi, akampa watoto, lakini Raheli alikuwa tasa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arooche ng’a Lea tanchiri, akamosesenia ase oroiboro rwa abana, korende Raeli ere nigo areenge omogomba.

English: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”
Kiswahili: Lea akapata mimba akazaa mwana. Akamwita Reubeni, kwa maana alisema, “Ni kwa sababu Bwana ameona huzuni yangu. Hakika mume wangu sasa atanipenda.”
Ekegusii: Lea akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Rubeni, naki nigo atebeete: “Omonene ororire buna ’nchayire. Korende ase engencho y’okoibora, bono omosacha one nanyanche.”

English: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.
Kiswahili: Akapata tena mimba, naye alipozaa mwana, akasema, “Kwa sababu Bwana alisikia kwamba sipendwi, amenipa tena huyu mwana.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Simeoni.
Ekegusii: Naende Lea akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Omonene ororire ng’a tinyanchiri, naende ong’eire omwana onde omoisia boigo,” akamoroka Simioni.

English: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.
Kiswahili: Akapata tena mimba, naye alipozaa mwana, akasema, “Sasa afadhali mume wangu ataambatana na mimi, kwa sababu nimemzalia wana watatu.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Lawi.
Ekegusii: Naende akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Bono engaki eye omosacha one nabwatane amo nainche, ekiagera namoiboreire abana abaisia batato.” Ase ayio akamoroka Lawi.

English: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
Kiswahili: Akapata tena mimba, naye alipozaa mwana, akasema, “Wakati huu nitamsifu Bwana.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Yuda. Kisha akaacha kuzaa watoto.
Ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Engaki eye nintogie Omonene.” Ase ayio akamoroka Yuda. Erio Lea agatenena koibora.

English: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”
Kiswahili: Raheli alipoona hamzalii Yakobo watoto, akamwonea ndugu yake wivu. Hivyo akamwambia Yakobo, “Nipe watoto, la sivyo nitakufa!”
Ekegusii: Ekero Raeli arooche ng’a tari koiborera Yakobo abana, akarorera mosubati omwabo ribero, agateebia Yakobo: “Ing’a abana! Otabang’eti, rirorio nigo ndakwe!”

English: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”
Kiswahili: Yakobo akamkasirikia, akamwambia, “Je, mimi ni badala ya Mungu, ambaye amekuzuia usizae watoto?”
Ekegusii: Yakobo akabea Raeli mono, akamobooria: “Inee! Ninche inde ribaga ria Nyasae, oyogotangete tikwaegwa abana?”

English: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Raheli akamwambia, “Hapa yupo Bilha, mtumishi wangu wa kike. Kutana naye kimwili ili aweze kunizalia watoto na kwa kupitia yeye mimi pia niweze kuwa na uzao.”
Ekegusii: Erio akamoiraneria: “Nimbwate omosomba one omoiseke, Bilia. Motware, erinde inyore abana korwa asare, barokwe abana baane, na goetera asare na inche inyore oroiboro.”

English: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Raheli akampa Yakobo Bilha awe mke wake. Yakobo akakutana naye kimwili,
Ekegusii: Naboigo Yakobo akaegwa Bilia, omosomba omoiseke o Raeli, abe mokaye, na Yakobo akaba nere.

English: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
Kiswahili: Bilha akapata mimba, naye akamzalia Yakobo mwana.
Ekegusii: Bilia akaba morito, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia.

English: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Raheli akasema, “Mungu amenipa haki yangu, amesikiliza maombi yangu na kunipa mwana.” Kwa sababu hiyo akamwita Dani.
Ekegusii: Erio Raeli akabora: “Nyasae ong’eire oboronge bwane, amaene, oigure ekerero kiane, ong’eire omwana omoisia.” Ase ayio akamoroka Dani.

English: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.
Kiswahili: Bilha mtumishi wa kike wa Raheli akapata mimba tena, akamzalia Yakobo mwana wa pili.
Ekegusii: Bilia, omosomba o Raeli, akaba morito naende, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o kabere.

English: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Raheli akasema, “Nilikuwa na mashindano makubwa na ndugu yangu, nami nimeshinda.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Naftali.
Ekegusii: Raeli akabora: “Ase okoamererania okonene namenyire nkoamererania na mosubati ominto, nabuire.” Ase igo, akamoroka Nafutali.

English: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
Kiswahili: Lea alipoona kuwa amekoma kuzaa watoto, alimchukua mtumishi wake wa kike Zilpa, naye akampa Yakobo awe mke wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Lea achia korora ng’a Bilia okoorire koibora abana, akaimokia Silpa, omosomba oye omoiseke, akamomoa Yakobo, abe mokaye.

English: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.
Kiswahili: Mtumishi wa Lea yaani Zilpa, akamzalia Yakobo mwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Silpa, omosomba omoiseke o Lea, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia.

English: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Lea akasema, “Hii ni bahati nzuri aje!” Kwa hiyo akamwita Gadi.
Ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Ninde negesio.” Akamoroka Gadi.

English: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.
Kiswahili: Mtumishi wa kike wa Lea akamzalia Yakobo mwana wa pili.
Ekegusii: Silpa, omosomba o Lea, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o kabere.

English: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Lea aliposema, “Jinsi gani nilivyo na furaha! Wanawake wataniita furaha.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Asheri.
Ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Inche ninde nomogooko omonene, naki abakungu nabandoke Oyore n’omogooko.” Ase igo, akamoroka Aseri.

English: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuvuna ngano, Reubeni akaenda shambani akakuta tunguja, ambazo alizileta kwa Lea mama yake. Raheli akamwambia Lea, “Tafadhali nakuomba unipe baadhi ya tunguja za mwanao.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki ye rigesa ri’engano Rubeni akagenda akanyora amasooni ng’ombe getii, akayatwa, akayarentera Lea ng’ina.

English: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Lea akamwambia, “Haikukutosha kumtwaa mume wangu? Je, utachukua na tunguja za mwanangu pia?” Raheli akasema, “Vema sana! Yakobo atakutana nawe kimwili leo usiku, kwa malipo ya tunguja za mwanao.”
Ekegusii: Erio Raeli agasaba Lea amwatanere amasooni ng’ombe y’omwana oye, korende Lea akamoiraneria: “Inee! Nering’ana rike kwang’urire omosacha one, na bono korigetie koira amasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana one boigo?” Raeli akamoiraneria: “Reero nache araare naye, korang’e amasooni ng’ombe y’omwana oo.”

English: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo alipokuja kutoka shambani jioni ile, Lea akaenda kumlaki, akamwambia, “Lazima ukutane nami kimwili. Nimekukodisha kwa tunguja za mwanangu.” Kwa hiyo akakutana naye kimwili usiku ule.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo areenge koirana korwa mogondo mogoroba, Lea akagenda komoorotota, akamoteebia: “Reero goika oraare mwane, nakogorire namasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana one.” Ase obotuko Yakobo akaba nere.

English: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamsikiliza Lea, naye akapata mimba akamzalia Yakobo mwana wa tano.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa Lea, na ere akaba morito, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o gatano.

English: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Lea akasema, “Mungu amenizawadia kwa kumpa mume wangu mtumishi wangu wa kike.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Isakari.
Ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Nyasae ong’eire eng’eria yane, ekiagera naete omosacha one omosomba one omoiseke.” Ase igo, Akaaroka omwana oria Isakaru.

English: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
Kiswahili: Lea akapata mimba tena akamzalia Yakobo mwana wa sita.
Ekegusii: Lea akaba morito naende, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o gatano na rimo.

English: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Lea aliposema, “Mungu amenizawadia kwa zawadi ya thamani sana. Wakati huu mume wangu ataniheshimu kwa sababu nimemzalia wana sita.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Zabuloni.
Ekegusii: Erio Lea akabora: “Nyasae ong’eire ekeegwa ekiya; bono omosacha one nansike, ekiagera namoiboreire abana abaisia batano nomo.” Ase igo, akamoroka Sabuloni.

English: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.
Kiswahili: Baadaye akamzaa mtoto wa kike akamwita Dina.
Ekegusii: Magega yaye akaibora omwana omoiseke, akamoroka Dina.

English: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akamkumbuka Raheli, akasikia maombi yake na akafungua tumbo lake.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamoinyora Raeli, akaigwa ogosaba kwaye, na akaigora enda yaye;

English: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”
Kiswahili: Akapata mimba na akamzaa mwana na kusema, “Mungu ameniondolea aibu yangu.”
Ekegusii: ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Nyasae onduseirie ogochaywa kwane.”

English: She named him Joseph, saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”
Kiswahili: Akamwita Yosefu na kusema, “Bwana na anipe mwana mwingine.”
Ekegusii: Akaroka omwana oria Yusufu, akabora: “Tiga Omonene karanche amentere omwana onde omoisia.”

English: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Raheli kumzaa Yosefu, Yakobo akamwambia Labani, “Nipe ruhusa nirudi katika nchi yangu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Raeli aiboire Yusufu, Yakobo agateebia Labani: “Ing’a ribaga ngende seito, ase ense yane.

English: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”
Kiswahili: Nipe wake zangu na watoto, ambao nimetumika kuwapata, nami niende zangu. Unajua ni kazi kiasi gani ambayo nimekufanyia.”
Ekegusii: Ing’a abakungu baane na abana baane, aba namenyire nkogokorera, ontige ’ngende seito; naki nomanyete emeremo nabeire nkogokorera.”

English: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Labani akamwambia, “Ikiwa nimepata kibali machoni pako, tafadhali ukae. Nimegundua kwa njia ya uaguzi kwamba Bwana amenibariki kwa sababu yako.”
Ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria: “Oise kong’anchera nkwane iga, rigereria namanyire boronge ng’a Omonene onsesenirie mono ase engencho yao.

English: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”
Kiswahili: Akaongeza kumwambia, “Taja ujira wako nami nitakulipa.”
Ekegusii: Bono nteebia eng’eria yao ey’oganetie, na inche ninkoyee.”

English: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akamwambia, “Unajua jinsi ambavyo nimekutumikia na jinsi ambavyo wanyama wako walivyolishwa vizuri chini ya uangalizi wangu.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Aye omonyene nomanyete buna nabeire omokoreri oo, na amaicho ao buna abeire ase oborendi bwane.

English: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”
Kiswahili: Kidogo ulichokuwa nacho kabla sijaja kimeongezeka sana, naye Bwana amekubariki popote nilipokuwa. Lakini sasa, ni lini nitashughulikia mambo ya nyumba yangu mwenyewe?”
Ekegusii: Naki enibo yao nigo yareenge enke ritang’ani ekero ntaracha aa, korende bono yamentekanire mono kegima. Omonene ogosesenirie aye, aande onsi ase nabeire nkogenda kogokorera emeremo. Ko bono, inche indi ndabe nkoroisia amang’ana abwone inche omonyene?”

English: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.
Kiswahili: Labani akamuuliza, “Nikupe nini?” Yakobo akamjibu, “Usinipe chochote lakini kama utanifanyia jambo hili moja, nitaendelea kuchunga na kuyaangalia makundi yako.
Ekegusii: Labani akamobooria: “Ninki ndakoe rende?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Tinganeti ong’e kende. Oise gonkorera ring’ana eri ndagoteebie rioka, rirorio naende ningenderere korisia amaicho ao, na koyarenda.

English: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.
Kiswahili: Niruhusu nipite katika makundi yako yote leo niondoe humo kila kondoo mwenye mabakabaka au madoadoa, kila mwana-kondoo mweusi na kila mbuzi mwenye madoadoa au mabakabaka. Hawa watakuwa ujira wangu.
Ekegusii: Tiga ng’ete reero ase amaicho ao onsi, ndusie korwao kera eng’ondi emechege na egesembe, na emaanwa y’eng’ondi emwamu, na kera embori nyankororo na nyankanga. Erinde echio nachio chirabe eng’eria yane.

English: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”
Kiswahili: Uadilifu wangu utanishuhudia siku zijazo, kila utakapochunguza ujira ambao umenilipa mimi. Mbuzi yeyote wangu ambaye hana mabakabaka wala madoadoa, au mwana-kondoo ambaye si mweusi, atahesabika ameibwa.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, amatuko agochia bosio, ekero orache korora eng’eria yane, oboronge bwane nabombeere kirori. Kera embori etari nyankanga gose nyankororo, na kera emaanwa y’eng’ondi etari emwamu, onye ekonyorekana ase ’nde, oyebare ng’a eyio nigo eibire.”

English: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”
Kiswahili: Labani akasema, “Ninakubali na iwe kama ulivyosema.”
Ekegusii: Labani agancha amang’ana ayio, agateeba: “Tiga abe buna gwateebire.”

English: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
Kiswahili: Siku ile ile Yakobo akawaondoa beberu wote waliokuwa na mistari au madoadoa na mbuzi wake wote waliokuwa na mistari au madoadoa (wote waliokuwa na alama nyeupe juu yao) na wana-kondoo weusi wote, akawaweka chini ya uangalizi wa wanawe.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Labani akarusia chigoree chiimarera ne chinkororo, ne chimbori chiaberi, echiare nyankanga ne chire nyankororo, na kera eyare nebimoa ebirabu ase omobere oye, na kera eng’ondi eyare emwamu. Echio chionsi agachia abana baye abamura bachirende.

English: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
Kiswahili: Kisha Labani akamwacha Yakobo kwa mwendo wa safari ya siku tatu kati yake na Yakobo, wakati Yakobo akiendelea kuchunga lile kundi la Labani lililobaki.
Ekegusii: Erio ageatanana korwa ase Yakobo oboare bw’orogendo rw’amatuko atato; na Yakobo agatigara okorisia riicho ria Labani eriatigarete.

English: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Yakobo, akachukua fito mbichi zilizokatwa wakati huo huo za miti ya mlubna, mlozi na mwaramoni akazibambua ili mistari myeupe ionekane katika fito hizo.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agatwa ebite ebibese biomopopla akabisata chinsemo, erinde emeng’ororia emerabu ekarorekana ase ebite biria.

English: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaweka fito alizozibambua kwenye mabirika yote ya kunyweshea mifugo, ili ziwe mbele ya makundi walipokuja kunywa maji. Wanyama walipokuja kunywa maji, hali wakiwa wanahitaji mbegu,
Ekegusii: Erio akabeeka ebite biria ase chintuba chi’amaache ase amaicho are gocha konywera. Na ekiagera ching’iti chiria chiare koa chiaberi amarieme, ekero chigocha konywa amaache,

English: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.
Kiswahili: wakapandwa hizo fito zikiwa mbele yao. Wanyama waliopata mimba mbele ya hizo fito walizaa wanyama wenye mistari, madoadoa na mabakabaka.
Ekegusii: chirochio chikanyora amarieme bosio bw’ebite ebio, chikabiara chimanwa chire chimarera, ne chinkanga, ne chire nyankororo.

English: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akawatenga wadogo wa kundi peke yao, lakini akazielekeza nyuso za hao waliobaki kwenye wale wenye mistari na weusi waliokuwa mali ya Labani. Hivyo akatenga makundi yake mwenyewe, na wala hakuwachanganya na wanyama wa Labani.
Ekegusii: Na Yakobo agaatanana ching’ondi chimingichi, ne ching’ondi chiaberi agachisang’anania ne chimingichi chie riicho ria Labani echiareenge namagwari, na echiare chimwamu. Naboigo akenyorera amaicho aye ere omonyene, ayio atabegete amo naya Labani.

English: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;
Kiswahili: Kila mara wanyama wenye nguvu walipohitaji mbegu, Yakobo aliweka zile fito kwenye mabirika mbele ya hao wanyama, ili wapandwe karibu na hizo fito,
Ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi chimbori gose ching’ondi echiare ne chinguru gochiaganirie amarieme, Yakobo nigo are kobeeka ebite biria bosio bwe ching’iti ase chintuba chiria chinyare konyora amarieme gochikorigereria ebite ebio.

English: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
Kiswahili: lakini ikiwa wanyama walikuwa wadhaifu hakuziweka hizo fito. Hivyo wanyama wadhaifu wakawa wa Labani, na wanyama wenye nguvu wakawa wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Korende echiare chinyoro tare gochibekera ebite ebio. Ase igo, echiare chinyoro nigo chiare koba echia Labani, na echiare ne chinguru chiba echia Yakobo.

English: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii Yakobo akastawi sana, tena akawa na makundi makubwa, watumishi wa kike na wa kiume na ngamia na punda.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akaba okomenteka koba omotenenku, akaba namaicho amange, na abasomba, abaiseke na abamura, ne chingamia, ne chitigere.

English: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”
Kiswahili: Yakobo akawasikia wana wa Labani wakisema, “Yakobo amechukua kila kitu kilichokuwa cha baba yetu naye amepata utajiri huu wote kutokana na vile vilivyokuwa mali ya baba yetu.”
Ekegusii: Bono basinto ba Labani bakaigwekana kwemurungania bagoteeba ng’a: “Yakobo oirire enibo yonsi ya tata; na ase enibo eyio bwenyoreire obotenenku obwo bwonsi abwate.”

English: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akatambua kwamba moyo wa Labani kwake haukuwa kama ulivyokuwa mwanzo.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akanyora ng’a Labani oonchokire, tamorigereretie buya buna botambe.

English: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Yakobo, “Rudi katika nchi ya baba zako na kwa watu wako, nami nitakuwa pamoja nawe.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana na Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Irana gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiao, ase eamate yao, na inche nimbe amo naye.”

English: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yakobo akatuma ujumbe kwa Raheli na Lea waje machungani yalikokuwa makundi yake.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akagania Raeli na Lea barangerigwe, erio Raeli na Lea bakagenda getii ase Yakobo areenge korisia amaicho aye.

English: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Naona moyo wa baba yenu kwangu sivyo kama ulivyokuwa mwanzoni, lakini Mungu wa baba yangu amekuwa pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Agwo Yakobo akabateebia: “Narorire ng’a iso tari kondigereria buya reero buna botambe. Korende Nyasae o tata nigo are amo nainche.

English: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.
Kiswahili: Mnajua kwamba nimemtumikia baba yenu kwa nguvu zangu zote,
Ekegusii: Inwe ’momanyete ng’a nabeire ngokorera iso ne chinguru chiane chionsi;

English: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.
Kiswahili: hata hivyo baba yenu amenidanganya kwa kubadilisha ujira wangu mara kumi. Hata hivyo, Mungu hakumruhusu kunidhuru.
Ekegusii: nonya nabo, iso obeire okong’ainereria, na koonchora eng’eria yane ara ikomi, korende Nyasae tamoete ribaga gonkorera bobe.

English: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.
Kiswahili: Kama alisema, ‘Wenye madoadoa watakuwa ujira wako,’ basi makundi yote yalizaa wenye madoadoa, kama alisema, ‘Wenye mistari watakuwa ujira wako,’ basi makundi yote yalizaa wenye mistari.
Ekegusii: Onye otebeete: ‘Echire nebisembe echio nachio chirabe eng’eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire nebisembe, na ekero atebeete.’ Echire namagwari nachio echio chirabe eng’eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire namagwari.

English: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mungu amechukua mifugo ya baba yenu na amenipa mimi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Nyasae akarusia etugo ya iso, akayeng’a.”

English: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.
Kiswahili: “Wakati fulani majira ya kuzaliana niliota ndoto ambayo niliinua macho na kuona kwamba wale mabeberu waliokuwa wakipanda kundi walikuwa wa mistari, madoadoa na mabakabaka.
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria amaicho gachiire rieme nkarigereria, nkarora ase chindoto ng’a chigoree echiaete amaicho amarieme nigo chiare namagwari na ebisembe, ne chimechege.

English: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Mungu akaniambia katika ndoto, ‘Yakobo.’ Nikamjibu, ‘Mimi hapa.’
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika o Nyasae akandangeria ase chindoto: Yakobo! Nainche ngaitaba: ‘Nao inde aa!’”

English: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.
Kiswahili: Akasema, ‘Inua macho yako uone wale mabeberu wote wanaopanda kundi wana mistari, madoadoa au mabakabaka, kwa maana nimeona yale yote ambayo Labani amekuwa akikutendea.
Ekegusii: Aganteebia: “Imokereria amaiso ao igoro, origererie orore, ng’a chigoree echiaete amaicho amarieme nigo chiare namagwari, na ebisembe, ne chimechege, naki narorire onsi aya Labani abeire okogokorera.

English: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”
Kiswahili: Mimi ndiye Mungu wa Betheli, ulikomiminia ile nguzo mafuta na pale mahali uliponiwekea nadhiri. Sasa ondoka katika nchi hii mara moja urudi katika nchi uliyozaliwa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Nyasae oria kwarooche aria Beteli, aria ase kwaumorerete rigena amaguta rikaba esiiro y’ekeinyorio, na okandiera eira. Bono imoka korwa ase ense eye, oirane gochia ase ense eria kwaiboreretwe.”

English: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Raheli na Lea wakajibu, “Je bado tu tunalo fungu lolote katika urithi wa nyumba ya baba yetu?
Ekegusii: Erio Raeli na Lea bakamoiraneria: “Inee! Ntwe ntori na egetari gose omwando ase omochie o tata?

English: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.
Kiswahili: Je, yeye hatuhesabu sisi kama wageni? Sio kwamba ametuuza tu, bali ametumia hata na vile vilivyolipwa kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Tatokorete buna abamenyi? Naki nigo atoonetie, naende akaria enibo eria yonsi.

English: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”
Kiswahili: Hakika utajiri wote ambao Mungu ameuchukua kutoka kwa baba yetu ni mali yetu na watoto wetu. Hivyo fanya lolote lile Mungu alilokuambia.”
Ekegusii: Naki enibo eyio yonsi Nyasae arusirie korwa ase tata nigo etotungetie intwe na abana baito. Ase igo, ayio onsi Nyasae agoteebirie, yakore.”

English: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yakobo akawapandisha watoto wake na wake zake juu ya ngamia,
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akaimoka, akariinia abana baye na abakungu baye ase chingamia igoro;

English: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: naye akawaswaga wanyama wote mbele yake pamoja na vitu vyote alivyokuwa amechuma huko Padan-Aramu kwenda kwa baba yake Isaki katika nchi ya Kanaani.
Ekegusii: akaira amaicho aye onsi, na enibo yaye yonsi eyio anyorete ase Padan-Aramu, erio akagenda ase ense ya Kaanani o Isaka ise.

English: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.
Kiswahili: Labani alipokuwa amekwenda kukata kondoo wake manyoya, Raheli aliiba miungu ya nyumba ya baba yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Labani konya achiire konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya, Raeli akaiba ebinyasae biaye bi’ogosasiimwa, ebiareenge nyomba mwaye.

English: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Yakobo alimdanganya Labani Mwaramu kwa kutokumwambia kwamba anakimbia.
Ekegusii: Yakobo nigo agendete bobisi korwa o Labani Omoaramu, tamoteebetie ng’a nkogenda are sobo.

English: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akakimbia pamoja na vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo na kuvuka Mto Frati akaelekea nchi ya vilima katika Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Agatama amo nenibo yaye yonsi eye abwate, akaamboka orooche roria rware korokwa Eufarati, akagenda gochia ebitunwa bia Gileadi.

English: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
Kiswahili: Siku ya tatu Labani akaambiwa kwamba Yakobo amekimbia.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato Labani agateebigwa ng’a Yakobo otamire.

English: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Akiwachukua jamaa zake, akamfuatia Yakobo kwa siku saba na kumkuta kwenye nchi ya vilima katika Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Erio Labani akaira abamwabo, bakamobwatia ase orogendo rw’amatuko atano na abere, akamoikeera ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi.

English: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akamjia Labani Mwaramu katika ndoto usiku na kumwambia, “Jihadhari usiseme neno lolote kwa Yakobo, liwe zuri au baya.”
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agaachera Labani Omoaramu ase chindoto botuko, akamoteebia: “Bwerende, tobaisa kwomania Yakobo, korende okwane nere ase obwororo.”

English: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Yakobo alikuwa amepiga hema lake katika nchi ya vilima katika Gileadi wakati Labani alipomkuta, Labani na jamaa yake wakapiga kambi huko pia.
Ekegusii: Ekero Labani aikeereire Yakobo, Yakobo nere konya otenenirie eema yaye agwo ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi. Labani nere amo nabamwabo bagatenenia chiema chiabo agwo.

English: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Labani akamwambia Yakobo, “Umefanya nini? Umenidanganya na umewachukua binti zangu kama mateka katika vita.
Ekegusii: Labani akabooria Yakobo: “Inki eke gwakorire iga? Ninki okong’ainera, na koira abana baane abasubati buna abasakorwa korwa ase esegi?

English: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;
Kiswahili: Kwa nini ulikimbia kwa siri na kunidanganya? Kwa nini hukuniambia ili nikuage kwa furaha na nyimbo za matari na vinubi?
Ekegusii: Nase ki gwatamete okeiberia, tigwanteebia? Inche anga nagokoobete nomochengo na amatera, na kobugia chikonu na amakano.

English: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.
Kiswahili: Hata hukuniruhusu niwabusu wajukuu zangu na kuwaaga binti zangu. Umefanya kitu cha kipumbavu.
Ekegusii: Naki otantigerete ribaga inyunyunte abachokoro baane na abana baane abasubati, mbaganerie amaya ase orogendo rwabo? Amaene, aye nigo gwankorerete egento ki’oboriri.

English: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’
Kiswahili: Nina uwezo wa kukudhuru, lakini usiku uliopita Mungu wa baba yako alisema nami, akaniambia, ‘Jihadhari, usiseme neno lolote kwa Yakobo liwe zuri au baya.’
Ekegusii: Ninde nokobua gw’okogokorera amabe, korende Nyasae o iso nakwanete nainche ase obotuko bwaetete, agankurera aganteebia: Bwerende, tobaisa kwomania Yakobo, korende okwane nere ase obwororo.

English: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”
Kiswahili: Sasa umeondoka kwa sababu umetamani kurudi nyumbani kwa baba yako. Lakini kwa nini umeiba miungu yangu?”
Ekegusii: Na bono gwachiire, ekiagera ore namaiga amange ay’abaanto banka seino, korende naki gwakorete okaiba emegwekano y’enyasae yane?”

English: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’
Kiswahili: Yakobo akamjibu Labani, “Niliogopa, kwa sababu nilifikiri ungeweza kuninyangʼanya binti zako kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria, akamoteebia: “Nigo noboete, nkarengereria ng’a nobaise kong’ura abana bao abasubati.

English: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama ukimkuta yeyote aliye na miungu yako, hataishi. Mbele ya jamaa yetu, angalia mwenyewe uone kama kuna chochote chako hapa nilicho nacho, kama kipo, kichukue.” Basi Yakobo hakujua kwamba Raheli alikuwa ameiba hiyo miungu.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oranyore obwate ebinyasae biao goika aitwe akwe. Tiga abaminto aba bare aa babe kirori. Rigia! Koranyore kende kiao kere ase ’nde, okeire.” Yakobo tamanyete ng’a Raeli obiibire.

English: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Labani akaingia ndani ya hema la Yakobo na ndani ya hema la Lea na ndani ya hema la watumishi wawili wa kike, lakini hakukuta chochote. Baadaye alipotoka katika hema la Lea, akaingia hema la Raheli.
Ekegusii: Erio Labani agasoa eema ya Yakobo, na eya Lea, na ey’abakungu baria babere abasomba, tanyora kende. Agasoka korwa ase eema ya Lea, agasoa eya Raeli.

English: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.
Kiswahili: Basi Raheli ndiye alikuwa amechukua ile miungu ya nyumbani kwao na kuiweka katika matandiko ya ngamia na kukalia. Labani akatafuta kila mahali kwenye hema lakini hakupata chochote.
Ekegusii: Korende Raeli konya obisire ebinyasae ebio ase egeikaransero kiaye igoro y’engamia, akaba obiikaranserete. Labani akariga‐rigia eema ime, tabinyora.

English: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.
Kiswahili: Raheli akamwambia baba yake, “Usikasirike, bwana wangu kwa kuwa siwezi kusimama ukiwepo, niko katika hedhi.” Labani akatafuta lakini hakuweza kuipata miungu ya nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Raeli agateebia ise: “Tata, onyabere, tobaisa kombea, naki tinkonyara koimoka ase obosio bwao, ekiagera nimbwate engencho yaito intwe abakungu.” Nabo akariga‐rigia, korende tanyora chinyasae chiaye.

English: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?
Kiswahili: Yakobo akakasirika na kumshutumu Labani, akisema, “Uhalifu wangu ni nini?” Akamuuliza Labani, “Ni dhambi gani niliyofanya hata unaniwinda?
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akabea mono, akomania Labani ase okomotogonyera na goteeba: “Nkomocha ki nakorire? Nebibe biane nakorire mbiribi, goika kwagerire nabeire nobororo engencho enga eye?

English: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.
Kiswahili: Sasa kwa kuwa umepekua vitu vyangu vyote umepata nini kilicho cha nyumbani mwako? Kiweke hapa mbele ya jamaa yako na yangu, nao waamue kati yetu sisi wawili.
Ekegusii: Kwariga‐rigirie ase ebinto bionsi. Ngento ki kiao kwanyorao narentanire? Kebeke aiga ase obosio bw’abaminto na obw’abamino, batwatanane inche naye.

English: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.
Kiswahili: “Mpaka sasa nimekuwa pamoja nawe miaka ishirini. Kondoo wako na mbuzi wako hawajaharibu mimba, wala sijala kondoo dume kutoka makundi yako.
Ekegusii: Bono inche namenyire bwoo emiaka emerongo ebere. Ching’ondi chiao gose chimbori, ekero chianga amarieme, ende terekereti; gose inche tinyenyeti chimingichi chinde chie riicho riao, na gochiria.

English: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
Kiswahili: Sikukuletea mfugo aliyeraruliwa na wanyama pori, nilibeba hasara mimi mwenyewe. Tena ulinidai malipo kwa chochote kilichoibwa mchana au usiku.
Ekegusii: Echiaitetwe ne chinyang’au tingochirentereti, ninche omonyene nachiakanete. Echiaibetwe mobaso gose botuko ogachinsaba korwa ase amaboko aane.

English: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo iliyokuwa hali yangu: Niliumia kwa joto la mchana na baridi usiku, pia usingizi ulinipa.
Ekegusii: Eye nero yareenge engencho yane: Riberera ri’omobaso boira rikaba rigonsamba, na obokendu boganchanda botuko, ne chitoro chikaera korwa ase amaiso aane.

English: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa hivi kwa miaka ile ishirini niliyokuwa nyumbani kwako. Nilikutumikia miaka ile kumi na minne kwa ajili ya binti zako wawili, miaka sita kwa ajili ya makundi yako, nawe ulibadilisha ujira wangu mara kumi.
Ekegusii: Emiaka eye emerongo ebere imenyete bwoo, nabeire nkogokorera emiaka ikomi na ene ase okonyora abaiseke bao babere, na emiaka etano nomo ase okonyora amaicho ao, na aye kwabeire gokoonchora eng’eria yane ara ikomi.

English: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”
Kiswahili: Kama Mungu wa baba yangu, Mungu wa Abrahamu na Hofu ya Isaki, hakuwa pamoja nami, hakika ungenifukuza mikono mitupu. Lakini Mungu ameona taabu yangu na kazi ngumu ya mikono yangu, naye usiku uliopita amekukemea.”
Ekegusii: Onye Nyasae o tata, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae oyio Isaka airogete ataarenge amo nainche, amaene, nanga nigo gwanseria bono inde namaboko amasa. Emechando na emeremo yane Nyasae oyerorire, Ase igo ere nagotogonyerete obotuko bwaetete.”

English: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?
Kiswahili: Labani akamjibu Yakobo, “Wanawake hawa ni binti zangu, watoto hawa ni watoto wangu na makundi haya ni makundi yangu. Vyote unavyoviona ni vyangu. Lakini hata hivyo ninaweza kufanya nini kuhusu hawa binti zangu, au kuhusu watoto waliowazaa?
Ekegusii: Labani akairaneria Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Abasubati aba nabana baane, na abana babo nabarabwo nabana baane, na amaicho aya, naro nayaane, na bionsi ebio orooche nebiane. Bono ninki ndanyare gokorera abana baane na abana babo baiboire?

English: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”
Kiswahili: Njoo sasa na tufanye agano, wewe na mimi, na liwe kama shahidi kati yetu.”
Ekegusii: Inchuo bono, tokore okobwatana, aye nainche, na korokwo inakobe kirori egati yao nainche.”

English: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yakobo akachukua jiwe, akalisimamisha kama nguzo.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaimokia rigena, akaritenenia ribe esiiro y’ekeinyorio.

English: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia jamaa yake, “Kusanyeni mawe.” Hivyo wakachukua mawe na kuyakusanya yakawa lundo, wakala chakula hapo karibu na hilo lundo.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agateebia abamwabo: “Sangereria amagena”, na barabwo bakayasangereria, bakayakora etui, bakariera endagera ase etui eyio.

English: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
Kiswahili: Labani akaliita Yegar-Sahadutha na Yakobo akaliita Galeedi.
Ekegusii: Labani akayeroka Yegari‐Sahaduta, korende Yakobo akayeroka Galeedi.

English: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed
Kiswahili: Labani akasema, “Lundo hili ni shahidi kati yako na mimi leo.” Ndiyo maana likaitwa Galeedi.
Ekegusii: Labani akabora: “Etui eye nero kirori egati yane naye reero iga.” Ase ayio akayeroka Galeedi.

English: and Mizpah, for he said, “Yahweh watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.
Kiswahili: Pia liliitwa Mispa, kwa sababu alisema, “Bwana na aweke ulinzi kati yako na mimi wakati kila mmoja akiwa mbali na mwingine.
Ekegusii: Naende ekarokwa Misipa, naki nigo ateebete: “Omonene nere orabe ogotorigereria aye nainche, ekero torabe totarochaini.

English: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”
Kiswahili: Kama ukiwatenda mabaya binti zangu au ukioa wake wengine zaidi ya binti zangu, hata ingawa hakuna hata mmoja aliye pamoja nasi, kumbuka kwamba Mungu ni shahidi kati yako na mimi.”
Ekegusii: Korabe gokobachanda abana baane abasubati, gose gokonyuoma abakungu bande abaao goetania barabwo, manya ng’a nonya monto onde taiyo oyarooche, rora, Nyasae nere kirori egati yao nainche.”

English: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.
Kiswahili: Pia Labani akamwambia Yakobo, “Hili ndilo lundo, na hii ndiyo nguzo niliyoisimamisha kati yako na mimi.
Ekegusii: Erio Labani agateebia Yakobo: “Rigereria etui eye na esiiro eye, natenenirie egati yao nainche.

English: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
Kiswahili: Lundo hili ni shahidi na nguzo hii ni shahidi, kwamba sitavuka lundo hili kuja upande wako kukudhuru, nawe kwamba hutavuka lundo hili na nguzo hii kuja upande wangu kunidhuru.
Ekegusii: Etui eye ebe kirori, na esiiro eye ebe kirori boigo, ng’a tingotamboka etui eye inchiche bwoo, gose aye togoetania etui eye na esiiro eye ochiche bwone, tokorerane amabe.

English: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.
Kiswahili: Mungu wa Abrahamu na Mungu wa Nahori, Mungu wa baba zao, aamue kati yetu.” Hivyo Yakobo akaapa kwa jina la Hofu ya baba yake Isaki.
Ekegusii: Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae o Nahori, oyorenge Nyasae o ise obo, agambe ase egati yaito.” Ase igo, Yakobo agatiana ase Oyio Isaka ise airogete.

English: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akatoa dhabihu juu ya kilima na akawaalika jamaa zake kula chakula. Baada ya kula, wakalala huko.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akarua ekeng’wanso agwo ase egetunwa, akarangeria abanto baye bache koragera amo nere, bakaba aroro ase egetunwa obotuko obwo bwonsi.

English: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema, Labani akawabusu wajukuu zake, binti zake na kuwabariki. Kisha akaondoka, akarudi nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Mambia chuni Labani akaimoka, akaagata abachokoro baye na abana baye abasubati, akabasesenia; erio akairana gocha bwoye.

English: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
Kiswahili: Yakobo pia akaondoka akaenda zake, nao malaika wa Mungu wakakutana naye.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akagenderera norogendo rwaye, bakaumerana nabamalaika ba Nyasae.

English: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.
Kiswahili: Yakobo alipowaona, akasema, “Hii ni kambi ya Mungu!” Kwa hiyo akapaita mahali pale Mahanaimu.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Yakobo abarooche akabora: “Oyo nomoganda o Nyasae!” Ase igo, Akaaroka aase aria Mahanaimu.

English: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akatuma wajumbe kumtangulia kwa Esau ndugu yake huko Seiri, katika nchi ya Edomu.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agatoma abatomwa batang’ane kogenda ase Esau momura omwabo, baike ensemo ya Edomu, ase ense y’Edomu.

English: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.
Kiswahili: Akawaagiza akisema: “Hili ndilo mtakalomwambia bwana wangu Esau: ‘Mtumishi wako Yakobo anasema, nimekuwa nikiishi pamoja na Labani na nimekuwako huko mpaka sasa.
Ekegusii: Akabachiika bateebie Esau omonene oye iga: “Aya naro Yakobo, omosomba oo, agokwana: Nabeire nkomenya ase ense y’obogeni, ense ya Labani goika reero iga;

English: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”
Kiswahili: Ninao ngʼombe na punda, kondoo na mbuzi, watumishi wa kiume na wa kike. Sasa ninatuma ujumbe huu kwa bwana wangu, ili nipate kibali machoni pako.’ ”
Ekegusii: nanyorire chiombe, ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke. Na bono, omonene one, nigo natomire abanto nkomanyie amang’ana ayio, inyoore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao.”

English: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”
Kiswahili: Wajumbe waliporudi kwa Yakobo, wakamwambia, “Tulikwenda kuonana na ndugu yako Esau, naye sasa anakuja kukulaki akifuatana na wanaume 400.”
Ekegusii: Abatomwa baria, ekero bairanete ase Yakobo bakamoteebia: “Ntwaika o momura omino Esau, ere ngocha are gokorotota ore nabaanto amagana ane (400).”

English: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.
Kiswahili: Kwa hofu kuu na huzuni, Yakobo akagawanya watu aliokuwa nao katika makundi mawili, pia akagawanya makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi, na vilevile ngʼombe na ngamia.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaondoka mono na koumata, agaatanana abanto baria baarenge amo nere, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chingamia, bikaba ebiombe bibere,

English: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”
Kiswahili: Yakobo alifikiri, “Kama Esau akija na kushambulia kundi moja, kundi lililobaki litaweza likanusurika.”
Ekegusii: akarengereria ng’a: “Esau karache aumokere ekeombe kie ritang’ani na kogesiria, keria kende nagetooreke.”

English: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Yahweh, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yakobo akaomba, “Ee Mungu wa baba yangu Abrahamu, Mungu wa baba yangu Isaki, Ee Bwana, ambaye uliniambia, ‘Rudi katika nchi yako na jamaa yako, nami nitakufanya ustawi,’
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agasaba, akabora: “Aye Nyasae o sokoro yane Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka tata, aye Omonene, gwanteebetie ng’a: Oirane gochia seino, na eamate yao, na inche ningokorere amaya.

English: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.
Kiswahili: mimi sistahili fadhili na uaminifu wako wote ulionitendea mimi mtumishi wako. Nilikuwa na fimbo tu mkononi mwangu nilipovuka mto huu wa Yordani, lakini sasa ninayo makundi mawili.
Ekegusii: Inche tingwenereti nonya ng’ake obuya na obwegenwa bwonsi gwankorerete inche, omosomba oo, naki engaki naambogeete orooche rwa Yorodani nigo nabwate enyimbo yoka koboko kwane, na bono nabeire ebiombe bibere.

English: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.
Kiswahili: Nakuomba, uniokoe na mkono wa ndugu yangu Esau, kwa maana ninaogopa kuwa atakuja kunishambulia, pia mama pamoja na watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Koranche ontoorie bono korwa ase okoboko kw’oyominto Esau, ekiagera nairokire ng’a nabaise kong’ita, aite na abakungu na abana.

English: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini umeshasema, ‘Hakika nitakufanya ustawi na kuufanya uzao wako kuwa mwingi kama mchanga wa baharini ambao hauwezi kuhesabika!’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende aye ngwanteebetie: Ningokorere amaya, ninkore ororeeria rwao robe buna omokenye o nyancha, otanyare kobareka, ekiagera nomonge.”

English: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:
Kiswahili: Akalala pale usiku ule, miongoni mwa vitu alivyokuwa navyo, akachagua zawadi kwa ajili ya Esau ndugu yake:
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaraara aroro ase obotuko obwo; agachora korwa ase etugo eria abwate, echio aranyare koa Esau omwabo ebiegwa.

English: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
Kiswahili: Mbuzi waume ishirini na mbuzi wake 200, kondoo dume ishirini na kondoo wake 200.
Ekegusii: Agachoora chimbori chiaberi amagana abere, ne chigoree emerongo ebere, ne ching’ondi chiaberi amagana abere, ne chimingichi emerongo ebere,

English: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.
Kiswahili: Ngamia wake thelathini pamoja na ndama zao, ngʼombe wake arobaini na mafahali kumi, punda wake ishirini na punda waume kumi.
Ekegusii: ne chingamia chiare gokamwa emerongo etato, amo ne chimori chiabo, ne chiombe chiaberi emerongo ene, ne chieeri ikomi, ne chitigere chiaberi emerongo ebere, ne chitigere chinsacha ikomi.

English: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”
Kiswahili: Akaviweka chini ya uangalizi wa watumishi wake, kila kundi peke yake na kuwaambia, “Nitangulieni na kuacha nafasi kati ya makundi.”
Ekegusii: Akabeeka ching’iti echio ase amaboko ’abasomba baye, kera riicho akaribeeka ao, agateebia abasomba baye: “Eta motang’ane, na egati ya kera riicho motige ribaga.”

English: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’
Kiswahili: Akamwagiza yule aliyetangulia kuwa, “Ndugu yangu Esau atakapokutana nawe na kukuuliza, ‘Wewe ni wa nani? Unakwenda wapi? Wanyama hawa wote mbele yako ni mali ya nani?’
Ekegusii: Agachiika omosomba oria bw’eritang’ani, akamoteebia: “Esau ominto, ekero araumerane naye, na gokoboria: Noyo ng’o ore? Ng’ai ogochia? Etugo eye otang’anetie, neya ng’o?.

English: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”
Kiswahili: Ndipo utakaposema, ‘Ni mali ya mtumishi wako Yakobo. Ni zawadi ambazo zimetumwa kwa bwana wangu Esau, naye anakuja nyuma yetu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio omoiranerie, omoteebie: Ney’omosomba oo Yakobo, nekeegwa akorenteire aye omonene one Esau; ere omonyene ngotobwatia are korwa magega,”

English: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.
Kiswahili: Akamwagiza pia yule mtumishi wa kundi la pili, la tatu na yale mengine yote yaliyofuata akiwaambia, “Mtamwambia Esau maneno hayo hayo mtakapokutana naye.
Ekegusii: Agachiika naende oyo o kabere, na oyo o gatato, na abande bonsi abaare gotunyana amaicho, akabateebia: “Moteebie Esau amang’ana ayio ayio ekero mokoumerana nere.

English: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”
Kiswahili: Hakikisheni mmesema, ‘Mtumishi wako Yakobo anakuja nyuma yetu.’ ” Kwa kuwa alifikiri, “Nitaweza kumtuliza kwa zawadi hizi ninazotanguliza, hatimaye, nitakapomwona, huenda atanikubali.”
Ekegusii: Naende momoteebie: Omosomba oo Yakobo ngotobwatia are korwa magega.” Ere nigo arengereretie ng’a: “Nimwororobie nebiegwa ebi namotang’aneirie; magega yaye nindore obosio bwaye, aande nanyanchere.”

English: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo zawadi za Yakobo zilitangulia mbele yake, lakini yeye mwenyewe alilala kambini usiku ule.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ebiegwa biria bigatang’anigwa gochia bosio bwaye, ere omonyene akaraara obotuko obwo aase aria atenenetie eema yaye.

English: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule Yakobo akaamka akawachukua wake zake wawili, watumishi wake wawili wa kike na wanawe kumi na mmoja na akavuka kivuko cha Yaboki.
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo Yakobo akaimoka, akaira abakungu baye babere, na abasomba baye babere abakungu, na abana baye ikomi nomo, akaamboka orooche rwa Yaboki.

English: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwavusha ngʼambo ya kijito, alivusha pia mali zake zote.
Ekegusii: Akabaimokia, akabaambokia orooche, akaambokia na bionsi ebi areenge nabio.

English: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo akaachwa peke yake na mtu mmoja akashikana naye mweleka mpaka mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agatigara ere bweka. Erio omonto oyomo agacha bagakinana nere, goika bogakiamoka.

English: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu alipoona kuwa hawezi kumshinda, aligusa kiungio cha nyonga ya Yakobo kwa hiyo nyonga yake ikateguka wakati alipokuwa akishikana mweleka na yule mtu.
Ekegusii: Nere omonto oria, ekero arora ng’a tari kobua Yakobo, akamokuna enengo y’ebachwa, akamoteng’eria, kobagendererete gokinana.

English: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule mtu akasema, “Niache niende, kwa kuwa ni mapambazuko.” Lakini Yakobo akajibu, “Sitakuacha uende usiponibariki.”
Ekegusii: Erio akamoteebia: “Ntige ngende, ekiagera bwakiire.” Korende Yakobo akamoteebia: “Tingokoa ribaga ogende, otaransesenia.”

English: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akamuuliza, “Jina lako nani?” Akajibu, “Yakobo.”
Ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Naki okorokwa?” Akamoiraneria: “Yakobo.”

English: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule mtu akasema, “Jina lako halitakuwa tena Yakobo, bali Israeli, kwa sababu umeshindana na Mungu na watu pia, nawe umeshinda.”
Ekegusii: Erio akamoteebia: “Bono tokorokwa naende Yakobo, nigo orarokwe Israeli, ekiagera mwakinanire na Nyasae na abanto, na aye kwabuire.”

English: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akasema, “Tafadhali niambie jina lako.” Lakini akajibu, “Kwa nini kuniuliza Jina langu?” Ndipo akambariki huko.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akamobooria: “Koranche, onteebie erieta riao.” Korende akamoteebia: “Nase ki okomboria erieta riane?” Agwo akamosesenia.

English: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo akapaita mahali pale Penieli, akasema, “Ni kwa sababu nimemwona Mungu uso kwa uso na bado maisha yangu yameokoka.”
Ekegusii: Yakobo Akaaroka aase aria Penieli, naki nigo ateebete: “Naroranire na Nyasae obosio ase obosio, na obogima bwane bwatoorigwe.”

English: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.
Kiswahili: Jua lilikuwa linachomoza Yakobo alipoondoka Penueli, naye alikuwa akichechemea kwa sababu ya nyonga yake.
Ekegusii: Erioba rikaorokera Yakobo kagoeta Penueli, akaba ogosegora, ekiagera ateng’eretigwe enengo y’ebachwa.

English: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mpaka leo Waisraeli hawali mshipa ulioungana na kiungio cha nyonga, kwa sababu kiungio cha nyonga ya Yakobo kiliteguliwa karibu na mshipa huo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli tibari koria omoki bw’enengo y’ebachwa goika reero iga, ekiagera omonto oria namoteng’eretie Yakobo omoki bw’enengo y’ebachwa yaye.

English: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akainua macho akamwona Esau akija na watu wake 400, kwa hiyo akawagawanya watoto kati ya Lea, Raheli na wale watumishi wake wawili wa kike.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarigereria, akarora Esau ogocha amo nabaanto amagana ane. Erio agaatanana abana, akaa kera omokungu abaye, Lea, na Raeli, na abakungu baria babere abasomba.

English: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
Kiswahili: Akawaweka wale watumishi wa kike na watoto wao mbele, Lea na watoto wake wakafuata, Raheli na Yosefu wakaja nyuma.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka abakungu baria abasomba amo nabana babo batang’ane, na Lea amo nabana baye korwa magega yabo, na Raeli na Yusufu akababeeka magega kegima.

English: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
Kiswahili: Yeye mwenyewe akatangulia mbele na kusujudu mara saba alipomkaribia ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Ere omonyene agatang’ana bosio bwabo, akaba okona‐gotung’ama inse chintunda isano na ibere goika agaika ase oyomwabo.

English: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.
Kiswahili: Lakini Esau akamkimbilia Yakobo kumlaki na kumkumbatia, akamwangukia shingoni na kumbusu. Nao wakalia.
Ekegusii: Esau akaminyoka gochia komorotota, akamoboania rigoti riaye, na komoagata, barabwo bakareererana.

English: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”
Kiswahili: Esau akainua macho akawaona wale wanawake na watoto. Akauliza, “Hawa uliofuatana nao ni nani?” Yakobo akamjibu, “Ni watoto ambao Mungu amempa mtumishi wako kwa neema.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Esau achia koimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora abakungu na abana, akamobooria: “Aba nabang’o more komo?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Aba nabana Nyasae ang’eire inche, omosomba oo, ase obuya bwaye.”

English: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.
Kiswahili: Kisha wale watumishi wa kike na watoto wao wakakaribia na kusujudu.
Ekegusii: Erio abakungu baria abasomba bagasuka gochia ang’e, kera oyomo nabana baye, bagatung’ama inse.

English: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
Kiswahili: Kisha Lea na watoto wake wakaja na kusujudu. Mwisho wa wote wakaja Yosefu na Raheli, nao pia wakasujudu.
Ekegusii: Lea nere boigo agasuka gochia ang’e amo n’abana baye, nabarabwo bagatung’ama inse. Magega kegima Yusufu na Raeli bagasuka gochia ang’e, nabarabwo boigo bagatung’ama inse.

English: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”
Kiswahili: Esau akauliza, “Una maana gani kuhusu makundi hayo yote niliyokutana nayo?” Akasema, “Ni ili kupata kibali machoni pako, bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Naende Esau akamobooria: “Emeganda eye yonsi twaumerana gochia aa, neya ki?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Engencho yaye inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, aye omonene one.”

English: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Esau akamwambia, “Ndugu yangu, tayari nina wingi wa mali. Ulivyo navyo viwe vyako mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Esau akamoiraneria: “Oyominto, echi mbwate nching’isaine. Echire echiao, kabe nachirochio.”

English: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akasema, “La hasha! Tafadhali, kama nimepata kibali machoni pako, upokee zawadi hii kutoka kwangu. Kwa maana kuuona uso wako, ni kama kuuona uso wa Mungu, kwa kuwa umenipokea kwa takabali kubwa.
Ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akamoteebia: “Taibo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, koranche obwate ekeegwa eke korwa ase okoboko kwane; naki okorora obosio bwao nigo enga buna okorora obosio bwa Nyasae, ase ogwanchera kwanyancheire inche.

English: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali ukubali zawadi iliyoletwa kwako, kwa kuwa Mungu amenineemesha na ninavyo vyote ninavyohitaji.” Kwa sababu Yakobo alisisitiza, Esau akapokea.
Ekegusii: Koranche oire ebiegwa ebi nakorenteire, ekiagera Nyasae onkoreire obuya obonge, na inche nimbwate ebing’isaine.” Naboigo ere akaebereria Esau na ere agancha, akabiira.

English: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Esau akasema, “Na tuendelee na safari, nitakuwa pamoja nawe.”
Ekegusii: Erio Esau akamoteebia: “Eta, togende seito, na inche ningotang’ane.”

English: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yakobo akamwambia, “Bwana wangu unajua kwamba watoto ni wachanga na kwamba ni lazima nitunze hawa kondoo wake na ngʼombe wanaonyonyesha. Wakipelekwa kwa haraka hata kama ni kwa siku moja tu, wanyama wote watakufa.
Ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Omonene one, nomanyete ng’a abana nebing’werere mbwate, naende chimbori ne ching’ondi nigo chibwate chimanwa chikogonka, ne chiombe boigo. Ching’iti echio chiise koayererigwa ase rituko erimo, nigo chirakwe chionsi.

English: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo bwana wangu umtangulie mtumishi wako, wakati mimi nikija polepole kwa mwendo wa makundi yaliyo mbele yangu na mwendo wa watoto, mpaka nifike kwa bwana wangu huko Seiri.”
Ekegusii: Koranche, omonene one, oete otang’ane bosio bwane, inche omosomba oo; na inche nindaae ching’iti echio ng’ora ng’ora, buna orogendo rwabo rong’ana, na abana buna chinguru chiabo ching’ana, goika ng’ike bwoo, omonene one, aaria Edomu.”

English: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
Kiswahili: Esau akamwambia, “Basi na niwaache baadhi ya watu wangu pamoja nawe.” Yakobo akauliza, “Lakini kwa nini ufanye hivyo, niache tu nipate kibali machoni pa bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Esau akamoteebia: “Ningotigere abanto bande ase aba inde nabwo.” Korende Yakobo akairaneria: “Bakore ki? Otatiga ndore ng’a nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, omonene one.”

English: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
Kiswahili: Hivyo siku hiyo Esau akashika njia akarudi Seiri.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Esau akabwatia enchera, akairana gochia Edomu.

English: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hayo, Yakobo akaenda Sukothi, mahali alipojijengea makazi kwa ajili yake na mabanda kwa ajili ya mifugo yake. Hii ndiyo sababu sehemu ile inaitwa Sukothi.
Ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akagenderera, agaika Sukoti, akeagachera enyomba, akaagachera na amaicho aye ebigutu. Ase igo, aase aria akarokwa Sukoti.

English: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yakobo kutoka Padan-Aramu, alifika salama katika mji wa Shekemu huko Kanaani na kuweka kambi yake karibu na mji.
Ekegusii: Yakobo kairanire korwa Padan‐Aramu, agaika buya ase omorembe ase Sekemu, omochie omonene bw’ense ya Kaanani, agatenenia eema yaye isiko y’omochie oyio.

English: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.
Kiswahili: Akanunua kiwanja kutoka kwa wana wa Hamori, baba wa Shekemu, kwa bei ya vipande mia vya fedha, ambapo alipiga hema lake.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Hamori, ise Sekemu, Yakobo akagora oboremo obwo ase rigori rie chifeta rigana erimo, agwo ase atenenetie eema yaye.

English: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.
Kiswahili: Pale akajenga madhabahu na kupaita El-Elohe-Israeli.
Ekegusii: Akaagacha agwo egesasiimero, agakeroka Eli‐Elohe‐Israeli.

English: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
Kiswahili: Basi Dina, binti wa Yakobo aliyezaliwa na Lea, akatoka nje kuwatembelea wanawake wa nchi ile.
Ekegusii: Bono Dina, omoiseke o Lea, oyio Lea aiborerete Yakobo, akagenda kororana nabaiseke b’ense eria.

English: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
Kiswahili: Ikawa Shekemu mwana wa Hamori Mhivi, mtawala wa eneo lile alipomwona, akamchukua na kumnajisi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Sekemu, omwana o Hamori Omohivi, omonene bw’ense eria, amorooche, akamobwata, akaba nere, akamosareria obwekungi bwaye.

English: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.
Kiswahili: Moyo wake ukavutwa sana kwa Dina binti Yakobo, akampenda huyu msichana na akazungumza naye kwa kumbembeleza.
Ekegusii: Korende magega y’ayio agakorera Dina, omoiseke oyio o Yakobo, buya, akamwancha na gokwana nere amang’ana amaya.

English: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”
Kiswahili: Shekemu akamwambia baba yake Hamori, “Nipatie msichana huyu awe mke wangu.”
Ekegusii: Sekemu agakwana na Hamori ise, akamoteebia: “Mborerie omoiseke oyo abe mokane!”

English: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.
Kiswahili: Yakobo aliposikia kwamba binti yake Dina amenajisiwa, wanawe walikuwa mashambani wakichunga mifugo yake, kwa hiyo akalinyamazia jambo hilo mpaka waliporudi nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo achia koigwa ng’a Sekemu osaririe Dina, omoiseke oye, abamura baye ngetii baarenge korisia, Ase igo Yakobo agakira‐kiri goika bakairana inka.

English: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Hamori baba yake Shekemu akaenda kuzungumza na Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Hamori, ise Sekemu, akaimoka akagenda o Yakobo gokwana nere.

English: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.
Kiswahili: Basi wana wa Yakobo walikuwa wamerudi kutoka mashambani mara tu waliposikia kilichotokea. Walikuwa wamejawa na huzuni na ghadhabu, kwa sababu Shekemu alikuwa amefanya jambo la aibu katika Israeli kwa kukutana kimwili na binti wa Yakobo, kitu ambacho hakingepasa kufanyika.
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Yakobo, ekero bachia koigwa ayio, bagacha korwa getii, bare nobororo na ekeririanda ekenene mono, ekiagera Sekemu akorete obokayayu ase Abaisraeli ase okomotachera inse omoiseke o Yakobo, ring’ana ritagwenerete gokoreka.

English: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
Kiswahili: Lakini Hamori akawaambia, “Moyo wa mwanangu Shekemu umeelekea kwa binti yenu. Tafadhali mpeni awe mke wake.
Ekegusii: Hamori agakwana nabarabwo, akabora: “Omomura one Sekemu omwanchire omoiseke oino, bono komoranche, momomoe amonyuome.

English: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
Kiswahili: Oaneni na sisi, tupeni binti zenu, nanyi mchukue binti zetu.
Ekegusii: Tonyuomerane intwe nainwe, motoe abaiseke baino, naintwe tobae abaito.

English: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”
Kiswahili: Mwaweza kuishi katikati yetu, nchi ni wazi kwenu. Ishini ndani yake, fanyeni biashara humu na mjipatie mali.”
Ekegusii: Inwe nabo moramenye egati yaito, aiga ase ense yaito ribaga ndireo ase more, moramenye na koonchoreria, mwenyorere enibo.”

English: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.
Kiswahili: Kisha Shekemu akamwambia baba yake Dina pamoja na ndugu zake, “Na nipate kibali machoni penu, nami nitawapa chochote mtakachosema.
Ekegusii: Sekemu agateebia ise Dina na bamura bamwabo: “Nyanchere aya naboria aase more, kende gionsi moramboorie nimbae.

English: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”
Kiswahili: Niambieni kiasi cha mahari na zawadi nitakayoileta, hata iwe kubwa kiasi gani, nami nitawalipa chochote mtakachodai. Nipeni tu huyu msichana awe mke wangu.”
Ekegusii: Mboorie enibo ende yonsi na ebiegwa boigo, nimbae buna moraganie, kogicha mong’e omoiseke oyo abe mokane.”

English: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ndugu yao Dina alikuwa amenajisiwa, wana wa Yakobo wakajibu kwa udanganyifu walipozungumza na Shekemu pamoja na baba yake Hamori.
Ekegusii: Erio abamura ba Yakobo bakairaneria Sekemu na Hamori ise ase okong’ainereria, ekiagera konya osaririe Dina, omoiseke omwabo.
