English: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.
Kiswahili: Wakawaambia, “Hatuwezi kufanya jambo kama hili, hatuwezi kumtoa dada yetu kwa mtu ambaye hakutahiriwa. Hiyo itakuwa aibu kwetu.
Ekegusii: Bakairaneria: “Titokonyara gokora ring’ana eri, komoa omonto otaarogeti, omoiseke ominto, ekiagera ayio nigo arabe aya obosooku ase tore.

English: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,
Kiswahili: Tutakuruhusu kwa sharti moja tu, kwamba mtakuwa kama sisi kwa kuwatahiri wanaume wenu wote.
Ekegusii: Natonyare gwancha okoboria kwaino ase ring’ana erimo rioka, naende nario eri: Komoranche mobe buna intwe, kera omonto omosacha ore asemore aarokigwe.

English: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
Kiswahili: Kisha tutawapa binti zetu na sisi tutawachukua binti zenu. Tutaishi kwenu na tutakuwa watu wamoja nanyi.
Ekegusii: Erio ’natobae abaiseke baito, na intwe toire abaino, tomenye amo, tobe abanto abamo.

English: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mkikataa kutahiriwa, tutamchukua ndugu yetu na kuondoka.”
Ekegusii: Korende motancheti mwarokigwe, rirorio nigo torarusie omoiseke oito aa, togende nere.”

English: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
Kiswahili: Pendekezo lao likawa jema kwa Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana abo akagwenera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu.

English: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.
Kiswahili: Kijana mdogo, ambaye alikuwa ameheshimiwa kati ya wote walioishi nyumbani mwa baba yake, hakupoteza muda kufanya waliyoyasema, kwa sababu alikuwa amependezwa sana na binti Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Omomura oyio tatebana gokora ring’ana riria, ekiagera omoiseke oria o Yakobo konya omogweneire. Bono Sekemu nigo asikire kobua abande bonsi ase eamate yabo.

English: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe walikwenda kwenye lango la mji kuzungumza na wenzao wa mjini.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Hamori na Sekemu, omomura oye, bakagenda ase egeita ki’omochie obo, bagakwana nabaanto babo, bakabateebia,

English: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.
Kiswahili: Wakasema, “Hawa watu ni marafiki kwetu, tuwaruhusu waishi katika nchi yetu na kufanya biashara ndani yake, nchi ina nafasi tele kwa ajili yao. Tunaweza kuoa binti zao. Nao wanaweza kuoa binti zetu.
Ekegusii: “Abanto aba babeire abasani baito, tiga bamenye ase ense yaito, babe abaonchoreria, ekiagera ense eye nenene, netoisane twensi, intwe amo na barabwo. Intwe ntonyuomerane na barabwo.

English: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu hao watakuwa tayari kukubali kuishi nasi kama watu wamoja nao kwa sharti kwamba wanaume wetu watahiriwe, kama wao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo banchire komenya seito babe obomo naintwe, korende mbaganetie tokore ring’ana erimo, nario eri, ng’a kera omosacha ore ase tore aarokigwe buna barabwo baarogete.

English: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”
Kiswahili: Je, si mifugo yao, mali zao na wanyama wao wengine wote watakuwa wetu? Basi na tuwape kibali, nao wataishi miongoni mwetu.”
Ekegusii: Amaicho abo, na enibo yabo, na etugo yabo yonsi, inee, tibikoba ebiaito? Tiga twancherane nabarabwo rioka, bamenye aa seito.”

English: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote waliotoka nje ya lango la mji walikubaliana na Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe na kila mwanaume katika mji ule akatahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abamenyete ase omochie oria, bakaigwera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu, na kera omosacha oyomenyeteo akaarokigwa.

English: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku tatu, wakati wote wakiwa wangali katika maumivu, wana wawili wa Yakobo, yaani Simeoni na Lawi, ndugu zake Dina, wakachukua panga zao na kuvamia mji ambao haukutazamia vita, wakaua kila mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato ekero abwo baarogete baarenge koromwa mono, abamura babere ba Yakobo, Simioni na Lawi, bamura ba ng’ina omo na Dina, bakaimoka nemeyio ya birende, bagasoa ase omochie ime mobosokano, bagaita abasacha bonsi abaarengeo.

English: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
Kiswahili: Wakawaua Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe kwa upanga kisha wakamchukua Dina kutoka nyumba ya Shekemu na kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Bagaita Hamori amo na Sekemu momura oye nemeyio ya birende, bakarusia Dina omwabo mwa Sekemu, bakagenda nere.

English: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yakobo walipita juu ya maiti katika kuteka nyara mji ule ambamo dada yao alikuwa amenajisiwa.
Ekegusii: Erio abamura bande ba Yakobo bagachiera abwo baitetwe na bagasakora omochie, ekiagera konya basaririe omoiseke omwabo;

English: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,
Kiswahili: Wakachukua kondoo na mbuzi, ngʼombe, punda na kila kitu kilichokuwa chao ndani ya mji ule na mashambani.
Ekegusii: bakaira ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, na bionsi ebiareenge ase omochie ime, na bionsi ebiareenge ase emegondo boigo.

English: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.
Kiswahili: Walichukua utajiri wao wote pamoja na wanawake na watoto wao, wakachukua nyara kila kitu ndani ya nyumba zao.
Ekegusii: Bagasakora enibo yabo yonsi, na abana babo, na abakungu babo, na bionsi ebiareenge ase chinyomba bakabiira.

English: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yakobo akawaambia Simeoni na Lawi, “Mmeleta taabu kwangu kwa kunifanya ninuke kama uvundo kwa Wakanaani na Waperizi, watu waishio katika nchi hii. Sisi ni wachache, kama wakiunganisha nguvu zao dhidi yangu na kunishambulia, mimi na nyumba yangu tutaangamizwa.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia Simioni na Lawi: “Inwe mwambekire ase emechando, mwankorire ogotioka okobe egati-gati y’abanto b’ebisaku bi’ense eye, Abakaanani na Abaperisi. Inche na abanto baane nabake tore; barabwo baise gosangererekana na kong’umokera nigo barang’ite na gonsiria amo nabaanto baane.”

English: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”
Kiswahili: Lakini wakamjibu, “Je, ilikuwa vyema kumtendea dada yetu kama kahaba?”
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Inee! Nabo barabwo bagwenerete bakorere omoiseke ominto buna omokungu omotayayi?”

English: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia Yakobo, “Panda uende Betheli ukakae huko na ukamjengee Mungu madhabahu huko, Yeye aliyekutokea ulipokuwa unamkimbia Esau ndugu yako.”
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo Nyasae agateebia Yakobo: “Imoka, otiire ogende omenye Beteli, oagachere Nyasae egesasiimero aroro, Nyasae, oyo okoorokerete ekero kware gotama korwa ase Esau momura omino.”

English: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yakobo akawaambia watu wa nyumbani mwake pamoja na wote waliokuwa naye, “Iondoeni miungu ya kigeni ile iliyoko katikati yenu, jitakaseni na mkabadilishe nguo zenu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia abanto baye amo naabwo bonsi baarenge komo: “Rusia emegwekano y’ebinyasae ebigeni b’ebisaku, ebi mobwate ase egati yaino, mwesibie inwe abanyene, moonchorerie chianga chiaino.

English: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”
Kiswahili: Kisha njooni, twende Betheli, mahali nitakapomjengea Mungu madhabahu, aliyenijibu katika siku ya shida yangu, ambaye amekuwa pamoja nami popote nilipokwenda.”
Ekegusii: Toimoke totiire gochia Beteli, erinde ing’agachere Nyasae egesasiimero aroro, Nyasae oyonyigwete ekero keria nareenge nobokong’u, akaba amo nainche ase orogendo rwane rwonsi.”

English: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakampa Yakobo miungu yote ya kigeni waliyokuwa nayo, pamoja na pete zilizokuwa masikioni mwao. Yakobo akavizika chini ya mti wa mwaloni huko Shekemu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaa Yakobo emegwekano y’ebinyasae ebigeni bionsi ebio babwate, na ebigera babeegete ase amato abo, na Yakobo akabitindeka inse y’omote okorokwa omwaloni, oyorenge ang’e na Sekemu.

English: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaondoka, na hofu ya Mungu ikawapata miji yote iliyowazunguka. Kwa hiyo hakuna aliyewafuatia wana wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Ekero baimogete kogenda orogendo rwabo, okoondokia gokarua ase Nyasae, gokabwata abanto b’emechie eria yabaetanaine; Ase igo tibanyara komonyookia basinto ba Yakobo.

English: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
Kiswahili: Yakobo na watu wote waliokuwa pamoja naye wakafika Luzu (ndio Betheli), katika nchi ya Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Yakobo amo nabwo bonsi baarenge nere bagaika omochie o Lusu, Omochie oyio naende noro okorokwa Beteli, oyio ore ime y’ense ya Kaanani

English: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
Kiswahili: Huko akajenga madhabahu na akapaita mahali pale El-Betheli, kwa sababu mahali pale ndipo Mungu alipojifunua kwake alipokuwa akimkimbia ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Agwo akaagacha egesasiimero, Akaaroka aase aria Eli‐Beteli, ekiagera agwo nao Nyasae aorokerete Yakobo, ekero areenge gotama korwa ase oyomwabo.

English: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Debora, mlezi wa Rebeka, akafa na akazikwa chini ya mti wa mwaloni ulioko chini ya Betheli. Kwa hiyo pakaitwa Alon-Bakuthi.
Ekegusii: Agwo Debora, omoreri o Rebeka, agakwa, agatindekwa inse y’omote okorokwa omwaloni. Aase agwo akarokwa Aloni‐Bakuti.

English: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yakobo kurudi kutoka Padan-Aramu, Mungu alimtokea tena na kumbariki.
Ekegusii: Erio naende Nyasae akaorokera Yakobo, ekero Yakobo areenge korwa Padan‐Aramu, Nyasae akamosesenia.

English: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Jina lako ni Yakobo, lakini hutaitwa tena Yakobo, jina lako utakuwa Israeli.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Israeli.
Ekegusii: Agwo Nyasae akamoteebia, “Erieta riao n’Yakobo, bono tokorokwa Yakobo naende, korende nigo orarokwe Israeli.” Ase igo, akamoroka Israeli.

English: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Mungu Mwenyezi, ukazae na kuongezeka. Taifa na jamii ya mataifa itatoka kwako, nao wafalme watatoka viunoni mwako.
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamoteebia, “Inche Nyasae Omobui, genderera gosarara, obuche. Egesaku na emeganda y’ebisaku nigo erarue asore, na abarwoti mbarue asore.

English: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”
Kiswahili: Nchi niliyowapa Abrahamu na Isaki nakupa wewe pia, nami nitawapa wazao wako baada yako.”
Ekegusii: Na ense eye naete Aburaamu na Isaka, ninkoyee aye na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao.”

English: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mungu akapanda juu kutoka kwake mahali pale alipozungumza naye.
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akaimoka akagenda igoro, akarwa asare, agwo ase areenge gokwana nere.

English: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akasimamisha nguzo ya jiwe mahali pale Mungu alipozungumza naye, akamimina sadaka ya kinywaji juu yake, pia akamimina mafuta juu yake.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agatenenia rigena buna esiiro aase aria Nyasae akwanerete amo nere, akaumora ekeng’wanso gi’ekenyugwa amo namaguta igoro yaye.

English: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akapaita mahali pale Mungu alipozungumza naye Betheli.
Ekegusii: Igo Yakobo akaaroka aase aria Nyasae akwanerete amo nere Beteli.

English: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaondoka Betheli. Walipokuwa umbali fulani kabla ya kufika Efrathi, Raheli akaanza kusikia uchungu na alipata shida kuu.
Ekegusii: Erio bagachaaka orogendo rwabo korwa Beteli, ekero batigairie orogendo oroke baike Efarati, Raeli agachaaka kobina ase okoibora, akaba nobokong’u bw’okoibora.

English: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa katika shida hii katika kujifungua, mkunga akamwambia, “Usiogope, kwa sababu umempata mwana mwingine.”
Ekegusii: Ekero areenge koromwa mono, omoiboria akamoteebia: “Toondoka, ekiagera naende nomwana omoisia oraibore.”

English: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Hapo alipopumua pumzi yake ya mwisho, kwa maana alikuwa akifa, akamwita mwanawe Benoni. Lakini babaye akamwita Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Agwo akaba okogireka ase ogokwa; na ekero areenge ang’e ase ogokwa, Akamoroka omwana oyio Ben‐Oni, korende ise akamoroka Benjamini.

English: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Raheli akafa, akazikwa kando ya njia iendayo Efrathi (ndio Bethlehemu).
Ekegusii: Erio Raeli agakwa, agatindekwa agwo ase enchera ekogenda Efarati, nao Bethlehemu.

English: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
Kiswahili: Juu ya kaburi lake, Yakobo akasimamisha nguzo, ambayo mpaka leo inatambulisha kaburi la Raheli.
Ekegusii: Na Yakobo agatenenia rigena ri’ekeinyorio ase embeera ya Raeli, nao rire goika reero iga.

English: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
Kiswahili: Israeli akaendelea tena na safari yake na kupiga hema mbele mnara wa Ederi.
Ekegusii: Erio Israeli akaimoka, akagenda, agatenenia eema yaye ng’umbu y’omoorobiri o Ederi.

English: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
Kiswahili: Wakati Israeli alipokuwa akiishi katika nchi ile, Reubeni mwanawe alikutana kimwili na suria wa baba yake aitwaye Bilha, naye Israeli akasikia jambo hili. Yakobo alikuwa na wana kumi na wawili:
Ekegusii: Engaki eria Israeli amenyete ase ense eria, Rubeni akagenda akaraara na Bilia, omokungu o ise, oria o sere-sere, na Israeli akaigwa amang’ana ayio. Abamura ba Yakobo nigo baarenge ikomi na babere.

English: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Lea walikuwa: Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yakobo, Simeoni, Lawi, Yuda, Isakari na Zabuloni.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lea nabwo aba: Rubeni, omwana omotangi o Yakobo, na Simioni, na Lawi, na Yuda, na Isakaru, na Sabuloni.

English: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Raheli walikuwa: Yosefu na Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Raeli nabwo Yusufu na Benjamini.

English: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
Kiswahili: Wana waliozaliwa na Bilha mtumishi wa kike wa Raheli walikuwa: Dani na Naftali.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bilia, omoiseke omosomba o Raeli, nabwo Dani na Nafutali.

English: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
Kiswahili: Wana waliozaliwa na Zilpa mtumishi wa kike wa Lea walikuwa: Gadi na Asheri. Hawa walikuwa wana wa Yakobo, waliozaliwa kwake akiwa Padan-Aramu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Silpa, omoiseke omosomba o Lea, nabwo Gadi na Aseri. Aba nabwo abana abamura Yakobo aiboreretwe agwo Padan‐Aramu.

English: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akarudi nyumbani kwa baba yake Isaki huko Mamre, karibu na Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni), ambapo walikuwa wameishi Abrahamu na Isaki.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agaika ase omochie o Isaka ise aaria Mamure, ang’e na Kiriati-Ariba, nao Heburoni, agwo ase Aburaamu na Isaka bamenyete buna abamenyi.

English: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
Kiswahili: Isaki aliishi miaka 180.
Ekegusii: Isaka nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na etato (180).

English: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Isaki akapumua pumzi yake ya mwisho akafa, akakusanywa pamoja na watu wake akiwa mzee wa miaka mingi. Nao wanawe Esau na Yakobo wakamzika.
Ekegusii: Erio Isaka ero agakwa, agasangerereka amo nabaanto baye, ore omogotu kegima, omonto bw’emiaka emenge, na abamura baye, Esau na Yakobo, bakamotindeka.

English: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Esau (yaani Edomu).
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Esau, nere Edomu.

English: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
Kiswahili: Esau akaoa wake kutoka miongoni mwa wanawake wa Kanaani: Ada binti wa Eloni Mhiti, Oholibama binti wa Ana, mjukuu wa kike wa Sibeoni Mhivi,
Ekegusii: Esau akanyuoma abakungu baye korwa ase Abakaanani: Ada, omoiseke o Eloni, Omohiti, na Oholibama, omoiseke o Ana, mosinto o Sibeoni, Omohivi,

English: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
Kiswahili: pia akaoa Basemathi binti wa Ishmaeli, dada yake Nebayothi.
Ekegusii: na Basemati, omoiseke o Isumaeli, omoiseke omwabo Nebayoti,

English: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
Kiswahili: Ada akamzalia Esau Elifazi, Basemathi akamzaa Reueli,
Ekegusii: Ada akamoiborera Esau omwana okorokwa Elifasi, na Basemati akaibora Reueli,

English: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Oholibama akamzaa Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Hawa ndio wana wa Esau waliozaliwa kwake huko Kanaani.
Ekegusii: na Oholibama akaibora Yeusi, na Yalamu, na Kora. Aba nabwo abana abamura Esau aiboreretwe ase ense ya Kaanani.

English: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
Kiswahili: Esau akawachukua wake zake, watoto wake wa kiume na wa kike na wote wa nyumbani mwake, mifugo yake pamoja na wanyama wake wengine wote na mali yake yote ambayo alikuwa ameipata akiwa Kanaani, akahamia katika nchi iliyo mbali na Yakobo ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Esau akaimokia abakungu baye, na abana baye abamura na abaiseke, na abanto bonsi ababwate abwo bwoye, ne chiombe chiaye, ne ching’iti chiaye chionsi echi atugete, na enibo yaye yonsi eyaniberete ase ense ya Kaanani; akagenda agaika ase ense yareenge aare korwa ase Yakobo omwabo.

English: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
Kiswahili: Mali zao zilikuwa nyingi sana kiasi kwamba haikuwa rahisi wao kuishi pamoja, nchi waliyokuwa wakiishi isingewatosha wote kwa ajili ya mifugo yao.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera babwate enibo enyinge tibare konyara komenya amo; na ense eria tiyare kobaisana bamenye babere bonsi ne chitugo chiabo.

English: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Esau (ambaye ni Edomu) aliishi katika nchi ya kilima huko Seiri.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Esau, oyokorokwa naende Edomu, akaba okomenya ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu.

English: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wazao wa Esau, baba wa Waedomu, katika nchi ya kilima cha Seiri.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Esau ise Edomu, ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu.

English: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Esau: Elifazi, mwana wa Esau ambaye mkewe Ada alimzalia; na Reueli, mwana wa Esau ambaye mkewe Basemathi alimzalia.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta a basinto b’Esau: Elifasi, omomura o Ada moga Esau, na Reueli, omomura o Basemati moga Esau.

English: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Elifazi ni: Temani, Omari, Sefo, Gatamu na Kenazi.
Ekegusii: Na basinto b’Elifasi nabwo aba: Temani na Omari, na Sefo, na Gatamu, na Kenasi.

English: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.
Kiswahili: Elifazi mwana wa Esau alikuwa pia na suria aliyeitwa Timna, ambaye alimzalia Amaleki. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wajukuu wa Ada mke wa Esau.
Ekegusii: Timuna nigo areenge omokungu o sere‐sere o Elifasi, mosinto bw’Esau. Ere akaiborera Elifasi Amaleki. Aba nabwo baareenge abachokoro abamura b’Ada moga Esau.

English: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Reueli ni: Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wajukuu wa Basemathi mkewe Esau.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto ba Reueli: Nahati, na Zera, na Sama, na Miza. Aba nabwo baarenge abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.

English: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Oholibama binti Ana, mkewe Esau, aliyekuwa mjukuu wa Sibeoni, aliomzalia Esau ni: Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora.
Ekegusii: Na abana aba nabwo abamura ba Oholibama, moga Esau mosubati o Ana, mosinto o Sibeoni: Ere akaiborera Esau Yeusi, na Yalamu, na Kora.

English: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu miongoni mwa wazao wa Esau: Wakuu wa wana wa Elifazi, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Esau ni: Temani, Omari, Sefo, Kenazi,
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rw’Esau. Basinto b’Elifasi, omomura omotangi bw’Esau, nabwo aba: Omogambi Temani, na omogambi Omari, na omogambi Sefo, na omogambi Kenasi,

English: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
Kiswahili: Kora, Gatamu na Amaleki. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu waliotoka kwa Elifazi huko Edomu, waliokuwa wajukuu wa kiume wa Ada.
Ekegusii: na omogambi Kora, na omogambi Gatamu, na omogambi Amaleki. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rw’Elifasi, ase ense y’Edomu. Barabwo nabachokoro abamura b’Ada.

English: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa wana wa Reueli, mwana wa Esau ni: Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Hawa ndio wakuu waliotoka kwa Reueli huko Edomu, waliokuwa wajukuu wa kiume wa Basemathi mkewe Esau.
Ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Reueli, mosinto bw’Esau: Omogambi Nahati, na omogambi Zera, na omogambi Sama, na omogambi Miza. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rwa Reueli ase ense y’Edomu. Aba nabwo abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.

English: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa wana wa Esau ambao mkewe Oholibama alimzalia ni: Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Hawa ndio wakuu waliotoka kwa mke wa Esau, Oholibama binti Ana.
Ekegusii: Naba nabwo abamura b’Oholibama, moga Esau: Omogambi Yeusi, na omogambi Yalamu, na omogambi Kora. Aba nabwo abagaambi baiboretwe na Oholibama, mosubati o Ana moga Esau.

English: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Esau (ndiye Edomu), na hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wao.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto b’Esau, nere Edomu; naba nabwo abagaambi babo.

English: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio walikuwa wana wa Seiri, Mhori, waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ile: Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ana,
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto ba Edomu Omohori, ababiare b’ense eria: Lotani, na Sobali, na Sibeoni, na Ana,

English: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
Kiswahili: Dishoni, Eseri na Dishani. Hawa ndio wana wa Seiri huko Edomu waliokuwa wakuu kwa Wahori.
Ekegusii: na Dishoni, na Eseri, na Disani. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi b’Abahori, basinto ba Edomu, ase ense y’Edomu.

English: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Lotani walikuwa: Hori na Homamu. Timna alikuwa dada yake Lotani.
Ekegusii: Na basinto ba Lotani nabwo Hori na Hemamu, na mosubati omwabo Lotani nigo areenge korokwa Timuna.

English: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shobali walikuwa: Alvani, Manahathi, Ebali, Shefo na Onamu.
Ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Sobali: Alivani, na Manahati, na Sefo, na Onamu.

English: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Sibeoni walikuwa: Aiya na Ana. Huyu Ana ndiye aligundua chemchemi ya maji moto jangwani alipokuwa akichunga punda za Sibeoni baba yake.
Ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Sibeoni: Aya na Ana. Ana oyo nere onyorete chinsoko chi’amaache are morero, ase erooro, ekero areenge korisia chitigere chia Sibeoni ise.

English: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
Kiswahili: Watoto wa Ana walikuwa: Dishoni na Oholibama binti wa Ana.
Ekegusii: Na mosinto o Ana nere Dishoni, na omoiseke o Ana nere Oholibama.

English: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Dishoni walikuwa: Hemdani, Eshbani, Ithrani na Kerani.
Ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Dishoni: Hemudani, na Esibani, na Itirani, na Kerani.

English: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Eseri walikuwa: Bilhani, Zaavani na Akani.
Ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto b’Eseri: Bilihani, na Sawani, na Akani.

English: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Dishani walikuwa: Usi na Arani.
Ekegusii: Na basinto ba Disani nabwo Usi na Arani.

English: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wa Wahori: Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ana,
Ekegusii: Na abagaambi barwete ase Abahori nabwo aba: Omogambi Lotani, na omogambi Sobali, na omogambi Sibeoni, na omogambi Ana,

English: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
Kiswahili: Dishoni, Eseri na Dishani. Hawa ndio walikuwa wakuu wa Wahori, kufuatana na makundi yao, katika nchi ya Seiri.
Ekegusii: na omogambi Dishoni, na omogambi Eseri, na omogambi Disani. Aba nabwo abagaambi b’Abahori, koreng’ana nebisaku biabo, ase ense ya Edomu.

English: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Wafuatao ni wafalme waliotawala Edomu kabla ya mfalme yeyote wa Israeli kutawala:
Ekegusii: Na abarwoti abagamberete ense y’Edomu ritang’ani konya morwoti onde bwensi ataragaambera Abaisraeli nabwo aba:

English: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
Kiswahili: Bela mwana wa Beori alikuwa mfalme wa Edomu. Mji wake uliitwa Dinhaba.
Ekegusii: Bela, mosinto o Beori, akaba okogaamba ase ense y’Edomu, na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Dinihaba.

English: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Bela alipofariki, Yobabu mwana wa Zera kutoka Bosra akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Bela agakwa, na Yobabu mosinto o Zera, oyo orwete Bosira, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Yobabu alipofariki, Hushamu kutoka nchi ya Watemani akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Yobabu nere agakwa, na Husamu bw’ense y’Abatemani akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
Kiswahili: Hushamu alipofariki, Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi, aliyeshinda Midiani katika nchi ya Moabu, akawa mfalme baada yake. Mji wake uliitwa Avithi.
Ekegusii: Husamu nere agakwa, na Hadadi, mosinto o Bedadi, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye; oyo nere obuete Abamidiani, ase ense ya Moabu na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Aviti.

English: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Hadadi alipofariki, Samla kutoka Masreka akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Hadadi nere agakwa, na Samula, oyo orwete Masereka, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Samla alipofariki, Shauli kutoka Rehobothi ngʼambo ya Mto Frati akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Samula nere agakwa, na Saulo, oyo orwete Rehoboti, omochie orenge orooche ensemo, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Shauli alipofariki, Baal-Hanani mwana wa Akbori akawa mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Saulo nere agakwa, na Baali‐Hanani mosinto o Akibori akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
Kiswahili: Baal-Hanani mwana wa Akbori alipofariki, Hadadi akawa mfalme baada yake. Mji wake uliitwa Pau, na mkewe aliitwa Mehetabeli binti Matredi, binti Me-Zahabu.
Ekegusii: Baali‐Hanani, mosinto o Akibori, nere agakwa, na Hadari akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye, na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Pau, na mokaye nigo areenge korokwa Mehetabeli, mosubati o Matiredi, mosubati o Mesahabu.

English: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wakuu waliotokana na Esau, kwa majina, kufuatana na koo zao na nchi zao: Timna, Alva, Yethethi,
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abagaambi barwete ase ororeeria rwa Esau, gotunyana chiamate chiabo, na aase bamenyete nigo are namarieta abo: Omogambi Timuna, na omogambi Aliva, na omogambi Yeteti,

English: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
Kiswahili: Oholibama, Ela, Pinoni,
Ekegusii: na omogambi Oholibama, na omogambi Ela, na omogambi Pinoni,

English: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
Kiswahili: Kenazi, Temani, Mibsari,
Ekegusii: na omogambi Kenasi, na omogambi Temani, na omogambi Mibusari,

English: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
Kiswahili: Magdieli na Iramu. Hawa ndio walikuwa wakuu wa Edomu, kufuatana na makazi yao katika nchi waliyoimiliki. Huyu ndiye alikuwa Esau, baba wa Waedomu.
Ekegusii: na omogambi Magadieli, na omogambi Iramu. Aba nabwo abagaambi barwete ase ororeeria rw’Edomu, koreng’ana buna bamenyete chinsemo chiabo ase ense eria bairete ekaba eyabo. (Esau nere sokoro bw’Abaedomu).

English: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akaishi Kanaani katika nchi ambayo baba yake alikuwa ameishi.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akaba okomenya ase ense y’Abakaanani, eyio ase ise nere areenge omenyete buna omomenyi.

English: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.
Kiswahili: Zifuatazo ni habari za Yakobo. Yosefu, kijana wa miaka kumi na saba, alikuwa akichunga makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi pamoja na ndugu zake wa mama wengine, yaani wana wa Bilha na wana wa Zilpa wake za baba yake, naye akawa akimletea baba yake taarifa mbaya kuhusu hao ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omogano bw’ororeeria rwa Yakobo. Yusufu, ekero aikire emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere, nigo areenge korisia amaicho amo na bamura bamwabo. Omosae oyio akaba ore amo nabamura bamwabo, abana ba Bilia na Silpa, abakungu ba ise. Yusufu akaba okorentera ise amang’ana igoro y’ogokora kwabo okobe.

English: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.
Kiswahili: Basi, Israeli akampenda Yosefu kuliko yeyote miongoni mwa kaka zake, kwani ni mwanawe wa uzeeni, akamshonea joho lililorembwa vizuri sana.
Ekegusii: Bono Israeli nigo anchete Yusufu kobua abana baye bande bonsi, ekiagera nigo areenge omwana oye bw’obogotu. Akamoroiseria eanga engiya entambe.

English: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zake walipoona kwamba baba yao anampenda Yosefu kuliko yeyote mwingine miongoni mwao, walimchukia na hawakusema naye neno lolote jema.
Ekegusii: Abamwabo ekero barooche ng’a ise nigo amwanchete ere kobua abamwabo bonsi, barabwo bakamogecha, tibare gokwana amang’ana y’omorembe amo nere.

English: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akaota ndoto, naye alipowaeleza ndugu zake, wakamchukia zaidi.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akaroota chindoto, na ekero ateebetie abamwabo chindoto echio, barabwo bakamenta mono komogecha.

English: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Sikilizeni ndoto niliyoota:
Ekegusii: Yusufu akabateebia: “Montegerere, moigwe okoroota oko narootete.

English: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”
Kiswahili: Tulikuwa tukifunga miganda ya nafaka shambani, ghafula mganda wangu ukasimama wima, wakati miganda yenu ikiuzunguka na kuuinamia.”
Ekegusii: Nkarora ng’a intwe nigo twareenge mogondo tokoboa emesaima y’endagera, na omosaima one okaimoka ogatenena boronge, na emesaima yaino ekaba ekoyoetanana, egotugama inse ase omosaima one.”

English: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zake wakamwambia, “Wewe unakusudia kututawala? Hivi kweli wewe utatutawala sisi?” Wakaongeza kumchukia zaidi kwa sababu ya ndoto yake pamoja na yale aliyowaambia.
Ekegusii: Abamwabo bakamobooria: “Inee! Aye nigo orengereretie ng’a nigo orabe omogambi oito, otogambere?” Ase igo, barabwo bakamenta komogecha mono ase engencho y’okoroota kwaye, na ase engencho y’amang’ana aye.

English: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akaota ndoto nyingine, akawaambia ndugu zake akisema, “Sikilizeni, nimeota ndoto nyingine, wakati huu jua, mwezi na nyota kumi na moja zilikuwa zinanisujudia.”
Ekegusii: Naende akaroota konde, na okwo agateebia abamwabo, akabora: “Moigwe! Inche nigo narootete okoroota konde. Nkarora erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni ikomi nemo bigotugama inse ase obosio bwane.”

English: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”
Kiswahili: Alipomwambia baba yake pamoja na ndugu zake, baba yake akamkemea akisema, “Ni ndoto gani hii uliyoota? Hivi kweli mama yako na mimi na ndugu zako tutakuja kukusujudia wewe hadi nchi?”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero ateebetie ise na bamura bamwabo amang’ana ayio, ise akamotogonyera, akamobooria: “nkoroota ki okwo okoroota? Inee! Inche na nyoko, na bamura bamino, amaene, nigo torache togotugamere togosasime aye?”

English: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zake wakamwonea wivu, lakini baba yake akaliweka jambo hilo moyoni.
Ekegusii: Abamwabo bakamobwaterwa ribero, korende ise ere akagacha ogokwana okwo ase enkoro yaye ime.

English: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
Kiswahili: Basi, ndugu zake walikuwa wamekwenda kuchunga makundi ya baba yao karibu na Shekemu,
Ekegusii: Erio abamwabo bakagenda korisia amaicho a ise ang’e na Sekemu.

English: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”
Kiswahili: naye Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Kama ujuavyo, ndugu zako wanachunga makundi huko karibu na Shekemu. Njoo, nitakutuma kwao.” Yosefu akajibu, “Vema sana, niko tayari.”
Ekegusii: Na Israeli akarangeria Yusufu, akamoteebia: “Inee! Abamino tibakari korisia amaicho aaria Sekemu? Inchuo bono ngotome gochia ase bakare.” Yusufu agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”

English: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akamwambia, “Nenda uone kama mambo yote ni salama kwa ndugu zako na makundi, kisha uniletee habari.” Ndipo akamtuma Yosefu kutoka Bonde la Hebroni. Yosefu alipofika Shekemu,
Ekegusii: Ise akamoteebia: “Genda bono orore gose abamino mbuya bare amo namaicho, erinde ondetere amang’ana.” Ase igo, akamotoma korwa ase omweya o Heburoni, akageenda agaika Sekemu;

English: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”
Kiswahili: mtu mmoja akamkuta akizungukazunguka mashambani na akamuuliza, “Unatafuta nini?”
Ekegusii: omonto oyomo akamonyora, ekero areenge kona‐goetanana ase erooro, na omonto oyio akamobooria: “Inki okorigia?”

English: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Ninawatafuta ndugu zangu. Unaweza kuniambia wanachunga wapi makundi yao?”
Ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Nabaminto nkorigia; koranche nteebie aase bakorisia amaicho.”

English: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akajibu, “Wamehama hapa. Nilisikia wakisema, ‘Twende Dothani.’ ” Kwa hiyo Yosefu akawafuatilia ndugu zake na kuwakuta karibu na Dothani.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akabateebia: “Barure aa, bachiire, naki nigo nabaigwa bagoteebania: Tiga togende Dotani.” Erio Yusufu akababwatia korwa magega, akabanyora Dotani.

English: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zake walipomwona akiwa mbali, kabla hajawafikia, wakapanga shauri baya la kumuua.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamorora ere okare egeka, ritang’ani konya ataraika ang’e asebare, bakagaamba buna bamoite.

English: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.
Kiswahili: Wakaambiana, “Yule mwota ndoto anakuja!
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania: “Omonyandooto oyio ogocha.

English: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”
Kiswahili: Njooni sasa, tumuue na kumtupa katika shimo mojawapo na tuseme kwamba mnyama mkali amemrarua. Kisha tutaona matokeo ya ndoto zake.”
Ekegusii: Bono ntore ne ribaga; tiga tomoite, tomorute ase engoro eyemo ye chingoro chire aa, erio toteebe ng’a neng’iti y’orosana yamoriete, na torore chindoto echio chiaye buna chirabe.”

English: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
Kiswahili: Reubeni aliposikia jambo hili, akajaribu kumwokoa kutoka mikononi mwao akasema, “Tusiutoe uhai wake.
Ekegusii: Rubeni ekero ayaigwete, akarigia komotooria korwa ase amaboko abo, akabakania: “Yaya! Titomoita akwe.”

English: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
Kiswahili: Tusimwage damu yoyote. Mtupeni katika shimo lililoko hapa jangwani, lakini msimguse.” Reubeni alisema hivyo ili amwokoe kutoka mikononi mwao, kisha amrudishe nyumbani kwa baba yake.
Ekegusii: Naende akabateebia: “Timoitera amanyinga aye; morute ase engoro eyemo y’echi chire aa ase erooro, korende timorambora amaboko aino gochia asare ase okomoita.” Ere nigo abateebetie igo, erinde anyare komotooria korwa ase amaboko abo, amoiranie ase ise.

English: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yosefu alipowafikia ndugu zake, walimvua lile joho lake, lile joho lililorembwa vizuri alilokuwa amevaa.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Yusufu achia goika ase abamwabo, barabwo bakamorusia eanga eria engiya entambe abeegete,

English: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakamchukua wakamtupa katika shimo. Wakati huo shimo lilikuwa tupu, halikuwa na maji ndani yake.
Ekegusii: bakamobwata, bakamoruta engoro ime. Engoro eyio nigo yareenge bosa, mache tareengeo.

English: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
Kiswahili: Walipokaa ili wale chakula chao, wakainua macho wakaona msafara wa Waishmaeli ukija kutoka Gileadi. Ngamia wao walikuwa wamepakizwa mizigo ya vikolezo, uvumba na manemane, nao walikuwa njiani kuvipeleka Misri.
Ekegusii: Erio bagaikaransa inse koragera; bagachia koimokia amaiso abo korigereria, bakarora omoganda bw’Abaisumaeli ogocha korwa Gileadi. Barabwo nigo baare ne chingamia chiabo, chibogoretie ubani, na amaguta akogwenia, na manemane, ase orogendo rwabo baare kogenda Misiri.

English: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
Kiswahili: Yuda akawaambia ndugu zake, “Tutafaidi nini ikiwa tutamuua ndugu yetu na kuificha damu yake?
Ekegusii: Agwo Yuda agateebia abamwabo: “Inki eratogwenere toite oyominto na kobisa ogokwa kwaye?

English: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.
Kiswahili: Njooni, tumuuze kwa hawa Waishmaeli. Tusimguse, kwa kuwa hata hivyo yeye ni ndugu yetu, nyama yetu na damu yetu wenyewe.” Ndugu zake wakakubali.
Ekegusii: Tiga tomoonie ase Abaisumaeli aba, erinde titobaisa komoita namaboko aito, ekiagera noyominto, toiboire komo.” Na abamwabo bagancherana nere.

English: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wale wafanyabiashara Wamidiani walipofika pale, ndugu zake wakamtoa Yosefu kutoka kwenye lile shimo, na kumuuza kwa shekeli ishirini za fedha kwa wale Waishmaeli, ambao walimpeleka Misri.
Ekegusii: Erio Abamidiani bagaeta aroro, baare gokora oboonchoreria; abamwabo bakarusia Yusufu korwa ase engoro eria, na komooneria Abaisumaeli ase chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo ebere; barabwo bakamoira goika Misiri.

English: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
Kiswahili: Reubeni aliporudi kutazama kwenye lile shimo na kuona kwamba Yosefu hayupo, alirarua nguo zake.
Ekegusii: Rubeni agachia koirana korigereria ase engoro eria, akanyora Yusufu taiyo ase engoro, ere agatandora chianga chiaye,

English: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”
Kiswahili: Akawarudia ndugu zake na kusema, “Kijana hayuko mle! Nielekee wapi sasa?”
Ekegusii: akeonchora gochia ase abamwabo, akabateebia: “Omwana timonyoreti ase engoro. Ng’ai rende nkogenda?”

English: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakalichukua lile joho la Yosefu, wakachinja mbuzi na kulichovya katika damu.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia eanga ya Yusufu, na bakanyenya embori, bakaimokia eanga eria, bakayetobeka ase amanyinga;

English: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”
Kiswahili: Wakalichukua lile joho lililorembwa vizuri na kulipeleka kwa baba yao na kusema, “Tumeliokota hili joho. Uchunguze uone kama ni la mwanao.”
Ekegusii: bakagenda n’eanga eria entambe bakayeirera ise, bakamobateebia: “Yemanye eanga eye gose ney’omwana oo gose tari ero.”

English: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”
Kiswahili: Baba yao akalitambua akasema, “Hili ni joho la mwanangu! Mnyama mkali amemrarua. Hakika Yosefu ameraruliwa vipande vipande.”
Ekegusii: Yakobo akayemanya, akabora: “Neanga y’omwana one, amaene neching’iti chi’orosana chiamoitire; Yusufu orirwe!”

English: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yakobo akararua nguo zake, akavaa nguo ya gunia na kumwombolezea mwanawe kwa siku nyingi.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chigunia kenema kiaye, akaba okomoreera omwana oye engaki entambe.

English: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.
Kiswahili: Wanawe wote na binti zake wakaja kumfariji, lakini hakukubali kufarijiwa. Akasema, “Hapana, nitamwombolezea mwanangu mpaka nimfikie kaburini.” Kwa hiyo baba yake akaendelea kumlilia.
Ekegusii: Abana baye, abamura na abaiseke bonsi, bakaimoka gochia komoremia, korende akaanga, taremigwa, agateeba: “Yaya, goika inkwe, ngende inse ase oboina nkona‐komoreera omwana one.” Ise akaba okona‐kweumia.

English: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, Wamidiani wakamuuza Yosefu huko Misri kwa Potifa, mmojawapo wa maafisa wa Farao, aliyekuwa mkuu wa ulinzi.
Ekegusii: Na Abamidiani baria bakamoonia aaria Misiri ase Potifari, omoteneneri bw’enka ya Farao na omotang’ani bw’abarendi baye bande.

English: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule, Yuda akawaacha ndugu zake, akaenda kuishi na Hira Mwadulami.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ase engaki eria Yuda agatigana n’abamwabo, agatirimboka, agaika ase omonto gete Omoadulamu ore korokwa Hira, bakabwatana nere.

English: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.
Kiswahili: Huko Yuda akakutana na binti wa Kikanaani aitwaye Shua, akamwoa na akakutana naye kimwili,
Ekegusii: Aroro Yuda akarora moiseke o Sua, omoiseke bw’Omokaanani gete, akamonyuoma. Bakaba bakorara amo,

English: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
Kiswahili: akapata mimba, akamzaa mwana, ambaye alimwita Eri.
Ekegusii: na moiseke o Sua akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Eri.

English: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.
Kiswahili: Akapata mimba tena, akamzaa mwana na kumwita Onani.
Ekegusii: Naende akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Onani.

English: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.
Kiswahili: Akamzaa mwana mwingine tena, akamwita Shela. Huyu alimzalia mahali paitwapo Kezibu.
Ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Sela. Yuda nere nao areenge aria Kisibo ekero amoiborerete abana.

English: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
Kiswahili: Yuda akampatia Eri, mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, mke aitwaye Tamari.
Ekegusii: Na Yuda akanyuomeria Eri, omwana oye omotangi, omokungu ore korokwa Tamari.

English: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. So Yahweh killed him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Eri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yuda, alikuwa mwovu machoni pa Bwana, kwa hiyo Bwana akamuua.
Ekegusii: Nere Eri, omomura omotangi o Yuda, nigo areenge omobe ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio Omonene akamoita.

English: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yuda akamwambia Onani, “Kutana kimwili na mke wa ndugu yako, na utimize wajibu wako kwake kama mke wa ndugu yako, ili umpatie ndugu yako uzao.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda agateebia Onani: “Motware moka momura omino, erinde omotenenerie egesaku.”

English: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.
Kiswahili: Lakini Onani alijua kwamba uzao haungekuwa wake, kwa hiyo kila alipokutana kimwili na mke wa ndugu yake, alimwaga chini mbegu za kiume ili asimpatie ndugu yake uzao.
Ekegusii: Korende Onani akamanya ng’a abana abwo agochia koibora tibari gochia korokwa abaye. Kera engaki, arekoba na moka momura omwabo, ekero embego y’oroiboro ere nchera gocha, asomora aitera inse, ng’a erio tabaisa goteneneria oyomwabo egesaku.

English: The thing which he did was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and he killed him also.
Kiswahili: Alichofanya kilikuwa kiovu machoni pa Bwana, hivyo, pia Bwana akamuua Onani.
Ekegusii: Ayio akorete akaba amabe ase obosio bwa Nyasae Omobui, nere Omonene akamoita.

English: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yuda akamwambia Tamari mkwewe, “Ishi kama mjane nyumbani mwa baba yako mpaka mwanangu Shela atakapokua.” Kwa maana alifikiri, “Angeweza kufa pia kama ndugu zake.” Kwa hiyo Tamari alikwenda kuishi nyumbani kwa baba yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda agateebia Tamari, moka momura oye: “Genda omenye buna omoboraka ase omochie o iso goika Sela omwana one akine”; naki nigo oboete ng’a nere nabaise gocha gokwa, buna abamwabo bakwete. Ase igo, Tamari akagenda akamenya o ise.

English: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda mrefu mke wa Yuda binti wa Shua akafariki. Baada ya msiba, Yuda alikwenda Timna, kwa watu waliokuwa wakikata kondoo wake manyoya, naye alifuatana na rafiki yake Hira Mwadulami.
Ekegusii: Magega ya amatuko make, moiseke o Sua, moka Yuda, agakwa; Yuda gakoorire okomoreera, agatiira gochia Timuna ase abanachi amarionya be ching’ondi chiaye, amo nomosani oye Hira Omoadulamu.

English: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
Kiswahili: Tamari alipoambiwa, “Baba mkwe wako yuko njiani kwenda Timna kukata kondoo wake manyoya,”
Ekegusii: Ekero Tamari ateebetigwe ng’a ise biara ’nkogenda akare Timuna konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya,

English: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
Kiswahili: alivua mavazi yake ya ujane, akajifunika kwa shela ili asifahamike, akaketi kwenye mlango wa Enaimu, ambao upo njiani kuelekea Timna. Akafanya hivyo kwa sababu aliona kwamba, ingawa Shela amekua, lakini alikuwa hajakabidhiwa kwake kuwa mkewe.
Ekegusii: akarusia chianga chiaye chi’ogokobania, akeboyia chianga na gwetuba obosio bwaye, agaikaransa geita ki’Enaimu, ang’e nenchera ekogenda Timuna; naki nigo arooche ng’a Sela obeire omonto omonene, na tamoeiri amotware.

English: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
Kiswahili: Yuda alipomwona alifikiri ni kahaba, kwa sababu alikuwa amefunika uso wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yuda amorooche, agakaga ng’a nomokuungu omotayayi, ekiagera nigo atubete obosio bwaye.

English: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”
Kiswahili: Pasipo kutambua kwamba alikuwa mkwe wake, akamwendea kando ya njia na kumwambia, “Njoo sasa, nikutane na wewe kimwili.” Yule mkwewe akamuuliza, “Utanipa nini nikikutana nawe kimwili?”
Ekegusii: Yuda akagobera gochia asare enchera ensemo, akamoteebia: “Inyanchere ’mbe naye,” naki tamanyete gose moka momura oye orenge. Tamari akamobooria: “Inki orang’e, erinde osoe ase ’nde?”

English: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Nitakutumia mwana-mbuzi kutoka kundi langu.” Akamuuliza, “Utanipa kitu chochote kama amana mpaka utakapompeleka?”
Ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Ninche ngotomera emaanwa egoree korwa ase riicho riane.” Omokungu oria akamobooria: “Inee! Inki orang’e kebe intenenera goika kwayentomeire?”

English: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.
Kiswahili: Akamuuliza, “Nikupe amana gani?” Akamjibu, “Pete yako na kamba yake pamoja na fimbo iliyo mkononi mwako.” Kwa hiyo akampa vitu hivyo kisha akakutana naye kimwili, naye akapata mimba yake.
Ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Ngento ki origetie nkoe kebe intenenera?” Akamoiraneria: “Ebonyi yao ere nekemanyererio, na orokini rwao, na enyimbo yao obwate koboko.” Erio akamobia, akaraara nere, na ere akaba morito.

English: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
Kiswahili: Tamari akaondoka, akavua shela yake akavaa tena nguo zake za ujane.
Ekegusii: Erio akaimoka akagenda, akarusia egietubo, akabeeka chianga chiaye chi’ogokobania.

English: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, Yuda akamtuma rafiki yake Mwadulami apeleke yule mwana-mbuzi ili arudishiwe amana yake kutoka kwa yule mwanamke, lakini yule rafiki yake hakumkuta yule mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Yuda akaa omosani oye Omoadulamu emaanwa egoree airere omokungu oria, erinde ere airanie ebinto biria amoete bibe intenenera, korende tamonyora.

English: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza watu wanaoishi mahali pale, “Yuko wapi yule kahaba wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu aliyekuwa kando ya barabara hapa Enaimu?” Wakamjibu, “Hajawahi kuwepo mwanamke yeyote kahaba wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu hapa.”
Ekegusii: Omoadulamu oria akabooria abanto b’aase aria: “Ng’ai are omokungu oria omotayayi, oyorenge aa Enaimu enchera ensemo?” Bakamokania: “Omokungu omotayayi tana koba aa.”

English: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akamrudia Yuda na kumwambia, “Sikumpata. Zaidi ya hayo, watu wanaoishi mahali pale walisema ‘Hapakuwahi kuwepo mwanamke yeyote kahaba wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu hapa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, akairana gochia ase Yuda, akabateebia: “Timonyoreti; naboigo nonya nabaanto b’aase aria nigo bankania ng’a mokuungu motayayi tana kobao.”

English: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yuda akasema, “Mwache avichukue vitu hivyo, ama sivyo tutakuwa kichekesho. Hata hivyo, nilimpelekea mwana-mbuzi, lakini hukumkuta.”
Ekegusii: Yuda akabora: “Tiga atware ebinto ebio namoete bibe intenenera, titobaisa gocha kororekana nobosooku. Rora, namotomerete emaanwa egoree, na aye tikwamonyorete.”

English: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya miezi mitatu Yuda akaambiwa, “Tamari mkweo ana hatia ya kuwa kahaba, na matokeo yake ana mimba.” Yuda akasema, “Mtoeni nje na achomwe moto hadi afe!”
Ekegusii: Ekaba magega y’emetienyi etato Yuda ateebetigwe ng’a Tamari, moka momura oye, okorire obotomani bw’obotayayi; amo nayio morito are ase obotayayi. Erio Yuda akabora: “Mosokie isiko, asambwe nomorero.”

English: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akitolewa nje, akatuma ujumbe kwa baba mkwe wake kusema, “Nina mimba ya mtu mwenye vitu hivi.” Akaongeza kusema, “Angalia kama utatambua kwamba pete hii na kamba yake pamoja na fimbo hii ni vya nani.”
Ekegusii: Gasokiigwe isiko agatoma abanto ase ise biara, bamoteebie: “Omonto omonyene ebinto ebi, nere ong’ete oborito obo.” Naende akabora: “Manya ebonyi eyio ere nekemanyererio, na orokini oro, na enyimbo eye, gose nebiang’o.”

English: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.
Kiswahili: Yuda akavitambua na kusema, “Yeye ana haki kuliko mimi, kwa kuwa sikumkabidhi kwa mwanangu Shela ili awe mkewe.” Tangu hapo hakukutana naye kimwili tena.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda akabimanya, akabora: “Ere nomooronge kombua, nigo akora ayio, ekiagera ntamoete Sela, omwana one, amotware.” Erio Yuda tarara nere naende.

English: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
Kiswahili: Wakati ulipofika wa kujifungua, kukawa na wana mapacha tumboni mwake.
Ekegusii: Ekero engaki yaye y’okoibora yachia goika, akarorekana ore ne chibarongo enda yaye ime.

English: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akijifungua, mmoja akatoa mkono wake nje, kwa hiyo mkunga akachukua uzi mwekundu na kuufunga mkononi mwa yule mtoto, akasema, “Huyu ametoka kwanza.”
Ekegusii: Ekero areenge koibora, omwana oyomo agatang’ania okoboko isiko, na omoiboria akamosibera okoboko okwo eusi embariri, agateeba: “Oyo nere otanga gosoka isiko.”

English: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.
Kiswahili: Lakini alipourudisha mkono wake ndugu yake akaanza kutoka, naye akasema, “Hivi ndivyo ulivyotoka kwa nguvu!” Akaitwa Peresi.
Ekegusii: Kairanirie okoboko kwaye, rora, oyomwabo akaromeng’ana, agasoka isiko. Erio omoiboria agateeba: “Naki okoromeng’ana ne chinguru iga?” Ase ayio bakamoroka Peresi.

English: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
Kiswahili: Kisha ndugu yake, aliyekuwa na uzi mwekundu mkononi, akatoka, naye akaitwa Zera.
Ekegusii: Magega yaye oyomwabo agasoka ore neusi embariri koboko kwaye. Nere akarokwa Zera.

English: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Yosefu alikuwa amechukuliwa mpaka Misri. Mmisri aliyeitwa Potifa aliyekuwa mmojawapo wa maafisa wa Farao, mkuu wa ulinzi, akamnunua Yosefu kutoka kwa Waishmaeli waliomleta Misri.
Ekegusii: Bono Yusufu agatirimbokigwa gochia Misiri; na Potifari, omoteneneri bw’enka ya Farao na omotang’ani bw’abarendi baye bande, omonto o Misiri, akamogora korwa ase Abaisumaeli, abwo bamotirimbogetie gochia aroro.

English: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Yosefu, naye akastawi, Yosefu akaishi nyumbani kwa bwana wake Mmisri.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo areenge amo na Yusufu, na ere akanyora ogosesenigwa. Yusufu akamenya ase enka y’omonene oye, oria Omomisiri.

English: His master saw that Yahweh was with him, and that Yahweh made all that he did prosper in his hand.
Kiswahili: Potifa alipoona kuwa Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Yosefu na kwamba Bwana alimfanikisha kwa kila kitu alichokifanya,
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arooche ng’a Omonene nigo areenge amo na Yusufu, ogerire ebinto bionsi biasesenigwe ase amaboko aye.

English: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
Kiswahili: Yosefu alipata kibali machoni pa Potifa, akamfanya mhudumu wake. Potifa akamweka kuwa msimamizi wa nyumba yake, naye akamkabidhi kuwa mwangalizi wa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.
Ekegusii: Ase igo,, Yusufu aganchwa mono ase obosio bw’omonene oye Potifari na akamobeka koba omokoreri oye; na ere akamobeka abe omoteneneri bw’enka yaye yonsi, na omorigereria bw’ebinto bionsi ebi abwate.

English: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, Yahweh blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. Yahweh’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia wakati huo Potifa alipomweka Yosefu kuwa msimamizi wa nyumba na mali zake zote alizokuwa nazo, Bwana aliibariki nyumba ya Mmisri huyo kwa sababu ya Yosefu. Baraka ya Bwana ilikuwa juu ya kila kitu alichokuwa nacho Potifa, nyumbani na shambani.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio amobegete abe omoteneneri igoro y’enka yaye, na bionsi ebi abwate. Omonene agasesenia Omomisiri oria ase engencho ya Yusufu, na ogosesenia kw’Omonene gokaba ase ebinto bionsi abwate ase enyomba na emegondo.

English: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Potifa akamwachia Yosefu uangalizi wa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, Yosefu alipokuwa katika uongozi, Potifa hakuwa na sababu ya kujishughulisha na kitu chochote isipokuwa chakula alichokula. Yosefu alikuwa mwenye umbo zuri na sura ya kuvutia;
Ekegusii: Ase igo, agatiga bionsi ebiareenge nabio ase amaboko a Yusufu; gose taba ogwechandera gento kende gionsi otatiga endagera yoka eria areenge koria. Yusufu nigo areenge omonto omerete buya, naende omonyakieni.

English: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
Kiswahili: baada ya kitambo mke wa Potifa akamtamani Yosefu, akamwambia, “Njoo, ukutane nami kimwili!”
Ekegusii: Magega y’engaki gete moka omonene oye akarigereria Yusufu ase okomogania, akamoteebia: “Inchuo oraare nainche!”

English: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yosefu akakataa. Akamwambia yule mwanamke, “Mimi nikiwa katika uongozi, bwana wangu hahusiki na kitu chochote katika nyumba hii, kila kitu alicho nacho amenikabidhi.
Ekegusii: Korende ere akaanga, agateebia moka omonene oye: “Rora, omonene one techandereti gento kende gionsi ase enka yaye, na bionsi ebi abwate obibekire ase amaboko aane.

English: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”
Kiswahili: Hapa nyumbani hakuna aliye mkuu kuliko mimi. Bwana wangu hakunizuilia kitu chochote isipokuwa wewe, kwa kuwa wewe ni mke wake. Nitawezaje basi kufanya uovu huu na kutenda dhambi dhidi ya Mungu?”
Ekegusii: Onde tari ase enyomba yaye oeire okobua otatiga inche, gose tantangeti gento kende gionsi otatiga aye bweka, ekiagera aye mokaye ore. Naki rende ndanyare gokora ebibe ebinene buna ebi, imomochere Nyasae?”

English: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
Kiswahili: Ingawa yule mwanamke aliendelea kumshawishi Yosefu siku baada ya siku, Yosefu alikataa kukutana naye kimwili wala kukaa karibu naye.
Ekegusii: Akaba okonagokwana na Yusufu rituko ase rituko, korende Yusufu tamwanchera baraare komo, gose koba amo.

English: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.
Kiswahili: Siku moja Yosefu akaingia ndani ya nyumba kufanya kazi zake, wala hapakuwepo na mfanyakazi yeyote ndani ya nyumba.
Ekegusii: Ekaba rituko erimo, ekero Yusufu asoete nyomba gokora emeremo yaye, gose monto onde bw’abaanto b’enyomba eria tareengeo,

English: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.
Kiswahili: Mke wa Potifa akashika vazi Yosefu alilokuwa amevaa, akamwambia, “Njoo tukutane kimwili!” Lakini Yosefu akaacha vazi lake mkononi mwa huyo mwanamke, akatoka nje ya nyumba akikimbia.
Ekegusii: omokungu oria akamobwata eanga yaye eyare kwambara, akabateebia: “Rara nainche.” Korende Yusufu agatigera omokungu oria eanga yaye eyare kwambara, agatama gochia isiko.

English: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke alipoona kwamba Yosefu amemwachia vazi lake mkononi na kukimbilia nje ya nyumba,
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria, ekero arooche ng’a Yusufu omotigeire eanga yaye koboko kwaye, na gotama gochia isiko,

English: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.
Kiswahili: akawaita watumishi wake wa nyumbani, akawaambia, “Tazameni! Huyu Mwebrania ameletwa hapa kutudhihaki! Aliingia hapa ndani ili akutane nami kimwili, lakini nikapiga kelele.
Ekegusii: akarangeria abanto ba nyomba mwaye, akabateebia: “Rigereria, omosacha one otorenteire omonto oyo Omoiberania ase egati yaito atokorere echeche; nigo acha ase ’nde ng’a araare nainche, na inche nakuura neriogi rinene.

English: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
Kiswahili: Aliposikia kelele za kuomba msaada, akaacha vazi lake kando yangu akakimbilia nje.”
Ekegusii: Na ekero aigwa ng’a nakuurire neriogi rinene, ontigera eanga yaye koboko kwane, otama gochia isiko.”

English: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akaliweka lile vazi karibu naye mpaka Potifa aliporudi nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Akagacha eanga eria goika omosacha oye agacha inka,

English: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,
Kiswahili: Ndipo akamweleza kisa hiki, akisema: “Yule mtumwa wa Kiebrania uliyetuletea alinijia ili kunidhihaki.
Ekegusii: akamoteebia amang’ana ayio ayio, agateeba: “Omoiberania oyo omosomba kwarenta aa nabo asoa ase ’nde gonkorera echeche.

English: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mara nilipopiga kelele kuomba msaada, akaliacha vazi lake kando yangu akakimbia nje ya nyumba.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero nachaka gokuura na goaka eriogi ontigera eanga yaye koboko kwane, otama gochia isiko.”

English: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.
Kiswahili: Potifa aliposikia kisa hiki mkewe alichomweleza, akisema, “Hivi ndivyo mtumwa wako alivyonitenda.” Hasira ya Potifa ikawaka.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonene o Yusufu achia koigwa aya mokaye amoteebirie ng’a: “Aya naro omosomba oo ankorera”, akaba nekeririanda ekenene.

English: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.
Kiswahili: Potifa akamchukua Yosefu na kumweka gerezani, mahali ambapo wahalifu wa mfalme walikuwa wamefungwa. Lakini wakati Yosefu alipokuwa huko gerezani,
Ekegusii: Omonene oyio akabwata Yusufu, akamobeka echela ime, aase abasomba b’omorwoti basibire, na ere akaba agwo echela ime.

English: But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa pamoja naye, akamhurumia na kumpa kibali mbele ya msimamizi wa gereza.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akaba ore amo na Yusufu, akamokorera obuya, akamoa ogwancherwa ase omonene bw’echela.

English: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo msimamizi wa gereza akamweka Yosefu awe mkuu wa wafungwa pamoja na kusimamia yote ambayo yalitendeka mle gerezani.
Ekegusii: Omonene oria akabeeka abasibwa bonsi abwo baarenge echela ime ase amaboko a Yusufu; na onsi ayare gokoreka ase echela, ere akaba okoyakora.

English: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because Yahweh was with him; and that which he did, Yahweh made it prosper.
Kiswahili: Msimamizi wa gereza hakujishughulisha tena na kitu chochote kilichokuwa chini ya uangalizi wa Yosefu, kwa sababu Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Yosefu akimfanikisha kwa kila alichofanya.
Ekegusii: Na omonene oria bw’echela tachia goitaa kende gionsi kiare ase amaboko a Yusufu, ekiagera Omonene nigo areenge amo nere, na ande onsi are gokora, Omonene nigo are koyasesenia.

English: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, mnyweshaji na mwokaji wa mfalme wa Misri, wakamkosea bwana wao, mfalme wa Misri.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki gete, magega y’amang’ana ayio, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa bia Farao na omoteneneri oye bw’abaroisia emegati bakamoochera omonene obo, omorwoti o Misiri.

English: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.
Kiswahili: Farao akawakasirikia hawa maafisa wake wawili, mnyweshaji mkuu na mwokaji mkuu,
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Farao akabeigwa n’abateneneri abwo babere, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati.

English: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
Kiswahili: akawaweka chini ya ulinzi katika nyumba ya mkuu wa kikosi cha ulinzi katika gereza lile lile alimofungwa Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Akababeeka barendwe ase enyomba yomotang’ani bw’abarendi, ase echela eyio Yusufu nere asibetwe.

English: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.
Kiswahili: Mkuu wa kikosi cha ulinzi akawakabidhi kwa Yosefu, naye akawahudumia. Walipokuwa wamekaa chini ya ulinzi kwa muda,
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’abarendi akamobeka Yusufu abe okobarigereria na kobakorera, na barabwo bakabeera ase egesibo ase engaki enke.

English: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.
Kiswahili: kila mmoja wa hao wawili waliokuwa wamewekwa gerezani, yaani mnyweshaji na mwokaji wa mfalme wa Misri, waliota ndoto usiku mmoja, na kila ndoto ilikuwa na maana yake tofauti.
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko obomo bonsi babere, omoteneneri oria bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati b’omorwoti o Misiri, abwo basibetwe echela, bakaba bakoroota chindoto. Kera oyomo akaroota okoroota kwaye okware nengencho eng’ao korwa ase okw’oyonde.

English: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.
Kiswahili: Yosefu alipowajia asubuhi yake, akawaona kwamba walikuwa na huzuni.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yusufu agendete mambia kobarigereria akabanyora nigo baichanete.

English: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawauliza maafisa hao wa Farao waliokuwa chini ya ulinzi pamoja naye nyumbani mwa bwana wake, akasema, “Mbona nyuso zenu zimejaa huzuni leo?”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, akabooria abateneneri abwo ba Farao, abaarenge amo nere ase egesibo ase enyomba y’omonene oye, akabora: “Naki moichaanete iga reero?”

English: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Sisi sote tuliota ndoto, lakini hapakuwa na mtu yeyote wa kuzifasiri.” Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia, “Je, kufasiri ndoto si kazi ya Mungu? Niambieni ndoto zenu.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Nigo twarootete chindoto, na onde tari oranyare kogoteebia engencho ye chindoto chiaito.” Yusufu akabateebia: “Nigoro ya Nyasae kobateebia engencho yaye. Komoranche, mochinteebie.”

English: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,
Kiswahili: Basi mkuu wa wanyweshaji akamweleza Yosefu ndoto yake. Akamwambia, “Katika ndoto yangu niliona mzabibu mbele yangu,
Ekegusii: Omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa agateebia Yusufu okoroota kwaye, akabora: “Ase okoroota kwane nigo narooche omosabibu ore ase obosio bwane,

English: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.
Kiswahili: nao mzabibu ulikuwa na matawi matatu. Mara tu ulipoanza kuchipua, maua yalichanua na vishada vyake vikawa zabibu zilizoiva.
Ekegusii: na omosabibu oyio nigo orenge ne chinsagia isato; bwango ogasomoria, ogasokia ebisicha, na okaama ebisago bi’amasabibu amatobu.

English: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”
Kiswahili: Kikombe cha Farao kilikuwa mkononi mwangu, nikazitwaa zabibu, nikazikamua katika kikombe cha Farao, na nikaweka kikombe mkononi mwake.”
Ekegusii: Na egekombe kia Farao nigo nakebwate ase okoboko kwane; nkabogoria amasabibu aria, nkayamitera ase egekombe kia Farao, nkaa Farao egekombe eke koboko kwaye.”

English: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akamwambia, “Hii ndiyo maana yake: Matawi matatu ni siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akamoteebia: “Engencho y’okoroota okwo nero eye: Chinsagia echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.

English: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizi tatu, Farao atakutoa gerezani na kukuweka tena kwenye nafasi yako, nawe utaweka kikombe cha Farao mikononi mwake, kama vile ulivyokuwa unafanya ulipokuwa mnyweshaji wake.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato Farao nakorusie aiga, akoe ogosika, akoiranie ase emeremo yao, na aye nobe gokomoa egekombe koboko kwaye, buna kware komoa agwo ritang’ani, ekero kwareenge omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa biaye.

English: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati mambo yatakapokuwia mazuri, unikumbuke, unifanyie wema, useme mema juu yangu kwa Farao ili niondoke huku gerezani.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero oranyore amaya, ong’inyore nainche, ondorere amaabera. Koranche nagosabire onyatore ase Farao, ondusie ase enyomba eye,

English: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nilichukuliwa kwa nguvu kutoka nchi ya Waebrania, na hata hapa nilipo sikufanya lolote linalostahili niwekwe gerezani.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo naibetwe korwa ase ense y’Abaiberania, nonya naa tinkoreti ing’ana rinde riibe riagwenerete kombeeka ase echela.”

English: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.
Kiswahili: Yule mwokaji mkuu alipoona kuwa Yosefu amefasiri ikiwa na maana nzuri, akamwambia Yosefu, “Mimi pia niliota ndoto: Kichwani mwangu kulikuwepo vikapu vitatu vya mikate.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati arooche ng’a okoonchora okwo nigo kwabeete okuya, agateebia Yusufu: “Nainche boigo nigo narootete. Nkarora ng’a inyetwegete chinteru isato chire nemegati emerabu ase omotwe one.

English: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”
Kiswahili: Katika kikapu cha juu kulikuwa na aina zote za vyakula vilivyookwa kwa ajili ya Farao, lakini ndege walikuwa wakivila kutoka kwenye kikapu nilichokuwa nimebeba kichwani.”
Ekegusii: Ase oroteru rwa igoro kegima yarengeo emegati y’ebisaku ao ao yaroiseretigwe Farao, korende chinyoni chigaacha chikayeria korwa ase oroteru igoro, oro netwegete ase omotwe one.”

English: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.
