Kiswahili: Yosefu akamwambia, “Hii ndiyo maana yake: Vikapu vitatu ni siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Na Yusufu akamoiraneria: “Engencho y’okoroota okwo nero eye: Chinteru echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.

English: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizi tatu, Farao atakata kichwa chako na kukutundika juu ya mti. Nao ndege watakula nyama ya mwili wako.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato Farao nakoimokie, agosunge ase omote igoro ne chinyoni nachirie chinyama chi’omobere oo.”

English: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
Kiswahili: Mnamo siku ya tatu, ilikuwa kumbukumbu ya kuzaliwa kwa Farao, naye akawaandalia maafisa wake wote karamu. Akawatoa gerezani mnyweshaji mkuu na mwokaji mkuu, akawaweka mbele ya maafisa wake:
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato, erio riaare ri’okoinyora okoiborwa gwa Farao, ere agakorera abasomba baye bonsi omoyega, akabarusia echela baria babere, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati, ase egati y’abasomba baye.

English: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;
Kiswahili: Ndipo akamrudisha mnyweshaji mkuu kwenye nafasi yake, ili aweke kikombe mikononi mwa Farao tena,
Ekegusii: Akairania omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa ase emeremo yaye y’obonyoisia, na ere akaba okomoa Farao egekombe ase okoboko kwaye;

English: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.
Kiswahili: lakini akamwangika yule mwokaji mkuu, sawasawa na jinsi Yosefu alivyowaambia katika tafsiri yake.
Ekegusii: korende omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati ere akamosunga ase omote igoro, buna Yusufu abanorete chingencho chie chindoto chiabo.

English: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hayo, mnyweshaji mkuu hakumkumbuka Yosefu, bali alimsahau.
Ekegusii: Nonya nabo oyio omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa taba okoinyora Yusufu, korende akamweba.

English: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.
Kiswahili: Baada ya miaka miwili kamili kupita, Farao aliota ndoto: Tazama alikuwa amesimama kando ya Mto Naili,
Ekegusii: Magega y’emiaka ebere koyaetire Farao akaroota chindoto ng’a oteneine engegu y’orooche rwa Naeli.

English: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.
Kiswahili: wakati ngʼombe saba, wazuri na wanono, walitokea mtoni wakajilisha kwenye matete.
Ekegusii: Akarora chiombe isano na ibere, chingiya mono chinoru, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka.

English: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.
Kiswahili: Baada yao ngʼombe wengine saba, wabaya na waliokonda, wakatokea mtoni Naili wakasimama kando ya wale wanono ukingoni mwa mto.
Ekegusii: Naende akarora chiombe chinde isano na ibere, chimbe mono chindeu, chikorwa rooche, chigochitunyana korwa magega, chigatenena ase engegu y’orooche ang’e nase chiombe chiria chinde.

English: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.
Kiswahili: Wale ngʼombe wabaya na waliokonda wakawala wale saba wazuri na wanono. Kisha Farao akaamka.
Ekegusii: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiria chingiya chinoru. Erio Farao akaboka.

English: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.
Kiswahili: Farao akaingia usingizini tena akaota ndoto ya pili: Akaona masuke saba ya nafaka, yenye afya na mazuri, yanakua katika bua moja.
Ekegusii: Akaraara naende, akaroota eria kabere, akarora ebigara bitano na bibere ebinene ebinoru, bikinete ase oroboba oromo.

English: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
Kiswahili: Baadaye, masuke mengine saba yakachipua, yakiwa membamba yaliyonyaushwa na upepo wa mashariki.
Ekegusii: Magega yabo ebigara binde ebireu, ebiasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, bikaoroka.

English: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
Kiswahili: Masuke yale membamba yakameza yale masuke saba yenye afya na yaliyojaa. Basi Farao akaamka kutoka usingizini, kumbe ilikuwa ndoto.
Ekegusii: Agwo ebigara ebio ebireu bitano na bibere bikaria biria binde ebinene ebinoru. Farao akaboka, akanyora ng’a nigo are koroota.

English: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi yake, alifadhaika akilini, hivyo akawaita waaguzi wote pamoja na watu wenye busara wa Misri. Walipokuja, Farao akawaeleza ndoto zake, lakini hakuna hata mmoja aliyeweza kumfasiria.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia mambia, akaba oichaanete, agatoma abanto barangerie abaringoria bonsi ba Misiri na abanto abang’aini bonsi abaarengeo. Farao akabateebia chindoto chiaye, korende onde tatogete ore konyara komoteebia engencho ye chindoto echio.

English: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mnyweshaji mkuu alipomwambia Farao, “Leo nimekumbushwa kuhusu kosa langu.
Ekegusii: Erio omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa agateebia Farao: “Bono nainyoire okomocha kwane.

English: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.
Kiswahili: Wakati fulani Farao aliwakasirikia watumishi wake, akanifunga mimi na mwokaji mkuu katika nyumba ya mkuu wa ulinzi.
Ekegusii: Ekero aye Farao gwatobeete intwe abasomba bao, na gotosiekera, inche na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati, ase echela eyere ase enyomba y’omotang’ani bw’abarendi,

English: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja wetu aliota ndoto katika usiku mmoja na kila ndoto ilikuwa na maana yake tofauti.
Ekegusii: intwe ase obotuko obomo tokaroota chindoto twensi, kera oyomo okoroota kwaye kore nengencho yaye eng’ao.

English: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.
Kiswahili: Basi kijana wa Kiebrania aliyekuwa pamoja nasi huko, alikuwa mtumishi wa mkuu wa kikosi cha ulinzi. Tulimweleza ndoto zetu, naye akatufasiria, akitupa kila mtu tafsiri ya ndoto yake.
Ekegusii: Agwo amo naintwe narengeo omomura oyomo Omoiberania, omosomba bw’omotang’ani bw’abarendi. Tokamoteebia chindoto chiaito, na ere agatoteebia engencho ye chindoto chiria, agatobanorera kera oyomo engencho y’okoroota kwaye.

English: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”
Kiswahili: Nayo mambo yakawa sawa kabisa na jinsi alivyotufasiria ndoto zetu: Mimi nilirudishwa kazini mwangu na huyo mtu mwingine akaangikwa.”
Ekegusii: Na buna ere atoteebetie engencho ye chindoto chiaito, naboigo abeete; inche nkairanigwa ase emeremo yane, na oria onde agasungwa ase omote igoro.”

English: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Basi, Farao akatuma Yosefu aitwe, naye akatolewa kifungoni haraka. Baada ya kunyoa na kubadilisha nguo zake akaenda mbele ya Farao.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao agatoma abanto korangeria Yusufu. Bakamorenta bwango korwa ase echela, na ere akagingirwa, akaonchoreria chianga chiaye, akagenda ase obosio bwa Farao.

English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”
Kiswahili: Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Nimeota ndoto, wala hakuna mtu hata mmoja anayeweza kuifasiri. Lakini nimesikia ikisemwa kwa habari yako kwamba unapoelezwa ndoto waweza kuifasiri.”
Ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Nigo narota okoroota, gose onde tari oranyare gonteebia engencho y’okoroota kwane. Inche naigure amang’ana ao ng’a gokwaigure chindoto, nabo okomanya engencho ye chindoto echio.”

English: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akamjibu Farao, “Siwezi kuifasiri, lakini Mungu atampa Farao jibu analolihitaji.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu akairaneria Farao, akabora: “Tari inche, korende Nyasae orakoe aye Farao okoiraneria kw’omorembe.”

English: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;
Kiswahili: Kisha Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Katika ndoto yangu nilikuwa nimesimama ukingoni mwa Mto Naili,
Ekegusii: Erio Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ase okoroota kwane nigo narooche ng’a nteneine ase engegu y’orooche.

English: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass;
Kiswahili: nikawaona ngʼombe saba, wazuri na wanono, wakijitokeza kutoka mtoni wakaja kujilisha kwenye matete.
Ekegusii: Nkarora chiombe isano na ibere, chinoru chingiya mono, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka;

English: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hao, ngʼombe wengine saba wadhaifu wakatokea, wabaya sana na waliokonda. Kamwe sikuwahi kuona ngʼombe wabaya jinsi hiyo katika nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: naende nkarora chiombe chinde isano na ibere, chimbe mono chindeu, chikorwa rooche, chigochitunyana korwa magega. Ase ense yonsi ya Misiri tinana korora chiombe chimbe buna echio.

English: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;
Kiswahili: Hao ngʼombe waliokonda na wabaya sana wakawala wale ngʼombe saba walionona waliojitokeza kwanza.
Ekegusii: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiombe chiria isano na ibere chi’eritang’ani, chiare chingiya chinoru,

English: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata baada ya kuwala, hakuna mtu ambaye angeweza kusema kwamba wamekula, bado walionekana wabaya kama mwanzoni. Kisha nikaamka kutoka usingizini.
Ekegusii: korende ekero chiachirire tichiarorekana ng’a nchiachiria, nkarora nabo chire buna chiare ritang’ani. Erio nkaboka.

English: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;
Kiswahili: “Pia katika ndoto zangu niliona masuke saba ya nafaka, yamejaa na mazuri, yanakua katika bua moja.
Ekegusii: Naende konararire nkarora ase okoroota kwane ebigara ebinene ebinoru bitano na bibere, bikinete ase oroboba oromo;

English: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo masuke mengine saba yakachipua, yaliyonyauka, membamba na yamekaushwa na upepo wa mashariki.
Ekegusii: na ebigara ebiomo ebireu, ebiasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, bikaoroka korwa magega yabo,

English: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”
Kiswahili: Yale masuke membamba ya nafaka yakayameza yale masuke saba mazuri yaliyojaa nafaka. Nimewaeleza waaguzi, wala hakuna yeyote aliyeweza kunifasiria.”
Ekegusii: na ebigara biria ebireu bikaria biria ebinoru bitano na bibere. Inche ngateebia abaringoria, korende onde tari onyarete gonteebia engencho y’okoroota kwane.”

English: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akamwambia Farao, “Ndoto za Farao ni ndoto iyo hiyo moja. Mungu amemfunulia Farao jambo analokusudia kufanya karibuni.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agateebia Farao: “Chindoto chiao, aye Farao, nigo chire echimo. Nyasae okworokirie, aye Farao, aya agochia gokora iga bwango.

English: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.
Kiswahili: Ngʼombe saba wazuri ni miaka saba, nayo masuke saba mazuri yaliyojaa nafaka ni miaka saba, ni ndoto iyo hiyo moja.
Ekegusii: Chiombe chiria chingiya isano na ibere, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere, na ebigara biria ebiya bitano na bibere, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere; chindoto echio nechimo.

English: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.
Kiswahili: Ngʼombe saba waliokonda na wabaya wale waliojitokeza baadaye ni miaka saba, vivyo hivyo masuke saba ya ngano yaliyodhoofika na kukaushwa na upepo wa mashariki, ni miaka saba ya njaa.
Ekegusii: Ne chiombe chiria isano na ibere chimbe chindeu, chiachitunyanete chiria chinoru, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere, na ebigara biria bitano na bibere bitaamete, biasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere y’enchara.

English: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.
Kiswahili: “Ni kama vile nilivyomwambia Farao: Mungu amemwonyesha Farao jambo analokusudia kufanya karibuni.
Ekegusii: Aya naro buna nagoteebia aye Farao, ng’a Nyasae okworokirie aya agochia gokora iga bwango.

English: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.
Kiswahili: Miaka saba ya neema inakuja katika nchi yote ya Misri,
Ekegusii: Rora, ngochi-gocha ere emiaka etano na ebere y’omoigoto ase ense yonsi ya Misiri,

English: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,
Kiswahili: lakini itafuata miaka saba ya njaa. Ndipo neema yote ya Misri itasahaulika na njaa itaikumba nchi.
Ekegusii: korende magega y’ayio neche emiaka ende etano na ebere y’enchara; na omoigoto oria bwonsi nigo ogochia kwebwa ase ense ya Misiri, ekiagera enchara eria nigo erarie ense eye.

English: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.
Kiswahili: “Neema iliyokuwa katika nchi haitakumbukwa, kwa sababu njaa itakayofuata itakuwa kali mno.
Ekegusii: Omoigoto oria tokoinyorwa ase ense eye, ase engencho y’enchara eye erache gocha korwa magega yaye, ekiagera nigo erabe endito mono.

English: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
Kiswahili: Sababu ya ndoto kumjia Farao kwa namna mbili ni kwamba jambo hilo Mungu ameshaamua kwa hakika, naye Mungu atalifanya karibuni.
Ekegusii: Na bono Farao, okoroota kwao nigo gwachete eria kabere, aya nigo akoorokia ng’a Nyasae ochikiire amang’ana aya, na Nyasae nayaikeranie iga bwango.

English: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “Basi sasa Farao na atafute mtu mwenye akili na hekima ili amweke kuwa msimamizi wa nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio Farao, rigia omonto ore omomanyi na omong’aini, omobeke igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.

English: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.
Kiswahili: Farao na aweke wenye amri nchini kote wakusanye sehemu ya tano ya mavuno ya Misri katika miaka hii saba ya neema.
Ekegusii: Na bono Farao, aya naro ogwenerete okore: Obeke abateneneri igoro y’ense eye bachoge ensemo ya isano y’endagera ase ense ya Misiri ase emiaka eye etano na ebere y’omoigoto.

English: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
Kiswahili: Wakusanye chakula chote katika miaka hii saba ya neema inayokuja na kuhifadhi nafaka chini ya mamlaka ya Farao, iwe akiba ya chakula katika miji.
Ekegusii: Tiga basangererie endagera eye yonsi y’emiaka eye emiya egocha, bayebeke erendwe ase emechie, ase okobua gwa Farao.

English: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”
Kiswahili: Chakula hiki kitakuwa akiba ya tahadhari kwa ajili ya nchi, ili kitumike katika ile miaka saba ya njaa itakayokuja Misri, ili nchi isiharibiwe na njaa.”
Ekegusii: Na endagera eye egachwe eche koegwa abanto emiaka eye etano na ebere y’enchara, erache gocha ase ense ya Misiri, abanto tibaabaisa gocha gosira ase enchara eyio.”

English: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu ulionekana mzuri kwa Farao na kwa maafisa wake wote.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio akagwenera Farao amo nabasomba baye bonsi.

English: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Farao akawauliza, “Je tunaweza kumpata yeyote kama mtu huyu, ambaye Roho wa Mungu yumo ndani yake?”
Ekegusii: Farao akabooria abasomba baye: “Inee! Ng’ai toranyore omonto onga buna oyo ore n’Omoika o Nyasae ime yaye?”

English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Maadamu Mungu amekufunulia yote haya, hakuna mwingine yeyote mwenye akili na hekima kama wewe.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ekiagera Nyasae okomanyirie amang’ana ayio onsi, onde tari aa omanyete, naende ore na obong’aini buna aye.

English: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”
Kiswahili: Wewe utakuwa msimamizi wa jumba langu la kifalme, na watu wangu wote watatii amri zako. Ni kuhusu kiti cha ufalme tu nitakuwa mkuu kuliko wewe.”
Ekegusii: Bono naye orabe omoteneneri bw’enka yane, na abanto baane bonsi nabakoigwere buna orabe gokobachika. Ase ekerogo kiane ki’obogaambi oka, nao ndabe omonene gokobua.”

English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Sasa nakuweka uwe msimamizi wa nchi yote ya Misri.”
Ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Rora nakobekire aye igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.”

English: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Farao akaivua pete yake ya muhuri kutoka kidoleni mwake na kuivalisha katika kidole cha Yosefu. Akamvika majoho mazuri ya kitani safi na mkufu wa dhahabu shingoni mwake.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarusia ebonyi yaye ere nekemanyererio korwa ase ekiara kiaye, akamoyebeekera Yusufu kiara kiaye, akamobekera na eanga engiya y’egatani, akamobekera ne chisonoi chi’etaabu igoti riaye.

English: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Akampandisha katika gari lake la farasi kama msaidizi wake, watu wakatangulia wakishangilia, wakisema, “Fungueni njia!” Ndivyo Farao alivyomweka Yosefu kuwa msimamizi wa nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Akamoriinia ase egari yaye ya kabere y’oborwoti. Abanto bagaaka eriogi, bakobora: “Tung’ama inse!” Naboigo akamobeka abe omogambi bw’ense yonsi ya Misiri.

English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Mimi ni Farao, lakini pasipo neno lako, hakuna mtu mwenye ruhusa kuinua mkono au mguu katika nchi yote ya Misri.”
Ekegusii: Naende Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ninche Farao. Otancheti aye, onde takoba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri oraimoke gokora gento.”

English: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Farao akamwita Yosefu Safenath-Panea, pia akampa Asenathi binti Potifera, kuhani wa mji wa Oni, kuwa mke wake. Ndipo Yosefu akaitembelea nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Farao Akaroka Yusufu Safenati‐Panea; akamonyuomeria omokungu, nere Asenati, omoiseke o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni. Yusufu akagenda aaria na aaria korigereria ense yonsi ya Misiri.

English: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Yosefu alikuwa na miaka thelathini alipoingia katika utumishi wa Farao mfalme wa Misri. Naye Yosefu akatoka mbele ya Farao akasafiri katika nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Agwo Yusufu, ekero asoete gokorera Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato. Na Yusufu akarua ase obosio bwa Farao, agaetanana ase ense yonsi ya Misri.

English: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.
Kiswahili: Katika ile miaka saba ya neema nchi ilizaa mazao kwa wingi sana.
Ekegusii: Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto egaika, ense ekaama endagera enyinge,

English: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akakusanya chakula chote kilichozalishwa katika ile miaka saba ya neema nchini Misri, akakihifadhi katika ghala za miji. Katika kila mji kulihifadhiwa chakula kilichozalishwa katika mashamba yaliyouzunguka mji huo.
Ekegusii: na Yusufu agasangereria endagera yonsi ase emiaka eria etano na ebere, ase ense ya Misiri, akayegacha ase emechie. Ase kera omochie akagacha endagera yonsi y’emegondo eria yayoetanaine.

English: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.
Kiswahili: Yosefu alihifadhi nafaka nyingi, mfano wa mchanga wa bahari, ilikuwa nyingi mno kiasi kwamba walishindwa kuweka kumbukumbu kwa sababu akiba ilizidi sana kupita kipimo.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akagacha endagera ase obonge mono, ekaba enyinge buna omokenye bw’Enyancha, goika agatiga koyerenga, ekiagera tiyare konyara korengeka.

English: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya miaka ya njaa kuanza, Asenathi binti Potifera, kuhani wa mji wa Oni, alikuwa amemzalia Yosefu wana wawili wa kiume.
Ekegusii: Ritang’ani konya emiaka eria y’enchara etaracha, Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni, akaiborera Yusufu abana abaisia babere.

English: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akamwita mzaliwa wake wa kwanza Manase, akisema, “Ni kwa sababu Mungu amenifanya nisahau taabu zangu zote pamoja na jamaa yote ya nyumba ya baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu Akaaroka omwana oria omotangi Manase, agateeba: “Nyasae ogerire inyebe obokong’u bwonsi na abanto b’enka ya tata”

English: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
Kiswahili: Mwana wa pili akamwita Efraimu, akisema, “Ni kwa sababu Mungu amenistawisha katika nchi ya mateso yangu.”
Ekegusii: Na omwana o kabere akamoroka Efraimu, agateeba: “Nyasae ong’eire oroiboro ase ense y’emechando yane.”

English: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
Kiswahili: Ile miaka saba ya neema huko Misri ikaisha,
Ekegusii: Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto ekaera ase ense ya Misiri,

English: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
Kiswahili: nayo miaka ile saba ya njaa ikaanza, sawasawa na alivyosema Yosefu. Kulikuwa na njaa katika nchi nyingine zote, bali katika nchi yote ya Misri kulikuwa na chakula.
Ekegusii: na emiaka eria etano na ebere y’enchara egachaka gocha, buna Yusufu abaanete. Enchara egacha ase chinse chionsi, korende ase ense yonsi ya Misiri endagera n’yareengeo.

English: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”
Kiswahili: Wakati nchi yote ya Misri ilipopatwa na njaa, watu wakamlilia Farao ili awape chakula. Ndipo Farao alipowaagiza Wamisri wote, akisema, “Nendeni kwa Yosefu, nanyi mfanye anachowaambia.”
Ekegusii: Ekero enchara yariete abanto bonsi ba Misiri, barabwo bakamorera Farao abae endagera; na Farao agateebia Abamisiri bonsi: “Genda ase Yusufu, na rinde rionsi arabateebie, goika morikore.”

English: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Wakati njaa ilipokuwa imeenea katika nchi yote, Yosefu akafungua ghala za vyakula na kuwauzia Wamisri nafaka, kwa sababu njaa ilikuwa kali mno katika nchi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, ekero enchara yasoete ase ense eria engima, Yusufu akaigora ebiage bionsi, akaooneria Abamisiri endagera, ekiagera enchara nigo yabeete endito ase ense ya Misiri.

English: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
Kiswahili: Pia nchi nyingine zote zilikuja Misri kununua nafaka kutoka kwa Yosefu, kwa sababu njaa ilikuwa kali mno duniani kote.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’echinse chionsi bagacha Misiri kogora endagera korwa ase Yusufu, ekiagera enchara nigo yareenge endito ase ense engima.

English: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”
Kiswahili: Wakati Yakobo alipofahamu kuwa kuna nafaka huko Misri, akawaambia wanawe, “Mbona mnakaa tu hapa mnatazamana?”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo aigwete ng’a endagera nekare ase ense ya Misiri, akabooria abamura baye: “Inaki morigereranetie iga?”

English: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kuwaambia, “Nimesikia kuwa huko Misri kuna nafaka. Telemkeni huko mkanunue chakula kwa ajili yetu, ili tuweze kuishi wala tusife.”
Ekegusii: Naende akabateebia: “Naigure ng’a endagera nekare Misiri, tirimboka gochiao, motogorere endagera toche koria, tobe moyo, titokwa.”

English: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wale ndugu kumi wa Yosefu, wakateremka huko Misri kununua nafaka.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, bamura bamwabo Yusufu ikomi bagatirimboka gochia Misiri kogora endagera.

English: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yakobo hakumtuma Benyamini, ndugu yake Yosefu, pamoja na wengine, kwa sababu aliogopa asije akapatwa na madhara.
Ekegusii: Korende Yakobo tamwancherete Benjamini, omwabo Yusufu, kogende amo nabarabwo, ekiagera nigo aoboete ng’a aande nabaise gochia konyorwa n’amabe.

English: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wana wa Israeli walikuwa miongoni mwa wale waliokwenda Misri kununua nafaka, kwani njaa ilikuwa katika nchi ya Kanaani pia.
Ekegusii: Nabo basinto ba Israeli bakagenda amo nabaanto bande abachiete kogora endagera, ekiagera enchara yarenge ase ense ya Kaanani.

English: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yosefu alikuwa mtawala wa nchi ya Misri, naye alikuwa ndiye aliwauzia watu wote nafaka. Kwa hiyo wakati ndugu zake Yosefu walipofika, wakamsujudia hadi nyuso zao zikagusa ardhi.
Ekegusii: Yusufu nere orenge gabana igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri, naende nere orenge kooneria abanto bonsi b’ense eria endagera. Na abamwabo Yusufu, ekero baigete asare, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.

English: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?” They said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”
Kiswahili: Mara Yosefu alipowaona ndugu zake, akawatambua, lakini akajifanya mgeni na kuzungumza nao kwa ukali, akiwauliza, “Ninyi mnatoka wapi?” Wakamjibu, “Tumetoka katika nchi ya Kanaani kuja kununua chakula.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu, ekero abarora, akabamanya, korende agekora buna tabamanyeti, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amakong’u. Akababooria: “Abanto aba, ng’ai mwarure?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Nigo twarure ase ense ya Kaanani, twachire kogora endagera.”

English: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.
Kiswahili: Ingawa Yosefu aliwatambua ndugu zake, wao hawakumtambua.
Ekegusii: Nonya Yusufu omanyete abamwabo, barabwo tibamomanyete ere.

English: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu alipokumbuka ndoto zake kuwahusu wao, akawaambia, “Ninyi ni wapelelezi! Mmekuja kuangalia mahali ambapo nchi yetu haina ulinzi.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akainyora chindoto chiria areenge kobarootera, akabateebia: “Inwe nechirooti more, nigo mwachire koroota ense eye, na korora ase ere bosa etari na getango.”

English: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Sivyo bwana wangu. Watumishi wako wamekuja kununua chakula.
Ekegusii: Bakamokania: “Tari bo, Omonene, intwe abasomba bao nigo twachire kogora endagera.

English: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”
Kiswahili: Sisi sote ni wana wa baba mmoja. Watumishi wako ni watu waaminifu, wala sio wapelelezi.”
Ekegusii: Intwe twensi nabana b’omonto oyomo. Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.”

English: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “La hasha! Mmekuja kuangalia mahali ambapo nchi yetu haina ulinzi.”
Ekegusii: Akabakania: “Yaya, nigo mwachire koroota ense, na korora ense ase ere bosa etari na getango.”

English: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wakamjibu, “Watumishi wako walikuwa kumi na wawili, wana wa mtu mmoja ambaye anaishi katika nchi ya Kanaani. Sasa mdogo wetu wa mwisho yupo na baba yetu na mwingine alikufa.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, abana b’omonto oyomo, ase ense ya Kaanani; na bono omoke ominto tari aa, inka akare ase tata, na oyomo ere takaiyo.”

English: Joseph said to them, “It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies!’
Kiswahili: Yosefu akawaambia, “Ni sawa kabisa kama nilivyowaambia: Ninyi ni wapelelezi!
Ekegusii: Korende Yusufu akabateebia “Nabo ere buna konya naikire kobateebia, ng’a inwe nechirooti more.

English: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.
Kiswahili: Na hivi ndivyo mtakavyojaribiwa: Hakika kama Farao aishivyo, hamtaondoka mahali hapa mpaka ndugu yenu mdogo aje hapa.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana aya nimbateeme: Amaene, buna Farao are moyo, timokorua aa mogende, oria omino omoke ataracha aa.

English: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.”
Kiswahili: Tumeni mmoja wenu akamlete huyo ndugu yenu, wengine mtawekwa gerezani, ili maneno yenu yajaribiwe kuona kama mnasema kweli. La sivyo, hakika kama Farao aishivyo ninyi ni wapelelezi!”
Ekegusii: Toma oyomo oino agende korenta oyio omino, na inwe abande motigare echela. Nabo morateemwe gose namaene mogoteeba. Onye taibo, amaene buna Farao are moyo, inwe nechirooti more.”

English: He put them all together into custody for three days.
Kiswahili: Akawaweka wote chini ya ulinzi kwa siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Erio agasiekera bonsi amo echela ime ase amatuko atato.

English: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.
Kiswahili: Siku ya tatu Yosefu akawaambia, “Fanyeni hili nanyi mtaishi, kwa maana namwogopa Mungu:
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Yusufu akabateebia: “Mokore iga buna ndabateebie, nario morabe moyo; naki inche nomonto imoirogete Nyasae.

English: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa ninyi ni watu waaminifu, mmoja wa ndugu zenu na abaki kifungoni, nanyi wengine pelekeni nafaka kwa jamaa yenu wanaoteseka kwa njaa.
Ekegusii: Onye inwe more abanto abaronge, tiga oyomo oino atigare aa ase echela, na inwe abande moirere abwo mwatigete inka endagera, ase engencho y’enchara;

English: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.
Kiswahili: Lakini ni lazima mniletee ndugu yenu mdogo hapa, ili maneno yenu yathibitike na kwamba msife.” Wakakubali kufanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: erio morente oria omino omoke ase ’nde. Igo amang’ana aino aenekigwe ng’a namaene are, na inwe timobaisa gokwa. Barabwo bagakora bo.”

English: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”
Kiswahili: Wakaambiana wao kwa wao, “Hakika tunaadhibiwa kwa sababu ya ndugu yetu. Tuliona jinsi alivyohuzunika alipokuwa anatusihi kuponya maisha yake, lakini hatukumsikiliza, hiyo ndiyo sababu dhiki hii imetupata.”
Ekegusii: Erio bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: “Amaene, ntwamocherete oyominto. Nigo twarooche ogochandeka kw’omoyo oye, na ekero atosororete titwamoigwete. Ase ayio nakio kiagerire obokong’u obo bwatonyorire.”

English: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”
Kiswahili: Reubeni akawajibu, “Sikuwaambieni msitende dhambi dhidi ya kijana? Lakini hamkunisikiliza! Sasa ni lazima tuadhibiwe kwa ajili ya damu yake.”
Ekegusii: Rubeni akabairaneria, “Tinabakanetie ng’a timomochera omosae oyo? Korende inwe mokanga, timwanyigwera. Ase igo, bono amanyinga aye aganigwe aakanwe.”

English: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.
Kiswahili: Hawakujua kuwa Yosefu angewaelewa, kwa sababu alitumia mkalimani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibamanya ng’a Yusufu nayaigwete, ekiagera omonogi nareengeo ore komoonchorera.

English: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akajitenga nao akaanza kulia, kisha akawarudia na kuzungumza nao tena. Akataka Simeoni akamatwe na kufungwa mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Erio akarua ase bare, akagenda ensemo, akarera amariga; naende akairana, agakwana nabarabwo. Akarusia Simioni korwa ase bare, akamosiba korwa ase amasio abo.

English: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akatoa amri ya kujaza magunia yao nafaka na kuweka fedha ya kila mmoja ndani ya gunia lake, kisha wapewe mahitaji ya njiani. Baada ya kufanyiwa hayo yote,
Ekegusii: Yusufu agachiika abanto baichorie chigunia chiabo endagera, na kera oyomo airanerigwe chitaabu chiaye, chibekwe egunia yaye ime, na aegwe endagera agochia koria inchera. Naboigo baabakorerete.

English: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.
Kiswahili: wakapakiza nafaka juu ya punda zao, wakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaberekia chitigere chiabo endagera, bakagenda.

English: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.
Kiswahili: Walipofika mahali pa kulala huko njiani mmoja wao akafungua gunia lake ili amlishe punda wake, akakuta fedha yake kwenye mdomo wa gunia lake.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase bakorara botuko, oyomo obo agasansora egunia yaye arusie endagera ae etigere yaye, akarora chitaabu chiaye igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime,

English: He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia ndugu zake, “Fedha yangu imerudishwa. Iko ndani ya gunia langu.” Mioyo yao ikazimia, na kila mmoja akamgeukia mwenzake wakitetemeka, wakaulizana, “Ni nini hiki Mungu alichotufanyia?”
Ekegusii: agateebia abamwabo: “Ayee! Chibesa chiane nigo chiairanetigwe, rigereria, nao chire aa egunia yane ime!” Chinkoro chiabo chikagoyaana, bakarigererania na koiguswa, bagateeba: “Inki eke Nyasae atokoreire iga?”

English: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,
Kiswahili: Walipofika kwa Yakobo baba yao katika nchi ya Kanaani, wakamweleza mambo yote yaliyowapata. Wakasema,
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase Yakobo ise, ase ense ya Kaanani, bakabateebia ayio onsi abanyorete, bakaboora,

English: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.
Kiswahili: “Huyo mtu ambaye ndiye bwana katika nchi hiyo alisema nasi kwa ukali, akatutendea kana kwamba sisi tulikuwa tunaipeleleza nchi.
Ekegusii: “Omonto oria omonene bw’ense eria nigo akwanete naintwe amang’ana amakong’u agatoroka ng’a intwe nechirooti, tokoroota ense.

English: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.
Kiswahili: Lakini tulimwambia, ‘Sisi ni watu waaminifu, sio wapelelezi.
Ekegusii: Korende tokamoteebia: Intwe nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.

English: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’
Kiswahili: Tulizaliwa ndugu kumi na wawili, wana wa baba mmoja. Mmoja alikufa, na mdogo wetu wa mwisho yupo na baba yetu huko Kanaani.’
Ekegusii: Nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, tata noyomo. Oyomo oito takaiyo, na omoke kegima nere okare ase tata inka, ase ense ya Kaanani.

English: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo huyo mtu aliye bwana katika nchi hiyo alipotuambia, ‘Hivi ndivyo nitafahamu kuwa ninyi ni watu waaminifu: Mwacheni mmoja wa ndugu zenu pamoja nami hapa, kisha nendeni mpeleke chakula kwa ajili ya jamaa yenu inayoteseka kwa njaa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio, omonene bw’ense eria, agatoteebia: Ase amang’ana aya naro ndamanyere gose nabaanto abaronge more: Tiga oyomo oino aiga ase ’nde, inwe abande genda, moire endagera ase engencho y’enchara ekare inka seino.

English: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. So I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini mleteni huyo ndugu yenu mdogo kwangu, ndipo nitajua kuwa ninyi sio wapelelezi, ila ni watu waaminifu. Kisha nitamrudisha ndugu yenu, nanyi mtaweza kufanya biashara katika nchi hii.’ ”
Ekegusii: Genda mondetere oyio omino omoke, erio nario ndamanye ng’a timori chirooti, korende nabaanto abaronge. Erio nimbairanerie oyomino, na inwe inamonyore ribaga mobe mokoonchoreria ase ense eye.”

English: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanamimina nafaka kutoka kwenye magunia yao, ndani ya gunia la kila mtu kulikuwa na mfuko wa fedha! Wakati wao na baba yao walipoona mifuko ya fedha, wakaogopa.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero baumorete endagera korwa ase chigunia, bakanyora kera oyomo esaro ye chitaabu chiaye nao ere egunia yaye ime. Na ekero barabwo amo na ise barooche chisaro chi’echitaabu chiabo, bakaondoka.

English: Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin away. All these things are against me.”
Kiswahili: Yakobo baba yao akawaambia, “Ninyi mmenipokonya watoto wangu. Yosefu hayupo na Simeoni hayupo tena na sasa mnataka kumchukua Benyamini. Kila kitu ni kinyume nami!”
Ekegusii: Yakobo ise akabateebia: “Mwang’urire abana baane, Yusufu taiyo, na Simioni taiyo, na bono morigetie koira Benjamini nere. Amang’ana aya onsi anyorire inche.”

English: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Reubeni akamwambia baba yake, “Waweza kuwaua wanangu wote wawili, ikiwa sitamrudisha Benyamini kwako. Mkabidhi Benyamini katika uangalizi wangu, nami nitamrudisha.”
Ekegusii: Erio Rubeni agateebia ise “Oite abana baane babere abamura onye tinkomoirania gocha asore. Mobeke ase amaboko aane na inche nimoiranie.”

English: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along the way in which you go, then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yakobo akasema, “Mwanangu hatashuka huko pamoja nanyi; ndugu yake amekufa naye ndiye peke yake aliyebaki. Ikiwa atapatwa na madhara katika safari mnayoiendea, mtashusha kichwa changu chenye mvi kaburini kwa masikitiko.”
Ekegusii: Akamokania: “Omwana one tagotirimboka amo nainwe, ekiagera oyomwabo okuure na oyo nere otigarete bweka. Amabe aise gochia komonyoora agwo inchera, nigo moragere ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane inde nomoichano.”

English: The famine was severe in the land.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu njaa ilikuwa bado ni kali mno katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Enchara ekaba enene ase ense.

English: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakati walikuwa wamemaliza kula nafaka yote waliyoileta kutoka Misri, Yakobo baba yao akawaambia, “Rudini Misri mkatununulie chakula kingine zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Na ekero bakoorire endagera eria bagorete korwa Misiri, ise akabateebia: “Irana naende motogorere endagera nke toche koria.”

English: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’
Kiswahili: Lakini Yuda akamwambia, “Mtu yule alituonya kwa msisitizo, ‘Hamtauona uso wangu tena mpaka mje na ndugu yenu.’
Ekegusii: Korende Yuda akabateebia: Omonto oria nigo atochigete bokong’u, agatoteebia: Timogocha kondora obosio bwane oyio omino atacheti amo nainwe.

English: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food;
Kiswahili: Kama utakubali ndugu yetu aende pamoja nasi, tutakwenda kuwanunulia chakula.
Ekegusii: Koratoe oyominto agende amo naintwe, rirorio inatotirimboke tokogorere endagera.

English: but if you don’t send him, we won’t go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa hutamruhusu aende, hatutakwenda, kwa sababu mtu yule alituambia, ‘Hamtauona uso wangu tena mpaka mje pamoja na ndugu yenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende onye togotomoa togende komo, rirorio titokogenda, ekiagera omonto oria nigo atoteebetie, “Timokondora obosio bwane motacheti noyio omino.”

English: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”
Kiswahili: Israeli akauliza, “Kwa nini mkaniletea taabu hii kwa kumwambia yule mtu mlikuwa na ndugu mwingine?”
Ekegusii: Israeli akababooria: “Ninki mwankorera igo na gonchanda, goika mogateebia omonto oria ng’a mokare noyomino onde inka?”

English: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Yule mtu alituhoji kwa undani sana habari zetu na za jamaa yetu. Alituuliza, ‘Je, baba yenu bado yungali hai? Je mnaye ndugu mwingine?’ Sisi tulimjibu maswali yake tu. Tungewezaje kujua kwamba angesema, ‘Mleteni mdogo wenu hapa’?”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Omonto oria nigo atounetie mono amanye amang’ana aito na ay’eamate yaito, agatoboria: Iso moyo are? Mokare nonde omino? Na intwe tokamoiraneria buna atoboretie. Inee! Ntwamanyete aya agochia gokwana ng’a: Gachie morente oyomino?”

English: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yuda akamwambia baba yake Israeli, “Mtume kijana pamoja nami, nasi tutaondoka mara, ili sisi na wewe pamoja na watoto wetu tuweze kuishi, wala tusife.
Ekegusii: Yuda agateebia Israeli ise: “Mong’e omosae oyo agende amo nainche, erio toimoke togende aroro, erinde egere tobe moyo, titokwa, intwe, naye, amo nabana baito abake.

English: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever;
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe nitakuhakikishia usalama wake, mimi mwenyewe nitawajibika kumrudisha. Ikiwa sitamrudisha kwako na kumweka mbele yako, nitakuwa mwenye lawama mbele yako maisha yangu yote.
Ekegusii: Nerure imbe intenenera asare: korwa ase okoboko kwane oche komonsaba. Onye tinkomoirania gocha asore, rirorio ontige mbogorie okomocha okwo amatuko onsi ase obosio bwao.

English: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”
Kiswahili: Hakika, kama hatukuchelewa kuondoka, tungekuwa tumekwenda na kurudi mara mbili.”
Ekegusii: Onye totatebanire nanga twairanire chintunda ibere.”

English: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;
Kiswahili: Basi baba yao Israeli akawaambia, “Kama ni lazima iwe hivyo, basi fanyeni hivi: Wekeni baadhi ya mazao bora ya nchi katika mifuko yenu na mpelekeeni yule mtu kama zawadi, zeri kidogo, asali kidogo, vikolezo, manemane, kungu na lozi.
Ekegusii: Israeli ise akabateebia: “Onye naboigo are, bono mokore iga: Mobeke ebinto ebiya bi’ense eye yaito ase chigunia chiaino, moirere omonto oyio buna ebiegwa. Momoirere amaguta okogwenia make, na obooke boke, na ubani, na manemane, na amajozi.

English: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.
Kiswahili: Chukueni fedha mara mbili, kwa kuwa mtazirudisha zile fedha zilizowekwa midomoni mwa magunia yenu. Labda ziliwekwa kwa makosa.
Ekegusii: Mobogorie chitaabu ara kabere ase amaboko aino, moirane chitaabu chiria chiairanetigwe, echio chiabegetwe igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaino ime. Aande nigo chiebetwe chikabekwao.

English: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.
Kiswahili: Mchukueni ndugu yenu pia mrudi kwa huyo mtu mara moja.
Ekegusii: Moire na oyomino, mogende komo, mogende ase omonto oria naende.

English: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”
Kiswahili: Naye Mungu Mwenyezi awajalieni rehema mbele ya huyo mtu ili apate kumwachia yule ndugu yenu na Benyamini mweze kurudi pamoja. Kwangu mimi kama nikufiwa nimefiwa.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae Omobui abae ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’omonto oyio, erio abasiborere oria omino onde, erinde moirane nere amo na Benjamini. Onye inche ekongwenera nsirerwe nabana baane, tiga abe bo.”

English: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
Kiswahili: Basi hao watu wakazichukua zile zawadi na zile fedha mara mbili pamoja na Benyamini. Wakafanya haraka kwenda Misri na walipofika wakajionyesha kwa Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, abanto abwo bakaimokia ebiegwa, bakaimokia ne chitaabu ara kabere; amo na Benjamini bakagenda, bagatirimboka gochia Misiri, bagachia bagatenena ase obosio bwa Yusufu.

English: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu alipomwona Benyamini pamoja nao, akamwambia msimamizi wa nyumba yake, “Wachukue watu hawa nyumbani kwangu, mchinje mnyama na kuandalia chakula kwa kuwa watakula chakula cha mchana pamoja nami.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yusufu arooche Benjamini ore amo nabarabwo agateebia omoteneneri bw’enka yaye: “Barente abanto abwo nyomba, na onyenye emori, oyeroisie, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo bagocha koragera amo nainche endagera ya mobaso.”

English: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.
Kiswahili: Yule Msimamizi akafanya kama Yosefu alivyomwambia na akawachukua wale watu nyumbani kwa Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie, agasoyia abanto abwo nyomba ime.

English: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”
Kiswahili: Basi watu hao wakaogopa walipopelekwa nyumbani kwa Yosefu. Wakafikiri, “Tumeletwa hapa kwa ajili ya zile fedha zilizorudishwa katika magunia yetu mara ile ya kwanza. Anataka kutushambulia na kutushinda, atuchukue sisi kama watumwa, na atwae hawa punda zetu.”
Ekegusii: Korende abanto aba bakaondoka, ekiagera bairetwe nyomba mwa Yusufu, bakaboora: “Nigo twarentirwe nyomba ime ase engencho ye chitaabu chiria chiabegetwe ase chigunia chiaito engaki eria entang’ani. Na bono nigo ararigie gotosoera, na atoimokere, atobwate, atokore tobe abasomba baye, aire ne chitigere chiaito.”

English: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakamwendea msimamizi wa nyumba wa Yosefu na kuzungumza naye kwenye ingilio la nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, bakamoika ang’e omoteneneri oria bw’enka ya Yusufu, bakaba bagokwana nere gesieri ki’enyomba,

English: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.
Kiswahili: Wakasema, “Tafadhali bwana, tulikuja hapa mara ya kwanza kununua chakula.
Ekegusii: bakabateebia: “Koranche Omonene, otoigwe! Engaki eria entang’ani twachete aiga kogora endagera,

English: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.
Kiswahili: Lakini mahali pale tulipotua wakati wa jioni tulifungua magunia yetu, na kila mmoja wetu akakuta fedha zake, kwenye mdomo wa gunia lake kiasi kile kile tulicholeta. Kwa hiyo tumezirudisha.
Ekegusii: ekero twairanete gochia seito, gotwaikire ase twaraarete botuko, togachia gosansora chigunia chiaito, tokanyora kera omonto chitaabu chiaye nao chire igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime, chitaabu chionsi pi. Bono chitaabu echi chionsi ntwachirentana, naa tochibwate amo naintwe.

English: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”
Kiswahili: Pia tumeleta fedha nyingine kwa ajili ya kununulia chakula. Hatujui ni nani aliziweka fedha hizo katika magunia yetu.”
Ekegusii: Naende ntwarentana chitaabu chinde, echi togocha kogora endagera. Titomanyeti gose ning’o ochibegete ase chigunia chiaito ime.”

English: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Vema, msiogope. Mungu wenu, Mungu wa baba yenu, amewapa ninyi hazina katika magunia yenu; mimi nilipokea fedha yenu.” Ndipo akawaletea Simeoni.
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria “Timoka, motoerere, timoondoka; Nyasae oino, oyore Nyasae o iso, nere obaete enibo eye ase chigunia chiaino; chitaabu chiaino inachinyorete.” Erio akarenta Simioni ase bare.

English: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.
Kiswahili: Msimamizi akawapeleka wale watu katika nyumba ya Yosefu, akawapa maji ya kunawa miguu na kuwapa punda wao majani.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akaira abanto baria nyomba mwa Yusufu, akabaa amaache bagesibia amagoro abo, akaa ne chitigere chiabo endagera.

English: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.
Kiswahili: Wakaandaa zawadi zao ili wampe Yosefu wakati atakapofika adhuhuri, kwa kuwa walikuwa wamesikia kwamba watakula chakula huko.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakabeeka ebiegwa biabo ang’e, baganye Yusufu kagocha mobaso, ekiagera konya baigure ng’a nao bagocha koragerera endagera ya mobaso.

English: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.
Kiswahili: Yosefu alipokuja nyumbani, walimkabidhi zile zawadi walizokuwa nazo, ambazo walikuwa wamezileta mle nyumbani, nao wakamsujudia hadi nchi.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Yusufu achete nyomba ime bakamoirera ebiegwa biria barentete, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.

English: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza kuhusu hali yao, kisha akawaambia, “Yule baba yenu mzee mliyeniambia habari zake, yu hali gani? Je, bado yu hai?”
Ekegusii: Akabakwania, akababooria: “Inee! Iso mbuya are, omogaka oria mwanteebia? Moyo are?”

English: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Mtumishi wako baba yetu bado anaishi na ni mzima.” Kisha wakainama chini kumpa heshima.
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Ee, omosomba oo tata mbuya are. Nabo moyo are.” Barabwo bagatureka emetwe yabo inse.

English: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”
Kiswahili: Alipotazama na kumwona Benyamini ndugu yake, mwana wa mama yake hasa, akauliza, “Je, huyu ndiye ndugu yenu wa mwisho, ambaye mlinieleza habari zake?” Ndipo akasema, “Mungu na akufadhili, mwanangu.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora Benjamini omwabo, omwana omwabo baruete enda eyemo nere, akababooria: “Oyo nere oria omoke omino, oria mwanteebia?” Akaonchokera Benjamini, akamoteebia: “Nyasae akoe obuya, omwana one!”

English: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.
Kiswahili: Akiwa ameguswa sana kwa kumwona ndugu yake, Yosefu akatoka nje kwa haraka na kutafuta mahali pa kulilia. Akaingia kwenye chumba chake cha pekee na kulilia humo.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akaimoka, agasoa enyomba ende, ekiagera enkoro yaye nigo yaare namaiga ase omwana omwabo, aroro ase enyomba eyio akarera amariga.

English: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kunawa uso wake, akatoka nje na huku akijizuia akasema, “Pakueni chakula.”
Ekegusii: Erio agesibia obosio, agasoka oremereretie. Naende akabora: “Renta endagera!”

English: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.
Kiswahili: Wakampakulia Yosefu peke yake, ndugu zake peke yao na Wamisri waliokula pamoja naye peke yao, kwa sababu Wamisri wasingeweza kula pamoja na Waebrania, kwa maana ilikuwa ni chukizo kwa Wamisri.
Ekegusii: Bakamobekera endagera bweka ao, na abamwabo boka ao, na Abamisiri baria konya bakoragera komo boka ao, ekiagera Abamisiri nigo bagechete Abaiberania, tibaare koria amo nabarabwo.

English: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another.
Kiswahili: Watu hao walikuwa wameketi mbele yake kwa mfuatano wa umri wao, kuanzia mzaliwa wa kwanza hadi mzaliwa wa mwisho, wakatazamana wao kwa wao kwa mshangao.
Ekegusii: Abamwabo Yusufu bagaikaransigwa ase obosio bwaye, bakaroberigwa gochakera ase oria omonene kogenderera goika ase oria omoke. Bonsi kobaikaransire, bakarigererania, bagakumia.

English: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.
Kiswahili: Wakati walipelekewa sehemu ya chakula kutoka mezani mwa Yosefu, sehemu ya Benyamini ilikuwa mara tano zaidi ya sehemu ya wale wengine. Kwa hiyo wakanywa na kufurahi pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Bakaegwa endagera korwa ase emesa ya Yusufu, korende Benjamini ere akarenterwa enyinge kobua abwo bande, ebirengo bitano. Naboigo bakanywa, bakagoka amo nere.

English: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yosefu akampa yule msimamizi wa nyumbani mwake maagizo haya: “Jaza magunia ya watu hawa kiasi cha chakula ambacho wanaweza kuchukua, na uweke fedha ya kila mtu kwenye mdomo wa gunia lake.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agachiika omoteneneri bw’enka yaye: “Ichoria chigunia chi’abaanto aba endagera, koreng’ana buna baranyare kobogoria, obeke ne chitaabu chia kera omonto igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime.

English: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
Kiswahili: Kisha weka kikombe changu kile cha fedha kwenye mdomo wa gunia la yule mdogo wa wote pamoja na fedha zake ambazo angenunulia nafaka yake.” Naye akafanya kama Yosefu alivyosema.
Ekegusii: Obeke na egekombe kiane keria kiaroisetigwe korwa ase chifeta, okebeke ime ase egunia y’omomura oria omoke kegima, amo ne chitaabu chiria achete nachio kogora endagera.” Ere agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie.

English: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka, hao watu wakaruhusiwa kuondoka pamoja na punda zao.
Ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia abanto baria bakaegwa ribaga baimokie chitigere chiabo, bagende sobo.

English: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?
Kiswahili: Kabla hawajafika mbali kutoka mjini, Yosefu akamwambia mtumishi wake, “Wafuatilie wale watu mara moja, utakapowakuta, waambie, ‘Kwa nini mmelipiza wema kwa ubaya?
Ekegusii: Ekero bagendire egeka geke korwa ase omochie, Yusufu agateebia omoteneneri bw’enka yaye. “Imoka, obwatie abanto baria! Ekero orabanyore obaborie: Nase ki mogoakana amabe ase amaya?

English: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”
Kiswahili: Je, kikombe hiki sicho anachonywea bwana wangu na pia hukitumia kwa kutabiri mambo yajayo? Hili ni jambo ovu mlilolitenda.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inee! Egekombe eke mwaibete, tai kerokio omonene one akonywera? Naende nakio agokorera oboringoria. Mwakorire bobe ase ogokora iga.”

English: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.
Kiswahili: Alipowafikia, akarudia maneno haya kwao.
Ekegusii: Ekero abaikerete agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana aria aria.

English: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!
Kiswahili: Lakini wakamwambia mtumishi, “Kwa nini bwana wangu anasema maneno kama haya? Liwe mbali na watumishi wako wasije wakafanya jambo kama hilo!
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Naki aye, Omonene oito, ogokwana amang’ana buna ayio?

English: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo tulikurudishia zile fedha kutoka nchi ya Kanaani ambazo tulizikuta kwenye midomo ya magunia yetu. Hivyo kwa nini tuibe fedha au dhahabu kutoka nyumbani kwa bwana wako?
Ekegusii: Tari bo, intwe abasomba bao titware gokora bo. Inee! Chibesa chiria twanyorete igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaito ime, titwagochiiraneria naende korwa ase ense ya Kaanani? Naki tware gokora toibe efeta gose etaabu korwa ase enyomba y’omonene oo?

English: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa yeyote miongoni mwa watumishi wako atapatikana nacho, auawe, na sisi wengine tutakuwa watumwa wa bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Oyoranyorekane ore negekombe ekio ase egati yaito intwe abasomba bao, oyio akwe, naintwe boigo rirorio tobe abasomba bao, Omonene oito.”

English: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Vema sana; na iwe kama msemavyo. Yeyote atakayekutwa nacho atakuwa mtumwa wangu, lakini ninyi wengine mtakuwa hamna lawama.”
Ekegusii: Akabora: “Tiga abe buna mwateeba, omonto oranyorekane okebwate nigo arabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande inamobe motari na komocha.”

English: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja wao akafanya haraka kushusha gunia lake chini na kulifungua.
Ekegusii: Erio bagakora bwango, bagaikia kera omonto egunia yaye inse, na koyesansora.

English: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
Kiswahili: Ndipo msimamizi akaendelea kutafuta, akianzia kwa mkubwa wa wote na akaishia kwa mdogo wa wote. Basi kikombe kikapatikana katika gunia la Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Na omosomba oria agachaaka koriga‐rigia, agachakera ase omomura omonene, agachia gokoorera ase omoke, na egekombe gekanyorekana ase egunia ya Benjamini.

English: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.
Kiswahili: Kwa jambo hili, wakararua nguo zao. Ndipo wote wakapakiza mizigo yao juu ya punda zao na kurudi mjini.
Ekegusii: Erio bonsi bagatandora chianga chiabo; kera omonto akabeekera etigere yaye egurube, bakairana gochia ase omochie.

English: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.
Kiswahili: Yosefu alikuwa bado yuko nyumbani mwake wakati Yuda na kaka zake walipoingia, wote wakajitupa chini mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Yuda na abamwabo, ekero bairanete ase omochie, bakanyora Yusufu nao are nyomba, barabwo bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, ase obosio bwaye.

English: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akawaambia, “Ni jambo gani hili mlilolifanya? Hamjui kuwa mtu kama mimi anaweza kufahamu mambo kwa njia ya kutabiri?”
Ekegusii: Yusufu akababooria: “Ing’ana ki eri mwakorire? Timomanyeti ng’a omonto buna inche nigo ndanyare gokora oboringoria imanye?”

English: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”
Kiswahili: Yuda akajibu, “Tutaweza kusema nini kwa bwana wangu? Tutaweza kuzungumza nini? Tutawezaje kuthibitisha kwamba hatuna hatia? Mungu amefunua hatia ya watumishi wako. Sasa sisi tu watumwa wa bwana wangu, sisi wenyewe pamoja na yule aliyepatikana na kikombe.”
Ekegusii: Yuda akairaneria: “Ninki togoteeba asore, Omonene oito? Ninki togokwana? Gose inatonyare kweenekia ng’a nabaronge tore? Nyasae ororire ebibe biaito intwe abasomba bao; na bono, omonene oito, intwe amo nere, oyo egekombe kianyorekana ase okoboko kwaye, tiga tobe abasomba bao.”

English: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yosefu alisema, “Liwe mbali nami kufanya jambo kama hili! Mtu yule tu aliyekutwa na kikombe ndiye atakayekuwa mtumwa wangu. Ninyi wengine, rudini kwa baba yenu kwa amani.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu akabora: “Yaya, tari bo; tingokora bo. Omonto oyo bweka egekombe kianyorekana koboko kwaye, nere orabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande, genda nomorembe seino ase iso.”

English: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yuda akamwendea na kumwambia: “Tafadhali bwana wangu, mruhusu mtumishi wako aseme neno kwa bwana wangu. Usimkasirikie mtumishi wako, ingawa wewe ni sawa na Farao mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda akamoika ang’e, akamoteebia: “Koranche, omonene one, ong’e inche, omosomba oo, ribaga ngoteebie ring’ana erimo. Tobaisa kombea inche, omosomba oo, naki aye nigo ore buna Farao.

English: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’
Kiswahili: Bwana wangu aliwauliza watumishi wake, ‘Mnaye baba au ndugu?’
Ekegusii: Aye omonene one, nigo gwatoboretie intwe abasomba bao: Inee! Mokare na iso gose onde omino?

English: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’
Kiswahili: Nasi tukakujibu, ‘Tunaye baba yetu ambaye ni mzee; pia yupo mwanawe mdogo aliyezaliwa katika uzee wake. Ndugu yake amekufa, na huyu mdogo ndiye mwana pekee kwa mama yake aliyebaki, naye baba yake anampenda.’
Ekegusii: Intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one: Ee, ntokare na tata, ere ogotire, nakabwate omwana omomura bw’obogotu bwaye, korende momura omwabo nakwete, oyo nere otigarete bweka ase ng’ina, na ise nigo amwanchete mono.

English: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’
Kiswahili: “Ndipo ulipowaambia watumishi wako, ‘Mleteni kwangu ili niweze kumwona kwa macho yangu mwenyewe.’
Ekegusii: Erio ogatoteebia intwe, abasomba bao: Gachie momondetere, ache aa imorore.

English: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’
Kiswahili: Nasi tukamwambia bwana wangu, ‘Kijana hawezi kumwacha baba yake; akimwacha, baba yake atakufa.’
Ekegusii: Na intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one, ng’a omosae oyo takonyara gotiga ise; aise komotiga, ise nigo arakwe.

English: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’
Kiswahili: Lakini ukawaambia watumishi wako, ‘Ndugu yenu mdogo asiposhuka pamoja nanyi, hamtauona uso wangu tena.’
Ekegusii: Naye ogatoteebia intwe abasomba bao: Momura omino omoke atatirimbogeti amo nainwe, timogocha ase obosio bwane naende.

English: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
Kiswahili: Tuliporudi nyumbani kwa mtumwa wako baba yangu, tulimwambia lile bwana wangu alilokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: “Ekero twairanete ase tata, omosomba oo, tokamoteebia amang’ana ao, omonene one.

English: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’
Kiswahili: “Ndipo baba yetu aliposema, ‘Rudini Misri mkanunue chakula kingine.’
Ekegusii: Na ekero tata atoteebetie ng’a toirane tomogorere endagera inke,

English: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’
Kiswahili: Lakini tukamwambia, ‘Hatuwezi kushuka Misri mpaka ndugu yetu mdogo awe pamoja nasi ndipo tutakapokwenda. Hatutaweza kuuona uso wa yule mtu mpaka ndugu yetu mdogo awe pamoja nasi.’
Ekegusii: tokamoiraneria: Titokonyara gotirimboka gochia ase obosio bw’omonto oria, oyominto omoke atari amo naintwe, korende onye oyominto ogotirimboka amo naintwe, rirorio natogende.

English: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
Kiswahili: “Mtumwa wako baba yangu alituambia, ‘Mnajua mke wangu alinizalia wana wawili.
Ekegusii: Erio omosomba oo tata agatoteebia: Momanyete ng’a omokungu one nigo anyiborerete abana abamura babere boka.

English: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.
Kiswahili: Mmojawapo alipotea, nami nikasema, “Hakika ameraruliwa vipande vipande.” Nami sijamwona tangu wakati huo.
Ekegusii: Oyomo nigo ansirerete, na inche ngateeba: Tekomocha koba ng’a neching’iti chi’orosana chiamoitete, tinana komoorora goika reero iga.

English: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtaniondolea huyu tena na akapatwa na madhara, mtashusha kichwa changu chenye mvi kaburini nikiwa mwenye huzuni.’
Ekegusii: Onye mokoirana oyo nere korwa ase ’nde, na amabe achie komonyoora, rirorio nigo moragere inkwe ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane, inde nomoichano.

English: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;
Kiswahili: “Hivyo sasa, kama kijana hatakuwa pamoja nasi nitakaporudi kwa mtumishi wako baba yangu, na kama baba yangu, ambaye maisha yake yamefungamanishwa na uhai wa kijana huyu,
Ekegusii: “Na bono kondagende inka ase tata, omosomba oo, ntaireti omosae oyo amo naintwe, oyo tata nigo amwanchete mono, takorora buya.

English: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.
Kiswahili: akiona kijana hayupo nasi, atakufa. Watumishi wako watashusha kichwa chenye mvi cha baba yetu kaburini kwa huzuni.
Ekegusii: Ekero ararore ng’a omosae oyo taiyo, nigo arakwe, na intwe, abasomba bao, nigo toragere agende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiaye, ore nomoichano.

English: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’
Kiswahili: Mtumwa wako alimhakikishia baba yangu usalama wa kijana. Nikamwambia, ‘Kama sikumrudisha kwako nitakuwa mwenye lawama mbele yako, baba yangu, maisha yangu yote!’
Ekegusii: Naki inche, omosomba oo, nigo nebegete nkaba intenenera ase omosae oyo ase tata, nkamoteebia: Ntamoiraneti asore, nigo ndabe omomochi asore ase obogima bwane bwonsi.

English: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi, tafadhali mruhusu mtumishi abaki hapa kama mtumwa wa bwana wangu badala ya kijana, naye kijana umruhusu arudi na ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Na bono, omonene one, nagosoroire, ntige imbe omosomba oo ribaga ri’ omosae oyo; ere omotige agende amo nabamwabo inka.

English: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”
Kiswahili: Ninawezaje kurudi kwa baba yangu kama kijana hatakuwa pamoja nami? La hasha! Usiniache nikaone huzuni ile itakayompata baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Naki ndakore ing’irane ase tata, omosae oyo atari amo nainche? Tinkoremereria korora emechando enga buna eyio ekomonyoora tata.”

English: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he called out, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
Kiswahili: Hapo Yosefu hakuweza kujizuia zaidi mbele ya wote waliokuwa wamesimama karibu naye, akapaza sauti, akasema, “Mwondoeni kila mtu mbele yangu!” Kwa hiyo hapakuwepo mtu yeyote pamoja na Yosefu alipojitambulisha kwa ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Agwo Yusufu agasinywa gotanga okweigwa kwaye, ase obosio bw’abaanto bonsi abateneine ang’e nere, agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Barusie aa bonsi ase obosio bwane!” Ase igo, monto onde tareengeo ase obosio bwa Yusufu ekero emanyekanetie ase abamwabo,

English: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.
Kiswahili: Naye akalia kwa sauti kubwa kiasi kwamba Wamisri walimsikia, hata watu wa nyumbani mwa Farao wakapata hizo habari.
Ekegusii: korende ekero aagete eriogi ase okorera, Abamisiri amo nabaanto b’enka ya Farao bakamoigwa.

English: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake, “Mimi ni Yosefu! Je, baba yangu angali hai bado?” Lakini ndugu zake hawakuweza kumjibu, kwa sababu walipatwa na hofu kuu mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia bamura bamwabo: “Ninche Yusufu. Tata moyo are?” Korende bamura bamwabo tibanyara komoiraneria, ekiagera basoetwe nobwoba obonene.

English: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. He said, “I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake, “Sogeeni karibu nami.” Waliposogea, akasema, “Mimi ni ndugu yenu Yosefu, yule ambaye mlimuuza Misri!
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agateebia bamura bamwabo: “Inchuo ase ’nde ang’e!” Barabwo bakamoika ang’e. Naende akabateebia: “Ninche Yusufu omiino, oyo mwaoonetie gocha aa Misiri.

English: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.
Kiswahili: Sasa, msihuzunike wala msijichukie wenyewe kwa kuniuza huku, kwa sababu ilikuwa ni ili kuokoa maisha ya watu ndiyo sababu Mungu alinituma niwatangulie ninyi.
Ekegusii: Korende timoichana, gose timwechanda ase emioyo yaino, ekiagera mwang’oonetie gocha aa. Naki Nyasae nere ontomete mbatang’anere gocha aa, erinde ntoorie obogima bw’abaanto.

English: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka miwili sasa imekuwepo njaa katika nchi, pia kwa miaka mitano ijayo hapatakuwepo kulima wala kuvuna.
Ekegusii: Omwaka oyo noyo o kabere enchara ere ase ense, naende netigarete emiaka etano abanto batareme gose kogesa.

English: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant on the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alinitanguliza mbele yenu ili kuhifadhi mabaki kwa ajili yenu katika nchi, na kuokoa maisha yenu kwa wokovu mkuu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo antomete mbatang’anere inwe, erinde motigare ase ense, na koba moyo ase ogotooreka kw’abange.

English: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo basi, si ninyi mlionileta huku, bali ni Mungu. Alinifanya kuwa baba kwa Farao, bwana wa watu wa nyumbani mwake wote, na mtawala wa Misri yote.
Ekegusii: Ase igo,, tari inwe mwantomete gocha aa, korende Nyasae omonyene. Nere ombegete imbe ise Farao, n’Omonene ase enka yaye yonsi, na omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.

English: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.
Kiswahili: Sasa rudini haraka kwa baba yangu na mwambieni, ‘Hili ndilo mwanao Yosefu asemalo: Mungu amenifanya mimi kuwa bwana wa Misri yote. Shuka uje kwangu, wala usikawie.
Ekegusii: “Ayerera bwango, moirane gochia ase tata, momoteebie iga: Aya naro omwana oo Yusufu agoteeba: Nyasae ombekire koba Omonene ase ense yonsi ya Misiri; tirimboka gocha ase ’nde, totebana.

English: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.
Kiswahili: Nawe utaishi katika nchi ya Gosheni na kuwa karibu nami, wewe, watoto wako na wajukuu wako, makundi yako ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe, pamoja na vyote ulivyo navyo.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo oramenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, nigo oramenye ang’e nainche, aye amo nabana bao, na abachokoro bao.

English: There I will provide for you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’
Kiswahili: Nitawatunza huko, kwa sababu bado iko miaka mingine mitano inayokuja ya njaa. La sivyo, wewe na nyumba yako na wote ulio nao mtakuwa fukara.’
Ekegusii: Agwo inche ninkoragerie, erinde tobaisa gocha gosoa ase okoremeerwa, aye amo nabaanto bao, na bionsi ebi ore nabio, ekiagera emiaka etano y’enchara netigarete.

English: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.
Kiswahili: “Mnaweza kujionea wenyewe, hata ndugu yangu Benyamini, kwamba hakika ni mimi ninayezungumza nanyi.
Ekegusii: “Na bono imorooche namaiso aino, na Benjamini boigo narooche namaiso aye, ng’a ninche omonyene ngokwana nainwe.

English: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”
Kiswahili: Mwambieni baba yangu juu ya heshima yote niliyopewa huku Misri, na kuhusu kila kitu mlichokiona. Mleteni baba yangu huku haraka.”
Ekegusii: Moteebie tata obonene bwonsi mbwate aiga Misiri, na binde bionsi mwarorire. Mokore bwango, momorente gocha aa.”

English: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akamkumbatia Benyamini ndugu yake na kulia, naye Benyamini akamkumbatia akilia.
Ekegusii: Erio akaboania Benjamini rigoti, akarera; Benjamini nere akarera kamoboanetie rigoti riaye.

English: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.
Kiswahili: Pia akawabusu ndugu zake wote, huku akilia. Baada ya hayo ndugu zake wakazungumza naye.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akanyunyunta abamwabo bonsi, akarera ase bare. Na magega y’ayio abamwabo bakagosoria nere.

English: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
Kiswahili: Habari zilipofika kwenye jumba la Farao kwamba ndugu zake Yosefu wamefika, Farao na maafisa wake wote wakafurahi.
Ekegusii: Ekero chinkuma chiaigwekanete ase enka ya Farao ng’a abamwabo Yusufu bachire, amang’ana ayio akagwenera Farao amo nabasomba baye bonsi.

English: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Waambie ndugu zako, ‘Fanyeni hivi: Pakieni wanyama wenu mrudi mpaka nchi ya Kanaani,
Ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Bateebie abamino iga: Berekia ching’iti chiaino chigurube, moimoke mogende ase ense yaino ya Kaanani,

English: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’
Kiswahili: mkamlete baba yenu na jamaa zenu kwangu. Nitawapa sehemu nzuri sana ya nchi ya Misri nanyi mtafurahia unono wa nchi.’
Ekegusii: Morente iso na abanto b’enka yaye bache ase ’nde. Inche nimbae ebire ebiya bi’ense ya Misiri, na inwe namorie obonoru bw’ense eye.

English: Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
Kiswahili: “Mnaagizwa pia kuwaambia, ‘Fanyeni hivi: Chukueni magari ya kukokotwa kutoka Misri, kwa ajili ya watoto wenu na wake zenu, mkamchukue baba yenu mje.
