Ekegusii: Naende goika obateebie iga, Ira chigari korwa aa Misiri, ase okobogoreria abana baino abake, na abakungu baino, mobogorerie na iso, moche nabarabwo.

English: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”
Kiswahili: Msijali kamwe kuhusu mali zenu, kwa sababu mema yote ya Misri yatakuwa yenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Timochandekera ebinto biaino, ebi moratige magega, ekiagera bionsi ebire ebiya mono ase ense ya Misiri nebiaino.”

English: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wana wa Israeli wakafanya hivyo. Yosefu akawapa magari ya kukokotwa, kama Farao alivyoagiza, pia akawapa mahitaji kwa ajili ya safari yao.
Ekegusii: Erio basinto ba Israeli bagakora buna bateebetigwe, na Yusufu akabaa chigari buna Farao achiigete, amo nendagera bagochia koria inchera.

English: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja mavazi mapya, lakini Benyamini akampa shekeli 300 za fedha, na jozi tano za nguo.
Ekegusii: Akaa kera oyomo eanga agochia koonchoreria, korende Benjamini ere akamoa chisekeli chi’echifeta amagana atato amo ne chianga isano, echi agochia koonchoreria.

English: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo vitu alivyotuma kwa baba yake: punda kumi waliochukua vitu vizuri vya Misri, punda wake kumi waliobeba nafaka, mikate na mahitaji mengine ya safari.
Ekegusii: Agatomera na ise chitigere ikomi chiabogoretie ebinto ebiya mono bia Misiri, ne chitigere chiaberi chiabogoretie endagera, na emegati, na endagera ende agochia koria inchera.

English: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”
Kiswahili: Akaagana na ndugu zake walipokuwa wakiondoka, akawaambia, “Msigombane njiani!”
Ekegusii: Erio agatigana nabamwabo bagende sobo, akabateebia: “Timobaisa kwomana inchera!”

English: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.
Kiswahili: Basi wakatoka Misri na kufika kwa baba yao Yakobo katika nchi ya Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakarua Misiri, bagaika ense ya Kaanani ase Yakobo ise.

English: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia baba yao, “Yosefu angali hai! Ukweli ni kwamba yeye ndiye mtawala wa Misri yote.” Yakobo akapigwa na bumbuazi; hakuwasadiki.
Ekegusii: Agwo bakamanyia ise amang’ana ng’a Yusufu moyo are, naende nere omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Yakobo agachia koyaigwa, akagoyaana ase omoyo oye, tanyara kwegena amang’ana abo.

English: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.
Kiswahili: Lakini walipokwisha kumweleza kila kitu ambacho Yosefu alikuwa amewaambia, na alipoona magari ya kukokotwa Yosefu aliyokuwa amempelekea ya kumchukua aende Misri, roho ya baba yao Yakobo ikahuishwa.
Ekegusii: Korende bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi Yusufu abateebetie. Ere agachia korora chigari chiria Yusufu amotomerete chigocha komoimokia, omoyo oye okaba nobogima oboyia.

English: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Israeli akasema, “Nimesadiki! Mwanangu Yosefu bado yu hai. Nitakwenda nikamwone kabla sijafa.”
Ekegusii: Israeli akabora: “Ayio aisanire. Yusufu, omwana one, moyo are. Nigo ndagende komoorora ritang’ani ntarakwa.”

English: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Israeli akaondoka na vyote vilivyokuwa mali yake, naye alipofika Beer-Sheba, akamtolea dhabihu Mungu wa Isaki baba yake.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Israeli akaimoka, akagenda, akaira ebinto bionsi ebi abwate, agaika Beeri‐Seba, akaruera Nyasae o Isaka ise ekeng’wanso.

English: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akanena na Israeli katika maono usiku na kusema, “Yakobo! Yakobo!” Akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae akarangeria Israeli ase okorora ekero kia botuko, akabora: “Yakobo! Yakobo!” Ere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”

English: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Mungu wa baba yako, usiogope kushuka Misri, kwa maana huko nitakufanya taifa kubwa.
Ekegusii: Erio akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Nyasae, Nyasae o iso; tobaisa kwoboa gotirimboka gochia Misiri, ekiagera ningokore obe egesaku ekenene aroro.

English: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”
Kiswahili: Nitashuka Misri pamoja nawe, nami hakika nitakurudisha tena Kanaani. Mikono ya Yosefu mwenyewe ndiyo itakayofunga macho yako.”
Ekegusii: Inche nintirimboke amo naye goika Misiri, naende tinkomocha gokoirania; na Yusufu nabe okoirania amaiso ao kogw akuure.”

English: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yakobo akaondoka Beer-Sheba nao wana wa Israeli wakamchukua baba yao Yakobo na watoto wao na wake zao katika magari ya kukokotwa yale Farao aliyokuwa amempelekea kumsafirisha.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaimoka korwa Beeri‐Seba, akagenda. Basinto ba Israeli bakabogoria Yakobo ise, amo nabana babo abake, na abakungu babo ase chigari chiria Farao abatomerete chibabogorie.

English: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,
Kiswahili: Wakachukua pia mifugo yao na mali walizokuwa wamezipata Kanaani, Yakobo na uzao wake wote wakashuka Misri.
Ekegusii: Bakaira chitugo chiabo ne chinibo chiabo echi baniberete ase ense ya Kaanani. Nabo bagaika Misiri, Yakobo na oroiboro rwaye rwonsi amo nere,

English: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.
Kiswahili: Akawachukua wanawe na binti zake, wajukuu wake wa kiume na wa kike, yaani uzao wake wote mpaka Misri.
Ekegusii: abana baye abamura na abamura babo; na abana baye abaiseke, na abaiseke b’abamura babo. Naboigo akaira oroiboro rwaye rwonsi, akagenda nabarabwo goika Misiri.

English: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Israeli (Yakobo na wazao wake), waliokwenda Misri: Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta Abaisraeli abwo bagendete Misiri: Yakobo na abana baye, nabwo aba: Rubeni, nere omotangi o Yakobo.

English: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Reubeni ni: Hanoki, Palu, Hesroni na Karmi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Rubeni nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi.

English: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Simeoni ni: Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Sohari na Shauli mwana wa mwanamke Mkanaani.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Saulo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omokaanani.

English: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Lawi ni: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.

English: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yuda ni: Eri, Onani, Shela, Peresi na Zera (lakini Eri na Onani walifariki katika nchi ya Kanaani). Wana wa Peresi ni: Hesroni na Hamuli.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Eri, na Onani, na Sela, na Peresu, na Zera; korende Eri na Onani bagakwera ase ense ya Kaanani. Na abana ba Peresu nabwo Hezironi na Hamuli.

English: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Isakari ni: Tola, Puva, Yashubu na Shimroni.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Isakaru nabwo aba: Tola, na Pua, na Yobu, na Simuroni.

English: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Zabuloni ni: Seredi, Eloni na Yaleeli.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Sabuloni nabwo aba: Seredi na Eloni, na Yaleeli.

English: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wana wa Lea aliomzalia Yakobo huko Padan-Aramu pamoja na binti yake Dina. Jumla ya wanawe na binti zake walikuwa thelathini na watatu.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana abamura Lea aiborerete Yakobo agwo Padan‐Aramu. Na omoiseke oyomo aiborete, nere Dina. Abana baye bonsi amo nabachokoro, abamura na abaiseke, nigo baareenge emerongo etato na batato.

English: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Gadi ni: Sefoni, Hagi, Shuni, Esboni, Eri, Arodi na Areli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gadi nabwo aba: Sifioni, na Hagi, na Suni, na Esiboni, na Eri, na Arodi, na Areli.

English: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Asheri ni: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi na Beria. Dada yao alikuwa Sera. Wana wa Beria ni: Heberi na Malkieli.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura b’Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi, na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo nere Sera. Na abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi na Malikieli.

English: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio watoto Zilpa aliomzalia Yakobo, ambao Labani alimpa binti yake Lea; jumla yao walikuwa kumi na sita.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro ba Silpa, oyio Labani aete Lea, omwana oye omosubati. Abwo Silpa aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na batano nomo.

English: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Raheli mke wa Yakobo ni: Yosefu na Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Raeli, moka Yakobo, nabwo Yusufu na Benjamini.

English: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
Kiswahili: Huko Misri, Asenathi binti wa Potifera, aliyekuwa kuhani wa mji wa Oni, alimzalia Yosefu wana wawili, Manase na Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akaiborerwa Manase na Efraimu, ase ense ya Misiri. Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni, akamoiborera abana abwo abamura.

English: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Benyamini ni: Bela, Bekeri, Ashbeli, Gera, Naamani, Ehi, Roshi, Mupimu, Hupimu na Ardi.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Benjamini nabwo aba: Bela, na Bekeri, na Asibeli, na Gera, na Naamani, na Eki, na Roshi, na Mupimu, na Hupimu, na Aridi.

English: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wana wa Raheli aliomzalia Yakobo; jumla yao ni kumi na wanne.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro Raeli aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na baane.

English: The son of Dan: Hushim.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Dani ni: Hushimu.
Ekegusii: Omwana omomura o Dani nere Husimu.

English: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Naftali ni: Yaseeli, Guni, Yeseri na Shilemu.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Nafutali nabwo aba: Yaseeli, na Guni, na Yaseri, na Silemu.

English: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wana wa Bilha aliomzalia Yakobo, ambaye Labani alikuwa amempa Raheli binti yake; jumla yao walikuwa saba.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro abamura Bilia aiborerete Yakobo, abanto batano na babere.

English: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.
Kiswahili: Wote waliokwenda Misri pamoja na Yakobo, waliokuwa wazao wake hasa pasipo kuhesabu wakwe zake, walikuwa watu sitini na sita.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagendete amo na Yakobo ase ense ya Misiri, abwo baiboretwe korwa asare, nigo baareenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano nomo. Abakungu b’abana abamura ba Yakobo, barabwo tibaabariri.

English: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na wana wawili waliozaliwa na Yosefu huko Misri, jumla yote ya jamaa ya Yakobo, waliokwenda Misri, walikuwa sabini.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yusufu, abaiboreretwe agwo Misiri, mbabere baarenge. Abanto bonsi ba Yakobo abasoete Misiri nigo baarenge emerongo etano na ebere.

English: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
Kiswahili: Basi Yakobo akamtanguliza Yuda aende kwa Yosefu ili amwelekeze njia ya Gosheni. Walipofika nchi ya Gosheni,
Ekegusii: Yakobo agatoma Yuda amotang’anere kogenda ase Yusufu, erinde aoroke ase obosio bwaye agwo Goseni, Naboigo bagaika ase ensemo ya Goseni.

English: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
Kiswahili: gari kubwa zuri la Yosefu liliandaliwa, naye akaenda Gosheni kumlaki baba yake Israeli. Mara Yosefu alipofika mbele yake, alimkumbatia baba yake, akalia kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akabeeka egari yaye ang’e, akayeriina, akagenda korotota Israeli aria Goseni. Ekero achia goika asare akamoboania rigoti riaye engaki etari nke.

English: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
Kiswahili: Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Sasa niko tayari kufa, kwa kuwa nimejionea mwenyewe kwamba bado uko hai.”
Ekegusii: Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Bono tiga inkwe, ekiagera nakororire obosio bwao, naende narorire ng’a moyo ore.”

English: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake na watu wa nyumbani mwa baba yake, “Nitapanda kwa Farao na kumwambia, ‘Ndugu zangu na watu wa nyumbani mwa baba yangu, waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, wamekuja kwangu.
Ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abamwabo na abanto b’enka ya ise: “Nkogenda inde ase Farao imoteebie: Abaminto na abanto b’enka ya tata, aba baarenge ase ense ya Kaanani, bachire ase ’nde.

English: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’
Kiswahili: Watu hao ni wachunga mifugo, huchunga mifugo, wamekuja na makundi ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe pamoja na kila kitu walicho nacho.’
Ekegusii: Na abanto abwo nabatugi be chitugo, na bono barentire chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio.

English: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’
Kiswahili: Farao atakapowaita na kuwaulizeni, ‘Kazi yenu ni nini?’
Ekegusii: Bono, Farao karabarangerie na kobaboria meremo ki monarete gokora,

English: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
Kiswahili: Mjibuni, ‘Watumwa wako wamekuwa wachunga mifugo tangu ujana wetu mpaka sasa, kama baba zetu walivyofanya.’ Ndipo mtakaporuhusiwa kukaa katika nchi ya Gosheni, kwa kuwa wachunga mifugo wote ni chukizo kwa Wamisri.”
Ekegusii: nigo moramoiranerie: Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abatugi be chitugo korwa obwana bwaito goika reero; buna tore igo, nabo ne chisokoro chiaito chiareenge. Na igo namonyore ribaga komenya ase ensemo ya Goseni, ekiagera kera omorisia bwe chitugo nigo are okogechia ase Abamisiri.”

English: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akaenda na kumwambia Farao, “Baba yangu na ndugu zangu wamekuja kutoka nchi ya Kanaani wakiwa na makundi yao ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe, pamoja na kila kitu walicho nacho, nao sasa wapo huko Gosheni.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagenda agateebia Farao: “Tata na bamura baminto bachire korwa ase ense ya Kaanani, amo ne chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio; barabwo nao bare ase ensemo ya Goseni.”

English: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Akachagua ndugu zake watano na kuwaonyesha kwa Farao.
Ekegusii: Agachora abamwabo batano, akabaira ase obosio bwa Farao.

English: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”
Kiswahili: Farao akawauliza hao ndugu zake, “Kazi yenu ni nini?” Wakamjibu, “Watumishi wako ni wachunga mifugo, kama vile baba zetu walivyokuwa.”
Ekegusii: Farao akababooria: “Emeremo yaino nereri?” Bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abarisia be chitugo, buna nechisokooro chiaito chiareenge.”

English: They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”
Kiswahili: Pia wakamwambia Farao, “Tumekuja kukaa huku kwa muda mfupi, kwa sababu njaa ni kali huko Kanaani, na mifugo ya watumishi wako haina malisho. Kwa hiyo sasa, tafadhali uruhusu watumishi wako wakae huko Gosheni.”
Ekegusii: Naende bakabateebia: “Nigo twachire tobe abamenyi b’ense eye, ekiagera intwe, abasomba bao, titori nase tokorisia amaicho aito, ekiagera enchara nenene mono ase ense ya Kaanani. Ase igo, koranche otoe intwe, abasomba bao, ribaga tomenye ase ensemo ya Goseni.”

English: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.
Kiswahili: Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Baba yako na ndugu zako wamekuja kwako,
Ekegusii: Erio Farao agakwana na Yusufu, akabateebia: “Narorire ng’a iso na abamino bagocheire.

English: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”
Kiswahili: nayo nchi ya Misri ipo mbele yako, uwakalishe baba yako na ndugu zako katika sehemu iliyo bora kupita zote katika nchi. Na waishi Gosheni. Kama unamfahamu yeyote miongoni mwao mwenye uwezo maalum, waweke wawe wasimamizi wa mifugo yangu.”
Ekegusii: Bono ense ya Misiri nigo ere ase obosio bwao; bae iso na bamura bamino ribaga bamenye aase are aagiya. Tiga bamenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, naende onye komanyete bande ase egati yabo abamanyete mono emeremo y’obotugi, obabeeke babe abateneneri ase chitugo chiane.”

English: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akamleta Yakobo baba yake na kumtambulisha mbele ya Farao. Baada ya Yakobo kumbariki Farao,
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akarenta Yakobo ise, akamoira ase obosio bwa Farao; na Yakobo agasesenia Farao.

English: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”
Kiswahili: Farao akamuuliza, “Je una umri gani?”
Ekegusii: Farao akabooria Yakobo: “Inee! Emiaka yao nerenga?”

English: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”
Kiswahili: Naye Yakobo akamwambia Farao, “Siku za miaka ya kusafiri kwangu ni miaka 130. Miaka yangu imekuwa michache na ya taabu, wala haikufikia miaka ya kusafiri ya baba zangu.”
Ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Emiaka yane nakoorire ase ense eye nerigana erimo, na emerongo etato (130). Ase obogima bwane nigo nabeire nobokong’u, naende emiaka yane nemeke, teikereti eye chisokoro chiane chiakorete ase obogima bwabo.”

English: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yakobo akambariki Farao, naye akaondoka mbele ya uso wake.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agasesenia Farao naende, akarua ase obosio bwaye.

English: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawakalisha baba yake na ndugu zake katika nchi ya Misri na kuwapa milki katika sehemu bora sana ya nchi, wilaya ya Ramesesi, kama Farao alivyoelekeza.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akaa ise amo na bamura bamwabo aase bakomenya, akabaa Ramesesi, orogongo oruya, ensemo engiya mono y’ense eria, buna Farao achiigete.

English: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household with bread, according to the sizes of their families.
Kiswahili: Pia Yosefu akampa baba yake, na ndugu zake na wote wa nyumbani mwa baba yake vyakula, kwa kulingana na hesabu ya watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Nere Yusufu akaba okorenda ise amo nabamwabo bonsi, akabaa endagera buna kera omonto abwate abanto baye bang’ana.

English: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, hapakuwepo chakula katika sehemu yote kwa kuwa njaa ilikuwa kali sana; Misri na Kanaani zote zikaharibiwa kwa sababu ya njaa.
Ekegusii: Bono ase ense yonsi endagera tiyareengeo; na enchara nigo yareenge endito mono, konya yanyarire abanto ba Misiri na Abakaanani.

English: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akakusanya fedha zote zilizopatikana kutoka mauzo ya nafaka huko Misri na Kanaani, akazileta kwenye jumba la kifalme la Farao.
Ekegusii: Yusufu agasangereria chitaabu chionsi echianyorekanete korwa ase ense ya Misiri na eya Kaanani ase okooneria abanto endagera, agachibeeka ase ekungo ya Farao.

English: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”
Kiswahili: Fedha za watu wa Misri na Kanaani zilipokwisha, Wamisri wote wakamjia Yosefu na kumwambia, “Tupatie chakula. Kwa nini tufe mbele ya macho yako? Fedha zetu zimekwisha.”
Ekegusii: Ekero chitaabu chionsi chiaerire ase ense ya Misiri na ase ense ya Kaanani, Abamisiri bagachiera Yusufu, bakamosaba, “Toe endagera, titobaisa gokwera ase obosio bwao, ekiagera chitaabu chiaito chiaerire.”

English: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akawaambia, “Basi leteni mifugo yenu, nitawauzia chakula kwa kubadilisha na mifugo yenu, kwa kuwa fedha zenu zimekwisha.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu akabairaneria, “Onye chitaabu chiaino chiaerire, ndetera chitugo chiaino, na inche mbae endagera morie.”

English: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakaleta mifugo yao kwa Yosefu, naye akawapa chakula kwa kubadilishana na farasi zao, kondoo na mbuzi zao, ngʼombe na punda zao. Katika mwaka huo wote Yosefu akawapa chakula kwa kubadilishana na mifugo yao yote.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarentera Yusufu chitugo chiabo, na Yusufu akabaa endagera. Bakarentera Yusufu chibarasi chiabo, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere. Igo akaba okobarenda na kobaa endagera ase omwaka oyio oyomo, na barabwo bakamoa chitugo chiabo.

English: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.
Kiswahili: Mwaka ule ulipokwisha, wakamjia mwaka uliofuata na kumwambia, “Hatuwezi kuficha ukweli mbele za bwana wetu kwamba, kwa kuwa fedha zetu zimekwisha na wanyama wetu ni mali yako, sasa hakuna chochote kilichosalia kwa ajili ya bwana wetu isipokuwa miili yetu na ardhi yetu.
Ekegusii: Omwaka oria oyomo okaera. Naende omwaka o kabere bakamochiera, bakamoteebia: “Titokonyara gokobisa, Omonene oito, ng’a chitaabu chiaito chiaerire, ne chitugo chiaito chiabeire echiao. Titotigareti gento kende togokoa, omonene oito, otatiga emebere yaito na amaremo aito.

English: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini tuangamie mbele ya macho yako, sisi pamoja na nchi yetu? Utununue sisi pamoja na ardhi yetu ili kubadilishana kwa chakula. Nasi pamoja na nchi yetu tutakuwa watumwa wa Farao. Tupe sisi mbegu ili tuweze kuishi wala tusife, nchi yetu isije ikawa ukiwa.”
Ekegusii: Nase ki torakwere ase obosio bwao, na amaremo aito asareke? Togore intwe, ogore na amaremo aito, na intwe tobe abasomba ba Farao, na amaremo aito abe ayaye. Toe chimbusuro tosimeke, titokwa, na amaremo aito abe bosa.”

English: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yosefu akamnunulia Farao nchi yote ya Misri. Wamisri, mmoja baada ya mwingine, waliuza mashamba yao, kwa sababu njaa ilikuwa kali sana kwao. Nchi ikawa mali ya Farao,
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagorera Farao amaremo onsi areenge Misiri, naki Abamisiri nigo baoonetie kera omonto oboremo bwaye, ekiagera enchara yareenge endito mono. Naboigo ense ekaba eya Farao.

English: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.
Kiswahili: naye Yosefu akawafanya watu watumike kama watumwa, kuanzia upande mmoja wa Misri hadi upande mwingine.
Ekegusii: Farao akang’anyia abanto abwo bamenye ase emechie, babe abasomba baye, bakore emeremo korwa ensemo eyemo ya Misiri goika eyende.

English: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, hakununua nchi ya makuhani, kwa sababu walikuwa wanapata mgawo wao wa kawaida kutoka kwa Farao, nao walikuwa na chakula cha kuwatosha kutokana na mgawo waliopewa na Farao. Hii ndiyo sababu hawakuuza ardhi yao.
Ekegusii: Korende Yusufu tagorete amaremo ’abakuani, ekiagera abwo konya bachikeirwe endagera baare konyora korwa ase Farao, nero baare koria. Ase igo, tibagwenerete koonia amaremo abo.

English: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akawaambia watu, “Kwa vile nimewanunua ninyi pamoja na nchi yenu leo kuwa mali ya Farao, hapa kuna mbegu kwa ajili yenu ili mweze kuziotesha.
Ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abanto: “Igwa! Reero nabagorire inwe amo namaremo aino, mobe enibo ya Farao. Bwata chimbusuro chiaino echi, chiire mochisimeke ase emegondo.

English: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati mazao yatakapokuwa tayari, mpeni Farao sehemu ya tano. Sehemu hizo nne zitakazobaki mtaziweka kama mbegu kwa ajili ya mashamba na kwa ajili ya chakula chenu wenyewe na cha watu wa nyumbani mwenu na watoto wenu.”
Ekegusii: Engaki ye rigesa moruserie Farao ensemo ya isano. Chinsemo inye chintigari inachibe echiaino ase chimbusuro na endagera yaino inwe abanyene, na ey’abare ase chinka chiaino, na ey’abana baino.”

English: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Umeokoa maisha yetu. Basi na tupate kibali mbele ya macho ya bwana wetu; tutakuwa watumwa wa Farao.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakamoiraneria, “Gwatooririe obogima bwaito. Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, Omonene oito, tiga tobe abasomba ba Farao.”

English: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.
Kiswahili: Basi Yosefu akaiweka iwe sheria kuhusu nchi ya Misri, ambayo inatumika mpaka leo, kwamba, sehemu ya tano ya mazao ni mali ya Farao. Ni nchi ya makuhani tu ambayo haikuwa ya Farao.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akabeeka ogochika ase ense ya Misiri, ng’a ensemo ya isano ebe eya Farao; na ogochika okwo ngokora kore emeremo nonya ngoika bono. Korende amaremo ’abakuani oka naro atabeete aya Farao.

English: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.
Kiswahili: Basi Waisraeli wakaishi Misri katika nchi ya Gosheni. Wakapata mali huko wakastawi na kuongezeka kwa wingi sana.
Ekegusii: Israeli na abana baye bakaba bakomenya ase ense ya Misiri, ensemo ya Goseni, bakayeira ekaba eyabo, bakamenteka na kobucha mono.

English: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akaishi Misri miaka kumi na saba, nayo miaka ya maisha yake ilikuwa 147.
Ekegusii: Yakobo akamenya ase ense ya Misiri emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere. Ase igo, agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, na etano na ebere (147) ase obogima bwaye.

English: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,
Kiswahili: Wakati ulipokaribia wa Israeli kufa, akamwita mwanawe Yosefu na kumwambia, “Kama nimepata kibali machoni pake, weka mkono wako chini ya paja langu na uniahidi kuwa utanifanyia fadhili na uaminifu. Usinizike Misri,
Ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’ogokwa gwa Israeli yabeete ang’e, ere akarangeria Yusufu, omwana oye, akamoteebia, “Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, beeka okoboko kwao inse y’ekebono kiane, na ondiere eira, ng’a nonkorere amaabera na obwanchani. Tontindeka aa ase ense ya Misiri,

English: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” Joseph said, “I will do as you have said.”
Kiswahili: lakini nitakapopumzika na baba zangu, unichukue kutoka Misri, ukanizike walipozikwa.” Yosefu akamwambia, “Nitafanya kama unavyosema.”
Ekegusii: korende ekero ndakwe, tiga ndare ne chisokoro chiane. Ombogorie korwa aa Misiri, ontindeke aase barabwo batindegetwe.” Yusufu akamoiraneria, “Ninkore buna gwantebirie.”

English: Israel said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Niapie.” Ndipo Yosefu akamwapia, naye Israeli akaabudu, akiwa ameegemea juu ya kichwa cha fimbo yake.
Ekegusii: Korende Israeli akamoteebia “Tiana ng’a nonkorere bo.” Ere agatiana. Erio Israeli agetureka ase ogotoorera omotwe borere bwaye.

English: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda Yosefu akaambiwa kwamba, “Baba yako ni mgonjwa.” Kwa hiyo akawachukua wanawe wawili Manase na Efraimu, pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Ekaba engaki magega y’ayio Yusufu ateebetigwe ng’a, “Iso nomorwaire.” Erio akaimokia abana baye babere abamura, Manase na Efraimu, bakagenda komoorora.

English: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.
Kiswahili: Yakobo alipoambiwa, “Mwanao Yosefu amekujia kukuona,” Israeli akakusanya nguvu zake, akaketi kitandani.
Ekegusii: Yakobo nere ateebetigwe ng’a “Yusufu, omwana oo, ngocha are gokorora.” Erio Israeli agekomereria, akaboka, agaikaransa borere igoro.

English: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
Kiswahili: Yakobo akamwambia Yosefu, “Mungu Mwenyezi alinitokea huko Luzu katika nchi ya Kanaani, huko akanibariki,
Ekegusii: Yakobo agateebia Yusufu: “Nyasae Omobui nang’orokerete aaria Lusu ase ense ya Kaanani, agansesenia,

English: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’
Kiswahili: naye akaniambia, ‘Nitakufanya ustawi na kuongezeka hesabu yako, nitakufanya kuwa jamii ya mataifa, nami nitakupa nchi hii uimiliki milele wewe na wazao wako baada yako.’
Ekegusii: aganteebia: Inche ninkomente, na oroiboro rwao robuche goika robe emeganda y’ebisaku. Ning’ee ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao ense eye ebe omwando obo kare na kare.

English: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi, wanao wawili waliozaliwa kwako huku Misri kabla sijaja hapa kwako watahesabiwa kuwa ni wangu; Efraimu na Manase watakuwa wangu, kama vile Reubeni na Simeoni walivyo wangu.
Ekegusii: “Bono abana bao abamura babere kwaiborerete ase ense ya Misiri ritang’ani ntaracha aa, barabwo nabaane bararokwe. Efraimu na Manase nigo barabe abaane, buna Rubeni na Simioni bare abaane.

English: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.
Kiswahili: Lakini watoto utakaowazaa baada yao watakuwa wako. Katika nchi watakayoirithi, watatambuliwa kwa jina la ndugu zao.
Ekegusii: Abana bao bande baiboire magega y’aba, barabwo nabao barabe; korende nigo baratorwe ase amarieta ’abamwabo, na komenya ase omwando obo.

English: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”
Kiswahili: Nilipokuwa ninarudi kutoka Padani, katika huzuni yangu Raheli alifariki katika nchi ya Kanaani tulipokuwa tungali tukisafiri, tukiwa karibu kufika Efrathi. Kwa hiyo nilimzika huko, kando ya njia iendayo Efrathi” (yaani Bethlehemu).
Ekegusii: Ekero nare korwa Padan‐Aramu, Raeli nyoko agankwera inchera gonkogenda Kaanani, ritang’ani ntaraika Efarati. Nkamotindeka agwo enchera ekogenda Efarati, nao Bethlehemu.”

English: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”
Kiswahili: Wakati Israeli alipowaona wana wa Yosefu, akauliza, “Hawa ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Israeli, ekero arooche abana ba Yusufu, akamobooria: “Aba mbarabi?”

English: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akamjibu baba yake, “Hawa ni wana ambao Mungu amenipa nikiwa huku.” Ndipo Israeli akasema, “Walete kwangu ili niwabariki.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu akamoiraneria: “Aba nabana baane Nyasae ang’erete aiga.” Erio Israeli akamoteebia, “Bandetere aiga ase ’nde, mbasesenie.”

English: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
Kiswahili: Basi macho ya Israeli yalikuwa hayaoni vizuri kwa sababu ya uzee, naye aliona kwa shida. Kwa hiyo Yosefu akawaleta wanawe karibu na baba yake, Israeli akawabusu na akawakumbatia.
Ekegusii: Bono amaiso a Israeli konya abeire chinchingori ase engencho y’obogotu, tare korora buya. Igo Yusufu akamorentera abana abwo, na ere akabaagata na kobaboania.

English: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”
Kiswahili: Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Kamwe sikutazamia kuuona uso wako tena, lakini sasa Mungu ameniruhusu kuwaona watoto wako pia.”
Ekegusii: Erio Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Tinasemeretie ng’a kaa ninche korora obosio bwao naende, na bono Nyasae onyancheire narorire abana bao nabarabwo,”

English: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaondoa wanawe magotini mwa Israeli naye akasujudu hadi nchi.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akarusia abana korwa ase amagoro a ise, agatugama inse.

English: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akachukua wale wana wawili, Efraimu kwenye mkono wake wa kuume akimwelekeza kwenye mkono wa kushoto wa Israeli, na Manase katika mkono wake wa kushoto akimwelekeza kwenye mkono wa kuume wa Israeli, akawaleta karibu na babu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akabwata bonsi babere, Efraimu ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, akamobeka ensemo y’okobee ya Israeli, na Manase akamobwata ase okoboko kwaye gw’okobee, akamobeka ensemo y’okorio ya Israeli.

English: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.
Kiswahili: Lakini Israeli akaupeleka mkono wake wa kuume, akauweka juu ya kichwa cha Efraimu, ingawa alikuwa ndiye mdogo, na mkono wake wa kushoto akaukatisha, akauweka juu ya kichwa cha Manase, ingawa Manase alikuwa ndiye mzaliwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Israeli akarambora okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, agakobeeka igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, nonya ere orenge omoke; agakorekania amaboko aye na kobeeka okoboko kwaye gw’okobee igoro ase omotwe o Manase, nere orenge omotangi.

English: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,
Kiswahili: Ndipo akambariki Yosefu akisema, “Mungu ambaye baba zangu Abrahamu na Isaki walimtii, Mungu ambaye amekuwa mchungaji wa maisha yangu yote mpaka leo hii,
Ekegusii: Erio agasesenia Yusufu, akabora, “Nyasae o sokoro yane Aburaamu na o Isaka tata, oyio baare gotaara ase obosio bwaye; Nyasae oyo nere ondisirie ase obogima bwane bwonsi goika reero,

English: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
Kiswahili: Malaika ambaye aliniokoa kutoka madhara yote, yeye na awabariki vijana hawa. Na waitwe kwa jina langu na kwa majina ya baba zangu Abrahamu na Isaki, wao na waongezeke kwa wingi katika dunia.”
Ekegusii: omomalaika oria ontooretie korwa ase amabe onsi, asesenie abamura aba. Abana aba babe bagwatorwa ase erieta riane, na ase erieta ria sokoro yane Aburaamu, na eria Isaka tata; tiga bakine babe abanto abange ase ense.”

English: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
Kiswahili: Yosefu alipoona baba yake akiweka mkono wa kuume juu ya kichwa cha Efraimu, hakupendezwa, kwa hiyo akauchukua mkono wa baba yake kutoka kichwa cha Efraimu na kuuweka juu ya kichwa cha Manase.
Ekegusii: Yusufu agachia korora ng’a ise obekire okoboko kwaye gw’okorio igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, ayio tayancha. Akabwata okoboko gwa ise akorusie korwa ase omotwe o Efraimu, erio akobeke ase oyo o Manase.

English: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu akamwambia, “Hapana, baba yangu, huyu ndiye mzaliwa wa kwanza; uweke mkono wako wa kuume juu ya kichwa chake.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia ise: “Taibo, tata, naki oyo nere omotangi; beeka okoboko kwao gw’okorio ase omotwe oye.”

English: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”
Kiswahili: Lakini baba yake akakataa, akasema, “Ninajua, mwanangu, ninajua. Yeye pia atakuwa taifa, naye pia atakuwa mkuu. Hata hivyo, ndugu yake mdogo atakuwa mkuu kuliko yeye, nao wazao wake watakuwa kundi la mataifa.”
Ekegusii: Korende ise akaanga, akabora: “Nimanyete, omwana one, nimanyete. Nere boigo nabe egesaku; ere boigo nabe omonene, korende oyomwabo omoke nabe omonene komobua, na oroiboro rwaye narobe egesaku kiabo ao boka.”

English: He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in your name, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Akawabarikia siku ile na kusema, “Kwa jina lenu Israeli watatamka baraka hii: ‘Mungu na awafanye kama Efraimu na Manase.’ ” Kwa hiyo akamtanguliza Efraimu mbele ya Manase.
Ekegusii: Rituko erio akabasesenia, akabora, “Ekero ogosesenigwa kogokwanwa ase Abaisraeli, abanto baatore amarieta aino na goteeba: Nyasae abakore mobe buna Efraimu na Manase.” Agwo agwo agatang’ania Efraimu ase obosio bwa Manase.

English: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Mimi ninakaribia kufa, lakini Mungu atakuwa pamoja nanyi, na atawarudisha katika nchi ya baba zenu.
Ekegusii: Erio Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Rora ng’ang’e inde gokwa. Nyasae nigo arabe amo nainwe, nabairanie gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiaino.

English: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”
Kiswahili: Kwako wewe, kama aliye juu ya ndugu zako, ninakupa sehemu moja zaidi ya ndugu zako, lile eneo nililoteka kwa Waamori kwa upanga wangu na upinde wangu.”
Ekegusii: Inche nakomentire ensemo y’ekenyoro ekeao kobua abamino. Eyio naurete Abaamori n’omoro one, na obota bwane.”

English: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yakobo akawaita wanawe na kusema: “Kusanyikeni kunizunguka ili niweze kuwaambia lile litakalowatokea siku zijazo.
Ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akarangeria abamura baye, akabateebia: “Sangererekana aa ase ’nde, mbateebie amang’ana arabanyore ase amatuko agochi‐gocha.

English: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
Kiswahili: “Kusanyikeni na msikilize, enyi wana wa Yakobo, msikilizeni baba yenu Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Inchuo montegerere, inwe abana ba Yakobo; montegerere inche Israeli iso.

English: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
Kiswahili: “Reubeni, wewe ni mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza, nguvu zangu, tunda la kwanza la nguvu zangu, umepita kwa heshima, umepita kwa uwezo.
Ekegusii: “Rubeni, aye nomwana one omotangi, aye nokobua kwane, na ogotongora gwe chinguru chiane. Noetanetie abamino ase okobua, nobaetanetie ase chinguru.

English: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.
Kiswahili: Usiyezuiwa kama maji, basi hutakuwa mkuu tena, kwa kuwa ulipanda kwenye kitanda cha baba yako, kwenye kitanda changu na kukinajisi.
Ekegusii: Aye nkwaberete buna amaache; korende togoetania abande, ekiagera nkwarinete borere bwa iso, okabosaria, ase igo okarenta obosooku.

English: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
Kiswahili: “Simeoni na Lawi ni wana ndugu: panga zao ni silaha za jeuri.
Ekegusii: “Simioni na Lawi naba ng’ina omo, ebirwanero biabo nebi’obotindi.

English: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.
Kiswahili: Mimi na nisiingie katika baraza lao, nami nisiunganike katika kusanyiko lao, kwa kuwa wamewaua watu katika hasira yao, walikata mishipa ya miguu ya mafahali kama walivyopenda.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one tosoa ase obobisi bwabo, gose enkoro yane tesanga ase omosangererekano obo; naki ase endamwamu yabo mbaitete abanto, na ase obomwenu bwabo bakanacha chinteng’e chie chintang’ana.

English: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
Kiswahili: Hasira yao na ilaaniwe, kwa kuwa ni kali mno, nayo ghadhabu yao ni ya ukatili! Nitawatawanya katika Yakobo Na kuwasambaza katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu yabo eragererigwe, ekiagera nigo yareenge entindi, na ekeririanda kiabo, ekiagera tikiareenge namaabera. Nimbaatanane ase abana ba Yakobo, nimbasiarere ase abana ba Israeli.

English: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.
Kiswahili: “Yuda, ndugu zako watakusifu; mkono wako utakuwa shingoni mwa adui zako; wana wa baba yako watakusujudia.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yuda, abamino inabagotogie; okoboko kwao inakobwate ebigoti biababisa bao; abamura ba iso ng’a batugame bosio bwao na amasikani.

English: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
Kiswahili: Ee Yuda, wewe ni mwana simba; unarudi toka mawindoni, mwanangu. Kama simba hunyemelea na kulala chini, kama simba jike: nani athubutuye kumwamsha?
Ekegusii: Yuda, aye nendo ensae. Omwana one, gokorwa gotwara, nigo oratiire, na korara, na gotimoka buna endo, buna endo eaberi, ning’o orabe noboremu kogotura?

English: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.
Kiswahili: Fimbo ya ufalme haitaondoka kwa Yuda, wala fimbo ya mtawala kati ya miguu yake, hadi aje yeye ambaye milki ni yake, ambaye utii wa mataifa ni wake.
Ekegusii: Enyimbo y’obogaambi tekorua o Yuda, gose omobeeki amachiiko ase ororeeria rwaye, goika achiche oyo orabogorie obogaambi, oyo abanto b’ebisaku bionsi baraigwere.

English: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
Kiswahili: Atamfunga punda wake katika mzabibu, naye mwana-punda wake kwenye tawi lililo bora zaidi; atafua mavazi yake katika divai, majoho yake katika damu ya mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Nigo arasibe etigere yaye ase omote bw’omosabibu, na emori y’etigere yaye ase chinsagia chi’omosabibu omuya. Nigo arasibie egetambaa kiaye akwambara nedivai, ne chianga chiaye n’amaache amonyinga y’amasabibu

English: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.
Kiswahili: Macho yake yatakuwa mekundu kwa divai, meno yake yatakuwa meupe kwa maziwa.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aye nigo arabe amabariri ase okonywa edivai, na amaino aye abe amarabu ase okonywa amabeere.

English: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
Kiswahili: “Zabuloni ataishi pwani ya bahari na kuwa bandari za kuegesha meli; mpaka wake utapanuka kuelekea Sidoni.
Ekegusii: “Sabuloni nigo aramenye ase enyancha mbarabare, agwo ase chimeeri chigotenenigwa, orobebe rwaye rosinyane norw’Abasidoni.

English: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
Kiswahili: “Isakari ni punda mwenye nguvu ambaye amelala kati ya mizigo yake.
Ekegusii: “Isakaru netigere ere ne chinguru, ekorara obweri bwe chitugo.

English: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
Kiswahili: Aonapo palivyo pazuri mahali pake pa kupumzika na jinsi nchi yake inavyopendeza, atainamisha bega lake kwenye mzigo na kujitolea kwa ajili ya kazi ngumu.
Ekegusii: Akarora ng’a aase agotimokera naagiya, na ense eria nero ekomogwenera. Ase igo, agekumba abogorie egurube, akerua kogenderera nemeremo emekong’u.

English: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Dani atahukumu watu wake kwa haki kama mmoja wa makabila ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Dani nagambere abanto baye, buna egesaku ekemo ki’Abaisraeli.

English: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.
Kiswahili: Dani atakuwa nyoka kando ya barabara, nyoka mwenye sumu kando ya njia, yule aumaye visigino vya farasi ili yule ampandaye aanguke chali.
Ekegusii: Dani nabe eng’iti ekweriba inchera, ring’ere ase oboeto, rikoroma egetingiro ki’ebarasi, goika oyoyeriinete agwe masogota.

English: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana, nautafuta wokovu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ninganyete ogotooreka kwao nogosemeria!

English: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
Kiswahili: “Gadi atashambuliwa ghafula na kundi la washambuliaji, lakini yeye atawageukia na kuwashinda kabisa.
Ekegusii: “Gadi namigwe nemeganda y’abauri, korende nere nabamige korwa magega.

English: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
Kiswahili: “Chakula cha Asheri kitakuwa kinono, naye atatoa chakula kitamu kimfaacho mfalme.
Ekegusii: “Aseri natware endagera y’obonoru, narue endagera engiya eragwenere abarwoti.

English: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
Kiswahili: “Naftali ni kulungu jike aliyeachiwa huru azaaye watoto wazuri.
Ekegusii: “Nafutali nengabi esiboire ekominyoka mono, nigo ekobiara chimanwa chingiya.

English: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
Kiswahili: “Yosefu ni mzabibu uzaao, mzabibu uzaao ulio kando ya chemchemi, ambao matawi yake hutanda ukutani.
Ekegusii: “Yusufu nomote omorere okwama ang’e nensoko; chinsagia chiaye nigo chikoranda enyasi igoro.

English: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:
Kiswahili: Kwa uchungu wapiga mshale walimshambulia, wakampiga mshale kwa ukatili.
Ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe bakomoimokera ase okomogwera n’bororo, bakomoruta emegwe na komoorosia,

English: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
Kiswahili: Lakini upinde wake ulibaki imara, mikono yake ikatiwa nguvu, na mkono wa Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo, kwa sababu ya Mchungaji, Mwamba wa Israeli,
Ekegusii: korende obota bwaye tibogosukigwa. Amaboko aye nigo are ne chinguru, naende namaango, goetera ase amaboko ’Omonyene Chinguru o Yakobo, oyore Omorisia na Egetare gia Israeli.

English: even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ya Mungu wa baba yako, anayekusaidia, kwa sababu ya Mwenyezi, yeye anayekubariki kwa baraka za mbinguni juu, baraka za kilindi kilichoko chini, baraka za matitini na za tumbo la uzazi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae o iso, nere oragokonye, Nyasae Omobui, nere oragosesenie nogosesenigwa gokorwa igoro, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa chindiba inse, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa inda na ase chimbeere.

English: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.
Kiswahili: Baraka za baba yako ni kubwa kuliko baraka za milima ya kale, nyingi kuliko vilima vya kale. Baraka hizo zote na zikae juu ya kichwa cha Yosefu, juu ya paji la yule mkuu miongoni mwa ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa gwa iso nkore ne chinguru ngoetanetie okw’ebitunwa bia kare, na obonene bw’ebigoro bia kare na kare. Ogosesenigwa okwo kobe egutwa ase omotwe o Yusufu, igoro y’egiototeri ki’oyore omogambi ase egati y’abamwabo.

English: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”
Kiswahili: “Benyamini ni mbwa mwitu mlafi mwenye njaa kuu; asubuhi hurarua mawindo yake, jioni hugawa nyara.”
Ekegusii: “Benjamini n’eseese y’orosana ekoria mono, engaki ya mambia yaria ebi’obotwari bwaye, na engaki ya mogoroba bwatanana ebiasakoire.”

English: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.
Kiswahili: Haya yote ndiyo makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli, na hivi ndivyo baba yao alivyowaambia alipowabariki, akimpa kila mmoja baraka inayomfaa.
Ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebisaku bia Israeli ikomi na bibere; naya naro ise abateebetie ekero are kobasesenia na koa kera oyomo ogosesenigwa kwaye.

English: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
Kiswahili: Ndipo alipowapa maelekezo haya: “Mimi niko karibu kukusanywa kwa watu wangu. Mnizike pamoja na baba zangu kwenye pango katika shamba la Efroni, Mhiti,
Ekegusii: Erio Israeli akabachiika, akabora: “Inche nkoirwa inde gosangererekana amo nabaanto baane. Montindeke ase chisokoro chiane chiatindegetwe ase rikuruma ri’oboremo bware bw’Efuroni Omohiti,

English: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
Kiswahili: pango lililoko katika shamba la Makpela, karibu na Mamre huko Kanaani, ambalo Abrahamu alinunua kwa ajili ya mahali pa kuzikia kutoka kwa Efroni, Mhiti, pamoja na shamba.
Ekegusii: rikuruma eri rire ase oboremo agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, ase ense ya Kaanani. Oboremo boria Aburaamu agorete korwa ase Efuroni Omohiti bobe aase ogotindeka.

English: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
Kiswahili: Huko ndiko Abrahamu na Sara mkewe walikozikwa, huko akazikwa Isaki na Rebeka mkewe, na huko nilimzika Lea.
Ekegusii: Agwo nao Aburaamu atindegetwe ase Sara mokaye ensemo; agwo nao Isaka na Rebeka mokaye batindegetwe, na agwo inche omonyene natindegete Lea.

English: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
Kiswahili: Shamba hilo na pango lililoko ndani yake lilinunuliwa kutoka kwa Wahiti.”
Ekegusii: Oboremo obwo amo ne rikuruma riria nigo biagoretwe korwa ase Abahiti.”

English: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yakobo kumaliza kutoa maelekezo hayo kwa wanawe, akarudisha miguu yake kitandani, akapumua pumzi ya mwisho, na akakusanywa kwa watu wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo akoorete gochiika abamura baye amang’ana aya, akaimokia amagoro aye, akayabeeka borere igoro; erio agakwa, erio agasangererekana amo nabaanto baye.

English: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.
Kiswahili: Basi Yosefu akamwangukia baba yake, akalilia juu yake na akambusu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagwera ise ase obosio bwaye, akarera na komonyunyunta.

English: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaagiza matabibu waliokuwa wakimhudumia, wamtie baba yake Israeli dawa ili asioze. Hivyo matabibu wakamtia dawa asioze,
Ekegusii: Agachiika abarwaria abaare komokorera, ng’a baake Israeli ise amafuta, tabaisa kogunda; naboigo abarwaria bamokorerete,

English: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.
Kiswahili: wakatumia siku arobaini, kwa maana ndio muda uliotakiwa wa kutia dawa ili asioze. Nao Wamisri wakamwombolezea Yakobo kwa siku sabini.
Ekegusii: goika amatuko emerongo ene agaikerana. Ase amatuko ang’ana buna ayio naro egetondo kiare goakwa amariogo. Abamisiri bakamoreera Israeli amatuko emerongo etano na ebere.

English: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s staff, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
Kiswahili: Siku za kumwombolezea zilipokwisha, Yosefu akawaambia washauri wa Farao, “Kama nimepata kibali machoni penu semeni na Farao kwa ajili yangu. Mwambieni,
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko okomoreera Israeli aerete, Yusufu agakwana nabaanto b’enka ya Farao, akabora: “Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase amaiso aino, komoranche monteeberie Farao

English: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”
Kiswahili: ‘Baba yangu aliniapisha na kuniambia, “Mimi niko karibu kufa; unizike katika kaburi lile nililochimba kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe katika nchi ya Kanaani.” Sasa nakuomba uniruhusu niende kumzika baba yangu, nami nitarudi.’ ”
Ekegusii: ng’a tata nandierete omwando ogoteeba: Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, ong’ire ontindeke ase oboina boria naremete ase ense ya Kaanani. Momonsabere ribaga ngende gotindeka tata, erio ning’irane.”

English: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”
Kiswahili: Farao akasema, “Panda, uende kumzika baba yako, kama alivyokuapiza kufanya.”
Ekegusii: Farao akairaneria: “Tiira ochie gotindeka iso, buna akorierete omwando.”

English: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yosefu akapanda kwenda kumzika baba yake. Maafisa wote wa Farao wakaenda pamoja naye, watu mashuhuri wa baraza lake na watu mashuhuri wote wa Misri.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agatiira gochia gotindeka ise. Abasomba bonsi ba Farao bakagenda amo nere, na abagaaka bonsi b’enka yaye, na abagaaka bonsi ba Misiri,

English: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
Kiswahili: Hawa ni mbali na watu wote wa nyumbani kwa Yosefu, na ndugu zake, na wale wote wa nyumbani mwa baba yake. Ni watoto wao, makundi yao ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe tu waliobakia katika nchi ya Gosheni.
Ekegusii: na bonsi ab’enka ya Yusufu, amo nabamwabo, na ab’enka ya ise. Abana babo boka bagatigara Goseni amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiabo.

English: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very great company.
Kiswahili: Magari makubwa na wapanda farasi pia walipanda pamoja naye. Likawa kundi kubwa sana.
Ekegusii: Naende Yusufu akaira amo nere chigari na abariini chibarasi; bakaba omoganda omonene mono.

English: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.
Kiswahili: Walipofika kwenye sakafu ya kupuria nafaka ya Atadi, karibu na Yordani, wakalia kwa sauti na kwa uchungu; Yosefu akapumzika huko kwa siku saba kumwombolezea baba yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase ekeooreri gi’Atadi ng’umbu y’orooche rwa Yorodani, bakaba bakorera ebirero ebinene mono. Agwo Yusufu akagenderera komoreera ise ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Wakanaani walioishi huko walipoona maombolezo yaliyofanyika katika sakafu ile ya kupuria ya Atadi, wakasema, “Wamisri wanafanya maombolezo makubwa.” Kwa hiyo mahali pale karibu na Yordani pakaitwa Abel-Mizraimu.
Ekegusii: Na Abakaanani abamenyete ase ense eria, ekero bachia korora ebirero agwo Atadi ase ekeooreri, bakaboora: “Ebirero ebi bi’Abamisiri nebinene mono.” Ase ayio, aase aria ng’umbu ya Yorodani akarokwa Abeli‐Misiri.

English: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,
Kiswahili: Hivyo wana wa Yakobo wakafanya kama baba yao alivyowaagiza:
Ekegusii: Naboigo basinto ba Yakobo bakorete buna ise abachiigete.

English: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.
Kiswahili: Wakamchukua mpaka nchi ya Kanaani, wakamzika kwenye pango katika shamba la Makpela, karibu na Mamre, ambalo Abrahamu alilinunua kutoka kwa Efroni, Mhiti, pamoja na shamba liwe mahali pa kuzikia.
Ekegusii: Bakamoimokia, bakamoira goika ase ense ya Kaanani. Erio bakamotindeka ase rikuruma riria riare, ase oboremo agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, oboremo boria Aburaamu agorete korwa ase Efuroni Omohiti abe aase aye agotindeka abakuure.

English: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yosefu kumzika baba yake, akarudi Misri pamoja na ndugu zake na wale wote waliokuwa wamekwenda naye kumzika baba yake.
Ekegusii: Yusufu, ekero akoorire gotindeka ise, akairana Misiri amo nabamwabo na bonsi abatiirete amo nere.

English: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”
Kiswahili: Ndugu zake Yosefu walipoona kwamba baba yao amekufa, wakasema, “Itakuwaje kama Yosefu ataweka kinyongo dhidi yetu na kutulipa mabaya yote tuliyomtendea?”
Ekegusii: Ekero abamwabo Yusufu barooche ng’a ise okuure bagateebania. “Aande Yusufu nigo aratorege, arusie egesiomba ase amabe aria twamokorerete.”

English: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakampelekea Yosefu ujumbe, wakasema, “Kabla baba yako hajafa aliacha maagizo haya:
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bagatoma abanto ase Yusufu komoteebia ng’a: “Iso nigo ateebete iga ritang’ani atarakwa.

English: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
Kiswahili: ‘Hili ndilo mtakalomwambia Yosefu: Ninakuomba uwasamehe ndugu zako dhambi na mabaya kwa vile walivyokutenda vibaya.’ Sasa tafadhali samehe dhambi za watumishi wa Mungu wa baba yako.” Ujumbe huu ulipomfikia, Yosefu akalia.
Ekegusii: Moteebie Yusufu iga: Nagosabire obaabere abamino amamocho abo na ebibe biabo bagokorerete. Nimanyete ng’a mbagokorerete bobe. Ase igo, bono twagosabire, otwabere ebibe biaito, naki intwe nabasomba ba Nyasae o iso.” Yusufu akarera ekero abamwabo bamoboretie amang’ana ayio.

English: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo ndugu zake wakaja na kujitupa chini mbele yake. Wakasema, “Sisi ni watumwa wako.”
Ekegusii: Erio abamwabo bagacha, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye, bakaboora: “Intwe iga nabasomba bao tore.”

English: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
Kiswahili: Lakini Yosefu akawaambia, “Msiogope. Je, mimi ni badala ya Mungu?
Ekegusii: Korende Yusufu akabateebia: “Timoiroka! Inee! Inche inde ribaga ria Nyasae?

English: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.
Kiswahili: Mlikusudia kunidhuru, lakini Mungu alikusudia mema, ili litimie hili linalofanyika sasa, kuokoa maisha ya watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, inwe nabo mwarengereretie gonkorera amabe, korende Nyasae akayaonchora akaba amaya, na buna mwarorire reero iga, otooririe obogima bw’abaanto abange.

English: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, msiogope. Mimi nitawatunza ninyi nyote pamoja na watoto wenu.” Akawahakikishia na kusema nao kwa wema.
Ekegusii: Gaki, bono timoiroka! Nimbaragerie inwe amo nabana baino.” Naboigo akaba okobaremia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amaya.

English: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
Kiswahili: Yosefu akakaa katika nchi ya Misri, yeye pamoja na jamaa yote ya baba yake. Akaishi miaka 110,
Ekegusii: Yusufu akamenya Misiri, ere amo nabaanto bamwabo, agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi (110).

English: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.
Kiswahili: naye akaona kizazi cha tatu cha watoto wa Efraimu. Pia akaona watoto wa Makiri mwana wa Manase, wakawekwa magotini mwa Yosefu walipozaliwa.
Ekegusii: Agwo akarora abana b’Efraimu na abachokoro baye goika ekiaare kia gatato, akarora na abana ba Makiri, omwana o Manase, baiboreretwe ase Yusufu.

English: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake, “Mimi ninakaribia kufa. Lakini kwa hakika Mungu atawasaidia na kuwachukueni kutoka nchi hii na kuwapeleka katika nchi aliyomwahidi kwa kiapo Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abamwabo: “Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, korende amaene Nyasae nabanyorere enchera y’okobarusia ase ense eye, abatiirie mogende ase ense eria abarierete eira na gotiana, ng’a nae Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo.”

English: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”
Kiswahili: Naye Yosefu akawaapisha wana wa Israeli na kuwaambia, “Hakika Mungu atawasaidia, nanyi ni lazima mhakikishe mmepandisha mifupa yangu kutoka mahali hapa.”
Ekegusii: Yusufu agatiania abana ba Israeli agwo, akabora: “Bono, ekero Nyasae arabachere abakoonye, goika moire amauga aane; mogende naro.”

English: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yosefu akafa akiwa na umri wa miaka 110. Baada ya kumtia dawa ili asioze, akawekwa kwenye jeneza huko Misri.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu erio agakwa ore n’emiaka rigana erimo na ikomi (110). Bakamoaka amafuta, tabaisa kogunda, bakamobeeka ase esanduki ime aaria Misiri.

English: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Israeli ambao walikwenda Misri na Yakobo, kila mmoja akiwa pamoja na jamaa yake:
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’abamura ba Israeli abasoete Misiri amo na Yakobo ise, kera oyomo amo nabaanto b’enyomba yaye:

English: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
Kiswahili: Reubeni, Simeoni, Lawi na Yuda;
Ekegusii: Rubeni, Simioni, Lawi na Yuda;

English: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
Kiswahili: Isakari, Zabuloni na Benyamini;
Ekegusii: Isakaru na Sabuloni, na Benjamini;

English: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
Kiswahili: Dani na Naftali, Gadi na Asheri.
Ekegusii: Dani na Nafutali, Gadi na Aseri.

English: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.
Kiswahili: Wazao wote wa Yakobo walikuwa watu sabini; Yosefu alikuwa tayari yuko Misri.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abaiboire korwa ase Yakobo nigo barenge emerongo etano na ebere. Yusufu momura o Yakobo ere konya nao amenyete Misiri korwa kare.

English: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.
Kiswahili: Basi Yosefu na kaka zake wote na kizazi kile chote walikufa,
Ekegusii: Korende Yusufu, na bamura bamwabo bonsi, na abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria bagakwera Misiri.

English: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
Kiswahili: lakini Waisraeli walikuwa wamezaana na kuongezeka sana, idadi yao ikawa kubwa mno, kwa hiyo wakaijaza nchi.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaba abegenwa ase Nyasae erio bagasarara na komenteka, bagatwara chinguru chinene, bakaba abange na obonge bwabo bokabucha kegima ase ense eria.

English: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme mpya ambaye hakufahamu habari za Yosefu akatawala Misri.
Ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti omoyia, oyotamomanyete Yusufu, akaira obogambi bw’ense ya Misiri.

English: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia watu wake, “Tazameni, Waisraeli wamekuwa wengi mno kwa idadi kutuliko sisi.
Ekegusii: Ere agateebia abanto baye, “Rigereria, Abaisraeli aba babeire abange gotobua, naende babeire ne chinguru gotobua,

English: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”
Kiswahili: Njooni, ni lazima tuwashughulikie kwa uangalifu, la sivyo watazidi kuwa wengi zaidi, na ikiwa patatokea vita, watajiunga na adui zetu kupigana dhidi yetu na kuondoka katika nchi hii.”
Ekegusii: goika torigie chisemi tobatenenie, tibagenderera komenteka, ekiagera toise gochaka esegi, barabwo nigo barabwatane nababisa baito batorwanie, erio bang’anye korwa ense yaito.”

English: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses.
Kiswahili: Basi Wamisri wakaweka wasimamizi wa kuwasimamia na kuwatesa Waisraeli kwa kazi ngumu, nao wakajenga miji ya Pithomu na Ramesesi ya kuweka akiba ya Farao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abamisiri bakabeeka abateneneri abatindi igoro ase Abaisraeli barenge erio baabachande nemeremo emekong’u mono yobosomba. Agwo Abaisraeli bakaagachera Farao emechie y’okogaacha chinibo, nero Pitoni na Ramesesi.

English: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini walivyozidi kuteswa ndivyo walivyozidi kuongezeka na kuenea katika nchi; Wamisri wakawaogopa Waisraeli,
Ekegusii: Korende buna Abamisiri bagendererete kobachanda mono, naboigo Abaisraeli bagendererete komenteka na gwesiarera, goika Abamisiri bakabairoka mono.

English: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve,
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo wakawatumikisha kwa ukatili.
Ekegusii: Erio Abamisiri bakaba abatindi ase Abaisraeli na kobabetereria gokora emeremo emekong’u

English: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.
Kiswahili: Wakafanya maisha ya Waisraeli kuwa machungu kwa kufanya kazi ngumu ya kutengeneza lami na kufyatua matofali, na kazi zote za mashambani; katika kazi zao zote ngumu, Wamisri waliwatumia Waisraeli kwa ukatili.
Ekegusii: bagakora obogima bwabo bokaba obokong’u ase okobakoria emeremo y’ogotiringa esike na koroisia amatabori, na emeremo ende ao ao ase emegondo. Ase emeremo ende yonsi Abaisraeli baare gokora nigo baare gokorigwa ase obotindi.

English: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Misri akawaambia wakunga wa Kimisri waliowazalisha wanawake wa Kiebrania, ambao majina yao ni Shifra na Pua,
Ekegusii: Omorwoti o Misiri agachiika Sifura na Pua, abaiboria b’Abaiberania, akabateebia,

English: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”
Kiswahili: “Mtakapowazalisha wanawake wa Kiebrania, chunguzeni wanapojifungua. Ikiwa ni mtoto wa kiume, muueni, lakini ikiwa ni msichana, mwacheni aishi.”
Ekegusii: “Ekero mokorigereria abakungu b’Abaiberania kobakoibora, morigererie mwana ki oiborwa; onye nomoisia, momoite, korende karabe omoiseke, momotige abe moyo.”

English: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.
Kiswahili: Lakini hao wakunga walimcha Mungu na hawakufanya kile mfalme wa Misri alichowaambia kufanya, bali wakawaacha watoto wa kiume waishi.
Ekegusii: Korende abaiboria baria nigo bamoirogete Nyasae, tibakorete buna omorwoti o Misiri abateebeetie, korende barabwo bagatiga abana abamura bakaba moyo.

English: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme wa Misri akawaita hao wakunga, akawauliza, “Kwa nini mmefanya hivi? Mbona mmeacha watoto wa kiume waishi?”
Ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti o Misiri akarangeria abaiboria baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwakorire iga Mwatigire abana abaisia bakoiborwa bare moyo.”?

English: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”
Kiswahili: Wakunga wakamjibu Farao, “Wanawake wa Kiebrania ni tofauti na wanawake wa Kimisri; wao wana nguvu, nao hujifungua watoto kabla wakunga hawajafika.”
Ekegusii: Abaiboria baria bakairaneria Farao, “Abakungu b’Abaiberania tibari buna aba Abamisiri; barabwo nabaango ase okoibora, nigo bakoibora ritang’ani omoiboria ataraika.”

English: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akawatendea mema wakunga hao. Waisraeli wakaongezeka na kuendelea kuwa wengi zaidi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae agakorera abaiboria baria amaya, na Abaisraeli bakagenderera komenteka na koba ne chinguru mono.

English: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.
Kiswahili: Kwa vile hao wakunga walimcha Mungu, Mungu akawajalia kuwa na jamaa zao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Na ekiagera abakungu baria abaiboria bamoirogete Nyasae, ere akabasesenia, na barabwo bakenyorera chinyomba chiabo.

English: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Farao akatoa agizo hili kwa watu wake wote: “Kila mtoto wa kiume atakayezaliwa kwa Waebrania lazima atupwe katika Mto Naili, bali kila mtoto wa kike aachwe aishi.”
Ekegusii: Erio Farao agachiika abanto baye bonsi, akabateebia, “Kera omwana omoisia oraiborwe ase Abaiberania, momotugute ase orooche rwa Naeli, korende kera omwana omoiseke momotige abe moyo.”

English: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.
Kiswahili: Basi mtu mmoja wa nyumba ya Lawi akaoa mwanamke Mlawi,
Ekegusii: Narengeo Omonto oyomo bw’egekasu kia Lawi akamonyuoma omoiseke korwa egesaku kia Lawi.

English: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.
Kiswahili: naye mwanamke huyo akapata mimba, akazaa mtoto wa kiume. Alipoona mtoto huyo ni mzuri, akamficha kwa miezi mitatu.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oyio akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, na ekero aroche ng’a omwana oria nomuya mono, akamobisa ase engaki y’emetienyi etato.

English: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.
Kiswahili: Lakini alipoona hawezi kumficha zaidi, akamtengenezea kisafina cha mafunjo, akakipaka lami. Kisha akamweka huyo mtoto ndani yake, akakificha katikati ya matete kando ya ukingo wa Mto Naili.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero aroche ng’a takonyara komobisa goetania agwo, akaimokia ekebaari ki’amauncho, agakeooma esike, erio agaaka eramu korwa isiko. Erio akaareria omwana oria ase ekebaari ime, agakebeeka ase amauncho ime y’orooche rwa Naeli.

English: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.
Kiswahili: Dada ya huyo mtoto akasimama mbali ili kuona kitakachompata mtoto.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke omwabo omwana oria agatenena aare ake amanye egekonyora omwana.

English: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.
Kiswahili: Ndipo binti Farao akateremka mtoni Naili kuoga, nao wahudumu wake wakawa wanatembea ukingoni mwa mto. Binti mfalme akaona kisafina katikati ya manyasi, akamtuma mmoja wa watumwa wake wa kike kukichukua.
Ekegusii: Erio omoiseke o Farao agatirimboka gochia Naeli rooche gwesibia, na abasomba baye abaiseke bakaba bakona goonchokanana ase engegu. Ekero aroche ekebaari keria ase amauncho, agatoma omoiseke oyomo akerente;

English: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”
Kiswahili: Alifungua kisafina akaona mtoto ndani yake. Mtoto alikuwa akilia, akamhurumia. Akasema, “Huyu ni mmoja wa watoto wa Kiebrania.”
Ekegusii: agakemumora, akanyora omwana omoke ore imeo. Omwana oria akarera, na omoiseke o Farao akamororera amabeebe, agakwana, “Oyoiga noyomo bw’abana b’Abaiberania.”

English: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo dada wa huyo mtoto akamuuliza binti Farao, “Je, niende nikakutafutie mmoja wa wanawake wa Kiebrania akulelee huyu mtoto?”
Ekegusii: Agwo agwo Omoiseke omwabo omwana oria akaoroka akaboria omoiseke o Farao, “Inee! Norigetie ngende nkorangererie omokungu okogonkia oyomo bw’Abaiberania ache gokomogonkeria?”

English: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.
Kiswahili: Binti Farao akamjibu, “Ndiyo, nenda.” Yule msichana akaenda akamleta mama wa mtoto.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke o Farao akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda!” Erio akagenda, akarangeria ng’ina omwana oria.

English: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed him.
Kiswahili: Binti Farao akamwambia, “Mchukue huyu mtoto unisaidie kumlea, nami nitakulipa.” Basi yule mwanamke akamchukua mtoto na kumlea.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke o Farao agateebia omokungu oria, “Moire omwana oyo, omongonkerie, na inche ninkoe eng’eria yao.” Erio omokungu oria akaira omwana, akamorera.

English: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”
Kiswahili: Mtoto alipokua, akampeleka kwa binti Farao, naye akawa mwanawe. Akamwita jina lake Mose akisema, “Nilimtoa kwenye maji.”
Ekegusii: Ekero omwana oria akinire, omokungu oria akamoirania ase omoiseke o Farao koba omwana oye na ere akamoroka Musa, ogoteeba, “Ndooche namorusetie.”

English: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.
