Kiswahili: Siku moja, baada ya Mose kukua, akaondoka kwenda walikokuwa watu wake, na akachunguza jinsi walivyokuwa wakifanya kazi ngumu. Akamwona Mmisri akimpiga Mwebrania, mmojawapo wa watu wake.
Ekegusii: Egachia koba ekero Musa abeire omonto omonene, rituko erimo akagenda gokwania Abaiberania bamwabo, akarora buna baare gokorigwa emeremo yobosomba emekong’u. Agwo akarora Omomisiri ogoita oyomo bw’Abaiberania bamwabo.

English: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
Kiswahili: Mose akatazama huku na huko asione mtu yeyote, akamuua yule Mmisri, akamficha mchangani.
Ekegusii: Erio akamaga‐maga chinsemo chionsi, na ekero arora ng’a monto onde tari aande, agaita Omomisiri oria agakwa, erio akabisa omobere oye ase omokenye ime.

English: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”
Kiswahili: Kesho yake akatoka, akaona Waebrania wawili wakipigana. Akamuuliza yule aliyekosa, “Mbona unampiga Mwebrania mwenzako?”
Ekegusii: Naende akagenda rituko ria kabere, akarora Abaiberania babere abasacha bakorwana; akamobooria oria ochegetie oyomwabo, “Nase ki ogoaka oyomino?”

English: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akamjibu, “Ni nani aliyekufanya mtawala na mwamuzi juu yetu? Je, unataka kuniua kama ulivyomuua yule Mmisri?” Ndipo Mose akaogopa na kuwaza, “Jambo lile nililofanya lazima limefahamika.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Ning’o okobegete koba omoteneneri na omogayani igoro yaito? Inee! Nigo origetie kong’ita buna gwaita Omomisiri oria?” Aya akagera Musa akoboa. Ere agateeba ase omoyo oye ime, “Ndoche ng’a eng’ana eye yamanyekanire!”

English: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.
Kiswahili: Farao aliposikia jambo hili, alijaribu kumuua Mose, lakini Mose akamkimbia Farao na kwenda kuishi katika nchi ya Midiani, akaketi kando ya kisima.
Ekegusii: Ekero Farao achia koigwa amang’ana ayio akarigia goita Musa, korende Musa agatama korwa o Farao akagenda komenya ase ense y’Abamidiani.

English: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
Kiswahili: Kuhani wa Midiani alikuwa na binti saba, nao wakaja kisimani ili kuchota maji na kujaza hori kwa ajili ya kunyweshea mifugo ya baba yao.
Ekegusii: Narengeo Omokuani o Midiani ore korokwa Jethiro obwate abaiseke batano na babere. Barabwo bagacha kobuucha amaache; bagaichoria chintuba amaache banyoisie riicho ria ise.

English: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wachungaji wakaja wakawafukuza hao wasichana. Ndipo Mose akainuka, akawasaidia na kunywesha mifugo yao.
Ekegusii: Erio abarisia b’aroro bagacha bagaseria abaiseke baria ba Jethiro, korende Musa agatenena agakonya abaiseke baria na kobanyoiseria riicho riabo.

English: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”
Kiswahili: Hao wasichana waliporudi nyumbani kwa Reueli baba yao, akawauliza, “Imekuwaje leo mmerudi mapema hivyo?”
Ekegusii: Ekero abaiseke baria bairanete ase ise, ere akababoria, “Nakimwakora reero mwairana bwango iga?”

English: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Mmisri mmoja alituokoa kutoka mikononi mwa wachungaji. Pia mtu huyo alituchotea maji na kunywesha mifugo.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Omomisiri oyomo otokonya korwa ase abarisia baria; amo nayio otobuuchera amaache na gotonyoiseria riicho riaito.”

English: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza binti zake, “Yuko wapi? Mbona mmemwacha? Mkaribisheni ale chakula.”
Ekegusii: Erio ise akababoria abaiseke baye, “Ng’ai are? Naki mwakora mwatiga omonto oyio? Gachie momorangerie ache koragera.”

English: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.
Kiswahili: Mose akakubali kukaa kwa huyo mtu, ambaye alimpa Mose binti yake aliyeitwa Sipora amwoe.
Ekegusii: Musa agancha komenya bw’omonto oria na omonto oria akaa Musa Sipora, omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.

English: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”
Kiswahili: Sipora alizaa mtoto wa kiume, naye Mose akamwita Gershomu, akisema, “Nimekuwa mgeni katika nchi ya kigeni.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oyio akamoiborera omwana omoisia, na Musa akamoroka Gerisomu, ogoteeba, “Nabeire omomenyi ase ense engeni.”

English: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda mrefu, mfalme wa Misri akafa. Waisraeli wakalia kwa huzuni katika utumwa wao, walilia na kilio chao cha kutaka msaada kwa ajili ya utumwa kikamfikia Mungu.
Ekegusii: Magega y’engaki entambe koyaetire omorwoti o Misiri agakwa. Abaisraeli bakaba bakweumia inse y’obosomba obwo, bakarera bakonywe, na ekerero kiabo korwa ase obosomba kegaika igoro, ase Nyasae obo.

English: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
Kiswahili: Mungu akasikia kilio chao cha huzuni, akakumbuka Agano alilofanya na Abrahamu pamoja na Isaki na Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa ekerero kiabo, na akainyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, okwo akorete na Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo;

English: God saw the children of Israel, and God understood.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akawaangalia Waisraeli na kuwahurumia.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akarigereria ogochandeka kw’Abaisraeli ase obosomba erio akabainyora.

English: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.
Kiswahili: Basi Mose alikuwa anachunga mifugo ya Yethro mkwewe, kuhani wa Midiani. Mose akapeleka mifugo mbali nyuma ya jangwa, naye akafika Horebu, mlima wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Musa nigo arenge omorisia bwe riicho, rituko erimo gakorisia riicho ria Jethiro oyio orenge ise biara na Omokuani o Midiani, akariraa gochia bosongo y’erooro, agaika magega ya Horebu, egetunwa egechenu.

English: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
Kiswahili: Huko malaika wa Bwana akamtokea Mose katika mwali wa moto kutoka kichakani. Mose akaona kwamba ingawa kile kichaka kilikuwa kinawaka moto, kilikuwa hakiteketei.
Ekegusii: Agwo omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera ase omogwekano bw’erisase ri’omorero riare gwoka korwa ase obogatagati bw’egetutu gete. Musa akarigereria, akarora ng’a nonya kiare gwoka, tikiare koyia keere.

English: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akawaza, “Nitageuka sasa nione kitu hiki cha ajabu, nami nione ni kwa nini kichaka hiki hakiteketei.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateeba, “Nigo ’ngoeta korwa moino ’ndore okorora oko kw’ogokumia, imanye naki egetutu eke getari koyia keere.”

English: When Yahweh saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”
Kiswahili: Bwana alipoona kuwa amegeuka ili aone, Mungu akamwita kutoka ndani ya kile kichaka, “Mose! Mose!” Naye Mose akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arooche ng’a Musa oikire ang’e arore, akamorangeria korwa ase egetutu ime, “Musa! Musa!” Musa agaitaba ogoteeba, “Nao inde aa.”

English: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Usikaribie zaidi. Vua viatu vyako, kwa maana mahali unaposimama ni patakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoteebia, “Tobaisa goika ang’e nonya ng’ake. Rusia ebikoroto biao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine naachenu.”

English: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia, “Mimi ni Mungu wa baba yako, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo.” Mose aliposikia hayo, akafunika uso wake kwa sababu aliogopa kumtazama Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naende akamoteebia, “Inche ninche Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiao, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo.” Erio Musa agatuba obosio bwaye, ekiagera nigo airogete komorigereria Nyasae.

English: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia, “Hakika nimeona mateso ya watu wangu katika Misri. Nimesikia kilio chao kwa sababu ya wasimamizi wao, nami naguswa na mateso yao.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akabora, “Amaene narorire emechando yabaanto baane abwo bakare Misiri; naigure buna bakweumia inse yamaboko y’Abamisiri abwo bakobachanda, na inche namanyire kegima obororo bwabo.

English: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Basi nimeshuka niwaokoe kutoka mkono wa Wamisri, niwatoe na kuwapandisha kutoka nchi hiyo, niwapeleke katika nchi nzuri na kubwa, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, nchi ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.
Ekegusii: Nainche nigo naikire inse mbatoorie korwa ase amaboko ya Abamisiri, mbatiirie korwa ase ense eria ya Misiri, mbaire ase ense engiya engare, ense eichire namabeere nobooke, ense ya Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi bono genda.

English: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
Kiswahili: Sasa kilio cha Waisraeli kimenifikia, nami nimeona jinsi Wamisri wanavyowatesa.
Ekegusii: Nainde bono ekerero ki’Abaisraeli giaikire ase ’nde, naende narorire ogochandwa koria Abamisiri bakobachanda,

English: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Basi, sasa nenda. Ninakutuma kwa Farao ili kuwatoa watu wangu Waisraeli kutoka Misri.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ’ngogotoma inde ogende ase Farao orusie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa ense ya Misiri.”

English: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akamwambia Mungu, “Mimi ni nani hata niende kwa Farao kuwatoa Waisraeli nchini Misri?”
Ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoteebia Nyasae, “Inche ninche ng’o, kogenda ase Farao ’ndusie Abaisraeli korwa ense ya Misiri?”

English: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”
Kiswahili: Naye Mungu akasema, “Mimi nitakuwa pamoja nawe. Hii itakuwa ishara kwako kwamba ni Mimi nimekutuma: Hapo utakapokuwa umewatoa watu Misri, mtamwabudu Mungu katika mlima huu.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Inche nimbe amo naye. Aye noruisie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri erio moche monsasime inche Nyasae ase egetunwa eke, na eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asore ng’a ninche omonyene nagotoma.”

English: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Mungu, “Ikiwa nitawaendea Waisraeli na kuwaambia, ‘Mungu wa baba zenu amenituma kwenu,’ nao wakiniuliza, ‘Jina lake ni nani?’ Nitawaambia nini?”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Nyasae, “Kondaimoke kogenda ase Abaisraeli na kobateebia: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino ontomire inche ase more, barabwo baramboria: Erieta riaye, nere ng’o? Inki ndabateebie?”

English: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
Kiswahili: Mungu akamwambia Mose, “Mimi niko ambaye niko. Hivyo ndivyo utakavyowaambia Waisraeli: ‘Mimi niko amenituma kwenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria Musa, “INCHE NINCHE INDE BUNA INDE. Obateebie Abaisraeli buna oria okorokwa: INCHE ontomire ase more.”

English: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.
Kiswahili: Vilevile Mungu akamwambia Mose, “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo amenituma kwenu.’ Hili ndilo Jina langu milele, Jina ambalo mtanikumbuka kwalo kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi.
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamoteebia Musa, “Goika obateebie Abaisraeli: Omonene bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka, na boigo Nyasae o Yakobo ontomire ase more; erio nario erieta riane kare na kare; ase erio nigo ’ndabe ekeinyorio ekiare ase ekiare.

English: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.
Kiswahili: “Nenda, ukawakusanye wazee wa Israeli, uwaambie, ‘Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, alinitokea akaniambia: Nimewatazama, nami nimeona mliyofanyiwa katika Misri.
Ekegusii: Genda, osangererie abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a: Omonene bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nang’orokera, aganteebia ng’a mbateebie: Amaene, narorire aya Abamisiri bakobakorera,

English: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’
Kiswahili: Nami nimeahidi kuwapandisha kutoka mateso yenu katika nchi ya Misri, niwapeleke nchi ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali.’
Ekegusii: na igo narire eira ng’a nimbang’anyie korwa Misiri ase mogochandwa, na kobaira ase ense y’Abakaanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, ense entenenku egoiteka amabeere na obooke.

English: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh, our God.’
Kiswahili: “Wazee wa Israeli watakusikiliza. Kisha wewe na wazee mtakwenda kwa mfalme wa Misri na kumwambia, ‘Bwana, Mungu wa Waebrania ametutokea. Turuhusu twende safari ya siku tatu huko jangwani kutoa dhabihu kwa Bwana Mungu wetu.’
Ekegusii: “Na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli inabaigwe amang’ana ao. Erio mogende, aye na abagaaka ba Abaisraeli, ase omorwoti o Misiri, momoteebie: Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, natoorokera; na bono twanchere togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erio toruere Omonene oito, ekeng’wanso.

English: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.
Kiswahili: Lakini nafahamu kwamba mfalme wa Misri hatawaruhusu kwenda, mpaka mkono wenye nguvu umlazimishe.
Ekegusii: Korende inche omonyene nimanyete ng’a omorwoti o Misiri takobaa ribaga mogende atabeetereirie nokoboko kwane gwe chinguru.

English: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitaunyoosha mkono wangu na kuwapiga Wamisri kwa maajabu yote nitakayofanya miongoni mwao. Baada ya hayo, atawaruhusu mwondoke.
Ekegusii: Erio inche nindambore okoboko kwane, ng’ake Abamisiri namaakwa aane yogokumia. Erio magega Omorwoti nabae ribaga mogende.

English: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.
Kiswahili: “Nami nitawapa hawa watu upendeleo mbele ya Wamisri, kwa hiyo mtakapoondoka nchini hamtaondoka mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: “Nimbae abanto baane ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Abamisiri; ekero moragende, timokogenda more namaboko amasa.

English: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”
Kiswahili: Kila mwanamke Mwisraeli atamwomba jirani yake Mmisri na mwanamke yeyote anayeishi nyumbani kwake ampe vyombo vya fedha, dhahabu na nguo, ambavyo mtawavika wana wenu na binti zenu. Hivyo mtawateka nyara Wamisri.”
Ekegusii: Kera omokungu asabe omogisangio oye, na omokungu onde bwensi omenyete nyomba mwaye, ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitaabu amo ne chianga; mobibekere abana baino, abamura na abaiseke. Ase enchera eyio nero morasakore Abamisiri chinibo chiabo.”

English: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘Yahweh has not appeared to you.’”
Kiswahili: Mose akamjibu, “Itakuwaje kama hawataniamini au kunisikiliza, waseme, ‘Bwana hakukutokea’?”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akamoiraneria Nyasae akamoteebia, “Eraba rende ng’a agwo tibanyegeti, gose koigwa eriogi riaane, barabwo nigo baratebe: Omonene takoorokereti.”

English: Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, “Ni nini hicho kilicho mkononi mwako?” Akajibu, “Fimbo.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamobooria, “Inki ekio obwate koboko kwao?” Musa akairaneria, “Nenyimbo.”

English: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Itupe chini.” Mose akaitupa chini hiyo fimbo nayo ikawa nyoka, naye akaikimbia.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Yerute inse!” Na ekero Musa ayeruta inse, ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti, na Musa agatama korwa asere.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Nyoosha mkono wako umkamate mkiani.” Basi Mose akanyoosha mkono akamkamata yule nyoka, naye akabadilika tena kuwa fimbo mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoteebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao, oyebwate ekemincha.” Erio ere akarambora okoboko kwaye, akayebwata, na ase okoboko kwaye ekaonchoka, ekaba enyimbo naende.

English: “This is so that they may believe that Yahweh, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Hivi ndivyo Waisraeli watakavyoamini kuwa Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo, amekutokea wewe.”
Ekegusii: Na Omonene akamoteebia, “Okore igo, na barabwo inabegene ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nakoorokera.”

English: Yahweh said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Weka mkono wako ndani ya joho lako.” Basi Mose akaweka mkono wake ndani ya joho lake, naye alipoutoa, ulikuwa na ukoma, mweupe kama theluji.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamoteebia, “Soyia okoboko kwao eanga yao ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora boigo; na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire okorabu se ase buna okwo omorwaire bwa ukoma.

English: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Sasa urudishe tena huo mkono ndani ya joho lako.” Basi Mose akaurudisha mkono wake ndani ya joho lake na alipoutoa, ulikuwa mzima, kama sehemu zingine za mwili wake.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamoteebia, “Irania okoboko kwao eanga ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora bo, na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire buya, buna koreng’ana omobere oye onde ore.

English: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, “Kama hawatakuamini wewe, au kutojali ishara ya kwanza, wataamini ishara ya pili.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Onye tibakwegena amang’ana ao, gose tibagwancha ase egekone kie ritang’ani, rirorio mbanche ase egia kabere.

English: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hawataamini ishara hizi mbili au hawatawasikiliza ninyi, chukua kiasi cha maji kutoka Mto Naili uyamimine juu ya ardhi kavu. Maji mtakayotoa mtoni yatakuwa damu juu ya ardhi.”
Ekegusii: Onye tibakwegena nonya nase ebikone ebio bibere, gose gwancha amang’ana ao, rirorio obuuche amaache make korwa ase orooche rwa Naeli, oyaitere ase ense enyomo; amaache ayio orabuuche korwa ase orooche naonchoke abe amanyinga ase ense enyomo.”

English: Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Ee Bwana, kamwe sijapata kuwa msemaji kwa ufasaha wakati uliopita wala tangu ulipoanza kuzungumza na mtumishi wako. Ulimi wangu ni mzito kuzungumza.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Omonene, “Koranche, Omonene one, inche tindi Omokuani omuya, nonya nkorwa kare, gose korwa riria gwachaagete gokwana nainche, omosomba oo. Oromeme rwane nororito na nigo ingotutura.”

English: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia, “Ni nani aliyempa mwanadamu kinywa? Ni nani aliyemfanya mtu kuwa kiziwi au bubu? Ni nani anayempa mtu kuona au upofu? Je, si mimi, Bwana?
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ning’o okoa Mwanyabaanto omonwa bw’ogokwana? Ning’o omokorete abe rimama, gose omotino, gose abe okorora, gose koba omouko? Inee! Tari inche Omonene?

English: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
Kiswahili: Sasa nenda, nitakusaidia kusema, nami nitakufundisha jambo la kusema.”
Ekegusii: Bono genda! Nainche omonyene nimbe naye naende ninkoe amang’ana ogochia gokwana nomonwa oo na gokworokereria aya ogochia goteeba.”

English: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akasema, “Ee Bwana, tafadhali mtume mtu mwingine kufanya kazi hiyo.”
Ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Omonene, koranche, toma monto onde bwensi oranche.”

English: Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
Kiswahili: Ndipo hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Mose, akamwambia, “Vipi kuhusu ndugu yako, Aroni Mlawi? Ninajua yeye anaweza kuzungumza vizuri. Naye yuko tayari njiani kukulaki, na moyo wake utafurahi wakati atakapokuona.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu ekoberoroka ase Musa, akamoteebia, “Inee! Aroni momura omino, oria Omolawi, takaiyo? Nimanyete ng’a ere nere omonto omanyete gokwana buya. Naama! Ngocha are gokorotota; ere ekero arakorore nasasoke ase enkoro yaye.

English: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.
Kiswahili: Utazungumza naye na kuweka maneno kinywani mwake. Nitawasaidia ninyi wawili kusema, nami nitawafundisha jambo la kufanya.
Ekegusii: Aye nokwane nere, omoteebie aya agochia gokwana. Inche nimbae inwe babere amang’ana mogochia gokwana, boigo nimbaorokererie aya mogochi gokora.

English: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
Kiswahili: Aroni ataongea na watu badala yako na itakuwa kwamba yeye amekuwa kinywa chako nawe utakuwa kama Mungu kwake.
Ekegusii: Nere orabe ogokwana nabaanto ribaga riao; ere abe Omokuani oo, na aye obe Enyasae asare ere.

English: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”
Kiswahili: Lakini chukua fimbo hii mkononi mwako ili uweze kuitumia kufanya ishara hizo za ajabu.”
Ekegusii: Aye obogorie enyimbo eyio koboko kwao, nero orakorere ebikone.”

English: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akarudi kwa Yethro mkwewe akamwambia, “Niruhusu nirudi kwa watu wangu Misri kuona kama yuko hata mmoja wao ambaye bado anaishi.” Yethro akamwambia, “Nenda, nami nakutakia mema.”
Ekegusii: Musa akairana gochia ase Jethiro, ise biara, akamoteebia, “Koranche, tiga ing’irane gochia Misiri korora abaminto gose moyo bare.” Jethiro akamoteebia, “Ee, genda nomorembe.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana alikuwa amemwambia Mose huko Midiani, “Rudi Misri kwa maana watu wote waliotaka kukuua wamekufa.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa konya atararwa aaria Midiani, Omonene akamoteebia, “Irana gochia Misiri, ekiagera baria bonsi barigetie obogima bwao bakuure.”

English: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.
Kiswahili: Basi Mose akamchukua mkewe na wanawe, akawapandisha juu ya punda na kuanza safari kurudi Misri. Naye akaichukua ile fimbo ya Mungu mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Musa akaimokia mokaye na abana baye, akabariinia etigere igoro, na barabwo bakairana gochia ase ense ya Misiri. Ere akabogoria enyimbo ya Nyasae koboko kwaye.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Utakaporudi Misri, hakikisha kwamba utafanya mbele ya Farao maajabu yote niliyokupa uwezo wa kuyafanya. Lakini nitafanya moyo wake kuwa mgumu ili kwamba asiwaruhusu watu waende.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Bono ekero orabe gokoirana Misiri, origererie buya ng’a nokore ase obosio bwa Farao amakumia onsi aya nakoeire okobua gw’okoyakora. Korende ninkong’ie enkoro yaye, na ere tagotiga abanto bagende.

English: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,
Kiswahili: Kisha mwambie Farao, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Israeli ni mwanangu mzaliwa wa kwanza,
Ekegusii: Erio omoteebie Farao: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Abaisraeli nomwana one omotangi.

English: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’”
Kiswahili: nami nilikuambia, “Ruhusu mwanangu aondoke, ili aweze kuniabudu mimi.” Lakini ukakataa kumruhusu kwenda, basi nitaua mwana wako mzaliwa wa kwanza.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inche nagotebirie: Moe omwana one ribaga agende gonsasiima korende koraange, rirorio nigo ndaite omwana oo omotangi.”

English: On the way at a lodging place, Yahweh met Moses and wanted to kill him.
Kiswahili: Mose alipokuwa mahali pa kulala wageni akiwa njiani kurudi Misri, Bwana akakutana naye, akataka kumuua.
Ekegusii: Kobare nchera kogenda, Omonene akaumerana na Musa aase baare gotimokera, akarigia komoita.

English: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Sipora akachukua jiwe gumu, akakata govi la mwanawe na kugusa nalo miguu ya Mose. Sipora akasema, “Hakika wewe ni bwana arusi wa damu kwangu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Sipora akaimokia rigena riare erioge, agasara omwana oye risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha akarikunia amagoro a Musa, akabora, “Amaene, nigo ore omonywomi one bw’amanyinga.”

English: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.
Kiswahili: Sipora alipomwita Mose, “Bwana arusi wa damu,” alikuwa anamaanisha ile tohara. Baada ya hayo Bwana akamwacha.
Ekegusii: Agw’Omonene agatiga Musa, tamoita. Erio omokungu oyio agateeba, “Omonyuomi bw’amanyinga ase engencho y’okwaroka.”

English: Yahweh said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Nenda jangwani ukamlaki Mose.” Basi akakutana na Mose kwenye mlima wa Mungu, akambusu.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Genda gochia ase erooro orotote Musa.” Erio Aroni akagenda, akaumerana na Musa ase egetunwa kia Nyasae, akamonyunyunta.

English: Moses told Aaron all Yahweh’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni kila kitu Bwana alichomtuma kusema, vilevile habari za ishara na maajabu alizokuwa amemwamuru kufanya.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni amang’ana onsi Omonene amotebetie, na igoro y’ebikone bionsi amochigeete akore.

English: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni wakawakusanya wazee wote wa Waisraeli,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakagenda, bagasangereria abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli.

English: Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
Kiswahili: naye Aroni akawaambia kila kitu Bwana alichokuwa amemwambia Mose. Pia akafanya ishara mbele ya watu,
Ekegusii: Aroni akabateebia amang’ana onsi Omonene atebeetie Musa, na ere agakora ebikone biria maiso marore ase obosio bw’abaanto.

English: The people believed, and when they heard that Yahweh had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.
Kiswahili: nao wakaamini. Nao waliposikia kuwa Bwana anajishughulisha nao, na kwamba ameona mateso yao, walisujudu na kuabudu.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bakwegena; na ekero baigwete ng’a Omonene bwechandeire Abaisraeli, na ororire emechando yabo, barabwo bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasiima.

English: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”
Kiswahili: Baadaye Mose na Aroni wakaenda kwa Farao, wakamwambia, “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Waruhusu watu wangu waende, ili waweze kunifanyia sikukuu huko jangwani.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakagenda ase Farao, bakamoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Kae abanto baane ribaga basoe ase orogendo gochia gonkorera omoyega bwe Rituko Rinene aaria ase erooro.”

English: Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”
Kiswahili: Farao akasema, “Huyo Bwana ni nani, hata nimtii na kuruhusu Israeli uende? Simjui huyo Bwana wala sitawaruhusu Israeli waende.”
Ekegusii: Farao akairaneria, “Omonene nere ng’o inyigwe amang’ana aye, na koa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende? Inche timomanyeti Omonene, gose tinkoa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende.”

English: They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh, our God, lest he fall on us with pestilence, or with the sword.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakasema, “Mungu wa Waebrania amekutana nasi. Sasa turuhusu tuwe na safari ya siku tatu ya jangwani ili tukamtolee Bwana Mungu wetu dhabihu, la sivyo aweza kutupiga sisi kwa tauni au kwa upanga.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakamoteebia, “Nyasae bw’Abaiberania natoorokera. Koranche, otoe ribaga togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde tomoruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebing’wanso, tabaisa gocha gotoita namarwaire gose nemioro.”

English: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”
Kiswahili: Lakini mfalme wa Misri akasema, “Mbona ninyi Mose na Aroni mnawachukua watu waache kazi zao? Rudini kwenye kazi zenu!”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti o Misiri akabairaneria, “Musa na Aroni, nase ki mogotenenia abanto korwa ase emeremo yabo? Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino y’obosomba.”

English: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Farao akasema, “Tazama, sasa watu hawa ni wengi, nanyi mnawazuia kufanya kazi.”
Ekegusii: Naende Farao akabora, “Abanto aba babeire abange kobua abanyene ense eye. Naende morigetie kobarusia ase emeremo yabo yobosomba.”

English: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,
Kiswahili: Siku iyo hiyo Farao akatoa amri hii kwa viongozi wa watumwa na wasimamizi wa watu akawaambia:
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Farao agachiika abwo abachandi amo nabateneneri, akabateebia,

English: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.
Kiswahili: “Tangu sasa msiwape hawa watu nyasi za kutengenezea matofali. Wao wakusanye nyasi zao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Timoa abanto aba naende chimboba ase okoroisia amatabori, buna mware kobaa agwo ritang’ani. Tiga bagende barabwo boka kwerigeria chimboba.

English: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’
Kiswahili: Lakini watakeni kutengeneza matofali kiasi kile kile cha mwanzo, kiwango kisipunguzwe. Wao ni wavivu, ndiyo sababu wanalia, wakisema, ‘Turuhusiwe twende kumtolea Mungu wetu dhabihu.’
Ekegusii: Korende mobabetererie baroisie omobaro bw’amatabori oyo baare gokora ritang’ani, batari koyokeyia. Barabwo tibari nemeremo ebaisaine. Nakio gekogera bakona‐koboria ng’a: Toe ribaga togende koruera Nyasae oito ekeng’wanso.

English: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”
Kiswahili: Fanyeni kazi kuwa ngumu zaidi kwa watu hao ili kwamba wakazane na kazi na kuacha kusikiliza uongo.”
Ekegusii: Bae abanto abwo emeremo emerito mono, kegima baisaneke nero, na tibanyora ribaga riogotegerera amang’ana ’oborimo.”

English: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.
Kiswahili: Basi viongozi wa watumwa na wasimamizi wakaenda kuwaambia watu, “Hivi ndivyo Farao asemavyo: ‘Sitawapa tena nyasi.
Ekegusii: Abachandi abwo na abateneneri bagasoka bagateebia Abaisraeli, “Farao oteebire iga: Tinkobaa inwe chimboba naende.

English: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”
Kiswahili: Nendeni mkatafute nyasi wenyewe popote mnapoweza kuzipata, lakini kazi yenu haitapunguzwa hata kidogo.’ ”
Ekegusii: Genda inwe mweka mwerigerie chimboba aande onsi morachinyore; korende goika moroisie omobaro bw’amatabori oria o botambe, kende nkeiyo nonya negeke kegokeigwa korwa ase ekerengo kie emeremo yaino ya kera rituko.”

English: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
Kiswahili: Basi watu wakatawanyika kote nchini Misri kukusanya mabua ya kutumia badala ya nyasi.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagesiarera ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na kwerigeria obonyansi ribaga rie chimboba.

English: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa watumwa wakasisitiza, wakisema, “Timizeni kazi mnayotakiwa kwa kila siku, kama wakati ule mlipokuwa mkipewa nyasi.”
Ekegusii: Abachandi baria bakagenderera kobabetereria, bagoteeba, “Goika moroisie kera rituko ekerengo kia amatabori buna konya mokoroisia ekero mware korenterwa chimboba.”

English: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”
Kiswahili: Wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli waliochaguliwa na viongozi wa watumwa wa Farao walipigwa na kuulizwa, “Kwa nini hamkutimiza kiwango chenu cha kutengeneza matofali jana na leo, kama mwanzoni?”
Ekegusii: Abachandi abwo babekire na Farao bakaba bagoaka abateneneri b’Abaisraeli, abwo babegetwe gotenenera emeremo, bakabateebia, “Naki motaikeranetie omobaro oino bw’amatabori igoro na reero, oyio konya mokoroisia botambe?”

English: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?
Kiswahili: Ndipo wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli wakaenda kumlilia Farao, wakisema: “Mbona umewatendea watumishi wako hivi?
Ekegusii: Erio abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakagenda ase Farao, bagateeba, “Inki ogotokorera abasomba bao iga?

English: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”
Kiswahili: Watumishi wako hawapewi nyasi, hata hivyo tumeambiwa, ‘Tengenezeni matofali!’ Watumishi wako wanapigwa, lakini kosa ni la watu wako wenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Chimboba titori koegwa, korende nigo tokona‐kobetererigwa ng’a toroisie amatabori. Na bono, abasomba bao, nigo bakona‐goakwa; korende okomocha nokw’abaanto bao.”

English: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to Yahweh.’
Kiswahili: Farao akasema, “Ninyi ni wavivu ndiyo sababu mnasema, ‘Turuhusu twende tukamtolee Bwana dhabihu.’
Ekegusii: Farao akabairaneria, “Inwe naboro mono. Nigo mobarachete nakio gekogera mogoteeba ng’a: Toe ribaga togende toruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.

English: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”
Kiswahili: Sasa nendeni kazini. Hamtapewa nyasi zozote, nanyi ni lazima mtengeneze matofali.”
Ekegusii: Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino. Timokorenterwa chimboba, korende goika moroisie ekerengo kia amatabori, keria mochikiire koroisia.”

English: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”
Kiswahili: Wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli walitambua kuwa wako taabani walipoambiwa, “Hamtakiwi kupunguza idadi ya matofali mliotakiwa kutengeneza kila siku.”
Ekegusii: Abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakarora ng’a basoire ase obokong’u ekiagera bateebetigwe ng’a, “Goika moikeranie kera rituko ekerengo keria kia amatabori.”

English: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Walipoondoka kwa Farao, wakawakuta Mose na Aroni wakingojea kukutana nao,
Ekegusii: Ekero baare korua ase Farao, bakanyora Musa na Aroni agwo nchera baabaganyete,

English: They said to them, “May Yahweh look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”
Kiswahili: wakawaambia Mose na Aroni, “Bwana na awaangalie awahukumu ninyi! Mmetufanya tunuke kwa Farao na maafisa wake, nanyi mmeweka upanga mikononi mwao ili kutuua sisi.”
Ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Omonene abarigererie na konacha ekiina, ekiagera mwatokorire koba chindoso ase obosio bwa Farao na ase abasomba baye. Mwabaeire engencho yogotoita.”

English: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?
Kiswahili: Mose akarudi kwa Bwana na kumwambia, “Ee Bwana, mbona umewaletea watu hawa taabu? Kwa nini basi ukanituma mimi?
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamoteebia, “Omonene, nase ki ogokorera abanto aba amabe buna aya? Inki rende gwantomera inche?

English: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”
Kiswahili: Tangu nilipomwendea Farao kuzungumza naye kwa jina lako, amewaletea taabu watu hawa, nawe kamwe hujawakomboa watu wako.”
Ekegusii: Naki korwa riria nagendete ase Farao gokwana amang’ana ao omentire gokorera abanto bao bobe mono, na aye torakora kende ase okobatooria.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Sasa utaona kitu nitakachomfanyia Farao: Kwa sababu ya mkono wangu wenye nguvu atawaachia watu waende; kwa sababu ya mkono wangu wenye nguvu atawafukuza waondoke nchini mwake.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Bono norore aya ndakorere Farao. Naki ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nimobetererie abae abanto baane ribaga bagende, ee, ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nabetererigwe abaserie korwa ase ense yaye.”

English: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Pia Mungu akamwambia Mose, “Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nyasae agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Inche ninche Omonene.

English: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.
Kiswahili: Nilimtokea Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo kama Mungu Mwenyezi, ingawa sikuwajulisha Jina langu, Yehova, Mimi mwenyewe sikujitambulisha kwao.
Ekegusii: Naorokerete Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo buna Nyasae Omobui. Korende ase erieta riane Yahwe, gose Omonene, tinamanyekanete ase bare.

English: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.
Kiswahili: Pia niliweka Agano langu nao kuwapa nchi ya Kanaani, ambako waliishi kama wageni.
Ekegusii: Naende ninche nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ng’a nimbae ense ya Kaanani, ense eria barenge buna abamenyi.

English: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, nimesikia kilio cha huzuni cha Waisraeli ambao Wamisri wamewatia utumwani, nami nimelikumbuka Agano langu.
Ekegusii: Na bono naigure okwerera kw’Abaisraeli abwo Abamisiri babegete inse y’obosomba, naende ning’inyorete okobwatana koria kwane.

English: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mimi ndimi Bwana, nami nitawatoa mtoke katika kongwa la Wamisri. Nitawaweka huru mtoke kuwa watumwa wao, nami nitawakomboa kwa mkono ulionyooshwa pamoja na matendo makuu ya hukumu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a, Inche ninche Omonene, ndabarusie korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri. Nimbatoorie korwa ase obosomba bwaino. Ase okoboko kwane koramboire, na goetera ase ebisusuro ebinene, nimbaboorie.

English: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
Kiswahili: Nitawatwaa mwe watu wangu mwenyewe, nami nitakuwa Mungu wenu. Ndipo mtajua kuwa mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, niliyewatoa chini ya kongwa la Wamisri.
Ekegusii: Nimbakore mobe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae oino. Inwe namomanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyobarusirie korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri.

English: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am Yahweh.’”
Kiswahili: Nami nitawaleta mpaka nchi niliyoapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kumpa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo. Nitawapa iwe milki yenu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nimbaire goika ense eria nariete eira koa Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo. Nimbayee ebe omwando oino. Inche ninche Omonene.”

English: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
Kiswahili: Mose akawaarifu Waisraeli jambo hili, lakini hawakumsikiliza kwa sababu ya maumivu makuu ya moyoni na utumwa wa kikatili.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana ayio, korende barabwo tibancha gotegerera, ekiagera konya emioyo yabo y akuure, ase engencho y’emeremo y’obosomba obotindi.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana na Musa akamoteebia,

English: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”
Kiswahili: “Nenda, mwambie Farao mfalme wa Misri awaachie Waisraeli waondoke nchini mwake.”
Ekegusii: “Genda okwane na Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, omoteebie abae Abaisraeli ribaga bagende, barue ase ense yaye.”

English: Moses spoke before Yahweh, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Ikiwa Waisraeli hawatanisikiliza, kwa nini yeye Farao anisikilize mimi, ambaye huzungumza kwa kigugumizi?”
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Omonene, akamoteebia. “Rora Abaisraeli baangire konyigwera, naki rende Farao ere arakore anyigwere, inche omonto ntamanyeti gokwana.?”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akanena na Mose na Aroni kuhusu Waisraeli na Farao mfalme wa Misri, naye akawaamuru wawatoe Waisraeli kutoka Misri.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabachika bagende bateebie Abaisraeli na Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, ng’a batomirwe barusie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.

English: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wakuu wa jamaa zao: Wana wa Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa Israeli walikuwa Hanoki, Palu, Hesroni na Karmi. Hawa walikuwa ndio koo za Reubeni.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chiamate chiabo. Abana abamura ba Rubeni, omomura omotangi o Israeli, nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Rubeni.

English: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Simeoni walikuwa Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Sohari na Shauli mwana wa mwanamke Mkanaani. Hawa walikuwa ndio koo za Simeoni.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Saulo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omokanani. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Simioni.

English: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Lawi kufuatana na orodha zao: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari. Lawi aliishi miaka 137.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abamura ba Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari. Lawi nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137).

English: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Gershoni kwa koo, walikuwa Libni na Shimei.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Libini na Simei, ne chiamate chiabo.

English: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli. Kohathi aliishi miaka 133.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli. Kohati nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etato (133).

English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Merari walikuwa Mahli na Mushi. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Lawi kufuatana na orodha zao.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo.

English: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.
Kiswahili: Amramu akamwoa Yokebedi, shangazi yake, ambaye alimzalia Aroni na Mose. Amramu aliishi miaka 137.
Ekegusii: Amuramu akanyuoma Yokebedi, omoiseke omwabo ise; na ere akamoiborera Aroni na Musa. Amuramu nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137).

English: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Ishari walikuwa Kora, Nefegi na Zikri.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Isari nabwo aba: Kora, na Nefegi, na Sikiri.

English: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Uzieli walikuwa Mishaeli, Elisafani na Sithri.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo aba: Mishaeli na Elisafani, na Sitiri.

English: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Aroni akamwoa Elisheba binti wa Aminadabu ndugu yake Nashoni, naye akamzalia Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Aroni akanyuoma Elisheba, omoiseke bw’Aminadabu, omoiseke omwabo Nashoni. Ere akamoiborera Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.

English: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kora walikuwa Asiri, Elikana na Abiasafu. Hawa walikuwa ndio koo za Kora.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kora nabwo aba: Asiri, na Elikana, na Abiasafu. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Kora.

English: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.
Kiswahili: Eleazari mwana wa Aroni akamwoa mmoja wa binti za Putieli, naye akamzalia Finehasi. Hawa walikuwa ndio wakuu wa jamaa za Walawi, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Eleazari, omwana o Aroni, akanyuoma omoiseke oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Putieli, na ere akamoiborera Finehasi. Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chinyomba chi’Abalawi, eamate ase eamate.

English: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom Yahweh said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa Aroni na Mose wale wale ambao Bwana aliwaambia, “Watoeni Waisraeli katika nchi ya Misri kwa vikosi vyao.”
Ekegusii: Aroni amo na Musa nabwo bari’Omonene atebeetie, “Barusie Abaisraeli ase ense ya Misiri, omoganda ase omoganda.”

English: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.
Kiswahili: Ndio hao hao waliozungumza na Farao mfalme wa Misri kuhusu kuwatoa Waisraeli Misri. Ilikuwa ni huyo Mose na huyo Aroni.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo baria Musa na Aroni bateebeetie Farao ng’a barusie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri.

English: On the day when Yahweh spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
Kiswahili: Bwana aliponena na Mose huko Misri,
Ekegusii: Rituko riri’Omonene akwanete na Musa ase ense ya Misiri

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”
Kiswahili: akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Bwana. Mwambie Farao mfalme wa Misri kila kitu nikuambiacho.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Inche ninche Omonene. Otebie Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, amang’ana onsi nkogoteebia.”

English: Moses said before Yahweh, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Kwa kuwa mimi huzungumza kwa kigugumizi, Farao atanisikiliza mimi?”
Ekegusii: Korende Musa akairaneri’Omonene akamoteebia, “Inche nomonto ntamanyeti gokwana, naki rende Farao arakore anyigwere?”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Tazama, nimekufanya kuwa kama Mungu kwa Farao, naye Aroni, huyo ndugu yako, atakuwa nabii wako.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rora nagokorire obe buna Nyasae ase Farao, na Aroni akwane nere buna omobani oo.

English: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
Kiswahili: Utasema kila kitu nitakachokuagiza, naye Aroni ndugu yako atamwambia Farao awaachie Waisraeli watoke katika nchi yake.
Ekegusii: Aye oteebie oyomino Aroni ayio onsi nagochikiire, na ere akwane na Farao, amoteebie ng’a ae Abaisraeli ribaga barue ase ense yaye.

English: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Lakini nitaufanya moyo wa Farao kuwa mgumu. Ingawa nitazidisha ishara na maajabu katika Misri,
Ekegusii: Korende ninkong’ie enkoro ya Farao; nonya nabo ninkore ebikone ebinge na amakumia amange ase ense ya Misiri.

English: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
Kiswahili: hatawasikiliza. Kisha nitaupeleka mkono wangu juu ya Misri, na kwa matendo makuu ya hukumu nitavitoa vikundi vyangu, watu wangu Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Korende Farao takobaigwa. Inche nindambore okoboko kwane igoro y’Abamisiri na kobaa ebisusuro ebinene, na nindusie emeganda yane, abanto baane Abaisraeli, korwa ase ense ya Misiri.

English: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”
Kiswahili: Nao Wamisri watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana nitakapounyoosha mkono wangu dhidi ya Misri na kuwatoa Waisraeli watoke humo.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abamisiri mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, ekero ndarambore okoboko kwane ase barabwo na koruisia Abaisraeli korwa ase bare.”

English: Moses and Aaron did so. As Yahweh commanded them, so they did.
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni wakafanya sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyowaagiza.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete.

English: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Mose alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na Aroni alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na mitatu walipozungumza na Farao.
Ekegusii: Ekero keria bakwanete na Farao, Musa nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano na etato (80), na Aroni emiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etato (83).

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni,
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni,

English: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”
Kiswahili: “Farao atakapowaambia, ‘Fanyeni muujiza,’ basi mwambie Aroni, ‘Chukua fimbo yako na uitupe chini mbele ya Farao,’ nayo fimbo itakuwa nyoka.”
Ekegusii: “Ekero Farao arababorie ng’a mokore egekone, erio aye Musa oteebie Aroni abogorie enyimbo yaye, ayerute inse bosio bwa Farao, na ero neonchoke ebe eng’iti.”

English: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as Yahweh had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakaenda kwa Farao wakafanya sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyoagiza. Aroni akaitupa ile fimbo yake chini mbele ya Farao na maafisa wake, nayo ikawa nyoka.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakagenda ase Farao, bagakora buna Omonene abachiigete. Aroni akaruta enyimbo yaye bosio bwa Farao na bw’abasomba baye, na ero ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti.

English: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.
Kiswahili: Farao naye akawaita watu wenye maarifa na wachawi na waganga wa Kimisri, nao wakafanya vivyo hivyo kwa siri ya uganga wao.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria abanto abanyasemi na abaragori, na abwo abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo bwa bobisi.

English: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja alitupa fimbo yake chini, nayo ikawa nyoka. Lakini fimbo ya Aroni ikazimeza zile fimbo zao.
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaruta enyimbo yaye inse, na chirochio chikaonchoka, chikaba ching’iti; korende enyimbo ya Aroni ekamera chinyimbo chiabo.

English: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo moyo wa Farao ukawa mgumu, naye hakuwasikiliza Mose na Aroni, sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Enkoro ya Farao nigo yarenge enkong’u, na buna Omonene atebeete, taigwera Musa na Aroni.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Moyo wa Farao ni mgumu, anakataa kuwaachia watu kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Farao okong’irie enkoro yaye, bwangire koa abanto aba ribaga bagende.

English: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.
Kiswahili: Nenda kwa Farao asubuhi wakati anapokwenda mtoni. Ngoja ukingoni mwa Naili ili uonane naye, na uchukue mkononi mwako fimbo ile iliyobadilishwa kuwa nyoka.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, genda oumerane na Farao ekero aragende rooche mambia, ogende otenene ase engegu, omoganye aroro. Enyimbo eria yaonchogete ekaba eng’iti, oyebogorie koboko kwao.

English: You shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”
Kiswahili: Kisha umwambie, ‘Bwana, Mungu wa Waebrania, amenituma nikuambie: Waachie watu wangu waende, ili wapate kuniabudu jangwani. Lakini hadi sasa hujasikiliza.
Ekegusii: Omoteebie ng’a: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, ontomire ngoteebie ng’a oe abanto baye ribaga bagende komokorera ase erooro. Naye goika bono toraigwa.

English: Yahweh says, “In this you shall know that I am Yahweh. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: Kwa hili utajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana: Fimbo iliyo mkononi mwangu nitapiga nayo maji ya Naili nayo yatabadilika kuwa damu.
Ekegusii: Ase ig’Omonene oteebire iga: Ase ring’ana eri ndakore, nario oramanye ng’a ninche Omonene. Rigereria, ning’ake amaache y’orooche rwa Naeli nenyimbo eye mbwate koboko kwane, na amaache aya naonchoke abe amanyinga.

English: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”
Kiswahili: Samaki waliomo katika Mto Naili watakufa, nao mto utanuka vibaya, Wamisri hawataweza kunywa hayo maji yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ne chinswe chire ase orooche ime inachikwe, chigunde, na orooche narotioke bobe, na Abamisiri nabasinywe konywa amaache aria.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mwambie Aroni, ‘Chukua ile fimbo yako unyooshe mkono wako juu ya maji ya Misri, juu ya chemchemi na mifereji, juu ya madimbwi na mabwawa yote,’ navyo vitabadilika kuwa damu. Damu itakuwa kila mahali katika Misri, hata kwenye vyombo vya miti na vya mawe.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa moteebie Aroni, aimokie enyimbo yaye, arambore okoboko kwaye igoro ase amaache onsi ay’Abamisiri, ase chindooche chiabo na ase ebirooche, ase amatibo onsi ne chinsoko. Amache ayio onsi aonchoke abe amanyinga. Naboigo amanyinga abe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, nonya nase chintuba na ase chinyongo chionsi.

English: Moses and Aaron did so, as Yahweh commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni wakafanya kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amewaagiza. Akainua fimbo yake machoni pa Farao na maafisa wake na kuyapiga maji ya Mto Naili, na maji yote yakabadilika kuwa damu.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete. Ase obosio bwa Farao na abasomba baye, Aroni akaimokia enyimbo yaye, agaaka orooche, na amaache ayare imeo akaonchoka, akaba amanyinga.

English: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Samaki katika Mto Naili wakafa, nao mto ukanuka vibaya sana kiasi kwamba Wamisri hawakuweza kunywa maji yake. Damu ilikuwa kila mahali katika nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Ne chinswe chiare ase orooche chigakwa, na orooche rokagunda na gotioka, na Abamisiri bagasinywa konywa amaache aria. Amanyinga akaba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.

English: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Kiswahili: Lakini waganga wa Misri kwa kutumia siri ya uganga wao wakafanya vivyo hivyo, nao moyo wa Farao ukawa mgumu, hakuwasikiliza Mose na Aroni, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Erio abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo. Farao akagenderera gokong’ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene konya atebiire, tabaigwa.

English: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, Farao akageuka, akaenda kwenye jumba lake la kifalme, wala hakulitia hili moyoni.
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akairana akogenda bwoye, amang’ana aria tayabeka ase omoyo oye.

English: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.
Kiswahili: Nao Wamisri wote wakachimba kandokando ya Mto Naili kupata maji ya kunywa, kwa sababu hawakuweza kunywa maji ya mto.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri bonsi bagakunya‐kunya mbarabare y’orooche ase okorigia amaache bakonywa, ekiagera tibare konyara konywa amaache a rooche.

English: Seven days were fulfilled, after Yahweh had struck the river.
Kiswahili: Zilipita siku saba baada ya Bwana kuyapiga maji ya Mto Naili.
Ekegusii: Amatuko atano na abere akaera korwa riri’Omonene aagete orooche rwa Naeli.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nenda kwa Farao ukamwambie, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Waachie watu wangu waende, ili wapate kuniabudu.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda oteebie Farao: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende gonkorera.

English: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.
Kiswahili: Kama ukikataa kuwaruhusu kuondoka, basi nitaipiga nchi yako yote kwa kuwaletea vyura.
Ekegusii: Korende koraange kobaa ribaga bagende, rirorio inche ning’ake ense yao yonsi ase okorenta ebioto.

English: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.
Kiswahili: Mto Naili utafurika vyura. Watakuja kwenye jumba lako la kifalme na katika chumba chako cha kulala na kitandani mwako, katika nyumba za maafisa wako na kwa watu wako, vyura hao wataingia katika meko yenu na kwenye vyombo vya kukandia unga.
Ekegusii: Orooche rwa Naeli naroichorwe nebioto, na birobio nabitiire korwa aroro, nabisoe nyomba mwao, na enyomba yao y’okorara, amo noborere bwao; nabisoe ne chinyomba chi’abasomba bao na echi’abaanto bao, ase amariiko ao ase okogeekera emegati, na ase ebituba biao bi’ooboseemiara obosie.

English: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”
Kiswahili: Vyura watapanda juu yako, juu ya watu wako na maafisa wako wote.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ebioto ebio inabikogenderere omobere oo, na ey’abaanto bao, na ey’abasomba bao.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mwambie Aroni, ‘Nyoosha mkono wako ukiwa na ile fimbo yako juu ya vijito, mifereji na madimbwi, fanya vyura waje juu ya nchi ya Misri.’ ”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Moteebie Aroni abwate enyimbo yaye, ayeimokie igoro ye chindooche, na ebirooche, na amatibo, erinde agere ebioto bigende igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”

English: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Aroni akaunyoosha mkono wake juu ya maji ya Misri, nao vyura wakatokea na kuifunika nchi.
Ekegusii: Aroni akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’amaache onsi a Misiri, na ebioto bigatiira, bigatuba ense eyio yonsi.

English: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Lakini waganga wakafanya vivyo hivyo kwa siri ya uganga wao, nao pia wakafanya vyura kuja juu ya nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Na abaringoria bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo, bakarenta ebioto igoro ase ense ya Misiri.

English: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat Yahweh, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Farao akamwita Mose na Aroni na kusema, “Mwombeni Bwana awaondoe vyura kutoka kwangu na kwa watu wangu, nami nitawaachia watu wenu waende kumtolea Bwana dhabihu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni, akabateebia, “Mosabe Omonene arusie ebioto korwa ase ense na korwa ase abanto baane, na inche ning’ee abanto baye ribaga bagende koruera Omonene ekeng’wanso.”

English: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Farao, “Ninakupa heshima ya kuamua ni wakati gani wa kukuombea wewe, maafisa wako na watu wako ili kwamba vyura watoke kwenu na kwenye nyumba zenu. Isipokuwa wale walio katika Mto Naili.”
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Farao, “Ase amasikani ao, naye oranteebie ngaki ki ndagosabere aye amo nabasomba bao, na abanto bao, erinde ebioto birue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, bitigare koba ase orooche rwa Naeli oka.”

English: Pharaoh said, “Tomorrow.” Moses said, “Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like Yahweh our God.
Kiswahili: Farao akasema, “Kesho.” Mose akamjibu, “Itakuwa kama unavyosema, ili upate kujua kwamba hakuna yeyote kama Bwana Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Farao akairaneria, “Ng’ankio.” Musa akamoteebia, “Nigo erabe buna gwateba, erinde omanye ng’a onde tari buna Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”
Kiswahili: Vyura wataondoka kwako na katika nyumba zako, kwa maafisa wako na kwa watu wako, ila watabakia katika Mto Naili tu.”
Ekegusii: Ebioto nabirue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, ase abasomba bao na ase abanto bao; binde tibigotigara otatiga ase orooche rwa Naeli oka.”

English: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to Yahweh concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Mose na Aroni kuondoka kwa Farao, Mose akamlilia Bwana kuhusu vyura aliokuwa amewaleta kwa Farao.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakarua o Farao, na Musa akabori’Omonene arusie ebioto ebio amorenterete Farao.

English: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana akafanya lile Mose alilomwomba. Vyura wakafia ndani ya nyumba, viwanjani na mashambani.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa amoboretie, na ebioto ebio biare ase chinyomba, na ase chigoora, na aande onsi isiko, bigakwa.

English: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.
Kiswahili: Wakayakusanya malundo, nchi nzima ikanuka.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakabisangereria, bakabibeka ebinge chinyinge, na ense yonsi egatioka bobe.

English: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Kiswahili: Lakini Farao alipoona pametokea nafuu, akaushupaza moyo wake na hakuwasikiliza Mose na Aroni, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Farao aroche ng’a amang’ana abeire buya, agakong’ia enkoro yaye naende, na buna Omonene ateebete, akanga koigwa Musa na Aroni.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mwambie Aroni, ‘Nyoosha fimbo yako uyapige mavumbi ya ardhi,’ nayo nchi yote ya Misri mavumbi yatakuwa viroboto.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Moteebie Aroni aimokie enyimbo yaye aake orotu rw’eriroba, na rororwo naroonchoke robe chinsona ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Wakafanya hivyo, Aroni aliponyoosha mkono wake wenye fimbo na kuyapiga mavumbi ya nchi, viroboto wakawajia watu na wanyama. Mavumbi yote katika nchi ya Misri yakawa viroboto.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagakora bo. Aroni akarambora okoboko kwaye, agaaka riroba nenyimbo yaye, na orotu rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona, na chirochio chikaroma Mwanyabaanto ne chitugo. Orotu rwonsi rwe riroba rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona.

English: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.
Kiswahili: Lakini waganga walipojaribu kutengeneza viroboto kwa siri ya uganga wao, hawakuweza. Nao viroboto walikuwa juu ya watu na wanyama.
Ekegusii: Abaringoria nabarabwo bagateema korenta chinsona ase oborogi bwabo, korende tibanyara. Chinsona echio chikaba aande onsi, ase Mwanyabaanto na ase chitugo.

English: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Kiswahili: Waganga wale wakamwambia Farao, “Hiki ni kidole cha Mungu.” Lakini moyo wa Farao ukawa mgumu naye hakuwasikiliza, kama vile Bwana alivyosema.
Ekegusii: Abaringoria bagateebia Farao, “Eke nekiara kia Nyasae.” Korende Farao agakong’ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene ateebete, akanga kobaigwa.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Amka mapema asubuhi na usimame mbele ya Farao wakati anapokwenda mtoni nawe umwambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: Waachie watu wangu waende, ili wapate kuniabudu.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni ekero Farao agochia kogenda rooche, otenene ase obosio bwaye, omoteebie: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende bankorere.

English: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.
Kiswahili: Kama hutawaachia watu wangu waondoke nitakupelekea makundi ya mainzi juu yako, kwa maafisa wako, kwa watu wako na kwenye nyumba zenu. Nyumba za Wamisri zitajazwa mainzi, hata na ardhi yote ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Onye tokoa abanto baane ribaga, rirorio nintome chingi chinyinge igoro yao na abasomba bao, na igoro y’abanto bao ne chinyomba chiao. Chinyomba chi’Abamisiri inachiichorwe ne chingi, nonya nense eyio yonsi bamenyete.

English: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am Yahweh on the earth.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini siku ile nitafanya kitu tofauti katika nchi ya Gosheni, ambapo watu wangu wanaishi, hapatakuwepo na makundi ya mainzi, ili mpate kujua kwamba Mimi, Bwana, niko katika nchi hii.
Ekegusii: Korende ase rituko erio nintige ensemo ya Goseni, ase abanto baane bamenyete; chingi echio tichigochiao, erio nomanye ng’a ninche Omonene bw’ense eye.

English: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”
Kiswahili: Nitaweka tofauti kati ya watu wangu na watu wenu. Ishara hii ya ajabu itatokea kesho.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ninkore ogwatananeka egati y’abanto baane na abao. Ankio egekone eke nagekoreke.”

English: Yahweh did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana akafanya hivyo. Makundi makubwa ya mainzi yalimiminika katika jumba la kifalme la Farao na katika nyumba za maafisa wake, pia nchi yote ya Misri ikaharibiwa na mainzi.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakora ayio. Chingi chigaacha ase obonge mono ase chinyomba chia Farao, na echi’abasomba baye, na ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Na ense eria egasarigwa ne chingi chiria.

English: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Farao akamwita Mose na Aroni na kuwaambia, “Nendeni mkamtolee Mungu wenu dhabihu katika nchi hii.”
Ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni, akabateebia, “Genda moruere Nyasae oino ekeng’wanso, korende naiga ase ense yaito.”

English: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to Yahweh our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akamwambia, “Hilo halitakuwa sawa. Dhabihu tutakazomtolea Bwana Mungu wetu zitakuwa chukizo kwa Wamisri. Kama tukitoa dhabihu ambazo ni chukizo mbele yao, je, hawatatupiga mawe?
Ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Titokonyara gokora igo, ekiagera intwe ntoruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso ekeragechie Abamisiri. Na onye Abamisiri bagotorora tokorua ekeng’wanso buna ekio, Inee, tibagocha gotoaka amagena?

English: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh our God, as he shall command us.”
Kiswahili: Ni lazima twende mwendo wa siku tatu mpaka tufike jangwani ili tumtolee Bwana Mungu wetu dhabihu, kama alivyotuagiza.”
Ekegusii: Goika togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde toruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso buna atochikiire.”

English: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to Yahweh your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”
Kiswahili: Farao akamwambia, “Nitawaruhusu mwende kumtolea Bwana Mungu wenu dhabihu huko jangwani, lakini hamna ruhusa kwenda mbali sana. Sasa mniombee.”
Ekegusii: Farao akabateebia, “Nimbae ribaga mogende moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekeng’wanso ase erooro, korende timogenda aare, naende monsabere inche.”

English: Moses said, “Behold, I am going out from you. I will pray to Yahweh that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow; only don’t let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Mose akajibu, “Mara tu nitakapoondoka, nitamwomba Bwana na kesho mainzi yataondoka kwa Farao, kwa maafisa wake na kwa watu wake. Hakikisha tu kwamba Farao hatatenda kwa udanganyifu tena kwa kutokuwaachia watu waende kumtolea Bwana dhabihu.”
Ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Bono buna nkorua asore nimosabe Omonene arusie chingi korwa asore aye Farao, na ase abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, ankio mambia. Korende aye Farao, tokora obong’ainereria naende, na kwanga koa abanto ribaga bagende baruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.”

English: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akamwacha Farao na kumwomba Bwana,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akarua o Farao, agasaba Omonene.

English: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.
Kiswahili: naye Bwana akafanya lile Mose alilomwomba. Mainzi yakaondoka kwa Farao, kwa maafisa wake na kwa watu wake, wala hakuna hata inzi aliyebakia.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa ateebete, akarusia chingi chiria ase Farao, na ase abasomba baye, na ase abanto baye; tichiatigara nonya neyemo.

English: Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati huu pia Farao akaushupaza moyo wake, wala hakuwaruhusu Waisraeli waondoke.
Ekegusii: Korende Farao agakong’ia enkoro yaye nonya nengaki eyio, taa abanto ribaga bagende.

English: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nenda kwa Farao ukamwambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Waebrania asemalo: “Waachie watu wangu waende ili wapate kuniabudu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda oteebie Farao: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.

English: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,
Kiswahili: Kama ukikataa kuwaachia waende, nawe ukiendelea kuwashikilia,
Ekegusii: Naki onye gokwanga kobaa ribaga, na kogenderera kobatanga,

English: behold, Yahweh’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.
Kiswahili: mkono wa Bwana utaleta pigo baya kwa mifugo yako, juu ya farasi wako, punda, ngamia, ngʼombe wako, kondoo na mbuzi.
Ekegusii: erio nario okoboko kw’Omonene koraake chitugo chiao aase chikorisia, ne chibarasi chiao, ne chitigere, ne chingamia, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi; chirochio chinyore oborwaire obobe mono borachiite.

English: Yahweh will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”
