Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde amaache airanerane igoro y’Abamisiri, ne chigari chiabo amo nabariini chibarasi.”

English: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. Yahweh overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.
Kiswahili: Mose akanyoosha mkono wake juu ya bahari, wakati wa mapambazuko bahari ikarudiana na kuwa kama kawaida. Wamisri wakajaribu kuyakimbia maji, lakini Bwana akawasukumia ndani ya bahari.
Ekegusii: Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha, na ekero bwachia gokiamoka, amaache akairana ase konya are botambe. Abamisiri bagatema gotama korwa ase amaache, korende Omonene akabasiria ase amaache.

English: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.
Kiswahili: Maji yakarudiana na kuyafunika magari ya vita na wapanda farasi pamoja na jeshi lote la Farao lililokuwa limewafuata Waisraeli ndani ya bahari. Hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyenusurika.
Ekegusii: Amache akairanerana, akamera chigari, na abariini chibarasi amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’abarwani ba Farao, obatunyanete Abaisraeli, gochia ase enyancha. Monto onde tatigara nonya noyomo.

English: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
Kiswahili: Lakini Waisraeli wakapita baharini mahali pakavu, ukiwepo ukuta wa maji upande wao wa kuume na upande wao wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bakagenderera goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku, amaache akaba ateneine buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi ase bare.

English: Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
Kiswahili: Siku ile Bwana akawaokoa Waisraeli kutoka mikononi mwa Wamisri, nao Waisraeli wakawaona Wamisri wamelala ufuoni mwa bahari wakiwa wamekufa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase rituko riri’Omonene atooretie Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri; na Abaisraeli bakarora Abamisiri bakwete bacheng’enenete ase engegu y’enyancha.

English: Israel saw the great work which Yahweh did to the Egyptians, and the people feared Yahweh; and they believed in Yahweh and in his servant Moses.
Kiswahili: Basi Waisraeli walipoona uwezo mkubwa Bwana aliodhihirisha dhidi ya Wamisri, watu wakamwogopa Bwana na wakaweka tumaini lao kwake na kwa Mose mtumishi wake.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Abaisraeli baroche buna Omonene aorokirie okobua kwaye okonene igoro y’Abamisiri, bakamoiroka Omonene, bakamwegena Omonene na Musa, omosomba oye.

English: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose na Waisraeli wakamwimbia Bwana wimbo huu: “Nitamwimbia Bwana, kwa kuwa ametukuzwa sana. Farasi na mpanda farasi amewatosa baharini.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Abaisraeli bakamoterera Omonene ogoteera oko, bagoteeba: Nimoterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene; chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.

English: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni nguvu zangu na wimbo wangu; amekuwa wokovu wangu. Yeye ni Mungu wangu, nami nitamsifu, Mungu wa baba yangu, nami nitamtukuza.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere chinguru chiane, nimoterere ere, ere nogotooreka kwane. Ere Nyasae one, nimotogie; ere Nyasae o tata, ninterere obonene bwaye.

English: Yahweh is a man of war. Yahweh is his name.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni shujaa wa vita; Bwana ndilo jina lake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nomorwani bwe chiseegi, Omonene nario erieta riaye.

English: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: Magari ya vita ya Farao na jeshi lake amewatosa baharini. Maafisa wa Farao walio bora sana wamezamishwa katika Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: Orutire chigari chia Farao amo nomoganda oye ase enyancha ime; abarwani baye abachore obarimeirie ase enyancha embariri.

English: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.
Kiswahili: Maji yenye kina yamewafunika, wamezama mpaka vilindini kama jiwe.
Ekegusii: Amache abatubire, barimeire chindiba ime buna rigena rikorutwa.

English: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
Kiswahili: “Mkono wako wa kuume, Ee Bwana ulitukuka kwa uweza. Mkono wako wa kuume, Ee Bwana, ukamponda adui.
Ekegusii: Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio nkore nokobua okonene, Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngosenyente ababisa.

English: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.
Kiswahili: Katika ukuu wa utukufu wako, ukawaangusha chini wale waliokupinga. Uliachia hasira yako kali, ikawateketeza kama kapi.
Ekegusii: Ase okobua kwao okonene nigo okobaiyeria inse abagokoimokera; endamwamu yao ekobera, nigo ekobasamba buna chimboba chinyomo.

English: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.
Kiswahili: Kwa pumzi ya pua zako maji yalijilundika. Mawimbi ya maji yakasimama imara kama ukuta, vilindi vikagandamana ndani ya moyo wa bahari.
Ekegusii: Ase omoika korwa ase chimioro chiao amaache akaimoka, agatenena buna orwaki, enyancha egakamoka goika inse kegima.

English: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’
Kiswahili: “Adui alijivuna, ‘Nitawafuatia, nitawapata. Nitagawanya nyara; nitajishibisha kwa wao. Nitafuta upanga wangu na mkono wangu utawaangamiza.’
Ekegusii: Omobisa agateeba, “Nimbabwatie, mbaikeere, mbiatanane ebi ndasakore, omoyo one oisaneke; ninsomore omoyio one o birende, nimbasirie nokoboko kwane.”

English: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
Kiswahili: Lakini ulipuliza kwa pumzi yako, bahari ikawafunika. Wakazama kama risasi kwenye maji makuu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ekero aye kwagusete buna omwaga, amaache akabamera; bakamerwa buna embunde ekorimera ase amaache amange ime, yarika inse.

English: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
Kiswahili: “Ni nani miongoni mwa miungu aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana? Ni nani kama Wewe: uliyetukuka katika utakatifu, utishaye katika utukufu, ukitenda maajabu?
Ekegusii: Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye ase egati ye chinyasae? Ning’o onga buna aye ore nobonene na obochenu? Naye ogwenerete koirokwa na gotogigwa, aye naye oyogokora amakumia.

English: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.
Kiswahili: Uliunyoosha mkono wako wa kuume na nchi ikawameza.
Ekegusii: Ekero kwaramborete okoboko kwao gw’okorio, ense ekabamera.

English: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
Kiswahili: “Katika upendo wako usiokoma utawaongoza watu uliowakomboa. Katika nguvu zako utawaongoza mpaka makao yako matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase chiira chiao chi’obwanchani chiria kwabarierete okaraa abanto aba kwabooretie, ase chinguru chiao okabaikia ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.

English: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
Kiswahili: Mataifa watasikia na kutetemeka, uchungu utawakamata watu wa Ufilisti.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bakayaigwa, bagatengechigwa ase omoondoko, omoichano na obororo bikabwata abamenyete Bofilisti.

English: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa Edomu wataogopa, viongozi wa Moabu watatetemeka kwa hofu, watu wa Kanaani watayeyuka,
Ekegusii: Abagaambi b’Edomu bakaondoka, abanto abanene ba Moabu bakabwatwa nomotengecho, na abanto bonsi ba Kaanani bakerusia moyo.

English: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, Yahweh, until the people you have purchased pass over.
Kiswahili: vitisho na hofu vitawaangukia. Kwa nguvu ya mkono wako watatulia kama jiwe, mpaka watu wako waishe kupita, Ee Bwana, mpaka watu uliowanunua wapite.
Ekegusii: Omoondoko na obwoba bikababwata; ase engencho y’okobua gw’okoboko kwao bagatenena, bagakira‐kiri buna amagena, goika abanto bao baetire, ee, Omonene, goika abanto bao kwabooretie baetire.

English: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, Yahweh, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.
Kiswahili: Utawaingiza na kuwapandikiza juu ya mlima wa urithi wako: hapo mahali, Ee Bwana, ulipopafanya kuwa makao yako, mahali patakatifu, Ee Bwana, ulipopajenga kwa mikono yako.
Ekegusii: Nobasoyie na kobabeeka ase egetunwa kiao aye omonyene, aase aria kweroiseretie, aye Omonene, obomenyo obochenu kwaagachete namaboko ao.

English: Yahweh will reign forever and ever.”
Kiswahili: Bwana atatawala milele na milele.”
Ekegusii: Omonene nagaambe kare na kare.

English: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahweh brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.
Kiswahili: Farasi wa Farao, magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake walipoingia baharini, Bwana aliyarudisha maji ya bahari yakawafunika, lakini wana wa Israeli walipita baharini mahali pakavu.
Ekegusii: Ekero chibarasi chia Farao, amo ne chigari na abariini basoete nyancha ime, Omonene akairania amaache igoro yabo, akabatuba; korende Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku.

English: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.
Kiswahili: Kisha Miriamu yule nabii mke, ndugu yake Aroni, akachukua matari mkononi mwake na wanawake wote wakamfuata na matari yao wakicheza.
Ekegusii: Na Miriamu omobani, omoiseke omwabo Aroni, akaimokia ekebangarara kiaye, na abakungu bonsi bakamobwatia bakobugia ebibangarara biabo na goteenga.

English: Miriam answered them, “Sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”
Kiswahili: Miriamu akawaimbia: “Mwimbieni Bwana, kwa maana ametukuka sana. Farasi na mpanda farasi amewatosa baharini.”
Ekegusii: Miriamu akabaterera ogoteera kogoteeba, “Moterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene, chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.”

English: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akawaongoza Israeli kutoka Bahari ya Shamu na kuingia katika Jangwa la Shuri. Kwa siku tatu walisafiri jangwani bila kupata maji.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agatang’ana Abaisraeli kogenda orogendo korwa ase Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro ya Suri. Bagataara ase engaki y’amatuko atato ase erooro, na tibanyora maache.

English: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.
Kiswahili: Walipofika Mara, hawakuweza kunywa maji yake kwa sababu yalikuwa machungu. (Ndiyo sababu mahali hapo panaitwa Mara)
Ekegusii: Erio bagaika aase are korokwa Mara, tibanyara konywa amaache arengeo, ekiagera arenge amaroro mono. Nakio kiagerete aase aria akarokwa Mara.

English: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo watu wakamnungʼunikia Mose, wakisema, “Tunywe nini?”
Ekegusii: Agwo abanto bakemurunganeria Musa, bakamobooria, “Ninki tokonywa?”

English: Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akamlilia Bwana, naye Bwana akamwonyesha kipande cha mti. Akakitupa ndani ya maji, nayo maji yakawa matamu. Huko Bwana akawapa amri na sheria na huko akawajaribu.
Ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, n’Omonene akamworokia ekeng’ese kio omote. Omote oyio Musa akayoruta amaache ime, na amaache aria akaba amaansu. Agw’Omonene akabeekera abanto amaachiko akobaraa, na agwo akaba okobateema.

English: He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, “Kama mkisikiliza kwa bidii sauti ya Bwana Mungu wenu na kuyafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pake, kama mkiyatii maagizo yake na kuzishika amri zake zote, sitaleta juu yenu ugonjwa wowote niliowaletea Wamisri, kwa kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, niwaponyaye.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Oise koigwera aya inche Omonene oo ngokwana, na koyakora ayare boronge ase amaiso aane, na gotegerera amaachiko aane, na kobwata emeroberio yane yonsi, rirorio inche tingokobekera amarwaire ande onsi buna aria nabeekerete Abamisiri; naki ninche Omonene oo, oyogokogwenia.”

English: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakafika Elimu, mahali palipokuwa na chemchemi kumi na mbili, na miti sabini ya mitende, wakapiga kambi huko karibu na maji.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bagaika Elimu; agwo chinsoko nchiarengeo ikomi na ibere, na emekendo emerongo etan’abere (70). Bagatoora agwo ang’e namaache.

English: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli ikaondoka Elimu, wakafika Jangwa la Sini, lililokuwa kati ya Elimu na Sinai, siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa pili baada ya kutoka Misri.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okamanora na koimoka korwa Elimu, na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o kabere magega kobarure ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sini, eyio ere egati y’Elimu na Sinai.

English: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;
Kiswahili: Huko jangwani hiyo jumuiya yote wakawanungʼunikia Mose na Aroni.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase erooro omoganda bwonsi bwa Abaisraeli bakemurunganeria Musa na Aroni,

English: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by Yahweh’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakawaambia, “Laiti tungelikufa kwa mkono wa Bwana huko Misri! Huko tuliketi tukizunguka masufuria ya nyama na tukala vyakula tulivyovitaka, lakini ninyi mmetuleta huku jangwani ili mpate kuua mkutano huu wote kwa njaa.”
Ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Nanga mbuya onye twakwerete ase amaboko a ’Omonene aaria ase ense ya Misiri. Agwo tware goikaransa ase chinyongo chie chinyama, tware koria endagera ende enyinge, twaigota. Korende bono mwatorentire aa ase erooro ase ogotoita intwe twensi nenchara.”

English: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nitanyesha mikate kutoka mbinguni kwa ajili yenu. Watu watatoka kila siku na kukusanya kitakachowatosha kwa siku ile, kwa njia hii, nitawajaribu nione kama watafuata maelekezo yangu.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rora, nimbatwerie endagera korwa igoro. Kera rituko abanto bagende isiko, basangererie eyekobaisana ase rituko erio. Ase enchera eyio inche mbateeme gose mbabwatie amachiiko aane.

English: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”
Kiswahili: Siku ya sita watatayarisha kile waletacho ndani, nacho kitakuwa mara mbili kuliko ya kile walichokusanya kila siku.”
Ekegusii: Korende rituko ria gatano na rimo goika basangererie na koroisia ara kabere buna bagosangereria amatuko ande.”

English: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that Yahweh has brought you out from the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose na Aroni wakawaambia Waisraeli wote, “Jioni mtajua kwamba Bwana ndiye aliwatoa Misri,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bagateebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Mogoroba reero inwe nario moramanye ng’a Omonene nere obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri,

English: In the morning, you shall see Yahweh’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against Yahweh. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”
Kiswahili: kisha asubuhi mtauona utukufu wa Bwana, kwa sababu amesikia manungʼuniko yenu dhidi yake. Sisi ni nani hata mtunungʼunikie?”
Ekegusii: na mambia inamorore obonene bw’Omonene, ekiagera ere oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Ee, mwamwemurunganeirie Omonene, tari intwe. Intwe inki toisaine moratuemurunganerie?”

English: Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because Yahweh hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Pia Mose akasema, “Mtajua kuwa alikuwa Bwana wakati atakapowapa nyama mle ifikapo jioni na mikate yote mtakayohitaji asubuhi kwa sababu amesikia manungʼuniko yenu dhidi yake. Sisi ni nani? Hamnungʼuniki dhidi yetu, bali dhidi ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Naende Musa agateeba, “inwe buna morore obonene bw’Omonene ekero arabae chinyama morie mogoroba, na mambia abae omogati morie, moigote ekiagera ere oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Inki mokwemurunganeria ase tore? Intwe titoisaini gento. Tari intwe mwemurunganeirie, korende n’Omonene.”

English: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to Yahweh, for he has heard your murmurings.’”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Iambie jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli kwamba, ‘Mje mbele zake Bwana, kwa maana amesikia manungʼuniko yenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni, “Bateebie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli basuke gocha ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera oigure okwemurungania kwabo.”

English: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, Yahweh’s glory appeared in the cloud.
Kiswahili: Aroni alipokuwa akizungumza na jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli, wakatazama kuelekea jangwani, na huko wakaona utukufu wa Bwana ukitokeza katika wingu.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Aroni arenge gokwana nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, barabwo bakeonchora bakarigereria gochia ase erooro, bakarora obonene bw’Omonene bokooroka korwa ase riire.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am Yahweh your God.’”
Kiswahili: “Nimesikia manungʼuniko ya Waisraeli. Waambie, ‘Jioni mtakula nyama, na asubuhi mtashiba mikate. Ndipo mtajua ya kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Naigure okwemurungania kw’Abaisraeli. Kwana nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a engaki ya mogoroba mbaegwe enyama barie, na mambia inabarie omogati. Erio bamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.”

English: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
Kiswahili: Jioni ile kware wakaja wakaifunika kambi na asubuhi kulikuwa na tabaka la umande kuzunguka kambi.
Ekegusii: Mogoroba chinkware chigaacha, chigaichora ase batoorete, na mambia yaye aase onsi aetanaine aase aria akanyorwa atoorire riimi.

English: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.
Kiswahili: Wakati umande ulipoondoka, vipande vidogo vidogo kama theluji vilionekana juu ya uso wa jangwa.
Ekegusii: Na ekero riimi riakamokire, bakarora inse aria ase erooro ebinto binga buna amagoocho, bikarorekana buna obosie oborabu.

English: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which Yahweh has given you to eat.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walipoona, wakaambiana, “Hiki ni nini?” Kwa kuwa hawakujua kilikuwa kitu gani. Mose akawaambia, “Huu ndio mkate ambao Bwana amewapa mle.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabateebia, “Oria nomogati oy’Omonene abaeire morie.

English: This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo Bwana alivyoamuru: ‘Kila mmoja akusanye kiasi anachohitaji. Chukueni pishi moja kwa kila mtu mliye naye katika hema yenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ring’ana erio nario Omonene achigete: Sangereria endagera eyio, kera oyomo buna agwenerete, ebimunu bibere ase kera omonto. Kera omonto asangererie buna abwate abanto bang’ana ase eema yaye.”

English: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanya kama walivyoambiwa, baadhi yao wakakusanya zaidi, wengine pungufu.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora bo, bagasangereria abande enyinge, na abande enke.

English: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.
Kiswahili: Nao walipopima katika pishi, yule aliyekusanya zaidi hakuwa na ziada, wala aliyekusanya kidogo hakupungukiwa. Kila mmoja alikusanya kiasi alichohitaji.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero bayerengete ase ebirengo, oyosangereretie enyinge tatigaria kende, na ere oyosangereretie enke taremeretwe gento. Kera oyomo konya osangereirie buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana.

English: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akawaambia, “Mtu yeyote asibakize chochote mpaka asubuhi.”
Ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Monto onde tatigaria endagera ende goika mambia.”

English: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, wengine hawakuzingatia aliyosema Mose, wakahifadhi kiasi fulani mpaka asubuhi, lakini kile alichohifadhi kikajaa mabuu na kuanza kunuka. Kwa hiyo Mose akawakasirikia.
Ekegusii: Korende tibaigwera Musa; abande bagatigaria eyende goika rituko ria kabere, na mambia yaye bakayenyora yagundire na yasoirwe namakonde, na Musa akababea mono.

English: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.
Kiswahili: Kila asubuhi, kila mmoja alikusanya kiasi alichohitaji na jua lilipokuwa kali, iliyeyuka.
Ekegusii: Ase igo kera emambia bakaba bagosangereria kera oyomo buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana; korende ekero omobaso oyesambire, yanyititoka.

English: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
Kiswahili: Siku ya sita, wakakusanya mara mbili, kiasi cha pishi mbili kwa kila mtu, nao viongozi wa jumuiya wakaja kumwarifu Mose.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo baba bagosangereria endagera eria ekerengo ara kabere, ase kera omonto ebimunu bine. Abagaaka bonsi b’omoganda bakagenda goteebia Musa amang’ana ayio.

English: He said to them, “This is that which Yahweh has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to Yahweh. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia, “Hivi ndivyo alivyoagiza Bwana: ‘Kesho itakuwa siku ya mapumziko, Sabato takatifu kwa Bwana. Kwa hiyo okeni kile mnachotaka kuoka na mchemshe kile mnachotaka kuchemsha. Hifadhini chochote kinachobaki na mkiweke mpaka asubuhi.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Ring’ana erio nario Omonene konya atebiire: Ankio nerituko richenu ri’ogotimoka, Esabato Enchenu yaatananirwe ase Omonene. Mosambe eki moganetie gosamba, na moiyeke eki moganetie koiyeka, na ebiratigare mobigache goika ankio.”

English: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakavihifadhi mpaka asubuhi, kama Mose alivyoagiza, na havikunuka wala kuwa na mabuu.
Ekegusii: Na buna Musa abachigete bakagacha endagera eria yatigarete goika rituko ria kabere; ero tiyagunda etioke, gose tiyasogwa namakonde.

English: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to Yahweh. Today you shall not find it in the field.
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia, “Kuleni leo, kwa sababu leo ni Sabato kwa Bwana. Hamtapata chochote juu ya nchi leo.
Ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Karie eye reero, ekiagera reero n’Esabato yaatananirwe ase Omonene, ekiagera reero timokoyerora isiko ase erooro.

English: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”
Kiswahili: Kwa siku sita mtakusanya, lakini siku ya saba, yaani Sabato, hakutakuwepo chochote.”
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo mobe mokoyesangereria endagera eye, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, endagera eyio tegotoka.”

English: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, baadhi ya watu wakatoka kwenda kukusanya siku ya saba, lakini hawakupata chochote.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere abande ase abanto baria bakagenda koyesangereria, tibayenyora.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Je, mtaacha kushika maagizo na maelekezo yangu mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ngoika ririri morabe mokwanga ogotebereria kwane na amachiiko aane?

English: Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”
Kiswahili: Fahamuni kuwa Bwana amewapa ninyi Sabato, ndiyo sababu katika siku ya sita amewapa mikate ya siku mbili. Kila mmoja inampasa kukaa pale alipo katika siku ya saba. Hata mmoja haruhusiwi kutoka.”
Ekegusii: Inyora ng’a inche Omonene nabaeire Esabato. Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo nkobaa endagera y’amatuko abere. Ase ayio, ase rituko eri ria gatano na kabere mobeere kera omonto aase aye, onde tabaisa korua inka.”

English: So the people rested on the seventh day.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo watu wakapumzika siku ya saba.
Ekegusii: Naboigo abanto bakaba bagotimoka ase rituko ria gatano na kabere.

English: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Israeli wakaita ile mikate mana Ilikuwa myeupe kama mbegu za mtama na ladha yake ilikuwa kama mkate mwembamba uliotengenezwa kwa asali.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaroka endagera eyio mana; ero nigo yare buna chinyeke chi’amaemba enkomba, chindabu, na obwansu bwaye nigo bware buna omogati ore nobooke.

English: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
Kiswahili: Mose akasema, “Hivi ndivyo alivyoagiza Bwana: ‘Chukueni pishi ya mana na kuhifadhi kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo ili vione mikate niliyowapa mle jangwani nilipowatoa katika nchi ya Misri.’ ”
Ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Omonene otochikiire togache endagera eye inke ya Mana ase engencho ye chinderia chiaito, erinde banyare gocha korora endagera eye Omonene atoete torie ase erooro, ekero atorusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before Yahweh, to be kept throughout your generations.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Chukua gudulia na uweke pishi moja ya mana ndani yake. Kisha uweke mbele za Bwana ili kihifadhiwe kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo.”
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni, “Imokia ekeguuru, obeke ebimunu bibere bia mana imeo, oyebeke ase obosio bw’Omonene egachwe ase engencho y’ebigori bigochi‐gocha.”

English: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
Kiswahili: Kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose, hatimaye Aroni alikuja kuihifadhi ndani ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda.
Ekegusii: Buna Omonene achigete Musa, naboigo Aroni ayebegete bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, ekagachwao.

English: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakala mana kwa miaka arobaini, mpaka walipofika katika nchi iliyokaliwa na watu; walikula mana hadi walipofika mpakani mwa Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenderera koria mana engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika bagaika aase ense abanto bamenyete; ense yarenge orobebe rw’ense ya Kaanani.

English: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.
Kiswahili: (Pishi moja ni sehemu ya kumi ya kipimo cha efa.)
Ekegusii: (Ekerengo ki’ebimunu bibere ekio nensemo ya ikomi y’ekerengo gi’efa.)

English: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to Yahweh’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya yote ya Israeli ikaondoka kutoka Jangwa la Sini, ikisafiri kutoka sehemu moja hadi nyingine kama Bwana alivyoagiza. Wakapiga kambi huko Refidimu, lakini hapakuwa na maji ya watu kunywa.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okaimoka korwa erooro ya Sinai. Barabwo bakabwatia orogendo rwabo, bakana‐gotoora buna Omonene abachiigete, Bagaika Refidimu, bagatoora aroro, korende mache tarengeo abanto baare konyara konywa.

English: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test Yahweh?”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakagombana na Mose wakisema, “Tupe maji ya kunywa.” Mose akajibu, “Mbona mnagombana nami? Kwa nini mnamjaribu Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bakomania Musa, bagoteeba, “Toe amaache tonywe!” Musa akabateebia, “Nase ki mokonyomania? Nase ki mogoteema Omonene?.”

English: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”
Kiswahili: Lakini watu walikuwa na kiu huko, wakanungʼunika dhidi ya Mose, wakisema, “Kwa nini ulitutoa kule Misri, ukatuleta hapa utuue kwa kiu sisi, watoto wetu na mifugo yetu?”
Ekegusii: Agwo bakaba nerang’o enene y’amaache, bakemurunganeria Musa, bakaboora, “Ninki gwatoruseria Misiri gocha aa, amo nabana baito ne chitugo chiaito, togokwa ase erang’o?”

English: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamlilia Bwana, akasema, “Niwafanyie nini watu hawa? Sasa wanakaribia kunipiga kwa mawe.”
Ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, akabora, “Ninki ngokorera abanto aba? Barabwo nigo bare ang’e kong’aka amagena.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamjibu Mose, “Pita mbele ya watu. Wachukue pamoja nawe baadhi ya wazee wa Israeli, ichukue mkononi mwako ile fimbo uliyopiga nayo Mto Naili, nawe uende.
Ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Oete bosio bwa abanto aba, oire abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli, oire boigo nenyimbo yao, eria kwaagete orooche, motang’ane abanto mogende.

English: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
Kiswahili: Huko nitasimama mbele yako karibu na mwamba wa Horebu. Uupige mwamba na maji yatatoka ndani yake kwa ajili ya watu kunywa.” Kwa hiyo Mose akafanya haya mbele ya wazee wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nondore inteneine agwo ase egetare kia Horebu, nkoganyete. Oake egetare, na amaache arwe aroro, erinde abanto banyore banywe.” Musa agakora bo ase amasio ’abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.

English: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested Yahweh, saying, “Is Yahweh among us, or not?”
Kiswahili: Naye akapaita mahali pale Masa, na Meriba kwa sababu Waisraeli waligombana na kumjaribu Bwana wakisema, “Je, Bwana yu pamoja nasi au la?”
Ekegusii: Akaroka aase aria Masa na Meriba, ase engencho y’eriomana ri’Abaisraeli, naende ekiagera abanto bamoteemete Omonene, bakoboora, “Inee! Omonene nare aa ase egati yaito, gose taiyo?”

English: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
Kiswahili: Waamaleki wakaja na kuwashambulia Waisraeli huko Refidimu.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaameleki bakaoroka na korwania Abaisraeli aaria Refidimu.

English: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Yoshua, “Chagua baadhi ya watu wetu na uende kupigana na Waamaleki. Kesho nitasimama juu ya kilima nikiwa na fimbo ya Mungu mkononi mwangu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Yoshua, “Tochorere abanto bagende korwana n’Abaameleki ankio; inche ninche ’ntenene ekegoro igoro, na enyimbo ya Nyasae in’yebwate koboko kwane.”

English: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yoshua akapigana na Waamaleki kama Mose alivyomwagiza, nao Mose, Aroni na Huri wakapanda juu ya kilima.
Ekegusii: Yoshua agakora buna Musa amotebetie, akarwania Abaameleki, na Musa, na Aroni, na Huri bagatiira gochia ekegoro igoro.

English: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
Kiswahili: Ikawa wakati wote Mose alipokuwa amenyanyua mikono yake, Waisraeli walikuwa wakishinda, lakini kila aliposhusha mikono yake Waamaleki walishinda.
Ekegusii: Ekaba Musa kaimokirie amaboko aye igoro, rirorio Abaisraeli babua, na kayairanirie inse, Abaameleki babua.

English: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.
Kiswahili: Mikono ya Mose ilipochoka, wakachukua jiwe na kumpa alikalie. Aroni na Huri wakaishikilia juu mikono ya Mose, mmoja upande huu na mwingine upande huu. Wakaitegemeza mikono yake ikabaki thabiti mpaka jua lilipozama.
Ekegusii: Ekero amaboko a Musa arosire, Aroni na Huri bakaimokia rigena, bakaritereka inse, na Musa akariikaransera. Erio bakaba bagosiira amaboko a Musa, oyomo okoboko gwo korio, na oyonde ogwokobee. Naboigo bakamosiira goika erioba rikagwa.

English: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yoshua akalishinda jeshi la Waamaleki kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Na igo Yoshua akabua Abaameleki kegima, akabaita nemioro.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Andika mambo haya katika kitabu ili yakumbukwe, na uhakikishe kwamba Yoshua amesikia, kwa sababu nitafuta kabisa kumbukumbu la Amaleki chini ya mbingu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Yarike amang’ana aya ase egetabu, abe amang’ana ’okoinyorwa, oteebie Yoshua ng’a ninsirie Abaameleki erio bebwe kegima, tibaabaisa koinyorwa inse y’erioba.”

English: Moses built an altar, and called its name “Yahweh our Banner”.
Kiswahili: Mose akajenga madhabahu na kuiita Yehova Nisi.
Ekegusii: Musa akaagacha egesasiimero agwo, agakeroka “Yahwe Nisi”, engencho yaye, “Omonene nebendera yane y’esegi”,

English: He said, “Yah has sworn: ‘Yahweh will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”
Kiswahili: Mose akasema, “Kwa maana mikono iliinuliwa mpaka kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Bwana. Bwana atakuwa na vita dhidi ya Waamaleki kutoka kizazi hata kizazi.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Ninyimokie okoboko kwane igoro, kobe ekemanyererio ki’Omonene, na gotiana ng’a Omonene nigo aragenderere korwania Abaameleki ebiaare ase ebiaare.”

English: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how Yahweh had brought Israel out of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Basi Yethro, kuhani wa Midiani, baba mkwe wa Mose, akawa amesikia kila kitu Mungu alichomfanyia Mose na watu wake wa Israeli, pia jinsi Bwana alivyowatoa Israeli Misri.
Ekegusii: Jethiro, Omokuani o Midiani, ise biara Musa, akaigwa amang’ana onsi aya Nyasae akorerete Musa na Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na buna abang’anyetie korwa Misiri.

English: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,
Kiswahili: Baada ya Mose kumrudisha mkewe Sipora, Yethro baba mkwe wake alimpokea
Ekegusii: Jethiro akaretana Sipora moka Musa ekiagera Musa konya omoiranirie ase ise.

English: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.
Kiswahili: pamoja na wanawe wawili. Jina la mmoja aliitwa Gershomu, kwa kuwa Mose alisema, “Nimekuwa mgeni katika nchi ya kigeni.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo akarentana Gerisomu na Eliezeri, abana abamura babere ba Musa. (Musa nigo ateebete, “Nabeire omomenyi ase ense engeni”), na akaroka omwana oyomo Gerisomu.

English: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”
Kiswahili: Mwingine aliitwa Eliezeri, kwa kuwa alisema, “Mungu wa baba yangu alikuwa msaada wangu, akaniokoa kutoka upanga wa Farao.”
Ekegusii: Boigo akaroka omwana oye okabere Eliezeri agateeba, “Nyasae o tata obeire omokonyi one, agantooria korwa ase ogoita gwa Farao”.

English: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.
Kiswahili: Yethro, baba mkwe wa Mose, pamoja na wana wawili wa Mose na mkewe, wakamjia Mose huko jangwani, mahali alipokuwa amepiga kambi karibu na mlima wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabo Jethiro, ise biara Musa, amo na moka Musa na abana baye babere, bagacha ase erooro aase Musa konya atoorire ase egetunwa kia Nyasae.

English: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”
Kiswahili: Yethro alikuwa ametuma ujumbe kwake Mose, kusema, “Mimi Yethro baba mkwe wako ninakuja kwako pamoja na mke wako na wanao wawili.”
Ekegusii: Konya otomire amang’ana ase Musa buna ngocha are aretane moka Musa nabana baye babere.

English: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akatoka kumlaki baba mkwe wake, akainama na kumbusu. Wakasalimiana, kisha wakaingia hemani.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agasoka komoorotota, agatung’ama na komonyunyunta. Ekero bakwananirie bagasoa ase eema.

English: Moses told his father-in-law all that Yahweh had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how Yahweh delivered them.
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia baba mkwe wake kuhusu kila kitu Bwana alichomfanyia Farao na Wamisri kwa ajili ya Israeli, na pia kuhusu shida zote walizokutana nazo njiani na jinsi Bwana alivyowaokoa.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia ise biara aya onsi Omonene akorerete Farao amo n’Abamisiri ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, na obokong’u bwonsi obwo banyorete inchera, naende buna Omonene abatooretie.

English: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahweh had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
Kiswahili: Yethro akafurahishwa sana kusikia juu ya mambo yote mazuri Bwana aliyowatendea Waisraeli kuwaokoa kutoka mkono wa Wamisri.
Ekegusii: Ekero Jethiro aigwete amaya onsi Nyasae akorerete Abaisraeli ase okobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri akagoka mono,

English: Jethro said, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
Kiswahili: Yethro akasema, “Sifa na ziwe kwa Bwana, aliyekuokoa wewe kutoka mikononi mwa Wamisri na Farao, na aliyewaokoa watu kutoka mikononi mwa Wamisri.
Ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene atogigwe, oyo obatooretie abanto baye korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri, na korwa ase Farao.

English: Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
Kiswahili: Sasa najua ya kuwa Bwana ni mkuu kuliko miungu mingine yote, kwa kuwa amewatendea hivi wale waliowatenda Israeli kwa ujeuri.”
Ekegusii: Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nomonene kobua chinyasae chinde chionsi, ekiagera atooririe abanto baye korwa ase Abamisiri abwo baabaenenerete.”

English: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yethro, baba mkwe wa Mose, akaleta sadaka ya kuteketezwa na dhabihu nyingine kwa Mungu, naye Aroni pamoja na wazee wote wa Israeli wakaja kula chakula pamoja na baba mkwe wa Mose mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio Jethiro ise biara Musa akamoruera Nyasae ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde bi’okonyenywa. Aroni amo nabagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha bakaragera amo nere, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata, Mose akachukua nafasi yake kama hakimu wa watu, nao wakasimama kumzunguka kuanzia asubuhi hadi jioni.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Musa agaikaransa kogamba ebiina bi’abaanto; na abanto nigo barengeo bamoetanaine korwa mambia goika mogoroba.

English: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”
Kiswahili: Baba mkwe wake alipoona yote Mose anayowafanyia watu, akasema, “Ni nini hiki unachowafanyia watu? Kwa nini wewe unakuwa mwamuzi wa watu hawa peke yako, wakati watu hawa wamesimama wakikuzunguka tangu asubuhi mpaka jioni?”
Ekegusii: Ekero ise biara Musa aroche onsi aya Musa are gokorera abanto, akamobooria. “Inki eke ogokorera abanto? Naki oikaransete aye bweka, na abanto bagoetanaine korwa mambia goika mogoroba?”

English: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
Kiswahili: Mose akamjibu, “Kwa sababu watu wananijia kutaka mapenzi ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria ise biara, “Nekiagera abanto bagonchichera, bakorigia oboraai bwa Nyasae.

English: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”
Kiswahili: Kila wakiwa na shauri huletwa kwangu, nami huamua kati ya mtu na mwenzake na kuwajulisha juu ya amri na sheria za Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero bomanire nigo bagocha ase ’nde, na inche nabagambera ebiina biabo na kobamanyia emeroberio ya Nyasae na amachiiko aye.”

English: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.
Kiswahili: Baba mkwe wa Mose akamjibu, “Unachofanya sio kizuri.
Ekegusii: Erio Jethiro agateebia Musa, “Enchera eye y’okobagambera ebiina biabo teri engiya.

English: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.
Kiswahili: Wewe pamoja na watu hawa wanaokujia mtajichosha bure. Kazi ni nzito sana kwako, huwezi kuibeba mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Nigo okorosigwa, aye amo nabaanto aba bonsi bare aa. Naki emeremo eye nemerito mono asore, tokonyara koyekora aye bweka.

English: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.
Kiswahili: Sasa nisikilize mimi, nitakupa shauri, naye Mungu na awe pamoja nawe. Yapasa wewe uwe mwakilishi wa watu mbele za Mungu na ulete mashauri yao kwake.
Ekegusii: Bono ntegerera, ngoteebie chisemi chingiya orakore, na Nyasae nabe amo naye. Aye kabe oyo ogotenenera abanto ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na komoirera amang’ana abo.

English: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.
Kiswahili: Uwafundishe amri na sheria, tena uwaonyeshe namna ya kuishi na kazi zinazowapasa wao kufanya.
Ekegusii: Goika oborokererie amachiiko na emeroberio, na obateebererie buna ebagwenerete babe na gokora.

English: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
Kiswahili: Lakini uchague watu wenye uwezo miongoni mwa watu wote, watu wanaomwogopa Mungu, watu waaminifu wanaochukia mali ya dhuluma, uwateuwe wawe maafisa juu ya maelfu, mamia, hamsini na makumi.
Ekegusii: Korende ochore abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, abegenwa, abatakorigia riaaki, abaranyare koba abaraai b’abaanto b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.

English: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.
Kiswahili: Waweke wawe waamuzi wa watu kwa wakati wote, lakini waambie wakuletee kila shauri lililo gumu; yale yaliyo rahisi wayaamue wao wenyewe. Hii itafanya mzigo wako kuwa mwepesi, kwa sababu watashirikiana nawe.
Ekegusii: Otige barabwo babe bakogambera abanto ebiina bia botambe. Ebiina ebikong’u birobio bakobirentere, korende ebire ebike babigambe barabwo boka. Ase enchera eyio egurube yao tekoba endito mono, ekiagera barabwo mbayebogorie amo naye.

English: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”
Kiswahili: Kama ukifanya hivi, na ikiwa Mungu ameagiza hivyo, utaweza kushinda uchovu, nao watu hawa wote watarudi nyumbani wameridhika.”
Ekegusii: Korakore igo, buna Nyasae aragochiikere, aye nonyore chinguru chi’okogenderera, na abanto aba bonsi ’nabagende chinka chiabo bare nomorembe.”

English: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
Kiswahili: Mose akamsikiliza baba mkwe wake na kufanya kila kitu alichosema.
Ekegusii: Musa agancha amang’ana aya ise biara amosemetie.

English: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
Kiswahili: Mose akawachagua watu wenye uwezo kutoka Israeli yote, akawafanya kuwa viongozi wa watu, maafisa juu ya maelfu, mamia, hamsini na makumi.
Ekegusii: Agachora abanto b’Abaisraeli abaranyare gokora emeremo eyio, akababeeka babe abaraai b’Abaisraeli, b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.

English: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
Kiswahili: Wakatumika kama waamuzi wa watu kwa wakati wote. Mashauri magumu wakayaleta kwa Mose, lakini yale yaliyo rahisi wakayaamua wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakogamba ebiina bi’abaanto botambe. Ebiina ebikong’u baba bakobirentera Musa, korende ebire ebike baba bakobigamba abanyene.

English: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akaagana na Yethro baba mkwe wake, naye akarudi kwa nchi yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agakooba ise biara, akamotiga okogenda ase ense yaye.

English: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
Kiswahili: Mnamo mwezi wa tatu baada ya Waisraeli kuondoka Misri, siku kama iyo hiyo, wakafika katika Jangwa la Sinai.
Ekegusii: Rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatato magega Abaisraeli kobarure ase ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai.

English: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuondoka Refidimu, waliingia katika Jangwa la Sinai na Israeli wakapiga kambi pale jangwani mbele ya mlima.
Ekegusii: Bakamanora korwa Refidimu, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora kororia egetunwa gia Sinai.

English: Moses went up to God, and Yahweh called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akakwea kwenda kwa Mungu, naye Bwana akamwita kutoka kwenye ule mlima akasema, “Hivi ndivyo utakavyosema na nyumba ya Yakobo na utakachowaambia watu wa Israeli:
Ekegusii: Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro koumerana na Nyasae. Omonene akamorangeria agwo ase egetunwa, akamoteebia, “Amang’ana aya naro orateebie abanto b’egesaku kia Yakobo, baria Abaisraeli:

English: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.
Kiswahili: ‘Ninyi wenyewe mmeona nililofanya huko Misri, jinsi nilivyowabeba kwenye mbawa za tai na kuwaleta kwangu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwarorire aya nakoreire Abamisiri, na buna nababogoretie inwe buna ekeongo ekobogoria amage aye ase chimbaaba chiaye, nabarentire aiga ase ’nde.

English: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;
Kiswahili: Sasa kama mkinitii kikamilifu na kutunza Agano langu, basi ninyi mtakuwa mali yangu ya thamani kubwa miongoni mwa mataifa yote. Ijapokuwa dunia yote ni mali yangu,
Ekegusii: Bono komoranyigwere na kobwata okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, rirorio inamobe abanto baane. Naki ense yonsi neyane, korende inwe inamobe abanto baane abachore kobua abanto b’ebisaku binde.

English: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”
Kiswahili: ninyi mtakuwa kwangu ufalme wa makuhani na taifa takatifu.’ Haya ndiyo maneno utakayosema kwa wana wa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Inwe inamobe oborwoti bwane, abanto bagonkorera buna abakuani, egesaku kiane egechenu. Amang’ana aya naro orateebie Abaisraeli.”

English: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Yahweh commanded him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akarudi, akawaita wazee wa watu na kuwaambia maneno yote ambayo Bwana alikuwa amemwamuru ayaseme.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akagenda akarangeria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli amo, akabateebia amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene amochigeete.

English: All the people answered together, and said, “All that Yahweh has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakajibu kwa pamoja, “Tutafanya kila kitu Bwana alichokisema.” Naye Mose akarudisha majibu yao kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi amo bakairaneria, bakaboora, “Ayio onsi Omonene atebiire, inatoyakore.” Musa nere akairera Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nitakujia katika wingu zito, ili watu wanisikie nikinena nawe na kila mara waweke tumaini lao kwako.” Kisha Mose akamwambia Bwana yale ambayo watu walikuwa wamesema.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ninchiche asore inde ase riire ririto ime, erio abanto aba baigwe kongokwana naye, na barabwo bakwegene botambe.” Erio Musa agateebia Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nenda kwa watu ukawaweke wakfu leo na kesho. Waambie wafue nguo zao
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda ase abanto aba, obachene reero na ankio, naende obateebie basibie chianga chiabo,

English: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day Yahweh will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.
Kiswahili: na wawe tayari siku ya tatu, kwa sababu siku hiyo, Bwana atashuka juu ya mlima Sinai machoni pa watu wote.
Ekegusii: bebeke ang’e goika mambia ende ekiagera ase rituko erio ria gatato, inche Omonene ning’ike ase egetunwa gia Sinai, agwo ase abanto bonsi barandore.

English: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.
Kiswahili: Weka mipaka kuzunguka mlima kwa ajili ya watu, uwaambie, ‘Mwe waangalifu, msije mkapanda mlimani au kuugusa. Yeyote atakayeugusa mlima hakika atauawa.
Ekegusii: Aye goika obekere abanto aba orobebe roetanane egetunwa eke, obateebie: Mwerende, timotiira ase egetunwa igoro, gose timokuna chinsinyo chiaye. Onde bwensi oragekune nigo araitwe akwe.

English: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”
Kiswahili: Hakika atapigwa mawe au kupigwa mishale; mkono wa mtu hautamgusa. Akiwa mwanadamu au mnyama, hataruhusiwa kuishi.’ Ila tu wakati baragumu itakapopigwa kwa mfululizo, ndipo watu wote watakapopanda mlimani.”
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw’omonto onde tigokuna omonto orakore ayio, korende nigo araakwe amagena gose araswe nemegwe. Aya achikirwe ase Mwanyabaanto na ase ching’iti, korende ekero egetureeri kerabugigwe, erio nario abanto baratiire gocha ase egetunwa.”

English: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Mose kushuka kutoka mlimani akawaendea watu na kuwaweka wakfu, wakafua nguo zao.
Ekegusii: Musa agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gochia ase abanto, akabachena, na barabwo bagasibia chianga chiabo.

English: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia watu, “Jitayarisheni kwa ajili ya siku ya tatu. Mwanaume yeyote asimkaribie mwanamke.”
Ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Mwebeke ang’e, na goika rituko ria gatato, timobaisa goika abakungu baino ang’e.”

English: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi ya siku ya tatu kulikuwa na ngurumo na radi pamoja na wingu nene juu ya mlima na mlio mkubwa sana wa tarumbeta. Kila mmoja aliyekuwa kambini akatetemeka.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato ekero kia mambia bikaba enkoba na okomesa, ne riire ririto rigaika ase egetunwa, na eriogi ri’egetureeri rikooga mono. Abanto bonsi ase egetwori bakaondoka na koiguswa.

English: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akawaongoza watu kutoka kambini kukutana na Mungu, nao wakasimama chini ya mlima.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agatang’ana abanto korwa ase egetwori bachie koumerana na Nyasae. Barabwo bagatenena ase egetunwa mbarabare.

English: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.
Kiswahili: Mlima Sinai ulikuwa umefunikwa na moshi, kwa sababu Bwana alishuka juu yake katika moto. Moshi wa moto huo ulipanda juu kama moshi kutoka kwenye tanuru kubwa na mlima wote ukatetemeka kwa nguvu nyingi,
Ekegusii: Egetunwa gionsi gia Sinai kegatubwa nerioki, ekiagera Omonene aigete aroro ore ase omorero ime; na erioki rigachongororoka gochia igoro buna eri’eriko rinene ri’oboturi, na egetunwa ekegima gekanyegerigwa mono.

English: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
Kiswahili: nayo sauti ya tarumbeta ikawa kubwa zaidi na zaidi. Kisha Mose akazungumza na sauti ya Bwana ikamjibu.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’egetureeri rikagenderera kwoga mono kobua. Musa agakwana, na Nyasae akamoiraneria nogoaka gw’enkoba.

English: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
Kiswahili: Bwana akashuka juu ya Mlima Sinai na akamwita Mose apande juu mlimani. Kwa hiyo Mose akapanda juu,
Ekegusii: Omonene agaika ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Sinai, akarangeria Musa agende asare, na Musa agatiira gochiao.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.
Kiswahili: naye Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Shuka ukawaonye watu ili wasijipenyeze kutafuta kumwona Bwana na wengi wao wakafa.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tirimboka gochia inse ase abanto, obakuurere tibatamboka orobebe bache kondora. Baise gokora igo, abange babo mbakwe.

English: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them.”
Kiswahili: Hata makuhani, watakaomkaribia Bwana ni lazima wajiweke wakfu, la sivyo Bwana atawaadhibu.”
Ekegusii: Na abakuani barabwo kobagocha ase ’nde, inche Omonene, goika bechene, timbaisa kobaa egesusuro.”

English: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Watu hawawezi kupanda mlima Sinai kwa sababu wewe mwenyewe ulituonya ukisema, ‘Wekeni mipaka kuuzunguka mlima na kuutenga kama patakatifu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Abanto aba tibakonyara gotiira gocha aa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ekiagera aye omonyene ngwatokania, ogatoteebia: Beka orobebe roetanane egetunwa, na ogiatanane kebe egechenu.”

English: Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to Yahweh, lest he break out against them.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akajibu, “Shuka ukamlete Aroni pamoja nawe. Lakini makuhani pamoja na watu wasije wakalazimisha kuja kwa Bwana, nisije nikawaadhibu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Tirimboka gochia inse, orente Aroni, motiire nere gocha aa. Korende abakuani na abanto tibaabaisa gotamboka orobebe gocha aa ase ’nde, mbaise kobaa egesusuro.”

English: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.
Kiswahili: Basi Mose akashuka kwa watu na kuwaambia lile aliloambiwa.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agatirimboka gochia ase abanto, akabateebia amang’ana ayio.

English: God spoke all these words, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akasema maneno haya yote:
Ekegusii: Nyasae agakwana amang’ana aya onsi, agateeba,

English: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako, niliyekutoa Misri, kutoka nchi ya utumwa.
Ekegusii: “Inche ninche Nyasae Omonene, oyokorusetie ase ense ya Misiri, ase ense y’obosomba.

English: “You shall have no other gods before me.
Kiswahili: Usiwe na miungu mingine ila mimi.
Ekegusii: “Toba ne chinyasae chinde otatiga inche.

English: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
Kiswahili: Usijitengenezee sanamu katika umbo la kitu chochote kilicho juu mbinguni, au duniani chini, au ndani ya maji.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gwekorera omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, omogwekano o getongwa kende gionsi kere igoro, gose kere ense, gose kere ime ase amaache inse y’ense.

English: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,
Kiswahili: Usivisujudie wala kuviabudu; kwa kuwa Mimi, Bwana Mungu wako, ni Mungu mwenye wivu, ninayewaadhibu watoto kwa ajili ya dhambi za baba zao hadi kizazi cha tatu na cha nne cha wanichukiao,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotugama gose gosasiima emegwekano ekorire, ekiagera inche ninche Nyasae Omonene, Nyasae bwe risemi. Ase engencho y’amabe yabaibori nigo nkoa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane, abwo bangechete.

English: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
Kiswahili: lakini ninaonyesha upendo kwa maelfu ya vizazi vya wale wanipendao na kuzishika amri zangu.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo nkoborokia obwanchani bwane botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu, ase abwo banyanchete na babwatete amachiiko aane.

English: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
Kiswahili: Usilitaje bure jina la Bwana Mungu wako, kwa kuwa Bwana hataacha kumhesabia hatia yeye alitajaye jina lake bure.
Ekegusii: “Toriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta ria Nyasae Omonene, ekiagera Omonene tagotiga komoa egesusuro omonto oria okoriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta riaye.

English: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
Kiswahili: Ikumbuke siku ya Sabato, uitakase.
Ekegusii: “Riinyore na korisika rituko ri’Esabato, orirende ribe richenu.

English: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,
Kiswahili: Kwa siku sita utafanya kazi na kutenda shughuli zako zote,
Ekegusii: Amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao yonsi,

English: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;
Kiswahili: lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato kwa Bwana Mungu wako. Siku hiyo hutafanya kazi yoyote, wewe, wala mwanao au binti yako, wala mtumishi wako wa kiume au wa kike, wala wanyama wako, wala mgeni aliye ndani ya malango yako.
Ekegusii: korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nerituko ri’Esabato, riatananetwe na Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye, gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya nomosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose chitugo chiao, gose omomenyi ore ase omochie oo.

English: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kwa siku sita, Bwana aliumba mbingu na nchi, bahari na vyote vilivyomo, lakini akapumzika siku ya saba. Kwa hiyo Bwana akaibariki siku ya Sabato na kuifanya takatifu.
Ekegusii: Naki ase amatuko atano na rimo nar’Omonene atongete igoro na ense, ne chinyancha, na bionsi ebire imeo; agatimoka ase rituko ria gatano na kabere. Ase ayio Omonene agasesenia rituko ri’Esabato, akariatanana ribe richenu.

English: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
Kiswahili: Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako, ili upate kuishi siku nyingi katika nchi anayokupa Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: “Sika iso na nyoko, nario oramenye amatuko amange ase ense eye Omonene, are ang’e gokoa.

English: “You shall not murder.
Kiswahili: Usiue.
Ekegusii: “Toita.

English: “You shall not commit adultery.
Kiswahili: Usizini.
Ekegusii: “Totomana.

English: “You shall not steal.
Kiswahili: Usiibe.
Ekegusii: “Toiba.

English: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
Kiswahili: Usimshuhudie jirani yako uongo.
Ekegusii: “Tomotebera omogisangio oo oborimo.

English: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”
Kiswahili: Usiitamani nyumba ya jirani yako. Usimtamani mke wa jirani yako, wala mtumishi wake wa kiume au wa kike, wala ngʼombe wake au punda wake, wala chochote kile alicho nacho jirani yako.”
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa kogania enyomba y’omoamate oo. Tobaisa kogania omokungu bw’omoamate oo, nonya nomosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yaye, gose etigere yaye, gose kende gionsi omoamate oo abwate.”

English: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.
Kiswahili: Watu walipoona ngurumo na radi, na kusikia mlio wa tarumbeta, na kuuona mlima katika moshi, walitetemeka kwa woga. Wakasimama mbali
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi barooche okomesa, na koigwa enkoba na eriogi ri’egetureeri na korora egetunwa gekoimoka erioki, bakaiguswa, bagatenenera aare.

English: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
Kiswahili: na wakamwambia Mose, “Sema nasi wewe mwenyewe, nasi tutakusikiliza. Lakini usimwache Mungu aseme nasi, la sivyo tutakufa.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebia Musa, “Kwana naintwe aye omonyene, na intwe inatogotegerere, korende Nyasae takwana naitwe ekiagera ogokwana naintwe, nigo torakwe.”

English: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia watu, “Msiogope! Mungu amekuja kuwajaribu, ili kwamba hofu ya Mungu iwakalie, msitende dhambi.”
Ekegusii: Musa akabairaneria, “Timoondoka! Naki Nyasae nigo achire kobateema inwe, erio egere mogenderere komoiroka, erinde timokora ebibe.”

English: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
Kiswahili: Watu wakabaki mbali, wakati Mose alipolisogelea lile giza nene mahali pale Mungu alipokuwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagatenena aare, korende Musa ere akagenda ang’e ase riire riria rimwamu, ase Nyasae arenge.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Waambie Waisraeli hivi: ‘Mmejionea wenyewe kwamba nimesema nanyi kutoka mbinguni:
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Amang’ana aya naro orateebie Abaisraeli: Inwe abanyene mwarorire ng’a nigo nakwanire nainwe korwa igoro.

English: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.
Kiswahili: Msijifanyizie miungu yoyote na kuilinganisha nami, msijitengenezee miungu ya fedha wala miungu ya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Timwekorera chinyasae chinde chi’echifeta gose echie chitaabu chi’ogosasimwa; monsasime inche bweka.

English: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Utanitengenezea madhabahu ya udongo, na juu yake utoe sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto na sadaka za amani, kondoo zako, mbuzi na ngʼombe zako. Popote nitakapofanya Jina langu liheshimiwe, nitakuja kwenu na kuwabariki.
Ekegusii: Ong’agachere egesasiimero ki’amaroba, onduere ebing’wanso igoro yaye, ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, korwa ase ching’ondi chiao, ne chiombe chiao. Kera aase ndatebe onsasimere, ninchiche asore, ngosesenie.

English: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unanitengenezea madhabahu ya mawe, usiijenge kwa mawe ya kuchonga, maana mkitumia chombo cha kuchongea mtaitia unajisi.
Ekegusii: Onye gokong’agachera egesasiimero ki’amagena, tokeagacha namagena abaachire; ekiagera onye gokoyabaacha nebikorero biao, rirorio kwayabekire riko.

English: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’
Kiswahili: Msitumie ngazi kupandia kwenye madhabahu yangu, uchi wako usije ukadhihirika kwa chini.’
Ekegusii: Naende totiirera ebiriinero igoro, gokogenda ase egesasiimero, egetirianda kiao tikebaisa kooroka.”

English: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:
Kiswahili: “Hizi ndizo sheria utakazoweka mbele ya Waisraeli:
Ekegusii: “Aya naro amachiiko orae Abaisraeli.”

English: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
Kiswahili: “Kama ukimnunua mtumwa wa Kiebrania, atakutumikia kwa miaka sita. Lakini katika mwaka wa saba, atakuwa huru naye atakwenda zake pasipo kulipa chochote.
Ekegusii: Koragore omosomba Omoiberania, nigo aragokorere ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo, korende omwaka o gatano na kabere mosibore agende ko tomoakana kende.

English: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
Kiswahili: Kama akija peke yake, atakwenda huru peke yake, lakini kama akija na mke, ataondoka pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Onye ochete bwoo tarenge na mokungu, rirorio nabo aragende bweka, korende onye orenge nomokuungu, omokungu oye nigo aragende amo nere.

English: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
Kiswahili: Kama bwana wake alimpatia mke naye akamzalia wana au binti, mwanamke pamoja na watoto wake watakuwa mali ya bwana wake na huyo mwanaume ataondoka peke yake.
Ekegusii: Onye omonene oye omonyuomeretie omokungu, na ere omoiboreire abana, abamura gose abaiseke, omokungu oria na abana baye nigo barabe enibo y’omonene oye; omosacha oria nigo ararueo ere bweka,

English: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
Kiswahili: “Lakini kama mtumishi akisema, ‘Ninampenda bwana wangu, mke wangu pamoja na watoto na sitaki kuwa huru,’
Ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria karatebe: Nimwanchete omonene one amo na mokane, na abana baane, tinganeti korua ase obosomba bwane,

English: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.
Kiswahili: ndipo bwana wake atakapolazimika kumpeleka mbele ya waamuzi. Kisha atampeleka kwenye mlango au kizingiti na kutoboa sikio lake kwa shazia. Naye atamtumikia bwana wake maisha yake yote.
Ekegusii: erio omonene oye amorente ase obosio bwa Nyasae, amoikie ase egesieri gose ase emetobwa ya gesieri na amotue ogoto kwaye n’esindake. Erio omonto oria abe omosomba oye ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akimuuza binti yake kuwa mtumwa, hataachwa huru kama watumwa wa kiume waachiwavyo.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karaoonie omwana oye omoiseke koba omosomba, omoiseke oyio tagosiborwa buna abasomba abamura barasiborwe.

English: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
Kiswahili: Kama hakumpendeza bwana wake aliyemchagua, huyo bwana atamwacha akombolewe. Hatakuwa na haki ya kumuuza kwa wageni, kwa sababu huyo bwana atakuwa amekosa uaminifu.
Ekegusii: Onye omoiseke oyio tagwenereti omonene oye, oyorengereretie komokora abe mokaye, rirorio nigo araboorigwe airane. Omonene oye takoba ne ribaga komoonia ase egesaku ekegeni, ekiagera among’ainete.

English: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.
Kiswahili: Kama akimchagua aolewe na mwanawe, ni lazima ampe haki za kuwa binti yake.
Ekegusii: Onye okomoa omomura oye abe mokaye, rirorio amwanche buna omwana oye omoiseke.

English: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa huyo mwana aliyeozwa mtumwa mwanamke ataoa mwanamke mwingine, ni lazima aendelee kumtosheleza huyo mke wa kwanza kwa chakula, mavazi na haki zote za ndoa.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio okonyuoma omokungu o kabere, takorina oria omotang’ani endagera yaye, ne chianga chiaye na kende gionsi aganetie buna mokaye.

English: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.
Kiswahili: Iwapo hatamtosheleza kwa mambo hayo matatu, huyo mke wa kwanza ataondoka na kuwa huru bila malipo yoyote ya fedha.
Ekegusii: Atamokorereti amang’ana aya atato, goika aegwe ribaga arue bwoye ataakaneiri embooria.”

English: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
Kiswahili: “Yeyote ampigaye mtu na kumuua ni lazima auawe hakika.
Ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi oraake omonto na amoite akwe, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kama hakumuua kwa makusudi, lakini Mungu akaruhusu itendeke, basi atakimbilia mahali nitakapomchagulia.
Ekegusii: Korende onye tamong’erete otatiga Nyasae omobegete ase amaboko aye, erio ninkworokie aase omoiti oria aratamere.

English: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mtu akipanga na kumuua mwingine kwa makusudi, mwondoe katika madhabahu yangu na kumuua.
Ekegusii: Korende omonto ogoita oyomwabo mweno ase obong’ainereria, ere goika aitwe akwe, naisa gotamera egesasiimero kiane.

English: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote amshambuliaye baba yake au mama yake ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraake ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote amtekaye nyara mwingine akamuuza au akamweka kwake, akikamatwa ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraibe omonto goika aitwe akwe, karabe omoonirie gose omobwate ase amaboko aye.

English: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote atakayemlaani baba yake au mama yake ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraragererie ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.”

English: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;
Kiswahili: “Kama watu wakigombana na mmoja akimpiga mwingine kwa jiwe au kwa ngumi yake na hakufa bali akaugua na kulala kitandani,
Ekegusii: “Abanto babere kobarabe bakorwana, na oyomo aake oyonde rigena, gose enkundi, amoate chingoma, echio chiramokore omorwaire goika araare borere,

English: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.
Kiswahili: yule aliyempiga ngumi hatahesabiwa kuwa na hatia kama mwenzake ataamka na kujikongoja kwa fimbo yake, lakini hata hivyo, ni lazima amlipe fidia ya muda wake aliopoteza na awajibike mpaka apone kabisa.
Ekegusii: karabe otimokire, naende asoke isiko gotaara ogwesiirera enyimbo, rirorio oria omoagete nigo aratigwe, otatiga amoakane ase engencho y’eng’eria eria asiririe ekero arwarete, na ere amorende goika agwene kegima.

English: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akimpiga mtumwa wake wa kiume au wa kike kwa fimbo na mtumwa huyo akafa papo hapo, ni lazima aadhibiwe
Ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, nenyimbo, erinde akwere ase amaboko aye, goika aegwe egesusuro.

English: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.
Kiswahili: lakini ikiwa mtumwa ataamka baada ya siku moja au mbili, hataadhibiwa, kwa sababu yule mtumwa ni mali yake.
Ekegusii: Korende omosomba oyio karagenderere koba moyo rituko erimo gose abere, omonto oyio takoegwa egesusuro, ekiagera omosomba oyio nenibo yaye.

English: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa watu wawili wanapigana na wakamuumiza mwanamke mjamzito, naye akazaa kabla ya wakati lakini hakuna majeraha makubwa, mhalifu atatozwa mali kiasi cha madai ya mume wa yule mwanamke, na jinsi mahakama itakavyoamua.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abasacha kobarabe bakorwana, na kogwera omokungu ore morito, na oborito bwaye bogwe, korende atabeti na bobe bonde, omonto oria omogwerete goika aakane buna omosacha bw’omokuungu oria araborie magega abagaambi kobanachire ekiina.

English: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
Kiswahili: Lakini kukiwa na jeraha kubwa, ni lazima ulipe uhai kwa uhai,
Ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria karakwe, rirorio egesusuro kebe obogima ase obogima,

English: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
Kiswahili: jicho kwa jicho, jino kwa jino, mkono kwa mkono, mguu kwa mguu,
Ekegusii: eriso ase eriso, na erino ase erino, okoboko ase okoboko, na okogoro ase okogoro,

English: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.
Kiswahili: kuchomwa moto kwa kuchomwa moto, jeraha kwa jeraha, mchubuko kwa mchubuko.
Ekegusii: ogosambwa ase ogosambwa, na eriote ase eriote, naende ogosionorwa ase ogosionorwa.

English: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa mtu atampiga mtumwa mwanaume au mwanamke kwenye jicho na kuliharibu, ni lazima amwache huru yule mtumwa kama fidia ya hilo jicho.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, na komwata eriso, rirorio goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’eriso riaye.

English: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.
Kiswahili: Kama akimvunja jino mtumwa wa kiume au wa kike, ni lazima amwache huru huyo mtumwa kwa kufidia hilo jino.
Ekegusii: Naende Karamoake omosomba oye omomura gose omoiseke amogookore erino, goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’erino riaye.”

English: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.
Kiswahili: “Kama fahali akimuua mwanaume au mwanamke kwa kumpiga kwa pembe, fahali huyo ni lazima auawe kwa kupigwa mawe, na nyama yake haitaliwa. Lakini mwenye fahali huyo hatawajibika.
