Ekegusii: “Eeri eise goita omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, ne ching’unchara chiaye, goika eakwe amagena ekwe, ne chinyama chiaye tichiriegwa; korende omonyene eng’ombe eyio taegwa egesusuro.

English: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata hivyo, ikiwa huyo fahali amekuwa na tabia ya kupiga kwa pembe, na mwenyewe ameonywa na hakutaka kumfungia naye akamuua mwanaume au mwanamke, huyo fahali ni lazima auawe kwa mawe na mwenye fahali pia auawe.
Ekegusii: Korende eeri eyio, onye enarete goita abanto, na omonyene eeri eyio okuureirwe, na ere tayesibeti, ero keraite omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, nigo eraakwe amagena ekwe, na omonyene nere aitwe akwe.

English: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa malipo yatatakiwa kwake, basi anaweza kulipa kinachodaiwa ili kuukomboa uhai wake.
Ekegusii: Onye embooria ekoborigwa korwa asare, goika arue chionsi echi chiraganigwe, chibe embooria ase obogima bwaye.

English: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
Kiswahili: Sheria hii pia itatumika ikiwa fahali atampiga kwa pembe mwana au binti.
Ekegusii: Onye eng’ombe egoita omomura gose omoiseke ne ching’unchara chiaye, ogochika nakwo okwo okomo.

English: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa fahali atampiga mtumwa wa kike au wa kiume, mwenye fahali atalipa shekeli thelathini za fedha kwa bwana mwenye mtumwa, na fahali ni lazima auawe kwa mawe.
Ekegusii: Onye eeri egoita omosomba, omomura gose omoiseke, omonyene eng’ombe nigo araakane omonyene omosomba oria chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etato, na eeri eria eitwe ase ogoakwa amagena.

English: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akiacha shimo wazi, ama akachimba shimo kisha asilifukie, na ngʼombe au punda akatumbukia ndani yake,
Ekegusii: “Omonto karatige engoro yasie, gose onye okunyire engoro na tayekuneka, na eng’ombe gose etigere egwe imeo,

English: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
Kiswahili: mwenye shimo ni lazima alipe hasara iliyotokea; ni lazima amlipe mwenye mnyama. Mnyama aliyekufa atakuwa wake.
Ekegusii: rirorio omonyene engoro goika aakane omonyene etugo chitaabu. Erio eng’iti eria y akuure ebe eyaye.

English: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.
Kiswahili: “Kama fahali wa mtu fulani atamuumiza fahali wa mtu mwingine na akafa, watamuuza yule aliye hai na wagawane sawa fedha pamoja na mnyama aliyekufa.
Ekegusii: Eeri y’omonto keraite ey’omonto onde ekwe, erio barabwo baoonie eeri eyio ere moyo, baatanane chitaabu echio, baatanane ne chinyama chi’eng’ombe eria y akuure boigo.

English: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kama ikifahamika kwamba fahali huyo alikuwa na tabia ya kupiga kwa pembe na mwenyewe hakumfunga, ni lazima mwenye fahali alipe mnyama kwa mnyama, na mnyama aliyekufa atakuwa wake.
Ekegusii: Korende onye emanyekanete ng’a eeri eria nigo enarete goita abanto, na omonyene tayesibeti, goika aakane omonyene eeri eria y akuure ase okomoa eeri eria ere moyo; na eria y akuure ebe eyaye.”

English: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akiiba maksai au kondoo na kumchinja au kumuuza, ni lazima alipe ngʼombe watano badala ya maksai mmoja na kondoo wanne badala ya kondoo mmoja.
Ekegusii: Omonto karaibe eng’ombe gose eng’ondi na koyenyenya, gose ayeoonie, nigo araakane chiombe isano ribaga ri’eng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi inye ribaga ri’eng’ondi eyemo.

English: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
Kiswahili: “Kama mwizi akishikwa anavunja nyumba akapigwa hata akafa, aliyemuua hana hatia ya kumwaga damu;
Ekegusii: Igo emogwenerete aakane chionsi. Onye tabwati gento, ere omonyene goika aoonigwe ase engencho y’oboibi bwaye. Onye etugo eyio aiba ekonyorekana ase amaboko aye ere moyo, aakane ara kabere, onye neng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi. Omoibi karanyorekane ogotagora enyomba botuko ase okoiba, nere aitwe akwe: omonto oria omoita takobarerwa oboiti obwo. Korende onye nigo amoita kobwakiire, rirorio nigo arabarerwe oboiti obwo.

English: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
Kiswahili: lakini jambo hilo likitokea wakati jua limechomoza, huyo mtu atakuwa na hatia ya kumwaga damu. “Mwizi huyo sharti alipe, lakini kama hana kitu, lazima auzwe ili alipe kwa ajili ya wizi wake.
Ekegusii: “Omonto kararisie etugo yaye ase omogondo bw’endagera, gose oyo bw’emesabibu, na gotiga riicho riaye ririe endagera y’omonto onde, nere goika aakane endagera enoru korwa ase omogondo oye, gose eyere engiya korwa ase emesabibu yaye.

English: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
Kiswahili: “Kama mnyama aliyeibwa akikutwa hai mikononi mwake, ikiwa ni maksai au punda au kondoo, lazima alipe mara mbili.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogosamba omorero, na omorero oyio bwesiarere gochia ase amagwa, na emesaima y’endagera ere ase omogondo eyie, omonto oria goika aakane yonsi pi.

English: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akichunga mifugo yake katika shamba au shamba la mizabibu, na akawaachia wajilishe katika shamba la mtu mwingine, ni lazima alipe vitu bora kutoka kwenye shamba lake mwenyewe au kutoka shamba lake la mizabibu.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karae omoiri oye chitaabu, gose ebinto binde biaye amogachere, na birobio biibwe korwa nyomba mwaye, omoibi karanyorekane goika aakane ara kabere.

English: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
Kiswahili: “Kama moto ukiwaka na kuenea kwenye vichaka vya miiba na kuteketeza miganda ya nafaka au nafaka ambayo haijavunwa, au kuteketeza shamba lote, mtu yule aliyewasha moto lazima alipe.
Ekegusii: Korende atanyorekaneti, oria omonyene enyomba arentwe ase obosio bw’ekegambero, erinde amanywe gose nere obiibete.

English: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akimpa jirani yake fedha au mali nyingine amtunzie, na kama vikiibwa kutoka nyumba ya huyo jirani, kama mwizi atashikwa, lazima alipe mara mbili.
Ekegusii: “Eriomana rinde rionsi riise gotuboka, onye igoro y’eng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi, gose eanga, gose gento kende gionsi kerasire, na omonto oyomo aamererie ng’a nekiaye, ekiina ekio ki’abaanto abwo babere nigo keraarentwe ase obosio bw’egesasiimero. Na oria Nyasae araorokie ng’a nomomochi, goika aakane oria onde ara kabere.

English: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwizi asipopatikana, mwenye nyumba atafika mbele ya waamuzi ili kuthibitisha kuwa hakuchukua mali ya mwenzake.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karae omoiri oye etigere, gose eeri, gose eng’ondi, gose etugo ende yonsi ebe sagare, na etugo eria eitwe gose eakwe, gose eirwe monto tarora,

English: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
Kiswahili: Pakiwepo jambo lolote la mali isiyo halali, ikiwa ni maksai, punda, kondoo, mavazi, ama mali yoyote iliyopotea ambayo fulani atasema, ‘Hii ni mali yangu,’ pande zote mbili wataleta mashauri yao mbele ya waamuzi. Yule ambaye waamuzi watamwona kuwa na hatia atamlipa jirani yake mara mbili.
Ekegusii: omoiri oria goika atenene bosio bw’ekegambero atiane ase Omonene ng’a takuneti enibo aetwe sagare. Omonyene etugo eria goika anche ng’a ayio atianwa namaene, na tagoakanwa.

English: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akimpa jirani yake punda, ngʼombe, kondoo au mnyama mwingine yeyote amtunzie, akifa au akijeruhiwa au akichukuliwa wakati haonekani na mtu yeyote,
Ekegusii: Korende onye nigo yaibwa korwa asare ere goika aakane omonyene oria.

English: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
Kiswahili: jambo hili kati yao wawili litaamuliwa kwa kuapa kiapo mbele za Bwana, kwamba huyo jirani hakuhusika na wizi wa mali ya jirani yake. Mwenye mali itampasa akubali jambo hili, na hakuna malipo yatakayohitajika.
Ekegusii: Onye yariegwa nenyang’au, arente chinyama chintigari chibe kirori, taakana ase eye enyang’au yaitete.

English: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mnyama aliibwa kwa jirani, itampasa amlipe mwenye mnyama.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karasabe na koegwa etugo sagare korwa ase omoiri oye, na etugo eyio keraakwe gose ekwe, na omonyene tayerochi, omonto oria goika ayeakane.

English: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
Kiswahili: Kama ameraruliwa na mnyama pori, ataleta mabaki ya mnyama kama ushahidi, naye hatadaiwa kulipa mnyama aliyeraruliwa.
Ekegusii: Onye omonyene abao ekero egoakwa gose egokwa, rirorio tagoakanwa. Onye etugo eyio yarenge eyogoakanerwa rirerio, ogoakanerwa okwo kobe kogoisanera ogosirerwa okwo.

English: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akimwazima mnyama kutoka kwa jirani yake, na kama akiumia au akafa na mwenye mnyama hayupo, lazima amlipe huyo mnyama.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karamoege na gosaria omoiseke omwekungi otararierwa boko, goika aakane enibo eraisane erio amonyuome.

English: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwenye mnyama akiwa angalipo na mnyama wake, mwazimaji hatalazimika kumlipa. Kama mnyama alikuwa amekodishwa, fedha iliyolipwa kwa kukodisha inatosha kwa kufidia hasara.
Ekegusii: Korende onye ise omoiseke okwanga, tamomoa, omonto oyio goika aakane chitaabu chireng’aine rigori ri’omoiseke omwekungi.

English: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akimshawishi bikira ambaye hajaposwa na akilala naye, lazima alipe mahari, kisha atamwoa msichana huyo.
Ekegusii: “Totiga omokungu omoorogi abe moyo.

English: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
Kiswahili: Baba wa msichana akikataa katakata kumpa huyo mtu huyo msichana wake, bado ni lazima huyo mtu atalipa mahari kama inavyostahili malipo ya ubikira.
Ekegusii: “Omonto oraraare neng’iti goika aitwe akwe.

English: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
Kiswahili: “Usiruhusu mwanamke mchawi aishi.
Ekegusii: “Omonto oraruere enyasae ende yonsi ekeng’wanso, otatiga Omonene bweka, goika asirigwe kegima.

English: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote aziniye na mnyama lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gokorera omomenyi bobe, gose komochegia, ekiagera nainwe abanyene mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri.

English: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.
Kiswahili: “Mtu awaye yote anayemtolea mungu mwingine dhabihu isipokuwa Bwana, lazima aangamizwe.
Ekegusii: Tochanda omoboraka onde bwensi, gose omwana entakana oyo abaibori baye bakuure.

English: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “Usimtendee mgeni vibaya au kumwonea, kwa kuwa nanyi mlikuwa wageni huko Misri.
Ekegusii: Oise kobachanda abwo, na barabwo kobaraarere ase ’nde, amaene, inche ninyigwe ekerero kiabo.

English: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
Kiswahili: “Usimdhulumu mjane wala yatima.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu yane inayoke, na inche mbaite n’omoro, na abakungu baino nababe ababoraka, na abana baino babe chintakaana batari nabaise.

English: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
Kiswahili: Kama ukifanya hivyo nao wakinililia, hakika nitasikia kilio chao.
Ekegusii: “Oise komoa singo omonto onde one omotaka ore ase egati yaino, tobaisa gokora buna abwo bakoa abanto singo na koboria ebitoki ebinge; tobaisa komoboria ebitoki.

English: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
Kiswahili: Hasira yangu itawaka, nami nitawaua kwa upanga, wake zenu watakuwa wajane na watoto wenu watakuwa yatima.
Ekegusii: “Onye kogosaba omonto onde egetambaa kiaye akwambara kebe intenenera, goika omokeiranerie erioba ritaragwa,

English: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.
Kiswahili: “Kama ukimkopesha mmojawapo wa watu wangu fedha ambaye ni mhitaji, usiwe kama mtu mkopesha fedha; usimtoze riba.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nakio gioka abwate akwebisia. Eke nakio abwate gekomobekera riberera ase omobere oye. Inee! Otakemoeti, inki rende araraarere? Ere karaarere ase ’nde, ekeene, nimoigwe, ekiagera inche nomonyamaabera.

English: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
Kiswahili: Kama ukichukua vazi la jirani kama rehani, ulirudishe kwake kabla jua kuzama,
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa korama Nyasae, gose koragereria omorai bw’abaanto bao.”

English: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa vazi lake ndilo pekee alilo nalo la kumfunika mwili wake. Ni nini kingine atajifunika nacho? Atakaponililia, nitasikia, kwa kuwa nina huruma.
Ekegusii: “Totebana kondetera ogotongora kwao kwe rigesa ri’endagera na eri’emesabibu. Ong’e omwana oo omomura omotangi ase abana bao, abe oyone.

English: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
Kiswahili: “Usimkufuru Mungu au kumlaani mtawala wa watu wako.
Ekegusii: Ong’e boigo chimori chintangi chi’echiombe, ne chimaanwa chintangi chi’eching’ondi. Ochitige chikoore amatuko atano na abere, ko rituko ria gatano na gatato ochindetere.

English: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
Kiswahili: “Usiache kutoa sadaka kutoka ghala lako au mapipa yako. “Lazima unipe mzaliwa wa kwanza wa wana wako.
Ekegusii: “Mobe abanto baane abachenu; timobaisa koria eng’iti ende yonsi eyaitirwe nenyang’au ase orosana, motugutere chisese chinyama echio.”

English: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
Kiswahili: “Usieneze habari za uongo. Usimsaidie mtu mwovu kwa kuwa shahidi mwenye nia ya kudhuru wengine.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosiarera oborimo, na tobaisa gokengera omokori amabe ase okomobera kirori bw’oborimo.

English: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
Kiswahili: “Usifuate umati wa watu katika kutenda mabaya. Unapotoa ushahidi kwenye mashtaka, usipotoshe haki ukijumuika na umati wa watu,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koba ensemo y’abare abange kobarigetie gokora amabe, gose tobaisa kobakorera abwo bare abange ogwanchereria na gotanga oboronge ase okoba kirori bw’okoonchorana oboronge.

English: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.
Kiswahili: nawe usimpendelee mtu maskini katika mashtaka yake.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gwanchereria omonto omotaka ase ekiina kiaye.

English: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
Kiswahili: “Kama ukikutana na maksai au punda wa adui yako anapotea, hakikisha umemrudisha kwake.
Ekegusii: “Oise korora eng’ombe y’omobisa oo gose etigere yaye egosira goika omoyeiranerie.

English: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.
Kiswahili: Ukiona punda wa mtu anayekuchukia ameanguka na mzigo wake, usimwache hapo alipoangukia; hakikisha kuwa umemsaidia.
Ekegusii: Korarore etigere y’oyo okogechete yagure negurube ebogoretie, tobaisa koyeetania, korende oyekonye.

English: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
Kiswahili: “Usiwanyime haki watu wako walio maskini katika mashtaka yao.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa korina omonto omotaka oboronge bwaye, ekero ekiina kiaye gekogambwa.

English: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
Kiswahili: Ujiepushe na mashtaka ya uongo, wala usimuue mtu asiye na hatia au mtu mwaminifu, kwa maana sitamhesabia hana hatia yeye aliye na hatia.
Ekegusii: Bwetange kegima korwa ase oborimo, na tobaisa kogera omonyaboronge aitwe, ekiagera inche Omonene tingotiga koa omomochi egesusuro.

English: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
Kiswahili: “Usipokee rushwa, kwa kuwa rushwa hupofusha wale waonao, na kupinda maneno ya wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gwancha oegwe riaaki, ekiagera riaaki nigo rikoukoria omonto erinde takorora ayare boronge; naende nigo rigosaria ekiina ki’abanyene oboronge.

English: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “Usimwonee mgeni; ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi mgeni anavyojisikia, kwa sababu mlikuwa wageni Misri.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gokorera omomenyi bobe, naki inwe momanyete buna omomenyi akoigwa ase enkoro yaye, ekiagera nainwe abanyene mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
Kiswahili: “Kwa muda wa miaka sita mtapanda mashamba yenu na kuvuna mazao,
Ekegusii: “Ase emiaka etano nomo osimeke na kobusura endagera, na ogese ebiamire,

English: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
Kiswahili: lakini katika mwaka wa saba usiilime ardhi wala kuitumia, ili watu walio maskini miongoni mwenu waweze kupata chakula kutoka kwenye hayo mashamba, nao wanyama pori wapate chakula kwa yale mabaki watakayobakiza. Utafanya hivyo katika shamba lako la mizabibu na la mizeituni.
Ekegusii: korende omwaka o gatano na kabere otige omogondo otimoke, toremwa, korende ebirakine na kwama ase omogondo obitigere abataka, na ebi baratigarie bibe endagera ye ching’iti chi’orosaana. Okore boigo nomogondo oo bw’emesabibu na oyo bw’emezeituni.

English: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.
Kiswahili: “Kwa siku sita fanya kazi zako, lakini siku ya saba usifanye kazi, ili maksai wako na punda wako wapate kupumzika, naye mtumwa aliyezaliwa nyumbani mwako, pamoja na mgeni, wapate kustarehe.
Ekegusii: “Ase amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere otimoke, na eng’ombe yao na etigere yao nachirochio chitimoke; naboigo nomosomba oo omomura oiboreire bwoo, na omomenyi oo, nabarabwo batimoke.”

English: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
Kiswahili: “Uzingatie kutenda kila kitu nilichokuambia. Usiombe kwa majina ya miungu mingine, wala usiyaruhusu kusikika kinywani mwako.
Ekegusii: “Motegerere mono onsi aya nabateebirie na moyabwate. Timwatora amarieta ye chinyasae chinde; ayio taigugwa korwa ase emenwa yaino.”

English: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
Kiswahili: “Mara tatu kwa mwaka utanifanyia sikukuu.
Ekegusii: “Kera omwaka nobe kogontwarera Amatuko Amanene ara gatato.

English: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
Kiswahili: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu; kwa siku saba utakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu kama nilivyokuagiza. Fanya jambo hili kwa wakati uliopangwa katika mwezi wa Abibu, ndio mwezi wa nne, kwa sababu katika mwezi huo ulitoka Misri. “Mtu yeyote asije mbele yangu mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bwa Abibu, omotienyi oyio mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri, Goika orende Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera ase enchera eyio nagochigeete. Naboigo orie emegati etabekiri memera ase amatuko atano na abere buna nagochigeete. Na monto onde tabaisa gocha ase obosio bwane namaboko amasa.

English: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
Kiswahili: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mavuno kwa malimbuko ya mazao yako uliyopanda katika shamba lako. “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Kukusanya mavuno mwishoni mwa mwaka, unapokusanya mavuno yako toka shambani.
Ekegusii: “Naende goika orende Rituko Rinene rie Rigesa ekero okogesa ogotongora gw’okwama kw’omogondo oo gwasimegete na ogakora emeremo. “Orende boigo Rituko Rinene ri’Ogosangereria Rigesa ri’omoerio bw’omwaka ekero ogosangereria okwama kw’emeremo yao emekong’u gwakorete.

English: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Mara tatu kwa mwaka wanaume wote watakuja mbele za Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene Nyasae.

English: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.
Kiswahili: “Msitoe damu ya dhabihu kwangu pamoja na kitu chochote kilicho na chachu. “Mafuta ya mnyama wa sadaka ya sikukuu yangu yasibakizwe mpaka asubuhi.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa kondetera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso amo nomogati obekire ememera. Ebitinya bie chinyama echi nkoruerwa ekeng’wanso ase rituko riane rinene, tibitigara goika bokie rituko rikobwatia.

English: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
Kiswahili: “Utaleta malimbuko bora ya ardhi yako katika nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wako. “Usimchemshe mwana-mbuzi katika maziwa ya mama yake.
Ekegusii: “Goika orente ogotongora okore okuya korwa ase omogondo oo, ase enyomba yane inche Omonene Nyasae oo. “Tobaisa koiyekera emanwa y’embori ime y’amabeere ’eng’ina.”

English: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
Kiswahili: “Tazama, ninamtuma malaika akutangulie mbele yako akulinde njiani na kukuleta mpaka mahali nilipoandaa.
Ekegusii: “Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane na gokorenda ase enchera, agoikie aase aria nakoroiseirie.

English: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
Kiswahili: Mtamtii na kusikiliza kile anachokisema. Usiasi dhidi yake; hatakusamehe uasi wako, kwa maana Jina langu limo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Mwerende ase obosio bwaye, na moigwere aya arabateebie. Tobaisa kwanga komoigwera, ere takomoororera amaabera oyoramoche koigwera ekiagera erieta riane nigo rire ime yaye.

English: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
Kiswahili: Kama ukitii kweli kweli kile asemacho na kufanya yote nisemayo, nitakuwa adui wa adui zako, na nitawapinga wale wakupingao.
Ekegusii: Korende koramoigwere ere, na gokora ayio onsi nakwanire inche, rirorio nindwanie ababisa bao, ninchande abwo bakogochanda.

English: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
Kiswahili: Malaika wangu atatangulia mbele yako na kukuleta katika nchi ya Waamori, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wakanaani, Wahivi na Wayebusi, nami nitawafutilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Naki omomalaika one nagotang’ane akoire na kogoikia ase ense y’Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abakanaani, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, na inche nimbasirie.

English: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
Kiswahili: Usiisujudie miungu yao, au kuiabudu, wala kufuata desturi yao. Utayabomoa kabisa na kuvunjavunja mawe yao ya ibada vipande vipande.
Ekegusii: Timosasiima chinyasae chiabo, gose gochikorera; na timokora buna abanto abwo bagokora, korende mosirie kegima emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa na moyaiyerie inse amagena abo onsi are aase bagosasimera.

English: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
Kiswahili: Utamwabudu Bwana Mungu wako, na baraka zake zitakuwa juu ya vyakula vyako na maji yako. Nami nitaondoa maradhi miongoni mwako,
Ekegusii: Momokorere Omonene Nyasae oino, na inche ninsesenie endagera yaino na amaache aino, nindusie amarwaire ase more.

English: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
Kiswahili: na hakuna atakayeharibu mimba wala atakayekuwa tasa katika nchi yako. Nami nitakupa maisha makamilifu.
Ekegusii: Ase ense yaino mokuungu onde tari oborito bwaye boragwe, gose onde takoba omogomba; nimbae obogima obotambe.

English: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
Kiswahili: “Nitapeleka utisho wangu mbele yako na kufadhaisha kila taifa utakalolifikia. Nitafanya adui zako wote wakupe kisogo na kukimbia.
Ekegusii: “Nintang’anie okwoboyia kwane bosio bwaino, na goichanie na gotantania abanto bonsi abwo morabe mokoumerana nabarabwo; ninkore ababisa baino bonsi baonchoke batame korwa ase more.

English: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
Kiswahili: Nitatanguliza manyigu mbele yako kuwafukuza Wahivi, Wakanaani na Wahiti waondoke njiani mwako.
Ekegusii: Nintome ebiaramba birase na goseria Abahivi, na Abakanaani, na Abahiti, korwa ase Kaanani bosio bwao.

English: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
Kiswahili: Lakini sitawafukuza kwa mara moja, kwa sababu nchi itabaki ukiwa na wanyama pori watakuwa wengi mno kwako.
Ekegusii: Tinkobaseria ase omwaka oyomo, ense ebaise koba bosa, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chimenteke chibachande.

English: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
Kiswahili: Nitawafukuza kidogo kidogo mbele yako, mpaka uwe umeongezeka kiasi cha kutosha kuimiliki nchi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ndabaserie ng’ora ng’ora goika momenteke moisane komenya ense eyio.

English: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
Kiswahili: “Nitaweka mipaka ya nchi yako kuanzia Bahari ya Shamu hadi Bahari ya Wafilisti, na kuanzia jangwani hadi Mto Frati. Nitawatia watu wanaoishi katika nchi hizo mikononi mwako, nawe utawafukuza watoke mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Inche ninkobekere orobebe rwao gochakera Enyancha Embariri goikera Enyancha y’Abafilisti, naende korwa ase erooro goika orooche rwa Eufarati, ekiagera nimbeke ababiare b’ense eyio ase amaboko aino, na inwe mobaseerie, batame korwa ase more.

English: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
Kiswahili: Usifanye agano lolote nao wala na miungu yao.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora okobwatana konde gwonsi nabarabwo, gose ne chinyasae chiabo.

English: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
Kiswahili: Usiwaache waishi katika nchi yako, la sivyo watakusababisha utende dhambi dhidi yangu, kwa sababu ibada ya miungu yao hakika itakuwa mtego kwako.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibaamenya ase ense yao, baabaise kogera onkorere ebibe. Onye kogokorera chinyasae chiabo, chirochio nachinyare kogotega.”

English: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia Mose, “Njooni huku juu kwa Bwana, wewe na Aroni, Nadabu na Abihu, pamoja na wazee sabini wa Israeli. Mniabudu kwa mbali,
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa ase ’nde, aye amo na Aroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etano na ebere. Mobeere aare ake, motugame inse monsasiime.

English: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”
Kiswahili: lakini Mose peke yake ndiye atakayemkaribia Bwana; wengine wasije karibu. Nao watu wasije wakapanda pamoja naye.”
Ekegusii: Naye Musa bweka orachiche ong’ike ang’e, korende abwo bande tibang’ika ang’e. Boigo n’Abaisraeli barabwo tibachicha amo naye nonya ng’ake.”

English: Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which Yahweh has spoken will we do.”
Kiswahili: Mose alipokwenda na kuwaambia watu maneno yote na sheria zote za Bwana, wakaitikia kwa sauti moja, “Kila kitu alichosema Bwana tutakifanya.”
Ekegusii: Musa akagenda agateebia abanto amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene akwanete, na amachiiko aye onsi. Abanto bonsi bakamoiraneria ase eriogi erimo, bakaboora, “Amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene akwanire inatoyakore.”

English: Moses wrote all Yahweh’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akaandika kila kitu Bwana alichokuwa amesema. Akaamka kesho yake asubuhi na mapema na kujenga madhabahu chini ya mlima na kusimamisha nguzo kumi na mbili za mawe kuwakilisha makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akariika amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene omoete. Erio akaimoka maambia chuni, akaagacha egesasiimero inse ye getunwa, agatenenia amagena ikomi na abere koreng’ana nebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.

English: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawatuma vijana wanaume wa Kiisraeli, nao wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu za mafahali wachanga kuwa sadaka za amani kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Agatoma abamura b’Abaisraeli bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, bakanyenyera Omonene chieri chi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.

English: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
Kiswahili: Mose akachukua nusu ya damu ya wale wanyama na kuiweka kwenye mabakuli na nusu nyingine akainyunyiza juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Musa akabogoria ekeng’ese ki’amanyinga aya, akayabeeka egetaabo ime, na ekeng’ese kende akanyororokeria egesasiimero.

English: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that Yahweh has said, and be obedient.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akachukua kile Kitabu cha Agano na kuwasomea watu. Nao wakajibu, “Tutafanya kila kitu alichosema Bwana, nasi tutatii.”
Ekegusii: Erio akaimokia egetabu gi’okobwatana kw’ogotianania agwo ase amariko a Omonene ariikire agasomera abanto bakaigwa, erio Barabwo bakaboora, “Natoigwere na gokora onsi ay’Omonene akwanire.”

English: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which Yahweh has made with you concerning all these words.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akachukua ile damu, akawanyunyizia wale watu, akasema, “Hii ni damu ya agano ambalo Bwana amelifanya nanyi kufuatana na maneno haya yote.”
Ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amanyinga aria arenge egetaabo ime, akanyororokeria abanto, akabora, “Aya n’amanyinga okobwatana okw’Omonene akorire ase ogotianania nainwe ase okobaa amachiiko aya onsi.”

English: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni, Nadabu na Abihu, pamoja na wazee sabini wa Israeli wakapanda mlimani,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa, na Aroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka baria emerongo etano na ebere b’Abaisraeli bagatiira gochia egetunwa igoro,

English: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.
Kiswahili: nao wakamwona Mungu wa Israeli. Chini ya miguu yake kulikuwa na kitu kama sakafu ya mawe ya yakuti samawi, iliyo safi kama anga angavu.
Ekegusii: bakarora Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Inse y’amagoro aye nigo arenge buna amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, are nobokenonoku buna obore igoro.

English: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu hakuinua mkono wake dhidi ya hawa viongozi wa Waisraeli; walimwona Mungu, nao wakala na kunywa.
Ekegusii: Omonene tarambora okoboko kwaye kobakorera bobe abagaaka baria b’Abaisraeli. Barabwo kobarorire Nyasae, bakaria na konywa.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Panda uje kwangu huku mlimani na ukae hapa, nami nitakupa vibao vya mawe, vyenye sheria na amri ambazo nimeziandika ziwe mwongozo wao.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa ase ’nde egetunwa igoro, oganye aa, na inche nkoe chibao chi’amagena chire namachiiko onsi aya narikireo, ayio ogochia kworokereria abanto.”

English: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
Kiswahili: Basi Mose akaondoka na Yoshua mtumishi wake, naye Mose akapanda juu kwenye mlima wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Musa akaimoka amo nomosomba oye Yoshua, erio ere agatiira gochia egetunwa kia Nyasae.

English: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia wazee wa Israeli, “Tungojeni hapa mpaka tutakapowarudia. Aroni na Huri wako pamoja nanyi, na kila aliye na neno aweza kuwaendea wao.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia abagaaka baria, “Motoganye aiga goika ekero torairane ase more. Rora Aroni na Huri nao bare aiga amo nainwe; onye omonto ore nobokong’u bonde, agende ababorie.”

English: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
Kiswahili: Mose alipopanda juu mlimani, wingu liliufunika huo mlima,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ne riire rikagetuba.

English: Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.
Kiswahili: nao utukufu wa Bwana ukatua juu ya Mlima Sinai. Kwa muda wa siku sita wingu lilifunika mlima, na siku ya saba Bwana akamwita Mose kutoka katikati ya lile wingu.
Ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene bogaacha bokabeera igoro y’egetunwa gia Sinai, ne riire rikagetuba ase engaki y’amatuko atano na rimo. Rituko ria gatano na kabere Omonene akarangeria Musa korwa riire gati.

English: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa Waisraeli utukufu wa Bwana ulionekana kama moto uteketezao juu ya mlima.
Ekegusii: Ase Abaisraeli obonene bw’Omonene bokarorekana buna omorero ogosiria, ase egetunwa igoro.

English: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akaingia ndani ya lile wingu alivyokuwa akipanda mlimani. Naye akakaa huko mlimani kwa muda wa siku arobaini, usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: Musa agasoa riire ime, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akabeera aroro ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli waniletee sadaka. Utapokea sadaka kwa niaba yangu kutoka kwa kila mtu ambaye moyo wake wapenda kutoa.
Ekegusii: “Bateebie Abaisraeli ng’a bandetere ebiegwa; aye obisangererie korwa ase kera omonto oyoranche kobirua ase ’nde.

English: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo sadaka utakazozipokea kutoka kwao: dhahabu, fedha na shaba;
Ekegusii: Na ebiegwa orasangererie korwa ase bare nabio ebi: chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai;

English: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
Kiswahili: nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, za rangi nyekundu, pamoja na kitani safi; singa za mbuzi;
Ekegusii: chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;

English: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
Kiswahili: ngozi za kondoo dume zilizopakwa rangi nyekundu, na ngozi za pomboo; mbao za mshita;
Ekegusii: amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ne chibao chi’emekonge;

English: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
Kiswahili: mafuta ya zeituni kwa ajili ya taa; vikolezi kwa ajili ya mafuta ya upako, pamoja na uvumba wa harufu nzuri;
Ekegusii: amaguta e chitaaya, na ebinto bi’okoroisia amaguta akwaakwa abachore, na ebi’okoroisia ubani ye rimusu rigiya;

English: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
Kiswahili: na vito vya shohamu na vito vingine vya thamani vya kuweka kwenye kisibau na kile kifuko cha kifuani.
Ekegusii: amagena e rigori rinene, buna oiniki na ayande, akobekwa ase egesibao ki’Omokuani na ase egesembe kiaye.

English: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
Kiswahili: “Kisha uwaamuru wanitengenezee mahali patakatifu, nami nitakaa miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Obateebie bandoiserie Obomenyo Obochenu, na inche inyare komenya ase egati yabo.

English: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza hema hili na vyombo vyake vyote sawasawa na kielelezo nitakachokuonyesha.
Ekegusii: Mondoiserie Obomenyo na ebinto bionsi ebirabeo, buna ndakworokie.”

English: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
Kiswahili: “Nao watatengeneza Sanduku la mbao za mshita, lenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili na nusu, upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: “Mondoiserie Esanduki ye chibao chi’omokonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

English: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
Kiswahili: Utalifunika hilo Sanduku kwa dhahabu safi ndani na nje, na kulifanyia ukingo wa dhahabu juu yake kulizunguka.
Ekegusii: Oyeome netaabu echenire ime na isiko, oyeetananie omong’orooria bw’etaabu.

English: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
Kiswahili: Utalisubu kwa pete nne za dhahabu na kuzifungia kwenye miguu yake minne, pete mbili kwa upande mmoja na pete mbili kwa upande mwingine.
Ekegusii: Okore chibonyi inye chi’echitaabu, ochibeke ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera ensemo.

English: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
Kiswahili: Kisha utatengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita na kuzifunika kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Obaache emiaro ebere y’emekonge, oyeoome netaabu.

English: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
Kiswahili: Utaiingiza hiyo mipiko kwenye zile pete katika pande mbili za Sanduku ili kulibeba.
Ekegusii: Osoyie emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria Esanduki eria.

English: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
Kiswahili: Hiyo mipiko itabakia daima katika hizo pete za hilo Sanduku; haitaondolewa.
Ekegusii: Emiaro eyio goika ebe ime ase chibonyi echio, terusigwao.

English: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.
Kiswahili: Kisha weka ndani ya hilo Sanduku ule Ushuhuda nitakaokupa.
Ekegusii: Ime y’Esanduki eria obeke chibao echi chiriikire oborori, echi ndakoe.”

English: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza kifuniko cha upatanisho cha dhahabu safi, chenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili na nusu, na upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie ekemumeko gi’etaabu echenire kebe Oboikaranso bwa amaabera. Obotaambe bwaye bobe ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

English: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza makerubi wawili wa dhahabu iliyofuliwa katika miisho ya hicho kifuniko.
Ekegusii: Naende okore emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibere bibwate chimbaba ey’etaabu esunyuntire, oyebeke ase chinsinyo ibere chi’Ekerogo Kiamaabera,

English: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza kerubi mmoja kwenye mwisho mmoja, na kerubi mwingine kwenye mwisho mwingine; watengeneze makerubi hao wawe kitu kimoja na hicho kifuniko katika miisho hiyo miwili.
Ekegusii: oyomo ase kera ensinyo. Oyekore ebe egento ekemo n’Ekerogo kia Amaabera.

English: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
Kiswahili: Makerubi hao watakuwa wametandaza mabawa kuelekea juu, yakitia kivuli hicho kifuniko. Makerubi hao wataelekeana, wakitazama hicho kifuniko.
Ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo barambore chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’ekerogo kiamaabera, babobekere ekiriri, na amasio abo abe achikaine, na barabwo barigererie ekerogo kiamaabera.

English: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.
Kiswahili: Weka huo Ushuhuda nitakaokupa ndani ya hilo Sanduku la Agano, na uweke hicho kifuniko juu ya hilo Sanduku.
Ekegusii: Oterekerere ekerogo kia amaabera igoro y’Esanduki eria. Erio obeke imeo chibao echi chiriikire oborori, echi ndakoe.

English: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hapo juu ya hicho kifuniko, kati ya hao makerubi wawili walioko juu ya hilo Sanduku la Ushuhuda, hapo ndipo nitakapokutana nawe na kukupa maagizo yangu kwa ajili ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Agwo ninchiche ng’umerane naye. Korwa igoro y’ekerogo kia amaabera, gati‐gati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba aba babere bare igoro y’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, nimbe ngokwana naye igoro y’amachiiko aya ngochia koa Abaisraeli goetera asore.”

English: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza meza ya mbao za mshita yenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili, upana wa dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

English: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
Kiswahili: Ifunike kwa dhahabu safi, na kuitengenezea ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka pande zote.
Ekegusii: Oyeome netaabu echenire, oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
Kiswahili: Kisha tengeneza upapi wenye upana wa nyanda nne, na ufanyie ule upapi ukingo wa dhahabu kuuzunguka pande zote.
Ekegusii: Erio obeke orosingo robe nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na oroetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza pete nne za dhahabu kwa ajili ya meza hiyo, na uzifungie kwenye pembe nne, pale penye miguu yake minne.
Ekegusii: Okore chibonyi inye chi’echitaabu ase emesa eria, ochibeeke ase chikoona inye ase amagoro aye,

English: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
Kiswahili: Pete hizo zitakuwa karibu na ukingo ule ili kuishikilia ile mipiko itakayotumika kuibebea hiyo meza.
Ekegusii: ang’e norosingo; na emiaro esoigwe imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.

English: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza mipiko hiyo kwa mbao za mshita, uifunike na dhahabu, uitumie kubeba hiyo meza.
Ekegusii: Obaache emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, oyeome netaabu, nero emesa erabogorerigwe.

English: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza sahani zake na masinia yake kwa dhahabu safi, pamoja na bilauri na bakuli zake kwa ajili ya kumiminia sadaka.
Ekegusii: Oroisie chinteru na ebitaabo ase ubani, ne chisani, korwa ase ebio bagocha koumora ebinyugwa ebikoruegwa. Obiroisie bionsi korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.

English: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
Kiswahili: Utaweka mikate ya Wonyesho juu ya meza hii iwe mbele yangu daima.
Ekegusii: Ase emesa eyio obeke emegati erabe ekoruegwa ase ’nde, imbe nkoyerora botambe.”

English: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi iliyofuliwa vizuri katika kitako chake na ufito wake; vikombe vyake vinavyofanana na ua, matovu yake na maua yake viwe kitu kimoja.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire esunyuntire, okeroisie na enterekerero amo ne ritina na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha, bionsi bibe egento ekemo.

English: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;
Kiswahili: Matawi sita yatatokeza kuanzia ule ufito wa katikati wa kinara cha taa: matawi matatu upande mmoja na matatu upande mwingine.
Ekegusii: Chinsagia isano nemo chibe chigosoka korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.

English: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
Kiswahili: Vikombe vitatu vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yenye matovu na maua vitakuwa katika tawi moja, vikombe vitatu katika tawi jingine, na vivyo hivyo kwa matawi yote sita yanayotokeza kwenye kile kinara cha taa.
Ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang’ani robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chibe boigo.

English: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
Kiswahili: Juu ya kinara chenyewe vitakuwepo vikombe vinne vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yakiwa na matovu yake na maua yake.
Ekegusii: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero keria ribe nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha.

English: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
Kiswahili: Tovu moja litakuwa chini ya jozi ya kwanza ya matawi yaliyotokeza kwenye kinara cha taa, tovu la pili chini ya jozi ya pili, nalo tovu la tatu chini ya jozi ya tatu, yaani matawi sita kwa jumla.
Ekegusii: Rimumu erimo ribe inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio amamumu abe inse ye chinsagia echio isano nemo, chiroisigwe chibe egento ekemo ne ritina.

English: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
Kiswahili: Matovu na matawi yote yatakuwa kitu kimoja na kile kinara cha taa, yakifuliwa kwa dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Amamumu ayio amo ne chinsagia biroisigwe bibe egento ekemo ne ritina, bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase ribomba erimo ri’etaabu echenire esunyuntire.

English: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
Kiswahili: “Kisha tengeneza taa zake saba na uziweke juu ya kinara hicho ili ziangaze mbele yake.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie chitaaya isano na ibere, ochibeke igoro y’ekebekerero keria, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.

English: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
Kiswahili: Mikasi ya kusawazishia tambi, pamoja na masinia, zote zitakuwa za dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Ebinachi ne chindogio chiaye biroisigwe korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.

English: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.
Kiswahili: Utatumia talanta moja ya dhahabu safi kutengeneza hicho kinara na vifaa vyake vyote.
Ekegusii: Okorere chitaabu chichenire chikiro emerongo etano ase okoroisia ekebekerero gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye.

English: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kuwa umevitengeneza sawasawa na ule mfano ulioonyeshwa kule mlimani.
Ekegusii: Origererie buya obikore buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.”

English: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza maskani kwa mapazia kumi ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, naye fundi stadi atatarizi makerubi kwenye mapazia hayo.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie eema y’Obomenyo nebitambaa ikomi biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Omoroisia omong’aini abiroisie bibe nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

English: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
Kiswahili: Mapazia yote yatatoshana kwa ukubwa: kila moja litakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa ishirini na nane, na upana wa dhiraa nne
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Ebitambaa ebio bionsi bibe bi’ekerengo ekemo.

English: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
Kiswahili: Unganisha mapazia matano pamoja; fanya vivyo hivyo kwa hayo mengine matano.
Ekegusii: Ebitambaa bitano bibwatanigwe bibe rirondia erimo. Naboigo nebitambaa binde bitano.

English: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza vitanzi vya kitambaa cha buluu kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu la kwanza, na ufanye vivyo hivyo na pazia la fungu la mwisho.
Ekegusii: Okore ebioro bie chiusi chiburu, obibeke ase ensinyo y’egetambaa eke kere ensinyo y’ensemo eyemo ya kera rirondia.

English: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.
Kiswahili: Fanya vitanzi hamsini katika pazia mmoja, na vitanzi vingine hamsini kwenye pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine, nazo vitanzi vyote vielekeane.
Ekegusii: Okore ebioro emerongo etano, obibeke ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bibe bichikaine.

English: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.
Kiswahili: Kisha tengeneza vifungo hamsini vya dhahabu ili vitumike kufunga na kuunganisha mapazia pamoja kufanya Hema liwe kitu kimoja.
Ekegusii: Oture ebigobanio bie chitaabu emerongo etano, obwateranie amarondia ayio abere amo, ebe eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.

English: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza mapazia kumi na moja ya singa za mbuzi kwa ajili ya kufunika maskani.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chimbori, abe eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo obwo.

English: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
Kiswahili: Mapazia hayo kumi na moja yatakuwa na kipimo kimoja, yaani urefu wa dhiraa thelathini, na upana wa dhiraa nne.
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera rirondia bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi ikomi na rimo abe ay’ekerengo ekemo.

English: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
Kiswahili: Unganisha hayo mapazia matano yawe fungu moja, na hayo mengine sita yawe fungu lingine. Kunja hilo pazia la sita mara mbili mbele ya maskani.
Ekegusii: Obwatanie amarondia atano amo, na amarondia ande atano na rimo oyabwateranie ao. Erio oringe erimo rirondia ria gatano na rimo igoro y’egesoero ki’eema.

English: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza vitanzi hamsini kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu moja, na vivyo hivyo kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine.
Ekegusii: Okore ebioro emerongo etano, obibeke ase ensinyo ye rirondia rinene rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase rirondia rinene ria kabere rigochakera.

English: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
Kiswahili: Kisha tengeneza vifungo hamsini vya shaba, uviingize katika vile vitanzi ili kukaza hema pamoja kuwa kitu kimoja.
Ekegusii: Oture ebigobanio emerongo etano bi’etai ase ebioro biria, obwatanerie amarondia ayio abere abe eema eyemo engima.

English: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu kile kipande cha ziada cha pazia la Hema, nusu ya hilo pazia lililobaki litaningʼinizwa upande wa nyuma wa Hema.
Ekegusii: Ekeng’ese kie rirondia riria kementire kebekwe gesung’unane, getube magega y’Obomenyo.

English: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
Kiswahili: Mapazia ya hema yatakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa moja zaidi pande zote, sehemu itakayobaki itaningʼinia pande zote za Hema ili kuifunika.
Ekegusii: Ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo kie rirondia keringwe, getube Obomenyo ase kera rikere riaye.

English: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza kifuniko cha hema kwa ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, na juu yake kifuniko cha ngozi za pomboo.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie rirondia ri’amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ribe rigotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri’amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ribe rikobekwa igoro ye rirondia rie ritang’ani.

English: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza mihimili ya kusimamisha ya mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya maskani.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, echio chiratenenigwe.

English: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
Kiswahili: Kila mhimili uwe na urefu wa dhiraa kumi na upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu,
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera ebao bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

English: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: zikiwa na ndimi mbili zilizo sambamba kila mmoja na mwingine. Tengeneza mihimili yote ya maskani jinsi hii.
Ekegusii: Okore chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwatanerigwe. Naboigo oranyare koroisia chibao chionsi chi’Obomenyo.

English: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza mihimili ishirini kwa ajili ya upande wa kusini wa maskani,
Ekegusii: Koraroisie chibao echio, oroisie emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya Irianyi.

English: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
Kiswahili: kisha tengeneza vitako arobaini vya fedha vya kuweka chini ya hiyo mihimili, vitako viwili kwa kila mhimili, kimoja chini ya kila ulimi.
Ekegusii: Oroisie ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere ase kera ebao ase okobwaterania chintamang’o chiaye ibere.

English: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
Kiswahili: Kuhusu upande wa kaskazini wa maskani, tengeneza mihimili ishirini
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya sugusu y’Obomenyo oroisie chibao emerongo ebere,

English: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
Kiswahili: na vitako arobaini vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.
Ekegusii: amo ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere ase kera ebao.

English: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
Kiswahili: Kisha tengeneza mihimili sita kwa mwisho ulio mbali, yaani upande wa magharibi wa maskani,
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya magega y’Obomenyo eyerochie bosongo, oroisie chibao isano nemo,

English: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.
Kiswahili: na pia utengeneze mihimili miwili ya pembe za upande ulio mbali.
Ekegusii: naende chibao ibere chie chikoona chi’Obomenyo ensemo ya magega.

English: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
Kiswahili: Katika pembe hizi mbili ni lazima mihimili yake iwe miwili kuanzia chini mpaka juu, na iingizwe kwenye pete moja; mihimili ya pembe hizi mbili itafanana.
Ekegusii: Kera ebao ase echio ibere ebwatanigwe ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere. Ase enchera eyio chibao ibere chibekwe ase chikoona ibere.

English: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo itakuwepo mihimili minane, na vitako kumi na sita vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.
Ekegusii: Chibao chionsi nigo chirabe isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chi’echifeta ikomi na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.

English: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
Kiswahili: “Pia tengeneza mataruma ya mti wa mshita: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mmoja wa maskani,
Ekegusii: “Obaache emeriibo ye chibao chi’emekonge, etano ase okoriiba chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,

English: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.
Kiswahili: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mwingine, na matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande wa magharibi, mwisho kabisa mwa maskani.
Ekegusii: na etano ase okoriiba chibao chie rikere rinde, na etano y’ensemo ya magega, eyerochie bosongo.

English: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
Kiswahili: Taruma la katikati litapenya katikati ya mihimili kutoka mwisho mmoja hadi mwisho mwingine.
Ekegusii: Omoriibo o gati‐gati obekwe omogima, oriibe korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.

English: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.
Kiswahili: Funika hiyo mihimili kwa dhahabu, kisha tengeneza pete za dhahabu ambazo zitashikilia hayo mataruma. Pia funika hayo mataruma kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Oome chibao echio netaabu na okore chibonyi chi’echitaabu ase emeriibo erasoigwe, na emeriibo eria oyeoome netaabu.

English: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
Kiswahili: “Simamisha Hema sawasawa na mfano ulioonyeshwa kule mlimani.
Ekegusii: Otenenie Obomenyo obwo buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.

English: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, naye fundi stadi atirizi makerubi kwenye hilo pazia.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie etoto ye chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya, chisisire. Omoroisia omong’aini ayeroisie ebe nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

English: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.
Kiswahili: Litundike kwa kulabu za dhahabu kwenye nguzo nne za mti wa mshita ambazo zimefunikwa kwa dhahabu, zikiwa zimesimamishwa kwenye vitako vinne vya fedha.
Ekegusii: Osunge etoto eria y’egetambaa ase chisiiro inye chi’emekonge chioomire netaabu, chire nebigobanio bie chitaabu, chiratenene ase chinterekerero inye chi’echifeta.

English: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
Kiswahili: Ningʼiniza pazia hilo kwenye vifungo, kisha weka Sanduku la Ushuhuda nyuma ya pazia. Pazia litatenganisha Mahali Patakatifu kutoka Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Osunge etoto eria inse y’ebigobanio, obeke Esanduki eyere ne chibao chiriikire oborori moino y’etoto. Etoto eria yaatanane Aase Aachenu korwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono.

English: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
Kiswahili: Weka kifuniko cha kiti cha rehema juu ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Erio obeke oboikaranso bw’amaabera igoro y’Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono.

English: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.
Kiswahili: Weka meza nje ya pazia upande wa kaskazini wa Hema, kisha weka kinara cha taa upande wa kusini wa Hema.
Ekegusii: Obeke emesa isiko y’etoto ensemo ya sugusu, na ekebekerero gie chitaaya ensemo ya Irianyi, ase Obomenyo ime.

English: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
Kiswahili: “Kwa ajili ya ingilio la hema, tengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi.
Ekegusii: Naende ase egesoero ki’eema oroisie egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, buna omoroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia.

English: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza kulabu za dhahabu kwa ajili ya hilo pazia, na nguzo tano za mshita zilizofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Kisha mimina vitako vitano vya shaba kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Naende obaache chisiiro isano chi’emekonge ase ogosunga egetambaa ekio, ochioome netaabu; oture ebigobanio bie chitaai. Okore chinterekerero inye chie chitaai chinyititoire, chibe ase chisiiro echio.”

English: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.
Kiswahili: “Jenga madhabahu ya mbao za mti wa mshita, kimo chake kiwe dhiraa tatu; itakuwa mraba, urefu wake dhiraa tano, na upana wake dhiraa tano.
Ekegusii: “Oagache egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano, nabo chinsemo chionsi inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.

English: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza upembe kwenye kila pembe ya hizo pembe nne, ili zile pembe na madhabahu ziwe zimeungana, na ufunike madhabahu kwa shaba.
Ekegusii: Ase chikoona inye chi’egesasiimero oroisie emegwekano ye ching’unchara inye. Ching’unchara echio nigo chirabe egento ekemo negesasiimero; oome gionsi netai.

English: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza vyombo vyake vyote kwa shaba: vyungu vyake vya kuondolea majivu, masepetu, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, uma za nyama, na vyombo vya kuchukulia moto.
Ekegusii: Okore chindogio chi’okobuucha ribu korwa ase egesasiimero. Naende okore ebichiko, na ebitaabo, ne chigami, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero. Ebinto ebi bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase chitaai.

English: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
Kiswahili: Kisha tengenezea hayo madhabahu wavu wa shaba, na utengeneze pete za shaba kwenye kila moja ya hizo pembe nne za huo wavu.
Ekegusii: Okore boigo egechungi gi’etai na obeke chibonyi inye chie chitaai ase chikoona chiaye inye.

English: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
Kiswahili: Weka wavu huo chini ya ukingo wa madhabahu ili ufikie nusu ya kimo cha madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Obeke egechungi eke korwa inse y’orosingo geike gochia gati‐gati y’egesasiimero.

English: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya madhabahu, na uifunike kwa shaba.
Ekegusii: Obaache emiaro y’emekonge ase egesasiimero ekio, oyeome netai.

English: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
Kiswahili: Hiyo mipiko itaingizwa kwenye zile pete ili iwe pande mbili za madhabahu inapobebwa.
Ekegusii: Oyesoyie ase chibonyi echio chie chinsemo ibere chi’egesasiimero, ebeo ekero gekobogorigwa.

English: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza madhabahu yawe na uvungu ndani yake ukitumia mbao. Utaitengeneza sawasawa na vile ulivyoonyeshwa mlimani.
Ekegusii: Egesasiimero keagachwe ne chibao, ime getigwe giasaime. Okeroisie buna kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.”

English: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza ua kwa ajili ya Hema la Kukutania. Upande wa kusini utakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, na utakuwa na mapazia ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri,
Ekegusii: “Oroisie eraaro y’Obomenyo. Ase ensemo ya Irianyi oroisie ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire, bibe ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bibe bigokenga eraaro ensemo eyemo.

English: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
Kiswahili: pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.
Ekegusii: Chisiiro chikobibwata chibe emerongo ebere chie chitaai, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio bie chisiiro chiria ne chinuga chiabo chibe chi’echifeta.

English: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
Kiswahili: Upande wa kaskazini utakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, nao utakuwa na mapazia, pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, pamoja na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase ensemo ya sugusu oroisie ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bisiirwe ne chisiiro emerongo ebere, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio amo ne chinuga chiabo bibe bie chifeta.

English: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
Kiswahili: “Upande wa magharibi wa ua utakuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini, nao utakuwa na mapazia, na nguzo kumi na vitako vyake kumi.
Ekegusii: Ase obogare bw’eraaro ensemo ya bosongo oroisie ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi, amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi.

English: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
Kiswahili: Upande wa mwisho wa mashariki jua linakochomoza, ua pia utakuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini.
Ekegusii: Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.

English: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
Kiswahili: Mapazia yenye urefu wa dhiraa kumi na tano yatakuwa upande mmoja wa ingilio, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bibe ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, bisiirwe ne chisiiro isato ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.

English: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
Kiswahili: Kutakuwepo tena na mapazia ya dhiraa kumi na tano kwa upande mwingine wa ingilio, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nensemo ende y’egesoero bibekwe ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, bisiirwe ne chisiiro isato, amo ne chinterekerero chiaye isato.

English: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
Kiswahili: “Kuhusu ingilio la ua, weka pazia lenye urefu wa dhiraa ishirini la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi. Pazia hilo litashikiliwa na nguzo nne na vitako vinne.
Ekegusii: Na ase egesoero oroisie egetambaa gi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, ebe emeremo y’omoroisia omong’aini. Egetambaa ekio gesiirwe ne chisiiro inye ne chinterekerero chiabo inye.

English: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.
Kiswahili: Nguzo zote zinazozunguka ua zitakuwa na tepe na kulabu za fedha, na vitako vya shaba.
Ekegusii: Chisiiro chionsi echietanaine eraaro nigo chirabe ne chinuga na ebigobanio bie chifeta, ne chinterekerero chiabo chibe chie chitaai.

English: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.
Kiswahili: Ua wa kukutania utakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja na upana wa dhiraa hamsini, ukiwa na mapazia ya kitani yaliyosokotwa vizuri yenye urefu wa dhiraa tano kwenda juu na vitako vya shaba.
Ekegusii: Obotambe bw’eraaro eyio bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano. Egetambaa keria geetanaine eraaro kebe nobotambe gochia igoro bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na keroisigwe ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire. Chinterekerero chi’eraaro chibe echie chitaai.

English: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vingine vyote vinavyotumika katika maskani kwa shughuli yoyote, pamoja na vigingi vyote na hata vile vya ua, vitakuwa vya shaba.
Ekegusii: Ebikorero bi’Obomenyo ebirabe bigokorerwa ase emeremo ende yonsi, amo nebirochi bi’ebitambaa na ebi’eraaro bionsi, nigo birabe ebie chitaai.”

English: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
Kiswahili: “Utawaamuru Waisraeli wakuletee mafuta safi ya zeituni yaliyokamuliwa kwa ajili ya mwanga ili zile taa ziwake mfululizo.
Ekegusii: “Ochike Abaisraeli barente amaguta amaya, amitire korwa ase amazeituni, akobekwa ase chitaaya kera rituko, chibe chikogenderera gwoka botambe.

English: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Katika Hema la Kukutania, nje ya pazia lililo mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, Aroni na wanawe watahakikisha kuwa taa hizo zinawaka kuanzia jioni mpaka asubuhi mbele za Bwana. Hili litakuwa agizo la milele miongoni mwa Waisraeli kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, isiko y’etoto eria ekeng’ete aase chibao chirikire oborori chibekire, Aroni na abamura baye inababe bakorenda chitaaya chiria chigwoka korwa mogoroba goika mambia, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Okwo nigo korabe ogochika ase Abaisraeli ebiare ase ebiare.”

English: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
Kiswahili: “Mtwae Aroni ndugu yako aliyeletwa kwako kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli, pamoja na wanawe Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari, ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Orangerie Aroni, momura omino, omobeke abe ange naye boigo nabamura baye obatanane korwa ase Abaisraeli, erio obarente ase obosio bwao, babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani, ere Aroni amo nabamura baye Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.

English: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
Kiswahili: Mshonee Aroni ndugu yako mavazi matakatifu ili yampe ukuu na heshima.
Ekegusii: Oroiserie Aroni, momura omino, chianga chinchenu chi’obonene na echi’oboseera.

English: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
Kiswahili: Waambie mafundi stadi wote niliowapa hekima katika shughuli hiyo wamtengenezee Aroni mavazi hayo, ili awekwe wakfu, anitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Oteebie abaroisia abang’aini, abwo naeire obong’aini ne chisemi, baroiserie Aroni chianga, erinde aatananwe abe ogonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.

English: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo mavazi watakayoshona: kifuko cha kifuani, kisibau, kanzu, joho lililorembwa, kilemba na mshipi. Mavazi haya yatashonwa kwa ajili ya ndugu yako Aroni na wanawe ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Ne chianga baramoroiserie nachio echi: Egesembe ki’obokuani, na egesibao ki’obokuani, na eganchwa, na eganchwa ende erobekanirie egoika inse, na ekegogwa, na orokini. Bakorere Aroni amo nabamura baye chianga chinchenu, erio babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.

English: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
Kiswahili: Waambie watumie dhahabu na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani safi.
Ekegusii: Nabwo abaroisia bachiroisie korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.

English: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza kisibau cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa, kazi ya fundi stadi.
Ekegusii: Bakore egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire; keroisigwe nomooroisia omong’aini.

English: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.
Kiswahili: Kitakuwa na vipande viwili vya mabegani vilivyoshikizwa kwenye pembe zake mbili ili kufungia kisibau.
