Ekegusii: Egesibao ekio ki’obokuani kebe nebitwanga bibere bi’amareko, aase gekobwateranigwa.

English: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Kiswahili: Mshipi wa kiunoni uliofumwa kwa ustadi utafanana nacho: utakuwa kitu kimoja na hicho kisibau, nao utengenezwe kwa dhahabu na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na kwa kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao ekio amo robe rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao, keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.

English: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Chukua vito viwili vya shohamu, na uchore juu yake majina ya wana wa Israeli
Ekegusii: Orente amagena abere a oiniki, na ase amagena ayio omang’ere amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli:

English: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.
Kiswahili: kufuatana na walivyozaliwa: majina sita katika kito kimoja, na mengine sita katika kito kingine.
Ekegusii: amarieta atano na rimo ase rigena erimo, na atano na rimo ase rigena rinde, ase omooroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo.

English: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.
Kiswahili: Yachore majina ya wana wa Israeli juu ya vito hivyo viwili kama vile sonara anavyochonga muhuri. Kisha uvitie vito hivyo katika vijalizo vya dhahabu,
Ekegusii: Ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omanyete buya gotura na komang’a ekemanyererio, omang’e amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase amagena aria abere. Erio obeke amagena aria ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.

English: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulders for a memorial.
Kiswahili: na uvifungie juu ya vipande vya mabega ya kisibau yawe kama vito vya ukumbusho kwa wana wa Israeli. Aroni atavaa majina hayo mabegani mwake kama kumbukumbu mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Oyabeeke ase ebitwang’a bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Naboigo Aroni abogorie amarieta abo ase amareko aye abere, abe ekeinyorio ase obosio bw’Omonene botambe.

English: You shall make settings of gold,
Kiswahili: Tengeneza vijalizo vya dhahabu
Ekegusii: Oture ebikonde bibere bi’etaabu,

English: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.
Kiswahili: na mikufu miwili ya dhahabu safi iliyosokotwa kama kamba, na uifunge mikufu hiyo kwenye vijalizo.
Ekegusii: na okore ebichanga bibere bie chitaabu chichenire, bisisire buna engori, bibwatanigwe nebikonde biria.

English: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.
Kiswahili: “Fanyiza kifuko cha kifuani kwa ajili ya kufanya maamuzi, kazi ya fundi stadi. Kitengeneze kama kile kisibau: cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, cha kitani safi iliyosokotwa.
Ekegusii: Oroisie egesembe gi’ekina ase Omokuani. Omoroisia omong’aini akeroisie ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.

English: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.
Kiswahili: Kitakuwa cha mraba, chenye urefu wa shibiri moja na upana wa shibiri moja, na kikunjwe mara mbili.
Ekegusii: Egesembe keria kebe keringire rimo. Obotambe bwaye bobe chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo.

English: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;
Kiswahili: Kisha weka safu nne za vito vya thamani juu yake. Safu ya kwanza itakuwa na akiki, yakuti manjano na zabarajadi;
Ekegusii: Obeke emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori rinene ase egesembe keria. Ase omong’ororia bw’eritang’ani obeke saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;

English: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
Kiswahili: katika safu ya pili itakuwa na almasi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi;
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o kabere alimasi, na safiro, na yasipi;

English: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
Kiswahili: safu ya tatu itakuwa na hiakintho, akiki nyekundu na amethisto;
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o gatato hiakinto, na agati, na ametisito;

English: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.
Kiswahili: na safu ya nne itakuwa na krisolitho, shohamu na yaspi. Yote yatiwe kwenye vijalizo vya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi abekwe ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.

English: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
Kiswahili: Patakuwa na vito kumi na viwili, kila kimoja kwa jina mojawapo la wana wa Israeli, kila kimoja kichorwe kama muhuri kikiwa na jina mojawapo la yale makabila kumi na mawili.
Ekegusii: Amagena ayio nigo arabe ikomi na abere, abe namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli. Amarieta ayio amang’erwe buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio. Kera rigena ribe nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.

English: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
Kiswahili: “Kwa ajili ya kile kifuko cha kifuani, tengeneza mikufu ya dhahabu safi, iliyosokotwa kama kamba.
Ekegusii: Okore ebichanga bie chitaabu chichenire bisisire, bibekwe ase egesembe keria.

English: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu kwa ajili yake, uzifungie kwenye pembe mbili za hicho kifuko cha kifuani.
Ekegusii: Okore boigo chibonyi ibere chi’etaabu, ochibeke ase emego ya igoro y’egesembe keria.

English: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
Kiswahili: Funga ile mikufu miwili ya dhahabu kwenye hizo pete zilizo katika pembe za hicho kifuko cha kifuani,
Ekegusii: Osiberanie ebichanga ebi bibere bie chitaabu ase chibonyi chi’emego ya igoro y’egesembe keria.

English: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.
Kiswahili: nazo zile ncha nyingine za mkufu zifunge kwenye vile vijalizo viwili, na uzishikamanishe na vile vipande vya mabega vya kile kisibau upande wa mbele.
Ekegusii: Chinsinyo chinde chi’ebichanga biria bibere ochisiberanie nebikonde biria bibere, naende obibwateranie bionsi ase ebitwanga bi’amareko bire bosio ase egesibao ki’obokuani.

English: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu, uzishikamanishe kwenye pembe mbili za chini, upande wa ndani wa kifuko cha kifuani karibu na kisibau.
Ekegusii: Okore chibonyi chinde ibere chi’echitaabu, ochibeke ase egesembe keria ase emego ebere ya inse korwa magega, echigeete egesibao.

English: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu, na uzishikamanishe sehemu ya chini ya vipande vya mabega upande wa mbele wa kile kisibau, karibu na pindo juu kidogo ya mshipi wa kiunoni wa kisibau.
Ekegusii: Naende okore chibonyi chinde ibere chi’echitaabu, ochibwateranie ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.

English: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.
Kiswahili: Pete za kifuko cha kifuani zitafungwa kwenye pete zile za kisibau kwa kamba ya buluu, ziunganishwe na ule mshipi wa kiunoni, ili kifuko cha kifuani kisisogee kutoka kwenye kile kisibau.
Ekegusii: Chibonyi chiria chibekire ase egesembe chibwateranigwe ne chibonyi chi’egesibao neusi eburu; erio egesembe keria kebeere orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka.

English: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.
Kiswahili: “Wakati wowote Aroni aingiapo Mahali Patakatifu, atakuwa na yale majina ya wana wa Israeli moyoni mwake juu ya kile kifuko cha kifuani cha uamuzi kama kumbukumbu ya kudumu mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Aroni arabogorie amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase egesembe keria gi’ekina igoro y’enkoro yaye ekero agosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu, ayarente abe ekeinyorio botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.
Kiswahili: Pia weka Urimu na Thumimu ndani ya kifuko cha kifuani, yawe juu ya moyo wa Aroni kila mara aingiapo mbele za Bwana. Kwa hiyo siku zote Aroni atakuwa na uwezo kufanya maamuzi kwa ajili ya wana wa Israeli mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Obeke Urimu na Tumimu (engencho yaye omobaso na oboikeranu) ime y’egesembe gi’ekina bibe igoro y’enkoro ya Aroni, ekero akogenda ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ekero Aroni are ase obosio bw’Omonene abogorie ekiorokererio gi’ekina botambe ase engencho y’Abaisraeli.

English: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
Kiswahili: “Shona joho la kisibau lote kwa kitambaa cha rangi ya buluu tupu,
Ekegusii: Okore eganchwa korwa ase egetambaa keroisirie ne chiusi chire buru chioka.

English: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.
Kiswahili: na katikati uweke nafasi ya kuingizia kichwa. Kutakuwa na utepe uliofumwa, unaofanana na ukosi kuizunguka nafasi hiyo, ili isichanike.
Ekegusii: Obochore engoro gati gati, ase omotwe ogosoera, oyebeke ekenario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.

English: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:
Kiswahili: Tengeneza makomamanga ya nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu kuzunguka pindo la hilo joho, na uweke pia vikengele vya dhahabu kati ya hayo makomamanga.
Ekegusii: Okore emegwekano y’amatunda e rikomomanga korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, oyebeke eetanane omoringero o inse. Ase egati ya kera omogwekano bwe rikomomanga obeke chindege chi’echitaabu.

English: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
Kiswahili: Hivyo vikengele vya dhahabu na makomamanga vitapishana kuzunguka upindo wa joho lile.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ebe emegwekano ye rikomomanga bwateranie ne chindege chi’echitaabu bietanane omoringero o inse bw’eganchwa.

English: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before Yahweh, and when he comes out, that he not die.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima Aroni alivae anapofanya huduma. Sauti ya hivyo vikengele itasikika anapoingia na kutoka Mahali Patakatifu mbele za Bwana, ili asije akafa.
Ekegusii: Aroni goika ayebeke eganchwa eyio ekero agokora emeremo y’obokuani, na eriogi rie chindege chiria riigweke ekero agosoa Aase Aachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ekero agosoka, erio tabaisa gokwa.

English: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza bamba la dhahabu safi na uchore juu yake maneno haya kama vile muhuri huchorwa: Mtakatifu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okore ebao y’etaabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio omang’ere amang’ana ayio: “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.

English: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.
Kiswahili: Lifunge hilo bamba kwa kamba ya buluu kwenye kilemba, nalo ni lazima liwe mbele ya kilemba.
Ekegusii: Oyesiberanie bosio bw’ekegogwa ne chiusi chire buru.

English: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Aroni alivae bamba hilo kwenye paji la uso wake, naye atachukua hatia kuhusu sadaka takatifu za Waisraeli wanazoweka wakfu, sadaka za aina yoyote. Litakuwa kwenye paji la uso wa Aroni daima ili zikubalike kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aroni ayebogorie ase obosio bwaye igoro. Ase igo abogoreranie na korusia amamocho are nebiegwa ebiraatananwe, ebi’Abaisraeli barabe bakoruera Omonene. Aroni nigo arabe okoyebogoria botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.
Kiswahili: “Fuma koti la kitani safi na ufanye kilemba cha kitani safi. Mshipi uwe ni kazi ya mtarizi.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie eganchwa entambe amo nekegogwa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya, na orokini rwe chiusi chire ne chirangi ao ao.

English: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.
Kiswahili: Watengenezee wana wa Aroni makoti, mishipi na kofia, ili kuwapa ukuu na heshima.
Ekegusii: “Erio oroiserie abamura ba Aroni chiganchwa, ne chinkini; naende obaroiserie ebigogwa emechoro bi’ogosika na ebi’oboseera:

English: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumvika Aroni ndugu yako pamoja na wanawe nguo hizi, watie mafuta na kuwabariki. Waweke wakfu ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Obekere Aroni, momura omino, amo nabamura baye, chianga echio. Erio obaake amaguta, obaatanane na kobachena, babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.

English: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.
Kiswahili: “Watengenezee nguo za ndani za kitani zitakazofunika mwili, kutoka kiunoni hadi mapajani.
Ekegusii: Obaroiserie chisirwari chi’egatani, chigoika amariagati abo, chibe chigotuba obogetirianda bwabo.

English: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.
Kiswahili: Aroni na wanawe ni lazima wavae haya kila wanapoingia katika Hema la Kukutania au wanaposogelea madhabahu wakati wa kutoa huduma katika Mahali Patakatifu, ili wasije wakafanya kosa wakafa. “Haya yawe maagizo ya kudumu kwa Aroni na vizazi vyake.
Ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye goika bachibeke botambe ekero bagosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, gose kobakogenda ase egesasiimero gokora emeremo y’obokuani Aase Aachenu ime, tibaabaisa kwerentera okomocha na gokwa. Oko nogochika koragenderere ase Aroni na ororeria rwaye.

English: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo utakalofanya ili kuwaweka wakfu makuhani ili wanitumikie mimi katika kazi ya ukuhani: Chukua fahali mchanga mmoja na kondoo dume wawili wasio na dosari.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro orakore ase Aroni na abamura baye ase okobaatanana, babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani: Orusie eeri ensae ne chimingichi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

English: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na unga laini wa ngano usiotiwa chachu, tengeneza mikate na maandazi yaliyokandwa kwa mafuta, pamoja na mikate midogo myembamba.
Ekegusii: Orusie boigo emegati etabekiri memera na amaandasi atabekiri memera, biroisirie namaguta, na emegati emeoo eakire amaguta. Emegati eyio yonsi eroisigwe korwa ase obosie obonuke bw’engano.

English: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.
Kiswahili: Viwekwe vyote ndani ya kikapu na kuvitoa pamoja na yule fahali na wale kondoo dume wawili.
Ekegusii: Oyebeke ase egetonga, oyendetere ebe egetonga ime ekero okondetera ekeng’wanso ki’eeri na egie chimingichi chiria ibere.

English: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
Kiswahili: Kisha mlete Aroni na wanawe kwenye lango la Hema la Kukutania na uwaoshe kwa maji.
Ekegusii: “Erio orente Aroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, obasibie namaache.

English: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
Kiswahili: Chukua yale mavazi na umvike Aroni koti, joho la kisibau na kisibau chenyewe pamoja na kile kifuko cha kifuani. Mfungie hicho kisibau kwa ule mshipi wa kiunoni uliosukwa kwa ustadi.
Ekegusii: Oimokie chianga chiria, obekere Aroni: Eganchwa erobekanirie egoika inse, na eganchwa eria ende, na egesibao ki’obokuani na egesembe keria; omoboerie norokini rw’egesibao.

English: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.
Kiswahili: Weka kilemba kichwani mwake na kuweka taji takatifu ishikamane na hicho kilemba.
Ekegusii: Omobekere na ekegogwa omotwe oye, na ase ekegogwa eke osiberanie ekemanyererio keria egechenu gekoorokia ng’a bwatananirwe.

English: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.
Kiswahili: Chukua yale mafuta ya upako umimine juu ya kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Erio oimokie amaguta akweakwa, omonyoororokerie ase omotwe oye, omoyaake na omobeke ensemo ase emeremo emechenu.

English: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
Kiswahili: Walete wanawe na uwavike makoti,
Ekegusii: “Orente na abamura baye, obabeekere chianga.

English: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.
Kiswahili: pia uwavike zile tepe za kichwani. Ndipo uwafunge Aroni na wanawe mishipi. Ukuhani ni wao kwa agizo la kudumu. Kwa njia hii utamweka wakfu Aroni na wanawe.
Ekegusii: Obaboerie chinkini ebinema biabo, Aroni na abamura baye, na obabeekere ebigogwa emetwe yabo. Ase enchera eyio bwatanane Aroni amo nabamura baye obabeeke ensemo babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani kogenderera botambe.

English: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.
Kiswahili: “Mlete yule fahali mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, naye Aroni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: “Orente eeri bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano; Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio.

English: You shall kill the bull before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Mchinje huyo fahali mbele za Bwana kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Erio oyenyenyere ase obosio bw’Omonene ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.
Kiswahili: Chukua sehemu ya damu ya huyo fahali na kuipaka kwenye pembe za hayo madhabahu kwa kidole chako, na damu iliyobaki uimwage sehemu ya chini ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Oimokie amanyinga make y’eeri, erinde ogindie nekiara kiao emegwekano ye ching’unchara chi’egesasiimero. Na amanyinga amatigari oyaumore inse ase egesasiimero.

English: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.
Kiswahili: Kisha chukua mafuta yote ya huyo mnyama ya sehemu za ndani, yale yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yake, uviteketeze juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Orusie ebitinya biria bitubete chinyama chi’enda; naboigo nebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete; obisambere ase egesasiimero igoro.

English: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.
Kiswahili: Lakini nyama ya huyo fahali na ngozi yake na matumbo yake utavichoma nje ya kambi. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Korende chinyama chieeri eyio, ne risankwa, enda na eura yonsi obisambere isiko y’egetwori. Ekio nekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.

English: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
Kiswahili: “Chukua mmoja wa wale kondoo dume, naye Aroni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: “Orente emingichi eyemo ase echio ibere, na Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.

English: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Mchinje huyo kondoo dume, chukua damu yake na uinyunyize pande zote za hayo madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio oyenyenye na oitorore amanyinga aye ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.
Kiswahili: Mkate huyo kondoo dume vipande vipande na usafishe sehemu za ndani pamoja na miguu, ukiviweka pamoja na kichwa na vipande vingine.
Ekegusii: Onache chinyama chi’emingichi eria chibe ebing’ese; osibie chinyama chi’enda eria amo nebirenge, na obibeeke igoro y’ebing’ese biria na omotwe oye.

English: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to Yahweh; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha mteketeze huyo kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa Bwana, harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Osambere chinyama echi chionsi chi’emingichi ase egesasiimero igoro. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

English: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
Kiswahili: “Mchukue yule kondoo dume mwingine, naye Aroni na wanawe waweke mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: “Erio orente emingichi eria ende, na Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.

English: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Mchinje, uchukue sehemu ya damu yake na kuipaka kwenye masikio ya Aroni na wanawe, kwenye vidole gumba vya mikono yao ya kuume, pia kwenye vidole gumba vya miguu yao ya kuume. Kisha nyunyiza hiyo damu pande zote za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio oyenyenye, orusie amanyinga make, na ase amanyinga ayio ogindie mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kwa Aroni amo na mesia y’amato ’abamura baye; ogindie boigo ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amagoro abo a borio. Oitorore amanyinga amatigari ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
Kiswahili: Pia chukua sehemu ya damu iliyo juu ya madhabahu na sehemu ya mafuta ya upako, umnyunyizie Aroni na mavazi yake, pia wanawe na mavazi yao. Ndipo Aroni na wanawe pamoja na mavazi yao watakuwa wamewekwa wakfu.
Ekegusii: Orusie amanyinga make ayare ase egesasiimero, na amaguta ayio akweakwa, onyororokerie Aroni ne chianga chiaye, na abamura baye, ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo Aroni na abamura baye baatananwe ase emeremo emechenu, amo ne chianga chiabo.

English: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),
Kiswahili: “Chukua mafuta ya huyu kondoo dume, mafuta ya mkia, mafuta ya sehemu za ndani yale yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili na mafuta yake, pamoja na paja la kulia. (Huyo ndiye kondoo dume kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu.)
Ekegusii: “Orusie ebitinya bi’emingichi eyio, na omokera oye ore omonoru, na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, na ebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete, na ebachwa ya borio, ekiagera emingichi eyio nigo yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu.

English: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwenye kile kikapu chenye mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichoko mbele za Bwana, chukua mkate, andazi lililokandwa kwa mafuta na mkate mdogo mwembamba.
Ekegusii: Orusie omogati oyomo, ne rindasi erimo riroisirie namaguta, na omogati oyomo omoo, ebio bitabekiri memera, bire ase egetonga ime, bibekire ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Viweke vitu hivi vyote mikononi mwa Aroni na wanawe na uviinue mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
Ekegusii: Ebi bionsi obibeeke ase amaboko Aroni amo nay’abamura baye, obisungusie bibe okoruegwa ase Omonene.

English: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before Yahweh: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha vichukue vitu hivyo kutoka mikononi mwao, uviteketeze juu ya madhabahu pamoja na sadaka ya kuteketezwa kuwa harufu nzuri ya kupendeza kwa Bwana, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Erio obirusie ase amaboko abo, obisambere ase egesasiimero igoro y’ekeng’wanso keria kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’omorero.

English: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be your portion.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuchukua kidari cha huyo kondoo dume wa kuwekwa wakfu kwa Aroni, kiinue mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa, nayo itakuwa fungu lako.
Ekegusii: “Obogorie ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ase ogwatanana Aroni, orisungusie ribe okoruegwa ase Omonene. Nerio naribe eriao, erigotungetie korwa ase eng’iti eyio.

English: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.
Kiswahili: “Weka wakfu zile sehemu za kondoo dume aliyetumika kwa kumweka wakfu Aroni na wanawe: kidari kile kilichoinuliwa na lile paja lililotolewa.
Ekegusii: “Nabo ekeo Omokuani akobekwa ensemo, naboigo oraatanane ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ekeng’wanso amo nekenama kiaye, ebitari ebio bi’emingichi eyio bibe ebitungetie Aroni amo nabamura baye.

English: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Siku zote hili litakuwa fungu la kawaida kutoka kwa Waisraeli kwa ajili ya Aroni na wanawe. Hili ni toleo la Waisraeli watakalotoa kwa Bwana kutoka sadaka zao za amani.
Ekegusii: Ebi nigo birabe bitungetie Abakuani kogenderera botambe korwa ase Abaisraeli, bibe ekeegwa ki’Omonene korwa ase bare, ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’omorembe.

English: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
Kiswahili: “Mavazi matakatifu ya Aroni yatakuwa ya wazao wake ili kwamba waweze kutiwa mafuta na kuwekwa wakfu wakiwa wameyavaa.
Ekegusii: “Chianga chiria chinchenu chia Aroni nigo chiraegwe ab’ororeria rwaye magega g akuure, bachieboyie ekero bagochia goakwa amaguta na gwatananwa.

English: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.
Kiswahili: Mwana atakayeingia mahali pake kuwa kuhani na kuja kwenye Hema la Kukutania kuhudumu katika Mahali Patakatifu atayavaa kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Omomura o Aroni, oyorabogorie emeremo y’obokuani ase ribaga ria ise, goika eboyie chianga echi engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, ekero agochia gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano na gokora emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu.

English: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.
Kiswahili: “Chukua nyama ya huyo kondoo dume wa kuwaweka wakfu uipike katika Mahali Patakatifu.
Ekegusii: “Oire emingichi eria yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, oiyekere chinyama chiaye Aase Aachenu.

English: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Aroni na wanawe wataila ile nyama ya huyo kondoo dume pamoja na ile mikate iliyo kwenye hicho kikapu wakiwa hapo ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Aroni na abamura baye barie chinyama chi’emingichi eria amo nemegati ere ase egetonga ime.

English: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.
Kiswahili: Watakula sadaka hizi ambazo upatanisho ulifanywa kwazo kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu na kuwatakasa. Lakini hakuna mtu mwingine yeyote anayeruhusiwa kuvila, kwa sababu ni vitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo barie ebinto ebi biarurwe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ekero baatananetwe ase emeremo emechenu. Monto onde omoao takoba ne ribaga ri’okobiria, ekiagera ebinto ebi nebichenu.

English: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa nyama yoyote ya huyo kondoo dume iliyotumika kwa kuwaweka wakfu au mkate wowote umebaki mpaka asubuhi, vichomwe. Kamwe visiliwe, kwa sababu ni vitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Onye chinyama gose emegati bigotigara goika mambia, erio obisambe nomorero; tibibaisa koriegwa, ekiagera nebichenu.

English: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo utamfanyia Aroni na wanawe kila kitu kama vile nilivyokuamuru: Utachukua muda wa siku saba kuwaweka wakfu.
Ekegusii: “Naboigo orakorere Aroni amo nabamura baye koreng’ana buna nagochikiire. Ogwatananwa kwabo kobe gokogenderera ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.
Kiswahili: Utatoa dhabihu ya fahali kila siku kuwa sadaka ya dhambi ili kufanya upatanisho. Takasa madhabahu kwa kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, nayo uitie mafuta na kuiweka wakfu.
Ekegusii: Kera rituko orue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa. Ase okorua ekeng’wanso ase okobwatanigwa nigo orabe kogochena egesasiimero. Erio ogeake amaguta na kogiatanana ase emeremo emechenu.

English: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda wa siku saba fanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya madhabahu na kuiweka wakfu. Ndipo madhabahu itakuwa takatifu sana na chochote kitakachoigusa kitakuwa kitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere obe gokogenderera gokora okobwatanigwa ase egesasiimero na kogechena mono; na kera egento kerabe gekogekuna, nigo kerabe egechenu.”

English: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
Kiswahili: “Kwa kawaida hiki ndicho utakachotoa juu ya madhabahu kila siku: wana-kondoo wawili wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja.
Ekegusii: “Na ebing’wanso orabe gokorua igoro ase egesasiimero nabio ebi: Kera rituko botambe, orue chimanwa ibere chi’eching’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo.

English: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;
Kiswahili: Utamtoa mmoja asubuhi na huyo mwingine jioni.
Ekegusii: Emanwa eyemo y’echio oyerue mambia na eria ende mogoroba.

English: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na mwana-kondoo wa kwanza utatoa efa moja ya unga wa ngano laini uliochanganywa na robo ya hini ya mafuta yaliyokamuliwa, pamoja na robo ya hini ya divai kuwa sadaka ya kinywaji.
Ekegusii: Amo nemanwa eria entang’ani orue ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta amaya, egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, amitire korwa ase amazeituni. Naende goika orue edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa.

English: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Huyo mwana-kondoo mwingine mtoe dhabihu wakati wa machweo pamoja na sadaka za unga na za kinywaji kama vile ulivyofanya asubuhi, kuwa harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Emanwa eria ende oyerue mogoroba; oyerue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna gwakorete mambia, kobe ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kebe ne rimisu rigiya ase Omonene.

English: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.
Kiswahili: “Kwa vizazi vijavyo itakuwa kawaida kutoa sadaka hii ya kuteketezwa kila mara kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mbele za Bwana. Hapo ndipo nitakapokutana na ninyi na kusema nanyi,
Ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso eke ki’ogosambwa kebe gekoruegwa ebiaare ase ebiaare botambe agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene. Agwo ndabe nkoumerana nainwe, naende nkwane naye.

English: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.
Kiswahili: Huko ndipo nitakapokutana na Waisraeli, nalo Hema la Kukutania litatakaswa na utukufu wangu.
Ekegusii: Agwo ning’umerane n’Abaisraeli, na aase agwo ning’akore abe aachenu nobonene bwane.

English: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo nitaliweka wakfu Hema la Kukutania pamoja na madhabahu, nami nitamweka wakfu Aroni na wanawe ili wanitumikie mimi katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Ninchene Eema y’Omosangererekano amo negesasiimero; naboigo ninchene Aroni amo nabamura baye babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.

English: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nitakapofanya makao miongoni mwa Waisraeli na kuwa Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Inche nimenye ase egati y’Abaisraeli, imbe Nyasae obo.

English: They shall know that I am Yahweh their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am Yahweh their God.
Kiswahili: Nao watajua kuwa Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wao, aliyewatoa Misri ili nipate kufanya makao miongoni mwao. Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Erio barabwo nabamanye ng’a inche ninche Nyasae obo; ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe imenyete ase egati yabo. Inche ninche Nyasae obo.”

English: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza madhabahu kwa mbao za mshita kwa ajili ya kufukizia uvumba.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani egosamberwa.

English: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.
Kiswahili: Madhabahu hayo yawe mraba, urefu na upana wake dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa mbili, nazo pembe zake zitakuwa kitu kimoja nayo.
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe amaboko abere. Emegwekano yaye ye ching’unchara nigo eraroisigwe ebe egento ekemo negesasiimero.

English: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.
Kiswahili: Funika hayo madhabahu juu na pande zote na pia pembe zake kwa dhahabu safi, na uifanyizie ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka.
Ekegusii: Oyeoome netaabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye inye, amo ne ching’unchara chiaye; oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu kwa ajili ya madhabahu chini ya huo ukingo, ziwe mbili kila upande, za kushikilia hiyo mipiko itumikayo kuibebea madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Okore chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu ochibeke inse y’omong’ororia chinsemo ibere, na emiaro esoigwe imeo, erinde egesasiimero kenyare kobogorerigwa.

English: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza mipiko kwa miti ya mshita na uifunike kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Obaache emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, oyeoome netaabu.

English: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.
Kiswahili: Weka hayo madhabahu mbele ya lile pazia lililo mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, lililo mbele ya kiti cha rehema kilicho juu ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, mahali ambapo nitakutana nawe.
Ekegusii: Obeke egesasiimero ekio bosio bw’etoto eria ekengete aase aria esanduki egachire, eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori amo n’Ekerogo ki’Amaabera igoro yaye. Aase agwo ndabe nkoumerana naye.

English: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.
Kiswahili: “Itampasa Aroni kufukiza uvumba wenye harufu nzuri juu ya madhabahu kila siku asubuhi wakati anapowasha zile taa.
Ekegusii: Kera emambia ekero Aroni akoroisia chitaaya nabe ogosambera agwo ubani egotioka buya,

English: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.
Kiswahili: Itampasa afukize uvumba tena wakati anapowasha taa wakati wa machweo ili uvumba ufukizwe daima mbele za Bwana kwa vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: naende ekero arabe ogwokia chitaaya engaki ya mogoroba. Ogosambwa okwo kwa ubani nigo koragenderere botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.
Kiswahili: Usifukize uvumba mwingine wowote juu ya madhabahu haya au sadaka nyingine yoyote ya kuteketezwa wala sadaka ya nafaka, wala usimimine sadaka ya kinywaji juu yake.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gosamba ubani eye etachikiri, gose ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timobaisa koumora okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa igoro yaye.

English: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Mara moja kwa mwaka Aroni atafanya upatanisho juu ya pembe za hayo madhabahu. Upatanisho huu wa mwaka lazima ufanywe kwa damu ya sadaka ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi kwa vizazi vijavyo. Ni takatifu sana kwa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ara rimo kera omwaka Aroni akore okobwatanigwa ase ching’unchara chiaye. Naboigo ara rimo kera omwaka nakorere egesasiimero okobwatanigwa namanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ayio nigo arakorerwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Egesasiimero ekio nagiatananwe kebe egechenu mono ase Omonene.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to Yahweh when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.
Kiswahili: “Utakapowahesabu Waisraeli, kila mmoja lazima alipe kwa Bwana fidia kwa ajili ya nafsi yake wakati wa kuhesabiwa kwake. Ndipo hakutakuwa na pigo juu yao unapowahesabu.
Ekegusii: “Ekero orabe gokobara Abaisraeli ase okorikwa kwabo, kera omonto arue ekeegwa ase Omonene, kebe embooria ase obogima bwaye, tibaabaisa konyora amaakwa ekero bakorikwa.

English: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja anayekwenda upande wa wale waliokwisha hesabiwa atatoa nusu shekeli, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, ambayo ina uzito wa gera ishirini. Hii nusu shekeli ni sadaka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, kera omonto oyorache korikwa goika arue ekeng’ese gi’esekeli ase ekerengo gi’esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, ebe ekeegwa ase Omonene. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera emerongo ebere.)

English: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wote wale wanaovuka, wenye umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi, watatoa sadaka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto oyorarikwe, engencho yaye oyokoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, goika arue ekeegwa eke ase Omonene.

English: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.
Kiswahili: Matajiri hawatalipa zaidi ya nusu shekeli, nao maskini hawatatoa pungufu wakati mnatoa sadaka kwa Bwana kwa kufanya upatanisho wa nafsi zenu.
Ekegusii: Oyore omonda takorua goetania ekeng’ese gi’esekeli, gose oyore omotaka takorua inse y’ekio, ekero morarue ekeegwa ekio ase Omonene. Kerokio kebe embooria ase obogima bwaino.

English: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.”
Kiswahili: Utapokea fedha ya upatanisho kutoka kwa Waisraeli na uzitumie kwa ajili ya huduma ya Hema la Kukutania. Itakuwa ni ukumbusho kwa Waisraeli mbele za Bwana kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya nafsi zenu.”
Ekegusii: Koranyore chitaabu echi Abaisraeli bararue chibe embooria, ochikorere ase emeremo y’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase igo Abaisraeli babe bakoinyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende chitaabu echio chibe embooria ase obogima bwabo.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza sinia la shaba lenye kitako cha shaba kwa ajili ya kunawia. Liweke kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, kisha uweke maji ndani yake.
Ekegusii: “Oroisie egetuba gi’etai amo nenterekerero yaye y’etai. Okebeeke egati y’Eema y’Omosangererekano na egesasiimero, na obeeke amaache imeo.

English: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.
Kiswahili: Aroni na wanawe watanawa mikono na miguu yao kwa maji yatokayo katika hilo sinia.
Ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye babe bagwesibia amaache ayio amaboko na amagoro.

English: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wakati wowote wanapoingia katika Hema la Kukutania, watanawa kwa maji ili kwamba wasije wakafa. Pia, wanapokaribia madhabahu ili kuhudumu kwa kuleta sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto,
Ekegusii: Ekero bagosoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano goika besibie ase amaache ayio, tibaabaisa gokwa; naboigo ekero bakogenda ase egesasiimero ase okoruera Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’omorero

English: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”
Kiswahili: watanawa mikono na miguu yao ili kwamba wasije wakafa. Hii itakuwa ni amri ya kudumu kwa ajili ya Aroni na wazao wake kwa vizazi vijavyo.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo babe bagoisaba amaboko, basibie na amagoro abo, tibaabaisa gokwa. Ekio nigo korabe ogochika koragenderere asare na ase ororeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.”

English: Moreover Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;
Kiswahili: “Chukua vikolezi bora vifuatavyo: shekeli 500 za manemane ya maji, shekeli 250 za mdalasini wenye harufu nzuri, shekeli 250 za miwa yenye harufu nzuri,
Ekegusii: “Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Amaguta a manemane chikiro ikomi, na omodalasini ore ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano,

English: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.
Kiswahili: shekeli 500 za aina nyingine ya mdalasini, vyote kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, pia hini ya mafuta ya zeituni.
Ekegusii: na kasia chikiro ikomi. (Bionsi bibe bi’ekerengo kegokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu). Oimokie na amaguta ’emezeituni ebituba bine.

English: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.
Kiswahili: Vitengeneze vikolezi hivi kuwa mafuta matakatifu ya upako yenye harufu nzuri, kazi ya mtengeneza manukato. Yatakuwa mafuta matakatifu ya upako.
Ekegusii: Ase ebinto ebio oroisie amaguta akweakwa ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omong’aini, abe amaguta amaachenu akweakwa.

English: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,
Kiswahili: Kisha yatumie kupaka hilo Hema la Kukutania, Sanduku la Ushuhuda,
Ekegusii: Oake Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori,

English: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,
Kiswahili: meza na vifaa vyake vyote, kinara cha taa na vifaa vyake vyote, madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba,
Ekegusii: na emesa amo n’ebinto bireo, na ekebekerero gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye, na egesasiimero ase ubani egosamberwa,

English: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.
Kiswahili: madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na vyombo vyake vyote na sinia pamoja na kitako chake.
Ekegusii: na egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa amo nebikorero biaye, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye.

English: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
Kiswahili: Utaviweka wakfu ili viwe vitakatifu sana na kila kitakachoigusa kitakuwa kitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo oraatanane ebinto ebi, obikore ebichenu kegima, erio onde bwensi orabikune abe omochenu.

English: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
Kiswahili: “Mtie Aroni na wanawe mafuta na uwaweke wakfu ili waweze kunitumikia katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye obaake amaguta na kobaatanana babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.

English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
Kiswahili: Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Haya yatakuwa mafuta matakatifu yangu ya upako kwa vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a amaguta aya akweakwa abe amaachenu ase ’nde egati yaino ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.
Kiswahili: Usiyamimine juu ya miili ya wanadamu wala usitengeneze mafuta ya aina nyingine kwa utaratibu huu. Ni mafuta matakatifu na ni lazima myaone kuwa ni matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Tabaisa goakwa ase emebere ya Mwanyabaanto bande bonsi. Timoroisia amaguta ande anga buna ayio. Ayio namaachenu, nabe amaachenu ase more.

English: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote atakayetengeneza manukato kama hayo na yeyote atakayeyamimina juu ya mtu yeyote ambaye si kuhani atakatiliwa mbali na watu wake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amaguta buna ayio gose koyaaka omonto omoao, oyotari Omokuani, nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku kiaye.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Chukua vikolezi vyenye harufu nzuri vifuatavyo: natafi, shekelethi, kelbena na uvumba safi vyote vikiwa na vipimo sawa,
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Oborembo bwa nafiti, na amaguta ’amakorogonte na oborembo bwa kalibani, na ebinto binde ebiansu, na ubani engiya; kera egento kebe gi’ekerengo ekemo.

English: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
Kiswahili: pia tengeneza mchanganyiko wa uvumba wenye harufu nzuri, kazi ya mtengeneza manukato. Utiwe chumvi ili upate kuwa safi na mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ebinto ebio oroisie amanukato oyaroisie ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omong’aini ebekwe omonyoo, abe amarabu achenire.

English: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.
Kiswahili: Saga baadhi yake kuwa unga na uweke mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, mahali ambapo nitakutana nawe. Itakuwa takatifu sana kwenu.
Ekegusii: Orusie bike, erio obiswage bibe obosie. Obeke boke bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, aase ndaumerane naye. Amanukato ayio abe amaachenu mono ase more.

English: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Msitengeneze uvumba mwingine wowote wa namna hii kwa ajili yenu wenyewe; uoneni kuwa ni mtakatifu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Timweroiseria amanukato ande onsi y’ogosambwa anga buna ayio. Abe ase more amaachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”
Kiswahili: Yeyote atakayetengeneza uvumba kama huu ili kufurahia harufu yake nzuri lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.”
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amanukato anga buna ayio ase okwegokeria rimisu riaye nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abaanto b’Omonene.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
Kiswahili: “Tazama, nimemchagua Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, wa kabila la Yuda,
Ekegusii: “Rora, nachorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri, bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

English: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,
Kiswahili: nami nimemjaza Roho wa Mungu, pamoja na ustadi, uwezo na ujuzi katika aina zote za ufundi,
Ekegusii: Inche Nyasae namoichoirie omoika one, namoeire obong’aini ne chisemi amanye gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,

English: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,
Kiswahili: ili kubuni michoro ya kupendeza katika ufundi wa dhahabu, fedha na shaba,
Ekegusii: abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai.

English: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.
Kiswahili: kuchonga vito na kuvitia mahali, kufanya ufundi kwa mbao, na kujishughulisha na aina zote za ufundi.
Ekegusii: Ere abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.

English: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
Kiswahili: Tena nimemteua Oholiabu mwana wa Ahisamaki, wa kabila la Dani, ili kumsaidia. Pia mafundi wote nimewapa ustadi wa kutengeneza kila kitu nilichokuamuru wewe:
Ekegusii: Nachorire Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani amokonye ase emeremo eyio. Nabaeire abaroisia bande bonsi obong’aini, erinde banyare gokora ebinto bionsi ebi nagochikiire.

English: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,
Kiswahili: Hema la Kukutania, Sanduku la Ushuhuda pamoja na kiti cha rehema juu yake, pia na vifaa vyote vya kwenye hema,
Ekegusii: Barabwo baroisie Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduki ebe ne chibao chiriikire oborori, na Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, na ebinto bionsi bi’Eema eyio,

English: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,
Kiswahili: meza na vifaa vyake, kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi na vifaa vyake vyote, madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba,
Ekegusii: emesa na ebinto birabeo, ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire na ebikorero biaye na egesasiimero ase ubani erasamberwe,

English: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,
Kiswahili: madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na vyombo vyake vyote, sinia na kinara chake,
Ekegusii: egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe na ebikorero biaye, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye,

English: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—
Kiswahili: pamoja na mavazi matakatifu yaliyofumwa ya kuhani Aroni, na mavazi kwa ajili ya wanawe wakati wanahudumu katika kazi ya ukuhani,
Ekegusii: ne chianga chingiya chinchenu chia Aroni Omokuani, na echi’abamura baye, echi barabeeke ekero bagokora emeremo y’obokuani,

English: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”
Kiswahili: pia mafuta ya upako na uvumba wenye harufu nzuri kwa ajili ya Mahali Patakatifu. Watavitengeneza sawasawa kama vile nilivyokuagiza wewe.”
Ekegusii: na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya esamberwe Aase Aachenu ime. Ase ogokora ebinto ebi bionsi goika bakore buna nagochikiire kegima.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia.

English: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Ninyi ni lazima mzishike Sabato zangu. Hii itakuwa ni ishara kati yangu na ninyi kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo, ili mpate kujua kwamba Mimi Ndimi Bwana, niwafanyaye ninyi watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli aye omonyene obateebie “Goika morende Chisabato chiane, ekiagera echio nekemanyererio egati yane nainwe ebiaare ase ebiaare, erinde momanye ng’a ninche Omonene oyokobachena.

English: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mtaishika Sabato, kwa sababu ni takatifu kwenu. Yeyote atakayeinajisi lazima auawe, yeyote atakayefanya kazi siku hiyo lazima akafie mbali na watu wake.
Ekegusii: Ase igo morende rituko ri’Esabato, ekiagera ne rituko richenu ase more. Onde bwensi aise korisaria, nigo araitwe akwe. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abaanto b’Omonene.

English: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to Yahweh. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: Kwa siku sita, mtafanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato ya kupumzika, takatifu kwa Bwana. Yeyote afanyaye kazi yoyote siku ya Sabato ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Mokore emeremo amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato Enchenu, rituko ri’ogotimoka, richenu ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.

English: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wataishika Sabato, kuiadhimisha kwa vizazi vijavyo kuwa Agano la milele.
Ekegusii: Nabo Abaisraeli goika babwate na korenda rituko ri’Esabato ebiaare ase ebiaare, ekiagera oko nokobwatana koragenderere botambe.

English: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”
Kiswahili: Itakuwa ishara kati yangu na Waisraeli milele, kwa kuwa kwa muda wa siku sita Bwana aliumba mbingu na dunia, na siku ya saba akaacha kufanya kazi, akapumzika.’ ”
Ekegusii: Rituko erio ribe ekemanyererio keragenderere egati yane na Abaisraeli, ekiagera ase amatuko atano na rimo inche Omonene natongete igoro na ense, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ngatiga emeremo yane yonsi, na gotimoka.”

English: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.
Kiswahili: Bwana alipomaliza kusema na Mose juu ya Mlima Sinai, Mungu akampa vile vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda, vibao vya mawe vilivyoandikwa kwa kidole cha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoorire gokwana na Musa agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai, akamoa chibao ibere chi’amagena chiriikire oborori nekiara kia Nyasae.

English: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”
Kiswahili: Watu walipoona kuwa Mose amekawia sana kushuka kutoka mlimani, walimkusanyikia Aroni na kumwambia, “Njoo, tutengenezee miungu itakayotutangulia. Kwa maana huyu jamaa yetu Mose aliyetupandisha kutoka Misri, hatujui jambo lililompata.”
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baroche ng’a Musa otebanire goika korwa ase egetunwa, bagasangererekana amo, bagachiera Aroni, bakamoteebia, “Inchuo aa, otokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”
Kiswahili: Aroni akawajibu, “Vueni vipuli vya dhahabu ambavyo wake zenu, wana wenu na binti zenu wamevaa, mkaniletee.”
Ekegusii: Aroni akabateebia, “Rusia ebigera bie chitaabu bire ase amato ’abakungu baino, na ase abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, mobindetere.”

English: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo watu wote wakavua vipuli vyao, wakavileta kwa Aroni.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakarusia ebigera bie chitaabu biare ase amato abo, bakamobiirera Aroni.

English: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Akavichukua vile vitu walivyomkabidhi, akavifanyiza kwa kusubu sanamu yenye umbo la ndama, akaichonga kwa kutumia chombo. Kisha wakasema, “Hii ndiyo miungu yenu, ee Israeli, iliyowapandisha kutoka Misri.”
Ekegusii: Ere akanyora ebinto ebi korwa ase amaboko abo, akanyititora chitaabu chiria. Ekero yabwatanire, akayebomba, ekaba omogwekano bw’emori eeri. Abanto bagateeba, “Abaisraeli aba, eye nero enyasae yaino, eyabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Aroni alipoona hili, akajenga madhabahu mbele ya yule ndama na kutangaza, “Kesho kutakuwa na sikukuu kwa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Aroni ayeroche, akaagacha egesasiimero bosio bwaye; erio akararia, akabora, “Ankio nigo rirabe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.”

English: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo siku iliyofuata watu wakaamka asubuhi na mapema na kutoa sadaka za kuteketeza na sadaka za amani. Baadaye watu wakaketi kula na kunywa, nao wakasimama, wakajizamisha katika sherehe.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere abanto bakaimoka mambia chuni, bakarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, bakarenta na ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe. Abanto bagaikaransa, bakaria na konywa, erio bakaimoka gotenga.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Shuka, kwa sababu watu wako, uliowatoa Misri, wamepotoka.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene agateebia Musa, Tirimboka gochia inse, ekiagera abanto abwo bao kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri besaririe ase ogokora amabe,

English: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
Kiswahili: Wamekuwa wepesi kugeuka na kuacha niliyowaamuru, na wamejitengenezea sanamu ya kuyeyusha yenye umbo la ndama. Wameisujudia na kuitolea dhabihu, nao wamesema, ‘Hii ndiyo miungu yenu, ee Israeli iliyokupandisha kutoka Misri.’ ”
Ekegusii: baonchokire bwango, batigire enchera eria nabachigete gotunyana, bekoreire emori eeri y’etaabu. Bayesasimire na koyeruera ekeng’wanso, bagoteeba, Abaisraeli aba, eye nero enyasae yaino, eyabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nimeona watu hawa, nao ni watu wenye shingo ngumu.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Narorire abanto aba ng’a nabanyabigoti bikong’u.

English: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”
Kiswahili: Sasa niache ili hasira yangu ipate kuwaka dhidi yao, nami nipate kuwaangamiza. Kisha nitakufanya wewe kuwa taifa kubwa.”
Ekegusii: Bono tiga endamwamu yane yoke igoro ase bare, erinde mbasirie, erio ngokore aye obe egesaku ekenene.”

English: Moses begged Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akamsihi Bwana Mungu wake, akasema, “Ee Bwana, kwa nini hasira yako iwake dhidi ya watu wako, wale uliowatoa Misri kwa uweza mkuu na mkono wenye nguvu?
Ekegusii: Korende Musa agasorora Omonene, Nyasae oye, akabora, “Gaaki Omonene nase ki’endamwamu yao ekoberorokera abanto bao, abakwang’anyetie korwa Misiri ase okobua okonene, na ase okoboko kwao gwe chinguru?

English: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini Wamisri waseme, ‘Ni kwa nia mbaya aliwatoa Misri, ili awaue milimani na kuwafuta usoni mwa dunia’? Achilia mbali hasira yako kali, waonee huruma na usilete maafa juu ya watu wako.
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo origetie Abamisiri bateebe: Igo abarusia aa, oganetie kobaita ase ebitunwa na kobasiria kegima? Ase igo onchoka korwa ase endamwamu yao enene, tokora amabe aya kwarengereirie gokorera abanto bao.

English: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”
Kiswahili: Wakumbuke watumishi wako Abrahamu, Isaki na Israeli, ambao uliwaapia kwa nafsi yako mwenyewe: ‘Nitawafanya uzao wako kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, nami nitawapa wazao wako nchi hii yote ambayo niliwaahidia, nayo itakuwa urithi wao milele.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inyora abasomba bao Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Israeli, na buna kwabarierete eira ase ogwetiania, okabateebia: Nigo ndamente oroiboro rwaino robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro. Nimbae ense eye yonsi nabarierete eira ng’a nimbae ebe omwando obo kare na kare.”

English: So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akawaonea huruma, wala hakuleta juu ya watu wake maafa aliyokuwa amekusudia.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaonchoka, tabakorera amabe aria konya arengereirie gokorera abanto baye.

English: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.
Kiswahili: Mose akageuka, akashuka kutoka mlimani akiwa na vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda mikononi mwake. Vilikuwa vimeandikwa pande zote mbili, mbele na nyuma.
Ekegusii: Musa akeonchora, agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, na ase amaboko aye obwate chibao ibere chi’amagena chiriikire oborori chinsemo chionsi ibere, bosio na magega.

English: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
Kiswahili: Vibao hivyo vilikuwa kazi ya Mungu; maandishi yalikuwa mwandiko wa Mungu, yaliyochorwa kama muhuri juu ya vibao.
Ekegusii: Chibao echio nigo chiaroisetigwe na Nyasae omonyene, na amariko aya nigo ariikire na Nyasae, amang’eire ase chibao chiria.

English: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
Kiswahili: Yoshua aliposikia sauti za watu wakipiga kelele, akamwambia Mose, “Kuna sauti ya vita kambini.”
Ekegusii: Yoshua akaigwa eriogi ri’abaanto bakwoga, agateebia Musa, “Naigure eriogi ase egetwori, eriogi buna eri’esegi.”

English: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”
Kiswahili: Mose akajibu: “Si sauti ya ushindi, wala si sauti ya kushindwa; ni sauti ya kuimba ninayosikia.”
Ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Eriogi eri tiriri eri’abaanto babuire esegi, gose eri’okorera kw’abaanto babuirwe, korende eriogi naigure neri’abaanto bagotera.”

English: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.
Kiswahili: Mose alipoikaribia kambi na kuona yule ndama na ile michezo, hasira yake ikawaka, akatupa vile vibao vilivyokuwa mikononi mwake, akavipasua vipande vipande pale chini ya mlima.
Ekegusii: Musa gaikire ang’e negetwori akarora emori eria, na buna abanto baare gotenga, akaba nendamwamu enene; agaakera inse chibao chiria abwate maboko aye, chigaateka, chikaba ebisamunye ase egetunwa inse.

English: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamchukua yule ndama waliokuwa wamemtengeneza na kumchoma kwenye moto, kisha akamsaga kuwa unga, akanyunyiza kwenye maji na kuwafanya Waisraeli wanywe.
Ekegusii: Erio akabwata emori eria bakorete, akayesamba na koyesegenya goika ekaba orotu, akaroitera ase amaache ime, na akaa Abaisraeli amaache ayio, na barabwo bakanywa.

English: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Watu hawa walikufanyia nini, hata ukawaongoza kufanya dhambi kubwa hivyo?”
Ekegusii: Agwo Musa akaboria Aroni, “Naki abanto aba bagokorete goika okagera bagakora ebibe ebinene buna ebi?”

English: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.
Kiswahili: Aroni akamwambia, “Usikasirike bwana wangu. Unajua jinsi watu hawa walivyo tayari kwa maovu.
Ekegusii: Aroni akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, toba nendamwamu entindi, aye nomanyete abanto aba ng’a nababe.

English: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
Kiswahili: Wao waliniambia, ‘Tufanyie miungu itakayotuongoza. Kwa kuwa huyu jamaa yetu Mose aliyetupandisha kutoka Misri, hatufahamu yaliyompata.’
Ekegusii: Naki nigo banteebia: Tokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa Misiri.

English: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nikawaambia, ‘Yeyote aliye na kito chochote cha dhahabu avue.’ Kisha wakanipa hiyo dhahabu, nami nikaitupa motoni, akatokea huyu ndama!”
Ekegusii: Inche: nkabateebia: Onde bwensi obwate etaabu ayerusie. Barabwo bagachirusia, bagaching’a, na inche ngachiruta ase omorero ime, na emori eye ekabao.”

English: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),
Kiswahili: Mose akaona kuwa watu wameasi, kwa kuwa Aroni alikuwa amewaacha waasi, na hivyo kuwa kichekesho kwa adui zao.
Ekegusii: Musa akarora abanto bakoonchobana, na buna Aroni abatigete baonchobaane na gosasiima omogwekano oria, ase amasio ’ababisa babo.

English: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akasimama kwenye ingilio la kambi, akasema, “Yeyote aliye upande wa Bwana, aje upande wangu.” Walawi wote wakamjia.
Ekegusii: Agwo Musa agatenena geita ki’egetwori, akabora, “Onde bwensi oyore ensemo y’Omonene ache aa ase ’nde.” Abana bonsi ba Lawi bagasangererekana asare.

English: He said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”
Kiswahili: Ndipo alipowaambia, “Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli asemalo: ‘Kila mmoja wenu ajifunge upanga wake kiunoni aende huku na huko kambi yote mwisho hadi mwisho mwingine, kila mmoja amuue ndugu yake, na rafiki yake na jirani yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, Omonene Nyasae, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oteebire iga “Kera oyomo oino abogorie omoyio oye o birende, agende aaria na aaria ase egetwori korwa egeita ekemo goika ekende. Kera oyomo aite onde bwensi aranyore, nonya noyomwabo, gose omosani, gose omogisangio”.

English: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.
Kiswahili: Walawi wakafanya kama Mose alivyoamuru, siku ile wakafa watu wapatao 3,000.
Ekegusii: Abana ba Lawi bagakora buna Musa abateebeetie, na abanto chilifu isato bagaitwa ase rituko erio.

English: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to Yahweh, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akasema, “Leo mmewekwa wakfu kwa Bwana, kwa kuwa mlikuwa kinyume na wana wenu wenyewe na ndugu zenu, naye Mungu amewabariki leo.”
Ekegusii: Musa akabateebia. “Reero inwe mweatananire ase ogokorera Omonene, kera oyomo ase rigori ria mosubati omwabo gose momura omwabo; ase ig’Omonene obasesenirie reero.”

English: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata Mose akawaambia watu, “Mmefanya dhambi kubwa. Lakini sasa nitapanda juu kwa Bwana, labda nitaweza kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi yenu.”
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Musa agateebia abanto, “Mwakorire ebibe ebinene mono. Na bono ngotiira inde gochia ase Omonene, aande nabo ndabanyorere okobwatanigwa, ekiagera mwakorire ebibe.”

English: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mose akarudi kwa Bwana na kumwambia, “Lo! Hawa watu wamefanya dhambi kubwa namna gani! Wamejitengenezea miungu ya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamoteebia, “Abanto aba bakorire ebibe ebinene mono, bekoreire enyasae y’etaabu.

English: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa nakusihi, wasamehe dhambi yao; lakini kama sivyo, basi nifute kutoka kwenye kitabu ulichoandika.”
Ekegusii: Na bono, koranche, obaabere ebibe biabo. Onye taibo, rirorio otinyie erieta riane korwa ase egetabu eria kwarigete.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamjibu Mose, “Yeyote aliyenitenda dhambi ndiye nitakayemfuta kutoka kwenye kitabu changu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Omonto oria onkoreire ebibe, nere ndatinyie erieta riaye korwa ase egetabu yane.

English: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”
Kiswahili: Sasa nenda, uongoze hao watu mpaka mahali nilipokuambia, naye malaika wangu atakutangulia. Pamoja na hayo, wakati utakapofika wa mimi kuwaadhibu, nitawaadhibu kwa ajili ya dhambi yao.”
Ekegusii: Korende bono genda, oraae abanto abwo goika aase aria nagotebetie; omomalaika one nagotang’ane. Korende rituko ndiche ekero ndabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.”

English: Yahweh struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akawapiga watu kwa ugonjwa wa tauni kwa sababu ya yale waliyoyafanya kwa ndama yule ambaye alitengenezwa na Aroni.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabaa egesusuro, ekiagera bagerete Aroni agakora emori eria, bakayesasiima.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Ondoka mahali hapa, wewe pamoja na hao watu uliowapandisha kutoka Misri, mpande mpaka nchi niliyomwahidi Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo kwa kiapo, nikisema, ‘Nitawapa wazao wenu nchi hii.’
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, Imoka korwa aa ogende, aye amo nabaanto aba kwang’anyetie korwa Misiri, obaire ase ense eria narierete Aburaamu na Isaka na Yakobo eira, ngateba “Ning’ee ororeria rwaino ense eyio.

English: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Nitamtuma malaika mbele yenu, naye atawafukuza Wakanaani, Waamori, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.
Ekegusii: Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane, Niserie Abakanaani, na Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi na Abayebusi.

English: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”
Kiswahili: Pandeni mwende katika nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali. Lakini mimi sitakwenda pamoja nanyi, kwa sababu ninyi ni watu wenye shingo ngumu, nisije nikawaangamiza njiani.”
Ekegusii: Nimbaire ase ense ere entenenku y’amabeere na amooke. Inche omonyene tinkogenda amo nainwe, mbaise kobaitera inchera, ekiagera inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u.”

English: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.
Kiswahili: Watu waliposikia habari hizo za huzuni, wakaanza kuomboleza wala hakuna mtu aliyevaa mapambo yoyote.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baigwete amang’ana ayio amakong’u bakarera na onde taba obegete ebinto biaye bi’ogwechabera.

English: Yahweh had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa amemwambia Mose, “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Ninyi ni watu wenye shingo ngumu. Kama ningefuatana nanyi hata kwa muda mfupi, ningewaangamiza. Sasa vueni mapambo yenu, nami nitaamua nitakalowatendea.’ ”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa “Bateebie Abaisraeli: Inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u. Inse kogenda amo nainwe, nonya netagika eyemo, nigo ndabasirie kegima. Gaki bono rusia ebinto biaino ebi mwechaberete, erio ndore inki ndabakorere.”

English: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Waisraeli wakavua mapambo yao katika Mlima wa Horebu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakarusia ebinto biria bechaberete, na tibabibeka korwa ekero baruete egetunwa kia Horebu nakogenderera.

English: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought Yahweh went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.
Kiswahili: Basi Mose alikuwa na desturi ya kuchukua hema na kuliweka wakfu nje ya kambi umbali kiasi, akaliita “Hema la Kukutania.” Kila aliyekuwa akiulizia shauri kwa Bwana, angelikwenda katika Hema la Kukutania nje ya kambi.
