Ekegusii: Musa nigo anarete koira eema na koyetenenia are ake korwa ase egetwori akayeroka “Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Na onde bwensi oganetie kobori’Omonene ring’ana, goika are kogende ase Eema eria, isiko y’egetwori.

English: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.
Kiswahili: Wakati wowote Mose alipokwenda kwenye Hema, watu wote waliinuka na kusimama kwenye maingilio ya mahema yao, wakimwangalia Mose mpaka aingie kwenye Hema.
Ekegusii: Engaki ende yonsi Musa arenge kogenda ase Eema eria, abanto bonsi nigo baare koimoka na gotenena, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye, na korigereria Musa goika osoire Eema eria ime.

English: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and Yahweh spoke with Moses.
Kiswahili: Kila mara Mose alipoingia ndani ya hema, nguzo ya wingu ingeshuka chini na kukaa kwenye ingilio, wakati Mungu akizungumza na Mose.
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa asoire Eema eria, riire riare buna esiiro riba rigoika na gotenena ase egesoero ki’Eema eria, n’Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa.

English: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.
Kiswahili: Kila mara watu walipoona hiyo nguzo ya wingu ikiwa imesimama kwenye ingilio la hema, wote walisimama wakaabudu, kila mmoja kwenye ingilio la hema lake.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi barorire riire riria rigotenena ase egesoero ki’Eema, baba bakoimoka na gotung’ama inse ase ogosasiima, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.
Kiswahili: Bwana angezungumza na Mose uso kwa uso, kama vile mtu azungumzavyo na rafiki yake. Kisha Mose angerudi kambini, lakini msaidizi wake kijana Yoshua mwana wa Nuni hakuondoka mle Hemani.
Ekegusii: Na Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa obosio ase obosio, buna omonto agokwana nomonto onde. Erio Musa aba okoirana gochia ase egetwori, korende Yoshua, omosomba oye omosae, mosinto o Nuni, tare korua ase Eema eria.

English: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Umekuwa ukiniambia, ‘Ongoza watu hawa,’ lakini hujanifahamisha ni nani utakayemtuma pamoja nami. Umesema, ‘Ninakujua wewe kwa jina lako, nawe umepata kibali mbele zangu.’
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Rora, aye nigo gwantebeetie: Baire abanto aba, korende tigwanteebia ng’a ning’o oratome agende amo nainche. Naende oganteebia: Ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa; naye kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane.

English: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa umependezwa nami, nifundishe njia zako ili nipate kukujua, nami nizidi kupata kibali mbele zako. Kumbuka kuwa taifa hili ni watu wako.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire, onyorokie chinchera chiao, erinde inyare gokomanya na konyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, naende rigereria ng’a abanto b’egesaku eke nabaanto bao bare.”

English: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akajibu, “Uso wangu utakwenda pamoja nawe, nami nitakupa raha.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Inche omonyene nigo ndagende amo naye, na ninkoe obotoereru.”

English: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia, “Kama Uso wako hauendi pamoja nasi, usituondoe hapa.
Ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Onye aye omonyene tokogenda amo naintwe, rirorio totige, tobeere aa.

English: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote atajuaje kuwa mimi pamoja na watu wako tumepata kibali mbele zako, usipokwenda pamoja nasi? Ni nini kingine kitakachoweza kututofautisha mimi na watu wako miongoni mwa watu wengine wote walio katika uso wa dunia?”
Ekegusii: Naki eramanyekane ng’a inche na abanto bao twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, onye tokogenda amo naintwe? Koragende amo naintwe, natororekane ng’a twachorirwe korwa ase abanto bande b’ense eye.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nitakufanyia jambo lile uliloomba, kwa sababu ninapendezwa nawe, nami ninakujua kwa jina lako.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Ninkore erio kwamboria, ekiagera kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane, na inche ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa.”

English: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akasema, “Basi nionyeshe utukufu wako.”
Ekegusii: Musa akamosaba, “Koranche, onyorokie obonene bwao!”

English: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akasema, “Nitapitisha wema wangu wote mbele yako, nami nitalitangaza Jina langu, Bwana, mbele ya uso wako. Nitamrehemu yeye nimrehemuye, na pia nitamhurumia yeye nimhurumiaye.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ninkore obosiani bwane bwonsi boete ase obosio bwao, na erieta riane, inche Omonene, nindirarie ase obosio bwao. Nimororere amabeebe oyio ndarorere amabeebe, na nimororere amaabera oyio ndarorere amaabera.”

English: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu akasema, “Hutaweza kuuona uso wangu, kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kuniona akaishi.”
Ekegusii: Naende akamokania, akamoteebia, “Tokonyara korora obosio bwane, ekiagera Mwanyabaanto aise kondora, takonyara koba moyo.”

English: Yahweh also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akasema, “Kuna mahali karibu nami ambapo unaweza kusimama juu ya mwamba.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akagenderera komoteebia, “Rora, aase aiga are ang’e nainche, aye oranyare gotenena egetare igoro.

English: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;
Kiswahili: Utukufu wangu unapopita, nitakuweka gengeni kwenye mwamba na kukufunika kwa mkono wangu mpaka nitakapokwisha kupita.
Ekegusii: Erio ekero obonene bwane borabe bogoeta, ninkobeke ase omotaro bw’egetare keria, na ngotube nokoboko kwane, goika imbe naetire.

English: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”
Kiswahili: Kisha nitaondoa mkono wangu nawe utaona mgongo wangu; lakini kamwe uso wangu hautaonekana.”
Ekegusii: Erio ndusie okoboko kwane, na aye ondore amagega aane, korende obosio bwane tokonyara koborora.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Chonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, nami nitaandika juu yake maneno yale yaliyokuwa kwenye vile vibao vya kwanza, ulivyovivunja.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Baacha chibao chi’amagena ibere chire buna chiria chi’eritang’ani, na inche nindiike ase chibao echio amang’ana aria arenge ase chiria chi’eritang’ani, echio gwatete.

English: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.
Kiswahili: Uwe tayari asubuhi, kisha upande juu ya Mlima Sinai. Uje mbele zangu kukutana nami huko juu ya mlima.
Ekegusii: Oche bwebeeke ang’e mambia, otiire gocha ase egetunwa gia Sinai maambia, bweorokie aroro ase inde ase egechuria ki’egetunwa.

English: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asije pamoja nawe, wala asionekane mtu popote juu ya mlima, wala kondoo na mbuzi au ngʼombe wasilishe karibu mbele ya huo mlima.”
Ekegusii: Monto onde tatiira amo naye, gose monto onde tarorekana aande onsi ase egetunwa eke, gose ching’ondi ne chiombe tichiba chikorisia ang’e negetunwa eke.”

English: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as Yahweh had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akachonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, naye akapanda juu ya Mlima Sinai asubuhi na mapema, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza, akachukua vile vibao viwili vya mawe mikononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akabaacha chibao ibere chi’amagena chire buna chiria chi’eritang’ani, akaimoka mambia chuni, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochikiire, obogoretie chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena koboko kwaye.

English: Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akashuka katika wingu akasimama pamoja naye huko, akalitangaza jina lake, Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene agaika ore riire ime, agatenena amo nere, akararia erieta NYASAE OMOBUI.

English: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,
Kiswahili: Bwana akapita mbele ya Mose, akitangaza, “Bwana, Bwana, Mungu mwenye huruma na neema, asiye mwepesi wa hasira, mwingi wa upendo na uaminifu,
Ekegusii: Omonene agaeta ase obosio bwa Musa, akeraria, “Omonene Nyasae, nere Nyasae omonyene amaabera na obuya, tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu; nigo are nobwanchani botari koera, na obwegenwa.

English: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”
Kiswahili: akidumisha upendo kwa maelfu, pia akisamehe uovu, uasi na dhambi. Lakini haachi kuadhibu mwenye hatia; huwaadhibu watoto na watoto wao kwa ajili ya dhambi ya baba zao hata katika kizazi cha tatu na cha nne.”
Ekegusii: Nigo agokorera ebiare chilifu obwanchani botari koera; ere nigo akwabera amamocho, na ogosaria, na ebibe, korende tagotiga koa abana na abachokoro egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane ase engencho y’amabe ’abaibori babo.”

English: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.
Kiswahili: Mara Mose akasujudu na kuabudu.
Ekegusii: Erio bwango Musa agatung’ama inse agatureka omotwe, agasasiima,

English: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”
Kiswahili: Mose akasema, “Ee Bwana, kama nimepata kibali mbele zako, basi Bwana uende pamoja nasi. Ingawa watu hawa ni wenye shingo ngumu, samehe uovu wetu na dhambi yetu, tuchukue kuwa urithi wako.”
Ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene, onye bono nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire ogende amo naintwe. Naki abanto aba nabanyabigoti bikong’u, korende otwabere ogosaria gwaito na ebibe biaito, otwanchere tobe abanto bao.”

English: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of Yahweh; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akasema: “Tazama ninafanya Agano mbele ya watu wako wote. Mbele ya watu wako wote nitafanya maajabu ambayo hayajafanyika katika taifa lolote katika ulimwengu wote. Watu wale mnaoishi miongoni mwao wataona jinsi ilivyo ya kushangaza ile kazi nitakayowafanyia mimi Bwana wenu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Rora, bono ngokora inde nainwe okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Ase amasio ’abaanto bao bonsi ninkore ebikone ebio bitana gokoreka ase ense yonsi, gose ase egesaku kende gionsi. Na abanto bonsi abagoetanaine inabarore ogokora kw’Omonene, naki ayio ndagokorere namang’ana ay’okoondokia.

English: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Tii yale ninayokuamuru leo. Tazama nawafukuza mbele yako Waamori, Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.
Ekegusii: Obwate amachiiko ayio ndakoe reero. Norore ase obosio bwao ngoseria Abaamori, na Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.

English: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;
Kiswahili: Uwe mwangalifu, usifanye agano na wale wanaokaa katika nchi ile unayoiendea, la sivyo watakuwa mtego katikati yako.
Ekegusii: Bwerende, tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria ase okogenda, baabaise kobatega mogwe.

English: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;
Kiswahili: Bomoa madhabahu yao, vunja mawe yao ya kuabudia na ukatekate nguzo zao za Ashera.
Ekegusii: Inwe motagore ebisasimero biabo, mobiiyerie inse, na gosenyenta chisiiro chi’amagena ase bagosasimera.

English: for you shall worship no other god; for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
Kiswahili: Usiabudu mungu mwingine, kwa kuwa Bwana, ambaye jina lake ni Wivu, ni Mungu mwenye wivu.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosasiima enyasae ende eng’ao, ekiagera Omonene nigo akorokwa Omonyaisemi, nere Nyasae bwe risemi.

English: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;
Kiswahili: “Uwe mwangalifu usifanye agano na wale watu wanaoishi katika nchi, kwa maana wakati wanapojifanyia ukahaba kwa miungu yao na kuwatolea kafara, watakualika wewe nawe utakula sadaka za matambiko yao.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria, ekiagera ekero bagokora obotomani ase ogosasiima chinyasae chiabo na gochiruera ebing’wanso, mbaabaise kobarangeria inwe morie ebing’wanso biabo.

English: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.
Kiswahili: Unapowachagua baadhi ya binti zao kuwa wake wa wana wenu na binti hao wakajifanyia ukahaba kwa miungu yao, watawaongoza wana wenu kufanya vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Inamoire abakungu korwa ase abasubati babo abwo bagokora obotomani ase ogosasiima chinyasae chiabo, barabwo bakore abamura baino basasime chinyasae chiabo.

English: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.
Kiswahili: “Usijifanyie sanamu za kusubu.
Ekegusii: “Tibwekorera chinyasae korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa.

English: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu. Kwa siku saba mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu, kama nilivyokuamuru. Fanya hivi kwa wakati ulioamriwa, katika mwezi wa Abibu, ndio mwezi wa nne, kwa kuwa katika mwezi huo ndipo wewe ulipotoka Misri.
Ekegusii: “Orende rituko rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera; na buna nagochigeete, orie emegati etabekiri memera ase amatuko atano na abere, ase engaki yachigetwe, y’omotienyi bw’Abibu, naki ase omotienyi oyio oyio noro kwaruete ense ya Misiri.

English: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
Kiswahili: “Mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kila tumbo ni mali yangu, pamoja na wazaliwa wa kwanza wote wa kiume wa mifugo yako, ikiwa ni wa ngʼombe au wa kondoo au mbuzi.
Ekegusii: “Kera omwana omoisia omotangi nabe oyone, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo, chibe chieri gose chimingichi.

English: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.
Kiswahili: Utakomboa mzaliwa wa kwanza wa punda kwa mwana-kondoo, lakini kama humkomboi, utavunja shingo yake. Utakomboa wazaliwa wako wa kwanza wote wa kiume. “Mtu yeyote asije mbele zangu mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Korende emori entangi y’etigere goika oyeboorie ase okorua eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso. Onye tibwancheti koyebooria, goika oyebune ebigoti. Abana bao abaisia abatangi goika obaboorie. Onde tari orabe ogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, namaboko amasa.

English: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.
Kiswahili: “Kwa siku sita utafanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba utapumzika, hata ikiwa ni majira ya kulima au ya kuvuna lazima upumzike.
Ekegusii: “Okore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere otimoke, nonya nengaki y’okorema na eye rigesa.

English: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.
Kiswahili: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Majuma kwa malimbuko ya mavuno ya ngano, na Sikukuu ya Mavuno mwishoni mwa mwaka.
Ekegusii: “Orende Rituko Rinene rie Chichuma, ase engencho y’ogotongora kw’engano, ne Rituko Rinene ri’Ogosangereria Rigesa, omoerio bw’omwaka.

English: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mara tatu kwa mwaka wanaume wako wote watakuja mbele za Bwana Mwenyezi, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao bonsi abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene Nyasae, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before Yahweh, your God, three times in the year.
Kiswahili: Nitawafukuza mataifa mbele yako na kupanua mipaka ya nchi yako, wala hakuna mtu yeyote atakayeitamani nchi yako wakati unapokwenda mara tatu kila mwaka kuonana na Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Ninserie abanto b’ebisaku korwa asore na kogareyia orogongo rwao, onde tari orakoroure ase chingaki echi isato kera omwaka, ekero orabe kogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Nyasae oo.

English: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.
Kiswahili: “Usinitolee damu ya dhabihu pamoja na kitu chochote chenye chachu, wala usibakize dhabihu yoyote ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka mpaka asubuhi.
Ekegusii: “Ekero okondetera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso, tobaisa koyandetera amo nomogati obekire ememera. Tobaisa gotigaria chinyama chinde chi’ekeng’wanso kie rituko rinene ri’Epasaka goika mambia.

English: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
Kiswahili: “Leta matunda ya kwanza yaliyo bora zaidi ya ardhi yako katika nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wako. “Usimchemshe mwana-mbuzi katika maziwa ya mama yake.”
Ekegusii: “Goika orente ase enyomba yane, inche Omonene oo, ogotongora kwao okore okuya korwa ase omogondo oo. “Tobaisa koiyekera emanwa y’embori, gose yeng’ondi ime y’amabeere ’eng’ina.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Andika maneno haya, kwa maana kulingana na maneno haya, nimefanya Agano na wewe pamoja na Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Riika amang’ana aya, ekiagera ase amang’ana ayio nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania naye amo n’Abaisraeli.”

English: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
Kiswahili: Mose alikuwa huko pamoja na Bwana kwa siku arobaini usiku na mchana bila kula chakula wala kunywa maji. Naye akaandika juu ya vibao maneno ya Agano, yaani zile Amri Kumi.
Ekegusii: Musa akabeera n’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, tare koria kende, gose konywa, akarika ase chibao echi ibere amang’ana ’okobwatana koria, Amachiiko ayio ikomi.

English: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.
Kiswahili: Mose alipoteremka kutoka Mlima Sinai akiwa na vile vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda mikononi mwake, hakujua kuwa uso wake ulikuwa ukingʼaa, kwa sababu alikuwa amezungumza na Bwana.
Ekegusii: Musa agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, obwate ase okoboko kwaye chibao chiriikire oborori, ere tamanya ng’a risankwa ri’obosio bwaye nigo riare komeka‐meka, ekiagera konya okwanire n’Omonene.

English: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.
Kiswahili: Aroni na Waisraeli wote walipomwona Mose, kuwa uso wake unangʼaa, waliogopa kumkaribia.
Ekegusii: Aroni na abanto bonsi, ekero baroche buna risankwa ri’obosio bwa Musa riare komeka‐meka, bakoboa komoika ang’e.

English: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akawaita, kwa hiyo Aroni na viongozi wote wa jumuiya wakarudi, naye akazungumza nao.
Ekegusii: Korende Musa akabarangeria, erio Aroni amo nabatang’ani bonsi b’omosangererekano bakairana asare, na Musa agakwana nabarabwo.

English: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that Yahweh had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
Kiswahili: Baadaye Waisraeli wote wakamkaribia, naye akawapa amri zote Bwana alizompa katika Mlima wa Sinai.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bagacha ase Musa, na ere akabaa amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene konya amoeire ase egetunwa gia Sinai.

English: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
Kiswahili: Mose alipomaliza kuzungumza nao, akaweka utaji kwenye uso wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana nabarabwo, akabeeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye.

English: But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila wakati Mose alipoingia mbele za Bwana kuzungumza naye, aliondoa ule utaji mpaka alipotoka nje. Naye alipotoka nje na kuwaambia Waisraeli lile ambalo ameagizwa,
Ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi Musa are gosoa eema ase obosio bw’Omonene gokwana nere, nigo are korusia egietubo goika osoka korwa aroro. Ekero asokire aba ogoteebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi aya achikirwe gokwana,

English: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
Kiswahili: waliona kuwa uso wake unangʼaa. Kisha Mose angeliweka tena utaji juu ya uso wake mpaka alipokwenda kuzungumza na Bwana.
Ekegusii: na barabwo baba bakorora risankwa ri’obosio bwaye rikomeka‐meka. Erio Musa abeeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye goika airana naende gokwana n’Omonene.

English: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.
Kiswahili: Mose akakusanya jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli na kuwaambia, “Haya ndiyo mambo ambayo Bwana amewaamuru ninyi mfanye:
Ekegusii: Musa akarangeria omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli amo, akabateebia, “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire morakore:

English: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.
Kiswahili: Kwa siku sita, mtafanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba itakuwa takatifu kwenu, Sabato ya kupumzika kwa Bwana. Yeyote atakayefanya kazi yoyote siku hiyo ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Mokore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nigo rirabe richenu ase more, rituko ri’Esabato, riogotimoka ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.

English: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”
Kiswahili: Msiwashe moto mahali popote katika makazi yenu siku ya Sabato.”
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gouta omorero ase rituko ri’Esabato, aande onsi ase momenyete.”

English: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,
Kiswahili: Mose akaiambia jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli, “Hili ndilo Bwana aliloamuru:
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire:

English: ‘Take from among you an offering to Yahweh. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as Yahweh’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,
Kiswahili: Toeni sadaka kwa Bwana kutoka mali mliyo nayo. Kila mmoja aliye na moyo wa kupenda atamletea Bwana sadaka ya dhahabu, fedha na shaba;
Ekegusii: Moruere Omonene ebiegwa. Kera omonto oyore nomoyo bw’ogwancha aruere Omonene ebinto ebi: Etaabu, na efeta, na etai;

English: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
Kiswahili: nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi; singa za mbuzi;
Ekegusii: chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;

English: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
Kiswahili: mafuta ya zeituni kwa ajili ya taa; vikolezi kwa ajili ya mafuta ya upako, pamoja na uvumba wa harufu nzuri;
Ekegusii: amaguta e chitaaya, na ebinto bi’okoroisia amaguta akweakwa, na ebi’okoroisia ubani;

English: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
Kiswahili: vito vya shohamu, na vito vingine vya thamani vya kuweka kwenye kisibau na kile kifuko cha kifuani.
Ekegusii: amagena e rigori rinene buna oiniki na ayande akobekwa ase egesibao na egesembe ki’obokuani.”

English: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded:
Kiswahili: “Wote wenye ujuzi miongoni mwenu inawapasa kuja na kutengeneza kila kitu Bwana alichoamuru:
Ekegusii: “Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini abare ase egati yaino, tiga bache baroisie ebinto bionsi Omonene achiikire,

English: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
Kiswahili: Maskani pamoja na hema lake na kifuniko chake, vibanio, mihimili, mataruma, nguzo na vitako;
Ekegusii: nabio ebi: Obomenyo na eema yaye, na egietubo kiaye, ebigobanio ne chibao chiaye, na emeriibo, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo;

English: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Agano pamoja na mipiko yake, kifuniko cha kiti cha rehema na pazia linalokizuia;
Ekegusii: Esanduki na emiaro yaye, na Oboikaranso bw’amaabera, na etoto eria erabeekwe ebokenge;

English: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;
Kiswahili: meza na mipiko yake pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote, mikate ya Wonyesho;
Ekegusii: emesa na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na emegati eria eraruegwe ase Nyasae;

English: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;
Kiswahili: kinara cha taa kwa ajili ya mwanga pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote, taa na mafuta kwa ajili ya mwanga;
Ekegusii: ekebekerero gie chitaaya na ebikorero biaye, ne chitaaya chiaye amo namaguta e chitaaya,

English: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
Kiswahili: madhabahu ya kufukiza uvumba pamoja na mipiko yake, mafuta ya upako na uvumba wenye harufu nzuri; pazia la mlangoni mahali pa kuingilia ndani ya maskani;
Ekegusii: na egesasiimero ase ubani egosamberwa amo nemiaro yaye, na amaguta akweakwa, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya, na ebitambaa bigosungwa ase egesoero ki’Obomenyo obwo;

English: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;
Kiswahili: madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketeza pamoja na wavu wake wa shaba, mipiko yake pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote; sinia la shaba pamoja na tako lake;
Ekegusii: na egesasiimero aase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa amo negechungi kiaye gi’etai, na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye;

English: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
Kiswahili: pazia la eneo la ua pamoja na nguzo zake na vitako vyake, pazia la ingilio la kwenye ua;
Ekegusii: ebitambaa ebirakenge eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiaye, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro,

English: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;
Kiswahili: vigingi vya hema kwa ajili ya maskani pamoja na ua na kamba zake;
Ekegusii: na ebirochi bi’Obomenyo na ebi’eraaro amo ne chingori chiabo,

English: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”
Kiswahili: mavazi yaliyofumwa yanayovaliwa wakati wa huduma katika mahali patakatifu, yaani mavazi matakatifu kwa ajili ya kuhani Aroni, na mavazi kwa ajili ya wanawe watakapokuwa wakihudumu katika kazi ya ukuhani.”
Ekegusii: ne chianga chiria chinseera chigokorerwa ime y’Ase Achenu, engencho yaye chianga chia Aroni Omokuani, amo nechi’abamura baye, barabe bakobeeka ekero bagokora emeremo yabo y’obokuani.”

English: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
Kiswahili: Ndipo jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli ilipoondoka mbele ya Mose,
Ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okaruao agwo ase obosio bwa Musa.

English: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.
Kiswahili: na kila mmoja aliyependa na ambaye moyo wake ulimsukuma alikuja na kuleta sadaka kwa Bwana, kwa ajili ya kazi katika Hema la Kukutania, kwa ajili ya huduma yake yote na kwa ajili ya mavazi matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naende bakairana kera oyomo buna enkoro yaye yamosugetie, na buna anchete ere omonyene, bakarentera Omonene ebiegwa biabo ase okoroisia Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebinto bionsi ebiaganeirie, ase emeremo eria na ase chianga chiria chinchenu.

English: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wote waliokuwa na utayari, wanaume kwa wanawake, wakaja wakaleta vito vya dhahabu vya kila aina: vipini, vipuli, pete na mapambo. Wote wakatoa dhahabu zao kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha, abasacha na abakungu, na ase ogwancha kwabo bakarenta amameka, na ebigera bi’amato abo, ne chibonyi chi’ebiara, ne chisonoi, na ebinto ao ao bie chitaabu bi’ogwechabera. Kera omonto akarenta ebinto bie chitaabu, ebi aatananete ase ogokorera Omonene.

English: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja aliyekuwa na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, au za rangi nyekundu au kitani safi, au singa za mbuzi, ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, au ngozi za pomboo, wakavileta.
Ekegusii: Naende kera omonto oyo obwate chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na egatani engiya, na amanya e chimbori, na amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa e ching’iti chia rooche, akabirenta.

English: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought Yahweh’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
Kiswahili: Wale waliotoa sadaka ya fedha au shaba wakavileta kama sadaka kwa Bwana, na kila aliyekuwa na mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya kazi yoyote ile akauleta.
Ekegusii: Bonsi abaare konyara korua chifeta ne chitaai bakabirenta bibe ebiegwa ase Omonene, na bonsi abarenge nemekonge eyere emiya ase emeremo ende yonsi, bakayerenta.

English: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
Kiswahili: Kila mwanamke aliyekuwa na ujuzi alisokota kwa mikono yake na alileta kile alichosokota, iwe ni nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, au za rangi nyekundu au kitani safi.
Ekegusii: Na abakungu abaroisia abang’aini bagasisa namaboko abo chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, bagachirenta.

English: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wote waliopenda na waliokuwa na ujuzi wakasokota singa za mbuzi.
Ekegusii: Na abakungu bonsi, abasugetigwe ase emioyo yabo, naende bamanyete emeremo eye, bagasisa amanya e chimbori abe chiusi.

English: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;
Kiswahili: Viongozi wakaleta vito vya shohamu pamoja na vito vingine vya thamani kwa ajili ya kuweka kwenye kisibau na kwenye kifuko cha kifuani.
Ekegusii: Abatang’ani babo bakarenta amagena e rigori rinene buna oiniki na ayande arabekwe ase egesibao na egesembe ki’obokuani,

English: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
Kiswahili: Wakaleta pia vikolezi na mafuta ya zeituni kwa ajili ya mwanga, kwa ajili ya mafuta ya upako na kwa ajili ya uvumba wenye harufu nzuri.
Ekegusii: naende ebinto bie rimisu rigiya amo namaguta e chitaaya, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya.

English: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to Yahweh; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wote waume kwa wake waliokuwa wanapenda wakaleta mbele za Bwana kwa hiari yao wenyewe sadaka kwa ajili ya kazi yote ya Bwana aliyokuwa amewaagiza kuifanya kupitia kwa Mose.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, abarenge nogwancha korenta ebinto bi’emeremo eye Omonene achigete goetera ase Musa, bakarenta ebiegwa biabo ase Omonene.

English: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akawaambia Waisraeli, “Tazameni, Bwana amemchagua Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, wa kabila la Yuda,
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli, Rora, Omonene ochorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

English: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;
Kiswahili: naye amemjaza Roho wa Mungu, pamoja na ustadi, na uwezo na ujuzi katika aina zote za ufundi,
Ekegusii: Omoichoirie omoika o Nyasae, omoeire obong’aini ne chisemi anyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,

English: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,
Kiswahili: ili kubuni michoro ya kupendeza katika ufundi wa dhahabu, fedha na shaba,
Ekegusii: abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai,

English: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.
Kiswahili: kuchonga vito na kuvitia mahali, kufanya ufundi kwa mbao, na kujishughulisha na aina zote za ufundi wa kupendeza.
Ekegusii: abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.

English: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
Kiswahili: Tena amempa yeye pamoja na Oholiabu, mwana wa Ahisamaki, wa kabila la Dani, uwezo wa kufundisha wengine.
Ekegusii: Omonene omoeire ere amo na Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, obong’aini bw’okworokereria abande oboroisia bwabo.

English: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.
Kiswahili: Amewajaza ustadi wa kufanya kazi za aina zote zifanywazo na mafundi, na wenye kubuni michoro, pia na watarizi kwa rangi za buluu, zambarau, nyekundu na kitani safi, na wafumaji: wote wakiwa mafundi na wabunifu hodari.
Ekegusii: Obaichoirie obong’aini ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi buna okomang’a, na okoroberia, na koroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, na koroisia ebitambaa binde bionsi. Banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi na bamanye koroberia oboroisia bonde bwonsi.

English: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bezaleli, Oholiabu na kila mtu Bwana aliyempa ustadi na uwezo wa kujua jinsi ya kufanya kazi zote za kujenga mahali patakatifu wataifanya hiyo kazi kama vile Bwana alivyoagiza.”
Ekegusii: Besaleli na Oholiabu amo nabaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene konya aeire obong’aini, abare nogwancha kw’ogokora emeremo ende yonsi egwenerete ase okoagacha Obomenyo Obochenu, goika bakore kera emeremo buna Omonene konya achiikire.

English: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Yahweh had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akawaita Bezaleli na Oholiabu na kila mtu mwenye ustadi ambaye Bwana alikuwa amempa uwezo na mwenye kupenda kuja na kufanya kazi.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Besaleli amo na Oholiabu na abaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene aeire obong’aini, abaasugetigwe ase chinkoro chiabo, bache, bachake emeremo eria.

English: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.
Kiswahili: Wakapokea kutoka kwa Mose sadaka zote ambazo Waisraeli walikuwa wameleta ili kuifanya kazi ya ujenzi wa Mahali Patakatifu. Nao watu wakaendelea kuleta sadaka za hiari kila asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa korwa ase Musa ebiegwa ebi bionsi Abaisraeli konya barentire ase okoroisia Obomenyo boria Obochenu. Na Abaisraeli bakagenderera komorentera ebiegwa biabo kera emambia.

English: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.
Kiswahili: Ikafika wakati mafundi wote wenye ujuzi waliokuwa wakiifanya kazi yote ya mahali patakatifu wakasimamisha kazi zao,
Ekegusii: Erio abaroisia baria abang’aini, abarenge gokora emeremo ende yonsi ase Obomenyo boria Obochenu, magega kobatigire emeremo eye baare gokora bagacha ase Musa,

English: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”
Kiswahili: wakaja na kumwambia Mose, “Watu wanaleta vitu vingi kuliko tunavyohitaji kwa ajili ya kazi hii ambayo Bwana ameagiza ifanyike.”
Ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Abanto barentire ebiegwa ebinge goetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eri’Omonene achigete ekorwe.”

English: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akatoa agizo, nao wakapeleka neno hili katika kambi yote: “Mtu yeyote mwanaume au mwanamke asilete tena kitu chochote kwa ajili ya sadaka ya mahali patakatifu.” Hivyo watu wakazuiliwa kuleta zaidi,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akarareria abanto bonsi b’egetwori, akabachiika, “Onde tabaisa korenta ebiegwa binde goetania ebi konya biasangererigwe ase Obomenyo Obochenu, abe omosacha gose omokungu.” Ase igo abanto bagatiga korenta ebiegwa binde.

English: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu walivyokuwa navyo tayari vilitosha na kuzidi kuifanya kazi yote.
Ekegusii: Ebi konya barentire nigo biabeete ebinge, bigaetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eria yare gocha gokorwa.

English: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.
Kiswahili: Watu wote wenye ustadi miongoni mwa wafanyakazi wote wakatengeneza maskani kwa mapazia kumi ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, naye fundi stadi akatirizi makerubi kwenye mapazia hayo.
Ekegusii: Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini b’abakori emeremo bakaroisia eema y’Obomenyo. Bakayeroisia nebitambaa ikomi, biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chimbariri Omoroisia omong’aini akabiroisia, bire nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

English: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
Kiswahili: Mapazia yote yalitoshana kwa ukubwa: kila moja lilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa ishirini na nane, na upana wa dhiraa nne
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane; bionsi nigo biarenge bi’ekerengo ekemo.

English: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.
Kiswahili: Wakayaunganisha mapazia matano pamoja, pia wakafanya vivyo hivyo kwa hayo mengine matano.
Ekegusii: Akabwatania ebitambaa bitano amo, bikaba rirondia erimo. Naboigo nebitambaa binde bitano.

English: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakatengeneza vitanzi vya kitambaa cha buluu kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu la kwanza, pia wakafanya vivyo hivyo na pazia la fungu la mwisho.
Ekegusii: Agakora ebioro bie chiusi chiburu, bakabibeeka ase ensinyo y’egetambaa kere ensinyo y’ensemo ya kera rirondia.

English: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza pia vitanzi hamsini katika pazia mmoja, na vitanzi vingine hamsini kwenye pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine, nazo vitanzi vyote vikaelekeana.
Ekegusii: Agakora ebioro emerongo etano, akabibeeka ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bigachikana.

English: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakatengeneza vifungo hamsini vya dhahabu, na wakavitumia kufunga na kuunganisha zile fungu mbili za mapazia pamoja ili maskani ipate kuwa kitu kimoja.
Ekegusii: Agatura ebigobanio bie chitaabu emerongo etano, na ase ebio akabwatania amarondia ayio amo, akaba eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.

English: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza mapazia kumi na moja ya singa za mbuzi kwa ajili ya kufunika maskani.
Ekegusii: Erio akaroisia amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chigoree, akaba eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo boria.

English: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.
Kiswahili: Mapazia hayo kumi na moja yalikuwa na kipimo kimoja, yaani urefu wa dhiraa thelathini, na upana wa dhiraa nne.
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera rirondia nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi aya ikomi na rimo nigo arenge ay’ekerengo ekemo.

English: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
Kiswahili: Wakaunganisha mapazia matano kuwa fungu moja, na hayo mengine sita kuwa fungu lingine.
Ekegusii: Akabwatania amarondia atano amo, akaba rirondia erimo, naende atano na rimo akaba rirondia erimo.

English: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakatengeneza vitanzi hamsini kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu moja, na vivyo hivyo kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine.
Ekegusii: Agakora ebioro emerongo etano, akabibeeka ase ensinyo ye rirondia rinene rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase rirondia rinene ria kabere ase rigochakera.

English: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza vifungo hamsini vya shaba ili kukaza hema pamoja kuwa kitu kimoja.
Ekegusii: Naende agakora ebigobanio emerongo etano bie chitaai ase okobwaterania amarondia ayio abere, abe eema engima.

English: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakatengeneza kifuniko cha hema kwa ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, na juu yake kifuniko cha ngozi za pomboo.
Ekegusii: Agakora rirondia ri’amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ase ogotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri’amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, erirabeekwe igoro ye rirondia rie ritang’ani.

English: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza mihimili ya kusimamisha ya mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya maskani.
Ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, agachitenenia.

English: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.
Kiswahili: Kila mhimili ulikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa kumi, na upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu,
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera ebao nigo bware obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

English: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
Kiswahili: zikiwa na ndimi mbili zilizokuwa sambamba kila mmoja na mwingine. Wakatengeneza mihimili yote ya maskani jinsi hii.
Ekegusii: Agakora chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwateranigwe. Naboigo aroisetie chibao echi chionsi chi’Obomenyo.

English: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza mihimili ishirini kwa ajili ya upande wa kusini wa maskani,
Ekegusii: Akaroisia chibao emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya Irianyi.

English: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
Kiswahili: na wakatengeneza vitako arobaini vya fedha vya kuweka chini ya hiyo mihimili, vitako viwili kwa kila mhimili, kimoja chini ya kila ulimi.
Ekegusii: Agakora ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao ase chintamang’o chiaye ibere.

English: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards
Kiswahili: Kwa upande wa kaskazini wa maskani wakatengeneza mihimili ishirini
Ekegusii: Nase ensemo ya kabere, nero ya sugusu y’Obomenyo, akaroisia chibao emerongo ebere,

English: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
Kiswahili: na vitako arobaini vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.
Ekegusii: ne chinterekerero chiaye chi’echifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.

English: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza mihimili sita kwa mwisho ulio mbali, yaani upande wa magharibi wa maskani,
Ekegusii: Korende ase ensemo ya magega y’Obomenyo, eyerochie bosongo, akaroisia chibao isano nemo.

English: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
Kiswahili: na mihimili miwili ikatengenezwa kwa ajili ya pembe za maskani za upande uliokuwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chibao ibere chikaba chikoona chi’Obomenyo ensemo ya magega.

English: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.
Kiswahili: Katika pembe hizi mbili mihimili yake ilikuwa miwili kuanzia chini mpaka juu, na ikaingizwa kwenye pete moja; mihimili ya pembe hizi mbili ilifanana.
Ekegusii: Kera ebao ase echio ibere ekabwatanigwa ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere; naboigo bakorete ase chibao echio ibere echiabegetwe ase chikoona ibere.

English: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kulikuwa na mihimili minane, na vitako kumi na sita vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.
Ekegusii: Chibao chionsi nigo chiabeete isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chi’echifeta ikomi, na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.

English: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza pia mataruma kwa mti wa mshita: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mmoja wa maskani,
Ekegusii: Akabaacha emeriibo etano y’emekonge, eriibe chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,

English: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
Kiswahili: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mwingine, na matano kwa ajili mihimili ya upande wa magharibi, mwisho kabisa mwa maskani.
Ekegusii: na etano ase rikere rinde, na etano ase ensemo ya magega, eyerochie bosongo.

English: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza taruma la katikati, likapenya katikati ya mihimili kutoka mwisho mmoja hadi mwisho mwingine.
Ekegusii: Akabaacha omoriibo o gati‐gati omogima, ase okoriiba chibao korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.

English: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
Kiswahili: Wakaifunika hiyo mihimili kwa dhahabu, na wakatengeneza pete za dhahabu za kushikilia hayo mataruma. Pia wakayafunika hayo mataruma kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Erio akaooma chibao echio netaabu, agakora chibonyi chi’echitaabu ase emiaro erasoigwe, naende akaooma emeriibo eria netaabu.

English: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, naye fundi stadi akatirizi makerubi kwenye hilo pazia.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia etoto ye chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire. Omoroisia omong’aini akayeroisia ekaba emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

English: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
Kiswahili: Wakatengeneza nguzo nne za mti wa mshita kwa ajili yake na kuzifunika kwa dhahabu. Wakatengeneza kulabu za dhahabu kwa ajili ya nguzo hizo, na kusubu vitako vinne vya fedha.
Ekegusii: Naende akabaacha chisiiro inye chi’emekonge, agachiooma netaabu, na ebigobanio biaye bie chitaabu. Agakora chinterekerero inye korwa ase efeta enyititoire.

English: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya ingilio la hema wakatengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi.
Ekegusii: Na ase egesoero ki’Eema akaroisia egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani, keroisirie nomoroisia omong’aini.

English: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
Kiswahili: Pia wakatengeneza nguzo tano zenye kulabu. Wakafunika ncha za juu za hizo nguzo pamoja na tepe zake kwa dhahabu, na pia wakatengeneza vitako vyake vitano vya shaba.
Ekegusii: Bakabaacha chisiiro isano amo nebigobanio biabo, bakaooma ebisure ne chinuga chiabo netaabu. Chinterekerero chiabo isano nigo chiakorire korwa ase chitaai.

English: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
Kiswahili: Bezaleli akatengeneza Sanduku la mbao za mshita: urefu wake ulikuwa dhiraa mbili na nusu, upana wake dhiraa moja na nusu, na kimo chake dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: Erio Besaleli akaroisia Esanduki ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo, na ekeng’ese.

English: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
Kiswahili: Akalifunika kwa dhahabu safi ndani na nje, na kulizungushia ukingo wa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Akayeooma netaabu echenire, ime na isiko, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
Kiswahili: Akasubu pete nne za dhahabu na kuzifungia kwenye miguu yake minne, pete mbili kwa upande mmoja na pete mbili kwa upande mwingine.
Ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase etaabu enyititoire, agachibeeka ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera rikere.

English: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
Kiswahili: Kisha akatengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita na kuzifunika kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Akabaacha emiaro y’emekonge, akayeooma netaabu.

English: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
Kiswahili: Akaiingiza hiyo mipiko kwenye zile pete katika pande mbili za Sanduku ili kulibeba.
Ekegusii: Agasoyia emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria esanduki eria.

English: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza kifuniko cha upatanisho kwa dhahabu safi: urefu wake ulikuwa dhiraa mbili na nusu, na upana wake dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia ekemumeko gi’etaabu echenire ebe Oboikaranso bwa’Amaabera. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

English: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:
Kiswahili: Kisha akatengeneza makerubi wawili wa dhahabu iliyofuliwa katika miisho ya hicho kifuniko.
Ekegusii: Erio agakora emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba babere ey’etaabu esunyuntire, akayebeka ase chinsinyo ibere chi’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera,

English: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza kerubi mmoja kwenye mwisho mmoja, na kerubi mwingine kwenye mwisho mwingine; akawatengeneza kuwa kitu kimoja na hicho kifuniko katika miisho hiyo miwili.
Ekegusii: oyomo ase kera ensinyo, akayekora ekaba egento ekemo n’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera.

English: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
Kiswahili: Makerubi hao walikuwa wametandaza mabawa kuelekea juu, wakitia kivuli hicho kifuniko. Makerubi hao walielekeana, wakitazama hicho kifuniko.
Ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo bakarambora chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, bakabobekera ekiriri, na amasio abo agachiikana; na barabwo bakarigereria Oboikaranso bwa amaabera.

English: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza meza ya mbao za mshita yenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili, upana wa dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

English: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaifunika kwa dhahabu safi, na kuitengenezea ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka pande zote.
Ekegusii: Akayeoma netaabu echenire, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.
Kiswahili: Pia akatengeneza upapi wenye upana wa nyanda nne, na kuufanyia ule upapi ukingo wa dhahabu kuuzunguka pande zote.
Ekegusii: Erio agakora orosingo rore nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na akaroetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
Kiswahili: Akasubu pete nne za dhahabu kwa ajili ya meza hiyo, na kuzifungia kwenye pembe nne, pale penye miguu yake minne.
Ekegusii: Naende agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase chitaabu, ne chibonyi echio agachibeka ase chikoona inye ase amagoro aye ane.

English: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.
Kiswahili: Pete hizo ziliwekwa karibu na ukingo ule ili kuishikilia ile mipiko iliyotumika kuibebea hiyo meza.
Ekegusii: Chibonyi chiria chikabekwa ang’e norosingo, na emiaro eria egasoigwa imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.

English: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
Kiswahili: Mipiko hiyo ya kubebea meza ilitengenezwa kwa mti wa mshita, na ilikuwa imefunikwa kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Akabaacha emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netaabu.

English: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vyote vya mezani vilitengenezwa kwa dhahabu safi: yaani sahani zake, masinia, na bakuli na bilauri zake kwa ajili ya kumiminia sadaka za vinywaji.
Ekegusii: Agakora ebikorero biare kobekwa ase emesa igoro: chinteru na ebitaabo ase ubani, ne chisani, korwa ase ebio bagocha koumora ebinyugwa ebikoruegwa; akabiroisia bionsi korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.

English: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi iliyofuliwa vizuri katika kitako chake na ufito wake; vikombe vyake vilivyofanana na ua, matovu na maua vilikuwa kitu kimoja.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire esunyuntire. Akayeroisia nenterekerero amo ne ritina, na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha; bionsi bikaroisigwa bikaba egento ekemo.

English: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:
Kiswahili: Matawi sita yalitokeza kuanzia ule ufito wa katikati wa kinara cha taa: matawi matatu upande mmoja na matatu upande mwingine.
Ekegusii: Nigo kiare ne chinsagia isano nemo, chiasogete korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.

English: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
Kiswahili: Vikombe vitatu vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yenye matovu na maua vilikuwa katika tawi moja, vikombe vitatu katika tawi jingine, na vivyo hivyo kwa matawi yote sita yaliyotokeza kwenye kile kinara cha taa.
Ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang’ani rokaba nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo rokaba nemegwekano y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chikaba boigo.

English: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
Kiswahili: Juu ya kinara chenyewe kulikuwepo na vikombe vinne vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yakiwa na matovu yake na maua yake.
Ekegusii: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero gie chitaaya keria rikaba nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi.

English: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
Kiswahili: Tovu moja lilikuwa chini ya jozi ya kwanza ya matawi yaliyotokeza kwenye kinara cha taa, tovu la pili chini ya jozi ya pili, nalo tovu la tatu chini ya jozi ya tatu, yaani, matawi sita kwa jumla.
Ekegusii: Rimumu erimo rikaba inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio rikaba rimumu erimo inse ya kera orosagia rw’echio isano nemo chiroisirie chikaba egento ekemo ne ritina.

English: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
Kiswahili: Matovu na matawi yote yalikuwa kitu kimoja na kile kinara cha taa, yakiwa yamefuliwa kwa dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Bionsi bikaroisigwa korwa ase ribomba erimo ri’etaabu echenire esunyuntire.

English: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza taa zake saba, na pia mikasi ya kusawazishia tambi, pamoja na masinia, zote kwa dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chitaaya chiaye isano na ibere, na ebiinachi, ne chindogio chiaye chi’echitaabu chichenire.

English: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza kinara hicho cha taa pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote kutumia talanta moja ya dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Ekebekerero keria gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye bionsi bikaroisigwa korwa ase chitaabu chichenire chi’ekerengo gie chikiro emerongo etano.

English: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba kwa mbao za mshita. Ilikuwa ya mraba, urefu na upana wake dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa mbili, nazo pembe zake zilikuwa kitu kimoja nayo.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani erasamberwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko abere. Emegwekano ye ching’unchara ekaroisigwa ekaba egento ekemo negesasiimero.

English: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
Kiswahili: Akafunika hayo madhabahu juu na pande zote na pia zile pembe zake kwa dhahabu safi, na akayafanyizia ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka.
Ekegusii: Agakeooma netaabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye, amo ne ching’unchara chiaye, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

English: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu kwa ajili ya madhabahu chini ya huo ukingo, zikiwa mbili kila upande, za kushikilia hiyo mipiko iliyotumika kuyabebea madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu, agachibeeka inse y’omong’ororia ase chinsemo ibere. Ase chibonyi echio emiaro egasoigwa, erinde egesasiimero kenyare kobogorerigwa.

English: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza mipiko kwa miti ya mshita na kuifunika kwa dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Na emiaro eria akabaacha korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netaabu.

English: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
Kiswahili: Pia akatengeneza mafuta matakatifu ya upako, na uvumba safi wenye harufu nzuri, kazi ya mtengeneza manukato.
Ekegusii: Naende akaroisia amaguta amaachenu akweakwa, na ubani echenire are ne rimisu rigiya, akayaroisia buna omooroisia, oyomanyete buya, aranyare koyaroisia.

English: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa mbao za mti wa mshita, kimo chake dhiraa tatu; nayo ilikuwa mraba, urefu wake dhiraa tano, na upana wa dhiraa tano
Ekegusii: Erio akaagacha egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chikaba chireng’aine, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.

English: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza upembe kwenye kila pembe ya hizo pembe nne, ili zile pembe na madhabahu zikawa zimeungana, akafunika madhabahu kwa shaba.
Ekegusii: Ase chikoona inye chi’egesasiimero akaroisia emegwekano ene ye ching’unchara, akayeroisia ekaba egento ekemo negesasiimero, akaooma gionsi netai.

English: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza vyombo vyake vyote kwa shaba: vyungu vyake vya kuondolea majivu, masepetu, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, uma za nyama na vyombo vya kuchukulia moto.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia ebikorero bionsi bi’egesasiimero nabio ebi: Chindogio chi’okobuucha riibu, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo, ne chigami, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero. Ebinto ebi bionsi akabiroisia korwa ase chitaai.

English: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza wavu wa shaba chini ya ukingo wa madhabahu ili ufikie nusu ya kimo cha madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Agakora egechungi gi’etai, agakebeeka korwa inse y’orosingo, kegaika gochia igoro gati gati y’egesasiimero.

English: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.
Kiswahili: Akasubu pete za shaba za kushikilia ile mipiko kwa ajili ya zile pembe nne za huo wavu wa shaba.
Ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye, agachibeka ase chikoona inye chi’egechungi ekio gi’etai, ase emiaro egosoigwa.

English: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita na kuifunika kwa shaba.
Ekegusii: Akabaacha emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netai.

English: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
Kiswahili: Akaiingiza ile mipiko kwenye zile pete, ili iwe pande mbili za madhabahu kwa ajili ya kuibeba. Akaitengeneza madhabahu yenye uvungu ndani yake akitumia mbao.
Ekegusii: Agasoyia emiaro eria ase chibonyi chire chinsemo chi’egesasiimero, erinde kenyare kobogorerigwa. Agakeagacha ne chibao, akagetiga giasaime.

English: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza sinia la shaba lenye kitako cha shaba kutoka kwa vioo vya shaba vilivyotolewa na wanawake waliohudumu pale ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye korwa ase ebirore bie chitaai bi’abakuungu baare gokorera ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;
Kiswahili: Kisha akatengeneza ua. Upande wa kusini ulikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, na ulikuwa na mapazia ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri,
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya Irianyi akaroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bwabo nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo.

English: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
Kiswahili: pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.
Ekegusii: Chisiiro chiaye emerongo ebere echiare kobibwata nigo chiarenge ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.

English: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
Kiswahili: Upande wa kaskazini ulikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, pamoja na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase ensemo ya sugusu akaroisia ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo. Chisiiro emerongo ebere echiare kobibwata nigo chiarenge ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.

English: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
Kiswahili: Upande wa mwisho wa magharibi ulikuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini na ulikuwa na mapazia, na nguzo kumi na vitako vyake kumi, pamoja na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya bosongo bakaroisia ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.

English: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,
Kiswahili: Upande wa mwisho wa mashariki jua linakochomoza, pia ulikuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini.
Ekegusii: Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.

English: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;
Kiswahili: Mapazia yenye urefu wa dhiraa kumi na tano yalikuwa upande mmoja wa ingilio, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bakaroisia ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, ne chisiiro isato amo ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.

English: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
Kiswahili: Mapazia yenye urefu wa dhiraa kumi na tano yalikuwa upande mwingine wa ingilio la ua, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase ensemo ende bakaroisia ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, ne chisiiro isato amo ne chinterekerero chiabo isato. Ase igo chinsemo chionsi ibere chi’egesoero chikaba chireng’aine.

English: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.
Kiswahili: Mapazia yote yaliyozunguka ua yalikuwa ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Ebitambaa bionsi ebiaetanaine eraaro eria bikaroisigwa ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire.

English: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.
Kiswahili: Vitako vya nguzo vilikuwa vya shaba. Kulabu na tepe juu ya nguzo zilikuwa za fedha, na ncha zake zilifunikwa kwa fedha. Kwa hiyo nguzo zote za ua zilikuwa na tepe za fedha.
Ekegusii: Chinterekerero chie chisiiro chiaye nigo chiarenge chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta, na ebisure biabo bikaoomwa nefeta.

English: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.
Kiswahili: Pazia la ingilio la ua lilikuwa la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi. Pazia hilo lilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa ishirini kama zile za kwenye ua, na kimo chake kilikuwa dhiraa tano,
Ekegusii: Egetambaa ki’egesoero bakaroisia korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bw’egetambaa keria nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano koreng’ana nobogare bwaye buna ebitambaa binde bi’eraaro.

English: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.
Kiswahili: likiwa na nguzo nne na vitako vinne vya shaba. Kulabu zake na tepe zake zilikuwa za fedha, na ncha zake zilikuwa zimefunikwa kwa fedha.
Ekegusii: Chisiiro inye, echiare gokebwata, ne chinterekerero chiabo inye, nigo chiarenge chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio biabo nigo biarenge bie chifeta, na ebisure bie chisiiro bikaoomwa nefeta, ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.

English: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.
Kiswahili: Vigingi vyote vya maskani na vya ua ulioizunguka vilikuwa vya shaba.
Ekegusii: Ebirochi bionsi bi’eema y’Obomenyo na ebi’ebitambaa bi’eraaro nigo biarenge bie chitaai.

English: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
Kiswahili: Ifuatayo ni orodha ya vifaa vilivyotumika kwa ajili ya ujenzi wa maskani, maskani ya Ushuhuda, ambavyo vilitayarishwa na Walawi kama alivyoagiza Mose, chini ya usimamizi wa Ithamari, mwana wa kuhani Aroni.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’ebinto ebiakoreretwe ase okoroisia Obomenyo, engencho yaye Obomenyo bw’Oborori. Omobaro oyo Musa achigete ogakorwa n’Abalawi inse y’oboraai bwa Itamari, mosinto o Aroni, Omokuani.

English: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: (Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, wa kabila la Yuda, alifanya kila kitu Bwana alichomwamuru Mose,
Ekegusii: Besaleli, mosinto o Uri o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda, agakora onsi ay’Omonene achigete Musa.

English: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.
Kiswahili: akiwa pamoja na Oholiabu mwana wa Ahisamaki, wa kabila la Dani, fundi stadi wa kutia nakshi, kubuni michoro, mtarizi kwa rangi ya buluu, ya zambarau, nyekundu na kitani safi.)
Ekegusii: Amo nere nigo arenge Oholiabu, omwana o Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, komokonya. Ere nigo arenge omong’aini bw’okomang’a na kobaacha, na bw’okoroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.

English: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya dhahabu iliyopatikana kutokana na sadaka ya kuinuliwa kwa ajili ya kazi ya mahali patakatifu ilikuwa na uzito wa talanta 29 na shekeli 730, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Etaabu yonsi eyakoreretwe ase emeremo y’okoroisia Obomenyo Obochenu, eyaatananetwe ebe ekerugwa, nigo yarenge chikiro elifu eyemo, na amagana ane, na emerongo etano nomo, na isano (1,465) ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
Kiswahili: Fedha iliyopatikana kutokana na jumuiya ya watu waliohesabiwa ilikuwa yenye uzito wa talanta mia moja na shekeli 1,775, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Efeta eyaruetwe nomoganda bw’abwo barigetwe nigo yarenge chikiro chilifu isano, na emerongo etato, na isano (5,035), ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu alitoa beka moja, ambayo ni sawa na nusu shekeli ya fedha, kwa kazi ya mahali patakatifu, kutoka kwa kila mtu aliyekuwa amehesabiwa mwenye umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi, ambao jumla yao walikuwa wanaume 603,550.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto oyorigetwe, oyokoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, akarua ebeka eyemo, engencho yaye ekeng’ese gi’esekeli ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu. Abanto abwo nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano na rimo na isato, na amagana atano, na emerongo etano (603,550).

English: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.
Kiswahili: Talanta hizo 100 za fedha zilitumika kusubu vile vitako mia moja kwa ajili ya mahali patakatifu na pazia: vitako mia moja kwa talanta mia, yaani, talanta moja kwa kila kitako.
Ekegusii: Chikiro chilifu isano chi’echifeta chiria nigo chiakoretwe ase okoroisia chinterekerero chi’Obomenyo Obochenu ne chi’etoto eria; chikiro chilifu isano ase chinterekerero rigana erimo, chikiro emerongo etano ase kera enterekerero.

English: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
Kiswahili: Akatumia zile shekeli hizo 1,775 kutengeneza kulabu za nguzo, kufunika ncha za nguzo na kutengeneza vitanzi vyake.
Ekegusii: Ase chifeta chikiro emerongo etato na isano chiatigarete chiakoreretwe ase okoroisia ebigobanio bie chisiiro na ase okooma ebisure biabo, na koroisia chinuga chiabo.

English: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
Kiswahili: Shaba iliyopatikana kutokana na sadaka ya kuinuliwa ilikuwa na uzito wa talanta 70 na shekeli 2,400.
Ekegusii: Chitaai chiatananetwe chibe ekerugwa, nigo chiarenge chikiro chilifu isato, na amagana atano, na emerongo ene, na isano (3,545).

English: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,
Kiswahili: Akaitumia hiyo shaba kutengeneza vitako vya ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, madhabahu ya shaba pamoja na ule wavu wake na vyombo vyake vyote,
Ekegusii: Ase chitaai chiria akaroisia chinterekerero chi’egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na egesasiimero gi’etai amo negechungi kiaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi,
