English: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.
Kiswahili: vile vitako vya ule ua uliozunguka na vile vya ingilio, na vigingi vyote vya Maskani pamoja na ule ua uliozunguka.
Ekegusii: ne chinterekerero chie chisiiro chi’eraaro chibe chinsemo chionsi, na echi’egesoero ki’eraaro, na ebirochi bionsi bi’eema y’Obomenyo, na ebi’eraaro chinsemo chionsi.

English: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, ya zambarau na nyekundu akatengeneza mavazi yaliyofumwa kwa ajili ya kuhudumu katika mahali patakatifu. Pia akamshonea Aroni mavazi matakatifu, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, bakaroisia chianga chinseera chi’ogokorera emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu. Bakaroisia chianga chinchenu chia Aroni, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza kisibau cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Bagakora egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chiusi chi’etaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.

English: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.
Kiswahili: Akafua vipande vyembamba vya dhahabu kwa nyundo na kutengeneza nyuzi nyembamba ili kuzifuma pamoja na hizo nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi, kazi ya fundi stadi.
Ekegusii: Bagasunyunta etaabu ekaba eng’ao, naende bakayeninta ekaba chiusi chinyerere, bagachisang’ania ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, ase okoroisia egetambaa buna omooroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia.

English: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza vipande vya mabegani vya kisibau, vilivyoshikizwa kwenye pembe zake mbili ili kukifungia kisibau.
Ekegusii: Bakaroisia ebitwanga bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria, bakabibwatania nakerokio, magega na bosio; chinsinyo chiaye ibere ibere chikabwatanigwa amo.

English: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Mshipi wa kiunoni uliofumwa kwa ustadi ulifanana nacho: ulikuwa kitu kimoja na hicho kisibau, nao ulitengenezwa kwa dhahabu na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na kwa kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao rokaroisigwa rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’etaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza vito vya shohamu vilivyowekwa katika vijalizo vya dhahabu, navyo vilichorwa na majina ya wana wa Israeli kama vile muhuri huchorwa.
Ekegusii: Bakabaacha amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa oiniki, bakayabeeka ase ebikonde bie chitaabu; na buna omooroisia omong’aini aranyare komanya komang’era ebimanyererio, bakamang’era amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli.

English: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha akavifungia kwenye vipande vya mabega ya kisibau kuwa vito vya ukumbusho kwa wana wa Israeli, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Bakayabeeka ase ebitwanga bi’amareko ase egesibao ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Kiswahili: Akafanyiza kifuko cha kifuani, kazi ya fundi stadi. Akakitengeneza kama kile kisibau: cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, cha kitani safi iliyosokotwa.
Ekegusii: Egesembe ki’obokuani bagakeroisia, buna omooroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia, korwa ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, nakio keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’etaabu na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.

English: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.
Kiswahili: Kifuko hicho kilikuwa cha mraba, chenye urefu wa shibiri moja na upana wa shibiri moja, nacho kilikunjwa mara mbili.
Ekegusii: Bakaroisia egesembe keria keringire rimo; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo. Chinsemo chiaye inye nigo chiarenge chireng’aine.

English: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
Kiswahili: Kifuko hicho kilipambwa kwa safu nne za vito vya thamani. Safu ya kwanza ilikuwa na akiki, yakuti manjano na zabarajadi;
Ekegusii: Bagakebeekera emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori. Ase omong’ororia bw’eritang’ani bakabeeka saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;

English: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
Kiswahili: safu ya pili ilikuwa na almasi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi;
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o kabere alimasi, na safiro, na yasipi;

English: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
Kiswahili: safu ya tatu ilikuwa na hiakintho, akiki nyekundu na amethisto;
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o gatato hiakinto, na agati, na ametisito;

English: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.
Kiswahili: katika safu ya nne ilikuwa na krisolitho, shohamu na yaspi. Vito hivyo vilitiwa kwenye vijalizo vya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi bakayabeka ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.

English: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
Kiswahili: Palikuwa na vito kumi na viwili, kila kimoja kikiwa na jina mojawapo la wana wa Israeli; kila kimoja kilichorwa kama muhuri kikiwa na jina mojawapo la yale makabila kumi na mawili.
Ekegusii: Na amagena ayio nigo arenge ikomi na abere, akaba namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli, amang’ekire buna ekemanyererio gekomang’wa. Kera rigena rikaba nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.

English: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya kile kifuko cha kifuani akakitengenezea mikufu ya dhahabu safi, iliyosokotwa kama kamba.
Ekegusii: Bagakora ebichanga bie chitaabu chichenire bisisire, bikabeekwa ase egesembe keria.

English: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza vijalizo viwili vya dhahabu na pete mbili za dhahabu, na kuzifungia pete hizo kwenye pembe mbili za hicho kifuko cha kifuani.
Ekegusii: Bagakora na ebikonde bibere bie chitaabu, ne chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu, na bakabeeka chibonyi echi ibere ase emego ebere ya igoro y’egesembe keria.

English: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
Kiswahili: Akafunga hiyo mikufu miwili ya dhahabu kwenye hizo pete katika pembe za hicho kifuko cha kifuani,
Ekegusii: Bagasiberania ebichanga ebi bibere bie chitaabu ase chibonyi echi ibere ase emego y’egesembe keria.

English: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.
Kiswahili: nazo zile ncha nyingine za mkufu akazifunga kwenye vile vijalizo viwili, na kuzishikamanisha na vile vipande vya mabega vya kile kisibau upande wa mbele.
Ekegusii: Naende bakabwaterania chinsinyo chinde ibere chi’ebichanga ase ebikonde biria bibere, na buna biare igo bakabibwaterania nebitwanga bi’amareko bire bosio bw’egesibao ki’obokuani.

English: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu na kuzishikamanisha kwenye pembe mbili za chini, upande wa ndani wa kifuko cha kifuani karibu na kisibau.
Ekegusii: Bagakora chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu bagachibeeka ase egesembe keria, ase emego ebere ya inse korwa magega, echigeete egesibao.

English: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
Kiswahili: Kisha akatengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu na kuzishikamanisha sehemu ya chini ya vipande vya mabega upande wa mbele wa kile kisibau, karibu na pindo juu kidogo ya mshipi wa kiunoni wa kisibau.
Ekegusii: Naende bagakora chibonyi chinde chi’echitaabu, bagachibeeka ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.

English: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Akafunga pete za hicho kifuko cha kifuani kwenye pete za kisibau kwa kamba ya buluu, wakiziunganisha na ule mshipi wa kiunoni, ili kifuko cha kifuani kisisogee kutoka kwenye kile kisibau, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Bagachibwaterania chibonyi chi’egesembe amo nechi’egesibao ki’obokuani neusi eburu; erio egesembe gekabeera orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
Kiswahili: Akashona joho la kisibau lote kwa kitambaa cha rangi ya buluu tupu, kazi ya mfumaji,
Ekegusii: Agakora eganchwa korwa ase egetambaa keroisirie ne chiusi chiburu chioka.

English: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.
Kiswahili: na lilikuwa na nafasi ya shingo katikati ya joho lile iliyofanana na ukosi, na utepe ulioshonwa kuizunguka nafasi hiyo ili isichanike.
Ekegusii: Ase eganchwa eria bakabochora engoro ase omotwe ogosoera, enga buna engoro y’esati. Engoro eria ekabekwa ekenaario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.

English: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza makomamanga ya nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri kuzunguka pindo la hilo joho.
Ekegusii: Bagakora emegwekano y’amatunda e rikomomanga korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, bakayebeeka ase omoringero o inse.

English: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;
Kiswahili: Kisha akatengeneza vikengele vya dhahabu safi na kuvishikamanisha kuzunguka pindo hilo kati ya hayo makomamanga.
Ekegusii: Naende bagakora chindege chi’echitaabu chichenire, bagachibeeka gati y’emegwekano ye rikomomanga chietanane omoringero o inse ase eganchwa.

English: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Hivyo vikengele na makomamanga vilipishana kuzunguka upindo wa joho ili livaliwe kwa kuhudumu, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Ase igo omong’ororia bw’emegwekano ye rikomomang’a bwateranirie ne chindege orenge ase omoringero o inse ase eganchwa eria ekobekwa ase obokoreri bw’obokuani. Naboigo buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,
Kiswahili: Pia akamtengenezea Aroni na wanawe makoti ya kitani safi, kazi ya mfumaji,
Ekegusii: Bakaroiseria Aroni amo nabamura baye chiganchwa chi’egatani engiya,

English: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,
Kiswahili: na kilemba cha kitani safi, tepe za kichwani za kitani, na nguo za ndani za kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: na egetinti amo nebigogwa emechoro bi’oboseera bi’egatani engiya, ne chisirwari chi’egatani engiya,

English: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Mshipi ulikuwa wa kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri ya rangi ya buluu, na zambarau, na nyekundu, kazi ya mtarizi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: na orokini rwe chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.
Kiswahili: Kisha akatengeneza lile bamba, taji takatifu, kwa dhahabu safi na kuchora juu yake maneno haya kama vile muhuri huchorwa: Mtakatifu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Bagatura ebao y’etaabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio, bakamang’a amang’ana aya: “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.

English: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakalifunga kwa kamba ya rangi ya buluu ili kulishikamanisha na kile kilemba kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Bakayesiberania bosio bw’ekegogwa ne chiusi chiburu, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kazi yote ya maskani, Hema la Kukutania ikakamilika. Waisraeli wakafanya kila kitu sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Naboigo emeremo y’Obomenyo bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano egaikeranigwa n’Abaisraeli; bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakaleta maskani kwa Mose: hema pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote, vibanio vyake, mihimili yake, mataruma yake, nguzo na vitako vyake;
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakarentera Musa Obomenyo boria, na eema amo n’ebinto bionsi ebirabeo: ebigobanio, ne chibao, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo,

English: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,
Kiswahili: kifuniko cha ngozi za kondoo dume kilichotiwa rangi nyekundu, kifuniko cha ngozi za pomboo, pazia la kufunikia;
Ekegusii: na egietubo ki’amasankwa e chimingichi, aakire etaago, na egietubo ki’amasankwa e ching’iti chia rooche, na etoto eria ekengete,

English: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Ushuhuda pamoja na mipiko yake na kiti cha rehema,
Ekegusii: na Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, amo nemiaro yaye, na ekerogo kia amaabera,

English: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,
Kiswahili: meza pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote na mikate ya Wonyesho;
Ekegusii: na emesa amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na Emegati eyare koruegwa ase Nyasae,

English: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,
Kiswahili: kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi, safu zake za taa pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote pamoja na mafuta kwa ajili ya taa;
Ekegusii: na ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire, ne chitaaya chiare kobekwa aroro amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na amaguta e chitaaya,

English: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,
Kiswahili: madhabahu ya dhahabu, mafuta ya upako, uvumba wenye harufu nzuri na pazia la ingilio la hema;
Ekegusii: na egesasiimero gi’etaabu, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Eema,

English: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,
Kiswahili: madhabahu ya shaba, pamoja na wavu wa shaba, nguzo zake na vyombo vyake vyote, sinia, na tako lake;
Ekegusii: na egesasiimero gi’etai amo negechungi gi’etai, na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye,

English: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,
Kiswahili: mapazia ya ua pamoja na nguzo na vitako vyake, pia na pazia kwa ajili ya ingilio la kwenye ua; kamba zake na vigingi vya hema kwa ajili ya ua; vyombo vyote vilivyohitajiwa kwa ajili ya maskani, Hema la Kukutania;
Ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi’eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori, na ebirochi, na ebikorero bionsi bi’obokoreri ase Obomenyo ime, ase Eema y’o mosangererekano,

English: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
Kiswahili: na mavazi yaliyofumwa yanayovaliwa wakati wa huduma katika mahali patakatifu, yaani mavazi matakatifu ya kuhani Aroni na mavazi kwa ajili ya wanawe watakapokuwa wakihudumu katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: ne chianga chiria chinseera chi’abakuani ase obokoreri bwabo ime y’Aase Aachenu, engencho yaye chianga chia Aroni amo nechi’abamura baye barabe bakobeeka ekero bagokora emeremo y’obokuani.

English: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walikuwa wamefanya kazi yote sawasawa na vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bakorire emeremo yonsi boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
Kiswahili: Mose akakagua kazi na kuona kuwa walikuwa wameifanya sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa ameagiza. Kwa hiyo Mose akawabariki.
Ekegusii: Musa akariga‐rigereria ebinto bionsi ebiakoretwe, akarora ng’a abanto babikorire boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achiikire. Erio Musa akabasesenia.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose:
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: “Simika Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania, katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: “Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, otenenie obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.

English: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
Kiswahili: Weka Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani yake na ulifunike kwa pazia. Ingiza meza na kupanga vitu vyake juu yake.
Ekegusii: Obeeke esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori imeo, na oyekenge netoto.

English: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.
Kiswahili: Kisha ingiza kinara cha taa na uweke taa zake juu yake.
Ekegusii: Osoyie emesa, na obeeke ebinto biaye igoro yaye; osoyie na ekebekerero gie chitaaya, na obeeke chitaaya igoro yaye.

English: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Weka madhabahu ya dhahabu ya kufukizia uvumba mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda kisha uweke pazia kwenye lango la Maskani ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio obeeke egesasiimero gi’etaabu ase ubani erasamberwe bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, na osunge egetambaa kere ase egesoero ki’obomenyo.

English: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: “Weka madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa mbele ya lango la Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania;
Ekegusii: Obeeke egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe bosio bw’egesoero ki’obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.

English: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.
Kiswahili: weka sinia kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, na uweke maji ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Obeeke egetuba egati y’Eema y’omosangererekano na egesasiimero, obeeke na amaache imeo.

English: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
Kiswahili: Fanyiza ua kuzunguka maskani na uweke pazia penye ingilio la ua.
Ekegusii: Otenenie orosenge rw’egetambaa roetanane eraaro, na osunge egetambaa ase egesoero ki’eraaro.

English: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.
Kiswahili: “Chukua mafuta ya upako, ipake Maskani ya Mungu pamoja na kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake; iweke wakfu pamoja na vitu vyote vilivyomo ndani mwake, nayo itakuwa takatifu.
Ekegusii: “Oimokie amaguta akweakwa, oake obomenyo na ebinto bionsi ebire imeo na obwatanane obomenyo amo n’ebinto biaye bionsi, erinde bibe ebichenu.

English: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.
Kiswahili: Kisha yapake mafuta hayo madhabahu ya kuteketezea sadaka pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote; weka wakfu madhabahu nayo yatakuwa takatifu sana.
Ekegusii: Naende oake amaguta ase egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe, amo nebikorero biaye bionsi. Naboigo ogiatanane, kebe egechenu mono.

English: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.
Kiswahili: Paka sinia mafuta pamoja na kishikilio chake na uviweke wakfu.
Ekegusii: Oake egetuba amaguta amo nenterekerero yaye, na kogiatanana.

English: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
Kiswahili: “Mlete Aroni na wanawe kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania na uwaoshe kwa maji.
Ekegusii: “Orente Aroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’omosangererekano, obasibie namaache.

English: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
Kiswahili: Kisha mvike Aroni yale mavazi matakatifu, umtie mafuta na kumweka wakfu ili apate kunitumikia katikati ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Erio obeekere Aroni chianga chiria chinchenu, omoake amaguta na komwatanana, anyare gonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani,

English: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.
Kiswahili: Walete wanawe na uwavike makoti.
Ekegusii: Orente na abamura baye, obabeekere chianga chiabo,

English: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
Kiswahili: Kisha watie mafuta kama ulivyomtia baba yao, ili nao pia wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani. Kutiwa mafuta kwao kutakuwa kwa ajili ya ukuhani utakaoendelea kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo.”
Ekegusii: obaake amaguta buna oraake ise, na barabwo nababe abakuani baane. Ogoakwa kw’amaguta kwabo nkobanyorere obokuani boragenderere botambe ase ororeria rwabo, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”

English: Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.
Kiswahili: Mose akafanya kila kitu sawa kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Musa agakora onsi buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Maskani ya Mungu ilisimikwa katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza, katika mwaka wa pili.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, omwaka o kabere magega kobarure Misiri, obomenyo boria bogatenenigwa.

English: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
Kiswahili: Mose alipoweka wakfu Maskani ya Mungu, aliweka vitako mahali pake, akasimamisha mihimili, akatia mataruma na kusimamisha nguzo.
Ekegusii: Musa agatenenia Obomenyo boria, akabeeka chinterekerero aase abo, agatenenia ne chibao chiaye, agasoyia emeriibo, na gotenenia chisiiro.

English: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha akalitandaza hema juu ya Maskani ya Mungu na kuifunika hema, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Akaara eema igoro y’obomenyo boria, na kobeeka egietubo kiaye buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
Kiswahili: Akachukua ule Ushuhuda na kuuweka ndani ya Sanduku la Agano, akaweka ile mipiko ya kubebea hilo Sanduku na kuweka kiti cha rehema juu yake.
Ekegusii: Akaimokia chibao chiriikire oborori, agachibeeka ase esanduki ime, agasoyia emiaro ase chibonyi, akamumeka esanduki eria n’ekerogo ki’amaabera.

English: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akalileta Sanduku ndani ya Maskani ya Mungu, akatundika pazia ili kulifunika Sanduku la Ushuhuda, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka esanduki eria ime y’obomenyo, agasunga etoto eria y’egetambaa ase ogokenga esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.
Kiswahili: Mose akaweka meza ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, upande wa kaskazini ya Maskani ya Mungu nje ya pazia
Ekegusii: Akabeeka emesa ase Eema y’omosangererekano ime, isiko y’etoto, ensemo ya sugusu,

English: He set the bread in order on it before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: na kupanga mikate juu yake mbele za Bwana, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: na akaroberia emegati igoro yaye ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikiire.

English: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Akaweka kinara cha taa ndani ya Hema la Kukutania mkabala na meza upande wa kusini mwa Maskani ya Mungu
Ekegusii: Akabeeka ekebekerero gie chitaaya ase obomenyo ime, ensemo ya Irianyi, kororia ase emesa.

English: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: na kuziweka taa mbele za Bwana, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Naende akabeeka chitaaya igoro y’ekebekerero ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikiire.

English: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;
Kiswahili: Mose akaweka madhabahu ya dhahabu ndani ya Hema la Kukutania mbele ya pazia
Ekegusii: Akabeeka na egesasiimero gi’etaabu ase Eema y’omosangererekano ime, bosio bw’etoto,

English: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: na kufukiza uvumba wenye harufu nzuri, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: na igoro yaye agasambera ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaweka pazia kwenye ingilio la Maskani ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Agasunga egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’obomenyo.

English: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Mose akaweka madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa karibu na ingilio la Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania, na kutoa juu yake sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za nafaka kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Na egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe akabeeka ase egesoero ki’eema y’Omosangererekano. Igoro yaye akarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

English: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.
Kiswahili: Akaweka sinia kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, akaweka maji ndani yake kwa ajili ya kunawia,
Ekegusii: Akabeeka egetuba ase egati y’Eema y’omosangererekano na egesasiimero, akabeeka amaache ogwesibia imeo.

English: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.
Kiswahili: Naye Mose, Aroni na wanawe wakayatumia kwa kunawia mikono na miguu yao.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakaba bagoisaba amaboko na gosibia amagoro ase amaache ayio.

English: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Wakanawa kila walipoingia katika Hema la Kukutania au walipoikaribia madhabahu kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Ekero baare gosoa Eema y’omosangererekano, gose goika ang’e ase egesasiimero, baba bagwesibia, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akafanya ua kuizunguka Maskani ya Mungu na madhabahu, pia akaweka pazia kwenye ingilio la huo ua. Hivyo Mose akaikamilisha kazi.
Ekegusii: Agatenenia orosenge rw’eraaro roetanane Obomenyo na egesasiimero, na agasunga ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro. Naboigo Musa agakoora emeremo eyio yonsi.

English: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wingu likafunika Hema la Kukutania, na utukufu wa Bwana ukaijaza Maskani ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio riire rigatuba Eema y’omosangererekano, na obonene bw’Omonene bogaichora ime ase Obomenyo.

English: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Mose hakuweza kuingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania kwa sababu wingu lilikuwa limetua juu ya Hema, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukaijaza Maskani ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Musa tanyara gosoa eema y’omosangererekano, ekiagera riire riria riabeete igoro yaye, na obonene bogaichora ime ase obomenyo.

English: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
Kiswahili: Katika safari yote ya Waisraeli, kila wakati wingu lilipoinuka kutoka juu ya Maskani ya Mungu, wangeondoka;
Ekegusii: Na ekero kende gionsi riire riare koimokerera igoro korwa ase obomenyo obwo, Abaisraeli nigo baare koimoka kogenda orogendo rwabo. Naboigo baare gokora ase orogendo rwabo rwonsi.

English: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.
Kiswahili: lakini kama wingu halikuinuka, hawakuondoka, mpaka siku lilipoinuka.
Ekegusii: Korende onye riire tiriare koimokerera igoro, barabwo tibaare koimoka kogenda goika rituko riria riire riare koimokerera igoro naende.

English: For the cloud of Yahweh was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wingu la Bwana lilikuwa juu ya maskani mchana, na moto ulikuwa katika hilo wingu wakati wa usiku, machoni pa nyumba yote ya Israeli siku zote za safari zao.
Ekegusii: Naki riire ri’Omonene nigo riare kobeera ase bomenyo ekero kia mobaso, na ekero kia botuko omorero oba ase riire ime; na agwo Abaisraeli bonsi baba bakorirora aande onsi ase barenge ase orogendo rwabo.

English: Yahweh called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwita Mose na kusema naye kutoka kwenye Hema la Kukutania, akamwambia,
Ekegusii: Omonene akarangeria Musa, agakwana nere korwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, akamoteebia.

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to Yahweh, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli na uwaambie, ‘Yeyote miongoni mwenu aletapo sadaka ya mnyama kwa Bwana, alete mnyama kama sadaka yake kutoka kundi lake la ngʼombe au la kondoo na mbuzi.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi akorwa ase egati yabo akondeetera inche Omonene eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso, ayerusie korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori.

English: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka hiyo ni ya kuteketezwa kutoka kwenye kundi la ngʼombe, atamtoa ngʼombe dume asiye na dosari. Ni lazima amlete kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania ili aweze kukubalika kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Onye ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa gekorwa ase amaicho chiombe, igo keraabe eki’eeri etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ayerente agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, erinde inche ’mwanchere.

English: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
Kiswahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka ya kuteketezwa, nayo itakubaliwa kwa niaba yake ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, erinde yancherwe ase okobwatania omonto oria amo n’ Omonene Nyasae.

English: He shall kill the bull before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Atamchinja yule fahali mchanga mbele za Bwana, kisha wana wa Aroni walio makuhani wataleta damu na kuinyunyiza pande zote za madhabahu yaliyo penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria onyeenyete eeri eria ensae agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, barente amanyinga bayasiarere chinsemo chionsi chi’egesasiimero kere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
Kiswahili: Ataichuna hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kuikata vipande vipande.
Ekegusii: Naende arusie riiyo ri’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso, ayenachane ebitari,

English: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;
Kiswahili: Wana wa Aroni kuhani wataweka moto juu ya madhabahu na kupanga kuni juu ya huo moto.
Ekegusii: na abamura ba Aroni Omokuani baute omorero ase egesasiimero, bachooke chinko ase omorero oyio.

English: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;
Kiswahili: Kisha wana wa Aroni walio makuhani watapanga vile vipande vya nyama, pamoja na kichwa na mafuta ya huyo mnyama juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Naende abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, babeeke ebitari biria, amo nomotwe n’ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasiimero.

English: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ataziosha sehemu za ndani na miguu yake kwa maji, naye kuhani atavichoma vyote juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, yenye harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende chinyama chi’enda, amo nebirenge bia magega, bisibigwe namaache. Omokuani oria otenenerete asaambe eng’iti eria yonsi ase egesasiimero, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa n’omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.

English: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka ni ya kuteketezwa kutoka kwenye kundi la kondoo au mbuzi, atamtoa mnyama dume asiye na dosari.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, korwa ase amaicho ye ching’ondi, gose chimbori, nigo araarente emingichi, gose egoree, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.

English: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Atamchinjia upande wa kaskazini wa madhabahu mbele za Bwana, nao wana wa Aroni walio makuhani watanyunyizia damu yake pande zote za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio ayenyeenyere ase ensemo ya sugusu y’egesasiimero, agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,
Kiswahili: Atamkata vipande vipande, naye kuhani atavipanga, pamoja na kichwa na mafuta ya mnyama juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Naende anachane eng’iti eria ebitari, na Omokuani oria otenenerete, abichooke buya, amo nomotwe n’ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasiimero,

English: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ataosha sehemu za ndani na miguu kwa maji, naye kuhani atavileta vyote na kuvichoma juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: korende chinyama chianda na ebirenge bisibigwe namaache. Erio Omokuani arue bionsi na kobisaambera ase egesasiimero. Ekio n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa n’omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.

English: “‘If his offering to Yahweh is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa inayotolewa kwa Bwana ni ndege, atamtoa hua au kinda la njiwa.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto okomoruera Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa gekorusigwa korwa ase chinyoni, rirorio omonto oyio arente amaruma gose amage amaruma.

English: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;
Kiswahili: Kuhani atamleta kwenye madhabahu, naye atamvunja shingo na kumnyofoa kichwa na kumchoma juu ya madhabahu. Damu yake itachuruzishwa ubavuni mwa madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omokuani arente enyoni eyio ase egesasiimero, na amiine omotwe oye, ayobutore. Erio ayosaambe ase egesasiimero. Anyititorere amanyinga ase egesasiimero ensemo,

English: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.
Kiswahili: Ataondoa kifuko cha chakula pamoja na uchafu wake na kuvitupa upande wa mashariki wa madhabahu, mahali pale penye majivu.
Ekegusii: korende emboochero yaye, amo neubi ere imeo, abitugute ensemo ya moocha y’egesasiimero, ase ribu rigotugutwa.

English: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Atampasua na kumweka wazi katika mabawa yake, lakini asimwachanishe kabisa, kisha kuhani ataichoma juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio ataandorane egekuba, korende tarusia chimbaaba, ayesaambere ase egesasiimero, igoro ye chinko chiria chire ase omorero. Ekio n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa n’omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.

English: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to Yahweh, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mtu yeyote aletapo sadaka ya nafaka kwa Bwana, sadaka yake itakuwa ya unga laini. Atamimina mafuta juu yake, aweke uvumba juu yake,
Ekegusii: “Ekero monto onde bwensi akoreeta okoruegwa kw’endagera ase Omonene, arue obosie obonuke, anyororokerie amaguta ase obosie obwo, abeeke na ekoroso.

English: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: naye atapeleka kwa makuhani wana wa Aroni. Kuhani atachukua konzi moja iliyojaa unga laini na mafuta pamoja na uvumba wote, na kuuteketeza kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu juu ya madhabahu, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oyio arente okoruegwa okwo ase abakuani, abamura ba Aroni. Omokuani otenenerete aimokie obosie boichire roe, amo namaguta, na ekoroso yonsi, abisaambere ase egesasiimero erio bibe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosaambwa n’omorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.

English: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.
Kiswahili: Sadaka ya nafaka iliyobaki ni ya Aroni na wanawe, ni sehemu ya sadaka iliyo takatifu sana iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Ekeratigare korwa ase okoruegwa kw’endagera okwo nakobe okwa Aroni na abamura baye. Ekio negechenu mono, ekiagera kiarusiigwe korwa ase okoruegwa kogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde.

English: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama utaleta sadaka ya nafaka iliyookwa jikoni, itakuwa ya unga laini: maandazi yaliyotengenezwa bila kutiwa chachu, yaliyochanganywa na mafuta, au mikate myembamba iliyotengenezwa bila kutiwa chachu, na iliyopakwa mafuta.
Ekegusii: “Ekero okorenta okoruegwa kw’endagera esaambeire riko nebe emegati etabeekiri memera eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta, gose emegati emeoo eakire amaguta.

English: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.
Kiswahili: Iwapo sadaka yako ya nafaka imeandaliwa kwenye kikaango, itakuwa ni ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, bila chachu.
Ekegusii: “Onye okoruegwa kwao kw’endagera n’emegati esaambeire orogio, ebe eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke amo namaguta, korende ebe etabeekiri memera.

English: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.
Kiswahili: Ukande na kumimina mafuta juu yake; hii ni sadaka ya nafaka.
Ekegusii: Oyesamunyorane, erio oumore amaguta igoro ase ebisamunye biria. Okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera.

English: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
Kiswahili: Kama sadaka yako ya nafaka imepikwa kwenye sufuria, itatengenezwa kwa unga laini na mafuta.
Ekegusii: “Onye okoruegwa kwao kw’endagera n’emegati ekarangeire esuguria, ebe eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke amo namaguta.

English: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to Yahweh. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.
Kiswahili: Ilete hiyo sadaka ya nafaka iliyotengenezwa kwa vitu hivi kwa Bwana; mkabidhi kuhani ambaye ataipeleka madhabahuni.
Ekegusii: Ondetere inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera eroisirie ase enchera eyemo y’echio, na ekero okoruegwa okwo kwairirwe ase Omokuani nere akorente ase egesasiimero.

English: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Naye atatoa ile sehemu ya kumbukumbu kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya nafaka na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu kuwa sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omokuani arusie ensemo y’okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera ebe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene, ayesaambere ase egesasiimero. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosaambwa n’omorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.

English: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.
Kiswahili: Sadaka ya nafaka iliyobaki ni ya Aroni na wanawe; ni sehemu ya sadaka iliyo takatifu sana ya sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Ekeratigare korwa ase okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera nakebe ekia Aroni na abamura baye. Ekio negechenu mono, ekiagera kiarusiigwe korwa ase okoruegwa kogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde.

English: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to Yahweh shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kila sadaka ya nafaka unayoleta kwa Bwana ni lazima ifanywe bila kutiwa chachu, kwa kuwa huna ruhusa kuchoma chachu yoyote au asali katika sadaka itolewayo kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: “Okoruegwa konde gwonsi kw’endagera bakonduera inche Omonene tigokoroiseranigwa n’ememera. Timobaisa gosamba ememera, gose obooke, bibe okoruegwa kogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde.

English: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to Yahweh, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.
Kiswahili: Unaweza kuzileta kwa Bwana kama sadaka ya malimbuko, lakini haziwezi kutolewa juu ya madhabahu kama harufu nzuri ya kupendeza.
Ekegusii: Monyare kondeetera ebinto ebio buna ogotongora kw’endagera, korende timobaisa kobisaambera ase egesasiimero. Moise gokora igo, tigokoba ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.

English: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.
Kiswahili: Koleza sadaka zako zote za nafaka kwa chumvi. Usiache kuweka chumvi ya Agano la Mungu wako katika sadaka zako za nafaka; weka chumvi kwenye sadaka zako zote.
Ekegusii: Goika obeeke omoonyo ase okoruegwa kwao gwonsi kw’endagera. Ase okoruegwa okwo tibweba kobeeka omoonyo ekiagera Omoonyo nigo okworokia okobwatana gati yaino na Nyasae. (Tomocha kobekwa ase kera okoruegwa kwao).

English: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama ukileta malimbuko ya sadaka ya nafaka kwa Bwana, utatoa masuke yaliyopondwa ya nafaka mpya iliyookwa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: “Aye gokorenta ogotongora kw’endagera ase ’nde inche Omonene, goika orente ebigara ebibese bisaambire ase omorero, bisenyentire.

English: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.
Kiswahili: Weka mafuta na uvumba juu yake; ni sadaka ya nafaka.
Ekegusii: Oumore amaguta ase okoruegwa okwo, obeeke n’ekoroso; okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera.

English: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atateketeza ile sehemu ya kumbukumbu kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya nafaka iliyopondwa kwa mafuta, pamoja na uvumba wote, kama sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Omokuani asaambe ebigara bike bia biria bisenyentire, amo namaguta; abisaambe amo n’ekoroso yonsi bibe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene. Okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde.

English: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka ya mtu ni sadaka ya amani, naye akatoa ngʼombe kutoka kundi, akiwa dume au jike, atamleta mnyama asiye na dosari mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Omonto kararue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, nigo ararente eeri gose eng’ombe etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.

English: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka yake na kumchinja penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania. Ndipo makuhani wana wa Aroni watanyunyiza damu yake pande zote za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’iti eyio ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso, erio ayenyeenyere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya amani ataleta sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto: mafuta yote ya mnyama yafunikayo sehemu za ndani, ama yanayoungana na hizo sehemu za ndani,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe arusie ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, n’ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime, amo ne chinyigo chionsi ibere n’ebitinya bichitubete; n’ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi abirue bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene.

English: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
Kiswahili: figo zote pamoja na mafuta yote yanayozizunguka karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini, ambayo atayaondoa pamoja na figo.
Ekegusii: Erio abamura ba Aroni babisaambere ase egesasiimero, igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa kebeekire ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero. Ekio n’ekengwanso kegosaambwa n’omorero kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.

English: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha wana wa Aroni wataiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, juu ya ile sadaka ya kuteketezwa iliyoko juu ya kuni zinazowaka, kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Omonto kararue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase ’nde inche Omonene, korwa ase riicho rie ching’ondi, gose chimbori, arente eng’iti etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, etuoni gose eaberi.

English: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama akitoa kondoo au mbuzi kutoka kundi kama sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana, atamtoa dume au jike asiye na dosari.
Ekegusii: Onye okorua eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso kiaye, erio ayerue ase obosio bwane.

English: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;
Kiswahili: Kama akimtoa mwana-kondoo, atamleta mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ere goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’ondi eyio akorua ebe ekeng’wanso, erio ayenyeenyere agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Abamura ba Aroni basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka yake, naye atamchinja mbele ya Hema la Kukutania. Kisha wana wa Aroni watanyunyiza damu yake kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe arue ebitinya, na omokera bwonsi ayobutore kegima korwa ase riuga ri’omogongo, n’ebitinya bitubete chinyama chionsi chi’enda, n’ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete; n’ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi bibe ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene.

English: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya amani ataleta dhabihu iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto: mafuta yake, mafuta yote ya mkia uliokatwa karibu na uti wa mgongo, mafuta yote yanayofunika sehemu za ndani au yale yanayounganika nazo,
Ekegusii: Omokuani otenenerete asaambe ebinto ebio bionsi ase egesasiimero bibe endagera ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene.

English: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
Kiswahili: figo mbili pamoja na mafuta yanayozizunguka yaliyo karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini, ambayo atayatoa pamoja na figo.
Ekegusii: “Onye ekeng’wanso kiaye nembori, ayerue ase obosio bwane,

English: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kuhani ataviteketeza juu ya madhabahu kama chakula, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: na omonto oyio goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’embori eyio, erio ayenyeenyere agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Abamura ba Aroni basiarere amanyinga aye ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka yake ni mbuzi, ataileta mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio arue ebitinya bionsi ebire ase enda ime, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, n’ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi abirue bibe ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene.

English: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa chake na kumchinja mbele ya Hema la Kukutania. Kisha wana wa Aroni watanyunyiza damu yake kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
Ekegusii: Omokuani abisaambere ase egesasiimero bibe endagera ekoruegwa egosaambwa n’omorero, ere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera. Ebitinya bionsi nebiane.

English: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
Kiswahili: Kutokana na ile sadaka anayotoa, atatoa sadaka hii kwa Bwana kwa moto: mafuta yote yanayofunika sehemu za ndani na yale yanayoungana nazo,
Ekegusii: Oyo nigo oraabe omooroberio ochiikire oragenderere botaambe ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase moraabe mokomenya, ng’a timobaisa koria ebitinya, gose konywa amanyinga.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them,
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mtu yeyote afanyapo dhambi bila kukusudia na akatenda lile lililokatazwa katika amri yoyote ya Bwana:
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a monto onde bwensi orakore ebibe mosiabano atancheti, ase amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene nakaanete ng’a takorwa, goika abe okobwatia amachiiko aya.

English: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to Yahweh for a sin offering.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa kuhani aliyetiwa mafuta amefanya dhambi na kuwaletea watu hatia, lazima alete kwa Bwana fahali mchanga asiye na dosari, kuwa sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya dhambi aliyotenda.
Ekegusii: “Onye Omokuani oyoakire amaguta ogokora ebibe, na igo arentere abanto bonsi okomocha, goika arue eeri ensae etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ase engencho y’ebibe ebio akorire, ayerue ase ’nde ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye.

English: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Atamkabidhi huyo fahali kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mbele za Bwana. Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha huyo fahali na kumchinja mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Arente eeri eria ase obosio bwane agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Erio goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eria, na ayenyeenyere agwo ase obosio bwane.

English: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani huyo aliyetiwa mafuta atachukua sehemu ya damu ya huyo fahali na kuileta katika Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Omokuani oyoakire amaguta aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri eria, ayarente ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, before the veil of the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Atachovya kidole chake katika hiyo damu na kuinyunyiza sehemu yake mara saba mbele za Bwana mbele ya pazia la mahali patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naende atobeke ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga ayio, ayanyororokerie ara gatano na kabere bosio bw’etoto eyio enachete Obomenyo Obochenu, agwo ase obosio bwane.

English: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani atatia sehemu ya hiyo damu juu ya pembe za madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba wenye harufu nzuri iliyoko mbele za Bwana katika Hema la Kukutania. Damu iliyobaki ya huyo fahali ataimwaga chini ya hayo madhabahu ya kuteketezea sadaka kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Omokuani oria agindie amanyinga make ase emegwekano ye ching’unchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasiimero ase n’ekoroso egosaamberwa, kere ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane, na amanyinga ’eeri eria agotigara ayaumore inse agwo ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa kere ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
Kiswahili: Atayaondoa mafuta yote ya fahali huyo wa sadaka ya dhambi, mafuta yale yanayofunika sehemu za ndani au zile zinazounganika nazo,
Ekegusii: Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’eeri eria y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, n’ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, n’ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime,

English: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,
Kiswahili: figo zote mbili na mafuta yaliyo juu yake karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini ambayo atayaondoa pamoja na figo zote,
Ekegusii: amo ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, n’ebitinya bichitubete bire ang’e nomogongo; n’ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo,

English: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.
Kiswahili: kama vile mafuta yanayoondolewa kutoka kwenye maksai aliyetolewa sadaka ya amani. Kisha kuhani ataviteketeza juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: koreng’ana buna akobirusia korwa ase eng’ombe eria ekonyeenywa ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe. Erio abisaambere ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso.

English: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung
Kiswahili: Lakini ngozi ya huyo fahali na nyama zake zote, pamoja na kichwa na miguu yake, sehemu za ndani na matumbo,
Ekegusii: Korende riiyo ri’eeri eyio amo ne chinyama chionsi, na omotwe, na ebirenge, na enda, na esike,

English: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.
Kiswahili: yaani sehemu nyingine zote zilizobaki za huyo fahali, lazima azitoe nje ya kambi mpaka mahali palipo safi kiibada, ambapo majivu hutupwa, naye atamchoma kwa moto juu ya kuni zilizoko juu ya lundo la majivu.
Ekegusii: ebinto ebio bionsi bi’eeri eyio abisokie isiko y’ebitwori, abiire gochia aase achenire, ase ribu rigotugutwa, abisaambere ase omorero bwe chinko agwo igoro ase ribu.

English: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa jumuiya yote ya Israeli watatenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia na kufanya lile lililokatazwa katika amri yoyote ya Bwana, hata kama jumuiya haifahamu juu ya jambo hilo, wana hatia.
Ekegusii: “Onye omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okorire ebibe mosiabano otancheti, na amang’ana ayio abe abisekanire ase bare, keraabe bakorire kende gionsi eki inche Omonene nakaanete ng’a tigekorwa, na igo babeire nokomocha,

English: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Wanapotambua kuhusu dhambi waliyoitenda, lazima kusanyiko lilete fahali mchanga kuwa sadaka ya dhambi na kuikabidhi mbele ya Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: agwo ekero ebibe biria biraabe biamanyekanire, omosangererekano orue eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na koyerenta agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before Yahweh; and the bull shall be killed before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wazee wa jumuiya wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha huyo fahali aliye mbele za Bwana, naye fahali atachinjwa mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase obosio bwane abagaaka b’omoganda oria goika babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio, na ero enyenyerwe agwo ase obosio bwane.

English: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani aliyetiwa mafuta ataiingiza sehemu ya damu ya huyo fahali ndani ya Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Omokuani oyio oakire amaguta, aire amanyinga make ay’eeri eyio ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime.

English: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.
Kiswahili: Atachovya kidole chake kwenye damu na kuinyunyiza mara saba mbele za Bwana mbele ya hilo pazia.
Ekegusii: Erio atobeke ekiara kiaye ime ase amanyinga na anyororokererie ara gatano na kabere ase obosio bwane agwo bosio bw’etoto eria y’egetambaa,

English: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before Yahweh, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Atatia sehemu ya hiyo damu juu ya pembe za madhabahu yaliyo mbele za Bwana katika Hema la Kukutania. Damu iliyobaki ataimwaga chini ya madhabahu ya kuteketezea sadaka, penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: agindie amanyinga make ase emegwekano ye ching’unchara chi’egesasiimero kere ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, agwo ase obosio bwane, korende amanyinga onsi aya agotigara ayaumore agwo inse ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.
Kiswahili: Atayaondoa mafuta yote ya yule fahali na kuyateketeza juu ya madhabahu,
Ekegusii: Naende ebitinya bionsi bi’eeri eyio abirusie na kobisaambera ase egesasiimero.

English: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.
Kiswahili: naye atamfanyia fahali huyu kama alivyomfanyia yule fahali mwingine wa sadaka ya dhambi. Kwa njia hii kuhani atawafanyia watu upatanisho, nao watasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo arakore eeri eyio buna akorete eeri eria ye ritang’ani y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase bare, na barabwo nabaaberwe.

English: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.
Kiswahili: Kisha atamchukua yule fahali nje ya kambi na kumteketeza kama alivyomteketeza yule wa kwanza. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya jumuiya.
Ekegusii: Erio aire eeri eyio isiko y’egetwori, ayesaambere aroro, buna asaambete eeri eria ye ritang’ani. Ekio n’ekengwanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoganda bwonsi.

English: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which Yahweh his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wakati kiongozi ametenda dhambi bila kukusudia na kufanya yaliyokatazwa katika amri yoyote ya Bwana Mungu wake, ana hatia.
Ekegusii: “Omogambi karakore ebibe mosiabano atancheti, na akore amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene, Nyasae oye, nakaanete ng’a takorwa, na igo obeire nokomocha,

English: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.
Kiswahili: Atakapofahamishwa dhambi aliyotenda, ni lazima alete mbuzi dume asiye na dosari kama sadaka yake.
Ekegusii: agwo ekero ebibe biria akorete biraabe biamanyekanire asare, arente egoree etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso kiaye.

English: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh. It is a sin offering.
Kiswahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha yule mbuzi na kumchinja mahali pale ambapo sadaka za kuteketezwa huchinjiwa mbele za Bwana. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Ere goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’egoree eyio, ayenyeenyere agwo aase abanto bakonyenyera ebing’wanso bi’ogosaambwa, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Ekio n’ekengwanso ki’ebibe.

English: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani atachukua sehemu ya damu ya sadaka ya dhambi kwa kidole chake na kuitia kwenye pembe za madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketeza, na kuimwaga damu iliyobaki chini ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omokuani atobeke ekiara kiaye ime ase amanyinga ayagindie ase emegwekano ye ching’unchara chi’egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, korende amanyinga onsi agotigara ayaumore agwo inse ase egesasiimero ekio.

English: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Atayateketeza mafuta yote juu ya madhabahu, kama alivyoteketeza mafuta ya sadaka ya amani. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho wa dhambi kwa ajili ya yule mtu, naye atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Ebitinya biaye bionsi abisaambere ase egesasiimero buna ebi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bigosaambwa. Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omogambi oria ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na omogambi oria naaberwe.

English: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtu katika jumuiya ametenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia na kufanya lile lililokatazwa katika amri yoyote ya Bwana, yeye ana hatia.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto onde bwensi ogokora ebibe mosiabano atancheti, ase amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene nakaanete ng’a takorwa, na igo obeire nokomocha,

English: if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has sinned.
Kiswahili: Atakapofahamishwa dhambi yake aliyoitenda, ni lazima alete mbuzi jike asiye na dosari kama sadaka yake kwa ajili ya dhambi aliyotenda.
Ekegusii: agwo ekero ebibe bi’omonto oria biraabe biamanyekanire asare arente esubeni etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye.

English: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka ya dhambi na kumchinjia mahali pa kuteketezea sadaka.
Ekegusii: Erio abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’embori eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na ayenyeenyere agwo ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosaambwa bikonyeenyerwa.

English: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani atachukua sehemu ya ile damu kwa kidole chake na kuitia kwenye pembe za madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kuimwaga damu iliyobaki chini ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omokuani aimokie amanyinga make, atobeke ekiara kiaye agindie emegwekano ye ching’unchara chi’egesasiimero ki’ogosaambera ebing’wanso; amanyinga aya agotigara ayaumore agwo inse, ase egesasiimero ekio.

English: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Atayaondoa mafuta yote, kama vile mafuta yaondolewavyo kwenye sadaka ya amani, naye kuhani atayateketeza juu ya madhabahu kama harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, naye atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’embori eyio buna ebitinya bi’eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bikorusigwa, na Omokuani asaambere ebitinya ebio ase egesasiimero bibe rimisu rigiya rikongwenera. Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.

English: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa ataleta mwana-kondoo kama sadaka yake ya dhambi, atamleta jike asiye na dosari.
Ekegusii: “Omonto oria kararue emaanwa y’eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, arente esigiti etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.

English: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha huyo mwana-kondoo na kumchinja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi mahali sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa.
Ekegusii: Ere abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’emaanwa eria, ayenyeenyere agwo ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosaambwa bikonyeenyerwa, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

English: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani atachukua sehemu ya damu ya sadaka ya dhambi kwa kidole chake na kuitia juu ya pembe za madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na ile damu iliyobaki ataimwaga chini ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omokuani aimokie amanyinga make ay’emaanwa eyio, atobeke ekiara kiaye agindie emegwekano ye ching’unchara chi’egesasiimero ki’ogosaambera ebing’wanso, korende amanyinga ayagotigara ayaumore agwo inse, ase egesasiimero ekio.

English: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Ataondoa mafuta yote, kama vile mafuta yaondolewavyo kutoka kwenye mwana-kondoo wa sadaka ya amani, naye kuhani atayateketeza juu ya madhabahu juu ya zile sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa dhambi aliyoitenda, naye atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’eng’ondi eyio, buna ebitinya bi’emaanwa y’eng’ondi y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bikorusigwa, na Omokuani abisaambere ase egesasiimero, igoro ase ekeng’wanso kegosaamberwa n’omorero ase ’nde. Ase enchera eyio Omokuani nakore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na omonto oria naaberwe.

English: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu atakuwa ametenda dhambi kwa sababu hakusema alipotakiwa kutoa ushahidi hadharani kuhusu jambo aliloona au kujua habari zake, yeye anastahili adhabu.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorangerigwa abe kirori na gotiana, anyare koorokia aya aroche, gose aigwete, ko tayaorokia, ere goika abarerwe obobe boria bw’ogotaorokia.

English: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Au kama mtu akigusa kitu chochote ambacho ni najisi, iwe ni mizoga ya wanyama pori walio najisi, au ya wanyama wafugwao walio najisi, au ya viumbe vitambaavyo ardhini, hata akiwa hana habari, amekuwa najisi na mwenye hatia.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogokuna kende gionsi getachenegeti, koraabe omobere okwete bw’eng’iti y’orosana etachenegeti, gose oyo bw’eng’iti etugire etachenegeti, gose oyo bw’akang’iti agake gatechenegeti, nonya amang’ana ayio abisekanete, ere nabe oyotachenegeti, abarerwe obobe bwaye.

English: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Au kama akigusa kitu kilicho kichafu kinachotokana na binadamu, kitu chochote kile kinachoweza kumfanya awe najisi, hata akiwa hana habari, atakapofahamu atakuwa na hatia.
Ekegusii: “Omonto aise gokuna egento kende gionsi kia Mwanyabaanto getachenegeti, gokoraabe ogotacheneka gwa kende gionsi keramokore abe oyotachenegeti, nonya amang’ana ayio abisekanete asare, ekero arayamanye, nabe nokomocha.

English: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Au kama mtu ameapa kufanya kitu chochote bila kufikiri, kiwe chema au kibaya, kwa vyovyote mtu aweza kuapa bila kujali, hata akiwa hana habari, atakapofahamu atakuwa na hatia.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karabe omwango gotiana ase ogokora amabe gose amaya, ogotiana konde gwonsi buna abanto bande bakoba abaango gotiana batari korengereria, na ayio abe abisekanete ase omonto oyio, ekero arayamanye, nabe nokomocha ase amang’ana ayio.

English: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wakati mtu yeyote atakapokuwa na hatia katika mojawapo ya haya, lazima akiri ni kwa njia gani ametenda dhambi,
Ekegusii: “Ekero omonto arabe nokomocha ase amang’ana goika aorokie ebibe ebio akorire.

English: and he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.
Kiswahili: na kama adhabu ya dhambi aliyoitenda, lazima alete kwa Bwana kondoo jike au mbuzi jike kutoka kwenye kundi lake kama sadaka ya dhambi; naye kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa dhambi yake.
Ekegusii: Naende andeetere inche Omonene ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ase engencho y’ebibe ebio akorire; arente eng’iti eaberi, eng’ondi gose embori, ebe ekeng’wanso ekio ki’ebibe, na Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe ebibe biaye.

English: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to Yahweh; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini huyo mtu kama hataweza kumtoa mwana-kondoo, ataleta hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa kwa Bwana kuwa adhabu kwa ajili ya dhambi yake, mmoja wa hao ndege kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na wa pili kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oria takonyara konyora eng’ondi, gose embori, rirorio andeetere inche Omonene amaruma abere, gose amage y’amaruma abere, abe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ase engencho y’ebibe akorire. Erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa.

English: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.
Kiswahili: Atawaleta kwa kuhani, ambaye atamtoa kwanza ndege mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi. Atamvunja shingo na kuacha kichwa chake kikiningʼinia,
Ekegusii: Arente amaruma ayio ase Omokuani, nere arue ritang’ani riruma erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, amiine ebigoti bie riruma erio, korende tabutora omotwe korwa ase ebigoti.

English: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.
Kiswahili: naye atanyunyiza sehemu ya hiyo damu ya sadaka ya dhambi kwenye pembe za madhabahu. Damu iliyobaki lazima ichuruzwe chini ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Erio anyororokerie amanyinga make y’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’ebibe ase egesasiimero ensemo. Amanyinga agotigara ayanyititorerie agwo inse ase egesasiimero. Ekio n’ekengwanso ki’ebibe.

English: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani atamtoa yule ndege wa pili kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa kufuata utaratibu uliowekwa, na hivyo kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa dhambi aliyoitenda, naye atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Naende arue riruma ria kabere ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, koreng’ana buna achiikire. Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’ebibe ebi akorire, na omonto oria naaberwe.

English: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa basi, hawezi kupata hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, ataleta sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi. Kamwe asiweke mafuta wala uvumba juu yake, kwa sababu ni sadaka ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oria takonyara konyora amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, rirorio arente obosie obonuke ebimunu bibere bobe okoruegwa kw’ebibe biaye. Tabeeka amaguta, gose ekoroso, ase okoruegwa okwo, ekiagera nokoruegwa kw’ebibe.

English: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. It is a sin offering.
Kiswahili: Atauleta unga kwa kuhani, ambaye atachukua konzi moja kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu na atauteketeza kwenye madhabahu juu ya sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi.
