Ekegusii: Arente obosie obwo ase Omokuani, na Omokuani aimokie obosie obwo boichire roe bobe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo kwarurwe ase ’nde inche Omonene, erio abosaambere ase egesasiimero, igoro ase ebing’wanso bigosaamberwa n’omorero ase ’nde. Okwo nokoruegwa gw’okorusia ebibe.

English: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa dhambi yoyote ya hizo alizotenda, naye atasamehewa. Sadaka iliyobaki itakuwa ya kuhani, kama ilivyokuwa ile sadaka ya nafaka.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’ebibe akorire ase ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’ayio, na omonto oria naaberwe. Oboratigare bobe obw’Omokuani, buna obw’okoruegwa kw’endagera bokoba obwaye.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose:
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.
Kiswahili: “Mtu anapokiuka na kutenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia kuhusu mojawapo ya mambo matakatifu ya Bwana, huyo mtu ataleta kwa Bwana kama adhabu kondoo dume mmoja kutoka kundi lake, asiye na dosari na mwenye thamani halisi kifedha, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu. Hii ni sadaka ya hatia.
Ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi karasarie na akore ebibe mosiabano atancheti ase ogotarua ebinto biatananirwe na gochenwa ase ’nde, goika andeetere emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ayerusie korwa ase riicho riaye ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye. Naye oyekorere rigori rireng’aine eri’esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima alipe kwa yale aliyoshindwa kufanya kuhusu vitu vitakatifu, kwa kuongeza sehemu ya tano ya thamani ile na kuitoa yote kwa kuhani, ambaye atamfanyia upatanisho kwa huyo kondoo dume kama sadaka ya dhambi, naye atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria naakane egento keria egechenu ataruete, naende goika ameente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio, ayee Omokuani. Erio Omokuani arue emingichi eyio y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha na akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.

English: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akifanya dhambi na kufanya yale yaliyokatazwa katika mojawapo ya amri za Bwana, hata ikiwa hajui, yeye ana hatia na anastahili adhabu.
Ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi aise gokora gento ase amang’ana ayio inche Omonene nakaanete ng’a takorwa, nonya tamanyeti ng’a ayio akorire nokomocha, ere omochire, goika abarerwe okomocha okwo.

English: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Atamletea kuhani kama sadaka ya hatia kondoo dume kutoka kundi lake, kondoo asiye na dosari na mwenye thamani halisi kifedha. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa kosa alilotenda bila kukusudia, naye atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio arente korwa ase riicho riaye emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha. Naye oyekorere rigori. Ase enchera eyio Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’okomocha koria akorire mosiabano atancheti, na omonto oria naaberwe.

English: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Hii ni sadaka ya hatia; amekuwa na hatia kwa kufanya kosa dhidi ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ekio n’ekengwanso gi’okomocha. Omonto oria nigo areenge nokomocha ase obosio bw’Omonene.”

English: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against Yahweh, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu yeyote akitenda dhambi, naye si mwaminifu kwa Bwana kwa kumdanganya jirani yake kuhusu kitu fulani alichokabidhiwa, au kimeachwa chini ya utunzaji wake, au kimeibwa, au kama akimdanganya,
Ekegusii: “Omonto aise gokora ebibe na gosaria ase ’nde inche Omonene ase okong’ainereria omogisangio oye ase okwanga koirania ebinto aetwe ase amaboko aye abirende, gose ase okomourereria, gose ase okomoibera ase okomorega,

English: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—
Kiswahili: au akiokota mali iliyopotea na akadanganya, au kuapa kwa uongo, au kama akitenda dhambi yoyote ambayo watu waweza kuitenda;
Ekegusii: gose onyorire egento giasirete, naende akane na gotiana ng’a takenyorete, bibe ebibe binde bionsi abanto bagokora,

English: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,
Kiswahili: wakati akitenda dhambi hizo na kuwa mwenye hatia, ni lazima arudishe kile alichokuwa amekiiba au amekichukua kwa dhuluma, au alichokuwa amekabidhiwa, au mali iliyokuwa imepotea akaipata,
Ekegusii: ekero omonto akorire ebibe buna ebio na obeire nokomocha, nairanie egento keria airete ase obourereria, gose ase okorega, gose egento aetwe korenda, gose egento giasirete agakenyora,

English: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.
Kiswahili: au chochote alichokuwa amekiapia kwa uongo. Lazima akirudishe kikamilifu, na aongeze sehemu ya tano ya thamani yake, vyote ampe mwenye mali siku ile anapeleka sadaka yake ya hatia.
Ekegusii: gose egento kende gionsi keria atianete ase okong’ainereria; goika akeiranie gionsi, naende ameente ensemo ya isano ase rigori riaye akee omonyene ase rituko riria akorua ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha.

English: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.
Kiswahili: Kisha kama adhabu lazima amletee kuhani, yaani kwa Bwana, kama sadaka yake ya hatia, kondoo dume asiye na dosari na mwenye thamani kamili kutoka kundi lake.
Ekegusii: Erio andeetere inche Omonene emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye; ayerusie korwa ase riicho riaye rie ching’ondi, ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye; naye oyekorere rigori, na omonto oria ayeirere Omokuani.

English: The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mbele za Bwana, naye atasamehewa kwa kosa lolote katika mambo hayo aliyoyatenda yaliyomfanya kuwa na hatia.”
Ekegusii: Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oyio ase obosio bwane, na omonto oyio naaberwe ase kende gionsi akorire na kwerentera okomocha.”

English: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
Kiswahili: “Mpe Aroni na wanawe agizo hili: ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa: Sadaka ya kuteketezwa itabaki kwenye moto juu ya madhabahu usiku kucha, mpaka asubuhi, nao moto lazima uwe unaendelea kuwaka juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: “Moe Aroni amo nabamura baye ogochika oko igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa; Ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa kebeere igoro ase egesasiimero obotuko bwonsi goika mambia, na omorero bw’egesasiimero orendwe ogenderere gwoka.

English: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani atavaa mavazi yake ya kitani, pamoja na nguo za ndani za kitani mwilini wake, na aondoe majivu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa ambayo moto umeteketeza juu ya madhabahu, na kuyaweka kando ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omokuani abeeke eganchwa yaye y’egatani, amo ne chisirwari chi’ogwetuba, erio abuuche ribu korwa ase omorero oria osaamberete ekeng’wanso ase egesasiimero, aribeke ase egesasiimero ensemo.

English: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
Kiswahili: Kisha atayavua mavazi haya na kuvaa mengine, naye achukue yale majivu nje ya kambi na kuyapeleka mahali palipo safi kwa kawaida ya ibada.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio arusie chianga chiaye, abeeke chianga ching’ao, naende aimokie ribu, arisokie isiko y’egetwori, ariire gochia aase achenire.

English: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.
Kiswahili: Moto ulio juu ya madhabahu lazima uwe unaendelea kuwaka, kamwe usizimike. Kila asubuhi kuhani ataongeza kuni na kupanga sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya moto, na kuteketeza mafuta ya sadaka za amani juu yake.
Ekegusii: Omorero ore ase egesasiimero orendwe ogenderere gwoka, torima. Kera emambia Omokuani ameente chinko ase omorero oyio, naende achooke buya ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa igoro ase chinko echio na asaambe ebitinya bi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.

English: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.
Kiswahili: Moto lazima uendelee kuwaka juu ya madhabahu mfululizo, kamwe usizimike.
Ekegusii: Omorero oyio orendwe ogenderere gwoka botaambe, ase egesasiimero tobaisa korima.

English: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti ya sadaka ya nafaka: Wana wa Aroni wataileta mbele za Bwana, mbele za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okoruegwa kw’endagera: Abamura ba Aroni babe bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera ase obosio bw’Omonene, agwo ase egesasiimero.

English: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atachukua konzi ya unga laini na mafuta, pamoja na uvumba wote ulioko juu ya sadaka ya nafaka, ateketeze sehemu ya kumbukumbu juu ya madhabahu kama harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani otenenerete aimokie obosie obonuke boichire roe korwa ase okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera, na amaguta, n’ekoroso yonsi ere igoro yaye, abisaambere ase egesasiimero, bibe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene, kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.

English: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Aroni na wanawe watakula sehemu iliyobaki, lakini italiwa bila kutiwa chachu mahali patakatifu, nao wataila kwenye ua wa Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye goika barie eyegotigara ase okoruegwa okwo etabeekiri memera, bayeriere aase achenire, agwo ase eraaro y’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.
Kiswahili: Kamwe haitaokwa na chachu; nimewapa kama fungu lao la sadaka iliyotolewa kwangu kwa moto. Ni takatifu sana, kama vile ilivyo sadaka ya dhambi na ya hatia.
Ekegusii: Tebaisa koroiseranigwa n’ememera. Inche nabaeire endagera eyio ebe egetari kiabo gi’okoruegwa kwane kogosaambwa n’omorero. Ekio negechenu mono koreng’ana buna ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na egi’okomocha bire.

English: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume mzao wa Aroni aweza kuila. Ni fungu lake la kawaida la sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto kwa vizazi vijavyo. Chochote kinachozigusa kitakuwa kitakatifu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ase ororeeria rwa Aroni nanyare koria endagera eyio. Ekio nkebe egetari kiabo kia botaambe, gi’okoruegwa kwogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene, ebiaare ase ebiaare. Monto onde bwensi orakune ebing’wanso ebio nigo arabe omochenu.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Tena Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to Yahweh in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.
Kiswahili: “Hii ni sadaka ambayo Aroni na wanawe wanapaswa kuleta kwa Bwana siku atakapotiwa mafuta: sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini kama sadaka ya kawaida ya nafaka. Nusu yake ataitoa asubuhi na nusu nyingine jioni.
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okoruegwa Aroni na abamura baye bararue ase ’nde inche Omonene ase rituko riria onde obo araakwe amaguta na gwatananwa: Ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke, buna okoruegwa kw’endagera gwa kera rituko, ekemo mambia na ekende mogoroba.

English: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Iandae kwa mafuta kwenye kikaango; ilete ikiwa imechanganywa vizuri, na utoe hiyo sadaka ya nafaka ikiwa imevunjwa vipande vipande kuwa harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okoruegwa okwo gokorapuugwe namaguta ase orogio, gosamunyorwe, erio kobe okoruegwa kw’endagera kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.

English: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mwanawe atakayeingia mahali pake kama kuhani aliyetiwa mafuta ndiye atakayeiandaa. Ni fungu la kawaida la Bwana, nalo litateketezwa kabisa.
Ekegusii: Omokuani, omomura o Aroni, oyo oakire amaguta na gwatananwa ase okomobwatia, nere orarue okoruegwa okwo ase ’nde. Okwo nogochika koragenderere botaambe. Okoruegwa okwo nagosambwe gwonsi ase ’nde inche Omonene.

English: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”
Kiswahili: Kila sadaka ya nafaka ya kuhani itateketezwa kabisa; kamwe haitaliwa.”
Ekegusii: Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera Omokuani akorua goika gosambwe gwonsi, tikobaisa koriegwa.”

English: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.
Kiswahili: “Mwambie Aroni na wanawe: ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi: Sadaka ya dhambi itachinjiwa mbele za Bwana mahali sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa, ni takatifu sana.
Ekegusii: “Moe Aroni amo nabamura baye ogochika oko igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe: Agwo ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa gekonyeenyerwa nao agwo eki’ebibe keranyenyerwe, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Ekeng’wanso ekio negechenu mono.

English: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Kuhani anayeitoa ndiye atakayeikula; itakuliwa katika mahali patakatifu, katika ua wa Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Omokuani oyio okorua ekeng’wanso ekio nakeriere Aase achenire, agwo ase eraaro y’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.
Kiswahili: Chochote kitakachogusa nyama yoyote ya hiyo sadaka kitakuwa kitakatifu, na kama hiyo damu itadondokea juu ya vazi, lazima uifulie mahali patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi orakune enyama y’ekeng’wanso ekio nabe omochenu; naboigo na kende gionsi kerayekune, na amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio aise gotonyera eanga, eyio esiberigwe agwo Aase achenire.

English: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.
Kiswahili: Chungu cha udongo kitakachopikiwa nyama lazima kivunjwe, lakini kama imepikiwa kwenye chombo cha shaba, chombo hicho kitasuguliwa na kusuuzwa kwa maji.
Ekegusii: Enyongo ye chinyama echio chiraiyekerwe goika yaatwe, korende onye chikoiyekerwa ase esuguria, rirorio ero esisikigwe na ogosibigwa namaache.

English: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume katika familia ya kuhani aweza kula nyama hiyo; ni takatifu sana.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ore ase chinka chi’abakuani arie chinyama echio echire chinchenu mono.

English: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila sadaka ya dhambi ambayo damu yake imeletwa ndani ya Hema la Kukutania kufanya upatanisho katika Mahali Patakatifu kamwe haitaliwa; lazima iteketezwe.
Ekegusii: Korende ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, ekio amanyinga aye araarentwe ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ime y’Aase Aachenu tigekoriegwa, nigo kerasambwe n’omorero.

English: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya hatia, ambayo ni takatifu sana:
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha. Ekio n’ekengwanso egechenu mono.

English: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Sadaka ya hatia itachinjiwa mahali pale ambapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa, nayo damu yake itanyunyizwa pande zote za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Aase agwo eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ekonyeenyerwa nao eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha eranyenyerwe. Amanyinga aye asiarerwe ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,
Kiswahili: Mafuta yake yote yatatolewa sadaka: mafuta ya mkia na mafuta yale yanayofunika sehemu za ndani,
Ekegusii: Ebitinya biaye bionsi birusigwe na koruegwa; omokera n’ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda,

English: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;
Kiswahili: figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yanayozizunguka yaliyo karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini, ambayo yataondolewa pamoja na hizo figo.
Ekegusii: ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete bire ang’e nomogongo, n’ebitinya bie riini birusigwe amo ne chinyigo.

English: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to Yahweh: it is a trespass offering.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atayateketeza juu ya madhabahu kuwa sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto. Hii ni sadaka ya hatia.
Ekegusii: Omokuani abisaambere ase egesasiimero, bibe ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene. Ekio n’ekengwanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha.

English: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
Kiswahili: Mwanaume yeyote katika jamaa ya kuhani aweza kuila, lakini lazima iliwe mahali patakatifu; ni takatifu sana.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagwenerete kobwaterana ase okorua ekengwanso ekio, kera omosacha bw’enka y’Omokuani. Oyio nakeriere agwo Aase achenu, ekiagera agwo nase achenu mono kegima.

English: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Sheria hii ya sadaka ya hatia ni sawasawa na ile ya sadaka ya dhambi: Nyama ya yule mnyama aliyetolewa sadaka ni ya yule kuhani anayesimamia ibada ya upatanisho.
Ekegusii: “Ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha, nigo kore okomo nogw’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Omokuani oria ogokora okobwatanigwa nakerokio aire chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso eke chibe echiaye.

English: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
Kiswahili: Kuhani anayetoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya mtu yeyote anaweza kuichukua ngozi ya mnyama yule aliyetolewa iwe yake.
Ekegusii: Omokuani okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase engencho y’omonto onde, Omokuani oyio omonyene aire risankwa ri’ekeng’wanso keria ribe eriaye.

English: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.
Kiswahili: Kila sadaka ya nafaka iliyookwa jikoni au kupikwa katika sufuria au katika kikaangio itakuwa ya kuhani anayeitoa.
Ekegusii: Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera ’echinyeke koroiseirie riiko, na kende gionsi ekeroiseirie ase orogio, gose ase egetega, okwo ’nakobe okw’Omokuani oria okoruete ase ’nde inche Omonene.

English: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.
Kiswahili: Nayo kila sadaka ya nafaka, iwe imechanganywa na mafuta au iko kavu, itakuwa ya wana wa Aroni, nayo itagawanywa sawa kati yao.
Ekegusii: Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera gwochoganirie namaguta, gose ogotari namaguta, abamura ba Aroni baegwe, baatananerwe bareng’anerigwe.

English: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:
Kiswahili: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya amani ambayo mtu aweza kuileta kwa Bwana:
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, ekio omonto araarente ase Omonene.

English: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu atatoa sadaka ya amani kwa ajili ya kuonyesha shukrani, pamoja na sadaka hii ya shukrani, atatoa maandazi yasiyotiwa chachu yaliyochanganywa na mafuta, mikate myembamba isiyotiwa chachu iliyopakwa mafuta, maandazi ya unga laini uliokandwa vizuri na kuchanganywa na mafuta.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ekio ase ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, rirorio amo n’ekengwanso ekio arue okoruegwa kw’amaandasi atabeekiri memera aroisirie namaguta, na emegati emeoo etabeekiri memera eakire amaguta, na emegati y’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta.

English: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na sadaka hii ya amani ya shukrani ataleta sadaka ya maandazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa chachu.
Ekegusii: Amo n’ekengwanso kiaye ki’omorembe ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, arente emegati ebekire ememera.

English: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
Kiswahili: Ataleta moja ya kila aina ya andazi kama sadaka, matoleo kwa Bwana; hii ni ya kuhani anayenyunyiza damu ya sadaka ya amani.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase okoruegwa okwo arue omogati oyomo bwa kera egesaku, ebe ekeegwa ase Omonene. Eyio ebe ey’Omokuani oyio ogosiarera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso keria ase egesasiimero.

English: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.
Kiswahili: Nyama ya sadaka ya amani kwa ajili ya shukrani lazima iliwe siku iyo hiyo inapotolewa; hutabakiza kitu chochote mpaka asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’omorembe ki ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono chiriegwe ase rituko riria gekoruegwa; tichibaisa gotigara nonya ne chinsinini goika rituko ria kabere.

English: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama sadaka yake ni kwa ajili ya nadhiri au ni sadaka ya hiari, sadaka hiyo italiwa siku hiyo inapotolewa, lakini chochote kinachobakia kinaweza kuliwa kesho yake.
Ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’eira ariete, gose neki’ogwancha kwaye, nakeriegwe ase rituko riria gekoruegwa, na ekegotigara keriegwe ase rituko ria kabere.

English: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
Kiswahili: Nyama yoyote ya sadaka inayobaki mpaka siku ya tatu lazima iteketezwe kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso ekio chigotigara ase rituko ria gatato goika chisambwe n’omorero chiyie chiere.

English: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.
Kiswahili: Kama nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani italiwa siku ya tatu, Bwana hataikubali. Haitahesabiwa kwake huyo aliyeitoa, kwa kuwa ni najisi. Mtu atakayekula sehemu yake yoyote atahesabiwa hatia.
Ekegusii: Onye enyama ende yonsi y’ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’omorembe ekoriegwa ase rituko ria gatato, ekeng’wanso ekio tikegwancherwa, gose oyo okeruete takobarerwa ekeng’wanso ekio. Ekio nakebe okogechia, na onde bwensi oraarie enyama y’ekeng’wanso ekio nabarerwe obobe bwaye.

English: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nyama ile inayogusa chochote ambacho ni najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada kamwe haitaliwa, ni lazima iteketezwe kwa moto. Kuhusu nyama nyingine, mtu yeyote aliye safi kwa kawaida ya ibada anaweza kuila.
Ekegusii: Enyama eyio keraakune gento kende gionsi getachenegeti esambwe n’omorero, eyie eere. “Onye enyama echenegete, kera omonto ochenekire nare ne ribaga ri’okoyeria,

English: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mtu yeyote najisi akila nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, huyo mtu lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.
Ekegusii: korende oyotachenegeti takoria enyama y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa ase Omonene. Aise gokora igo, nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

English: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akigusa kitu kilicho najisi, iwe ni uchafu wa mwanadamu, au mnyama najisi, au kitu chochote kilicho najisi, kitu cha kuchukiza, kisha akala nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Naende omonto karakune egento getachenegeti, gokeraabe egetachenegeti kere ase omonto, gose ase eng’iti, gose okogechia konde gwonsi, na arie enyama y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa ase Omonene, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.”

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Msile mafuta yoyote ya ngʼombe, kondoo wala mbuzi.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a tibaabaisa koria ebitinya binde bionsi, ebi’eng’ombe, gose ebi’eng’ondi, gose ebi’embori.

English: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.
Kiswahili: Mafuta ya mnyama aliyekutwa amekufa au ameraruliwa na mnyama pori yanaweza kutumika kwa kazi nyingine yoyote, lakini kamwe msiyale.
Ekegusii: Ebitinya bi’eng’iti egokwa yoka enyene, na ebi’eng’iti egoitwa neyende, ebio nabikorerwe emeremo emeao, korende tibikoriegwa nonya ng’ake.

English: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote alaye mafuta ya mnyama ambaye ametolewa sadaka kwa Bwana kwa moto ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi oraarie ebitinya bi’eng’iti yarurwe ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene, oyio nigo eraatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

English: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.
Kiswahili: Popote mtakapoishi, kamwe msinywe damu ya ndege yeyote wala ya mnyama.
Ekegusii: Naende timoria amanyinga e chinyoni, gose aye ching’iti aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu yeyote atakunywa damu, mtu huyo lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi oraarie amanyinga ande onsi, oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Musa,

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mtu yeyote aletaye sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana ataleta sehemu ya sadaka hiyo kama dhabihu yake kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a omonto onde bwensi orarue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, arue korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio gentungetie inche Omonene.

English: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ataleta sadaka kwa mikono yake mwenyewe iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto; ataleta mafuta ya huyo mnyama pamoja na kidari, naye atainua hicho kidari mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
Ekegusii: Arente namaboko aye omonyene ekeng’wanso kiaye kegosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene; arente ebitinya amo ne ritaana, ne ritaana erio risungusigwe ribe ekeng’wanso kegosungusigwa ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.

English: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atayateketeza hayo mafuta juu ya madhabahu, lakini kidari kitakuwa cha Aroni na wanawe.
Ekegusii: Omokuani asaambere ebitinya ase egesasiimero, korende ritaana ribe eria Aroni na abamura baye.

English: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
Kiswahili: Paja la kulia la sadaka zako za amani utampa kuhani kama matoleo.
Ekegusii: Ekenama kia borio okee Omokuani buna ekeegwa korwa ase ebing’wanso biaino bi’omorembe.

English: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Aroni atoaye damu na mafuta ya sadaka ya amani ndiye atakayepewa paja hilo la kulia kuwa fungu lake.
Ekegusii: Omokuani, omomura o Aroni, oyio oraabe okorua amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe amo nebitinya, nere oraire ekenama keria kia borio kebe egetari kiaye.

English: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwenye sadaka za amani za Waisraeli, mimi Mungu nimepokea kidari kile kilichoinuliwa pamoja na lile paja lililotolewa, nami nimevitoa kwa kuhani Aroni na wanawe kuwa fungu lao la kawaida kutoka kwa Waisraeli.’ ”
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa n’Abaisraeli narusirie ritaana rigosungusigwa amo nekenama kia borio, nabieire Aroni Omokuani na abamura baye. Ebio nabio Abaisraeli barabe bakoa abakuani, bibe ebitari biabo botaambe.

English: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to Yahweh in the priest’s office;
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sehemu ya sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, ambazo zilitengwa kwa ajili ya Aroni na wanawe siku ile walipowekwa wakfu ili kumtumikia Bwana katika kazi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: “Ekio negetari kemotungetie Aroni na abamura baye korwa ase ebing’wanso bigosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde; nigo kiabeete ekiabo korwa rituko riria baatananetwe bakaba abakuani bagonkorera inche Omonene.

English: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.
Kiswahili: Siku ile walipotiwa mafuta, Bwana aliagiza kwamba Waisraeli wawape hili kama fungu lao la kawaida kwa vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Rituko riria baagetwe amaguta inche ngachiika ng’a egetari ekio korwa ase Abaisraeli kebe ekiabo kogenderera botaambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”

English: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings
Kiswahili: Basi haya ndiyo masharti kuhusu sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka ya nafaka, sadaka ya dhambi, sadaka ya hatia, sadaka ya kuwekwa wakfu, na sadaka ya amani,
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na egi’okorongeyia okomocha, na eki’ogosungusigwa, na eki’omorembe.

English: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.
Kiswahili: ambayo Bwana alimpa Mose juu ya Mlima Sinai siku ile alipowaagiza Waisraeli walete sadaka zao kwa Bwana, katika Jangwa la Sinai.
Ekegusii: Ogochika okwo nakwo Omonene aete Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, ase rituko riria achiigete Abaisraeli bamoruere Omonene ebing’wanso biabo.

English: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
Kiswahili: “Waletee Aroni na wanawe mavazi yao, mafuta ya upako, fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, kondoo dume wawili na kikapu chenye mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu.
Ekegusii: “Ira Aroni na abamura baye amo ne chianga chiabo chi’obokuani, na amaguta akweakwa, na eeri ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, ne chimingichi ibere, na egetonga kere n’emegati etabeekiri memera.

English: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”
Kiswahili: Kisha kusanya mkutano wote kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.”
Ekegusii: Naende orangerie omoganda bwonsi osangererekane ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.”

English: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza, na mkutano ukakusanyika kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete, na ekero omoganda bwonsi osangererekanete ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano,

English: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”
Kiswahili: Mose akaliambia kusanyiko, “Hili ndilo Bwana ameagiza lifanyike.”
Ekegusii: Musa akayoteebia. “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire akorwe.”

English: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamleta Aroni na wanawe mbele, akawaosha kwa maji.
Ekegusii: Musa akarenta Aroni na abamura baye, akabasibia namaache.

English: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.
Kiswahili: Akamvika Aroni koti, akamfunga mshipi, akamvika joho na kumvalisha kisibau. Pia akafunga kisibau juu yake na kukifunga kiunoni mwake kwa mshipi wake uliosokotwa kwa ustadi.
Ekegusii: Akabeekera Aroni eganchwa erobekanirie eigete inse, na eganchwa eria ende, akamoboeria norokini. Naende akamobeekera egesibao ki’obokuani, akamoboeria norokini rw’egesibao roroisirie nomonto omong’aini.

English: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.
Kiswahili: Akaweka kifuko cha kifuani juu yake, na kuweka Urimu na Thumimu kwenye hicho kifuko.
Ekegusii: Erio akamobeekera egesembe, na ime ase egesembe ekio akabeeka Urimu na Tumimu (omobaso na oboikeranu).

English: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamvika Aroni kilemba kichwani pake, akaweka lile bamba la dhahabu, yaani ile taji takatifu, upande wa mbele wa kilemba, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Akamobeekera ekegogwa ase omotwe oye, na bosio ase ekegogwa ekio agasiberania ekemanyererio egechenu gi’etaabu kiareenge kworokia ng’a bwatananirwe. Ase igo Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete.

English: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akachukua mafuta ya upako na kuipaka maskani na kila kitu kilichokuwamo ndani yake, kisha akaviweka wakfu.
Ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amaguta akweakwa, agaaka Obomenyo Obochenu, na kera egento kiareenge imeo, akabiaatanana bikaba ebichenu.

English: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.
Kiswahili: Akanyunyiza baadhi ya mafuta juu ya madhabahu mara saba, akaipaka madhabahu mafuta na vyombo vyake vyote pamoja na sinia na kinara chake, ili kuviweka wakfu.
Ekegusii: Akanyororokeria egesasiimero namaguta akweakwa ara gatano na kabere, naende agaaka egesasiimero amaguta aria, agaaka nebikorero bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye ase okobiaatanana bibe ebichenu.

English: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
Kiswahili: Akamimina sehemu ya hayo mafuta ya upako kichwani mwa Aroni, akamtia mafuta ili kumweka wakfu.
Ekegusii: Akaumora amaguta akweakwa igoro ase omotwe o Aroni, na akamoaka amaguta ase okomwaatanana na komochena.

English: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaleta wana wa Aroni mbele, akawavika makoti, akawafunga mishipi na kuwavika vilemba, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Naende Musa akarenta abamura ba Aroni, akababeekera chiganchwa, akababoeria chinkini na akababeekera ebigogwa ebike ase emetwe yabo, buna Omonene amochiigete.

English: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamtoa fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, nao Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Musa akarenta eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, erio Aroni amo nabamura baye bakabeeka amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio.

English: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.
Kiswahili: Mose akamchinja yule fahali na akachukua sehemu ya hiyo damu, kisha kwa kidole chake akaitia kwenye pembe zote za madhabahu ili kutakasa madhabahu. Akaimwaga damu iliyobaki chini ya madhabahu. Kwa hiyo akayaweka wakfu ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Eeri eyio ekanyenywa, erio Musa agatobeka ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga y’eeri eyio, akayagindia ase emegwekano yonsi ye ching’unchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasiimero, na agachena egesasiimero; na amanyinga aria atigarete akayaumora ase egesasiimero inse, akagiaatanana na kogechena, na igo akagekorera okobwatanigwa.

English: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.
Kiswahili: Pia Mose akachukua mafuta yote yanayozunguka sehemu za ndani, mafuta yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yake, akayateketeza juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Akaimokia ebitinya bionsi biareenge ase chinyama chi’enda, n’ebitinya bie riini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete, Erio Musa akabisaambera ase egesasiimero.

English: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Lakini fahali, ikiwa pamoja na ngozi yake na nyama yake na sehemu zake za ndani na matumbo, akaiteketeza nje ya kambi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Korende ebiatigarete korwa ase eeri eria, riiyo riaye, ne chinyama, na esike, akabisokia isiko y’egetwori akabisaambera aroro, buna Omonene amochiigete.

English: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamleta kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, naye Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Erio akarenta emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, na Aroni amo nabamura baye bakabeeka amaboko abo ase omotwe bw’emingichi eyio.

English: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akamchinja yule kondoo dume na kunyunyiza damu yake pande zote za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Emingichi eyio ekanyenywa, na Musa agasiara amanyinga y’emingichi eyio ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
Kiswahili: Mose akamkata yule kondoo dume vipande vipande na kukiteketeza kichwa, vile vipande na yale mafuta.
Ekegusii: Akanachana chinyama chi’emingichi eyio chikaba ebitari, agasibia chinyama chi’enda na ebirenge namaache. Erio agasamba omotwe, na ebitari biria, n’ebitinya, ne chinyama chionsi chi’emingichi eyio ase egesasiimero. Emingichi eyio ekaba ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Naboigo Omonene achiigete Musa.

English: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamsafisha sehemu za ndani na miguu kwa maji, na kumteketeza yule kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Musa akarenta emingichi ya kabere, eyio yaruetwe ase ogwaatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, Aroni na abamura baye bakabeeka amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’emingichi eyio.

English: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaleta kondoo dume mwingine, ndiye kondoo dume kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu, naye Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Emingichi eyio ekanyenywa, na Musa akaimokia amanyinga make, akagindia mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kwa Aroni, na ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio.

English: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
Kiswahili: Mose akamchinja yule kondoo dume, akaichukua sehemu ya damu yake na kuipaka juu ya ncha ya sikio la kuume la Aroni, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mkono wake wa kuume na juu ya kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kuume.
Ekegusii: Boigo abamura ba Aroni bakarentwa na Musa akagindia amanyinga mesia y’amato abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amagoro abo a borio. Erio amanyinga aria atigarete akayasiarera ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Pia Mose akawaleta hao wana wa Aroni mbele, akaipaka sehemu ya hiyo damu kwenye ncha za masikio yao ya kuume, juu ya vidole gumba vya mikono yao ya kuume, na juu ya vidole vikubwa vya miguu yao ya kuume. Kisha akanyunyiza damu pande zote za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Akaimokia ebitinya, na omokera, n’ebitinya bionsi bie chinyama chi’enda, n’ebitinya bie riini, ne chinyigo ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete, na ekenama kia borio.

English: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;
Kiswahili: Akachukua mafuta ya mnyama, mafuta ya mkia, mafuta yote yanayozunguka sehemu za ndani, mafuta yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yake, na paja la kulia.
Ekegusii: Naende korwa ase egetonga keria kiareenge agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene akarusia omogati oyomo otabeekiri memera, ne rindasi erimo, na omogati oyomo omoo, erio akabibeeka igoro ase ebitinya ebio na ekenama ekio kia borio.

English: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.
Kiswahili: Kisha kutoka kwenye kikapu cha mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichokuwa mbele za Bwana, akachukua andazi moja, na jingine lililotengenezwa kwa mafuta, na mkate mwembamba; akaviweka hivi vyote juu ya mafungu ya mafuta ya mnyama, na juu ya lile paja la kulia.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka ebinto ebio bionsi ase amaboko Aroni, na ay’abamura baye, akabisungusia bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Akaviweka hivi vyote mikononi mwa Aroni na wanawe, na kuviinua mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
Ekegusii: Naende Musa akabirusia korwa ase amaboko abo, akabisaambera ase egesasiimero amo n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa, bibe ekeng’wanso gi’okobaaatanana. Eke n’ekengwanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.

English: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akavichukua kutoka mikononi mwao na kuviteketeza juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kuwa sadaka ya kuwekwa wakfu, harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akaimokia ritaana, akarisungusia ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene. Nigo riabeete egetari kiaye kiarusetigwe korwa ase emingichi eria yaruetwe ase ogwaatanana abakuani. Ase igo Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete.

English: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha akachukua kidari, kilicho fungu la Mose la kondoo dume kwa ajili ya kuwekwa wakfu, na kukiinua mbele za Bwana kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amaguta akweakwa amo namanyinga areenge igoro ase egesasiimero, akanyororokeria Aroni amo ne chianga chiaye, akanyororokeria na abamura ba Aroni amo ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo agaatanana Aroni na abamura baye amo ne chianga chiabo ase emeremo emechenu.

English: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akachukua sehemu ya mafuta ya upako, na sehemu ya damu kutoka kwenye madhabahu, na kuvinyunyiza juu ya Aroni na mavazi yake, na juu ya wanawe na mavazi yao. Kwa hiyo akamweka Aroni na mavazi yake wakfu, pamoja na wanawe na mavazi yao.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni na abamura baye, “Iyekera enyama eyio agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na moyeriere aroro, moyerie amo n’emegati eria ere ime ase egetonga gi’okoruegwa ase ogwatananwa kw’abakuani! Naboigo inche nachiigete, ngateeba: Aroni amo nabamura baye mbayerie.

English: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni na wanawe, “Pika hiyo nyama kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, na uile hapo pamoja na mkate kutoka kwenye kikapu cha sadaka ya kuweka wakfu, kama nilivyoagiza, nikisema, ‘Aroni na wanawe wataila.’
Ekegusii: Korende enyama amo n’emegati biratigare mobisaambe n’omorero.

English: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.
Kiswahili: Kisha teketeza nyama na mikate iliyobaki.
Ekegusii: Inwe timobaisa gosoka isiko goetania egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, korende mobeereo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, goika amatuko ’ogwaatananwa kwaino aere.

English: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.
Kiswahili: Msitoke kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania kwa muda wa siku saba, mpaka siku zenu za kuwekwa wakfu ziwe zimetimia, kwa kuwa muda wenu wa kuwekwa wakfu utakuwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Buna akorirwe ase rituko ria reero, naboigo Omonene achiikire akorwe kogenderera ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more, erinde mwaberwe.

English: What has been done today, so Yahweh has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
Kiswahili: Lile lililofanyika leo liliagizwa na Bwana ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo moraabeere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, omobaso na obotuko, ase amatuko atano na abere, mobe mogokora ay’Omonene achiikire. Motakoreti ayio, inwe nigo morakwe.”

English: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”
Kiswahili: Lazima mkae kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania usiku na mchana kwa siku saba, na kufanya lile Bwana analolitaka, ili kwamba msife; kwa kuwa hilo ndilo nililoamriwa.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo Aroni na abamura baye bagakora onsi ay’Omonene achiigete goetera ase Musa.

English: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya nane, Mose akawaita Aroni na wanawe, na wazee wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato Musa akarangeria Aroni amo nabamura baye, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.

English: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia Aroni, “Chukua ndama dume kwa ajili ya sadaka yako ya dhambi, na kondoo dume kwa sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa, wote wawili wasiwe na dosari, nao uwalete mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende agateebia Aroni, “Chora eeri ensae na emori, chionsi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, ochirue ase Omonene. Eeri eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi ebe eki’ogosaambwa.

English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;
Kiswahili: Kisha waambie Waisraeli: ‘Chukueni mbuzi dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na ndama na mwana-kondoo, wote wawili wawe wa umri wa mwaka mmoja, na wasio na dosari, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa,
Ekegusii: Naende oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a bachore egoree ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emori amo nemaanwa y’eng’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa,

English: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”
Kiswahili: na pia maksai na kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya amani, ili kutoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka iliyochanganywa na mafuta. Kwa kuwa leo Bwana atawatokea.’ ”
Ekegusii: na eng’ombe amo nemingichi chibe ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase obosio bw’Omonene. Naboigo barue okoruegwa kw’endagera gwochoganirie namaguta, ekiagera ase rituko ria rero Omonene nabaorokere.”

English: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wakavileta vile vitu Mose alivyowaagiza mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, nalo kusanyiko lote likakaribia na kusimama mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakarenta ebinto ebio bionsi Musa abachiigete, bakabibeeka bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na omoganda bwonsi ogaika ang’e, ogatenena agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do; and Yahweh’s glory shall appear to you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akasema, “Hili ndilo Bwana alilowaagiza mlifanye, ili utukufu wa Bwana upate kuonekana kwenu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateeba: “Eke naki’Omonene abachiigete mokore, erio obonene bw’Omonene mbobaorokere.”

English: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as Yahweh commanded.”
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Njoo madhabahuni ili utoe dhabihu yako ya sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa, ufanye upatanisho kwa ajili yako mwenyewe na kwa ajili ya watu. Kisha utoe sadaka ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya watu, kama vile Bwana alivyoagiza.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni, “Suka gochia ang’e ase egesasiimero, na orue ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ebibe na eki’ogosaambwa, okore okobwatanigwa ase ore aye omonyene, na ase abanto, erinde mwaberwe. Naende orue ekeng’wanso ekio abanto barentire, na okore okobwatanigwa ase bare, buna Omonene achiigete.”

English: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Aroni akaja madhabahuni na kumchinja yule ndama kuwa sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Aroni agasuka gochia ang’e ase egesasiimero, akanyenya emori eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye omonyene,

English: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;
Kiswahili: Wanawe wakamletea damu, naye akachovya kidole chake katika hiyo damu, akaitia kwenye pembe za madhabahu, nayo damu iliyobaki akaimwaga chini ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: na abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga y’ekeng’wanso ekio, ere agatobeka ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga aria, erio akayagindia ase emegwekano ye ching’unchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasiimero, na amanyinga atigarete akayaumora ase egesasiimero inse.

English: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Juu ya madhabahu akateketeza mafuta, figo na mafuta yanayofunika ini kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya dhambi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Ebitinya ne chinyigo, n’ebitinya bie riini, ebiarusetie ase ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe, akabisaambera ase egesasiimero, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

English: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.
Kiswahili: Akateketeza nyama na ngozi nje ya kambi.
Ekegusii: Korende chinyama ne riiyo akabisamba n’omorero isiko y’egetwori.

English: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
Kiswahili: Kisha Aroni akachinja sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Wanawe wakamletea damu, naye akainyunyiza pande zote za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio akanyenya eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, na abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.
Kiswahili: Wakamletea sadaka ya kuteketezwa kipande kwa kipande, pamoja na kichwa, naye akaviteketeza juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Abamura baye bakamorentera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, egetari ase egetari, amo nomotwe, na ere akabisaambera ase egesasiimero.

English: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.
Kiswahili: Akasafisha sehemu za ndani na miguu, akaviteketeza juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Agasibia chinyama chi’enda amo nebirenge, erio akabisaambera amo n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa ase egesasiimero.

English: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.
Kiswahili: Kisha Aroni akaleta sadaka ile iliyokuwa kwa ajili ya watu. Akachukua yule mbuzi wa sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya watu, akamchinja na kumtoa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, kama alivyofanya kwa ile ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Erio Aroni akarenta ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe bi’abaanto. Akaimokia embori y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe bi’abaanto, akayenyenya, akayerua buna aruete eria ye ritang’ani ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene.

English: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
Kiswahili: Aroni akaleta sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kuitoa kama ilivyoelekezwa.
Ekegusii: Naende akarenta eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, akayerua buna konya achikirwe.

English: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.
Kiswahili: Pia akaleta sadaka ya nafaka, akachukua konzi moja na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, pamoja na sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Akarenta okoruegwa kw’endagera, akaimokia obosie boichire roe, akabosaambera ase egesasiimero amo n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa kia mambia.

English: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;
Kiswahili: Akachinja maksai na kondoo dume kama sadaka ya amani kwa ajili ya watu. Wanawe Aroni wakampa ile damu, naye akainyunyiza kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
Ekegusii: Akanyenya boigo eeri amo nemingichi, chikaba ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase engencho y’abanto. Abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ’ebing’wanso ebio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

English: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;
Kiswahili: Lakini sehemu zile za mafuta ya yule maksai na kondoo dume, yaani mafuta ya mkia, mafuta yaliyofunika tumbo, ya figo na yaliyofunika ini,
Ekegusii: Ebitinya bi’eeri eyio, na omokera bw’emingichi n’ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, ne chinyigo, n’ebitinya bie riini,

English: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.
Kiswahili: hivi vyote wakaviweka juu ya vidari, kisha Aroni akayateketeza hayo mafuta ya wanyama juu ya madhabahu.
Ekegusii: ebitinya ebio bionsi bakabibeeka igoro ase amataana, na Aroni akabisaambera ase egesasiimero,

English: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.
Kiswahili: Aroni akaviinua vile vidari na paja la kulia mbele za Bwana ili viwe sadaka ya kuinuliwa, kama Mose alivyoagiza.
Ekegusii: korende amataana na ebinema bia borio akabisungusia bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene, buna Musa achiigete.

English: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
Kiswahili: Kisha Aroni akainua mikono yake kuwaelekea watu na kuwabariki. Naye baada ya kutoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya dhambi, sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka ya amani, akashuka chini.
Ekegusii: Aroni gakoorire korua ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na eki’ogosaambwa, na eki’omorembe, akaimokia amaboko aye igoro ase abanto, akabasesenia, naende agaika gocha inse.

English: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the people.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose na Aroni wakaingia kwenye Hema la Kukutania. Walipotoka nje, wakawabariki watu. Nao utukufu wa Bwana ukawatokea watu wote.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bagasoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime, naende ekero basokire korwa aroro, bagasesenia abanto, na obonene bw’Omonene bokaorokera abanto bonsi.

English: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
Kiswahili: Moto ukaja kutoka uwepo wa Bwana, ukairamba ile sadaka ya kuteketezwa, pamoja na sehemu ya mafuta yaliyokuwa juu ya madhabahu. Watu wote walipoona jambo hili, wakapiga kelele kwa furaha na kusujudu.
Ekegusii: Omorero ogaika korwa ase Omonene mobosokano, ogasamba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa amo nebitinya biareenge ase egesasiimero, na ebinto ebio bikayia bikaera. Ekero abanto bonsi baroche amang’ana ayio bagaaka amariogi, bagatung’ama inse, bakaumama.

English: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before Yahweh, which he had not commanded them.
Kiswahili: Nadabu na Abihu, wana wa Aroni, wakachukua vyetezo vyao, wakaweka moto ndani yake na kuongeza uvumba; kisha wakamtolea Bwana moto usio halali, kinyume na agizo la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nadabu na Abihu, abamura ba Aroni, kera oyomo akaimokia orogio rwaye, akabeeka omorero ase orogio orwo, na akabeeka ekoroso igoro ase omorero oyio, bakarentera Omonene omorero orenge bw’engencho eng’ao, oyi’Omonene atabachiigete.

English: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hivyo moto ukaja kutoka kwa uwepo wa Bwana na kuwaramba, nao wakafa mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Na omorero ogaika korwa ase Omonene, okabasamba, barabwo bakayia, bagakwera agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Hili ndilo alilonena Bwana wakati aliposema: “ ‘Miongoni mwa wale watakaonikaribia nitajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu; machoni pa watu wote nitaheshimiwa.’ ” Aroni akanyamaza.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni, “Aya nar’Omonene atebiire, ng’a ere neorokie koba omochenu ase abanto abwo bakomoika ang’e, na ase amaiso b’abaanto bonsi naorokie obonene bwaye.” Aroni agakira‐kiri.

English: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”
Kiswahili: Mose akawaita Mishaeli na Elisafani, wana wa Uzieli mjomba wake Aroni, akawaambia, “Njooni hapa. Ondoeni miili ya binamu zenu mbele ya mahali patakatifu, mkaipeleke nje ya kambi.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Mishaeli na Elisafani, basinto ba Usieli, ise moke Aroni, akabateebia, “Inchuo mobogorie emebere y’abamino, abana ba iso moke, moyerusie korwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, moyeire isiko y’egetwori.”

English: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakaja na kuwaondoa, wakiwa bado wamevalia makoti yao ya ibada, wakawapeleka nje ya kambi, kama Mose alivyoamuru.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagaacha, bakabogoria emebere eria eboyirie chiganchwa chiabo, bakayeira isiko y’egetwori, buna Musa abateebeetie.

English: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which Yahweh has kindled.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akamwambia Aroni pamoja na wanawe, Eleazari na Ithamari, “Msifunue vichwa vyenu wala msirarue mavazi yenu, la sivyo mtakufa na Bwana ataikasirikia jumuiya nzima. Lakini ndugu zenu, nyumba yote ya Israeli, wanaweza kuwaombolezea wale ambao Bwana amewaangamiza kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni amo n’Eleazari na Itamari, abamura ba Aroni, “Timobaisa gotiga chitukia chiaino chitachanuiri, gose timobaisa gotandora chianga chiaino ase okobaichanera. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, na endamwamu entindi y’Omonene echiche igoro y’omoganda bwonsi. Korende Abaisraeli bamino bonsi barabwo mbabe bakorera ase engencho y’ogosamba ogotindi Omonene arentire.

English: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of Yahweh is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.
Kiswahili: Msitoke nje ya ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, la sivyo mtakufa, kwa sababu mafuta ya Bwana ya upako yako juu yenu.” Hivyo wakafanya kama vile Mose alivyosema.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gosoka isiko goetania egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, ekiagera mwatananirwe ase ogoakwa amaguta ’Omonene.” Barabwo bagakora buna Musa abateebetie.

English: Then Yahweh said to Aaron,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Aroni,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Aroni, akamoteebia,

English: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
Kiswahili: “Wewe na wanao msinywe mvinyo wala kinywaji kingine kilichochachuka wakati mwingiapo katika Hema la Kukutania, la sivyo mtakufa. Hili litakuwa Agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: “Aye amo nabamura bao timobaisa konywa edivai, gose ekenyugwa kegotindia, ekero mogosoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe. Okwo nogochika koragenderere ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima mtenganishe kilicho kitakatifu na kile kilicho cha kawaida, kati ya yaliyo najisi na yaliyo safi,
Ekegusii: Inwe goika momanye gwaatanana egento egechenu kere ekia Omonene korwa ase ekio getaatananiri koba egechenu, na egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti.

English: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Yahweh has spoken to them by Moses.”
Kiswahili: na lazima mwafundishe Waisraeli amri zote ambazo Bwana aliwapa kupitia Mose.”
Ekegusii: Mworokererie Abaisraeli amachiiko onsi aya inche Omonene nabachiikire goetera ase Musa.”

English: Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, “Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar; for it is most holy;
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Aroni pamoja na wanawe waliosalia, Eleazari na Ithamari, “Chukueni sadaka ya nafaka iliyobaki kutoka sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, muile hapo kando ya madhabahu ikiwa imeandaliwa bila chachu, kwa sababu ni takatifu sana.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni na abamura baye abatigarete, Eleazari na Itamari, “Imokia okoruegwa kw’endagera, okwo gotigarete korwa ase okwo gwasambirwe n’omorero ase Omonene, mokorie gotabeekiri memera, agwo ase egesasiimero ensemo, ekiagera okoruegwa okwo nogochenu mono.

English: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; for so I am commanded.
Kiswahili: Mtaila katika mahali patakatifu kwa sababu ni fungu lenu na fungu la wana wenu la sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, kwa maana hivyo ndivyo nilivyoamriwa.
Ekegusii: Mokoriere agwo Aase gete are aachenu. Ekio negetari kiao, na eki’abamura bao, gekorusigwa korwa ase okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene. Ayio nar’Omonene anchiigete.

English: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe na wanao na binti zako mwaweza kula kidari kile kilichoinuliwa na paja lile lililotolewa. Mtavila mahali safi pa kawaida ya ibada; mmepewa wewe na watoto wako kuwa fungu lenu la sadaka za amani za Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Korende ritaana rigosungusigwa, na ekenama gekoruegwa, aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, mwaeirwe ribaga kobiriera agwo aase achenire. Ebinto ebio aye na abana bao mwabieirwe korwa ase ebing’wanso bi’omorembe bikoruegwa n’Abaisraeli.

English: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as Yahweh has commanded.”
Kiswahili: Paja lile lililotolewa na kidari kile kilichoinuliwa lazima viletwe pamoja na sehemu za mafuta ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto, ili kuinuliwa mbele za Bwana kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa. Hili litakuwa fungu lako la kawaida na wanao, kama Bwana alivyoagiza.”
Ekegusii: Ekenama gekoruegwa, ne ritaana riria rigosungusigwa, birentwe amo nebitinya bikoruegwa ebing’wanso bigosaambwa n’omorero, bisungusigwe bibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ebio nabibe egetari kiao amo neki’abamura bao kogenderera botaambe, buna Omonene achiigete.”

English: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,
Kiswahili: Mose alipouliza kuhusu mbuzi atolewaye kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na kukuta kwamba ameteketezwa, aliwakasirikia Eleazari na Ithamari, wana wa Aroni waliobaki, akawauliza,
Ekegusii: Musa agatuka mono komanya inaki embori y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe yabeete, akamanya ng’a embori eria nigo yasaambetwe. Ase ayio akaba nendamwamu enene ase Eliezeri na Itamari, abamura ba Aroni, baria batigarete, akabateebia.

English: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahweh?
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini hamkula sadaka ya dhambi katika eneo la mahali patakatifu? Ni takatifu sana. Mlipewa ninyi ili kuondoa hatia ya jumuiya kwa ajili ya kuwafanyia upatanisho mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Nase ki motarierete ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe agwo aase are aachenu? Ekio negento egechenu mono mwaeirwe, erinde moruserie omoganda ebibe biabo, na gokora okobwatanigwa ase bare ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa damu yake haikuletwa ndani ya Mahali Patakatifu, mngemla mbuzi huyo katika sehemu ya mahali patakatifu kama nilivyoagiza.”
Ekegusii: Rora, amanyinga aye tairetwe agwo Aase Aachenu; nigo yabagwenerete mokeriere agwo aase achenire.”

English: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before Yahweh; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in Yahweh’s sight?”
Kiswahili: Aroni akamjibu Mose, “Leo wanangu wametoa sadaka zao za dhambi na sadaka zao za kuteketezwa mbele za Bwana, lakini mambo kama haya yamenitokea mimi. Je, Bwana angependezwa kama ningekuwa nimekula sadaka ya dhambi leo?”
Ekegusii: Aroni akairaneria Musa, “Rora, rituko ria reero abanto barure ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’ebibe, na eki’ogosaambwa, ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende nonya naboigo nomanyete emechando eye nanyorire. Onye inaria ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe rituko ria reero, Inee, nanga nancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene?”

English: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.
Kiswahili: Mose aliposikia haya, akaridhika.
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa aigwete amang’ana ayio agaisaneka.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,
Kiswahili: Bwana akawaambia Mose na Aroni,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.
Kiswahili: “Waambieni Waisraeli: ‘Kati ya wanyama wote waishio juu ya nchi, hawa ndio mtakaowala:
Ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli, mobateebie: Ase ching’iti chire ase ense, echi nachio moraarie chinyama chiabo:

English: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.
Kiswahili: Mwaweza kula mnyama yeyote mwenye kwato zilizogawanyika sehemu mbili na ambaye hucheua.
Ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, naende ekoria eng’ang’ura, nero moraarie.

English: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kuna wanyama wengine ambao hucheua tu au wenye kwato zilizogawanyika tu, lakini hao kamwe msiwale. Ngamia ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; kwa kawaida ya ibada hiyo ni najisi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Korende ase ching’iti chikoria eng’ang’ura gose chibwate ebitaago biatananegete timoria engamia, ekiagera nigo ekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio techenegeti.

English: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
Kiswahili: Pelele ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; huyo ni najisi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Timoria egesengi, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.

English: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.
Kiswahili: Sungura ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; huyo ni najisi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Timoria egesusu, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.

English: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.
Kiswahili: Naye nguruwe ingawa anazo kwato zilizogawanyika sehemu mbili, hacheui; huyo ni najisi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Naende timoria embeche, ekiagera nigo ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, korende teri koria eng’ang’ura; eyio techenegeti.

English: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.
Kiswahili: Kamwe msile nyama yao wala kugusa mizoga yao; wao ni najisi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Timoria chinyama chie ching’iti echio, gose timokuna emebere yabo ekwete, ekiagera echio tichichenegeti.

English: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kuhusu viumbe wote wanaoishi ndani ya maji ya bahari na vijito, mtakula wale wote wenye mapezi na magamba.
Ekegusii: Monyare koria chinswe chire ase chinyancha ne chindooche ime, echibwate chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho.

English: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,
Kiswahili: Lakini viumbe wote ndani ya bahari au vijito wasio na mapezi na magamba, wakiwa miongoni mwa makundi au viumbe wote ndani ya maji, hao ni machukizo kwenu.
Ekegusii: Korende ebitongwa binde bionsi bire moyo ime ase chinyancha, gose ase chindooche, bigotaara bire amaicho bitabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho, timobiria; ebio nokogechia ase more.

English: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.
Kiswahili: Nao watakuwa machukizo kwenu. Msile nyama yao, nayo mizoga yao itakuwa machukizo.
Ekegusii: Ebio nabigenderere koba okogechia ase more, chinyama chiabo timochiria, na echikwete ase echio timochiria, ekiagera echio nokogechia ase more.

English: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.
Kiswahili: Chochote kinachoishi ndani ya maji ambacho hakina mapezi na magamba kitakuwa chukizo kwenu.
Ekegusii: Kera egento kere ime ase chinyancha ne chindooche getabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho, ekio nokogechia ase more.

English: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wafuatao ndio ndege watakaokuwa machukizo kwenu, hivyo msiwale kwa sababu ni chukizo: tai, furukombe, kipungu,
Ekegusii: Nase chinyoni chiraabe okogechia ase more motarie nachio echi: Ekeongo, na ensoti, na obotere;

English: the red kite, any kind of black kite,
Kiswahili: mwewe mwekundu, aina zote za mwewe mweusi,
Ekegusii: amakoru na ebisaku biamwabo;

English: any kind of raven,
Kiswahili: aina zote za kunguru,
Ekegusii: ebigonkoru na ebisaku biamwabo bionsi;

English: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
Kiswahili: mbuni, kiruka-njia, dudumizi, kipanga, shakwe, aina zote za kipanga,
Ekegusii: esagero, na omoyaaye, na enyakoboke, na ebisaku biamwabo;

English: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
Kiswahili: bundi, mnandi, bundi mkubwa,
Ekegusii: enyakweumia, na endubi, na ebaraara;

English: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,
Kiswahili: mumbi, mwari, nderi,
Ekegusii: etibibi, na egetekere, na ensoti;

English: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.
Kiswahili: korongo, koikoi wa aina yoyote, hudihudi na popo.
Ekegusii: riagonga, na omoneke, na ebisaku biamwabo; enteema bobe na egetabora mato.

English: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wadudu wote warukao ambao hutembea kwa miguu minne watakuwa chukizo kwenu.
Ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebisinini bionsi bire moyo bire ne chimbaaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia ase more.

English: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.
Kiswahili: Lakini wako viumbe wenye mabawa ambao hutembea kwa miguu minne mtakaowala: wale wenye vifundo katika miguu yao ya kurukaruka juu ya ardhi.
Ekegusii: Korende ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaaba na amagoro ane inamorie ebio bigotaroka nebirenge.

English: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa hawa, mtakula nzige wa aina zote, senene, parare au panzi.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi bie chingige, na ebi’amabururu, na ebisase, ebio nabio moraarie.

English: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.
Kiswahili: Lakini viumbe wengine wote wenye mabawa na wenye miguu minne ni machukizo kwenu.
