English: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.
Kiswahili: Kamwe asimwoe mjane, au mwanamke aliyepewa talaka, wala mwanamke aliyejinajisi kwa ukahaba, bali atamwoa tu bikira kutoka miongoni mwa watu wake,
Ekegusii: Tabaisa konyuoma omokungu omoboraka, gose oyobatiganire nomosaacha oye, gose oyotari omwekuungi, gose ore omotayayi, korende anyuome omoiseke omwekuungi korwa ase abanto b’egesaku kiaye.

English: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies him.’”
Kiswahili: na hivyo hatawatia unajisi watoto wake miongoni mwa watu wake. Mimi ndimi Bwana, nimfanyaye mtakatifu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio nario abana baye barabe abachenu, tibasareka ase egati y’abanto baye, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa naende, akamoteebia,

English: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.
Kiswahili: “Mwambie Aroni: ‘Kwa vizazi vijavyo, hakuna mzao wako mwenye dosari atakayekaribia kutoa chakula cha Mungu wake.
Ekegusii: “Kwana na Aroni, omoteebie ng’a onde bwensi ore ekerema tabaisa goika ang’e kondeetera inche, Nyasae oye, okoruegwa kw’endagera. Okwo nogochika koragenderere botaambe ase ororeeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu mwenye dosari yoyote awezaye kukaribia: hakuna mtu aliye kipofu au kiwete, au aliyeharibika uso au asiye na viungo kamili,
Ekegusii: Omonto ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tabaisa goika ang’e, onye ore omouko, gose rigata, gose ore na kemocho ase obosio bwaye, gose ore nekiimo ekemo egetambe goetania ekende,

English: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,
Kiswahili: hakuna mtu mwenye mguu au mkono uliolemaa,
Ekegusii: gose omonto ore na kemocho ase okoboko gose ase okogoro,

English: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
Kiswahili: au mwenye kibiongo au aliyedumaa, au aliye na tatizo la macho, au aliye na uvimbe wenye usaha au majipu, au aliyehasiwa.
Ekegusii: gose omonto ore nesukubi ase omogongo oye, gose ore oboengere, gose oyore na kemocho ase eriso, gose oyo obosisa boriete, gose oborwaire bonde ase risankwa, gose omosacha chingetia chiaye chisaregete.

English: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mzao wa kuhani Aroni mwenye kilema chochote atakayekaribia kutoa sadaka kwa Bwana ya kuteketezwa kwa moto. Kama ana kilema, kamwe asikaribie kutoa chakula cha Mungu wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ase ororeeria rwa Aroni Omokuani ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tabaisa goika ang’e kondeetera inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero, ekiagera oyio ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tagoika ang’e andeetere inche, Nyasae oye, okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero.

English: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
Kiswahili: Anaweza kula chakula kitakatifu sana cha Mungu wake, pia hata chakula kitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ere nabe ne ribaga ri’okoria okoruegwa kw’endagera gokoruegwa ase ’nde inche Nyasae oye, okoruegwa okore ogochenu, amo nokore ogochenu mono.

English: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu ya kilema chake, kamwe asikaribie karibu na pazia wala kukaribia madhabahu, asije akanajisi mahali patakatifu pangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana, niwafanyaye watakatifu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende ekiagera are na kemocho ase omobere oye, tagoika ang’e netoto enachete Obomenyo Obochenu, gose tagocha aike ang’e negesasiimero. Aise goika ang’e, nigo aragere Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe botachenegeti. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”

English: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Basi Mose akamwambia Aroni jambo hili na wanawe, pamoja na Waisraeli wote.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio naro Musa atebeetie Aroni, amo nabamura ba Aroni, na Abaisraeli bonsi.

English: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Mwambie Aroni na wanawe kushughulikia kwa uangalifu sadaka takatifu Waisraeli wanazoziweka wakfu kwangu, ili wasilinajisi Jina langu takatifu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Kwana na Aroni na abamura baye, obateebie ng’a barende na bakore amasikani ase ebinto ebichenu, biria Abaisraeli bagwaatanana ase ’nde, erio tibaabaisa korenta obosooku ase erieta riane richenu. Inche ninche Omonene.

English: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Waambie: ‘Katika vizazi vijavyo, ikiwa yeyote wa wazao wako ni najisi kwa taratibu za kiibada, naye akakaribia sadaka takatifu zile Waisraeli wanazoweka wakfu kwa Bwana, mtu huyo lazima akatiliwe mbali na uso wangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Obateebie ng’a onye omonto onde bwensi ase ororeeria rwabo, ekero are oyotachenegeti; aise goika ang’e n’ebinto ebio Abaisraeli barabe bagwaatanana ase ’nde inche Omonene, omonto oyio naatananwe korwa ase obosio bwane, tagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani. Inche ninche Omonene.

English: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mzao wa Aroni ana ugonjwa wa ngozi unaoambukiza au anatokwa na usaha mwilini, hawezi kula sadaka takatifu mpaka atakasike. Pia atakuwa najisi ikiwa atagusa kitu chochote kilicho najisi kwa kugusa maiti au mtu aliyetokwa na shahawa,
Ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi ase ororeeria rwa Aroni obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, gose okorua amaache anga buna chimengere, tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu goika ekero arabe ochenekire; naboigo na onde bwensi orakune egento getachenegeti, buna egetondo, gose omonto ogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro,

English: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—
Kiswahili: au ikiwa atagusa kitu chochote kitambaacho kimfanyacho mtu najisi, au mtu yeyote awezaye kumtia unajisi, hata unajisi uwe gani.
Ekegusii: na onde bwensi orakune eng’iti ekwagura, eye eramokore abe oyotachenegeti, gose akune omonto oragere abe oyotachenegeti, ogotacheneka kwaye gakoraabe okw’engencho ende yonsi.

English: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.
Kiswahili: Mtu anayegusa kitu chochote cha aina hiyo atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni. Kamwe hatakula sadaka yoyote takatifu mpaka yeye mwenyewe awe ameoga kwa maji.
Ekegusii: Omokuani onde bwensi orakune egento buna ekio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio; ere takoria ebinto ebichenu goika ekero arabe bwesibirie omobere oye namaache.

English: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
Kiswahili: Wakati jua linapotua, atakuwa safi, na baadaye anaweza kula sadaka takatifu, kwa kuwa ni vyakula vyake.
Ekegusii: Ekero erioba riagure, abe ochenekire, na magega y’ayio amanye koria ebinto ebichenu, ekiagera ebinto ebio nabio endagera yaye.

English: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kamwe asile nyama ya mzoga wala iliyoraruliwa na wanyama pori, naye akatiwa unajisi kwa hilo. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Taria enyama y’eng’iti ekwete yoka enyene, gose eye eitire neng’iti ende y’orosana. Aise koria enyama buna eyio, nigo arabe oyotachenegeti. Inche ninche Omonene.

English: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Makuhani lazima washike maagizo yangu ili wasiwe na hatia, wakafa kwa kuyadharau. Mimi ndimi Bwana ninayewafanya watakatifu.
Ekegusii: “Abakuani bonsi goika barende amang’ana aya nachiikire. Batayabwateti, nababe abakori ebibe ase ayio, na barabwo mbakwe, ekiagera bagosaria aya nachiikire. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.

English: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hakuna mtu yeyote asiye wa jamaa ya kuhani anayeruhusiwa kula sadaka takatifu, hata mgeni wa kuhani au mfanyakazi wake haruhusiwi kuila.
Ekegusii: “Omonto otari bw’eamate y’Omokuani tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu. Omomenyi omenyete amo n’Omokuani, gose omonto orikire komokorera emeremo, abwo tibaabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu.

English: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa kuhani amenunua mtumwa kwa fedha, au mtumwa amezaliwa katika nyumba ya kuhani huyo, mtumwa huyo aweza kula chakula cha huyo kuhani.
Ekegusii: Omosomba onde bwensi Omokuani agorete ne chitaabu chiaye omonyene, gose omosomba oiboreire ase enka yaye, abwo nabarie endagera eria Omokuani akoegwa.

English: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa binti wa kuhani ameolewa na mtu asiye kuhani, binti huyo haruhusiwi kula chochote cha matoleo matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke bw’Omokuani karanyuomwe nomonto otari Omokuani tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu bikoruegwa bibe ebing’wanso.

English: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa binti wa kuhani amekuwa mjane au amepewa talaka, naye hana watoto, na akarudi kuishi na jamaa ya baba yake kama wakati wa usichana wake, binti huyo anaweza kula chakula cha baba yake. Hata hivyo, mtu asiyeruhusiwa hawezi kula chochote katika chakula hiki.
Ekegusii: Korende omosubati bw’Omokuani osogete otigirwe ore omoboraka, gose batiganire nomosaacha oye, na tabwati omwana, na bono oiranire gocha o ise komenyao buna ekero areenge omoke, nanyare koria endagera eria ya ise. Korende omonto otari bw’eamate y’Omokuani tabaisa koria endagera eria.

English: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu yeyote amekula sadaka takatifu kwa makosa, lazima atoe malipo ya sadaka hiyo kwa kuhani na kuongeza sehemu ya tano ya thamani ya sadaka hiyo.
Ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi otari bw’eamate y’Omokuani oraarie ebinto biria ebichenu ase ogotamanya, goika airanie egento egechenu ase Omokuani, buna keria airete, na ameente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio.

English: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,
Kiswahili: Kamwe makuhani wasiinajisi sadaka takatifu ambayo Waisraeli wameitoa kwa Bwana
Ekegusii: Abakuani tibaabaisa gokora ebinto ebi ebichenu Abaisraeli bagwaatanana na kobirua ase Omonene bibe ebitachenegeti,

English: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”
Kiswahili: kwa kuwaruhusu kuzila sadaka hizo takatifu, na hivyo kuwaletea hatia ya kudaiwa malipo. Mimi ndimi Bwana niwafanyaye watakatifu.’ ”
Ekegusii: na igo bakogera abanto babogorie ebibe biabo, na okomocha kwabo, ase okoria ebinto ebichenu baruete. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”

English: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering:
Kiswahili: “Sema na Aroni na wanawe, na Waisraeli wote uwaambie: ‘Ikiwa mmoja wenu, aliye Mwisraeli au mgeni anayeishi katika nchi ya Israeli, atatoa matoleo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa Bwana, iwe kutimiza nadhiri au kuwa sadaka ya hiari,
Ekegusii: “Teebia Aroni na abamura baye, na Abaisraeli bonsi, ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, aganetie konduera inche Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, keraabe nase engencho y’eira, gose neki’ogwancha kwaye,

English: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
Kiswahili: lazima mtoe mnyama dume asiye na dosari, akiwa ngʼombe, mbuzi au kondoo, ili aweze kukubalika kwa niaba yako.
Ekegusii: goika arue eeri, gose egoree, gose emingichi, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, erio nario ekeng’wanso kerancherwe.

English: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.
Kiswahili: Kamwe usitoe kitu chochote chenye dosari kwa sababu hakitakubaliwa kwa niaba yako.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa korua eng’iti ende yonsi ere na kemocho ase omobere oye, naki ase ekeng’wanso buna ekio timogwancherwa.

English: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote aletapo sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana kutoka kundi la ngʼombe au mbuzi ili kutimiza nadhiri maalum au sadaka ya hiari, lazima sadaka hiyo isiwe na dosari au waa ili ikubalike.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto onde bwensi akorua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase ’nde, ase engencho y’eira ariete, gose eki’ogwancha kwaye, korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, goika ebe eng’iti eng’ikeranu, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, eyio nero erancherwe.

English: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kamwe usimtolee Bwana mnyama aliye kipofu, aliyejeruhiwa wala aliye kilema, au chochote kilicho na uvimbe, au chenye upele au vidonda vinavyotoka usaha. Kamwe chochote cha aina hii kisiwekwe juu ya madhabahu kuwa sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana ya kuteketezwa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa konduera ching’iti chiukorete, gose chire ebisegora, gose ebirema, gose chire namaote akorua amaira, gose chibwate egesuneri, gose amaote, ng’a chibe ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase egesasiimero.

English: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
Kiswahili: Lakini waweza ukatoa ngʼombe au kondoo mwenye kilema au aliyedumaa kama sadaka ya hiari, lakini hii haitakubalika kuwa sadaka ya kutimiza nadhiri.
Ekegusii: Eeri gose emaanwa y’eng’ondi ebwate ekiimo egetambe goetania ekende, gose ekieng’e mono, nabo oranyare koyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogwancha, korende ase okoyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogoikerania eira kwariete, tegwancherwa nainche.

English: You must not offer to Yahweh that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.
Kiswahili: Kamwe usimtolee Bwana mnyama ambaye mapumbu yake yamejeruhiwa, au kuhasiwa, au kuraruliwa au kukatwa. Kamwe usifanye hivi katika nchi yako mwenyewe,
Ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi chingetia chiaye chisaregete ase ogosunyuntwa, gose ase okomiorigwa, gose ase okobutorwa, gose ase okonatwa, timobaisa koyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ase ’nde. Timokora igo ase ense yaino.

English: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”
Kiswahili: na kamwe usikubali wanyama wa aina hii kutoka mkono wa mgeni ili kuwatoa wanyama hao kuwa chakula kwa Mungu wako. Wanyama hao hawatakubaliwa kwa niaba yako, kwa sababu wana vilema, nao wana dosari.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Eng’iti ende yonsi ere buna echio moranyore korwa ase omomenyi, timobaisa koyerua ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera ase ’nde. Echio nigo chire nebimocho ase emebere yabo, na ase ebing’wanso buna ebio timogwancherwa.”

English: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Wakati ndama, mwana-kondoo au mwana-mbuzi azaliwapo, atabaki na mama yake kwa siku saba. Kuanzia siku ya nane na kuendelea anaweza kukubaliwa kuwa sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa kuteketezwa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: “Ekero emori, gose emaanwa y’eng’ondi, gose ey’embori, yabiarirwe, etigwe ebe ase eng’ina ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, korende korwa ase rituko ria gatano na gatato yancherwe ebe ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde.

English: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
Kiswahili: Usimchinje ngʼombe na ndama wake, au kondoo na kitoto chake siku moja.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa konyenya eng’ombe amo nemori yaye ase rituko erimo, gose eng’ondi, gose embori amo ne chimanwa chiabo ase rituko erimo.

English: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
Kiswahili: “Unapomtolea Bwana dhabihu ya shukrani, itoe kwa namna ambayo itakubalika kwa niaba yako.
Ekegusii: Ekero moganetie konduera inche Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, mokerue ase enchera endonge, erinde monyare gwancherwa.

English: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima iliwe siku iyo hiyo, pasipo kubakiza chochote mpaka asubuhi. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ekio keriegwe keere ase rituko erio erio, tigetigara nonya ngesinini goika rituko ria kabere. Inche ninche Omonene.

English: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Shikeni maagizo yangu na kuyafuata. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio mobwate amachiiko aane na koyakora. Inche ninche Omonene,

English: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,
Kiswahili: Msilinajisi Jina langu takatifu. Lazima nikubalike kuwa mtakatifu kwa Waisraeli. Mimi ndimi Bwana ninayewafanya watakatifu,
Ekegusii: Timobaisa korentera erieta riane obosooku, korende nincheneke ase Abaisraeli. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.

English: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: na niliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri niwe Mungu wenu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe Nyasae oino. Inche ninche Omonene.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli na uwaambie: ‘Hizi ndizo sikukuu zangu zilizoamriwa, sikukuu zilizoamriwa za Bwana, ambazo mtazitangaza kuwa makusanyiko matakatifu.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Moraarie Amatuko Amanene ay’Omonene, na mobe nemesangererekano yaatananirwe ase ogosasiima.

English: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kuna siku sita mnazoweza kufanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato ya kupumzika, siku ya kusanyiko takatifu. Hamtafanya kazi yoyote. Popote mnapoishi, ni Sabato kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo mokore emeremo yaino, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka, rituko ri’omosangererekano bwatananirwe ase ogosasiima. Timobaisa gokora meremo ende yonsi. Erio nerituko ri’Esabato ri’Omonene, aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: “‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hizi ni sikukuu za Bwana zilizoamriwa, makusanyiko matakatifu mtakayoyatangaza kwa nyakati zilizoamriwa:
Ekegusii: “Naende nareo Amatuko ande Amanene ay’Omonene, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima, moyararie ase engaki yachikiire.

English: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.
Kiswahili: Pasaka ya Bwana huanza jioni ya siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: “Rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, chinsa chia mogoroba, nario Epasaka y’Omonene.

English: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to Yahweh. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi huo wa kwanza, Sikukuu ya Bwana ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu huanza; kwa siku saba, mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu.
Ekegusii: Na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi oyio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene, rituko ri’Emegati etabeekiri memera; inamorie emegati etabeekiri memera ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kwanza, mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima, na timobaisa gokora emeremo ya kera rituko,

English: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa siku saba mtamletea Bwana sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto. Kwenye siku hiyo ya saba mtafanya kusanyiko takatifu, na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.’ ”
Ekegusii: korende namorue okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko.”

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli na uwaambie: ‘Mtakapoingia katika nchi nitakayowapa na kuvuna mazao ya nchi hiyo, leteni kwa kuhani mganda wa nafaka ya kwanza mtakayovuna.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moraike ase ense eri’Omonene arabae, na mokogesa okwama kwaino, morente riboa ri’ogotongora kwe rigesa riaino ase Omokuani.

English: He shall wave the sheaf before Yahweh, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
Kiswahili: Naye atauinua huo mganda mbele za Bwana ili ukubaliwe kwa niaba yenu; kuhani ataupunga siku inayofuata Sabato.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rigotunyana eri’Esabato Omokuani asungusie riboa erio ase obosio bwane, erio monyore ogwancherwa.

English: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo mtakapoinua huo mganda, lazima mtoe kwa Bwana dhabihu ya kuteketezwa kwa moto ya mwana-kondoo wa mwaka mmoja asiye na dosari,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riboa erio rigosungusigwa inamorue boigo emaanwa emingichi yakoorire omwaka oyomo, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase ’nde.

English: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
Kiswahili: pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka ya sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, na sadaka yake ya kinywaji ya robo ya hini ya divai.
Ekegusii: Amo n’ekengwanso ekio morue obosie ebimunu bine bwochoganirie namaguta, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene, kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera. Amo nokwo morue edivai egetuba ekemo ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa.

English: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Kiswahili: Kamwe msile mkate wowote, au nafaka iliyokaangwa au nafaka mpya, mpaka siku ile mtakayomletea Mungu wenu sadaka hii. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo, popote mnapoishi.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa koria okwama okwo okoyia: Ebigara ebibese, gose ebikarangire, gose ebiaroisigwe emegati, ekero motaraarentera Nyasae oino okoruegwa kwaino kw’ogotongora. Ogochika okwo nigo koragenderere ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Tangu siku ile iliyofuata Sabato, siku mliyotoa sadaka ya mganda wa kuinuliwa, hesabuni majuma saba kamili.
Ekegusii: “Mobare chichuma isano na ibere korwa ase rituko rigotunyana eri’Esabato, rituko riria mokorentera Omonene riboa ri’ogotongora rigosungusigwa.

English: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mtahesabu siku hamsini mpaka siku inayofuata Sabato ya saba, ndipo mtatoa sadaka ya nafaka mpya kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Rituko ri’emerongo etano, nario rituko magega y’Esabato ya gatano na kabere, erio morentere Omonene okoruegwa konde kw’endagera enyia.

English: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kutoka popote mnapoishi, mtaleta mikate miwili ya unga laini, sehemu mbili za kumi za efa, uliookwa kwa chachu, kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa ya malimbuko kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase kera enka morente emegati ebere eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke ebimunu bine amo n’ememera eraabe okoruegwa kw’endagera entang’ani y’okwama, kogosungusigwa ase Omonene.

English: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to Yahweh, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Toeni pamoja na hiyo mikate wana-kondoo saba, kila mmoja wa mwaka mmoja asiye na dosari, na fahali mchanga, na kondoo dume wawili. Watakuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, pamoja na sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto yenye harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Amo nokoruegwa okwo morente ching’ondi isano na ibere echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, na eeri ensae, ne chimingichi ibere, chionsi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase Omonene, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyuugwa okwo gochiikire amo. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene, kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.

English: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
Kiswahili: Kisha toeni dhabihu ya mbuzi dume mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na wana-kondoo wawili, kila mmoja wa mwaka mmoja, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya amani.
Ekegusii: Naboigo morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, ne chimanwa ibere chi’eching’ondi, chiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.

English: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atawainua hao wana-kondoo wawili mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa, pamoja na mkate wa malimbuko. Ni sadaka takatifu kwa Bwana kwa ajili ya kuhani.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani asungusie omogati bw’ogotongora amo ne chimanwa chi’eching’ondi echio ibere ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ebinto ebio biatananwe bibe ebichenu ase Omonene, bibe endagera y’Omokuani.

English: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
Kiswahili: Siku iyo hiyo mtatangaza kusanyiko takatifu, na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo, popote mnapoishi.
Ekegusii: Rituko erio goika moraarie na mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima; timokora emeremo yaino ya kera rituko. Okwo nogochika koragenderere ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mnapovuna mavuno ya ardhi yenu, msivune hadi mpakani mwa shamba lenu, au kukusanya masazo ya mavuno yenu. Hayo utayaacha kwa ajili ya maskini na mgeni. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Ekero mokogesa emegondo yaino, timogesa moikie ase chingito kegima, gose timoirana gochora ebitigari ase emegondo yaino; eyio motigere abataka na abamenyi. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa saba mtakuwa na siku ya mapumziko, kusanyiko takatifu la ukumbusho litakaloadhimishwa kwa kupiga tarumbeta.
Ekegusii: “Bateebie Abaisraeli ng’a rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere batimoke, batige emeremo kegima. Rituko erio naribe Rituko Rinene ri’Ekeinyorio, rirarigwe ase okobugigwa kw’ebiroria, babe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima.

English: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.’”
Kiswahili: Msifanye kazi zenu zozote za kawaida, lakini toeni sadaka kwa Bwana iliyoteketezwa kwa moto.’ ”
Ekegusii: Tibakora emeremo yabo ya kera rituko, nabanduere inche Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero.”

English: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Siku ya kumi ya mwezi huu wa saba ni Siku ya Upatanisho. Mtafanya kusanyiko takatifu, mfunge, nanyi mtoe sadaka kwa Bwana ya kuteketezwa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: “Rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi oyio o gatano na kabere, erio nario Rituko ri’Okobwatanigwa, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima, na inwe inamobe mokweng’ata na gweitia, na mondetere inche Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero.

English: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Msifanye kazi siku hiyo, kwa sababu ni Siku ya Upatanisho, ambapo upatanisho unafanyika kwa ajili yenu mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio timokora emeremo ende yonsi; rituko erio nario Rituko ri’Okobwatanigwa ekero okobwatanigwa kogokorwa ase more, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote ambaye hatafunga siku hiyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oteng’ate na gweitia ase rituko erio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

English: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote atakayefanya kazi siku hiyo nitamwangamiza kutoka miongoni mwa watu wake.
Ekegusii: Na monto onde bwensi orakore emeremo ende yonsi ase rituko erio, oyio inche Omonene nimosirie korwa ase abanto baye.

English: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Kiswahili: Hamtafanya kazi kamwe. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo popote mnapoishi.
Ekegusii: Timokora emeremo ende yonsi. Okwo nogochika koragenderere ase more, ebiaare ase ebiaare aande onsi ase moramenye.

English: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”
Kiswahili: Ni Sabato ya mapumziko kwenu ninyi, na lazima mfunge. Tangu jioni ya siku ya tisa ya mwezi hadi jioni inayofuata, mtaishika Sabato yenu.”
Ekegusii: Rituko erio aribe ase more rituko ri’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka kegima, na inwe namweng’ate na gweitia. Ase rituko ria kianda ase omotienyi oyio, chinsa chia mogoroba, mochaake korenda Esabato yaino, na mogenderere goika omogoroba onde.”

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa saba, Sikukuu ya Bwana ya vibanda itaanza, nayo itaadhimishwa kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: “Bateebie Abaisraeli: Rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi oyio o gatano na kabere nario Rituko Rinene ri’ogochaaka Amatuko Amanene ase Omonene. Amatuko ’Ebigutu agenderere ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza ni kusanyiko takatifu, msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani timogokora emeremo ende yonsi ya kera rituko, korende nigo moraabe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima.

English: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.
Kiswahili: Kwa siku saba toeni sadaka kwa Bwana za kuteketezwa kwa moto. Kwenye siku ya nane fanyeni kusanyiko takatifu, na mtoe sadaka kwa Bwana ya kuteketezwa kwa moto. Ni kusanyiko la mwisho, msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Kera rituko ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere namobe mokoruera Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero. Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima moruere Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero. Oyio nomosangererekano bw’engencho enene bwatananire ase ogosasiima; timokora emeremo yaino ya kera rituko.

English: “‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—
Kiswahili: (“ ‘Hizi ni sikukuu za Bwana zilizoamriwa, ambazo mtazitangaza kuwa makusanyiko matakatifu kwa kuleta sadaka kwa Bwana za kuteketeza kwa moto: sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za nafaka, dhabihu na sadaka za vinywaji zitahitajika kila siku.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Amatuko Amanene ase Omonene; moyararie, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Ase amatuko ayio momoruere Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosaambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso binde, na okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa, kera ekemo ase rituko riaye richikiire.

English: in addition to the Sabbaths of Yahweh, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Sadaka hizi ni nyongeza ya zile mnazozitoa katika Sabato za Bwana, na pia ni nyongeza ya matoleo yenu ya chochote mlichoweka nadhiri, na sadaka zenu zote za hiari mnazozitoa kwa Bwana.)
Ekegusii: Amatuko aya Amanene nigo amentirwe ase Chisabato chiane chia botaambe, naende amentirwe ase ebiegwa biaino, na ase ebing’wanso bie chiira mwariete, na ebi’ogwancha, mokomoruera Omonene.

English: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of Yahweh seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Basi kuanzia siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa saba, baada ya kuvuna mazao yote ya nchi, mtaadhimisha sikukuu kwa Bwana kwa siku saba; siku ya kwanza ni mapumziko, pia siku ya nane ni mapumziko.
Ekegusii: “Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, ekero mwakoorire rigesa ri’emegondo yaino, namorende Amatuko Amanene atano na abere ase Omonene. Rituko rie ritang’ani naribe rituko ri’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka kegima, naboigo nase rituko ria gatano na gatato.

English: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God seven days.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza mtachukua matunda mazuri ya miti, matawi ya mitende, matawi yenye majani mengi, na matawi ya mirebi, nanyi mtashangilia mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani namoimokie amatunda amaya korwa ase emete yaino emiya, ne chinsagia chi’emekendo, ne chinsagia chibwate amato amange, na echi’emete enga buna emesobeti, na inwe namobe nomochengo ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: You shall keep it as a feast to Yahweh seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.
Kiswahili: Mtaadhimisha siku hii kuwa sikukuu kwa Bwana kwa siku saba kila mwaka. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo; iadhimisheni mwezi wa saba.
Ekegusii: Amatuko atano na abere ase kera omwaka morende Amatuko ayio Amanene ase Omonene. Okwo nogochika koragenderere botaambe ase more, ebiaare ase ebiaare. Ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere namoyarende.

English: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,
Kiswahili: Mtaishi katika vibanda kwa siku saba: Wazawa wote wa Waisraeli wataishi katika vibanda,
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abare ababiare b’Abaisraeli nabamenye ase ebigutu ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’”
Kiswahili: ili wazao wenu wajue kuwa niliwafanya Waisraeli waishi kwenye vibanda nilipowatoa Misri. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio chinderia chiaino inachimanye ng’a Omonene nabamenyetie inwe Abaisraeli ase ebigutu ekero nabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”

English: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawatangazia Waisraeli sikukuu zilizoamriwa na Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Musa akaba ogokwana n’Abaisraeli igoro y’Amatuko amanene ay’Omonene.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa akamoteebia,

English: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
Kiswahili: “Waagize Waisraeli wakuletee mafuta safi ya zeituni yaliyokamuliwa kwa ajili ya mwanga ili taa ziwe zinawaka daima.
Ekegusii: “Chiika Abaisraeli ng’a barente amaguta amaya amitire korwa ase amazeituni akobekwa ase chitaaya, erinde chigenderere gwoka botaambe.

English: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
Kiswahili: Nje ya pazia la Ushuhuda ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, Aroni ataziwasha taa mbele za Bwana kuanzia jioni hadi asubuhi bila kuzima. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Agwo isiko y’etoto eye ekengete chibao chiriikire oborori chibeekire ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Aroni abe okorenda chitaaya korwa mogoroba goika mambia ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene. Okwo nogochika ase more koragenderere ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before Yahweh continually.
Kiswahili: Taa zilizo juu ya kinara cha dhahabu safi mbele za Bwana lazima zihudumiwe daima.
Ekegusii: Aroni arende chitaaya echio chire ase ekebekerero gi’echitaaya gi’etaabu echenire, erinde chigenderere gwoka botaambe ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.

English: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
Kiswahili: “Chukua unga laini, uoke mikate kumi na miwili, ukitumia sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga kwa kila mkate.
Ekegusii: “Aye goika oimokie obosie obonuke, oroisie emegati ikomi na ebere. Kera omogati oire obosie boisaine ebimunu bine.

English: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Iweke katika mistari miwili, kila mstari mikate sita, uiweke mbele za Bwana juu ya meza iliyotengenezwa kwa dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Oroberie emegati eyio ase chindwaro ibere, etano nomo ase kera orwaro, igoro ase emesa eoomire netaabu echenire, agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.

English: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kando ya kila mstari, weka uvumba safi kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu ili kuwakilisha mikate kuwa sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa kuteketezwa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Obeke ekoroso echenire ase kera orwaro ebe ekemanyererio, ne ribaga ri’emegati eyio, ekoroso eyio eruegwe buna okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene.

English: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mikate hii itawekwa mbele za Bwana kila wakati, Sabato baada ya Sabato, kwa niaba ya Waisraeli, kuwa Agano la kudumu.
Ekegusii: Kera rituko ri’Esabato botaambe emegati eroberigwe ase emesa igoro, agwo ase obosio bwane. Okwo nokoruegwa korwa ase Abaisraeli, nakobe okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa botaambe.

English: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
Kiswahili: Hii ni mali ya Aroni na wanawe, watakaoila katika mahali patakatifu, kwa sababu ni sehemu takatifu sana ya fungu lao la kawaida la sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa kuteketezwa kwa moto.”
Ekegusii: Emegati eyio nigo eraabe eya Aroni amo nabamura baye, na barabwo nabayeriere Aase achenire, ekiagera nemechenu mono, ebe egetari kiabo botaambe gi’okoruegwa okwo kogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde.”

English: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
Kiswahili: Basi mwana wa mama Mwisraeli na baba Mmisri alikwenda miongoni mwa Waisraeli, nayo mapigano yakatokea ndani ya kambi kati yake na Mwisraeli.
Ekegusii: Nareenge omonto oyomo, ng’ina areenge Omoisraeli, na ise n’Omomisiri. Omonto oyio akagenda ase egetwori akoomana n’omonto onde Omoisraeli.

English: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
Kiswahili: Huyu mwana wa mwanamke Mwisraeli akalikufuru Jina la Bwana kwa kulaani; kwa hiyo wakamleta kwa Mose. (Jina la mama yake aliitwa Shelomithi binti wa Dibri, wa kabila la Dani.)
Ekegusii: Omonto oria ng’ina areenge Omoisraeli akarama erieta ri’Omonene na koriragereria. Abanto bakamobwata, bakamorenta ase Musa. Ng’ina omonto oyio nigo areenge korokwa Selomiti, omosubati o Debiri bw’egesaku kia Dani.

English: They put him in custody until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.
Kiswahili: Nao wakamweka mahabusu mpaka mapenzi ya Bwana yawe wazi kwao.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakamobeeka echela, na bakaganya amang’ana korwa ase Omonene ng’a ninki omonto oyio agochia gokorerwa.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose:
Ekegusii: Na Omonene agateebia Musa,

English: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
Kiswahili: “Mchukue huyo aliyekufuru nje ya kambi. Wale wote waliomsikia akikufuru wataweka mikono juu ya kichwa chake, kisha kusanyiko lote litampiga mawe.
Ekegusii: “Mosokie isiko y’egetwori omonto oyio oragereretie Omonene, na abanto baria bonsi bamoigwete gakoragereria, babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe oye, na omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena akwe.

English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
Kiswahili: Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Ikiwa mtu yeyote atamlaani Mungu wake, atakuwa na hatia kwa uovu wake;
Ekegusii: Erio oteebie Abaisraeli: Monto onde bwensi oraragererie Nyasae oye nabogorie ebibe biaye na anyore egesusuro.

English: He who blasphemes Yahweh’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.
Kiswahili: yeyote atakayekufuru Jina la Bwana ni lazima auawe. Kusanyiko lote litampiga kwa mawe. Iwe ni mgeni au mzawa, atakapolikufuru Jina la Bwana, ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Omonto oraraame erieta ri’Omonene goika aitwe akwe; omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena. Karabe omomenyi gose omobiare, oyokorama Erieta ri’Omonene goika aitwe akwe.

English: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtu yeyote atamuua mtu mwingine, ni lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: “Omonto oraite omonto onde, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote auaye mnyama wa mtu mwingine lazima afidie, uhai kwa uhai.
Ekegusii: Omonto oraite engi’ti etugire goika nayeakane. Obogima boakanwe nobogima.

English: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu yeyote atamjeruhi jirani yake, chochote alichomtenda naye atatendewa:
Ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omonto onde asarie omobere oye, buna omonto oria akorera oyonde, nere naboigo arakorerwe.

English: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
Kiswahili: iwapo amemvunja mfupa atavunjwa mfupa, jicho kwa jicho, jino kwa jino. Kama alivyomjeruhi mwenzake, vivyo hivyo ndivyo atakavyojeruhiwa.
Ekegusii: Oyokobuna riuga ri’omonto onde, nere eriaye naribunwe; oyogwata eriso ri’omonto onde, nere eriaye nariaatwe; oyokogookora omonto onde erino, nere eriaye ndigookorwe; oyoraaremarie omonto onde, nere goika aremarigwe.

English: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
Kiswahili: Yeyote auaye mnyama wa mtu lazima alipe fidia, lakini yeyote auaye mtu, lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Omonto oraite etugo goika nayeakane, na omonto oraite omonto onde, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.’”
Kiswahili: Mtakuwa na sheria iyo hiyo kwa mgeni na kwa mzawa. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Mobe ne richiiko erimo rikogaambera abanto bonsi, karabe omomenyi gose omobiare, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”

English: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akasema na Waisraeli, nao wakamchukua yule aliyekufuru nje ya kambi na kumpiga mawe. Waisraeli wakafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Nabo Musa agateebia Abaisraeli, na barabwo bakamosokia omonto oria oragereretigwe isiko y’egetwori, bakamoaka amagena, bakamoita. Naboigo Abaisraeli bagakora buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: Yahweh said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika Mlima Sinai,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, akamoteebia,

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Mtakapoingia katika nchi ninayowapa ninyi, nchi yenyewe ni lazima ishike Sabato kwa ajili ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moraike ase ense eria Omonene arabae, ense eyio ebe n’Esabato ase Omonene, etimoke.

English: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka sita mtapanda mazao katika mashamba yenu, nanyi kwa miaka sita mtaikata mizabibu yenu matawi na kuvuna mazao yake.
Ekegusii: Namosimeke emegondo yaino na gocheera emesabibu yaino, naende mogese okwama kw’emegondo y’ense eyio ase emiaka etano nomo.

English: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to Yahweh. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwaka wa saba nchi lazima iwe na Sabato ya mapumziko, Sabato kwa Bwana. Msipande mbegu katika mashamba yenu, wala msikate mizabibu yenu matawi.
Ekegusii: Korende omwaka o gatano na kabere obe omwaka bw’ogotimoka; ense etimokigwe kegima ase Esabato y’Omonene. Ase omwaka oyio timosimeka kende ase emegondo yaino, gose gocheera emesabibu yaino.

English: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
Kiswahili: Msivune na kuweka akiba kinachoota chenyewe, wala kuvuna na kusindika zabibu ambayo hamkuhudumia mashamba yake. Nchi lazima iwe na mwaka wa mapumziko.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa kogesa echikwemeria korwa ase chimbusuro chiagwete, gose timosangereria amasabibu y’emesabibu etacheeretwe. Oyio nigo oraabe omwaka bw’ogotimoka kegima gw’ense eyio.

English: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
Kiswahili: Chochote nchi itoacho katika mwaka wa Sabato kitakuwa chakula chenu wenyewe, watumishi wenu wa kiume na wa kike, mfanyakazi aliyeajiriwa, na mkazi wa muda anayeishi miongoni mwenu,
Ekegusii: Echio chiremerie ase omwaka bw’ogotimoka gw’ense eria, nachio chiraabe chindagera chibaisaine, aye omonyene, na abasomba bao, abamura na abaiseke, na omokori emeremo oo orikire, na omomenyi omenyete bwoo.

English: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.
Kiswahili: vilevile malisho ya mifugo yenu na wanyama pori katika nchi yenu. Chochote nchi itakachozalisha kinaweza kuliwa.
Ekegusii: Boigo ching’iti chitugire, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chire ase ense eyio nachirie okwama okwo kwemeretie.

English: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hesabu Sabato saba za miaka, yaani miaka saba mara saba, ili Sabato saba za miaka utakuwa muda wa miaka arobaini na tisa.
Ekegusii: “Mobare chichuma isano na ibere ara gatano na kabere. (Kera echuma eyemo ebe ey’engaki y’omwaka omogima.) Naboigo engaki eyio ebe ey’emiaka emerongo ene, na kianda.

English: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.
Kiswahili: Ndipo tarumbeta itapigwa kila mahali katika siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa saba. Katika Siku ya Upatanisho, piga tarumbeta katika nchi yako yote.
Ekegusii: Erio ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, Rituko ri’Okobwatanigwa, egetureeri kebugigwe ase ense yaino yonsi.

English: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.
Kiswahili: Mwaka wa hamsini mtauweka wakfu na kutangaza uhuru katika nchi kwa wakazi wake wote. Itakuwa ni yubile kwenu; kila mmoja wenu atairudia mali ya jamaa yake, na kila mmoja kurudi kwenye ukoo wake.
Ekegusii: Mwatanane omwaka oyio bw’emerongo etano, moyochene. Morarie obosibore ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense yaino. Omwaka oyio nobe omwaka bw’Omochengo ase more. Kera omonto ore ase more airanigwe ase omwando oye, na kera oyomo ase eamate yaye.

English: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.
Kiswahili: Mwaka wa hamsini utakuwa yubile kwenu, msipande wala msivune kile kiotacho chenyewe, au kuvuna zabibu zisizohudumiwa.
Ekegusii: Omwaka oyo bw’emerongo etano nobe oyio bw’Omochengo ase more. Ase omwaka oyio timobusura kende, gose kogesa echiemeretie korwa ase chimbusuro chiagwete inse, gose timosangereria amasabibu korwa emesabibu etacheeretwe.

English: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ni yubile, nayo itakuwa takatifu kwenu; mtakula tu kile kilichotoka moja kwa moja mashambani.
Ekegusii: Omwaka oyio noyo bw’Omochengo. Nobe omochenu ase more. Inamorie chindagera chiemeretie chinyene korwa ase riroba.

English: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika huu Mwaka wa Yubile, kila mmoja atarudi kwenye mali yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Ase Omwaka oyio bw’Omochengo kera omonto airanigwe ase omwando oye.

English: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa utauza ardhi kwa mmoja wa wazawa wa nchi yako, au ukinunua ardhi kutoka kwake, mmoja asimpunje mwingine.
Ekegusii: Ase igo onye gokooneria omonto onde gento kende gionsi, gose kogora korwa asaare, timobaisa gokorerana oborianania.

English: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.
Kiswahili: Utanunua ardhi kwa mzawa wa nchi yako kwa misingi ya hesabu ya miaka baada ya Yubile. Naye ataiuza kwako kwa misingi ya hesabu ya miaka iliyobaki kwa kuvuna mavuno.
Ekegusii: Koragore omogondo korwa ase omonto onde oakane omonto oria koreng’ana n’emiaka eyio etigarete aragese ekero Omwaka bw’Omochengo otaraika.

English: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.
Kiswahili: Miaka inapokuwa mingi, utaongeza bei, nayo miaka ikiwa michache, utapunguza bei, kwa sababu kile anachokuuzia kwa hakika ni hesabu ya mazao.
Ekegusii: Onye emiaka ere emenge, nomente rigori, onye ere emeke, norikeeyie, ekiagera egento ekio agokooneria nomobaro bw’okwama kw’omogondo.

English: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Mmoja asimpunje mwingine, bali utamcha Mungu wako. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gokorerana oborianania, korende moiroke Nyasae oino, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Fuateni amri zangu, mwe waangalifu kutii amri zangu, nanyi mtaishi salama katika nchi.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, mobwate amachiiko aane na koyakora, na mobwatie emeroberio yane echiikire; erio nario moramenye ase ense na mobe n’obotoereru.

English: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
Kiswahili: Kisha nchi itazaa matunda yake, nanyi mtakula na kushiba na kuishi humo kwa salama.
Ekegusii: Ense eria iyame okwama kwaye, na inwe monyore endagera mokoria na koigota, naende momenye ase obotoereru.

English: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”
Kiswahili: Mwaweza kuuliza, “Tutakula nini katika mwaka wa saba ikiwa hatutapanda wala kuvuna mazao yetu?”
Ekegusii: Namoisa koboria: Ninki toraarie ase omwaka o gatano na kabere, onye titogosimeka gose gosangereria okwama?

English: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.
Kiswahili: Nitawapelekeeni baraka ya pekee katika mwaka wa sita, kwamba nchi itazalisha mazao ya kutosha kwa miaka mitatu.
Ekegusii: Momanye ng’a ninche Omonene ndasesenie ense yaino ase omwaka o gatano na rimo, erinde yaame endagera eraisane ase engaki y’emiaka etato.

English: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.
Kiswahili: Mnapopanda mwaka wa nane, mtakula mavuno ya miaka iliyopita. Pia mtaendelea kuyala mazao hayo hadi mvune mavuno ya mwaka wa tisa.
Ekegusii: Ekero morabusure chindagera ase emegondo yaino ase omwaka o gatano na gatato mogenderere koria endagera eria enkoro, goika endagera y’omwaka o kianda egeswe.

English: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kamwe ardhi isiuzwe kwa mkataba wa kudumu, kwa sababu nchi ni mali yangu, nanyi ni wageni na wapangaji wangu.
Ekegusii: “Ense tekoonigwa ebe egenderere koba ey’oyio oyegora, ekiagera ense neyaane; inwe nigo more abamenyi momenyete ase ’nde.

English: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
Kiswahili: Katika nchi yote mtakayoshika kuwa milki yenu, ni lazima mtoe ukombozi wa ardhi.
Ekegusii: “Ase ense eyio yonsi moranyore ebe eyaino, ekero amaremo araoonigwe, namotige ribaga ri’okoyabooria naende.

English: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mmoja wa wazawa wa nchi yako amekuwa maskini na akauza baadhi ya mali yake, ndugu yake wa karibu atakuja na kukomboa kile ndugu yako alichokiuza.
Ekegusii: Onye oyomino obeire omotaka na aoonie ensemo y’omwando oye, omoamate omwabo ore ang’e namoboorerie ensemo eyio konya aoonirie.

English: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,
Kiswahili: Iwapo mtu huyo hana jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa mali hiyo kwa ajili yake, lakini yeye mwenyewe akafanikiwa na kupata mali itoshayo kuikomboa,
Ekegusii: Omonto oria otabwati omonto omwabo oranyare komobooreria eria aoonetie, korende ere omonyene aise konyora enibo eisaine kobooria omwando oye,

English: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.
Kiswahili: ataamua tena thamani yake kwa miaka tangu alipoiuza, na kurudisha kiasi kilichobaki cha thamani kwa mtu ambaye alikuwa amemuuzia mali hiyo, naye ataweza kuirudia mali yake.
Ekegusii: rirorio omonyene oyio aboorie omwando oye, na abare emiaka gochakera engaki eria ayoonetie, erio aakane omonto oria onde korwa ekero keria goika ase omwaka bw’omochengo. Erio airanerigwe omwando oye.

English: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hatapata njia ya kumlipa mnunuzi, ile mali aliyouza itabaki kumilikiwa na mnunuzi mpaka Mwaka wa Yubile. Mali hiyo itarudishwa mwaka wa Yubile, naye ataweza kuirudia mali yake.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omonyene oria tabwati enibo eisaine akobooria omwando oye, nabo omwando oyio oratigare ase okoboko kw’omonto oria oyogorete goika Omwaka bw’Omochengo. Korende ase omwaka oria omwando oyio noiranigwe, na ere omonyene airane ase omwando oye.

English: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu atauza nyumba iliyo ndani ya mji uliozungukwa kwa ukuta, yeye anayo haki ya kuikomboa mwaka mzima baada ya mauzo ya hiyo nyumba. Wakati huo anaweza kuikomboa.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto okoonia enyomba ere ime ase omochie ogiteire orwaki, nanyare koyebooria goika ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo korwa ekero ayeoonetie. Ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo omogima nabe ne ribaga ri’okoyebooria.

English: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa haikukombolewa kabla ya mwaka mmoja kamili kupita, nyumba iliyo ndani ya mji uliozungukwa kwa ukuta itakuwa mali ya kudumu ya mnunuzi na wazao wake. Haitarudishwa mwaka wa Yubile.
Ekegusii: Onye enyomba eria tekoboorigwa ase engaki eria y’omwaka omogima, rirorio enyomba eria nigo eraabe ey’omonto oria oyegorete, amo ney’ororeeria rwaye kogenderera botaambe. Enyomba eria tekoiranigwa ase omonyene ekero Omwaka bw’Omochengo oraike.

English: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
Kiswahili: Lakini nyumba zilizo vijijini bila ya kuwa na kuta zilizozizunguka zitahesabiwa kama mashamba. Zinaweza kukombolewa, nazo zirudishwe katika mwaka wa Yubile.
Ekegusii: Korende chinyomba chire ase ebichie bitagiteiri chindwaki, nachibarwe koba echi’emegondo y’ense eria; nabo chiranyare koboorigwa na koiranigwa ase abanyene ekero Omwaka bw’Omochengo oraike.

English: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Walawi siku zote wana haki ya kukomboa nyumba zao katika miji ya Walawi wanayoimiliki.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi mbare ne ribaga kobooria chinyomba chi’emechie ere emiando yabo engaki ende yonsi.

English: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mali ya Mlawi inaweza kukombolewa, yaani nyumba iliyouzwa katika mji wowote wanaoushikilia itarudishwa mwaka wa Yubile, kwa sababu nyumba zilizo katika miji ya Walawi ni mali yao miongoni mwa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto Omolawi takobooria enyomba aoonetie ere ime ase omochie ore omwando oye, enyomba eyio neiranigwe ase Omwaka bw’Omochengo, ekiagera chinyomba chire ime ase emechie y’Abalawi nigo chire omwando obo ase egati y’Abaisraeli.

English: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.
Kiswahili: Lakini nchi ya malisho iliyo mali ya miji yao kamwe isiuzwe, ni milki yao ya kudumu.
Ekegusii: Korende ebitii bi’oborisia bietanaine emechie yabo tibikoonigwa, ekiagera ebio nebiabo kogenderera botaambe.

English: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mmoja wa wazawa wa nchi yako amekuwa maskini, naye akashindwa kujitegemeza mwenyewe katikati yako, msaidie kama vile ambavyo ungelimsaidia mgeni au kama mkazi wa muda, ili aweze kuendelea kuishi katikati yako.
Ekegusii: “Onye oyomino obeire omotaka ere takonyara gwetenenera ere omonyene, aye nomoe ebio aremeire, abeere bwoo buna omomenyi, gose buna omorikwa.

English: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.
Kiswahili: Usichukue riba wala faida yoyote kutoka kwake, bali utamwogopa Mungu wako, ili mzawa wa nchi yako aweze kuendelea kuishi katikati yako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kwenyorera ebitoki, gose okomentekana konde korwa asare, korende aye omoiroke Nyasae oo, na otige omonto oyio omino amenye bwoo.

English: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.
Kiswahili: Usimkopeshe fedha ili alipe na riba, wala usimuuzie chakula kwa faida.
Ekegusii: Ekero oramoe chitaabu chia singo, tobaisa komosaba ebitoki korwa asare.

English: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
Kiswahili: Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako, niliyekuleta kutoka nchi ya Misri nikupe nchi ya Kanaani, nami niwe Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde mbae ense ya Kaanani, na inche imbe Nyasae oino.

English: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mmoja wa wazawa wa nchi yako amekuwa maskini katikati yako, naye akajiuza kwako, usimfanye atumike kama mtumwa.
Ekegusii: “Onye oyomino omenyete bwoo obeire omotaka, ere eoonie omonyene ase ore, tobaisa komokoria emeremo buna omosomba.

English: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.
Kiswahili: Atatendewa kama mfanyakazi aliyeajiriwa, au kama mkazi wa muda katikati yako, naye atatumika mpaka Mwaka wa Yubile.
Ekegusii: Nabeere ase ore buna omonto orikire, na buna omomenyi oo, abe okogokorera goika ekero Omwaka bw’Omochengo oraike.

English: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.
Kiswahili: Ndipo yeye na watoto wake wataachiwa, naye atarudi kwa watu wa ukoo wake, na kwenye mali ya baba zake.
Ekegusii: Erio arue bwoo, ere amo nabana baye, airane gochia ase eamate yaye na amenye ase omwando bwe chisokoro chiaye.

English: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu Waisraeli ni watumishi wangu niliowaleta kutoka nchi ya Misri, kamwe wasiuzwe kama watumwa.
Ekegusii: Abwo nabaanto bagonkorera, ninche nabarusetie ase ense ya Misiri. Abwo tibakoonigwa buna abasomba.

English: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.
Kiswahili: Usiwatawale kwa ukatili, lakini utamcha Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kobagaambera nobotiindi, korende aye omoiroke Nyasae oo.

English: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Watumwa wako wa kiume na wa kike watatoka katika mataifa yanayokuzunguka; kutoka kwao waweza kununua watumwa.
Ekegusii: Onye koganetie abasomba, abamura gose abaiseke, nabo oranyaare kobagora korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bibaetanaine inwe.

English: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.
Kiswahili: Pia waweza kununua baadhi ya wakazi wa muda wanaoishi katikati yako, na jamaa ya koo zao waliozaliwa katika nchi yako, nao watakuwa mali yako.
Ekegusii: Nabo oranyaare kogora abana b’abamenyi baria bamenyete ase more, abana babo baria baiboreire ase ense yaino babe abaino.

English: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.
Kiswahili: Hao waweza kuwarithisha watoto wako kuwa urithi wao, na wanaweza kuwafanya watumwa maisha yao yote, lakini usiwatawale ndugu zako Waisraeli kwa ukatili.
Ekegusii: Monyaare gotiga abasomba abwo ase abana baino barache magega yaino, babe omwando obo bakobakorera kogenderera botambe. Abwo mbanyare koba abasomba baino. Korende abanto bamino Abaisraeli, timobagaambera nobotiindi.

English: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mgeni au mkazi wa muda katikati yako atakuwa tajiri, na mmoja wa wazawa wa nchi yako akawa maskini, naye akajiuza kwa yule mgeni anayeishi katikati yako, au kwa mmoja wa jamaa wa koo za wageni,
Ekegusii: “Onye omomenyi, gose omonto orikire omenyete bwoo, obeire omonda, na omonto omino bw’Abaisraeli obeire omotaka, eoonie ere omonyene ase omomenyi oria ore bwoo, gose ase monto onde bwensi bw’eamate y’abamenyi;

English: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;
Kiswahili: anayo haki ya kukombolewa baada ya kujiuza. Mmoja wa jamaa zake aweza kumkomboa:
Ekegusii: magega yaye omonto oyio nabo aranyare koboorigwa. Omonto omwabo nabo aramoboorie,

English: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.
Kiswahili: Mjomba wake, au binamu yake, au yeyote aliye ndugu wa damu katika ukoo wake aweza kumkomboa. Au ikiwa atafanikiwa, anaweza kujikomboa mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: gose ise moke, gose omwana o ise moke, gose omoamate omwabo ore ang’e, gose ere omonyene karabe nenibo, nabo areboorie ere omonyene.

English: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.
Kiswahili: Yeye na huyo aliyemnunua watahesabu muda kuanzia mwaka aliojiuza hadi Mwaka wa Yubile. Mahali pa kuanzia bei ya kuachiwa kwake itakadiriwa kwa ujira unaolipwa mfanyakazi aliyeajiriwa kwa idadi ya hiyo miaka.
Ekegusii: Ere amo noria omogorete baabare emiaka gochakera korwa ekero eoonetie goika ekero ki’Omwaka bw’Omochengo oraike, erio bakore rigori ri’okoboorigwa kwaye, koreng’ana n’emiaka eyio na koreng’ana neng’eria y’omonto orikire.

English: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa imebaki miaka mingi, ni lazima atalipia ukombozi wake fungu kubwa la bei iliyolipwa kumnunua yeye.
Ekegusii: Onye emiaka emenge etigarete goika Omwaka bw’Omochengo oike, goika airanie ang’e bionsi ebi aetwe ekero eoonetie.

English: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa miaka iliyobaki ni michache kufikia Mwaka wa Yubile, atafanya hesabu yake, naye atalipa malipo yanayostahili kwa ajili ya ukombozi wake.
Ekegusii: Korende onye emiaka etigarete nemeke, rirorio aakane ase emiaka eyio yoka ase okwebooria.

English: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.
Kiswahili: Atatendewa kama mtu wa kuajiriwa mwaka hadi mwaka; lazima uone kwamba yule aliyemnunua hamtawali kwa ukatili.
Ekegusii: Omonene oye amokorere buna akomokorera omonto orikire ase okomokorera emeremo omwaka ase omwaka. Aye goika origererie orore ng’a onde tari okomogaambera ase obotiindi.

English: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hata ikiwa hakukombolewa kwa njia mojawapo ya hizi, yeye na watoto wake wataachiwa katika Mwaka wa Yubile,
Ekegusii: Onye takoboorigwa ase enchera eyemo y’echio, rirorio ere na abana baye batigwe babe abasibore ase Omwaka bw’Omochengo.

English: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: kwa maana Waisraeli ni mali yangu kama watumishi. Wao ni watumishi wangu, niliowatoa kutoka nchi ya Misri. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli nabasomba baane, ee, barabwo nabasomba baane aba narusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”

English: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Msijitengenezee sanamu au kusimamisha kinyago cha kuchonga, au mnara, wala jiwe la kuabudia, na pia msijiwekee jiwe lililochongwa katika nchi yenu na kusujudu mbele yake. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana, “Timobaisa kweroiseria emegwekano mochie gosasiima, gose gotenenia ase ense yaino emegwekano, gose chisiiro, gose rigena ribachire rire nemegwekano, ase okobisasiima, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Zishikeni Sabato zangu na kuheshimu mahali patakatifu pangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Morende Chisabato chiane na mosike Obomenyo bwane Obochenu. Inche ninche Omonene.

English: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtafuata amri zangu na kuwa waangalifu kutii maagizo yangu,
Ekegusii: “Komorabwatie aya nachiikire, na kobwata amachiiko aane na koyakora,

English: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
Kiswahili: nitawanyeshea mvua katika majira yake, nayo ardhi itatoa mazao yake, na miti ya mashambani itazaa matunda yake.
Ekegusii: erio nimbatwerie embura ase engaki egwenerete, na ense inayaame endagera, na emete y’emegondo yaame amatunda.

English: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
Kiswahili: Kupura nafaka kwenu kutaendelea mpaka wakati wa kuvuna zabibu. Pia kuvuna zabibu kutaendelea mpaka wakati wa kupanda mbegu, nanyi mtakula na kushiba, na mtaishi salama katika nchi yenu.
Ekegusii: Okwama kwaino ’nakobe okonene, na mogenderere koora goika engaki y’ogotora amasabibu eike, na mogenderere gotora amasabibu goika engaki y’ogosimeka eike; na inwe namonyore endagera enyinge, naende momenye ase ense yaino ase obotoereru.

English: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nitawapa amani katika nchi, mpate kulala pasipo kutiwa hofu na yeyote. Nitawaondoa wanyama wakali watoke kwenye nchi, nao upanga hautapita katika nchi yenu.
Ekegusii: “Nindeete omorembe ase ense yaino, na inwe namoraare motari kwoboa monto onde bwensi. Nindusie ching’iti chi’orosana chirueo, ne chiseegi tichikobao.

English: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
Kiswahili: Mtawafukuza adui zenu, nanyi mtawaua kwa upanga mbele yenu.
Ekegusii: Namoserie ababisa baino, nababugwe ase amasio aino, baitwe nemioro.

English: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
Kiswahili: Watu wenu watano watafukuza adui mia, watu wenu mia watafukuza adui elfu kumi, nao adui zenu wataanguka kwa upanga mbele yenu.
Ekegusii: Abanto baino batano ’nababue abanto rigana erimo, na abanto baino rigana erimo nababue abanto chilifu ikomi; ababisa baino nababugwe ase amasio aino, baitwe nemioro.

English: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nitawaangalia kwa upendeleo na kuwafanya mzae na kuzidisha idadi yenu, nami nitalishika Agano langu na ninyi.
Ekegusii: Nimbasesenie moibore abana abange, momeenteke. Ninkore okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania kogenderera koba nainwe.

English: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuvuna mtakuwa bado mnakula mavuno ya mwaka uliopita, na itawalazimu kuyaondoa ghalani ili mpate nafasi ya mavuno mapya.
Ekegusii: Namogenderere koria endagera enkoro ere enyinge ase ebiage, na ekiagera ere enyinge mono namoyerusie aroro, erinde monyore ribaga mobeeke enyia.

English: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.
Kiswahili: Nitafanya makao yangu miongoni mwenu, nami sitawachukia.
Ekegusii: Nimenye ase egati yaino ase Obomenyo bwane Obochenu; tinkobatiga nonya ng’ake.

English: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.
Kiswahili: Nitatembea katikati yenu niwe Mungu wenu, nanyi mtakuwa watu wangu.
Ekegusii: Nintaare amo nainwe; inche nimbe Nyasae oino, na inwe mobe abanto baane.

English: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.
Kiswahili: Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, niliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri ili msiendelee kuwa watumwa wa Wamisri, nikavunja kongwa lenu, na kuwawezesha kutembea mkiwa mmeinua vichwa vyenu juu.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde timobaisa koba abasomba aroro; inche nasaretie chinguru chi’Abamisiri, nkabuna amakorogoto barabwo babeegete ase amareko aino, nkabatiga mokaruao mogwesigooria.

English: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama hamtanisikiliza na kutimiza maagizo haya yote,
Ekegusii: “Korende onye timokonyigwera gose kobwata amachiiko aya onsi,

English: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,
Kiswahili: nanyi kama mtazikataa amri zangu na kuzichukia sheria zangu, tena mkishindwa kutimiza amri zangu na hivyo mkavunja agano langu,
Ekegusii: na onye timokobwatia aya nachiikire, naende komoraange emeroberio yane echiikire, na timokora amachiiko aane onsi, korende mobe mogosaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania,

English: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.
Kiswahili: ndipo nitakapowafanyia hili: Nitawaletea juu yenu hofu ya ghafula, magonjwa ya kufisha, na homa itakayopofusha macho yenu na kuwaondolea uhai wenu. Mtapanda mbegu bila mafanikio, kwa sababu adui zenu wataila.
Ekegusii: rirorio nainche nimbakorere amang’ana aya: Nimbarentere omoondoko mobosokano, na oborwaire bw’okoria emebere, na obw’ogosaria amaiso, na obw’ogokoora obogima. ’Namobusure chindagera, korende timokonyora gento, ekiagera ababisa baino nabwo barachirie.

English: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.
