Kiswahili: Nitauelekeza uso wangu dhidi yenu ili mshindwe na adui zenu; wale wanaowachukia watawatawala, nanyi mtakimbia ingawa hakuna mtu anayewafukuza.
Ekegusii: Nimbe mamincha yaino, na inwe namobugwe nababisa baino. Abanto baabageechete nabwo barabagambere, na inwe namobugwe nababisa baino. Mobe mogotama nonya monto onde tari okobabwatia.

English: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama baada ya haya yote hamtanisikiliza, nitawaadhibu mara saba zaidi kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu.
Ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya onsi karabe abanyorire, na inwe mogenderere kwanga konyingwera, erio nario ndabae egesusuro ara gatano na kabere ase engencho y’ebibe biaino.

English: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.
Kiswahili: Nitakivunja kiburi chenu cha ukaidi na kuifanya anga iliyo juu yenu iwe kama chuma, na ardhi yenu kama shaba.
Ekegusii: Ninsarie chinguru chi’oboenenu, ninkore igoro ome pa, abe buna ekioma, embura tetwa, ne riroba ri’ense yaino rioome pa, ribe buna etai.

English: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.
Kiswahili: Nguvu zenu zitatumika bila ya mafanikio, kwa sababu ardhi yenu haitawazalia mazao yake, wala miti ya nchi yenu haitazaa matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yaino emekong’u moraabe mogokora, nigo eraabe bosa, ekiagera ense yaino tekwama endagera, na emete tekwama amatunda.

English: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtaendelea kuwa na uadui nami, na kukataa kunisikiliza, nitawazidishia mateso yenu mara saba zaidi, kama dhambi zenu zinavyostahili.
Ekegusii: “Onye naende mokogenderera koba mamincha yane na kwanga konyigwera, nindeete amaakwa amange ase more, ara gatano na kabere, buna ebibe biaino biragwenere.

English: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.
Kiswahili: Nitawatuma wanyama mwitu dhidi yenu, nao watawaibieni watoto wenu, watawaangamiza ngʼombe wenu, na kuifanya idadi yenu kuwa ndogo, hivi kwamba barabara zenu zitakuwa hazina watu.
Ekegusii: Nimbatomere ching’iti chintindi chi’orosana chiite abana baino, ne chitugo chiaino, chibakeyie mobe abake goika chinchera chiaino chibe bosa.

English: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ikiwa pamoja na mambo haya hamtakubali maonyo yangu lakini mkaendelea kuweka uadui nami,
Ekegusii: “Komoraabe mwanyorire egesusuro ekio gionsi timong’iranera, korende mogenderere koba mamincha yane,

English: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
Kiswahili: mimi mwenyewe nitaweka uadui nanyi, na kuwatesa kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu mara saba zaidi.
Ekegusii: rirorio boigo nimbe mamincha yaino, erio inche omonyene imbae egesusuro ara gatano na kabere buna ebibe biaino biragwenere.

English: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
Kiswahili: Nitawaletea upanga juu yenu ili kuwapatiliza kwa kuvunja Agano langu. Mtakapokimbilia mijini mwenu, nitatuma tauni katikati yenu, nanyi mtatiwa mikononi mwa adui zenu.
Ekegusii: Nindeete esegi ase more, inyeruserie egesiomba, ekiagera mwasaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania. Komoraabe mogosangererekana ase emechie yaino korigia obotamero, nimbatomere amarwaire amabe abaite, goika mobekwe ase amaboko y’ababisa baino.

English: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.
Kiswahili: Nitakapowaondolea upatikanaji wa mkate wenu, wanawake kumi wataoka mkate wenu katika tanuru moja, nao wataugawa mkate kidogo kwa kupima. Mtakula, lakini hamtashiba.
Ekegusii: Ninkeyie chindagera chiaino chibe chinke; abakungu ikomi barugere eriko erimo, na barabwo babareengere endagera ensinini, na inwe namoyerie, korende timokoigota.

English: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama hata baada ya haya bado hamtanisikiliza lakini mkaendelea kuweka uadui nami,
Ekegusii: “Komoraabe mwanyorire emechando eye yonsi, na mogenderere kwanga konyigwera na koba mamincha yane,

English: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
Kiswahili: ndipo katika hasira yangu nitaweka uadui nanyi, nami mwenyewe nitawaadhibu mara saba kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu.
Ekegusii: erio nario naende ndabae egususuro ara gatano na kabere ase engencho y’ebibe biaino.

English: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.
Kiswahili: Mtakula nyama ya wana wenu na nyama ya binti zenu.
Ekegusii: Enchara nebe enene mono goika morie emebere y’abana baino, abamura na abaiseke.

English: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.
Kiswahili: Nitapaharibu mahali penu pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, nibomoe madhabahu zenu za kufukizia uvumba, na kuzilundika maiti zenu juu ya sanamu zenu zisizo na uhai, nami nitawachukia ninyi sana.
Ekegusii: Ninsarie obotunwa bwaino ase mogosasimera, nintagore ebisasiimero biaino ase mogosaambera amanukato, erio intugute emebere yaino ekwete igoro y’emegwekano yaino mogosasiima etari moyo. Inche nimbaange kegima.

English: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya miji yenu kuwa magofu, na kuharibu mahali patakatifu penu pa kuabudia, nami sitapendezwa na harufu nzuri ya sadaka zenu.
Ekegusii: Nintagore emechie yaino ebe amatombe, ninsarie kegima aase aino ase mogosasiimera; tingwanchera ebing’wanso biaino, ebio tibikoba rimisu rikongwenera.

English: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.
Kiswahili: Nitaiharibu nchi, ili adui zenu watakaokuja kuishi humo washangae.
Ekegusii: Ninsarie ense yaino kegima goika ababisa baino bache komenya imeo bakumie buna esaregete.

English: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
Kiswahili: Nitawatawanya ninyi miongoni mwa mataifa, na kuufuta upanga wangu na kuwafuatia. Nchi yenu itaharibiwa, nayo miji yenu itakuwa magofu.
Ekegusii: Nimbaserebanie mogende komenya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, nimbatunyanerie esegi, naende ninsarie ense yaino ebe bosa, na emechie ebe amatongo.

English: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nchi itafurahia Sabato zake muda wote ule itakapokuwa ukiwa, nanyi mkiwa katika nchi ya adui zenu. Ndipo nchi itapumzika na kufurahia Sabato zake.
Ekegusii: Ekero mokare ase ense y’ababisa baino, na ense yaino negendererete koba amatongo, ero negokere engaki y’ogotimoka okwo inwe mwayetaangete.

English: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.
Kiswahili: Wakati wote nchi itakapobaki ukiwa, itapumzika na kufurahia Sabato zake ambazo haikuzipata mlipokuwa mnaishi humo.
Ekegusii: Ekero ense eria egendererete koba amatongo netimoke ogotimoka okwo motayeete ekero mwamenyeteo.

English: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa habari ya wenzenu wale watakaobaki, nitaifanya mioyo yao kuwa na hofu kuu katika nchi za adui zao, kiasi kwamba sauti ya jani linalopeperushwa na upepo itawafanya wakimbie. Watakimbia kana kwamba wanakimbia upanga, nao wataanguka, ingawa hakuna anayewafukuza.
Ekegusii: “Nimbatige inwe, abwo moratigare ase ense y’ababisa baino mobe nobwoba ase chinkoro chiaino ime, goika eriogi rie rito ri’omote rikonyegerigwa nembeo naribagose motame; ee, namotame buna omonto ogotama kagoserigwa korwa ase esegi, namogwe nonya onde tari kobabwatia.

English: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.
Kiswahili: Watajikwaa mmoja juu ya mwingine kama wakimbiao upanga, hata ingawa hakuna anayewafuatia. Hivyo hamtaweza kusimama mbele ya adui zenu.
Ekegusii: Namogochane buna abanto bagotama korwa ase esegi, nonya monto onde tari kobabwatia. Timokonyara koba ne chinguru chi’okorwania ababisa baino.

English: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.
Kiswahili: Mtaangamia katikati ya mataifa; nchi ya adui zenu itawala.
Ekegusii: Namokwe mosirere ase ense y’ababisa baino, na ense yabo nebamere kegima.

English: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.
Kiswahili: Wale wenu watakaobaki wataangamia katika nchi za adui zao kwa sababu ya dhambi zao; pia kwa sababu ya dhambi za baba zao wataangamia.
Ekegusii: Baria bare abake ase more baratigare bare moyo agwo ase ense y’ababisa baino nabasirere aroro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, naboigo nase engencho y’ebibe bie chisokoro chiabo nabasire buna chisokoro chiabo chiasirete.

English: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama watatubu dhambi zao na dhambi za baba zao, udanganyifu wao dhidi yangu na uadui wao kwangu,
Ekegusii: “Erio abwo baratigare goika baorokie ebibe biabo, naende baorokie ebie chisokoro chiabo, abwo batabeete abegenwa ase ’nde, na ekiagera baangete konyigwera,

English: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,
Kiswahili: ambao ulinifanya niwe na uadui nao hata nikawapeleka katika nchi ya adui zao, wakati mioyo yao isiyotahiriwa itanyenyekea na kutubu dhambi yao,
Ekegusii: bakagera nkaba nendamwamu ase bare goika nkabaira ase ense y’ababisa babo. Onye chinkoro chiabo echio chire chinkong’u chigwekeyia, na barabwo banche konyora egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo,

English: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.
Kiswahili: nami nitakumbuka agano langu na Yakobo, na agano langu na Isaki, na agano langu na Abrahamu, nami nitaikumbuka nchi.
Ekegusii: erio nario ndainyore okobwatana kwane k’wogotianania okwo nakorete na Yakobo, na Isaka, na Aburaamu, naende ning’inyore ense eria nabaete.

English: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wataiacha nchi ukiwa, nayo itafurahia Sabato zake wakati itakuwa ukiwa bila wao. Wataadhibiwa kwa ajili ya dhambi zao, kwa sababu walizikataa sheria zangu na kuzichukia amri zangu.
Ekegusii: Ense eria netigwe nabarabwo, erinde egokere engaki y’ogotimoka kwaye ekero etari nabaanto. Abanto abwo nabanyore egesusuro, ekiagera bangete kobwata amachiiko aane, na bakaanga kobwatia emeroberio yane nachiigete.

English: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God.
Kiswahili: Lakini pamoja na hili, wakati watakuwa katika nchi ya adui zao, sitawakataa wala kuwachukia kiasi cha kuwaharibu kabisa na kuvunja agano langu nao. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya nabo ase engaki eyio ekero bagendererete komenya ase ense eria y’ababisa babo, inche tinkobaanga gose kobatiga, na tinkobaseria. Tingotiga okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nakorete nabarabwo, ekiagera ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.

English: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am Yahweh.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa ajili yao nitalikumbuka agano langu na baba zao, ambao niliwatoa Misri mbele ya mataifa ili niwe Mungu wao. Mimi ndimi Bwana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ase engencho yabo ning’inyore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo, echio narusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri ase obosio bw’abaanto b’ebisaku, erinde imbe Nyasae obo. Inche ninche Omonene.”

English: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo amri, sheria na pia masharti ambazo Bwana alifanya kati yake mwenyewe na Waisraeli katika Mlima Sinai kupitia kwa Mose.
Ekegusii: Eyio nero emeroberio echiikire amo namachiik’Omonene aruete goetera ase omonwa o Musa, agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ebe ase egati yaye na Abaisraeli.

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to Yahweh in a vow, according to your valuation,
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Kama mtu yeyote ataweka nadhiri maalum ili kuweka watu wakfu kwa Bwana, kwa kutoa kiasi cha thamani inayolingana,
Ekegusii: “oteebie Abaisraeli: Onye eira yarietwe ng’a omonto aruegwe ase ogokorera Omonene, na omonto oyio karaboorigwe arueo, goika akorerwe rigori buna iga:

English: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: thamani ya kukomboa mwanaume mwenye kati ya umri wa miaka ishirini na miaka sitini itakuwa shekeli hamsini za fedha, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu;
Ekegusii: Rigori ri’omonto omosacha bw’emiaka emerongo ebere goika emerongo etano nomo, nigo riraabe chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etano, ase ekerengo gi’esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
Kiswahili: ikiwa ni mwanamke, weka thamani yake kwa shekeli thelathini.
Ekegusii: Onye n’omokuungu nigo riraabe chisekeli emerongo etato.

English: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
Kiswahili: Kama ni mtu mwenye umri wa miaka kati ya mitano na ishirini, weka thamani ya mwanaume kuwa shekeli ishirini, na mwanamke shekeli kumi.
Ekegusii: Onye nomonto omoke bw’emiaka etano goika emerongo ebere, rigori riaye nigo riraabe, ase omomura chisekeli emerongo ebere, na ase omoiseke chisekeli ikomi.

English: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
Kiswahili: Kama ni mtu mwenye umri kati ya mwezi mmoja na miaka mitano, weka thamani ya mwanaume kuwa shekeli tano za fedha, na ile ya mwanamke kuwa shekeli tatu za fedha.
Ekegusii: Onye nomwana bw’omotienyi oyomo goika emiaka etano, rigori riaye nigo riraabe, ase omomura chisekeli isano, na ase omoiseke chisekeli isato.

English: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
Kiswahili: Kama ni mtu mwenye miaka sitini na zaidi, weka thamani ya mwanaume kuwa shekeli kumi na tano, na mwanamke shekeli kumi.
Ekegusii: Onye nomonto omogotu bw’emiaka emerongo etano nomo na goetania, rigori riaye nigo riraabe, ase omogaka chisekeli ikomi na isano, na ase omong’ina chisekeli ikomi.

English: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote anayeweka nadhiri ni maskini mno kuweza kulipa kiasi kilichowekwa, atampeleka huyo mtu kwa kuhani, ambaye ataweka thamani yake kulingana na kile mweka nadhiri anachoweza kulipa.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto oria orieretwe eira nigo are omotaka mono otanyare goakana rigori riria riabeekirwe, rirorio omonto oria nigo araarentwe ase Omokuani, nere amokorere rigori koreng’ana nokonyara kw’omonto oyio oriete eira.

English: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama kile mtu alichokiwekea nadhiri ni mnyama anayekubalika kama sadaka kwa Bwana, mnyama wa namna hiyo aliyetolewa kwa Bwana anakuwa mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: “Onye eira y’omonto oria ariete niigoro y’eng’iti yancheire nainche Omonene ebe ekeng’wanso, ekeegwa buna ekio ase ’nde ’nakebe egechenu.

English: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.
Kiswahili: Mtu haruhusiwi kumbadilisha au kutoa mnyama mzuri kwa mbaya, au mnyama mbaya kwa mzuri. Kama atatoa mnyama badala ya mwingine, wanyama wote wawili, yaani yule aliyetolewa na yule aliyebadiliwa, ni watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria takoba ne ribaga koonchoreria eng’iti eria arente eng’iti eng’ao, takoonchoreria eng’iti engiya arente eyere embe, gose eng’iti embe arente eyere engiya. Onye omonto okoonchoreria ching’iti, erio chionsi ibere ’nachibe chiatananirwe ase ’nde.

English: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;
Kiswahili: Kama alichokiwekea nadhiri ni mnyama aliye najisi kiibada, yaani yule asiye kubalika kuwa sadaka kwa Bwana, huyo mnyama lazima aletwe kwa kuhani,
Ekegusii: Keraabe eng’iti etachenegeti ebe ekeng’wanso ase Omonene, omonto oria ayerente ase Omokuani,

English: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.
Kiswahili: ambaye ataamua ubora wa mnyama huyo, kama ni mzuri au mbaya. Thamani yoyote atakayoweka kuhani, hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa.
Ekegusii: na ere akore rigori ri’eng’iti eria koreng’ana buna ere engiya gose embe. Rigori Omokuani arakore, nario erio riraabe.

English: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.
Kiswahili: Kama mwenye mnyama atapenda kumkomboa mnyama huyo, lazima aongeze sehemu ya tano ya thamani yake.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omonto omonyene oganetie kobooria eng’iti eria, rirorio aakane rigori riria ribekire, n’ameente eyemo ya isano ase rigori erio.

English: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtu ataweka nyumba yake wakfu kama kitu kitakatifu kwa Bwana, kuhani ataamua ubora wa nyumba hiyo, kama ni nzuri au mbaya. Thamani yoyote kuhani atakayoweka, basi hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa.
Ekegusii: “Ekero omonto agwaatanana enyomba yaye ebe enchenu ase Omonene, Omokuani akore rigori ri’enyomba eria, buna ere engiya gose embe; buna Omokuani arakore rigori ri’enyomba eria, nario erio riraabe.

English: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu aliyeweka nyumba yake wakfu ataikomboa, lazima aongeze sehemu ya tano ya thamani yake, nayo nyumba itakuwa yake tena.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oria bwatananete enyomba eria aganetie koyebooria ebe eyaaye naende, rirorio aakane rigori riria ribekire, na ameente eyemo ya isano ase rigori erio; ase igo etigare ebe eyaaye.

English: “‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtu anaweka sehemu ya ardhi ya jamaa yake wakfu kwa Bwana, thamani yake itawekwa kulingana na kiasi cha mbegu inayohitajiwa kupandwa katika ardhi hiyo, yaani homeri moja ya mbegu za shayiri kwa shekeli hamsini za fedha.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogwaatanana ensemo y’oboremo bw’omwando oye, erio aye oyekorere rigori koreng’ana nekerengo gie chimbusuro chikobusurwa aroro, chimbusuro chi’esairi ebitonga ikomi chiakanwe chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etano.

English: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.
Kiswahili: Kama akiweka shamba lake wakfu katika Mwaka wa Yubile, ile thamani iliyokwisha wekwa itakuwa iyo hiyo.
Ekegusii: Omonto karaatanane oboremo bwaye korwa ase engaki y’Omwaka bw’Omochengo, rigori erio nario riraabe buna aye kwarikora.

English: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama akiweka shamba lake wakfu baada ya Yubile, kuhani ataweka thamani kulingana na idadi ya miaka iliyobaki kufikia Mwaka wa Yubile unaofuata, na thamani yake iliyoamuliwa itapunguzwa.
Ekegusii: Korende omonto karaatanane omogondo oye magega y’Omwaka bw’Omochengo, erio Omokuani akore rigori rie chitaabu koreng’ana n’emiaka yatigaire goika Omwaka onde bw’Omochengo, na igo nakeyie rigori.

English: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu anayeweka wakfu shamba anataka kulikomboa, lazima aongeze sehemu ya tano ya thamani yake, nalo shamba litakuwa lake tena.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria oraatanane oboremo bwaye ase ’nde, onye oganetie kobobooria, aakane rigori riria ribekire, naende ameente ensemo ya isano ase rigori erio, na oboremo botigare koba obwaye.

English: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;
Kiswahili: Kama pengine halikomboi shamba hilo, au kama ameliuza kwa mtu mwingine, kamwe haliwezi kukombolewa.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oria taganeti kobooria oboremo boria, korende aboonerie omonto omoao, rirorio oboremo obwo tibokoboorigwa nonya ’ng’ake.

English: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.
Kiswahili: Shamba hilo litakapoachiwa mwaka wa Yubile, litakuwa takatifu, kama shamba lililotolewa kwa Bwana, nalo litakuwa mali ya makuhani.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero oboremo boria bogochia gotigwa ase engaki y’Omwaka bw’Omochengo, bobe obwatananirwe ase Omonene. Oboremo nigo boraabe obw’Omokuani.

English: “‘If he dedicates a field to Yahweh which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtu ameweka wakfu kwa Bwana shamba alilonunua, ambalo si sehemu ya ardhi ya jamaa yake,
Ekegusii: “Omonto karaatanane ase Omonene oboremo agorete, obwo botari ensemo y’omwando oye,

English: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: kuhani ataamua thamani yake hadi Mwaka wa Yubile, naye huyo mtu atalazimika kulipa thamani yake siku hiyo kama kitu kitakatifu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omokuani akore rigori ri’oboremo boria koreng’ana n’emiaka etigarete goika Omwaka bw’Omochengo. Ase rituko riria kegima, omonto oria aakane rigori riria ribekire, ne chitaabu echi chibe chiatananirwe ase Omonene.

English: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.
Kiswahili: Katika Mwaka wa Yubile, shamba litarudishwa kwa mtu yule ambaye lilinunuliwa kutoka kwake, yule ambaye ardhi ilikuwa mali yake.
Ekegusii: Ase Omwaka oria bw’Omochengo oboremo boria boiranerigwe omonyene oria oboonetie, oyio oboremo bwareenge ensemo y’omwando oye.

English: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.
Kiswahili: Kila thamani lazima iwekwe kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, gera ishirini kwa shekeli.
Ekegusii: “Kera rigori rikobekwa nigo riraareng’anigwe nekerengo gi’esekeli eyio egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to Yahweh as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is Yahweh’s.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini hakuna mtu atakayeweka wakfu mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mnyama, kwa kuwa mzaliwa wa kwanza tayari ni mali ya Bwana; awe ngʼombe au kondoo, ni wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Korende chitugo chintangi n’echia Omenene Nyasae, ase igo onde tachiaatanana, keraabe eng’ombe gose eng’ondi, gose embori; eng’iti entangi nigo chire echia Omonene.

English: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.
Kiswahili: Kama ni mmoja wa wanyama walio najisi, aweza kumnunua kwa bei iliyowekwa, akiongeza sehemu ya tano ya thamani yake. Kama hatamkomboa, mnyama huyo atauzwa kwa bei iliyowekwa.
Ekegusii: Korende onye eng’iti eria entangi techenegeti, rirorio omonto oria ayeboorie koreng’ana ne rigori riraabekwe, naende ameente ensemo ya isano ase rigori erio, gose onye tekoboorigwa rirorio eoonigwe ase rigori erabeekerwe.

English: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini chochote kile mtu alicho nacho na akakiweka wakfu kwa Bwana, iwe ni binadamu, au mnyama, au ardhi ya jamaa, hakiwezi kuuzwa au kukombolewa. Chochote kilichowekwa wakfu ni kitakatifu sana kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Korende gento kende gionsi omonto aatananire ase Omonene ase enchera gete kebe ekiaye kegima, keraabe omonto, gose eng’iti gose oboremo bw’omwando oye, egento ekio tikebaisa koonigwa gose koboorigwa. Kera egento giaatananirwe nigo kere egechenu mono ase Omonene.

English: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mtu yeyote aliyewekwa wakfu ili kuangamizwa, hawezi kukombolewa. Mtu kama huyo lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi bwatananirwe ase ogosirigwa takonyara koboorigwa; omonto oyio goika aitwe akwe.

English: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Zaka ya kila kitu kutoka shambani, iwe ni nafaka kutoka kwa ardhi, au tunda kutoka kwa miti, ni mali ya Bwana; ni takatifu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Ensemo ya ikomi y’okwama kwa mogondo, keraabe endagera gose amatunda, ebio nebia Omonene, ebio nebichenu ase Omonene.

English: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akikomboa chochote cha zaka yake, lazima aongeze sehemu ya tano ya thamani yake.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oganetie kobooria ensemo yaye ya ikomi, nigo arameente eyemo ya isano ase rigori riaye.

English: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Zaka yote ya kundi la ngʼombe au la kondoo na mbuzi, kila mnyama wa kumi apitaye chini ya fimbo ya yule awachungaye, atakuwa mtakatifu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Boigo eyemo ya ikomi y’amaicho e chiombe, gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori, engencho yaye kera eng’iti ya ikomi ye ching’iti chigoeta inse ase enyimbo y’omorisia, nebe enchenu ase Omonene.

English: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”
Kiswahili: Yule mnyama wa kumi hatachaguliwa kwa kigezo cha uzuri au ubaya, naye haruhusiwi kubadiliwa. Ikiwa atabadiliwa, basi mnyama yule wa kwanza na huyo aliyebadiliwa wote watahesabiwa kuwa watakatifu, na haiwezekani kuwakomboa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Omonyene eng’iti eria takoriga — rigereria, onye ere engiya gose embe, na takoyeonchoreria. Onye omonto okoonchoreria ching’iti echio, erio chionsi ibere nchibe chinchenu, tichikoboorigwa.”

English: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maagizo Bwana aliyompa Mose juu ya Mlima Sinai kwa ajili ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amachiiko y’Omonene achiigete Abaisraeli goetera ase Musa agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana alisema na Mose katika Jangwa la Sinai, katika Hema la Kukutania, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa pili, katika mwaka wa pili baada ya Waisraeli kutoka nchi ya Misri. Akamwambia,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o kabere bw’omwaka o kabere magega Abaisraeli kobarure ase ense ya Misiri, Omonene agakwana na Musa ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, okomoteebia,

English: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,
Kiswahili: “Hesabu watu wa jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli kwa kufuata koo zao na jamaa zao, ukiorodhesha kila mwanaume kwa jina lake, mmoja mmoja.
Ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba. Oriike amarieta y’ abanto abasacha bonsi, oyomo ase oyomo.

English: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.
Kiswahili: Wewe na Aroni mtawahesabu kwa migawanyo yao wanaume wote katika Israeli wenye miaka ishirini na kuendelea ambao wanaweza kutumika katika jeshi.
Ekegusii: Aye amo na Aroni mobare abanto abakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, baria baranyare korwana esegi, mobaroberie ase esegi, ekeombe ase ekeombe.

English: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
Kiswahili: Mwanaume mmoja kutoka kila kabila, kila aliye kiongozi wa jamaa yake, atawasaidia.
Ekegusii: Naende mochore korwa ase kera egesaku omonto oyomo ore omoteneneri obo. Barabwo babe amo nainwe ase okobakonya.

English: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wanaume watakaowasaidia: “kutoka Reubeni, ni Elisuri mwana wa Shedeuri;
Ekegusii: Amarieta y’ abanto abwo naro aya: Korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni, Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri.

English: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Kiswahili: kutoka Simeoni, ni Shelumieli mwana wa Surishadai;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Simioni, Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai.

English: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Kiswahili: kutoka Yuda, ni Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu.

English: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
Kiswahili: kutoka Isakari, ni Nethaneli mwana wa Suari;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Netaneli, mosinto o Suari.

English: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.
Kiswahili: kutoka Zabuloni, ni Eliabu mwana wa Heloni;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni.

English: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Kiswahili: kutoka wana wa Yosefu: kutoka Efraimu, ni Elishama mwana wa Amihudi; kutoka Manase, ni Gamalieli mwana wa Pedasuri;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu: ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, na ase egesaku kia Manase, Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri.

English: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Kiswahili: kutoka Benyamini, ni Abidani mwana wa Gideoni;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini, Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni.

English: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Kiswahili: kutoka Dani, ni Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Dani, Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai.

English: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.
Kiswahili: kutoka Asheri, ni Pagieli mwana wa Okrani;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani.

English: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
Kiswahili: kutoka Gadi, ni Eliasafu mwana wa Deueli;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi, Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli.

English: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”
Kiswahili: kutoka Naftali, ni Ahira mwana wa Enani.”
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Ahira, mosinto o Enani.”

English: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wanaume walioteuliwa kutoka jumuiya, viongozi wa makabila ya baba zao. Walikuwa wakuu wa koo za Israeli.
Ekegusii: Abaaanto aba nabwo barenge abateneneri ase ebisaku ebio biabo, naende abatang’ani be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bachoretwe korwa ase omoganda bwonsi.

English: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni wakawachukua wanaume hao waliokuwa wamepewa majina yao,
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakaira abanto abwo baatoretwe ase amarieta abo,

English: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.
Kiswahili: wakaita jumuiya yote pamoja katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa pili. Watu wakaonyesha nasaba zao kwa koo zao na jamaa zao, nao wanaume waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, mmoja mmoja,
Ekegusii: na ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o kabere bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto amo. Bakariika amarieta y’ abanto abwo konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba, na omonto ase omonto.

English: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.
Kiswahili: kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose. Hivyo aliwahesabu katika Jangwa la Sinai:
Ekegusii: Musa akabara abanto abwo na kobarika, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochiikire.

English: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Reubeni, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa Israeli: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, mmoja mmoja, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Rubeni, omotangi o Israeli, bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abaaanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Reubeni ilikuwa watu 46,500.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano nemo, n’amagana atano (46,500).

English: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Simeoni: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi walihesabiwa na kuorodheshwa kwa majina, mmoja mmoja, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Simioni bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Simeoni walikuwa watu 59,300.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na kianda, n’amagana atato (59,300).

English: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Gadi: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Gadi walikuwa watu 45,650.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene naisano, n’amagana atano nomo, namerongo etano (45,650).

English: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Yuda: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Yuda walikuwa watu 74,600.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nebere na inye, n’amagana atano nomo (74,600).

Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Isakari: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

English: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Zabuloni: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Zabuloni walikuwa watu 57,400.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na isano ibere, n’amagana ane (57,400).

English: Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wana wa Yosefu: Kutoka wazao wa Efraimu: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, narwo orw’Efraimu, bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Efraimu walikuwa watu 40,500.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene, n’amagana atano (40,500).

English: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Manase: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Manase walikuwa watu 32,200.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato naibere, n’amagana abere (32,200).

English: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Benyamini: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Benyamini walikuwa watu 35,400.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato naisano, n’amagana ane (35,400).

English: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Dani: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Dani walikuwa watu 62,700.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo naibere, n’amagana atano n’abere (62,700).

English: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Asheri: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’Aseri bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Asheri walikuwa watu 41,500.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene nomo, n’amagana atano (41,500).

English: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Naftali: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Nafutali bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Naftali walikuwa watu 53,400.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano naisato, n’amagana ane (53,400).

English: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wanaume waliohesabiwa na Mose, Aroni na viongozi kumi na wawili wa Israeli, kila mmoja akiwakilisha jamaa yake.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barigetwe na Musa, na Aroni, na abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli ikomi na babere, abatenenerete kera oyomo egesaku kiaye.

English: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote Waisraeli waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi la Israeli walihesabiwa kufuatana na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi abarigetwe, enyomba ase enyomba, baria konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, naende baare konyara korwana esegi,

English: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya hesabu yao ilikuwa watu 603,550.
Ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano nomo na isato, n’amagana atano, namerongo etano (603,550).

English: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, jamaa ya kabila la Lawi hawakuhesabiwa pamoja na wengine.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ororeria rwa Lawi, barabwo tibaabaretwe amo n’abanto abwo bande,

English: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa amemwambia Mose:
Ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene nigo atebeetie Musa,

English: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;
Kiswahili: “Kamwe usihesabu kabila la Lawi wala kuwaweka pamoja katika hesabu ya Waisraeli wengine.
Ekegusii: “Abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi tobaabara amo n’Abaisraeli bande.

English: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, waweke Walawi kuwa viongozi wa Maskani ya Ushuhuda, juu ya samani zake na kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake. Wao watabeba Maskani na samani zake zote; wataitunza na kupiga kambi kuizunguka.
Ekegusii: Obeeke Abalawi babe bakorenda Obomenyo Obochenu obwo bore noborori, naende babe bakorenda ebinto bire ase Obomenyo boria ime, na ebikorero biaye. ’Nababe bakobobogoria amo n’ebinto biaye bionsi, na gokora emeremo imeo. Barabwo nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chi’okomenya chietanane Obomenyo obwo.

English: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.
Kiswahili: Wakati wowote Maskani inapohamishwa, Walawi wataifungua, na wakati wowote maskani inapotakiwa kusimamishwa, Walawi watafanya kazi hiyo. Mtu yeyote mwingine ambaye atasogea karibu nayo atauawa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Obomenyo obwo boraabe bokong’anyigwa, Abalawi nabwo barabosimore, na ekero boraabe bogotenenigwa naende, nabwo barabotenenie aase agwo. Omonto onde bwensi otachikiri aise goika ang’e n’Obomenyo obwo goika aitwe akwe.

English: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli watapiga mahema yao kwa makundi makundi, kila mwanaume katika kambi yake mwenyewe chini ya bendera yake.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande nabatenenie chiema chiabo, kera egesaku ase egetwori kiaye, na kera omonto abeere inse y’ebendera yaye, ase ekeombe kiaye.

English: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Walawi watapiga mahema yao kuzunguka Maskani ya Ushuhuda ili ghadhabu isiipate jumuiya ya Waisraeli. Walawi watawajibika kwa utunzaji wa Maskani ya Ushuhuda.”
Ekegusii: Korende Abalawi nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chietanane Obomenyo obwo bore noborori, na komenyao, erinde endamwamu yane etangwe tebaisa kogwera omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli. Abalawi barende Obomenyo obwo bore noborori.”

English: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walifanya yote haya sawasawa kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora onsi buna Omonene abachiigete goetera ase Musa.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana aliwaambia Mose na Aroni:
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,

English: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.
Kiswahili: “Waisraeli watapiga kambi zao kuzunguka Hema la Kukutania kwa umbali fulani kutoka kwenye hema, kila mwanaume chini ya alama yake pamoja na bendera ya jamaa yake.”
Ekegusii: “Ekero Abaisraeli baratoore, kera omonto abe inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiaye, na inse y’ekemanyererio ki’eamate yaye; batoore baetanane Eema y’Omosangererekano, ne chiema chi’ abanto chirigererie Eema eria.

English: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande wa mashariki kuelekea mawio ya jua, kambi ya makundi ya Yuda watapiga kambi chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Yuda ni Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya moocha n’Abayuda, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 74,600.
Ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano ebere nainye, n’amagana atano nomo (74,600).

English: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Isakari watapiga kambi karibu na Yuda. Kiongozi wa watu wa Isakari ni Nethaneli mwana wa Suari.
Ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abaisakaru. Netaneli, mosinto o Suari, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 54,400.
Ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano nainye, n’amagana ane (54,400).

English: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Zabuloni litafuata. Kiongozi wa watu wa Zabuloni ni Eliabu mwana wa Heloni.
Ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abasabuloni. Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 57,400.
Ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano na isanaibere, n’amagana ane (57,400).

English: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote walio katika kambi ya Yuda, kufuatana na makundi yao, ni 186,400. Wao watatangulia kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori ki’Abayuda, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo namerongo etano netato na isanonemo, n’amagana ane (186,400). Aba nabwo barabe bagotang’ana komanora kogeenda orogeendo.

English: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande wa kusini kutakuwa kambi ya makundi ya Reubeni chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Reubeni ni Elisuri mwana wa Shedeuri.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya Irianyi n’Abareubeni, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 46,500.
Ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo ene na isanonemo, n’amagana atano (46,500).

English: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Simeoni watapiga kambi karibu na Reubeni. Kiongozi wa watu wa Simeoni ni Shelumieli mwana wa Surishadai.
Ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abasimeoni. Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 59,300.
Ekegusii: na omogaanda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano nakianda, n’amagana atato (59,300).

English: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Gadi litafuata. Kiongozi wa watu wa Gadi ni Eliasafu mwana wa Deueli.
Ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abagadi. Eliasafu, mosinto o Reueli, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 45,650.
Ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo ene naisano, n’amagana atano nomo, na merongo etano (45,650).

English: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote walio katika kambi ya Reubeni, kufuatana na makundi yao, ni 151,450. Nao watakuwa nafasi ya pili kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori kia Rubeni, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo namerongo etano n’eyemo, n’amagana ane, namerongo etano (151,450). Aba nabwo barabe aba kabere komanora kogeenda orogeendo.

English: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.
Kiswahili: Kisha Hema la Kukutania na kambi ya Walawi vitakuwa katikati ya kambi zote. Wao watasafiri kwa utaratibu ule ule kama walivyopiga kambi, kila mmoja mahali pake mwenyewe chini ya alama yake.
Ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakogeenda orogeendo, Eema y’Omosangererekano n’ebe ekobogorigwa n’Abalawi, na barabwo babe gati‐gati y’ebiombe binde. Ase omooroberio oyo abanto ’’mbabe bagotoora, naboigo barabe ko bakogeenda orogeendo. Kera omonto abe ensemo yaye inse y’ebendera yaye.

English: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
Kiswahili: Upande wa magharibi kutakuwepo na kambi ya makundi ya Efraimu chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Efraimu ni Elishama mwana wa Amihudi.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya bosongo n’Abaefraimu, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 40,500.
Ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo ene, n’amagana atano (40,500).

English: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Manase litafuata baada ya Efraimu. Kiongozi wa watu wa Manase ni Gamalieli mwana wa Pedasuri.
Ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abamanase. Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 32,200.
Ekegusii: na omogaanda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etato naibere, n’amagana abere (32,200).

English: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Benyamini litafuata baada ya Manase. Kiongozi wa watu wa Benyamini ni Abidani mwana wa Gideoni.
Ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Ababenjamini. Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 35,400.
Ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etato na isano, n’amagana ane (35,400).

English: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote walio katika kambi ya Efraimu kufuatana na makundi yao ni 108,100. Nao watakuwa nafasi ya tatu kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori gi’Efraimu, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na isano isato, ne’rigana erimo (108,100). Aba nabwo barabe aba gatato komanora kogeenda orogeendo.

English: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Kiswahili: Upande wa kaskazini kutakuwa na makundi ya kambi ya Dani, chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Dani ni Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya sugusu n’Abadani, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 62,700.
Ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano nomo naibere, n’amagana atano abere (62,700).

English: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Asheri watapiga kambi karibu na Dani. Kiongozi wa watu wa Asheri ni Pagieli mwana wa Okrani.
Ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abaaseri. Pagieli, mosinto bw’okirani, nere oraabe omotang’ani abo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 41,500.
Ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo ene neyemo, na magana atano (41,500).

English: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Naftali litafuata. Kiongozi wa watu wa Naftali ni Ahira mwana wa Enani.
Ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abanafutali. Ahira, mosinto o Enani, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

English: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Kundi lake lina watu 53,400.
Ekegusii: na omogaanda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano na isato, na magana ane (53,400).

English: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote walio katika kambi ya Dani ni 157,600. Wao watakuwa wa mwisho kuondoka chini ya alama yao.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori gia Dani, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na merongo etano na isano ibere, na magana atano nomo (157,600). Aba nabwo barabe abamagega kegima komanora kogeenda orogeendo, babe inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo.”

English: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio Waisraeli, wakiwa wamehesabiwa kufuatana na jamaa zao. Wote walio kambini kwa makundi yao ni watu 603,550.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo Abaisraeli barigetwe korwa ase kera eamate, ekeombe ase ekeombe. Omobaro obo nigo ore chilifu amagana atano nomo na isato, namagana atano, namerongo etano (603,550).

English: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Walawi hawakuhesabiwa pamoja na Waisraeli wengine, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Abalawi barabwo tibaabaretwe amo n’Abaisraeli bande, ekiagera nabo Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakafanya kila kitu Bwana alichomwamuru Mose. Hivyo ndivyo walivyopiga kambi chini ya alama zao, pia hivyo ndivyo walivyoondoka, kila mmoja akiwa na ukoo wake na jamaa yake.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Bagatoora inse ye chibendera chiabo, naende kobakogeenda orogeendo, bakageenda kera oyomo amo neamate yaye, n’enyomba yaye.

English: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.
Kiswahili: Hii ni hesabu ya jamaa ya Aroni na Mose kwa wakati ambao Bwana alizungumza na Mose katika Mlima Sinai.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, na orwa Musa, ase engaki eri’Omonene akwanete na Musa, agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai.

English: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Majina ya wana wa Aroni yalikuwa: Nadabu mzaliwa wa kwanza na Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’abamura ba Aroni: Nadabu, omomura oye omotangi, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.

English: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
Kiswahili: Hayo yalikuwa majina ya wana wa Aroni, makuhani wapakwa mafuta, waliokuwa wamesimikwa kuhudumu kama makuhani.
Ekegusii: Abamura aba ba Aroni nabwo baagetwe amaguta na gwatananwa ase emeremo y’obokuani.

English: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh when they offered strange fire before Yahweh in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo Nadabu na Abihu walikufa mbele za Bwana walipotoa sadaka kwa moto usioruhusiwa mbele zake katika Jangwa la Sinai. Hawakuwa na wana; kwa hiyo Eleazari na Ithamari walihudumu peke yao kama makuhani wakati wote wa maisha ya Aroni baba yao.
Ekegusii: Korende Nadabu na Abihu, barabwo bagakwera ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekero bamoruerete ase omorero otachenegeti, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai. Barabwo tibabwate abana. Ase ayio Eleazari na Itamari bakagenderera gokora emeremo y’obokuani ase amatuko onsi Aroni ise arenge moyo.

English: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.
Kiswahili: “Walete watu wa kabila la Lawi mbele ya Aroni kuhani ili wamsaidie.
Ekegusii: “Renta abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi, erinde obabeeke bamokorere Aroni, Omokuani.

English: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Watafanya huduma kwa ajili yake na kwa jumuiya yote katika Hema la Kukutania kwa kufanya kazi za Maskani.
Ekegusii: Abalawi abwo ’mbakorere Aroni emeremo, boigo bakorere omoganda bwonsi agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, ekero bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Watatunza samani zote za Hema la Kukutania, wakitimiza wajibu wa kuhudumia Waisraeli kwa kufanya kazi ya Maskani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbatenenere ebinto bionsi bire ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase ogokora emeremo yonsi ase Obomenyo Obochenu nigo barabe bagokorera Abaisraeli bonsi.

English: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Wakabidhi Walawi kwa Aroni na wanawe; hao ndio Waisraeli ambao wanakabidhiwa kwake kabisa.
Ekegusii: Aroni amo n’abamura baye baegwe Abalawi buna ekeegwa korwa ase Abaisraeli.

English: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
Kiswahili: Waweke Aroni na wanawe kuhudumu kama makuhani; mtu mwingine yeyote atakayesogea mahali patakatifu ni lazima auawe.”
Ekegusii: Obeeke Aroni amo n’abamura baye bakore emeremo y’obokuani, korende monto onde bwensi omoao aise gwesoyia ase emeremo eyio nigo araitwe akwe.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene Nyasae agateebia Musa,

English: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,
Kiswahili: “Nimewatwaa Walawi kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli badala ya mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa kila mwanamke wa Mwisraeli. Walawi ni wangu,
Ekegusii: “Rora, inche omonyene neatananerete Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli ribaga ri’abana abatangi. Abalawi mbabe abaane,

English: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa wazaliwa wote wa kwanza ni wangu. Nilipowaua wazaliwa wa kwanza huko Misri, nilimtenga kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika Israeli awe wangu, akiwa mwanadamu au mnyama. Watakuwa wangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera abana abatangi bonsi nabaane. Ase rituko riria naitete abana abatangi, ne ching’iti chintangi, agwo Misiri, nigo neatananerete abana abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli babe abaane, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo. Inche ninche Omonene.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika Jangwa la Sinai,
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa arenge agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, Omonene agakwana nere, akamoteebia,

English: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”
Kiswahili: “Wahesabu Walawi kwa jamaa zao na koo zao. Mhesabu kila mwanaume mwenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi.”
Ekegusii: “Bara Abalawi enyomba ase enyomba, na eamate ase eamate. Oriike kera omonto omosacha, naboigo kera omwana omomura okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania.”

English: Moses counted them according to Yahweh’s word, as he was commanded.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawahesabu, kama alivyoamriwa na neno la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akabaabara, buna Omonene amochiigete.

English: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Kiswahili: Haya yalikuwa majina ya wana wa Lawi: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
Ekegusii: Lawi nigo abwate abamura batato: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.

English: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo yaliyokuwa majina ya koo za Wagershoni: Libni na Shimei.
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Libini na Simei.

English: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Kiswahili: Koo za Wakohathi zilikuwa ni: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
Ekegusii: Abana ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.

English: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
Kiswahili: Koo za Wamerari zilikuwa ni: Mahli na Mushi. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Walawi, kufuatana na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abana ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Abanto abwo nigo barenge chisokoro chie chiamate chi’Abalawi, kera oyomo ase eamate yaye.

English: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na koo za Walibni na Washimei kwa Gershoni; hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wagershoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Libini na eya Simei, abwo nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gerisoni.

English: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Idadi ya waume wote waliokuwa na mwezi mmoja au zaidi waliohesabiwa walikuwa 7,500.
Ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano ibere, na magana atano (7,500).

English: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
Kiswahili: Ukoo wa Wagershoni walitakiwa kuweka kambi zao upande wa magharibi, nyuma ya Maskani.
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisoni nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya bosongo magega y’Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.
Kiswahili: Kiongozi wa jamaa za Wagershoni alikuwa Eliasafu mwana wa Laeli.
Ekegusii: Eliasafu, mosinto o Laeli, nere oraabe omotang’ani bwe chiamate chi’Abagerisoni.

English: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
Kiswahili: Katika Hema la Kukutania, Wagershoni walikuwa na wajibu wa kutunza Maskani na hema, vifuniko vyake, pazia katika mlango wa kuingilia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania,
Ekegusii: Ase Eema y’Omosangererekano Abagerisoni nabwo barabe bakorenda Obomenyo obonyene, na ebimumeko biaye, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’Eema eria.

English: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.
Kiswahili: mapazia ya ua, pazia katika ingilio la ua unaozunguka Maskani na madhabahu, pamoja na kamba, na kila kinachohusika kwa matumizi yake.
Ekegusii: Naende babe bakorenda ebitambaa bigosungwa ase ogotuba eraaro, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro eetanaine Obomenyo Obochenu, na egesasiimero, ne chingori chiabo. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

English: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.
Kiswahili: Kwa Kohathi kulikuwepo koo za Waamramu, Waishari, Wahebroni na Wauzieli; hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wakohathi.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate y’Amuramu, na eya Isari, na eya Heburoni, na eya Usieli; abwo nabwo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Kohati.

English: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Hesabu ya waume wote wenye mwezi mmoja au zaidi ilikuwa watu 8,600. Wakohathi waliwajibika kutunza mahali patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano isato, na magana atano nomo (8,600). Abanto aba nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto bire ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Koo za Wakohathi zilitakiwa kuweka kambi zao upande wa kusini wa Maskani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya Irianyi y’Obomenyo boria.

English: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
Kiswahili: Kiongozi wa jamaa za koo za Wakohathi alikuwa Elisafani mwana wa Uzieli.
Ekegusii: Elisafani, mosinto bwa Usieli, nere oraabe omotang’ani bw’egesaku ki’Abakohati.

English: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.
Kiswahili: Waliwajibika kutunza Sanduku la Agano, meza, kinara cha taa, madhabahu, na vile vyombo vya mahali patakatifu vinavyotumika kuhudumu, pazia, na kila kitu kinachohusika na matumizi yake.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kwogotianania, n’emesa, n’ekebeekerero gie chitaaya, na ebisasimero, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Obomenyo boria, biria abakuani bagokorera emeremo, amo negetambaa getubete Aase Aachenu Mono. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

English: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Kiongozi mkuu wa Walawi alikuwa Eleazari mwana wa kuhani, Aroni. Aliwekwa juu ya wale waliowajibika kutunza mahali patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, nere oraabe omonene igoro ase abaraai b’Abalawi, naende omoteneneri bw’abaanto barabe bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
Kiswahili: Kwa Merari kulikuwa na koo za Wamahli na Wamushi; hizi zilikuwa koo za Merari.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Mali, na eya Musi abwo nabwo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Merari.

English: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
Kiswahili: Hesabu ya waume wote wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja au zaidi waliohesabiwa walikuwa 6,200.
Ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano nemo, na magana abere (6,200).

English: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.
Kiswahili: Kiongozi wa jamaa za koo za Wamerari alikuwa Surieli mwana wa Abihaili; hawa walitakiwa kuweka kambi zao upande wa kaskazini mwa Maskani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya sugusu y’Obomenyo boria. Surieli, mosinto bw’Abihaili, nere oraabe omotang’ani bw’ abanto b’egesaku kia Merari.

English: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
Kiswahili: Wamerari waliwekwa kutunza miimo ya Maskani, mataruma yake, nguzo, vitako na vifaa vyake vyote na kila kitu kilichohusika na matumizi yake,
Ekegusii: Abamerari nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: chibao chi’Obomenyo Obochenu, n’emeriibo, ne chisiiro, ne chinterekerero, amo nebikorero biabo bionsi. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

English: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
Kiswahili: na pia nguzo za ua unaozunguka pamoja na vitako vyake, vigingi vya hema na kamba zake.
Ekegusii: Nabwo naende babegetwe korenda chisiiro chi’eraaro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo na ebirochi, ne chingori chiabo.

English: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
Kiswahili: Mose, na Aroni na wanawe walitakiwa kuweka kambi zao mashariki mwa Maskani, kuelekea mawio ya jua, mbele ya Hema la Kukutania. Wao walihusika na utunzaji wa mahali patakatifu kwa niaba ya Waisraeli. Mtu mwingine yeyote aliyepasogelea mahali patakatifu angeuawa.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni amo nabamura baye mbabe bagotoora kororia Obomenyo Obochenu ensemo ya moocha, bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Barabwo nigo barabe bagokora emeremo eganeirie gokorwa ime y’Aase Aachenu, na gotenenera emeremo ende yonsi erakorerwe Abaisraeli. Omonto onde bwensi otatananiri gokora emeremo eyio, korende aike ang’e ase Obomenyo Obochenu, nigo araitwe akwe.

English: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya hesabu ya Walawi waliohesabiwa na Mose na Aroni kwa amri ya Bwana, kufuatana na koo, pamoja na kila mume mwenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi, walikuwa 22,000.
Ekegusii: Abanto abasacha b’Abalawi, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, abwo Musa na Aroni bariigete, eamate ase eamate, buna Omonene abachiigete, nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000).

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Wahesabu wazaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wote wa Waisraeli wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi na uorodheshe majina yao.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Bara abanto abasacha abatangi, n’abana abamura abatangi bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, obariike.

English: You shall take the Levites for me—I am Yahweh—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Nitwalie Walawi badala ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Waisraeli, nayo mifugo ya Walawi badala ya wazaliwa wa mifugo ya Waisraeli. Mimi ndimi Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene. Ase ayio Abalawi ’mbabe abaane. Obanyatananere ribaga ri’abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli. Naboigo ne ribaga rie ching’iti chintangi chi’Abaisraeli onyatananere ching’iti chi’Abalawi.”

English: Moses counted, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mose akawahesabu wazaliwa wa kwanza wote wa Waisraeli, kama Bwana alivyomwamuru.
Ekegusii: Musa akabara na korika abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli, ne ching’iti chintangi, buna Omonene amochiigete.

English: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya hesabu ya wazaliwa wa kwanza waume wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi, walioorodheshwa kwa majina, walikuwa 22,273.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abasacha abatangi n’abana abamura abatangi konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere, na merongo etano ebere, na batato (22,273).

English: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Watwae Walawi badala ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wote wa Israeli, nayo mifugo ya Walawi badala ya mifugo yao. Walawi watakuwa wangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Ira Abalawi babe abaane ribaga ri’ abanto abasacha abatangi b’Abaisraeli, naende oire ching’iti chi’Abalawi chibe echiane ribaga rie ching’iti chintangi chi’Abaisraeli. Inche ninche Omonene.

English: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,
Kiswahili: Ili kukomboa wazao wa kwanza 273 wa Waisraeli ambao wamezidi hesabu ya Walawi,
Ekegusii: Abanto abasacha abatangi b’Abaisraeli nabange bare, mbaetanetie Abalawi ase amagana abere, na emerongo etano ebere na batato (273).

English: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);
Kiswahili: kusanya shekeli tano kwa kila mmoja, kufuatana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, ambayo ina uzito wa gera ishirini.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio oboorie kera oyomo obo ne chitaabu chie chisekeli isano, koreng’ana ne chisekeli chigokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera emerongo ebere).

English: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”
Kiswahili: Mpe Aroni na wanawe hizo fedha kwa ajili ya ukombozi wa idadi ya Waisraeli waliozidi.”
