English: At the commandment of Yahweh they encamped, and at the commandment of Yahweh they traveled. They kept Yahweh’s command, at the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa amri ya Bwana walipiga kambi, na kwa amri ya Bwana waliondoka. Walitii amri ya Bwana, kufuatana na agizo lake kupitia Mose.
Ekegusii: Bun’Omonene arenge gochiika nigo barenge gotoora, batiga orogeendo, gose baimoka bachaaka orogeendo. Bakaba bakoigwera Omonene buna achiigete goetera ase Musa.

English: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.
Kiswahili: “Tengeneza tarumbeta mbili za fedha ya kufua, uzitumie kwa kuita jumuiya pamoja na wakati wa kuvunja makambi ili kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Roisia chitarumbeta ibere chie chifeta chiturire. Obe gokobibugia ekero ogosangereria omoganda amo, na ekero abanto barabe bakoimoka korwa ase ebitwori gochaaka orogeendo.

English: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Tarumbeta zote mbili zikipigwa, jumuiya yote itakusanyika mbele yako katika ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Ekero chitarumbeta chionsi ibere chirabugigwe, abanto bonsi ’nabache na gosangererekana agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
Kiswahili: Kama tarumbeta moja tu ikipigwa, viongozi, yaani wakuu wa koo za Israeli, ndio watakaokusanyika mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Korende onye eyemo yoka gekobugigwa, abatang’ani abwo bare abateneneri b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli nabwo boka barachiche ase ore.

English: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.
Kiswahili: Wakati mlio wa kujulisha hatari ukipigwa, makabila yaliyo na makambi upande wa mashariki yataondoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero morabugie etarumbeta ase eriogi ri’ogotabobora, abanto bare ase ebitwori bi’enseemo ya moocha baimoke bachaake orogeendo rwabo.

English: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
Kiswahili: Ukisikika mlio wa pili wa jinsi hiyo, walioko kwenye makambi ya kusini wataondoka. Mlio huo wa kujulisha hatari utakuwa ishara ya kuondoka.
Ekegusii: Naende ekero morabugie etarumbeta ase eriogi ri’ogotabobora eria’kabere, abanto bare ase ebitwori bi’enseemo ya Irianyi baimoke bachaake orogeendo. Etarumbeta goika ebugigwe ase eriogi erio ase chingaki chionsi abanto barabe bakomanora gochaaka orogeendo.

English: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
Kiswahili: Ili kukusanya kusanyiko, piga tarumbeta zote, lakini siyo kwa mlio wa kujulisha hatari.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero omosangererekano okorangerigwa goochicha amo, chitarumbeta goika chibugigwe, korende tari ase eriogi ri’ogotabobora.

English: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.
Kiswahili: “Wana wa Aroni, makuhani, ndio watakaopiga hizo tarumbeta. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa ajili yenu na kwa vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Aroni Omokuani nabwo barabe bakobugia chitarumbeta echio. Oko nakwo koraabe ogochika ase more kogenderera botambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
Kiswahili: Wakati mtakapopigana vita katika nchi yenu wenyewe dhidi ya adui anayewaonea, piga tarumbeta kwa mlio wa kujulisha hatari. Ndipo utakumbukwa na Bwana Mungu wenu na kuokolewa kutoka kwa adui zenu.
Ekegusii: Ekero moraabe mokorwana esegi nababisa baino abwo baraache kobarwania ase ense yaino, mobe mokobugia chitarumbeta ase eriogi ri’ogotabobora, erinde monyaare koinyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino, na inwe ’namotoorigwe korwa ase ababisa baino.

English: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”
Kiswahili: Pia nyakati za furaha yenu, yaani sikukuu zenu zilizoamriwa na sikukuu za Mwezi Mwandamo, mtapiga tarumbeta juu ya sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa na sadaka zenu za amani, nazo zitakuwa ukumbusho kwa ajili yenu mbele za Mungu wenu. Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wenu.”
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aino y’omogooko, na amatuko achiikire abe Amatuko Amanene ase more, na ase omochakano bw’emetienyi ’namobe mokobugia chitarumbeta igoro y’ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, na chitarumbeta echio chigere mobe mokoinyorwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae oino. Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya ishirini ya mwezi wa pili wa mwaka wa pili, wingu liliinuka kutoka juu ya maskani ya Ushuhuda.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere ri’omotienyi o kabere, ase omwaka o kabere, riire riria rikaimokerera igoro korwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

English: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Waisraeli wakaondoka kutoka Jangwa la Sinai wakasafiri kutoka sehemu moja hadi nyingine mpaka wingu lilipotua katika Jangwa la Parani.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka korwa ase erooro ya Sinai, bakageenda bakaba bakona‐gotoora egetwori ase egetwori, ne riire riria rigaika agwo ase erooro ya Parani, rigatenena aroro.

English: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
Kiswahili: Waliondoka kwa mara ya kwanza kwa agizo la Bwana kupitia kwa Mose.
Ekegusii: Omonene agachiika Musa, na Abaisraeli bagachaaka orogeendo rwabo ase ekero egetang’ani.

English: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.
Kiswahili: Vikosi vya kambi ya Yuda vilitangulia kwanza chini ya alama yao. Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu alikuwa kiongozi wao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egetwori kia Yuda, abatoorete inse y’ebendera yabo, bakaba abatang’ani b’okoimoka gochaaka orogeendo, ekeombe ase ekeombe, na Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu, nere orenge omoraai bw’omoganda oria.

English: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
Kiswahili: Nethaneli mwana wa Suari alikuwa kiongozi wa kabila la Isakari,
Ekegusii: Netaneli, mosinto o Suari, nere orenge omoraai bw’ abanto b’egesaku gia Isakaru,

English: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.
Kiswahili: naye Eliabu mwana wa Heloni alikuwa kiongozi wa kabila la Zabuloni.
Ekegusii: na Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni, nere orenge omoraai bw’ abanto b’egesaku gia Sabuloni.

English: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Maskani iliposhushwa, nao wana wa Gershoni na wana wa Merari ambao waliibeba wakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero Obomenyo bwatagoretwe Abagerisoni na Abamerari, abarenge kobobogoria, bachaaka orogeendo.

English: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
Kiswahili: Vikosi vya kambi ya Reubeni vilifuata, chini ya alama yao. Elisuri mwana wa Shedeuri alikuwa kiongozi wao.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio abanto b’egetwori kia Rubeni, abatoorete inse y’ebendera yabo, bakaimoka kogeenda ekeombe ase ekeombe, na Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri, nere orenge omoraai bw’omoganda oria.

English: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.
Kiswahili: Shelumieli mwana wa Surishadai aliongoza kikosi cha kabila la Simeoni,
Ekegusii: Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai, nere orenge omoraai bw’ abanto b’egesaku gia Simioni.

English: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.
Kiswahili: naye Eliasafu mwana wa Deueli aliongoza kikosi cha kabila la Gadi.
Ekegusii: Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli, nere orenge omoraai bw’ abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi.

English: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
Kiswahili: Kisha Wakohathi wakaondoka, wakichukua vitu vitakatifu. Maskani ilikuwa isimamishwe kabla wao hawajafika.
Ekegusii: Erio Abakohati bakaimoka kogeenda babogoretie Ebinto Ebichenu. Ekero konya bataraika ase egetwori bakanyora ng’a baria bande batenenirie Obomenyo boria Obochenu.

English: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.
Kiswahili: Vikosi vya kambi ya Efraimu vilifuata, chini ya alama yao. Elishama mwana wa Amihudi alikuwa kiongozi wao.
Ekegusii: Naende abanto b’egetwori kia Efraimu, abatoorete inse y’ebendera yabo, bakaimoka kogeenda, ekeombe ase ekeombe, na Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, nere orenge omoraai bw’omoganda oria.

English: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Gamalieli mwana wa Pedasuri aliongoza kikosi cha kabila la Manase,
Ekegusii: Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri, nere orenge omoraai bw’ abanto b’egesaku kia Manase.

English: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.
Kiswahili: naye Abidani mwana wa Gideoni alikuwa kiongozi wa kikosi cha kabila la Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni, nere orenge omoraai bw’ abanto b’egesaku gia Benjamini.

English: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.
Kiswahili: Mwishowe, kama kikosi cha nyuma cha ulinzi wa vikosi vyote, vikosi vya kambi ya Dani viliondoka chini ya alama yao. Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai alikuwa kiongozi wao.
Ekegusii: Omoerio abanto b’egetwori gia Dani, abatoorete inse y’ebendera yabo, bakaimoka kogeenda, ekeombe ase ekeombe. Abwo nigo barenge abarendi ba magega ase ebitwori bionsi. Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai, nere orenge omoraai bw’omoganda oria.

English: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.
Kiswahili: Pagieli mwana wa Okrani aliongoza kikosi cha kabila la Asheri,
Ekegusii: Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani, nere orenge omoraai bw’ abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri,

English: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.
Kiswahili: naye Ahira mwana wa Enani aliongoza kikosi cha kabila la Naftali.
Ekegusii: na Ahira, mosinto o Enani, nere orenge omoraai bw’ abanto b’egesaku kia Nafutali.

English: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio ulikuwa utaratibu wa kuondoka wa vikosi vya Waisraeli walipokuwa wanaondoka.
Ekegusii: Oyo n’oro orenge omooroberio bw’Abaisraeli ekero barenge kogeenda orogeendo rwabo, ekeombe ase ekeombe, ekero kende gionsi baare koimoka korwa ase egetwori.

English: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”
Kiswahili: Basi Mose akamwambia Hobabu mwana wa Reueli, Mmidiani, mkwewe Mose, “Tunaondoka kwenda mahali ambapo Bwana amesema ‘Nitawapa ninyi mahali hapo.’ Twende pamoja nasi tutakutendea mema, kwa maana Bwana ameahidi mambo mema kwa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana na Hobabu, mosinto o Reueli Omomidiani, akamoteebia, “Intwe ’nkogeenda tore aase aaria ase Omonene atotebetie ng’a n’atoe. Inchuo ogende amo naintwe, na intwe ’natogokorere amaya, ekiagera Omonene orire eira ng’a nasesenie Abaisraeli.”

English: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Hapana, sitakwenda; nitarudi kwenye nchi yangu mwenyewe na watu wangu mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Korende Hobabu akairaneria, “Tinkogeenda amo nainwe; inche nigo ’nkoirana ingende ase ense yane, na ase abanto b’eamate yane.”

English: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akasema, “Tafadhali usituache. Wewe unajua mahali ambapo yatupasa kupiga kambi jangwani, nawe unaweza kuwa macho yetu.
Ekegusii: Musa akamosorora, akamoteebia, “Koranche tobaisa gototiga, ekiagera aye nomanyete buna togochia kona gotoora ase erooro. Ase ayio nobe kogototang’ana.

English: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa utafuatana nasi, tutashirikiana nawe mema yoyote tutakayopewa na Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Naende koragende amo naintwe, amaya ari’Omonene agochia gotokorera, ayio naro naintwe toragokorere.”

English: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo waliondoka kutoka mlima wa Bwana, nao wakasafiri kwa siku tatu. Sanduku la Agano la Bwana liliwatangulia kwa zile siku tatu ili kuwatafutia mahali pa kupumzika.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka korwa ase egetunwa keria kia Omonene, bakageenda orogeendo rw’amatuko atato. Esanduki y’okobwatana kw’Omonene yare ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana ekabatang’ana ekabanyorera aase bagochia gotoora,

English: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
Kiswahili: Wingu la Bwana lilikuwa juu yao wakati wa mchana walipoondoka kambini.
Ekegusii: ne riire riria ri’Omonene nigo riarenge igoro ase bare ekero kia mobaso chingaki chinde chionsi barenge koimoka korwa ase ebitwori kogeenda ase orogeendo.

English: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”
Kiswahili: Wakati wowote Sanduku lilipoondoka, Mose alisema, “Ee Bwana, inuka! Watesi wako na watawanyike; adui zako na wakimbie mbele zako.”
Ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi Esanduki eria yarenge gochaaka kobogorigwa gotang’ana orogeendo, Musa nigo arenge koboora, “Omonene, imoka, ababisa bao tiga baserigwe na goserebanigwa, na baria bakogechete tiga batame korwa ase obosio bwao.”

English: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Wakati wowote Sanduku liliposimama, alisema, “Ee Bwana, rudi, kwa maelfu ya Waisraeli wasiohesabika.”
Ekegusii: Na ekero Esanduki eria yarenge goikigwa aase bagotimokera, Musa nigo arenge goteeba, “Aye Omonene, bairanere Abaisraeli aba bare chilifu ne chilifu.”

English: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
Kiswahili: Basi watu wakalalamika kwa habari ya taabu zao masikioni mwa Bwana, naye alipowasikia, hasira yake ikawaka. Ndipo moto kutoka kwa Bwana ukawaka miongoni mwao na kuteketeza baadhi ya viunga vya kambi.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakerera ase engencho y’emechando yabo. Ekero Omonene aigwete okwereera kwabo akaba n’endamwamu enene, agatoma omorero ogoka ase egati y’ abanto, na omorero oria ogasamba abanto barenge ase chinsinyo chi’ebitwori.

English: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.
Kiswahili: Watu walipomlilia Mose, akamwomba Bwana, nao moto ukazimika.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakarera ase Musa ng’a bakonywe, nere agasaba Omonene, na omorero oria okarimigwa.

English: The name of that place was called Taberah, because Yahweh’s fire burned among them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mahali pale pakaitwa Tabera, kwa sababu moto kutoka kwa Bwana uliwaka miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Aase aria akarokwa Tabera, ekiagera omorero Omonene bwogete ase egati y’ abanto.

English: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
Kiswahili: Umati wa watu wenye zogo waliokuwa miongoni mwao walitamani sana chakula kingine, Waisraeli wakaanza kulia tena na kusema, “Laiti tungekuwa na nyama tule!
Ekegusii: Abanto baria basang’anaine n’Abaisraeli nigo barenge nobotoonu obonene bw’okogania chinyama, na Abaisraeli boigo bakarera bagateeba, “Naki totanyora chinyama torie?

English: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
Kiswahili: Tunakumbuka wale samaki tuliokula huko Misri bila gharama, pia yale matango, matikitimaji, mboga, vitunguu, na vitunguu saumu.
Ekegusii: Twainyoire chinswe twarenge koria ase ense ya Misiri totare goakanera, na endagera ende enga buna emiongo emerandi, na emenyobio, na ebitunguo biare ao ao, ebiororo amo nebiroro.

English: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa tumepoteza hamu ya chakula; hatuoni kitu kingine chochote isipokuwa hii mana!”
Ekegusii: Na bono chinguru chiaito chiatoereire, titobwati endagera ende tokoria otatiga Mana yoka.”

English: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.
Kiswahili: Mana ilifanana kama mbegu za giligilani, nayo ilikuwa na rangi ya manjano iliyopauka.
Ekegusii: Mana nigo yarenge kororekana buna chinyeke chi’amaemba enkomba.

English: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.
Kiswahili: Hao watu walikwenda kukusanya, kisha waliisaga kwa mawe ya kusagia ya mkono au kuitwanga kwenye vinu. Waliipika vyunguni au kutengeneza maandazi. Ladha yake ilikuwa kama kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa mafuta ya zeituni.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo barenge gosoka bayesangereria, naende bayesia ne chingena, gose bayeswaga ase chikonu. Erio baba bakoyeiyekera ase chinyongo na koyeroisia yaba emagaati. Igo yarenge gwansa buna amaandasi aroiseirie amaguta.

English: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
Kiswahili: Umande ulipoanguka kambini wakati wa usiku, pia mana ilianguka pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Mana eyio nigo yarenge kogwa amo ne riime ase ebitwori ekero kia botuko.

English: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and Yahweh’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.
Kiswahili: Mose akasikia watu wa kila jamaa wakilia, kila mmoja kwenye mlango wa hema lake. Bwana akakasirika mno, naye Mose akafadhaika.
Ekegusii: Musa akaigwa abanto bakwereera ase chiamate chiabo, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye. Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase bare; ase ayio Musa akagechigwa.

English: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
Kiswahili: Akamuuliza Bwana, “Kwa nini umeleta taabu hii juu ya mtumishi wako? Nimekufanyia nini cha kukuchukiza hata ukaweka mzigo huu wa watu hawa wote juu yangu?
Ekegusii: Ere akamoteebia Omonene, “Nase ki gwankoreire inche, omosomba oo, obobe obo iga? Naende ’ntanyoreti ogwancherwa ase ore. Nase ki kwang’eire emeremo emenene ase okoraa abanto aba?

English: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?
Kiswahili: Je, watu hawa wote mimi ndiye niliyewatungisha mimba? Je, ni mimi niliyewazaa? Kwa nini unaniambia niwachukue mikononi mwangu, kama vile mlezi abebavyo mtoto mchanga, hadi kwenye nchi uliyowaahidi baba zao?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ninche naiborete abanto aba bonsi? Gose ninche nabatongete? Naki rende ogonteebia ng’a ’mbabogorie na kobarera ase egekuba kiane, buna omoreri akobogoria omwana ekeng’werere okogonka, goika imbaikie ase ense eria kwarierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nobayee?”

English: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
Kiswahili: Nitapata wapi nyama kwa ajili ya watu wote hawa? Wanaendelea kunililia wakisema, ‘Tupe nyama tule!’
Ekegusii: Ng’ai ’nkorusia chinyama ’nkoa abanto aba bonsi? Barabwo nigo bakorera ase ’nde bagoteeba: Toe chinyama torie!

English: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
Kiswahili: Mimi siwezi kuwabeba watu hawa wote peke yangu, mzigo ni mzito sana kwangu.
Ekegusii: Inche bweka tinkonyara koraa abanto aba, egurube eye n’endito mono ase ’nde.

English: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”
Kiswahili: Kama hivi ndivyo unavyonitendea, uniue sasa hivi, yaani kama nimepata kibali machoni pako, wala usiniache nione maangamizi yangu mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Onye aye kogonkorera amang’ana buna ayio, indorere amaabera, ong’ite rimo rioka inkwe ase obosio bwao, erinde timbaisa korora obokong’u obo.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose: “Niletee wazee sabini wa Israeli, unaowafahamu kama viongozi na maafisa miongoni mwa watu. Walete katika Hema la Kukutania, ili waweze kusimama huko pamoja nawe.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Sangereria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etan’ebere, abwo basikire, bamanyekanete bare abatang’ani b’ abanto, obarente agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, batenene aroro amo naye.

English: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.
Kiswahili: Nami nitashuka na kusema nawe huko. Nami nitachukua sehemu ya Roho iliyo juu yako na kuiweka juu yao. Watakusaidia kubeba mzigo wa watu hao ili usije ukaubeba peke yako.
Ekegusii: Inche ning’ike korwa igoro, ’nkwane naye aroro agwo. Naende nimbae barabwo omoika korwa ase omoika oria ore ime yao. Erio barabwo bakore emeremo amo naye, erinde tobaisa kobogoria obokong’u bw’okoraa abanto aba aye bweka.

English: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you meat, and you will eat.
Kiswahili: “Waambie hao watu: ‘Jiwekeni wakfu wenyewe kwa ajili ya kesho, wakati mtakapokula nyama. Bwana aliwasikia mlipolia, mkisema, “Laiti tungekuwa na nyama tule! Tulikuwa na hali nzuri zaidi katika nchi ya Misri!” Sasa Bwana atawapa nyama, nanyi mtaila.
Ekegusii: Kwana n’abanto, obateebie: Echene inwe abanyene ase engencho y’ankio; namonyore chinyama mokoria. Omonene oigure okwereera kwaino na buna mwaboria: Ning’o ogotoa chinyama torie? Ekero twarenge ase ense ya Misiri, nigo twarenge buya. Ase ayio Omonene nache abae chinyama morie.

English: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,
Kiswahili: Hamtaila kwa siku moja tu, au siku mbili, au tano, kumi au siku ishirini,
Ekegusii: Timogochiria ase rituko erimo rioka, gose ase amatuko abere, gose atano, gose ikomi, gose emerongo ebere,

English: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”
Kiswahili: bali kwa mwezi mzima mpaka iwatokee puani, nanyi mtaichukia kabisa, kwa kuwa mmemkataa Bwana, ambaye yupo miongoni mwenu, nanyi mmelia mbele zake, mkisema, “Hivi kwa nini tulitoka Misri?” ’ ”
Ekegusii: korende ’namorie chinyama ase omotienyi omogima goika mochiroke chietere ase chimioro na kobagara‐garia emioyo. Ayio nigo arakoreke, ekiagera mwangire Omonene oria omenyete ase egati yaino, mwarerire ase obosio bwaye na gokwana: Ninki kiagerete tokarua Misiri?”

English: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose alisema, “Mimi niko hapa miongoni mwa watu 600,000 wanaotembea kwa miguu, nawe umesema, ‘Nitawapa nyama ya kula kwa mwezi mzima!’
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Abanto aba nkoraa, nigo bare abarwani chilifu amagana atano nomo bagotaara namagoro, naye bono gwateebire ng’a nobae chinyama barie ase omotienyi omogima.

English: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”
Kiswahili: Je, wangeweza kupata nyama ya kuwatosha hata kama makundi ya kondoo na ya ngʼombe yangechinjwa kwa ajili yao? Je, wangetosheka hata kama samaki wote wa baharini wangevuliwa kwa ajili yao?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Ntonyare konyenya ching’ondi gose chiombe chiisaine abanto aba baegwe barie baigote? Gose ne chinswe chionsi chia nyancha chirasangererigwe, erinde chibaisane?”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamjibu Mose, “Je, mkono wa Bwana ni mfupi sana? Sasa utaona kama jambo nililolisema litatimizwa kwa ajili yako au la.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Inee! Nigo orooche ng’a okoboko kwane nokweng’e? Bono norore gose amang’ana ane naikeranigwe ase ore, gose yaaya.”

English: Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akatoka na kuwaambia watu lile ambalo Bwana alikuwa amesema. Akawakusanya wazee wao sabini, akawasimamisha kuzunguka Hema.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akageenda, agateebia abanto amang’ana onsi Omonene akwanete. Agasangereria abagaaka emerongo etan’ebere, nabwo bagatenena agwo goetanana Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akashuka katika wingu na kunena na Mose, naye akachukua sehemu ya Roho iliyokuwa juu ya Mose na kuiweka juu ya wale wazee sabini. Roho aliposhuka juu yao, wakatoa unabii, lakini hawakufanya hivyo tena.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agaika korwa igoro ore riire ime, agakwana na Musa, na akaa abagaaka baria emerongo etan’ebere korwa ase omoika oria oria orenge ime ase Musa. Ekero omoika oria obete igoro ase bare barabwo bakabana, korende tibagenderera gokora igo naende nonya ndinde.

English: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
Kiswahili: Lakini, watu wawili, ambao majina yao ni Eldadi na Medadi, walibaki kambini. Walikuwa wameorodheshwa miongoni mwa wale wazee sabini, lakini hawakutoka kwenda kwenye Hema. Lakini Roho pia alishuka juu yao, nao wakatabiri huko kambini.
Ekegusii: Bono abanto babere, Elidadi na Medadi, barabwo bagatigara ase egetwori, na omoika ogaacha igoro ase bare. Igo barenge abamo b’abwo bachoretwe, korende tibageenda agwo ase Eema, na barabwo bakabanera agwo ase egetwori.

English: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
Kiswahili: Mwanaume mmoja kijana alikimbia na kumwambia Mose, “Eldadi na Medadi wanatoa unabii kambini.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo omosae akaminyoka ase Musa, akamoteebia, “Elidadi na Medadi ’nkobana bare ase egetwori.”

English: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
Kiswahili: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, ambaye alikuwa msaidizi wa Mose tangu ujana wake, akajibu akasema, “Mose bwana wangu, wanyamazishe!”
Ekegusii: Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, nigo arenge omokoreri o Musa korwa ekero arenge omosae. Ere agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Musa Omonene one, bakanie.”

English: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akajibu, “Je, unaona wivu kwa ajili yangu? Ningetamani watu wote wa Bwana wangekuwa manabii na kwamba Bwana angeweka Roho yake juu yao!”
Ekegusii: Musa akamobooria, “Aye nigo ore neribero ase emeremo y’ane? Ninganetie ng’a Omonene ae abanto bonsi omoika oye, erinde babe ababani.”

English: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose na wale wazee wa Israeli wakarudi kambini.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli bakairana ase egetwori.

English: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.
Kiswahili: Kisha ukatokea upepo kutoka kwa Bwana, nao ukawaletea kware kutoka baharini. Ukawaangusha kwenye eneo lote linalozunguka kambi na kujaa ardhini kimo cha mita moja hivi kutoka ardhini kwenye eneo la umbali wa mwendo wa siku moja kila upande.
Ekegusii: Omonene akarenta omwaga, na omwaga oyio okarenta chinkware korwa ase enyancha, ogachiruta igoro y’ebitwori gochia ase oboare bw’orogeendo rwe rituko erimo goetania ebitwori chigatorerekana, chikaba chinduenyi gocha igoro koreng’ana ekerengo ki’amaboko abere.

English: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.
Kiswahili: Mchana kutwa na usiku kucha pamoja na siku nzima iliyofuata watu walitoka kwenda kuokota kware. Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyekusanya chini ya homeri kumi. Kisha wakazianika kuzunguka kambi yote.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakaimoka, bagasangereria chinkware chiria ase rituko riria rigima, na obotuko bwonsi, naende rituko ria kabere. Oyosangereretie chinke nigo asangereretie chiaisaine goetania ebitonga rigana erimo. Bagachikora emetanda aande onsi ase ebitwori.

English: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, Yahweh’s anger burned against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.
Kiswahili: Lakini walipokuwa wakila nyama, ilipokuwa ingali kati ya meno yao na kabla hawajamaliza kula, hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya watu, naye akawapiga kwa tauni.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto babekire chinyama menwa yabo, na konya batarachimera, Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase bare, akabaita ase okobaaka namaakwa amanene mono.

English: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mahali hapo pakaitwa Kibroth-Hataava, kwa sababu huko ndiko walipowazika watu ambao walitamani sana chakula kingine.
Ekegusii: Aase aaria akarokwa Kibiroti‐Hatawa, ekiagera aroro agwo nao abanto baria barenge abatoonu b’okogania chinyama batindegetwe.

English: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Kibroth-Hataava watu wakasafiri mpaka Haserothi na kukaa huko.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakarua Kibiroti‐Hatawa, bakageenda bagaika Haseroti, bakabeera aroro.

English: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
Kiswahili: Miriamu na Aroni walianza kuzungumza dhidi ya Mose kwa sababu ya mke wake Mkushi, kwa kuwa alikuwa ameoa Mkushi.
Ekegusii: Miriamu na Aroni bagakwana amang’ana arenge mamincha ya Musa, ekiagera Musa konya onyuomire omokungu korwa ase Abaetiopia.

English: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.
Kiswahili: Waliuliza, “Je, Bwana amesema kupitia Mose peke yake? Je, hajasema kutupitia sisi pia?” Naye Bwana akasikia hili.
Ekegusii: Bagakwana, bagateeba, “Inee! Omonene nigo agokwana na Musa bweka? Tari gokwana naintwe?” Omonene akaigwa amang’ana ayio.

English: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
Kiswahili: (Basi Mose alikuwa mtu mnyenyekevu sana, mnyenyekevu kuliko mtu mwingine yeyote katika uso wa dunia.)
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio Musa nigo arenge omoitongo mono kobua abanto bonsi barenge ase ense.

English: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.
Kiswahili: Ghafula Bwana akawaambia Mose, Aroni na Miriamu, “Njooni katika Hema la Kukutania, ninyi nyote watatu.” Kwa hiyo wote watatu wakaenda.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo Omonene agakwana na Musa, na Aroni, na Miriamu, akabateebia, “Nimbaganetie inwe batato mochiche agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Abwo batato bakageenda aroro.

English: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akashuka katika nguzo ya wingu, akasimama kwenye ingilio la Hema, akawaita Aroni na Miriamu. Wakati wote wawili waliposogea mbele,
Ekegusii: Omonene agaika korwa igoro ore ime ase riire riria riare buna esiiro, agatenena agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema eria, akarangeria Aroni na Miriamu. Barabwo bagasuka gochia bosio,

English: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Sikilizeni maneno yangu: “Akiwapo nabii wa Bwana miongoni mwenu, nitajifunua kwake kwa maono, nitanena naye katika ndoto.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akabateebia, “Igwa amang’ana ane: Onye omobani ore ase egati yaino, inche Omonene nigo ’nkwemanyekania ase are ase okorora, naende nakwana nere ase chindoto.

English: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.
Kiswahili: Lakini sivyo kwa mtumishi wangu Mose; yeye ni mwaminifu katika nyumba yangu yote.
Ekegusii: Korende ase Musa, omosomba one, taibo, ere nomwegenwa ase enyomba yane yonsi.

English: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
Kiswahili: Kwake nitanena naye uso kwa uso, waziwazi wala si kwa mafumbo; yeye ataona umbo la Bwana. Kwa nini basi ninyi hamkuogopa kuzungumza kinyume cha mtumishi wangu Mose?”
Ekegusii: Nigo ’ngokwana nere obosio ase obosio, gose tindi gokwana nere ase emerabaaro; ere ororire ekieni kiane. Nase ki inwe motabeete n’obwoba gokwana mamincha ya Musa, omosomba one?”

English: Yahweh’s anger burned against them; and he departed.
Kiswahili: Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi yao, akawaacha.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu y’Omonene ekaba enene ase bare, akarua aroro agwo, akageenda.

English: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
Kiswahili: Wakati hilo wingu liliinuka kutoka juu ya Hema, Miriamu akawa tayari ana ukoma, mweupe kama theluji. Aroni akamgeukia, akaona ana ukoma.
Ekegusii: Ekero riire riria riaruete ase Eema eria, omobere o Miriamu konya obeire noborwaire bwa ukoma, okaraba se. Aroni akaonchoka komorigereria, akarora ng’a omobere oye obeire noborwaire bwa ukoma.

English: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
Kiswahili: Kisha Aroni akamwambia Mose, “Tafadhali, bwana wangu, usituhesabie dhambi hii ambayo tumeifanya kwa upumbavu.
Ekegusii: Erio Aroni agateebia Musa, “Aye omonene one, koranche, tobaisa gotoa egesusuro, ekiagera intwe nigo twakorire egento ki’oboriri, na twakorire ebibe.

English: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
Kiswahili: Usimwache awe kama mtoto mchanga aliyezaliwa akiwa mfu, ambaye nusu ya mwili wake imeharibika hapo atokapo katika tumbo la mama yake.”
Ekegusii: Totiga Miriamu abe buna oyokuure, buna omonto oiboretwe ne chinyama ekeng’ese, chianiarokeire inda, chiaerire.”

English: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mose akamlilia Bwana akisema, “Ee Mungu, nakuomba umponye!”
Ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, “Aye Nyasae, nagosoroire, koranche ogwenie Miriamu!”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamjibu Mose, “Je, kama baba yake angemtemea usoni, asingeona aibu kwa siku saba? Mfungie nje ya kambi kwa siku saba; baada ya hapo anaweza kurudishwa kambini.”
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Onye rende ise arenge komotwera amate ase obosio bwaye, Inee, tagwenerete anyore obosooku ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere? Tiga aatananwe korwa ase egetwori abekwe ase aao ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere, na magega y’ayio airanigwe ase egetwori.”

English: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Miriamu akafungiwa nje ya kambi kwa siku saba, nao watu hawakuendelea na safari mpaka aliporudishwa kambini.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Miriamu agasokigwa isiko y’egetwori, akabeekwa ase aao ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere, na abanto tibaimogete kogeenda goika ekero Miriamu airanete ase egetwori.

English: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo, watu waliondoka Haserothi, wakapiga kambi katika Jangwa la Parani.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio abanto bakaimoka kogeenda korwa ase Haseroti, bagaika ase erooro ya Parani, bagatoora aroro.

English: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
Kiswahili: “Watume baadhi ya watu wakaipeleleze nchi ya Kanaani, ambayo ninawapa Waisraeli. Kutoka kwa kila kabila la baba zao, tuma mmoja wa viongozi wao.”
Ekegusii: “Chora omotang’ani oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku ase ebisaku bionsi ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli, erio obatome bagende koroota ense ya Kaanani, ense eria ’ngochia koa Abaisraeli.”

English: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kwa agizo la Bwana Mose akawatuma kutoka Jangwa la Parani. Wote walikuwa viongozi wa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa ase erooro ya Parani, buna Omonene amochiigete. Abanto abwo bonsi nigo barenge abatang’ani ase Abaisraeli.

English: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina yao: kutoka kabila la Reubeni, Shamua mwana wa Zakuri;
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta abo: Korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni, Samua, mosinto o Sakuri;

English: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Simeoni, Shafati mwana wa Hori;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Simioni, Safati, mosinto o Hora;

English: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Yuda, Kalebu mwana wa Yefune;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune;

English: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Isakari, Igali mwana wa Yosefu;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Igali, mosinto o Yusufu;

English: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Efraimu, Hoshea mwana wa Nuni;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Efraimu, Hosea, mosinto o Nuni;

English: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Benyamini, Palti mwana wa Rafu;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Benjamini, Paliti, mosinto o Rafu;

English: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Zabuloni, Gadieli mwana wa Sodi,
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Gadieli, mosinto o Sodi;

English: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Manase (kabila la Yosefu), Gadi mwana wa Susi;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Yusufu (nakio ekia Manase), Gadi, mosinto o Susi;

English: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Dani, Amieli mwana wa Gemali;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Dani, Amieli, mosinto o Gemali;

English: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Asheri, Sethuri mwana wa Mikaeli;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Seturi, mosinto o Mikaeli;

English: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Naftali, Nabi mwana wa Wofsi;
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Nabi, mosinto o Bofasi;

English: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Gadi, Geueli mwana wa Maki.
Ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi, Geueli, mosinto o Maki.

English: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya watu ambao Mose aliwatuma kuipeleleza nchi. (Mose akampa Hoshea mwana wa Nuni jina Yoshua.)
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’ abanto baria Musa atomete gochia koroota ense eria. Musa akaroka Hosea, mosinto o Nuni, Yoshua.

English: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
Kiswahili: Mose alipowatuma wakaipeleleze Kanaani, alisema, “Pandeni kupitia Negebu, mwende mpaka nchi ya vilima.
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa are kobatoma gochia koroota ense ya Kaanani, akabateebia, “Genda motiire gochia Negebu, ensemo ya Irianyi y’ense eria, naende motiire gochia igoro ase ense y’ebitunwa.

English: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
Kiswahili: Mwone nchi ni ya namna gani, na kama watu waishio humo wana nguvu au ni wadhaifu, iwapo ni wachache au wengi.
Ekegusii: Morigererie buna ense eria ere, naende morore gose abanto bareo ’mbare ne chinguru, gose naboro bare, gose nabake, gose nabange.

English: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
Kiswahili: Wanaishi katika nchi ya namna gani? Je, ni nzuri au mbaya? Wanaishi katika miji ya namna gani? Je, haina kuta au ngome?
Ekegusii: Naende morore gose ense eria abanto bamenyete nengiya gose nembe, naende morore emechie yabo ase bamenyete, onye nigo ere ebitwori gose nigo egiteire chindwaki.

English: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
Kiswahili: Ardhi iko aje? Ina rutuba au la? Je, kuna miti ndani yake au la? Jitahidini kadiri mwezavyo kuleta baadhi ya matunda ya nchi.” (Ulikuwa msimu wa kuiva zabibu za kwanza.)
Ekegusii: Morigererie gose riroba ndire nobotobu gose neritaka, naende gose emete nereo, gose teiyo. Mobe abaremu, morentane okwama kw’amatunda gw’ense eria.” (Engaki eria nigo yarenge ekero emesabibu konya yamire ase ogotongorwa.)

English: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakapanda na kuipeleleza nchi kutoka Jangwa la Sini hadi Rehobu, kuelekea Lebo-Hamathi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakageenda bakaroota ense eria, bagachaakera korwa ase erooro ya Sini bagaika Rehobu ase enchera ekogeenda Hamati.

English: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
Kiswahili: Wakapanda kupitia Negebu hadi wakafika Hebroni, mahali ambapo Ahimani, Sheshai na Talmai, wazao wa Anaki, waliishi. (Hebroni ulikuwa umejengwa miaka saba kabla ya mji wa Soani ulioko Misri.)
Ekegusii: Bagatiira, bakageenda ritang’ani ase ensemo ya Irianyi y’ense eria, na bagaika Heburoni, agwo ase Ahimani, na Sesai, na Talimai, abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki, bamenyete. (Heburoni konya oagachirwe emiaka etan’ebere ritang’ani omochie o Soani o Misiri otaraagachwa.)

English: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
Kiswahili: Walipofika katika Bonde la Eshkoli, walivunja tawi lililokuwa na kishada kimoja cha zabibu. Wawili wao wakalichukua lile tawi kwenye mti, pamoja na komamanga na tini.
Ekegusii: Bagaika ase rikura ri’Esikoli, na aroro bakabutora orosagia rw’emesabibu rwabwate egesago ekenene mono, bagasomeka omwaro ase orosagia roria, na abanto babere bakarwambana. Naende bagatwa amakomomanga na amako.

English: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
Kiswahili: Eneo lile likaitwa Bonde la Eshkoli kwa sababu ya kile kishada cha zabibu ambacho Waisraeli walikikata huko.
Ekegusii: Aase aria akarokwa Rikura ri’Esikoli ase engencho y’orosagia roria Abaisraeli babutorete korwa aroro.

English: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
Kiswahili: Mwishoni mwa siku arobaini wakarudi kutoka kuipeleleza nchi.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko emerongo ene aerire, abanto baria chirooti bakairana korwa ase okoroota ense eria.

English: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
Kiswahili: Wakarudi kwa Mose, Aroni na jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli huko Kadeshi kwenye Jangwa la Parani. Hapo ndipo walipotoa habari kwao na kwa kusanyiko lote na kuwaonyesha matunda ya hiyo nchi.
Ekegusii: Bakairana gochia ase Musa na Aroni, na ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli agwo Kadeshi ase erooro ya Parani, bakabateebia amang’ana onsi, na bakaborokia okwama gw’ense eria.

English: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
Kiswahili: Wakampa Mose taarifa hii: “Tuliingia katika nchi uliyotutuma, nayo inatiririka maziwa na asali! Hili hapa tunda lake.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebia Musa, “Ntwageenda ase ense eria gwatotomete, ’ntwayenyora ng’a nentenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke, rora okwama gw’ense eria.

English: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wanaoishi huko ni wenye nguvu, na miji yao ina ngome na ni mikubwa sana. Huko tuliona hata wazao wa Anaki.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, abanto bamenyeteo nigo bare ne chinguru, na emechie yabo nemenene mono, naende egiteire bokong’u ne chindwaki. Tari ayio oka, korende boigo ’ntwarora abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki bare aroro.

English: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
Kiswahili: Waamaleki wanaishi Negebu; Wahiti, Wayebusi na Waamori wanaishi katika nchi ya vilima; nao Wakanaani wanaishi karibu na bahari na kando ya Yordani.”
Ekegusii: Abaameleki nigo bamenyete ase ense ya Negebu, ensemo ya Irianyi y’ense eria; Abahiti, na Abayebusi, na Abaamori, nigo bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa. Abakaanani barabwo nigo bamenyete ase enyancha enene mbarabare, ang’e norooche rwa Yorodani.”

English: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”
Kiswahili: Kisha Kalebu akawanyamazisha watu mbele ya Mose na kusema, “Imetupasa kupanda na kuimiliki nchi, kwa maana hakika tunaweza kufanya hivyo.”
Ekegusii: Korende Kalebu agakiria abanto tibaabaisa koamereria Musa, agateeba, “Tiga togende bwango, erinde toire ense eria, ekiagera intwe ’ntonyare kobua ense eria.”

English: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”
Kiswahili: Lakini watu waliokuwa wamepanda pamoja naye wakasema, “Hatuwezi kuwashambulia wale watu; wana nguvu kutuliko sisi.”
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bagendete amo nere bagateeba, “Intwe titokonyara korwania abanto baria tobabue; nigo bare ne chinguru gotobua.”

English: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.
Kiswahili: Wakaeneza taarifa mbaya miongoni mwa Waisraeli kuhusu nchi waliyoipeleleza. Wakasema, “Nchi tuliyoipeleleza hula watu waishio ndani yake. Watu wote tuliowaona huko ni majitu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakarentera Abaisraeli amang’ana amabe igoro y’ense eria bagendete koroota, bagateeba, “Ense eria twataara ime yaye koyeroota, nigo ere ense egoita abanto bamenyeteo. Abanto bonsi twarora nabatambe mono.

English: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
Kiswahili: Tuliwaona Wanefili huko (wazao wa Anaki wanatokana na Wanefili.) Tulijiona kama panzi machoni petu wenyewe, nao ndivyo walivyotuona.”
Ekegusii: Ee, ’ntwarora amamonto, abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki. Intwe nigo twerora ng’a n’ebimonto ebisinini mono, tore omogwekano bw’ebisase. Naboigo twarorekana ase bare.”

English: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule watu wote wa jumuiya walipaza sauti zao na kulia kwa sauti kuu.
Ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto bagaaka eriogi rinene, bakaba bakorera ase obotuko boria.

English: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wote wakanungʼunika dhidi ya Mose na Aroni, nalo kusanyiko lote wakawaambia, “Laiti tungekuwa tumefia humo nchi ya Misri! Au humu kwenye hili jangwa!
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bakwomania Musa na Aroni; bonsi bagakwana “Nigo anga yaba buya onye ’ntwakwerete Misiri, gose ase erooro eye.

English: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini Bwana anatuleta katika nchi hii ili tufe kwa upanga? Wake zetu na watoto wetu watachukuliwa kama nyara. Je, isingekuwa bora kwetu kurudi Misri?”
Ekegusii: Ninki gekogera Omonene agotoira ase ense eria tochie goitwa ase esegi? Abakungu baito, na abana baito, nigo bagochia gwoswa n’ababisa baito. Naki yare koba buya onye ’ntwairana gochia Misiri.”

English: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Inatupasa kumchagua kiongozi na kurudi Misri.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania, “Tochore omonto oyomo abe omoraai oito, toirane Misiri.”

English: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakaanguka kifudifudi mbele ya kusanyiko lote la Kiisraeli lililokusanyika hapo.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama ase obosio bw’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli osangererekanete.

English: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
Kiswahili: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, waliokuwa miongoni mwa watu wale waliokwenda kuipeleleza nchi, wakararua nguo zao,
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, abwo barenge amo ne chirooti chiria chiarootete ense eria, bagatandora chianga chiabo,

English: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
Kiswahili: wakasema na kusanyiko lote la Kiisraeli, wakawaambia, “Nchi tuliyopita katikati yake na kuipeleleza ni nzuri sana sana.
Ekegusii: bagateebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, “Ense eria twataarete ase okoyeroota nigo ere ense engiya mono.

English: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Bwana anapendezwa nasi, atatuongoza kuingia katika nchi ile, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, naye atatupa nchi hiyo.
Ekegusii: Onye Omonene okogokigwa naintwe, na gotoyea toyeire, ense eria n’entenenku ere namabeere naamooke.

English: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”
Kiswahili: Ila tu msimwasi Bwana. Wala msiwaogope watu wa nchi hiyo, kwa sababu tutawameza. Ulinzi wao umeondoka, lakini Bwana yupo pamoja nasi. Msiwaogope.”
Ekegusii: Timobaisa kwanga komoigwera Omonene, na timobaisa koboboa ababiare b’ense eria; abwo nigo barabe buna endagera enyororo ase tore. Baurirwe okorendwa kwabo; Omonene nigo are amo naintwe; timobairoka.”

English: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini kusanyiko lote likazungumza juu ya kuwapiga kwa mawe. Ndipo utukufu wa Bwana ukaonekana katika Hema la Kukutania kwa Waisraeli wote.
Ekegusii: Korende omoganda bwonsi ogaaka eriogi, ogateeba ng’a baitwe n’amagena. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaoroka mosiabanoagwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ase Abaisraeli bonsi.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Watu hawa watanidharau mpaka lini? Wataendelea kukataa kuniamini mimi mpaka lini, ingawa nimetenda ishara za miujiza miongoni mwao?
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ngoika ririri abanto aba barabe bagonchaaya? Na ngoika ririri barabe batari konyegena, nonya nakorire ebikone ebinge ase egati yabo?

English: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
Kiswahili: Nitawapiga kwa tauni na kuwaangamiza, lakini nitakufanya wewe kuwa taifa kubwa lenye nguvu kuliko wao.”
Ekegusii: Nkobaaka inde noborwaire bogoita erinde imbasirie, na aye ’ngokore obe egesaku ekenene, naende kere nokobua goetania abanto aba.”

English: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Ndipo Wamisri watasikia juu ya jambo hili! Kwa uweza wako uliwapandisha watu hawa kutoka miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwarusetie abanto aba korwa ase ense ya Misiri ne chinguru chinene. Ekero Abamisiri bonsi baraigwe aya gwakorire ase abanto aba,

English: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
Kiswahili: Nao watawaambia wenyeji wa nchi hii jambo hili. Wao tayari wameshasikia kwamba wewe, Ee Bwana, upo pamoja na watu hawa, na kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umeonekana uso kwa uso, nalo wingu lako hukaa juu yao. Tena wewe unawatangulia kwa nguzo ya wingu mchana na kwa nguzo ya moto usiku.
Ekegusii: barabwo ’mbatebie abanto b’ense eye amang’ana ayio. Barabwo konya baigure ng’a aye Omonene nigo ore ase egati y’Abaisraeli, kwarorekanire ase bare obosio ase obosio, ne riire riao nigo riteneine ase bare, naende naye okobatang’ana, omobaso ase riire rire buna esiiro, na obotuko ase omorero ore buna esiiro.

English: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa utawaua watu hawa wote mara moja, mataifa ambayo yamesikia taarifa hii kukuhusu wewe watasema,
Ekegusii: Bono onye aye kogoita abanto aba bonsi amo, erio abanto b’ebisaku abaraigwe chinkuma chiao ’mbateebe:

English: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’
Kiswahili: ‘Bwana alishindwa kuwaingiza watu hawa katika nchi aliyowaahidi kwa kiapo; hivyo akawaua jangwani.’
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo asinyetwe koira abanto aba ase ense eria konya arire eira akobaa; ase ayio obaiteire ase erooro.

English: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
Kiswahili: “Basi sasa nguvu za Bwana na zionekane, sawasawa na vile ulivyosema:
Ekegusii: Bono nagosabire, tiga okobua kwao, aye Omonene, kobe okonene buna aye kwarire eira, kogokwana:

English: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
Kiswahili: ‘Bwana si mwepesi wa hasira, ni mwingi wa upendo na mwenye kusamehe dhambi na uasi. Lakini haachi kumwadhibu mwenye hatia, huadhibu watoto kwa ajili ya dhambi ya baba zao hata kizazi cha tatu na cha nne.’
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene tindi omwango bw’okoba n’endamwamu, nigo inde omonyene amaabera, naende nigo inde n’obwanchani botari koera. Nigo ’nkwabera amamocho na ogosaria, korende tingotiga koa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato, na egia kane, ase engencho y’amabe y’abaibori baabo.

English: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kadiri ya upendo wako mkuu, usamehe dhambi ya watu hawa, kama vile ulivyowasamehe tangu wakati walitoka Misri mpaka sasa.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo nagosabire, bwabere ebibe bi’abaanto aba koreng’ana nobonene bw’obwanchani bwao botari koera, koreng’ana buna aye kwabaaberete korwa ekero barenge Misiri goika reero iga.”

English: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word;
Kiswahili: Bwana akajibu, “Nimewasamehe kama ulivyoomba.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba, “Nabaabeire koreng’ana buna gwansabire.

English: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory—
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kwa hakika kama niishivyo, na kwa hakika kama utukufu wa Bwana uijazavyo dunia yote,
Ekegusii: Korende ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, naende buna ense yonsi eraichorwe nobonene bwane,

English: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;
Kiswahili: hakuna hata mmoja wa watu hawa ambao waliuona utukufu wangu na ishara za miujiza niliyotenda huko Misri na huko jangwani, lakini ambaye hakunitii na akanijaribu mara hizi kumi,
Ekegusii: onde tari ase abanto aba orasoe ense eria. Aba barorire obonene bwane na ebikone biria nakorete aaria Misiri, na ase erooro eye, korende nonya naboigo babeire bagonteema ase chingaki echi chionsi, nonya ng’ara ikomi, bangire konyigwera.

English: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.
Kiswahili: hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeona nchi niliyowaahidi baba zao kwa kiapo. Hakuna hata mmoja ambaye amenidharau atakayeiona.
Ekegusii: Ase barabwo onde tari nonya noyomo, oranyare korora ense eria narierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nimbayee. Onde tari ase abwo banchaayete oranyare koyerora.

English: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu mtumishi wangu Kalebu ana roho ya tofauti na ananifuata kwa moyo wote, nitamwingiza katika nchi aliyoiendea, nao wazao wake watairithi.
Ekegusii: Korende Kalebu, omosomba one, ekiagera abwate omoika ore nogwatananekana korwa ase oyo bwa baria bande, naende obeire okonyigwera buya ase amang’ana onsi, nimoire ase ense eria agendete koroota naende ning’ee abanto b’ororeria rw’aye ense eria ebe eyabo.

English: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Waamaleki na Wakanaani wanaishi katika mabonde, kesho geukeni mwelekee jangwani kwa kufuata njia iendayo Bahari ya Shamu.”
Ekegusii: Na bono ekiagera Abaameleki na Abakaanani bamenyete ime ase amakura, inwe ankio moonchoke, mochake koirana gochia ase enchera ekogeenda ase omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni:
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,

English: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.
Kiswahili: “Jumuiya hii ovu itanungʼunika dhidi yangu hadi lini? Nimesikia malalamiko ya hawa Waisraeli wanaonungʼunika.
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri omoganda oyo omobe oremurunganie ase ’nde? Naigure Abaisraeli banyemurunganeirie.

English: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
Kiswahili: Hivyo waambie, ‘Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana, nitawafanyia vitu vilevile nilivyosikia mkisema:
Ekegusii: Obateebie ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Buna inche inde moyo, naigure amang’ana ayio mwakwanire, ayio naro ndabakorere.

English: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja wenu mwenye umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi ambaye alihesabiwa na amenungʼunika dhidi yangu, miili yenu itaanguka katika jangwa hili.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera mwemurunganirie ase ’nde, inwe mwensi abamwabarirwe na korikwa, abamwakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, nigo morakwe, na emebere yaino ekwete ebeere aiga ase erooro.

English: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayeingia katika nchi niliyoapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kuwa makao yenu, isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.
Ekegusii: Ase ense eria nabarierete eira na gotiana ng’a nimbayee, onde tari ase more orachie komenyao, otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.

English: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.
Kiswahili: Lakini watoto wenu ambao mlisema watachukuliwa kama mateka, nitawaingiza humo ili waifurahie nchi ambayo ninyi mmeikataa.
Ekegusii: Korende abana baino, abwo mwateebete ng’a nabooswe, aba nabwo ndaire aroro, na barabwo mbamenye ase ense eria inwe mwangire.

English: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi, miili yenu itaanguka katika jangwa hili.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe nigo morakwere aiga ase erooro, na emebere yaino esirere aiga.

English: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Watoto wenu watakuwa wachungaji wa mifugo hapa kwa miaka arobaini, wakiteseka kwa ajili ya kukosa uaminifu kwenu, hadi mwili wa mtu wenu wa mwisho ulale katika jangwa hili.
Ekegusii: Abana baino nababe abarisia ase erooro eye ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nabarabwo nabachandeke, ekiagera inwe motabeete abegenwa ase ’nde, mbabe bagochandeka goika omonto bw’omoerio bw’ekegori kiaino akwe, na omobere oye osirere ase erooro eye.

English: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka arobaini, mwaka mmoja kwa kila siku katika zile siku arobaini mlizoipeleleza nchi, mtateseka kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu, na kujua jinsi ilivyo vibaya kunifanya mimi kuwa adui yenu.’
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo morachandeke ase emiaka emerongo ene, omwaka oyomo ase kera rituko mwarenge koroota ense eria, nainwe namonyare komanya ng’a inki gekoba ekero nkoba mamincha yaino.

English: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”
Kiswahili: Mimi Bwana nimesema, na hakika nitafanya mambo haya kwa jumuiya hii yote ovu, ambayo imefungamana pamoja dhidi yangu. Watakutana na mwisho wao katika jangwa hili; hapa ndipo watafia.”
Ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nakwanire. Ekeene ninkore egento eke ase omoganda oyo omobe osangererekanire amo, na obeire mamincha y’ane. Aiga ase erooro ninsirie abanto aba, aa ase erooro nao barakwere.”

English: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,
Kiswahili: Hivyo watu wale ambao Mose alikuwa amewatuma kuipeleleza nchi, waliorudi na kuifanya jumuiya nzima kunungʼunika dhidi ya Mose kwa kueneza taarifa mbaya kuhusu hiyo nchi:
Ekegusii: Abanto baria Musa atomete gochia koroota ense eria barentete amang’ana amabe igoro y’ense eria, bakagera omoganda bwonsi okemurungania ase Omonene.

English: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: watu hawa waliohusika kueneza taarifa mbaya kuhusu hiyo nchi walipigwa na kuanguka kwa tauni mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akabaaka noborwaire bogoita, na barabwo bagakwera agwo ase obosio bwaye.

English: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa watu waliokwenda kuipeleleza hiyo nchi, ni Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na Kalebu mwana wa Yefune peke yao waliosalia.
Ekegusii: Korende Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, barabwo boka bagatigwa bare moyo korwa ase abanto baria bagendete koroota ense eria.

English: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
Kiswahili: Mose alipotoa taarifa hii kwa Waisraeli wote, waliomboleza kwa uchungu.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi Omonene akwanete, na abanto bakarera mono nobororo.

English: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised; for we have sinned.”
Kiswahili: Mapema asubuhi siku iliyofuata walipanda juu kuelekea kwenye nchi ya vilima virefu, wakasema, “Tumetenda dhambi. Tutakwea mpaka mahali Bwana alipotuahidi.”
Ekegusii: Ase emambia ye rituko ria kabere bakaimoka, bagatiira gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa, bagakwana, “Rora twachire, nao tore aa, bono twanchire kogeenda ase ense eri’Omonene atoteebetie. Intwe twakorire ebibe.”

English: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose akasema, “Kwa nini hamtii amri ya Bwana? Jambo hili halitafanikiwa!
Ekegusii: Korende Musa akabateebia, “Nase ki bono mogosaria ogochika kw’Omonene. Timokonyara konyora ogosesenigwa ase okogeendao.

English: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.
Kiswahili: Msipande juu, kwa kuwa Bwana hayupo pamoja nanyi. Mtashindwa na adui zenu,
Ekegusii: Timobaisa kogeenda; moise gokora igo, rirorio nigo mogochia goitwa n’ababisa baino, ekiagera Omonene tari amo nainwe.

English: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following Yahweh; therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Waamaleki na Wakanaani watapambana nanyi huko. Kwa sababu mmemwacha Bwana, hatakuwa pamoja nanyi, ninyi mtaanguka kwa upanga.”
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo bosio bwaino Abaameleki na Abakaanani mbareo. Nigo bagochia kobarwania baababue na kobakenya, ekiagera inwe mwaonchokire, mwangire komoigwera Omonene; nere takonyara koba amo nainwe.”

English: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kwa kiburi chao walipanda juu kuelekea nchi ya vilima virefu, ijapokuwa Mose hakutoka kambini wala Sanduku la Agano la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende bagekora abaremu, bagatiira gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa, nonya Esanduki eria yare ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene yatigarete ase egetwori, na Musa nao atigarete.

English: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Waamaleki na Wakanaani walioishi katika hiyo nchi ya vilima wakateremka na kuwashambulia, wakawapiga njia yote hadi Horma.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaameleki na Abakaanani abamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, bagatirimboka bakarwania Abaisraeli abwo, bakababua na kobaseria, bakababwatia goika Horima.

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Baada ya ninyi kuingia katika nchi ninayowapa kama nyumbani,
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie buna barachie gokora ekero baraike ase ense eria ’ngochia kobaa.

English: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock—
Kiswahili: nanyi mkitoa sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto, kutoka makundi ya ngʼombe au kondoo, kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana, ikiwa ni sadaka za kuteketezwa au dhabihu, kwa ajili ya nadhiri maalum ama sadaka ya hiari au sadaka ya sikukuu zenu,
Ekegusii: Bateebie: ’Monyare komoruera Omonene eng’iti korwa ase chiombe, gose korwa ase riicho rie ching’ondi, gose chimbori, chibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi ase ogoikerania eira mwariete, gose eki’ogwancha kwaino, gose ase chingaki chichiikire ase Amatuko aino Amanene, kebe ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.

English: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.
Kiswahili: ndipo yeye aletaye sadaka yake ataiweka mbele za Bwana sadaka ya nafaka, sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa na robo ya hini ya mafuta.
Ekegusii: Oyokorua ebing’wanso buna ebio ase Omonene, goika arue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke ebimunu bibere bwochoganirie n’amaguta egetuba ekemo,

English: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa au dhabihu, andaa robo ya hini ya divai kwa sadaka ya kinywaji.
Ekegusii: n’edivai egetuba ekemo kebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa, amo na kera emanwa y’eng’ondi; onye nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi.

English: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Pamoja na kondoo dume andaa sadaka ya nafaka ya sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na theluthi moja ya hini ya mafuta,
Ekegusii: Ekero okorua emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso, orente amo nero obosie obonuke ebimunu bine, bwochoganirie n’amaguta egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera.

English: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: na theluthi moja ya hini ya divai kama sadaka ya kinywaji. Vitoe kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa morue edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese ebe rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.

English: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Unapoandaa fahali mchanga kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa au dhabihu, kwa ajili ya nadhiri maalum au sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana,
Ekegusii: Ekero okorua eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi, onye nase ogoikerania eira kwariete, gose ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase Omonene,

English: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
Kiswahili: leta pamoja na huyo fahali sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini sehemu tatu za kumi za efa uliochanganywa na nusu ya hini ya mafuta.
Ekegusii: orue amo n’eeri eria obosie obonuke ebimunu bitan’omo, bwochoganirie n’amaguta ebituba bibere,

English: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Pia utaleta nusu ya hini ya divai kama sadaka ya kinywaji. Itakuwa sadaka iliyoteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: na orue edivai ebituba bibere ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa. Okwo n’okoruegwa kogosambwa n’omorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.

English: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.
Kiswahili: Kila fahali au kondoo dume, kila mwana-kondoo au mbuzi mchanga, atatayarishwa kwa njia hii.
Ekegusii: “Ebinto ebi nabio biraruegwe amo na kera eeri, gose emingichi, gose kera emanwa y’eng’ondi gose ey’embori.

English: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.
Kiswahili: Fanyeni hivi kwa ajili ya kila mmoja, kwa kadiri ya wingi wa mtakavyoandaa.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omobaro bwe ching’iti echio chiraruegwe chibe ebing’wanso oraabe, n’okoruegwa kw’endagera naboigo koraabe.

English: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kila mmoja ambaye ni mzawa ni lazima afanye vitu hivi kwa njia hii hapo aletapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi ababiare nabwo barabwatie omooroberio oyio, ekero bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kobe risimu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.

English: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, as you do, so he shall do.
Kiswahili: Kwa vizazi vijavyo, wakati wowote mgeni au mtu mwingine yeyote anayeishi miongoni mwenu aletapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa kuwa harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana, ni lazima afanye sawasawa kabisa na jinsi mnavyofanya ninyi.
Ekegusii: Onye omogeni ore amo nainwe, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, nere oganetie korenta okoruegwa kwaye kogosambwa n’omorero, kobe rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene, nigo arabwatie omooroberio oria oria obekirwe ase more.

English: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya itakuwa na sheria hizo hizo kwenu na kwa mgeni aishiye miongoni mwenu; hii ni amri ya kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo. Ninyi na mgeni mtakuwa sawa mbele za Bwana:
Ekegusii: Ase omosangererekano oyio ogochika nokomo koraabe ase more na ase omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino. Okwo nakobe ogochika koragenderere botambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare. Buna inwe more, naboigo nomomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino arabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”
Kiswahili: Sheria hizo hizo na masharti hayo hayo hayo, yatawahusu ninyi na mgeni aishiye miongoni mwenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ogochika nokomo, na omooroberio noyomo, ase more na ase omomenyi omenyete amo nainwe.”

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli na uwaambie: ‘Mtakapoingia katika nchi ninayowapeleka
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moraike ase ense eria ase ’ngochia kobaira,

English: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: nanyi mkala chakula cha nchi hiyo, toeni sehemu ya chakula hicho kama sadaka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: na mokoria endagera y’ense eria, morente okoruegwa kogosungusigwa ase Omonene.

English: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.
Kiswahili: Toeni andazi kutoka kwa malimbuko ya chakula chenu kitokacho katika ardhi, na mkitoe kama sadaka kutoka sakafu ya kupuria nafaka.
Ekegusii: Ekero moraroisie omogati korwa ase obosie bw’ogotongora kw’endagera, namoyorente ase Omonene obe okoruegwa kw’ogotongora buna mokomoruera endagera korwa ase ekeooreri kiaino.

English: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.
Kiswahili: Kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo hamna budi kutoa sadaka hii kwa Bwana kutoka kwa malimbuko ya unga wenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ebiaare biaino bionsi morentere Omonene okoruegwa korwa ase obosie bw’ogotongora kwaino.

English: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which Yahweh has spoken to Moses—
Kiswahili: “ ‘Basi kama pasipo kukusudia umeshindwa kushika mojawapo katika amri hizi ambazo Bwana alimpa Mose,
Ekegusii: “Korende nenyare koba ng’a mwamochire kobwatia amachiiko ande onsi Omonene achiikire Musa,

English: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—
Kiswahili: amri yoyote ya Bwana kwenu kupitia Mose, tangu siku ile Bwana alipowapa na inaendelea hadi vizazi vyote vijavyo;
Ekegusii: gose abanto baino tibarakora onsi ay’Omonene achiikire goetera ase Musa, gochaakera rituko riri’Omonene aruete amachiiko, na kogenderera ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.
Kiswahili: ikiwa hili limefanyika pasipo kukusudia bila jumuiya kuwa na habari nalo, basi jumuiya yote itatoa fahali mchanga kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa ikiwa harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka na ya kinywaji zilizoamriwa kwayo, na mbuzi dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.
