Ekegusii: Onye okomocha okwo gwakorirwe ase ogotancha, na ase ogotamanya kw’omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto, rirorio barue eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Amo nekio barente okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa, koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire, amo negoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

English: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli, nao watasamehewa, kwa kuwa haikuwa makusudi nao wamemletea Bwana sadaka iliyoteketezwa kwa moto na sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya kosa lao.
Ekegusii: Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, na barabwo ’mbaaberwe, ekiagera okomocha okwo nigo gwakoretwe mosiabano ase ogotancha. Barabwo barentire okoruegwa kwabo, ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, naboigo barentire ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’ebibe ase Omonene ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo gwakoretwe mosiabano ase ogotancha.

English: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli pamoja na wageni waishio miongoni mwao watasamehewa, kwa sababu watu wote walihusika katika kosa lile lisilokusudiwa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli amo nomomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, bonsi ’nabaaberwe, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo baabareretwe okomocha koria gwakoretwe mosiabano ase ogotancha.

English: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama mtu mmoja peke yake akitenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia, ni lazima alete mbuzi mke wa mwaka mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto oyomo ogokora ebibe mosiabano atancheti, arue emanwa esubeni yakoorire omwaka oyomo, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

English: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atafanya upatanisho mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya yule aliyekosa kwa kufanya dhambi pasipo kukusudia, upatanisho utakapofanywa kwa ajili yake, atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene ase omonto oria okorire ebibe atancheti, na omonto oria naaberwe.

English: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.
Kiswahili: Sheria hiyo moja itamhusu kila mmoja ambaye ametenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia, awe Mwisraeli mzawa ama mgeni.
Ekegusii: Nigo moraabe n’ogochika okomo ase oyio okorire ebibe mosiabano, atancheti, karabe omobiare bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino.

English: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini yeyote ambaye amefanya dhambi kwa dharau awe mzawa au mgeni, anamkufuru Bwana, naye mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.
Ekegusii: “Korende omonto orakore gento kende gionsi moeneno, karabe omobiare bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, oyio igo oramire Omonene, ere oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

English: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu amelidharau neno la Bwana na kuvunja amri zake, mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali; hatia yake inabaki juu yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Oyio ochaayire ring’ana ri’Omonene, naende osaririe ogochika kwaye, takororerwa amaabera. Goika aatananwe kegima, nere abarerwe ebibe biaye.”

English: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walipokuwa jangwani, mtu mmoja alikutwa akikusanya kuni siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bagendererete koba ase erooro, omonto oyomo akanyorwa ogotenya chinko ase rituko ri’Esabato.

English: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
Kiswahili: Wale waliomkuta akikusanya kuni wakamleta kwa Mose, Aroni na kusanyiko lote,
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bamonyorete bakamoira ase Musa na Aroni, na ase omoganda bwonsi.

English: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
Kiswahili: nao wakamweka kifungoni, kwa sababu haikufahamika kwa wazi kwamba afanyiwe nini.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria agasiekerwa aase gete akarendwa, ekiagera konya teramanyekana boronge egento agwenerete akorerwe.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Huyo mtu ni lazima afe. Kusanyiko lote lazima limpige mawe nje ya kambi.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Omonto oyio goika aitwe akwe: asokigwe isiko y’egetwori, erio omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena.”

English: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kusanyiko likamtoa nje ya kambi na kumpiga mawe hadi akafa, kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’omoganda bakamosokia isiko y’egetwori, bakamoaka amagena goika agakwa, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo jifanyieni vifundo katika pindo za mavazi yenu vikiwa na uzi wa buluu kwenye kila kifundo.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obachiike ng’a bakore amasugunia ase emego ye chianga chiabo, babeeke ase kera obosugunia eusi ere buru. Naboigo barakore ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all Yahweh’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;
Kiswahili: Mtakuwa mkivitazama vifundo hivyo ili mpate kukumbuka amri zote za Bwana, ili mpate kuzitii msije mkajitia uzinzi wenyewe kwa kuzifuata tamaa za mioyo yenu na za macho yenu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera amasugunia ayio nabe ekeinyorio ase more. Ekero mokoyarigereria monyare koinyora amachiiko ane onsi na koyabwata. Naboigo moranyare gokonywa, erinde mobe abegenwa ase ’nde na gwetanga korwa ase okogania okobe gwe chinkoro chiaino na amaiso aino.

English: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtakumbuka kuzitii amri zangu zote nanyi mtawekwa wakfu kwa Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo moinyore na kobwata amachiiko ane onsi, nainwe ’namobe abachenu ase ’nde inche Nyasae oino.

English: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”
Kiswahili: Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, niliyewatoa Misri niwe Mungu wenu. Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ninche Omonene Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe Nyasae oino. Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino.”

English: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.
Kiswahili: Kora mwana wa Ishari, mwana wa Kohathi, mwana wa Lawi, pamoja na baadhi ya Wareubeni, yaani Dathani na Abiramu, wana wa Eliabu, na Oni mwana wa Pelethi, wakachukua baadhi ya watu,
Ekegusii: Kora, mosinto o Isari, Omolawi bw’eamate ya Kohati, na Datani, na Abiiramu, basinto b’Eliabu, na Oni, mosinto o Peleti bw’egesaku kia Rubeni,

English: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.
Kiswahili: wakainuka dhidi ya Mose. Pamoja nao walikuwepo wanaume wa Kiisraeli 250, watu waliojulikana, viongozi wa jumuiya waliokuwa wameteuliwa kuwa wakuu wa kusanyiko.
Ekegusii: bakabwatana, bakaanga koigwera Musa. Amo nabwo ’mbarengeo abanto bande b’Abaisraeli, amagana abere, namerongo etano. Abwo barenge abaraai bachorire korwa ase omosangererekano, bamanyekanete, naende basikire.

English: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above Yahweh’s assembly?”
Kiswahili: Wakaja kama kikundi kuwapinga Mose na Aroni, wakawaambia, “Ninyi mmejitukuza sana! Kusanyiko hili lote ni takatifu, kila mmoja wao, naye Bwana yu pamoja nao. Kwa nini basi mmejitukuza wenyewe juu ya kusanyiko la Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakabwatana, bakaba mamincha ya Musa na Aroni, bakabateebia, “Bono ayio aisanire. Abanto bonsi b’omoganda oyo nigo bare abachenu; Omonene nigo are amo na kera oyomo. Nase ki rende inwe mweimokereirie igoro na mogwekora abanene igoro y’omosangererekano Omonene?”

English: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.
Kiswahili: Mose aliposikia jambo hili, akaanguka kifudifudi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa aigwete amang’ana ayio akagwa inse maumama.

English: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia Kora na wafuasi wake wote: “Asubuhi Bwana ataonyesha ni nani aliye wake na ni nani aliye mtakatifu, tena atamtaka mtu huyo aje kwake. Mtu yule ambaye atamchagua atamfanya kuja karibu naye.
Ekegusii: Erio agakwana na Kora na abanto bonsi b’ekeombe kiaye, akabateebia, “Ankio mambia Omonene nache aorokie ng’a ning’o ore oyoye, naende ning’o ore omochenu na ning’o arae ribaga amoike ang’e. Nache arente omonto oyio achorire amoike ang’e.

English: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,
Kiswahili: Wewe Kora na wafuasi wako wote mtafanya hivi: Chukueni vyetezo,
Ekegusii: Ankio mambia moche mokore iga: Aye Kora amo na bonsi abagokobwatia, moimokie chindogio,

English: put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”
Kiswahili: kesho wekeni moto na uvumba kwenye hivyo vyetezo mbele za Bwana. Mtu ambaye Bwana atamchagua atakuwa ndiye mtakatifu. Ninyi Walawi mmejitukuza sana!”
Ekegusii: mwanchare omorero mobekeo, na igoro y’omorero oyio mobeke ubani, naende mochirente ase obosio bw’Omonene. Omonto ori’Omonene arachore, nere oyio oraabe oria omochenu. Inwe Abalawi, bono ayio abaisanire.”

English: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
Kiswahili: Pia Mose akamwambia Kora, “Enyi Walawi! Sasa nisikilizeni.
Ekegusii: Musa akagenderera gokwana na Kora, agateeba, “Bono inwe Abalawi, igwa!

English: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of Yahweh’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;
Kiswahili: Haiwatoshi ninyi kwamba Mungu wa Israeli amewateua ninyi kutoka kusanyiko lote la Kiisraeli, na kuwaleta karibu naye mpate kufanya kazi kwenye Maskani ya Bwana, na kusimama mbele ya kusanyiko ili kuwahudumia?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo morooche ng’a negento egesinini ase more ng’a Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli obaatananire inwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, na kobarenta mobe ang’e nere, na komokorera Omonene ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu, na gotenenera omoganda bw’ abanto, na kobakorera?

English: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
Kiswahili: Amekuleta wewe na ndugu zako Walawi mwe karibu naye, lakini sasa unajaribu kupata na ukuhani pia.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoete aye amo n’Abalawi bamino ribaga mobeere ang’e nere. Inee! Igo mokorigia obokuani boigo?

English: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”
Kiswahili: Wewe na wafuasi wako wote mmekusanyika pamoja kinyume cha Bwana. Aroni ni nani kwamba ninyi mnungʼunike dhidi yake?”
Ekegusii: Aroni ninki aisaine inwe mwamwemurunganirie mamincha yaye? Ase ayio, mwerende, aye amo na bonsi abagokobwatia. Igo mwasangererekanire mamincha y’Omonene.”

English: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akawaita Dathani na Abiramu, wana wa Eliabu. Lakini wao wakasema, “Sisi hatuji!
Ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Datani na Abiiramu, basinto b’Eliabu. Barabwo bakairaneria, “Intwe titogocha.

English: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?
Kiswahili: Haitoshi tu kwamba wewe umetuleta kutoka nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali ili kutuua sisi jangwani? Nawe sasa pia unataka kuwa mkuu juu yetu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Aya namang’ana amagusu ase ore ng’a gwatorusetie korwa ase ense eria entenenku ere n’amabeere n’amooke, na ogatorenta aa, erinde otoite tokwere aa ase erooro eye? Na bono aye nigo ogwekora koba omonene igoro ase tore?

English: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, hujatuingiza katika nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali, wala hujatupa urithi wa mashamba na mashamba ya mizabibu. Je, utayangʼoa macho ya watu hawa? Hapana, sisi hatuji!”
Ekegusii: Naende nonya naboigo, aye totorenteti ase ense eria entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, gose totoeti emiando y’amaremo na emegondo y’emesabibu. Inee! Nigo otagete kobaukoria abanto aba bonsi? Intwe titogocha.”

English: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akakasirika sana na kumwambia Bwana, “Usiikubali sadaka yao. Mimi sikuchukua chochote, hata punda kutoka kwao, wala sijamkosea hata mmoja wao.”
Ekegusii: Musa akagechigwa mono, agateebia Omonene, “Tobaisa gwanchera ebing’wanso biabo. Inche tindaira nonya netigere yabo eyemo, gose tindakorera nonya noyomo obo bobe.”

English: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Kora, “Wewe na wafuasi wako wote kesho mtatokea mbele za Bwana: yaani wewe na hao wenzako, pamoja na Aroni.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Kora, Ankio aye amo na bonsi abagokobwatia mochiche ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aroni nere nache boigo.

English: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”
Kiswahili: Kila mtu atachukua chetezo chake na kuweka uvumba ndani yake, vyetezo 250 kwa jumla, na kukileta mbele za Bwana. Wewe na Aroni mtaleta vyetezo vyenu pia.”
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino aimokie orogio rw’aye rw’omorero, na arobekere ubani na kororenta ase obosio bw’Omonene. Chindogio chionsi nigo chirabe amagana abere, na merongo etano; naye orente orwao, na Aroni nere arente orwaye.’

English: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kila mtu akachukua chetezo chake, akaweka moto na uvumba ndani yake, na kusimama pamoja na Mose na Aroni kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio kera omonto akaimokia orogio rw’aye, akarobeka omorero, na igoro yaye ubani, bagaacha bagatenena ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Musa na Aroni bagatenenenao boigo.

English: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the congregation.
Kiswahili: Kora alipokuwa amekusanya wafuasi wake wote kuwapinga Mose na Aroni kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, utukufu wa Bwana ukatokea kwa kusanyiko lote.
Ekegusii: Erio Kora agasangereria omoganda bwonsi, na barabwo bagatenena bosio bwa Musa na Aroni agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema eria. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaorokera omoganda bwonsi.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,

English: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
Kiswahili: “Jitengeni kutoka kwenye kusanyiko hili ili nipate kuwaangamiza mara moja.”
Ekegusii: “Tigera, morue ase abanto b’omoganda oyo, erinde mbasirie ara rimo.”

English: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mose na Aroni wakaanguka kufudifudi na kulia kwa sauti, wakasema, “Ee Mungu, Mungu wa roho za wanadamu wote, utakuwa na hasira na kusanyiko lote wakati ni mtu mmoja tu ametenda dhambi?”
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, bagateeba, “Aye ’Nyasae, Nyasae okorua obogima ase abanto bonsi, Inee, omonto oyomo gakorire ebibe, naye igo okogechigwa n’omoganda oyo bwonsi?”

English: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”
Kiswahili: “Liambie kusanyiko, ‘Ondokeni hapo karibu na mahema ya Kora, Dathani na Abiramu.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’omoganda bw’ abanto oyoteebie: Tigera morue aase aetanaine chiema chia Kora, na Datani, na Abiiramu.”

English: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
Kiswahili: Mose akainuka na kuwaendea Dathani na Abiramu, nao wazee wa Israeli wakafuatana naye.
Ekegusii: Musa akaimoka amo nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli, bakageenda ase Datani na Abiiramu.

English: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”
Kiswahili: Mose akalionya kusanyiko, “Sogeeni nyuma mbali na mahema ya hawa watu waovu! Msiguse kitu chochote kilicho mali yao, la sivyo mtafagiliwa mbali kwa sababu ya dhambi zao zote.”
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto, “Eatanane, nabasoroire, morue ase chiema chi’ abanto aba abakori amabe. Timobaisa gokuna gento kende gionsi kiabo; moise kogekuna nigo mogochia gosirigwa ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bionsi.”

English: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakaondoka karibu na mahema ya Kora, Dathani na Abiramu. Dathani na Abiramu walikuwa wametoka nje, nao walikuwa wamesimama pamoja na wake zao, watoto wao na wale wanyonyao kwenye mlango wa mahema yao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo bageatanana bakarua ase chiema chia Kora, na Datani, na Abiiramu. Datani na Abiiramu bagasoka isiko, amo nabakungu babo na abana babo, abanene na abake, bagatenena ase ebisoero bie chiema chiabo.

English: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akasema, “Hivi ndivyo mtakavyojua kuwa Bwana amenituma kufanya mambo haya, na kwamba halikuwa wazo langu.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia abanto, “Ase aya namomanye ’ng’a Omonene ontomire gokora aya onsi, naende ng’a tari inche omonyene nebegete gokora buna inyanchete.

English: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa watu hawa watakufa kifo cha kawaida na kupatwa na yale ya kawaida yanayowapata wanadamu, basi Bwana hakunituma mimi.
Ekegusii: Onye abanto aba bagochia gokwa buna Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi agokwa, gose bakonyora egesusuro buna Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi akonyora, rirori’Omonene tantometi.

English: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa Bwana ataleta jambo jipya kabisa, ardhi ikifunua kinywa chake na kuwameza wao, pamoja na kila kitu kilicho mali yao, nao washuke chini kaburini wakiwa hai, ndipo mtafahamu kuwa watu hawa wamemdharau Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Korende onye Omonene ogochia gokora egento ekeyia, erinde riroba ritandoke, rimere abanto abwo amo n’ebinto biabo bionsi, na barabwo barimere riroba ime bare moyo, bagende gochia aase abakuure, erio ’namomanye ng’a abanto aba bachaayire Omonene.”

English: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
Kiswahili: Mara Mose alipomaliza kusema haya yote, ardhi iliyokuwa chini yao ikapasuka,
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya onsi, riroba rigatandoka inse yabo.

English: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
Kiswahili: nchi ikafunua kinywa chake na kuwameza wao, pamoja na jamaa zao, na watu wote wa Kora na mali zao zote.
Ekegusii: Riroba rikabwereka, rikabamera, amo ne chiamate chiabo, na abanto bonsi ababwatetie Kora, amo n’ebinto biabo bionsi.

English: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.
Kiswahili: Wakashuka chini kaburini wakiwa hai, pamoja na kila kitu walichokuwa nacho; nchi ikajifunika juu yao, nao wakaangamia wakatoweka kutoka kusanyiko.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio barabwo bonsi bakamerwa bare moyo, bakageenda gochia aase abakuure, boigo n’ebinto biabo, erio riroba rikairanerana, rikabatindeka, na barabwo bagasirigwa bakarua ase omosangererekano oria.

English: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
Kiswahili: Kutoka kilio chao, Waisraeli wote waliowazunguka walikimbia, wakipaza sauti, “Nchi inatumeza na sisi pia!”
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge ang’e nabarabwo bagatama, bakarera, bakobora, “Boigo naintwe riroba ndibaise gotomera.”

English: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
Kiswahili: Moto ukaja kutoka kwa Bwana, ukawateketeza wale watu 250 waliokuwa wakifukiza uvumba.
Ekegusii: Erio omorero okarua ase Omonene, ogasamba abanto baria amagana abere, na merongo etano, abwo konya barentire ubani.

English: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,
Kiswahili: “Mwambie Eleazari mwana wa kuhani Aroni, atoe vyetezo kwenye mabaki ya moto na kutawanya makaa mbali kiasi, kwa maana vyetezo ni vitakatifu:
Ekegusii: “Teebia Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, ng’a arusie chindogio chiria chi’omorero korwa ase omorero oyio ogwoka, na omorero oyio ayosiare gochia aare. Chindogio chiria chi’omorero konya chiabeire chinchenu.

English: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before Yahweh. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”
Kiswahili: vyetezo vya watu waliofanya dhambi iliyowagharimu maisha yao. Fua vyetezo hivyo kuwa bamba ili kufunika madhabahu, kwa maana vimeletwa mbele za Bwana na vimekuwa vitakatifu. Navyo viwe ishara kwa Waisraeli.”
Ekegusii: Chindogio echio chi’ abanto baria basirete ekiagera bakorete ebibe, tiga chisunyuntwe chiroisigwe, chibe ekemumeko gekomumeka egesasiimero, ekiagera abanto baria nigo bachiruete ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio chindogio echio konya chiabeire chinchenu. Echio nachio ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera.”

English: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,
Kiswahili: Hivyo kuhani Eleazari akavikusanya vile vyetezo vya shaba vilivyoletwa na wale waliokuwa wameteketezwa kwa moto, naye akavifua kufunika madhabahu,
Ekegusii: Nabo Eleazari Omokuani akaimokia chindogio chiria chi’etai, echio abanto baria omorero osambete konya barentire ase obosio bw’Omonene. Echio chikaroisigwa, chikaba ekemumeko ki’egesasiimero.

English: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before Yahweh, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.
Kiswahili: kama vile Bwana alivyomwelekeza kupitia Mose. Hili lilikuwa kuwakumbusha Waisraeli kwamba hakuna mtu hata mmoja, isipokuwa mzao wa Aroni, awezaye kuja kufukiza uvumba mbele za Bwana, la sivyo, angekuwa kama Kora na wafuasi wake.
Ekegusii: Ekio gekaba ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera Abaisraeli, ng’a nonya noyomo otari Omokuani, otari bw’ororeria rwa Aroni, tabaisa goika ang’e gosamba ubani ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aise gokora bo, nasire buna Kora amo n’abanto baria bamobwatetie basirete. Aya onsi nigo akoretwe buna Omonene konya achiikire Eleazari goetera ase Musa.

English: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli wakanungʼunika dhidi ya Mose na Aroni, wakisema, “Mmewaua watu wa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Korende rituko ria kabere, omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okemurunganeria Musa na Aroni, okabora. “Ninwe mwaitire abanto ba Omonene.”

English: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and Yahweh’s glory appeared.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati kusanyiko lilipokusanyika kupingana na Mose na Aroni, nalo likageuka kuelekea Hema la Kukutania, ghafula wingu likafunika Hema, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukatokea.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoganda oria konya osangererekanire amo ase okoba mamincha ya Musa na Aroni, barabwo bakeonchora bakarigereria Eema y’Omosangererekano bakarora riire riayetubire, na obonene bw’Omonene bokaoroka.

English: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakaenda mbele ya Hema la Kukutania,
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagaacha bosio bw’Eema eria.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: naye Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: N’Omonene agateebia Musa,

English: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
Kiswahili: “Jitenge mbali na kusanyiko hili ili niweze kuwaangamiza mara moja.” Wakaanguka chini kifudifudi.
Ekegusii: “Karue ase omoganda oyo, otigere gochia aare, erio inche ’mbasirie ara rimo.” Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.

English: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Chukua chetezo chako na uweke uvumba ndani yake, pamoja na moto kutoka madhabahuni, nawe uende haraka kwenye kusanyiko ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yao. Ghadhabu imekuja kutoka kwa Bwana, na tauni imeanza.”
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni, “Imokia orogio rwao rw’ogosambera ubani rusia omorero ase egesasiimero oyobeke igoro yaye, erio obeeke ubani igoro ase omorero oyio, oroimokie ogende bwango ase omoganda bw’ abanto, erinde okore okobwatanigwa ase bare, ekiagera Omonene obeire nendamwamu: amaakwa achakire goita abanto.”

English: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Aroni akafanya kama Mose alivyosema, akakimbilia katikati ya kusanyiko. Tauni ilikuwa tayari imeanza miongoni mwa watu, lakini Aroni akafukiza uvumba na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yao.
Ekegusii: Aroni akaimokia orogio rwa ubani buna Musa amoteebetie, akaminyoka gochia ase egati y’omoganda oria. Amaakwa konya achakire ase egati y’ abanto, korende Aroni akabeeka ubani ase orogio roria, agakora okobwatanigwa ase bare.

English: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
Kiswahili: Aroni akasimama kati ya waliokuwa hai na waliokufa, nayo tauni ikakoma.
Ekegusii: Ekero Aroni atenenete gati gati ya baria bakwete na baria barenge moyo, amaakwa aria agatiga goita abanto.

English: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.
Kiswahili: Lakini walikufa watu 14,700 kutokana na tauni hiyo, licha ya wale waliokuwa wamekufa kwa sababu ya Kora.
Ekegusii: Abanto konya bakuure nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na inye, na magana atano abere (14,700). Baria bakwete ase ogosaria gwa Kora tibarenge ase omobaro oyo.

English: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Aroni akamrudia Mose kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, kwa maana tauni ilikuwa imekoma.
Ekegusii: Ekero amaakwa atigete goita abanto, Aroni akairana ase Musa agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli, na ujipatie fimbo kumi na mbili kutoka kwao, moja kutoka kwa kila mmoja wa viongozi wa kabila za baba zao. Andika jina la kila mtu kwenye fimbo yake.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a bakoe chinyimbo chiabo, eyemo ase kera omotang’ani o kera egesaku kiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, Oriike erieta ria kera oyomo ase enyimbo yaye.

English: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.
Kiswahili: Kwenye fimbo ya Lawi andika jina la Aroni, kwa maana ni lazima iwepo fimbo moja kwa kila kiongozi kwa ajili ya kila kabila la baba zao.
Ekegusii: Oriike erieta ria Aroni ase enyimbo y’egesaku kia Lawi. Kera omotang’ani bwe chiamate chia kera egesaku abe n’enyimbo eyemo.

English: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.
Kiswahili: Ziweke hizo fimbo ndani ya Hema la Kukutania mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, mahali nikutanapo nawe.
Ekegusii: Erio obeke chinyimbo echio ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano bosio bw’Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, agwo ase inche ndaumerane nainwe.

English: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”
Kiswahili: Fimbo ya mtu nitakayemchagua itachipuka, nami mwenyewe nitayakomesha haya manungʼuniko ya mara kwa mara ya Waisraeli dhidi yako.”
Ekegusii: Enyimbo y’omonto oria inche ’ndachoore neseboke. Ase enchera eyio ninkore Abaisraeli batige kwemurungania mamincha y’ane, naende ningere batige kwemurungania mamincha yaino.”

English: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mose akasema na Waisraeli, nao viongozi wao wakampa fimbo kumi na mbili, fimbo moja kwa ajili ya kila kabila la baba zao, nayo fimbo ya Aroni ikiwa miongoni mwa hizo.
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Abaisraeli, akabateebia amang’ana ayio, na abaraai bonsi be chiamate chia kera egesaku bakamoa chinyimbo chiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, na enyimbo ya Aroni nigo yarenge ase egati ye chinyimbo chiria.

English: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the Tent of the Testimony.
Kiswahili: Mose akaziweka hizo fimbo mbele za Bwana ndani ya Hema la Ushuhuda.
Ekegusii: Musa akaira chinyimbo chiria ime ase Eema y’Oborori, agachibekao ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata Mose aliingia kwenye Hema la Ushuhuda akaona ile fimbo ya Aroni ambayo iliwakilisha jamaa ya Lawi haikuwa tu imechipuka, bali pia ilikuwa imetoa machipukizi, kuchanua maua na kuzaa malozi.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Musa agasoa ase Eema eria y’Oborori, akarora enyimbo ya Aroni, eyatenenerete egesaku kia Lawi, yasebokire, ne chinsagia echio chiasokirie amamumu na ebisicha, naende chiamire amatunda amalozi atobire.

English: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akaleta zile fimbo zote kwa Waisraeli wote kutoka mbele za Bwana. Wakaziangalia, na kila mtu akaichukua fimbo yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agachisokia isiko chinyimbo chiria chionsi korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, agachirenta ase Abaisraeli bonsi. Abwo bagachirigereria, na kera omonto akabogoria enyimbo yaye.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Rudisha fimbo ya Aroni mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, ili ihifadhiwe kama alama kwa waasi. Hili litakomesha manungʼuniko yao dhidi yangu, ili kwamba wasife.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, Irania enyimbo ya Aroni ebeere agwo bosio bw’Esanduki ere noborori, erinde egachwe ebe ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera abanto batari koigwera. Nabo okirie okwemurungania kwabo ase ’nde, timbaisa koigwa amang’ana buna ayio, mbaise kobaita bakwe.

English: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.
Kiswahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwamuru.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Musa akorete buna Omonene amochiigete.

English: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakamwambia Mose, “Tutakufa! Tumepotea, sote tumepotea!
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagateebia Musa, “Rora, intwe twaikeire omoerio oito, tw akuure, twasirire intwe twensi.

English: Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”
Kiswahili: Yeyote akaribiaye Maskani ya Bwana atakufa. Je, sisi sote tutakufa?”
Ekegusii: Kera omonto ogoika ang’e ase Obomenyo bw’Omonene, goika akwe. Inee! Ntwensi pi torakwe?”

English: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Wewe, wanao na jamaa ya baba yako mtawajibika kwa makosa dhidi ya mahali patakatifu, na wewe na wanao peke yenu ndio mtakaowajibika kwa makosa dhidi ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Aye na abamura bao amo n’abanto b’eamate yaino nigo morabarerwe okomocha konde gwonsi koraabe kogokorerwa ase obokoreri ime y’Aase Aachenu, naende aye na abamura bao inamobarerwe okomocha konde gwonsi koraabe kogokorwa ase obokuani bwaino.

English: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.
Kiswahili: Walete Walawi wenzako kutoka kabila la baba zako ili waungane nanyi na kuwasaidia wakati wewe na wanao mnapohudumu mbele ya Hema la Ushuhuda.
Ekegusii: Renta Abalawi bamino, egesaku gia iso, barabwo bakore emeremo aroro amo naye. Abwo bagokorere aye amo nabamura bao, ekero mogokora emeremo agwo bosio bw’Eema eria ere noborori.

English: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.
Kiswahili: Watawajibika kwenu na watafanya kazi zote za Hema, lakini kamwe wasisogelee vifaa vya patakatifu au madhabahu, la sivyo wao na ninyi mtakufa.
Ekegusii: Barabwo ’nabagokorere, naende bakore emeremo yonsi ase Eema eria, korende tibaabaisa goika ang’e ase ebikorero ebichenu bi’Aase Aachenu, gose tibaika ang’e ase egesasiimero. Baise gokora igo, aye amo nabarabwo igo morakwe.

English: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.
Kiswahili: Watajiunga nanyi na watawajibika kwa utunzaji wa Hema la Kukutania, yaani kazi zote kwenye Hema, wala hakuna mtu mwingine yeyote atakayeweza kusogea karibu hapo mlipo.
Ekegusii: Nigo barabwatane naye na gokora emeremo yabo yonsi y’obokoreri ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Omonto onde omoao otachiikiri tabaisa goika ang’e akore emeremo amo nainwe.

English: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Mtawajibika katika utunzaji wa mahali patakatifu na madhabahu, ili kwamba ghadhabu isiwaangukie Waisraeli tena.
Ekegusii: Aye amo nabamura bao, ninwe mweka morakore emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu na ase egesasiimero, erio nario endamwamu yane etabaise koba igoro y’Abaisraeli naende.

English: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe nimewachagua Walawi wenzenu kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli kama zawadi kwenu, waliowekwa wakfu kwa Bwana ili kufanya kazi katika Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Ninche nachorire Abalawi bamino korwa ase Abaisraeli, babe ekeegwa ase more. Barabwo baatananirwe ase ’nde inche Omonene, bakore emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ni wewe tu na wanao mtakaoweza kutumika kama makuhani kuhusiana na kila kitu kwenye madhabahu na ndani ya pazia. Ninawapa utumishi wa ukuhani kama zawadi. Mtu mwingine yeyote atakayekaribia mahali patakatifu ni lazima auawe.”
Ekegusii: Aye amo nabamura bao, ninwe mweka morakore emeremo yonsi y’obokuani, na emeremo yonsi ase egesasiimero, na eria ere moino y’etoto enachete Obomenyo Obochenu. Nabaeire obokuani buna ekeegwa kebe ekiaino. Onye omonto onde omoao otachiikiri ogocha ang’e ase obokoreri obwo, goika aitwe akwe.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Mimi mwenyewe nimekuweka kuwa mwangalizi wa sadaka zote zitakazotolewa kwangu; matoleo yote matakatifu Waisraeli wanayonipa ninakupa wewe na wanao kama sehemu yenu na fungu lenu la kawaida.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Rora, nakoeire okoruegwa konde gwonsi gokoruegwa ase ’nde, obe gokorenda. Ebinto bionsi ebichenu Abaisraeli bakorua, ebio nakobieire bibe egetari kiao amo neki’ororeria rwao kogenderera botambe.

English: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.
Kiswahili: Mtachukua sehemu ya yale matoleo matakatifu sana ambayo hayateketezwi kwa moto. Kutoka kwa matoleo yote wanayoniletea kama sadaka takatifu sana, ziwe za nafaka, au za dhambi, au za makosa, sehemu ile itakuwa yako na wanao.
Ekegusii: Ase ebinto bire ebichenu mono, ebiratigare, bitari gosambwa nomorero, ebiraabe ebiao, nabio ebi: Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera, na kera ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha. Ebinto bionsi barabwo barabe bakorua ase ’nde, nabibe ebichenu mono ase ore, na ase abamura bao.

English: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.
Kiswahili: Mtaila kama kitu kilicho kitakatifu sana; kila mwanaume ataila. Ni lazima mtaiheshimu kama takatifu.
Ekegusii: Noriere ebinto ebio aase gete are aachenu mono. Kera omonto omosacha ore ase more nanyare koria ebinto ebio. Ebio n’ebinto ebichenu ase ore.

English: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.
Kiswahili: “Hiki pia ni chako: chochote kilichotengwa kutoka kwenye matoleo yote ya sadaka za kuinuliwa za Waisraeli. Ninakupa wewe haya, wana na binti zako kama sehemu yenu ya kawaida. Kila mmoja wa nyumba yako ambaye ni safi kwa taratibu za ibada anaweza kuyala.
Ekegusii: “Boigo nakoeire okoruegwa Abaisraeli barabe bakorenta ase ’nde buna ebing’wanso bi’ogosungusia. Nakoeire aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, ’nabibe ebiaino kogenderera botambe. Kera omonto ochenegete ore ase enyomba yao nanyare koria ebinto ebio.

English: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Ninawapa mafuta ya zeituni yaliyo bora kuliko yote, na divai mpya iliyo bora kuliko zote na nafaka wanazompa Bwana kama malimbuko katika mavuno yao.
Ekegusii: “Nakoeire kera ekere ekiya mono ki’ogotongora oko Abaisraeli bakondetera: Amaguta y’amazeituni, na edivai, n’endagera.

English: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.
Kiswahili: Malimbuko yote ya nchi ambayo wanamletea Bwana yatakuwa yenu. Kila mmoja nyumbani kwako ambaye ni safi kwa taratibu za Ibada anaweza kula.
Ekegusii: Okwama gwonsi kw’eritang’ani ase ebinto bionsi bigokina ase ense yabo, okwo bakondetera, ’nakobe okwao. Kera omonto ochenegete ore ase enyomba yao nanyare koria ebinto ebio.

English: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.
Kiswahili: “Kila kitu katika Israeli ambacho kimetolewa kwa Bwana ni chenu.
Ekegusii: “Kera egento Abaisraeli baatananire ase ’nde ’nakebe ekiao.

English: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.
Kiswahili: Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mwanadamu na wa mnyama, ambaye ametolewa kwa Bwana ni wenu. Lakini ni lazima mtamkomboa kila mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza na kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa wanyama wasio safi.
Ekegusii: “Kera omwana omotangi bakorua ase ’nde ’nabe oyoo, na kera eng’iti entangi boigo, korende nonya naboigo bwanche embooria ase omwana omotangi o Mwanyabaanto, na ase chintangi chie ching’iti chiria chitachenegeti.

English: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.
Kiswahili: Watakapokuwa na umri wa mwezi mmoja, ni lazima mtawakomboa kwa bei ya ukombozi iliyowekwa, kwa shekeli tano za fedha, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, yenye uzito wa gera ishirini.
Ekegusii: Abana baboorigwe ekero bakoorire omotienyi oyomo, ne ching’iti boigo. Aye nobeke rigori ri’okobooria, ribe chisekeli isano chi’echifeta, koreng’ana nesekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera ibere.)

English: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Lakini kamwe usimkomboe mzaliwa wa kwanza wa maksai, kondoo au mbuzi; hawa ni watakatifu. Nyunyizia damu yao juu ya madhabahu na uchome mafuta yao kama sadaka itolewayo kwa moto, harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende ching’iti chintangi chi’echiombe, gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori, tichikoboorigwa. Echio nchiatananwe ase ’nde. Amanyinga abo oyanyororokererie igoro ase egesasiimero, na ebitinya biabo obisambe bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero kere ne rimisu rikongwenera.

English: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.
Kiswahili: Nyama zao zitakuwa chakula chenu, kama ilivyokuwa kidari cha kuinuliwa na paja la mguu wa kulia.
Ekegusii: Korende chinyama chiabo amo ne ritaana rigosungusigwa, na ekenama kia borio, echio nachio echiao.

English: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your offspring with you.”
Kiswahili: Chochote kitakachotengwa kutoka sadaka takatifu ambazo Waisraeli wanamtolea Bwana, ninakupa wewe, wanao na binti zako kama fungu lenu la kawaida. Ni Agano la milele la chumvi mbele za Bwana kwako na watoto wako.”
Ekegusii: “Ebiegwa bionsi ebichenu Abaisraeli barandetere inche Omonene nakobieire aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, bibe ebitari biaino kera ekero. Okwo nokobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’omonyoo gwa kare na kare ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, okwo nakorire naye na ororeria rwao.”

English: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Hutakuwa na urithi wowote katika nchi yao, wala hutakuwa na sehemu miongoni mwao; Mimi ni fungu lako na urithi wako miongoni mwa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Aye tokonyora omwando bw’orogongo ase egati y’Abaisraeli bande. Tokoegwa ensemo ende yonsi ase egati yabo. Inche ninche ensemo yao, naende omwando oo, ase egati y’Abaisraeli.

English: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: “Ninawapa Walawi zaka yote katika Israeli kama urithi wao kuwa kama malipo kwa kazi wanayoifanya wakati wanapohudumu katika Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: “Naeire Abalawi ensemo ya ikomi, eye Abaisraeli bakorua, ebe eyabo, ebe eng’eria ase emeremo eye barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia sasa, kamwe Waisraeli wasisogelee karibu na Hema la Kukutania, la sivyo watabeba matokeo ya dhambi zao, nao watakufa.
Ekegusii: Korwa bono na kogenderera Abaisraeli bande tibaabaisa goika ang’e n’Eema eria. Baise gokora bo, nigo barabe nebibe, erio bakwe.

English: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.
Kiswahili: Ni Walawi watakaofanya kazi katika Hema la Kukutania na kubeba wajibu wa makosa dhidi yake. Hili ni agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo. Hawatapokea urithi wowote miongoni mwa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Korende Abalawi barabwo nigo barakore emeremo ase Eema y’omosangererekano, okomocha kw’ebibe gokoraabeo nakobarwe igoro ase bare. Okwo nakwo koraabe ogochika ase bare kogenderera ebiaare ase ebiaare. Barabwo tibakoba nomwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli.

English: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”
Kiswahili: Badala yake, ninawapa Walawi zaka zote zinazotolewa na Waisraeli kama sadaka kwa Bwana kuwa urithi wao. Hiyo ndiyo sababu nimesema hivi kuhusu wao: ‘Hawatakuwa na urithi miongoni mwa Waisraeli.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya ikomi eye Abaisraeli bakondetera buna okoruegwa kwabo nayeire Abalawi ebe eyabo. Ase ayio, nabateebirie ng’a tibakoba nomwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli bande.”

English: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe.
Kiswahili: “Sema na Walawi na uwaambie: ‘Mtakapopokea zaka kutoka kwa Waisraeli ambayo ninawapa kama urithi wenu kutoka kwao, ni lazima mtoe sehemu ya kumi ya hiyo zaka kama sadaka kwa Bwana, iwe zaka ya hiyo zaka.
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abalawi, obateebie: Ekero mokonyora ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Abaisraeli, eri’Omonene abaeire ebe eyaino, erio morusie ensemo ya ikomi y’okoruegwa okwo, moyerentere Omonene.

English: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.
Kiswahili: Sadaka yenu itahesabiwa kwenu kama nafaka kutoka sakafu ya kupuria, au divai kutoka kwenye shinikizo la kukamulia zabibu.
Ekegusii: Okoruegwa okwo inwe morarue, nigo korabarwe ase more buna n’okoruegwa kw’endagera korwa ase ebiooreri biaino, na ogw’edivai na amaguta korwa ase ekemitero, okwo abande bakorua.

English: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to Yahweh of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give Yahweh’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii, ninyi pia mtatoa sadaka kwa Bwana kutoka zaka zote mtakazopokea kutoka kwa Waisraeli. Kutoka kwenye zaka hizi, ni lazima mtoe sehemu ya Bwana kwa Aroni, kuhani.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eye nainwe morentere Omonene okoruegwa kwaino, okwo mokorusia korwa ase ensemo ya ikomi eria mokonyora korwa ase Abaisraeli. Na okoruegwa okwo gw’enseemo ya ikomi okore kw’Omonene, moe Aroni Omokuani.

English: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to Yahweh, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’
Kiswahili: Ni lazima mtoe kama sehemu ya Bwana iliyo nzuri sana tena ile sehemu iliyo takatifu sana kuliko zote ya kile kitu mlichopewa.’
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ebiegwa ebio bionsi moranyore korwa ase Abaisraeli, mwatananere Omonene biria bire ebiya mono.

English: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Walawi: ‘Mtakapotoa sehemu zilizo bora sana, itahesabiwa kwenu kama mazao ya sakafu ya kupuria nafaka, au ya shinikizo la kukamulia zabibu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio otebie Abalawi: Ekero moraabe mwarure ebinto ebiya mono korwa ase ensemo ya ikomi eria, erio ebinto ebio nigo birabarwe ase more, inwe Abalawi, buna okoruegwa kwaino kw’endagera, na okomitwa gw’edivai, na okw’amaguta.

English: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Ninyi na watu wa nyumbani mwenu mnaweza kula sehemu iliyobaki mahali popote, kwani ndio ujira wenu kwa ajili ya kazi yenu katika Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Inwe amo n’abanto b’echinka chiaino namoriere ebinto ebio aase aande onsi, ekiagera eyio neng’eria yaino moraakanwe ase emeremo mogokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa kutoa sehemu zake zilizo bora sana, hamtakuwa na hatia katika jambo hili; ndipo hamtatia unajisi sadaka takatifu za Waisraeli, nanyi hamtakufa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ekero mwarure ensemo engiya kobua korwa ase okoruegwa okwo, timokoba nokomocha ase okoria eria entigari. Timobaisa gokora ebinto ebichenu bi’Abaisraeli bibe ebitachenegeti, erinde timokwa.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni:
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa amo na Aroni, akabateebia,

English: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.
Kiswahili: “Hivi ndivyo sheria ambayo Bwana ameagiza itakavyo: Waambie Waisraeli wakuletee mtamba mwekundu asiye na dosari wala waa, na ambaye hajapata kufungwa nira.
Ekegusii: “Oyo n’oro omooroberio inche Omonene nachiikire: Teebia Abaisraeli ng’a barente eng’ombe eaberi embariri etari na kemoa ase omobere oye, naende etana kobekerwa rikorogoto ase ogokorigwa emeremo.

English: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.
Kiswahili: Mpeni kuhani Eleazari huyo mtamba; naye atatolewa nje ya kambi na kuchinjwa mbele yake huyo kuhani.
Ekegusii: Orente eng’ombe eria, oyee Eleazari Omokuani; na eng’ombe eria eirwe isiko y’egetwori, erio enyenyerweo ase obosio bwaye.

English: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani Eleazari atachukua baadhi ya damu yake kwenye kidole chake na kuinyunyiza mara saba kuelekea upande wa mbele ya Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Eleazari atobeke ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga y’eng’ombe eria, ayanyororokerie ara gatano nakabere bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.
Kiswahili: Wakati angali akitazama, mtamba huyo atateketezwa: ngozi yake, nyama yake, damu na sehemu zake za ndani.
Ekegusii: Erio chinyama chi’eng’ombe eria, chisamberwe ase obosio bwaye amo ne riiyo na amanyinga, n’esike.

English: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atachukua kuni za mti wa mwerezi, hisopo na sufu nyekundu, na kuvitupa kwenye huyo mtamba anayeungua.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani abogorie oroko rw’emecharake na orosagia rwa hisopo, na eusi embariri, erio abirute as’omorero oria ogosamba eng’ombe eria.

English: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo, kuhani lazima afue nguo zake, na aoge mwili wake kwa maji. Kisha anaweza kurudi kambini, lakini atakuwa najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani asibie chianga chiaye, esibie omobere boigo namaache. Ekero akoorire gokora bo achiche ase egetwori, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.
Kiswahili: Mtu amchomaye huyo mtamba lazima naye pia afue nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye pia atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Na omonto oria ogosamba eng’ombe eria goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.
Kiswahili: “Mtu ambaye ni safi atakusanya majivu ya mtamba huyo na kuyaweka mahali ambapo ni safi nje ya kambi kwa taratibu za kiibada. Yatahifadhiwa na jumuiya ya Kiisraeli kwa matumizi katika maji ya utakaso; ni kwa ajili ya kutakasa kutoka dhambini.
Ekegusii: Omonto ochenegete abuuche riibu ri’eng’ombe eria, erio ariumore isiko y’egetwori, aase achenire. Riibu erio rigachwe agwo ase engencho y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli ase ogokorerwa emeremo y’ogochena amaache akonyororokigwa ase okorusia ebibe.

English: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.
Kiswahili: Mtu akusanyaye majivu ya huyo mtamba ni lazima pia afue nguo zake, kadhalika naye pia atakuwa najisi hadi jioni. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa Waisraeli na kwa wageni wanaoishi miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria orabuuche riibu riria, asibie chianga chiaye, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio. Oko nakwo ogochika koragenderere botambe ase Abaisraeli na ase omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo.

English: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote agusaye maiti ya mtu yeyote atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi orakune egetondo, nabe oyotachenegeti ase amatuko atan’abere.

English: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima ajitakase mwenyewe kwa maji katika siku ya tatu na siku ya saba, ndipo atakuwa safi. Lakini kama hatajitakasa mwenyewe katika siku ya tatu na ya saba, hatakuwa safi.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato, naende ase rituko ria gatan’akabere, omonto oria goika esibie n’amaache, nabe ochenekire; korende onye tagwesibia ase amatuko aya abere takoba oyochenekire.

English: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote agusaye maiti ya mtu yeyote na kushindwa kujitakasa mwenyewe hunajisi Maskani ya Bwana. Mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na Israeli. Kwa sababu hajanyunyiziwa maji ya utakaso, yeye ni najisi; unajisi wake unabaki juu yake.
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orakune egetondo, korende tesibia, igo agokora Obomenyo bw’Omonene bobe obotachenegeti. Omonto oyio aatananwe korwa ase Abaisraeli, ekiagera amaache aria ay’okomochena taumoiri ase are; ere agenderere koba oyotachenegeti.

English: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo sheria itumikayo wakati mtu amekufa ndani ya hema: Yeyote aingiaye ndani ya hema hilo na yeyote aliye ndani yake watakuwa najisi kwa muda wa siku saba,
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika: Omonto onde bwensi orasoe eema eria ase egetondo kere, na omonto onde bwensi ore imeo, nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere.

English: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.
Kiswahili: nacho kila chombo kisicho na kifuniko juu yake kitakuwa najisi.
Ekegusii: Egekorero kende gionsi kere ase eema eria ime, getabwati egekuneko, korende kere giasie, kiabeire egetachenegeti.

English: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote aliyeko nje mahali pa wazi agusaye mtu aliyeuawa kwa upanga au mtu aliyekufa kwa kifo cha kawaida, au mtu yeyote agusaye mfupa wa mtu aliyekufa au kaburi, atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oranyore omonto okenyirwe orosana ime, gose okwete ogokwa konde gwonsi, na amokune, gose akune riuga ri’egetondo, gose oboina, omonto oyio nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere.

English: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.
Kiswahili: “Kwa mtu aliye najisi, weka majivu ya sadaka ya utakaso wa dhambi ndani ya chombo, umimine maji safi juu yao.
Ekegusii: “Ekiagera babeire abatachenegeti, nabaimokie riibu ike ri’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, keria giasambirwe, na kobeeka amaache amaya a rooche igoro ye riibu riria.

English: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.
Kiswahili: Kisha mtu aliye safi kwa kawaida za kiibada atachukua hisopo, achovye ndani ya maji, na kunyunyizia hema na vifaa vyote pamoja na watu ambao walikuwamo. Pia ni lazima amnyunyizie mtu yeyote ambaye amegusa mfupa wa mtu aliyekufa, au kaburi, au mtu ambaye ameuawa, au mtu ambaye amekufa kifo cha kawaida.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto ochenegete aimokie orosagia rwa hisopo, arotobeke ase amaache ayio ime, erio anyororokerie eema n’ebinto bionsi bireo, amo n’abanto barenge imeo. Naende anyororokerie omonto oria okunete riuga, gose okunete omonto oitetwe, gose oyokwete bweka, gose oboina.

English: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.
Kiswahili: Mtu ambaye ni safi ndiye atakayemnyunyizia yeyote ambaye ni najisi siku ya tatu na siku ya saba, na katika siku ya saba atamtakasa mtu huyo. Mtu ambaye ametakaswa lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, na jioni ile atakuwa safi.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato, na ase rituko ria gatan’akabere, omonto ochenegete anyororokie amaache ase oria otachenegeti. Ase igo ase rituko ria gatan’akabere namochene; ere oria ogochia gochenwa nasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, na ase engaki ya mogoroba nabe ochenekire.

English: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahweh. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mtu ambaye ni najisi hakujitakasa mwenyewe, ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na jumuiya, kwa sababu ameinajisi Maskani ya Bwana. Maji ya utakaso hayajanyunyizwa juu yake, naye ni najisi.
Ekegusii: “Omonto obeire oyotachenegeti, nere tancheti gwesibia, arusigwe ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto. Ere okorire Aase Aachenu a Omonene abeire atachenegeti, ekiagera amaache aria y’okomochena tanyororokeretigwe ase are; ere nigo are oyotachenegeti.

English: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.
Kiswahili: Hii ni sheria ya kudumu kwao. “Mtu yeyote ambaye ananyunyiza yale maji ya utakaso lazima pia afue nguo zake, na yeyote ambaye hugusa maji ya utakaso atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika kwa botambe ase bare. Omonto oria okonyororokeria amaache aria y’ogochena asibie chianga chiaye, na omonto onde omoao karakune amaache aria, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

English: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”
Kiswahili: Kitu chochote anachogusa mtu aliye najisi kitakuwa najisi, na yeyote akigusaye huwa najisi mpaka jioni.”
Ekegusii: Egento kende gionsi omonto oria otachenegeti arakune nakerokio ’nakebe egetachenegeti. Omonto onde bwensi orakune egento keria nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.”

English: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
Kiswahili: Katika mwezi wa kwanza jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli ilifika kwenye Jangwa la Sini, nao wakakaa Kadeshi. Miriamu akafa huko na kuzikwa.
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli ogaika ase erooro ya Sini na gotoora agwo Kadeshi. Miriamu agakwana agatindekwa aroro.

English: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
Kiswahili: Mahali hapo hapakuwa na maji kwa ajili ya jumuiya hiyo, nao wakakusanyika ili kumpinga Mose na Aroni.
Ekegusii: Amaache tarenge agwo ase batoorete; ase ayio omoganda ogasangererekana amo, okaba mamincha ya Musa na Aroni.

English: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!
Kiswahili: Watu wakagombana na Mose, na kusema, “Laiti tungelikufa wakati ndugu zetu walipoanguka na kufa mbele za Bwana!
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bakaamerererania na Musa, bagakwana, “Nanga nigo yabeete buya kobua onye naintwe ’ntwakwete ekero abaminto baitetwe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Why have you brought Yahweh’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mmeileta jumuiya ya Bwana kwenye jangwa hili, ili tufe humu, sisi na mifugo yetu?
Ekegusii: Ninki mwatwegegeretie intwe omoganda Omonene gocha ase erooro eye, erio toche gokwera aiga, amo ne chitugo chiaito?

English: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mmetupandisha kutoka Misri mpaka mahali hapa pa kutisha? Hapa hakuna nafaka wala tini, zabibu au makomamanga. Wala hapa hakuna maji ya kunywa!”
Ekegusii: Ninki mwatorusetie Misiri gocha ense eye yamakweri? Aase aa ataka atari kwama endagera, gose amako, gose amasabibu, gose amakomomanga. Nonya namaache tokonywa tari aa.”

English: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. Yahweh’s glory appeared to them.
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni wakaondoka pale kwenye kusanyiko mpaka kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania na kuanguka kifudifudi, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukawatokea.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakarua agwo ase omoganda oria, bakageenda ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama agwo ase egesoero. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokabaorokera.

English: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”
Kiswahili: “Chukua ile fimbo, na wewe na ndugu yako Aroni mkusanye kusanyiko pamoja. Nena na ule mwamba mbele ya macho yao, nao utatoa maji yake. Utatoa maji kutoka huo mwamba kwa ajili ya jumuiya ili wao na mifugo yao waweze kunywa.”
Ekegusii: “Imokia enyimbo eria, erio aye na Aroni mosangererie omoganda bwonsi, na agwo ase amasio y’ abanto bonsi mokwane negetare keria, na amaache ’nasoke korwa aroro. Ase enchera eyio ’mosokerie abanto amaache yokonywa, ne chitugo chiabo ’nchiyanywe.”

English: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akaichukua hiyo fimbo kutoka pale ilipokuwa mbele za Bwana kama alivyomwagiza.
Ekegusii: Musa akaimokia enyimbo eria korwa aase yarenge, agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna Omonene konya amochiikire.

English: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni wakakusanya kusanyiko pamoja mbele ya huo mwamba, naye Mose akawaambia, “Sikilizeni, enyi waasi. Je, ni lazima tuwatoleeni maji kutoka mwamba huu?”
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bosio bw’egetare keria, akabateebia, “Igwa inwe abasaria aba! Inee! ’Nkobasokeria tore amaache korwa ase egetare eke?”

English: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mose akainua mkono wake na kuupiga mwamba mara mbili kwa fimbo yake. Maji yakabubujika, nayo jumuiya na mifugo yao wakanywa.
Ekegusii: Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye, agaaka egetare keria nenyimbo yaye ara kabere. Amaache agasoka amaange mono, na omoganda oria okanywa ne chitugo chiabo chikayanywa boigo.

English: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni, “Kwa sababu hamkuniamini mimi kiasi cha kuniheshimu kama mtakatifu machoni pa Waisraeli, hamtaiingiza jumuiya hii katika nchi ninayowapa.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni, “Ekiagera inwe motanyegenete na koorokia ase amasio y’Abaisraeli ng’a inche nomochenu inde, timokoraa na goikia omosangererekano oyio ase ense eria ebe eyabo.

English: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.
Kiswahili: Haya yalikuwa maji ya Meriba, mahali pale ambapo Waisraeli waligombana na Bwana, naye akajionyesha mwenyewe huko kuwa mtakatifu katikati yao.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amaache a Meriba aase Abaisraeli baamereranetie n’Omonene, na ere akeorokia ng’a nomochenu are ase egati yabo.”

English: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;
Kiswahili: Mose akawatuma wajumbe kutoka Kadeshi kwenda kwa mfalme wa Edomu, akisema: “Hili ndilo ndugu yako Israeli asemalo: Wewe unafahamu juu ya taabu zote ambazo zimetupata.
Ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa Kadeshi gochia ase omorwoti o Edomu bamoteebie, “Amang’ana aya naro intwe Abaisraeli bamino togoteeba: Nomanyete emechando yonsi yatonyorire,

English: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.
Kiswahili: Baba zetu walishuka Misri, nasi tumeishi huko miaka mingi. Wamisri walitutesa sisi na baba zetu,
Ekegusii: buna chisokoro chiaito chiagendete ase ense ya Misiri, chikamenyao emiaka emenge. Abamisiri bagachichanda ase obotindi obobe, bagatochanda naintwe.

English: When we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.
Kiswahili: lakini tulipomlilia Bwana, alisikia kilio chetu na akamtuma malaika akatutoa Misri. “Sasa tupo hapa Kadeshi, mji ulio mpakani mwa nchi yako.
Ekegusii: Ekero twarerete ase Omonene, ere akaigwa ebirero biaito, agatoma omomalaika agatorusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Bono nao tore aiga Kadeshi, omochie ore ase orobebe kegima rw’orogongo rwao.

English: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”
Kiswahili: Tafadhali turuhusu tupite katika nchi yako. Hatutapita katika shamba lolote, wala shamba la mizabibu, au kunywa maji kutoka kwenye kisima chochote. Tutasafiri kufuata njia kuu ya mfalme, na hatutageuka kulia wala kushoto mpaka tuwe tumeshapita nchi yako.”
Ekegusii: Koranche otoe ribaga toete ase egati y’ense yao. Titokogobera gochia ase emegondo y’endagera, gose ey’emesabibu, gose titokonywa amaache korwa ase chinsoko chiaino. Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, titokogobera gochia ensemo ya borio, gose eya bomosi, goika tobe twaetanirie orogongo rwao.”

English: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mfalme wa Edomu akajibu: “Hamtapita hapa; kama mkijaribu kupita, tutatoka na kuwashambulia kwa upanga.”
Ekegusii: Korende omorwoti o Edomu akamoiraneria, “Timobaisa goeta ase egati y’ense y’ane; moise goeta, nigo ndabarwanie esegi imbaite nemioro.”

English: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakajibu: “Sisi tutafuata njia kuu; tena ikiwa sisi au mifugo yetu tutakunywa tone la maji yenu, tutalilipia. Sisi tunataka tu kupita kwa miguu, wala si kitu kingine chochote.”
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamoteebia, “Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, na gatoranywe amaache ao, intwe gose chitugo chiaito, rirorio ’natoakane amaache ayio. Toe ribaga toete rioka namagoro, titokogania gento kende goetania ekio.”

English: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Edomu wakajibu tena: “Hamwezi kupita hapa.” Ndipo watu wa Edomu wakatoka dhidi ya Waisraeli, jeshi kubwa lenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Abaedomu bakairaneria naende, “Timori ne ribaga goeta ase ense yaito.” Bagacha nabarwani barenge ne chinguru gocha korwania Abaisraeli.

English: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Waedomu waliwakatalia Waisraeli kupita katika nchi yao, Israeli wakageuka, wakawaacha.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Abaedomu barinete Abaisraeli ribaga goeta ase ense yabo, Abaisraeli bakarua ase bare, bagaeta ensemo eng’ao.

English: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli ikaondoka kutoka Kadeshi, wakafika kwenye Mlima Hori.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okarua Kadeshi, okageenda ogaika egetunwa kia Hori.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
Kiswahili: Kwenye Mlima Hori, karibu na mpaka wa Edomu, Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni,
Ekegusii: Agwo ase egetunwa keria kia Hori, ase orobebe rw’ense ya Edomu, Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,

English: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.
Kiswahili: “Aroni atakusanywa pamoja na watu wake. Hataingia katika nchi ninayowapa Waisraeli, kwa sababu ninyi wawili mliasi dhidi ya agizo langu kwenye maji ya Meriba.
Ekegusii: “Aroni nakwe, asangererekane amo n’abanto baye. Ere tagosoa ase ense eria naeire Abaisraeli, ekiagera inwe babere mwasaretie, timwanyigwera buna nabachiigete agwo ase amaache a Meriba.

English: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;
Kiswahili: Watwae Aroni na Eleazari mwanawe, na uwapandishe juu katika Mlima wa Hori.
Ekegusii: Ira Aroni na Eleazari, momura oye, igoro ase egetunwa kia Hori.

English: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”
Kiswahili: Mvue Aroni mavazi yake, na umvike Eleazari mwanawe, kwa maana Aroni atakusanywa pamoja na watu wake; atakufa huko.”
Ekegusii: Orusie Aroni chianga chiaye chi’obokuani, ochibekere Eleazari, momura oye. Aroni ere ’nakwe, na asangererekane amo n’abanto baye, ekero more aaria.”

English: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
Kiswahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza: Wakapanda Mlima Hori mbele ya macho ya jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli.
Ekegusii: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete. Barabwo bagatiira gochia igoro as egetunwa keria kia Hori, ekero omoganda bwonsi origereretie.

English: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
Kiswahili: Mose akamvua Aroni mavazi yake na kumvika mwanawe Eleazari mavazi hayo. Naye Aroni akafia pale juu ya mlima. Kisha Mose na Eleazari wakateremka kutoka mlimani.
Ekegusii: Musa akarusia Aroni chianga chiria chi’obokuani, agachibekera Eleazari, momura o Aroni. Aroni agakwera ase egetunwa keria, na Musa na Eleazari bagatirimboka korwao.

English: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya yote ilipofahamu kwamba Aroni amekufa, jamaa yote ya Kiisraeli wakamwomboleza kwa siku thelathini.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoganda bw’Abaisraeli orooche ng’a Aroni okuure bakamoreera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato.

English: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Kikanaani wa Aradi aliyeishi huko Negebu aliposikia kwamba Waisraeli walikuwa wanakuja kwa njia ya Atharimu, aliwashambulia Waisraeli na kuwateka baadhi yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti oyomo Omokaanani, oyorenge kogaamba agwo Aradi, ensemo ya Irianyi ase ense ya Kaanani, aigwete ng’a Abaisraeli nigo bare ase enchera ekogeenda Atarimu, akabaumokera, akabarwania, na agoosa abande babo.

English: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Israeli akaweka nadhiri hii kwa Bwana: “Ikiwa utawatia watu hawa mikononi mwetu, tutaiangamiza kabisa miji yao.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakariera Omonene eira, bakaboora, “Aye koraabeeke abanto aba ase amaboko aito, intwe natosirie emechie yabo kegima.”

English: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasikiliza ombi la Waisraeli, naye akawapa ushindi juu ya Wakanaani. Wakawaangamiza kabisa na miji yao; hivyo mahali pale pakaitwa Horma.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kw’Abaisraeli, akabaa obobui igoro y’Abakaanani. Abaisraeli bakabasiria kegima, bagasaria emechie yabo. Ase ogokora oko, aase aria akarokwa Horima.

English: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakasafiri kutoka mlima Hori kupitia njia inayoelekea Bahari ya Shamu, kuizunguka Edomu. Lakini watu wakakosa uvumilivu njiani,
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua ase egetunwa keria kia Hori, bakageenda orogeendo rwabo, bagaetera enchera ekogeenda gochia omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri, erio bachie goetanana ense ya Edomu. Abanto tibaaba abaremereria ase ogoeta enchera eria.

English: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”
Kiswahili: wakamnungʼunikia Mungu na Mose, wakisema, “Kwa nini umetupandisha kutoka Misri ili tufe jangwani? Hakuna mkate! Hakuna maji! Nasi tunachukia sana chakula hiki duni!”
Ekegusii: Bakemurunganeria Nyasae na Musa, bakaboora, “Ninki mwatwegegeretie korwa ase ense ya Misiri mogatorenta toche gokwera aiga aase erooro? Aiga endagera na amaache tibiiyo, intwe twagechiigwe nendagera eye embe.”

English: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akapeleka nyoka wenye sumu katikati yao; wakawauma watu, nao Waisraeli wengi wakafa.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agatoma ching’iti chingeenda inse chire nobosongo chigaacha ase egati y’Abaisraeli, chikabaroma, na abanto abange bagakwa.

English: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh and against you. Pray to Yahweh, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.
Kiswahili: Watu wakamjia Mose na kusema, “Tumetenda dhambi wakati tuliponena dhidi ya Bwana na dhidi yako. Mwombe Bwana ili atuondolee hawa nyoka.” Hivyo Mose akawaombea hao watu.
