Ekegusii: Abanto bakageenda ase Musa, bakamoteebia, “Twakorire ebibe, ekiagera twakwanire mamincha y’Omonene na ase ore. Koranche osabe Omonene arusie ching’iti echi ase tore.” Ase ayio Musa akabasabera.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Tengeneza nyoka wa shaba na umweke juu ya mti; yeyote aliyeumwa na nyoka anaweza kumtazama na akaishi tena.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Roisia omogwekano bw’eng’iti korwa ase etai, erio oyebeke igoro ase omote, erinde kera omonto oromirwe neng’iti kararigererie eng’iti eria nabe moyo.”

English: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akatengeneza nyoka wa shaba na kumweka juu ya mti. Kisha wakati mtu yeyote aliumwa na nyoka, naye akamtazama yule nyoka wa shaba, aliishi.
Ekegusii: Musa akaroisia eng’iti y’etai, akayebeka igoro ase omote, na monto onde bwensi konya oromirwe neng’iti, onye orenge koyerigereria eng’iti eria, nigo arenge koba moyo.

English: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli waliendelea na safari yao na wakapiga kambi huko Obothi.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka kogeenda orogeendo rwabo, bagaika Oboti, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaondoka Obothi na kupiga kambi huko Iye-Abarimu, katika jangwa linalotazamana na Moabu kuelekea mawio ya jua.
Ekegusii: Naende bakarua agwo Oboti, bakageenda bagaika Iye‐Abarimu, agwo ase erooro ere moocha ya Moabu, bagatoora aroro.

English: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.
Kiswahili: Kutoka hapo waliendelea mbele wakapiga kambi kwenye Bonde la Zeredi.
Ekegusii: Na korwa aroro bakageenda bagaika ase Rikura ria Seredi, bagatoora aroro.

English: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
Kiswahili: Wakasafiri kutoka hapo na kupiga kambi kando ya Mto Arnoni, ambao uko katika jangwa lililoenea hadi nchi ya Waamori. Arnoni ni mpaka wa Moabu, kati ya Moabu na Waamori.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio bakaimoka korwa Seredi, bakageenda bagatoora sugusu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, ase erooro eria eigete orobebe rw’Abaamori. Arinoni nigo rware orobebe gati y’Abamoabu na Abaamori.

English: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu Kitabu cha Vita vya Bwana kinasema: “…Mji wa Wahebu nchini Seifa na mabonde ya Arnoni,
Ekegusii: Aya naro akogera “Egetabu gi’echisegi chi’Omonene” yakwana igoro ya “Omochie bw’Abahebu ase orogongo rwa Sufa, na amakura ase orooche rw’Arinoni rogoeta,

English: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”
Kiswahili: na miteremko ya mabonde inayofika hadi mji wa Ari na huelekea mpakani mwa Moabu.”
Ekegusii: na egetirimboko ki’amakura, aase omochie bw’Ari ore, na gochia orobebe rwa Moabu.”

English: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”
Kiswahili: Kutoka hapo waliendelea mbele hadi kisima cha Beeri; kwenye kisima ambacho Bwana alimwambia Mose, “Wakusanye watu pamoja, nami nitawapa maji.”
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase Arinoni bakagenderera n’orogeendo rwabo, bagaika Beeri. Eyio nensoko eria aase Omonene atebeetie Musa, “Sangereria abanto, na inche nimbae amaache banywe.”

English: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,
Kiswahili: Kisha Israeli akaimba wimbo huu: “Bubujika, ee kisima! Imba kuhusu maji,
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatera ogoteera oko: “Chinsoko, sokia amaache acharaare gocha, naintwe togoke na goteera ase amaache ayio.

English: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;
Kiswahili: kuhusu kisima ambacho kilichimbwa na wakuu, ambacho watu mashuhuri walikifukua, watu mashuhuri wakiwa na fimbo za utawala na bakora.” Kisha wakatoka jangwani kwenda Matana,
Ekegusii: Chinsoko abanene baremete, echio chiaremetwe nenyimbo y’omogaambi, ne chinyimbo chiabo chi’ogotaarera.” Korwa agwo ase erooro bakageenda bagaika Matana,

English: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;
Kiswahili: kutoka Matana wakafika Nahalieli, kutoka Nahalieli wakafika Bamothi,
Ekegusii: na korwa Matana bakageenda bagaika Nahalieli, na korwa agwo bakageenda bagaika Bamoti.

English: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.
Kiswahili: na kutoka Bamothi wakafika kwenye bonde lililoko Moabu, mahali ambapo kilele cha Pisga kinatazamana na nyika.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Bamoti, bakageenda gochia ase rikura riarenge ase ense y’Abaamori, ase egetirimboko ki’egetunwa gia Pisiga, ekio kerochie maate ase erooro.

English: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
Kiswahili: Israeli akawatuma wajumbe kumwambia Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori:
Ekegusii: Korwa aroro agwo Abasiraeli bagatoma abanto ase Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori bakwane nere, bamoborie,

English: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”
Kiswahili: “Uturuhusu tupite katika nchi yako. Hatutageuka kando kwenda katika mashamba au mashamba ya mizabibu, ama kunywa maji kutoka kisima chochote. Tutasafiri kwenye njia kuu ya mfalme hata tutakapokuwa tumekwisha kupita katika nchi yako.”
Ekegusii: “Koranche, otoe ribaga toete ase egati y’ense yao. Titogotiga enchera na kogobera gochia ase emegondo y’endagera, gose ey’emesabibu, gose titokonywa amaache korwa ase chinsoko chiaino, korende nigo toraete ase enchera enene goika tobe twaetanirie ense yaino.”

English: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini Sihoni hakumruhusu Israeli apite katika nchi yake. Alilikutanisha jeshi lake lote, wakaondoka kwenda jangwani ili kupigana na Israeli. Alipofika huko Yahazi, akapigana na Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende Sihoni akaanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga baete ase ense yaye. Agasangereria abarwani baye b’esegi, akageenda agaika Yahasi ase erooro, na agwo akarwania Abaisraeli.

English: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Israeli alimshinda kwa upanga na kuiteka ardhi yake kutoka Arnoni mpaka Yaboki, lakini ni hadi kufikia nchi ya Waamoni tu, kwa sababu mipaka yake ilikuwa imezungushwa ukuta.
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagakenya abanto abange, bakaira ense ya Sihoni, korwa orooche rw’Arinoni goika orooche rwa Yaboki ase ense y’Abaamoni. Ribebe ri’Abaamoni nigo riarendire ne chinguru.

English: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.
Kiswahili: Israeli akaiteka miji yote ya Waamori na kuikalia, pamoja na Heshboni na makazi yote yanayoizunguka.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira emechie yonsi y’Abaamori, bakaira na Hesiboni, erio bakamenya ase emechie amo nebichie bi’emechie eyio.

English: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.
Kiswahili: Heshboni ulikuwa mji wa Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alikuwa amepigana dhidi ya mfalme wa Moabu aliyetangulia na akawa amechukua ardhi yake yote mpaka Arnoni.
Ekegusii: Hesiboni n’oro orenge omochie omonene o Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria konya orwanirie omorwoti orenge kogambera Abaamori agwo ritang’ani. Sihoni konya oirire ense yonsi y’omorwoti oyio goikera Arinoni.

English: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu watunga mashairi husema: “Njoo Heshboni na ujengwe tena; mji wa Sihoni na ufanywe upya.
Ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera abateri be chingero bakobora: “Inchuo ase Hesiboni, tiga omochie oyo oagachwe, tiga omochie o Sihoni oagachwe na kogitwa.

English: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.
Kiswahili: “Moto uliwaka kutoka Heshboni, mwali wa moto kutoka mji wa Sihoni. Uliteketeza Ari ya Moabu, raiya wa mahali pa Arnoni palipoinuka.
Ekegusii: Omorero okarua ase Hesiboni, chimeme chi’omorero korwa omochie o Sihoni, ogasaria Ari, omochie o Moabu, ogasamba abanene b’ebigoro bi’Arinoni.

English: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.
Kiswahili: Ole wako, ee Moabu! Umeharibiwa, enyi watu wa Kemoshi! Amewatoa wanawe kuwa wakimbizi, na binti zake kama mateka kwa Mfalme Sihoni wa Waamori.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe Abamoabu! Mwasirigwe, inwe abamogosasiima Kemosi! Nere otigire abana baino abamura bagotama, bakorigia aase bakwebisa, na abana baino abaiseke boosirwe, barabwo bairirwe ase Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori.

English: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”
Kiswahili: “Lakini tumewashinda; Heshboni umeharibiwa hadi Diboni. Tumebomoa hadi kufikia Nofa, ulioenea hadi Medeba.”
Ekegusii: Intwe twabarasire chinsara; Abahesiboni basiriigwe, twabaitire goika Diboni. Tokabasiria goika Nofa na korwa Nofa goika Medeba.”

English: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Israeli akaishi katika nchi ya Waamori.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakamenya ase ense y’Abaamori.

English: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Mose kutuma wapelelezi kwenda mji wa Yazeri, Waisraeli waliteka viunga vya mji huo na kuwafukuza Waamori waliokuwa wanaishi huko.
Ekegusii: Musa agatoma chirooti gochia koroota omochie o Yaeseri. Abaisraeli bakayorwania, bakayoira amo nebichie biaye, bakabang’anyia Abaamori bamenyeteo.

English: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakageuka na kwenda katika njia inayoelekea Bashani, naye Ogu mfalme wa Bashani pamoja na jeshi lake lote wakatoka kupigana nao huko Edrei.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakairana, bagaetera ase enchera yarenge kogeenda Basani. Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, agacha amo nabarwani baye korwania Abaisraeli agwo Edirei.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Usimwogope Ogu, kwa sababu nimeshamkabidhi mikononi mwako, pamoja na jeshi lake lote na nchi yake. Mtendee kama ulivyomtendea Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala huko Heshboni.”
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tobaisa komoiroka, ekiagera namobekire ase okoboko kwao, ere amo n’abanto baye bonsi, na ense yaye. Aye goika omokore buna gwakorete Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria omenyete agwo Hesiboni.”

English: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakamuua, pamoja na wanawe na jeshi lake lote, bila ya kumwacha hata mtu mmoja hai. Nao wakaimiliki nchi yake.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagaita Ogi, bagaita nabana baye abamura, na abanto baye, goika tibatigaria nonya nomonto oyomo ore moyo. Erio bakayeira ense yaye ekaba eyabo.

English: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
Kiswahili: Kisha Waisraeli wakasafiri katika tambarare za Moabu na kupiga kambi kando ya Mto Yordani, ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenderera norogeendo rwabo gochia ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, bagatoora aroro, moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.

English: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
Kiswahili: Basi Balaki mwana wa Sipori, aliona mambo yale yote ambayo Israeli aliwatendea Waamori,
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, akaigwa amang’ana onsi Abaisraeli konya bakoreire Abaamori.

English: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Moabu aliogopa, kwa kuwa walikuwepo watu wengi sana. Hakika, Moabu alijawa na hofu kubwa kwa sababu ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Abamoabu bakoboa abanto abwo mono, ekiagera nigo barenge abange; ee Abamoabu bakabegosera Abaisraeli.

English: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
Kiswahili: Wamoabu wakawaambia wazee wa Midiani, “Umati huu wa watu unakwenda kuramba kila kitu kinachotuzunguka, kama maksai arambavyo majani ya shambani.” Kwa hiyo Balaki mwana wa Sipori, ambaye alikuwa mfalme wa Moabu wakati huo,
Ekegusii: Abamoabu bagateebia abagaaka ba Midiani, “Omoganda oyo omonene nigo ogochia komena okoore kera egento getoetanaine aiga, buna chintang’ana chikomena obonyansi ase egetii chiabokoora.” Ase engaki eria Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, nere orenge omorwoti bw’Abamoabu.

English: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.
Kiswahili: akatuma wajumbe kwenda kumwita Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ambaye alikuwa huko Pethori, karibu na Mto Frati, katika nchi yake ya kuzaliwa. Balaki akasema: “Taifa limekuja kutoka Misri, nao wamefunika uso wa nchi, nao wametua karibu nami.
Ekegusii: Ere agatoma abanto ase Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, agwo Petori ore ang’e norooche rw’Eufarati, ase ense yabo. Barabwo bakamoteebia amang’ana a Balaki. “Rigereria, abanto bachire korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nabarabwo nabange, batubete orogongo rwonsi, batoorire ang’e naintwe, barigereretie ense yane.

English: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”
Kiswahili: Sasa uje kuwalaani watu hawa, kwa kuwa wana nguvu sana kuniliko. Kisha huenda nikaweza kuwashinda na kuwatoa nje ya nchi. Kwa kuwa ninajua kwamba, wale unaowabariki wanabarikiwa na wale unaowalaani wanalaaniwa.”
Ekegusii: Bono inchwo obandagererie, ekiagera barabwo nigo bare ne chinguru chinyinge gotobua. Gokobaragereria, ande nabo ndabaise kobarwania mbabue na kobaseria, barabwo barue ase ense y’ane. Nimanyete ng’a oyo aye ogosesenia, nigo agoseseneka, na oyo aye okoragereria, nigo akoragerereka.”

English: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.
Kiswahili: Wazee wa Moabu na wa Midiani wakaondoka, wakiwa wamechukua ada ya uaguzi. Walipokwenda kwa Balaamu, wakamweleza kile Balaki alikuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Abagaaka ba Moabu na ab’Abamidiani bakabogoria eng’eria y’okoringoreria ase amaboko abo, bakayeirera Baalamu, bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi a Balaki.

English: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahweh shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
Kiswahili: Balaamu akawaambia, “Mlale hapa usiku huu, nami nitawaletea jibu lile Bwana atakalonipa.” Kwa hiyo wakuu wa Moabu wakakaa naye.
Ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia abanto baria, “Rara aa ase obotuko obo, nainche nimbarentere amairanerio korwa ase Omonene ankio mambia.” Ase ayio abanene baria ba Moabu bakabeera aroro amo na Baalamu.

English: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”
Kiswahili: Mungu akamjia Balaamu na kumuuliza, “Watu gani hawa walio pamoja nawe?”
Ekegusii: Nyasae agacha ase Baalamu, akamobooria, “Abanto abamore komo mbarabi?”

English: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,
Kiswahili: Balaamu akamwambia Mungu, “Balaki mwana wa Sipori, mfalme wa Moabu, alinipelekea ujumbe huu:
Ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, omorwoti o Moabu, nere otomire abanto aba ase ’nde, ogoteeba ng’a

English: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”
Kiswahili: ‘Taifa ambalo limekuja kutoka Misri limefunika uso wa nchi. Sasa uje unilaanie hao watu. Kisha huenda nitaweza kupigana nao na kuwafukuza.’ ”
Ekegusii: abanto bachire korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na barabwo nigo bare abange, batubete orogongo rwonsi. Ere nigo aganetie imbaragererie, erinde abarwanie, ababue na kobaseria.”

English: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Balaamu, “Usiende pamoja nao. Hupaswi kulaani watu hao, kwa kuwa wamebarikiwa.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobaisa kogeenda amo nabarabwo gose gochia koragereria Abaisraeli. Barabwo nigo basesenirie.”

English: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for Yahweh refuses to permit me to go with you.”
Kiswahili: Asubuhi iliyofuata Balaamu akaamka, akawaambia wakuu wa Balaki, “Rudini katika nchi yenu, kwa kuwa Bwana amenikataza nisiende pamoja nanyi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Baalamu akaimoka mambia rituko ria kabere, agateebia abanene baria batometwe na Balaki, “Bono inwe irana mogende ase ense yaino, ekiagera Omonene bwangire kong’a ribaga ngende amo nainwe.”

English: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakuu wa Moabu wakarudi kwa Balaki na kumwambia, “Balaamu amekataa kuja pamoja nasi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanene baria ba Moabu bakaimoka bakageenda ase Balaki bakamoteebia, “Baalamu nigo aanga, tacheti amo naintwe.”

English: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaki akatuma wakuu wengine, wengi zaidi na wanaoheshimiwa zaidi kuliko wale wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Naende Balaki agatoma abanene bande, abange kobua baria b’eritang’ani, naende ababwate amasikani amanene kobua abwo.

English: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,
Kiswahili: Wakafika kwa Balaamu na kumwambia: “Balaki mwana wa Sipori amesema hivi: Usiruhusu kitu chochote kikuzuie kuja kwangu,
Ekegusii: Nabarabwo bagaacha ase Baalamu, bakamoteebia, “Aya naro Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, agoteeba: Koranche totiga kende gionsi kegotange tochicha.

English: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”
Kiswahili: kwa sababu nitakulipa vizuri sana na kufanya lolote usemalo. Njoo unilaanie watu hawa.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene, inche nigo ’ngochia kogokorera aya arakorentere amasikani amanene, naende kende gionsi oramborie, ekio ningokorere; aye inchwo ondagererie abanto aba.”

English: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh my God, to do less or more.
Kiswahili: Lakini Balaamu akawajibu, “Hata kama Balaki angenipa jumba lake la kifalme likiwa limejazwa fedha na dhahabu, singeweza kufanya kitu chochote kikubwa au kidogo ili kutenda kitu nje ya agizo la Bwana Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Korende Baalamu akairaneria abasomba baria ba Balaki, akabateebia, “Nonya Balaki arenge kong’a enyomba yaye eichire chifeta ne chitaabu, tintageti gosaria na kwanga koigwera amang’an’Omonene Nyasae anchiikire, na gokora amang’ana ande ase ogwancha kwane, abe amake gose amanene.

English: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else Yahweh will speak to me.”
Kiswahili: Mlale hapa usiku huu kama wale wengine walivyofanya, nami nitatafuta ni nini kingine Bwana atakachoniambia.”
Ekegusii: Nababoririe komoranche, mobeere aa ase obotuko bwa reero, erio imborie Omonene, imanye gose nabwate amang’ana ande aranteebie.”

English: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”
Kiswahili: Usiku ule Bwana akamjia Balaamu na kumwambia, “Kwa kuwa watu hawa wamekuja kukuita wewe, nenda nao, lakini ufanye tu lile nitakalokuambia.”
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agacha ase Baalamu ase obotuko boria, akamoteebia, “Onye abanto aba bachire gokorangeria, imoka ogende amo nabarabwo, korende egento ndagochiike nakio gioka orakore.”

English: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
Kiswahili: Balaamu akaamka asubuhi, akatandika punda wake akaenda pamoja na wakuu wa Moabu.
Ekegusii: Baalamu akaimoka mambia rituko ria kabere, akaberekia etigere yaye egeikaransero, akageenda amo nabanene baria ba Moabu.

English: God’s anger burned because he went; and Yahweh’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alikasirika sana alipokwenda, naye malaika wa Bwana akasimama barabarani kumpinga. Balaamu alikuwa amepanda punda wake, na watumishi wake wawili walikuwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Ekero Baalamu aimogete kogeenda amo nabasomba baye babere oriinete etigere, Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene ase are; na omomalaika Omonene agatenena ase enchera gati komotanga tageenda.

English: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.
Kiswahili: Wakati punda alipomwona malaika wa Bwana akiwa amesimama barabarani akiwa na upanga uliofutwa mkononi mwake, punda akageukia upande kuelekea shambani. Balaamu akampiga ili amrudishe barabarani.
Ekegusii: Etigere eria egachia korora omomalaika oria obwate omoyio o birende koboko kwaye, ekagobera gochia enchera ensemo, ekageenda ase omogondo. Baalamu agaaka etigere eria koyeirania ase enchera.

English: Then Yahweh’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
Kiswahili: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana akasimama katika njia nyembamba iliyo kati ya mashamba mawili ya mizabibu, yakiwa na kuta pande zote mbili.
Ekegusii: Naende omomalaika oria Omonene akageenda ase enchera yarenge engote gati y’emegondo y’emesabibu, ne chimbago nchiarenge ase chinsemo chionsi ibere.

English: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.
Kiswahili: Punda alipomwona malaika wa Bwana, alijisukumiza karibu na ukuta, na kugandamiza mguu wa Balaamu ukutani. Ndipo Balaamu akampiga tena punda.
Ekegusii: Etigere eria egachia korora omomalaika oria Omonene, ekemigereria gochia orobago ang’e, ekabwaterania okogoro kwa Baalamu ase orobago, na Baalamu akayeaka naende.

English: Yahweh’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika wa Bwana akaendelea mbele na kusimama mahali pembamba ambapo hapakuwepo nafasi ya kugeuka, upande wa kulia wala wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Erio naende omomalaika Omonene akageenda bosio, agatenena aase aagote mono, ase ribaga ritarenge ri’okogobera gochia ensemo ya borio, gose eya bomosi.

English: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
Kiswahili: Punda alipomwona malaika wa Bwana, alilala chini Balaamu angali amempanda, naye Balaamu akakasirika na kumpiga kwa fimbo yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero etigere yarooche omomalaika oria, ekarara inse, na Baalamu oyeriinete mogongo igoro. Baalamu akaba nendamwamu enene mono, agaaka etigere eria nenyimbo yaye.

English: Yahweh opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akakifungua kinywa cha punda, akamwambia Balaamu, “Nimekutendea nini kinachokufanya unipige mara hizi tatu?”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakunora omonwa bw’etigere eria goika egakwana, ekaboria Baalamu, “Ngento ki nagokoreire goika kwang’akire chintunda echi isato?”

English: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”
Kiswahili: Balaamu akamjibu punda, “Umenifanya mjinga! Kama ningelikuwa na upanga mkononi mwangu, ningelikuua sasa hivi.”
Ekegusii: Baalamu akayeiraneria, “Nekiagera gwankoreire echeche. Onye nabwate omoro ase okoboko kwane, nanga nigo narenge kogoita.”

English: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”
Kiswahili: Punda akamwambia Balaamu, “Je, mimi si punda wako mwenyewe, ambaye umenipanda siku zote, hadi leo? Je, nimekuwa na tabia ya kufanya hivi kwako?” Akajibu, “Hapana.”
Ekegusii: Naende etigere ekaboria Baalamu, “Inee! Inche tindi etigere yao, kwabeire gokondiina ase amatuko y’obogima bwao bwonsi goika rituko eri ria reero? Inee! Inche nana‐gokora egento buna eke ase ore?” Baalamu akairaneria, “Yaya.”

English: Then Yahweh opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akafungua macho ya Balaamu, naye akamwona malaika wa Bwana amesimama barabarani akiwa ameufuta upanga wake. Balaamu akainama, akaanguka kifudifudi.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaramokia Baalamu amaiso, na ere akarora omomalaika Omonene oteneine ase enchera gati, obwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye. Baalamu agekumba, agatung’ama inse, akaumama.

English: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana akamuuliza Balaamu, “Kwa nini umempiga punda wako mara tatu hizi? Nimekuja kukuzuia kwa sababu njia yako imepotoka mbele yangu.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene akaboria Baalamu, “Nase ki gwaakire etigere yao chintunda echi isato? Rora, inche nigo nacha kogotanga, ekiagera orogeendo oro okogeenda norw’ogosaria rore mamincha yane.

English: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”
Kiswahili: Punda aliniona na kunikwepa mara hizi tatu. Kama punda hangenikwepa, hakika ningekuwa nimeshakuua sasa, lakini ningemwacha punda hai.”
Ekegusii: Korende etigire ero yandora, nero yeonchora gochia enchera ensemo chintunda isato. Ekeene, onye etigere eye eteonchora gochia ensemo korwa asende, nanga nigo nagoita okwe, ntige etigere ere moyo.”

English: Balaam said to Yahweh’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”
Kiswahili: Balaamu akamwambia malaika wa Bwana, “Nimetenda dhambi. Sikutambua kuwa umesimama barabarani kunizuia. Basi kama haikupendezi, nitarudi.”
Ekegusii: Erio Baalamu agateebia omomalaika Omonene, “Inche nakorire ebibe, tinamanyete ng’a naye gwateneine gati y’enchera gontanga. Korende bono onye orogeendo rokororekana ng’a norobe ase ore, tiga ing’irane.”

English: Yahweh’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana akamwambia Balaamu, “Uende na watu hao, lakini useme tu lile nikuambialo.” Kwa hiyo Balaamu akaenda na wale wakuu wa Balaki.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene agateebia Baalamu, “Genda amo n’abanto abwo, korende amang’ana aria ndagochike, naro oka ogochia gokwana.” Bono Baalamu akageenda amo nabanene baria ba Balaki.

English: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.
Kiswahili: Balaki aliposikia kuwa Balaamu anakuja, akatoka kumlaki katika mji wa Moabu, katika mpaka wa Arnoni, ukingoni mwa nchi yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Balaki aigwete ng’a Baalamu inchera are gocha, akageenda komoorototera agwo Ari, omochie orenge ang’e norooche rw’Arinoni, ase orobebe rwa Moabu.

English: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”
Kiswahili: Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Je, sikukupelekea jumbe za haraka? Kwa nini hukuja kwangu? Hivi kweli mimi siwezi kukulipa?”
Ekegusii: Balaki akaboria Baalamu, “Inee! Naki otachete ekero natomete abanto gokorangeria? Nase ki otachete? Nigo gwakagete ng’a tingocha gokoa ogosika kogoisaine?”

English: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”
Kiswahili: Balaamu akajibu, “Vema, sasa nimekuja kwako. Lakini kwani nina uwezo wa kusema tu chochote? Ni lazima niseme tu kile ambacho Mungu ataweka kinywani mwangu.”
Ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Rora, bono nachire ase ore, nigo okagete ng’a inche nimbwate okobua nonya nogoke gokwana ring’ana ase ore? Ring’ana riria Nyasae aranteebie nario ndakwane.”

English: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaamu alikwenda na Balaki mpaka Kiriath-Husothi.
Ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akageenda amo na Balaki, bagaika Kiriati‐Husoti.

English: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.
Kiswahili: Balaki akatoa dhabihu ya ngʼombe na kondoo; baadhi yake akampa Balaamu na wakuu waliokuwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Balaki akanyenya chiombe ne ching’ondi, akaa Baalamu amo nabanene barenge amo nere.

English: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi iliyofuata Balaki akamchukua Balaamu mpaka Bamoth-Baali, na kutoka huko Balaamu akawaona baadhi ya watu.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere mambia Balaki akaira Baalamu igoro ase Bamoti‐Baali, na korwa igoro agwo Baalamu akarora ensemo eyemo y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli.

English: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
Kiswahili: Balaamu akasema, “Nijengee hapa madhabahu saba, mnitayarishie mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba.”
Ekegusii: Baalamu akamoteebia Balaki, “Ng’agachere aiga ebisasimero bitano na bibere, naende ondetere chieri isan’aibere, ne chimingichi isan’aibere.”

English: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.
Kiswahili: Balaki akafanya kama Balaamu alivyosema; hao wawili kila mmoja wao akatoa fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Balaki agakora buna Baalamu amoteebetie, na abwo babere bakarua ekeng’wanso igoro ase kera egesasiimero, eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo.

English: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps Yahweh will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Kaa hapa kando ya sadaka yako wakati mimi ninakwenda kando. Huenda Bwana atakuja kukutana nami. Lolote atakalonifunulia, nitakuambia.” Basi akaenda hata mahali peupe palipoinuka.
Ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Beera aa, otenene mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ogosambwa; inche ’ngende korora gose ande Omonene nang’orokere. Kende gionsi aranteebie, ekio nakio ndagoteebie.” Baalamu agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro aarabu.

English: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”
Kiswahili: Mungu akakutana naye, kisha Balaamu akasema, “Nimekwisha kutengeneza madhabahu saba, na juu ya kila madhabahu nimetoa sadaka ya fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae agaika korwa igoro, akaumerana na Baalamu. Baalamu akamoteebia, “Naagachire ebisasimero bitano na bibere, naende narure igoro ase kera ekemo eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo.”

English: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akaweka ujumbe katika kinywa cha Balaamu na kusema, “Rudi kwa Balaki umpe ujumbe huu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Baalamu ring’ana agochia gokwana. Naende akamotoma airane ase Balaki namang’ana ayio ayio.

English: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
Kiswahili: Basi Balaamu akarudi kwa Balaki, akamkuta amesimama kando ya sadaka yake akiwa na wakuu wote wa Moabu.
Ekegusii: Baalamu akairana gochia ase Balaki, akamonyora oteneine mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, amo nabanene bonsi b’Abamoabu.

English: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Balaamu akasema ujumbe wake: “Balaki amenileta kutoka Aramu, mfalme wa Moabu kutoka milima ya mashariki. Akasema, ‘Njoo, unilaanie Yakobo; njoo unishutumie Israeli.’
Ekegusii: Baalamu agakwana obobani bwaye, agateeba: “Balaki, omorwoti o Moabu, ondetire korwa Siiria, korwa ase ebitunwa bia Moocha, oteebire: Inchuo, ondagererie abanto ba Yakobo, inchwo ogambie Abaisraeli.

English: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?
Kiswahili: Nitawezaje kuwalaani, hao ambao Mungu hajawalaani? Nitawezaje kuwashutumu hao ambao Bwana hakuwashutumu?
Ekegusii: Naki ’ndakore ndagererie oyo Nyasae ataragerereti? Naki ’ndakore ’ngambie oy’Omonene atagambeti?

English: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.
Kiswahili: Kutoka vilele vya miamba ninawaona, kutoka mahali palipoinuka ninawatazama. Ninaliona taifa ambalo wanaishi peke yao, nao hawahesabiwi kama mojawapo ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Korwa aiga ase ebitare igoro nimbarooche, na korwa aiga ase ebitunwa nimbarigereretie. Abwo n’abanto bamenyete boka, beatananire korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku.

English: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kuhesabu mavumbi ya Yakobo, au kuhesabu robo ya Israeli? Mimi na nife kifo cha mtu mwenye haki, na mwisho wangu na uwe kama wao!”
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobara ororeria rwa Yakobo, abwo bare abange buna orotu rw’amaroba? Gose ning’o oranyare kobara nonya nenseemo ya inye y’Abaisraeli? Tiga inkwe buna oyomo bw’abanyene oboronge, na omoerio bw’amatuko ane obe buna oyoobo.”

English: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”
Kiswahili: Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Ni nini ulichonitendea? Nimekuleta ulaani adui zangu, lakini wewe badala yake umewabariki!”
Ekegusii: Balaki akaboria Baalamu, “Ngento ki eke aye gwankoreire? Nigo nakorangeretie ng’a oche obaragererie ababisa bane, na rora, ribaga ri’ayio kwabasesenirie.”

English: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”
Kiswahili: Balaamu akajibu, “Je, hainipasi kusema kile Bwana anachoweka katika kinywa changu?”
Ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Inee! Tiyangwenerete inyigwere na gokwana amang’ana ari’Omonene agonteebia nkwane?”

English: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Balaki akamwambia, “Twende pamoja mahali pengine ambapo unaweza kuwaona; utawaona baadhi tu wala si wote. Nawe kutoka huko, unilaanie hao.”
Ekegusii: Balaki akamoteebia, “Inchuo, togende amo naye goika aase ande aao. Korwa aroro nonyare korora abare ang’e. Tokorora bonsi. Korwa aase agwo nobandagererie.”

English: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
Kiswahili: Basi akampeleka kwenye shamba la Sofimu, juu ya kilele cha Mlima Pisga. Pale akajenga madhabahu saba na kutoa sadaka ya fahali na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Akamoira goika ase omogondo o Sofimu agwo ase egechuria gia Pisiga. Agwo Balaki akaagacha ebisasimero bitano na bibere, akarua eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo igoro ase kera egesasiimero.

English: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”
Kiswahili: Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Kaa hapa kando ya sadaka yako wakati ninapokwenda kuonana na Mungu kule.”
Ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Beera aa, otenene ensemo y’ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ogosambwa inche ’ngende aaria ng’umbu, toumerane n’Omonene.”

English: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akakutana na Balaamu, akaweka ujumbe katika kinywa chake akasema, “Rudi kwa Balaki umpe ujumbe huu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoorokera Baalamu, akamoteebia amang’ana arenge gochia gokwana, naende akamotoma airane ase Balaki namang’ana ayio ayio.

English: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”
Kiswahili: Basi Balaamu akarudi kwa Balaki, akamkuta amesimama kando ya sadaka yake, akiwa na wakuu wa Moabu. Balaki akamuuliza, “Je, Bwana amesema nini?”
Ekegusii: Baalamu akairana gochia ase Balaki, akamonyora oteneine mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, na abanene b’Abamoabu bateneine agwo amo nere. Balaki akamobooria, “Mang’ana ki Omonene akwanire?”

English: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Balaamu akasema ujumbe wake: “Balaki, inuka na usikilize, nisikie mimi, wewe mwana wa Sipori.
Ekegusii: Baalamu agachaaka gokwana obobani bwaye, agateeba, “Inchuo aye Balaki, omwana o Sipori, ontegerere oigwe aya ’ngokwana!

English: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?
Kiswahili: Mungu si mtu, hata aseme uongo, wala yeye si mwanadamu, hata ajute. Je, anasema, kisha asitende? Je, anaahidi, asitimize?
Ekegusii: Nyasae tari omonto, erinde akwane oborimo, gose tari Mwanyabaanto, erinde anyare koonchoka. Inee! Aya akwanire, takonyara koyakora? Gose, aya ateebire, takonyara koyaikerania?

English: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
Kiswahili: Nimepokea agizo kubariki; amebariki, nami siwezi kubadilisha.
Ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo nachigetwe ng’a ’nsesenie; na ekero Nyasae asesenirie, inche tinkonyara koirania ogosesenigwa okwo.

English: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
Kiswahili: “Haijaonekana bahati mbaya katika Yakobo, wala taabu katika Israeli. Bwana, Mungu wao yu pamoja nao, nayo sauti kuu ya Mfalme imo katikati yao.
Ekegusii: Ere tarochi obobe ase Yakobo, tarochi bokong’u bonde ase Abaisraeli. Omonene, Nyasae obo, nigo are amo nabarabwo, igo bakoraria nomochengo ng’a omorwoti nareo.

English: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
Kiswahili: Mungu aliwatoa kutoka Misri; wao wana nguvu za nyati.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri; barabwo nigo babwate chinguru buna echi’eng’era.

English: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’
Kiswahili: Hakuna uchawi dhidi ya Yakobo, wala hakuna uaguzi dhidi ya Israeli. Sasa itasemwa kuhusu Yakobo na Israeli, ‘Tazama yale Mungu aliyotenda!’
Ekegusii: Oborogi tibogokora gento ase abanto ba Yakobo, gose oboriori ase Abaisraeli. Nakwanwe igoro y’ abanto ba Yakobo, nabwo Abaisraeli: Rora aya Nyasae akorire!

English: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”
Kiswahili: Taifa lainuka kama simba jike; linajiinua kama simba ambaye hatulii mpaka amalize kurarua mawindo yake na kunywa damu ya mawindo yake.”
Ekegusii: Rigereria abanto abwo nigo banga buna endo eaberi ekoboka, na buna endo ekoimokerera igoro, teri korara goika eraria echi yatwarire, goika eranywa amanyinga ay’echi yaitire.”

English: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Usiwalaani kabisa, wala usiwabariki kabisa!”
Ekegusii: Naende Balaki agateebia Baalamu, “Bono tobaisa kobaragereria, gose tobaisa kobasesenia nonya ng’ake.”

English: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do’?”
Kiswahili: Balaamu akajibu, “Je, sikukuambia ni lazima nifanye lolote analosema Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Korende Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Tinagoteebia ng’a amang’ana onsi Omonene agonteebia, ayio naro ’ndakore?”

English: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
Kiswahili: Basi Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Njoo, nikupeleke mahali pengine. Huenda itampendeza Mungu kukuruhusu unilaanie hao watu kutoka mahali hapo.”
Ekegusii: Balaki agateebia Baalamu, “Bono inchwo ’nkoire aase ande aao. Aande gose Nyasae nanche obandagererie korwa aroro.”

English: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
Kiswahili: Balaki akamchukua Balaamu juu ya Mlima Peori, unaotazamana na nyika.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Balaki akaira Baalamu gochia ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Peori, bakarigereria erooro inse.

English: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
Kiswahili: Balaamu akasema, “Nijengee hapa madhabahu saba, uandae mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba kwa ajili yangu.”
Ekegusii: Baalamu akamoteebia, “Ng’agachere aiga ebisasimero bitano na bibere, na ondetere chieri isan’aibere, ne chimingichi isan’aibere.”

English: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
Kiswahili: Balaki akafanya kama Balaamu alivyosema, kisha akatoa sadaka ya fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Balaki agakora buna atebetigwe, akarua eeri eyemo amo n’emingichi eyemo ase kera egesasiimero.

English: When Balaam saw that it pleased Yahweh to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Basi Balaamu alipoona imempendeza Bwana kubariki Israeli, hakuendelea tena kutafuta uchawi kama nyakati nyingine, bali aligeuza uso wake kuelekea nyikani.
Ekegusii: Ekero Baalamu arooche ng’a Omonene nigo amoganetie asesenie Abaisraeli tagendete naende ase okorigia oboringoria buna chingaki chiria chi’eritang’ani, korende akaonchora obosio bwaye gochia ase erooro.

English: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.
Kiswahili: Balaamu alipotazama nje na kuona Israeli amepiga kambi kabila kwa kabila, Roho wa Mungu akawa juu yake,
Ekegusii: Agachia koimokia amaiso, aye, akarora Abaisraeli batoorete egesaku ase egesaku. Erio Omoika o Nyasae ogaacha igoro ase are.

English: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
Kiswahili: naye akatoa ujumbe wake: “Ujumbe wa Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ujumbe wake yeye ambaye jicho lake linaona vizuri;
Ekegusii: Agwo Baalamu agakwana obobani obo: “Amang’ana aya naro inche Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, ’ngokwana amang’ana aya nay’ane, inche omonto oramokiigwe amaiso.

English: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
Kiswahili: ujumbe wake yeye ambaye husikia maneno ya Mungu, ambaye huona maono kutoka kwa Mwenyezi, ambaye huanguka kifudifudi, na ambaye macho yake yamefunguka:
Ekegusii: Aya namang’ana y’omonto okoigwa buya aya Nyasae agoteeba, oyo okorora amaroro akorwa ase ere oria Omonguru, oyogotung’ama inse na koramokigwa amaiso aye.

English: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
Kiswahili: “Tazama jinsi yalivyo mazuri mahema yako, ee Yakobo, maskani yako, ee Israeli!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, chiema chiaino naki chire chingiya! Inwe Abaisraeli aase momenyete, naki are aagiya mono!

English: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which Yahweh has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
Kiswahili: “Kama mabonde, yanaenea, kama bustani kando ya mto, kama miti ya udi iliyopandwa na Bwana, kama mierezi kando ya maji.
Ekegusii: Igo mogwekaine omweya orambogete gochia aare, gose emegondo ere mbarabare y’orooche, nigo more buna emegaka Omonene asimegete. Gose emecharake ere ase amaache mbarabare.

English: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.
Kiswahili: Maji yatatiririka kutoka ndoo zake; mbegu yake itakuwa na maji tele. “Mfalme wake atakuwa mkuu kuliko Mfalme Agagi; ufalme wake utatukuka.
Ekegusii: Amache amaange naiteke korwa ase chinyongo chiabo na oroiboro rwabo nigo roraabe oronge mono. Omorwoti obo nabe omonene goetania Agagi, na oborwoti bwaye inabotogigwe mono.

English: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
Kiswahili: “Mungu alimleta kutoka Misri; yeye ana nguvu kama nyati. Anayararua mataifa yaliyo adui zake, na kuvunja mifupa yao vipande vipande; huwachoma kwa mishale yake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri, chinguru chiabo nigo chire buna echi’eng’era. Barabwo mbasirie abanto abare mamincha yabo, babune amauga y’emebere y’ababisa babo, na baabarase ne chinsara chiabo.

English: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
Kiswahili: Hujikunyata na kuvizia kama simba, kama simba jike; nani anayethubutu kumwamsha? “Abarikiwe kila akubarikiye, na alaaniwe kila akulaaniye!”
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli nigo batung’aime inse buna endo, buna endo eaberi, ning’o oraabe noboremu abature? Asesenigwe omonto oria okobasesenia inwe, na aragererigwe omonto oria okobaragereria inwe.”

English: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.
Kiswahili: Ndipo hasira ya Balaki ikawaka dhidi ya Balaamu. Akapiga mikono yake pamoja, akamwambia Balaamu, “Nilikuita uje kuwalaani adui zangu, lakini umewabariki mara hizi tatu.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio Balaki akaba n’endamwamu enene ase Baalamu, agaaka chinkobi, akamoteebia, “Nigo nakorangeretie ng’a oragererie ababisa bane, na rora, bono aye kwabasesenirie chintunda echi isato.

English: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from honor.”
Kiswahili: Sasa ondoka upesi uende nyumbani! Mimi nilisema nitakuzawadia vizuri sana, lakini Bwana amekuzuia usizawadiwe.”
Ekegusii: Bono irana gochia bwoo. Inche igo narengereretie gokoa ogosika okonene, korende Omonene okorinire, tonyora ogosikwa okwo.”

English: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Je, hukumbuki jinsi nilivyowaambia wajumbe uliowatuma kwangu? Niliwaambia hivi,
Ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Inee! Tinateebetie abanto baria gwatomete ase inde ng’a

English: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond Yahweh’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says’?
Kiswahili: ‘Hata ikiwa Balaki angenipa jumba lake la kifalme likiwa limejazwa fedha na dhahabu, nisingeweza kufanya kitu chochote kwa matakwa yangu, kikiwa kizuri au kibaya, kwenda kinyume na agizo la Bwana, nami imenipasa kusema tu kile Bwana atakachosema’?
Ekegusii: Balaki naisa kong’a enyomba yaye eichire ne chifeta, ne chitaabu, tinkonyara kwanga koigwera amang’an’Omonene anchikiire, na tingokora gento kende ase ogwancha kwane, abe amabe, gose amaya. Ay’Omonene agoteeba, ayio naro ngwenerete ’nkore.

English: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”
Kiswahili: Sasa ninarudi kwa watu wangu. Lakini njoo, nikuonye kuhusu kile watu hawa watakachowatenda watu wako siku zijazo.”
Ekegusii: “Bono ’nkoirana inde gochia ase abanto bane. Inchuo ’nkomanyie egento Abaisraeli barakore ase abanto bao ase amatuko agochia goocha.”

English: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaamu akatoa ujumbe wake: “Ujumbe wa Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ujumbe wake yeye ambaye jicho lake linaona vizuri;
Ekegusii: Erio Baalamu agakwana obobani obo: “Amang’ana aya inche Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, ’ngokwana, amang’ana aya nay’ane, inche omonto oramokiigwe amaiso.

English: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
Kiswahili: ujumbe wake yeye ambaye husikia maneno ya Mungu, ambaye ana maarifa kutoka kwa Aliye Juu Sana, huona maono kutoka Mwenyezi, ambaye huanguka kifudifudi na ambaye macho yake yamefunguka:
Ekegusii: Aya namang’ana y’omonto okoigwa buya aya Nyasae agoteeba, naende onyorire okomanya korwa ase oria ore Igoro Mono. Na okorora amaroro akorwa ase oria Omobui, oyogotung’ama inse na koramokigwa amaiso.

English: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.
Kiswahili: “Namwona yeye, lakini si sasa; namtazama yeye, lakini si karibu. Nyota itatoka kwa Yakobo, fimbo ya ufalme itainuka kutoka kwa Israeli. Atawaponda Wamoabu vipaji vya nyuso na mafuvu yote ya wana wa Shethi.
Ekegusii: Namororire, korende tari bono; namorigereirie, korende tari ang’e. Eng’enang’eni neoroke korwa ase egati y’ abanto ba Yakobo, na enyimbo y’obogambi neoroke korwa ase Abaisraeli. Nesenyente chintakunero chi’emetwe y’Abamoabu, neiyerie abanto b’ororeeria rwa Seti.

English: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
Kiswahili: Edomu itamilikiwa, Seiri, adui wake, itamilikiwa, lakini Israeli atakuwa na nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ense ya Edomu nebugwe eirwe, Edomu nebugwe ebe eyabo, eyio nense y’ababisa babo. Abaisraeli ’mbagenderere koba n’okobua.

English: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
Kiswahili: Mtawala atakuja kutoka kwa Yakobo na kuangamiza walionusurika katika mji.”
Ekegusii: Omogambi naoroke korwa ase egati y’ abanto ba Yakobo asirie abanto batameire emechie banyore oborendi.”

English: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaamu akawaona watu wa Amaleki, na kutoa ujumbe wake: “Amaleki ilikuwa ya kwanza miongoni mwa mataifa, lakini mwisho wake itaangamizwa milele.”
Ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akarigereria Abaameleki, agakwana obobani obo: “Abaameleki nabwo barenge ab’eritang’ani ase ebisaku, korende ase omoerio nabasirigwe kegima.”

English: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaona Wakeni, akatoa ujumbe wake: “Makao yenu ni salama, kiota chenu kiko kwenye mwamba.
Ekegusii: Naende akarigereria Abakeni, agakwana obobani obo: “Obomenyo bwabo nabogenderere kobao, buna egeswa keagachire ase engako y’egetare.

English: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo ninyi Wakeni mtaangamizwa Ashuru atakapowachukua mateka.”
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Abakeni nabasirigwe, ekero Abaasuri barabaire babe abasibwa.”

English: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?
Kiswahili: Ndipo akatoa ujumbe wake: “Lo, ni nani atakayeweza kuishi wakati Mungu atakapofanya hili?
Ekegusii: Baalamu akagenderera gokwana obobani bwaye: “Obee! Ning’o oranyare koba moyo ekero Nyasae arakore aya?

English: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”
Kiswahili: Meli zitakuja kutoka pwani za Kitimu, zitaitiisha Ashuru na Eberi, lakini nao pia wataangamizwa.”
Ekegusii: Abanto ’mbachiche ne chimeeri korwa ase engegu ya Kitimu, nabarabwo ’mbachaande Abaasuri na Abaeberi, korende barabwo abanyene ’mbasirigwe boigo.”

English: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
Kiswahili: Kisha Balaamu akainuka na kurudi nyumbani kwake, naye Balaki akashika njia yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akaimoka, akairana bwoye, na Balaki nere akabwatia enchera, akageenda bwoye.

English: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;
Kiswahili: Israeli alipokuwa akikaa Shitimu, wanaume wa Israeli walianza kuzini na wanawake wa Kimoabu,
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli batoorete agwo Sitimu, abanto bagachaaka gokora obotomani n’abakuungu b’Abamoabu.

English: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.
Kiswahili: ambao waliwaalika kushiriki katika kutoa kafara kwa miungu yao. Watu wakala na kusujudu mbele ya miungu hii.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakarangeria Abaisraeli bagende ase emeyega y’ebing’wanso yarenge gokorerwa chinyasae chiabo, na barabwo bakabiria, naende bagasasiima chinyasae chi’Abamoabu.

English: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Israeli akaungana katika kumwabudu Baali wa Peori. Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi yao.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabwatana n’enyasae yarenge korokwa Baali‐Peori, bakayesasiima. Omonene akaba n’endamwamu enene ase bare.

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahweh may turn away from Israel.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Uwachukue viongozi wote wa watu hawa, uwaue na uwaweke hadharani mchana peupe mbele za Bwana, ili hasira kali ya Bwana iweze kuondoka kwa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia Musa, “Renta abatang’ani bonsi b’Abaisraeli, obasunge agwo ase obosio bwane erioba ribasambe, erinde endamwamu yane enene etige Abaisraeli.”

English: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawaambia waamuzi wa Israeli, “Kila mmoja wenu lazima awaue wale wanaume wenu, walioshiriki katika kumwabudu Baali wa Peori.”
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia abagaambi b’Abaisraeli, “Kera oyomo ase more, tiga aite abanto baye bonsi baria babwatanire na Baali‐Peori.”

English: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mwanaume wa Kiisraeli akamleta mwanamke wa Kimidiani katika jamaa yake palepale mbele ya Mose na mkutano wote wa Israeli walipokuwa wakilia kwenye lango la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Omoisraeli oyomo agacha akarentana omokungu oyomo bw’Abamidiani ase eamate yaye, ase obosio bwa Musa amo nomoganda bwonsi kobateneine agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bakorera.

English: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.
Kiswahili: Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari, mwana wa kuhani Aroni, alipoona jambo hili, akaondoka kwenye kusanyiko, akachukua mkuki mkononi mwake,
Ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Aroni Omokuani, akaimoka korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, akabogoria ritimo,

English: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: akamfuata yule Mwisraeli ndani ya hema. Akawachoma mkuki wote wawili kwa pamoja, ukapenya kwenye mwili wa yule Mwisraeli na mwili wa yule mwanamke. Ndipo tauni iliyokuwepo dhidi ya Waisraeli ikakoma.
Ekegusii: akabwatia omonto oria gochia ase akanyomba ka ime, akababeta ritimo bonsi babere, Omoisraeli oria amo nomokuungu oria, ase chinda chiabo. Ase igo amaakwa aria agatiga goita Abaisraeli.

English: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale waliokufa kwa hiyo tauni walikuwa watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abakwete ase ogoakwa okwo nigo babete chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.
Kiswahili: “Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari, mwana wa kuhani Aroni, amegeuza hasira yangu mbali na Waisraeli, kwa sababu alikuwa na wivu kama nilio nao kwa heshima yangu miongoni mwao, hata kwamba kwa wivu wangu sikuwaangamiza.
Ekegusii: “Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Aroni Omokuani, nere ogera endamwamu yane yatigire Abaisraeli, ekiagera ere aba ne risemi buna inche inde ne risemi ase egati y’ abanto aba. Ase ayio tinasiretie bonsi ase risemi riane.

English: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mwambie Finehasi ninafanya Agano langu la amani naye.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, moteebie ng’a, ’ngokora inde nere okobwatana kwane kw’omorembe.

English: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”
Kiswahili: Yeye pamoja na wazao wake watakuwa na Agano la ukuhani milele, kwa sababu alikuwa na wivu kwa ajili ya heshima ya Mungu wake, na akafanya upatanisho kwa Waisraeli.”
Ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo kw’omorembe ’nkobe ase are ere, na ase ororeria rw’aye, okobwatana kwa botambe kw’obokuani, ekiagera abeete ne risemi ase engencho yane, inche Nyasae oye, naende agakora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli.”

English: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.
Kiswahili: Jina la Mwisraeli ambaye aliuawa pamoja na mwanamke wa Kimidiani ni Zimri mwana wa Salu, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Simeoni.
Ekegusii: Omoisraeli oria oitetwe amo nomokuungu Omomidiani nigo arenge korokwa Simuri, mosinto o Salu, omotang’ani bw’eamate yaye ase egesaku gia Simioni.

English: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
Kiswahili: Jina la mwanamke wa Kimidiani aliyeuawa ni Kozbi binti wa Suri, aliyekuwa mkuu wa kabila la jamaa ya Wamidiani.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria bw’Abamidiani oitetwe ere nigo arenge korokwa Kosibi. Suri ise nere orenge omotang’ani bwe chiamate chinde chi’Abamidiani.

English: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;
Kiswahili: “Watendeeni Wamidiani kama adui na mwaue,
Ekegusii: “Umokera Abamidiani, obasirie,

English: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”
Kiswahili: kwa sababu wao waliwatendea kama adui wakati waliwadanganya katika tukio la Peori na dada yao Kozbi, binti wa kiongozi wa Kimidiani, mwanamke ambaye aliuawa wakati tauni ilikuja kama matokeo ya tukio la Peori.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera barabwo baabachandire ase okobaebereria gosasiima Peori, na ase amang’ana a Kosibi, omosubati oria bw’omonene bw’Abamidiani. Omosubati oria obo oitetwe ase rituko riria amaakwa achete ase engencho ya Peori.”

English: After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
Kiswahili: Baada ya hiyo tauni, Bwana akamwambia Mose na Eleazari mwana wa kuhani Aroni,
Ekegusii: Ekaba magega amaakwa aria gaetire, Omonene agakwana na Musa na Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, akabateebia,

English: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”
Kiswahili: “Hesabu jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli kwa jamaa zao, wale wote wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, ambao wanaweza kutumika katika jeshi la Israeli.”
Ekegusii: “Mobare omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, eamate ase eamate. Moriike, abanto bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baranyare korwana esegi.”

English: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakazungumza na watu kwenye nchi tambarare ya Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yordani kutokea Yeriko, wakasema,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bagakwana n’abanto baria ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ase orooche rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, akabateebia,

English: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “Hesabuni wanaume wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.” Hawa ndio Waisraeli waliotoka Misri:
Ekegusii: “Riika abanto bonsi abakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.” Abaisraeli abwo barwete ense ya Misiri nabwo aba.

English: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Reubeni, mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Israeli, walikuwa: kutoka kwa Hanoki, ukoo wa Wahanoki; kutoka kwa Palu, ukoo wa Wapalu;
Ekegusii: Rubeni nere orenge omomura omotangi o Israeli. Ase egesaku kiaye nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abahanoki, abarwete ase Hanoki, na Abapalu, abarwete ase Palu,

English: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Hesroni, ukoo wa Wahesroni; kutoka kwa Karmi, ukoo wa Wakarmi.
Ekegusii: na Abahezironi, abarwete ase Hezironi, na Abakarimi, abarwete ase Karimi.

English: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
Kiswahili: Hizi zilikuwa ndizo koo za Reubeni; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 43,730.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Rubeni. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isato, na amagana atano abere, na merongo etato (43,730).

English: The son of Pallu: Eliab.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Palu alikuwa Eliabu,
Ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Palu n’Eliabu

English: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against Yahweh;
Kiswahili: nao wana wa Eliabu walikuwa Nemueli, Dathani na Abiramu. Hawa wawili Dathani na Abiramu ndio walikuwa maafisa wa jumuiya ambao walimwasi Mose na Aroni, na walikuwa miongoni mwa wafuasi wa Kora wakati walimwasi Bwana.
Ekegusii: amo nabana baye: Nemweli, na Datani, na Abiiramu. (Aba nabwo Datani na Abiiramu bachoretwe korwa ase omoganda. Barabwo bakaamererania na Musa na Aroni, bakaba ase ekeombe gia Kora, ekero baamereranetie n’Omonene.

English: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.
Kiswahili: Ardhi ilifunua kinywa chake na kuwameza pamoja na Kora, ambaye wafuasi wake walikufa wakati moto ulipowateketeza wanaume 250. Nao walikuwa kama alama ya onyo.
Ekegusii: Riroba rikabwereka rikabamera amo na Kora, ekero omorero osambete na gosiria abanto amagana abere, na merongo etano. Ayio akaba ekiorokererio ki’ogokuurera.

English: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hayo, hao ukoo wa Kora hawakufa.
Ekegusii: Korende abana ba Kora barabwo tibaitetwe.)

English: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Simeoni kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Nemueli, ukoo wa Wanemueli; kutoka kwa Yamini, ukoo wa Wayamini; kutoka wa Yakini, ukoo wa Wayakini;
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Simioni nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaanemweli, abarwete ase Nemweli, na Abayamini, abarwete ase Yamini, na Abayakini, abarwete ase Yakini,

English: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Zera, ukoo wa Wazera; kutoka kwa Shauli, ukoo wa Washauli.
Ekegusii: na Abazera, abarwete ase Zera, na Abasauli, abarwete ase Saulo.

English: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo koo za Simeoni; walikuwa 22,200.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simioni. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere (22,200).

English: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Gadi kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Sifoni, ukoo wa Wasifoni; kutoka kwa Hagi, ukoo wa Wahagi; kutoka kwa Shuni, ukoo wa Washuni;
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Gadi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abazefoni, abarwete ase Zefoni, na Abahagi, abarwete ase Hagi, na

English: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Ozni, ukoo wa Waozni; kutoka kwa Eri, ukoo wa Waeri;
Ekegusii: Abasuni, abarwete ase Suni, na Abaosini, abarwete ase Osini, na Abaeri, abarwete ase Eri,

English: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Arodi, ukoo wa Waarodi; kutoka kwa Areli, ukoo wa Waareli.
Ekegusii: na Abaarodi, abarwete ase Arodi, na Abaareli, abarwete ase Areli.

English: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Gadi; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 40,500.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Gadi. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifi emerongo ene, na amagana atano (40,500).

English: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Eri na Onani walikuwa wana wa Yuda, lakini walifia huko Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Basinto ba Yuda, Eri na Onani, bagakwera agwo ase ense ya Kaanani.

English: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Yuda kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Shela, ukoo wa Washela; kutoka kwa Peresi, ukoo wa Waperesi; kutoka kwa Zera, ukoo wa Wazera.
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Yuda nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abasela, abarwete ase Sela, na Abaperisi, abarwete ase Peresi, na Abazera, abarwete ase Zera.

English: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Peresi walikuwa: kutoka kwa Hesroni, ukoo wa Wahesroni; kutoka kwa Hamuli, ukoo wa Wahamuli.
Ekegusii: Chiamate chia Peresi nigo chiarenge: Abahezironi, abarwete ase Hezironi, na Abahamuli, abarwete ase Hamuli.

English: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Yuda; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 76,500.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano ebere na isano nemo, na amagana atano (76,500).

English: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Isakari kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Tola, ukoo wa Watola; kutoka kwa Puva, ukoo wa Wapuva;
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Isakaru nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abatola, abarwete ase Tola, na Abapua, abarwete ase Pua,

English: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Yashubu, ukoo wa Wayashubu; kutoka kwa Shimroni, ukoo wa Washimroni.
Ekegusii: na Abayasubu, abarwete ase Yasubu, na Abashimuroni, abarwete ase Shimuroni.

English: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Isakari; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 64,300.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na inye, n’amagana atato (64,300).

English: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Zabuloni kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Seredi, ukoo wa Waseredi; kutoka kwa Eloni, ukoo wa Waeloni; kutoka kwa Yaleeli, ukoo wa Wayaleeli.
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Sabuloni nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaseredi, abarwete ase Seredi, na Abaeloni, abarwete ase Eloni, na Abayaleeli, abarwete ase Yaleeli.

English: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Zabuloni, wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 60,500.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na amagana atano (60,500).

English: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Yosefu kwa koo zao kutoka kwa Manase na kwa Efraimu walikuwa:
Ekegusii: Ebisaku bia Yusufu nebi’abamura baye babere, Manase na Efraimu.

English: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Manase: kutoka kwa Makiri, ukoo wa Wamakiri (Makiri alikuwa baba wa Gileadi); kutoka kwa Gileadi, ukoo wa Wagileadi.
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Manase nao eamate ya Makiri yarwete. Makiri nere orenge ise Gileadi, na korwa ase are nao Abagileadi barwete.

English: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Gileadi: kutoka kwa Iezeri, ukoo wa Waiezeri; kutoka kwa Heleki, ukoo wa Waheleki;
Ekegusii: Ase ororeria rwa Gileadi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaieseri, abarwete ase Ieseri, na Abaheleki, abarwete ase Heleki,

English: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Asirieli, ukoo wa Waasirieli; kutoka kwa Shekemu, ukoo wa Washekemu;
Ekegusii: Abaasirieli, abarwete ase Asirieli, na Abasekemu, abarwete ase Sekemu,

English: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Shemida, ukoo wa Washemida; kutoka kwa Heferi, ukoo wa Waheferi.
Ekegusii: na Abasemida, abarwete ase Semida, na Abaheferi, abarwete ase Heferi.

English: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
Kiswahili: (Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi hakuzaa wana, bali alikuwa na watoto wa kike tu, ambao majina yao yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.)
Ekegusii: Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi, tabwate abana abamura, korende nabana abaiseke boka abwate, na amarieta y’abaiseke abwo naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.

English: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Manase; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 52,700.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi’egesaku kia Manase. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na ibere, na amagana atano abere (52,700).

English: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Efraimu kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Shuthela, ukoo wa Washuthela; kutoka kwa Bekeri, ukoo wa Wabekeri; kutoka kwa Tahani, ukoo wa Watahani;
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku gi’Efraimu nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abasutela, abarwete ase Sutela, na Ababeekeri, abarwete ase Bekeri, na Abatahani, abarwete ase Tahani.

English: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio walikuwa wazao wa Shuthela: kutoka kwa Erani, ukoo wa Waerani.
Ekegusii: Sutela nigo arenge ise Erani, na korwa ase are nao Abaerani barwete.

English: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Efraimu; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 32,500. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Yosefu kwa koo zao.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Efraimu. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato na ibere, na amagana atano (32,500). Aba nabwo barenge abana ba Yusufu ne chiamate chiabo.

English: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Benyamini kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Bela, ukoo wa Wabela; kutoka kwa Ashbeli, ukoo wa Waashbeli; kutoka kwa Ahiramu, ukoo wa Waahiramu;
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Benjamini nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Ababela, abarwete ase Bela, na Abaasibeli, abarwete ase Asibeli, na Abaahiramu, abarwete ase Ahiramu,

English: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Shufamu, ukoo wa Washufamu; kutoka kwa Hufamu, ukoo wa Wahufamu.
Ekegusii: na Abasefufamu, abarwete ase Sefufamu, na Abahufamu, abarwete ase Hufamu.

English: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Bela kutoka kwa Ardi na Naamani walikuwa: kutoka kwa Ardi, ukoo wa Waardi; kutoka kwa Naamani, ukoo wa Wanaamani.
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Bela nabwo Aridi na Naamani. Korwa ase Aridi nao Abaaridi barwete, na korwa ase Naamani nao Abanaamani barwete.

English: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Benyamini; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 45,600.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi’egesaku gia Benjamini Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano, na amagana atano na rimo (45,600).

English: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Dani kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Shuhamu, ukoo wa Washuhamu. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Dani:
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Dani nigo chiarenge chiamate chi’Abasuhamu, abarwete ase Suhamu. Aba nabwo abanto b’egesaku gia Dani ase chiamate chiabo.

English: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Wote walikuwa koo za Washuhamu; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 64,400.
Ekegusii: Abarwete ase chiamate chi’Abasuhamu nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na inye, na amagana ane (64,400).

English: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Asheri kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Imna, ukoo wa Waimna; kutoka kwa Ishvi, ukoo wa Waishvi; kutoka kwa Beria, ukoo wa Waberia;
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku gi’Aseri nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaimuna, abarwete ase Imuna, na Abaisibi, abarwete ase Isibi, na Ababeria, abarwete ase Beria.

English: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa wazao wa Beria: kutoka kwa Heberi, ukoo wa Waheberi; kutoka kwa Malkieli, ukoo wa Wamalkieli.
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi ase eamate y’Abaheberi yarwete, na Malikieli, ase eamate y’Abamalikieli yarwete.

English: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
Kiswahili: (Asheri alikuwa na binti aliyeitwa Sera.)
Ekegusii: Omwana omoiseke o Aseri nigo arenge korokwa Sera.

English: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Asheri; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 53,400.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na isato, na amagana ane (53,400).

English: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Naftali kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Yaseeli, ukoo wa Wayaseeli; kutoka kwa Guni, ukoo wa Waguni;
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Nafutali nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abayaseli, abarwete ase Yaseli, na Abaguni, abarwete ase Guni,

English: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
Kiswahili: kutoka kwa Yeseri, ukoo wa Wayeseri; kutoka kwa Shilemu, ukoo wa Washilemu.
Ekegusii: na Abayeseri, abarwete ase Yeseri, na Abasilemu, abarwete ase Silemu.

English: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Naftali; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 45,400.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano, na amagana ane (45,400).

English: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya hesabu ya wanaume wa Israeli ilikuwa 601,730.
