Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli abarigetwe nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano nomo na eyemo, na amagana atano abere na merongo etato (601,730).

English: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
Kiswahili: “Watagawiwa nchi kama urithi kwa kulingana na hesabu ya majina.
Ekegusii: Aatananere abanto aba chingongo chibe emiando yabo. Ochiatanane kobwatekana nomobaro bw’ abanto.

English: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.
Kiswahili: Kundi kubwa zaidi lipe urithi mkubwa zaidi, na kundi dogo zaidi lipewe urithi mdogo zaidi; kila kundi litapokea urithi wake kulingana na hesabu ya wale walioorodheshwa.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kere ekenene keegwe orogongo oronene robe omwando obo, na egesaku kere egeke keegwe orogongo oroke robe omwando obo. Kera egesaku nakeegwe omwando oye koreng’ana nomobaro obo.

English: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kuwa nchi inagawanywa kwa kura. Kile kitakachorithiwa na kila kikundi kitakuwa kwa kulingana na majina ya kabila la babu yao.
Ekegusii: Ense yaatananwe ase ogoakerwa obomera. Abanto mbanyore omwando koreng’ana nomobaro bw’amarieta ’ebisaku bie chisokoro chiabo.

English: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”
Kiswahili: Kila urithi utagawanywa kwa kura miongoni mwa makundi makubwa na madogo.”
Ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna obomera boragwere abanto ba kera egesaku, ekenene gose egeke, nabo baranyore omwando obo.

English: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa Walawi ambao walihesabiwa kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Gershoni, ukoo wa Wagershoni; kutoka kwa Kohathi, ukoo wa Wakohathi; kutoka kwa Merari, ukoo wa Wamerari.
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Lawi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abagerisoni, abarwete ase Gerisoni, na Abakohati, abarwete ase Kohati, na Abamerari, abarwete ase Merari.

English: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
Kiswahili: Hizi pia zilikuwa koo za Walawi: ukoo wa Walibni; ukoo wa Wahebroni; ukoo wa Wamahli; ukoo wa Wamushi; ukoo wa wana wa Kora. (Kohathi alikuwa baba aliyemzaa Amramu;
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Lawi: Eamate y’Abalibini, na ey’Abaheburoni, na ey’Abamali na ey’Abamusi, na ey’Abakora. Kohati nere orenge ise Amuramu.

English: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
Kiswahili: jina la mke wa Amramu ni Yokebedi, naye pia alikuwa mzao wa Lawi, ambaye alizaliwa kwa Walawi nchini Misri. Alimzalia Amramu: Aroni, Mose na dada yao Miriamu.
Ekegusii: Moka Amuramu nigo arenge korokwa Yokebedi, mosubati o Lawi, oria oiboreretwe Lawi agwo ase ense ya Misiri. Omokungu oria akamoiborera Amuramu abana aba: Aroni, na Musa, na Miriamu, omoiseke omwabo.

English: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Aroni alikuwa baba yake Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Basinto ba Aroni nabwo aba: Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.

English: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Lakini Nadabu na Abihu walikufa wakati walitoa sadaka mbele za Bwana kwa moto usioruhusiwa.)
Ekegusii: Korende Nadabu na Abihu bagakwa ekero baruete ogosambwa kw’engeencho eng’ao otachiikiri ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wote wa Walawi wa umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi walikuwa 23,000. Wao hawakuhesabiwa pamoja na Waisraeli wengine kwa sababu hawakupokea urithi miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ase egati yabo oyo konya okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo abaretwe. Barabwo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isato (23,000). Abanto aba tibaabaretwe amo n’Abaisraeli bande, ekiagera tibaetwe omwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli.

English: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio walioorodheshwa na Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakati waliwahesabu Waisraeli kwenye nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bariigete ekero baabarete Abaisraeli agwo ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ase Yorodani kororia Yeriko.

English: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyekuwa miongoni mwa wale waliohesabiwa na Mose na kuhani Aroni wakati waliwahesabu Waisraeli katika Jangwa la Sinai.
Ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’ abanto aba onde tarengeo, nonya noyomo, ase baria Musa na Aroni Omokuani baabarete agwo ase erooro ya Sinai.

English: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana alikuwa amewaambia hao Waisraeli hakika wangekufa huko jangwani, wala hakuna mmoja wao aliyeachwa, isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.
Ekegusii: Omonene nakwanete igoro y’abwo, “Barabwo nigo barakwere ase erooro.” Omonto onde tagotigara ore moyo nonya noyomo, otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.

English: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
Kiswahili: Binti za Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase, walikuwa wa koo za Manase mwana wa Yosefu. Majina ya hao binti yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa. Walikaribia
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abaiseke ba Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi o Gileadi, o Makiri, o Manase bagaacha. Aba nigo barwete ase chiamate chia Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, na amarieta abo naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.

English: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,
Kiswahili: ingilio la Hema la Kukutania na kusimama mbele ya Mose, kuhani Eleazari, viongozi na kusanyiko lote, wakasema,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagaacha ase obosio bwa Musa, na obwa Eleazari Omokuani, na ase amasio y’abatang’ani, na ase omoganda bwonsi, bagatenena agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagateeba,

English: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.
Kiswahili: “Baba yetu alikufa jangwani. Hakuwa miongoni mwa wafuasi wa Kora, ambao walifungamana pamoja dhidi ya Bwana, lakini alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe na hakuacha wana.
Ekegusii: “Tata nigo akwerete agwo ase erooro. Ere tarenge ase egati y’ekeombe keria giasangererekanete amo gekaba mamincha y’Omonene, ase abwo barenge ase ensemo ya Kora, korende ere nigo akwete ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene. Ekero akwete tatigete abana abamura

English: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini jina la baba yetu lifutike kutoka ukoo wake kwa sababu hakuwa na mwana? Tupatie milki miongoni mwa ndugu za baba yetu.”
Ekegusii: Nase ki erieta ria tata rigosirigwa korwa ase eamate yaye ekiagera tabwate abana abamura? Toe naintwe omwando ase egati y’abamura bamwabo tata.”

English: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akalileta shauri lao mbele za Bwana,
Ekegusii: Musa akaira amang’ana abo ase obosio bw’Omonene,

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: naye Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: n’Omonene akamoteebia,

English: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
Kiswahili: “Wanachosema binti za Selofehadi ni sawa. Ni lazima kwa hakika uwape milki kama urithi miongoni mwa ndugu za baba yao, na kubadili urithi wa baba yao uwe wao.
Ekegusii: “Abaiseke ba Selofehadi nekeene bakoboria. Bae omwando obo ase egati ya bamura bamwabo ise. Tiga omwando o ise obe oyobo.

English: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Ikiwa mtu atakufa naye hakuacha mwana, utampa binti yake urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Naende oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a omonto karakwe, onye ere tabwati omwana omomura, omwando bw’omonto oyio omwana oye omoiseke ayoire.

English: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa hana binti, wape ndugu zake wa kiume urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati nonya nomwana omoiseke, omwando oye abamura bamwabo bayoire.

English: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa hana ndugu wa kiume toa urithi wake kwa ndugu za baba yake.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati abamura bamwabo, omwando oye oirwe nabamura bamwabo ise.

English: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa baba yake hakuwa na ndugu wa kiume, toa urithi wake kwa ndugu wa karibu katika ukoo wake, ili aumiliki. Hili litakuwa dai la sheria kwa Waisraeli, kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.’ ”
Ekegusii: Na onye omonto oyio tabwati abamura bamwabo ise, omwando oye oirwe nomoamate oye ore ang’e. Okwo nigo koraabe ogochika kw’oboronge ase Abaisraeli, buna inche Omonene nagochiikire.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Panda juu ya mlima huu katika kilele cha Abarimu uione nchi ambayo nimewapa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Tiira gochia igoro ase egetunwa eke ki’Abarimu, na origererie ense naeire Abaisraeli.

English: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuiona, wewe pia utakusanywa pamoja na watu wako kama ndugu yako Aroni alivyokusanywa,
Ekegusii: Ekero kwayerorire, aye nigo orasangererekane amo n’abanto bao buna Aroni omino asangererekanete amo n’abanto baye,

English: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa jumuiya ilipoasi amri yangu kwenye maji katika Jangwa la Sini, wakati jumuiya ilipogombana nami, nyote wawili mliacha kuitii amri yangu ya kuniheshimu kama mtakatifu mbele ya macho yao.” (Haya yalikuwa maji ya Meriba huko Kadeshi, katika Jangwa la Sini.)
Ekegusii: ekiagera timwaigwerete ring’ana riane agwo ase erooro ya Sini, rituko riria omoganda bwonsi bwemurunganetie, gose timwaorogetie ng’a inche nomochenu inde, ekero mware kobochorera abanto amaache.” (Aya namaache a Meriba ya Kadeshi ase erooro ya Sini).

English: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,
Kiswahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana,
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Omonene akabora,

English: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
Kiswahili: “Bwana, Mungu wa roho zote za wanadamu, na amteue mtu juu ya jumuiya hii
Ekegusii: “Aye Omonene Nyasae, aye oyokorua obogima ase abanto bonsi, chora omonto oraraae omoganda oyo,

English: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”
Kiswahili: ili atoke na kuingia mbele yao, atakayewaongoza katika kutoka kwao na kuingia kwao, ili watu wa Bwana wasiwe kama kondoo wasio na mchungaji.”
Ekegusii: omonto oranyare gotang’ana abanto kobagosoka na kobakoirana, erinde omoganda bw’ abanto ba Omonene tobaisa koba buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia.”

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mchukue Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, mtu ambaye Roho yuko ndani yake, uweke mkono juu yake.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ira Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omonto oyio omoika one ore ime yaye, erio omobekere amaboko.

English: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
Kiswahili: Msimamishe mbele ya kuhani Eleazari pamoja na kusanyiko lote, umpe maagizo mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Omorente atenene ase obosio bw’Eleazari Omokuani, na ase amasio y’omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto, erio ase amasio abo omorarie ng’a nere oirire ribaga ria’o.

English: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
Kiswahili: Mpe sehemu ya mamlaka yako ili jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli ipate kumtii.
Ekegusii: Omoe okobua buna okwao, erio nario omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli oramoigwere.

English: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”
Kiswahili: Atasimama mbele ya kuhani Eleazari, ambaye atapokea maamuzi kwa ajili yake, kwa kuuliza mbele za Bwana kwa ile Urimu. Kwa amri yake, yeye na jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli watatoka, na kwa amri yake, wataingia.”
Ekegusii: Yoshua abe ogotenena ase obosio bw’Eleazari Omokuani, na Eleazari abe okomonogeri oye ase Urimu, agwo ase obosio bwane amanye ogwancha kwane. Yoshua amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli nigo barakore emeremo yabo yonsi buna Eleazari arabachiike.”

English: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
Kiswahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza. Akamtwaa Yoshua na kumsimamisha mbele ya kuhani Eleazari na kusanyiko lote.
Ekegusii: Musa akaira Yoshua buna Omonene konya amochiikire, akamorenta ase obosio bw’Eleazari Omokuani nomoganda bwonsi.

English: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaweka mikono yake juu ya kichwa cha Yoshua na kumpa maagizo, kama vile Bwana alivyoelekeza kupitia kwa Mose.
Ekegusii: Naende akabeeka amaboko aye igoro ase omotwe o Yoshua, akamwatanana, akamobeka ase ribaga riaye, buna Omonene konya amochikiire goetera ase Musa.

English: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
Kiswahili: “Wape Waisraeli agizo hili na uwaambie: ‘Hakikisheni kwamba mnaniletea mimi kwa wakati uliowekwa chakula kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto, kama harufu nzuri ya kupendeza.’
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli obachike ng’a ase ekero keria gechiikire goika banduere ebing’wanso na okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.

English: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Waambie: ‘Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto mnayomtolea Bwana: wana-kondoo wawili wa mwaka mmoja wasio na dosari, kama sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa kila siku.
Ekegusii: “Obateebie: Eke nakio ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero moramoruere Omonene: Kera rituko botambe morue chimanwa chimingichi ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

English: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,
Kiswahili: Andaa mwana-kondoo mmoja asubuhi na mwingine jioni,
Ekegusii: Eyemo y’echio oyerue mambia, na eyende mogoroba.

English: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
Kiswahili: kila mmoja atolewe pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa pamoja na robo ya hini ya mafuta ya zeituni.
Ekegusii: Kera eyemo oyerue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta amitire korwa ase amazeituni egetuba ekemo.

English: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hii ni sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa iliyoanzishwa katika Mlima Sinai kama harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, ekio Musa aruete ritang’ani agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai gekaba rimisu rigiya, ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene.

English: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.
Kiswahili: Sadaka ya kinywaji itakayotolewa pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo ni robo ya hini ya kinywaji kilichochachuka. Mimina sadaka ya kinywaji kwa Bwana mahali patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Orue okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa egetuba ekemo, amo nemingichi eria entang’ani. Ekenyugwa eke egetindi keraumorwe agwo Aase Aachenu, ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Andaa yule mwana-kondoo wa pili jioni, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka na sadaka ya kinywaji kama ulivyofanya kwa ile sadaka nyingine ya asubuhi. Hii ni sadaka iliyotolewa kwa kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Emingichi eria ya kabere oyerue mogoroba amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna kwaruete eria ya mambia. Eke nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.”

English: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
Kiswahili: “ ‘Siku ya Sabato, utatoa sadaka ya wana-kondoo wawili wa mwaka mmoja wasiokuwa na dosari pamoja na sadaka yake ya kinywaji na sadaka ya nafaka yenye uzito wa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Esabato morue chimanwa chimingichi ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Amo nachirochio morue obosie obonuke ebimunu bine bwochoganirie amaguta y’amazeituni, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Morue boigo okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire.

English: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
Kiswahili: Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa itakayotolewa kwa ajili ya kila Sabato, pamoja na sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa na sadaka yake ya kinywaji.
Ekegusii: Eke nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera Esabato gekoruegwa amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire amo.

English: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Siku ya kwanza ya kila mwezi, mtamletea Bwana sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali wawili wachanga, kondoo dume mmoja na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasiokuwa na dosari.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ria kera omotienyi mobe mokorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene. Morue chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isan’aibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi echitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

English: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;
Kiswahili: Pamoja na kila fahali, kutakuwa na sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini sehemu tatu za kumi za efa, uliochanganywa na mafuta, pamoja na kondoo dume mmoja, sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta;
Ekegusii: Morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta y’amazeituni. Amo na kera eeri morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

English: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo, sadaka ya nafaka yenye uzito wa sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta. Hii ni kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, harufu nzuri, sadaka ya kuteketezwa iliyotolewa kwa moto kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: na amo na kera emanwa emingichi, obosie ebimunu bibere. Ebing’wanso ebio bi’ogosambwa nigo bire okoruegwa kw’endagera kore ne rimisu rigiya kogosambwa n’omorero ase Omonene.

English: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na kila fahali kutakuwa na sadaka ya kinywaji nusu ya hini ya divai; pamoja na kila kondoo dume, theluthi moja ya hini, na pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo robo hini. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya kila mwezi itakayotolewa kila mwandamo wa mwezi kwa mwaka.
Ekegusii: Ekenyugwa gekoruegwa amo na kera eeri nigo kerabe edivai ebituba bibere, na amo nemingichi eria, edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, na amo na kera emanwa emingichi edivai egetuba ekemo. Eke ’nkebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gekoruegwa kera omotienyi ase emetienyi yonsi y’omwaka.

English: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa pamoja na sadaka yake ya kinywaji, mbuzi mmoja dume atatolewa kwa Bwana kama sadaka ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa, morue egoree eyemo ase Omonene, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

English: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa kwanza, itafanyika Pasaka ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani nerituko ri’Epasaka y’Omonene.

English: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi huo itakuwa sikukuu; kwa siku saba mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi oyio nario Rituko Rinene. Ase amatuko atan’abere morie emagaati etabekiri memera.

English: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kwanza mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, msifanye kazi za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.

English: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,
Kiswahili: Leteni mbele za Bwana sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya mafahali wawili wachanga, kondoo dume mmoja na wana-kondoo dume saba wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
Ekegusii: Morue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

English: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na kila fahali, andaa sadaka ya nafaka sehemu tatu za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, andaa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa;
Ekegusii: Naende morue okoruegwa kw’endagera obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta: Amo na kera eeri ensae morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

English: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
Kiswahili: pia pamoja na kila mmoja wa wale wana-kondoo saba, andaa sehemu ya kumi ya efa.
Ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi chiria isan’aibere obosie ebimunu bibere.

English: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
Kiswahili: Pia mtoe beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi ambaye atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more.

English: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Andaa hizi licha ya zile sadaka za kawaida za kuteketezwa za kila asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Igo morarue ebinto ebi amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko botambe.

English: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii andaa chakula cha sadaka ya kuteketezwa kila siku, kwa siku saba kama harufu nzuri impendezayo Bwana. Hii itaandaliwa licha ya ile sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa ya kila siku pamoja na sadaka yake ya kinywaji.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio kera rituko, ase amatuko atano na abere, mobe mokoruera Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera. Morue okoruegwa okwo amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire.

English: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
Kiswahili: Siku ya saba mwe na kusanyiko takatifu na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.

English: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Siku ya malimbuko, mnapomletea Bwana sadaka ya nafaka mpya wakati wa Sikukuu ya Majuma, mwe na kusanyiko takatifu na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani rie rigesa, ekero moraabe mokorenta okoruegwa kw’endagera enyia ase Omonene, ase Rituko Rinene rie Chichuma, ’namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.

English: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;
Kiswahili: Mlete sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya mafahali wawili wachanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na pia wana-kondoo saba wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja, kama harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Morue chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, amo ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Echi nchibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na kila fahali itatolewa sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini sehemu tatu za kumi za efa uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, andaa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini;
Ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ekio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta ’amazeituni. Amo na kera eeri morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

English: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
Kiswahili: na sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini kwa kila mmoja wa wana-kondoo saba.
Ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi chiria isano na ibere obosie ebimunu bibere.

English: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.
Kiswahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kwa kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more.

English: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.
Kiswahili: Andaa hizi sadaka pamoja na sadaka zake za vinywaji, kuwa nyongeza ya sadaka za kawaida za kuteketezwa, pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka. Hakikisha kuwa wanyama hao hawana dosari.
Ekegusii: Morue ekeng’wanso ekio amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera. Ching’iti echio chionsi chi’ebing’wanso chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chiruegwe amo n’okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire amo.

English: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa saba mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu na msifanye kazi ya kawaida. Ni siku kwa ajili yenu ya kupiga tarumbeta.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere ’namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko. Rituko erio nigo rirabe rituko ri’okobugia ebiroria.

English: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
Kiswahili: Mtatayarisha sadaka ya kuteketezwa kama harufu nzuri impendezayo Bwana ya fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
Ekegusii: Morue eeri ensae eyemo, na emingichi enene eyemo, ne chimingichi chimanwa isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na fahali, andaeni sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi tatu za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; kwa kondoo dume, andaa unga sehemu ya kumi mbili za efa;
Ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ekio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta: Amo neeri eria morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

English: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
Kiswahili: na pamoja na wana-kondoo saba kila mmoja aandaliwe na sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga.
Ekegusii: boigo ase kera eyemo ye chimanwa ye chimingichi chiria isano na ibere, obosie ebimunu bibere.

English: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
Kiswahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more.

English: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hivi ni nyongeza ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kila mwezi na kila siku pamoja na sadaka zake za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji kama ilivyoainishwa. Ni sadaka zinazotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, harufu inayopendeza.
Ekegusii: Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ki’Omotienyi Omoyia, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera gochiikire, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa gokorentwa amo nebio, koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire. Ebinto ebio bire ne rimisu rigiya, okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene.

English: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwenye siku ya kumi ya mwezi huu wa saba mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu. Mtajikana wenyewe na msifanye kazi.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi oyio o gatan’akabere, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Mobe mokweng’ata na gweitia. Timokora emeremo ende yonsi.

English: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;
Kiswahili: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari, kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Morue eeri ensae eyemo, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isan’aibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na fahali, andaeni sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi tatu za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, sehemu ya kumi mbili za efa za unga laini;
Ekegusii: Amo nachirochio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta. Amo neeri eria morue obosie ebimunu bitan’akemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

English: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
Kiswahili: na kwa kila mmoja wa wana-kondoo saba andaa sehemu ya kumi ya unga laini kwa kila mmoja.
Ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi, chiria isan’aibere, obosie ebimunu bibere.

English: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
Kiswahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, katika nyongeza ya sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya upatanisho, na sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka, na sadaka zake za vinywaji.
Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, kementwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogokora okobwatanigwa, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

English: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa saba, mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, na hamtafanya kazi za kawaida. Adhimisheni sikukuu kwa Bwana kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ende yonsi, korende morende Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;
Kiswahili: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa mafahali wachanga kumi na watatu, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari, kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Morue chieri ikomi na isato, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari ne kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekengwanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

English: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hao mafahali kumi na watatu, kila mmoja aandaliwe na sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi tatu za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; kwa kondoo dume wawili, kila mmoja aandaliwe sehemu ya kumi mbili za efa za unga laini;
Ekegusii: Amo nechio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta. Amo na kera eyemo ye chieri chiria ikomi na isato morue obosie ebimunu bitan’akemo, na amo na kera eyemo ye chimingichi chiria ibere obosie ebimunu bine,

English: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;
Kiswahili: na kwa wana-kondoo kumi na wanne, kila mmoja aandaliwe sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini.
Ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi chiria ikomi na inye obosie ebimunu bibere.

English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
Kiswahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka ya vinywaji.
Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

English: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya pili andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere morue chieri chinsae ikomi na ibere, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

English: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
Kiswahili: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
Ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruerwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.

English: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.
Kiswahili: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.
Ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko. Morue n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

English: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya tatu andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya sita andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na rimo morue chieri isano na isato, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya saba andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

Ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.

English: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya nane mtakuwa na kusanyiko, na msifanye kazi ya kawaida.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato goika mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.

English: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
Kiswahili: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana, sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali mmoja, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo dume saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

English: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na fahali, kondoo dume na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka, na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
Ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo neeri eria, na emingichi eria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.

English: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Zaidi ya kile unachoweka nadhiri na sadaka zenu za hiari, andaeni hizi kwa ajili ya Bwana kwenye sikukuu zenu zilizoamriwa: sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka, sadaka za vinywaji, pamoja na sadaka zenu za amani.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ebing’wanso ebio amo n’okoruegwa okwo goika mobirue ase Omonene ase chingaki chi’Amatuko aino Amanene achorire. Nabirobio bimentwe ase ebing’wanso biaino mwariete chiira ng’a morue, na ebing’wanso bi’ogwancha, onye nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose okw’ebinyugwa, gose ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.

English: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia Waisraeli yale yote Bwana alimwagiza.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi buna Omonene konya amochiikire.

English: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia viongozi wa makabila ya Israeli: “Hili ndilo Bwana analoagiza:
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana nabatang’ani b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, akabateebia, “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire:

English: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
Kiswahili: Mwanaume awekapo nadhiri kwa Bwana, au anapoapa kujifunga kwa ahadi, kamwe asitangue neno lake, bali ni lazima afanye kila kitu alichosema.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoria eira ase Omonene, gose agotiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete, tagosaria eira eria yaye. Goika akore na goikerania buna akwanete.

English: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
Kiswahili: “Wakati mwanamwali anayeishi bado nyumbani kwa baba yake atakapoweka nadhiri kwa Bwana, ama amejifunga mwenyewe kwa ahadi,
Ekegusii: “Ekero omoiseke otarasoka korwa ase omochie o ise akoria eira ase Omonene, gose gotiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete,

English: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
Kiswahili: na baba yake akasikia kuhusu nadhiri au ahadi yake lakini asimwambie lolote, ndipo nadhiri zake zote na kila ahadi aliyoiweka na kujifunga kwayo itathibitika.
Ekegusii: na ise karaigwe igoro y’eira eria y’omoiseke oye, korende takwana ring’ana, eira eria negenderere kobao. Kera egento omoiseke oria akwanire goika ageikeranie.

English: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama baba yake akimkataza wakati anapoisikia, hakuna nadhiri wala ahadi yake yoyote aliyojifunga kwayo itakayosimama; Bwana atamweka huru huyo mwanamwali kwa sababu baba yake amemkataza.
Ekegusii: Korende onye ise ase rituko riria araigwe ring’ana igoro y’eira eria na tayianchera, omoiseke oria tagwenereti koyeikerania. Omonene naabere omoiseke oria, ekiagera ise nangete ng’a eira eria tekobao.

English: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa ataolewa baada ya kuweka nadhiri au baada ya midomo yake kutamka ahadi fulani bila kufikiri akawa amejifunga hivyo,
Ekegusii: “Omoiseke oria onye onyuomirwe nomosaacha ritang’ani ataraikerania eira ariete, gose amang’ana akwanete ase ogotarengereria,

English: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
Kiswahili: na mume wake akasikia habari hiyo asimwambie neno lolote, ndipo nadhiri zake ama ahadi zake ambazo alikuwa amejifunga nazo zitathibitika.
Ekegusii: goika aikeranie onsi. Aya nigo arakoreke onye omosacha oye ase rituko riria aigwete amang’ana y’eira eria agakira, takwana ing’ana rinde rionsi.

English: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. Yahweh will forgive her.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mume wake atamkataza atakaposikia kuhusu hilo, atakuwa ametangua nadhiri ambazo zilikuwa zimemfunga mkewe, ama ahadi aliyotamka pasipo kufikiri ambayo amejifunga kwayo, naye Bwana atamweka huru yule mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oye ase rituko riria araigwe amang’ana y’eira eria tayianchera, erio eira eria omokungu oyio ariete, na amang’ana aya akwanete atarengereretie buya, tagoikeranigwa, n’Omonene naabere omokungu oyio.

English: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.
Kiswahili: “Nadhiri yoyote ama patano ambalo limefanywa na mjane ama mwanamke aliyeachwa vitakuwa vimemfunga.
Ekegusii: “Korende eira ende yonsi, gose amang’ana ande onsi omokungu omotakaanwa, gose oyotiganire nomosaacha oye arierete eira, gose aya atianete, goika aikeranigwe.

English: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa mwanamke anayeishi na mumewe ataweka nadhiri ama kujifunga mwenyewe kwa ahadi chini ya kiapo,
Ekegusii: “Onye omokungu ore bwoye ase omosacha oye oriete eira, gose agatiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete,

English: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.
Kiswahili: na mumewe akasikia kuhusu jambo hili lakini asimwambie lolote wala hakumkataza, ndipo viapo vyake vyote au ahadi zinazomfunga zitakapothibitika.
Ekegusii: na omosacha oye oyaigure, korende takwana ing’ana rinde rionsi, gose komokania, omokungu oyio goika akore na goikerania kera egento akwanete.

English: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mumewe atabatilisha nadhiri hizo baada ya kuzisikia, basi hakuna nadhiri au ahadi zozote alizoziweka kwa midomo yake zitakazothibitika. Mumewe atakuwa amezibatilisha, na Bwana atamweka huru yule mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oye okwanga eira yaye gose ogotiana kwaye, na kobikora bibe bosa ase rituko riria akoyaigwa, amang’ana yomokuungu oria akwanete tagoikeranigwa. Omonene naabere omokungu oria, ekiagera omosacha oye bwangire ng’a taikerania eira eria, gose ogotiana koria.

English: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
Kiswahili: Mumewe anaweza kuthibitisha au kutangua nadhiri yoyote anayoweka, au ahadi yoyote aliyoweka kwa kuapa ili kujikana mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Eira ende yonsi, gose ogotiana konde gwonsi kw’ogwetanga korwa ase egento gete, omokungu oria arakore, omosacha oye nabo aranyare koyianchera, gose koyianga.

English: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mumewe hasemi lolote kwake kuhusu jambo hilo siku baada ya siku, basi mumewe atakuwa amethibitisha nadhiri zote, na ahadi zote zinazomfunga mkewe. Anavithibitisha kwa kutokusema lolote kwa mkewe anapoyasikia hayo.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oria okirete goika rituko ria kabere, takwanete ing’ana igoro y’ayio, rirorio nayiancherete, na omokungu oria goika aikeranie chiira chiaye chionsi ariete, gose ogotiana kwaye kw’ogwetanga korwa ase egento gete. Omosacha oye nayianchete, ekiagera takwanete gento kende ase rituko riria ayaigwete.

English: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ikiwa mumewe atavibatilisha baada ya kusikia hayo, basi atawajibika kwa hatia ya mkewe.”
Ekegusii: Korende omosacha oria karasarie na kwanga amang’ana yomokuungu oye akwanete magega kayaigure, rirorio okomocha kw’ogotayaikerania nigo koraabe igoro y’omosaacha oria.”

English: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo masharti ambayo Bwana alimpa Mose kuhusu mahusiano kati ya mtu na mkewe, na kati ya baba na binti yake ambaye bado anaishi nyumbani kwa baba yake.
Ekegusii: Eye nero emeroberio echiikire, Omonene amoete Musa, yarenge koba ase egati y’omosaacha nomokuungu oye, na egati ya ise na omwana oye omoiseke otarasoka, ekero are ase omochie o ise.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia.

English: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
Kiswahili: “Uwalipize kisasi Wamidiani kwa ajili ya Waisraeli. Halafu baada ya hayo, utakufa.”
Ekegusii: “Genda obaruserie Abaisraeli egesiomba ase Abamidiani ase engencho y’ayio abanto abwo baabakorerete, erio magega yaye nokwe, osangererekane amo n’abanto bao.”

English: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawaambia watu, “Waandaeni baadhi ya wanaume wenu waende vitani kupigana na Wamidiani ili wawalipize kisasi cha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Musa agateebia abanto, “Babeeke ang’e abanto bare ase egati yaino, mobae ebirwanero bagende korwania Abamidiani, erinde bamoruserie Omonene egesiomba.

English: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”
Kiswahili: Peleka wanaume 1,000 vitani kutoka kila kabila la Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Korwa ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli motome abanto elifu eyemo, bagende korwana esegi.”

English: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo waliandaliwa wanaume 12,000 kwa vita, wanaume 1,000 kutoka kila kabila, walitolewa kutoka koo za Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio korwa ase Abaisraeli chilifu chinyinge bagachora abanto elifu eyemo korwa ase kera egesaku. Abarwani bonsi bachoretwe kogeenda korwana esegi nigo baarenge chilifu ikomi na ibere.

English: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
Kiswahili: Mose aliwatuma vitani, watu 1,000 kutoka kila kabila, pamoja na Finehasi mwana wa kuhani Eleazari, ambaye alichukua vyombo vya mahali patakatifu na tarumbeta za kuashiria.
Ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto aba, elifu eyemo korwa ase kera egesaku, bakageenda korwana esegi. Amo nabarabwo agatoma Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari Omokuani. Ere akaira ebikorero bi’Obomenyo Obochenu na chitarumbeta bi’okobugigwa.

English: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.
Kiswahili: Walipigana dhidi ya Wamidiani, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose, nao waliua kila mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaumokera Abamidiani, bakabarwania buna Omonene achiigete Musa, bagaita kera omosacha ase abanto abwo.

English: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa watu waliouawa walikuwepo wafalme watano wa Midiani, nao ni Evi, Rekemu, Suri, Huri na Reba. Vilevile walimuua Balaamu mwana wa Beori kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Amo nabwo baitetwe nigo barenge abarwoti batano b’Abamidiani. Abarwoti abwo nabwo aba: Ebi, na Rekemu, na Suri, na Huri, na Reba. Boigo bagaita na Baalamu, mosinto o Beori n’omoro.

English: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli waliwateka wanawake wa Kimidiani pamoja na watoto wao na walichukua makundi ya ngʼombe, kondoo na mali zao kama nyara.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira abakungu b’Abamidiani amo nabana babo. Boigo bagasakora chiombe ne ching’ondi, n’ebinto bionsi bi’Abamidiani.

English: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
Kiswahili: Walichoma moto miji yote ambayo Wamidiani walikuwa wanaishi, pamoja na kambi zao zote.
Ekegusii: Bagasamba emechie ase Abamidiani bamenyete, bagasamba nebitwori biabo bionsi bie chiema.

English: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
Kiswahili: Walichukua nyara zote na mateka, pamoja na watu na wanyama,
Ekegusii: Bakaira ebinto bionsi basakorete, bagoosa abanto, boigo bakaira chitugo chionsi.

English: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
Kiswahili: nao waliwaleta wafungwa mateka na nyara kwa Mose na kwa kuhani Eleazari, nao Waisraeli walikusanyika kwenye kambi zao katika tambarare za nchi ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarenta ebinto basakorete, na abanto boosete, ne chitugo, ase Musa na Eleazari Omokuani, na ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli otoorete ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, agwo ase orooche rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.

English: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
Kiswahili: Mose, kuhani Eleazari na viongozi wote wa jumuiya wakatoka kuwalaki nje ya kambi.
Ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani, amo na abaraai bonsi b’omoganda bw’ abanto, bagasoka korwa ase ebitwori, bakageenda korotota abarwani baria b’esegi.

English: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
Kiswahili: Mose aliwakasirikia maafisa wa jeshi, yaani hao wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, ambao walirudi kutoka vitani.
Ekegusii: Musa akagechigwa nabanene b’abarwani, abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na ab’amagana, baria bairanete korwa ase okorwana esegi,

English: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
Kiswahili: Mose akawauliza, “Je, mmewaacha wanawake wote hai?”
Ekegusii: akabora, “Inee! Ninki kiaba motaita abakungu?

English: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Wanawake hao ndio waliofuata ushauri wa Balaamu, nao ndio waliowasababisha Waisraeli wamwasi Bwana kwa kile kilichotokea kule Peori, na kwa hiyo pigo liliwapata watu wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inyora ng’a nabwo baigwerete ogosemia gwa Baalamu, bakagera Abaisraeli tibaaba abegenwa ase Omonene, ekero barenge agwo Peori, na ase ayio amaakwa agacha ase egati y’omoganda bw’ abanto ba Omonene.

English: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
Kiswahili: Sasa waue wavulana wote. Pia muue kila mwanamke ambaye alikwisha fanya tendo la ndoa,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bono ita kera omwana omomura, naboigo moite kera omokungu obeire nomosaacha.

English: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
Kiswahili: lakini mwacheni hai kwa ajili yenu kila msichana ambaye kamwe hajawahi kuzini na mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Korende abaiseke bonsi abekungi timobaisa kobaita, mobaire babe abaino.

English: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
Kiswahili: “Ninyi nyote ambao mmeua mtu yeyote au kumgusa mtu yeyote ambaye ameuawa, lazima mkae nje ya kambi kwa muda wa siku saba. Katika siku ya tatu na ya saba lazima mjitakase wenyewe pamoja na wafungwa wenu.
Ekegusii: Na bono, onde bwensi ore ase more oitire omonto, na onde bwensi okunire egetondo, goika abeere isiko y’egetwori ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Ase rituko ria gatato, naende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, mwechene inwe abanyene, amo nabooswa baino.

English: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”
Kiswahili: Takaseni kila vazi pamoja na kila kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa ngozi, kwa singa za mbuzi au kwa mti.”
Ekegusii: Naende mochene kera eanga, na kera egento keroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose korwa ase amanya ye chimbori, na ebinto bionsi bi’emete.”

English: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani Eleazari aliwaambia askari waliokuwa wamekwenda vitani, “Haya ndiyo matakwa ya sheria ambayo Bwana alimpa Mose:
Ekegusii: Na Eleazari Omokuani agateebia abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase okorwana esegi, “Oyo n’oro omoroberio Omonene achiigete Musa:

English: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
Kiswahili: Dhahabu, fedha, shaba, chuma, bati, risasi,
Ekegusii: Etaabu, na efeta, na etai, na ebioma ao ao,

English: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
Kiswahili: na kitu kingine chochote ambacho kinaweza kuhimili moto lazima mkipitishe kwenye moto, kisha kitakuwa safi. Lakini ni lazima pia kitakaswe kwa maji ya utakaso. Kitu chochote kisichoweza kuhimili moto lazima kipitishwe kwenye yale maji ya utakaso.
Ekegusii: na ebinto binde bionsi bitanyare gosarigwa nomorero, ebio mobietie ase omorero ime ase okobirura, nabirobio nabicheneke. Nonya naboigo goika mobisibie namaache yogochena, na kera egento getanyare kobua omorero goika mogeetie ime ase amaache ayio.

English: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya saba fueni nguo zenu, nanyi mtakuwa safi. Kisha mtaweza kuingia kambini.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere mosibie chianga chiaino, nainwe ’namobe abachenekire; magega y’ayio monyare gosoa ase ebitwori.”

English: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
Kiswahili: “Wewe na kuhani Eleazari pamoja na viongozi wa jamaa ya jumuiya mtahesabu watu wote na wanyama ambao walitekwa.
Ekegusii: “Aye amo n’Eleazari Omokuani na abaraai b’ebisaku bi’omoganda bwonsi, mobare ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto abooswa, amo ne chitugo barenta.

English: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
Kiswahili: Gawanyeni hizo nyara kati ya askari ambao walishiriki katika vita na kwa jumuiya.
Ekegusii: Erio bwatanane ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto booswa amo ne ching’iti ase chinsemo ibere. Ensemo eyemo ebe ey’abarwani b’esegi, na eyende ey’omoganda.

English: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
Kiswahili: Kutoka fungu la wale waliokwenda kupigana vitani, tenga kama ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana kitu kimoja kati ya kila mia tano, ikiwa ni wanadamu, ngʼombe, punda, kondoo au mbuzi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ensemo etungetie abarwani orusie omonto oyomo korwa ase abanto amagana atano aboosetwe abe oyo bw’Omonene. Naboigo orusie eng’iti eyemo korwa ase ching’iti amagana atano ase chiombe, chitigere, ching’ondi ne chimbori, chibe echia Omonene.

English: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.
Kiswahili: Chukua ushuru huu kutoka fungu lao, umpe kuhani Eleazari kama sehemu ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo baatananwe korwa ase ekeng’ese ekio baegwe Eleazari Omokuani, erio babe ekeegwa ase Omonene, naboigo ne ching’iti chiria.

English: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”
Kiswahili: Kutoka fungu la Waisraeli, chukua kitu kimoja kati ya kila hamsini, ikiwa ni wanadamu, ngʼombe, punda, kondoo, mbuzi au wanyama wengine. Hivyo uwape Walawi, ambao wanawajibika kutunza Maskani ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Naende korwa ase ekeng’ese egetungetie omoganda bw’Abaisraeli bwatanane omonto oyomo korwa ase abanto emerongo etano, na eyemo ye chiombe ase emerongo etano, naboigo ase chitigere, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori. Abanto abwo amo ne ching’iti echio chionsi oe Abalawi abwo bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene.”

English: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bagakora buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
Kiswahili: Nyara zilizobaki kutoka mateka ambayo askari walichukua ni kondoo 675,000,
Ekegusii: Ebisakorwa ebiatigarete ase abarwani b’esegi, ebi barentete ekero babuete, nabio ebi: ching’ondi, amo ne chimbori, chilifu amagana atano nomo na merongo etano na ebere na isano (675,000),

English: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
Kiswahili: ngʼombe 72,000,
Ekegusii: ne chiombe chilifu emerongo etano na ebere na ibere (72,000),

English: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
Kiswahili: punda 61,000,
Ekegusii: ne chitigere chilifu emerongo etano nomo na eyemo (61,000)

English: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
Kiswahili: na wanawake 32,000 ambao hawakumjua mume kwa kufanya tendo la ndoa.
Ekegusii: na abaiseke abekungi chilifu emerongo etato na ibere (32,000).

English: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;
Kiswahili: Nusu ya fungu la wale waliokwenda kupigana vitani lilikuwa: Kondoo 337,500
Ekegusii: Ekeng’ese egiatungetie abarwani b’esegi nigo kiarenge: Ching’ondi amo ne chimbori chilifu amagana atato na merongo etato na isano ibere, na amagana atano (337,500).

English: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
Kiswahili: ambayo ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ilikuwa kondoo 675;
Ekegusii: Ebango y’Omonene yarusetigwe korwa ase ching’ondi echio, amo ne chimbori, nigo yarenge amagana atano rimo, na merongo etan’ebere, na isano (675).

English: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.
Kiswahili: ngʼombe 36,000 ambao ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ulikuwa ngʼombe 72;
Ekegusii: Chiombe baetwe nigo chiarenge chilifu emerongo etato na isano nemo (36,000), na echia Omonene nigo chiarenge emerongo etano na ebere, (72).

English: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.
Kiswahili: punda 30,500 ambao ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ulikuwa punda 61;
Ekegusii: Chitigere baetwe nigo chiarenge chilifu emerongo etato, na amagana atano (30,500), na echi’Omonene nigo chiarenge emerongo etano nomo, na eyemo (61).

English: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
Kiswahili: Watu 16,000 ambao ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ulikuwa watu 32.
Ekegusii: Abaiseke abekungi baetwe nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na isano nemo (16,000) na aba Omonene nigo barenge emerongo etato, na babere (32).

English: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Mose alimpa kuhani Eleazari ushuru kama sehemu ya Bwana, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Musa akaa Eleazari Omokuani ensemo eria yaruetwe ase Omonene, buna ere konya achiikire Musa.

English: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
Kiswahili: Ile nusu iliyokuwa ya Waisraeli, ambayo Mose aliitenga kutoka kwa ile ya watu waliokwenda vitani,
Ekegusii: Ekeng’ese giatungetie Abaisraeli, ekio Musa arusetie korwa ase abarwani baria b’esegi,

English: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
Kiswahili: nusu iliyokuwa ya jumuiya, ilikuwa kondoo 337,500,
Ekegusii: nigo kiarenge ching’ondi chilifu amagana atato, emerongo etato na isano na ibere, na amagana atano (337,500),

English: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
Kiswahili: ngʼombe 36,000,
Ekegusii: ne chiombe chilifu emerongo etato na isano nemo (36,000),

English: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
Kiswahili: punda 30,500,
Ekegusii: ne chitigere chilifu emerongo etato, na amagana atano (30,500),

English: and sixteen thousand persons),
Kiswahili: na wanadamu 16,000.
Ekegusii: na abanto chilifu ikomi na isano nemo (16,000).

English: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kutoka hiyo nusu iliyokuwa ya Waisraeli, Mose alichagua moja kati ya kila hamsini ya wanadamu na wanyama, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza, naye aliwapa Walawi, ambao waliwajibika kutunza Maskani ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese giatungetie omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, Musa agaatanana oyomo bw’ abanto emerongo etano, na eyemo ye ching’iti emerongo etano, akaa Abalawi baria barenge gokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
Kiswahili: Kisha maafisa waliokuwa juu ya vikosi vya jeshi, wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, walimwendea Mose
Ekegusii: Erio abanene b’abarwani, abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na ab’amagana, bagaacha ase Musa,

English: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
Kiswahili: na kumwambia, “Watumishi wako wamehesabu askari walio chini ya amri yetu na hakuna hata mmoja aliyekosekana.
Ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Omonene, intwe abasomba bao, twabarire abarwani b’esegi abarenge inse y’oborendi bwaito, na twanyorire ng’a mbonsi bare, onde tasireti korwa ase tore.

English: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tumeleta kama sadaka kwa Bwana vyombo vya dhahabu kila mmoja wetu alivyopata, yaani vikuku, bangili, pete za muhuri, vipuli na mikufu, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yetu mbele za Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio twarentire ebinto bie chitaabu bi’ogwechabera: ebitange bi’amaboko, na ebigera, ne chibonyi, na ebigera bi’amato, ne chisonoi. Ebinto ebio twasakorete kera oyomo oito, na bono twabirentire, twabirure ase Omonene, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase tore ase obosio bwaye.”

English: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
Kiswahili: Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakapokea kutoka kwao dhahabu, yaani vyombo vyote vilivyonakshiwa.
Ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bakanyora korwa ase abatang’ani abwo chitaabu chiria chiaroisetigwe ebinto bi’ogwechabera.

English: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
Kiswahili: Dhahabu yote kutoka kwa wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia ambavyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari walimletea Bwana kama zawadi ilikuwa shekeli 16,750
Ekegusii: Chitaabu chionsi chiaruetwe ase Omonene, chiria abatang’ani baria b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana barentete, nigo chiarenge chi’oborito koreng’ana ne chikiro amagana abere.

English: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
Kiswahili: Kila askari alikuwa amejichukulia nyara zake binafsi.
Ekegusii: Abarwani b’esegi konya basakoire ebinto, na kera oyomo obo konya oirire ebiaye bweka omonyene.

English: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mose na kuhani Eleazari walipokea dhahabu kutoka kwa wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, wakazileta katika Hema la Kukutania kama ukumbusho kwa Waisraeli mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bakanyora chitaabu chiria korwa ase abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana, bagachiira ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Abaisraeli bakainyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.
Kiswahili: Kabila la Wareubeni na Wagadi, waliokuwa na makundi makubwa ya ngʼombe, kondoo na mbuzi, waliona kuwa nchi ya Yazeri na nchi ya Gileadi ni nzuri kwa mifugo.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi, nigo babwate amaicho amaange mono. Ekero barooche ense ya Yaeseri na eya Gileadi ng’a nigo chire chingiya ase oborisia,

English: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
Kiswahili: Hivyo walimjia Mose, na kuhani Eleazari na viongozi wa jumuiya, na kuwaambia,
Ekegusii: bakageenda ase Musa, na Eleazari Omokuani, na ase abaraai b’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, bakabateebia,

English: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
Kiswahili: “Atarothi, Diboni, Yazeri, Nimra, Heshboni, Eleale, Sebamu, Nebo na Beoni,
Ekegusii: “Ataroti, na Diboni, na Yaeseri, na Nimura, na Hesiboni, na Eleali, na Sibamu, na Nebo, na Beoni,

English: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
Kiswahili: nchi ambayo Bwana ameishinda mbele ya wana wa Israeli, inafaa kwa mifugo, nao watumishi wako wana mifugo.
Ekegusii: nemechie y’ense eyi’Omonene atigete omoganda bw’Abaisraeli okayebua, na ense eye nigo ere engiya ase oborisia bwe chitugo, na intwe abasomba bao nigo tobwate amaicho amaange ye chitugo.”

English: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
Kiswahili: Kama tumepata kibali mbele ya macho yako, nchi hii na ipewe watumishi wako kama milki yetu. Usitufanye tuvuke Yordani.”
Ekegusii: Naende bagateeba, “Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa korwa ase ore, tiga intwe, abasomba bao, toegwe ense eye ebe eyaito, korende tobaisa gotwambokia gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani komenyao.”

English: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia Wagadi na Wareubeni, “Je, watu wa nchi yenu watakwenda vitani wakati ninyi mmeketi hapa?
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’abanto ba Gadi na abareubeni, akabora, “Inee! Abanto bamino nigo bakogeenda korwana esegi, nainwe mobe motigarete aase aa?

English: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mmewakatisha Waisraeli tamaa wasivuke katika nchi ambayo Bwana amewapa?
Ekegusii: Nase ki inwe mogoita Abaisraeli emioyo, erinde tibaabaisa kwamboka gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, na koira ense eri’Omonene abaeire?

English: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo baba zenu walivyofanya wakati nilipowatuma kutoka Kadesh-Barnea kuipeleleza nchi.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro chisokoro chiaino chiakorete ekero nabatomete korwa Kadeshi-Barinea gochia koroota ense eyio.

English: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kufika kwenye Bonde la Eshkoli na kuitazama nchi, waliwakatisha tamaa Waisraeli wasiingie katika nchi ambayo Bwana alikuwa amewapa.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakageenda bagaika ase ense omweya y’Esikoli, na ekero barooche ense eria, bakairana bagaita Abaisraeli emioyo ase ogotageenda ase ense eri’Omonene konya abaeire.

English: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,
Kiswahili: Siku ile hasira ya Bwana iliwaka naye akaapa kiapo hiki:
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene, agatiana, akabora:

English: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
Kiswahili: ‘Kwa kuwa hawakunifuata kwa moyo wote, hakuna mtu yeyote mwenye miaka ishirini au zaidi ambaye alikuja kutoka Misri atakayeona nchi niliyoahidi kwa kiapo kwa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo;
Ekegusii: Ekeene ase abanto bonsi baruete Misiri, aba bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, onde tari, nonya noyomo oranyare korora ense eria narierete Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a nimbae, ekiagera abanto aba bangire koba abegenwa asende.

English: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed Yahweh completely.’
Kiswahili: hakuna hata mmoja isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, Mkenizi, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, kwa sababu walimfuata Bwana kwa moyo wote.’
Ekegusii: Ase barabwo onde tari oranyare goika aroro otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune Omokenisi, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni. Barabwo nabaike aroro, ekiagera babeire abegenwa ase ’nde, inche Omonene.

English: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in Yahweh’s sight was consumed.
Kiswahili: Hasira ya Bwana iliwaka dhidi ya Waisraeli na akawafanya watangetange katika jangwa kwa miaka arobaini, mpaka kizazi chote cha wale waliofanya maovu mbele yake kimeangamia.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli, akabatiga bakana‐goetanana ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika abanto bonsi b’ekiaare keria, abwo konya bakorire ebibe ase Omonene, bagasirigwa kegima.

English: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.
Kiswahili: “Nanyi mko hapa, uzao wa wenye dhambi, mkisimamia mahali pa baba zenu na mkimfanya Bwana kuwakasirikia Waisraeli hata zaidi.
Ekegusii: Na bono, inwe oroiboro rw’ abanto abanyabibe, mwabeire mamincha y’Omonene, buna chisokoro chiaino chiarenge, na mwagerire Omonene omentire endamwamu yaye ase Abaisraeli.

English: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
Kiswahili: Kama mkigeuka na mkiacha kumfuata, atawaacha tena watu hawa wote jangwani, na mtakuwa sababu ya maangamizi yao.”
Ekegusii: Inwe komoraange koigwera Omonene, ere nigo aratige abanto aba bonsi agwo ase erooro, nainwe mogere abanto aba bonsi basire.”

English: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakamjia Mose na kumwambia, “Tungalitaka kujenga mazizi hapa kwa ajili ya mifugo yetu na miji kwa ajili ya wanawake wetu na watoto.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi bagaacha ase Musa bakaboora, “Toe ribaga toagache ameri amakong’u aiga ase chitugo chiaito chikobeera, naende toagache emechie egiteire chindwaki ase abana baito baramenye.

English: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi tuko tayari kuchukua silaha zetu na kutangulia mbele ya Waisraeli mpaka tutakapowaleta mahali pao. Wakati huo wanawake wetu na watoto wataishi katika miji yenye ngome, kwa ajili ya ulinzi dhidi ya wenyeji wa nchi.
Ekegusii: Erio intwe toimokie ebirwanero bi’eseegi, twebeke ang’e totang’ane Abaisraeli korwana esegi goika tobaikie aase abo. Korende abana baito batigare aa, bamenyete ime yemechie egiteire chindwaki, erinde abanto b’ense eye tibaabaisa kobakorera bobe.

English: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.
Kiswahili: Hatutarudi nyumbani mwetu mpaka kila Mwisraeli apokee urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Titokoirana ase chinka chiaito goika torore ng’a Abaisraeli baminto banyorire kera omonto orogongo rw’omwando oye.

English: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
Kiswahili: Hatutapokea urithi wowote pamoja nao ngʼambo ya Yordani, kwa sababu urithi wetu umekuja kwetu upande wa mashariki ya Yordani.”
Ekegusii: Intwe titokonyora omwando oito amo nabarabwo agwo ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ekiagera twanyorire omwando oito aiga moocha ya Yorodani.”

English: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akawaambia, “Kama mtafanya jambo hili, kama mtajivika silaha mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya vita,
Ekegusii: Musa akabairaneria, agateeba, “Onye mogochia gokora bo, rirorio bogoria ebirwanero biaino bi’eseegi ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio mogende korwana esegi.
