English: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
Kiswahili: na kama ninyi nyote mtakwenda mmejivika silaha ngʼambo ya Yordani mbele za Bwana mpaka awe amewafukuza adui zake mbele zake,
Ekegusii: Kera omonto ore ase more, oyobogoretie ebirwanero bi’eseegi nigo aramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ase obosio bw’Omonene: mobeereo goika ere abue ababisa baye barue ase are,

English: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to Yahweh and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: hadi wakati nchi itakapokuwa imeshindwa mbele za Bwana, ndipo mtaweza kurudi na kuwa huru kutoka masharti yenu kwa Bwana na Israeli. Nayo nchi hii itakuwa milki yenu mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: na ense eria ebe yabuirwe ase Omonene. Magega y’ayio nario moranyare koirana aiga motari na komocha, na igo monyore ense eye ebe eyaino, monyare komenya ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.
Kiswahili: “Lakini mkishindwa kufanya hili, mtakuwa mnatenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana; nanyi kuweni na hakika kuwa dhambi yenu itawapata.
Ekegusii: Korende motaikeraneti chiira chiaino mwarire, ekeene rirorio mwakorire ebibe ase Omonene, na mobe nobomaene ng’a nase engencho y’ebibe ebio biaino moranyore egesusuro.

English: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
Kiswahili: Jengeni miji kwa ajili ya wanawake na watoto wenu, na mazizi kwa ajili ya mbuzi na kondoo zenu, lakini fanyeni yale mliyoahidi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio agacha emechie ase abana baino baramenye na ameri ase ching’ondi chiaino, erio mokore buna mwariire chiira chiaino.”

English: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
Kiswahili: Wagadi na Wareubeni wakamwambia Mose, “Sisi watumishi wako tutafanya kama bwana wetu anavyotuagiza.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi na ab’ekia Rubeni bakamoteebia Musa, “Omonene oito, intwe abasomba bao inatokore buna gwachiikire.

English: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
Kiswahili: Watoto na wake zetu, makundi ya mbuzi na kondoo, na makundi ya ngʼombe zetu, watabaki hapa katika miji ya Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Abana baito na abakungu barabwo tiga batigare amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiaito aiga ase emechie ya Gileadi.

English: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”
Kiswahili: Lakini watumishi wenu, kila mwanaume aliyevaa silaha za vita, watavuka ngʼambo kupigana mbele za Bwana, sawa kama bwana wetu anavyosema.”
Ekegusii: Korende intwe abasomba bao, kera oyomo oito oyobogoretie ebirwanero bi’okorwana esegi agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene ’namboke gochia ng’umbu, buna aye omonene oito gwachiikire.”

English: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akatoa amri kuhusu wao kwa kuhani Eleazari, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi wa jamaa za makabila ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana y’ abanto abwo, Musa agachiika Eleazari Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na abaraai be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli,

English: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
Kiswahili: Mose akawaambia, “Ikiwa Wagadi na Wareubeni, kila mwanaume aliyevaa silaha za vita, atavuka Yordani pamoja nanyi mbele za Bwana, basi wakati mtakapoishinda nchi iliyoko mbele yenu, wapeni nchi ya Gileadi kama milki yao.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Onye Abagadi na Abareubeni, abwo bonsi babogoretie ebirwanero bi’eseegi, bakwamboka Yorodani amo nainwe korwana esegi ase obosio bw’Omonene, na inwe mobue ense eria, na koyeira, erio mobae ense ya Gileadi ebe eyabo.

English: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hawatavuka pamoja nanyi wakiwa wamevaa silaha za vita, lazima wakubali kupokea milki yao pamoja nanyi katika nchi ya Kanaani.”
Ekegusii: Korende onye tibakobogoria ebirwanero bi’eseegi bamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, rirorio nigo baranyore orogongo rwabo amo nainwe agwo ase ense ya Kaanani.”

English: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.
Kiswahili: Wagadi na Wareubeni wakajibu, “Watumishi wako watafanya lile Bwana alilosema.
Ekegusii: Abagadi na Abareubeni bakairaneria, bagateeba, “Bun’Omonene atochiikire intwe abasomba bao, nabo torakore.

English: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
Kiswahili: Tutavuka mbele za Bwana kuingia Kanaani tukiwa tumevaa silaha za vita, lakini mali tutakayoirithi itakuwa ngʼambo hii ya Yordani.”
Ekegusii: Intwe ’ntobogorie ebirwanero biaito bi’eseegi, na twamboke gochia ase ense ya Kaanani ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio nario toratware ense eye ere aa moocha ya Yorodani ebe eyaito.”

English: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akawapa Wagadi, Wareubeni, na nusu ya kabila la Manase mwana wa Yosefu ufalme wa Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, na ufalme wa Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, nchi yote pamoja na miji yake, na nchi inayowazunguka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akaa abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi, na ab’ekia Rubeni, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, na orw’Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. Amo nechio akabaa boigo emechie y’ense eria amo ne chinse chiaetanaineo.

English: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
Kiswahili: Wagadi wakajenga Diboni, Atarothi, Aroeri,
Ekegusii: Abagadi bakaagacha emechie ya Diboni, na Ataroti, na Aroeri,

English: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
Kiswahili: Atroth-Shofani, Yazeri, Yogbeha,
Ekegusii: na Ataroti‐Shofani, na Yaeseri, ne Yogibea,

English: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.
Kiswahili: Beth-Nimra na Beth-Harani kama miji iliyozungushiwa ngome, tena wakajenga mazizi kwa ajili ya makundi yao ya mbuzi na kondoo.
Ekegusii: na Beti‐Nimura, na Beti‐Harani, emechie yagiteire chindwaki, naende yabwate ameri ye ching’ondi.

English: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
Kiswahili: Nao Wareubeni wakajenga upya miji ya Heshboni, Eleale na Kiriathaimu,
Ekegusii: Abareubeni bakaagacha emechie ya Hesiboni, na Eleale, na Kiriataimu,

English: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
Kiswahili: pia Nebo na Baal-Meoni (majina ya hiyo miji yalibadilishwa) na Sibma. Miji waliyoijenga upya waliipa majina.
Ekegusii: Nebo, na Baali‐Meoni (amarieta abo akaonchorwa), na Sibuma. Boigo bakaroka emechie eyio baagachete ase amarieta ande amayia.

English: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Makiri mwana wa Manase walikwenda Gileadi, wakaiteka nchi na kuwafukuza Waamori waliokuwa huko.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Makiri, mosinto o Manase, bakageenda bakaumokera ense ya Gileadi, bagaseria Abaamori bamenyeteo, erio bakaira ense eria.

English: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawapa Wamakiri, wazao wa Manase, nchi ya Gileadi, nao wakakaa huko.
Ekegusii: Musa akaa abanto ba Makiri, mosinto o Manase, ense ya Gileadi, na barabwo bakamenyao.

English: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
Kiswahili: Yairi, mzao wa Manase, akateka makao yao, akayaita Hawoth-Yairi.
Ekegusii: Egesaku kia Yairi, mosinto o Manase, gekageenda, gekaumokera na koira emechie emeke y’ense ya Gileadi, bakayeroka Emechie ya Yairi.

English: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
Kiswahili: Naye Noba akateka Kenathi na makao yaliyoizunguka, akayaita Noba kwa jina lake.
Ekegusii: Na Noba nere akageenda akaumokera na koira Kenati amo nebichie biaetanaineo, nere akaroka Kenati Noba, erieta riaye omonyene.

English: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo vituo katika safari ya Waisraeli walipotoka Misri kwa vikosi chini ya uongozi wa Mose na Aroni.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’ebitwori bi’Abaisraeli, ekero baare ase orogeendo korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase emeganda yabo inse y’oboraai bwa Musa na Aroni.

English: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their starting points.
Kiswahili: Kwa agizo la Bwana, Mose aliweka kumbukumbu ya vituo katika safari yao. Hivi ndivyo vituo katika safari yao:
Ekegusii: Bun’Omonene achiigete Musa, nere akariika kera aase ase baare gotoora. Ebi nabio ebitwori biabo buna baare gotoora na koimoka kogeenda.

English: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walisafiri kutoka Ramesesi katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa kwanza, siku iliyofuata Pasaka. Walitembea kwa ujasiri wazi mbele ya Wamisri wote,
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, rituko ria ikomi na gatano, rituko riarenge kobwatia eri’Epasaka, Abaisraeli bakang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Bakaimoka korwa Ramesesi, bare noboremu. Bakarua ase amasio y’Abamisiri,

English: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.
Kiswahili: waliokuwa wakizika wazaliwa wao wa kwanza wote, ambao Bwana alikuwa amewaua katikati yao, kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa ameleta hukumu juu ya miungu yao.
Ekegusii: ekero barabwo barenge gotindeka abana babo abatangi, bari’Omonene aitete, naende akanachera chinyasae chiabo ekiina.

English: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli waliondoka Ramesesi na kupiga kambi huko Sukothi.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua Ramesesi, bakageenda Sukoti, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Sukothi na kupiga kambi huko Ethamu, pembeni mwa jangwa.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Sukoti, bakageenda Etamu, ase ensinyo y’erooro, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Ethamu, wakageuka wakarudi Pi-Hahirothi, hadi mashariki ya Baal-Sefoni, wakapiga kambi yao karibu na Migdoli.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Etamu, bakaonchoka bakairana bagaika Pi‐Hahiroti, moocha ya Baali‐Sefoni, bagatoora ang’e na Migidoli.

English: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Pi-Hahirothi wakapita katikati ya bahari mpaka jangwani, na baada ya kusafiri kwa siku tatu katika Jangwa la Ethamu, walipiga kambi huko Mara.
Ekegusii: Bakarua agwo Pi‐Hahiroti, bakageenda bagaeta egati y’Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro. Erio bakageenda orogeendo rw’amatuko atato ase erooro ya Etamu, bagatoora agwo Mara.

English: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Mara wakaenda Elimu, mahali ambapo palikuwa na chemchemi kumi na mbili na mitende sabini, huko wakapiga kambi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Mara, bakageenda bagaika Elimu, aase chinsoko chi’amaache ikomi na ibere chiarenge amo nemekendo emerongo etano na ebere, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Elimu na kupiga kambi kando ya Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Elimu, bakageenda bagaika ang’e n’Enyancha Embariri, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka kando ya Bahari ya Shamu na kupiga kambi katika Jangwa la Sini.
Ekegusii: Bakarua aase aria bagaika erooro ya Sini, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka katika Jangwa la Sini, wakapiga kambi huko Dofka.
Ekegusii: Bakarua erooro ya Sini, bakageenda bagaika Dofuka, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Dofka, wakapiga kambi huko Alushi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Dofuka, bakageenda bagaika Alusi, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Alushi, wakapiga kambi Refidimu, mahali ambapo hapakuwa na maji kwa ajili ya watu kunywa.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Alusi, bakageenda bagaika Refidimu, aase abanto batanyorete amaache bakonywa, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Refidimu na kupiga kambi katika Jangwa la Sinai.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Refidimu, bakageenda bagaika erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka katika Jangwa la Sinai na kupiga kambi huko Kibroth-Hataava.
Ekegusii: Bakarua erooro ya Sinai, bakageenda bagaika Kibiroti‐Hatawa, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Kibroth-Hataava na kupiga kambi huko Haserothi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Kibiroti‐Hatawa, bakageenda bagaika Haseroti, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Haserothi na kupiga kambi huko Rithma.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Haseroti, bakageenda bagaika Ritima, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Rithma na kupiga kambi huko Rimon-Peresi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Ritima, bakageenda bagaika Rimoni‐Peresi, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Rimon-Peresi na kupiga kambi huko Libna.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Rimoni‐Peresi, bakageenda bagaika Libuna, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Libna na kupiga kambi huko Risa.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Libuna, bakageenda bagaika Risa, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Risa na kupiga kambi huko Kehelatha.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Risa, bakageenda bagaika Kehelata, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Kehelatha na kupiga kambi kwenye mlima Sheferi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Kehelata, bakageenda bagaika egetunwa gia Seferi, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka kwenye mlima Sheferi na kupiga kambi huko Harada.
Ekegusii: Bakarua egetunwa gia Seferi, bakageenda bagaika Harada, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Harada na kupiga kambi huko Makelothi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Harada, bakageenda bagaika Makeloti, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Makelothi na kupiga kambi huko Tahathi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Makeloti bakageenda bagaika Tahati, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Tahathi na kupiga kambi huko Tera.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Tahati, bakageenda bagaika Tera, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Tera na kupiga kambi huko Mithka.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Tera, bakageenda bagaika Mitika, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Mithka na kupiga kambi huko Hashmona.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Mitika, bakageenda bagaika Hasimona, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Hashmona na kupiga kambi Moserothi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Hasimona, bakageenda bagaika Moseroti, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Moserothi na kupiga kambi huko Bene-Yakani.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Moseroti, bakageenda bagaika Bene‐Yakani, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Bene-Yakani na kupiga kambi huko Hor-Hagidgadi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Bene‐Yakani, bakageenda bagaika Hori‐Hagidigadi, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Hor-Hagidgadi na kupiga kambi huko Yotbatha.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Hori‐Hagidigadi, bakageenda bagaika Yotibata, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Yotbatha na kupiga kambi huko Abrona.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Yotibata, bakageenda bagaika Aburona, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Abrona na kupiga kambi huko Esion-Geberi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Aburona, bakageenda bagaika Esioni‐Geberi, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Esion-Geberi na kupiga kambi huko Kadeshi katika Jangwa la Sini.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Esioni‐Geberi, bakageenda bagaika erooro ya Sini (nao Kadeshi), bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Kadeshi na kupiga kambi kwenye Mlima Hori, mpakani mwa Edomu.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Kadeshi, bakageenda bagaika egetunwa kia Hori, ang’e norobebe rw’ense ya Edomu, bagatoora aroro.

English: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
Kiswahili: Kwa amri ya Bwana, kuhani Aroni alipanda Mlima Hori, mahali alipofia katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa tano, mwaka wa arobaini baada ya Waisraeli kutoka Misri.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano, omwaka bw’emerongo ene magega Abaisraeli kobarure ense ya Misiri, Aroni Omokuani agatiira gochia igoro ase egetunwa kia Hori, buna Omonene konya amochiikire, agakwera aroro.

English: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
Kiswahili: Aroni alikufa juu ya Mlima Hori akiwa na umri wa miaka 123.
Ekegusii: Aroni konya okoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na merongo ebere, na etato (123), ekero akwerete agwo ase egetunwa keria kia Hori.

English: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Mkanaani wa Aradi, ambaye aliishi huko Negebu ya Kanaani, akasikia kwamba Waisraeli wanakuja.
Ekegusii: Na omorwoti orenge kogamba Aradi, ensemo ya Irianyi ase ense ya Kaanani, akaigwa ng’a Abaisraeli nigo bare inchera gocha.

English: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka kwenye mlima Hori na kupiga kambi huko Salmona.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua egetunwa keria kia Hori, bakageenda bagaika Salimona bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Salmona, wakapiga kambi huko Punoni.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Salimona, bakageenda bagaika Punoni, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Punoni, wakapiga kambi huko Obothi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Punoni, bakageenda bagaika Oboti, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Obothi, wakapiga kambi huko Iye-Abarimu, mipakani mwa Moabu.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Oboti, bakageenda bagaika Iye‐Abarimu, bagatoora aroro ase orobebe rwa Moabu.

English: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Iye-Abarimu, wakapiga kambi huko Dibon-Gadi.
Ekegusii: Bakarua agwo Iyumu, bakageenda bagaika Diboni‐Gadi, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Dibon-Gadi na kupiga kambi huko Almon-Diblathaimu.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Diboni‐Gadi, bakageenda bagaika Alimoni‐Dibulataimu, bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka Almon-Diblathaimu na kupiga kambi katika milima ya Abarimu, karibu na Nebo.
Ekegusii: Bakarua Alimoni‐Dibulataimu, bagaika ebitunwa bi’Abarimu kororia Nebo bagatoora aroro.

English: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka kwenye milima ya Abarimu na kupiga kambi kwenye tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Bakarua ebitunwa bi’Abarimu, bakageenda bagaika ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ang’e na Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, bagatoora aroro.

English: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
Kiswahili: Huko kwenye tambarare za Moabu walipiga kambi kandokando ya Mto Yordani, kuanzia Beth-Yeshimothi mpaka Abel-Shitimu.
Ekegusii: Bagatoora ang’e na Yorodani, na egetwori kiabo kegachaakera Beti‐Yesimoti, kegaikeera Abeli‐Sitimu, ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
Kiswahili: Katika tambarare za Moabu kando ya Yordani kuvukia Yeriko, Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu mbarabare y’oro rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Mtakapovuka Mto Yordani kuingia Kanaani,
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moraabe mwambokire Yorodani na mwaikire ase ense ya Kaanani,

English: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
Kiswahili: wafukuzeni wakazi wote wa nchi iliyo mbele yenu. Haribuni sanamu zao zote za kuchongwa, na sanamu zilizotengenezwa kwa kuyeyusha chuma, na kupabomoa mahali pao pa ibada.
Ekegusii: moseerie abanto ababiare bonsi b’ense eria barue ase amasio aino. Naende mosarie emegwekano yabo eyio bagosasiima eroisirie korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa, motagore aase aimokererete igoro ase bagosasiimera.

English: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
Kiswahili: Mtaimiliki nchi hiyo na kukaa huko, kwa kuwa nimewapeni ninyi kuimiliki.
Ekegusii: Moire ense yabo ebe eyaino momenyeo, ekiagera nabayeere.

English: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
Kiswahili: Mtaigawanya nchi hiyo kwa kupiga kura, kufuatana na koo zenu. Kwa kundi kubwa zaidi toa urithi mkubwa zaidi, na kwa kundi dogo zaidi urithi mdogo zaidi. Chochote kinachowaangukia kwa kura kitakuwa chao. Mtaigawanya nchi kufuatana na makabila ya babu zenu.
Ekegusii: Mwatanane ense eria ase kera egesaku ase ogoaka obomera. Moe abanto b’egesaku ekenene orogongo oronene robe omwando obo, na abanto b’egesaku egeke orogongo oroke robe orwabo. Obomera koboragwere omonto, omwando oria nobe oyo bw’omonto oyio. Kera egesaku keegwe omwando buna obomera borakegwere. Inamoegwe emiando koreng’ana nebisaku bie chisokoro chiaino.

English: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama hamkuwafukuza wenyeji wakaao katika nchi hiyo, wale mtakaowaruhusu wabaki watakuwa kama sindano kwenye macho yenu na miiba kwenu kila upande. Watawasumbua katika nchi mtakayoishi.
Ekegusii: Korende onye timogoseria ababiare b’ense eria barue ase more, rirorio baria moratige bamenye amo nainwe ’nababe buna chimbambo chinyoge chikobabeta amaiso aino, na buna amagwa akobabeta ase amakere aino; barabwo nababachaande ase ense eyio mogochia komenya.

English: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”
Kiswahili: Kisha nitawatenda ninyi kile ambacho nimepanga kuwatenda wao.’ ”
Ekegusii: Motabasereti, rirorio nimbakore inwe buna konya narengereirie kobakorera barabwo.”

English: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
Kiswahili: “Waamuru Waisraeli na uwaambie: ‘Mtakapoingia nchi ya Kanaani, nchi ambayo itagawanywa kwenu kama urithi itakuwa na mipaka ifuatayo:
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obachiike: Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kaanani, eyio nero ense erabe omwando oino, chimbebe chiaye nigo chirabe iga:

English: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Upande wenu wa kusini utajumuisha sehemu ya Jangwa la Sini kufuata mpaka wa Edomu. Upande wa mashariki mpaka wenu wa kusini utaanzia mwisho wa Bahari ya Chumvi,
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya Irianyi, ense yaino eike ase erooro ya Sini, egenderere gochia ase orobebe rwa Edomu. Orobebe rwaino rwa Irianyi rochakere ensemo ya moocha ase ensinyo y’Enyancha y’omonyoo,

English: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
Kiswahili: katiza kusini mwa Pito la Akrabimu, endelea mpaka Sini na kwenda kusini ya Kadesh-Barnea. Kisha mpaka huo utaenda hadi Hasar-Adari hadi Azmoni,
Ekegusii: naende roonchoke gochia Irianyi y’egetunwa ki’Ebiuge roetere Sini, Irianyi ya Kadeshi‐Barinea. Korwa agwo rogenderere roike Hasari‐Adari, naende roete roike Asimoni,

English: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
Kiswahili: mahali ambapo utapinda, na kuunganika na Kijito cha Misri na kumalizikia kwenye Bahari ya Kati.
Ekegusii: na korwa agwo Asimoni rogenderere kobwatia orooche rw’orobebe rwa Misiri, roike Enyancha Enene.

English: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mpaka wenu wa magharibi utakuwa Bahari ya Kati. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu upande wa magharibi.
Ekegusii: “Enyancha Enene nero erabe orobebe rwaino rwa bosongo.

English: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa mpaka wenu wa kaskazini, wekeni alama kuanzia Bahari ya Kati hadi mlima Hori,
Ekegusii: “Orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu ’ndochakere korwa ase Enyancha Enene, rogenderere gochia ase egetunwa kia Hori.

English: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
Kiswahili: na kutoka mlima Hori hadi Pito la Hamathi. Kisha mpaka utaenda hadi Sedadi,
Ekegusii: Korwa aroro rogenderere roike enchera ekogeenda Hamati, erio naende rogenderere goikera Sedadi,

English: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
Kiswahili: kuendelea hadi Zifroni, na kuishia Hasar-Enani. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu upande wa kaskazini.
Ekegusii: naende rogenderere gochia Sifuroni, na korwa aroro roike Hasari‐Enani. Oro narwo orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu.

English: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa mpaka wenu wa mashariki, wekeni alama kuanzia Hasar-Enani hadi Shefamu.
Ekegusii: “Orobebe rwaino rwa moocha rochakere korwa Hasari‐Enani, roikere Sefamu,

English: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
Kiswahili: Mpaka utaelekea kusini kuanzia Shefamu hadi Ribla upande wa mashariki wa Aini, na kuendelea kwenye miteremko mashariki mwa Bahari ya Kinerethi.
Ekegusii: naende rotirimboke gochia Ribula, moocha y’Aini, rotirimboke gochia moocha y’engegu y’enyancha ya Galili.

English: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
Kiswahili: Kisha mpaka utashuka kuelekea Mto Yordani na kuishia katika Bahari ya Chumvi. “ ‘Hii itakuwa nchi yenu, ikiwa na mipaka yake kila upande.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio rotirimboke robwatie orooche rwa Yorodani rotwomere Enyancha y’omonyoo. Eye nero erabe ense yaino, ne chimbebe chiaye chietanaineo.”

English: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
Kiswahili: Mose akawaamuru Waisraeli: “Gawanyeni nchi hii kwa kura kama urithi. Bwana ameagiza kwamba itolewe kwa yale makabila tisa na nusu,
Ekegusii: Musa agachiika Abaisraeli, akabateebia, “Eyio nero ense morarie ebe omwando oino ase ogoaka obomera, ense eri’Omonene achiikire ng’a n’ebe ey’ebisaku kianda na ekeng’ese.

English: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu jamaa ya kabila la Reubeni, kabila la Gadi, na nusu ya kabila la Manase wamekwishapokea urithi wao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ab’egesaku kia Gadi amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, barabwo konya banyorire omwando obo.

English: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
Kiswahili: Haya makabila mawili na nusu wamekwishapokea urithi wao upande wa mashariki wa Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko, kuelekea mawio ya jua.”
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebio bibere na ekeng’ese, barabwo konya banyorire omwando obo moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.”

English: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
Kiswahili: “Haya ndiyo majina ya watu ambao watakusaidia kugawanya nchi kama urithi: Eleazari kuhani na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.
Ekegusii: “Abanto aba nabwo bagochia kogokonya gwatanana ense: Ritang’ani Eleazari Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.

English: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
Kiswahili: Tena uteue kiongozi mmoja kutoka kila kabila kusaidia kuigawanya nchi.
Ekegusii: Naende ochore omoraai oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku aoboseemia gwatanana ense eria.”

English: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina yao: “Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, kutoka kabila la Yuda;
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bachoretwe. Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune.

English: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
Kiswahili: Shemueli mwana wa Amihudi, kutoka kabila la Simeoni;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Simioni, Semueli, mosinto bw’Amihudi.

English: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
Kiswahili: Elidadi mwana wa Kisloni, kutoka kabila la Benyamini;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini, Elidadi, mosinto o Kisiloni.

English: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
Kiswahili: Buki mwana wa Yogli, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Dani;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Dani, Buki, mosinto o Yogili.

English: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
Kiswahili: Hanieli mwana wa Efodi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Manase mwana wa Yosefu;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu; ase egesaku kia Manase, Hanieli, mosinto o Efodi.

English: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
Kiswahili: Kemueli mwana wa Shiftani, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Efraimu mwana wa Yosefu;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Efraimu, Kemueli, mosinto o Sifutani.

English: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
Kiswahili: Elisafani mwana wa Parnaki, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Zabuloni;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Elisafani, mosinto o Parinaki.

English: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
Kiswahili: Paltieli mwana wa Azani, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Isakari;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Palitieli, mosinto bw’Asani.

English: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
Kiswahili: Ahihudi mwana wa Shelomi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Asheri;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Ahihudi, mosinto o Selomi.

English: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
Kiswahili: Pedaheli mwana wa Amihudi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Naftali.”
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Pedaheli, mosinto bw’Amihudi.

English: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio watu ambao Bwana aliamuru wagawanye urithi kwa Waisraeli katika nchi ya Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabw’Omone ne achiigete baatanane ense ya Kaanani ebe emiando y’Abaisraeli.

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Mto Yordani kuvukia Yeriko,
Ekegusii: Ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ang’e na Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

English: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.
Kiswahili: “Waagize Waisraeli kuwapa Walawi miji ya kuishi kutoka urithi ambao Waisraeli wataumiliki. Wape maeneo ya malisho kuzunguka hiyo miji.
Ekegusii: “Chiika Abaisraeli ng’a korwa ase emiando eyio baranyore baatananere Abalawi emechie baramenye, amo noborisia boetanaineo.

English: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.
Kiswahili: Kisha watakuwa na miji ya kuishi na maeneo ya malisho kwa ajili ya ngʼombe zao, mbuzi, kondoo na mifugo yao mingine yote.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio ebe eyabo baramenye, na ebitii bi’oborisia bakorisia chiombe chiabo ne ching’iti chiabo chinde chionsi.

English: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.
Kiswahili: “Maeneo ya malisho kuzunguka miji hiyo ambayo mtawapa Walawi yataenea mita 450 kutoka kwenye ukuta wa miji.
Ekegusii: Ebitii bi’oborisia morae Abalawi bichakere korwa ase chindwaki chi’omochie, bigareigwe gochia ase oboare bwechifuti elifu eyemo korwa ase kera ensemo y’omochie.

English: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.
Kiswahili: Nje ya mji, pima mita 900 upande wa mashariki, upande wa kusini mita 900, upande wa magharibi mita 900, na upande wa kaskazini mita 900, na mji utakuwa katikati. Eneo hili litakuwa lao kwa ajili ya malisho.
Ekegusii: Naende mobare isiko y’omochie, ensemo ya moocha ekerengo giechifuti chilifu ibere, na ensemo ya Irianyi, na eya sugusu, na eya bosongo boigo, chifuti chilifu ibere; omochie obe gati‐gati. Ebitii ebi bi’oborisia Abalawi baegwe amo ne’mechie yabo.

English: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.
Kiswahili: “Miji sita mtakayowapa Walawi itakuwa ya makimbilio, ambayo mtu anayemuua mwenzake aweza kukimbilia humo. Zaidi ya hiyo, wapeni miji mingine arobaini na miwili.
Ekegusii: Moe Abalawi emechie etan’omo y’obotamero, erinde ekero omonto aitire omonto onde mosiabano, anyare gotamerao, naende mobae emechie ende emeao emerongo ene na ebere.

English: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Kwa jumla inawapasa kuwapa Walawi miji arobaini na minane, pamoja na maeneo ya malisho yao.
Ekegusii: Emechie yonsi morabae nigo erabe emerongo ene, na etan’etato, amo nebitii bi’oborisia bietanaine emechie eyio.

English: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”
Kiswahili: Miji ambayo mtawapa Walawi kutoka nchi ambayo Waisraeli wanamiliki itatolewa kwa uwiano wa urithi wa kila kabila. Chukua miji mingi kutoka lile kabila lenye miji mingi, lakini uchukue miji michache kutoka kwa kabila lile lenye miji michache.”
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio morae Abalawi nigo morayerusie korwa ase eria Abaisraeli babwate. Morusie emechie emenge korwa ase egesaku keria kere ekenene kebwate emechie emenge, na korwa ase egesaku kere egeke kebwate emechie emeke morusie emekeo, koreng’ana nomobaro obo.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose:
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa,

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
Kiswahili: “Sema na Waisraeli, uwaambie: ‘Mtakapovuka Yordani kuingia Kanaani,
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani na goika ense ya Kaanani,

English: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
Kiswahili: chagueni baadhi ya miji iwe miji yenu ya makimbilio, ambayo mtu ambaye ameua mwenzake bila kukusudia aweza kukimbilia humo.
Ekegusii: mochore emechie erabe obotamero ase more, erinde omonto onde bwensi, ora’be oitire omonto onde mosiabano, natamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio.

English: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
Kiswahili: Itakuwa mahali pa kukimbilia kutoka mlipiza kisasi, ili kwamba mtu aliyeshtakiwa kwa mauaji asife kabla ya kujitetea mbele ya mkutano.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio nebe obotamero bwaino, erinde omonto oria okorigia korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo oria oitwa, omoiti oria aratamere gochiao, abeereo goika rituko arache korentwa kogambigwa ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi.

English: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
Kiswahili: Miji hii sita mtakayoitoa itakuwa miji yenu ya makimbilio.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio morachore ebe ey’obotamero nigo erabe etano nomo.

English: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.
Kiswahili: Mtatoa miji mitatu ngʼambo hii ya Yordani na miji mingine mitatu upande wa Kanaani kama miji ya makimbilio.
Ekegusii: Etato ebe moocha ya Yorodani, na etato ebe ase ense ya Kaanani. Eyio ebe emechie y’obotamero.

English: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
Kiswahili: Miji hii sita itakuwa mahali pa makimbilio kwa ajili ya Waisraeli, wageni na watu wengine wanaoishi katikati yenu, ili kwamba mtu yeyote ambaye ameua mtu mwingine pasipo kukusudia aweze kukimbilia humo.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio etano nomo ebe ey’obotamero ase Abaisraeli, na ase abageni bagoeta, na ase abanto bare abamenyi ase egati yabo, erinde monto onde bwensi oraite omonto mosiabano atancheti atamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio.

English: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kama mtu akimpiga mwenzake kwa chuma naye mtu huyo akafa, mtu huyo ni muuaji; muuaji sharti atauawa.
Ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oakire omonto onde negento buna ekioma, na omonto oria okuure, omoiti oyio nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: Au kama mtu analo jiwe mkononi mwake ambalo laweza kuua, naye akampiga mwenzake akafa, yeye ni muuaji; muuaji huyo sharti atauawa.
Ekegusii: Boigo onye omonto obwate rigena ase okoboko kwaye oakire omonto onde, na omonto oria okuure, omoiti oyio nere goika aitwe akwe, ekiagera ere nomoorominta.

English: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: Au kama mtu ana chombo cha mti mkononi mwake ambacho chaweza kuua, naye akampiga mwenzake akafa, yeye ni muuaji; muuaji huyo sharti atauawa.
Ekegusii: Gose onye omonto oakire omonto onde nomote abwate ase okoboko kwaye, erinde omonto oria akwe, omoiti oyio nigo aita oria moeneno, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.
Kiswahili: Mlipiza kisasi cha damu atamuua muuaji; wakati akikutana naye, atamuua.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria okorigia korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo oitetwe, nere oraite omoiti oria aande onsi ase araumerane nere.

English: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu ana chuki ya siku nyingi na mwenzake akamsukuma au akamtupia kitu kwa kukusudia naye akafa,
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogechete oyonde na komoita ase okomotwoma, gose komoruta egento moeneno, na komoita,

English: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.
Kiswahili: au ikiwa katika uadui akampiga ngumi naye akafa, mtu yule sharti atauawa; yeye ni muuaji. Mlipiza kisasi cha damu atamuua muuaji atakapokutana naye.
Ekegusii: gose ase engencho y’obobisa bwarengeo agaaka oyonde nokoboko kwaye na komoita, rirorio omonto oria oaka oyonde na komoita, nere goika aitwe akwe. Ere nomoiti. Omonto oria okogania korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo, nere oramoite aande onsi ase araumerane nere.

English: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama mtu akimsukuma mwenziwe ghafula pasipo chuki, au kumtupia kitu pasipo kukusudia,
Ekegusii: “Eise koba ng’a omonto nigo atwomete oyonde atamogechete agwo ritang’ani, gose nigo amorutete egento mosiabano,

English: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,
Kiswahili: au, pasipo kumwona, akimwangushia jiwe ambalo laweza kumuua naye akafa, basi kwa kuwa hakuwa adui yake naye hakukusudia kumuumiza,
Ekegusii: gose omonto oria nigo arutete rigena, tamorooche, korende akamoaka akamoita atamogechete, gose taganetie komokorera bobe.

English: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
Kiswahili: kusanyiko lazima liamue kati yake na mlipiza kisasi wa damu kufuatana na sheria hizi.
Ekegusii: Onye ekoba bo, omosangererekano bw’ abanto n’oro oragaambe ekiina ase egati y’omonto oria oita omonto onde mosiabano na oria oganetie korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo oitetwe, na onache ekiina koreng’ana nemeroberio echiikire.

English: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko ni lazima limlinde yule anayeshtakiwa kuua kutoka kwa mlipiza kisasi wa damu, na kumrudisha katika mji wa makimbilio alikokuwa amekimbilia. Lazima akae humo mpaka atakapokufa kuhani mkuu ambaye alikuwa amepakwa mafuta matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Omosangererekano bw’ abanto notoorie omoiti oria korwa ase oria oganetie korusia egesiomba. Bamotige airane abeere ase omochie oria bw’obotamero atamerete, amenye aroro goika Omokuani omonene bw’engaki eyio, oyoakire amagutwa, akwe.

English: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kama mshtakiwa atatoka nje ya mipaka ya mji wa makimbilio ambao amekimbilia,
Ekegusii: Korende onye omoiti oria o mosiabano ase engaki ende yonsi ogosoka korwa ase omochie bw’obotamero, agwo ase atamerete,

English: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,
Kiswahili: na mlipiza kisasi wa damu akamkuta nje ya mji, mlipiza kisasi wa damu anaweza kumuua mshtakiwa huyo bila kuwa na hatia ya kuua.
Ekegusii: na omonto oria okorusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo amonyore ore isiko y’omochie oria karamoite, rirorio takobarerwa okomocha ase okomoita.

English: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
Kiswahili: Mshtakiwa lazima akae katika mji wake wa makimbilio mpaka atakapokufa kuhani mkuu; atarudi tu kwenye mali yake baada ya kifo cha kuhani mkuu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria oitete oyonde moeneno goika agenderere kobeera ase omochie oria bw’obotamero goika Omokuani bw’engaki eyio akwe. Korende Omokuani oria omonene gakuure, omonto oria nairane gochia ase ense yaye, na ase omwando oye.

English: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hizi ndizo kanuni za sheria zitakazohitajiwa kwenu na katika vizazi vyenu vijavyo, popote mtakapoishi.
Ekegusii: Okwo nogochika kwa boronge koraabe ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare, aase aande onsi ase moraabe momenyete.

English: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Yeyote anayeua mtu atauawa kama muuaji ikiwa tu kuna ushuhuda wa mashahidi. Lakini hakuna mtu atakayeuawa kwa ushuhuda wa shahidi mmoja tu.
Ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi karaite omonto onde moeneno, omonto oyio nere goika aitwe akwe ase oborori bw’ abanto babere gose goetania, korende omonto tagoitwa ase oborori bw’omonto oyomo bweka.

English: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usikubali fidia yoyote ya kuokoa uhai wa muuaji ambaye anastahili kufa. Mtu huyo hakika lazima auawe.
Ekegusii: Omonto oitire omonto onde moeneno takoegerwa aruerwe embooria. Omoiti oria onyorekanire n’okomocha kw’ogoita, nere goika aitwe akwe.

English: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Usikubali fidia ya mtu yeyote ambaye amekimbilia katika mji wa makimbilio na kumruhusu kurudi kuishi katika nchi yake kabla ya kifo cha kuhani mkuu.
Ekegusii: Boigo omonto oria omoiti o mosiabano otamire gochia ase oyomo bw’emechie y’obotamero takoboorigwa ng’a erio airane ase ense yaye ekero Omokuani Omonene bw’engaki eyio atarakwa.

English: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Msiinajisi nchi mnayoishi. Umwagaji damu hunajisi nchi, na upatanisho hauwezekani kufanyika katika nchi ambayo damu imemwagwa, isipokuwa tu kwa damu ya yule aliyeimwaga damu.
Ekegusii: Moise gokora ayio, nigo morasarie ense eye ase momenyete na koyekora ebe eyetachenegeti, ekiagera amanyinga agoiterwa nigo arakore ense ebe etachenegeti, na okobwatanigwa konde tikori korakorwe ase ense eria ase engencho y’amanyinga aiteirwe, otatiga ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ay’oria omoiti oka.

English: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, Yahweh, dwell among the children of Israel.’”
Kiswahili: Msiinajisi nchi mnayoishi, ambayo nami ninakaa, kwa kuwa Mimi, Bwana, ninakaa katikati ya Waisraeli.’ ”
Ekegusii: Timokora ense eyio ase momenyete ebe etachenegeti, ekiagera inche nigo imenyete ase egati yaino. Inche ninche Omonene imenyete ase egati y’ abanto bane Abaisraeli.”

English: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa jamaa ya ukoo wa Gileadi mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase, waliokuwa wametoka katika koo za wazao wa Yosefu, walikuja na kuzungumza mbele ya Mose na viongozi, wakuu wa jamaa ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Erio abanene b’egesaku kia Gileadi mosinto o Makiri mosinto o Manase abwo barenge korwa ase chinyomba chie egesaku kia Yusufu bagaacha na gokwana ase obosio bwa Musa, boigo ase abarai amo na abateneneri b’echinyomba chia Abaisraeli.

English: They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
Kiswahili: Wakasema, “Bwana alipomwamuru bwana wangu kuwapa Waisraeli nchi kama urithi kwa kura, alikuamuru kutoa urithi wa ndugu yetu Selofehadi kwa binti zake.
Ekegusii: Bagateeba, “ekero Omonene Nyasae aruete ogochika buna ebisaku bigaberwe emegondo buna omwando obo ase obomera, nigo ateebete omwando o Selofehadi oegwe abaiseke baye.

English: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
Kiswahili: Sasa ikiwa wataolewa na watu wa makabila mengine ya Kiisraeli, itakuwa kwamba urithi wao utaondolewa kutoka urithi wa mababu zetu na kuongezwa katika urithi wa kabila ambalo dada hao wameolewa. Kwa hiyo sehemu ya urithi tuliyogawiwa itachukuliwa kutoka kwetu.
Ekegusii: Eraisa koba barabwo banywomirwe nabaanto b’ebisaku na omwando oyio obo korwa ase emegondo yaito ementeranigwe ase ebisaku biria basokerete; igo omwando bw’egesaku giaito nigo okoirwa korwa ase tore?

English: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”
Kiswahili: Wakati mwaka wa Yubile kwa Waisraeli utafika, urithi wao utaongezwa kwa lile kabila ambalo wameolewa, na mali yao itaondolewa kutoka urithi wa kabila la mababu zetu.”
Ekegusii: Boigo ekero omwaka bw’echubiri ase Abaisraeli, engaki eria chinibo chionsi chiebisakore chikoiranerigwa abanyene, nenyarekane omwando ase abaiseke ba Selofehadi oriegwe na abasacha babo korwa ase ebisaku bia isiko”.

English: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.
Kiswahili: Ndipo kwa agizo la Bwana Mose akatoa amri ifuatayo kwa Waisraeli: “Kile wazao wa kabila la Yosefu wanachosema ni kweli.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akarua ogochika ase Musa ogoteeba; ayio nekeene abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu bagokwana.

English: This is the thing which Yahweh commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo Bwana anavyoamuru kwa binti za Selofehadi: Wanaweza kuolewa na mtu yeyote wampendaye, mradi tu waolewe miongoni mwa koo za kabila za baba yao.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase abaiseke ba Selofehadi, barabwo ’mbare nobosibore konywomwa na monto onde bwensi banchete, korende omonto oyio goika arue ase egesaku kiabo.

English: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
Kiswahili: Hakuna urithi katika Israeli utakaohamishwa kutoka kabila moja kwenda kabila jingine, kwa kuwa kila Mwisraeli atatunza ardhi ya kabila lake aliyoirithi kutoka kwa baba zake.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio omwando bw’egesaku ekemo tokonyara koirwa n’egesaku kende ekeao. Naboigo kera Omoisraeli narende omwando oye omotungetie.

English: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.
Kiswahili: Kila binti atakayerithi ardhi katika kabila lolote la Israeli ni lazima aolewe na mtu kutoka kabila na ukoo wa baba yake, ili kila Mwisraeli amiliki urithi wa baba zake.
Ekegusii: Kera omoiseke ore omonyamwando ase egesaku kia Abaisraeli goika anywomwe ase omonto bw’egesaku kiaye, erio kera Omoisraeli anyare konyora omwando korwa ase ororeeria rwe chisokoro chiaye.

English: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”
Kiswahili: Hakuna urithi uwezao kuhamishwa kutoka kabila moja kwenda kabila jingine, kwa kuwa kila kabila la Israeli litatunza nchi linayorithi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nenyarekane ng’a omwando bw’egesaku ekemo tokonyara koirwa n’egesaku kende ekeao. Kera egesaku ase Abaisraeli ’nkenyare koegerera omwando oye ogetungetie.

English: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo binti za Selofehadi wakafanya kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.
Ekegusii: Abaiseke ba Selofehadi bagakora buna Omonene Nyasae amochiigete Musa.

English: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.
Kiswahili: Binti za Selofehadi, ambao ni Mahla, Tirsa, Hogla, Milka na Noa, wakaolewa na waume, wana wa ndugu za baba yao.
Ekegusii: Abaiseke obwo ba Selofehadi; Maala, Teresa, Ogila, Milika, amo na Nuhu bakanywomwa n’abamwabo korwa are ororeeria rwa ise.

English: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
Kiswahili: Waliolewa ndani ya koo za wazao wa Manase mwana wa Yosefu, na urithi wao ukabaki katika ukoo na kabila la baba yao.
Ekegusii: Bakanywomwa gochia ase emechie y’ororeria rwa Manase mosinto o Yusufu erio omwando oise ogatigara ase egesaku kiabo ime ase enyomba yabo.

English: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maagizo na masharti ambayo Bwana aliwapa Waisraeli kupitia Mose katika tambarare za Moabu, karibu na Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amachiiko n’emeroberio y’Omonene Nyasae, buna biaruetwe gochia ase Abaisraeli, goteera ase Musa agwo ase ense omweya ya Moabu ng’umbu y’orooche rwa Yorodani ang’e n’omochie o Yeriko.

English: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
Kiswahili: Haya ni maneno Mose aliyoyasema kwa Israeli yote jangwani mashariki ya Yordani, ambayo iko Araba, inayokabiliana na Sufu, kati ya Parani na Tofeli, Labani, Haserothi na Dizahabu.
Ekegusii: Egetabu eke nigo kebwate amang’ana Musa akwanete n’Abaisraeli ekero barenge ase erooro, moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodani. Nigo barenge ase Ekerubo Ekiomo kerigereretie Sufu, obogati bw’omochie o Parani ase ensemo eyemo, na emechie ya Tofeli na Labani, na Haseroti, na Disahabu ase ensemo ende.

English: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
Kiswahili: (Ni mwendo wa siku kumi na moja kutoka Horebu kwa njia ya Mlima Seiri mpaka Kadesh-Barnea.)
Ekegusii: Nigo rore orogendo rwa amatuko ikomi na rimo korwa ase egetunwa kia Horebu goetera ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu goika Kadeshi‐Barinea.

English: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh had given him in commandment to them,
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa arobaini, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi na moja, Mose aliwatangazia Waisraeli yale yote Bwana aliyomwamuru kuwahusu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi nomo, omwaka bw’emerongo ene, korwa barwete Misiri, Musa akabateebia amang’ana onsi ayi’Omonene amochiigete abateebie.

English: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa baada ya kumshinda Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala Heshboni, na pia huko Edrei alikuwa amemshinda Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, ambaye alitawala huko Ashtarothi.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nigo abeete ekero Omonene konya abuire Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oyio ogambete ase omochie o Hesiboni, amo n’omorwoti Ogi o Basani, oyio ogambete ase emechie ya Asitaroti na Edirei.

English: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,
Kiswahili: Huko mashariki ya Yordani katika nchi ya Moabu, Mose alianza kuielezea sheria hii, akisema:
Ekegusii: Nigo yarenge ekero abanto barenge ase ense ya Moabu, moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodani, Musa agachaaka kworokereria na kwegeria amachiiko a Nyasae. Ogoteeba,

English: “Yahweh our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wetu alisema nasi huko Horebu, “Mmekaa vya kutosha katika mlima huu.
Ekegusii: Ekero twarenge ase egetunwa gia Sinai, Omonene, Nyasae oito, agakwana naintwe, agatoteebia, “Mwabereire aiga ase egetunwa eke ase egeka geisaine.

English: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
Kiswahili: Vunjeni kambi, msonge mbele kuelekea nchi ya vilima ya Waamori; nendeni kwa watu wote ambao ni majirani wa Araba, katika milima, upande wa magharibi chini ya vilima, katika Negebu na kandokando ya pwani, mpaka nchi ya Wakanaani hadi Lebanoni, na kufika mto mkubwa Frati.
Ekegusii: Tagora ebigutu imoka mochaake orogeendo rwaino. Genda gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaamori, na ase abanto b’echinse chietanaineo-gochia ase Ekerubo kia Jorodani, na ase ense y’ebitunwa, na ase ense omweya, na ase ense ere ang’e n’Enyancha Enene. Mogende ase ense y’ Abakaanani gochia ase egetunwa kia Lebanoni, na goikera ase orooche roria oronene rw’Eufarati.

English: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”
Kiswahili: Tazama, nimewapa ninyi nchi hii. Ingieni mkaimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana aliapa kuwa angaliwapa baba zenu, Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, pamoja na vizazi vyao baada yao.”
Ekegusii: Eyio yonsi n’ense inche Omonene nariete eira koa chisokoro chiaino Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, chisokoro chiaino, amo n’abanto b’ororeeria rwabo. Genda moyeire.”

English: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule niliwaambia, “Ninyi mmekuwa mzigo mzito sana kwangu kuwachukua peke yangu.
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’abanto, Ase engaki eria twarenge egetunwa gia Sinai nigo nabateebetie ng’a inche bweka tinkonyaara kobaraa.

English: Yahweh your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu ameongeza hesabu yenu, hivi kwamba leo ninyi ni wengi kama nyota za angani.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, obamentekanirie mono, na bono inwe nigo more abange mono buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro.

English: May Yahweh, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu na awaongeze mara elfu na kuwabariki kama alivyoahidi!
Ekegusii: Tiga Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, abamentekanie ara elifu, mobe abange goetania buna more bono, naende abasesenie buna ariete eira.

English: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi nitawezaje kubeba matatizo yenu, na mizigo yenu, na magomvi yenu peke yangu?
Ekegusii: Korende naki ndakore inyare inche bweka kobogoria egurube enene y’okogaayana emechando yaino

English: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”
Kiswahili: Chagueni baadhi ya watu wenye hekima, wenye ufahamu na wanaoheshimika kutoka kila kabila lenu, nami nitawaweka juu yenu.”
Ekegusii: chora abanto abang’aini, abare abamanyi, abanto bamanyekanete buya korwa ase kera egesaku, na inche nimbabeeke babe abataang’ani baino.

English: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”
Kiswahili: Mlinijibu, “Shauri ulilolitoa ni zuri.”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwancheranete buna ayio namaya na buna moyakore.

English: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo niliwachukua wanaume viongozi wa makabila yenu, wenye hekima na wanaoheshimika, nami nikawateua wawe na mamlaka juu yenu kama majemadari wa maelfu, wa mamia, wa hamsini, na wa makumi, na kama maafisa wa makabila.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabeeka abanto baria abang’aini na bamanyekanete buya, abwo mwachorete korwa ase ebisaku biaino nkababeeka koba abaraai baino. Abande ase chilifu, na abande ase amagana, na abande ase emerongo etano, na abande ase ikomi. Naboigo nkababeeka abateneneri bande b’ebisaku biaino bionsi.

English: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.
Kiswahili: Nami wakati ule nikawaagiza waamuzi wenu: Sikilizeni magomvi kati ya ndugu zenu na mwamue kwa haki, hata kama shauri ni kati ya ndugu wa Kiisraeli, au kati ya mmoja wa ndugu wa Kiisraeli na mgeni.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria ngachiika abagaambi baino, nkabateebia: Motegerere ebiina bire ase egati y’Abaisraeli bamino. Monache ekiina kia boronge, keraabe ase egati y’omonto n’oyomwabo, gose ase egati yaye n’omomenyi omenyete bwoye.

English: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”
Kiswahili: Msionyeshe upendeleo katika maamuzi; wasikilizeni wote sawasawa, wadogo kwa wakubwa. Msimwogope mtu yeyote, kwa kuwa hukumu ni ya Mungu. Mniletee mimi shauri lolote lililo gumu sana kwenu, nami nitalisikiliza.
Ekegusii: Timoba n’ogwanchereria komokonacha ebiina; mokore boronge, abe omonto omoke gose omonene. Timoiroka omonto onde bwensi, ekiagera okonacha mogokora nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae. Onye kiina kende gionsi kere egekong’u ase more, mokendetere, na inche ninkenache.

English: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
Kiswahili: Nami wakati ule niliwaambia kila kitu ambacho mngefanya.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase engaki eria nabachiigete igoro y’amang’ana onsi mogwenerete gokora.

English: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.
Kiswahili: Kisha, kama Bwana Mungu wetu alivyotuamuru, tuliondoka kutoka Horebu na kwenda kuelekea nchi ya vilima ya Waamori, kupitia jangwa lile kubwa lote la kutisha, lile mliloliona, nasi tukafika Kadesh-Barnea.
Ekegusii: Intwe togakora buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, atochiigete. Tokarua ase egetunwa gia Sinai, tokageenda, togaeta ase egati y’erooro enene ekwoboyia mono, eria mwarooche ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Abaamori; erio togaika Kadeshi‐Barinea.

English: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God gives to us.
Kiswahili: Kisha niliwaambia, “Mmefika katika nchi ya vilima ya Waamori, ambayo Bwana Mungu wetu anatupa.
Ekegusii: ’Nkabateebia: Bono mwaikire ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaamori, eyi’Omonene, Nyasae oito, agochia gotoa.

English: Behold, Yahweh your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as Yahweh the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”
Kiswahili: Tazama, Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa nchi. Pandeni mkaimiliki kama Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, alivyowaambia. Msiogope, wala msikate tamaa.”
Ekegusii: Rigereria, Omonene Nyasae oino, obaeire ense eria. Genda moyeire ebe eyaino, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, abateebirie. Timoiroka, gose timokwa emioyo.

English: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo ninyi nyote mkanijia na kusema, “Tupeleke watu watutangulie kuipeleleza nchi kwa ajili yetu, na kutuletea taarifa kuhusu njia tutakayopita, na miji tutakayoiendea.”
Ekegusii: Erio inwe mwensi mogaacha ase ’nde, moganteebia: Totome abanto bagende koroota ense eria, erinde batorentere amang’ana buna ense eria ere, barore enchera togochia goetera, naende emechie eria togochia koira, buna ere.

English: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.
Kiswahili: Wazo hilo lilionekana zuri kwangu; kwa hiyo niliwachagua watu wenu kumi na wawili, mwanaume mmoja kutoka kila kabila.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio akarorekana ase ’nde ng’a namaya, na inche ngachoora abanto ikomi na babere, oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku.

English: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
Kiswahili: Waliondoka na kukwea katika nchi ya vilima, wakafika katika Bonde la Eshkoli na kuipeleleza.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakageenda gochia ase ense eria y’ebitunwa, bagaika ase ense omweya y’Esikoli, bakaroota ense eria.

English: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which Yahweh our God gives to us.”
Kiswahili: Wakachukua baadhi ya matunda ya nchi, wakatuletea na kutuarifu, “Ni nchi nzuri ambayo Bwana Mungu wetu anatupa.”
Ekegusii: Bakanyora okwama gw’ense eria, bagakorenta ase tore, naende bagatorentera amang’ana aya barooche agwo ase ense eria, bagakwana: Ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oito, agochia gotoa nigo ere entobu mono.

English: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Lakini hamkuwa tayari kukwea, mkaasi dhidi ya amri ya Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Korende timwanchete kogeenda ase ense eria, mokaanga koigwera ogochika Omonene Nyasae oino, abaete.

English: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because Yahweh hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.
Kiswahili: Mkanungʼunika ndani ya mahema yenu na kusema, “Bwana anatuchukia, kwa hiyo alitutoa Misri ili kututia mikononi mwa Waamori kutuangamiza.
Ekegusii: Mokemurungania ekero mwamenyete ase chiema chiaino, mogateeba: Omonene nigo atogeechete, nakio kiagerete agatorusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde atobeeke ase amaboko ya Abaamori, nabarabwo batoite na gotosiria.

English: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”
Kiswahili: Twende wapi? Ndugu zetu wametufanya kufa moyo. Wanasema, ‘Watu wa huko wana nguvu zaidi na ni warefu kuliko sisi tulivyo; miji ni mikubwa, yenye kuta zilizofika juu angani. Zaidi ya hayo, tumewaona Waanaki huko.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nase ki toragende aroro? Abaminto batwoboirie, ekiagera bateebire ng’a abanto bare ase ense eria n’abanene naende n’abatambe gotobua. Emechie yabo n’emenene, naende nigo egiteire chindwaki chigete igoro. Naende ntwarora amamonto aroro.

English: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikawaambia, “Msihofu, wala msiwaogope.
Ekegusii: Korende nkabateebia: Timoiroka abanto baria.

English: Yahweh your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu anayewatangulia, atawapigania, kama alivyofanya kwa ajili yenu huko Misri, mbele ya macho yenu hasa,
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, oria okobaraa, nere orabarwanere esegi buna mwarooche ay’abakorerete ekero mwarenge Misiri,

English: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that Yahweh your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”
Kiswahili: na pia huko jangwani. Huko mliona jinsi Bwana Mungu wenu alivyowachukua, kama baba amchukuavyo mwanawe, katika njia yote mliyoiendea mpaka mkafika mahali hapa.”
Ekegusii: naende ekero mwarenge ase erooro. ’Mwarooche buna abaraaete, na ase chinchera chionsi echio mwaetete goika mogaika aase aa: ere nigo ababogoretie buna omonto akobogoria omwana oye.

English: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God,
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hili, hamkumtegemea Bwana Mungu wenu,
Ekegusii: Korende nonya okorete ayio onsi, timwegenete Omonene,

English: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.
Kiswahili: ambaye aliwatangulia katika safari yenu, kwa moto usiku na kwa wingu mchana, kuwatafutia mahali penu pa kupiga kambi na kuwaonyesha njia mtakayoiendea.
Ekegusii: nonya oyorenge kobatang’ana botambe na kobarigeria aase mware gochia gotoora. Ase obotuko nigo arenge kobaraa n’omorero, na ase omobaso obaraa ne riire, koborokia aase mware goetera.

English: Yahweh heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,
Kiswahili: Wakati Bwana aliposikia lile mlilosema, alikasirika, akaapa, akasema:
Ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa okwemurungania kwaino, akaba n’endamwamu, agatiana na goteeba:

English: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mtu wa kizazi hiki kiovu atakayeona nchi nzuri niliyoapa kuwapa baba zenu,
Ekegusii: Ekeene, onde tari ase abanto b’ekegori eke ekebe oraike ase ense eria entobu narierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nimbayee,

English: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune. Yeye ataiona, nami nitampa yeye na wazao wake nchi aliyoikanyaga kwa miguu, kwa sababu alimfuata Bwana kwa moyo wote.”
Ekegusii: otatiga Kalebu mosinto o Yefune. Ere nasoe ense eria. Ere obeire omwegenwa ase inde nimoyee ere na ororeeria rw’aye, ense eyio arotire.

English: Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu yenu Bwana pia alinikasirikia mimi, akasema, “Hutaingia hiyo nchi pia.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho yaino Omonene nigo abeete n’endamwamu ase inde agateeba “Nonya naye Musa tokonyaara gosoa ase ense eria.”

English: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
Kiswahili: Lakini msaidizi wako, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, ataingia. Mtie moyo, kwa sababu atawaongoza Waisraeli kuirithi hiyo nchi.
Ekegusii: Korende Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omokonyi oo, nere orasoe aroro. Mobeeke chinguru, omoremie, ekiagera nere oraraae Abaisraeli bagende koira ense eria.

English: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.
Kiswahili: Wale watoto ambao mliwasema wangelichukuliwa mateka, yaani watoto wenu ambao bado hawajui jema na baya, wataingia katika nchi. Nitawapa hiyo nchi, nao wataimiliki.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agatoteebia twensi: Abana baino abake abwo mwateebete ng’a ’nabooswe, abwo ase rituko ria reero bataramanya ayaare amabe gose amaya, nabwo baraike ase ense eria, inche nimbayee ebe eyabo.

English: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
Kiswahili: Bali ninyi geukeni, mwondoke kuelekea jangwani kwa kufuata njia ya Bahari ya Shamu.”
Ekegusii: Korende inwe onchoka, mogende gochia ase erooro, gochia ase enchera ekogeenda ase omosomo bwa Akaba.

English: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against Yahweh. We will go up and fight, according to all that Yahweh our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mkanijibu, “Tumemtenda Bwana dhambi. Tutakwenda kupigana, kama Bwana Mungu wetu alivyotuamuru.” Hivyo kila mmoja wenu akachukua silaha zake, huku mkifikiri kuwa ni rahisi kukwea katika nchi ya vilima.
Ekegusii: Erio mokang’iraneria moganteebia: Musa twakorire ebibe ase Omonene, korende bono ’nkogeenda tore korwana esegi buna Omonene Nyasae oito, atochiigete. Kera omonto ase more akabogoria ebirwanero biaye bi’eseegi, akarengereria ng’a namang’ana amagusu kogeenda koira ense eria y’ebitunwa.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana aliniambia, “Waambie, ‘Msipande kupigana, kwa sababu sitakuwa pamoja nanyi. Mtashindwa na adui zenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia: Bakanie, obateebie ng’a tibaabaisa kogeenda korwana esegi, ekiagera inche Omonene tindi amo nabarabwo. Kobaragende nigo bagochia kobugwa n’ababisa baabo.

English: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.
Kiswahili: Hivyo niliwaambia, lakini hamkutaka kusikia. Mliasi dhidi ya amri ya Bwana, na katika kiburi chenu mlienda katika nchi ya vilima.
Ekegusii: ’Nkabateebia amang’ana ayi’Omonene akwanete, korende mokaanga koigwera, mogasaria amang’ana Omonene abachiigete, mokageenda n’obomwenu ase ense eria y’ebitunwa.

English: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.
Kiswahili: Waamori ambao waliishi katika vilima hivyo waliinuka dhidi yenu, wakawafukuza kama kundi la nyuki wakiwapiga njia yote ya Seiri mpaka Horma.
Ekegusii: Abaamori abamenyete ase ense eria bagaacha bakabaumokera buna chinchoke. Bakabaseria goika Horima erio bakababua agwo ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu.

English: You returned and wept before Yahweh, but Yahweh didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.
Kiswahili: Mlirudi na kulia mbele za Bwana, lakini Mungu hakusikiliza kilio chenu, wala hakuwajali.
Ekegusii: Erio inwe, mokarera ase Omonene abakoonye, korende Omonene taigwete ekerero kiaino gose tabategererete.

English: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mlikaa Kadeshi kwa siku nyingi, kwa muda ule wote mliokaa huko.
Ekegusii: Ekio gekagera mokabeera agwo Kadeshi ase amatuko amaange.

English: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.
Kiswahili: Kisha tukageuka nyuma na kusafiri kuelekea jangwani kwa njia inayoelekea Bahari ya Shamu, kama Bwana alivyonielekeza. Kwa muda mrefu tulitembea kuzunguka vilima katika nchi ya Seiri.
Ekegusii: Omoerio tokaonchoka, tokageenda gochia ase erooro goetera ase enchera egochia ase omosomo bwa Akaba, buna Omonene konya anteebiire. Ase amatuko amaange, tokaba tokonakoong’anyaong’anya ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu.

English: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akaniambia,
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana nainche, aganteebia:

English: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.
Kiswahili: “Umetembea kuzunguka hii nchi ya vilima kwa muda wa kutosha; sasa geukia kaskazini.
Ekegusii: Mwabeire mokona koong’anya-ong’anya ase ense eye y’ebitunwa ase engaki entambe eisaine; bono onchoka mogende gochia ensemo ya Sugusu.

English: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.
Kiswahili: Wape watu maagizo haya: ‘Mko karibu kupita katikati ya nchi ya ndugu zako ambao ni wazao wa Esau, ambao wanaishi Seiri. Watawaogopa, lakini mwe waangalifu.
Ekegusii: Naende aganteebia: Bachiike abanto, obateebie ng’a ’mbare ang’e goeta ase orogongo rw’ abanto bamwabo, abanto b’ororeeria rwa Esau, abwo bamenyete Edomu. Barabwo nigo barabairoke. Ase ayio mwerende mono,

English: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.
Kiswahili: Msiwachokoze kwa vita kwa maana sitawapa ninyi sehemu yoyote ya nchi yao, hata sehemu ya kutosha kuweka wayo wenu juu yake. Nimempa Esau nchi ya vilima ya Seiri kama yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: timobaisa korwana nabarabwo, ekiagera tinkobaa inwe ense yabo nonya n’enseemo enke eisaine egesanyi gi’okogoro, ekiagera naeire abanto b’ororeeria rw’Esau ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu ebe eyaabo.
