English: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”
Kiswahili: Mtawalipa fedha kwa chakula mtakachokula na maji mtakayokunywa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nigo moragore endagera n’amache korwa ase bare.

English: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu amewabariki kwa kazi yote ya mikono yenu. Amewalinda katika safari yenu katikati ya jangwa hili kubwa. Kwa miaka hii arobaini Bwana Mungu wenu amekuwa pamoja nanyi, na hamkupungukiwa na kitu chochote.
Ekegusii: Inyora buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abasesenirie ase emeremo yaino yonsi mwabeire mogokora. Nigo abeire obarendete ase orogeendo rwaino ase erooro eye enene ase emiaka eye emerongo ene. Omonene Nyasae oino, obeire amo nainwe, na inwe timwaremeretwe na gento kende.

English: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
Kiswahili: Basi tulipita kwa ndugu zetu wazao wa Esau ambao wanaishi Seiri. Tuligeuka kutoka njia ya Araba ambayo inatokea Elathi na Esion-Geberi, tukasafiri kufuata njia ya jangwa la Moabu.
Ekegusii: Erio tokaimoka, tokagenderera, togatiga enchera ekogenda ase emechie ya Elati, na Esioni‐Geberi gochia ase ekerubo Ekiomo, erio tokaonchoka, tokageenda gochia ase erooro ya Moabu.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Usiwasumbue Wamoabu kwa vita, kwa kuwa sitawapa sehemu yoyote ya nchi yao. Nimetoa nchi ya Ari kwa wazao wa Loti kama milki yao.”
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia: Timobaisa gochegia abanto ba Moabu abanto b’ororeeria rwa Loti, gose korwana na barabwo Nabaeire omochie o Ari tinkobaa inwe ensemo ende yonsi y’ense yabo ebe eyaino.

English: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.
Kiswahili: (Waemi walikuwa wakiishi huko hapo zamani, watu wenye nguvu na wengi, warefu kama Waanaki.
Ekegusii: (Amamonto are korokwa Abaemi nabwo bamenyete agwo Ari. Abanto abwo nigo barenge abanene, bareng’aine na Abanaki abwo nabarabwo barenge amamonto.

English: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
Kiswahili: Kama walivyokuwa Waanaki, hao pia walikuwa kama Warefai, lakini Wamoabu waliwaita Waemi.
Ekegusii: Na buna Abanaki abwo nigo barenge korokwa Abarefai, korende Abamoabu nigo barenge kobaroka Abaemi.

English: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which Yahweh gave to them.)
Kiswahili: Wahori waliishi Seiri, lakini wazao wa Esau waliwafukuza. Waliwaangamiza Wahori na kukaa mahali pao, kama Waisraeli walivyofanya katika nchi ambayo Bwana aliwapa kama milki yao.)
Ekegusii: Abahori nigo bakamenyire Edomu, korende abanto b’ororeeria rw’Esau bakabaseeria na gosaria ense yabo, bakamenya ase ense eria ribagaa riabo. Bagakora buna Abaisraeli bakorete ase ense eri’Omonene abaete ebe eyaabo.)

English: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Sasa ondokeni mvuke Bonde la Zeredi.” Hivyo tukavuka bonde.
Ekegusii: “Naende Omonene agatoteebia: Bono imoka, mogende mwamboke gochia ng’umbu y’akarooche ga Seredi. Erio tokageenda, tokaamboka akarooche akwo.

English: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.
Kiswahili: Miaka thelathini na minane ilipita tangu wakati tulipoondoka Kadesh-Barnea mpaka tulipovuka Bonde la Zeredi. Kwa wakati huo kile kizazi chote cha wanaume kuanzia wale wawezao kwenda vitani kilikuwa kimekufa, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amewaapia.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki twarwete Kadeshi‐Barinea goika ekero twambogete akarooche ga Seredi nigo yarenge emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato (38). Abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagakwa bakaera, buna Omonene konya atianire.

English: Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Bwana uliwakabili hadi alipowaangamiza wote huko kambini.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agendererete koamererania nabarabwo, goika bonsi bagasira kegima.

English: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
Kiswahili: Ikawa baada ya mtu wa mwisho kuanzia wale wawezao kwenda vitani kufa,
Ekegusii: “Ekero abarwani bonsi b’esegi konya bakuure,

English: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia,
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia:

English: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.
Kiswahili: “Leo utapita katika nchi ya Moabu huko Ari.
Ekegusii: Reero moetere orobebe rwa Moabu ase enchera ya Ari.

English: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”
Kiswahili: Utakapokuja kwa Waamoni, msiwasumbue wala kuwachokoza kwa vita, kwa kuwa sitawapa ardhi yoyote iliyo ya Waamoni kuwa milki yenu. Nimeitoa kama milki ya wazao wa Loti.”
Ekegusii: Ekero moraike ang’e n’ense y’Abaamoni, abanto b’ororeeria rwa Loti, timobaisa kobachegia gose kobarwania esegi, ekiagera tinkobaa inwe nonya n’enseemo eyemo y’orogongo orwo nabaeire barabwo.”

English: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
Kiswahili: (Hiyo pia ilidhaniwa kuwa nchi ya Warefai waliokuwa wakiishi huko, lakini Waamoni waliwaita Wazamzumi.
Ekegusii: (Orogongo orwo nigo naende rwamanyekanete buna ense y’Abarefai. Erieta ri’abanto abwo bamenyeteo agwo kare, korende Abaamoni bakabaroka Abasamusumi.

English: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,
Kiswahili: Walikuwa watu wenye nguvu na wengi, warefu kama Waanaki. Bwana akawaangamiza kutoka mbele ya Waamoni, ambao waliwafukuza na kukaa mahali pao.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo barenge abanene naende abatambe buna Abanaki; boigo nigo barenge abange. Korende Omonene akabasiria, na Abaamoni bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo.

English: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa amefanya vivyo hivyo kwa wazao wa Esau, ambao waliishi Seiri, wakati alipowaangamiza Wahori watoke mbele yao. Waliwafukuza na wao wakaishi mahali pao mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akorerete abanto b’ororeeria rw’Esau, baria bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu. Agaita Abahori, na Abaesau bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo, nao bamenyete goika reero iga.

English: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)
Kiswahili: Nao Waavi ambao waliishi katika vijiji mpaka Gaza, Wakaftori waliokuja kutoka Kaftori waliwaangamiza na kukaa mahali pao.)
Ekegusii: Abaavi nigo bamenyete agwo ase Emechie yarenge ensemo ase enyancha ya Mediterania goika Gaza. Abakafitori korwa ase egesinga gia Kaptori bagaita Abaavi bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo.)

English: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
Kiswahili: “Ondoka sasa na uvuke Bonde la Arnoni. Tazama, nimemweka mikononi mwako Sihoni Mwamori, mfalme wa Heshboni na nchi yake. Anza kuimiliki nchi hiyo na umwingize katika vita.
Ekegusii: “Naende Omonene agateeba: Imoka, mochaake orogeendo rwaino, mwamboke orooche rw’Arinoni. Naama! Nabeekire ase amaboko aino Sihoni Omoamori, omorwoti o Hesiboni, amo n’ense yaye. Ase igo, mochaake komorwania esegi, moire ense yaye.

English: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya leo nitaanza kuwatia hofu na woga mataifa yote chini ya mbingu wawaogope ninyi. Watakaposikia taarifa zenu, watatetemeka na kufadhaika kwa sababu yenu.”
Ekegusii: Reero ninchaake kogosa abanto bonsi bare inse y’erioba, erinde baabairoke na koboboa ekero bakoigwa chinkuma chiaino, nabatengechigwe n’omoondoko.

English: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
Kiswahili: Kutoka jangwa la Kedemothi nilituma wajumbe wenye maneno ya amani kwa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni kusema,
Ekegusii: “Erio ngatoma abanto korwa ase erooro ya Kedemoti, bakageenda ase Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni, nkamotomera amang’ana y’omorembe, ngateeba:

English: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.
Kiswahili: “Turuhusu tupite katika nchi yako. Tutapita katika barabara kuu, hatutageuka kuume wala kushoto.
Ekegusii: Koranche onyanchere ng’etere ase ense yao. Nigo ndaete ase enchera enene yoka; tinkogobera aande.

English: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,
Kiswahili: Tuuzie chakula tule na maji tunywe kwa thamani yake katika fedha. Turuhusu tu tupite kwa miguu,
Ekegusii: Nong’oonerie endagera indie na amaache inywe, nainche ninkoe chitaabu. Aye ing’a ribaga ng’ete n’amagoro ase ense yao.

English: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which Yahweh our God gives us.”
Kiswahili: kama wazao wa Esau ambao wanaishi Seiri na Wamoabu ambao wanaishi Ari walivyotufanyia, mpaka tuvuke Yordani kuingia nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wetu anatupatia.”
Ekegusii: Buna abanto b’ororeeria rw’Esau, abamenyete Edomu, na Abamoabu, abamenyete Ari, bankorerete, naye onkorere boigo, goika imbe nambokire orooche rwa Yorodani, na nasoire ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oito, agochia gotoa.

English: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.
Kiswahili: Lakini Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni alikataa kuturuhusu kupita. Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wako alikuwa ameifanya roho yake kuwa ngumu na moyo wake kuwa mkaidi ili amweke kwenye mikono yenu, kama alivyofanya sasa.
Ekegusii: “Korende Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni, akaanga, tatoa ribaga toete ase ense yaye Omonene Nyasae oino. Nigo akong’etie enkoro yaye ekaba ey’ogotaigwera, akamobeka ase amaboko aino, na inwe mokamobua na mokaira ense yaye, eyio tobwate goika rero iga.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Tazama, nimeanza kuwapa Mfalme Sihoni na nchi yake kwako. Sasa anzeni kuishinda na kuimiliki nchi yake.”
Ekegusii: “Omonene aganteebia: Rora, nachaakire kobeeka Sihoni amo n’ense yaye ase amaboko aino. Ase ayio, chaaka koira ense yaye ebe eyaino.

English: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
Kiswahili: Wakati Sihoni pamoja na jeshi lake lote walipokuja kukutana nasi katika vita huko Yahazi,
Ekegusii: Erio Sihoni amo n’abanto baye bonsi bagaacha gotorwania esegi, ekero twarenge ase omochie o Yahasi,

English: Yahweh our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wetu alimweka mikononi mwetu, nasi tukamwangamiza pamoja na wanawe na jeshi lake lote.
Ekegusii: korende Omonene Nyasae oito, akamobeka ase amaboko aito, ere amo n’abamura baye, na abanto baye bonsi, na intwe tokabaita.

English: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.
Kiswahili: Kwa wakati ule tuliteka miji yake yote na kuiangamiza kabisa: wanaume, wanawake na watoto. Hatukumwacha yeyote.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria tokabwata emechie yaye yonsi, tokayesaria, togaita abasacha, n’abakuungu, na abana, titwatigaretie monto ore moyo, nonya n’oyomo.

English: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.
Kiswahili: Lakini mifugo na nyara tulizoziteka kutoka ile miji tulijichukulia wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Togoosa chitugo chiabo, na gosakora ebinto biarenge ase emechie eyio bikaba ebiaito.

English: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Aroeri kwenye ukingo wa Bonde la Arnoni, kutoka mji ulio ndani ya bonde, hata mpaka Gileadi, hapakuwa na mji hata mmoja uliokuwa na nguvu kutushinda. Bwana Mungu wetu alitupa yote.
Ekegusii: Korwa Aroeri, omochie oria ore ase engegu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, goika Gileadi, amo n’omochie ore ase rikura, omochie onde torenge ne chindwaki chinkong’u totanyaarete gotagora. Omonene Nyasae oito, nigo abegete emechie yonsi ase amaboko aito.

English: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever Yahweh our God forbade us.
Kiswahili: Lakini kulingana na amri ya Bwana Mungu wetu, hamkujiingiza katika nchi yoyote ya Waamoni, wala katika sehemu yoyote iliyo kandokando ya Mto Yaboki, wala katika miji iliyoko katika vilima.
Ekegusii: Korende titwaigete ang’e ase ense y’Abaamoni, gose ase chingegu chi’orooche rwa Yaboki, na emechie y’ense y’ebitunwa, na aande onsi ase Omonene Nyasae oito, atokanetie titogeendao.

English: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
Kiswahili: Kisha tukageuka tukakwea kufuata njia iliyoelekea Bashani, Ogu mfalme wa Bashani akaondoka na jeshi lake lote kupigana na sisi huko Edrei.
Ekegusii: “Magega y’ayio tokaonchoka, togatiira gochia sugusu gochia ase orogongo rwa Basani. Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, amo n’abanto baye bonsi, bagaacha gotorwania esegi agwo ase omochie o Edirei.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Usimwogope kwa kuwa nimekwisha mkabidhi mikononi mwako pamoja na jeshi lake lote na nchi yake. Umfanyie sawasawa na ulivyomfanyia Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala huko Heshboni.”
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene aganteebia: Tobaisa komoiroka, ekiagera ere amo n’abanto baye bonsi nababeekire ase amaboko ao, boigo nakoeire ense yaye. Nomokore buna gwakorete Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria orenge kogaamba agwo Hesiboni.

English: So Yahweh our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bwana Mungu wetu pia akamweka Ogu mfalme wa Bashani pamoja na jeshi lake lote mikononi mwetu. Tuliwaangamiza wote, hakubakia hata mmoja.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio Omonene akabeeka omorwoti Ogi, amo n’abanto baye bonsi, ase amaboko aito, erio tokabaita bonsi pi, nonya n’oyomo tatigara ore moyo.

English: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo tuliteka miji yake yote. Hakuna mji hata mmoja kati ya ile sitini ambao hatukuuteka, yaani eneo lote la Argobu, utawala wa Mfalme Ogu katika Bashani.
Ekegusii: Boigo tokaira emechie yaye yonsi ase engaki eria. Titwatigete nonya n’omochie oyomo totairete. Emechie yonsi twairete nigo yarenge emerongo etano nomo, tokaira orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu, ase Ogi, Omorwoti o Basani, arenge kogaamba.

English: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.
Kiswahili: Miji yote hii ilijengewa ngome zenye kuta ndefu zenye malango na makomeo, pia kulikuwako na vijiji vingi ambavyo havikujengewa kuta.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio yonsi nigo yagiteire chindwaki chintambe gochia igoro, na ebiita biarenge gosiekwa n’emekorogoto; naboigo ebichie ebinge mbiarengeo bitagiteire chindwaki.

English: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.
Kiswahili: Tuliwaangamiza kabisa, kama tulivyomfanyia Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni, tukiangamiza kila mji, yaani wanaume, wanawake na watoto.
Ekegusii: Togasaria emechie eyio yonsi, togaita abanto bonsi, abasacha n’abakuungu, na abana, buna twakorete ase emechie ya Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni.

English: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.
Kiswahili: Lakini wanyama wote wa kufuga pamoja na nyara kutoka kwenye miji yao tulichukua vikawa vyetu.
Ekegusii: Tokaira chitugo chionsi na gosakora ebinto biarenge ase emechie eyio bikaba ebiaito.

English: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kwa wakati huo tukachukua kutoka kwa wafalme hawa wawili wa Waamori nchi ya mashariki ya Yordani, kutoka Bonde la Arnoni mpaka kufika kwenye Mlima Hermoni.
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria tokaira ense y’abarwoti baria babere b’Abaamori, ense yarenge moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodani, gochaakera orooche rw’Arinoni goikera egetunwa kia Herimoni.

English: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
Kiswahili: (Wasidoni huuita mlima huo Sirioni, nao Waamori huuita Seniri.)
Ekegusii: (Abanto ba Sidoni nigo bakoroka egetunwa kia Herimoni Sirioni, na Abaamori nigo bagokeroka Seniri.)

English: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
Kiswahili: Tuliteka miji yote kwenye uwanda wa juu, Gileadi yote, Bashani yote mpaka kufika Saleka na Edrei, miji ya utawala wa Ogu huko Bashani.
Ekegusii: Tokaira orogongo rwonsi orwo rwarenge inse y’omorwoti Ogi o Basani: emechie yonsi yarenge ase ense eraire eimokererete igoro na Gileadi yonsi, na Basani yonsi, goikera Saleka na Edirei.”

English: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
Kiswahili: (Mfalme Ogu wa Bashani ndiye peke yake aliyesalia miongoni mwa mabaki ya Warefai. Kitanda chake kilikuwa cha chuma chenye urefu wa dhiraa tisa na upana wa dhiraa nne. Mpaka sasa kinaweza kuonekana katika mji wa Waamoni wa Raba.)
Ekegusii: (Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, nere orenge oyobwomoerio ase Abarefai. Esanduki yaye y’ogotindekerwa eyaroiseirie ebioma, nigo yarenge chimita inye ase obotambe boigo n’echimita ibere ase obogare koreng’ana nokorenga kwa boronge. Nao ere agwo Raba, omochie bw’Abaamoni.)

English: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;
Kiswahili: Katika nchi tuliyoiteka wakati ule, niliwapa kabila la Reubeni na Gadi eneo lililoko kaskazini la Aroeri kando ya Bonde la Arnoni, na nusu ya eneo la milima ya Gileadi, pamoja na miji yake.
Ekegusii: “Ekero twairete ense eria ekaba eyaito, ’nkaa abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, orogongo roria rogochaakera ase omochie bw’Aroeri, rore ang’e norooche rw’Arinoni amo n’ekeng’ese gi’ense y’ebitunwa ya Gileadi, na emechie yarengeo.

English: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
Kiswahili: Kisha nusu ya kabila la Manase niliwapa sehemu ya Gileadi iliyobaki pamoja na Bashani yote, ambayo ilikuwa utawala wa Ogu. (Eneo lote la Argobu katika Bashani lilikuwa linajulikana kama nchi ya Warefai.
Ekegusii: Nkaa ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase ensemo yatigarete ase ense ya Gileadi, amo na Basani yonsi, eyio yarenge obogaambi bwa Ogi. Orwo narwo orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu.” (Basani yonsi nigo yarenge korokwa ense ya Refaimu.

English: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
Kiswahili: Yairi, mzao wa kabila la Manase, alichukua eneo lote la nchi ya Argobu hadi kufikia mpaka wa Wageshuri na Wamaaka, ukaitwa kwa jina lake; kwa hiyo mpaka leo hii Bashani inaitwa Hawoth-Yairi.)
Ekegusii: Yairi, omonto bw’ororeeria rwa Manase, akaira orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu, narwo Basani, goika orogongo rw’Abagesuri na Abamaaka. Akaroka emechie yarengeo ase erieta riaye, Emechie ya Yairi, nabo ekorokwa goika reero iga.)

English: I gave Gilead to Machir.
Kiswahili: Nikampa Makiri nchi ya Gileadi.
Ekegusii: “Nkaa abanto b’eamate ya Makiri, orogongo rwa Gileadi,

English: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
Kiswahili: Lakini niliwapa Wareubeni na Wagadi eneo kuanzia Gileadi hadi Bonde la Arnoni (katikati ya bonde ulikuwa ndio mpaka), kuelekea mpaka Mto Yaboki, ambao ndio mpaka wa Waamoni.
Ekegusii: na abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ab’egesaku kia Gadi ’nkabaa orogongo gochakera Gileadi goikera orooche rw’Arinoni. Egati‐gati y’orooche orwo ekaba orobebe rwabo rw’enseemo ya Irianyi, na orooche rwa Yaboki rokaba orobebe rwabo sugusu, orwarenge orobebe rw’Abaamoni.

English: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande wa magharibi mpaka wao ulikuwa Yordani katika Araba, toka ziwa Galilaya hadi Bahari ya Araba (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi), kwenye miteremko ya Pisga upande wa mashariki.
Ekegusii: Bakanyora orogongo rwe rikura ria Yorodani. Orwo rokaba orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo, korwa ase enyancha ya Kinereti, ensemo ya sugusu, goika ase orogongo rwe nyacha y’omoonyo, ensemo ya Irianyi inse y’ebitirimboko bia Pisiga, ensemo ya moocha.

English: I commanded you at that time, saying, “Yahweh your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo nilikuamuru: “Bwana Mungu wako amekupa nchi hii uimiliki. Lakini ni lazima wanaume wenu wote wenye uwezo, wakiwa wamejiandaa tayari kwa vita, wavuke ngʼambo wakiwatangulia ndugu zako Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria inche ’nkabachiika, nkabateebia: Omonene Nyasae oino, obaeire ense eye, ebe eyaino. Ase ayio abarwani baino bonsi, baria bare chituoni, baimokie ebirwanero biabo bi’eseegi, bagende bamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, batang’anere Abaisraeli bamwabo.

English: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,
Kiswahili: Lakini wake zenu, watoto wenu na mifugo yenu (kwani najua mnayo mifugo mingi) wanaweza kukaa katika miji niliyowapa,
Ekegusii: “Korende abakungu baino n’abana, barabwo batigare amo ne’chitugo chiaino ase emechie eyio nabaeire. (Nimanyete ng’a nigo mobwate chitugo chinyinge.)

English: until Yahweh gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which Yahweh your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”
Kiswahili: mpaka hapo Bwana atakapowapa ndugu zenu kupumzika kama alivyowapa ninyi, wao pia wamiliki ile nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa, ngʼambo ya Yordani. Baada ya hapo, kila mmoja wenu anaweza kurudi kwenye milki niliyowapa.”
Ekegusii: Mokonye Abaisraeli bamino goika banyore ense eri’Omonene, arabae ng’umbu ya Yorodani na goika Omonene abae barabwo omorembe buna abaete inwe iga. Nyuma yayio ’namoirane gocha ase ense eye nabaeire inwe.

English: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to these two kings. So shall Yahweh do to all the kingdoms where you go over.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo nilimwamuru Yoshua, “Umejionea kwa macho yako mwenyewe yale yote ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu amewafanyia wafalme hawa wawili. Bwana atazifanyia falme zote huko mnakokwenda vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: “Ase ekero keria ’ngachiika Yoshua, ’nkamoteebia: ’Nkwarooche amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorerete abarwoti baria babere Sihoni na Ogi; Naboigo arakorere kera oyomo ase ense oraabe kogosoa.

English: You shall not fear them; for Yahweh your God himself fights for you.”
Kiswahili: Msiwaogope, Bwana Mungu wenu atapigana kwa ajili yenu.”
Ekegusii: Timobaisa kobairoka, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nere orabarwanere esegi.

English: I begged Yahweh at that time, saying,
Kiswahili: Wakati huo nilimsihi Bwana:
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria ’ngasaba mono,

English: “Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, umemwonyesha mtumishi wako ukuu wako na mkono wako wenye uweza. Kwa kuwa ni mungu yupi aliye mbinguni au duniani anayeweza kufanya kazi na matendo makuu kama ufanyayo wewe?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, bono kwanyorokirie inche, omosomba oo, omochakano bwoka bw’obonene bwao, n’okoboko kwao gwechinguru. Enyasae ende teri, igoro gose ase ense, eranyaare gokora emeremo emenene na eyechinguru buna ey’ogokora aye.

English: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
Kiswahili: Acha niende nikaione hiyo nchi nzuri ngʼambo ya Yordani, ile nchi nzuri ya vilima na Lebanoni.”
Ekegusii: Nagosabire, koranche aye Omonene ong’e ribaga nyamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, indore ense eria engiya y’ebitunwa amo na Lebanoni.

English: But Yahweh was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. Yahweh said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu yenu Bwana alinikasirikia na hakutaka kunisikiliza. Bwana aliniambia, “Hilo latosha; usiseme nami jambo hili tena.
Ekegusii: “Korende ase engencho yaino inwe Omonene akaba n’endamwamu ase ’nde tanchete koigwa okoboria kwane. Korende aganteebia: Ayio aisanire! Tobaisa gokwana nainche gento kende igoro ye ring’ana erio.

English: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.
Kiswahili: Kwea juu ya kilele cha Pisga uangalie magharibi, kaskazini, kusini na mashariki. Iangalie hiyo nchi kwa macho yako, kwa vile wewe hutavuka Yordani.
Ekegusii: Tiira gochia igoro ase egentunwa gia Pisiga, otenene ase egechuuria kiaye, oimokie amaiso ao, origererie gochia ensemo ya bosongo, na sugusu, na Irianyi, na moocha, origererie buya ense eria orarore, ekiagera tokonyaara kwamboka ng’umbu ya Yorodani.

English: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mwagize Yoshua, mtie moyo na umtie nguvu, kwa kuwa yeye atawaongoza watu hawa hadi ngʼambo na kuwarithisha nchi utakayoiona.”
Ekegusii: Tebereria Yoshua, omoremie na omobeeke chinguru, ekiagera nere oraraae abanto aba, abaambokie ng’umbu, ense eyio orarore.

English: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tulikaa kwenye bonde karibu na Beth-Peori.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio tokabeera ase rikura riarochie omochie o Beti‐Peori.”

English: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.
Kiswahili: Sikia sasa, ee Israeli, amri na sheria nitakazokufundisha wewe. Zifuate ili upate kuishi na uingie kuimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana, Mungu wa baba zako anawapa.
Ekegusii: Naende Musa agakwana, “Inwe Abaisraeli, bono igwera amachiiko na emeroberio ’nkoborokereria, moyakore, erio nario moraabe moyo, erinde mogende moire ense eria, Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, agochia kobaa.

English: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.
Kiswahili: Usiongeze wala usipunguze chochote ninachowaamuru ninyi, ila myashike maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wenu ambayo nawapa.
Ekegusii: Timomenta ring’ana rinde rionsi ase aria nabachiikire, gose timorusia gento aroro. Mobwate amachiiko y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ayio inche nabaeire.

English: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.
Kiswahili: Mliona kwa macho yenu wenyewe kile Bwana alichokifanya kule Baal-Peori. Bwana Mungu wenu aliwaangamiza kutoka miongoni mwenu kila mmoja aliyemfuata Baali wa Peori,
Ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwarooche ari’Omonene akorerete Baali‐Peori; abanto baria bonsi basasiimete Baali‐Peori, akabasiria korwa ase egati yaino.

English: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.
Kiswahili: lakini ninyi nyote mlioshikamana na Bwana kwa uthabiti, Mungu wenu, mko hai mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe abamwabete abegenwa ase Omonene Nyasae oino, kera oyomo oino moy’are goika reero iga.

English: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.
Kiswahili: Tazama, nimewafundisha amri na sheria kama Bwana Mungu wangu alivyoniamuru mimi, ili mzifuate katika nchi mnayoiingia kuimiliki.
Ekegusii: “Naama! Inche naborokereirie amachiiko na emeroberio, buna Omonene Nyasae one, anchiigete, erinde inwe moyaigwere ase ense eria mokogeenda koira ebe eyaino.

English: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
Kiswahili: Zishikeni kwa uangalifu, kwa kuwa hii itaonyesha hekima na ufahamu wenu kwa mataifa, ambayo yatasikia kuhusu amri zote hizi, nao watasema, “Hakika taifa hili kubwa ni watu wenye hekima na ufahamu.”
Ekegusii: Moyabwate na koyaigwera, ekiagera ayio naro araorokererie abanto b’ebisaku binde ng’a ’more n’obong’aini. Barabwo kobaraigwe amachiiko aya onsi mbateebe: Ekeene, abanto b’egesaku eke ekenene nigo bare abamanyi naende nabang’aini!

English: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?
Kiswahili: Ni taifa gani jingine lililo kubwa kiasi cha kuwa na miungu yao iliyo karibu nao kama Bwana Mungu wetu alivyo karibu nasi wakati wowote tunapomwomba?
Ekegusii: “Inee! ’Mbanto ba gesaku ki ekenene babwate enyasae ere ang’e nabarabwo buna Omonene Nyasae oito, are ang’e naintwe? Nigo agotoigwa kero kende gionsi tokomorangeria atokoonye.

English: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
Kiswahili: Nalo ni taifa gani jingine lililo kubwa hivi lenye kuwa na amri na sheria za haki kama hizi ninazoweka mbele yenu leo?
Ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki ekenene babwate amachiiko amaronge na emeroberio emeronge, buna amachiiko aya onsi inche naborokereirie reero?

English: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—
Kiswahili: Mwe waangalifu, na makini ili msije mkasahau mambo ambayo mliyaona kwa macho yenu, wala kuyaacha yaondoke moyoni mwenu siku zote za uhai wenu. Mwafundishe hayo watoto wenu na watoto wao baada yao.
Ekegusii: Mwerende! Morende chinkoro chiaino, erinde timobaisa kweba ayamwarorire n’amaiso aino, gose koyatiga arue ase chinkoro chiaino ase amatuko onsi more moyo. Boigo moyorokererie abana baino na abaachokoro baino,

English: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
Kiswahili: Kumbuka siku uliyosimama mbele za Bwana Mungu wako kule Horebu, wakati aliponiambia, “Wakutanishe watu mbele yangu wasikie maneno yangu ili kwamba waweze kujifunza kuniheshimu kwa muda wote watakaoishi katika nchi, nao waweze kuwafundisha watoto wao maneno hayo.”
Ekegusii: erinde bamanye ayakoregete ase rituko riria mwatenenete ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino, agwo Horebu, ekero Omonene akwanete nainche, aganteebia: Sangereria abanto bonsi amo, na inche mbateebie amang’ana, erinde beorokererie konyiroka ase amatuko onsi barabe bare moyo ase ense, nabarabwo baborokererie abana babo boigo.

English: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
Kiswahili: Mlisogea karibu na mkasimama chini ya mlima wakati ulipowaka moto mpaka mbinguni juu, pamoja na mawingu meusi na giza nene.
Ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mwachete ang’e, mogatenena ase egetunwa keria mbarabare, ekero kiagendererete gwoka omorero oria ochongororogete gochia igoro obwate erioki rimwamu ti, na amare, n’omosunte omonene.

English: Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana alipozungumza nanyi kutoka moto. Mkasikia sauti ya maneno lakini hamkuona umbo, kulikuwa na sauti tu.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana nainwe korwa ase omorero oria ime, mokaigwa amang’ana aye, korende timwarooche ekieni kiaye. Nigo mwaigwete eriogi rioka.

English: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.
Kiswahili: Aliwatangazia Agano lake na Amri Kumi, ambazo aliwaamuru mzifuate, kisha akaziandika juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaborokereria okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabachiika mokobwate; okwo nakwo amachiiko aye ikomi. Akayariika ase chibao ibere chi’amagena.

English: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana alinielekeza wakati huo kuwafundisha ninyi sheria na amri ambazo mnapaswa kuzifuata katika nchi ambayo mnavuka Yordani kuimiliki.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo Omonene aganchiika ng’a imborokererie amachiiko ayio, na emeroberio echiikire, erinde monyaare koyaigwera ase ense eria mokogeenda koira.

English: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
Kiswahili: Hamkuona umbo la aina yoyote siku ambayo Bwana alizungumza nanyi kule Horebu kutoka kwenye moto. Kwa hiyo mjihadhari kwa uangalifu sana,
Ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene akwanete nainwe korwa ase omorero ime agwo Horebu, timwarooche ekieni kiaye. Ase ayio moigwere na kwerenda,

English: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
Kiswahili: ili msije mkajichafua na kujitengenezea sanamu au kinyago chenye umbo lolote kama la mwanaume au mwanamke,
Ekegusii: timobaisa gokora ebibe na gwesaria ase okoroisia omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, omogwekano onde bwensi ogwekaine omonto, omosacha gose omokungu,

English: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,
Kiswahili: au kama mnyama aliye juu ya nchi au ndege yeyote arukaye angani,
Ekegusii: gose omogwekano ogwekaine eng’iti ende yonsi ere ase ense, gose oyo bw’enyoni ebwate chimbaaba ekoiruruka igoro,

English: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
Kiswahili: au kama kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi au samaki yeyote aliye ndani ya maji.
Ekegusii: gose oyo bw’eng’iti ekwagura ase riroba, gose oyo bw’enswe ende yonsi ere ime ase amaache inse y’ense.

English: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
Kiswahili: Na utazamapo juu angani na ukaliona jua, mwezi na nyota na vyote vinavyoipamba mbingu, usije ukashawishiwa kuviinamia na kuviabudu vile ambavyo Bwana Mungu wenu alivyogawia mataifa yote chini ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Ekero okorigereria gochia igoro, gokorora ebinto bitongire bireo buna risase, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, omoganda oyio bwonsi, tobaisa gotiga Omonene, erinde osasiime na gokorera ebinto ebio, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oo, obirure ase ebisaku bionsi bire inse y’erioba.

English: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwenu ninyi, Bwana amewatoa kutoka kwenye tanuru ya kuyeyushia chuma, katika Misri kuwa watu wa urithi wake kama mlivyo sasa.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe Omonene obarusirie ase eriiko ri’ebioma rigosamba, nario Misiri, erinde mobe abanto baye ere omonyene buna more goika reero iga.

English: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance;
Kiswahili: Bwana alinikasirikia kwa sababu yenu na akaapa kwamba sitavuka Yordani kuingia katika nchi nzuri Bwana Mungu wenu anayowapa kuwa urithi wenu.
Ekegusii: Kobua ayio Omonene nigo abeete ase engencho yaino, agatiana ng’a inche tinkonyaara kwamboka orooche rwa Yorodani, na kogeenda ase ense eria engiy’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, ebe omwando oino.

English: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.
Kiswahili: Nitakufa katika nchi hii; sitavuka Yordani, lakini ninyi ni karibu mvuke mkaimiliki ile nchi nzuri.
Ekegusii: Inche goika ’nkwere aiga ase orogongo oro: ting’eiri ribaga kwamboka Yorodani, korende ninwe moramboke, erinde moire ense eria engiya.

English: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.
Kiswahili: Jihadharini msilisahau Agano la Bwana Mungu wenu lile alilofanya nanyi; msijitengenezee sanamu katika umbo la kitu chochote ambacho Bwana Mungu wenu amewakataza.
Ekegusii: Moigwere na kwerenda, timobaisa kweba okobwatana kw’ogotianania, okw’Omonene Nyasae oino, akorete nainwe; timobaisa koroisia omogwekano onde bwensi mogosasiima. Omonene Nyasae oino, obakanirie ayio.

English: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu ni moto ulao, Mungu mwenye wivu.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo are omorero ogosamba na gosiria; ere nere Nyasae bwe risemi.

English: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwa na watoto na wajukuu na kuishi katika nchi hiyo siku nyingi, tena kama mkijichafua na kutengeneza sanamu ya aina yoyote, mkifanya maovu machoni pa Bwana Mungu wenu na kumfanya awe na hasira,
Ekegusii: “Komogochia koibora abana na abaachokoro, naende komenya amatuko amaange ase ense eyio; timokora ebibe na gwesaria ase okoroisia omogwekano onde bwensi mogosasiima gose gokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino. Moise gokora ayio, rirorio nigo moramogeechie abe n’endamwamu ase more.

English: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
Kiswahili: ninaziita mbingu na nchi kama mashahidi dhidi yenu siku hii kwamba mtaangamia mara moja kutoka nchi ile ambayo mnavuka Yordani kuimiliki. Hamtaishi kule kwa muda mrefu bali kwa hakika mtaangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Onye timokoigwera, inche ’nkorangeria inde igoro na ense chibe birori ase more reero ng’a, goika mosire kegima ase obwango. Timokomenya amatuko amaange ase ense eyio mogochia koira, ekero moramboke Yorodani.

English: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead you away.
Kiswahili: Bwana atawatawanya miongoni mwa mataifa, na ni wachache wenu tu watakaosalia miongoni mwa mataifa hayo ambayo Bwana atawafukuzia.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabasiarere ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku binde, nainwe abamoratigare n’abake ase omobaro, namomenye ase egati y’ abanto baria ase Omonene arabaire.

English: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
Kiswahili: Huko mtaabudu miungu ya miti na mawe iliyotengenezwa na watu, ambayo haiwezi kuona au kusikia wala kula au kunusa.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase morasiarerwe gochia, ’namobe mogosasiima chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena, emeremo y’amaboko a Mwanyabaanto, echio chitari korora, gose koigwa, gose koragera, gose konyonka.

English: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mtamtafuta Bwana Mungu wenu, mtampata; kama mtamtafuta kwa moyo wenu wote na kwa roho yote.
Ekegusii: Korende aroro agwo, komorarigie Omonene Nyasae oino, ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi, inamomonyoore.

English: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God and listen to his voice.
Kiswahili: Wakati mnapokuwa katika dhiki, nayo mambo haya yote yamewatokea siku hizo, ndipo mtamrudia Bwana Mungu wenu na kumtii.
Ekegusii: Ekero moraabe n’emechando, na ayio onsi arabanyoore ase amatuko agochia goocha, imomoiranere Omonene Nyasae oino, naende moigwere eriogi riaye.

English: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu ni Mungu mwenye huruma, hatawaacha au kuwaangamiza wala kusahau Agano alilofanya na baba zenu, alilowathibitishia kwa kiapo.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, takobatiga, ekiagera ere n’oyo bw’amaabera. Takobasiria, gose takweba okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania akorete ne’chisokoro chiaino.

English: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?
Kiswahili: Sasa uliza kuhusu siku za zamani, zamani kabla ya wakati wako, tangu siku ile Mungu alipomuumba mtu juu ya nchi, uliza kutoka mwisho mmoja wa mbingu mpaka mwisho mwingine wa mbingu. Je, kumepata kutokea jambo jingine lililo kubwa kama hili, au kuna jambo jingine kama hilo limepata kusikiwa?
Ekegusii: “Bono booria, momanye korwa ase amatuko a kare, amatuko ayio arengeo ekero konya motaraiborwa, korwa rituko riria Nyasae atongete Mwanyabaanto ase ense, naende moboorie momanye korwa ase ensemo eyemo y’ense goikera ensemo ende, gose amang’ana agwekaine buna aya ana koba, gose koigugwa.

English: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
Kiswahili: Je, kuna watu wengine wowote waliosikia sauti ya Mungu ikizungumza kwenye moto, kama mlivyosikia, nao wakaishi?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abanto bande bana koigwa Nyasae ogokwana korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero buna inwe mwaiguure, naende mogendererete koba moyo?

English: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
Kiswahili: Je, kuna mungu yeyote amepata kujaribu mwenyewe kuchukua taifa moja kutoka taifa lingine, kwa mapigo, kwa ishara za miujiza na maajabu, kwa vita, kwa mkono wenye nguvu na mkono ulionyooshwa au kwa matendo makuu ya kutisha, kama yale ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu aliyofanya kwa ajili yenu huko Misri mbele ya macho yenu?
Ekegusii: Gose enyasae ende kero kende gionsi yana korenta egesaku kende korwa ase egati y’ebisaku binde, erinde agekore kebe abanto baye omonyene, buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abakorerete inwe agwo Misiri? Ase amaiso aino nigo arentete amateemwa, na ebikone, na amakumia, na esegi, na ase okoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire akarenta okoondokia okonene.

English: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.
Kiswahili: Mlionyeshwa mambo haya ili mpate kujua kuwa Bwana ndiye Mungu; hakuna mwingine ila yeye.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aborogetie ayio, erinde momanye ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae; onde tari otatiga ere bweka.

English: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
Kiswahili: Kutoka mbinguni amewasikizisha sauti yake ili kuwaadilisha. Hapa duniani aliwaonyesha moto wake mkubwa, nanyi mlisikia maneno yake kutoka kwenye ule moto.
Ekegusii: Akabakora mokaigwa eriogi riaye riarwete igoro, erinde anyare koborokereria; na ase ense akaborokia omorero omonene, nainwe mokaigwa amang’ana aye korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero oria.

English: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu aliwapenda baba zenu na alichagua wazao wao baada yao, aliwatoa katika nchi ya Misri kwa Uwepo wake na kwa uwezo wake mkuu,
Ekegusii: Agancha chisokoro chiaino, na ase engencho eyio akabachoora inwe, ororeeria rwabo, mobe ribaga riabo, na ere omonyene akabang’anyia korwa Misiri ase okobua kwaye okonene.

English: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.
Kiswahili: aliwafukuza mbele yenu mataifa makubwa na yenye nguvu kuliko ninyi na kuwaleta ninyi katika nchi yao na akawapa ninyi kuwa urithi wenu, kama ilivyo leo.
Ekegusii: Korwa bosio bwaino akabiseeria ebisaku biarenge ebinene, naende biarenge ne chinguru kobabua; akabarenta ase ense yabo, nainwe mokayeira ekaba omwando oino, naboigo ere nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that Yahweh himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.
Kiswahili: Kubalini na mweke moyoni leo kuwa Bwana ndiye Mungu mbinguni juu na duniani chini. Hakuna mwingine.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio manya rituko ria reero, morengererie mono ng’a, Omonene nere Nyasae o igoro na ense; naende onde tari otatiga ere bweka.

English: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for all time.
Kiswahili: Mshike amri na maagizo yake ninayowapa leo, ili mpate kufanikiwa ninyi na watoto wenu baada yenu, na mpate kuishi maisha marefu katika nchi awapayo Bwana Mungu wenu siku zote.
Ekegusii: Inwe goika morende emeroberio yaye echiikire n’amachiiko aye, ayio inche nkobaa rituko ria reero, erio nario er’abe buya ase more, naboigo nase abana baino, naende amatuko aino nabe amaange ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe eyaino kogenderera.”

English: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akatenga miji mitatu mashariki ya Yordani,
Ekegusii: Erio Musa agachoora emechie etato agwo moocha ya Yorodani.

English: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
Kiswahili: ambayo mtu yeyote aliyemuua mtu angeweza kukimbilia ikiwa amemuua jirani yake bila kukusudia na bila kuwa na chuki naye siku zilizopita. Angeweza kukimbilia katika mmojawapo ya miji hii na kuokoa maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio nero omoiti aranyare gotamera, ere oy’oraite omonto omwabo mosiabano, gose oyio atabwati obobisa nere. Omonto oria karatamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio nigo aratigwe abe moyo.

English: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
Kiswahili: Miji hiyo ilikuwa: Bezeri katika tambarare ya jangwa kwa ajili ya Wareubeni; Ramothi katika nchi ya Gileadi kwa ajili ya Wagadi; nao mji wa Golani katika nchi ya Bashani kwa ajili ya Wamanase.
Ekegusii: Beseri ase erooro, ase ense eraire eimokererete igoro, nigo orenge omochie bw’obotamero ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na Ramoti ase ense ya Gileadi ase abanto ba Gadi, na Golani ase ense ya Basani ase abanto ba Manase.

English: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sheria Mose aliyoweka mbele ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amachiiko a Nyasae Musa aruete ase Abaisraeli.

English: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo masharti, amri na sheria Mose aliyowapa wana wa Israeli wakati walitoka Misri,
Ekegusii: Magega Abaisraeli kobaruure Misiri, Musa akaa Abaisraeli oborori, na emeroberio echiikire, n’amachiiko aya.

English: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.
Kiswahili: nao walikuwa katika bonde karibu na Beth-Peori mashariki ya Yordani, katika nchi ya Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala Heshboni, naye alishindwa na Mose na Waisraeli walipokuja toka Misri.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo abeete agwo moocha ya Yorodani ase rikura riarenge ensemo ekororia Beti‐Peori, ase orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oyio omenyete agwo Hesiboni. Nere oria Musa na Abaisraeli babuete ekero barwete Misiri,

English: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
Kiswahili: Waliimiliki nchi yake na nchi ya Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, wafalme wawili Waamori waliotawala mashariki ya Yordani.
Ekegusii: bakaira ense yaye ekaba eyabo, naende bakaira ense ya Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. (Abarwoti abwo babere nigo bamenyete moocha ya Yorodani.)

English: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),
Kiswahili: Nchi hii ilienea kutoka Aroeri ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni mpaka Mlima Sioni (yaani Hermoni),
Ekegusii: Bakaira ense gochaakera Aroeri ase orobebe rwe rigoko ri’Arinoni goikera egetunwa keria Sioni (nakio Herimoni).

English: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
Kiswahili: pamoja na eneo lote la Araba mashariki ya Yordani, na kuenea mpaka Bahari ya Araba kwenye miteremko ya Pisga.
Ekegusii: Bakaira orogongo gochakera rikura moocha ya Yorodani goikera ase Enyancha y’omonyoo inse y’ebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga.

English: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
Kiswahili: Mose akawaita Israeli wote, akawaambia: Ee Israeli, sikilizeni amri na sheria ninazowatangazia leo. Jifunzeni, na mwe na hakika kuzifuata.
Ekegusii: Musa akarangeria Abaisraeli bonsi goocha amo, erio akabateebia, Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa amachiiko na emeroberio echiikire ’nkobateebia rituko ria reero, moyieorokererie, mobe n’obomaene ng’a ’moyakore.

English: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wetu alifanya Agano nasi katika mlima wa Horebu.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oito, nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo naintwe agwo Horebu.

English: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba Bwana alifanya Agano na baba zetu, bali alifanya nasi, nasi sote ambao tuko hai hapa leo.
Ekegusii: Omonene takorete okobwatana okwo ne’chisokoro chiaito, korende nigo akorete okobwatana okwo naintwe abanyene, intwe twensi abatore moyo rituko ria reero.

English: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
Kiswahili: Bwana alisema nanyi uso kwa uso kutoka moto juu ya mlima.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase egetunwa, korwa ase egati-gati y’omorero, Omonene nigo akwanete nainwe obosio ase obosio.

English: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,
Kiswahili: (Wakati huo nilisimama kati ya Bwana na ninyi kuwatangazia neno la Bwana, kwa sababu mliogopa ule moto, nanyi hamkupanda mlimani.) Naye Mungu alisema:
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria inche nabeete ’nteneine ase egati y’Omonene nainwe, nareenge gokwana nainwe ring’ana ri’Omonene, ekiagera inwe nigo mwarenge n’obwoba ase engencho y’omorero oria, timwatiirete goocha ase egetunwa. “Omonene agakwana:

English: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako, niliyekutoa katika nchi ya Misri, kutoka nchi ya utumwa.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense y’obosomba.

English: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
Kiswahili: Usijitengenezee sanamu katika umbo la kitu chochote kilicho juu mbinguni au duniani chini au ndani ya maji.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gwekorera omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, omogwekano o getongwa kende gionsi kere igoro, gose ase ense, gose ime ase amaache inse y’ense.

English: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me
Kiswahili: Usivisujudie wala kuviabudu; kwa kuwa Mimi, Bwana Mungu wako, ni Mungu mwenye wivu, ninayewaadhibu watoto kwa ajili ya dhambi za baba zao hadi kizazi cha tatu na cha nne cha wanichukiao,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotugama gose gosasiima emegwekano, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oo, inche ’Nyasae bwe risemi. Ase engencho y’amabe y’abaibori nigo ’nkobaa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane, abwo bangeechete.

English: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
Kiswahili: lakini ninaonyesha upendo kwa maelfu ya vizazi vya wale wanipendao na kuzishika amri zangu.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo ’nkoborokia obwanchani bwane botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu, ase abwo banyanchete na babwatete amachiiko ane.

English: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God; for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
Kiswahili: Usilitaje bure jina la Bwana Mungu wako, kwa kuwa Bwana hataacha kumhesabia hatia yeye alitajaye jina lake bure.
Ekegusii: “Toriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oo, ekiagera Omonene tagotiga komoa egesusuro oria okoriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta riaye.”

English: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God commanded you.
Kiswahili: Adhimisha siku ya Sabato na kuiweka takatifu, kama Bwana Mungu wako alivyokuagiza.
Ekegusii: “Bwata rituko ri’Esabato, oriatanane ribe richenu, buna Omonene Nyasae oo, agochiigete.

English: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;
Kiswahili: Kwa siku sita utafanya kazi na kutenda shughuli zako zote.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao yonsi.

English: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
Kiswahili: Lakini siku ya Saba ni Sabato kwa Bwana, Mungu wako. Siku hiyo hutafanya kazi yoyote, wewe, wala mwanao au binti yako, wala mtumishi wa kiume au mtumishi wa kike, wala ngʼombe wako, punda wako au mnyama wako yeyote, wala mgeni aliyeko malangoni mwako, ili kwamba mtumishi wako wa kiume na wa kike wapate kupumzika kama wewe.
Ekegusii: Korende rituko ria gatan’akabere, ne’rituko ri’Esabato riatananwe ase Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya n’omosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yao, gose etigere yao, gose etugo yao ende yonsi egokora emeremo, gose omomenyi oyomenyete mwao. Omosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nabarabwo batimoke buna aye ogotimoka.

English: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore Yahweh your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka mlikuwa watumwa huko Misri, na Bwana Mungu wenu aliwatoa huko kwa mkono wenye nguvu na kwa mkono ulionyooshwa. Kwa hiyo Bwana Mungu wako amekuagiza kuiadhimisha siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Inyora ng’a aye omonyene nigo kwarenge omosomba ase ense ya Misiri, n’Omonene, Nyasae oo, agakorusia korwa aroro n’okoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire. Ase ayio Omonene, Nyasae oo, nigo agochiigete orende rituko ri’Esabato.

English: “Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
Kiswahili: Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako, kama Bwana Mungu wako alivyokuagiza, ili siku zako zipate kuwa nyingi na kufanikiwa katika nchi Bwana Mungu wako anayokupa.
Ekegusii: “Sika iso na nyoko, buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochiikire; nario oramenye amatuko amaange, naende er’abe buya ase ore ase ense eri’Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochia gokoa.

English: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
Kiswahili: Usimshuhudie jirani yako uongo.
Ekegusii: “Tomoteebera omogisangio oo oborimo.

English: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”
Kiswahili: Usitamani mke wa jirani yako. Usitamani nyumba ya jirani yako au shamba lake, mtumishi wake wa kiume au wa kike, ngʼombe au punda wake, wala kitu chochote cha jirani yako.”
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa kogania omokungu bw’omogisangio oo. Tobaisa kogania enyomba y’omogisangio oo, nonya n’omogondo oye, gose omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yaye, gose etigere yaye, gose gento kende gionsi abwate.

English: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
Kiswahili: Hizi ndizo amri alizozitangaza Bwana kwa sauti kubwa kwa kusanyiko lenu lote huko mlimani kutoka kwenye moto, wingu na giza nene, wala hakuongeza chochote zaidi. Kisha akaziandika juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe, naye akanipa mimi.
Ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya nar’Omonene akwanete ase omosangererekano oino bwonsi agwo ase egetunwa, ekero akwanete korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, ne riire, na omosunte ekerima. Akayakwana n’eriogi rinene, na tamentete gento kende gionsi. Akayariika ase chibao ibere chi’amagena, erio agachiing’a.

English: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
Kiswahili: Mliposikia sauti kutoka kwenye giza, mlima ulipokuwa ukiwaka moto, viongozi wenu wote wa makabila yenu na wazee wenu walinijia mimi.
Ekegusii: “Ekero egetunwa keria kiagendererete gwoka omorero, mokaigwa eriogi korwa ase egati‐gati y’omosunte oria, nainwe mwensi, abamore abatang’ani na abagaaka ase ebisaku biaino, mogaacha ase ’nde.

English: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mkasema, “Bwana Mungu wetu ametuonyesha utukufu na enzi yake, nasi tumesikia sauti yake kutoka kwenye moto. Leo tumeona kwamba mwanadamu anaweza kuishi hata kama Mungu akizungumza naye.
Ekegusii: Mokabora: Naama, Omonene Nyasae oito, otworokirie obonene bwaye na obonguru bwaye, naintwe twaiguure eriogi riaye korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero. Rituko ria reero twarorire Nyasae ogokwana na Mwanyabaanto, na Mwanyabaanto oyio ogendererete koba moyo.

English: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa, kwa nini tufe? Moto huu mkubwa utatuteketeza sisi na tutakufa kama tukiendelea kusikia sauti ya Bwana Mungu wetu zaidi.
Ekegusii: Bono nase ki togwenerete gokwa? Omorero oyo omonene nigo ogochia gotosamba na gotosiria, onye naende togochia koigwa eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae oito, goika tokwe.

English: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
Kiswahili: Ni mtu yupi mwenye mwili ambaye amewahi kuisikia sauti ya Mungu aliye hai akizungumza kutoka kwenye moto, kama sisi tulivyoisikia, naye akaishi?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nareo obeire okoigwa Nyasae ore moyo kagokwana korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, buna intwe twamoiguure, na omonto oyio ogendererete koba moyo?

English: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
Kiswahili: Sogea karibu usikie yale yote asemayo Bwana Mungu wetu. Kisha utuambie chochote kile ambacho Bwana Mungu wetu anakuambia. Tutasikiliza na kutii.”
Ekegusii: Naende moganteebia: Aye genda ang’e, oigwe amang’ana onsi Omonene Nyasae oito, agokwana. Erio oche ototeebie onsi ayio Omonene Nyasae oito, aragoteebie, naintwe ’natoyaigwe na koyakora.

English: Yahweh heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
Kiswahili: Bwana aliwasikia wakati mlipozungumza nami, na Bwana akaniambia, “Nimesikia kile hawa watu walichokuambia. Kila kitu walichokisema ni kizuri.
Ekegusii: “Omonene nigo aigwete amang’ana aino ekero keria mware gokwana nainche, erio aganteebia: Naiguure amang’ana abanto abwo bakwanire naye. Ayio onsi bagoteebirie, mbuya bakwanire.

English: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!
Kiswahili: Laiti kama mioyo yao ingekuwa na mwelekeo wa kuniogopa na kuzishika amri zangu zote daima, ili kwamba wafanikiwe wao pamoja na watoto wao milele!
Ekegusii: Onye ndiria baare koba n’omoyo oyio botambe, na kong’iroka na korenda amachiiko ane onsi, nanga kera egento nigo kiare koba buya ase bare, na ase ororeeria rwabo, kare na kare.

English: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
Kiswahili: “Nenda uwaambie warudi kwenye mahema yao.
Ekegusii: Genda obateebie bairane ase chiema chiabo.

English: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe baki hapa pamoja nami ili niweze kukupa maagizo yote, amri na sheria ambazo utawafundisha wazifuate katika nchi ninayokwenda kuwapa waimiliki.”
Ekegusii: Korende aye tigara aa ase ’nde, na inche ngoteebie amachiiko onsi, na emeroberio echiikire, na onsi aya nachiikire, ayio ogochia koborokia, erio bayarende na koyakora ase ense eria ’ngochia kobaa, ebe eyabo.

English: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kuweni waangalifu kuyafanya yale Bwana Mungu wenu aliyowaagiza; msigeuke upande wa kuume wala wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio morende na gokora ayio Omonene Nyasae oino, abachiikire. Timoyatiga na koonchoka gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.

English: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
Kiswahili: Fuateni yale yote ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu aliwaagiza, ili mpate kuishi, kustawi na kuziongeza siku zenu katika nchi mtakayoimiliki.
Ekegusii: Mobwatie chinchera chionsi Omonene Nyasae oino, abachiikire, erio nario mor’abe moyo, naende nario er’abe buya ase more, na inwe momenye amatuko amaange ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.

English: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maagizo, amri na sheria ambazo Bwana Mungu wenu aliniagiza niwafundishe ninyi ili mpate kuyashika katika nchi ambayo ninyi mnavuka Yordani kuimiliki,
Ekegusii: “Aya naro amachiiko, na emeroberio echiikire, Omonene Nyasae oino, anchiigete imborokererie, erinde moyaigwere na koyakora ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.

English: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba ninyi, watoto wenu na watoto wao baada yao wamche Bwana Mungu wenu siku zote kwa kushika amri na maagizo yake yote ninayowapa, ili mweze kuyafurahia maisha marefu.
Ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaino bwonsi, inwe amo nabana baino, na abaachokoro baino, goika moiroke Omonene Nyasae oino, na kobwata emeroberio yaye yonsi yachiikirwe, n’amachiiko aye onsi ayio inche ’nkobachiika, erio nario amatuko aino arabe amaange.

English: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
Kiswahili: Sikia, ee Israeli, nawe uwe mwangalifu kutii ili upate kufanikiwa na kuongezeka sana katika nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, kama Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, alivyowaahidi ninyi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe, monyaare koyarenda; erio nario er’abe buya ase more, naende ’momentekane mono ase ense eria entenenku ere n’amabeere n’amooke, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, abarierete eira.

English: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.
Kiswahili: Sikia, ee Israeli: Bwana Mungu wako, Bwana ni mmoja.
Ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe! Omonene Nyasae oito, nere bweka Omonene.

English: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
Kiswahili: Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, na kwa roho yako yote, na kwa nguvu zako zote.
Ekegusii: Mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oo, n’enkoro yao yonsi, n’omoyo oo bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi.

English: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
Kiswahili: Amri hizi ninazokupa leo zitakuwa katika moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya ’nkobachiika rituko ria reero timobaisa koyeeba nonya ng’ake.

English: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto wako kwa bidii. Nena kuhusu amri hizi uketipo nyumbani na wakati utembeapo njiani, ulalapo na uamkapo.
Ekegusii: Moyorokererie abana baino mono, mobe mokona‐koyairanerera botambe; moyakwane ekero moikaransete ase chinyomba chiaino, na ekero more ase orogeendo inchera, na ekero mogochia korara, na ekero mokobooka.

English: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
Kiswahili: Zifunge kama alama juu ya mkono wako, na uzifunge juu ya paji la uso wako.
Ekegusii: Moyasiberanie ase amaboko aino, na moyabeeke ase amasio aino igoro, abe amariiko akobainyoria.

English: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.
Kiswahili: Ziandike kwenye miimo ya milango ya nyumba yako na juu ya malango yako.
Ekegusii: Moyariike ase emetobwa na emeriibo y’ebisieri bi’echinyomba chiaino, na ase ebiita biaino.

English: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,
Kiswahili: Wakati Bwana Mungu wako atakapokuleta katika nchi aliyowaapia baba zako, Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, kukupa wewe, nchi kubwa, ina miji inayopendeza ambayo hukuijenga,
Ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae oino, nabaire na kobaikia ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino, Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira, ng’a nabae inwe ense eria ebwate emechie emenene naende emiya, eyio inwe motaagachete.

English: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
Kiswahili: nyumba zilizojaa vitu vizuri vya aina nyingi ambavyo hukuvijaza, visima ambavyo hukuchimba, na mashamba ya mizabibu na mizeituni ambayo hukupanda wewe, basi, utakapokula na kushiba,
Ekegusii: Chinyomba nigo chiraabe chiichire n’ebinto ebiya, ebio inwe motabegeteo, ne chinsooko chi’amaache echio motakuunyete, na emegondo y’emesabibu na ey’emezeituni, eyio motasimegete.

English: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
Kiswahili: jihadhari usije ukamwacha Bwana, aliyekutoa katika nchi ya Misri, kutoka nchi ya utumwa.
Ekegusii: Komoraikeo mwerende mono, timobaisa kweba Omonene oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase mwarenge abasomba.

English: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
Kiswahili: Utamcha Bwana Mungu wako, na umtumikie yeye peke yake na kuapa kwa jina lake.
Ekegusii: Momoiroke Omonene Nyasae oino; momokorere ere bweka na motiane ase erieta riaye rioka.

English: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,
Kiswahili: Usifuate miungu mingine, miungu ya mataifa yanayokuzunguka;
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gosasiima chinyasae chinde chionsi chiria chi’ abanto baabaetanaine.

English: for Yahweh your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of Yahweh your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wako, ambaye yuko katikati yako, ni Mungu mwenye wivu na hasira yake itawaka dhidi yako, naye atakuangamiza kutoka uso wa nchi.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, oyomenyete ase egati yaino, nigo are Nyasae bwe risemi; mwerende, erinde endamwamu yaye tebaisa gwoka igoro ase more na kobasiria korwa ase ense.

English: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
Kiswahili: Usimjaribu Bwana Mungu wako kama ulivyofanya huko Masa.
Ekegusii: “Timobaisa komoteema Omonene Nyasae oino, buna mwamoteemete aaria Masa.

English: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
Kiswahili: Utayashika maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wako kwa bidii, na masharti na amri alizokupa.
Ekegusii: Mobe abeegenwa ase okobwata amachiiko a Omonene Nyasae oino, na oborori bwaye, na emeroberio echiikire, eyio abaeire.

English: You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahweh swore to your fathers,
Kiswahili: Fanya lililo haki na jema mbele za Bwana, ili upate kufanikiwa, uweze kuingia na kuimiliki nchi nzuri ambayo Bwana aliahidi kwa kiapo kwa baba zako,
Ekegusii: Mokore ayaare amaronge na’amaya ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio nario er’abe buya ase more, monyaare gosoa na koira ense eria engiy’Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee,

English: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.
Kiswahili: kuwafukuza kwa nguvu adui zako mbele yako kama Bwana alivyosema.
Ekegusii: na kobaseeria ababisa baino bonsi korwa ase more, buna Omonene ateebete.

English: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh our God has commanded you mean?”
Kiswahili: Siku zijazo, mtoto wako atakapokuuliza, “Ni nini maana ya masharti haya, amri na sheria hizi ambazo Bwana Mungu wako alikuagiza wewe?”
Ekegusii: “Ase chingaki chigochia‐goocha ekero abana baino barababorie: Ninki engencho y’oborori obo, n’amachiiko aya, na emeroberio eye, ebi Omonene Nyasae oito, abachiigete? Nase ki Omonene Nyasae oito, abachiigete amachiiko aya na emeroberio eye?

English: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
Kiswahili: Mwambie: “Tulikuwa watumwa wa Farao huko Misri, lakini Bwana alitutoa sisi kutoka Misri kwa mkono wenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Goika mobairanerie: Intwe nigo twarenge abasomba ba Farao ase ense ya Misiri, n’Omonene agatorusiao n’okoboko kwaye gwe’chinguru.

English: and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
Kiswahili: Bwana akapeleka mbele yetu ishara za miujiza na maajabu makubwa na ya kutisha mno juu ya Misri na Farao pamoja na nyumba yake yote.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aorogetie ebikone na amakumia amanene, naende ay’okoondokia, aaria ase ense ya Misiri, ase Farao, na ase abanto bonsi b’enyomba yaye, naintwe tokayarora.

English: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu akatutoa huko, akatuleta na kutupa nchi hii ambayo aliwaahidi baba zetu kwa kiapo.
Ekegusii: Omonene agatorusia ase ense eria, erio agatorenta aiga, agatoa ense eye arierete chisokoro chiaito eira ng’a n’abayee.

English: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
Kiswahili: Bwana akatuagiza tutii amri hizi zote na kumcha Bwana Mungu wetu, ili tupate kustawi na kuendelea kuwa hai kama ilivyo leo.
Ekegusii: Erio agatochiika ng’a toigwere amachiiko aya onsi, na koimoroka ere Omonene Nyasae oito, erio nario er’abe buya ase tore botambe. Toise gokora bo ere natorende, buna atorendete goika reero iga, naintwe ’natogenderere koba moyo.

English: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”
Kiswahili: Kama tukizitii kwa bidii amri hizi zote mbele za Bwana Mungu wetu, kama alivyotuamuru sisi, hiyo itakuwa haki yetu.”
Ekegusii: Onye tokorenda na koigwera amachiiko aya onsi, ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, buna ere atochiikire, nigo torabarerwe oboronge.”

English: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wako akuletapo katika nchi unayoingia kuimiliki, na awafukuzapo mbele yako mataifa mengi, yaani Wahiti, Wagirgashi, Waamori, Wakanaani, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, mataifa saba makubwa tena yenye nguvu kuliko wewe,
Ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae oino, nabaikie ase ense eria, mogochia koira ebe eyaino, na aseerie ebisaku ebinge birue ase amasio aino, ebisaku bitano bibere bire ebinene, naende bire nechinguru kobabua. Ebisaku ebio nabio ebi: Abahiti, na Abagirigasi, na Abaamori, na Abakaanani, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.

English: and when Yahweh your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.
Kiswahili: pia Bwana Mungu wako atakapowatia mkononi mwako na ukawashinda, basi ni lazima uwaangamize wote kabisa. Usifanye agano nao, wala usiwahurumie.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene Nyasae oino, arabeeke abanto abwo ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobabue, goika mobaite na kobasiria kegima, timobaisa gokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, gose kobarorera amaabera.

English: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
Kiswahili: Usioane nao. Usimtoe binti yako kuolewa na mwanawe, au kumchukua binti yake aolewe na mwanao.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa konyuomerana nabarabwo; timorua abana baino abaiseke ase abamura babo, gose timonyuomeria abana baino abamura ase abaiseke babo,

English: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So Yahweh’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana watamgeuza mwanao aache kunifuata, ili aitumikia miungu mingine, nayo hasira ya Bwana itawaka dhidi yako, naye atakuangamiza ghafula.
Ekegusii: ekiagera barabwo nigo baraonchore abana baino abamura batige gosasiima Omonene, erio bakorere chinyasae ching’ao. Eri’Omonene abaise koba n’endamwamu ase more, abasirie ara rimo rioka.

English: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo utakalowafanyia: Vunja madhabahu yao, vunja mawe yao ya kuabudia, katakata nguzo zao za Ashera na kuchoma sanamu zao kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Aya naro morabakorere: Motagore ebisasimero biabo, mobutore chisiiro chiabo bagosasiima, monachane emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkuungu, na mosambe n’omorero emegwekano yabo bagosasiima,

English: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
