English: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, mnaweza kuikata miti ambayo sio miti ya matunda na kuitumia kujenga ngome, mpaka mji ulio katika vita na ninyi utakapoanguka.
Ekegusii: Mogeeche emete eria yoka momanyete ng’a teri kwama amatunda akoriegwa. Moyekorere emeremo y’okoagachera aase mogokengana korwa ase omochie oria mokorwania esegi, goika obugwe.

English: If someone is found slain in the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akikutwa ameuawa, naye amelala kwenye shamba katika nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kuimiliki, wala haijulikani ni nani aliyemuua,
Ekegusii: “Omonto karanyorekane oitirwe okuure ore orosana ime agwo ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, na onye omonto omoita tamanyekaneti,

English: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.
Kiswahili: wazee wenu na waamuzi watatoka na kupima umbali kutoka maiti alipolala mpaka kwenye miji ya jirani.
Ekegusii: rirorio abagaaka baino amo n’abagaambi, bageende korenga oboaare korwa aase agwo omonto oyio akwerete goika ase emechie eetanaine ere ang’e nase agwo.

English: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.
Kiswahili: Kisha wazee wa ule mji ulio karibu zaidi na yule maiti watamchukua mtamba ambaye hajapata kufanyishwa kazi na ambaye hajafungwa nira,
Ekegusii: Erio abagaaka b’omochie oranyorekane ore ang’e kobua nase omonto oyio akwerete, bachoore ritororo ritarakorigwa emeremo, gose ritarasiberwa rikorogoto ase ogokuruura ebinto.

English: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.
Kiswahili: na kumpeleka kwenye bonde ambalo halijapata kulimwa au kupandwa mazao na ambapo kuna chemchemi itiririkayo. Huko kwenye hilo bonde, wazee watamvunja yule mtamba shingo.
Ekegusii: Barabwo baire ritororo riria, baritirimbokie gochia ase rigoko ase orooche rore n’amaache agotirimboka, rigoko ritana koremwa gose gosimekwa chindagera, na aroro agwo ase rigoko, babune ebigoti bie ritororo riria.

English: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them Yahweh your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in Yahweh’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.
Kiswahili: Makuhani, hao wana wa Lawi, watasogea mbele, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu, amewachagua kuhudumu na kutoa baraka katika jina la Bwana, na kuamua mashauri yote ya mabishano na mashambulio.
Ekegusii: Na abakuani Abalawi bagende agwo ase rigoko, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, abachoorire bamokorere na gosesenia ase erieta riaye. Ase ring’ana riabo kera eriomana na ogokorerana bobe ase obotindi ’nabinachwe.

English: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wazee wote wa mji ulio karibu zaidi na huyo maiti watanawa mikono yao juu ya huyo mtamba ambaye shingo yake imevunjwa huko kwenye bonde,
Ekegusii: Abagaaka bonsi b’omochie oria ore ang’e kobua nase aria omonto oria aiteretwe baisaabere amaboko abo igoro ase ritororo riria riabunetwe ebigoti agwo ase rigoko.

English: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.
Kiswahili: nao watatangaza: “Mikono yetu haikumwaga damu hii, wala macho yetu hayakuona likifanyika.
Ekegusii: Erio bakwane amang’ana aya ase okoenekia oborori bwabo: Amaboko aito tari aro aitera amanyinga aya, gose amaiso aito tarooche ayio kagokorwa.

English: Forgive, Yahweh, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ukubali upatanisho kwa watu wako Israeli, ambao umewakomboa, wala usiwahesabie watu wako hatia ya damu ya mtu asiyekuwa na hatia.” Nayo damu iliyomwagika itakuwa imefanyiwa upatanisho.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abera abanto bao Abaisraeli, aba kwabooretie; tobabarera okomocha oko kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga y’omonto otari na komocha. Naboigo baaberwe okomocha oko kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga.

English: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mtakuwa mmejitakasa wenyewe kutoka hatia ya kumwaga damu isiyokuwa na hatia, kwa kuwa mmefanya lile lililo sawa mbele za macho ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Goika morusie korwa ase more okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’omonto otari na komocha; mokore boronge ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and Yahweh your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,
Kiswahili: Mkienda vitani kupigana na adui zenu naye Bwana Mungu wenu akawatia adui mikononi mwenu, nanyi mkachukua mateka,
Ekegusii: “Ekero mokogeenda ase esegi korwania ababisa baino, n’Omonene Nyasae oino, ababeeke ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobabue na moboose,

English: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,
Kiswahili: kama ukiona miongoni mwa mateka mwanamke mzuri wa sura nawe wavutwa naye, waweza kumwoa akawa mke wako.
Ekegusii: n’onde oino arore omokungu ore omonyakieni ase egati yabooswa abwo, nere aganie komoira abe mokaaye,

English: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.
Kiswahili: Mlete nyumbani mwako, anyoe nywele na kukata kucha zake,
Ekegusii: rirorio amoire ’nka bwoye, na omokungu oria akigite etukia y’omotwe oye naende aninte chinchara chiaye.

English: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.
Kiswahili: avue nguo alizokuwa amevaa alipotekwa. Baada ya kuishi nyumbani mwako na kumwombolezea baba yake na mama yake kwa mwezi mzima, ndipo utakapoweza kumwendea na kuwa mume wake naye atakuwa mke wako.
Ekegusii: Aonchoorerie chianga chiria abegete ekero oosetwe, na agenderere kobeera agwo enka y’omonto oyio, abe okoreera ise na ng’ina ase engaki y’omotienyi omogima. Magega yaye omonto oria amotware abe mokaaye.

English: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hutaendelea kupendezwa naye, mwache aende popote anapotaka. Kamwe huwezi kumuuza au kumtendea kama mtumwa, kwa sababu utakuwa umemvunjia heshima.
Ekegusii: Korende keraabe ng’a tagookiri n’omokuungu oyio, amoe ribaga agende aande onsi ase aranche, korende tamoonia chitaabu gose komokorera buna agokorera omosomba, ekiagera igo amobetereretie koba nere, na akamoa obosooku.

English: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,
Kiswahili: Kama mwanaume ana wake wawili, naye anampenda mmoja na mwingine hampendi na wote wawili wamemzalia wana wa kiume, lakini mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza ni wa yule mke asiyempenda,
Ekegusii: “Nenyaare koba ng’a omonto nabwate abakungu babere; ere nigo anchete oyomo na bwangete oria onde. Abakungu abwo bonsi babere baiboreire omosacha oyio abana, korende omwana omoisia omotangi nigo are oyo bw’omokuungu oria angete.

English: then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;
Kiswahili: wakati anapotoa wosia wa mali yake kwa wanawe, kamwe asitoe haki za mzaliwa wa kwanza kwa mwana wa mke ampendaye kwa upendeleo, badala ya mzaliwa hasa wa kwanza, ambaye ni mwana wa mke ambaye hampendi.
Ekegusii: Ekero rituko ri’okobariera omwando riraike, omonto oria takoba ne ribaga gwanchereria omomura oye bw’omokuungu oria anchete, na komoa omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi ribaga ri’okomoa oria ore omotangi bori oiboreretwe n’omokuungu atancheti.

English: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima amkubali mwana wa mke asiyempenda kama mzaliwa wa kwanza kwa kumpa sehemu ya vile vyote alivyo navyo maradufu. Mwana huyo ni ishara ya kwanza ya nguvu za baba yake. Haki ya mzaliwa wa kwanza ni yake yeye.
Ekegusii: Goika amoe omomura oye omotangi chinibo ara kabere, nonya ore omwana bw’omokuungu atancheti. Omomura oyio nere omotangi; omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi n’oyoye.

English: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,
Kiswahili: Kama mtu ana mwana mkaidi na mwasi ambaye hamtii baba yake na mama yake, na hasikii wazazi wanapomrudi,
Ekegusii: “Nenyaare koba ng’a omonto nabwate omwana omomura omobe, omoenenu, otari koigwera ise gose ng’ina, nonya bateemire komoa egesusuro ase okomoorongeyia, ere tari kobaigwera.

English: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.
Kiswahili: baba yake na mama yake watamleta kwa wazee kwenye lango la mji wake.
Ekegusii: Ise na ng’ina omwana oyio bamobwate, bamoire ase abagaaka b’omochie agwo ase bakogaambera ebiina geita ki’omochie.

English: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”
Kiswahili: Watawaambia wazee, “Huyu mwanetu ni mkaidi na mwasi. Hatutii sisi, yeye ni mpotovu na mlevi.”
Ekegusii: Agwo bakwane amang’ana aya ase abagaaka baria: Omwana oyo oito nigo are omoenenu, na omosaria, tari gotoigwera, nigo are omoria bobe na gotinda ase okonywa.

English: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.
Kiswahili: Kisha wanaume wote wa mjini mwake watampiga kwa mawe mpaka afe. Ndivyo imewapasa kuondoa maovu kati yenu. Israeli yote itasikia hili na kuogopa.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo abanto bonsi b’omochie oye bamoake amagena goika akwe. Ase enchera eyio morusie obobe borue ase egati yaino. Abaisraeli bonsi kobaraigwe ayio, mbairoke.

English: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,
Kiswahili: Kama mtu ana hatia ya kosa linalompasa kuuawa naye akauawa, mwili wake utaangikwa mtini,
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorire ebibe na koegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa, asungwe ase omote.

English: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God. Don’t defile your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.
Kiswahili: kamwe msiuache mwili wake mtini usiku kucha. Hakikisheni mnauzika mwili wake siku ile ile, kwa sababu kila mtu anayeangikwa mtini yupo chini ya laana ya Mungu. Msiinajisi nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kama urithi wenu.
Ekegusii: Omobere oye totigwa ore ase omote igoro obotuko obogima, korende otindekwe ase rituko erio erio, ekiagera omonto oitirwe ase ogosungwa nigo aragereirie na Nyasae. Timobaisa gotiga ense yaino ebe n’obobe, ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, abaeire ebe omwando oino.

English: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.
Kiswahili: Kama ukimwona ngʼombe au kondoo wa ndugu yako anapotea, usipuuze, bali uhakikishe unamrudisha kwa mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Korarore eng’ombe y’oyomino gose eng’ondi yaye ekogenda gosira, tobaisa koombia buna toyerochi, korende goika oyeiranie gochia ase omonyene.

English: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa huyo ndugu haishi karibu nawe au kama hufahamu yeye ni nani, mchukue nyumbani kwako huyo mnyama umweke mpaka mwenyewe aje kumtafuta. Ndipo umrudishie.
Ekegusii: Onye tamenyeti ang’e naye gose tomomanyeti, goika oyerente bwoo ebeere aroro goika oria omino ache koyerigia, erio omoyee.

English: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.
Kiswahili: Fanya vivyo hivyo ukimkuta punda wa nduguyo au joho lake au chochote alichopoteza. Usipuuze jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo orakore koranyore etigere yaye, gose eanga yaye, gose gento kende gionsi ki’oyomino gesirete; aye kogokenyora tobaisa koombia tomogekoonyera.

English: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.
Kiswahili: Kama ukimwona punda wa nduguyo au ngʼombe wake ameanguka barabarani, usipuuze jambo hilo. Msaidie asimame kwa miguu yake.
Ekegusii: “Koranyore etigere y’oyomino yaguure inse agwo ase enchera, gose eng’ombe yaye, tobaisa koombia oyetige aroro; goika oyegororokie etenene.

English: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Haimpasi mwanamke kuvaa nguo za kiume wala mwanaume kuvaa nguo za kike, kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu anachukia yeyote ambaye hufanya hivi.
Ekegusii: “Omokungu tabaisa kobeeka chianga chi’omosaacha, gose omosacha tabaisa kobeeka echi’omokuungu. Onde bwensi orakore bo, nigo arakore ayaare okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.
Kiswahili: Kama ukikuta kiota cha ndege kando ya barabara, iwe juu ya mti au chini, naye ndege amelala juu ya makinda au mayai, usimchukue huyo ndege pamoja na makinda yake.
Ekegusii: “Keraabe ng’a kwanyoorire egeswa ki’enyoni kere igoro ase omote, gose inse ase riroba, na onyoore enyoni eng’ina eraire igoro ase amage aye, gose ase amagena, tobaisa koira enyoni eria amo n’amage aye.

English: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.
Kiswahili: Waweza kuchukua makinda, lakini uwe na hakika ya kumwacha huyo ndege, ili upate kufanikiwa na uweze kuishi maisha marefu.
Ekegusii: Oire amage oka, korende eng’ina ero oyetige eiruruke egende. Korakore igo n’ebe buya ase ore, naende n’obe moyo ase engaki entambe.

English: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.
Kiswahili: Wakati unapojenga nyumba mpya, fanya ukuta wa kuzuia kandokando ya dari ili usijiletee hatia ya kumwaga damu juu ya nyumba yako ikiwa yeyote ataanguka kutoka humo.
Ekegusii: “Ekero okoagaacha enyomba enyia, goika oagache egetango ase ekerama insinyo, erio nario omonto atagwe korwao akwe; okomocha kw’ogokwa kw’omonto oragwe korwao tigokobarerwa enyomba yao.

English: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.
Kiswahili: Usipande aina mbili za mbegu katika shamba lako la mizabibu; ikiwa utafanya hivyo, si mazao utakayopanda tu yatakuwa najisi, bali nayo matunda ya shamba la mizabibu pia.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosimeka chimbusuro chi’ebisaku bibere ase omogondo oo bw’emesabibu; oise gokora bo okwama kwao gwonsi ogw’echio gwasimegete amo nokw’emesabibu nigo korairwe kobe agwo aase Aachenu.

English: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
Kiswahili: Usilime kwa maksai aliyefungwa nira pamoja na punda.
Ekegusii: “Gokorema, tobaisa gosiberania eng’ombe n’etigere ching’use obokombe amo.

English: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.
Kiswahili: Usivae nguo za sufu na kitani zilizofumwa pamoja.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa kobeeka eanga eroiseranirie chiusi chi’amarionya na echi’egatani amo.

English: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.
Kiswahili: Fanya vishada kwenye pembe nne za joho unalovaa.
Ekegusii: “Okore amasugunia, oyabeeke ase emego ene y’eganchwa yao entambe, eria okwambara.

English: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atamwoa mke na, baada ya kufanya naye tendo la ndoa, akamchukia,
Ekegusii: “Nenyaare koba ng’a omonto onyuomire omokungu bamenyane, na magega y’ayio amwange,

English: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”
Kiswahili: akimsingizia na kumwita jina baya, akisema, “Nilimwoa mwanamke huyu, lakini nilipomkaribia sikupata uthibitisho wa ubikira wake”
Ekegusii: amosoere ase amang’ana y’obonyaka, erio asarie erieta riaye, ogoteeba: Nigo naira omokungu oyo, na ekero naba nere tindoochi ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bwaye.

English: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.
Kiswahili: ndipo baba na mama wa msichana wataleta uthibitisho kwamba alikuwa bikira kwa wazee wa mji kwenye lango.
Ekegusii: “Onye naboigo, ise na ng’ina omoiseke oria bamoire ase abagaaka b’omochie oria, ase bakogaambera agwo ase egeita, baabarentere ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bw’omoiseke oria.

English: The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.
Kiswahili: Baba wa msichana atawaambia wazee, “Nilimwoza binti yangu kwa huyu mwanaume, lakini hampendi.
Ekegusii: Ise omoiseke oria akwane n’abagaaka baria, abateebie: ’Naa omonto oyo omoiseke one abe mokaaye, na bono ere omwangire.

English: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.
Kiswahili: Sasa amemsingizia na kusema, ‘Sikumkuta huyu binti akiwa bikira.’ Lakini hapa kuna uthibitisho wa ubikira wa binti yangu.” Kisha wazazi wake wataonyesha nguo zake kwa wazee wa mji,
Ekegusii: Boigo osoereire omoiseke oyo one na omorenteire obosooku ogoteeba ng’a taroochi ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bwaye. Korende rora aa, egetambaa eke nkebwate ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bwaye. Erio barambore egetambaa keria ase amaiso ’abagaaka b’omochie oria.

English: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.
Kiswahili: nao wazee watamchukua huyo mwanaume na kumwadhibu.
Ekegusii: Erio abagaaka b’omochie oria babwate omosacha oria, bamoake ebiranya.

English: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.
Kiswahili: Watamtoza shekeli mia moja za fedha na kupewa wazazi wa msichana, kwa sababu mwanaume huyu amempa bikira wa Kiisraeli jina baya. Ataendelea kuwa mke wake; kamwe hawezi kumpa talaka siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Naende bamonachere aakane, chitaabu, chisekeli chi’echifeta rigana erimo, amoe ise omoiseke oria, ekiagera osaririe erieta ri’omoiseke omwekungi bw’Abaisraeli. Erio oria agenderere koba mokaaye, na omosacha oye tabaisa komotiga nonya ng’ake ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kama shtaka ni la kweli na hakuna uthibitisho juu ya ubikira wa huyo msichana ulioweza kupatikana,
Ekegusii: “Korende keraabe ng’a namaene ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bw’omoiseke oria tibirorekaneti,

English: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
Kiswahili: huyo msichana ataletwa kwenye mlango wa nyumba ya baba yake, na hapo watu wa mji wake watampiga kwa mawe hadi afe. Amefanya kitu cha aibu katika Israeli kwa kufanya ukahaba akiwa nyumbani kwa babaye. Lazima mwondoe uovu katikati yenu.
Ekegusii: rirorio bamorente ase egesieri ki’enyomba ya ise, na abanto b’omochie bw’omoiseke oria bamoake amagena akwe, ekiagera orentire obosooku ase egati y’Abaisraeli ase ogokora obonyaka ekero atarasoka. Goika morusie obobe borue ase more.

English: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mwanaume atakutwa akizini na mke wa mtu mwingine, wote wawili, mwanaume na mwanamke aliyezini naye, lazima wauawe. Lazima mwondoe uovu katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Omonto omosacha aise konyorekana oraire n’omokuungu bw’omonto onde, bonsi babere, omosacha oria amo n’omokuungu oria, goika baitwe bakwe. Goika morusie obobe borue ase Abaisraeli.

English: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mwanaume atakutana na bikira mjini ambaye ameposwa na mtu akazini naye,
Ekegusii: “Omoiseke omwekungi oriereirwe boko nomonto, karaumerane nomosaacha omoao agwo ase omochie, na omosacha oyio abe nere,

English: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
Kiswahili: utawachukua wote wawili kwenye lango la mji na kuwapiga kwa mawe mpaka wafe; yule msichana kwa kuwa alikuwa mjini na hakupiga kelele kuomba msaada, na yule mwanaume kwa sababu amemtenda jeuri mke wa mtu mwingine. Lazima mwondoe uovu katikati yenu.
Ekegusii: mobasokie bonsi babere, mobaire isiko y’egeita ki’omochie, erio mobaake amagena bakwe. Omoiseke oria aitwe, ekiagera atakuurete akonywe, nonya orenge ase omochie ime, na omosacha oria, ekiagera atomana n’omoiseke oriereirwe boko n’omonto omoao. Goika morusie obobe borue ase more.

English: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa itatokea mwanaume akakutana na msichana aliyeposwa huko mashambani, akambaka, mwanaume aliyefanya hivi peke yake ndiye atakayeuawa.
Ekegusii: “Korende omonto karaumerane n’omoiseke omwekungi oriereirwe boko n’omonto omoao amobwate ne chinguru abe nere agwo ase orosana isiko y’omochie, omonto oria nere bweka oraitwe akwe.

English: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;
Kiswahili: Usimtendee msichana yule jambo lolote; hajafanya dhambi inayostahili kifo. Shauri hili ni kama lile la yeyote ambaye anamshambulia na kumuua kwa makusudi jirani yake,
Ekegusii: Timokorera omoiseke oria ing’ana rinde; ere takorete okomocha kogwenerete aitwe, ekiagera amang’ana ayio nigo anga buna ekero omonto akorwania omonto onde omoao na komoita moeneno.

English: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.
Kiswahili: kwa maana mwanaume huyo alimkuta msichana huko mashambani, na ingawa msichana aliyeposwa alipiga kelele, hapakuwa na mtu wa kumwokoa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo amonyoorete agwo ase orosana, akamorwania ne chinguru. Nonya omoiseke oria okuurete akonywe, monto onde tarengeo okomokoonya.

English: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa itatokea mwanaume akutane na bikira ambaye hajaposwa na kumbaka nao wakakutwa,
Ekegusii: “Omonto karaumerane n’omoiseke omwekungi otararierwa boko, na komobwata ne chinguru, abe nere, nabarabwo babere banyorwe,

English: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.
Kiswahili: mwanaume atamlipa baba wa msichana shekeli hamsini za fedha. Ni lazima amwoe huyo msichana, kwa maana amemfanyia jeuri. Kamwe hawezi kumpa talaka siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: rirorio omonto oria naae ise omoiseke oria chitaabu, chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etano, atwaare omoiseke oria abe mokaaye, ekiagera omosareirie obwekungi bwaye; takoba n’eribaga komotiga ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.
Kiswahili: Mwanaume asimwoe mke wa baba yake; kamwe asidhalilishe kitanda cha baba yake.
Ekegusii: “Omonto tabaisa korara na moga ise, abaise korentera ise obosooku.

English: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
Kiswahili: Asiingie mtu yeyote aliyehasiwa kwa kupondwa makende au kwa kukatwa uume wake katika kusanyiko la Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Omosacha ogombairie, gose ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha kebutogete, tabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano Omonene.

English: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote ambaye amezaliwa kwenye ndoa isiyo halali au wazao wake wasiingie kwenye kusanyiko la Bwana, hata mpaka kizazi cha kumi.
Ekegusii: “Ekerentane, gose omonto bw’ororeeria rw’aye, nonya ngoika ekiaare gia ikomi, tabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano Omonene.

English: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh’s assembly forever,
Kiswahili: Hapatakuwa na Mwamoni au Mmoabu au yeyote wa wazao wao atakayeruhusiwa kuingia katika kusanyiko la Bwana, hata mpaka kizazi cha kumi.
Ekegusii: “Abaamoni, gose Abamoabu, gose ororeeria rwabo, nonya ngoika ekiaare gia ikomi, tibaabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano bw’Omonene nonya ng’ake.

English: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hawakuja kuwalaki wakiwa na mkate na maji mlipokuwa njiani mlipotoka Misri, tena walimwajiri Balaamu mwana wa Beori kutoka Pethori iliyoko Aramu-Naharaimu ili kuwalaani ninyi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibaabarototete na kobarentera endagera na amaache ekero mwarenge ase orogeendo korwa Misiri, naende nigo barangeretie Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, korwa Petori ya Mesopotamia achiche kobaragereria inwe.

English: Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Bwana Mungu wenu hakumsikiliza Balaamu bali aligeuza laana kuwa baraka kwenu kwa sababu Bwana Mungu wenu anawapenda.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Omonene Nyasae oino, taigwerete Baalamu, korende akaonchora okoragereria koria gokaba ogosesenigwa ase more, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo abanchete.

English: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.
Kiswahili: Msitafute mapatano ya urafiki nao maisha yenu yote.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aino onsi more moyo, timobaisa kobarigeria omorembe, gose ogosesenigwa.

English: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.
Kiswahili: Usimchukie Mwedomu, kwa kuwa yeye ni ndugu yako. Usimchukie Mmisri, kwa sababu uliishi kama mgeni katika nchi yake.
Ekegusii: “Timobaisa gochaaya Abaedomu, barabwo n’abanto bamino; gose timobaisa gochaaya Abamisiri, ekiagera inwe agwo kare nao mwarenge abamenyi ase ense yabo.

English: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
Kiswahili: Kizazi cha tatu cha watoto watakaozaliwa nao wanaweza kuingia katika kusanyiko la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ekiaare kia gatato ase ororeeria rwabo, bancherwe basoe ase omosangererekano Omonene.

English: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.
Kiswahili: Unapokuwa umepiga kambi dhidi ya adui zako, jitenge na kitu chochote kisicho safi.
Ekegusii: “Ekero morabe mokogeenda korwania ababisa baino, na momenyete ase egetwori, mwerende mono korwa ase kera egento getachenegeti.

English: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu amechafuka kwa sababu ya kutokwa na shahawa usiku, inampasa atoke nje ya kambi na kukaa huko.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto ase egati yaino obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro botuko, oyio asoke gochia isiko y’egetwori; tabaisa gosoa ime aroro.

English: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.
Kiswahili: Lakini jioni ikikaribia ataoga, na baada ya jua kuzama ataingia tena kambini.
Ekegusii: “Ekero kia mogoroba, esibie omobere n’amaache, na ekero bwairiire kegima asoe ase egetwori.

English: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.
Kiswahili: Tengeni mahali nje ya kambi ambapo mnaweza kwenda kujisaidia.
Ekegusii: “Mochoore aase isiko y’ebitwori ase mogochia gwekonyera.

English: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu ya vifaa vyenu kuweni na kitu cha kulimia, nanyi mnapojisaidia, chimba shimo na kisha funika kile kikutokacho.
Ekegusii: Mobe mokoimokia chinyimbo amo nebirwanero biaino; ekero mogochia rosana agwo isiko y’ebitwori, mokuunye chingoro ne chinyimbo chiria, na ekero mwekonyire motube obonyira n’amaroba.

English: for Yahweh your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu hutembea katika kambi yenu ili kuwalinda na kuwaweka adui zenu mikononi mwenu. Kambi yenu ni lazima iwe takatifu, ili asione kitu chochote miongoni mwenu kilicho kichafu akageuka na kuwaacha.
Ekegusii: Ebitwori biaino goika bibe ebichenu, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo agotaara ase ebitwori biaino, erinde abakoonye, n’abeeke ababisa baino ase amaboko aino. Omonene tabaisa korora obonyinyeru ase more; aise koborora, nigo arabatige.

English: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtumwa amekimbilia kwako, usimrudishe kwa bwana wake.
Ekegusii: “Onye omosomba otamire korwa ase omonene oye, ochire ase more, timobaisa komoirania gochia ase omonene oye naende.

English: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.
Kiswahili: Mwache aishi miongoni mwenu mahali popote anapopapenda na katika mji wowote anaochagua. Usimwonee.
Ekegusii: Motige amenye amo nainwe ase omochie arachoore, oyio oramogookie agwo ase emechie yaino. Timobaisa komokorera bobe.

English: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
Kiswahili: Asiwepo Mwisraeli mwanamke kahaba au mwanaume hanithi wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu.
Ekegusii: “Onde taaba ase Abaisraeli, omokungu gose omosacha, okwebeeka ase obonyaka bwe chie hekalu.

English: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of Yahweh your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Kamwe usilete mapato ya ukahaba ikiwa ni ya mwanamke au ni ya mwanaume katika nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wako kwa ajili ya nadhiri yoyote, kwa sababu Bwana Mungu wako anachukizwa na yote mawili.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa korenta ase enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae oino, chitaabu chikonyorekana korwa ase obonyaka bw’abakuungu, gose obw’abasaacha banga buna chisese, ase ogoikerania chiira. Chibesa chikonyorekana korwa ase chinchera echio nigo chire okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.
Kiswahili: Usimtoze ndugu yako riba, iwe ni fedha ama chakula ama kitu kingine chochote ambacho waweza kupata riba juu yake.
Ekegusii: “Ekero okoa omonto bw’egesaku kiao chitaabu singo, gose endagera, gose gento kende gionsi, tobaisa komoboria ebitoki ekero agokoiraneria egento keria airete singo.

English: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.
Kiswahili: Unaweza kumtoza mgeni riba, lakini siyo nduguyo Mwisraeli, ili kwamba Bwana Mungu wako akubariki katika kila kitu unachoweka mkono katika nchi unayoingia kuimiliki.
Ekegusii: Nonyare gosaba ebitoki korwa ase omonto omomenyi kwaete singo, korende tari korwa ase omonto omino Omoisraeli. Koraigwere amang’ana ayio, rirorio Omonene Nyasae oino, nagosesenie ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.

English: When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for Yahweh your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.
Kiswahili: Ukiweka nadhiri kwa Bwana Mungu wako, usichelewe kuitimiza, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wako atakudai, nawe utakuwa na hatia ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: “Ekero okoria eira ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, goika oikeranie eira eyio. Otayeikeraneti nigo Omonene arakobarere ebibe ebio.

English: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.
Kiswahili: Lakini ukijizuia kuweka nadhiri, hutakuwa na hatia.
Ekegusii: Korende koratige koria eira, tokobarerwa ebibe ase ayio.

English: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.
Kiswahili: Chochote kitakachotamkwa kwa midomo yako ni lazima uhakikishe umekifanya, kwa sababu uliweka nadhiri yako kwa hiari mbele za Bwana Mungu wako kwa kinywa chako mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Orende mono, oikeranie egento gwakwanete n’omonwa oo, ekiagera nigo kwariete eira y’ogwancha ase Omonene, Nyasae oo.

English: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.
Kiswahili: Kama ukiingia katika shamba la mizabibu la jirani yako, unaweza kula zabibu kadiri utakavyo, lakini usiweke chochote kwenye kikapu chako.
Ekegusii: “Ekero ogoeta ase omogondo bw’emesabibu bw’omogisangio oo norie amatunda y’emesabibu goika oigote, korende totwa nonya n’erimo obeeke ase esaaro yao na koriira.

English: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.
Kiswahili: Kama ukiingia katika shamba la nafaka la jirani yako, unaweza kukwanyua kwa mikono yako, lakini usikate kwa mundu nafaka iliyosimama.
Ekegusii: Ekero oraabe kogoeta ase omogondo bw’omogisangio oo ore n’endagera eteneine, notabore ebigara n’okoboko kwao obunge otakune chinyeke, korende tobaisa kogesa n’omoyio oo ore enkuro endagera yaye eteneine.

English: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atamwoa mke na akamchukia kwa sababu ya kukosa adabu, naye akamwandikia hati ya talaka, akampa na kumfukuza kutoka nyumbani kwake,
Ekegusii: “Nenyaare koba ng’a omonto onyuomire omokungu, na magega y’ayio amwange, ekiagera anyorire ring’ana ase are ritamogogeti. Erio amoriikere riruube ri’ogotigana nere, ae omokungu oria na komoseeria korwa bwoye.

English: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.
Kiswahili: ikiwa baada ya kuondoka nyumbani kwake atakuwa mke wa mtu mwingine,
Ekegusii: Naende nenyaare koba ng’a omokungu oyio gatigire omosacha oria, agende anyuomwe n’omosaacha omoao,

English: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;
Kiswahili: ikiwa mume wake wa pili atachukizwa naye akamwandikia hati ya talaka, akampa na kumfukuza kutoka nyumbani kwake, au kama akifa,
Ekegusii: na oyo nere amwange, amoriikere riruube ri’ogotigana, amoseerie korwa bwoye, gose omosacha oyio o kabere akwe.

English: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to Yahweh. You shall not cause the land to sin, which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.
Kiswahili: basi yule mume wake wa kwanza, ambaye alimpa talaka, haruhusiwi kumwoa tena baada ya mwanamke huyo kuwa najisi. Hayo yatakuwa machukizo machoni pa Bwana. Usilete dhambi juu ya nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wako anakupa kama urithi.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio onsi, omosacha oria bw’eritang’ani omoseretie, tabaisa komoirania goocha bwoye abe mokaaye naende, ekiagera omokungu oria obeire oyotachenegeti; okwo nigo kore okogeechia ase obosio bw’Omonene, nainwe timobaisa korenta okomocha kobe ase ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino.

English: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu ameoa karibuni, kamwe asipelekwe vitani au kupewa wajibu mwingine wowote. Kwa mwaka mmoja atakuwa huru kubaki nyumbani ili amfurahishe mke aliyemwoa.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto onyuomire omokungu tageenda ase esegi amo n’abarwani bande, gose taegwa emeremo ende yonsi akorere egesaku, korende nigo araegwe ribaga abeere ’nka bwoye ase omwaka oyomo kogokia mokaaye.

English: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.
Kiswahili: Usitoe jozi ya mawe ya kusagia, hata ikiwa lile la juu, kuweka rehani kwa ajili ya deni, kwa sababu itakuwa ni kuweka uhai wa mtu kama dhamana.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto okoa omonto onde egento singo, taira orogena gose ensio bibe intenenera, ekiagera igo n’obogima bwaye akoira bobe intenenera.

English: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akikamatwa akiiba yeyote miongoni mwa ndugu zake wa Waisraeli na kumtenda kama mtumwa au akimuuza, mwizi huyo ni lazima auawe. Nawe utaondoa uovu kutoka miongoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: “Omonto karanyorekane oibire Omoisraeli omwabo amokore buna omosomba, gose amoonie, omoibi oria goika aitwe akwe. Goika morusie obobe korwa ase more.

English: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.
Kiswahili: Pakitokea magonjwa ya ngozi ya kuambukiza, mwe waangalifu sana kufanya sawasawa na maagizo ya makuhani, ambao ni Walawi. Ni lazima mfuate kwa uangalifu yale niliyowaamuru.
Ekegusii: “Mwerende mono ekero mwarwarire oborwaire bwa ukoma, mokore buna abakuani Abalawi barabateebie.

English: Remember what Yahweh your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni kile Bwana Mungu wenu alichomfanyia Miriamu njiani baada ya ninyi kutoka Misri.
Ekegusii: Ayio onsi inche nabachiigete ng’a babateebie, goika moyakore. Inyora ay’Omonene Nyasae oino, akorerete Miriamu ekero mwarenge ase orogeendo rwaino korwa Misiri.

English: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.
Kiswahili: Unapomkopesha jirani yako chochote, usiingie nyumbani kwake kutwaa kile anachokitoa kama rehani.
Ekegusii: “Ekero okoa omogisangio oo egento kende gionsi singo, tobaisa gosoa ase enyomba yaye koira egento keria abeekire kebe intenenera.

English: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.
Kiswahili: Ukae nje na umwache huyo mtu uliyemkopesha akuletee hiyo rehani.
Ekegusii: Aye otenene isiko y’enyomba yaye, nere akorentere egento abeeka koba intenenera.

English: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu huyo ni maskini, usiende kulala ukiwa na hiyo rehani yake katika milki yako.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oria n’omotaka, tobaisa kogeenda korara n’egento keria kiaye kere bwoo.

English: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Rudisha vazi lake kabla ya machweo ya jua ili apate kulilalia. Kisha atakushukuru na kitaonekana kama kitendo cha haki mbele za Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: “Ekero bogochia koira omoiranerie egetambaa akwambara erinde ebisie, nario aragosesenie, na igo gwakorire ayaare boronge ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo.

English: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.
Kiswahili: Usimwonee mtu maskini na mhitaji ambaye umemwajiri, akiwa ni nduguyo Mwisraeli au mgeni anayeishi katika mojawapo ya miji yenu.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa gokorera bobe omonto omoriikwa ore omotaka na oremeire, karabe omonto omino Omoisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase ense yaino.

English: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to Yahweh, and it be sin to you.
Kiswahili: Mlipe ujira wake kila siku kabla ya jua kutua, kwa sababu yeye ni maskini na anautegemea ujira huo. La sivyo, anaweza kumlilia Bwana dhidi yako, nawe ukapata hatia ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Rituko riria akorire emeremo, omoe eng’eria yaye ritang’ani risase ritaragwa, ekiagera ere n’omotaka, nigo asemeretie konyora eng’eria yaye. Onye tokomoakana nigo arabaise korera ase Omonene igoro yao, naende ayio nigo arabe ebibe ase ore.

English: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
Kiswahili: Baba wasiuawe kwa ajili ya watoto wao, wala watoto wasiuawe kwa ajili ya baba zao; kila mmoja atakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Abaibori tibagoitwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abana babo, gose abana tibagoitwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abaibori babo; korende kera omonto nigo araitwe ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene.

English: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;
Kiswahili: Usipotoshe hukumu ya mgeni au yatima, au kuchukua vazi la mjane kama rehani.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa korina omonto omomenyi, gose entakaana, oboronge bwaye, na toira eanga y’ omoboraka ebe intenenera.

English: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni kwamba mlikuwa watumwa huko Misri, naye Bwana Mungu wenu akawakomboa kutoka huko. Hii ndiyo sababu ninawaamuru kutenda hili.
Ekegusii: Korende moinyore ing’a nainwe ’mwarenge abasomba ase ense ya Misiri, korende Omonene Nyasae oino, akababooria korwa aroro; ase ayio nabachiikire mobwatie amang’ana ayio.

English: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
Kiswahili: Unapovuna shamba lako na ukasahau mganda, usirudi kuuchukua. Acha kwa ajili ya mgeni, yatima na mjane, ili Bwana Mungu wako aweze kukubariki wewe katika kazi zote za mikono yako.
Ekegusii: “Ekero mokogesa chindagera chi’emegondo yaino, na mwebe omosaima bw’endagera mogondo, timobaisa koirana gochia koywoyia, korende moyotige obe oyo bw’omonto omomenyi omenyete ase more, gose oyo bwe chintakana, n’ababoraka, erio nario Omonene Nyasae oino, arasesenie emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora.

English: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
Kiswahili: Unapovuna zeituni kutoka miti yako, usirudie matawi mara ya pili. Acha kilichobaki kwa ajili ya mgeni, yatima na mjane.
Ekegusii: Ekero mwatorire amazeituni aino, timoirana naende gosangereria ase chinsagia aya mwamochete gotora. Moyatigere abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka.

English: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
Kiswahili: Unapochuma zabibu katika shamba lako la mizabibu usirudie tena. Acha zinazobaki kwa ajili ya mgeni, yatima na mjane.
Ekegusii: Ekero mwatorire amasabibu aino, timoirana naende gochia gosangereria ayatigaire, korende moyatigere abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka.

English: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka kwamba mlikuwa watumwa katika nchi ya Misri. Ndiyo sababu ninawaamuru kufanya hili.
Ekegusii: Inyora ng’a inwe nigo mwarenge abasomba ase ense ya Misiri; ase ayio nabachiikire mobwatie amang’ana ayio.

English: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.
Kiswahili: Watu wanapokuwa na ugomvi, wapeleke mahakamani na waamuzi wataamua shauri hilo; watawaachia wasio na kosa na kuwahukumu wenye hatia.
Ekegusii: “Onye abanto babere babwate eriomana ase egati yabo, rirorio bageende ase ekegaambero, erio abagaambi bagaambe ekiina ekio, na oyio ore n’oboronge aegwe oboronge bwaye, na oria ore n’okomocha abarerwe okomocha kwaye.

English: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu mwenye hatia anastahili kuchapwa, mwamuzi atamwamuru alale chini ili achapwe mbele yake idadi ya viboko kulingana na kosa lake,
Ekegusii: Keraabe ng’a oria omomochi nigo agwenerete goakwa ebiranya, omogambi oria amochiike aramame inse agwo ase obosio bwaye na goakwa ebiranya koreng’ana buna okomocha kwaye kore.

English: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.
Kiswahili: lakini kamwe asichapwe zaidi ya viboko arobaini. Ikiwa atachapwa zaidi ya viboko arobaini, nduguyo atadhalilika machoni pako.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio aakwe ebiranya emerongo ene, korende tari goetania ebio; aise kogenderera goakwa goetania, nigo arasookigwe ase obosio bwao. Takoegwa ogoakwa goetania okwo gochiikire.

English: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.
Kiswahili: Usimfunge maksai kinywa anapopura nafaka.
Ekegusii: “Tobaisa kobeekera eng’ombe ekeokio ekero ekoora endagera.

English: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa ndugu wanaishi pamoja na mmoja wao akafa bila kuacha mwana, kamwe mjane wake asiolewe nje ya jamaa hiyo. Ndugu wa mumewe atamchukua, amwoe na kutimiza wajibu wa shemeji kwake.
Ekegusii: “Onye abamura babere ba ise omo bamenyete aase aamo, na oyomo akwe, nere tabwate omwana, omokungu bw’omonto oria takonyuomwa n’omonto bw’eamate eng’ao, korende omomura omwabo omosacha oye nere oratware omokungu oria abe ribaga ria momura omwabo.

English: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa kwanza atakayemzaa atapewa jina la ndugu aliyekufa ili jina lake lisifutike katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: Omwana omoisia omotangi omokungu oria araibore, arokwe erieta ri’oyomwabo ise oria okwete. Erio nario erieta riaye ritabaise gosira korwa ase Abaisraeli.

English: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ikiwa ndugu huyo wa mume hataki kuoa huyo mke wa nduguye, mjane atawaendea wazee kwenye lango la mji na kusema, “Ndugu wa mume wangu anakataa kuendeleza jina la nduguye katika Israeli. Hataki kutimiza wajibu wa shemeji kwangu.”
Ekegusii: Korende onye omonto oria okwanga gotwara moka momura omwabo, rirorio omokungu oria agende ase abagaaka bare agwo ase egeita ki’omochie, akwane amang’ana aya: Omomura omwabo omosacha one bwangire goteneneria oyomwabo egesaku, erinde erieta riaye tirisira korwa ase Abaisraeli.

English: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wazee wa mji wake watamwita na kuzungumza naye. Kama atashikilia kukataa akisema, “Sitaki kumwoa,”
Ekegusii: “Erio abagaaka baria b’omochie barangerie omonto oria, bakwane nere, na karagenderere gokaana ng’a tatageti gotwara omokungu oria,

English: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”
Kiswahili: mjane wa nduguye atamwendea mbele ya wazee, atamvua kiatu kimoja na kumtemea mate usoni, na kusema, “Hivi ndivyo ambavyo hufanywa kwa mtu ambaye atakataa kuendeleza jamaa ya ndugu yake.”
Ekegusii: erio omokungu oria omoboraka aike ang’e ase omomura oria omwabo omosacha oye, asomore egekooroto korwa ase okogoro kw’omonto oria agwo ase amasio y’abagaaka, naende amotwere amate ase obosio bwaye, akwane: Nabo arakorwe omonto onde bwensi okwanga goteneneria omomura omwabo egesaku.

English: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”
Kiswahili: Jamaa ya mtu huyo itafahamika katika Israeli kama Jamaa ya Aliyevuliwa Kiatu.
Ekegusii: Eamate y’omonto oyio emanyekane ase Abaisraeli, buna eamate y’omonto oyio osomoretwe egekooroto korwa ase okogoro kwaye.

English: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa watu wawili wanapigana na mke wa mmoja wao akaja kumwokoa mumewe na yule anayemshambulia, naye mke huyo akifika na kumkamata sehemu za siri,
Ekegusii: “Ekero abasacha babere bakorwana, na omokungu bw’omosaacha oyomo achiche gokoonya omosacha oye, na omokungu oria arambore okoboko abwate ekiimo ki’obosaacha ki’omonto oria onde,

English: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.
Kiswahili: huyo mwanamke utamkata mkono wake. Usimhurumie.
Ekegusii: timororera omokungu oria amaabera; goika mobutore okoboko kwaye.

English: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.
Kiswahili: Usiwe na mawe ya kupimia ya aina mbili katika mkoba wako, moja zito na jingine jepesi.
Ekegusii: “Timobaisa koba n’ebirengo bibere ase chisaaro chiaino, ekemo ekenene na ekende egeke.

English: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.
Kiswahili: Usiwe na vipimo viwili tofauti katika nyumba yako, kimoja kikubwa, kingine kidogo.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gotwara ebimunu bikorenga bibere ase chinyomba chiaino, ekemo ekenene, na ekende egeke.

English: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima uwe na uzito na vipimo sahihi na vya haki, ili upate kuishi maisha marefu katika nchi anayokupa Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Mokorere ebirengo bi’ekeene, naende ebiisaine bi’okomanya oborito na obonge; erio nario amatuko aino arabe amaange ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa.

English: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana Mungu wako humchukia yeyote ambaye hufanya mambo kama haya, yeyote anayetenda kwa udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagokora oborianania buna obwo, nigo bare okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,
Kiswahili: Kumbuka kile Waamaleki walichowatendea mlipokuwa njiani mkitoka Misri.
Ekegusii: “Moinyore aya Abaameleki baabakorerete ekero mwarenge ase orogeendo korwa Misiri.

English: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.
Kiswahili: Wakati mlipokuwa mmechoka na kuishiwa nguvu kwa safari yenu, wakawapiga wale wote waliokuja nyuma. Waamaleki hawakumwogopa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibamoirogete Nyasae. Ase ayio bagaacha, bakabarwania na goita abanto abatigarete magega konya bagoyire na korosa.

English: Therefore it shall be, when Yahweh your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wako atakapokupa pumziko mbali na adui zako wote wanaokuzunguka katika nchi akupayo kuimiliki kuwa urithi, utafutilia mbali kumbukumbu lote la Waamaleki chini ya mbingu. Usisahau!
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, n’ebe ekero Omonene Nyasae oino, abaeire ense eria ebe omwando oino, naende ekero abaeire obotoereru korwa ase ababisa baino bonsi baabaetanaine, goika mosirie Abaameleki bonsi, tibainyorwa nonya ng’ake inse y’erioba. Timobaisa kweba amang’ana ayio.

English: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,
Kiswahili: Mtakapokuwa mmeingia nchi ile ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kama urithi na mtakapokuwa mmeimiliki na kukaa ndani yake,
Ekegusii: “Ekero moraabe mwaikire ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino, na komenyao,

English: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that Yahweh your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
Kiswahili: chukueni baadhi ya mavuno ya kwanza ya yale yote mtakayozalisha kutoka udongo wa nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa na mweke kwenye kapu. Kisha uende mahali ambapo Bwana Mungu wako atapachagua kuwa makao kwa ajili ya Jina lake
Ekegusii: kera oyomo oino, arusie ogotongora gw’okwama kw’endagera aragese korwa ase omogondo bw’ense eria. Erio ayebeeke ase egetonga ime, ayeire goika aase ari’Omonene Nyasae oino, arachoore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye.

English: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to Yahweh your God, that I have come to the land which Yahweh swore to our fathers to give us.”
Kiswahili: na umwambie kuhani atakayekuwepo kwa wakati huo, “Ninatangaza leo kwa Bwana Mungu wako kwamba nimekuja katika nchi ambayo Bwana aliwaapia baba zetu kwamba atatupa.”
Ekegusii: Agende ase Omokuani oyo otenenerete ase engaki eyio, amoteebie: Ase rituko ria reero naorokirie ase Omonene Nyasae oito, ng’a naikire ase ense eye Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaito eira ng’a natoyee.

English: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before Yahweh your God’s altar.
Kiswahili: Kuhani atapokea lile kapu mikononi mwako na kuliweka chini mbele ya madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: “Erio Omokuani arusie egetonga keria korwa ase okoboko kwao akebeeke bosio bw’egesasiimero kia Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.
Kiswahili: Kisha utatangaza mbele za Bwana Mungu wako: “Baba yangu alikuwa Mwaramu aliyekuwa anatangatanga, akaenda Misri pamoja na watu wachache, akaishi huko hadi akawa taifa kubwa, lenye nguvu na watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Oiranerie amang’ana aya okwane ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo: Sokorooria yane nigo arenge Omoaramu, orenge okona‐koong’anyang’anya. Agatirimboka gochia Misiri, akaba omomenyi aroro amo n’abanto baye. Ekero ageendete ase ense eria nigo abwate abanto abake, na aroro agwo bakabucha, bakaba egesaku ekenene, kiarenge n’echinguru, naende kiarenge n’abanto abange.

English: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wamisri walituonea na kututaabisha, wakitufanyisha kazi ngumu.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri bagatokorera bobe, bakaba bagotochaanda na gotokoria emeremo emekong’u.

English: Then we cried to Yahweh, the God of our fathers. Yahweh heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.
Kiswahili: Kisha tulimlilia Bwana, Mungu wa baba zetu, naye Bwana akasikia sauti yetu na akaona huzuni yetu, taabu yetu na mateso yetu.
Ekegusii: Erio tokarera ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaito, atokoonye, nere agatoigwa, akarora emechando yaito, na emeremo emekong’u twarenge gokora, na ogokorerwa bobe gwaito.

English: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akatutoa nchi ya Misri kwa mkono wenye nguvu na ulionyooshwa, pamoja na utisho mkuu, ishara za miujiza na maajabu.
Ekegusii: Omonene agatorusia ase ense ya Misiri n’okoboko kwaye kore n’echinguru koramboire, na ase okoondokia okonene na ebikone na amakumia.

English: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
Kiswahili: Akatuleta mahali hapa akatupa nchi hii, nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali;
Ekegusii: Agatorenta aiga na gotoyea ense eye entenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke.

English: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, Yahweh, have given me.” You shall set it down before Yahweh your God, and worship before Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: nami sasa ninaleta malimbuko ya ardhi ambayo wewe, Ee Bwana, umenipa.” Weka kapu mbele za Bwana Mungu wako na usujudu mbele zake.
Ekegusii: Bono rora, inche narentire ogotongora gwe chindagera chiamire ase riroba ri’ense eye Omonene atoeire. “Erio obeeke egetonga keria inse ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo, na osasiime agwo ase obosio bwaye.

English: You shall rejoice in all the good which Yahweh your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.
Kiswahili: Kisha wewe pamoja na Walawi na wageni wote walioko miongoni mwenu mtafurahi katika vitu vyote vizuri ambavyo Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa pamoja na wa nyumbani mwenu.
Ekegusii: Ogookere ebinto bionsi ebi’Omonene, Nyasae oo, akoeire, aye amo n’eamate yao; boigo Abalawi, na abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino bagooke amo naye.

English: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.
Kiswahili: Wakati utakapokuwa umeshatoa zaka zote za mazao yako katika mwaka wa tatu, ambao ni mwaka wa zaka, utampa Mlawi, mgeni, yatima na mjane, ili waweze kula katika miji yenu na kushiba.
Ekegusii: “Ase omwaka o gatato orue ensemo ya ikomi y’okwama kwao gwe chindagera ase Abalawi, n’abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka, erinde barabwo banyore chindagera chibaisaine barariere agwo ase emechie yaino.

English: You shall say before Yahweh your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.
Kiswahili: Kisha umwambie Bwana Mungu wako: “Nimeondoa katika nyumba yangu ile sehemu iliyowekwa wakfu na nimempa Mlawi, mgeni, yatima na mjane, kulingana na yote uliyoamuru. Sijazihalifu amri zako wala kusahau hata mojawapo.
Ekegusii: Erio okwane amang’ana aya ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo, omoteebie: Inche nabirusirie korwa ase enyomba yane ebinto biatananetwe bibe ebichenu, nabieire Abalawi, n’abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka. Nakorire buna gwanchiigete. Tinsareti gose tinyebeti ogochika konde kwao.

English: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to Yahweh my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.
Kiswahili: Sijala sehemu iliyowekwa wakfu wakati nilipokuwa nikiomboleza, wala sijaondoa mojawapo wakati nilipokuwa najisi, wala sijatoa sehemu yake yoyote kwa wafu. Nimemtii Bwana Mungu wangu; nimefanya kila kitu ulichoniamuru.
Ekegusii: Tinariete ensemo eria ya ikomi ase omoichano, gose tinarusetie korwa ase ensemo eria ekero nareenge ’ntachenegeti gose tinaruete ensemo ende yonsi ya ikomi ase engencho y’abakuure. Nabeire ’ngokoigwera aye Omonene Nyasae one; nakorire amang’ana aria onsi gwanchiigete.

English: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”
Kiswahili: Angalia chini kutoka mbinguni, maskani yako matakatifu, uwabariki watu wako Israeli pamoja na nchi uliyotupa kama ulivyoahidi kwa kiapo kwa baba zetu, nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali.”
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro, ase Obomenyo bwao Obochenu bore, origererie, erinde otorore inse aa; osesenie abanto bao Abaisraeli, osesenie na ense eye gwatoeire buna kwarierete chisokoro chiaito eira, ense entenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke.

English: Today Yahweh your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wako anakuagiza leo kufuata amri hizi na sheria; zishike kwa bidii kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote.
Ekegusii: “Rituko ria rero Omonene, Nyasae oo, ogochiikire oigwere na kobwata amachiiko aya n’emeroberio echiikire. Ase ayio oyarende mono na koyakora n’enkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi.

English: You have declared today that Yahweh is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.
Kiswahili: Umetangaza leo kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu wako na kwamba utafuata njia zake, kwamba utayashika maagizo yake, amri zake na sheria zake nawe utamtii.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria reero kwaorokirie ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae oo, naende ng’a n’obwatie chinchera chiaye chionsi na kobwata emeroberio yaye echiikire, n’amachiiko aye, na aya onsi achiikire, naende ng’a nomoigwere.

English: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana ametangaza leo kwamba ninyi ni taifa lake, hazina yake ya thamani kama alivyoahidi, ili kwamba mpate kuyashika maagizo yake yote.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere okwanire rituko ria reero ng’a, ere buna abarierete eira, inwe nabaanto baye b’ekeene, nere omonyene boigo obachiikire ng’a morende na kobwata amachiiko aye onsi.

English: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to Yahweh your God, as he has spoken.
Kiswahili: Ametangaza kwamba atawaweka juu kuliko mataifa mengine aliyoyafanya katika sifa, kuwa fahari na heshima, na kwamba mtakuwa taifa takatifu kwa Bwana Mungu wenu, kama alivyoahidi.
Ekegusii: N’abakore mobe abanene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi biria atongete; n’abakore momanyekane ase ogotogigwa okuya na ogosikwa, nainwe ’namobe abanto bare abachenu ase Omonene Nyasae oino, buna ere ateebire.”

English: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.
Kiswahili: Mose na wazee wa Israeli wakawaagiza watu: “Yashikeni maagizo haya yote ninayowaagiza leo.
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa arenge n’abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, agachiika abanto erio akabateebia, “Mobwate amachiiko aya onsi nabachiikire ase rituko ria reero.

English: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.
Kiswahili: Mtakapokuwa mmevuka Mto Yordani na kuingia katika nchi awapayo Bwana Mungu wenu, msimamishe mawe makubwa na mkayatie lipu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria moramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, na ekero moraike ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, motenenie amagena amanene, moyaoomeranie.

English: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
Kiswahili: Andikeni juu yake maneno yote ya sheria hii wakati mtakapokuwa mmevuka na kuingia katika nchi awapayo Bwana Mungu wenu, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, kama vile Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, alivyowaahidi.
Ekegusii: Erio moriike ase amagena ayio amang’ana onsi y’ogochika oko. Ekero moraabe mwambokire gochia ng’umbu na gosoa ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, ense eria entenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, abarierete eira ng’a n’abayee,

English: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
Kiswahili: Mtakapokuwa mmevuka Yordani, simamisheni mawe haya juu ya Mlima Ebali, kama ninavyowaagiza leo, mkayatie lipu.
Ekegusii: na komwambokire ng’umbu, buna nabachiikire rituko ria reero, motenenie amagena aria ase egetunwa kia Ebali, erio moyaoomeranie amo n’ekebuuse giechooka.

English: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.
Kiswahili: Huko mjengeeni Bwana Mungu wenu madhabahu, madhabahu ya mawe. Msitumie kifaa chochote cha chuma juu yake.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo moaagachere Omonene Nyasae oino, egesasiimero ki’amagena. Timobaisa gokorera emeremo na gekorero kende gionsi gi’ekioma.

English: You shall build Yahweh your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Jengeni madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wenu kwa mawe ya shambani, na mtoe sadaka za kuteketezwa juu yake kwa Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Egesasiimero keria ki’Omonene Nyasae oino, mokeagachere amagena atabaachiri; na igoro yaye momoruere ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa,

English: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Toeni sadaka za amani juu yake, mkizila na kufurahia mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: morue na ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, mobiriereo na mogooke ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”
Kiswahili: Nanyi mtaandika maneno yote ya sheria hii kwa wazi sana juu ya mawe haya ambayo mmesimamisha.”
Ekegusii: Ase amagena ayio moriike amang’ana onsi y’ogochika oko, arorekane buya kegima.”

English: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose na makuhani, ambao ni Walawi, wakawaambia Israeli wote, “Nyamaza ee Israeli, sikiliza! Sasa umekuwa taifa la Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Musa na abakuani Abalawi bagakwana n’Abaisraeli bonsi, bakabateebia, “Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera, moigwe! Rituko ria reero inwe mwabeire abanto b’Omonene Nyasae oino.

English: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”
Kiswahili: Mtii Bwana Mungu wako, na kufuata amri zake na maagizo ninayokupa leo.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio moigwere Omonene Nyasae oino, n’emeroberio yaye echiikire, na mobwate amachiiko aye, ayio inche ’nkobaa rituko ria reero.”

English: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,
Kiswahili: Siku ile ile Mose akawaagiza watu:
Ekegusii: Musa agachiika abanto ase rituko erio erio, agakwana,

English: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Mtakapovuka Mto Yordani, makabila haya yatasimama juu ya Mlima Gerizimu kubariki watu: Simeoni, Lawi, Yuda, Isakari, Yosefu na Benyamini.
Ekegusii: “Ekero moraabe mwambokire gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, Abasimeoni, na Abalawi, na Abayuda, na Abaisakaru, na Abayusufu, na Ababenjamini, batenene igoro ase egetunwa kia Gerisimu, basesenie abanto.

English: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
Kiswahili: Makabila haya yatasimama juu ya Mlima Ebali kwa kutamka laana: Reubeni, Gadi, Asheri, Zabuloni, Dani na Naftali.
Ekegusii: Na Abareubeni n’Abagadi, n’Abaaseri, n’Abasabuloni, n’Abadani, n’Abanafutali batenene igoro ase egetunwa kia Ebali baragererie abanto.

English: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,
Kiswahili: Nao Walawi watawasomea watu wote wa Israeli kwa sauti kubwa:
Ekegusii: Na Abalawi bakwane amang’ana aya n’eriogi rinene, erinde Abaisraeli bonsi bayaigwe.

English: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu afanyaye sanamu ya kuchonga au mwenye kusubu sanamu, kitu ambacho ni chukizo kwa Bwana, kazi ya mikono ya fundi stadi, na kuisimamisha kwa siri.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oyoraroisie omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, koyotenenia na koyosasiima bobisi, koraabe omogwekano obaachire, gose oyo bw’ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa, eyere emeremo y’omooroisia omong’aini. Okwo n’okogeechia ase Omonene. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu amdharauye baba yake na mama yake.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto ogochaaya ise gose ng’ina. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu asogezaye jiwe la mpaka wa jirani yake.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto ogotumana orobebe rw’omogisangio oye. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu ampotoshaye kipofu njiani.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto ogotantania omonto omouko na komosiria enchera. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu apotoshaye haki ya mgeni, yatima au mjane.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto okorina omomenyi, gose entakaana, gose omotakaanwa, oboronge bwaye. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu akutanaye kimwili na mke wa baba yake, kwa maana anadharau malazi ya baba yake.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraraare na moga ise, ekiagera ayio nokorentera ise obosooku. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu akutanaye kimwili na mnyama yeyote.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraraare n’eng’iti ende yonsi. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu akutanaye kimwili na dada yake, binti wa baba yake au binti wa mama yake.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraraare n’omoiseke omwabo, omoiseke o ise, gose oyo o ng’ina. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu akutanaye kimwili na mama mkwe wake.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraraare na ng’ina biara. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu amuuaye jirani yake kwa siri.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraite omonto onde bobisi. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu apokeaye rushwa ili kumuua mtu asiye na hatia.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraegwe riaaki, erinde agende goita omonto otari na komocha. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe mtu yule ambaye hatashikilia maneno ya sheria hii kwa kuyatekeleza.”
Ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto otari kobwata amang’ana onsi ay’ogochika oko, na koyakora. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

English: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
Kiswahili: Kama ukimtii Bwana Mungu wako kwa bidii na kufuata amri zake zote ninazokupa leo kwa bidii, Bwana Mungu wako atakuweka juu ya mataifa yote katika dunia.
Ekegusii: “Komoramoigwere Omonene Nyasae oino, erinde morende na kobwata amachiiko aye onsi inche nabachiikire ase rituko ria reero, Omonene Nyasae oino, nabakore mobe abanene kobua ebisaku bionsi bire ase ense.

English: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
Kiswahili: Baraka hizi zote zitakuja juu yako na kukupata, kama ukimtii Bwana Mungu wako:
Ekegusii: Komoraigwere eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae oino, rirorio nabae ogosesenigwa oko gwonsi kobe okwaino.

English: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
Kiswahili: Utabarikiwa mjini na utabarikiwa mashambani.
Ekegusii: “Imosesenigwe ase emechie yaino na ase emegondo yaino.

English: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
Kiswahili: Utabarikiwa uzao wa tumbo lako, na mazao ya nchi yako na wanyama wako wachanga wa kufugwa, yaani ndama wa makundi yako ya ngʼombe, na wana-kondoo wa makundi yako.
Ekegusii: “’Ndosesenigwe oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, amo n’okwama kwaino kwe riroba, na okobiara gwe chitugo chiaino chi’echiombe, ne’ching’ondi, ne’chimbori.

English: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.
Kiswahili: Kapu lako na vyombo vyako vya kukandia vitabarikiwa.
Ekegusii: “Nesesenigwe endagera y’ebitonga biaino amo ney’ebituba biaino mogoseera obosie.

English: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
Kiswahili: Utabarikiwa uingiapo na utabarikiwa utokapo.
Ekegusii: “Imosesenigwe ekero mogosoa inka, na ekero mokogeenda isiko.

English: Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.
Kiswahili: Bwana atasababisha adui wainukao dhidi yako kushindwa mbele yako. Watakujia kwa njia moja lakini watakimbia mbele yako kwa njia saba.
Ekegusii: “Omonene nabatige ababisa baino, baria bagoocha kobarwania, babugwe ase amasio aino. Barabwo ’mbaabachere baetere ase enchera eyemo ekero bagoocha kobarwania, korende mbatame korwa ase more baetere chinchera isan’aibere.

English: Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataagiza baraka juu ya ghala zako na juu ya kila kitu utakachogusa kwa mkono wako. Bwana Mungu wako atakubariki katika nchi anayokupa.
Ekegusii: “Omonene ’nachiike ogosesenia kwaye goocha ase more, ase ebiage biaino, na ase emeremo yonsi mogokora; nabasesenie ase ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe eyaino.

English: Yahweh will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and walk in his ways.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakufanya kuwa taifa lake takatifu, kama alivyokuahidi kwa kiapo, kama ukishika maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wako na kwenda katika njia zake.
Ekegusii: “Kamorarende na kobwata amachiiko y’Omonene Nyasae oino, na gotaara ase chinchera chiaye, nabaimokererie igoro mobe abanto abachenu ase are, buna abariereire eira na gotiana.

English: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
Kiswahili: Kisha mataifa yote ya dunia wataona kuwa unaitwa kwa jina la Bwana, nao watakuogopa.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ense ’mbaabarore mogwatorwa ase erieta riaye, erio baabairoke.

English: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakupa kustawi kwa wingi, katika tunda la uzao wa tumbo lako, katika wanyama wachanga wa mifugo yako na katika mazao ya ardhi yako, katika nchi aliyowaapia baba zako kuwapa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabae obotenenku, nabuchie oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, nabuchie ne’chitugo chiaino, naende nabae okwama okonge kwe riroba agwo ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee inwe.

English: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
