Ekegusii: Naki omonto oyomo arakore aseerie abanto elifu eyemo, na abanto babere baseerie abanto chilifu ikomi, onye oria ore egetare kiabo atabaoonetie na kobarua, naende onye Omonene tabatigete?

English: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mwamba wao si kama Mwamba wetu, sawasawa na vile adui zetu wanavyokiri.
Ekegusii: Egetare kiabo tikeri buna Egetare giaito, nonya n’ababisa baito ’mbamanyete amang’ana ayio.

English: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
Kiswahili: Mzabibu wao unatoka kwenye mzabibu wa Sodoma, na kutoka kwenye mashamba ya Gomora. Zabibu zake zimejaa sumu, na vishada vyake vimejaa uchungu.
Ekegusii: Emesabibu yabo nigo ekorwa ase emesabibu ya Sodomu, na korwa ase emegondo ya Gomora; na amasabibu abo nigo are n’obosongo, ebisago biabo nigo bire ebiroro.

English: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
Kiswahili: Mvinyo wao ni sumu ya nyoka, sumu yenye kufisha ya swila.
Ekegusii: Edivai yabo nigo enga buna obosongo bwe ching’iti, na obotindi bwabo buna obosongo obotindi bw’amarubi.

English: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
Kiswahili: “Je, hili sikuliweka akiba na kulifungia kwenye vyumba vyangu vya hazina?
Ekegusii: “Omonene nigo akoboria: Inee! Amang’ana aya tagachiri ase ’nde? Tabeekiri ekemanyererio ase ekungo yane?

English: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”
Kiswahili: Ni juu yangu kulipiza kisasi; nitalipiza. Wakati utakapowadia, mguu wao utateleza; siku yao ya maafa ni karibu, na maangamizo yao yanawajia haraka.”
Ekegusii: Egesiomba n’ekiane, ninche ’ndaakane, kegachire goika amagoro abo atererigwe, ekiagera rituko ri’emechando yabo riaikire ang’e, na ogosirigwa kwabo nigo kogoocha bwango.

English: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.
Kiswahili: Bwana atawahukumu watu wake, na kuwahurumia watumishi wake atakapoona nguvu zao zimekwisha wala hakuna yeyote aliyebaki, mtumwa au aliye huru.
Ekegusii: Omonene nanachere abanto baye ekiina kia boronge, na arorere abasomba baye amaabera, ekero ararore ng’a chinguru chiabo chiaerire, naende onde tatigareti, omosomba gose omobiare.

English: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
Kiswahili: Atasema: “Sasa iko wapi miungu yao, mwamba walioukimbilia,
Ekegusii: Erio naborie: Ng’ai chinyasae chiabo chire? Egetare ekio basemeretie na kogetamera, ng’ai kere?

English: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.
Kiswahili: miungu wale waliokula mafuta ya dhabihu zao na kunywa mvinyo wa sadaka zao za vinywaji? Wainuke basi, wawasaidie! Wawapeni basi ulinzi!
Ekegusii: Chinyasae echio chiariete ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso biabo, na konywa okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa bi’edivai, ng’ai chire? Tiga chichiche erio chibakonye na kobarenda.

English: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
Kiswahili: “Tazama basi, Mimi mwenyewe, Mimi Ndiye! Hakuna mungu mwingine ila Mimi. Mimi ninaua na Mimi ninafufua, Mimi nimejeruhi na Mimi nitaponya, wala hakuna awezaye kuokoa kutoka mkononi mwangu.
Ekegusii: “Rora bono, inche ninche bweka Nyasae, onde tari otatiga inche bweka. Ninche ’ngoita, naende nairania obogima, ninche ’ngoaka, naende nagwenia. Onde tari oranyaare kwerwanerera ekonye korwa ase okoboko kwane.

English: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
Kiswahili: Ninainua mkono wangu kuelekea mbinguni na kusema: Hakika kama niishivyo milele,
Ekegusii: Inche ninche ’nkoimokia amaboko ane gochia igoro, natiana na goteeba: Buna inche inde moyo kare na kare.

English: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
Kiswahili: wakati ninapounoa upanga wangu unaometameta na mkono wangu unapoushika ili kutoa hukumu, nitalipiza kisasi juu ya adui zangu na kuwalipiza wale wanaonichukia.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’ngotieria omoro one okomesa, n’okoboko kwane kwanacha ekiina. Nindusie egesiomba igoro ase ababisa bane, ning’akane baria bonsi bangeechete.

English: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”
Kiswahili: Nitailevya mishale yangu kwa damu, wakati upanga wangu ukitafuna nyama: damu ya waliochinjwa pamoja na mateka, vichwa vya viongozi wa adui.”
Ekegusii: Nintindie chinsara chiane n’amanyinga, omoro one oite abanto, oigote chinyama chi’abwo baitirwe, na amanyinga yabooswa na emetwe y’abatang’ani b’ababisa.

English: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.
Kiswahili: Furahini, enyi mataifa, pamoja na watu wake, kwa kuwa atailipiza damu ya watumishi wake, atalipiza kisasi juu ya adui zake na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya nchi na watu wake.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto b’ebisaku, goka amo n’abanto b’Omonene; ekiagera orusirie egesiomba ki’amanyinga y’abasomba baye; orusirie egesiomba igoro ase ababisa baye, okorire okobwatania ase ense yaye na ase abanto baye.”

English: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
Kiswahili: Mose na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni wakaja, wakanena maneno yote ya wimbo watu wakiwa wanasikia.
Ekegusii: Musa ekero arenge na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, agacha agakwana amang’ana onsi y’ogoteera okwo, ekero abanto bategererete.

English: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.
Kiswahili: Mose alipomaliza kuyasoma maneno haya yote kwa Israeli wote,
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana amang’ana ayio ase Abaisraeli bonsi,

English: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
Kiswahili: akawaambia, “Yawekeni moyoni maneno yote ambayo nimewatangazia kwa makini siku hii ya leo, ili kwamba mpate kuwaagiza watoto wenu wayatii kwa bidii maneno yote ya sheria hii.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Renda na koigwera amang’ana onsi aya nabeekire abe kirori ase more ase rituko ria reero, mochiike abana baino babwate na gokora amang’ana onsi y’amachiiko ayio.

English: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
Kiswahili: Siyo maneno matupu tu kwenu, bali ni uzima wenu. Kwa hayo mtaishi maisha marefu katika nchi mnayovuka Yordani kuimiliki.”
Ekegusii: Ayio tari amang’ana abosa ase more, naro obogima bwaino; na ase okoigwera amang’ana aya ’namogenderere komenya engaki entambe ase ense eyio mogochia koira ng’umbu ya Yorodani.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Moses that same day, saying,
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo hiyo Bwana akamwambia Mose,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio eri’Omonene agateebia Musa,

English: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
Kiswahili: “Kwea katika mapangano ya Mlima Abarimu hadi kilima cha Nebo kilichoko Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yeriko, na uitazame Kanaani, nchi ninayowapa Waisraeli kama milki yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa bi’Abarimu, ase egetunwa kia Nebo, kere ase ense ya Moabu, kororia Yeriko, erio origererie ense ya Kaanani eyio ingochia koa Abaisraeli ebe eyabo.

English: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;
Kiswahili: Utafia kwenye mlima huo unaokwea na kukusanyika pamoja na watu wako, kama ndugu yako Aroni alivyofia juu ya Mlima Hori naye akakusanyika kwa watu wake.
Ekegusii: Aye nokwere ase egetunwa ekio ase ogotiira gochia, osangererekane amo n’abanto bao, buna Aroni momura omino akwerete ase egetunwa kia Hori, akabwatia abanto baye,

English: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hii ni kwa sababu ninyi wawili mlivunja uaminifu nami mbele ya Waisraeli kwenye maji ya Meriba-Kadeshi katika Jangwa la Sini, na kwa sababu hamkuuinua utakatifu wangu miongoni mwa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: ekiagera timwabeete abeegenwa ase ’nde ase egati y’Abaisraeli agwo ase amaache a Meriba‐Kadeshi, ase erooro ya Sini. Timwansigete na kworokia Abaisraeli ng’a inche nigo inde omochenu.

English: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, utaiona tu nchi kwa mbali; wewe hutaingia nchi ninayowapa watu wa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nonyare korora ense eria ere bosio bwao, korende tokonyaara kogeenda aroro na gosoa ase ense eria ’ngochia koa Abaisraeli.”

English: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo baraka Mose mtu wa Mungu aliyotamka kwa Waisraeli kabla ya kifo chake.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosesenia Musa, omonto o Nyasae, asesenetie Abaisraeli ekero konya atarakwa.

English: He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.
Kiswahili: Alisema: “Bwana alikuja kutoka Mlima Sinai, akachomoza kama jua juu yao kutoka Mlima Seiri, akaangaza kutoka Mlima Parani. Alikuja pamoja na watakatifu makumi elfu kutoka kusini, kutoka materemko ya mlima wake.
Ekegusii: Akabora: “Omonene agacha korwa Sinai, akabamorekera korwa Edomu, akabara buna risase korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani; agacha ore amo n’abachenu chilifu ikomi, ogochika kore buna chinsase chi’omorero gokabaachera korwa ase ensemo yaye y’okorio.

English: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
Kiswahili: Hakika ni wewe ambaye huwapenda watu, watakatifu wako wote wamo mkononi mwako. Miguuni pako wote wanasujudu na kutoka kwako wanapokea mafundisho,
Ekegusii: Amaene, nigo anchete abanto b’ebisaku bionsi; abachenu baye bonsi nigo bare ase oborendi bw’okoboko kwaye. Barabwo nigo baikaraansete inse ase amagoro yo Omonene, borokererigwe amang’ana aye.

English: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
Kiswahili: sheria ile Mose aliyotupa sisi, tulio milki ya kusanyiko la Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Musa agatoa amachiiko, ayio are omwando bw’omosangererekano bw’ abanto ba Yakobo.

English: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa mfalme juu ya Yeshuruni wakati viongozi wa watu walipokusanyika, pamoja na makabila ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaba omorwoti o Yesuruni ekero abatang’ani b’ abanto basangererekanete amo n’abanto b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.”

English: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”
Kiswahili: “Reubeni na aishi, asife, wala watu wake wasiwe wachache.”
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana: “Tiga Abareubeni bagenderere koba moyo, tibaabaisa gokwa, nonya abanto abwo bare abake.”

English: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, Yahweh, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”
Kiswahili: Akasema hili kuhusu Yuda: “Ee Bwana, sikia kilio cha Yuda, mlete kwa watu wake. Kwa mikono yake mwenyewe hujitetea. Naam, uwe msaada wake dhidi ya adui zake!”
Ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abayuda: “Aye Omonene, igwa okorera kw’Abayuda, obairanie naende babe amo n’abanto bamwabo. Berwanerere boka n’amaboko abo, obakonye ekero ababisa baabo bakobarwania.”

English: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Lawi alisema: “Thumimu yako na Urimu yako ulimpa, mtu yule uliyemfadhili. Ulimjaribu huko Masa na kushindana naye kwenye maji ya Meriba.
Ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abalawi: “Omonene, obamaanorere babe nobomanyi goetera ase Tumimu na Urimu, ekiagera barabwo nabeegenwa bao bare. Aye’ nkwabateemete aria Masa. ’Nkwaamereranetie nabarabwo ase amaache a Meriba.

English: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.
Kiswahili: Alinena hivi kuhusu baba yake na mama yake, ‘Mimi siwahitaji kamwe.’ Akawasahau jamaa zake, asiwatambue hata watoto wake, lakini akaliangalia neno lako na kulilinda Agano lako.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakwanete igoro y’abaise na abaang’ina, ng’a tibaabarooche, bagatigana n’abaamwabo, gose tibaabarete abana babo ng’a ’mbare nengeencho ase bare, ekiagera baigwete ring’ana ria’o, bakabwata okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwakorete na barabwo.

English: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.
Kiswahili: Humfundisha Yakobo mausia yako na Israeli sheria yako. Hufukiza uvumba mbele zako na sadaka nzima za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu yako.
Ekegusii: Barabwo ’mborokererie Abayakobo emeroberio yao echiikire na Abaisraeli amachiiko ao, ’mbarente ubani ase obosio bwao, naende ’mbasambere ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase egesasiimero kiao.

English: Yahweh, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, bariki ustadi wake wote, nawe upendezwe na kazi ya mikono yake. Vipige viuno vya wale wainukao dhidi yake; wapige adui zake hata wasiinuke tena.”
Ekegusii: Omonene, obasesenie amo nebi bionsi babwate, bwanche emeremo eria bagokora, obune chibachwa chi’ababisa baabo baria bagoocha kobarwania, baria baabageechete, tibaabaisa goocha kobarwania naende.”

English: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Benyamini akasema: “Mwache mpenzi wa Bwana apumzike salama kwake, kwa maana humkinga mchana kutwa, na yule Bwana ampendaye hupumzika kati ya mabega yake.”
Ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Ababenjamini: “Aba n’abanchwa ba Omonene, ’mbamenye inse y’oborendi bwaye bare n’obotoereru, Omonene nabagitere abaetanane botambe, barabwo mbamenye ase amareko aye.”

English: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by Yahweh, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Yosefu akasema: “Bwana na aibariki nchi yake kwa umande wa thamani kutoka mbinguni juu, na vilindi vya maji vilivyotulia chini;
Ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abayusufu: “Ogosesenigwa kw’Omonene kobe ase riroba riabo, abae ebiegwa ebiya bikorwa igoro, abae obotooru na ebinto ebiya bire ase riroba ime,

English: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,
Kiswahili: pamoja na vitu vilivyo bora sana viletwavyo na jua, na vitu vizuri sana vinavyoweza kutolewa na mwezi;
Ekegusii: abae amatunda amaya y’okwama kw’omobaso, abae okwama okonge kw’emetienyi.

English: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,
Kiswahili: pamoja na zawadi bora sana za milima ya zamani na kwa wingi wa baraka za vilima vya milele;
Ekegusii: Asesenie ebigoro bia kare bitubwe n’obonge bw’okwama okuya, n’ebitunwa bireo botambe, birue okwama okonge boigo.

English: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.
Kiswahili: pamoja na baraka nzuri mno za ardhi na ukamilifu wake, na upendeleo wake yeye aliyeishi kwenye kichaka kilichokuwa kinawaka moto. Hivi vyote na vikae juu ya kichwa cha Yosefu, juu ya paji la uso la aliye mkuu miongoni mwa ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Abae ebinto ebiya korwa ase riroba, na ebiichire ime yaye, amo n’ogwancherwa gokorwa ase are ere oyobweorokereretie ase egetutu keria. Ogosesenigwa okwo kobe igoro y’Abayusufu, ekiagera Yusufu nigo achooretwe akaba omogambi ase egati y’abaamwabo.

English: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”
Kiswahili: Katika fahari yeye ni kama fahali mzaliwa wa kwanza; pembe zake ni pembe za nyati, na kwa pembe hizo atapiga mataifa, hata yaliyo miisho ya dunia. Hivyo ndivyo yalivyo makumi elfu ya Efraimu; hivyo ndivyo yalivyo maelfu ya Manase.”
Ekegusii: Omotangi oye nigo are n’obonene bw’echinguru buna chieeri, ne ching’unchara chiaye nigo chire buna echi’eng’era, ase chirochio naseerie abanto goikera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense. Echio nachio chilifu ikomi chi’Abaefraimu, naende echio nachio chilifu chinyinge chi’Abamanase.”

English: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Zabuloni akasema: “Shangilia, Zabuloni, wakati wa kutoka nje, nawe Isakari, katika mahema yako.
Ekegusii: Musa agakwana igoro y’Abasabuloni: “Inwe Abasabuloni, mogooke ekero mogosooka isiko, nainwe Abaisakaru, mogooke ase chiema chiaino ime.

English: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”
Kiswahili: Watawaita mataifa kwenye mlima, na huko mtatoa dhabihu za haki; watajifurahisha kwa wingi uliojaza bahari, kwa hazina zilizofichwa mchangani.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbarangerie abanto b’ebisaku bachiche ase egetunwa kiabo, aroro agwo ’nabarue ebing’wanso ebironge, ekiagera nigo bakonyora obotenenku bwabo korwa ase chinyancha ase chinibo chibisekanete ime y’omokenye.”

English: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Gadi akasema: “Atabarikiwa yeye aongezaye milki ya Gadi! Gadi huishi huko kama simba, akirarua kwenye mkono au kichwa.
Ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abagadi: “Omonene abakwe, oria okogareyia orogongo rw’Abagadi. Abagadi nigo barabe bakoramama inse buna endo, batandora okoboko amo n’ekeore ki’omotwe.

English: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of Yahweh, His ordinances with Israel.”
Kiswahili: Alijichagulia nchi nzuri kuliko zote kwa ajili yake mwenyewe; fungu la kiongozi lilikuwa limehifadhiwa kwa ajili yake. Viongozi wa watu walipokusanyika, alitimiza haki ya mapenzi ya Bwana, na hukumu zake kuhusu Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Bageechoorera abanyene orogongo rwarenge oruya, ekiagera agwo nao egetari ki’omogaambi kiagachetwe. Bakaba amo n’abataang’ani b’ abanto, bakaba bagokora oboronge bw’Omonene na konacha ebiina bi’ekeene ase Abaisraeli.”

English: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Dani akasema: “Dani ni mwana simba, akiruka kutoka Bashani.”
Ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abadani: “Abadani nigo banga buna endo ensae egocharoka korwa Basani.”

English: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Naftali akasema: “Naftali amejaa tele upendeleo wa Bwana, naye amejaa baraka yake; atarithi magharibi na kusini.”
Ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abanafutali: “Inwe Abanafutali nigo mwanyorire ogwancherwa okonge na ogosesenigwa kw’ogoisaneka korwa ase Omonene, moire orogongo rore ase enyancha ensemo ya Irianyi,”

English: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Asheri akasema: “Aliyebarikiwa zaidi sana katika wana ni Asheri; yeye na apate upendeleo kwa ndugu zake, yeye na anawe miguu yake kwenye mafuta.
Ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abaaseri: “Abaaseri basesenigwe kobua ebisaku binde. Tiga barabwo banchwe n’abaamwabo; amagoro abo atache riroba rikomera amazeituni.

English: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
Kiswahili: Makomeo ya malango yako yawe chuma na shaba, nazo nguvu zako zitakuwa sawa na siku zako.
Ekegusii: Emekorogoto y’ebiita biaino ebe ey’ebioma ne chitaai, na buna amatuko aino arabe, naboigo ne chinguru chiaino chiraabe.

English: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mwingine kama Mungu wa Yeshuruni, ambaye hupanda juu ya mbingu ili akusaidie, na juu ya mawingu katika utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yesuruni, onde tari ore buna Nyasae oo, oria ogoeta igoro gati ase obonene bwaye goocha kogokoonya.

English: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
Kiswahili: Mungu wa milele ni kimbilio lako, na chini kuna mikono ya milele. Atamfukuza adui yako mbele yako, akisema, ‘Mwangamize yeye!’
Ekegusii: Nyasae o kare na kare nere ore obotamero bwaino; Inse aa nao amaboko aye a kare na kare are kogaamba. Naseerie ababisa baino korwa ase more, abateebie inwe: Basirie!

English: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Israeli ataishi salama peke yake. Mzao wa Yakobo ni salama katika nchi ya nafaka na divai mpya, mahali ambapo mbingu hudondosha umande.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli nigo baramenye batari n’obwoba, na ororeeria rorwete ase Yakobo nigo roramenye ase obotoereru, ase ense eichire endagera n’edivai ase riime rigotonya korwa igoro.

English: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
Kiswahili: Ee Israeli, wewe umebarikiwa! Ni nani kama wewe, taifa lililookolewa na Bwana? Yeye ni ngao yako na msaada wako, na upanga wako uliotukuka. Adui zako watatetemeka mbele yako, nawe utapakanyaga mahali pao pa juu.”
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, imosesenirie! Inwe n’abanto mwatoorigwe n’Omonene. Nere enguba yaino ekobakengera; Nere omoro oino okobarentera obobui! Ababisa baino ’mbebeeke inse ase more, nainwe motaare goetera ase ebigoro biabo.”

English: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,
Kiswahili: Kisha Mose akaupanda mlima Nebo kutoka tambarare za Moabu mpaka kilele cha Pisga, ngʼambo ya Yeriko. Huko Bwana akamwonyesha nchi yote: kutoka Gileadi mpaka Dani,
Ekegusii: Musa akarua emieya ya Moabu, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa kia Nebo igoro ase egechuuria gia Pisiga, kororia Yeriko. Omonene akamworokia ense eria yonsi, ense ya Gileadi goika orogongo rwa Dani,

English: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,
Kiswahili: Naftali yote, nchi ya Efraimu na Manase, nchi yote ya Yuda mpaka bahari ya magharibi,
Ekegusii: na orogongo rwonsi rwa Nafutali, na orwa Efraimu, na orwa Manase, na orwa Yuda rwonsi goika Enyancha Enene ya bosongo,

English: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.
Kiswahili: Negebu na nchi yote kuanzia Bonde la Yeriko, Mji wa Mitende, hadi Soari.
Ekegusii: na Negebu, na ense omweya ya Yeriko, Omochie bw’Emekendo, na goika Soari.

English: Yahweh said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Hii ndiyo nchi niliyomwahidi Abrahamu na Isaki na Yakobo kwa kiapo niliposema, ‘Nitawapa wazao wako.’ Nimekuruhusu uione kwa macho yako, lakini hutavuka kuingia.”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoteebia Musa, “Eye nero ense eria narierete Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a ning’ee ororeeria rwabo ebe eyabo. Inche nigo nakoeire ribaga oyerore namaiso ao, korende tokonyaara kwamboka gochia aroro.”

English: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.
Kiswahili: Naye Mose mtumishi wa Bwana akafa huko Moabu, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, agakwera agwo ase ense ya Moabu, buna Omonene ateebete.

English: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.
Kiswahili: Mungu akamzika huko Moabu, katika bonde mkabala na Beth-Peori, lakini hakuna ajuaye kaburi lake lilipo mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamotindeka agwo ase rikura ri’ense ya Moabu kororia Beti‐Peori; korende goika reero iga monto onde tari omanyete embeera yaye.

English: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
Kiswahili: Mose alikuwa na umri wa miaka mia moja na ishirini alipofariki; hata hivyo nguvu ya macho yake haikufifia wala mwili wake haukudhoofika.
Ekegusii: Musa ekero akwete konya omenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na merongo ebere, korende amaiso aye konya tarasareka, gose chinguru chiaye konya tichiramoerera

English: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakaomboleza kwa ajili ya Mose kwenye tambarare za Moabu kwa siku thelathini, mpaka wakati wa kulia na kuomboleza ulipopita.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamoreera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato agwo ase emieya ya Moabu, na magega y’ayio amatuko okomoreera na kobokia amagombo ase engencho yaye akaera.

English: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Basi Yoshua mwana wa Nuni alijazwa roho ya hekima kwa sababu Mose alikuwa ameweka mikono yake juu yake. Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakamsikiliza na wakafanya yale ambayo Bwana alikuwa amemwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, nigo aichire n’Omoika bw’obong’aini, ekiagera Musa konya omobeekeire amaboko aye na Abaisraeli bakaba bakomoigwera, bagakora buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati huo, katika Israeli hajainuka nabii mwingine kama Mose, ambaye Bwana alimjua uso kwa uso,
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio mobani onde tana gotooka ase Abaisraeli onga buna Musa, oyi’Omonene arenge gokwana nere obosio ase obosio.

English: in all the signs and the wonders which Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
Kiswahili: aliyetenda ishara zote zile za miujiza na maajabu ambayo Bwana alimtuma kuyatenda huko Misri, yaani kwa Farao na maafisa wake wote na nchi yake yote.
Ekegusii: Onde tana gotooka okorete ebikone buna ebi Omonene atomete Musa kobikora ase ense ya Misiri, na ase Farao amo n’abasomba baye, na ense yaye yonsi.

English: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote aliyewahi kuonyesha nguvu nyingi ama kutenda matendo ya kutisha ambayo Mose aliwahi kuyafanya mbele ya Israeli yote.
Ekegusii: Mobani onde tari okorete ogokora gwe chinguru chinene, na ogokora okonene, na gw’okoondokia okwo Musa aorogetie ase amaiso y’Abaisraeli bonsi.

English: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,
Kiswahili: Baada ya kifo cha Mose mtumishi wa Bwana, Bwana akamwambia Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, msaidizi wa Mose:
Ekegusii: Ekero Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya akuure, Omonene agakwana na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, oyio orenge omokonyi o Musa,

English: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Mtumishi wangu Mose amekufa. Sasa basi, wewe pamoja na watu wote hawa, jiandaeni kuvuka huu Mto Yordani kuingia nchi ambayo karibu nitawapa wana wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Musa, omosomba one, okuure. Imoka, bwamboke orooche oro rwa Yorodani, aye na Abaisraeli aba bonsi, mosoe ase ense eria ngochia kobaa.

English: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.
Kiswahili: Kila mahali nyayo za miguu yenu zitakapokanyaga nimewapa, kama vile nilivyomwahidi Mose.
Ekegusii: Nabaeire aase onsi morataare namagoro aino, buna narierete Musa eira ng’a nimbayee.

English: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.
Kiswahili: Nchi yenu itaenea kuanzia jangwa hili hadi Lebanoni, tena kuanzia mto mkubwa wa Frati, yaani nchi yote ya Wahiti, hadi Bahari ile Kubwa iliyoko upande wa magharibi.
Ekegusii: Orogongo rwaino nigo rorachaakere erooro ya Irianyi, roikere Lebanoni ensemo ya sugusu, naende rochakeere orooche oronene rw’Eufarati, robwateranie ense yonsi y’Abahiti roikere Enyancha Enene ya bosongo.

English: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote atakayeweza kushindana na wewe siku zote za maisha yako. Kama vile nilivyokuwa pamoja na Mose, ndivyo nitakavyokuwa pamoja na wewe, sitakuacha wala sitakupungukia.
Ekegusii: Ase obogima bwao bwonsi, omonto tari orakobue. Buna narenge amo na Musa, nimbe amo naye botambe, tinkogotiga nonya ng’ake.

English: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
Kiswahili: “Uwe hodari na shujaa, kwa sababu wewe ndiwe utakayewaongoza watu hawa kuirithi nchi niliyowaapia baba zao kuwapa.
Ekegusii: Obe omokong’u na omoremu, ekiagera naye oraikie abanto aba, baire ense eyio narierete chisokoro chiabo eira na gotiana ng’a nimbayee.

English: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.
Kiswahili: Uwe hodari na uwe na ushujaa mwingi. Uwe na bidii kutii sheria yote aliyokupa Mose mtumishi wangu, usiiache kwa kugeuka kuelekea kuume au kushoto, ili upate kufanikiwa popote uendako.
Ekegusii: Otenene bokong’u rioka, na obe omoremu! Orende na obwate boronge amachiiko onsi aya omosomba one Musa agochigete. Tobaisa koyatiga, na koonchoka gochia aande onsi ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee; erio nario orasesenigwe aande onsi ase ogochia.

English: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
Kiswahili: Usiache Kitabu hiki cha Sheria kiondoke kinywani mwako; yatafakari maneno yake usiku na mchana, ili upate kuwa mwangalifu kufanya kila kitu sawasawa na yote yaliyoandikwa ndani yake. Ndipo utakapofanikiwa na kisha utastawi.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana y’egetabu eke ki’amachiiko oyakwane botambe nomonwa oo, oyairanerere omobaso na obotuko, obwate na okore onsi ayarikireo. Erio nario orasesenigwe mono ase chinchera chiao chionsi na kogenderera.

English: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
Kiswahili: Je, si mimi niliyekuamuru? Uwe hodari na shujaa. Usihofu wala usivunjike moyo, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wako atakuwa pamoja nawe kokote uendako.”
Ekegusii: Inee! Tari inche nagochikiire ng’a otenene bokung’u, obe omoremu? Ase ayio, toondoka, tobaisa gokwa omoyo, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oo, nigo inde amo naye aande onsi orabe gokogenda.”

English: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawaagiza maafisa wa watu akisema,
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agachiika abatang’ani b’abaanto

English: “Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.’”
Kiswahili: “Pitieni katika kambi yote mkawaambie watu, ‘Wekeni tayari mahitaji yenu. Siku tatu kuanzia sasa mtavuka hii Yordani ili kuingia na kuimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa iwe yenu wenyewe.’ ”
Ekegusii: ng’a baete egati y’ebitwori bachiike abanto ng’a beroiserie endagera, ekiagera ritang’ani amatuko atato ataraera inabamboke orooche oro rwa Yorodani, baire ense eyi’Omonene, Nyasae obo, abaeire ebe eyabo.

English: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase, Yoshua akasema,
Ekegusii: Yoshua agateebia abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase,

English: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, saying, ‘Yahweh your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.
Kiswahili: “Kumbukeni agizo lile Mose mtumishi wa Bwana alilowapa: ‘Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa ninyi raha, naye amewapa nchi hii.’
Ekegusii: “Inyora ring’ana riria Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abachigete ekero abateebeetie ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabae obotoereru ase ense eyio arabae momenye.

English: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them
Kiswahili: Wake zenu, watoto wenu na mifugo yenu watakaa katika nchi ile Mose aliyowapa mashariki ya Yordani, lakini mashujaa wenu wote, wakiwa wamevikwa silaha kikamilifu lazima wavuke mbele ya ndugu zenu. Imewapasa kuwasaidia ndugu zenu hadi
Ekegusii: Abakungu baino na abana baino nabatigare, amo namaicho aino, ase ense eye Musa abaete ng’umbu ya Yorodani. Inwe abanyene abamore chituoni chi’esegi goika mwamboke mobogoretie ebirwanero biaino, motang’ane abamino.

English: until Yahweh has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which Yahweh your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”
Kiswahili: Bwana awape nao raha, kama alivyokwisha kufanya kwa ajili yenu hadi wao pia watakapokuwa wamemiliki nchi ile Bwana Mungu wenu anayowapa. Baada ya hilo, mwaweza kurudi na kukalia nchi yenu wenyewe, ambayo Mose mtumishi wa Bwana aliwapa mashariki mwa Yordani kuelekea linakochomoza jua.”
Ekegusii: Mobakoonye goika Omonene abae barabwo obotoereru, buna abaete inwe, nabarabwo mbaire ense eyi’Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabae. Erio momanye koirana ase ense yaino, eye Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete ng’umbu ya Yorodani.”

English: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakamjibu Yoshua, “Chochote ambacho umetuagiza tutafanya na popote utakapotutuma tutakwenda.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria Yoshua, “Onsi ayagwatochikiire natoyakore, na aase aande onsi oratotome natogende.

English: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may Yahweh your God be with you, as he was with Moses.
Kiswahili: Kama vile tulivyomtii Mose kikamilifu, ndivyo tutakavyokutii wewe. Bwana Mungu wako na awe pamoja nawe tu kama vile alivyokuwa pamoja na Mose.
Ekegusii: Buna tware koigwera Musa, naye natokoigwere. Omonene, Nyasae oo, abe amo naye buna abeete na Musa.

English: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”
Kiswahili: Yeyote atakayeasi neno lako na kuacha kuyatii maneno yako, au chochote utakachowaamuru, atauawa. Uwe imara na hodari tu!”
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amachiiko ao na taigwa amang’ana ande onsi orachiike, goika aitwe akwe. Aye otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu!”

English: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yoshua mwana wa Nuni kwa siri akawatuma wapelelezi wawili kutoka Shitimu, akawaambia, “Nendeni mkaikague hiyo nchi, hasa Yeriko.” Kwa hiyo wakaenda na kuingia kwenye nyumba ya kahaba mmoja jina lake Rahabu na kukaa humo.
Ekegusii: Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni agatoma abanto babere korwa Sitimu bobisi, bachie koroota, akabateebia, “Genda, moroote ense eria, na mono omochie o Yeriko.” Bakagenda aroro, bagasoa enyomba y’omokuungu omotayayi ore korokwa Rahabu, bakarara aroro.

English: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Yeriko akaambiwa, “Tazama! Baadhi ya Waisraeli wamekuja huku usiku huu kuipeleleza nchi.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti o Yeriko agateebigwa ng’a Abaisraeli bande basoire aroro obotuko boria koroota ense eria.

English: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo mfalme wa Yeriko akatuma huu ujumbe kwa Rahabu: “Watoe wale watu waliokujia na kuingia nyumbani mwako, kwa sababu wamekuja kuipeleleza nchi yote.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omorwoti o Yeriko agatoma abanto ase Rahabu komoteebia, “Abanto abwo basoire mwao, nigo bachire koroota ense engima. Ase igo, basokie gocha ase tore.”

English: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.
Kiswahili: Lakini huyo mwanamke alikuwa amewachukua hao watu wawili na kuwaficha. Akasema, “Naam, watu hao walikuja kwangu, lakini sikujua walikotoka.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria konya oirire abanto abwo babere, obabisire. Ase ayio akairaneria, “Amaene, abanto abwo mbacha aa mwane, korende timanyeti ase barwete.

English: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”
Kiswahili: Kulipoingia giza, wakati wa kufunga lango la mji, watu hao waliondoka. Sijui njia waliyoiendea. Wafuatilieni haraka. Huenda mkawapata.”
Ekegusii: Ekero konya bwairiire na egeita kiarenge gosiekwa bagenda; timanyeti ase bagenda, korende ayerera bwango, mobabwatie, nabo mokobabua.”

English: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.
Kiswahili: (Lakini alikuwa amewapandisha darini akawafunika kwa mabua ya kitani aliyokuwa ameyatandika darini.)
Ekegusii: Ere konya obairire kerama igoro, obatubire chimboba chi’egatani anekerete aroro.

English: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.
Kiswahili: Basi hao watu wakaondoka kuwafuatilia hao wapelelezi katika njia ile inayoelekea vivuko vya Yordani, mara tu wafuatiliaji walipotoka nje, lango likafungwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria batometwe nomorwoti bakababwatia gochia Yorodani goika ebiambokero biaye. Kobachiire, egeita kegasiekwa.

English: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.
Kiswahili: Kabla wale wapelelezi hawajalala, Rahabu akawaendea huko juu darini,
Ekegusii: Ritang’ani abanto baria chirooti batararara, Rahabu akariina ase bare kerama igoro,

English: She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.
Kiswahili: akawaambia, “Ninajua kuwa Bwana amewapa nchi hii na hofu kuu imetuangukia kwa sababu yenu, kiasi kwamba wote waishio katika nchi hii wanayeyuka kwa hofu kwa sababu yenu.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Namanyire ng’a Omonene obaeire ense eye. Amaene twoboire bori. Abanto bonsi b’ense eye baondokire ase engencho yaino.

English: For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
Kiswahili: Tumesikia jinsi Bwana alivyokausha maji ya Bahari ya Shamu kwa ajili yenu mlipotoka Misri, pia lile mlilowatendea Sihoni na Ogu, wafalme wawili wa Waamori mashariki mwa Yordani, ambao mliwaangamiza kabisa.
Ekegusii: Twaigure buna Omonene akamogetie amaache ’Enyancha Embariri bosio bwaino, ekero mware kong’anya korwa Misiri, naende buna mwasiretie kegima Sihoni na Ogi, abarwoti baria babere b’Abaamori, ng’umbu ya Yorodani.

English: As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.
Kiswahili: Tuliposikia juu ya hili, mioyo yetu iliyeyuka na kila mmoja alikosa ujasiri kwa sababu yenu, kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu ni Mungu juu mbinguni na duniani chini.
Ekegusii: Ekero twaigwete ayio, tokerusia moyo ekiagera twaboboete; onde tari noboremu bonde, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere Nyasae o igoro na oyo bw’ense inse.

English: Now therefore, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, tafadhali niapieni kwa Bwana, kwamba mtaitendea hisani jamaa ya baba yangu, kwa kuwa mimi nimewatendea hisani. Nipeni ishara ya uaminifu
Ekegusii: Bono nabasabire, mondiere eira na gotiana ase obosio bw’Omonene ng’a, buna nabakoreire inwe amaya, nainwe mokorere abanto b’enyomba ya tata amaya, na mong’e ekemanyererio kio’bwegenwa.

English: and that you will save alive my father, my mother, my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.”
Kiswahili: kwamba mtayahifadhi maisha ya baba yangu na mama yangu, ndugu zangu wa kiume na wa kike, pamoja na wale wote walio wa kwao na kwamba mtatuokoa na kifo.”
Ekegusii: Mondiere eira ng’a inamotoorie obogima bwa tata, na baba, na bamura baminto, na basubati baminto, na abanto babo bonsi! Motoorie amagima aito korwa ase amakweri!”

English: The men said to her, “Our life for yours, if you don’t talk about this business of ours; and it shall be, when Yahweh gives us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.”
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakamhakikishia Rahabu, “Uhai wetu kwa uhai wenu! Ikiwa hutatoa habari ya nini tunachofanya, wakati Bwana atakapotupa nchi hii, tutawatendea kwa hisani na kwa uaminifu.”
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bakamoiraneria, “Nigo tore ang’e gokwa onye titogotooria obogima bwaino, komorabe timoorogeti amang’ana aito ase ogotosigaana. Ekero Omonene arabe otoeire ense eye, ntobakorere amaya, buna twarire eira.”

English: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was on the side of the wall, and she lived on the wall.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawateremsha dirishani kwa kamba, kwa kuwa nyumba yake aliyokuwa anaishi ilikuwa sehemu ya ukuta wa mji.
Ekegusii: Rahabu nigo amenyete ase enyomba yaagachetwe ekabwateranigwa norwaki rw’omochie. Ere akabaikeria nengori goetera ase ekebao,

English: She said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward, you may go your way.”
Kiswahili: Alikuwa amewaambia, “Nendeni vilimani ili wale wafuatiliaji wasiwapate. Jificheni huko kwa siku tatu mpaka watakaporudi, hatimaye mwende zenu.”
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Genda ase ebitunwa, abanto baria bakobabwatia tibaabaisa kobanyora. Mwebise aroro amatuko atato, goika barabwo bairane aa. Magega y’ayio monyare kogenda enchera yaino.”

English: The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakamwambia, “Hiki kiapo ulichotuapisha hakitatufunga,
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bakamoteebia, “Intwe natosiborwe korwa ase eira twatianete, onye aye togokora aya tokoboria.

English: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.
Kiswahili: isipokuwa, hapo tutakapoingia katika nchi hii, utakuwa umefunga hii kamba nyekundu dirishani pale ulipotuteremshia na kama utakuwa umewaleta baba yako na mama yako, ndugu zako na jamaa yako yote ndani ya nyumba yako.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio togokoboria okore: Ekero torasoe ase ense eye, osibe engori eye embariri ase ekebao eke gwatoikeria. Osangererie gocha nyomba mwao iso, na nyoko, na bamura bamino, amo nabaanto bonsi b’enyomba ya iso.

English: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, and we will be guiltless. Whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand is on him.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu yeyote atatoka nje ya nyumba yako akaenda mtaani, damu yake itakuwa juu ya kichwa chake mwenyewe, hatutawajibika. Lakini yule ambaye atakuwa ndani pamoja nawe, kama mkono wa mtu yeyote ukiwa juu yake damu yake itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyetu.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi orasoke korwa mwao na konyorwa namakweri, okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga aye nigo korabe okwaye ere omonyene, na intwe titokoba nokomocha; korende onde bwensi orabe mwao ime, na omonto oito amoite, okomocha nakobe ogwaito.

English: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you’ve made us to swear.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa utatoa habari ya shughuli yetu tunayofanya, tutakuwa tumefunguliwa kutoka kwenye kiapo hiki ulichotufanya tuape.”
Ekegusii: Korararie amang’ana aito na otosigaane, erio natosiborwe korwa ase eira twatianire.”

English: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.
Kiswahili: Naye akajibu, “Nimekubali. Na iwe kama mnavyosema.” Kwa hiyo akaagana nao, nao wakaondoka. Yeye akaifunga ile kamba nyekundu dirishani.
Ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Abe buna mwateeba.” Akabatiga bakagenda. Erio agasiba engori eria embariri ase ekebao keria.

English: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but didn’t find them.
Kiswahili: Walipoondoka, wakaelekea vilimani na kukaa huko siku tatu, hadi wale waliokuwa wakiwafuatilia wakawa wamewatafuta njia nzima na kurudi pasipo kuwapata.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bakagenda gochia ase ebitunwa, bakebisa aroro amatuko atato, goika baria baababwatetie bakairana Yeriko. Barabwo bakaba bakobarigia ase chinchera chionsi, korende tibaabanyora.

English: Then the two men returned, descended from the mountain, crossed the river, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wale watu wawili wakaanza kurudi. Wakashuka kutoka kule vilimani, wakavuka mto na kuja kwa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na kumweleza kila kitu kilichowapata.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto baria babere bakairana, bagatirimboka korwa ase ebitunwa, bakaamboka orooche, bakagenda ase Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni. Agwo bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi aya abanyorete,

English: They said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia Yoshua, “Hakika Bwana ametupa nchi yote mikononi mwetu; watu wote wanayeyuka kwa hofu kwa sababu yetu.”
Ekegusii: bakaboora, “Ntwaenegetie ng’a Omonene otoeire ense eria yonsi, na bono abanto bonsi b’ense eria baondokire ase engencho yaito.”

English: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.
Kiswahili: Yoshua na Waisraeli wote wakaondoka asubuhi na mapema kutoka Shitimu, wakaenda mpaka Mto Yordani, ambako walipiga kambi kabla ya kuvuka.
Ekegusii: Yoshua akaimoka, mambia chuni, amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakaimoka korwa Sitimu, bakagenda, bagaika orooche rwa Yorodani. Bagatoora bakabeera aroro magega bataraamboka.

English: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku tatu maafisa wakapita katika kambi yote,
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato kaerire abateneneri bagaeta ase ebitwori,

English: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.
Kiswahili: wakitoa maagizo kwa watu, wakiwaambia: “Mtakapoona Sanduku la Agano la Bwana Mungu wenu, likichukuliwa na Walawi ambao ndio makuhani, mtaondoka hapo mlipo na kulifuata.
Ekegusii: bagateebia abanto, “Ekero morarore Esanduki y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori bw’okobwatana, ekobogorigwa nabakuani Abalawi, morue aase aa, moyetunyane.

English: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtakapotambua njia mtakayoiendea, kwa kuwa hamjawahi kuipita kabla. Lakini msisogee karibu, bali kuwe na umbali wa dhiraa 2,000 kati yenu na Sanduku.”
Ekegusii: Timoyeika ang’e; mobeere magega ase oboare bw’ekiromita eyemo. Erio namomanye ase mogoeta, naki timwana goeta enchera eyio rinde.”

English: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawaambia hao watu, “Jitakaseni, kwa kuwa kesho Bwana atatenda mambo ya kushangaza katikati yenu.”
Ekegusii: Yoshua agateebia abanto, “Mwechene, ekiagera anki’Omonene nakore amakumia ase egati yaino.”

English: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia makuhani, “Liinueni Sanduku la Agano mkatangulie mbele ya watu.” Hivyo wakaliinua na kutangulia mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio agateebia abakuani, “Imokia Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana, mogende motang’ane abanto.” Erio barabwo bakayeimokia, bakagenda, bagatang’ana abanto.

English: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Leo nitaanza kukutukuza machoni pa Israeli yote, ili wapate kujua kuwa niko pamoja nawe kama nilivyokuwa pamoja na Mose.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Rituko ria reero ngochaka inde gokoimokererie igoro, ase amasio a ’baisraeli, nabarabwo mbamanye ng’a buna narenge amo na Musa, nabo ndabe amo naye boigo.

English: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”
Kiswahili: Uwaambie makuhani wanaochukua Sanduku la Agano, ‘Mnapofika kwenye ukingo wa maji ya Yordani, nendeni mkasimame ndani ya mto.’ ”
Ekegusii: Aye nochiike abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana ng’a ekero baraike engegu y’orocche rwa Yorodani goika bateneneo.”

English: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of Yahweh your God.”
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia Waisraeli, “Njooni hapa msikilize maneno ya Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agateebia Abaisraeli, “Inchuo ang’e aiga, motegerere amang’ana ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino, akobateebia.”

English: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo mtakavyojua ya kuwa Mungu aliye hai yupo katikati yenu, na kwamba kwa hakika atawafukuza mbele yenu hao Wakanaani, Wahiti, Wahivi, Waperizi, Wagirgashi, Waamori na Wayebusi.
Ekegusii: Naende akabora, “Iga namomanye ng’a Nyasae ore moyo nigo are ase egati yaino, takomocha kobaseria korwa ase more Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abahivi, na Abaperisi, na Abagirigasi, na Abaamori, na Abayebusi.

English: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Tazameni, Sanduku la Agano la Bwana wa dunia yote litaingia ndani ya Mto Yordani likiwa limewatangulia.
Ekegusii: Rora, Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori bw’okobwatana, eyio y’Omonene bw’ense engima, nkwambokigwa ere gochia rooche ng’umbu, bosio bwaino.

English: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, chagueni watu kumi na wawili kutoka makabila ya Israeli, mtu mmoja kutoka kila kabila.
Ekegusii: Gaki bono chora abanto ikomi na babere korwa ase ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku.

English: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of Yahweh, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”
Kiswahili: Mara tu nyayo za makuhani walichukualo Sanduku la Bwana, Bwana wa dunia yote, zitakapokanyaga ndani ya Mto Yordani, maji hayo yatiririkayo kutoka juu yatatindika na kusimama kama chuguu.”
Ekegusii: Igo erabe ekero abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Omonene Nyasae bw’ense engima, baratache amaache a Yorodani namagoro abo, amaache akorwa rogoro ya Yorodani nanacheke, atenene buna enyasi.”

English: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,
Kiswahili: Basi, watu walipovunja kambi ili kuvuka Yordani, makuhani wakiwa wamebeba Sanduku la Agano waliwatangulia.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baimogete korwa ase chiema chiabo erinde bamboke Yorodani, abakuani bakabatang’ana, babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana.

English: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),
Kiswahili: Wakati huu ulikuwa wakati wa mavuno, nao Mto Yordani ulikuwa umefurika hadi kwenye kingo zake. Ilikuwa kawaida ya Yordani kufurika nyakati zote za mavuno. Mara tu makuhani wale waliokuwa wamebeba Sanduku la Agano walipofika mtoni na nyayo zao kuzama ndani ya yale maji,
Ekegusii: Bono orooche rwa Yorodani nigo rware goichora engaki yerigesa amaache aetanana chingegu. Ekero abakuani, abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria, baigete Yorodani na batachete amaache namagoro abo,

English: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.
Kiswahili: maji hayo yaliyotiririka kutoka upande wa juu yaliacha kutiririka yakasimama kama chuguu mbali kabisa nao, kwenye mji ulioitwa Adamu kwenye eneo la Sarethani, wakati yale maji yaliyokuwa yanatiririka kuingia kwenye Bahari ya Araba (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi), yalitindika kabisa. Hivyo watu wakavuka kukabili Yeriko.
Ekegusii: erio amaache ayare gotirimboka korwa rogoro agatenena buna orwaki aare mono, agwo Adamu, omochie orenge ang’e na Saretani. Amache arenge gotirimboka gochia enyancha ya Araba nero enyancha y’omonyoo, akanacheka pi. Erio abanto bakaamboka kororia omochie o Yeriko.

English: The priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Wale makuhani waliobeba Sanduku la Agano la Bwana, wakasimama imara mahali pakavu katikati ya Mto Yordani, wakati Waisraeli wote wakiwa wanapita hadi taifa lote likaisha kuvuka mahali pakavu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli baare kwamboka ase ense yakamokire, abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene bagatenena gati‐gati ya Yorodani, ase ense yakamokire, goika abanto bonsi bakaera ase okwamboka Yorodani.

English: When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan, Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,
Kiswahili: Wakati taifa lote lilipokwisha kuvuka Mto Yordani, Bwana akamwambia Yoshua,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi ba Israeli konya bambokire Yorodani, Omonene agateebia Yoshua,

English: “Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,
Kiswahili: “Chagua watu kumi na wawili miongoni mwa watu, kila kabila mtu mmoja,
Ekegusii: “Chora abanto ikomi na babere, oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku,

English: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”
Kiswahili: nawe uwaambie wachukue mawe kumi na mawili katikati ya Mto Yordani, palepale makuhani waliposimama, wayachukue na kuyaweka mahali mtakapokaa usiku huu wa leo.”
Ekegusii: obachike baimokie amagena ikomi na abere, korwa agwo gati‐gati ya Yorodani aase abakuani bateneine namagoro abo, bayaire na bayabeeke amo ase moraraare obotuko obo.”

English: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, a man out of every tribe.
Kiswahili: Basi Yoshua akawaita watu kumi na wawili ambao alikuwa amewachagua kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli, mtu mmoja kutoka kila kabila,
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akarangeria abanto baria ikomi na babere konya achorire korwa ase Abaisraeli, oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku,

English: Joshua said to them, “Cross before the ark of Yahweh your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;
Kiswahili: naye akawaambia, “Mtangulie mbele ya Sanduku la Bwana Mungu wenu, mwende katikati ya Mto Yordani. Kila mmoja wenu atainua jiwe begani mwake, kufuatana na hesabu ya makabila ya Waisraeli,
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Eta mogende bosio bw’Esanduki y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, goika gati‐gati ya Yorodani. Kera oyomo oino aimokie rigena erimo, aribeke ireko riaye, erimo ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli.

English: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these stones?’
Kiswahili: kuwa kama ishara katikati yenu. Siku zijazo, wakati watoto wenu watakapowauliza, ‘Ni nini maana ya mawe haya?’
Ekegusii: Amagena aya abe ekeinyorio ase more. Ekero abana baino barache kobabooria: Ninki engencho y’amagena aya?

English: then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant. When it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever.’”
Kiswahili: waambieni kwamba maji ya Mto Yordani yaliyokuwa yakitiririka yalitindika mbele ya Sanduku la Agano la Bwana. Wakati lilipovuka Yordani, maji ya Yordani yalitindika. Mawe haya yatakuwa kumbukumbu kwa watu wa Israeli milele.”
Ekegusii: Mobateebie: Engencho yaye neye: Ekero Esanduki y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene yambogetigwe Yorodani, amaache nigo anachegete bosio bw’Esanduki eria. Ase ayio amagena aya nabe ekeinyorio ase Abaisraeli botambe.”

English: The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as Yahweh spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel. They carried them over with them to the place where they camped, and laid them down there.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Waisraeli wakafanya kama Yoshua alivyowaagiza. Wakachukua mawe kumi na mawili kutoka katikati ya Mto Yordani, kulingana na hesabu ya kabila za Waisraeli kama Bwana alivyomwambia Yoshua, nao wakayabeba hadi kambini mwao, mahali walipoyatua chini.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora buna Yoshua abachigete. Bakaimokia amagena ikomi na abere korwa Yorodani, erimo ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene konya atebereirie Yoshua, bakayaira ase baare gochia gotoora, bakayabeeka inse.

English: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.
Kiswahili: Yoshua akayasimamisha yale mawe kumi na mawili ambayo yalikuwa katikati ya Mto Yordani, mahali pale ambapo miguu ya makuhani waliobeba Sanduku la Agano iliposimama. Nayo yako huko mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Yoshua akabeeka amo amagena ande ikomi na abere gati‐gati ya Yorodani, aase abakuani batenenete, abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana. Amagena aria nao are goika reero iga.

English: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that Yahweh commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and passed over.
Kiswahili: Makuhani waliobeba lile Sanduku walibakia wakiwa wamesimama katikati ya Mto Yordani mpaka kila kitu Bwana alichomwamuru Yoshua kilipokuwa kimefanywa na watu, sawasawa na vile Mose alivyokuwa amemwamuru Yoshua. Watu wakafanya haraka kuvuka,
Ekegusii: Abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria bakaba bateneine gati‐gati ya Yorodani, goika amang’ana onsi agaikeranigwa, ay’Omonene konya achiikire Yoshua goteebia abanto. Aya naro Yoshua achigetwe na Musa. Abanto bakaayerera kwamboka.

English: When all the people had completely crossed over, Yahweh’s ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people.
Kiswahili: na mara tu watu wote walipokwisha kuvuka, Sanduku la Bwana na makuhani wakavuka watu wakiwa wanatazama.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi konya bambokire, Abakuani bakamboka nesanduki y’Omonene bakagenda bosio bw’abaanto.

English: The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke to them.
Kiswahili: Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wakavuka mbele ya Waisraeli, wakiwa wamevaa silaha, kama Mose alivyowaamuru.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Rubeni, na Abagadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bagatang’ana Abaisraeli, babogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi, buna Musa abateebeetie,

English: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh to battle, to the plains of Jericho.
Kiswahili: Kiasi cha watu 40,000 waliojiandaa kwa vita walivuka mbele za Bwana hadi nchi tambarare za Yeriko kwa ajili ya vita.
Ekegusii: Abanto koreng’ana chilifu emerongo ene babogoretie ebirwanero, baare ang’e korwana esegi, bagaetera ebirubo ebiomo ang’e na Yeriko, ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: On that day, Yahweh magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Siku ile Bwana akamtukuza Yoshua mbele ya Israeli yote, nao wakamheshimu siku zote za maisha yake, kama vile walivyomheshimu Mose.
Ekegusii: Rituko riri’Omonene akaimokereria Yoshua igoro, ase amasio ’abaisraeli bonsi. Barabwo bakaba basigete Yoshua ase obogima bwaye bwonsi, buna basigete Musa.

English: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana akamwambia Yoshua,
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Yoshua,

English: “Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”
Kiswahili: “Waamuru hao makuhani wanaolibeba Sanduku la Ushuhuda, wapande kutoka ndani ya Mto Yordani.”
Ekegusii: “Bachike abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, ng’a batiire korwa Yorodani.”

English: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, “Come up out of the Jordan!”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yoshua akawaamuru hao makuhani akisema, “Pandeni kutoka ndani ya Mto Yordani.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agachiika abakuani, akabateebia, “Karue agwo ase Yorodani.”

English: When the priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.
Kiswahili: Nao makuhani wakapanda kutoka ndani ya Mto Yordani wakilibeba hilo Sanduku la Agano la Bwana. Mara tu walipoiweka miguu yao penye kingo, nje ya mto, maji ya Yordani yakarudi kufurika kama ilivyokuwa kabla.
Ekegusii: Ekero abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria batiirete korwa gati gati ya Yorodani bagatacha ense enyomo. Erio bwango amaache a Yorodani akairanerana, agaetania chingegu chiaye chionsi akaba buna arenge agwo ritang’ani.

English: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa kwanza watu walipanda kutoka Yordani na kupiga kambi huko Gilgali, kwenye mpaka wa mashariki ya Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakamboka Yorodani rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, bagatoora Giligali, ase orobebe rwa moocha ya Yeriko.

English: Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.
Kiswahili: Naye Yoshua akayasimamisha huko Gilgali yale mawe kumi na mawili ambayo walikuwa wameyachukua katikati ya Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Agwo Giligali Yoshua akabeeka amo amagena aria ikomi na abere arusetigwe Yorodani.

English: He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’
Kiswahili: Akawaambia Waisraeli, “Wazao wenu watakapowauliza baba zao siku zijazo wakisema, ‘Mawe haya maana yake ni nini?’
Ekegusii: Agateebia Abaisraeli, “Ase engaki egochi‐gocha abana be chinderia chiaino kobaraborie abaise engencho y’amagena aya,

English: Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
Kiswahili: Basi waambieni, ‘Israeli ilivukia mahali pakavu katika Mto Yordani.’
Ekegusii: mobateebie ng’a Abaisraeli nigo baambokerete Yorodani ase ense enkamoku.

English: For Yahweh your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over, as Yahweh your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up from before us, until we had crossed over,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu alikausha maji ya Yordani mbele yenu, hadi mlipomaliza kuvuka. Bwana Mungu wenu alifanya haya kwa Mto Yordani sawasawa na kile alichoifanyia Bahari ya Shamu wakati alipoikausha mbele yetu hadi tulipomaliza kuvuka.
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo akamogetie amaache a Yorodani bosio bwaino goika mokaamboka, naboigo buna akamogetie Enyancha Embariri bosio bwaito goika tokaamboka.

English: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh’s hand is mighty, and that you may fear Yahweh your God forever.’”
Kiswahili: Alifanya hivi ili kwamba mataifa yote ya dunia yapate kujua kuwa mkono wa Bwana ni wenye nguvu, na ili kwamba kila wakati mpate kumcha Bwana Mungu wenu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto bonsi b’ense engima mbamanye ng’a okoboko kw’Omonene nkore ne chinguru, erinde bamoiroke Omonene, Nyasae oino, botambe.”

English: When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Basi wafalme wote wa Waamori magharibi ya Yordani na wafalme wote wa Kanaani waliokuwa kwenye pwani waliposikia jinsi Bwana alivyoukausha Mto Yordani mbele ya Waisraeli hata tulipokwisha kuvuka, mioyo yao ikayeyuka kwa hofu, wala hawakuwa na ujasiri kuwakabili Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti bonsi b’Abaamori, abamenyete bosongo ya Yorodani, na abarwoti bonsi b’Abakanaani, abamenyete ang’e n’Enyancha ya Mediterania, bakaigwa buna Omonene akamogetie amaache a Yorodani bosio bw’Abaisraeli goika bakaamboka. Ase igo bakoboa mono na kwerusia moyo ase engencho y’Abaisraeli.

English: At that time, Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Tengeneza visu vya mawe magumu sana na uwatahiri Waisraeli tena.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Roisia emeyio emioge y’amagena ochake kwarokia Abaisraeli naende.”

English: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yoshua akatengeneza visu vya mawe magumu sana na kutahiri Waisraeli huko Gibeath-Haaralothi.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akaroisia emeyio y’amagena na akarokia Abaisraeli agwo ase Egetunwa gekorokwa Gibeati‐Haraloti.

English: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu ya Yoshua kufanya hivyo: Wanaume wote waliotoka Misri, wote wenye umri wa kwenda vitani, walikufa jangwani wakiwa njiani baada ya kuondoka Misri.
Ekegusii: Aya naro agerete Yoshua akarokia: Abasacha bonsi b’esegi, abwo bang’anyete korwa Misiri, konya bakwereire ase erooro kobare orogendo rwabo korwa Misiri.

English: For all the people who came out were circumcised; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.
Kiswahili: Watu wote waliotoka Misri walikuwa wametahiriwa, lakini watu wote waliozaliwa jangwani wakiwa safarini toka Misri walikuwa hawajatahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria baruete Misiri konya barokigwe bonsi, korende ase abwo baiboreretwe ase orogendo rw’erooro, onde tarenge konya bwarokigwe, nonya noyomo.

English: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation, even the men of war who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice. Yahweh swore to them that he wouldn’t let them see the land which Yahweh swore to their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walitembea jangwani miaka arobaini mpaka wanaume wote wale waliokuwa na umri wa kwenda vitani wakati waliondoka Misri walipokwisha kufa, kwa kuwa hawakumtii Bwana. Kwa maana Bwana alikuwa amewaapia kuwa wasingeweza kuona nchi ambayo alikuwa amewaahidi baba zao katika kuapa kutupatia, nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bataarire ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika abanto bonsi abaare konyara korwana esegi konya bakuure, ekiagera bangete koigwera Omonene. Ase ig’Omonene agatiana ng’a takobaa ribaga ri’ogosoa ense eria konya ariereire chisokoro chiabo eira ase ogotiana ng’a natoe ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke.

English: Their children, whom he raised up in their place, were circumcised by Joshua, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akawainua wana wao baada yao na hawa ndio hao ambao Yoshua aliwatahiri. Walikuwa hawajatahiriwa bado kwa sababu walikuwa safarini.
Ekegusii: Ase igo abana b’abaanto abwo baria baiboretwe korwa magega yabo nabw’Omone akinetie ribaga riabo nabwo konya batararokigwa kobaare orogendo ase erooro, abwo nabwo Yoshua arogetie.

English: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.
Kiswahili: Baada ya taifa lote kutahiriwa, waliendelea kukaa kambini mpaka walipokuwa wamepona.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi bakoorire kwarokigwa, abanto bonsi bakabeera aase abo ase egetwori goika bakagwena.

English: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Leo nimeiondoa aibu ya Wamisri kutoka kwenu.” Basi mahali pale pakaitwa Gilgali hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Rituko ria reero narusirie korwa ase more ogochaywa mwarenteretwe n’Abamisiri.” Ase ayio aase aaria akarokwa Giligali, naboigo akorokwa goika reero iga.

English: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.
Kiswahili: Jioni ya siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi, wakiwa kambini huko Gilgali katika tambarare za Yeriko, Waisraeli wakaadhimisha Pasaka.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli batoorete Giligali ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Yeriko bakaba bakorenda rituko rinene ri’Epasaka chinsa chia mogoroba, ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi.

English: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata Pasaka, katika siku ile ile, wakala mazao ya nchi, mikate isiyotiwa chachu na nafaka za kukaanga.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kabere magega kobariire Epasaka, bakaria okwama gw’ense eria: emegati etabekiri memera, na engano ekarangire, ase rituko erio erio.

English: The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
Kiswahili: Mana ilikoma siku iliyofuata baada ya Waisraeli kula chakula kilichotoka katika nchi; hapakuwa na mana tena kwa ajili ya Waisraeli, ila mwaka huo walikula mazao ya nchi ya Kanaani.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio mana ekaera, tiyagwa, na Abaisraeli tibanyora mana naende. Korwa ase omwaka oria oria, bariete okwama gwa Kaanani.

English: When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”
Kiswahili: Basi wakati Yoshua alipokuwa karibu na Yeriko, akainua macho, akaona mtu aliyesimama mbele yake, akiwa na upanga mkononi uliofutwa kwenye ala. Yoshua akamwendea na kumuuliza, “Je, wewe uko upande wetu au upande wa adui zetu?”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yoshua aigete ang’e na Yeriko akarigereria akarora omonto oteneine obwate omoyio o birende koboko kwaye. Yoshua akamoika ang’e, akamobooria, “Inee! Aye nensemo yaito ore, gose nensemo y’ababisa baito?”

English: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of Yahweh’s army.” Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and worshiped, and asked him, “What does my lord say to his servant?”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “La, siko upande wowote, lakini mimi nimekuja nikiwa jemadari wa jeshi la Bwana.” Yoshua akaanguka kifudifudi hadi chini, akasujudu, akamuuliza, “Je, Bwana, una ujumbe gani kwa mtumishi wako?”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akairaneria, “Inche nigo inde omotang’ani bw’omoganda okorwana esegi y’Omonene, nakio bono nacheire aa.” Erio Yoshua agatung’ama inse akaumama, agasasiima. Naende akamobooria. “Mang’ana ki obwate ogonteebia omonene one, inche omosomba oo?”

English: The prince of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua did so.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa jeshi la Bwana akajibu, “Vua viatu vyako, kwa maana mahali hapa unaposimama ni patakatifu.” Naye Yoshua akafanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria bw’omoganda okorwana esegi y’Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Rusia ebikoroto biao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine naachenu.” Na Yoshua agakora bo.

English: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.
Kiswahili: Basi malango ya Yeriko yalifungwa kwa uthabiti kwa ajili ya Waisraeli. Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyetoka au kuingia.
Ekegusii: Ebiita bia Yeriko nigo biasiekire bokong’u ng’a Abaisraeli tibaabaisa gosoa aroro. Onde tarenge gosoka gose gosoa imeo.

English: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Tazama, nimeitia Yeriko mikononi mwako, pamoja na mfalme wake na watu wake wa vita.
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Rora, nabekire Yeriko amo nomorwoti oye, na abamura chituoni baye b’esegi, ase okoboko kwao.

English: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.
Kiswahili: Zunguka mji mara moja pamoja na watu wote wenye silaha. Fanya hivi kwa siku sita.
Ekegusii: Aye amo nabarwani bao goika motaare moetanane omochie oyio ara rimo kera rituko ase engaki y’amatuko atano na rimo.

English: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day, you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.
Kiswahili: Uwe na makuhani saba wakibeba mabaragumu ya pembe za kondoo dume mbele ya Sanduku. Siku ya saba, mzunguke mji mara saba, nao makuhani wakipiga baragumu hizo.
Ekegusii: Abakuani batano na babere babogorie ebitureeri na bagende bosio bw’Esanduki eria. Rituko ria gatano na kabere motaare, moetanane omochie oyio ara gatano na kabere, na abakuani babugie ebitureeri biria.

English: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; then the city wall will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, every man straight in front of him.”
Kiswahili: Utakapowasikia wamepaliza sauti kubwa ya baragumu, watu wote wapige kelele kwa sauti kuu, kisha ukuta wa mji utaanguka na watu watapanda, kila mtu akiendelea mbele.”
Ekegusii: Ekero egetureeri kerabugigwe ase eriogi rinene, na mokoigwa eriogi eri, abanto bonsi baake eriogi rinene, erio agwo chindwaki chi’omochie nachigwe inse kegima. Erio abanto bonsi bayoumokere, kera omonto agende bosio rimo rioka.”

English: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh’s ark.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua mwana wa Nuni akaita makuhani na kuwaambia, “Chukueni Sanduku la Agano la Bwana na makuhani saba wachukue baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume mbele yake.”
Ekegusii: Nabo Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, akarangeria abakuani, akabateebia, “Imokia Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana, na abakuani batano na babere babogorie ebitureeri bi’omochengo bagende bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Omonene.”

English: They said to the people, “Advance! March around the city, and let the armed men pass on before Yahweh’s ark.”
Kiswahili: Naye akawaagiza watu, “Songeni mbele! Mkauzunguke mji, na walinzi wenye silaha watangulie mbele ya Sanduku la Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia abanto, “Genda moetanane omochie oria, na abanto babwate ebirwanero bi’esegi bagende bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Omonene.”

English: It was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of Yahweh’s covenant followed them.
