Ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha nabarwani babo bonsi, omoganda bw’abaanto abange buna omokenye bw’engegu y’enyancha. Nigo barenge ne chibarasi ne chigari chinyinge mono.

English: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.
Kiswahili: Wafalme hawa wote wakaunganisha majeshi yao na kupiga kambi pamoja kwenye Maji ya Meromu, ili kupigana dhidi ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti abwo bonsi bakabwatana, bakagenda bagatoora amo, ang’e ne chinsoko chia Meromu, ase okorwania Abaisraeli.

English: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Usiwaogope, kwa sababu kesho saa kama hii nitawatia wote mikononi mwa Israeli, wakiwa wameuawa. Utakata mishipa ya nyuma ya miguu ya farasi wao na kuyachoma moto magari yao ya vita.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Toiroka abanto aba, ekiagera ankio, engaki buna eye, nimbarue bonsi bakwe ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli. Nainwe monache chibarasi chiabo chinteng’e na mosambe chigari chiabo nomorero.”

English: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yoshua pamoja na jeshi lake lote wakaja dhidi yao ghafula kwenye Maji ya Meromu kuwashambulia,
Ekegusii: Yoshua amo nabarwani baye bonsi bakabachiera mobosokano, bakabarwania agwo Meromu, ase chinsoko chiarenge.

English: Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.
Kiswahili: naye Bwana akawatia mikononi mwa Israeli. Wakawashinda na kuwafukuza hadi Sidoni Kuu na kuwafikisha Misrefoth-Maimu, hadi Bonde la Mispa upande wa mashariki, hadi pakawa hakuna yeyote aliyebaki.
Ekegusii: Na Omonene akababeeka ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakabaumokera na kobaseria gochia Sidoni, omochie omonene, na Misirefoti‐Maimu, na goika ebate ya Misipa, ensemo ya moocha. Bakabaita; monto tatigara nonya noyomo.

English: Joshua did to them as Yahweh told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawatendea kama Bwana alivyoamuru. Akakata mishipa ya nyuma ya miguu ya farasi wao na kuchoma moto magari yao ya vita.
Ekegusii: Yoshua akabakora buna Omonene amochigeete; akanacha chibarasi chiabo chinteng’e agasamba chigari chiabo nomorero.

English: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yoshua akarudi na kuuteka mji wa Hazori na kumuua mfalme wake kwa upanga. (Hazori ulikuwa mji mkuu wa falme hizo zote.)
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua akairana gochia Hasori, akayobwata, agaita omorwoti bw’aroro n’omoro. (Engaki eria Hasori nigo orenge omochie omonene bw’amarwoti aria onsi).

English: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was no one left who breathed. He burned Hazor with fire.
Kiswahili: Kila aliyekuwa ndani yake wakamuua kwa upanga. Wakawaangamiza kabisa, wala hawakusaza chochote chenye pumzi na akauchoma Hazori kwenyewe kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Bagaita bonsi abarenge ase omochie oyio ime, bakabasiria kegima, tibatigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo, na omochie obo bakayosamba nomorero.

English: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded.
Kiswahili: Yoshua akaiteka hii miji yote ya kifalme pamoja na wafalme wake na kuwapiga kwa upanga. Akawaangamiza kabisa wote, jinsi Mose mtumishi wa Bwana alivyowaagiza.
Ekegusii: Nabo Yoshua akaira emechie yonsi y’abarwoti baria, na abarwoti abanyene amo na bonsi abarengeo akabaita nemioro, akabasiria kegima, buna Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya achiikire.

English: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.
Kiswahili: Lakini Israeli hawakuichoma moto hata mojawapo ya miji iliyojengwa katika vilima vyao vidogo isipokuwa mji wa Hazori ambao Yoshua aliuchoma moto.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibasambete emechie eyio yaagachetwe ase ebigoro igoro, otatiga Hazori bwoka, noro Yoshua asambete.

English: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They didn’t leave any who breathed.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakajichukulia nyara zote na mifugo yote ya miji hii, bali waliwaua watu wote kwa upanga hadi walipowaangamiza kabisa, pasipo kumbakiza yeyote mwenye pumzi.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagasakora ebinto bionsi bi’emechie eyio, ne chitugo chionsi bakaira chikaba echiabo. Korende bagaita abanto bonsi nemioro, bakabasiria kegima, tibatigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo.

English: As Yahweh commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose mtumishi wake, vivyo hivyo Mose alimwagiza Yoshua, naye Yoshua akafanya kama vivyo, hakukosa kufanya lolote katika yale yote Bwana aliyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Bun’Omonene achigete Musa, omosomba oye, naboigo Musa achigete Yoshua. Na Yoshua agakora ayio onsi, tatigete kende gionsi ase ayio onsi Omonene achigete Musa.

English: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,
Kiswahili: Yoshua akaiteka nchi hii yote: nchi ya vilima, Negebu yote, eneo yote ya Gosheni, shefela ya upande wa magharibi, Araba na milima ya Israeli pamoja na shefela zao,
Ekegusii: Yoshua akaira ense eria engima: Ense y’ebitunwa, na Negebu engima, na ense yonsi ya Goseni, na ense omweya, na Ekerubo Ekiomo, amo nebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli na ense omweya y’aroro.

English: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.
Kiswahili: kuanzia Mlima Halaki ambao umeinuka kuelekea Seiri hadi Baal-Gadi katika Bonde la Lebanoni chini ya Mlima Hermoni. Akawateka wafalme wake wote, akawapiga na kuwaua.
Ekegusii: Akaira ense eria yonsi gochakeera egetunwa kia Halaki agwo Irianyi, kegotiirerwa gochia Edomu na goikera Baali‐Gadi agwo sugusu ase ebate ya Lebanoni, inse y’egetunwa kia Herimoni. Agoosa abarwoti bonsi b’agwo, akabaaka na kobaita.

English: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
Kiswahili: Yoshua akapigana vita dhidi ya wafalme hawa wote kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Yoshua konya obeire okorwania abarwoti abwo ase engaki entambe.

English: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mji wowote katika eneo hili uliofanya mkataba wa amani na Israeli, isipokuwa hao Wahivi wa Gibeoni. Wengine wote walishindwa katika vita.
Ekegusii: Omochie onde tori, nonya noyomo, okorete omorembe na kobwatana n’Abaisraeli, otatiga Gibeoni ase Abahivi bamenyete. Emechie ende yonsi nigo yabuetwe ase esegi eria.

English: For it was of Yahweh to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana mwenyewe ndiye aliifanya mioyo yao iwe migumu, ili kupigana vita dhidi ya Israeli ili apate kuwafutilia mbali pasipo huruma, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere okong’etie chinkoro chiabo ng’a barwanie Abaisraeli, erinde barabwo abanyene basirigwe kegima batari kororerwa amaabera. Nab’Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

English: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yoshua akaenda kuwaangamiza Waanaki kutoka nchi ya vilima: kuanzia Hebroni, Debiri na Anabu, na kutoka nchi yote ya vilima ya Yuda na kutoka nchi yote ya vilima ya Israeli. Yoshua akawaangamiza kabisa pamoja na miji yao.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Yoshua akagenda gosiria Abanaki, abamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, na ase Heburoni, na Debiri, na Anabu, na ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa bi ’Abayuda na ebi’Abaisraeli, Yoshua akabasiria kegima amo nemechie yabo.

English: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.
Kiswahili: Hawakubaki Waanaki wowote katika nchi ya Israeli, ila tu katika nchi ya Gaza, Gathi na Ashdodi.
Ekegusii: Abanaki bande tibatigarete ase ense y’Abaisraeli nonya noyomo. Ase Gati, na Asidodi nao bake batigarete.

English: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yoshua akaiteka nchi hiyo yote kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza Mose, naye Yoshua akawapa Israeli kuwa urithi wao, kulingana na walivyogawanyika katika kabila zao. Ndipo nchi ikawa na amani bila vita.
Ekegusii: Yoshua akaira ense eria engima, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Akayea Abaisraeli ebe omwando obo, akayiatananera kera egesaku ensemo yaye. Na bono ense eria ekaba nomorembe etari nesegi.

English: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wafalme wa nchi ambao Waisraeli waliwashinda na kuitwaa nchi yao upande wa mashariki mwa Yordani, kuanzia Bonde la Arnoni mpaka Mlima Hermoni, pamoja na eneo lote la upande wa mashariki ya Araba:
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabua abarwoti na bakaira ense yarenge ng’umbu, moocha ya Yorodani, korwa rigoko ri’Arinoni goika egetunwa kia Herimoni, amo n’Ekerubo Ekiomo, ensemo ya moocha. Abarwoti abwo nabwo aba:

English: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;
Kiswahili: Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala huko Heshboni. Alitawala kuanzia Aroeri kwenye ukingo wa Bonde la Arnoni, kuanzia katikati ya bonde, hadi kwenye Mto Yaboki, ambao ni mpaka wa Waamoni. Hii ilijumlisha nusu ya Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Oyomo obo nere Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori. Ere nigo amenyete Hesiboni, akagamba korwa Aroeri ore ensinyo ye rigoko ri’Arinoni, na korwa gati‐gati ye rigoko riria goika orooche rwa Yaboki, orore ribebe ri’Abaamoni. Ense eyio nekeng’ese kia Gileadi.

English: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:
Kiswahili: Pia alitawala Araba ya mashariki kuanzia Bahari ya Kinerethi hadi Bahari ya Araba (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi), hadi Beth-Yeshimothi, kisha kuelekea kusini chini ya materemko ya Pisga.
Ekegusii: Naende akaba okogamba ase rikura ria Yorodani, moocha y’enyancha ya Galili goika Beti‐Yesimoti, ensemo ya moocha y’Enyancha y’omonyoo, eyere ase orogongo rwa Araba, gochia Irianyi goika ebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga.

English: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
Kiswahili: Nayo nchi ya Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, aliyekuwa mmoja wa mabaki ya Warefai, aliyetawala Ashtarothi na Edrei.
Ekegusii: Naende bakabua Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, oyorenge oyomo bw’Abarefai abwo batigarete. Ere nigo amenyete ase Asitaroti na Edirei,

English: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
Kiswahili: Naye alitawala katika Mlima Hermoni, Saleka, Bashani yote hadi mpaka wa watu wa Geshuri, na watu wa Maaka na nusu ya Gileadi, hadi kwenye mpaka wa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni.
Ekegusii: akaba okogamba ase egetunwa kia Herimoni, na ase Saleka, na ase Basani engima goika orobebe rw’Abagesuri na Abamaaka, amo nekeng’ese kende kia Gileadi goika orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni.

English: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Mose, mtumishi wa Bwana, na Waisraeli wakawashinda. Naye Mose mtumishi wa Bwana akawapa Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase nchi ya hao wafalme ili iwe milki yao.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti abwo konya babuirwe na Musa omosomba bw’Omonene amo n’Abaisraeli. Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya oeire Abareubeni na Abagadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ense eria ebe eyabo.

English: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wafalme wa nchi ambao Yoshua na Waisraeli waliwashinda upande wa magharibi mwa Yordani, kuanzia Baal-Gadi katika Bonde la Lebanoni hadi kufikia Mlima Halaki, unaoinuka ukielekea Seiri. (Yoshua alitoa nchi zao kwa makabila ya Israeli iwe urithi wao sawasawa na mgawanyiko wa makabila yao:
Ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bakabua na goita abarwoti bonsi abamenyete bosongo ya Yorodani, gochakera Baali‐Gadi ase ebate ya Lebanoni goikera egetunwa kia Halaki, kegotiirerwa gochia Edomu. Yoshua agaatananera kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli ense eria ekaba eyabo.

English: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
Kiswahili: nchi ya vilima, shefela, upande wa magharibi, Araba, materemko ya milima, jangwa, na Negebu; nchi za Wahiti, Waamori, Wakanaani, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi):
Ekegusii: Ense eria ekabwaterania ense y’ebitunwa, na ense omweya, na Ekerubo Ekiomo, na ebitirimboko bi’ebitunwa, amo nerooro, na Negebu, na ense y’Abahiti, na ey’Abaamori, na ey’Abakanaani, na ey’Abaperisi, na ey’Abahivi, na ey’Abayebusi. Abarwoti abwo babuetwe nabwo aba:

English: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Yeriko mmoja mfalme wa Ai (karibu na Betheli) mmoja
Ekegusii: Omoruoto o Yeriko, na oyo bwa Ai, ang’e na Beteli,

English: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Yerusalemu mmoja mfalme wa Hebroni mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni,

English: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Yarmuthi mmoja mfalme wa Lakishi mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Yarimuti, na oyo o Lakisi,

English: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Egloni mmoja mfalme wa Gezeri mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo bw’Egiloni, na oyo o Geseri,

English: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Debiri mmoja mfalme wa Gederi mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Debiri, na oyo o Gederi,

English: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Horma mmoja mfalme wa Aradi mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Horima, na oyo bw’Aradi,

English: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Libna mmoja mfalme wa Adulamu mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Libuna, na oyo bw’Adulamu,

English: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Makeda mmoja mfalme wa Betheli mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Makeda, na oyo o Beteli,

English: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Tapua mmoja mfalme wa Heferi mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Tapua, na oyo o Heferi,

English: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Afeki mmoja mfalme wa Lasharoni mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo bw’Afeki, na oyo o Lasaroni,

English: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Madoni mmoja mfalme wa Hazori mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Madoni, na oyo o Hasori,

English: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Shimron-Meroni mmoja mfalme wa Akishafu mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Simuroni‐Meroni, na oyo bw’Akisafu,

English: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Taanaki mmoja mfalme wa Megido mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Taanaki, na oyo o Megido

English: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Kedeshi mmoja mfalme wa Yokneamu katika Karmeli mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Kedesi, na oyo o Yokinamu, ang’e na Karimeli,

English: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Dori (katika Nafoth-Dori) mmoja mfalme wa Goimu katika Gilgali mmoja
Ekegusii: na oyo o Dori, ase orogongo rwa Dori, na oyo o Goimu ase Giligali,

English: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.
Kiswahili: mfalme wa Tirsa mmoja wafalme jumla yao ilikuwa thelathini na mmoja.
Ekegusii: na oyo o Tirisa. Abarwoti abwo bonsi nigo barenge emerongo etato nomo (31).

English: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.
Kiswahili: Yoshua alipokuwa mzee na umri wake ukiwa umesogea sana, Bwana akamwambia, “Wewe ni mzee sana, na bado kumesalia sehemu kubwa sana za nchi ambazo ni za kutwaliwa.
Ekegusii: Bono Yoshua konya ogotire mono. Omonene akamoteebia, “Aye bono kwagotire mono, korende ensemo enene y’ense netigarete etarairwa.

English: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;
Kiswahili: “Nchi iliyosalia ni hii: maeneo yote ya Wafilisti na Wageshuri:
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chiatigaire nachio echi: Chinsemo chionsi chi’Abafilisti, na ense yonsi y’Abagesuri.

English: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,
Kiswahili: kutoka Mto Shihori ulioko mashariki mwa Misri, kuelekea kaskazini kwenye eneo la Ekroni, ambayo yote ilihesabika kama ya Wakanaani (maeneo yale matano ya watawala wa Kifilisti, ambayo ni Gaza, Ashdodi, Ashkeloni, Gathi na Ekroni: ndiyo nchi ya Waavi);
Ekegusii: (Ense yonsi gochakeera orooche rwa Sihori, moocha ya Misiri, goikera orobebe rw’Ekironi aria sugusu nigo ebarire ng’a ney’Abakanaani. Abagaambi batano b’Abafilisti nigo bamenyete Gasa, na Asidodi, na Asikeloni, na Gati, na Ekironi.) Naende nero ense y’Abaavi,

English: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;
Kiswahili: kuanzia kusini, nchi yote ya Wakanaani, kuanzia Ara ambayo ni ya Wasidoni, ikienea hadi Afeki, na eneo la Waamori,
Ekegusii: na gochia Irianyi ense yonsi y’Abakanaani, korwa Meara eyare kogamberwa n’Abasidoni, goika Afeki na goika orobebe rw’Abaamori;

English: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;
Kiswahili: eneo la Wagebali; Lebanoni yote kuelekea mashariki, kuanzia Baal-Gadi chini ya Mlima Hermoni hadi Lebo-Hamathi.
Ekegusii: ense y’Abagebali amo na Lebanoni yonsi gochia moocha, na korwa Baali‐Gadi inse y’egetunwa kia Herimoni goika enchera ekogenda Hamati.

English: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
Kiswahili: “Na kuhusu wakaaji wote katika maeneo ya milima, kuanzia Lebanoni hadi Misrefoth-Maimu, pamoja na eneo lote la Wasidoni, mimi mwenyewe nitawafukuza watoke mbele ya Waisraeli. Hakikisha umegawa nchi hii kwa Israeli kuwa urithi, kama nilivyokuagiza,
Ekegusii: Abasidoni abwo bonsi bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa egati y’egetunwa kia Lebanoni na omochie o Misirefoti‐Maimu, inche omonyene nimbaserie barue bosio bw’Abaisraeli. Aye goika bwatananere Abaisraeli ense eyio ebe omwando obo, ase okoyeakera obomera, buna nagochigeete.

English: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
Kiswahili: sasa basi, ligawanye eneo hili kwa yale makabila tisa na ile nusu ya kabila la Manase kuwa urithi.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo bono atanana ense eye ase egati y’ebisaku kianda amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ebe omwando obo.”

English: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them:
Kiswahili: Ile nusu nyingine ya Manase, Wareubeni na Wagadi, walishapokea urithi Mose aliokuwa amewapa mashariki mwa Yordani, sawasawa na mtumishi wa Bwana alivyowagawia.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, konya bairire ense ere ng’umbu, moocha ya Yorodani ekaba, omwando obo. Eyio nero Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya abaeire.

English: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;
Kiswahili: Eneo lao lilienea toka Aroeri, iliyoko ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni kuanzia mji ulio katikati ya bonde, likijumlisha nchi ya uwanda wa juu wote wa Medeba mpaka Diboni,
Ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo yachakerete korwa Aroeri, ang’e ne rigoko ri’Arinoni, na omochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko riria, ekabwaterania nense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, korwa Medeba goika Diboni,

English: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;
Kiswahili: nayo miji yote ya Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, aliyetawala Heshboni, hadi mpakani mwa Waamoni.
Ekegusii: amo nemechie yonsi ya Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria orenge kogambera Hesiboni, goikera orogongo rw’Abaamoni.

English: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
Kiswahili: Vilevile ilijumlisha Gileadi, eneo la Wageshuri na Wamaaka, mlima wote wa Hermoni na Bashani yote ikienea hadi Saleka:
Ekegusii: Naende ekabwaterania Gileadi na orogongo rw’Abagesuri na orw’Abamaaka, amo negetunwa gionsi kia Herimoni, na Basani yonsi goika Saleka,

English: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.
Kiswahili: yaani ufalme wote wa Ogu katika Bashani, aliyekuwa ametawala katika Ashtarothi na Edrei, na ndiye pekee alisalia kwa Warefai. Mose alikuwa amewashinda na kuteka nchi yao.
Ekegusii: na ime ase Basani oborwoti bwonsi bwa Ogi, oyo orenge kogambera Asitaroti na Edirei. (Ogi nere oyo otigarete korwa ase Abarefai.) Abwo Musa konya abuire na kobaseria.

English: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.
Kiswahili: Lakini Waisraeli hawakuwafukuza watu wa Geshuri na wa Maaka, kwa hiyo wanaendelea kuishi miongoni mwa Waisraeli mpaka leo hii.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibaseretie Abagesuri na Abamaaka: barabwo nigo bamenyete ase egati y’Abaisraeli goika reero iga.

English: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of Yahweh, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kabila la Lawi, Mose hakupeana urithi, kwa kuwa sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto zilizotolewa kwa Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ndizo zilizokuwa urithi wao, kama alivyowaahidi.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi Musa tabaete ensemo ende yonsi ebe omwando obo. Barabwo nigo barabe bakonyora omwando obo obatungetie korwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, egekoruegwa ase egesasiimero kia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene atebeetie Musa.

English: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maeneo ambayo Mose alikuwa amewapa kabila la Reubeni ukoo kwa ukoo:
Ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’egesaku kia Rubeni ensemo y’ense kobwatekana n’enyomba yabo.

English: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;
Kiswahili: Eneo la Aroeri lililo ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni, na kuanzia mji ulio katikati ya bonde, pia uwanda wote wa juu kupita Medeba
Ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie omochie bw’Aroeri, ang’e ne rigoko ri’Arinoni, amo nomochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko, na ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, yaetanaine Medeba,

English: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
Kiswahili: hadi Heshboni na miji yake yote kwenye uwanda wa juu, ikijumlishwa miji ya Diboni, Bamoth-Baali, Beth-Baal-Meoni,
Ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na emechie yonsi ase ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu; Diboni, na Bamoti‐Baali, na Beti‐Baali‐Meoni;

English: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
Kiswahili: Yahasa, Kedemothi, Mefaathi,
Ekegusii: Yahasi na Kedemoti, na Mefaati;

English: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,
Kiswahili: Kiriathaimu, Sibma, Sereth-Shahari juu ya kilima kilicho katika bonde,
Ekegusii: Kiriataimu, na Sibuma, na Sereti‐Sahari, oyore ase ekegoro kie rigoko;

English: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,
Kiswahili: Beth-Peori, materemko ya Pisga na Beth-Yeshimothi:
Ekegusii: Beti‐Peori amo nebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga, na Beti‐Yesimoti;

English: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.
Kiswahili: miji yote ya uwanda wa juu na eneo lote la utawala wa Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, aliyetawala katika Heshboni. Mose alikuwa amemshinda Sihoni, pia watawala wakuu wa Wamidiani, ambao ni Evi, Rekemu, Suri, Huri na Reba, waliokuwa wameungana na Sihoni, ambao waliishi katika nchi ile.
Ekegusii: emechie yonsi y’ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, na oborwoti bwonsi bwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oyio konya ogambeire Hesiboni. Musa konya omobuire ere amo nabanene bonsi b’Abamidiani: Evi, na Rekemu, na Suri, na Huri, na Reba. Abwo bonsi barenge kogamba inse ya Sihoni bamenyete ase ense eria.

English: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na wale waliouawa katika vita, Waisraeli walikuwa wamemuua kwa upanga Balaamu mwana wa Beori aliyekuwa mchawi.
Ekegusii: Baalamu, omoringoria, mosinto o Beori, nigo arenge oyomo bw’abwo Abaisraeli baitete nemioro.

English: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.
Kiswahili: Mpaka wa Wareubeni ulikuwa ni ukingo wa Mto Yordani. Miji hii na vijiji vyake ndiyo iliyokuwa urithi wa Wareubeni ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Orooche rwa Yorodani nigo rwarenge orobebe rwa bosongo rw’orogongo rw’egesaku kia Rubeni. Emechie eyio amo nebichie biabo nigo yaatananetwe ase kera eamate y’egesaku kia Rubeni, ekaba omwando obo.

English: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maeneo ambayo Mose alikuwa amewapa kabila la Gadi, ukoo kwa ukoo:
Ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’egesaku kia Gadi ensemo y’ense eria ebe omwando obo.

English: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;
Kiswahili: Nchi ya Yazeri, miji yote ya Gileadi na nusu ya nchi ya Amoni iliyoenea hadi Aroeri, karibu na Raba;
Ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie Yaeseri na emechie yonsi ya Gileadi, na ekeng’ese gi’ense y’Abaamoni goika Aroeri, oyore moocha ya Raba,

English: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
Kiswahili: na kuanzia Heshboni mpaka Ramath-Mispa na Betonimu, na kutoka Mahanaimu hadi eneo la Debiri;
Ekegusii: na ense korwa Hesiboni goika Ramati‐Misipa na Betonimu, na korwa Mahanaimu goika orobebe rwa Debiri.

English: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
Kiswahili: na katika bonde, Beth-Haramu, Beth-Nimra, Sukothi na Safoni na sehemu iliyobaki ya eneo la utawala wa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni (upande wa mashariki mwa Mto Yordani, eneo inayoishia kwenye Bahari ya Kinerethi).
Ekegusii: Ase riranya ria Yorodani orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie Beti‐Haramu na Beti‐Nimura, na Sukoti, na Safoni, na ensemo eye yatigarete ey’oborwoti bwa Sihoni o Hesiboni. Orooche rwa Yorodani narwo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo gochia sugusu goika enyancha ya Galili.

English: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.
Kiswahili: Miji hii na vijiji vyake ilikuwa urithi wa kabila la Gadi ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio amo nebichie biabo nigo yaatananetwe ase kera eamate y’egesaku kia Gadi ebe omwando obo.

English: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maeneo ambayo Mose alikuwa amewapa hiyo nusu ya kabila la Manase, yaani kwa nusu ya jamaa ya uzao wa Manase, ukoo kwa ukoo:
Ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase ensemo y’ense eyio, koreng’ana ne’nka yabo.

English: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.
Kiswahili: Eneo lililoenea kuanzia Mahanaimu, na kujumlisha Bashani yote, ufalme wote wa Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, makazi yote ya Yairi huko Bashani, miji sitini,
Ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwachakerete Mahanaimu, na nigo rwabwateranetie Basani engima oborwoti bwonsi bw’Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, amo nemechie yonsi emerongo etano nomo ya Yairi agwo Basani.

English: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
Kiswahili: nusu ya Gileadi, na Ashtarothi na Edrei (miji ya kifalme ya Ogu katika Bashani). Hii ilikuwa kwa ajili ya wazao wa Makiri mwana wa Manase, kwa ajili ya nusu ya wana wa Makiri, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie naende ekeng’ese kia Gileadi amo n’Asitaroti, na Edirei, emechie emenene y’oborwoti bw’Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. Eyio nigo yarwetwe ase kera eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Makiri, mosinto o Manase, ekaba omwando obo.

English: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio urithi alioupeana Mose wakati alipokuwa katika tambarare za Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yordani mashariki mwa Yeriko.
Ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Musa aatananete agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.

English: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. Yahweh, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kabila la Walawi, Mose hakuwapa urithi; Bwana Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli ndiye urithi wao, kama alivyowaahidi.
Ekegusii: Korende Musa taete egesaku kia Lawi ensemo ende yonsi ebe omwando obo. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nere obete omwando obo, buna abateebeetie.

English: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,
Kiswahili: Basi haya ndiyo maeneo Waisraeli waliyopokea kama urithi katika nchi ya Kanaani, ambayo kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi wa koo za kabila za Israeli waliwagawia.
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chingongo Abaisraeli baatananeretwe ase ense ya Kaanani, chibe emiando yabo. Eleazari, Omokuani, amo na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli bakabaatananera ense ase ogoaka obomera.

English: by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
Kiswahili: Urithi wao uligawanywa kwa kura kwa yale makabila tisa na nusu, kama Bwana alivyoamuru Mose.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo achigete Musa ng’a obomera boakwe ekero agwatanana ense ase ebisaku biria kianda, amo na keria kende ekeng’ese.

English: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
Kiswahili: Mose alikuwa amewapa yale makabila mawili na nusu urithi wao upande wa mashariki mwa Yordani, lakini Walawi hawakupewa urithi miongoni mwa hao wengine,
Ekegusii: Naki Musa konya oeire ebisaku binde bibere na ekeng’ese ense ere ng’umbu, moocha ya Yorodani, ebe omwando obo, korende Abalawi barabwo tibaetwe ense ase egati yabo, ebe omwando obo.

English: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa wana wa Yosefu walikuwa makabila mawili; Manase na Efraimu. Walawi hawakupata mgawo wa ardhi, bali walipewa miji tu kwa ajili ya kuishi, pamoja na maeneo ya malisho kwa ajili ya makundi yao ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe wao.
Ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yusufu nigo rwarenge ebisaku bibere: Manase na Efraimu. Abalawi tibaetwe orogongo, otatiga baetwe emechie bakomenya, amo nebitii ase chitugo chiabo chiare korisia na ase baare kobeeka ebinto biabo.

English: The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakagawana ile nchi, kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Abaisraeli baatananete ense ase ogoaka obomera, buna Omonene achigete Musa.

English: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that Yahweh spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wa Yuda wakamwendea Yoshua huko Gilgali, naye Kalebu mwana wa Yefune yule Mkenizi, akamwambia, “Unajua jambo ambalo Bwana alimwambia Mose mtu wa Mungu huko Kadesh-Barnea kukuhusu wewe na mimi.
Ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto bande b’egesaku kia Yuda bakagenda ase Yoshua agwo Giligali. Oyomo bw’abwo, Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, Omokenisi, akamoteebia, “Nomanyete ay’Omonene atebeetie Musa, omonto oria o Nyasae, igoro yane naye, ekero twarenge Kadeshi‐Barinea.

English: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of Yahweh sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
Kiswahili: Nilikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini, wakati Mose mtumishi wa Bwana, aliponituma kutoka Kadesh-Barnea kuipeleleza hiyo nchi. Nami nikamletea taarifa kama kulingana na nilivyosadiki moyoni.
Ekegusii: Inche konya nakoorire emiaka emerongo ene ekero Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, antomete korwa Kadeshi‐Barinea koroota ense eye, na inche nkamorentera amang’ana ’ekeene.

English: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu zangu tuliopanda nao waliifanya mioyo ya watu iyeyuke kwa hofu. Bali mimi, nilimfuata Bwana Mungu wangu kwa moyo wote.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria twagendete komo bakagera abanto bakerusia moyo, korende inche nkaba omwegenwa ase okoigwera Omonene, Nyasae one.

English: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed Yahweh my God.’
Kiswahili: Hivyo katika siku ile, Mose akaniapia, ‘Nchi ambayo umeikanyaga kwa miguu yako itakuwa urithi wako na wa watoto wako milele, kwa sababu umemfuata Bwana Mungu wangu kwa moyo wote.’
Ekegusii: Rituko riria Musa akandiera eira na gotiana, agateeba: Ekeene, ense eyio amagoro ao atachete nigo erabe omwando oo, na oyo bw’ororeria rwao botambe, ekiagera kwaigwerete Omonene, Nyasae one.

English: “Now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that Yahweh spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi, kama vile Bwana alivyoahidi, ameniweka hai kwa miaka arobaini na mitano tangu wakati alipomwambia Mose jambo hili, wakati Waisraeli wakiwa wanazunguka jangwani. Hivyo mimi hapa leo, nina umri wa miaka themanini na mitano!
Ekegusii: Bono rora, emiaka emerongo ene, na etano, yaetire korwa rituko riri’Omonene atebeetie Musa amang’ana ayio, ase engaki eria Abaisraeli baetete ase erooro, n’Omonene ondendire ngendererete koba moyo. Na bono, rora, nabeire nemiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etano,

English: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.
Kiswahili: Bado ninazo nguvu kama siku ile Mose aliponituma. Bado ninazo nguvu za kwenda vitani sasa kama vile nilivyokuwa wakati ule.
Ekegusii: na inche nigo inde ne chinguru ching’ana buna chiria nabwate rituko riria Musa antomete. Nonya ndero nabo inde ne chinguru chi’okogenda korwana esegi na echi’okoirana.

English: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that Yahweh will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Yahweh said.”
Kiswahili: Basi nipe nchi hii ya vilima, ambayo Bwana aliniahidi siku ile. Wewe mwenyewe ulisikia wakati ule kwamba Waanaki walikuwako huko na miji yao ilikuwa mikubwa na yenye maboma, lakini, kwa msaada wa Bwana, nitawafukuza watoke huko kama vile alivyonena.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, bono ing’a ense eye y’ebitunwa, eye Omonene andierete eira ase rituko riria ng’a nang’e. Nkwaigwete aye omonyene ng’a Abanaki nigo bamenyeteo, na buna emechie yabo yarenge emenene, naende yagiteire chindwaki. Aande nab’Omonene arabe amo nainche, erinde imbaserie, buna Omonene ateebete.”

English: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akambariki Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, na akampa Hebroni kama urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agasesenia Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, akamoa omochie o Heburoni okaba omwando oye.

English: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed Yahweh, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Hebroni imekuwa mali ya Kalebu mwana wa Yefune Mkenizi tangu wakati ule, kwa sababu alimwandama Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa moyo wote.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, Omokenisi, akaegwa Heburoni, okaba omwando oye. Nonya ndero iga ororeria rwaye narwo royobwate, ekiagera ere aigwerete Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.
Kiswahili: (Hebroni uliitwa Kiriath-Arba hapo mwanzo, kutokana na huyo Arba ambaye alikuwa mtu mkuu kupita wote miongoni mwa Waanaki.) Kisha nchi ikawa na amani bila vita.
Ekegusii: Kare Heburoni nigo orenge korokwa Kiriati‐Ariba. Ariba nigo arenge omonto omonene ase Abanaki. Na bono ense eria ekaba nomorembe, etari nesegi.

English: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
Kiswahili: Mgawo kwa kabila la Yuda, ulienea ukoo kwa ukoo, ukishuka kufikia eneo la Edomu, hadi Jangwa la Sini mwisho kabisa upande wa kusini.
Ekegusii: Chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda nigo chiaetwe orogongo rwabo ase ensemo ya Irianyi, ang’e norobebe rwa Edomu, ase erooro ya Sini ere Irianyi kegima.

English: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;
Kiswahili: Mpaka wao wa kusini ulianzia kwenye ghuba iliyoko kwenye ncha ya kusini mwa Bahari ya Chumvi,
Ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rwa Irianyi nigo rwachakerete ase ensinyo y’Enyancha y’omonyoo ensemo ya Irianyi,

English: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;
Kiswahili: ukakatiza kusini mwa Akrabimu, ukaendelea hadi Sini ukaenda hadi kusini mwa Kadesh-Barnea. Tena ukapitia Hesroni ukapanda hadi Adari na ukapinda hadi Karka.
Ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Irianyi y’egetunwa ki’Ebiuge, na goetera Sini gochia Irianyi ya Kadeshi‐Barinea, naende rogaeta Hezironi, rogatiira gochia Adari, rokaonchoka rogaika Karika,

English: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.
Kiswahili: Kisha ukaendelea mpaka Azmoni na kuunganika na Kijito cha Misri, na kuishia baharini. Huu ndio mpaka wao wa upande wa kusini.
Ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Asimoni rokabwatia orooche rw’orobebe rwa Misiri goika Enyancha Enene ase rwatwomerete. Oro narwo orobebe rw’Abayuda, ensemo ya Irianyi.

English: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Mpaka wa upande wa mashariki ni Bahari ya Chumvi ukienea mahali Mto Yordani unapoingilia. Mpaka wa upande wa kaskazini ulianzia penye ghuba ya bahari mahali Mto Yordani unapoingilia,
Ekegusii: Orobebe rwa moocha nigo rwabwatetie Enyancha y’omonyoo goika ensemo yaye ya sugusu ase orooche rwa Yorodani ronuchete. Orobebe rwa sugusu nigo rwachakerete aroro,

English: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
Kiswahili: ukapanda hadi Beth-Hogla, na kuendelea kaskazini mwa Beth-Araba hadi kwenye Jiwe la Bohani mwana wa Reubeni.
Ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Beti‐Hogila, rogaeta sugusu ya Beti‐Araba. Erio rogaika Rigena ria Bohani, mosinto o Rubeni,

English: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.
Kiswahili: Kisha mpaka ulipanda hadi Debiri kutoka Bonde la Akori na kugeuka kaskazini hadi Gilgali inayotazamana na materemko ya Adumimu, kusini mwa bonde. Ukaendelea sambamba hadi maji ya En-Shemeshi na kutokeza huko En-Rogeli.
Ekegusii: na rokagenda korwa ebate eria y’Akori goika Debiri, naende rokaonchoka sugusu gochia Giligali kororia Adumini, Irianyi y’ebate eria. Naende rokagenderera goika chinsoko chia Eni‐Semesi rogaika ase ensoko ya Eni‐Rogeli. Erio rokagenderera goika chinsoko chia Eni‐Semesi, na goika ensoko ya Eni‐Rogeli.

English: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.
Kiswahili: Kisha ukapanda kwa kufuata Bonde la Ben-Hinomu sambamba na mteremko wa kusini wa mji mkubwa wa Wayebusi (yaani Yerusalemu). Kutoka hapo ukapanda juu ya kilima magharibi ya Bonde la Hinomu mwisho wa ncha ya kaskazini mwa Bonde la Warefai.
Ekegusii: Erio rokagenderera gochia rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, Irianyi y’egetunwa kia Yebusi, nao Yerusalemu. Magega y’ayio rogatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ekio kerochie Rikura ria Hinomu, ensemo ya bosongo, sugusu y’ense omweremo ya Refaimu.

English: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);
Kiswahili: Kutoka juu ya kilima mpaka ule ukaendelea hadi kwenye chemchemi ya maji ya Neftoa, ukatokea kwenye miji ya Mlima Efroni na kuteremka kuelekea Baala (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu).
Ekegusii: Korwa egetunwa igoro orobebe rogatirimboka gochia ensoko ya Nefitoa, na korwa agwo rogaikera emechie ang’e negetunwa gia Efuroni. Agwo rokaonchoka gochia Baala, (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu),

English: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;
Kiswahili: Kisha ukapinda upande wa magharibi kutoka Baala hadi Mlima Seiri, ukafuatia sambamba mteremko wa kaskazini mwa Mlima Yearimu (yaani Kesaloni), ukaendelea chini hadi Beth-Shemeshi na kukatiza hadi Timna.
Ekegusii: rogaetanana bosongo ya Baala gochia egetunwa gia Edomu, naende sugusu y’egetunwa kia Yearimu (nakio Kesaloni), na maate gochia Beti‐Semesi na rokabwatia Timuna.

English: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
Kiswahili: Ukaelekea hadi kwenye mteremko wa kaskazini mwa Ekroni, ukageuka kuelekea Shikeroni, ukapita hadi Mlima Baala na kufika Yabineeli. Mpaka ule ukaishia baharini.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera gochia sugusu ase egetunwa gi’Ekironi, rokaonchoka gochia Sikironi, rokabwatia egetunwa kia Baala, naende rogaika Yabuneli, na omoerio rogaika Enyancha Enene,

English: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.
Kiswahili: Mpaka wa magharibi ni pwani ya Bahari Kuu. Hii ndiyo mipaka ya watu wa Yuda kwa koo zao.
Ekegusii: eyarenge orobebe rwa bosongo. Abanto be chiamate chia Yuda nabwo bamenyete ase orogongo orwo.

English: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of Yahweh to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).
Kiswahili: Kwa kufuata maagizo ya Bwana kwake, Yoshua alimpa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune sehemu katika Yuda: Kiriath-Arba, yaani Hebroni (Arba alikuwa baba wa zamani wa Anaki).
Ekegusii: Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, akaegwa orogongo rwaye ase egati y’abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda, buna Omonene achigete Yoshua. Akaegwa Kiriati‐Ariba, (nao Heburoni). Ariba nere orenge sokoro y’Anaki.

English: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Hebroni Kalebu alifukuza hao wana watatu wa Anaki, nao ni Sheshai, Ahimani na Talmai, wazao wa Anaki.
Ekegusii: Kalebu agaseria abanto batato b’ororeria rw’Anaki korwa ase omochie oyio. Abanaki abwo nabwo aba: Sesai, na Ahimani, na Talimai.

English: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.
Kiswahili: Kutoka hapo akaondoka kupigana dhidi ya watu walioishi Debiri (jina la Debiri hapo kwanza uliitwa Kiriath-Seferi).
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo agatiira kogenda korwania abanto ba Debiri. (Kare omochie oyio nigo ore korokwa Kiriati‐Seferi).

English: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”
Kiswahili: Kalebu akasema, “Nitamwoza binti yangu Aksa kwa mtu atakayeweza kupigana na kuteka Kiriath-Seferi.”
Ekegusii: Kalebu akabora, “Onde bwensi oranyare kobua na koira omochie o Kiriati‐Seferi nimoe omoiseke one Asika, abe mokaye.”

English: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
Kiswahili: Basi Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu yake Kalebu, akauteka; hivyo Kalebu akamtoa Aksa binti yake aolewe naye.
Ekegusii: Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, momura omwabo Kalebu, akaira omochie oyio, na Kalebu akamoa omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.

English: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”
Kiswahili: Siku moja Aksa alipokuja kwa Othnieli, alimsihi Othnieli amwombe baba yake, Kalebu, shamba. Aksa aliposhuka kutoka juu ya punda wake, Kalebu akamuuliza, “Je, wataka nikufanyie nini?”
Ekegusii: Ekero Asika achete bw’Otinieli, akamobooria asabe ise amoe oboremo. Asika akaayerera goika korwa ase etigere igoro. Erio Kalebu akamobooria, “Inki otagete?”

English: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
Kiswahili: Akamjibu, “Naomba unifanyie jambo moja la hisani. Kwa kuwa umenipa ardhi huko Negebu, nipe pia chemchemi za maji.” Basi Kalebu akampa chemchemi za juu na za chini.
Ekegusii: Asika akairaneria, “Nekeegwa ntagete, ekiagera ngwansogetie okang’ira ase ense enyomo ya Negebu. Ase ayio, ong’e chinsoko chi’amaache.” Kalebu akamoa chinsoko chia rogoro amo nechia maate.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio urithi wa kabila la Yuda, ukoo kwa ukoo:
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda.

English: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
Kiswahili: Miji ya kusini kabisa ya kabila la Yuda katika Negebu kuelekea mpaka wa Edomu ilikuwa: Kabseeli, Ederi, Yaguri,
Ekegusii: Emechie yabo eyarenge ensinyo kegima ya Irianyi ang’e norobebe rw’Edomu, nigo yarenge: Kabuseli, na Ederi, na Yaguri,

English: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
Kiswahili: Kina, Dimona, Adada,
Ekegusii: Na Kina, na Dimona, na Adada,

English: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
Kiswahili: Kedeshi, Hazori, Ithnani,
Ekegusii: na Kedesi, na Hazori, na Itinani,

English: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
Kiswahili: Zifu, Telemu, Bealothi,
Ekegusii: na Sifu, na Telemu, na Bealoti,

English: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),
Kiswahili: Hazor-Hadata, Kerioth-Hezroni (yaani Hazori),
Ekegusii: na Hasori‐Hadata, na Kerioti‐Hezironi (noro Hasari),

English: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
Kiswahili: Amamu, Shema, Molada,
Ekegusii: na Amamu, na Sema, na Molada,

English: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
Kiswahili: Hasar-Gada, Heshmoni, Beth-Peleti,
Ekegusii: na Hasari‐Gada, na Hesimoni, na Beti‐Peleti,

English: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
Kiswahili: Hasar-Shuali, Beer-Sheba, Biziothia,
Ekegusii: na Hasari‐Saulo, na Beeri‐Seba, na Bisiotia,

English: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,
Kiswahili: Baala, Iyimu, Esemu,
Ekegusii: na Baala, na Iyimu, na Esemu,

English: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,
Kiswahili: Eltoladi, Kesili, Horma,
Ekegusii: na Elitoladi, na Kesili, na Horima,

English: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
Kiswahili: Siklagi, Madmana, Sansana,
Ekegusii: na Sikilagi, na Madimana, na Sanisana,

English: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.
Kiswahili: Lebaothi, Shilhimu, Aini na Rimoni; hiyo yote ni miji ishirini na tisa, pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Lebaoti, na Silihimu, na Aini, na Rimoni, emechie emerongo ebere na kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

English: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
Kiswahili: Kwenye shefela ya magharibi: Eshtaoli, Sora, Ashna,
Ekegusii: Ase ense omweya nero Esitaoli, na Sora, na Asina,

English: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
Kiswahili: Zanoa, En-Ganimu, Tapua, Enamu,
Ekegusii: na Sanoa, na Eni‐Ganimu, na Tapua, na Enamu,

English: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
Kiswahili: Yarmuthi, Adulamu, Soko, Azeka,
Ekegusii: na Yarimuti, na Adulamu, na Soko, na Aseka,

English: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Shaaraimu, Adithaimu na Gedera (au Gederothaimu); yote ni miji kumi na minne, pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Saaraimu, na Aditaimu, na Gedera, na Gederotaimu, emechie ikomi na ene, amo nebichie biabo.

English: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,
Kiswahili: Senani, Hadasha, Migdal-Gadi,
Ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Senani, na Hadasa, na Migidali‐Gadi,

English: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,
Kiswahili: Dileani, Mispa, Yoktheeli,
Ekegusii: na Diliani, na Misipe, na Yokiteli,

English: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
Kiswahili: Lakishi, Boskathi, Egloni,
Ekegusii: na Lakisi, na Bosikati, na Egiloni,

English: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,
Kiswahili: Kaboni, Lamasi, Kitlishi,
Ekegusii: na Kaboni, na Lamasi, na Kitilisi,

English: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Gederothi, Beth-Dagoni, Naama na Makeda; yote ni miji kumi na sita pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Gederoti, na Beti‐Dagoni, na Naama, na Makeda, emechie ikomi, na etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

English: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
Kiswahili: Libna, Etheri, Ashani,
Ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Libuna, na Eteri, na Asani,

English: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
Kiswahili: Yifta, Ashna, Nesibu,
Ekegusii: na Yifuta, na Asina, na Nesibu,

English: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Keila, Akzibu na Maresha; yote ni miji tisa pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Keila, na Akisibu, na Maresa, emechie kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

English: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;
Kiswahili: Ekroni, pamoja na viunga vyake na vijiji vyake;
Ekegusii: Norengeo Ekironi, amo nemechie na ebichie biaye;

English: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.
Kiswahili: magharibi ya Ekroni, maeneo yote yaliyokuwa karibu na Ashdodi, pamoja na vijiji vyake;
Ekegusii: na korwa Ekironi gochia Enyancha Enene emechie yonsi yarengeo ensemo y’Asidodi, amo nebichie biaye.

English: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.
Kiswahili: Ashdodi, miji yake na vijiji vyake na Gaza viunga vyake na vijiji vyake, hadi kufikia Kijito cha Misri na Pwani ya Bahari Kuu.
Ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Asidoli na Gasa amo nemechie na ebichie biabo, goika orooche orore orobebe rwa Misiri, naende goika engegu y’Enyancha Enene.

English: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
Kiswahili: Katika nchi ya vilima: Shamiri, Yatiri, Soko,
Ekegusii: Na ase ense y’ebitunwa nigo yarengeo: Samiri, na Yatiri, na Soko,

English: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),
Kiswahili: Dana, Kiriath-Sana (yaani Debiri),
Ekegusii: na Dana, na Kiriati‐Sana (noro Debiri),

English: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
Kiswahili: Anabu, Eshtemoa, Animu,
Ekegusii: na Anabu, na Esitemoa, na Animu,

English: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Gosheni, Holoni na Gilo; miji kumi na mmoja pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Goseni, na Holoni, na Gilo, emechie ikomi nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

English: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
Kiswahili: Arabu, Duma, Ashani,
Ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Arabu, na Duma, na Esani,

English: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,
Kiswahili: Yanimu, Beth-Tapua, Afeka,
Ekegusii: na Yanumu, na Beti‐Tapua, na Afeka,

English: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Humta, Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni), na Siori; miji tisa pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Humuta, na Kiriati‐Ariba (noro Heburoni), na Sihori, emechie kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

English: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,
Kiswahili: Maoni, Karmeli, Zifu, Yuta,
Ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Maoni, na Karimeli, na Sifu, na Yuta,

English: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
Kiswahili: Yezreeli, Yokdeamu, Zanoa,
Ekegusii: na Yesireeli, na Yokidamu, na Sanoa,

English: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Kaini, Gibea na Timna; miji kumi pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Kaini, na Gibea, na Timuna, emechie ikomi, amo nebichie biabo.

English: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
Kiswahili: Halhuli, Beth-Suri, Gedori,
Ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Halihuli, na Beti‐Suri, na Gedori,

English: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Maarathi, Beth-Anothi na Eltekoni; miji sita pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Maarati, na Beti‐Anoti, na Elitekoni, emechie etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

English: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Kiriath-Baali (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu) na Raba; miji miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), na Raba, emechie ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

English: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,
Kiswahili: Huko jangwani: Beth-Araba, Midini, Sekaka,
Ekegusii: Na aria ase erooro nigo yarengeo: Beti‐Araba, na Midini, na Sekaka,

English: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Nibshani, Mji wa Chumvi, na En-Gedi; miji sita pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Nibusani, na Omochie bw’Omonyoo, na Eni‐Gedi, emechie etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

English: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
Kiswahili: Yuda hakuweza kuwafukuza Wayebusi, waliokuwa wakiishi Yerusalemu; hadi leo Wayebusi huishi huko pamoja na watu wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Korende Abayuda tibanyarete goseria Abayebusi, abamenyete Yerusalemu. Ase igo Abayebusi nigo bamenyete amo n’Abayuda goika reero iga.

English: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.
Kiswahili: Mgawanyo wa Yosefu ulianzia Yordani ya Yeriko, mashariki mwa miji ya Yeriko na kutoka hapo ulipanda kupitia jangwani na kuingia katika nchi ya vilima ya Betheli.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rw’orogongo roria obomera bwagwerete ororeria rwa Yusufu rogaachakera orooche rwa Yorodani, ang’e na Yeriko, moocha ye chinsoko chi’aroro goika erooro, rogatiira korwa Yeriko goetera ase erooro gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Beteli.

English: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
Kiswahili: Ukaendelea kutoka Betheli (ndiyo Luzu), ukavuka kuingia eneo la Waariki huko Atarothi,
Ekegusii: Korwa Beteli rokagenda Lusu, rogatiira gochia Ataroti ase Abaariki bamenyete.

English: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.
Kiswahili: ukateremkia kuelekea magharibi hadi eneo la Wayafleti ukienea hadi eneo la Beth-Horoni ya Chini hadi Gezeri, ukiishia baharini.
Ekegusii: Erio rogatirimboka gochia ase ense y’Abayafeleti goika Beti‐Horoni ya maate, na goika Geseri, naende rogatwomera Enyancha Enene.

English: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Manase na Efraimu, wazao wa Yosefu, walipokea urithi wao.
Ekegusii: Orogongo orwo narwo omwando bw’ebisaku bia Manase na Efraimu, ebi’ororeria rwa Yusufu.

English: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo lilikuwa eneo la Efraimu, ukoo kwa ukoo: Mpaka wa urithi wao ulianzia Ataroth-Adari upande wa mashariki hadi Beth-Horoni ya Juu,
Ekegusii: Oro narwo orogongo rwe chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Efraimu: Orobebe rwabo rwa moocha rogaachakeera Ataroti‐Adari, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Horoni ya rogoro,

English: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.
Kiswahili: na kuendelea mpaka baharini. Kutoka Mikmeta upande wa kaskazini ulipinda kuelekea mashariki hadi Taanath-Shilo, ukiupita hadi Yanoa upande wa mashariki.
Ekegusii: na korwa aroro goika Enyancha Enene. Mikimetati noro orenge orobebe rw’ensemo ya sugusu. Korwa Mikimetati orobebe rokaonchoka gochia moocha, rogaika Taanati‐Silo, rogaeta ase omochie oyio, rokagenderera gochia moocha, rogaika Yanoa.

English: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Kisha uliteremka kutoka Yanoa hadi Atarothi na Naara, ukagusa Yeriko na kutokea katika Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Korwa Yanoa rogatirimboka gochia Ataroti na Naara, erio rogatwomera Yeriko, na korwa aroro rogaika Yorodani.

English: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;
Kiswahili: Kutoka Tapua mpaka ulikwenda magharibi hadi Bonde la Kana na kuishia baharini. Huu ulikuwa ndio urithi wa kabila la Waefraimu, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Korwa Tapua rokagenderera gochia bosongo, rogaika akarooche ga Kana, naende rogaika Enyancha Enene ase rwatwomerete. Oro narwo orogongo chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Efraimu chianyorete, rokaba omwando obo,

English: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Pia ulijumuisha miji yote na vijiji vyake ambavyo vilitengwa kwa ajili ya Waefraimu ndani ya urithi wa kabila la Manase.
Ekegusii: amo nemechie na ebichie barabwo baatananeretwe, ebiarenge ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Manase.

English: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.
Kiswahili: Hawakuwatoa Wakanaani waishio Gezeri; mpaka leo Wakanaani wanaishi miongoni mwa watu wa Efraimu lakini wanatakiwa kufanya kazi ngumu za kulazimishwa.
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo tibaseretie Abakaanani abwo bamenyete Geseri. Ase ayio Abakaanani nao bamenyete amo n’Abaefraimu, naboigo nao bare nonya ngoika reero iga. Korende mbakoretwe bakaba abasomba babo bogokora emeremo emekong’u.

English: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mgawo wa kabila la Manase kama mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yosefu, yaani kwa ajili ya Makiri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Manase. Makiri alikuwa baba wa Wagileadi, ambao walipokea Gileadi na Bashani kwa sababu Wamakiri walikuwa askari wakuu.
Ekegusii: Orogongo oro narwo rwaetwe egesaku kia Manase, omwana omomura omotangi o Yusufu ase ogoakerwa obomera, Makiri, ise Gileadi, nigo arenge omwana omomura omotangi o Manase. Ororeria rwaye rokaegwa Gileadi na Basani, ekiagera Makiri nigo arenge omonto etuoni y’esegi.

English: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mgawo huu ulikuwa kwa ajili ya watu wa Manase waliokuwa wamebaki, ambao ni koo za Abiezeri, Heleki, Asirieli, Shekemu, Heferi na Shemida. Hawa ndio wanaume wale wengine wa uzao wa Manase mwana wa Yosefu kwa koo zao.
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chinde chi’egesaku kia Manase bakaegwa chingongo chiabo. Aba nabwo barenge b’ororeria rw’Abieseri na Heleki, na Asirieli, na Sekemu, na Heferei, na Shemida. Aba nabwo abamura b’ororeria rwa Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, naende barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.

English: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
Kiswahili: Basi Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase hakuwa na wana waume ila mabinti tu, ambao majina yao yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.
Ekegusii: Korende Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi, o Gileadi, o Makiri, o Manase, taiborete abana abamura, otatiga abaiseke boka. Amarieta ’abaiseke aba naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.

English: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of Yahweh he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.
Kiswahili: Wakamwendea kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na viongozi, wakasema: “Bwana alimwagiza Mose atupatie urithi miongoni mwa ndugu zetu.” Kwa hiyo Yoshua akawapa urithi pamoja na ndugu wa baba yao, kufuatana na agizo la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na ase abatang’ani abanene, bakaboora, “Omonene nachigete Musa ng’a intwe toegwe orogongo ororabe omwando oito ase egati y’abaminto.” Ase ayio bakaegwa omwando ase egati y’abamwabo ise, buna Omonene achigete.

English: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;
Kiswahili: Fungu la Manase lilikuwa na sehemu kumi za nchi, licha ya Gileadi na Bashani mashariki mwa Yordani,
Ekegusii: Ase igo abanto ba Manase bakaegwa chinsemo ikomi, amo nense eria ya Gileadi, na Basani, ng’umbu ya Yorodani,

English: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu wale binti za kabila la Manase walipokea urithi miongoni mwa wana wa kiume. Nchi ya Gileadi ilikuwa mali ya wazao wa Manase waliobaki.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abaiseke abwo b’ororeria rwa Manase nigo baetwe omwando ase egati y’abamura b’orororeria rwaye. Abana bande b’ororeria rwa Manase konya baeirwe ense ya Gileadi.

English: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
Kiswahili: Eneo la Manase lilienea kuanzia Asheri hadi Mikmeta mashariki mwa Shekemu. Mpaka ule ulielekea upande wa kusini kutoka pale kujumuisha watu walioishi En-Tapua.
Ekegusii: Orogongo rwa Manase rogaachakera Aseri, rogaika Mikemetati, moocha ya Sekemu. Erio rokagenda gochia Irianyi ase abanto b’Eni‐Tapua.

English: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
Kiswahili: (Nchi ya Tapua ilikuwa mali ya Manase, lakini Tapua yenyewe iliyo mpakani mwa nchi ya Manase ilikuwa ya Waefraimu.)
Ekegusii: (Ense ya Tapua neya Manase yarenge, korende omochie o Tapua, ase orobebe rwa Manase, okaegwa Efraimu.)

English: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.
Kiswahili: Kisha mpaka ule uliendelea kuelekea kusini hadi Bonde la Kana. Kulikuwepo miji ya Efraimu iliyokuwa miongoni mwa miji ya Manase, lakini mpaka wa Manase ulikuwa upande wa kaskazini wa lile bonde na kuishia kwenye bahari.
Ekegusii: Erio orobebe rogatirimboka gochia akarooche ga Kana. Emechie yarenge Irianyi y’akarooche aka neya Efraimu, nonya yarenge ase orogongo rwa Manase. Orobebe rwa Manase rokagenderera goika sugusu y’akarooche, rogatwomera Enyancha Enene.

English: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
Kiswahili: Nchi ya kusini ilikuwa ya Efraimu, na ile iliyokuwa upande wa kaskazini ilikuwa ya Manase. Eneo la Manase lilifika bahari na ikapakana na Asheri upande wa kaskazini, na Isakari upande wa mashariki.
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya Irianyi nense y’Efraimu, na ensemo ya sugusu neya Manase yarenge. Enyancha Enene nero yarenge orobebe rwabo ensemo ya bosongo. Ensemo ya sugusu bagasinyana nabaanto b’Aseri, na ensemo ya moocha naba Isakaru.

English: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.
Kiswahili: Katika Isakari na Asheri Manase alikuwa na miji pia: Beth-Shani, Ibleamu na watu wa Dori, Endori, Taanaki na Megido, pamoja na vijiji vyote vinavyohusika na miji hiyo (ya tatu katika orodha ni Nafothi).
Ekegusii: Ase orogongo rwa Isakaru na orw’Aseri Manase akaegwa Beti‐Sehani, na Ibileamu, amo nebichie biabo. Naende akaegwa abanto ba Dori, na Eni‐Dori, na Taanaki, na Megido, amo nebichie b’emechie eyio, na Nafati, ensemo ya gatato.

English: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wamanase hawakuweza kuimiliki miji hii, kwa kuwa Wakanaani walikazana kuishi katika maeneo hayo.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Manase tibanyarete goseria Abakanaani b’emechie eyio. Ase igo Abakanaani bakagenderera komenya ase ense eria.

English: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Waisraeli walivyoendelea kupata nguvu waliwatumikisha Wakanaani na kuwatia katika kazi za kulazimishwa, lakini hawakuwafukuza kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babete ne chinguru kobua bakaa Abakaanani baria emeremo emekong’u, korende tibaabaseretie kegima.

English: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because Yahweh has blessed us so far?”
Kiswahili: Watu wa Yosefu wakamwambia Yoshua, “Kwa nini umetupa sisi mgawo mmoja tu na sehemu moja tu kuwa urithi? Sisi tu watu wengi sana, na Bwana ametubariki kwa wingi.”
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu bagakwana na Yoshua, bakamoteebia, “Nase ki gwatoeire ensemo eyemo yoka ebe omwando oito? Intwe nigo tore abanto abange, ekiagera Omonene otosesenirie.”

English: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”
Kiswahili: Yoshua akajibu, “Kama ninyi ni wengi sana, na kama nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu ni ndogo sana kwenu, pandeni msituni mkafyeke eneo kwa ajili yenu wenyewe huko kwenye nchi ya Waperizi na Warefai.”
Ekegusii: Yoshua akabairaneria, “Onye more abange igo, na ensemo y’ebitunwa bi’Efraimu tebaisaini, tiira gochia rinani, morirabie, na momenye aroro ase ense y’Abaperisi na ey’Abarefai.”

English: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”
Kiswahili: Watu wa Yosefu wakajibu, “Hiyo nchi ya vilima haitutoshi, nao Wakanaani wote wanaoishi katika tambarare wanayo magari ya vita ya chuma, wote wa Beth-Shani na miji yake, na wale walio katika Bonde la Yezreeli.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria, “Ense eria y’ebitunwa tegotoisana, na Abakanaani abamenyete ase ense omweya nigo babwate chigari chi’ebioma, abwo bamenyete Beti‐Sehani na ebichie bire inse yabo, amo nabwo bamenyete ase ense omweremo ya Yesireeli boigo.”

English: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;
Kiswahili: Lakini Yoshua akanena na nyumba ya Yosefu, yaani Efraimu na Manase: “Ninyi ni wengi sana na wenye nguvu sana. Hamtakuwa na mgawo mmoja tu,
Ekegusii: Yoshua agateebia abanto b’ebisaku bi’Efraimu na Manase (abw’ororeria rwa Yusufu), “Amaene, inwe nabaanto abange more, naende nigo more ne chinguru. Ase ayio, ensemo eyemo yoka tekobaisana ase okomenya.

English: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”
Kiswahili: bali pia nchi hii ya kilima yenye msitu. Ifyekeni, nayo mipaka yake itakuwa yenu umbali mtakaoweza kufika. Ingawa Wakanaani wana magari ya chuma, nao wana nguvu, mwaweza kuwafukuza humo.”
Ekegusii: Ense y’ebitunwa nabo erabe eyaino. Nonya ere ne rinani, genda moyerabie, moyeire engima ebe eyaino, korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende. Goika moserie Abakanaani korwa aroro nonya babwate chigari chi’ebioma, naende bare ne chinguru.”

English: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko lote la Waisraeli likakusanyika huko Shilo na kusimamisha Hema la Kukutania. Nchi ikawa chini ya utawala wao,
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babuete ense eria, omoganda obo bwonsi ogasangererekana agwo Silo, na agwo bagatenenia Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.
Kiswahili: lakini palikuwa bado makabila saba ya Israeli ambayo yalikuwa hayajapokea urithi wao.
Ekegusii: Korende ebisaku bitano na bibere mbiatigarete bitatananeretwe ensemo y’ense ebe omwando obo.

English: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you?
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yoshua akawaambia Waisraeli, “Je, mtasubiri hata lini ili kuingia kumiliki nchi ambayo Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, amewapa?
Ekegusii: Ase igo Yoshua agateebia Abaisraeli, “Inee! Ngoika ririri moratebaane kogenda koira ense eye Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, abaeire?

English: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.
Kiswahili: Chagueni watu watatu kutoka kwenye kila kabila. Nitawatuma hao watu kukagua hiyo nchi na kuniandikia mapendekezo ya mgawanyo wa urithi wa kila kabila. Nao watanirudia.
Ekegusii: Nchorere abanto batato korwa ase kera egesaku, na inche nimbatome bataare ase ense engima, bayiate na kworokia ase okorika chinsemo chigwenerete koba omwando bwa kera egesaku. Erio bandetere amang’ana.

English: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.
Kiswahili: Mtaigawanya hiyo nchi katika sehemu saba. Yuda atabaki katika eneo lake upande wa kusini na nyumba ya Yosefu katika nchi yake upande wa kaskazini.
Ekegusii: Ense yatananwe ase chinsemo isano na ibere. Abayuda nigo baragenderere komenya ase orogongo rwabo agwo ensemo ya Irianyi, na Abayusufu ase orwabo, ensemo ya sugusu.

English: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuandika maelezo ya hizo sehemu saba za nchi, yaleteni kwangu, nami nitawapigia kura kwa kura mbele za Bwana Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Morike mworokie omooroberio oyio bw’ogwaterana ense ase chinsemo isano na ibere, moyorente ase ’nde, na inche nimbaakere obomera ase okobori’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Walawi hawatakuwa na sehemu miongoni mwenu, kwa maana huduma ya ukuhani kwa Bwana ndio urithi wao. Nao Gadi, Reubeni na nusu ya kabila la Manase wameshapata urithi wao upande wa mashariki mwa Yordani, ambako Mose mtumishi wa Bwana aliwapa.”
Ekegusii: Abalawi barabwo tibakoegwa egetari gi’ense amo nainwe, ekiagera egetari kiabo nokomokorera Omonene ase emeremo y’obokuani. Egesaku kia Gadi, na ekia Rubeni na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase barabwo konya baeirwe omwando obo moocha ya Yorodani, omwando oria Musa, omosomba Omonene, abaatananerete.”

English: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh in Shiloh.”
Kiswahili: Watu hao walipokuwa wanaondoka kwenda kuandika vizuri kuhusu hiyo nchi, Yoshua akawaagiza, “Nendeni mkakague hiyo nchi na mwandike maelezo kuihusu. Kisha mrudi kwangu, nami nitawapigia kura hapa Shilo mbele za Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Abanto aba bakagenda gwata ense buna Yoshua abachiigete na kobateebereria, “Genda motaare ase ense engima, mworokie ase okorika buna ense eyio ere. Erio moirane ase ’nde, na inche nimbaakere obomera ase okobori’Omonene aiga Silo.”

English: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.
Kiswahili: Ndipo hao watu walipoondoka na kupita katika ile nchi. Wakaandika maelezo yake kwenye kitabu, mji kwa mji, katika sehemu saba na kurudisha taarifa kwa Yoshua huko kambini Shilo.
Ekegusii: Bono abanto abwo bakagenda, bagaetanana ense eria engima, bakarika ase okworokia buna bayiatete ense ase chinsemo isano na ibere kobwatekana nemechie yonsi. Erio bakairana ase Yoshua ase egetwori agwo Silo

English: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.
Kiswahili: Basi Yoshua akawapigia kura huko Shilo mbele za Bwana, na hapo akagawanya ile nchi kwa Waisraeli kufuatana na mgawanyo wa kabila zao.
Ekegusii: Yoshua akabaakera obomera ase okobori’Omonene aria Silo, agaatananera Abaisraeli ense eyio, kera egesaku ensemo yaye.

English: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
Kiswahili: Kura iliangukia kabila la Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo. Eneo lao walilogawiwa lilikuwa kati ya kabila la Yuda na la Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Obomera bw’eritang’ani bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini. Orogongo rwabo rokaba egati y’orogongo rw’egesaku kia Yuda na orw’ekia Yusufu.

English: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
Kiswahili: Upande wa kaskazini mpaka wao ulianzia pale Yordani, kupitia kaskazini ya mteremko wa Yeriko na kuendelea magharibi kuingia katika nchi ya vilima, ukitokea kwenye jangwa la Beth-Aveni.
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rwabo rogaachakera orooche rwa Yorodani, rogatiira gochia egetirimboko sugusu ya Yeriko, naende gochia bosongo goetera ense y’ebitunwa, rogaika erooro ya Beti‐Aveni.
