English: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.
Kiswahili: Kutoka hapo ulikatiza kwenye mteremko wa kusini mwa Luzu (yaani Betheli) na kushuka hadi Ataroth-Adari katika kilima kusini mwa Beth-Horoni ya Chini.
Ekegusii: Na korwa aroro rokagenderera goika ebitirimboko bia Lusu (noro Beteli), rogatirimboka goika Ataroti Adari ase egetunwa kere, Irianyi ya Beti‐Horoni maate.

English: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kilima kinachotazamana na Beth-Horoni upande wa kusini mpaka ule ukazunguka kusini kufuatia upande wa magharibi, na ukatokezea Kiriath-Baali (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu), mji wa watu wa Yuda. Huu ndio uliokuwa upande wa magharibi.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera na rokaonchoka gochia Irianyi, bosongo y’egetunwa keria kerochie Beti‐Horoni, rogaika Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), omochie bw’egesaku kia Yuda. Oro nigo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo.

English: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
Kiswahili: Upande wa kusini mpaka ulianzia kwenye viunga vya Kiriath-Yearimu kwa upande wa magharibi, nao ukatokeza kwenye chemchemi ya maji ya Neftoa.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rwa Irianyi nigo rwachakerete ensinyo ya Kiriati‐Yearimu, rokagenderera gochia ensemo ya bosongo, rogaika ase chinsoko chia Nefitoa.

English: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.
Kiswahili: Mpaka ukateremka hadi shefela inayotazamana na Bonde la Ben-Hinomu, kaskazini mwa Bonde la Refaimu. Ukaendelea chini kwenye Bonde la Hinomu sambamba na mteremko wa kusini mwa mji mkubwa wa Wayebusi na kisha hadi En-Rogeli.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo rogatirimboka rogaika ensinyo y’egetunwa kerochie Rikura ria Beni‐Hinomu, rire ensemo ya sugusu y’ense omweremo ya Refaimu. Erio rokagenda gochia Irianyi goetera Rikura ria Hinomu, Irianyi y’esagamo y’Abayebusi gochia Eni‐Rogeli.

English: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
Kiswahili: Kisha ukapinda kuelekea kaskazini, ukaenda hadi En-Shemeshi na kuendelea mpaka Gelilothi, inayotazamana na Njia ya Adumimu, ukateremka hadi kwenye Jiwe la Bohani mwana wa Reubeni.
Ekegusii: Naende rokagenderera gochia sugusu rogaika Eni‐Semesi, naende goika Geliloti kororia egetirimboko ki’Adumimi. Erio rogatirimboka gochia Rigena ria Bohani, mosinto o Rubeni,

English: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.
Kiswahili: Ukaendelea upande wa mteremko wa kaskazini wa Beth-Araba ukateremka hadi Araba.
Ekegusii: rogaeta sugusu y’esagamo ere igoro y’Ekerubo Ekiomo, naende rogatirimboka goika Ekerubo keria Ekiomo.

English: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.
Kiswahili: Kisha ukaenda mpaka kwenye mteremko wa kaskazini wa Beth-Hogla na kujitokeza kwenye ghuba ya kaskazini ya Bahari ya Chumvi, kwenye maingilio ya Yordani upande wa kusini. Huo ulikuwa mpaka wa kusini.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rokagenderera gochia esagamo ya Beti‐Hogila, rogaika ensemo ya sugusu y’Enyancha y’omonyoo ase orooche rwa Yorodani ronuchete. Oro narwo orobebe rwa Irianyi.

English: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.
Kiswahili: Nayo Yordani ikawa ndio mpaka wa upande wa mashariki. Hii ilikuwa ndiyo mipaka iliyoonyesha urithi wa koo za Benyamini pande zote.
Ekegusii: Yorodani narwo orobebe rwa moocha. Echio nachio chimbebe chiaetanaine orogongo orwo chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini chianyorete rokaba omwando obo.

English: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
Kiswahili: Kabila ya Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo, ilikuwa na miji mikubwa ifuatayo: Yeriko, Beth-Hogla, Emeki-Kesisi,
Ekegusii: Emechie ye chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini nigo yarenge: Yeriko, na Beti‐Hogila, na Emeki‐Kesisi,

English: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
Kiswahili: Beth-Araba, Semaraimu, Betheli,
Ekegusii: na Beti‐Araba, na Semaraimu, na Beteli,

English: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
Kiswahili: Avimu, Para na Ofra,
Ekegusii: na Avimu, na Para, na Ofura,

English: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Kefar-Amoni, Ofni, na Geba; miji kumi na miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Kefari‐Amoni, na Ofuni, na Geba, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

English: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
Kiswahili: Gibeoni, Rama na Beerothi,
Ekegusii: Naende yarenge Gibeoni, na Rama, na Beroti,

English: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,
Kiswahili: Mispa, Kefira, Moza,
Ekegusii: na Misipa, na Kefira, na Mosa,

English: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
Kiswahili: Rekemu, Irpeeli, Tarala,
Ekegusii: na Rekemu, na Iripeli, na Tarala,

English: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
Kiswahili: Zela, Elefu, mji wa Wayebusi (yaani Yerusalemu), Gibea na Kiriathi; miji kumi na minne pamoja na vijiji vyake. Huu ndio uliokuwa urithi wa Benyamini kwa ajili ya koo zake.
Ekegusii: na Zela, na Elefu, na Yebusi (noro Yerusalemu), na Gibea, na Kiriati‐Yearimu, emechie ikomi na ene, amo nebichie biabo. Oyo noro orenge omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini.

English: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
Kiswahili: Kura ya pili ikaangukia kabila la Simeoni, ukoo kwa ukoo. Urithi wao ulikuwa ndani ya eneo la Yuda.
Ekegusii: Obomera bwa kabere bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simioni. Omwando obo nigo orenge gati‐gati y’omwando bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

English: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
Kiswahili: Ulijumuisha: Beer-Sheba (au Sheba), Molada,
Ekegusii: Emechie banyorete ase omwando obo nero: Beeri‐Seba, na Seba, na Molada,

English: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
Kiswahili: Hasar-Shuali, Bala, Esemu,
Ekegusii: na Hasari‐Suali, na Bala, na Esemu,

English: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
Kiswahili: Eltoladi, Bethuli, Horma,
Ekegusii: na Elitoladi, na Betuli, na Horima,

English: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
Kiswahili: Siklagi, Beth-Markabothi, Hasar-Susa,
Ekegusii: na Sikilagi, na Beti‐Marikaboti, na Hasari‐Susa,

English: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;
Kiswahili: Beth-Lebaothi na Sharuheni; hii ilikuwa miji kumi na mitatu pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Beti‐Lebaoti, na Saruheni, emechie ikomi na etato, amo nebichie biabo.

English: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;
Kiswahili: Pia Aini, Rimoni, Etheri, na Ashani; hii ilikuwa miji minne na vijiji vyake,
Ekegusii: Naende yarenge Aini, na Rimoni, na Eteri, na Asani, emechie ene, amo nebichie biabo.

English: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
Kiswahili: pamoja na vijiji vyote vinavyoizunguka miji hii mpaka Baalath-Beeri (ambayo ndiyo Rama iliyo katika Negebu). Huu ulikuwa ni urithi wa kabila la Simeoni ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Amo neyio bakanyora ebichie bionsi biaetanaine emechie eyio goika Baalati‐Beeri (noro Rama‐Negebu). Oyio noro orenge bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simioni.

English: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.
Kiswahili: Urithi wa Wasimeoni ulitolewa kutoka fungu la Yuda, kwa kuwa fungu la Yuda lilikuwa kubwa kuliko walivyohitaji. Hivyo kabila la Simeoni lilipewa urithi wao ndani ya eneo la Yuda.
Ekegusii: Omwando bw’egesaku gia Simioni nigo orenge ensemo y’oyio bw’egesaku kia Yuda, ekiagera ensemo y’egesaku kia Yuda nigo yarenge enene mono ase bare. Ayio naro agerete egesaku gia Simioni gekaegwa omwando obo korwa ase omwando bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

English: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.
Kiswahili: Kura ya tatu ikaangukia kabila la Zabuloni, ukoo kwa ukoo: Mpaka wa urithi wao uliendelea hadi Saridi.
Ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatato bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Orogongo rwabeete omwando obo rogaikera Saridi.

English: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
Kiswahili: Kuelekea upande wa magharibi ukafika Marala, ukagusa Dabeshethi, na kuendelea mpaka kwenye bonde karibu na Yokneamu.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rwabo rogatiira gochia bosongo, rogaika Marala, rogatwomera Dabeseti ne rigoko rire moocha ya Yokinamu.

English: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
Kiswahili: Ukageuka mashariki, kuanzia Saridi kuelekea mawio ya jua hadi kwenye nchi ya Kisiloth-Tabori, na kwenda hadi Daberathi, kupanda Yafia.
Ekegusii: Korwa Saridi rokagenderera goika Kisiloti‐Tabori, naende goika Daberati, erio rogatiira goika Yafia.

English: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
Kiswahili: Kisha ukaendelea mashariki hadi Gath-Heferi na kufika Eth-Kasini, ukatokea Rimoni na kugeuka kuelekea Nea.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo rokagenderera gochia moocha, rogaika Gati‐Heferi na Eta‐Kasini, rokagenda gochia Rimoni, rokaonchoka gochia Nea.

English: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
Kiswahili: Huko mpaka ukazungukia upande wa kaskazini hadi Hanathoni na kuishia katika Bonde la Ifta-Eli.
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rokaonchokera Hanatoni, rogaikera ense omweremo ya Ifuta‐Eli.

English: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji mingine iliyojumuishwa ni Katathi, Nahalali, Shimroni, Idala na Bethlehemu. Kulikuwa na miji kumi na miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: Amo neyio orogongo rwabo rokabwaterania Katati, na Nahalali, na Simuroni, na Idala, na Bethlehemu, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

English: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji hii na vijiji vyake ilikuwa ndio urithi wa Zabuloni, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nigo biarenge omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni.

English: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.
Kiswahili: Kura ya nne ikamwangukia Isakari, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Obomera bwa kane bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru.

English: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
Kiswahili: Eneo lao lilijumuisha: Yezreeli, Kesulothi, Shunemu,
Ekegusii: Ensemo yabo nigo yabwateranetie Yesireeli, na Kesuloti, na Sunemu,

English: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
Kiswahili: Hafaraimu, Shioni, Anaharathi,
Ekegusii: na Hafaraimu, na Sihoni, na Anaharati,

English: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
Kiswahili: Rabithi, Kishioni, Ebesi,
Ekegusii: na Rabiti, na Kisioni, na Ebesi,

English: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
Kiswahili: Remethi, En-Ganimu, En-Hada na Beth-Pasesi.
Ekegusii: na Remeti, na Eni‐Ganimu, na Eni‐Hada, na Beti‐Pasesi.

English: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Mpaka ule ukagusa Tabori, Shahasuma na Beth-Shemeshi, na ukaishia kwenye Yordani. Ilikuwa miji kumi na sita, pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rogatwomera boigo Tabori na Sahasuma, na Beti‐Semesi, rokanacha Yorodani. Orogongo oro rokabwaterania emechie ikomi, na etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji hii pamoja na vijiji vyake ilikuwa urithi wa kabila la Isakari, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate ch’egesaku gia Isakaru.

English: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
Kiswahili: Kura ya tano ikaangukia kabila la Asheri, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri.

English: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
Kiswahili: Eneo lao lilijumuisha: Helkathi, Hali, Beteni, Akishafu,
Ekegusii: Ensemo yabo nigo yabwateranetie Helikati, na Hali, na Beteni, na Akisafu,

English: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.
Kiswahili: Alameleki, Amadi na Mishali. Upande wa magharibi mpaka uligusa Karmeli na Shihor-Libnathi.
Ekegusii: na Alameleki, na Amadi, na Misali. Ensemo ya bosongo orobebe rwabo rogatwomera Karimeli na Sihori‐Libinati.

English: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
Kiswahili: Tena ukageuka mashariki kuelekea Beth-Dagoni, ukagusa Zabuloni na Bonde la Ifta-Eli, ukaenda upande wa kaskazini hadi Beth-Emeki na Neyeli, ukipitia Kabul upande wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Erio rokaonchoka gochia moocha, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Dagoni, rogatwomera Sabuloni na ense yo’mweremo o Ifuta‐Eli, ensemo ya sugusu, rogaika Beti‐Emeki na Neieli. Erio rokagenderera gochia sugusu goika Kabuli,

English: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
Kiswahili: Ukaendelea hadi Abdoni, Rehobu, Hamoni na Kana, na kufika Sidoni Kuu.
Ekegusii: na Eburoni, na Rehobu, na Hamoni, na Kana, rogaika Sidoni, Omochie omonene.

English: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;
Kiswahili: Mpaka huo ukageukia nyuma kuelekea Rama na kwenda hadi kwenye mji wenye ngome wa Tiro, ukageuka kuelekea Hosa na kutokeza baharini katika eneo la Akzibu,
Ekegusii: Erio orobebe rokaonchoka gochia Rama, rogaika omochie omonene o Turo, oyogiteire chindwaki, rokaonchoka gochia Hosa, na rokanucha Enyancha Enene. Naende orogongo orwo rokabwaterania engegu y’ensemo y’Akisibu,

English: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Uma, Afeki na Rehobu. Ilikuwepo miji ishirini na miwili, pamoja na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Uma, na Afeki, na Rehobu, emechie emerongo ebere, na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji hii pamoja na vijiji vyake ilikuwa ndio urithi wa kabila la Asheri, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri.

English: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
Kiswahili: Kura ya sita ikaangukia kabila la Naftali, ukoo kwa ukoo:
Ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano na rimo bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali.

English: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Mpaka wao uliendelea kutoka Helefi na kwenye mti mkubwa ulio katika Saananimu, ukipitia Adami-Nekebu na Yabineeli hadi Lakumu, na kuishia katika Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rogaachaka korwa Helefu ase Omoaluni orenge, agwo Sananimu, na korwa Adami‐Nekebu, na Yabuneli, rogaika Lakumu, rogatwomera Yorodani.

English: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.
Kiswahili: Mpaka ukaendelea magharibi kupitia Aznoth-Tabori na kutokea Hukoki. Ukagusa Zabuloni upande wa kusini, Asheri upande wa magharibi, na Yordani upande wa mashariki.
Ekegusii: Erio orobebe rokaonchoka gochia bosongo goika Asinoti‐Tabori, na korwa agwo rokagenderera goika Hukoki, rogatwomera orogongo rw’egesaku gia Sabuloni ensemo ya Irianyi, na orw’egia Aseri ensemo ya bosongo, na orw’ekia Yuda ensemo ya moocha ase Yorodani.

English: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
Kiswahili: Miji yenye ngome ilikuwa Sidimu, Seri, Hamathi, Rakathi, Kinerethi,
Ekegusii: Emechie yabo yagiteire chindwaki nero: Sidimu, na Seri, na Hamati, na Rakati, na Galili,

English: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
Kiswahili: Adama, Rama, Hazori,
Ekegusii: na Adama, na Rama, na Hasori,

English: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
Kiswahili: Kedeshi, Edrei, na En-Hasori,
Ekegusii: na Kedesi na Edirei, na Eni‐Hasori,

English: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Ironi, Migdal-Eli, Horemu, Beth-Anathi na Beth-Shemeshi. Kulikuwa na miji kumi na tisa na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: na Yironi, na Migidali‐Eli, na Horemu, na Beti‐Anati, na Beti‐Semesi, emechie ikomi na kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji hiyo pamoja na vijiji vyake ndio iliyokuwa urithi wa kabila la Naftali, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali.

English: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
Kiswahili: Kura ya saba ikaangukia kabila la Dani, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano na kabere bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Dani.

English: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,
Kiswahili: Eneo la urithi wao lilijumuisha: Sora, Eshtaoli, Iri-Shemeshi,
Ekegusii: Omwando obo okabwaterania Sora, na Esitaoli, na Iri‐Semesi,

English: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
Kiswahili: Shaalabini, Aiyaloni, Ithla,
Ekegusii: na Saalabini, na Ayaloni, na Itila,

English: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
Kiswahili: Eloni, Timna, Ekroni,
Ekegusii: na Eloni, na Timuna, na Ekironi,

English: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
Kiswahili: Elteke, Gibethoni, Baalathi,
Ekegusii: na Eliteke, na Gibetoni, na Baalati,

English: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,
Kiswahili: Yehudi, Bene-Beraki, Gath-Rimoni,
Ekegusii: na Yehudi, na Bene‐Beraki, na Gati‐Rimoni,

English: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.
Kiswahili: Me-Yarkoni na Rakoni, pamoja na eneo linalotazamana na Yafa.
Ekegusii: na Me‐Yarikoni, na Rakoni, amo nense erochie Yafo.

English: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.
Kiswahili: (Lakini Wadani walipata shida kulimiliki eneo lao; kwa hiyo walipanda kuishambulia Leshemu, wakaitwaa, wakawaua watu wake kwa upanga na kuukalia. Walikaa Leshemu na kuuita Dani kufuatana na jina la baba yao.)
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’egesaku gia Dani basiretie ense yabo, bakagenda Lesemu, bakayoumokera, bakayoira na bagaita abanto b’agwo nemioro. Bagasakora chinibo chiarengeo, bakamenya omochie oyio. Erio bakaonchora erieta ri’omochie oyio Lesemu, bakayoroka Dani, erieta ria sokoro yabo Dani.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
Kiswahili: Miji hii na vijiji vyake ndio iliyokuwa urithi wa kabila la Dani, ukoo kwa ukoo.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Dani.

English: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.
Kiswahili: Walipomaliza kugawanya nchi katika migawo kulingana na sehemu zao zilizowaangukia, Waisraeli wakampa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni urithi katikati yao,
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli kobakoorire gwatanana ense eria ase chinsemo ao ao, bakaa Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, ensemo ase egati yabo, ebe omwando oye.

English: According to Yahweh’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.
Kiswahili: kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa ameamuru. Walimpa mji alioutaka, ambao ni Timnath-Sera ulio katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu. Naye akajenga mji, akakaa huko.
Ekegusii: Na buna Omonene achigete bakamoa omochie oria aboretie, noro Timunati‐Sera ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu. Erio Yoshua akaagacha omochie oria okaba omoyia, akamenya aroro.

English: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maeneo ambayo kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na viongozi wa koo za kabila za Israeli waliyoyagawanya kwa kura huko Shilo mbele za Bwana penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania. Hivyo wakamaliza kuigawanya nchi.
Ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, baatananete ase ogoaka obomera aria Silo, ase okobori’Omonene, ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Nabo bagakoora emeremo y’ogwatanana ense eria.

English: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Yoshua,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Yoshua, akamoteebia,

English: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,
Kiswahili: “Waambie Waisraeli, watenge miji mikubwa ya kukimbilia, kama nilivyokuagiza kupitia Mose,
Ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a bachore emechie y’obotamero, buna nabateebetie goetera ase Musa.

English: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.
Kiswahili: ili mtu yeyote atakayemuua mtu kwa bahati mbaya na pasipo kukusudia aweze kukimbilia huko na kujiepusha na mlipiza kisasi wa damu.
Ekegusii: Omonto karaite omonto onde mosiabano atancheti, anyare gotamera oyomo bw’emechie eyio ase ogwetooria korwa ase oyomwabo oria oitetwe oganetie korusia egesiomba.

English: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.
Kiswahili: “Anapokimbilia mojawapo ya hii miji mikubwa atasimama kwenye maingilio ya lango la mji mkuu na kueleza wazee wa mji kuhusu shauri lake. Kisha watampokea katika mji wao na kumpa mahali pa kuishi nao.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria omoiti, ekero aratamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio goika agende atenene ase egeita ki’omochie oyio, akwane amang’ana aye nabatang’ani b’omochie oria. Barabwo bamosoyie ase omochie bamoe aase akomenya ase egati yabo.

English: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.
Kiswahili: Kama mlipiza kisasi wa damu akimfuatilia, wasimkabidhi yule mshtakiwa, kwa sababu alimuua jirani yake bila kukusudia, na bila kuwa na nia ya kudhuru.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto oria oganetie korusia egesiomba okomobwatia gochiao, abanto b’omochie oyio tibakorua omoiti oria ase amaboko aye, ekiagera aitete omoamate oye mosiabano, atamogechete.

English: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”
Kiswahili: Huyu aliyeua atakaa kwenye mji mkubwa huo mpaka awe amesimama kukabili mashtaka yake mbele ya kusanyiko na mpaka kuhani mkuu anayehudumu kwa wakati huo atakapokufa. Ndipo atakapoweza kurudi nyumbani kwake katika mji ambao aliukimbia.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria namenye ase omochie oria goika ere arentwe bosio bw’omosangererekano agambigwe na goika Omokuani Omonene bw’engaki eria akwe. Magega y’ayio arue ase omochie oria atamerete, airane nka ase omochie oye.”

English: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
Kiswahili: Basi wakatenga Kedeshi katika Galilaya kwenye nchi ya vilima ya Naftali, Shekemu katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, na Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni) kwenye nchi ya vilima ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: Ase igo bagaatanana Kedesi o Galili, ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Nafutali, na Sekemu ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na Kiriati‐Ariba (nao Heburoni), ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Yuda.

English: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Katika upande wa mashariki mwa Yordani ya Yeriko wakatenga Bezeri katika jangwa katika uwanda wa juu katika kabila la Reubeni, Ramothi katika Gileadi katika kabila la Gadi, na Golani huko Bashani katika kabila la Manase.
Ekegusii: Ngumbu ya moocha ya Yorodani ase erooro moocha ya Yeriko, bagachora Beseri ase orogongo rwa Rubeni, na Ramoti o Gileadi, ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Gadi, na Golani o Basani ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Manase.

English: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.
Kiswahili: Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni yeyote aishiye miongoni mwao aliyemuua mtu kwa bahati mbaya, angeweza kukimbilia katika miji mikubwa hiyo iliyotengwa na asiuawe na mlipiza kisasi wa damu kabla hajasimama kukabili mashtaka mbele ya kusanyiko.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio nero yachoretwe ebe obotamero ase Abaisraeli, na ase abamenyi abaare ase egati yabo. Onde bwensi orenge goita omonto mosiabano atame gochia aroro, erinde taitwa noria oganetie korusia egesiomba, ataratenena ase omosangererekano amang’ana aye agambwe.

English: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Basi viongozi wa jamaa ya Walawi, wakamwendea kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na viongozi wa jamaa nyingine za makabila ya Israeli
Ekegusii: Abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi bagaacha ase Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na ase abateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli,

English: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “Yahweh commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”
Kiswahili: huko Shilo katika Kanaani na kuwaambia, “Bwana aliamuru kupitia Mose kuwa mtupe miji ya kuishi yenye sehemu za malisho kwa mifugo yetu.”
Ekegusii: bagakwana nabarabwo agwo Silo, bakabateebia, “Omonene nigo achigete goetera ase Musa ng’a toegwe emechie ase tokomenya, amo namarisio, ase chitugo chiaito chirarisie.”

English: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kama vile Bwana alivyoamuru, Waisraeli wakawapa Walawi miji ifuatayo pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho kutoka urithi wao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakaa Abalawi emechie gete amo namarisio arengeo korwa ase emiando yabo, koreng’ana buna Omonene achigete.

English: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Kura ya kwanza ikaangukia Wakohathi, ukoo kwa ukoo. Walawi waliokuwa wazao wa kuhani Aroni walipewa miji kumi na mitatu kutoka makabila ya Yuda, Simeoni na Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera chiamate chi’Abakohati buna iga: Abalawi abarenge b’ororeria rwa Aroni, Omokuani, bakanyora emechie ikomi na etato korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simioni, na ekia Benjamini, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

English: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Wazao wengine waliobaki wa Wakohathi walipewa miji kumi kutoka koo za makabila ya Efraimu, Dani na nusu ya Manase.
Ekegusii: Na Abakohati abatigarete bakanyora emechie ikomi korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku ki’Efraimu na ekia Dani, na ekeng’ese kia Manase, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

English: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Gershoni walipewa miji kumi na mitatu kutoka koo za makabila ya Isakari, Asheri, Naftali na nusu ya Manase huko Bashani.
Ekegusii: Abagerisoni bakanyora emechie ikomi na etato korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru, na egi’Aseri, na ekia Nafutali, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase agwo Basani, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

English: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Merari, ukoo kwa ukoo, walipewa miji kumi na miwili kutoka makabila ya Reubeni, Gadi na Zabuloni.
Ekegusii: Abamerari bakanyora emechie ikomi na ebere ase chiamate chiabo korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, na egia Sabuloni.

English: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakawapa Walawi miji hii pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa ameamuru kupitia kwa Mose.
Ekegusii: Nabo Abaisraeli baete Abalawi emechie eyio amo namarisio arengeo, ase ogoaka obomera, buna Omonene konya achiikire goetera ase Musa.

English: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
Kiswahili: Kutoka makabila ya Yuda na Simeoni waligawa miji ifuatayo kwa majina
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simioni bakarua emechie eyio egwatorwa aiga.

English: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.
Kiswahili: (miji hii walipewa wazao wa Aroni ambao walitokana na koo za Wakohathi wa Walawi, kwa sababu kura ya kwanza iliwaangukia):
Ekegusii: Obomera bw’eritang’ani bokagwera abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, eamate eyemo y’Abakohati, abarenge Abalawi.

English: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.
Kiswahili: Waliwapa Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni), pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho zilizoizunguka, katika nchi ya vilima ya Yuda. (Arba alikuwa baba wa Anaki.)
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa Kiriati‐Ariba (noro Heburoni), ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Yuda, amo namarisio aetanaineo. (Ariba nigo arenge sokoro y’Anaki.)

English: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
Kiswahili: Lakini mashamba na vijiji vilivyozunguka mji mkubwa walikuwa wamempa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune kuwa milki yake.
Ekegusii: Korende emegondo amo nebichie bi’omochie oyio konya baeire Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, bikaba omwando oye.

English: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wazao wa kuhani Aroni wakapewa Hebroni (mji mkuu wa makimbilio kwa ajili ya yeyote aliyeshtakiwa kwa mauaji), Libna,
Ekegusii: Eye nero emechie abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni Omokuani baetwe: Heburoni, omochie oyio abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Libuna,

English: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Yatiri, Eshtemoa,
Ekegusii: na Yatiri, na Esitemoa,

English: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Holoni, Debiri,
Ekegusii: na Holoni, na Debiri,

English: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.
Kiswahili: Aini, Yuta na Beth-Shemeshi, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji tisa kutoka kwa makabila haya mawili.
Ekegusii: na Aini, na Yuta, na Beti‐Semesi, emechie kianda, amo namarisio arengeo, korwa ase ebisaku ebio bibere.

English: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Benyamini wakawapa Gibeoni, Geba,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini bakaegwa Gibeoni, na Geba,

English: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.
Kiswahili: Anathothi na Almoni, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.
Ekegusii: na Anatoti, na Alamoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Miji yote waliyopewa makuhani, wazao wa Aroni, ilikuwa kumi na mitatu, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho.
Ekegusii: Emechie yonsi abanto b’ororeria rwa Abakuani baetwe nigo yarenge ikomi na etato; bakayeegwa, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
Kiswahili: Koo nyingine za Wakohathi, ambao pia ni Walawi, walipewa miji kutoka kabila la Efraimu:
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati, abarenge Abalawi, bakaegwa emechie korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

English: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu walipewa Shekemu (mji mkubwa wa makimbilio kwa yeyote anayeshtakiwa kwa mauaji) na Gezeri,
Ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie oyomo abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na Geseri,

English: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.
Kiswahili: Kibsaimu na Beth-Horoni, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.
Ekegusii: na Kibusaimu, na Beti‐Horoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Pia kutoka kabila la Dani wakapokea Elteke, Gibethoni,
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Dani bakaegwa Eliteke, na Gibetoni,

English: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
Kiswahili: Aiyaloni na Gath-Rimoni pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne
Ekegusii: na Ayaloni, na Gati‐Rimoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.
Kiswahili: Kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase, wakapokea Taanaki na Gath-Rimoni pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji miwili.
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakaegwa Taanaki na Gati‐Rimoni, emechie ebere, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Miji yote hii kumi pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho ilipewa koo za Wakohathi zilizobaki.
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate echio chi’Abakohati nigo baetwe emechie eyio ikomi, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
Kiswahili: Koo za Walawi za Wagershoni walipewa: kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase, Golani katika Bashani (mji mkuu wa makimbilio kwa yeyote aliyeshtakiwa kwa mauaji) na Beeshtera, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji miwili;
Ekegusii: Abagerisoni, chiamate chinde chi’Abalawi, bakaegwa korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Golani o Basani, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Besitera, emechie ebere, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Isakari walipewa, Kishioni, Daberathi,
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kisioni, na Daberati,

English: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.
Kiswahili: Yarmuthi na En-Ganimu, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne
Ekegusii: na Yarimuti na Eni‐Ganimu, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Asheri walipewa, Mishali, Abdoni,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri bakaegwa Misali, na Abidoni,

English: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.
Kiswahili: Helkathi na Rehobu, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.
Ekegusii: na Helikati, na Rehobo, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Naftali walipewa, Kedeshi katika Galilaya (mji wa makimbilio kwa ajili ya yeyote anayeshtakiwa kwa mauaji), Hamoth-Dori na Kartani, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji mitano.
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi o Galili, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Hamoti‐Dori, na Karitani, emechie etato, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Miji yote ya koo za Wagershoni ilikuwa kumi na mitatu, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho.
Ekegusii: Nabo abanto be chiamate chionsi chi’Abagerisoni baetwe emechie ikomi na etato, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Koo za Wamerari (Walawi waliobaki) walipewa: kutoka kabila la Zabuloni, Yokneamu, Karta,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Abalawi abatigarete, chiamate chia Merari, bakaegwa emechie ya Yokinamu, na Karita,

English: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.
Kiswahili: Dimna na Nahalali, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne;
Ekegusii: na Dimuna, na Nahalali, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Reubeni walipewa Bezeri, Yahasa,
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni bakaegwa Beseri, na Yahasi,

English: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.
Kiswahili: Kedemothi na Mefaathi, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne;
Ekegusii: na Kedemoti, na Mefaati, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: kutoka kabila la Gadi walipewa, Ramothi katika Gileadi (mji wa makimbilio kwa ajili ya yeyote anayeshtakiwa kwa ajili ya mauaji), Mahanaimu,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti o Gileadi, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Mahanaimu,

English: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.
Kiswahili: Heshboni na Yazeri, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.
Ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na Yaeseri, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.
Kiswahili: Miji yote waliyopewa koo za Wamerari, waliokuwa mabaki ya Walawi, ilikuwa ni kumi na miwili.
Ekegusii: Nabo abanto b’eamate ya Merari, abatigarete ase chiamate chi’Abalawi, baetwe emechie ikomi na ebere, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

English: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Miji yote ya Walawi katika eneo lililoshikwa na Waisraeli lilikuwa arobaini na minane, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho.
Ekegusii: Emechie yonsi y’Abalawi eyarenge ase egati y’omwando bw’Abaisraeli nigo yarenge emerongo ene, na etano na etato, amo namarisio arengeo.

English: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja wa miji hii ulikuwa na sehemu ya malisho kuuzunguka; ndivyo ilivyokuwa kwa miji hii yote.
Ekegusii: Kera omochie bw’eyio nigo orenge namarisio aetanaineo, Nabo arenge ase emechie eyio yonsi.

English: So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akawapa Israeli nchi yote aliyokuwa ameapa kuwapa baba zao, nao wakaimiliki na kukaa humo.
Ekegusii: Ase ig’Omonene akaa Abaisraeli ense eyio yonsi arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nabayee; barabwo kobayeeirwe bakamenya aroro.

English: Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Yahweh delivered all their enemies into their hand.
Kiswahili: Bwana akawapa pumziko kila upande, kama vile alivyokuwa amewaapia baba zao, hakuna hata mmoja wa adui zao aliyeweza kusimama mbele yao, Bwana akawatia adui zao wote mikononi mwao.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabaa obotoereru ase chinsemo chionsi, buna arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ase ogotiana. Onde tarenge ase ababisa babo obabuete, ekiagera Omonene abegete ababisa babo bonsi ase amaboko abo.

English: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mojawapo ya ahadi nzuri ya Bwana kwa nyumba ya Israeli ambayo haikutimia; kila moja ilitimia.
Ekegusii: Nab’Omonene aikeranetie chiira chionsi chingiya echi abarierete Abaisraeli. Ende teri etaikeranetigwe.

English: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawaita Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase,
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akarangeria abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase,

English: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.
Kiswahili: naye akawaambia, “Mmeshafanya yale yote Mose mtumishi wa Bwana aliyowaamuru, nanyi mmenitii kwa kila jambo nililowaamuru.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Mwakorire amang’ana onsi Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abachigete mokore, na mwaigwereire amang’ana onsi aya nabachigete.

English: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda mrefu sasa, hadi siku hii ya leo, hamkuwaacha ndugu zenu, bali ninyi mmetimiza ile kazi Bwana Mungu wenu aliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aya amange timwatigete Abaisraeli bamino goika reero iga. Mwarendire mono na koigwera ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino abachigete mokore.

English: Now Yahweh your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Sasa kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa ndugu zenu pumziko kama alivyoahidi, rudini nyumbani mwenu katika nchi ile ambayo Mose mtumishi wa Bwana aliwapa ngʼambo ya Yordani.
Ekegusii: Bono Omonene, Nyasae oino, oeire abamino obotoereru, buna abarierete eira. Ase igo, bono irana ase chinka chiaino, ase ense eria mwanyorire ebe omwando oino, eria Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete ng’umbu ya Yorodani.

English: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mwe waangalifu sana kushika amri na sheria zile Mose mtumishi wa Bwana alizowapa: yaani kumpenda Bwana Mungu wenu na kuenenda katika njia zake zote, kutii amri zake, kushikamana naye kwa uthabiti na kumtumikia kwa moyo wenu wote na roho yenu yote.”
Ekegusii: Morende mono na koigwera amachiiko aya Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete; mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oino, na motaare ase chinchera chiaye chionsi. Moigwere amachiiko aye, mobe abegenwa asare, na momokorere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi.”

English: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawabariki na kuwaaga waende zao, nao wakaenda nyumbani mwao.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akabasesenia, akabaa ribaga, na barabwo bakagenda chinka chiabo.

English: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,
Kiswahili: (Kwa nusu ya kabila la Manase Mose alikuwa amewapa eneo katika Bashani na ile nusu nyingine ya hilo kabila Yoshua aliwapa eneo upande wa magharibi ya Yordani pamoja na ndugu zao). Yoshua alipowaaga waende zao nyumbani, aliwabariki,
Ekegusii: (Musa konya oeire ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase orogongo agwo Basani, na ekeng’ese kende Yoshua agakea orogongo ang’e nabamwabo, bosongo ya Yorodani.) Na ekero Yoshua abaete ribaga bagende chinka chiabo akabasesenia,

English: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”
Kiswahili: akisema, “Rudini nyumbani mwenu na utajiri wenu mwingi, yaani makundi makubwa ya mifugo, mkiwa na fedha, dhahabu, shaba na chuma, pia wingi wa nguo, nanyi mkagawane na ndugu zenu hizo nyara zilizotoka kwa adui zenu.”
Ekegusii: akabateebia “Irana chinka chiaino amo nobotenenku obo obonge mwanyorire, chitugo chinyinge amo ne chifeta ne chitaabu ne chitaai, na ebioma, amo ne chianga chinyinge. Ase ayio mwatananere abamino ebisakorwa ebio mwasakorete ababisa baino.”

English: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Wareubeni, Wagadi na hiyo nusu ya kabila la Manase wakawaacha Waisraeli huko Shilo katika nchi ya Kanaani ili kurudi Gileadi, nchi yao wenyewe waliyoipata sawasawa na agizo la Bwana kupitia Mose.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese kiegesaku kia Manase bagatiga Abaisraeli bande agwo Silo ase ense ya Kaanani, bakairana ase ense ya Gileadi, ense eria banyorete ase okomenya, buna Omonene konya achiikire goetera ase Musa.

English: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.
Kiswahili: Walipofika Gelilothi karibu na Yordani, katika nchi ya Kanaani, Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wakajenga madhabahu ya fahari kubwa huko kando ya Yordani.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Dani amo nekeng’ese gi’ekia Manase baigete Yorodani mbarabare ase ensemo ya Kaanani bakaagacha aroro egesasiimero ekenene kiare kororekana korwa are.

English: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wengine waliposikia kwamba Wareubeni, Wagadi na ile nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa wamejenga madhabahu kwenye mpaka wa Kanaani huko Gelilothi karibu na Yordani kwenye upande wa Israeli,
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande bakaigwa amang’ana aya agokwanwa, “Naama! Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase baagachire egesasiimero aria Geliloti, ensemo ya bosio bw’ense ya Kaanani, ang’e na Yorodani, erochie ensemo y’Abaisraeli.”

English: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.
Kiswahili: kusanyiko lote la Israeli wakakusanyika huko Shilo ili wakapigane vita dhidi yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli baigwete amang’ana ayio, omoganda obo bwonsi ogasangererekana agwo Silo, erinde ogende kobarwania esegi.

English: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wengine wakamtuma Finehasi mwana wa kuhani Eleazari katika nchi ya Gileadi, kwa Wareubeni, Wagadi na hiyo nusu ya kabila la Manase.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatoma Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, Omokuani, gochia ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Dani amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ase ense ya Gileadi.

English: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.
Kiswahili: Wakatuma pamoja naye watu kumi ambao ni viongozi, mmoja kwa kila kabila la Israeli, kila mmoja aliyekuwa kiongozi katika mgawanyiko wa jamaa miongoni mwa koo za Israeli.
Ekegusii: Amo na Finehasi bagatoma abatang’ani ikomi, oyomo bwa kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli; kera oyomo nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’eamate ase egesaku kiaye.

English: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,
Kiswahili: Walipofika Gileadi, kwa Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase, wakawaambia:
Ekegusii: Ekero barabwo baigete ase ense ya Gileadi, ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, bagakwana nabarabwo, bakabateebia,

English: “The whole congregation of Yahweh says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following Yahweh, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against Yahweh?
Kiswahili: “Kusanyiko lote la Bwana lasema: ‘Je, mmewezaje kuacha kumwamini Mungu wa Israeli jinsi hii? Mmewezaje kumwacha Bwana na kujijengea madhabahu dhidi yake na kumwasi?
Ekegusii: “Intwe nigo togokwana ribaga ri’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Omonene. Nase ki motari nobwegenwa ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli? Mwatigire Omonene reero ase okweagachera egesasiimero, mwabeire mamincha y’Omonene.

English: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,
Kiswahili: Je, dhambi ya Peori haikutosha? Hata ingawa kulikuja tauni juu ya kusanyiko la Bwana, mpaka leo hii hatujatakasika kutokana na dhambi hiyo!
Ekegusii: Inee! Ebibe biria twakorete ase ogosasiima Peori tibiatoisanete? Korwa ase ebibe biria titwana gochenwa nonya ngoika reero iga, na egesusuro gekanyora omoganda bwonsi bw’Omonene.

English: that you must turn away today from following Yahweh? It will be, since you rebel today against Yahweh, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.
Kiswahili: Je, sasa ndiyo mnamwacha Bwana? “ ‘Kama mkimwasi Bwana leo, kesho atalikasirikia kusanyiko lote la Israeli.
Ekegusii: Inee! Na bono inwe motagete gotiga Omonene? Onye mokwanga reero koigwera Omonene, ekeene, ankio nigo arabe nekeririanda ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli.

English: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of Yahweh, in which Yahweh’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against Yahweh, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than Yahweh our God’s altar.
Kiswahili: Kama nchi mnayomiliki imenajisika, vukeni mje katika nchi ya Bwana, mahali Maskani ya Bwana ilipo, nanyi mkajitwalie sehemu miongoni mwetu, lakini msije mkaasi dhidi ya Bwana wala dhidi yetu sisi kwa kujijengea madhabahu, zaidi ya madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Onye morooche ng’a ense eye mwaeirwe ebe eyaino tegwenereti mogosasimerao, imoka mwamboke gochia ase ense y’Omonene, ase obomenyo bwaye boteneine, moegwe chingongo chiaino agwo ase egati yaito. Timobaisa kwanga koigwera Omonene, gose kwanga gotoigwera intwe ase okweagachera egesasiimero kiaino ekeao goetania eki’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”
Kiswahili: Wakati Akani mwana wa Zera alipokosa uaminifu kwa vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu, je, ghadhabu haikulipata kusanyiko lote la Israeli? Hakuwa yeye peke yake aliyekufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inyora buna Akani, mosinto o Zera, amochete ase ebinto biria biatananetwe ase ogosirigwa; omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli nigo onyorete egesusuro ase engencho eyio, tari omonto oria bweka osirete ase ogosaria koria.”

English: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase walipowajibu viongozi wa koo za Israeli, wakisema:
Ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakairaneria abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakabateebia,

English: “The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, the Mighty One, God, Yahweh, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against Yahweh (don’t save us today),
Kiswahili: “Yeye Mwenye Nguvu, Mungu, Bwana! Yeye Mwenye Nguvu, Mungu, Bwana! Yeye anajua! Israeli na wajue! Kama huu umekuwa ni uasi au kukosa utii kwa Bwana, msituache hai siku hii ya leo.
Ekegusii: “Omobui nere Nyasae! Nere Omonene! Omobui nere Nyasae! Nere Omonene. Ere namanyete aya twakorire, nainwe Abaisraeli boigo moyamanye. Onye aya twakorire akorirwe mamincha y’Omonene, gose onye titwarenge nobwegenwa asare, rirorio timogototooria reero.

English: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following Yahweh; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let Yahweh himself require it.
Kiswahili: Kama tumejijengea madhabahu yetu wenyewe ili kumwacha Bwana na kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za nafaka, au kutoa sadaka za amani juu yake, Bwana mwenyewe na atupatilize leo.
Ekegusii: Onye tweagacheire egesasiimero giaito intwe abanyene ase ogotiga Omonene, na onye tokoruerao ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose ogw’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, tiga Omonene omonyene atoe egesusuro.

English: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with Yahweh, the God of Israel?
Kiswahili: “Sivyo! Tulifanya hivyo kwa hofu kwamba siku zijazo wazao wenu wanaweza wakawaambia wazao wetu, ‘Mna uhusiano gani na Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli?
Ekegusii: Taibo! Nigo twakorire aya, ekiagera twoboire ng’a gose ase engaki erache abana b’ororeria rwaino baise gocha koboria ab’orwaito: Inee! Nainwe more negetari ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli?

English: For Yahweh has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in Yahweh.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Bwana ameifanya Yordani kuwa mpaka kati yetu na ninyi, ninyi Wareubeni na Wagadi! Hamna fungu kwa Bwana.’ Kwa hiyo wazao wenu wanaweza wakawasababisha wazao wetu wakaacha kumcha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naki Omonene nigo akorete orooche rwa Yorodani rokaba orobebe egati yaito nainwe, inwe Abareubeni na Abagadi. Ase ayio timori negetari kende gionsi ase Omonene. Na igo abana b’ororeria rwaino mbaabaise kogera ab’orwaito tibamoiroka Omonene.

English: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo sababu tulisema, ‘Tujiweke tayari na tujenge madhabahu, lakini si kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa au dhabihu.’
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo twateebete: Tiga toagache egesasiimero, tari ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi,

English: but it will be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of Yahweh before him with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings;’ that your children may not tell our children in time to come, ‘You have no portion in Yahweh.’
Kiswahili: Badala yake, itakuwa ni ushahidi kati yetu na ninyi na vizazi vijavyo, kwamba tutamwabudu Bwana katika mahali patakatifu pake pamoja na sadaka zetu za kuteketezwa, dhabihu na sadaka za amani. Ndipo katika siku zijazo, wazao wenu hawataweza kuwaambia wazao wetu, ‘Ninyi hamna fungu katika Bwana.’
Ekegusii: otatiga ase okoba kirori egati yaito nainwe, na egati y’ororeria rwaito na orwaino, ng’a nigo tokomokorera Omonene ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ekeng’wanso kende amo neki’omorembe ase obosio bwaye. Aya nigo twakorire ase ogotanga abana b’ororeria rwaino tibaabaisa gocha goteebia ab’orwaito ng’a: Timori negetari ase Omonene.

English: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of Yahweh’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’
Kiswahili: “Nasi tulisema, ‘Ikiwa wakati wowote watatuambia hilo, au kuwaambia uzao wetu, tutawajibu hivi: Angalieni nakala hii ya madhabahu ya Bwana, ambayo baba zetu waliijenga, si kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu, bali kama ushahidi kati yetu na ninyi.’
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo twarengerererie ng’a: Kerabe babe bagokwana igo ase tore, gose ase abana b’ororeria rwaito, nabanyare kobairaneria: Rora, chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagachete egesasiimero keng’ana buna eki’Omonene. Eke tikeri ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose ekeng’wanso kende, otatiga kere kirori egati yaito nainwe.

English: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against Yahweh, and turn away today from following Yahweh, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides Yahweh our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”
Kiswahili: “Hili jambo la kumwasi Bwana na kumwacha siku hii ya leo kwa kujenga madhabahu kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na dhabihu, zaidi ya madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wetu iliyo mbele ya maskani yake na liwe mbali nasi.”
Ekegusii: Taibo! Ayio abe aare naintwe ng’a ntorigetie kwanga koigwera Omonene Nyasae, gose komotiga bono, ase okoagacha egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ekeng’wanso, gose korua okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, egesasiimero kere ao na keria kere bosio bw’Obomenyo bwaye.”

English: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.
Kiswahili: Wakati kuhani Finehasi na viongozi wa kusanyiko na wakuu wa koo za Israeli, waliposikia hayo waliyosema Wareubeni, Wagadi na Manase, wakaridhika.
Ekegusii: Ekero Finehasi, Omokuani, na abatang’ani b’omoganda abwo baare abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, abaare amo nere, baigwete aya abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi, amo nab’ekia Manase bakwanete, barabwo bagaisaneka.

English: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that Yahweh is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahweh. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of Yahweh’s hand.”
Kiswahili: Naye Finehasi mwana wa kuhani Eleazari, akawaambia Wareubeni, Wagadi na Manase, “Leo tunajua kwamba Bwana yuko pamoja nasi, kwa sababu hamkukosa uaminifu kwa Bwana katika jambo hili. Sasa mmewaokoa Waisraeli na mkono wa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, Omokuani, agateebia Abareubeni na Abagadi amo n’Abamanase, “Bono twamanyire ng’a Omonene nigo are ase egati yaito, ekiagera timwangete koba abegenwa ase Omonene. Igo mwatooririe Abaisraeli korwa ase egesusuro ki’Omonene.”

English: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Finehasi, mwana wa kuhani Eleazari na viongozi wakarudi Kanaani kutoka kwenye kukutana kwao na Wareubeni na Wagadi huko Gileadi nao wakatoa taarifa kwa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, Omokuani, na abatang’ani baria, bagatiga Abareubeni na Abagadi agwo Gileadi, bakairana gochia ase ense ya Kaanani, ase Abaisraeli, bakabairera amang’ana onsi.

English: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.
Kiswahili: Walifurahi kusikia taarifa hiyo, na wakamhimidi Mungu. Wala hawakuzungumza tena habari za kupigana vita dhidi yao ili kuharibu nchi ambayo Wareubeni na Wagadi waliishi.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akagwenera Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bagatogia Nyasae, na tibaaba bakoroberia korwania Abareubeni na Abagadi, gose gosaria ense eria bamenyete.

English: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God.”
Kiswahili: Nao Wareubeni na Wagadi wakayaita yale madhabahu Edi, yaani Shahidi: kwa kuwa itakuwa shahidi kati yetu na ninyi kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abareubeni na Abagadi bagateeba, “Egesasiimero eke nkirori egati yaito nainwe ng’a, Omonene nere Nyasae”, na igo bagakeroka “Kirori”.

English: After many days, when Yahweh had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda mrefu kupita, naye Bwana akawa amewapa Israeli pumziko mbele ya adui zao wote waliowazunguka, Yoshua, wakati huo akiwa mzee na umri ukiwa umeendelea sana,
Ekegusii: Magega y’engaki entambe, ekero Omonene konya aeire Abaisraeli obotoereru korwa ase ababisa babo abwo baabaetanaine, na Yoshua konya ogotire mono,

English: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.
Kiswahili: akawaita Israeli wote, wazee wao, viongozi, waamuzi na maafisa Yoshua akawaambia: “Mimi ni mzee na umri wangu umeendelea sana.
Ekegusii: akarangeria Abaisraeli bonsi: abagaaka, na abatang’ani, na abagaambi, amo nabaraai babo, akabateebia, “Inche nabeire omogaka omogotu mono.

English: You have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is Yahweh your God who has fought for you.
Kiswahili: Ninyi wenyewe mmeona kila kitu Bwana Mungu wenu, alichowatendea mataifa haya yote kwa ajili yenu. Ilikuwa ni Bwana Mungu wenu aliyewapigania.
Ekegusii: Inwe mweroreire aya onsi Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorire ase abanto aba bonsi b’ebisaku ebi ase engencho yaino. Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere obeire okobarwanera.

English: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni jinsi nilivyowagawia kama urithi kwa makabila yenu yote nchi ya mataifa yaliyobaki, yaani mataifa niliyowashinda, kati ya Mto Yordani na Bahari kuu upande wa magharibi.
Ekegusii: Rora, ase ogoaka obomera naatananeire ebisaku biaino ense y’abanto aba batigarete amo ney’abwo konya nasiririe, ebe omwando oino, ense yonsi korwa orooche rwa Yorodani goika Enyancha Enene ya bosongo.

English: Yahweh your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as Yahweh your God spoke to you.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wenu mwenyewe atawaondoa watoke mbele yenu. Atawafukuza mbele yenu, nanyi mtamiliki nchi yao, kama vile Bwana Mungu wenu alivyowaahidi.
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere oraserie abanto abwo baabatame, nainwe moire ense yabo moyemenye, buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, abarierete eira.

English: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;
Kiswahili: “Kuweni hodari sana, kuweni waangalifu kutii yote yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Sheria ya Mose, pasipo kugeuka upande wa kuume au kushoto.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, motenene bokong’u, morende na koigwera boronge aya onsi ariikire ase Egetabu ki’Amachiko a Musa, timoonchoka gochia aande onsi, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.

English: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;
Kiswahili: Msishirikiane na mataifa yaliyobakia katikati yenu, wala msiombe kwa majina ya miungu yao au kuapa kwayo. Msiitumikie wala kuisujudia.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gosanga nabaanto aba b’ebisaku batigarete ase egati yaino, gose timwatora amarieta e chinyasae chiabo, gose gotiana ase chirochio. Timochikorera gose gochisasiima.

English: but hold fast to Yahweh your God, as you have done to this day.
Kiswahili: Bali mtashikamana kwa uthabiti na Bwana, Mungu wenu, kama vile ambavyo mmefanya mpaka sasa.
Ekegusii: Inwe mobe abegenwa ase Omonene, buna mwabeire goika reero iga.

English: “For Yahweh has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.
Kiswahili: “Bwana amewafukuza mbele yenu mataifa makubwa na yenye nguvu, mpaka siku ya leo hakuna yeyote aliyeweza kusimama mbele yenu.
Ekegusii: Omonene oseririe abanto b’ebisaku ebinene bire ne chinguru; onde tari obabuire goika reero iga.

English: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is Yahweh your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja miongoni mwenu anafukuza watu elfu, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu anawapigania, kama alivyoahidi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo oino nanyare goseria abanto elifu eyemo, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere okobarwanera esegi, buna abarierete eira.

English: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kuweni waangalifu sana kumpenda Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, mwerende, momwanche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;
Kiswahili: “Lakini ikiwa mtageuka na kushikamana na mabaki ya mataifa haya yaliyosalia katikati yenu na kama mtaoana na kushirikiana nao,
Ekegusii: Moise koonchoka korwa asare, na mobwatane nabaanto aba batigarete ase egati yaino, na konyuomerana, na igo mobe mogosanga nabarabwo, nabarabwo nainwe,

English: know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you.
Kiswahili: basi mwe na hakika kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu hatawafukuza tena mataifa hayo mbele yenu. Badala yake, watakuwa tanzi na mitego kwenu, mijeledi migongoni mwenu, na miiba machoni mwenu, mpaka mwangamie kutoka nchi hii nzuri, ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa.
Ekegusii: rirorio goika momanye ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, tagoseria abanto aba korwa ase more, korende barabwo nigo barabe bakobatega, naende babe buna ebiranya bikobang’wania amakere aino, na buna amagwa akobeta amaiso aino. Goika mosirigwe kegima korwa ase ense eye engiy’Omonene, Nyasae oino, abaeire.

English: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.
Kiswahili: “Sasa mimi ninakaribia kwenda katika njia ya watu wote wa dunia. Mnajua kwa mioyo yenu na roho zenu kwamba hakuna ahadi zozote njema Bwana Mungu wenu alizowaahidia, ambazo hazikutimia. Kila ahadi imetimizwa, hakuna hata moja ambayo haikutimia.
Ekegusii: “Bono nkogenda inde enchera eria abanto bonsi b’ense bagochia. Mwamanyire buya ase chinkoro chiaino ime, na ase emioyo yaino boigo, ng’a timoremeiri gento kende gionsi ekiya eke Omonene, Nyasae oino, abarierete eira ng’a nakebae. Amang’ana ayio onsi aikeranire, rinde tiriremeti.

English: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you,
Kiswahili: Lakini kama vile kila ahadi njema ya Bwana Mungu wenu imekuwa kweli, vivyo hivyo Bwana ataleta maovu yote kama alivyo onya, mpaka awe amewaangamiza kutoka nchi hii nzuri aliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Bun’Omonene, Nyasae oino aikeranetie amaya onsi aya abarierete eira ng’a nakore, naboigo araikeranie amabe onsi goika abasirie korwa ase ense eye engiya abaeire.

English: when you disobey the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then Yahweh’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”
Kiswahili: Kama mkilivunja agano la Bwana Mungu wenu, ambalo aliwaamuru ninyi, mkaenda na kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuisujudia, hasira ya Bwana itawaka dhidi yenu, nanyi mtaangamia kutoka nchi nzuri aliyowapa ninyi.”
Ekegusii: Onye mogosaria okobwatana kw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, okwo abachigete, naende mogokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasiima, erio endamwamu yaye inayoke igoro yaino, nainwe bwango mosire korwa ase ense eye engiya abaeire.”

English: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akaita pamoja makabila yote ya Israeli huko Shekemu. Akawaita wazee, viongozi, waamuzi na maafisa wa Israeli, nao wakaja mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Yoshua agasangereria ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli agwo Sekemu. Akarangeria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani, na abagaambi, amo nabaraai babo, nabarabwo bagacha ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: Joshua said to all the people, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia watu wote, “Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo: ‘Hapo zamani baba zenu, pamoja na Tera baba yake Abrahamu na Nahori, waliishi ngʼambo ya Mto nao waliiabudu miungu mingine.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agakwana nabaanto bonsi, akabateebia, “Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli; agokwana: Agwo kare chisokoro chiaino amo na Tera, ise Aburaamu, na Nahori, nigo bamenyete ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Eufarati bakaba bagokorera chinyasae ching’ao.

English: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.
Kiswahili: Lakini nilimwondoa baba yenu Abrahamu kutoka nchi hiyo ngʼambo ya Mto, nami nikamwongoza katika nchi yote ya Kanaani, nikampa wazao wengi. Nikampa Isaki,
Ekegusii: Korende inche nkarusia Aburaamu, sokoro yaino, korwa ng’umbu y’orooche orwo, nkamotang’ana, ere agaeta ase ense engima ya Kaanani; nkamenta oroiboro rwaye. Nkamoa Isaka,

English: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
Kiswahili: naye Isaki nikampa Yakobo na Esau. Esau nikampa nchi ya vilima ya Seiri, lakini Yakobo pamoja na wanawe wakashuka Misri.
Ekegusii: na Isaka nere nkamoa Yakobo na Esau. Esau nkamoa ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu ekaba eyaye, korende Yakobo na abana baye bagatirimboka gochia Misiri.

English: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kisha nikawatuma Mose na Aroni, nami nikawapiga Wamisri kwa kile nilichokitenda huko, tena nikawatoa ninyi huko.
Ekegusii: Erio ngatoma Musa na Aroni, ngaaka Abamisiri namaakwa aya nabarenterete, na magega y’ayio nkabarusia inwe aroro.

English: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: Nilipowatoa baba zenu Misri, mlifika kwenye bahari, nao Wamisri wakawafuatia baba zenu kwa magari na wapanda farasi mpaka kwenye Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: Nkarusia chisokoro chiaino korwa Misiri, mogaika ase Enyancha Embariri, Abamisiri bakababwatia goikao ne chigari ne chibarasi.

English: When they cried out to Yahweh, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakamlilia Bwana wakitaka msaada, naye akaweka giza kati yenu na Wamisri, akaileta bahari juu yao ikawafunika. Ninyi mliona kwa macho yenu wenyewe kile nilichowatendea Wamisri. Kisha mliishi jangwani kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Erio chisokoro chiaino chikarera ase ’nde inche Omonene, mbakonye, na inche nkabeka omosunte ase egati yaino na Abamisiri. Nkaonchora enyancha egatuba Abamisiri ekabamera. Ee, ’mwaroche namaiso aino aya nakorete ase Abamisiri. Erio ase engaki entambe mokamenya ase erooro.

English: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nikawaleta katika nchi ya Waamori ambao waliishi mashariki mwa Yordani. Wakapigana nanyi, lakini nikawatia mikononi mwenu. Nikawaangamiza mbele yenu nanyi mkaimiliki nchi yao.
Ekegusii: “Magega y’ayio nkabarenta ase ense y’Abaamori, baria bamenyete moocha ya Yorodani. Barabwo bakabarwania, korende inche nkababeka ase amaboko aino. Inwe mokaira ense yabo, na inche nkabasiria ase amasio aino.

English: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,
Kiswahili: Wakati Balaki mwana wa Sipori, mfalme wa Moabu, alipojiandaa kupigana dhidi ya Israeli, alimwita Balaamu mwana wa Beori apate kuwalaani.
Ekegusii: Erio Balaki, omorwoti o Moabu, mosinto o Sipori, akaimoka kobarwania inwe Abaisraeli. Akarangeria Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, achiche kobaragereria,

English: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.
Kiswahili: Lakini sikumkubali Balaamu, kwa hiyo aliwabariki tena na tena, nami niliwaokoa toka mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: korende tinancha koigwera Baalamu. Ase ayio akabasesenia, nainche nkabatooria korwa ase amaboko a Balaki.

English: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ndipo mlipovuka Yordani mkafika Yeriko. Raiya wa Yeriko wakapigana nanyi, kama walivyofanya Waamori, Waperizi, Wakanaani, Wahiti, Wagirgashi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, lakini niliwatia mikononi mwenu.
Ekegusii: Mokaamboka Yorodani, mogaika Yeriko. Abanto ba Yeriko bakabarwania, naboigo Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abagirigasi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi bakorete, korende nkababeka ase amaboko aino.

English: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.
Kiswahili: Nikatuma manyigu mbele yenu, ambao pia waliwafukuza mbele yenu, hao wafalme wawili wa Waamori. Siyo upanga au upinde wenu wenyewe vilivyowapatia ushindi.
Ekegusii: Ngatoma ebiaramba bikabarasa, na ase ebio abarwoti babere b’Abaamori bagasirigwa bosio bwaino, tari ase emioro yaino, gose ase amata aino.

English: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’
Kiswahili: Hivyo nikawapa ninyi nchi ambayo hamkuitaabikia na miji ambayo hamkuijenga na mnaishi ndani yake na kula toka kwa mashamba ya mizabibu na mizeituni msiyoipanda.’
Ekegusii: Nkabaa ense ase motakorete emeremo, na emechie motaagachete. Nigo momenyete ase emechie eyio na koria okwama kw’emesabibu na okw’emezeituni motasimegete.

English: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi mcheni Bwana na kumtumikia kwa uaminifu wote. Itupeni mbali miungu ambayo baba zenu waliiabudu huko ngʼambo ya Mto Frati na huko Misri, nanyi mtumikieni Bwana.
