Ekegusii: “Ase igo moiroke Omonene na komokorera ase okoigwera na ase obwegenwa. Rusia korwa ase more chinyasae chiria chisokoro chiaino chiare gokorera aaria ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Eufarati na ase ense ya Misiri; mokorere Omonene bweka.

English: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Lakini msipoona vyema kumtumikia Bwana, chagueni hivi leo mtakayemtumikia, kama ni miungu ile ambayo baba zenu waliitumikia ngʼambo Frati, au miungu ya Waamori, ambao mnakaa katika nchi yao. Lakini mimi na nyumba yangu, tutamtumikia Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Kerabe timogokiri gokorera Omonene, rirorio mwechorere reero oyo mwanchete gokorera, onye ne chinyasae chiria chisokoro chiaino chiakorerete ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Eufarati, gose chinyasae chi’Abaamori, baria momenyete ase ense yabo. Korende inche amo nabaanto b’enyomba yane ntomokorere Omonene.”

English: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;
Kiswahili: Ndipo hao watu wakajibu, “Hili jambo liwe mbali nasi la kumsahau Bwana na kuitumikia miungu mingine!
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakairaneria, “Taibo. Titorigeti gotiga Omonene na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao.

English: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wetu mwenyewe ndiye alitutoa sisi na baba zetu akatupandisha kutoka Misri, kutoka nchi ile ya utumwa, na kutenda zile ishara kubwa mbele ya macho yetu. Ndiye aliyetulinda katika safari yetu yote na kutokana na mataifa yote ambayo tulipita katikati yao.
Ekegusii: Naki Omonene, Nyasae oito, nere otong’anyetie intwe amo ne chisokoro chiaito korwa Misiri, ense eria ase twarenge abasomba. Nere okorete ebikone ebinene ase amasio aito, naende nere otorendete aande onsi twaetete ase egati y’abanto aba bonsi.

English: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akayafukuza mbele yetu mataifa yote pamoja na Waamori, walioishi katika nchi hii. Hivyo sisi nasi tutamtumikia Bwana kwa kuwa yeye ndiye Mungu wetu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agatosereria Abaamori aba bonsi abamenyete ase ense eye. Ase ayio, ntorigetie komokorera Omonene. Ere nere Nyasae oito.”

English: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve Yahweh, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia watu, “Hamwezi kumtumikia Bwana. Yeye ni Mungu Mtakatifu, ni Mungu mwenye wivu. Hatasamehe uasi wenu na dhambi zenu.
Ekegusii: Yoshua agateebia abanto, “Timokonyara komokorera Omonene. Ere Nyasae omochenu, na Nyasae bwe risemi; takobaabera ogosaria kwaino na ebibe biaino.

English: If you forsake Yahweh, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mkimwacha Bwana na kuitumikia miungu migeni, atageuka na kuwaleteeni maafa na kuwaangamiza, baada ya kuwa mwema kwenu.”
Ekegusii: Moise gotiga Omonene na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao, nere neonchore abatige, nabae egesusuro na abasirie, magega kabakoreire amaya ritang’ani.”

English: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wakamwambia Yoshua, “Sivyo! Sisi tutamtumikia Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakamoiraneria, “Taibo! Intwe inatomokorere Omonene.”

English: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen Yahweh yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawaambia, “Ninyi mmekuwa mashahidi juu yenu wenyewe kuwa mmechagua kumtumikia Bwana.” Nao wakajibu, “Ndiyo, tu mashahidi.”
Ekegusii: Yoshua akabateebia, “Inwe mwebereire birori ng’a mwachorire Omonene.” Bakairaneria, “Ee, twebereire birori intwe abanyene.”

English: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to Yahweh, the God of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia, “Sasa basi, itupeni mbali hiyo miungu migeni iliyo katikati yenu, nanyi mtoleeni Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, mioyo yenu.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rusia chinyasae chingeni echire ase egati yaino, moonchore chinkoro chiaino ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.”

English: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve Yahweh our God, and we will listen to his voice.”
Kiswahili: Nao watu wakamwambia Yoshua, “Tutamtumikia Bwana Mungu wetu na kumtii yeye.”
Ekegusii: Abanto bakairaneria Yoshua, “Omonene, Nyasae oito, nere torakorere, na amang’ana aye naro toraigwere.”

English: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
Kiswahili: Siku ile Yoshua akafanya agano kwa ajili ya watu na hapo Shekemu ndipo alipowaandikia amri na sheria.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Yoshua agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabaanto abwo, na agwo Sekemu akabaa amachiiko na emeroberio barabwatie.

English: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Naye Yoshua akayaandika mambo haya katika Kitabu cha Sheria ya Mungu. Ndipo akalitwaa jiwe kubwa, akalisimamisha huko chini ya mwaloni, karibu na mahali patakatifu pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Yoshua akarika amang’ana aria ase Egetabu ki’amachiiko a Nyasae. Erio agatenenia rigena rinene agwo inse y’Omoaluni, oteneine ang’e n’Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene.

English: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all Yahweh’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”
Kiswahili: Yoshua akawaambia watu wote, “Angalieni! Jiwe hili litakuwa shahidi juu yetu. Limesikia maneno yote Bwana aliyotuambia. Litakuwa shahidi juu yenu kama mtakuwa waongo kwa Mungu wenu.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia abanto bonsi, “Rigena eri nigo rirabe kirori ase tore, riaigure amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene akwana naintwe. Ase igo riabeire kirori igoro yaino, erinde mobe abegenwa ase Nyasae oino.”

English: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
Kiswahili: Basi Yoshua akawatuma watu kila mmoja aende katika urithi wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akaa abanto ribaga bakagenda kera oyomo ase omwando oye.

English: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mambo haya, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, mtumishi wa Bwana akafa akiwa na umri wa miaka mia moja na kumi.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omosomba bw’Omonene, agakwa gakoorire emiaka rigana, na ikomi (110).

English: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
Kiswahili: Nao wakamzika katika nchi ya urithi wake, huko Timnath-Sera katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, kaskazini ya Mlima wa Gaashi.
Ekegusii: Bakamotindeka ase omochie bw’omwando oye, agwo Timunati‐Sera, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, sugusu y’egetunwa kia Gaasi.

English: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Yahweh, that he had worked for Israel.
Kiswahili: Israeli wakamtumikia Bwana siku zote za maisha ya Yoshua, na za hao wazee walioishi baada ya Yoshua kufa, ambao waliona kila kitu Bwana alichowatendea Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko a Yoshua Abaisraeli bakaba bagokorera Omonene, naende bagakora boigo ase amatuko ’abagaaka baria batigarete magega y’ogokwa kwa Yoshua, abwo bamanyete amang’ana ay’Omonene akorete ase Abaisraeli.

English: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
Kiswahili: Nayo ile mifupa ya Yosefu, ambayo Waisraeli waliipandisha kutoka huko Misri, wakaizika huko Shekemu kwenye eneo, ambalo Yakobo alilinunua kwa wana wa Hamori baba yake Shekemu, kwa vipande mia vya fedha. Eneo hili likawa ni urithi wa uzao wa Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Amauga a Yusufu, aya Abaisraeli barentete korwa Misiri, agatindekwa agwo Sekemu, ase oboremo bw’ense eria Yakobo agorete korwa ase basinto ba Hamori, ise Sekemu, ase rigori rie chifeta rigana erimo (100). Oboremo obo bokaba omwando bw’ororeria rwa Yusufu.

English: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.
Kiswahili: Naye Eleazari mwana wa Aroni akafariki akazikwa huko Gibea, mlima aliokuwa amepewa mtoto wake Finehasi, kwenye nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Na Eleazari, mosinto o Aroni, agakwa, agatindekwa Gibea, omochie oyio Finehasi, omwana oye, aetwe ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu.

English: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of Yahweh, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kifo cha Yoshua, Waisraeli wakamuuliza Bwana, “Ni nani atakayetangulia kupanda mbele yetu kwa ajili ya kupigana na Wakanaani?”
Ekegusii: Magega Yoshua gakuure, Abaisraeli bakamoboori’Omonene, “Mbanto ba gesaku ki ase egati yaito barabe b’eritang’ani kobachiera Abakaanani ase esegi?”

English: Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akajibu, “Yuda ndiye atakayetangulia; nimewapa hiyo nchi mikononi mwao.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akabairaneria, “Abayuda ’mbabe ab’eritang’ani kogeenda; rora, nayebeekire ense eria ase amaboko abo.”

English: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wa Yuda wakawaambia Wasimeoni ndugu zao, “Pandeni pamoja nasi katika nchi tuliyopewa, ili tupate kupigana na Wakanaani. Sisi pia tutakwenda pamoja nanyi katika sehemu yenu mliyopewa.” Basi Wasimeoni wakaenda pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Abayuda bakabateebia Abasimeoni bamwabo, “Inchuo tobwaterane, inwe motiire amo naintwe gochia ase orogongo orore omwando oito, tobarwanie Abakaanani. Erio naintwe ’natogende boigo amo nainwe ase orogongo rwaino rore.” Ase ayio Abasimeoni bagaitaba kogeenda amo nabarabwo.

English: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
Kiswahili: Yuda aliposhambulia, Bwana akawatia Wakanaani na Waperizi mikononi mwao, nao wakawaua watu 10,000 huko Bezeki.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayuda bakageenda korwana esegi, n’Omonene akababeeka Abakaanani n’Abaperisi ase amaboko abo; Abayuda bagaita abanto chiribu ikomi agwo Bezeki.

English: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
Kiswahili: Huko ndiko walipomkuta huyo Adoni-Bezeki, nao wakapigana naye na kuwafanya Wakanaani na Waperizi wakimbie.
Ekegusii: Bakababua Abakaanani n’Abaperisi; bakanyora Adoni‐Bezeki agwo, erio bakamorwania.

English: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
Kiswahili: Adoni-Bezeki pia alikimbia, nao wakamfuata na kumkamata, wakamkata vidole vyake gumba vya mikono na vya miguu.
Ekegusii: Adoni‐Bezeki agatama, korende Abayuda bakamominyokia, bakamobwata na komonacha ebiara biaye ebinene bi’amaboko nebi’amagoro.

English: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Adoni-Bezeki akasema, “Nimewatendea wafalme sabini kama nilivyotendewa na kuwalisha makombo ya chakula chini ya meza yangu. Sasa Mungu amenilipa haya, kama yale niliyowatendea.” Wakamleta Yerusalemu, naye akafa huko.
Ekegusii: Erio Adon‐Bezeki agateeba, “’Nababerete Abarwoti emerongo etano n’ebere, abwo ebiara biabo ebinene bi’amaboko n’ebi’amagoro bianachetwe, barenge gochoora amatori korwa nyaaro y’emesa yane. Na bono Nyasae ong’iraneirie egesiomba buna inche nabakorerete barabwo.” Erio akarentwa Yerusalemu, agakwera aroro.

English: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Yuda wakashambulia pia Yerusalemu na kuiteka. Wakaupiga mji kwa upanga na kuuchoma kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Abayuda bakayorwania Yerusalemu na koyoira. Bagakenyana abanto b’aroro na kobaita, erio bagasaamba omochie oyio n’omorero.

English: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo, watu wa Yuda wakateremka kupigana na Wakanaani walioishi katika nchi ya vilima, yaani, Negebu na nchi chini ya vilima vya magharibi.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio bagatirimboka kobarwania Abakaanani abamenyete ase ense y’ebigoro, na kororia Irianyi, boigo Negebu, na ase ense omweya.

English: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
Kiswahili: Yuda wakakabiliana na Wakanaani walioishi Hebroni (ambayo hapo kwanza iliitwa Kiriath-Arba) na kuwashinda Sheshai, Ahimani na Talmai.
Ekegusii: Naende bakageenda kobarwania Abakaanani abamenyete ase omochie o Heburoni, oyio ase amatuko amagega omanyekanete buna Kiriati‐Ariba. Bakababua abaSesai, ab’Ahimani, na abaTalimai.

English: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)
Kiswahili: Kutoka huko wakasonga mbele kukabiliana na watu walioishi Debiri (ambao hapo kwanza uliitwa Kiriath-Seferi.)
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo Abayuda bakageenda kobarwania abanto b’omochie o Debiri, oyio ase amatuko amagega omanyekanete buna Kiriati‐Seferi.

English: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”
Kiswahili: Kalebu akasema, “Nitamwoza binti yangu Aksa kwa mtu atakayeweza kupigana na kuteka Kiriath-Seferi.”
Ekegusii: Kalebu agateeba, “Onde bwensi orayochiere omochie o Kiriati‐Seferi na koyoira, inche nimoe omoiseke one Akisa abe mokaaye.”

English: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.
Kiswahili: Basi Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu mdogo wa huyo Kalebu, akawashinda, kwa hiyo Kalebu akamtoa binti yake Aksa akaolewa naye.
Ekegusii: Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, omomura omoke omwabo Kalebu, akayobua omochie oyio. Erio Kalebu akamoa Akisa, omoiseke oye, akaba mokaaye.

English: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”
Kiswahili: Siku moja Aksa alipokuja kwa Othnieli, alimsihi Othnieli amwombe baba yake, Kalebu, shamba. Aksa aliposhuka kutoka juu ya punda wake, Kalebu akamuuliza, “Je, wataka nikufanyie nini?”
Ekegusii: Ekero Akisa aigete bw’Otinieli, akamobooria Otinieli amosabe isebiara amoe omogoondo. Erio agwo Akisa agaika korwa etigere igoro, na Kalebu akamobooria, “Ninki oganetie?”

English: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
Kiswahili: Akamjibu, “Naomba unifanyie jambo moja la hisani. Kwa kuwa umenipa ardhi huko Negebu, nipe pia chemchemi za maji.” Ndipo Kalebu akampa chemchemi za juu na za chini.
Ekegusii: Akisa akamoiraneria, “Nekeegwa ’nganetie, ekiagera ’ngwansogetie okang’ira ase ense enyomo ya Negebu. Ase ayio, ing’a chinsooko chi’amaache.” Kalebu akamoa chinsooko chia amaache chia rogoro amo n’echia maate.

English: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa yule Mkeni, baba mkwe wa Mose, wakapanda pamoja na watu wa Yuda kutoka Mji wa Mitende, wakaenda kuishi miongoni mwa watu wa jangwa ya Yuda huko Negebu karibu na mji wa Aradi.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeeria rw’oyomo bw’Abaakeni, ise biara Musa, bakageenda amo n’Abayuda korwa ase Omochie bw’Emekendo gochia erooro, Irianyi y’Aradi, ase ense ya Yuda, na bakamenya ase egati y’ abanto b’aroro.

English: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
Kiswahili: Basi watu wa Yuda wakaenda na Wasimeoni ndugu zao kushambulia Wakanaani waishio Sefathi, nao wakauangamiza huo mji kabisa. Kwa hiyo huo mji ukaitwa Horma
Ekegusii: Abayuda bakageenda amo n’Abasimeoni bamwabo, bakabarwania Abakaanani aria Sefati na kobabua. Bakayosaria omochie oria kegima; magega y’ayio bagasiria erieta riaye bakayoroka Horima.

English: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Yuda wakatwaa pia Gaza, Ashkeloni na Ekroni, kila mji na vijiji vyake vinavyouzunguka.
Ekegusii: Abayuda bakayeira Gasa, n’Asikeloni, na Ekironi, amo ne chinsemo chiaetanaine emechie eyio.

English: Yahweh was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa pamoja na watu wa Yuda. Wakaimiliki nchi ya vilima, lakini hawakuweza kuwafukuza watu waliokaa katika hiyo tambarare, kwa sababu walikuwa na magari ya chuma.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge amo n’Abayuda, na barabwo bakayeira ense y’ebitunwa, korende tibanyaarete goseeria abanto bamenyete ase ense omweya, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo babwate chigari chi’ebioma.

English: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Mose alivyoahidi, Kalebu alipewa Hebroni, naye akawafukuza wana watatu wa Anaki.
Ekegusii: Na buna Musa ateebete, Kalebu akaegwa omochie o Heburoni, nere agaseeria abanto batato b’ororeeria rw’Anaki korwao.

English: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Wabenyamini walishindwa kuwafukuza Wayebusi, waliokuwa wanaishi Yerusalemu; hivyo hadi leo Wayebusi huishi humo pamoja na Wabenyamini.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto b’eamate ya Benjamini tibaabaseretie Abayebusi, abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu. Ase ayio Abayebusi nigo bagendererete komenya Yerusalemu amo n’Ababenjamini nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.
Kiswahili: Basi nyumba ya Yosefu wakashambulia Betheli, naye Bwana alikuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge amo n’abanto b’eamate ya Yusufu. Barabwo bakageenda kobarwania abanto b’omochie o Beteli.

English: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)
Kiswahili: Walipotuma watu kwenda kupeleleza Betheli (ambao hapo kwanza uliitwa Luzu),
Ekegusii: Bagachitoma chirooti gochia Beteli. Agwo ase amatuko akare omochie oyio nigo omanyekanete buna Lusu.

English: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”
Kiswahili: wale wapelelezi wakaona mtu anatoka mjini, nao wakamwambia, “Tuonyeshe jinsi ya kuingia mjini nasi tutakutendea wema.”
Ekegusii: Abanto baria chirooti bakamorora omonto oyomo ogosoka korwa ase omochie oria, bakamoteebia, “Tworokie ng’ai toranyaare gosoera ime y’omochie oyo, naintwe ’ntogokorere amaya.”

English: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akawaonyesha, nao wakaupiga mji kwa upanga lakini wakamhifadhi hai yule mtu na jamaa yake yote.
Ekegusii: Akaborokia ase baranyare gosoera gochia omochie oria. Barabwo bakabakenyana abanto bande bonsi, bakamotiga omonto oria amo neamate yaye bare moyo.

English: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akaenda hadi nchi ya Wahiti, ambapo aliujenga mji na kuuita Luzu, ambao ndio jina lake hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akageenda ase ense y’Abahiti, akayoagaacha omochie oye aroro, akayoroka Lusu, buna orenge korokwa omochakano; naende nabo okorokwa goika reero iga.

English: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
Kiswahili: Lakini Manase hawakuwafukuza watu wa Beth-Shani na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Taanaki na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Dori na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Ibleamu na vijiji vyake, au watu wa Megido na vijiji vyake, lakini Wakanaani waliazimu kuishi katika nchi ile.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Manase tibaabang’anyetie abanto bamenyete Beti‐Sehani, na Taanaki, na Dori, na Ibileamu, na Megido, amo n’ebichie biabo. Korende Abakaanani baria ’mbagendererete komenya ase ense eria.

English: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
Kiswahili: Israeli walipopata nguvu, wakawatia Wakanaani katika kazi ya kulazimishwa, lakini kamwe hawakuwafukuza watoke kabisa.
Ekegusii: Agwo magega, ekero Abaisraeli babeire ne chinguru, bakabetereria Abakaanani baabakorere emeremo emekong’u, korende tibaabang’anyetie korwa ense eria.

English: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
Kiswahili: Wala Efraimu hawakuwafukuza kabisa Wakanaani walioishi Gezeri, bali Wakanaani waliendelea kuishi humo miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Efraimu tibaabang’anyetie Abakaanani abamenyete ase omochie o Geseri. Ase igo Abakaanani bakagenderera komenya ase egati yabo.

English: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo Zabuloni hawakuwafukuza Wakanaani walioishi huko Kitroni, wala walioishi Nahaloli, ambao walibaki miongoni mwao; bali waliwatia katika kazi ya kulazimishwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku gia Sabuloni tibaabang’anyetie abanto bamenyete ase emechie ya Kitironi na Nahalali. Ase ayio Abakaanani baria bakagenderera komenya agwo ase egati yabo, korende bakabetererigwa kobakorera emeremo emekong’u.

English: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
Kiswahili: Wala Asheri hawakuwafukuza wale walioishi huko Ako, Sidoni, Alabu, Akzibu, Helba, Afeki wala Rehobu
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri tibaabang’anyetie abanto bamenyete ase emechie y’Ako, na Sidoni, n’Alabu, n’Akisibu, na Heliba, n’Afeki, na Rehobu.

English: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.
Kiswahili: na kwa sababu ya jambo hili Waasheri wakaishi miongoni mwa Wakanaani, wenyeji wa nchi.
Ekegusii: Nabo Abaaseri bagendererete komenya ase egati y’Abakaanani, ababiare b’ense eria, ekiagera barabwo tibang’anyetigwe korwao.

English: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.
Kiswahili: Wala Naftali hawakuwafukuza wale walioishi Beth-Shemeshi wala wale walioishi Beth-Anathi; lakini Naftali nao pia wakaishi miongoni mwa Wakanaani, wenyeji wa nchi, nao wale walioishi Beth-Shemeshi na Beth-Anathi wakawa watumishi wao katika kazi ya kulazimishwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Nafutali tibaabang’anyetie abanto bamenyete ase emechie ya Beti‐Semesi na Beti‐Anati. Ase igo bakaba bakomenya ase egati y’ Abakaanani, ababiare b’ense eria, bakabetereria abanto ba Beti‐Semesi na Beti‐Anati kobakorera emeremo emekong’u.

English: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
Kiswahili: Waamori wakawazuilia Wadani kwenye nchi ya vilima, kwa maana hawakuwaacha washuke kuingia kwenye sehemu tambarare.
Ekegusii: Abaamori bakamiga abanto b’egesaku gia Dani gochia ense y’ebigoro gose tibaabatigerete ribaga batirimboke gochia ase ense omweya,

English: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
Kiswahili: Waamori pia wakaendelea kukaa katika Mlima Heresi, katika Aiyaloni na Shaalbimu, lakini mkono wa nyumba ya Yosefu ukawalemea, nao wakashindwa hata wakalazimika kuingia katika kazi ya kulazimishwa.
Ekegusii: Abaamori bakabwaterera ensemo yabo y’egetunwa kia Heresi, n’Ayaloni, na Shaalabimu, korende abanto b’eamate ya Yusufu bakabaengera, bakababetereria babakorere emeremo emekong’u.

English: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
Kiswahili: Mpaka wa Waamori ulikuwa kuanzia Genge la Akrabimu, kuendelea hadi Sela na kuelekea juu.
Ekegusii: Agwo aase ensinyo ya sugusu ya Sera, orobebe rw’Abaamori rokabeekerwa ase egetirimboko gia Akirabimu.

English: Yahweh’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana akakwea kutoka Gilgali hadi Bokimu, naye akasema, “Niliwapandisha kutoka Misri na kuwaingiza katika nchi niliyoapa kuwapa baba zenu. Nikasema, ‘Kamwe sitalivunja Agano langu nanyi.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene agatiira korwa Giligali, agaika Bokimu, agateebia Abaisraeli, “Inche nigo nababooretie korwa Misiri, ’nkabarenta ase ense eye narierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nimbayee. ’Ngateeba: Tingosaria okobwatana gwa kare na kare kw’ogotianania okwo nakorete nainwe.

English: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?
Kiswahili: Nanyi msifanye agano na watu wa nchi hii, bali mtazibomoa madhabahu yao.’ Lakini ninyi hamkunitii mimi. Kwa nini mmefanya jambo hili?
Ekegusii: Boigo, nainwe timokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’ababiare b’ense eye. Inwe goika mobitaagore ebisasimero biabo, mobiiyerie inse. Korende timonyigwereti. Bono ninki eke mwakorire?

English: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”
Kiswahili: Sasa basi ninawaambia kuwa sitawafukuza watoke katikati yenu ila watakuwa miiba kwenu, nao miungu yao itakuwa tanzi kwenu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono ’nkobateebia inde ng’a, tinkobaseeria abanto aba korwa ase amasio aino. Barabwo ’mbabe bakobamiga korwa chinsemo chionsi, naende chinyasae chiabo ’nchibe chikobatega inwe.”

English: When Yahweh’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana alipomaliza kusema mambo haya kwa Waisraeli wote, watu wakalia kwa sauti kuu.
Ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika bw’Omonene abateebetie Abaisraeli bonsi amang’ana ayio, barabwo bakaimokereria amariogi abo igoro bakarera na kweumia.

English: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wakapaita mahali pale Bokimu. Nao wakamtolea Bwana sadaka.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio bakaaroka aase aria Bokimu. Agwo bakamoruera Omonene ebing’wanso.

English: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yoshua kuwapa watu ruhusa waende zao, Waisraeli wakaenda kwenye urithi wao wenyewe ili kumiliki nchi yao.
Ekegusii: Yoshua konya oeire Abaisraeli ribaga bageende, na kera oyomo akageenda koira omwando bwendemero yaye ase ense eria.

English: The people served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of Yahweh that he had worked for Israel.
Kiswahili: Watu wakamtumikia Bwana siku zote za maisha ya Yoshua, na za hao wazee walioishi baada ya Yoshua kufa, waliokuwa wameona mambo makuu ambayo Bwana alikuwa ametenda kwa ajili ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakaba bakomokorera Omonene ase amatuko a Yoshua, na ase amatuko y’abagaaka abatigarete magega y’ogokwa kwaye, abwo barooche ogokora okwo okonene Nyasae abakorerete Abaisraeli.

English: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.
Kiswahili: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, mtumishi wa Bwana, akafa akiwa na umri wa miaka 110.
Ekegusii: Yoshua mosinto o Nuni, omosomba bw’Omonene agakwa ore n’emiaka rigana erimo na ikomi.

English: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
Kiswahili: Wakamzika katika nchi ya urithi wake, huko Timnath-Heresi katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, kaskazini ya Mlima Gaashi.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakamotindeka ase orogoongo rwarenge omwando oye agwo Timunati‐Heresi, ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu, sugusu y’egetunwa kia Gaasi.

English: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know Yahweh, nor the work which he had done for Israel.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kizazi kile chote kukusanywa pamoja na baba zao, kikainuka kizazi kingine baada yao ambacho hakikumjua Bwana, wala matendo yale aliyokuwa ametenda kwa ajili ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ekegori keria gionsi bagakwa bakabwatia chisokoro chiabo, n’abanto b’ekegori kiababwatetie ’mbamomanyete Omonene na keria abakorerete Abaisraeli.

English: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakatenda maovu machoni pa Bwana na kuwatumikia Mabaali.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe ase obosio bw’Omonene, bagachaaka gokorera chinyasae chiare korokwa Baali.

English: They abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked Yahweh to anger.
Kiswahili: Wakamwacha Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao, aliyekuwa amewatoa katika nchi ya Misri. Wakaifuata na kuiabudu miungu mbalimbali ya mataifa yanayowazunguka. Wakamkasirisha Bwana,
Ekegusii: Bagatiga komokorera Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiabo, oria obarusetie ase ense ya Misiri, bakaba bakobwatana ne chinyasae chinde ching’ao; chinyasae chi’ abanto baria bamenyete ase egati yabo. Bagachisasiima chirochio, na ase ayio bakamogeechia Omonene.

English: They abandoned Yahweh, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu walimwacha na kutumikia Baali na Maashtorethi.
Ekegusii: Bakamotiga Omonene na bagachaaka gochikorera chinyasae chiria chiare korokwa Baali, na echinde chiare korokwa Asitaroti.

English: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
Kiswahili: Hivyo hasira ya Bwana ikawaka juu ya Israeli, naye akawatia mikononi mwa wavamizi waliowateka nyara. Akawauza katika mikono ya adui zao pande zote, hivyo hawakuweza tena kuwazuia adui zao.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Omonene akaba n’endamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli, akababeeka ase amaboko y’ abanto abaurereria. Naende akababeeka ase amaboko y’ababisa baabo, baria baabaetanaine, n’Abaisraeli bakabugwa n’ababisa baria.

English: Wherever they went out, Yahweh’s hand was against them for evil, as Yahweh had spoken, and as Yahweh had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.
Kiswahili: Popote Israeli walipotoka kwenda kupigana, mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa kinyume nao ili kuwashinda, kama vile alivyokuwa amewaapia. Nao wakawa katika taabu kubwa.
Ekegusii: Kera engaki barenge kogeenda ase esegi, Omonene nigo arenge kobabeera mamincha na obarentera amabe, buna konya abateebirie na gotiana. Barabwo nigo barenge n’emechando emenene kegima.

English: Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akawainua waamuzi, ambao waliwaokoa katika mikono ya hao watu waliowashambulia.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaa Abaisraeli abagaambi baare kobatooria korwa ase abaurereria baria.

English: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying Yahweh’s commandments. They didn’t do so.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakuwasikiliza hata waamuzi wao, bali walifanya uasherati kwa kuifuata miungu mingine na kuiabudu. Waligeuka mara na kuiacha njia ambayo baba zao waliiendea, yaani, njia ya kutii amri za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende, tibaigwerete abagaambi baria. Abaisraeli tibabete abegenwa ase Omonene, korende bagatayaya ase ogochisasiima chinyasae chinde ching’ao. Ase obwango bakayetiga enchera eria chisokoro chiabo chiabwatetie, eyio yarenge enchera y’okoyaigwera amachiiko y’Omonene.

English: When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved Yahweh because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.
Kiswahili: Kila mara Bwana alipowainulia mwamuzi, Bwana alikuwa pamoja na huyo mwamuzi, naye aliwaokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zao kwa kipindi chote alichoishi yule mwamuzi. Kwa kuwa Bwana aliwahurumia kwa sababu ya kilio chao cha huzuni kwa ajili ya wale waliokuwa wakiwatesa na kuwataabisha.
Ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi Omonene arenge kobaa omogambi, nigo arenge koba amo n’omogaambi oria, naende oba okobatooria abanto korwa ase ababisa baabo, ase engaki omogambi oria arenge moyo. Omonene nigo arenge kobarorera amaabera ekero aiguure okweumia kwabo inse y’abwo baabamigete na kobachaanda.

English: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila mara mwamuzi alipofariki, watu walirudia katika hali mbaya ya uovu zaidi kuliko baba zao, wakiifuata miungu mingine kuitumikia na kuiabudu. Walikataa kuacha matendo yao maovu na njia zao za ukaidi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero omogambi oria akuure, abanto baba bakoonchoka na gokora amabe kobua aye’chisokoro chiabo chiakorete. Naende baba bakobwatana n’echinyasae chinde ching’ao, ase ogochikorera na gochisasiima. Tibatigete ogokora kwabo okobe okwo banarete gokora n’oboenenu.

English: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akawakasirikia sana Israeli na kusema, “Kwa kuwa taifa hili limevunja Agano lile nililofanya na baba zao na hawakunisikiliza,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Omonene akaba n’endamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli, agateeba, “Abanto aba basaririe okobwatana Kwane kw’ogotianania, okwo nachiigete chisokoro chiabo chikobwatie. Na bono ekiagera tibanyigwereti,

English: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;
Kiswahili: mimi nami sitafukuza taifa lolote ambalo Yoshua aliliacha alipofariki.
Ekegusii: Inche tinkomoseeria nonya n’omonto oyomo bw’ebisaku ebio Yoshua ataseeretie ritang’ani atarakwa.

English: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep Yahweh’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”
Kiswahili: Nitayatumia ili nipate kuwapima Israeli na kuona kama wataishika njia ya Bwana na kuenenda katika hiyo kama njia baba zao walivyofanya.”
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio, nimbateeme Abaisraeli, ’ndore gose ’mbarende chinchera chiane inche Omonene, na gochitunyana, buna chisokoro chiabo chiakorete.”

English: So Yahweh left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikuwa ameyaacha hayo mataifa yabaki; hakuyaondoa mara moja kwa kuyatia mikononi mwa Yoshua.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, Omonene akabatiga abanto b’ebisaku biria bamenyeo, tabaseeria bwango, gose tababeegete ase amaboko a Yoshua.

English: Now these are the nations which Yahweh left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo mataifa Bwana aliyoyaacha ili kuwajaribu Waisraeli wote ambao hawakujua vita vyovyote vya Kanaani
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo atigete abanto b’ebisaku binde bamenye ase ense eria, erinde abateeme Abaisraeli baria konya bataramanya esegi ende yonsi ase ense ya Kaanani.

English: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:
Kiswahili: (alifanya hivi ili tu kuwafundisha wazao wa Waisraeli ambao hawakuwa wamejua vita hapo awali):
Ekegusii: Nabo akorete ase okworokereria kera ekegori ki’Abaisraeli engencho y’eseegi, mono abwo konya batararwana esegi ende yonsi.

English: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.
Kiswahili: wafalme watano wa Wafilisti, Wakanaani wote, Wasidoni, Wahivi waishio katika milima ya Lebanoni kuanzia Mlima wa Baal-Hermoni hadi Lebo-Hamathi.
Ekegusii: Abanto batigarete ase ense eria nabwo aba: Abagaambi batano b’Abafilisti, n’ Abakaanani bonsi, n’Abasidoni, n’Abahivi, baria bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Lebanoni, korwa egetunwa gia Baali‐Herimoni goika enchera ekogeenda Hamati.

English: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to Yahweh’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.
Kiswahili: Waliachwa ili kuwajaribu Waisraeli kuona kama wangetii amri za Bwana, alizokuwa amewapa baba zao kwa mkono wa Mose.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo atigete abanto aba ase ense eria, erinde abateeme Abaisraeli, arore gose mbatagete koigwera amachiiko aria achiigete chisokoro chiabo goetera ase Musa.

English: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakaishi miongoni mwa Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakamenya ase egati y’ Abakaanani, n’Abahiti, n’Abaamori, n’Abaperisi, n’Abahivi, n’Abayebusi.

English: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.
Kiswahili: Wakawaoa binti zao, nao wakawatoa binti zao waolewe na wana wa hayo mataifa, na kuitumikia miungu yao.
Ekegusii: Bakanyuomeria abamura babo abaiseke b’ abanto baria b’ebisaku, na bakanywomeria abaiseke babo ase abanto abwo naende bagasasiima chinyasae chiabo.

English: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and forgot Yahweh their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanya maovu machoni pa Bwana, wakamsahau Bwana Mungu wao na kutumikia Mabaali na Maashera.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, bakamweba Omonene obo, na bagasasiima chinyasae echio Baali n’Asera.

English: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.
Kiswahili: Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Israeli, hivyo akawauza na kuwatia mikononi mwa Kushan-Rishathaimu mfalme wa Aramu-Naharaimu ambaye Israeli walikuwa chini yake wakimtumikia kwa muda wa miaka minane.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene akaba n’endamwamu ekoberoroka ase Abaisraeli, akabatiga bakabugwa na Kusani‐Risataimu, omorwoti o Mesopotamia; n’Abaisraeli bakaba abasomba baye ase engaki y’emiaka etano na etato.

English: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli walipomlilia Bwana, yeye akawainulia mwokozi, Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu mdogo wa Kalebu, ambaye aliwaokoa.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene ng’a ababoorie, nere akabaa omonto ababoorie. Omonto oyio nere Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, omomura omoke omwabo Kalebu.

English: Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.
Kiswahili: Roho wa Bwana akaja juu yake, hivyo akawa mwamuzi wa Israeli, akaenda vitani. Bwana akamtia Kushan-Rishathaimu mfalme wa Aramu mikononi mwa Othnieli, naye akamshinda.
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omoneneo ogaacha igoro ase are, na ere akaba omogambi bw’Abaisraeli. Akageenda korwana esegi, n’Omonene akabeeka Kusani‐Risataimu, omorwoti o Mesopotamia, ase amaboko aye Otinieli. Otinieli akamobua kegima.

English: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nchi ikawa na amani kwa muda wa miaka arobaini, mpaka Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi alipofariki.
Ekegusii: Bono ense eria ekaba n’omorembe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene. Erio Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, agakwa.

English: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and Yahweh strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanya maovu mbele za Bwana tena, kwa kuwa walifanya maovu hayo Bwana akamtia nguvu Egloni mfalme wa Moabu dhidi ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Naende Abaisraeli bagakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ase engencho yayio Omonene akabarentera Egiloni, omorwoti bw’ense ya Moabu, nere akabarwania, akababua.

English: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.
Kiswahili: Egloni akawataka Waamoni na Waamaleki waungane naye, akaja kuishambulia Israeli, nao wakatwaa Mji wa Mitende
Ekegusii: Egiloni akabwatana n’Abaamoni n’Abaameleki; barabwo bakabasangera Abaisraeli, bakababua, bakaira Omochie bw’Emekendo.

English: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakawa chini ya Egloni mfalme wa Moabu kwa muda wa miaka kumi na minane.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaba abasomba ba Egiloni, omorwoti o Moabu, ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi, na etano na etato.

English: But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakamlilia tena Bwana, naye akawapa mwokozi: Ehudi, mtu wa shoto, mwana wa Gera, Mbenyamini. Waisraeli wakatuma kwa Egloni mfalme wa Moabu ushuru kwa mkono wa Ehudi.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene ng’a ababoorie, nere akabaa omonto okobabooria. Omonto oria nere Ehudi, mosinto o Gera, bw’egesaku gia Benjamini. Ehudi nigo arenge omonyakebee. Abaisraeli bagatoma Ehudi koirera Egiloni, omorwoti bw’ense ya Moabu, ebiegwa bi’amasikani.

English: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.
Kiswahili: Basi Ehudi alikuwa ametengeneza upanga wenye ukatao kuwili, urefu wake ni kama dhiraa moja, akaufunga upanga huo ndani ya nguo yake kwenye paja lake la mkono wa kuume.
Ekegusii: Ehudi ageturera omoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo; akayweboerania ensemo yaye y’okorio, ime ye chianga chiaye.

English: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.
Kiswahili: Akamkabidhi ushuru Egloni mfalme wa Moabu, ambaye alikuwa mtu mnene sana.
Ekegusii: Erio akairera Egiloni, omorwoti bw’ense ya Moabu, ebiegwa biria. Egiloni nigo arenge omonto omonetu mono.

English: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Ehudi kumkabidhi ule ushuru, wale watu waliokuwa wameubeba huo ushuru aliwaruhusu waende zao.
Ekegusii: Ekero Ehudi aruete ebiegwa biria agateebia abanto baria babibogoretie bairane bageende,

English: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.
Kiswahili: Yeye mwenyewe akafuatana nao hadi kwenye sanamu ya kuchora kwenye mawe karibu na Gilgali, ndipo yeye akarudi, akafika kwa Egloni na kusema, “Ee Mfalme, ninao ujumbe wa siri kwa ajili yako.” Mfalme akasema, “Nyamazeni kimya!” Nao wale waliomhudumia wote wakamwacha, wakatoka nje.
Ekegusii: korende Ehudi omonyene, ekero aigete ase amagena abaachire are emegwekano, ang’e na Giligali, akairana, akageenda naende ase Egiloni, akamoteebia, “aye omorwoti, nimbwate ring’ana ria bobisi nkogoteebia.” Ase igo omorwoti agateebia abanto bonsi abateneine ang’e komokorera, “Toe ribaga, tobe intwe tweka!” Barabwo bonsi bagasoka.

English: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Ehudi akamsogelea alipokuwa ameketi peke yake kwenye chumba cha juu cha jumba lake la kifalme la majira ya kiangazi, na kusema, “Ninao ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu kwa ajili yako.” Mfalme alipokuwa anainuka kutoka kwenye kiti chake,
Ekegusii: Ehudi akariina kerama igoro ase akanyomba kare nembeo engiya, ase omorwoti aikaransete, akamoteebia, “Ninde namang’ana arure ase Nyasae nkogoteebia.” Omorwoti oria akaimoka korwa ase aikaransete.

English: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.
Kiswahili: Ehudi akaunyoosha mkono wake wa kushoto na kuufuta ule upanga aliokuwa ameufunga kwenye paja lake la kulia, akamdunga Mfalme Egloni tumboni mwake.
Ekegusii: Ehudi akarambora okoboko kwaye gw’okobee, agasomora omoyio oye o birende, oyio eboeranetie ensemo yaye y’okorio, akamobeta Egiloni enda.

English: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.
Kiswahili: Hata mpini nao ukazama tumboni pamoja na upanga wenyewe, nao upanga ukatokea mgongoni mwake. Ehudi hakuuchomoa huo upanga, nayo mafuta yakashikamana juu ya upanga.
Ekegusii: Omoyio oyio okarimera ime amo n’egete, na ebitinya bienda y’omorwoti bikayotuba, ekiagera Ehudi tarenge koyosomora korwa ase enda y’omorwoti oria goika omoyio oria okaorokera magega.

English: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.
Kiswahili: Ehudi akatoka nje barazani; akamfungia milango ya chumba cha juu na kuifunga kwa funguo.
Ekegusii: Erio Ehudi agasooka, akairaneria ebisieri bi’akanyomba karia, akabibunga.

English: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuondoka, watumishi wakaja na kukuta milango ya chumba cha juu imefungwa kwa funguo. Wakasema, “Bila shaka amejipumzisha kwenye chumba cha ndani cha nyumba yake ya majira ya kiangazi.”
Ekegusii: Ekero asookire, abasomba b’Egiloni bagaacha, bakanyora ebisieri nigo bisiekire na kobungwa. Barabwo bakarengereria ng’a omorwoti nigo are ase akanyomba ka ime kogwekoonya.

English: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.
Kiswahili: Wakangoja hata wakawa na fadhaa, basi wakati hakufungua milango ya chumba, wakachukua funguo na kuifungua. Tazama wakaona bwana wao amelala sakafuni, amekufa.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaganya egeka goika bakaganyora. Nonya naboigo, omorwoti taigora egesieri ki’enyomba eyio. Ase igo bakaimokia ekeigorero, bakaigora ebisieri, na Ani! Omonene obo nigo arambereretie inse okwete.

English: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wangali wanangoja, Ehudi akatoroka, akapita hapo kwenye sanamu ya kuchora kwenye mawe na kukimbilia Seira.
Ekegusii: Ekero abasomba baria barenge baganyete, Ehudi agatama. Ere konya oetire ase amagena arenge, aria abaachire are emegwekano, agatama gochia Seira.

English: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.
Kiswahili: Alipofika huko, akapiga tarumbeta katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, nao Waisraeli wakateremka pamoja naye kutoka vilimani, yeye akiwa anawaongoza.
Ekegusii: Ekero aigete aroro, akabugia egetuureri gi’eseegi ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu. Erio Abaisraeli bagatirimboka korwa ase ebitunwa bakamobwatia, nere akaba omorai obo.

English: He said to them, “Follow me; for Yahweh has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.
Kiswahili: Akawaagiza, “Nifuateni, kwa kuwa Bwana amewatia Moabu, adui zenu, mikononi mwenu.” Kwa hiyo wakateremka wakamfuata, wakavishika vivuko vya Yordani kuelekea Moabu, wala hawakuacha mtu yeyote kuvuka.
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, “’Ntunyane, ekiagera Omonene obeekire ababisa baino Abamoabu ase amaboko aino.” Erio bakamotunyana, bagasieka chitaracha chia Yorodani, ase Abamoabu banarete kwambokera, tibaa nonya n’oyomo ribaga ri’okwamboka.

English: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo wakawaua Wamoabu watu waume wapatao 10,000 ambao wote walikuwa wenye nguvu na mashujaa; hakuna mtu yeyote aliyetoroka.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio bakabaita Abamoabu ang’e chiribu ikomi. Abwo bonsi nigo barenge abanto abanene, naende barenge chituoni chi’eseegi; onde taminchoretie nonya n’oyomo.

English: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.
Kiswahili: Siku ile Moabu wakashindwa na Israeli, nayo nchi ikawa na amani kwa miaka themanini.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Abaisraeli bakabua Abamoabu, na ense eria ekaba n’omorembe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano n’etato.

English: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Ehudi akaja Shamgari mwana wa Anathi, aliyewapiga Wafilisti 600 kwa fimbo iliyochongoka ya kuongozea ngʼombe. Naye pia akawaokoa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Oyomobwatetie Ehudi ase obogaambi, nere Samugari, mosinto bw’Anati. Ere agaita Abafirisiti amagana atano na rimo n’enyimbo are gotemera chieri. Nere boigo akabatooria Abaisraeli.

English: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, when Ehud was dead.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Ehudi kufa, Waisraeli wakafanya tena maovu machoni pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero Ehudi akuure, Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe ase obosio bw’Omonene naende.

English: Yahweh sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bwana akawatia mikononi mwa Yabini, mfalme wa Kanaani, aliyetawala huko Hazori. Jemadari wa jeshi lake alikuwa Sisera, aliyeishi huko Haroshethi-Hagoyimu
Ekegusii: Ase ig’Omonene akabatiga bakabugwa na Yabini, omorwoti o Kaanani, oyorenge kogaambera omochie o Hasori. Omotang’ani bw’emeganda yaye y’eseegi nigo arenge korokwa Sisera. Ere nigo amenyete Haroseti, omochie bw’Ebisaku.

English: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Sisera alikuwa na magari ya chuma yapatayo 900, naye alikuwa amewatesa Waisraeli kwa ukatili kwa muda wa miaka ishirini, Waisraeli wakamlilia Bwana wakaomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Yabini nigo abwate chigari chi’ebioma amagana kianda. Ere agachaanda Abaisraeli mono ase obotindi obonene ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, n’Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene abakoonye.

English: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.
Kiswahili: Debora, nabii mwanamke, mkewe Lapidothi, ndiye alikuwa anaamua Israeli wakati ule.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omobani Debora, moka Lapidoti, nigo arenge omogambi bw’Abaisraeli.

English: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
Kiswahili: Debora alikuwa akiketi chini ya Mtende wa Debora uliokuwa kati ya Rama na Betheli katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, nao Waisraeli wakaja kwake ili awaamue.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo anarete goikaransa inse y’omote orenge korokwa Omokendo o Debora, egati ya Rama na Beteli, ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu na Abaisraeli nigo baanarete goocha ase are abagaayane.

English: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
Kiswahili: Akatuma wamwite Baraka mwana wa Abinoamu kutoka Kedeshi huko Naftali na kumwambia, “Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, anakuagiza: ‘Nenda, chukua wanaume 10,000 toka Naftali na Zabuloni, mwende Mlima Tabori.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo akarangeria Baraki, mosinto bw’Abinoamu, korwa ase omochie o Kedesi bw’ense ya Nafutali, akamoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agochiikire: Genda ochoore abanto chilifu ikomi korwa ase eamate ya Nafutali na eya Sabuloni, obaire gochia ase Egetunwa gia Tabori.

English: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”
Kiswahili: Nitamshawishi Sisera, jemadari wa jeshi la Yabini, pamoja na magari yake na jeshi lake, hadi Mto Kishoni na kumtia mikononi mwako.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inche nimoseegete Sisera, omotang’ani bw’emeganda y’eseegi, y’omorwoti Yabini amo ne chigari chiaye n’emegaanda yaye, goocha ase ore, agwo ase Orooche rwa Kisoni, na aroro nimobeeke ase amaboko ao.”

English: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”
Kiswahili: Baraka akamwambia, “Ukienda pamoja nami nitakwenda, lakini usipokwenda pamoja nami, sitakwenda.”
Ekegusii: Baraki akamoiraneria Debora, “Aye korageende amo nainche, rirorio ningeende, korende otageendeti amo nainche, tinkogeenda.”

English: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for Yahweh will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
Kiswahili: Debora akamwambia, “Hakika nitakwenda pamoja nawe, lakini njia unayoiendea haitakupa heshima wewe, kwa kuwa Bwana atamtia Sisera mikononi mwa mwanamke.” Hivyo Debora akaenda pamoja na Baraka mpaka Kedeshi,
Ekegusii: Debora akamoiraneria, “Goika ’’ngende amo naye, korende orogeendo oro tirogokorentera ogotogigwa, ekiagera Omonene nigo agochia gotiga Sisera agwe ase amaboko y’omokuungu.” Erio Debora akaimoka akageenda amo na Baraki, bagaika Kedesi.

English: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.
Kiswahili: mahali ambapo Baraka aliwaita Zabuloni na Naftali. Watu 10,000 wakamfuata Baraka, na Debora pia akaenda pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Erio Baraki akabarangeria abanto ba Nafutali amo na Abasabuloni bache Kedesi, n’abanto chilifu ikomi bagatiira amo na Baraki, na Debora akageenda amo nere.

English: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.
Kiswahili: Basi Heberi, Mkeni, alikuwa amejitenga na Wakeni wengine, yaani, wazao wa Hobabu, mkwewe Mose, naye akapiga hema lake karibu na ule mti mkubwa wa mwaloni ulioko Saananimu, karibu na Kedeshi.
Ekegusii: Bono Heberi Omokeni akayetenenia eema yaye ang’e Omoaluni ase Sananimu, ang’e na Kedesi. Ere konya bweatananire korwa ase Abakeni bande. Abakeni nigo barenge ab’ororeeria rwa Hobabu, mokoyoye Musa.

English: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.
Kiswahili: Sisera alipoambiwa kuwa Baraka mwana wa Abinoamu alikuwa amepanda Mlima Tabori,
Ekegusii: Sisera agateebigwa ng’a Baraki, mosinto bw’Abinoamu, otiirire gochia ase Egetunwa gia Tabori.

English: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.
Kiswahili: Sisera akakusanya pamoja magari yake yote 600 ya chuma na watu wote waliokuwa pamoja naye, kuanzia Haroshethi-Hagoyimu mpaka Mto wa Kishoni.
Ekegusii: Erio agasangereria chigari chiaye amagana kianda, amo n’abarwani baye bonsi, korwa ase Haroseti, omochie bw’Ebisaku, gochia ase orooche rwa Kisoni.

English: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which Yahweh has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t Yahweh gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Debora akamwambia Baraka, “Nenda! Hii ndiyo siku ambayo Bwana amemtia Sisera mikononi mwako. Je, Bwana hakukutangulia mbele yako?” Hivyo Baraka akashuka kutoka Mlima Tabori, akifuatwa na watu 10,000.
Ekegusii: Erio Debora akamoteebia Baraki, “Imoka, ogende! Rituko ria reero nario Omonene amobeekire Sisera ase amaboko ao. Omonene ogotang’aneire aye gochia korwana esegi.” Baraki agatirimboka korwa ase Egetunwa gia Tabori amo n’abanto chilifu ikomi baare komotunyana.

English: Yahweh confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.
Kiswahili: Bwana akamfadhaisha Sisera na magari yake yote, pamoja na jeshi lake lote kwa upanga mbele ya Baraka, naye Sisera akaliacha gari lake na kukimbia kwa miguu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoondokia na komotantania Sisera amo ne chigari chiaye amo n’omoganda bw’abarwani bonsi b’esegi. Erio abarwani abwo bagatama korwa ase omoro o Baraki, na Sisera omonyene agaika korwa ase egari yaye, agatama n’amagoro.

English: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.
Kiswahili: Lakini Baraka akafuata magari pamoja na jeshi mpaka Haroshethi-Hagoyimu. Jeshi lote la Sisera likaanguka kwa upanga, wala hakuna hata mtu mmoja aliyesalia.
Ekegusii: Baraki akabwatia chigari n’omoganda bw’abarwani b’esegi goika Haroseti, omochie bw’ebisaku, n’omoganda bwonsi bw’abarwani b’esegi o Sisera ogaitwa, monto onde taiyo nonya n’oyomo ominchoretie.

English: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
Kiswahili: Sisera, hata hivyo, akakimbia kwa miguu mpaka kwenye hema la Yaeli, mkewe Heberi, Mkeni, kwa sababu palikuwa na uhusiano wa kirafiki kati ya Yabini mfalme wa Hazori na ukoo wa Heberi, Mkeni.
Ekegusii: Sisera akamonyoka, agatama gochia ase eema ya Yaeli, moka Heberi Omokeni, ekiagera ase engaki eria Yabini, omorwoti o Hasori, n’eamate ya Heberi Omokeni nigo barenge abasani.

English: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.
Kiswahili: Yaeli akaenda kumlaki Sisera na kumwambia, “Karibu, bwana wangu, karibu ingia ndani kabisa. Usiogope.” Basi Sisera akaingia ndani ya hema ya Yaeli, naye akamfunika kwa blanketi nene.
Ekegusii: Yaeli agasooka korotota Sisera, akamoteebia, “Omonene one, gobera gochaa aa, soa ime aa, toba n’obwoba!” Erio Sisera agasoa ase eema ya Yaeli, na Yaeli akamobisia egetambaa.

English: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Nina kiu, tafadhali nipe maji ya kunywa.” Ndipo akafungua kiriba cha maziwa na kumpa akanywa, kisha akamfunika.
Ekegusii: Sisera agateebia Yaeli, “Ing’a amaache inywe! Igo inde n’erang’o.” Omokungu oria agakuunora ekerandi kiare n’amabeere, akamoa, nere akanywa. Magega y’ayio Yaeli akamobisia naende.

English: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”
Kiswahili: Naye Sisera akamwambia, “Simama mlangoni pa hema na mtu yeyote akija na kukuuliza, ‘Je, kuna mtu yeyote hapa?’ sema, ‘Hapana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Sisera agateebia Yaeli, “Tenena ase egesieri ki’eema, na monto onde bwensi orache akoborie iga, Onde nare ime aa? Mokanie yaya, onde taiyo.”

English: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yaeli, mkewe Heberi, akatwaa kigingi cha hema, akachukua nyundo mkononi mwake, akamwendea polepole, akiwa amelala usingizi, akiwa amechoka. Akakigongomea kile kigingi kwenye paji la uso wake, kikapenya hata kuingia ardhini, naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Sisera konya orosire mono, akarara chitoro chindito, ko bono, Yaeli, moka Heberi, akaimokia ekeroochi ki’eema na ekegoogi agachoba ng’ora ng’ora gochia ase Sisera, akamoaka ekeroochi keria korwa chintakunero gochia ase omotwe, akamobwaterania inse ase riroba, Sisera agakwa.

English: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.
Kiswahili: Baraka akakaribia akimfuatia Sisera, Yaeli akatoka kumlaki. Akamwambia, “Njoo, nitakuonyesha mtu unayemtafuta.” Hivyo wakaingia ndani ya hema wakiwa wamefuatana na tazama Sisera alikuwa amelala humo, akiwa amekufa, na hicho kigingi cha hema kikiwa kimegongomewa kupitia paji la uso wake.
Ekegusii: Engaki eria Baraki agacha, okomorigia Sisera, na Yaeli agasooka komoorotota, akamoteebia, “Inchuo, ’nkworokie omonto oria okorigia.” Baraki agasoa nyomba amo nere, akanyora Sisera orambereretie inse, okwete, n’ekerochi kere ase chintakunero chiaye ime.

English: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.
Kiswahili: Basi siku ile Mungu akamshinda Yabini, mfalme wa Kanaani, mbele ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Nyasae akabaa Abaisraeli chinguru bakamobua Yabini, omorwoti o Kaanani.

English: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
Kiswahili: Nao mkono wa Waisraeli ukaendelea kuwa na nguvu zaidi na zaidi dhidi ya Yabini, mfalme wa Kanaani, mpaka wakamwangamiza.
Ekegusii: Na Abaisraeli bakamoengera Yabini, omorwoti o Kaanani goika bakamosiria kegima.

English: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Debora na Baraka mwana wa Abinoamu wakaimba wimbo huu:
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Debora na Baraki, mosinto bw’Abinoamu, bagateera ogoteera oko:

English: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, Yahweh!
Kiswahili: “Wakuu katika Israeli wanapoongoza, wakati watu wanapojitoa kwa hiari yao wenyewe: mhimidini Bwana!
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, ekiagera abaraai batang’anete Abaisraeli, n’abanto beruete ase ogwancha kwabo!

English: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to Yahweh. I will sing praise to Yahweh, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Sikieni hili, enyi wafalme! Sikilizeni, enyi watawala! Nitamwimbia Bwana, nitaimba; kwa wimbo nitamhimidi Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Inwe abarwoti, igwa! Inwe abagaambi, tegerera! Inche ninterere Omonene ase okomobaaka, nintogie Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli!

English: “Yahweh, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana, ulipotoka katika Seiri, ulipopita katika mashamba ya Edomu, nchi ilitetemeka, mbingu nazo zikamwaga, naam, mawingu yakamwaga maji.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ekero kwarwete ebitunwa bia Edomu, na ogataara korwa ense ya Edomu, ense egatengechigwa, n’embura egatwa korwa igoro. Ee, amare agaitera amaache.

English: The mountains quaked at Yahweh’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Milima ilitetemeka mbele za Bwana, hata ule wa Sinai, mbele za Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ebitunwa bikanyegerigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, ee, nonya n’egetunwa keria gia Sinai, ase obosio bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.
Kiswahili: “Katika siku za Shamgari mwana wa Anathi, katika siku za Yaeli, barabara kuu hazikuwa na watu; wasafiri walipita njia za kando.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko a Samugari, mosinto bw’Anati, na ase amatuko a Yaeli, chinchera chinene nigo chiaribete, abagendi bakonyenyeka chinsana ime.

English: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.
Kiswahili: Mashujaa walikoma katika Israeli, walikoma mpaka mimi, Debora, nilipoinuka, nilipoinuka kama mama katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: Emechie y’Abaisraeli nigo yaraire, kende tikiarenge gokorekao goika aye Debora okaimoka, ee, goika okaimoka, okaba ng’ina Abaisraeli.

English: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
Kiswahili: Walipochagua miungu migeni, vita vilikuja katika malango ya mji, hapakuonekana ngao wala mkuki miongoni mwa mashujaa 40,000 katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagachoora chinyasae chinyia, erio chiseegi chikaba ase ebiita biabo. Ase abanto chilifu emerongo ene ase Abaisraeli, inee, onde obo narorekanete ore n’enguba gose ritimo?

English: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless Yahweh!
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu u pamoja na wakuu wa Israeli, pamoja na wale wanaojitoa wenyewe kwa hiari yao miongoni mwa watu. Mhimidini Bwana!
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo ere amo n’abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli, na ase abanto abwo beruete ase ogwancha. Motogie Omonene!

English: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
Kiswahili: “Nanyi mpandao punda weupe, mkiketi juu ya matandiko ya thamani, nanyi mtembeao barabarani, fikirini
Ekegusii: Inwe aba’mokoriina chitigere chindabu, nainwe aba’mogoikaransa ase emegeeke yaino, nainwe aba’mogotaara ase chinchera, morarie amang’ana ayio!

English: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse Yahweh’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then Yahweh’s people went down to the gates.
Kiswahili: juu ya sauti za waimbaji mahali pa kunyweshea maji. Wanasimulia matendo ya haki ya Bwana, matendo ya haki ya mashujaa wake katika Israeli. “Ndipo watu wa Bwana walipoteremka malangoni pa mji.
Ekegusii: Tegerera! Abwo bagoaka amariogi ase bagosangererekana kobuucha amaache, nigo bagokwana igoro y’obobui Omonene, ee, igoro y’ogokora kwaye okoronge gokogambera Abaisraeli. Erio abanto b’Omonene bagatirimboka gochia ase ebiita.

English: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’
Kiswahili: ‘Amka, amka! Debora! Amka, amka, uimbe! Ee Baraka! Inuka, chukua mateka wako uliowateka, ee mwana wa Abinoamu.’
Ekegusii: Imoka, Debora, imoka! Imoka, oteere ogoteera! Naye Baraki, mosinto bw’Abinoamu, tenena, oire abanto abwo gwosire.

English: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. Yahweh came down for me against the mighty.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo mabaki ya watu wakashuka dhidi ya wenye nguvu, watu wa Bwana, wakashuka dhidi ya mashujaa wenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Abatigarete bagatirimboka gochia ase abatang’ani baabo; Omonene agacha ase engencho yane arwanie chituoni.

English: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Efraimu wakaja watu, ambao chimbuko lao ni Amaleki; Benyamini akiwa miongoni mwa watu waliokufuata. Kutoka Makiri wakashuka viongozi, na kutoka Zabuloni wale washikao fimbo ya jemadari.
Ekegusii: Abwo ritina riabo riarenge ase ense y’Abaameleki, bagatirimboka korwa ase Efraimu, abanto b’egesaku gia Benjamini bagakobwatia. Abatang’ani b’abarwani b’esegi bagatirimboka korwa Makiri, na abarenge abariiki ase esegi korwa Sabuloni.

English: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa Isakari walikuwa pamoja na Debora; naam, Isakari alikuwa pamoja na Baraka, wakija nyuma yake kwa mbio wakielekea bondeni. Katika jamaa za Reubeni, palikuwa na kujihoji kukubwa moyoni.
Ekegusii: Abaanene b’Abaisakaru nigo babwatetie Debora, na bun’Abaisakaru bakorete, naboigo na Baraki, bagatirimboka gochia ase ense omweya, bakabwatia chimbaratero chiabo. Korende ase chindooche chi’ abanto b’eamate ya Rubeni, okogaamba na okoroberia okonene nigo biarengeo.

English: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini ulikaa katikati ya mazizi ya kondoo kusikiliza sauti ya filimbi zinazoita makundi? Kwa jamaa za Reubeni, palikuwa na kujihoji kukubwa moyoni.
Ekegusii: Nase ki moikaransete ase eero ye ching’ondi, mokoigwa abarisia bakobugia ebiroria bakorangeria ching’ondi? Ee, ase chindooche chi’ abanto b’eamate ya Rubeni; okogaamba n’okorooberia okonene nigo biarengeo, nigo kwarenge okoamererania okonene.

English: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.
Kiswahili: Gileadi alikaa ngʼambo ya Yordani. Naye Dani, kwa nini alikaa kwenye merikebu siku nyingi? Asheri alikaa kwa utulivu ufuoni mwa bahari, akikaa kwenye ghuba zake ndogo.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Gileadi, moocha ya Yorodani, mbaikaranseteo. Na abanto b’egesaku gia Dani, nase ki babeerete ase chimeeri chiabo? Abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri bagaikaransa enyancha mbarabare, bagakira‐kiri, bakabeera ase engegu yabo.

English: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Zabuloni walihatarisha maisha yao, vilevile nao watu wa Naftali.
Ekegusii: Abasabuloni bakerua nonya ’ngoika ogokwa, n’Abanafutali boigo ase okorwana esegi ebitunwa igoro.

English: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.
Kiswahili: “Wafalme walikuja na kufanya vita; wafalme wa Kanaani walipigana huko Taanaki karibu na maji ya Megido, lakini hawakuchukua fedha wala nyara.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti bagaacha, bakarwana, ee, abarwoti ba Kaanani bakarwana ase Taanaki, agwo ase chindooche chia Megido, korende tibasakorete chifeta.

English: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.
Kiswahili: Kutoka mbinguni nyota zilipigana, nyota kutoka njia zake zilipigana na Sisera.
Ekegusii: Korwa igoro esegi ekarwana, ching’enang’eni chikamorwania Sisera ekero chiare ase orogeendo rwabo.

English: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.
Kiswahili: Mto wa Kishoni uliwasomba, ule mto wa zamani, mto wa Kishoni. Songa mbele, ee nafsi yangu, kwa ujasiri!
Ekegusii: Orooche rwa Kisoni rokabaira, orwo n’orooche rwa orokoro rwa Kisoni. Omoyo one, genderera ne chinguru!

English: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.
Kiswahili: Ndipo kwato za farasi zikafanya mshindo: farasi wake wenye nguvu huenda mbio kwa kurukaruka.
Ekegusii: Erio chibarasi chiare gotiria n’ebitaago biabo, chituoni chiachiriinete chiare gochara‐charaara.

English: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said Yahweh’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help Yahweh, to help Yahweh against the mighty.’
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana akasema, ‘Merozi alaaniwe. Walaaniwe watu wake kwa uchungu, kwa kuwa hawakuja kumsaidia Bwana, kumsaidia Bwana dhidi ya hao wenye nguvu.’
Ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene nigo agoteeba, Ragereria Merosi, ragereria abanto bamenyeteo, ekiagera tibaachete gokony’Omonene, komokonya korwania abare ne chinguru.

English: “Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
Kiswahili: “Yaeli abarikiwe kuliko wanawake wote, mkewe Heberi, Mkeni, abarikiwe kuliko wanawake wote waishio kwenye mahema.
Ekegusii: Yaeli, moka Heberi Omokeni, nasesenirie kobua abakungu bande, ee, nasesenirie kobua abakungu bande bamenyete ase chiema.

English: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.
Kiswahili: Aliomba maji, naye akampa maziwa; kwenye bakuli la heshima akamletea maziwa mgando.
Ekegusii: Sisera agasaba amaache, erio Yaeli akamoa amabeere, akamoa amaguta y’amabeere are ase egetaabo egeseera.

English: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.
Kiswahili: Akanyoosha mkono wake akashika kigingi cha hema, mkono wake wa kuume ukashika nyundo ya fundi. Akampiga Sisera kwa nyundo, akamponda kichwa chake, akamvunjavunja na kumtoboa paji lake la uso.
Ekegusii: Akarambora okoboko kwaye, akaimokia ekeroochi ki’eema, na ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio akaimokia ekegogi, agakong’ontera Sisera, akamwata orogoma, agasenyenta omotwe oye, akabeta na gochiata chintakunero chiaye.

English: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
Kiswahili: Aliinama miguuni pa Yaeli, akaanguka; akalala hapo. Pale alipoinama miguuni pake, alianguka; pale alipoinamia, ndipo alipoanguka, akiwa amekufa.
Ekegusii: Sisera akeringa akagwa inse, akagwa inse ase amagoro a Yaeli, akarambereria inse ase amagoro aye, agwo ase agwete agakwa.

English: “Through the window she looked out, and cried: Sisera’s mother looked through the lattice. ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariots wait?’
Kiswahili: “Kupitia dirishani mamaye Sisera alichungulia; nyuma ya dirisha alilia, akasema, ‘Mbona gari lake linachelewa kufika? Mbona vishindo vya magari yake vimechelewa?’
Ekegusii: Ng’ina Sisera akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, agatengera goetera ase ekebao kiabeekire ebitange, akarera, “Nase ki chigari chiaye chiateebanire goocha? Nase ki amagoro ye chibarasi chiaye chie chigari atebanire koirana?”

English: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,
Kiswahili: Wanawake wenye busara kuliko wengine wote wakamjibu; naam, husema moyoni mwake,
Ekegusii: Abaiseke abang’aini abarenge amo nere bakamoiraneria, na ere omonyene akaba okoiranerera amang’ana aya:

English: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’
Kiswahili: ‘Je, hawapati na kugawanya nyara: msichana mmoja au wawili kwa kila mtu, mavazi ya rangi mbalimbali kwa Sisera kuwa nyara, mavazi ya rangi mbalimbali yaliyotariziwa, mavazi yaliyotariziwa vizuri kwa ajili ya shingo yangu: yote haya yakiwa nyara?’
Ekegusii: “Ande, nigo banyorire ebisakorwa bakare gwatanana ase egati yabo, kera omonto aire omoiseke oyomo, gose babere; Sisera ere aire ebitambaa bi’ebieni ebiya, egetambaa keroisirie ekiya, ekemo gose bibere, bibe ebisakorwa ase rigoti riaye.”

English: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.
Kiswahili: “Adui zako wote na waangamie, Ee Bwana! Bali wote wakupendao na wawe kama jua lichomozavyo kwa nguvu zake.” Hivyo nchi ikawa na amani kwa miaka arobaini.
Ekegusii: “Omonene, tiga ababisa bao bonsi basire buna igo, korende baria bagwanchete babe buna erioba rire ekero rigosoka ne chinguru.” Na ense eria ekaba n’omorembe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.

English: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, so Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wakafanya tena yaliyo maovu mbele za Bwana, naye kwa miaka saba Bwana akawatia mikononi mwa Wamidiani.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe naende ase obosio bw’Omonene, n’Omonene akababeeka ase amaboko y’Abamidiani ase engaki y’emiaka etano n’ebere.

English: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Midiani ukawa na nguvu dhidi ya Israeli na kwa ajili ya Wamidiani, Waisraeli wakajitengenezea mahali pa kujificha milimani, kwenye mapango na ngome.
Ekegusii: Abamidiani nigo baabaengerete Abaisraeli, na ase engencho y’Abamidiani Abaisraeli bakabetererigwa korigia obotamero ase amakuruma na emetaro, na ase chingoro chiakuunyire ase ebitunwa.

English: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
Kiswahili: Kila wakati Waisraeli walipopanda mazao mashambani, Wamidiani, Waamaleki na mataifa mengine ya mashariki walivamia nchi yao.
Ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi Abaisraeli barenge kobusura chimbusuro chiabo, Abamimidiani, n’Abaameleki, n’abanto ba moocha nigo baare goocha baabarwania esegi.

English: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.
Kiswahili: Wakapiga kambi katika mashamba yao na kuharibu mazao ya nchi yote hadi kufikia Gaza, wala hawakuacha kiumbe chochote kilicho hai kwa Waisraeli, iwe kondoo au ngʼombe au punda.
Ekegusii: Bakaba bagotoora ase ense y’Abaisraeli, erio basaria chindagera chiabo goika chimbebe chia Gasa. Tibaare gotigareria Abaisraeli ching’ondi, gose chiombe, gose chitigere, nonya ngento kende gionsi Abaisraeli baare koria.

English: For they came up with their livestock and their tents. They came in as locusts for multitude. Both they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land to destroy it.
