Ekegusii: Omonene akagenderera kweorokia agwo Silo, akeorokia ase Samweli goetera ase ring’ana riaye. Na ekero Samweli areenge gokwana, Abaisraeli bonsi nigo baarenge gotegerera.

English: The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.
Kiswahili: Nalo neno la Samweli likaja kwa Israeli yote. Basi Waisraeli walitoka kwenda kupigana dhidi ya Wafilisti. Waisraeli wakapiga kambi huko Ebenezeri, nao Wafilisti wakapiga kambi huko Afeki.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenda korwania Abafirisiti. Barabwo bagatoora agwo Ebeni‐Eseri, na Abafirisiti agwo Afeki.

English: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakapanga safu za majeshi yao kupambana na Israeli, wakati vita vilipoenea, Israeli wakashindwa na Wafilisti, ambao waliwaua askari wa Israeli wapatao 4,000 kwenye uwanja wa vita.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakeroberia korwania Abaisraeli. Esegi egatindia, na Abafirisiti bakabua Abaisraeli, bagaita Abanto chilifu inye.

English: When the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, “Why has Yahweh defeated us today before the Philistines? Let’s get the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us, that it may come among us and save us out of the hand of our enemies.”
Kiswahili: Askari waliporudi kambini, wazee wa Israeli wakawauliza, “Kwa nini Bwana ameruhusu leo tushindwe mbele ya Wafilisti? Tuleteni Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kutoka Shilo, ili lipate kwenda pamoja nasi, na kutuokoa kutoka mikono ya adui zetu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero abarwani abatigarete bairanete gocha ase egetwori, abagaaka b’Abaisraeli bagateeba: “Nase ki Omonene atotiga twabugwa n’Abafilisti ase rituko ria reero? Togende torente korwa Silo Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene, erinde eche ebe egati yaito na gototooria korwa ase amaboko yababisa baito.”

English: So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of Yahweh of Armies, who sits above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakawatuma watu huko Shilo, nao wakalichukua Sanduku la Agano la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, aliyekaa kwenye kiti chake cha enzi kati ya makerubi. Nao wale wana wawili wa Eli, Hofni na Finehasi, walikuwako huko pamoja na Sanduku la Agano la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio Abanto bagatomwa Silo, bakarenta Esanduki eria y’Omonene bw’Emeganda, oyio omenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba; na Hofini na Finehasi, abamura babere ba Eli, bagaacha amo n’Esanduki eria.

English: When the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.
Kiswahili: Wakati Sanduku la Agano la Bwana lilikuja kambini, Waisraeli wote wakapiga kelele kwa sauti kuu hata ardhi ikatikisika.
Ekegusii: Ekero Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene yaigete ase egetwori, Abaisraeli bonsi bagaaka amariogi amanene goika ense ekooga.

English: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that Yahweh’s ark had come into the camp.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti waliposikia makelele wakauliza, “Ni nini makelele haya yote katika kambi ya Waebrania?” Walipofahamu kuwa Sanduku la Bwana limekuja kambini,
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagachia koigwa amariogi aria agoakwa bakaboorania: “Ninki engencho y’ogoakwa kw’amariogi ayio amanene ase egetwori ki’Abaiberania?” Ekero banyorete amang’ana ng’a n’Esanduki y’Omonene yarentirwe ase egetwori,

English: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakaogopa, wakasema, “Mungu amekuja kambini, ole wetu. Halijatokea jambo kama hili tangu hapo.
Ekegusii: bakaondoka mono, bagakwana: “Enyasae yachire ase egetwori keria.” Naende bagateeba: “Obobe nobwaito! Egento kenga buna ekio tikiana gokorekana ase tore nonya ng’ake.

English: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Ole wetu! Ni nani atakayetuokoa kutoka mikononi mwa miungu hii yenye nguvu? Ni miungu ile iliyowapiga Wamisri kwa mapigo ya aina zote huko jangwani.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaito! Ning’o oratotoorie korwa ase amaboko ye chinyasae echio chire nokobua gotoetania?

English: Be strong and behave like men, O you Philistines, that you not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Strengthen yourselves like men, and fight!”
Kiswahili: Tuweni hodari, enyi Wafilisti! Tuweni wanaume, la sivyo mtakuwa watumwa wa Waebrania, kama wao walivyokuwa kwenu. Kuweni wanaume, mpigane!”
Ekegusii: Chinyasae echio nachio chiaagete Abamisiri namaakwa amange aaria ase erooro. Korende inwe Abafirisiti, motenene bokong’u buna abasacha, erinde timoba abasomba b’Abaiberania baria, buna barabwo baarenge abasomba baino. Ee, motenene buna abasacha, morwane bokong’u!”

English: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.
Kiswahili: Basi Wafilisti wakapigana, nao Waisraeli wakashindwa na kila mtu akakimbilia hemani mwake. Mauaji yalikuwa makubwa sana, Israeli wakapoteza askari 30,000 waendao kwa miguu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abafirisiti bakarwana bokong’u, na Abaisraeli bakabugwa, bagatama bonsi, korende kera oyomo gochia ase enka yaye. Okobugwa okwo nigo kwareenge okonene mono. Abarwani b’Abaisraeli chilifu emerongo etato bagaitwa bagakwa.

English: God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Mungu likatekwa, na hao wana wawili wa Eli, Hofni na Finehasi, wakauawa.
Ekegusii: Esanduki ya Nyasae ekairwa, na Hofini na Finehasi, abamura babere ba Eli, bagaitwa.

English: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.
Kiswahili: Siku ile ile mtu mmoja wa kabila la Benyamini akakimbia kutoka kwenye uwanja wa vita na kwenda Shilo, nguo zake zikiwa zimeraruka na akiwa na mavumbi kichwani mwake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’egesaku kia Benjamini agatama korwa ase esegi, akaminyoka gochia Silo, agaikao rituko erio erio, ore ne chianga chiatandoire, na obegete ebuse ase omotwe oye.

English: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.
Kiswahili: Alipofika, Eli alikuwa ameketi juu ya kiti chake kando ya barabara akiangalia, kwa sababu moyo wake ulikuwa na hofu kwa ajili ya Sanduku la Mungu. Mtu yule alipoingia mjini na kueleza kilichokuwa kimetokea, mji wote ukalia.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria aigeteo, Eli nigo areenge oikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye agwo enchera ensemo otengerete, ekiagera nigo areenge nobwoba ase engencho y’Esanduki eria ya Nyasae. Na ekero omonto oria arentete amang’ana ayio akorekire, Abanto bonsi b’omochie bakarera mono.

English: When Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, “What does the noise of this tumult mean?” The man hurried, and came and told Eli.
Kiswahili: Eli akasikia kelele za kilio, naye akauliza, “Ni nini maana ya makelele haya?” Yule mtu akafanya haraka kwenda kwa Eli,
Ekegusii: Erio Eli akaigwa okorera kw’Abaanto, akabooria: “Eriogi eri ri’okorera okonene neria ki?” Erio omonto oria akaayerera gochia ase Eli komoteebia amang’ana ayio.

English: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.
Kiswahili: wakati huu Eli alikuwa na miaka tisini na minane nayo macho yake yalikuwa yamepofuka na hakuweza kuona.
Ekegusii: (Eli konya okoorire emiaka emerongo kianda, na megwanse etano na etato (98); amaiso aye konya aukoire; ase ayio tareenge konyara korora.)

English: The man said to Eli, “I am he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army.” He said, “How did the matter go, my son?”
Kiswahili: Akamwambia Eli, “Mimi nimetoka vitani sasa hivi, nimekimbia kutoka huko leo hii.” Eli akamuuliza, “Je, mwanangu, ni nini kimetokea huko?”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria agateebia Eli: “Ninche narua ase esegi, natama korwao ase rituko ria reero.” Erio Eli akamobooria: “Omwana one, naki esegi yagenderera?”

English: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”
Kiswahili: Yule mtu aliyeleta habari akajibu, “Israeli amekimbia mbele ya Wafilisti, nalo jeshi limepata hasara kubwa. Pia wana wako wawili, Hofni na Finehasi, wamekufa, na Sanduku la Mungu limetekwa.”
Ekegusii: Erio oria orentete amang’ana akamoiraneria: “Abaisraeli batamire korwa ase Abafirisiti, Abanto abange baitirwe; Hofini na Finehasi, abana bao babere, bakuure; boigo Esanduki ya Nyasae yairirwe.”

English: When he made mention of God’s ark, Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.
Kiswahili: Mara alipotaja Sanduku la Mungu, Eli alianguka kutoka kwenye kiti chake kwa nyuma kando ya lango. Shingo yake ikavunjika naye akafa, kwa kuwa alikuwa mzee tena mzito. Alikuwa amewaongoza Israeli kwa miaka arobaini.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria atorete Esanduki eria ya Nyasae, Eli akagwa gochia magega korwa ase ekerogo, agwo ase egeita ensemo, akabuneka ebigoti agakwa, ekiagera konya ogotire mono, naende nigo areenge omorito. Ere konya ogambeire Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.

English: His daughter-in-law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child, near to giving birth. When she heard the news that God’s ark was taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth; for her pains came on her.
Kiswahili: Mkwewe, mke wa Finehasi, alikuwa mjamzito na karibu wakati wa kujifungua. Aliposikia habari kwamba Sanduku la Mungu limetekwa na ya kuwa baba mkwe wake na mumewe wamekufa, akapata utungu naye akajifungua lakini akazidiwa na utungu.
Ekegusii: Bono moga Finehasi, omomura o Eli, nigo areenge morito; engaki yaye y’okogonkia konya yabereire ang’e. Ekero aigwete amang’ana ng’a ise biara amo nomosaacha oye bakuure, obororo bw’okobina bokamocheera, agatugama inse, akagonkia.

English: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn’t answer, neither did she regard it.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akifa, wanawake waliokuwa wanamhudumia wakamwambia, “Usikate tamaa, umemzaa mwana.” Lakini hakujibu wala kuweka maanani.
Ekegusii: Ekero areenge ang’e nogokwa, abakungu abaarenge komokoonya ase okomoiboria bakamoteebia: “Toiroka, ekiagera kwaiboire omwana omomura.” Korende omokungu oria tabairaneria gento, gose tategerera amang’ana abo.

English: She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.
Kiswahili: Alimwita yule mtoto Ikabodi, akisema, “Utukufu umeondoka katika Israeli,” kwa sababu ya kutekwa kwa Sanduku la Mungu na vifo vya baba mkwe na mumewe.
Ekegusii: Akaroka omwana oria I‐Kabodi, ogoteeba: “Obonene bwarure ase Abaisraeli.” Nigo akwanete igo, ekiagera Esanduki eria ya Nyasae konya yairirwe, boigo ekiagera ise biara konya okuure na omosacha oye konya oitirwe.

English: She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Utukufu umeondoka katika Israeli, kwa kuwa Sanduku la Mungu limetekwa.”
Ekegusii: Agateeba: “Obonene bwarure ase Abaisraeli,” ekiagera Esanduki eria ya Nyasae konya yairirwe.

English: Now the Philistines had taken God’s ark, and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Wafilisti kuteka Sanduku la Mungu, walilichukua kutoka Ebenezeri mpaka Ashdodi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abafirisiti bairete Esanduki eria ya Nyasae, bakayebogoria korwa Ebeni‐Eseri, bakayeira goika Asidodi,

English: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaliingiza lile Sanduku ndani ya hekalu la Dagoni na kuliweka kando ya huyo Dagoni.
Ekegusii: bakayesoyia ase Hekalu ya Dagoni, bakayegeka ensemo ya Dagoni, enyasae yabo.

English: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Ashdodi walipoamka asubuhi na mapema kesho yake, kumbe, wakamkuta Dagoni ameanguka chini kifudifudi mbele ya Sanduku la Bwana! Wakamwinua Dagoni na kumrudisha mahali pake.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere mambia chuni, ekero Abanto b’Asidodi babogeete, bakanyora Dagoni egwete inse maumama bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Omonene. Bakayegororokia, bakayetenenia aase aye.

English: When they arose early on the following morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold. Only Dagon’s torso was intact.
Kiswahili: Lakini asubuhi iliyofuata, walipoamka kumbe, walimkuta huyo Dagoni ameanguka chini kifudifudi mbele ya Sanduku la Bwana! Kichwa chake na mikono vilikuwa vimevunjwa navyo vimelala kizingitini, ni kiwiliwili chake tu kilichokuwa kimebaki.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato bagachia koboka mambia chuni, bakanyora naende Dagoni yaguure inse maumama, bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Omonene. Omotwe o Dagoni, na amaboko aye, konya biabutokire bire agwo ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri, ne rieene rioka nario riatigarete.

English: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu mpaka leo makuhani wa Dagoni wala wengine waingiao katika hekalu la Dagoni huko Ashdodi hawakanyagi kizingiti.
Ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na Abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase Hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa mzito juu ya watu wa Ashdodi na vijiji jirani, akaleta uharibifu juu yao na kuwatesa kwa majipu.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene gokaritoera Abanto b’Asidodi. Ere agaachanda na kwoboyia Abanto bonsi b’Asidodi amo nab’orogongo orwo rwonsi, akabaaka bakariegwa namagumba.

English: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us, for his hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god.”
Kiswahili: Watu wa Ashdodi walipoona kile kilichokuwa kikitokea, wakasema, “Sanduku la Mungu wa Israeli kamwe lisikae hapa pamoja na sisi, kwa sababu mkono wake ni mzito juu yetu na juu ya Dagoni mungu wetu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Abanto b’Asidodi baroche amang’ana ayio, bagateeba: “Esanduki eye ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tekonyara kobeera aiga amo naintwe, ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene nokorito igoro ase tore, na igoro ase Dagoni, enyasae yaito.”

English: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” They answered, “Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath.” They carried the ark of the God of Israel there.
Kiswahili: Basi wakawaita watawala wote wa Wafilisti pamoja na kuwauliza, “Tutafanya nini na hili Sanduku la Mungu wa Israeli?” Wakajibu, “Sanduku la Mungu wa Israeli na liende Gathi.” Basi wakalihamisha Sanduku la Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Bagatoma Abanto basangererie amo abanene bonsi b’Abafilisti, bakababooria: “Ninki togokora n’Esanduki eye ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli?” Barabwo bakairaneria: “Esanduki eria ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tiga eirwe Gati.” Ase igo bakaira Esanduki eria ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli aroro.

English: It was so, that after they had carried it there, Yahweh’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya kulihamisha, mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa dhidi ya huo mji wa Gathi, akiuweka katika fadhaa kuu. Mungu akawatesa watu wa huo mji, vijana kwa wazee, kwa kuwaletea majipu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bayeirireo, Omonene akarenta obotantanu obonene ase Abanto b’omochie oria, agaaka Abanto bonsi, abanene na abake, ase okobarentera amagumba.

English: So they sent God’s ark to Ekron. As God’s ark came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, “They have brought the ark of the God of Israel here to us, to kill us and our people.”
Kiswahili: Basi wakapeleka Sanduku la Mungu Ekroni. Wakati Sanduku la Mungu lilipokuwa linaingia Ekroni, watu wa Ekroni walilia wakisema “Wamelileta Sanduku la Mungu wa Israeli kwetu ili kutuua sisi na watu wetu.”
Ekegusii: Erio bakaira Esanduki eria ya Nyasae goika omochie bw’Ekironi. Korende ekero yaigete aroro, Abanto b’Ekironi bagaaka amariogi, bakaboora: “Barentire Esanduki eria ya Nyasae aiga seito, erinde batoite intwe twensi.”

English: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.
Kiswahili: Basi wakawaita watawala wote wa Wafilisti pamoja na kusema, “Liondoeni Sanduku la Mungu wa Israeli na lirudishwe mahali pake, la sivyo litatuua sisi na watu wetu.” Kwa kuwa kifo kilikuwa kimeujaza mji hofu; kwani mkono wa Mungu ulikuwa mzito sana juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bagatoma Abanto basangererie amo abanene bonsi b’Abafilisti, bakaboora: “Rusia aiga Esanduki eye ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, moyeiranie gochia aase aye, teebaisa gotoita intwe amo nabana baito.” Obwoba bw’amakweri konya bwasoire ase omochie bwonsi, ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwareenge okorito mono aroro.

English: The men who didn’t die were struck with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
Kiswahili: Wale ambao hawakufa walipatwa na majipu, na kilio cha mji kilikwenda juu hadi mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria batakwete bakariegwa namagumba, bakarera, na ekerero kiabo kegaika igoro.

English: Yahweh’s ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Bwana lilipokuwa limekaa katika nchi ya Wafilisti kwa miezi saba,
Ekegusii: Esanduki eria y’Omonene ekabeera ase ense y’Abafilisti ase engaki y’emetienyi etano na ebere.

English: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, “What shall we do with Yahweh’s ark? Show us how we should send it to its place.”
Kiswahili: Wafilisti waliwaita makuhani wa Dagoni na waaguzi, na kuwaambia, “Tutafanya nini na hili Sanduku la Bwana? Tuambieni jinsi tutakavyolirudisha mahali pake.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abafirisiti bakarangeria abakuani babo na abaringoria, bakababooria, “Ninki togokora ase Esanduki eye y’Omonene? Toteebie ’nchera ki torayeiranie aase aye.”

English: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, don’t send it empty; but by all means return a trespass offering to him. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.”
Kiswahili: Wakajibu, “Kama mtalirudisha Sanduku la Mungu wa Israeli, msilirudishe mikono mitupu bali kwa vyovyote mpelekeeni sadaka ya hatia. Kisha mtaponywa, nanyi mtafahamu kwa nini mkono wake haujaondolewa kwenu.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakabairaneria: “Onye mokoirania Esanduki eyio ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, timobaisa koyeirania bosa etari nebiegwa; goika momoruere okoruegwa ase engencho y’okomocha. Erio namogwene, naende monyare komanya ng’a nase ki Omonene agendererete kobaa egesusuro.”

English: Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?” They said, “Five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakawauliza, “Ni sadaka gani ya hatia tutakayompelekea?” Wakajibu, “Majipu matano ya dhahabu na panya wa dhahabu watano, kulingana na idadi ya watawala wa Wafilisti, kwa sababu tauni iyo hiyo imewaua ninyi na watawala wenu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakabooria, “Inee! Okoruegwa okwo gw’okomocha nkoroki torairanie ase Omonene?” Barabwo bakabairaneria, “Emegwekano etano y’amagumba, na etano ye chimbeba, yonsi eroisirie korwa ase etaabu. Moire emegwekano koreng’ana nomobaro bwe chinyasae chia Abafirisiti, ekiagera amaakwa ayio nigo abeete igoro ase more mwensi, na igoro ase abanene baino boigo.

English: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.
Kiswahili: Tengenezeni mifano ya majipu na ya panya wale wanaoharibu nchi yenu, nanyi mheshimuni Mungu wa Israeli. Labda ataondoa mkono wake kutoka kwenu na kwa miungu yenu na nchi yenu.
Ekegusii: Goika moroisie emegwekano y’amagumba, na eye chimbeba, ebio bigosaria ense yaino; erio motogie Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ande nabo arakore emechando yaino ebe emegusu ase more, na ase chinyasae chiaino, na ase ense yaino.

English: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully among them, didn’t they let the people go, and they departed?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini ninyi mnafanya mioyo yenu migumu kama Wamisri na Farao walivyofanya? Je, alipowatendea kwa ukali, hawakuwaachia Waisraeli wakaenda zao?
Ekegusii: Nase ki mogokong’ia chinkoro chiaino buna Abamisiri na Farao bakong’etie chinkoro chiabo. Inee! Ekero Omonene abaete amaakwa amakong’u tibaete Abaisraeli ribaga bakaruao?

English: “Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke; and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi, wekeni gari jipya la kukokotwa pamoja na ngʼombe wawili ambao wamezaa lakini ambao kamwe hawajafungwa nira. Fungieni hao ngʼombe hilo gari, lakini ondoeni ndama wao na mwaweke zizini.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, roisia egari enyia morente chiombe ibere chigokamwa, chitana gosiberwa rikorogoto; mosibere chiombe echio egari eyio, korende morusie chimori chiabo korwa ase chirochio, mochitige ’nka.

English: and take Yahweh’s ark and lay it on the cart. Put the jewels of gold, which you return him for a trespass offering, in a box by its side; and send it away, that it may go.
Kiswahili: Chukueni hilo Sanduku la Bwana na mliweke juu ya gari la kukokotwa, na ndani ya kasha kando yake wekeni hivyo vitu vya dhahabu mnavyompelekea Bwana kama sadaka ya hatia. Lipelekeni,
Ekegusii: Moimokie Esanduki eye y’Omonene ase egari igoro, na emegwekano eria y’etaabu, mokebeeke ase esanduki eng’ao ebeere ensemo y’Esanduki eria y’Omonene. Emegwekano eyio moyeirere Omonene, erio ebe okoruegwa ase engencho y’okomocha okwo. Magega y’ayio motige Esanduki egende aase aye.

English: Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.”
Kiswahili: lakini liangalieni kwa makini. Iwapo litakwenda katika nchi yake lenyewe, kuelekea Beth-Shemeshi, basi tutajua kwamba Bwana ndiye alileta haya maafa makubwa juu yetu. Lakini kama halikwenda, basi tutajua kwamba haukuwa mkono wa Bwana uliotupiga na kwamba iliyotokea kwetu ni ajali.”
Ekegusii: Erio morende: onye ekogenda enchera ya boronge gochia ase ense yaye, nakwo ogoteeba omochie o Beti‐Semesi, rirorio momanye ng’a Omonene otorenteire obobe obwo obonene, korende onye taibo, rirorio tomanye ng’a tari okoboko kwaye gwatoaka; ande nigo twanyora emechando eye mosiabano.”

English: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.
Kiswahili: Basi wakafanya hivyo. Wakachukua ngʼombe wawili wa aina hiyo, wakawafungia hilo gari la kukokotwa, nao ndama wao wakawekwa zizini.
Ekegusii: Erio Abanto abwo bagakora boigo. Bakaimokia chiombe ibere chigokamwa, bagachisibera egari, bagasiekera chimori nka.

English: They put Yahweh’s ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.
Kiswahili: Wakaliweka Sanduku la Bwana juu ya hilo gari la kukokotwa pamoja na lile kasha lenye ile mifano ya panya wa dhahabu na ya majipu ya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Bakabeeka Esanduki y’Omonene ase egari, bakabeeka na esanduki eria yabeekire emegwekano eria ye chimbeba na ey’amagumba eroisirie korwa ase etaabu.

English: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh. They went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.
Kiswahili: Kisha hao ngʼombe wakaenda moja kwa moja kuelekea Beth-Shemeshi, wakishuka bila kugeuka kuume au kushoto, huku wakilia njia yote. Watawala wa Wafilisti waliwafuata hao ngʼombe hadi mpakani mwa Beth-Shemeshi.
Ekegusii: Chiombe chiria chikagenda chikona‐kwana, chikabwatia enchera endonge ekogenda Beti‐Semesi, tichiagobera aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee, na abagaambi b’Abafilisti bakaba bagochitunyana korwa magega, goika ase orobebe rwa Beti‐Semesi.

English: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu watu wa Beth-Shemeshi walikuwa wakivuna ngano yao huko bondeni, walipoinua macho yao na kuona lile Sanduku, wakafurahi kuliona.
Ekegusii: Bono Abanto ba Beti‐Semesi nkogesa baarenge engano yabo agwo ase rikura, na ekero barigereretie, bakarora Esanduki eria, bakagooka mono.

English: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Lile gari la kukokotwa lilikuja mpaka kwenye shamba la Yoshua wa Beth-Shemeshi, nalo likasimama kando ya mwamba mkubwa. Watu wakapasua mbao za lile gari la kukokotwa na kutoa dhabihu wale ngʼombe kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero egari eria yaigete ase omogondo o Yoshua o Beti‐Semesi egatenenao, ase rigena rinene riarenge. Abanto bagaatia chibao chi’egari eria, erio bakarua chiombe chiria chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase Omonene.

English: The Levites took down Yahweh’s ark and the box that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone; and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Walawi walilishusha Sanduku la Bwana, pamoja na lile kasha lililokuwa na vile vitu vya dhahabu na kuviweka juu ya ule mwamba mkubwa. Siku ile watu wa Beth-Shemeshi wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abalawi bakarusia Esanduki eria y’Omonene, amo nesanduki eria ende yabeekire amo, eyareenge nemegwekano eria y’etaabu, bagachibeeka igoro ase rigena riria rinene. Erio ase rituko riria Abanto ba Beti‐Semesi bakaruera Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde.

English: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.
Kiswahili: Wale watawala watano wa Wafilisti waliona haya yote, nao wakarudi siku ile ile mpaka Ekroni.
Ekegusii: Ekero abagaambi baria b’Abafilisti baroche ayio bakairana gochia Ekironi ase rituko riria.

English: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to Yahweh: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo yale majipu ya dhahabu Wafilisti waliyotuma kama sadaka ya hatia kwa Bwana, moja kwa ajili ya Ashdodi, moja kwa Gaza, moja kwa Ashkeloni, moja kwa Gathi, na moja kwa Ekroni.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakarua emegwekano eria y’amagumba, eroisirie korwa ase etaabu, ekaba okoruegwa gw’okomocha ase Omonene, omogwekano oyomo korwa ase kera oyomo bw’emechie eyio: Asidodi, na Gasa, na Askeloni, na Gati, na Ekironi.

English: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.
Kiswahili: Nayo hesabu ya wale panya wa dhahabu ilikuwa kulingana na idadi ya miji ya Wafilisti ya watawala watano wa Wafilisti: miji yao iliyozungukwa na maboma, pamoja na vijiji vya miji hiyo. Ule mwamba mkubwa, ambao juu yake waliliweka lile Sanduku la Bwana, ni ushahidi hadi leo katika shamba la Yoshua wa Beth-Shemeshi.
Ekegusii: Boigo bakarua emegwekano eria ye chimbeba eroisirie korwa ase chitaabu, oyomo korwa ase kera omochie orenge kogamberwa nabanene baria batano b’Abafilisti, emechie eyio yonsi yagiteire chindwaki na ebichie bionsi bitagiteire. Ne rigena riria rinene ase babeegete Esanduki eria y’Omonene nigo rire kirori goika rituko ria reero agwo ase omogondo o Yoshua o Beti‐Semesi.

English: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men. Then the people mourned, because Yahweh had struck the people with a great slaughter.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu aliwapiga baadhi ya watu wa Beth-Shemeshi, akiwaua watu sabini miongoni mwao kwa sababu walichungulia ndani ya Sanduku la Bwana. Watu wakaomboleza kwa sababu ya pigo zito kutoka kwa Bwana,
Ekegusii: Omonene agaita Abanto ba Beti‐Semesi emerongo etano na ebere korwa ase Abanto chilifu emerongo etano, ekiagera barigereretie Esanduki eria. Abanto bakaba bakorera na kweumia, ekiagera Omonene aitete Abanto abange ase egati yabo.

English: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before Yahweh, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”
Kiswahili: nao watu wa Beth-Shemeshi wakauliza, “Ni nani awezaye kusimama mbele za Bwana, huyu Mungu aliye mtakatifu? Sanduku litapanda kwenda kwa nani kutoka hapa?”
Ekegusii: Erio Abanto ba Beti‐Semesi bakaboora, “Ning’o oranyare gotenena ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oyo Omochenu? Nase banto ki aragende gakorua ase tore?”

English: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back Yahweh’s ark. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.”
Kiswahili: Kisha wakatuma wajumbe kwa watu wa Kiriath-Yearimu, wakisema, “Wafilisti wamerudisha Sanduku la Bwana. Shukeni na mlipandishe huko kwenu.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo bagatoma Abanto ase baria bemenyete Kiriati‐Yearimu baabateebie ng’a, “Abafirisiti bairanirie Esanduki eria y’Omonene. Tirimboka gocha moyioyie.”

English: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took Yahweh’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep Yahweh’s ark.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wa Kiriath-Yearimu wakaja na kulichukua Sanduku la Bwana. Wakalipeleka katika nyumba ya Abinadabu juu kilimani na kumweka Eleazari mwanawe wakfu kulichunga Sanduku la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu bagaacha, bakaira Esanduki eria y’Omonene, bakayebeka ase enyomba y’Abinadabu, ase ekegoro igoro; bagachoora na gwatanana Eleazari, omwana oye omomura, abe okorenda Esanduki eria.

English: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long—for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel lamented after Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Bwana lilibakia huko Kiriath-Yearimu kwa muda mrefu, yaani jumla ya miaka ishirini, nao watu wa Israeli wakaomboleza na kumtafuta Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio Esanduki eria y’Omonene ekabeera agwo Kiriati-Yearimu ase engaki entaambe, emiaka emerongo ebere. Ase engaki eyio yonsi, Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bakorera ase Omonene ng’a abakoonye.

English: Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to Yahweh with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to Yahweh, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”
Kiswahili: Naye Samweli akawaambia nyumba yote ya Israeli, “Ikiwa mtamrudia Bwana kwa mioyo yenu yote, basi iacheni miungu migeni na Maashtorethi na kujitoa wenyewe kwa Bwana na kumtumikia yeye peke yake, naye atawaokoa ninyi na mkono wa Wafilisti.”
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli agateebia Abaisraeli bonsi: “Onye mogochia koonchoka na koirana ase Omonene ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, morusie korwa ase more chinyasae chingeni chionsi, amo n’Asitaroti, mokorere Omonene bweka; erio nario arabatoorie korwa ase amaboko yabafilisti.”

English: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served Yahweh only.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Waisraeli wakaweka mbali Mabaali yao na Maashtorethi, nao wakamtumikia Bwana peke yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarusia korwa ase bare chinyasae chiria Baali na Asitaroti, bakamokorera Omonene bweka.

English: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to Yahweh for you.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Samweli akasema, “Wakusanyeni Israeli wote huko Mispa, nami nitawaombea ninyi kwa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Samweli agateeba, “Sangereria Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Misipa, erinde imbasabere aroro ase Omonene.”

English: They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before Yahweh, and fasted on that day, and said there, “We have sinned against Yahweh.” Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kukutanika huko Mispa, walichota maji na kuyamimina mbele za Bwana. Siku hiyo walifunga na wakaungama, wakisema, “Tumetenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana.” Naye Samweli alikuwa kiongozi wa Israeli huko Mispa.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagasangererekana agwo Misipa, bakabuucha amaache, bakayaumora agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakeng’ata ase rituko erio, bagakwana aroro agwo, “Twakorire ebibe ase Omonene.” Erio Samweli akaba okogaambera Abaisraeli agwo Misipa.

English: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. When the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti waliposikia kwamba Israeli wamekusanyika huko Mispa, watawala wa Wafilisti wakapanda ili kuwashambulia. Waisraeli waliposikia habari hiyo, waliogopa kwa sababu ya Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abafirisiti baigwete ng’a Abaisraeli basangererekanire agwo Misipa, abanene b’Abafilisti bakagenda gochia kobarwania. Abaisraeli bagachia koigwa amang’ana ayio, bakabairoka,

English: The children of Israel said to Samuel, “Don’t stop crying to Yahweh our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia Samweli, “Usiache kumlilia Bwana, Mungu wetu, kwa ajili yetu, ili apate kutuokoa na mikono ya Wafilisti.”
Ekegusii: bagateebia Samweli, “Tobaisa gotiga kogenderera gotosabera ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, ng’a atotoorie korwa ase amaboko y’Abafilisti.”

English: Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt offering to Yahweh. Samuel cried to Yahweh for Israel, and Yahweh answered him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Samweli akamchukua mwana-kondoo anyonyaye na kumtoa mzima kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa Bwana. Akamlilia Bwana kwa niaba ya Israeli, naye Bwana akamjibu.
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimokia emaanwa y’eng’ondi ekogonka, akayerua ase Omonene ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ekegima, agasabera Abaisraeli ase Omonene, n’Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kwaye.

English: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines came near to battle against Israel; but Yahweh thundered with a great thunder on that day on the Philistines and confused them; and they were struck down before Israel.
Kiswahili: Samweli alipokuwa anatoa hiyo dhabihu ya kuteketezwa, Wafilisti wakasogea karibu ili kupigana vita na Israeli. Lakini siku ile Bwana alinguruma kwa ngurumo kubwa dhidi ya Wafilisti na kuwafanya wafadhaike na kutetemeka hivi kwamba walikimbizwa mbele ya Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Ekero Samweli areenge korua ekeng’wanso keria ki’ogosaambwa, Abafirisiti bagaacha korwania Abaisraeli, korende Omonene akabarentera okogukura okonene gwe chinkoba korwa igoro, akabataantania, na Abaisraeli bakabua Abafirisiti.

English: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them until they came under Beth Kar.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Israeli wakatoka mbio huko Mispa na kuwafuatia Wafilisti, wakiwachinja njiani hadi mahali chini ya Beth-Kari.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka korwa agwo Misipa, bakabwatia Abafirisiti goika Beti‐Kari, bakabaitera ’nchera.

English: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us until now.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Samweli akachukua jiwe na kulisimamisha kati ya Mispa na Sheni. Akaliita Ebenezeri, akisema, “Hata sasa Bwana ametusaidia.”
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimokia rigena, akaritenenia gati ya Misipa na Seni, akariroka Ebeni‐Eseri, akabora: “Omonene otokonyire twaikire aiga.”

English: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped coming within the border of Israel. Yahweh’s hand was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
Kiswahili: Basi Wafilisti wakashindwa na hawakuvamia nchi ya Israeli tena. Katika maisha yote ya Samweli, mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa dhidi ya Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Abafirisiti bakabugwa, tibanyora ribaga naende gosoa ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwareenge mamincha y’Abafilisti ase amatuko onsi Samweli areenge moyo.

English: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines. There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
Kiswahili: Miji kuanzia Ekroni hadi Gathi, ile ambayo Wafilisti walikuwa wameiteka kutoka Israeli, ilirudishwa kwake, naye Israeli akazikomboa nchi jirani mikononi mwa Wafilisti. Kukawepo amani kati ya Israeli na Waamori.
Ekegusii: Emechie yonsi egati y’Ekironi na Gati, eyio Abafirisiti konya baurire Abaisraeli, ekairanigwa amo ne chingongo chiaetanaineo. Agwo boigo omorembe okaba ase egati y’Abaisraeli na Abaamori.

English: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Samweli akaendelea kama mwamuzi juu ya Israeli siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Samweli akaba omogambi ebiina bw’Abaisraeli ase amatuko onsi areenge moyo.

English: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.
Kiswahili: Mwaka hadi mwaka aliendelea kuzunguka kutoka Betheli mpaka Gilgali na Mispa, akiamua Israeli katika sehemu hizo zote.
Ekegusii: Kera omwaka akaba okogenda goika Beteli, na Giligali, na Misipa, akaba okogaambera Abaisraeli ebiina ase emechie eyio yonsi.

English: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there, and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to Yahweh there.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila mara alirudi Rama, kulikokuwa nyumbani kwake, huko pia aliwaamua Israeli. Naye huko alimjengea Bwana madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Erio akaba okoirana Rama, ekiagera agwo nao bwoye yarenge, na agwo akaba okogaamba ebiina bi’Abaisraeli, naende akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero.

English: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
Kiswahili: Samweli alipokuwa mzee, akaweka wanawe kuwa waamuzi wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ekero Samweli konya agotire akabeeka abamura baye babe abagaambi igoro y’Abaisraeli.

English: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
Kiswahili: Mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Yoeli, na la wa pili lilikuwa Abiya, nao wakatumika huko Beer-Sheba.
Ekegusii: Omomura oye omotangi nigo are korokwa Yoel, na oyo o kabere Abiya. Barabwo nigo babete abagaambi agwo Beeri‐Seba.

English: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.
Kiswahili: Lakini wanawe hawakuenenda katika njia zake. Waliziacha wakageukia faida za udanganyifu nao wakapokea rushwa na kupotosha haki.
Ekegusii: Korende abamura ba Samweli tibakorete buna ise areenge gokora ase okobwatia oboronge; bakabotiga na bakerigeria chinibo, bakarigia riaaki na bakaonchorana oboronge.

English: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.
Kiswahili: Basi wazee wote wa Israeli wakakusanyika pamoja na kumjia Samweli huko Rama.
Ekegusii: Erio abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagasangererekana amo, bakagenda ase Samweli agwo Rama,

English: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Wewe umekuwa mzee, nao wanao hawaenendi katika njia zako, sasa tuteulie mfalme wa kutuongoza, kama ilivyo kwa mataifa mengine yote.”
Ekegusii: bakamoteebia: “Rora bono aye kwagotire, na abamura bao tibari kobwatia chinchera chiao. Ase ayio tochorere omorwoti oranyare gotogaambera buna ebisaku binde bionsi bibwate abarwoti.”

English: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao waliposema, “Tupe mfalme wa kutuongoza,” hili lilimchukiza Samweli, hivyo akamwomba Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende Samweli tancha amang’ana ayio bamoteebetie: “Toe omorwoti atogaambere.” Ase ayio Samweli agasaba Omonene.

English: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana akamwambia: “Sikiliza yale yote watu wanakuambia. Si wewe ambaye wamekukataa, bali wamenikataa mimi kuwa mfalme wao.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoteebia: “Otegerere amang’ana abo baragotebie. Tari aye bangire, korende ninche bangire, timba omorwoti obo.

English: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.
Kiswahili: Kama vile walivyofanya tangu siku nilipowapandisha kutoka Misri mpaka siku hii ya leo; wakiniacha mimi na kutumikia miungu mingine, ndivyo wanavyokufanyia wewe.
Ekegusii: Korwa ekero keria nabarusetie Misiri goika reero iga bantigire inche, babeire bagokorera chinyasae ching’ao, na bono bagotigire aye buna bantigete inche.

English: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”
Kiswahili: Sasa wasikilize, lakini waonye kwa makini na uwafahamishe yale watakayotendewa na mfalme atakayewatawala.”
Ekegusii: Gaki bono, igwera amang’ana abo, korende obakuurere mono, obateebie aya omorwoti orache kobagaambera arabe ogokora.”

English: Samuel told all Yahweh’s words to the people who asked him for a king.
Kiswahili: Samweli akawaambia wale watu waliokuwa wakiomba wapewe mfalme maneno yote ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Samweli agateebia Abanto baria baganetie omorwoti amang’ana onsi Omonene amotebeetie.

English: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Hivi ndivyo atakavyowatendea mfalme atakayewatawala. Atawachukua wana wenu na kuwafanya watumike kwa magari yake ya vita na farasi, nao watakimbia mbele ya magari yake.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Aya naro omorwoti oyio orabagambere arabakorere: Naire abana baino abamura, ababeeke ase chigari chiaye, na abande ababeeke babe abariini be chibarasi chiaye bamokorere. Abande babetererigwe baminyoke bosio bwe chigari chiaye.

English: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.
Kiswahili: Baadhi yao atawaweka kuwa majemadari wa jeshi wa maelfu na majemadari wa jeshi wa hamsini, wengine kulima mashamba yake na kuvuna mavuno yake, pia na wengine kutengeneza silaha za vita na vifaa kwa ajili ya magari yake.
Ekegusii: Abande babekwe babe abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na abande b’emerongo etano. Abande babe bakorema emegondo yaye na kogesa endagera yaye, abande babe bakoroisia ebirwanero bi’eseegi na ebikorero bie chigari chiaye.

English: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.
Kiswahili: Atawachukua binti zenu kuwa watengeneza manukato, wapishi na waokaji.
Ekegusii: Naire abaiseke baino bachie koba abaroisia amaguta akweakwa, abande babe bakoruga endagera na koroisia emegati.

English: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.
Kiswahili: Atayachukua mashamba yenu yaliyo mazuri, mashamba ya mizabibu na mashamba yenu ya mizeituni na kuwapa watumishi wake.
Ekegusii: Naire na emegondo yaino y’endagera, na ey’emesabibu, na ey’emezeituni eyere emiya mono, ayee abasomba baye.

English: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.
Kiswahili: Ataichukua sehemu ya kumi ya nafaka yenu na ya zabibu zenu na kuwapa maafisa wake na watumishi wake.
Ekegusii: Narusie ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase rigesa riaino ri’emegondo y’endagera, na ey’emesabibu, ayee abwo bakomorenda, na abasomba baye.

English: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.
Kiswahili: Atawachukua watumishi wenu wa kiume na wa kike, na ngʼombe wenu walio wazuri sana na punda kwa matumizi yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Boigo naire abasomba baino, abamura na abaiseke, na abasae baino abaya, babe bakomokorera, ne chitigere chiaino chibe chikomokorera boigo.

English: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.
Kiswahili: Atachukua sehemu ya kumi ya makundi yenu ya kondoo na mbuzi, na ninyi wenyewe mtakuwa watumwa wake.
Ekegusii: Naende arusie ensemo ya ikomi y’amaicho aino, nainwe abanyene mobe abasomba baye.

English: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”
Kiswahili: Siku ile itakapowadia, mtalia kwa kutaka msaada kutokana na mfalme mliyemchagua, naye Bwana hatawajibu.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio inamobe mokorera nobororo ase engencho y’omorwoti oino, oyio mwechorerete, korende Omonene takoba ogotegerera okorera kwaino.”

English: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wakakataa kumsikiliza Samweli wakasema, “Hapana! Tunataka mfalme wa kututawala.
Ekegusii: Korende Abanto bakaanga gotegerera Samweli, bakaboora: “Yaya, taibo! Nigo toganetie omorwoti atogambere.

English: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”
Kiswahili: Kisha tutakuwa kama mataifa mengine yote, tukiwa na mfalme wa kutuongoza na kwenda mbele yetu na kutupigania vita vyetu.”
Ekegusii: Ntorigetie koba buna ebisaku binde; ntoganetie omorwoti ogotogaambera na gototang’ana, ekero togochia korwana chiseegi chiaito.”

English: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Samweli aliposikia yote watu waliyosema, akarudia kuyasema mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero Samweli aigwete amang’ana aya Abanto bakwanire, akayaira ase Omonene.

English: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamjibu, “Wasikilize na uwape mfalme.” Kisha Samweli akawaambia watu wa Israeli, “Kila mmoja arudi mjini kwake.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Samweli: “Igwera amang’ana abo, obachorere omorwoti.” Erio Samweli agateebia Abaisraeli bairane, kera omonto ase omochie oye.

English: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwako Mbenyamini mmoja, mtu maarufu, ambaye aliitwa Kishi mwana wa Abieli, mwana wa Serori, mwana wa Bekorathi, mwana wa Afia wa Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Benjamini nareengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Kisi, mosinto bw’Abieli, o Serori, o Bekorati bw’Afia, omonto bw’egesaku gia Benjamini. Kisi nigo areenge omonto omonda.

English: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa na mwana aliyeitwa Sauli, kijana anayevutia sana, hakuwepo aliyelingana naye miongoni mwa Waisraeli, alikuwa mrefu kuliko wengine wote.
Ekegusii: Nabwate omwana omomura ore korokwa Saulo. Ere nigo areenge omonyakieni mono. Momura onde tareenge ase egati y’Abaisraeli obwate ekieni ekiya komobua. Ere nigo aetanetie Abanto bande bonsi ase obotaambe bw’omotwe korwa ase amareko gochia igoro.

English: The donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. Kish said to Saul his son, “Now take one of the servants with you, and arise, go look for the donkeys.”
Kiswahili: Basi punda wa Kishi baba yake Sauli walipotea, naye Kishi akamwambia mwanawe Sauli, “Mchukue mmoja wa watumishi mwende pamoja naye kuwatafuta punda.”
Ekegusii: Bono chitigere chia Kisi, ise Saulo, chigasira. Ase igo Kisi agateebia Saulo: “Imoka oire oyomo bw’abasomba, mogende korigia chitigere.”

English: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akapita katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu na katika eneo la Shalisha, lakini hawakuwapata. Wakaendelea katika sehemu ya Shaalimu, lakini punda hawakuwepo huko. Kisha wakapita katika nchi ya Benyamini, lakini hawakuwapata.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda, bagaeta ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu, na ense ya Salisa, korende tibachinyora. Naende bagaeta ase ense ya Saalimu, korende chitigere echio tichiareengeo. Magega y’ayio bagaeta ase orogongo rwa Benjamini, nonya narororwa tibachinyoora.

English: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, “Come! Let’s return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us.”
Kiswahili: Walipofika sehemu ya Sufu, Sauli akamwambia mtumishi aliyekuwa pamoja naye, “Njoo, sisi na turudi, au baba yangu ataacha kufikiria juu ya punda na kuanza kufadhaika kutuhusu sisi.”
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase ense ya Sufu, Saulo agateebia omosomba oria baarenge komo: “Bono tiga toirane gochia nka. Ande nigo tata aratige korengereria igoro ye chitigere, ne ribaga ri’ayio abe ogotochandekera intwe.”

English: The servant said to him, “Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor. All that he says surely happens. Now let’s go there. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mtumishi akajibu, “Tazama, katika mji huu yupo mtu wa Mungu, anayeheshimiwa sana na kila kitu asemacho hutokea kweli. Sasa na twende huko. Huenda atatuambia twende njia ipi.”
Ekegusii: Omosomba oria akamoiraneria: “Rora, ase omochie oyo omonto o Nyasae nareo, ere nomonto osikire; amang’ana onsi agokwana nigo agoikerana. Eta togende aroro, ande nabo aratotebie amang’ana igoro y’orogendo rwaito.”

English: Then Saul said to his servant, “But behold, if we go, what should we bring the man? For the bread is spent in our sacks, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?”
Kiswahili: Sauli akamwambia mtumishi wake, “Kama tukienda, tutampa nini huyo mtu? Chakula kimekwisha kwenye mifuko yetu. Hatuna zawadi ya kumpelekea huyo mtu wa Mungu. Je tuna nini?”
Ekegusii: Saulo akabooria omosomba oye: “Onye tokogenda ase omonto oyio, inki tobwate tokomoirera? Endagera twabwate ase ebibekerero biaito yaerire, na keegwa kende titobwati tokoirera omonto oyio o Nyasae. Ninki tobwate?”

English: The servant answered Saul again and said, “Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way.”
Kiswahili: Mtumishi akamjibu Sauli tena, akasema, “Tazama, nina fedha robo shekeli. Hiyo nitampa huyo mtu wa Mungu ili aweze kutuambia twende kwa njia ipi.”
Ekegusii: Omosomba oria akamoiraneria naende: “Rora, nimbwate aa akang’ese gi’esekeli y’efeta. Eye ning’ee omonto oria o Nyasae, erinde atotebie enchera tokogenda.”

English: (In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.)
Kiswahili: (Zamani katika Israeli, kama mtu alikwenda kuuliza neno kwa Mungu, angalisema, “Njoo na twende kwa mwonaji,” kwa sababu nabii wa sasa alikuwa akiitwa mwonaji.)
Ekegusii: (Agwo kare ase Abaisraeli, ekero omonto areenge kogenda koboria ring’ana korwa ase Nyasae nigo areenge goteeba: “Inchuo togende ase omoorori.” Omonto okorokwa omobani bono, kare nigo areenge korokwa omoorori.)

English: Then Saul said to his servant, “Well said. Come! Let’s go.” So they went to the city where the man of God was.
Kiswahili: Sauli akamwambia mtumishi wake, “Vyema, njoo na twende.” Basi wakaenda mjini alipokuwepo huyo mtu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Saulo agateebia omosomba oye: “gwateebire buya; inchwo togende.” Ase igo bakagenda ase omochie ase omonto oyio o Nyasae areenge.

English: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here?”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakipanda mlima kwenda mjini, wakakutana na baadhi ya wasichana wanakuja kuchota maji, nao wakawauliza, “Je, mwonaji yuko?”
Ekegusii: Ekero baareenge gotiira ekegoro gochia ase omochie, bakaumerana nabaiseke baare kogenda kobuucha amaache, bakababooria: “Inee! Omorori nao are aa?”

English: They answered them and said, “He is. Behold, he is before you. Hurry now, for he has come today into the city; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place.
Kiswahili: Wakajibu, “Yuko, yu mbele yenu amewatangulia, sasa fanyeni haraka, ndiyo tu amekuja mjini kwetu leo, kwa kuwa watu wana dhabihu huko mahali pa juu.
Ekegusii: Abaiseke baria bakabairaneria: “Ee, nao are aa, oyio bosio bwaino. Genda bwango momonyooore. Mbono achire ase omochie, ekiagera Abanto ngochia bare korua ebing’wanso agwo ase ekegoro igoro.

English: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”
Kiswahili: Mara tu mwingiapo mjini, mtamkuta kabla hajapanda kwenda mahali pa juu kula. Watu hawataanza kula mpaka atakapofika kwa sababu ni lazima kwanza yeye abariki dhabihu, ndipo wale walioalikwa watakapokula. Pandeni sasa, mtamkuta kwa wakati huu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero mogosoa ase omochie namomonyoore ritang’ani ataratiira gochia ase ekegoro koragera. Abanto tibakoragera ritang’ani ataraikao, ekiagera ere goika asesenie ekeng’wanso keria. Erio baria barangeirie banyare gochaaka koragera. Ase ayio, genda bwango, ekiagera ase engaki eye nero moramonyoore.”

English: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them to go up to the high place.
Kiswahili: Wakapanda mjini, nao walipokuwa wakiingia mjini, tazama, Samweli alikuwa akija kuelekea walikokwenda mahali pa juu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakagenda ase omochie. Ekero baarenge gosoa aroro bakarora Samweli ogocha koumerana nabarabwo, ekero areenge gotiira gochia aase agwo bakoruera ebing’wanso.

English: Now Yahweh had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,
Kiswahili: Basi siku moja kabla Sauli hajaja, Bwana alikuwa amemfunulia Samweli jambo hili:
Ekegusii: Bono rituko erimo, ekero Saulo ataracha aroro, Omonene konya omoorokeirie Samweli na omotebirie,

English: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”
Kiswahili: “Kesho wakati kama huu nitakupelekea mtu kutoka nchi ya Benyamini. Umtie mafuta awe kiongozi juu ya watu wangu Israeli, ndiye atakayewakomboa watu wangu na mkono wa Wafilisti. Nimewaangalia watu wangu, kwa kuwa kilio chao kimenifikia.”
Ekegusii: “Ankio engaki buna eye ninkorentere omonto korwa ase orogongo rwa Benjamini, naye omoake amaguta, erinde abe omonene igoro y’Abanto baane Abaisraeli. Nere oratoorie Abanto baane korwa ase amaboko y’Abafilisti, ekiagera narorire emechando y’Abanto baane, na ekerero kiabo giaikire ase ’nde.”

English: When Samuel saw Saul, Yahweh said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! He will have authority over my people.”
Kiswahili: Samweli alipomwona Sauli, Bwana akamwambia, “Huyu ndiye mtu niliyekuambia habari zake, kwamba yeye atawatawala watu wangu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Samweli aroche Saulo, Omonene akamoteebia: “Omonto oyio nere nagoteebia amang’ana aye. Oyo nere orabe okogaambera Abanto baane.”

English: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”
Kiswahili: Sauli akamkaribia Samweli langoni na kumuuliza, “Tafadhali, je, waweza kuniambia mahali nyumba ya mwonaji ilipo?”
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo akamochiera Samweli agwo ase egeita, akamoteebia: “Koranche onteebie ase omoorori amenyete.”

English: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.
Kiswahili: Samweli akamjibu Sauli, “Mimi ndiye mwonaji, panda utangulie mbele yangu mpaka mahali pa juu, kwa kuwa leo itakupasa kula pamoja nami na asubuhi nitakuruhusu uende na nitakuambia yale yote yaliyo moyoni mwako.
Ekegusii: Samweli akamoiraneria: “Ninche omoorori oyio. Genda motang’ane gochia aase agwo ebing’wanso bikoruerwa, ekiagera reero namorie endagera aroro amo nainche. Ankio ninkoe ribaga ogende, na inche ngotebie amang’ana onsi are ase ebirengererio biao.

English: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago, don’t set your mind on them, for they have been found. For whom does all Israel desire? Is it not you and all your father’s house?”
Kiswahili: Kuhusu wale punda uliowapoteza siku tatu zilizopita, usifadhaike kwa habari yao; wamepatikana. Ni kwa nani ambaye shauku yote ya Israeli imeelekea, kama si kwako na jamaa yote ya baba yako?”
Ekegusii: Tochandeeka ase engencho ye chitigere chiria chiasirete korwa ase amatuko atato aetire, ekiagera echio chianyorekanire. Inee! Ebinto bionsi ebiya bire ase egati y’Abaisraeli nase ng’o birabe? Nigo birabe asore na ase Abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya iso.”

English: Saul answered, “Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak to me like this?”
Kiswahili: Sauli akajibu, “Je, mimi si Mbenyamini, kutoka kabila dogo kuliko yote ya Israeli, nao ukoo wangu si ndio mdogo kuliko koo zote za kabila la Benyamini? Kwa nini uniambie jambo la namna hiyo?”
Ekegusii: Saulo akairaneria akabora: “Inche nomonto bw’egesaku gia Benjamini egesaku egeke mono ase Abaisraeli, na eamate yane nero nenke mono ase chiamate chionsi chi’egesaku ekio. Nase ki rende gwakwanire ase inde ring’ana ringa buna erio?”

English: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.
Kiswahili: Kisha Samweli akamleta Sauli na mtumishi wake ndani ukumbini na kuwaketisha mahali pa heshima zaidi miongoni mwa wale waliokuwa wamealikwa; jumla yao walikuwa kama watu thelathini.
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaira Saulo amo nomosomba oye, akabasoyia ase enyomba y’abageni, akabaikaransia aase y’amasikani, ase egati y’abageni bande emerongo etato.

English: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, ‘Set it aside.’”
Kiswahili: Samweli akamwambia mpishi, “Leta ile sehemu ya nyama niliyokupa, ile niliyokuambia iweke kando.”
Ekegusii: Samweli agateebia omorugi bwe chindagera: “Renta egetari keria nakoa, nkagoteebia ng’a okegache ensemo ao.”

English: The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Saul. Samuel said, “Behold, that which has been reserved! Set it before yourself and eat; because it has been kept for you for the appointed time, for I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mpishi akachukua mguu pamoja na kile kilichokuwa juu yake akaiweka mbele ya Sauli. Samweli akasema, “Hiki ndicho ambacho kimewekwa kwa ajili yako. Ule, kwa sababu kilitengwa kwa ajili yako kwa tukio hili, tangu niliposema, ‘Nimewaalika wageni.’ ” Naye Sauli akala pamoja na Samweli siku ile.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omorugi oria bwe chindagera akaimokia ekenama keria ekiya, agakebeeka bosio bwa Saulo. Samweli agateebia Saulo: “Rora egetari eke kiagachetwe, kiabekirwe ase obosio bwao; okerie, ekiagera naye gwakegacheretwe ng’a oche gokeria ase engaki eyio ekero abageni barangeriigwe.” Ase igo Saulo akaragera na Samweli ase rituko erio.

English: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kushuka kutoka mahali pa juu na kufika mjini, Samweli alizungumza na Sauli juu ya dari ya nyumba yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero batirimbogeete korwa aase aria ase ebing’wanso biare koruerwa, bakagenda mwa Samweli kerama igoro, na aroro agwo Samweli akagosoria na Saulo.

English: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you away.” Saul arose, and they both went outside, he and Samuel, together.
Kiswahili: Walipoamka mapema alfajiri, Samweli akamwita Sauli darini, akamwambia, “Jiandae, nami nitakuaga uende zako.” Sauli alipokuwa tayari yeye na Samweli wakatoka nje pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokiamoka, Samweli akarangeria Saulo oyoreenge ase ekerama igoro, akabora: “Imoka ngokoobe, ogende ase orogendo rwao.” Saulo akaimoka, na barabwo babere bakagenda bare amo.

English: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us.” He went ahead, then Samuel said, “But stand still first, that I may cause you to hear God’s message.”
Kiswahili: Hata walipokuwa wakiteremka kuelekea mwisho wa mji, Samweli akamwambia Sauli, “Mwambie mtumishi atangulie mbele yetu.” Naye mtumishi akafanya hivyo. “Lakini subiri hapa kwa kitambo kidogo, ili nipate kukupa ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero baikire ang’e nensinyo y’omochie, Samweli agateebia Saulo: “Teebia omosomba oo aete atang’ane.” Omosomba oria akagenda bosio, na Samweli agateebia Saulo: “Beera aiga ake igo, na inche ningotebie amang’ana aya Nyasae akwanire.”

English: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head, then kissed him and said, “Hasn’t Yahweh anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Samweli akachukua chupa ndogo ya mafuta na kuyamimina juu ya kichwa cha Sauli, akambusu, akisema, “Je, Bwana hakukutia mafuta uwe kiongozi juu ya watu wake Israeli?
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimokia echuba y’amaguta, akaumorera Saulo ase omotwe, akamonyunyunta, akamoteebia: “Omonene ogoakire amaguta obe omotang’ani bw’Abaisraeli, Abanto baye. Aye nogaambere Abanto ba Omonene na kobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo baabaetanaine. Eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asore ng’a Omonene ogoakire amaguta ng’a obe omotang’ani igoro ase Abanto bare omwando oye:

English: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’
Kiswahili: Utakapoondoka kwangu leo, utakutana na watu wawili karibu na kaburi la Raheli, huko Selsa kwenye mpaka wa Benyamini. Watakuambia, ‘Punda wale uliotoka kwenda kuwatafuta, wamekwisha kupatikana. Sasa baba yako ameacha kufikiri kuhusu punda na sasa ana hofu kukuhusu wewe. Anauliza, “Nitafanyaje kuhusu mwanangu?” ’
Ekegusii: Ekero okorua aa ase ’nde reero noumerane n’abanto babere ang’e nembeera ya Raeli, ase orogongo rwa Benjamini ase Selisa. Barabwo nigo baragoteebie ng’a chitigere chiria mwagendete korigia chiatokire. Iso otigire gochichandekera, na bono naye achaandekerete, ogoteeba: Naki ndakore indore omwana one?

English: “Then you will go on forward from there, and you will come to the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel: one carrying three young goats, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a container of wine.
Kiswahili: “Kisha utakwenda mbele kutoka hapa mpaka uufikie mwaloni wa Tabori. Watu watatu wanaopanda kwa Mungu huko Betheli watakutana nawe hapo. Mmoja atakuwa amechukua wana-mbuzi watatu, mwingine mikate mitatu, na mwingine kiriba cha divai.
Ekegusii: Erio norueo, ogenderere orogendo, oike ase omote okorokwa Omoaruni ore agwo Tabori. Aroro agwo noumerane n’Abanto batato bagotiira gochia gosasiima Nyasae agwo Beteli. Oyomo obo nabe obwate chimanwa chie chimbori isato, na oyonde obogoretie emegati etato, na oyonde ekerandi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa kere nedivai.

English: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.
Kiswahili: Watakusalimu na kukupa mikate miwili, ambayo utaipokea kutoka kwao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbagokwanie, bakoe emegati ebere, noyianche, oyebogorie korwa ase amaboko abo.

English: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you have come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute, a tambourine, a pipe, and a harp before them; and they will be prophesying.
Kiswahili: “Baada ya hayo utakwenda Gibea ya Mungu, ambapo hapo kuna kambi ya Wafilisti. Unapokaribia mji utakutana na kundi la manabii wakiteremka kutoka mahali pa juu wakiwa na vinubi, matari, filimbi na zeze vikipigwa mbele yao, nao watakuwa wakitoa unabii.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio nogende gochia ekegoro kia Nyasae agwo Gibea, ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti kere. Agwo ase egesoero ki’omochie noumerane nekeombe ki’ababani bagotirimboka korwa ase ekegoro aase agwo ebing’wanso bikoruerwa, babe bakobugia amakano ne chikonu, na ebiroria, na amakano yebirigisa. Barabwo mbabe bakobaboka ase okobana.

English: Then Yahweh’s Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man.
Kiswahili: Roho wa Bwana atakuja juu yako kwa nguvu, nawe utatoa unabii pamoja nao; nawe utageuzwa kuwa mtu wa tofauti.
Ekegusii: Erio Omoika bw’Omonene noche igoro yao ne chinguru; naye nobaane amo nabarabwo, na oonchorwe obe kore ne chingencho ching’ao.

English: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.
Kiswahili: Mara ishara hizi zitakapotimizwa, fanya lolote mkono wako upasao kufanya, kwa kuwa Mungu yu pamoja nawe.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero ebimanyererio ebio birakoreke asore, okore rinde rionsi orarore, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naye.

English: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”
Kiswahili: “Tangulia kushuka mbele yangu mpaka Gilgali. Hakika nami nitateremka nikujie ili kutoa dhabihu za sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu za amani, lakini lazima ungoje kwa siku saba hata nitakapokujia na kukuambia likupasalo kufanya.”
Ekegusii: Erio ontang’ane gotirimboka gochia Giligali. Inche ninchiche aroro asore ase okorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe. Onganye aroro ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere goika inchiche asore, nkworokie aya ogwenerete gokora.”

English: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs happened that day.
Kiswahili: Ikawa Sauli alipogeuka kumwacha Samweli, Mungu aliubadilisha moyo wa Sauli, na ishara hizi zote zikatimizwa siku ile.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Saulo eonchorete gotigana na Samweli, Nyasae akaa Saulo enkoro ere ne chingencho ching’ao, na ebimanyererio biria bionsi bigakoreka ase rituko riria.

English: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.
Kiswahili: Walipofika Gibea, akakutana na kundi la manabii. Roho wa Mungu akaja juu yake kwa nguvu, naye akajiunga nao katika kutoa unabii kwao.
Ekegusii: Ekero Saulo amo nomosomba oye baigete Gibea, ekeombe ekenene ki’ababani gekaumerana nere. Omoika o Nyasae ogaacha igoro asare ne chinguru, nere agaachaka kobaboka ase okobana ase egati y’ababani baria.

English: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
Kiswahili: Ikawa wale wote waliomfahamu hapo mwanzo walipomwona akitoa unabii pamoja na manabii, wakaulizana, “Ni nini hiki kilichomtokea mwana wa Kishi? Je, Sauli naye pia yumo miongoni mwa manabii?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abwo konya bamomanyete agwo ritang’ani, ekero bamorooche okobana amo nababani baria, bagakwana barabwo ase barabwo: “Mang’ana ki aya amonyorire omwana o Kisi? Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”

English: One from the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja ambaye aliishi huko akajibu, “Je, naye baba yao ni nani?” Basi ikawa mithali, kusema, “Je, Sauli pia yumo miongoni mwa manabii?”
Ekegusii: Omonto omenyete aase aria akabooria: “Ise nere ng’o?” Ase engencho eyio amang’ana akaba agokwanwa iga: “Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”

English: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Sauli kumaliza kutoa unabii, alikwenda mahali pa juu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Saulo akoorire kobaboka ase okobana, agatiira gochia ase ekegoro aase ebing’wanso biare koruerwa.

English: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”
Kiswahili: Basi babaye mdogo akamuuliza Sauli na mtumishi wake, “Je, mlikuwa wapi?” Akajibu, “Tulikuwa tukiwatafuta punda. Lakini tulipoona hawapatikani, tulikwenda kwa Samweli.”
Ekegusii: Ise moke Saulo akabooria Saulo na omosomba oye: “Ng’ai mwachiete?” Saulo akairaneria: “Nechitigere twagendete korigia, na ekero totachinyorete, tokagenda ase Samweli.”

English: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”
Kiswahili: Babaye mdogo Sauli akasema, “Niambie Samweli amekuambia nini.”
Ekegusii: Ise moke akamoteebia: “Koranche onteebie aya Samweli abateebeetie.”

English: Saul said to his uncle, “He told us plainly that the donkeys were found.” But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he didn’t tell him.
Kiswahili: Sauli akajibu, “Alituhakikishia kwamba punda wamepatikana.” Lakini hakumwambia babaye mdogo kila kitu Samweli alichomwambia kuhusu ufalme.
Ekegusii: Saulo akamoiraneria: “Nigo atotebetie boronge ng’a chitigere chianyorekanire.” Korende amang’ana aya Samweli akwanete igoro y’oborwoti tamoyatebeetie.

English: Samuel called the people together to Yahweh to Mizpah;
Kiswahili: Samweli akawaita watu wa Israeli kuja kwa Bwana huko Mispa,
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli akarangeria Abaisraeli basangererekane amo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Misipa,

English: and he said to the children of Israel, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
Kiswahili: naye akawaambia, “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Niliwatoa Israeli kutoka Misri, nami niliwaokoa toka nguvu za Misri na falme zote zilizowaonea.’
Ekegusii: akabateebia: “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oteebire iga: Inche nigo nabang’anyetie korwa Misiri, nkabatooria korwa ase amaboko y’Abanto b’amarwoti ande onsi, abwo baarenge kobachaanda.

English: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us!’ Now therefore present yourselves before Yahweh by your tribes and by your thousands.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa mmemkataa Mungu wenu, ambaye anawaokoa toka katika maafa yenu yote na taabu zenu zote. Nanyi mmesema, ‘Hapana, tuteulie mfalme atutawale.’ Sasa basi, jihudhurisheni wenyewe mbele za Bwana kwa kabila zenu na kwa koo zenu.”
Ekegusii: Korende bono mwangire Nyasae oino oria obatooretie korwa ase obokong’u bwonsi na ogochandwa, mwateebire ng’a: tobeekere omorwoti atogambere. Gaki bono sangererekana ase obosio bw’Omonene, egesaku ase egesaku, na eamate ase eamate.”

English: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.
Kiswahili: Samweli alipoyasogeza makabila yote ya Israeli, kabila la Benyamini likachaguliwa.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Samweli akarenta ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli ang’e, na egesaku gia Benjamini kegachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera.

English: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.
Kiswahili: Kisha akalisogeza mbele kabila la Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo, nao ukoo wa Matri ukachaguliwa. Mwishoni Sauli mwana wa Kishi akachaguliwa. Lakini walipomtafuta, hakuonekana.
Ekegusii: Ekero arentire egesaku gia Benjamini ang’e, obomera bokagwera eamate ya Matiri, na ase eamate ya Matiri obomera bokagwera Saulo, omomura o Kisi, korende Abanto bagachia komorigia tibamonyora.

English: Therefore they asked of Yahweh further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” Yahweh answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”
Kiswahili: Wakazidi kuuliza kwa Bwana, “Je, huyo mtu amekwisha kufika hapa?” Naye Bwana akasema, “Ndiyo, amejificha katikati ya mizigo.”
Ekegusii: Erio naende bakaboori’Omonene: “Inee! Omonto oyio nachete aa?” Omonene akairaneria: “Rigereria oyio bw’ebisete ase ebinto bikogachwa.”

English: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
Kiswahili: Wakakimbia na kumleta kutoka huko, naye aliposimama katikati ya watu, alikuwa mrefu kuliko watu wengine wote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakaminyoka bakamorusia aroro, na ekero atenenete ase egati y’Abanto bamorooche ng’a naetanetie Abanto bande bonsi ase obotaambe bw’omotwe korwa amareko gochia igoro.

English: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom Yahweh has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?” All the people shouted and said, “Long live the king!”
Kiswahili: Samweli akawaambia watu wote, “Je, mnamwona mtu ambaye Bwana amemchagua? Hayupo aliye kama yeye miongoni mwa watu wote.” Ndipo watu wakapiga kelele, wakasema, “Mfalme na aishi maisha marefu.”
Ekegusii: Samweli agateebia Abanto bonsi: “Aiga morooche ere oyi’Omonene achorire. Monto onde tari aa ase egati y’Abanto aba bonsi omoreng’aine.” Erio Abanto bonsi bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora: “Omorwoti oyo achie kare!”

English: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before Yahweh. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
Kiswahili: Samweli akawaeleza watu madaraka ya ufalme. Akayaandika kwenye kitabu na kuweka mbele za Bwana. Kisha Samweli akawaruhusu watu, kila mmoja aende nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Erio Samweli agateebia Abanto buna oborwoti bogwenerete kogaambwa, na akariika emeroberio eyio ase egetabu akayebeeka ase obosio bw’Omonene. Magega yayio Samweli akaa Abanto ribaga, kera oyomo agende inka bwoye.

English: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.
Kiswahili: Sauli pia akaenda nyumbani kwake huko Gibea, akisindikizwa na watu hodari ambao Mungu alikuwa amegusa mioyo yao.
Ekegusii: Saulo nere akagenda nka bwoye aria Gibea. Abanto bande abanene, abwo Nyasae konya akwanire ne chinkoro chiabo, bakamotunyana.

English: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.
Kiswahili: Lakini baadhi ya watu wakorofi walisema, “Huyu mtu atawezaje kutuokoa?” Wakamdharau na wala hawakumletea zawadi. Lakini Sauli akanyamaza kimya.
Ekegusii: Korende Abanto bande abaarenge ababe bakaboora: “Naki oyo arakore atotoorie?” Barabwo bakamochaaya, tibamoirera biegwa binde. Korende ere akaba buna taigwete aya bakwanete.

English: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”
Kiswahili: Nahashi yule Mwamoni, akakwea kuuzunguka kwa jeshi mji wa Yabeshi-Gileadi. Watu wote wa Yabeshi wakamwambia, “Fanya mkataba na sisi, na tutakuwa chini yako.”
Ekegusii: Nahasi Omoamoni akagenda, agaetanana Yabesi ase ense ya Gileadi koyorwania esegi. Abanto bonsi ba Yabesi bakamoteebia: “Kora okobwatana naintwe, erio tobe inse asore togokorere.”

English: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make it with you, that all your right eyes be gouged out. I will make this dishonor all Israel.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Nahashi yule Mwamoni akajibu, “Nitafanya mkataba na ninyi tu kwa sharti kwamba nitangʼoa jicho la kulia la kila mmoja wenu, na hivyo kuleta aibu juu ya Israeli yote.”
Ekegusii: Nahasi Omoamoni akabairaneria: “Ninkore okobwatana nainwe komoranche ng’a ndusie eriso ria borio ria kera oyomo oino, erinde ndetere Abaisraeli bonsi obosooku.”

English: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there is no one to save us, we will come out to you.”
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa Yabeshi wakamwambia, “Tupe siku saba ili tuweze kutuma wajumbe katika Israeli yote, kama hakuna hata mmoja anayekuja kutuokoa, tutajisalimisha kwako.”
Ekegusii: Abagaaka ba Yabesi bakamoteebia: “Toe ribaga ri’amatuko atano na abere, erinde totome Abanto ase chingongo chionsi chi’Abaisraeli. Onde atatogeti oratotoorie, rirorio twerue asore.”

English: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice and wept.
Kiswahili: Wajumbe walipofika Gibea ya Sauli na kutoa taarifa juu ya masharti haya kwa watu, wote walilia kwa sauti kubwa.
Ekegusii: Abatomwa baria bagaika Gibea ase Saulo amenyete, bagateebia Abanto b’aroro amang’ana ayio, na Abanto bonsi bakarera mono.

English: Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.
