Ekegusii: Daudi amo n’baanto baye bakamenya amo n’Akisi agwo Gati. Kera omonto nigo amenyete amo n’baanto b’eamate yaye, na Daudi amo nabakungu baye babere, Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli, na Abigaeli korwa Karimeli, oyio Nabali atigete ore omoboraka.

English: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, so he stopped looking for him.
Kiswahili: Sauli alipokuwa ameambiwa kwamba Daudi alikuwa amekimbilia Gathi, hakuendelea kumsaka tena.
Ekegusii: Ekero Saulo ateebetigwe ng’a Daudi konya otamire gochia Gati, tagendete komorigia.

English: David said to Achish, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akamwambia Akishi, “Kama nimepata kibali machoni pako, unipe sehemu katika mojawapo ya miji katika nchi nikae huko. Kwa nini mtumwa wako akae pamoja nawe katika mji huu wa kifalme?”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Akisi: “Onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, koranche ong’e aase nkomenya ase omochie ore isiko korwa ase omochie oo. Tari buya ase ’nde, omosomba oo, ngenderere komenya ase omochie omonene bw’oborwoti amo naye?”

English: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.
Kiswahili: Hivyo siku hiyo Akishi akampa Daudi mji wa Siklagi, nao Siklagi umekuwa mali ya wafalme wa Yuda tangu wakati huo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase rituko riria Akisi akaa Daudi Sikilagi. Ase engencho eyio omochie oyio o Sikilagi nigo ore oyo bw’abarwoti b’Abayuda goika reero iga.

English: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.
Kiswahili: Daudi akaishi katika nchi ya Wafilisti muda wa mwaka mmoja na miezi minne.
Ekegusii: Daudi akagenderera komenya ase ense y’Abafilisti ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo na emetienyi ene.

English: David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land who were of old, on the way to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi na watu wake wakapanda na kuwashambulia Wageshuri, Wagirizi na Waamaleki. (Tangu zamani haya mataifa yalikuwa yameishi kwenye eneo lililotanda kuanzia Telemu katika njia iteremkayo Shuri hadi kufikia nchi ya Misri.)
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Daudi na abanto baye bakaba bakogenda korwania Abagesuri, na Abagirisi, na Abaameleki. Abwo nigo baarenge ababiare b’ense eyio korwa kare; nigo bamenyete goika Suri na goika orobebe rw’ense ya Misiri.

English: David struck the land, and saved no man or woman alive, and took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned, and came to Achish.
Kiswahili: Kila mara Daudi aliposhambulia eneo, hakubakiza hai mwanaume wala mwanamke, lakini alichukua kondoo na ngʼombe, punda na ngamia, na nguo. Kisha akarudi kwa Akishi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaba okorwania ense eyio na goita Abanto bonsi pi, abasacha na abakungu; agasakora ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, ne chingamia, akaira ne chianga. Erio aba okoirana gochia ase Akisi.

English: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”
Kiswahili: Akishi alipomuuliza, “Je leo umeshambulia wapi?” Daudi humjibu, “Dhidi ya Negebu ya Yuda,” au wakati mwingine husema, “Dhidi ya Negebu ya Yerameeli,” au “Dhidi ya Negebu ya Wakeni.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Akisi areenge koboria Daudi: “Insemo ki gwachiete korwania rituko ria reero?” Daudi aba okomoiraneria: “Ense ya Irianyi ere ey’Abayuda,” gose “Ense ya Irianyi ere eya Yerameeli,” gose “Ense ya Irianyi ere ey’Abakeni,”

English: David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’”
Kiswahili: Daudi hakumwacha hai mwanaume au mwanamke ili apate kuletwa Gathi, kwa maana Daudi aliwaza, “Wanaweza kujulisha habari zetu na kusema, ‘Hivi ndivyo alivyofanya Daudi.’ ” Hii ndiyo ilikuwa desturi yake wakati wote aliishi katika nchi ya Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Daudi tareenge gotiga nonya nomonto oyomo, omosacha gose omokungu, ore moyo, ekiagera nigo areengereretie ng’a onde tabaisa kogenda Gati ateebe ng’a: “Aya naro Daudi agotokorera.” Naboigo yareenge engencho ya Daudi ekero agendererete komenya ase ense y’Abafilisti.

English: Achish believed David, saying, “He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him. Therefore he will be my servant forever.”
Kiswahili: Akishi akamsadiki Daudi na kuwaza moyoni mwake, akasema, “Daudi amekuwa kitu cha kuchukiza kabisa kwa watu wake, Waisraeli, hivi kwamba atakuwa mtumishi wangu milele.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Akisi akwegena Daudi mono, akarengereria: “Bono Daudi okorire Abaisraeli bamwabo bamogeche kegima; ase igo agenderere koba omosomba one botaambe.”

English: In those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, “Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army, you and your men.”
Kiswahili: Siku zile Wafilisti wakakusanya majeshi yao ili kupigana vita dhidi ya Israeli. Akishi akamwambia Daudi, “Lazima ujue kuwa wewe pamoja na watu wako mtafuatana nami kwenda vitani.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abafirisiti bagasangereria abarwani babo amo, erinde barwanie Abaisraeli, na Akisi agateebia Daudi: “Goika omanye ng’a aye amo n’baanto bao nigo mogochia kondwanesia esegi.”

English: David said to Achish, “Therefore you will know what your servant can do.” Achish said to David, “Therefore I will make you my bodyguard forever.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akasema, “Ndipo wewe mwenyewe utakapojionea jambo ambalo mtumishi wako anaweza kufanya.” Akishi akamjibu Daudi, “Vyema sana, mimi nitakufanya uwe mlinzi wangu daima.”
Ekegusii: Daudi akamoiraneria: “Ayio mbuya kegima; aye nomanye egento inche, omosomba oo, ndakore.” Akisi agateebia Daudi: “Ningokore obe omorendi bw’obogima bwane kogenderera botaambe.”

English: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Samweli alikuwa amekufa, nao Israeli wote walikuwa wamemwombolezea na kumzika kwenye mji wake mwenyewe huko Rama. Sauli alikuwa amewafukuza waaguzi na wachawi.
Ekegusii: Bono Samweli konya okuure na Abaisraeli bonsi konya bamoreereire, bamotindekire ase omochie oye Rama. Boigo Saulo konya oseririe Abanto baarenge koboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’Abanto bakuure, amo nabaringoria bonsi.

English: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakakusanyika na kupiga kambi yao huko Shunemu, naye Sauli akawakusanya Waisraeli wote na kupiga kambi yao huko Gilboa.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagasangererekana, bagatoora agwo Sunemu; Saulo nere agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, nabarabwo bagatoora agwo Giliboa.

English: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.
Kiswahili: Sauli alipoona jeshi la Wafilisti, akaogopa; moyo wake ukajawa na hofu kuu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Saulo aroche abarwani b’Abafilisti agasogwa nomoondoko, na enkoro yaye ekaiguswa mono.

English: When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sauli akauliza ushauri kwa Bwana, lakini Bwana hakumjibu kwa ndoto, wala kwa Urimu, wala kwa njia ya manabii.
Ekegusii: Saulo akabooria komanya korwa ase Omonene, korende Omonene tamoiraneretie gento kende, nonya goetera ase chindoto, gose goetera ase Urimu, gose goetera ase ababani.

English: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”
Kiswahili: Basi Sauli akawaambia watumishi wake, “Nitafutieni mwanamke mwaguzi ili nimwendee, nipate kuuliza kwake.” Watumishi wake wakamwambia, “Yuko mwanamke mmoja huko Endori.”
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agateebia abasomba baye: “Indigerie omokungu okoboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakuure, nimochiere, ndigie ogosemigwa korwa asare.” Abasomba baye bakamoiraneria: “Naama! Agwo Eni‐Dori omokungu buna oyio nareo.”

English: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night. Then he said, “Please consult for me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whomever I shall name to you.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Sauli akajigeuza kwa kuvaa mavazi mengine, naye usiku akiwa amefuatana na watu wawili wakaenda kwa huyo mwanamke. Akamwambia, “Nibashirie kwa uaguzi, unipandishie yule nitakayekutajia.”
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agekona, akabeeka chianga ching’ao, akagenda amo n’baanto bande babere, bagaika ase omokungu oyio botuko. Saulo agateebia omokungu oria: “Indagore ase omoika, ondetere omonto oria ndatore erieta riaye asore.”

English: The woman said to him, “Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?”
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanamke akamwambia, “Wewe unajua lile alilofanya Mfalme Sauli. Amewakatilia mbali waaguzi, wapiga ramli wote na wachawi katika nchi. Mbona umenitegea maisha yangu ili wapate kuniua?”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoiraneria: “Amaene, aye nomanyete aya Saulo akorire, buna asiririe korwa ase ense eye abakungu abakoboria emeika y’Abanto bakuure amo nabaringoria bonsi. Nase ki rende okombeeka ase oboreba, mbwatwe na gokwa?”

English: Saul swore to her by Yahweh, saying, “As Yahweh lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing.”
Kiswahili: Sauli akamwapia huyo mwanamke kwa Jina la Bwana, akasema, “Kwa hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, hutaadhibiwa kwa ajili ya jambo hili.”
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatiana ase engencho y’omokuungu oria, agateeba: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, aye tokonyora egesusuro ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio.”

English: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule mwanamke akauliza, “Je unataka nikupandishie nani?” Sauli akasema, “Nipandishie Samweli.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamobooria: “Ning’o oganetie nkorangererie arorekane?” Saulo akamoiraneria: “Indangererie Samweli.”

English: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, “Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!”
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke alipomwona Samweli, alipiga yowe kwa sauti kuu, naye akamuuliza Sauli, “Mbona umenidanganya? Wewe ndiwe Sauli.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero omokungu oria aroche Samweli, agakuura neriogi rinene agateebia Saulo: “Nase ki kwang’aina? Aye n’Saulo.”

English: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid! What do you see?” The woman said to Saul, “I see a god coming up out of the earth.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme akamwambia, “Usiogope. Unaona nini?” Yule mwanamke akasema, “Naona mungu unapanda kutoka ardhini.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti oria akamoteebia: “Tibwoboa! Ninki kwarora?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria: “Narorire enyasae egotiira korwa riroba inse.”

English: He said to her, “What does he look like?” She said, “An old man comes up. He is covered with a robe.” Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and showed respect.
Kiswahili: Sauli akamuuliza, “Ni mfano wa nini?” Yule mwanamke akasema, “Ni mwanaume mzee amevaa joho anayepanda.” Ndipo Sauli akatambua kwamba ni Samweli. Sauli akasujudu kifudifudi, uso wake hadi ardhini.
Ekegusii: Saulo akamobooria: “Naki ekerorekana?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria: “Nomogaka omogotu bwetubete egetambaa gi’okwambara.” Erio Saulo akamanya ng’a oyio ’Samweli, agatugama inse, akaorokia amasikani.

English: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?” Saul answered, “I am very distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me, and answers me no more, by prophets, or by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may make known to me what I shall do.”
Kiswahili: Samweli akamuuliza Sauli, “Kwa nini unanitaabisha kwa kunipandisha juu?” Sauli akasema, “Mimi ninasumbuka sana, kwa maana Wafilisti wanapigana vita dhidi yangu, naye Mungu ameniacha. Hanijibu tena wala kwa njia ya manabii wala kwa ndoto. Kwa hiyo nimekuita wewe ili unijulishe la kufanya.”
Ekegusii: Samweli akabooria Saulo: “Nase ki gwanchandire okondeta korwa ase omotimoko one.” Saulo akairaneria: “Inche nigo nchandegete mono; Abafirisiti nkondwania bare esegi, na Nyasae onyangire, tari kong’iraneria, goetera ase ababani, gose ase chindoto. Ase ayio nigo nakorangeirie, erinde onteebie eki ndakore.”

English: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since Yahweh has departed from you and has become your adversary?
Kiswahili: Samweli akamuuliza, “Kwa nini uniulize mimi, maadamu Bwana amekuacha na kuwa adui yako?
Ekegusii: Samweli akairaneria: “Nase ki okomboria inche, onye Omonene okwangire na obeire omobisa oo?

English: Yahweh has done to you as he spoke by me. Yahweh has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, even to David.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametenda lile alilotangulia kusema kupitia kwangu. Bwana ameurarua ufalme kutoka mikononi mwako, naye amempa mmoja wa jirani zako, yaani Daudi.
Ekegusii: Omonene ogokoreire ayio akwanete goetera ase ’nde; okourire oborwoti korwa ase amaboko ao, oboeire omonto omoao, nere Daudi.

English: Because you didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, and didn’t execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore Yahweh has done this thing to you today.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu wewe hukumtii Bwana, wala hukumtimizia ghadhabu yake kali juu ya Waamaleki, Bwana amekutendea mambo haya leo.
Ekegusii: Tikwaigwerete eriogi ri’Omonene, gose goikerania egesusuro ki’endamwamu yaye entindi igoro y’Abaameleki. Ekio nakio kiagera Omonene akorire amang’ana ayio asore reero iga.

English: Moreover Yahweh will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. Yahweh will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines.”
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Bwana atawatia Israeli pamoja na wewe mikononi mwa Wafilisti, na kesho wewe na wanao mtakuwa pamoja nami. Bwana pia atalitia jeshi la Israeli mikononi mwa Wafilisti.”
Ekegusii: Boig’Omonene nache abeeke Abaisraeli amo naye ase amaboko ’Abafilisti. Ankio aye amo nabamura bao moche kobeera amo nainche, n’Omonene nache abeeke abarwani b’esegi b’Abaisraeli ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.”

English: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of Samuel’s words. There was no strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long.
Kiswahili: Papo hapo Sauli akaanguka chini, akajinyoosha, akiwa amejawa na hofu kwa ajili ya maneno ya Samweli. Nguvu zake zikamwishia kwa maana alikuwa hajala chochote mchana ule wote na usiku.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo Saulo agaaka inse, akarambereria ore nobwoba obonene ase amang’ana ayio a Samweli. Chinguru chikamoerera kegima, ekiagera tariete kende ase omobaso bwonsi na obotuko boigo.

English: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, “Behold, your servant has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke alipomwendea Sauli na kumwona amepatwa na hofu, akamwambia, “Tazama, mimi mtumishi wako mwanamke nimekutii. Nimeweka maisha yangu hatarini kwa kufanya kile ulichoniagiza nifanye.
Ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akamochera Saulo akarora ng’a osoirwe nomoondoko, akamoteebia: “Rora inche omosomba oo omokungu nigo nakoigwera na tinaegerete obogima bwane, nakora buna kwaganetie.

English: Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your servant, and let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way.”
Kiswahili: Sasa tafadhali isikilize sauti ya mtumishi wako, uniruhusu nikupatie chakula kidogo ule ili uwe na nguvu za kurejea ulikotoka.”
Ekegusii: Gaki bono koranche inyigwe inche omosomba oo omokungu, tiga nkorentere endagera orie, erinde onyore chinguru, ogenderere norogendo rwao.”

English: But he refused, and said, “I will not eat.” But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.
Kiswahili: Akakataa, akisema, “Mimi sitaki kula.” Lakini watumishi wake wakaungana na yule mwanamke wakamsihi ale, naye akakubali. Basi akainuka hapo chini, akaketi juu ya kitanda.
Ekegusii: Ere akaanga, akabora: “Tinganeti koria,” korende abasomba baye amo nomokuungu oria bakamosorora goika akaigwera amang’ana abo. Erio akaimoka korwa inse agwo, agaikaransa borere.

English: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke alikuwa na ndama aliyenona hapo nyumbani, akamchinja mara moja. Akachukua unga, akaukanda, akatengeneza mkate usio chachu.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria nabwate emori enoru nka bwoye, akayenyenya bwango. Boigo akaimokia obosie, akabokonya, agakora emegati etabekiri memera, akayegekera.

English: She brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate. Then they rose up and went away that night.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akamwandalia meza Sauli pamoja na watu wake, nao wakala. Usiku ule ule wakainuka na kwenda zao.
Ekegusii: Erio akarenta endagera eyio ase Saulo na abasomba baye, nabarabwo bakayeria. Magega y’ayio bakaimoka, bakagenda ase obotuko obwo.

English: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakakusanya majeshi yao yote huko Afeki, nao Waisraeli wakapiga kambi karibu na chemchemi iliyoko Yezreeli.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagasangereria abarwani babo bonsi b’esegi agwo Afeki, na Abaisraeli bagatoora ang’e nensoko yareenge agwo Yesireeli.

English: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish.
Kiswahili: Watawala wa Wafilisti walipokuwa wakipita pamoja na vikosi vyao vya mamia na vya maelfu, Daudi na watu wake walikuwa wakitembea huko nyuma pamoja na Akishi.
Ekegusii: Abaanene b’Abafilisti bagaacha bagaeta baare nebiombe biabo bi’abaanto amagana ne chilifu. Daudi na’baanto baye bakaba bakorwa magega amo n’Akisi.

English: Then the princes of the Philistines said, “What about these Hebrews?” Achish said to the princes of the Philistines, “Isn’t this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or rather these years? I have found no fault in him since he fell away until today.”
Kiswahili: Majemadari wa Wafilisti wakauliza, “Vipi kuhusu hawa Waebrania?” Akishi akajibu, “Huyu si Daudi, aliyekuwa afisa wa Sauli mfalme wa Israeli? Ameshakuwa pamoja nami kwa zaidi ya mwaka, naye tangu alipomwacha Sauli hadi sasa, sikuona kosa lolote kwake.”
Ekegusii: Erio abanene baria b’Abafilisti bakabooria: “Ninki Abaiberania aba bagokora aiga?” Akisi akabairaneria: “Oyo ’Daudi, omosomba o Saulo, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli. Oyio obeire omenyete amo nainche goetania omwaka oyomo, tinana korora komocha asare korwa riria achete ase ’nde goika reero iga.”

English: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, “Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?
Kiswahili: Lakini majemadari wa Wafilisti wakamkasirikia na kusema, “Mrudishe mtu huyu, apate kurudi mahali pale ulipompangia. Haimpasi kufuatana pamoja nasi vitani, asije akageuka, akawa kinyume chetu vitani. Ni kwa njia ipi bora zaidi angeweza kujipatia tena kibali kwa bwana wake, isipokuwa kwa vichwa vya watu wetu wenyewe?
Ekegusii: Korende abanene b’Abafilisti bakaba nendamwamu enene ase Akisi, bakamoteebia: “Irania omonto oyo agende aase kwamobegete amenye. Ere takogenda amo naintwe korwana esegi. Karaikeo nabo arabaise gotoonchokera, abe omobisa oito. Naki arakore anyore ogwancherwa ase omonene oye otatiga ase ogoita Abanto baito.

English: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”
Kiswahili: Je, huyu si ndiye Daudi walioimba kumhusu katika ngoma zao, wakisema: “ ‘Sauli amewaua elfu zake, naye Daudi makumi elfu yake’?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Daudi tari ere oria abakungu baterete igoro yaye kobagotenga, bakaboora: Saulo oitire chilifu chiaye, korende Daudi oitire chilifu chiaye emerongo na emerongo.”

English: Then Achish called David and said to him, “As Yahweh lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords don’t favor you.
Kiswahili: Basi Akishi akamwita Daudi na kumwambia, “Kama vile Bwana aishivyo, wewe umekuwa mtu mwaminifu, nami ningependa utumike pamoja nami katika jeshi. Tangu siku ile uliyofika kwangu hadi sasa, sijaona kosa lolote kwako, lakini hao watawala hawakukubali.
Ekegusii: Erio Akisi akarangeria Daudi, akamoteebia: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, nigo ndoche buya ng’a ogende amo nainche ase esegi. Korwa ekero gwachete ase ’nde goika rituko ria reero tinana korora okomocha asore, korende nonya naboigo, abanene aba tibagwancheti.

English: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”
Kiswahili: Rudi na uende kwa amani; usifanye chochote cha kuwakasirisha watawala wa Kifilisti.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio irana ogende nomorembe, erinde tobaisa gokora gento ase okogechia abanene b’Abafilisti.”

English: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza Akishi, “Lakini mimi nimefanya nini? Je, umeona nini kibaya juu ya mtumishi wako tangu siku ile niliyokuja kwako hadi leo? Kwa nini nisirudi na kupigana na adui za bwana wangu mfalme?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akabooria Akisi: “Ngento ki nakorire? Korwa ekero inche, omosomba oo, nachete aa kogokorera, goika rituko ria reero, mbobe ki kwarorire ase ’nde bokogera tingenda korwania ababisa bao, aye omorwoti, omonene one?”

English: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’
Kiswahili: Akishi akamjibu Daudi, “Mimi ninajua ya kuwa wewe umekuwa wa kupendeza machoni pangu kama vile malaika wa Mungu. Lakini hao majemadari wa Wafilisti wamesema, ‘Huyu haimpasi kwenda vitani pamoja nasi.’
Ekegusii: Akisi akamoiraneria: “Inche nimanyete buya ng’a nigo ore omooronge ase ’nde buna omomalaika O Nyasae. Korende nonya nabo abanene b’Abafilisti bakanire ng’a aye Daudi tobaisa kogenda amo naintwe ase esegi.

English: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”
Kiswahili: Sasa amka mapema, pamoja na watumishi wa bwana wako waliofuatana nawe, nanyi ondokeni asubuhi mara kutakapopambazuka.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye amo nabasomba bande ba Omonene oo baria bachete amo naye, moche moimoke mambia chuni erio mochaake kogenda kobogokiamoka.”

English: So David rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines; and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Daudi na watu wake wakaamka asubuhi na mapema, wakaenda zao kurudi katika nchi ya Wafilisti, nao Wafilisti wakapanda kwenda Yezreeli.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi amo n’baanto baye bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagaachaka orogendo rwabo, bakairana ase ense y’Abafilisti, korende Abafirisiti bakagenda gochia Yesireeli.

English: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,
Kiswahili: Daudi na watu wake wakafika Siklagi siku ya tatu. Basi Waamaleki walikuwa wamevamia Negebu na Siklagi. Wakawa wameshambulia mji wa Siklagi na kuuteketeza kwa moto,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato Daudi na Abanto baye bagaika Sikilagi. Abaameleki konya bachakiire esegi agwo Negebu na Sikilagi. Na bono konya babuire Sikilagi na koyosamba nomorero,

English: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.
Kiswahili: nao wakawa wamewachukua mateka wanawake pamoja na wote waliokuwamo humo, vijana na wazee. Hawakuua yeyote, bali waliwachukua wakaenda zao.
Ekegusii: boosire abakungu na bonsi abaarengeo, abake na abanene. Tibaitete monto onde, korende nigo baabairete, bakagenda nabarabwo.

English: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.
Kiswahili: Daudi na watu wake walipofika Siklagi, wakakuta mji umeangamizwa kwa moto na wake zao pamoja na wana wao na binti zao wamechukuliwa mateka.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi na abanto baye bachete ase omochie oyio, bakanyora ng’a osambirwe, na abakungu babo amo na’bamura na abaiseke babo bairirwe ase obosomba.

English: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Daudi na watu wake wakapiga yowe mpaka wakaishiwa na nguvu za kulia.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi na abanto baria baarenge komo bagaaka amariogi abo, bakarera mono goika chinguru chikabaerera.

English: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
Kiswahili: Wake wawili wa Daudi walikuwa wametekwa: yaani Ahinoamu wa Yezreeli, na Abigaili, mjane wa Nabali wa Karmeli.
Ekegusii: Abakungu ba Daudi bonsi babere, Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli, na Abigaeli, oyotigetwe omoboraka orenge moka Nabali o Karimeli, konya bairirwe ase obosomba nabarabwo.

English: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in Yahweh his God.
Kiswahili: Daudi alihuzunika sana kwa sababu watu walikuwa wakisemezana juu ya kumpiga kwa mawe. Kila mmoja alikuwa na uchungu rohoni kwa sababu ya wanawe na binti zake. Lakini Daudi akajitia nguvu katika Bwana, Mungu wake.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaba nemechando emenene, ekiagera Abanto nigo baarengereretie komoaka amagena bamoite. Barabwo nigo baarenge nobororo obonge ase engencho y’abana babo abamura na abaiseke. Korende Daudi akanyora chinguru korwa ase Omonene Nyasae oye.

English: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akamwambia kuhani Abiathari mwana wa Ahimeleki, “Niletee kisibau.” Abiathari akamletea,
Ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Abiatari Omokuani, mosinto bw’Ahimeleki: “Ndetere egesibao ki’obokuani.” Abiatari akarentera Daudi egesibao keria.

English: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue, for you will surely overtake them, and will without fail recover all.”
Kiswahili: naye Daudi akamuuliza Bwana, “Je, nifuatie kundi hili la wavamizi? Je, nitawapata?” Bwana akajibu, “Wafuatie. Hakika utawapata na utafanikiwa kuwaokoa.”
Ekegusii: Daudi akaboori’Omonene, akabora, “Inee! Ndabwatia omoganda oyo bw’abauri, Nimbaikere gose?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Babwatie! Nobatoorie Abanto boosirwe.”

English: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.
Kiswahili: Daudi pamoja na watu wake 600 wakafika kwenye Bonde la Besori, mahali ambapo wengine waliachwa nyuma,
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi amo n’baanto baye amagana atano na rimo bakagenda, bagaika ase akarooche ka Besori. Agwo abanto bande bagatigara magega.

English: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa watu 200 walikuwa wamechoka sana kuweza kuvuka hilo bonde. Lakini Daudi pamoja na watu 400 wakaendelea kufuatia.
Ekegusii: Daudi amo n’baanto amagana ane bakagenderera kobwatia ababisa baria. Abanto baria bande amagana abere bakarosa mono, bagasinywa kwamboka; ase igo bagatigara ase akarooche karia Besori.

English: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.
Kiswahili: Wakamkuta Mmisri katika shamba fulani, nao wakamleta kwa Daudi. Wakampa huyo Mmisri maji ya kunywa na chakula;
Ekegusii: Abanto baria ba Daudi bakanyora omomura omosae bw’Abamisiri agwo ase areenge aarabu, bakamorenta ase Daudi, bakamoa omogati akaria, na amaache akanywa,

English: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.
Kiswahili: kipande cha andazi la tini na andazi la zabibu zilizokaushwa. Akala naye akapata nguvu, kwa kuwa hakuwa amekula chakula chochote wala kunywa maji kwa siku tatu usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: naende bakamoa amako amomo, na amabomba abere ay’amasabibu amomo, na ekero ariire, akanyora chinguru. Ase engaki y’amatuko atato konya atana koria gento, gose konywa.

English: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Wewe ni wa nani, na umetoka wapi?” Akajibu, “Mimi ni Mmisri, mtumwa wa Mwamaleki. Bwana wangu alinitelekeza nilipougua siku tatu zilizopita.
Ekegusii: Daudi akamobooria, “Noyong’o ore? Seino ng’ai?” Omosae oria akairaneria, “Inche nigo inde omomura bw’Abamisiri na omosomba bw’omonto oyomo Omoameleki. Bono amatuko atato aerire korwa ekero omonene one antigete, ekiagera nabeete omorwaire.

English: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”
Kiswahili: Tulivamia Negebu ya Wakerethi, na nchi ya Yuda, na Negebu ya Kalebu. Nasi tulichoma moto Siklagi.”
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo twasagana Negebu aase Abakereti bamenyete, na ensemo ere ey’Abayuda na ey’abaanto ba Kalebu. Boigo togasamba Sikilagi nomorero.”

English: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Je, unaweza kuniongoza kufikia kundi hili la uvamizi?” Akajibu, “Niapie mbele ya Mungu kwamba hutaniua wala kunikabidhi mikononi mwa bwana wangu, nami nitakupeleka hadi waliko.”
Ekegusii: Daudi akamobooria: “Inee! Nonyare kong’ira na konyorokia aase abauri abwo bare?” Omomura oria akairaneria: “Tiana ase Nyasae ng’a tokong’ita, gose tokombeeka ase okoboko kw’omonene one; rirorio ninkoire nkwoorokie aase omoganda oria ore.”

English: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
Kiswahili: Akamwongoza Daudi mpaka mahali walipokuwa, nao walikuwa wametawanyika eneo lote, wakila, wakinywa na wakifanya karamu kwa sababu ya nyara nyingi walizochukua kutoka nchi ya Wafilisti na kutoka Yuda.
Ekegusii: Erio akaraa Daudi gochiao. Abauri abwo nigo baserebekanete aande onsi bakoria, bakonywa na kwegokia, ekiagera konya banyorire ebisakorwa ebinge korwa ase ense y’Abafilisti na ense ya Yuda.

English: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.
Kiswahili: Daudi akapigana nao kuanzia machweo ya jua hadi kesho yake jioni, na hakuna yeyote miongoni mwao aliyetoroka, isipokuwa vijana wanaume 400 waliopanda ngamia na kutoroka.
Ekegusii: Daudi akabarwania korwa mogoroba kobokomura‐mura goika mogoroba rituko ria kabere. Agaita abanto bonsi otatiga abamura amagana ane abariinete chingamia batamete.

English: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.
Kiswahili: Daudi akarudisha kila kitu Waamaleki walikuwa wamechukua, pamoja na wake zake wawili.
Ekegusii: Daudi akairania ebinto bionsi, na abanto bonsi, aba Abaameleki konya bairire, amo nabakungu baye babere.

English: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.
Kiswahili: Hakuna chochote kilichopotea: kijana au mzee, mvulana au msichana, nyara au kitu kingine chochote walichokuwa wamechukua. Daudi akarudisha kila kitu.
Ekegusii: Onde tasirete nonya noyomo, omoke gose omonene. Kera omwana, omomura gose omoiseke, o kera omonto nigo atooretigwe, na ebinto bionsi boigo. Daudi akairania abanto bonsi, na ebinto bionsi pi.

English: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”
Kiswahili: Akachukua makundi yote ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe, nao watu wake wakawaswaga wanyama hao mbele ya wanyama wengine wa kufugwa, wakisema, “Hizi ni nyara za Daudi.”
Ekegusii: Boigo Daudi akairania ching’ondi, ne chimbori, ne chiombe. Abanto baye bagachitang’ania bosio bwaye, bagateeba: “Ebi nebisakorwa bia Daudi.”

English: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akafika kwa wale watu 200 waliokuwa wamechoka sana kumfuata na ambao waliachwa nyuma kwenye Bonde la Besori. Wakatoka kwenda kumlaki Daudi na wale watu aliokuwa nao. Daudi na watu wake walipowakaribia, akawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akairana gochia ase abanto baria amagana abere konya barosire batigarete agwo ase akarooche ka Besori. Ekero aigete ang’e, barabwo bagaacha komoorotota, ere na abanto baria baarenge komo. Daudi akabachiera, akabakwania.

English: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wote waovu na wakorofi miongoni mwa wafuasi wa Daudi wakasema, “Kwa sababu hawakwenda pamoja nasi, hatutagawana nao nyara tulizorudisha. Lakini, kila mtu aweza kuchukua mkewe na watoto wake na kuondoka.”
Ekegusii: Korende abanto bande ababe abatagwenerete ase abwo bagendete na Daudi bakaboora: “Ekiagera abanto aba tibagendete amo naintwe, titokobaa gento kende gionsi ase ebi twasakoire, otatiga kera omonto araegwe mokaye na abana baye, aire bwoye.”

English: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which Yahweh has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.
Kiswahili: Daudi akajibu, “La hasha, ndugu zangu, kamwe hamwezi kufanya hivyo kwa kile ambacho Bwana ametupatia. Yeye ametulinda na kuweka mikononi mwetu majeshi yale yaliyokuja kupigana dhidi yetu.
Ekegusii: Korende Daudi akabateebia: “Abaminto, timobaisa gokora igo n’ebinto ebi Omonene atoiraneirie. Ere ototooririe, obekire ase amaboko aito abanto baria abauri abwo batoumokerete.

English: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”
Kiswahili: Ni nani atasikiliza yale mnayosema? Fungu la mtu aliyekaa na vyombo litakuwa sawa na la yule aliyekwenda vitani. Wote watashiriki sawa.”
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobaigwera ase amang’ana buna ayio? Yaya, buna abanto abwo bagendete korwana esegi bakoegwa ebisakorwa, naboigo nabwo batigarete magega korenda ebinto baraegwe. Nigo baragaberwe bareng’anie.”

English: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.
Kiswahili: Daudi akafanya hili liwe amri na agizo kwa Israeli kutoka siku ile hata leo.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase rituko erio Daudi agakora ring’ana erio rikaba ogochika ase Abaisraeli. Naboigo rire nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of Yahweh’s enemies.”
Kiswahili: Daudi alipofika Siklagi, akatuma baadhi ya nyara kwa wazee wa Yuda, waliokuwa rafiki zake, akasema, “Tazama, hapa kuna zawadi kwa ajili yenu kutoka nyara za adui za Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigete Sikilagi, agatoma ebiegwa ase abagaaka b’Abayuda abwo baarenge abasani baye, akabora, “Ebiegwa ebi nebisakorwa korwa ase ababisa ba Omonene.”

English: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,
Kiswahili: Akazituma kwa wale waliokuwa Betheli, Ramoth-Negebu na Yatiri;
Ekegusii: Naboigo abitomerete abagaaka ba Beteli na Ramoti agwo Negebu, na abwo b’emechie ya Yatiri,

English: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,
Kiswahili: kwa wale walioko Aroeri, Sifmothi, Eshtemoa
Ekegusii: na Aroeri, na Sifamoti, na Esitemoa,

English: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,
Kiswahili: na Rakali; kwa wale waliokuwa katika miji ya Wayerameeli na ya Wakeni;
Ekegusii: na Rakali; abwo b’emechie y’Abayerameli, na Abakeni,

English: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,
Kiswahili: na kwa wale walioko Horma, Bori-Ashani, Athaki,
Ekegusii: abwo ba Horima, na Bori‐Asani, na Ataki,

English: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.
Kiswahili: na kwa wakazi wa Hebroni; na kwa wale waliokuwa mahali pengine pote ambako Daudi na watu wake walitembelea.
Ekegusii: na Heburoni. Agatoma ebiegwa ase chinsemo echio chionsi ase areenge kona‐gotaarera amo n’baanto baye.

English: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
Kiswahili: Basi Wafilisti wakapigana na Israeli. Waisraeli wakawakimbia, na wengi wakauawa katika Mlima Gilboa.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakarwania Abaisraeli, na Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase bare, bagaiterwa ase egetunwa kia Giliboa

English: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakawafuatia kwa bidii Sauli na wanawe, wakawaua Yonathani, Abinadabu na Malki-Shua.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakabwatia Saulo mono, na abamura baye, bagaita Yonathani, na Aminadabu, na Maliki‐Sua, abamura ba Saulo.

English: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.
Kiswahili: Mapigano yakawa makali sana kumzunguka Sauli, nao wapiga upinde wakampata na kumjeruhi vibaya.
Ekegusii: Esegi ekaba entindi mono igoro ya Saulo; abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria mono; ere akabwatwa nomoondoko omonene ase engencho ya barabwo.

English: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me!” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.
Kiswahili: Sauli akamwambia mbeba silaha wake, “Futa upanga wako unichome nao, la sivyo hawa watu wasiotahiriwa watakuja wanichome na kunidhalilisha.” Lakini mbeba silaha wake akaogopa sana wala hakuweza kufanya hivyo. Kwa hiyo Sauli akachukua upanga wake mwenyewe na kuuangukia.
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agateebia omonto oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero: “Somora omoyio, ombete nkwe, erinde abanto aba batarogeti tibaabaisa kong’ita na gonchecheria.” Korende omonto oria akaanga, ekiagera abeete nobwoba obonene. Erio Saulo agasomora omoyio oye omonyene, akegweria ase omoyio oyio bweka omonyene.

English: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.
Kiswahili: Mchukua silaha wake alipoona Sauli amekufa, naye pia akaangukia upanga wake akafa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Ekero omobogoria ebirwanero aroche ayio, nere akegweria ase omoyio oye, agakwa amo na Saulo.

English: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.
Kiswahili: Basi Sauli, wanawe watatu, mbeba silaha wake na watu wake wote wakafa pamoja siku ile ile.
Ekegusii: Nabo Saulo, na abamura baye batato, na omobogoria ebirwanero, amo n’baanto baye bonsi, baitetwe ase rituko erio erimo.

English: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli waliokuwa kandokando ya bonde na wale waliokuwa ngʼambo ya Yordani walipoona kuwa jeshi la Waisraeli limekimbia na kwamba Sauli na wanawe wamekufa, wakaacha miji yao na kukimbia. Nao Wafilisti wakaja na kukaa humo.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli abwo baarenge ensemo ende ase ense omweremo, na abwo bareenge moocha ya Yorodani baigwete ng’a Abaisraeli konya batamire, na ng’a Saulo na abamura baye bakuure, bagatiga emechie yabo bagatama. Erio Abafirisiti bakagenda bakamenya ase emechie eyio.

English: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake Wafilisti walipokuja kuwavua maiti silaha, walimkuta Sauli na wanawe watatu wameanguka katika Mlima Gilboa.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere ekero Abafirisiti bachete konuura ebinto korwa ase emebere y’abanto bakwete, bakanyora Saulo na abamura baye batato bakwete agwo ase egetunwa kia Giliboa.

English: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people.
Kiswahili: Wakamkata Sauli kichwa na kumvua silaha zake, nao wakatuma wajumbe katika nchi yote ya Wafilisti kutangaza habari katika hekalu la sanamu zao na miongoni mwa watu wao.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakabutora omotwe o Saulo, bakaira na ebirwanero biaye, erio bagatoma abanto bararie amang’ana ayio ase ense yonsi y’Abafilisti, ase Hekalu y’emegwekano yabo bagosasiima, na ase abanto.

English: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.
Kiswahili: Wakaweka silaha zake katika hekalu la Maashtorethi, na kukifunga kiwiliwili chake katika ukuta wa Beth-Shani.
Ekegusii: Erio bakabeeka ebirwanero biaye ase enyomba y’Asitaroti, enyasae yabo enkuungu, na omobere oye bakayotonga ase orwaki rwa Beti‐Sani.

English: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
Kiswahili: Watu wa Yabeshi-Gileadi waliposikia yale Wafilisti walichomfanyia Sauli,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bamenyete Yabesi o Gileadi baigwete aya Abafirisiti bakorete ase Saulo,

English: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.
Kiswahili: mashujaa wao wote wakaenda usiku hadi Beth-Shani. Wakauchukua mwili wa Sauli na miili ya wanawe kutoka kwenye ukuta wa Beth-Shani na kurudi hadi Yabeshi, mahali ambapo waliiteketeza kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi chituoni bakaimoka, bakagenda ase obotuko obogima, bakarusia omobere o Saulo, na ey’abamura baye, korwa ase orwaki rwa Beti‐Sani, bakayerenta Yabesi, bakayesambera aroro.

English: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakachukua mifupa yao na kuizika chini ya mti wa mkwaju huko Yabeshi, nao wakafunga siku saba.
Ekegusii: Erio bakabogoria amauga abo, bakayatindeka inse y’omote onga buna egekone agwo Yabesi, bakeng’ata ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,
Kiswahili: Baada ya kifo cha Sauli, Daudi alipokuwa amerudi kutoka kuwashinda Waamaleki, Daudi alikaa siku mbili huko Siklagi.
Ekegusii: Magega Saulo gakuure, Daudi akairana korwa ase ogoita Abaameleki, akabeera agwo Sikilagi ase engaki y’amatuko abere.

English: on the third day, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn and earth on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the earth and showed respect.
Kiswahili: Siku ya tatu akaja mtu mwenye nguo zilizoraruka na mavumbi kichwani mwake kutoka kwenye kambi ya Sauli. Alipomjia Daudi, akajitupa chini ili kumpa heshima.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato, omonto agacha korwa ase egetwori gia Saulo; chianga chiaye nigo chiatandoire, na amaroba are ase omotwe oye. Ekero aigete ase Daudi, akagua inse maumama ase okoorokia amasikani.

English: David said to him, “Where do you come from?” He said to him, “I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Wewe umetoka wapi?” Akamjibu, “Nimetoroka kutoka kambi ya Waisraeli.”
Ekegusii: Daudi akamobooria, “Ng’ai okorwa”? Ere akamoiraneria, “Nigo natoorekire korwa ase egetwori ki’Abaisraeli.”

English: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.” He answered, “The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead. Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Ni nini kilichotokea? Niambie.” Akasema, “Watu walikimbia kutoka vitani. Wengi wao walianguka na kufa. Naye Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe wamekufa.”
Ekegusii: Naende Daudi akamobooria, “Amoteebie buna amang’ana agendererete aria.” Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Abanto abange batamire korwa ase esegi eria, na abande abange mono baitirwe bakuure. Boigo Saulo amo na Yonathani, momura oye, baitirwe bakuure.”

English: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akamwambia huyo kijana aliyemletea taarifa, “Je, umefahamuje kwamba Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe wamekufa?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akaboria omomura oria, “Inaki gwakorete okamanya ng’a Saulo na Yonathani, momura oye, bakuure?”

English: The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed close behind him.
Kiswahili: Yule kijana akasema, “Nilijipata huko Mlima Gilboa, naye Sauli alikuwa huko akiegemea mkuki wake, na magari ya vita na wapanda farasi wa upande wa adui wakawa wamemkaribia sana.
Ekegusii: Omomura oria akamoiraneria, “Nigo yabete ng’a nao narenge ase egetunwa kia Giliboa, na aroro ’nkarora Saulo osigamerete riitimo riaye; chigaari konya chiamoikereire ang’e, na abanto bariinete chibarasi bakomominyokia.

English: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’
Kiswahili: Alipogeuka na kuniona, akaniita, nami nikasema, ‘Je, nifanye nini?’
Ekegusii: Agachia korigereria magega, akandora, akandangeria, na inche ngaitaba: Nao inde aa.

English: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
Kiswahili: “Akaniuliza, ‘Wewe ni nani?’ “Nikamjibu, ‘Mimi ni Mwamaleki.’
Ekegusii: Erio akamboria: Naye ng’o? Nkamoiraneria ng’a n’Omoameleki inde.

English: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me, for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me.’
Kiswahili: “Kisha akaniambia, ‘Nikaribie mimi na uniue! Niko katika maumivu makali ya kifo, lakini bado ningali hai.’
Ekegusii: Ere aganteebia: Koranche, ong’ike ang’e ong’ite, ekiagera nonya ngendererete koba moyo, nigo inde nobororo bw’ogokwa.

English: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo nikamkaribia nikamuua, kwa sababu nilijua kwamba baada ya kuanguka hangeweza kupona. Nami nikachukua lile taji lililokuwa kichwani mwake na utepe uliokuwa mkononi mwake nami nimevileta hapa kwa bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ’nkamoika ang’e, ’nkamoita, ekiagera nigo namanyete ng’a tare koba moyo magega kaguure. Nkamorusia eguutwa y’obogaambi yare motwe oye na egetange kiarenge koboko kwaye, narentire ebinto ebio aa ase ore, aye omonene one.”

English: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi pamoja na watu wote waliokuwa pamoja naye wakazishika nguo zao na kuzirarua.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabwata chianga chiaye, agachitandora, na abanto bonsi abarenge amo nere bagakora bo.

English: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
Kiswahili: Wakaomboleza, wakalia pia na kufunga mpaka jioni kwa ajili ya Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe, kwa ajili ya jeshi la Bwana na nyumba ya Israeli, kwa sababu wameanguka kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Bakarera na kweumia, na kweng’ata goika mogoroba ase engencho ya Saulo na Yonathani, omwana oye, na ase engencho y’abanto ba Omonene na ey’Abaisraeli, ekiagera barabwo konya baitirwe nemioro.

English: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwambia yule kijana aliyemletea taarifa, “Wewe ni mwenyeji wa wapi?” Akamjibu, “Mimi ni mwana wa mgeni, Mwamaleki.”
Ekegusii: Daudi akaboria omomura oria omoteebia amang’ana ayio, “Aye noyo o arari ore?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Inche nigo inde omwana bw’Omoameleki ore omomenyi aa.”

English: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Kwa nini hukuogopa kuinua mkono wako ili kumwangamiza mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akamobooria, “Inaki yabete otairogete korambora okoboko kwao ase ogoita omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene”?

English: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akamwita mmoja wa watu wake na kumwambia, “Nenda ukamuue!” Kwa hiyo akampiga, naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria omomura oyomo, akamoteebia, “Inchuo omoite!” Omomura oria agaaka Omoameleki oria, akamoita,

English: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain Yahweh’s anointed.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Daudi alikuwa amemwambia, “Damu yako iwe juu ya kichwa chako mwenyewe. Kinywa chako mwenyewe kimeshuhudia dhidi yako uliposema, ‘Nilimuua mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana.’ ”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Daudi konya oteebirie Omoameleki oria, “Okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ao, tiga kobarwe igoro yao, ekiagera kwebereire kirori aye omonyene, ekero gwateba ng’a gwaitire omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.”

English: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son
Kiswahili: Daudi akafanya maombolezo haya kuhusu Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe,
Ekegusii: Daudi akareera Saulo na Yonathani, momura o Saulo, n’ogoteera oko gw’okweumia.

English: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):
Kiswahili: naye akaagiza kwamba watu wa Yuda wafundishwe ombolezo hili la upinde (ambalo limeandikwa katika Kitabu cha Yashari):
Ekegusii: Agachiika ng’a abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda borokererigwe ogoteera okwo kw’obota koriikire ase Egetabu kia Yashari.

English: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
Kiswahili: “Walio fahari yako, ee Israeli, wameuawa juu ya mahali pako palipoinuka. Jinsi wenye nguvu walivyoanguka!
Ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, obonene bwaino bwasireire igoro ase ebigoro biaino! Chituoni chi’eseegi chiaitirwe.

English: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t publish it in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
Kiswahili: “Msilisimulie hili katika Gathi, msilitangaze hili katika barabara za Ashkeloni, binti za Wafilisti wasije wakafurahia, binti za hao wasiotahiriwa wasije wakashangilia.
Ekegusii: Timoteeba amang’ana aya ase Gati, timoyararia ase chinchera chi’Askeloni. Timotiga abaiseke b’Abafilisti bachenge; timotiga abaiseke b’ abanto baria batarogeti bagoke!

English: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, and no fields of offerings; for there the shield of the mighty was defiled and cast away, the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.
Kiswahili: “Enyi milima ya Gilboa, msipate umande wala mvua, wala mashamba yazaayo sadaka ya nafaka. Kwa maana huko ndiko ngao ya mwenye nguvu iliponajisiwa, ngao ya Sauli haitapakwa tena mafuta.
Ekegusii: “Inwe ebigoro bia Giliboa, ogotoora kwe riime tikoba igoro ase more, gose embura tetwa, gose emegondo teeba ekwama endagera ekoruegwa ase Omonene, ekiagera aroro agwo nao chinguba chie chituoni chiasareretigwe, na enguba ya Saulo etaagetwe amaguta naende.

English: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan’s bow didn’t turn back. Saul’s sword didn’t return empty.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na damu ya waliouawa, kutokana na miili ya wenye nguvu, ule upinde wa Yonathani haukugeuka nyuma. Upanga wa Sauli haukurudi bure.
Ekegusii: Obota bwa Yonathani nigo bwaitete abanto abange, nigo bwaiterete amanyinga, bogaita abanto chituoni abarenge abanoru; naboigo omoro o Saulo torenge koirana bosa.

English: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.
Kiswahili: “Sauli na Yonathani, maishani walipendwa na kuneemeka, na katika kifo hawakutengana. Walikuwa wepesi kuliko tai, walikuwa na nguvu kuliko simba.
Ekegusii: Saulo na Yonathani barenge abanchwa baito, barenge gotogokia. Ase obogima na ase amakweri tibaatananetwe. Barabwo nigo barenge abaango kobua ebiongo, nigo barenge ne chinguru kobua chindo.

English: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.
Kiswahili: “Enyi binti za Israeli, lieni kwa ajili ya Sauli, ambaye aliwavika nguo nyekundu na maridadi, ambaye aliremba mavazi yenu kwa mapambo ya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abakungu b’Abaisraeli, reera Saulo, nere obaboyetie chianga chie rigori rinene, chianga chimbariri chi’okwegokeria, agachichabera ebinto bi’etaabu.

English: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan was slain on your high places.
Kiswahili: “Tazama jinsi mashujaa walivyoanguka vitani! Yonathani ameuawa mahali pako palipoinuka.
Ekegusii: “Chituoni chiaitirwe ase esegi! Yonathani nao araire ase ebigoro igoro, oitire.

English: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, surpassing the love of women.
Kiswahili: Nahuzunika kwa ajili yako, Yonathani ndugu yangu, kwangu ulikuwa mpendwa sana. Upendo wako kwangu ulikuwa wa ajabu, wa ajabu zaidi kuliko ule wa wanawake.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yonathani ominto, nigo inde nomoichano omonene ase engencho yao, aye nigo konya ongogetie mono. Ase inde obwanchani bwao nigo bwarenge obonene kobua obwanchani bw’abakuungu.

English: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!”
Kiswahili: “Tazama jinsi mashujaa walivyoanguka! Silaha za vita zimeangamia!”
Ekegusii: Chituoni chiaitirwe, na ebirwanero bi’eseegi biasiriigwe.”

English: After this, David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”
Kiswahili: Ikawa baada ya mambo haya, Daudi akamuuliza Bwana, “Je, nipande kwenda katika mojawapo ya miji ya Yuda?” Bwana akasema, “Panda.” Daudi akauliza, “Je, niende wapi?” Bwana akajibu, “Nenda Hebroni.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Daudi akamoboori’Omonene, “Inee! Ndageenda ase omochie onde bw’Abayuda inyoire?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, geenda.” Naende Daudi akamobooria, “Norori?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Heburoni.”

English: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi akakwea kwenda huko pamoja na wake zake wawili, Ahinoamu wa Yezreeli na Abigaili, mjane wa Nabali wa Karmeli.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agatiira gochiao amo nabakungu baye babere, Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli, na Abigaeli, oyotigetwe omotakaanwa, orenge moka Nabali o Karimeli.

English: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.
Kiswahili: Pia Daudi akawachukua watu waliokuwa pamoja naye, kila mmoja na jamaa yake, nao wakaishi huko Hebroni na miji yake.
Ekegusii: Boigo akairana abanto baye bonsi amo ne chiamate chiabo komenya ase emechie ya Heburoni.

English: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wa Yuda wakaja Hebroni, huko wakamtia Daudi mafuta awe mfalme juu ya nyumba ya Yuda. Daudi alipoambiwa kuwa ni watu wa Yabeshi-Gileadi waliomzika Sauli,
Ekegusii: Abayuda bagaacha Heburoni, bagaaka Daudi amaguta akaba omorwoti bwa abanto b’egesaku kiabo. Ekero Daudi ateebetigwe ng’a abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi nabwo batindegete Saulo,

English: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by Yahweh, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.
Kiswahili: akatuma wajumbe kwa watu wa Yabeshi-Gileadi kuwaambia, “Bwana awabariki kwa kuonyesha wema huu kwa kumzika Sauli bwana wenu.
Ekegusii: agatoma amang’ana gochia Yabesi o Gileadi goteebia abanto b’aroro, “Omonene abasesenie, ekiagera mwaorogetie obuya bwaino ase Saulo, omonene oino, ase okomotindeka.

English: Now may Yahweh show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.
Kiswahili: Sasa Bwana na awaonyeshe wema na uaminifu, nami pia nitawaonyesha wema ule ule kwa kuwa mmefanya jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Omonene abaorokerie obwanchani bwaye botari koera, na obwegenwa bwaye. Nainche boigo nimbakorere amaya, ekiagera mwakora ring’ana erio.

English: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, kuweni hodari na mashujaa, kwa maana bwana wenu Sauli amekufa, nayo nyumba ya Yuda imenitia mafuta niwe mfalme juu yao.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bono motenene bokong’u, mobe abaremu. Saulo, omonene oino, okuure, na Abayuda bang’akire amaguta imbe omorwoti obo.”

English: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Abneri mwana wa Neri, jemadari wa jeshi la Sauli, alikuwa amemchukua Ish-Boshethi mwana wa Sauli na kumleta hadi Mahanaimu.
Ekegusii: Bono Abineri, mosinto o Neri, orenge omotang’ani bw’abarwani ba Saulo. Ere konya oirire Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, gochia Mahanaimu,

English: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
Kiswahili: Akamweka awe mfalme juu ya nchi ya Gileadi, Waasheri, Yezreeli, Efraimu, Benyamini na Israeli yote.
Ekegusii: akamobeka koba omorwoti bwa abanto ba Gileadi, na Asuri, na Yesireeli, na Efraimu, na Benjamini, na igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi.

English: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
Kiswahili: Ish-Boshethi mwana wa Sauli alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini alipoanza kutawala Israeli, naye akatawala miaka miwili. Hata hivyo, nyumba ya Yuda ikamfuata Daudi.
Ekegusii: Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, konya okoorire emiaka emerongo ene ekero abegetwe koba omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli; akagaamba ase engaki y’emiaka ebere. Korende abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda bakaba bakobwatia Daudi.

English: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
Kiswahili: Muda ambao Daudi alikuwa mfalme juu ya nyumba ya Yuda huko Hebroni ilikuwa miaka saba na miezi sita.
Ekegusii: Ere akabagaambera Abayuda agwo Heburoni ase engaki y’emiaka etan’ebere, na emetienyi etano nomo.

English: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
Kiswahili: Abneri mwana wa Neri, pamoja na watu wa Ish-Boshethi mwana wa Sauli, wakatoka Mahanaimu kwenda Gibeoni.
Ekegusii: Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na abasomba ba Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, bakarua Mahanaimu, bakageenda ase omochie o Gibeoni.

English: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.
Kiswahili: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya na watu wa Daudi wakatoka na kukutana nao kwenye bwawa la Gibeoni. Kikundi kimoja kiliketi upande mmoja wa bwawa, na kikundi kingine upande wa pili.
Ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, na abanto ba Daudi bakageenda, bakaumerana nabarabwo ase ritibo ria Gibeoni. Abanto aba bakabeera ensemo eyemo ye ritibo riria, na abwo bande ensemo ende.

English: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!” Joab said, “Let them arise!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abneri akamwambia Yoabu, “Tuwaweke baadhi ya vijana wasimame na wapigane ana kwa ana mbele yetu.” Yoabu akasema, “Sawa, na wafanye hivyo.”
Ekegusii: Abineri agateebia Yoabu, “Tiga abamura baimoke bagosorie ase amasio aito.” Yoabu agateeba, “Tiga baimoke.”

English: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo vijana wakasimama, wakahesabiwa: watu wa Benyamini na wa Ish-Boshethi mwana wa Sauli kumi na wawili, na upande wa Daudi kumi na wawili.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaimoka, bakaroberia abanto ikomi na babere abatenenerete egesaku kia Benjamini na Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, na abanto ikomi na babere abatenenerete Daudi.

English: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.
Kiswahili: Kisha kila mtu akakamatana na mpinzani wake kichwani na kuchomana kwa upanga, nao wakaanguka chini pamoja. Kwa hiyo mahali pale katika Gibeoni pakaitwa Helkath-Hasurimu.
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo akabwata omotwe bw’oyo riare koamererania, na komobeta omoyio ase riikere; bonsi bakagwa inse bagakwa. Ase ayio, aase aria a Gibeoni akarokwa Helikati‐Hasurimu.

English: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo vita vilikuwa vikali sana, naye Abneri na watu wa Israeli wakashindwa na watu wa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Esegi ekaba entindi mono ase rituko erio, na Abineri na Abaisraeli bakabugwa n’abanto ba Daudi.

English: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.
Kiswahili: Wana watatu wa Seruya walikuwako huko: nao ni Yoabu, Abishai na Asaheli. Basi huyo Asaheli alikuwa na mbio kama paa.
Ekegusii: Abamura batato b’omokuungu Seruya, Yoabu na Abisai, na Asaeli, nao barenge. Asaeli nigo arenge omominyoki mono buna egesia.

English: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.
Kiswahili: Asaheli akamfukuza Abneri, pasipo kugeuka kulia wala kushoto wakati akimfuata.
Ekegusii: Ere agachaaka kobwatia Abineri, na ekero arenge komobwatia taonchogete gochia aande, ensemo ya borio gose eya bomosi.

English: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”
Kiswahili: Abneri akaangalia nyuma na kumuuliza, “Ni wewe, Asaheli?” Akamjibu, “Ndiyo.”
Ekegusii: Abineri akeonchora, akamobooria, “Naye Asaeli?” Ere akairaneria, “Ee, ninche.”

English: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abneri akamwambia, “Geuka upande wa kulia au kushoto. Mchukue mmoja wa vijana wa kiume na umvue silaha zake.” Lakini Asaheli hakuacha kumfukuza.
Ekegusii: Abineri akamoteebia, “Gobera gochia ensemo ende, eya borio gose eya bomosi, obwatie omomura oyomo bw’abwo, oire ebirwanero biaye.” Korende Asaeli tancha koonchoka amotige.

English: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”
Kiswahili: Abneri akamwonya tena Asaheli akimwambia, “Acha kunifukuza! Kwa nini nikuue? Je, nitawezaje kumtazama ndugu yako Yoabu usoni?”
Ekegusii: Abineri akamoteebia eria kabere, “Gobera, tiga kombwatia. Nigo orabaise kogera ngoake nkobwateranie inse. Igo inaki ndakore ng’oroke ase obosio bwa Yoabu omino?”

English: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
Kiswahili: Lakini Asaheli alikataa kuacha kumfuatia, kwa hiyo Abneri akamchoma Asaheli tumboni kwa ncha butu ya mkuki wake, mkuki ukamtoboa ukatokea mgongoni mwake. Akaanguka na kufa papo hapo. Ikawa kila mtu alisimama alipofika mahali pale Asaheli alipoanguka na kufa.
Ekegusii: Korende Asaeli akaanga kogobera. Ase igo Abineri akamobeta enda nesimisi y’orotanga rwe riitimo, na rirorio rigasokera omogongo oye. Asaeli agaaka inse, agakwera agwo aase arenge, Abanto bonsi abachete agwo ase Asaeli akwerete, bagatenenao.

English: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yoabu na Abishai walimfuata Abneri, na jua lilipokuwa linatua, wakafika kwenye kilima cha Ama, karibu na Gia kwenye njia ya kuelekea kwenye nyika ya Gibeoni.
Ekegusii: Korende Yoabu na Abisai bakabwatia Abineri. Ekero erioba rigochia kogwa bagaika ekegoro ki’Ama, kerochie Gia, ase enchera ekogeenda erooro ya Gibeoni.

English: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wa kabila la Benyamini wakakusanyika tena nyuma ya Abneri. Wakaunda kikosi na kujiimarisha juu ya kilima.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku gia Benjamini bagasangererekana amo ase okoegera Abineri, bakageenda ase ekegoro igoro, bagatenenao.

English: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”
Kiswahili: Abneri akamwita Yoabu, akamwambia, “Je, ni lazima upanga uendelee kuangamiza milele? Hutambui kwamba jambo hili litaishia katika uchungu? Utaacha kuwaagiza watu wako waache kuwafuatilia ndugu zao hata lini?”
Ekegusii: Erio Abineri akarangeria Yoabu, akamobooria, “Inee! Nigo oganetie omoro oite abanto kogenderera botambe? Tomanyeti ng’a omoerio nobororo borabe? Nengaki eng’ana inaki oraganye goika omanye gokania abanto bao tibabwatia abamwabo?”

English: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”
Kiswahili: Yoabu akajibu, “Hakika kama aishivyo Mungu, kama hukusema, hawa watu wangeendelea kuwafuatia ndugu zao mpaka asubuhi.”
Ekegusii: Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Nyasae are moyo, onye otakwana, abanto bane anga nigo barenge kobabwatia goika mambia.”

English: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.
Kiswahili: Basi Yoabu akapiga tarumbeta, nao watu wote wakasimama, hawakuwafuata Israeli tena, wala hawakuwapiga tena.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Yoabu akabugia egetuureri, na abanto bonsi bagatenena, bagatiga kobwatia Abaisraeli, tibaaba bakobarwania naende.

English: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule wote Abneri na watu wake wakatembea kupitia Araba. Wakavuka Mto Yordani, wakaendelea wakipitia nchi yote ya Bithroni wakafika Mahanaimu.
Ekegusii: Abineri na abanto baye bakageenda ase obotuko boria obogima goetera ase Ekerubo Ekiomo; bakaamboka orooche rwa Yorodani, bagaeta egati ya Bitironi, bagaika Mahanaimu.

English: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.
Kiswahili: Basi Yoabu akarudi kutoka kumfuatia Abneri, na kuwakusanya watu wake wote. Pamoja na Asaheli, watu kumi na tisa wa Daudi walikuwa wamepotea.
Ekegusii: Yoabu akairana korwa ase okobwatia Abineri; na ekero asangereretie abanto bonsi amo, bakanyora ng’a abasomba ba Daudi ikomi na kianda tibaiyo; boigo Asaeli taiyo.

English: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin and Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wa Daudi walikuwa wamewaua watu wa kabila la Benyamini 360 waliokuwa pamoja na Abneri.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto ba Daudi konya baitire abanto b’egesaku gia Benjamini amagana atato, na emerongo etanomo (360), abwo barenge amo n’Abineri.

English: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.
Kiswahili: Wakamchukua Asaheli, wakamzika katika kaburi la baba yake huko Bethlehemu. Kisha Yoabu na watu wake wakatembea usiku kucha na kufika huko Hebroni wakati wa mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakaimokia omobere bw’Asaeli, bakayoira bakayotindeka ase embeera ya ise agwo Bethlehemu. Erio Yoabu na abanto baye bakaba bare ase orogendo ase obotuko obogima, na ekero baikire Heburoni bokabakiera aroro.

English: Now there was a long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.
Kiswahili: Vita kati ya nyumba ya Sauli na nyumba ya Daudi vilidumu kwa muda mrefu. Daudi akaendelea kuwa imara zaidi na zaidi, wakati nyumba ya Sauli iliendelea kudhoofika zaidi na zaidi.
Ekegusii: Esegi ase egati y’eamate ya Saulo na eya Daudi ekaba ekogenderera ase engaki entaambe. Daudi akagenderera komenteka chinguru chiaye, korende abanto b’eamate ya Saulo bakageenderera koba aboro goetania.

English: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
Kiswahili: Wana walizaliwa kwa Daudi huko Hebroni: Mzaliwa wake wa kwanza alikuwa Amnoni mwana wa Ahinoamu wa Yezreeli;
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura Daudi baiboreretwe agwo Heburoni: Aminoni nere orenge omwana oye omotangi, omwana bw’Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli.

English: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
Kiswahili: mzaliwa wake wa pili alikuwa Danieli mwana wa Abigaili, mjane wa Nabali wa Karmeli; wa tatu, Absalomu mwana wa Maaka, binti Talmai mfalme wa Geshuri;
Ekegusii: Oyo o kabere Kileabu, omwana bw’Abigaeli, oyotigetwe omotakaanwa, orenge moka Nabali o Karimeli; na oyo o gatato Abisalomu o Maaka, mosubati o Talimai, omorwoti o Gesuri.

English: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
Kiswahili: wa nne, Adoniya mwana wa Hagithi; wa tano, Shefatia mwana wa Abitali;
Ekegusii: Oyo o kane Adonia o Hagiti, na oyo o gatano Sefatia bw’Abitali;

English: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
Kiswahili: wa sita, Ithreamu mwana wa Egla, mkewe Daudi. Hawa ndio waliozaliwa kwa Daudi huko Hebroni.
Ekegusii: na oyo o gatano na rimo Iteramu bw’Egila, moga Daudi. Abamura aba nabwo Daudi aiborerete agwo Heburoni.

English: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa vita kati ya nyumba ya Sauli na nyumba ya Daudi, Abneri alikuwa anajiimarisha katika nafasi yake kwenye nyumba ya Sauli.
Ekegusii: Ekero esegi eyio yagendererete gati y’eamate ya Saulo na eya Daudi, Abineri akagenderera kwenyorera chinguru chinyinge ase egati y’eamate ya Saulo.

English: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”
Kiswahili: Basi Sauli alikuwa amekuwa na suria, jina lake Rispa binti wa Aiya. Naye Ish-Boshethi akamwambia Abneri, “Kwa nini umekutana kimwili na suria wa baba yangu?”
Ekegusii: Saulo nabwate omokungu o sere‐sere ore korokwa Risipa, mosubati bw’Aya. Isi‐Boseti akaboria Abineri, “Nase ki mwamenyanire nomokuungu o sere‐sere o tata?”

English: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!
Kiswahili: Abneri akakasirika sana kwa sababu ya kile Ish-Boshethi alichosema, naye akamjibu, “Je, mimi ni kichwa cha mbwa, kwa upande wa Yuda? Siku hii ya leo mimi ni mtiifu kwa nyumba ya baba yako Sauli, kwa jamaa yake na rafiki zake. Sijakukabidhi kwa Daudi, lakini bado unanilaumu kwa kosa la kuhusika na huyu mwanamke!
Ekegusii: Erio Abineri akaba n’endamwamu enene ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio a Isi‐Boseti, akabora, “Inee! Inche nigo inde omotwe bw’esese korwa ase ense ya Yuda? Goika rituko ria reero ’ngendererete koba omwegenwa ase abanto b’eamate ya Saulo iso, na ase abamwabo, na ase abasani baye, ko tinakobeeka ase okoboko gwa Daudi, na bono aye gwansoereire na gonkora koba n’okomocha ase engencho y’omokuungu oyo.

English: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:
Kiswahili: Mungu na amshughulikie Abneri, tena kwa ukali, ikiwa sitafanya kwa ajili ya Daudi kile Bwana alichomwahidi kwa kiapo,
Ekegusii: Nyasae ang’e egesusuro ekenene onye tingoikeraneria Daudi ay’Omonene amorierete eira amokorere:

English: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”
Kiswahili: na kuuhamisha ufalme kutoka kwenye nyumba ya Sauli na kuimarisha kiti cha ufalme cha Daudi juu ya Israeli na Yuda kuanzia Dani mpaka Beer-Sheba.”
Ekegusii: Arusie oborwoti korwa ase enyomba ya Saulo, abobeeke ase Daudi, na Daudi abe omorwoti, agaambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.”

English: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.
Kiswahili: Ish-Boshethi hakuthubutu kusema neno jingine kwa Abneri, kwa sababu alimwogopa Abneri.
Ekegusii: Na Isi‐Boseti tanyara koiraneria Abineri ring’ana nonya nerimo, ekiagera amoirogete.

English: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Abneri akatuma wajumbe kwa niaba yake kwa Daudi, kumwambia, “Nchi hii ni ya nani? Fanya mapatano na mimi, nami nitakusaidia kuiweka Israeli yote juu yako.”
Ekegusii: Abineri agatoma abanto ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, akabora, “Ense eye neyang’o? Kora okobwatana nainche, erio ngokoonye na nkorentere Abaisraeli bonsi babwatane naye.”

English: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akasema, “Vyema, nitafanya mapatano nawe. Lakini nahitaji jambo moja kwako: Usije mbele yangu mpaka umemleta Mikali binti Sauli wakati utakapokuja kuniona.”
Ekegusii: Daudi agatoma amairanerio, agateeba, “Ayio namaya, ninkore bo. Korende ninganetie onkorere egento ekemo. Kogocha aa ondetere Mikali, mosubati o Saulo. Onye togokora bo, rirorio tokonyara kondora.”

English: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akapeleka wajumbe kwa Ish-Boshethi mwana wa Sauli, kudai, “Nipe Mikali mke wangu, ambaye nilimposa mwenyewe kwa mahari ya magovi 100 ya Wafilisti.”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatoma abanto ase Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, akabora, “Ing’iranerie Mikali mok’ane, oyio narierete boko, na ’ngaakana rigori ri’amasankwa a isiko ay’ebiimo bi’obosaacha ay’Abafilisti rigana erimo, erinde imonyuome.”

English: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Ish-Boshethi akatoa amri kwamba Mikali achukuliwe kutoka kwa Paltieli mumewe, mwana wa Laishi.
Ekegusii: Erio Isi‐Boseti agatoma abanto barusie omokungu oria korwa ase Palitieli, omosacha oye, mosinto o Laisi.

English: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, mumewe alikwenda pamoja naye, akilia nyuma ya mkewe njia yote hadi Bahurimu. Ndipo Abneri akamwambia Paltieli, “Rudi nyumbani!” Kwa hiyo akarudi.
Ekegusii: Korende omosacha oye akamotunyana goika Bahurimu okona‐korera. Erio Abineri akamoteebia, “Irana!” Ere akairana.

English: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.
Kiswahili: Abneri akafanya shauri pamoja na wazee wa Israeli, akasema, “Muda mrefu mmetaka kumfanya Daudi mfalme wenu.
Ekegusii: Agwo Abineri agakwana nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli, akabora, “Korwa ase chingaki chinde chiaetire mwabeire mokogania ng’a Daudi abe omorwoti oino.

English: Now then do it! For Yahweh has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”
Kiswahili: Sasa fanyeni hivyo! Kwa maana Bwana alimwahidi Daudi akisema, ‘Kwa kupitia Daudi mtumishi wangu nitawaokoa watu wangu Israeli kutoka mikononi mwa Wafilisti na kutoka mikononi mwa adui zako wote.’ ”
Ekegusii: Gaki bono, kora bo, ekiagera Omonene nariete eira igoro ya Daudi, agateeba: Nintoorie Abaisraeli, abanto bane, goetera ase okoboko gwa Daudi, omosomba one. Nimbarusie korwa ase amaboko y’Abafilisti, na korwa ase amaboko y’ababisa baabo bande bonsi.”
