Kiswahili: Yoabu alikwenda mbele yake, akamuuliza, “Wewe ni Yoabu?” Akamjibu, “Ndiye mimi.” Yule mwanamke akamwambia, “Sikiliza kile mtumishi wako atakachokuambia.” Akamwambia, “Ninasikiliza.”
Ekegusii: Yoabu agasuka gochia ang’e ase are, na omokungu oria akamobooria, “Naye Yoabu?” Akairaneria, “Ee, ninche.” Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Tegerera amang’ana ane, inche omosomba oo omokungu.” Yoabu akairaneria, “Nintegererete.”

English: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanamke akaendelea kusema, “Zamani za kale walikuwa wakisema, ‘Wakaulize ushauri huko Abeli,’ hivyo kulimaliza lile shauri.
Ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Agwo kare abanto nigo banarete goteeba: Geenda Abeli, omochie oyio, erinde onyore ogoseemigwa; ayio naro arenge gokoora amang’ana abo.

English: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up Yahweh’s inheritance?”
Kiswahili: Sisi ni watu wa amani na waaminifu katika Israeli. Wewe unajaribu kuharibu mji ambao ni mama katika Israeli. Kwa nini unataka kumeza urithi wa Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore abanto b’omorembe na abegenwa ase Abaisraeli. Inee! Aye nigo origetie gosiria omochie oyo ore ng’ina ase egati y’Abaisraeli? Nase ki oganetie gosaria omwando bw’Omonene?”

English: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
Kiswahili: Yoabu akajibu, “Hilo liwe mbali nami. Hilo liwe mbali nami kumeza au kuharibu.
Ekegusii: Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Ayio tiga abe are nainche; timbaisa gosaria omochie na koyosiria.

English: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo sivyo ilivyo. Mtu mmoja jina lake Sheba mwana wa Bikri, kutoka nchi ya vilima vya Efraimu, ameinua mkono wake dhidi ya mfalme, dhidi ya Daudi. Nikabidhini mtu huyu mmoja, nami nitajiondoa katika mji huu.” Huyu mwanamke akamwambia Yoabu, “Kichwa chake mtatupiwa kupitia juu ya ukuta.”
Ekegusii: Oyio tari oro omooroberio oito, korende omonto oyomo bw’ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu, Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, oimokire koba mamincha y’omorwoti Daudi. Mosokie, nainche indue aa ase omochie oyo”! Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, noruterwe omotwe oye ase orwaki igoro.”

English: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
Kiswahili: Ndipo huyo mwanamke akaenda kwa watu wote akiwa na ushauri wake wa busara, nao wakakata kichwa cha Sheba mwana wa Bikri na kumtupia Yoabu. Kwa hiyo Yoabu akapiga tarumbeta, na watu wake wakatawanyika kutoka mjini, kila mmoja akirejea nyumbani kwake. Naye Yoabu akarudi kwa mfalme huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akaebereria abanto bonsi ase chiseemi, na barabwo bakabutora Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, omotwe, bakayoruta gochia isiko ase Yoabu. Erio Yoabu akabugia egetuureri, na abanto bonsi bagaserebeekana; kera omonto akageenda bwoye. Na Yoabu akairana Yerusalemu ase omorwoti.

English: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,
Kiswahili: Yoabu alikuwa jemadari wa jeshi lote la Israeli; Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa juu ya Wakerethi na Wapelethi;
Ekegusii: Yoabu nere orenge omochiki bw’abarwani bonsi b’esegi ase Abaisraeli, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti na Abapeleti.

English: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,
Kiswahili: Adoramu alikuwa kiongozi wa wale waliofanya kazi ya kulazimishwa; Yehoshafati mwana wa Ahiludi alikuwa mweka kumbukumbu;
Ekegusii: Adorama nigo abegetwe koba omoteneneri bw’emeremo ende yonsi. Yehosafati mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nigo areenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.

English: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,
Kiswahili: Sheva alikuwa mwandishi; Sadoki na Abiathari walikuwa makuhani;
Ekegusii: Sheva nomoriiki oreenge, na Zadoki na Abiatari nabakuani bareenge.

English: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.
Kiswahili: na Ira, Myairi, alikuwa kuhani wa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Amo nabwo, Ira Omoyairi nigo areenge Omokuani ase Daudi.

English: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of Yahweh. Yahweh said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”
Kiswahili: Wakati wa utawala wa Daudi kulikuwa na njaa kwa miaka mitatu mfululizo, kwa hiyo Daudi akautafuta uso wa Bwana. Bwana akasema, “Ni kwa sababu ya Sauli na nyumba yake iliyotiwa madoa ya damu, kwa sababu aliwaua Wagibeoni.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y’obogaambi bwa Daudi enchara nigo yareenge koba omwaka ase omwaka, ase engaki y’emiaka etato, na Daudi akabori’Omonene igoro y’ayio. Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ayio nigo agokoreka ase engencho ya Saulo na enyomba yaye, ekiagera baiterete amaanyinga’ yabaanto; ere naitete Abagibeoni.”

English: The king called the Gibeonites and said to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the children of Israel had sworn to them; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);
Kiswahili: Mfalme akawaita Wagibeoni na kuzumgumza nao. (Wagibeoni hawakuwa wa wana wa Israeli, ila walikuwa mabaki ya Waamori. Waisraeli walikuwa wameapa kuwaacha hai, lakini Sauli katika wivu wake kwa ajili ya Israeli na Yuda, alikuwa amejaribu kuwaangamiza.)
Ekegusii: Daudi akarangeria Abagibeoni. (Barabwo tibarenge Abaisraeli; nigo bareenge ekeombe giatigarete korwa ase Abaamori, na Abaisraeli konya baabariereire eira ng’a baabatige babe moyo, korende Saulo akarigia kobaita ase omokia oye, ase engencho y’Abaisraeli na Abayuda.)

English: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless Yahweh’s inheritance?”
Kiswahili: Daudi akawauliza Wagibeoni, “Niwatendee nini? Nitawaridhishaje ili mbariki urithi wa Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Daudi akaboria Abagibeoni, “Ninki ’nkobakorera? Nindigetie gokora okobwatanigwa ase engencho y’obobe mwakoreretwe, erinde mosesenie abanto ba Omonene.”

English: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”
Kiswahili: Wagibeoni wakamjibu, “Hatuna haki ya kudai fedha wala dhahabu kutoka kwa Sauli au jamaa yake, wala hatuna haki ya kumuua mtu yeyote katika Israeli.” Daudi akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafanyie nini?”
Ekegusii: Abagibeoni bakamoiraneria, “Titorigeti chifeta gose chitaabu korwa ase Saulo, gose korwa ase eamate yaye; intwe titorigeti goita omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli.” Daudi akababoria, “Ninki rende ’nkobakorera?”

English: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu mfalme, “Kwa habari ya mtu aliyetuangamiza na kufanya hila mbaya dhidi yetu ili kwamba tuangamizwe na tusiwe na yeyote katika Israeli,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria omorwoti, “Omonto oria akarigia gotosiria kegima ng’a titomenya ase Abaisraeli.

English: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to Yahweh in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of Yahweh.” The king said, “I will give them.”
Kiswahili: tupatieni wazao wake saba wa kiume tuwaue hadharani mbele za Bwana huko Gibea ya Sauli, aliyekuwa amechaguliwa na Bwana.” Basi mfalme akasema, “Nitawakabidhi kwenu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, tiga toegwe abamura batano na babere b’ororeria rw’aye, erinde tobasunge ase obosio bw’Omonene aiga Gibea aase Saulo, omochoore Omonene, amenyete.” Omorwoti akabairaneria, “Nimbaabae inwe.”

English: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Yahweh’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akamhifadhi Mefiboshethi mwana wa Yonathani, mwana wa Sauli, kwa sababu ya kile kiapo mbele za Bwana kati ya Daudi na Yonathani.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agatiga Mefiboseti, mosinto o Yonathani o Saulo, ase engencho y’eira Daudi na Yonathani bariereranete ase Omonene,

English: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
Kiswahili: Lakini mfalme akamchukua Armoni na Mefiboshethi, wana wawili wa Rispa binti Aiya, ambao alikuwa amemzalia Sauli, pamoja na wana watano wa Merabu binti Sauli, aliokuwa amemzalia Adrieli mwana wa Barzilai, Mmeholathi.
Ekegusii: korende akairera Arimoni na Mefiboseti, abana abamura babere abwo Risipa, omosubati o Aya aiborerete Saulo. Naende akairera abamura batano, aba Mikali, omosubati o Saulo, aiborerete Adirieli, mosinto o Barisilai Omomehola.

English: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before Yahweh, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.
Kiswahili: Akawakabidhi kwa Wagibeoni, ambao waliwaua na kuwaweka wazi juu ya kilima mbele za Bwana. Wote saba walianguka kwa pamoja; waliuawa katika siku za kwanza za mavuno, mara tu uvunaji wa shayiri ulipokuwa unaanza.
Ekegusii: Akababeeka ase amaboko y’Abagibeoni, na barabwo bakabasunga ase egetunwa igoro, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Bonsi batano na babere bagaiterwa amo. Bagaitwa ase amatuko amatang’ani ye rigesa, ekero bachaakire kogesa endagera ekorokwa esairi.

English: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.
Kiswahili: Rispa binti Aiya akachukua nguo ya gunia, akajitandikia juu ya mwamba. Kuanzia mwanzo wa mavuno mpaka mvua ziliponyesha juu ya miili ya hao waliouawa, Rispa hakuruhusu ndege wa angani kuwagusa wakati wa mchana, wala wanyama wa mwitu wakati wa usiku.
Ekegusii: Erio Risipa, mosubati o Aya, akaira chianga chi’echigunia agachiaara ase egetare keria, akabeerao korwa omochakano bwe rigesa goika embura ekorwa igoro egachaaka gotwera emebere y’abwo basungetwe, gose tatigete chinyoni chigwe ase emebere eyio mobaso, gose ching’iti chi’orosana chichicheo botuko.

English: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
Kiswahili: Daudi alipoambiwa kile Rispa binti Aiya, suria wa Sauli, alichokuwa amekifanya,
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebeetigwe ayio Risipa, mosubati o Aya, omokungu o sere‐sere o Saulo akorete,

English: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa;
Kiswahili: alikwenda akachukua mifupa ya Sauli na mwanawe Yonathani kutoka kwa watu wa Yabeshi-Gileadi. (Walikuwa wameichukua kwa siri kutoka uwanja wa watu wote huko Beth-Shani, mahali ambapo Wafilisti walikuwa wamewatundika baada ya kumuua Sauli huko Gilboa.)
Ekegusii: akageenda akoyia amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, momura o Saulo, korwa ase abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi. (Abanto abwo konya baibire emebere eyio korwa ase ekeooreri agwo Bati‐Sani aase Abafirisiti baabasungete, aase rituko riria baitete Saulo aaria Giliboa.)

English: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.
Kiswahili: Daudi akaileta mifupa ya Sauli na ya mwanawe Yonathani kutoka huko, pia mifupa ya wale waliokuwa wameuawa na kutupwa ilikusanywa.
Ekegusii: Daudi akarenta amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, momura o Saulo; boigo agasangereria amauga y’abanto baria batano na babere konya batongirwe.

English: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.
Kiswahili: Wakazika mifupa ya Sauli na ya mwanawe Yonathani katika kaburi la Kishi, babaye Sauli, huko Sela katika nchi ya Benyamini, nao wakafanya kila kitu mfalme alichoagiza. Baada ya hayo, Mungu akajibu maombi kwa ajili ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Erio bagatindeka amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, omwana oye, ase ense ya Benjamini, aaria Zela, ase embeera ya Kisi ise. Barabwo bagakora onsi aya omorwoti achiigete. Magega y’ayio Nyasae akaigwa aya basaberete ense eria.

English: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;
Kiswahili: Kwa mara nyingine tena kulikuwa na vita kati ya Wafilisti na Israeli. Daudi akashuka pamoja na watu wake ili kupigana dhidi ya Wafilisti, naye akawa amechoka sana.
Ekegusii: Esegi ekaba naende ase egati y’Abafilisti na Abaisraeli, na Daudi agatirimboka amo nabarwani baye korwania Abafirisiti. Daudi akaba orosire,

English: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.
Kiswahili: Naye Ishbi-Benobu, mmoja wa wazao wa Warefai, ambaye mkuki wake ulikuwa na uzito wa shekeli 300 za shaba, alikuwa amejifunga upanga mpya, naye alisema angemuua Daudi.
Ekegusii: na Isi‐Benobu, oyomo bw’amamonto, nabwate riitimo riare noborito bwe chikiiro isato na ekeng’ese, naende nabwate omoro omoyia; ere akarigia goita Daudi.

English: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Abishai mwana wa Seruya akaja kumwokoa Daudi; akampiga huyo Mfilisti, akamwangusha chini na kumuua. Ndipo watu wakamwapia Daudi, wakisema, “Kamwe hutakwenda tena nasi vitani, ili kwamba taa ya Israeli isije ikazimwa.”
Ekegusii: Korende Abisai, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, akamotooria, agaita Omofilisti oria. Erio abanto ba Daudi bagakania Daudi na gotiana ng’a, “Aye bono togosooka na kogeenda ase esegi amo naintwe; aye nigo ore etaya y’Abaisraeli, toyerimia.”

English: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, kukawa na vita nyingine na Wafilisti, huko Gobu. Wakati huo Sibekai, Mhushathi, akamuua Safu, mmoja wa wazao wa Warefai.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio esegi in’yareenge ase Abaisraeli n’Abafilisti aria Gobu, na Sibeekai Omohusa agaita Safu, oyomo bw’amamonto.

English: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
Kiswahili: Katika vita vingine na Wafilisti huko Gobu, Elhanani mwana wa Yaare-Oregimu, Mbethlehemu, alimuua nduguye Goliathi, Mgiti, ambaye mkuki wake ulikuwa na mpini kama mti wa mfumaji.
Ekegusii: Esegi ende yarenge n’Abafilisti agwo Gobu. Elihanani, mosinto o Yaare‐Oregimu korwa Bethlehemu, agaita Goliato korwa Gati. Orotanga rwe riitimo ria Goliato nigo rwareenge buna omwaro omonene.

English: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.
Kiswahili: Katika vita vingine tena, vilivyopiganwa huko Gathi, kulikuwako na mtu mmoja mkubwa mwenye vidole sita katika kila mkono na vidole sita kila mguu, jumla vidole ishirini na vinne. Yeye alikuwa pia mzao wa Mrefai.
Ekegusii: Naende esegi yareenge Gati. Omonto omotambe nareengeo. Nigo areenge nebiara bitano na ekemo ase kera okoboko, na bitano na ekemo ase kera okogoro; bionsi nigo biareenge emerongo ebere na bine. Ere boigo noyomo bw’amamonto oreenge.

English: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.
Kiswahili: Alipowadhihaki Israeli, Yonathani mwana wa Shimea, nduguye Daudi, akamuua.
Ekegusii: Ere akarama Abaisraeli, na Yonathani, momura o Simea omwabo Daudi, akamoita.

English: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
Kiswahili: Hawa wanne walikuwa wazao wa Warefai huko Gathi, nao walianguka kwa mikono ya Daudi na watu wake.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo baane nigo bareenge ab’ororeria rw’amamonto korwa Gati. Barabwo nigo baitetwe na Daudi na abanto baye.

English: David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,
Kiswahili: Daudi alimwimbia Bwana maneno ya wimbo huu wakati Bwana alipomwokoa mikononi mwa adui zake wote, na pia mkononi mwa Sauli.
Ekegusii: Oko nogoteera Daudi atererete Omonene, ekero Omonene amotooretie korwa ase amaboko y’ababisa baye na aya Saulo.

English: and he said: “Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
Kiswahili: Akasema: “Bwana ni mwamba wangu, ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu,
Ekegusii: Agateeba: Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi y’ane enkong’u; nere Omotooria one.

English: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.
Kiswahili: Mungu wangu ni mwamba wangu, ambaye kwake ninakimbilia, ngao yangu na pembe ya wokovu wangu. Yeye ni ngome yangu, kimbilio langu na mwokozi wangu, huniokoa kutoka kwa watu wenye jeuri.
Ekegusii: Nyasae one nere egetare kiane, ase are nao nyebisete, ere n’enguba y’ane enkengerete, na orogunchara rwane rwandeterete ogotooreka, naende nere eburi y’ane enkong’u, na obotamero bwane. Ere n’Omotooria one, oy’ogontooria korwa ase obotindi.

English: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
Kiswahili: Ninamwita Bwana, anayestahili kusifiwa, nami ninaokolewa kutoka kwa adui zangu.
Ekegusii: Nindangerie Omonene, oyo ogwenerete gotogigwa, nigo arantoorie korwa ase ababisa bane.

English: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
Kiswahili: “Mawimbi ya mauti yalinizunguka, mafuriko ya maangamizi yalinilemea.
Ekegusii: Emerindo y’amakweri konya yang’etananire, chiooro chi’obobe chikandetera obwoba.

English: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.
Kiswahili: Kamba za kuzimu zilinizunguka, mitego ya mauti ilinikabili.
Ekegusii: Obobe bw’amakweri nigo bwang’etananete, emeeto y’amakweri egantega na kombwata.

English: In my distress, I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.
Kiswahili: Katika shida yangu nalimwita Bwana, nilimlilia Mungu wangu. Kutoka Hekaluni mwake alisikia sauti yangu, kilio changu kikafika masikioni mwake.
Ekegusii: Ase emechando y’ane ’nkarangeri’Omonene; ’nkarera ase Nyasae one. Korwa ase Hekalu yaye akaigwa eriogi riane, ekerero kiane gekamoikera, ere agakeigwa.

English: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
Kiswahili: “Dunia ilitetemeka na kutikisika, misingi ya mbingu ikatikisika, vilitetemeka kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika.
Ekegusii: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, amaroso a igoro agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene areenge n’endamwamu.

English: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
Kiswahili: Moshi ukapanda kutoka puani mwake, moto uteketezao ukatoka kinywani mwake, makaa ya moto yawakayo yakatoka ndani mwake.
Ekegusii: Erioki rigasoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, na omorero ogosaamba korwa ase omonwa oye: ee, omorero bw’amakara ogasooka korwa ase are.

English: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
Kiswahili: Akazipasua mbingu akashuka chini, mawingu meusi yalikuwa chini ya miguu yake.
Ekegusii: Akang’usa igoro goocha inse aa, nere agacha, riire rimwamu rikaba inse y’amagoro aye.

English: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.
Kiswahili: Alipanda juu ya kerubi akaruka, akapaa juu kwa mbawa za upepo.
Ekegusii: Akariina egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, akairuruka; akarorekana igoro ye chimbaaba chi’embeo.

English: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
Kiswahili: Alifanya giza hema lake la kujifunika: mawingu meusi ya mvua ya angani.
Ekegusii: Agetuba ere omonyene n’omosunte, na amare amarito aichire amaache.

English: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na mwanga wa uwepo wake mawingu yalisogea, ikanyesha mvua ya mawe na umeme wa radi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase obomeka‐meku obwo bwareenge bosio bwaye okomesa gokaruta ebibembeeri bi’omorero.

English: Yahweh thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.
Kiswahili: Bwana alinguruma kutoka mbinguni, sauti ya Aliye Juu Sana ilisikika.
Ekegusii: Omonene agaaka enkoba korwa igoro, na eriogi ri’Oyore Igoro Mono rikaiguugwa.

English: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.
Kiswahili: Aliipiga mishale na kutawanya adui, umeme wa radi na kuwafukuza.
Ekegusii: Akaruta chinsara, agaserebania ababisa baye, akabaaka nokomesa.

English: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by Yahweh’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
Kiswahili: Mabonde ya bahari yalifunuliwa, na misingi ya dunia ikawa wazi kwa kukaripia kwake Bwana, kwa uvumi wa pumzi kutoka puani mwake.
Ekegusii: Erio ebiambokero bi’enyancha bikarorekana, na oboroso bw’ense bokaorokigwa aarabu, ekero Omonene abatogonyerete ase okwoga kw’omoika bwe chimioro chiaye.

English: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
Kiswahili: “Alinyoosha mkono kutoka juu na kunishika; alinitoa kutoka kilindi cha maji makuu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amaache amaange.

English: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
Kiswahili: Aliniokoa kutoka adui wangu mwenye nguvu nyingi, kutoka adui zangu waliokuwa na nguvu nyingi kuliko mimi.
Ekegusii: Agantooria korwa ase ababisa bane bare ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo bareenge ne chinguru kombua.

English: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
Kiswahili: Walinikabili siku ya msiba wangu, lakini Bwana alikuwa msaada wangu.
Ekegusii: Ekero nareenge nemechando bakandwania, korende Omonene akaba egekengero kiane.

English: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
Kiswahili: Alinileta nje mahali penye nafasi tele, akaniokoa kwa kuwa alipendezwa nami.
Ekegusii: Akang’ira aase areenge aagare, agantooria, ekiagera namogoogetie.

English: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
Kiswahili: “Bwana alinitendea sawasawa na uadilifu wangu; sawasawa na usafi wa mikono yangu amenilipa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo ang’ete eng’eria y’obuya, ekiagera inde omooronge; nigo ansesenetie, ekiagera inde n’amaboko atari na komocha.

English: For I have kept Yahweh’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nimezishika njia za Bwana; sijatenda ubaya nikamwacha Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire ’nkobwatia chinchera chia Omonene, tintigeti Nyasae one ase ogokora amabe.

English: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.
Kiswahili: Sheria zake zote zi mbele yangu, wala sijayaacha maagizo yake.
Ekegusii: Nabeire ’nkoreenda amachiiko aye onsi, na timbeti ’ngotiga emeroberio yaye echiikire.

English: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa sina hatia mbele zake, nami nimejilinda nisitende dhambi.
Ekegusii: Nigo nareenge omoikeranu ase are, ’nkereenda korwa ase obobe.

English: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
Kiswahili: Bwana amenilipa sawasawa na uadilifu wangu, sawasawa na usafi wangu machoni pake.
Ekegusii: Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ’ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera arooche ng’a nomochenu inde.

English: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.
Kiswahili: “Kwa yeye aliye mwaminifu unajionyesha kuwa mwaminifu, kwa asiye na hatia unajionyesha kutokuwa na hatia,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ore omwegenwa ase abwo bare abegenwa; nigo okweorokia ng’a nomoikeranu ore ase abwo bare abaikeranu.

English: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
Kiswahili: kwa aliye mtakatifu unajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu, lakini kwa aliyepotoka unajionyesha kuwa mkaidi.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu, nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.

English: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.
Kiswahili: Wewe huwaokoa wanyenyekevu, lakini macho yako ni juu ya wenye kiburi ili uwashushe.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende amaiso ao nigo arigereretie abare abaenenu ase okobairania inse.

English: For you are my lamp, Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni taa yangu, Ee Bwana. Bwana hulifanya giza langu kuwa mwanga.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ore etaya y’ane; Omonene one, nigo okoonchora omosunte one oba omobaso.

English: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
Kiswahili: Kwa msaada wako naweza kushinda jeshi, nikiwa pamoja na Mungu wangu nitaweza kuruka ukuta.
Ekegusii: Konde amo naye, nigo ndasirie omogaanda bw’eseegi, na ekero inde na Nyasae one nincharoke chindwaki igoro.

English: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
Kiswahili: “Kuhusu Mungu, njia yake ni kamilifu; neno la Bwana halina dosari. Yeye ni ngao kwa wote wanaokimbilia kwake.
Ekegusii: Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu; amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.

English: For who is God, besides Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God?
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni nani aliye Mungu zaidi ya Bwana? Ni nani aliye Mwamba isipokuwa Mungu wetu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore Nyasae, otatiga Omonene? Ning’o ore egetare, otatiga Nyasae oito?

English: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
Kiswahili: Mungu ndiye anivikaye nguvu na kufanya njia yangu kuwa kamilifu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere eburi y’ane ye chinguru, nigo akoraa omonto omooronge ase enchera agoeta.

English: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.
Kiswahili: Huifanya miguu yangu kama miguu ya kulungu, huniwezesha kusimama mahali palipo juu.
Ekegusii: Ere okorire amagoro ane abeire buna ay’egesia, onkong’irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.

English: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
Kiswahili: Huifundisha mikono yangu kupigana vita; mikono yangu inaweza kupinda upinde wa shaba.
Ekegusii: Ere bworokereirie amaboko ane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko ane anyare gokumba obota bw’etai.

English: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.
Kiswahili: Hunipa ngao yako ya ushindi, unajishusha chini ili kuniinua.
Ekegusii: “Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.

English: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
Kiswahili: Huyapanua mapito yangu, ili miguu yangu isiteleze.
Ekegusii: Kwang’eire aase aagare ngotaara, na amagoro ane tagotererigwa.

English: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.
Kiswahili: “Niliwafuatia adui zangu na nikawaseta, sikurudi nyuma mpaka walipoangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Nkabwatia ababisa bane, nkabasiria, gose tinairanete goika nkabakoora.

English: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.
Kiswahili: Niliwaseta kabisa, nao hawakuweza kuinuka tena; walianguka chini ya miguu yangu.
Ekegusii: Nkabaakera inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro ane, bakabugwa.

English: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
Kiswahili: Ulinivika nguvu kwa ajili ya kupigana vita; uliwafanya adui zangu wasujudu miguuni pangu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwambeegete chinguru chi’okorwana esegi; okabeeka ababisa bane inse y’amagoro ane.

English: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
Kiswahili: Uliwafanya adui zangu wageuke na kukimbia, nami nikawaangamiza adui zangu.
Ekegusii: Ogaseeria ababisa bane bagatama korwa ase inde, abangeechete ’nkabasiria kegima.

English: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
Kiswahili: Walipiga yowe, lakini hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwaokoa; walimlilia Bwana, lakini hakuwajibu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakarigereria, korende onde tarenge obatooretie; bakarangeri’Omonene, korende ere tabaigwa.

English: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.
Kiswahili: Niliwaponda kama mavumbi ya nchi; niliwaponda na kuwakanyaga kama tope barabarani.
Ekegusii: Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ye riroba, nkabamionogora na kobatiringa buna esike egotachwa ase chinchera.

English: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.
Kiswahili: “Umeniokoa kutokana na mashambulizi ya watu wangu; umenihifadhi mimi kama kiongozi wa mataifa. Watu ambao sikuwajua wananitumikia,
Ekegusii: “Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania n’abanto bane, kwandendire nabeire omogambi bw’abaanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba bane.

English: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.
Kiswahili: nao wageni huja wakininyenyekea, mara wanisikiapo, hunitii.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi nigo bebeegete inse y’ane, na ekero baigure chinkuma chiane, banyigwera.

English: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
Kiswahili: Wote wanalegea, wanatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo, kobagosooka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.

English: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
Kiswahili: “Bwana yu hai! Sifa ni kwa Mwamba wangu! Atukuzwe Mungu, Mwamba, Mwokozi wangu!
Ekegusii: “Omonene nigo are moyo! Ere oyore egetare kiane atogigwe! Nyasae, egetare ki’ogotooreka kw’ane, aimokererigwe igoro.

English: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye Mungu anilipiziaye kisasi, ayawekaye mataifa chini yangu,
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akonduseria egesiomba, nabeeke abanto b’ebisaku inse y’ane.

English: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
Kiswahili: aniwekaye huru toka kwa adui zangu. Uliniinua juu ya adui zangu; uliniokoa toka kwa watu wajeuri.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa bane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha y’ane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.

English: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitakusifu, Ee Bwana, katikati ya mataifa; nitaliimbia sifa jina lako.
Ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, ase ayio ningotogie ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, ninterere erieta ria’o ase okoritogia.

English: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”
Kiswahili: Humpa mfalme wake ushindi mkuu; huonyesha fadhili zake kwa mpakwa mafuta wake, kwa Daudi na wazao wake milele.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae ong’eire inche, omorwoti oye, obobui obonene, oorokirie obwanchani botari koera ase ’nde, inche omoakwa amaguta oye, inche Daudi, na ororeria rw’ane, goika kare na kare.”

English: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
Kiswahili: Haya ni maneno ya mwisho ya Daudi: “Neno la Daudi mwana wa Yese, neno la mtu aliyeinuliwa na Aliye Juu Sana, mtu aliyepakwa mafuta na Mungu wa Yakobo, mwimbaji wa nyimbo wa Israeli:
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana y’omoerio a Daudi, mosinto o Yese, omonto oyo oimokereretigwe igoro, omoakwa amaguta o Nyasae o Yakobo, omoteri bw’amatera agwansa ase Abaisraeli:

English: “Yahweh’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
Kiswahili: “Roho wa Bwana alinena kupitia kwangu, neno lake lilikuwa ulimini mwangu.
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene ogokwana goetera ase inde, ring’ana riaye nigo rire ase omonwa one.

English: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,
Kiswahili: Mungu wa Israeli alinena, mwamba wa Israeli akaniambia: ‘Mtu anatawala watu kwa haki, wakati anapotawala akiwa na hofu ya Mungu,
Ekegusii: Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli okwanire, ere oyore egetare ki’Abaisraeli onteebirie: “Oyo okogaambera abanto ase oboronge, oyo okogaambera ase okoiroka Nyasae,

English: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’
Kiswahili: yeye ni kama mwanga wa asubuhi jua lichomozapo asubuhi isiyo na mawingu, kama mwanga baada ya mvua uchipuzao majani kutoka ardhini.’
Ekegusii: nigo anga buna omobaso o mambia ase bare, buna erioba rikobara emambia etari namare. Nigo anga buna obonyansi bogokiina magega embura koyatuure.”

English: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won’t he make it grow?
Kiswahili: “Je, si hivyo ilivyo nyumba yangu mbele za Mungu? Je, hajafanya Agano la milele nami, lililopangwa na kuimarishwa kila sehemu? Je, hatanifanya niufurahie wokovu wangu na kunijalia matakwa yangu yote?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ororeria rw’ane tirori boronge ase Nyasae? Takorete nainche okobwatana gwa kare na kare, okwo korobeirie gotari koonchoka? Inee! Nyasae tagonsesenia na gontooria, naende ang’e aya ’nganetie?

English: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu waovu wote watatupwa kando kama miiba, ambayo haikusanywi kwa mkono.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto ababe nigo bare buna amagwa atugutire, atari gokunwa namaboko.

English: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”
Kiswahili: Yeyote agusaye miiba hutumia chombo cha chuma au mpini wa mkuki, nayo huchomwa pale ilipo.”
Ekegusii: Omonto takoyakuna otatiga abe obwate ebioma na orotanga rwe riitimo, barabwo ’nabasaambwe n’omorero aroro agwo.”

English: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth, a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya mashujaa wa Daudi: Yosheb-Bashebethi, Mtahkemoni, alikuwa kiongozi wa wale Watatu; yeye aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 800, ambao aliwaua katika pambano moja.
Ekegusii: Aya n’aro amarieta y’abarwani chituoni Daudi abwate: Yosebe‐Basebeti korwa Takemoni. Ere nigo areenge omonene bw’abwo batato, chituoni chi’abarwani. Ere agaita abanto amagana atan’atato ase engaki eyeemo, ase okona‐kong’wana‐ng’wania ne riitimo ria’ye.

English: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.
Kiswahili: Wa pili wake alikuwa Eleazari mwana wa Dodai, Mwahohi. Akiwa mmojawapo wa wale mashujaa watatu, alikuwa pamoja na Daudi wakati waliwadhihaki Wafilisti waliokuwa wamekusanyika huko Pas-Damimu kwa ajili ya vita. Kisha watu wa Israeli wakarudi nyuma,
Ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere bw’abwo batato n’Eleazari, mosinto o Dodai bw’eamate y’Ahohi. Ere nigo arenge na Daudi ekero baramete Abafirisiti aase basangererekanete amo barwane esegi, na Abaisraeli bakairana magega.

English: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and Yahweh worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.
Kiswahili: lakini yeye alisimama imara akawaua Wafilisti hadi mkono wake ukachoka na ukagandamana na upanga. Bwana akawapa ushindi mkubwa siku ile. Vikosi vikarudi kwa Eleazari, kuteka tu nyara za waliokufa.
Ekegusii: Korende ere agatenena, agaita Abafirisiti goika okoboko kwaye gokarosa gokananterera ase omoro. Omonene akabanyorera obobui obonene mono ase rituko riria. Erio abanto bakairana bagatunyana Eleazari, bagasakora ebisakorwa.

English: After him was Shammah the son of Agee, a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Aliyefuata alikuwa Shama mwana wa Agee, Mharari. Wafilisti walipokusanyika pamoja mahali palipokuwa shamba lililojaa dengu, vikosi vya Israeli viliwakimbia.
Ekegusii: Na oyo o gatato ase abwo nere Sama, mosinto bw’Agee korwa Harari. Abafirisiti konya basangererekanire agwo, Lehi, ase omogondo orenge oichire ne ching’ende chi’egatani. Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase Abafirisiti,

English: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh worked a great victory.
Kiswahili: Lakini Shama akasimama imara katikati ya lile shamba. Akalitetea na kuwaua Wafilisti, naye Bwana akawapa ushindi mkubwa.
Ekegusii: korende Sama agatenena ase omogondo gati, akayorwanerera, agaita Abafirisiti, n’Omonene akarenta obobui obonene mono.

English: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mavuno, viongozi watatu kati ya viongozi thelathini walishuka, wakamwendea Daudi katika pango la Adulamu, wakati kikundi cha Wafilisti kilikuwa kimepiga kambi katika Bonde la Warefai.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo, ekero kie rigesa, abanto batato ase abwo abanene emerongo etato bakageenda ase Daudi maate ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu, na Abafirisiti konya batoorire ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.

English: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Daudi alikuwa katika ngome, na kambi ya Wafilisti ilikuwa huko Bethlehemu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Daudi nigo areenge ase eburi ime, na abarwani b’Abafilisti nigo bareenge agwo Bethlehemu.

English: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
Kiswahili: Daudi akatamani maji, akasema, “Laiti mtu angenipatia maji ya kunywa kutoka kisima kilicho karibu na lango la Bethlehemu!”
Ekegusii: Daudi akaba okogania amaache anywe, akabora, “Ntare konyora omonto andetere amaache inywe korwa ase ensoko eyio ere ase egeita kia Bethlehemu!”

English: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Basi mashujaa hao watatu wakapenya katikati ya Wafilisti, wakaenda kuchota maji kutoka kwa kisima kilicho karibu na lango la Bethlehemu, wakamletea Daudi. Lakini Daudi akakataa kuyanywa. Badala yake, aliyamimina mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batato bakabinya‐binyia egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amaache korwa ase ensoko eria yareenge ase egeita gia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa, otatiga ayaiterete koba ekeng’wanso gi’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,

English: He said, “Be it far from me, Yahweh, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Iwe mbali nami, Ee Bwana, kufanya kitu hiki. Je, hii si damu ya watu ambao walikwenda kwa kuhatarisha maisha yao?” Naye Daudi hakuyanywa. Haya yalifanywa na hao mashujaa watatu.
Ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene antange tinkora bo. Inee! Inywe amanyinga y’abanto bataegerete obogima bwabo?” Ase ayio akaanga, tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto abwo batato chituoni bakorete.

English: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
Kiswahili: Abishai ndugu yake Yoabu mwana wa Seruya ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa hao Watatu. Aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 300 ambao aliwaua, kwa hiyo naye akawa na sifa kama hao Watatu.
Ekegusii: Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu bw’omokuungu Seruya ere nigo amanyekanete ase baria batato; akarwania abanto amagana atato, akababeta ne riitimo riaye, akabaita, akaba nerieta rinene ase baria batato.

English: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.
Kiswahili: Je, hakupata heshima kubwa zaidi kuliko hao Watatu? Alikuwa jemadari wao, ingawa hakuhesabiwa miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Ase baria batato ere nigo abwate ogosikwa okuya goetania abande, akaba omoraai obo, korende tareng’anetie na baria batato b’eritang’ani.

English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.
Kiswahili: Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa mpiganaji hodari kutoka Kabseeli ambaye alifanya mambo makubwa ya ujasiri. Aliwaua mashujaa wawili waliokuwa hodari kuliko wote wa Moabu. Pia alishuka shimoni kulipokuwa na theluji na kumuua simba.
Ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omonto etuoni korwa Kabuseli. Ere agakora emeremo emenene, agaita abanto babere chituoni b’Abamoabu. Engaki ende, ekero ki’obokendu, na amagena y’embura atwete, agasoa engoro agaita endo aroro.

English: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
Kiswahili: Pia alimuua Mmisri mrefu mkubwa. Ingawa Mmisri alikuwa na mkuki mkononi mwake, Benaya alimwendea akiwa na rungu. Alipokonya mkuki kutoka mkononi mwa Mmisri na kumuua kwa mkuki wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Boigo agaita Omomisiri orenge omonene obwate riitimo. Akamochiera nenyimbo, akamoura riitimo riare koboko kwaye, akamoita neritimo riria riaye omonyene.

English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
Kiswahili: Haya yalikuwa mambo ya ushujaa ya Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada; naye pia alikuwa maarufu kama wale mashujaa watatu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akorete; nere akaba n’erieta rinene buna abanto baria batato chituoni.

English: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliheshimiwa zaidi ya wale Thelathini, lakini hakujumuishwa miongoni mwa wale Watatu. Daudi akamweka kuwa kiongozi wa walinzi wake.
Ekegusii: Akanyora ogosikwa okuya ase egati ya baria emerongo etato, korende tareng’anetie na baria batato b’eritang’ani. Daudi akamobeka akaba omoreendi bw’obogima bwaye.

English: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa wale Thelathini walikuwepo: Asaheli ndugu wa Yoabu; Elhanani mwana wa Dodo kutoka Bethlehemu;
Ekegusii: Abande ba baria emerongo etato nabwo aba: Asaeli, momura omwabo Yoabu, na Elihanani, mosinto o Dodo korwa Bethlehemu;

English: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
Kiswahili: Shama, Mharodi; Elika, Mharodi;
Ekegusii: Sama na Elika korwa Harodi;

English: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
Kiswahili: Helesi, Mpalti; Ira mwana wa Ikeshi kutoka Tekoa;
Ekegusii: Helesi korwa Peleti, na Ira, mosinto o Ikesi, korwa Tekoa;

English: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
Kiswahili: Abiezeri kutoka Anathothi; Mebunai, Mhushathi;
Ekegusii: Abieseri korwa Anatoti, na Mebunai korwa Husa;

English: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
Kiswahili: Salmoni, Mwahohi; Maharai, Mnetofathi;
Ekegusii: Salimoni korwa Ahohi, na Maharai korwa Netofa;

English: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
Kiswahili: Heledi mwana wa Baana, Mnetofathi; Itai mwana wa Ribai kutoka Gibea ya Benyamini;
Ekegusii: Helebu, mosinto o Baana, korwa Netofa, na Itai, mosinto o Ribai, korwa Gibea, bw’egesaku gia Benjamini.

English: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.
Kiswahili: Benaya Mpirathoni; Hidai kutoka mabonde ya Gaashi;
Ekegusii: Benaya korwa Piratoni, na Hidai korwa ase amagoko ang’e na Gaasi;

English: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
Kiswahili: Abi-Alboni, Mwaribathi; Azmawethi, Mbarhumi;
Ekegusii: Abi‐Aliboni korwa Araba na Asimaweti korwa Bahurimu;

English: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
Kiswahili: Eliaba, Mshaalboni; wana wa Yasheni; Yonathani
Ekegusii: Eliaba korwa Saalaboni, na basinto ba Yaseni, na Yonathani;

English: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Shama, Mharari; Ahiamu mwana wa Sharari, Mharari;
Ekegusii: Sama korwa Harari na Ahiamu, mosinto o Sharari, korwa Harari;

English: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
Kiswahili: Elifeleti mwana wa Ahasbai, Mmaakathi; Eliamu mwana wa Ahithofeli, Mgiloni;
Ekegusii: Elifeleti, mosinto bw’Ahasibai, omonto korwa Maaka; Eliamu, mosinto bw’Ahitofeli, korwa Gilo;

English: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
Kiswahili: Hezro, Mkarmeli; Paarai, Mwarbi;
Ekegusii: Hesiro korwa Karimeli na Paarai korwa Ariba;

English: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
Kiswahili: Igali mwana wa Nathani kutoka Soba; Bani, Mgadi;
Ekegusii: Igali, mosinto o Nathani, korwa Soba na Bani korwa Gadi;

English: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
Kiswahili: Seleki, Mwamoni; Naharai, Mbeerothi, aliyekuwa mbeba silaha za Yoabu mwana wa Seruya;
Ekegusii: Seleki korwa Amoni na Naharai korwa Beroti, omobogoria ebirwanero bia Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya;

English: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
Kiswahili: Ira, Mwithiri; Garebu, Mwithiri;
Ekegusii: Ira na Garebu korwa Itiri;

English: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.
Kiswahili: na Uria, Mhiti. Jumla yao wote walikuwa watu thelathini na saba.
Ekegusii: na Uria Omohiti. Bonsi nigo bareenge emerongo etato, na batan’obabere.

English: Again Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”
Kiswahili: Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka tena dhidi ya Israeli, naye akamchochea Daudi dhidi yao, akisema, “Nenda ukawahesabu Israeli na Yuda.”
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akaba n’endamwamu enene igoro y’Abaisraeli, agasukia enkoro ya Daudi akamoteebia, “Geenda obare Abaisraeli na Abayuda.”

English: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mfalme akamwambia Yoabu, pamoja na majemadari wa jeshi aliokuwa nao, “Nendeni kwa makabila yote ya Israeli kuanzia Dani hadi Beer-Sheba na mwandikishe watu wapiganaji, ili niweze kujua idadi yao.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo omorwoti agateebia Yoabu, omotang’ani bw’emegaanda yaye y’abarwani, “Bono etanana ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba, mobare abanto, erinde imanye omobaro obo.”

English: Joab said to the king, “Now may Yahweh your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yoabu akamjibu mfalme, “Bwana Mungu wako na azidishe jeshi mara mia, nayo macho ya bwana wangu mfalme na yaone hili. Lakini kwa nini bwana wangu mfalme anataka kufanya kitu cha namna hii?”
Ekegusii: Korende Yoabu akairaneria omorwoti, “Omonene, Nyasae oo, amente abanto ara amagana atakobareka, na aye omonene one omorwoti obe moyo goika oyarore. Korende inaki ring’ana eri riakogwenera aye omonene one omorwoti?”

English: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, neno la mfalme likawa na nguvu juu ya Yoabu pamoja na majemadari wa jeshi, kwa hiyo wakaondoka mbele ya mfalme kuandikisha wapiganaji wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’omorwoti rikaba ne chinguru igoro ya Yoabu na abatang’ani b’abarwani. Ase igo Yoabu na abatang’ani bande bakarua ase omorwoti, bakageenda kobara Abaisraeli.

English: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuvuka Yordani, walipiga kambi karibu na Aroeri, kusini ya mji ulioko kwenye bonde jembamba, ndipo wakipitia Gadi, wakaenda hadi Yazeri.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamboka Yorodani, bagatoora Aroeri, na korwa ase omochie oyio agwo ase egati ye rikura bakageenda Gadi, naende gochia Yeseri,

English: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,
Kiswahili: Walikwenda hadi Gileadi na pia eneo la Tahtimu-Hodshi, wakaendelea hadi Dani-Yaani na kuzunguka kuelekea Sidoni.
Ekegusii: Erio bakageenda Gileadi na ase ense ya Tatimu‐Hodisi. Naende bakageenda Dani, na korwa Dani bagaetanana bagaika Sidoni.

English: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaenda kuelekea ngome ya Tiro pamoja na miji yote ya Wahivi na ya Wakanaani. Mwishoni, walikwenda mpaka Beer-Sheba katika Negebu ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: Bakageenda Turo, omochie ore ne chindwaki, na ase emechie yonsi y’Abahivi, na ey’Abakaanani. Magega y’ayio bakageenda Beeri‐Seba ase ense y’Abayuda, ensemo ya sugusu.

English: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kupita katika nchi nzima, walirudi Yerusalemu baada ya miezi tisa na siku ishirini.
Ekegusii: Magega y’emetienyi kianda na amatuko emerongo ebere, ekero baetananire ense yonsi, bakairana Yerusalemu.

English: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
Kiswahili: Yoabu akatoa hesabu ya wapiganaji kwa mfalme: Katika Israeli kulikuwako watu 800,000 wenye uwezo wa kupigana, na katika Yuda watu 500,000.
Ekegusii: Yoabu akaa omorwoti omobaro bw’abaanto abaare konyara korwana esegi nemioro. Ase Abaisraeli nigo barenge abanto chilifu amagana atan’atato (800,000), na ase Abayuda chilifu amagana atano (500,000).

English: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to Yahweh, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, Yahweh, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”
Kiswahili: Dhamiri ya Daudi ilishtuka baada ya kuwahesabu wapiganaji, naye akamwambia Bwana, “Nimefanya dhambi kubwa kwa kufanya jambo hili. Ee Bwana, sasa ninakusihi, ondoa hatia ya mtumishi wako. Nimefanya jambo la kipumbavu sana.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi akoorire kobara abanto, enkoro yaye ekamogaambia. Erio agateebia Omonene, “Nakorire ebibe ebinene ase aya nakorire; korende b’Omonene, nagosabire onyabere inche omosomba oo, inaki nigo nakorire egento ki’oboriri mono.”

English: When David rose up in the morning, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
Kiswahili: Kabla Daudi hajaamka kesho yake asubuhi, neno la Bwana lilikuwa limemjia Gadi nabii, aliyekuwa mwonaji wa Daudi, kusema:
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi abogete mambia, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaachera Gadi, omobani, oyorenge omoorori o Daudi, rikamotebia,

English: “Go and speak to David, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”
Kiswahili: “Nenda ukamwambie Daudi, ‘Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: Ninakupa wewe uchaguzi wa mambo matatu. Nichagulie mojawapo nitakalotenda dhidi yako.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Geenda okwane na Daudi, omoteebie ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Nabeekire ase ore amang’ana atato; ase ayio chora erimo, eri ndagokorere.”

English: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”
Kiswahili: Basi Gadi akaenda kwa Daudi na kumwambia, “Je, ije njaa ya miaka mitatu katika nchi yako? Au miezi mitatu ya kukimbia adui zako wakikufuatia? Au siku tatu za tauni katika nchi yako? Basi sasa, fikiri juu ya hilo na uamue jinsi nitakavyomjibu huyo aliyenituma.”
Ekegusii: Erio Gadi akageenda ase Daudi, akamomanyia amang’ana ayio, akamoteebia, “Nigo origetie enchara eche ase ense yao emiaka etato? Gose nigo origetie otame korwa ase ababisa bao emetienyi etato? Gose nigo origetie oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita abanto bosoe ense yao amatuko atato? Bono rengereria mono na ong’e amairanerio imoirere oyio ontomete.”

English: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamjibu Gadi, “Nitataabika sana. Afadhali tuangukie mikononi mwa Bwana, kwa maana rehema zake ni kuu, lakini usiniache nianguke mikononi mwa wanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Gadi, “Inche nasoire ase emechando emenene. Gaki, bono, tiga togwe ase okoboko kw’Omonene, ekiagera amaabera aye n’amanene; korende ase amaboko a Mwanyabaanto tintageti ingweo.”

English: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana akatuma tauni katika Israeli kuanzia asubuhi mpaka mwisho wa muda ulioamriwa, wakafa watu 70,000 kuanzia Dani hadi Beer-Sheba.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akarentera Abaisraeli oborwaire obobe, na borobwo bogaita abanto korwa mambia goika engaki yaragetwe; abanto chilifu emerongo etan’ebere (70,000) bagakwa korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.

English: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Yahweh relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Malaika aliponyoosha mkono wake ili kuangamiza Yerusalemu, Bwana akahuzunika kwa sababu ya maafa, akamwambia yule malaika aliyekuwa anawadhuru watu, “Yatosha! Rudisha mkono wako.” Wakati huo malaika wa Bwana alikuwa kwenye sakafu ya kupuria ya Arauna, Myebusi.
Ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika aramborete okoboko kwaye asirie Yerusalemu, Omonene akaonchora ebirengererio biaye ase amabe ayio, agateebia omomalaika oria orenge gosiria abanto, “Bono aisanire, ororobia okoboko kwao.” Omomalaika konya oikire ang’e nekeooreri ki’Arauna Omoyebusi.

English: David spoke to Yahweh when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”
Kiswahili: Ikawa Daudi alipomwona huyo malaika aliyekuwa akiwaua watu, akamwambia Bwana, “Mimi ndiye niliyetenda dhambi na kukosa. Hawa ni kondoo tu. Wamefanya nini? Mkono wako uwe juu yangu na nyumba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi arooche omomalaika oria orenge goita abanto, agateebia Omonene, “Rora, ninche inde omonyabibe, ninche nakorire obobe obo, korende ching’ondi echi chiane, inki chiakorete? Okoboko kwao tiga kobe igoro y’ane, na igoro y’enyomba ya tata.”

English: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo Gadi akamwendea Daudi na kumwambia, “Panda ukamjengee Bwana madhabahu kwenye sakafu ya kupuria ya Arauna Myebusi.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Gadi akageenda ase Daudi, akamoteebia, “Imoka oagachere Omonene egesasiimero agwo ase ekeooreri ki’Arauna Omoyebusi.”

English: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Yahweh commanded.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akakwea kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa ameamuru kwa kinywa cha Gadi.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akaigwera amang’ana ayio Omonene achiigete goetera ase Gadi.

English: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
Kiswahili: Arauna alipotazama na kumwona mfalme na watu wake wakija kumwelekea, alitoka nje na kusujudu mbele ya mfalme kifudifudi, akiuinamisha uso wake ardhini.
Ekegusii: Arauna agachia korigereria akarora omorwoti na abasomba baye bagotiira goocha ase are. Erio agasooka, agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase obosio bw’omorwoti.

English: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to Yahweh, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
Kiswahili: Arauna akasema, “Mbona bwana wangu mfalme amekuja kwa mtumishi wake?” Daudi akajibu, “Kununua sakafu yako ya kupuria, ili niweze kumjengea Bwana madhabahu, ili tauni iliyo katika watu iondolewe.”
Ekegusii: Arauna akamobooria, “Omonene, omorwoti one, inaki gwachire aa ase ’nde inche omosomba oo?” Daudi akamoiraneria, “Nigo naachire ’ngore ekeooreri kiao, inyagaachere Omonene egesasiimero aiga, erinde amaakwa atangwe korwa ase abanto.”

English: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.
Kiswahili: Arauna akamwambia Daudi, “Bwana wangu mfalme na achukue chochote kinachompendeza na akitoe sadaka. Hapa kuna maksai kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, pia kuna miti ya kupuria na nira za ngʼombe kwa ajili ya kuni.
Ekegusii: Erio Arauna akairaneria Daudi, “omonene one omorwoti, rora kende gionsi keramogwenere ase ekeng’wanso. Ira chintang’ana echi ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ebikorero ebi bi’okoora amo namakorogoto bibe chiinko chi’okogesambera.”

English: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May Yahweh your God accept you.”
Kiswahili: Ee mfalme, Arauna anatoa vyote hivi kwa mfalme.” Pia Arauna akamwambia mfalme, “Bwana Mungu wako na akukubali.”
Ekegusii: Arauna akaa omorwoti ebinto ebio bionsi, akamoteebia, “Tiga Omonene Nyasae oo agwanchere.”

English: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to Yahweh my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
Kiswahili: Lakini mfalme akamjibu Arauna, “La hasha, nasisitiza kuvilipia. Sitatoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa Bwana Mungu wangu isiyonigharimu chochote.” Kwa hiyo Daudi akanunua ile sakafu ya kupuria nafaka na maksai, akazilipia shekeli hamsini za fedha.
Ekegusii: Korende omorwoti akairaneria Arauna, “Yaya taibo, korende nigo ’nkobigora korwa ase ore ase rigori bikoonigwa: tinkoruera Omonene Nyasae ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nebiinto ntagoreti ase rigori.” Igo Daudi akagora ekeooreri ekio amo ne chiombe ase chitaabu, chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etano.

English: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So Yahweh was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akamjengea Bwana madhabahu mahali hapo, na kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani. Kisha Bwana akajibu kwa ajili ya nchi, nayo tauni ikakoma katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: Na Daudi akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero, agwo akarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na eki’omorembe. Ase ayio Omonene akaigwa ogosaba gw’ense eria, na amarwaire agatangwa korwa ase Abaisraeli.

English: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Daudi alipokuwa mzee umri ukiwa umesogea, hakuweza kupata joto hata walipomfunika kwa nguo.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Daudi konya ogotire mono, nonya abakori emeremo baye bare komobisia amarangeti amange, tareenge koigwa riberera.

English: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo watumishi wake wakamwambia, “Turuhusu tumtafute kijana mwanamwali bikira amhudumie mfalme na kumtunza. Anaweza kulala pembeni mwake ili bwana wetu mfalme apate joto.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo abasomba baye bakamoteebia: “Tiga aye omorwoti, omonene oito origerigwe omoiseke omwekuungi; ere abe ogokorenda na kogokorera. Boigo abe ogokorarisia, akobeekere riberera.”

English: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakatafuta katika Israeli yote ili kumpata msichana mzuri wa sura na wakampata Abishagi, Mshunami, wakamleta kwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakarigia ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli, banyore omoiseke omwekuungi omonyakieni. Bakanyora Abisagi Omosunemu, bakamorenta ase omorwoti.

English: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.
Kiswahili: Msichana huyo alikuwa mzuri sana wa sura, akamtunza mfalme na kumhudumia, lakini mfalme hakufanya naye tendo la ndoa.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke oria nigo areenge omonyakieni mono kegima: ere akaba omokoreri bw’omorwoti, korende omorwoti tamenyanete nere.

English: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
Kiswahili: Basi Adoniya, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Hagithi, akajigamba na kusema, “Mimi nitakuwa mfalme.” Hivyo akajiwekea tayari magari na wapanda farasi, pamoja na watu hamsini wa kumtangulia wakikimbia.
Ekegusii: Adonia, omwana omomura bwa Hagiti, moga Daudi, akeimokereria igoro omonyene, ogoteeba: “Ninche ndabe omorwoti.” Akenyorera chigari na abanto abariini chibarasi, na abanto emerongo etano (50) barabe bagotang’ana bosio bwaye.

English: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.
Kiswahili: (Baba yake hakuwa ameingilia na kumuuliza, “Kwa nini unafanya hivyo?” Alikuwa pia kijana mzuri sana wa sura, na alizaliwa baada ya Absalomu.)
Ekegusii: Ise konya tana komotogonyera nonya ng’ake ase okomobooria: “Nase ki gwakora aya na aya?” Boigo Adonia nigo areenge omonto omonyakieni; ere nigo aiboretwe magega Abisalomu kaiboirwe.

English: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.
Kiswahili: Adoniya akashauriana pamoja na Yoabu mwana wa Seruya na kuhani Abiathari, nao wakamsaidia.
Ekegusii: Adonia agakwana na Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, na Abiatari Omokuani; barabwo bagancherana komokoonya.

English: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
Kiswahili: Lakini kuhani Sadoki, Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada, Nathani nabii, Shimei, Rei na walinzi maalum wa Daudi hawakujiunga na Adoniya.
Ekegusii: Korende Zadoki Omokuani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Nathani omobani, na Simei, na Rei, na abarwani chituoni ba Daudi, barabwo tibabwatanete n’Adonia.

English: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;
Kiswahili: Ndipo Adoniya akatoa dhabihu ya kondoo, ngʼombe na ndama walionona kwenye Jiwe la Zohelethi karibu na En-Rogeli. Akawaalika ndugu zake wote, wana wa mfalme na wanaume wote wa Yuda waliokuwa maafisa wa mfalme,
Ekegusii: Adonia akanyenya ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chimori chinoru, chikaba ekeng’wanso agwo ang’e n’Egetare gie Ching’iti kere ase ensoko y’Eni‐Rogeli, akarangeria abamura bamwabo bonsi, abwo abamura b’omorwoti, na abanto bonsi abanene b’obogaambi bwa Yuda.

English: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.
Kiswahili: lakini hakumwalika nabii Nathani, Benaya, walinzi maalum wa mfalme, wala ndugu yake Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Korende tarangeretie Nathani omobani, gose Benaya, gose abanto baria baarenge abarwani chituoni, gose Sulemani, momura omwabo.

English: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Nathani akamuuliza Bathsheba, mama yake Solomoni, “Je, hujasikia kwamba Adoniya, mwana wa Hagithi, amekuwa mfalme pasipo bwana wetu Daudi kujua jambo hili?
Ekegusii: Nathani akagenda ase Batiseba, akamoteebia: “Inee! Aye toraigwa ng’a Adonia, omwana o Hagiti, obeire omorwoti, na Daudi, omonene oito, taramanya amang’ana ayio?

English: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, acha nikushauri jinsi utakavyookoa uhai wako mwenyewe na uhai wa mwanao Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono tiga ngosemie, erinde otoorie obogima bwao obonyene, na obw’omwana oo Sulemani.

English: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’
Kiswahili: Ingia kwa Mfalme Daudi na umwambie, ‘Bwana wangu mfalme, je hukuniapia mimi mtumishi wako: “Hakika mwanao Solomoni atakuwa mfalme baada yangu na ndiye atakayeketi juu ya kiti changu cha ufalme”? Kwa nini basi Adoniya amekuwa mfalme?’
Ekegusii: Bono genda, osoe ara rimo ase omorwoti Daudi, omoboorie: Inee! Aye omonene one omorwoti, tikwandierete inche, omosomba oo, eira y’ogotiana, ogateeba: Sulemani, omwana oo omomura, nere oragaambe magega yane; ere naikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oborwoti? Nase ki rende Adonia abeire omorwoti?

English: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”
Kiswahili: Utakapokuwa ukizungumza na mfalme, nitaingia na kuthibitisha hayo uliyoyasema.”
Ekegusii: Bono nebe ekero aye ogendererete gokwana nomorwoti, nainche boigo ninsoe mbeeke amang’ana ao chinguru ase okoenekia ng’a nekeene.”

English: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bathsheba akaenda kumwona mfalme chumbani mwake mahali ambapo Abishagi, Mshunami, alikuwa akimhudumia, naye mfalme alikuwa mzee sana.
Ekegusii: Batiseba akagenda ase omorwoti, agasoa akanyomba k’omorwoti. (Bono omorwoti konya obeire omogotu mono, na Abisagi, Omosunemu, nere orenge omokoreri oye.)

English: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”
Kiswahili: Bathsheba akasujudu na kupiga magoti mbele ya mfalme. Mfalme akauliza, “Ni nini hiki unachotaka?”
Ekegusii: Batiseba agatugama inse ase okoorokia amasikani ase omorwoti, na omorwoti akamobooria: “Ninki oganetie?”

English: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by Yahweh your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Bwana wangu, wewe mwenyewe uliniapia mimi mtumishi wako kwa Bwana Mungu wako kwamba: ‘Solomoni Mwanao atakuwa mfalme baada yangu na ndiye atakayeketi kwenye kiti changu cha ufalme.’
Ekegusii: Batiseba akamoteebia: “Aye omonene one, nkwandierete inche, omosomba oo, eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, ogateeba: Sulemani, omwana oo omomura, nere oragaambe magega yane, nere oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oborwoti.

English: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa Adoniya amekuwa mfalme, nawe, bwana wangu mfalme huna habari kuhusu jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Na bono rora, Adonia bweeire oborwoti, na aye omonene one omorwoti, tomanyeti amang’ana ayio.

English: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.
Kiswahili: Ametoa dhabihu idadi kubwa ya ngʼombe, ndama walionona na kondoo, naye amewaalika wana wa mfalme wote, kuhani Abiathari, na Yoabu jemadari wa jeshi, lakini hakumwalika Solomoni mtumishi wako.
Ekegusii: Okorire ekeng’wanso, onyenyire chieri chinyinge, ching’ondi, ne chimori chinoru; naende orangeirie abana abamura bonsi b’omorwoti, na Abiatari Omokuani, na Yoabu, omochiki bw’abarwani b’esegi, korende tarangereti Sulemani, omosomba oo.

English: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
Kiswahili: Bwana wangu mfalme, macho ya Israeli yote yanakutazama wewe wajue kutoka kwako kuwa ni nani atakayeketi katika kiti cha ufalme cha bwana wangu mfalme baada yake.
Ekegusii: Na bono, omonene one omorwoti, amaiso yabaanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli naye arigereretie, obateebie ng’a ning’o oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’oborwoti, aye omorwoti one, magega gokwarureo.

English: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”
Kiswahili: Kama sivyo, mara tu bwana wangu mfalme atakapopumzishwa pamoja na baba zake, mimi na mwanangu Solomoni tutatendewa kama wahalifu.”
Ekegusii: Onye taibo, nebe ekero aye, omonene one omorwoti, gwakuure na koraraare ase chisokoro chiao chiaraarete, inche na omwana one Sulemani toche kobarwa koba abamochi abanene.”

English: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa angali anazungumza na mfalme, nabii Nathani akafika.
Ekegusii: Ekero omokungu oria agendererete gokwana nomorwoti, Nathani omobani agacha aroro agwo.

English: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia mfalme, “Nabii Nathani yuko hapa.” Kisha akaenda mbele ya mfalme na kumsujudia hadi uso wake ukagusa ardhi.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agatebigwa: “Nathani omobani, oyo aiga.” Na ekero achete ase obosio bw’omorwoti, agatugama inse akaumama.

English: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?
Kiswahili: Nathani akasema, “Je, bwana wangu mfalme, umetangaza kuwa Adoniya atakuwa mfalme baada yako na kwamba ataketi kwenye kiti chako cha ufalme?
Ekegusii: Nathani agakwana, akamobooria: “Omonene one omorwoti, Inee, nabo gwateebete ng’a, Adonia nere oragaambe magega yao, aikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’oborwoti?

English: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’
Kiswahili: Leo ameshuka na kutoa dhabihu idadi kubwa ya ngʼombe, ndama walionona na kondoo. Amewaalika wana wote wa mfalme, jemadari wa jeshi na kuhani Abiathari. Sasa hivi, wanakula na kunywa pamoja naye wakisema, ‘Aishi maisha marefu, Mfalme Adoniya!’
Ekegusii: Reero ere otirimbokire, onyenyire chiombe, ne chimori chinoru, ne ching’ondi, ase obonge, naende orangeirie abana abamura bonsi b’omorwoti, na abachiki b’abasikari, na Abiatari Omokuani; na rora, igo bakoria na konywa ase obosio bwaye bagoteeba: Adonia omorwoti ochie kare!

English: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi mtumishi wako, kuhani Sadoki, Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada na mtumishi wako Solomoni hakutualika.
Ekegusii: Korende inche, omosomba oo, na Zadoki Omokuani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Sulemani, omosomba oo, intwe tatorangereti.

English: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”
Kiswahili: Je, hili ni jambo ambalo bwana wangu mfalme amelifanya pasipo kuwajulisha watumishi wake ili wapate kujua ni nani atakayeketi kwenye kiti cha ufalme cha bwana wangu mfalme baada yake?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Ring’ana eri igo riakorirwe, naye omonene one omorwoti toratotebia intwe abasomba bao ng’a ning’o oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiao abe omorwoti magega yao?”

English: Then King David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mfalme Daudi akasema, “Mwite Bathsheba, aingie ndani.” Hivyo akaingia mbele ya mfalme na kusimama mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Daudi akairaneria: “Rangeria Batiseba achiche ase ’nde.” Ase ayio Batiseba agacha ase obosio bw’omorwoti, agatenenao.

English: The king vowed and said, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme akaapa: “Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, ambaye ameniokoa kutoka kila taabu,
Ekegusii: Na omorwoti akaria eira y’ogotiana, agateeba: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oria otooretie obogima bwane korwa ase emechando yonsi,

English: most certainly as I swore to you by Yahweh, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”
Kiswahili: hakika nitatekeleza leo kile nilichokuapia kwa Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: Mwanao Solomoni atakuwa mfalme baada yangu, naye ataketi kwenye kiti changu cha ufalme baada yangu.”
Ekegusii: buna nakorierete eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ngateeba: Sulemani omwana oo, nere oragaambe magega yane, na reero boigo ngokoriera inde eira eyio eyio.”

English: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord King David live forever!”
Kiswahili: Kisha Bathsheba akasujudu akipiga magoti mbele ya mfalme uso wake ukigusa ardhi akasema, “Bwana wangu Mfalme Daudi na aishi milele!”
Ekegusii: Erio Batiseba agatugama inse, akaumama ase okoorokia amasikani ase omorwoti, agakwana: “Tiga aye omonene one, omorwoti Daudi, ochie kare!”

English: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Daudi akasema, “Mwite kuhani Sadoki ndani, nabii Nathani na Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada.” Walipofika mbele ya mfalme,
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agateeba: “Indangererie Zadoki Omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada.” Erio abanto abwo bagacha ase obosio bw’omorwoti.

English: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.
Kiswahili: akawaambia: “Wachukueni watumishi wa bwana wenu pamoja nanyi na mkamkalishe mwanangu Solomoni juu ya nyumbu wangu mwenyewe mkamteremshe hadi Gihoni.
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia: “Imoka mogende nabasomba baane, moriinie Sulemani, omwana one, ase ebarasi yane, erio momotirimbokie gochia Gihoni.

English: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
Kiswahili: Huko kuhani Sadoki na nabii Nathani wamtie mafuta awe mfalme juu ya Israeli. Pigeni tarumbeta na mpaze sauti, ‘Mfalme Solomoni aishi maisha marefu!’
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo Zadoki Omokuani na Nathani omobani bamoake amaguta ase okomwatanana abe omorwoti okogaambera Abaisraeli. Erio mobugie ebitureeri bi’omochengo, motebe: Sulemani omorwoti ochie kare!

English: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”
Kiswahili: Kisha mtapanda pamoja naye, atakuja na kuketi kwenye kiti changu cha ufalme na kutawala badala yangu. Nimemweka awe mtawala juu ya Israeli na Yuda.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio momokoobe gocha aiga nka ase ’nde, nere aikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oborwoti, ekiagera nere orabe omorwoti ase ribaga riane; nere nachorire agambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda.”

English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May Yahweh, the God of my lord the king, say so.
Kiswahili: Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada akamjibu mfalme, “Amen! Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu mfalme, na aseme vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akairaneria omorwoti: “Amina. Tiga Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one omorwoti, anchere ayio.

English: As Yahweh has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”
Kiswahili: Kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa na bwana wangu mfalme, vivyo hivyo na awe na Solomoni kukifanya kiti chake cha utawala kuwa kikuu kuliko kile cha bwana wangu Mfalme Daudi!”
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’an’Omonene abeire amo naye, omonene one, naboigo abe amo na Sulemani, erio akore ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti kebe ekenene goetania ekerogo kiao aye omorwoti Daudi, omonene one.”

English: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kuhani Sadoki, nabii Nathani, Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada, Wakerethi na Wapelethi wakampandisha Solomoni juu ya nyumbu wa Mfalme Daudi, nao wakamsindikiza hadi Gihoni.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Zadoki Omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Abakereti, na Abapeleti bagatirimboka, bakariinia Sulemani ase ebarasi y’omorwoti, erio bakamoira Gihoni.

English: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”
