Ekegusii: Boigo Yerameeli nabwate omokungu onde orenge korokwa Atara; nere orenge ng’ina Onamu.

English: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Ramu mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yerameeli walikuwa: Maasi, Yamini na Ekeri.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ramu, omomura omotangi o Yerameeli, nabwo aba: Maasi na Yamini, na Ekeri.

English: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Onamu walikuwa: Shamai na Yada. Wana wa Shamai walikuwa: Nadabu na Abishuri.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Onamu nabwo Samai na Yada. Abana abamura ba Samai nabwo Nadabu na Abisuri.

English: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
Kiswahili: Mke wa Abishuri aliitwa Abihaili, ambaye alimzalia Abani na Molidi.
Ekegusii: Moka Abisuri nigo arenge korokwa Abihaili, nere akamoiborera Ahabani na Molidi.

English: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Nadabu walikuwa Seledi na Apaimu, lakini Seledi alikufa bila kuzaa watoto.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nadabu nabwo Seledi na Apaimu; Seledi agakwa atabwati bana.

English: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
Kiswahili: Apaimu akamzaa: Ishi ambaye alikuwa baba wa Sheshani. Sheshani akamzaa Alai.
Ekegusii: Apaimu akaibora Ishi, na Ishi akaibora Sesani, na Sesani akaibora Alai.

English: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yada, nduguye Shamai walikuwa: Yetheri na Yonathani. Yetheri alikufa bila kuzaa watoto.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yada, momura omwabo Sama, nabwo Yeteri na Yonathani. Yeteri agakwa atabwati bana.

English: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yonathani walikuwa: Pelethi na Zaza. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Yerameeli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yonathani nabwo Peleti na Sasa. Aba nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yerameeli.

English: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
Kiswahili: Sheshani hakuwa na watoto wa kiume, ila wasichana tu. Alikuwa na mtumishi Mmisri aliyeitwa Yarha.
Ekegusii: Sesani tabwate abana abamura, korende igo abwate abana abaiseke boka. Ere Sesani nabwate omosomba oye omomura Omomisiri orenge korokwa Yara.

English: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
Kiswahili: Sheshani akamwoza huyu mtumishi wake Yarha binti yake, akamzalia mwana jina lake Atai.
Ekegusii: Sesani akaa Yara, omosomba oye, omoiseke oye akaba mokaye; ere akaibora omomura orenge korokwa Atai.

English: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
Kiswahili: Atai akamzaa Nathani, Nathani akamzaa Zabadi,
Ekegusii: Atai akaibora Nathani, na Nathani akaibora Sabadi,

English: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,
Kiswahili: Zabadi akamzaa Eflali, Eflali akamzaa Obedi,
Ekegusii: Sabadi akaibora Efilali, na Efilali akaibora Obedi;

English: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,
Kiswahili: Obedi akamzaa Yehu, Yehu akamzaa Azaria,
Ekegusii: Obedi akaibora Yehu, na Yehu akaibora Asaria;

English: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,
Kiswahili: Azaria akamzaa Helesi, Helesi akamzaa Eleasa,
Ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Helesi, na Helesi akaibora Eleasa;

English: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,
Kiswahili: Eleasa akamzaa Sismai, Sismai akamzaa Shalumu,
Ekegusii: Eleasa akaibora Sisimai, na Sisimai akaibora Salumu;

English: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
Kiswahili: Shalumu akamzaa Yekamia, naye Yekamia akamzaa Elishama.
Ekegusii: Salumu akaibora Yekamia, na Yekamia akaibora Elisama.

English: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kalebu nduguye Yerameeli walikuwa: Mesha mzaliwa wake wa kwanza alimzaa Zifu, naye mwanawe Maresha akamzaa Hebroni.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kalebu omwabo Yerameeli nabwo aba: Mesha, omwana omomura oye omotangi, oyorenge ise Sifu, oyorenge ise Maresa, na Maresa orenge ise Heburoni.

English: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
Kiswahili: Hebroni alikuwa na wana wanne: Kora, Tapua, Rekemu na Shema.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Kora na Tapua, Rekemu na Sema.

English: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
Kiswahili: Shema alikuwa baba yake Rahamu na Rahamu alikuwa baba wa Yorkeamu na Rekemu alikuwa baba wa Shamai.
Ekegusii: Sema akaibora Rahamu, ise Yorikeamu. Rekemu akaibora Samai.

English: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
Kiswahili: Shamai akamzaa Maoni na Maoni akamzaa Beth-Suri.
Ekegusii: Samai akaibora Maoni, na Maoni akaibora Beti‐Suri.

English: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
Kiswahili: Efa, suria wa Kalebu alikuwa mamaye Harani, Mosa na Gazezi. Harani alikuwa baba wa Gazezi.
Ekegusii: Boigo Efa, omokungu o sere‐sere o Kalebu, akaibora Harani, na Moza, na Gasesi; na Harani boigo nabwate omomura orenge korokwa Gasesi.

English: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yadai walikuwa: Regemu, Yothamu, Geshani, Peleti, Efa na Shaafu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yahadai nabwo aba: Regemu na Yotamu, Gesani na Peleti, Efa na Saafu.

English: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
Kiswahili: Maaka suria wa Kalebu alikuwa mamaye Sheberi na Tirhana.
Ekegusii: Maaka, omokungu o sere‐sere o Kalebu, akaibora Seberi na Tirihana.

English: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
Kiswahili: Pia Maaka akamzaa Shaafu babaye Madmana, na Sheva babaye Makbena na Gibea. Kalebu alikuwa na binti jina lake Aksa.
Ekegusii: Boigo omokungu oria akaibora Saafu, ise Madimana, na Sheva, ise abanto ba Makibena na Abagibea. Omoiseke o Kalebu nigo arenge korokwa Asika.

English: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Kalebu. Wana wa Huri, mzaliwa mkuu wao wa Efrathi, walikuwa: Shobali akamzaa Kiriath-Yearimu,
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Kalebu. Abana abamura ba Huri, omwana omomura omotangi bw’Efarata, nabwo aba; Sobali, ise abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu,

English: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
Kiswahili: Salma akamzaa Bethlehemu, naye Harefu akamzaa Beth-Gaderi.
Ekegusii: na Salima, ise abanto ba Bethlehemu, na Harefu, ise abanto ba Beti‐Gaderi.

English: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Shobali, baba yake Kiriath-Yearimu, walikuwa: Haroe, nusu ya wakazi wa mji wa Menuhothi,
Ekegusii: Sobali, ise abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu, nabwate abana abamura bande: Haroe na ekeng’ese ki’abaanto ba Menuhoti.

English: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
Kiswahili: pamoja na koo za Kiriath-Yearimu ambazo ni: Waithiri, Waputhi, Washumathi na Wamishrai. Kutokana na watu hawa walizaliwa Wasorathi na Waeshtaoli.
Ekegusii: Ne chiamate chia Kiriati‐Yearimu nachio echi: Abaitiri na Abaputi, Abasumati na Abamisira. Korwa ase abanto aba nao Abasori na Abaesitaoli barwete.

English: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Salma walikuwa: Bethlehemu, Wanetofathi, Atroth-Beth-Yoabu, nusu ya Wamanahathi, Wasori,
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Salima nabwo abanto ba Bethlehemu, na Abaanetofa, na abanto b’Ataroti‐Beti‐Yoabu, na ekeng’ese ki’Abamanahati, nabwo Abasori,

English: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
Kiswahili: pamoja na koo za waandishi zilizoishi katika mji wa Yabesi: yaani Watirathi, Washimeathi na Wasukathi. Hawa ndio Wakeni waliotokana na Hamathi, baba wa nyumba ya Rekabu.
Ekegusii: amo ne chiamate chi’abariki baria bamenyete agwo Yabesi, nabwo Abatirati, na Abasimeati, na Abasukati. Aba nabwo Abakeni abarwete ase Hamati, ise abanto b’enyomba ya Rekabu.

English: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Daudi waliozaliwa huko Hebroni: Mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Amnoni ambaye mama yake aliitwa Ahinoamu wa Yezreeli; wa pili, Danieli ambaye mama yake alikuwa Abigaili wa Karmeli;
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura ba Daudi, abwo baiboretwe ekero arenge Heburoni: Amunoni, omomura oye omotangi, oiboretwe n’Ahinoamu orwete Yesireeli, na oyo o kabere Danieli, oiboretwe n’Abigaeli orwete Karimeli;

English: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
Kiswahili: wa tatu alikuwa Absalomu, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Maaka, binti Talmai mfalme wa Geshuri; wa nne, Adoniya, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Hagithi;
Ekegusii: oyo o gatato Abisalomu, oiboretwe na Maaka, mosubati o Talimai, omorwoti o Gesuri; oyo o kane Adonia, oiboretwe na Hagiti;

English: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
Kiswahili: wa tano alikuwa Shefatia ambaye mama yake alikuwa Abitali; wa sita alikuwa Ithreamu, aliyezaliwa na mke wake Egla.
Ekegusii: oyo o gatano Sefatia, oiboretwe n’Abitali, na oyo o gatano na rimo Iteramu, oiboretwe n’Egila moga Daudi.

English: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;
Kiswahili: Hawa sita walizaliwa huko Hebroni ambako Daudi alitawala kwa miaka saba na miezi sita. Daudi alitawala Yerusalemu kwa miaka thelathini na mitatu,
Ekegusii: Abamura aba batano nomo nabwo Daudi aiboreretwe agwo Heburoni, aroro agwo ase agambete ase engaki y’emiaka etano, na ebere (7), na emetienyi etano nomo (6). Daudi akaba okogamba agwo Yerusalemu emiaka emerongo etato, na etato (33).

English: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
Kiswahili: nao hawa ndio watoto wa Daudi waliozaliwa huko Yerusalemu: mkewe Bathsheba, binti Amieli, alimzalia Shamua, Shobabu, Nathani na Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu: Simea na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani. Aba nigo baiboretwe na Beti‐Sua, mosubati bw’Amieli.

English: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
Kiswahili: Pia kulikuwa na wana wengine: Ibihari, Elishua, Elifeleti,
Ekegusii: Daudi nabwate abamura bande, nabwo aba: Ibuhari na Elisama, na Elifeleti;

English: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
Kiswahili: Noga, Nefegi, Yafia,
Ekegusii: Noga na Nefegi, na Yafia;

English: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
Kiswahili: Elishama, Eliada na Elifeleti; wote walikuwa tisa.
Ekegusii: Elisama na Eliada, na Elifeleti; abwo nigo barenge kianda.

English: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote walikuwa wana wa Daudi, mbali na wale wana waliozaliwa na masuria. Naye Tamari alikuwa dada yao.
Ekegusii: Aba bonsi nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Daudi, naende nabwate abamura bande b’abakungu ba sere‐sere. Tamari nere orenge omoiseke omwabo abamura abwo.

English: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Solomoni alikuwa Rehoboamu, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Abiya, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yehoshafati, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Asa,
Ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Sulemani narwo oro: Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya; Abiya akaibora Asa, na Asa akaibora Yehosafati;

English: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
Kiswahili: mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yehoramu, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Ahazia, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yoashi,
Ekegusii: Yehosafati akaibora Yehoramu, na Yehoramu akaibora Ahasia, na Ahasia akaibora Yoashi;

English: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Kiswahili: mwanawe huyo alikuwa Amazia, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Azaria, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yothamu,
Ekegusii: Yoashi akaibora Amasia, na Amasia akaibora Asaria, na Asaria akaibora Yotamu;

English: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
Kiswahili: mwanawe huyo alikuwa Ahazi, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Hezekia, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Manase,
Ekegusii: Yotamu akaibora Ahasi, na Ahasi akaibora Hezekia, na Hezekia akaibora Manase;

English: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
Kiswahili: mwanawe huyo alikuwa Amoni na mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yosia.
Ekegusii: Manase akaibora Amoni, na Amoni akaibora Yosia.

English: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yosia walikuwa: Yohanani mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Yehoyakimu mwanawe wa pili, wa tatu Sedekia, wa nne Shalumu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yosia nabwo aba: Yohanani, omwana oye omotangi na Yehoyakimu, oyo o kabere, na Zedekia, oyo o gatato, na Salumu, oyo o kane.

English: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.
Kiswahili: Walioingia mahali pa Yehoyakimu kama wafalme ni: Yekonia mwanawe, na Sedekia.
Ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yehoyakimu narwo oro: Yehoyakimu akaibora Yekonia, na Yekonia akaibora Zedekia.

English: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Yekonia aliyekuwa mateka: Shealtieli mwanawe,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yekonia, oyo bwosetwe, nabwo aba: Sealitieli,

English: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
Kiswahili: Malkiramu, Pedaya, Shenasari, Yekamia, Hoshama na Nedabia.
Ekegusii: na Malikiramu, Pedaya na Senasari, Yekamia na Hosama, na Nedabia.

English: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
Kiswahili: Wana wa Pedaya walikuwa: Zerubabeli na Shimei. Wana wa Zerubabeli walikuwa: Meshulamu na Hanania. Shelomithi alikuwa dada yao.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Pedaya nabwo Serubabeli na Simei. Abana abamura ba Serubabeli nabwo Mesulamu na Hanania, na Selomiti nere orenge omoiseke omwabo.

English: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.
Kiswahili: Pia walikuwepo wengine watano: Hashuba, Oheli, Berekia, Hasadia na Yushab-Hesedi.
Ekegusii: Abamura bande batano ba Serubabeli nabwo aba: Hasuba na Oheli, Berekia na Hasadia, na Yusabi‐Hesedi.

English: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Hanania walikuwa: Pelatia na Yeshaya, na wana wa Refaya, na wana wa Arnani, na wana wa Obadia, na wana wa Shekania.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hanania nabwo Pelatia na Yesaia, naende abamura ba Refaya, na ab’Arinani, na ab’Obadia, na aba Sekania.

English: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Shekania: Shemaya na wanawe: Hatushi, Igali, Baria, Nearia na Shafati; jumla yao walikuwa sita.
Ekegusii: Omwana o Sekania nere Semaya, na abana baye abamura nabwo aba: Hatusi na Igali, Baria na Nearia, na Safati; bonsi mbatano nomo.

English: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Nearia walikuwa: Elioenai, Hizkia na Azrikamu; jumla yao watatu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nearia nabwo aba: Elionai na Hezekia, na Asirikamu; bonsi mbatato (3).

English: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Elioenai walikuwa: Hodavia, Eliashibu, Pelaya, Akubu, Yohanani, Delaya na Anani; jumla yao wote saba.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elionai nabwo aba: Hodawia na Eliasibu, Pelaya na Akubu, Yohanani na Delaya, na Anani; bonsi mbatano na babere (7).

English: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yuda walikuwa: Peresi, Hesroni, Karmi, Huri na Shobali.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Peresi na Hezironi, Karimi na Huri, na Sobali.

English: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
Kiswahili: Reaya mwana wa Shobali akamzaa Yahathi, Yahathi akawazaa Ahumai na Lahadi. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wasorathi.
Ekegusii: Reaya, mosinto o Sobali, akaibora Yahati, na Yahati akaibora Ahumai na Lahadi. Korwa ase abwo nao Abasora barwete.

English: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Etamu: Yezreeli, Ishma na Idbashi. Dada yao aliitwa Haselelponi.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura b’Etamu: Yesireeli na Isima, na Idibasi, na omoiseke omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Haseleliponi.

English: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
Kiswahili: Penueli akamzaa Gedori, naye Ezeri akamzaa Husha. Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Huri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Efrathi, na baba yake Bethlehemu.
Ekegusii: Penueli nigo arenge ise Abagedori, na Eseri ise Abahusa. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Huri, omwana omotangi o Efarata, ise abanto ba Bethlehemu.

English: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
Kiswahili: Ashuri baba yake Tekoa alikuwa na wake wawili, Hela na Naara.
Ekegusii: Asuri ise abanto ba Tekoa, nabwate abakungu babere, Hela na Naara.

English: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Naara: Ahuzamu, Heferi, Temeni na Haahashtari.
Ekegusii: Naara akamoiborera Ahusamu na Heferi, Temeni na Hahasitari. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Naara.

English: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hela walikuwa: Serethi, Sohari, Ethnani,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hela nabwo aba: Sereti na Isihari, na Etinani.

English: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
Kiswahili: na Kosi ambaye aliwazaa Anubi, Sobeba na jamaa zote za Aharheli mwana wa Harumu.
Ekegusii: Kosi nere orenge ise Anubu na Sobeba, na ise bwe chiamate chi’Aharibeli, mosinto o Harumu.

English: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
Kiswahili: Yabesi aliheshimiwa kuliko ndugu zake. Mama yake alimwita Yabesi, akisema, “Nilimzaa kwa huzuni.”
Ekegusii: Yabesi nigo arenge namasikani amanene kobua abamura bamwabo. Ng’ina akamoroka Yabesi, ekiagera amoiborete ase obororo.

English: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.
Kiswahili: Yabesi akamlilia Mungu wa Israeli akisema, “Ee Mungu, laiti ungenibariki kweli kweli na kuipanua mipaka yangu! Mkono wako na uwe pamoja nami, uniepushe na uovu ili nisidhurike!” Naye Mungu akamjalia hayo aliyoyaomba.
Ekegusii: Yabesi akarangeria Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akabora, “Onye aye ndiria kwarenge gonsesenia naende ogareyie obomenyo bwane, naende okoboko kwao kobe amo nainche, na ondende korwa ase obororo tibobaisa gonkora bobe.” Nyasae akamwanchera aya aganetie.

English: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
Kiswahili: Kelubu, nduguye Shuha, akamzaa Mehiri, naye Mehiri akamzaa Eshtoni.
Ekegusii: Kelubu, omomura omwabo o Suba, nere akaibora Mehiri, oria orenge ise Esitoni.

English: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
Kiswahili: Eshtoni akawazaa Beth-Rafa, Pasea na Tehina. Tehina alikuwa baba wa Iri-Nahashi. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Reka.
Ekegusii: Esitoni akaibora Beti‐Rafa na Pasea, na Tehina, ise abanto b’omochie o Nahasi. Aba nabaanto bamenyete Reka.

English: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kenazi walikuwa: Othnieli na Seraya. Wana wa Othnieli walikuwa: Hathathi na Meonathai.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kenasi nabwo Otinieli na Seraya; na abamura b’Otinieli nabwo Hatati na Meonotai.

English: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.
Kiswahili: Meonathai akamzaa Ofra. Seraya akamzaa Yoabu, baba wa Ge-Harashimu. Liliitwa hivyo kwa sababu watu walioishi humo walikuwa mafundi.
Ekegusii: Meonotai akaibora Ofura. Seraya akaibora Yoabu ise Abageharasimu. Barabwo nigo barogetwe igo, ekiagera barenge abaroisia ebinto.

English: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
Kiswahili: Kalebu mwana wa Yefune alikuwa na wana watatu: Iru, Ela na Naamu. Naye mwana wa Ela alikuwa: Kenazi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, nabwo aba: Iru na Ela, na Naamu; na omwana omomura bw’Ela nere Kenasi.

English: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yahaleleli walikuwa: Zifu, Zifa, Tiria na Asareli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yehaleleli nabwo aba: Sifu na Zifa, Tiria na Asareli.

English: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Ezra walikuwa: Yetheri, Meredi, Eferi na Yaloni. Mmojawapo wa wake zake Meredi aliwazaa: Miriamu, Shamai na Ishba aliyekuwa baba yake Eshtemoa.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Ezara nabwo aba: Yeteri na Meredi, Eferi na Yaloni. Aba nabwo abana ba Bitia, mosubati o Farao, oria Meredi anyuomete: Omoiseke oye nigo are korokwa Miriamu, na abamura nabwo Samai na Isiba, ise abanto b’Esitemoa.

English: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
Kiswahili: Meredi alikuwa na mke mwingine Myahudi ambaye aliwazaa: Yeredi baba wa Gedori, Heberi baba wa Soko na Yekuthieli baba wa Zanoa. Hawa walikuwa watoto wa Bithia binti Farao, ambaye Meredi alikuwa amemwoa.
Ekegusii: Meredi nabwate naende omokungu Omoyuda; nere akaibora Yeredi, ise abanto ba Gedori, na Heberi, ise abanto ba Soko, na Yekutieli, ise abanto ba Sanoa.

English: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
Kiswahili: Wana wa mke wa Hodia aliyekuwa dada yake Nahamu walikuwa: baba yake Keila, Mgarmi na Eshtemoa, Mmaakathi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hodia, mosubati omwabo Nahamu, nigo barenge babere, oyomo nigo arenge ise Keila Omogarimi, na oyo o kabere n’Esitemoa bw’Abamaaka.

English: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shimoni walikuwa: Amnoni, Rina, Ben-Hanani na Tiloni. Wazao wa Ishi walikuwa: Zohethi na Ben-Zohethi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Shimoni nabwo aba: Amunoni na Rina, Beni‐Hanani na Tiloni. Abana abamura ba Ishi nabwo Soheti na Beni‐Soheti.

English: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shela, mwana wa Yuda, walikuwa: Eri baba yake Leka, Laada baba yake Maresha na jamaa za wafumaji nguo za kitani safi waliokuwa wakiishi huko Beth-Ashbea,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sela, mosinto o Yuda, nabwo aba: Eri, ise abanto ba Leka, na Laada, ise abanto ba Maresa, na aba echiamate chi’abaroisia ebitambaa bi’egatani agwo Beti‐Asibea;

English: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
Kiswahili: Yokimu, watu walioishi Kozeba, Yoashi na Sarafi waliotawala huko Moabu na Yashubi-Lehemu. (Taarifa hizi ni za zamani sana.)
Ekegusii: naende Yokimu na abanto ba Koseba, Yoashi na Sarafu, abwo barenge kogambera Abamoabu, naende Yasubi‐Lehemu. (Korende amang’ana aya namakoro.)

English: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wafinyanzi walioishi Netaimu na Gedera; waliishi huko wakimtumikia mfalme.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abaroisia chinyongo na ababiare ba Netaimu na Gedera; aba nigo bamenyete amo nomorwoti, bakaba bakomokorera emeremo.

English: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Simeoni walikuwa: Nemueli, Yamini, Yaribu, Zera na Shauli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Nemweli na Yamini, Yaribu na Zera, na Saulo.

English: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Shauli alikuwa Shalumu, Shalumu akamzaa Mibsamu, na Mibsamu akamzaa Mishma.
Ekegusii: Saulo akaibora Salumu, na Salumu akaibora Mibusamu, na Mibusamu akaibora Misima.

English: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Mishma walikuwa: Hamueli aliyemzaa Zakuri, Zakuri akamzaa Shimei.
Ekegusii: Misima akaibora Hamueli, na Hamueli akaibora Sakuri, na Sakuri akaibora Simei.

English: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.
Kiswahili: Shimei alikuwa na wana kumi na sita, na binti sita, lakini ndugu zake hawakuwa na watoto wengi, hivyo ukoo wao wote haukuwa na watu wengi kama ukoo wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Simei nigo abwate abana abamura ikomi na batano nomo (16), na abaiseke batano nomo (6); korende abamura bamwabo tibabwate abana abange, gose chiamate chiabo chionsi tichiamentekanete buna echia Yuda.

English: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
Kiswahili: Waliishi Beer-Sheba, Molada, Hasar-Shuali,
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bamenyete agwo Beeri‐Seba, na Molada, na Hasari‐Suali;

English: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
Kiswahili: Bilha, Esemu, Toladi,
Ekegusii: Bilaha, na Esemu, na Toladi;

English: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
Kiswahili: Bethueli, Horma, Siklagi,
Ekegusii: Betueli, na Horima, na Sikilagi;

English: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
Kiswahili: Beth-Markabothi, Hasar-Susimu, Beth-Biri na Shaaraimu. Hii ilikuwa miji yao mpaka wakati wa utawala wa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Beti‐Marikaboti, na Hasari‐Susimu, na Beti‐Biri, na Saaraimu. Eye nero yarenge emechie yabo goika ekero Daudi abeete omorwoti.

English: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
Kiswahili: Vijiji vilivyoizunguka vilikuwa Etamu, Aini, Rimoni, Tokeni na Ashani; jumla miji mitano:
Ekegusii: Na emechie yabo emeke nigo yarenge Etamu na Aini, Rimoni na Tokeni, na Asani; yonsi netano.

English: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.
Kiswahili: pamoja na vijiji vyote kuizunguka hii miji hadi huko Baali. Haya yalikuwa makao yao, nao waliweka kumbukumbu ya ukoo wao.
Ekegusii: Boigo mbabwate ebichie biabo biaetanaine emechie eyio goikeera Baali. Obo nabwo bwarenge obomenyo bwabo. Barabwo bakarika omooroberio bwe chinderia chiabo.

English: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
Kiswahili: Meshobabu, Yamleki, Yosha mwana wa Amazia,
Ekegusii: Mesobabu, na Yamuleki, na Yosha, mosinto bw’Amasia.

English: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
Kiswahili: Yoeli, Yehu mwana wa Yoshibia, mwana wa Seraya, mwana wa Asieli.
Ekegusii: Yoel, na Yehu, mosinto o Yosibia o Seraya bw’Asieli.

English: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
Kiswahili: Pia Elioenai, Yaakoba, Yeshohaya, Asaya, Adieli, Yesimieli, Benaya,
Ekegusii: Elioenai na Yaakoba, Yesohaya na Asaia, Adieli na Yesimieli, na Benaya.

English: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
Kiswahili: Ziza mwana wa Shifi, mwana wa Aloni, mwana wa Yedaya, mwana wa Shimri, mwana wa Shemaya.
Ekegusii: Sisa, mosinto o Sifi bw’Aloni, o Yedaya, o Simuri, o Semaya.

English: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
Kiswahili: Watu hawa walioorodheshwa hapa juu kwa majina walikuwa viongozi wa koo zao. Jamaa zao ziliongezeka sana,
Ekegusii: Aba iga batoire ase amarieta abo nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo. Chiamate echi chikamentekana mono.

English: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
Kiswahili: wakaenea mpaka kwenye viunga vya Gedori kuelekea mashariki mwa bonde wakitafuta malisho kwa ajili ya mifugo yao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio barabwo bakang’anya gochia ase omochie o Gedori, ensemo ya moocha ye rikura, korigia oborisia ase chitugo chiabo.

English: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.
Kiswahili: Huko walipata malisho mengi mazuri, nayo nchi ilikuwa na nafasi kubwa, yenye amani na utulivu. Baadhi ya Wahamu waliishi huko zamani.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo ase banyorete oborisia obuya na obonoru, ense nigo yarenge engare, na entoereru, na ey’omorembe. Abanto bamenyete agwo ritang’ani nigo barenge abanto ba Hamu.

English: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
Kiswahili: Watu walioorodheshwa majina walikuja katika nchi hiyo wakati wa Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda. Akawashambulia Wahamu katika makao yao pamoja na Wameuni ambao walikuwako huko nao wakawaangamiza kabisa, kama ilivyo dhahiri hadi leo. Kisha wakafanya makazi yao huko kwa sababu kulikuwa na malisho mazuri kwa ajili ya mifugo yao.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba batoire ase amarieta abo bagacha ekero Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, arenge kogamba. Barabwo bagasaria chiema chi’abaanto b’aroro na bagasiria Abameuni, abanto banyorekanete aroro; bakabasiria kegima na tibaiyo nonya goika reero iga. Erio bakamenya agwo ribaga riabo, ekiagera oborisia mbwarengeo ase chitugo chiabo.

English: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
Kiswahili: Watu wa kabila la wa Simeoni wapatao mia tano, wakiongozwa na Pelatia, Nearia, Refaya na Uzieli wana wa Ishi, wakavamia nchi ya vilima ya Seiri.
Ekegusii: Na abanto amagana atano (500) b’egesaku gia Simioni, bakagenda goika egetunwa gia Edomu, bakaba nabaraai babo: Pelatia na Nearia, Refaya na Usieli, basinto ba Ishi.

English: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.
Kiswahili: Wakawaua Waamaleki waliobaki, waliokuwa wamenusurika, nao wanaishi huko hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagasiria abanto abatigari b’Abaameleki, naende bakamenya aroro, nao bare goika reero iga.

English: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Israeli (yeye alikuwa mzaliwa wa kwanza, lakini kwa kuwa alikinajisi kitanda cha baba yake, haki zake za mzaliwa wa kwanza walipewa wana wa Yosefu mwana wa Israeli. Hivyo hakuorodheshwa kwenye orodha ya ukoo wao kulingana na haki yake ya kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Rubeni oyio orenge omwana omomura omotangi o Israeli. (Korende ekiagera naraarete na moga ise, omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi okaegwa abana abamura ba Yusufu, mosinto o Israeli. Korende Yusufu tarikiri ase omooroberio bw’okonyora omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.

English: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—
Kiswahili: Na ingawa Yuda alikuwa na nguvu zaidi ya ndugu zake wote, na mtawala alitoka kwake, haki za mzaliwa wa kwanza zilikuwa za Yosefu.)
Ekegusii: Nonya Yuda obete ne chinguru ase egati y’abamura bamwabo, na korwa asare nao omogambi arwete, omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi nigo obete oyo o Yusufu.)

English: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Israeli walikuwa: Hanoki, Palu, Hesroni na Karmi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Rubeni, omwana omotangi o Israeli, nabwo aba: Hanoki na Palu, Hezironi na Karimi.

English: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Yoeli walikuwa: Shemaya mwanawe, Gogu mwanawe; Shimei mwanawe,
Ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yoel narwo oro: Yoel akaibora Semaya, na Semaya akaibora Gogi, na Gogi akaibora Simei.

English: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
Kiswahili: Mika mwanawe, Reaya mwanawe, Baali mwanawe,
Ekegusii: Simei akaibora Mika, na Mika akaibora Reaya, na Reaya akaibora Baali.

English: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.
Kiswahili: na Beera mwanawe, ambaye Tiglath-Pileseri mfalme wa Ashuru alimchukua kwenda uhamishoni. Beera alikuwa kiongozi wa Wareubeni.
Ekegusii: Baali akaibora Beera oria Tiligati‐Pileseri omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, aosete, akamoira ase obosomba. Beera orenge omoteneneri bw’abaanto ba Rubeni.

English: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
Kiswahili: Jamaa zao kulingana na koo zao, walioorodheshwa kwa kufuata koo zao kama ifuatavyo: Yeieli aliyekuwa mkuu wao, Zekaria,
Ekegusii: Na abamwabo ase chiamate chiabo buna barigetwe ase omooroberio bwe chinderia chi’ebiare biabo nabwo aba: Yeieli, nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Zakaria,

English: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
Kiswahili: Bela mwana wa Azazi, mwana wa Shema, mwana wa Yoeli. Hao waliishi katika eneo kuanzia Aroeri mpaka Nebo na Baal-Meoni.
Ekegusii: na Bela, mosinto bw’Asasi o Sema, o Yoel, Barabwo nigo bamenyete agwo Aroeri goikera orobebe rwa Nebo na Baali‐Meoni.

English: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande wa mashariki walienea hadi pembeni mwa jangwa linaloenea mpaka kwenye Mto Frati, kwa sababu mifugo yao ilikuwa imeongezeka huko Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Ensemo ya moocha bakamenya goikera egesoero ki’erooro egoikera orooche rw’Eufarati, ekiagera amaicho abo nigo abuchete mono ase ense ya Gileadi.

English: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Sauli, walipigana vita dhidi ya Wahagari, wakaanguka kwa mikono yao, kisha wakaishi katika mahema ya Wahagari katika eneo lote la mashariki ya Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Saulo arenge kogamba bakarwana esegi n’Abahagari, bakabaita, na barabwo bakamenya ase chiema chiabo agwo ase ense yonsi moocha ya Gileadi.

English: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
Kiswahili: Wagadi waliishi jirani nao katika nchi ya Bashani, mpaka Saleka.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Gadi bakamenya sugusu y’abanto b’orwa Rubeni agwo ase ense ya Basani, bagaikera omochie o Saleka.

English: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
Kiswahili: Yoeli ndiye alikuwa mkuu wao, Shafamu wa pili, na wakafuata Yanai na Shafati, huko Bashani.
Ekegusii: Yoel nere orenge omonene, na Safamu oyo o kabere, naende Yanai na Safati bakaba agwo Basani.

English: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zao kulingana na koo zao walikuwa saba: Mikaeli, Meshulamu, Sheba, Yorai, Yakani, Zia na Eberi.
Ekegusii: Na abamwabo be chiamate chiabo nabwo aba: Mikaeli na Mesulamu, Seba na Yorai, Yakani na Sia, na Eberi, bonsi mbatano na babere.

English: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa ndio wana wa Abihaili mwana wa Huri, mwana wa Yaroa, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Mikaeli, mwana wa Yeshishai, mwana wa Yahdo, mwana wa Buzi.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge basinto b’Abihaili, mosinto o Huri o Yaroa, o Gileadi, o Mikaeli, o Yesisai, o Yado, o Busi.

English: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
Kiswahili: Ahi mwana wa Abdieli, mwana wa Guni, alikuwa ndiye kiongozi wa jamaa yao.
Ekegusii: Ahi, mosinto bw’Abidieli, o Guni, nere orenge omoteneneri bwe chiamate chiabo.

English: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.
Kiswahili: Wagadi waliishi Gileadi, huko Bashani pamoja na vijiji vilivyoizunguka, pia katika nchi yote ya malisho ya Sharoni kote walikoenea.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi bakamenya agwo Gileadi na Basani, na ase emechie y’aroro na ase oborisia bwonsi bwa Saroni goikera chinsinyo chiaye.

English: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
Kiswahili: Yote haya yaliwekwa katika kumbukumbu za ukoo wao wakati wa utawala wa Yothamu, mfalme wa Yuda na Yeroboamu mfalme wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo baabaretwe na korikwa ekero omobaro bwe chinderia chiabo okoretwe ase amatuko ’okogamba kwa Yotamu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na aya okwa Yeroboamu, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.

English: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.
Kiswahili: Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa na watu mashujaa 44,760 waliokuwa wameandaliwa kwa ajili ya vita: watu wenye nguvu, hodari wa kutumia ngao na upanga, mashujaa wa kutumia upinde, waliokuwa tayari kwa ajili ya kazi hiyo.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Rubeni, na Abagadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, nigo babwate abanto chituoni barenge kobogoria chinguba na emioro, naende nigo bamanyete korasa nemegwe abanto abang’aini ase esegi. Abwo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na inye, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (44,760), nigo barenge bebegete ang’e korwana esegi.

English: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
Kiswahili: Walipigana vita dhidi ya Wahagari, Yeturi, Nafishi na Nodabu.
Ekegusii: Bakaba bakorwana esegi n’Abahagari abarwete ase Yeturi na Nafisi, na Nodabu.

English: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.
Kiswahili: Walisaidiwa katika kupigana nao, Mungu akawatia Wahagari pamoja na wote walioungana nao mikononi mwao, kwa sababu walimlilia Mungu wakati wa vita. Alijibu maombi yao, kwa sababu walimtegemea.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera bamwegenete Nyasae bakarera ase okonyora ogokonywa, na Nyasae akaigwa ogosaba kwabo, na barabwo bakabua Abahagari na abanto bonsi barenge amo nabarabwo.

English: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.
Kiswahili: Walitwaa mifugo ya Wahagari: ngamia 50,000, kondoo 250,000, punda 2,000. Pia wakateka watu 100,000,
Ekegusii: Bagasakora chitugo chiabo: Chingamia chilifu emerongo etano (50,000), ne ching’ondi chilifu amagana abere na emerongo etano (250,000) ne chitigere chilifu ibere (2,000). Naende bagoosa abanto chilifu rigana erimo (100,000),

English: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.
Kiswahili: na wengine wengi waliuawa kwa sababu vita vilikuwa ni vya Mungu. Nao waliendelea kuikalia nchi hiyo mpaka wakati wa uhamisho.
Ekegusii: na bagaita abanto abange, ekiagera esegi yarenge eya Nyasae. Erio bakamenya aase abo goika engaki y’okong’anyigwa.

English: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
Kiswahili: Idadi ya nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa wengi sana, Wakakaa kuanzia Bashani hadi Baal-Hermoni, yaani mpaka Seniri na mlima Hermoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakamenya ense eria; bakamentekana mono, bakamenya korwa orobebe rwa Basani goika Baali‐Herimoni, na Seniri, na egetunwa kia Herimoni.

English: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za kabila hilo: Eferi, Ishi, Elieli, Azrieli, Yeremia, Hodavia na Yahdieli. Walikuwa askari shujaa watu maarufu, viongozi wa jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo: Eferi na Ishi, Elieli na Asirieli, Yeremia na Hodawia, na Yadieli. Abwo nabaanto chituoni bachiete nkuma ase okorwana esegi.

English: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakuwa waaminifu kwa Mungu wa baba zao, nao wakafanya ukahaba kwa miungu ya mataifa, ambayo Mungu alikuwa ameyaangamiza mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ebisaku bia moocha bagakora ogosaria ase Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, bagakora obotayayi, bakabwatia chinyasae chi’abaanto b’ense eria, abwo Nyasae asiretie korwa ase bare.

English: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu wa Israeli akaiamsha roho ya Pulu, mfalme wa Ashuru (ambaye pia alijulikana kama Tiglath-Pileseri), ambaye aliwachukua Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase kwenda uhamishoni. Akawapeleka huko Hala, Habori, Hara na mto Gozani, ambako wamekaa mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli agaseegeta omoika o Puli, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri (nere Tiligati‐Pileseri), na Puli oyio akaira abanto b’ororeria rwa Rubeni, na ab’orwa Gadi, na ekeng’ese ki ’egesaku kia Manase goika Hala na Habori, na Hara, na goika ase orooche rwa Goseni; nao bare goika reero iga.

English: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Lawi walikuwa: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.

English: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, Heburoni na Usieli.

English: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Amramu alikuwa na wana: Aroni, Mose, na Miriamu. Aroni alikuwa na wana: Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Abana b’Amuramu nabwo aba: Aroni na Musa, na Miriamu omoiseke. Abana abamura ba Aroni nabwo aba: Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Itamari.

English: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
Kiswahili: Eleazari akamzaa Finehasi, Finehasi akamzaa Abishua,
Ekegusii: Eleazari akaibora Finehasi, na Finehasi akaibora Abisua;

English: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.
Kiswahili: Abishua akamzaa Buki, Buki akamzaa Uzi,
Ekegusii: Abisua akaibora Buki, na Buki akaibora Usi;

English: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.
Kiswahili: Uzi akamzaa Zerahia, Zerahia akamzaa Merayothi,
Ekegusii: Usi akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Merayoti;

English: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
Kiswahili: Merayothi akamzaa Amaria, Amaria akamzaa Ahitubu,
Ekegusii: Merayoti akaibora Amaria, na Amaria akaibora Ahitubu;

English: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.
Kiswahili: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Ahimaasi,
Ekegusii: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Ahimasi;

English: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.
Kiswahili: Ahimaasi akamzaa Azaria, Azaria akamzaa Yohanani,
Ekegusii: Ahimasi akaibora Asaria, na Asaria akaibora Yohanani;

English: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Yohanani akamzaa Azaria (ndiye alifanya kazi ya ukuhani katika Hekalu alilojenga Mfalme Solomoni huko Yerusalemu),
Ekegusii: Yohanani akaibora Asaria (oyo nere orenge Omokuani ase enyomba eria Sulemani aagachete agwo Yerusalemu);

English: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
Kiswahili: Azaria akamzaa Amaria, Amaria akamzaa Ahitubu,
Ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Amaria, na Amaria akaibora Ahitubu;

English: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.
Kiswahili: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Shalumu,
Ekegusii: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Salumu;

English: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.
Kiswahili: Shalumu akamzaa Hilkia, Hilkia akamzaa Azaria,
Ekegusii: Salumu akaibora Hilikia, na Hilikia akaibora Asaria;

English: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.
Kiswahili: Azaria akamzaa Seraya, Seraya akamzaa Yehosadaki.
Ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Yehosadaki.

English: Jehozadak went into captivity when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
Kiswahili: Yehosadaki alihamishwa wakati Bwana aliwapeleka uhamishoni watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu kwa mkono wa Mfalme Nebukadneza.
Ekegusii: Yehosadaki agooswa akairwa ense eng’ao, ekero Omonene aruete Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bagooswa, bakairwa na Nebukadinesaro.

English: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Lawi walikuwa: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisomu na Kohati, na Merari.

English: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Gershoni: Libni na Shimei.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana abamura ba Gerisomu: Libini na Simei.

English: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.

English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Merari walikuwa: Mahli na Mushi. Zifuatazo ni koo za Walawi zilizoorodheshwa kufuatana na baba zao:
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Echi nechiamate chi’abaanto ba Lawi, chiatoire ase abaise.

English: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Gershoni: Gershoni akamzaa Libni, Libni akamzaa Yahathi, Yahathi akamzaa Zima,
Ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Gerisomu: Libini omomura oye, na Yahati omomura oye, na Sima omomura oye,

English: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
Kiswahili: Zima akamzaa Yoa, Yoa akamzaa Ido, Ido akamzaa Zera, Zera akamzaa Yeatherai.
Ekegusii: na Yoa omomura oye, na Ido omomura oye, na Zera omomura oye, na Yeateri omomura oye.

English: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Kohathi: Kohathi akamzaa Aminadabu, Aminadabu akamzaa Kora, Kora akamzaa Asiri,
Ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Kohati: Aminadabu omomura oye, na Kora omomura oye, na Asiri omomura oye,

English: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
Kiswahili: Asiri akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Ebiasafu, Ebiasafu akamzaa Asiri,
Ekegusii: na Elikana omomura oye, na Ebiasafu omomura oye, na Asiri omomura oye,

English: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
Kiswahili: Asiri akamzaa Tahathi, Tahathi akamzaa Urieli, Urieli akamzaa Uzia, Uzia akamzaa Shauli.
Ekegusii: na Tahati omomura oye, na Urieli omomura oye, na Usia omomura oye, na Saulo omomura oye.

English: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Elikana walikuwa: Amasai na Ahimothi,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elikana nabwo Amasi na Ahimoti.

English: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
Kiswahili: Ahimothi akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Sofai, Sofai akamzaa Nahathi,
Ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Ahimoti: Elikana omomura oye, na Sofai omomura oye, na Nahati omomura oye,

English: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
Kiswahili: Nahathi akamzaa Eliabu, Eliabu akamzaa Yerohamu, Yerohamu akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Samweli.
Ekegusii: na Eliabu omomura oye, na Yerohamu omomura oye, na Elikana omomura oye.

English: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Samweli walikuwa: Yoeli mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, na Abiya mwanawe wa pili.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Samweli nabwo Yoel, omwana oye omotangi, na Abiya, oyo o kabere.

English: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
Kiswahili: Wafuatao ndio wazao wa Merari: Merari akamzaa Mahli, Mahli akamzaa Libni, Libni akamzaa Shimei, Shimei akamzaa Uza,
Ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Merari: Mali omomura oye, na Libini omomura oye, na Simei omomura oye, na Usa omomura oye,

English: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
Kiswahili: Uza akamzaa Shimea, Shimea akamzaa Hagia, Hagia akamzaa Asaya.
Ekegusii: na Simea omomura oye, na Hagia omomura oye, na Asaia omomura oye.

English: These are they whom David set over the service of song in Yahweh’s house after the ark came to rest there.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio watu ambao Daudi aliwaweka kuwa viongozi wa uimbaji katika nyumba ya Bwana, baada ya Sanduku la Agano kuletwa ili kukaa huko.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto Daudi abegete bakaba abateneneri b’amatera ase enyomba y’Omonene, ekero Esanduki eria yarenge nokobwatana kw’Omonene konya yabekirwe aroro.

English: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.
Kiswahili: Walihudumu kwa kuimba mbele ya Maskani, Hema la Kukutania, mpaka hapo Mfalme Solomoni alipojenga Hekalu la Bwana huko Yerusalemu. Walitimiza wajibu wao kulingana na taratibu walizokuwa wamewekewa.
Ekegusii: Nigo barenge gokora obokoreri bwabo bw’amatera agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano goika engaki eria Sulemani aagachete enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu; barabwo bagakora emeremo yabo ase omooroberio ochikiire.

English: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
Kiswahili: Wafuatao ni watu waliohudumu pamoja na wana wao: Kutoka ukoo wa Kohathi walikuwa: Hemani, mpiga kinanda, alikuwa mwana wa Yoeli, mwana wa Samweli,
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bakorete emeremo amo nororeria rwabo. Korwa ase ororeria rwa Kohati: Hemani, omonene bw’abateri, mosinto o Yoel o Samweli,

English: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Elikana, mwana wa Yerohamu, mwana wa Elieli, mwana wa Toa,
Ekegusii: bw’Elikana, o Yerohamu, bw’Elieli, o Toa,

English: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Sufu, mwana wa Elikana, mwana wa Mahathi, mwana wa Amasai,
Ekegusii: o Sufu, bw’Elikana, o Mahati, bw’Amasai,

English: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Elikana, mwana wa Yoeli, mwana wa Azaria, mwana wa Sefania,
Ekegusii: bw’Elikana, o Yoel, bw’Asaria, o Zefania,

English: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Tahathi, mwana wa Asiri, mwana wa Ebiasafu, mwana wa Kora,
Ekegusii: o Tahati, bw’Asiri, bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora,

English: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
Kiswahili: mwana wa Ishari, mwana wa Kohathi, mwana wa Lawi, mwana wa Israeli;
Ekegusii: o Isari, o Kohati, o Lawi, o Israeli.

English: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
Kiswahili: na msaidizi wa Hemani alikuwa Asafu, aliyesimama mkono wa kuume: Asafu mwana wa Berekia, mwana wa Shimea,
Ekegusii: Oyo o kabere nere Asafu, oyo bw’eamate ya Hemani. Ere nigo arenge gotenena ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio. Asafu nigo arenge mosinto o Berekia, o Simea,

English: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Mikaeli, mwana wa Baaseya, mwana wa Malkiya,
Ekegusii: o Mikaeli, o Baseya, o Malikia,

English: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Ethni, mwana wa Zera, mwana wa Adaya,
Ekegusii: bw’Etini, o Zera, bw’Adaya,

English: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Ethani, mwana wa Zima, mwana wa Shimei,
Ekegusii: bw’Etani, o Sima, o Simei,

English: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
Kiswahili: mwana wa Yahathi, mwana wa Gershoni, mwana wa Lawi.
Ekegusii: o Yahati, o Gerisomu, o Lawi.

English: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
Kiswahili: Na kutoka kwa walioshirikiana nao, Wamerari, mkono wake wa kushoto: Ethani mwana wa Kishi, mwana wa Abdi, mwana wa Maluki,
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee mbarengeo abamwabo b’ororeria rwa Merari: Etani, mosinto o Kisi bw’Abidi, o Maluku,

English: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Hashabia, mwana wa Amazia, mwana wa Hilkia,
Ekegusii: o Hasabia, bw’Amasia, o Hilikia,

English: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
Kiswahili: mwana wa Amsi, mwana wa Bani, mwana wa Shemeri,
Ekegusii: bw’Amusi, o Bani, o Semeri,

English: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
Kiswahili: mwana wa Mahli, mwana wa Mushi, mwana wa Merari, mwana wa Lawi.
Ekegusii: o Mali, o Musi, o Merari, o Lawi.

English: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zao wengine Walawi walipewa huduma nyingine za kuhudumia hema takatifu, nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abalawi bamwabo bagachorwa gokora emeremo yonsi y’Eema nero enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
Kiswahili: Lakini Aroni na uzao wake ndio waliokuwa na wajibu wa kutoa sadaka katika madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kwenye madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba pamoja na yote yaliyofanyika pa Patakatifu, wakifanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya Israeli, sawasawa na yale yote aliyoagiza Mose mtumishi wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Aroni amo nabamura b’ororeria rwaye bakaba bakorua ebing’wanso agwo ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na gosambera ubani ase egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ubani. Bagakora emeremo yonsi ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono, naende bagakora ayaganetigwe ase okobwatania Abaisraeli na Nyasae, koreng’ana namang’ana onsi Musa, omosomba o Nyasae, achigete.

English: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Aroni: Aroni akamzaa Eleazari, Eleazari akamzaa Finehasi, Finehasi akamzaa Abishua,
Ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Aroni: Eleazari omomura oye, na Finehasi omomura oye, na Abisua omomura oye,

English: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
Kiswahili: Abishua akamzaa Buki, Buki akamzaa Uzi, Uzi akamzaa Zerahia,
Ekegusii: na Buku omomura oye, na Usi omomura oye, na Seraya omomura oye,

English: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Kiswahili: Zerahia akamzaa Merayothi, Merayothi akamzaa Amaria, Amaria akamzaa Ahitubu,
Ekegusii: na Merayoti omomura oye, na Amaria omomura oye, na Ahitubu omomura oye,

English: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
Kiswahili: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Ahimaasi.
Ekegusii: na Zadoki omomura oye, na Ahimasi omomura oye.

English: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
Kiswahili: Zifuatazo ni sehemu walizopewa ziwe nchi yao kwa ajili ya makazi yao (walipewa wazao wa Aroni waliotoka katika ukoo wa Wakohathi, kwa sababu kura ya kwanza iliwaangukia):
Ekegusii: Echi nachio chinsemo abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni b’eamate ya Kohati bamenyete ase chingongo chiabo. Obomera bw’eritang’ani bokabagwera;

English: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;
Kiswahili: Walipewa Hebroni katika nchi ya Yuda pamoja na sehemu ya malisho inayouzunguka.
Ekegusii: ase igo bakaegwa Heburoni amo namarisio aetanaineo, agwo ase ense ya Yuda.

English: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Kiswahili: Lakini mashamba pamoja na vijiji vilivyouzunguka mji alipewa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune.
Ekegusii: Korende emegondo y’omochie amo nebichie bi’omochie oyio bakaa Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune.

English: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wazao wa Aroni walipewa miji ifuatayo pamoja na eneo la malisho: Hebroni (mji wa makimbilio), Libna, Yatiri, Eshtemoa,
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni bakaegwa emechie eye: Heburoni, omochie bw’obotamero, na Libuna, amo namarisio aetanaineo, Yatiri na Esitemoa amo namarisio aetanaineo,

English: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Hileni, Debiri,
Ekegusii: Hileni na Debiri amo namarisio aetanaineo;

English: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;
Kiswahili: Ashani, Yuta na Beth-Shemeshi pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: Asani na Beti‐Semesi amo namarisio aetanaineo.

English: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Benyamini walipewa Gibeoni, Geba, Alemethi na Anathothi, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho. Miji hii kumi na mitatu iligawanywa miongoni mwa koo za Wakohathi.
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini bakaegwa Geba na Alemeti, na Anatoti, emechie eyio yonsi amo namarisio aetanaineo. Emechie yabo yonsi ase chiamate chiabo nigo yarenge ikomi na etato.

English: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
Kiswahili: Wazao waliobaki wa Wakohathi walipewa miji kumi kutoka koo za nusu ya kabila la Manase.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Kohati abatigarete bakaegwa emechie ikomi ase ogoakerwa obomera, bakayeegwa korwa ase eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase.

English: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Gershoni, ukoo kwa ukoo, walipewa miji kumi na mitatu kutoka kwa makabila ya Isakari, Asheri na Naftali kutoka sehemu ya kabila la Manase huko Bashani.
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisomu bakaegwa emechie ikomi na etato (13) agwo Basani korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bia Isakaru, na Aseri, na Nafutali, na Manase agwo Basani.

English: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Merari, ukoo kwa ukoo walipewa miji kumi na miwili kutoka makabila ya Reubeni, Gadi na Zabuloni.
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abamerari bakaegwa emechie ikomi na ebere (12) korwa ase ebisaku bia Rubeni, na Gadi, na Sabuloni.

English: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli waliwapa Walawi miji hii pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Abaisraeli baete Abalawi emechie amo namarisio aetanaineo.

English: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
Kiswahili: Kutoka makabila ya Yuda, Simeoni na Benyamini walipewa miji iliyotajwa hapo juu.
Ekegusii: Emechie eyio yatoire bakabayea korwa ase ebisaku bia Yuda, na Simioni, na Benjamini ase okoyeakera obomera.

English: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya koo za Wakohathi walipewa kama nchi yao miji kutoka kabila la Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Na abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati bakaegwa emechie korwa ase orogongo rw’egesaku gi’Efraimu.

English: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu walipewa Shekemu (mji wa makimbilio) na Gezeri,
Ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie bw’obotamero ase ense y’Efraimu na Geseri,

English: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Yokmeamu, Beth-Horoni,
Ekegusii: Yokimeamu na Beti‐Horoni,

English: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;
Kiswahili: Aiyaloni na Gath-Rimoni, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: Ayaloni na Gati‐Rimoni, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
Kiswahili: Kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase, Waisraeli waliwapa koo za Wakohathi waliobaki miji ya Aneri na Bileamu pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Abakohati abatigarete bakaegwa Aneri na Bileamu amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;
Kiswahili: Wagershoni walipokea miji ifuatayo pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho: Katika nusu ya kabila la Manase: walipewa Golani katika Bashani na pia Ashtarothi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Abagerisomu bakaegwa Golani agwo Basani, na Asitaroti, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Isakari walipokea Kedeshi, Daberathi,
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kedesi na Daberati,

English: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;
Kiswahili: Ramothi na Anemu, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: na Ramoti, na Anemu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Asheri walipokea Mashali, Abdoni,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri bakaegwa Masali na Abidoni,

English: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;
Kiswahili: Hukoki na Rehobu, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: na Hukoki na Rebobu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Naftali walipokea Kedeshi katika Galilaya, Hamoni na Kiriathaimu pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi agwo Galili, na Hamoni, na Kiriataimu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;
Kiswahili: Wamerari (Walawi waliobakia) walipokea miji ifuatayo: kutoka kabila la Zabuloni walipokea Yokneamu, Karta, Rimoni na Tabori pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: Abamerari abatigarete bakaegwa korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni: Rimoni na Tabori amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Kutoka kabila la Reubeni, ngʼambo ya Yordani mashariki mwa Yeriko walipokea Bezeri ulioko jangwani, Yahasa,
Ekegusii: Na ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ensemo ya moocha ya Yeriko, bakaegwa korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni: Beseri agwo aase ateremu, na Yahasi,

English: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;
Kiswahili: Kedemothi na Mefaathi pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: na Kedemoti, na Mefati, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
Kiswahili: Na kutoka kabila la Gadi walipokea Ramothi huko Gileadi, Mahanaimu,
Ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti agwo Gileadi, na Mahanaimu,

English: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.
Kiswahili: Heshboni na Yazeri, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
Ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na Yaeseri amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

English: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Isakari walikuwa: Tola, Pua, Yashubu na Shimroni; wote ni wanne.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Isakaru nabwo aba: Tola, na Pua, na Yasubu, na Simuroni, bonsi mbaane.

English: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Tola walikuwa: Uzi, Refaya, Yerieli, Yahmai, Ibsamu na Shemueli waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao. Wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Daudi, wazao wa Tola walioorodheshwa kama wapiganaji katika ukoo wao walikuwa watu 22,600.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Tola nabwo aba: Usi na Refaya, na Yerieli, na Yamai, na Ibusamu, na Semueli. Aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate chia Tola, abanto chituoni ase okorwana esegi ase ebigori biabo. Ase amatuko ’okogamba gwa Daudi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana atano na rimo (22,600).

English: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Uzi alikuwa: Izrahia. Wana wa Izrahia walikuwa: Mikaeli, Obadia, Yoeli na Ishia. Wote hawa watano walikuwa wakuu wao.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Usi nabwo aba: Isiraya amo nabana baye abamura: Mikaeli, na Obadia, na Yoel, na Isia, bonsi mbatano; na abwo nigo barenge abateneneri.

English: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na ukoo wa jamaa zao, walikuwa na watu hodari wa vita wapatao 36,000, kwa sababu walikuwa na wanawake na watoto wengi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babwate abakungu abange babaiborerete abana abamura abange. Ase igo barwete korwa ase chinderia chiabo abasikari abakong’u chilifu emerongo etato na isano nemo (36,000).

English: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.
Kiswahili: Jamaa ya watu waliokuwa wapiganaji hodari kutoka koo zote za Isakari, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika ukoo wao, jumla yao walikuwa 87,000.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo be chiamate chionsi chia Isakaru nigo barenge abakong’u ase esegi. Bonsi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na etato na isano na ibere (87,000), buna barigetwe ase chinderia chiabo.

English: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
Kiswahili: Wana watatu wa Benyamini walikuwa: Bela, Bekeri na Yediaeli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Benjamini nabwo aba: Bela, na Bekeri, na Yediaeli, bonsi mbatato.

English: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Bela walikuwa: Esboni, Uzi, Uzieli, Yeremothi na Iri; walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao; wote ni watano. Watu wapiganaji walioorodheshwa katika ukoo wao walikuwa 22,034.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bela nabwo aba: Esiboni, na Usi, na Usieli, na Yerimoti, na Iri. Aba bonsi batano nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, abanto abakong’u ase esegi. Abwo barikire ase omooroberio bwe chinderia chiabo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na emerongo etato, na baane (22,034).

English: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Bekeri walikuwa: Zemira, Yoashi, Eliezeri, Elioenai, Omri, Yeremothi, Abiya, Anathothi na Alemethi. Hawa wote walikuwa wana wa Bekeri.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bekeri nabwo aba: Semira, na Yoashi, na Eliezeri, na Elioenai, na Omuri, na Yerimoti, na Abiya, na Anatoti, na Alemeti. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura ba Bekeri.

English: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.
Kiswahili: Orodha ya ukoo wao iliyoandikwa viongozi wa jamaa zao walikuwa wapiganaji 20,200.
Ekegusii: Abwo barikire ase omooroberio bwe chinderia chiabo, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chiabo, nigo barenge abanto abakong’u ase esegi, abanto chilifu emerongo ebere, na amagana abere (20,200).

English: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Yediaeli alikuwa: Bilhani. Wana wa Bilhani walikuwa: Yeushi, Benyamini, Ehudi, Kenaana, Zethani, Tarshishi na Ahishahari.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yediaeli nabwo aba: Bilihani amo nabana baye abamura: Yeusi, na Benjamini, na Ehudi, na Kenaana, na Setani, na Tarisisi, na Ahisahari,

English: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
Kiswahili: Hawa wana wote wa Yediaeli walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao. Kulikuwako wanaume wapiganaji 17,200 waliokuwa tayari kwenda vitani.
Ekegusii: Aba bonsi nabwo ab’ororeria rwa Yediaeli. Barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, naende nigo barenge abakong’u ase esegi. Omobaro obo nechilifu ikomi na isano na ibere, na amagana abere (17,200).

English: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
Kiswahili: Washupimu na Wahupimu walikuwa wazao wa Iri. Wahushimu walikuwa wazao wa Aheri.
Ekegusii: Supimu na Hupimu nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Iri, naende Abahusi nab’ororeria rw’Aheri.

English: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Naftali walikuwa: Yahzieli, Guni, Yeseri na Shalumu; hao walikuwa wazao wa Bilha.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nafutali nabwo aba: Yaseeli, na Guni, na Yeseri, na Salumu. Nabwo abanto b’ororeria rwa Bilia.

English: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Manase walikuwa: Asirieli alikuwa mzao wake kutokana na suria wake wa Kiaramu. Huyu suria akamzaa Makiri baba wa Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Manase nabwo aba: Asirieli, oria omokungu oye o sere‐sere, orenge Omoaramai amoiborerete. Boigo omokungu oria akaibora Makiri, ise Gileadi.

English: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
Kiswahili: Makiri akatwaa mke kutoka miongoni mwa Wahupimu na Washupimu. Jina la dada yake aliitwa Maaka. Mwana wa pili wa Makiri aliitwa Selofehadi, ambaye alikuwa na wasichana tu.
Ekegusii: Makiri akanywomeria Hupimu omokungu, boigo akanywomeria Supimu omokungu. Omoiseke omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Maaka. Omwana omomura o kabere o Manase nigo arenge korokwa Selofehadi. Selofehadi nigo abwate abana abaiseke boka.

English: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
Kiswahili: Maaka mkewe Makiri akamzaa mwana aliyemwita Pereshi. Jina la nduguye lilikuwa Shereshi. Wana wa Pereshi walikuwa Ulamu na Rakemu.
Ekegusii: Maaka, moka Makiri, akaibora omwana omomura, akamoroka Peresi; na momura omwabo Peresi akarokwa Seresi. Abana abamura babere ba Peresi nabwo Ulamu na Rakemu.

English: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Ulamu alikuwa: Bedani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Gileadi mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase.
Ekegusii: Ulamu nabwate omwana omomura orenge korokwa Bedani. Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gileadi, mosinto o Makiri o Manase.

English: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
Kiswahili: Dada yake aliyeitwa Hamolekethi aliwazaa Ish-Hodi, Abiezeri na Mahla.
Ekegusii: Hamoleketi omosubati omwabo Gileadi, akaibora Isi‐Hodi na Abieseri, na Mahala.

English: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shemida walikuwa: Ahiani, Shekemu, Liki na Aniamu.
Ekegusii: Abana ba Shemida nabwo aba: Ahiani, na Sekemu, na Liki, na Aniamu.

English: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
Kiswahili: Wana wa Efraimu walikuwa: Shuthela, ambaye alimzaa Beredi, Beredi akamzaa Tahathi, Tahathi akazaa Eleada, Eleada akamzaa Tahathi,
Ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Efraimu: Sutela omomura oye, na Beredi omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye, na Eleada omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye,

English: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
Kiswahili: Tahathi akamzaa Zabadi, na Zabadi akamzaa Shuthela. Ezeri na Eleadi waliuawa na wenyeji wa Gathi walipokuwa wamekwenda huko kuwanyangʼanya mifugo yao.
Ekegusii: na Sabadi omomura oye, na Sutela omomura oye. Naende Efraimu nabwate abana babere, Eseri na Eleadi; baria abanto baiboretwe ase ense ya Gadi baitete, ekiagera bachete koiba chiombe chiabo.

English: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
Kiswahili: Baba yao Efraimu akawaombolezea kwa siku nyingi, na jamaa zake wakaja kumfariji.
Ekegusii: Efraimu ise akaba okobareera ase amatuko amange, na abamura bamwabo bagacha komoremia.

English: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.
Kiswahili: Kisha akakutana kimwili na mke wake tena, naye akachukua mimba, akamzalia mwana. Akamwita Beria, kwa sababu ya misiba iliyoipata nyumba yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Efraimu akaba na mokaye, na ere akanyora oborito, akaibora omwana omomura. Efraimu akaroka omwana oria Beria, ekiagera amang’ana amabe achete ase enka yaye.

English: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
Kiswahili: Beria alikuwa na binti jina lake Sheera. Huyu ndiye aliijenga miji ya Beth-Horoni ya Juu na Beth-Horoni ya Chini, pamoja na Uzen-Sheera.
Ekegusii: Omwana oye omoiseke nigo arenge korokwa Seera, oria oagachete Beti‐Horoni ya rogoro na eya maate, na Useni‐Seera.

English: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
Kiswahili: Beria akamzaa pia Refa, naye Refa akamzaa Reshefu, Reshefu akamzaa Tela, Tela akamzaa Tahani,
Ekegusii: Refa nigo arenge omomura bw’Efraimu, na Resefu omomura oye, na Tela omomura oye, na Tahani omomura oye,

English: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Kiswahili: Tahani akamzaa Ladani, Ladani akamzaa Amihudi, Amihudi akamzaa Elishama,
Ekegusii: na Ladani omomura oye, na Amihudi omomura oye, na Elisama omomura oye,

English: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
Kiswahili: Elishama akamzaa Nuni, Nuni akamzaa Yoshua.
Ekegusii: na Nuni omomura oye, na Yoshua omomura oye.

English: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
Kiswahili: Nchi zao na makazi yao yalijumuisha Betheli na vijiji vilivyouzunguka, Naarani ilikuwa upande wa mashariki, Gezeri pamoja na vijiji vyake upande wa magharibi, pia Shekemu na vijiji vyake hadi kufikia Aya na vijiji vyake.
Ekegusii: Chingongo chiabo bamenyete nachio Beteli na ebichie biaye, na ensemo ya moocha Naarani, na ensemo ya bosongo Geseri na ebichie biaye, na Sekemu na ebichie biaye, na Aya na ebichie biaye.

English: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.
Kiswahili: Katika mipaka ya Manase walikuwepo Beth-Shani, Taanaki, Megido na Dori pamoja na vijiji vyake. Wana wa Yosefu mwana wa Israeli waliishi katika miji hii.
Ekegusii: Boigo ase ribebe ri’abaanto ba Manase mbabwate Beti‐Sehani na ebichie biaye, na Taanaki na ebichie biaye, na Megido na ebichie biaye, na Dori na ebichie biaye. Ase emechie eyio na ebichie nao abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, mosinto o Israeli, bamenyete.

English: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Asheri walikuwa: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi na Beria. Dada yao alikuwa Sera.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo Sera.

English: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Beria walikuwa: Heberi na Malkieli, aliyekuwa baba yake Birzaithi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi, na Malikieli, oria orenge ise Birisaiti.

English: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
Kiswahili: Heberi akawazaa Yafleti, Shomeri na Hothamu, na Shua dada yao.
Ekegusii: Heberi nere orenge ise Yafileti, na Someri, na Hotamu, na ise omoiseke omwabo Sua.

English: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
