Kiswahili: Wana wa Yafleti walikuwa: Pasaki, Bimhali na Ashvathi. Hawa walikuwa wana wa Yafleti.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yafileti nabwo aba: Pasaki, na Bimuhali, na Asiwati. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Yafileti.

English: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shemeri walikuwa: Ahi, Roga, Yehuba na Aramu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Someri, omomura omwabo, nabwo aba: Roga, na Yehuba, na Aramu.

English: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Helemu ndugu yake walikuwa: Sofa, Imna, Sheleshi na Amali.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Helemu, omomura omwabo, nabwo aba: Sofa, na Imuna, na Selesi, na Amali.

English: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
Kiswahili: Wana wa Sofa walikuwa: Sua, Harneferi, Shuali, Beri, Imra,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sofa nabwo aba: Sua, na Hareneferi, na Suali, na Beri, na Imura,

English: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
Kiswahili: Bezeri, Hodu, Shama, Shilsha, Ithrani na Beera.
Ekegusii: na Beseri, na Hodi, na Sama, na Silisa, na Itirani, na Beera.

English: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yetheri walikuwa: Yefune, Pispa na Ara.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yeteri nabwo aba: Yefune, na Pisipa, na Ara.

English: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Ula walikuwa: Ara, Hanieli na Risia.
Ekegusii: Abana ba Ula nabwo aba: Ara, na Hanieli, na Risia.

English: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Asheri, viongozi wa jamaa zao, watu bora, mashujaa walio hodari na viongozi maarufu. Idadi ya watu waliokuwa tayari kwa vita, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika ukoo wao, walikuwa 26,000.
Ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo barenge abanto b’ororeria rw’Aseri. Nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, abanto bamanyekanete ng’a nabakong’u ase esegi, abatang’ani b’abaraai. Abwo barigetwe korwa ase chinderia chiabo bagende korwana esegi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isano nemo (26,000).

English: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
Kiswahili: Benyamini akamzaa: Bela mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Ashbeli mwanawe wa pili, Ahara mwanawe wa tatu,
Ekegusii: Benjamini nere orenge ise Bela, omwana oye omomura omotangi na Asibeli oyo o kabere, na Ahara oyo o gatato,

English: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
Kiswahili: Noha mwanawe wa nne na Rafa mwanawe wa tano.
Ekegusii: na Noha oyo o kane, na Rafa oyo o gatano.

English: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
Kiswahili: Wana wa Bela walikuwa: Adari, Gera, Abihudi,
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Bela nabwo aba: Adari na Gera, na Abihudi,

English: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
Kiswahili: Abishua, Naamani, Ahoa,
Ekegusii: Abisua na Naamani, na Ahoa,

English: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
Kiswahili: Gera, Shefufani na Huramu.
Ekegusii: Gera na Sefufani, na Huramu.

English: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wazao wa Ehudi, waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za wale walioishi huko Geba na ambao walihamishiwa Manahathi:
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Ehudi nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, echio chiamenyete Geba. Barabwo bagooswa, bakairwa ase ense ya Manahati.

English: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
Kiswahili: Naamani, Ahiya na Gera. Gera alikuwa baba yao Uza na Ahihudi na ndiye aliwaongoza kwenda uhamishoni.
Ekegusii: Abamura abwo nabwo aba: Naamani na Ahiya, na Gera, oyio obairete aroro. Abana abamura baye nabwo Usa na Ahihudi.

English: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
Kiswahili: Shaharaimu aliwazaa wana katika nchi ya Moabu baada ya kuwapa talaka wake zake wawili yaani, Hushimu na Baara.
Ekegusii: Saharaimu akaibora abana abamura ase ense ya Moabu ekero konya aseririe Husimu na Baara, abakungu baye.

English: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
Kiswahili: Kwa mkewe Hodeshi, akawazaa wana saba: Yobabu, Sibia, Mesha, Malkamu,
Ekegusii: Hodesi mokaye akamoiborera abana abamura, nabwo aba: Yobabu na Zibia, na Mesa, na Malikamu,

English: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.
Kiswahili: Yeuzi, Sakia na Mirma. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wanawe, viongozi wa jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Yeusi na Sakia, na Mirima. Abana aba baye nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.

English: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
Kiswahili: Hushimu alimzalia: Abitubu na Elpaali.
Ekegusii: Naende Husimu akamoiborera abamura babere, nabwo Abitubu na Elipali.

English: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;
Kiswahili: Wana wa Elpaali walikuwa: Eberi, Mishamu, Shemedi (aliyeijenga miji ya Ono na Lodi, pamoja na vijiji vilivyoizunguka),
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elipali nabwo Eberi na Misamu, naende Semedi, oria oagachete emechie ya Omo na Lodi amo nebichie biabo.

English: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;
Kiswahili: na Beria na Shema, waliokuwa viongozi wa zile jamaa zilizokuwa zinaishi katika mji wa Aiyaloni, na ambao waliwafukuza wenyeji wa Gathi.
Ekegusii: Beria na Sema nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chi’abaanto bamenyete agwo Ayaloni, nabwo baseretie abanyene ense ya Gati.

English: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
Kiswahili: Wana wa Beria walikuwa Ahio, Shashaki, Yeremothi,
Ekegusii: Ahiyo na Sasaki, na Yeremoti,

English: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
Kiswahili: Zebadia, Aradi, Ederi,
Ekegusii: Sebadia na Aradi, na Ederi,

English: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,
Kiswahili: Mikaeli, Ishpa, na Yoha.
Ekegusii: Mikaeli, na Isipa, na Yoha; aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Beria.

English: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
Kiswahili: Zebadia, Meshulamu, Hizki, Heberi,
Ekegusii: Sebadia na Mesulamu, Hisiki na Heberi,

English: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
Kiswahili: Ishmerai, Izlia na Yobabu ndio waliokuwa wana wa Elpaali.
Ekegusii: Isimerai na Isilia, na Yobabu; aba nigo barenge abana abamura b’Elipali.

English: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
Kiswahili: Yakimu, Zikri, Zabdi,
Ekegusii: Yakimu na Sikiri, na Sabidi,

English: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
Kiswahili: Elienai, Silethai, Elieli,
Ekegusii: Elinai na Siletai, na Elieli,

English: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,
Kiswahili: Adaya, Beraya na Shimrathi walikuwa wana wa Shimei.
Ekegusii: Adaya na Beraya, na Simurati; aba nigo baare abana abamura ba Simei.

English: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shashaki walikuwa Ishpani, Eberi, Elieli,
Ekegusii: Isipani na Eberi, na Elieli,

English: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
Kiswahili: Abdoni, Zikri, Hanani,
Ekegusii: Abidoni na Sikiri, na Hanani,

English: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
Kiswahili: Hanania, Elamu, Anthothiya,
Ekegusii: Hanania na Elamu, na Anitotia,

English: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,
Kiswahili: Ifdeya na Penueli.
Ekegusii: Ifudia na Penueli; aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Sasaki.

English: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
Kiswahili: Shamsherai, Sheharia, Athalia,
Ekegusii: Samiserai na Seharia, na Atalia,

English: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.
Kiswahili: Yaareshia, Eliya na Zikri walikuwa wana wa Yerohamu.
Ekegusii: Yaresia na Elija, na Sikiri; aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Yerohamu.

English: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao wakuu, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao, nao waliishi Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo ase ebiaare biabo; nigo barenge abaraai abanene. Abwo nigo bamenyete Yerusalemu.

English: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon
Kiswahili: Yeieli alikuwa baba yake Gibeoni naye aliishi huko Gibeoni. Mke wake aliitwa Maaka.
Ekegusii: Ise Abagibeoni nigo amenyete agwo Gibeoni; omokungu oye nigo arenge korokwa Maaka.

English: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
Kiswahili: Mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Abdoni, akafuatiwa na Suri, Kishi, Baali, Neri, Nadabu,
Ekegusii: Omwana oye omomura omotangi nere Abidoni; na abande nabwo aba: Suri na Kisi, Baali na Nadabu,

English: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
Kiswahili: Gedori, Ahio, Zekeri,
Ekegusii: Gedori na Ahiyo, na Sekeri,

English: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
Kiswahili: na Miklothi ambaye alikuwa baba yake Shimea. Hawa pia waliishi karibu na jamaa zao huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: na Mikiloti (nere orenge ise Simea). Aba nigo bamenyete bakabebekana nabaanto bamwabo agwo Yerusalemu.

English: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
Kiswahili: Neri akamzaa Kishi, Kishi akamzaa Sauli, Sauli akamzaa Yonathani, Malki-Shua, Abinadabu na Esh-Baali.
Ekegusii: Neri akaibora Kisi, na Kisi akaibora Saulo, na Saulo akaibora Yonathani na Malikisua, na Abinadabu, na Esi‐Baali.

English: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
Kiswahili: Yonathani akamzaa: Merib-Baali, naye Merib-Baali akamzaa Mika.
Ekegusii: Omwana omomura o Yonathani nere Meribu‐Baali; ere akaibora Mika.

English: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Mika walikuwa: Pithoni, Meleki, Tarea na Ahazi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Mika nabwo aba: Pitoni na Meleki, na Tarea, na Ahasi.

English: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
Kiswahili: Ahazi akamzaa Yehoada. Naye Yehoada akawazaa Alemethi, Azmawethi na Zimri, naye Zimri akamzaa Mosa.
Ekegusii: Ahasi akaibora Yehoada, na Yehoada akaibora Alemeti na Asimaweti, na Simuri, na Simuri akaibora Moza.

English: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
Kiswahili: Mosa akamzaa Binea, Binea akamzaa Rafa, na mwanawe huyo ni Eleasa, na mwanawe huyo ni Aseli.
Ekegusii: Moza akaibora Binea; Rafa nigo arenge omomura oye, na Eleasa omomura oye, na Aseli omomura oye.

English: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
Kiswahili: Aseli alikuwa na wana sita; haya ndiyo majina yao: Azrikamu, Bokeru, Ishmaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani. Hawa wote ndio waliokuwa wana wa Aseli.
Ekegusii: Aseli nabwate abana abamura batano nomo, naya naro amarieta abo: Asirikamu na Bokeru, Isumaeli na Searia, Obadia na Hanani. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura b’Aseli.

English: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Esheki, nduguye Aseli, walikuwa: Mzaliwa wake wa kwanza alikuwa Ulamu, wa pili Yeushi na wa tatu Elifeleti.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Eseki, momura omwabo, nabwo aba: Ulamu, omwana oye omotangi, na Yeusi, oyo o kabere, na Elifeleti, oyo o gatato.

English: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Ulamu walikuwa mashujaa hodari walioweza kutumia upinde. Alikuwa na wana wengi na wajukuu, jumla yao 150. Hawa wote ndio walikuwa wazao wa Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ulamu nigo barenge abanto chituoni ase esegi, bamanyete koruta emegwe. Nigo babwate abana abamura na abachokoro abamura abange, bonsi nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamini.

English: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wote waliorodheshwa katika koo zilizoandikwa kwenye kitabu cha wafalme wa Israeli. Watu wa Yuda walichukuliwa mateka kwenda Babeli kwa sababu ya kukosa uaminifu kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi nigo baabaretwe na korikwa koreng’ana ne chinderia chiabo, na amang’ana abo nigo anyorekanete ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli. Abayuda nigo baosetwe bakairwa Babiloni, ekiagera tibarenge abegenwa.

English: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
Kiswahili: Basi watu wa kwanza kurudi kukaa kwenye milki zao katika miji yao walikuwa baadhi ya Waisraeli, makuhani, Walawi na watumishi wa Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Abanto batang’anete koirana na komenya sobo ase emechie yabo n’Abaisraeli bande, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu.

English: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
Kiswahili: Wale waliotoka Yuda, Benyamini, Efraimu na Manase ambao waliishi Yerusalemu walikuwa:
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda, na orwa Benjamini, na orw’Efraimu, na orwa Manase, abwo bamenyete Yerusalemu nabwo aba.

English: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
Kiswahili: Uthai mwana wa Amihudi, mwana wa Omri, mwana wa Imri, mwana wa Bani, wa wana wa Peresi, mwana wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Utai, omwana bw’Amihudi, mosinto bw’Omuri o Imuri, o Bani korwa ase ororeria rwa Peresi, mosinto o Yuda,

English: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Washiloni waliorudi ni: Asaya mzaliwa wa kwanza na wanawe.
Ekegusii: na korwa Silo Asaia, omwana omotangi amo nabana baye abamura.

English: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
Kiswahili: Kwa wana wa Zera: Yeueli. Watu wa Yuda jumla yao walikuwa watu 690.
Ekegusii: Ase ororeria rwa Zera Yeueli amo nabaanto bamwabo. Bonsi nigo barenge abanto amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo kianda (690).

English: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
Kiswahili: Kwa Benyamini walikuwa: Salu mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Hodavia, mwana wa Hasenua;
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamini nabwo aba: Salu, mosinto o Mesulamu o Hodawia, o Hasenua;

English: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
Kiswahili: Ibneya mwana wa Yerohamu, Ela mwana wa Uzi, mwana wa Mikri; na Meshulamu mwana wa Shefatia, mwana wa Reueli, mwana wa Ibniya.
Ekegusii: naende Ibunia, mosinto o Yerohamu, na Ela, mosinto o Usi o Mikiri, na Mesulamu, mosinto o Sefatia o Reueli, o Ibunia,

English: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.
Kiswahili: Watu kutoka Benyamini kama walivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao jumla yao ni 956. Watu hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: amo nabaanto bamwabo ase chinderia chiabo, nigo barenge amagana kianda, na emerongo etano, na batano nomo (956). Aba bonsi nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, kera oyomo ase eamate yaye.

English: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,
Kiswahili: Wa jamaa za makuhani walikuwa: Yedaya, Yehoyaribu na Yakini;
Ekegusii: Abakuani aba nabwo bamenyete Yerusalemu: Yedaya na Yehoyaribu, na Yakini;

English: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;
Kiswahili: Azaria mwana wa Hilkia, mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Sadoki, mwana wa Merayothi, mwana wa Ahitubu aliyekuwa afisa kiongozi wa nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Asaria, mosinto o Hilikia o Mesulamu, o Zadoki, o Meraioti, bw’Ahitubu, omoteneneri omonene bw’enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
Kiswahili: Adaya mwana wa Yerohamu, mwana wa Pashuri, mwana wa Malkiya; Maasai, mwana wa Adieli, mwana wa Yahzera, mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Meshilemithi, mwana wa Imeri.
Ekegusii: Naende Adaya, mosinto o Yerohamu o Pasuri, o Malikia; na Maasai, mosinto bw’Adieli o Yasera, o Mesulamu, o Mesilemiti, o Imeri.

English: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.
Kiswahili: Makuhani waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao walikuwa 1,760. Walikuwa watu wenye uwezo, waliowajibika kuhudumu katika nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge abamwabo, abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, elifu eyemo, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (1,760). Bonsi nigo barenge abamanyi ase ogokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
Kiswahili: Jamaa za Walawi walikuwa: Shemaya, mwana wa Hashubu, mwana wa Azrikamu, mwana wa Hashabia, wa wana wa Merari.
Ekegusii: Abalawi aba nabwo bamenyete Yerusalemu: Semaya, mosinto o Hasubu bw’Asirikamu, o Hasabia korwa ase eamate y’Abamerari;

English: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
Kiswahili: Bakbakari, Hereshi, Galali na Matania mwana wa Mika, mwana wa Zikri, mwana wa Asafu.
Ekegusii: Bakibakari na Heresi, Galali na Matania, mosinto o Mika o Sikiri, bw’Asafu;

English: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
Kiswahili: Obadia mwana wa Shemaya, mwana wa Galali, mwana wa Yeduthuni. Berekia mwana wa Asa, mwana wa Elikana, ambao waliishi katika vijiji vya Wanetofathi.
Ekegusii: Obadia, mosinto o Semaya o Galali, o Yedutuni; na Berekia, mosinto bw’Asa bw’Elikana, oyomenyete ase emechie y’Abaanetofa.

English: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),
Kiswahili: Mabawabu katika Hekalu la Bwana waliorudi walikuwa: Shalumu, Akubu, Talmoni, Ahimani na ndugu zao. Shalumu alikuwa mlinzi wao mkuu.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarendi b’ebiita bamenyete Yerusalemu: Salumu na Akubu, Talimoni na Ahimani, na abanto bande bamwabo. Salumu nere orenge omoteneneri obo.

English: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wamewekwa katika lango la mfalme lililokuwa upande wa mashariki, mpaka wakati huu. Hawa walikuwa mabawabu wa kutoka kwenye kambi ya Walawi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaba bakorenda agwo ase Egeita ki’Omorwoti, ensemo ya moocha, goika engaki eye. Kare nabwo barenge abarendi b’egetwori ki’Abalawi.

English: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.
Kiswahili: Shalumu mwana wa Kore, mwana wa Ebiasafu, mwana wa Kora, pamoja na mabawabu wenzake kutoka jamaa yake ya Kora waliwajibika kulinda malango ya Hema, kama vile baba zao walivyokuwa wamewajibika kulinda ingilio la Maskani ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Salumu, mosinto o Kore bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora, amo nabaanto bande b’eamate yaye, nabwo Abakora, nigo barenge abateneneri bokorenda ase Ebiita bi’Eema y’Omosangererekano, buna chisokoro chiabo chiarenge korenda ase egesoero ki’egetwori ki’Omonene.

English: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.
Kiswahili: Hapo zamani Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari alikuwa kiongozi wa mabawabu, naye Bwana alikuwa pamoja naye:
Ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, nere orenge omogambi agwo kare, n’Omonene nigo arenge amo nere.

English: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Kiswahili: Zekaria mwana wa Meshelemia alikuwa bawabu katika ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
Ekegusii: Zakaria, mosinto o Meselemia, nere orenge omorendi bw’egeita agwo ase egesoero ki Eema y’Omosangererekano.

English: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya waliochaguliwa kuwa mabawabu katika sakafu za kupuria nafaka walikuwa watu 212. Waliandikishwa kwa koo zao kwenye vijiji vyao. Mabawabu hawa waliwekwa katika nafasi zao za kuaminiwa na Daudi pamoja na mwonaji Samweli.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi amagana abere, na ikomi na babere (212) nigo bachoretwe bakaba abarendi b’ebisoero bi’ebiita. Bakabarwa na korikwa ase chinderia chiabo. Daudi na Samweli omoorori bakababeeka ase emeremo, ekiagera babegenete.

English: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of Yahweh’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.
Kiswahili: Wao na wazao wao walikuwa viongozi wa kulinda malango ya nyumba ya Bwana, nyumba iliyoitwa Hema.
Ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo amo nabamura be chinderia chiabo bakagenderera korenda ebiita bi’enyomba y’Omonene, nero Eema eria.

English: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.
Kiswahili: Mabawabu walikuwa pande zote nne: mashariki, magharibi, kaskazini na kusini.
Ekegusii: Abarendi baria b’ebiita bakabeera aria korenda chinsemo chia moocha, na bosongo, na sugusu, na Irianyi.

English: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zao katika vijiji vyao walikuwa wakija mara kwa mara na kuwasaidia katika kazi zao kwa vipindi mbalimbali vya siku saba.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo abarenge ase emechie yabo bakabetererigwa gocha koba amo nabarabwo ase kera rituko ria gatano na kabere ase engaki yachikiire.

English: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.
Kiswahili: Lakini mabawabu wanne wakuu, waliokuwa Walawi, walikabidhiwa wajibu kwa ajili ya vyumba na hazina katika nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abalawi baria baane abarenge abateneneri b’emeremo y’okorenda ebiita nabwo batenenerete ebinyomba ne chikungo chi’enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.
Kiswahili: Walikesha mahali walipowekwa kuizunguka nyumba ya Mungu, kwa sababu iliwapasa kuilinda. Pia walitunza funguo kwa ajili ya kufungua mlango kila siku asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakobeera isiko bagaetanana enyomba ya Nyasae, ekiagera emeremo y’oborendi nigo yabegetwe igoro ase bare, naende nabwo barenge koigora enyomba eria kera emambia.

English: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.
Kiswahili: Baadhi yao walikuwa viongozi wa kutunza vifaa vilivyotumika katika huduma ndani ya Hekalu; walivihesabu kila vilipoingizwa ndani na kila vilipotolewa.
Ekegusii: Abalawi bande nabwo batenenerete ebikorero bi’emeremo, ekiagera nigo baganeirie kobibara ekero biarenge korentwa ime, na ekero biarenge koirwa isiko ase emeremo.

English: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
Kiswahili: Wengine walipangiwa kutunza mapambo na vifaa vingine vya patakatifu, pamoja na unga, divai, mafuta, uvumba na vikolezo.
Ekegusii: Abande babo bagachorwa gotenenera chimesa na ebinto binde, na ebikorero ebichenu, na obosie obonuke, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na ubani, na ebinsari.

English: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.
Kiswahili: Lakini baadhi ya makuhani walifanya kazi ya kuchanganya vikolezo.
Ekegusii: Abande b’abamura b’abakuani nigo babegetwe kwearigania na gwochogania ebinsari.

English: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
Kiswahili: Mlawi aliyeitwa Matithia, mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Shalumu, wa ukoo wa Kora, alikabidhiwa wajibu kwa ajili ya kuoka mikate ya sadaka.
Ekegusii: Matitia, oyomo bw’Abalawi, omomura omotangi o Salumu, omonto bw’eamate ya Kora, agatenenera emeremo y’okoroisia emegati ekoruegwa.

English: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya ndugu zao wa ukoo wa Kohathi walikuwa viongozi wa kuandaa mikate ya Wonyesho kwa ajili ya kila Sabato, mikate iliyokuwa inawekwa mezani.
Ekegusii: Boigo abande bamwabo b’eamate ya Kohati bagatenenera emeremo y’okoroisia emegati yarenge koruegwa ase Omonene kera Esabato.

English: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa waimbaji, viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi, waliishi katika vyumba vya Hekalu, nao hawakufanya shughuli nyingine yoyote kwa sababu iliwapasa kuwajibika kwa kazi hiyo usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: Abande nigo barenge abateri abanene, boigo nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi. Barabwo nigo bamenyete ase ebinyomba bie Hekalu; tibarenge gokora emeremo ende emeao, ekiagera omobaso na obotuko nigo barenge ase emeremo baetwe gokora.

English: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi, wakuu kama walivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao, nao waliishi Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo chi’Abalawi ase ebiare biabo. Abwo nigo barenge abaraai baria bamenyete Yerusalemu.

English: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.
Kiswahili: Yeieli alikuwa baba yake Gibeoni naye aliishi huko Gibeoni. Mke wake aliitwa Maaka,
Ekegusii: Yeieli ise Abagibeoni, nigo amenyete agwo Gibeoni na mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Maaka.

English: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
Kiswahili: mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Abdoni, akafuatiwa na Suri, Kishi, Baali, Neri, Nadabu,
Ekegusii: Abidoni nere orenge omwana oye omomura omotangi, na abande nabwo aba: Suri na Kisi, Baali na Neri, na Nadabu,

English: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
Kiswahili: Gedori, Ahio, Zekaria na Miklothi.
Ekegusii: Gedori na Ahiyo, Zakaria na Mikiloti.

English: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
Kiswahili: Miklothi akamzaa Shimeamu. Wao pia waliishi karibu na jamaa zao huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Mikiloti nere orenge ise Simeamu. Aba boigo nigo bamenyete bakabebekana nabamwabo agwo Yerusalemu.

English: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
Kiswahili: Neri akamzaa Kishi, Kishi akamzaa Sauli. Sauli akamzaa Yonathani, Malki-Shua, Abinadabu na Esh-Baali.
Ekegusii: Neri akaibora Kisi, na Kisi akaibora Saulo, na Saulo akaibora Yonathani na Malikisua, Abinadabu na Esi‐Baali.

English: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
Kiswahili: Yonathani akamzaa Merib-Baali, naye Merib-Baali akamzaa Mika.
Ekegusii: Yonathani akaibora Meribu‐Baali, na Meribu‐Baali akaibora Mika.

English: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Mika walikuwa: Pithoni, Meleki, Tarea, na Ahazi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Mika nabwo aba: Pitoni na Meleki, Tarea na Ahasi.

English: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
Kiswahili: Ahazi akamzaa Yara, Yara akawazaa Alemethi, Azmawethi na Zimri, naye Zimri akamzaa Mosa.
Ekegusii: Ahasi akaibora Yara, na Yara akaibora Alemeti na Asimaweti, na Simuri; nere Simuri akaibora Moza.

English: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
Kiswahili: Mosa akamzaa Binea, Binea akamzaa Refaya, na mwanawe huyo ni Eleasa, na mwanawe huyo ni Aseli.
Ekegusii: Moza akaibora Binea, na Binea akaibora Refaya, na Refaya akaibora Eleasa, na Eleasa akaibora Aseli.

English: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
Kiswahili: Aseli alikuwa na wana sita, na haya ndiyo majina yao: Azrikamu, Bokeru, Ishmaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Aseli.
Ekegusii: Aseli nabwate abana abamura batano nomo, na amarieta abo naro aya: Asirikamu, na Bokeru, na Isumaeli, na Searia, na Obadia, na Hanani. Aba nabwo abana abamura b’Aseli.

English: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
Kiswahili: Basi Wafilisti wakapigana na Israeli. Waisraeli wakawakimbia, na wengi wakauawa katika mlima Gilboa.
Ekegusii: Bono Abafirisiti bakarwania Abaisraeli, na Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase bare na bagaiterwa ase egetunwa kia Giliboa.

English: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti wakawafuatia kwa bidii Sauli na wanawe, wakawaua Yonathani, Abinadabu na Malki-Shua.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakabwatia Saulo na abamura baye, bagaita Yonathani, na Abinadabu, na Malikisua, abamura ba Saulo.

English: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.
Kiswahili: Mapigano yakawa makali kumzunguka Sauli na wakati wapiga mishale walipompata, wakamjeruhi.
Ekegusii: Esegi ekaba entindi mono ase Saulo, na abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria, bakamorasa, bakamoaka chingoma.

English: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.
Kiswahili: Sauli akamwambia mbeba silaha wake, “Futa upanga wako unichome nao, la sivyo hawa watu wasiotahiriwa watakuja na kunidhalilisha.” Lakini mbeba silaha wake akaogopa sana wala hakuweza kufanya hivyo. Kwa hiyo Sauli akachukua upanga wake mwenyewe na kuuangukia.
Ekegusii: Erio Saulo agateebia omonto oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero, “Simora omoyio oo, ombete nkwe, erinde abanto aba batarogeti tibaabaisa kong’ita na gonchecheria.” Korende omonto oria akaanga, ekiagera nigo abeete nobwoba obonene. Ase ayio Saulo akabwata omoyio oye omonyene akegweria igoro yaye.

English: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.
Kiswahili: Mbeba silaha wake alipoona kwamba Sauli amekufa, naye pia akauangukia upanga wake akafa.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria omobogoria ebirwanero aroche ng’a Saulo okuure, nere akegweria ase omoyio oye omonyene, agakwa.

English: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Sauli na wanawe watatu wakafa, pamoja na nyumba yake yote.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Saulo agakwa, ere na abamura baye batato amo nabaanto baye bonsi.

English: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli wote waliokuwa bondeni walipoona kwamba jeshi limekimbia na kwamba Sauli na wanawe wamekufa, waliacha miji yao wakakimbia. Nao Wafilisti wakaja na kukaa humo.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge ase ense eria omweremo baroche ng’a abarwani ’esegi babo batamire, na ng’a Saulo na abamura baye bakuure, bagatiga emechie yabo bagatama. Erio Abafirisiti bagacha, bakamenya ase emechie eyio.

English: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake Wafilisti walipokuja kuwavua maiti silaha, walimkuta Sauli na wanawe wameanguka katika Mlima Gilboa.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, ekero Abafirisiti bachete konuura ebinto korwa ase emebere y’abanto bakwete, bakanyora Saulo amo nabamura baye bakwete agwo ase egetunwa kia Giliboa.

English: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.
Kiswahili: Wakamvua mavazi, wakachukua kichwa chake pamoja na silaha zake, wakawatuma wajumbe katika nchi yote ya Wafilisti kutangaza habari hizi miongoni mwa sanamu zao na watu wao.
Ekegusii: Bakamonuura ebinto biaye, bakanacha omotwe oye bakayoira, bakaira nebirwanero biaye, erio bagatoma abanto bararie amang’ana aya amaya ase ense yonsi y’Abafilisti, ase emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa na ase abanto.

English: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
Kiswahili: Waliweka silaha zake katika hekalu la miungu yao, wakatundika kichwa chake katika hekalu la Dagoni.
Ekegusii: Bakabeeka ebirwanero biaye ime ase Hekalu ye chinyasae chiabo, erio bagasiberania omotwe oye ase Hekalu ya Dagoni.

English: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
Kiswahili: Wakazi wote wa Yabeshi-Gileadi waliposikia yote Wafilisti waliyomtendea Sauli,
Ekegusii: Korende ekero abanto bonsi ba Yabeshi o Gileadi baigwete aya onsi Abafirisiti bakorerete Saulo,

English: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
Kiswahili: mashujaa wao wote wakaondoka, wakautwaa mwili wa Sauli na miili ya wanawe, wakaileta Yabeshi. Wakaizika mifupa yao chini ya mti mkubwa huko Yabeshi, nao wakafunga kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: abarwani bonsi chituoni bakagenda bakarusia omobere o Saulo na ey’abamura baye korwa ase yarenge, bakayerenta Yabesi. Erio bagatindeka amauga abo inse y’Omoaluni agwo Yabesi, erio bakeng’ata amatuko atano na abere.

English: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,
Kiswahili: Sauli alikufa kwa sababu hakuwa mwaminifu kwa Bwana. Hakulishika neno la Bwana, hata akataka shauri kwa mwaguzi kwa ajili ya uongozi,
Ekegusii: Naboigo Saulo akwete, ekiagera atarenge omwegenwa. Tarenge omwegenwa ase Omonene na tarendete amang’an’Omonene amochigeete; naende akagenda korigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakuure, ase okoraagwa nero,

English: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
Kiswahili: hakumuuliza Bwana. Kwa hiyo Bwana alimuua, na ufalme akampa Daudi mwana wa Yese.
Ekegusii: na tarigetie okoraagwa korwa ase Omonene. Ase ayio Omonene akamoita, akarusia oborwoti asare, akaboa Daudi, mosinto o Yese.

English: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
Kiswahili: Israeli yote walimjia Daudi kwa pamoja huko Hebroni wakamwambia, “Sisi ni nyama yako na damu yako.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangerereka ase Daudi agwo Heburoni bakamoteebia, “Naama! Intwe nigo tore abamo naye, aba amanyinga ayamo, na omobere oyomo.

English: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. Yahweh your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
Kiswahili: Zamani, wakati Sauli alikuwa mfalme, wewe ndiwe uliyeiongoza Israeli vitani, naye Bwana Mungu wako alikuambia, ‘Wewe utawachunga watu wangu Israeli, na utakuwa mtawala wao.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki yaetire, nonya nekero Saulo arenge omorwoti, naye kwarenge gotang’ana Abaisraeli kobaare korwana esegi naende kobakoirana. Na Omonene, Nyasae oo, akagoteebia ng’a naye orabe omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na koba omogambi igoro yabo.”

English: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh. They anointed David king over Israel, according to Yahweh’s word by Samuel.
Kiswahili: Wazee wote wa Israeli walipokuwa wamewasili kwa Mfalme Daudi huko Hebroni, alifanya mapatano nao huko Hebroni mbele za Bwana, nao wakamtia Daudi mafuta awe mfalme wa Israeli, sawasawa na Bwana alivyoahidi kupitia kwa Samweli.
Ekegusii: Nabo abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha ase omorwoti agwo Heburoni; na aroro Daudi agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, na barabwo bagaaka Daudi amaguta akaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riri’Omonene akwanete goetera ase Samweli.

English: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
Kiswahili: Daudi na Waisraeli wote wakaenda Yerusalemu (ndio Yebusi). Nao Wayebusi walioishi humo
Ekegusii: Daudi amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakagenda Yerusalemu, noro Yebusi, ase Abayebusi, abanto b’ense eria, barenge.

English: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
Kiswahili: wakamwambia Daudi, “Wewe hutaingia humu.” Hata hivyo, Daudi akaiteka ngome ya Sayuni, Mji wa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Yebusi bakamoteebia, “Aye tokonyara gocha aiga nonya ng’ake.” Korende nonya naboigo, Daudi akabua eburi ya Sayoni, oyio noro Omochie o Daudi.

English: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
Kiswahili: Daudi alikuwa amesema, “Yeyote aongozaye mashambulizi dhidi ya Wayebusi, atakuwa jemadari mkuu.” Yoabu mwana wa Seruya akawa wa kwanza kukwea, naye akawa mkuu.
Ekegusii: Daudi konya oteebire, ng’a “Monto onde bwensi orabe oyo bw’eritang’ani goita abanto ba Yebusi, ere oyio nabe omochiki omonene bw’abarwani.” Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani kogenda aroro; ase ayio ere akaba omochiki.

English: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.
Kiswahili: Daudi akafanya makao yake kwenye ngome, hivyo ukaitwa Mji wa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaba okomenya ase eburi eria enkong’u, ase ayio ekarokwa Omochie o Daudi.

English: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
Kiswahili: Akajenga mji pande zote, kuanzia kwenye mito hadi kwenye ukuta kuzunguka, wakati huo huo Yoabu akajenga sehemu zingine zilizobaki za Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Erio akaagacha omochie goetanana onsi korwa Milo, okaba egesingo kegima; na Yoabu akaroisia omochie ase konya otagokire.

English: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh of Armies was with him.
Kiswahili: Daudi akazidi kuwa na nguvu zaidi na zaidi, kwa sababu Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote alikuwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Daudi akamenta koba omonene, na koba nokobua, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo arenge amo nere.

English: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to Yahweh’s word concerning Israel.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wa mashujaa wa Daudi: wao pamoja na Israeli wote wakauimarisha ufalme wake ili kuenea katika nchi yote, kama Bwana alivyoahidi.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto abanene chituoni ba Daudi, baria bamosiirete bokong’u ase oborwoti bwaye, amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakamobeeka akaba omorwoti, koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene igoro y’Abaisraeli.

English: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
Kiswahili: Hii ndio orodha ya mashujaa wa Daudi: Yashobeamu, Mhakmoni, alikuwa mkuu wa maafisa; yeye aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 300, ambao aliwaua katika pambano moja.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’abaanto chituoni ba Daudi: Ritang’ani Yasobeamu korwa Hakimoni. Ere nigo arenge omonene bwa baria batato. Ere akarwania abanto amagana atato ne ritimo riaye akabaita ase engaki eyemo.

English: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
Kiswahili: Aliyefuata alikuwa Eleazari, mwana wa Dodai, Mwahohi, mmojawapo wa wale mashujaa watatu.
Ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere bw’abwo batato n’Eleazari, mosinto o Dodo, Omoahohi.

English: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Huyo alikuwa pamoja na Daudi huko Pas-Damimu, wakati Wafilisti walikusanyika huko kwa ajili ya vita. Huko ambapo kulikuwa na shamba lililokuwa limejaa shayiri, vikosi vya Israeli vikawakimbia Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge amo na Daudi agwo Pasi‐Damimu ekero Abafirisiti basangererekanete amo, barwane esegi aase omogondo bw’esairi orenge. Ekero abanto batamete korwa ase Abafirisiti,

English: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh saved them by a great victory.
Kiswahili: Lakini Eleazari na Daudi wakasimama imara katikati ya lile shamba, nao wakalishindania na wakawaua Wafilisti. Naye Bwana akawapa ushindi mkubwa.
Ekegusii: Eleazari agatenena gati gati y’omogondo oria, akaba omokong’u akayoegera, agaaka Abafirisiti, akabaita. Omonene akabaa obobui obonene.

English: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
Kiswahili: Wakuu watatu miongoni mwa wale thelathini, walimwendea Daudi katika mwamba huko kwenye pango la Adulamu, wakati kikundi cha Wafilisti kilikuwa kimepiga kambi katika Bonde la Warefai.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo abanto batato ba baria abanene emerongo etato bagatirimboka gochia ase egetare, bakagenda ase Daudi agwo ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu, ekero abasikari b’Abafilisti batoorete ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.

English: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Daudi alikuwa katika ngome, na kambi ya Wafilisti ilikuwa huko Bethlehemu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Daudi nigo arenge ime ase eburi, na abasikari b’Abafilisti nigo barenge Bethlehemu.

English: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
Kiswahili: Daudi akatamani maji, akasema, “Laiti mtu angenipatia maji ya kunywa kutoka kisima kilichoko karibu na lango la Bethlehemu!”
Ekegusii: Daudi akabora ase okogania okonene, “Ntare konyora omonto andetere amaache inywe korwa ase ensoko eyio ere ase egeita kia Bethlehemu?”

English: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo wale watatu, wakapita katikati ya safu za Wafilisti, wakachota maji kutoka kwa kisima kilicho karibu na lango la Bethlehemu, wakamletea Daudi. Lakini yeye akakataa kuyanywa. Badala yake, aliyamimina mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batato bakabinya‐binyia egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amaache korwa ase ensoko eria yarenge ase egeita kia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa otatiga ayaumorete akaba okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,

English: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Mungu apishie mbali kwamba nifanye hivi! Je kweli, niinywe damu ya watu hawa waliohatarisha maisha yao?” Kwa sababu walihatarisha maisha yao kuyaleta yale maji, Daudi hakukubali kuyanywa. Huo ndio uliokuwa ujasiri wa wale mashujaa watatu.
Ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene ontange tiyanywa. Aya nigo anga buna nkonywa amanyinga ’abaanto bataegerete obogima bwabo ase okorenta amaache aya.” Ase ayio akaanga tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto abwo chituoni batato bakorete.

English: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
Kiswahili: Abishai, ndugu yake Yoabu ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa hao Watatu. Aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 300, ambao aliwaua, kwa hiyo naye akawa na sifa kama hao Watatu.
Ekegusii: Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, nigo amanyekanete ase baria batato; akarwania abanto amagana atato akabaaka ne ritimo riaye, akabaita, na igo akaba nerieta rinene ase egati ya baria batato.

English: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.
Kiswahili: Alitunukiwa heshima maradufu ya wale Watatu, akawa jemadari wao, ingawa hakuhesabiwa miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Ase baria batato ere nigo abwate ogosikwa okuya goetania abande, akaba omoraai obo, korende tareng’anetie na baria batato b’eritang’ani.

English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
Kiswahili: Benaya, mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa mpiganaji hodari kutoka Kabseeli ambaye alifanya mambo makubwa ya ujasiri. Aliwaua mashujaa wawili waliokuwa hodari kuliko wote wa Moabu. Pia alishuka shimoni kulipokuwa na theluji na kumuua simba.
Ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omonto etuoni korwa ase Kabuseli. Ere agakora emeremo emenene, agaita abanto babere chituoni b’Abamoabu. Engaki ende, ekero ki’obokendu na amagena ’embura yatwete, agasoa engoro agaita endo aroro.

English: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
Kiswahili: Alimuua Mmisri aliyekuwa na urefu kama dhiraa tano. Ingawa Mmisri alikuwa na mkuki kama mti wa mfumaji mkononi mwake, Benaya alimwendea na rungu. Akamnyangʼanya Mmisri mkuki wake na kumuua nao.
Ekegusii: Naende agaita Omomisiri, omonto orenge nobotambe bw’ekerengo gie chimita ibere. Omomisiri oria nigo abwate ritimo koboko kwaye, riachomeire orotanga oronene buna omwaro, korende Benaya akamochiera nenyimbo, akamoura ritimo riarenge koboko kwaye, akamoitera ne ritimo riria riaye omonyene.

English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.
Kiswahili: Haya yalikuwa mambo ya ushujaa ya Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada; naye pia alikuwa maarufu kama wale mashujaa watatu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akorete. Nigo anyorete erieta rinene ase egati ya baria batato.

English: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliheshimiwa zaidi ya wale Thelathini, lakini hakujumuishwa miongoni mwa wale Watatu: Daudi akamweka kuwa kiongozi wa walinzi wake.
Ekegusii: Nonya osikire kobua baria Emerongo etato, tareng’anirie na baria batato. Daudi akamobeka akaba omoteneneri bw’abarendi b’obogima bwaye.

English: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
Kiswahili: Wale watu mashujaa walikuwa: Asaheli nduguye Yoabu, Elhanani mwana wa Dodo kutoka Bethlehemu,
Ekegusii: Abanto chituoni b’abasikari nabwo aba: Asaeli momura omwabo Yoabu, na Elihanani, mosinto o Dodo korwa Bethlehemu.

English: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
Kiswahili: Shamothi Mharori, Helesi Mpeloni,
Ekegusii: Samoti korwa Harodi na Helesi korwa Peleti;

English: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
Kiswahili: Ira mwana wa Ikeshi kutoka Tekoa, Abiezeri kutoka Anathothi,
Ekegusii: Ira, mosinto o Ikesi korwa Tekoa, na Abieseri korwa Anatoti;

English: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
Kiswahili: Sibekai Mhushathi, Ilai Mwahohi,
Ekegusii: Sibekai korwa Husa, na Ilai korwa Ahohi;

English: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
Kiswahili: Maharai Mnetofathi, Heledi mwana wa Baana, Mnetofathi,
Ekegusii: Maharai korwa Netofa, na Heledi, mosinto o Baana korwa Netofa;

English: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
Kiswahili: Itai mwana wa Ribai kutoka Gibea ya Benyamini, Benaya Mpirathoni,
Ekegusii: Itai, mosinto o Ribai korwa Gibea o Benjamini, na Benaya korwa Piratoni;

English: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
Kiswahili: Hurai kutoka mabonde ya Gaashi, Abieli Mwaribathi,
Ekegusii: Hurai korwa ase amakura ang’e na Gaasi, na Abieli korwa Ariba;

English: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
Kiswahili: Azmawethi Mbaharumi, Eliaba Mshaalboni,
Ekegusii: Asimaweti korwa Gahurimu na Eliaba korwa Saalaboni;

English: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
Kiswahili: wana wa Hashemu Mgiloni, Yonathani mwana wa Shagee Mharari,
Ekegusii: basinto ba Hasemu korwa Gisoni na Yonathani, mosinto o Sagee, korwa Harari;

English: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
Kiswahili: Ahiamu mwana wa Sakari Mharari, Elifale mwana wa Uru,
Ekegusii: Ahiamu, mosinto o Sakari korwa Harari, na Elifali, mosinto o Uri;

English: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
Kiswahili: Heferi Mmekerathi, Ahiya Mpeloni,
Ekegusii: Heferi korwa Mekera na Ahiya korwa Peloni

English: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
Kiswahili: Hezro Mkarmeli, Naarai mwana wa Ezbai,
Ekegusii: Hesero korwa Karimeli, na Naara, mosinto bw’Esibai;

English: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
Kiswahili: Yoeli nduguye Nathani, Mibhari mwana wa Hagri,
Ekegusii: Yoel, momura omwabo Nathani, na Mibihari, mosinto o Hagiri.

English: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),
Kiswahili: Seleki Mwamoni, Naharai Mbeerothi, mbeba silaha wa Yoabu mwana wa Seruya,
Ekegusii: Seleki korwa Amoni na Naharai korwa Beroti, omobogoria ebirwanero bia Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya;

English: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
Kiswahili: Ira Mwithiri, Garebu Mwithiri,
Ekegusii: Ira na Garebu korwa Itiri;

English: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
Kiswahili: Uria Mhiti, Zabadi mwana wa Alai,
Ekegusii: Uria Omohiti na Sabadi, mosinto bw’Alai,

English: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,
Kiswahili: Adina mwana wa Shiza Mreubeni, ambaye alikuwa mkuu wa Wareubeni, akiwa pamoja na watu thelathini,
Ekegusii: Adina, mosinto o Sisa bw’egesaku kia Rubeni, omoraai bw’abaanto b’egesaku ekio, na amo nere abanto emerongo etato;

English: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
Kiswahili: Hanani mwana wa Maaka, Yoshafati Mmithni,
Ekegusii: Hanani, mosinto o Maaka na Yosafati korwa Mitani;

English: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
Kiswahili: Uzia Mwashterathi, Shama na Yeieli wana wa Hothamu Mwaroeri,
Ekegusii: Usia korwa Asitera; Sama na Yeieli, basinto ba Hotamu korwa Aroeri;

English: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
Kiswahili: Yediaeli mwana wa Shimri, nduguye Yoha Mtizi,
Ekegusii: Yediaeli, mosinto o Simuri, na Yoha, momura omwabo, omonto o Tisi;

English: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
Kiswahili: Elieli Mmahawi, Yeribai na Yoshavia wana wa Elnaamu, Ithma Mmoabu,
Ekegusii: Elieli korwa Mahawa Yeribai na Yosawia, basinto b’Elinamu, na Itima korwa Moabu;

English: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
Kiswahili: Elieli, na Obedi na Yaasieli Mmesobai.
Ekegusii: Elieli, na Obedi, na Yaasieli korwa Soba.

English: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio watu waliomjia Daudi huko Siklagi, wakati alikuwa amefukuzwa mbele ya Sauli mwana wa Kishi (walikuwa miongoni mwa mashujaa waliomsaidia Daudi vitani,
Ekegusii: Daudi nigo amenyete Sikilagi, ekero arenge kwebisa korwa ase Saulo, mosinto o Kisi. Abanto chituoni abarenge komokonya ase esegi bagacha asare.

English: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.
Kiswahili: walikuwa na pinde na walikuwa na uwezo wa kupiga mishale au kutupa mawe kwa kombeo wakitumia mkono wa kushoto au wa kulia; hawa walikuwa ndugu zake Sauli kutoka kabila la Benyamini):
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babwate amata, na nigo bamanyete koruta emegwe na amagena e chinduruche nokoboko gw’okorio amo nogw’okobee. Aba nigo barenge Ababenjamini, abanto bamwabo Saulo. Abanto aba nabwo aba:

English: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
Kiswahili: Mkuu wao alikuwa Ahiezeri, na wa pili Yoashi, wote wana wa Shemaa Mgibeathi; pia Yezieli na Peleti wana wa Azmawethi; Beraka, Yehu Mwanathothi,
Ekegusii: Ahieseri orenge omonene obo, naende Yoashi; aba babere mbasinto ba Semaa korwa Gibea; Yesieli na Peleti basinto b’Asimaweti; Beraka na Yehu korwa Anatoti;

English: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;
Kiswahili: na Ishmaya Mgibeoni, shujaa miongoni mwa wale Thelathini, ambaye alikuwa kiongozi wa wale Thelathini; Yeremia, Yahazieli, Yohanani, Yozabadi, Mgederathi,
Ekegusii: Isimaya korwa Gibeoni, omonto etuoni naende omoraai ase egati y’abanto baria Emerongo etato; Yeremia na Yehasieli, Yohanani na Yosabadi korwa Gedera;

English: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;
Kiswahili: Eluzai, Yeremothi, Bealia, Shemaria, Shefatia, Mharufi;
Ekegusii: Elusai na Yerimoti, Bealia na Semaria, na Sefatia korwa Harufi;

English: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
Kiswahili: Elikana, Ishia, Azareli, Yoezeri na Yashobeamu, wana wa Kora;
Ekegusii: Elikana na Isia, Asareli na Yoeseri, na Yasobeamu, abarenge Abakora;

English: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
Kiswahili: Yoela na Zebadia, wana wa Yerohamu, kutoka Gedori.
Ekegusii: Yoela na Sebadia, basinto ba Yerohamu, korwa Gedori.

English: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Wagadi wakajitenga na kujiunga na Daudi katika ngome yake huko jangwani. Walikuwa mashujaa hodari, waliokuwa tayari kwa vita na wenye uwezo wa kutumia ngao na mkuki. Nyuso zao zilikuwa nyuso za simba na walikuwa na wepesi kama paa milimani.
Ekegusii: Abagadi bande bakagenda kobwatia Daudi agwo ase eburi yarenge ase erooro. Abanto aba nigo barenge chituoni, bamanyete korwana chiseegi, naende nigo bamanyete korwanera chinguba na amatimo. Amasio abo nigo arenge buna aye chindo, naende nigo barenge kominyoka buna chingabi igoro y’ebitunwa.

English: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
Kiswahili: Ezeri alikuwa mkuu wao, Obadia alikuwa wa pili katika uongozi, Eliabu wa tatu,
Ekegusii: Eseri nere orenge omotang’ani obo na Obadia oyo o kabere, na Eliabu oyo o gatato,

English: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
Kiswahili: Mishmana wa nne, Yeremia wa tano,
Ekegusii: na Misimana oyo o kane, na Yeremia oyo o gatano,

English: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
Kiswahili: Atai wa sita, Elieli wa saba,
Ekegusii: na Atai oyo o gatano na rimo, na Elieli oyo o gatano na kabere,

English: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
Kiswahili: Yohanani wa nane, Elzabadi wa tisa,
Ekegusii: na Yohanani oyo o gatano na gatato, na Elisabadi oyo o kianda,

English: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.
Kiswahili: Yeremia wa kumi, na Makbanai wa kumi na moja.
Ekegusii: na Yeremia oyo o ikomi, na Makibani oyo o ikomi na rimo.

English: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
Kiswahili: Hawa Wagadi walikuwa majemadari. Aliyekuwa wa mwisho kuliko wote aliweza kuongoza askari 100, na aliyekuwa na uweza zaidi ya wote aliongoza 1,000.
Ekegusii: Abagadi aba nigo barenge abatang’ani b’abasikari, na oyo otarenge ne chinguru nigo are konyara kobua abanto rigana erimo (100), na oyorenge ne chinguru nigo are konyara kobua abanto elifu eyemo (1,000).

English: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.
Kiswahili: Wao ndio walivuka Mto Yordani katika mwezi wa kwanza ukiwa umefurika hadi kwenye kingo zake zote na kusababisha watu wote waliokuwa wanaishi kwenye mabonde kukimbilia mashariki na wengine magharibi.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bambogete Yorodani ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, ekero orooche orwo rwaichorete goetania chingegu chinsemo chionsi, bagaseria abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense y’amaranya, ensemo ya moocha na eya bosongo.

English: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
Kiswahili: Wabenyamini wengine na baadhi ya watu kutoka Yuda pia walikuja kwa Daudi katika ngome yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande b’egesaku kia Benjamini, na ekia Yuda, bagacha ase eburi agwo ase Daudi arenge.

English: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akatoka nje kuwalaki na akawaambia, “Kama mmekuja kwangu kwa amani, kunisaidia, mimi niko tayari kuwaruhusu ninyi kuungana nami. Lakini kama mmekuja ili kunisaliti kwa adui zangu wakati mimi mikono yangu haina hatia, basi Mungu wa baba zetu aone na awahukumu.”
Ekegusii: Daudi agasoka kobarotota akabateebia, “Onye igo mwachire buna abasani baane monkonye, rirorio enkoro yane nebwatane nainwe, korende onye nigo mwachire monsigane na kondua ase ababisa baane, nonya amaboko aane takorete okomocha konde gwonsi, rirorio Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito arore amang’ana ayio abae egesusuro.”

English: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.
Kiswahili: Kisha Roho akaja juu ya Amasai, mkuu wa wale Thelathini, naye akasema: “Sisi tu watu wako, ee Daudi! Nasi tuko pamoja na wewe, ee mwana wa Yese! Ushindi, naam, ushindi uwe kwako, pia ushindi kwa wale walio upande wako, kwa kuwa Mungu wako atakusaidia.” Kwa hiyo Daudi akawapokea na kuwafanya viongozi wa vikosi vyake vya uvamizi.
Ekegusii: Erio omoika ogaacha igoro ase Amasai, omonene bw’abaanto baria Emerongo etato, nere agateeba, “Aye Daudi, intwe nigo tore abanto bao; na nigo tokobwatana amo naye, aye omwana o Yese. Omorembe obe asore, na omorembe obe ase abakogokonya, ekiagera Nyasae oo, nere okogokonya.” Erio Daudi akabanchera, akababeeka bakaba abatang’ani b’emeganda yaye y’esegi.

English: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya watu kutoka kabila la Manase wakajiunga na Daudi wakati alikwenda pamoja na Wafilisti, kupigana na Sauli. (Daudi na watu wake hawakuwasaidia Wafilisti kwa sababu, baada ya ushauri, watawala wao walimrudisha. Wakasema, “Itatugharimu vichwa vyetu kama Daudi atatuasi na kurudi kwa Sauli bwana wake.”)
Ekegusii: Abanto bande b’egesaku kia Manase bagatama, bakagenda ase Daudi ekero arenge kogenda amo n’Abafilisti korwania Saulo. Korende Abafirisiti tibaete Daudi ribaga abakoonye, ekiagera ekero abagaambi babo bagambete amo, bagateeba, Aise kogenda amo naintwe, ande nigo arabwatane amo na Saulo, omonene oye, igo batobutore emetwe.

English: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
Kiswahili: Daudi alipokwenda Siklagi, hawa ndio watu wa kabila la Manase waliojiunga naye: Adna, Yozabadi, Yediaeli, Mikaeli, Yozabadi, Elihu na Silethai, viongozi wa vikosi vya watu 1,000 katika kabila la Manase.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi agendete Sikilagi, abanto aba b’egesaku kia Manase bagacha asare: Adina na Yosabadi, Yediaeli na Mikaeli, Yosabadi na Elihu, na Siletai. Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri b’abaanto chilifu ba Manase.

English: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.
Kiswahili: Walimsaidia Daudi dhidi ya makundi ya uvamizi, kwa kuwa wote walikuwa mashujaa hodari na walikuwa majemadari katika jeshi lake.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bagokonya Daudi korwania ebiombe bi’abasakori. Abwo bonsi nigo barenge abanto chituoni, bakaba abatang’ani b’abasikari.

English: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.
Kiswahili: Siku baada ya siku watu walikuja kumsaidia Daudi, mpaka akawa na jeshi kubwa, kama jeshi la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Rituko ase rituko abanto bakagenderera gocha ase Daudi komokonya, goika agatwara abarwani abange mono, buna abasikari ba Nyasae.

English: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to Yahweh’s word.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio watu waliojiandaa kwa ajili ya vita waliokuja kwa Daudi huko Hebroni ili kumtwalia ufalme kutoka kwa Sauli, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amesema:
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’emeganda y’abasikari, baria bachete ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, buna Omonene achigete, erinde bamoe oborwoti boria bwarusetigwe ase Saulo.

English: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.
Kiswahili: watu wa Yuda, wanaochukua ngao na mikuki walikuwa 6,800 wote wakiwa tayari kwa vita.
Ekegusii: Abayuda ababogoretie chinguba na amatimo nigo barenge chilifu isano nemo, na amagana atano na atato (6,800), baisanerete ase okorwana esegi.

English: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Simeoni, mashujaa waliokuwa tayari kwa vita walikuwa 7,100.
Ekegusii: Abasimeoni nigo barenge chilifu isano na ibere, ne rigana erimo (7,100), abanto chituoni abakong’u ase esegi.

English: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Lawi walikuwa 4,600,
Ekegusii: Abalawi nigo barenge chilifu inye, na amagana atano na rimo (4,600),

English: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,
Kiswahili: pamoja na Yehoyada, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Aroni, aliyekuwa pamoja na watu 3,700,
Ekegusii: amo na Yehoyada, omoteneneri bw’eamate ya Aroni, na amo nere abanto chilifu isato, na amagana atano na abere (3,700);

English: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.
Kiswahili: na Sadoki, kijana shujaa na hodari, aliyekuwa pamoja na maafisa ishirini na wawili kutoka jamaa yake.
Ekegusii: na Zadoki, omomura etuoni, amo nabaanto bamwabo abatang’ani b’esegi emerongo ebere, na babere (22).

English: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Benyamini, ndugu zake Sauli, walikuwa 3,000; wengi wao walikuwa wameendelea kuwa waaminifu kwa Sauli mpaka wakati huo.
Ekegusii: Ababenjamini, abanto b’eamate ya Saulo, nigo barenge chilifu isato (3,000), nonya nase ekero ekio abange mono kobua b’abwo bagendererete kobwatana nenyomba ya Saulo.

English: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Efraimu, mashujaa hodari 20,800, watu waliokuwa maarufu katika koo zao.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaefraimu: chilifu emerongo ebere, na amagana atano na atato (20,800), abanto chituoni ase esegi bamanyekanete ase chiamate chiabo.

English: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
Kiswahili: Watu wa nusu ya kabila la Manase, waliotajwa kwa majina ili waje kumweka Daudi kuwa mfalme, watu 18,000.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku ekeng’ese kia Manase: chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000), baria batoretwe amarieta abo bache kobeeka Daudi abe omorwoti.

English: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Isakari, waliofahamu majira na kujua kile ambacho Israeli inapasa kufanya, walikuwa viongozi 200, pamoja na jamaa zao wote chini ya uongozi wao.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaisakaru: abanto abang’aini abamanyi ebimanyererio bie chingaki, bamanyete egento Abaisraeli bagwenerete gokora, abateneneri amagana abere (200), amo nabamwabo abarenge inse ase obochiki bwabo.

English: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Zabuloni, askari wenye uzoefu mkubwa walioandaliwa tayari kwa vita wakiwa na silaha za kila aina, ili kumsaidia Daudi kwa uaminifu thabiti, walikuwa 50,000.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abasabuloni: abarwani abakong’u baare nomoyo oyomo, baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, babwate ebirwanero biisaine, abanto chilifu emerongo etano (50,000).

English: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Naftali, maafisa 1,000, pamoja na watu 37,000 waliochukua ngao na mikuki.
Ekegusii: Korwa Abanafutali: abachiki elifu eyemo (1,000), amo nabaanto chilifu emerongo etato na isano na ibere (37,000), babwate chinguba na amatimo.

English: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Dani 28,600 waliokuwa tayari kwa vita.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abadani: abanto baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, chilifu emerongo ebere na isano na isato, na amagana atano na rimo (28,600).

English: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Asheri, askari 40,000 wenye uzoefu mkubwa waliondaliwa kwa ajili ya vita.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaaseri: abanto abakong’u baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, chilifu emerongo ene (40,000).

English: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.
Kiswahili: Na pia watu kutoka mashariki ya Yordani, watu wa Reubeni, Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase, wakiwa na kila aina ya silaha, watu 120,000.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abareubeni na Abagadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, abwo bamenyete ng’umbu ya Yorodani, abanto babwate ebirwanero bionsi bi’okorwana esegi, chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000).

English: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
Kiswahili: Wote hawa walikuwa watu wapiganaji waliojitolea kutumika katika safu zao. Walikuja Hebroni wakiwa wameamua kikamilifu kumfanya Daudi mfalme juu ya Israeli yote. Waisraeli wengine wote walikuwa pia na nia hiyo moja ya kumfanya Daudi kuwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Abarwani aba bonsi baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, na bagacha agwo Heburoni, bare nomoyo oyomo kobeeka Daudi koba omorwoti igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi. Boigo Abaisraeli bande bonsi nigo barenge nebirengererio ebimo bi’okobeeka Daudi abe omorwoti.

English: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.
Kiswahili: Watu hawa wakakaa huko na Daudi siku tatu, wakila na kunywa, kwa sababu jamaa zao zilikuwa zimewapatia mahitaji yao.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakabeera aroro amo na Daudi ase amatuko atato, bakaba bakoria na konywa, ekiagera abamwabo konya baabaariganeirie ebinto bionsi.

English: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.
Kiswahili: Pia, majirani zao hata wale walio mbali hadi Isakari, Zabuloni na Naftali, walikuja wakiwaletea vyakula walivyovibeba kwa punda, ngamia, nyumbu na maksai. Kulikuwepo na wingi wa unga, maandazi ya tini, maandazi ya zabibu kavu, divai, mafuta, ngʼombe na kondoo, kwa maana kulikuwa na furaha katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: Abaamate bamwabo abamenyete ang’e amo nabwo bamenyete ase chingongo chia Isakaru na Sabuloni, na Nafutali, abwo bakarenta chindagera babogoretie ne chitigere ne chingamia, ne chibarasi, ne chiombe; bakarenta chindagera chinyinge mono; obosie, na amabomba ’amako amomo na ay’amasabibu amomo, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ekiagera Abaisraeli nigo barenge nomogooko omonene.

English: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
Kiswahili: Daudi alishauriana na kila afisa wake, majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaba ogosemania nabanene bonsi abarenge abatang’ani b’abarwani elifu eyemo (1,000) na abe rigana erimo (100).

English: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of Yahweh our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote la Israeli, “Kama mkiona ni vyema, na kama ni mapenzi ya Bwana Mungu wetu, tupeleke ujumbe kwa ndugu zetu wengine walio mbali na walio karibu katika nchi yote ya Israeli, pia kwa makuhani na Walawi walio pamoja nao katika miji yao na katika sehemu zao za malisho yao, waje waungane na sisi.
Ekegusii: Erio agakwana n’Abaisraeli bonsi basangererekanete, akabateebia, “Onye ekororekana buya ase more, naende onye kore ogwancha kw’Omonene, Nyasae oito, tiga totome abanto gochia aaria na aaria barangerie abaminto baria batigarete ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli, na abakuani na Abalawi bakare ase emechie eria ere namarisio, erinde bachiche babe amo naintwe.

English: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”
Kiswahili: Sisi na tulirudishe Sanduku la Mungu wetu kwetu kwa maana hatukujali wakati wa utawala wa Sauli.”
Ekegusii: Erio torente naende Esanduki ya Nyasae oito ebeere amo naintwe, ekiagera ntwayetigete ase amatuko aria Saulo arenge kogamba.”

English: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko lote likakubaliana kufanya hivyo, kwa sababu ilionekana vyema kwa watu wote.
Ekegusii: Omosangererekano oria bwonsi bw’abaanto ogancha gokora amang’ana ayio, ekiagera nigo abeete amaronge ase abanto bonsi.

English: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi akawakusanya Waisraeli wote, kuanzia Mto Shihori ulioko Misri hadi Lebo-Hamathi, ili kulileta Sanduku la Mungu kutoka Kiriath-Yearimu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Sihori ya Misiri goika egesoero kia Hamati, erinde barente Esanduki eria ya Nyasae korwa Kiriati‐Yearimu.

English: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God Yahweh’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
Kiswahili: Daudi akiwa pamoja na Waisraeli wote wakaenda Baala ya Yuda (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu) kulipandisha Sanduku la Mungu Bwana, yeye anayeketi katika kiti cha enzi kati ya makerubi: Sanduku linaloitwa kwa Jina lake, kutoka huko.
Ekegusii: Daudi amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakagenda Baala (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), orenge bw’Abayuda, korenta korwa aroro Esanduki ya Nyasae, eyio ekorokwa ase erieta ri’Omonene, oyio omenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

English: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
Kiswahili: Wakalisafirisha Sanduku la Mungu kwa gari jipya la kukokotwa na maksai kutoka nyumba ya Abinadabu, Uza na Ahio wakiliongoza gari hilo.
Ekegusii: Bakarusia Esanduki eria ya Nyasae korwa ase enyomba y’Abinadabu, bakayebeeka igoro ase egari enyia. Usa na Ahiyo nabwo barenge koraa egari eria.

English: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.
Kiswahili: Daudi pamoja na Waisraeli wote walikuwa wanasifu kwa nguvu zao zote mbele za Mungu, kwa nyimbo na kwa vinubi, zeze, matari, matoazi na tarumbeta.
Ekegusii: Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bagochenga ase obosio bwa Nyasae ne chinguru chiabo chionsi, bagotera na kobugia amakano ’ebirigisa, na amakano ande, na ebikonu, ne chisani chigoakanigwa na kwoga, na ebitureeri.

English: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
Kiswahili: Walipofika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka wa Kidoni, Uza akaunyoosha mkono wake ili kulizuia Sanduku, kwa sababu maksai walijikwaa.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase ekeooreri gia Kidoni, Usa akarambora okoboko kwaye gosiira Esanduki eria, ekiagera chiombe chiare kong’usa egari chiagochetwe.

English: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
Kiswahili: Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Uza, akampiga kwa sababu aliuweka mkono wake kwenye Sanduku. Kwa hiyo akafa pale mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Usa, akamoaka, ekiagera akunete Esanduki eria; na Usa agakwera aroro ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akakasirika kwa sababu ghadhabu ya Bwana ilifurika dhidi ya Uza, mahali pale pakaitwa Peres-Uza hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Daudi akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Omonene aitete Usa. Aase aria akarokwa Peresi‐Usa, naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
Kiswahili: Siku ile Daudi akamwogopa Mungu naye akauliza. “Nitawezaje kulichukua Sanduku la Mungu kwangu?”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Daudi akairoka Nyasae, akabora, “Naki rende ndakore imbe noboremu ndete Esanduki ya Nyasae nka bwone?”

English: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
Kiswahili: Hakulichukua hilo Sanduku akae nalo katika Mji wa Daudi. Badala yake, akalipeleka nyumbani kwa Obed-Edomu, Mgiti.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi tairete Esanduki eria mwaye ase omochie okorokwa Omochie o Daudi, korende akayebogoria akayebeka nyomba mw’Obedi‐Edomu, Omogiti.

English: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Mungu likabaki pamoja na jamaa ya Obed-Edomu, nyumbani kwake kwa miezi mitatu, naye Bwana akaibariki nyumba yake pamoja na kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.
Ekegusii: Esanduki eria ya Nyasae ekabeera ase enka y’Obedi‐Edomu nyomba ime ase engaki y’emetienyi etato; n’Omonene agasesenia enka y’Obedi‐Edomu na ebinto bionsi abwate.

English: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
Kiswahili: Basi Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro akawatuma wajumbe kwa Daudi, wakiwa na magogo ya mierezi, waashi na maseremala ili kumjengea jumba la kifalme.
Ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, agatoma abatomwa ase Daudi, akamotomera ebingese bi’emete y’emecharake na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, erinde baagachere Daudi enyomba.

English: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.
Kiswahili: Naye Daudi akatambua kwamba Bwana amemwimarisha kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli na kwamba ufalme wake umetukuzwa kwa ajili ya Israeli, watu wake.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akamanya ng’a Omonene omokong’irie ase okoba omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, na omoimokereirie igoro ase engencho y’abanto baye Abaisraeli.

English: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
Kiswahili: Huko Yerusalemu Daudi akaoa wake wengine zaidi na akawa baba wa wana na mabinti wengi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akanyuoma abakungu bande agwo Yerusalemu, na abwo bakamoiborera abana abange, abamura na abaiseke.

English: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya watoto waliozaliwa kwake huko: Shamua, Shobabu, Nathani, Solomoni,
Ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu: Samua na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani,

English: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
Kiswahili: Ibihari, Elishua, Elpeleti,
Ekegusii: Ibuhari na Eliasama, na Elifeleti,

English: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
Kiswahili: Noga, Nefegi, Yafia,
Ekegusii: Noga na Nefegi, na Yafia,

English: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
Kiswahili: Elishama, Beeliada na Elifeleti.
Ekegusii: Elisama na Beliada, na Elifeleti.

English: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti waliposikia kuwa Daudi ametiwa mafuta kuwa mfalme wa Israeli yote, wakapanda na jeshi lao lote kwenda kumsaka, lakini Daudi akapata habari hizo, naye akatoka ili kwenda kukabiliana nao.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abafirisiti baigwete ng’a Daudi oakirwe amaguta obeire omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi, bagatiira gochia komorigia. Daudi akaigwa ayio, akagenda koumerana nabarabwo ase okorwana esegi.

English: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
Kiswahili: Basi Wafilisti walikuwa wameingia na kushambulia Bonde la Warefai,
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagacha gosakora agwo ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.
