English: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Daudi akamuuliza Mungu: “Je, niende kuwashambulia hao Wafilisti? Je, utawatia mikononi mwangu?” Bwana akamjibu, “Nenda, nitawatia mikononi mwako.”
Ekegusii: Na Daudi akaboria Nyasae “Inee! Ndagenda korwania Abafirisiti?” Nobabeeke ase amaboko aane gose? Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda, nimbabeeke ase amaboko ao.”

English: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Daudi pamoja na watu wake wakakwea mpaka Baal-Perasimu, akawashinda huko. Akasema, “Kama maji yafurikavyo, Mungu amewafurikia adui zangu kwa kutumia mkono wangu.” Kwa hiyo mahali pale pakaitwa Baal-Perasimu.
Ekegusii: Daudi akagenda goika Baali‐Perasimu, akababua agwo. Erio akabora, “Nyasae okoroorire ababisa baane goetera ase okoboko kwane, buna chiooro chi’amaache are nemerindo chigokoroora.” Ase ayio bakaroka aase aria Baali‐Perasimu.

English: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.
Kiswahili: Wafilisti walikuwa wameacha miungu yao huko, Daudi akaamuru iteketezwe kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagatiga chinyasae chiabo aroro, na Daudi agachiika abanto, bachisambe nomorero.

English: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.
Kiswahili: Kwa mara nyingine Wafilisti wakavamia lile bonde;
Ekegusii: Naende Abafirisiti bakagenda aroro eria kabere bagasakora.

English: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.
Kiswahili: hivyo Daudi akamuuliza Mungu tena, naye Mungu akamjibu, “Usiwapandie moja kwa moja, bali wazungukie na uwashambulie kutoka mbele ya hiyo miti ya miforosadi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aboretie Nyasae naende, Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobarwania esegi korwa aa, korende oetanane ogende obatubokere korwa magega ase emete ekorokwa balisamu ere.

English: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
Kiswahili: Mara usikiapo sauti ya kwenda juu ya hiyo miti ya miforosadi, hapo ndipo utoke upigane vita, kwa sababu hiyo itaonyesha kwamba Mungu amekutangulia ili kupiga jeshi la Wafilisti.”
Ekegusii: Na ekero oraigwe ebititiro bigoeta ase emete eyio igoro, erio ogende korwana esegi; omanye ng’a Nyasae ogotang’aneire kobua abarwani b’Abafilisti.”

English: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akafanya kama alivyoagizwa na Mungu, wakalipiga jeshi la Wafilisti kuanzia Gibeoni hadi Gezeri.
Ekegusii: Daudi agakora buna Nyasae amochigeete, na barabwo bagaita abarwani b’Abafilisti korwa Gibeoni goikera Geseri.

English: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.
Kiswahili: Hivyo umaarufu wa Daudi ukaenea katika kila nchi, naye Bwana akayafanya mataifa yote kumwogopa Daudi.
Ekegusii: Chinkuma chia Daudi chigasarera ase chinse chionsi; n’Omonene akarentera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi obwoba, bakamoiroka.

English: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Daudi kujijengea nyumba zake katika Mji wa Daudi, akatengeneza sehemu kwa ajili ya Sanduku la Mungu, kisha akasimamisha hema kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Daudi akeagachera chinyomba agwo ase Omochie o Daudi. Akaroisia aase ase Esanduki ya Nyasae yare koganchwa, naende akayeteneneria eema aroro.

English: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akasema, “Hakuna mtu yeyote anayeruhusiwa kulibeba Sanduku la Mungu isipokuwa Walawi peke yao, kwa sababu Bwana aliwachagua kulibeba Sanduku la Bwana na kuhudumu mbele zake milele.”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabora, “Onde takobogoria Esanduki eria ya Nyasae otatiga Abalawi boka, ekiagera Omonene nigo achorete Abalawi babe bakobogoria Esanduki y’Omonene, naende bamokorere botambe.”

English: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
Kiswahili: Daudi akawakusanya Israeli wote huko Yerusalemu ili kulipandisha Sanduku la Bwana na kulileta hadi kwenye sehemu aliyokuwa ametengeneza kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Yerusalemu gochia korenta Esanduki eria y’Omonene gocha aase aye ayeroiseretie.

English: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akawakusanya pamoja wazao wa Aroni na Walawi:
Ekegusii: Naende agasangereria amo abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni na Abalawi.

English: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Kohathi, Urieli kiongozi na ndugu zake 120,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase eamate ya Kohati: Urieli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere (120);

English: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Merari, Asaya kiongozi na ndugu zake 220.
Ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Merari: Asaia, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo amagana abere, na emerongo ebere (220);

English: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Gershoni, Yoeli kiongozi na ndugu zake 130.
Ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Gerisomu: Yoel, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na emerongo etato (130);

English: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Elisafani, Shemaya kiongozi na ndugu zake 200.
Ekegusii: korwa ase eamate y’Elisafani: Semaya, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo amagana abere (200);

English: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Hebroni, Elieli kiongozi na ndugu zake 80.
Ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Heburoni Elieli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo emerongo etano na etato (80);

English: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
Kiswahili: Kutoka wazao wa Uzieli, Aminadabu kiongozi na ndugu zake 112.
Ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Usieli: Aminadabu, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112).

English: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akawaita makuhani Sadoki na Abiathari, pamoja na Walawi Urieli, Asaya, Yoeli, Shemaya, Elieli na Aminadabu.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria abakuani Zadoki na Abiatari, naende Abalawi: Urieli na Asaia, Yoel na Semaya, Elieli na Aminadabu,

English: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Ninyi ndio viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi. Ninyi pamoja na Walawi wenzenu inawapasa mjitakase na kulipandisha Sanduku la Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli hadi mahali ambapo nimetengeneza kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Inwe nabateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi, echene inwe abanyene amo nabaanto bamino, mochie kwoyia Esanduki eria y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, moyebeke aase agwo inche nayeroiseirie.

English: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa ni kwa sababu hii, ninyi Walawi, hamkulipandisha Sanduku la Bwana mara ya kwanza, hata ikasababisha Bwana Mungu wetu kuwaka hasira dhidi yetu. Hatukumuuliza jinsi ya kufanya ili tupate kulileta jinsi alivyoagiza.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe timwayebogoretie engaki eria entang’ani, Omonene, Nyasae oito, atoete egesusuro; titwamorigetie buna atochigeete.”

English: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo makuhani pamoja na Walawi wakajitakasa ili kulipandisha Sanduku la Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abakuani na Abalawi bagechena abanyene, erinde bachie korenta Esanduki eria y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh’s word.
Kiswahili: Nao Walawi wakalichukua Sanduku la Mungu mabegani mwao wakitumia mipiko, kama vile Mose alivyoamuru sawasawa na neno la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abalawi bakabogoria Esanduki eria ya Nyasae nemiaro igoro ase amareko abo, buna Musa abachigete koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene.

English: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.
Kiswahili: Daudi akawaambia viongozi wa Walawi kuwaweka ndugu zao waimbaji ili waimbe nyimbo za shangwe, wakiwa na vyombo vya uimbaji: zeze, vinubi na matoazi.
Ekegusii: Boigo Daudi agachiika abatang’ani b’Abalawi bachore abanto bamwabo babe abateri, baranyare kobugia ebinto bigoterera ase amariogi, ababugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa, ne chisani chigoakanigwa na kwoga ase ogoteera nomogooko.

English: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
Kiswahili: Basi Walawi wakawaweka Hemani mwana wa Yoeli; kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zake, Asafu mwana wa Berekia; kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zao Wamerari, Ethani mwana wa Kushaiya;
Ekegusii: Ase igo Abalawi bagachora Hemani, mosinto o Yoel, na ase abanto bamwabo Asafu, mosinto o Berekia, na ase ororeria rwa Merari abanto bamwabo Etani, mosinto o Kusaya.

English: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
Kiswahili: hawa ndio waliochaguliwa kuwa wasaidizi wao: Zekaria, Yaazieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Uni, Eliabu, Benaya, Maaseya, Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, pamoja na mabawabu Obed-Edomu na Yehieli.
Ekegusii: Ase okobakonya baria bachorire abanto bamwabo b’omooroberio o kabere: Zakaria na Yasieli, Semiramoti na Yeieli, Uni na Eliabu, Benaya na Maaseya. Naende bagachora Matitia na Elifelehu, na Mikineya, na abarendi b’egeita Obedi‐Edomu na Yeieli.

English: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
Kiswahili: Waimbaji Hemani, Asafu na Ethani walichaguliwa kupiga matoazi ya shaba;
Ekegusii: Abateri baria Hemani na Asafu, na Etani babe bakobugia chisani chi’etai chikobugigwa na kwoga.

English: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;
Kiswahili: Zekaria, Azieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Uni, Eliabu, Maaseya na Benaya walikuwa wapiga zeze kufuatana na sauti ya alamothi,
Ekegusii: Zakaria na Yasieli, Semiramoti na Yehieli, Uni na Eliabu, Maaseya na Benaya, aba babe bakobugia amakano koreng’ana buna amariogi a igoro ay’Alamoti.

English: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
Kiswahili: na Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-Edomu, Yehieli na Azazia walikuwa wapiga vinubi, wakiongozwa kwa kufuata sauti ya sheminithi.
Ekegusii: Korende Matitia na Elifelehu, Mikineya na Obedi‐Edomu, Yeieli na Asasia babe abaraai ase okobugia amakano koreng’ana buna amariogi a inse a Seminiti.

English: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.
Kiswahili: Kenania kiongozi wa Walawi alikuwa msimamizi wa uimbaji; huu ndio uliokuwa wajibu wake kwa sababu alikuwa stadi katika hilo.
Ekegusii: Kenania, omoraai bw’Abalawi ase amatera, abe omoteria, ekiagera namanyete emeremo eyio.

English: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
Kiswahili: Berekia na Elikana walikuwa mabawabu kwa ajili ya Sanduku.
Ekegusii: Berekia na Elikana babe abarendi b’egeita ase Esanduki eria y’Omonene.

English: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
Kiswahili: Shebania, Yoshafati, Nethaneli, Amasai, Zekaria, Benaya na Eliezeri, makuhani, walikuwa wapiga tarumbeta mbele ya Sanduku la Mungu. Obed-Edomu na Yehiya waliwekwa pia kuwa mabawabu wa Sanduku.
Ekegusii: Sebania na Yehosafati, Netaneli na Amasai, Zakaria na Benaya, na Eliezeri, abakuani, babe bakobugia ebitureeri bosio bw’Esanduki eria ya Nyasae. Obedi‐Edomu na Yehia barabwo babe abarendi b’egeita ase Esanduki eria.

English: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi pamoja na wazee wa Israeli na majemadari wa vikosi vya elfu wakaenda ili kulipandisha Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kutoka nyumba ya Obed-Edomu kwa shangwe.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu bakagenda kwoyia Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, korwa ase enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, bagachenga nomogooko omonene mono.

English: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa amewasaidia Walawi waliokuwa wanalichukua Sanduku la Agano la Bwana, mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba walitolewa dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae akonyete Abalawi baria babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, bakarua ebing’wanso bie chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere.

English: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi alikuwa amevaa joho la kitani safi, kama walivyokuwa wamevaa Walawi wote waliokuwa wanalichukua lile Sanduku, waimbaji nao walivaa vivyo hivyo, pamoja na Kenania aliyekuwa anaongoza nyimbo za waimbaji. Daudi alivaa pia kisibau cha kitani safi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka eanga engiya y’egatani, boigo n’Abalawi baria bonsi babogoretie Esanduki eria bakabeeka, na abateri boigo, na Kenania, omoteria bw’abateri. Daudi akabeeka negesibao ki’egatani.

English: Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Israeli wote wakalipandisha Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kwa shangwe, wakipiga pembe za kondoo dume, tarumbeta, matoazi, wakipiga zeze na vinubi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bakarenta Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene. Bagaaka amariogi ’omochengo, bakabugia chingoma na eirombeta, ne chisani chigoakanigwa chikwoga, naende bakabugia mono namakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa.

English: As the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
Kiswahili: Sanduku la Agano la Bwana lilipokuwa linaingia katika Mji wa Daudi, Mikali binti Sauli akachungulia dirishani. Naye alipomwona Mfalme Daudi akicheza na kusherehekea, akamdharau moyoni mwake.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene yare korentwa ase Omochie o Daudi, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Daudi omorwoti ogocharoka‐charoka na gotenga ore nomogooko, akamochaya ase omoyo oye ime.

English: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
Kiswahili: Wakaleta Sanduku la Mungu na kuliweka ndani ya hema ambalo Daudi alikuwa amelisimamisha kwa ajili yake, na wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Kobarentire Esanduki eria ya Nyasae, bakayebeeka ime ase eema eria Daudi ayeteneneretie, bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Daudi kumaliza kutoa hizo sadaka za kuteketezwa na hizo sadaka za amani, akawabariki watu katika jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Daudi akoorire korua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na eki’omorembe agasesenia abanto ase erieta ri’Omonene.

English: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamgawia kila Mwisraeli mwanaume na mwanamke mkate, andazi la tende na andazi la zabibu kavu.
Ekegusii: Naende akagaba endagera ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, ase abasacha na abakungu; kera oyomo akaegwa omogati oyomo, na enyama inke, ne ribomba ri’amasasabibu amomo.

English: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before Yahweh’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel:
Kiswahili: Akawaweka pia baadhi ya Walawi ili wahudumu mbele ya Sanduku la Bwana kufanya maombi, kumshukuru na kumsifu Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli:
Ekegusii: Naende agachora abanto bande b’Abalawi bakaba abakoreri bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Omonene, bakaba bagotogia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono na komobaka.

English: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
Kiswahili: Asafu ndiye alikuwa mkuu wao, akisaidiwa na Zekaria, Yeieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Matithia, Eliabu, Benaya, Obed-Edomu na Yeieli. Hawa ndio wangepiga zeze na vinubi, Asafu angepiga matoazi,
Ekegusii: Asafu nere orenge omotang’ani obo. Abaare komobwatia nabwo aba: Zakaria na Yeieli, Semiramoti na Yehieli, Matitia na Eliabu, Benaya na Obedi‐Edomu, na Yeieli, baria barenge kobugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Asafu agaakania chisani chiarenge kwoga.

English: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
Kiswahili: nao Benaya na Yahazieli makuhani, ndio wangepiga tarumbeta mara kwa mara mbele ya Sanduku la Agano la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Benaya na Yahasieli, abakuani, bakaba bakobugia ebitureeri botambe agwo bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire Okobwatana kwa Nyasae.

English: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to Yahweh by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
Kiswahili: Siku ile, kitu cha kwanza Daudi alichofanya ni kumkabidhi Asafu na wenzake zaburi hii ya shukrani kwa Bwana:
Ekegusii: Rituko eri nario Daudi achigete ritang’ani ng’a ogoteera gw’okomoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono goterwe n’Asafu na abanto bamwabo ase enchera eyio.

English: Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, liitieni jina lake; wajulisheni mataifa yale aliyoyatenda.
Ekegusii: Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono! Rangeria erieta riaye ase ogokonywa, teebia abanto b’ebisaku ogokora kwaye.

English: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni yeye, mwimbieni yeye sifa; waambieni matendo yake yote ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia; raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia.

English: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
Kiswahili: Lishangilieni jina lake takatifu; mioyo ya wale wamtafutao Bwana na ifurahi.
Ekegusii: Etogerie erieta riaye richenu, abanto bonsi abakorigia Omonene basasoke ase chinkoro chiabo ime.

English: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
Kiswahili: Mtafuteni Bwana na nguvu zake; utafuteni uso wake siku zote.
Ekegusii: Rigia Omonene amo ne chinguru chiaye, morigie mobe ase obosio bwaye botambe.

English: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
Kiswahili: Kumbuka matendo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya, miujiza yake na hukumu alizozitamka,
Ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Israeli, omosomba bw’Omonene, inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abachore b’Omonene, inyora ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia na amakumia aye amo nebiina anachete.

English: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
Kiswahili: enyi wazao wa Israeli mtumishi wake, enyi wana wa Yakobo, wateule wake.
Ekegusii: Ere nere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebiina biaye nigo bire ase ense yonsi.

English: He is Yahweh our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye Bwana Mungu wetu; hukumu zake zimo duniani pote.
Ekegusii: Inyora botambe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, goika ebiaare elifu mobe mokoinyora ring’ana achigete,

English: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
Kiswahili: Hulikumbuka agano lake milele, neno ambalo aliamuru, kwa vizazi elfu,
Ekegusii: na okobwatana koria kw’ogotianania akorete na Aburaamu, na eira yaye y’ogotianania arierete Isaka.

English: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
Kiswahili: agano alilolifanya na Abrahamu, kiapo alichomwapia Isaki.
Ekegusii: Eira eyio aenegetie koba ase Yakobo buna ogochika, ee, ase Israeli okobwatana gwa kare na kare,

English: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
Kiswahili: Alilithibitisha kwa Yakobo kuwa amri, kwa Israeli liwe agano la milele:
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Aye ninkoe ense ya Kaanani ebe omwando bw’ororeria rwao.”

English: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
Kiswahili: “Nitakupa wewe nchi ya Kanaani kuwa sehemu utakayoirithi.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria nigo barenge abake ase omobaro, bakabarwa ng’a tibaisaini gento, nigo barenge abaeti ase ense eyio.

English: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wachache kwa idadi, wachache sana na wageni ndani yake,
Ekegusii: Bakaba bagoetanana korwa ase egesaku ekemo gochia ase ekende, na korwa ase oborwoti obomo gochia ase obonde.

English: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
Kiswahili: walitangatanga kutoka taifa moja hadi jingine, kutoka ufalme mmoja hadi mwingine.
Ekegusii: Nyasae tatigete abanto bande baabachande; agatogonyera abarwoti ase engencho yabo,

English: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
Kiswahili: Hakuruhusu mtu yeyote awaonee; kwa ajili yao aliwakemea wafalme, akisema:
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Timobaisa gokuna abaakwa amaguta baane, gose timokorera ababani baane bobe!”

English: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
Kiswahili: “Msiwaguse niliowatia mafuta; msiwadhuru manabii wangu.”
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, moterere Omonene! Raria ogotooreka kwaye rituko ase rituko!

English: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana dunia yote; tangazeni wokovu wake siku baada ya siku.
Ekegusii: Raria obonene bwaye ase egati y’ebisaku, na ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ase abanto bonsi!

English: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
Kiswahili: Tangazeni utukufu wake katikati ya mataifa, matendo yake ya ajabu miongoni mwa mataifa yote.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe, na airokwe goetania chinyasae chinde.

English: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mkuu, mwenye kustahili kusifiwa kuliko wote; yeye ni wa kuogopwa kuliko miungu yote.
Ekegusii: Chinyasae chionsi chi’abaanto b’ebisaku nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa rioka, korende Omonene nere otongete igoro chionsi.

English: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana miungu yote ya mataifa ni sanamu, lakini Bwana aliziumba mbingu.
Ekegusii: Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na omogooko nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye.

English: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
Kiswahili: Fahari na enzi viko mbele yake; nguvu na utukufu vimo patakatifu pake.
Ekegusii: Inwe abe chiamate chi’abaanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye!

English: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of the peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength!
Kiswahili: Mpeni Bwana, enyi jamaa za mataifa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu,
Ekegusii: Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye; moche ase obosio bwaye morentane ebiegwa, mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu!

English: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
Kiswahili: mpeni Bwana utukufu unaostahili jina lake. Leteni sadaka na mje katika nyua zake; mwabuduni Bwana katika uzuri wa utakatifu wake.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye, ee, ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa.

English: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
Kiswahili: Dunia yote na itetemeke mbele zake! Ulimwengu ameuweka imara; hauwezi kusogezwa.
Ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogooko na ense echenge, abanto b’ebisaku bateebigwe: “Omonene nere okogamba.”

English: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”
Kiswahili: Mbingu na zishangilie, nchi na ifurahi; semeni katikati ya mataifa, “Bwana anatawala!”
Ekegusii: Tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo n’ebinto bionsi bire ime yaye, na emegondo echenge amo n’ebinto bionsi bireo.

English: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!
Kiswahili: Bahari na ivume, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake; mashamba na yashangilie, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Erio emete ye rinani netere nomogooko ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ere ngocha are konachera ense ekiina.

English: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.
Kiswahili: Kisha miti ya msituni itaimba, itaimba kwa furaha mbele za Bwana, kwa maana anakuja kuihukumu dunia.
Ekegusii: Iraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete kare na kare.

English: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Kwana: Aye Nyasae, ogotooreka gwaito, totoorie, otosangererie amo, na otoboorie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, erinde totogie erieta riao richenu, na twetogerie ogotogigwa kwao.

English: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
Kiswahili: Mlilieni, “Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, tuokoe. Tukusanye tena na utukomboe kutoka kwa mataifa, ili tuweze kulishukuru jina lako takatifu, na kushangilia katika sifa zako.”
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe, korwa kare na kare, na gochia kare na kare! Erio abanto bonsi bagateeba, “Amina!” Na bakamotogia Omonene.

English: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Atukuzwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele na hata milele. Nao watu wote wakasema, “Amen,” na “Msifuni Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agatiga Asafu na abanto bamwabo agwo bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene babe abakoreri asare botambe, buna okogania gwa kera rituko kwarenge.

English: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwacha Asafu na wenzake mbele ya Sanduku la Agano la Bwana ili wahudumu humo mara kwa mara, kulingana na mahitaji ya kila siku.
Ekegusii: Obedi‐Edomu na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano na batato (68). Ere Obedi‐Edomu mosinto o Yedutuni, na Hosea, bakabeekwa bakaba abarendi b’egeita.

English: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
Kiswahili: Pia akamwacha Obed-Edomu pamoja na wenzake sitini na wanane wahudumu pamoja nao. Obed-Edomu mwana wa Yeduthuni na pia Hosa walikuwa mabawabu wa lango.
Ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka Zadoki Omokuani amo nabakuani bande bamwabo, babe bagokorera Omonene ase Eema yaye agwo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa aaria Gibeoni.

English: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before Yahweh’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwacha kuhani Sadoki pamoja na makuhani wenzake mbele ya hema ya ibada ya Bwana katika mahali pa juu pa kuabudia huko Gibeoni
Ekegusii: Kera emambia na omogoroba botambe babe bakorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, koreng’ana buna arigetwe ase amachiiko ari’Omonene aete Abaisraeli.

English: to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in Yahweh’s law, which he commanded to Israel;
Kiswahili: ili kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa Bwana kwenye madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa mara kwa mara, asubuhi na jioni, sawasawa na kila kitu kilichoandikwa katika sheria ya Bwana ambayo alikuwa amempa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge Hemani na Yedutuni, na abanto baria bachoretwe na korikwa amarieta abo ase okoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye obwo bogendererete kare na kare.

English: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Waliohudumu pamoja nao walikuwa Hemani, Yeduthuni na wale wote waliochaguliwa na kutajwa kwa jina kumpa Bwana shukrani, “Kwa maana fadhili zake zadumu milele.”
Ekegusii: Hemani na Yedutuni nigo bagachete ebitureeri ne chisani chiarenge kwoga ekero chiare goakanigwa, amo n’ebinto binde biare kobugigwa ekero amatera amaachenu agoterwa. Abanto b’eamate ya Yedutuni bagachorwa korenda egeita.

English: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
Kiswahili: Hemani na Yeduthuni walikuwa na wajibu wa kupiga tarumbeta, matoazi na kutumia vyombo vingine kwa ajili ya nyimbo za sifa kwa Mungu. Wana wa Yeduthuni waliwekwa langoni.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakarua agwo, kera omonto akagenda nka bwoye, na Daudi akagenda bwoye gosesenia abanto b’enyomba yaye.

English: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of Yahweh’s covenant is in a tent.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya Daudi kuingia rasmi katika jumba lake la kifalme, akamwambia nabii Nathani, “Hebu tazama, mimi ninakaa kwenye nyumba nzuri iliyojengwa kwa mierezi, wakati Sanduku la Agano la Bwana liko ndani ya hema.”
Ekegusii: Bono ekero Daudi amenyete ase enyomba yaye agakwana na Nathani omobani, agateeba, “Rora inche nigo imenyete ase enyomba eagachire nemecharake, korende Esanduki ya Nyasae ero nigo ere ase eema ime.”

English: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”
Kiswahili: Nathani akamjibu Daudi, “Lolote ulilo nalo moyoni mwako litende, kwa maana Mungu yu pamoja nawe.”
Ekegusii: Nathani agateebia Daudi, “Kora ande onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naye.”

English: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
Kiswahili: Usiku ule neno la Mungu likamjia Nathani, kusema:
Ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko obwo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Nathani, rikamoteebia,

English: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;
Kiswahili: “Nenda ukamwambie mtumishi wangu Daudi, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Wewe hutanijengea mimi nyumba ili nikae humo.
Ekegusii: “Genda oteebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Aye tokong’agachera enyomba imenye imeo.

English: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.
Kiswahili: Mimi sijakaa ndani ya nyumba tangu siku ile niliyowatoa Israeli kutoka Misri mpaka leo. Nimehama kutoka hema moja hadi jingine na kutoka mahali pamoja hadi pengine.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria nang’anyetie Abaisraeli goika rituko ria reero inche tinana komenya ime ase enyomba, korende nabeire nkona‐kogenda korwa eyemo goika eyende, na korwa obomenyo obomo goika obonde.

English: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
Kiswahili: Je, popote nilipokwenda pamoja na Waisraeli wote, wakati wowote nilimwambia kiongozi yeyote niliyemwagiza kuwachunga watu wangu, kwa nini hujanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?’
Ekegusii: Aase ande onsi nabeire nkona‐kogenda amo n’Abaisraeli, tinana koboria mogambi onde bw’Abaisraeli, oyo nabegete akaba omorisia bw’abaanto baane ng’a nase ki atang’agachereti obomenyo bw’emecharake.

English: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi, mwambie mtumishi wangu Daudi, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: Nilikuchukua machungani na kutoka kuandama kondoo ili uwatawale watu wangu Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro orateebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nateebire iga: Nigo nakorusetie korwa ase kwarenge korisia ching’ondi, erinde obe gokogambera abanto baane Abaisraeli;

English: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa pamoja nawe popote ulipokwenda, nami nimekuondolea mbali adui zako wote mbele yako. Basi nitalifanya jina lako kuwa kuu kama majina ya watu walio wakuu sana duniani.
Ekegusii: nainche nkaba amo naye aande onsi ase kware kogenda ngasiria ababisa bao bonsi korwa ase obosio bwao; inche ninkore erieta riao rimanyekane, buna amarieta ’abaanto abanene b’ense amanyekanete.

English: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,
Kiswahili: Nami nitawapatia watu wangu Israeli mahali na nitawapa ili wawe na mahali pao wenyewe pa kuishi na wasisumbuliwe tena. Watu waovu hawatawaonea tena, kama walivyofanya mwanzoni,
Ekegusii: Ninchorere abanto baane Abaisraeli aase ndababeekere bamenye, aase abo abanyene, na abakori amabe tibakobachanda naende nonya ng’ake buna baabachandete agwo ritang’ani

English: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that Yahweh will build you a house.
Kiswahili: na ambavyo wamefanya siku zote tangu nilipowachagua viongozi kwa ajili ya watu wangu Israeli. Pia nitawatiisha adui zenu wote. “ ‘Pamoja na hayo ninakuambia kwamba Bwana atakujengea nyumba:
Ekegusii: korwa engaki eria nachorete abagaambi igoro ase abanto baane Abaisraeli. Boigo nimbue ababisa bao bonsi. Na bono nigo ngokomanyia ng’a inche Omonene ninkoagachere enyomba.

English: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
Kiswahili: Wakati wako utakapokuwa umekwisha, nawe ukawa umekwenda kukaa na baba zako, nitamwinua mzao wako aingie mahali pako kuwa mfalme, mmoja wa wana wako mwenyewe, nami nitaufanya imara ufalme wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko ao araikeranigwe na obe gokogenda korara ase chisokoro chiao chiaraarete, nimbeke oyomo bw’ororeria rwao, oyorarue ase oyomo bw’abamura bao, agambe; nainche ninkong’ie oborwoti bwaye.

English: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili yangu, nami nitakifanya imara kiti cha ufalme wake milele.
Ekegusii: Oyio nere orang’agachere enyomba; nainche ninkong’ie ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti kebeo kogenderera botambe.

English: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;
Kiswahili: Mimi nitakuwa baba yake, naye atakuwa mwanangu. Kamwe sitaondoa upendo wangu kwake, kama nilivyouondoa kwa yeye aliyekutangulia.
Ekegusii: Inche nimbe ise, nere nabe omwana one; tinkorusia obwanchani bwane botari koera korwa asare, buna naborusetie korwa ase oria orengeo ritang’ani asore.

English: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”
Kiswahili: Nitamweka juu ya nyumba yangu na ufalme wangu milele; kiti chake cha enzi nitakifanya imara milele.’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende nimokore agenderere kobeerao botambe ase enyomba yane, na ase oborwoti bwane, na obogambi bwaye bokong’igwe kobao botari nomoerio.”

English: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
Kiswahili: Nathani akamwarifu Daudi maneno yote ya maono haya.
Ekegusii: Nathani agateebia Daudi amang’ana ayio onsi buna ayaigwete na korora.

English: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mfalme Daudi akaingia ndani, akaketi mbele za Bwana, akasema: “Mimi ni nani, Ee Bwana Mungu, na jamaa yangu ni nini, hata umenileta mpaka hapa nilipo?
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi omorwoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, akabora, Aye Omonene, inche ninki ing’isaine, na eamate yane ninki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?

English: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.
Kiswahili: Kana kwamba hili halitoshi machoni pako, Ee Mungu, umenena pia kuhusu siku zijazo za nyumba ya mtumishi wako. Umeniangalia kama mtu aliyetukuka kuliko watu wote, Ee Bwana Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naende ring’ana eri tiriisaini kende asore, aye Omonene Nyasae. Boigo gwakwanire nainche omosomba oo, igoro y’enyomba yane na amang’ana akare bosio. Ee, Omonene, gwankoreire koreng’ana nobo Mwanyabaanto, kwanyimokereirie igoro.

English: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.
Kiswahili: “Daudi aweza kukuambia nini zaidi kuhusu kumheshimu mtumishi wako? Kwa maana wewe unamjua mtumishi wako,
Ekegusii: Inche Daudi, inki ndagoteebie naende kobua ayio, ekiagera gwansikire iga? Aye nigo omanyete inche, omosomba oo.

English: Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu. Kwa ajili ya mtumishi wako, tena sawasawa na mapenzi yako, umefanya jambo hili kubwa sana na kujulisha ahadi hizi zote zilizo kubwa sana.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase engencho yane inche, omosomba oo, na koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao aye omonyene, gwakorire amanene aya onsi, naende kwayakorire amanyekanire.

English: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu, wala hakuna Mungu ila wewe, kama vile tulivyosikia kwa masikio yetu wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari otatiga aye bweka, koreng’ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.

English: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?
Kiswahili: Naye ni nani aliye kama watu wako Israeli: taifa pekee duniani ambalo Mungu wake alitoka kwenda kulikomboa kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na kujifanyia jina kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, kwa kufanya maajabu makubwa na ya kutisha kwa kuwafukuza mataifa mbele ya watu wako, ambao uliwakomboa kutoka Misri?
Ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki bare ase ense, bare buna abanto bao Abaisraeli, abwo aye Nyasae kwabooretie babe abanto bao, okenyorera erieta ase engencho y’amang’ana amanene na ay’ogokumia ase ogoseria abanto b’ebisaku bakarua ase obosio bw’abaanto bao baria kwabooretie korwa Misiri?

English: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.
Kiswahili: Uliwafanya watu wako Israeli kuwa watu wako wewe mwenyewe milele, nawe, Ee Bwana Mungu, umekuwa Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.

English: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi, Bwana ahadi uliyoweka kuhusu mtumishi wako na nyumba yake na uithibitishe milele. Fanya kama ulivyoahidi,
Ekegusii: Na bono aye Omonene, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro yane inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ororeria rwane, na okore aya gwateebete ng’a noyakore,

English: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’
Kiswahili: ili ithibitike na jina lako litakuwa kuu milele. Kisha watu watasema, ‘Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu aliye juu ya Israeli, ndiye Mungu wa Israeli.’ Nayo nyumba ya mtumishi wako Daudi itafanywa imara mbele zako.
Ekegusii: erinde erieta riao ribeo ritogigwe goika kare na kare. Erio abanto bateebe: Omonene bw’Emeganda nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ekeene nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ase enchera eyio enyomba y’omosomba oo, inche Daudi, ekong’igwe ase obosio bwao.

English: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
Kiswahili: “Wewe, Mungu wangu, umemfunulia mtumishi wako Daudi kwamba utamjengea yeye nyumba. Hivyo mtumishi wako amekuwa na ujasiri wa kukuomba maombi haya.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one kwang’orokeirie inche omosomba oo, ng’a nong’agachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro yane kogosaba ogosaba oko.

English: Now, Yahweh, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ndiwe Mungu! Umemwahidi mtumishi wako mambo haya mazuri.
Ekegusii: Na bono, aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae, kwandiereire inche, omosomba oo, eira gonkorera ring’ana eri rigiya.

English: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Yahweh, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”
Kiswahili: Basi imekupendeza kuibariki nyumba ya mtumishi wako, ili idumu milele machoni pako; kwa ajili yako, Ee Bwana, umeibariki, nayo itabarikiwa milele.”
Ekegusii: Gaki bono, koranche osesenie enyomba yane inche erinde egenderere kare na kare ase obosio bwao. Aye Omonene, aya gwasesenirie nigo agoseseneka kare na kare.

English: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, Daudi akawashinda Wafilisti na kuwatiisha, naye akautwaa Gathi pamoja na vijiji vinavyouzunguka kutoka utawala wa Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Daudi akarwania Abafirisiti, akababua, akaira omochie o Gati amo nebichie biaye korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.

English: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.
Kiswahili: Pia Daudi akawashinda Wamoabu, wakawa watumishi wake, nao wakawa wanamletea ushuru.
Ekegusii: Naende akabua Abamoabu, na barabwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakorenta ebango asare.

English: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Daudi akapigana na Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba, hadi Hamathi, wakati alikwenda kuimarisha utawala wake katika Mto Frati.
Ekegusii: Naende Daudi akabua Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba, agwo Hamati, ekero omorwoti oria agendete gokong’ia oborwoti bwaye aaria ase orooche rw’Eufarati.

English: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.
Kiswahili: Daudi akateka magari ya vita 1,000 miongoni mwa magari yake, waendesha hayo magari ya kukokotwa na farasi 7,000 na askari wa miguu 20,000. Daudi akakata mishipa ya miguu ya nyuma ya farasi wote wakokotao magari, ila akabakiza 100.
Ekegusii: Daudi agoosa chigari elifu eyemo (1,000), na abariini chibarasi chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), na abarwani abaare kogenda namagoro chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000). Erio akabutora chibarasi chionsi chinteng’e otatiga chibarasi rigana erimo (100) chikaba chikong’usa chigari.

English: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.
Kiswahili: Waaramu wa Dameski, walipokuja kumsaidia Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba, Daudi akawashambulia na kuwaua 22,000 miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Abasiiria ba Damesiki bachete gokonya Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba, Daudi akabarwania, agaita abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000).

English: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
Kiswahili: Daudi akaweka askari walinzi katika ufalme wa Waaramu huko Dameski. Basi Waaramu wakawa watumwa wa Daudi, na kumlipa ushuru. Bwana akampa Daudi ushindi kote alipokwenda.
Ekegusii: Erio akabeeka abasikari ase egati y’Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Na Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana.

English: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Daudi akazitwaa ngao za dhahabu zilizokuwa za maafisa wa Hadadezeri na kuzileta Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Daudi agasakora chinguba chi’echitaabu chiria abasomba ba Hadadeseri babogoretie, agachiira Yerusalemu.

English: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
Kiswahili: Kutoka miji ya Tibhathi na Kuni, iliyokuwa miji ya Hadadezeri, Daudi akatwaa shaba nyingi sana, ambayo Solomoni aliitumia kutengenezea ile Bahari ya shaba, zile nguzo na vifaa mbalimbali vya shaba.
Ekegusii: Naende akaira chitaai chinyinge korwa Tibati na Kuni, emechie ya Hadadeseri. Korwa ase chitaai echio Sulemani akaroiseria egetuba ekenene, ne chisiiro, na ebikorero binde bie chitaai.

English: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
Kiswahili: Tou mfalme wa Hamathi aliposikia kwamba Daudi amelishinda jeshi lote la Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba,
Ekegusii: Tou, omorwoti o Hamati, agachia koigwa ng’a Daudi obuire abarwani bonsi ba Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba,

English: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
Kiswahili: akamtuma mwanawe, Hadoramu kwa Mfalme Daudi ili kumsalimu na kumpongeza kwa ushindi wake katika vita dhidi ya Mfalme Hadadezeri, kwa kuwa alikuwa amepigana vita mara nyingi na Tou. Hadoramu akamletea Daudi vifaa mbalimbali vya dhahabu, fedha na shaba.
Ekegusii: agatoma Hadoramu, omomura oye, ase omorwoti Daudi komokwania na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri na omobuire. Hadadeseri nigo abeete okonakorwania Tou. Boigo Tou agatoma ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitaabu, na ebie chitaai.

English: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Daudi akaviweka vifaa hivi wakfu kwa Bwana kama vile alivyokuwa amefanya kwa fedha na dhahabu aliyokuwa ameitwaa katika mataifa yote haya: Edomu na Moabu, Waamoni, Wafilisti na Waamaleki.
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebio boigo Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chifeta ne chitaabu biria asakorete korwa ase ebisaku binde bionsi, korwa ase Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafirisiti, na Abaameleki.

English: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
Kiswahili: Abishai mwana wa Seruya akawaua Waedomu 18,000 katika Bonde la Chumvi.
Ekegusii: Abisai, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, agaita Abaedomu chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000) agwo ase Riranya ri’Omonyo.

English: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
Kiswahili: Akaweka kambi za askari walinzi huko Edomu, nao Waedomu wote wakawa watumishi wa Daudi. Bwana akampa Daudi ushindi kila alipokwenda.
Ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka abarwani aande onsi ase egati y’Abaedomu, na Abaedomu bonsi bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, n’Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana esegi.

English: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
Kiswahili: Daudi akatawala Israeli yote, akitenda lililo haki na sawa kwa watu wake wote.
Ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaba okogambera Abaisraeli bonsi na akaba ogokorera abanto baye bonsi ayare boronge na ekeene.

English: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
Kiswahili: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alikuwa jemadari wa jeshi; Yehoshafati mwana wa Ahiludi alikuwa mweka kumbukumbu;
Ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, nere orenge omochiki bw’emeganda y’abarwani, na Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.

English: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;
Kiswahili: Sadoki mwana wa Ahitubu na Ahimeleki mwana wa Abiathari walikuwa makuhani; Shausha alikuwa mwandishi;
Ekegusii: Zadoki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani, na Sausa nere orenge omoriki.

English: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.
Kiswahili: naye Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa msimamizi wa Wakerethi na Wapelethi; nao wana wa Daudi walikuwa maafisa wakuu katika utumishi wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti na Abapeleti; na basinto ba Daudi nabwo barenge abanene bamoetanaine.

English: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, Nahashi mfalme wa Waamoni akafa, mwanawe akaingia mahali pake.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Nahasi, omorwoti bw’Abaamoni, agakwa, na omomura oye akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

English: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.
Kiswahili: Daudi akawaza, “Nitamtendea wema Hanuni mwana wa Nahashi, kwa sababu baba yake alinitendea wema.” Hivyo Daudi akatuma wajumbe ili kumfariji Hanuni kwa ajili ya kifo cha baba yake. Watu wa Daudi walipofika kwa Hanuni katika nchi ya Waamoni ili kumfariji,
Ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Goika inkorere Hanuni, omomura o Nahasi, amaya, ekiagera ise nigo arenge gonkorera amaya.” Ase igo Daudi agatoma abanto bagende komoremia ase engencho y’ogokwa gwa ise. Abasomba abwo ba Daudi bakagenda ase Hanuni agwo ase ense y’Abaamoni komoremia.

English: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”
Kiswahili: wakuu wa Waamoni wakamwambia Hanuni, “Hivi unadhani Daudi anamheshimu baba yako kwa kuwatuma wajumbe kukufariji? Je, hawa watu hawakuja kuipeleleza na kuidadisi nchi ili waishinde?”
Ekegusii: Korende abatang’ani b’Abaamoni bagateebia Hanuni, “Inee! Igo okagete ng’a Daudi nigo asigete iso ase ogotoma abanto gocha gokoremia? Taibo. Abasomba baye nigo bachire koroota ense eye bayesarie.”

English: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Hanuni akawakamata watu wa Daudi, akawanyoa ndevu akakata nguo zao katikati kwenye matako, akawaacha waende zao.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Hanuni akabwata abasomba ba Daudi akabagingira chinderu chiabo, na akabutora chianga chiabo chikaba ebimini, agachiikeria ebinema, erio akabaseria bakagenda.

English: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja alipofika na kumpasha Daudi habari za watu hawa, akawatuma wajumbe wengine kuwalaki, kwa maana walikuwa wamevunjiwa heshima sana. Mfalme akasema, “Kaeni huko Yeriko mpaka ndevu zenu ziote, ndipo mje.”
Ekegusii: Abasomba abwo bakarora obosooku obonene mono, na ekero Daudi atebetigwe buna bakoretwe, agatoma abanto bachie kobarotota na kobateebia, “Omorwoti oteebire ng’a mobeere agwo Yeriko goika chinderu chiaino chimere, erio monyare koirana nka.”

English: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
Kiswahili: Waamoni walipotambua kuwa wamekuwa machukizo kwa Daudi, Hanuni na Waamoni wakatuma talanta 1,000 za fedha ili kukodisha magari ya vita pamoja na waendeshaji wa hayo magari ya kukokotwa na farasi, kutoka Aramu-Naharaimu, Aramu-Maaka na Soba.
Ekegusii: Abaamoni bakamanya ng’a bekorire koba okogechia ase Daudi, erio Hanuni na Abaamoni bagatoma chifeta chitalanta elifu eyemo goakanera chigari na abariini chibarasi chiare korwa Mesopotamia na Aramu‐Maaka, na korwa Soba.

English: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
Kiswahili: Wakakodisha magari ya vita 32,000 yakiwa na waendeshaji wake, pamoja na mfalme wa Maaka na vikosi vyake, wakaja na kupiga kambi karibu na Medeba. Waamoni nao wakakusanyika toka miji yao, wakatoka ili kupigana vita.
Ekegusii: Bagasaba chigari chilifu emerongo etato na ibere (32,000) amo nomorwoti o Maaka na abarwani baye b’esegi. Barabwo bagacha, bagatoora bosio bwa Medeba. Abaamoni bagasangererigwa korwa ase emechie yabo, bagacha korwana esegi.

English: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.
Kiswahili: Daudi aliposikia jambo hili, akamtuma Yoabu na jeshi lote la wapiganaji.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, agatoma Yoabu amo nabarwani bonsi chituoni b’esegi.

English: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
Kiswahili: Waamoni wakatoka wakajipanga wakiwa tayari kwa vita langoni la mji wao, wakati wale wafalme wengine waliokuja nao walijipanga kwa vita uwanjani.
Ekegusii: Abaamoni bagacha bakarobera agwo ase egesoero ki’omochie, na abarwoti baria konya bachire bakabeera boka aase aarabu.

English: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
Kiswahili: Yoabu akaona kuwa mbele yake na nyuma yake kumepangwa vita; kwa hiyo akachagua baadhi ya vikosi vilivyo bora sana katika Israeli akavipanga dhidi ya Waaramu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu aroche ng’a esegi nigo ere bosio na magega, agachora abanto abakong’u, abamanyete korwana esegi, akabaroberia barwane n’Abasiiria.

English: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
Kiswahili: Akawaweka wale wanajeshi wengine waliobaki chini ya amri ya Abishai ndugu yake, nao wakapangwa ili wakabiliane na Waamoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande abatigari akababeeka inse y’oboteneneri bw’Abisai momura omwabo, akaroberia barwane n’Abaamoni.

English: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
Kiswahili: Yoabu akasema, “Kama Waaramu watanizidi nguvu, basi itakupasa wewe unisaidie; lakini kama Waamoni watakuzidi nguvu, basi mimi nitakusaidia.
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia Abisai, “Onye Abasiiria bakombua, rirorio oche onkonye, korende onye Abaamoni bagokobua, rirorio inche inchiche noboseemia.

English: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May Yahweh do that which seems good to him.”
Kiswahili: Uwe hodari na tupigane kwa ujasiri kwa ajili ya watu wetu na miji ya Mungu wetu. Bwana atafanya lile lililo jema machoni pake.”
Ekegusii: Otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu! Torwanere abanto baito na emechie ya Nyasae oito. Na ig’Omonene akore ayaroche are amaya.”

English: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.
Kiswahili: Basi Yoabu na vikosi vyake wakasonga mbele kupigana na Waaramu, nao Waaramu wakakimbia mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Agwo Yoabu na abanto barenge amo nere bagasuka bagaika ang’e n’Abasiiria ase okorwana esegi, na Abasiiria baria bagatama korwa asare.

English: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Waamoni walipoona Waaramu wanakimbia, nao pia wakakimbia mbele ya nduguye Abishai na kuingia ndani ya mji. Basi Yoabu akarudi Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Abaamoni bagachia korora ng’a Abasiiria batamire, nabarabwo boigo bagatama korwa ase Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, bagasoa omochie ime. Erio Yoabu akagenda Yerusalemu.

English: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Waaramu kuona kwamba wameshindwa na Israeli, wakapeleka wajumbe na kuwataka Waaramu wengine kutoka ngʼambo ya Mto Frati, wakiongozwa na Shofaki, jemadari wa jeshi la Hadadezeri.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abasiiria baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagatoma abanto korangeria Abasiiria, abarenge ng’umbu y’Eufarati, bache batang’anwe na Sofaki, omochiki bw’abasikari ba Hadadeseri.

English: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
Kiswahili: Daudi alipoambiwa haya, akawakusanya Israeli wote na kuvuka Yordani. Akasonga mbele dhidi yao na akajipanga kuwakabili. Daudi akapanga vita ili kupigana na Waaramu, nao wakapigana dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, akaamboka orooche rwa Yorodani, erio akagenda ase bare, akaira abarwani baye b’esegi gochia kobarwania. Ekero Daudi aroberetie abarwani baye b’esegi korwania Abasiiria, barabwo bakamorwania.

English: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.
Kiswahili: Lakini Waaramu wakakimbia mbele ya Israeli, naye Daudi akawaua waendesha magari 7,000 na askari wao wa miguu 40,000. Pia akamuua Shofaki, jemadari wa jeshi lao.
Ekegusii: Abasiiria bagatama korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli; na Daudi agaita Abasiiria abagendia chigari chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), na abarwani barenge gotaara namagoro chilifu emerongo ene (40,000). Boigo agaita Sofaki, omochiki obo bw’abasikari.

English: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.
Kiswahili: Raiya wa Hadadezeri walipoona kuwa wameshindwa na Israeli, wakafanya mapatano ya amani na Daudi, wakawa watumishi wake. Hivyo Waaramu hawakukubali kuwasaidia Waamoni tena.
Ekegusii: Ekero abasomba ba Hadadeseri baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagakora omorembe na Daudi, bakebeka inse yaye. Ase ayio Abasiiria tibanchete gokonya Abaamoni naende.

English: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.
Kiswahili: Mwanzoni mwa mwaka mpya, wakati ambapo wafalme huenda vitani, Yoabu aliliongoza jeshi. Aliangamiza nchi ya Waamoni, na akaenda Raba na kuuzingira, lakini Daudi alibaki Yerusalemu. Yoabu akashambulia Raba na kuuacha ukiwa magofu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y’ogosimeka ekero abarwoti baare koba bakogenda korwana esegi, Yoabu agatang’ana abarwani b’esegi, agasaria ense y’Abaamoni, akagenda koboera omochie o Raba, korende Daudi akabeera agwo Yerusalemu. Yoabu akarwania Raba, akayobua akayosaria.

English: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.
Kiswahili: Daudi akachukua taji kutoka kwa kichwa cha mfalme wao, lililokuwa na uzito wa talanta moja ya dhahabu, nayo ilizungushiwa vito vya thamani. Ikawekwa juu ya kichwa cha Daudi. Alichukua nyara nyingi kutoka mjini huo.
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarusia egutwa y’etaabu korwa ase omotwe bw’omorwoti bw’aroro, akanyora ng’a oborito bw’egutwa eria nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etato na inye, naende nigo yachabeire amagena e rigori rinene. Egutwa eyio ekabekwa igoro y’omotwe o Daudi. Ere agasakora ebinto ebinge mono bi’omochie oria.

English: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Akawatoa watu waliokuwa humo, akawaweka wafanye kazi kwa misumeno, sululu za chuma na mashoka. Daudi akafanya hivi kwa miji yote ya Waamoni. Kisha Daudi na jeshi lake lote wakarudi Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Naende akabasokia abanto barenge ase omochie ime, akababetereria gokora emeremo ne chinseke, na amakombe ’ebioma, na ebisire. Naboigo Daudi akorete abanto b’emechie yonsi y’Abaamoni. Erio akairana Yerusalemu amo nabaanto baye.

English: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, kulitokea vita dhidi ya Wafilisti, huko Gezeri. Wakati huo Sibekai, Mhushathi, akamuua Sipai, aliyekuwa mmoja wa wazao wa Warefai, nao Wafilisti wakashindwa.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio esegi ekaba ase egati y’Abaisraeli na Abafirisiti agwo Geseri. Sibekai Omohusa agaita Sipai, omonto bw’ororeria rw’amamonto; na igo Abafirisiti bakabugwa na kogamberwa.

English: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
Kiswahili: Katika vita vingine na Wafilisti, Elhanani mwana wa Yairi alimuua Lahmi nduguye Goliathi, Mgiti, ambaye mkuki wake ulikuwa na mpini kama mti wa mfumaji.
Ekegusii: Naende esegi ekaba n’Abafilisti; Elihanani, mosinto o Yairi, agaita Lahami, omomura omwabo Goliato korwa Gati, oria orotanga rwe ritimo riaye rwareng’aine omwaro omonene.

English: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.
Kiswahili: Katika vita vingine tena, vilivyopiganwa huko Gathi, kulikuwako na mtu mmoja mkubwa mwenye vidole sita katika kila mkono na vidole sita katika kila mguu: jumla vidole ishirini na vinne. Yeye alikuwa pia mzao wa Mrefai.
Ekegusii: Naende esegi ekaba agwo Gati. Omonto omotambe narengeo, oyorenge nebiara bitano na ekemo (6) ase kera okoboko, na bitano na ekemo (6) ase kera okogoro; bionsi nigo biarenge emerongo ebere na bine. Ere boigo noyomo bw’amamonto orenge.

English: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
Kiswahili: Alipowadhihaki Israeli, Yonathani, mwana wa Shimea, nduguye Daudi, akamuua.
Ekegusii: Ere akarama Abaisraeli, na Yonathani, omomura o Simea omwabo Daudi, akamoita.

English: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa ndio wazao wa Warefai huko Gathi, nao walianguka kwa mikono ya Daudi na watu wake.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo barenge ab’ororeria rw’amamonto korwa Gati. Abwo nigo Daudi na abanto baye baabaitete.

English: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.
Kiswahili: Shetani akainuka dhidi ya Israeli na kumshawishi Daudi ahesabu watu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Saitani akagania gochanda Abaisraeli, agasukia enkoro ya Daudi ase okobara Abaisraeli.

English: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akamwambia Yoabu na majemadari wa jeshi, “Nendeni mkawahesabu Waisraeli kuanzia Beer-Sheba mpaka Dani. Kisha nileteeni taarifa ili kwamba niweze kufahamu wako wangapi.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agateebia Yoabu na abatang’ani b’abasikari, “Genda mobare Abaisraeli korwa Beeri‐Seba goika Dani, erio mondetere amang’ana imanye omobaro obo.”

English: Joab said, “May Yahweh make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”
Kiswahili: Yoabu akajibu, “Bwana na aongeze jeshi lake mara mia na zaidi. Mfalme bwana wangu, kwani hawa wote si raiya wa bwana wangu? Kwa nini bwana wangu unataka kufanya hivi? Kwa nini kuleta hatia juu ya Israeli?”
Ekegusii: Yoabu agateeba, “Omonene amente abanto baye bamentekane ara rigana ase omobaro obo. Inee! Aye omorwoti, omonene one, abanto aba bonsi tibari abasomba bao? Nase ki aye omonene one okogania gokora ayio? Nase ki ogochia korenta okomocha igoro ase Abaisraeli?”

English: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, neno la mfalme likawa na nguvu juu ya Yoabu; kwa hiyo Yoabu akaondoka na kuzunguka Israeli yote kisha akarudi Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’omorwoti rikaba ne chinguru igoro ya Yoabu. Erio Yoabu akaimoka akagenda ase Abaisraeli bonsi, erio akairana gocha Yerusalemu.

English: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.
Kiswahili: Yoabu akampa Daudi jumla ya idadi ya watu wanaoweza kupigana. Katika Israeli kulikuwa na watu 1,100,000 ambao wangeweza kutumia upanga na katika Yuda watu 470,000.
Ekegusii: Yoabu akaa Daudi omobaro bw’abaanto. Ase Abaisraeli bonsi abwo barenge komanya korwana esegi nemioro nigo barenge abanto emilioni eyemo, ne chilifu rigana erimo (1,100,000), na ase Abayuda abanto chilifu amagana ane na emerongo etano na ebere (470,000).

English: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yoabu hakuwahesabu Walawi na Wabenyamini, kwa sababu alichukizwa sana na amri ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Korende Yoabu tabarete Abalawi na Ababenjamini, ekiagera ogochika koria omorwoti aruete nigo kwamogechetie.

English: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.
Kiswahili: Amri hii ilikuwa mbaya machoni pa Mungu pia; hivyo akaiadhibu Israeli.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio akoregete akagechia Nyasae; ere akaa Abaisraeli amaakwa.

English: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akamwambia Mungu, “Nimetenda dhambi kubwa kwa kufanya jambo hili. Sasa, ninakusihi, ondoa hatia ya mtumishi wako. Nimefanya jambo la kipumbavu sana.”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Nyasae, “Nakorire ebibe ebinene ase aya nakorire. Korende bono nagosabire, onyabere inche, omosomba oo, ogosaria kwane, naki nigo nakorire egento ki’oboriri obonene.”

English: Yahweh spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Gadi, mwonaji wa Daudi,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Gadi, omoorori o Daudi, akamoteebia,

English: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”
Kiswahili: “Nenda ukamwambie Daudi, hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: ‘Ninakupa wewe uchaguzi wa mambo matatu. Nichagulie mojawapo nitakalotenda dhidi yako.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Genda okwane na Daudi, omoteebie ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteeba: Nabekire asore amang’ana atato; ase ayio chora erimo, eri ngochia kogokorera.”

English: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Gadi akamwendea Daudi akamwambia, “Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: ‘Chagua:
Ekegusii: Erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi akamoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Chora erimo eri oranche.

English: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and Yahweh’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”
Kiswahili: miaka mitatu ya njaa, au miezi mitatu ya kushindwa na adui zako, ukipatwa na upanga wao, au siku tatu za upanga wa Bwana, yaani, siku tatu za tauni katika nchi na malaika wa Bwana akiangamiza kila mahali katika Israeli.’ Sasa basi, amua jinsi nitakavyomjibu yeye aliyenituma.”
Ekegusii: Noganetie enchara echiche ase emiaka etato; gose nigo oganetie oserigwe nababisa bao ase engaki y’emetienyi etato, babe bakobabuna‐buna na kobaita nemioro; gose mochandwe n’omoro Omonene ase amatuko atato, ekero oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita abanto borache igoro ase ense eye yaino, na omomalaika bw’Omonene ogosaria ense y’Abaisraeli? Bono nteebie aya ngochia koiraneria oria ontoma.”

English: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwambia Gadi, “Ninayo mahangaiko makubwa. Mimi na nianguke mikononi mwa Bwana kwa maana rehema zake ni kuu mno, lakini usiniache niangukie mikononi mwa wanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Gadi, “Inche nasoire ase emechando emenene. Gaki bono, tiga ingwe ase okoboko kw’Omonene, ekiagera amaabera aye namanene mono; korende ase amaboko a Mwanyabaanto tintageti ingweo.”

English: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana akatuma tauni katika Israeli, watu 70,000 wa Israeli wakafa.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akarentera Abaisraeli oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita; Abaisraeli chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bagakwa.

English: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, Yahweh saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Mungu akapeleka malaika kuangamiza Yerusalemu. Lakini malaika alipokuwa akifanya hivyo, Bwana akaona na akahuzunika kwa sababu ya maafa, akamwambia yule malaika aliyekuwa anaangamiza watu, “Yatosha! Rudisha mkono wako.” Wakati huo malaika wa Bwana alikuwa amesimama katika sakafu ya kupuria nafaka ya Arauna Myebusi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae agatoma omomalaika oye gochia ase Yerusalemu koyosaria; korende ekero omomalaika oria abeete ang’e koyosaria, Omonene akaywechandera, akaonchoreria ebirengererio biaye igoro y’obobe boria, agateebia omomalaika oria ogendererete gosaria omochie, “Bono aisanire, ororobia okoboko kwao!” Omomalaika oria konya oikire ang’e nekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi.

English: David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
Kiswahili: Daudi akayainua macho yake akamwona huyo malaika wa Bwana akiwa amesimama katikati ya mbingu na dunia, naye ameunyoosha upanga wake juu ya Yerusalemu tayari kuangamiza. Kisha Daudi na wazee, waliokuwa wamevaa nguo za gunia, wakaanguka kifudifudi.
Ekegusii: Daudi akarigereria akarora omomalaika oria bw’Omonene oteneine gati y’ense na igoro; ere nabwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye okoramborete gochia igoro ya Yerusalemu, na Daudi na abagaaka babegete chianga chi’echigunia, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.

English: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O Yahweh my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwambia Mungu, “Je, si mimi ndiye niliyeamuru watu wahesabiwe? Mimi ndiye niliyetenda dhambi na kukosa. Hawa ni kondoo tu. Wamefanya nini? Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, mkono wako na uwe juu yangu mimi na jamaa yangu, lakini usiache tauni hii iendelee juu ya watu wako.”
Ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Nyasae, “Inee! Tari inche nachigete abanto bakabarwa? Ninche nakorire ebibe; nakorire amang’ana amabe mono. Korende ching’ondi echi, ninki chiakorire? Nagosabire aye Omonene, Nyasae one, tiga okoboko kwao kong’ake inche amo neamate ya tata; korende oborwaire tibobaisa goita abanto bao.”

English: Then Yahweh’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika wa Bwana akamwamuru Gadi amwambie Daudi apande na kumjengea Bwana madhabahu kwenye sakafu ya kupuria nafaka ya Arauna Myebusi.
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene agachiika Gadi ateebie Daudi ng’a agende atenenie egesasiimero ase Omonene agwo ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani, Omoyebusi.

English: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akakwea, akalitii lile neno ambalo Gadi alikuwa amelisema katika jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene koria Gadi amotebetie Daudi, Daudi agatiira.

English: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
Kiswahili: Arauna alipokuwa akipura ngano, akageuka akamwona yule malaika. Wanawe wanne waliokuwa pamoja naye wakajificha, yeye akaendelea kupura ngano.
Ekegusii: Bono Orinani nigo arenge koora engano, na agwo akeonchora akarora omomalaika, na abana baye abamura baane abarenge amo nero bakebisa.

English: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akakaribia, Arauna alipotazama na kumwona, akaondoka kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka akamsujudia Daudi akiuinamisha uso wake ardhini.
Ekegusii: Daudi agacha ase Orinani, na ekero Orinani amorooche akarua agwo ase ekeooreri, agacha agatung’ama, akaumama ase obosio bwa Daudi.

English: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to Yahweh on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwambia, “Nipatie huu uwanja wako wa kupuria nafaka ili niweze kujenga madhabahu ya Bwana tauni ipate kukomeshwa katika watu. Niuzie kwa bei yake kamili.”
Ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Orinani, “Ing’a ensemo eyio y’ekeooreri, ing’agachere Omonene egesasiimero, erinde oborwaire botangwe korwa ase abanto. Inche ningakane rigori riaye rionsi.”

English: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”
Kiswahili: Arauna akamwambia Daudi, “Uchukue huo uwanja. Mfalme bwana wangu na afanye lolote analopenda. Tazama, nitatoa maksai kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa, vifaa vya kupuria kuwa kuni, pamoja na ngano kwa ajili ya dhabihu ya nafaka. Natoa hivi vyote.”
Ekegusii: Erio Orinani agateebia Daudi, “Ira ekeooreri ekio! Aye omonene one omorwoti, kora eki oranche. Rora, narure chiombe chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebikorero ebi bi’okoorera bibe chinko, na engano ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Nakobieire bionsi.”

English: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for Yahweh, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mfalme Daudi akamjibu Arauna, “La hasha! Lakini ninasisitiza kwamba nitalipa bei yake kamili. Sitachukua kilicho chako kwa ajili ya Bwana au kutoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa ambayo hainigharimu chochote.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Daudi agakania Orinani, akamoteebia, “Yaya taibo, korende nigo ndabiakanere rigori riikeranu; tinkoira ekere ekiao koa Omonene gose okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa eke ntaakanereti.”

English: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.
Kiswahili: Basi Daudi akamlipa Arauna shekeli za dhahabu 600 kwa ajili ya ule uwanja.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akaa Orinani etaabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli amagana atano na rimo agoakanera ekeooreri keria.

English: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on Yahweh; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akamjengea Bwana madhabahu mahali hapo, na kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani. Akamwita Bwana naye Bwana akajibu maombi yake kwa moto toka mbinguni juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero aroro, akarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, agasaba Omonene, nere akamoiraneria ase ogotoma omorero korwa igoro gocha ase egesasiimero keria gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
