English: Then Yahweh commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akanena na yule malaika, naye akarudisha upanga wake katika ala yake.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agachiika omomalaika oria, na ere akairania omoyio oye ime ase ekegoocho.

English: At that time, when David saw that Yahweh had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, Daudi alipoona kwamba Bwana amemjibu kule kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka wa Arauna Myebusi, akatoa dhabihu huko.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase engaki eria, ekero Daudi aroche ng’a Omonene oiraneirie ogosaba kwaye ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi, akarua ebing’wanso biaye aroro agwo.

English: For Yahweh’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
Kiswahili: Maskani ya Bwana ambayo Mose aliitengeneza kule jangwani, pamoja na madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa wakati huo vilikuwa viko mahali pa juu pa kuabudia huko Gibeoni.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engaki eria Eema y’Omonene, eria Musa atenenetie agwo ase erooro, na egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nigo kiarenge agwo aase aimokererete igoro aaria Gibeoni.

English: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of Yahweh’s angel.
Kiswahili: Lakini Daudi hakuthubutu kuisogelea ili kumuuliza Mungu, kwa sababu aliuogopa upanga wa yule malaika wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende Daudi tagendete ase egesasiimero keria koboria Nyasae, ekiagera nigo oboete omoyio oria bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene.

English: Then David said, “This is the house of Yahweh God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akasema, “Nyumba ya Bwana Mungu itakuwa mahali hapa, pia pamoja na madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Daudi agateeba, “Aiga nao egesasiimero ki’Omonene kerabe ase Abaisraeli bakoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.”

English: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akatoa amri wakusanyike wageni wote waliokuwa wanaishi Israeli, na kutoka miongoni mwao akaweka waashi ili kuchonga mawe kwa ajili ya kujenga nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Daudi agachiika abamenyi abarenge ase ense y’Abaisraeli basangererigwe amo, akababeeka kobaacha amagena na koyaroisia ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,
Kiswahili: Daudi akatoa chuma tele ili kutengenezea misumari kwa ajili ya mafungo ya malango ya nyumba na shaba tele isiyopimika.
Ekegusii: Naende Daudi akarenta ebioma ebinge bi’okoroisigwa emesumari y’ebisieri bi’ebiita amo nebibwatero, akarenta ne chitaai chinyinge chitare korengeka.

English: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.
Kiswahili: Pia akatoa magogo ya mierezi yasiyohesabika, kwa kuwa Wasidoni na Watiro walikuwa wamemletea Daudi idadi kubwa ya mierezi.
Ekegusii: Boigo akarenta chibao chi’emecharake chitare kobareka, ekiagera Abasidoni nigo barenterete Daudi emecharake emenge mono.

English: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.
Kiswahili: Daudi akasema, “Mwanangu Solomoni bado ni mdogo wa umri na hana uzoefu. Nyumba itakayojengwa kwa ajili ya Bwana inatakiwa iwe yenye uzuri mwingi na sifa na fahari mbele ya mataifa yote. Kwa hiyo nitaifanyia matayarisho.” Daudi akafanya matayarisho makubwa kabla ya kifo chake.
Ekegusii: Daudi nigo arengereretie ng’a Sulemani, omwana oye omoke otaramanya amange, na enyomba egochia koagachwa ase Omonene goika ebe engiya mono, naende eramanyekane ase ense yonsi ng’a nigo ere nobonene; na igo ere bweka goika abeeke ebinto bionsi ang’e. Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria ebinto ebinge ekero atarakwa.

English: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwita Solomoni mwanawe akamwagiza kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Akarangeria Sulemani, omwana oye, akamochika aagachere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli enyomba.

English: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.
Kiswahili: Daudi akamwambia Solomoni: “Mwanangu, nilikuwa na jambo hili ndani ya moyo wangu kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Jina la Bwana Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Sulemani, “Omwana one, nigo biarenge ebirengererio biane ng’a ning’agachere erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae one, enyomba.

English: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.
Kiswahili: Lakini neno hili la Bwana likanijia, kusema: ‘Wewe umemwaga damu nyingi na kupigana vita vingi. Wewe hutajenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Jina langu, kwa sababu umemwaga damu nyingi juu ya nchi machoni pangu.
Ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia: Aye gwaiteire amanyinga amange, naende kwarwanire chiseegi chinene; na ase engencho y’amanyinga aya amange gwaiteire ase obosio bwane tokonyara koagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane.

English: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
Kiswahili: Lakini utakuwa na mwana ambaye atakuwa mtu wa amani na utulivu nami nitampa utulivu mbele ya adui zake wote pande zote. Jina lake ataitwa Solomoni, nami nitawapa Israeli amani na utulivu wakati wa utawala wake.
Ekegusii: Rora noiborerwe omwana omomura oyorabe omonto bw’omorembe; inche nimoe omorembe ase ababisa baye bonsi bamoetanaine. Nigo ararokwe Sulemani, na ase amatuko aye ning’ee Abaisraeli omorembe na obotoereru.

English: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Yeye atakuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa baba yake. Nami nitakifanya imara kiti chake cha enzi cha utawala wake katika Israeli milele.’
Ekegusii: Ere naagache enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane. Ere nabe omwana one, nainche nimbe ise, na inche ninkore ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti bw’Abaisraeli kebe ne chinguru goika kare na kare.

English: Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
Kiswahili: “Sasa, mwanangu, Bwana awe pamoja nawe, nawe uwe na mafanikio upate kuijenga nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wako, kama alivyosema utafanya.
Ekegusii: “Bono omwana one, Omonene abe amo naye, erio obe nokogenderera okuya ase okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oo, buna akwanete igoro yao.

English: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.
Kiswahili: Bwana na akupe hekima na ufahamu wakati atakuweka juu ya Israeli, ili uweze kuishika sheria ya Bwana Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Tiga Omonene akoe obong’aini na okomanya, erio ekero orabe gokogambera Abaisraeli obwate amachiiko a Omonene, Nyasae oo.

English: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.
Kiswahili: Ndipo utakapofanikiwa, ikiwa utakuwa na bidii kutii amri na sheria Bwana alizompa Mose kwa ajili ya Israeli. Uwe hodari na ushujaa. Usiogope wala usikate tamaa.
Ekegusii: Korarende na kobwata emeroberio yonsi eyi’Omonene achigete Musa ase engencho y’Abaisraeli nigo orasesenigwe. Obe omokong’u na omoremu! Toiroka, tobaisa gokwa omoyo!

English: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.
Kiswahili: “Nimejitaabisha sana ili kupata mahitaji kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Bwana: talanta 100,000 za dhahabu, talanta 1,000,000 za fedha na kiasi kisichopimika cha shaba na chuma, pia mbao na mawe. Nawe waweza kuviongeza.
Ekegusii: Ase ogwechanda mono nasangereirie ebinto bi’okoagachera enyomba y’Omonene. Nasangereirie chitaabu chitalanta chilifu rigana erimo (100,000) ne chifeta chitalanta emilioni eyemo (1,000,000), ne chitaai amo nebioma ebinge mono, bitari korengeka. Boigo narentire chibao na amagena. Ase ebinto ebio naye omente ebinde.

English: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;
Kiswahili: Unao wafanyakazi wengi: Wachonga mawe, waashi na maseremala, pamoja na watu walio na ustadi katika kila kazi
Ekegusii: Nigo obwate abakori emeremo abange: abaabaachi amagena, na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, na abanto bamanyete gokora emeremo ende yonsi

English: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”
Kiswahili: wa kufua dhahabu, fedha, shaba na chuma, mafundi wasiohesabika. Sasa basi anza kazi hii, naye Bwana awe pamoja nawe.”
Ekegusii: ase chitaabu, ne chifeta, na etai. Imoka, ochake gokora emeremo! Omonene abe amo naye.”

English: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha Daudi akawaamuru viongozi wote wa Israeli wamsaidie Solomoni mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Daudi agachiika abaraai bonsi b’Abaisraeli ng’a babe bagokonya Sulemani, omwana oye, akabateebia,

English: “Isn’t Yahweh your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Yahweh and before his people.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Je, Bwana Mungu wenu si yuko pamoja na ninyi? Pia si amewapa raha pande zote? Kwa maana amewatia wenyeji wa nchi mkononi mwangu, nayo nchi iko chini ya Bwana na watu wake.
Ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene, Nyasae oino, tari amo nainwe? Naende tabaete omorembe ase chinsemo chiaino chionsi? Ere obekire abanto abanyene ense eye ase okoboko kwane; na ense eye nkogambera yabekirwe inse y’Omonene na inse y’abanto baye.

English: Now set your heart and your soul to follow Yahweh your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for Yahweh’s name.”
Kiswahili: Sasa itoeni mioyo yenu na nafsi zenu katika kumtafuta Bwana Mungu wenu. Anzeni kujenga Maskani ya Bwana Mungu, ili mweze kulileta Sanduku la Agano la Bwana na vyombo vitakatifu vya Mungu katika Hekalu litakalojengwa kwa ajili ya Jina la Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Bono beka ebirengererio biaino ne chinkoro chiaino ase okomorigia Omonene, Nyasae oino. Imoka moagache obomenyo Obochenu ase Omonene, erinde Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene na ebikorero ebichenu bia Nyasae birentwe ime ase enyomba eye eraagachwe ase engencho yerieta ri’Omonene.”

English: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
Kiswahili: Daudi alipokuwa mzee aliyeshiba siku, akamfanya Solomoni mwanawe kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ekero Daudi konya agotire mono akabeeka Sulemani, omomura oye, akaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.

English: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
Kiswahili: Pia akawakusanya pamoja viongozi wote wa Israeli, pamoja na makuhani na Walawi.
Ekegusii: Daudi agasangereria abaraai bonsi b’Abaisraeli amo nabakuani na Abalawi.

English: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
Kiswahili: Walawi waliokuwa na umri wa miaka thelathini au zaidi walihesabiwa, nayo hesabu ya wanaume ilikuwa 38,000.
Ekegusii: Abalawi abarenge nemiaka emerongo etato na goetania bakabarwa, na omobaro obo okaba chilifu emerongo etato na isano na isato (38,000).

English: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,
Kiswahili: Daudi akasema, “Miongoni mwa hawa, 24,000 watasimamia kazi ya Hekalu la Bwana na 6,000 watakuwa maafisa na waamuzi,
Ekegusii: Daudi agateeba, “Abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na baane (24,000) ase aba mbabe bagotenenera emeremo ye nyomba y’Omonene, na abanto chilifu isano nemo (6,000) nababe abateneneri na abagaambi ebiina;

English: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
Kiswahili: na 4,000 watakuwa mabawabu, na wengine 4,000 watamsifu Bwana kwa ala za uimbaji nilizotoa kwa ajili ya kusudi hilo.”
Ekegusii: abanto chilifu inye (4,000) nababe abarendi b’ebiita na abanto chilifu inye (4,000) babe bagotogia Omonene n’ebinto ebio bikobugigwa naroisirie ase okomotogia.”

English: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Kiswahili: Daudi akawagawa Walawi katika makundi kufuatana na wana wa Lawi: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
Ekegusii: Daudi agaatanana Abalawi ase ebiombe kobwatekana nabamura ba Lawi: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.

English: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Wagershoni walikuwa wawili: Ladani na Shimei.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Ladani na Simei.

English: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Ladani walikuwa watatu: Yehieli wa kwanza, Zethamu na Yoeli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ladani nabwo aba batato: Yehieli, omoteneneri obo, na Setamu, na Yoel.

English: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shimei walikuwa watatu: Shelomothi, Hazieli na Harani. Hawa watatu walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Ladani.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simei nabwo aba batato: Selomoti na Hasieli na Harani. Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chia Ladani.

English: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
Kiswahili: Nao wana wa Shimei walikuwa wanne: Yahathi, Zina, Yeushi na Beria.
Ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Simei nabwo aba baane: Yahati na Sina, Yeusi na Beria.

English: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
Kiswahili: Yahathi alikuwa wa kwanza na Ziza wa pili, lakini Yeushi na Beria hawakuwa na wana wengi; kwa hiyo walihesabiwa kama jamaa moja, wakapewa wajibu kwa pamoja.
Ekegusii: Yahati nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Sisa oyo o kabere, korende Yeusi na Beria tibabwate abana abamura abange; ase ayio bakabeekeranigwa amo ase okobarwa, bakaba eamate eyemo.

English: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa wanne: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba baane: Amuramu na Isari, Heburoni na Usieli.

English: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Amramu walikuwa: Aroni na Mose. Aroni waliwekwa wakfu, yeye na wazao wake milele, wawe wakiweka wakfu vitu ambavyo ni vitakatifu mno, kutoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana, kuhudumu mbele zake na kutamka baraka katika Jina la Bwana milele.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Amuramu nabwo Aroni na Musa. Aroni agaatananwa koba oyochenegete mono kogenderera botambe. Ere amo nabamura baye babe bagosamba ubani ase obosio bw’Omonene na komokorera, naende babe bagosesenia ase erieta riaye botambe.

English: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Mose mtu wa Mungu walihesabiwa kama sehemu ya kabila la Lawi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musa, omonto o Nyasae, bakabareranigwa amo negesaku kia Lawi.

English: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Mose walikuwa: Gershomu na Eliezeri.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musa nabwo Gerisomu na Eliezeri.

English: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Gershomu: Shebueli alikuwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Ase abana ba Gerisomu Sebueli nere orenge omoteneneri obo.

English: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Eliezeri: Rehabia alikuwa wa kwanza. Eliezeri alikuwa na mwana mmoja tu, lakini wana wa Rehabia walikuwa wengi sana.
Ekegusii: Ase abana b’Eliezeri Rehabia nere orenge omoteneneri obo. Eliezeri tabwate abana abamura bande; korende abana abamura ba Rehabia nigo barenge abange mono.

English: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Ishari: Shelomithi alikuwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Ase abana ba Isari, Selomiti nere orenge omoteneneri obo.

English: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hebroni walikuwa: Yeria alikuwa wa kwanza, wa pili Amaria, wa tatu Yahazieli, na wa nne Yekameamu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Yeria nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Amaria, oyo o kabere, na Yahasieli, oyo o gatato, na Yekameamu, oyo o kane.

English: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Uzieli walikuwa: Mika wa kwanza na Ishia wa pili.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo Mika, omoteneneri obo, na Isia, oyo o kabere.

English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Merari walikuwa: Mahli na Mushi. Wana wa Mahli walikuwa: Eleazari na Kishi.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi; na abana abamura ba Mali nabwo Eleazari na Kisi.

English: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.
Kiswahili: Eleazari akafa bila ya kuwa na wana: alikuwa na binti tu. Binamu zao, wana wa Kishi, wakawaoa.
Ekegusii: Eleazari nigo akwete atabwati abana abamura, korende nabwate abana abaiseke. Abanto bamwabo, abana abamura ba Kisi, bakanyuoma abaiseke baria.

English: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Mushi: Mahli, Ederi na Yeremothi; wote walikuwa watatu.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musi nabwo aba batato: Mali, na Ederi, na Yeremoti.

English: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
Kiswahili: Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Lawi kwa jamaa zao. Wakuu wa jamaa kama walivyoandikwa kwa majina yao na kuhesabiwa kila mmoja, yaani, wenye uwezo wa kufanya kazi kuanzia miaka ishirini au zaidi, waliohudumu katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Lawi ase chiamate chiabo amo nabateneneri be chiamate chiria, buna barigetwe kera oyomo ase erieta riaye. Abwo nigo barenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, na nigo baisanerete gokora emeremo y’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.

English: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Daudi alikuwa amesema, “Kwa vile Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli amewapa watu wake raha na amekuja kuishi Yerusalemu milele,
Ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oeire abanto baye obotoereru, na bono ere nigo amenyete Yerusalemu kare na kare.

English: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
Kiswahili: Walawi hawahitaji tena kubeba Maskani wala chombo chochote cha utumishi wake.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abalawi tibaganeirie kobogoria Eema gose ebinto binde bionsi bi’obokoreri bw’Eema eria.”

English: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na maagizo ya mwisho ya Daudi, Walawi waliohesabiwa ni wale wa kuanzia umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko omoerio o Daudi, Abalawi bonsi bakarikwa, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania.

English: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;
Kiswahili: Wajibu wa Walawi ulikuwa kuwasaidia wazao wa Aroni kuhudumu katika Hekalu la Bwana: Kuwa wasimamizi wa nyua, vyumba vya pembeni, kutakasa vyombo vitakatifu na utendaji mwingine wowote katika nyumba ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yabo nebe ogokonya abwo b’ororeria rwa Aroni ase obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene, na gotenenera chiraaro na ebinyomba ebike; boigo ogosibia ebinto bichenire, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’obokoreri bw’enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wasimamizi wa mikate iliyowekwa mezani, unga kwa ajili ya sadaka za nafaka, mikate isiyotiwa chachu, uokaji na uchanganyaji, pamoja na vipimo vyote vya wingi na ukubwa.
Ekegusii: Naende babe bagotenenera emeremo y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na ey’obosie obonuke bw’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ey’emegati ere emeoo etabekiri memera, na ey’ekarangeire orogio, na ey’obosie bwochoganirie amaguta, na ey’ebirengo binde bionsi.

English: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;
Kiswahili: Pia ulikuwa wajibu wao kila asubuhi kumshukuru na kumsifu Bwana. Iliwapasa pia kufanya hivyo jioni
Ekegusii: Barabwo babe bagotenenera kera rituko, mambia na mogoroba, bakoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono na komotogia.

English: and to offer all burnt offerings to Yahweh on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Yahweh;
Kiswahili: na wakati wowote sadaka za kuteketezwa zilipotolewa kwa Bwana siku za Sabato na kwenye sikukuu za Mwezi Mwandamo na katika sikukuu nyingine zilizoamriwa. Iliwapasa kuhudumu mbele za Bwana mara kwa mara kwa idadi maalum na kwa namna waliyokuwa wamepewa maelekezo.
Ekegusii: Nigo barenge gokonya ekero kende gionsi ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa biarenge koruegwa ase Omonene, ase Chisabato na ase Emetienyi Emeyia, na ase Amatuko Amanene ande. Nigo baroberetigwe gokora emeremo eyio koreng’ana nomobaro oganeirie, bakagenderera koyekora botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of Yahweh’s house.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Walawi wakafanya wajibu wao katika Hema la Kukutania, katika Mahali Patakatifu chini ya uongozi wa ndugu zao wazao wa Aroni, kwa ajili ya utumishi katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eye mbabe bakorenda Eema y’Omosangererekano na Aase Aachenu, na bakonye abanto bamwabo ab’ororeria rwa Aroni ase obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.

English: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo migawanyo ya wana wa Aroni: Aroni alikuwa na wana wanne: Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebiombe bi’abaanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni. Abana abamura ba Aroni nabwo aba: Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Itamari.

English: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
Kiswahili: Nadabu na Abihu walikufa kabla ya baba yao, nao hawakuwa na wana; kwa hiyo ndugu zao Eleazari na Ithamari wakahudumu kama makuhani.
Ekegusii: Nadabu na Abihu bagakwa bagatiga ise ore moyo, barabwo tibabwate abana; na igo Eleazari na Itamari bakaba abakuani.

English: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
Kiswahili: Akisaidiwa na Sadoki mwana wa Eleazari na Ahimeleki mwana wa Ithamari, Daudi aliwapanga wazao wa Aroni katika migawanyo kufuatana na wajibu wa huduma zao.
Ekegusii: Daudi agaatanana abwo b’ororeria rwa Aroni na akaroberia buna bakore emeremo. Zadoki bw’ororeria rw’Eleazari na Ahimeleki bw’ororeria rwa Itamari barabwo m babete bakomokonya.

English: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
Kiswahili: Idadi kubwa ya viongozi walipatikana miongoni mwa wazao wa Eleazari, kuliko miongoni mwa wazao wa Ithamari, nao waligawanywa kwa uwiano: Viongozi kumi na sita kutoka jamaa ya wazao wa Eleazari na viongozi wanane kutoka jamaa ya wazao wa Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’Eleazari bakanyorekana bare nabateneneri abange kobua abwo b’ororeria rwa Itamari. Ase ayio bakabeeka abanto ikomi na batano nomo b’ororeria rw’Eleazari babe abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, na batano na batato b’ororeria rwa Itamari babe abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.

English: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Waliwagawanya bila upendeleo kwa kupiga kura, kwa kuwa kulikuwa na maafisa wa mahali patakatifu na maafisa wa Mungu miongoni mwa wazao wale wa Eleazari na wale wa Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Igo baatananetwe ase ogoakerwa obomera, bonsi ase enchera eyemo, ekiagera abateneneri abwo b’Aase Aachenu na abwo ba Nyasae nigo bachoretwe korwa ase ororeria rw’Eleazari amo norwa Itamari.

English: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
Kiswahili: Mwandishi Shemaya mwana wa Nethaneli, Mlawi, aliorodhesha majina yao mbele ya Mfalme Daudi na maafisa: Kuhani Sadoki, Ahimeleki mwana wa Abiathari, na viongozi wa jamaa za makuhani na za Walawi: jamaa moja ikitoka upande wa Eleazari na nyingine upande wa Ithamari.
Ekegusii: Semaya, mosinto o Netaneli Omolawi, akarika amarieta abo agwo ekero omorwoti na abanene abarenge komokonya, na Zadoki Omokuani, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’abakuani, na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Chiamate chigachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera, eyemo korwa ase ororeria rw’Eleazari, na eyende korwa ase orwa Itamari.

English: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
Kiswahili: Kura ya kwanza ilimwangukia Yehoyaribu, ya pili Yedaya,
Ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yehoyaribu, na obwa kabere Yedaya;

English: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
Kiswahili: ya tatu Harimu, ya nne Seorimu,
Ekegusii: obwa gatato bokagwera Harimu, na obwa kane Seorimu;

English: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
Kiswahili: ya tano Malkiya, ya sita Miyamini,
Ekegusii: obwa gatano bokagwera Malikia, na obwa gatano na rimo Miyamini;

English: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
Kiswahili: ya saba Hakosi, ya nane Abiya,
Ekegusii: obwa gatano na kabere bokagwera Hakosi, na obwa gatano na gatato Abiya;

English: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
Kiswahili: ya tisa Yeshua, ya kumi Shekania,
Ekegusii: obwa kianda bokagwera Yesua, na obwa ikomi Sekania;

English: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
Kiswahili: ya kumi na moja Eliashibu, ya kumi na mbili Yakimu,
Ekegusii: obwa ikomi na rimo bokagwera Eliasibu, na obwa ikomi na kabere Yakimu;

English: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
Kiswahili: ya kumi na tatu Hupa, ya kumi na nne Yeshebeabu,
Ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatato bokagwera Hupa, na obwa ikomi na kane Yesebeabu;

English: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
Kiswahili: ya kumi na tano Bilga, ya kumi na sita Imeri,
Ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatano bokagwera Biliga, na obwa ikomi na gatano na rimo Imeri;

English: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
Kiswahili: ya kumi na saba Heziri, ya kumi na nane Hapisesi,
Ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatano na kabere bokagwera Hesiri, na obwa ikomi na gatano na gatato Hapisesi;

English: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
Kiswahili: ya kumi na tisa Pethahia, ya ishirini Yehezkeli,
Ekegusii: obwa ikomi na kianda bokagwera Petahia, na obwa emerongo ebere Ezekieli;

English: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na moja Yakini, ya ishirini na mbili Gamuli,
Ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na rimo bokagwera Yakini, na obwa emerongo ebere na kabere Gamuli;

English: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na tatu Delaya, ya ishirini na nne Maazia.
Ekegusii: obwa emerongo ebere na gatato bokagwera Delaya, na obwa emerongo ebere na kane Maasia.

English: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
Kiswahili: Huu ulikuwa ndio utaratibu wao uliokubalika wa kuhudumu walipoingia katika Hekalu la Bwana kulingana na masharti waliyoelekezwa na Aroni baba yao, kama Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, alivyokuwa amemwamuru.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio obo bw’obokoreri bwabo bw’enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli buna Aroni, sokoro yabo, abarobereretie koreng’ana buna Omonene amochigeete.

English: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu wazao wa Lawi waliobaki: Kutoka kwa wana wa Amramu: alikuwa Shubaeli; kutoka kwa wana wa Shubaeli: alikuwa Yedeya.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo Abalawi bande: Subaeli bw’ororeria rw’Amuramu na Yehedia bw’ororeria rwa Subaeli;

English: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
Kiswahili: Kwa wa Rehabia, kutoka kwa wanawe: Ishia alikuwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Isia, omoteneneri korwa ase ororeria rwa Rehabia;

English: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa Waishari: alikuwa Shelomithi, kutoka kwa wana wa Shelomithi: alikuwa Yahathi.
Ekegusii: Selomoti bw’ororeria rwa Isari, na Yahati bw’ororeria rwa Selomoti.

English: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hebroni: Yeria alikuwa mkuu, Amaria wa pili, Yahazieli wa tatu, na Yekameamu wa nne.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Yeria omotangi, na Amaria oyo o kabere, na Yahasieli, oyo o gatato, na Yekameamu oyo o kane;

English: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Uzieli: alikuwa Mika; kutoka kwa wana wa Mika: alikuwa Shamiri.
Ekegusii: Mika bw’ororeria rwa Usieli, na Samiri bw’ororeria rwa Mika;

English: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
Kiswahili: Ndugu yake Mika: alikuwa Ishia; na kutoka kwa wana wa Ishia: alikuwa Zekaria.
Ekegusii: Isia omomura omwabo Mika, na Zakaria bw’ororeria rwa Isia.

English: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Merari: walikuwa Mahli na Mushi. Mwana wa Yaazia: alikuwa Beno.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Omwana omomura o Yaasia nere Beno.

English: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Merari: kutoka kwa Yaazia: ni Beno, Shohamu, Zakuri na Ibri.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Merari ase Yaasia, omwana oye omomura, nabwo aba: Beno na Sohamu, Sakuri na Ibiri.

English: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa Mahli: alikuwa Eleazari, ambaye hakuwa na wana.
Ekegusii: Omwana o Mali n’Eleazari; ere tabwate abana abamura.

English: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa Kishi: mwana wa Kishi: alikuwa Yerameeli.
Ekegusii: Yerameeli nomwana omomura o Kisi.

English: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
Kiswahili: Nao wana wa Mushi: walikuwa Mahli, Ederi na Yeremothi. Hawa walikuwa Walawi kulingana na jamaa zao.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musi nabwo aba: Mali na Ederi, na Yerimoti. Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Lawi koreng’ana ne chiamate chiabo.

English: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
Kiswahili: Pia walipiga kura kama vile ndugu zao wazao wa Aroni walivyofanya, mbele ya Mfalme Daudi, Sadoki, Ahimeleki na mbele ya viongozi wa jamaa ya makuhani na ya Walawi. Jamaa za ndugu wakubwa zilitendewa sawasawa na zile za ndugu wadogo.
Ekegusii: Abateneneri abwo be chiamate chiabo, abatang’ani amo nabamwabo abake, bagaaka obomera buna abamwabo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, ekero Daudi omorwoti, na Zadoki, na Ahimeleki, na abatang’ani be chiamate chi’abakuani na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Oyorenge omonene ase eamate ogaakerwa obomera koreng’ana buna oyorenge omoke.

English: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:
Kiswahili: Daudi, pamoja na majemadari wa jeshi, wakawatenga baadhi ya wana wa Asafu, wana wa Hemani na wana wa Yeduthuni, kwa ajili ya huduma ya kutoa unabii, wakitumia vinubi, zeze na matoazi. Hii ndiyo orodha ya watu waliofanya huduma hii:
Ekegusii: Daudi amo nabatang’ani abarenge komokonya bagaatanana ase obokoreri abamura bande b’Asafu, na aba Hemani, na aba Yedutuni, baria barenge gochia kobana ase okobugia amakano ao ao, na goakania chisani chikwoga. Omoroberio bw’abaanto baria baetwe emeremo eria noro oyo.

English: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa wana wa Asafu walikuwa: Zakuri, Yosefu, Nethania na Asarela. Wana wa Asafu walikuwa chini ya usimamizi wa Asafu, ambaye alitoa unabii chini ya usimamizi wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ase abana abamura b’Asafu nabwo aba: Sakuri na Yusufu, Netania na Asarela. Abamura aba bakaba inse y’oboraai bw’Asafu ise, oyorenge kobana inse y’oboraai bw’omorwoti.

English: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Yeduthuni walikuwa sita: Gedalia, Seri, Yeshaya, Shimei, Hashabia, na Matithia, nao walikuwa chini ya usimamizi wa baba yao Yeduthuni, wao walikuwa wakitoa unabii wakitumia vinubi, wakimshukuru na kumtukuza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Amo na Yedutuni nigo barenge abamura baye: Gedalia na Seri, Yesaia na Simei, Hesabia na Matitia. Abamura aba batano nomo bakaba inse y’oboraai bwa Yedutuni ise, oyorenge kobana ase okobugia obokano ase okoiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono na komotogia.

English: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Hemani walikuwa: Bukia, Matania, Uzieli, Shebueli na Yeremothi, Hanania, Hanani, Eliatha, Gidalti na Romamti-Ezeri, Yoshbekasha, Malothi, Hothiri na Mahaziothi.
Ekegusii: Amo na Hemani nigo barenge abamura baye: Bukia na Matania, Usieli na Sebueli, Yerimoti na Hanania, Hanani na Eliata, Gidaliti na Romamuti‐Eseri, Yosibekasa na Maloti, Horiti na Mahasioti.

English: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
Kiswahili: Wote hawa walikuwa wana wa Hemani mwonaji wa mfalme. Aliwapata wana hawa kutokana na ahadi ya Mungu ili kumwinua. Mungu alimpa Hemani wana kumi na wanne na binti watatu.
Ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Hemani, omoorori bw’omorwoti. Nyasae amorierete eira y’okomokong’ia; ase ayio akamoa abana abamura ikomi na baane, na abaiseke batato.

English: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
Kiswahili: Hawa wanaume wote walikuwa chini ya usimamizi wa baba yao kwa ajili ya uimbaji katika Hekalu la Bwana wakitumia matoazi, zeze na vinubi, kwa ajili ya huduma katika nyumba ya Mungu. Asafu, Yeduthuni na Hemani walikuwa chini ya usimamizi wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo barenge inse y’oboraai bwa ise ekero barenge goteera agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene na goakania chisani chikwoga, amo na kobugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Asafu na Yedutuni, na Hemani nigo barenge inse y’oboraai bw’omorwoti.

English: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na ndugu zao wote walikuwa wamefundishwa na kuwa stadi wa uimbaji kwa Bwana. Idadi yao walikuwa 288.
Ekegusii: Omobaro obo amo nabaanto bamwabo borokereretigwe goterera Omonene, abamanyete goteera buya kegima, nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na batano na batato (288).

English: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
Kiswahili: Vijana kwa wazee, walimu kwa wanafunzi, wote walipanga kazi zao kwa kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi, abake na abanene, aborokia na aborokigwa, bagaaka obomera ase ogwatanana emeremo yabo.

English: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;
Kiswahili: Kura ya kwanza, ambayo ilikuwa kwa ajili ya Asafu, ilimwangukia Yosefu, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12 Ya pili ikamwangukia Gedalia, yeye na wanawe pamoja na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yusufu ase eamate y’Asafu. Obwa kabere bokagwera Gedalia; ere amo nabamwabo na abana baye abamura nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: Ya tatu ikamwangukia Zakuri, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa gatato bokagwera Sakuri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya nne ikamwangukia Isri, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa kane bokagwera Isiri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya tano ikamwangukia Nethania, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa gatano bokagwera Netania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya sita ikamwangukia Bukia, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa gatano na rimo bokagwera Bukia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya saba ikamwangukia Yesarela, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa gatano na kabere bokagwera Yesarela; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya nane ikamwangukia Yeshaya, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa gatano na gatato bokagwera Yesaia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya tisa ikamwangukia Matania, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa kianda bokagwera Matania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya kumi ikamwangukia Shimei, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi bokagwera Simei; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya kumi na moja ikamwangukia Azareli, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na rimo (11) bokagwera Asareli; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya kumi na mbili ikamwangukia Hashabia, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kabere (12) bokagwera Hasabia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya kumi na tatu ikamwangukia Shubaeli, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatato (13) bokagwera Subaeli; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya kumi na nne ikamwangukia Matithia, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kane (14) bokagwera Matitia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya kumi na tano ikamwangukia Yeremothi, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano bokagwera (15) Yeremoti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: Ya kumi na sita ikamwangukia Hanania, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na rimo (16) bokagwera Hanania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya kumi na saba ikamwangukia Yoshbekasha, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na kabere (17) bokagwera Yosibekasa; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya kumi na nane ikamwangukia Hanani, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na gatato (18) bokagwera Hanani; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya kumi na tisa ikamwangukia Malothi, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kianda (19) bokagwera Maloti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya ishirini ikamwangukia Eliatha, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere (20) bokagwera Eliata; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na moja ikamwangukia Hothiri, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na rimo (21) bokagwera Hotiri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na mbili ikamwangukia Gidalti, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na kabere (22) bokagwera Gidaliti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na tatu ikamwangukia Mahaziothi, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12
Ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na gatato (23) bokagwera Mahasioti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
Kiswahili: ya ishirini na nne ikamwangukia Romamti-Ezeri, wanawe na jamaa zake, 12.
Ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na kane (24) bokagwera Romamuti‐Eseri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

English: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo migawanyo ya mabawabu: Kutoka kwa wana wa Kora alikuwa: Meshelemia mwana wa Kore, mmoja wa wana wa Asafu.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarendi b’ebiita: Korwa ase ororeria rwa Kora, Meselemia, omwana omomura o Kora bw’ororeria rw’Asafu.

English: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
Kiswahili: Meshelemia alikuwa na wana wafuatao: Zekaria mzaliwa wa kwanza, Yediaeli wa pili, Zebadia wa tatu, Yathnieli wa nne,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Meselemia nabwo aba: Zakaria omwana oye omotangi; Yediaeli oyo o kabere; Zebadia oyo o gatato; Yatinieli oyo o kane.

English: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
Kiswahili: Elamu wa tano Yehohanani wa sita na Eliehoenai wa saba.
Ekegusii: Elamu oyo o gatano; Yehohanani oyo o gatano na rimo; Eliehoenai oyo o gatano na kabere.

English: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
Kiswahili: Obed-Edomu naye alikuwa na wana wafuatao: Shemaya mzaliwa wa kwanza, Yehozabadi wa pili, Yoa wa tatu, Sakari wa nne, Nethaneli wa tano,
Ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Obedi‐Edomu nabwo aba: Semaya omwana oye omotangi; Yehosabadi oyo o kabere; Yoa oyo o gatato; Sakari oyo o kane; Netaneli oyo o gatano;

English: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
Kiswahili: Amieli wa sita, Isakari wa saba, na Peulethai wa nane. (Kwa kuwa Mungu alikuwa amembariki Obed-Edomu.)
Ekegusii: Amieli oyo o gatano na rimo; Isakaru oyo o gatano na kabere; Peuletai oyo o gatano na gatato. Nyasae nigo asesenetie Obedi‐Edomu.

English: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.
Kiswahili: Shemaya mwanawe pia alikuwa na wana, waliokuwa viongozi katika jamaa ya baba yao kwa sababu walikuwa watu wenye uwezo mkubwa.
Ekegusii: Semaya, omomura oye, akaiborerwa abana abamura bakaba abateneneri be chiamate chiabo; abwo nigo barenge abanto abakong’u ase emeremo yabo.

English: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
Kiswahili: Wana wa Shemaya ni: Othni, Refaeli, Obedi na Elizabadi; jamaa zake Elihu na Semakia walikuwa pia watu wenye uwezo.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Semaya nabwo aba: Otini na Refaeli, na Obedi, na Elisabadi; boigo Elihu na Semakia, abamura bamwabo Semaya, nigo barenge abamura abakong’u mono ase emeremo yabo.

English: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote walikuwa wazao wa Obed-Edomu; wao na wana wao na jamaa zao walikuwa watu wenye uwezo pamoja na nguvu za kufanya kazi. Wazao wa Obed-Edomu jumla yao walikuwa sitini na wawili.
Ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo barenge b’ororeria rw’Obedi‐Edomu. Barabwo amo nabana babo abamura na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge abanto abakong’u, bamanyete gokora emeremo yabo. Bonsi abwo b’Obedi‐Edomu nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo na babere.

English: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.
Kiswahili: Meshelemia alikuwa na wana na jamaa zake, waliokuwa watu wenye uwezo: jumla yao watu kumi na wanane.
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Meselemia amo nabaanto bamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na batano, abamanyete buya gokora emeremo yabo.

English: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
Kiswahili: Hosa, Mmerari, alikuwa na wana wafuatao: Shimri alikuwa mkuu wao (baba yake alikuwa amemweka yeye kuwa mkuu ijapokuwa hakuwa mzaliwa wa kwanza),
Ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hosa b’ororeria rwa Merari nabwo aba: Simuri, omoteneneri obo, nonya tarenge omotangi, ise akamobeka akaba omoteneneri.

English: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
Kiswahili: Hilkia wa pili, Tabalia wa tatu na Zekaria wa nne. Wana na jamaa za Hosa jumla yao walikuwa watu kumi na watatu.
Ekegusii: Hilikia nigo arenge oyo o kabere, na Tebalia oyo o gatato, na Zakaria oyo o kane. Aba nabamura ba Hosa amo nabamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na batato.

English: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh’s house.
Kiswahili: Hii migawanyo ya mabawabu, kupitia wakuu wao, walikuwa na zamu za kuhudumu hekaluni mwa Bwana kama jamaa zao walivyokuwa nazo.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebiombe ebio bi’abarendi b’ebiita amo nabatang’ani babo nigo babegetwe gokora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene buna Abalawi bamwabo barenge gokora.

English: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
Kiswahili: Kura zilipigwa kwa kila lango, kufuatana na jamaa zao, wakubwa kwa wadogo.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba kera eamate, enke na enene, bagaaka obomera bamanye ngeita ki baraarende.

English: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
Kiswahili: Kura ya Lango la Mashariki ilimwangukia Shelemia. Kisha wakapiga kura kwa Zekaria mwanawe, aliyekuwa mshauri mwenye hekima, nayo kura ya Lango la Kaskazini ikamwangukia.
Ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera Selemia ase okorenda egeita kia moocha. Naende bagaakera Zakaria, omomura oye, obomera, bokamochora korenda egeita gia sugusu. Ere nigo arenge omosemia omong’aini.

English: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
Kiswahili: Kura ya Lango la Kusini ikamwangukia Obed-Edomu, nayo kura ya maghala ikawaangukia wanawe.
Ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera Obedi‐Edomu, bokamochora korenda egeita kia Irianyi, na abamura baye bakaegwa korenda ebigachero.

English: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.
Kiswahili: Kura za Lango la Magharibi na Lango la Shalekethi kwenye barabara ya juu zikawaangukia Shupimu na Hosa. Zamu za walinzi ziligawanywa kwa usawa:
Ekegusii: Supimu na Hosea bagachorwa korenda ensemo ya bosongo, agwo ase Egeita gia Saleketi, ase enchera egotiira, na oborendi obomo bogachikana nobonde.

English: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na Walawi sita kila siku upande wa mashariki, wanne upande wa kaskazini, wanne upande wa kusini, na wawili wawili kwa mara moja kwenye ghala.
Ekegusii: Abarendi batano nomo nigo barenge kobeera ensemo ya moocha kera rituko, na ensemo ya sugusu mbaane kera rituko, na ensemo ya Irianyi mbaane kera rituko; na ase ebigachero babere babere.

English: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu ukumbi kuelekea magharibi, kulikuwa na wanne barabarani na wawili kwenye ukumbi wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase akanyomba kaagachire ensemo ya bosongo, abarendi baane nigo barenge agwo ase enchera, na babere ase akanyomba karia.

English: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo iliyokuwa migawanyo ya mabawabu waliokuwa wazao wa Kora na wa Merari.
Ekegusii: Ebi nabio biarenge ebiombe bi’abarendi b’ebiita korwa ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Kora na orwa Merari.

English: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
Kiswahili: Katika Walawi, Ahiya alikuwa mwangalizi wa hazina za nyumba ya Mungu na mwangalizi wa hazina za vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu.
Ekegusii: Ahiya oyomo bw’Abalawi nere otenenerete chikungo chi’enyomba ya Nyasae, naende nere orendete ebiatananetwe bikaba ebichenu.

English: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa Ladani, waliokuwa Wagershoni kupitia Ladani na waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Ladani Mgershoni, walikuwa Yehieli,
Ekegusii: Abamura b’ororeria rwa Ladani, nabwo Abagerisoni, nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chia Ladani Omogerisoni. Ase abwo nigo barenge Abayehieli.

English: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.
Kiswahili: wana wa Yehieli, wana wa Zethamu na wa nduguye Yoeli. Wao walikuwa waangalizi wa hazina za Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abamura babere b’Abayehieli, Setamu na Yoel momura omwabo, abwo bakaba bagotenenera chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene.

English: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa wana wa Amramu, wana wa Ishari, wana wa Hebroni na wana wa Uzieli:
Ekegusii: Ase ebiombe bie chinderia chi’Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli:

English: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.
Kiswahili: Shebueli, mzao wa Gershomu mwana wa Mose, alikuwa afisa mwangalizi wa hazina.
Ekegusii: Sebueli, omomura o Gerisomu, mosinto o Musa, nere orenge omoteneneri omonene bwe chikungo chiria.

English: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
Kiswahili: Jamaa zake kutoka kwa Eliezeri, wanawe walikuwa: Rehabia, Yeshaya, Yoramu, Zikri na Shelomithi.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo korwa ase Eliezeri nigo barenge Rehabia, omomura oye, na Yesaia omomura oye, na Yoramu omomura oye, na Sikiri omomura oye, na Selomiti omomura oye.

English: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.
Kiswahili: Shelomithi na jamaa zake walikuwa waangalizi wa hazina zote za vitu vile vilivyowekwa wakfu na Mfalme Daudi, kwa viongozi wa jamaa waliokuwa majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia, na kwa maafisa wengine wa jeshi.
Ekegusii: Selomiti na abamwabo nabwo batenenerete chikungo chionsi chi’ebiegwa Daudi omorwoti aatananerete Omonene, amo nebio abateneneri be chiamate, na abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na abachiki b’abasikari baatananete bikaba ebichenu.

English: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair Yahweh’s house.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya nyara zilizotekwa vitani waliziweka wakfu kwa ajili ya ukarabati wa Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ebinto binde biasakoretwe ekero gi’esegi bigaatananwa bikaba ebiegwa ase ogokorerwa emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene.

English: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.
Kiswahili: Kila kitu kilichokuwa kimewekwa wakfu na Samweli mwonaji, na Sauli mwana wa Kishi, Abneri mwana wa Neri, na Yoabu mwana wa Seruya, pamoja na vitu vingine vyote vilivyokuwa vimewekwa wakfu, vyote vilikuwa chini ya uangalizi wa Shelomithi na jamaa zake.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, nebiegwa bionsi biria Samweli omoorori, na Saulo, mosinto o Kisi, na Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya baatananete. Ebinto bionsi bikabekwa inse y’oborendi bwa Selomiti na abamwabo.

English: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa wana wa Ishari: Kenania na wanawe walipewa kazi nje ya Hekalu kama maafisa na waamuzi juu ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaisari, Kenania na abamura baye bagachorwa gokora emeremo ya isiko buna abatang’ani b’emeremo ao ao, na abagaambi ebiina.

English: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Yahweh and for the service of the king.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa wana wa Hebroni: Hashabia na jamaa zake, watu 1,700 wenye uwezo, waliwajibika katika Israeli magharibi ya Yordani kwa ajili ya kazi zote za Bwana na utumishi wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Hasabia na abanto b’eamate yaye, elifu eyemo na amagana atano na abere (1,700), abanto abamanyete buya gokora emeremo yabo, bakabeekwa ensemo ya bosongo ya Yorodani gotenenera Abaisraeli ase emeremo yonsi y’Omonene na ey’omorwoti.

English: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu wana wa Hebroni, Yeria alikuwa mkuu wao kufuatana na orodha ya jamaa yao. Katika mwaka wa arobaini wa utawala wa Daudi uchunguzi ulifanyika katika kumbukumbu, nao watu wenye uwezo miongoni mwa wana wa Hebroni wakapatikana huko Yazeri katika Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Yeria nere otenenerete abanto be chiamate chionsi chi’ororeria rwa Heburoni. (Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ene bw’okogamba gwa Daudi, obotuki bogakorwa, na abanto be chiamate echio abamanyete korwana esegi buya bakanyorekana agwo Yaeseri ya Gileadi).

English: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
Kiswahili: Yeria alikuwa na jamaa ya watu 2,700 waliokuwa watu wenye uwezo na viongozi wa jamaa, naye Mfalme Daudi akawaweka kuangalia Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila Manase kuhusu kila jambo lililomhusu Mungu na shughuli za mfalme.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria abamwabo Yeria nigo barenge chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na abere (2,700), abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, bamanyete korwana esegi buya. Barabwo Daudi omorwoti akababeeka bakaba abateneneri b’abaanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi, na ab’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ase emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae na ey’omorwoti.

English: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo orodha ya Waisraeli: viongozi wa jamaa, majemadari wa maelfu, majemadari wa mamia na maafisa wao, waliomtumikia mfalme kwa lolote lililohusu vikosi vya jeshi vilivyokuwa zamu mwezi baada ya mwezi katika mwaka mzima. Kila kikosi kimoja kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’Abaisraeli na abateneneri be chiamate chiabo na obw’abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na obw’abateneneri b’emeremo ende yonsi ase oborwoti. Kera omotienyi ase omwaka ekeombe ki’abaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000), nigo kiarenge gokora emeremo inse y’oboraai bw’omotang’ani bw’omotienyi oyio.

English: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Msimamizi wa kikosi cha kwanza kwa mwezi wa kwanza alikuwa Yashobeamu mwana wa Zabdieli. Kulikuwa na watu 24,000 katika kikosi chake.
Ekegusii: Yasobeamu, mosinto o Sabidieli, nere otenenerete ekeombe egetang’ani, ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani; ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
Kiswahili: Yeye alikuwa mzao wa Peresi, na mkuu wa maafisa wote wa jeshi kwa mwezi wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge bw’ororeria rwa Peresi, na orenge omochiki bw’abatang’ani bonsi b’abasikari ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani.

English: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Msimamizi wa kikosi kwa mwezi wa pili alikuwa Dodai Mwahohi. Miklothi ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa kikosi chake. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Dodadi bw’ororeria rw’Ahohi nere otenenerete ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000). Mikiloti nere orenge omokonyi oye.

English: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha tatu kwa mwezi wa tatu alikuwa Benaya mwana wa kuhani Yehoyada. Ndiye alikuwa mkuu wa kikosi chake kilichokuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Omoteneneri bw’ekeombe kia gatato, ase omotienyi o gatato, nere Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada Omokuani. Benaya nigo arenge omotang’ani omonene, na ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye yule Benaya aliyekuwa shujaa miongoni mwa wale Thelathini na ndiye alikuwa juu yao hao Thelathini. Mwanawe Amizabadi ndiye alikuwa mkuu katika kikosi chake.
Ekegusii: Benaya nere orenge omonto etuoni, omanyekanete ase baria Emerongo etato, naende orenge nomochiki obo. Amisabadi, omomura oye, nere orenge komokonya ase ekeombe ekio.

English: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa nne kwa mwezi wa nne alikuwa Asaheli nduguye Yoabu, mwanawe Zebadia ndiye aliingia mahali pake kwenye uongozi. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o kane, Asaeli, omomura omwabo Yoabu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kane, na Sebadia, omomura oye, akagetenenera magega yaye. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha tano kwa mwezi wa tano alikuwa Shamhuthi Mwizrahi. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o gatano, Samuti bw’ororeria rwa Isihari akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha sita kwa mwezi wa sita alikuwa Ira, mwana wa Ikeshi Mtekoa. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na rimo, Ira, mosinto o Ikesi Omotekoa akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha saba kwa mwezi wa saba alikuwa Helesi Mpeloni wa Waefraimu. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na kabere, Helesi, Omopeloni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa nane kwa mwezi wa nane, alikuwa Sibekai Mhushathi wa Wazera. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na gatato, Sibekai bw’ororeria rwa Husa Omozera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na gatato. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa tisa kwa mwezi wa tisa alikuwa Abiezeri Mwanathothi wa Wabenyamini. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o kianda, Abieseri korwa Anatoti bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kianda. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kumi kwa mwezi wa kumi alikuwa Maharai Mnetofathi wa Wazera. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi, Maharai korwa Netofa bw’ororeria rwa Zera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kumi na moja kwa mwezi wa kumi na moja alikuwa Benaya Mpirathoni wa Waefraimu. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na rimo, Benaya korwa Piratoni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa kumi na mbili kwa mwezi wa kumi na mbili alikuwa Heldai Mnetofathi kutoka jamaa ya Othnieli. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.
Ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na kabere, Helidai korwa Netofa bw’ororeria rw’Otinieli akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

English: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;
Kiswahili: Maafisa waliokuwa wanaoongoza makabila ya Israeli walikuwa: Kwa Wareubeni: Eliezeri mwana wa Zikri; kwa Wasimeoni: Shefatia mwana wa Maaka;
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abaraai b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli: Eliezeri, mosinto o Sikiri, ase Abareubeni; Sefatia, mosinto o Maaka, ase Abasimeoni;

English: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;
Kiswahili: kwa Walawi: Hashabia mwana wa Kemueli; kwa Aroni: Sadoki;
Ekegusii: Hasabia, mosinto o Kemueli, ase Abalawi; Zadoki ase abanto ba Aroni;

English: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;
Kiswahili: kwa Yuda: Elihu, nduguye Daudi; kwa Waisakari: Omri mwana wa Mikaeli;
Ekegusii: Elihu, oyomo bw’abamura bamwabo Daudi, ase Abayuda; Omuri, mosinto o Mikaeli, ase Abaisakaru;

English: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;
Kiswahili: kwa Wazabuloni: Ishmaya mwana wa Obadia; kwa Wanaftali: Yeremothi mwana wa Azrieli;
Ekegusii: Isimaya, mosinto bw’Obadia, ase Abasabuloni; Yerimoti, mosinto bw’Asirieli, ase Abanafutali;

English: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
Kiswahili: kwa Waefraimu: Hoshea mwana wa Azazia; kwa nusu ya kabila la Manase: Yoeli mwana wa Pedaya;
Ekegusii: Hosea, mosinto bw’Asasia, ase Abaefraimu; Yoel, mosinto o Pedaya, ase ekeng’ese kende ki’egesaku kia Manase;

English: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;
Kiswahili: kwa nusu nyingine ya kabila la Manase huko Gileadi: Ido mwana wa Zekaria; kwa Wabenyamini: Yaasieli mwana wa Abneri;
Ekegusii: Ido, mosinto o Zakaria, ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, keria kiarenge agwo Gileadi; Yaasieli, mosinto bw’Abineri ase Ababenjamini;

English: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: kwa Wadani: Azareli mwana wa Yerohamu. Hao ndio waliokuwa maafisa wa makabila ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Asareli, mosinto o Yerohamu, ase Abadani. Aba nabwo barenge abaraai b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.

English: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.
Kiswahili: Daudi hakuwahesabu watu waliokuwa chini ya miaka ishirini, kwa sababu Bwana alikuwa ameahidi kuwafanya Israeli kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani.
Ekegusii: Daudi tabarete na korika abanto konya bataraika emiaka emerongo ebere, ekiagera Omonene nariete eira ng’a namente Abaisraeli babe abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro.

English: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.
Kiswahili: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alianza kuwahesabu watu lakini hakumaliza. Kwa sababu ya kuwahesabu watu, hasira ya Mungu iliwaka juu ya Israeli, nayo hiyo hesabu yao haikuingizwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za Mfalme Daudi.
Ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, agachaaka kobara Abaisraeli, korende takoorete emeremo eyio. Nyasae akaba nendamwamu ase Abaisraeli ase engencho y’okobarwa koria, na omobaro oyio tobegetwe ase Egetabu ki’ogokora gwa Daudi.

English: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;
Kiswahili: Azmawethi mwana wa Adieli ndiye alikuwa msimamizi wa hazina za mfalme. Msimamizi wa hazina katika mashamba, miji, vijiji na kwenye ngome alikuwa Yonathani mwana wa Uzia.
Ekegusii: Asimaweti, mosinto bw’Adieli, agatenenera chimonga chi’omorwoti; na Yonathani, mosinto bwa Usia, agatenenera chimonga chi’ense eria, ase emechie emenene na emeke, na ase emerobiri.

English: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.
Kiswahili: Ezri mwana wa Kelubu alikuwa msimamizi wa wafanyakazi waliolima katika mashamba.
Ekegusii: Esiri, mosinto o Kelubi, agatenenera abakori emeremo b’emegondo, abarenge koyerema.

English: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.
Kiswahili: Shimei Mramathi alikuwa msimamizi wa mashamba ya mizabibu. Zabdi Mshifmi alikuwa msimamizi wa zabibu, utengenezaji na uhifadhi wa divai katika mapipa makubwa.
Ekegusii: Simei Omoramati agatenenera emegondo y’emesabibu, na Sabidi Omosifumi agatenenera edivai ase yare kogachwa.

English: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.
Kiswahili: Baal-Hanani Mgederi ndiye alikuwa mwangalizi wa mashamba ya mfalme ya mizeituni na mikuyu katika tambarare za vilima vya magharibi. Yoashi alikuwa msimamizi wa ghala za mafuta ya zeituni.
Ekegusii: Baali‐Hanani Omogederi agatenenera emezeituni na emeko agwo ase ense omweya. Na Yoashi agatenenera ebigachero bi’amaguta ’amazeituni.

English: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.
Kiswahili: Shitrai Msharoni alikuwa msimamizi wa makundi ya ngʼombe waliojilisha huko Sharoni. Shafati mwana wa Adlai alikuwa msimamizi wa yale makundi ya ngʼombe yaliyokuwa makondeni.
Ekegusii: Sitirai Omosaroni agatenenera amaicho arenge korisia agwo Saroni, na Safati, mosinto bw’Adilai, agatenenera amaicho arenge korisia ase amakura.

English: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
Kiswahili: Obili Mwishmaeli alikuwa msimamizi wa ngamia. Yedeya Mmeronothi alikuwa msimamizi wa punda.
Ekegusii: Obili Omoisumaeli agatenenera chingamia, na Yedaya Omomeroni agatenenera chitigere, na

English: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.
Kiswahili: Yazizi Mhagri alikuwa msimamizi wa makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi. Hawa wote ndio waliokuwa maafisa wasimamizi wa mali alizokuwa nazo Mfalme Daudi.
Ekegusii: Yasisi Omohagari agatenenera ching’ondi ne chimbori. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abateneneri ba chinibo chia Daudi omorwoti.

English: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.
Kiswahili: Yonathani mjomba wa Daudi alikuwa mshauri, mtu mwenye ufahamu mkubwa na mwandishi. Yehieli mwana wa Hakmoni alikuwa akiwahudumia wana wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Yonathani, ise moke Daudi, nere orenge omosemia; nigo arenge omonto omong’aini naende omonyasemi. Ere na Yehieli, mosinto o Hakimoni, nigo barenge abateneneri b’abana abamura b’omorwoti.

English: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
Kiswahili: Ahithofeli alikuwa mshauri wa mfalme. Hushai Mwariki alikuwa rafiki wa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ahitofeli nere orenge omosemia bw’omorwoti, na Husai Omoariki nomosani bw’omorwoti orenge.

English: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Ahithofeli, Yehoyada mwana wa Benaya aliingia mahali pake kama mshauri wa mfalme pamoja na Abiathari. Yoabu alikuwa ndiye jemadari wa majeshi ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Yehoyada, mosinto o Benaya, na Abiatari bakabeekwa ase ribaga ri’Ahitofeli g akuure. Yoabu nere orenge omochiki bw’abasikari b’omorwoti.

English: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Daudi akawaita maafisa wote wa Israeli wakusanyike huko Yerusalemu: yaani, maafisa walio juu ya makabila, majemadari wa vikosi katika utumishi wa mfalme, majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia, maafisa wanaosimamia mali zote na mifugo ya mfalme na wanawe, wakiwemo maafisa wa jumba la kifalme, mashujaa na askari wote walio hodari.
Ekegusii: Daudi akarangeria abateneneri bonsi b’Abaisraeli bache Yerusalemu. Ase ayio abateneneri b’ebisaku, na ab’ebiombe biarenge gokorera omorwoti, na abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na baria batenenerete chinibo chionsi chi’omorwoti ne chiombe chiaye, na echi’abana baye, amo nabateneneri b’enyomba y’omorwoti, na abanto bonsi chituoni, na abwo bonsi barenge abakong’u ase esegi, bagacha aroro.

English: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Daudi akainuka na kusema: “Nisikilizeni ndugu zangu nanyi watu wangu. Nilikuwa na nia ya kujenga nyumba ili iwe mahali pa kukaa Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kwa ajili ya kuwa mahali pa kuwekea miguu ya Mungu wetu, nami nikafanya maandalizi ya kuijenga.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Daudi agatenena, agakwana, “Inwe baminto na abanto baane, inyigwe. Nigo narengereretie koagacha enyomba ase Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene erabeekwe, eyio ere egeteni ki’amagoro ’Omonene, Nyasae oito, nkabeka ebinto ang’e ase okoagacha enyomba eyio.

English: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu akaniambia, ‘Wewe hutajenga nyumba kwa Jina langu, kwa sababu wewe umepigana vita na umemwaga damu.’
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene agankania, aganteebia: Aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera kwarwanire chiseegi na gwaiteire amanyinga ’abaanto.

English: However Yahweh, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo, Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, alinichagua mimi kutoka jamaa yangu yote niwe mfalme juu ya Israeli milele. Alimchagua Yuda kuwa kiongozi na kutoka nyumba ya Yuda akaichagua jamaa yangu na kutoka wana wa baba yangu ikampendeza kunifanya niwe mfalme juu ya Israeli yote.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aganchora korwa ase enyomba ya tata, akambeka nkaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli kogenderera botambe. Nigo achorete Abayuda bakaba abaraai, na korwa ase Abayuda agachora enyomba ya tata, na ase egati y’abana baye Omonene akagokigwa nainche, akambeka nkaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi.

English: Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh’s kingdom over Israel.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa wanangu wote, naye Bwana amenipa wengi, amemchagua Solomoni mwanangu ili kukikalia kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wa Bwana juu ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Omonene ong’eire abamura abange, na ase abwo bonsi ochorire Sulemani aikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti ki’Abaisraeli abw’Omonene akogambera.

English: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
Kiswahili: Aliniambia, ‘Solomoni mwanao ndiye atakayejenga nyumba yangu na nyua zangu, kwa maana nimemchagua yeye kuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa baba yake.
Ekegusii: “Omonene agakwana aganteebia: Sulemani, omomura oo, nere oraagache enyomba yane ne chiraaro chiane, ekiagera namochorire abe omwana one, na inche nimbe ise.

English: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’
Kiswahili: Nitaufanya imara ufalme wake milele kama akiendelea kuzishika amri zangu na sheria zangu, kama afanyavyo hivi leo.’
Ekegusii: Ninkore oborwoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru kare na kare karagenderere bokong’u kobwata na koigwera amachiiko aane, na emeroberio yane echiikire, buna agokora ase engaki eye.

English: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, Yahweh’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of Yahweh your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo basi ninawaagiza mbele za Israeli yote na kusanyiko hili la Bwana naye Mungu wetu akiwa anasikia: Kuweni na bidii kuzifuata amri za Bwana Mungu wenu, ili mpate kumiliki nchi hii nzuri na kuwaachia wana wenu kuwa urithi milele.
