Kiswahili: Ingawa sisi ni mwili na damu moja sawa na watu wa nchi yetu, na ijapo wana wetu ni wazuri kama wana wao, bado inatupasa kuwatoa wana wetu na binti zetu kwenye utumwa. Baadhi ya binti zetu wameshakuwa watumwa tayari, lakini hatuna uwezo wa kuwakomboa, kwa sababu mashamba yetu na mashamba ya mizabibu yetu ni mali ya wengine.”
Ekegusii: Bono emebere yaito nabo ere nengencho enene buna ey’abaminto, na abana baito nigo bare nengencho enene buna ababo, ko bono rora, yatobetereirie kobeeka abana baito, abamura na abaiseke, ase obosomba. Abaiseke baito bande baikire koba abasomba, korende intwe titobwati okobua kw’ogotanga ring’ana erio tiriba bo, ekiagera abanto abaao nabwo babwate amaremo aito amo nemegondo yaito y’emesabibu.”

English: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
Kiswahili: Niliposikia kilio chao na malalamiko haya, nilikasirika sana.
Ekegusii: Ekero naigwete amang’ana ’ebirero biabo nkaba nendamwamu enene;

English: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.
Kiswahili: Nikayatafakari katika akili yangu, nikiwalaumu wakuu na maafisa. Nikawaambia, “Mnawaonea ndugu zenu kwa kuwatoza riba!” Basi nikaitisha mkutano mkubwa ili kuwashughulikia
Ekegusii: Nkarengereria inche omonyene gokora egento ase engencho y’ayio. Ngasoera abanto basikire na abatang’ani, nkabateebia, “Inwe nigo mokwenyorera ebitoki korwa ase abamino.” Erio nkarangeria omoganda omonene gocha kogamba igoro y’amang’ana ayio,

English: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.
Kiswahili: na kusema: “Kulingana na uwezo wetu, tumewakomboa ndugu zetu Wayahudi waliokuwa wameuzwa kwa watu wasioamini. Sasa mnawauza ndugu zenu, ili wauzwe tena kwetu!” Walinyamaza kimya, kwa sababu hawakupata chochote cha kusema.
Ekegusii: nkayoteebia, “Intwe ase okonyara gwaito twabooririe Abayahudi baminto tokabairania korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku ebio ase baoonetigwe gochia, korende inwe nigo mokoonia abanto bamino, erinde intwe tobaboorie korwa ase more tobairanie.” Abaanene baria tibabwate nonya nering’ana erimo baare kobairaneria, korende nigo bakirete-kiri.

English: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?
Kiswahili: Basi nikaendelea kusema, “Mnachokifanya si sawa. Je, haikuwapasa kutembea katika hofu ya Mungu wetu ili tuepukane na shutuma za adui zetu wasioamini?
Ekegusii: Erio naende nkabateebia, “Amang’ana aya mogokora tari amaya. Inee! Tebagwenereti momoiroke Nyasae oito ase orogendo rwaino, erio nario abanto b’ebisaku, ababisa baito, batabe nengencho y’ogotochaya?

English: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.
Kiswahili: Mimi na ndugu zangu na watu wangu tunawakopesha watu fedha na nafaka. Lakini jambo hili la kutoza riba likome!
Ekegusii: Inche omonyene amo nabaminto, na abasomba baane, twarure chitaabu na endagera singo; bono totige koboria ebinto ebio, titoakanwa.

English: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”
Kiswahili: Warudishieni mara moja mashamba yao, mashamba yao ya mizabibu, mashamba yao ya mizeituni, na nyumba zao, pia riba yao mnayowatoza na sehemu ya fungu la mia la fedha, nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta.”
Ekegusii: Bono rituko ria reero bairanerie ebio bionsi baboreretigwe baakane: amaremo abo, na emegondo y’emesabibu na ey’emezeituni, edivai, ne chinyomba amo nebitoki bie chitaabu mwabeire mokoboria.”

English: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.” Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they would do according to this promise.
Kiswahili: Wakasema, “Tutawarudishia na hatutataka kitu chochote zaidi kutoka kwao. Tutafanya kama ulivyosema.” Kisha nikawaita makuhani na kuwafanya wakuu na maafisa kuapa kufanya kile walichoahidi.
Ekegusii: Erio abatang’ani abwo bakairaneria, bagateeba, “Goika toiranie ebinto ebio, gose titoboria ebitoki korwa ase bare; ntokore buna gwateebire.” Agwo nkarangeria abakuani batianie abatang’ani abwo barie eira ng’a bakore buna bateebetigwe.

English: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh. The people did according to this promise.
Kiswahili: Pia nikakungʼuta makunjo ya vazi langu na kusema, “Kila mtu ambaye hatatimiza ahadi hii, Mungu na amkungʼute hivi kutoka nyumba yake na katika mali zake. Basi mtu wa namna hiyo akungʼutiwe nje na aachwe bila kitu!” Waliposikia hili, mkutano wote ukasema, “Amen,” na wakamtukuza Bwana. Nao watu wakafanya kama walivyokuwa wameahidi.
Ekegusii: Erio ngasamunsa omoringo bw’omwambaro one, ngateba, “Naboigo kera oyomo oyotaikerania eira yaye, Nyasae amosamunse korwa ase abanto b’enyomba yaye, na korwa ase ebinto babwate. Ee, asamunswe abe bosa.” Omoganda bwonsi okairaneria, ogateba, “Amina,” na bakamotogia Omonene. Abanto baria bagakora buna bariete eira ng’a mbakore.

English: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, kutoka mwaka wa ishirini wa Mfalme Artashasta, wakati nilipoteuliwa kuwa mtawala wao katika nchi ya Yuda, mpaka mwaka wake wa thelathini na mbili, yaani miaka kumi na miwili, mimi wala ndugu zangu hatukula chakula ambacho kwa kawaida hupewa watawala.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria yonsi y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, ekero narenge omogabana bw’ense ya Yuda, korwa omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, goika omwaka bw’emerongo etato na ebere, bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, inche gose abanto baminto titwariete endagera omogabana agwenerete koegwa.

English: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people, but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.
Kiswahili: Lakini watawala wa mwanzoni, wale walionitangulia, waliwalemea watu na kuchukua kutoka kwao shekeli arobaini za fedha, pamoja na chakula na mvinyo. Wasaidizi wao pia walijifanya wakuu juu ya watu. Lakini kwa kumheshimu Mungu sikufanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Kera omogambi ontang’anerete kogamba nigo arenge kobeeka egurube endito igoro ase abanto na kobaboria barue endagera, na edivai, amo ne chitaabu chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo ene. Nonya nabasomba babo nabo bakorerete abanto. Inche tinakorete buna abagaambi abwo, ekiagera nigo namoirogete Nyasae.

English: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, nilijitoa kwa bidii katika kazi ya ukuta huu. Watu wangu wote walikutanika pale kwa ajili ya kazi. Hatukujipatia shamba lolote.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nakorete omokia, nkagenderera koagacha orwaki, gose titwagorete oboremo bonde, na abasomba baane nigo babete amo nainche ase ogokora emeremo eria.

English: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Wayahudi na maafisa 150 walikula mezani pangu, pamoja na wale waliotujia kutoka mataifa jirani.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi amo nabatang’ani babo abarenge koragera amo nainche nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Naende abanto b’ebisaku binde abamenyete ase chinsemo chiaito chionsi nigo barenge gocha baragera amo nainche.

English: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.
Kiswahili: Kila siku niliandaliwa maksai mmoja, kondoo sita wazuri, na kuku, na mvinyo wa kila aina kwa wingi kila baada ya siku kumi. Licha ya mambo haya yote, sikudai chakula kilichokuwa fungu la mtawala, kwa sababu madai yalikuwa mazito sana kwa watu hawa.
Ekegusii: Kera rituko endagera narenge korua neng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi chinoru isano nemo, amo ne chingoko; na kera rituko ria ikomi nigo narenge korua ebirandi ebinge biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, bire nedivai. Ase ebinto ebio bionsi tinarenge gosaba endagera eria abagaambi bagwenerete koegwa, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo babogoretie egurube endito.

English: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.
Kiswahili: Unikumbuke kwa fadhili, Ee Mungu wangu, kwa yote niliyofanya kwa ajili ya watu hawa.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ong’inyore ong’e amaya koreng’ana buna amaya nakoreire abanto aba.

English: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),
Kiswahili: Habari zilipofika kwa Sanbalati, Tobia, Geshemu Mwarabu, na adui zetu wengine kwamba nimejenga tena ukuta na hakuna nafasi iliyobakia ndani mwake, ingawa mpaka wakati huo sikuwa nimeweka milango kwenye malango,
Ekegusii: Bono ekero Sanibalati, na Tobia, na Gesemu Omoarabu, amo nababisa bande baito, bateebetigwe ng’a naagachire orwaki roria, naende ng’a konya naribirie aase onsi atagoretwe. (Nonya ase engaki eria konya tindabeeka ebisieri ase ebiita.)

English: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.
Kiswahili: Sanbalati na Geshemu wakanitumia ujumbe huu: “Njoo, tukutane katika mojawapo ya vijiji katika nchi tambarare ya Ono.” Lakini walikuwa wakikusudia kunidhuru.
Ekegusii: Erio Sanibalati na Gesemu bagatoma abanto gocha kondangeria, bagoteeba, “Inchuo toumerane aiga ase oyomo bw’emechie ere ase ense omweya ya Ono.” Korende nigo barengereretie gochia gonkorera amabe.

English: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo niliwatuma wajumbe kwao na majibu haya: “Kazi ninayoifanya ni kubwa sana, siwezi kuja. Kwa nini niiache kazi isimame nije kwenu?”
Ekegusii: Erio ngatoma abatomwa ase bare, nkabateebia, “Nigo ngokora emeremo ere emenene mono; tinkonyara gotirimboka gocha agwo. Nase ki ndatige emeremo etenene, ntirimboke gocha ase more?”

English: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.
Kiswahili: Mara nne walinitumia ujumbe wa namna iyo hiyo, na kila mara niliwapa jibu lile lile.
Ekegusii: Bagatoma abanto ase ’nde chintunda inye, bagokwana amang’ana aria aria, na inche nkaba nkobairaneria amang’ana aria aria konya nabateebirie ritang’ani.

English: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,
Kiswahili: Basi, mara ya tano, Sanbalati akamtuma msaidizi wake kwangu akiwa na ujumbe wa aina ile ile, naye alikuwa amechukua mkononi mwake barua isiyofungwa,
Ekegusii: Naende ase entunda ya gatano, Sanibalati agatoma omosomba oye ase ’nde obwate riruube ritamumekeirie

English: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.
Kiswahili: iliyokuwa imeandikwa: “Habari imeenezwa miongoni mwa mataifa, naye Geshemu anasema kwamba ni kweli, kuwa wewe na Wayahudi mnafanya hila ya kuasi, ndiyo sababu mnajenga ukuta. Zaidi ya hayo, kufuatana na taarifa hizi, karibuni utakuwa mfalme wao,
Ekegusii: Nigo riarikire iga: “Abanto b’ebisaku amo na Gesemu batebiire ng’a aye amo n’Abayahudi bande nigo moganetie kwanga koigwera; naende ng’a nakio gekogera mokoagacha orwaki; na koreng’ana namang’ana ayio, aye noganetie koba omorwoti obo.

English: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let’s take counsel together.”
Kiswahili: na hata umewateua manabii wafanye tangazo hili kukuhusu wewe huko Yerusalemu: ‘Yuko mfalme katika Yuda!’ Sasa taarifa hii itarudishwa kwa mfalme. Basi njoo, tufanye shauri pamoja.”
Ekegusii: Tari ayio oka, korende kwabeekire ababani bakoraria agwo Yerusalemu ng’a naye omorwoti bw’Abayuda. Na bono omorwoti ngochia goteebigwa are amang’ana ayio; ase ayio inchwo toumerane naye tokwane komo.”

English: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”
Kiswahili: Nilimpelekea jibu hili: “Hakuna jambo kama hilo unalosema linalofanyika. Unalitunga tu kwenye kichwa chako.”
Ekegusii: Erio ngatoma amang’ana gochia asare, nkamoiraneria, “Amang’ana buna ayio tari ay’ekeene, ayio namang’ana ao aye omonyene okorengereria korwa ase enkoro yao na koyaroisia boigo.”

English: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.
Kiswahili: Wote walikuwa wakijaribu kutuogopesha, wakifikiri hivi: “Mikono ya watu italegea kiasi kwamba hawataweza kufanya kazi, nayo haitakamilika.” Lakini niliomba, “Ee Mungu, sasa nitie mikono yangu nguvu.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera nigo baganetie gotwoboyia, bakorengereria ng’a nigo bagochia gotoita emioyo, toborwe chinguru chi’ogokora emeremo eyio, erinde etenene. Korende ngasaba, “bono aye Nyasae, ing’a chinguru ase ababoko aane.”

English: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”
Kiswahili: Siku moja nilikwenda nyumbani kwa Shemaya mwana wa Delaya, mwana wa Mehetabeli, ambaye alikuwa amefungwa ndani ya nyumba yake. Akasema, “Tukutane katika nyumba ya Mungu, ndani ya Hekalu, na tufunge milango ya Hekalu, kwa sababu watu wanakuja kukuua. Naam, wanakuja usiku kukuua.”
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo nkagenda ase enyomba ya Semaya, mosinto o Delaya o Mehetabeli, oyio osiekeire mwaye. Ere aganteebia, “Togende komo ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ase Hekalu eria ime, tosieke ebisieri bie Hekalu, ekiagera abanto abwo ngocha bare kogoita. Nigo barache ase obotuko bwa reero, bagoite bagosirie.”

English: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nikasema, “Je, mtu kama mimi akimbie? Au mtu kama mimi aende Hekaluni kuokoa maisha yake? Sitakwenda!”
Ekegusii: Korende nkamoteebia, “Inee! Omonto onga buna inche ningwenerete gotama? Omonto onga buna inche ninyare gotama gochia ase Hekalu ime, ase ogotooria obogima bwane? Tinkonyara kogenda aroro.”

English: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
Kiswahili: Nilitambua kwamba Mungu hakumtuma, bali alitabiri dhidi yangu kwa sababu Tobia na Sanbalati walikuwa wamemwajiri.
Ekegusii: Inche nkamanya ng’a tari Nyasae omotomete, korende Tobia na Sanibalati bamoete chitaabu akwane amang’ana arache konyora inche.

English: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa ameajiriwa kunitisha ili kwa kufanya jambo hili nitende dhambi, kisha waweze kuniharibia jina langu na kuniaibisha.
Ekegusii: Semaya nigo aetwe chitaabu ng’a anyoboyie, nainche nyancherane nere, na ase enchera eyio nkore ebibe; erio bakwane amang’ana amabe igoro y’erieta riane, na gonchecheria ase ogonchaya.

English: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu wangu, wakumbuke Tobia na Sanbalati kwa sababu ya yale waliyotenda. Pia kumbuka nabii mke Noadia na manabii wengine ambao wamekuwa wakijaribu kunitisha.
Ekegusii: “Aye Nyasae one, inyora amang’ana a Tobia na Sanibalati, boigo aya Nuhudia, omobani oria omokungu, amo nay’ababani bande, abaganetie konyoboyia.”

English: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.
Kiswahili: Basi ukuta ukakamilika siku ya ishirini na tano mwezi wa Eluli, kazi ambayo ilichukua siku hamsini na mbili.
Ekegusii: Orwaki roria rokaira amatuko emerongo etano, na abere, rokaera ase rituko ria emerongo ebere na gatano ri’omotienyi bw’Elulu.

English: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.
Kiswahili: Adui zetu wote waliposikia kuhusu hili, mataifa yote yaliyotuzunguka yakaogopa na kupoteza ujasiri, kwa sababu yalitambua kuwa kazi hii imefanyika kwa msaada wa Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baito bonsi baigwete ayio, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi biatoetanaine bayaroche, bakaba nobwoba obonene, bagechaya na gwesookera abanyene, ekiagera nigo bamanyete ng’a emeremo eyio nigo yakoretwe na goikeranigwa ase ogokonywa kwa Nyasae oito.

English: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.
Kiswahili: Pia katika siku hizo wakuu wa Yuda walikuwa wakituma barua nyingi kwa Tobia, nayo majibu yaliyotoka kwa Tobia yaliendelea kuwajia.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio onsi abasike b’Abayuda nigo bagendererete konagotoma amarube amange ase Tobia, nere nabo agendererete kona-gotoma ayande ase okobairaneria.

English: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa watu wengi katika Yuda walikuwa wamemwapia Tobia, kwani alikuwa mkwewe Shekania mwana wa Ara, na Yehohanani mwanawe alikuwa amemwoa binti wa Meshulamu mwana wa Berekia.
Ekegusii: Abanto abange b’ense ya Yuda konya babwatanire na Tobia ase ogotianania, ekiagera ere nigo anyuomete omoiseke o Sekania, mosinto bw’Ara; boigo Yehohanani, momura oye, konya onyuomire omoiseke o Mesulamu, mosinto o Berekia.

English: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, walikuwa wakiniarifu jinsi Tobia alivyo mtu mwema, nao walimwambia kila kitu nilichosema. Naye Tobia alituma barua za kunitisha.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi abwo nigo barenge gotogia Tobia ase obosio bwane, na abwo nigo barenge komoirera amang’ana aane. Tobia omonyene akaba ogontomera amarube ay’okonyoboyia.

English: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
Kiswahili: Baada ya ukuta kukamilika kujengwa upya na nikaweka milango, mabawabu wa lango, waimbaji, na Walawi waliteuliwa.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero orwaki konya rwaerire koagachwa, nkabeeka ebisieri, nkabeeka nabarendi b’ebiita na abateeri, na Abalawi.

English: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.
Kiswahili: Nikamweka Hanani ndugu yangu kuwa kiongozi wa Yerusalemu, pamoja na Hanania jemadari wa ngome, kwa kuwa alikuwa mtu mwadilifu na mwenye kumcha Mungu kuliko watu wengine.
Ekegusii: Nkabeeka Hanani, momura ominto, na Hanania oyo otenenerete eburi, babe abachiki ase omochie o Yerusalemu. Hanani nigo arenge omogabana, naende nigo amoirogete Nyasae kobua abange.

English: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”
Kiswahili: Nikawaambia, “Malango ya Yerusalemu yasifunguliwe mpaka jua litakapokuwa limepanda. Walinzi wa malango wakiwa bado kwenye zamu, waamuru wafunge milango na waweke makomeo. Pia wateueni wenyeji wa Yerusalemu wawe walinzi, kila mmoja kwenye lindo lake, na wengine karibu na nyumba zao wenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Nkabateebia, “Timobaisa koigora ebiita bia Yerusalemu, goika ekero omobaso obarire buya, na ekero abarendi batarainoka goika basieke ebisieri bokong’u nemekorogoto. Mochore abarendi korwa ase abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, kera omonto abeekwe aase aye ang’e nenyomba yaye.”

English: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.
Kiswahili: Mji ulikuwa mkubwa, tena wenye nafasi nyingi, lakini walikuwepo watu wachache ndani yake, nazo nyumba zilikuwa bado ni magofu.
Ekegusii: Omochie oria nigo orenge omogare naende omonene, korende abanto barengeo nigo barenge abake ase omobaro, ne chinyomba konya tichiraagachwa imeo.

English: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mungu wangu akaweka moyoni mwangu kuwakusanya wakuu, maafisa na watu wa kawaida kwa ajili ya kuorodheshwa kulingana na jamaa zao. Nilikuta orodha ya vizazi ya wale waliokuwa wa kwanza kurudi toka utumwani. Haya ndiyo niliyokuta yameandikwa humo:
Ekegusii: Erio Nyasae one akabeeka amang’ana ase ebirengererio biane gosangereria abanene abasikire, na abatang’ani, na abanto bonsi, erinde barikwe ase omooroberio bwe chinderia. Erio nkanyora egetabu gie chinderia chi’abachete ritangani. Na aba batobwata nabwo barikire.

English: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio watu wa jimbo waliotoka uhamishoni, ambao Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alikuwa amewachukua mateka (walirudi Yerusalemu na Yuda, kila mmoja kwenye mji wake,
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto b’orogongo rwa Yuda, baria Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, airete ase obosomba, bairanete gocha Yerusalemu na ase ense y’Abayuda, (kera oyomo akagenda komenya ase omochie oye

English: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
Kiswahili: wakiwa wamefuatana na Zerubabeli, Yeshua, Nehemia, Azaria, Raamia, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshani, Mispereti, Bigwai, Nehumu na Baana): Orodha ya wanaume wa Israeli ilikuwa:
Ekegusii: amo nabarenge kobaraa: Serubabeli, na Yesua, Nehemia na Asaria, Raamia na Nahamani, Moredekai na Bilisani, Misipereti na Bigiwani, Nehumu na Baana). Omobaro bw’abasaacha baria b’Abaisraeli noro oyo:

English: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Paroshi 2,172
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Parosi: chilifu ibere, ne rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (2,172);

English: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Shefatia 372
Ekegusii: aba orwa Sefatia: amagana atato, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (372);

English: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Ara 652
Ekegusii: aba orwa Ara, amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano, na babere (652);

English: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Pahath-Moabu (wa jamaa ya Yeshua na Yoabu) 2,818
Ekegusii: aba orwa Pahati-Moabu, be chiamate chia Yesua na Yoabu: chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na batano na batato (2,818);

English: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Elamu 1,254
Ekegusii: aba orw’Elamu: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo etano na baane (1,254);

English: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Zatu 845
Ekegusii: aba orwa Satu: amagana atano na atato, na emerongo ene, na batano (845);

English: The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Zakai 760
Ekegusii: aba orwa Sakai: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (760);

English: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Binui 648
Ekegusii: aba orwa Binui: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ene, na batano na batato (648);

English: The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Bebai 628
Ekegusii: aba orwa Bebai: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (628);

English: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Azgadi 2,322
Ekegusii: aba orw’Asigadi: chilifu ibere, na amagana atato, na emerongo ebere, na babere (2,322);

English: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Adonikamu 667
Ekegusii: aba orw’Adonikamu: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano nomo, na batano na babere (667);

English: The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Bigwai 2,067
Ekegusii: aba orwa Bigiwai: chilifu ibere, na emerongo etano nomo, na batano na babere (2,067);

English: The children of Adin: six hundred fifty-five.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Adini 655
Ekegusii: aba orw’Adini: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano, na batano (655);

English: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Ateri (kupitia Hezekia) 98
Ekegusii: aba orw’Ateri b’eamate ya Hezekia: emerongo kianda, na batano na batato (98);

English: The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Hashumu 328
Ekegusii: aba orwa Hasumu: amagana atato, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (328);

English: The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Besai 324
Ekegusii: aba orwa Besai: amagana atato, na emerongo ebere, na baane (324);

English: The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Harifu 112
Ekegusii: aba orwa Harifu: rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112);

English: The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Gibeoni 95
Ekegusii: aba orwa Gibeoni: emerongo kianda, na batano (95).

English: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.
Kiswahili: watu wa Bethlehemu na Netofa 188
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Bethlehemu na Netofa: rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na etato, na batano na batato (188);

English: The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.
Kiswahili: watu wa Anathothi 128
Ekegusii: abanto b’Anatoti: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128);

English: The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.
Kiswahili: watu wa Beth-Azmawethi 42
Ekegusii: abanto ba Beti-Asimaweti; emerongo ene, na babere (42);

English: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.
Kiswahili: watu wa Kiriath-Yearimu, Kefira na Beerothi 743
Ekegusii: abanto ba Kiriati-Yearimu, na Kefira, na Beeroti: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ene, na batato (743);

English: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.
Kiswahili: watu wa Rama na Geba 621
Ekegusii: abanto ba Rama na Geba: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ebere, na oyomo (621);

English: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.
Kiswahili: watu wa Mikmashi 122
Ekegusii: abanto ba Mikimasi: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na babere (122):

English: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.
Kiswahili: watu wa Betheli na Ai 123
Ekegusii: abanto ba Beteli na Ai: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batato (123);

English: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.
Kiswahili: watu wa Nebo 52
Ekegusii: abanto ba Nebo o kabere: emerongo etano, na babere (52);

English: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Elamu 1,254
Ekegusii: abanto ba Elamu o kabere: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo etano, na baane (1,254);

English: The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Harimu 320
Ekegusii: abanto ba Harimu: amagana atato, na emerongo ebere (320);

English: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Yeriko 345
Ekegusii: abanto ba Yeriko: amagana atato, na emerongo ene, na batano (345);

English: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Lodi, Hadidi na Ono 721
Ekegusii: abanto ba Lodi, na Hadidi, na Ono: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ebere, na oyomo (721);

English: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Senaa 3,930
Ekegusii: abanto ba Senaa: chilifu isato, na amagana kianda, na emerongo etato (3,930).

English: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.
Kiswahili: Makuhani: wazao wa Yedaya (kwa jamaa ya Yeshua) 973
Ekegusii: Omobaro bw’abakuani noro oyo: Ab’ororeria rwa Yedaya, bw’eamate ya Yesua: amagana kianda, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batato (973);

English: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Imeri 1,052
Ekegusii: aba orwa Imeri: elifu eyemo, na emerongo etano, na babere (1,052).

English: The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Pashuri 1,247
Ekegusii: Aba orwa Pasuri: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo ene, na batano na babere (1,247);

English: The children of Harim: one thousand seventeen.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Harimu 1,017
Ekegusii: aba orwa Harimu: elifu eyemo, na ikomi na batano na babere (1,017).

English: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.
Kiswahili: Walawi: wazao wa Yeshua (kupitia Kadmieli kupitia jamaa ya Hodavia) 74
Ekegusii: Abalawi nabwo aba: Abe chiamate chia Yesua o Kadimieli, ab’ororeria rwa Hodawia: emerongo etano na ebere, na baane (74).

English: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.
Kiswahili: Waimbaji: wazao wa Asafu 148
Ekegusii: Abateri, nabwo abanto b’ororeria rw’Asafu: rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, na batano na batato (148).

English: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.
Kiswahili: Mabawabu wa malango: wazao wa Shalumu, Ateri, Talmoni, Akubu, Hatita na Shobai 138
Ekegusii: Abarendi b’ebiita, nabwo abe chiamate chia Salumu, na Ateri, na Talimoni, na Akubu, na Hatita, na Sobai: rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na batano na batato (138).

English: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa Hekalu: wazao wa Siha, Hasufa, Tabaothi,
Ekegusii: Abakori emeremo be Hekalu nabwo aba: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Siha, na Hasufa, na Tabaoti;

English: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Kerosi, Sia, Padoni,
Ekegusii: Kerosi, na Sia, na Padoni;

English: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Lebana, Hagaba, Shalmai,
Ekegusii: Lebana, na Hagaba, na Salimai;

English: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Hanani, Gideli, Gahari,
Ekegusii: Hanani, na Gideli, na Gahari;

English: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Reaya, Resini, Nekoda,
Ekegusii: Reaya, na Resini, na Nekoda;

English: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Gazamu, Uza, Pasea,
Ekegusii: Gasamu, na Usa, na Pasea;

English: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Besai, Meunimu, Nefusimu,
Ekegusii: Besai, na Meunimu, na Nefusimu;

English: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Bakbuki, Hakufa, Harhuri,
Ekegusii: Bakibuki, na Hakufa, na Harihuri;

English: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Basluthi, Mehida, Harsha,
Ekegusii: Basiluti, na Mehida, na Harisa;

English: the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Nesia na Hatifa.
Ekegusii: Nesia na Hatifa.

English: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
Kiswahili: Wazao wa watumishi wa Solomoni: wazao wa Sotai, Soferethi, Perida,
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani nabwo aba: Chiamate chia Sotai, na Sofereti, na Perida;

English: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
Kiswahili: wazao wa Yaala, Darkoni, Gideli,
Ekegusii: Yaala, na Darikoni, na Gideli;

English: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Shefatia, Hatili, Pokereth-Hasebaimu na Amoni.
Ekegusii: Sefatia na Hatili, na Pokereti-Hasebamiu, na Amoni.

English: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa Hekalu wote na wazao wa watumishi wa Solomoni 392
Ekegusii: Abakori emeremo be Hekalu na abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani nigo barenge amagana atato, na emerongo kianda, na babere (392).

English: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:
Kiswahili: Wafuatao walikuja kutoka miji ya Tel-Mela, Tel-Harsha, Kerubu, Adoni na Imeri, lakini hawakuweza kuthibitisha kwamba jamaa zao zilikuwa uzao wa Israeli:
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo bachete korwa Teli-Mela, na Teli-Harisa, na Kerubu, na Adoni, na Imeri, korende tibanyarete koorokia ase okomanyereria chiamate chiabo, nonya ne chinderia chiabo gose ekeene ng’a n’Abaisraeli bare:

English: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.
Kiswahili: wazao wa Delaya, Tobia na Nekoda 642
Ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chia Delaya, na Tobia, na Nekoda; bonsi namagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ene, na babere (642).

English: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
Kiswahili: Na kutoka miongoni mwa makuhani: wazao wa Hobaya, Hakosi na Barzilai (mtu aliyekuwa amemwoa binti wa Barzilai, Mgileadi, naye akaitwa kwa jina hilo).
Ekegusii: Boigo nase abakuani aba: Abanto be chiamate chia Habaya, na Hakosi, na Barisilai, oyio onyuomete oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Barisilai Omogileadi na akarokwa ase erieta riabo Barisilai.

English: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.
Kiswahili: Hawa walitafuta orodha za jamaa zao, lakini hawakuonekana humo, kwa hiyo waliondolewa kutoka kundi la makuhani, kwa kuwa walihesabiwa kuwa najisi.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakariga-rigia korwa ase emeroberio ye chinderia gose mbanyore chisokoro chiabo, korende tichianyoretwe chiriikire aroro. Ase ayio bakaangwa tibaaba abakuani, ekiagera nigo baabaretwe koba abatachenegeti.

English: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, mtawala aliagiza kuwa wasile chochote miongoni mwa vyakula vitakatifu hadi kuwe kuhani atakayehudumu kwa Urimu na Thumimu.
Ekegusii: Omogabana akabakania akabateebia ng’a tibaabaisa koria endagera yarenge enchenu mono, goika engaki Omokuani arenge gochia koboria Nyasae goetera ase Urimu na Tumimu.

English: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
Kiswahili: Jumla ya watu wote waliorudi walikuwa 42,360;
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’abaanto nigo orenge chilifu emerongo ene na ibere, na amagana atato, na emerongo etano nomo (42,360),

English: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.
Kiswahili: tena zaidi ya hao walikuwepo watumishi wa kiume na wa kike 7,337; pia walikuwamo waimbaji wanaume na wanawake 245.
Ekegusii: amo na abasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana atato, na emerongo etato, na batano na babere (7,337). Boigo mbabwate abateri, abasacha na abakungu, amagana abere, na emerongo ene, na batano (245).

English: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;
Kiswahili: Walikuwa na farasi 736, nyumbu 245
Ekegusii: Naende mbabwate chibarasi amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etato, na isano nemo (736), ne chibarasi amagana abere, na emerongo ene, na isano (245),

English: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya viongozi wa jamaa walichangia kazi ya ujenzi. Mtawala alikabidhi kwenye hazina darkoni 1,000 za dhahabu, mabakuli 50, na mavazi 530 kwa ajili ya makuhani.
Ekegusii: Abateneneri bande be chiamate chiabo mbaruete ebiegwa ase ogokorera emeremo. Omogabana akabeeka ase ekungo ebisamunye bie chitaabu bikorokwa chidariki, elifu eyemo (1,000), ne chisani emerongo etano (50), ne chianga chi’abakuani, amagana atano, na emerongo etato (530).

English: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya viongozi wa jamaa walikabidhi kwenye hazina darkoni 20,000 za dhahabu, na mane 2,200 za fedha kwa ajili ya kazi hiyo.
Ekegusii: Abatang’ani bande b’echinyomba chinde bakarua ase ekungo eyio y’ogokorerwa emeremo, ebisamunye bie chitaabu, chidariki chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000), na ebie chifeta bikorokwa chimina, chilifu ibere, na amagana abere (2,200).

English: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya matoleo ya watu wengine yalikuwa ni darkoni 20,000 za dhahabu, mane 2,000 za fedha, na mavazi sitini na saba ya makuhani.
Ekegusii: Ebi’abaanto bande baruete nigo biarenge: ebisamunye bie chitaabu chidariki chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000), na ebisamunye bie chifeta, chimina chilifu ibere (2,000), ne chianga chi’abakuani, emerongo etano nomo, na isano na ibere (67).

English: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.
Kiswahili: Makuhani, Walawi, mabawabu, waimbaji na watumishi wa Hekalu, pamoja na baadhi ya watu wengine na Waisraeli waliosalia waliishi katika miji yao wenyewe. Ilipotimia miezi saba, nao Waisraeli wakiwa tayari wanaishi katika miji yao,
Ekegusii: Erio abakuani, na Abalawi, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abateri, na abanto bande, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, amo n’Abaisraeli bande bakaba bakomenya ase emechie yabo. Ekero omotienyi o gatano na kabere oigete, Abaisraeli bonsi konya bamenyire ase emechie yabo.

English: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.
Kiswahili: watu wote wakakusanyika kama mtu mmoja kwenye uwanja mbele ya Lango la Maji. Wakamwambia Ezra mwandishi alete Kitabu cha Sheria ya Mose, ambacho Bwana aliamuru kwa ajili ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto bonsi bakabwatana buna omonto oyomo, bagasangererekana ase eraaro agwo bosio bw’Egeita ki’Amache, bagateebia Ezra, oria orenge omworokia bw’amachiiko, arente Egetabu ki’Amachiko, a Musa, ayio Omonene aruete ase Abaisraeli.

English: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.
Kiswahili: Basi katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa saba, kuhani Ezra akaleta Sheria mbele ya kusanyiko, ambamo walikuwamo wanaume, wanawake na watu wote walioweza kufahamu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, Ezra Omokuani akarenta Egetabu ekio ki’Amachiko ase omoganda bwonsi, abasacha na abakungu, nabwo bonsi barenge konyara komanya aya baigwete.

English: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.
Kiswahili: Akaisoma kwa sauti kubwa tangu mapambazuko mpaka adhuhuri, akiwa ameuelekea uwanja uliokuwa mbele ya Lango la Maji mbele ya wanaume, wanawake na wengine ambao waliweza kufahamu. Watu wote wakasikiliza kwa makini kile Kitabu cha Sheria.
Ekegusii: Agatenena bosio bw’Egeita ki’Amache, origereretie eraaro eria, na korwa mambia chuni goika mobaso gati akaba ogosomera abasacha na abakungu, na abwo bonsi barenge konyara komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio. Abanto bonsi bagategerera koigwa ayarenge ase Egetabu ekio ki’Amachiko.

English: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
Kiswahili: Mwandishi Ezra alikuwa amesimama juu ya jukwaa la miti lililojengwa kwa kusudi hilo. Karibu naye upande wa kuume alisimama Matithia, Shema, Anaya, Uria, Hilkia na Maaseya. Upande wake wa kushoto walikuwepo Pedaya, Mishaeli, Malkiya, Hashumu, Hashbadani, Zekaria na Meshulamu.
Ekegusii: Ezra, omworokia bw’amachiiko, nigo atenenete igoro ase obotindiaro bwe chibao bwaroisetigwe ase emeremo eyio. Abatenenete ase ensemo yaye y’okorio nabwo aba: Matitia na Sema, Anaya na Uria, Hilikia na Maaseya. Na abatenenete ensemo yaye y’okobee, nabwo aba: Pedaya na Mishaeli, Malikia na Hasumu, Hasibadana na Zakaria, na Mesulamu.

English: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.
Kiswahili: Ezra akakifungua kile kitabu. Watu wote waliweza kumwona kwa sababu alikuwa amesimama juu zaidi, naye alipokifungua watu wote wakasimama.
Ekegusii: Ezra agatenena agwo igoro goetania abanto bonsi na akamaanora egetabu ase amasio abo. Ekero ayeigorete, abanto bonsi bagatenena.

English: Then Ezra blessed Yahweh, the great God. All the people answered, “Amen, Amen,” with the lifting up of their hands. They bowed their heads, and worshiped Yahweh with their faces to the ground.
Kiswahili: Ezra akamsifu Bwana, Mungu mkuu, nao watu wote wakainua mikono yao na kuitikia, “Amen! Amen!” Kisha wakasujudu na kumwabudu Bwana hali nyuso zao zikigusa ardhi.
Ekegusii: Ezra agatogia Omonene Nyasae bw’ogokumia. Abanto bonsi bakarambora amaboko abo gochia igoro, bagateeba, “Amina! Amina!” Erio bagatung’ama bakaumama, bagasasiima Omonene.

English: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.
Kiswahili: Watu wakiwa wamesimama pale, Walawi wafuatao waliwafunza ile Sheria: Yeshua, Bani, Sherebia, Yamini, Akubu, Shabethai, Hodia, Maaseya, Kelita, Azaria, Yozabadi, Hanani na Pelaya.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bagatenena, kera oyomo aase aye, na Yesua na Bani, Serebia na Yamini, Akubu na Sabetai, Hodia na Maaseya, Kelita na Asaria, Yosabadi na Hanani, na Pelaya, Abalawi bakorokereria abanto amachiiko.

English: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.
Kiswahili: Walisoma kutoka kile Kitabu cha Sheria ya Mungu, wakiifafanua na kuwapa maelezo ili watu waweze kufahamu kile kilichokuwa kikisomwa.
Ekegusii: Erio bagasoma buya mono amachiiko a Nyasae korwa ase Egetabu keria. Naende bakaorokia engencho y’amang’ana ayio, erinde abanto bayaigwe na koyamanya.

English: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to Yahweh your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Nehemia aliyekuwa mtawala, Ezra kuhani na mwandishi, pamoja na Walawi waliokuwa wakiwafundisha watu wakawaambia wote, “Siku hii ni takatifu kwa Bwana Mungu wenu. Msiomboleze wala msilie.” Kwa kuwa watu wote walikuwa wakilia walipokuwa wakisikiliza maneno ya ile Sheria.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baigwete amang’ana ya ’machiko bakarera. Nehemia oyorenge omogabana obo, na Ezra, Omokuani na omworokia bw’amachiiko, na Abalawi abwo borokereretie abanto bonsi, bagateebia abanto, “Rituko eri ria reero nerichenu ase Omonene, Nyasae oino; ase ayio timobaisa korera, gose kobokia amagombo.”

English: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”
Kiswahili: Nehemia akasema, “Nendeni mkafurahie chakula kizuri na vinywaji vitamu, na mpeleke sehemu kwa wale ambao hawana chochote cha kula. Siku hii ni takatifu kwa Bwana. Msihuzunike, kwa kuwa furaha ya Bwana ni nguvu zenu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Nehemia agateebia abanto, “Genda ase chinka chiaino, morie ebinoru biaino, monywe edivai enyansu, naende mobaatanere chindagera chiaino abwo batabwati, ekiagera rituko eri nerichenu ase Omonene oito. Timobaisa koba nomoichano, ekiagera omogooko Omonene noro chinguru chiaino.”

English: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”
Kiswahili: Walawi wakawatuliza watu wote wakisema, “Kuweni watulivu, kwa kuwa hii ni siku takatifu. Msihuzunike.”
Ekegusii: Abalawi bagaeta ase egati y’abanto, bakabakiria, bagoteeba, “Kabe n’obotoereru, ekiagera rituko eri nerichenu, timobaisa koba nomoichano.”

English: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wote wakaondoka kwenda kula na kunywa, na kupeana sehemu ya chakula, na wakaadhimisha kwa furaha kubwa, kwa sababu sasa walifahamu maneno yale waliyokuwa wameelezwa.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakagenda ase chinka chiabo, bakaba bakoria na konywa, bagaatanera chindagera chiabo baria batabwate, bakaba nomogooko, ekiagera konya bamanyire buya engencho y’amang’ana ayio bateebetigwe.

English: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya pili ya mwezi, wakuu wa mbari zote, pamoja na makuhani na Walawi, walikusanyika wakimzunguka Ezra mwandishi ili wapate kusikiliza kwa makini maneno ya Sheria.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, abateneneri be chiamate chiabo chionsi amo nabakuani na Abalawi, bagacha ase Ezra, omworokia bw’amariko, erinde beorokererie amang’ana ’amachiiko aria.

English: They found written in the law how Yahweh had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;
Kiswahili: Wakakuta imeandikwa katika ile Sheria, ambayo Bwana aliiamuru kupitia kwa Mose, kwamba Waisraeli walipaswa kukaa katika vibanda wakati wa sikukuu ya mwezi wa saba,
Ekegusii: Bakanyora amang’ana ariikire ase amachiiko ayio Omonene aruete ase Abaisraeli goetera ase Musa, ng’a Abaisraeli goika bamenye ase ebigutu ase Rituko Rinene ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere,

English: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, as it is written.”
Kiswahili: na kwamba walipaswa kutangaza neno hili na kulieneza katika miji yao na katika Yerusalemu wakisema: “Enendeni katika nchi ya mlima na kuleta matawi kutoka miti ya mizeituni, mizeituni mwitu, mihadasi, mitende na miti ya kivuli, ili kutengeneza vibanda,” kama ilivyoandikwa.
Ekegusii: naende ng’a ase engaki eyio goika bararie ase emechie yabo yonsi, na ase Yerusalemu, bateebie abanto bagende ase ebigoro barente chinsagia chi’emezeituni, ere ase emegondo na eyere ase orosana, na echi’emeadasi, na echi’emekendo, na echi’emete ende ere namato amange, erio baagachere ebigutu buna eriikire.

English: So the people went out and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.
Kiswahili: Basi watu wakaenda na kuleta matawi, nao wakajijengea vibanda juu ya paa za nyumba zao, katika nyua zao, katika nyua za nyumba ya Mungu, na katika uwanja karibu na Lango la Maji na uwanja wa Lango la Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakarenta chinsagia echio, erio kera omonto akaagacha ekegutu igoro ase ekerama ki’enyomba yaye, gose ase ekeooreri kiaye, na ase chiraaro chi’enyomba ya Nyasae, na ase eraaro bosio bw’Egeita ki’Amache, na ase ey’Egeita ki’Efraimu.

English: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.
Kiswahili: Jamii yote ya watu waliorudi kutoka utumwani wakajenga vibanda na kuishi ndani yake. Tangu wakati wa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni mpaka siku ile, Waisraeli hawakuwahi kuiadhimisha namna hii. Furaha yao ilikuwa kubwa sana.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’abaanto bairanete korwa ase obosomba bakaagacha ebigutu bamenye imeo, ekiagera korwa ase engaki ya Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, goika ase engaki eyio, Abaisraeli konya tibana gokora bo. Na bono bakaba nomogooko omonene.

English: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.
Kiswahili: Siku baada ya siku, kuanzia siku ya kwanza hadi ya mwisho, Ezra alisoma kutoka kwenye kile Kitabu cha Sheria ya Mungu. Wakaiadhimisha sikukuu ile kwa siku saba, nayo siku ya nane, kufuatana na maagizo, kulikuwa na kusanyiko maalum.
Ekegusii: Kera rituko, korwa erie ritang’ani goikera eri’omoerio, Ezra akaba okobasomera Korea ase Egetabu keria kiarikire amachiiko a Nyasae. Abanto bakagenderera korenda Amatuko aria Amanene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, na ase rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaba nomosangererekano omonene bw’ogosasiima, buna yachikiire.

English: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt on them.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi ule ule, Waisraeli walikusanyika pamoja, wakifunga na kuvaa nguo za gunia na kujitia mavumbi vichwani mwao.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane ri’omotienyi oyio, Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangererekana amo, beng’atete na beboyetie chigunia, bageaka ebundo ase emetwe yabo.

English: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.
Kiswahili: Wale wa uzao wa Israeli walijitenga na wageni wote. Wakasimama mahali pao, na kuungama dhambi zao na uovu wa baba zao.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya berusananirie korwa ase abamenyi bonsi, na bagatenena koorokia ebibe biabo, amo nogokora okobe gwe chisokoro chiabo.

English: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped Yahweh their God.
Kiswahili: Wakasimama pale walipokuwa, wakasoma kutoka kwenye kile Kitabu cha Sheria ya Bwana Mungu wao kwa muda wa robo siku, na wakatumia robo nyingine kwa kuungama dhambi na kumwabudu Bwana Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Bagatenena kera oyomo aseye, na Egetabu keria ki’Amachiko y’Omonene, Nyasae obo, ekaba egosomwa ase bare ase egeka gie chinsa inye, naende bakaba bakoorokia ebibe biabo na komosasiima Omonene, Nyasae obo, ase egeka kende gie chinsa inye, ase rituko erio.

English: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.
Kiswahili: Walawi wafuatao walikuwa wamesimama kwenye ngazi: Yeshua, Bani, Kadmieli, Shebania, Buni, Sherebia, Bani na Kenani. Hawa walimlilia Bwana Mungu wao kwa sauti kubwa.
Ekegusii: Erio Yesua na Bani, Kadimieli na Sebania, Buni na Serebia, Bani na Kenani, bagatenena igoro y’obotindiaro bwachikeire Abalawi, bagasaba neriogi rinene ase Omonene, Nyasae obo.

English: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!
Kiswahili: Nao Walawi Yeshua, Kadmieli, Bani, Hashabnea, Sherebia, Hodia, Shebania na Pethahia wakasema: “Simameni mkamsifu Bwana Mungu wenu, yeye ambaye ni Mungu tangu milele hata milele. “Libarikiwe jina lake tukufu, litukuzwe juu ya baraka zote na sifa.
Ekegusii: Abalawi aba: Yesua na Kadimieli, Bani na Hasabineya, Serebia na Hodia, Sebania na Petahia, bagateebia abanto, “Tenena motogie Omonene, Nyasae oino, momotogie korwa bono goika kare na kare. Ogotogigwa kobe ase erieta riaye rinene riimokereirie igoro goetania ogosesesenigwa na ogotogigwa gwonsi.”

English: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.
Kiswahili: Wewe peke yako ndiwe Bwana. Uliziumba mbingu, hata mbingu za mbingu na jeshi lote la mbinguni, dunia na vyote vilivyo ndani yake, na pia bahari na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake. Huvipa vitu vyote uhai, nalo jeshi la mbinguni linakuabudu wewe.
Ekegusii: “Aye naye Omonene, aye bweka. Naye gwatongete igoro, na igoro ya igoro chionsi, na emeganda yabo yonsi, na ense amo n’ebinto bionsi bireo, ne chinyancha, na ebinto bionsi bire imeo. Naye obirendete bigendererete kobao; ebitongwa bionsi bia igoro nigo bikogosasiima.

English: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,
Kiswahili: “Wewe ni Bwana Mungu uliyemchagua Abramu na kumtoa kutoka Uru ya Wakaldayo, nawe ukamwita Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae gwachorete Aburamu na okamorusia korwa Uri bw’Abakalidayo, erio okaonchora erieta riaye, okamoroka Aburaamu.

English: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.
Kiswahili: Uliona kuwa moyo wake ni mwaminifu kwako, nawe ukafanya Agano naye kuwapa wazao wake nchi ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Waperizi, Wayebusi na Wagirgashi. Umetimiza ahadi yako kwa sababu wewe ni mwenye haki.
Ekegusii: Okamorora ng’a nigo arenge nenkoro y’obwegenwa ase obosio bwao, erio ogakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo nere ng’a noe ororeria rwaye ense y’Abakanaani, ey’Abahiti na Abaamori, ey’Abaperisi, na Abayebusi, na Abagirigasi, na bono gwaikeranirie ring’ana gwakwanete, ekiagera aye nomonyene oboronge.

English: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,
Kiswahili: “Uliona mateso ya baba zetu huko Misri, ukasikia kilio chao huko Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: “Aye kwaroche emechando ye chisokoro chiaito aaria Misiri, naende okaigwa okorera kwabo agwo mbarabare ase Enyancha Embariri.

English: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today.
Kiswahili: Ulituma ishara za miujiza na maajabu dhidi ya Farao, dhidi ya maafisa wake wote na watu wote wa nchi yake, kwa kuwa ulifahamu jinsi Wamisri walivyowafanyia ufidhuli. Ukajifanyia jina linalodumu hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Ogakora ebikone na amakumia mamincha ya Farao, mamincha y’abasomba baye bonsi na abanto bonsi b’ense yaye, ekiagera nkwamanyete buna abakorerete chisokoro chiaito bobe; boigo erieta riao rikamanyekana, rikaba rinene buna rire goika reero iga.

English: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.
Kiswahili: Ukagawa bahari mbele yao, ili waweze kupita katikati yake penye nchi kavu, lakini uliwatupa Wamisri waliowafuatilia katika vilindi, kama jiwe kwenye maji mengi.
Ekegusii: Ogaatanana amaache ’enyancha ase amasio e chisokoro chiaito, erinde bagaeta ase egati y’enyancha buna ense enyomo; okarimeria abachandi babo ase chindiba, buna rigena rikorutwa ase amaache amanene ime.

English: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.
Kiswahili: Mchana uliwaongoza kwa nguzo ya wingu, na usiku kwa nguzo ya moto kuwamulikia njia iliyowapasa kuiendea.
Ekegusii: Ase omobaso okaraa Abaisraeli ne riire, na ase obotuko ne riire ri’omorero ase okobamorekera enchera baare goetera.

English: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,
Kiswahili: “Ulishuka katika Mlima Sinai, ukanena nao kutoka mbinguni. Uliwapa masharti na sheria zile ambazo ni za kweli na haki, pia amri na maagizo mazuri.
Ekegusii: Aye kwaigwete korwa igoro ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ogakwana nabarabwo korwa igoro, okabachikera emeroberio emeronge na okabaa amachiiko ay’ekeene.

English: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,
Kiswahili: Uliwafahamisha Sabato yako takatifu na ukawapa amri, maagizo na sheria kupitia mtumishi wako Mose.
Ekegusii: Okaborokereria bakamanya Esabato yao Enchenu, naende okabaa emeroberio na amachiiko goetera ase Musa, omosomba oo.

English: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.
Kiswahili: Katika njaa yao uliwapa mkate kutoka mbinguni, na katika kiu yao uliwatolea maji kutoka kwenye mwamba. Uliwaambia waingie na kuimiliki nchi ambayo ulikuwa umeapa kuwapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa.
Ekegusii: “Ekero barenge nenchara, okabarentera endagera korwa igoro, na ekero barenge nerang’o, okabasokeria amaache korwa ase egetare, naende okabateebia bagende koira ense eyio konya kwarire eira y’ogotiana ng’a nobayee.

English: “But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,
Kiswahili: “Lakini wao, baba zetu, wakawa na kiburi na shingo ngumu, nao hawakutii maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Korende chisokoro chiaito, barabwo bakaba abaenenu, bagakong’ia ebigoti biabo ase ogotaigwera, bakaanga kobwata amachiiko ao.

English: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.
Kiswahili: Wakakataa kusikiliza na kushindwa kukumbuka miujiza uliyoifanya miongoni mwao. Wakawa na shingo ngumu, na katika uasi wao wakamchagua kiongozi ili warudi kwenye utumwa wao. Lakini wewe ni Mungu mwenye kusamehe, mwenye neema na mwingi wa huruma, si mwepesi wa hasira, ni mwingi wa upendo. Kwa hiyo hukuwaacha,
Ekegusii: Bakaanga koigwera, gose tibarengereretie na koinyora amakumia gwakorete ase egati yabo; bagakong’ia ebigoti, bagachora omoraai abatang’ane koirana gochia Misiri ase obosomba. Korende aye naye Nyasae bw’okwabera, nigo ore omuya, naende omonyene amaabera, tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, aye nigo ore nobwanchani obonge botari koera, gose tikwabatigete.

English: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies,
Kiswahili: hata wakati walijitengenezea sanamu ya ndama ya kusubu na kusema, ‘Huyu ni mungu wenu, aliyewapandisha kutoka nchi ya Misri,’ au walipofanya makufuru makubwa.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakeroiseria omogwekano bw’emori korwa ase etaabu enyititoire na kobombwa, bagateeba ng’a oyo noro ore Nyasae oino obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, bagakwana amang’ana ay’okorama okonene.

English: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.
Kiswahili: “Kwa sababu ya huruma zako kuu hukuwaacha jangwani. Wakati wa mchana ile nguzo ya wingu haikukoma kuwaongoza katika njia yao, wala nguzo ya moto haikuacha kuwamulikia usiku njia iliyowapasa kuiendea.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, ase engencho y’amaabera ao amanene tikwabatigete agwo ase erooro. Riire riria riarenge kobaraa ase omobaso tiriaruete ase bare; gose riire riria ri’omorero tiriatigete kobamorekera ase enchera barenge goeta ase obotuko.

English: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.
Kiswahili: Uliwapa Roho wako mwema ili kuwafundisha. Hukuwanyima mana yako vinywani mwao, nawe ukawapa maji kwa ajili ya kiu yao.
Ekegusii: Aye okabaa Omoika oo omuya koborokereria; tikwabarinete mana baare koria, naende nigo kwabaete amaache baare konywa ekero barenge nerang’o.

English: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka arobaini uliwatunza jangwani. Hawakukosa chochote, na nguo zao hazikuchakaa wala miguu yao haikuvimba.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene bagendererete kobeera ase erooro okabarenda, barabwo tibaremeretwe gento kende, nonya ne chianga chiabo tichiagotete, gose amagoro abo tabimbete.

English: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
Kiswahili: “Uliwapa falme na mataifa, ukiwagawia hata mipaka ya mbali. Wakaimiliki nchi ya Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni, na nchi ya Ogu mfalme wa Bashani.
Ekegusii: “Okabaa okobua igoro ase amarwoti; okabaatanera chinse ao ao. Bakaira ense ya Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni, na eya Ogi, omorwoti o Basani.

English: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.
Kiswahili: Uliwafanya wana wao kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, nawe ukawaleta katika nchi ambayo uliwaambia baba zao kuingia na kuimiliki.
Ekegusii: Okabaa abana abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, na okabarenta ase ense eyio kwarierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a ebe eyabo.

English: “So the children went in and possessed the land; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.
Kiswahili: Wana wao wakaingia na kuimiliki nchi. Uliwatiisha Wakanaani mbele yao, walioishi katika nchi, ukawatia Wakanaani mikononi mwao, pamoja na wafalme wao na watu wa nchi, wawafanyie kama wapendavyo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abana babo bakagenda bakaira ense eyio. Aye okabua Abakanaani, abanto b’ense eye, okababeka ase amaboko ’abaanto bao, okabaa nabarwoti babo na abanto b’ense eye, erinde baabakorere buna banchete.

English: They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.
Kiswahili: Wakateka miji yenye ngome na nchi yenye rutuba, wakamiliki nyumba zilizojazwa na vitu vizuri vya kila aina, visima vilivyochimbwa tayari, mashamba ya mizabibu, mashamba ya mizeituni na miti yenye matunda kwa wingi. Wakala, wakashiba nao wakanawiri sana, wakajifurahisha katika wema wako mwingi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaira emechie yagiteire chindwaki, na ense entenenku, bakaira ne chinyomba chiaichire n’ebinto ebiya, ne chinsoko chi’amaache chiabaachetwe ase ebitare, na emegondo y’emesabibu na ey’emezeituni, na emete emenge y’amatunda. Bakaria, bakaigota na konora, bakaba nomogooko omonene ase obuya bwao obonge.

English: “Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.
Kiswahili: “Lakini hawakukutii nao wakaasi dhidi yako, wakatupa sheria zako nyuma yao. Wakawaua manabii wako, waliowaonya ili wakurudie, na wakafanya makufuru makubwa.
Ekegusii: “Nonya naboigo nigo bangete gokoigwera, bagasaria asore, bakaa amachiiko ao amagega, bagaita ababani bao, abwo babakuurerete bairane gochia asore; ase ayio bagakora okomocha okonge gw’okorama erieta riao.

English: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ukawatia mikononi mwa adui zao, ambao waliwatesa. Lakini walipoteswa, wakakulilia wewe. Kutoka mbinguni uliwasikia, nawe kwa huruma zako kuu ukawapa waokozi, waliowaokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio okababeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na barabwo bakabachanda. Ekero barenge ase emechando yabo, bakarera asore; aye okabaigwa agwo igoro; na ase engencho y’amaabera ao amange, okabaa abatooria abwo bakabatooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo.

English: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,
Kiswahili: “Lakini mara walipokuwa na raha, wakafanya maovu tena machoni pako. Kisha ukawaacha mikononi mwa adui zao, nao wakawatawala. Walipokulilia tena, ukasikia kutoka mbinguni, na kwa huruma zako ukawaokoa kila mara.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya banyorire obotoereru, bagakora ebibe asore naende; aye ogatiga ababisa babo bakababua na kobagambera. Nonya naboigo, ekero barenge gokoiranera na korera asore, nigo kwarenge kobaigwa korwa agwo igoro, na ase engencho y’amaabera ao amange nigo kwabeete gokobatooria ase chingaki chinyinge.

English: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.
Kiswahili: “Ukawaonya warudi katika sheria yako, lakini wakawa na kiburi na hawakutii amri zako. Wakatenda dhambi dhidi ya maagizo yako ambayo kwayo mtu ataishi kama akiyatii. Kwa ukaidi wakakugeuzia kisogo, wakawa na shingo ngumu na wakakataa kusikiliza.
Ekegusii: Nigo kwabakuurerete bairane babwate amachiiko ao, korende ase engencho y’oboenenu bwabo bakaanga koigwera amachiiko ao, bagakora ebibe ase emeroberio yao echiikire, eyio omonto karayebwate nabe moyo. Bakaenena, bagakong’ia ebigoti tibaigwera.

English: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would not listen. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka mingi ulikuwa mvumilivu kwao. Kwa njia ya Roho wako ukawaonya kupitia manabii wako. Hata hivyo hawakujali, basi ukawatia mikononi mwa mataifa jirani.
Ekegusii: Ase emiaka emenge okabaremereria, okabakuurera n’Omoika oo goetera ase ababani bao. Nonya naboigo tibaigwerete; erio okababeka ase amaboko ’abaanto b’ebisaku ebiao.

English: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa rehema zako kuu hukuwakomesha wala kuwaacha, kwa kuwa wewe ni Mungu mwenye neema na rehema.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’amaabera ao amange, tikwabasiretie gose kobatiga, ekiagera aye Nyasae oito nomuya ore, na omonyene amaabera.

English: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.
Kiswahili: “Basi sasa, Ee Mungu wetu, uliye mkuu, mwenye nguvu na Mungu wa kuogofya, mwenye kushika agano lake la upendo, usiache taabu hizi zote zionekane kuwa kitu kidogo mbele za macho yako, taabu hizi zilizotupata, juu ya wafalme wetu na viongozi, juu ya makuhani wetu na manabii, juu ya baba zetu na watu wako wote, tangu siku za wafalme wa Ashuru hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Na bono, aye Nyasae oito, nigo ore omonene, na omobui, na oyo bw’okoirokia. Nigo orendete okobwatana kw’ogotianania, na obwanchani bwao boria bogendererete botambe. Tobara buna negento egesinini obokong’u obo bwonsi bwatonyorire. Korwa ase engaki eria abarwoti b’Abaasuri batogamberete goika reero, twabeire togochandeka intwe na abarwoti baito, na abanene baito, na abakuani baito, na ababani baito, ne chisokoro chiaito; ee, abanto bao bonsi.

English: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.
Kiswahili: Katika hayo yote yaliyotupata, umekuwa mwenye haki, na umetenda kwa uaminifu, wakati sisi tumetenda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, aye nigo ore omonyene oboronge ase amang’ana aya onsi abeire agotonyora; aye nigo ore omwegenwa, korende intwe twakorire ayare amabe.

English: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.
Kiswahili: Wafalme wetu, viongozi wetu, makuhani wetu na baba zetu hawakufuata sheria yako. Hawakuzingatia amri zako wala maonyo uliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti baito, na abanene baito, na abakuani baito, ne chisokoro chiaito, tibabwatete amachiiko ao, gose tibaigwerete ogokuurera kwao kwabakuurerete.

English: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.
Kiswahili: Hata walipokuwa wangali katika ufalme wao, wakiufurahia wema wako mkuu katika nchi kubwa na yenye rutuba uliyowapa, hawakukutumikia wala kugeuka kutoka njia zao mbaya.
Ekegusii: Nonya bamenyete ase oborwoti bwabo abanyene, na kwabaeire amaya amange ase ense eria entenenku kwabaete, tibagokorerete gose tibaonchogete korwa ase ogokora kwabo okobe.

English: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.
Kiswahili: “Lakini tazama, sisi ni watumwa leo, watumwa katika nchi uliyowapa baba zetu ili wapate kula matunda yake na vitu vingine vizuri inayozalisha.
Ekegusii: Bono nigo tore abasomba aiga ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiaito ng’a barie okwama kwaye na kwegokeria amaya.

English: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya dhambi zetu, mavuno yake mengi huenda kwa wafalme uliowaweka watutawale. Wanatawala juu ya miili yetu na mifugo yetu kama wapendavyo. Tuko katika dhiki kuu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ebibe biaito obotenenku bw’ense eye bwairirwe nabarwoti abwo babekirwe gotogambera. Abwo mbabwate okobua igoro ase emebere yaito, na ase chitugo chiaito, batokorere buna banchete, na intwe nigo tore nemechando emenene.”

English: Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”
Kiswahili: “Kwa sababu ya haya yote, tunajifunga katika mapatano, na kuyaandika, nao viongozi wetu, Walawi wetu na makuhani wetu wanatia mihuri yao.”
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio onsi, bono nigo togokora okobwatana gotari koonchoka na tokorike, erinde abanene baito amo n’Abalawi baito, na abakuani baito, babeeke ebimanyererio biabo ase korokwo.

English: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,
Kiswahili: Wale waliotia muhuri walikuwa: Nehemia mtawala, mwana wa Hakalia. Sedekia,
Ekegusii: Ababegete ebimanyererio biabo ase okobwatana koria nabwo aba: Nehemia omogabana, mosinto o Hakalia, na Zedekia.

English: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
Kiswahili: Seraya, Azaria, Yeremia,
Ekegusii: Seraya, na Asaria, na Yeremia;

English: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,
Kiswahili: Pashuri, Amaria, Malkiya,
Ekegusii: Pasuri, na Amaria, na Malikia;

English: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
Kiswahili: Hatushi, Shebania, Maluki,
Ekegusii: Hatusi, na Sebania, na Maluki;

English: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
Kiswahili: Harimu, Meremothi, Obadia,
Ekegusii: Harimu, na Meremoti, na Obadia;

English: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
Kiswahili: Danieli, Ginethoni, Baruku,
Ekegusii: Danieli, na Ginetoni, na Baruku;

English: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
Kiswahili: Meshulamu, Abiya, Miyamini,
Ekegusii: Mesulamu, na Abiya, na Miyamini;

English: Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.
Kiswahili: Maazia, Bilgai na Shemaya. Hawa ndio waliokuwa makuhani.
Ekegusii: Maasia, na Biligai, na Semaya. Aba nabwo barenge abakuani.

English: The Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
Kiswahili: Walawi: Yeshua mwana wa Azania, Binui wa wana wa Henadadi, Kadmieli,
Ekegusii: Abalawi nabwo aba: Yesua, mosinto bw’Asania, na Binui bw’eamate ya Henadadi, na Kadimieli;

English: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
Kiswahili: na wenzao: Shebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaya, Hanani,
Ekegusii: abamwabo: Sebania na Hodia; Kelita, na Pelaya, na Hanani;

English: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
Kiswahili: Mika, Rehobu, Hashabia,
Ekegusii: Mika, na Rehobu, na Hasabia;

English: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
Kiswahili: Zakuri, Sherebia, Shebania,
Ekegusii: Sakuri, na Serebia, na Sebania;

English: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
Kiswahili: Hodia, Bani na Beninu.
Ekegusii: Hodia, na Bani, na Beninu.

English: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa watu: Paroshi, Pahath-Moabu, Elamu, Zatu, Bani,
Ekegusii: Abatang’ani b’abaanto nabwo aba: Parosi, na Pahati-Moabu, na Elamu, na Satu, na Bani;

English: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
Kiswahili: Buni, Azgadi, Bebai,
Ekegusii: Buni, na Asigadi, na Bebai;

English: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
Kiswahili: Adoniya, Bigwai, Adini,
Ekegusii: Adonia, na Bigiwai, na Adini;

English: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
Kiswahili: Ateri, Hezekia, Azuri,
Ekegusii: Ateri, na Hezekia, na Asuri;

English: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
Kiswahili: Hodia, Hashumu, Besai,
Ekegusii: Hodia, na Hasumu, na Besai;

English: Hariph, Anathoth, Nobai,
Kiswahili: Harifu, Anathothi, Nebai,
Ekegusii: Harifu, na Anatoti, na Nebai;

English: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
Kiswahili: Magpiashi, Meshulamu, Heziri,
Ekegusii: Magipiasi, na Mesulamu, na Hesiri;

English: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
Kiswahili: Meshezabeli, Sadoki, Yadua,
Ekegusii: Meshesabeli, na Zadoki na Yadua;

English: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
Kiswahili: Pelatia, Hanani, Anaya,
Ekegusii: Pelatia, na Hanani, na Anaya;

English: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
Kiswahili: Hoshea, Hanania, Hashubu,
Ekegusii: Hosea, na Hanania, na Hasubu;

English: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
Kiswahili: Haloheshi, Pilha, Shobeki,
Ekegusii: Halohesi, na Pila, na Sobeki;

English: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
Kiswahili: Rehumu, Hashabna, Maaseya,
Ekegusii: Rehumu, na Hasabuna, na Maaseya;

English: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
Kiswahili: Ahiya, Hanani, Anani,
Ekegusii: Ahiya, na Hanani, na Anani;

English: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah.
Kiswahili: Maluki, Harimu na Baana.
Ekegusii: Maluku, na Harimu, na Baana.

English: The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—everyone who had knowledge and understanding—
Kiswahili: “Watu wengine wote, wakiwa ni makuhani, Walawi, mabawabu, waimbaji, watumishi wa Hekalu, na wale wote waliojitenga na mataifa jirani kwa ajili ya Sheria ya Mungu, pamoja na wake zao na wana wao na binti zao wote waliokuwa na uwezo wa kufahamu,
Ekegusii: Abanto abatigarete, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abateri, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, na abanto bonsi konya berusananirie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku ase engencho y’amachiiko a Nyasae, barabwo amo nabakungu babo, na abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, nabwo bonsi babwate obong’aini bw’okomanya,

English: joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of Yahweh our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;
Kiswahili: basi hawa wote wanajiunga na ndugu zao na wakuu wao, na kujifunga kwa laana na kwa kiapo kufuata Sheria ya Mungu iliyotolewa kupitia kwa Mose mtumishi wa Mungu, na kutii kwa uangalifu amri zote, maagizo na sheria za Bwana, Bwana wetu.
Ekegusii: bakabwatana nabaanto bamwabo basikire, bakaria eira bagatiana ng’a mbabwatie amachiiko a Nyasae ayaruetwe goetera ase Musa, omosomba oye, naende ng’a mbarende na gokora amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene, oyore Omonene oito, amo nemeroberio yaye yonsi echiikire.

English: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;
Kiswahili: “Tunaahidi kutowaoza binti zetu kwa watu wanaotuzunguka, wala kuwaoza wana wetu binti zao.
Ekegusii: Bagateeba, Titokorua abaiseke baito banyuomwe nabaanto b’ense eye, gose titokonyuomeria abamura baito abaiseke babo.
