Ekegusii: Abanto ba Seba bacha mobasokano, baira chitugo chionsi, naende baita abasomba nemioro; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”

English: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Moto wa Mungu ulishuka kutoka mbinguni na kuteketeza kondoo na watumishi, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari!”
Ekegusii: Ekero oyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateeba, “Omorero o Nyasae nigo ogwa korwa igoro, osamba ching’ondi chiayia chiaera, naende boigo osamba abasomba bayia baera; ninche bweka natigara, natama gocha kogoteebia.”

English: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Wakaldayo waliunda vikosi vitatu vya uvamizi na kuwaangukia ngamia wako na kuwachukua wakaondoka nao. Wakawaua watumishi kwa upanga, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari.”
Ekegusii: Na ekero noyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateebia Ayubu, “Abakalidayo nigo bachicha bare ebiombe bitato, baumokera chingamia, bachiira, naende baita abasomba bande nemioro; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”

English: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Wana wako na binti zako walipokuwa wakifanya karamu, wakila na kunywa divai katika nyumba ya ndugu yao mkubwa,
Ekegusii: Ekero noyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateebia Ayubu, “Abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, nigo babwate omoyega bw’okoria na konywa edivai ase enyomba ya momura omwabo omonene;

English: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”
Kiswahili: ghafula upepo wenye nguvu ukavuma kutoka jangwani, nao ukaipiga nyumba hiyo pembe zake nne. Ikawaangukia hao watoto nao wamekufa, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari!”
Ekegusii: bono omwaga bw’echinguru ocha korwa ase erooro, onyegeria chikoona inye chi’enyomba eria, erinde yagwera abana abwo abasae, bakuure bonsi; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”

English: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Ayubu akasimama, akararua joho lake na kunyoa nywele zake. Kisha akaanguka chini katika kuabudu
Ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akaimoka, agatandora eanga yaye, agakigita etukia yaye, erio agatung’ama inse, agasasiima,

English: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away. Blessed be Yahweh’s name.”
Kiswahili: na kusema: “Nilitoka tumboni mwa mama yangu uchi, nami nitaondoka uchi, Bwana alinipa, naye Bwana ameviondoa, jina la Bwana litukuzwe.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Nigo narwete ase enda ya baba inde getirianda, naende nigo ndairane korwa ase ense inde getirianda. Omonene nere oruete, naende oirire. Erieta riaye ritogigwe.”

English: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.
Kiswahili: Katika mambo haya yote, Ayubu hakutenda dhambi kwa kumlaumu Mungu kwa kufanya ubaya.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe, gose tabeekerete Nyasae obobe.

English: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, Satan came also among them to present himself before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Siku nyingine wana wa Mungu walikuja kujionyesha mbele za Bwana. Shetani naye akaja pamoja nao kujionyesha mbele zake.
Ekegusii: Naende ekaba ng’a rituko erimo, ekero abamura ba Nyasae bachete kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene, Saitani nere agacha agwo ase barenge kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamuuliza Shetani, “Umetoka wapi?” Shetani akamjibu Bwana “Natoka kuzunguka pote duniani, nikitembea huku na huko humo.”
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Naye ng’ai okorwa?” Saitani akamoiraneria, “Nigo nkorwa ase etaaro yane, nkona‐goetanana ase ense yonsi, naende nabo nkonagotiira na gotirimboka aroro.”

English: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Je, umemwangalia huyo mtumishi wangu Ayubu? Hakuna mtu mwingine duniani aliye kama yeye, mtu asiye na hatia, ni mnyofu, mwenye kumcha Mungu na kuepukana na uovu. Naye bado anadumisha uadilifu wake, ingawa ulinichochea dhidi yake, ili nimwangamize pasipo sababu.”
Ekegusii: Agwo Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Ayubu, omosomba one, kwarorire buna are? Monto onde tari ase ense onga buna ere; nigo are omwegenwa na obwate enkoro endonge; ere nigo anyirogete inche Nyasae, naende nigo etangete korwa ase ogokora amabe. Nonya kwang’ebereretie komochanda ngencho ende etaiyo, ere nigo agendererete koba omwegenwa.”

English: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
Kiswahili: Shetani akamjibu Bwana, “Ngozi kwa ngozi! Mwanadamu atatoa vyote alivyo navyo kwa ajili ya uhai wake.
Ekegusii: Erio Saitani akairaneri’Omonene, akamoteebia, “Risankwa ase risankwa; omonto nigo ararue gento kende gionsi abwate ase ogotooria obogima bwaye.

English: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nyoosha mkono wako na kuipiga nyama yake na mifupa yake, naye kwa hakika atakulaani mbele za uso wako.”
Ekegusii: Bono aye rambora okoboko kwao, okune amauga ’omobere oye, amo ne chinyama, omokore bobe, ekeene, ere nigo arakoragereria agwo ase obosio bwao.”

English: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Vema sana, kwa hiyo, yeye yumo mikononi mwako, lakini lazima umwachie uhai wake.”
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Saitani ayio namaya, “Rora, Ayubu nigo are inse y’okobua kwao, korende omotige abe moyo.”

English: So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
Kiswahili: Basi Shetani akatoka mbele za Bwana naye akampiga Ayubu kwa majipu mabaya tangu nyayo za miguu yake hadi utosi wa kichwa.
Ekegusii: Erio Saitani akarua agwo ase Omonene, akageenda, akarentera Ayubu amagumba, gochakera chimbaratero goikera ase omotwe igoro.

English: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Ayubu akachukua kigae na kujikuna nacho huku akiketi kwenye majivu.
Ekegusii: Ayubu akaba ogoikaransa ase ribu, akaimokia orogio, akana‐kweageria amaote aye.

English: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”
Kiswahili: Mke wake akamwambia, “Je, bado unashikamana na uadilifu wako? Mlaani Mungu nawe ukafe!”
Ekegusii: Erio mokaye akamobooria, “Inee, nonya ngoika bono nigo ogendererete koba omwegenwa ase Omonene? Ragereria Nyasae, erio okwe!”

English: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.
Kiswahili: Akamjibu, “Unazungumza kama vile ambavyo mwanamke mpumbavu yeyote angenena. Je, tupokee mema mikononi mwa Mungu, nasi tusipokee na udhia?” Katika mambo haya yote, Ayubu hakutenda dhambi katika kusema kwake.
Ekegusii: Korende Ayubu akairaneria mokaye, akamoteebia, “Aye nigo ogokwana buna omokungu onde bwensi omoriri agokwana. Onye tokonyora amaya korwa ase Nyasae, Inee, titokonyora amabe naro korwa asare?” Ase amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe ase ogokwana kwaye.

English: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.
Kiswahili: Basi marafiki watatu wa Ayubu, ndio Elifazi Mtemani, na Bildadi Mshuhi na Sofari Mnaamathi, waliposikia juu ya taabu yote iliyompata Ayubu, wakajipanga toka manyumbani mwao, nao wakakutana pamoja kwa makubaliano kwenda kumtuliza katika taabu hiyo na kumfariji.
Ekegusii: Ayubu nabwate abasani batato: Elifasi korwa Temani, na Bilidadi korwa Sua, na Sofari korwa Naama. Ekero barabwo baigwete igoro y’emechando eria Ayubu anyorete, bagachikana ng’a kera oyomo arue bwoye, baumerane amo, bagende komwechandera na komoremia.

English: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.
Kiswahili: Walipomwona kwa mbali, ilikuwa vigumu kumtambua. Wakaanza kulia kwa sauti kubwa, wakayararua majoho yao na kujirushia mavumbi juu ya vichwa vyao.
Ekegusii: Bagachia komoorora korwa aare, tibanyara komomanya gose nere. Bagachaaka goaka amariogi bakorera; bagatandora chianga chiabo, bagesiarera ebuse gochia igoro na ase emetwe yabo.

English: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaketi chini kwenye udongo pamoja na Ayubu kwa siku saba usiku na mchana. Hakuna yeyote aliyesema naye neno, kwa sababu waliona jinsi mateso yake yalivyokuwa makubwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagaikaransa inse agwo amo nere ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, omobaso na obotuko; agwo onde tabeete ogokwana ing’ana rinde rionsi ase Ayubu, ekiagera baroche ng’a emechando yaye nigo yarenge emenene mono.

English: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.
Kiswahili: Baada ya jambo hili, Ayubu akafumbua kinywa chake na kuilaani siku ya kuzaliwa kwake.
Ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu agachaaka gokwana, akaragereria rituko riria aiboretwe.

English: Job answered:
Kiswahili: Kisha akasema:
Ekegusii: Ayubu agateeba,

English: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’
Kiswahili: “Siku ya kuzaliwa kwangu na ipotelee mbali, nao usiku ule iliposemekana, ‘Mtoto wa kiume amezaliwa!’
Ekegusii: Rituko riria naiboretwe, tiga risire riebwe kegima, boigo obotuko boria amang’ana aya akwanetwe: Omwana omoisia otongirwe enda ime.

English: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.
Kiswahili: Siku ile na iwe giza; Mungu juu na asiiangalie; nayo nuru isiiangazie.
Ekegusii: Tiga rituko riria ribe omosunte; Nyasae ore igoro tabaisa koriechandera, gose omobaso tobaisa koribarera.

English: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.
Kiswahili: Giza na kivuli kikuu kiikalie tena; wingu na likae juu yake; weusi na uifunike nuru yake.
Ekegusii: Tiga omosunte na ekiriri ekemwamu biritube. Tiga amare aritube, na kende gionsi egekorenta obomwamu ase rituko kerioboyie.

English: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule na ushikwe na giza kuu; usihesabiwe katika siku za mwaka, wala usihesabiwe katika siku za mwezi wowote.
Ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima otube obotuko boria, tibobaisa kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’omwaka, gose kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’emetienyi.

English: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule na uwe tasa; sauti ya furaha na isisikike ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Ee, obotuko boria tiga bogombae; eriogi ri’omogooko tiribaisa koigugwa ase borobwo.

English: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
Kiswahili: Wale wazilaanio siku wailaani hiyo siku, wale walio tayari kumwamsha Lewiathani.
Ekegusii: Boragererigwe nabwo bamanyete koragereria amatuko, abwo baganyete korenta Leviatani eng’iti enene y’okwoboyia.

English: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,
Kiswahili: Nyota zake za alfajiri na ziwe giza; nao ungojee mwanga bila mafanikio, wala usiuone mwonzi wa kwanza wa mapambazuko,
Ekegusii: Ching’enang’eni chiaye chia ituko ria mambia chibe omosunte; obotuko tiga bochie koganya ng’a bokie, korende tibokia rinde, gose tibobaisa korora ogokiamoka kwa mambia,

English: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu huo usiku haukunifungia mlango wa tumbo la mama yangu, ili kuyaficha macho yangu kutokana na taabu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera borobwo tibwatangete baba tanyibora, gose tibwatangete emechando korwa ase amaiso aane.

English: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini sikuangamia wakati wa kuzaliwa? Kwa nini sikufa nilipokuwa ninatoka tumboni?
Ekegusii: Ninki kiagerete tinakwera inda ya baba? Ninki kiagerete tinakwa ekero keria nasogete korwao?

English: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini pakawa na magoti ya kunipokea na matiti ili nipate kunyonyeshwa?
Ekegusii: Ninki kiagerete baba akaang’agata? Ninki kiagerete akangonkia amabeere aye?

English: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sasa ningekuwa nimepumzika kwa amani. Ningekuwa nimelala na kupumzika
Ekegusii: Onye nakwete, anga nindaire ntoererete, anga nindaire chitoro ntimogete,

English: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;
Kiswahili: pamoja na wafalme na washauri wa dunia, waliojijengea mahali ambapo sasa ni magofu,
Ekegusii: buna abarwoti b’ense amo nabasemia babo bakaraire, abwo beagacherete amaagacho ’obosareku.

English: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;
Kiswahili: pamoja na watawala waliokuwa na dhahabu, waliozijaza nyumba zao kwa fedha.
Ekegusii: Inche anga nigo inde buna abanene batenengete ne chitaabu, baichoretie chinyomba chiabo ne chifeta.

English: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
Kiswahili: Au kwa nini sikufichwa ardhini kama mtoto aliyezaliwa mfu, kama mtoto mchanga ambaye kamwe hakuuona mwanga?
Ekegusii: Nigo nanga nabeete buna enda erekeire egatindekwa, na buna abana bataroche omobaso.

English: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
Kiswahili: Huko waovu huacha kusumbua na huko waliochoka hupumzika.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo abakori amabe tibari gochanda abande, boigo abarosire kobaikire aroro, nigo bagotimoka.

English: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
Kiswahili: Wafungwa nao hufurahia utulivu wao, hawasikii tena sauti ya kukemea ya kiongozi wa watumwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero abasibwa baikire aroro, nigo bakoba bagotimoka amo, tibari koigwa amariogi y’abarendi babo bakobabetereria nobotindi.

English: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.
Kiswahili: Wadogo na wakubwa wamo humo, na mtumwa ameachiwa huru kutoka kwa bwana wake.
Ekegusii: Abanto batasikiri na abasikire nigo bareng’anetie aroro; omosomba nigo are omosibore korwa ase oyorenge omonene oye.

English: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
Kiswahili: “Mbona nuru inawaangazia wale walio taabuni, na hao wenye uchungu kupewa uhai,
Ekegusii: “Nase ki oyochandegete akoegwa korora omobaso? Nase ki oria obwate obororo ase enkoro akoegwa obogima?

English: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
Kiswahili: wale wanaotamani kifo ambacho hakiji, wale watafutao kufa zaidi ya kutafuta hazina iliyofichwa,
Ekegusii: Abwo baganyete amakweri, korende tibari koyanyora; nigo bakoyarigia kobua korigia chinibo chibisire.

English: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
Kiswahili: ambao hujawa na furaha, na hushangilia wafikapo kaburini?
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakogoka mono na gochenga, ee, nabo bakogoka kobabeire ang’e kogenda ase chimbeera na gotubererwa.

English: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini uhai hupewa mtu ambaye njia yake imefichika, ambaye Mungu amemzungushia boma?
Ekegusii: Nase ki omobaso oorokire ase omonto chinchera chiaye chibisire, oyio Nyasae agiteire chinsemo chionsi?

English: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kulia kwangu kwa uchungu kwanijia badala ya chakula; kusononeka kwangu kunamwagika kama maji.
Ekegusii: Obororo bw’emechando yane bwabeire buna endagera nkoria, na ebirero biane nigo bigoiteka buna amaache.

English: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.
Kiswahili: Lile nililokuwa naliogopa limenijia; lile nililokuwa ninalihofia limenipata.
Ekegusii: Naki ring’ana riria inyoboete rianchicheire, na riria rikoondokia rianyorire.

English: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”
Kiswahili: Sina amani, wala utulivu; sina pumziko, bali taabu tu.”
Ekegusii: Inche timbwati omorembe gose botoereru bonde; timbwati ogotimoka, korende emechando nigo egendererete konagocha.”

English: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:
Ekegusii: Bono Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:

English: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu akithubutu kuzungumza nawe, kutakukasirisha? Lakini ni nani awezaye kujizuia asiseme?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto arateema gokwana naye, nogechigwe nere? Nonya naboigo, monto ki oranyare gokira‐kiri takwana?

English: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
Kiswahili: Fikiri jinsi ambavyo umewafundisha watu wengi, jinsi ambavyo umeitia nguvu mikono iliyokuwa dhaifu.
Ekegusii: Rora, aye kworokereirie abanto abange, na amaboko atabwate chinguru kwayakong’irie.

English: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.
Kiswahili: Maneno yako yamewategemeza wale waliojikwaa; umeyatia nguvu magoti yaliyokuwa dhaifu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ao abeire akoremia oyo konya osinyirwe kogenderera, na aye gwakong’irie amaru aye arenge koiguswa.

English: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa hii taabu imekujia wewe, nawe unashuka moyo; imekupiga wewe, nawe unafadhaika.
Ekegusii: Bono naye emechando yacheire, na tori noboremu bonde bwonsi, yagokunire na aye kwegosire.

English: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
Kiswahili: Je, kumcha Mungu kwako hakupaswi kuwa ndiyo matumaini yako na njia zako kutokuwa na lawama ndilo taraja lako?
Ekegusii: Aye buna omoirogete Nyasae, tori noboremu? Naende buna chinchera chiao chire chindonge, tori nogosemeria?

English: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
Kiswahili: “Fikiri sasa: Ni mtu yupi asiye na hatia ambaye aliwahi kuangamia? Ni wapi wanyofu waliwahi kuangamizwa?
Ekegusii: Bono rengereria, indi yabeete ng’a omonto omoikeranu nasiretigwe? Naende indi yabeete ng’a abanto abaronge mbatugutetwe?

English: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.
Kiswahili: Kwa jinsi ambavyo mimi nimechunguza, wale walimao ubaya na wale hupanda uovu, huvuna hayo hayo hayo.
Ekegusii: Aya naroche naya: Baria bakorema obosareku, na baria bagosimeka emechando, nabagese ayio ayio.

English: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
Kiswahili: Kwa pumzi ya Mungu huangamizwa; kwa mshindo wa hasira zake huangamia.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaeyanera basira, na ase okogusa kw’endamwamu yaye baerigwa.

English: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
Kiswahili: Simba anaweza kunguruma na kukoroma, lakini bado meno ya simba mkubwa huvunjika.
Ekegusii: Nonya bakoruma buna endo ere entindi, bakirigwe, na amaino e chindo chinsae nigo akobunwa.

English: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
Kiswahili: Simba anaweza kuangamia kwa kukosa mawindo, nao wana wa simba jike hutawanyika.
Ekegusii: Endo engotu nekwe ase okoborwa chinyama ekoria. Ne chimanwa chi’endo eaberi nigo chigosererebekana.

English: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
Kiswahili: “Neno lililetwa kwangu kwa siri, masikio yangu yakasikia mnongʼono wake.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ndire rianchicherete bobisi, nigo nariigwete rikomonyerera.

English: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
Kiswahili: Katikati ya ndoto za kutia wasiwasi wakati wa usiku, hapo usingizi mzito uwapatapo wanadamu,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bararire chitoro chindito na inche narenge nebirengererio na korora amaroro,

English: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
Kiswahili: hofu na kutetemeka kulinishika na kufanya mifupa yangu yote itetemeke.
Ekegusii: obwoba bokambwata amo nokoiguswa, na amauga onsi ay’omobere one agachaaka gotengechigwa.

English: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
Kiswahili: Kuna roho aliyepita mbele ya uso wangu, nazo nywele za mwili wangu zikasimama.
Ekegusii: Embeo egaeta ase obosio bwane, na amarionya ’omobere one agatenena.

English: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
Kiswahili: Yule roho akasimama, lakini sikuweza kutambua kilikuwa kitu gani. Umbo fulani lilisimama mbele ya macho yangu, kukawa na ukimya kisha nikasikia sauti:
Ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’egento gete ogatenena ase obosio bwane, korende tinanyarete komanya ng’a ngento ki gose nkieni ki; erio nkaigwa eriogi eriororo rigoteeba:

English: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
Kiswahili: ‘Je, binadamu aweza kuwa mwadilifu kuliko Mungu? Je, mtu aweza kuwa safi kuliko Muumba wake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Mwanyabaanto nanyare koba omooronge kobua Nyasae? Nanyare koba oyochenegete kobua Omotongi oye?

English: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
Kiswahili: Kama Mungu hawaamini watumishi wake, kama yeye huwalaumu malaika zake kwa kukosea,
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabasomba baye; ere nigo akobabeekeera abamalaika baye obobe.

English: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
Kiswahili: ni mara ngapi zaidi wale waishio katika nyumba za udongo wa mfinyanzi, ambazo misingi yake ipo mavumbini, ambao wamepondwa kama nondo!
Ekegusii: Onye naboigo, naki rende arasemerie abwo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi’amaroba, abwo amaroso abo abekire ase riroba? Barabwo nigo bagoakwa na komionogorwa buna ebigwankwa.

English: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
Kiswahili: Kati ya mawio na machweo huvunjwa vipande vipande; bila yeyote kutambua, huangamia milele.
Ekegusii: Abanto nabo baranyare koba moyo ase engaki ya mambia, korende omogoroba otaraika, kwanyora baitirwe, basirire goika kare na kare, na onde tari okobechandera.

English: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
Kiswahili: Je, kamba za hema yao hazikungʼolewa, hivyo hufa bila hekima?’
Ekegusii: Bionsi ebi’abaanto abwo basemeretie nigo bigosira kegima. Nigo bagokwa bataraikera komanya obong’aini bonde bwonsi.

English: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
Kiswahili: “Ita kama unataka, lakini ni nani atakayekujibu? Ni yupi kati ya hao watakatifu utakayemgeukia?
Ekegusii: Bono rangeria! Inee! Onde nareo oragoitabere? Ase abwo abachenu, ning’o oraonchokere?

English: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
Kiswahili: Kuweka uchungu moyoni humuua mpumbavu, nao wivu humchinja mjinga.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ogwechanda nigo kogoita omoriri, na emoko nigo egoita oyo otari omong’aini.

English: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe nimemwona mpumbavu akistawi, lakini ghafula nyumba yake ikawa imelaaniwa.
Ekegusii: Nabeire nkorora omonto omoriri okogenderera bokong’u, korende mobosokano nkaragereria enka yaye.

English: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
Kiswahili: Watoto wake wako mbali na usalama, hushindwa mahakamani bila mtetezi.
Ekegusii: Abana baye tibakonyora ogokonywa, nigo bakomionogorerwa geita, gose monto onde tari okobatooria.

English: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
Kiswahili: Wenye njaa huyala mavuno yake, wakiyatoa hata katikati ya miiba, nao wenye kiu huitamani sana mali yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bare nenchara nabwo bakoria endagera eye omonto oria akogesa, abwo nigo bakoyerusia nonya egiteire namagwa; abasaneri nigo bagosanera obotenenku bwaye.

English: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana taabu haioti kutoka kwenye udongo, wala udhia hauchipui kutoka ardhini.
Ekegusii: Obobe tibori korwa ase riroba, gose emechando teri komera korwa inse ase riroba,

English: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwanadamu huzaliwa ili kutaabika, kwa hakika kama cheche za moto zirukavyo kuelekea juu.
Ekegusii: korende Mwanyabaanto nigo akoiborwa ase okonyora emechando, buna chinsase chi’omorero chigotaroka gochia igoro.

English: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
Kiswahili: “Lakini ingekuwa ni mimi, ningemlalamikia Mungu, ningeliweka shauri langu mbele zake.
Ekegusii: Yare koba ng’a ninche nanga nigo narigia Nyasae, nere bweka nare goteebia amang’ana aane.

English: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
Kiswahili: Yeye hutenda maajabu yasiyoweza kutambuliwa, miujiza isiyoweza kuhesabika.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana amanene atari komanyekana buna are, boigo namakumia atanyare kobareka.

English: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;
Kiswahili: Yeye huipa nchi mvua, huyapeleka maji kunyesha mashamba.
Ekegusii: Nigo akorua embura yatwa igoro ase ense, na emegondo yanyora amaache.

English: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
Kiswahili: Huwainua juu wanyonge, nao wale waombolezao huinuliwa wakawa salama.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, na abwo bachandegete bakorera, nigo akobabeka ase oborendi obuya.

English: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
Kiswahili: Huipinga mipango ya wenye hila, ili mikono yao isifikie ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agosaria emeroberio y’abang’ainereria, erinde emeremo bagokora namaboko abo tegoikerana buna baganetie.

English: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
Kiswahili: Yeye huwanasa wenye hekima katika hila yao, nayo mipango ya wadanganyifu huifagilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akobwata abare nobong’aini ase obong’ainereria bwabo, emeroberio yabo y’ogotega nigo egosirigwa bwango.

English: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
Kiswahili: Giza huwapata wakati wa mchana; wakati wa adhuhuri hupapasa kama vile usiku.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakobwatwa nomosunte mobaso gati, bataba‐taba mobaso gati buna nobotuko bore.

English: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
Kiswahili: Humwokoa mhitaji kutokana na upanga ulioko kinywani mwao; huwaokoa kutokana na makucha ya wenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka korwa ase emenwa egoita, na abaremeire korwa ase abwo bare ne chinguru.

English: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo maskini analo tarajio, nao udhalimu hufumba kinywa chake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abaremerwa mbabe nogosemeria, korende abakori amabe nigo barakirigwe‐kiri.

English: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: “Heri mtu yule ambaye Mungu humrudi; kwa hiyo usidharau adhabu yake Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae akoa egesusuro ase okomoorongeyia; ase ayio tobaisa gochaaya ogoaka, gw’okorongeyia kw’oyore Omonguru.

English: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hutia jeraha, lakini pia huyafunga; huumiza, lakini mikono yake pia huponya.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenta amaote, naende oyaboa; ere nigo agoaka chingoma, naende okoboko kwaye kwagwenia.

English: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
Kiswahili: Kutoka majanga sita atakuokoa; naam, hata katika saba hakuna dhara litakalokupata wewe.
Ekegusii: Ere nagotoorie korwa ase emechando etano nomo, ee, nonya nkorwa ase etano na ebere, na amabe tagokonyora.

English: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa njaa atakukomboa wewe na kifo, naye katika vita atakukomboa na pigo la upanga.
Ekegusii: Ekero ki’enchara nagotoorie korwa ase amakweri, na ekero gi’esegi korwa ase abwo bagoita nemioro.

English: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
Kiswahili: Utalindwa kutokana na kichapo cha ulimi, wala hutakuwa na sababu ya kuogopa maangamizi yatakapokujia.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bakogokwana bobe nobiswe, na ekero amabe agoita arache, toyoboa.

English: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
Kiswahili: Utayacheka maangamizo na njaa, wala hutakuwa na sababu ya kuwaogopa wanyama wakali wa mwituni.
Ekegusii: Ekero ogosiria na enchara birache, aye nobe gokobisekerera, gose tokwoboa ching’iti chintindi chire ase ense.

English: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa utakuwa na agano na mawe ya mashamba, nao wanyama wa mwitu watakuwa na amani nawe.
Ekegusii: Nonya namagena are mogondo, nobwatane naro, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nobe nomorembe nachirochio.

English: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.
Kiswahili: Utajua ya kwamba hema lako li salama; utahesabu mali zako wala hutakuta chochote kilichopungua.
Ekegusii: Erio nonyare korora ng’a obomenyo bwao mborendire buya, na ekero orabe gokorata ase ameri e chitugo chiao, nonyore ng’a ende tesireti korwao.

English: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.
Kiswahili: Utajua ya kuwa watoto wako watakuwa wengi, nao wazao wako wengi kama majani ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Norore buna abana bao babeire abange, na ororeria rwao ndobuche robe oronge buna obonyansi bore ase ense.

English: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
Kiswahili: Utaingia kaburini ukiwa na umri wa uzee mtimilifu, kama masuke ya ngano yakusanywapo kwa wakati wake.
Ekegusii: Nogende ase embeera kore nobogotu obuya, buna emesaima y’endagera ekorentwa ekero engaki yabo yaikire.

English: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
Kiswahili: “Tumelichunguza hili, nalo ni kweli. Hivyo lisikie na ulitendee kazi.”
Ekegusii: “Naama! Twabeire togokora obotuki ase amang’ana ayio; naro nay’ekeene. Ase ayio bono igwa amang’ana ayio, oyagache ase omoyo oo.”

English: Then Job answered,
Kiswahili: Kisha Ayubu akajibu:
Ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneria, agateeba:

English: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
Kiswahili: “Laiti uchungu wangu ungeweza kupimwa, nayo taabu yangu yote ingewekwa kwenye mizani!
Ekegusii: Onye ndiria obororo bwane bwarenge korengwa, na emechando yane yonsi ebeekwe ase ekerengo erengwe!

English: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hakika ingekuwa nzito kuliko mchanga wa bahari zote, kwa hiyo si ajabu maneno yangu yamekuwa ya haraka.
Ekegusii: Ebio nigo biare ebirito kobua omokenye ore ase enyancha; ase ayio nabeire omwango ase ogokwana ayio.

English: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.
Kiswahili: Mishale ya Mwenyezi iko ndani yangu, roho yangu inakunywa sumu yake; vitisho vya Mungu vimejipanga dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae Omonguru ombetire chinsara chiaye, na omoika one ong’usire obosongo bwabo; okogosa kwa Nyasae kwarobeire kondwania.

English: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?
Kiswahili: Je, punda-mwitu hulia akiwa na majani, au ngʼombe dume hulia akiwa na chakula?
Ekegusii: Inee! Etigere y’orosana nkwana ere, ekero egotakuna obonyansi? Gose eng’ombe nkwana ere, ekero egendererete korisia?

English: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
Kiswahili: Je, chakula kisicho na ladha huliwa bila chumvi, au upo utamu katika ute mweupe wa yai?
Ekegusii: Onye endagera tebekiri omonyoo okoyiansia, neriegwe? Inee! Omochununu bwe rigena ri’engoko nobwate obwansu?

English: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.
Kiswahili: Ninakataa kuvigusa; vyakula vya aina hii hunichukiza.
Ekegusii: Chindagera echio omoyo one ochiangire, chiabeire chindagera chikongechia.

English: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,
Kiswahili: “Laiti ningepata haja yangu, kwamba Mungu angenijalia hilo nililotarajia,
Ekegusii: Naki nanga yaba buya onye nanyora aya nkobooria, onye Nyasae nanchera aya nganetie!

English: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
Kiswahili: kwamba Mungu angekuwa radhi kuniponda, kuuachia mkono wake na kunikatilia mbali!
Ekegusii: Nigo nganetie Nyasae anche ang’ake ansegenye, arambore okoboko kwaye ang’ite nkwe!

English: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
Kiswahili: Ndipo bado ningekuwa na hii faraja, furaha yangu katika maumivu makali: kwamba sikuwa nimeyakana maneno yake yeye Aliye Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo are kogera ndemigwe; nigo narenge kogoka ntari koigwa obororo bw’okoromwa oko okonene. Ekiagera tinkaneti amang’ana a Nyasae ore Omochenu.

English: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
Kiswahili: “Ninazo nguvu gani, hata niendelee kutumaini? Matazamio yangu ya mbele ni nini, hata niendelee kuwa mvumilivu?
Ekegusii: Chinguru chiane inki chiisaine imbe nokoganya kore nogosemeria? Na omoerio one naki ogochia koba, ngenderere koremereria?

English: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?
Kiswahili: Je, mimi nina nguvu za jiwe? Je, mwili wangu ni shaba?
Ekegusii: Inee! Chinguru chiane nigo chire chinkong’u buna echi’amagena? Gose omobere one nigo ore omokong’u buna etai?

English: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?
Kiswahili: Je, ninao uwezo wowote wa kujisaidia mimi mwenyewe, wakati ambapo mafanikio yamefukuziwa mbali nami?
Ekegusii: Ekeene gokonywa konde gwonsi tikori ime yane, amagenderero nabwate naurirwe.

English: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: “Mtu anayekata tamaa angetazamia moyo wa kujitoa wa rafiki zake, hata kama akiacha uchaji wa Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Oyotakororera omosani oye amaabera oyio, rirorio otigire koiroka Omobui.

English: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu zangu sio wa kutegemewa, ni kama vijito vya msimu, ni kama vijito ambavyo hufurika
Ekegusii: Abaminto bakorire obong’ainereria babeire buna chintuboka chi’amaache, na buna chiooro chi’emegoko chigoeta chiaera.

English: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.
Kiswahili: wakati vimefunikwa barafu iyeyukayo, ambavyo hujazwa na theluji inayoyeyuka,
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo banga buna chindooche chiamerire amaache ’obokendu abwataine, na amagena ’embura are imeo.

English: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
Kiswahili: lakini hukauka majira ya ukame, na wakati wa hari hutoweka katika mikondo yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero ki’omobaso chiasunkera chiakea; na omorakera ogocha chiasira kegima korwa aase abo.

English: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.
Kiswahili: Misafara hugeuka kutoka njia zake; hukwea kwenda kwenye nchi ya ukiwa na kuangamia.
Ekegusii: Abagendi babwate chitugo chiabo nigo bakogobera korigia amaache, tibakoyanyora; ase igo bakwera ase erooro.

English: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.
Kiswahili: Misafara ya Tema inatafuta maji, wafanyabiashara wa Sheba wanaosafiri hutazama kwa matarajio.
Ekegusii: Abagendi ba Tema nigo bakoriga‐rigia amaache, naboigo abaonchoreria ba Seba basemeria koyanyora.

English: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.
Kiswahili: Wamedhikika, kwa sababu walikuwa na matumaini; wanafika huko, lakini wanahuzunika kwa kukosa walichotarajia.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagoichana, ekiagera tibanyorete eki basemeretie; ekero bachete aase agwo, bakanyora ng’a nigo bang’ainetwe.

English: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.
Kiswahili: Sasa nanyi mmethibitika kwamba hamna msaada wowote; mnaona jambo la kutisha, nanyi mnaogopa.
Ekegusii: Nabogio nainwe mwabeire ase ’nde buna chintuboka chiria; mwarorire emechando yane, mwakumirie na kwoboa.

English: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?
Kiswahili: Je, nimewahi kusema, ‘Toeni kitu kwa ajili yangu, au mnilipie fidia kutoka mali zenu,
Ekegusii: Inee! Inche nateebirie onde ng’a andetere ekeegwa? Gose naboririe onde ng’a arue embooria korwa ase chinibo chiaye?

English: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?
Kiswahili: au niokoeni mikononi mwa adui, au nikomboeni kutoka makucha ya wasio na huruma’?
Ekegusii: Gose nateebirie onde ng’a antoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omobisa one? Gose nateebirie onde ng’a amboorie korwa ase amaboko ’abachandi baane?

English: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.
Kiswahili: “Nifundisheni, nami nitanyamaza kimya; nionyesheni nilikokosea.
Ekegusii: Inyorokererie, na inche ninkire‐kiri imanyie amamocho nakorire.

English: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
Kiswahili: Tazama yalivyo ya kuumiza maneno ya kweli! Lakini mabishano yenu yanathibitisha nini?
Ekegusii: Naki amang’ana ’ekeene agwansa! Korende amang’ana ayio aino ay’obong’ainereria, inki agokonya?

English: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?
Kiswahili: Je, mna maana ya kuyasahihisha ninayosema, na kuyafanya maneno ya mtu anayekata tamaa kama upepo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mokorengereria ng’a amang’ana ’omonto bwerusirie moyo nigo anga buna omwaga?

English: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.
Kiswahili: Mngeweza hata kupiga kura kwa ajili ya yatima, na kubadilishana rafiki yenu na mali.
Ekegusii: Onye naboigo, rirorio monyare goaka obomera igoro ye chintakana, monyare gokorera abasani baino amagori amake ase okobaoonia.

English: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.
Kiswahili: “Lakini sasa kuweni na huruma mkaniangalie mimi. Je, ningeweza kusema uongo mbele zenu?
Ekegusii: Bono, komoranche mondigererie; ninde nobomaene kegima, tingokwana oborimo ase more.

English: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.
Kiswahili: Tulizeni hasira, msiwe wadhalimu; angalieni tena, kwa maana nimehatarisha uadilifu wangu.
Ekegusii: Nabasoroire, irana, timobaisa gokora ing’ana rinde riibe. Bono irana naende, ekiagera ring’ana riane neri’oboronge.

English: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
Kiswahili: Je, pana uovu wowote midomoni mwangu? Je, kinywa changu hakiwezi kupambanua hila?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana aane ngokwana nay’oborimo? Inee! Tinkonyara gokwana inyatanane ayare amabe?

English: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?
Kiswahili: “Je, mwanadamu hana kazi ngumu duniani? Siku zake si kama zile za mtu aliyeajiriwa?
Ekegusii: “Ekero omonto are ase ense, nigo abwate obogima buna obw’oyokorwana esegi. Amatuko y’obogima bwaye nigo anga buna ay’omorikwa emeremo.

English: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,
Kiswahili: Kama mtumwa anavyovionea shauku vivuli vya jioni, au mtu aliyeajiriwa anavyoungojea mshahara wake,
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omosomba akogania anyore aase agokenderera, na buna koreng’ana omonto orikire emeremo akogania aegwe eng’eria yaye,

English: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
Kiswahili: ndivyo nilivyogawiwa miezi ya ubatili, nami nimeandikiwa huzuni usiku hata usiku.
Ekegusii: naboigo nainche ngendererete koba nobobe omotienyi ase omotienyi, na obotuko ase obotuko nigo inde ase emechando.

English: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.
Kiswahili: Wakati nilalapo ninawaza, ‘Itachukua muda gani kabla sijaamka?’ Usiku huwa mrefu, nami najigeuzageuza hadi mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Ekero nararire nigo nkobooria: Indi bogocha gokia mboke? Obotuko bwatambeire mono. Agwo naba nkona‐kweonchaonchora bokia goika mambia.

English: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
Kiswahili: Mwili wangu umevikwa mabuu na uchafu, ngozi yangu imetumbuka na kutunga usaha.
Ekegusii: Amakonde ne riko biatubire omobere one; omobere one nigo okona‐gosaboka amasabo, erio otandoka, na obogundo bwaruao.

English: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
Kiswahili: “Siku zangu zinapita upesi kuliko mtande wa kufuma, nazo zinafikia mwisho wake bila matumaini.
Ekegusii: Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango kobua egekorero gi’okoroisia egetambaa, nigo akoera ntabwati gosemeria konde.

English: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka, Ee Mungu, maisha yangu ni kama pumzi; macho yangu kamwe hayataona tena raha.
Ekegusii: “Manya ng’a obogima bwane nigo bore buna embeo bosa; amaiso aane takorora amaya naende.

English: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
Kiswahili: Lile jicho linaloniona sasa halitaniona tena; utanitafuta, wala sitakuwepo.
Ekegusii: Omonto ondoche bono takondora naende nonya ng’ake, bono aye nondoche, korende bwango nimbe tindio.

English: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.
Kiswahili: Kama vile wingu liondokavyo na kutoweka, vivyo hivyo yeye ashukaye kaburini harudi tena.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana riire rigokubakubana riasira, naboigo noyokogenda aase abakuure atakoirana korwao.

English: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.
Kiswahili: Kamwe harudi tena nyumbani mwake; wala mahali pake hapatamjua tena.
Ekegusii: Oyio takoirana gocha mwaye, na aase aye taakomonyoora naende.

English: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo sitanyamaza; nitanena kutokana na maumivu makuu ya roho yangu, nitalalama kwa uchungu wa nafsi yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, tinkonyara gokira tinkwana, nimbe ngokwana emechando y’omoyo one na kwemurungania nobororo ase omoyo one.

English: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?
Kiswahili: Je, mimi ni bahari, au mnyama mkubwa mno akaaye vilindini, hata uniweke chini ya ulinzi?
Ekegusii: “Nase ki obegete oborendi igoro yane? Inche nenyancha inde, gose neng’iti enene mono ya nyancha?

English: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’
Kiswahili: Ninapofikiri kwamba kitanda changu kitanifariji, nacho kiti changu cha fahari kitapunguza malalamiko yangu,
Ekegusii: Ekero nkorengereria ng’a oborere bwane mbonyare kondemia, na ebirengererio biane mbinyare gonkeaneria obororo bwane,

English: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,
Kiswahili: ndipo wanitisha kwa ndoto na kunitia hofu kwa maono,
Ekegusii: erio aye nigo okongosa ase ogontomera chindoto na kong’a obwoba goetera ase amaroro.

English: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
Kiswahili: hivyo ninachagua kujinyonga na kufa, kuliko huu mwili wangu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo nachorire ng’a ng’entwe inkwe, ekiagera amakweri namaya kobua obororo bore ase omobere one.

English: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
Kiswahili: Ninayachukia maisha yangu; nisingetamani kuendelea kuishi. Niache; siku zangu ni ubatili.
Ekegusii: Nagechire obogima bwane; tinganeti kogenderera koba moyo. Takondosia namange; amatuko aane nigo are buna embeo bosa.

English: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani hata umjali kiasi hiki, kwamba unamtia sana maanani,
Ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto ninki aisaine, goika okomokora koba oyo bw’engencho enene, naende oba komorengereretie mono?

English: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?
Kiswahili: kwamba unamwangalia kila asubuhi na kumjaribu kila wakati?
Ekegusii: Nigo okomorigereria kera emambia, naende nigo okomorenga kera engaki.

English: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
Kiswahili: Je, hutaacha kamwe kunitazama, au kuniacha japo kwa kitambo kidogo tu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nengaki eng’ana naki ogochia koba gokona‐kondigereria? Naki otagontiga, erinde inyore obosibore imere amate?

English: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa nimetenda dhambi, nimekufanyia nini, Ewe mlinzi wa wanadamu? Kwa nini umeniweka niwe shabaha yako? Je, nimekuwa mzigo kwako?
Ekegusii: Aye omorigereria bw’abaanto, onye ngokora ebibe, ninki nagokoreire? Nase ki gwankorire nabeire ekerenga kiao? Nase ki nabeire buna egurube endito asore?

English: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini husamehi makosa yangu na kuachilia dhambi zangu? Kwa kuwa hivi karibuni nitalala mavumbini; nawe utanitafuta, wala sitakuwepo.”
Ekegusii: Nase ki otakonyabera ogosaria kwane, erinde otige ebibe biane kegima? Bono inche nkogenda inde korara ime ye riroba; aye nigo orabe gokondigia, korende tokonyora aande.”

English: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bildadi Mshuhi akajibu:
Ekegusii: Erio Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:

English: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
Kiswahili: “Hata lini wewe utasema mambo kama haya? Maneno yako ni kama upepo mkuu.
Ekegusii: “Ngoika ririri orabe kogokwana amang’ana aya, na amang’ana ’omonwa oo abe buna omwaga omonene?

English: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
Kiswahili: Je, Mungu hupotosha hukumu? Je, Mwenyezi hupotosha kile kilicho haki?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nanyare koonchorana ekeene? Gose Omonguru naonchorane ayare ay’oboronge?

English: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
Kiswahili: Watoto wako walipomtenda dhambi, aliwapa adhabu ya dhambi yao.
Ekegusii: Onye abana bao bakorete ebibe asare, ere obaeire egesusuro ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo.

English: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
Kiswahili: Lakini ukimtafuta Mungu, nawe ukamsihi Mwenyezi,
Ekegusii: Korende aye korarigie Nyasae na gosaba ase oboitongo ase ere Omonyanguru,

English: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
Kiswahili: ikiwa wewe ni safi na mnyofu, hata sasa atainuka mwenyewe kwa niaba yako, na kukurudisha katika mahali pako pa haki.
Ekegusii: korabe oyochenegete na ore nenkoro endonge, ekeene, rirorio ere nagochandekere, nakoroiserie obomenyo, na oboronge bogenderere kobao.

English: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
Kiswahili: Ijapokuwa mwanzo wako ulikuwa mdogo, lakini mwisho wako utakuwa wa mafanikio.
Ekegusii: Eki kwabwate ritang’ani kerorekane kere egeke, koreng’anigwa neki oramenterwe magega.

English: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
Kiswahili: “Ukaulize vizazi vilivyotangulia na uone baba zao walijifunza nini,
Ekegusii: “Korende boria omanye ay’ebigori bia kare, bweigwere aya chisokoro chiao chianyorete.

English: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa sisi tumezaliwa jana tu na hatujui lolote, nazo siku zetu duniani ni kama kivuli tu.
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo tonga buna abaiborwa igoro totamanyeti kende, naki amatuko aito tomenyete ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari ogosira.

English: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
Kiswahili: Je, hawatakufundisha na kukueleza? Je, hawataleta maneno kutoka kwenye kufahamu kwao?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ’obong’aini chisokoro chiria chiakwanete, takonyara gokworokereria, erinde bwegere?

English: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
Kiswahili: Je, mafunjo yaweza kumea mahali pasipo na matope? Matete yaweza kustawi bila maji?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Amauncho nanyare komera ase entente etari? Gose ebitonto nabimere ase amaache atari?

English: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
Kiswahili: Wakati bado yanaendelea kukua kabla ya kukatwa, hunyauka haraka kuliko majani mengine.
Ekegusii: Ekero bigendererete gosicha, engaki y’okobitema etaraika, nigo birasusane bitige ebimeri binde.

English: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mwisho wa watu wote wanaomsahau Mungu; vivyo hivyo matumaini ya wasiomjali Mungu huangamia.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabaanto bonsi abebire Nyasae bakoba, ogosemeria kw’omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae nagosire.

English: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.
Kiswahili: Lile analolitumainia huvunjika upesi; lile analolitegemea ni utando wa buibui.
Ekegusii: Aya asemeretie nasirigwe kegima, na aya egenete nigo are buna enyomba y’oronyambobe.

English: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
Kiswahili: Huutegemea utando wake, lakini hausimami; huungʼangʼania, lakini haudumu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agwesiirera ase enyomba yaye, korende tekogenderera gotenena, nigo ayesemeretie, korende tekogenderera kobao.

English: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni kama mti ulionyeshewa vizuri wakati wa jua, ukieneza machipukizi yake bustanini;
Ekegusii: “Nabo akoreereta buna ekemeri kere ase omobaso, ekio gekoranda ase omogondo bwonsi;

English: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
Kiswahili: huifunganisha mizizi yake kwenye lundo la mawe, na kutafuta nafasi katikati ya mawe.
Ekegusii: emeri yaye nigo egwesiserania ase etui y’amagena; buna eyekwemigereria ase egati y’amagena y’egetare.

English: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
Kiswahili: Unapongʼolewa kutoka mahali pake, ndipo mahali pale huukana na kusema, ‘Mimi kamwe sikukuona.’
Ekegusii: Geise gosirigwa korwa aase aye, aase aria nigo aragekanie ng’a tana gokerora.

English: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.
Kiswahili: Hakika uhai wake hunyauka, na kutoka udongoni mimea mingine huota.
Ekegusii: Ee, oyio noro omogooko ere abwate ase obogima bwaye, naende abande mbache babe ase ribaga riaye.

English: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
Kiswahili: “Hakika Mungu hamkatai mtu asiye na hatia, wala kuitia nguvu mikono ya mtenda mabaya.
Ekegusii: “Rora, Nyasae takonyara kwanga na gotiga omonto omoikeranu; gose tagokonya abakori amabe.

English: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.
Kiswahili: Bado atakijaza kinywa chako na kicheko, na midomo yako na kelele za shangwe.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, nagoichorie namaseko, na omonwa oo otere nomochengo.

English: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
Kiswahili: Adui zako watavikwa aibu, nazo hema za waovu hazitakuwepo tena.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abakogechete mbarenterwe obosooku, na obomenyo bw’abakori amabe tibokogenderera kobao.”

English: Then Job answered,
Kiswahili: Kisha Ayubu akajibu:
Ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:

English: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
Kiswahili: “Naam, najua hili ni kweli. Lakini mwanadamu awezaje kuwa mwadilifu mbele za Mungu?
Ekegusii: Ekeene, namanyire ng’a ayio nabo are, korende naki omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae?

English: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
Kiswahili: Ingawa mtu angetaka kushindana naye, asingaliweza kumjibu Mungu hata mara moja miongoni mwa elfu moja.
Ekegusii: Omonene karaamereranie nomonto amang’ana elifu eyemo, omonto takonyara komoiraneria nonya nerimo.

English: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
Kiswahili: Hekima yake ni kubwa sana na ana uwezo mwingi mno. Ni nani aliyempinga naye akawa salama?
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobong’aini ase enkoro yaye, na omonyene chinguru, monto ki oratoorigwe onye takomoigwera?

English: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
Kiswahili: Aiondoa milima bila yenyewe kujua na kuipindua kwa hasira yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoba nendamwamu nigo akoonchorana ebitunwa, obitigeria korwa aase abo, na abanto tibari komanya ayio.

English: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.
Kiswahili: Aitikisa dunia kutoka mahali pake na kuzifanya nguzo zake zitetemeke.
Ekegusii: Nigo agotengechia ense yarwa aase aye, erio chintenenero chiaye chianyegerigwa.

English: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.
Kiswahili: Husema na jua, nalo likaacha kuangaza; naye huizima mianga ya nyota.
Ekegusii: Nigo agochika erioba tirigosoka; ne ching’enang’eni ochibeeka ekemanyererio.

English: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
Kiswahili: Yeye peke yake huzitandaza mbingu na kuyakanyaga mawimbi ya bahari.
Ekegusii: Nere bweka oramborete igoro chionsi, agachiaara, nere ogotaara igoro ase emerindo y’enyancha.

English: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye Muumba wa nyota za Dubu, na Orioni, Kilimia, na makundi ya nyota za kusini.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere otongete ching’enang’eni chia igoro Edubu. Orioni, boigo neching’enang’eni chiinde chikorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo, boigo na Amakundia a Irianyi.

English: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.
Kiswahili: Hutenda maajabu yasiyopimika, miujiza isiyoweza kuhesabiwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo agokora amang’ana amanene aetanetie obomanyi bwonsi, na amakumia amange atari kobareka.

English: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
Kiswahili: Anapopita karibu nami, siwezi kumwona; apitapo mbele yangu, simtambui.
Ekegusii: Rora! Ere nigo akong’ika ang’e oeta, tinkomoorora; nigo akong’etania, tinkomomanyereria.

English: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’
Kiswahili: Anapochukua kwa ghafula, ni nani awezaye kumzuia? Ni nani awezaye kumwambia, ‘Unafanya nini?’
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoira eki aganetie. Ning’o oranyare komotanga? Ning’o oranyare komobooria ng’a ninki ekio agokora?

English: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
Kiswahili: Mungu hataizuia hasira yake; hata jeshi kubwa la Rahabu lenye nguvu linajikunyata miguuni pake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae tari gotigeria endamwamu yaye, abanto abagokonya Rahabu, nigo bagotung’ama inse asare baumama.

English: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?
Kiswahili: “Ni vipi basi mimi nitaweza kubishana naye? Nawezaje kupata maneno ya kuhojiana naye?
Ekegusii: Naki rende ndakore imanye gochora amang’ana agwenerete, erinde inyare koiraneria Omonene.

English: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
Kiswahili: Ingawa sikuwa na hatia, sikuweza kumjibu; ningeweza tu kumsihi Mhukumu wangu anihurumie.
Ekegusii: Nonya inche nare koba tindi nokomocha, tinarenge komoiraneria; nigo narenge gosaba amaabera korwa ase omonsoeri.

English: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
Kiswahili: Hata kama ningemwita kwenye shauri, naye akakubali, siamini kama angenisikiliza.
Ekegusii: Onye narenge komorangeria, na ere ang’itabere, rirorio tinarenge kwegena ng’a nategererete eriogi riane.

English: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
Kiswahili: Yeye angeniangamiza kwa dhoruba na kuongeza majeraha yangu pasipo na sababu.
Ekegusii: Ere ong’akire nomwaga ore nomoubera, na omentire amaote aane ngencho ende etaiyo.

English: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
Kiswahili: Asingeniacha nipumue bali angenifunika kabisa na huzuni kuu.
Ekegusii: Tang’eti ribaga nkoeyanera, korende omenteire obororo obonge mono.

English: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
Kiswahili: Kama ni suala la nguvu, yeye ni mwenye nguvu! Kama ni suala la haki, ni nani awezaye kumwita mahakamani?
Ekegusii: Onye namang’ana e chinguru, rora ere nigo are ne chinguru. Onye igoro y’oboronge, monto ki oranyare koamererania nere?

English: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
Kiswahili: Hata kama sikuwa na hatia, kinywa changu kingenihukumu; kama sikuwa na kosa, kingenitangaza kuwa mwenye hatia.
Ekegusii: Nonya nare koba omonyaboronge, amang’ana ngokwana nigo are kongambia; nonya nare koba ng’a tindi na komocha, aya nigo are kombera kirori ng’a nomokori amabe inde.

English: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
Kiswahili: “Ingawa mimi sina kosa, haileti tofauti katika nafsi yangu; nauchukia uhai wangu.
Ekegusii: Inche tindi na komocha. Tinyemanyeti; tinkobara obogima bwane ng’a negento.

English: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
Kiswahili: Hayo yote ni sawa; ndiyo sababu nasema, ‘Yeye huwaangamiza wasio na makosa pamoja na waovu.’
Ekegusii: Mang’ana taiyo. Ase ayio nigo ngoteeba: Ere nigo agosiria omonyaboronge na omokori amabe amo.

English: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
Kiswahili: Wakati pigo liletapo kifo cha ghafula, yeye hudhihaki kule kukata tamaa kwa yule asiye na kosa.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebiku bikorenta amakweri a mobosokano, na abanto batari na komocha banyorwe namaakwa, ere nigo akobachecheria.

English: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
Kiswahili: Wakati nchi inapoangukia mikononi mwa waovu, yeye huwafunga macho mahakimu wake. Kama si yeye, basi ni nani?
Ekegusii: Ense nigo ebeekire inse y’amaboko ’abakori amabe, Nyasae otubire amasio ’abagaambi ebiina. Onye tari ere, ning’o rende okorire ayio?

English: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.
Kiswahili: “Siku zangu zapita mbio kuliko mkimbiaji; zinapita upesi bila kuona furaha hata kidogo.
Ekegusii: Amatuko aane nigo agoeta bwango kobua omominyoki okominyoka; nigo akoera bwango, tari korora maya ande.

English: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
Kiswahili: Zinapita upesi kama mashua ya mafunjo, mfano wa tai ayashukiaye mawindo kwa ghafula.
Ekegusii: Ee, nigo agoeta bwango buna obwato obonyerere bw’ebirigisa, buna ensoti egotaboria ebiekoria biaye.

English: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’
Kiswahili: Kama nikisema, ‘Nitayasahau malalamiko yangu, nitabadili sura ya uso wangu na kutabasamu,’
Ekegusii: Inse goteeba ng’a nyebe ogwechanda kwane, na ntige omoichano one inyeremie,

English: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.
Kiswahili: bado ninahofia mateso yangu yote, kwa kuwa ninajua hutanihesabu kuwa sina hatia.
Ekegusii: nigo ndabe nobwoba igoro y’emechando yane yonsi, ekiagera nimanyete ng’a aye goika ombare ng’a nomomochi inde.

English: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nimeonekana mwenye hatia, kwa nini basi nitaabishwe bure?
Ekegusii: Inche goika mbarwe ng’a nomokori amabe inde. Nase ki rende ngwechanda nemeremo ere bosa?

English: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
Kiswahili: Hata kama ningejiosha kwa sabuni na kutakasa mikono yangu kwa magadi,
Ekegusii: Ninsa gwesibia namaache arabete buna amagena ’embura, na goisaba nesabuni,

English: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
Kiswahili: wewe ungenitupa kwenye shimo la utelezi kiasi kwamba hata nguo zangu zingenichukia sana.
Ekegusii: nigo orantugute ime ase engoro, ne chianga chiane chigechigwe ase engencho yane.

English: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
Kiswahili: “Yeye si mwanadamu kama mimi ili niweze kumjibu, ili kwamba tuweze kushindana naye mahakamani.
Ekegusii: Nyasae tari omonto buna inche, erinde imoiranerie, na ngende nere ase ekegambero.

English: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
Kiswahili: Laiti angelikuwepo mtu wa kutupatanisha kati yetu, aweke mkono wake juu yetu sote wawili,
Ekegusii: Monto onde tari orabe omogayani oito, oyio oratogambie inche nere.

English: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
Kiswahili: mtu angeliiondoa fimbo ya Mungu juu yangu, ili utisho wake usiendelee kunitia hofu.
Ekegusii: Tiga ere arusie enyimbo yaye korwa ase ’nde; okogosa kwaye tikobaisa kong’ondokia.

English: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.
Kiswahili: Ndipo ningenena naye, bila kumwogopa, lakini kama ilivyo kwangu sasa, sitaweza.
Ekegusii: Erio inyare gokwana ntari nobwoba ase engencho yaye, nimanyete ng’a tindi nokomocha.

English: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
Kiswahili: “Nayachukia sana haya maisha yangu; kwa hiyo nitatoa malalamiko yangu kwa wazi bila kujizuia, nami nitanena kutokana na uchungu wa moyo wangu.
Ekegusii: “Omoyo one ogechire obogima bwane; nimbe nobosibore gokwana na kwemurungania, ninkwane nobororo bore ase omoyo one.

English: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
Kiswahili: Nitamwambia Mungu: Usinihukumu, bali niambie una mashtaka gani dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Ninkwane, nteebie Nyasae: Tobaisa kongambia; imanyie egekogera aye okondwania iga.

English: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
Kiswahili: Je, inakupendeza wewe kunionea, kuikataa kwa dharau kazi ya mikono yako, huku wewe ukitabasamu juu ya mipango ya waovu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ogokirie ase ogonchanda na gochaaya emeremo y’amaboko ao, na gwanchera ogosemania kw’abakori amabe?

English: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?
Kiswahili: Je, wewe una macho ya kimwili? Je, wewe huona kama mwanadamu aonavyo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amaiso ao naya Mwanyabaanto are? Gose nigo okorora buna Mwanyabaanto akorora?

English: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
Kiswahili: Je, siku zako ni kama zile za mwanadamu, au miaka yako ni kama ile ya mtu,
Ekegusii: Inee! Amatuko ao nabo ang’ana buna aya Mwanyabaanto, gose emiaka yao buna ey’omonto,

English: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
Kiswahili: ili kwamba utafute makosa yangu na kuichunguza dhambi yangu;
Ekegusii: goika okona‐gotuka okomocha kwane na korigia ebibe biane?

English: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
Kiswahili: ingawa wajua kuwa mimi sina hatia, na hakuna awezaye kunitoa mkononi mwako?
Ekegusii: Nonya nabo nomanyete ng’a inche tindi nokomocha, na onde tari orantoorie korwa ase okoboko kwao?

English: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
Kiswahili: “Mikono yako ndiyo iliyoniumba na kunifanya. Je, sasa utageuka na kuniangamiza?
Ekegusii: “Amaboko ao naro ambombete, akandoisia; na bono kwang’onchokeire na gonsiria.

English: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
Kiswahili: Kumbuka kuwa ulinifinyanga kama udongo wa mfinyanzi. Je, sasa utanifanya kuwa mavumbi tena?
Ekegusii: Inyora ng’a naye kwambombete buna esike. Inee! Nigo okong’irania imbe orotu naende?

English: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
Kiswahili: Je, wewe hukunimimina mimi kama maziwa, na kunigandisha kama jibini,
Ekegusii: Inee! Tari aye kwang’umorete buna amabeere, na okambomba buna ekerimu kiabwatanire?

English: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
Kiswahili: ukanivika ngozi na nyama, na kuniunga pamoja kwa mifupa na mishipa?
Ekegusii: Aye okaboyia omobere one risankwa okayobekera chinyama, okayobwatania namauga na emekia.

English: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
Kiswahili: Umenipa uhai na kunitendea wema, katika uangalizi wako umeilinda roho yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire obogima na konyorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera; na oborendi bwao nigo borendete omoika one.

English: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:
Kiswahili: “Lakini hili ndilo ulilolificha moyoni mwako, nami ninajua kuwa hili lilikuwa katika nia yako:
Ekegusii: Nonya nabo nigo obisete amang’ana ayio ase enkoro yao, nimanyete ng’a oko nakwo kwarenge okogania kwao.

English: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
Kiswahili: Kama nilifanya dhambi, ungekuwa umeniona, wala usingeacha kosa langu lipite bila kuadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Inse gokora ebibe, aye nigo ondigereretie, na totiga kong’a egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biane.

English: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
Kiswahili: Kama nina hatia, ole wangu! Hata kama ningekuwa sina hatia, siwezi kukiinua kichwa changu, kwa kuwa nimejawa na aibu, na kuzama katika mateso yangu.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwane onye inde omokori amabe; na onye inde omonyaboronge tinkonyara gwetogia; nigo ing’ichire nobosooku, ase ayio aye origererie emechando yane.

English: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
Kiswahili: Kama nikiinua kichwa changu juu, unaninyatia kama simba, na kuonyesha tena uwezo wa kutisha dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Kondaimokererie omotwe one igoro, aye nigo okondigia buna endo egotwara orotwari, erinde ogenderere koorokia amakumia ao igoro yane.

English: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
Kiswahili: Wewe waleta mashahidi wapya dhidi yangu na kuzidisha hasira yako juu yangu; nazo nguvu zako zinanijia wimbi moja baada ya jingine.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okomenta oborori bwao igoro yane, na kwamentera ekeririanda igoro yane. Nigo okona‐kondetera ababisa bakondwania.

English: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini basi ulinitoa tumboni? Ninatamani ningekufa kabla jicho lolote halijaniona.
Ekegusii: “Nase ki kwandusetie ase enda ya baba? Naki anga yare koba buya onye nakwete ekero monto onde atarandora,

English: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
Kiswahili: Laiti nisingekuwako kamwe, au ningekuwa nimechukuliwa moja kwa moja kutoka tumboni kwenda kaburini!
Ekegusii: imbe buna tinarengeo, anga nigo narusetigwe ase enda ya baba ntindekwe.

English: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
Kiswahili: Je, siku zangu chache si zimekaribia kuisha? Niachie ili niweze kupata muda mfupi wa kufurahi
Ekegusii: Inee! Amatuko y’obogima bwane tari amake? Intige, imbe n’obotoereru ase engaki eye enke,

English: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
Kiswahili: kabla sijaenda mahali ambapo hakuna kurudi tena, katika nchi ya giza na uvuli wa mauti,
Ekegusii: ekero ntaragenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao rinde, ense eria y’omosunte ekerima na ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri,

English: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
Kiswahili: nchi ya giza kuu sana, yenye uvuli wa giza na machafuko, mahali ambapo hata nuru ni giza.”
Ekegusii: ense emwamu ti buna omosunte ekerima; naende ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri na obotantanu, agwo oborabu bwaye bore obomwamu ti buna obw’obotuko gati.”

English: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sofari Mnaamathi akajibu:
Ekegusii: Erio Sofari Omonaama agakwana, akabora:

English: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
Kiswahili: “Je, maneno haya yote yapite bila kujibiwa? Je, huyu mnenaji athibitishwe kuwa na haki?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Amang’ana aya amange natigwe tairanerigwa? Na omonto obwate amang’ana amange buna iga nabarerwe oboronge?

English: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
Kiswahili: Je, maneno yako ya upuzi yawafanye watu wanyamaze kimya? Je, mtu asikukemee unapofanya dhihaka?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ao atari nengencho nagere abanto bakire‐kiri? Na ekero ogokwana amang’ana ay’ogochecheria, monto onde takogosookia?

English: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
Kiswahili: Unamwambia Mungu, ‘Imani yangu ni kamili nami ni safi mbele zako.’
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoteeba ng’a amang’ana ogokwana nay’ekeene, naende ng’a nigo ochenegete ase amaiso a Nyasae.

English: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,
Kiswahili: Aha! Laiti kwamba Mungu angesema, kwamba angefungua midomo yake dhidi yako,
Ekegusii: Korende onye ndiria Nyasae are gokwana na akoorokie buna ore,

English: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.
Kiswahili: naye akufunulie siri za hekima, kwa kuwa hekima ya kweli ina pande mbili. Ujue hili: Mungu amesahau hata baadhi ya dhambi zako.
Ekegusii: erinde akomaanorere orore obobisi bw’obong’aini! Ere nigo abwate obomanyi botari korengeka. Ase ayio manya ng’a nigo akoeire egesusuro egeke, tari buna okomocha kwao kogwenerete.

English: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
Kiswahili: “Je, waweza kujua siri za Mungu? Je, waweza kuyachunguza mambo yote kumhusu Mwenyezi?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nonyare komanya ebinto bia Nyasae bibisekanete? Nonyare komanya oboikeranu bw’Omonguru?

English: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?
Kiswahili: Ni juu mno kuliko mbingu: waweza kufanya nini? Kina chake ni kirefu kuliko kuzimu: wewe waweza kujua nini?
Ekegusii: Onye bore obonene gochia igoro, inki oranyare gokora? Onye bore obotambe inse gochia aase abakuure, inki oranyare komanya?

English: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
Kiswahili: Kipimo chake ni kirefu kuliko dunia, nacho ni kipana kuliko bahari.
Ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye nigo boetanetie obw’ense, na obogare bwaye mboetanetie obw’enyancha.

English: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?
Kiswahili: “Kama akija na kukufunga gerezani, na kuitisha mahakama, ni nani awezaye kumpinga?
Ekegusii: Karaete asibe abanto, gose kobagambia, ning’o oramotange?

English: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.
Kiswahili: Hakika anawatambua watu wadanganyifu; naye aonapo uovu, je, haangalii?
Ekegusii: Ere nigo amanyete abanto batagwenereti. Ekero akorora amabe agokorwa, Inee, takorengereria igoro y’ayio?

English: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu aweza kuwa mwenye hekima, endapo mtoto wa punda-mwitu atazaliwa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Onye omoriri okonyara koba omong’aini, rirorio emori y’etigere y’orosana nenyare koiborwa ebe omonto.

English: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
Kiswahili: “Hata sasa ukiutoa moyo wako kwake na kumwinulia mikono yako,
Ekegusii: “Oise kwebeeka ang’e ase enkoro yao gokora amaronge, na orambore amaboko ao gochia ase Nyasae;

English: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
Kiswahili: ukiiondolea mbali ile dhambi iliyo mkononi mwako wala usiuruhusu uovu ukae hemani mwako,
Ekegusii: onye kogotuguta ebibe bire ase amaboko ao, na togotiga obobe bomenye ase eema yao,

English: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,
Kiswahili: ndipo utainua uso wako bila aibu; utasimama imara bila hofu.
Ekegusii: amaene, rirorio norigererie otari na komocha, naende norendwe buya tokoba nobwoba.

English: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.
Kiswahili: Hakika utaisahau taabu yako, utaikumbuka tu kama maji yaliyokwisha kupita.
Ekegusii: Nigo orebe emechando yao, buna amaache aetire, takoinyorwa naende.

English: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.
Kiswahili: Maisha yako yatangʼaa kuliko adhuhuri, nalo giza litakuwa kama alfajiri.
Ekegusii: Na obogima bwao nigo borarabe se kobua erioba ria mobaso gati; omosunte oye nigo oraonchoke obe buna ekero bogokia mambia.

English: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
Kiswahili: Utakuwa salama, kwa kuwa lipo tumaini; utatazama pande zote na kupumzika kwa salama.
Ekegusii: Aye nomenye kore noboremu, ekiagera ogosemeria nkoreo; norendwe na gotimoka ase obotoereru.

English: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
Kiswahili: Utalala, wala hakuna atakayekuogofya, naam, wengi watajipendekeza kwako.
Ekegusii: Ekero okorara, monto onde tagokwoboyia; abanto abange mbache asore bagosorore ng’a banyore ogwancherwa.

English: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
Kiswahili: Bali macho ya waovu hayataona, wokovu utawaepuka; tarajio lao litakuwa ni hangaiko la mtu anayekata roho.”
Ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbabe bakouna‐una ase omosunte, tibakorora omobaso. Tibagotooreka nonya ng’ake; ogosemeria kwabo ngosire pi.”

English: Then Job answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:
Ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:

English: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
Kiswahili: “Bila shaka ninyi ndio watu, nayo hekima itakoma mtakapokufa!
Ekegusii: Ekeene, inwe ninwe abanto bori, ekero morakwe, obong’aini nigo borasire.

English: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi ninao ufahamu kama ninyi; mimi si duni kwenu. Ni nani asiyejua mambo haya yote?
Ekegusii: Korende nainche nabo inde nokomanya buna inwe, gose timombueti. Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana buna ayio?

English: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
Kiswahili: “Nimekuwa mtu wa kuchekwa na rafiki zangu, ingawa nilimwita Mungu naye akanijibu: mimi ni mtu wa kuchekwa tu, ingawa ni mwadilifu na nisiye na hatia!
Ekegusii: Abasani baane nigo bagonchecheria, inche oyo narenge korangeria Nyasae, na ere akaba okong’iraneria, inche omonyaboronge ntari na komocha, bono nigo ngochecherigwa.

English: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
Kiswahili: Wanadamu wakiwa katika utulivu huwa na dharau kwa wale wenye msiba kana kwamba ndiyo haki ya wale ambao miguu yao inateleza.
Ekegusii: Omonto otari na mechando ende, nigo agochaaya emechando, nigo are ang’e gotindachera inse abwo batererigwe.

English: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
Kiswahili: Hema za wanyangʼanyi hazisumbuliwi, wale wanaomghadhibisha Mungu wako salama: wale wamchukuao mungu wao mikononi mwao.
Ekegusii: Chinka chi’abauri nigo chigendererete koba nomorembe, na abwo bagechete Nyasae nigo barendire buya, na enyasae yabo nigo ere ase amaboko abo.

English: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ulizeni wanyama, nao watawafundisha, au ndege wa angani, nao watawaambia;
Ekegusii: Bono boria ching’iti, nchikworokererie; boria chinyoni chia igoro chigoteebie amang’ana;

English: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
Kiswahili: au zungumzeni na dunia, nayo itawafundisha, au acheni samaki wa baharini wawape taarifa.
Ekegusii: gose kwana ne riroba, ndikworokererie, ne chinswe chia nyancha, nchikoraarerie.
