English: Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this,
Kiswahili: Ni nani miongoni mwa hawa wote asiyejua kwamba mkono wa Bwana ndio uliofanya hili?
Ekegusii: Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana aya onsi ng’a okoboko kw’Omonene nakwo gwakorire aya?

English: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
Kiswahili: Mkononi mwake kuna uhai wa kila kiumbe, na pumzi ya wanadamu wote.
Ekegusii: Obogima bwa kera egetongwa kere moyo na omoika o Mwanyabaanto, nigo bire ase okoboko kwaye.

English: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
Kiswahili: Je, sikio haliyajaribu maneno kama vile ulimi uonjavyo chakula?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ogoto gokoigwa, tikori koyateema buna oromeme rokomena rwaigwa endagera?

English: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
Kiswahili: Je, hekima haipatikani katikati ya wazee? Je, maisha marefu hayaleti ufahamu?
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore ase abanto abanene, na okomenya emiaka emenge nakwo okomanya.

English: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
Kiswahili: “Hekima na nguvu ni vya Mungu; shauri na ufahamu ni vyake yeye.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo are nobong’aini na okobua, boigo nare nogosemia na obomanyi.

English: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
Kiswahili: Kile anachokibomoa hakiwezi kujengeka tena; mtu aliyefungiwa naye hawezi kufunguliwa.
Ekegusii: Ere aise gotagora, onde tari oraagache naende; aise gosiekera omonto, onde tari oramoigorere.

English: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
Kiswahili: Akizuia maji, huwa pana ukame; akiyaachia maji, huharibu nchi.
Ekegusii: Aise gotanga amaache, ense igo erome pa, na ekero akoyarenta nigo akoonchorana ense.

English: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
Kiswahili: Kwake kuna nguvu na ushindi; adanganywaye na adanganyaye, wote wawili ni wake.
Ekegusii: Chinguru na obong’aini nigo bikorwa asare. Abwo bakong’aineka na abakong’ainereria nigo bare ase okoboko kwaye.

English: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
Kiswahili: Yeye huwaondoa washauri wakiwa wametekwa nyara, naye huwapumbaza wanaotoa maamuzi.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoombogania abare abasemia obatiga getirianda, nigo agokora abagaambi ebiina baba abariri.

English: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
Kiswahili: Huondoa pingu zilizofungwa na wafalme, na kuwafunga mishipi ya kiunoni.
Ekegusii: Nigo agosibora chinkini chi’abarwoti, erio obaboyia ebibarachi.

English: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
Kiswahili: Huwaondoa makuhani wakiwa wametekwa nyara, na kuwaangusha waliojiimarisha muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoombogania abakuani, obatiga getirianda, na oonchorana abanto bare nokobua.

English: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
Kiswahili: Hunyamazisha midomo ya washauri wanaoaminika, na kuondoa busara ya wazee.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo basemeirie nigo akobaura amang’ana bagokwana, na oura abanto abagotu ogosemia.

English: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
Kiswahili: Huwamwagia dharau wanaoheshimika, na kuwavua silaha wenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorentera abagaambi ogochaywa, na abanto bare nokobua nigo akobaura chinguru.

English: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
Kiswahili: Hufunua mambo ya ndani ya gizani, na kuyaleta nuruni yale yaliyositirika sana.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoorokia obobisi ase omosunte, erio okora obobisi boria bore ase omosunte bwaba oborabu.

English: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
Kiswahili: Huyafanya mataifa yatukuke na kuyaangamiza; hufanya mataifa kuwa makubwa, naye huyatawanya.
Ekegusii: Nigo agokinia ebisaku, naende obisiria; nigo akobikora biabucha, naende obing’anyia.

English: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
Kiswahili: Huwaondolea viongozi wa nchi akili zao; huwapeleka watangetange nyikani pasipo na njia.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorusia obong’aini ase abatang’ani b’abaanto bare ase ense, erio obatiga bakoombogana erooro bosa.

English: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
Kiswahili: Hupapasa gizani pasipokuwa na mwanga; huwafanya wapepesuke kama walevi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotaba‐taba ase omosunte borabu botaiyo, na ogera baong’anya buna omonto otindire.

English: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
Kiswahili: “Macho yangu yameona hili lote, masikio yangu yamesikia na kulielewa.
Ekegusii: Naama! Amang’ana aya onsi nayarorire neriso riane, nayaigure nogoto kwane, nayamanyire.

English: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
Kiswahili: Hayo mnayoyajua mimi pia ninayajua; mimi si mtu duni kuliko ninyi.
Ekegusii: Aya momanyete, nainche ninyamanyete; inwe timombueti kende.

English: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninayo shauku ya kuzungumza na Mwenyezi na kuhojiana shauri langu na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo nganetie nkwane n’Omonguru; mbeke amang’ana aane ase Nyasae, erinde ng’amereranie nere,

English: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
Kiswahili: Ninyi, hata hivyo, hunipakaza uongo; ninyi ni matabibu wasiofaa kitu, ninyi nyote!
Ekegusii: Korende inwe nabatongi oborimo, inwe mwensi nabarwaria bare bosa, motari kogwenia.

English: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
Kiswahili: Laiti wote mngenyamaza kimya! Kwa kuwa kwenu hilo lingekuwa hekima.
Ekegusii: Onye ndiria mware gokira‐kiri! Okwo nanga nigo kwaba obong’aini bwaino.

English: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
Kiswahili: Sikieni sasa hoja yangu; sikilizeni kusihi kwangu.
Ekegusii: Bono tegerera moigwe amang’ana ngwekwanera, naende tegerera moigwe ogosorora gokorwa ase omonwa one.

English: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
Kiswahili: Je, mtazungumza kwa uovu kwa niaba ya Mungu? Je, mtazungumza kwa udanganyifu kwa niaba yake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo mokorwanerera Nyasae ase ogokwana oborimo? Naende mokomorwanerera ase obong’ainereria?

English: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
Kiswahili: Mtamwonyesha upendeleo? Mtamtetea Mungu kwenye mashtaka yake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo more nogwanchereria asare? Nigo moganetie korwanerera Nyasae ase ekegambero?

English: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
Kiswahili: Je, ingekuwa vyema Mungu akiwahoji ninyi? Je, mngeweza kumdanganya kama ambavyo mngeweza kuwadanganya wanadamu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana nabe amaya ase more Omonene karabarenge abamanye buna more? Gose mokagete ng’a nigo moramong’aine buna abanto bakong’ainana?

English: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
Kiswahili: Hakika angewakemea kama mkiwapendelea watu kwa siri.
Ekegusii: Ekeene ere nabatogonyere Onye mogokora ogwanchereria bobisi.

English: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?
Kiswahili: Je, huo ukuu wake haungewatisha ninyi? Je, hofu yake isingewaangukia ninyi?
Ekegusii: Inee! Obonene bwaye tibokobaboyia, na okogosa kwaye kobaondokie?

English: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
Kiswahili: Maneno yenu ni mithali za majivu; utetezi wenu ni ngome za udongo wa mfinyanzi.
Ekegusii: Emereng’anio y’obong’aini bwaino nigo ere bosa buna ribu, ne chiburi chiaino nigo chigiteire esike.

English: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
Kiswahili: “Nyamazeni kimya nipate kusema; kisha na yanipate yatakayonipata.
Ekegusii: Inwe kira‐kiri, montige nkwane, na kende gionsi kegochia konyora, tiga kenyore.

English: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini nijiweke mwenyewe kwenye hatari na kuyaweka maisha yangu mikononi mwangu?
Ekegusii: Nase ki ndabeeke enyama y’omobere one ase amaino aane? Ting’egerereti obogima bwane.

English: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
Kiswahili: Ingawa ataniua, bado nitamtumaini; hakika nitazitetea njia zangu mbele zake.
Ekegusii: Omonene naisa kong’ita, ningenderere komosemeria, nonya nabo goika ndete amang’ana aane ase obosio bwaye.

English: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.
Kiswahili: Naam, hili litanigeukia kuwa wokovu wangu, kwa maana hakuna mtu asiyemcha Mungu atakayethubutu kuja mbele yake!
Ekegusii: Ayio nabe ogotooreka kwane ng’a omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae tagocha ase obosio bwaye.

English: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni maneno yangu kwa makini; nayo masikio yenu yaingize kile nisemacho.
Ekegusii: Tegerera onyigwe, tiga ogotebereria kwane gosoe ase amato aino.

English: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
Kiswahili: Sasa kwamba nimekwisha kutayarisha mambo yangu, ninajua mimi nitahesabiwa kuwa na haki.
Ekegusii: Rora, naroisirie amang’ana aane, namanyire ng’a nimbarerwe oboronge.

English: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.
Kiswahili: Je, kuna yeyote anayeweza kuleta mashtaka dhidi yangu? Kama ndivyo, nitanyamaza kimya na nife.
Ekegusii: Ning’o oreo ogochia koamererania nainche? Onye oreo, rirorio inche nigo ndakire‐kiri inkwe.

English: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
Kiswahili: “Ee Mungu, unijalie tu mimi haya mambo mawili, nami sitajificha uso wako:
Ekegusii: Bono nigo ngokoboria onkorere ebinto bibere, nario ntebise korwa ase obosio bwao:

English: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
Kiswahili: Ondoa mkono wako uwe mbali nami, nawe uache kuniogofya kwa hofu zako kuu.
Ekegusii: Rusia okoboko kwao korwa ase ’nde, na okogosa kwao tikogenderera konyoboyia.

English: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
Kiswahili: Niite kwenye shauri nami nitajibu, au niache niseme, nawe upate kujibu.
Ekegusii: Erio aye ondangerie, na inche ng’itabe, gose ing’a ribaga nkwane, naye ong’iranerie.

English: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
Kiswahili: Ni makosa na dhambi ngapi nilizotenda? Nionyeshe kosa langu na dhambi yangu.
Ekegusii: Amamocho aane, na ebibe biane, mbirenga bire? Imanyie ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane.

English: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini kuuficha uso wako na kunihesabu mimi kuwa adui yako?
Ekegusii: Nase ki okobisa obosio bwao na kombara ng’a nomobisa oo inde?

English: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
Kiswahili: Je, utaliadhibu jani lipeperushwalo na upepo? Je, utayasaka makapi makavu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo orasegenyie rito eriomo rikona‐koirwa nembeo? Gose aye nigo ogochia gotunya omoiriro korwa magega?

English: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa unaandika mambo machungu dhidi yangu na kunifanya nizirithi dhambi za ujana wangu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera gwanchikeire amang’ana ’obororo, naende kwang’akanire amabe ’obosae bwane.

English: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
Kiswahili: Umeifunga miguu yangu kwenye pingu. Unazichunga kwa makini njia zangu zote kwa kutia alama kwenye nyayo za miguu yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye gwasoirie amagoro aane ase rikorogoto, nigo origereretie orogendo rwane rwonsi; aye kwabeekire orobebe ase chimbaratero chiane chigotacha.

English: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo mwanadamu huangamia kama kitu kilichooza, kama vazi lililoliwa na nondo.
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo agosira oruao buna egento ekegundo, na buna eanga yarirwe nebigwankwa.

English: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu aliyezaliwa na mwanamke siku zake ni chache nazo zimejaa taabu.
Ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto okoiborwa nomokuungu, amatuko aye namake; ayio aichire nemechando.

English: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
Kiswahili: Huchanua kama ua kisha hunyauka; huwa kama kivuli kipitacho upesi, wala hadumu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akororekana buna egesicha giasichire na giasira bwango, nigo agoeta bwango buna omorengari, tari kogenderera kobao.

English: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
Kiswahili: Je, unamwekea jicho lako mtu kama huyo? Je, utamleta mbele yako katika hukumu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye nigo okorigereria omonto buna oyio? Nigo okondeta ase obosio bwao na kongambia ekiina?

English: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kutoa kitu safi kutoka kitu najisi? Hakuna awezaye!
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare korenta egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti? Onde taiyo, nonya noyomo.

English: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.
Kiswahili: Siku za mwanadamu zimewekewa mpaka; umekwisha kutangaza idadi ya miezi yake na kuweka mpaka ambao hawezi kuuvuka.
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo abareire amatuko aye, na omobaro bw’emetienyi yaye naye kwayochikire, naende kwamobeekeire chimbebe atanyare goetania.

English: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.
Kiswahili: Hivyo angalia mbali umwache, hadi awe amekamilisha muda wake kama mtu aliyeajiriwa.
Ekegusii: Tiga komorigereria, motige anyore obotoereru, erinde agokere amatuko aye buna omonto orikire emeremo.

English: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
Kiswahili: “Kwa maana lipo tumaini kwa mti; kama ukikatwa utachipuka tena, nayo machipukizi yake mapya hayatakoma.
Ekegusii: “Ogosemeria nkoreo ase omote, ekero ogechirwe noseboke naende, na emeseboko eyio tegosira.

English: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
Kiswahili: Mizizi yake yaweza kuchakaa ardhini na kisiki chake kufa udongoni,
Ekegusii: Emeri y’omote oyio neisa kogota ime ase riroba, na egetugi kiaye nkegote gesire ime ase riroba,

English: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
Kiswahili: lakini kwa kupata dalili ya maji utachipua na kutoa machipukizi kama mche.
Ekegusii: nonya naboigo, ekero embura eratwe, nigo keraseboke na gosokia ebisabo buna ekemeri ekeyia.

English: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
Kiswahili: Lakini mwanadamu hufa, na huo ndio mwisho wake; hutoa pumzi ya mwisho, naye hayuko tena!
Ekegusii: Korende omonto nigo agokwa, bwarerigwa riroba inse; omonto nigo agotiga koeyana, ng’ai agochia?

English: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
Kiswahili: Kama vile maji yatowekavyo katika bahari, au mkondo wa mto ukaushwavyo na kuwa mkavu,
Ekegusii: “Buna koreng’ana amaache e chinyancha agosira pi, naboigo naye chindooche agokama chioma pa,

English: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
Kiswahili: ndivyo mwanadamu alalavyo chini asiamke; hadi mbingu zitakapokuwa hazipo tena, wanadamu hawataamka au kuamshwa kutoka kwenye usingizi wao.
Ekegusii: naboigo na Mwanyabaanto kararire, tagotenena naende; tagoturwa goika ekero igoro na ense bitabeo; tagotaboborwa korwa ase chitoro chiaye.

English: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
Kiswahili: “Laiti kama ungenificha kaburini, na kunisitiri hadi hasira yako ipite! Laiti ungeniwekea wakati, na kisha ukanikumbuka!
Ekegusii: “Naki anga yaba buya, onye nkwambisa agwo aase abakuure; onye kwandenda aase are bobisi, goika endamwamu yao ebe yaetire, onye gwanchikera engaki na kong’inyora!

English: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
Kiswahili: Je, kama mtu akifa, aweza kuishi tena? Siku zote za kazi zangu ngumu nitangojea kufanywa upya kwangu.
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto gakuure, nairane koba moyo naende? Inche ase amatuko aane onsi inchikeire, nimbe nganyete, goika ogosiborwa kwane goche.

English: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
Kiswahili: Utaniita nami nitakuitika; utakionea shauku kiumbe ambacho mikono yako ilikiumba.
Ekegusii: Aye korandangerie, na inche ningoitabere, ekiagera noganie emeremo y’amaboko ao.

English: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
Kiswahili: Hakika ndipo utakapozihesabu hatua zangu, lakini hutazifuatia dhambi zangu.
Ekegusii: Bono aye nigo okobara amatambokero aane, gose tori korigereria ebibe biane.

English: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
Kiswahili: Makosa yangu yatafungiwa kwa lakiri kwenye mfuko, nawe utazifunika dhambi zangu.
Ekegusii: Ogosaria kwane kware komumekerigwa egunia ime, aye nigo kware gotuba ebibe biane.

English: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.
Kiswahili: “Lakini kama mlima umomonyokavyo na kufikichika na kama vile mwamba uondolewavyo mahali pake,
Ekegusii: “Buna egetunwa gekogwa na giasamunyokana, na egetare giasukigwa korwa aase aye;

English: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
Kiswahili: kama maji yamalizavyo mawe, na mafuriko yachukuavyo udongo, ndivyo unavyoharibu tegemeo la mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: buna amaache agwata amagena asamunyokana, ne chiooro chiaira amaroba aera, naboigo aye ogosiria ogosemeria kwa Mwanyabaanto.

English: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
Kiswahili: Humshinda mara moja kwa daima, naye hutoweka; waibadilisha sura yake na kumwondoa.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogendererete kobua omonto, na ere nigo agoeta osira, nigo okoonchora ekieni kiaye kwamosiria.

English: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
Kiswahili: Kama wanawe wakipewa heshima, yeye hafahamu; kama wakidharauliwa, yeye haoni.
Ekegusii: Abana baye nigo bakoegwa ogosikwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio; nigo bakourwa ogosikwa kwabo na gokoigwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio.

English: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
Kiswahili: Yeye hasikii kingine isipokuwa maumivu ya mwili wake mwenyewe, naye huomboleza kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoigwa obororo ase omobere oye, na oba okona‐kwereera omonyene.”

English: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
Kiswahili: Kisha Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:
Ekegusii: Erio Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:

English: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
Kiswahili: “Je, mtu mwenye hekima hujibu kwa mawazo matupu, au kujaza tumbo lake kwa upepo wenye joto wa mashariki?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto omong’aini nagwenerete airanerie amang’ana are buna omwaga okogusa, na goichoria enda yaye nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha?

English: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
Kiswahili: Je, aweza kubishana juu ya maneno yasiyofaa, kwa hotuba zisizo na maana?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nemogwenerete koamererania ne chinkwana chitari nengencho, gose amang’ana atari korenta buya bonde?

English: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
Kiswahili: Lakini unadhoofisha hata uchaji wa Mungu na kuzuia ibada mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogosiria okomoiroka Nyasae, naende gwatanga ogosaba ase obosio bwaye.

English: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
Kiswahili: Dhambi yako inasukuma kinywa chako, nawe umechagua ulimi wa hila.
Ekegusii: Ebibe biao biorokereirie omonwa oo amang’ana ogokwana, aye gwachorire gokwana amang’ana y’obong’ainereria.

English: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
Kiswahili: Kinywa chako mwenyewe kinakuhukumu, wala si changu; midomo yako mwenyewe inashuhudia dhidi yako.
Ekegusii: Tari inche ngokonachera ekiina, korende amang’ana aya ogokwana, ee, aya ogokwana nomonwa oo akobereire kirori.

English: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
Kiswahili: “Je, wewe ni mtu wa kwanza kuzaliwa? Ulizaliwa kabla ya vilima?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Naye ore omonto bw’eritang’ani koiborwa? Gose naye gwatongetwe ritang’ani ebitunwa bitarabao?

English: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
Kiswahili: Je, wewe husikiliza mashauri ya siri ya Mungu? Je, wewe unaizuia hekima iwe yako mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Inee! Kwana koigwa emeroberio y’obobisi bwa Nyasae? Aye nigo kwenyoreire obong’aini aye bweka?

English: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
Kiswahili: Wewe unajua kitu gani tusichokijua sisi? Unafahamu kitu gani tusichokifahamu sisi?
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye ninki omanyete intwe totamanyeti? Mbong’aini ki omanyete intwe totamanyeti?

English: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.
Kiswahili: Wale wenye mvi na wazee wako upande wetu, watu ambao ni wazee hata kuliko baba yako.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamerire chimbuche amo nabakoorire emiaka emenge nao bare aa amo naintwe, barabwo mbabuete iso ase emiaka.

English: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
Kiswahili: Je, faraja za Mungu hazikutoshi, au maneno yaliyosemwa kwako kwa upole si kitu?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Okoremia koria Nyasae akoeire tikogoisaini? Gose ring’ana ri’oboitongo agokwana naye nigo rire bosa asore?

English: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
Kiswahili: Kwa nini moyo wako unakudanganya, na kwa nini macho yako yanangʼaa,
Ekegusii: Nase ki enkoro yao ere morero, na amaiso ao akomogora,

English: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
Kiswahili: ili kwamba upate kutoa hasira yako dhidi ya Mungu, na kumwaga maneno kama hayo kutoka kinywani mwako?
Ekegusii: goika omoyo oo obeire mamincha ya Nyasae, na bono aye ngosokia ore amang’ana aya korwa ase omonwa oo?

English: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani, hata aweze kuwa safi, au yeye aliyezaliwa na mwanamke, hata aweze kuwa mwadilifu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Mwanyabaanto ninki are goika anyare koba oyochenegete? Gose ere oyio oiboire nomokuungu ng’a anyare koba omonyaboronge?

English: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
Kiswahili: Kama Mungu hawaamini watakatifu wake, kama hata mbingu zenyewe si safi machoni pake,
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabachenu baye, na igoro chionsi tichichenegeti ase obosio bwaye.

English: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
Kiswahili: sembuse mwanadamu ambaye ni mwovu na mpotovu, ambaye hunywa uovu kama anywavyo maji!
Ekegusii: Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio ogokora ay’okogechia na gosaria, oyio okonywa ebibe buna amaache?

English: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
Kiswahili: “Nisikilize mimi nami nitakueleza, acha nikuambie yale niliyoyaona,
Ekegusii: “Integerera oigwe, na inche nkworokie; amang’ana narorire ninyararie.

English: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
Kiswahili: ambayo watu wenye hekima wameyanena, bila kuficha lolote walilopokea toka kwa baba zao
Ekegusii: Ayio abanto abang’aini bateebeetigwe ne chisokoro chiabo, nabarabwo tibayabisete.

English: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
Kiswahili: (wakati ambao wao peke yao ndio walipewa nchi, hakuna mgeni aliyepita miongoni mwao):
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa ense eria, na abanto b’ense engeni tibaetete aroro.

English: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu siku zake zote hupata mateso, miaka yote aliwekewa mkorofi.
Ekegusii: “Omokori amabe nigo akogenderera gochandeka nobororo ase amatuko aye onsi, na omochandi boigo ase emiaka ere achikeretwe.

English: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
Kiswahili: Sauti za kutisha hujaa masikioni mwake; katika kufanikiwa kwake, wanyangʼanyi humshambulia.
Ekegusii: Amariogi ay’okwoboyia nigo agosoa ase amato aye; na ekero are n’obotoereru, oyo ogosiria nigo akomocheera.

English: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
Kiswahili: Hukata tamaa kuokoka gizani; amewekwa kwa ajili ya upanga.
Ekegusii: Ere tari koba nogosemeria ng’a gose narue ase omosunte naende, ekiagera omoro nigo omoganetie.

English: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
Kiswahili: Hutangatanga, akitafuta chakula; anajua kwamba siku ya giza iko karibu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akoba okoombogana korigia endagera, oboria: Ng’ai ere? Nigo amanyete ng’a rituko ri’omosunte riamoikeire ang’e.

English: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
Kiswahili: Taabu na maumivu makuu vinamtia hofu; humshinda kama mfalme aliye tayari kwa vita,
Ekegusii: Emechando na obwoba nigo bikomoondokia. Ebio nigo bikomorwania na komobua, ne chinguru buna echi’omorwoti bwebekire ang’e korwana esegi.

English: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
Kiswahili: kwa sababu amemkunjia Mungu ngumi yake na kujigamba dhidi ya Mwenyezi,
Ekegusii: “Ere oramboire okoboko kwaye mamincha ya Nyasae, naende oba nomokia gokora ay’oboenenu ase obosio bw’Omonguru.

English: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
Kiswahili: kwa kiburi akishambulia dhidi ya Mungu akiwa na ngao nene, iliyo imara.
Ekegusii: Oyio nigo akobogoria ching’aya chiaye chikumbire, ominyoka ore nebigoti ebikong’u ochia korwania Omonene.

English: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
Kiswahili: “Ingawa uso wake umefunikwa na mafuta kwa unene na kiuno chake kimevimba kwa kunenepa,
Ekegusii: Nigo atubire obosio bwaye namaguta ’obonoru, naende onorire ase ebibono biaye.

English: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
Kiswahili: ataishi katika miji ya magofu, na katika nyumba ambazo haziishi mwanadamu yeyote, nyumba zinazokuwa vifusi.
Ekegusii: “Oyio obeire omenyete ase emechie yasaretigwe agwo ase chinyomba chitamenyiri nonde, echio konya chiarurwe ase ogosarigwa chibe amatombe.

English: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
Kiswahili: Hatatajirika tena, nao utajiri wake hautadumu, wala mali zake hazitakuwa nyingi juu ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio takoba omonda, obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera kobao, gose tibokobucha ase ense.

English: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
Kiswahili: Hatatoka gizani; mwali wa moto utanyausha machipukizi yake, nayo pumzi ya kinywa cha Mungu itamwondolea mbali.
Ekegusii: Tagotooreka korwa ase omosunte; omorero mbwomie emeseboka egoseboka, ere omonyene nasire ase omoika bw’Omonene.

English: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.
Kiswahili: Asijidanganye mwenyewe kutumainia ubatili, kwa kuwa hatapata malipo yoyote.
Ekegusii: Tabaisa kweng’aina ase ogosemeria amang’ana abosa, ekiagera obosa obwo nabwo borabe eng’eria yaye.

English: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
Kiswahili: Atakuwa amelipwa kikamilifu kabla ya wakati wake, nayo matawi yake hayatastawi.
Ekegusii: Naakanwe obosa obwo ritang’ani engaki yaye etaraika, na nigo arabe buna orosagia rwaye rotarasicha.

English: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
Kiswahili: Atafanana na mzabibu uliopukutishwa matunda yake kabla hayajaiva, kama mzeituni unaodondosha maua yake.
Ekegusii: Oyio nigo arabe buna omosabibu okoarora amasabibu ataratoba, na buna omozeituni okoarora ebisicha biaye.

English: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa jamii ya wasiomcha Mungu watakuwa tasa, nao moto utateketeza hema za wale wanaopenda rushwa.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bi’abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo biragombae, na omorero nosambe emechie y’abanchete amaaki.

English: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
Kiswahili: Hutunga mimba ya madhara na kuzaa uovu; matumbo yao huumba udanganyifu.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia amabe, barenta ogosaria; okwama kwabo bakorenta nokw’obong’ainereria.”

English: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
Kiswahili: “Nimepata kusikia mambo mengi kama haya, nanyi nyote ni wafariji wenye kutaabisha!
Ekegusii: Inche naigure amang’ana amange buna ayio, inwe mwensi nigo more abaremia mogonchanda.

English: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
Kiswahili: Je, maneno yenu mengi yasiyo na maana hayana mwisho? Mna nini hata mwendelee kushindana kwa maneno?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ayio anga buna omwaga okogusa aerire? Gose nkere egekogoseegeta oiranerie ayande?

English: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,
Kiswahili: Mimi pia ningeweza kuzungumza kama ninyi, kama mngekuwa katika hali yangu; ningeweza kutoa hotuba nzuri dhidi yenu, na kuwatikisia ninyi kichwa changu.
Ekegusii: Onye ndiria obogima bwaino bware koba ribaga ri’obwane, nanga nigo nakwana buna inwe; nigo nare gokwana amang’ana amange mamincha yaino na gosingisia omotwe one.

English: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.
Kiswahili: Lakini kinywa changu kingewatia moyo; faraja kutoka midomoni mwangu, ingewaletea nafuu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana nare ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one, nigo are kobabeeka chinguru; ee, amabeebe ay’ebikoba igoro nigo are kobaremia.

English: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?
Kiswahili: “Lakini kama nikisema, maumivu yangu bado hayatulizwi; nami kama nikijizuia, wala hayaondoki.
Ekegusii: Ninsa koba ngokwana, obororo bwane tibogokea; na ninsa koremereria nkire, emechando yane tegokea nonya ng’ake.

English: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, hakika umenichakaza; umewaangamiza kabisa watu wa nyumbani mwangu wote.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae okoorire chinguru chiane, na osiririe abanto bonsi b’enka yane.

English: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
Kiswahili: Umenikunjakunja, nalo limekuwa ushahidi; nako kukonda kwangu kumeongezeka sana na kushuhudia dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Ere okorire omobere one obeire nemenia, na eyio yambereire kirori; oboreu bwane bwaorokeire ase obosio bwane kombera kirori.

English: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
Kiswahili: Mungu amenishambulia na kunirarua katika hasira yake, na kunisagia meno yake; adui yangu hunikazia macho yake makali.
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire nendamwamu ase ’nde, ontandoranire, naende ongechire; oromananirie amaino aye ase ’nde; omochandi one omogoreirie inche amaiso bobe.

English: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.
Kiswahili: Watu wamenifumbulia vinywa vyao kunidhihaki; hunipiga shavuni mwangu kwa dharau, na kuungana pamoja dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo banyansameretie emenwa yabo, bang’akire chindoe ase chinsea. Bakondama; nigo bagosangererekana amo ng’a bankore bobe.

English: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Mungu amenigeuzia kwa watu wabaya, na kunitupa katika makucha ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ondure ase abanto batamoirogeti, ombekire ase amaboko abakori amabe.

English: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.
Kiswahili: Mambo yote yalikuwa mazuri, lakini alinivunjavunja; amenikamata shingo na kuniponda. Amenifanya mimi kuwa shabaha yake;
Ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge inde n’obotoereru, korende ere agansenyenta, ee, Nyasae akambwata ebigoti, akambutorana ebing’ese, bono onkorire nabeire ekerenga kiaye gekoraswa.

English: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
Kiswahili: wapiga upinde wake wananizunguka. Bila huruma, huchoma figo zangu, na kuimwaga nyongo yangu juu ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe baye bang’etananire aande onsi, ombetire chinyigo chiane, tandorereti amaabera; oumoire amaache endorwe yane igoro ase riroba.

English: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
Kiswahili: Huniponda tena na tena; hunishambulia kama shujaa wa vita.
Ekegusii: Ong’akire amaakwa igoro ase amaakwa ande; nigo akondindokera buna omorwani esegi ore ne chinguru.

English: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
Kiswahili: “Nimejishonea nguo ya gunia juu ya mwili wangu nami nimekizika kipaji cha uso wangu kwenye vumbi.
Ekegusii: Bono natubire omobere one negunia, ne chinguru chiane nachitugutire ime ase orotu.

English: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,
Kiswahili: Uso wangu umekuwa mwekundu kwa kulia, macho yangu yamepigwa na giza kuu.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane abariirire ase obosio bwane, na ekiriri kiarorekanire ase obosio bwane,

English: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo mikono yangu haijafanya jeuri, na maombi yangu ni safi.
Ekegusii: nonya tindakora bobe bonde namaboko aane, na ogosaba kwane kore ogoikeranu.

English: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
Kiswahili: “Ee nchi, usiifunike damu yangu, nacho kilio changu kisinyamazishwe kamwe.
Ekegusii: Aye riroba, tobaisa gotuba amanyinga aane, na ekerero kiane tikenyora ase kegotimokera.

English: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
Kiswahili: Hata sasa shahidi wangu yuko mbinguni; wakili wangu yuko juu.
Ekegusii: Rora, Kirori one igoro are nonya mbono, ee, Oyokondwanerera igoro are.

English: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
Kiswahili: Mwombezi wangu ni rafiki yangu macho yangu yamwagapo machozi kwa Mungu;
Ekegusii: Nonya nabasani baane nigo bagonsekerera, inche nigo nkoiyeria amariga ndigereretie Nyasae.

English: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
Kiswahili: kwa niaba ya mtu anamsihi Mungu kama mtu anavyosihi kwa ajili ya rafiki yake.
Ekegusii: Kirori one nansororere ase Nyasae, buna omonto agosororera omonto onde.

English: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.
Kiswahili: “Ni miaka michache tu itapita kabla sijaenda safari ambayo sitarudi.
Ekegusii: Emiaka emeke netigarete, inche mbwatie enchera ekogenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao naende.

English: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu umevunjika, siku zangu zimefupishwa, kaburi linaningojea.
Ekegusii: “Omoika ong’ereire, amatuko aane aikeire omoerio; oboina mbonganyete.

English: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
Kiswahili: Hakika wenye mizaha wamenizunguka; macho yangu yamebaki kutazama uadui wao.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, abachecheria bang’etananire, na amaiso aane nigo agendererete korora okogechia kwabo.

English: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
Kiswahili: “Ee Mungu, nipe dhamana unayodai. Ni nani mwingine atakayeweka dhamana kwa ajili yangu?
Ekegusii: Aye omonyene obe ntenenera ase ’nde, imbe asore. Inee! Ning’o rende oranyare kwerua abe ntenenera ase ’nde?

English: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.
Kiswahili: Umezifunga akili zao zisipate ufahamu, kwa hiyo hutawaacha wapate ushindi.
Ekegusii: Aye gwasiekire ebirengererio biabo tibiba nokomanya, ase ayio tokobaimokereria igoro na kobaa okobua.

English: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akiwashutumu rafiki zake ili apate ujira, macho ya watoto wake yatashindwa kuona.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogosigaana abasani ase okwenyorera chinibo chiabo, amaiso abana babo nigo araukore.

English: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
Kiswahili: “Mungu amenifanya kitu cha dhihaka kwa kila mtu, mtu ambaye watu humtemea mate usoni.
Ekegusii: Omonene onkorire nabeire ring’ana abanto bakorabaara, nabeire oyo abanto bagochaaya ase ogotwa amate.

English: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yamefifia kwa ajili ya majonzi; umbile langu lote ni kama kivuli.
Ekegusii: Emechando yagerire amaiso aane abeire orotutu, na ebiimo biane bionsi biabeire buna omorengari bosa.

English: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
Kiswahili: Watu wanyofu wanatishwa na hili; watu wasio na hatia wanasimama dhidi ya wasiomcha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaronge bakumirie amang’ana aya, ee, omonto otari na komocha oimokire gokorera bobe oria otamoirogeti Nyasae.

English: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, waadilifu watazishika njia zao, nao wale wenye mikono safi wataendelea kupata nguvu.
Ekegusii: Korende omonyene oboronge nabwaterere enchera yaye, na oyio obwate amaboko achenegete nagenderere koba ne chinguru.

English: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ninyi njooni, ninyi nyote, jaribuni tena! Sitampata mtu mwenye hekima miongoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe mwensi, moirane gocha; tinkonyara konyora nonya nomonto oyomo ase egati yaino ore omong’aini.

English: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
Kiswahili: Siku zangu zimepita, mipango yangu imevunjika, vivyo hivyo shauku za moyo wangu.
Ekegusii: Amatuko aane aetire, emeroberio yane yasarekire, nonya nokogania gw’enkoro yane.

English: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
Kiswahili: Watu hawa hufanya usiku kuwa mchana, kwenye giza wao husema, ‘Mwanga u karibu.’
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo baonchoire obotuko bwabeire omobaso; nigo bagoteeba ng’a omobaso nigo ore ang’e, korende omosunte noreo.

English: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
Kiswahili: Kama nyumba pekee ninayoitarajia ni kaburi, kama nikikitandika kitanda changu gizani,
Ekegusii: Nonya inde nogosemeria, aase abakuure nao obomenyo bwane, nindambore oborere bwane ase omosunte ime.

English: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’
Kiswahili: kama nikiuambia uharibifu, ‘Wewe u baba yangu,’ na kuliambia buu, ‘Wewe u mama yangu’ au ‘Dada yangu,’
Ekegusii: Ninteebie oboina: Naye tata Ninteebie amakonde: Ninwe baba na abaiseke baminto.

English: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?
Kiswahili: liko wapi basi tarajio langu? Ni nani awezaye kuona tarajio lolote kwa ajili yangu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ng’ai rende ogosemeria kwane kore? Ning’o oranyare gokorora?

English: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
Kiswahili: Je, litashuka chini hadi kwenye malango ya mauti? Je, tutashuka pamoja mavumbini?”
Ekegusii: Ogosemeria okwo nigo koragende gochia aase abakuure. Nintirimboke amo nakorokwo gochia gotimoka ase riroba ime.”

English: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
Kiswahili: Bildadi Mshuhi akajibu:
Ekegusii: Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:

English: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
Kiswahili: “Je, ni lini utafika mwisho wa maneno haya? Uwe mwenye busara, nasi ndipo tutakapoweza kuongea.
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri ogochia korigia amang’ana agokwanwa? Yarengererie, magega yaye naintwe tokwane.

English: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini sisi tunafikiriwa kama wanyama, na kuonekana wajinga machoni pako?
Ekegusii: Nase ki tokobarwa koba buna ching’iti? Nase ki tokobarwa koba abanto batamanyeti gento kende?

English: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
Kiswahili: Wewe unayejirarua mwenyewe vipande vipande katika hasira yako, je, dunia iachwe kwa ajili yako wewe? Au ni lazima miamba iondolewe mahali pake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye nigo ogwetandora ase engencho y’endamwamu yao, ense nigo egochia gotigwa bosa ase engencho yao? Gose egetare ngetigerigwe korwa aase aye?

English: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
Kiswahili: “Taa ya mwovu imezimwa, nao mwali wa moto wake umezimika.
Ekegusii: “Amaene, omobaso bw’omokori amabe norime, gose amasase aye takobara.

English: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
Kiswahili: Mwanga hemani mwake umekuwa giza; taa iliyo karibu naye imezimika.
Ekegusii: Oborabu bore ase obomenyo bwaye nigo borabe omosunte, na etaya yaye ere asare nerimigwe.

English: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
Kiswahili: Nguvu za hatua zake zimedhoofishwa; shauri lake baya litamwangusha.
Ekegusii: Amatambokero aye are ne chinguru nakeeigwe, na emeroberio yaye emoiyerie inse.

English: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
Kiswahili: Miguu yake imemsukumia kwenye wavu, naye anatangatanga kwenye matundu ya wavu.
Ekegusii: Amagoro aye nabwatwe nomotego, abe ogotaara ase egati ye chiirima.

English: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
Kiswahili: Tanzi litamkamata kwenye kisigino; mtego utamshikilia kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Omotego nomobwate ase egetingiro na omoeto nomobwate omong’userere bokong’u.

English: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
Kiswahili: Kitanzi kimefichwa ardhini kwa ajili yake; mtego uko kwenye njia yake.
Ekegusii: Engori y’ogotegerwa nebiswe ase riroba ase agotacha, na omotego otegwe ase enchera agoeta.

English: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
Kiswahili: Vitisho vimemtia hofu kila upande, na adui zake humwandama kila hatua.
Ekegusii: Nabe okogoswa na kwoboigwa korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, nkomoseria atame namagoro.

English: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
Kiswahili: Janga linamwonea shauku; maafa yako tayari kwa ajili yake aangukapo.
Ekegusii: Enchara nemorie goika chinguru chiaye chiere, na emechando nemobeere ang’e komoiyeria.

English: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
Kiswahili: Nayo yatakula sehemu ya ngozi yake; mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mauti atakula maungo yake.
Ekegusii: Oborwaire mbokoore risankwa ri’omobere oye, oborwaire obotang’ani bw’amakweri mbogundie ebiimo biaye.

English: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
Kiswahili: Atangʼolewa kutoka usalama wa hema lake, na kupelekwa kwa mfalme wa vitisho.
Ekegusii: Nataboranwe ne chinguru korwa ase obomenyo konya asemeretie, erio airwe ase omorwoti bw’okwoboyia okonge.

English: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
Kiswahili: Moto utakaa katika hema lake; moto wa kiberiti utamwagwa juu ya makao yake.
Ekegusii: Enka yaye nebe bosa abanto abaao mbabe bakomenya aroro; amagena omorero nasiarerwe ase enka yaye.

English: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
Kiswahili: Mizizi yake chini itakauka na matawi yake juu yatanyauka.
Ekegusii: Emeri yaye ’nyome inse ye riroba, ne chinsagia chiaye nachisusane.

English: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
Kiswahili: Kumbukumbu lake litatoweka katika dunia, wala hatakuwa na jina katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Oyio takoinyorwa ase ense nonya ng’ake, gose nonya nerieta riaye tirikogenderera koinyorwa agwo ase enchera.

English: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
Kiswahili: Ameondolewa nuruni na kusukumiwa gizani, naye amefukuzwa mbali atoke duniani.
Ekegusii: Ere narusigwe korwa ase oborabu arutwe gochia ase omosunte; naende aserigwe korwa ase ense.

English: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
Kiswahili: Hana mtoto wala mzao miongoni mwa watu wake, wala aliyenusurika mahali alipoishi.
Ekegusii: Takoba nomwana gose abanto b’ororeria rwaye ase egati y’abanto bamwabo, gose monto onde oye tagotigara ore moyo agwo ase amenyete.

English: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
Kiswahili: Watu wa magharibi watashangaa yaliyompata; watu wa mashariki watapatwa na hofu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete bosongo mbakumie igoro ye rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwaye, na abamenyete moocha mbaondokigwe namang’ana ayio.

English: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
Kiswahili: Hakika ndivyo yalivyo makao ya mtu mwovu; ndivyo palivyo mahali pake mtu asiyemjua Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene, obomenyo bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nabo bore igo, na aase ay’abataganeti komomanya Nyasae nabo are igo.”

English: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
Kiswahili: “Je, mtaendelea kunitesa mpaka lini, na kuniponda kwa maneno yenu?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri morabe mokogechia omoyo one na mogonsenyenta namang’ana aino?

English: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
Kiswahili: Mara kumi hizi mmenishutumu; bila aibu mnanishambulia.
Ekegusii: Mwabeire mogonchecheria ara ikomi. Inee! Timori korora obosooku gonkorera bobe iga?

English: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
Kiswahili: Kama ni kweli nimepotoka, kosa langu ninabaki kuhusika nalo mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ee, nonya ekeene nakorire okomocha, okomocha okwo nokwane inche omonyene.

English: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,
Kiswahili: Kama kweli mngejitukuza wenyewe juu yangu, na kutumia unyonge wangu dhidi yangu,
Ekegusii: Inwe onye mogwetogia ng’a nabaya more kombua na kong’enekeria igo kobwatekana nogochaywa kwane,

English: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
Kiswahili: basi jueni kuwa Mungu amenitendea yaliyo mabaya, naye amekokota wavu wake kunizunguka.
Ekegusii: rirorio momanye ng’a Nyasae orentire amabe aya ase ’nde, na ontegire noboreba bwaye.

English: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
Kiswahili: “Ingawa ninalia, ‘Nimetendewa mabaya!’ sipati jibu; ingawa ninaomba msaada, hakuna haki.
Ekegusii: Rora, nigo nkorera mono ngoteeba: Nakoreirwe bobe, korende tindi koiranerigwa; nigo nkorangeria neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe, korende ekeene, oboronge tibori gokorwa.

English: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
Kiswahili: Yeye ameizuia njia yangu hivyo siwezi kupita; ameyafunika mapito yangu na giza.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oagachire orwaki aase ngoeta, obeekire omosunte ase ebinchera ngoeta.

English: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
Kiswahili: Amenivua heshima yangu, na kuniondolea taji kichwani pangu.
Ekegusii: Ong’urire obonene bwane. Orusirie egutwa korwa ase omotwe one.

English: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
Kiswahili: Amenibomoa kila upande hadi nimeisha; amelingʼoa tegemeo langu kama mti.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase chinsemo chionsi ong’iyeirie, bono inche nasirigwe; osimoire ogosemeria kwane buna omote ogosimorwa.

English: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
Kiswahili: Hasira yake imewaka juu yangu; amenihesabu kuwa miongoni mwa adui zake.
Ekegusii: Obeire nekeririanda ekenene ase ’nde, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.

English: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
Kiswahili: Majeshi yake yananisogelea kwa nguvu; yamenizingira, yamepiga kambi kulizunguka hema langu.
Ekegusii: Ebiombe bi’abarwani baye b’esegi nigo bigocha bire amo, biabekire eburi ase ngoetera; biatoorire biang’etananire ase chinsemo chionsi chi’Obomenyo bwane.

English: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
Kiswahili: “Amewatenga ndugu zangu mbali nami; wale tunaojuana nao wamefarakana nami kabisa.
Ekegusii: “Nyasae ogerire abaminto bantigire, bambeereire aare, na abanto twamanyaine bantigire, babeire buna tibamanyeti.

English: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
Kiswahili: Watu wa jamaa yangu wamekwenda mbali; rafiki zangu wamenisahau.
Ekegusii: Abanto baminto bantigire, na abasani twanchaine mono banyebire.

English: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
Kiswahili: Wageni wangu na watumishi wangu wa kike wananiona kama mgeni; wananitazama kama mgeni.
Ekegusii: Abageni bamenyete mwane banyebire; na abasomba baane abaiseke bambarire buna omoeti; nabeire omomenyi ase amaiso abo.

English: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
Kiswahili: Namwita mtumishi wangu, wala haitiki, ingawa namwomba kwa kinywa changu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ekero nkorangeria omosomba one, ere tari kong’itabera, otatiga ekero namosoroire, nario rioka agocha.

English: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
Kiswahili: Pumzi ya kinywa changu ni kinyaa kwa mke wangu; nimekuwa chukizo mno kwa ndugu zangu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omoika okorwa ase omonwa one nigo ogotiokera omokungu one bobe; nigo inde okogechia ase abamura baminto torwete enda eyemo.

English: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
Kiswahili: Hata watoto wadogo hunidhihaki; ninapojitokeza, hunifanyia mzaha.
Ekegusii: Nonya n’abana abake banchayire; ekero ngotenena nigo bagonkwana bobe.

English: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
Kiswahili: Rafiki zangu wa moyoni wote wananichukia kabisa; wale niwapendao wamekuwa kinyume nami.
Ekegusii: Abasani abagisangio banyinyerire na kogechigwa nainche; nabwo nanchete bang’onchokeire na gonkora bobe.

English: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
Kiswahili: Mimi nimebaki mifupa na ngozi tu; nimeponea nikiwa karibu kufa.
Ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one atongononire ase risankwa ne chinyama, natigeirwe egesabo getubete amaino gioka.

English: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.
Kiswahili: “Nihurumieni, rafiki zangu, kuweni na huruma, kwa kuwa mkono wa Mungu umenipiga.
Ekegusii: Inwe abasani baane, ndorera amabeebe, ndorera amabeebe, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae kwang’akire!

English: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mnanifuatia kama Mungu afanyavyo? Hamtosheki kamwe na mwili wangu?
Ekegusii: Nase ki nainwe mogonchanda buna Nyasae anchandire? Inee! Timoisanegeti ase ogonchanda omobere one?

English: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
Kiswahili: “Laiti maneno yangu yangewekwa kwenye kumbukumbu, laiti kwamba yangeandikwa kwenye kitabu,
Ekegusii: “Naki yare koba buya onye amang’ana aane narikwa bono! Yare koba buya arikwe ase egetabu,

English: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
Kiswahili: kwamba yangechorwa kwenye risasi kwa kifaa cha chuma, au kuyachonga juu ya mwamba milele!
Ekegusii: ee, arikwe nekaramu eroisirie korwa ase risasi, ekioma egekong’u, amang’erwe ase egetare abeo kare na kare.

English: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
Kiswahili: Ninajua kwamba Mkombozi wangu yu hai, naye kwamba mwishoni atasimama juu ya nchi.
Ekegusii: “Korende nimanyete ng’a Omobooria one moyo are, omoerio nigo aratenene igoro ye riroba.

English: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
Kiswahili: Nami baada ya ngozi yangu kuharibiwa, bado nikiwa na mwili huu nitamwona Mungu;
Ekegusii: Nyuma risankwa ri’omobere one korirabe riasarekire, erio nindore Nyasae ’nde ase omobere one.

English: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
Kiswahili: mimi nitamwona kwa macho yangu mwenyewe: mimi, wala si mwingine. Tazama jinsi moyo wangu unavyomtamani sana!
Ekegusii: Nimwerorere inche omonyene; amaiso aane namorigererie, ayane, tari ay’omonto omoao. “Nimoganetie mono ase enkoro yane ime.

English: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
Kiswahili: “Kama mkisema, ‘Tazama tutakavyomwinda, maadamu mzizi wa tatizo uko ndani yake,’
Ekegusii: Moise goteeba: Nase nchera ki tokomochanda? Nigo mokorengereria ng’a ninche nagerire amabe onsi anyorire?

English: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
Kiswahili: ninyi wenyewe uogopeni upanga, kwa kuwa ghadhabu italeta adhabu kwa upanga, nanyi ndipo mtakapojua kwamba kuna hukumu.”
Ekegusii: Inwe iroka ogoitwa n’omoro, ekiagera oyore nekeririanda nigo akoegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa nemioro; erio monyare komanya ng’a okogambigwa nkoreo.”

English: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sofari Mnaamathi akajibu:
Ekegusii: Erio Sofari Omonaama akairaneria, akabora:

English: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
Kiswahili: “Mawazo yanayonisumbua yananisukuma kujibu, kwa sababu nimehangaika sana.
Ekegusii: “Bono ebirengererio bire ime yane bianchandire, ase ayio biagerire imbe omwango koiraneria.

English: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
Kiswahili: Ninasikia makaripio ambayo yananivunjia heshima, nao ufahamu wangu unanisukuma kujibu.
Ekegusii: Naigure ogokuurerwa gw’okonyomania ng’a inche nomomochi, korende omoika bw’okomanya ore ime yane ogerire ing’iranerie.

English: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
Kiswahili: “Hakika unajua jinsi ilivyokuwa tangu zamani, tangu zamani mwanadamu alipowekwa duniani,
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye tikwana komanya ng’a korwa kare, ekero Mwanyabaanto babeegetwe ase ense,

English: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
Kiswahili: macheko ya mtu mwovu ni ya muda mfupi, nayo furaha ya wasiomcha Mungu hudumu kwa kitambo tu.
Ekegusii: omochengo bw’abakori amabe noyo bw’engaki enke, na omogooko bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nomweng’e?

English: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
Kiswahili: Ingawa kujikweza kwake hufikia mbinguni na kichwa chake hugusa mawingu,
Ekegusii: Ere naisa koba nobonene boigete igoro, na omotwe oye oike ase amare,

English: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
Kiswahili: ataangamia milele kama mavi yake mwenyewe. Wale waliomwona watauliza, ‘Yuko wapi?’
Ekegusii: goika asire kare na kare, buna obonyira bwaye bogosira. Abwo bamorooche mbaborie; Omonto oria, ng’ai are?

English: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
Kiswahili: Kama ndoto hutoweka, wala hapatikani tena, amefukuziwa mbali kama maono ya usiku.
Ekegusii: Nigo arasire buna chindoto, takonyorekana, ee, nigo aragikerigwe buna amaroro a botuko.

English: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
Kiswahili: Jicho lililomwona halitamwona tena; mahali pake hapatamwona tena.
Ekegusii: Eriso riarenge komoorora, tirikomoorora naende, gose aase aye takomorigereria naende.

English: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.
Kiswahili: Watoto wake watalipa yote baba yao aliyowadhulumu maskini, nayo mikono yake itarudisha mali yote aliyonyangʼanya watu.
Ekegusii: Abana baye mbabe bagosaberera korwa ase abataka, na amaboko aye nairanie obotenenku bwaye bwonsi.

English: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
Kiswahili: Nguvu za ujana zilizoijaza mifupa yake, zitalala naye mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Amauga aye nigo aichire ne chinguru chi’oboke bwaye, korende chinguru echio nigo chiraraare nere ase riroba.

English: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
Kiswahili: “Ingawa uovu ni mtamu kinywani mwake naye huuficha chini ya ulimi wake,
Ekegusii: “Nonya obobe bore obwansu ase omonwa oye ime, nabobise inse y’oromeme rwaye,

English: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,
Kiswahili: ingawa hawezi kukubali kuuachia uende, lakini huuweka kinywani mwake.
Ekegusii: nonya obwatererete obobe obwo bokong’u, takobotiga, korende nabogache ase omonwa oye ime,

English: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo chakula chake kitakuwa kichungu tumboni mwake, nacho kitakuwa sumu kali ya nyoka ndani yake.
Ekegusii: endagera eyio nigo erarore se ase enda yaye, ebe buna obosongo bw’eng’iti engenda inse ime yaye.

English: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
Kiswahili: Atatema mali alizozimeza; Mungu atalifanya tumbo lake kuzitapika.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akomera chinibo, naende ochiroka; Nyasae nigo agochiseria korwao.

English: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.
Kiswahili: Atanyonya sumu za majoka; meno ya nyoka mwenye sumu kali yatamuua.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nanyunyunte obosongo bw’eng’iti nomonwa, na obosongo bokorwa ase oromeme rw’eng’iti eria mbomoite.

English: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
Kiswahili: Hatafurahia vijito, mito inayotiririsha asali na siagi.
Ekegusii: Ere takwegokia ase okorora chindooche, chinsoko chiichire namooke na amabeere.

English: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.
Kiswahili: Vile alivyovitaabikia atavirudisha bila kuvila; hatafurahia faida itokanayo na biashara yake.
Ekegusii: Ebinto akoreire emeremo emekong’u nabiiranie, takobimera, gose takonyara kwegokeria ebitoki biria anyorire.

English: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa aliwaonea maskini na kuwaacha pasipo kitu; amenyangʼanya kwa nguvu nyumba asizozijenga.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera obeire ogokorera abataka bobe na kobatiga bare bosa, naende obeire okoira ne chinguru enyomba ende yonsi ere ataagachete.

English: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.
Kiswahili: “Hakika hatakuwa na raha katika kutamani kwake sana; hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe kwa hazina zake.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ribero ri’omonto oyio riagerire taba n’obotoereru, takonyara kogaacha gento kende gekomogokia.

English: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.
Kiswahili: Hakuna chochote kitakachosalia kwa ajili yake ili ale; kufanikiwa kwake hakutadumu.
Ekegusii: Ekero arageire tari gotigaria kende, ase ayio obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera.

English: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.
Kiswahili: Katikati ya wingi wa ustawi wake, dhiki itampata; taabu itamjia kwa nguvu zote.
Ekegusii: Nebe ekero agendererete gotenenka mono nachandwe, na obokong’u obonge mbomochere.

English: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
Kiswahili: Atakapokuwa amelijaza tumbo lake, Mungu ataionyesha ghadhabu kali dhidi yake, na kumnyeshea mapigo juu yake.
Ekegusii: Nebe ng’a ekero aisire koigota, Nyasae namotomere ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwaye; egesusuro ekio nigo keramochere ekero agendererete koragera.

English: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
Kiswahili: Ijapokuwa aikimbia silaha ya chuma, mshale wa shaba utamchoma.
Ekegusii: Nabe ogotama korwa ase ekerwanero gi’ekioma, abetwe nensara y’etai.

English: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
Kiswahili: Atauchomoa katika mgongo wake, ncha ingʼaayo kutoka ini lake. Vitisho vitakuja juu yake;
Ekegusii: Ensara eyio eng’uswe korwa ase omobere oye, ee, ensonga ekomesa nesokere ase endorwe yaye, erio ekeondoko ki’amakweri nakemosoe.

English: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.
Kiswahili: giza nene linavizia hazina zake. Moto usiopepewa na mtu utamteketeza, na kuangamiza yaliyosalia nyumbani mwake.
Ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima nigo ogacheire chinibo chiaye; omorero otautiri nonde nomosirie, na ebitigarete ase obomenyo bwaye mbisambwe biere.

English: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.
Kiswahili: Mbingu zitaweka wazi hatia yake, nayo nchi itainuka kinyume chake.
Ekegusii: Igoro neorokie ebibe biaye maiso marore, na ense nemoimokere komorwania.

English: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko yataichukua nyumba yake, maji yaendayo kasi katika siku ya ghadhabu ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ebinto asangereretie ase enyomba yaye mbiirwe; bionsi nigo birairwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu ya Nyasae.

English: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo fungu Mungu alilowagawia waovu, urithi uliowekwa kwa ajili yao na Mungu.”
Ekegusii: “Eke nakio egetari ki’omokori amabe gekorwa ase Nyasae, naende oyio noro omwando oye Nyasae amochikerete.”

English: Then Job answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:
Ekegusii: Bono Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:

English: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
Kiswahili: “Yasikilizeni maneno yangu kwa makini; hii na iwe faraja mnayonipa mimi.
Ekegusii: Tegerera mono moigwe amang’ana aane, ayio naro arabe okoremia kwaino ase ’nde.

English: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.
Kiswahili: Nivumilieni ninapozungumza, nami nikishazungumza, endeleeni kunidhihaki.
Ekegusii: Remereria, erinde nkwane; na ngokoora gokwana, mogenderere gonchecheria.

English: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
Kiswahili: “Je, kwani malalamiko yangu yanaelekezwa kwa mwanadamu? Kwa nini nisikose subira?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inche Mwanyabaanto nkwemurunganeria? Nase ki rende ndaremererie tinyemurungania?

English: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
Kiswahili: Niangalieni mkastaajabu; mkaweke mkono juu ya vinywa vyenu.
Ekegusii: Indigererie na moichanigwe; erio motube emenwa yaino namaboko, mokire.

English: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
Kiswahili: Ninapowaza juu ya hili, ninaogopa, nao mwili wangu unatetemeka.
Ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora amang’ana aya, obwoba nigo bogonsoa, na omobere one oiguswa.

English: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini waovu wanaendelea kuishi, wakifikia umri wa uzee na kuendelea kuwa na nguvu?
Ekegusii: Nase ki abakori amabe bakogenderera koba moyo na kwegotera bare ne chinguru na okobua?

English: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
Kiswahili: Huwaona watoto wao wakithibitika wakiwa wamewazunguka, wazao wao mbele za macho yao.
Ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bakoba nokogenderera okuya amo nabarabwo, na ororeria rwabo boigo.

English: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
Kiswahili: Nyumba zao zi salama wala hakuna hofu; fimbo ya Mungu haiko juu yao.
Ekegusii: Chinka chiabo nigo chire buya, bwoba tiboiyo, gose Nyasae tari kobaa egesusuro.

English: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
Kiswahili: Madume yao ya ngʼombe huvyaza bila kushindwa kamwe; ngʼombe wao huzaa wala hawaharibu mimba.
Ekegusii: Chiombe chiabo nigo chikonyora amarieme buya, naende chiabiara chitari korekera.

English: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
Kiswahili: Huwatoa watoto wao nje kama kundi; wadogo wao huchezacheza.
Ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bagotomwa isiko banga buna amaicho, nigo bakoba bagotenga.

English: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
Kiswahili: Huimba nyimbo kwa matari na kwa kinubi, nao huifurahia sauti ya filimbi.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagotera bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano, naende bagokera amariogi ’ebiroria.

English: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
Kiswahili: Huitumia miaka yao katika mafanikio nao hushuka kaburini kwa amani.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakogenderera kwegokia nobotenenku bwabo; bakwa bagenda aase abakuure bare nomorembe.

English: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
Kiswahili: Lakini humwambia Mungu, ‘Tuache sisi!’ Hatuna haja ya kufahamu njia zako.
Ekegusii: Barobwo nigo bagoteebia Nyasae: totige intwe! Titoganeti komanya chinchera chiao.

English: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
Kiswahili: Mwenyezi ni nani hata tumtumikie? Tutapata faida gani kumwomba?
Ekegusii: Oria Omobui ninki are goika tomokorere? Mbitoki ki toranyore ase okomosaba?

English: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
Kiswahili: Lakini kufanikiwa kwao hakupo mikononi mwao wenyewe, hivyo najitenga mbali na shauri la waovu.
Ekegusii: Rora, ogosesenigwa kwabo tikori ase amaboko abo; ogosemia kw’abakori amabe nigo kore aare nainche.

English: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
Kiswahili: “Lakini ni mara ngapi taa ya waovu huzimwa? Ni mara ngapi maafa huwajia, yale yawapatayo ambayo Mungu huwapangia katika hasira yake?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ng’ara karenga chitaaya chi’abakori amabe chikorimigwa? Ng’ara karenga emechando ekobacheera? Inee! Ara karenga Nyasae akobaa emechando ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye?

English: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
Kiswahili: Ni mara ngapi huwa kama majani makavu mbele ya upepo, kama makapi yachukuliwayo na dhoruba?
Ekegusii: Gose barabwo nkoirurukigwa bare buna chimboba, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga?

English: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
Kiswahili: Imesemekana, ‘Mungu huiweka akiba adhabu ya mtu kwa ajili ya wanawe.’ Mungu na amlipe mtu mwenyewe, ili apate kulijua!
Ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mogoteeba ng’a Nyasae nigo akogachera abana ebibe bi’abaise. Tiga Omonene aakane abanto abanyene ebibe biabo, erio nario baranyare kobimanya.

English: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: Macho yake mwenyewe na yaone maangamizi yake; yeye na ainywe ghadhabu ya Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Tiga barore ogosirigwa kwabo namaiso abo, naende banyoosigwe endamwamu y’Omonguru.

English: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
Kiswahili: Kwani anajali nini kuhusu jamaa anayoiacha nyuma, miezi yake aliyopangiwa ifikapo mwisho?
Ekegusii: Ekero emetienyi yabo yaerire na bakuure, Inee, mbabe bagwechandera chinka chiabo?

English: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
Kiswahili: “Je, yuko mtu yeyote awezaye kumfundisha Mungu maarifa, iwapo yeye ndiye ahukumuye hata walio juu ya wote?
Ekegusii: Onde nare oranyare kworokereria Nyasae obong’aini, ere oria okogambia abwo bare igoro mono?

English: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja hufa akiwa na nguvu zake kamili, akiwa salama na mwenye raha kamili,
Ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo nigo agokwa ore nobotenenku obonge, ore n’obotoereru bwonsi na orendire buya,

English: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
Kiswahili: mwili wake ukiwa umenawiri, nayo mifupa yake ikiwa imejaa mafuta ndani yake.
Ekegusii: ebirandi biaye biichire namabeere, na amauga ’omobere oye aichire nemeseto.

English: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwingine hufa katika uchungu wa nafsi, akiwa hajafurahia kamwe jambo lolote zuri.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde igo agokwa ore nobororo bw’omoyo oye, atana konyora amaya nonya ng’ake.

English: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
Kiswahili: Hao wote hulala mavumbini, nao mabuu huwafunika wote.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo bakobeekwa ase riroba bareng’anetie, bagunda, na amakonde abatuba.

English: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
Kiswahili: “Ninayajua kikamilifu yale mnayoyafikiri, mipango ambayo kwayo mngenitendea mabaya.
Ekegusii: “Rora, nimanyete ebirengererio biaino, na emeroberio yaino y’ogonkora bobe.

English: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
Kiswahili: Mwasema, ‘Iko wapi sasa nyumba ya huyo mtu mkuu, mahema ambayo watu waovu walikaa?’
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ng’ai enyomba y’omochandi oria ere? Naende: Ng’ai obomenyo bw’abakori amabe bore?

English: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
Kiswahili: Je, hamkuwahi kuwauliza hao wanaosafiri? Je, hamkutafakari taarifa zao:
Ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe timori koboria abaeti chinchera, naende mwanchera oborori bwabo,

English: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?
Kiswahili: kwamba mtu mwovu huepushwa kutoka siku ya maafa, kwamba huokolewa kutoka siku ya ghadhabu?
Ekegusii: ng’a omokori amabe nigo akorendwa ekero emechando yachire, naende atoorigwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu?

English: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?
Kiswahili: Ni nani hulaumu matendo yake mbele ya uso wake? Ni nani ampatilizaye kwa yale aliyoyatenda?
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koorokeria omokori amabe chinchera chiaye? Ning’o oramoakane amabe ayio akorire?

English: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
Kiswahili: Hupelekwa kaburini, nao ulinzi ukawekwa kwenye kaburi lake.
Ekegusii: Ekero arabeekwe ase oboina, oboina boria nigo boraarendwe.

English: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
Kiswahili: Udongo ulio bondeni ni mtamu kwake; watu wote watamfuata, nao umati wa watu usiohesabika umemtangulia.
Ekegusii: Amaroba erigoko nabe amansu asare; abanto bonsi mbamotunyane korwa magega, na omobaro bw’abamotang’anerete tori kobareka.

English: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
Kiswahili: “Hivyo ninyi mnawezaje kunifariji kwa upuzi wenu? Hakuna kilichosalia cha majibu yenu isipokuwa uongo!”
Ekegusii: “Nase ki rende mokondemia namang’ana abosa? Ayatigaire ase amairanerio aino nigo are oborimo bwoka.”

English: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:
Ekegusii: Erio Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:

English: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
Kiswahili: “Je, mwanadamu aweza kuwa wa faida kwa Mungu? Je, hata mtu mwenye hekima aweza kumfaidi?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nenyarekane ng’a omonto abe nengencho ase Nyasae? Ekeene, omonto oria ore nobong’aini nigo akwegwenera ere bweka omonyene.

English: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
Kiswahili: Je, Mwenyezi angefurahia nini kama ungekuwa mwadilifu? Au je, yeye angepata faida gani kama njia zako zingekuwa kamilifu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omogoko onde nore ase Omonguru ng’a nomonyaboronge ore? Gose inki aranyore onye aye kogokora chinchera chiao chibe ching’ikeranu?

English: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
Kiswahili: “Je, ni kwa ajili ya utaua wako ndiyo maana anakukemea na kuleta mashtaka dhidi yako?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a nekiagera omoirogete, nakio gekogera agokoa egesusuro na gokorenta ase ekiina?

English: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
Kiswahili: Je, uovu wako si mkuu? Dhambi zako si hazina mwisho?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amabe gwakorire tari amanene? Ekeene, ebibe biao tibiri nomoerio.

English: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
Kiswahili: Umedai dhamana kwa ndugu zako bila sababu; umewavua watu nguo zao, ukawaacha uchi.
Ekegusii: Aye kwairire bosa ebinto abamino baruete bibe ntenenera, naende kwabachaboire chianga, kwabatigire gesobono.

English: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
Kiswahili: Hukumpa maji aliyechoka, nawe ulimnyima chakula mwenye njaa,
Ekegusii: Oyo konya orosire tomoeti amaache anywe, na oyo orenge nenchara okamorina endagera.

English: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
Kiswahili: ingawa ulikuwa mtu mwenye uwezo ukimiliki nchi: mtu uliyeheshimiwa, ukiishi ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto obwate okobua nigo akoira ense yaba eyaye, na oyio oeirwe ogosikwa nere okoyemenya.

English: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
Kiswahili: Umewafukuza wajane mikono mitupu na kuzivunja nguvu za yatima.
Ekegusii: Aye kwabeire kogoseria ababoraka bare namaboko amasa na kobuna amaboko e chintakana.

English: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu mitego imekuzunguka pande zote, hatari ya ghafula inakutia hofu,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio emeeto yagoetananire, na obwoba bwa mobosokano nkogochanda bore.

English: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
Kiswahili: ndiyo sababu ni giza sana huwezi kuona, tena ndiyo sababu mafuriko ya maji yamekufunika.
Ekegusii: Oborabu bwao bwabekirwe omosunte, goika tori korora, na amaache amange agotubire.

English: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
Kiswahili: “Je, Mungu hayuko katika mbingu za juu? Juu kuliko nyota zilizo juu sana!
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nyasae tari aaria igoro mono? Rigereria ching’enang’eni chia igoro buna chire aare mono!

English: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
Kiswahili: Hivyo wewe wasema, ‘Mungu anajua nini?’ Je, yeye huhukumu katika giza kama hilo?
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio aye nigo ogoteeba: Inki Nyasae amanyete? Nanyare konacha ekiina goetera ase omosunte ekerima?

English: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
Kiswahili: Mawingu mazito ni pazia lake, hivyo hatuoni sisi atembeapo juu ya anga la dunia.
Ekegusii: Amare amarito nigo amotubete, takonyara korora, naende nigo agotaara ase obokumbe bwa igoro.

English: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
Kiswahili: Je, utaifuata njia ya zamani, ambayo watu waovu waliikanyaga?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nenchera enkoro ogochia kobwatia, eria abakori amabe babwatetie?

English: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
Kiswahili: Waliondolewa kabla ya wakati wao, misingi yao ikachukuliwa na mafuriko.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bataboretigwe engaki yabo konya etaraika; na oboroso bwabo bokairwa buna omogooko okoira.

English: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
Kiswahili: Walimwambia Mungu, ‘Tuache sisi! Huyo Mwenyezi aweza kutufanyia nini?’
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bateebeetie Nyasae: Karue ase tore! Naende bakaboora: Inee! Ngento ki Omobui oyio aratokorere?

English: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
Kiswahili: Lakini ndiye alizijaza nyumba zao na vitu vizuri, hivyo ninajitenga mbali na mashauri ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Nyasae konya oichoirie chinyomba chiabo n’ebinto ebiya. Ogosemia kw’abakori amabe tiga kobe aare nainche.

English: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
Kiswahili: “Wenye haki wanaona maangamizi yao na kufurahi, nao wasio na hatia huwadhihaki, wakisema,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanyaboronge bakorora ayio, nigo bakogoka; ee, abwo batari na komocha nigo bagosekerera abakori amabe na kobachecheria,

English: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
Kiswahili: ‘Hakika adui zetu wameangamizwa, nao moto umeteketeza mali zao.’
Ekegusii: bateba: Amaene, ababisa baito basirigwe kegima, na ebinto biabo biatigarete biasambirwe nomorero.

English: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
Kiswahili: “Mjue sana Mungu ili uwe na amani, ndipo mema yatakapokujia.
Ekegusii: “Obwatane na Nyasae, nario orabe nomorembe; korakore igo, nonyore amaya.

English: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
Kiswahili: Uyapokee mafundisho toka kinywani mwake, na maneno yake uyaweke moyoni mwako.
Ekegusii: Ancha amorokererio akorwa ase omonwa oye; gacha amang’ana aye ime ase enkoro yao.

English: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
Kiswahili: Kama ukimrudia Mwenyezi, utarudishwa upya: Kama ukiuondoa uovu uwe mbali na hema lako,
Ekegusii: Korairanere Omobui, noiranerigwe amaya ao; korende oserie obobe korwa ase obomenyo bwao.

English: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
Kiswahili: kama dhahabu yako ukiihesabu kama mavumbi, dhahabu yako ya Ofiri kama miamba ya mabondeni,
Ekegusii: Otugute chitaabu chiao ime ase amaroba, ne chitaabu chikorwa Ofiri ochibeke ase egati y’amagena ’ebirooche,

English: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
