Kiswahili: ndipo Mwenyezi atakuwa dhahabu yako, naye atakuwa fedha yako iliyo bora.
Ekegusii: erinde Omobui bweka abe etaabu yao, na efeta yao ere nengencho enene.

English: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
Kiswahili: Hakika ndipo utakapojifurahisha kwa Mwenyezi, nawe utamwinulia Mungu uso wako.
Ekegusii: Rirorio nobe gokwegokia ase Omobui oria, onyare korigereria Nyasae.

English: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.
Kiswahili: Utamwomba yeye, naye atakusikia, nawe utazitimiza nadhiri zako.
Ekegusii: Na ekero orabe gokomosaba, nakoigwe; naye nonyare goakana chiira chiao chi’ogotiana.

English: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
Kiswahili: Utakusudia jambo nalo litatendeka, nao mwanga utaangazia njia zako.
Ekegusii: Erio ekero orabe gokoroberia gokora gento kende gionsi, ekio nkebe bo, na oborabu mbomoreke chinchera chiao.

English: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
Kiswahili: Watu watakaposhushwa, nawe ukasema, ‘Wainue!’ ndipo atamwokoa aliyevunjika moyo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokeyia abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo obatooria.

English: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
Kiswahili: Atamwokoa hata yule ambaye ana hatia, ataokolewa kwa sababu ya usafi wa mikono yako.”
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agotooria omonto ore nokomocha, omonto buna oyio nigo aratoorigwe goetera ase amaboko ao achenegete.”

English: Then Job answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:
Ekegusii: Ayubu akairaneria, akabora,

English: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
Kiswahili: “Hata leo malalamiko yangu ni chungu; mkono wake ni mzito juu yangu hata nikiugua.
Ekegusii: Nonya ngoika reero okwemurungania kwane nigo kore okororo se; ogoakwa kwane nigo kore okorito kobua okweng’ereria kwane.

English: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
Kiswahili: Laiti ningefahamu mahali pa kumwona; laiti ningeweza kwenda mahali akaapo!
Ekegusii: Onye ndiria nare komanya aase ndamonyore, rirorio nigo nare kogenda goika ase obomenyo bwaye bore.

English: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
Kiswahili: Ningeliweka shauri langu mbele zake, na kukijaza kinywa changu na hoja.
Ekegusii: Nigo narenge komoteebia amang’ana aane, ing’ichorie omonwa one namang’ana nkoamererania nere.

English: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
Kiswahili: Ningejua kwamba angenijibu nini, na kuelewa lile ambalo angelisema.
Ekegusii: Igo nigo nare komanya eki akong’iraneria, na komanya ayarenge gonteebia.

English: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
Kiswahili: Je, angenipinga kwa nguvu nyingi? La, asingenigandamiza.
Ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nkoamererania arenge nainche ase okobua kwaye kore okonene? Yaya, nigo arenge gontegerera.

English: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
Kiswahili: Hapo mtu mwadilifu angeweka shauri lake mbele zake, nami ningeokolewa milele na mhukumu wangu.
Ekegusii: Agwo omonto omonyaboronge nigo are konyara koamererania nere, rirorio nigo nare gotigwa kegima noyokongambia.

English: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.
Kiswahili: “Lakini nikienda mashariki, hayupo; nikienda magharibi, simpati.
Ekegusii: Rora, nabeire nkogenda gochia bosio, korende ere taiyo; naende nabeire nkoirana gochia magega, korende tindi komoorora.

English: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
Kiswahili: Anapokuwa kazini pande za kaskazini, simwoni; akigeukia kusini, nako simwoni hata kidogo.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkomorigeria ensemo y’okobee, korende ere nigo akwebisa; naonchoka gochia ase ensemo y’okorio, korende tindi komoorora.

English: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
Kiswahili: Lakini anaijua njia niiendeayo; akiisha kunijaribu, nitatoka kama dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Korende ere namanyete chinchera chiane ngoetera. Ekero arakoore gonteema, nimbioke buna etaabu ekobioka korwa riko.

English: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
Kiswahili: Nyayo zangu zimefuata hatua zake kwa karibu; nimeishika njia yake bila kukengeuka.
Ekegusii: Inche natachire bokong’u ase amabarato aye, nabeire ndendete chinchera chiaye, gose tindi koonchoka nchitige.

English: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
Kiswahili: Sijaziacha amri zilizotoka midomoni mwake; nimeyathamini maneno ya kinywa chake kuliko chakula changu cha kila siku.
Ekegusii: Tinana gotiga kobwata amachiiko akwanete; nimbwatetie amang’ana ere akwanete, gose tari aya naroberetie inche omonyene.

English: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
Kiswahili: “Lakini yeye husimama peke yake; ni nani awezaye kumpinga? Yeye hufanya lolote atakalo.
Ekegusii: Korende ere tari koonchoka, ning’o oranyare komoonchorana? Egento aganirie gokora, nigo akogekora.

English: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
Kiswahili: Hutimiliza maagizo yake dhidi yangu, na bado anayo mipango mingi kama hiyo ambayo ameiweka akiba.
Ekegusii: Aya achiikire igoro yane, goika ayaikeranie, na amange buna ayio nigo agachire ase ebirengererio biaye.

English: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
Kiswahili: Hiyo ndiyo sababu ninaingiwa na hofu mbele zake; nifikiriapo haya yote ninamwogopa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nabeire nobwoba koba ase obosio bwaye, na ekero nkoyarengereria nigo nkomwoboa.

English: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
Kiswahili: Mungu ameufanya moyo wangu kuzimia; yeye Mwenyezi amenitia hofu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ogoyirie omoyo one, ee, Omobui ongosire,

English: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo sijanyamazishwa na giza, wala kwa giza nene linalofunika uso wangu.
Ekegusii: ere tantigete ase omosunte nsire, nonya noria ekerima otubete obosio bwane.

English: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini Mwenyezi asiweke nyakati kwa ajili ya hukumu? Kwa nini wale wamjuao wazitafute siku kama hizo bila mafanikio?
Ekegusii: Nase ki Omonguru atabegeti chingaki chi’ekina? Naende nase ki baria bamwanchete batararora rituko riria riaye?

English: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
Kiswahili: Watu husogeza mawe ya mpaka; huchunga makundi ya wanyama waliyonyangʼanya kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagotigeria chimbebe, baira amaicho e chitugo nechinguru, bachia koyarisia aba ayabo.

English: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
Kiswahili: Huwanyangʼanya yatima punda wao, na kumchukua rehani fahali wa mjane.
Ekegusii: Barobwo nigo bakoira chitigere chie chintakana, baira chiombe chi’ababoraka koba intenenera.

English: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
Kiswahili: Humsukuma mhitaji kutoka njia, na kuwafanya maskini wote wa nchi kulazimika kujificha.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagotwoma abaremeire korwa inchera, bagera abataka bonsi b’ense eyio bachia kwebisa amo.

English: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.
Kiswahili: Kama punda-mwitu jangwani, maskini huzunguka katika kazi zao za kutafuta chakula; mahali palipo jangwa huwapa chakula cha watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Rora, abataka abwo babeire buna chitigere chi’orosana chire ase erooro; nigo bagokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora ebi bakoria. Ase ekerubo ekiomo nao bakorigeria abana babo endagera.

English: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Hukusanya chakula mashambani na kuokota masazo katika mashamba ya mizabibu ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakogesera omonto onde chindagera chi’echitugo chiaye, naende basangereria amasabibu agotigwa ase omogondo bw’omokori amabe.

English: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.
Kiswahili: Kwa kukosa nguo, usiku kucha hukaa uchi; hawana chochote cha kujifunika baridi.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakorara gesobono ase obotuko bwonsi, batabwati eki bakwebisia, gose tibabwati eki bakobeeka ekero ki’embeo.

English: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.
Kiswahili: Hutota kwa mvua za mlimani, nao huikumbatia miamba kwa ajili ya kukosa pa kujisitiri.
Ekegusii: Emebere yabo nigo enyiete nembura egotwa ase ebitunwa, erio bamigererania ase chingako chi’ebitare koigama aroro.

English: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,
Kiswahili: Mtoto yatima hupokonywa matitini; mtoto wachanga wa maskini hunyakuliwa kwa ajili ya deni.
Ekegusii: Abande nigo bagotaboria chintakana korwa ase chimbeere chi’abang’ina, na baira abana ebing’werere b’abataka babe intenenera.

English: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.
Kiswahili: Kwa kukosa nguo, hutembea uchi; hubeba miganda ya ngano, lakini huwa na njaa.
Ekegusii: Abataka baria bakona‐koong’anya bare getirianda, nigo bakobogoria emesaima bare nenchara.

English: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.
Kiswahili: Hukamua zeituni katika mawe ya kusagia; hukanyaga mashinikizo, lakini wanaona kiu.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakomita amaguta ’amazeituni, boigo edivai korende nonya naboigo nigo bare nerang’o.

English: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.
Kiswahili: Kilio cha huzuni cha wanaokufa kinapaa kutoka mjini, nazo nafsi za waliojeruhiwa zinalilia msaada. Lakini Mungu hamlaumu mtu yeyote kwa kutenda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Abanto bachandegete ase omochie nigo bakweumia, abanto baakire chingoma nigo bakorera, nonya naboigo Nyasae tari gotegerera ogosaba kwabo.

English: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
Kiswahili: “Wako wale wanaoiasi nuru, wasiofahamu njia zake wala hawakai katika mapito yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande bangire oborabu, nonya ne chinchera chi’oborabu tibachimanyeti, gose tibari kobwatia chinchera chi’oborabu obwo.

English: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.
Kiswahili: Wakati mwanga wa mchana unapotoweka, muuaji huinuka naye huwaua maskini na mhitaji; wakati wa usiku hunyemelea kama mwizi.
Ekegusii: Omoiti nigo akoboka mambia chuni ng’a aite abataka na abachandegete, na ase obotuko emeremo yaye neyoboibi.

English: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.
Kiswahili: Jicho la mzinzi hungojea wakati wa giza, naye hufikiri, ‘Hakuna jicho litakaloniona,’ naye huuficha uso wake.
Ekegusii: Eriso ri’omotomani nigo rikoganya kobwairire, ere oteeba: Onde tari ondoche, erio otuba obosio bwaye bwekona.

English: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.
Kiswahili: Katika giza, huvunja majumba, lakini wakati wa mchana hujifungia ndani; hawataki kufanya lolote nuruni.
Ekegusii: Omosunte gosoire, abaibi nigo bakobochora chinyomba basoa ime. Barabwo mobaso nigo bagwesiekerera bebisa; tibamanyeti oborabu.

English: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
Kiswahili: Kwa wote hawa, giza nene ndiyo asubuhi yao; hujifanya rafiki na vitisho vya gizani.
Ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima nigo onga buna emambia ase bare; barabwo nigo bare abasani b’okwoboyia kw’omosunte.

English: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed on the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.
Kiswahili: “Lakini wao ni povu juu ya maji; sehemu yao juu ya nchi imelaaniwa, hivyo hakuna hata mmoja aendaye kwenye shamba la mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Omokori amabe nigo akoirwa bwango ne chiooro, na egetari kiaye ase ense eye nigo keragereirie, ere takonyara koirana ase emegondo yaye y’emesabibu.

English: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.
Kiswahili: Kama vile joto na hari vinyakuavyo theluji iliyoyeyuka, ndivyo kuzimu kuwanyakuavyo waliotenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana egurugura ne riberera bigokoora amaache ’amagena ’embura, naboigo nabaanto bakorire ebibe barairwe gochia aase abakuure.

English: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.
Kiswahili: Tumbo lililowazaa huwasahau, nao huwa karamu ya mabuu; watu waovu hawakumbukwi tena, lakini huvunjika kama mti.
Ekegusii: Chinda chi’abaiborete nchibange pi; amakonde nabarie baere, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake; igo oyogokora amabe nabunwe buna omote.

English: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
Kiswahili: Huwafanya mawindo wanawake tasa na wasio na watoto, nao hawaonyeshi huruma kwa wajane.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoibera omokungu omogomba; gose tari gokorera omoboraka amaya.

English: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu huwakokota wenye nguvu kwa uwezo wake; ingawa wamestawi, hawana hakika ya maisha.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Nyasae ase okobua kwaye nigo akoa omokori amabe chinguru; ekero erusirie moyo, nigo agotenena naende.

English: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.
Kiswahili: Aweza akawaacha wakapumzika wakijihisi salama, lakini macho yake yanaona njia zao.
Ekegusii: Nabo Nyasae akomorenda buya na komokonya, na nigo akoba origereretie mono chinchera chiaye.

English: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.
Kiswahili: Kwa kitambo kidogo hutukuka, hatimaye hutoweka; hushushwa na kukusanywa kama wengine wote, hukatwa kama masuke ya nafaka.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki enke nabo abakori amabe bagokinigwa, erio bwango basirigwa; nigo bakogwa inse, bakwa buna abande, babutorwa buna ebigara bikobutorwa ekero bikogeswa.

English: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
Kiswahili: “Kama hili sivyo, ni nani awezaye kunithibitisha kuwa mwongo, na kuyafanya maneno yangu kuwa si kitu?”
Ekegusii: Onye amang’ana ayio tari bo, ning’o oranyare kong’enekia ng’a nomorimo inde, naende aorokie ng’a amang’ana nakwanire nigo are bosa.

English: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bildadi Mshuhi akajibu:
Ekegusii: Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:

English: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.
Kiswahili: “Mamlaka na kuheshimiwa ni vyake Mungu; yeye huthibitisha amani katika mbingu juu.
Ekegusii: “Obonene na okoirokia nigo bire ase Nyasae, nigo agokora omorembe aaria igoro mono.

English: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
Kiswahili: Je, majeshi yake yaweza kuhesabika? Ni nani asiyeangaziwa na nuru yake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o oranyare kobara emeganda yaye? Ning’o omobaso oye otari kobarera?

English: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
Kiswahili: Mtu awezaje kuwa mwadilifu mbele za Mungu? Awezaje mtu aliyezaliwa na mwanamke kuwa safi?
Ekegusii: Naki rende omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae? Naki omonto oiboire nomokuungu aranyare koba oyochenegete?

English: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
Kiswahili: Ikiwa hata mwezi sio mwangavu nazo nyota si safi machoni pake,
Ekegusii: Rora, nonya nomotienyi tori noborabu asare, gose ching’enang’eni tichiikeraneti ase amaiso aye.

English: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”
Kiswahili: sembuse mtu ambaye ni funza: mwanadamu ambaye ni buu tu!”
Ekegusii: Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio onga buna rikonde; na Mwanyabaanto oyio onga buna enyongore.”

English: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
Kiswahili: “Tazama jinsi ulivyomsaidia mtu asiye na uwezo! Jinsi ulivyouokoa mkono ulio dhaifu!
Ekegusii: “Naki ere buya aye gwakonyire omonto otari nokobua! Ee, aye gwatooririe omonto omoreu otari ne chinguru.

English: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
Kiswahili: Ni shauri gani ulilompa yeye asiye na hekima? Nayo ni busara gani kubwa uliyoonyesha!
Ekegusii: Naki ere buya gwasemirie omonto otari nobong’aini, na gwakwanire amang’ana aichire ne chisemi chingiya!

English: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyekusaidia kutamka maneno hayo? Nayo ni roho ya nani iliyosema kutoka kinywani mwako?
Ekegusii: Nase chinguru chia ng’o gwakwanire amang’ana buna aya? Na ngoetera ase omoika o ng’o kwayakwanire?

English: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
Kiswahili: “Wafu wako katika maumivu makuu, wale walio chini ya maji na wale waishio ndani yake.
Ekegusii: “Emeika y’abanto bakwete nigo ekoiguswa; boigo namaache na ebimenyete imeo.

English: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
Kiswahili: Mauti iko wazi mbele za Mungu; Uharibifu haukufunikwa.
Ekegusii: Aase abakuure nigo aasie ase obosio bwa Nyasae; ee, aase agwo ogosiria tabwati kemumeko.

English: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
Kiswahili: Hutandaza anga la kaskazini mahali patupu; naye huiningʼiniza dunia mahali pasipo na kitu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo aramborete ensemo ya sugusu aase arenge bosa, nigo asungete ense aase bosa etabwateti aande.

English: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
Kiswahili: Huyafungia maji kwenye mawingu yake, hata hivyo mawingu hayapasuki kwa uzito wake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo aochoganetie amaache amo, akayaboerania amare amanetu ime; na amare ayio tari gotandoka.

English: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
Kiswahili: Huufunika uso wa mwezi mpevu, akitandaza mawingu juu yake.
Ekegusii: Nigo atubete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akagetuba namare aye.

English: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
Kiswahili: Amechora mstari wa upeo juu ya uso wa maji, ameweka mpaka wa nuru na giza.
Ekegusii: Ong’ororirie ekeringerera kere orobebe rw’amaache ase ogwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte.

English: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
Kiswahili: Nguzo za mbingu nazo zatetemeka, zinatishika anapozikemea.
Ekegusii: Chisiiro chia igoro nigo chigotengecha, chiakumia ase ogotogonyera kwaye.

English: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
Kiswahili: Kwa nguvu zake aliisukasuka bahari; kwa hekima yake alimkata Rahabu vipande vipande.
Ekegusii: Ere ase okobua kwaye nigo agoturubania enyancha, na ase chisemi chiaye akanachana Rahabu, eng’iti enene y’enyancha.

English: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
Kiswahili: Aliisafisha anga kwa pumzi yake; kwa mkono wake alimchoma joka aendaye mbio.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoeyana, na omoika oye omechiera igoro, ere nigo aitete nokoboko kwaye engiti eria yare gotama.

English: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
Kiswahili: Haya ni mambo madogo tu katika matendo yake; tazama jinsi ulivyo mdogo mnongʼono tunaousikia kumhusu! Ni nani basi awezaye kuelewa ngurumo za nguvu zake?”
Ekegusii: Naama! Echi nechinsinyo chie chinchera chiaye, aya tokoigugwa nokomonyerera ogosinini. Korende ning’o oranyare komanya okobua kwaye konga buna enkoba egoaka.”

English: Job again took up his parable, and said,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Ayubu akaendelea na hoja yake, akasema:
Ekegusii: Ayubu akagenderera gokwana emerabaaro yaye akabora:

English: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
Kiswahili: “Hakika kama Mungu aishivyo, aliyeninyima haki yangu, Mwenyezi ambaye amenifanya nionje uchungu wa nafsi,
Ekegusii: Ekeene, buna Nyasae are moyo, oyo ong’urire ebiantungetie, na buna Omonguru aeire omoyo one obororo,

English: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
Kiswahili: kwa muda wote nitakaokuwa na uhai ndani yangu, nayo pumzi ya Mungu ikiwa puani mwangu,
Ekegusii: naende omoika bw’obomoyo ogendererete koba ime yane, na omoika o Nyasae ore ase chimioro chiane,

English: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
Kiswahili: midomo yangu haitanena uovu, wala ulimi wangu hautatamka udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: omonwa one togokwana aya atari a boronge, gose oromeme rwane ay’obong’ainereria.

English: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
Kiswahili: Sitakubaliana nanyi kabisa kuwa mko sahihi; hadi nife, sitakana uadilifu wangu.
Ekegusii: Abe aare korwa ase ’nde kobabara ng’a nabanyaboronge more; goika ogokwa kwane ningenderere goteeba ng’a tindi nokomocha.

English: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
Kiswahili: Nitadumisha haki yangu wala sitaiacha; dhamiri yangu haitanisuta muda wote ninaoishi.
Ekegusii: Nimbwaterere bokong’u oboronge bwane, tinkobotiga, enkoro yane tekongambia ase amatuko ande inde moyo.

English: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
Kiswahili: “Watesi wangu wawe kama waovu, nao adui zangu wawe kama wasio haki!
Ekegusii: Tiga omobisa one abarwe buna omokori amabe, na oyore mamincha yane buna oyotari omonyaboronge.

English: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mtu asiyemcha Mungu analo tegemeo gani anapokatiliwa mbali, Mungu anapouondoa uhai wake?
Ekegusii: Ngosemeria ki omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae abwate, ekero arakwe, ekero Nyasae aramoure obogima bwaye?.

English: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
Kiswahili: Je, Mungu husikiliza kilio chake, shida zimjiapo?
Ekegusii: Inee, ekero emechando eramochere Nyasae, namoigwe gose?

English: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
Kiswahili: Je, anaweza kumfurahia Mwenyezi? Je, atamwita Mungu nyakati zote?
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nagokigwe ase Omobui? Nabe okorangeria Nyasae ase chingaki chionsi?

English: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
Kiswahili: “Nitawafundisha juu ya uweza wa Mungu; njia za Mwenyezi sitazificha.
Ekegusii: Nimborokererie igoro y’okobua kwa Nyasae; amang’ana onsi igoro y’Omonguru tinkoyabisa.

English: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
Kiswahili: Ninyi nyote mmeona hili wenyewe. Ni ya nini basi mazungumzo haya yasiyo na maana?
Ekegusii: Rora, inwe mwensi mweroreire ayio; bono, nase ki rende mogokwana amang’ana abosa?

English: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo fungu ambalo Mungu humpa mtu mwovu, urithi ule mtu mdhalimu anapokea kutoka kwa Mwenyezi:
Ekegusii: Ekio nakio egetari Nyasae akoa omokori amabe, na omwando Omobui akoa abwo bagochanda abanto.

English: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
Kiswahili: Hata kama watoto wake watakuwa wengi kiasi gani, fungu lao ni kuuawa kwa upanga; wazao wake hawatakuwa kamwe na chakula cha kuwatosha.
Ekegusii: Abana b’omokori amabe nabaisa komentekana, nigo bareo ase ogocha goitwa n’omoro, abanto b’ororeria rwaye tibakonyora endagera eisaine.

English: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.
Kiswahili: Tauni itawazika wale watakaonusurika miongoni mwao, nao wajane wao hawatawaombolezea.
Ekegusii: Abatigari baye nigo oborwaire borabaite, na abakungu baratigwe bare ababoraka, tibakonyara kobareera.

English: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
Kiswahili: Ajapokusanya fedha nyingi kama mavumbi, na mavazi kama malundo ya udongo wa mfinyanzi,
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio naisa gosangereria chifeta chinyinge buna orotu naende atumbe chianga chibe chinyinge mono;

English: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
Kiswahili: yale yote mtu mwovu aliyojiwekea akiba, mwenye haki atayavaa, naye asiye na hatia ataigawanya fedha yake.
Ekegusii: nonya ochitumbire igo, nomonto omooronge orachibeeke, na abatari na komocha baatanane chifeta chiaye.

English: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
Kiswahili: Nyumba aijengayo ni kama utando wa buibui, kama kibanda alichotengeneza mlinzi.
Ekegusii: Enyomba omonto oyio araagache nigo erabe buna ey’oronyambobe, na buna ekegutu omorendi akoagacha.

English: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
Kiswahili: Yeye hulala akiwa tajiri, lakini ndiyo mara ya mwisho; afunguapo macho yake, yote yametoweka.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenda korara ore omonda, korende takoba bo rinde; ekero akoramokia amaiso kabokire anyore obotenenku bwaye bwasirire.

English: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
Kiswahili: Vitisho humjia kama mafuriko; dhoruba humkumba ghafula usiku.
Ekegusii: Obwoba obonene bonga buna eooro nigo bokomocheera; erio ekembugu‐mbugu kiamocheera botuko kiamoira.

English: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
Kiswahili: Upepo mkali wa mashariki humchukua, naye hutoweka; humzoa kutoka mahali pake.
Ekegusii: Omwaga okorwa moocha nigo okomoirurukia; omorusia aase aye, omosiria kegima.

English: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
Kiswahili: Humvurumisha bila huruma, huku akikimbia kasi kukwepa nguvu zake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akomoruta emegwe atari namaabera, nere otama bokong’u korua ase okoboko kwaye.

English: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
Kiswahili: Upepo humpigia makofi kwa dharau, na kumfukuza atoke mahali pake.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagoaka chinkobi igoro yaye, bamoseria neriogi ri’okomwogerera, orua aase aye.

English: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
Kiswahili: “Kuna machimbo ya fedha, na mahali dhahabu isafishwapo.
Ekegusii: “Ekeene, ribwago ase chifeta chigokunywa korwa ndire, na aase abanto bagosiberia chitaabu nare.

English: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
Kiswahili: Chuma hupatikana ardhini, nayo shaba huyeyushwa kutoka mawe ya madini.
Ekegusii: Ebioma nigo bigokunywa korwa riroba inse, ne chitaai nigo chikonyorwa ase amagena ’ebitare anyititorwa.

English: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
Kiswahili: Mwanadamu hukomesha giza; huyatafuta hadi sehemu iliyo mbali, kwa ajili ya kuchimbua mawe yenye madini katika giza jeusi sana.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagotongia chitaaya ime aaria, basiria omosunte; erio baba bakoriga‐rigia amagena ase ebinunchi bire ase omosunte ekerima.

English: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
Kiswahili: Huchimba shimo jembamba mbali na makao ya watu, mahali paliposahaulika na nyayo za wanadamu; mbali na wanadamu huningʼinia na kupembea kwa kamba.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagokunya chingoro chintambe gochia inse. Abwo nigo bakoba bebirwe nabaanto bagotaara igoro ye riroba, nigo bagotirimbokigwa basung’unaine bairwa aare korwa ase abanto.

English: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
Kiswahili: Ardhi, ambako chakula hutoka, chini hugeuzwa kwa moto;
Ekegusii: Ase riroba igoro nao endagera ekwama ime y’ense inse aroro aonchoranwa aba buna omorero ogosamba oonchorana.

English: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
Kiswahili: yakuti samawi hutoka katika miamba yake, nalo vumbi lake lina vipande vya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo nao are amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, amo namagena e chitaabu.

English: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
Kiswahili: Hakuna ndege awindaye aijuaye njia ile iliyofichika, wala hakuna jicho la mwewe lililoiona.
Ekegusii: Enchera ekogenda aase agwo enyoni ende yonsi egotwara orotwari teyemanyeti, gose ekebaki tikiana koyerora.

English: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
Kiswahili: Wanyama wa porini wanaotamba hawajawahi kupakanyaga, wala simba azungukaye huko.
Ekegusii: Eng’iti y’orosana eng’enenu tiyana koyetacha, gose endo tiyana goetera aroro.

English: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
Kiswahili: Mikono ya mwanadamu hushambulia miamba migumu sana, na kuiacha wazi mizizi ya milima.
Ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto nigo agokunya egetare ekiomo pa, erio osensema ebitunwa korwa inse obionchorana.

English: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
Kiswahili: Hutoboa shimo refu la kupenya chini kwa chini kwenye miamba; macho yake huona hazina zake zote.
Ekegusii: Nigo akorema emetaro ime ase ebitare, na amaiso aye arora kera egento kie rigori rinene.

English: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
Kiswahili: Hutafuta vyanzo vya mito na kuvileta vitu vilivyofichika katika nuru.
Ekegusii: Nigo akogita chindooche, otanga amaache tagoeta, erio egento kebisekanete ime, okerenta aase aarabu.

English: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
Kiswahili: “Lakini hekima inaweza kupatikana wapi? Ufahamu unakaa wapi?
Ekegusii: Korende ng’ai obong’aini boranyorekane? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?

English: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.
Kiswahili: Mwanadamu hatambui thamani yake; haiwezi kupatikana katika nchi ya walio hai.
Ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto tamanyeti rigori ri’obong’aini; borobwo tibori konyorekana ase ense emenyire nabare moyo.

English: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
Kiswahili: Kilindi husema, ‘Haiko ndani yangu’; bahari nayo husema, ‘Haiko pamoja nami.’
Ekegusii: Chindiba nigo chigokana chiateeba: Tibori ase ’nde aa, na enyancha nigo egoteeba: Tibori aiga ase ’nde.

English: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
Kiswahili: Haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu safi kuliko zote, wala thamani yake haiwezi kupimwa kwa fedha.
Ekegusii: Tibokogorwa chitaabu, gose chifeta tichikorengwa koba rigori riaye.

English: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
Kiswahili: Haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu ya Ofiri, kwa shohamu ya thamani kubwa au yakuti samawi ya thamani kubwa.
Ekegusii: Tibokoreng’anigwa ne chitaabu chikorwa Ofiri, gose namagena e rigori rinene akorokwa oiniki na safiro.

English: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
Kiswahili: Dhahabu wala mawe maangavu haviwezi kulinganishwa nayo, wala haiwezi hubadilishwa na vito vya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Chitaabu na ebirore ebiya tibikoreng’anigwa naborobwo, gose tibokoonchorerigwa n’ebinto bi’ogwechabera, biroisirie korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.

English: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
Kiswahili: Marijani na yaspi hazistahili kutajwa; thamani ya hekima ni zaidi ya akiki nyekundu.
Ekegusii: Amakorongote na ebirore bichenire tibigwatorwa. Rigori ri’obong’aini nigo rire rinene kobua eri’amagena erigori rinene akomeka‐meka.

English: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.
Kiswahili: Yakuti manjano ipatikanayo Kushi haiwezi kulinganishwa nayo, wala haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Topasio, rigena rie rigori rinene rikorwa Ethiopia, tirikoboreng’anigwa, gose tibokoreng’anigwa netaabu echenire.

English: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
Kiswahili: “Ni wapi basi hekima itokako? Ufahamu hukaa wapi?
Ekegusii: “Bono rende, obong’aini ng’ai bokorwa? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?

English: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
Kiswahili: Imefichika machoni pa kila kitu kilicho hai, imesitiriwa hata kwa ndege wa angani.
Ekegusii: Nigo bobisire korwa ase amaiso ’ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo; ee, nigo botubire chinyoni tichiborora.

English: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
Kiswahili: Uharibifu na Mauti husema, ‘Ni uvumi wake tu uliotufikia masikioni mwetu.’
Ekegusii: Aase ay’obosareku na amakweri nigo bigoteeba: Intwe twaigure chinkuma chiaye.

English: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
Kiswahili: Mungu anaifahamu njia ya kuiendea hekima na ndiye peke yake anayefahamu inakokaa,
Ekegusii: “Nyasae bweka namanyete enchera y’obong’aini, namanyete aase aye.

English: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
Kiswahili: kwa maana yeye huitazama miisho ya dunia na huona kila kitu chini ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arigereretie goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense, aroche kera egento kere inse y’erioba.

English: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
Kiswahili: Alipofanyiza nguvu za upepo na kuyapima maji,
Ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae arengete chinguru chi’omwaga, na akarenga obonge bw’amaache,

English: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
Kiswahili: alipofanya maagizo kwa ajili ya mvua na njia kwa ajili ya umeme wa radi,
Ekegusii: ekero abegete ogochika ase embura, na akaroisia enchera y’okomesa gw’enkoba,

English: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
Kiswahili: ndipo alipoitazama hekima na kuikadiria thamani yake, akaithibitisha na kuihakikisha.
Ekegusii: nario aroche obong’aini naende akaboraria; akaboikerania na koboenekia ase abanto.

English: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
Kiswahili: Naye Mungu akamwambia mwanadamu, ‘Kumcha Bwana: hiyo ndiyo hekima, nako kujitenga na uovu ndio ufahamu.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Erio Nyasae agateebia Mwanyabaanto: Naama! Okomoiroka Omonene, okwo nakwo obong’aini; na ogweatanana korwa ase ebibe, okwo nakwo okomanya.”

English: Job again took up his parable, and said,
Kiswahili: Ayubu akaendelea na hoja yake, akasema:
Ekegusii: Erio Ayubu agachaaka gokwana naende.

English: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
Kiswahili: “Tazama jinsi ninavyoitamani miezi iliyopita, zile siku ambazo Mungu alikuwa akinilinda,
Ekegusii: Onye ndiria obogima bwane bware koba buna bwarenge ase amatuko a kare, amatuko aria Nyasae andendete!

English: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
Kiswahili: wakati taa yake iliniangazia kichwani changu, na kwa mwanga wake Mungu nikapita katikati ya giza!
Ekegusii: Engaki eria etaya yaye yarenge komorekera omotwe one, na ase oborabu bwaye nkaba ngotaara ase omosunte.

English: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
Kiswahili: Natamani siku zile nilizokuwa katika ustawi wangu, wakati urafiki wa Mungu wa ndani ulipoibariki nyumba yangu,
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria nakinete inde ne chinguru, na obosani bwa Nyasae bwagendererete kobeera ase obomenyo bwane.

English: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
Kiswahili: wakati Mwenyezi alikuwa pamoja nami, nao watoto wangu walikuwa wamenizunguka,
Ekegusii: Engaki eria Omonguru nigo arenge amo nainche, na abana baane nigo bang’etanaine;

English: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
Kiswahili: wakati njia yangu ilikuwa imenyweshewa siagi, nao mwamba ukanimiminia vijito vya mafuta ya zeituni.
Ekegusii: nigo narenge gwesibia amagoro aane namabeere, emezeituni ekamera ase egetare, nkanyora chindooche chi’amaguta ’amazeituni.

English: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
Kiswahili: “Wakati nilipokwenda kwenye lango la mji na kuketi katika kiwanja,
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge kogenda ase egeita ki’omochie, goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane agwo ase ekeraario,

English: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
Kiswahili: vijana waliniona wakakaa kando, nao wazee walioketi wakasimama;
Ekegusii: abasae abaare kondora nigo barenge kogobera, na abanto abagotu batenena konyorokia amasikani.

English: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
Kiswahili: wakuu wakaacha kuzungumza na kuziba vinywa vyao kwa mikono yao;
Ekegusii: Abagaambi b’abaanto nigo baare gokira tibagokwana, batuba emenwa yabo namaboko.

English: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
Kiswahili: wenye vyeo wakanyamazishwa, nazo ndimi zao zikagandamana na makaakaa ya vinywa vyao.
Ekegusii: Amariogi ’abagaambi nigo arenge gokea, chimeme chiabo chiabwatana namang’ang’ura abo.

English: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,
Kiswahili: Yeyote aliyenisikia alinena mema juu yangu, nao walioniona walinisifu,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto barenge konyigwa, nigo barenge kondoka oyosesenirie, ekero baare kondora, baba birori ase ’nde,

English: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
Kiswahili: kwa sababu nilimwokoa maskini aliyeomba msaada, naye yatima aliyekuwa hana wa kumsaidia.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabeete ngotooria abataka abwo barenge korera, ne chintakana chitabwate onde ogochikonya.

English: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
Kiswahili: Mtu aliyekuwa karibu kufa alinibariki, nami niliufanya moyo wa mjane kuimba.
Ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa kw’omonto konya obeire ang’e gosira nigo gwanchicherete, nkagera ababoraka bagateera nechinkoro chire nomogooko.

English: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
Kiswahili: Niliivaa haki kama vazi langu; uadilifu ulikuwa joho langu na kilemba changu.
Ekegusii: Nigo neboyetie oboronge, naborobwo bogantuba; ekeene kiane nigo kiarenge buna omwambaro na ekegogwa.

English: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
Kiswahili: Nilikuwa macho ya kipofu na miguu kwa kiwete.
Ekegusii: Ninche narenge eriso ase emeuko, na okogoro ase ebirema.

English: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.
Kiswahili: Nilikuwa baba kwa mhitaji; nilimtetea mgeni.
Ekegusii: Ninche narenge ise bw’abataka: na omonto ochandegete ntamanyete, nigo namwechanderete.

English: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
Kiswahili: Niliyavunja meno makali ya waovu, na kuwapokonya wahanga kwenye meno yao.
Ekegusii: Nigo nabunete chinsea chi’abatari abanyaboronge, ngatooria korwa ase emenwa yabo abwo konya babwatirwe.

English: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.
Kiswahili: “Nikafikiri, ‘Nitafia katika nyumba yangu mwenyewe, nazo siku zangu zitakuwa nyingi kama chembechembe za mchanga.
Ekegusii: Erio nkaba nkorengereria ng’a amatuko aane nigo arabe amange buna omokenye, erio ngokwa imbe ase egeswa kiane.

English: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
Kiswahili: Mizizi yangu itafika mpaka kwenye maji, nao umande utakaa juu ya matawi yangu usiku kucha.
Ekegusii: Nigo narenge buna omote emeri yaye ekoranda yaika ase chindooche; chinsagia chiane chikagenderera gotoora riime ase obotuko bwonsi;

English: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
Kiswahili: Utukufu wangu utabakia kuwa mpya ndani yangu, upinde wangu daima utaendelea kuwa mpya mkononi mwangu.’
Ekegusii: obonene bwane nigo bwarenge kona‐koba oboyia ase ’nde, na obota bwane bokona‐konyora chinguru chinyia ase amaboko aane.

English: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
Kiswahili: “Watu walinisikiliza kwa tumaini, wakingojea ushauri wangu kwa utulivu.
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge korua ogosemia, abanto nigo barenge gontegerera, bakira‐kiri.

English: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mimi kuzungumza, hawakusema zaidi; maneno yangu yaliingia masikioni mwao kwa makini.
Ekegusii: Ekero nakoorire gokwana, monto onde tarenge komenta ing’ana rinde, ekiagera amang’ana aane nigo arenge kobagwera buna amatoima ’embura.

English: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
Kiswahili: Waliningojea kama manyunyu ya mvua na kuyapokea maneno yangu kama ardhi inyonyavyo mvua ya vuli.
Ekegusii: Nigo barenge koba baganyete buna embura ekoganywa; bakaba bagwasamia emenwa yabo buna embura y’okwamia endagera egwasamerwa.

English: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
Kiswahili: Walipokata tamaa niliwaonyesha uso wa furaha; nuru ya uso wangu ilikuwa ya thamani kwao.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya berusirie moyo nigo narenge kobasekera; obwasioku bw’obosio bwane tibabosieereretie.

English: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
Kiswahili: Niliwachagulia njia na kukaa kama mkuu wao; niliishi kama mfalme katikati ya majeshi yake; nikawa kama yeye anayewafariji waombolezaji.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nachorete enchera bagwenerete kobwatia, naende nkabeera egati yabo buna omogambi; nigo namenyete ase bare buna omorwoti akomenya nabarwani baye b’esegi, naende buna omonto okoremia baria bakorera.

English: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
Kiswahili: “Lakini sasa watu wadogo kwa umri kuniliko wananidhihaki, watu ambao baba zao ningekataa kwa dharau kuwaweka pamoja na mbwa wangu wa kulinda kondoo.
Ekegusii: Korende bono abanto bare abake ase ’nde, nigo bagonsekerera, abwo abaise babo batagwenereti kende, anga ntababegete nonya nase egati ye chisese chikorenda amaicho aane.

English: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
Kiswahili: Nguvu za mikono yao zingekuwa na faida gani kwangu, kwa kuwa nguvu zao zilikuwa zimewaishia?
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo chinguru chiabo chiaerire ase obogotu, ngokonywa ki ndanyore korwa ase amaboko abo?

English: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa wamekonda kutokana na kupungukiwa na kwa njaa, walizurura usiku katika nchi kame iliyo ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’okoremerwa na enchara babeire ebigonkobe, nigo bakona‐kogokona namaino abo riroba eriomo pa, erio riasaregete.

English: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.
Kiswahili: Katika vichaka walikusanya mimea ya chumvi, nacho chakula chao kilikuwa mizizi ya mti wa mfagio.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakona‐gosangereria ebimeri bie chinsana, na baremora emeri y’emete enga buna ebisanka.

English: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,
Kiswahili: Walifukuzwa mbali na watu wao, wakipigiwa kelele kama wevi.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagoserigwa korwa ase egati y’abanto, baakerwa amariogi korwa magega na kwogererwa buna abaibi.

English: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
Kiswahili: Walilazimika kuishi katika mikondo ya vijito vilivyokauka, kwenye majabali na mahandaki.
Ekegusii: Ase igo bagenda komenya ase amakuruma are ase amagoko, na ase chingoro inse y’ense, na ase ebitare.

English: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.
Kiswahili: Kwenye vichaka walilia kama punda, na walijisongasonga pamoja kwenye vichaka.
Ekegusii: Ime ase ebitutu nigo bakwogererana, inse y’amase akorura nao bagosangererekana amo.

English: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
Kiswahili: Wao ni watoto wa wapumbavu wenye asili ya ubaya, waliofukuzwa watoke katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nabana b’abaanto abariri na ab’abakayayu; nigo baseretigwe nemecharichi barue ase ense.

English: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
Kiswahili: “Nao sasa wana wao wananidhihaki katika nyimbo; nimekuwa kitu cha dhihaka kwao.
Ekegusii: Na bono inche nabeire engero egoterwa ase bare, ee, nabeire ase bare ring’ana rikorabaarwa.

English: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
Kiswahili: Wananichukia sana na kujitenga nami, wala hawasiti kunitemea mate usoni.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bangechete, bantamire; tibetangeti gontwera amate obosio bwane.

English: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
Kiswahili: Sasa kwa kuwa Mungu ameilegeza kamba ya upinde wangu na kunitesa, wamekuwa huru kunitendea waonavyo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ong’urire chinguru, naende onkorire koba omoitongo, na abanto abwo babeire abaremu ase ogonkorera bobe.

English: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.
Kiswahili: Kuume kwangu kundi linashambulia; wao huitegea miguu yangu tanzi, na kunizingira.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ki’abanto abasaria nigo bagontubokera korwa ensemo yane ya borio, erio baminyokia gonseria; nigo bagokora emeroberio emenge y’ogonsiria.

English: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.
Kiswahili: Huizuia njia yangu, nao hufanikiwa katika kuniletea maafa, nami sina yeyote wa kunisaidia.
Ekegusii: Basaririe enchera yane ngoetera; abwo batabwate ogosemia konde abanyene, nigo bagokonya abande ase ogonsiria.

English: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.
Kiswahili: Wananijia kama watu wapitao katika ufa mpana; katikati ya magofu huja na kunishambulia.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoeta aase omogwa omogare banchichera ne chinguru, erio bang’umokera goetera ase omogwa oyio baabagoire.

English: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
Kiswahili: Vitisho vimenifunika; heshima yangu imetoweshwa kama kwa upepo, salama yangu imetoweka kama wingu.
Ekegusii: Obwoba obonene bwanchicheire; ogosikwa kwane gwasirigwe buna omwaga ogosiria, na obotenenku bwane bwasirire pi buna amare agosira.

English: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.
Kiswahili: “Sasa maisha yangu yamefikia mwisho; siku za mateso zimenikamata.
Ekegusii: Na bono omoyo one oberire ime yane; amatuko ’emechando ambwatereire bokong’u.

English: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
Kiswahili: Usiku mifupa yangu inachoma; maumivu yanayonitafuna hayatulii kamwe.
Ekegusii: Amauga omobere one nigo akonyatia botuko bokia, na obororo bokondia tibori gokenda.

English: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
Kiswahili: Kwa uwezo wake mkuu Mungu huwa kwangu kama nguo; hushikamana nami kama ukosi wa vazi langu.
Ekegusii: Oborwaire bwane bwabeire ne chinguru bwaonchoire risankwa ri’omobere one, bono nigo ring’usererete buna rigoti ri’eanga yane.

English: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
Kiswahili: Yeye amenitupa kwenye matope, nami nimekuwa kama mavumbi na majivu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ontugutire ase etintira ime, nabeire buna orotu ne ribu.

English: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana, ninakulilia wewe lakini hunijibu; ninasimama, nawe unanitazama tu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkorera asore, korende aye tori kong’iraneria; nigo nteneine asore, korende aye nigo onsonchete rioka.

English: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
Kiswahili: Wewe unanigeukia bila huruma; unanishambulia kwa nguvu za mkono wako.
Ekegusii: Aye kwabeire omotindi ase ’nde; nigo okondwania nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru.

English: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
Kiswahili: Unaninyakua na kunipeperusha kwa upepo; umenirusha huku na huko kwenye dhoruba kali.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo onyimokereretie igoro kwambekire ase omwaga na kondiinia igoro yaye. Aye nigo okona‐konduchania gochia aaria na aaria, naba bosa ase omwaga omotindi.

English: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.
Kiswahili: Ninajua utanileta mpaka kifoni, mahali ambapo wenye uhai wote wamewekewa.
Ekegusii: Ee, namanyire ng’a nong’ire aase abakuure, ase enyomba eria echikeire abare moyo bonsi.

English: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
Kiswahili: “Hakika hakuna yeyote amshambuliaye mhitaji, anapoomba msaada katika shida yake.
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto karagwe takorambora okoboko kwaye, na ase emechando yaye arere akonywe?

English: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
Kiswahili: Je, sikulia kwa ajili ya wale waliokuwa katika taabu? Je, nafsi yangu haikusononeka kwa ajili ya maskini?
Ekegusii: Inee! Tinarerete ase engencho y’abwo barenge ase emechando? Omoyo one tochandekerete abataka?

English: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
Kiswahili: Lakini nilipotazamia mema, mabaya yalinijia; nilipotafuta nuru, ndipo giza lilipokuja.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero nasemeretie konyora amaya, amabe agacha, na ekero nabeete nsemeretie konyora oborabu, omosunte ogaacha.

English: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
Kiswahili: Kusukwasukwa ndani yangu kamwe hakutulii; siku za mateso zinanikabili.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo ere nemechando mono, teri n’obotoereru, amatuko ’emechando anchicheire.

English: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
Kiswahili: Ninazunguka nikiwa nimeungua, lakini si kwa jua; ninasimama katika kusanyiko nikiomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkona‐koong’anya inde nemechando ntarochi omobaso; nigo ngotenena ase omosangererekano, narera ng’a nkonywe.

English: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa ndugu wa mbweha, rafiki wa mabundi.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire oyomwabo chisese chi’orosana, na omogisangio bwe chisagero.

English: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
Kiswahili: Ngozi yangu imekuwa nyeusi nayo inachunika; mifupa yangu inaungua kwa homa.
Ekegusii: Risankwa riane riaonchokire riamwamire ti, na nigo rikona‐kobutoka, na amauga aane nigo akoyia buna omorero.

English: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
Kiswahili: Kinubi changu kimegeuka kuwa maombolezo, nayo filimbi yangu imekuwa sauti ya kilio.
Ekegusii: Obokano bwane bw’ebirigisa nigo bokominwa bwaba obw’ebirero, na ekeroria kiane kiaonchoirwe kobugigwa ase abanto bakorera.

English: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
Kiswahili: “Nimefanya agano na macho yangu yasimtazame msichana kwa kumtamani.
Ekegusii: Inche nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namaiso aane ng’a tinkorigereria omoiseke omwekungi ase okomogania.

English: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa fungu la mwanadamu ni gani kutoka kwa Mungu juu, urithi wake kutoka kwa Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Aliye juu?
Ekegusii: Naki rende egetari kiane gekorwa ase Nyasae o igoro kerabe? Na omwando one okorwa ase Omobui ore igoro, naki orabe?

English: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
Kiswahili: Je, si uharibifu kwa watu waovu, maangamizi kwa wale watendao mabaya?
Ekegusii: Inee! Emechando teri konyora abatari abanyaboronge, na ogosirigwa gwachera abagokora ebibe?

English: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
Kiswahili: Je, yeye hazioni njia zangu na kuihesabu kila hatua yangu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae tarochi chinchera chiane chionsi na kobara amatambokero aane onsi?

English: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
Kiswahili: “Kama nimeishi katika uongo au mguu wangu umekimbilia udanganyifu,
Ekegusii: Inee! Nabeire ngotaara ase chinchera chi’obong’ainereria, gose amagoro aane naminyokeire ay’oborimo?

English: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);
Kiswahili: Mungu na anipime katika mizani za uaminifu, naye atajua kwamba sina hatia:
Ekegusii: Tiga ndengwe ase ekerengo ekeronge, na Nyasae amanye oboikeranu bwane.

English: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,
Kiswahili: kama hatua zangu zimepotoka kutoka kwenye njia, kama moyo wangu umeongozwa na macho yangu, au kama mikono yangu imetiwa unajisi,
Ekegusii: Onye nagobeire korwa ase enchera, na enkoro yane yabeire ekobwatia okogania kw’amaiso aane, na onye komocha konde kwabwatereire amaboko aane,

English: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
Kiswahili: basi wengine na wale nilichokipanda, nayo yale yote niliyootesha na yangʼolewe.
Ekegusii: rirorio inche nsimeke endagera, na omonto omoao ayeire, na kende gionsi kiane keramere gesimorwe.

English: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
Kiswahili: “Kama moyo wangu umeshawishiwa na mwanamke, au kama nimevizia mlangoni mwa jirani yangu,
Ekegusii: Onye omoyo one obeire okoebererigwa na gwancha omokungu omoao, na igo nabeire nkoboera omonto onde ase egesieri kiaye imosirie,

English: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.
Kiswahili: basi mke wangu na asage nafaka ya mwanaume mwingine, nao wanaume wengine walale naye.
Ekegusii: rirorio tiga omokungu one abe ogoseera omonto omoao obosie, naende abasacha bande babe bakoba nere.

English: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hilo lingekuwa aibu, naam, dhambi ya kuhukumiwa.
Ekegusii: Okwo nigo kware koba ogosaria okobe mono goetania, na kware koegwa egesusuro nabagaambi ebiina bonsi.

English: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
Kiswahili: Ni moto uwakao kwa Uharibifu; ungekuwa umengʼoa mavuno yangu.
Ekegusii: Boigo nigo kware koba omorero ogosamba gochia aase ay’ogosiria na koria ebinto biane bionsi kobikoora.

English: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,
Kiswahili: “Kama ningewanyima haki watumishi wangu wanaume au vijakazi wangu, walipokuwa na manungʼuniko dhidi yangu,
Ekegusii: Inse kwanga koroisia amang’ana omosomba one, omosacha gose omokungu, ekero baremurunganie igoro yane,

English: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?
Kiswahili: nitafanya nini Mungu atakaponikabili? Nitamjibu nini nitakapoitwa kutoa hesabu?
Ekegusii: ninki ndakore ekero Nyasae aranyimokere? Ninki ndamoiranerie ekero arabe okorua egesusuro ki’ebibe biane?

English: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?
Kiswahili: Je, yeye aliyeniumba tumboni mwa mama yangu, si ndiye aliwaumba? Je, si ni yeye huyo mmoja aliyetuumba sote ndani ya mama zetu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Oyio ontongete ase enda ya baba, tari ere otongete oyio boigo? Tari ere oyomo otobombete ase enda ime?

English: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa nimewanyima maskini haja zao, au kuyaacha macho ya wajane yadhoofike,
Ekegusii: Inche tinarinete omotaka egento aganetie, gose tinatigete omoboraka kwerusia moyo;

English: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it
Kiswahili: kama nimekula chakula changu mwenyewe, bila kuwashirikisha yatima;
Ekegusii: tinarenge koria endagera yane inche bweka, nigo naete nentakana nero, ekayeria.

English: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);
Kiswahili: lakini tangu ujana wangu nimemlea yatima kama ambavyo baba angefanya, nami tangu kuzaliwa kwangu nimewaongoza wajane:
Ekegusii: Oyio inche nabeete ise korwa obosae bwaye, na korwa okoiborwa kwaye nkaba nkomorera na komoraa.

English: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;
Kiswahili: kama nilimwona yeyote akiteseka kwa kukosa nguo, au mtu mhitaji asiye na mavazi
Ekegusii: Inee! Monto onde nare ochandegete ase okoborwa chianga, gose omotaka otabwati ekiebisio, ntakonyete?

English: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
Kiswahili: ambaye wala moyo wake haukunibariki kwa kumpatia joto kwa mavazi ya manyoya ya kondoo zangu,
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bansesenetie, ekiagera nabaete chingobo chi’amarionya e ching’ondi chikorwa ase amaicho aane.

English: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;
Kiswahili: na kama nimeinua mkono wangu dhidi ya yatima, nikijua kuwa nina ushawishi mahakamani,
Ekegusii: Onye nakorerete entakana bobe ekiagera namanyete ng’a ekegambero agwo ase egeita ngenkonye,

English: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
Kiswahili: basi mkono wangu na unyofoke toka begani mwangu, nao na uvunjike kutoka kiungio chake.
Ekegusii: rirorio tiga amareko aane ongoke agwe inse, ne chinengo chi’amaboko aane chisomoke.

English: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa niliogopa uharibifu kutoka kwa Mungu, nami kwa kuuogopa utukufu wake sikuweza kufanya mambo kama hayo.
Ekegusii: Nigo nare gocha kwoboigwa nemechando korwa ase Nyasae; na tinare konyara gotenena bosio bw’obonene bwaye.

English: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
Kiswahili: “Kama nimeweka tumaini langu kwenye dhahabu, au kuiambia dhahabu safi, ‘Wewe ndiwe salama yangu,’
Ekegusii: Tinasemeretie etaabu, nonya netaabu echenire;

English: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
Kiswahili: kama nimefurahia wingi wa utajiri wangu, ustawi ambao mikono yangu ilikuwa imepata,
Ekegusii: tinagokerete gose gochengera obotenenku bwane obonge, gose ebinto nenyorerete namaboko aane.

English: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,
Kiswahili: kama nimelitazama jua katika kungʼaa kwake au mwezi ukienda kwa fahari yake,
Ekegusii: Tinarigereretie erioba ekero riabarete, gose omotienyi ekero omesete,

English: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;
Kiswahili: hivyo moyo wangu kushawishiwa kwa siri, au kubusu mkono wangu kwa kuviheshimu,
Ekegusii: goika enkoro yane ekaebererigwa bobisi ase okobisasiima, gose tinanyunyuntete okoboko kwane ase okobisika.

English: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.
Kiswahili: basi hiyo pia ingekuwa dhambi ya kuhukumiwa, kwa kuwa ningekuwa si mwaminifu kwa Mungu aishiye juu sana.
Ekegusii: Onye nakorete ayio nigo nare koegwa egesusuro nabagaambi ebiina, ekiagera ayio nokomokana Nyasae ore igoro.

English: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him
Kiswahili: “Kama nimeshangilia msiba wa adui yangu, au kutazama kwa furaha taabu iliyomjia,
Ekegusii: Inee! Nagokerete ogosirigwa kw’omobisa one? Gose netogetie ekero amabe amocherete?

English: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
Kiswahili: lakini sikuruhusu kinywa changu kufanya dhambi kwa kuomba laana dhidi ya maisha yake;
Ekegusii: Yaya, tinatigete omonwa one okore ebibe ase okomoragereria na komoganeria amakweri.

English: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
Kiswahili: kama watu wa nyumbani mwangu kamwe hawakusema, ‘Ni nani ambaye hajashibishwa na nyama ya Ayubu?’
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bamenyete aa bwone babeire birori ng’a kera omonto obeire oisanegete nendagera nkomoa.

English: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
Kiswahili: Lakini hakuna mgeni aliyelala njiani, kwa maana mlango wangu ulikuwa wazi kwa msafiri;
Ekegusii: Nigo narenge koigorera abaeti ebisieri biane basoa; gose motaari onde tabeete okorara isiko botuko.

English: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,
Kiswahili: kama nimeifunika dhambi yangu kama wanadamu wengine wafanyavyo, kwa kuficha hatia yangu moyoni mwangu,
Ekegusii: Tinatubete ogosaria kwane buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ere, gose ebibe biane ase egekuba kiane ime.

English: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ya kuogopa umati wa watu, na hivyo kuwa na hofu ya kudharauliwa na jamaa, nikanyamaza kimya nisitoke nje ya mlango:
Ekegusii: Tinairogete omoganda omonene bw’abaanto, gose kwoboa abaamate abwo barenge gonchaya, erinde imbe nkirete na kobeera nyomba ime.

English: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!
Kiswahili: (“Laiti kama angekuwepo mtu wa kunisikia! Tazama sasa ninatia sahihi kwenye utetezi wangu: Mwenyezi na anijibu; mshtaki wangu na aweke mashtaka yake kwenye maandishi.
Ekegusii: “Naki yare koba buya onye nanyora omonto okonyigwa. Inche nakoorire amang’ana aane! Oria Omonguru nang’iranerie! Ninganetie ndore amang’ana omobisa one andikerete ase okonyomania.

English: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.
Kiswahili: Hakika ningeyavaa begani mwangu, ningeyavaa kama taji.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, nigo nare koyabogoria igoro ase amareko aane; nanga nigo nayesiberania abe buna egutwa ase ’nde.

English: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.
Kiswahili: Ningempa hesabu ya kila hatua yangu, ningemwendea kama mwana wa mfalme.)
Ekegusii: Nanga namoteebia igoro y’orogendo rwane rwonsi; nigo nare komochiera inde buna omogambi.

English: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
Kiswahili: “Kama nchi yangu inalia dhidi yangu, na mifereji yake yote imelowana kwa machozi,
Ekegusii: “Inee! Oboremo bwane bwanakondeera? Gose emeng’ororia ye chintinde yana‐korererana?

English: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
Kiswahili: kama nimekula mazao yake bila malipo, au kuvunja mioyo ya wapangaji wake,
Ekegusii: Onye nabeire nkoria okwama kwaye ntari goakana na kogera abanyene bakwe,

English: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
Kiswahili: basi miiba na iote badala ya ngano, na magugu badala ya shayiri.” Mwisho wa maneno ya Ayubu.
Ekegusii: rirorio tiga amagwa amereo ribaga ri’engano, na amabanchore ribaga ri’esairi.” Amang’ana ’Ayubu aereire aa.

English: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
Kiswahili: Basi watu hawa watatu wakaacha kumjibu Ayubu, kwa kuwa alikuwa mwadilifu machoni pake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: 32:1—37:24. Bono ekiagera Ayubu arenge omonyaboronge ase amaiso aye ere omonyene, abanto baria batato bagatiga komoiraneria.

English: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
Kiswahili: Lakini Elihu mwana wa Barakeli, wa kabila la Buzi wa jamaa ya Ramu, akamkasirikia sana Ayubu, kwa sababu ya kujihesabia haki mwenyewe badala ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio Elihu akaba nendamwamu ase Ayubu, ekiagera ekorete omonyakeene kobua Nyasae. Elihu oyio nigo arenge mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, na oyo bw’eamate ya Ramu.

English: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
Kiswahili: Pia aliwakasirikia hao rafiki watatu wa Ayubu, kwa sababu hawakuweza kupata njia ya kuthibitisha ya kuwa hayo maneno ya Ayubu hayakuwa ya kweli, nao bado walikuwa wamemlaumu.
Ekegusii: Boigo akaba nendamwamu ase abasani baria batato b’Ayubu, ekiagera batanyorete amang’ana bakoiraneria, nonya bateebeete ng’a Ayubu nomomochi.

English: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.
Kiswahili: Basi Elihu alikuwa amesubiri kwanza waongee na Ayubu kwa sababu walikuwa na umri mkubwa kumliko yeye.
Ekegusii: Elihu akaba okoganya baria batato barakwana n’Ayubu, ekiagera ere arenge omoke ase emiaka.

English: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
Kiswahili: Lakini alipoona watu hao watatu hawakuwa na kitu zaidi cha kusema, hasira yake ikaamka.
Ekegusii: Na ekero aroche ng’a baria batato tibabwate ing’ana baare koiraneria, akaba nendamwamu.

English: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
Kiswahili: Basi Elihu mwana wa Barakeli wa kabila la Buzi akasema: “Mimi ni mdogo kwa umri, nanyi ni wazee; ndiyo sababu niliogopa, sikuthubutu kuwaambia kile ninachojua.
Ekegusii: Elihu mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, agateeba: Inche nigo inde omoke ase emiaka, korende inwe nabakoro more; ayio naro agerete nkaba nobwoba, ngakira‐kiri, na tinakwana ay’ebirengererio biane ase more.

English: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
Kiswahili: Nilifikiri, ‘Yafaa umri useme, nao wingi wa miaka ungefundisha hekima.’
Ekegusii: Korende ngateeba: Tiga abanto b’amatuko amange bakwane, abanyamiaka menge borokererie obong’aini.

English: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.
Kiswahili: Lakini ni Roho iliyoko ndani ya mwanadamu, pumzi ya Mwenyezi, ndiyo impayo yeye ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Korende omoika nore ime ase Mwanyabaanto, omoika oyio bw’Omonguru noro okobaa okomanya.

English: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
Kiswahili: Sio wazee peke yao walio na hekima, sio wenye umri mkubwa peke yao wanaofahamu lililo sawa.
Ekegusii: Bono tari ng’a nabaanto b’emiaka emenge bare abang’aini, gose tari ng’a nabagotu bamanyete ayare boronge.

English: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo nasema: Nisikilizeni mimi; mimi nami nitawaambia lile ninalojua.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkoboria, montegerere, erinde nkwane ayare ase ebirengererio biane.

English: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
Kiswahili: Nilingojea mlipokuwa mnaongea, nilizisikiliza hoja zenu; mlipokuwa mkitafuta maneno ya kusema,
Ekegusii: Naama! Nigo nategererete mono ekero mwarenge gokwana; nkaba ndemereretie koigwa chinkwana chiaino chi’obong’aini, ekero mwarenge koriga‐rigia ng’a mang’ana ki mwagwenerete gokwana.

English: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
Kiswahili: niliwasikiliza kwa makini. Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyethibitisha kwamba Ayubu amekosa; hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyeweza kujibu hoja zake.
Ekegusii: Ee, nigo nabategererete mono, korende onde tarenge ase more obuete Ayubu, gose onde tanyarete koiraneria amang’ana aye.

English: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’
Kiswahili: Msiseme, ‘Tumepata hekima; Mungu na amthibitishe kuwa mwongo, wala si mwanadamu.’
Ekegusii: Inwe erende mono, timobaisa goteeba: Intwe twanyorire obong’aini. Nyasae nere orabue Ayubu na amoiyerie, tari Mwanyabaanto.

English: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
Kiswahili: Lakini Ayubu hajayapanga maneno yake dhidi yangu, nami sitamjibu kwa kutumia hoja zenu.
Ekegusii: Ayubu takwanete nainche amang’ana ande ay’okweegerera, na inche tinkomoiraneria buna inwe.

English: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
Kiswahili: “Wametiwa hofu na hawana la zaidi la kusema; maneno yamewaishia.
Ekegusii: Bono batang’ang’ire, tibakonyara kong’iraneria nonya ng’ake; tibabwati ring’ana bagokwana.

English: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
Kiswahili: Je, ningoje sasa kwa sababu wamekuwa kimya, kwa vile sasa wanasimama bila kuwa na la kujibu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nainche nigo nkogenderera koganya, ekiagera tibari gokwana, na ekiagera bateneine agwo batari koiraneria?

English: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
Kiswahili: Mimi nami nitakuwa na la kusema; mimi nami nitasema lile nilijualo.
Ekegusii: Inche ngokwana inde ayane, erinde ng’orokie ayare ase ebirengererio biane.

English: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nimejawa na maneno, nayo Roho iliyomo ndani yangu yanisukuma;
Ekegusii: Inche nimbwate amang’ana amange nganetie gokwana, ekiagera omoika ore ime yane onsukirie.

English: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
Kiswahili: ndani yangu niko kama chupa iliyojazwa divai, kama kiriba kipya cha divai kilicho tayari kupasuka.
Ekegusii: Rora, enda yane nigo enga buna edivai ekunekire mono, buna ebirandi biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa amayia bire ang’e kworeka.

English: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima niseme ili niweze kutulia; ni lazima nifumbue midomo yangu nipate kujibu.
Ekegusii: Goika nkwane, erio nario ndanyore obotoereru; goika imaanore omonwa nkwane, ing’iranerie.

English: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
Kiswahili: Sitampendelea mtu yeyote, wala sitajipendekeza kwa mtu yeyote;
Ekegusii: Inche tinkonyara gwanchereria monto onde bwensi, gose gokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia.’

English: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa kama ningekuwa stadi wa kujipendekeza, Muumba wangu angeniondolea mbali kwa upesi.
Ekegusii: Inche timanyeti gokwana amang’ana ’okweansia, inse gokora bo, Omotongi one nigo aransirie bwango.

English: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
Kiswahili: “Lakini Ayubu, sasa, sikiliza maneno yangu; zingatia kila kitu nitakachosema.
Ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, bono inyigwe, ntegerera ase onsi aya ngokwana.

English: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
Kiswahili: Karibu nitafungua kinywa changu; maneno yangu yapo katika ncha ya ulimi wangu.
Ekegusii: Rora, bono namumoire omonwa one, na oromeme rwane rwachakire gokwana.

English: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
Kiswahili: Maneno yangu yanatoka katika moyo mnyofu; midomo yangu hunena kwa uaminifu yale niyajuayo.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aane nigo akoorokia oboronge bore ime ase enkoro yane, na ase omonwa one nigo ngokwana aya imanyete.

English: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
Kiswahili: Roho wa Mungu ameniumba; pumzi ya Mwenyezi hunipa uhai.
Ekegusii: Omoika o Nyasae noro ontongete, na omoika bw’obomoyo bw’Omonguru noro okong’a obogima.

English: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
Kiswahili: Unijibu basi, kama unaweza; jiandae kunikabili mimi.
Ekegusii: Bono ing’iranerie onye gokonyara; beka amang’ana ao ang’e, otenene bokong’u!

English: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni kama wewe mbele za Mungu; mimi pia nimetolewa kwenye udongo.
Ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo inde buna aye ase obosio bwa Nyasae; inche boigo nigo natongetwe korwa ase riroba.

English: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
Kiswahili: Huna sababu ya kuniogopa, wala mkono wangu haupaswi kukulemea.
Ekegusii: Rora, inche tindi kende ogwenerete konyoboa; gose tindi gochia koba buna egurube endito asore.

English: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
Kiswahili: “Lakini umesema nikiwa ninakusikia, nami nilisikia maneno yenyewe:
Ekegusii: “Ekeene, gwakwanire ase ntegererete, na inche naigure amang’ana ao.

English: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
Kiswahili: ‘Mimi ni safi na sina dhambi; mimi ni safi na sina hatia.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoteeba iga: Inche nigo nchenegete, tindi nogosaria konde, na bibe tibiri ime yane.

English: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
Kiswahili: Lakini bado Mungu amepata dosari kwangu, naye ananiona kama adui yake.
Ekegusii: Naama! Nyasae onyorire amasoero ase ’nde, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.

English: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
Kiswahili: Ananifunga miguu kwa pingu, tena anaziangalia njia zangu zote kwa karibu.’
Ekegusii: Osoirie amagoro aane ase rikorogoto, na nigo akoba ondigereretie ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.

English: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
Kiswahili: “Lakini mimi ninakuambia, katika jambo hili wewe una makosa, kwa maana Mungu ni mkuu kuliko mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: “Naama! Nigo ngokoiraneria ng’a ase amang’ana aya tokwaneti ekeene; Nyasae nigo are omonene goetania Mwanyabaanto.

English: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unamlalamikia kwamba yeye hamjibu mwanadamu?
Ekegusii: Nase ki okoamererania nere kogoteeba ng’a ere takoiraneria amang’ana aya nonya nerimo?

English: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu husema, wakati huu kwa njia moja, au wakati mwingine kwa njia nyingine, ingawa mwanadamu anaweza asielewe.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae nigo agokwana ase enchera eyemo, gose ibere; nonya nabo monto onde tari okomotegerera.

English: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,
Kiswahili: Mungu husema na mwanadamu katika ndoto, katika maono ya usiku, wakati usingizi mzito uwaangukiapo wanadamu wasinziapo vitandani mwao,
Ekegusii: Nigo agokwana ase chindoto na amaroro a botuko, na ekero abanto bararire chitoro chindito, na ekero basundokire ase amarere abo.

English: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
Kiswahili: anaweza akasemea masikioni mwao, na kuwatia hofu kwa maonyo,
Ekegusii: Erio agwo otinora amato abanto, na obarentera ogokuurera gw’okoondokia

English: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
Kiswahili: ili kumgeuza mtu kutoka kwenye kutenda mabaya na kumwepusha na kiburi,
Ekegusii: ng’a anyare koonchora omonto atige ogokora kwaye okobe, na atange oboenenu bw’omonto.

English: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
Kiswahili: kuiokoa nafsi yake na shimo, uhai wake usiangamizwe kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Nigo agotanga omonto tagenda ase oboina, naende orenda obogima bwaye tibosirigwa n’omoro.

English: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
Kiswahili: Mtu anaweza kutiwa adabu kwa maumivu kitandani mwake, kwa dhiki za mfululizo katika mifupa yake,
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo akonyora egesusuro gi’okomoorongeyia, ekero are nobororo ase oborere bwaye, na amauga aye agendererete komwatia.

English: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
Kiswahili: kiasi kwamba maisha yake yenyewe yanakataa chakula nayo nafsi yake ikakichukia kabisa hata chakula kizuri.
Ekegusii: Omoyo oye ogecha endagera, nonya endagera ere engiya mono.

English: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
Kiswahili: Nyama ya mwili wake huisha kwa kukonda, nayo mifupa yake ambayo mwanzoni ilikuwa imefichika, sasa inatokeza nje.
Ekegusii: Chinyama chi’omobere oye nigo chikoera, tichikororekana, na amauga aye atongonona.

English: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yake inakaribia kaburi, nao uhai wake karibu na wajumbe wa kifo.
Ekegusii: Ere omonyene nigo agosuka gochia ang’e noboina, na obogima bwaye gochia ase abagosiria obogima.

English: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,
Kiswahili: “Kama bado kuna malaika upande wake kama mtetezi, mmoja miongoni mwa elfu, wa kumwambia mwanadamu lililo jema kwake,
Ekegusii: “Onye omomalaika nkoba arenge asare, oyomo bwa baria chilifu bagokora okobwatania asare, erinde amworokie ayare ay’oboronge,

English: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
Kiswahili: kumwonea huruma na kusema, ‘Mwokoe asije akatumbukia shimoni; nimepata ukombozi kwa ajili yake’:
Ekegusii: erio amororere amaabera, ateebe: Tooria omonto oyo tabaisa gotirimboka gochia ase oboina, ekiagera inche namonyoreire embooria.

English: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
Kiswahili: ndipo nyama ya mwili wake hufanywa mpya kama ya mtoto; hurudishwa upya kama siku za ujana wake.
Ekegusii: Omobere oye oiranigwe obe buna oyo bw’obosae bwaye, naende aonchorwe abe buna ekero arenge ne chinguru.

English: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
Kiswahili: Humwomba Mungu, akapata kibali kwake, huuona uso wa Mungu na kushangilia kwa furaha; Mungu humrudisha katika hali yake ya uadilifu.
Ekegusii: Ekero arabe ogosaba Nyasae, nere namororere amaabera; omonto oyio nachiche ase obosio bwaye ore nomogooko, na Nyasae nairanie oboronge bw’omonto oyio.

English: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo huja mbele za watu na kusema, ‘Nilitenda dhambi na kupotosha kilichokuwa haki, lakini sikuadhibiwa kama nilivyostahili.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio natere ase amasio ’abaanto, ateebe: Nigo nakorete ebibe, nkaonchorana aya arenge amaronge, gose tinanyorete egesusuro buna nagwenerete.

English: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
Kiswahili: Alinikomboa nafsi yangu nisitumbukie shimoni, nami nitaishi ili kuufurahia mwanga.’
Ekegusii: Ere obooririe omoyo one togenda ase oboina, bono obogima bwane mborore oborabu.

English: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
