Kiswahili: “Mungu hufanya haya yote kwa mwanadamu; mara mbili hata mara tatu,
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana ayio onsi ase omonto ara kabere, gose ara gatato,

English: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
Kiswahili: ili aigeuze nafsi yake toka shimoni, ili nuru ya uzima imwangazie.
Ekegusii: erinde amoiranie korwa ase oboina, ng’a oyio anyare komorekerwa noborabu bw’obogima.

English: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
Kiswahili: “Ayubu, zingatia, nisikilize mimi; nyamaza, nami nitanena.
Ekegusii: “Aye Ayubu, ntegerera, okire‐kiri, inche nkwane.

English: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
Kiswahili: Kama unalo lolote la kusema, unijibu; sema, kwa maana ninataka uonekane huna hatia.
Ekegusii: Onye kobwate ing’ana rinde okong’iraneria, kwana, ekiagera nigo nganetie gokoa oboronge bwao.

English: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama huna la kusema, basi nisikilize mimi; nyamaza, nami nitakufundisha hekima.”
Ekegusii: Onye tobwati kende, kira‐kiri ontegerere, na inche ninkworokererie obong’aini.”

English: Moreover Elihu answered,
Kiswahili: Kisha Elihu akasema:
Ekegusii: Erio Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:

English: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
Kiswahili: “Sikieni maneno yangu, enyi watu wenye hekima; nisikilizeni mimi, ninyi watu wenye maarifa.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto abang’aini, igwa amang’ana aane! Inwe abamanyi chisemi, ntegerera!

English: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa sikio huyajaribu maneno kama vile ulimi uonjavyo chakula.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana amato akoigwa, nigo akoyateema, buna oromeme rokomena endagera.

English: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.
Kiswahili: Tujichagulie wenyewe yaliyo sawa, nasi tujifunze pamoja yaliyo mema.
Ekegusii: Tochore ayare amaronge; intwe amo toteeme komanya ayare amaronge.

English: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.
Kiswahili: “Ayubu anasema, ‘Mimi sina hatia, lakini Mungu ameninyima haki yangu.
Ekegusii: Ayubu nigo agoteeba: Inche nomonyene oboronge, korende Nyasae ong’urire oboronge bwane.

English: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
Kiswahili: Ingawa niko sawa, ninaonekana mwongo; nami ingawa sina kosa, kidonda changu hakiponi.’
Ekegusii: Nonya inde omonyene oboronge, nabarirwe ng’a nomonyaborimo inde; amaote aane takonyara kogwena, nonya gosaria konde tikori ime ase ’nde.

English: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
Kiswahili: Ni mtu gani aliye kama Ayubu, anywaye dharau kama maji?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Monto ki onga buna Ayubu, oyio okonywa ogochaywa, ogokomera buna amaache?

English: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
Kiswahili: Ashirikianaye na watenda mabaya na kuchangamana na watu waovu.
Ekegusii: Ere oyio ogosanga nabanyabibe na gotaara nabakori amabe.

English: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa anasema, ‘Haimfaidi mwanadamu kitu chochote anapojitahidi kumpendeza Mungu.’
Ekegusii: Naende ere oteebire ng’a kobwatana na Nyasae, ayio tari komokonya gento kende.

English: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo nisikilizeni mimi, ninyi watu wenye ufahamu. Kamwe Mungu hatendi uovu, Mwenyezi hafanyi kosa.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, inwe abanto abamore nokomanya, inyigwa! Nyasae tabaisa gokagerwa ng’a nakore amabe. Inee! Ere Omonguru nakore ebibe?

English: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
Kiswahili: Humlipa mwanadamu kwa ajili ya lile alilotenda; huleta juu yake kile ambacho matendo yake yanastahili.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agoakana omonto koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere; nabo akoa omonto eng’eria buna orogendo rwaye rore.

English: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
Kiswahili: Ni jambo lisiloweza kufikiriwa kwamba Mungu angefanya makosa, kwamba Mwenyezi angepotosha hukumu.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae tagokora ayare amabe; ee, ere Omonguru tari gosaria ayare ay’ekeene.

English: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?
Kiswahili: Je, ni nani aliyemtawaza juu ya dunia? Ni nani aliyemweka kuwa mwangalizi wa ulimwengu wote?
Ekegusii: Ning’o oete Nyasae okobua gw’okogambera ense? Ning’o obeegete ense yonsi koba eyaye?

English: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
Kiswahili: Kama lilikuwa kusudi la Mungu, naye akaiondoa Roho yake na pumzi yake,
Ekegusii: Ere aise koirania omoika oye, ee, airanie gochia asare omoika bw’obogima,

English: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
Kiswahili: wanadamu wote wangeliangamia kwa pamoja, na mtu angerudi mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto bonsi pi goika bakwe, bairane ase amaroba.

English: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.
Kiswahili: “Kama ninyi mnaufahamu, sikieni hili; sikilizeni hili nisemalo.
Ekegusii: “Onye more nokomanya, igwa aya; tegerera moigwe aya ngoteeba:

English: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,
Kiswahili: Je, yeye aichukiaye haki aweza kutawala? Je, utamhukumu mwenye haki, Aliye na Nguvu Zote?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto ogechete ekeene nanyare kogamba? Nonachere ekiina omonyene oboronge oyore nokobua?

English: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
Kiswahili: Je, si ni yeye awaambiaye wafalme, ‘Ninyi hamfai kitu,’ nao watu mashuhuri, ‘Ninyi ni waovu,’
Ekegusii: Nonyare goteebia omorwoti: Aye nigo ore omonto bosa, gose noteebie abanene basikire: Inwe nabakori amabe?

English: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.
Kiswahili: yeye asiyependelea wakuu, wala haonyeshi upendeleo kwa matajiri kuliko maskini, kwa kuwa wote ni kazi ya mikono yake?
Ekegusii: Nyasae tari gwanchereria abagaambi, gose tari kobara abanda ng’a mbare nengencho enene kobua abataka, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo bare emeremo y’amaboko aye.

English: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
Kiswahili: Wanakufa ghafula, usiku wa manane; watu wanatikiswa nao hupita; wenye nguvu huondolewa bila mkono wa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagokwa ara rimo; nigo bakonyegerigwa botuko gati, basira kegima, baria bare nokobua nigo bagosirigwa ko tari namaboko a Mwanyabaanto.

English: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.
Kiswahili: “Macho yake yanazitazama njia za wanadamu; anaona kila hatua yao.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo arigereretie chinchera chi’omonto; ere nigo aroche amatambokero aye onsi.

English: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mahali penye giza nene, wala uvuli mkubwa, ambapo watenda mabaya wanaweza kujificha.
Ekegusii: Aase aamwamu tari, gose omosunte ekerima, ase omokori amabe aranyare kwebisa.

English: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
Kiswahili: Mungu hana haja ya kumchunguza mtu sana, ili apate kuja mbele zake kwa hukumu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae taganeti engaki entambe korigereria, goika abeeke omonto ase ekiina.

English: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
Kiswahili: Bila kuuliza huwapondaponda wenye nguvu nyingi na kuwaweka wengine mahali pao.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agosenyenta abare nokobua atari kona‐kouna‐unia, erio abeeke abande aase abo.

English: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu huyaangalia matendo yao yote, huwaondoa usiku, nao wakaangamia.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ere namanyete emeremo yabo, nigo akobaonchorana botuko baitwa kegima.

English: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
Kiswahili: Anawaadhibu kwa ajili ya uovu wao mahali ambapo kila mmoja ataweza kuwaona,
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaita maiso marore, ase engencho y’ebibe biabo,

English: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,
Kiswahili: kwa sababu wameacha kumfuata Mungu, nao hawakuiheshimu njia yake hata moja.
Ekegusii: na ekiagera baonchokire na gotiga komobwatia, gose tibari korengereria igoro ye chinchera chiaye nonya ng’ake.

English: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.
Kiswahili: Wamesababisha kilio cha maskini kifike mbele zake, hivyo akasikia kilio cha wahitaji.
Ekegusii: Abwo bagerire ekerero ki’abataka giaikire asare, nere oigure ekerero ki’abagokorerwa bobe.

English: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,
Kiswahili: Lakini kama akinyamaza kimya, ni nani awezaye kumhukumu? Kama akiuficha uso wake, ni nani awezaye kumwona? Ikiwa ni taifa au mtu mmoja, kwake ni sawa,
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nyasae karakire‐kiri ning’o oramonachere ekiina? Karabise obosio bwaye, ning’o oranyare komorigereria, gokerabe egesaku gete gose omonto gete,

English: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.
Kiswahili: ili kumzuia mtu mwovu kutawala, au wale ambao huwategea watu mitego.
Ekegusii: ekero ararusie okogamba korwa ase abatamoirogeti na abatange tibaaba emeribo ase abanto?

English: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
Kiswahili: “Kama mwanadamu akimwambia Mungu, ‘Nimekosa lakini sitatenda dhambi tena.
Ekegusii: “Inee! Monto onde nare oteebirie Nyasae: Inche naremereirie egesusuro gi’okondongeyia, nonya tinkorereti monto onde bobe.

English: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
Kiswahili: Nifundishe nisichoweza kuona; kama nimekukosea, sitafanya hivyo tena.’
Ekegusii: Bono inyorokererie aya ntamanyeti, na onye nakorire ebibe, tingwancha kobikora naende.

English: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.
Kiswahili: Je basi, Mungu atakulipa kwa masharti yako, wakati wewe umekataa kutubu? Yakupasa wewe uamue, wala si mimi; sasa niambie lile ulijualo.
Ekegusii: Nigo okagete ng’a Nyasae nigo aragoakane buna oranche, ekiagera gwakanire ande onsi? Aye goika ochore, gose tari inche; ase ayio, kwana aya omanyete.

English: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
Kiswahili: “Wanadamu wenye ufahamu husema, wenye hekima wanaonisikia huniambia,
Ekegusii: “Abanto abare nokomanya, na kera omonto omong’aini orabe okonyigwa, nigo baranteebie:

English: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
Kiswahili: ‘Ayubu huongea bila maarifa; maneno yake hayana busara.’
Ekegusii: Ayubu nigo agokwana atari na semi; na amang’ana aye tari ay’obong’aini.

English: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.
Kiswahili: Laiti Ayubu angejaribiwa hadi kikomo cha mwisho, kwa sababu anajibu kama mtu mwovu!
Ekegusii: Nigo yagwenerete Ayubu ateemwe goika omoerio, ekiagera nigo akoiraneria buna abakori amabe bakoiraneria.

English: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
Kiswahili: Kwenye dhambi yake huongeza uasi; kwa dharau hupiga makofi miongoni mwetu, na kuzidisha maneno yake dhidi ya Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akomenta ogosaria ase ebibe biaye, naende nigo agotoakera chinkobi ase ogotochaya na gokwana amang’ana amange are mamincha ya Nyasae.”

English: Moreover Elihu answered,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Elihu akasema:
Ekegusii: Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:

English: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
Kiswahili: “Je, unadhani hili ni haki? Wewe unasema, ‘Nina haki mbele za Mungu.’
Ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, nigo okorengereria ng’a ayio nekeene? Gose nigo ogoteeba ng’a nomonyaboronge ore ase obosio bwa Nyasae?

English: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
Kiswahili: Bado unamuuliza, ‘Ni faida gani nimepata, na imenifaidi nini kwa kutokutenda dhambi?’
Ekegusii: Naende nigo okoboria ng’a mbuya ki oboronge bokogokorera kobua ogokora ebibe?

English: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
Kiswahili: “Ningependa nikujibu wewe pamoja na marafiki zako walio pamoja nawe.
Ekegusii: Bono ngokoiraneria nde aye amo nabasani bao abamore komo.

English: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
Kiswahili: Tazama juu mbinguni ukaone; yaangalie mawingu yaliyo juu sana juu yako.
Ekegusii: Rigereria gochia igoro, orore; rora amare buna are igoro mono kogoetania.

English: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
Kiswahili: Je, ukitenda dhambi, inamdhuruje Mungu? Kama dhambi zako zikiwa nyingi, hilo linamfanyia nini Mungu?
Ekegusii: Aye noisa gokora ebibe, ninki ayio arakore ase Nyasae? Na ogosaria nagoisa komentekana mono, ninki okwo koramokorere?

English: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
Kiswahili: Kama wewe ni mwadilifu, unampa nini, au yeye anapokea nini mkononi kwako?
Ekegusii: Onye kore omonyene oboronge, ngento ki okoa Nyasae, gose ninki akonyora korwa ase okoboko kwao?

English: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
Kiswahili: Uovu wako unamdhuru tu mtu mwingine kama wewe, nayo haki yako inawafaa wanadamu tu.
Ekegusii: Amabe ao ogokora nigo akorenta emechando ase omonto onde onga buna aye, na oboronge bwao nabo boragere omonto onde anyore ayare amaya.

English: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
Kiswahili: “Wanadamu hulia kwa kulemewa na mateso; huomba msaada kutoka mkono wenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ogokorerwa bobe kwabuchire, abanto nigo bakorera mono ng’a bakonywe; nigo bakorangeria bakonywe korwa ase amaboko ay’abare nokobua.

English: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
Kiswahili: Lakini hakuna asemaye, ‘Yuko wapi Mungu Muumba wangu, yeye anifanyaye niimbe usiku,
Ekegusii: Korende monto onde tari okobooria: Ng’ai Nyasae, oria ontongete, are, oyio okogera amatera ay’ogotogia aterwa botuko?

English: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
Kiswahili: yeye atufundishaye sisi zaidi kuliko wanyama wa dunia, na kutufanya wenye hekima kuliko ndege wa angani?’
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agotworokereria kobua ching’iti chi’ense, na otokora twaba nobong’aini kobua chinyoni.

English: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.
Kiswahili: Yeye hajibu wakati watu waliapo kwa sababu ya kiburi cha watu waovu.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakorera, korende Nyasae tari koiraneria, ase engencho y’ogokora okobe kw’oboenenu kwa’ banyabibe.

English: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.
Kiswahili: Naam, Mungu hasikilizi maombi yao ya ubatili; Mwenyezi hayazingatii.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae tari koigwa okorera gotari ogw’ekeene, gose ere Omonguru takogwechandera.

English: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
Kiswahili: Si zaidi sana kwamba hatakusikiliza wewe usemapo humwoni, tena ya kwamba shauri lako liko mbele zake na wewe lazima umngojee,
Ekegusii: “Nonya kogoteeba ng’a tori komoorora, ere tagokoigwa; ekiina kiao nigo kere ase obosio bwaye, bono nigo omoganyete nogosemeria.

English: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,
Kiswahili: pia zaidi, kwamba hasira yake kamwe haiadhibu wala haangalii uovu hata kidogo?
Ekegusii: Korende bono nigo okorengereria ng’a Nyasae tari korua egesusuro ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye, naende ng’a ere tari gwechandera ogosaria.

English: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Ayubu hufumbua kinywa chake kwa maneno yasiyo na maana; anaongea maneno mengi bila maarifa.”
Ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera aye Ayubu ogokwana amang’ana atari nengencho, nigo okomenta gokwana amang’ana atari ay’obong’aini.”

English: Elihu also continued, and said,
Kiswahili: Elihu akaendelea kusema:
Ekegusii: Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora,

English: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
Kiswahili: “Nivumilie kidogo zaidi nami nitakuonyesha kwamba yako mengi zaidi ya kusemwa kwa ajili ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Indemereria ake igo, inche nkworokie amang’ana; nimbwate ring’ana ngokwana ribaga ria Nyasae.

English: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
Kiswahili: Ninayapata maarifa yangu kutoka mbali, nami nitamhesabia haki Muumba wangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nindusie chisemi chiane korwa aare, ing’orokie ng’a Omotongi one nere omonyene oboronge.

English: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
Kiswahili: Uwe na hakika kwamba maneno yangu si ya uongo; mmoja aliye mkamilifu katika maarifa yuko pamoja na wewe.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, amang’ana aane tari ay’oborimo; inche oyo nteneine aiga amo naye nomoikeranu inde ase okomanya.

English: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
Kiswahili: “Mungu ni mwenye nguvu, lakini hamdharau mwanadamu; ni mwenye nguvu, naye ni thabiti katika shauri lake.
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo are Omonguru, ere tachayeti onde; nigo are nokobua ase chinguru na obong’aini.

English: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
Kiswahili: Hawaachi waovu waendelee kuishi, bali huwapa walioteswa haki yao.
Ekegusii: Ere tagotiga omokori amabe agenderere koba moyo, korende nigo akoa abachandire oboronge bwabo.

English: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
Kiswahili: Yeye haondoi macho yake kwa wenye haki; huwaketisha penye viti vya enzi pamoja na wafalme na kuwatukuza milele.
Ekegusii: Tari gotiga korigereria abanyene oboronge, korende nigo akobabeeka amo nabarwoti ase ebirogo bi’obonene. Ee, nigo akobakinia bagenderera kobeera aroro,

English: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa watu wamefungwa kwenye minyororo, wakiwa wameshikiliwa na kamba za mateso,
Ekegusii: na onye bagosibwa chingataare na baba bare ase emechando, gose kobwatwa ase emeeto y’emechando,

English: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
Kiswahili: huwaonyesha yale waliyoyatenda, kwamba wametenda dhambi kwa majivuno.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaorokeria ayabakorire, na ogosaria kwabo, boigo obaorokeria buna bakororekana abaenenu.

English: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
Kiswahili: Huwafanya wao kusikia maonyo, na huwaagiza kutubu uovu wao.
Ekegusii: Nigo agotinora amato abo baigwa ogokuurerwa, na obachika baonchoke, batige gokora amabe.

English: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
Kiswahili: Kama wakitii na kumtumikia, wataishi siku zao zilizobaki katika mafanikio, na miaka yao katika utoshelevu.
Ekegusii: Kobaraigwere na komokorera, rirorio mbabe bagoseseneka ase amatuko abo onsi, naende babe bakwegokia ase obogima bwabo.

English: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
Kiswahili: Lakini wasiposikiliza, wataangamia kwa upanga, nao watakufa pasipo maarifa.
Ekegusii: Korende onye tibakoigwera, nigo baraitwe nemioro, erio bakwe batamanyeti kende.

English: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
Kiswahili: “Wasiomcha Mungu moyoni mwao huficha chuki; hata anapowafunga, hawamwombi msaada.
Ekegusii: Abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo bagachete endamwamu ime ase chinkoro chiabo; barabwo tibari korera barigie bakonywe, ekero Nyasae akobaa egesusuro.

English: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
Kiswahili: Wanakufa wangali vijana, miongoni mwa wanaume hanithi wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagokwa ekero bare abake, obogima bwabo nigo bogosirigwa buna obw’abanyaka.

English: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
Kiswahili: Bali wao wanaoteseka huwaokoa katika mateso yao, na kuzungumza nao katika dhiki zao.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka goetera ase emechando yabo, otinora amato abo goetera ase ogokorerwa bobe kwabo.

English: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
Kiswahili: “Yeye anakubembeleza utoke katika mataya ya dhiki, ili kukuweka mahali palipo na nafasi mbali na kizuizi, hadi kwenye meza yako ya faraja iliyojaa vyakula vizuri.
Ekegusii: Ee, nigo akoebereretie, agakorusia korwa ase chimbanderana, agakorenta aase aagare, ase komigwa gotaiyo; boigo chindagera kwabeekeretwe emesa nigo chiarenge chinoru.

English: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa umelemewa na hukumu kwa ajili ya uovu; hukumu na haki vimekukamata.
Ekegusii: Korende bono aye nigo okonacherwa ekiina buna eki’abakori amabe, ekiina na ayare ay’ekeene mbikonyore.

English: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
Kiswahili: Uwe mwangalifu ili yeyote asikushawishi kwa utajiri; usipotoshwe kwa fungu kubwa la rushwa.
Ekegusii: Bono erende, endamwamu tebaisa gokoebereria na kogokora obe omochecheria, tobaisa gwancha obonge bw’embooria bogosirie.

English: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
Kiswahili: Je, utajiri wako hata nguvu zako nyingi vinaweza kukusaidia usiingie kwenye dhiki?
Ekegusii: Inee! Obotenenku bwao mbonyare kogotanga korwa ase emechando? Gose okobua kwao ne chinguru chiao mbinyare?

English: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
Kiswahili: Usiutamani usiku uje, ili uwaburute watu mbali na nyumba zao.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kogania ng’a obotuko boria boche, obwo abanto baraitwe basirigwe.

English: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
Kiswahili: Jihadhari usigeukie uovu, ambao unaupenda zaidi kuliko mateso.
Ekegusii: Bwerende, tobaisa koirana gokora amabe, ekiagera nigo gwanchire gokora ayio kobua konyora emechando.

English: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
Kiswahili: “Mungu ametukuzwa katika nguvu zake. Ni nani aliye mwalimu kama yeye?
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amanene ase okobua kwaye. Inee! Ning’o okworokereria buna ere?

English: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyemwelekeza katika njia zake, au kumwambia, ‘Wewe umetenda yasiyo sawa’?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ochikeire Nyasae enchera yaye? Gose ning’o oranyare komoteebia: Aye gwakorire bobe?

English: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka kuzitukuza kazi zake, ambazo watu wamezisifu katika wimbo.
Ekegusii: Inyora gotogia emeremo yaye, eyio abanto babeire bagoteera na koyetogia.

English: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
Kiswahili: Wanadamu wote wameiona; watu wanaikazia macho kwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bayerorire, ee, Mwanyabaanto mbayerigereretie korwa aare.

English: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi Mungu alivyo mkuu, kupita ufahamu wetu! Hesabu ya miaka yake haitafutiki.
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo are omonene mono, na intwe titomomanyeti; omobaro bw’emiaka yaye temanyekaneti.

English: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
Kiswahili: “Yeye huvuta juu matone ya maji, ayachujayo kama mvua kutoka kwenye vijito;
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akong’usa chintonyi chi’amaache gochia igoro, na chirochio chiatwa buna embura chiaba riime.

English: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
Kiswahili: mawingu huangusha chini maji yake, nayo mvua nyingi huwanyeshea wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Embura eyio nigo egotwa gocha ase ense, yatwera Mwanyabaanto ase obonge.

English: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?
Kiswahili: Ni nani ajuaye jinsi ayatandazavyo mawingu, jinsi angurumavyo kutoka hemani mwake.
Ekegusii: Inee! Monto onde nanyare komanya buna amare agwesiarera, gose buna okogukura gw’enkoba gokorua ase obomenyo bwa Nyasae?

English: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi anavyotandaza umeme wa radi kumzunguka, naye huvifunika vilindi vya bahari.
Ekegusii: Rora, nigo agosiarera okomesa kwamoetanana, naende otuba enkori y’enyancha.

English: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo atawalavyo mataifa, na kuwapa chakula kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio nigo akonachera abanto ekiina; naende nigo akobaa chindagera ase obonge.

English: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
Kiswahili: Huujaza mkono wake kwa umeme wa radi, na kuuagiza kulenga shabaha yake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo amumegete amaboko aye ase okomesa, erio ochika goake ase ekerenga kere.

English: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.
Kiswahili: Ngurumo zake hutangaza dhoruba inayokuja; hata mifugo hujulisha kukaribia kwake.
Ekegusii: Ekerundo gi’okomesa nigo gekoraria igoro ya Nyasae, nonya ne ching’iti nigo chikomanya ng’a ekerundo ngocha kere.

English: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hili moyo wangu unatetemeka, nao unaruka kutoka mahali pake.
Ekegusii: “Ayio nigo akogera enkoro yane yaiguswa, yatuma gocha ase omoyo.

English: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza! Sikiliza ngurumo ya sauti yake, sauti ya ngurumo itokayo kinywani mwake.
Ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe okogukura kw’eriogi riaye, na okoruma gokorwa ase omonwa oye.

English: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
Kiswahili: Huuachilia umeme wake wa radi chini ya mbingu yote na kuupeleka hata miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Nigo agotoma okoruma okwo korwa igoro gocha ase ense yonsi; okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo kogochera chinsinyo chi’ense.

English: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo huja sauti ya ngurumo yake; Mungu hunguruma kwa sauti yake ya fahari. Wakati sauti yake ingurumapo tena, huuachilia umeme wake wa radi.
Ekegusii: Erio eriogi riaye rikoruma, ere nigo akogukura neriogi ri’obonene, gose tari gotanga okomesa ekero eriogi riaye ri’okogukura riaigurwe.

English: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Mungu hunguruma kwa namna za ajabu; yeye hutenda mambo makuu kupita ufahamu wetu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akogukura neriogi riaye ase enchera y’ogokumia mono, nigo agokora amang’ana amanene, ayio totanyare komanya.

English: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
Kiswahili: Huiambia theluji, ‘Anguka juu ya dunia,’ nayo manyunyu ya mvua, ‘Uwe mvua ya nguvu.’
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agoteebia amagena ’embura: Kagwe igoro ase ense; na otoma omonyirira na embura enene ere ne chinguru.

English: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
Kiswahili: Ili wanadamu wote aliowaumba wapate kujua kazi zake, yeye humzuilia kila mtu shughuli zake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agotanga emeremo y’amaboko a kera omonto, erinde abanto bonsi banyare komanya emeremo yaye.

English: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
Kiswahili: Wanyama hujificha; hubakia kwenye mapango yao.
Ekegusii: Erio ching’iti chi’orosana chiagenda kwebisa, chiagenderera kobeera ase amakuruma abo.

English: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
Kiswahili: Dhoruba hutoka katika chumba chake, baridi hutoka katika upepo uendao kasi.
Ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu nigo kegosoka korwa ase chiero chiaye agwo Irianyi, na omwaga ore nobokendu orua sugusu oseria amare.

English: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
Kiswahili: Pumzi ya Mungu hutoa barafu, eneo kubwa la maji huganda.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akorua omoika bw’obokeng’entu obwatania amaache, na amaache oyarenta abwatana oma pa.

English: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
Kiswahili: Huyasheheneza mawingu kwa maji, naye husambaza umeme wake wa radi kupitia hayo.
Ekegusii: Nigo agoichoria amare amarito namaache, amare nigo agosiarera chinkoba chiaye.

English: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
Kiswahili: Nayo mawingu huzungukazunguka pande zote kwa amri yake, juu ya uso wa dunia yote, kufanya lolote ayaamuruyo.
Ekegusii: Amare nigo agoetanana gochia aaria na aaria, akoraagwa nere, goikerania aya onsi ere achiikire akore ase ense.

English: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
Kiswahili: Huleta mawingu ili kuadhibu wanadamu, au kuinyeshea dunia yake na kuonyesha upendo wake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokora ayio aba bo, ase okorua ebisusuro bi’okorongeyia, gose ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye.

English: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
Kiswahili: “Ayubu, sikiliza hili; nyamaza na uyafikiri maajabu ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, igwa aya; karategerera, orengererie igoro y’emeremo y’ogokumia ya Nyasae.

English: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
Kiswahili: Je, unajua jinsi Mungu anavyoyaongoza mawingu, na kufanya umeme wake wa radi utoe mwanga?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete buna Nyasae agokora ochika ayio, naende buna agokora okomesa kwamoreka goetera ase amare,

English: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
Kiswahili: Je, wajua jinsi mawingu yanavyokaa yakiwa yametulia, hayo maajabu yake yeye aliye mkamilifu katika maarifa?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete buna areng’anetie amare, eyio ere emeremo y’ogokumia y’oria ore nobong’aini oboikeranu?

English: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
Kiswahili: Wewe unayeshindwa na joto katika nguo zako wakati nchi imenyamazishwa kimya bila upepo wa kusini,
Ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete egekogera chianga chiao chigosamba ne riberera, ekero ense egotoererigwa nomwaga okogusa korwa Irianyi?

English: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
Kiswahili: je, waweza kuungana naye katika kuzitandaza anga, zilizo ngumu kama kioo cha shaba ya kuyeyushwa?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare korambora igoro buna ere ayeramborete, igoro eria ere enkong’u buna ekerore gi’ekioma?

English: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
Kiswahili: “Tuambieni yatupasayo kumwambia; hatuwezi kutayarisha shauri letu kwa sababu ya ujinga wetu.
Ekegusii: Tworokererie aya togochia gokwana asare; titokonyara konyora amang’ana togochia gokwana, ekiagera tore ase omosunte.

English: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
Kiswahili: Je, aambiwe kwamba nataka kuongea? Je, yuko mtu ambaye angeomba kumezwa?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nigo agochia goteebigwa ng’a inche ninganetie gokwana? Onde nare oganetie ere amosirie?

English: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
Kiswahili: Basi hakuna awezaye kulitazama jua, jinsi linavyongʼaa angani, upepo ukishafagia mawingu.
Ekegusii: “Abanto tibakonyara korigereria amasase ’erioba, kabarire igoro ekero amare abisirwe nomwaga.

English: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kaskazini yeye huja na fahari kuu; Mungu huja katika utukufu wa kutisha.
Ekegusii: Oborabu bokomeka‐meka nigo bokorwa sugusu; ee, Nyasae nigo eboetie nobonene bw’ogosikwa gw’okoondokia.

English: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
Kiswahili: Yeye Mwenyezi hatuwezi kumfikia, naye ametukuzwa katika uweza; katika hukumu zake na haki yake kuu, hataonea.
Ekegusii: Oyio Omobui, intwe titokonyara komoorora buna are; nigo abwate okobua okonene, naende nigo are omonyene ekeene, ere nigo are omonyene oboronge mono, takorega onde.

English: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, wanadamu mheshimuni, kwa kuwa yeye hamstahi yeyote anayejidhania kuwa ana hekima.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Mwanyabaanto nigo bamoirogete; ere tari gosika oyokwerengereria ng’a nomong’aini are.”

English: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akamjibu Ayubu kutoka upepo wa kisulisuli. Akasema:
Ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Ayubu korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime, akamoteebia:

English: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
Kiswahili: “Nani huyu atiaye mashauri yangu giza kwa maneno yasiyo na maarifa?
Ekegusii: Aye naye ng’o okorenta omosunte ase ogosemia ase ogokwana amang’ana atari ay’obong’aini?

English: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
Kiswahili: Jikaze kama mwanaume; nitakuuliza swali, nawe unijibu.
Ekegusii: Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ninkoborie, naye ong’iranerie.

English: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
Kiswahili: “Ulikuwa wapi nilipoweka misingi ya dunia? Niambie, kama unafahamu.
Ekegusii: Ng’ai kwarenge ekero nabegete oboroso bw’ense? Ntebie onye aye kore omong’aini.

English: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyeweka alama vipimo vyake? Hakika wewe unajua! Ni nani aliyenyoosha kamba ya kupimia juu yake?
Ekegusii: Ning’o obegete ebirengo biaye? Ntebie onye komanyete. Gose ning’o oramborete engori y’okoyerenga?

English: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
Kiswahili: Je, misingi yake iliwekwa juu ya nini, au ni nani aliyeweka jiwe la pembeni,
Ekegusii: Ng’ai amaroso aye aterekereretwe? Gose ning’o obegete rigena riaye ri’ekoona,

English: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
Kiswahili: wakati nyota za asubuhi zilipoimba pamoja, na malaika wote walipokuwa wakipiga kelele kwa furaha?
Ekegusii: ekero ching’enang’eni chia mambia chiaterete amo, na abana bonsi ba Nyasae baagete eriogi ri’omogooko?

English: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
Kiswahili: “Ni nani aliyeifungia bahari milango ilipopasuka kutoka tumbo,
Ekegusii: Ning’o osiegete ebisieri bi’enyancha, ekero yarindoretie buna ndiria yarenge ime ase enda y’ense?

English: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
Kiswahili: nilipoyafanya mawingu kuwa vazi lake, na kuyafungia katika giza nene,
Ekegusii: Ekero keria naroisetie amare abe chianga chiaye, na nkayeboyia omosunte ekerima,

English: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
Kiswahili: nilipoamuru mipaka yake, na kuiweka milango yake na makomeo mahali pake,
Ekegusii: naende nkabeekera enyancha chimbebe chiaye, boigo nkayebekera emekorogoto na ebisieri,

English: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?
Kiswahili: niliposema, ‘Unaweza kufika mpaka hapa wala si zaidi; hapa ndipo mawimbi yako yenye kiburi yatakapokomea’?
Ekegusii: ngateba: Aa nao oraikere, korende togoetania, naiga nao emerindo yao eimokererete igoro eratangerwe.

English: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
Kiswahili: “Umepata kuiamrisha asubuhi ipambazuke, au kuyaonyesha mapambazuko mahali pake,
Ekegusii: Inee! Ase obogima bwao bwonsi kwana gochika emambia ebeo? Kwana kworokia amasase a mambia aase akomoreka,

English: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
Kiswahili: yapate kushika miisho ya dunia, na kuwakungʼuta waovu waliomo?
Ekegusii: erinde ense yonsi ekiamoke, ebwatwe ase chinsinyo chiaye, na abakori amabe banyegerigwe barueo?

English: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
Kiswahili: Dunia hubadilika kama udongo wa mfinyanzi chini ya lakiri; sura yake hukaa kama ile ya vazi.
Ekegusii: Ense nigo ekoonchorwa yarorekana buna amaroba abeire inse y’ebonyi ere nekemanyererio, na ebinto bionsi nigo bikororekana buna chianga chire n’ebieni ao ao.

English: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
Kiswahili: Waovu huzuiliwa nuru yao, nao mkono wao ulioinuliwa huvunjwa.
Ekegusii: Oborabu nigo bogotangwa korwa ase abakori amabe, ne chinguru chiabo chi’okweenenia nigo chikobunwa chiasirigwa.

English: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
Kiswahili: “Je, umepata kufika kwenye chemchemi za bahari? Au kutembea mahali pa ndani pa vilindi?
Ekegusii: Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase chinsoko chi’enyancha, gose kwana gotaara ase enkoro ye chindiba?

English: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
Kiswahili: Umewahi kuonyeshwa malango ya mauti? Umewahi kuiona milango ya uvuli wa mauti?
Ekegusii: Kwana kworokigwa ebiita bi’amakweri, gose korora ebisieri bi’ekiriri ki’amakweri?

English: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
Kiswahili: Je, wewe unafahamu ukubwa wa dunia? Niambie kama unajua haya yote.
Ekegusii: Kwana korengereria igoro y’obogare bw’ense? Onye komanyete ayio onsi, yararie!

English: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
Kiswahili: “Njia ya kufika kwenye makao ya nuru ni ipi? Nako maskani mwa giza ni wapi?
Ekegusii: Enchera ekogenda ase oborabu bore, ng’ai ere? Nomanyete ase omosunte omenyete,

English: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
Kiswahili: Je, unaweza kuvirudisha kwenye makao yake? Unajua njia za kufika maskani mwake?
Ekegusii: erinde ogende oyoire ase ribebe riaye? Naende nomanyete ebinchera bigochia ase enyomba yaye?

English: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
Kiswahili: Hakika unajua, kwa kuwa ulikuwa umeshazaliwa! Kwani umeishi miaka mingi!
Ekegusii: Ee, aye nomanyete, ekiagera nigo kwaiboretwe kare, na emiaka yao nemenge.

English: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
Kiswahili: “Je, umeshawahi kuingia katika ghala za theluji, au kuona ghala za mvua ya mawe,
Ekegusii: Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase ebigachero bi’obokeng’entu, gose ebigachero bi’amagena ’embura?

English: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
Kiswahili: ambazo nimeziweka akiba kwa ajili ya wakati wa taabu, na kwa ajili ya wakati wa vita na mapigano?
Ekegusii: Amagena ayio ngachete goika ase engaki y’emechando, amatuko aria arabe ay’esegi na okorwana konde.

English: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
Kiswahili: Ni ipi njia iendayo mahali umeme wa radi unapotawanyiwa, au mahali upepo wa mashariki unaposambaziwa juu ya dunia?
Ekegusii: Inchera ki ekogenda aase oborabu bokoruerwa, gose ekogenda aase omwaga okorwa moocha bwesiarera ense yonsi?

English: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyepasua mifereji kwa ajili ya maji mengi ya mvua yaendayo kasi na njia ya umeme wa radi,
Ekegusii: Ning’o oremete omotaro ase chiooro chi’embura chigoeta, gose enchera ase chinkoba chikogukura goeta,

English: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
Kiswahili: ili kusababisha mvua kunyeshea mahali pasipokaliwa na mtu, jangwa lisilo na yeyote ndani yake,
Ekegusii: echio chikogera embura yatwa aase monto atamenyeti, ase erooro monto ataiyo?

English: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
Kiswahili: ili kuitosheleza nchi ya ukiwa na jangwa, na majani yaanze kumea ndani yake?
Ekegusii: Embura eyio nigo ekoigotia ense ere bosa etamenyiri, yagera yamera obonyansi.

English: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
Kiswahili: Je, mvua ina baba? Ni nani baba azaaye matone ya umande?
Ekegusii: Inee! Embura nebwate ise? Gose ning’o okoibora amatoima e riime?

English: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
Kiswahili: Barafu inatoka tumbo la nani? Ni nani azaaye ukungu kutoka mbinguni,
Ekegusii: Nkorwa ase enda ya ng’o obokeng’entu bokorwa? Ning’o okoibora obokendu bokorwa igoro?

English: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
Kiswahili: wakati maji yawapo magumu kama jiwe, wakati uso wa vilindi vya maji unapoganda?
Ekegusii: Amache nigo akobwatana oma pa buna rigena, ne chinyancha chioma pa chiaba buna egetare.

English: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
Kiswahili: “Je, waweza kuufunga mnyororo wa Kilimia? Waweza kulegeza kamba za Orioni?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare gosiberania egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo? Gose bwororobie egetuse keria gekorokwa Orioni?

English: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
Kiswahili: Waweza kuyaongoza makundi ya nyota kwa majira yake, au kuongoza Dubu na watoto wake?
Ekegusii: Nonyare koraa ching’enang’eni chioroke ase chingaki chiabo? Gose nonyare koraa egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Edubu ne chimanwa chiaye?

English: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
Kiswahili: Je, unajua sheria zinazotawala mbingu? Waweza kuweka utawala wa Mungu duniani?
Ekegusii: Nomanyete emeroberio ya igoro echiikire? Nonyare koroberia okogamba kwabo igoro ase ense?

English: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?
Kiswahili: “Waweza kuiinua sauti yako mpaka mawinguni, na kujifunika mwenyewe na gharika ya maji?
Ekegusii: Nonyare goaka eriogi riao riike ase amare ogere embura enyinge egotwere?

English: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
Kiswahili: Je, wewe hutuma umeme wa radi kwenye njia zake? Je, hutoa taarifa kwako kukuambia, ‘Sisi tuko hapa’?
Ekegusii: Nonyare gotoma chinkoba chigende aase gete, erio chigoteebie: Ee, nao tore aa?

English: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyeujalia moyo hekima au kuzipa akili ufahamu?
Ekegusii: Ning’o okobeeka obong’aini ase enkoro ime, gose okomanya ase omoyo ime?

English: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
Kiswahili: Nani mwenye hekima ya kuyahesabu mawingu? Ni nani awezaye kuinamisha magudulia ya mbinguni
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koba nobong’aini abare amare? Gose ning’o oranyare koberereka chinyongo chi’amaache chia igoro,

English: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
Kiswahili: wakati mavumbi yawapo magumu, na mabonge ya udongo kushikamana pamoja?
Ekegusii: ekero riroba riabwatanire riomire pa, na amagakara abwatanire amo.

English: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
Kiswahili: “Je, utamwindia simba jike mawindo, na kuwashibisha simba wenye njaa
Ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare gotwarera endo ebi ekoria, gose koigotia chindo chinsae chiganetie endagera,

English: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
Kiswahili: wakati wao wamejikunyata mapangoni mwao, au wakivizia kichakani?
Ekegusii: ekero chire ase amakuruma abo chieringanetie ase okoboera, gose gochiramaime agwo ase chiebisete?

English: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
Kiswahili: Ni nani ampaye kunguru chakula wakati makinda yake yanamlilia Mungu, yakizungukazunguka kwa ajili ya kukosa chakula?
Ekegusii: Ning’o okoa ekegonkoru endagera yaye, ekero amage aye akorera ase Nyasae na goetanana onsi korigia endagera?

English: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?
Kiswahili: “Je, wajua ni wakati gani mbuzi wa mlimani wanapozaa? Je, watambua ni wakati gani kulungu jike azaapo mtoto wake?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nomanyete chingaki ekero chimbori chi’orosana chikobiara? Gose ekero chinsune chikobiara?

English: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?
Kiswahili: Je, waweza kuhesabu miezi hadi wazaapo? Je, unajua majira yao ya kuzaa?
Ekegusii: Nonyare komanya omobaro bw’emetienyi chigokoora, naende nomanyete chingaki chikobiara?

English: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.
Kiswahili: Wao hujiinamisha na kuzaa watoto wao; utungu wa kuzaa unakoma.
Ekegusii: Nigo chigwekumba chiabiara chimanwa chiabo, na ekero chiabiarire, obororo bw’okobina bwasira.

English: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.
Kiswahili: Watoto wao hustawi na kuongezeka nguvu nyikani; huenda zao wala hawarudi tena.
Ekegusii: Chimanwa chiabo nigo chikoba ne chinguru chiakinera ase orosana. Nigo chikogenda kegima, tichiri koirana.

English: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,
Kiswahili: “Ni nani aliyemwachia punda-mwitu awe huru? Ni nani aliyezifungua kamba zake?
Ekegusii: “Ning’o otigire etigere y’orosana esiboire? Gose ning’o bwororobirie ebisibo bi’etigere ere enyango?

English: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?
Kiswahili: Nimempa nchi isiyokaliwa na watu kuwa masikani yake, nchi ya chumvi kuwa makao yake.
Ekegusii: Inche nayeeire ekerubo ekiomo kebe enka yaye, na ense ere nomonyo, emenyeo.

English: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.
Kiswahili: Huzicheka ghasia za mji, wala hasikii kelele za mwendesha gari.
Ekegusii: Ero nigo egochaaya eriogi rire ase omochie, teri koigwa okwoga kw’omotemi onde bwensi.

English: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.
Kiswahili: Huzunguka vilimani kwa ajili ya malisho na kutafuta kila kitu kibichi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ekona‐kogenda aaria na aaria ase ebitunwa ekorisia, yaba ekorigia kera ekemeri ekebese.

English: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?
Kiswahili: “Je, nyati atakubali kukutumikia? Atakaa karibu na hori lako usiku?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Eng’era nayanche egokorere emeremo? Nenyare korara ase obweri bwao botuko?

English: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?
Kiswahili: Je, waweza kumfungia kwenye matuta kwa kamba? Je, atalima mabonde nyuma yako?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare koyesiba ne chingori eete ase emeng’ororia ye chintinde? Gose ebutorane chintinde ase rikura riao?

English: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?
Kiswahili: Je, utamtumainia kwa ajili ya nguvu zake nyingi? Utamwachia yeye kazi zako nzito?
Ekegusii: Inee! Noyesemerie ekiagera ere ne chinguru chinyinge? Nonyare gotiga emeremo yao, ng’a ero ekoyekorere?

English: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?
Kiswahili: Utaweza kumwamini akuletee nafaka yako nyumbani kutoka shambani na kuikusanya kwenye sakafu yako ya kupuria?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo oyiegenete ng’a neirane na ekorentere endagera ase ekeoreri kiao?

English: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?
Kiswahili: “Mbuni hupigapiga mabawa yake kwa furaha, lakini hayawezi kulinganishwa na mabawa na manyoya ya korongo.
Ekegusii: “Esagero nigo egosamunsa chimbaaba chiaye chioga; korende, Inee, chimbaaba echio nchibwate obwanchani?

English: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,
Kiswahili: Huyataga mayai yake juu ya ardhi, na kuyaacha yapate joto mchangani,
Ekegusii: Esagero eaberi nigo egotiga amagena aye ase amaroba ime anyora riberera korwao.

English: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.
Kiswahili: bila kujali kuwa mguu waweza kuyaponda, kwamba baadhi ya wanyama wa porini wanaweza kuyakanyaga.
Ekegusii: Ero nigo ekoyeba, tekomanya ng’a naatwe namagoro, naende ng’a gose eng’iti y’orosana neyatache.

English: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
Kiswahili: Yeye huyafanyia makinda yake ukatili kama vile si yake; hajali kwamba taabu yake inaweza ikawa bure,
Ekegusii: Nigo ere entindi mono ase ebichuchu biaye, yabikorera biaba buna mbitari ebiaye; teri gwechandera oroiboro rwaye,

English: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Mungu hakumjalia hekima, wala hakumpa fungu la akili njema.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nigo ayerinete obong’aini, gose tayeete okomanya.

English: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.
Kiswahili: Lakini akunjuapo mabawa yake kukimbia, humcheka farasi pamoja na yeye aliyempanda.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekoimokerera igoro, egwesamunsa eminyoke, nigo egosekerera ebarasi na oyo oyerinete.

English: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?
Kiswahili: “Je, wewe humpa farasi nguvu au kuivika shingo yake manyoya marefu?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Naye okoa ebarasi chinguru? Naye oboetie ebigoti biaye namanya?

English: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.
Kiswahili: Je, wewe humfanya farasi aruke kama nzige, akistaajabisha kwa tishio la mlio wake wa majivuno?
Ekegusii: Naye oyeete chinguru egocharokera buna engige? Eriogi egochuria nigo rire ri’okoirokia.

English: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.
Kiswahili: Huparapara bila woga, akizifurahia nguvu zake, husonga mbele kukabiliana na silaha.
Ekegusii: Nigo egokura‐kura riroba ase ense omweya, yagokera chinguru chiaye. Erio yaminyoka koumerana nabare nebirwanero bi’esegi.

English: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.
Kiswahili: Huicheka hofu, haogopi chochote, wala haukimbii upanga.
Ekegusii: Ero nigo egosekerera obwoba, teri koondokigwa na kende; gose teri koonchoka etame korwa ase emioro.

English: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.
Kiswahili: Podo hutoa sauti kando yake, pamoja na mkuki unaongʼaa na fumo.
Ekegusii: Chinsara nigo chikorutwa chiaba chikwoga goeta igoro yaye, na amatimo akomesa, ne chisimisi boigo.

English: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.
Kiswahili: Bila woga na kwa ghadhabu huimeza nchi, wala tarumbeta iliapo yeye hawezi kusimama.
Ekegusii: Nigo egotitiria riroba ere nobotindi na ekeririanda, gose teri gotegerera ekire, ekero egetureri gekobugigwa.

English: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
Kiswahili: Asikiapo sauti ya baragumu yeye hulia, ‘Aha!’ Hunusa harufu ya vita toka mbali, sauti ya mtoa amri na ukelele wa vita.
Ekegusii: Ekero egetureeri gekobugigwa, nigo ekwana eriogi riaye ri’okoega‐ega. Nigo ekoigwa omonyonko bw’esegi korwa aare, na buna abachiki b’esegi bagochika, na okwoga gw’esegi.

English: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?
Kiswahili: “Je, mwewe huruka kwa hekima yako na kuyakunjua mabawa yake kuelekea kusini?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Nobong’aini bwao bokogera ekebaki kiairuruka igoro, naende kiarambora chimbaaba chiaye koiruruka gochia Irianyi?

English: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?
Kiswahili: Je, tai hupaa juu kwa amri yako na kujenga kiota chake mahali pa juu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Naye ogochika ekeongo kiairuruka gochia igoro, kiaagacha egeswa kiaye aase a igoro mono?

English: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.
Kiswahili: Huishi juu ya miamba mirefu na kukaa huko usiku; majabali yenye ncha kali ndiyo ngome yake.
Ekegusii: Ekeongo nigo gekomenya ase egetare; ase omwenya bw’egetare, aase gekonyora oborendi obuya.

English: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.
Kiswahili: Kutoka huko hutafuta chakula chake; macho yake hukiona kutoka mbali.
Ekegusii: Korwa aaria igoro nigo kegotengera ebi kegotwara, amaiso aye nigo akobirora korwa aare.

English: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
Kiswahili: Makinda yake hujilisha damu, na pale palipo na machinjo, ndipo yeye alipo.”
Ekegusii: Amage aye nigo akonywa amanyinga, na aase emebere ekwete ere, nao ekeongo kere.”

English: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Ayubu:
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akagenderera gokwana, agateebia Ayubu,

English: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
Kiswahili: “Je, mwenye kushindana na Mwenyezi aweza kumsahihisha? Mwenye kumlaumu Mungu na ajibu.”
Ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto okona‐korigia amamocho naamereranie n’Omonguru? Aye okona‐koamererania na Nyasae, iraneria rende.”

English: Then Job answered Yahweh,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Ayubu akamjibu Bwana:
Ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneri’Omonene, agateeba:

English: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
Kiswahili: “Mimi sistahili kabisa: ninawezaje kukujibu wewe? Nauweka mkono wangu juu ya kinywa changu.
Ekegusii: “Naama! Inche ting’isaini kende, ngento ki ndanyare gokoiraneria? Natubire omonwa one nokoboko kwane.

English: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
Kiswahili: Nimesema mara moja, lakini sina jibu; naam, nimesema mara mbili, lakini sitasema tena.”
Ekegusii: Inche nakwanire rimo, tinkomenta gento; ee, nakwanire kabere, korende tinkogenderera goetania ayio.”

English: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind:
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akasema na Ayubu kutoka upepo wa kisulisuli:
Ekegusii: Erio korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime Omonene akairaneria Ayubu, akamoteebia:

English: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
Kiswahili: “Jikaze kama mwanaume; nitakuuliza maswali, nawe yakupasa unijibu.
Ekegusii: “Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ngokoboria nde, naye ong’iranerie.

English: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
Kiswahili: “Je, utabatilisha hukumu yangu? Utanilaumu mimi ili kujihesabia haki mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare kombara ng’a nomomochi inde? Norigetie kongambia inche, erinde obarerwe oboronge?

English: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
Kiswahili: Je, una mkono kama wa Mungu, nawe waweza kutoa sauti ya ngurumo kama yake?
Ekegusii: Aye nobwate okoboko buna okwane inche Nyasae? Nonyare kogukura neriogi riao buna inche nkogukura?

English: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
Kiswahili: Basi jivike mwenyewe utukufu na fahari, nawe uvae heshima na enzi.
Ekegusii: Aye echabere nobonene na obwari, eboyie ogosikwa na okobua.

English: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Kiswahili: Fungulia ukali wa ghadhabu yako, mtafute kila mwenye kiburi umshushe,
Ekegusii: Siara ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwao, erio origererie kera omonto ore omoenenu, omokeyie.

English: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
Kiswahili: mwangalie kila mtu mwenye kiburi na umnyenyekeze, waponde waovu mahali wasimamapo.
Ekegusii: Ee, rigereria oyio ore omoenenu, omokeyie, na abakori amabe obatindachere inse agwo ase bateneine.

English: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
Kiswahili: Wazike wote mavumbini pamoja; wafunge nyuso zao kaburini.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi babise ime ase amaroba; obwateranie bokong’u amasio abo ime y’ense inse.

English: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mimi mwenyewe nitakukubalia kuwa mkono wako mwenyewe wa kuume unaweza kukuokoa.
Ekegusii: Igo inche ninyancherane naye, ng’a okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngokoe okobua.

English: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
Kiswahili: “Mwangalie mnyama aitwaye Behemothi, niliyemuumba kama nilivyokuumba wewe, anayekula majani kama ngʼombe.
Ekegusii: “Rigereria engubo! Eyio natongete buna nagotongete aye. Nigo ekorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe.

English: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
Kiswahili: Tazama basi nguvu alizo nazo kwenye viuno vyake, uwezo alio nao kwenye misuli ya tumbo lake!
Ekegusii: Rora, chinguru chiaye nigo chire ase ekeneema kiaye, na okobua kwaye nigo kore ase chinyama chi’enda yaye.

English: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
Kiswahili: Mkia wake hutikisika kama mwerezi; mishipa ya mapaja yake imesukwa pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ekemincha kiaye nigo kere egekong’u pa buna omocharake, na emekia y’amariagati aye nigo esisekaine amo.

English: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
Kiswahili: Mifupa yake ni bomba za shaba, maungo yake ni kama fito za chuma.
Ekegusii: Amauga aye nigo are amakong’u buna emebirangwa eroisirie korwa ase etai; ee, amauga ’omobere oye nigo anga buna emeriibo y’ebioma.

English: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni wa kwanza miongoni mwa kazi za Mungu, lakini Muumba wake anaweza kumsogelea kwa upanga wake.
Ekegusii: “Ero negetongwa ki’ogokumia inche Nyasae natongete; inche nayetongete, nayeete amaino anga buna emioro.

English: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
Kiswahili: Vilima humletea yeye mazao yake, nao wanyama wote wa porini hucheza karibu naye.
Ekegusii: Endagera ekoria nigo ekwama ase ebitunwa igoro, agwo ase ching’iti chi’orosana chikogosoreria.

English: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
Kiswahili: Hulala chini ya mimea ya yungiyungi, katika maficho ya matete kwenye matope.
Ekegusii: Nigo ekorara ase ekiriri ki’omote okorokwa lotusi, yebisa na gokenderera ime ase ebitonto bire ase etente.

English: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
Kiswahili: Hiyo mimea ya yungiyungi humficha kwenye vivuli vyake; miti mirefu karibu na kijito humzunguka.
Ekegusii: Omote oyio noro ore ekiriri kiaye; ee, emete enga buna emesobeti nigo eyeetanaine.

English: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
Kiswahili: Wakati mto ufurikapo, yeye hapati mshtuko wa hofu; yeye yu salama, hata kama Yordani ingefurika hadi kwenye kinywa chake.
Ekegusii: Rora, nonya orooche rore nemerindo, ero teri kwoboa; nonya orooche rwa Yorodani rokominyoka gocha ase omonwa oye, nigo ere noboremu.

English: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
Kiswahili: Je, mtu yeyote anaweza kumkamata yeye akiwa macho, au kumnasa kwa mtego na kutoboa pua yake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nanyare koyebwata ekero ere ase riraro riaye? Gose nabochore chimioro chiaye ayesibe nengori?”

English: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
Kiswahili: “Je, waweza kumvua Lewiathani kwa ndoano ya samaki, au kufunga ulimi wake kwa kamba?
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye nonyare kong’usa Leviatani, eng’iti enene y’okwoboyia, korwa rooche nendobio. Gose nonyare gosiba oromeme rwaye nengori?

English: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
Kiswahili: Waweza kupitisha kamba puani mwake, au kutoboa taya lake kwa kulabu?
Ekegusii: Nonyare gosoyia engori ime ase chimioro chiaye, gose kobochora orosea rwaye nendobio?

English: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
Kiswahili: Je, ataendelea kukuomba umhurumie? Atasema nawe maneno ya upole?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nenyare gokoboria amang’ana amange ase oboitongo? Gose nenyare gokwana naye amang’ana amororo?

English: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
Kiswahili: Je, atafanya agano nawe ili umtwae awe mtumishi wako maisha yake yote?
Ekegusii: Ero nekore okobwatana amo naye, ng’a ebe omosomba oo kogenderera botambe?

English: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
Kiswahili: Je, utamfuga na kumfanya rafiki kama ndege, au kumfunga kamba kwa ajili ya wasichana wako?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nokore egosori nero buna orakore nenyoni? Gose oyebeke ekorere abasomba bao abaiseke egosori?

English: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
Kiswahili: Je, wafanyabiashara watabadilishana bidhaa kwa ajili yake? Watamgawanya miongoni mwa wafanyao biashara?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abaoonia mbakorerane rigori igoro yaye, gose bayebutorane ase okoyeonerania?

English: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
Kiswahili: Je, waweza kuijaza ngozi yake kwa vyuma vyenye ncha kali, au kichwa chake kwa mkuki wa kuvulia samaki?
Ekegusii: Nonyare kobochora riiyo riaye ne ritimo rikobeta chinswe? Gose ritimo erio ndibete omotwe oye riyobochore?

English: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
Kiswahili: Kama ukiweka mkono wako juu yake, utavikumbuka hivyo vita na kamwe hutarudia tena!
Ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao oyebwate, erio oteeme gokora esegi nero. Tokoiranera eria kabere.

English: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?
Kiswahili: Tumaini lolote la kumtiisha ni kujidanganya; kule kumwona tu kunamwangusha mtu chini.
Ekegusii: “Ekero omonto agoteema igo, nigo ogosemeria kwaye kogosira kegima; nonya nase okoyerora rioka, omonto nigo akwerusia moyo.

English: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
Kiswahili: Hakuna yeyote aliye mkali athubutuye kumchokoza. Ni nani basi awezaye kusimama dhidi yangu?
Ekegusii: Onde tari ore omotindi oraremererie ayechegie. Ning’o rende oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwane?

English: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
Kiswahili: Ni nani mwenye madai dhidi yangu ili nipate kumlipa? Kila kitu kilicho chini ya mbingu ni mali yangu.
Ekegusii: Ning’o ong’eire egento ritang’ani ng’a nainche imogeakane? Gento kende gionsi kere inse y’erioba nekiane.

English: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
Kiswahili: “Sitashindwa kunena juu ya maungo yake, nguvu zake na umbo lake zuri.
Ekegusii: “Inche tingotiga ting’orokia buna ebiimo biaye bire, naende buna okobua ne chinguru chiaye bire, na buna amauga ’omobere oye aagachegete buya.

English: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kumvua gamba lake la nje? Ni nani awezaye kumsogelea na lijamu?
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koyiaboria risankwa riaye? Ning’o oranyare gosoyia okoboko kwaye gati‐gati y’amaino aye?

English: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
Kiswahili: Nani athubutuye kuufungua mlango wa kinywa chake, kilichozungukwa na meno yake ya kutisha pande zote?
Ekegusii: Ning’o oraasamie omonwa oye? Amaino aye nigo are ay’okwoboyia mono.

English: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.
Kiswahili: Mgongo wake una safu za ngao zilizoshikamanishwa imara pamoja;
Ekegusii: Obonene bwaye namagonko aye anga buna chinguba, achokaine chindwaro; nigo abwataine amo, buna ayanantirie.

English: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
Kiswahili: kila moja iko karibu sana na mwenzake, wala hakuna hewa iwezayo kupita kati yake.
Ekegusii: Rigonko erimo nigo risoaine nerinde ang’e kegima, nonya nembeo tekonyara gosoera gati yabo.

English: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.
Kiswahili: Zimeunganishwa imara kila moja na nyingine; zimengʼangʼaniana pamoja wala haziwezi kutenganishwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo erinde ribwatanirie nerinde; naro nigo asoaine, takonyara gwatananwa.

English: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
Kiswahili: Akipiga chafya mwanga humetameta; macho yake ni kama mionzi ya mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Ekero egwasimora, chinsase nigo chigosoka chiamoreka, amaiso aye nigo anga buna amasase agosakia mambia.

English: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.
Kiswahili: Mienge iwakayo humiminika kutoka kinywani mwake; cheche za moto huruka nje.
Ekegusii: Chinsase chi’omorero nigo chikorwa ase omonwa oye; ee, chinsase nigo chigotaroka korwa asere.

English: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
Kiswahili: Moshi hufuka kutoka puani mwake, kama kutoka kwenye chungu kinachotokota kwa moto wa matete.
Ekegusii: Erioki nigo rigosoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, buna enyongo ekobera egosokia omwoki bw’amaache.

English: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
Kiswahili: Pumzi yake huwasha makaa ya mawe, nayo miali ya moto huruka kutoka kinywani mwake.
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’omonwa oye nigo ogosoka buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, na omorero nigo ogosoka korwa ase omonwa oye,

English: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
Kiswahili: Nguvu hukaa katika shingo yake; utisho hutangulia mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Rigoti riaye nigo ribwate chinguru, na okoondokia nigo kore bosio bwaye.

English: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.
Kiswahili: Mikunjo ya nyama yake imeshikamana imara pamoja; iko imara na haiwezi kuondolewa.
Ekegusii: Emenia y’omobere oye nigo ekinyaine amo; nigo yesibete bokong’u ase omobere oye, tekonyarwa kobwatokanigwa.

English: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.
Kiswahili: Kifua chake ni kigumu kama mwamba, kigumu kama jiwe la chini la kusagia.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yaye nenkong’u buna rigena, ee, nenkong’u buna orogena rogosia.

English: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.
Kiswahili: Ainukapo, mashujaa wanaogopa; hurudi nyuma mbele yake anapokwenda kwa kishindo.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekoimoka gotenena, abanto chituoni nigo bakwoboa mono; ekero ekorindoka gocha nigo bagotang’ang’a.

English: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
Kiswahili: Upanga unaomfikia haumdhuru, wala mkuki au mshale wala fumo.
Ekegusii: Nerutwa omoro oyegwere, tori koyekorera kende, nonya ne ritimo, gose ensara, gose esimisi.

English: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.
Kiswahili: Chuma hukiona kama unyasi, na shaba kama mti uliooza.
Ekegusii: Ekioma nigo kenga risakwe asere, na etai nigo enga omote ogundire.

English: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.
Kiswahili: Mishale haimfanyi yeye akimbie; mawe ya kombeo kwake ni kama makapi.
Ekegusii: Ensara tekoyioboyia etame; amagena ’enduruche akorutwa nigo anga buna amasakwe.

English: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.
Kiswahili: Rungu kwake huwa kama kipande cha jani kavu; hucheka sauti za kugongana kwa mkuki.
Ekegusii: Chinungu nigo chinga buna amasakwe asere; ekero amatimo akwoga gocha nigo egoseka.

English: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
Kiswahili: Sehemu zake za chini kwenye tumbo zina menomeno na mapengo kama vigae vya chungu, zikiacha mburuzo kwenye matope kama chombo chenye meno cha kupuria.
Ekegusii: Ase enda yaye nigo ebwate ebigionkorio ebioge; nigo egotiga ebimanyerererio buna ebi’egari y’okoorera egokurura ase etintira.

English: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
Kiswahili: Huvisukasuka vilindi kama sufuria kubwa ichemkayo, na kukoroga bahari kama chungu cha marhamu.
Ekegusii: Nigo egoserokia amaache korwa ase chindiba inse, nigo egokora amaache ’enyancha aba buna amaguta aburukanirie.

English: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.
Kiswahili: Anapopita nyuma yake huacha mkondo unaometameta; mtu angedhani vilindi vilikuwa na mvi.
Ekegusii: Enchera yaeteire nigo ekogenderera komesa, enyancha inse nigo egokagwa ng’a nechimbuche.

English: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.
Kiswahili: Hakuna chochote duniani kinacholingana naye: yeye ni kiumbe kisicho na woga.
Ekegusii: Getongwa kende tikeri igoro ase ense kenga ero, ekio giatongetwe getari kwoboa.

English: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”
Kiswahili: Yeye huwatazama chini wale wote wenye kujivuna; yeye ni mfalme juu ya wote wenye kiburi.”
Ekegusii: Nigo ekorigereria kera egento kere igoro mono etari gokioboa, nigo ere omorwoti bw’ebitongwa bionsi bire noboenenu.”

English: Then Job answered Yahweh:
Kiswahili: Ndipo Ayubu akamjibu Bwana:
Ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneri’Omonene, akabora.

English: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
Kiswahili: “Ninajua ya kuwa unaweza kufanya mambo yote, wala hakuna mpango wako unaoweza kuzuilika.
Ekegusii: “Nimanyete ng’a aye nonyare gokora ebinto bionsi, naende ng’a aya kwaganirie gokora takonyara gotangwa taba.

English: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.
Kiswahili: Uliuliza, ‘Ni nani huyu afichaye mashauri yangu bila maarifa?’ Hakika nilisema juu ya mambo niliyokuwa siyaelewi, mambo ya ajabu mno kwangu mimi kuyajua.
Ekegusii: Ninche ng’o mbwate ogosemia gotari nobong’aini? Ase ayio nakwanire aya ntamanyeti, amang’ana ’ogokumia ansinyire komanya.

English: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’
Kiswahili: “Ulisema, ‘Sikiliza sasa, nami nitanena; nitakuuliza swali, nawe yakupasa kunijibu.’
Ekegusii: Koranche, ontegerere nkwane, nkoborie, naye onteebie buna are.

English: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
Kiswahili: Masikio yangu yalikuwa yamesikia habari zako, lakini sasa macho yangu yamekuona.
Ekegusii: Nabeire nkoigwa igoro yao ase okoigwa namato rioka, korende bono amaiso aane akororire.

English: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo najidharau mwenyewe, na kutubu katika mavumbi na majivu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nechayire inche omonyene, naende neakire orotu ne ribu ase ogweitia na goonchoka.”

English: It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Bwana kusema mambo haya yote na Ayubu, akamwambia Elifazi Mtemani, “Nina hasira juu yako na juu ya rafiki zako wawili, kwa sababu hamkusema yaliyo sawa kwa habari yangu, kama alivyosema mtumishi wangu Ayubu.
Ekegusii: Omonene gakwanire amang’ana ayio n’Ayubu, agakwana n’Elifasi Omotemani, akamoteebia, “Nabeire nendamwamu asore na ase abasani bao baria babere, ekiagera inwe timokwaneti ayare ay’oboronge igoro yane buna Ayubu, omosomba one, akwanete.

English: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”
Kiswahili: Basi sasa chukueni mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba mkamwendee mtumishi wangu Ayubu nanyi mkatoe sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa ajili yenu wenyewe. Mtumishi wangu Ayubu ataomba kwa ajili yenu, nami nitayakubali maombi yake ili nisiwatendee sawasawa na upumbavu wenu. Ninyi hamkusema yaliyo sawa kwa habari yangu, kama alivyosema mtumishi wangu Ayubu.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo bono ira ase Ayubu, omosomba one, chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere; mochirue chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase engencho yaino inwe abanyene. Ayubu, omosomba one, nabasabere, ekiagera inche nigo ndanchere ogosaba kwaye ase engencho yaino, timbaisa kobakorera buna oboriri bwaino bore. Inwe timokwaneti igoro yane amang’ana are ay’oboronge buna Ayubu, omosomba one, akwanete.”

English: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what Yahweh commanded them, and Yahweh accepted Job.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Elifazi Mtemani, Bildadi Mshuhi, na Sofari Mnaamathi wakafanya kama Bwana alivyowaambia; naye Bwana akayakubali maombi ya Ayubu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Elifasi Omotemani, na Bilidadi Omosua, na Sofari Omonama, bakagenda bagakora buna Omonene abachigete, n’Omonene aganchera ogosaba kw’Ayubu.

English: Yahweh restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Ayubu kuwaombea rafiki zake, Bwana akamwondoa kwenye uteka, akamfanikisha tena naye akampa mara mbili ya vile alivyokuwa navyo hapo mwanzoni.
Ekegusii: Erio magega Ayubu gasabeire abasani baria baye, Omonene akairaneria Ayubu amaya aye, akamoa ebinto ara kabere kobua ebi abwate ritang’ani.

English: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that Yahweh had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.
Kiswahili: Ndipo ndugu zake wote waume kwa wake na kila mtu aliyemfahamu mwanzoni, wakaja wakala pamoja naye katika nyumba yake. Wakamfariji na kumtuliza moyo juu ya taabu yote Bwana aliyoileta juu yake, nao kila mmoja akampa kipande cha fedha na pete ya dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Erio abamura bamwabo Ayubu, na abasubati bamwabo, na abasani baye bonsi abamomanyete agwo ritang’ani, bagacha asare, bakaragera amo nere nyomba mwaye. Bakamororera amabebe na komoremia ase engencho y’amabe aria onsi Omonene amorenterete, na kera oyomo akamoa chitaabu na ebonyi eroisirie korwa ase etaabu.

English: So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
Kiswahili: Bwana akaibariki sehemu ya mwisho ya maisha ya Ayubu kuliko ile ya kwanza. Alikuwa na kondoo elfu kumi na nne, ngamia elfu sita, jozi za mafahali elfu moja, na punda wa kike elfu moja.
Ekegusii: Omonene agasesenia amatuko a magega ay’Ayubu kobua aye ritang’ani. Boigo Ayubu akanyora ching’ondi chilifu ikomi na inye, ne chingamia chilifu isano nemo, ne chiombe chilifu ibere, ne chitigere chiaberi elifu eyemo.

English: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
Kiswahili: Tena alikuwa na wana saba na binti watatu.
Ekegusii: Boigo akaegwa abamura batano na babere, na abaiseke batato.

English: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.
Kiswahili: Binti wa kwanza aliitwa Yemima, wa pili Kesia na wa tatu Keren-Hapuki.
Ekegusii: Akaroka omoiseke omotang’ani Yemima, na oyo o kabere Kesia, na oyo o gatato Kereni‐Hapuki.

English: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
Kiswahili: Hapakuwepo mahali popote katika nchi ile yote palipopatikana wanawake wazuri kama binti za Ayubu; naye baba yao akawapa urithi pamoja na ndugu zao.
Ekegusii: Ase ense eyio yonsi bakungu bande tibarengeo baare abanyabieni buna abaiseke b’Ayubu, na ise akabaa omwando amo nabamura bamwabo.

English: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hili Ayubu akaishi miaka 140; akawaona wanawe na wana wa wanawe hata kizazi cha nne.
Ekegusii: Na magega y’ayio Ayubu akagenderera koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, akarora abana baye, na abachokoro, na abachokororia, goika ekiaare gia kane.

English: So Job died, being old and full of days.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Ayubu akafa, akiwa mzee aliyekuwa ameshiba siku.
Ekegusii: Na Ayubu agakwa kabeire omogotu mono.

English: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule ambaye haendi katika shauri la watu waovu, wala hasimami katika njia ya wenye dhambi, au kuketi katika baraza la wenye mizaha.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto otari gotunyana chingencho chi’abakori amabe, n’otari kobwatia chinchera chi’abanyabibe, gose otari gosanga amo nabwo bagochecheria.

English: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
Kiswahili: Bali huifurahia sheria ya Bwana, naye huitafakari hiyo sheria usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: Korende richiko ri’Omonene nigo rikomogokia mono, na okorengereria kwaye gwonsi nigo kore ase richiko erio, omobaso na obotuko.

English: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
Kiswahili: Mtu huyo ni kama mti uliopandwa kando ya vijito vya maji, ambao huzaa matunda kwa majira yake na majani yake hayanyauki. Lolote afanyalo hufanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo anga buna omote osimekire rooche mbarabare, oyokwama amatunda amaya ekero engaki yaye egoika, na amato aye tari kwoma ngaki ende yonsi, na rinde rionsi agokora nigo agosesenigwa.

English: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
Kiswahili: Sivyo walivyo waovu! Wao ni kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe tibari bo, korende nigo banga buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.

English: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo waovu hawatastahimili hukumu, wala wenye dhambi katika kusanyiko la wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abakori amabe tibagocha gwekengera ase rituko ri’ekiina, gose abanyabibe tibagosangererekana amo n’abanyene oboronge.
