English: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana huziangalia njia za mwenye haki, bali njia ya waovu itaangamia.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoraa enchera y’abanyene oboronge, korende enchera y’abakori amabe nesire.

English: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mataifa wanashauriana kufanya mabaya, na kabila za watu kula njama bure?
Ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bagokora rirorooche? Nase ki abanto bagokora emeroberio ere bosa?

English: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,
Kiswahili: Wafalme wa dunia wanajipanga na watawala wanajikusanya pamoja dhidi ya Bwana na dhidi ya Mpakwa Mafuta wake.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense bebekire ang’e, na abagaambi nigo bakogamba amo ase okwanga Omonene na Omoakwa Amaguta oye.

English: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
Kiswahili: Wanasema, “Tuvunje minyororo yao na kuvitupilia mbali vifungo vyao.”
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoteebania: “Tobutore ebisibo biabo, totugute chingori chiabo batosiberete!”

English: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
Kiswahili: Yeye atawalaye mbinguni hucheka, Bwana huwadharau.
Ekegusii: Omonene oria oikaransete aaria igoro, nigo agoseka na kobachecheria.

English: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
Kiswahili: Kisha huwakemea katika hasira yake na kuwaogopesha katika ghadhabu yake, akisema,
Ekegusii: Erio nabatogonyere ase endamwamu yaye, abagose ase ekeririanda kiaye, ogoteeba:

English: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
Kiswahili: “Nimemtawaza Mfalme wangu juu ya Sayuni, mlima wangu mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: “Nabeekire omorwoti one ase Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu.”

English: I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
Kiswahili: Nitatangaza amri ya Bwana: Yeye aliniambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu, leo mimi nimekuzaa.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti oteebire: “Nindarie amang’an’Omonene aroberetie. Ere aganteebia: Aye naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire.

English: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
Kiswahili: Niombe, nami nitayafanya mataifa kuwa urithi wako, miisho ya dunia kuwa milki yako.
Ekegusii: Omborie, na inche ninkoe ebisaku bionsi bibe omwando oo, ne chinsemo chionsi chi’ense nchibe echiao.

English: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
Kiswahili: Utawatawala kwa fimbo ya chuma na kuwavunjavunja kama chombo cha mfinyanzi.”
Ekegusii: Aye nobasenyente nenyimbo y’ekioma, obasegenye babe buna ebigonkorio.”

English: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ninyi wafalme, kuweni na hekima; mwonyeke, enyi watawala wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abarwoti, mobe abang’aini, inwe abagaambi b’ense, igwera ogokuurerwa oko:

English: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
Kiswahili: Mtumikieni Bwana kwa hofu na mshangilie kwa kutetemeka.
Ekegusii: Mokorere Omonene more nobwoba na okoiguswa.

English: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
Kiswahili: Mbusu Mwana, asije akakasirika nawe ukaangamizwa katika njia yako, kwa maana hasira yake inaweza kuwaka ghafula. Heri wote wanaomkimbilia.
Ekegusii: Tugama inse na kworokia amasikani ase Omwana oye. Motakoreti bo, Omonene nigo arabe nendamwamu, abasirie ase chinchera chiaino, ekiagera endamwamu yaye nigo egwoka bwango mbasesenirie abanto bonsi bakomotamera.

English: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Alipomkimbia mwanawe Absalomu. Ee Bwana, tazama adui zangu walivyo wengi! Ni wengi kiasi gani wanaoinuka dhidi yangu!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi ekero arenge gotama Abisalomu, omwana oye) Aye Omonene, ababisa baane mbarenga bare! Abange banyimokeire gonkorera bobe.

English: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
Kiswahili: Wengi wanasema juu yangu, “Mungu hatamwokoa.”
Ekegusii: Abange nigo bagokwana igoro yane, bateeba: Nyasae tancheti komotooria.

English: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, ni ngao pande zote; umeniwekea utukufu na kuinua kichwa changu.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, aye naye enguba yane, na naye obonene bwane, nigo okong’iraneria oboremu bw’obobui bwane.

English: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
Kiswahili: Ninamlilia Bwana kwa sauti kuu, naye ananijibu kutoka mlima wake mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkorera na gokuura ase Omonene ng’a ankonye, nere nigo akong’iraneria korwa ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu.

English: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.
Kiswahili: Ninajilaza na kupata usingizi; naamka tena, kwa maana Bwana hunitegemeza.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngwetoora na korara chitoro, erio naboka naende, ekiagera Omonene nigo agendererete kondenda.

English: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
Kiswahili: Sitaogopa makumi elfu ya adui, wanaojipanga dhidi yangu kila upande.
Ekegusii: Tindi koiroka ababisa chilifu chinyinge, abwo mamincha yane, bakondia korwa chinsemo chiane chionsi.

English: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, amka! Niokoe, Ee Mungu wangu! Wapige adui zangu wote kwenye taya, vunja meno ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene imoka, gaki, inchwo! Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie! Aye gwaakire ababisa baane bonsi oroe ase chinsea chiabo, kwabunire amaino ’abakori amabe kwabakorire bosa.

English: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wokovu watoka kwa Bwana. Baraka yako na iwe juu ya watu wako.
Ekegusii: Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa asore aye bweka Omonene; ase ayio, sesenia abanto bao.

English: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa ala za nyuzi za muziki. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nijibu nikuitapo, Ee Mungu wangu mwenye haki! Nipumzishe katika shida zangu; nirehemu, usikie ombi langu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, aye okong’a oboronge, ong’iranerie ekero ngokorangeria! Ekero narenge nkomiga‐migwa nobokong’u nigo kwang’ete ribaga rigare. Indorera amaabera, na oigwe ogosaba kwane!

English: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.
Kiswahili: Enyi watu, mtabadilisha utukufu wangu kuwa aibu mpaka lini? Mtapenda udanganyifu na kufuata miungu ya uongo mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: Inwe Mwanyabaanto, ngoika ririri moragenderere korenta emechando na kobeka echayo ase obonene bwane? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwancha amang’ana abosa na korigia ay’oborimo?

English: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly; Yahweh will hear when I call to him.
Kiswahili: Fahamuni hakika kwamba Bwana amewatenga wale wamchao kwa ajili yake; Bwana atanisikia nimwitapo.
Ekegusii: Korende manya ng’a Omonene bwechoreire omonyene oboronge. Omonene nigo akonyigwa ekero nkomosaba.

English: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
Kiswahili: Katika hasira yako, usitende dhambi. Mkiwa vitandani mwenu, mtulie kimya mkiichunguza mioyo yenu.
Ekegusii: Nabo morabee, korende timobaisa gokora ebibe; morengereria mono kegima amang’ana ayio ime ye chinkoro chiano ekero mokorara ase amarere aino, na mobe abatoereru.

English: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Toeni dhabihu zilizo haki; mtegemeeni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Karue ebing’wanso bi’oboronge, na mosemerie Omonene.

English: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
Kiswahili: Wengi wanauliza, “Ni nani awezaye kutuonyesha jema lolote?” Ee Bwana, tuangazie nuru ya uso wako.
Ekegusii: Abanto abange bagokwana iga: “Naki yare koba buya onye ’ntwanyora ayare amaya.” Aye Omonene, tiga omobaso bw’obosio bwao otomorekere.

English: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
Kiswahili: Wewe umejaza moyo wangu kwa furaha kubwa kuliko watu waliopata nafaka na divai kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Kwang’eire omogooko ase enkoro yane ime ore omuya kobua oyo abanto bande bakonyora, abwo bare nobonge bw’endagera na edivai.

English: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
Kiswahili: Nitajilaza chini na kulala kwa amani, kwa kuwa wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, waniwezesha kukaa kwa salama.
Ekegusii: Ekero ngochia gwetoora koraara, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.

English: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa filimbi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, tegea sikio maneno yangu, uangalie kupiga kite kwangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane; oiraneria egekoe kiane.

English: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza kilio changu ili unisaidie, Mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu, kwa maana kwako ninaomba.
Ekegusii: Aye omorwoti one, aye Nyasae one, tegerera oigwe amang’ana ’okorera kwane, ekiagera naye ngosaba.

English: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi, unasikia sauti yangu, Ee Bwana; asubuhi naleta haja zangu mbele zako, na kusubiri kwa matumaini.
Ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba kwane maambia; kobogokiamoka nigo nkobeka okogania kwane obosio bwao, erio naganya ntegesetie.

English: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
Kiswahili: Wewe si Mungu unayefurahia uovu, kwako mtu mwovu hataishi.
Ekegusii: Aye tori Nyasae bwanchete ogokora okobe. Oyogokora ebibe takonyara komenya amo naye.

English: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
Kiswahili: Wenye kiburi hawawezi kusimama mbele yako, unawachukia wote watendao mabaya.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaenenu tibakonyara gotenena obosio bwao, nigo ogechete abakori amabe bonsi.

English: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
Kiswahili: Unawaangamiza wasemao uongo. Bwana huwachukia wamwagao damu na wadanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo orasirie abanyaborimo bonsi; aye Omonene nigo ogechete abaiteri amanyinga na abang’ainereria.

English: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi, kwa rehema zako kuu, nitakuja katika nyumba yako, kwa unyenyekevu, nitasujudu kuelekea Hekalu lako takatifu.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’obonge bw’obwanchani bwao botari koera ninsoe nyomba mwao; nigo ndasasime ndigereretie Hekalu yao Enchenu na nimbe ngokoiroka.

English: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
Kiswahili: Niongoze katika haki yako, Ee Bwana, kwa sababu ya adui zangu, nyoosha njia yako mbele yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo mbwate ababisa abange, ase ayio, ondaae ase oboronge bwao; roisia enchera yao ase ngoetera ebe endonge.

English: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
Kiswahili: Hakuna neno kinywani mwao linaloweza kuaminika, mioyo yao imejaa maangamizi. Koo lao ni kaburi lililo wazi, kwa ndimi zao, wao hunena udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ababisa baane bagokwana nay’oborimo, chinkoro chiabo nigo chire nemeroberio y’ogosiria kegima; emioyo yabo noboina bwasie, chimeme chiabo nigo chigokwana amang’ana amansu ay’ogosiria.

English: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
Kiswahili: Uwatangaze kuwa wenye hatia, Ee Mungu! Hila zao ziwe anguko lao wenyewe. Wafukuzie mbali kwa sababu ya dhambi zao nyingi, kwa kuwa wamekuasi wewe.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, obae egesusuro ase ebibe biabo: emeroberio eyio bakorire tiga egere bagwe. Obaserie kegima, ekiagera basaririe asore, na ekiagera bangire gokoigwera.

English: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
Kiswahili: Lakini wote wakimbiliao kwako na wafurahi, waimbe kwa shangwe daima. Ueneze ulinzi wako juu yao, ili wale wapendao jina lako wapate kukushangilia.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abakogotamera mbabe nomogooko, barabwo mbatere kogenderera botambe na gochenga. Aye igo orakengere abwo banchete erieta riao, erio banyare koba nomogooko omonene ase engencho yao.

English: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
Kiswahili: Kwa hakika, Ee Bwana, unawabariki wenye haki, unawazunguka kwa wema wako kama ngao.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ogosesenia omonyene oboronge na komotuba n’obuya bwao bw’amaabera buna enguba.

English: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa ala za nyuzi za muziki. Mtindo wa sheminithi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, usinikemee katika hasira yako, wala usiniadhibu katika ghadhabu yako.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omonene, tontogonyera ekero ore nendamwamu; tong’a egesusuro gi’okondongeyia ekero ore nekeririanda.

English: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
Kiswahili: Unirehemu Bwana, kwa maana nimedhoofika; Ee Bwana, uniponye, kwa maana mifupa yangu ina maumivu makali.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ndorera amaabera, ekiagera ’nde omonyanyuru. Aye Omonene, ’ngwenie, ekiagera amauga aane nigo akonyegerigwa.

English: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu ina uchungu mwingi. Mpaka lini, Ee Bwana, mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: Omoyo one ochandekire nomoondoko. Omonene, ngoika ririri orenane otarankonya?

English: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
Kiswahili: Geuka Ee Bwana, unikomboe, uniokoe kwa sababu ya fadhili zako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’iranere omboorie! Ontoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera.

English: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu anayekukumbuka akiwa amekufa. Ni nani awezaye kukusifu akiwa kuzimu?
Ekegusii: Ase abwo bakuure onde tari oranyare gokoinyora. Inee! Ning’o oranyare kogotogia korwa aase abakuure?

English: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
Kiswahili: Nimechakaa kwa kulia kwa huzuni; usiku kucha nafurikisha kitanda changu kwa machozi; nimelowesha viti vyangu vya fahari kwa machozi.
Ekegusii: Nanyarekire ase okwerera kwane kw’obororo, kera obotuko nigo ngoteremia namariga ase oborere bwane, ebirarero biane biaichoirwe namariga.

English: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yamedhoofika kwa kuhuzunika, yamedhoofika kwa sababu ya adui zangu wote.
Ekegusii: Obosio bwane bwomire pa ase engencho y’emechando, bwareeire ase engencho y’ababisa baane bonsi.

English: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.
Kiswahili: Kaeni mbali nami, ninyi nyote mtendao mabaya, kwa maana Bwana amesikia kulia kwangu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abakori amabe, karue asende ekiagera Omonene oigure eriogi ria ebirero biane.

English: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.
Kiswahili: Bwana amesikia kilio changu kwa huruma, Bwana amekubali sala yangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene oigure okoboria kwane gw’okonyora amaabera, nere bwancheire ogosaba kwane.

English: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
Kiswahili: Adui zangu wote wataaibika na kufadhaika, watarudi nyuma kwa aibu ya ghafula.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baane bonsi mbarore obosooku, bagoswe na koondokigwa mono kegima, mbairane gochia magega bwango bare nobosooku.

English: A meditation by David, which he sang to Yahweh, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
Kiswahili: Ombolezo la Daudi kwa Bwana kwa sababu ya Kushi, Mbenyamini. Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, ninakukimbilia wewe, uniokoe na kunikomboa na wote wanaonifuatia,
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omonene one, Nyasae one, naye ngotamera, intoorie korwa ase abachandi baane, ’nkonye!

English: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
Kiswahili: la sivyo watanirarua kama simba na kunichana vipande vipande, asiwepo wa kuniokoa.
Ekegusii: Onye taibo, nigo barantaborane bare buna chindo, ’mbankurure gochia aase omonto onde otache gontooria.

English: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, kama nimetenda haya na kuna hatia mikononi mwangu,
Ekegusii: Omonene one, Nyasae one, onye nakorire amang’ana aya, onye nakorire amabe namaboko aane,

English: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),
Kiswahili: au ikiwa nimemtenda uovu aliye na amani nami, au nimemnyangʼanya adui yangu pasipo sababu,
Ekegusii: onye naakanire omosani one amabe, gose nasakoire ebinto bi’omobisa one ase engencho ende etaiyo,

English: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
Kiswahili: basi adui anifuatie na kunipata, auponde uhai wangu ardhini na kunilaza mavumbini.
Ekegusii: rirorio tiga omobisa one ambwatie na kombwata, erio antiringere inse egere asirie obogima bwane, erio ansarerie amasikani.

English: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
Kiswahili: Amka kwa hasira yako, Ee Bwana, inuka dhidi ya ghadhabu ya adui zangu. Amka, Mungu wangu, uamue haki.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka kore nendamwamu yao, imokerera igoro orwanie ekeririanda ki’ababisa baane! Inchuo onkonye! Aye gwachikiire ekiina.

English: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko la watu na likuzunguke. Watawale kutoka juu.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi tiga basangererekane bagoetanane; obagambere korwa ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene aaria igoro.

English: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
Kiswahili: Bwana na awahukumu kabila za watu. Nihukumu Ee Bwana, kwa kadiri ya haki yangu, kwa kadiri ya uadilifu wangu, Ewe Uliye Juu Sana.
Ekegusii: Omonene, naye okogamba na konachera abanto bonsi ekiina. Aye Omonene, onachere inche ekiina koreng’ana noboronge bwane, na buna ntari na komocha.

English: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu mwenye haki, uchunguzaye mawazo na mioyo, komesha ghasia za waovu na ufanye wenye haki waishi kwa amani.
Ekegusii: Tiga ebibe bi’abakori amabe biere, korende omonto omooronge omotenenie bokong’u. Aye Nyasae omonyene oboronge nigo okorenga chinkoro na emioyo.

English: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
Kiswahili: Ngao langu ni Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, awaokoaye wanyofu wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere enguba yane, ere nigo agotooria abare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
Kiswahili: Mungu ni mwamuzi mwenye haki, Mungu aghadhibikaye kila siku.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are omogambi omooronge, na kera rituko nigo akoba nekeririanda ase abakori amabe.

English: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
Kiswahili: Kama hakutuhurumia, atanoa upanga wake, ataupinda na kuufunga uzi upinde wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto karaange gweitia, Nyasae natierie omoro oye, natinge obota bwaye abobeke ang’e.

English: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
Kiswahili: Ameandaa silaha zake kali, ameweka tayari mishale yake ya moto.
Ekegusii: Oroisirie ebirwanero biaye ebiogoita omonto buna oyio, akore emegwe yaye esambe buna omorero.

English: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliye na mimba ya uovu na achukuaye mimba ya ghasia huzaa uongo.
Ekegusii: Omonyabibe nigo aichire nobobe, nigo are morito, oborito bw’ogosaria na gakoibora oibara oborimo.

English: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
Kiswahili: Yeye achimbaye shimo na kulifukua hutumbukia katika shimo alilochimba mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo agokunya eirima entambe, korende ogwa ime y’eirima eyio ere omonyene.

English: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
Kiswahili: Ghasia azianzishazo humrudia mwenyewe, ukatili wake humrudia kichwani.
Ekegusii: Emechando yaye nigo ekomoiranera; na ogokora kwaye okobe kwamogwera ere omonyene.

English: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
Kiswahili: Nitamshukuru Bwana kwa ajili ya haki yake, na nitaliimbia sifa jina la Bwana Aliye Juu Sana.
Ekegusii: Ning’akere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye; nimotererie Omonene ogoteera kw’ogotogia erieta riaye, oyore Igoro Mono kegima.

English: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa gitithi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, Bwana wetu, tazama jinsi lilivyo tukufu jina lako duniani mwote! Umeuweka utukufu wako juu ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, aye Omonene oito, erieta riao naki riakuma iga ense yonsi! Obonene bwao nigo bogotogigwa nonya ngoika igoro.

English: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
Kiswahili: Midomoni mwa watoto wachanga na wanyonyao umeamuru sifa, kwa sababu ya watesi wako, kumnyamazisha adui na mlipiza kisasi.
Ekegusii: Ase emenwa y’abana n’eyabakogonka nigo kweagacheire eburi bosio bw’ababisa bao, erinde okoiyeria ababisa bao inse na abakorusia egesiomba.

English: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,
Kiswahili: Nikiziangalia mbingu zako, kazi ya vidole vyako, mwezi na nyota, ulizoziratibisha,
Ekegusii: Ekero nkorigereria gochia igoro, na korora emeremo gwakorete namaboko ao, omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni, ebi kwabegete kera ekemo ase aaye;

English: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
Kiswahili: mwanadamu ni kitu gani hata unamfikiria, binadamu ni nani hata unamjali?
Ekegusii: omonto ’nki aisaine aye ogendererete komorengereria? Mwanyabaanto ’nki aisaine aye okomorenda?

English: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
Kiswahili: Umemfanya chini kidogo kuliko viumbe wa mbinguni, ukamvika taji ya utukufu na heshima.
Ekegusii: Kwamokorire koba inse kegima asore aye omonyene, Nyasae; korende kwamoboirie obonene na amasikani.

English: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
Kiswahili: Umemfanya mtawala juu ya kazi za mikono yako; umeweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu yake.
Ekegusii: Kwamobekire kogambera ebinto bionsi gwatongete; kwabekire ebitongwa bionsi inse y’amagoro aye:

English: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
Kiswahili: Mifugo na makundi yote pia, naam, na wanyama wa kondeni,
Ekegusii: ching’ondi chionsi ne chiombe, amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana,

English: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
Kiswahili: ndege wa angani na samaki wa baharini, naam, kila kiogeleacho katika njia za bahari.
Ekegusii: ne chinyoni chikoiruruka amo ne chinswe chi’enyancha, na kende gionsi kegoetanana ase chindiba chie chinyancha.

English: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, Bwana wetu, tazama jinsi lilivyo tukufu jina lako duniani mwote!
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, aye Omonene oito, naki erieta riao riakuma ense yonsi!

English: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa muth-labeni. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, nitakutukuza kwa moyo wangu wote, nitayasimulia matendo yako yote ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ningoakere mbuya mono kegima n’enkoro yane yonsi. Nindarie emeremo yao yonsi y’ogokumia.

English: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
Kiswahili: Nitafurahi na kushangilia ndani yako. Nitaliimbia sifa jina lako, Ewe Uliye Juu Sana.
Ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga mono kegima ase engencho yao, nintere na gotogia erieta riao, aye Omonene Ore Igoro Mono Kegima.

English: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
Kiswahili: Adui zangu wamerudi nyuma, wamejikwaa na kuangamia mbele zako.
Ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baane bakoirana magega, bagwe inse na gosirigwa bosio bwao.

English: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana umetetea haki yangu na msimamo wangu; umeketi kwenye kiti chako cha enzi, ukihukumu kwa haki.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okonacha ekiina kiane ase oboronge; noikaransete ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kore omonachi ebiina omooronge.

English: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Umekemea mataifa na kuwaangamiza waovu; umeyafuta majina yao milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatogonyeire abanto b’ebisaku na gosiria abakori amabe, gwasiririe amarieta abo kegima, tibakoinyorwa goika kare na kare.

English: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
Kiswahili: Uharibifu usiokoma umempata adui, umeingʼoa miji yao; hata kumbukumbu lao limetoweka.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baerire, basirigwe kegima, gwatagoire emechie yabo, barabwo bebirwe, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake.

English: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
Kiswahili: Bwana anatawala milele, ameweka kiti chake cha enzi apate kuhukumu.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo are omorwoti o kare na kare, obekire ang’e ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, erinde anache ekiina.

English: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
Kiswahili: Mungu atahukumu ulimwengu kwa haki, atatawala mataifa kwa haki.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aragambie ense ase oboronge na konachera abanto ekiina gi’ekeene atari gwanchereria.

English: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni kimbilio la watu wanaoonewa, ni ngome imara wakati wa shida.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are obotamero ase abwo bagokorerwa bobe, nere obotamero ase chingaki chi’emechando.

English: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
Kiswahili: Wote wanaolijua jina lako watakutumaini wewe, kwa maana wewe Bwana, hujawaacha kamwe wakutafutao.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bamanyete erieta riao, nigo bagosemeretie, ekiagera aye Omonene togotiga abwo bagokorigia.

English: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana sifa, amefanywa mtawala Sayuni, tangazeni miongoni mwa mataifa, yale aliyoyatenda.
Ekegusii: Tera amatera ase ogotogia Omonene oyomenyete Sayoni! Teebia ebisaku bionsi buna ogokora kwaye gokumete!

English: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye alipizaye kisasi cha damu hukumbuka, hapuuzi kilio cha wanaoonewa.
Ekegusii: Ere oyo okorusia egesiomba ase okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga na koinyora abaichanete, Omonene tari kweba ekerero ki’abwo bagokorerwa bobe.

English: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, tazama jinsi walivyo wengi adui zangu wanaonitesa! Nihurumie, uniinue kutoka malango ya mauti,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ndorere amaabera! Rora emechando eye abanto bangechete bakondetera. Aye kwandusirie korwa ase ebiita bi’amakweri,

English: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
Kiswahili: ili niweze kutangaza sifa zako katika malango ya Binti Sayuni na huko niushangilie wokovu wako.
Ekegusii: erinde intenene ase abanto ba Sayoni, ase ebiita biabo nimbatebie amang’ana onsi agerire nkogotogia; ningokere ogotooreka kwao.

English: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
Kiswahili: Mataifa wameanguka kwenye shimo walilolichimba, miguu yao imenaswa kwenye wavu waliouficha.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bagure ase eirima bakunyete, na ase oboreba babisete bombwate, babwatirwe barabwo abanyene.

English: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.
Kiswahili: Bwana anajulikana kwa haki yake, waovu wamenaswa katika kazi za mikono yao.
Ekegusii: Omonene bwemanyekanirie ase okonacha ebiina bia boronge; abakori amabe babwatirwe ase ogokora kwabo abanyene.

English: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
Kiswahili: Waovu wataishia kuzimu, naam, mataifa yote wanaomsahau Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bakogenda gochia aase abakuure, naboigo gochia ase nabaanto bonsi b’ebisaku abwo bebire Nyasae.

English: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
Kiswahili: Lakini mhitaji hatasahaulika siku zote, wala matumaini ya walioonewa hayatapotea.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaremerwa tibakwebwa kogenderera botambe, na ogosemeria kw’abagokorerwa bobe tikogosira nonya ng’ake.

English: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, inuka, usimwache binadamu ashinde. Mataifa na yahukumiwe mbele zako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, gaki ’nchuo! Totiga abanto babue, tiga abanto b’Ebisaku banacherwe ekiina ase obosio bwao.

English: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wapige kwa hofu, mataifa na yajue kuwa wao ni watu tu.
Ekegusii: Omonene, obaondokie! Tiga bamanye ng’a barabwo botaambe nigo bare Mwanyabaanto.

English: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini, Ee Bwana, unasimama mbali? Kwa nini unajificha wakati wa shida?
Ekegusii: Omonene, naki gwateneneire aare iga? Naki okwebisa, otari kororekana chingaki chi’emechando?

English: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
Kiswahili: Katika kiburi chake, mwovu humtesa maskini, waovu na wanaswe katika hila wanazozitunga.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe baenenire na gokorera abaremerwa bobe. Tiga babwatwe barabwo abanyene ase emeroberio yabo y’obobe.

English: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hujivunia tamaa za moyo wake; humbariki mlafi na kumtukana Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto omokori ebibe nigo agwetogeria okogania okobe gw’enkoro yaye; na omonto ore ne ribero nigo akoragereri’Omonene ase okomochecheria.

English: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
Kiswahili: Katika kiburi chake, mwovu hamtafuti Mungu, katika mawazo yake yote hakuna nafasi ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe ase oboenenu bwaye nigo agoteeba ng’a Nyasae takomoa egesusuro. Ase ebirengerio biaye ime nigo agokaga ng’a Nyasae tari.

English: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
Kiswahili: Njia zake daima hufanikiwa; hujivuna na amri zako ziko mbali naye, huwacheka kwa dharau adui zake wote.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera gokiina ase chinchera chiaye. Ebina biao okonacha nigo bire igoro mono, takobimanya; nigo agochaaya ababisa baye bonsi.

English: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
Kiswahili: Anajisemea mwenyewe, “Hakuna kitakachonitikisa, daima nitakuwa na furaha, kamwe sitakuwa na shida.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio ase enkoro yaye ime oteeba iga: “Tinkwoboa gento kende, tinkonyorwa na bobe bonde nonya ng’ake.”

English: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
Kiswahili: Kinywa chake kimejaa laana, uongo na vitisho; shida na ubaya viko chini ya ulimi wake.
Ekegusii: Aya agokwana nigo aichire okoragereria, na obong’ainereria, na ogokorera abande bobe; oromeme rwaye nigo robwate amang’ana obobe n’ogosaria.

English: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
Kiswahili: Huvizia karibu na vijiji; kutoka mafichoni huwanasa wasio na hatia, akivizia wapitaji.
Ekegusii: Nigo akwebisa ase emechie oboera abanto, oganya agwo ase ogoita abanto batari na komocha. Nigo agotengera konyora abanto batari na gokonywa konde,

English: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.
Kiswahili: Huvizia kama simba aliye mawindoni; huvizia kumkamata mnyonge, huwakamata wanyonge na kuwaburuza katika wavu wake.
Ekegusii: bw’ebisa aase are bobisi, buna endo ere ase egetutu eboerete, oganya ase okobwata abaremerwa; obabwata ekero akobakurura ase omoeto oye.

English: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
Kiswahili: Mateka wake hupondwa, huzimia; wanaanguka katika nguvu zake.
Ekegusii: Abaremerwa nigo bagosegenyigwa na koiyerigwa, barutwa endiba ime, abanto batari na gokonywa konde, obasiria n’echinguru chiaye.

English: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
Kiswahili: Anajisemea mwenyewe, “Mungu amesahau, huficha uso wake na haoni kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Igo ase enkoro yaye ime orengereria iga: “Nyasae tagwechandera kende, obisire obosio bwaye tayarora nonya ng’ake.”

English: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
Kiswahili: Inuka Bwana! Inua mkono wako, Ee Mungu. Usiwasahau wanyonge.
Ekegusii: Omonene, gaki ’nchuo! Aye Nyasae, rambora okoboko kwao, gaki tibweba bachandegete!

English: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mtu mwovu anamtukana Mungu? Kwa nini anajiambia mwenyewe, “Hataniita nitoe hesabu?”
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nase ki omonto omokori amabe akogochecheria, na gokaga ng’a aye tokomoa egesusuro?

English: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, unaona shida na huzuni, umekubali kuyapokea mkononi mwako. Mhanga anajisalimisha kwako, wewe ni msaada wa yatima.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okorora abachandeku na komanya okwerera kwabo, amang’ana ayio nigo oyabegete ase amaboko ao. Omonto otari na gokonywa konde nigo akwerua asore, ekiagera naye botambe ogokonya chintakana.

English: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
Kiswahili: Vunja mkono wa mtu mwovu na mbaya, mwite atoe hesabu ya maovu yake ambayo yasingejulikana.
Ekegusii: Saria chinguru chi’abakori amabe na abanyabibe, obae egesusuro ase amabe onsi bagokora goika toyarora naende.

English: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni Mfalme milele na milele, mataifa wataangamia watoke nchini mwake.
Ekegusii: Omonene n’Omorwoti o kare na kare; abanto b’Ebisaku batamomanyeti basirigwe ase ense yaye.

English: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
Kiswahili: Unasikia, Ee Bwana, shauku ya wanaoonewa, wewe huwatia moyo, na kusikiliza kilio chao,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogotegerera abanto abaitongo abakoganetie; nigo okobaigwa na kobeka chinkoro chiabo chinguru.

English: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
Kiswahili: ukiwatetea yatima na walioonewa, ili mwanadamu, ambaye ni udongo, asiogopeshe tena.
Ekegusii: Igo okoa chintakana na abachandeku oboronge bwabo, erinde monto onde bw’ense tabachanda naende.

English: For the Chief Musician. By David. In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Kwa Bwana ninakimbilia, unawezaje basi kuniambia: “Ruka kama ndege kwenye mlima wako.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omonene nere obotemero bwane! Nase ki rende mogonteebia: “Iruruka buna enyoni ogende gochia ebitunwa igoro?

English: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
Kiswahili: Hebu tazama, waovu wanapinda pinde zao, huweka mishale kwenye uzi wake, wakiwa gizani ili kuwapiga wale wanyofu wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Rigereria abakori amabe buna batingire amata abo, babekire chinsara chiabo ang’e ase chingori chi’amata, erinde barase abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
Kiswahili: Wakati misingi imeharibiwa, mwenye haki anaweza kufanya nini?”
Ekegusii: Onye amaroso atagoirwe, ngento ki omonto omooronge arakore?”

English: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
Kiswahili: Bwana yuko ndani ya Hekalu lake takatifu; Bwana yuko kwenye kiti chake cha enzi mbinguni. Huwaangalia wana wa watu, macho yake yanawajaribu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ime ye Hekalu yaye enchenu, ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene naaria igoro kere. Amaiso aye nigo amongerete, nigo arigereretie na korenga Mwanyabaanto.

English: Yahweh examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwajaribu wenye haki, lakini waovu na wanaopenda jeuri, nafsi yake huwachukia.
Ekegusii: Omonene arengete abare abaronge na abakori amabe, korende omoyo oye nigo ogechete abakori amabe na abagoita abande ase obotindi bwa bosa.

English: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
Kiswahili: Atawanyeshea waovu makaa ya moto mkali na kiberiti kinachowaka, upepo wenye joto kali ndio fungu lao.
Ekegusii: Natwerie abakori amabe omorero bw’amakara, amagena agosamba na omwaga ore n’oroguto rw’omorero, ’ng’a bibe egesusuro kiabo.

English: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mwenye haki, yeye hupenda haki. Wanyofu watauona uso wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nomonyene oboronge, nigo anchete ogokora kw’oboronge; abanto abare ne chinkoro chindonge mbarore obosio bwaye.

English: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa sheminithi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana tusaidie, kwa kuwa wacha Mungu wametoweka; waaminifu wametoweka miongoni mwa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omonene, gaki ayerera totoorie! Abakoirogete aye Nyasae baerire, abegenwa tibari konyorekana ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja humwambia jirani yake uongo; midomo yao ya hila huzungumza kwa udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi nigo bagoteebania amang’ana ’oborimo; nigo bare okong’o nyamenwa ebere na gokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia.

English: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
Kiswahili: Bwana na akatilie mbali midomo yote ya hila na kila ulimi uliojaa majivuno,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, koranche kiria emenwa y’abwo egokwana amang’ana ’okweansia, ne chimeme chi’abwo bagwetogia ase amang’ana y’oboenenu.

English: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
Kiswahili: ule unaosema, “Kwa ndimi zetu tutashinda; midomo ni mali yetu, bwana wetu ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: “Ase amang’ana ’emenwa yaito ntore ne chinguru, aya togokwana nigo agotokonya. Ning’o ore Omonene gotobua?”

English: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
Kiswahili: “Kwa sababu ya uonevu wa wanyonge na kulia kwa uchungu kwa wahitaji, nitainuka sasa,” asema Bwana. “Nitawalinda kutokana na wale wenye nia mbaya juu yao.”
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Bono ninchiche, ekiagera abataka baregirwe na abaremerwa nkorera bare. Nindwe oborendi obuya kegima ase abwo basemeretie kobonyora.”

English: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya Bwana ni safi, kama fedha iliyosafishwa katika tanuru, iliyosafishwa mara saba.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ’Omonene nigo are ay’obwegenwa naende n’amaachenu, nigo agwekaine efeta yasambirwe ase riera ri’omorero na koumorwa inse, yachenirwe ara gatano na kabere.

English: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, utatuweka salama na kutulinda na kizazi hiki milele.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otorende! Otorende botambe korwa ase obobe bw’ekegori eke.

English: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
Kiswahili: Watu waovu huenda wakiringa kila mahali wakati ambapo yule aliye mbaya sana ndiye anayeheshimiwa miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bagoetanana chinsemo chionsi, na obonyaka bonde bwonsi botogigwa ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Mpaka lini, Ee Bwana? Je, utanisahau milele? Utanificha uso wako mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere konyeba? Ngoika kare na kare? Ngoika ririri orabe kobisete obosio bwao ng’a tondora?

English: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
Kiswahili: Nitapambana na mawazo yangu mpaka lini, na kila siku kuwa na majonzi moyoni mwangu? Adui zangu watanishinda mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: Ngoika ririri ndabe ndemereretie emechando ase omoyo one, imbe nobororo ase enkoro yane rituko ase rituko? Ngoika ririri omobisa one arabe okogokera emechando yane?

English: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
Kiswahili: Nitazame, unijibu, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu. Yatie nuru macho yangu, ama sivyo nitalala usingizi wa mauti.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, aye Nyasae one, ondigererie, ong’iranerie ase ogosaba kwane! Ondamokie amaiso aane, timbaisa korara chitoro chi’amakweri.

English: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
Kiswahili: Adui yangu atasema, “Nimemshinda,” nao adui zangu watashangilia nitakapoanguka.
Ekegusii: Totiga omobisa one ateebe ng’a ombuire, na ababisa baane bonsi bachengere okogwa kwane.

English: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninategemea upendo wako usiokoma; moyo wangu unashangilia katika wokovu wako.
Ekegusii: Ninsemerie obwanchani bwao botari koera, enkoro yane negokere ogotooreka gokorwa asore.

English: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
Kiswahili: Nitamwimbia Bwana, kwa kuwa amekuwa mwema kwangu.
Ekegusii: Ningoterere aye Omonene, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya amange.

English: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Mpumbavu anasema moyoni mwake, “Hakuna Mungu.” Wameharibika, matendo yao ni maovu kabisa; hakuna hata mmoja atendaye mema.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Abanto abariri nigo bakorengereria ase chinkoro chiabo ime: “Nyasae tari.” Barabwo nabasareku, bagokora amang’ana ay’okogechia; onde tari ogokora ayare amaya, nonya noyomo.

English: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
Kiswahili: Bwana anawachungulia wanadamu chini kutoka mbinguni aone kama wako wenye akili, wowote wanaomtafuta Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arigereretie Mwanyabaanto korwa igoro, arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.

English: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
Kiswahili: Wote wamepotoka, wameharibika wote pamoja, hakuna atendaye mema. Naam, hakuna hata mmoja!
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi basirire enchera, bonsi amo bagundire; onde tari ogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.

English: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?
Kiswahili: Je, watendao mabaya kamwe hawatajifunza: wale ambao huwala watu wangu kama watu walavyo mkate, hao ambao hawamwiti Bwana?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abanto aba bonsi abakori amabe tibari nokomanya? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari korangeri’Omonene abakoonye.

English: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
Kiswahili: Wako hapo, wameingiwa na hofu kuu, maana Mungu yupo pamoja na wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo abanto abwo mbasogwe nomoondoko omonene mono, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo nabaanto abaronge.

English: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.
Kiswahili: Ninyi watenda mabaya mnakwamisha mipango ya maskini, bali Bwana ndiye kimbilio lao.
Ekegusii: Inwe abakori amabe nigo mogochaaya omooroberio bw’omonto otari na nguru, korende Omonene nere obotamero bwaye.

English: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
Kiswahili: Laiti wokovu wa Israeli ungalikuja kutoka Sayuni! Wakati Bwana arejeshapo wafungwa wa watu wake, Yakobo na ashangilie, Israeli na afurahi!
Ekegusii: Naki yare koba buya onye ogotooreka ngwachera Abaisraeli korwa Sayoni! Ekero Omonene arairanerie abanto baye amaya abo, abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo mbachenge, ee, Abaisraeli mbabe nomogooko.

English: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana, ni nani awezaye kukaa katika Hekalu lako? Nani awezaye kuishi katika mlima wako mtakatifu?
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ’monto ki oranyare komenya ase obomenyo bwao? Ning’o oranyare komenya ase egetunwa kiao egechenu?

English: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
Kiswahili: Ni yule aendaye pasipo mawaa, atendaye yaliyo haki, asemaye kweli toka moyoni mwake,
Ekegusii: Nomonto oria orogendo rwaye rore oroikeranu, oria ogokora kwaye kore okuya, na amang’ana agokwana korwa ase enkoro yaye nay’ekeene,

English: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
Kiswahili: na hana masingizio ulimini mwake, asiyemtenda jirani yake vibaya, na asiyemsingizia mwenzake,
Ekegusii: naende ere tari omogenki, omonto oyio tari gokorera monto onde bobe, gose tari gokwana onde bobe.

English: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
Kiswahili: ambaye humdharau mtu mbaya, lakini huwaheshimu wale wamwogopao Bwana, yule atunzaye kiapo chake hata kama anaumia.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo achayete oyobwangire na Nyasae, korende osika abwo bamoirogete Omonene. Karire eira na gotiana tari koonchoka, nonya egochia komorentera obokong’u.

English: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
Kiswahili: Yeye akopeshaye fedha yake bila riba, na hapokei rushwa dhidi ya mtu asiye na hatia. Mtu afanyaye haya kamwe hatatikisika.
Ekegusii: Ekero akorua chitaabu chiaye singo tari kogania ebitoki, omonto oyio tari koira risoya, erio kogera omonto otari nokomocha agambigwe. Omonto ogokora oboronge ase amang’ana ayio onsi namenye ase obotoereru kare na kare.

English: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa Daudi. Ee Mungu, uniweke salama, kwa maana kwako nimekimbilia.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, gaki ondende, ekiagera naye ngotamera.

English: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
Kiswahili: Nilimwambia Bwana, “Wewe ndiwe Bwana wangu; pasipo wewe sina jambo jema.”
Ekegusii: Nigo ngoteebia Omonene iga: “Aye naye Omonene one, obuya bwonsi ’nde nabwo nigo bokorwa asore.”

English: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya watakatifu walioko duniani, ndio walio wa fahari ambao ninapendezwa nao.
Ekegusii: Abanto abachenu bare ase ense nigo bare nobonene bokumete; abwo nabwo bangogeetie mono.

English: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
Kiswahili: Huzuni itaongezeka kwa wale wanaokimbilia miungu mingine. Sitazimimina sadaka zao za damu au kutaja majina yao midomoni mwangu.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakominyokera chinyasae ching’ao, nigo bakwementera emechando. Tinkoumora okoruegwa kw’amanyinga okwo bakorua, gose tingwatora amarieta abo n’ebikoba biane.

English: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
Kiswahili: Bwana umeniwekea fungu langu na kikombe changu; umeyafanya mambo yangu yote yawe salama.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere egetare kiane; nere okong’a onsi aya ’ngwenerete konyora; ere igo arendete aya antungetie.

English: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
Kiswahili: Alama za mipaka zimeniangukia mahali pazuri, hakika nimepata urithi mzuri.
Ekegusii: Ebintungetie biangwereire agwo aase are aagiya, ee, omwando one nigo ore omuya mono kegima.

English: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
Kiswahili: Nitamsifu Bwana ambaye hunishauri, hata wakati wa usiku moyo wangu hunifundisha.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngotogia Omonene oyo ogonsemia, ase obotuko enkoro yane nigo egonteebereria gokora igo.

English: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Kiswahili: Nimemweka Bwana mbele yangu daima. Kwa sababu yuko mkono wangu wa kuume, sitatikisika.
Ekegusii: Botambe, nigo ndigereretie Omonene; ere nigo are ensemo yane y’okorio, igo tinkwoboa.

English: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unafurahia, na ulimi wangu unashangilia; mwili wangu nao utapumzika salama,
Ekegusii: Ase igo, enkoro yane amo n’omoyo one nigo bire nomosasoko; nonya n’omobere one nigo omenyete ase ogosemeria.

English: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
Kiswahili: kwa maana hutaniacha kaburini, wala hutamwacha Mtakatifu Wako kuona uharibifu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, togontiga agwo aase abakuure gose togotiga omochenu oo agunde.

English: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
Kiswahili: Umenijulisha njia ya uzima; utanijaza na furaha mbele zako, pamoja na furaha za milele katika mkono wako wa kuume.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nonyorokererie enchera ekogenda ase obogima; ase obosio bwao noreo omogooko omonge mono kegima; ase ensemo yao y’okorio mboreo obwansu obuya goika kare na kare.

English: A Prayer by David. Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
Kiswahili: Sala ya Daudi. Sikia, Ee Bwana, kusihi kwangu kwa haki, sikiliza kilio changu. Tega sikio kwa ombi langu, halitoki kwenye midomo ya udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe okogania kwane kw’ogokorerwa oboronge, igwa okorera kwane na ogosaba kwane, omonwa one tori gokwana obong’ainereria.

English: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
Kiswahili: Hukumu yangu na itoke kwako, macho yako na yaone yale yaliyo haki.
Ekegusii: Aye omonyene onachere ekiina gi’okong’a oboronge, amaiso ao nigo akorora ayare ay’ekeene.

English: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
Kiswahili: Ingawa unauchunguza moyo wangu na kunikagua usiku, ingawa umenijaribu, hutaona chochote. Nimeamua kwamba kinywa changu hakitatenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kwarengire enkoro yane, nonya nase obotuko nigo ogonteema, kwauna-unirie na tonyoreti gento, amabe are ase enkoro yane tinkoyakwana.

English: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu matendo ya wanadamu: kwa neno la midomo yako, nimejiepusha na njia za wenye jeuri.
Ekegusii: Mang’ana ande onsi abanto bagokora, na koreng’ana namang’ana ao natigire kobwatia chinchera chi’abasaria.

English: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
Kiswahili: Hatua zangu zimeshikamana na njia zako; nyayo zangu hazikuteleza.
Ekegusii: Nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chiao botambe; amagoro aane tana-gotererigwa.

English: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, ninakuita, kwa kuwa utanijibu, nitegee sikio lako na usikie ombi langu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, nigo ngokorangeria ng’a onkonye, ekiagera aye nong’itabere; tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane ngokoboria.

English: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
Kiswahili: Uonyeshe ajabu ya upendo wako mkuu, wewe uokoaye kwa mkono wako wa kuume wale wanaokukimbilia kutokana na adui zao.
Ekegusii: Aye Omotooria bw’abagotamera okoboko kwao kwa borio korwa ase ababisa babo, oorokia obwanchani bwao bw’ogokumia.

English: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
Kiswahili: Nilinde kama mboni ya jicho lako, unifiche chini ya kivuli cha mbawa zako
Ekegusii: Indende buna orendete endorero y’eriso riao; intube ase ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao;

English: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
Kiswahili: kutokana na waovu wanaonishambulia, kutokana na adui wauaji wanaonizunguka.
Ekegusii: mbise korwa ase abakori amabe, abarigetie gonsiria, korwa ase ababisa bang’etanaine bang’ite.

English: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
Kiswahili: Huifunga mioyo yao iliyo migumu, vinywa vyao hunena kwa majivuno.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bare ne chinkoro chitari namaabera nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu.

English: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
Kiswahili: Wamenifuatia nyayo zangu, sasa wamenizingira, wakiwa macho, waniangushe chini.
Ekegusii: Bono bang’etananire ase chinsemo chionsi; banaaririe, erinde bambwate na konyiyeria inse.

English: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
Kiswahili: Wamefanana na simba mwenye njaa awindaye, kama simba mkubwa anyemeleaye mafichoni.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo banga buna endo eganetie orotwari; buna endo ensae eboete ase egesarara.

English: Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,
Kiswahili: Inuka, Ee Bwana, pambana nao, uwaangushe, niokoe kutokana na waovu kwa upanga wako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, gaki imoka! Orwanie ababisa baane obabue! Ntoorie korwa ase abakori amabe ase okobarwania n’omoro oo.

English: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, mkono wako uniokoe na watu wa jinsi hii, kutokana na watu wa ulimwengu huu ambao fungu lao liko katika maisha haya. Na wapate adhabu ya kuwatosha. Watoto wao na wapate zaidi ya hayo, hukumu na iendelee kwa watoto wa watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Ee, Omonene, ntoorie nokoboko kwao korwa ase abanto abwo. Barabwo nabaanto b’ense eye, egetari kiabo neki’obogima obo. Chinda chiabo chiisaneke n’ebinto ebio kwabagacheire, biisane nase abana babo, naende abachokoro babo batigerwe ebiatigaire.

English: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
Kiswahili: Na mimi katika haki nitauona uso wako, niamkapo, nitaridhika kwa kuona sura yako.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nindore obosio bwao inde noboronge; ekero ndabokigwe ning’isaneke ase ogokorora.

English: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi mtumishi wa Bwana aliyomwimbia Bwana wakati Bwana alipomwokoa mikononi mwa adui zake wote, na pia mkononi mwa Sauli. Alisema hivi: Nakupenda wewe, Ee Bwana, nguvu yangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera Daudi, omosomba bw’Omonene, atererete Omonene, ekero Omonene amotooretie korwa ase Saulo na ababisa bande) Aye Omonene, aye chinguru chiane, ningwanchete mono!

English: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwamba wangu, ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu, Mungu wangu ni mwamba, ambaye kwake ninakimbilia. Yeye ni ngao yangu na pembe ya wokovu wangu, ngome yangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi yane y’ogokumia, nere Omotooria one, na Nyasae one, Nyasae one nere egetare kiane ’ndatamere; nere enguba egonkengera, na Omotooria one bw’echinguru, oyo ogonkengera bokong’u.

English: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
Kiswahili: Ninamwita Bwana anayestahili kusifiwa, nami ninaokolewa kutoka kwa adui zangu.
Ekegusii: Nindangerie Omonene, oyo ogwenerete gotogigwa, nigo arantoorie korwa ase ababisa baane.

English: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
Kiswahili: Kamba za mauti zilinizunguka, mafuriko ya maangamizi yalinilemea.
Ekegusii: Obororo bw’amakweri bokong’etanana, chiooro chi’obobe chikandetera obwoba.

English: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
Kiswahili: Kamba za kuzimu zilinizunguka, mitego ya mauti ilinikabili.
Ekegusii: Obobe bw’amakweri nigo bwang’etananete, emeeto y’amakweri egantega na kombwata.

English: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
Kiswahili: Katika shida yangu nalimwita Bwana, nilimlilia Mungu wangu anisaidie. Kutoka hekaluni mwake alisikia sauti yangu, kilio changu kikafika mbele zake, masikioni mwake.
Ekegusii: Ase emechando yane nkarangeri’Omonene, nkarera ase Nyasae one ng’a ankonye. Korwa ase Hekalu yaye akaigwa eriogi riane, ekerero kiane gekamoikera, ere agakeigwa.

English: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
Kiswahili: Dunia ilitetemeka na kutikisika, misingi ya milima ikatikisika, vilitetemeka kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika.
Ekegusii: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, na amaroso ’ebitunwa agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene arenge nendamwamu.

English: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
Kiswahili: Moshi ukapanda kutoka puani mwake, moto uteketezao ukatoka kinywani mwake, makaa ya moto yawakayo yakatoka ndani mwake.
Ekegusii: Erioki rigasoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, na omorero ogosamba ogasoka korwa ase omonwa oye; ee, omorero bw’amakara ogasoka korwa asare.

English: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
Kiswahili: Akazipasua mbingu akashuka chini, mawingu meusi yalikuwa chini ya miguu yake.
Ekegusii: Akang’usa igoro gocha inse aa, agacha; riire rimwamu rikaba inse y’amagoro aye.

English: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
Kiswahili: Alipanda juu ya kerubi akaruka, akapaa juu kwa mbawa za upepo.
Ekegusii: Akariina egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, akairuruka, agacha ng’ora igoro ye chimbaaba chi’embeo.

English: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
Kiswahili: Alifanya giza kuwa kitu chake cha kujifunika, hema lake kumzunguka, mawingu meusi ya mvua ya angani.
Ekegusii: Agakora omosunte koba egietubo kiaye ere omonyenye, na amare amarito aichire amaache.

English: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na mwanga wa uwepo wake mawingu yalisogea, ikanyesha mvua ya mawe na umeme wa radi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase obomeka-meku obwo bwarenge bosio bwaye amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigasoka goetera ase amare aye.

English: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
Kiswahili: Bwana alinguruma kutoka mbinguni, sauti ya Aliye Juu Sana ilisikika.
Ekegusii: Omonene agaaka enkoba korwa igoro; na eriogi ri’Oyore Igoro Mono rikaigugwa; amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigacha.

English: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.
Kiswahili: Aliipiga mishale yake na kutawanya adui, naam, umeme mwingi wa radi na kuwafukuza.
Ekegusii: Akaruta emegwe yaye, agaserebania ababisa baye; akamesia chinkoba, akabatantania.

English: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
Kiswahili: Mabonde ya bahari yalifunuliwa, na misingi ya dunia ikawa wazi kwa kukaripia kwako, Ee Bwana, kwa uvumi wa pumzi kutoka puani mwako.
Ekegusii: Erio ebiambokero bi’enyancha bikarorekana, na amaroso ’ense akaorokigwa aarabu, ekero Omonene abatogonyerete ase ogwoka kw’omoika bwe chimioro chiaye.

English: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
Kiswahili: Alinyoosha mkono kutoka juu na kunishika; alinitoa kutoka kilindi cha maji makuu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amaache amange.

English: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
Kiswahili: Aliniokoa kutoka adui wangu mwenye nguvu nyingi, kutoka adui zangu waliokuwa na nguvu nyingi kuliko mimi.
Ekegusii: Agantooria korwa ase omobisa one ore ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo barenge ne chinguru kombua.

English: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
Kiswahili: Walinikabili siku ya msiba wangu, lakini Bwana alikuwa msaada wangu.
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge nemechando bakandwania, korende Omonene akaba egekengero kiane.

English: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
Kiswahili: Alinileta nje mahali penye nafasi tele, akaniokoa kwa kuwa alipendezwa nami.
Ekegusii: Akang’ira aase arenge aagare; agantooria, ekiagera namogogetie.

English: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
Kiswahili: Bwana alinitendea sawasawa na uadilifu wangu; sawasawa na usafi wa mikono yangu amenilipa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo ang’ete eng’eria y’obuya, ekiagera inde omooronge, nigo ansesenetie, ekiagera inde namaboko atari na komocha.

English: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nimezishika njia za Bwana; sijatenda ubaya nikamwacha Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chia Omonene, tintigeti Nyasae one ase ogokora obonyaka.

English: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
Kiswahili: Sheria zake zote zi mbele yangu, wala sijayaacha maagizo yake.
Ekegusii: Nabeire nkorenda amachiiko aye onsi, na timbeti ngotiga emeroberio yaye echiikire.

English: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa sina hatia mbele zake, nami nimejilinda nisitende dhambi.
Ekegusii: Nigo narenge omoikeranu asare, nkerenda korwa ase obobe.

English: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
Kiswahili: Bwana amenilipa sawasawa na uadilifu wangu; sawasawa na usafi wa mikono yangu machoni pake.
Ekegusii: Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera aroche ng’a amaboko aane achenekire.

English: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
Kiswahili: Kwa yeye aliye mwaminifu, unajionyesha kuwa mwaminifu, kwa asiye na hatia, unajionyesha kutokuwa na hatia.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omwegenwa ase abwo bare abegenwa, nigo okweorokia ng’a nomoikeranu ore ase abwo bare abaikeranu.

English: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
Kiswahili: Kwa aliye mtakatifu, unajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu, lakini kwa aliyepotoka, unajionyesha kuwa mkaidi.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu; nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.

English: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
Kiswahili: Wewe huwaokoa wanyenyekevu, lakini huwashusha wenye kiburi.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende abwo bare namaiso ’oboenenu nigo okobairania inse.

English: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
Kiswahili: Wewe, Ee Bwana, unaifanya taa yangu iendelee kuwaka; Mungu wangu hulifanya giza langu kuwa mwanga.
Ekegusii: Ee, naye ogontongeria etaya yane; Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo akomoreka omosunte ore asende oba oborabu.

English: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
Kiswahili: Kwa msaada wako naweza kushinda jeshi, nikiwa pamoja na Mungu wangu nitaweza kuruka ukuta.
Ekegusii: Konde amo naye, nigo ndasirie omoganda bw’esegi; na ekero inde na Nyasae one nincharoke chindwaki igoro.

English: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Mungu, njia yake ni kamilifu, neno la Bwana halina dosari. Yeye ni ngao kwa wote wanaokimbilia kwake.
Ekegusii: Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu, amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.

English: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni nani aliye Mungu zaidi ya Bwana? Ni nani aliye Mwamba isipokuwa Mungu wetu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore Nyasae, otatiga Omonene? Ning’o ore egetare, otatiga Nyasae oito?

English: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
Kiswahili: Mungu ndiye anivikaye nguvu na kufanya njia yangu kuwa kamilifu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere okomboyia chinguru na kondenda ase enchera yane.

English: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
Kiswahili: Huifanya miguu yangu kama miguu ya kulungu, huniwezesha kusimama mahali palipo juu.
Ekegusii: Ere okorire amagoro aane abeire buna ey’egesia, onkong’irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.

English: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
Kiswahili: Huifundisha mikono yangu kupigana vita; mikono yangu inaweza kupinda upinde wa shaba.
Ekegusii: Ere bworokereirie amaboko aane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko aane anyare gotinga obota bw’etai.

English: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
Kiswahili: Hunipa ngao yako ya ushindi, nao mkono wako wa kuume hunitegemeza, unajishusha chini ili kuniinua.
Ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, okoboko kwao gw’okorio kogansiira; na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.

English: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
Kiswahili: Huyapanua mapito yangu, ili miguu yangu isiteleze.
Ekegusii: Kwang’eire aase aagare ngotaara, na amagoro aane tagotererigwa.

English: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
Kiswahili: Niliwafuatia adui zangu na nikawapata, sikurudi nyuma mpaka walipoangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Nkabwatia ababisa baane, nkabaikeera inchera; gose tinairanete goika nkabakoora.

English: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
Kiswahili: Niliwaseta hata hawakuweza kuinuka tena; walianguka chini ya miguu yangu.
Ekegusii: Nkabaaka inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro aane, bakabugwa.

English: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
Kiswahili: Ulinivika nguvu kwa ajili ya kupigana vita; uliwafanya adui zangu wasujudu miguuni pangu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwambegete chinguru chi’okorwana esegi; okabeka ababisa baane inse y’amagoro aane.

English: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
Kiswahili: Uliwafanya adui zangu wageuke na kukimbia, nami nikawaangamiza adui zangu.
Ekegusii: Ogakora ababisa baane bagatama korwa asende; abangechete nkabasiria kegima.

English: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
Kiswahili: Walipiga yowe, lakini hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwaokoa; walimlilia Bwana, lakini hakuwajibu.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba bakarera ng’a bakonywe, korende onde tarenge obatooretie, bakarangeri’Omonene, korende ere tabaigwa.

English: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
Kiswahili: Niliwaponda kama mavumbi yanayopeperushwa na upepo; niliwamwaga nje kama tope barabarani.
Ekegusii: Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ekoirurukigwa nomwaga; nkabatuguta buna ngotuguta esike ase enchera.

English: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
Kiswahili: Umeniokoa kutokana na mashambulizi ya watu; umenifanya kuwa kiongozi wa mataifa, watu ambao sikuwajua wananitumikia.
Ekegusii: Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania nabaanto, kwambekire nabeire omogambi bw’abaanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba baane.

English: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
Kiswahili: Mara wanisikiapo hunitii, wageni hunyenyekea mbele yangu.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigure chinkuma chiane nigo bakonyigwera; abamenyi nigo bagocha bebeka inse yane.

English: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
Kiswahili: Wote wanalegea, wanatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo kobagosoka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.

English: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
Kiswahili: Bwana yu hai! Sifa ni kwa Mwamba wangu! Atukuzwe Mungu Mwokozi wangu!
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are moyo! Ere oyore egetare kiane atogigwe! Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane aimokererigwe igoro.

English: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye Mungu anilipiziaye kisasi, awatiishaye mataifa chini yangu,
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akonduseria egesiomba, nabeeke abanto b’ebisaku inse yane.

English: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
Kiswahili: aniokoaye na adui zangu. Uliniinua juu ya adui zangu; uliniokoa toka kwa watu wajeuri.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa baane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha yane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.

English: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitakusifu katikati ya mataifa, Ee Bwana; nitaliimbia sifa jina lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase ayio ningotogie ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, ninterere erieta riao ase okoritogia.

English: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
Kiswahili: Humpa mfalme wake ushindi mkuu, huonyesha fadhili zake kwa mpakwa mafuta wake, kwa Daudi na wazao wake milele.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ong’eire inche, omorwoti oye, obobui obonene, oorokirie obwanchani botari koera asende, inche omoakwa amaguta oye. Inche Daudi, na ororeria rwane, goika kare na kare.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Mbingu zinatangaza utukufu wa Mungu, anga zahubiri kazi ya mikono yake.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Igoro nigo chikoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae; na eaanga ya igoro eraria emeremo y’amaboko aye.

English: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
Kiswahili: Siku baada ya siku zinatoa habari, usiku baada ya usiku zinatangaza maarifa.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo riatebia erinde obonene obo, na obotuko obomo bwarareria obotuko bonde ayio ayio.

English: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
Kiswahili: Hakuna msemo wala lugha, ambapo sauti zao hazisikiki.
Ekegusii: Chinkwana chinde tichiri aroro, gose omonwa onde ogokwanwa tori, na eriogi riabo tiriri koigugwa.

English: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
Kiswahili: Sauti yao imeenea duniani pote, nayo maneno yao yameenea hadi miisho ya ulimwengu. Katika mbingu amepiga hema kwa ajili ya jua,
Ekegusii: Eriogi riabo riagendire, riesiareire ase ense engima, na amang’ana abo aikire chinsinyo chi’ense. Nyasae okorire igoro koba obomenyo bw’erioba.

English: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
Kiswahili: linafanana na bwana arusi akitoka chumbani mwake, kama shujaa afurahiavyo kukamilisha kushindana kwake.
Ekegusii: Erioba nigo rigosoka buna omonywomi ogosoka korwa mwaye, na riagoka buna omogosoria omokong’u okominyoka chimbero.

English: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
Kiswahili: Huchomoza upande mmoja wa mbingu, na kufanya mzunguko wake hadi upande mwingine. Hakuna kilichojificha joto lake.
Ekegusii: Nigo rigosoka korwa ensemo eyemo ya igoro, naende riekumba riagenda gochia ensemo ende; gento kende tikeri gekobisekana korwa ase riberera riaye.

English: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Kiswahili: Sheria ya Bwana ni kamilifu, ikihuisha nafsi. Shuhuda za Bwana ni za kuaminika, zikimpa mjinga hekima.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko ’Omonene namaikeranu, nigo agokora omoyo oba omoyia. Oborori bw’Omonene nobw’ekeene, nigo akong’ainiyia oyotamanyeti amange.

English: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
Kiswahili: Maagizo ya Bwana ni kamili, nayo hufurahisha moyo. Amri za Bwana huangaza, zatia nuru machoni.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko ’Omonene namaronge, nigo akogokia enkoro; ring’an’Omonene achiikire nerironge, nigo rikorenta oborabu ase amaiso.

English: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana ni utakatifu, nako kwadumu milele. Amri za Bwana ni za hakika, nazo zina haki.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nering’ana richenegete, okwo koragenderere kare na kare; okogamba kw’Omonene nogw’ekeene, na okw’oboronge.

English: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
Kiswahili: Ni za thamani kuliko dhahabu, kuliko dhahabu iliyo safi sana, ni tamu kuliko asali, kuliko asali kutoka kwenye sega.
Ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo are amaya kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu echenire na amansu kobua obooke, ee, kobua richoe ri’obooke.

English: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
Kiswahili: Kwa hizo mtumishi wako anaonywa, katika kuzishika kuna thawabu kubwa.
Ekegusii: Amo nayio nigo ogokuurera omosomba oo; oyio okoyarenda nigo akoegwa eng’eria enene y’obuya.

English: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kutambua makosa yake? Nisamehe makosa yangu nisiyoyajua.
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare komanya amamocho aye? Omonene, nchene korwa ase amamocho aane abisekanete.

English: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
Kiswahili: Mlinde mtumishi wako na dhambi za makusudi, nazo zisinitawale. Ndipo nitakapokuwa sina lawama, wala sitakuwa na hatia ya kosa kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ontange inche, omosomba oo, tinkora ebibe bi’obomwenu; tobitiga ebio bingambere! Rirorio nimbe ntari na komocha, nimbe omosibore korwa ase ogosaria okonene.

English: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya kinywa changu na mawazo ya moyo wangu, yapate kibali mbele zako, Ee Bwana, Mwamba wangu na Mkombozi wangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Egetare kiane na Omobooria one, anchera amang’ana aane na ebirengererio bire ase enkoro yane.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana na akujibu unapokuwa katika dhiki, jina la Mungu wa Yakobo na liwe kinga yako.
