Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Tiga Omonene aigwe ogosaba kwao ase engaki y’emechando. Erieta ria Nyasae o Yakobo rikorende.

English: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
Kiswahili: Na akutumie msaada kutoka patakatifu na akupatie msaada kutoka Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Ere nagotomere ogokonywa korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, na akoe chinguru korwa ase Sayoni.

English: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.
Kiswahili: Na azikumbuke dhabihu zako zote, na azikubali sadaka zako za kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: Tiga ainyore okorua kwao gwonsi, anche na kogokera ebing’wanso biao bionsi bi’ogosambwa.

English: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
Kiswahili: Na akujalie haja ya moyo wako, na aifanikishe mipango yako yote.
Ekegusii: Tiga akoe okogania gw’enkoro yao, na aikeranie emeroberio yao yonsi.

English: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.
Kiswahili: Tutashangilia kwa furaha utakaposhinda, tutainua bendera zetu kwa jina la Mungu wetu. Bwana na akupe haja zako zote.
Ekegusii: Erio toake amariogi yomogooko ase engencho y’obobui bwao, toimokererie igoro ebendera y’erieta ria Nyasae oito! Tiga Omonene aikeranie okoboria kwao kw’oboitongo.

English: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
Kiswahili: Sasa nafahamu kuwa Bwana humwokoa mpakwa mafuta wake, humjibu kutoka mbingu yake takatifu kwa nguvu za wokovu wa mkono wake wa kuume.
Ekegusii: Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nae omoakwa amaguta oye obobui, namoiranerie korwa aase aye aachenu aaria igoro, namoe obobui goetera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.

English: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
Kiswahili: Wengine wanatumaini magari ya vita, na wengine farasi, bali sisi tutalitumainia jina la Bwana, Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo basemeretie chigari chi’esegi, na abande chibarasi chi’esegi, korende intwe nigo tosemeretie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
Kiswahili: Wao wameshushwa chini na kuanguka, bali sisi tunainuka na kusimama imara.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baragochwe bagwe inse korende intwe nigo toragororoke totenene boronge.

English: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, mwokoe mfalme! Tujibu tunapokuita!
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kae omorwoti oo gwachorire obobui; otoiranerie ekero togokorangeria!

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, mfalme huzifurahia nguvu zako. Tazama jinsi ilivyo kuu furaha yake kwa ushindi unaompa!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, omorwoti nigo agokerete chinguru chiao, na gochengera obobui kwamoeire.

English: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
Kiswahili: Umempa haja ya moyo wake na hukumzuilia maombi ya midomo yake.
Ekegusii: Kwamoeire okogania gw’enkoro yaye; na totangeti aya aboretie korwa asore.

English: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
Kiswahili: Ulimkaribisha kwa baraka tele na kumvika taji ya dhahabu safi kichwani pake.
Ekegusii: Aye kwamorenteire ogosesenigwa okuya; kwamobekeire egutwa y’etaabu echenire ase omotwe oye.

English: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Alikuomba maisha, nawe ukampa, wingi wa siku milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Akagosaba ng’a omoe obogima, naye okabomoa; okamoa amatuko amange amenye kogenderera botambe.

English: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na ushindi uliompa, utukufu wake ni mkubwa, umeweka juu yake fahari na utukufu.
Ekegusii: Amasikani ’omorwoti nigo are amanene, ekiagera aye kwamokonyire; kwamoeire obonene obonge na ogosika okonene.

English: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
Kiswahili: Hakika umempa baraka za milele, umemfanya awe na furaha kwa shangwe ya uwepo wako.
Ekegusii: Ee, kwamokorire koba ogoseseneka gwa kare na kare, kwamogokeire, ekiagera ore amo nere botambe.

English: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mfalme anamtumaini Bwana; kwa upendo usiokoma wa Aliye Juu Sana hatatikiswa.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti nigo asemeretie Omonene, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bw’Omonene Ore Igoro bogendererete botambe ere takonyara kwoboa.

English: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
Kiswahili: Mkono wako utawashika adui zako wote, mkono wako wa kuume utawakamata adui zako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omorwoti, noikeere ababisa bao bonsi; nobwate nokoboko kwao gw’okorio abwo bakogechete.

English: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
Kiswahili: Wakati utakapojitokeza utawafanya kama tanuru ya moto. Katika ghadhabu yake Bwana atawameza, moto wake utawateketeza.
Ekegusii: Ekero orabaorokere nobakore booke buna omorero ekebemberi. Omonene nabasirie nendamwamu yaye enene; omorero nobasambe, bayie baere.

English: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
Kiswahili: Utawaangamiza wazao wao kutoka duniani, uzao wao kutoka wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Aye noite abana babo, obasirie korwa ase ense, na ororeria rwabo orosirie kegima korwa ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
Kiswahili: Ingawa watapanga mabaya dhidi yako na kutunga hila, hawawezi kufanikiwa,
Ekegusii: Kobarabe bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora bobe, gose korengereria chinchera chi’okorenta emechando, tibakobua,

English: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa utawafanya wakimbie utakapowalenga usoni pao kwa mshale kutoka kwenye upinde wako.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nobaserie batame, nobarenge emegwe ase amasio abo.

English: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, utukuzwe katika nguvu zako, tutaimba na kusifu nguvu zako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene otogigwe ase engencho ye chinguru chiao, intwe ntobe togotera ogoteera kw’ogotogia okobua kwao.

English: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa utenzi wa “Kulungu wa Alfajiri.” Zaburi ya Daudi. Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha? Kwa nini uko mbali hivyo kuniokoa? Mbali hivyo na maneno ya kuugua kwangu?
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Nyasae one, aye Nyasae one, naki gwantigire iga? Nabeire nkorera ontoorie, korende kwambeereire aare.

English: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu wangu, ninalia mchana, lakini hunijibu, hata usiku, sinyamazi.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one! Nigo nkorera botuko bokia, korende tori kong’iraneria; nase obotuko boigo, korende tindi konyora ogotimoka.

English: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo umesimikwa katika kiti cha enzi kama Uliye Mtakatifu; wewe ni sifa ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, aye nigo ore omochenu; obonene nobwao, naye ogotogigwa n’Abaisraeli.

English: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
Kiswahili: Kwako wewe baba zetu waliweka tumaini lao, walikutumaini nawe ukawaokoa.
Ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagosemeretie, ee, nigo chiagosemeretie, naye ogachitooria.

English: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
Kiswahili: Walikulilia wewe na ukawaokoa, walikutegemea wewe nao hawakuaibika.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barerete asore, bakanyora ogotooreka, nigo babete bagosemeretie, na tibasoogetigwe.

English: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mnyoo wala si mwanadamu, wanaume wamenibeza, na watu wamenidharau.
Ekegusii: Inche nerikonde, tindi omonto, nigo ngochecherigwa na gochaywa n’abanto.

English: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
Kiswahili: Wote wanionao hunidhihaki, hunivurumishia matusi, wakitikisa vichwa vyao:
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abakondora nigo bagonchecheria na gonsekerera; nigo bagoaka eriogi asende na gosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo,

English: “He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
Kiswahili: Husema, “Anamtegemea Bwana, basi Bwana na amwokoe. Amkomboe basi, kwa maana anapendezwa naye.”
Ekegusii: bagoteeba: “Omonto oyo nigo asemeretie Omonene ng’a namotoorie, tiga amotoorie bono, ekiagera agokirie nere!”

English: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo ulinitoa tumboni, ukanifanya nikutegemee, hata nilipokuwa ninanyonya matiti ya mama yangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene, naye kwandusetie ase enda ya baba; naye kwabete gokondenda buya ase amaboko a baba.

English: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
Kiswahili: Nimekabidhiwa kwako tangu kuzaliwa, toka tumboni mwa mama yangu umekuwa Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo narutetwe asore korwa ase okoiborwa kwane, na korwa ekero narenge ase enda ya baba naye kwarenge Nyasae one.

English: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
Kiswahili: Usiwe mbali nami, kwa maana shida iko karibu na hakuna wa kunisaidia.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende, ekiagera emechando nigo ere ange, na monto onde tari orankonye.

English: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
Kiswahili: Mafahali wengi wamenizunguka, mafahali wa Bashani wenye nguvu wamenizingira.
Ekegusii: Chieri chinyinge nching’etanaine, ee, chieri chiria chia Basani chire ne chinguru nigo ching’etanaine.

English: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
Kiswahili: Simba wangurumao wanaorarua mawindo yao hupanua vinywa vyao dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Baasamirie emenwa yabo gocha asende, yabeire buna chindo chikoronya na koruma.

English: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
Kiswahili: Nimemiminwa kama maji, mifupa yangu yote imetoka katika viungo vyake. Moyo wangu umegeuka kuwa nta, umeyeyuka ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Nabeire buna amaache aiteirwe ’nse; amauga onsi ay’omobere one atengokire na achoga‐chogire; enkoro yane yabeire buna obochoe, yanyititokire ime yane.

English: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
Kiswahili: Nguvu zangu zimekauka kama kigae, ulimi wangu umegandamana na kaakaa la kinywa changu, kwa sababu umenilaza katika mavumbi ya kifo.
Ekegusii: Chinguru chiane chiang’ereire, omoyo one bwomire pa buna ekegonkorio, oromeme rwane rwabwatanire namang’ang’ura; aye kwanyareirie ase amaroba nkwete.

English: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
Kiswahili: Mbwa wamenizunguka, kundi la watu waovu limenizingira, wametoboa mikono yangu na miguu yangu.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bang’etanaine korwa kera aase, ee, nigo bang’etanaine korwa chinsemo chionsi buna ekeombe gie chisese; bambetire ebisanyi bi’amaboko, na ebi’amagoro boigo.

English: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
Kiswahili: Naweza kuhesabu mifupa yangu yote, watu wananikodolea macho na kunisimanga.
Ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one atongororokire nabo ’nkoyabara; abanto nigo bakondigereria na kogokera obobe bwane.

English: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
Kiswahili: Wanagawana nguo zangu wao kwa wao, na vazi langu wanalipigia kura.
Ekegusii: Baatananire chianga chiane ase egati yabo; baakeire eganchwa yane obomera.

English: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, usiwe mbali. Ee Nguvu yangu, uje haraka unisaidie.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, tobeera aare korwa asende; aye ore chinguru chiane, koranche, ayerera onkonye!

English: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
Kiswahili: Okoa maisha yangu na upanga, uhai wangu wa thamani kutoka nguvu za mbwa.
Ekegusii: Ntoorie korwa ase omoro bw’amakweri, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase okobua gwe chisese chiria!

English: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
Kiswahili: Niokoe kutoka kinywani mwa simba, niokoe kutoka pembe za mafahali mwitu.
Ekegusii: Ntoorie, ondusie ase emenwa ye chindo chiria; nkonya korwa ase ching’unchara chie ching’era!

English: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
Kiswahili: Nitalitangaza jina lako kwa ndugu zangu, katika kusanyiko nitakusifu wewe.
Ekegusii: Omonene, nindarie erieta riao ase abanto baminto, ase egati y’omosangererekano ningotogie.

English: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
Kiswahili: Ninyi ambao mnamcha Bwana, msifuni! Ninyi nyote wazao wote wa Yakobo, mheshimuni yeye! Mcheni yeye, ninyi wazao wote wa Israeli!
Ekegusii: Inwe abamoirogete Omonene, motogie! Inwe mwensi ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, togia obonene bwaye! Inwe Abaisraeli bonsi, moiroke!

English: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hakupuuza wala kudharau mateso ya aliyeonewa; hakumficha uso wake bali alisikiliza kilio chake ili amsaidie.
Ekegusii: Omonene tari gochaaya emechando y’abwo bachandegete, gose koyegecha, gose tabiseti obosio bwaye korwa ase bare; korende ekero bamorangeretie nigo abaigwete.

English: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
Kiswahili: Kwako wewe hutoka kiini cha sifa zangu katika kusanyiko kubwa, nitatimiza nadhiri zangu mbele ya wale wakuchao wewe.
Ekegusii: Ekero ’nde ase omosangererekano omonene ningotogie. Chiira nariete ning’ikeranie agwo ase obosio bw’abaanto bamoirogete Omonene.

English: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
Kiswahili: Maskini watakula na kushiba, wale wamtafutao Bwana watamsifu: mioyo yenu na iishi milele!
Ekegusii: Abwo bare abaitongo mbanyore endagera barie baigote. Abanto bakorigia Omonene mbabe bakomotogia, ne chinkoro chiaino nchigenderere koba moyo goika kare na kare.

English: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
Kiswahili: Miisho yote ya dunia itakumbuka na kumgeukia Bwana, nazo jamaa zote za mataifa watasujudu mbele zake,
Ekegusii: Abanto b’echinsemo chionsi chi’ense mbainyore Omonene, bamoonchokere; chiamate chionsi chi’ebisaku nchimosasime.

English: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
Kiswahili: kwa maana ufalme ni wa Bwana naye hutawala juu ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Omogambi Omonene, nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku bionsi.

English: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
Kiswahili: Matajiri wote wa dunia watasherehekea na kuabudu. Wote waendao mavumbini watapiga magoti mbele yake, wote ambao hawawezi kudumisha uhai wao.
Ekegusii: Ee, abanto abatenenku bonsi bare ase ense goika batung’ame ase obosio bw’Omonene, abwo bonsi bakogenda ase chimbeera ime mbatung’ame ase obosio bwaye; naboigo nabwo batanyare korenda obogima bwabo bogenderere.

English: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
Kiswahili: Wazao wa baadaye watamtumikia yeye; vizazi vijavyo vitajulishwa habari za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwaye mbabe bakomokorera; mbabe bagokwana igoro y’Omonene ase ebiaare bigochi‐gocha.

English: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
Kiswahili: Watatangaza haki yake kwa watu ambao hawajazaliwa bado, kwa maana yeye ametenda hili.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwaye mbobe bokorarigwa ase abanto bataraiborwa, ng’a ere oikeranirie onsi.

English: A Psalm by David. Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana ndiye mchungaji wangu, sitapungukiwa na kitu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omonene nomorisia one, tinkoremerwa kende,

English: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
Kiswahili: Hunilaza katika malisho ya majani mabichi, kando ya maji matulivu huniongoza,
Ekegusii: Nigo agontimokeria ase obonyansi obobese na kondaa gochia ase amaache amakenonoku akwongora ng’ora.

English: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
Kiswahili: hunihuisha nafsi yangu. Huniongoza katika njia za haki kwa ajili ya jina lake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agokora omoyo one koba omoyia na kondaa ase chinchera chiaye chia boronge, ase engencho y’erieta riaye.

English: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Kiswahili: Hata kama nikipita katikati ya bonde la uvuli wa mauti, sitaogopa mabaya, kwa maana wewe upo pamoja nami; fimbo yako na mkongojo wako vyanifariji.
Ekegusii: Ninsa goeta ase omwenya bw’ekiriri ki’amakweri, tinkoiroka bobe bonde, ekiagera aye Omonene nigo ore amo nainche, enyimbo yao na enungu yao nabindemie.

English: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
Kiswahili: Waandaa meza mbele yangu machoni pa adui zangu. Umenipaka mafuta kichwani pangu, kikombe changu kinafurika.
Ekegusii: Kwambekeire endagera ase amasio ’ababisa baane; kwang’akire amaguta omotwe one ase okonyarigania, gwaichoirie egekombe kiane, ngoiteka kere.

English: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
Kiswahili: Hakika wema na upendo vitanifuata siku zote za maisha yangu, nami nitakaa nyumbani mwa Bwana milele.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, obuya na obwanchani botari koera nabintunyane amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane; nainche nimenye ase enyomba y’Omonene goika kare na kare.

English: A Psalm by David. The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Dunia ni mali ya Bwana, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, ulimwengu, na wote waishio ndani yake,
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Ense na ebinto bire aroro nebia Omonene; oboiko bwonsi nobwaye, amo nabaanto bamenyeteo.

English: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
Kiswahili: maana aliiwekea misingi yake baharini na kuifanya imara juu ya maji.
Ekegusii: Nigo abegete oboroso bwaye igoro ase chinyancha, akabokong’ia igoro ase chindooche.

English: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
Kiswahili: Nani awezaye kuupanda mlima wa Bwana? Ni nani awezaye kusimama patakatifu pake?
Ekegusii: Ning’o oragwenere gotiira ase egetunwa kia Omonene? Ning’o oragwenere gotenena aase aye aachenu?

English: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
Kiswahili: Ni yule mwenye mikono safi na moyo mweupe, yule ambaye hakuinulia sanamu nafsi yake au kuapa kwa kitu cha uongo.
Ekegusii: Nomonto oria obwate amaboko atari na komocha, na enkoro echenegete, noria otari gosasiima chinyasae chi’oborimo, gose gotiana ase obong’ainereria.

English: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Kiswahili: Huyo atapokea baraka kutoka kwa Bwana, na hukumu ya haki kutoka kwa Mungu Mwokozi wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nonyore ogosesenigwa korwa ase Omonene; boigo nanyore oboronge korwa ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwaye.

English: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
Kiswahili: Hiki ndicho kizazi cha wale wamtafutao, wale wautafutao uso wako, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ekegori ki’abakomorigia kere; abwo bakorigia barore obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.

English: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
Kiswahili: Inueni vichwa vyenu, enyi malango, inukeni enyi milango ya kale, ili mfalme wa utukufu apate kuingia.
Ekegusii: Inwe ebiita, imokereria emekorogoto yaino igoro! Inwe ebiita bia kare, igoka, erinde Omorwoti bw’obonene asoe ime!

English: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.
Kiswahili: Ni nani huyu Mfalme wa utukufu? Ni Bwana aliye na nguvu na uweza, ni Bwana aliye hodari katika vita.
Ekegusii: Inee! Omorwoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere Omonene ore ne chinguru na okobua, ere Omonene, omobui ase chiseegi.

English: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
Kiswahili: Inueni vichwa vyenu, enyi malango, viinueni juu enyi milango ya kale, ili Mfalme wa utukufu apate kuingia.
Ekegusii: Inwe ebiita, imokereria emetwe yaino igoro! Inwe ebiita bia kare, igoka, erinde Omorwoti bw’obonene asoe ime!

English: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
Kiswahili: Ni nani yeye, huyu Mfalme wa utukufu? Ni Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote; yeye ndiye Mfalme wa utukufu.
Ekegusii: Inee! Omorwoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere n’Omorwoti bw’Obonene.

English: By David. To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, nainua nafsi yangu,
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ngocha nde asore nomoyo one bwonsi.

English: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
Kiswahili: ni wewe ninayekutumainia, Ee Mungu wangu. Usiniache niaibike, wala usiache adui zangu wakanishinda.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, naye nsemeretie, tontiga nsookigwe; totiga ababisa baane bagokere okobugwa kwane.

English: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
Kiswahili: Kamwe hakuna hata mmoja anayekutegemea atakayeaibishwa, bali wataaibishwa wafanyao hila bila sababu.
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi ogosemeretie totiga asookigwe; korende abwo batigire obwegenwa engencho ende etaiyo basookigwe.

English: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
Kiswahili: Nionyeshe njia zako, Ee Bwana, nifundishe mapito yako,
Ekegusii: Omonene, imanyie chinchera chiao; inyorokererie oboeto bwao.

English: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
Kiswahili: niongoze katika kweli yako na kunifundisha, kwa maana wewe ni Mungu Mwokozi wangu, nalo tumaini langu liko kwako wakati wote.
Ekegusii: Ondaae ase ekeene kiao na onyorokererie, ekiagera aye Nyasae nogotooreka kwane, aye nigo ngosemeretie.

English: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka, Ee Bwana, rehema zako kuu na upendo, kwa maana zimekuwepo tangu zamani.
Ekegusii: Omonene, inyora amaabera ao na obwanchani bwao botari koera, ekiagera nao biarenge korwa kare.

English: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Usizikumbuke dhambi za ujana wangu wala njia zangu za uasi, sawasawa na upendo wako unikumbuke, kwa maana wewe ni mwema, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tobaisa koinyora ebibe na ogosaria bi’obosae bwane; ong’inyore ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase engencho y’obuya bwao.

English: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwema na mwenye adili, kwa hiyo huwafundisha wenye dhambi njia zake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya na ere nere omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.

English: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
Kiswahili: Huwaongoza wanyenyekevu katika haki, naye huwafundisha njia yake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoraa abanto bare abaitongo ase enchera endonge, naende aborokereria komanya enchera yaye.

English: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
Kiswahili: Njia zote za Bwana ni za upendo na uaminifu kwa wale wanaoshika shuhuda za agano lake.
Ekegusii: Chinchera chionsi chi’ Omonene nigo chire echi’obwanchani, na echi’obwegenwa, ase abwo barendete okobwatana kwaye na oborori bwaye.

English: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kwa ajili ya jina lako, unisamehe uovu wangu, ijapokuwa ni mwingi.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ase engencho y’erieta riao onyabere ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nokonene.

English: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
Kiswahili: Ni nani basi, mtu yule anayemcha Bwana? Atamfundisha katika njia atakayoichagua kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto omoirogete Omonene, eri’Omonene amworokereria enchera agwenerete gochora.

English: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
Kiswahili: Mtu huyo atafanikiwa maishani mwake, nao wazao wake watairithi nchi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nagenderere gosesenigwa, na ororeria rwaye ndoire ense.

English: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
Kiswahili: Siri ya Bwana iko kwa wale wamchao, yeye huwajulisha agano lake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omosani bw’abaanto bamoirogete, nigo akobamanyia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.

English: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu humwelekea Bwana daima, kwa kuwa yeye peke yake ndiye ataitoa miguu yangu kutoka mtego.
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo nkoba imorigereretie Omonene, nere orarusie amagoro aane ase oboreba.

English: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
Kiswahili: Nigeukie na unihurumie, kwa maana mimi ni mpweke na mwenye kuteseka.
Ekegusii: Aye omonene, ing’iranere ondorere amaabera, ekiagera nigo inde inche bweka, naende nchandegete.

English: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
Kiswahili: Shida za moyo wangu zimeongezeka, niokoe katika dhiki yangu.
Ekegusii: Omoichano nigo oichire ase enkoro yane, ndusie ase obokong’u bwane,

English: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
Kiswahili: Uangalie mateso na shida zangu na uniondolee dhambi zangu zote.
Ekegusii: ndigererie orore obororo bwane na ogochandwa kwane, na onyabere ebibe biane bionsi.

English: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
Kiswahili: Tazama adui zangu walivyo wengi, pia uone jinsi wanavyonichukia vikali!
Ekegusii: Rora ababisa baane bonsi buna bare abange; na buna bangechete nobotindi obonge.

English: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
Kiswahili: Uyalinde maisha yangu na uniokoe, usiniache niaibike, kwa maana nimekukimbilia wewe.
Ekegusii: Renda omoyo one na ontoorie; naye ngotamera tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe.

English: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
Kiswahili: Uadilifu na uaminifu vinilinde, kwa sababu tumaini langu ni kwako.
Ekegusii: Tiga obwegenwa na oboronge bindende, ekiagera naye nsemeretie.

English: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, wakomboe Israeli, katika shida zao zote!
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, booria Abaisraeli korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.

English: By David. Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, nithibitishe katika haki, maana nimeishi maisha yasiyo na lawama; nimemtumainia Bwana bila kusitasita.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ing’a oboronge bwane; ekiagera nabeire ntari na komocha; naboigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene ntari ne chitang’u‐tang’u.

English: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, unijaribu, unipime, uuchunguze moyo wangu na mawazo yangu;
Ekegusii: Omonene, inteeme na ondenge; orenge enkoro yane na ebirengererio biane.

English: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
Kiswahili: kwa maana upendo wako uko mbele yangu daima, nami natembea siku zote katika kweli yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ndigereretie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe na gotaara ase obwegenwa bwao.

English: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
Kiswahili: Siketi pamoja na watu wadanganyifu, wala siandamani na wanafiki,
Ekegusii: Tindi gosanga nabanyaborimo, gose tindi kogosoria nabang’ainereria.

English: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
Kiswahili: ninachukia kusanyiko la watenda mabaya na ninakataa kuketi pamoja na waovu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ngechete gosanga nabaanto bagokora amabe, na tingwancha goikaransa amo nabaanto abakayayu.

English: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,
Kiswahili: Ninanawa mikono yangu kwa kuwa sina hatia, naikaribia madhabahu yako, Ee Bwana,
Ekegusii: Nigo ngoisaba amaboko aane ase okoorokia ng’a tindi na komocha, erio naetanana egesasiimero kiao, aye Omonene,

English: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
Kiswahili: nikitangaza sifa yako kwa sauti kubwa, huku nikisimulia matendo yako ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: imba ngoteera neriogi rinene gokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono na koraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.

English: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, naipenda nyumba yako mahali unakoishi, mahali ambapo utukufu wako hukaa.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inche nigo nyanchete obomenyo bwao, aase obonene bwao bore.

English: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men
Kiswahili: Usiiondoe nafsi yangu pamoja na watenda dhambi, wala uhai wangu pamoja na wamwagao damu,
Ekegusii: Tosiria omoyo one ekero ogosiria abanyabibe; gose obogima bwane ekero ogosiria abaiti.

English: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.
Kiswahili: ambao mikononi mwao kuna mipango miovu, ambao mikono yao ya kuume imejaa rushwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagokora emeroberio y’obonyaka, na amaboko abo a borio nigo aichire namaaki.

English: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
Kiswahili: Bali mimi ninaishi maisha yasiyo na lawama; nikomboe na unihurumie.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo inde norogendo rotari na komocha; indorere amaabera na omboorie.

English: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Miguu yangu imesimama katika uwanja tambarare; katika kusanyiko kuu nitamsifu Bwana.
Ekegusii: Amagoro aane nigo agotenena aase ateremu; nintogie Omonene ase egati y’omosangererekano omonene.

English: By David. Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana ni nuru yangu na wokovu wangu, nimwogope nani? Bwana ni ngome ya uzima wangu, nimhofu nani?
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omonene nere omobaso one, na ogotooreka kwane, ning’o ndanyare koiroka? Omonene nere eburi ekengerete obogima bwane, monto ki ndanyare kwoboa?

English: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
Kiswahili: Waovu watakaposogea dhidi yangu ili wanile nyama yangu, adui zangu na watesi wangu watakaponishambulia, watajikwaa na kuanguka.
Ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakong’umokera ng’a bamere, ababisa baane abwo bangechete nigo baragochwe na kogwa.

English: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
Kiswahili: Hata jeshi linizunguke pande zote, moyo wangu hautaogopa; hata vita vitokee dhidi yangu, hata hapo nitakuwa na ujasiri.
Ekegusii: Neba omoganda omonene bw’esegi ong’etananire, enkoro yane tekoba nobwoba; gose abanto nabachicha kondwania esegi, inche nigo ndagenderere koba noboremu.

English: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
Kiswahili: Jambo moja ninamwomba Bwana, hili ndilo ninalolitafuta: niweze kukaa nyumbani mwa Bwana siku zote za maisha yangu, niutazame uzuri wa Bwana na kumtafuta hekaluni mwake.
Ekegusii: Nasabire ring’ana erimo korwa ase Omonene. Erio nario nganetie: Imenye ase enyomba y’Omonene ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane, erinde ndore oboseera bw’Omonene na kona‐koboiranerera ase Hekalu yaye.

English: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa siku ya shida, atanihifadhi salama katika maskani yake, atanificha uvulini mwa hema yake na kuniweka juu kwenye mwamba.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emechando nantube ase ekiriri kiaye; nambise ase eema yaye ime, Nanyimokie ambeke ase egetare igoro.

English: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha kichwa changu kitainuliwa juu ya adui zangu wanaonizunguka. Katika maskani yake nitatoa dhabihu kwa kelele za shangwe; nitamwimbia Bwana na kumsifu.
Ekegusii: Ninyimokererigwa igoro ase ababisa baane bang’etanaine. Ase eema yaye ime nindue ebing’wanso inde nomochengo; ninterere Omonene na komotogia.

English: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
Kiswahili: Isikie sauti yangu nikuitapo, Ee Bwana, unihurumie na unijibu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oigwe okorera kwane, indorere amaabera na oiranerie ogosaba kwane.

English: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu unasema kuhusu wewe, “Utafute uso wake!” Uso wako, Bwana “Nitautafuta.”
Ekegusii: Aye gwatebire: “Indigie ondore obosio bwane.” Na enkoro yane nigo ekogoteebia: “Omonene, inche igo nkorigia obosio bwao.”

English: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
Kiswahili: Usinifiche uso wako, usimkatae mtumishi wako kwa hasira; wewe umekuwa msaada wangu. Usinikatae wala usiniache, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one ore ogotooreka kwane, tobisa obosio bwao korwa asende; tontiga kore nendamwamu. Aye kwabeire kogonkonya botambe, tontuguta gose tontiga.

English: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.
Kiswahili: Hata kama baba yangu na mama wakiniacha, Bwana atanipokea.
Ekegusii: Onye tata na baba baraba bagontiga, Omonene nang’ire imbe oyoye.

English: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
Kiswahili: Nifundishe njia yako, Ee Bwana, niongoze katika njia iliyonyooka kwa sababu ya watesi wangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao; indaae ong’eterie aase ateremu, ntooreke korwa ase ababisa baane.

English: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
Kiswahili: Usiniachilie kwa nia za adui zangu, kwa maana mashahidi wa uongo wameinuka dhidi yangu, wakipumua ujeuri.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kondua ase ababisa baane bankore buna banchete; birori b’oborimo banyimokeire, bagontianera nobotindi.

English: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
Kiswahili: Nami bado nina tumaini hili: nitauona wema wa Bwana katika nchi ya walio hai.
Ekegusii: Naenekirie ng’a nindore obuya bw’ Omonene; ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.

English: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mngojee Bwana, uwe hodari na mwenye moyo mkuu, nawe, umngojee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Remereria oganye Omonene, kabe omoremu, tokwa omoyo; ee, remereria oganye Omonene!

English: By David. To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ninakuita wewe, Ee Bwana, Mwamba wangu; usiwe kwangu kama kiziwi. Kwa sababu ukinyamaza nitafanana na walioshuka shimoni.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, egetare kiane, naye nkorangeria, tibwanga konyigwa. Oise gokira, inche nigo ndabe oyomo bw’abakogenda ase chimbeera.

English: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
Kiswahili: Sikia kilio changu unihurumie ninapokuita kwa ajili ya msaada, niinuapo mikono yangu kuelekea Patakatifu pa Patakatifu pako.
Ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane, ekero nkorera asore onkonye, ekero ndamborete amaboko aane igoro gocha ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.

English: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
Kiswahili: Usiniburute pamoja na waovu, pamoja na hao watendao mabaya, ambao huzungumza na jirani zao maneno mazuri, lakini mioyoni mwao wameficha chuki.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gonsiria amo nabakori amabe na abasaria, abanto abagokwana amang’ana yo omorembe nabaanto bande, korende ime ase chinkoro chiabo nigo baabagechete.

English: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
Kiswahili: Walipe sawasawa na matendo yao, sawasawa na matendo yao maovu; walipe sawasawa na kazi za mikono yao, uwalipe wanavyostahili.
Ekegusii: Bae egesusuro koreng’ana nogokora kwabo na ebibe biabo, obaakane koreng’ana nemeremo y’amaboko abo, obae eki bagwenerete konyora.

English: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hawaheshimu kazi za Bwana, na yale ambayo mikono yake imetenda, atawabomoa na kamwe hatawajenga tena.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari kobara ng’a ogokora kw’Omonene, gose emeremo y’amaboko aye, negento; ase ayio nabaiyerie inse, takobaimokia naende.

English: Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
Kiswahili: Bwana asifiwe, kwa maana amesikia kilio changu nikimwomba anihurumie.
Ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe! Ere oigure okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo.

English: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni nguvu zangu na ngao yangu, moyo wangu umemtumaini yeye, nami nimesaidiwa. Moyo wangu unarukaruka kwa furaha nami nitamshukuru kwa wimbo.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere chinguru chiane na enguba yane; nere nsemeretie ase enkoro yane, ere nankonyete. Ase ayio ninde nomosasoko ase enkoro yane; nimbe nkomoterera na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

English: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni nguvu ya watu wake, ngome ya wokovu kwa mpakwa mafuta wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are chinguru ase abanto baye, na obotamero bw’ogotooreka ase omoakwa amaguta oye.

English: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
Kiswahili: Waokoe watu wako na uubariki urithi wako; uwe mchungaji wao na uwabebe milele.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tooria abanto bao abare omwando oo, obe omorisia obo, obabogorie goika kare na kare.

English: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Mpeni Bwana, enyi mashujaa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Inwe abana ba Nyasae, motogie Omonene, atora obonene bw’Omonene ne chinguru chiaye.

English: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
Kiswahili: Mpeni Bwana utukufu unaostahili jina lake; mwabuduni Bwana katika uzuri wa utakatifu wake.
Ekegusii: Togia erieta ri’Omonene rire nobonene obonge; mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu.

English: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana iko juu ya maji; Mungu wa utukufu hupiga radi, Bwana hupiga radi juu ya maji makuu.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigweka ase chinyancha igoro; Nyasae bw’obonene nigo agoaka enkoba, Omonene nigo akogukura igoro ye chinyancha chinyinge.

English: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana ina nguvu; sauti ya Bwana ni tukufu.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigweka rire nokobua; eriogi ri’Omonene nigo riichire nobonene.

English: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana huvunja mierezi; Bwana huvunja vipande vipande mierezi ya Lebanoni.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikobuna emete emecharake, ee, nigo rikobuna emecharake ya Lebanoni.

English: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
Kiswahili: Hufanya Lebanoni irukaruke kama ndama, Sirioni urukaruke kama mwana nyati.
Ekegusii: Nigo agotira‐tiria emete eyio buna emori egotiria, na ebitunwa bia Lebanoni na Sirioni buna eng’era ensae.

English: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana hupiga kwa miali ya umeme wa radi.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikomesia chinsase chi’omorero.

English: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana hutikisa jangwa; Bwana hutikisa Jangwa la Kadeshi.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rigotengechia erooro; ee, nigo rigotengechia erooro ya Kadeshi.

English: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana huzalisha ayala, na huuacha msitu wazi. Hekaluni mwake wote wasema, “Utukufu!”
Ekegusii: Eriogi erio ri’Omonene nigo rikorekeria chingabi, nigo rigosabora emete y’amanani yaba bosa. Ase Hekalu yaye ebitongwa bionsi biatogia obonene bwaye.

English: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.
Kiswahili: Bwana huketi akiwa ametawazwa juu ya gharika; Bwana ametawazwa kuwa Mfalme milele.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kogambera chioora; Omonene nere omorwoti ase ekerogo kiaye kare na kare.

English: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwapa watu wake nguvu; Bwana huwabariki watu wake kwa kuwapa amani.
Ekegusii: Omonene nae abanto baye chinguru, naende abasesenie ase okobaa omorembe.

English: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa kuweka wakfu hekalu. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitakutukuza wewe, Ee Bwana, kwa kuwa umeniinua kutoka vilindi, na hukuacha adui zangu washangilie juu yangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi ekero aatananete Hekalu ekaba enchenu) Aye Omonene, ningotogie, ekiagera kwanyimokirie korwa inse, tigwatigete ababisa baane betogie igoro yane.

English: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, nilikuita unisaidie na wewe umeniponya.
Ekegusii: Aye, Omonene Nyasae one, nigo narerete asore ng’a onkonye, na bono kwangwenirie.

English: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, umenitoa Kuzimu, umeniokoa nisishuke kwenye shimo la mauti.
Ekegusii: Omonene, gwatooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakuure kwang’iraneirie obogima tingenda ase oboina ime.

English: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana, enyi watakatifu wake; lisifuni jina lake takatifu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abachenu baye, tera amatera ay’okobaka Omonene, iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.

English: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hasira yake ni ya muda mfupi, bali upendo wake hudumu siku zote. Inawezekana kilio kiwepo usiku kucha, lakini asubuhi kukawa na furaha.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoba nendamwamu ase engaki ensinini yoka, korende obuya bwaye nigo bokoba ase obogima bw’omonto. Ekerero nabo keranyare kobao ase omogoroba, korende mambia omogooko na omochengo nigo bigocha.

English: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
Kiswahili: Nilipofanikiwa nilisema, “Sitatikiswa kamwe.”
Ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana onsi arenge amaya asende, ngateeba ng’a tinkobugwa.

English: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uliponijalia, uliuimarisha mlima wangu, lakini ulipouficha uso wako nilifadhaika.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase engencho y’obuya bwao ogakora egetunwa kiane kegatenena bokong’u, korende ekero kwabisete obosio bwao nkaba nobwoba.

English: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:
Kiswahili: Kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, niliita, kwa Bwana niliomba rehema:
Ekegusii: Erio nkarera asore, aye Omonene, ngakoboria ase oboitongo:

English: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
Kiswahili: “Kuna faida gani katika kuangamia kwangu? Katika kushuka kwangu shimoni? Je, mavumbi yatakusifu? Je, yatatangaza uaminifu wako?
Ekegusii: Mbitoki ki aye oranyore onye ngokwa na gosoa ase oboina ime? Inee! Orotu rw’amaroba ndonyare kogotogia? Ndonyare koraria obwegenwa bwao?

English: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, unisikie na kunihurumia, Ee Bwana, uwe msaada wangu.”
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyigwe, ondorere amaabera! Omonene, inkonye!

English: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
Kiswahili: Uligeuza maombolezo yangu kuwa kucheza, ulinivua nguo za gunia ukanivika shangwe,
Ekegusii: Aye kwaonchoire omoichano one okaba omochengo; kwandusirie eanga y’emechando, kwambekeire ey’omogooko.

English: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
Kiswahili: ili moyo wangu uweze kukusifu na usikae kimya. Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, nitakushukuru milele.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, omoyo one nogenderere kogotogia, togokira. Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ninkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera kare na kare.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, nimekukimbilia wewe, usiache nikaaibika kamwe, kwa haki yako uniokoe.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, naye ngotamera, tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe; ntoorie goetera ase oboronge bwao!

English: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
Kiswahili: Nitegee sikio lako, uje uniokoe haraka; uwe kwangu mwamba wa kimbilio, ngome imara ya kuniokoa.
Ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane, obe omwango gontooria. Kabe egetare kiane ngotamera, na eburi yane enkong’u, na ontoorie!

English: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wewe ni mwamba wangu na ngome yangu, uniongoze na kunilinda kwa ajili ya jina lako.
Ekegusii: Aye naye egetare kiane na eburi yane; ase engencho y’erieta riao ondaae na kondenda.

English: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
Kiswahili: Uniepushe na mtego niliotegewa, maana wewe ndiwe kimbilio langu.
Ekegusii: Indusie korwa ase oboreba bobisire bombwate, aye naye egekengero kiane.

English: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.
Kiswahili: Ninaikabidhi roho yangu mikononi mwako, unikomboe Ee Bwana, uliye Mungu wa kweli.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae omwegenwa, naye kwambooririe.

English: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ninawachukia wale wanaongʼangʼania sanamu batili; mimi ninamtumaini Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngechete abanto bagosasiima emegwekano ere bosa, korende nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene.

English: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
Kiswahili: Nitafurahia na kushangilia upendo wako, kwa kuwa uliona mateso yangu na ulijua maumivu ya nafsi yangu.
Ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; aye igo ogwechandera emechando yane, na kondengereria mono ase ogochandwa kwane.

English: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
Kiswahili: Hukunikabidhi kwa adui yangu bali umeiweka miguu yangu mahali penye nafasi.
Ekegusii: Tombegeti ase amaboko ’omobisa one; korende gwatenenirie amagoro aane aase are aagare.

English: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana unihurumie, kwa kuwa niko kwenye shida; macho yangu yanafifia kwa huzuni, nafsi yangu na mwili wangu kwa sikitiko.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ndorere amaabera, ekiagera nigo mbwate emechando; amaiso aane arimeire ime ase engencho y’obororo, omoyo one ogoyire, naboigo nomobere one.

English: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
Kiswahili: Maisha yangu yamedhoofika kwa majonzi, naam, miaka yangu kwa kulia kwa maumivu makali; nguvu zangu zinaisha kwa ajili ya mateso, na mifupa yangu inachakaa.
Ekegusii: Ase obogima bwane bwonsi nabeire inde nemechando; na ase emiaka yane yonsi nabeire inde nomoichano; chinguru chiane chiaerire ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane; amauga yomobere one omire pa.

English: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya adui zangu wote, nimedharauliwa kabisa na jirani zangu, hata kwa rafiki zangu nimekuwa tisho, wale wanionao barabarani hunikimbia.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baane bonsi nigo bagonchecheria, na abasani baane boigo. Abanto baamanyete banyoboire; bonsi abakondora ase enchera nigo bagontama.

English: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
Kiswahili: Nimesahaulika miongoni mwao kama mtu aliyekufa, nimekuwa kama chombo cha mfinyanzi kilichovunjika.
Ekegusii: Abanto banyebire buna bakweba omonto okuure; nabeire buna enyongo yatekire.

English: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nimesikia maneno niliyosingiziwa na wengi; vitisho viko pande zote; kwa kuwa wamefanya mashauri dhidi yangu, na kula njama kuniua.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkoigwa ababisa baane bakomonyererana; okogosa nigo kong’etanaine. Abwo nigo bagosangererekana amo kogamba, bagokora omooroberio bw’okong’ita.

English: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi ninakutumaini wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana; nimesema, “Wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu.”
Ekegusii: Korende inche nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene. Nigo ngoteeba: “Aye naye Nyasae one.”

English: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
Kiswahili: Siku za maisha yangu ziko mikononi mwako, uniokoe mikononi mwa adui zangu na wale wanifuatiao.
Ekegusii: Obogima bwane nigo bore ase amaboko ao; ntoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baane na ay’abachandi baane.

English: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
Kiswahili: Mwangazie mtumishi wako uso wako, uniokoe kwa ajili ya upendo wako usiokoma.
Ekegusii: Ing’onchorere obosio bwao, inche omosomba oo, ontoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.

English: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
Kiswahili: Usiniache niaibike, Ee Bwana, kwa maana nimekulilia wewe, bali waovu waaibishwe na kunyamazishwa Kuzimu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tontiga nsookigwe, ekiagera nigo ngokorangeria. Tiga abakori amabe basookigwe, bagende aase abakuure babe amamama.

English: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
Kiswahili: Midomo yao isemayo uongo na inyamazishwe, kwa maana kwa kiburi na dharau wao husema kwa majivuno dhidi ya wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Kiria emenwa yabwo bagokwana amang’ana ’oborimo, abwo bagokwana amang’ana amabe igoro y’oyore omooronge, na gokwana amang’ana yoboenenu na ay’ogochaaya.

English: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi ulivyo mkuu wema wako, uliowawekea akiba wakuchao, ambao huwapa wale wakukimbiliao machoni pa watu.
Ekegusii: Naki obuya bwao bore obonge na obw’ogokumigwa, obwo kwagacheire abanto abakoirogete, ase amasio a Mwanyabaanto nigo okoboorokia ase abakogotamera.

English: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
Kiswahili: Unawahifadhi katika uvuli wa uwepo wako kutokana na hila za wanadamu; katika makao yako huwaweka salama kutokana na ndimi za mashtaka.
Ekegusii: Nigo okobabisa agwo asore, ase okobarenda korwa ase emeroberio emebe y’abanto; nigo okobarenda ase ekiriri kiao korwa ase abanto abang’achi.

English: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
Kiswahili: Atukuzwe Bwana, kwa kuwa amenionyesha upendo wake wa ajabu nilipokuwa katika mji uliozingirwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe! Nigo anyorogetie obwanchani bwaye bw’ogokumia; akandenda ase omochie omokong’u.

English: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
Kiswahili: Katika hofu yangu nilisema, “Nimekatiliwa mbali na macho yako!” Hata hivyo ulisikia kilio changu ukanihurumia nilipokuita unisaidie.
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge nobwoba nigo narengereretie, ngateeba; “Bono naserigwe gochia aare korwa ase obosio bwao!” Korende nigo kwaigwete okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, ekero narerete asore ng’a onkonye.

English: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
Kiswahili: Mpendeni Bwana ninyi watakatifu wake wote! Bwana huwahifadhi waaminifu, lakini wenye kiburi huwalipiza kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Mwanche Omonene, inwe abachenu baye mwensi! Omonene nigo akobarenda buya abanto bare abegenwa, korende nigo akorua egesusuro ase oyore omomwenu.

English: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kuweni hodari na mjipe moyo, ninyi nyote mnaomtumaini Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwensi aba momosemeretie Omonene, kabe ne chinguru, mobe abaremu!

English: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Funzo. Heri mtu yule ambaye amesamehewa makosa yake, ambaye dhambi zake zimefunikwa.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Nasesenirie omonto oyo bwabeirwe ogosaria kwaye, na ebibe biaye biatubirwe.

English: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule ambaye Bwana hamhesabii dhambi, na ambaye rohoni mwake hamna udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyi’Omonene atabarereti okomocha kwaye, oyo otari nobong’ainereria ase omoyo oye ime.

English: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
Kiswahili: Niliponyamaza, mifupa yangu ilichakaa kwa kulia kwa maumivu makali mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaraorokia ebibe biane, omobere one okoma pa ase okwerera omobaso boira.

English: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
Kiswahili: Usiku na mchana mkono wako ulinilemea, nguvu zangu zilinyonywa kama vile katika joto la kiangazi.
Ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko okoboko kwao gokanditoera negesusuro; chinguru chiane chikaera buna amaache akoera ekero ki’egurugura.

English: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
Kiswahili: Kisha nilikujulisha dhambi yangu wala sikuficha uovu wangu. Nilisema, “Nitaungama makosa yangu kwa Bwana.” Ndipo uliponisamehe hatia ya dhambi yangu.
Ekegusii: Erio ngakoorokeria ebibe biane, gose tinakobisete okomocha kwane, ngateeba: “Nimoorokerie Omonene ogosaria kwane,” erio okanyabera ebibe biane bionsi.

English: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kila mtu mcha Mungu akuombe wakati unapopatikana, hakika maji makuu yatakapofurika hayatamfikia yeye.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, kera omonto oyokoirogete tiga agosabe ase engaki y’emechando. Ekero amaache amange agotirimboka gocha bwango, tabaisa komoikera.

English: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
Kiswahili: Wewe ndiwe mahali pangu pa kujificha, utaniepusha na taabu na kunizunguka kwa nyimbo za wokovu.
Ekegusii: Aye naye obwebiso bwane, nondendete korwa ase emechando, nimbe nomogooko na omochengo, ekiagera gwantooririe.

English: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
Kiswahili: Nitakufundisha na kukuonyesha njia utakayoiendea; nitakushauri na kukuangalia.
Ekegusii: Ninkworokererie na gokoraa ase enchera ogwenerete kogenda; ningosemie, na amaiso aane nakorigererie.

English: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
Kiswahili: Usiwe kama farasi au nyumbu wasio na akili, ambao ni lazima waongozwe kwa lijamu na hatamu la sivyo hawatakukaribia.
Ekegusii: Timoba buna chibarasi ne chibarasi chitari nobong’aini, echigwenerete chibekerwe chinkini na ebigobanio bi’ogochigambera.

English: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu ana taabu nyingi, bali upendo usio na kikomo wa Bwana unamzunguka mtu anayemtumaini.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nare namaakwa amange, korende oyomosemeretie Omonene, Omonene nigo amoetananeretie nobwanchani botari koera.

English: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
Kiswahili: Shangilieni katika Bwana na mfurahi, enyi wenye haki! Imbeni, nyote mlio wanyofu wa moyo!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanyene oboronge, mogokere Omonene na komochengera; inwe mwensi abamore ne chinkoro chindonge, aka eriogi nomogooko.

English: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana kwa furaha, enyi wenye haki; kusifu kunawapasa wanyofu wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto abaronge, mochengere Omonene! Inwe abamore ne chinkoro chindonge goika motogie Omonene!

English: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana kwa kinubi, mwimbieni sifa kwa zeze la nyuzi kumi.
Ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase okobugia amakano yebirigisa, motogie ase okobugia amakano are ne chinga ikomi!

English: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni wimbo mpya; pigeni kwa ustadi, na mpaze sauti za shangwe.
Ekegusii: Moteerere ogoteera okoyia, na kobugia ase eriogi rireng’aine buya na komochengera!

English: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
Kiswahili: Maana neno la Bwana ni haki na kweli, ni mwaminifu kwa yote atendayo.
Ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rire boronge, na ogokora kwaye gwonsi nigo agokora ase obwegenwa.

English: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Bwana hupenda uadilifu na haki; dunia imejaa upendo wake usiokoma.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo anchete ayare boronge na ekeene, na ense nigo eichire nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera.

English: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
Kiswahili: Kwa neno la Bwana mbingu ziliumbwa, jeshi lao la angani kwa pumzi ya kinywa chake.
Ekegusii: Ase chinguru chi’ering’ana ri’Omonene igoro egatongwa, na ase okobua kwe ring’ana riaye erioba na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni bigatongwa.

English: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
Kiswahili: Ameyakusanya maji ya bahari kama kwenye chungu; vilindi vya bahari ameviweka katika ghala.
Ekegusii: Igo agosangereria amaache yenyancha, buna amaache are enyongo ime, obeka chindiba aase abo.

English: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
Kiswahili: Dunia yote na imwogope Bwana, watu wote wa dunia wamche.
Ekegusii: Ense yonsi neiroke Omonene, na bonsi abamenyete ase ense bamwoboe.

English: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu alisema, na ikawa, aliamuru na ikasimama imara.
Ekegusii: Naki ere agakwana, na ayio agakoreka; agachiika, na ayio akabao.

English: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
Kiswahili: Bwana huzuia mipango ya mataifa, hupinga makusudi ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoonchorana emeroberio y’abanto b’ebisaku, na gosaria okogamba kwa Mwanyabaanto kwaba bosa.

English: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
Kiswahili: Lakini mipango ya Bwana inasimama imara milele, makusudi ya moyo wake kwa vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: Okogamba kw’Omonene nigo goteneine kare na kare; emeroberio yaye nigo egendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
Kiswahili: Heri taifa ambalo Bwana ni Mungu wao, watu ambao aliwachagua kuwa urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Ngesesenirie egesaku eke Omonene are Nyasae obo, abanto aba achorete babe omwando oye.

English: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
Kiswahili: Kutoka mbinguni Bwana hutazama chini na kuwaona wanadamu wote;
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arigereretie korwa igoro, orooche Mwanyabaanto bonsi.

English: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
Kiswahili: kutoka maskani mwake huwaangalia wote wakaao duniani:
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo ase aikaransete, nigo akobagambera bonsi abamenyete ase ense.

English: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
Kiswahili: yeye ambaye huumba mioyo yao wote, ambaye huangalia kila kitu wanachokitenda.
Ekegusii: Nere otongete chinkoro chi’abaanto bonsi, namanyete korenga ogokora kwabo gwonsi.

English: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mfalme aokokaye kwa ukubwa wa jeshi lake; hakuna shujaa aokokaye kwa wingi wa nguvu zake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti tari orabue nomoganda oye omonene Nyasae bw’abarwani, gose etuoni teri eratoorigwe ne chinguru chiaye chinyinge.

English: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
Kiswahili: Farasi ni tumaini la bure kwa wokovu, licha ya nguvu zake nyingi, hawezi kuokoa.
Ekegusii: Gosemeria chibarasi chi’esegi, ayio mbosa, tichikonyara kobua, chinguru chiabo chinyinge tichigotooria omonto.

English: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
Kiswahili: Lakini macho ya Bwana yako kwa wale wamchao, kwa wale tumaini lao liko katika upendo wake usio na kikomo,
Ekegusii: Rora amaiso a Omonene nigo abarigereretie abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye botari koera.

English: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
Kiswahili: ili awaokoe na mauti, na kuwahifadhi wakati wa njaa.
Ekegusii: Omonene natoorie emioyo yabo korwa ase amakweri, tibakwa ekero gi’enchara.

English: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
Kiswahili: Sisi tunamngojea Bwana kwa matumaini, yeye ni msaada wetu na ngao yetu.
Ekegusii: Emioyo yaito nigo emoganyete Omonene, ere nere ogokonywa gwaito, na enguba yaito.

English: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
Kiswahili: Mioyo yetu humshangilia, kwa maana tunalitumainia jina lake takatifu.
Ekegusii: Ee, chinkoro chiaito nchimogokerete, ekiagera tosemeretie erieta riaye richenu.

English: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
Kiswahili: Upendo wako usio na mwisho ukae juu yetu, Ee Bwana, tunapoliweka tumaini letu kwako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, obwanchani bwao botari koera bobe amo naintwe, ekiagera naye togosemeretie.

English: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi, alipojifanya mwendawazimu mbele ya Abimeleki, ambaye alimfukuza, naye akaondoka. Nitamtukuza Bwana nyakati zote, sifa zake zitakuwa midomoni mwangu siku zote.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Nimbake Omonene chingaki chionsi, ase omonwa one nimotogie botambe.

English: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu itajisifu katika Bwana, walioonewa watasikia na wafurahi.
Ekegusii: Ase omoyo one ninyetogerie Omonene, abwo bachayire tiga bayaigwe bagoke.

English: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
Kiswahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana pamoja nami, naam, na tulitukuze jina lake pamoja.
Ekegusii: Raria obonene bw’Omonene amo nainche totogie erieta riaye twensi amo.

English: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
Kiswahili: Nilimtafuta Bwana naye akanijibu, akaniokoa kwenye hofu zangu zote.
Ekegusii: Nkarangeria Omonene, nere akang’iraneria, akandusia korwa ase obwoba bwane bwonsi.

English: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
Kiswahili: Wale wamtazamao hutiwa nuru, nyuso zao hazifunikwi na aibu kamwe.
Ekegusii: Abwo bamorigereretie nigo bakomeka‐meka bare nomogooko, gose amasio abo takororekana are nobosooku.

English: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Kiswahili: Maskini huyu alimwita Bwana, naye akamsikia, akamwokoa katika taabu zake zote.
Ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo akorera, n’Omonene omoigwa, omotooria korwa ase emechando yaye yonsi.

English: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana hufanya kituo akiwazunguka wale wamchao, naye huwaokoa.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene nigo akorenda na goetanana abwo bamoirogete Omonene na kobatooria.

English: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Kiswahili: Onjeni mwone kwamba Bwana ni mwema, heri mtu yule anayemkimbilia.
Ekegusii: Moteeme Omonene, morore ng’a nomuya. Nasesenirie omonto oria omotameire.

English: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
Kiswahili: Mcheni Bwana enyi watakatifu wake, kwa maana wale wamchao hawapungukiwi na chochote.
Ekegusii: Moiroke Omonene, inwe abachenu baye, naki abwo bamoirogete tibakoremerwa kende.

English: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
Kiswahili: Wana simba wenye nguvu hutindikiwa na kuona njaa, bali wale wamtafutao Bwana hawatakosa kitu chochote kilicho chema.
Ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nachinyare koremerwa na koba nenchara, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene tibakoremerwa kende gionsi kere ekiya.

English: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Njooni, watoto wangu, mnisikilize, nitawafundisha kumcha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abana baane, inchwo montegerere, mborokererie buna moramoiroke Omonene.

English: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
Kiswahili: Yeyote kati yenu anayependa uzima na kutamani kuziona siku nyingi njema,
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye nomonto bwanchete obogima? Oganetie obe moyo amatuko amange, na korora amaya?

English: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
Kiswahili: basi auzuie ulimi wake na mabaya, na midomo yake kutokana na kusema uongo.
Ekegusii: Rirorio tanga oromeme rwao tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biao tibikwana obong’ainereria.

English: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
Kiswahili: Aache uovu, atende mema, aitafute amani na kuifuatilia.
Ekegusii: Otige amabe, okore amaya; origie omorembe na koyobwata mono.

English: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
Kiswahili: Macho ya Bwana huwaelekea wenye haki, na masikio yake yako makini kusikiliza kilio chao.
Ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ebirero biabo.

English: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
Kiswahili: Uso wa Bwana uko kinyume na watendao maovu, ili kufuta kumbukumbu lao duniani.
Ekegusii: Obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore mamincha y’abwo bagokora amabe, nabasirie korwa ase ense, tibainyorwa.

English: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
Kiswahili: Wenye haki hulia, naye Bwana huwasikia, huwaokoa katika taabu zao zote.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bakorera ng’a bakonywe, Omonene nigo akobaigwa na kobatooria korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.

English: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Kiswahili: Bwana yu karibu na waliovunjika moyo, na huwaokoa waliopondeka roho.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang’e nabwo chinkoro chiabo chiabunekire, nigo akobatooria abwo berusirie moyo.

English: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
Kiswahili: Mwenye haki ana mateso mengi, lakini Bwana humwokoa nayo yote,
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akonyora emechando emenge, korende Omonene namotoorie korwa ase eyio yonsi;

English: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
Kiswahili: huhifadhi mifupa yake yote, hata mmoja hautavunjika.
Ekegusii: nigo akorenda amauga aye onsi, rinde tiribunwa nonya nerimo.

English: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
Kiswahili: Ubaya utamuua mtu mwovu, nao adui za mwenye haki watahukumiwa.
Ekegusii: Obobe nigo boraite omokori amabe, na abwo bagechete omonyene oboronge nabagaambigwe, banyore egesusuro.

English: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwakomboa watumishi wake, yeyote anayemkimbilia yeye hatahukumiwa kamwe.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobooria emioyo y’abasomba baye, gose onde tari ase abwo bakomotamera orache kogambigwa.

English: By David. Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, pingana na wale wanaopingana nami, upigane na hao wanaopigana nami.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, engereria abanto abwo bakoengererania nainche, rwania abwo bakondwania!

English: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
Kiswahili: Chukua ngao na kigao. Inuka unisaidie.
Ekegusii: Bogoria enguba na eng’aya, imoka onkonye!

English: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
Kiswahili: Inua mkuki wako na fumo lako dhidi ya hao wanaonifuatia. Iambie nafsi yangu, “Mimi ni wokovu wako.”
Ekegusii: Aye orute abanto abwo bakombwatia ritimo na esimisi! Ontebie ase omoyo one: “Ninche Omotooria oo.”

English: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
Kiswahili: Wafedheheshwe na waaibishwe wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu. Wanaofanya shauri kuniangamiza warudishwe nyuma kwa hofu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, tiga babugwe na gosookigwa. Abwo bagokora emeroberio emebe y’okong’ita, tiga bairanigwe babe nobosooku.

English: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh’s angel driving them on.
Kiswahili: Wawe kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo, malaika wa Bwana akiwafukuza.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga, na omomalaika Omonene abe okobaiyeria.

English: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.
Kiswahili: Njia yao na iwe giza na ya utelezi, malaika wa Bwana akiwafuatilia.
Ekegusii: Omosunte na oboterere bibe ase enchera bagoetera, na omomalaika Omonene abe okobabwata abasirie.

English: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
Kiswahili: Kwa vile walinifichia wavu wao bila sababu, na bila sababu wamenichimbia shimo,
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bambekeire oboreba bobisi engencho ende etaiyo, na bakunyire eirima ng’a basirie obogima bwane.

English: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
Kiswahili: maafa na yawapate ghafula: wavu walionifichia na uwatege wenyewe, na waanguke katika shimo hilo, kwa maangamizo yao.
Ekegusii: Ogosirigwa tiga kobanyore mobosokano; oboreba obwo bantegeire tiga bobabwate barabwo abanyene, tiga bagwe imeo abanyene na gosirigwa.

English: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nafsi yangu itashangilia katika Bwana na kuufurahia wokovu wake.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nogoke ase Omonene na gochenga ase engencho y’ogotooreka kwaye.

English: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
Kiswahili: Nitapaza sauti yangu nikisema, “Ni nani aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana? Wewe huwaokoa maskini kutokana na wale walio na nguvu kuliko wao, maskini na mhitaji kutokana na wanaowanyangʼanya!”
Ekegusii: Amauga onsi ay’omobere one nateebe, “Aye Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye? Aye Omonene, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru korwa ase oyore ne chinguru komobua, ee, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru naende omoremerwa, korwa ase oyo okomochanda.”

English: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
Kiswahili: Mashahidi wakatili wanainuka, wananiuliza mambo nisiyoyajua.
Ekegusii: Birori bi’oborimo nigo bakonyimokera, bakomboria ase amang’ana ntamanyeti.

English: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
Kiswahili: Wananilipa baya kwa jema na kuiacha nafsi yangu ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya, nerusirie moyo.

English: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
Kiswahili: Lakini walipokuwa wagonjwa, nilivaa nguo ya gunia na nikajinyenyekesha kwa kufunga. Maombi yangu yaliponirudia bila kujibiwa,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo barwarete nigo neboyetie eanga y’okweumia na goichana; ngechanda ase okweng’ata, ngasaba nturegete omotwe.

English: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
Kiswahili: niliendelea kuomboleza kama vile wao ni rafiki au ndugu. Niliinamisha kichwa chini kwa huzuni kama ninayemwombolezea mama yangu.
Ekegusii: Nkabechandera buna nigo barenge abasani baane gose abaminto; nigo nabegete eanga y’okweumia, nturegete omotwe buna omonto okweumia ekero ng’ina akuure.

English: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
Kiswahili: Lakini nilipojikwaa, walikusanyika kwa shangwe; washambuliaji walijikusanya dhidi yangu bila mimi kujua. Walinisingizia pasipo kukoma.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero narenge ase emechando, nigo basangererekanete amo bakagoka. Abanto batagwenerete, aba ntamanyeti bakaba bagonchecheria batari gotiga.

English: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Kiswahili: Kama watu wasiomcha Mungu, wamenidhihaki, wamenisagia meno.
Ekegusii: Abatamoirogeti Omonene nigo banchayete na gonchecheria, bakangecha bakaba bakondiananeria amaino.

English: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, utatazama mpaka lini? Niokoe maisha yangu na maangamizi yao, uhai wangu wa thamani kutokana na simba hawa.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri orabe koyarigereretie rioka? Intaborie korwa ase ogosiria barobeirie, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase chindo echio!

English: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
Kiswahili: Nami nitakushukuru mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa, nitakusifu katikati ya watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Erio ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono agwo ase omosangererekano omonene, ningotogie ase omoganda omonene bw’abaanto.

English: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
Kiswahili: Usiwaache wale wanaonisimanga, wale ambao ni adui zangu bila sababu; usiwaache wale ambao ni adui zangu bila sababu wakonyeze jicho kwa hila.
Ekegusii: Totiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane engencho ende etaiyo; totiga abwo bangechete bosa bagosimanera amaiso bankore bobe.

English: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
Kiswahili: Hawazungumzi kwa amani, bali wanatunga mashtaka ya uongo dhidi ya wale wanaoishi kwa utulivu katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari gokwana amang’ana akorenta omorembe; nigo bakona-korigia amang’ana yobong’ainereria igoro y’abanto abwo bare abatoereru ase ense.

English: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
Kiswahili: Hunifumbulia vinywa vyao wakisema, “Aha! Aha! Kwa macho yetu wenyewe tumeliona.”
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagwasamia emenwa yabo bateeba: “Ahaa! Ahaa! Ntwayarora namaiso aito.”

English: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, umeona hili, usiwe kimya. Usiwe mbali nami, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kwarorire amang’ana ayio, tokirakiri. Omonene, tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende!

English: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
Kiswahili: Amka, inuka unitetee! Unipiganie Mungu wangu na Bwana wangu.
