Ekegusii: Omonene one, ore Nyasae one, tabobora, oimokerere igoro, erinde orwanerere oboronge bwane na amang’ana aane.

English: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
Kiswahili: Nihukumu kwa haki yako, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, sawasawa na haki yako; usiwaache wakusimange.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nacha ekiina kiane koreng’ana noboronge bwao, tobaisa gotiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane.

English: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
Kiswahili: Usiwaache wafikiri, “Aha, hili ndilo tulilotaka!” Au waseme, “Tumemmeza.”
Ekegusii: Tobatiga bateebe: “Bono twamonyorire buna twaganetie.” Tobatiga bateebe: “Bono twamobuire.”

English: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
Kiswahili: Wote wanaofurahia dhiki yangu waaibishwe na wachanganyikiwe; hao wanaojiinua dhidi yangu wavikwe aibu na dharau.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakogokera emechando yane, tiga basookigwe na batantanigwe; abwo bagwetogia igoro yane, tiga baboigwe obosooku na ogochaywa.

English: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
Kiswahili: Wale wanaofurahia hukumu yangu ya haki wapige kelele za shangwe na furaha; hebu waseme siku zote, “Bwana atukuzwe, ambaye amefurahia mafanikio ya mtumishi wake.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo banchete ng’a ng’egwe oboronge bwane, tiga baake eriogi ri’omogooko na omochengo, bagenderere goteeba: “Omonene noyo bw’obonene! Ee, nigo agokirie namaya omosomba oye akonyora!”

English: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wangu utanena haki yako na sifa zako mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Erio oromeme rwane ndogenderere koraria oboronge bwao, na ogotogigwa kwao, omobaso boira.

English: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of Yahweh. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi mtumishi wa Bwana. Kuna neno moyoni mwangu kuhusu hali ya dhambi ya mwovu. Hakuna hofu ya Mungu mbele ya macho yake.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi, omosomba Omonene) Ebibe nigo bigokwana nomonto omokori amabe ase enkoro yaye ime; okomoiroka Nyasae tikori ase obosio bwaye.

English: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa machoni pake mwenyewe hujisifu mno hata hawezi kugundua au kuichukia dhambi yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyo nigo akweremia omonyene ase okweng’aina, ng’a ebibe biaye tibikomanyekana bigechwe.

English: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya kinywa chake ni maovu na ya udanganyifu, ameacha kuwa mwenye hekima na kutenda mema.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana omonto oyio agokwana nigo are ay’ogosaria na obong’ainereria; ere otigire gokora amang’ana ’obong’aini na ayare amaya.

English: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
Kiswahili: Hata kitandani mwake hupanga hila mbaya, hujitia katika njia ya dhambi na hakatai lililo baya.
Ekegusii: Ekero araire borere bwaye nigo agokora emeroberio y’amabe, na kobwatia chinchera chitari chingiya, tari kwanga obobe bonde bwonsi.

English: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Kiswahili: Upendo wako, Ee Bwana, unafika hadi mbinguni, uaminifu wako hadi kwenye anga.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao botari koera nigo bogoika aaria igoro, na obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete ase amare igoro.

English: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.
Kiswahili: Haki yako ni kama milima mikubwa, hukumu zako ni kama kilindi kikuu. Ee Bwana, wewe huwahifadhi mwanadamu na mnyama.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oboronge bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u buna ebitunwa biao. Okogamba kwao nigo kore buna chindiba chintambe, aye nigo orendete Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti boigo.

English: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
Kiswahili: Upendo wako usiokoma ni wa thamani mno! Watu wakuu na wadogo hujificha uvulini wa mbawa zako.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, naki obwanchani bwao bwa botambe bore obonene! Mwanyabaanto nigo bagotamera ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao.

English: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
Kiswahili: Wanajifurahisha katika wingi nyumbani mwako, nawe utawanywesha katika mto wa furaha zako.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoisanekigwa nobonoru bokorwa ase enyomba yao, aye nobae banywe korwa ase orooche rwao rw’okogokia.

English: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
Kiswahili: Kuwa pamoja nawe ni kijito cha uzima, katika nuru yako twaona nuru.
Ekegusii: Naye ore ensoko y’obogima, na ase omobaso oo nigo tokorora omobaso.

English: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Kiswahili: Dumisha upendo wako kwa wale wanaokujua wewe, haki yako kwa wale walio wanyofu wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Genderera koorokia obwanchani bwao obonene ase abwo bakomanyete, na oboronge bwao ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
Kiswahili: Mguu wa mwenye kiburi usije dhidi yangu, wala mkono wa mwovu usinifukuze.
Ekegusii: Totiga amagoro ya abaenenu ang’ike ang’e kondwania, gose amaboko ya abakori amabe anserie.

English: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
Kiswahili: Angalia jinsi watenda mabaya walivyoanguka: wametupwa chini, hawawezi kuinuka!
Ekegusii: Rora aase abakori amabe bagure inse, baiyerigwe tibakonyara koboka naende.

English: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Usisumbuke kwa ajili ya watendao maovu, wala usiwaonee wivu watendao mabaya,
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Togechigwa ase engencho y’abakori amabe, toba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.

English: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
Kiswahili: kwa maana kama majani watanyauka mara, kama mimea ya kijani watakufa mara.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbasirigwe bwango, basire buna obonyansi basusane buna ebimeri ebibese.

English: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
Kiswahili: Mtumaini Bwana na utende yaliyo mema; Kaa katika nchi ukafurahie malisho salama.
Ekegusii: Mosemerie Omonene okore ayare amaya, erio nario oramenye ase ense, obe korendire buya.

English: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Kiswahili: Jifurahishe katika Bwana naye atakupa haja za moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Goka ase Omonene, ere nakoe okogania gw’enkoro yao.

English: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
Kiswahili: Mkabidhi Bwana njia yako, mtumaini yeye, naye atatenda hili:
Ekegusii: Erue ase Omonene mosemerie ere bweka, nere naoboseemia.

English: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
Kiswahili: Yeye atafanya haki yako ingʼae kama mapambazuko, na hukumu ya shauri lako kama jua la adhuhuri.
Ekegusii: Omonene naorokie oboronge bwao buna akoorokia oborabu, na ekeene kiao buna amasase a mobaso gati.

English: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
Kiswahili: Tulia mbele za Bwana na umngojee kwa uvumilivu; usisumbuke watu wanapofanikiwa katika njia zao, wanapotekeleza mipango yao miovu.
Ekegusii: Obe n’obotoereru ase obosio bw’Omonene, omoganye noboremereria. Togechigwa nomonto okogenderera buya ase enchera yaye, omonto oyio okoroberia ogosaria.

English: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
Kiswahili: Epuka hasira na uache ghadhabu, usihangaike: itakuongoza tu kutenda uovu.
Ekegusii: Bwetange korwa ase endamwamu, tiga ekeririanda kegima. Togechigwa; okogechigwa nigo koragere okore ebibe.

English: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana waovu watakatiliwa mbali, bali wale wanaomtumaini Bwana watairithi nchi.
Ekegusii: Abanyabibe mbasirigwe kegima, korende abamoganyete Omonene mbaire ense ebe omwando obo.

English: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
Kiswahili: Bado kitambo kidogo, nao waovu hawataonekana, ingawa utawatafuta, hawataonekana.
Ekegusii: Netigarete engaki ensinini, na omokori amabe asirigwe; nobe gokorigereria mono aase aye, takonyorekana oreo.

English: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
Kiswahili: Bali wanyenyekevu watairithi nchi na wafurahie amani tele.
Ekegusii: Abaitongo mbaire ense ebe omwando obo, na barabwo mbagoke na goisaneka ase obonge bw’omorembe.

English: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
Kiswahili: Waovu hula njama dhidi ya wenye haki na kuwasagia meno,
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agokora omooroberio bw’ogoita oyore omooronge, na komoriananeria amaino.

English: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
Kiswahili: bali Bwana huwacheka waovu, kwa sababu anajua siku yao inakuja.
Ekegusii: Omonene nasekerere omokori amabe, ekiagera aroche ng’a rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwaye ndichiche.

English: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
Kiswahili: Waovu huchomoa upanga na kupinda upinde, ili wawaangushe maskini na wahitaji, kuwachinja wale ambao njia zao ni nyofu.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bagosomora emeyio yabo na batinga amata abo, erinde baite abanto abataka na abaremeire, baite na abakobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge.

English: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
Kiswahili: Lakini panga zao zitachoma mioyo yao wenyewe, na pinde zao zitavunjwa.
Ekegusii: Emeyio yabo nebete chinkoro chiabo abanyene, na amata abo nabunwe.

English: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
Kiswahili: Bora kidogo walicho nacho wenye haki kuliko wingi wa mali wa waovu wengi;
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebike omonto omonyaboronge abwate, nigo bire ebiya kobua ebinge biria abakori amabe abange babwate.

English: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
Kiswahili: kwa maana nguvu za waovu zitavunjwa, lakini Bwana humtegemeza mwenye haki.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe mbaurwe chinguru echi babwate, korende Omonene nagenderere koa abanyaboronge chinguru.

English: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
Kiswahili: Bwana anazifahamu siku za wanyofu, na urithi wao utadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo amanyete amatuko ya abamoirogete, na omwando obo nogenderere kobao kare na kare.

English: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
Kiswahili: Siku za maafa hawatanyauka, siku za njaa watafurahia wingi wa vitu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibari gosookigwa ase chingaki chi’amabe, ase chingaki chi’enchara nigo bakoigota.

English: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
Kiswahili: Lakini waovu wataangamia: Adui za Bwana watakuwa kama uzuri wa mashamba, watatoweka, watatoweka kama moshi.
Ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbasirigwe; ababisa ba Omonene nigo bare buna obuya bw’ebisicha, nigo barasire, ee, mbasire buna erioki rigosira kegima.

English: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
Kiswahili: Waovu hukopa na hawalipi, bali wenye haki hutoa kwa ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoira egento singo tagokeirania, korende omonto omooronge nigo are namaabera na korua ebiegwa,

English: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaobarikiwa na Bwana watairithi nchi, bali wale anaowalaani watakatiliwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Abanto abw’Omonene asesenirie mbaire ense ebe eyabo, korende abwo aragereirie mbasirigwe kegima.

English: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
Kiswahili: Kama Bwana akipendezwa na njia ya mtu, yeye huimarisha hatua zake,
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobeka orogendo rw’omonto omooronge chinguru, na kogokigwa nabarabwo.

English: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
Kiswahili: ajapojikwaa, hataanguka, kwa maana Bwana humtegemeza kwa mkono wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio naisa kogochwa, takogwa inse, ekiagera Omonene namobwatete okoboko kwaye.

English: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
Kiswahili: Nilikuwa kijana na sasa ni mzee, lakini sijaona kamwe wenye haki wameachwa au watoto wao wakiombaomba chakula.
Ekegusii: Nigo narenge omwana, bono nagotire, korende tinana-korora omonto omooronge ogotigwa bosa, gose abana baye bakoborwa endagera.

English: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
Kiswahili: Wakati wote ni wakarimu na hukopesha bila masharti. Watoto wao watabarikiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera kona-korua ebiegwa na korua singo, abana baye nigo barasesenigwe.

English: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
Kiswahili: Acha ubaya na utende wema, nawe utaishi katika nchi milele.
Ekegusii: Tiga gokora amabe, kora ayare amaya, igo nario orachie kare.

English: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana huwapenda wenye haki naye hatawaacha waaminifu wake. Watalindwa milele, lakini uzao wa waovu utakatiliwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo anchete oboronge; tagotiga abachenu baye. Barabwo mbarendwe goika kare na kare, korende ororeria rw’abakori amabe ndosirigwe kegima.

English: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
Kiswahili: Wenye haki watairithi nchi, na kuishi humo milele.
Ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbaire ense ebe eyabo, erio bagenderere komenyao botambe.

English: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
Kiswahili: Kinywa cha mwenye haki hutamka hekima, nao ulimi wake huzungumza lililo haki.
Ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonto omooronge nigo agokwana amang’ana yobong’aini, na oromeme rwaye nigo rogosokia ay’ekeene.

English: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
Kiswahili: Sheria ya Mungu wake imo moyoni mwake; nyayo zake hazitelezi.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko a Nyasae oye nigo abeerete ase enkoro y’omonto oyio; ase agoeta tari gotererigwa.

English: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
Kiswahili: Watu waovu huvizia wenye haki, wakitafuta kuwaua;
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotengera omonto omooronge, erio origia chinchera chi’okomoita.

English: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
Kiswahili: lakini Bwana hatawaacha mikononi mwao wala hatawaacha wahukumiwe kuwa wakosa wanaposhtakiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene tagotiga omonto omooronge ase okobua kw’omokori amabe, gose takomotiga abugwe ekero asoeirwe ase ekegambero.

English: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
Kiswahili: Mngojee Bwana, na uishike njia yake. Naye atakutukuza uirithi nchi, waovu watakapokatiliwa mbali, utaliona hilo.
Ekegusii: Gany’Omonene na obwatie enchera yaye, nere nakoimokererie igoro akoe ense ebe eyao; erio norigererie orore buna abanyabibe bagosirigwa.

English: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
Kiswahili: Nimemwona mtu mwovu na mkatili akistawi kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni,
Ekegusii: Narorire omokori amabe otindire ase obomwenu, akaba okoranda buna emecharake egokina ase amaroba amatobu.

English: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
Kiswahili: lakini alitoweka mara na hakuonekana, ingawa nilimtafuta, hakupatikana.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amake ngaetera aase agwo, korende tarengeo, nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora aande.

English: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
Kiswahili: Watafakari watu wasio na hatia, wachunguze watu wakamilifu, kuna mafanikio kwa mtu apendaye amani.
Ekegusii: Rigereria omonto omoikeranu, ee, origererie omonto ore nenkoro endonge, norore ng’a omonto ogokora omorembe nere orachie kare.

English: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
Kiswahili: Lakini watenda dhambi wote wataangamizwa, mafanikio yao yatakatiliwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Korende abasaria mbasirigwe bonsi pi, na ororeria rw’abakori amabe tirokogenderera.

English: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
Kiswahili: Wokovu wa wenye haki hutoka kwa Bwana, yeye ni ngome yao wakati wa shida.
Ekegusii: Ogotooreka kw’abanyaboronge nigo gokorwa ase Omonene, ere nere obotamero bwabo ase chingaki chi’emechando.

English: Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwasaidia na kuwaokoa, huwaokoa kutoka kwa waovu na kuwahifadhi, kwa maana wanamkimbilia.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobakonya na kobatooria; nigo akobarusia korwa ase abakori amabe, obatooria, ekiagera bakomotamera.

English: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Maombi. Ee Bwana, usinikemee katika hasira yako, wala kuniadhibu katika ghadhabu yako.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omonene, tontogonyera ekero ore nendamwamu, tong’a egesusuro gi’okondongeyia ekero ore nekeririanda.

English: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mishale yako imenichoma, na mkono wako umenishukia.
Ekegusii: Kwandasire emegwe yao yasoeire ime yane, kwanyiyeirie inse nokoboko kwao.

English: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
Kiswahili: Hakuna afya mwilini mwangu kwa sababu ya ghadhabu yako, mifupa yangu haina uzima kwa sababu ya dhambi zangu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ekeririanda kiao omobere one bwensi orwarire, nase engencho y’ebibe biane amauga aane nigo akonyatia.

English: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
Kiswahili: Maovu yangu yamenifunika kama mzigo usiochukulika.
Ekegusii: Ebibe biane biantubire nonya nomotwe bwonsi, bianditoeire na kombua.

English: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
Kiswahili: Majeraha yangu yameoza na yananuka, kwa sababu ya upumbavu wa dhambi zangu.
Ekegusii: Amaote aane agundire atiokire bobe ase engencho y’oboriri bwane.

English: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
Kiswahili: Nimeinamishwa chini na kushushwa sana, mchana kutwa nazunguka nikiomboleza.
Ekegusii: Igo ng’umaime na koumata, nigo ingendererete korera na goichana omobaso boira.

English: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
Kiswahili: Viuno vyangu vimejaa maumivu yaunguzayo, hakuna afya mwilini mwangu.
Ekegusii: Chibachwa chiane nigo chikoyia buna omorero, omobere one bwonsi orwarire.

English: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
Kiswahili: Nimedhoofika na kupondwa kabisa, nasononeka kwa maumivu makuu ya moyoni.
Ekegusii: Chinguru chiane chionsi chiaerire, nasenyentekire, nigo nkona‐kweumia ase engencho y’obororo bw’enkoro yane.

English: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, yote ninayoyaonea shauku yako wazi mbele zako, kutamani kwangu sana hakufichiki mbele zako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo omanyete okogania kwane gwonsi, na ogochandeka kwane tikobisekaneti asore.

English: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu unapigapiga, nguvu zangu zimeniishia; hata macho yangu yametiwa giza.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, chinguru chiang’ereire; amaiso aane asoirwe orotutu, tindi korora.

English: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
Kiswahili: Rafiki na wenzangu wananikwepa kwa sababu ya majeraha yangu; majirani zangu wanakaa mbali nami.
Ekegusii: Abanchi na abasani baane babeereire aare korwa ase amaakwa aane, na abanto baminto boigo bambeereire aare.

English: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu wanatega mitego yao, wale ambao wangetaka kunidhuru huongea juu ya maangamizi yangu; hufanya shauri la hila mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo baganetie gosiria obogima bwane bantegeire oboreba; na abwo baganetie gonkora bobe nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’ogosirigwa kwane, bakorengereria amang’ana yobong’ainereria omobaso boira.

English: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni kama mtu kiziwi, asiyeweza kusikia, ni kama bubu, asiyeweza kufungua kinywa chake,
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabeire buna omotino, tindi koigwa, nabeire buna omonto rimama, tindi gokwana.

English: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
Kiswahili: nimekuwa kama mtu asiyesikia, ambaye kinywa chake hakiwezi kutoa jibu.
Ekegusii: Ee, inche nabeire buna omonto otari koigwa, buna oyo omonwa oye otabwati amang’ana okoiraneria.

English: For I hope in you, Yahweh. You will answer, Lord my God.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ninakungojea wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, utajibu.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene, naye nsemereretie. Omonene, Nyasae one, naye oranyare koiraneria.

English: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nilisema, “Usiwaache wafurahie, wala wasijitukuze juu yangu mguu wangu unapoteleza.”
Ekegusii: Nigo nkogosaba ng’a ababisa baane tibagokera emechando yane; na tibetogeria okogwa kwane.

English: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninakaribia kuanguka, na maumivu yangu yananiandama siku zote.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeereire ang’e kogwa, na obororo bwane nigo bogendererete kobeera asende.

English: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
Kiswahili: Naungama uovu wangu, ninataabishwa na dhambi yangu.
Ekegusii: Bono nigo nkoorokia ogosaria kwane, neitirie ase engencho y’ebibe biane.

English: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
Kiswahili: Wengi ni wale ambao ni adui zangu hodari, wale wanaonichukia bila sababu ni wengi.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bare abagima, naende bare ne chinguru, abwo bangechete bosa nabange bare.

English: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
Kiswahili: Wanaolipa maovu kwa wema wangu hunisingizia ninapofuata lililo jema.
Ekegusii: Abwo bagoakana amabe ase amaya nigo babeire ababisa baane, ekiagera ngokora ayare amaya.

English: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, usiniache, usiwe mbali nami, Ee Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene, tontiga! Aye Nyasae one, tobaisa kombeera aare!

English: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwokozi wangu, uje upesi kunisaidia.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ore ogotooreka kwane, ayerera onkonye!

English: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa Yeduthuni. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nilisema, “Nitaziangalia njia zangu na kuuzuia ulimi wangu usije ukatenda dhambi; nitaweka lijamu kinywani mwangu wakati wote waovu wanapokuwa karibu nami.”
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Ngateeba: “Nindende orogendo rwane, timbaisa gokora ebibe ekero ngokwana. Nimbeke omonwa one ekeokio ekero abakori amabe bare ase obosio bwane.”

English: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
Kiswahili: Lakini niliponyamaza kimya na kutulia, hata pasipo kusema lolote jema, uchungu wangu uliongezeka.
Ekegusii: Igo narenge nkirete‐kiri, tinare gokwana, tinaba na koremigwa konde, obororo bwane bokamenteka mono,

English: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu ulipata moto ndani yangu, nilipotafakari, moto uliwaka, ndipo nikasema kwa ulimi wangu:
Ekegusii: enkoro yane ekaba ekoyia omorero ime yane. Ekero naare ndengereretie aya, omorero ogoka, tinare konyara gwetanga ogokwana kwane.

English: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana, nijulishe mwisho wa maisha yangu na hesabu ya siku zangu; nijalie kujua jinsi maisha yangu yanavyopita upesi.
Ekegusii: Omonene, imanyie omoerio bw’amatuko aane, na ekerengo ki’amatuko aane naki keng’ana, erinde imanye ng’a obogima bwane nobweng’e.

English: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
Kiswahili: Umefanya maisha yangu mafupi kama pumzi; muda wangu wa kuishi ni kama hauna thamani kwako. Maisha ya kila mwanadamu ni kama pumzi.
Ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko kwang’ete nameng’e mono. Engaki y’obogima bwane nigo ere buna teri gento ase obosio bwao. Amaene, kera omonto, nonya bwetenenerete bokong’u, nigo agoeta bwango buna omwaga.

English: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
Kiswahili: Hakika kila binadamu ni kama njozi aendapo huku na huko: hujishughulisha na mengi lakini ni ubatili; anakusanya mali nyingi, wala hajui ni nani atakayeifaidi.
Ekegusii: Amaene, Mwanyabaanto nigo agotaara ore buna omogwekano okorora ase okorota; nigo agwechanda bosa; asangereria enibo, korende tamanyeti gose ning’o orache koyeria.

English: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
Kiswahili: “Lakini sasa Bwana, nitafute nini? Tumaini langu ni kwako.
Ekegusii: Nabono aye Omonene, inki nganyete? Naye bweka nsemeretie.

English: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
Kiswahili: Niokoe kutoka kwenye makosa yangu yote, usinifanye kuwa dhihaka ya wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Ntoorie korwa ase ogosaria kwane, tontiga nsekererwe noyio ore omoriri.

English: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
Kiswahili: Nilinyamaza kimya, sikufumbua kinywa changu, kwa sababu wewe ndiwe uliyetenda hili.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkirete‐kiri, tindi komumora omonwa one, ekiagera aye naye gwakorete ayio.

English: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
Kiswahili: Niondolee mjeledi wako, nimeshindwa kwa mapigo ya mkono wako.
Ekegusii: Rusia egesusuro kiao asende; naerire ase ogoakwa gw’okoboko kwao.

English: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.
Kiswahili: Unakemea na kuadhibu wanadamu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao; unaharibu utajiri wao kama nondo aharibuvyo: kila mwanadamu ni kama pumzi tu.
Ekegusii: Ekero okorongeyia omonto ase okomotogonyera ase engencho y’ebibe, nigo ogosiria obonene bwaye, koreng’ana buna ebigwankwa bikoria chianga. Amaene, Mwanyabaanto nigo anga buna omwaga.

English: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana, usikie maombi yangu, usikie kilio changu unisaidie, usiwe kiziwi kwa kulia kwangu. Kwani mimi ninaishi na wewe kama mgeni, kama walivyokuwa baba zangu wote,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane, otegerere okorera kwane; tokira‐kiri ekero nkoiyeria amariga, ekiagera inche nomogeni oo inde, na omoeti buna chisokoro chiane chiarenge.

English: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
Kiswahili: Tazama mbali nami, ili niweze kufurahi tena kabla sijaondoka na nisiwepo tena.”
Ekegusii: Intige, inyore chinguru chinyia ntararua ase ense, na ntabeo naende.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nilimngoja Bwana kwa saburi, naye akaniinamia, akasikia kilio changu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Nkaba imoganyete Omonene ase okoremereria, na ere akanyeonchorera akaigwa ekerero kiane.

English: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
Kiswahili: Akanipandisha kutoka shimo la uharibifu, kutoka matope na utelezi; akaiweka miguu yangu juu ya mwamba na kunipa mahali imara pa kusimama.
Ekegusii: Ere akandusia korwa ase engoro y’obosareku, korwa ase etintira na esike; agatenenia amagoro aane ase egetare igoro, agankong’ia ase ngoeta.

English: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Akaweka wimbo mpya kinywani mwangu, wimbo wa sifa kwa Mungu wetu. Wengi wataona na kuogopa na kuweka tumaini lao kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Akanyorokereria oteera ogoteera okoyia, ogoteera gw’okomotogia Nyasae oito. Abange nabayarore na koiroka, na igo mbamosemerie Omonene.

English: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule amfanyaye Bwana kuwa tumaini lake, asiyewategemea wenye kiburi, wale wenye kugeukia miungu ya uongo.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria omosemeretie Omonene, otari kweonchora gochia ase abanto abaenenu, gose ase abwo bagosira ase okoonchokera chinyasae chi’oborimo.

English: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, umefanya mambo mengi ya ajabu. Mambo uliyopanga kwa ajili yetu hakuna awezaye kukuhesabia; kama ningesema na kuyaelezea, yangekuwa mengi mno kuyaelezea.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ogokora kwao na ebirengererio biao ase tore nebi’ogokumia; onde tari orareng’anigwe naye. Ninganetie koraria ayio na koyakwana, korende namange mono, takobareka.

English: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
Kiswahili: Dhabihu na sadaka hukuvitaka, lakini umefungua masikio yangu; sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za dhambi hukuzihitaji.
Ekegusii: Ebing’wanso na ebiruegwa tobiganeti, korende amato aane kwayatinoire. Ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’ebibe tobiganeti.

English: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
Kiswahili: Ndipo niliposema, “Mimi hapa, nimekuja: imeandikwa kunihusu katika kitabu.
Ekegusii: Erio ngateeba: “Rigereria, nachire; ase egetabu nigo eriikire aya ngwenerete gokora.

English: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu wangu, natamani kuyafanya mapenzi yako; sheria yako iko ndani ya moyo wangu.”
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ninganetie nkore ogwancha kwao, amachiiko ao nigo are ase enkoro yane ime.”

English: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.
Kiswahili: Nimehubiri haki katika kusanyiko kubwa, sikufunga mdomo wangu, Ee Bwana, kama ujuavyo.
Ekegusii: Ase omosangererekano omonene narandirie amang’ana amaya ay’oboronge; aye Omonene, nomanyete ng’a tingotanga ebikoba biane tibiyakwana.

English: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
Kiswahili: Sikuficha haki yako moyoni mwangu; ninasema juu ya uaminifu wako na wokovu wako. Sikuficha upendo wako na kweli yako mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa.
Ekegusii: Tinyegachereti inche bweka oboronge bwao ase enkoro yane ime; korende nararirie obwegenwa bwao, na ogotooreka kwao. Timbiseti obuya bwao, na obwegenwa bwao, korwa ase omosangererekano omonene.

English: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, usizuilie huruma zako, upendo wako na kweli yako daima vinilinde.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tondina amaabera ao! Obuya na obwegenwa bwao bindende botambe.

English: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana taabu zisizo na hesabu zimenizunguka, dhambi zangu zimenikamata, hata nisiweze kuona. Zimekuwa nyingi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu, nao moyo unazimia ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Amabe amange atari kobareka nigo ang’etanaine. Ebibe biane biambuire, goika tinkonyara korora; biabeire ebinge kobua etukia y’omotwe one, goika nerusirie moyo.

English: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uwe radhi kuniokoa; Ee Bwana, njoo hima unisaidie.
Ekegusii: Omonene, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!

English: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
Kiswahili: Wote wanaotafuta kuuondoa uhai wangu, waaibishwe na kufadhaishwa; wote wanaotamani kuangamizwa kwangu, warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi barigetie kong’ita, tiga basookigwe na batantanigwe bonsi amo, na abwo baganetie obobe bonyore, tiga bairanigwe magega barore obosooku.

English: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
Kiswahili: Wale waniambiao, “Aha! Aha!” wafadhaishwe na iwe aibu yao.
Ekegusii: Abwo bagonsiereria bagoteeba: “Kiamonyorire!” Tiga bakirigwe‐kiri ase obosooku bwabo.

English: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”
Kiswahili: Lakini wote wakutafutao washangilie na kukufurahia, wale wapendao wokovu wako siku zote waseme, “Bwana atukuzwe!”
Ekegusii: Korende abwo bonsi bagokorigia, tiga bakogokere na kogochengera; abwo banchete ogotooreka kwao bateebe botambe, “Omonene nigo are omonene!”

English: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
Kiswahili: Lakini bado mimi ni maskini na mhitaji; Bwana na anifikirie. Wewe ndiwe msaada wangu na Mwokozi wangu; Ee Mungu wangu, usikawie.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa, korende Omonene nigo akonyechandera. Naye ore ogokonywa kwane, na ogotooreka kwane. Aye Nyasae one, totebana!

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Heri mtu yule anayemjali mnyonge, Bwana atamwokoa wakati wa shida.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Nasesenirie omonto oyo ogwechandera abataka. Ekero aranyorwe nemechando, Omonene namokonye.

English: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
Kiswahili: Bwana atamlinda na kuyahifadhi maisha yake, atambariki katika nchi na hatamwacha katika tamaa ya adui zake.
Ekegusii: Omonene amorende na komokorera agenderere koba moyo, erinde arokwe oyosesenirie ase ense. Omonene tagotiga ababisa bamokorere buna banchete.

English: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
Kiswahili: Bwana atamtegemeza awapo mgonjwa kitandani, atamwinua kutoka kitandani mwake.
Ekegusii: Omonene namorende ekero are borere arwarete, namogusuerie oborwaire bwaye.

English: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
Kiswahili: Nilisema, “Ee Bwana nihurumie, niponye, maana nimekutenda dhambi wewe.”
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nateebete: “Omonene, indorera amaabera, ingwenie omoyo one, ekiagera nakorire ebibe asore.”

English: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
Kiswahili: Adui zangu wanasema kwa hila, “Lini atakufa, na jina lake litokomee kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bagokwana amang’ana amabe igoro yane, bateba, “Omonto oyo indi arakwe na erieta riaye riebwe kegima?”

English: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
Kiswahili: Kila anapokuja mtu kunitazama, huzungumza uongo, huku moyo wake hukusanya masingizio; kisha huondoka na kuyasambaza huku na huko.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogocha kondora nigo agokwana amang’ana yoborimo, enkoro yaye nigo egosangereria amabe, erio ogenda isiko oraria amang’ana ayio amabe.

English: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
Kiswahili: Adui zangu wote hunongʼonezana dhidi yangu, hao huniwazia mabaya sana, wakisema,
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bangechete nigo bakomonyererana igoro yane, nigo bakorire omooroberio bw’ogonkora bobe.

English: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
Kiswahili: “Ugonjwa mbaya sana umempata, kamwe hatainuka tena kitandani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: “Noborwaire boramoite bwamonyorire, takoboka naende korwa ase araire”.

English: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
Kiswahili: Hata rafiki yangu wa karibu niliyemwamini, yule aliyekula chakula changu ameniinulia kisigino chake.
Ekegusii: Nonya nomosani one negenete, tware koragera komo, ong’akire chintacho.

English: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, nihurumie, ukaniinue tena, ili niweze kuwalipiza kisasi.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ndorera amaabera, ngwenie, erinde ing’akane ababisa baane obobe bwabo.

English: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
Kiswahili: Najua kwamba wapendezwa nami, kwa kuwa adui yangu hanishindi.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baane tibagochenga igoro yane. Ase ayio nimanye ng’a aye nogokirie nainche.

English: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
Kiswahili: Katika uadilifu wangu unanitegemeza na kuniweka kwenye uwepo wako milele.
Ekegusii: Aye gwankonyire, ekiagera tindi na komocha, kwambekire gotenena ase obosio bwao kogenderera botambe.

English: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele na hata milele.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe, buna yarenge korwa kare nabo erabe goika kare na kare. Amina. Amina.

English: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Utenzi wa wana wa Kora. Kama vile ayala aoneavyo shauku vijito vya maji, ndivyo nafsi yangu ikuoneavyo shauku, Ee Mungu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Buna koreng’ana engabi ekogania amaache a rooche, naboigo omoyo one okoganetie aye Nyasae.

English: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu inamwonea Mungu kiu, Mungu aliye hai. Ni lini nitaweza kwenda kukutana na Mungu?
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore aye Nyasae ore moyo. Ndiriri ndachiche ndore obosio bwao, aye Nyasae?

English: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
Kiswahili: Machozi yangu yamekuwa chakula changu usiku na mchana, huku watu wakiniambia mchana kutwa, “Yuko wapi Mungu wako?”
Ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera, na amariga abeire endagera yane; botambe abanto nigo bakomboria: “Nyasae oo ng’ai are?”

English: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
Kiswahili: Mambo haya nayakumbuka ninapoimimina nafsi yangu: Jinsi nilivyokuwa nikienda na umati wa watu, nikiongoza maandamano kuelekea kwenye nyumba ya Mungu, kwa kelele za shangwe na za shukrani katikati ya umati uliosherehekea.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkoumora ayare ase omoyo one ime, ekero nkoinyora amang’ana aetire, buna narenge kogenda amo nomoganda bw’abaanto gochia ase enyomba ya Nyasae, nkaba ngotera nomogooko neriogi rinene na koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono amo nabwo barenge koinyora na korenda Rituko Rinene.

English: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
Kiswahili: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu, Mwokozi wangu na
Ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano? Nase ki otari n’obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ase ogotooreka gokorwa ase obosio bwaye.

English: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
Kiswahili: Mungu wangu. Nafsi yangu inasononeka ndani yangu; kwa hiyo nitakukumbuka kutoka nchi ya Yordani, katika vilele vya Hermoni, kutoka Mlima Mizari.
Ekegusii: Nyasae one, enkoro yane yabeire nomoichano, ase ayio, nakoinyoire ekero inde ase ense ya Yorodani, na ase egetunwa kia Herimoni na ekia Misari.

English: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
Kiswahili: Kilindi huita kilindi, katika ngurumo za maporomoko ya maji yako; mawimbi yako yote pamoja na viwimbi vimepita juu yangu.
Ekegusii: Endiba y’amaache nigo ekorangeria endiba ende, ekero amaache ’ebieera akoeera; chiooro chiao chionsi na emerindo yao biantubire.

English: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
Kiswahili: Mchana Bwana huelekeza upendo wake, usiku wimbo wake uko nami: maombi kwa Mungu wa uzima wangu.
Ekegusii: Ase omobaso Omonene nigo akong’a obwanchani bwaye botari koera, na ase obotuko nigo nkomotogia namatera na gosaba Nyasae oyore obogima bwane.

English: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
Kiswahili: Ninamwambia Mungu Mwamba wangu, “Kwa nini umenisahau? Kwa nini niendelee kuomboleza, nikiwa nimeonewa na adui?”
Ekegusii: Nigo ngotebia Nyasae ore egetare kiane, “Nase ki aye kwanyebire? Nase ki ngendererete korera ngochandwa nababisa baane?”

English: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
Kiswahili: Mifupa yangu inateseka kwa maumivu makali adui zangu wanaponidhihaki, wakiniambia mchana kutwa, “Yuko wapi Mungu wako?”
Ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baane bagonchecheria, nigo nkoigwa buna amauga aane akonyatia. Nigo bagendererete kona‐komboria, “Nyasae oo, ng’ai are?”

English: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
Kiswahili: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu, Mwokozi wangu na Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano omonene? Nase ki otari n’obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ere oyore ogotooreka kwane, na Nyasae one.

English: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu unihukumu, nitetee dhidi ya taifa lisilomcha Mungu, niokoe na watu wadanganyifu na waovu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ing’a oboronge bwane, ndwanerere nkonye korwa ase abanto batakoirogeti, ntoorie korwa ase abanto abang’ainereria, abatari abanyakeene.

English: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
Kiswahili: Wewe ni Mungu ngome yangu. Kwa nini umenikataa? Kwa nini niendelee kuomboleza, nikiwa nimeonewa na adui?
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore obotamero bwane, naki gwantigire? Ninki gekogera inche ngendererete kweumia, na ababisa baane bagendererete gonkorera bobe?

English: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
Kiswahili: Tuma hima nuru yako na kweli yako na viniongoze; vinilete mpaka mlima wako mtakatifu, mpaka mahali unapoishi.
Ekegusii: Ntomere oborabu bwao, na ekeene kiao, binyare kondaa, na kong’ikia ase egetunwa kiao egechenu kere obomenyo bwao.

English: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nitakwenda madhabahuni pa Mungu, kwa Mungu, furaha yangu na shangwe yangu. Nitakusifu kwa kinubi, Ee Mungu, Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Erio ngende ase egesasiimero kiao, aye Nyasae, Nyasae, aye oyore omogooko one omonene, nimbugie obokano na goteera ogoteera gw’okogotogia, aye Nyasae ore Nyasae one.

English: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
Kiswahili: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu Mwokozi wangu na Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano omonene? Nase ki otari n’obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae, ekiagera ninyare komotogia naende ere oyore ogotooreka kwane, na Nyasae one.

English: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Utenzi wa wana wa Kora. Ee Mungu, tumesikia kwa masikio yetu, baba zetu wametueleza yale uliyotenda katika siku zao, siku za kale.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Nyasae, intwe tweigwereire namato aito, chisokoro chiaito nchiatotebetie amang’ana gwakorete ase amatuko a kare.

English: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
Kiswahili: Kwa mkono wako uliwafukuza mataifa na ukawapanda baba zetu, uliangamiza mataifa na kuwastawisha baba zetu.
Ekegusii: Aye omonyene nigo gwaseretie abanto b’ebisaku nokoboko kwao, korende chisokoro chiaito okabarenta okabasimeka aroro; nigo kwarentete emechando ase abanto b’ebisaku, korende chisokoro chiaito okabamentekania bakaranda.

English: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
Kiswahili: Sio kwa upanga wao waliipata nchi, wala si mkono wao uliwapatia ushindi; ilikuwa ni kitanga cha mkono wako wa kuume, na nuru ya uso wako, kwa kuwa uliwapenda.
Ekegusii: Abanto bao tibairete ense eria ase okoyerwania nemioro, gose tari chinguru chi’amaboko abo chiabarenterete obobui, korende nokoboko kwao gw’okorio ne chinguru chi’amaboko ao, amo noborabu bwaruete ase obosio bwao, ekiagera aye nigo kwagogetigwe nabarabwo.

English: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!
Kiswahili: Wewe ni mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu, unayeamuru ushindi kwa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Aye naye omorwoti one, na Nyasae one, ase ayio, chiika ng’a abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baegwe obobui.

English: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
Kiswahili: Kwa uwezo wako tunawasukuma nyuma watesi wetu; kwa jina lako tunawakanyaga adui zetu.
Ekegusii: Ase chinguru chiao nigo toraiyerie inse ababisa baito; goetera ase erieta riao nigo toratiringere inse abwo bagocha gotorwania esegi.

English: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.
Kiswahili: Siutumaini upinde wangu, upanga wangu hauniletei ushindi;
Ekegusii: Inche tinsemeretie obota bwane; gose omoro one tong’a obobui.

English: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
Kiswahili: bali wewe unatupa ushindi juu ya adui zetu, unawaaibisha watesi wetu.
Ekegusii: Korende naye gwatoete obobui igoro y’ababisa baito, abwo batogechete nigo kwabasoogetie.

English: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
Kiswahili: Katika Mungu wetu tunajivuna mchana kutwa, nasi tutalisifu jina lako milele.
Ekegusii: Intwe ntogenderere gwetogia asore aye Nyasae, ntobe tokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao kogenderera botambe.

English: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa umetukataa na kutudhili, wala huendi tena na jeshi letu.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo gwatotigire na gotosookia, tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.

English: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
Kiswahili: Umetufanya turudi nyuma mbele ya adui, nao watesi wetu wametuteka nyara.
Ekegusii: Gwatokorire gotama ababisa baito, na barabwo babeire bagosakora ebinto biaito.

English: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
Kiswahili: Umetuacha tutafunwe kama kondoo na umetutawanya katika mataifa.
Ekegusii: Aye kwarure ribaga toriegwe buna ching’ondi chikoriegwa, gwatosiareire gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku.

English: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
Kiswahili: Umewauza watu wako kwa fedha kidogo, wala hukupata faida yoyote kwa mauzo yao.
Ekegusii: Aye kwaoonirie abanto bao ase rigori risinini mono; tikwababeekerete rigori rinene.

English: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
Kiswahili: Umetufanya lawama kwa jirani zetu, dharau na dhihaka kwa wale wanaotuzunguka.
Ekegusii: Gwatokorire koba okogechia ase abanto baito; twabeire togochaywa na gosekererwa nabaanto batoetanaine.

English: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
Kiswahili: Umetufanya kuwa mithali miongoni mwa mataifa, mataifa hutikisa vichwa vyao.
Ekegusii: Gwatokorire koba omorabaaro ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, twabeire togosingiserigwa emetwe nabaanto.

English: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
Kiswahili: Fedheha yangu iko mbele yangu mchana kutwa, na uso wangu umejaa aibu tele,
Ekegusii: Ogochaywa kwane nigo kogendererete asende omobaso boira, na obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane

English: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
Kiswahili: kwa ajili ya dhihaka ya wale wanaonilaumu na kunitukana, kwa sababu ya adui, ambaye anatamani kulipiza kisasi.
Ekegusii: ekero nkoigwa amang’ana ’abagonchecheria na gonkwana bobe, na ekero nkorora obosio bw’omobisa na obw’oyo okorusia egesiomba.

English: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
Kiswahili: Hayo yote yametutokea, ingawa tulikuwa hatujakusahau wala hatujaenda kinyume na agano lako.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya onsi atonyorire, nonya intwe titoraba togokweba, gose titorasaria okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania.

English: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
Kiswahili: Mioyo yetu ilikuwa haijarudi nyuma; nyayo zetu zilikuwa hazijaiacha njia yako.
Ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaito tichionchogeti chigotige, gose titotigeti kobwatia enchera yao,

English: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
Kiswahili: Lakini ulituponda na kutufanya makao ya mbweha, na ukatufunika kwa giza nene.
Ekegusii: erinde otoake na gototuguta ase chisese chi’orosana chimenyete, gose gototuba ekiriri ki’amakweri.

English: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
Kiswahili: Kama tungalikuwa tumelisahau jina la Mungu wetu au kunyooshea mikono yetu kwa mungu mgeni,
Ekegusii: Onye ntwebire erieta ria Nyasae oito, gose ntwaramboire amaboko aito ase ogosasiima enyasae ende eng’ao.

English: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
Kiswahili: je, Mungu hangaligundua hili, kwa kuwa anazijua siri za moyo?
Ekegusii: Inee, Nyasae tari komanya amang’ana ayio? Ere nigo amanyete obobisi bwonsi bore ime ase enkoro.

English: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo kwa ajili yako tunauawa mchana kutwa; tumehesabiwa kama kondoo wa kuchinjwa.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho yao nigo togoitwa omobaso boira, nigo tokobarwa buna ching’ondi chikonyenywa.

English: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
Kiswahili: Amka, Ee Bwana! Kwa nini unalala? Zinduka! Usitukatae milele.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, boka oimokerere igoro? Nase ki oraire? Boka, tototuguta kegima!

English: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unauficha uso wako na kusahau taabu na mateso yetu?
Ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwabisire obosio bwao korwa ase tore? Nase ki aye kwebire emechando yaito na ogokorerwa bobe gwaito?

English: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
Kiswahili: Tumeshushwa hadi mavumbini, miili yetu imegandamana na ardhi.
Ekegusii: Amaene, emioyo yaito yaiyerigwe inse ase orotu, emebere yaito yabwateranigwe inse ase riroba.

English: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
Kiswahili: Inuka na utusaidie, utukomboe kwa sababu ya upendo wako usio na mwisho.
Ekegusii: Imokerera igoro, ochiche otokonye! Ototoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.

English: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa utenzi wa “Yungiyungi.” Utenzi wa wana wa Kora. Wimbo wa arusi. Moyo wangu umesisimuliwa na jambo jema ninapomsimulia mfalme mabeti yangu; ulimi wangu ni kalamu ya mwandishi stadi.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kw’obwanchani korikire na basinto ba Kora) Enkoro yane nigo eichire namang’ana amaya, engero yane nigo ere igoro y’omorwoti; oromeme rwane nigo rore buna ekaramu y’omoriki omuya.

English: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni bora kuliko watu wengine wote na midomo yako imepakwa neema, kwa kuwa Mungu amekubariki milele.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omoseera kobua abanto bonsi; ebikoba biao nigo bigokwana amang’ana ’obwanchani. Ase ayio Nyasae ogosesenirie goika kare na kare.

English: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.
Kiswahili: Jifunge upanga wako pajani mwako, ee mwenye nguvu, jivike fahari na utukufu.
Ekegusii: Aye omobui, eboeranie omoyio o birende ase ekenema kiao, aye nigo ore nobonene na ogosikwa okonene.

English: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
Kiswahili: Katika fahari yako, songa mbele kwa ushindi, kwa ajili ya kweli, unyenyekevu na haki, mkono wako wa kuume na uonyeshe matendo ya kutisha.
Ekegusii: Genda bosio nobobui na obonene,! Okengere ekeene, na obwororo, na oboronge; na okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngokworokererie amang’ana ’ogokumia.

English: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
Kiswahili: Mishale yako mikali na ichome mioyo ya adui za mfalme, mataifa na yaanguke chini ya nyayo zako.
Ekegusii: Emegwe yao nigo ere emioge, nigo ekobeta chinkoro chi’ababisa bao aye omorwoti abanto nigo bakogwa inse yao.

English: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, kiti chako cha enzi kitadumu milele na milele, fimbo ya utawala wa haki itakuwa fimbo ya utawala wa ufalme wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekerogo kiao ki’obonene nigo kegendererete kobao kare na kare. Enyimbo yao y’oborwoti nigo ere ey’oboronge.

English: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
Kiswahili: Unaipenda haki na kuchukia uovu; kwa hiyo Mungu, Mungu wako, amekuweka juu ya wenzako, kwa kukupaka mafuta ya furaha.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo bwanchete oboronge na kogechete ebibe. Ase ayio, Nyasae, oyore Nyasae oo ogoakire amaguta, okorenteire omogooko kobua oyo bw’abande bamino.

English: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
Kiswahili: Mavazi yako yote yana harufu nzuri ya manemane, udi na mdalasini; kutoka kwenye majumba ya kifalme yaliyopambwa kwa pembe za ndovu, sauti za vinanda vya nyuzi zinakufanya ufurahi.
Ekegusii: Chiganchwa chiao nigo chikouboka rimisu ri’amaguta a manemane, na ay’omogaka, na aya kasia. Korwa ase chinyomba chichabeire amaino e chinchogu abanto nigo bakobugia amakano na gokogokia.

English: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
Kiswahili: Binti za wafalme ni miongoni mwa wanawake wako waheshimiwa; kuume kwako yupo bibi arusi malkia aliyevaa dhahabu ya Ofiri.
Ekegusii: Abaiseke b’abarwoti nigo bare amo nabwo bakogokorera ase amasikani; eting’ana bwechaberete netaabu ekorwa Ofiri, nigo ateneine ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio.

English: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza, ewe binti, fikiri na utege sikio: Sahau watu wako na nyumba ya baba yako.
Ekegusii: Aye omoiseke, igwa! Ntegerera mono! Eba bono abanto baino na ab’enyomba ya iso.

English: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
Kiswahili: Mfalme ameshangazwa na uzuri wako; mheshimu, kwa kuwa yeye ni bwana wako.
Ekegusii: Oboseera bwao mbogere omorwoti agosanere, ekiagera ere nomonene oo, goika bwekumbe ase obosio bwaye.

English: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
Kiswahili: Binti wa Tiro atakuletea zawadi, watu wenye utajiri watatafuta upendeleo wako.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Turo, abare abanda mono, nigo barakorentere ebiegwa, barigie ogwancherwa kwao.

English: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
Kiswahili: Utukufu wote una binti mfalme katika chumba chake; vazi lake limefumwa kwa nyuzi za dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Omoiseke bw’omorwoti nigo are ime ase eero yaye ore nobonene, obegete eganchwa yaye eroiseirie etaabu.

English: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
Kiswahili: Anaongozwa kwa mfalme, akiwa amevalia mavazi yaliyotariziwa, mabikira wenzake wanamfuata na wanaletwa kwako.
Ekegusii: Nigo akoirwa ase omorwoti obegete chiganchwa chi’ebieni ao ao, nigo agotunyanwa nabaiseke abekungi abare abagisangio baye; bonsi nigo bakoirwa ase omorwoti.

English: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
Kiswahili: Wanaingizwa ndani kwa shangwe na furaha, na kuingia katika jumba la mfalme.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakoirwa bare nomogooko na omochengo, erio basoigwa ase enyomba y’omorwoti.

English: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
Kiswahili: Wana wenu watachukua nafasi za baba zenu, mtawafanya wakuu katika nchi yote.
Ekegusii: Abana bao abamura mbabe ribaga rie chisokoro chiao, naye nobabeeke babe abagaambi igoro ase ense yonsi.

English: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Nitadumisha kumbukumbu lako katika vizazi vyote, kwa hiyo mataifa watakusifu milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Ninkore erieta riao ribe rikoinyorwa nebiaare bionsi; ase ayio, abanto b’ebisaku mbabe bakogotogia goika kare na kare.

English: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Mtindo wa alamothi. Mungu kwetu sisi ni kimbilio na nguvu, msaada utakaoonekana tele wakati wa mateso.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Nyasae nobotamero bwaito, ne chinguru chiaito, botambe nigo are ang’e gotokonya ase engaki y’emechando.

English: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hatutaogopa, hata kama dunia ikiondolewa nayo milima ikiangukia moyoni mwa bahari.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio titokwoboa, ense neisa gotengechigwa na ebitunwa birutwe ase chindiba chi’enyancha,

English: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
Kiswahili: Hata kama maji yake yatanguruma na kuumuka, milima nayo ikitetemeka kwa mawimbi yake.
Ekegusii: gose emerindo y’enyancha neba ekoruma na koimokerera igoro, na ebitunwa bibe bigotengechigwa ase ogoturubanigwa okwo.

English: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
Kiswahili: Kuna mto ambao vijito vyake vinaufurahisha mji wa Mungu, mahali patakatifu ambako Aliye Juu Sana anaishi.
Ekegusii: Orooche ndoreo chindooche chiaye chikogokia omochie o Nyasae, omochie ore obomenyo obochenu bw’Oyore Igoro Mono.

English: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
Kiswahili: Mungu yuko katikati yake, hautaanguka, Mungu atausaidia asubuhi na mapema.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo amenyete imeo, tokonyegerigwa, ere nayokonye kobogokia mambia.

English: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yanafanya ghasia, falme zinaanguka, Yeye huinua sauti yake, dunia ikayeyuka.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku babeire neburuburu, amagambi aiyerigwe; Nyasae ogoaka eriogi riaye, ense nenyititoke.

English: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote yu pamoja nasi, Mungu wa Yakobo ni ngome yetu.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo are amo naintwe, Nyasae o Yakobo nere obotamero bwaito.

English: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.
Kiswahili: Njooni mkaone kazi za Bwana jinsi alivyofanya ukiwa katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Inchuo morore ay’Omonene akorire, orentire ogosirigwa ase ense.

English: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
Kiswahili: Anakomesha vita hata miisho ya dunia, anakata upinde na kuvunjavunja mkuki, anateketeza ngao kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Otangire chiseegi ase ense engima, obunire amata, osenyentire amatimo, osambire chigari nomorero.

English: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
Kiswahili: “Tulieni, mjue ya kwamba mimi ndimi Mungu; nitatukuzwa katikati ya mataifa, nitatukuzwa katika dunia.”
Ekegusii: “Toerera, momanye ng’a ninche Nyasae; inche inde omonene ase abanto b’ebisaku, omonene ase ense.”

English: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote yu pamoja nasi; Mungu wa Yakobo ni ngome yetu.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo are amo naintwe, Nyasae o Yakobo nere obotamero bwaito.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Pigeni makofi, enyi mataifa yote, mpigieni Mungu kelele za shangwe!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Inwe abanto bonsi, aka chinkobi, moterere Nyasae amatera ’omogooko neriogi rinene!

English: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
Kiswahili: Jinsi gani alivyo wa kutisha, Bwana Aliye Juu Sana, Mfalme mkuu juu ya dunia yote!
Ekegusii: Omonene ore Igoro Mono nigo are oyo bw’okoirokia, ere nomorwoti omonene bw’ense yonsi.

English: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
Kiswahili: Ametiisha mataifa chini yetu watu wengi chini ya miguu yetu.
Ekegusii: Omonene obekire abanto inse yaito, otoeire okobua kogambera abanto b’ebisaku.

English: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
Kiswahili: Alituchagulia urithi wetu, fahari ya Yakobo, aliyempenda.
Ekegusii: Nigo atochorerete omwando, oyio ore obwari bwa Yakobo, ori’Omonene anchete.

English: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
Kiswahili: Mungu amepaa kwa kelele za shangwe, Bwana kwa sauti za tarumbeta.
Ekegusii: Nyasae otiirire namariogi ay’ogochengerwa, Omonene nigo akobugerigwa ebitureeri.

English: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Mungu sifa, imbeni sifa, mwimbieni sifa Mfalme wetu, imbeni sifa.
Ekegusii: Tera amatera ay’ogotogia Nyasae, tera amatera ay’ogotogia! Tera amatera ay’ogotogia omorwoti oito, tera amatera ay’ogotogia!

English: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu ni mfalme wa dunia yote, mwimbieni zaburi za sifa.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are omorwoti bw’ense yonsi, motogie namatera are nengencho.

English: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
Kiswahili: Mungu anatawala juu ya mataifa, Mungu ameketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi kitakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku; ere nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kere egechenu.

English: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa mataifa wanakusanyika kama watu wa Mungu wa Abrahamu, kwa kuwa wafalme wa dunia ni mali ya Mungu; yeye ametukuka sana.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi b’abaanto basangererekanire amo, babe abanto ba Nyasae o Aburaamu. Chinguba chi’ense nigo chire echia Nyasae; ere oimokererigwe igoro mono kegima.

English: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
Kiswahili: Wimbo. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Bwana ni mkuu, anayestahili kusifiwa sana, katika mji wa Mungu wetu, mlima wake mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe; ere goika atogigwe agwo ase omochie o Nyasae oito, ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu.

English: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
Kiswahili: Ni mzuri katika kuinuka kwake juu sana, furaha ya dunia yote. Kama vilele vya juu sana vya Safoni ni Mlima Sayuni, mji wa Mfalme Mkuu.
Ekegusii: Sayoni, egetunwa kia Nyasae egeseera, keimokererete igoro agwo sugusu, nigo kere omogooko bw’ense engima; omochie oyio noyo bw’omorwoti omonene.

English: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
Kiswahili: Mungu yuko katika ngome zake; amejionyesha mwenyewe kuwa ngome yake.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase chiburi chi’omochie oyio, Nyasae bweorokirie ng’a nere obotamero bw’ogwekengera.

English: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
Kiswahili: Wakati wafalme walipounganisha nguvu, waliposonga mbele pamoja,
Ekegusii: Rora, abarwoti nigo basangererekanete, bagacha amo.

English: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
Kiswahili: walimwona nao wakashangaa, wakakimbia kwa hofu.
Ekegusii: Ekero baroche omochie oria, nigo bakumetie, bakaondoka, bagatama.

English: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
Kiswahili: Kutetemeka kuliwashika huko, maumivu kama ya mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa.
Ekegusii: Bagasogwa nobwoba, bakaiguswa, bagaichana na koba nobororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore.

English: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
Kiswahili: Uliwaangamiza kama meli za Tarshishi zilizovunjwa na upepo wa mashariki.
Ekegusii: Nigo kwababunete buna chimeeri chia Tarisisi nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha.

English: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
Kiswahili: Kama tulivyokuwa tumesikia, ndivyo tulivyoona katika mji wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, katika mji wa Mungu wetu: Mungu ataufanya uwe salama milele.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana twaigwete, bono twayarorire agwo ase omochie Omonene bw’Emeganda, omochie o Nyasae oito. Nyasae nigo ayorendete na koyokong’ia goika kare na kare.

English: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, hekaluni mwako tunatafakari upendo wako usiokoma.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, ekero tore ase Hekalu yao ime, nigo tokorengereria igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.

English: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, kama jina lako lilivyo, sifa zako zinafika hadi miisho ya dunia, mkono wako wa kuume umejazwa na haki.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, buna koreng’ana erieta riao rikumete, naboigo nogotogigwa kwao gokumete goikera chinsinyo chi’ense. Okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo goichire noboronge.

English: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
Kiswahili: Mlima Sayuni unashangilia, vijiji vya Yuda vinafurahi kwa sababu ya hukumu zako.
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’egetunwa gia Sayoni bagoke; boigo nab’emechie y’Abayuda, ekiagera aye nigo okonacha ebiina bia boronge.

English: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
Kiswahili: Tembeeni katika Sayuni, uzungukeni mji, hesabuni minara yake;
Ekegusii: Taara moetanane Sayoni, mobare emerobiri yaye.

English: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
Kiswahili: yatafakarini vyema maboma yake, angalieni ngome zake, ili mpate kusimulia habari zake kwa kizazi kijacho.
Ekegusii: Rigereria chindwaki chiaye, eta motaare ime ase chiburi chiaye; erio nario morache goteebia ebigori bigochi-gocha:

English: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa huyu Mungu ni Mungu wetu milele na milele; atakuwa kiongozi wetu hata mwisho.
Ekegusii: “Omonene oyo nere Nyasae oito o kare na kare. Ere nabe omoraai oito kogenderera botambe.”

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Sikieni haya, enyi mataifa yote, sikilizeni, ninyi wote mkaao dunia hii.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Inwe abanto bonsi, igwa amang’ana aya! Tegerera moigwe, inwe mwensi momenyete ase ense,

English: both low and high, rich and poor together.
Kiswahili: Wakubwa kwa wadogo, matajiri na maskini pamoja:
Ekegusii: inwe mwensi, abake na abanene, abanda na abataka mwensi amo tegerera!

English: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
Kiswahili: Kinywa changu kitasema maneno ya hekima, usemi wa moyo wangu utatoa ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Omonwa one nokwane amang’ana ’obong’aini, na ebirengererio bi’enkoro yane nigo birabe ebi’okomanya.

English: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.
Kiswahili: Nitatega sikio langu nisikilize mithali, nitafafanua kitendawili kwa zeze:
Ekegusii: Nintegerere amang’ana agokwanwa ase omoreng’anio, ning’orokie engencho yaye ’gokobugia obokano.

English: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini niogope siku mbaya zinapokuja, wakati wadanganyifu waovu wanaponizunguka,
Ekegusii: Inche tinkoba nobwoba ase chingaki chi’emechando, ekero amabe ’abachandi baane arabe ang’etananire.

English: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
Kiswahili: wale wanaotegemea mali zao na kujivunia utajiri wao mwingi?
Ekegusii: Tinkwoboa abanto abwo basemeretie obotenenku bwabo; barabwo nigo bare bakoenenera obonda bwabo bore obonge.

English: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mwanadamu awaye yote awezaye kuukomboa uhai wa mwingine, au kumpa Mungu fidia kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, omonto tari oranyare kobooria oyomwabo, gose koa Nyasae embooria y’ogotooria obogima bwaye.

English: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
Kiswahili: Fidia ya uhai ni gharama kubwa, hakuna malipo yoyote yanayotosha,
Ekegusii: Rigori ri’okobooria omoyo oye nigo rire rinene mono, na mbooria ende teri eraisanere rigori erio,

English: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba aishi milele na asione uharibifu.
Ekegusii: eyio eragere omonto agenderere koba moyo botambe, tabaisa kogenda ase embeera.

English: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
Kiswahili: Wote wanaona kwamba watu wenye hekima hufa; wajinga na wapumbavu vivyo hivyo huangamia na kuwaachia wengine mali zao.
Ekegusii: Bonsi nigo bamanyete ng’a nonya nabaanto abang’aini ngokwa bare, naboigo nabare abariri na amachara, erio batiga abanto abaao bakoira chinibo chiabo.

English: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
Kiswahili: Makaburi yao yatabaki kuwa nyumba zao za milele, makao yao vizazi vyote; ingawa walikuwa na mashamba na kuyaita kwa majina yao.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakorengereria ng’a nigo chirabeo kare na kare, na obomenyo bwabo ebiaare ase ebiaare; nigo bagwatora emegondo yabo ase amarieta abo.

English: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwanadamu, licha ya utajiri wake, hadumu; anafanana na mnyama aangamiaye.
Ekegusii: Korende Mwanyabaanto takonyara kogenderera koba nogosikwa, ere nigo anga buna ching’iti chigokwa chiasira.

English: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo hatima ya wale wanaojitumainia wenyewe, pia ya wafuasi wao, waliothibitisha misemo yao.
Ekegusii: Obwo nabwo obosiru bw’abaanto abwo besemeretie abanyene, omoerio obo abwo begenete amang’ana abo.

English: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
Kiswahili: Kama kondoo, wamewekewa kwenda kaburini, nacho kifo kitawala. Wanyofu watawatawala asubuhi, maumbile yao yataozea kaburini, mbali na majumba yao makubwa ya fahari.
Ekegusii: Buna riicho rie ching’ondi nigo bakoirwa gochia aase abakuure amakweri naro arabe omorisia obo. Abwo bare abaronge mbaabagambere kobogokiamoka, na ebieni biabo mbisirere agwo aase abakuure aase are obomenyo bwabo.

English: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu atakomboa uhai wangu na kaburi, hakika atanichukua kwake.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae naboorie omoyo one, ayorusie korwa ase okobua gw’aase abakuure erinde ang’ire imenye asare.

English: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
Kiswahili: Usitishwe mtu anapotajirika, fahari ya nyumba yake inapoongezeka,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koiroka ekero omonto abeire omotenenku, na ebinto bire ase enyomba yaye biamentekanire.

English: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
Kiswahili: kwa maana hatachukua chochote atakapokufa, fahari yake haitashuka pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto oyio arakwe, takoira gento kende, obonene bwaye tibokomotunyana bogende inse aaria amo nere.

English: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
Kiswahili: Ingawa alipokuwa akiishi alijihesabu kuwa heri, na wanadamu wanakusifu unapofanikiwa,
Ekegusii: Nonya omonto oyio ekero are moyo, ogweteba ng’a nigo asesenirie, ee, nonya ogotogigwa ekero ekoreire amaya,

English: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
Kiswahili: atajiunga na kizazi cha baba zake, ambao hawataona kamwe nuru ya uzima.
Ekegusii: ere goika akwe, asangerereke ase chisokoro chiaye chire, echio chitarore oborabu naende.

English: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
Kiswahili: Mwanadamu mwenye utajiri bila ufahamu ni kama wanyama waangamiao.
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto oyio osikire otabwati obong’aini, nigo anga buna ching’iti chigokwa chiasira.

English: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Asafu. Mwenye Nguvu, Mungu, Bwana, asema na kuiita dunia, tangu mawio ya jua hadi mahali pake liendapo kutua.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Nyasae omonguru, Nyasae Omonene, nigo agokwana, nigo agokwana na korangeria ense yonsi korwa moocha goika bosongo.

English: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Sayuni, penye uzuri mkamilifu, Mungu anaangaza.
Ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni, omochie omoikeranu bw’oboseera, Nyasae omorekire korwao.

English: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
Kiswahili: Mungu wetu anakuja na hatakaa kimya, moto uteketezao unamtangulia, akiwa amezungukwa na tufani kali.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oito ngocha are, tagokirakiri; omorero okoria nigo otang’aine bosio bwaye, omwaga omotindi nigo omoetanaine.

English: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
Kiswahili: Anaziita mbingu zilizo juu, na nchi, ili aweze kuwahukumu watu wake:
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorangeria igoro na ense chibe birori, ekero akonachera abanto baye ekiina, ogoteeba:

English: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
Kiswahili: “Nikusanyieni watu wangu waliowekwa wakfu, waliofanya agano nami kwa dhabihu.”
Ekegusii: “Sangereria abanto baane abegenwa bache asende, abwo bakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainche ase okorua ebing’wanso.”

English: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
Kiswahili: Nazo mbingu zinatangaza haki yake, kwa maana Mungu mwenyewe ni hakimu.
Ekegusii: Igoro nigo chikoraria oboronge bwa Nyasae; Nyasae omonyene nere omonachi ebiina.

English: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
Kiswahili: “Sikieni, enyi watu wangu, nami nitasema, ee Israeli, nami nitashuhudia dhidi yenu: Mimi ndimi Mungu, Mungu wenu.
