Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, tegerera moigwe, inche nkwane! Inwe Abaisraeli, inche nimbe nkorua oborori bore mamincha yaino. Inche Nyasae inde Nyasae oino.

English: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
Kiswahili: Sikukemei kwa sababu ya dhabihu zako, au sadaka zako za kuteketezwa, ambazo daima ziko mbele zangu.
Ekegusii: Tinkobatogonyera ase engencho y’ebing’wanso biaino; ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa nigo bire ase obosio bwane botambe.

English: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
Kiswahili: Sina haja ya fahali wa banda lako, au mbuzi wa zizi lako.
Ekegusii: Tingwanchera chieri chikorwa ase ameeri aino, gose chigoree chikorwa ase amaicho aino;

English: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila mnyama wa msituni ni wangu, na pia makundi ya mifugo juu ya vilima elfu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana nechiane, ne chiombe chilifu chire ase ebigoro nechiane.

English: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
Kiswahili: Ninamjua kila ndege mlimani, nao viumbe wa kondeni ni wangu.
Ekegusii: Nimanyete chinyoni chionsi chire ase ebitunwa, ne ching’iti chinde chionsi chikonagoetanana ase ense nechiane.

English: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
Kiswahili: Kama ningekuwa na njaa, nisingewaambia ninyi, kwa maana ulimwengu ni wangu, pamoja na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: “Onye narenge nenchara, tinare kogotebia, ekiagera ense, na ebinto bionsi bireo nebiane.

English: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Kiswahili: Je, mimi hula nyama ya mafahali au kunywa damu ya mbuzi?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inche ne chinyama chie chieri nkoria? Gose namanyinga e chimbori nkonywa?

English: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
Kiswahili: Toa sadaka za shukrani kwa Mungu, timiza nadhiri zako kwake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana,
Ekegusii: Aye omoruere Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende ikerania ase Oyore Igoro Mono chiira kwamorierete.

English: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
Kiswahili: na uniite siku ya taabu; nami nitakuokoa, nawe utanitukuza.”
Ekegusii: Ndangerie ase engaki y’emechando; inche ninoboseemia, naye nontogie.”

English: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
Kiswahili: Lakini kwake mtu mwovu, Mungu asema: “Una haki gani kunena sheria zangu au kuchukua agano langu midomoni mwako?
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo agotebia omokori amabe, “Naye mboronge ki obwate okonagwatora amachiiko aane? Gose kona‐gokwana‐kwana okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania?

English: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
Kiswahili: Unachukia mafundisho yangu na kuyatupa maneno yangu nyuma yako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogechete amorokererio ay’okorongeyia, gwatugutire amang’ana aane gochia magega.

English: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
Kiswahili: Unapomwona mwizi, unaungana naye, unapiga kura yako pamoja na wazinzi.
Ekegusii: Ekero okorora omoibi, nigo ogwancherana nere, boigo nigo okobwatana nabatomani.

English: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
Kiswahili: Unakitumia kinywa chako kwa mabaya na kuuongoza ulimi wako kwa hila.
Ekegusii: “Omonwa oo nigo ore omwango gokwana amang’ana ’obobe, na oromeme rwao nigo romanyete koroisia amang’ana ’obong’ainereria.

English: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
Kiswahili: Wanena daima dhidi ya ndugu yako na kumsingizia mwana wa mama yako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoikaransa na konakogamba abanto bamino bobe; nigo okona‐kong’acha oyomino morwete enda eyemo.

English: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
Kiswahili: Mambo haya unayafanya, nami nimekaa kimya, ukafikiri Mimi nami ni kama wewe. Lakini nitakukemea na kuweka mashtaka mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Kwabeire gokona‐gokora ayio, nainche nkirete‐kiri, nigo okagete ng’a inche nigo inde buna aye. Korende bono nkogotogonyera nde na kobeka ayio ase obosio bwao.

English: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
Kiswahili: “Yatafakarini haya, ninyi mnaomsahau Mungu, ama sivyo nitawararua vipande vipande, wala hapatakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwaokoa:
Ekegusii: “Inwe aba mwanyebire inche Nyasae, rengereria amang’ana aya mono; onye taibo, nimbaake mbatandorane, na monto onde tari orabatoorie.

English: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
Kiswahili: Atoaye dhabihu za shukrani ananiheshimu mimi, naye aiandaa njia yake ili nimwonyeshe wokovu wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi okong’iraneria ng’a mbuya mono, okwo nakwo ekeng’wanso ki’ogonsika, na onde bwensi okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge, oyio nimorentere ogotooreka kwane inche Nyasae.”

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Baada ya kukemewa na nabii Nathani kwa kuzini na Bathsheba. Ee Mungu, unihurumie, kwa kadiri ya upendo wako usiokoma, kwa kadiri ya huruma yako kuu, uyafute makosa yangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogosaba gwa Daudi magega y’ogocherwa na Omobani Natani Magega Daudi gatomanire na Batiseba) Aye Nyasae, ’ndorere amaabera koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao botari koera; ase engencho y’obonge bw’amaabera ao otinyie ogosaria kwane.

English: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
Kiswahili: Unioshe na uovu wangu wote na unitakase dhambi yangu.
Ekegusii: Onsibie korwa obobe bwane kegima, na onchene korwa ase ebibe biane.

English: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninajua makosa yangu, na dhambi yangu iko mbele yangu daima.
Ekegusii: Inche namanyire ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane nigo bire bosio bwane botambe.

English: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
Kiswahili: Dhidi yako, wewe peke yako, nimetenda dhambi na kufanya yaliyo mabaya machoni pako, ili uthibitike kuwa wa kweli unenapo, na kuwa na haki utoapo hukumu.
Ekegusii: Nagokoreire ebibe aye omonyene bweka, nakorire amabe bosio bwao. Aye omanyekane ng’a mboronge ore ekero ogokwana, na mboronge ore na nigo okonacha ekiina buya kegima.

English: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
Kiswahili: Hakika mimi nilizaliwa mwenye dhambi, mwenye dhambi tangu nilipotungwa mimba kwa mama yangu.
Ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo naiboretwe inde ne chingencho chi’ebibe; nigo narenge omonyabibe korwa ekero natongetwe ase enda yabaaba.

English: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
Kiswahili: Hakika wewe wapendezwa na kweli itokayo moyoni, ndani sana ya moyo wangu wanifundisha hekima.
Ekegusii: Rora, aye nigo oganetie ekeene ase enkoro ime; ase ayio inyorokererie obong’aini bwao ase enkoro yane ime.

English: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Kiswahili: Nioshe kwa hisopo, nami nitakuwa safi, unisafishe, nami nitakuwa mweupe kuliko theluji.
Ekegusii: Onsibie ne chinsagia chia hisopo, na inche nincheneke; onsibie erio imbe omorabu se goetania amagena ’embura.

English: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
Kiswahili: Unipe kusikia furaha na shangwe, mifupa uliyoiponda na ifurahi.
Ekegusii: Ong’ichorie n’omogooko na omochengo, amauga aane aya gwasenyentete n’agoke.

English: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
Kiswahili: Ufiche uso wako usizitazame dhambi zangu, na uufute uovu wangu wote.
Ekegusii: Togaacha etobo y’ebibe biane bosio bwao, torora ebibe biane; ontinyie obobe bwane bwonsi.

English: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, uniumbie moyo safi, uifanye upya roho ya uthabiti ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ontongere enkoro endabu, okore omoika ore ime yane obe omoyia na oyokong’ie.

English: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
Kiswahili: Usinitupe kutoka mbele zako wala kuniondolea Roho wako Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Tonyatanana korwa ase obosio bwao, nonya n’Omoika Omochenu toyorusia asende.

English: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
Kiswahili: Unirudishie tena furaha ya wokovu wako, unipe roho ya utii, ili initegemeze.
Ekegusii: Ong’iranerie omogooko okorwa ase ogotooreka kwao, okong’ie omoika one obe omoigweri.

English: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nitakapowafundisha wakosaji njia zako, na wenye dhambi watakugeukia wewe.
Ekegusii: Erio inyorokererie abasaria chinchera chiao, na abanyene ebibe mbairane asore.

English: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, Mungu uniokoaye, niokoe na hatia ya kumwaga damu, nao ulimi wangu utaimba juu ya haki yako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Nyasae bw’ogotooreka kwane, ontoorie, ting’itera amanyinga ’abaanto, na oromeme rwane rotere n’oboronge bwao.

English: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, fungua midomo yangu, na kinywa changu kitatangaza sifa zako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ong’igore ebikoba biane, na omonwa one norarie ogotogigwa kwao.

English: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Wewe hupendezwi na dhabihu, au ningaliileta, hufurahii sadaka za kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: Togokiri nekeng’wanso, ninsa gokerua; aye toganeti ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.

English: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
Kiswahili: Bali dhabihu za Mungu ni roho iliyovunjika, moyo uliovunjika wenye toba, Ee Mungu, hutaudharau.
Ekegusii: Ebing’wanso biancheire na Nyasae omoyo omokanyeku na bw’okweitia; enkoro yasionokire na gwekeyia, aye Nyasae, tokoyechaya.

English: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kwa wema wa radhi yako uifanye Sayuni istawi, ukazijenge upya kuta za Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene okorere Sayoni amaya ase amaabera ao; oagache chindwaki chia Yerusalemu.

English: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
Kiswahili: Hapo ndipo kutakapokuwa na dhabihu za haki, sadaka nzima za kuteketezwa za kukupendeza sana, pia mafahali watatolewa madhabahuni mwako.
Ekegusii: Erio nario oragokigwe n’ogosambwa kw’bing’wanso bi’ekeene; erio chieri nchiruegwe igoro ase egesasiimero kiao.

English: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Utenzi wa Daudi. Baada ya Doegi, Mwedomu kumwendea Sauli na kumjulisha kuwa: “Daudi amekwenda nyumbani kwa Ahimeleki.” Ewe jitu, mbona unajivunia ubaya? Kwa nini unajivuna mchana kutwa, wewe ambaye ni fedheha mbele za Mungu?
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi ekero Doegi Omoedomu achierete Saulo komotebia ng’a Daudi ochire mw’Abimeleki) Aye omonto ore nokobua, nase ki ogwetogeria amabe aya ogokora? Obwanchani bwa Nyasae nigo bogendererete kare na kare.

English: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wako hupanga mashauri mabaya ya maangamizi. Ni kama wembe mkali, ninyi mfanyao hila.
Ekegusii: Aye omong’ainereria, oromeme rwao nigo rokoroberia amang’ana ’ogosaria; nigo ronga buna omoyio otukia omwoge.

English: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
Kiswahili: Unapenda mabaya kuliko mema, uongo kuliko kusema kweli.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo bwanchete amabe kobua amaya, nigo bwanchete gokwana oborimo kobua ekeene.

English: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
Kiswahili: Unapenda kila neno lenye kudhuru, ewe ulimi wenye hila!
Ekegusii: Aye ore noromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo bwanchete gokwana amang’ana agosaria.

English: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
Kiswahili: Hakika Mungu atakushusha chini kwa maangamizi ya milele: atakunyakua na kukuondoa kwa nguvu kutoka hema yako, atakungʼoa kutoka nchi ya walio hai.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nakoiyerie inse kare na kare, nakobwate na kogotaboria korwa nyomba mwao, nagosimore korwa ase ense y’abare moyo.

English: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
Kiswahili: Wenye haki wataona na kuogopa, watamcheka, wakisema,
Ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbarore ayio boboe, bamosekerere bateebe;

English: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
Kiswahili: “Huyu ni yule mtu ambaye hakumfanya Mungu kuwa ngome yake, bali alitumainia wingi wa utajiri wake, na akawa hodari kwa kuwaangamiza wengine!”
Ekegusii: “Rora, omonto oyo bwangete gokora Nyasae abe obotamero bwaye, nigo egenete obonge bw’obonda bwaye omonyene, na akeenenia ase chinguru chiaye chi’ogosaria.”

English: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi ni kama mti wa mzeituni unaostawi katika nyumba ya Mungu, nautegemea upendo wa Mungu usiokoma milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nigo inga buna omozeituni osebogete ase enyomba ya Nyasae ime. Nigo nsemeretie obwanchani bwa Nyasae botari koera goika kare na kare.

English: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
Kiswahili: Nitakusifu milele kwa yale uliyoyatenda, nitatumaini jina lako, kwa kuwa jina lako ni jema. Nitakusifu mbele ya watakatifu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ngokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kare na kare, ekiagera gwakorire ayio. Ase amasio ’abaanto bao bare abegenwa nindarie erieta riao, ekiagera nerigiya.

English: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa mahalathi. Utenzi wa Daudi. Mpumbavu anasema moyoni mwake, “Hakuna Mungu.” Wameharibika, na njia zao ni za uovu kabisa, hakuna hata mmoja atendaye mema.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Abanto abariri nigo bagwetebia ase chinkoro chiabo ime: “Nyasae tari.” Barabwo nabasareku, nigo bagokora amang’ana amabe ay’okogechia; onde tari ogokora ayare amaya, nonya noyomo.

English: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
Kiswahili: Mungu anawachungulia wanadamu chini kutoka mbinguni aone kama wako wenye akili, wowote wanaomtafuta Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo arigereretie Mwanyabaanto korwa igoro arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.

English: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja amegeukia mbali, wameharibika wote pamoja, hakuna atendaye mema. Naam, hakuna hata mmoja!
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bairanire magega, bonsi amo basarekire; onde tari ogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.

English: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
Kiswahili: Je, watendao mabaya kamwe hawatajifunza: wale ambao huwala watu wangu kama watu walavyo mkate, hao ambao hawamwiti Mungu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abanto abwo bagokora amabe, tibamanyeti gento? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari kondangeria inche Nyasae mbakonye.

English: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.
Kiswahili: Hapo waliingiwa na hofu kuu, ambapo hapakuwa cha kutetemesha. Mungu alitawanya mifupa ya wale waliokushambulia; uliwaaibisha, kwa sababu Mungu aliwadharau.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagosogwa nomoondoko omonene mono, omoondoko buna oyio tona‐komanyekana nonya ndinde, Nyasae nasiarere amauga ’emebere y’ababisa abwo bakonaaretie. Nyasae nabasookie, ekiagera obaangire.

English: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
Kiswahili: Laiti wokovu wa Israeli ungalikuja kutoka Sayuni! Wakati Mungu arejeshapo wafungwa wa watu wake, Yakobo na ashangilie, Israeli na afurahi!
Ekegusii: Naki yare koba buya onye ogotooreka ngwachera Abaisraeli korwa Sayoni! Ekero Nyasae arairanerie abanto baye amaya abo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo mbachenge, ee, Abaisraeli mbabe nomogooko.

English: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Na ala za nyuzi za uimbaji. Utenzi wa Daudi. Wakati Wazifu walimwendea Sauli na kumjulisha, “Je, Daudi hajifichi miongoni mwetu?” Ee Mungu uniokoe kwa jina lako, unifanyie hukumu kwa uwezo wako.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi ekero omonto oyomo korwa Sifu achierete Saulo komotebia ng’a Daudi nsobo ebisete) Aye Nyasae, ntoorie ase engencho y’erieta riao, ong’e oboronge bwane goetera ase okobua kwao.

English: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, sikia maombi yangu, usikilize maneno ya kinywa changu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, igwa ogosaba kwane; tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane ngokwana.

English: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.
Kiswahili: Wageni wananishambulia, watu wakatili wanayatafuta maisha yangu, watu wasiomjali Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu bang’umokeire kong’ita, na abanto abatindi nigo baganetie obogima bwane; abwo tibakoirogeti aye Nyasae.

English: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
Kiswahili: Hakika Mungu ni msaada wangu, Bwana ndiye anayenitegemeza.
Ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a Nyasae nere omokonyi one, Omonene nere orendete obogima bwane.

English: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
Kiswahili: Mabaya na yawarudie wale wanaonisingizia, kwa uaminifu wako uwaangamize.
Ekegusii: Nairanerie ababisa baane obobe bwabo. Aye Omonene, obasirie, ekiagera igo ore omwegenwa.

English: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.
Kiswahili: Nitakutolea dhabihu za hiari; Ee Bwana, nitalisifu jina lako kwa kuwa ni vyema.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ninkoruere ekeng’wanso inde nenkoro y’ogwancha, nimbe nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, ekiagera nerigiya.

English: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ameniokoa katika shida zangu zote, na macho yangu yamewatazama adui zangu kwa ushindi.
Ekegusii: Aye gwantooririe ase emechando yonsi, na amaiso aane nigo arigereretie ababisa baane inde nomochengo.

English: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Na ala za uimbaji. Utenzi wa Daudi. Ee Mungu, sikiliza maombi yangu, wala usidharau hoja yangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, tobaisa kwebisa toigwa ogosaba kw’ogosorora kwane.

English: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan
Kiswahili: Nisikie na unijibu. Mawazo yangu yananisumbua na nimehangaishwa
Ekegusii: Inyigwe na ong’iranerie; inche nigo nkona‐korera na kweumia inde nobororo.

English: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
Kiswahili: kwa sauti ya adui, kwa kukaziwa macho na waovu, kwa sababu wananiletea mateso juu yangu na kunitukana kwa hasira zao.
Ekegusii: Ninde nobwoba ase engencho y’amariogi ’ababisa baane, na ase engencho y’obobe bw’abakori amabe. Abanto abwo nigo bakondetera amaakwa, bakongecha bare nendamwamu.

English: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu umejaa uchungu, hofu ya kifo imenishambulia.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo ere nomoichano, nasoirwe nokogoswa kw’amakweri.

English: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
Kiswahili: Woga na kutetemeka vimenizunguka, hofu kuu imenigharikisha.
Ekegusii: Nasoirwe nobwoba na okoiguswa, nabuirwe nomoichano omonene.

English: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
Kiswahili: Nilisema, “Laiti ningekuwa na mbawa za njiwa! Ningeruka niende mbali kupumzika.
Ekegusii: Bono nigo ngoteeba: “Onye ndiria nabwate chimbaaba buna riruma, nanga nigo nare koiruruka ngende gotimoka.

English: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
Kiswahili: Ningalitorokea mbali sana na kukaa jangwani,
Ekegusii: Ee, nigo nanga nare kogenda aare, imbe ntoorete ase erooro.

English: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
Kiswahili: ningaliharakisha kwenda mahali pa salama, mbali na tufani kali na dhoruba.”
Ekegusii: Nigo nare kominyoka chimbero, erinde inyenyorere aase nkwebisa, korwa ase omwaga omotindi na ekembugu‐mbugu.”

English: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uwatahayarishe waovu na uwachanganyishie semi zao, maana nimeona jeuri na ugomvi mjini.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, saria emeroberio y’abanto abwo, otantanie chimeme chiabo tibaigwana. Narorire obotindi na amariomana bire agwo ase omochie,

English: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
Kiswahili: Usiku na mchana wanazunguka juu ya kuta zake, uovu na dhuluma vimo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: bikoyoetanana igoro ase chindwaki omobaso na obotuko; amabe a mobosokano na emechando bire ase omochie oyio.

English: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
Kiswahili: Nguvu za uharibifu zinatenda kazi mjini, vitisho na uongo haviondoki mitaani mwake.
Ekegusii: Obosareku nigo boichire ime yaye, obong’ainereria na ogokorera abande bobe tibikorua ase chinchera chiaye.

English: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
Kiswahili: Kama aliyenitukana ni adui yangu, ningevumilia, kama mtu mwovu angejiinua dhidi yangu, ningejificha asinione.
Ekegusii: Onye nomobisa ore gonchecheria, nanga nigo nare koremereria; naende onye nomobisa ore gonkorera bobe ase oboenenu, nanga nigo nare kwebisa.

English: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
Kiswahili: Kumbe ni wewe, mwenzangu, mshiriki na rafiki yangu wa karibu,
Ekegusii: Korende bono naye ogonkorera bobe, aye oyo kwarenge obomo nainche, omosani tomanyaine.

English: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
Kiswahili: ambaye awali tulifurahia ushirika mzuri, tulipokuwa tukienda na umati hekaluni mwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nigo tware koba tokogamba amo amang’ana amaya ay’ogosemania, naende nigo tware koba togosasiima amo ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.
Kiswahili: Kifo na kiwajie adui zangu ghafula, na washuke kuzimu wangali hai, kwa maana uovu upo ndani yao.
Ekegusii: Tiga amakweri abachere ababisa baane mobosokano, bagende gochia aase abakuure bare moyo; obobe nigo bore ase obomenyo bwabo, na ase chinkoro chiabo.

English: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninamwita Mungu, naye Bwana huniokoa.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nigo nkomorangeria Nyasae, nere Omonene nantoorie.

English: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
Kiswahili: Jioni, asubuhi na adhuhuri ninalia kwa huzuni, naye husikia sauti yangu.
Ekegusii: Kera omogoroba, na emambia, na mobaso gati, nigo nkwereera ase engencho y’emechando yane, n’Omonene naigwe eriogi riane.

English: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
Kiswahili: Huniokoa nikawa salama katika vita vilivyopangwa dhidi yangu, ingawa watu wengi hunipinga.
Ekegusii: Ere nantoorie, andende buya korwa ase esegi eyio nkorwana, ekiagera ababisa abange banyimokeire.

English: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.
Kiswahili: Mungu anayemiliki milele, atawasikia na kuwaadhibu, watu ambao hawabadilishi njia zao, wala hawana hofu ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oyio obeire okogamba korwa kare, nanyigwe inche, erio abue abanto abwo, ekiagera abwo tibari koonchoka na komoiroka Nyasae.

English: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
Kiswahili: Mwenzangu hushambulia rafiki zake, naye huvunja agano lake.
Ekegusii: Oyorenge omosani one nigo aramborete okoboko kwaye, akore bobe ase abakorete omorembe nere, osaririe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.

English: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
Kiswahili: Mazungumzo yake ni laini kama siagi, hata hivyo vita vimo moyoni mwake. Maneno yake ni mororo kuliko mafuta, hata hivyo ni upanga mkali uliofutwa.
Ekegusii: Chinkwana chiaye nigo chiarenge chinyororo kobua amaguta atundire, korende ebirengererio biaye nebi’esegi; amang’ana aye nigo arenge amororo kobua amaguta, nonya naboigo nigo akonachanacha buna emioro.

English: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
Kiswahili: Mtwike Bwana fadhaa zako, naye atakutegemeza, hatamwacha kamwe mwenye haki wake aanguke.
Ekegusii: Motweke Omonene chigurube chiao, nere nakobwate nokoboko kwaye akorende; ere tagotiga omonyaboronge abugwe namabe.

English: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, utawashusha waovu katika shimo la uharibifu. Wenye kiu ya kumwaga damu na wenye hila, hawataishi nusu ya siku zao. Lakini mimi ninakutumaini wewe.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abaiti na abang’ainereria aye Nyasae nobaturunkanie gochia ase eoromomo, ekero bataraika ase ekeng’ese ki’obogima bwabo, korende inche nimbe nkwegenete aye Omonene.

English: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Njiwa mkimya wa mbali.” Utenzi wa Daudi. Baada ya kukamatwa na Wafilisti huko Gathi. Ee Mungu unihurumie, maana watu wananifuatia vikali; mchana kutwa wanazidisha mashambulizi yao.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi ekero Abafirisiti bamobwatete agwo Gati) Aye Nyasae, indorere amaabera, ekiagera abanto nigo baganetie ng’a bang’ite bansirie kegima; omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakondwania esegi.

English: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
Kiswahili: Wasingiziaji wangu wananifuatia mchana kutwa, wengi wananishambulia kwa kiburi chao.
Ekegusii: Omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakondigia baamere, ee, mbare abange mono bakondwania ase oboenenu.

English: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
Kiswahili: Wakati ninapoogopa, nitakutumaini wewe.
Ekegusii: Ekero inde nobwoba, nigo ngosemeretie.

English: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
Kiswahili: Katika Mungu, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu, katika Mungu ninatumaini; sitaogopa. Mwanadamu apatikanaye na kufa, atanitenda nini?
Ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring’ana riaye, ninsemeretie Nyasae ntari nobwoba. Inee! Mwanyabaanto inki baranyare gonkorera?

English: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
Kiswahili: Mchana kutwa wanayageuza maneno yangu, siku zote wanapanga shauri la kunidhuru.
Ekegusii: Omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakoonchorana amang’ana aane; ebirengererio biabo bionsi nigo bire ebibe igoro yane.

English: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
Kiswahili: Wananifanyia hila, wanajificha, wanatazama hatua zangu, wakiwa na shauku ya kuutoa uhai wangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagosangererekana amo baroberia komboera, barigererie kera egento ngokora; naboigo bagendererete korigia obogima bwane babosirie.

English: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
Kiswahili: Wasiepuke kwa vyovyote, Ee Mungu, katika hasira yako yaangushe mataifa.
Ekegusii: Inee! Nabatooreke korwa ase obobe buna obwo? Taibo. Aye Nyasae, basirie abanto abwo kegima nendamwamu yao entindi.

English: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
Kiswahili: Andika maombolezo yangu, orodhesha machozi yangu katika gombo lako: je, haya hayapo katika kumbukumbu zako?
Ekegusii: Omonene, aye nomanyete okoong’anya kwane, nigo osangereretie amariga aane okayabeka ase egetono kiao. Inee! Ayio onsi tarikiri ase egetabu yao?

English: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo adui zangu watarudi nyuma ninapoita msaada. Kwa hili nitajua kwamba Mungu yuko upande wangu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ndarangerie Omonene, ababisa baane mbairanigwe gochia magega. Nimanyete kegima ng’a Nyasae nigo are ase ensemo yane.

English: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.
Kiswahili: Katika Mungu, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu, katika Bwana, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu,
Ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring’ana riaye; ee, ase okobua kw’Omonene nintogie ring’ana riaye.

English: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Kiswahili: katika Mungu ninatumaini, sitaogopa. Mwanadamu anaweza kunitenda nini?
Ekegusii: Nigo nsemeretie Nyasae ntari nobwoba. Inee! Mwanyabaanto inki aranyare gonkorera?

English: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, nina nadhiri kwako, nitakutolea wewe sadaka zangu za shukrani.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, goika ng’ikeranie chiira nakorierete; naende ninkoruere ebing’wanso bi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

English: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa umeniokoa toka kwenye mauti na miguu yangu kwenye kujikwaa, ili niweze kuenenda mbele za Mungu katika nuru ya uzima.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase amakweri, ee, gwatangire amagoro aane tagwa, erinde inyare gotaara ase obosio bwao, aye Nyasae, ase oborabu bw’abwo bare moyo.

English: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Usiharibu!” Utenzi wa Daudi. Baada ya kumponyoka Sauli pangoni. Unihurumie, Ee Mungu, unihurumie, kwa maana nafsi yangu inakukimbilia. Chini ya uvuli wa mbawa zako nitakimbilia mpaka maafa yapite.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi ekero atamete Saulo na akebisa ase rikuruma) Aye Nyasae, indorera amaabera, indorera amaabera, ekiagera naye natameire nomoyo one. Nintame nyebise inse ase ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao, goika omwaga bw’ogosiria oete.

English: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
Kiswahili: Namlilia Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, Mungu atimizaye makusudi yake kwangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nkorera ase Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, ase Nyasae oria okong’ikeraneria onsi.

English: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
Kiswahili: Hutumana kutoka mbinguni na kuniokoa, akiwakemea wale wanaonifuatilia vikali; Mungu huutuma upendo wake na uaminifu wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nantomere ogotooreka korwa igoro, nababue abwo bagonkorera bobe babe nobosooku. Nyasae naorokie amaabera aye na ekeene kiaye.

English: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
Kiswahili: Niko katikati ya simba, nimelala katikati ya wanyama wenye njaa kuu: watu ambao meno yao ni mikuki na mishale, ambao ndimi zao ni panga kali.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oetananire ne chindo, nigo ndaire ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto bagoutoka omorero, amaino abo nigo are amoge buna amatimo ne chinsara, chimeme chiabo nigo chire emioro emioge.

English: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu ya mbingu, utukufu wako na uenee duniani kote.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi, tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.

English: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.
Kiswahili: Waliitegea miguu yangu nyavu, nikainamishwa chini na dhiki. Wamechimba shimo katika njia yangu, lakini wametumbukia humo wao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ababisa bantegeire oboreba ase ngoeta, bamionogoreire inse. Bakunyire eirima ase enchera yane, korende mbarabwo abanyene bagure imeo.

English: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, moyo wangu ni thabiti; nitaimba na kusifu kwa moyo wangu wote.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, enkoro yane nigo ere noboremu, ee, nigo ere noboremu; nintere na gochenga.

English: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
Kiswahili: Amka, nafsi yangu! Amka, kinubi na zeze! Nitayaamsha mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, boka! Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.

English: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
Kiswahili: Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, katikati ya mataifa; nitaimba habari zako, katikati ya jamaa za watu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase egati y’abanto ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, nimbe ngotera amatera ay’okogotogia ase egati y’ebisaku.

English: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu, waenea hadi mbinguni, uaminifu wako unazifikia anga.
Ekegusii: Amabera ao nigo are amanene aigete aaria igoro; obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete igoro ase amare.

English: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu mbinguni, utukufu wako na uwe duniani pote.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokia ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi, tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.

English: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Usiharibu!” Utenzi wa Daudi. Enyi watawala, je, kweli mwanena kwa haki? Je, mnahukumu kwa unyofu miongoni mwa watu?
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Inwe abamokogamba, Inee, ngokwana more amang’ana ’ekeene? Inee! Nkonachera more abanto ebiina bire boronge?

English: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.
Kiswahili: La, mioyoni mwenu mnatunga udhalimu, na mikono yenu hupima jeuri duniani.
Ekegusii: Yaya, nigo more nemeroberio emekorekanu ime ase chinkoro chiaino, amaboko aino nigo agokora obotindi bw’oborianania ase ense.

English: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
Kiswahili: Waovu ni wapotovu tangu kuzaliwa kwao, toka tumboni mwa mama zao ni wakaidi na husema uongo.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo basirete korwa chinda chi’abang’ina, abanyaborimo nigo bakoba abatantanu korwa engaki y’okoiborwa kwabo.

English: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
Kiswahili: Sumu yao ni kama sumu ya nyoka, kama ile ya fira ambaye ameziba masikio yake,
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babwate obosongo bonga buna obw’eng’iti, nigo banga buna rirubi rigoticha amato aye,

English: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
Kiswahili: ambaye hatasikia sauti ya kutumbuiza ya mwaguzi, hata kama mganga angecheza kwa ustadi kiasi gani.
Ekegusii: erinde tiriigwa amariogi abanyamosira, gose ay’abaebia b’obong’aini.

English: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, yavunje meno katika vinywa vyao; Ee Bwana, vunja meno makali ya hao simba!
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, obune amaino ’emenwa yabo; aye Omonene, gokora amagegu e chindo chinsae!

English: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
Kiswahili: Na watoweke kama maji yapitayo kwa kasi, wavutapo pinde zao, mishale yao na iwe butu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga basirigwe kegima buna amaache omogooko agoeta asira; ekero bakoruta emegwe yabo, eburoke.

English: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
Kiswahili: Kama konokono ayeyukavyo akitembea, kama mtoto aliyezaliwa akiwa mfu, wasilione jua.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna amakorominyo akonyititoka amarenda aera, na buna oborito bw’omokuungu bokogwa botaraika engaki yaye.

English: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
Kiswahili: Kabla vyungu vyenu havijapata moto wa kuni za miiba, zikiwa mbichi au kavu, waovu watakuwa wamefagiliwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabasirie bwango, ee, bwango kobua chinyongo chiaino chitarabwata riberera ri’omorero bw’amagwa, karabe amabese gose amasusanu.

English: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
Kiswahili: Wenye haki watafurahi waonapo wakilipizwa kisasi, watakapochovya nyayo zao katika damu ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nagoke ekero egesiomba kegoakanwa, natiringe amanyinga ’abaanto abanyabibe.

English: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wanadamu watasema, “Hakika utulivu wa wenye haki bado una thawabu, hakika kuna Mungu ahukumuye dunia.”
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bateebe, “Ekeene, abanyaboronge nigo bakonyora eng’eria yabo; ekeene, Nyasae nareo okonacha ebiina ase ense.”

English: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Usiharibu!” Utenzi wa Daudi. Wakati Sauli alipotuma wapelelezi nyumbani mwa Daudi ili wamuue. Ee Mungu, uniokoe na adui zangu, unilinde kutokana na hao wanaoinuka dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi ekero Saulo atomete abanto bamoite) Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane, indende korwa ase abanto aba banyimokeire gonkora bobe.

English: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
Kiswahili: Uniponye na watu watendao mabaya, uniokoe kutokana na wamwagao damu.
Ekegusii: Nkonye korwa ase abakori amabe; ntoorie korwa ase abaiteri amanyinga.

English: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Tazama wanavyonivizia! Watu wakali wananifanyia hila, ingawa Ee Bwana, mimi sijakosea wala kutenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Rora, abanto aba bebisete na komboera bang’ite, abanto abatindi basangererekanire amo bankore bobe; Omonene, ayio tari ase engencho y’ogosaria gose ebibe nakorire.

English: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
Kiswahili: Sijatenda kosa; hata hivyo wako tayari kunishambulia. Inuka unisaidie, uone hali yangu mbaya!
Ekegusii: Tindakora bobe bonde bokogera baminyoke gocha gonkora bobe. Omonene imoka, orore amang’ana ayio, onkonye!

English: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli! Zinduka uyaadhibu mataifa yote, usionyeshe huruma kwa wasaliti.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, naye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli! Imoka, orue egesusuro ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, tobaisa gotigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo ase abwo bagokora amabe ase obong’ainereria.

English: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
Kiswahili: Hurudi wakati wa jioni, wakibweka kama mbwa, wakiuzurura mji.
Ekegusii: Kera omogoroba nigo bakoirana, baetanana omochie, bakoga buna chisese.

English: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
Kiswahili: Tazama yale wanayotema kutoka vinywa vyao, hutema upanga kutoka midomo yao, nao husema, “Ni nani atakayetusikia?”
Ekegusii: Oise kobarigereria, orore buna bakona‐gokwana‐kwana! Ebikoba biabo nigo bire buna emioro emioge, bateba: “Ning’o oranyare gotoigwa?”

English: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Bwana, uwacheke; unayadharau mataifa hayo yote.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo okobasekerera, aye nigo ogochecheria abanto bonsi batakomanyeti.

English: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
Kiswahili: Ee nguvu yangu, ninakutazama wewe, wewe, Ee Mungu, ndiwe ngome yangu,
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore chinguru chiane, nimbe nkoganyete, ekiagera naye ore obotamero obokong’u.

English: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
Kiswahili: Mungu wangu unipendaye. Mungu atanitangulia, naye atanifanya niwachekelee wale wanaonisingizia.
Ekegusii: Nyasae one nigo agonchichera nobwanchani bwaye botari koera, Nyasae one nankore nchenge igoro y’ababisa baane.

English: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
Kiswahili: Lakini usiwaue, Ee Bwana, ngao yetu, au sivyo watu wangu watasahau. Katika uwezo wako wafanye watangetange na uwashushe chini.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, enguba yaito, tobaisa kobaita! Abanto baane nigo barabaise kweba. Obaomboganie ase chinguru chiao, erio omanye kobasiria.

English: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya dhambi za vinywa vyao, kwa ajili ya maneno ya midomo yao, waache wanaswe katika kiburi chao. Kwa ajili ya laana na uongo wanaotamka,
Ekegusii: Ebibe nigo bire ase emenwa yabo, na amang’ana bagokwana namabe. Ase igo, tiga oboenenu bwabo bobabwate buna oboreba bokobwata. Barabwo nigo bakoragereria na gokwana amang’ana ’oborimo.

English: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
Kiswahili: wateketeze katika ghadhabu, wateketeze hadi wasiwepo tena. Ndipo itakapofahamika katika miisho ya dunia kwamba Mungu anatawala juu ya Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, obasirie nendamwamu yao; basirie kegima, onde tanyorekana ore moyo nonya noyomo, erio abanto b’ense yonsi mbamanye ng’a Nyasae nere okogambera abanto ba Yakobo.

English: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.
Kiswahili: Hurudi jioni, wakibweka kama mbwa, wakiuzurura mji.
Ekegusii: Kera omogoroba nigo bakoirana, baetanana omochie, bakoga buna chisese.

English: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
Kiswahili: Wanatangatanga wakitafuta chakula, wasipotosheka hubweka kama mbwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakoong’anya korigia endagera, batayenyoreti nigo bakogeesa bokia.

English: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi nitaziimba nguvu zako, asubuhi nitaimba juu ya upendo wako; kwa maana wewe ndiwe ngome yangu na kimbilio langu wakati wa shida.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nintere igoro y’okobua kwao, kera emambia nintere neriogi rinene igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, ekiagera ase chingaki chi’emechando nigo kwabeire egekengero kiane na obotamero bwane.

English: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
Kiswahili: Ee uliye Nguvu zangu, ninakuimbia sifa. Wewe, Ee Mungu, ndiwe ngome yangu, Mungu unipendaye.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore chinguru chiane, nintere ogoteera gw’okogotogia; aye naye egekengero kiane, aye naye Nyasae onyanchete mono.

English: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Shushani Eduthi.” Utenzi wa Daudi wa kufundisha. Wakati alipopigana na Waaramu kutoka Aramu-Naharaimu na Aramu-Soba, naye Yoabu akarudi nyuma na kuwaua Waedomu 12,000 katika Bonde la Chumvi. Ee Mungu, umetukataa na kutokea ghafula juu yetu, umekasirika: sasa turejeshe upya!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi gw’okworokereria, ekero arwanete n’Abaaramu korwa Naharimu na Soba, na Yoabu akairana goita Abaedomu 12,000 ase Riranya ri’Omonyo) Nyasae, aye gwatwangire na gwatosiareire, kwabeire kore nendamwamu, toiranerie amaya aito.

English: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
Kiswahili: Umetetemesha nchi na kuipasua; uiponye mavunjiko yake, kwa maana inatetemeka.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatengechirie ense na koyetandora; iraneria naende amatandoku ayio, ekiagera nigo egotengecha mono.

English: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
Kiswahili: Umewaonyesha watu wako nyakati za kukata tamaa; umetunywesha mvinyo unaotuyumbisha.
Ekegusii: Gwakorire abanto bao babeire nemechando emekong’u; gwatonyoisirie edivai yatotindirie na gotoong’anyia.

English: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
Kiswahili: Kwa wale wanaokucha wewe, umewainulia bendera, ili iweze kutwekwa dhidi ya upinde.
Ekegusii: Aye kwaeire abanto abwo bakoirogete ekemanyererio, kenyare koimokererigwa igoro ase ogotenenera ekeene.

English: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
Kiswahili: Tuokoe na utusaidie kwa mkono wako wa kuume, ili wale uwapendao wapate kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Igo nonyare gotooria abanto abwo gwanchete; otoe obobui goetera ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio, oigwe ogosaba gwaito.

English: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
Kiswahili: Mungu amenena kutoka patakatifu pake: “Nitaigawa Shekemu kwa ushindi na kulipima Bonde la Sukothi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae okwanire korwa ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu, ogoteeba, “Ase omochengo ninyatanane Sekemu, na ense omweya ya Sukoti inyiate chincherere.

English: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
Kiswahili: Gileadi ni yangu na Manase ni yangu; Efraimu ni kofia yangu ya chuma, nayo Yuda ni fimbo yangu ya utawala.
Ekegusii: Gileadi neyane, na Manase neyane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogambi.

English: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
Kiswahili: Moabu ni sinia langu la kunawia, juu ya Edomu natupa kiatu changu; nashangilia kwa kushindwa kwa Ufilisti.”
Ekegusii: Moabu negetaabo kiane ngoisabera; nindute egekoroto kiane igoro ase Edomu, ning’ake eriogi ri’okobua igoro y’ense y’Abafilisti.”

English: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
Kiswahili: Ni nani atakayenipeleka hadi mji wenye ngome? Ni nani atakayeniongoza hadi nifike Edomu?
Ekegusii: Ning’o orandaae ansoyie ase omochie ogiteire chindwaki? Ning’o orantang’ane gochia Edomu?

English: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, si ni wewe uliyetukataa sisi, na hutoki tena na majeshi yetu?
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Inee, ngwatotigire kegima? Aye tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.

English: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
Kiswahili: Tuletee msaada dhidi ya adui, kwa maana msaada wa mwanadamu haufai kitu.
Ekegusii: Tokonye torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokonywa kwa Mwanyabaanto mbosa.

English: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
Kiswahili: Kwa msaada wa Mungu tutapata ushindi, naye atawaponda adui zetu.
Ekegusii: Ekero tore amo na Nyasae, inatokore amang’ana amanene, nere orabue ababisa baito na kobatiringera inse.

English: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa ala za nyuzi za uimbaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, sikia kilio changu, usikilize maombi yangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae one, igwa ekerero kiane; tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane.

English: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
Kiswahili: Kutoka miisho ya dunia ninakuita, ninaita huku moyo wangu unadhoofika; uniongoze kwenye mwamba ule ulio juu kuliko mimi.
Ekegusii: Ekero enkoro yane yarusirie moyo, nigo ngokorangeria korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Aye ondaae gochia egetare keria kere egetambe mono kombua.

English: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa umekuwa kimbilio langu, ngome imara dhidi ya adui.
Ekegusii: Aye naye obotamero bwane, eburi enkong’u egonkengera korwa ase ababisa baane.

English: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
Kiswahili: Natamani kukaa hemani mwako milele, na kukimbilia chini ya uvuli wa mbawa zako.
Ekegusii: Ing’a ribaga ingenderere komenya botambe ase eema yao; ninganetie inyore oborendi obuya inse y’ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao.

English: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, kwa kuwa umesikia nadhiri zangu, umenipa urithi wa wale wanaoliogopa jina lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae kwaigure chiira chiane narire ase ogotiana, abanto bairogete erieta riao kwabaeire omwando obo.

English: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
Kiswahili: Mwongezee mfalme siku za maisha yake, miaka yake kwa vizazi vingi.
Ekegusii: Omentere omorwoti amatuko agenderere koba moyo; emiaka yaye ebe ey’ebiaare ebinge.

English: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
Kiswahili: Yeye na atawazwe kwenye kiti cha enzi mbele za Mungu milele; amuru upendo wako na uaminifu wako vimlinde.
Ekegusii: Tiga agenderere botambe koba omorwoti ase obosio bwao aye Nyasae; obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwao, bimorende.

English: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
Kiswahili: Ndipo daima nitaliimbia sifa jina lako na kuzitimiza nadhiri zangu siku baada ya siku.
Ekegusii: Igo nimbe ngotera ase ogotogia erieta riao botambe, naende rituko ase rituko imbe ngoikerania chiira chiane.

English: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa Yeduthuni. Zaburi ya Daudi. Kwa Mungu peke yake nafsi yangu inapata pumziko; wokovu wangu watoka kwake.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omoyo one nigo oganyete Nyasae bweka ase okonyora obotoereru; ogotooreka kwane nigo gokorwa asare.

English: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
Kiswahili: Yeye peke yake ndiye mwamba wangu na wokovu wangu; yeye ni ngome yangu, sitatikisika kamwe.
Ekegusii: Ere nere bweka egetare kiane, na ogotooreka kwane, nere orwaki rwane, tinkonyegerigwa mono.

English: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
Kiswahili: Mtamshambulia mtu hata lini? Je, ninyi nyote mtamtupa chini, ukuta huu ulioinama na uzio huu unaotikisika?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inwe mwensi, ngoika ririri moragenderere korwania omonto ore bweka, erinde momoakere inse, inwe mwensi amo, buna nigo are enyasi ere ang’e kogwa na orwaki rwatandokire?

English: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
Kiswahili: Walikusudia kikamilifu kumwangusha toka mahali pake pa fahari; wanafurahia uongo. Kwa vinywa vyao hubariki, lakini ndani ya mioyo yao hulaani.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia bamoiyerie korwa ase obonene bwaye. Barabwo nigo bakogokigwa mono gokwana oborimo; nigo bagosesenia nebikoba biabo bosa, korende ase chinkoro chiabo ime nigo bakoragereria.

English: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
Kiswahili: Ee nafsi yangu, upumzike, kwa Mungu peke yake, tumaini langu latoka kwake.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo omoganyete Nyasae bweka ase okonyora obotoereru; ogosemeria kwane nigo gokorwa asare.

English: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
Kiswahili: Yeye peke yake ndiye mwamba wangu na wokovu wangu; ndiye ngome yangu, sitatikisika.
Ekegusii: Ere bweka negetare kiane, na ogotooreka kwane, na egekengero kiane egekong’u; tinkonyegerigwa.

English: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
Kiswahili: Wokovu wangu na heshima yangu viko kwa Mungu, ndiye mwamba wangu wenye nguvu na kimbilio langu.
Ekegusii: Ogotooreka kwane, na obonene bwane, nigo bikonyorekana ase Nyasae. Nyasae negetare kiane gie chinguru, na obotamero bwane.

English: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
Kiswahili: Enyi watu, mtumainini yeye wakati wote, miminieni mioyo yenu kwake, kwa kuwa Mungu ni kimbilio letu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto, mwegene Omonene ase chingaki chionsi, morentere emechando yaino; Nyasae nere obotamero bwaito.

English: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
Kiswahili: Binadamu wa ngazi ya chini ni pumzi tu, nao wa ngazi ya juu ni uongo tu; wakipimwa kwenye mizani, si chochote; wote kwa pamoja ni pumzi tu.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Mwanyabaanto nigo bare buna omooki rioka, abanto baeire obonene nigo bare bosa; ekero bakorengwa nigo bare abagusu; bonsi nigo bare abagusu kobua omooki.

English: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
Kiswahili: Usitumainie vya udhalimu wala usijivune kwa vitu vya wizi; ingawa utajiri wako utaongezeka, usiviwekee moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gosemeria obourereria, timobaisa koba nogosemeria kwa bosa ase ebinto bi’oboibi. Onye obotenenku bwaino bwabeire obonge, timobaisa kobosemeria.

English: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
Kiswahili: Jambo moja Mungu amelisema, mambo mawili nimeyasikia: kwamba, Ee Mungu, wewe una nguvu,
Ekegusii: Nyasae okwanire ara rimo, ee, nabeire nkoyaigwa chintunda ibere, ng’a Nyasae nere omonyene okobua.

English: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
Kiswahili: na kwamba, Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwenye upendo. Hakika utampa kila mtu thawabu kwa kadiri ya alivyotenda.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nigo ore nobwanchani bogendererete botambe; aye nigo ogoakana omonto koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere.

English: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Wakati alipokuwa katika Jangwa la Yuda. Ee Mungu, wewe ni Mungu wangu, nakutafuta kwa moyo wote; nafsi yangu inakuonea kiu, mwili wangu unakuonea wewe shauku, katika nchi kame na iliyochoka mahali ambapo hapana maji.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi ekero arenge ase erooro ya Yuda) Aye Nyasae, Nyasae one, naye ngotang’ana korigia. Omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore, na omobere one nigo okoganetie, ase ense y’eguru‐gura enyomo pa etari namaache.

English: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
Kiswahili: Nimekuona katika mahali patakatifu na kuuona uwezo wako na utukufu wako.
Ekegusii: Nabeire ngokorigia ase Obomenyo Obochenu, erinde ndore okobua kwao na obonene bwao.

English: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu upendo wako ni bora kuliko uhai, midomo yangu itakuadhimisha.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya kobua obogima, ase ayio nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one.

English: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
Kiswahili: Nitakusifu siku zote za maisha yangu, na kwa jina lako nitainua mikono yangu.
Ekegusii: Nimbe nkona‐kogotogia ase obogima bwane bwonsi, ase erieta riao nindambore amaboko aane gochia igoro.

English: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu itatoshelezwa kama kwa wingi wa vyakula; kwa midomo iimbayo kinywa changu kitakusifu wewe.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one oisanekire buna oyorire obonoru bw’emeseto na ebitinya, nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one ore nebikoba bire nomogooko.

English: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
Kiswahili: Kitandani mwangu ninakukumbuka wewe, ninawaza juu yako makesha yote ya usiku.
Ekegusii: Ekero indaire ase oborere bwane, nigo nkoba nkorengereretie, ase obotuko obogima ebirengererio biane nigo bikona‐gokoiranerera.

English: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu wewe ndiwe msaada wangu, chini ya uvuli wa mbawa zako naimba.
Ekegusii: Aye kwabeire botambe ogokonya kwane, na inse y’ekiiriri gie chimbaaba chiao nintere nomogooko.

English: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu inaambatana nawe, mkono wako wa kuume hunishika.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nokobwaterere mono, ekiagera aye nonsiirete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio.

English: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu wataharibiwa, watakwenda chini kwenye vilindi vya dunia.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, mbagende gochia inse kegima y’ense.

English: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
Kiswahili: Watatolewa wafe kwa upanga, nao watakuwa chakula cha mbweha.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bararuegwe baitwe nemioro, babe endagera ye chisese chi’orosana.

English: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
Kiswahili: Bali mfalme atafurahi katika Mungu, wale wote waapao kwa jina la Mungu watamsifu, bali vinywa vya waongo vitanyamazishwa.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo omorwoti nabe okogoka ase Nyasae, na abanto bonsi abagotiana asare mbabe bagwetogia, korende emenwa y’abanto bagokwana oborimo nekirigwe.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, unisikie ninapoeleza lalamiko langu, uyahifadhi maisha yangu kutokana na vitisho vya adui.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, igwa eriogi riane ekero nkorera; renda obogima bwane korwa ase omobisa oyo okongosa.

English: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
Kiswahili: Unifiche kutokana na shauri la siri la waovu, kutokana na zile kelele za kundi la watenda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Imbise korwa ase emeroberio ya bobisi y’abakori amabe, korwa ase eburu-buru y’abakori ebibe.

English: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
Kiswahili: Wananoa ndimi zao kama panga na kuelekeza maneno yao kama mishale ya kufisha.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagotieria chimeme chiabo buna emioro, amang’ana bagokwana nigo are nobororo, anga buna chinsara.

English: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
Kiswahili: Hurusha mishale kutoka kwenye mavizio kwa mtu asiye na hatia, humrushia ghafula bila woga.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase baboeete nigo bakorasa omonto otari na komocha, bamorasa chinsara mobosokano batari nobwoba.

English: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja humtia moyo mwenzake katika mipango mibaya; huzungumza juu ya kuficha mitego yao, nao husema, “Ni nani ataiona?”
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobeekana chinguru ase ogokora ebibe ebio barobeirie; nigo bagokwana amo igoro y’ogotegera abande oboreba bobisi, bagoteebania: “Ning’o torooche?”

English: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
Kiswahili: Hufanya shauri baya la dhuluma na kusema, “Tumebuni mpango mkamilifu!” Hakika nia na moyo wa mwanadamu vina hila.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagokora emeroberio emebe, bagoteeba, “Bono twakorire omooroberio oito omoikeranu.” Ekeene, ebirengererio bia ime bi’omonto, na enkoro yaye, nigo bisinyete.

English: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
Kiswahili: Bali Mungu atawapiga kwa mishale, nao ghafula wataangushwa.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nabarase ensara yaye, na barabwo baraswe mobosokano.

English: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
Kiswahili: Atageuza ndimi zao wenyewe dhidi yao na kuwaleta kwenye maangamizi; wote wawaonao watatikisa vichwa vyao kwa dharau.
Ekegusii: Nasirie abanto abwo ase engencho y’amang’ana amabe bagokwana; bonsi abarabe bakobarora mbasingisie emetwe yabo ase ogoichana.

English: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
Kiswahili: Wanadamu wote wataogopa, watatangaza kazi za Mungu na kutafakari yale aliyoyatenda.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi mbairoke, babe bakoraria emeremo ya Nyasae na komanya mono ayakorire.

English: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
Kiswahili: Wenye haki na wafurahi katika Bwana, na wakimbilie kwake; wanyofu wote wa moyo na wamsifu yeye!
Ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbabe nomogooko ase Omonene na komotamera. Abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbabe bagwetogia.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Wimbo. Ee Mungu, sifa zakungojea katika Sayuni; kwako wewe nadhiri zetu zitatimizwa.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae o Sayoni, ogotogigwa nokwao; goika togoikeranerie chiira chiaito.

English: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
Kiswahili: Ewe usikiaye maombi, kwako wewe watu wote watakuja.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba, ase ayio abanto bonsi mbache asore.

English: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
Kiswahili: Tulipokuwa tumefunikwa kabisa na dhambi, wewe ulisamehe makosa yetu.
Ekegusii: Nonya ebibe biambuire aye nigo okwabera ogosaria okwo.

English: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
Kiswahili: Heri wale uliowachagua na kuwaleta karibu ili waishi katika nyua zako! Tunashibishwa kwa mema ya nyumba yako, mema ya Hekalu lako takatifu.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio gwachorire na komoikia ang’e, amenye naye ase chigoora chiao. Intwe ntoisaneke nobuya bw’enyomba yao, Hekalu yao Enchenu.

English: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.
Kiswahili: Unatujibu kwa matendo ya kushangaza ya haki, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, tumaini la miisho yote ya duniani na la bahari zilizo mbali sana,
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase ogokora kw’ogokumia ogotoigwa ase oboronge bwao; naye ore ogosemeria kw’abaanto bamenyete ase ense, nonya ngoika chinsinyo chi’ense, na ase chinyancha chi’aare.

English: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
Kiswahili: uliyeumba milima kwa uwezo wako, ukiwa umejivika nguvu,
Ekegusii: Aye gwakong’irie ebitunwa ne chinguru chiao, ekiagera aye nigo bweboetie okobua.

English: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
Kiswahili: uliyenyamazisha dhoruba za bahari, ngurumo za mawimbi yake, na ghasia za mataifa.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotoereria enyancha ekoruma, na emerindo yaye, naboigo namarorooche a Mwanyabaanto.

English: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaoishi mbali sana wanaogopa maajabu yako, kule asubuhi ipambazukiapo na kule jioni inakofifilia umeziita nyimbo za furaha.
Ekegusii: Abamenyete ase chinsinyo chi’ense nigo bagokumia ebimanyererio biao. Abare ase erioba rigosoka korwa goikera ase rikogwa gochia, nigo okogera batera nomogooko.

English: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
Kiswahili: Waitunza nchi na kuinyeshea, waitajirisha kwa wingi. Vijito vya Mungu vimejaa maji ili kuwapa watu nafaka, kwa maana wewe umeviamuru.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogwechandera ense, kwayerentera embura, nigo okoyea obotenenku obonge mono; chindooche chiao aye Nyasae nigo chiichire namaache. Ase okoroisia riroba igo nigo okoa abanto endagera.

English: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
Kiswahili: Umeilowesha mifereji yake na kusawazisha kingo zake; umeilainisha kwa manyunyu na kuibariki mimea yake.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okorenta embura ase chinchwara chi’emegondo y’ense; nigo okwarania aase aimokererete igoro, erio gwatoma embura yororobia riroba na gosesenia ebigokina ase emegondo.

English: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
Kiswahili: Umeuvika mwaka taji ya baraka, magari yako yanafurika kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Kwabeekeire omwaka egutwa y’obuya bwao, amabarato ao nigo agotonya obonoru.

English: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
Kiswahili: Mbuga za majani za jangwani umezineemesha; vilima vimevikwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Amarisia e chirooro nigo agotonya boigo, na ebigoro nigo bieboetie omogooko.

English: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
Kiswahili: Penye nyanda za malisho pamejaa makundi ya wanyama, na mabonde yamepambwa kwa mavuno; vyote vinashangilia kwa furaha na kuimba.
Ekegusii: Ebirubo nigo biichire namaicho e ching’ondi, na amakura nigo atubire ne chindagera. Kera egento nigo kegochenga nomogooko.

English: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Wimbo. Zaburi. Mpigieni Mungu kelele za shangwe, dunia yote!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi, ase omoteria) Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Nyasae;

English: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
Kiswahili: Imbeni utukufu wa jina lake; mpeni sifa zake kwa utukufu!
Ekegusii: terera obonene bw’erieta riaye, moe obonene ase okomotogia!

English: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
Kiswahili: Mwambieni Mungu, “Jinsi gani yalivyo ya kutisha matendo yako! Uwezo wako ni mkuu mno kiasi kwamba adui wananyenyekea mbele zako.
Ekegusii: Motebie Nyasae: Naki ogokora kwao kore ogw’okwoboyia! Obobui bwao nigo bore obonene mono, goika ababisa bao bekeyie asore.

English: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
Kiswahili: Dunia yote yakusujudia, wanakuimbia wewe sifa, wanaliimbia sifa jina lako.”
Ekegusii: Ense engima nigo ekogosasiima na kogotogia, abanto bonsi nigo bagotera na gotogia erieta riao.

English: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
Kiswahili: Njooni mwone yale Mungu aliyoyatenda, mambo ya kutisha aliyoyatenda miongoni mwa wanadamu!
Ekegusii: Inchuo morore aya Nyasae akorire. Aya akorire ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto nigo are ay’okwoboyia.

English: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
Kiswahili: Alifanya bahari kuwa nchi kavu, wakapita kati ya maji kwa miguu, njooni, tumshangilie.
Ekegusii: Ere akaonchora enyancha ekaba ense enyomo, erio abanto bakambokera aroro namagoro. Aroro agwo tokagoka mono asare.

English: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
Kiswahili: Yeye hutawala kwa uwezo wake milele, macho yake huangalia mataifa yote: waasi wasithubutu kujiinua dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba ase okobua kwaye kare na kare; amaiso aye nigo arigereretie ebisaku bionsi, ase igo abasaria tibaabaisa kweimokereria igoro.

English: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
Kiswahili: Enyi mataifa, msifuni Mungu wetu, sauti ya sifa yake isikike,
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, motogie Nyasae oito, tiga eriogi ri’okomotogia riigweke.

English: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
Kiswahili: ameyahifadhi maisha yetu na kuizuia miguu yetu kuteleza.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere otorendete tore moyo, tatotigeti totererigwe amagoro.

English: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, wewe ulitujaribu, ukatusafisha kama fedha.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae gwatoteemire, ee, gwatoteemire buna efeta egoteemwa ase omorero.

English: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
Kiswahili: Umetuingiza kwenye nyavu na umetubebesha mizigo mizito migongoni mwetu.
Ekegusii: Nigo gwatotigete tokagwa ase egesibo aye nigo gwatotwegete egurube endito.

English: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
Kiswahili: Uliwaruhusu watu watukalie vichwani, tulipita kwenye moto na kwenye maji, lakini ulituleta kwenye nchi iliyojaa utajiri tele.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwarentete ababisa baito bagatotacha emetwe. Intwe nigo twaetete ime y’omorero na amaache, korende nonya nabo, ogatorusiao, ogatobeka ase obuya obonge bore.

English: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
Kiswahili: Nitakuja hekaluni mwako na sadaka za kuteketezwa na kukutimizia nadhiri zangu:
Ekegusii: Ninchiche ase enyomba yao, indetane ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa. Ning’ikeranie chiira nakorierete ase ogotiana,

English: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
Kiswahili: nadhiri ambazo midomo yangu iliahidi na nilizotamka kwa kinywa changu nilipokuwa katika shida.
Ekegusii: chiira chiria nakwanete nomonwa one, echio nariete ekero narenge ase emechando.

English: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.
Kiswahili: Nitakutolea dhabihu za wanyama wanono na sadaka za kondoo dume, nitakutolea mafahali na mbuzi.
Ekegusii: Ninkorentere ching’iti chire chinoru chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ninchirue amo nekeng’wanso gie chimingichi kere ne rimisu rigiya. Nindue ne chieri ne chimbori chibe ebing’wanso.

English: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
Kiswahili: Njooni msikilize ninyi nyote mnaomcha Mungu, nami niwaambie aliyonitendea.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamoirogete Nyasae, inchwo moigwe, nainche nimbatebie ay’Omonene ankoreire.

English: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
Kiswahili: Nilimlilia kwa kinywa changu, sifa zake zilikuwa katika ulimi wangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo narerete neriogi rinene asare, na ogotogigwa kwaye nigo kwarenge ase oromeme rwane.

English: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
Kiswahili: Kama ningekuwa nimeyaficha maovu moyoni mwangu, Bwana asingekuwa amenisikiliza;
Ekegusii: Onye nabete ndengereretie amabe ase enkoro yane, Omonene anga tantegererete.

English: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
Kiswahili: lakini hakika Mungu amenisikiliza na amesikia sauti yangu katika maombi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekeene, Nyasae ontegereire; ee, oigure eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane.

English: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
Kiswahili: Sifa apewe Mungu, ambaye hakulikataa ombi langu wala kunizuilia upendo wake!
Ekegusii: Nyasae atogigwe, ekiagera tangeti koigwa ogosaba kwane, gose tarusetie korwa asende obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.

English: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Na ala za nyuzi za muziki. Zaburi. Wimbo. Mungu aturehemu na kutubariki, na kutuangazia nuru za uso wake,
Ekegusii: (Ase omoteria) Nyasae atororere amaabera, atosesenie, atoraberie obosio bwaye.

English: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
Kiswahili: ili njia zako zijulikane duniani, wokovu wako katikati ya mataifa yote.
Ekegusii: Tiga enchera yao emanyekane ase ense, na okobua kwao kw’ogotooria komanyekane ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

English: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, mataifa na wakusifu, mataifa yote na wakusifu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tiga abanto bagotogie; ee, abanto bonsi tiga bagotogie!

English: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote wafurahi na kuimba kwa shangwe, kwa kuwa unatawala watu kwa haki na kuongoza mataifa ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’ebisaku bagoke na oteera nomochengo; ekiagera aye nigo okonachera abanto ebiina ase oboronge. Aye naye okoraa ebisaku bire ase ense.

English: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, mataifa na wakusifu, mataifa yote na wakusifu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tiga abanto bagotogie, ee, abanto bonsi tiga bagotogie!

English: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nchi itatoa mazao yake, naye Mungu, Mungu wetu, atatubariki.
Ekegusii: Ense yamire okwama kwaye okonge, Nyasae, aye ore Nyasae oito, otosesenie!

English: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
Kiswahili: Mungu atatubariki na miisho yote ya dunia itamcha yeye.
Ekegusii: Nyasae otosesenirie; ase igo, tiga abanto bare ase ense engima bamoiroke!

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Wimbo. Mungu na ainuke, watesi wake watawanyike, adui zake na wakimbie mbele zake.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Tiga Nyasae aimokerere igoro, na ababisa baye basiarerwe, abanto abwo bamogechete, tiga batame barue asare.

English: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
Kiswahili: Kama vile moshi upeperushwavyo na upepo, vivyo hivyo uwapeperushe mbali, kama vile nta iyeyukavyo kwenye moto, vivyo hivyo waovu na waangamie mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Tiga baserigwe gochia aare, buna erioki rikoirwa aa n’aaria; Tiga abakori amabe basirigwe kegima, barue ase obosio bwa Nyasae, basirigwe buna obochoe bokonyititoka ase omorero.

English: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
Kiswahili: Bali wenye haki na wafurahi, washangilie mbele za Mungu, wafurahi na kushangilia.
Ekegusii: Korende abanyene oboronge tiga babe nomogooko omonene kegima, tiga babe nomochengo ase obosio bwa Nyasae, babe bagoteera bare nomogooko.

English: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Mungu, liimbieni sifa jina lake, mtukuzeni yeye aendeshwaye juu ya mawingu: jina lake ni Bwana, furahini mbele zake.
Ekegusii: Moteerere Nyasae, tera amatera agotogia erieta riaye. Moroiserie enchera ere agoetera ase chirooro. Erieta riaye n’Omonene, kabe nomochengo ase obosio bwaye!

English: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
Kiswahili: Baba wa yatima, mtetezi wa wajane, ni Mungu katika makao yake matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oria omenyete aase aye aachenu, nere ise bwe chintakana, na omorendi bw’ababoraka.

English: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
Kiswahili: Mungu huwaweka wapweke katika jamaa, huwaongoza wafungwa wakiimba, bali waasi huishi katika nchi kame.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoa abatigirwe bosa chinka ase bakomenya. Nigo agosibora abanto basibire baseseneka, korende abasaria nigo bakomenya ase ense enyomo kegima.

English: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, ulipowatangulia watu wako, ulipopita nyikani,
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekero gwatang’anete abanto bao na ogotaara ase erooro,

English: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: dunia ilitikisika, mbingu zikanyesha mvua, mbele za Mungu, Yule wa Sinai, mbele za Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli.
