Ekegusii: ense nigo yatengechete, embura egatwa korwa igoro, na aye Nyasae nao kwarenge. Nonya negetunwa gia Sinai nigo giatengechete, ekero aye Nyasae kwarengeo; aye ore Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, ulinyesha mvua nyingi na kuiburudisha ardhi iliyokuwa imechoka.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nigo kwarentete embura enyinge mono, na igo omwando oo oria konya orosire okayoiraneria chinguru.

English: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, watu wako waliishi huko, nawe kwa wingi wa utajiri wako uliwapa maskini mahitaji yao.
Ekegusii: Omoganda oo okanyora obomenyo aase agwo. Aye Nyasae, ase engencho y’obuya bwao, kwaeire abanto abataka aya baremeire.

English: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
Kiswahili: Bwana alitangaza neno, waliolitangaza neno hilo walikuwa kundi kubwa:
Ekegusii: Nyasae akarua ogochika, na omoganda omonene bw’abakungu bakararia amang’ana ayio:

English: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
Kiswahili: “Wafalme na majeshi walikimbia upesi, watu waliobaki kambini waligawana nyara.
Ekegusii: “Abarwoti b’abarwani esegi batamire, ee, batamire!” Abakungu batigarete ase chinka ngwatanana bare ebisakorwa.

English: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
Kiswahili: Hata ulalapo katikati ya mioto ya kambini, mabawa ya njiwa wangu yamefunikwa kwa fedha, manyoya yake kwa dhahabu ingʼaayo.”
Ekegusii: Nonya bagendererete kobeera ase ameri e ching’ondi, nigo bare buna amaruma are ne chimbaaba chiatubire nefeta, na amarionya abo atubire netaabu ekomeka‐meka.

English: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
Kiswahili: Wakati Mwenyezi alipowatawanya wafalme katika nchi, ilikuwa kama theluji iliyoanguka juu ya Salmoni.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene, Omobui asiarerete abarwoti b’aase agwo, amagena ’embura agatwa ase egetunwa gia Salimoni.

English: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
Kiswahili: Milima ya Bashani ni milima iliyotukuka, milima ya Bashani ina vilele vilivyochongoka.
Ekegusii: Aye egetunwa kia Basani, nigo ore egetunwa kia Nyasae, aye egetunwa kia Basani, nigo obwate ebichuria ebinge.

English: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.
Kiswahili: Enyi milima yenye vilele vilivyochongoka, kwa nini mnakazia macho kwa wivu, katika mlima Mungu anaochagua kutawala, ambako Bwana mwenyewe ataishi milele?
Ekegusii: Aye egetunwa ki’ebichuria ebinge, nase ki okorigereria ne ribero ase egetunwa ekio Nyasae achorire koba obomenyo bwaye? Ee, Omonene ochorire komenya aroro kogenderera botambe.

English: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Magari ya Mungu ni makumi ya maelfu, na maelfu ya maelfu; Bwana amekuja kutoka Sinai hadi katika patakatifu pake.
Ekegusii: Chigari chia Nyasae nigo chire chilifu chinyinge mono, Omonene nigo are ase egati yabo buna nase Sinai, Aase aye aachenu.

English: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.
Kiswahili: Ulipopanda juu, uliteka mateka, ukapokea vipawa kutoka kwa wanadamu, hata kutoka kwa wale walioasi, ili wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu, upate kuishi huko.
Ekegusii: Aye ogatiira gochia igoro ogoosa abasibwa, na okanyora ebiegwa ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto, ee, nonya nase egati y’abasaria, ng’a aye Omonene Nyasae onyare komenya aroro.

English: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
Kiswahili: Sifa apewe Bwana, Mungu Mwokozi wetu, ambaye siku kwa siku hutuchukulia mizigo yetu.
Ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, rituko ase rituko nigo agotobogoreria chigurube chiaito. Nyasae nere ogotooreka gwaito.

English: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
Kiswahili: Mungu wetu ni Mungu aokoaye, Bwana Mwenyezi hutuokoa na kifo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oito nigo are Nyasae ogotooria. Nyasae oito, Omonene nigo agototooria korwa ase amakweri.

English: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
Kiswahili: Hakika Mungu ataponda vichwa vya adui zake, vichwa vya hao waendao katika njia za dhambi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nasenyente emetwe y’ababisa baye, nasenyente ebiore bire netukia bi’abwo bakogenderera ne chinchera chiabo chi’ebibe.

English: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,
Kiswahili: Bwana alisema, “Nitawarudisha kutoka Bashani; nitawarudisha kutoka vilindi vya bahari,
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agateeba: “Ning’iranie abanto abwo korwa Basani, mbarente korwa ase chindiba chi’enyancha,

English: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
Kiswahili: ili uweze kuchovya miguu yako katika damu ya adui zako, huku ndimi za mbwa wako zikiwa na fungu lake.”
Ekegusii: erinde motache amanyinga abo namagoro aino, ne chisese chiaino chinyore ebitari biabo biababisa baino.”

English: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, maandamano yako yameonekana, maandamano ya Mungu wangu, Mfalme wangu, yakielekea patakatifu pake.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, omoganda oo ogotaara ororekanire; ee, aye Nyasae one, na omorwoti one, omoganda oria oo ogosoa ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.

English: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
Kiswahili: Mbele wako waimbaji, baada yao wapiga vinanda, pamoja nao wako wanawali wakipiga matari.
Ekegusii: Abateri nigo batang’aine bosio, magega yabo abakobugia amakano, na ase egati yabo abaiseke bakobugia chinchigiri:

English: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
Kiswahili: Msifuni Mungu katika kusanyiko kubwa, msifuni Bwana katika kusanyiko la Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abamore ab’ororeria rw’Abaisraeli, motogie Nyasae ase egati y’omosangererekano Omonene.”

English: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
Kiswahili: Liko kabila dogo la Benyamini likiwaongoza, wakifuatwa na kundi kubwa la watawala wa Yuda, hatimaye watawala wa Zabuloni na Naftali.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Benjamini, abare abasinini mono ase egati yabo, nao bare baabatang’aine, na abanene b’Abayuda nao bare amo nomoganda obo, na abanene b’Abasabuloni na ab’Abanafutali.

English: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, amuru uwezo wako, Ee Mungu tuonyeshe nguvu zako, kama ulivyofanya hapo awali.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokia okobua kwao; ee Nyasae, ayio gwatokoreire, genderera koyabeka chinguru.

English: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya Hekalu lako Yerusalemu wafalme watakuletea zawadi.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti nigo bagokorentera ebiegwa ime ase Hekalu yao ere agwo Yerusalemu.

English: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
Kiswahili: Mkemee mnyama aliyeko kwenye manyasi, kundi la mafahali katikati ya ndama za mataifa. Na walete minara ya madini ya fedha wakinyenyekea. Tawanya mataifa yapendayo vita.
Ekegusii: Togonyera eng’iti eria y’orosana emenyete ase ebitonto ime, na amaicho e chieri amo ne chimori chiabo, nabwo abanto. Togonyera abanto goika bekeyie na gokoruera chifeta chiabo. Osiarere abanto banchete esegi.

English: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
Kiswahili: Wajumbe watakuja kutoka Misri, Kushi atajisalimisha kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bare ne chinguru mbarue Misiri, na abanto b’Ethiopia baayerere koramborera Nyasae amaboko abo.

English: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah—
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Mungu, enyi falme za dunia, mwimbieni Bwana sifa,
Ekegusii: Inwe amarwoti are ase ense, tera motogie Nyasae; tera amatera ay’okomotogia Omonene!

English: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
Kiswahili: mwimbieni sifa yeye apandaye mbingu za kale zilizo juu, yeye angurumaye kwa sauti kuu.
Ekegusii: Moteerere ere oria oriinete igoro, igoro eria yarengeo korwa chingaki chia kare. Rora, nigo agoaka eriogi riaye rire ne chinguru riaigugwa.

English: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
Kiswahili: Tangazeni uwezo wa Mungu, ambaye fahari yake iko juu ya Israeli, ambaye uwezo wake uko katika anga.
Ekegusii: Inwe raria okobua kwa Nyasae, oyio obonene bwaye bore igoro y’Abaisraeli, na okobua kwaye nigo kore igoro onsi.

English: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, wewe unatisha katika mahali patakatifu pako, Mungu wa Israeli huwapa watu wake uwezo na nguvu. Mungu Asifiwe!
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are oyo bw’okogosa korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu; ere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli; nigo akoa abanto baye okobua ne chinguru. Omonene atogigwe!

English: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Yungiyungi.” Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, niokoe, kwa maana maji yamenifika shingoni.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Nyasae, intoorie, ekiagera amaache aichoire, aikire ase omoyo one.

English: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Kiswahili: Ninazama kwenye vilindi vya matope, pasipo mahali pa kukanyaga, Nimefika kwenye maji makuu, mafuriko yamenigharikisha.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngendererete korimera endiba y’etintira ime, aase tari ase ngotacha n’amagoro. Narimeire ase amaache ase endiba entambe, na emerindo yantubire.

English: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
Kiswahili: Nimechoka kwa kuomba msaada, koo langu limekauka. Macho yangu yanafifia, nikimtafuta Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Narosire ekiagera nkona-korera, omoyo one bwomire kegima. Amaiso aane abeire orotutu, nganyete Nyasae one.

English: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaonichukia bila sababu ni wengi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu; wengi ni adui kwangu bila sababu, wale wanaotafuta kuniangamiza. Ninalazimishwa kurudisha kitu ambacho sikuiba.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bangechete bosa ’ngencho ende etaiyo; nigo bare abange kobua etukia ere ase omotwe one. Ababisa baane nigo bagokwana oborimo igoro yane, baganetie gosiria obogima bwane, nigo bare ne chinguru chinyinge. Nigo n’akanete ebi ntaibete.

English: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, wewe unajua upumbavu wangu, wala hatia yangu haikufichika kwako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nomanyete oboriri bwane, naki amamocho aane tabisekaneti korwa asore.

English: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ewe Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, wakutumainio wasiaibishwe kwa ajili yangu; wakutafutao wasifedheheshwe kwa ajili yangu, Ee Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, totiga abanto abwo bagosemeretie, bare ime yane, barore obosooku. Aye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, totiga abanto abwo bagokorigia, bare ime yane, bachaywe.

English: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nimestahimili dharau kwa ajili yako, aibu imefunika uso wangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nachayirwe ase engencho yao, obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane.

English: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa mgeni kwa ndugu zangu, mgeni kwa wana wa mama yangu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire omogeni ase abanto baminto, na omoeti ase abaminto twaiboretwe korwa ase enda eyemo.

English: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wivu wa nyumba yako unanila, matukano ya wale wanaokutukana yameniangukia.
Ekegusii: Risemi ri’enyomba yao riandire, emerumi y’abwo bakoramete nigo yangwerete.

English: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
Kiswahili: Ninapolia na kufunga, lazima nivumilie matusi.
Ekegusii: Ekero nabete nkorera ase omoyo one na kweng’ata, ngachaywa na gokwanwa bobe.

English: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
Kiswahili: Ninapovaa nguo ya gunia, watu hunidharau.
Ekegusii: Ekero neboyetie chigunia ase okweumia bakaba bakondabaara.

English: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaoketi mlangoni wananisimanga, nimekuwa wimbo wa walevi.
Ekegusii: Inche ’ngokwanwa bobe nabwo bagoikaransa ang’e negeita kogamba, abakonywa na gotinda bakoroisia amatera ay’ogonchecheria.

English: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
Kiswahili: Lakini Ee Bwana, ninakuomba, kwa wakati ukupendezao; katika upendo wako mkuu, Ee Mungu, unijibu kwa wokovu wako wa hakika.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ngosaba ase engaki yancheire. Aye Nyasae, inyigwere, ekiagera nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera, naende nigo ore omwegenwa ase ogotooria.

English: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
Kiswahili: Uniokoe katika matope, usiniache nizame; niokoe na hao wanichukiao, kutoka kwenye vilindi vya maji.
Ekegusii: Ntoorie, tindimera ase etintira ime! Ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane, na korwa ase amaache ’endiba entambe.

English: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
Kiswahili: Usiache mafuriko yanigharikishe au vilindi vinimeze, au shimo lifumbe kinywa chake juu yangu.
Ekegusii: Gaki totiga emerindo entube, gose chindiba chimere, gose engoro emumekerie.

English: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, unijibu, kwa wema wa upendo wako; kwa huruma zako nyingi unigeukie.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ing’iranerie, ekiagera obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya, ing’iranere, ekiagera amaabera ao namange mono.

English: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
Kiswahili: Usimfiche mtumishi wako uso wako, uharakishe kunijibu, kwa sababu niko katika shida.
Ekegusii: Tobisa obosio bwao korwa asende inche omosomba oo; inyigwe bwango, ekiagera inche nigo inde ase emechando emenene.

English: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
Kiswahili: Njoo karibu uniokoe, nikomboe kwa sababu ya adui zangu.
Ekegusii: Inchuo ang’e asende, omboorie, onsibore korwa ase ababisa baane!

English: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
Kiswahili: Unajua jinsi ninavyodharauliwa, kufedheheshwa na kuaibishwa, adui zangu wote unawajua.
Ekegusii: Aye nomanyete amabe nakoreirwe, na buna nasookigwe na gochaywa; nigo omanyete ababisa baane bonsi.

English: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
Kiswahili: Dharau zimenivunja moyo na nimekata tamaa, nimetafuta wa kunihurumia, lakini sikumpata, wa kunituliza, lakini sikumpata.
Ekegusii: Amabe ayio nakoreirwe asionoire enkoro yane, bono nerusirie moyo. Nigo nasemeretie ng’a ndorerwe amabeebe, korende tinayaroreretwe; nigo nasemeretie inyore abaremia, korende tinabanyora.

English: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
Kiswahili: Waliweka nyongo katika chakula changu na walinipa siki nilipokuwa na kiu.
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge nenchara, abanto bakang’a amaache endorwe ribaga ri’endagera, na ekero narenge nerang’o, bakang’a chinkama nkanywa.

English: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
Kiswahili: Meza iliyoandaliwa mbele yao na iwe mtego, nayo iwe upatilizo na tanzi.
Ekegusii: Tiga endagera ere ase amasio abo, ebe egesugunia ase bare, na oboreba ase abwo bekagete ng’a mbuya bare.

English: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
Kiswahili: Macho yao yatiwe giza ili wasiweze kuona, nayo migongo yao iinamishwe daima.
Ekegusii: Oukorie amaiso abo: otengechie chibachwa chiabo kogenderera.

English: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
Kiswahili: Uwamwagie ghadhabu yako, hasira yako kali na iwapate.
Ekegusii: Obaumorere ekeririanda kiao, na endamwamu yao yoke igoro yabo.

English: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
Kiswahili: Mahali pao na pawe ukiwa, wala asiwepo yeyote atakayeishi katika mahema yao.
Ekegusii: Tiga omochie obo otigare bosa, monto onde tamenya ase chiema chiabo.

English: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wanawatesa wale uliowajeruhi, na kuzungumza juu ya maumivu ya wale uliowaumiza.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bachandete omonto oria kwaagete, na bagokwana igoro y’obororo bw’oyio kwabetete.

English: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
Kiswahili: Walipize uovu juu ya uovu, usiwaache washiriki katika wokovu wako.
Ekegusii: Menta obobe igoro ase obobe bwabo; tobatiga basoe ase oboronge bwao.

English: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
Kiswahili: Wafutwe kutoka kitabu cha uzima na wasiorodheshwe pamoja na wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Tiga amarieta abo atinyigwe korwa ase egetabu y’abare moyo, tarikwa amo nay’abanyene oboronge.

English: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
Kiswahili: Mimi niko katika maumivu na dhiki; Ee Mungu, wokovu wako na unihifadhi.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo inde ase emechando n’obororo; aye Nyasae, ogotooreka kwao konyimokererie igoro.

English: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
Kiswahili: Nitalisifu jina la Mungu kwa wimbo, nami nitamtukuza kwa kumtolea shukrani.
Ekegusii: Nintogie erieta ria Nyasae ase okomoterera; nindarie obonene bwaye ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

English: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
Kiswahili: Hili litampendeza Bwana kuliko ngʼombe dume, zaidi ya fahali akiwa na pembe na kwato zake.
Ekegusii: Ayio naro aragokie Omonene kobua komoruera eng’ombe koba ekeng’wanso, gose komoruera eeri ere ne ching’unchara na ebitaago.

English: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
Kiswahili: Maskini wataona na kufurahi: ninyi mnaomtafuta Mungu, mioyo yenu na iishi!
Ekegusii: Abwo bakoreire bobe mbarore ayio, bagoke; inwe aba mokorigia Nyasae, tiga chinkoro chiaino chikorwe chinyia.

English: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwasikia wahitaji wala hadharau watu wake waliotekwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoigwa abanto baria baremeire; ere tari gochaaya abanto baye abwo bare ase obosibwa.

English: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
Kiswahili: Mbingu na dunia zimsifu, bahari na vyote viendavyo ndani yake,
Ekegusii: Tiga igoro na ense chitogie Omonene, naboigo na enyancha, na ebitongwa bionsi bire imeo.

English: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
Kiswahili: kwa maana Mungu ataiokoa Sayuni na kuijenga tena miji ya Yuda. Kisha watu watafanya makao yao humo na kuimiliki,
Ekegusii: Nyasae natoorie Sayoni na aagache emechie y’Abayuda naende, abasomba baye mbayeire ebe eyabo na komenya aroro.

English: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
Kiswahili: watoto wa watumishi wake watairithi na wale wote walipendao jina lake wataishi humo.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba b’Omonene mbayeire ebe eyabo, boigo nabaanto baria banchete erieta ri’Omonene mbamenye aroro.

English: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Maombi. Ee Mungu, ufanye haraka kuniokoa; Ee Bwana, njoo hima unisaidie.
Ekegusii: (Ogosaba gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!

English: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaotafuta kuuondoa uhai wangu, waaibishwe na kufadhaishwa; wote wanaotamani kuangamizwa kwangu, warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo barigetie gosiria obogima bwane, tiga basookigwe na gotantanigwa, na abwo baganetie ng’a obobe bonyore inche, tiga bairanigwe magega na gochaywa.

English: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
Kiswahili: Wale waniambiao, “Aha! Aha!” warudi nyuma kwa sababu ya aibu yao.
Ekegusii: Abwo bagonchaya na goteeba: “Kiamonyorire!” Tiga bakirigwe-kiri ase obosooku bwabo.

English: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
Kiswahili: Lakini wote wakutafutao washangilie na kukufurahia, wale wapendao wokovu wako siku zote waseme, “Mungu na atukuzwe!”
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bagokorigia, tiga bakogokere na kogochengera; abwo banchete ogotooreka kwao, tiga bagenderere goteeba: “Nyasae atogigwe!”

English: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
Kiswahili: Lakini bado mimi ni maskini na mhitaji; Ee Mungu, unijie haraka. Wewe ndiwe msaada wangu na mwokozi wangu; Ee Bwana, usikawie.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa; aye Nyasae, inchwo bwango onkonye! Aye naye Omokonyi one, na Omotooria one. Aye Omonene, totebana!

English: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, nimekukimbilia wewe, usiache nikaaibika kamwe.
Ekegusii: Omonene, naye natameire, tontiga nsookigwe.

English: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
Kiswahili: Kwa haki yako uniponye na kuniokoa, unitegee sikio lako uniokoe.
Ekegusii: Nkonye na onsibore goetera ase oboronge bwao; ntegerere, ontoorie!

English: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
Kiswahili: Uwe kwangu mwamba wa kimbilio, mahali nitakapokimbilia kila wakati; toa amri ya kuniokoa, kwa kuwa wewe ni mwamba wangu na ngome yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye kabe egetare kiane ki’obotamero ase nkogenda botambe, aye gwanchire gontooria. Naki aye negetare kiane, na egekengero kiane egekong’u.

English: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu wangu uniokoe kutoka kwenye mkono wa mwovu, kutoka kwenye makucha ya watu wabaya na wakatili.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omokori amabe, indusie korwa ase okobua kw’oyo otari omooronge, na oyore omotindi.

English: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa umekuwa tumaini langu, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, tegemeo langu tangu ujana wangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ogosemeria kwane, nabeire nkwegenete korwa obwana bwane.

English: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
Kiswahili: Tangu kuzaliwa nimekutegemea wewe, ulinitoa tumboni mwa mama yangu. Nitakusifu wewe daima.
Ekegusii: Kwabeire gontenenerete korwa ekero ntaraiborwa, naye kwandusetie korwa ase enda ya baba. Naye ndabe nkona-gotogia botambe.

English: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa kama kioja kwa wengi, lakini wewe ni kimbilio langu imara.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire buna egento ki’ogoichanerwa ase abanto abange, korende aye naye obotamero bwane obokong’u.

English: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
Kiswahili: Kinywa changu kimejazwa sifa zako, nikitangaza utukufu wako mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Omonwa one noichorigwe nogotogigwa kwao, na omobaso boira ninkobake.

English: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
Kiswahili: Usinitupe wakati wa uzee, wala usiniache nguvu zangu zinapopungua.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gonchwara ekero ndabe nagotire, tontiga ekero chinguru chirabe chiang’ereire.

English: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana adui zangu wananisengenya, wale wanaonivizia kuniua wafanya hila.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bakongamba, basangererekanire gokora omooroberio bw’ogonsiria,

English: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
Kiswahili: Wanasema, “Mungu amemwacha, mkimbilieni mkamkamate, kwani hakuna wa kumwokoa.”
Ekegusii: bateeba: “Nyasae omotigire, inchwo tomotunye, erinde tomobwate, onde tari oranyare komotooria.”

English: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, usiwe mbali nami, njoo haraka kunisaidia, Ee Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tombeera aare, Nyasae one, inchwo bwango onkonye!

English: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
Kiswahili: Washtaki wangu na waangamie kwa aibu, wale wanaotaka kunidhuru na wafunikwe kwa dharau na fedheha.
Ekegusii: Ababisa abwo bakorigia obogima bwane, tiga basookigwe na gosirigwa kegima; abwo bakorigia gonkora bobe, tiga bachaywe na gochecherigwa mono.

English: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi, nitatumaini siku zote, nitakusifu zaidi na zaidi.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nimbe nogosemeria botambe, na nimbe nkona-kogotogia mono goetania.

English: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
Kiswahili: Kinywa changu kitasimulia haki yako, wokovu wako mchana kutwa, ingawa sifahamu kipimo chake.
Ekegusii: Nimbe nkoraria ogokora kwao kw’oboronge nomonwa one. Omobaso boira nimbe nkonagwatora ogotooreka kwao; okwo kore okonene ntanyare gokorenga.

English: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, nitakuja na kutangaza matendo yako makuu, nitatangaza haki yako, yako peke yako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, nimbe nkoraria ogokora kwao okonene, nimbe nkona-gotogia oboronge bwao, ee, ningotogie aye bweka.

English: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, umenifundisha tangu ujana wangu, hadi leo ninatangaza matendo yako ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, kwabeire gokonyorokereria korwa obwana bwane, goika reero iga ningenderere konakoraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.

English: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, usiniache, hata niwapo mzee wa mvi, mpaka nitangaze uwezo wako kwa kizazi kijacho, nguvu zako kwa wote watakaokuja baadaye.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tobaisa gonchwara ekero ndabe nagotire, namerire chimbuche chiarabire se, goika imbe narareirie abanto b’ebiaare bigochi-gocha chinguru chiao, na okobua kwao.

English: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, haki yako imefika juu katika mbingu, wewe ambaye umefanya mambo makuu. Ee Mungu, ni nani aliye kama wewe?
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oboronge bwao boigete aaria igoro mono. Aye nigo gwakorete amang’ana amanene mono. Ee, Nyasae, ning’o ore buna aye?

English: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
Kiswahili: Ingawa umenifanya nipate taabu, nyingi na chungu, utanihuisha tena, kutoka vilindi vya dunia utaniinua tena.
Ekegusii: Ekero gwatotigete, nigo twaroche emechando emenge, korende nonyare gotokora abayia naende; torusie, ototiirie korwa ase chiirima chire ase ense.

English: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
Kiswahili: Utaongeza heshima yangu na kunifariji tena.
Ekegusii: Aye omente obonene bwane, na ondemie naende.

English: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu wangu, nitakusifu kwa kinubi kwa ajili ya uaminifu wako; Ee Uliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli, nitakuimbia sifa kwa zeze.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, nimbe nkobugia obokano ase okogotogia, ekiagera aye nigo ore omwegenwa. Nimbe nkogoterera ase okobugia obokano bw’ebirigisa, aye Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
Kiswahili: Midomo yangu itapaza sauti kwa furaha ninapokuimbia sifa, mimi, ambaye umenikomboa.
Ekegusii: Ning’ake eriogi rinene ri’omogooko nomonwa one, ekero ndabe ngotera amatera akogotogia. Nintere nomoyo one boigo, ekiagera aye gwantooririe.

English: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wangu utasimulia matendo yako ya haki mchana kutwa, kwa maana wale waliotaka kunidhuru, wameaibishwa na kufadhaishwa.
Ekegusii: Omobaso boira oromeme rwane ndobe rokona-gokwana igoro y’oboronge bwao, erinde abwo barigetie gonkora bobe basookigwe na gochaywa.

English: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Solomoni. Ee Mungu, mjalie mfalme aamue kwa haki yako, mwana wa mfalme kwa haki yako.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Sulemani) Nyasae, kae omorwoti okobua gw’okogamba buna aye okogamba, na omwana bw’omorwoti agambe ase oboronge buna aye.

English: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
Kiswahili: Atawaamua watu wako kwa haki, watu wako walioonewa kwa haki.
Ekegusii: Erio amanye konachera abanto bao ebiina bi’oboronge na gokora ekeene ase abataka.

English: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Milima italeta mafanikio kwa watu, vilima tunda la haki.
Ekegusii: Ebitunwa na ebigoro mbirentere abanto omorembe goetera ase oboronge.

English: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
Kiswahili: Atawatetea walioonewa miongoni mwa watu na atawaokoa watoto wa wahitaji, ataponda mdhalimu.
Ekegusii: Tiga omorwoti abe okorwanerera abataka, na atoorie abana b’abaremeire, korende asenyente abanto bagokorera abande bobe.

English: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
Kiswahili: Atadumu kama jua lidumuvyo, kama mwezi, vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbakoiroke, koreng’ana buna erioba na omotienyi bigendererete kobao, ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
Kiswahili: Atakuwa kama mvua inyeshayo juu ya shamba lililofyekwa, kama manyunyu yanyeshayo ardhi.
Ekegusii: Ere tiga aike korwa igoro buna embura egotwa ase obonyansi oborere, na buna omonyirira ogotwa igoro ase riroba.

English: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
Kiswahili: Katika siku zake wenye haki watastawi; mafanikio yatakuwepo mpaka mwezi utakapokoma.
Ekegusii: Tiga omonyaboronge asesenigwe ase amatuko aye, na omorembe ogenderere kobao goika ekero omotienyi otabeo.

English: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
Kiswahili: Atatawala kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutoka Mto mpaka miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Tiga omorwoti abe okogamba korwa ase enyancha eyemo goika eyende, na korwa ase orooche rw’Eufarati goika ase ensinyo y’ense.

English: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
Kiswahili: Makabila ya jangwani watamsujudia, na adui zake wataramba mavumbi.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete ase erooro mbatugame ase obosio bwaye bamosike, n’ababisa baye bamene orotu.

English: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
Kiswahili: Wafalme wa Tarshishi na wa pwani za mbali watamletea kodi; wafalme wa Sheba na Seba watampa zawadi.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti ba Tarisisi na ab’ebisinka ’mbabe bakomorentera ebiegwa; naboigo nabarwoti ba Sheba na Seba mbamorentere ebango.

English: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
Kiswahili: Wafalme wote watamsujudia na mataifa yote yatamtumikia.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti bonsi ’mbatugame ase obosio bwaye bamosike, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbamokorere.

English: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana atamwokoa mhitaji anayemlilia, aliyeonewa asiye na wa kumsaidia.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agotooria oyoremeire gakorangeria, naboigo nomotaka na oyotabwati onde okomokonya.

English: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
Kiswahili: Atawahurumia wanyonge na wahitaji na kuwaokoa wahitaji kutoka mauti.
Ekegusii: Nigo are omwororo ase omoremerwa na ase omotaka, boigo nigo agotooria emioyo y’abaremeire.

English: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
Kiswahili: Atawaokoa kutoka uonevu na ukatili, kwani damu yao ni ya thamani machoni pake.
Ekegusii: Nigo akobooria emioyo yabo korwa ase abachandi babo na korwa ase obotindi. Amanyinga abo nigo are nengencho enene asare.

English: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.
Kiswahili: Aishi maisha marefu! Na apewe dhahabu ya Sheba. Watu wamwombee daima na kumbariki mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Tiga omorwoti agenderere koba moyo. Chitaabu chi’ense ya Seba chirentwe asare, tiga abanto babe bakomosabera botambe, boigo tiga abe okona-gosesenigwa kera rituko.

English: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
Kiswahili: Nafaka ijae tele katika nchi yote, juu ya vilele vya vilima na istawi. Tunda lake na listawi kama Lebanoni, listawi kama majani ya kondeni.
Ekegusii: Tiga endagera yame enyinge ase ense, nonya nase ebitunwa igoro. Chindagera echio tiga china-konyegerigwa buna emete ya Lebanoni. Abanto b’emechie tiga babuche babe buna obonyansi bw’ense.

English: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
Kiswahili: Jina lake na lidumu milele, na lidumu kama jua. Mataifa yote yatabarikiwa kupitia kwake, nao watamwita aliyebarikiwa.
Ekegusii: Erieta riaye tiga rigenderere kobao botambe, rikume koreng’ana buna erioba rigendererete kobao. Abanto mbabe bagosesenigwa ime yaye; abanto b’ebisaku bionsi tiga bamoroke oyosesenirie.

English: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli, apewe sifa, yeye ambaye peke yake hutenda mambo ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, tiga atogigwe, nere bweka ogokora amakumia.

English: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
Kiswahili: Jina lake tukufu lisifiwe milele, ulimwengu wote ujae utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: Tiga erieta riaye ri’obonene ritogigwe goika kare na kare; obonene bwaye tiga boichore ase ense yonsi. Amina, Amina!

English: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mwisho wa maombi ya Daudi mwana wa Yese.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omoerio bw’ogosaba gwa Daudi, mosinto o Yese.

English: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Asafu. Hakika Mungu ni mwema kwa Israeli, kwa wale ambao mioyo yao ni safi.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Ekeene, Nyasae nigo are omuya mono ase Abaisraeli, ee, ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chichenegete.

English: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
Kiswahili: Bali kwangu mimi, miguu yangu ilikuwa karibu kuteleza; nilikuwa karibu mguu wangu kuachia uliposimama.
Ekegusii: Amagoro aane konya abeire ang’e kogochwa, konya nabeire ang’e gotererigwa,

English: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana niliwaonea wivu wenye kujivuna nilipoona kufanikiwa kwa waovu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabeete ne ribero ase abanto abaenenu, ekero naroche ng’a abwo ababe nigo basesenirie.

English: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
Kiswahili: Wao hawana taabu, miili yao ina afya na nguvu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibari konyorwa nobokong’u bonde ase obogima bwabo; emebere yabo nigo ere emiya, naende emenoru.

English: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
Kiswahili: Hawapati shida zinazowataabisha watu wengine, wala hawapati mapigo kama wanadamu wengine.
Ekegusii: Tibabwati emechando buna abanto bande babwate; tibari konyora amaakwa buna abande.

English: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kiburi ni mkufu wao, wamejivika jeuri.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, obwerori nigo boetanaine amagoti abo, na obotindi nabwo beboyetie buna eanga.

English: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
Kiswahili: Uovu hutoka katika mioyo yao iliyokufa ganzi, majivuno maovu kutoka mioyoni mwao hauna kikomo.
Ekegusii: Amaiso abo nigo akogirigenta nobonoru, obotantanu bw’ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo nobonge mono.

English: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
Kiswahili: Hudhihaki na kusema kwa ukorofi, katika majivuno yao wanatishia kutesa.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagochecheria abande na gokwana ase okobakorera bobe. Nigo bakweimokereria igoro na kobatianera.

English: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
Kiswahili: Vinywa vyao huweka madai hata kwa mbingu, nazo ndimi zao humiliki duniani.
Ekegusii: Emenwa yabo nigo egokwana amang’ana amabe are mamincha ya igoro; ne chimeme chiabo chiasokia ayakogenda ase ense engima.

English: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo watu wao huwageukia na kunywa maji tele.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto babo nigo bakoonchoka baababwatia, nigo bakwong’otera amaache abo are amange.

English: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
Kiswahili: Wanasema, “Mungu awezaje kujua? Je, Yeye Aliye Juu Sana anayo maarifa?”
Ekegusii: Erio bateeba, “Naki Nyasae arakore amanye? Inee! Ere Oyore Igoro Mono nabwate obong’aini?”

English: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo walivyo waovu: siku zote hawajali, wanaongezeka katika utajiri.
Ekegusii: Naama! Naboigo abakori amabe bare; botambe nigo bare buya na bagendererete komenta obotenenku bwabo.

English: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
Kiswahili: Hakika nimeuweka moyo wangu safi bure, ni bure nimenawa mikono yangu nisiwe na hatia.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, mbosa nabeire ndendete enkoro yane ebe echenegete, mbosa nabeire ngoisaba amaboko aane ng’a timba nokomocha.

English: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
Kiswahili: Mchana kutwa nimetaabika, nimeadhibiwa kila asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Omobaso boira nabeire nkonyora amaakwa, na kera emambia nabeire nkonyora egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.

English: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
Kiswahili: Kama ningesema, “Nitasema hivi,” ningelikuwa nimewasaliti watoto wako.
Ekegusii: Onye nakwanete amang’ana buna ayio, nigo narenge gocha koba oyotari omwegenwa ase ebiaare bi’abaanto bao.

English: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—
Kiswahili: Nilipojaribu kuelewa haya yote, yalikuwa magumu kwangu kuelewa.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero nabeete nkorengereria komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio, amang’ana ayio akaba amakong’u ase ’nde,

English: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
Kiswahili: Mpaka nilipoingia patakatifu pa Mungu, ndipo nilipotambua mwisho wao.
Ekegusii: goika ekero nasoete ime ase obomenyo obochenu bwa Nyasae, erio nario namanyete omoerio bw’abanyabibe buna ore.

English: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
Kiswahili: Hakika unawaweka mahali pa utelezi, unawaangusha chini kwa uharibifu.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, aye Omonene nigo okobabeeka aase are aaterere, aye nigo okobaturunkania kwabasiria kegima.

English: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi wanavyoangamizwa ghafula, wanatoweshwa kabisa na vitisho!
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagosirigwa rioka, omoerio obo nomoondoko okobasiria.

English: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
Kiswahili: Kama ndoto mtu aamkapo, hivyo wakati uinukapo, Ee Bwana, utawatowesha kama ndoto.
Ekegusii: Nigo banga buna chindoto omonto akweba mambia gakoboka. Aye Omonene, naboigo bare asore buna omogwekano okororwa ase okorota, ekero okoimoka nigo okweba ebieni biabo.

English: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
Kiswahili: Wakati moyo wangu ulipohuzunishwa, na roho yangu ilipotiwa uchungu,
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge nobororo ase omoyo ime, na enkoro yane ekaba buna eyabetirwe.

English: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
Kiswahili: nilikuwa mpumbavu na mjinga, nilikuwa mnyama mkatili mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo nabeete omoriri mono, tinamanya gento; nkaba buna eng’iti y’orosana ase obosio bwao.

English: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo niko pamoja nawe siku zote, umenishika mkono wangu wa kuume.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, inche nigo ngendererete kobeera asore botambe, aye nigo obwatete okoboko kwane gw’okorio.

English: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
Kiswahili: Unaniongoza kwa shauri lako, hatimaye utaniingiza katika utukufu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okondaa na gonsemia, na magega y’ayio noche kong’ira onsoyie ase obonene.

English: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
Kiswahili: Nani niliye naye mbinguni ila wewe? Dunia haina chochote ninachokitamani ila wewe.
Ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o naende imbwate aaria igoro, otatiga aye bweka? Ekero nkobwate, gento tikeri aiga ase ense nganetie.

English: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Kiswahili: Mwili na moyo wangu vyaweza kushindwa, bali Mungu ni nguvu ya moyo wangu na fungu langu milele.
Ekegusii: Omobere one na enkoro yane nabo biranyare koborwa chinguru, korende aye Nyasae, naye ore egetare gi’enkoro yane, naende naye egetare kiane goika kare na kare.

English: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
Kiswahili: Wale walio mbali nawe wataangamia, unawaangamiza wote wasio waaminifu kwako.
Ekegusii: Rora, abanto abwo bagweatanana korwa asore nabasire; aye nigo orasirie abwo batari abegenwa asore.

English: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwangu mimi, ni vyema kuwa karibu na Mungu. Nimemfanya Bwana Mwenyezi kimbilio langu; nami nitayasimulia matendo yako yote.
Ekegusii: Korende ase ’nde inche, nigo ere buya mono kobeera ang’e na Nyasae. Omonene obeire obotamero bwane, ninyare koraria emeremo yaye yonsi.

English: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa Asafu. Ee Mungu, mbona umetukataa milele? Mbona hasira yako inatoka moshi juu ya kondoo wa malisho yako?
Ekegusii: (Ototera gw’Asafu) Aye Nyasae, nase ki gwatotigire kegima? Ninki gekogera endamwamu yao yokire igoro ye ching’ondi chi’oborisia bwao?

English: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka watu uliowanunua zamani, kabila la urithi wako, ambao uliwakomboa: Mlima Sayuni, ambamo uliishi.
Ekegusii: Inyora omoganda bw’abaanto bao, abwo kwenyorerete ase chingaki chia kare. Aye nigo kwababooretie babe egesaku kere omwando oo. Inyora egetunwa gia Sayoni, agwo ase kwabeire komenyete.

English: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Geuza hatua zako kuelekea magofu haya ya kudumu, uharibifu wote huu ambao adui ameuleta pale patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Inchuo otaare aase agwo agendererete gosareka; ababisa nigo basaretie bionsi ebiarenge ime ase obomenyo boria obochenu.

English: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
Kiswahili: Adui zako wamenguruma pale ulipokutana nasi, wanaweka bendera zao kama alama.
Ekegusii: Ababisa bao nigo bakwoga aase abanto bao basangererekanete, barabwo batenenirie chibendera chiabo koba ebimanyererio biabo.

English: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
Kiswahili: Walifanya kama watu wanaotumia mashoka kukata kichaka cha miti.
Ekegusii: Nigo yarorekanete buna nabaanto bakogecha emete, bakaimokia ebisire kogecha rinani rinoru.

English: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
Kiswahili: Walivunjavunja milango yote iliyonakshiwa kwa mashoka na vishoka vyao.
Ekegusii: Nigo baimogetie chinyundo na ebisire, bakabuna ebinto bionsi bie Hekalu biabachetwe korwa ase emete.

English: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
Kiswahili: Waliteketeza kabisa mahali pako patakatifu, wakayanajisi makao ya Jina lako.
Ekegusii: Nigo basambete nomorero Obomenyo bwao Obochenu, bakaiyeria inse Obomenyo Obochenu bw’erieta riao, na bakabokora bokaba obotachenegeti.

English: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
Kiswahili: Walisema mioyoni mwao, “Tutawaponda kabisa!” Walichoma kila mahali ambapo Mungu aliabudiwa katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagateeba ase emioyo yabo, “Goika tobasirie kegima.” Nigo basambete aase onsi abanto ba Nyasae bagosangererekana.

English: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
Kiswahili: Hatukupewa ishara za miujiza; hakuna manabii waliobaki, hakuna yeyote kati yetu ajuaye hali hii itachukua muda gani.
Ekegusii: Titorochi ebimanyererio biaito, na ababani tibaiyo, na onde tari ase egati yaito omanyete ngoika ririri aya arabe.

English: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, mtesi atakudhihaki mpaka lini? Je, adui watalitukana jina lako milele?
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ngoika ririri ababisa barabe bakona‐gochecheria? Inee! Ababisa aba nigo bagochia kona‐korama erieta riao kogenderera botambe?

English: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unazuia mkono wako, mkono wako wa kuume? Uutoe kutoka makunjo ya vazi lako na uwaangamize!
Ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwaringire okoboko kwao gw’okorio? Korambore korwa ase egekuba kiao, obasirie kegima.

English: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, ni mfalme wangu tangu zamani, unaleta wokovu duniani.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, aye nigo ore omorwoti one, kwarengeo korwa kare, naye kwabeire kogokora emeremo y’ogotooria ense engima.

English: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
Kiswahili: Ni wewe uliyeigawanya bahari kwa uweza wako; ulivunja vichwa vya wanyama wakubwa wa kutisha katika maji.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatananete enyancha ase okobua kwao, ogasenyenta emetwe ye chinchoka chi’enyancha.

English: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
Kiswahili: Ni wewe uliyeponda vichwa vya Lewiathani nawe ukamtoa kama chakula kwa viumbe vya jangwani.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasenyentete emetwe ya Leviatani, eng’iti eria enene y’okwoboyia, erio omobere oye okayoa ching’iti chi’erooro chikayoria.

English: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
Kiswahili: Ni wewe uliyefungua chemchemi na vijito, ulikausha mito ambayo ilikuwa ikitiririka daima.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatubogetie chinsoko ne chindooche; boigo ogasiria amaache ye chindooche chinene, chigakamoka.

English: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
Kiswahili: Mchana ni wako, nao usiku ni wako pia, uliziweka jua na mwezi.
Ekegusii: Omobaso noyoo, na obotuko nobwao, naye gwatongete omotienyi na erioba.

English: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
Kiswahili: Ni wewe uliyeiweka mipaka yote ya dunia, ulifanya kiangazi na masika.
Ekegusii: Naye gwachiigete aase chimbebe chionsi chi’ense chikobeera, naende ogakora chingaki chi’egura gura n’etoigo.

English: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kumbuka jinsi mtesi alivyokudhihaki, jinsi watu wapumbavu walivyolitukana jina lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna ababisa bagendererete kogochecheria, na abatakoirogeti nigo bagendererete korama erieta riao.

English: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
Kiswahili: Usiukabidhi uhai wa njiwa wako kwa wanyama wakali wa mwitu; usisahau kabisa uhai wa watu wako wanaoteseka milele.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa korua omoyo one, inche riruma riao, ase omoganda oria omobe; tibweba nonya ng’ake abanto bao abwo baregire.

English: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
Kiswahili: Likumbuke agano lako, maana mara kwa mara mambo ya jeuri yamejaa katika sehemu za giza nchini.
Ekegusii: Oinyore okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete naintwe; ense nigo eichire nobobe ase kera ensemo y’omosunte.

English: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
Kiswahili: Usiruhusu walioonewa warudi nyuma kwa aibu; maskini na wahitaji hebu walisifu jina lako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga abanto abwo bagokorerwa bobe basookigwe; tiga abanto abataka na abwo baremeire batogie erieta riao.

English: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
Kiswahili: Inuka, Ee Mungu, ujitetee; kumbuka jinsi wapumbavu wanavyokudhihaki mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, imoka bwerwanerere aye omonyene; inyora buna abatakoirogeti bakogokorera echeche kera rituko.

English: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
Kiswahili: Usipuuze makelele ya watesi wako, ghasia za adui zako, zinazoinuka mfululizo.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kweba okwoga kw’ababisa bao, ne rirorooche ri’abakogochecheria rigotiira botambe.

English: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Usiharibu!” Zaburi ya Asafu. Wimbo. Ee Mungu, tunakushukuru, tunakushukuru wewe, kwa kuwa jina lako li karibu; watu husimulia matendo yako ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Aye Nyasae, nigo togokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende mbuya mono, ekiagera erieta riao nigo rire ang’e, nigo tokoraareria emeremo yao y’ogokumia.

English: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
Kiswahili: Unasema, “Ninachagua wakati maalum; ni mimi nihukumuye kwa haki.
Ekegusii: “Ekero engaki nachigete eraike, inche Nyasae ninache ekiina kia boronge.

English: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.
Kiswahili: Wakati dunia na watu wake wote inapotetemeka, ni mimi ninayezishikilia nguzo zake imara.
Ekegusii: Ekero ense egotengechigwa amo na bonsi abamenyeteo, ninche omonyene nigo nkobwata chisiiro chiaye bokong’u.

English: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
Kiswahili: Kwa wale wenye majivuno ninasema, ‘Msijisifu tena,’ kwa wale waovu, ‘Msiinue pembe zenu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngokania abanto bagwetogia: Timobaisa gwetogia, naende nintebie abakori amabe: Timobaisa komera ching’unchara chi’obomwenu.

English: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
Kiswahili: Msiinue pembe zenu dhidi ya mbingu; msiseme kwa shingo zilizonyooshwa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ee, timobaisa gochiimokereria igoro ase ogwekaga, gose gokwana amabe, inwe abamore abanyabigoti bikong’u.”

English: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yeyote atokaye mashariki wala magharibi au kutoka jangwani awezaye kumkweza mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Obonene tibori korwa moocha, gose korwa bosongo, gose tibori korwa ase ebitunwa bi’erooro.

English: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
Kiswahili: Bali Mungu ndiye ahukumuye: Humshusha huyu na kumkweza mwingine.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nere okonacha ekiina, okeyia oyomo, na oimokereria oyonde igoro.

English: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
Kiswahili: Mkononi mwa Bwana kuna kikombe kilichojaa mvinyo unaotoka povu uliochanganywa na vikolezo; huumimina, nao waovu wote wa dunia hunywa mpaka tone la mwisho.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabwate egekombe ase okoboko kwaye, geichire nedivai entindi yochoganirie, nayeumorere abakori amabe bonsi b’ense na kobabetereria bayenywe, bayekoore amo neturubo yaye.

English: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
Kiswahili: Bali mimi, nitatangaza hili milele; nitaimba sifa kwa Mungu wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nimbe nkona‐koraria kobeeka kogenderera botambe; nimbe nkona‐goteera ogoteera gw’okomotogia Nyasae o Yakobo.

English: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
Kiswahili: Nitazikatilia mbali pembe za waovu wote, bali pembe za wenye haki zitainuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabune kegima ching’unchara chi’abakori amabe, korende echi’abanyaboronge nachiimokererie igoro.

English: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa ala za nyuzi za muziki. Zaburi ya Asafu. Wimbo. Katika Yuda, Mungu anajulikana, jina lake ni kuu katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Nyasae nigo amanyekanete ase Abayuda, erieta riaye rire rinene mono ase Abaisraeli.

English: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.
Kiswahili: Hema lake liko Salemu, makao yake katika Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu nigo bore agwo Salemu, ere nigo amenyete agwo Sayoni.

English: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
Kiswahili: Huko alivunja mishale imetametayo, ngao na panga, silaha za vita.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo nabunete chinsara chi’amata chikomesa, boigo naende akabutorana chinguba, na emioro na ebirwanero binde bi’esegi.

English: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
Kiswahili: Wewe unangʼaa kwa mwanga, mwenye fahari zaidi ya milima yenye utajiri wa wanyama pori.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okomeka‐meka oichire nobonene kogocha korwa ase ebitunwa biababisa kwabuire.

English: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
Kiswahili: Mashujaa hulala wametekwa nyara, hulala usingizi wao wa mwisho; hakuna hata mmoja wa watu wa vita anayeweza kuinua mikono yake.
Ekegusii: Abare ne chinkoro chimwenu baurirwe ebinto konya basakoire, bono bararire chitoro chindito. Abarwani esegi bonsi basinyirwe korwana namaboko abo.

English: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
Kiswahili: Kwa kukemea kwako, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo, farasi na gari la vita vilikaa kimya.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae o Yakobo, ekero gwatogonyerete abanto bariinete chibarasi, barabwo nigo bagwete inse, bakaba buna nigo bakwete, amo ne chibarasi chiabo.

English: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
Kiswahili: Wewe peke yako ndiye wa kuogopwa. Ni nani awezaye kusimama mbele yako unapokasirika?
Ekegusii: Aye bweka nigo ore oyo bw’okoondokia mono. Ning’o oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwao, ekero kwabeire nendamwamu?

English: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
Kiswahili: Kutoka mbinguni ulitamka hukumu, nayo nchi ikaogopa, ikawa kimya:
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro, nigo kwamanyetie ense ebiina biao; na ense ekoboa egakira‐kiri,

English: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
Kiswahili: wakati wewe, Ee Mungu, ulipoinuka kuhukumu, kuwaokoa wote walioonewa katika nchi.
Ekegusii: ekero aye Nyasae gwatenenete konacha ekiina na kobatooria abwo bonsi bagokorerwa bobe.

English: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
Kiswahili: Hakika ghadhabu yako dhidi ya wanadamu inakuletea sifa, na masalia ya ghadhabu yako unajifunga mshipi.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, endamwamu ya Mwanyabaanto nenyare kogera aye otogigwe; eyeratigare noyieboyie buna orokini.

English: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
Kiswahili: Wekeni nadhiri kwa Bwana Mungu wenu na kuzitimiza; nchi zote za jirani na walete zawadi kwa Yule astahiliye kuogopwa.
Ekegusii: Inwe karie chiira ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, na mochiikeranie. Abanto bonsi bamoetanaine, tiga bamorentere ebiegwa, ere oria ogwenerete koirokwa.

English: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
Kiswahili: Huvunja roho za watawala; anaogopwa na wafalme wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agokeyia abare abaenenu ase ense, abarwoti bonsi b’ense nigo bamwoboete.

English: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa Yeduthuni. Zaburi ya Asafu. Nilimlilia Mungu ili anisaidie, nilimlilia Mungu ili anisikie.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Nkorera nde ase Nyasae neriogi rinene, nigo nkorera mono asare ng’a anyigwe.

English: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
Kiswahili: Nilipokuwa katika taabu, nilimtafuta Bwana, usiku nilinyoosha mikono bila kuchoka na nafsi yangu ilikataa kufarijika.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki chi’emechando nigo nkorigia Omonene; ase obotuko nigo nkorambora okoboko kwane ase ogosaba ntari korosa, omoyo one nigo okwanga koremigwa.

English: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, nilikukumbuka wewe, nikalia kwa huzuni; nikatafakari, roho yangu ikadhoofika.
Ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora Nyasae, nigo nkorera, na ekero nkomorengereria, nigo ngokwa omoyo.

English: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
Kiswahili: Ulizuia macho yangu kufumba; nilikuwa nasumbuka, nikashindwa kusema.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogotanga amaiso aane takonyora chitoro. Nigo nchandegete mono, tinkonyara gokwana.

English: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
Kiswahili: Nilitafakari juu ya siku zilizopita, miaka mingi iliyopita,
Ekegusii: Nigo nkoba nkorengereria igoro y’amatuko a kare, nkoinyora emiaka ya kare buna yarenge.

English: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
Kiswahili: nilikumbuka nilivyoimba nyimbo usiku. Moyo wangu ulitafakari na roho yangu ikauliza:
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko obogima nigo nkoinyora amatera aane: nigo nkoba nkorengereria ase enkoro yane ime, neriga‐rigia na kweboria:

English: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
Kiswahili: “Je, Bwana atakataa milele? Je, hatatenda mema tena?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene natotigire kegima? Tagotororera amaabera rinde?

English: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
Kiswahili: Je, upendo wake usio na mwisho umetoweka milele? Je, ahadi yake imekoma nyakati zote?
Ekegusii: Inee! Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe mbwaerire kegima? Chiira chiaye nchiaikire omoerio?

English: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
Kiswahili: Je, Mungu amesahau kuwa na huruma? Je, katika hasira amezuia huruma yake?”
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo ebire koba omonyamaabera? Inee! Nigo abeire nendamwamu, goika osiekire amabeebe?”

English: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikawaza, “Huu ndio udhaifu wangu: lakini nitakumbuka miaka ya mkono wa kuume wa Aliye Juu Sana.”
Ekegusii: Erio ngateeba, “Obo nobororo bwane, eye nengaki okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore Igoro Mono gwantomeire.”

English: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
Kiswahili: Nitayakumbuka matendo ya Bwana; naam, nitaikumbuka miujiza yako ya zamani.
Ekegusii: Ning’inyore ogokora kwao aye Omonene; ee, ning’inyore amakumia ao a kare.

English: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
Kiswahili: Nitazitafakari kazi zako zote na kuyawaza matendo yako makuu.
Ekegusii: Nimbe nkorengereria igoro y’emeremo yao yonsi, na imbe nkona‐koiranerera ogokora kwao gwe chinguru.

English: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, njia zako ni takatifu. Ni mungu yupi aliye mkuu kama Mungu wetu?
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, chinchera chiao nigo chire chinchenu. Nenyasae ereri ere enene buna Nyasae oito?

English: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
Kiswahili: Wewe ndiwe Mungu utendaye miujiza, umeonyesha uwezo wako katikati ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore Nyasae ogokora amakumia; kwaorokirie okobua kwao ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.

English: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
Kiswahili: Kwa mkono wako wenye nguvu umewakomboa watu wako, uzao wa Yakobo na Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatooretie abanto bao nokoboko kwao koramboire. Abanto abwo nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo na orwa Yusufu.

English: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
Kiswahili: Maji yalikuona, Ee Mungu, maji yalikuona yakakimbia, vilindi vilitetemeka.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekero amaache akorooche, ee, ekero akorooche, nigo akwoboete, ne chindiba chikanyegerigwa.

English: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
Kiswahili: Mawingu yalimwaga maji, mbingu zikatoa ngurumo kwa radi, mishale yako ikametameta huku na huko.
Ekegusii: Amare agaitera amaache; ne chinkoba chigaaka korwa igoro, chinsara chiao chikamesa ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
Kiswahili: Ngurumo yako ilisikika katika upepo wa kisulisuli, umeme wako wa radi ukaangaza dunia, nchi ikatetemeka na kutikisika.
Ekegusii: Okogukura gw’enkoba nigo kwarenge ime ase ekerambauti, na ense egatengecha.

English: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
Kiswahili: Njia yako ilipita baharini, mapito yako kwenye maji makuu, ingawa nyayo zako hazikuonekana.
Ekegusii: Nigo gwakorete enchera yao ase enyancha, oboeto bwao bokaba ime ase amaache amange mono, korende nonya naboigo amabarato ao tarorekanete aroro.

English: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Kiswahili: Uliongoza watu wako kama kundi kwa mkono wa Mose na Aroni.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaraaete abanto bao buna riicho rikoraagwa, ee, okabaraa goetera ase amaboko a Musa na Aroni.

English: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa Asafu. Enyi watu wangu, sikieni mafundisho yangu, sikilizeni maneno ya kinywa changu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Inwe abanto baane, igwa amang’ana nkoborokereria, tegerera moigwe amang’ana ’omonwa one.

English: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
Kiswahili: Nitafungua kinywa changu kwa mafumbo, nitazungumza mambo yaliyofichika, mambo ya kale:
Ekegusii: Inche ninkwane ase omoreng’anio, nigo ndakwane ase emebayeno ya kare.

English: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
Kiswahili: yale ambayo tuliyasikia na kuyajua, yale ambayo baba zetu walituambia.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio twaigwete na koyamanya, ayio chisokoro chiaito chiatotebetie.

English: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
Kiswahili: Hatutayaficha kwa watoto wao; tutakiambia kizazi kijacho matendo yastahiliyo sifa ya Bwana, uweza wake, na maajabu aliyoyafanya.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio titokoyabisa ase abana babo; goika toteebie ebiaare bigochi‐gocha ogokora kw’obonene bw’Omonene, na amakumia aye ay’okobua akorire.

English: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
Kiswahili: Aliagiza amri kwa Yakobo na akaweka sheria katika Israeli, ambazo aliwaamuru baba zetu wawafundishe watoto wao,
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abegete oborori bwaye ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, na akaa Abaisraeli amachiiko, ayio achigete chisokoro chiaito chiorokererie abana babo.

English: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
Kiswahili: ili kizazi kijacho kizijue, pamoja na watoto ambao watazaliwa, nao pia wapate kuwaeleza watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Nigo aganetie ng’a abanto b’ebiaare bigochi‐gocha bayamanye, ee, nonya nabana b’ebiaare konya bataraiborwa, naende abwo bayateebie abana babo.

English: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
Kiswahili: Ndipo wangeweka tumaini lao kwa Mungu, nao wasingesahau matendo yake, bali wangalizishika amri zake.
Ekegusii: Erio nario barabe bagosemeria Nyasae, na tibaabaisa kweba emeremo yaye, korende babe bakobwata amachiiko aye.

English: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
Kiswahili: Ili wasifanane na baba zao, waliokuwa kizazi cha ukaidi na uasi, ambao roho zao hazikuwa na uaminifu kwake, ambao roho zao hazikumwamini.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibaabaisa koba buna chisokoro chiabo, chiria chitaigwerete, naende chiasaretie; tichiarenge ne chinkoro chindonge, gose tichiarenge chinyegenwa ase Nyasae ase emioyo yabo.

English: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Efraimu, ingawa walijifunga pinde, walikimbia siku ya vita.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’Efraimu, abwo babogoretie amata, bakaonchoka bagatama ase rituko ri’esegi.

English: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
Kiswahili: Hawakulishika agano la Mungu na walikataa kuishi kwa sheria yake.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibarendete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa Nyasae, naende nigo bangete kobwatia amachiiko aye.

English: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
Kiswahili: Walisahau aliyokuwa ameyatenda, maajabu aliyokuwa amewaonyesha.
Ekegusii: Bakeba amang’an’Omonene konya akorire, na ebikone biria konya aorokirie ase bare.

English: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
Kiswahili: Alitenda miujiza machoni mwa baba zao, huko Soani, katika nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Ase amasio e chisokoro chiabo Nyasae nigo akorete amakumia agwo ase ense ya Misiri, ase orogongo rwa Soani.

English: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
Kiswahili: Aliigawanya bahari akawapitisha, alifanya maji yasimame imara kama ukuta.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aatananete amaache ’enyancha, akaambokeria chisokoro chiabo aroro, agakora amaache ayio agatenena buna orwaki.

English: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
Kiswahili: Aliwaongoza kwa wingu mchana na kwa nuru kutoka kwenye moto usiku kucha.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki chia mobaso nigo arenge kobaraa ne riire, na ase chingaki chia botuko abaraa ne riire ri’omorero.

English: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
Kiswahili: Alipasua miamba jangwani na akawapa maji tele kama bahari,
Ekegusii: Ere agatandora ebitare agwo ase erooro, agasokeria abanto amaache amange mono buna aye chindooche chinene.

English: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
Kiswahili: alitoa vijito kutoka kwenye jabali lililochongoka, akayafanya maji yatiririke kama mito.
Ekegusii: Agatubokia chindooche korwa ase ebitare ime, na amaache agatirimboka buna aye chindooche chinene.

English: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
Kiswahili: Lakini waliendelea kutenda dhambi dhidi yake, wakiasi jangwani dhidi ya Aliye Juu Sana.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo abanto abwo nigo bamentete gokora ebibe ase Omonene, agwo ase erooro nigo basaretie ase Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.

English: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
Kiswahili: Kwa makusudi walimjaribu Mungu, wakidai vyakula walivyovitamani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bateemete Nyasae ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakagania baegwe endagera basanerete.

English: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
Kiswahili: Walinena dhidi ya Mungu, wakisema, “Je, Mungu aweza kuandaa meza jangwani?
Ekegusii: Bagakwana amang’ana arenge mamincha ya Nyasae, bagateeba, “Inee! Nyasae nanyare gototerekera endagera eisaine aa ase erooro?

English: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”
Kiswahili: Alipopiga mwamba, maji yalitoka kwa nguvu, vijito vikatiririka maji mengi. Lakini je, aweza kutupa chakula pia? Je, anaweza kuwapa watu wake nyama?”
Ekegusii: Ee, amaene ere naagete egetare na amaache agacharara korwao, ne chindooche chi’amaache amange chikarwao, korende, Inee, nanyare boigo koa intwe abanto baye endagera? Nanyare gotoa na enyama torie?”

English: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
Kiswahili: Bwana alipowasikia, alikasirika sana, moto wake ukawa dhidi ya Yakobo, na ghadhabu yake ikawaka dhidi ya Israeli,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero Omonene aigwete ayio, agaichorwa nekeririanda, akarwania abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo nomorero, ekiagera nigo abeete nendamwamu enene mono ase Abaisraeli.

English: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa hawakumwamini Mungu, wala kuutumainia ukombozi wake.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete, ekiagera tibamwegenete Nyasae, naende tibegenete ng’a ere nanyare kobatooria.

English: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo alitoa amri kwa anga zilizo juu na kufungua milango ya mbingu,
Ekegusii: Korende nonya nabo, ere nigo achigete igoro, akaigora ebisieri bi’aroro;

English: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
Kiswahili: akawanyeshea mana ili watu wale; aliwapa nafaka ya mbinguni.
Ekegusii: akabatweria endagera ekorokwa mana, bakaba bakoyeria; ee, akabaa endagera korwa igoro.

English: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
Kiswahili: Watu walikula mkate wa malaika, akawatumia chakula chote ambacho wangeliweza kula.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Mwanyabaanto bakaria endagera y’abamalaika; Omonene akabatomera endagera enyinge mono.

English: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
Kiswahili: Aliachia upepo wa mashariki kutoka kwenye mbingu na kuuongoza upepo wa kusini kwa uwezo wake.
Ekegusii: Akarenta omwaga o moocha okagusa igoro, na ase okobua kwaye akagusia omwaga korwa Irianyi.

English: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
Kiswahili: Aliwanyeshea nyama kama mavumbi, ndege warukao kama mchanga wa pwani.
Ekegusii: Erio akabarentera chinyama chinyinge buna orotu, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka chinyinge buna omokenye ore ase enyancha;

English: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
Kiswahili: Aliwafanya washuke ndani ya kambi yao, kuzunguka mahema yao yote.
Ekegusii: agatiga chinyoni echio chikagwa gati‐gati y’egetwori kiabo, chigaetanana chiema chiabo.

English: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
Kiswahili: Walikula na kusaza, kwa maana alikuwa amewapa kile walichotamani.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakaria chinyama bakaigota, ekiagera Nyasae nigo abaete eke basanerete.

English: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
Kiswahili: Kabla hawajamaliza kula walichokitamani, hata kilipokuwa kingali bado vinywani mwao,
Ekegusii: Korende ekero chinyama chiarenge ase emenwa yabo bagendererete gochitakuna, naende konya bataraisanekia obogworu bwabo.

English: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
Kiswahili: hasira ya Mungu ikawaka juu yao, akawaua wale waliokuwa na nguvu zaidi miongoni mwao, akiwaangusha vijana wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene ase bare, agaita abanto abwo barenge ne chinguru goetania abande, agakoora kegima abamura b’Abaisraeli.

English: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
Kiswahili: Licha ya haya yote, waliendelea kutenda dhambi, licha ya maajabu yake, hawakuamini.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, abanto abwo nigo bagendererete gokora ebibe, nonya ere okorete amakumia, tibamwegenete.

English: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akamaliza siku zao katika ubatili na miaka yao katika vitisho.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio agakoora amatuko abo, akayasiria, na emiaka yabo ekaera ase okoondokia.

English: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
Kiswahili: Kila mara Mungu alipowaua baadhi yao, waliosalia walimtafuta, walimgeukia tena kwa shauku.
Ekegusii: Ekero aitete abanto abatigari nigo bamorigetie; nigo baonchogete, bakamorigia ase ekeene.

English: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
Kiswahili: Walikumbuka kwamba Mungu alikuwa Mwamba wao, kwamba Mungu Aliye Juu Sana alikuwa Mkombozi wao.
Ekegusii: Nigo bainyorete ng’a Nyasae nere egetare kiabo; naende ng’a Nyasae Oyore Igoro Mono, nere Omobooria obo.

English: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
Kiswahili: Lakini walimdanganya kwa vinywa vyao, wakisema uongo kwa ndimi zao,
Ekegusii: Korende nigo bakwanete amang’ana amansu ase okomong’aina, bagakwana oborimo nemenwa yabo.

English: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
Kiswahili: mioyo yao haikuwa thabiti kwake, wala hawakuwa waaminifu katika agano lake.
Ekegusii: Tibamobwatetie bokong’u ne chinkoro chiabo, gose tibarenge abegenwa ase okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.

English: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo alikuwa na huruma, alisamehe maovu yao na hakuwaangamiza. Mara kwa mara alizuia hasira yake, wala hakuchochea ghadhabu yake yote.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo arenge namaabera, akaba okwabera ebibe biabo tabasiria; ase chingaki chinyinge nigo arenge gotanga endamwamu yaye, gose tarenge gotiga ekeririanda kiaye gioke mono.

English: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
Kiswahili: Alikumbuka kwamba wao walikuwa nyama tu, upepo upitao ambao haurudi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ainyorete ng’a barabwo Mwanyabaanto bagosira, nigo banga buna embeo egoeta na tekoirana.

English: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
Kiswahili: Mara ngapi walimwasi jangwani na kumhuzunisha nyikani!
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinyinge nigo babete bagosaria ase Omonene agwo ase erooro; bakaba bakomoichania aroro agwo.

English: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Walimjaribu Mungu mara kwa mara, wakamkasirisha yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nigo babete bakomoteema naende, bakaba bakomogechia ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
Kiswahili: Hawakukumbuka uwezo wake, siku aliyowakomboa kutoka kwa mtesi,
Ekegusii: Ti babete bakoinyora chinguru chi’okoboko kwaye, gose tibabete bakoinyora rituko riria ababooretie korwa ase ababisa babo,

English: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
Kiswahili: siku aliyoonyesha ishara zake za ajabu huko Misri, maajabu yake huko Soani.
Ekegusii: na buna akorete ebikone ebinge ase ense ya Misiri, na amakumia agwo ase orogongo rwa Soani.

English: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
Kiswahili: Aligeuza mito yao kuwa damu, hawakuweza kunywa maji kutoka vijito vyao.
Ekegusii: Aroro aari’Omonene nigo aonchorete amaache e chindooche akaba amanyinga, abanto tibanyara koyanywa.

English: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
Kiswahili: Aliwapelekea makundi ya mainzi yakawala, na vyura wakawaharibu.
Ekegusii: Nigo arentete chingi chinyinge chikabachanda, na akabarentera ebioto bigasaria ense yabo.

English: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
