Kiswahili: Aliruhusu tunutu kuharibu mimea yao, mazao yao kwa nzige.
Ekegusii: Akarenta chingeeti chigasaria ebimeri biabo, naende akarenta chingige chikaria endagera y’emegondo yabo bechanderete.

English: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
Kiswahili: Aliharibu mizabibu yao kwa mvua ya mawe na mikuyu yao kwa mvua iliyochangamana na theluji.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arentete amagena ’embura agasaria emesabibu yabo, agasaria nemeko yabo.

English: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
Kiswahili: Aliwaachia mifugo yao mvua ya mawe, akayapiga makundi ya wanyama wao kwa radi.
Ekegusii: Akarenta amagena ’embura agaita chiombe chiabo, ne chinkoba chigaita ching’ondi ne chimbori chiabo.

English: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
Kiswahili: Aliwafungulia hasira yake kali, ghadhabu yake, hasira na uadui, na kundi la malaika wa kuharibu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabatomera endamwamu yaye enene, na ekeririanda kiaye, na okogechigwa kwaye na emechando yonsi, ekeombe ekio ki’abamalaika b’ogosiria.

English: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
Kiswahili: Aliitengenezea njia hasira yake, hakuwaepusha na kifo, bali aliwaachia tauni.
Ekegusii: Ere akaroiseria endamwamu yaye enchera; akabeeka emioyo yabo ase amakweri, akabarentera oborwaire bokabaita.

English: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
Kiswahili: Aliwapiga wazaliwa wote wa kwanza wa Misri, matunda ya kwanza ya ujana katika mahema ya Hamu.
Ekegusii: Agaita abana abatangi bonsi aaria Misiri, abwo barenge abatangi b’echinguru chiabo ase chiema chia Hamu.

English: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
Kiswahili: Lakini aliwatoa watu wake kama kundi, akawaongoza kama kondoo kupitia jangwani.
Ekegusii: Erio akang’anyia abanto baye buna ching’ondi chikong’anyigwa, akabaraa ase erooro buna riicho rikoraagwa.

English: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
Kiswahili: Aliwaongoza salama, wala hawakuogopa, bali bahari iliwameza adui zao.
Ekegusii: Akabaraa na kobarenda buya, na tibabete nobwoba, korende enyancha ekamera ababisa babo.

English: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akawaleta hadi kwenye mpaka wa nchi yake takatifu, hadi nchi ya vilima ambayo mkono wake wa kuume ulikuwa umeitwaa.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabarenta ase ense yaye enchenu, ase egetunwa keria enyorerete nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio.

English: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
Kiswahili: Aliyafukuza mataifa mbele yao, na kuwagawia nchi zao kama urithi, aliwakalisha makabila ya Israeli katika makao yao.
Ekegusii: Agaseria abanto b’ebisaku korwa bosio bwabo. Nigo abaatananerete ense eyio ekaba emiando yabo, akabeeka Abaisraeli bakamenya ase chiema chiabo.

English: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
Kiswahili: Lakini wao walimjaribu Mungu, na kuasi dhidi ya Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, wala hawakuzishika sheria zake.
Ekegusii: Erio bagateema Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, bakamogechia, tibabwatete amachiiko aye.

English: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
Kiswahili: Kama baba zao, hawakuwa thabiti wala waaminifu, wakawa wasioweza kutegemewa kama upinde wenye kasoro.
Ekegusii: Nigo baonchogete tibaaba abegenwa, buna chisokoro chiabo chitabeete abegenwa, bakaba abasaria buna obota bosaregete.

English: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
Kiswahili: Wakamkasirisha Mungu kwa mahali pao pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, wakachochea wivu wake kwa sanamu zao.
Ekegusii: Bakagechia Omonene ase engencho y’aase abo aimokererete igoro bagosasimera, na ekiagera basasimete emegwekano, Omonene akaba ne risemi.

English: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
Kiswahili: Wakati Mungu alipowasikia, alikasirika sana, akamkataa Israeli kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae aroche ayio, akaba nekeririanda, agatiga Abaisraeli kegima.

English: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
Kiswahili: Akaiacha hema ya Shilo, hema aliyokuwa ameiweka katikati ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaanga eema yaye yarenge Silo, eema eria akorete obomenyo bwaye ase egati y’abanto.

English: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
Kiswahili: Akalipeleka Sanduku la nguvu zake utumwani, utukufu wake mikononi mwa adui.
Ekegusii: Nigo atigete eke kiarenge chinguru chiaye kegasakorwa, ekio kiarenge obonene bwaye agakerua ase amaboko ababisa.

English: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
Kiswahili: Aliachia watu wake wauawe kwa upanga, akaukasirikia sana urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abeete nendamwamu ase abanto abwo barenge omwando oye, akabarua bagaitwa nemioro.

English: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
Kiswahili: Moto uliwaangamiza vijana wao, na wanawali wao hawakuimbiwa nyimbo za arusi,
Ekegusii: Omorero ogaita abamura babo, na abaiseke babo bakaborwa abakobanyuoma.

English: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
Kiswahili: makuhani wao waliuawa kwa upanga, wala wajane wao hawakuweza kulia.
Ekegusii: Abakuani babo nigo baitetwe nemioro, na ababoraka babo tibanyarete kobareera.

English: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana alipoamka kama vile kuamka usingizini, kama vile mtu aamkavyo kutoka kwenye bumbuazi la mvinyo.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaboka buna nigo araire chitoro, na akaba buna omonto etuoni onyure edivai ogoaka eriogi;

English: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
Kiswahili: Aliwapiga na kuwashinda adui zake, akawatia katika aibu ya milele.
Ekegusii: agaaka abachandi baye bagatama gochia ase barwete, akababeeka ase obosooku goika kare na kare.

English: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
Kiswahili: Ndipo alipozikataa hema za Yosefu, hakulichagua kabila la Efraimu,
Ekegusii: Omonene akaanga abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, gose tachorete abanto b’egesaku gi’Efraimu,

English: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
Kiswahili: lakini alilichagua kabila la Yuda, Mlima Sayuni, ambao aliupenda.
Ekegusii: korende agachora abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda, na egetunwa gia Sayoni ekio anchete.

English: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
Kiswahili: Alijenga patakatifu pake kama vilele, kama dunia ambayo aliimarisha milele.
Ekegusii: Aroro akaagacha obomenyo bwaye obochenu bobere igoro mono, nabobe obokong’u buna ense ekong’irie kogenderera botambe.

English: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
Kiswahili: Akamchagua Daudi mtumishi wake na kumtoa kwenye mazizi ya kondoo.
Ekegusii: Agachora Daudi omosomba oye, akamorusia korwa ase arenge korisia ching’ondi.

English: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kuchunga kondoo alimleta kuwa mchungaji wa watu wake Yakobo, wa Israeli urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Ee, akamorusia korwa ase arenge gotunyana ching’ondi chiare ne chimanwa chikogonka, akamokora akaba omorisia bw’ororeria rwa Yakobo, abanto baye, nabwo Abaisraeli omwando oye.

English: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
Kiswahili: Naye Daudi aliwachunga kwa uadilifu wa moyo, kwa mikono ya ustadi aliwaongoza.
Ekegusii: Daudi akaba omorisia bw’abaanto abwo ore nenkoro endonge, akaba okobaraa nokoboko kw’obong’aini.

English: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Asafu. Ee Mungu, mataifa yameuvamia urithi wako, wamelinajisi Hekalu lako takatifu, wameifanya Yerusalemu kuwa magofu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Aye Nyasae, abanto batakomanyeti bachire basoire ase omwando oo, barabwo bakorire Hekalu yao Enchenu yabeire eyetachenegeti, bakorire Yerusalemu obeire chitui chi’amagena.

English: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
Kiswahili: Wametoa maiti za watumishi kuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na nyama ya watakatifu wako kwa wanyama wa nchi.
Ekegusii: Baeire chinyoni emebere y’abasomba bao chiyerie, ee, chinyama chi’emebere y’abachenu bao ase ching’iti chi’orosana.

English: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
Kiswahili: Wamemwaga damu kama maji kuzunguka Yerusalemu yote, wala hakuna yeyote wa kuwazika.
Ekegusii: Baiteire amanyinga abo buna amaache ase chinsemo chionsi chia Yerusalemu, abakobatindeka baborire.

English: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
Kiswahili: Tumekuwa kitu cha aibu kwa jirani zetu, cha dharau na mzaha kwa wale wanaotuzunguka.
Ekegusii: Intwe twabeire okogechia ase abanto bamenyete ang’e naintwe, abanto batoetanaine nigo bagotochecheria na gotosekerera.

English: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Kiswahili: Hata lini, Ee Bwana? Je, wewe utakasirika milele? Wivu wako utawaka kama moto hadi lini?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ngoika ririri oragenderere koba nendamwamu ase tore? Inee! Ribero riao, ngoika ririri rigochia gwoka buna omorero?

English: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,
Kiswahili: Mwaga ghadhabu yako kwa mataifa yasiyokukubali, juu ya falme za hao wasioliitia jina lako,
Ekegusii: Umora endamwamu yao igoro ase abanto b’ebisaku batakomanyeti, na igoro ase amagambi ayio atari gokorangeria oyakonye.

English: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
Kiswahili: kwa maana wamemrarua Yakobo na kuharibu nchi ya makao yake.
Ekegusii: Naki abanto abwo basiririe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, naende basaririe aase bamenyete.

English: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
Kiswahili: Usituhesabie dhambi za baba zetu, huruma yako na itujie hima, kwa maana tu wahitaji mno.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotoa intwe egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe bie chisokoro chiaito; otorotote namaabera ao bwango, ekiagera twabeire bosa kegima.

English: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, utusaidie, kwa ajili ya utukufu wa jina lako; tuokoe na kutusamehe dhambi zetu kwa ajili ya jina lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase engencho y’obonene bw’erieta riao, tokonye; naende ase engencho y’erieta riao otoboorie, otwabere ebibe biaito!

English: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mataifa waseme, “Yuko wapi Mungu wenu?” Mbele ya macho yetu, dhihirisha kati ya mataifa kwamba unalipiza kisasi damu iliyomwagwa ya watumishi wako.
Ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bakoboria, “Ng’ai Nyasae oyio obo are?” Ase amasio aito tiga abanto b’ebisaku bamanye buna okorusia egesiomba ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’abasomba bao.

English: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
Kiswahili: Kilio cha huzuni cha wafungwa kifike mbele zako; kwa nguvu za mkono wako hifadhi wale waliohukumiwa kufa.
Ekegusii: Tiga ekerero ki’abasibire geike ase obosio bwao; tooria abanto abwo banacheirwe ekiina bakwe, ekiagera aye nobwate okobua okonene.

English: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
Kiswahili: Walipize jirani zetu mara saba vifuani mwao aibu walizovurumisha juu yako, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abanto abwo bamenyete ang’e bagochecheirie na kogochaaya, obairanerie amabe ayio abo ara gatano na kabere.

English: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
Kiswahili: Ndipo sisi watu wako, kondoo wa malisho yako, tutakusifu milele; toka kizazi hadi kizazi tutasimulia sifa zako.
Ekegusii: Erio intwe, abanto bao, abatore abe riicho ri’oborisia bwao, natokoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera botambe, na ebiaare ase ebiaare natobe tokogotogia.

English: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Yungiyungi za Agano.” Zaburi ya Asafu. Ee Mchungaji wa Israeli tusikie, wewe umwongozaye Yosefu kama kundi; wewe uketiye katika kiti cha enzi katikati ya makerubi, angaza
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Aye omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, tegerera oigwe, aye okoraa abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu buna riicho rikoraagwa! Aye oyore ase oboikaranso bw’obonene igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, tomorekere!

English: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
Kiswahili: mbele ya Efraimu, Benyamini na Manase. Uamshe nguvu zako, uje utuokoe.
Ekegusii: Orokia chinguru chiao ase abanto b’Efraimu, na Ababenjamini, na Abamanase, na oche ototoorie!

English: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, uturejeshe, utuangazie uso wako, ili tuweze kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, otokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.

English: Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, hata lini hasira yako itawaka na kufoka moshi dhidi ya maombi ya watu wako?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ngoika ririri orabe gokogechigwa nogosaba kw’abaanto bao?

English: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
Kiswahili: Umewalisha kwa mkate wa machozi, umewafanya wanywe machozi bakuli tele.
Ekegusii: Aye gwakorire amariga ’omoichano koba endagera yabo, kwabanyoisirie amariga amange mono.

English: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
Kiswahili: Tumekuwa chanzo cha ugomvi kwa jirani zetu, na adui zetu wanatudhihaki.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatokorire twabeire abakwomanerwa ase egati y’abanto bare ang’e naintwe, na ababisa baito nigo bagendererete gotochecheria.

English: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, uturejeshe; utuangazie uso wako, nasi tuweze kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, otoonchore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.

English: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
Kiswahili: Ulileta mzabibu kutoka Misri, ukawafukuza mataifa, ukaupanda.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo kwarentete omosabibu korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erio ogaseria abanto b’ebisaku korwa aase abo, okayosimeka aroro.

English: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
Kiswahili: Uliandaa shamba kwa ajili yake, mizizi ikawa imara, ukajaza nchi.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwayoraberetie aase na koaroisia, noro ogakina okaira emeri inse, okaranda ase ense eyio engima.

English: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
Kiswahili: Milima ilifunikwa kwa kivuli chake, matawi yake yakafunika mierezi mikubwa.
Ekegusii: Ekiriri ki’omosabibu oyio nigo giatubete ebitunwa, ne chinsagia chiaye chikaranda gochia aase emecharake ya Nyasae ere.

English: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.
Kiswahili: Matawi yake yalienea mpaka Baharini, machipukizi yake mpaka kwenye Mto.
Ekegusii: Chinsagia echio chikaranda chigaikeera Enyancha Enene, na emeseboka yaye gochia ase orooche rw’Eufarati.

English: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
Kiswahili: Mbona umebomoa kuta zake ili wote wapitao karibu wazichume zabibu zake?
Ekegusii: Nase ki rende aye gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye, erinde bonsi abagoeta ase enchera batabora amasabibu aye?

English: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
Kiswahili: Nguruwe mwitu wanauharibu na wanyama wa kondeni hujilisha humo.
Ekegusii: Chimbeche chie rinani nigo chigosaria omosabibu oyio, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chikoyotakuna.

English: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
Kiswahili: Turudie, Ee Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote! Tazama chini kutoka mbinguni na uone! Linda mzabibu huu,
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, yoiranere naende, rigereria korwa agwo igoro orore; bwechandere omosabibu oyio.

English: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
Kiswahili: mche ulioupanda kwa mkono wako wa kuume, mwana uliyemlea kwa ajili yako mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Renda omote oyo gwasimegete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, orosagia orwo gwechoreire na korobeka chinguru.

English: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
Kiswahili: Mzabibu wako umekatwa, umechomwa moto, unapowakemea, watu wako huangamia.
Ekegusii: Abanto bayosambire nomorero na koyogecha. Osirie abanto abwo ase okobea kwao!

English: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
Kiswahili: Mkono wako na utulie juu ya mtu aliyeko mkono wako wa kuume, mwana wa mtu uliyemlea kwa ajili yako mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Orende nokoboko kwao omonto oyio gwachorire nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, Mwanyabaanto abwo aye gwechoreire.

English: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
Kiswahili: Ndipo hatutakuacha tena, utuhuishe, nasi tutaliitia jina lako.
Ekegusii: Erio titokoonchoka togotige; torende togenderere koba moyo, na intwe ntobe togotogia erieta riao.

English: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, uturejeshe; utuangazie uso wako, ili tuweze kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, tokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.

English: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa gitithi. Zaburi ya Asafu. Mwimbieni kwa furaha, Mungu aliye nguvu yetu; mpigieni kelele za shangwe Mungu wa Yakobo!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Moterere Nyasae neriogi rinene, ekiagera nere chinguru chiaito, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Nyasae o Yakobo.

English: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
Kiswahili: Anzeni wimbo, pigeni matari, pigeni kinubi na zeze kwa sauti nzuri.
Ekegusii: Tera ogoteera kw’ogotogia, mobugie chinchigiri amo namakano ’ebirigisa, na amakano ande.

English: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
Kiswahili: Pigeni baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume wakati wa Mwandamo wa Mwezi, na wakati wa mwezi mpevu, katika siku ya Sikukuu yetu;
Ekegusii: Mobugie egetureeri ase rituko ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ekero oorokire omogima, ase ogosika rituko riaito ri’omoyega richikiire.

English: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
Kiswahili: hii ni amri kwa Israeli, agizo la Mungu wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Oyio nigo ore omooroberio ochikiire ase Abaisraeli, na aya Nyasae o Yakobo achiikire.

English: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
Kiswahili: Aliiweka iwe kama sheria kwa Yosefu alipotoka dhidi ya Misri, huko tulikosikia lugha ambayo hatukuielewa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene aetete ense ya Misiri, agachiika omooroberio oyio ase abanto ba Yusufu. Nkaigwa enkwana y’omonwa ntamanyete egoteeba:

English: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
Kiswahili: Asema, “Nimeondoa mzigo mabegani mwao; mikono yao iliwekwa huru kutoka kwenye kikapu.
Ekegusii: “Ninche narusetie chigurube korwa ase amareko aino, na ngasibora amaboko aino korwa ase ebitonga bi’okobogoria chigurube.

English: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.
Kiswahili: Katika shida yako uliniita nami nikakuokoa, nilikujibu katika mawingu yenye ngurumo; nilikujaribu katika maji ya Meriba.
Ekegusii: Ekero mwarenge nemechando nigo mwandangeretie, na inche nkabatooria, nigo nabairaneretie korwa ime y’enkoba ase nebisete, nkabateema agwo ase amaache a Meriba.

English: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
Kiswahili: “Enyi watu wangu, sikieni, nami nitawaonya: laiti kama mngenisikiliza, ee Israeli!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, igwa ekero nkob akuurera! Inwe Abaisraeli, onye ndiria mware konyigwera!

English: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
Kiswahili: Hamtakuwa na mungu mgeni miongoni mwenu; msimsujudie mungu wa kigeni.
Ekegusii: Timoba nenyasae ende eng’ao ase egati yaino, timotung’amera na gosasiima enyasae engeni.

English: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni Bwana Mungu wako, niliyekutoa nchi ya Misri. Panua sana kinywa chako nami nitakijaza.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ase ayio, asamia emenwa yaino ebe yasie, na inche imbaragerie.

English: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
Kiswahili: “Lakini watu wangu hawakutaka kunisikiliza; Israeli hakutaka kunitii.
Ekegusii: “Korende abanto baane tibaigwete eriogi riane; Abaisraeli abwo nigo bangete kegima konyigwera.

English: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
Kiswahili: Basi niliwaacha katika ukaidi wa mioyo yao wafuate mashauri yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabatiga babwatie obomwenu bwe chinkoro chiabo, erinde bakore buna koreng’ana konya barobeirie abanyene.

English: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
Kiswahili: “Laiti kama watu wangu wangalinisikiliza, kama Israeli wangalifuata njia zangu,
Ekegusii: Onye ndiria abanto abwo baane bantegererete! Onye Abaisraeli mbabwatetie chinchera chiane!

English: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
Kiswahili: ningaliwatiisha adui zao kwa haraka, na kuugeuza mkono wangu dhidi ya watesi wao!
Ekegusii: Rirorio nanga nabuete ababisa babo bwango, na okoboko kwane nkoba kware mamincha yabo.

English: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaomchukia Bwana wangalinyenyekea mbele zake, na adhabu yao ingedumu milele.
Ekegusii: Abwo bangechete inche Omonene, nigo baare gocha gotung’ama ase ’nde bare nobwoba, na amatuko abo nagenderere kobao kare na kare.

English: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
Kiswahili: Bali ninyi mngalilishwa ngano iliyo bora, na kuwatosheleza kwa asali itokayo kwenye mwamba.”
Ekegusii: Korende inwe nigo narenge gocha kobaa engano enoru, na kobaisanekia nobooke korwa ase egetare.”

English: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Asafu. Mungu anaongoza kusanyiko kuu, anatoa hukumu miongoni mwa “miungu”:
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Nyasae nigo agotenena ase omosangererekano oye omochenu, ase egati ye chinyasae nigo akonacha ekiina.

English: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.
Kiswahili: “Hata lini utaendelea kuwatetea wasio haki na kuonyesha upendeleo kwa waovu?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri moragenderere konacha ebiina bitari noboronge? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwanchereria abanto ababe?

English: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
Kiswahili: Teteeni wanyonge na yatima, tunzeni haki za maskini na walioonewa.
Ekegusii: Kae abataka ne chintakana oboronge bwabo; boigo nabwo bagokorerwa bobe, na abaremeire.

English: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
Kiswahili: Mwokoeni mnyonge na mhitaji, wakomboeni kutoka mkononi mwa mwovu.
Ekegusii: Tooria abatari na nguru, na abatabwati kende, basibore korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.”

English: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
Kiswahili: “Hawajui lolote, hawaelewi lolote. Wanatembea gizani; misingi yote ya dunia imetikisika.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gento, tibari nobong’aini, nigo bagotaara bakona‐kouna‐una ime ase omosunte; amaroso ’ense anyegerigwe.

English: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
Kiswahili: “Nilisema, ‘Ninyi ni “miungu”; ninyi nyote ni wana wa Aliye Juu Sana.’
Ekegusii: Natebiire ng’a: “Inwe nechinyasae; inwe mwensi nabana b’Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.

English: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mtakufa kama wanadamu wa kawaida; mtaanguka kama mtawala mwingine yeyote.”
Ekegusii: Korende nigo morakwe buna Mwanyabaanto bande, na obogima bwaino boere buna obw’abanene b’ense.”

English: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, inuka uihukumu nchi, kwa kuwa mataifa yote ni urithi wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, imoka, ogambie ense ekiina, ekiagera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabao.

English: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
Kiswahili: Wimbo. Zaburi ya Asafu. Ee Mungu, usinyamaze kimya, usinyamaze, Ee Mungu, usitulie.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Asafu) Aye Nyasae, tokira‐kiri! Nyasae, totoerera na gotimoka.

English: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
Kiswahili: Tazama watesi wako wanafanya fujo, jinsi adui zako wanavyoinua vichwa vyao.
Ekegusii: Rora, ababisa bao buna bagokora rirorooche; abwo bakogechete baimokereirie emetwe igoro ase oboenenu.

English: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
Kiswahili: Kwa hila, wanafanya shauri dhidi ya watu wako, wanafanya shauri baya dhidi ya wale unaowapenda.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagokora emeroberio y’obong’ainereria igoro y’abanto bao; abwo nigo bagosemania kobakorera bobe abanto bao abwo orendete.

English: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
Kiswahili: Wanasema, “Njooni, tuwaangamize kama taifa, ili jina la Israeli lisikumbukwe tena.”
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoteebania: “Inchuo tobasirie tibaaba egesaku naende, tiga erieta ri’Abaisraeli riebwe kegima!”

English: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
Kiswahili: Kwa nia moja wanapanga mashauri mabaya pamoja, wanafanya muungano dhidi yako,
Ekegusii: Abanto abagaambire ase omoyo oyomo na bakorire okobwatana mamincha yao nabwo aba;

English: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
Kiswahili: mahema ya Edomu na Waishmaeli, ya Wamoabu na Wahagari,
Ekegusii: abanto bamenyete ase chiema chi’Edomu na Abaisumaeli; Abamoabu na Abahagari;

English: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
Kiswahili: Gebali, Amoni na Amaleki, Ufilisti, pamoja na watu wa Tiro.
Ekegusii: Abagebali, na Abaamoni, na Abaamaleki; Abafirisiti amo nabamenyete Turo.

English: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
Kiswahili: Hata Ashuru wameungana nao kuwapa nguvu wazao wa Loti.
Ekegusii: Boigo Abaasuri babwatanire nabwo ase ogokonya abanto b’ororeria rwa Loti.

English: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
Kiswahili: Uwatendee kama vile ulivyowatendea Midiani, na kama vile ulivyowatendea Sisera na Yabini hapo kijito cha Kishoni,
Ekegusii: Omonene, obakore buna gwakorete Abamidiani, na buna gwakorete Sisera na Yabini agwo ase orooche rwa Kisoni.

English: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
Kiswahili: ambao waliangamia huko Endori na wakawa kama takataka juu ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo baiteretwe agwo EniDori; bakaba esike ase riroba.

English: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
Kiswahili: Wafanye wakuu wao kama Orebu na Zeebu, watawala wao kama Zeba na Salmuna,
Ekegusii: Okore abanto babo basikire buna gwakorete Orebu na Seebu, na abanene babo babe buna Seba na Salimuna,

English: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
Kiswahili: ambao walisema, “Na tumiliki nchi ya malisho ya Mungu.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera bateebete, “Inchuo toire amarisio a Nyasae abe ayaito.”

English: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu wangu, wapeperushe kama mavumbi ya kisulisuli, kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, tiga abanto abwo bairurukigwe buna orotu, ee, buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.

English: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
Kiswahili: Kama vile moto uteketezavyo msitu au mwali wa moto unavyounguza milima,
Ekegusii: Buna omorero ogokoora rinani, na buna ekebemberi ki’omorero kegosamba ebitunwa,

English: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
Kiswahili: wafuatilie kwa tufani yako na kuwafadhaisha kwa dhoruba yako.
Ekegusii: naboigo batunyanerie omwaga oo bw’omoubera, na obaondokie nekembugu‐mbugu kiao.

English: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Funika nyuso zao kwa aibu ili watu walitafute jina lako, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kora amasio abo abe nobosooku obonene, erinde babe bakorigia erieta riao.

English: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
Kiswahili: Wao na waaibishwe na kufadhaishwa milele, na waangamie kwa aibu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga babe nobosooku na omoichano goika kare na kare; ee, tiga basookigwe na basire kegima.

English: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
Kiswahili: Hebu wajue kwamba wewe, ambaye jina lako ni Bwana, kwamba wewe peke yako ndiwe Uliye Juu Sana ya dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga bamanye ng’a naye bweka okorokwa Omonene, nigo ore Oyore Igoro Mono igoro y’ense yonsi.

English: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa gitithi. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, makao yako yapendeza kama nini!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, naki obomenyo bwao bore oboseera!

English: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu inatamani sana, naam, hata kuona shauku, kwa ajili ya nyua za Bwana; moyo wangu na mwili wangu vinamlilia Mungu Aliye Hai.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nore namaiga amange kobeera ase chigoora chia Omonene; enkoro yane na omobere one nigo bigoterera Nyasae ore moyo nomogooko omonene.

English: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.
Kiswahili: Hata shomoro amejipatia makao, mbayuwayu amejipatia kiota mahali awezapo kuweka makinda yake: mahali karibu na madhabahu yako, Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Enchiro nigo ekonyora obomenyo, na egesingororo nigo gekwenyorera egeswa ase amage aye akobeera, agwo ase egesasiimero kiao, aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, aye Omorwoti one, na Nyasae one.

English: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
Kiswahili: Heri wale wanaokaa nyumbani mwako, wanaokusifu wewe daima.
Ekegusii: Mbarenomogooko abanto abwo bamenyete ase enyomba yao, abwo bakona‐goteera botambe ase okogotogia.

English: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
Kiswahili: Heri wale ambao nguvu zao ziko kwako, na njia ziendazo Sayuni zimo mioyoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Mbare nomogooko abanto abwo bakonyora chinguru chiabo korwa asore; abwo chinkoro chiabo chiganetie kogenda Sayoni.

English: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
Kiswahili: Wanapopita katika Bonde la Baka, hulifanya mahali pa chemchemi, pia mvua za vuli hulijaza kwa madimbwi.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo bagoeta ase Rigoko ria Baka, nigo bakorikora riaba aase e chinsoko chi’amaache; na embura ye ritang’ani nigo ekorirentera ogosesenigwa okonge.

English: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
Kiswahili: Huendelea toka nguvu hadi nguvu, hadi kila mmoja afikapo mbele za Mungu huko Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe bakomenta koba ne chinguru kogenderera botambe, mbarore Nyasae ayobuete chinyasae agwo Sayoni.

English: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, sikia maombi yangu; nisikilize, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, igwa ogosaba kwane, tegerera onyigwe, aye Nyasae o Yakobo.

English: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, uitazame ngao yetu, mtazame kwa wema mpakwa mafuta wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore enguba yaito, origererie obosio bw’omoakwa amaguta oo.

English: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
Kiswahili: Siku moja katika nyua zako ni bora kuliko siku elfu mahali pengine; afadhali ningekuwa bawabu katika nyumba ya Mungu wangu kuliko kukaa katika mahema ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Mbuya kobeera ase enyomba yao rituko erimo rioka kobua kobeera amatuko chilifu chinyinge aande onsi; mbuya koba omorendi bw’egesieri ki’enyomba yao aye Nyasae one, kobua kobeera ase obomenyo bw’abakori amabe.

English: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni jua na ngao, Bwana hutoa wema na heshima; hakuna kitu chema anachowanyima wale ambao hawana hatia.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are erioba na enguba, ere nigo agotoa amaabera na obonene; ere takorina abare ne chinkoro chindonge gento kende gionsi kere ekiya.

English: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, heri ni mtu yule anayekutumaini wewe.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, nasesenirie omonto okwegenete.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Ee Bwana, ulionyesha wema kwa nchi yako. Ulimrejeshea Yakobo baraka zake.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Omonene, kare nigo kwarenge namaabera ase ense yao, nigo kwairaneretie abanto ba Yakobo amaya abo.

English: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
Kiswahili: Ulisamehe uovu wa watu wako, na kufunika dhambi zao zote.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaberete abanto bao obobe bwabo, nigo gwatubete ebibe biabo bionsi.

English: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
Kiswahili: Uliweka kando ghadhabu yako yote na umegeuka na kuiacha hasira yako kali.
Ekegusii: Boigo ngwatigete koba nekeririanda, ngwatigete kegima kogechigwa nabarabwo.

English: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, uturejeshe tena, nawe uiondoe chuki yako juu yetu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Omotooria oito, otoiranere, rusia ekeririanda kiao korwa ase tore.

English: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
Kiswahili: Je, utatukasirikia milele? Utaendeleza hasira yako kwa vizazi vyote?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ogochia koba nendamwamu ase tore kogenderera botambe? Inee! Endamwamu yao nigo egendererete koba ase ebiaare bionsi?

English: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
Kiswahili: Je, hutatuhuisha tena, ili watu wako wakufurahie?
Ekegusii: Inee! Togotokora abayia naende, erinde intwe abanto bao tobe nomogooko asore?

English: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
Kiswahili: Utuonyeshe upendo wako usiokoma, Ee Bwana, utupe wokovu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otoorokerie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na otoe ogotooreka kwao.

English: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
Kiswahili: Nitasikiliza lile atakalosema Mungu aliye Bwana; anaahidi amani kwa watu wake, watakatifu wake: lakini nao wasirudie upumbavu.
Ekegusii: Nimbe nkoigwa amang’an’Omonene Nyasae agokwana; ere nigo agokwana amang’ana ’omorembe ase abanto baye abachenu, tobatiga baonchokere oboriri naende.

English: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
Kiswahili: Hakika wokovu wake uko karibu na wale wamchao, ili utukufu wake udumu katika nchi yetu.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ogotooreka kwaye nigo kore ang’e ase abanto bairogete Omonene; obonene mbobe bomenyete ase ense yaito.

English: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
Kiswahili: Upendo na uaminifu hukutana pamoja, haki na amani hubusiana.
Ekegusii: Aase agwo obwanchani bogendererete botambe na ekeene mbiumerane, boigo oboronge na omorembe mbinyunyuntane.

English: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
Kiswahili: Uaminifu huchipua kutoka nchi, haki hutazama chini kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Aase agwo obwegenwa mbooroke ase ense, na oboronge mborigererie korwa igoro.

English: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
Kiswahili: Naam, hakika Bwana atatoa kilicho chema, nayo nchi yetu itazaa mavuno yake.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene narue ayare amaya, na orogongo rwaito rorue okwama kwaye.

English: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
Kiswahili: Haki itatangulia mbele yake na kutengeneza njia kwa ajili ya hatua zake.
Ekegusii: Oboronge mbotang’ane bosio bwaye, naende bobwatie ase aetete.

English: A Prayer by David. Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
Kiswahili: Maombi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, sikia na unijibu, kwa maana mimi ni maskini na mhitaji.
Ekegusii: (Ogosaba gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, integerera, onyigwe na ong’iranerie, ekiagera nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa.

English: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
Kiswahili: Linda maisha yangu, kwa maana nimejiweka kwako, wewe ni Mungu wangu, mwokoe mtumishi wako anayekutumaini.
Ekegusii: Orende omoyo one, ekiagera nigo nkoirogete; aye Nyasae one, intoorie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera nigo ngosemeretie.

English: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, nihurumie mimi, kwa maana ninakuita mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, indorera amaabera, ekiagera nigo nkorera asore omobaso boira.

English: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
Kiswahili: Mpe mtumishi wako furaha, kwa kuwa kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, ninainua nafsi yangu.
Ekegusii: Gokia omoyo one inche omosomba oo, ekiagera narentire omoyo one asore aye Omonene.

English: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwema na mwenye kusamehe, umejaa upendo kwa wote wakuitao.
Ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo ore omuya na oyo okwabera; nigo okoorokia obwanchani obonge ase abagokorangeria obakonye.

English: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, sikia maombi yangu, sikiliza kilio changu unihurumie.
Ekegusii: Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, igwa ekerero ki’ogosorora kwane.

English: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya shida yangu nitakuita, kwa maana wewe utanijibu.
Ekegusii: Ekero inde nemechando nigo ngokorangeria, ekiagera aye nigo okonyigwa na kong’iraneria.

English: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, katikati ya miungu hakuna kama wewe, hakuna matendo ya kulinganishwa na yako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, enyasae teri enga buna aye, gose emeremo ende teri enga buna eyao.

English: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, mataifa yote uliyoyafanya yatakuja na kuabudu mbele zako; wataliletea utukufu jina lako.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi gwatongete mbichiche, bitung’ame ase obosio bwao kogosasiima, mbitogie erieta riao, aye Omonene.

English: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wewe ni mkuu, na unafanya mambo ya ajabu; wewe peke yako ndiwe Mungu.
Ekegusii: Aye naye ore omonene, nigo ogokora amakumia; aye naye bweka ore Nyasae.

English: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, nifundishe njia yako, nami nitakwenda katika kweli yako; nipe moyo usiositasita, ili niweze kulicha jina lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao, nigo nganetie kobwatia ekeene kiao; renda enkoro yane, erinde inyiroke erieta riao.

English: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana wangu, nitakusifu kwa moyo wote; nitaliadhimisha jina lako milele.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae one, nigo nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono nenkoro yane yonsi, nindarie obonene bw’erieta riao goika kare na kare.

English: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu kwangu; umeniokoa kutoka kwenye vilindi vya kaburi.
Ekegusii: Naki obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obonene ase ’nde; aye kwabooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakuure.

English: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, wenye majivuno wananishambulia; kundi la watu wakatili linatafuta uhai wangu: watu wasiokuheshimu wewe.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, abanto abaenenu banyimokeire kondwania esegi; ekeombe ki’abaanto abatindi nigo bakorigia basirie obogima bwane, abwo tibakoirogeti nonya ng’ake.

English: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, ni Mungu wa huruma na neema, si mwepesi wa hasira, bali ni mwingi wa upendo na uaminifu.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore Nyasae bw’amaabera na obuya; tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera, na obwegenwa.

English: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
Kiswahili: Nigeukie na unihurumie; mpe mtumishi wako nguvu zako, mwokoe mwana wa mtumishi wako wa kike.
Ekegusii: Ing’iranerie na ondorere amaabera, ong’e inche omosomba oo chinguru chiao, intoorie inche omwana bw’omosomba oo omokungu.

English: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
Kiswahili: Nipe ishara ya wema wako, ili adui zangu waione nao waaibishwe, kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umenisaidia na kunifariji.
Ekegusii: Inyorokie ekemanyererio ki’obuya bwao, erinde abanto bangechete bakerore na gosookigwa, ekiagera aye Omonene gwankonyire na kondemia.

English: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Wimbo. Ameuweka msingi wake katika mlima mtakatifu;
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Omochie oria obegetwe oboroso n’Omonene nigo oteneine igoro ase ebitunwa ebichenu.

English: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Kiswahili: Bwana anayapenda malango ya Sayuni kuliko makao yote ya Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo anchete ebiita bia Sayoni kobua aande onsi ase abanto ba Yakobo bamenyete.

English: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
Kiswahili: Mambo matukufu yanasemwa juu yako, ee mji wa Mungu:
Ekegusii: Aye omochie o Nyasae, amang’ana ’obonene nigo agokwanwa igoro yao.

English: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
Kiswahili: “Nitaweka kumbukumbu ya Rahabu na Babeli miongoni mwa wale wanaonikubali mimi: Ufilisti pia na Tiro, pamoja na Kushi, nami nitasema, ‘Huyu alizaliwa Sayuni.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ase abanto abwo bamanyete inche ninyatore Rahabu, na Abaababeli, na Abafirisiti, na Abaturo, amo nabaanto b’Ethiopia, na goteeba, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”

English: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Sayuni itasemwa hivi, “Huyu na yule walizaliwa humo, naye Aliye Juu Sana mwenyewe atamwimarisha.”
Ekegusii: Igoro ya Sayoni amang’ana aya nakwanwe. “Omonto oyo na oria nao baiboreretwe ime yaye,” n’Omonene ore Igoro Mono nere orabe okoyokong’ia.

English: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataandika katika orodha ya mataifa: “Huyu alizaliwa Sayuni.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arakore omobaro bw’abaanto, nigo ararike, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”

English: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
Kiswahili: Watakapokuwa wanapiga vinanda wataimba, “Chemchemi zangu zote ziko kwako.”
Ekegusii: Ekero bagotera na bagotenga nigo bagoteeba, “Chinsoko chiaito chionsi nigo chire ime yao.”

English: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
Kiswahili: Wimbo. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa mahalathi leanothi. Utenzi wa Hemani Mwezrahi. Ee Bwana, Mungu uniokoaye, nimelia mbele zako usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora; okworokereria kwa Hamani Omoezara) Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’ogotooreka kwane, omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera asore ng’a onkonye.

English: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
Kiswahili: Maombi yangu yafike mbele zako, utegee kilio changu sikio lako.
Ekegusii: Ogosaba kwane tiga goike ase obosio bwao, tegerera oigwe okorera kwane.

English: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nafsi yangu imejaa taabu, na maisha yangu yanakaribia kaburi.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oichire nemechando, na obogima bwane bwaikire ang’e kogenda aase abakuure.

English: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
Kiswahili: Nimehesabiwa miongoni mwa wale waendao shimoni, niko kama mtu asiye na nguvu.
Ekegusii: Inche nabareranigwe amo nabwo bakogenda ase embeera, chinguru chiang’ereire.

English: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
Kiswahili: Nimetengwa pamoja na wafu, kama waliochinjwa walalao kaburini, ambao huwakumbuki tena, ambao wamekatiliwa mbali na uangalizi wako.
Ekegusii: Natigirwe inde buna oyomo bw’abakuure buna abwo baitetwe, bono bare ase chimbeera ime. Nabeire buna abwo aye otainyoreti nonya ng’ake, kwabaatananire korwa ase okoboko kwao.

English: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
Kiswahili: Umenitupa katika shimo lenye kina kirefu sana, katika vina vya giza nene.
Ekegusii: Kwambekire inse kegima ase embeera ime; agwo aase are omosunte na aatambe gochia inse.

English: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu yako imekuwa nzito juu yangu, umenigharikisha kwa mawimbi yako yote.
Ekegusii: Egesusuro kiao nigo kere ekerito igoro yane, kwambagoreire emerindo yao yonsi yantubire kegima.

English: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
Kiswahili: Umenitenga na rafiki zangu wa karibu na kunifanya chukizo kwao. Nimezuiliwa, wala siwezi kutoroka;
Ekegusii: Kwabekire aare abagisangio baane twamanyaine, gwankorire nabeire okogechia ase bare; nasiekereirwe, tinkonyara gosoka.

English: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
Kiswahili: nuru ya macho yangu imefifia kwa ajili ya huzuni. Ee Bwana, ninakuita kila siku, ninakunyooshea wewe mikono yangu.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane amwamire ase okweumia; Aye Omonene, kera rituko nigo ngokorangeria, ndamborete amaboko aane gocha asore.

English: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
Kiswahili: Je, wewe huwaonyesha wafu maajabu yako? Je, wale waliokufa huinuka na kukusifu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abakuure nkobakorera ore amakumia? Inee! Abwo nkoimoka bare na kogotogia?

English: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
Kiswahili: Je, upendo wako hutangazwa kaburini, uaminifu wako katika Uharibifu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Obwanchani bwao ngokwanwa bore ime ase chimbeera, gose obwegenwa bwao agwo aase aasareku?

English: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
Kiswahili: Je, maajabu yako hujulikana mahali pa giza, au matendo yako ya haki katika nchi ya usahaulifu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ao ay’ogokumia namanyire agwo ase omosunte ime? Gose oboronge bwao mbomanyire agwo ase ense y’okwebwa?

English: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninakulilia wewe, Ee Bwana, unisaidie; asubuhi maombi yangu huja mbele zako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore, onkonye, nonya nemambia ogosaba kwane nigo kogoika asore.

English: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kwa nini unanikataa na kunificha uso wako?
Ekegusii: Omonene, nase ki gwatugutire omoyo one? Nase ki kwabisire obosio bwao korwa ase ’nde?

English: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
Kiswahili: Tangu ujana wangu nimeteseka, nikakaribia kifo; nimepatwa na hofu zako, nami nimekata tamaa.
Ekegusii: Korwa obwana bwane nabeire inde nemechando, nabeire ang’e nogokwa, ndemereretie okogosa kwao, tindi nogokonywa konde nonya nogoke.

English: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu yako imepita juu yangu; hofu zako zimeniangamiza.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu yao entindi yantubire kegima, amaakwa ao ansiririe.

English: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
Kiswahili: Mchana kutwa zinanizunguka kama mafuriko; zimenimeza kabisa.
Ekegusii: Nigo ang’etanaine buna amaache omobaso boira; abwatanire amo, na amigire inche.

English: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
Kiswahili: Umeniondolea marafiki na wapendwa wangu; giza limekuwa ndilo rafiki yangu wa karibu kuliko wote.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatananire omwanchwa one na omosani one bambeereire aare, na omosunte obeire omogisangio one.

English: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa Ethani Mwezrahi. Nitaimba juu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana milele; kwa kinywa changu nitajulisha uaminifu wako ujulikane kwa vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kw’Etani Omoezara) Aye Omonene, goika kare na kare ninterere obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, nindarie obwegenwa bwao ase ebiaare bionsi.

English: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
Kiswahili: Nitatangaza kuwa upendo wako unasimama imara milele na uaminifu wako umeuthibitisha mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ninkwane ng’a obwanchani bwao mbogendererete botambe bwakorirwe kobao goika kare na kare; aaria igoro nigo okong’etie obwegenwa bwao.

English: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
Kiswahili: Ulisema, “Nimefanya agano na mteule wangu, nimemwapia mtumishi wangu Daudi,
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwateebete, “Nakorire okobwatana nomochore one, narire eira y’ogotiana ase Daudi omosomba one.

English: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
Kiswahili: ‘Nitaimarisha uzao wako milele na kudumisha ufalme wako kwa vizazi vyote.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ninkore oroiboro rwao rogenderere koba ne chinguru botambe, nintenenie ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kebe ase ebiaare bionsi.”

English: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, mbingu zinayasifu maajabu yako, uaminifu wako pia katika kusanyiko la watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igoro nchitogie emeremo yao y’ogokumia, naende obwegenwa bwao boigo ase omosangererekano bw’abachenu bao.

English: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ni nani katika mbingu anayeweza kulinganishwa na Bwana? Ni nani miongoni mwa viumbe vya mbinguni aliye kama Bwana?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore agwo igoro oranyare koreng’anigwa n’Omonene? Nkereki ase ebitongwa bia Nyasae kenga buna ere?

English: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
Kiswahili: Katika kusanyiko la watakatifu, Mungu huogopwa sana, anahofiwa kuliko wote wanaomzunguka.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo are Nyasae oirokire ase ekegambero ki’abachenu, bonsi abamoetanaine nigo bamoirogete.

English: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ni nani aliye kama wewe? Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwenye nguvu, na uaminifu wako unakuzunguka.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ning’o obwate okobua buna okwao? Ee, Omonene, obwegenwa bwao nigo bogoetanaine.

English: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
Kiswahili: Wewe unatawala bahari yenye msukosuko; wakati mawimbi yake yanapoinuka, wewe unayatuliza.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okogambera enyancha ekoimokerera igoro; ekero emerindo yaye ekoimokerera igoro, aye nigo okoyotoereria.

English: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
Kiswahili: Wewe ulimponda Rahabu kama mmojawapo wa waliochinjwa; kwa mkono wako wenye nguvu, uliwatawanya adui zako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasenyentete enchoka eria Rahabu ekaba buna egetondo, nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru ogasiarera ababisa bao.

English: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
Kiswahili: Mbingu ni zako, nayo nchi pia ni yako, uliuwekea ulimwengu msingi pamoja na vyote vilivyomo.
Ekegusii: Igoro neyao, na ense neyao, ense na ebinto bionsi bireo naye kwabitongete.

English: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
Kiswahili: Uliumba kaskazini na kusini; Tabori na Hermoni wanaliimbia jina lako kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Naye gwatongete sugusu na Irianyi; egetunwa gia Tabori, na ekia Herimoni, nigo bigotogia erieta riao nomogooko.

English: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
Kiswahili: Mkono wako umejaa uwezo; mkono wako una nguvu, mkono wako wa kuume umetukuzwa.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kwao nigo kore nokobua, ee, nigo kore ne chinguru; okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo koimokererete igoro.

English: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
Kiswahili: Haki na hukumu ndio msingi wa kiti chako cha enzi; upendo na uaminifu vinakutangulia.
Ekegusii: Oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’okogamba kwao, obwanchani bwa kare na kare, na obwegenwa, nigo bitang’aine bosio bwao.

English: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Heri ni wale ambao wamejifunza kukusifu kwa shangwe, wanaotembea katika mwanga wa uwepo wako, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Mbarenomogooko abanto abwo bamanyete goaka eriogi ri’omogooko asore, abwo bagotaara ase oborabu bokorwa ase obosio bwao aye Omonene.

English: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
Kiswahili: Wanashangilia katika jina lako mchana kutwa, wanafurahi katika haki yako.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagochengera erieta riao omobaso boira; na goetera ase oboronge bwao nigo bakoimokererigwa igoro.

English: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wewe ni utukufu na nguvu yao, kwa wema wako unatukuza pembe yetu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore obonene bwabo ne chinguru chiabo; ase engencho y’ogwancherwa kwao ching’unchara chiaito chiakinire.

English: For our shield belongs to Yahweh, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Naam, ngao yetu ni mali ya Bwana, na mfalme wetu mali ya Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Oyore enguba yaito n’oyore Omonene, ee, omorwoti oito noyo bw’Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
Kiswahili: Ulizungumza wakati fulani katika maono, kwa watu wako waaminifu, ukasema: “Nimeweka nguvu kwa shujaa, nimemwinua kijana miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Kare ngwakwanete nabegenwa bao ase okorora, okabateebia, “Narentire ogokonywa goetera ase oyomo ore nokobua, naimokereirie igoro oyomo nachorire korwa ase egati y’abanto.

English: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
Kiswahili: Nimemwona Daudi, mtumishi wangu, na nimemtia mafuta yangu matakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nanyorire Daudi, omosomba one, namoakire amaguta aane amaachenu ase okomwatanana ase ’nde.

English: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
Kiswahili: Kitanga changu kitamtegemeza, hakika mkono wangu utamtia nguvu.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kwane nkobe amo nere botambe, ee, okoboko kwane nkomobeke chinguru.

English: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
Kiswahili: Hakuna adui atakayemtoza ushuru, hakuna mtu mwovu atakayemwonea.
Ekegusii: Ababisa tibakomobwata mobosokano, na abakori amabe tibakomochanda.

English: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
Kiswahili: Nitawaponda adui zake mbele zake na kuwaangamiza watesi wake.
Ekegusii: Ninsenyente ababisa baye ase obosio bwaye, abwo bamogechete nimbae amaakwa.

English: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
Kiswahili: Upendo wangu mkamilifu utakuwa pamoja naye, kwa Jina langu pembe yake itatukuzwa.
Ekegusii: Obwegenwa na obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe mbibe amo nere; ase erieta riane orogunchara rwaye ndokine.

English: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
Kiswahili: Nitauweka mkono wake juu ya bahari, mkono wake wa kuume juu ya mito.
Ekegusii: Nimbeke enyancha inse y’okoboko kwaye, ne chindooche nchibe inse y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.

English: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
Kiswahili: Naye ataniita kwa sauti, ‘Wewe ni Baba yangu, Mungu wangu, Mwamba na Mwokozi wangu.’
Ekegusii: Ere nabe okorera ase ’nde na goteeba; Aye naye Tata, naye Nyasae one, na Egetare kiane ki’ogotooreka.

English: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
Kiswahili: Nitamteua pia awe mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza, aliyetukuka kuliko wafalme wote wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Erio inche nimokore abe omwana one omotangi, abe omorwoti ore omonene kobua abarwoti bande bonsi b’ense.

English: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
Kiswahili: Nitadumisha upendo wangu kwake milele, na agano langu naye litakuwa imara.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bwane botari koera nimoborendere kare na kare, na okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nkorete nere ngotenene bokong’u.

English: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
Kiswahili: Nitaudumisha uzao wake milele, kiti chake cha enzi kama mbingu zinavyodumu.
Ekegusii: Ninkore oroiboro rwaye rogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao buna igoro erabe ereo.

English: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
Kiswahili: “Kama wanae wataacha amri yangu na wasifuate sheria zangu,
Ekegusii: “Onye abanto b’ororeria rwaye bagochia gotiga amachiiko aane, bange koigwera emeroberio yane echiikire,

English: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
Kiswahili: kama wakihalifu maagizo yangu na kutoshika amri zangu,
Ekegusii: na onye bagochia gosaria aya nachiikire. Bange kobwata amachiiko aane,

English: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
Kiswahili: nitaadhibu dhambi yao kwa fimbo, uovu wao kwa kuwapiga,
Ekegusii: rirorio nimbae egesusuro, mbaake nenyimbo ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo, na mbang’wanie ebiranya ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.

English: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
Kiswahili: lakini sitauondoa upendo wangu kwake, wala sitausaliti uaminifu wangu kamwe.
Ekegusii: Korende obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe tinkoborusia asare, tingotiga koba omwegenwa asare.

English: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
Kiswahili: Mimi sitavunja agano langu wala sitabadili lile ambalo midomo yangu imelitamka.
Ekegusii: Tinkonyara gosaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, gose tinkoonchora ring’ana nakwanire nomonwa one.

English: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
Kiswahili: Mara moja na kwa milele, nimeapa kwa utakatifu wangu, nami sitamdanganya Daudi:
Ekegusii: “Ase obochenu bwane natianire rimo ng’a tingokwana oborimo ase Daudi.

English: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
Kiswahili: kwamba uzao wake utaendelea milele, na kiti chake cha enzi kitadumu mbele zangu kama jua;
Ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ndogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao, buna erioba rirabe rireo ase obosio bwane.

English: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
Kiswahili: kitaimarishwa milele kama mwezi, shahidi mwaminifu angani.”
Ekegusii: Nkegenderere kobao buna omotienyi, oborori obwo bwa igoro nigo bore obwegenwa.”

English: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe umemkataa, umemdharau, umemkasirikia sana mpakwa mafuta wako.
Ekegusii: Korende bono, aye Omonene kwangire omoakwa amaguta oo, kwabeire nendamwamu enene asare.

English: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
Kiswahili: Umelikana agano lako na mtumishi wako, na umeinajisi taji yake mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Bono gwatigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete nomosomba oo, kwarutire egutwa yaye y’obogambi inse kwayemwamirie.

English: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
Kiswahili: Umebomoa kuta zake zote, na ngome zake zote umezifanya kuwa magofu.
Ekegusii: Gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye chionsi gwatagoire amaagacho aye onsi are amakong’u abeire amatombe.

English: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
Kiswahili: Wote wapitao karibu wamemnyangʼanya mali zake; amekuwa dharau kwa jirani zake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagoetera aase agwo nigo bakomosakora, abamenyete ang’e nere nigo bakomochecheria.

English: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
Kiswahili: Umeutukuza mkono wa kuume wa adui zake, umewafanya watesi wake wote washangilie.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakomochanda aye kwabaeire chinguru chinyinge, na kwagerire ababisa baye bonsi bagoke.

English: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
Kiswahili: Umegeuza makali ya upanga wake, na hukumpa msaada katika vita.
Ekegusii: Kwairanirie omoro oye bw’esegi, tori komoa chinguru chi’okorwana esegi.

English: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
Kiswahili: Umeikomesha fahari yake, na kukiangusha kiti chake cha enzi.
Ekegusii: Kwamourire obonene bwaye, gwaakeire inse ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi.

English: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
Kiswahili: Umezifupisha siku za ujana wake, umemfunika kwa vazi la aibu.
Ekegusii: Kwanachire amatuko aye ay’obosae abeire ameng’e, boigo kwamotubire nobosooku obonge mono.

English: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
Kiswahili: Hata lini, Ee Bwana? Utajificha milele? Ghadhabu yako itawaka kama moto hata lini?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere kwebisete? Inee! Ngoika ririri endamwamu yao eragenderere gwoka buna omorero?

English: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
Kiswahili: Kumbuka jinsi maisha yangu yanavyopita haraka. Ni kwa ubatili kiasi gani umemuumba mwanadamu!
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna obogima bwane bore obweng’e, nigo gwatongete Mwanyabaanto bonsi bakwe igo.

English: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
Kiswahili: Ni mtu gani awezaye kuishi na asione kifo, au kujiokoa mwenyewe kutoka nguvu za kaburi?
Ekegusii: Monto ki orabe moyo otakwe? Ning’o oranyare gotooria omoyo oye korwa ase chinguru chi’amakweri?

English: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uko wapi upendo wako mkuu wa mwanzoni, ambao katika uaminifu wako ulimwapia Daudi?
Ekegusii: Omonene, ng’ai obwanchani bwao bwa kare na kare bore, obwo ase obwegenwa bwao kwarierete Daudi eira?

English: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
Kiswahili: Bwana kumbuka jinsi mtumishi wako amesimangwa, jinsi ninavyovumilia moyoni mwangu dhihaka za mataifa yote,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’inyore inche omosomba oo buna ingokorerwa echeche; nigo ndemereretie emerumi y’abanto abange.

English: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
Kiswahili: dhihaka ambazo kwazo adui zako wamenisimanga, Ee Bwana, ambazo kwazo wamesimanga kila hatua ya mpakwa mafuta wako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, ababisa bao nigo bagonchecheria, ee, nigo bagochecheria amabarato ’omoakwa amaguta oo.

English: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana milele!
Ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe kare na kare! Amina. Amina.

English: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
Kiswahili: Maombi ya Mose, mtu wa Mungu. Bwana, wewe umekuwa makao yetu katika vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: (Ogosaba kwa Musa, omonto o Nyasae) Omonene, aye nigo ore obotamero bwaito ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kuzaliwa milima au hujaumba dunia na ulimwengu, wewe ni Mungu tangu milele hata milele.
Ekegusii: Ritang’ani ebigoro bitarabao, gose konya otaratonga ense, korwa kare na kare aye naye Nyasae.

English: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
Kiswahili: Huwarudisha watu mavumbini, ukisema, “Rudini mavumbini, enyi wanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okoonchorana abanto bairana, baba amaroba naende, gwateba, “Inwe Mwanyabaanto, irana!”

English: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwako miaka elfu ni kama siku moja iliyokwisha pita, au kama kesha la usiku.
Ekegusii: Asore aye, emiaka elifu eyemo nigo ere buna rituko ria igoro koriaetire, buna engaki enke y’okorenda botuko.

English: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
Kiswahili: Unawatowesha wanadamu katika usingizi wa kifo, nao ni kama majani machanga ya asubuhi:
Ekegusii: Nigo ogokorobanania Mwanyabaanto buna eooro, baeta bwango buna chindoto. Barabwo nigo bare buna obonyansi bokomera mambia;

English: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
Kiswahili: ingawa asubuhi yanachipua, ifikapo jioni huwa yamenyauka na kukauka.
Ekegusii: mambia nigo bogokina bwasicha, mogoroba bwanachwa bwoma.

English: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
Kiswahili: Tumeangamizwa kwa hasira yako na tumetishwa kwa ghadhabu yako.
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo togosirigwa nendamwamu yao, twaondokigwa nekeririanda kiao.

English: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
Kiswahili: Umeyaweka maovu yetu mbele yako, dhambi zetu za siri katika nuru ya uwepo wako.
Ekegusii: Amabe aya twakorire nigo oyabegete ase obosio bwao, na ebibe biaito bia bobisi nigo bire maiso marore asore.

English: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
Kiswahili: Tumeishi siku zetu zote chini ya ghadhabu yako, tunamaliza miaka yetu kwa kuomboleza.
Ekegusii: Obogima bwaito bwonsi nigo bokoera bwango inse y’ekeririanda kiao, nigo togokoora emiaka yaito buna ogoita egekoe

English: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
Kiswahili: Siku zetu za kuishi ni miaka sabini, au miaka themanini ikiwa tuna nguvu, lakini yote ni ya shida na taabu, nazo zapita haraka, nasi twatoweka.
Ekegusii: Emiaka y’obogima bwaito nemerongo etano na ebere; onye tore ne chinguru, eba emerongo etano na etato; na obogima obo nigo boichire nobokong’u na emechando, nigo bogoeta bwango, na intwe tweiruruka twasira.

English: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
Kiswahili: Ni nani ajuaye nguvu za hasira yako? Kwa maana ghadhabu yako ni kubwa kama hofu tunayopaswa kuwa nayo kwako.
Ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete okobua kw’endamwamu yao, na ogw’ekeririanda kiao, erinde akoiroke?

English: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
Kiswahili: Tufundishe kuzihesabu siku zetu vizuri, ili tujipatie moyo wa hekima.
Ekegusii: Tworokererie, tomanye obweng’e bw’obogima bwaito, erinde chinkoro chiaito chibe nobong’aini.

English: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uwe na huruma! Utakawia hata lini? Wahurumie watumishi wako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, irana ase tore! Ngoika ririri orabe kogoteebana? Otororere intwe, abasomba bao, amaabera!

English: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
Kiswahili: Tushibishe asubuhi kwa upendo wako usiokoma, ili tuweze kuimba kwa shangwe na kufurahi siku zetu zote.
Ekegusii: Kobogokia mambia, otoisanekie nobwanchani bwao botari koera, erinde tochenge na kogoka amatuko aito onsi.

English: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
Kiswahili: Utufurahishe kulingana na siku ulizotuadhibu, kulingana na miaka tuliyotaabika.
Ekegusii: Otogokie amatuko ang’ana buna ayio twachandegete, na emiaka eng’ana buna eria twanyorete amabe.

English: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
Kiswahili: Matendo yako na yaonekane kwa watumishi wako, utukufu wako kwa watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Tworokie intwe, abasomba bao, ogokora kwao, na abana baito oborokie obonene bwao.

English: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
Kiswahili: Wema wa Bwana Mungu wetu uwe juu yetu; uzithibitishe kazi za mikono yetu: naam, uzithibitishe kazi za mikono yetu.
Ekegusii: Obosiani bw’Omonene, Nyasae oito, bobe igoro yaito, na emeremo y’amaboko aito oyesesenie ase tore, ee, osesenie emeremo y’amaboko aito!

English: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
Kiswahili: Yeye akaaye mahali pa salama pake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, atadumu katika uvuli wake Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Ere oyomenyete inse y’oborendi bw’Oyore Igoro Mono, na otimogete ase ekiriri ki’oyore Omobui,

English: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
Kiswahili: Nitasema kumhusu Bwana, “Yeye ndiye kimbilio langu na ngome yangu, Mungu wangu, ambaye ninamtumaini.”
Ekegusii: oyio nigo aranyare goteeba, “Omonene nere obotamero bwane, na orwaki rwane, nere Nyasae one oyo nsemeretie.”

English: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
Kiswahili: Hakika yeye ataniokoa na mtego wa mwindaji, na maradhi ya kuambukiza ya kuua.
Ekegusii: Ere nagotoorie korwa ase omoeto bw’omotegi, na korwa ase amarwaire amabe agoita.

English: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
Kiswahili: Atakufunika kwa manyoya yake, chini ya mbawa zake utapata kimbilio, uaminifu wake utakuwa ngao na kinga yako.
Ekegusii: Ere nagotube namarionya aye, ase chimbaaba chiaye ime nonyore obotamero. Obwegenwa bwaye nenguba na eng’aya asore.

English: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
Kiswahili: Hutaogopa vitisho vya usiku, wala mshale urukao mchana,
Ekegusii: Tokwoboa okogoswa ekero kia botuko, gose omogwe okorutwa mobaso,

English: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
Kiswahili: wala maradhi ya kuambukiza yanayonyemelea gizani, wala tauni iharibuyo adhuhuri.
Ekegusii: nonya namarwaire amabe agoeta ase omosunte, gose amabe ande onsi agoita mobaso.

English: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
Kiswahili: Ijapo watu elfu wataangukia kando yako, kumi elfu mkono wako wa kuume, lakini haitakukaribia wewe.
Ekegusii: Abanto elifu eyemo nabaisa kogwa ase rikere riao, gose chilifu ikomi ase ensemo yao ya borio, korende ayio tagokonyora aye.

English: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Utatazama tu kwa macho yako na kuona adhabu ya waovu.
Ekegusii: Norigererie namaiso ao, orore buna abakori amabe bakoegwa egesusuro.

English: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
Kiswahili: Kama ukimfanya Aliye Juu Sana kuwa makao yako: naam, Bwana ambaye ni kimbilio langu,
Ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabekire Omonene obeire egekengano kiao, na Oyore Igoro Mono obotamero bwao,

English: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
Kiswahili: basi hakuna madhara yatakayokupata wewe, hakuna maafa yataikaribia hema yako.
Ekegusii: amabe ande onsi tagokonyora, na amaakwa ande onsi tagocha ase enka yao.

English: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa atawaagiza malaika zake kwa ajili yako, wakulinde katika njia zako zote.
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende ase chinchera chiao chionsi.

English: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
Kiswahili: Mikononi mwao watakuinua, ili usijikwae mguu wako kwenye jiwe.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.

English: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
Kiswahili: Utawakanyaga simba na nyoka wakali, simba mkubwa na nyoka utawaponda kwa miguu.
Ekegusii: Notache chindo na amarubi, notiringe chindo chinsae ne chinchoka.

English: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
Kiswahili: Bwana asema, “Kwa kuwa ananipenda, nitamwokoa; nitamlinda, kwa kuwa analikiri Jina langu.
Ekegusii: Naki oyo obwatanire nainche ase obwanchani nimotoorie, nimorende, ekiagera namanyete erieta riane.

English: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
Kiswahili: Ataniita, nami nitamjibu; nitakuwa pamoja naye katika taabu, nitamwokoa na kumheshimu.
Ekegusii: Ekero arandangerie, inche nimoitabere, inche nigo inde amo nere ase engaki y’emechando. Nimotoorie, naende nimoe ogosika.

English: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
Kiswahili: Kwa siku nyingi nitamshibisha na kumwonyesha wokovu wangu.”
Ekegusii: Nimoisanekie nobogima obotambe na komwoorokia ogotooreka kwane.

English: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
Kiswahili: Zaburi. Wimbo wa siku ya Sabato. Ni vyema kumshukuru Bwana na kuliimbia jina lako, Ee Uliye Juu Sana,
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gw’Esabato) Nigo ere buya gokoakera aye Omonene Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, na goteera ase ogotogia erieta riao, aye Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono.

English: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
Kiswahili: kuutangaza upendo wako asubuhi, na uaminifu wako wakati wa usiku,
Ekegusii: Kera emambia nigo ere buya koraria obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na kera obotuko koraria obwegenwa bwao,

English: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
Kiswahili: kwa zeze yenye nyuzi kumi na kwa sauti ya kinubi.
Ekegusii: ase okobugia obokano bore ne chinga ikomi, na amakano ande are namariogi amaya.

English: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kwa kuwa matendo yako yamenifurahisha, nitaziimba kwa shangwe kazi za mikono yako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ogokora kwao nigo kongogetie; ninchenge ase engencho y’emeremo y’amaboko ao.

English: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, tazama jinsi yalivyo makuu matendo yako, tazama jinsi yalivyo ya kina mawazo yako!
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, emeremo yao nigo ere emenene mono, na ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebia ime mono.
