English: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
Kiswahili: Mjinga hafahamu, mpumbavu haelewi,
Ekegusii: Omonto omoriri takonyara kobimanya, na oyo otari nobong’aini takonyara komanya amang’ana buna ayio.

English: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
Kiswahili: ingawa waovu huchipua kama majani na wote watendao mabaya wanastawi, wataangamizwa milele.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe nabaisa koreereta buna obonyansi, na abakori ebibe bonsi babe bagosicha buya, korende omoerio obo nogosirigwa goika kare na kare.

English: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
Kiswahili: Bali wewe, Ee Bwana, utatukuzwa milele.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omonene mono kare na kare.

English: For behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, hakika adui zako, hakika adui zako wataangamia. Wote watendao mabaya watatawanyika.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Naama! Ababisa bao mbasirigwe; na abakori ebibe bonsi mbasiarerwe gochia aande onsi.

English: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
Kiswahili: Umeitukuza pembe yangu kama ile ya nyati dume, mafuta mazuri yamemiminwa juu yangu.
Ekegusii: Gwakinirie orogunchara rwane rwabeire buna orw’eng’era, kwang’umoreire amaguta amayia.

English: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yamewaona adui zangu wakishindwa, masikio yangu yamesikia maangamizi ya adui zangu waovu.
Ekegusii: Narorire namaiso aane ababisa baane bakobugwa, naigure namato aane igoro y’abakori amabe abanyimokerete.

English: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
Kiswahili: Wenye haki watastawi kama mtende, watakuwa kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni,
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge naseboke buna omokendo, nakine buna omocharake o Lebanoni.

English: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
Kiswahili: waliopandwa katika nyumba ya Bwana, watastawi katika nyua za Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Abwo basimekire ase enyomba y’Omonene, nigo baragenderere koreereta ase chigoora chia Nyasae oito.

English: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
Kiswahili: Wakati wa uzee watakuwa bado wanazaa matunda, watakuwa wabichi tena wamejaa nguvu,
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakogenderera goseboka nonya bagotire, nigo baragenderere kobesea.

English: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
Kiswahili: wakitangaza, “Bwana ni mkamilifu; yeye ni Mwamba wangu, na ndani yake hamna uovu.”
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo akworokia ng’a Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere nere egetare kiane, na obokorekanu tibori ime yaye.

English: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
Kiswahili: Bwana anatawala, amejivika utukufu; Bwana amejivika utukufu tena amejivika nguvu. Dunia imewekwa imara, haitaondoshwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba, nigo eboetie obonene. Omonene nigo asiberanetie chinguru. Ase ayio ense nigo eteneine bokong’u tekonyegerigwa.

English: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
Kiswahili: Kiti chako cha enzi kimekuwa thabiti tangu zamani; wewe umekuwako tangu milele.
Ekegusii: Ekerogo kiao ki’obonene nigo kiabekire aroro korwa kare, ekiagera aye nao kwarenge korwa kare.

English: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Kiswahili: Bahari zimeinua, Ee Bwana, bahari zimeinua sauti zake; bahari zimeinua sauti za mawimbi yake.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, amaache aimokereire igoro, amaache nkoeera are neriogi, ee, aimokereirie emerindo yaye igoro.

English: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni mkuu kuliko ngurumo ya maji makuu, ni mkuu kuliko mawimbi ya bahari: Bwana aishiye juu sana ni mkuu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere obwate okobua okonene aria igoro; okobua kwaye nigo kobuete okoruma kw’amaache, ee, okw’amaache amange na okw’emerindo y’enyancha.

English: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, sheria zako ni imara; utakatifu umepamba nyumba yako pasipo mwisho.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oborori bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u. Obochenu nabwo bore ogochaberwa kw’enyomba yao goika kare na kare.

English: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ulipizaye kisasi, Ee Mungu ulipizaye kisasi, uangaze sasa.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene ogoakana egesiomba, aye Nyasae ogoakana egesiomba, oorokia oborabu bwao.

English: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
Kiswahili: Ee Mhukumu wa dunia, inuka, uwalipize wenye kiburi kama wanavyostahili.
Ekegusii: Aye omonachi ebiina bw’ense, imoka oe abanto abaenenu eng’eria koreng’ana buna ogokora kwabo kore!

English: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
Kiswahili: Hata lini, waovu, Ee Bwana, hata lini waovu watashangilia?
Ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri abanyabibe baragenderere gwetogia? Ngoika ririri?

English: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
Kiswahili: Wanamimina maneno ya kiburi, watenda mabaya wote wamejaa majivuno.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe bonsi nigo bagwetogia, nigo bagokwana‐kwana amang’ana amabe.

English: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wanawaponda watu wako, wanawaonea urithi wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abwo nigo bagosamunyorana abanto bao, na gochanda abanto bare omwando oo.

English: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
Kiswahili: Wanamchinja mjane na mgeni, na kuwaua yatima.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoita ababoraka na abamenyi, ne chintakana nigo bagochiita;

English: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
Kiswahili: Nao husema, “Bwana haoni, Mungu wa Yakobo hafahamu.”
Ekegusii: erio bateba, “Omonene tari korora amang’ana ayio, Nyasae o Yakobo tari komanya ayio.”

English: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
Kiswahili: Sikizeni, enyi wajinga miongoni mwa watu; enyi wapumbavu, lini mtakuwa na hekima?
Ekegusii: Inwe abamotamanyeti gento, kabe nokomanya! Inwe abariri, ndiriri morabe abang’aini?

English: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
Kiswahili: Je, aliyeweka sikio asisikie? Aliyeumba jicho asione?
Ekegusii: Inee! Oyo otongete amato, tari koigwa? Ere oyo otongete amaiso, tari korora?

English: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
Kiswahili: Je, anayeadhibisha mataifa asiadhibu? Je, awafundishaye wanadamu asiwe na maarifa?
Ekegusii: Oyo okorongeyia ebisaku, tari korua ebisusuro? Ere nigo akworokereria Mwanyabaanto bamanye obong’aini.

English: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
Kiswahili: Bwana anajua mawazo ya mwanadamu; anajua kwamba ni ubatili.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo amanyete ebirengererio bia Mwanyabaanto, ng’a nigo bire bosa.

English: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, heri mtu anayeadhibishwa na wewe, mtu unayemfundisha kwa sheria yako,
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio aye Omonene okorongeyia na komworokereria amachiiko ao,

English: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
Kiswahili: unampa utulivu siku za shida, mpaka shimo litakapokuwa limechimbwa kwa ajili ya mwovu.
Ekegusii: naende kwamoa ogotimoka ase amatuko ’emechando, goika ekero abakori amabe baraaremerwe chimbeera chiabo.

English: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana hatawakataa watu wake, hatauacha urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene tagotuguta abanto baye, takonyara gotiga abwo bare omwado oye.

English: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
Kiswahili: Hukumu itasimamishwa tena kwenye haki, wote walio na mioyo minyofu wataifuata.
Ekegusii: Ebiina mbinachwe ase oboronge naende, na abanto bonsi bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbabobwatie.

English: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
Kiswahili: Ni nani atakayeinuka dhidi ya mwovu kwa ajili yangu? Ni nani atakayenikinga dhidi ya watenda maovu?
Ekegusii: Ning’o oratenene andwanerie abakori amabe? Ning’o oratenene ankonye korwa ase abakori ebibe?

English: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
Kiswahili: Kama Bwana asingelinisaidia upesi, ningelikuwa ninaishi katika ukimya wa kifo.
Ekegusii: Onye Omonene atankonyete, omoyo one nigo orenge gocha kobeera ase obokiriru bw’amakweri bwango.

English: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
Kiswahili: Niliposema, “Mguu wangu unateleza,” Ee Bwana, upendo wako ulinishikilia.
Ekegusii: Ekero naroche ng’a natererigwe, aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bwansiirete tinagwa.

English: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
Kiswahili: Wakati wasiwasi ulipokuwa mwingi ndani yangu, faraja yako ilinipa furaha nafsini mwangu.
Ekegusii: Ekero enkoro yane ere nogwechanda okonge, okoremia kwao okonge nigo gokogokia omoyo one.

English: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
Kiswahili: Je, kiti cha utawala wa udhalimu kitajiunga nawe, ule utawala uletao taabu kutokana na sheria zake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abanto b’ekegambero egekorekanu mbabwatane naye? Abwo nigo bakorenta obokong’u ase okoonchorana amachiiko.

English: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
Kiswahili: Huungana kuwashambulia wenye haki, kuwahukumu kufa wasio na hatia.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakoumokera amo omoyo bw’oyore omonyaboronge, banachera oyotari nokomocha ekiina ki’ogokwa.

English: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana amekuwa ngome yangu, na Mungu wangu amekuwa mwamba ninaoukimbilia.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene obeire egekengero kiane egekong’u, ee, Nyasae one negetare ngotamera.

English: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.
Kiswahili: Yeye atawalipa kwa ajili ya dhambi zao na atawaangamiza kwa ajili ya maovu yao; Bwana Mungu wetu atawaangamiza.
Ekegusii: Ere nabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, na abasirie ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo; ee, Omonene, Nyasae oito, nabasirie kegima.

English: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
Kiswahili: Njooni, tumwimbie Bwana kwa furaha; tumfanyie kelele za shangwe Mwamba wa wokovu wetu.
Ekegusii: Inchuo, tomoterere Omonene Nyasae nomogooko, inchwo, tomochengere oyore egetare ki’ogotooreka gwaito!

English: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
Kiswahili: Tuje mbele zake kwa shukrani, tumtukuze kwa vinanda na nyimbo.
Ekegusii: Inchuo, togende ase obosio bwaye ase okomoakera ng’a mbuya mono, tomochengere namatera ay’ogotogia!

English: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni Mungu mkuu, mfalme mkuu juu ya miungu yote.
Ekegusii: Naki Omonene nere Nyasae ore omonene, nere Omorwoti omonene obuete chinyasae chionsi.

English: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
Kiswahili: Mkononi mwake mna vilindi vya dunia, na vilele vya milima ni mali yake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abwatete amakura ’ense ase okoboko kwaye, naboigo nebitunwa ebitambe bire ebiaye.

English: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
Kiswahili: Bahari ni yake, kwani ndiye aliifanya, na mikono yake iliumba nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: Enyancha neyaye, ekiagera nere oyetongete, okoboko kwaye nakwo kwabombete ense enyomo.

English: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,
Kiswahili: Njooni, tusujudu, tumwabudu, tupige magoti mbele za Bwana Muumba wetu,
Ekegusii: Inchuo, twekumbe ase obosio bw’Omonene, totung’ame asare, ekiagera nere ototongete.

English: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
Kiswahili: kwa maana yeye ndiye Mungu wetu, na sisi ni watu wa malisho yake, kondoo chini ya utunzaji wake. Kama mkiisikia sauti yake leo,
Ekegusii: Ere nere Nyasae oito, na intwe nigo tore abanto b’oborisia bwaye, nigo tore ching’ondi chire ase oborendi bwaye. Naki yare koba buya onye rituko ria reero mwategerera eriogi riaye!

English: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
Kiswahili: msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu kama mlivyofanya kule Meriba, kama mlivyofanya siku ile kule Masa jangwani,
Ekegusii: Timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino, buna abakoro bakorete aaria Meriba; na buna bakorete ase rituko riria aaria Masa agwo ase erooro.

English: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
Kiswahili: ambapo baba zenu walinijaribu na kunipima, ingawa walikuwa wameyaona matendo yangu.
Ekegusii: Aaria chisokoro chiaino nigo chianteemete, nonya chiaroche emeremo yane nigo chiandengete.

English: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka arobaini nilikasirikia kizazi kile, nikasema, “Hawa ni taifa ambalo mioyo yao imepotoka, nao hawajazijua njia zangu.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nigo nagechetigwe nekiaare keria, ngateba, “Abanto aba nabasareku ase chinkoro chiabo ime, tibaraareti chinchera chiane.”

English: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo nikatangaza kwa kiapo katika hasira yangu, “Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ngatiana ase endamwamu yane ng’a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane.

English: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya; mwimbieni Bwana dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia, aye ense yonsi, moterere Omonene!

English: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana, lisifuni jina lake; tangazeni wokovu wake siku baada ya siku.
Ekegusii: Moterere Omonene, motogie erieta riaye, mobe mokoraria ogotooreka kwaye rituko ase rituko.

English: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
Kiswahili: Tangazeni utukufu wake katikati ya mataifa, matendo yake ya ajabu miongoni mwa mataifa yote.
Ekegusii: Raria obonene bwaye ase egati y’ebisaku, na ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ase abanto bonsi!

English: For Yahweh is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mkuu mwenye kustahili kusifiwa kuliko wote; yeye ni wa kuogopwa kuliko miungu yote.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe, goika airokwe goetania chinyasae chinde.

English: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana miungu yote ya mataifa ni sanamu, lakini Bwana aliziumba mbingu.
Ekegusii: Chinyasae chionsi chi’abaanto b’ebisaku nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa rioka, korende Omonene nere otongete igoro chionsi.

English: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Fahari na enzi viko mbele yake; nguvu na utukufu vimo patakatifu pake.
Ekegusii: Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na oboseera nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu.

English: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
Kiswahili: Mpeni Bwana, enyi jamaa za mataifa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abe chiamate chi’abaanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye.

English: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
Kiswahili: Mpeni Bwana utukufu unaostahili jina lake; leteni sadaka na mje katika nyua zake.
Ekegusii: Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye, moche ase chigoora chiaye, morentane ebiegwa.

English: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
Kiswahili: Mwabuduni Bwana katika uzuri wa utakatifu wake; dunia yote na itetemeke mbele zake.
Ekegusii: Mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu! Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye.

English: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
Kiswahili: Katikati ya mataifa semeni, “Bwana anatawala.” Ulimwengu ameuweka imara, hauwezi kusogezwa; atawahukumu watu kwa uadilifu.
Ekegusii: Teebia abanto bonsi b’ebisaku, “Omonene nere okogamba. Ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa. Omonene nanachere abanto ekiina atari gwanchereria.”

English: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
Kiswahili: Mbingu na zishangilie, nchi na ifurahi; bahari na ivume, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake;
Ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogooko, tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo na bionsi ebire ime yaye!

English: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
Kiswahili: mashamba na yashangilie, pamoja na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake. Kisha miti yote ya msituni itaimba kwa furaha;
Ekegusii: Emegondo echenge amo n’ebinto bionsi bire ime yabo! Erio emete yonsi ye rinani netere nomogooko,

English: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
Kiswahili: itaimba mbele za Bwana kwa maana anakuja, anakuja kuihukumu dunia. Ataihukumu dunia kwa haki, na mataifa katika kweli yake.
Ekegusii: ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ngocha are, ee, ngocha are konachera ense ekiina. Nigo aranachere ense ekiina ase oboronge, na anachere abanto ekiina ase obwegenwa.

English: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
Kiswahili: Bwana anatawala, nchi na ifurahi, visiwa vyote vishangilie.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere omorwoti. Aye ense, goka! Na inwe ebisinka ebinge, chenga!

English: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
Kiswahili: Mawingu na giza nene vinamzunguka, haki na hukumu ndio msingi wa kiti chake cha enzi.
Ekegusii: Amare na omosunte ekerima nigo bimoetanaine; oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.

English: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
Kiswahili: Moto hutangulia mbele zake na huteketeza adui zake pande zote.
Ekegusii: Omorero nigo otang’aine bosio bwaye, oro nigo ogosamba ababisa baye abwo bamoetanaine.

English: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
Kiswahili: Umeme wake wa radi humulika dunia, nchi huona na kutetemeka.
Ekegusii: Okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo gokomoreka ense eye; ense nigo ekorora okomesa okwo yatengechigwa.

English: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
Kiswahili: Milima huyeyuka kama nta mbele za Bwana, mbele za Bwana wa dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Ebitunwa nigo bikonyititoka buna obochoe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ee, ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’ense yonsi.

English: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
Kiswahili: Mbingu zinatangaza haki yake, na mataifa yote huona utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: Igoro chionsi nigo chikoraria oboronge bwaye, na abanto bonsi barora obonene bwaye.

English: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
Kiswahili: Wote waabuduo sanamu waaibishwa, wale wajisifiao sanamu: mwabuduni yeye, enyi miungu yote!
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagosasiima emegwekano nigo bagosookigwa, ee, abwo bagwetogeria emegwekano y’ogosasimwa ere bosa; inwe chinyasae chionsi, tung’ama ase obosio bwaye.

English: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Sayuni husikia na kushangilia, vijiji vya Yuda vinafurahi kwa sababu ya hukumu zako, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Sayoni nigo bakoigwa ayio bagoka, na ab’emechie ya Yuda bachenga, ekiagera aye Nyasae kwanachire ebiina.

English: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, ndiwe Uliye Juu Sana kuliko dunia yote; umetukuka sana juu ya miungu yote.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ore omonene goetania ense yonsi, aye kwaimokererigwe igoro kobua chinyasae chionsi.

English: You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaompenda Bwana na wauchukie uovu, kwa maana yeye hulinda maisha ya waaminifu wake na kuwaokoa kutoka mkononi mwa mwovu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamwanchete Omonene, gecha obobe! Ere nigo akorenda emioyo y’abachenu baye; nigo akobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.

English: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
Kiswahili: Nuru huangaza wenye haki na furaha kwa watu wanyofu wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Oborabu nigo bokomocheera oyore omooronge, na omogooko obachera abare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
Kiswahili: Furahini katika Bwana, ninyi mlio wenye haki, lisifuni jina lake takatifu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamore abaronge, goka ase Nyasae, moake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.

English: A Psalm. Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
Kiswahili: Zaburi. Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, kwa maana ametenda mambo ya ajabu; kitanga chake cha kuume na mkono wake mtakatifu umemfanyia wokovu.
Ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia, ekiagera okorire amang’ana ay’ogokumia; obuire nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio, ee, nokoboko kwaye ogochenu.

English: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
Kiswahili: Bwana ameufanya wokovu wake ujulikane na amedhihirisha haki yake kwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogotooreka kwaye komanyekane, oorokirie oboronge bwaye ase amasio ’abaanto b’ebisaku;

English: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Kiswahili: Ameukumbuka upendo wake na uaminifu wake kwa nyumba ya Israeli; miisho yote ya dunia imeuona wokovu wa Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: oinyoire obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwaye, obwo aorogetie ase Abaisraeli. Chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense chiarorire ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.

English: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
Kiswahili: Mpigieni Bwana kelele za shangwe, dunia yote, ipaze sauti kwa nyimbo za shangwe na vinanda;
Ekegusii: Aye ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Omonene, tera ogoteera kw’omogooko na motogie ase amariogi amanene.

English: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
Kiswahili: mwimbieni Bwana kwa kinubi, kwa kinubi na sauti za kuimba,
Ekegusii: Terera Omonene ase okobugia amakano, ee, ase okobugia amakano tera namariogi amaya.

English: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: kwa tarumbeta na mvumo wa baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume: shangilieni kwa furaha mbele za Bwana, aliye Mfalme.
Ekegusii: Moake amariogi ’omogooko ase Omonene ore omorwoti ase okobugia ebirombeta na ebitureeri.

English: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
Kiswahili: Bahari na ivume na kila kiliomo ndani yake, dunia na wote wakaao ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Tiga enyancha ebe ekoruma amo n’ebinto bionsi bire ime yaye, boigo nense na abanto bonsi bamenyeteo.

English: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
Kiswahili: Mito na ipige makofi, milima na iimbe pamoja kwa furaha,
Ekegusii: Chindooche tiga chiake chinkobi, na ebitunwa tiga bitere nomogooko amo,

English: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
Kiswahili: vyote na viimbe mbele za Bwana, kwa maana yuaja kuhukumu dunia. Atahukumu dunia kwa haki na mataifa kwa haki.
Ekegusii: ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ngocha are konachera ense ekiina. Ere nanachere ense ekiina ase oboronge, na abanto nabanachere ekiina atari gwanchereria.

English: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
Kiswahili: Bwana anatawala, mataifa na yatetemeke; anakalia kiti cha enzi katikati ya makerubi, dunia na itikisike.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba! Ase ayio, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakoiguswa. Omonene nigo amenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na ense nigo egotengechigwa.

English: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mkuu katika Sayuni; ametukuzwa juu ya mataifa yote.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene ase Sayoni, oimokererigwe igoro kobua abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

English: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
Kiswahili: Wanalisifu jina lako ambalo ni kuu na la kuogopwa: yeye ni mtakatifu!
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi tiga batogie erieta riaye rinene na eri’okoirokia. Ere nigo are omochenu.

English: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
Kiswahili: Mfalme ni mwenye nguvu na hupenda haki, wewe umethibitisha adili; katika Yakobo umefanya yaliyo haki na sawa.
Ekegusii: Aye omorwoti ore nokobua, nigo bwanchete ekeene, aye gwakorire oboronge botenene bokong’u, nigo okonacha ebiina bi’ekeene na oboronge ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo.

English: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
Kiswahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana Mungu wetu, na mkaabudu katika mahali pa kuwekea miguu yake; yeye ni mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro, mosasime agwo ase egeteni kiaye ki’amagoro! Ere nigo are omochenu.

English: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on Yahweh, and he answered them.
Kiswahili: Mose na Aroni walikuwa miongoni mwa makuhani wake, Samweli alikuwa miongoni mwa walioliitia jina lake; walimwita Bwana, naye aliwajibu.
Ekegusii: Musa na Aroni nigo barenge abamo b’abakuani b’Omonene, boigo Samweli nigo arenge oyomo bw’abaanto barenge korangeria erieta riaye. Abanto abwo nigo barangeretie Omonene ng’a abakoonye, nere akabaigwa.

English: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
Kiswahili: Alizungumza nao kutoka nguzo ya wingu; walizishika sheria zake na amri alizowapa.
Ekegusii: Nigo akwanete nabarabwo, ore ime ase riire. Abanto abwo nigo babwatete oborori bwaye, na amachiiko abaete.

English: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wetu, ndiwe uliyewajibu, kwa Israeli ulikuwa Mungu mwenye kusamehe, ingawa uliadhibu matendo yao mabaya.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo kwaigwete abanto baria, nigo kwarenge Nyasae, kwarenge kobaabera, nonya naboigo nigo kwarenge kobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe.

English: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
Kiswahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana Mungu wetu, mwabuduni kwenye mlima wake mtakatifu, kwa maana Bwana Mungu wetu ni mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro! Inchuo mosasimere ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo are omochenu.

English: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya shukrani. Mpigieni Bwana kelele za shangwe, dunia yote.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kw’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono) Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, moterere Omonene more nomochengo!

English: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
Kiswahili: Mwabuduni Bwana kwa furaha; njooni mbele zake kwa nyimbo za shangwe.
Ekegusii: Mokorere Omonene more nomogooko, moche ase obosio bwaye na komoterera amatera ’omochengo!

English: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Kiswahili: Jueni kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu. Yeye ndiye alituumba, sisi tu mali yake; sisi tu watu wake, kondoo wa malisho yake.
Ekegusii: Manya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae. Nere ototongete, na intwe nabaye tore; nigo tore abanto baye, ne ching’ondi chie riicho riaye.

English: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
Kiswahili: Ingieni malangoni mwake kwa shukrani na katika nyua zake kwa kusifu, mshukuruni yeye na kulisifu jina lake.
Ekegusii: Soa ase ebiita biaye na komoakera ng’a mbuya mono, soa ase chigoora chiaye na komotogia! Moakere ng’a mbuya mono, motogie erieta riaye!

English: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana ni mwema na upendo wake wadumu milele; uaminifu wake unadumu kwa vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: Naki Omonene nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nobwa kare na kare, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitaimba juu ya upendo wako na haki yako; kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, nitaimba sifa.
Ekegusii: (Ogosaba gwa Daudi) Nintere igoro y’amaabera ao na oboronge bwao; ningoterere aye Omonene.

English: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
Kiswahili: Nitazingatia kuishi maisha yasiyo na lawama: utakuja kwangu lini? Nitatembea nyumbani mwangu kwa moyo usio na lawama.
Ekegusii: Nigo nganetie na korenda enchera y’oboronge. Inee! Ndiriri orache ase ’nde? Nigo nganetie imbe norogendo ororonge ase enyomba yane imenyete.

English: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
Kiswahili: Sitaweka mbele ya macho yangu kitu kiovu. Ninayachukia matendo ya watu wasio na imani; hawatashikamana nami.
Ekegusii: Tinkobeeka ase obosio bwane ing’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe; nigo ngechete ogokora kw’abaanto bagotiga obwegenwa, tinkonyara kobwatwa ne chingencho chiabo.

English: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa ukaidi utakuwa mbali nami; nitajitenga na kila ubaya.
Ekegusii: Nimbeere aare korwa ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chi’obokorekanu, ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe ribe aare nainche.

English: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
Kiswahili: Kila amsingiziaye jirani yake kwa siri, huyo nitamnyamazisha; mwenye macho ya dharau na moyo wa kiburi huyo sitamvumilia.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie omonto okona‐gokwana bobe omonto onde bobisi, tinkoremereria omonto omoenenu na omweanchi.

English: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yatawaelekea waaminifu katika nchi, ili waweze kuishi pamoja nami; yeye ambaye moyo wake hauna lawama atanitumikia.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane narigereretie abegenwa bare ase ense, abwo mbamenye amo nainche. Omonto okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge, oyio nabe ogonkorera.

English: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
Kiswahili: Mdanganyifu hatakaa nyumbani mwangu, yeye asemaye kwa uongo hatasimama mbele yangu.
Ekegusii: Omonto okwenaria obong’ainereria takomenya ase enyomba yane, oyo ogoteeba oborimo takobeera ase obosio bwane.

English: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.
Kiswahili: Kila asubuhi nitawanyamazisha waovu wote katika nchi; nitamkatilia mbali kila mtenda mabaya kutoka mji wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Kera emambia nimbe ngosiria abakori amabe bonsi abare ase ense, nindusie abakori ebibe bonsi korwa ase omochie O’ Omonene.

English: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before Yahweh. Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
Kiswahili: Maombi ya mtu aliyechoka. Anapoteseka na kumimina malalamiko yake kwa Bwana. Ee Bwana, usikie maombi yangu, kilio changu cha kuomba msaada kikufikie.
Ekegusii: (Omonto ochandegete okorera ase Omonene) Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane; ekerero kiane tiga geike asore.

English: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
Kiswahili: Usinifiche uso wako ninapokuwa katika shida. Unitegee sikio lako, ninapoita, unijibu kwa upesi.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kobisa obosio bwao korwa ase ’nde ase engaki inde nemechando, integerere onyigwe, ong’iranerie bwango ase rituko ngokorangeria.

English: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa siku zangu zinatoweka kama moshi, mifupa yangu inaungua kama kaa la moto.
Ekegusii: Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango na gosira buna erioki, amauga ’omobere one nigo akoyia buna omorero bw’amakara.

English: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu umefifia na kunyauka kama jani, ninasahau kula chakula changu.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane yaakirwe yabeire buna obonyansi bwagekirwe na kwoma; nigo nkweba koria endagera yane,

English: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya kusononeka kwangu kwa uchungu, nimebakia ngozi na mifupa.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo ngendererete korera na kweumia, amauga ’omobere one abwatanire ne chinyama chi’omobere one.

English: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa kama bundi wa jangwani, kama bundi kwenye magofu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo inga buna etigere ere ase erooro, gose buna enyakweumia etigarete komenya aase amatuuri.

English: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
Kiswahili: Nilalapo sipati usingizi, nimekuwa kama ndege mpweke kwenye paa la nyumba.
Ekegusii: Tindi korara chitoro; nigo inga buna enyoni etigarete yoka kerama igoro.

English: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
Kiswahili: Mchana kutwa adui zangu hunidhihaki, wale wanaonizunguka hutumia jina langu kama laana.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bagonchecheria omobaso boira; abwo bangechete, kobakoragereria nigo bagwatora erieta riane.

English: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
Kiswahili: Ninakula majivu kama chakula changu na nimechanganya kinywaji changu na machozi
Ekegusii: Nigo nkoria ribu buna nkoria endagera, na ekenyugwa kiane nigo ngokeburukania namariga,

English: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ya ghadhabu yako kuu, kwa maana umeniinua na kunitupa kando.
Ekegusii: ekiagera kwabeire nekeririanda na endamwamu ase ’nde. Aye kwambwatire na gwantugutire gochia aare.

English: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
Kiswahili: Siku zangu ni kama kivuli cha jioni, ninanyauka kama jani.
Ekegusii: Amatuko aane nigo agoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba; nasusanire buna obonyansi.

English: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, umeketi katika kiti chako cha enzi milele, sifa zako za ukuu zaendelea vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore omogambi goika kare na kare; erieta riao nigo rigendererete ase ebiaare bionsi.

English: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
Kiswahili: Utainuka na kuihurumia Sayuni, kwa maana ni wakati wa kumwonyesha wema; wakati uliokubalika umewadia.
Ekegusii: Aye noimokerere igoro ororere Sayoni amaabera; ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okoywancha; ee, engaki eria yachigetwe yaikire.

English: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mawe yake ni ya thamani kwa watumishi wako, vumbi lake lenyewe hulionea huruma.
Ekegusii: Abasomba bao nigo banchete amagena aye, na nigo bare namabeebe ase orotu rwaye.

English: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
Kiswahili: Mataifa wataogopa jina la Bwana, wafalme wote wa dunia watauheshimu utukufu wako.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi mbiiroke erieta ri’Omonene, na abarwoti bonsi b’ense mbairoke obonene bwaye.

English: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana ataijenga tena Sayuni na kutokea katika utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene naagache Sayoni naende, nere orarorekane aroro ore ase obonene bwaye.

English: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
Kiswahili: Ataitikia maombi ya mtu mkiwa, wala hatadharau hoja yao.
Ekegusii: Nabe okoigwa ogosaba kw’abaanto batigirwe bosa, tagochaaya ogosorora kwabo.

English: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah,
Kiswahili: Hili na liandikwe kwa ajili ya kizazi kijacho, ili taifa litakaloumbwa baadaye waweze kumsifu Bwana:
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio tiga arikwe agachwe ase engencho y’ekiaare kegochi‐gocha, erinde abanto abwo bataraiborwa, nabarabwo bache gotogia Omonene.

English: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth,
Kiswahili: “Bwana alitazama chini kutoka patakatifu pake palipo juu, kutoka mbinguni alitazama dunia,
Ekegusii: Korwa aaria igoro aase aye aachenu Omonene nigo arigereretie gocha aa, ee, nigo arigereretie gocha ase ense,

English: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,
Kiswahili: kusikiliza vilio vya uchungu vya wafungwa na kuwaweka huru wale waliohukumiwa kufa.”
Ekegusii: erinde aigwe okweumia kw’abasibwa, na gosibora abwo konya banacheirwe ekiina ki’ogokwa.

English: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo jina la Bwana latangazwa huko Sayuni na sifa zake katika Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: Erio abanto banyare koraria erieta ri’Omonene ase Sayoni, na ogotogigwa kwaye agwo Yerusalemu,

English: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.
Kiswahili: wakati mataifa na falme zitakapokusanyika ili kumwabudu Bwana.
Ekegusii: ekero ekio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbasangererekane amo namarwoti ase ogosasiima Omonene.

English: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
Kiswahili: Katika kuishi kwangu alivunja nguvu zangu, akafupisha siku zangu.
Ekegusii: Ere okeeirie chinguru chiane konde ase orogendo, bweng’eirie amatuko aane.

English: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
Kiswahili: Ndipo niliposema: “Ee Mungu wangu, usinichukue katikati ya siku zangu; miaka yako inaendelea vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngoteeba, Aye Nyasae one, takondusia aiga ekero inde ase egati‐gati y’obogima bwane. Omonene, aye nigo oreo kare na kare, ase ebiaare bionsi.

English: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
Kiswahili: Hapo mwanzo uliweka misingi ya dunia, nazo mbingu ni kazi ya mikono yako.
Ekegusii: Agwo kare nigo kwabegete oboroso bw’ense, na igoro chionsi nigo chire emeremo y’amaboko ao.

English: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
Kiswahili: Hizi zitatoweka, lakini wewe utadumu, zote zitachakaa kama vazi. Utazibadilisha kama nguo nazo zitaondoshwa.
Ekegusii: Echio chionsi nchisirigwe, korende aye nigo oreo kare na kare, echio chionsi nchigote buna eanga, ekiagera aye nigo ogochionchoreria buna eanga ekoonchorerigwa, ee, nigo chirasirigwe kegima.

English: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, U yeye yule, nayo miaka yako haikomi kamwe.
Ekegusii: Korende aye naye oria oria, na emiaka yao tekoba nomoerio.

English: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
Kiswahili: Watoto wa watumishi wako wataishi mbele zako; wazao wao wataimarishwa mbele zako.”
Ekegusii: Abana b’abasomba bao mbamenye ase oborendi obuya, ne chinderia chiabo chigenderere komenya ase obosio bwao.

English: By David. Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana. Vyote vilivyomo ndani yangu vilihimidi jina lake takatifu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, na bionsi ebire ime yane bitogie erieta riaye richenu.

English: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Kiswahili: Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana, wala usisahau wema wake wote,
Ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, tobaisa kweba obuya bwaye bwonsi agokoreire.

English: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
Kiswahili: akusamehe dhambi zako zote, akuponya magonjwa yako yote,
Ekegusii: Nere ogokwabera ebibe biao bionsi, na kogwenia amarwaire ao onsi.

English: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
Kiswahili: aukomboa uhai wako na kaburi, akuvika taji ya upendo na huruma,
Ekegusii: Nigo akobooria obogima bwao korwa ase embeera na gokobekera egutwa y’obwanchani bogendererete botambe amo namaabera.

English: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
Kiswahili: atosheleza mahitaji yako kwa vitu vyema, ili ujana wako uhuishwe kama wa tai.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agoisanekia okogania kwao namaya, erinde otigara koba omosae buna ekeongo kegwekerora.

English: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
Kiswahili: Bwana hutenda haki, naye huwapa hukumu ya haki wote wanaoonewa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere okorua oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bonsi bagokorerwa bobe.

English: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Alijulisha Mose njia zake, na wana wa Israeli matendo yake.
Ekegusii: Nere omanyekanetie chinchera chiaye ase Musa, naboigo nogokora kwaye ase Abaisraeli.

English: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwingi wa huruma na mwenye neema; si mwepesi wa hasira, bali amejaa upendo.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene amaabera na obuya, tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo are nobwanchani botari koera.

English: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
Kiswahili: Yeye hatalaumu siku zote, wala haweki hasira yake milele,
Ekegusii: Ere tari kona‐gotogonyera ase chingaki chionsi, gose takogenderera kogaacha endamwamu yaye botambe.

English: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
Kiswahili: yeye hatutendei kulingana na dhambi zetu wala hatupatilizi kwa kadiri ya maovu yetu.
Ekegusii: Omonene tari gotokorera aya togwenerete ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, gose tari gotoa egesusuro koreng’ana nobobe bwaito.

English: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mbingu zilivyo juu ya dunia sana, ndivyo wema wake ulivyo mwingi kwa wanaomcha;
Ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna igoro ere aare mono korwa ase ense, naboigo obwanchani bwaye bore obonene ase abanto bamoirogete.

English: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
Kiswahili: kama mashariki ilivyo mbali na magharibi, ndivyo Mungu alivyoziweka dhambi zetu mbali nasi.
Ekegusii: Naende koreng’ana buna moocha ere aare mono korwa bosongo, naboigo Omonene akorusia ebibe biaito korwa ase tore biabeera aare.

English: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
Kiswahili: Kama baba alivyo na huruma kwa watoto wake, ndivyo Bwana anavyowahurumia wale wanaomcha;
Ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna ise abana akoba namaabera ase bare, naboigo n’Omonene akoba namaabera ase abwo bamoirogete.

English: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa anajua tulivyoumbwa, anakumbuka kwamba sisi tu mavumbi.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo amanyete buna totongire, nigo akoinyora ng’a nigo tore orotu bosa.

English: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu mwanadamu, siku zake ni kama majani, anachanua kama ua la shambani;
Ekegusii: Amatuko ’omonto nigo anga buna obonyansi, omonto nigo akoba buna egesicha gekoreereta ase omogondo;

English: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
Kiswahili: upepo huvuma juu yake nalo hutoweka, mahali pake hapalikumbuki tena.
Ekegusii: ekero omwaga ogocha, okerusiao giasira kegima, aase aye tari komanya ng’a nkiarengeo.

English: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
Kiswahili: Lakini kutoka milele hata milele upendo wa Bwana uko kwa wale wamchao, nayo haki yake kwa watoto wa watoto wao:
Ekegusii: Korwa kare goika kare na kare obwanchani bw’ Omonene nigo bore ase abwo bamoirogete, na oboronge bwaye nigo borabe ase chinderia chiabo

English: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
Kiswahili: kwa wale walishikao agano lake na kukumbuka kuyatii mausia yake.
Ekegusii: ase abwo bakobwata okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, naende bakoinyora amachiiko aye na koyaigwera.

English: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
Kiswahili: Bwana ameweka imara kiti chake cha enzi mbinguni, ufalme wake unatawala juu ya vyote.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo abegete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene aaria igoro, na oborwoti bwaye nigo bokogambera onsi.

English: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
Kiswahili: Mhimidini Bwana, enyi malaika zake, ninyi mlio mashujaa mnaozitii amri zake, ninyi mnaotii neno lake.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamalaika b’Omonene, motogie; inwe abamore ne chinguru chinene na mogokora aya agochika ekero mwaigure eriogi rie ring’ana riaye.

English: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
Kiswahili: Mhimidini Bwana, ninyi jeshi lake lote la mbinguni, ninyi watumishi wake mnaofanya mapenzi yake.
Ekegusii: Togia Omonene, inwe emeganda yaye yonsi, na inwe abasomba baye, aba mogokora ogwancha kwaye!

English: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
Kiswahili: Mhimidini Bwana, kazi zake zote kila mahali katika milki yake. Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Togia Omonene, inwe ebitongwa biaye bionsi, motogie aande onsi ase akogamba. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!

English: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
Kiswahili: Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana. Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, wewe ni mkuu sana, umejivika utukufu na enzi.
Ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene! Omonene, Nyasae one, aye nigo ore omonene mono; nigo bweboetie ogosikwa na obonene.

English: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
Kiswahili: Amejifunika katika nuru kama vile kwa vazi, amezitandaza mbingu kama hema
Ekegusii: Aye nigo bwetubete oborabu buna ogwetuba egetambaa gi’okwambara, kwaramboire igoro buna eema eramboire.

English: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
Kiswahili: na kuziweka nguzo za orofa yake juu ya maji. Huyafanya mawingu kuwa gari lake, na hupanda kwenye mbawa za upepo.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo bwarete emiaro y’obomenyo bwao ase amaache, gwakorire amare abeire egari yao, nigo ogoeta kore ase chimbaaba chi’embeo.

English: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
Kiswahili: Huzifanya pepo kuwa wajumbe wake, miali ya moto watumishi wake.
Ekegusii: Gwakorire abamalaika bao babeire chimbeo, na abasomba bao babeire ebibemberi bi’omorero.

English: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
Kiswahili: Ameiweka dunia kwenye misingi yake, haiwezi kamwe kuondoshwa.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo otenenetie ense bokong’u igoro ase amaroso aye, tebaisa konyegerigwa nonya ng’ake.

English: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
Kiswahili: Uliifunika kwa kilindi kama kwa vazi, maji yalisimama juu ya milima.
Ekegusii: Nigo kwayetubete chindiba buna eanga egotuba, amaache akabeera igoro ase ebitunwa.

English: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kukemea kwako maji yalikimbia, kwa sauti ya radi yako yakatoroka,
Ekegusii: Ekero gwatogonyerete amaache ayio, nigo atamete, na ekero aigwete eriogi riao ri’okogukura, nigo aayererete agatama.

English: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
Kiswahili: yakapanda milima, yakateremka mabondeni, hadi mahali pale ulipoyakusudia.
Ekegusii: Agatiira gochia ebitunwa igoro, na agatirimboka gochia ase amakura inse, agaika aase kwayachikerete.

English: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
Kiswahili: Uliyawekea mpaka ambao hayawezi kuuvuka, kamwe hayataifunika dunia tena.
Ekegusii: Nigo kwabegete chimbebe aase amaache atanyare goetania, erinde tabaisa gotuba ense yonsi naende.

English: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
Kiswahili: Huzifanya chemchemi zimwage maji mabondeni, hutiririka kati ya milima.
Ekegusii: Nigo ogotubokia chinsoko ase amagoko, amaache aba agoeta ase egati y’ebitunwa.

English: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
Kiswahili: Huwapa maji wanyama wote wa kondeni, punda-mwitu huzima kiu yao.
Ekegusii: Chinsoko echio nigo chikoa ching’iti chionsi amaache chianywa, ne chitigere chi’orosana nigo chikoyanywa, na erang’o yasira.

English: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
Kiswahili: Ndege wa angani hufanya viota kando ya maji, huimba katikati ya matawi.
Ekegusii: Chinyoni nigo chikomenya ang’e na chirochio, nigo chikoba chigotera ekero chigwete ase chinsagia chi’emete.

English: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
Kiswahili: Huinyeshea milima kutoka orofa zake, dunia inatoshelezwa kwa matunda ya kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro ase omenyete, nigo ogotweria ebitunwa embura, na ense nigo egoisaneka nokwama kw’emeremo yao.

English: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
Kiswahili: Huyafanya majani ya mifugo yaote, na mimea kwa watu kulima, wajipatie chakula kutoka ardhini:
Ekegusii: Nigo okomeria obonyansi ching’iti chikorisia, naende kwanyorera abanto ebimeri bagokorera, na igo kwabanyorera chindagera korwa ase riroba.

English: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
Kiswahili: divai ya kuufurahisha moyo wa mwanadamu, mafuta kwa ajili ya kungʼarisha uso wake, na mkate wa kutia mwili nguvu.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakonywa edivai na baba nomogooko; nigo bakweaka amaguta, bagirigenta amasio abo, naende baria endagera, erinde emebere yabo yanyora chinguru.

English: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,
Kiswahili: Miti ya Bwana inanyeshewa vizuri, mierezi ya Lebanoni aliyoipanda.
Ekegusii: Emete y’Omonene nigo egoisaneka namaache, ee, emecharake ya Lebanoni, eyi’Omonene asimegete.

English: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
Kiswahili: Humo ndege hufanya viota vyao, korongo ana nyumba yake kwenye msunobari.
Ekegusii: Chinyoni nigo chikoagacha ebiswa biabo ase emete eyio, amaagonga nigo akoagacha ebiswa biabo aroro ase emetarakwa.

English: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
Kiswahili: Milima mirefu ni makao ya mbuzi-mwitu, majabali ni kimbilio la pelele.
Ekegusii: Ebitunwa ebitambe nabio bire obomenyo bwe chimbori chi’orosana, emienya y’ebitare nero obotamero bw’ebisengi.

English: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
Kiswahili: Mwezi hugawanya majira, na jua hutambua wakati wake wa kutua.
Ekegusii: Aye kwabekire omotienyi obeire ekemanyererio gie chingaki, na erioba nigo rimanyete boronge ekero rigwenerete kogwa.

English: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
Kiswahili: Unaleta giza, kunakuwa usiku, wanyama wote wa mwituni huzurura.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okorenta omosunte bwaba botuko, erio ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana chiachaka gotaara.

English: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
Kiswahili: Simba hunguruma kwa mawindo yao, na kutafuta chakula chao kutoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nigo chikoronya ekero chigotwara, chiarigia endagera yabo korwa ase Nyasae.

English: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
Kiswahili: Jua huchomoza, nao huondoka, hurudi na kulala katika mapango yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero erioba rigochia kooroka chiairana, chiagenda korara ase amakuruma abo.

English: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
Kiswahili: Kisha mwanadamu huenda kazini mwake, katika kazi yake mpaka jioni.
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo bakogenda ase emeremo yabo, bayekora goika mogoroba.

English: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, jinsi matendo yako yalivyo mengi! Kwa hekima ulizifanya zote, dunia imejaa viumbe vyako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naki ogokora kwao kore okonene! Okwo gwonsi nigo okogokora nobong’aini, ense nigo eichire nebitongwa biao.

English: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
Kiswahili: Pale kuna bahari, kubwa na yenye nafasi tele, imejaa viumbe visivyo na idadi, vitu vyenye uhai vikubwa na vidogo.
Ekegusii: Enyancha nero enene naende engare; nigo eichire nebitongwa bire moyo bitari kobareka, ebike na ebinene.

English: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
Kiswahili: Huko meli huenda na kurudi, pia Lewiathani, uliyemuumba acheze ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Chimeeri nao chigoeta, na Leviatani, eng’iti eria enene y’okwoboyia gwatongete, ekonagoswenenao.

English: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote wanakutazamia wewe, uwape chakula chao kwa wakati wake.
Ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebio bionsi naye bisemeretie, erio oe kera ekemo endagera yaye ase engaki egwenerete.

English: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
Kiswahili: Wakati unapowapa, wanakikusanya, unapofumbua mkono wako, wao wanashibishwa mema.
Ekegusii: Ekero kwabieire endagera, nigo bikoyesangereria; ekero kwaramboire okoboko kwao, nigo bigoisaneka n’ebinto bire ebiya.

English: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
Kiswahili: Unapoficha uso wako, wanapata hofu, unapoondoa pumzi yao, wanakufa na kurudi mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Ekero kwabisire obosio bwao, nigo bikoba nobwoba obonene; na ekero okobiura omoika obo, nigo bigokwa, biairana ase amaroba ime.

English: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
Kiswahili: Unapopeleka Roho wako, wanaumbwa, nawe huufanya upya uso wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Ekero ogotoma omoika oo, nigo bigotongwa, naende gwakora ense yaba enyia.

English: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.
Kiswahili: Utukufu wa Bwana na udumu milele, Bwana na azifurahie kazi zake:
Ekegusii: Tiga obonene bw’Omonene bogenderere kobao kare na kare; Omonene tiga agokere emeremo yaye.

English: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
Kiswahili: yeye aitazamaye dunia, nayo ikatetemeka, aigusaye milima, nayo ikatoa moshi.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorigereria ense, nero yatengecha, nigo agokuna ebitunwa, na birobio biasokia erioki.

English: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
Kiswahili: Nitamwimbia Bwana maisha yangu yote; nitaimba sifa kwa Mungu wangu muda wote ninaoishi.
Ekegusii: Ninterere Omonene ase obogima bwane bwonsi, nimbe ngotera ase ogotogia Nyasae one ekero inde moyo.

English: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kutafakari kwangu na kumpendeze yeye, ninapofurahi katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tiga Omonene agokigwe nebirengererio ebio biane, ekiagera inche nigo ngogete asare.

English: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: Lakini wenye dhambi na watoweke katika dunia na waovu wasiwepo tena. Ee nafsi yangu, msifu Bwana. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanyabibe tiga basirigwe korwa ase ense, abakori amabe tibaabaisa kobao. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, Motogie Omonene!

English: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, liitieni jina lake, wajulisheni mataifa yale aliyoyatenda.
Ekegusii: Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, rangeria erieta riaye ase ogokonywa, teebia abanto b’ebisaku ogokora kwaye.

English: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni yeye, mwimbieni yeye sifa, waambieni matendo yake yote ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia, raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia!

English: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
Kiswahili: Lishangilieni jina lake takatifu, mioyo ya wale wamtafutao Bwana na ifurahi.
Ekegusii: Etogerie erieta riaye richenu, abanto bonsi abakorigia Omonene basasoke ase chinkoro chiabo.

English: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
Kiswahili: Mtafuteni Bwana na nguvu zake, utafuteni uso wake siku zote.
Ekegusii: Rigia Omonene amo ne chinguru chiaye, morigie obosio bwaye botambe.

English: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
Kiswahili: Kumbuka matendo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya, miujiza yake na hukumu alizozitamka,
Ekegusii: Inyora emeremo yo’gokumia eria akorire, ebikone biaye na ebiina biaye bi’ekeene arure

English: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
Kiswahili: enyi wazao wa Abrahamu mtumishi wake, enyi wana wa Yakobo, wateule wake.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Aburaamu, omosomba O’ Omonene, ee, inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abachore b’Omonene,

English: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye Bwana Mungu wetu, hukumu zake zimo duniani pote.
Ekegusii: Ere nere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebiina biaye nigo bire ase ense yonsi.

English: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
Kiswahili: Hulikumbuka agano lake milele, neno ambalo aliamuru, kwa vizazi elfu,
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo akoinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, boigo goika ebiare elifu eyemo nigo akoinyora ring’ana achigete,

English: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
Kiswahili: agano alilolifanya na Abrahamu, kiapo alichomwapia Isaki.
Ekegusii: na okobwatana koria gw’ogotianania akorete na Aburaamu, na eira yaye y’ogotianania amorierete Isaka.

English: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
Kiswahili: Alilithibitisha kwa Yakobo kuwa amri, kwa Israeli liwe agano la milele:
Ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo akagokong’ia gokaba ogochika ase Yakobo, ee, ase Israeli okobwatana gwa kare na kare,

English: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
Kiswahili: “Nitakupa wewe nchi ya Kanaani kuwa sehemu utakayoirithi.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Ninkoe ense ya Kaanani ebe egetari oraire kebe omwando oo.”

English: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wachache kwa idadi, wachache sana na wageni ndani yake,
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria nigo barenge abanto abake ase omobaro, bakabarwa ng’a tibaisaini gento; nigo barenge abaeti ase ense eyio.

English: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
Kiswahili: walitangatanga kutoka taifa moja hadi jingine, kutoka ufalme mmoja hadi mwingine.
Ekegusii: Bakaba bagoetanana korwa ase egesaku ekemo gochia ase ekende, na korwa ase oborwoti obomo gochia ase obonde.

English: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
Kiswahili: Hakuruhusu mtu yeyote awaonee; kwa ajili yao aliwakemea wafalme, akisema:
Ekegusii: Nyasae tatigete abanto bande baabachande; agatogonyera abarwoti ase engencho yabo,

English: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
Kiswahili: “Msiwaguse niliowatia mafuta; msiwadhuru manabii wangu.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Timobaisa gokuna abaakwa amaguta baane, gose timokorera ababani baane bobe.”

English: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
Kiswahili: Akaiita njaa juu ya nchi na kuharibu chakula chao chote,
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arentete enchara ase ense, na asiretie chindagera chiabo chionsi,

English: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
Kiswahili: naye akatuma mtu mbele yao, Yosefu, aliyeuzwa kama mtumwa.
Ekegusii: konya otomire omonto agwo ritang’ani, nere Yusufu konya oonigwe obeire omosomba.

English: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
Kiswahili: Walichubua miguu yake kwa minyororo, shingo yake ilifungwa kwa chuma,
Ekegusii: Nigo asibetwe chingatare chigasionora amagoro aye, naende akabeekerwa eteyo y’ekioma ase rigoti riaye,

English: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.
Kiswahili: hadi yale aliyotangulia kusema yalipotimia, hadi neno la Bwana lilipomthibitisha.
Ekegusii: goika ayabaanete agaikerana. Ase ayio ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaenekia ng’a Yusufu nomooronge.

English: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
Kiswahili: Mfalme alituma watu wakamfungua, mtawala wa watu alimwachia huru.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agatoma abanto bakamosibora, ee, oyorenge omogambi bw’abaanto akamosibora.

English: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
Kiswahili: Alimfanya mkuu wa nyumba yake, mtawala juu ya vyote alivyokuwa navyo,
Ekegusii: Akamobeka akaba Omonene bw’enyomba yaye, amo n’ebinto bionsi abwate,

English: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
Kiswahili: kuwaelekeza wakuu wa mfalme apendavyo na kuwafundisha wazee wake hekima.
Ekegusii: erinde abe ogotebereria abanene b’oborwoti boria buna anchete, na kworokereria abagaaka baye b’oborwoti chisemi.

English: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
Kiswahili: Kisha Israeli akaingia Misri, Yakobo akaishi kama mgeni katika nchi ya Hamu.
Ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagacha Misiri; Yakobo akaba omomenyi ase ense ya Hamu.

English: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
Kiswahili: Bwana aliwafanya watu wake kuzaana sana, akawafanya kuwa wengi sana kuliko adui zao,
Ekegusii: Omonene agasesenia abanto abwo bakabucha mono, naende bakaba ne chinguru chinyinge kobua abachandi babo.

English: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
Kiswahili: ndiye aliigeuza mioyo yao iwachukie watu wake, wakatenda hila dhidi ya watumishi wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora chinkoro chi’Abamisiri, erinde bakagecha abanto baye, erio bagakorera abasomba b’Omonene amabe ay’obong’ainereria.

English: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
Kiswahili: Akamtuma Mose mtumishi wake, pamoja na Aroni, aliyemchagua.
Ekegusii: Omonene agatoma Musa, omosomba oye, na Aroni, oyio konya achorire.

English: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
Kiswahili: Walifanya ishara zake za ajabu miongoni mwao, miujiza yake katika nchi ya Hamu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaorokia ebimanyererio ase egati y’abanto, bagakora ebikone agwo ase ense ya Hamu.

English: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
Kiswahili: Alituma giza na nchi ikajaa giza, kwani si walikuwa wameyaasi maneno yake?
Ekegusii: Omonene agatoma omosunte, na ense eria ekamwama ti. Barabwo tibangete koigwera amang’ana aye.

English: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
Kiswahili: Aligeuza maji yao kuwa damu, ikasababisha samaki wao kufa.
Ekegusii: Akaonchora amaache abo akaba amanyinga, na ayio akagera chinswe chiabo chigakwa.

English: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
Kiswahili: Nchi yao ilijaa vyura tele, ambao waliingia hadi kwenye vyumba vya kulala vya watawala wao.
Ekegusii: Ebioto bigacha bigaichora ase ense yabo nonya nase ebinyomba bi’okorara bi’abagaambi babo.

English: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
Kiswahili: Alisema, yakaja makundi ya mainzi, na viroboto katika nchi yao yote.
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana, ne chingi chinyinge mono chigaacha, ne chinsona boigo ase ense eria yonsi.

English: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
Kiswahili: Alibadilisha mvua yao ikawa mvua ya mawe, yenye umeme wa radi nchini yao yote,
Ekegusii: Akarenta amagena ’embura ribaga ri’embura, chinkoba chikamesa aande onsi ase ense eria.

English: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
Kiswahili: akaharibu mizabibu yao na miti ya tini, na akaangamiza miti ya nchi yao.
Ekegusii: Agasaria emesabibu na emeko yabo, emete y’ense eria ekabunwa.

English: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.
Kiswahili: Alisema, nzige wakaja, tunutu wasio na idadi,
Ekegusii: Agakwana, ne chingige chigaacha, chirochio chikabiara chikaba chinyinge,

English: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
Kiswahili: wakala kila jani katika nchi yao, wakala mazao ya ardhi yao.
Ekegusii: chikaria chigakoora ebimeri bi’ense eria, boigo chikaria okwama kwe riroba riabo.

English: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaua wazaliwa wote wa kwanza katika nchi yao, matunda ya kwanza ya ujana wao wote.
Ekegusii: Omonene agaita abana abatangi bonsi ase ense eria, ne ching’iti chintangi, ogotongora gwe chinguru chiabo chionsi.

English: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
Kiswahili: Akawatoa Israeli katika nchi wakiwa na fedha na dhahabu nyingi, wala hakuna hata mmoja kutoka kabila zao aliyejikwaa.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa aroro bare ne chifeta ne chitaabu, monto onde tarenge ase abanto baye oborire chinguru.

English: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
Kiswahili: Misri ilifurahi walipoondoka, kwa sababu hofu ya Israeli ilikuwa imewaangukia.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo babete nomogooko ekero Abaisraeli bang’anyete, ekiagera obwoba konya bwabagwereire ase engencho y’Abaisraeli.

English: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
Kiswahili: Alitandaza wingu kama kifuniko, na moto kuwamulikia usiku.
Ekegusii: Omonene akarambora riire rigatuba abanto baye, na omorero okaba okobamorekera botuko.

English: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
Kiswahili: Waliomba, naye akawaletea kware, akawashibisha kwa mkate wa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ekero baboretie eki bakoria, ere agatoma chinkware, boigo akabaigotia nendagera korwa igoro.

English: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
Kiswahili: Alipasua mwamba, maji yakabubujika, yakatiririka jangwani kama mto.
Ekegusii: Akabochora egetare, na amaache agasoka korwao, akaminyoka ase erooro buna orooche.

English: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana alikumbuka ahadi yake takatifu, aliyompa Abrahamu mtumishi wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene akainyora eira eria enchenu ariete, boigo akainyora Aburaamu, omosomba oye.

English: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
Kiswahili: Aliwatoa watu wake kwa furaha, wateule wake kwa kelele za shangwe,
Ekegusii: Ase igo akang’anyia abanto baye korwa ase ense eria bakaba bagochenga, abanto abwo baye achorete bakaba bagoteera nomogooko.

English: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
Kiswahili: akawapa nchi za mataifa, wakawa warithi wa mali wengine walikuwa wameitaabikia:
Ekegusii: Akabaa chinse chi’abaanto b’ebisaku chikaba echiabo, akabaa n’ebinto abanto abwo konya bechandeire.

English: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: alifanya haya ili wayashike mausia yake na kuzitii sheria zake. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete, erinde Abaisraeli baigwere emeroberio yaye echiikire, naende barende amachiiko aye. Motogie Omonene!

English: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kusimulia matendo makuu ya Bwana au kutangaza kikamilifu sifa zake?
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare goteeba ogokora okonene kw’Omonene, gose koraria obonene bwaye bwonsi?

English: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
Kiswahili: Heri wale wanaodumisha haki, ambao daima wanafanya yaliyo mema.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bagokora oboronge, abwo bagokora oboronge ase chingaki chionsi.

English: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, unikumbuke unapowatendea mema watu wako, uwe msaada wangu unapowaokoa,
Ekegusii: Omonene, ong’inyore ekero okororera abanto bao amaabera, onchichere, ontoorie!

English: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
Kiswahili: ili niweze kufurahia mafanikio ya wateule wako, niweze kushiriki katika furaha ya taifa lako, na kuungana na urithi wako katika kukusifu.
Ekegusii: Erio inyare korora ebisio abanto bao abachore baranyore, na inche inyare kogokera omogooko bw’abaanto bao, naende inyare gwetogia amo n’abanto bare omwando oo.

English: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
Kiswahili: Tumetenda dhambi, kama vile baba zetu walivyotenda, tumekosa na tumetenda uovu.
Ekegusii: Intwe twakorire ebibe buna chisokoro chiaito chiakorete; twakorire ayare amabe mono, ee, twakorire ayare amabe.

English: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: Wakati baba zetu walipokuwa Misri, hawakuzingatia maajabu yako, wala hawakukumbuka wingi wa fadhili zako, bali waliasi kando ya bahari, Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: Ekero chisokoro chiaito chiarenge Misiri, tichiarengereretie igoro y’emeremo yao y’ogokumia; tichiainyorete obwanchani bwao obonge bogendererete botambe, korende chigasaria asore aaria ase Enyancha Embariri.

English: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo aliwaokoa kwa ajili ya jina lake, ili apate kudhihirisha uweza wake mkuu.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Omonene akabatooria ase engencho y’erieta riaye, ng’a anyare komanyekania okobua kwaye okonene.

English: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
Kiswahili: Alikemea Bahari ya Shamu, nayo ikakauka, akawaongoza katika vilindi vyake kama vile jangwani.
Ekegusii: Nigo atogonyerete Enyancha eria Embariri egakamoka, erio agaetia Abaisraeli aroro buna nase ense enyomo.

English: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
Kiswahili: Aliwaokoa mikononi mwa adui; kutoka mikononi mwa adui aliwakomboa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akabatooria korwa ase amaboko ay’abaabagechete na kobabooria korwa ase chinguru chi’ababisa babo.

English: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
Kiswahili: Maji yaliwafunika adui zao, hakunusurika hata mmoja.
Ekegusii: Amaache akamera kegima abachandi baria babo; onde tatigarete ore moyo nonya noyomo.

English: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
Kiswahili: Ndipo walipoamini ahadi zake, nao wakaimba sifa zake.
Ekegusii: Erio bakwegena ring’ana ri’Omonene, agwo bagateera ase okomotogia.

English: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
Kiswahili: Lakini mara walisahau aliyowatendea, wala hawakungojea shauri lake.
Ekegusii: Korende ase obwango bakeba ogokora kwaye, tibaganyete Omonene abasemie.

English: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
Kiswahili: Jangwani walitawaliwa na tamaa zao, walimjaribu Mungu nyikani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babete nobotoonu bw’okogania endagera. Bagateema Nyasae agwo ase erooro.

English: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo aliwapa kile walichoomba, lakini akatuma juu yao ugonjwa wa kudhoofisha.
Ekegusii: Ere akabaa egento baboretie baegwe, korende akabatomera oborwaire bw’okobareyia.

English: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.
Kiswahili: Kambini walimwonea wivu Mose, na pia Aroni aliyekuwa amewekwa wakfu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’egetwori babete ne ribero ase Musa, na ase Aroni, oyio orenge omochenu o Nyasae,

English: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
Kiswahili: Ardhi ilifunguka ikawameza Dathani, ikawazika Abiramu na kundi lake.
Ekegusii: riroba rikabwereka rikamera Datani, na rikamumekeria abanto b’ekeombe ki’Abiiramu.

English: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
Kiswahili: Moto uliwaka katikati ya wafuasi wao, mwali wa moto uliwateketeza waovu.
Ekegusii: Boigo omorero ogatuboka agwo ase egati y’ekeombe kiabo, ekebemberi ki’omorero kegasamba abakori amabe baria.

English: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
Kiswahili: Huko Horebu walitengeneza ndama, na kuabudu sanamu ya kusubu kwa chuma.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakaroisia omogwekano bw’emori agwo Horebu, erio bagasasiima omogwekano oria obombire.

English: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
Kiswahili: Waliubadilisha Utukufu wao kwa sanamu ya fahali, ambaye hula majani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaonchoreria oyorenge obonene bwabo, bakaonchokera omogwekano bw’eng’ombe ekorisia obonyansi.

English: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
Kiswahili: Walimsahau Mungu aliyewaokoa, aliyekuwa ametenda mambo makuu huko Misri,
Ekegusii: Bakeba Nyasae, Omotooria obo, oria okorete amang’ana amanene aaria Misiri;

English: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: miujiza katika nchi ya Hamu na mambo ya kutisha huko Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: oria okorete ogokora kw’ogokumia ase ense ya Hamu, naende agakora amang’ana ay’okoondokia aaria ase Enyancha Embariri.

English: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo alisema kwamba angewaangamiza: kama Mose mteule wake, asingesimama kati yao na Mungu kuizuia ghadhabu yake kuwaangamiza.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akarengereria ng’a abasirie, korende Musa, omochore oye, agatenena ase obosio bwaye buna omobwatania, ase ogotanga endamwamu yaye teita abanto.

English: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
Kiswahili: Kisha waliidharau ile nchi nzuri, hawakuiamini ahadi yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagachaaya ense eria yarenge engiya, ekiagera tibegenete eira y’Omonene.

English: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.
Kiswahili: Walinungʼunika ndani ya mahema yao, wala hawakumtii Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero barenge ase chiema chiabo ime nigo bemurunganetie, tibaigwera eriogi ri’Omonene.

English: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akaapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kwamba atawafanya waanguke jangwani,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro yaabo, agatiana ng’a abatige bakwere agwo ase erooro,

English: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
Kiswahili: kuwatawanya wazao wao waanguke miongoni mwa mataifa, na kuwatawanya katika nchi zote.
Ekegusii: naende ng’a asiarere abanto b’ororeria rwabo, bagende komenya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ase chinse ao ao.

English: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
Kiswahili: Walijifunga nira na Baali wa Peori, wakala dhabihu zilizotolewa kwa miungu isiyo na uhai.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabwatana na Baali, enyasae ya Peori, bakaria ebing’wanso biarenge koruegwa ase chinyasae chitari moyo.

English: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
Kiswahili: Waliichochea hasira ya Bwana, wakamkasirisha kwa matendo yao maovu, nayo tauni ikazuka katikati yao.
Ekegusii: Ase igo ogokora okwo kwabo gokagechia Omonene goika akaba nendamwamu, na oborwaire bogoita bogatuboka ase egati yaabo.

English: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
Kiswahili: Lakini Finehasi alisimama na kuingilia kati, nayo tauni ikazuiliwa.
Ekegusii: Erio Finehasi agatenena agaakanera amabe ayio akoretwe, na oborwaire boria bogatiga goita abanto.

English: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
Kiswahili: Hili likahesabiwa kwake haki, kwa vizazi visivyo na mwisho vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ogokora okwo Finehasi akabarwa ng’a nomonyene oboronge aare, ebiaare ase ebiaare kogenderera botambe.

English: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
Kiswahili: Kwenye maji ya Meriba, walimkasirisha Bwana, janga likampata Mose kwa sababu yao;
Ekegusii: Abanto bakagechia Omonene agwo ase amaache a Meriba, na ase engencho yaabo Musa agasoa ase emechando.

English: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
Kiswahili: kwa maana walimwasi Roho wa Mungu, na maneno yasiyofaa yakatoka midomoni kwa Mose.
