Ekegusii: Nigo bagechetie enkoro ya Musa, goika agakwana amang’ana nobororo, ase ogotarengereria buya.

English: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,
Kiswahili: Hawakuyaangamiza yale mataifa kama Bwana alivyowaagiza,
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibaitete basirie kegima abanto b’ebisaku, buna Omonene konya achiikire.

English: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
Kiswahili: bali walijichanganya na mataifa na wakazikubali desturi zao.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo basang’ananete n’abanto abwo bakeorokereria ogokora kwabo.

English: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
Kiswahili: Waliabudu sanamu zao, zikawa mtego kwao.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakorerete emegwekano yaabo baare gosasiima, na eyio ekaba amareba ase bare.

English: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
Kiswahili: Wakawatoa wana wao na binti zao dhabihu kwa mashetani.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baruete abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, bakaba ebing’wanso ase ebirecha.

English: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
Kiswahili: Walimwaga damu isiyo na hatia, damu za wana wao na binti zao, ambao waliwatoa dhabihu kwa sanamu za Kanaani, nayo nchi ikanajisika kwa damu zao.
Ekegusii: Bagaitera amanyinga ya bana babo, abamura na abaiseke, abatari na komocha, abwo baruete bakaba ebing’wanso ase emegwekano bagasasiima ase ense ya Kaanani; na ense eria ekaba eyetachenegeti ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ayio.

English: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
Kiswahili: Wakajinajisi wenyewe kwa yale waliyotenda; kwa matendo yao wenyewe wakajifanyia ukahaba.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo bagesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo, bagakora obonyaka tibaaba abegenwa.

English: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akawakasirikia watu wake na akauchukia sana urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu ase abanto baye, na akagechigwa n’abanto bare omwando oye.

English: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
Kiswahili: Akawakabidhi kwa mataifa na adui zao wakawatawala.
Ekegusii: Akababeka ase amaboko ya banto b’ebisaku, erinde abanto abwo baabagechete bakaba bakobagambera.

English: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
Kiswahili: Adui zao wakawaonea na kuwatia chini ya mamlaka yao.
Ekegusii: Ababisa babo bakabakorera bobe, bakababua bakababeeka inse yobogambi bwabo.

English: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
Kiswahili: Mara nyingi aliwaokoa lakini walikuwa wamezama kwenye uasi, nao wakajiharibu katika dhambi zao.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinyinge Omonene nigo arenge kobatooria, korende ase ogosemania kwabo bagachora gosaria asare: ase igo bakaba bagochandeka mono ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.

English: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
Kiswahili: Lakini akaangalia mateso yao wakati aliposikia kilio chao;
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo nabechanderete ase emechando yaabo, akaigwa ekerero kiabo.

English: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
Kiswahili: kwa ajili yao akakumbuka agano lake, na kutokana na upendo wake mkuu akapooza hasira yake.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho yaabo nigo ainyorete okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.

English: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
Kiswahili: Akawafanya wahurumiwe na wote waliowashikilia mateka.
Ekegusii: Nigo agerete abwo babosete bakabarorera amaabera.

English: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mungu wetu, tuokoe. Tukusanye tena kutoka kwa mataifa, ili tuweze kulishukuru jina lako takatifu, na kushangilia katika sifa zako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, totoorie; tosangererie amo, otorusie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, erio tonyare gotogia erieta riao richenu, na gochengera obonene bwao.

English: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: Atukuzwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele na hata milele. Watu wote na waseme, “Amen!” Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe korwa kare goika kare na kare; na abanto bonsi pi bateebe, “Amina.” Togia Omonene!

English: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa yeye ni mwema, upendo wake wadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, no’bwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
Kiswahili: Waliokombolewa wa Bwana na waseme hivi, wale aliowaokoa kutoka mkono wa adui,
Ekegusii: Abanto abw’Omonene abooretie tiga bakwane igo, abwo aboretie korwa ase okoboko kw’omochaandi.

English: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
Kiswahili: wale aliowakusanya kutoka nchi mbalimbali, kutoka mashariki na magharibi, kutoka kaskazini na kusini.
Ekegusii: Obasangereirie obarentire korwa ase chinse ao ao, korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na Irianyi.

English: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
Kiswahili: Baadhi yao walitangatanga jangwani, hawakuona njia ya kuwafikisha mji ambao wangeweza kuishi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babete bakona goetanana ase erooro enyomo, tibanyorete mochie onde ase baare komenya.

English: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa na njaa na kiu, nafsi zao zikadhoofika.
Ekegusii: Nigo babete n’enchara amo n’erang’o goika bakerusia moyo.

English: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
Kiswahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.

English: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
Kiswahili: Akawaongoza kwa njia iliyo sawa hadi mji ambao wangeweza kuishi.
Ekegusii: Akabaraa ase enchera endonge, goika akabaikia ase omochie banyaarete komenya.

English: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Kiswahili: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu,
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akobakorera Mwanyabaanto.

English: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
Kiswahili: kwa maana yeye humtosheleza mwenye kiu, na kumshibisha mwenye njaa kwa vitu vyema.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoisanekia oyore n’erang’o, na oyore n’enchara omoigotia n’ebinto ebiya.

English: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
Kiswahili: Wengine walikaa gizani na katika huzuni kuu, wafungwa wakiteseka katika minyororo,
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bamenyete ase omosunte na ase ekiriri ki’amakweri, nigo basibire ase emechando, basibeire chingataare,

English: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu walikuwa wameasi dhidi ya maneno ya Mungu na kudharau shauri la Aliye Juu Sana.
Ekegusii: ekiagera bangete koigwera ring’ana ria Nyasae, bagachaaya ogoseemia kw’Oyore Igoro Mono.

English: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
Kiswahili: Aliwatumikisha kwa kazi ngumu; walijikwaa na hapakuwepo yeyote wa kuwasaidia.
Ekegusii: Agakanya chinkoro chiabo ase okobaa obokong’u, bakaiyerigwa inse, na monto onde tarengeo okobakoonya.

English: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
Kiswahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.

English: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
Kiswahili: Akawatoa katika giza na huzuni kuu na akavunja minyororo yao.
Ekegusii: Akabarusia korwa ase omosunte ekerima, akabutora chingataare basibeire.

English: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Kiswahili: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu,
Ekegusii: Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire Mwanyabaanto.

English: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa yeye huvunja malango ya shaba na kukata mapingo ya chuma.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abunete ebisiekero bie chitaai, na akabuna emekorogoto y’ebioma ekaba ebing’ese.

English: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
Kiswahili: Wengine wakawa wapumbavu kutokana na uasi wao, wakapata mateso kwa sababu ya uovu wao.
Ekegusii: Abande bakariria, ekiagera babwatetie enchera y’ogosareka, na bakaba bagochaandeka ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.

English: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
Kiswahili: Wakachukia kabisa vyakula vyote, wakakaribia malango ya mauti.
Ekegusii: Kera endagera ekaba enguundo ase bare, bakaba ang’e gosoa ase ebiita bi’amakweri.

English: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
Kiswahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.

English: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
Kiswahili: Akalituma neno lake na kuwaponya, akawaokoa kutoka maangamizo yao.
Ekegusii: Akabatomera ring’ana riaye, akabagwenia, akabatooria korwa ase chimbeera.

English: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Kiswahili: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire Mwanyabaanto.

English: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
Kiswahili: Na watoe dhabihu za kushukuru, na wasimulie matendo yake kwa nyimbo za furaha.
Ekegusii: Tiga barue ebing’wanso bi’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende bararie ogokora kwaye ase ogoteera n’omogooko.

English: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
Kiswahili: Wengine walisafiri baharini kwa meli, walikuwa wafanyabiashara kwenye maji makuu.
Ekegusii: Abwo bageendete ne chimeeri ase enyancha, bagakora oboonchoreria ase chinyancha chinene,

English: these see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
Kiswahili: Waliziona kazi za Bwana, matendo yake ya ajabu kilindini.
Ekegusii: mbaarooche ogokora kw’Omonene, ee, ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ime ase chindiba.

English: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana alisema na kuamsha tufani iliyoinua mawimbi juu.
Ekegusii: Ere agachiika ekembugu‐mbugu gekaimoka, kerokio gekaimokereria igoro emerindo y’enyancha,

English: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
Kiswahili: Yakainuka juu mbinguni, yakashuka chini hadi vilindini, katika hatari hii ujasiri wao uliyeyuka.
Ekegusii: Emerindo eyio ekaimokerera igoro, naende ekairana inse, na ase ayio abanto bakerusia moyo ase omoichano.

English: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
Kiswahili: Walipepesuka na kuyumbayumba kama walevi, ujanja wao ukafikia ukomo.
Ekegusii: Bakaba bakoong’anya na gotabataba buna abanto batiindire, na obong’aini bwabo bwonsi bokabaerera.

English: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
Kiswahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawatoa kwenye taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, nere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.

English: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
Kiswahili: Akatuliza dhoruba kwa mnongʼono, mawimbi ya bahari yakatulia.
Ekegusii: Agachiika ekembugu‐mbugu keria, kegakira‐kiri, na emerindo y’enyancha egatoerera.

English: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
Kiswahili: Walifurahi ilipokuwa shwari, naye akawaongoza hadi bandari waliyoitamani.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaba n’omogooko, ekiagera banyorete obotoereru, n’Omonene akabaikia ase ekiambokero keria baganetie.

English: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
Kiswahili: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire Mwanyabaanto.

English: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
Kiswahili: Na wamtukuze yeye katika kusanyiko la watu, na wamsifu katika baraza la wazee.
Ekegusii: Tiga baabake Omonene agwo ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto, bamotogie nase abagaaka bagoikaransa kogaamba.

English: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
Kiswahili: Yeye aligeuza mito kuwa jangwa, chemchemi za maji zitiririkazo kuwa ardhi yenye kiu,
Ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora chindooche chikaba erooro, ne chinsooko chikaba ense enyomo.

English: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
Kiswahili: nchi izaayo ikawa ya chumvi isiyofaa, kwa sababu ya uovu wa wale walioishi humo.
Ekegusii: Akaonchora n’ense ere entobu ekaba ekerubo ki’omonyo, ase engencho y’obobe bw’ abanto bamenyeteo.

English: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
Kiswahili: Aligeuza jangwa likawa madimbwi ya maji, nayo ardhi kame kuwa chemchemi za maji zitiririkazo;
Ekegusii: Boigo akaonchora erooro ekaba ritibo riichire amaache, na ense enyomo egatuboka chinsooko chi’amaache.

English: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
Kiswahili: aliwaleta wenye njaa wakaishi humo, nao wakajenga mji wangeweza kuishi.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo nigo arentete abanto bare n’enchara; barabwo bakaagaacha omochie aroro bakamenyao.

English: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
Kiswahili: Walilima mashamba na kupanda mizabibu, nayo ikazaa matunda mengi,
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobusura emegondo, naende basimeka emesabibu, bakanyora okwama okonene mono.

English: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
Kiswahili: Mungu aliwabariki, hesabu yao ikaongezeka sana, wala hakuruhusu mifugo yao kupungua.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabasesenia bagasarara mono, tatigete omobaro bwe chitugo chiabo okee.

English: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
Kiswahili: Kisha hesabu yao ilipungua, na walinyenyekeshwa kwa kuonewa, maafa na huzuni.
Ekegusii: Ekero bakeetigwe na kworoba ase engencho y’ogokorerwa bobe na gochaandwa,

English: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye huwamwagia dharau wakuu, aliwafanya watangetange nyikani isiyo na njia.
Ekegusii: Omonene agachaaya abanene baria babachaandete, bakaba bakoong’anya ase chirooro chitari ne chinchera.

English: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye aliwainua wahitaji katika taabu zao, na kuongeza jamaa zao kama makundi ya kondoo.
Ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akorusia abaremeire korwa ase emechando, na obuchia chiamate chiabo chiaba buna amaicho.

English: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
Kiswahili: Wanyofu wataona na kufurahi, lakini waovu wote watafunga vinywa vyao.
Ekegusii: Abanyaboronge nigo bakorora amang’ana ayio na bagooka mono; korende abakori amabe nigo bagokira‐kiri baumata.

English: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Yeyote aliye na hekima, ayasikie mambo haya, na atafakari upendo mkuu wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ore omong’aini, tiga aigwe amang’ana aya, tiga arengererie mono amanye obwanchani bw’Omonene bogendererete botambe.

English: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
Kiswahili: Wimbo. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, moyo wangu ni thabiti; nitaimba na kusifu kwa moyo wangu wote.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, enkoro yane nigo ere n’oboremu! Nintere na gochenga! Omoyo one bwonsi, boka!

English: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
Kiswahili: Amka, kinubi na zeze! Nitayaamsha mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.

English: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
Kiswahili: Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, katikati ya mataifa; nitaimba habari zako, katikati ya jamaa za watu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono ase egati y’ abanto, nimbe ’ngotera amatera y’okogotogia ase egati y’ebisaku.

English: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu, ni juu kuliko mbingu; uaminifu wako unazifikia anga.
Ekegusii: Amaabera ao nigo are amanene aigete aaria igoro, obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete igoro ase amare.

English: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu ya mbingu, utukufu wako na uenee duniani kote.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi. Tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.

English: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
Kiswahili: Tuokoe na utusaidie kwa mkono wako wa kuume, ili wale uwapendao wapate kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Intoorie n’okoboko kwao gw’okorio na oigwe aya ’nkogosaba.

English: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
Kiswahili: Mungu amenena kutoka patakatifu pake: “Nitaigawa Shekemu kwa ushindi na kulipima Bonde la Sukothi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae orire eira korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, ogoteeba, “Ase omochengo ninyatanane Sekemu, na ense omweya ya Sukoti ni’nyiate chincherere.

English: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
Kiswahili: Gileadi ni yangu, Manase ni yangu, Efraimu ni kofia yangu ya chuma, nayo Yuda ni fimbo yangu ya utawala.
Ekegusii: Gileadi neyaane, na Manase neyaane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogaambi.

English: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
Kiswahili: Moabu ni sinia langu la kunawia, juu ya Edomu natupa kiatu changu; nashangilia kwa kushindwa kwa Ufilisti.”
Ekegusii: Moabu negetaabo kiane ngoisabera, nindute egekooroto kiane igoro ase Edomu, ning’ake eriogi ri’okobua igoro y’ense y’Abafilisti.”

English: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
Kiswahili: Ni nani atakayenipeleka hadi mji wenye ngome? Ni nani atakayeniongoza hadi nifike Edomu?
Ekegusii: Ning’o orandaae ansoyie ase omochie ogiteire chindwaki? Ning’o orantang’ane gochia Edomu?

English: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, si ni wewe uliyetukataa sisi, na hutoki tena na majeshi yetu?
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Inee, ngwatotigire kegima? Aye tori kogeenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.

English: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
Kiswahili: Tuletee msaada dhidi ya adui, kwa maana msaada wa mwanadamu haufai kitu.
Ekegusii: Tokoonye, torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokoonywa gokorwa ase Mwanyabaanto mbosa.

English: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
Kiswahili: Kwa msaada wa Mungu tutapata ushindi, naye atawaponda adui zetu.
Ekegusii: Ekero tore amo na Nyasae, ’natokore amang’ana amanene, nere orabue ababisa baito na kobatiringera inse.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, ambaye ninakusifu, usiwe kimya,
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae ningotogie, tobaisa gokira‐kiri.

English: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
Kiswahili: kwa maana watu waovu na wadanganyifu wamefungua vinywa vyao dhidi yangu; wasema dhidi yangu kwa ndimi za udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe abare abang’ainereria nigo bagokwana igoro yane, ee, nigo bagokwana oborimo igoro yane.

English: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
Kiswahili: Wamenizunguka kwa maneno ya chuki, wananishambulia bila sababu.
Ekegusii: Bang’etananire bagokwana amang’ana y’obobisa, nigo bakondwania ’ntari na komocha konde.

English: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
Kiswahili: Wanachonilipa badala ya urafiki wangu ni kunishtaki, lakini mimi ninawaombea.
Ekegusii: Nonya inche ’mbanchete, barabwo nigo bangeechete, ee, nonya ngendererete kobasabera ebisio.

English: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
Kiswahili: Wananilipiza mabaya kwa mema, chuki badala ya urafiki wangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya aane na okogeecha ase obwanchani bwane.

English: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
Kiswahili: Agiza mtu mwovu ampinge, mshtaki asimame mkono wake wa kuume.
Ekegusii: Chora omonto omobe amogambere omobisa one, na tiga oria omosoeri atenene ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio amosoere.

English: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
Kiswahili: Anapohukumiwa, apatikane na hatia, nayo maombi yake yamhukumu.
Ekegusii: Ekero agambiigwe ekiina, tiga abarerwe okomocha, nonya n’ogosaba kwaye kobarwe ng’a nebibe.

English: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
Kiswahili: Siku zake za kuishi na ziwe chache, nafasi yake ya uongozi ichukuliwe na mtu mwingine.
Ekegusii: Amatuko aye tiga abe amake, na oboteneneri bwaye omoao aboire.

English: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
Kiswahili: Watoto wake na waachwe yatima, mke wake na awe mjane.
Ekegusii: Tiga abana baye batigwe bare chintakana, na omokungu oye atigwe ore omoboraka.

English: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
Kiswahili: Watoto wake na watangetange wakiomba, na wafukuzwe kwenye magofu ya nyumba zao.
Ekegusii: Abana baye babe bakoombogana na kona‐gosaberera, bageende kona‐korigia endagera aare korwa ase amatuuri bamenyete.

English: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
Kiswahili: Mtu anayemdai na ateke vyote alivyo navyo, matunda ya kazi yake yatekwe nyara na wageni.
Ekegusii: Tiga abamoete ebinto singo bache baire ebinto biaye bionsi; abanto abaao bache basakore ebi bakorerete emeremo emekong’u.

English: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
Kiswahili: Asiwepo mtu yeyote wa kumtendea mema wala wa kuwahurumia yatima wake.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tabaisa koba omuya asare, gose onde taba n’amaabera ase abana baye bare chintakana.

English: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
Kiswahili: Uzao wake na ukatiliwe mbali, majina yao yafutike katika kizazi kifuatacho.
Ekegusii: Tiga ororeeria rwaye rosirigwe, na erieta riaye riebwe kegima ase ekiare gia kabere.

English: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
Kiswahili: Maovu ya baba zake na yakumbukwe mbele za Bwana, dhambi ya mama yake isifutwe kamwe.
Ekegusii: Ebibe bie chisokoro chiaye biinyorwe ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ebibe bia ng’ina tibibaisa gotinyigwa.

English: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
Kiswahili: Dhambi zao na zibaki daima mbele za Bwana, ili apate kukatilia mbali kumbukumbu lao duniani.
Ekegusii: Ebibe biabo tiga bigenderere kobeera ase obosio Omonene botambe; na barabwo tibaabaisa koinyorwa ase ense nonya ng’ake.

English: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kamwe hakuweza kutenda wema, bali alimfukuza mnyonge na mhitaji, aliwafanyia jeuri wahitaji na waliovunjika moyo.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio tainyorete koorokia amaabera, korende abataka, na abaremerwa, na abasionoire chinkoro chiabo, nigo abachaandete goika ogokwa kwabo.

English: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
Kiswahili: Alipenda kulaani, nayo laana ikampata; hakupenda kubariki, kwa hiyo baraka na ikae mbali naye.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo anchete koragereria, bono tiga okoragereria okwo komoiranere. Ere tanchete gosesenia, ase ayio ogosesenigwa kobe aare asare.

English: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
Kiswahili: Alivaa kulaani kama vazi lake, nayo laana ikamwingia mwilini mwake kama maji, kwenye mifupa yake kama mafuta.
Ekegusii: Nigo ambarete okoragererigwa buna akwambara egoti yaye; bono tiga konywere ase omobere oye buna amaache akonywera ase omobere, na buna amaguta akweakwa akonywera aika ase amauga aye.

English: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
Kiswahili: Na iwe kama joho alilozungushiwa, kama mshipi aliofungiwa daima.
Ekegusii: Tiga okoragererigwa okwo kobe buna egetambaa akwambara, naende kobe buna orokini akweboeria botambe.

English: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.
Kiswahili: Haya na yawe malipo ya Bwana kwa washtaki wangu, kwa wale wanaoninenea mabaya.
Ekegusii: Tiga Omonene abaakane igo abwo bagonsoera, abwo bagokwana bobe igoro y’obogima bwane.

English: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, unitendee wema kwa ajili ya jina lako, uniokoe kwa wema wa pendo lako.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Nyasae, Omonene one, ondwanerere ase engencho y’erieta riao, intoorie, ekiagera obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bore obuya.

English: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
Kiswahili: Maana mimi ni maskini na mhitaji, moyo wangu umejeruhiwa ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omotaka oremeire mono, na nigo ’nde n’obororo ase enkoro yane ime.

English: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
Kiswahili: Ninafifia kama kivuli cha jioni, nimerushwa-rushwa kama nzige.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’ngoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba, nigo nkoirurukigwa buna chingige.

English: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
Kiswahili: Magoti yangu yamelegea kwa kufunga, mwili wangu umedhoofika na kukonda.
Ekegusii: Amaru aborirwe chinguru ase engencho y’okweng’ata, na omobere one oreeire mono.

English: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa kitu cha kudharauliwa kwa washtaki wangu, wanionapo, hutikisa vichwa vyao.
Ekegusii: Nabeire omonto ogosekererwa nabansoeri; ekero bakondora, nigo bagonchaaya basingisia emetwe yaabo.

English: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu nisaidie, niokoe sawasawa na upendo wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, inkonye! Intoorie, ekiagera aye nigo obwate amaabera amange!

English: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.
Kiswahili: Watu na wafahamu kuwa ni mkono wako, kwamba wewe, Ee Bwana, umetenda hili.
Ekegusii: Tiga abansoeri abwo bamanye ng’a aya nigo arure ase okoboko kwao. Aye Omonene, naye gwakorire aya.

English: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
Kiswahili: Wanaweza kulaani, lakini wewe utabariki, watakaposhambulia wataaibishwa, lakini mtumishi wako atashangilia.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tiga bandagererie, korende aye onsesenie. Tiga abwo bagonkorera bobe barore obosooku, korende inche, omosomba oo, nimbe n’omogooko.

English: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
Kiswahili: Washtaki wangu watavikwa fedheha, na kufunikwa na aibu kama joho.
Ekegusii: Tiga abansoeri baboigwe ogochaaywa, tiga obosooku obwo bobatube buna egetambaa gi’okwambara.

English: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
Kiswahili: Kwa kinywa changu nitamtukuza sana Bwana, katika umati mkubwa nitamsifu.
Ekegusii: Ning’iranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono kegima n’omonwa one, nimbe nkona‐komotogia ase egati y’ abanto abange.

English: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana husimama mkono wa kuume wa mhitaji, kuokoa maisha yake kutoka kwa wale wanaomhukumu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo ateneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’omotaka, ase okomotooria korwa ase abwo bakomonachera ekiina ki’ogokwa.

English: A Psalm by David. Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana amwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, mpaka nitakapowafanya adui zako kuwa mahali pa kuweka miguu yako.”
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Omonene agateebia Nyasae Omonene one, “Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio goika mbeeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.”

English: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataeneza fimbo yako ya utawala yenye nguvu kutoka Sayuni; utatawala katikati ya adui zako.
Ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni Omonene narambore enyimbo yao y’obogaambi ere n’okobua, ateebe, “Gamba ase egati y’ababisa bao.”

English: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
Kiswahili: Askari wako watajitolea kwa hiari katika siku yako ya vita. Ukiwa umevikwa fahari takatifu, kutoka tumbo la mapambazuko utapokea umande wa ujana wako.
Ekegusii: Abanto bao mberue n’ogwancha kwabo, ekero orasangererie abarwani bao b’esegi. Abamura bao mbaache asore beboetie oboseera obochenu, buna riime ria mambia.

English: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
Kiswahili: Bwana ameapa, naye hatabadilisha mawazo yake: “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”
Ekegusii: Omonene otianire, takoonchora ebirengererio biaye: “Aye nigo ore Omokuani goika kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”

English: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
Kiswahili: Bwana yuko mkono wako wa kuume, atawaponda wafalme siku ya ghadhabu yake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo ateneine ase ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio; ere nasenyente abarwoti ase rituko ri’endamwamu yaye.

English: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
Kiswahili: Atawahukumu mataifa, akilundika mizoga na kuwaponda watawala wa dunia nzima.
Ekegusii: Nanachere abanto b’ebisaku ekiina, ense neichore n’ebitondo; nasenyente emetwe y’abagaambi b’ense engima.

English: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
Kiswahili: Atakunywa maji katika kijito kando ya njia, kwa hiyo atainua kichwa chake juu.
Ekegusii: Nabe okonywa amaache y’ensoko ekero are ase orogeendo rwaye, ase ayio naimokererie omotwe oye igoro kabuire.

English: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Nitamtukuza Bwana kwa moyo wangu wote, katika baraza la wanyofu na katika kusanyiko.
Ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Ning’ake ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene n’enkoro yane yonsi, agwo ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
Kiswahili: Kazi za Bwana ni kuu, wote wanaopendezwa nazo huzitafakari.
Ekegusii: Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okonene, Abwo bagokogookera nigo bagokweorokereria erinde bakomanye.

English: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Kazi zake zimejaa fahari na utukufu, haki yake hudumu daima.
Ekegusii: Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okw’ogosikwa okonene na obonene, na oboronge bwaye nigo bogendererete kobao goika kare na kare.

English: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
Kiswahili: Amefanya maajabu yake yakumbukwe, Bwana ni mwenye neema na huruma.
Ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia kobe gokoinyorwa, ere nigo are n’obuya na amaabera.

English: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
Kiswahili: Huwapa chakula wale wanaomcha, hulikumbuka agano lake milele.
Ekegusii: Nigo akoa abanto abwo bamoirogete endagera; nabe ogendererete koinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania goika kare na kare.

English: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
Kiswahili: Amewaonyesha watu wake uwezo wa kazi zake, akiwapa nchi za mataifa mengine.
Ekegusii: Oorokeirie abanto baye okobua kw’ogokora kwaye ase okobaa emiando y’ abanto b’ebisaku.

English: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
Kiswahili: Kazi za mikono yake ni za uaminifu na haki, mausia yake yote ni ya kuaminika.
Ekegusii: Ogokora kw’amaboko aye nigo kore okw’obwegenwa na okw’oboronge, n’amachiiko aye onsi nay’obwegenwa.

English: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
Kiswahili: Zinadumu milele na milele, zikifanyika kwa uaminifu na unyofu.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko ayio nigo ateneine bokong’u kare na kare, aikeranigwe ase ekeene na oboronge.

English: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
Kiswahili: Aliwapa watu wake ukombozi, aliamuru agano lake milele: jina lake ni takatifu na la kuogopwa.
Ekegusii: Ere otomeire abanto baye okoboorigwa, na ochiikire okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania kobeo goika kare na kare. Erieta riaye nigo rire richenu na eri’okoirokwa.

English: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana ndicho chanzo cha hekima, wote wanaozifuata amri zake wana busara. Sifa zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, oyio noro omochakano bw’obong’aini, bonsi abagokora ayio nigo bare nokomanya okuya. Ogotogigwa kwaye nogwa kare na kare.

English: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Heri mtu yule amchaye Bwana, mtu yule apendezwaye sana na amri zake.
Ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Nasesenirie omonto oyio omoirogete Omonene, na ogokirie mono koigwera amachiiko aye.

English: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
Kiswahili: Watoto wake watakuwa wenye uwezo katika nchi, kizazi cha watu waadilifu kitabarikiwa.
Ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ’ndobe n’okobua ase ense; ekiaare ki’abare ne chinkoro chindonge ’ngesesenigwe.

English: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Nyumbani mwake kuna mali na utajiri, haki yake hudumu milele.
Ekegusii: Obotenenku na obonda ’mbibe ase enyomba yaye, na oboronge bwaye ’mbogenderere kobao botambe.

English: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
Kiswahili: Hata gizani nuru humzukia mtu mwadilifu, yule mwenye rehema, huruma na haki.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omobaso okobara ase omosunte, Omonene nabo ogochera abanyaboronge, ore nobuya, n’amaabera, na oboronge.

English: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
Kiswahili: Mema yatamjia mtu yule aliye mkarimu na mwenye kukopesha bila riba, anayefanya mambo yake kwa haki.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto ore n’amaabera na okorua ebinto singo, boigo ogokora amang’ana aye onsi ase oboronge.

English: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
Kiswahili: Hakika hatatikisika kamwe, mtu mwenye haki atakumbukwa milele.
Ekegusii: Omonyaboronge takonyegerigwa nonya ng’ake, nabe okoinyorwa kare na kare.

English: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hataogopa habari mbaya, moyo wake ni thabiti, ukimtegemea Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ere takwoboa kagotebigwa amang’ana amabe, enkoro yaye nigo ere endemu esemeretie Omonene.

English: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
Kiswahili: Moyo wake ni salama, hatakuwa na hofu, mwishoni ataona ushindi dhidi ya adui zake.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yaye teri koirianyeka gose kwoboa, ere nigo akoremereria goika abachaandi baye babugwe.

English: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
Kiswahili: Ametawanya vipawa vyake kwa ukarimu akawapa maskini; haki yake hudumu milele; pembe yake itatukuzwa kwa heshima.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoa abataka ebiegwa ore n’omoyo omorabu; oboronge bwaye ’mbogenderere kobao kare na kare; orogunchara rwaye ’ndokiine ase ogosikwa.

English: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu ataona na kuchukizwa, atasaga meno yake na kutoweka, kutamani kwa mtu mwovu kutaishia patupu.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto omonyabibe akorora ayio, nigo agoichana ogeechigwa, oriania amaino aye, orea osira. Okogania kw’omonyabibe nigo kogosira.

English: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Enyi watumishi wa Bwana msifuni, lisifuni jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Inwe abasomba b’Omonene, motogie, ee, ritogie erieta riaye!

English: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
Kiswahili: Jina la Bwana na lisifiwe, sasa na hata milele.
Ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene ritogigwe korwa bono goika kare na kare!

English: From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia mawio ya jua hadi machweo yake, jina la Bwana linapaswa kusifiwa.
Ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene ribe rigotogigwa korwa ekero risase rikooroka goika ekero rikorimera!

English: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametukuka juu ya mataifa yote, utukufu wake juu ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi, na obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine igoro chionsi.

English: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliye kama Bwana Mungu wetu, Yeye ambaye ameketi juu kwenye kiti cha enzi,
Ekegusii: Ning’o onga buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, oria omenyete aaria igoro mono,

English: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?
Kiswahili: ambaye huinama atazame chini aone mbingu na nchi?
Ekegusii: na origereretie goocha inse aa arore igoro na ense.

English: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
Kiswahili: Huwainua maskini kutoka mavumbini, na kuwanyanyua wahitaji kutoka kwenye jalala,
Ekegusii: Nigo akoimokia omotaka korwa ase obotaka obwere, na koimokia omoremerwa korwa ase ribu,

English: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
Kiswahili: huwaketisha pamoja na wakuu, pamoja na wakuu wa watu wake.
Ekegusii: obabeeka baikaransa amo n’abwo bare n’okobua, baria bakogambera abanto baye.

English: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: Humjalia mwanamke tasa kutulia nyumbani mwake, akiwa mama watoto mwenye furaha. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nigo akoa omokungu omogomba chinguru chi’okoibora, oba n’omogooko ase obomenyo bwaye. Omonene atogigwe!

English: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
Kiswahili: Wakati Israeli walipotoka Misri, nyumba ya Yakobo kutoka kwa watu wa lugha ngeni,
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri, ee, ekero abanto ba Yakobo barwete ase abanto barenge konoga omonwa omoao,

English: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
Kiswahili: Yuda alifanywa makao matakatifu ya Mungu, Israeli akawa milki yake.
Ekegusii: Abayuda bakaba aase aachenu a Omonene, na Abaisraeli bakaba ab’obogaambi bwaye.

English: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
Kiswahili: Bahari ilitazama ikakimbia, Yordani ulirudi nyuma,
Ekegusii: Enyancha ekarora ayio egatama, na orooche rwa Yorodani rokanacheka, rokairana magega.

English: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
Kiswahili: milima ilirukaruka kama kondoo dume, vilima kama wana-kondoo.
Ekegusii: Ebitunwa bigatuma-tuma buna chimingichi, na ebigoro buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi.

English: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
Kiswahili: Ee bahari, ni nini kilichokufanya ukakimbia, nawe, ee Yordani, ukarudi nyuma,
Ekegusii: Aye enyancha, ninki kwarooche, erinde ogatama? Aye Yorodani, ninki kiabeete asore, erinde okanacheka okairana magega?

English: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?
Kiswahili: enyi milima mkarukaruka kama kondoo dume, enyi vilima, kama wana-kondoo?
Ekegusii: Inwe ebitunwa, ninki kiagerete mogatuma‐tuma buna chimingichi, nainwe ebigoro boigo buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi?

English: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
Kiswahili: Ee dunia, tetemeka mbele za Bwana, mbele za Mungu wa Yakobo,
Ekegusii: Aye ense, tengecha ase obosio Omonene, ee, ase obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.

English: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
Kiswahili: aliyegeuza mwamba kuwa dimbwi la maji, mwamba mgumu kuwa chemchemi za maji.
Ekegusii: Oyio oonchorete egetare gekaba ritibo ri’amaache, ne rigena riikong’u rikaba ensoko y’amaache.

English: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
Kiswahili: Sio kwetu sisi, Ee Bwana, sio kwetu sisi, bali utukufu ni kwa jina lako, kwa sababu ya upendo na uaminifu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, intwe titobaisa gotogigwa, korende erieta riao rioka ritogigwe, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, nase obwegenwa bwao.

English: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mataifa waseme, “Yuko wapi Mungu wao?”
Ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku baraborie, “Nyasae oyio obo ng’ai are?”

English: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
Kiswahili: Mungu wetu yuko mbinguni, naye hufanya lolote limpendezalo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oito niigoro are, naende nigo agokora rinde rionsi aganetie.

English: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
Kiswahili: Lakini sanamu zao ni za fedha na dhahabu, zilizotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Emegwekano abanto abwo bagosasiima nigo eroiseirie chifeta ne chitaabu, nigo ere emeremo y’amaboko a Mwanyabaanto.

English: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
Kiswahili: Zina vinywa, lakini haziwezi kusema, zina macho, lakini haziwezi kuona;
Ekegusii: Nigo ebwate omonwa, korende teri gokwana, nebwate amaiso, korende teri korora.

English: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
Kiswahili: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, zina pua, lakini haziwezi kunusa;
Ekegusii: Nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, nebwate emioro, korende teri konyonka eigwe rimisu.

English: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
Kiswahili: zina mikono, lakini haziwezi kupapasa, zina miguu, lakini haziwezi kutembea; wala koo zao haziwezi kutoa sauti.
Ekegusii: Nebwate amaboko, korende teri kobwata gento, nebwate amagoro, korende teri gotaara; gose tebwati eriogi ri’ogokwana korwa ase emioyo yaabo.

English: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaozitengeneza watafanana nazo, vivyo hivyo wale wote wanaozitumainia.
Ekegusii: Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nabo barabe buna ero ere; na baria bayiegenete boigo.

English: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
Kiswahili: Ee nyumba ya Israeli, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.

English: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
Kiswahili: Ee nyumba ya Aroni, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.
Ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.

English: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnaomcha, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamoirogete Omonene, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.

English: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
Kiswahili: Bwana anatukumbuka na atatubariki: ataibariki nyumba ya Israeli, ataibariki nyumba ya Aroni,
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire ogotoinyora, natosesenie; nasesenie Abaisraeli, nasesenie ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni.

English: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
Kiswahili: atawabariki wale wanaomcha Bwana, wadogo kwa wakubwa.
Ekegusii: Ere nasesenie bonsi abamoirogete, abake na abanene.

English: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.
Kiswahili: Bwana na awawezeshe kuongezeka, ninyi na watoto wenu.
Ekegusii: Tiga Omonene abamentekanie, inwe amo ne chinderia chiaino.

English: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Kiswahili: Mbarikiwe na Bwana Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.
Ekegusii: Mosesenigwe n’Omonene, oria otongete igoro na ense.

English: The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
Kiswahili: Mbingu zilizo juu sana ni mali ya Bwana, lakini dunia amempa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Igoro yonsi na aase aye ere Omonene ore igoro, korende ense ero oyeire Mwanyabaanto.

English: The dead don’t praise Yah, nor any who go down into silence,
Kiswahili: Sio wafu wanaomsifu Bwana, wale washukao mahali pa kimya,
Ekegusii: Abakuure tibari gotogia Omonene, na ase abwo bagendire aase aakiriru onde tari okomotogia.

English: but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: bali ni sisi tunaomtukuza Bwana, sasa na hata milele. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe ntogenderere gotogia Omonene, korwa bono goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!

English: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Kiswahili: Ninampenda Bwana kwa maana amesikia sauti yangu; amesikia kilio changu ili anihurumie.
Ekegusii: Nigo inyanchete Omonene, ekiagera ere oiguure eriogi riane na ogosaba kwane.

English: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu amenitegea sikio lake, nitamwita siku zote za maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Ere ontegereire onyiguure, ase ayio, ekero ’nde moyo nimbe ’nkona‐komorangeria ng’a ankonye.

English: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
Kiswahili: Kamba za mauti zilinizunguka, maumivu makuu ya kuzimu yalinipata, nikalemewa na taabu na huzuni.
Ekegusii: Ebisibo bi’amakweri nigo biang’etananete; ekeondoko gi’aase abakuure gekambwata; nigo nabeete n’emechando na omoichano.

English: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikaliitia jina la Bwana: “Ee Bwana, niokoe!”
Ekegusii: Erio nkarangeria erieta ri’Omonene, ’ngasaba, “Aye Omonene, nagosoroire ontoorie omoyo one.”

English: Yahweh is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwenye neema na haki, Mungu wetu ni mwingi wa huruma.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobuya na oboronge; Ere, Nyasae oito nigo are omonyamaabera.

English: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwalinda wanyenyekevu, nilipokuwa katika shida kubwa, aliniokoa.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenda abanto abakanyeku; ekero nabeete ing’ichaanete, nigo antooretie.

English: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
Kiswahili: Ee nafsi yangu, tulia tena, kwa kuwa Bwana amekuwa mwema kwako.
Ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, irana ase n’obotoereru bwao, ekiagera Omonene ogokoreire amaya amange.

English: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umeniokoa nafsi yangu na mauti, macho yangu kutokana na machozi, miguu yangu kutokana na kujikwaa,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwarusirie omoyo one ase amakweri, gwatinyirie amariga korwa ase amaiso aane, kwarendire amagoro aane tindichaniwa ingwe.

English: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.
Kiswahili: ili niweze kutembea mbele za Bwana, katika nchi ya walio hai.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ’ngotaara ase obosio Omonene, ’nde ase ense y’ abanto bare moyo.

English: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
Kiswahili: Niliamini, kwa hiyo nilisema, “Mimi nimeteseka sana.”
Ekegusii: Nigo negenete, na ase engencho eyio ’ngakwana, “Inche nigo ’nchaandegete mono”

English: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
Kiswahili: Katika taabu yangu nilisema, “Wanadamu wote ni waongo.”
Ekegusii: na ase okwegosa kwane ’ngateeba, “Kere omonto nomonyaborimo.”

English: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
Kiswahili: Nimrudishie Bwana nini kwa wema wake wote alionitendea?
Ekegusii: Ngento ki ’ndarue ing’akane Omonene ase engencho y’amaya aya ankoreire?

English: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: Nitakiinua kikombe cha wokovu na kulitangaza jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ninyimokie egekombe ki’ogotooreka, ’ndangerie ase erieta ri’Omonene.

English: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.
Kiswahili: Nitazitimiza nadhiri zangu kwa Bwana mbele za watu wake wote.
Ekegusii: Ning’ikeranie chiira chiane ase Omonene agwo ase amasio y’ abanto baye bonsi.

English: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.
Kiswahili: Kifo cha watakatifu kina thamani machoni pa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere engencho enene ase amaiso y’Omonene ekero abanto baye abachenu bagokwa.

English: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, hakika mimi ni mtumishi wako, mimi ni mtumishi wako, mwana wa mjakazi wako; umeniweka huru toka katika minyororo yangu.
Ekegusii: Nagosoroire, Omonene, inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo; nigo ’nde omosomba oo, omwana bw’omokuungu ore omosomba oo. Aye gwachisiboire chingataare korwa ase amagoro ane.

English: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: Nitakutolea dhabihu ya kukushukuru na kuliita jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ninkoruere okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende ’ndangerie erieta ri’Omonene.

English: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,
Kiswahili: Nitazitimiza nadhiri zangu kwa Bwana mbele za watu wake wote,
Ekegusii: Ning’ikeranie chiira chiane ase Omonene agwo ase amasio y’ abanto baye bonsi.

English: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: katika nyua za nyumba ya Bwana, katikati yako, ee Yerusalemu. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ime ase chigoora chi’enyomba y’Omonene gati‐gati yao aye Yerusalemu; Omonene atogigwe!

English: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana, enyi mataifa yote; mtukuzeni yeye, enyi watu wote.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, motogie Omonene! Inwe abanto bonsi, mobake!

English: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa upendo wake kwetu ni mkuu, uaminifu wa Bwana unadumu milele. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bore obonene ase tore, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogenderete goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!

English: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Israeli na aseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”
Ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

English: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Nyumba ya Aroni na iseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’enyomba ya Aroni bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

English: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Wote wamchao Bwana na waseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto abwo bairogete Omonene bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

English: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa maumivu yangu makuu nilimlilia Bwana, naye akanijibu kwa kuniweka huru.
Ekegusii: Ekero nareenge n’emechando nkamorangeri’Omonene; nere akang’iraneria, akambeeka aase aagare.

English: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Kiswahili: Bwana yuko pamoja nami, sitaogopa. Mwanadamu anaweza kunitenda nini?
Ekegusii: Omonene kare ase ensemo yane, tinkonyaara kwoboa. Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi ninki aranyare gonkorera?

English: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
Kiswahili: Bwana yuko pamoja nami, yeye ni msaidizi wangu. Nitawatazama adui zangu wakiwa wameshindwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ase ensemo y’abarwanereri baane; ningoke ase engencho yokobugwa kw’abwo bangeechete.

English: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
Kiswahili: Ni bora kumkimbilia Bwana kuliko kumtumainia mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya komotamera Omonene, kobua gosemeria Mwanyabaanto.

English: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
Kiswahili: Ni bora kumkimbilia Bwana kuliko kuwatumainia wakuu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya komotamera Omonene kobua gosemeria omonyamwando bw’obogaambi.

English: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote yalinizunguka, lakini kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nigo bang’etananete kondwania, korende ase erieta ri’Omonene ’nkabasiria.

English: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
Kiswahili: Walinizunguka pande zote, lakini kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Nigo bamboerete korwa chinsinyo chionsi, korende ase erieta ri’Omonene nkabasiria.

English: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
Kiswahili: Walinizunguka kama kundi la nyuki, lakini walikufa haraka kama miiba iteketeayo; kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Nigo bang’umokerete buna chinchoke, korende bakarima buna omorero bw’amagwa; ase erieta ri’Omonene ’nkabasiria.

English: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
Kiswahili: Nilisukumwa nyuma karibu kuanguka, lakini Bwana alinisaidia.
Ekegusii: Nigo natwometwe bokong’u ng’a ingwe, korende Omonene agankonya.

English: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni nguvu yangu na wimbo wangu, yeye amefanyika wokovu wangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere chinguru na omoegereri one, ere obeire ogotooreka kwane.

English: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
Kiswahili: Sauti za shangwe na ushindi zinavuma hemani mwa wenye haki: “Mkono wa kuume wa Bwana umetenda mambo makuu!
Ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe amateera y’omogooko igoro y’ogotoreka, ayio akorwa ase chiema ase abanyene oboronge bamenyete, agoteeba, “Okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo kogokora amang’ana y’ogokumia.

English: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
Kiswahili: Mkono wa kuume wa Bwana umeinuliwa juu, mkono wa kuume wa Bwana umetenda mambo makuu!”
Ekegusii: Okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo koimokererete igoro, ee, okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo kogokora amang’ana y’ogokumia.”

English: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
Kiswahili: Sitakufa, bali nitaishi, nami nitatangaza yale Bwana aliyoyatenda.
Ekegusii: Inche tingokwa, korende nimbe moyo, erio ning’iranerere amakumia a Omonene.

English: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
Kiswahili: Bwana ameniadhibu vikali, lakini hakuniacha nife.
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire okong’a egesusuro ekenene gi’okondongeyia, korende tang’ereretie gochia ase amakweri.

English: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
Kiswahili: Nifungulie malango ya haki, nami nitaingia na kumshukuru Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inyigorere ebiita bi’oboronge, erio insoe aroro ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene.

English: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
Kiswahili: Hili ni lango la Bwana ambalo wenye haki wanaweza kuliingia.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio egeita kia Omonene, agwo nao abanyene oboronge barasoere.

English: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
Kiswahili: Nitakushukuru, kwa kuwa ulinijibu, umekuwa wokovu wangu.
Ekegusii: Nagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera kwanyiguure, naende kwabeire ogotooreka kwane.

English: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
Kiswahili: Jiwe walilolikataa waashi, limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.
Ekegusii: Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.

English: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametenda hili, nalo ni la kushangaza machoni petu.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, eri neriogokumia ase amaiso aito.

English: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo siku Bwana aliyoifanya, tushangilie na kufurahi ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Rituko eri nario Omonene akorire, tiga tobe n’omogooko, tochenge ase rirorio.

English: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, tuokoe, Ee Bwana, utujalie mafanikio.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, twagosoroire ototoorie! Omonene, twakogarameire, toe obobui!

English: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
Kiswahili: Heri yule ajaye kwa jina la Bwana. Kutoka nyumba ya Bwana tunakubariki.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyio ogoocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Intwe nigo tokobasesenia korwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
Kiswahili: Bwana ndiye Mungu, naye ametuangazia nuru yake. Mkiwa na matawi mkononi, unganeni kwenye maandamano ya sikukuu hadi kwenye pembe za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae, ere otorabeirie ensaakia. Bogoria chinsagia chi’emete, mochaake rituko rinene, moroobere gochia ase egesasiimero kere n’emegwekano ye ching’unchara!

English: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni Mungu wangu, nitakushukuru, wewe ni Mungu wangu, nitakutukuza.
Ekegusii: Aye naye Nyasae one, nimbe ’nkogoakera ng’a mbuya mono; Nyasae one, nimbe nkona‐gokobaka.

English: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
Kiswahili: Heri wale walio waadilifu katika njia zao, wanaoenenda katika sheria ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inaki bagasesenirie abwo chinchera chiabo chire chindonge! Barabwo abagendererete kobwatia amachiiko y’Omonene!

English: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
Kiswahili: Heri wale wanaozishika shuhuda zake, wamtafutao kwa moyo wao wote.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abwo barendete oborori bwaye, abwo bakorigia Omonene ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi,

English: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
Kiswahili: Wasiofanya lolote lililo baya, wanaoenenda katika njia zake.
Ekegusii: abwo batari gokora amabe, korende nigo bakobwatia chinchera chiaye.

English: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
Kiswahili: Umetoa maagizo yako ili tuyatii kwa ukamilifu.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatoeire amachiiko ao, toyarende nomokia.

English: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
Kiswahili: Laiti mwenendo wangu ungekuwa imara katika kuyatii maagizo yako!
Ekegusii: Nigo nganetie ng’a chinchera chiane chibe chindonge, erinde ndende emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mimi sitaaibishwa ninapozingatia amri zako zote.
Ekegusii: Rirorio tingosookigwa ekero ’ndabe ’ndigereretie amachiiko ao onsi.

English: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
Kiswahili: Nitakusifu kwa moyo mnyofu ninapojifunza sheria zako za haki.
Ekegusii: Ekero ’ndabe neorokereirie okogaamba kwao kw’oboronge, rirorio nimbe nkona‐kogotogia nenkoro endonge.

English: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH
Kiswahili: Nitayatii maagizo yako; usiniache kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ninyigwere amachiiko ao; tobaisa gontiga.

English: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
Kiswahili: Kijana aifanye njia yake kuwa safi jinsi gani? Ni kwa kutii, akilifuata neno lako.
Ekegusii: Naki omonto omosae arakore arende obochenu bw’obogima bwaye? Nase okorenda orogeendo rwaye kobwatekana ne ring’ana riao.

English: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
Kiswahili: Ninakutafuta kwa moyo wangu wote, usiniache niende mbali na amri zako.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’ngokorigia nenkoro yane yonsi; ondende timbaisa gotiga amachiiko ao.

English: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
Kiswahili: Nimelificha neno lako moyoni mwangu ili nisikutende dhambi.
Ekegusii: Nagachire ring’ana riao ase enkoro yane ime, ng’a tinkora ebibe asore.

English: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
Kiswahili: Sifa ni zako, Ee Bwana, nifundishe maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo osesenegete. Inyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
Kiswahili: Kwa midomo yangu nitasimulia sheria zote zinazotoka katika kinywa chako.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkona‐koraria aya onsi gwanchiikire nomonwa oo.

English: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
Kiswahili: Ninafurahia kufuata sheria zako kama mtu afurahiaye mali nyingi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase obonene bwe chinkuma chiao; kobua koba nobotenenku obonene.

English: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
Kiswahili: Ninatafakari maagizo yako na kuziangalia njia zako.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkorengereria mono igoro y’amachiiko ao, naende ’mbe ’nkorigereria chinchera chiao chionsi.

English: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL
Kiswahili: Ninafurahia maagizo yako, wala sitalipuuza neno lako.
Ekegusii: Ningokere emeroberio yao echiikire; tinkweba ring’ana riao.

English: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
Kiswahili: Mtendee mema mtumishi wako, nami nitaishi; nitalitii neno lako.
Ekegusii: ’nkorere amaya, inche omosomba oo, erio nario ’ndabe moyo, ’mbwate ring’ana riao.

English: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
Kiswahili: Yafungue macho yangu nipate kuona mambo ya ajabu katika sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Ndamokie amaiso, inyare korora amang’ana y’ogokumia y’amachiiko ao.

English: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mgeni duniani, usinifiche amri zako.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omoeti ase ense, tobaisa kombisa amachiiko ao.

English: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu inataabika kwa shauku kubwa juu ya sheria zako wakati wote.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane yarang’ire namaiga, chingaki chionsi nigo eganetie komanya okogania kwao.

English: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
Kiswahili: Unawakemea wenye majivuno, waliolaaniwa waendao mbali na amri zako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotogonyera abanto abaenenu, abwo baragereirie, baria batigire kobwata amachiiko ao.

English: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
Kiswahili: Niondolee dharau na dhihaka, kwa kuwa ninazishika sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Onduserie ogochecherigwa na ogochaaywa kwabo, ekiagera inche nigo ’ndendete oborori bwao.

English: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
Kiswahili: Ingawa watawala huketi pamoja na kunisingizia, mtumishi wako atatafakari juu ya maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi nabaikaransa amo koroberia bankorere bobe, korende inche, omosomba oo, nigo nkona‐koiranerera emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH
Kiswahili: Sheria zako ni furaha yangu, nazo ni washauri wangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’ngokerete oborori bwao, ekiagera nabwo bogonseemia.

English: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
Kiswahili: Nimelazwa chini mavumbini, yahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na neno lako.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one otiringeirwe inse, ’ng’a obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

English: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
Kiswahili: Nilikueleza njia zangu ukanijibu, nifundishe sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Ekero naorogetie amakora aane nigo kwanyigwete; ’nyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire!

English: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
Kiswahili: Nijulishe mafundisho ya mausia yako, nami nitatafakari maajabu yako.
Ekegusii: Inyorokererie, erinde imanye chinchera chi’amachiiko ao, nimbe ’nkona koiranerera ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.

English: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu imechakazwa kwa huzuni, uniimarishe sawasawa na neno lako.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one obuirwe n’emechando, ’mbeeke chinguru koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

English: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
Kiswahili: Niepushe na njia za udanganyifu, kwa neema unifundishe sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Nduserie chinchera chi’obong’ainereria chibe aare korwa ase ’nde, ase obuya bwao ’nyorokererie amachiiko ao.

English: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
Kiswahili: Nimechagua njia ya kweli, nimekaza moyo wangu katika sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Inche nachoorire enchera y’ekeene, nayabeekire motwe aria gwanchiikire.

English: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
Kiswahili: Nimengʼangʼania sheria zako, Ee Bwana, usiniache niaibishwe.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nabwatereire oborori bwao, tobaisa gontiga ’nsookigwe.

English: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE
Kiswahili: Nakimbilia katika njia ya maagizo yako, kwa kuwa umeuweka moyo wangu huru.
Ekegusii: Ekero oramanyie enkoro yane obuya bwao, niminyoke ’nyigwere amachiiko ao.

English: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, nifundishe kuyafuata maagizo yako, nami nitayashika mpaka mwisho.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’nyorokererie enchera y’emeroberio yao echiikire; na inche nin’yerende goika omoerio.

English: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
Kiswahili: Nipe ufahamu, nami nitaishika sheria yako na kuitii kwa moyo wangu wote.
Ekegusii: Imanyie amachiiko ao, erinde ’n’yabwate na koyarenda nenkoro yane yonsi.

English: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
Kiswahili: Niongoze kwenye njia ya amri zako, kwa kuwa huko napata furaha.
Ekegusii: Indaae ’mbwatie enchera y’amachiiko ao, ekiagera inche nigo ’ngokirie naro.

English: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
Kiswahili: Ugeuze moyo wangu kuelekea sheria zako, na siyo kwenye mambo ya ubinafsi.
Ekegusii: Oonchore enkoro yane. Yanche oborori bwao, na toyetiga ebe nokogania kwe ribero.

English: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
Kiswahili: Geuza macho yangu kutoka kwenye mambo yasiyofaa, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na neno lako.
Ekegusii: Oyaonchore amaiso aane tarigereria amang’ana atagwenereti; ing’a obogima oboyia ’mbwatie chinchera chiao.

English: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
Kiswahili: Mtimizie mtumishi wako ahadi yako, ili upate kuogopwa.
Ekegusii: Ikerania ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo, eira kwandierete, eira eyio okoa abakoirogete.

English: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
Kiswahili: Niondolee aibu ninayoiogopa, kwa kuwa sheria zako ni njema.
Ekegusii: Induserie amang’ana y’ogochaaywa inyirogete, ekiagera aya gwachiikire nigo are amaya.

English: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi ninavyoonea shauku mausia yako! Hifadhi maisha yangu katika haki yako.
Ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo ’nganetie koigwera amachiiko ao; ing’a obogima oboyia goetera ase oboronge bwao.

English: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, upendo wako usiokoma unijie, wokovu wako sawasawa na ahadi yako,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, orokia ase ’nde obwanchani bwao botakoera, naende ontoorie buna kwandierete eira.

English: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
Kiswahili: ndipo nitakapomjibu anayenidhihaki, kwa kuwa ninalitumainia neno lako.
Ekegusii: Erio inyore ring’ana ’ndairanerie abwo bagonchecheria, ekiagera nigo ’nyegenete ring’ana riao.

English: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
Kiswahili: Usilinyakue neno la kweli kutoka kinywani mwangu, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu katika amri zako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa korusia nonya ng’ake ring’ana ri’ekeene korwa ase omonwa one, ekiagera nigo ’nsemeretie aria gwachiikire.

English: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Nitaitii amri yako daima, naam, milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkoigwera amachiiko ao botambe goika kare na kare.

English: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
Kiswahili: Nitatembea nikiwa huru, kwa kuwa nimejifunza mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ’ngotaara ase obosibore, ekiagera neorokereirie amachiiko ao.

English: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
Kiswahili: Nitasema sheria zako mbele za wafalme wala sitaaibishwa,
Ekegusii: Nindue oborori bwao ase amasio y’abarwoti ’ntari nobosooku.

English: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa ninazifurahia amri zako kwa sababu ninazipenda.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase amachiiko ao, ekiagera ayio nin’yanchete.

English: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN
Kiswahili: Ninaziinulia amri zako ambazo ninazipenda mikono yangu, nami ninatafakari juu ya maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Nindambore amaboko aane ’mbwate amachiiko ao nyanchete, na nimbe ’nkorengereria igoro y’emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka neno lako kwa mtumishi wako, kwa sababu umenipa tumaini.
Ekegusii: Inyora ring’ana riao gwakwanete ase ’nde inche omosomba oo, ekiagera ase rirorio kwang’eire ogosemeria.

English: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
Kiswahili: Faraja yangu katika mateso yangu ni hii: Ahadi yako inahifadhi maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Egekondemia ase emechando yane n’eke: Ring’ana riao nigo rigonkora naba omoyia.

English: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
Kiswahili: Wenye majivuno wamenisimanga bila kuchoka, hata hivyo sitaiacha sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu nigo bagonchecheria mono, nonya naboigo tindi gotiga amachiiko ao.

English: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ninazikumbuka sheria zako za zamani, nazo zinanifariji.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero ’nkoinyora okogaamba kwao korwa kare, nigo ’nkoba nokoremigwa.

English: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
Kiswahili: Nimeshikwa sana na ghadhabu kwa ajili ya waovu, ambao wameacha sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nde n’okogeechigwa okonene ase engencho y’abakori amabe, ekiagera bagosaria amachiiko ao.

English: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
Kiswahili: Maagizo yako ni kiini cha nyimbo zangu popote ninapoishi.
Ekegusii: Ekero imenyete ase enyomba yane y’obogeni, nabeire ’nkona‐gotererera emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wakati wa usiku ninalikumbuka jina lako, nami nitatii sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkoinyora erieta riao botuko, nigo ’ndendete amachiiko ao.

English: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH
Kiswahili: Hili limekuwa zoezi langu: nami ninayatii mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosesenigwa kwane, ng’a nabeire ’ndendete amachiiko ao.

English: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni fungu langu, nimeahidi kuyatii maneno yako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, aye negetare kiane; nariire eira koigwera amang’ana ao.

English: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
Kiswahili: Nimetafuta uso wako kwa moyo wangu wote, nihurumie sawasawa na ahadi yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogosorora nenkoro yane yonsi: Ondorere amaabera koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

English: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
Kiswahili: Nimezifikiri njia zangu na nimeelekeza hatua zangu katika mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo nareengereretie igoro ye chinchera chiane, ’nkaonchora amagoro aane ’nkabwatia oborori bwao.

English: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
Kiswahili: Nitafanya haraka bila kuchelewa kuzitii amri zako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoayerera, tingotebana koigwera amachiiko ao.

English: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
Kiswahili: Hata waovu wanifunge kwa kamba, sitasahau sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Chingori chi’abakori amabe chiang’etananire, korende tinkweba amachiiko ao.

English: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
Kiswahili: Usiku wa manane ninaamka kukushukuru kwa sababu ya sheria zako za haki.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobooka botuko gati kogoakera ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera okogaamba kwao nokoronge.

English: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni rafiki kwa wale wote wakuchao, kwa wote wanaofuata mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omogisangio bw’abwo bonsi bakoirogete, abwo barendete amachiiko ao.

English: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes. TETH
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, dunia imejaa upendo wako, nifundishe maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo boichire ase ense, ’nyorokererie imanye emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mtendee wema mtumishi wako Ee Bwana, sawasawa na neno lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao gwankoreire inche omosomba oo obuya obonge.

English: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
Kiswahili: Nifundishe maarifa na uamuzi mzuri, kwa kuwa ninaamini amri zako.
Ekegusii: Inyorokererie imanye kogaamba buya na imbe ne chisemi, ekiagera nigo ’nyegenete amachiiko ao.

English: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
Kiswahili: Kabla sijapata shida nilipotea njia, lakini sasa ninalitii neno lako.
Ekegusii: Ekero konya ’ntaraegwa egesusuro, nigo nareenge omosiru, korende bono nigo ’ndendete ring’ana riao.

English: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni mwema, unalotenda ni jema, nifundishe maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omuya, naende nigo ogokora amaya, ase ayio ’nyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
Kiswahili: Ingawa wenye majivuno wamenisingizia uongo, nitafuata mausia yako kwa moyo wangu wote.
Ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu nigo bakongamba na gokwana oborimo igoro yane, korende inche nigo ’ndendete amachiiko ao nenkoro yane yonsi.

English: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
Kiswahili: Mioyo yao ni katili na migumu, bali mimi napendezwa na sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chinorete buna ebitinya, korende inche nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase amachiiko ao.

English: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa vyema mimi kupata shida ili nipate kujifunza maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo yabeete buya mono ase ’nde konyora egesusuro keria, ekiagera ayio naro agerete neorokereirie emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
Kiswahili: Sheria inayotoka kinywani mwako ina thamani kubwa kwangu kuliko maelfu ya vipande vya fedha na dhahabu.
