Ekegusii: Amachiiko ao gwakwanete nigo are amaya ase ’nde, kobua chitaabu ne chifeta chilifu chinyinge.

English: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
Kiswahili: Mikono yako ilinifanya na kuniumba, nipe ufahamu niweze kujifunza amri zako.
Ekegusii: Amaboko ao naro ambombete akandoisia, ing’a obong’aini, erinde inyare kweorokereria amachiiko ao.

English: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
Kiswahili: Wakuchao wafurahie wanaponiona, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakoirogete ’mbandore bagoke, ekiagera ’nsemeretie ring’ana riao.

English: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ninajua kwamba sheria zako ni za haki, katika uaminifu wako umeniadhibu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nimanyete ng’a ebiina biao nebia boronge, naende ase bwegenwa bwao, nigo kwang’eire egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.

English: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
Kiswahili: Upendo wako usiokoma uwe faraja yangu, sawasawa na ahadi yako kwa mtumishi wako.
Ekegusii: Tiga obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe bondemie, koreng’ana buna kwariire eira ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo.

English: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
Kiswahili: Huruma yako na inijie ili nipate kuishi, kwa kuwa naifurahia sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Ondorere amaabera, erinde imbe moyo; inche nigo ’ngokerete amachiiko ao.

English: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
Kiswahili: Wenye majivuno na waaibishwe kwa kunikosea mimi bila sababu, lakini mimi nitatafakari juu ya mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto abamwenu barore obosooku, ekiagera bankoreire bobe engencho ende etaiyo, korende inche nigo ’nkona koiranerera amachiiko ao.

English: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
Kiswahili: Wale wakuchao na wanigeukie mimi, hao ambao wanazielewa sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto abwo bakoirogete bache ase ’nde. Abwo bamanyete oborori bwao.

English: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu usiwe na lawama katika kutii maagizo yako, ili nisiaibishwe.
Ekegusii: Tiga enkoro yane ebe etari na komocha ase emeroberio yao echiikire, erinde timbaisa konyora obosooku.

English: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu inazimia kwa kutamani wokovu wako, lakini nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one oganyoire ase okogania ogotooreka kwao, nigo ’nsemeretie ring’ana riao.

English: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yamefifia, nikingoja ahadi yako; ninasema, “Utanifajiri lini?”
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane asundokire ase okoganya ring’ana riao, nigo ’nkoboria, “Indi aye orache kondemia?”

English: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
Kiswahili: Ingawa nimekuwa kama kiriba kwenye moshi, bado sijasahau maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire buna ekerandi gi’edivai gekorire korwa ase risankwa kere ase erioki, nonya naboigo, tindeba emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
Kiswahili: Mtumishi wako itampasa angoje mpaka lini? Ni lini utawaadhibu washtaki wangu?
Ekegusii: Ngoika ririri inche omosomba oo ’ndagenderere koremereria? Ndiriri oranache ekiina ase abachaandi baane?

English: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
Kiswahili: Wenye majivuno wananichimbia mashimo, kinyume na sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu batabwateti amachiiko ao nigo bankuunyeire emetaro.

English: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
Kiswahili: Amri zako zote ni za kuaminika; unisaidie, kwa sababu watu wananishtaki bila sababu.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene, korende abanto nigo bagonchaanda ase okong’aacha. Koranche onkonye!

English: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
Kiswahili: Walikaribia kabisa kunifuta kutoka uso wa dunia, lakini sijaacha mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Barabwo babeire ang’e gonsiria aiga ase ense, nonya naboigo, tintigeti amachiiko ao.

English: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH
Kiswahili: Yahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na upendo wako, nami nitatii sheria za kinywa chako.
Ekegusii: Ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, erinde ’mbwatie oborori bwao gwakwanete.

English: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, neno lako ni la milele, linasimama imara mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ring’ana riao nigo riteneine bokong’u aaria igoro goika kare na kare.

English: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
Kiswahili: Uaminifu wako unaendelea kwa vizazi vyote, umeiumba dunia, nayo inadumu.
Ekegusii: Obwegenwa bwao nigo bogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi; aye gwatenenirie ense aase aye, ero nigo eteneine bokong’u.

English: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
Kiswahili: Sheria zako zinadumu hadi leo, kwa kuwa vitu vyote vinakutumikia.
Ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi nigo bigendererete kobao goika reero buna aye kwabichiigete, ekiagera bionsi nigo bikogokorera.

English: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
Kiswahili: Kama nisingefurahia sheria yako, ningeangamia katika taabu zangu.
Ekegusii: Onye ogochika kwao gotarenge omogooko one nanga nigo nasirete ase emechando yane.

English: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
Kiswahili: Sitasahau mausia yako kamwe, kwa maana kwayo umehifadhi maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Inche tinkonyaara kweba amachiiko ao, ekiagera aye kwang’eire obogima oboyia goetera ase aro.

English: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
Kiswahili: Uniokoe, kwa maana mimi ni wako, kwa kuwa nimetafuta mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Inche noyoo, ntoorie! Nigo nabeire ’nkona‐koinyora amachiiko ao.

English: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
Kiswahili: Waovu wanangojea kuniangamiza, bali mimi ninatafakari sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bakomboera ng’a bansirie, korende nigo ’nyigwerete oborori bwao.

English: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM
Kiswahili: Katika ukamilifu wote ninaona mna kikomo, lakini amri zako hazina mpaka.
Ekegusii: Narorire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere noboikeranu, korende amachiiko ao namaikeranu.

English: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
Kiswahili: Aha! Tazama, sheria yako naipenda mno ajabu. Ninaitafakari mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Aa! Naki inyanchete amachiiko ao! Naro nkona‐koiranerera omobaso boira.

English: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
Kiswahili: Amri zako zimenipa hekima zaidi kuliko adui zangu, kwa kuwa nimezishika daima.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko ao nigo agonkora naba omong’aini kobua ababisa baane, ekiagera ayio nigo are ase ’nde chingaki chionsi.

English: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
Kiswahili: Nina akili zaidi kuliko walimu wangu wote, kwa kuwa ninatafakari juu ya sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde nokomanya okonge kobua aborokia baane, ekiagera nigo ’nkona‐korengereria mono igoro y’oborori bwao.

English: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
Kiswahili: Nina ufahamu zaidi kuliko wazee, kwa kuwa ninayatii mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’manyete amange kobua abanto abagotu, ekiagera ’mbwatete amachiiko ao.

English: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
Kiswahili: Nimezuia miguu yangu isiende kwenye kila njia mbaya, ili niweze kutii neno lako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’ntangete amagoro aane tabaisa kobwatia enchera ende yonsi y’obobe, erinde ’nyaare korenda ring’ana riao.

English: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
Kiswahili: Sijaziacha sheria zako, kwa kuwa umenifundisha wewe mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Tindi gotiga aya gwachiikire, ekiagera naye kwanyorokereirie.

English: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi maneno yako yalivyo matamu kwangu, matamu kuliko asali katika kinywa changu!
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ao naki are amansu ase ’nde! Ee, nigo are amansu ase omonwa one kobua obooke.

English: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN
Kiswahili: Ninapata ufahamu kutoka mausia yako, kwa hiyo ninachukia kila njia ya upotovu.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko ao ang’eire obong’aini, ase ayio nigo ’ngeechete kera enchera y’obong’ainereria.

English: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Kiswahili: Neno lako ni taa ya miguu yangu na mwanga katika njia yangu.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana riao netaya ase amagoro aane na omobaso ase enchera ’ngoeta.

English: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
Kiswahili: Nimeapa na nimethibitisha, kwamba nitafuata sheria zako za haki.
Ekegusii: Natianire ng’a ning’ikeranie eira eyio yane; nimbwatie aria onsi gwachiikire ase oboronge.

English: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
Kiswahili: Nimeteseka sana, uhifadhi maisha yangu, Ee Bwana, sawasawa na neno lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nchaandegete mono, ing’a obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

English: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, pokea sifa za hiari za kinywa changu, nifundishe sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, anchera ogosaba kwane kw’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende onyorokererie aya gwachiikire.

English: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
Kiswahili: Ingawa maisha yangu yako hatarini siku zote, sitasahau sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki chionsi tinaboegererete obogima bwane, na tinebete amachiiko ao.

English: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
Kiswahili: Waovu wamenitegea mtego, lakini sijayakiuka maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe babeekire omoeto ase ’ngoeta, korende tintantaniri korwa ase amachiiko ao.

English: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Kiswahili: Sheria zako ni urithi wangu milele, naam ni furaha ya moyo wangu.
Ekegusii: Oborori bwao nabwo omwando one goika kare na kare, ee, nabwo enkoro yane egokerete mono.

English: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH
Kiswahili: Nimekusudia moyoni mwangu kuyafuata maagizo yako mpaka mwisho.
Ekegusii: Narure enkoro yane erende amachiiko ao, botambe goika omoerio.

English: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
Kiswahili: Ninachukia watu wa nia mbili, lakini ninapenda sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’ngeechete abanyamenwa ebere, korende nigo ’nyanchete amachiiko ao.

English: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni kimbilio langu na ngao yangu, nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
Ekegusii: Aye naye ore obwebisero bwane, na enguba yane, nigo ’nsemeretie ring’ana riao.

English: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Kiswahili: Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi mtendao mabaya, ili niweze kushika amri za Mungu wangu!
Ekegusii: Inwe abakori amabe, karue ase ’nde, erinde ’nyaare korenda amachiiko a Nyasae one.

English: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Kiswahili: Nihifadhi sawasawa na ahadi yako, nami nitaishi; usiache matumaini yangu yakavunjwa.
Ekegusii: Ing’a chinguru buna kwariire eira, erinde imbe moyo. Tobaisa gontiga ’ndore obosooku ase ogosemeria kwane.

English: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
Kiswahili: Nitegemeze, nami nitaokolewa, nami daima nitayaheshimu maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Imboanie kegima, ’ngitere buya, inyare gosika botambe emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
Kiswahili: Unawakataa wote wanaoyaasi maagizo yako, kwa maana udanganyifu wao ni bure.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okwanga abwo bagotantana korwa ase emeroberio yao echiikire; ee, obong’ainereria bwabo nigo bore bosa.

English: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
Kiswahili: Waovu wa nchi unawatupa kama takataka, kwa hivyo nazipenda sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo obarete abakori amabe bonsi b’ense koba bosa buna amabiria; ase ayio inche nigo inyanchete oborori bwao.

English: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN
Kiswahili: Mwili wangu unatetemeka kwa kukuogopa wewe, ninaziogopa sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Omobere one nigo okoiguswa ore n’obwoba asore, naende nairokire ebiina biao.

English: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
Kiswahili: Nimetenda yaliyo haki na sawa, usiniache mikononi mwa watesi wangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nakorire amang’ana are ay’ekeene na ay’oboronge; tontiga ase abachandi baane.

English: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
Kiswahili: Mhakikishie mtumishi wako usalama, usiache wenye kiburi wanionee.
Ekegusii: Ontenenere inche omosomba oo inyore ebisio; totiga abanto abamwenu bankorere bobe.

English: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yamefifia, yakitazamia wokovu wako, na kuitazamia ahadi yako ya kweli.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoganya ogotooreka gokorwa asore, amo nogoikeranigwa kw’eira yao y’oboronge.

English: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
Kiswahili: Mfanyie mtumishi wako kulingana na upendo wako na unifundishe maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Nkorere amaya inche omosomba oo koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, naende onyorokererie ’manye emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mtumishi wako; nipe ufahamu ili niweze kuelewa sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo, ing’a okomanya, erinde ’manye oborori bwao.

English: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wakati wako wa kutenda umewadia, kwa kuwa sheria yako inavunjwa.
Ekegusii: Engaki yaikire aye Omonene ogwenerete gokora ogokora kwao, ekiagera basaririe amachiiko ao.

English: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu nazipenda amri zako zaidi ya dhahabu, naam, zaidi ya dhahabu safi,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nigo ’nyanchete amachiiko ao kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu enkenonoku.

English: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE
Kiswahili: na kwa sababu naona maagizo yako yote ni adili, nachukia kila njia potovu.
Ekegusii: Na ase ayio nigo ndoche ng’a amachiiko ao onsi namaronge. Nigo ngeechete kera enchera y’obong’ainereria.

English: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
Kiswahili: Sheria zako ni za ajabu, hivyo ninazitii.
Ekegusii: Oborori bwao nigo bore obw’ogokumia, ase ayio nigo mbobwatete nomoyo one bwonsi.

English: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
Kiswahili: Kuingia kwa maneno yako kunaleta nuru, kunampa mjinga ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ao amaanoirwe nigo akorua omobaso na kobaa abatamanyeti amange obong’aini.

English: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
Kiswahili: Nimefungua kinywa changu na kuhema, nikitamani amri zako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngwasamia omonwa one na gwesesa, ekiagera nigo ’nde namaiga imanye amachiiko ao.

English: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
Kiswahili: Nigeukie na unihurumie, kama uwafanyiavyo siku zote wale wanaolipenda jina lako.
Ekegusii: Ndigererie, ondorere amaabera buna egwenerete abwo banchete erieta riao.

English: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
Kiswahili: Ongoza hatua zangu kulingana na neno lako, usiache dhambi yoyote initawale.
Ekegusii: Kong’ia orogendo rwane koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao, totiga obobe bongambere.

English: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
Kiswahili: Niokoe na uonevu wa wanadamu, ili niweze kutii mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Mboorie korwa ase ogochaandwa kwa Mwanyabaanto, erio nario ndanyaare korenda amachiiko ao.

English: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
Kiswahili: Mwangazie mtumishi wako uso wako na unifundishe amri zako.
Ekegusii: Mbarerie inche omosomba oo obosio bwao, na onyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE
Kiswahili: Chemchemi za machozi zinatiririka kutoka machoni yangu, kwa kuwa sheria yako haifuatwi.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkorera, naitera amariga amange mono, ekiagera abanto tibarendeti amachiiko ao.

English: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwenye haki, sheria zako ni sahihi.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ore omonyene oboronge, na okogaambera kwao n’okwaboronge.

English: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
Kiswahili: Sheria ulizoziweka ni za haki, ni za kuaminika kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Gwachiikire oborori bwao ase oboronge, na ase obwegenwa bwonsi.

English: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
Kiswahili: Jitihada yangu imenidhoofisha, kwa kuwa adui zangu wanayapuuza maneno yako.
Ekegusii: Risemi riane riandire, ekiagera ababisa baane bebire ring’ana riao.

English: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
Kiswahili: Ahadi zako zimejaribiwa kikamilifu, mtumishi wako anazipenda.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana riao riateemirwe, nigo riteneine bokong’u, na inche omosomba oo nigo ndianchete.

English: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
Kiswahili: Ingawa ni mdogo na ninadharauliwa, sisahau mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nde oyo otasikiri, naende inchayire, korende nonya naboigo tinkweba amachiiko ao.

English: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
Kiswahili: Haki yako ni ya milele, na sheria yako ni kweli.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwao nigo bore obwa kare na kare, n’amachiiko ao nigo are ay’ekeene.

English: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
Kiswahili: Shida na dhiki zimenipata, lakini amri zako ni furaha yangu.
Ekegusii: Emechando na omoichano bianyorire, korende nigo ’ngokerete amachiiko ao.

English: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH
Kiswahili: Sheria zako ni sahihi milele, hunipa ufahamu ili nipate kuishi.
Ekegusii: Oborori bwao nigo bore oboronge goika kare na kare; on g’e okomanya, erinde imbe moyo.

English: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ninakuita kwa moyo wangu wote, nami nitayatii maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’ngokorangeria nenkoro yane yonsi, inyigwe, na inche nimbwate emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
Kiswahili: Ninakuita; niokoe nami nitazishika sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorera asore, ontoorie, erinde ’mbwate oborori bwao.

English: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
Kiswahili: Ninaamka asubuhi na mapema na kukuomba msaada; nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobooka mambia chuni gokorangeria ng’a onkonye, ninsemeretie amang’ana ao.

English: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
Kiswahili: Sikufumba macho yangu usiku kucha, ili niweze kutafakari juu ya ahadi zako.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkogeesa botuko bokia, mbe nkona‐koiranerera ring’ana riao.

English: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
Kiswahili: Usikie sauti yangu sawasawa na upendo wako, Ee Bwana, uyahifadhi maisha yangu, sawasawa na sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Omonene, igwa eriogi riane ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana noboronge bwao.

English: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaopanga mipango miovu wako karibu nami, lakini wako mbali na sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakominyokera amabe bambereire ang’e; abwo nigo bare aare korwa ase amachiiko ao.

English: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, hata hivyo wewe u karibu, na amri zako zote ni za kweli.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore ang’e, n’amachiiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene.

English: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH
Kiswahili: Tangu zamani nimejifunza kutoka shuhuda zako kwamba umezithibitisha ili zidumu milele.
Ekegusii: Korwa kare nimanyete korwa ase oborori bwao ng’a naye kwabobegete bobeo goika kare na kare.

English: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
Kiswahili: Yaangalie mateso yangu, uniokoe, kwa kuwa sijasahau sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Rigereria emechando yane, ontoorie, ekiagera tinyebeti amachiiko ao.

English: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
Kiswahili: Nitetee katika hali hii yangu na unikomboe, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na ahadi yako.
Ekegusii: Indwanerere, omboorie, ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

English: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
Kiswahili: Wokovu uko mbali na waovu, kwa kuwa hawatafuti maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Ogotooreka nigo kore aare korwa ase abakori amabe, ekiagera barabwo tibari korigia emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, huruma zako ni kuu, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, amaabera ao nigo are amanene; ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nokogaamba kwao.

English: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
Kiswahili: Adui wanaonitesa ni wengi, lakini mimi sitaziacha sheria zako.
Ekegusii: Abagonchaanda na abare ababisa baane nigo bare abange, korende tinkogobera ase okorwa oborori bwao.

English: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
Kiswahili: Ninawatazama wasioamini kwa chuki, kwa kuwa hawalitii neno lako.
Ekegusii: Ekero nkorigereria abatari abegenwa nigo nkogeechigwa nabarabwo, ekiagera tibabwateti ring’ana riao.

English: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi ninavyopenda mausia yako; Ee Bwana, uyahifadhi maisha yangu, sawasawa na upendo wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, rora buna nyanchete amachiiko ao! Ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao botari koera.

English: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN
Kiswahili: Maneno yako yote ni kweli, sheria zako zote za haki ni za milele.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ao onsi nay’ekeene, na okogaamba kwao gwonsi kw’oboronge nogwa kare na kare.

English: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
Kiswahili: Watawala wamenitesa bila sababu, lakini moyo wangu unatetemeka kwa neno lako.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi nigo bagonchaanda bosa ’ntari na komocha, korende enkoro yane nigo eirogete amang’ana ao.

English: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
Kiswahili: Nafurahia ahadi zako kama mtu aliyepata mateka mengi.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkogokera ring’ana riao, naba buna oyo onyorire ebisakorwa ebinge.

English: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
Kiswahili: Ninachukia na kuchukizwa sana na uongo, lakini napenda sheria yako.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngeechete kegima oborimo bonde bwonsi, korende nigo nyanchete amachiiko ao.

English: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
Kiswahili: Ninakusifu mara saba kwa siku, kwa ajili ya sheria zako za haki.
Ekegusii: Ara gatan’akabere ase rituko nigo ’nkogotogia, ase engencho y’emeroberio yao y’oboronge echiikire.

English: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
Kiswahili: Wanaopenda sheria yako wana amani tele, wala hakuna kitu kinachoweza kuwakwaza.
Ekegusii: Abwo banchete amachiiko ao nigo bare n’omorembe omonene mono, kende tikeri gekobagoocha.

English: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ninangojea wokovu wako, nami ninafuata amri zako,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nganyete ng’a ontoorie, naende nigo ’ngokora buna amachiiko ao agoteeba.

English: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
Kiswahili: Ninazitii sheria zako, kwa sababu ninazipenda mno.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo obwatete oborori bwao, nigo ’mbwanchete mono.

English: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV
Kiswahili: Nimetii mausia yako na sheria zako, kwa kuwa njia zangu zote zinajulikana kwako.
Ekegusii: Nigo imbwatete amachiiko ao, na oborori bwao, ekiagera nigo omanyete chinchera chiane chionsi.

English: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kilio changu na kifike mbele zako, nipe ufahamu sawasawa na neno lako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tiga okorera kwane goike ase obosio bwao; ing’a obong’aini koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao!

English: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
Kiswahili: Maombi yangu na yafike mbele zako, niokoe sawasawa na ahadi yako.
Ekegusii: Tiga ogosaba kwane goike asore; ontoorie koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao!

English: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
Kiswahili: Midomo yangu na ibubujike sifa, kwa kuwa unanifundisha maagizo yako.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkona‐kogotogia nebikoba biane, ekiagera aye kwanyorokereirie ’manye emeroberio yao echiikire.

English: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wangu na uimbe kuhusu neno lako, kwa kuwa amri zako zote ni za haki.
Ekegusii: Oromeme rwane ’ndoteere ring’ana riao, ekiagera amachiiko ao onsi nigo are amaronge.

English: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
Kiswahili: Mkono wako uwe tayari kunisaidia, kwa kuwa nimechagua mausia yako.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kwao, tiga kobe ang’e gonkonya, ekiagera nachoorire kobwatia amachiiko ao.

English: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ninatamani wokovu wako, na sheria yako ni furaha yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nde namaiga ng’a ontoorie, n’amachiiko ao nigo angogetie mono.

English: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
Kiswahili: Nijalie kuishi ili nipate kukusifu, na sheria zako zinitegemeze.
Ekegusii: Tiga omoyo one obe moyo, erinde ’ngotogie, na aya gwachiikire, tiga ankonye.

English: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
Kiswahili: Nimetangatanga kama kondoo aliyepotea. Mtafute mtumishi wako, kwa kuwa sijasahau amri zako.
Ekegusii: Inche nasirire buna eng’ondi ensiru, ’ndigie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera tinyebeti amachiiko ao.

English: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Katika dhiki yangu namwita Bwana, naye hunijibu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ’nde n’emechando nigo ’nkorera ase Omonene, ere nigo akonyigwa.

English: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uniokoe kutoka midomo ya uongo na ndimi za udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase abanto abanyaborimo, bare ne chimeme chi’obong’ainereria.

English: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
Kiswahili: Atakufanyia nini, au akufanyie nini zaidi, ewe ulimi mdanganyifu?
Ekegusii: Inwe abamore ne chimeme chi’obong’ainereria, ngento ki moraegwe, na mang’ana ki naende morakorerwe?

English: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
Kiswahili: Atakuadhibu kwa mishale mikali ya shujaa, kwa makaa yanayowaka ya mti wa mretemu.
Ekegusii: Mobetwe chinsara chinyoge chi’omorwani etuoni, na mosambwe n’omorero bw’amakara ’omote okorokwa omoretemu.

English: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
Kiswahili: Ole wangu kwa kuwa naishi Mesheki, kwamba naishi katikati ya hema za Kedari!
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwane, ekiagera ’nde omomenyi agwo Meseki, nigo imenyete ase egati y’Abakedari.

English: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
Kiswahili: Nimeishi muda mrefu mno miongoni mwa wale wanaochukia amani.
Ekegusii: Nabeire imenyete ase engaki entambe ase egati y’ abanto bageechete omorembe.

English: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mtu wa amani; lakini ninaposema, wao wanataka vita.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’ngokora omorembe, korende ekero ’ngokwana, barabwo nigo baganetie esegi.

English: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Nayainua macho yangu nitazame vilima, msaada wangu utatoka wapi?
Ekegusii: Ninyimokererie amaiso aane gochia ase ebitunwa. Ogokonywa kwane, ng’ai korarwe?

English: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Kiswahili: Msaada wangu hutoka kwa Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.
Ekegusii: Ogokonywa kwane nigo korarwe ase Omonene, oyotongete igoro na ense.

English: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
Kiswahili: Hatauacha mguu wako uteleze, yeye akulindaye hatasinzia,
Ekegusii: Ere tagotiga okogoro kwao gotererigwe; oyokorendete tagosundoka.

English: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
Kiswahili: hakika, yeye alindaye Israeli hatasinzia wala hatalala usingizi.
Ekegusii: Ee, ere omorendi bw’Abaisraeli tagosundoka, gose takorara.

English: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
Kiswahili: Bwana anakulinda, Bwana ni uvuli wako mkono wako wa kuume,
Ekegusii: Omonene nere omorendi oo, nere ekiriri kiao ase ensemo y’okoboko kwao kwa borio.

English: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
Kiswahili: jua halitakudhuru mchana, wala mwezi wakati wa usiku.
Ekegusii: Erioba tirikogoaka omobaso, gose omotienyi obotuko.

English: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakukinga na madhara yote, atayalinda maisha yako,
Ekegusii: Omonene nakorende korwa ase amabe onsi, narende omoyo oo.

English: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakulinda unapoingia na unapotoka, tangu sasa na hata milele.
Ekegusii: Omonene nakorende kogosoa na kogosoka, korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

English: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Daudi. Nilishangilia pamoja na wale walioniambia, “Twende nyumbani ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Nigo nagogete na baria banteebetie, “Inchuo, togende ase enyomba y’Omonene!”

English: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
Kiswahili: Ee Yerusalemu, miguu yetu imesimama malangoni mwako.
Ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, bono amagoro aito nigo ateneine aa ase ebiita biao.

English: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
Kiswahili: Yerusalemu imejengwa vyema kama mji ambao umeshikamanishwa pamoja.
Ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu kwaagachirwe naende aye n’omochie obwateranirie amo.

English: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.
Kiswahili: Huko ndiko makabila hukwea, makabila ya Bwana, kulisifu jina la Bwana kulingana na maagizo waliopewa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Agwo nao ebisaku bigotiira gochia, ebio bire ebisaku bi’Omonene. Abaisraeli abwo nigo bachigetwe ng’a babe bakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta ri’Omonene.

English: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
Kiswahili: Huko viti vya enzi vya hukumu hukaa, viti vya enzi vya nyumba ya Daudi.
Ekegusii: Agwo nao ebirogo bi’abanachi ebiina bire, ebirogo bi’obonene bi’enyomba ya Daudi.

English: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
Kiswahili: Omba kwa ajili ya amani ya Yerusalemu: “Wote wakupendao na wawe salama.
Ekegusii: Sabera Yerusalemu, erinde obe n’omorembe! Abanto abwo bagwanchete tiga basesenigwe.

English: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
Kiswahili: Amani na iwepo ndani ya kuta zako na usalama ndani ya ngome zako.”
Ekegusii: Omorembe obe ase chindwaki chiao ime, na ogosesenigwa kobe ase chinyomba chiao chi’oborwoti.

English: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya ndugu zangu na marafiki, nitasema, “Amani iwe ndani yako.”
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’abaminto na abagisangio baane, nigo ’ngokoganeria omorembe.

English: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wetu, nitatafuta mafanikio yako.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae oito ningosabere ebisio.

English: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Ninayainua macho yangu kwako, kwako wewe ambaye kiti chako cha enzi kiko mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ninyimokererie amaiso aane goocha agwo asore, igoro ase obomenyo bwao.

English: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.
Kiswahili: Kama vile macho ya watumwa yatazamavyo mkono wa bwana wao, kama vile macho ya mtumishi wa kike yatazamavyo mkono wa bibi yake, ndivyo macho yetu yamtazamavyo Bwana Mungu wetu, mpaka atakapotuhurumia.
Ekegusii: Ama! Buna koreng’ana abasomba basemeretie omonene obo, na abasomba abaiseke basemeretie omoteneneri obo omokungu; naboigo naintwe tosemeretie Omonene Nyasae oito, goika abe otororeire amaabera.

English: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
Kiswahili: Uturehemu, Ee Bwana, uturehemu, kwa maana tumevumilia dharau nyingi.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otororere amaabera, koranche otororere amaabera, ekiagera twabeire togochecherigwa mono goetania.

English: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
Kiswahili: Tumevumilia dhihaka nyingi kutoka kwa wenye kiburi, dharau nyingi kutoka kwa wenye majivuno.
Ekegusii: Twaichoirwe n’echaayo y’abwo beisanekerete, na ogochecherigwa kw’abamwenu.

English: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Daudi. Kama Bwana asingalikuwa upande wetu; Israeli na aseme sasa:
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa Daudi) Inee! Naki yare goocha koba onye Omonene atabeete ase ensemo yaito? Tiga Abaisraeli bairanerie.

English: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
Kiswahili: kama Bwana asingalikuwa upande wetu, wakati watu walipotushambulia,
Ekegusii: Onye Omonene atabeete ase ensemo yaito, ekero abanto batoumokerete gotorwania,

English: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,
Kiswahili: wakati hasira yao ilipowaka dhidi yetu, wangalitumeza tungali hai,
Ekegusii: nanga nigo batomerete gatore moyo, ekiagera babete n’endamwamu enene ase tore;

English: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
Kiswahili: mafuriko yangalitugharikisha, maji mengi yangalitufunika,
Ekegusii: naende emerindo nigo yarenge goocha gotokorobanania, eooro nigo yarenge goocha goeta igoro yaito;

English: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
Kiswahili: maji yaendayo kasi yangalituchukua.
Ekegusii: ee, amaache aichoreranete nigo arenge goocha gotomera kegima.

English: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Kiswahili: Bwana asifiwe, yeye ambaye hakuruhusu turaruliwe kwa meno yao.
Ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera tatoruete totaboranwe namaino y’ abanto abwo.

English: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
Kiswahili: Tumeponyoka kama ndege kutoka mtego wa mwindaji; mtego umevunjika, nasi tukaokoka.
Ekegusii: Emioyo yaito yatoorekire buna enyoni egotooreka korwa ase egesuguni ki’omotegi. Egesuguni kiabutokire, naintwe twaminchoirie na gotama.

English: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
Kiswahili: Msaada wetu ni katika jina la Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.
Ekegusii: Ogokonywa gwaito nigo gokorwa ase erieta ri’Omonene, oyio otongete igoro na ense.

English: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wale wamtumainio Bwana ni kama mlima Sayuni, ambao hauwezi kutikisika, bali wadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Abwo bamosemeretie Omonene nigo banga buna egetunwa gia Sayoni getari konyegerigwa, korende nigo kegendererete kobao botambe.

English: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
Kiswahili: Kama milima inavyozunguka Yerusalemu, ndivyo Bwana anavyowazunguka watu wake sasa na hata milele.
Ekegusii: Buna ebitunwa bietanaine Yerusalemu, naboigo Omonene abaetanaine abanto baye korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

English: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
Kiswahili: Fimbo ya waovu haitadumu juu ya nchi waliopewa wenye haki, ili wenye haki wasije wakatumia mikono yao kutenda ubaya.
Ekegusii: Enyimbo y’obogaambi y’abakori amabe tekogenderera kogambera omwando bw’ abanto abaronge; abwo baabaise korambora amaboko abo ase ogokora amabe.

English: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, watendee mema walio wema, wale walio wanyofu wa moyo.
Ekegusii: Omonene, bakorere amaya abanto abwo bare abaya, abwo bare ne chinkoro chinyegenwa!

English: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
Kiswahili: Bali wale wanaogeukia njia zilizopotoka, Bwana atawafukuza pamoja na watenda mabaya. Amani iwe juu ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende abwo bakogobera gochia ase chinchera chiabo chi’obosiru, Omonene nabarusieo amo nabagokora amabe. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!

English: A Song of Ascents. When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Bwana alipowarejeza mateka Sayuni, tulikuwa kama watu walioota ndoto.
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene atoiraneretie intwe Abasayoni ebisio bieito, nigo twabeete buna abakoroota!

English: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”
Kiswahili: Vinywa vyetu vilijaa kicheko, ndimi zetu zilijaa nyimbo za shangwe. Ndipo iliposemwa miongoni mwa mataifa, “Bwana amewatendea mambo makuu.”
Ekegusii: Erio emenwa yaito egaichorwa namaseko, ne chimeme chiaito chigatera as’omogooko. Erio abanto b’ebisaku bagateebania, “Omonene okoreire abanto abwo amang’ana amanene.”

English: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametutendea mambo makuu, nasi tumejaa furaha.
Ekegusii: Ee, Omonene otokoreire amang’ana amanene; ase igo ntore n’omogooko.

English: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, turejeshee watu wetu waliotekwa, kama vijito katika Negebu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toiranerie ebisio biaito, buna okoirania chindooche ase Ense ya Irianyi.

English: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
Kiswahili: Wapandao kwa machozi watavuna kwa nyimbo za shangwe.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakobusura bare namariga mbagese bare nomochengo.

English: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
Kiswahili: Yeye azichukuaye mbegu zake kwenda kupanda, huku akilia, atarudi kwa nyimbo za shangwe, akichukua miganda ya mavuno yake.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagosoka bakoiyeria amariga, babogoretie chimbusuro gochia kobusura mbairane bare n’omochengo, babogoretie emesaima yabo bagesire.

English: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Solomoni. Bwana asipoijenga nyumba, wajengao hufanya kazi bure. Bwana asipoulinda mji, walinzi wakesha bure.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Sulemani) Onye Omonene takoagaacha enyomba, abwo bakoyeagaacha nigo bagokora emeremo ya bosa. Onye Omonene takorenda omochie omonto oyio okoyorenda nigo akorenda bosa.

English: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
Kiswahili: Mnajisumbua bure kuamka mapema na kuchelewa kulala, mkitaabikia chakula: kwa maana yeye huwapa usingizi wapenzi wake.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa ase more kobooka mambia chuni na gokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora endagera, naende mwanyorwa gochia korara. Korende Omonene nigo agwechaandera abanto baye anchete, nonya nekero baraire chitoro.

English: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
Kiswahili: Wana ni urithi utokao kwa Bwana, watoto ni zawadi kutoka kwake.
Ekegusii: Rora, abana nigo bare omwando okorwa ase Omonene, ekiagera oroiboro rokorwa ase enda nigo rore ekeegwa.

English: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
Kiswahili: Kama mishale mikononi mwa shujaa ndivyo walivyo wana awazaao mtu katika ujana wake.
Ekegusii: Abana omonto akonyora kare ne’chinguru chi’obosae bwaye, nigo banga buna chinsara chire koboko kw’omorwani etuoni.

English: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu ambaye podo lake limejazwa nao. Hawataaibishwa wanaposhindana na adui zao langoni.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyo oichoretie esaaro yaye ne chinsara echio. Oyio takobugwa ekero arabe okogamberana nababisa baye agwo ase ekegambero gia’etureti.

English: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Heri ni wale wote wamchao Bwana, waendao katika njia zake.
Ekegusii: Naki agasesenirie omonto omoirogete Omonene, naende obwatete chinchera chiaye!

English: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
Kiswahili: Utakula matunda ya kazi yako; baraka na mafanikio vitakuwa vyako.
Ekegusii: Aye nobe gokonyora okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko ao; nosesenigwe, na amang’ana onsi nigo arabe buya asore.

English: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
Kiswahili: Mke wako atakuwa kama mzabibu uzaao ndani ya nyumba yako; wana wako watakuwa kama machipukizi ya mizeituni kuizunguka meza yako.
Ekegusii: Mokao nabe ase enyomba yao buna omosabibu okwama amasabibu; abana bao nigo barabe buna ebisabo bi’omozeituni, baikaranse baetanane emesa yao.

English: Behold, this is how the man who fears Yahweh is blessed.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ndivyo atakavyobarikiwa mtu amchaye Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ama! Naboigo omonto oria omoirogete Omonene arasesenigwe.

English: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
Kiswahili: Bwana na akubariki kutoka Sayuni siku zote za maisha yako, na uone mafanikio ya Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: Omonene agosesenie korwa Sayoni! Erio orore obuya bwa Yerusalemu ase amatuko onsi ore moyo,

English: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
Kiswahili: nawe ujaliwe kuishi uone watoto wa watoto wako. Amani iwe juu ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: naende orore abaachokoro bao. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!

English: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wamenionea mno tangu ujana wangu; Israeli na aseme sasa:
Ekegusii: “Ababisa nigo batochaandete korwa oboke bwaito.” Nabo Abaisraeli bagoteeba.

English: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
Kiswahili: wamenionea mno tangu ujana wangu, lakini bado hawajanishinda.
Ekegusii: “Ee, barabwo nigo batochaandete korwa oboke bwaito, korende tibana‐gotobua.

English: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamelima mgongo wangu, na kufanya mifereji yao mirefu.
Ekegusii: Bakang’ororia emegongo yaito buna emegondo. Bakayetambeyia emeng’ororia yaabo.”

English: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana ni mwenye haki; amenifungua toka kamba za waovu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere obutoire chingori chi’abakori amabe.

English: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
Kiswahili: Wale wote waichukiao Sayuni na warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bageechete Sayoni, taga basookigwe na koiranigwa magega.

English: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
Kiswahili: Wawe kama majani juu ya paa, ambayo hunyauka kabla hayajakua;
Ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna obonyansi bore kerama igoro, bogosusana botarakina;

English: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
Kiswahili: kwa hayo mvunaji hawezi kujaza vitanga vyake, wala akusanyaye kujaza mikono yake.
Ekegusii: tibori goichora okoboko kw’omosangereria, gose kobogwa omosaima okoboko.

English: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”
Kiswahili: Wale wapitao karibu na wasiseme, “Baraka ya Bwana iwe juu yako; tunakubariki katika jina la Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Abanto bagoeta inchera tibakonyaara goteeba, “Omonene abasesenie!” Gose goteeba, “Nkobasesenia tore inwe ase erieta ri’Omonene!”

English: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Kutoka vilindini ninakulilia, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore, korwa ase chindiba ime.

English: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, sikia sauti yangu. Masikio yako na yawe masikivu kwa kilio changu unihurumie.
Ekegusii: Omonene, igwa eriogi riane; tegerera oigwe eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane.

English: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
Kiswahili: Kama wewe, Ee Bwana, ungeweka kumbukumbu ya dhambi, Ee Bwana, ni nani angeliweza kusimama?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onye ’nkware gokora omobaro bw’ebibe, ning’o ore konyaara gotenena ase obosio bwao?

English: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwako kuna msamaha, kwa hiyo wewe unaogopwa.
Ekegusii: Korende aye nigo ore omwaberi, erinde onyaare koirokwa.

English: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
Kiswahili: Namngojea Bwana, nafsi yangu inangojea, katika neno lake naweka tumaini langu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nganyete Omonene, ee, omoyo one nigo omoganyete; nigo ’nsemeretie ring’ana riaye.

English: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu inamngojea Bwana kuliko walinzi waingojeavyo asubuhi, naam, kuliko walinzi waingojeavyo asubuhi.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oganyete Omonene, kobua buna abarendi bakoganya ogokiamoka, ee, kobua abarendi baganyete ng’a bokie.

English: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
Kiswahili: Ee Israeli, mtumaini Bwana, maana kwa Bwana kuna upendo usiokoma, na kwake kuna ukombozi kamili.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nigo are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe, na ogotooreka okonge nigo gokorwa asare.

English: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
Kiswahili: Yeye mwenyewe ataikomboa Israeli kutoka dhambi zao zote.
Ekegusii: Ere naboorie Abaisraeli korwa ase ebibe biabo bionsi.

English: A Song of Ascents. By David. Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Daudi. Moyo wangu hauna kiburi, Ee Bwana, macho yangu hayajivuni; sijishughulishi na mambo makuu kunizidi wala mambo ya ajabu mno kwangu.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa Daudi) Omonene, ase enkoro yane tindi kweimokereria igoro, gose tindi omwerori. Inche tinyechaandeti kwerigeria amang’ana amanene, gose ayaare amakong’u mono ase ’nde.

English: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
Kiswahili: Lakini nimetuliza na kunyamazisha nafsi yangu; kama mtoto aliyeachishwa kunyonya na mama yake, kama mtoto aliyeachishwa kunyonya ndivyo ilivyo nafsi iliyoko ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nigo intoereretie omoyo one; buna omwana otigire okogonka oagatire koboko kwa ng’ina, ee, naboigo omoyo one ore ime yane.

English: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.
Kiswahili: Ee Israeli, mtumaini Bwana tangu sasa na hata milele.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

English: A Song of Ascents. Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Ee Bwana, mkumbuke Daudi na taabu zote alizozistahimili.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oinyore Daudi, ase engencho y’obokong’u bwonsi bwamonyoorete.

English: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
Kiswahili: Aliapa kiapo kwa Bwana na akaweka nadhiri kwa Yule Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo:
Ekegusii: Oinyore buna ariete eira na gotiana asore aye Omonene ore Chinguru chia Yakobo, agateeba,

English: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
Kiswahili: “Sitaingia nyumbani mwangu au kwenda kitandani mwangu:
Ekegusii: “Tingosoa nyomba mwane, gose tinkoriina borere korara;

English: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
Kiswahili: sitaruhusu usingizi katika macho yangu, wala kope zangu kusinzia,
Ekegusii: tingwancha korara chitoro, gose gosundoka,

English: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
Kiswahili: mpaka nitakapompatia Bwana mahali, makao kwa ajili ya Yule Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo.”
Ekegusii: goika inyore aase, agwo arabe obomenyo bw’Oyore Chinguru chia Yakobo.”

English: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.
Kiswahili: Tulisikia habari hii huko Efrathi, tulikutana nayo katika mashamba ya Yaara:
Ekegusii: Ama! Agwo Efarata tokaigwa amang’ana igoro y’Esanduki y’Okobwatana, tokayenyora aaria ase orosana rwa Yearimu.

English: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”
Kiswahili: “Twendeni kwenye makao yake, na tuabudu kwenye kiti cha kuwekea miguu yake;
Ekegusii: “Inchuo togende ase obomenyo bw’Omonene, tosasiime agwo ase egeteni kiaye kia amagoro!”

English: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
Kiswahili: inuka, Ee Bwana, uje mahali pako pa kupumzikia, wewe na Sanduku la nguvu zako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka ochiche aase ao ogotimokera, aye amo n’Esanduki eria ekworokia okobua kwao.

English: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!
Kiswahili: Makuhani wako na wavikwe haki, watakatifu wako na waimbe kwa furaha.”
Ekegusii: Tiga abakuani bao beboyie oboronge, na abanto bao abachenu babe bagoaka amariogi y’omogooko.

English: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya Daudi mtumishi wako, usimkatae mpakwa mafuta wako.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba oo, tobaisa kwanga korigereria omoakwa amaguta oo.

English: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
Kiswahili: Bwana alimwapia Daudi kiapo, kiapo cha uhakika ambacho hatakitangua: “Nitamweka mmoja wa wazao wako mwenyewe katika kiti chako cha enzi,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tokonyaara gotiga eira eyio kwarierete Daudi ase ogotiana, ogateeba: “Oyomo bw’oroiboro rwao nimobeeke aikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogaambi.

English: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
Kiswahili: kama wanao watashika Agano langu na sheria ninazowafundisha, ndipo wana wao watarithi kiti chako cha enzi milele na milele.”
Ekegusii: Abana bao kobarabwate okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, na oborori bwane ’ndaborokererie, rirorio abana baabo boigo ’mbabe bagoikaransa ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogaambi kogenderera botambe.”

English: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana ameichagua Sayuni, amepaonea shauku pawe maskani yake:
Ekegusii: Omonene ochorire Sayoni; nigo aganetie obe obomenyo bwaye, oteebire,

English: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.
Kiswahili: “Hapa ni mahali pangu pa kupumzika milele na milele; hapa ndipo nitakapoketi nikitawala, kwa sababu nimepaonea shauku:
Ekegusii: “Aase aa nao obotimokero bwane bwa botambe, aa nao ’ndabe ’nkomenya, ekiagera naanchire.

English: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
Kiswahili: Nitambariki kwa kumpa mahitaji tele: nitashibisha maskini wake kwa chakula.
Ekegusii: Ninsesenie omochie oyo obe n’ebinto bionsi biganeirie, abaremeire endagera nimbaigotie.

English: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
Kiswahili: Nitawavika makuhani wake wokovu, nao watakatifu wake watadumu wakiimba kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Nimboyie abakuani b’omochie oyo nogotooreka, na abachenu baye ’mbabe bagoaka amariogi y’omogooko.

English: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
Kiswahili: “Hapa nitamchipushia Daudi pembe, na kuweka taa kwa ajili ya masiya wangu.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo nimererie Daudi orogunchara, ekiagera nimwokerie omoakwa amaguta one etaya.

English: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
Kiswahili: Adui zake nitawavika aibu, bali taji kichwani pake itangʼaa sana.”
Ekegusii: Ninsookie ababisa baye kegima, korende egutwa y’omotwe oye omonyene negenderere komekameka.”

English: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Daudi. Tazama jinsi ilivyo vyema na kupendeza wakati ndugu wanapoishi pamoja katika umoja!
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa Daudi) Rora buna ere buya na okogokia okonene ekero abanto abamo bakomenya amo, baigwanaine.

English: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
Kiswahili: Ni kama mafuta ya thamani yaliyomiminwa kichwani, yakitiririka kwenye ndevu, yakitiririka kwenye ndevu za Aroni, mpaka kwenye upindo wa mavazi yake.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo anga buna amaguta akweakwa are amaya mono, akonyororoka gochia ase chinderu chia Aroni, aitekera omokoba bwe rigoti ri’omwambaro oye.

English: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
Kiswahili: Ni kama vile umande wa Hermoni unavyoanguka juu ya Mlima Sayuni. Kwa maana huko ndiko Bwana alikoamuru baraka yake, naam, hata uzima milele.
Ekegusii: Naende nigo anga buna riime ria Herimoni, rigotonya igoro y’ebitunwa bia Sayoni. Aroro agwo Omonene ochiikire ogosesenigwa na obogima botari nomoerio.

English: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Msifuni Bwana, ninyi nyote watumishi wa Bwana, ninyi mnaotumika usiku ndani ya nyumba ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inchuo motogie Omonene, inwe abasomba baye mwensi, inwe abamokomokorera ase enyomba yaye botuko.

English: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
Kiswahili: Inueni mikono yenu katika pale patakatifu na kumsifu Bwana.
Ekegusii: Rambora amaboko aino gochia Aase Aachenu, motogie Omonene!

English: May Yahweh bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia, awabariki kutoka Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Omonene, oria otongete igoro na ense, agosesenie korwa Sayoni!

English: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Lisifuni jina la Bwana, msifuni, enyi watumishi wa Bwana,
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Togia erieta ri’Omonene! Inwe abasomba ba Omonene, motogie!

English: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
Kiswahili: ninyi ambao mnatumika ndani ya nyumba ya Bwana, katika nyua za nyumba ya Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Inwe aba mogotenena ase enyomba y’Omonene, agwo ase chigoora chi’enyomba ya Nyasae oito, motogie!

English: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana, kwa kuwa Bwana ni mwema, liimbieni sifa jina lake, kwa maana hilo lapendeza.
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, ekiagera ere nigo are omuya, terera erieta riaye, ekiagera nigo rire eriansu.

English: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana amemchagua Yakobo kuwa wake mwenyewe, Israeli kuwa mali yake ya thamani.
Ekegusii: Omonene bwechooreire Yakobo, bwechooreire Abaisraeli koba aba aye bori.

English: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
Kiswahili: Ninajua ya kuwa Bwana ni mkuu, kwamba Bwana wetu ni mkuu kuliko miungu yote.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo imanyete ng’a Omonene nigo are omonene; ee, Omonene oito nigo are igoro ye’chinyasae chionsi.

English: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
Kiswahili: Bwana hufanya lolote apendalo, mbinguni na duniani, katika bahari na vilindi vyake vyote.
Ekegusii: Kende gionsi Omonene agwancha gokora nigo akogekora; gokeraabe ase ense, gose igoro, gose ase enyancha, gose ase chindiba.

English: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.
Kiswahili: Hufanya mawingu kupanda kutoka miisho ya dunia; hupeleka umeme wa radi pamoja na mvua na huleta upepo kutoka ghala zake.
Ekegusii: Nere okorenta amare korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense; nere okorenta chinkoba chire nembura, na omwaga okogusa korwa ase ebigancha biaye.

English: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
Kiswahili: Alimuua mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa wanadamu na wanyama.
Ekegusii: Nere oitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.

English: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
Kiswahili: Alipeleka ishara zake na maajabu katikati yako, ee Misri, dhidi ya Farao na watumishi wake wote.
Ekegusii: Nere okorete ebikone na amakumia ase egati yao, aye Misiri, na ase Farao amo nabasomba baye.

English: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—
Kiswahili: Aliyapiga mataifa mengi, na akaua wafalme wenye nguvu:
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo asiretie ebisaku ebinge, na agaita abarwoti barenge ne’chinguru;

English: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—
Kiswahili: Mfalme Sihoni na Waamori, Ogu mfalme wa Bashani na wafalme wote wa Kanaani:
Ekegusii: Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani; boigo agasiria amarwoti onsi a Kaanani.

English: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
Kiswahili: akatoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, urithi kwa watu wake Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ense y’ebisaku ebio akayea Abaisraeli, abanto baye, ekaba omwando obo.

English: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, jina lako ladumu milele, kumbukumbu za fahari zako, Ee Bwana, kwa vizazi vyote.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, erieta riao nigo rigendererete kobao goika kare na kare. Nobe gokoinyorwa nebiaare bionsi.

English: For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
Kiswahili: Maana Bwana atawathibitisha watu wake, na kuwahurumia watumishi wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene narwanerere abanto baye, narorere abasomba baye amaabera.

English: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
Kiswahili: Sanamu za mataifa ni fedha na dhahabu, zilizotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Emegwekano egosasiimwa n’abanto b’ebisaku nigo eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitaabu; nigo ere emeremo y’amaboko a Mwanyabaanto.

English: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
Kiswahili: Zina vinywa, lakini haziwezi kusema, zina macho, lakini haziwezi kuona;
Ekegusii: Nigo ebwate emenwa, korende teri gokwana, nebwate amaiso, korende teri korora,

English: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
Kiswahili: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, wala hakuna pumzi katika vinywa vyao.
Ekegusii: nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, gose tebwati omoika bw’okoeyana.

English: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaozitengeneza watafanana nazo, vivyo hivyo wale wote wanaozitumainia.
Ekegusii: Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nigo banga buna ero, ee, naboigo abwo bonsi bayiegenete.

English: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
Kiswahili: Ee nyumba ya Israeli, msifuni Bwana; ee nyumba ya Aroni, msifuni Bwana;
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, togia Omonene! Nainwe ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni, togia Omonene!

English: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
Kiswahili: ee nyumba ya Lawi, msifuni Bwana; ninyi mnaomcha, msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeeria rwa Lawi, togia Omonene! Nainwe abamoirogete Omonene, motogie!

English: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana kutoka Sayuni, msifuni yeye aishiye Yerusalemu. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene tiga atogigwe korwa Sayoni, Omonene oria omenyete Yerusalemu. Motogie Omonene!

English: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Mungu wa miungu. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Moakere Nyasae, oyobuete chinyasae, ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Bwana wa mabwana: Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Moakere Omonene bw’abanene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Kwake yeye pekee atendaye maajabu makuu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Nere bweka okorete amakumia amanene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Ambaye kwa ufahamu wake aliziumba mbingu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere ase obong’aini bwaye nigo atongete igoro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Ambaye aliitandaza dunia juu ya maji, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere oramborete ense, akayiaara ase amaache, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Ambaye aliumba mianga mikubwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere okorete emebaso eria emenene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Jua litawale mchana, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka risase rigambe mobaso, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Mwezi na nyota vitawale usiku, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni bigambe botuko, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Kwake yeye aliyemuua mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Na kuwatoa Israeli katikati yao, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Erio akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase Abamisiri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Kwa mkono wenye nguvu ulionyooshwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Akabarusia aroro n’okoboko kwaye gwe chinguru koramboire, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Kwake yeye aliyeigawa Bahari ya Shamu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo aatananete Enyancha Embariri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Na kuwapitisha Israeli katikati yake, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Erio akaambokeria Abaisraeli aroro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Lakini alimfagia Farao na jeshi lake katika Bahari ya Shamu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere akarimeria Farao amo nemeganda yaye ase Enyancha Embariri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Kwake yeye aliyewaongoza watu wake katika jangwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo araaete abanto baye goetera ase erooro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Ambaye aliwapiga wafalme wenye nguvu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abarwoti barenge ne’chinguru, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Naye aliwaua wafalme wenye nguvu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abarwoti abaakumete, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Agaita Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamoni, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Agaita na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Akatoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Akabaura chinse chiabo chikaba omwando bw’ abanto baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Urithi kwa Israeli mtumishi wake, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Chinse echio chikaba omwando bw’Abaisraeli, abasomba baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Aliyetukumbuka katika unyonge wetu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo atoinyorete ekero twarenge aboororo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;
Kiswahili: Alituweka huru toka adui zetu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo atotooretie korwa ase ababisa baito, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Ambaye humpa chakula kila kiumbe. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorua endagera oa ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Kiswahili: Mshukuruni Mungu wa mbinguni, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
Ekegusii: Moakere Nyasae o igoro ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

English: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
Kiswahili: Kando ya mito ya Babeli tuliketi, tukaomboleza tulipokumbuka Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Nigo twarenge goikaransa ase chingegu chie chindooche chia Babiloni, twaba tokorera ekero twarenge koinyora Sayoni.

English: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
Kiswahili: Kwenye miti ya huko tulitundika vinubi vyetu,
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo nigo twasungete amakano aito ase emete enga buna emesobeti.

English: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
Kiswahili: kwa maana huko hao waliotuteka walitaka tuwaimbie nyimbo, watesi wetu walidai nyimbo za furaha; walisema, “Tuimbieni wimbo mmoja kati ya nyimbo za Sayuni!”
Ekegusii: Abanto baria batwosete bakagania tobaterere, abachandi abwo baito bakagania tobagokie, bagateeba, “Toterere ogoteera gwa Sayoni.”

English: How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?
Kiswahili: Tutaimbaje nyimbo za Bwana, tukiwa nchi ya kigeni?
Ekegusii: Naki torakore totere ogoteera kw’Omonene ase ense engeni?

English: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
Kiswahili: Nikikusahau wewe, ee Yerusalemu, basi mkono wangu wa kuume na usahau ujuzi wake.
Ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, inse gokweba, rirorio okoboko kwane gw’okorio kogatae.

English: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wangu ushikamane na kaakaa la kinywa changu kama sitakukumbuka wewe, kama nisipokufikiri Yerusalemu kuwa furaha yangu kubwa.
Ekegusii: Onye tingokoinyora aye Yerusalemu, erinde obe omogooko one omonene mono, rirorio tiga oromeme rwane robwatane namang’ang’ura.

English: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
Kiswahili: Kumbuka, Ee Bwana, walichokifanya Waedomu, siku ile Yerusalemu ilipoanguka. Walisema, “Bomoa, Bomoa mpaka kwenye misingi yake!”
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora amabe aya abanto b’Edomu bakorete ase rituko riria Yerusalemu obwatetwe; buna bateebete, “Yotagore kegima! Yotagore amo noboroso bwaye!”

English: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
Kiswahili: Ee binti Babeli, uliyehukumiwa kuangamizwa, heri yeye atakayekulipiza wewe kwa yale uliyotutenda sisi:
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Babiloni nigo mogochia gosirigwa. Nagoke oyio ogochia kobaakana amabe aya mwabeire mogotokorera.

English: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
Kiswahili: yeye ambaye atawakamata watoto wako wachanga na kuwaponda juu ya miamba.
Ekegusii: Nachenge omonto oyio ogochia koira abana baino abake na kobaakera ase amagena y’Ebitare.

English: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, kwa moyo wangu wote, mbele ya “miungu” nitaimba sifa zako.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkogoakera ng’a mbuya mono n’enkoro yane yonsi, ningoterere na kogotogia ase obosio bwe chinyasae.

English: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
Kiswahili: Nitasujudu nikielekea Hekalu lako takatifu, nami nitalisifu jina lako kwa ajili ya upendo wako na uaminifu, kwa kuwa umelikuza jina lako na neno lako juu ya vitu vyote.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogosasiima ndigereretie gochia ase Hekalu yao Enchenu, naaka ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase obwegenwa bwao. Aye gwakorire eira yao koba enene goetania onsi aya erieta riao riatoteebetie.

English: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
Kiswahili: Nilipoita, ulinijibu; ulinifanya jasiri na mwenye moyo hodari.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria nakorangeretie, nigo kwanyigwete, okaremia omoyo one, okambeeka chinguru.

English: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
Kiswahili: Wafalme wote wa dunia wakusifu wewe Ee Bwana, wakati wanaposikia maneno ya kinywa chako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abarwoti bonsi b’ense ’mbagotogie, ekero baraigwe amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo;

English: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!
Kiswahili: Wao na waimbe kuhusu njia za Bwana, kwa maana utukufu wa Bwana ni mkuu.
Ekegusii: ’mbabe bagotera igoro y’ogokora kwao, aye Omonene, ekiagera obonene bwao nigo bore obonene mono.

English: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
Kiswahili: Ingawa Bwana yuko juu, humwangalia mnyonge, bali mwenye kiburi yeye anamjua kutokea mbali.
Ekegusii: Nony’Omonene ore igoro aare, nigo arooche abanto abaitongo, korende abare abaenenu nigo akobamanya kobare aare.

English: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
Kiswahili: Nijapopita katikati ya shida, wewe unayahifadhi maisha yangu, unanyoosha mkono wako dhidi ya hasira ya adui zangu, kwa mkono wako wa kuume unaniokoa.
Ekegusii: Nimba ngoeta ase egati y’emechando, aye nigo ondendete ngenderere koba moyo; aye nigo okorambora okoboko kwao igoro y’ababisa baane bare n’endamwamu, n’okoboko kwao gw’okorio gwantooria.

English: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
Kiswahili: Bwana atatimiza kusudi lake kwangu, Ee Bwana, upendo wako wadumu milele: usiziache kazi za mikono yako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nonyare goikerania aria kwandierete eira, ekiagera obwanchani bwao nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare. Tobaisa kweba emeremo y’amaboko ao.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, umenichunguza na kunijua.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene kwariga‐rigirie ime yane, kwamanyire inche.

English: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
Kiswahili: Unajua ninapoketi na ninapoinuka; unatambua mawazo yangu tokea mbali.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo omanyete ekero ing’ikaransete, na ekero ’nkoimoka. Nigo omanyete ebirengererio biane bionsi kore aare.

English: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
Kiswahili: Unafahamu kutoka kwangu na kulala kwangu; unaelewa njia zangu zote.
Ekegusii: Ekero ’ngotaara gose kondaire nigo omanyete; aye nigo omanyete chinchera chiane chionsi.

English: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.
Kiswahili: Kabla neno halijafika katika ulimi wangu, wewe walijua kikamilifu, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nonya nekero ’ntarakwana ring’ana rinde rionsi, Naama, aye Omonene nigo orimanyete kegima.

English: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
Kiswahili: Umenizunguka nyuma na mbele; umeweka mkono wako juu yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ong’etanaine ase chinsemo chionsi, na nigo obegete okoboko kwao igoro yane ondendete.

English: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
Kiswahili: Maarifa haya ni ya ajabu mno kwangu, ni ya juu sana kwangu kuyafikia.
Ekegusii: Okomanya okwo nigo kore okw’ogokumia ase ’nde; nigo kore okonene mono, tinkonyaara gokomanya.

English: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
Kiswahili: Niende wapi nijiepushe na Roho yako? Niende wapi niukimbie uso wako?
Ekegusii: Ng’ai ’ndagende, erinde ntigane n’Omoika oo? Gose ng’ai ’ndatame gochia, ’ndue ase obosio bwao?

English: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
Kiswahili: Kama nikienda juu mbinguni, wewe uko huko; nikifanya vilindi kuwa kitanda changu, wewe uko huko.
Ekegusii: Ninsa koriina gochia igoro, aye nao ore; ninsa kwara ekerarero kiane agwo aase abakuure, aye nao ore.

English: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
Kiswahili: Kama nikipanda juu ya mbawa za mapambazuko, kama nikikaa pande za mbali za bahari,
Ekegusii: Ninsa koirurukigwa namasase a mambia, ingende komenya ase chinsinyo chi’enyancha,

English: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
Kiswahili: hata huko mkono wako utaniongoza, mkono wako wa kuume utanishika kwa uthabiti.
Ekegusii: nonya naroro okoboko kwao ’nkondaae, ee, okoboko kwao gw’okorio ’nkombwate.

English: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
Kiswahili: Kama nikisema, “Hakika giza litanificha na nuru inayonizunguka iwe usiku,”
Ekegusii: Ninsa goteeba, “Tiga omosunte ontube kegima, na oborabu bong’etanaine boonchoke bobe omosunte”,

English: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
Kiswahili: hata giza halitakuwa giza kwako, usiku utangʼaa kama mchana, kwa kuwa giza ni kama nuru kwako.
