Ekegusii: nonya nomosunte tori omosunte asore, obotuko nigo bokoraba se, bwaba buna omobaso, asore omusunte na oborabu nigo bigwekaine.

English: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wewe ndiwe uliyeumba utu wangu wa ndani; uliniunga pamoja tumboni mwa mama yangu.
Ekegusii: Naye gwatongete ebire ase enda yane ime, nigo kwambwatanetie amo ase enda ya baba.

English: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
Kiswahili: Ninakusifu kwa sababu nimeumbwa kwa namna ya ajabu na ya kutisha; kazi zako ni za ajabu, ninajua hayo kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogotogia, ekiagera natongetwe ase enchera y’ogokumia, na ey’ogoichania. Ogokora kwao nigo kore okuya kw’ogokumia! Igo nimanyete amang’ana ayio buya ase omoyo one.

English: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
Kiswahili: Umbile langu halikufichika kwako, nilipoumbwa mahali pa siri. Nilipoungwa pamoja kwa ustadi katika vilindi vya nchi,
Ekegusii: Amauga y’omobere one tabisekanete asore, ekero natongetwe bobisi, ekero nabombetwe ase ense ime.

English: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
Kiswahili: macho yako yaliniona kabla mwili wangu haujakamilika. Siku zangu zote ulizonipangia ziliandikwa katika kitabu chako kabla haijakuwepo hata moja.
Ekegusii: Amaiso ao nigo andoche ekero nareenge inche ase enda ya baba ime, amatuko aane onsi nigo arigetwe ase egetabu yao, na akaroberigwa ritang’ani rituko rinde ritaraika.

English: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi yalivyo ya thamani mawazo yako kwangu, Ee Mungu! Jinsi jumla yake ilivyo kubwa!
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebikong’u ase ’nde kobimanya, naende nebinge mono bitanyaare kobareka.

English: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
Kiswahili: Kama ningezihesabu, zingekuwa nyingi kuliko mchanga. Niamkapo, bado niko pamoja nawe.
Ekegusii: Inse kobibara, nigo bire ebinge goetania omokenye. Ekero ’nkobooka, nigo ’ngendererete kobeera amo naye.

English: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
Kiswahili: Laiti ungewachinja waovu, Ee Mungu! Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi wamwaga damu!
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, naki yare goocha koba buya onye ’ngwaita abakori amabe, onye abagoitera amanyinga ’mbarua ase ’nde.

English: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
Kiswahili: Wanazungumza juu yako wakiwa na kusudi baya, adui zako wanatumia vibaya jina lako.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagokwana bobe igoro yao; nigo bare abaenenu bagokora ebibe asore.

English: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, je, nisiwachukie wanaokuchukia? Nisiwachukie sana wanaoinuka dhidi yako?
Ekegusii: Omonene, Inee, tingeecheti abwo bakogeechete? Tinkonyinyera abwo bagosaria asore?

English: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
Kiswahili: Sina kitu zaidi ya chuki dhidi yao, ninawahesabu ni adui zangu.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo ’mbageechete mono, nigo ’mbaabarete ng’a nababisa baane.

English: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, nichunguze, uujue moyo wangu, nijaribu na ujue mawazo yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ndiga‐rigie omanye enkoro yane. Nteeme omanye ebirengererio biane.

English: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
Kiswahili: Uone kama kuna njia iletayo machukizo ndani yangu, uniongoze katika njia ya milele.
Ekegusii: Origererie timbwatia enchera y’obosiru, na ondaae ase enchera ya kare na kare.

English: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, Yahweh, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:
Kiswahili: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, niokoe, kutoka kwa watu waovu; nilinde na watu wenye jeuri,
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase abanto ababe; indende korwa ase abanto abatindi!

English: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
Kiswahili: ambao hupanga mipango mibaya mioyoni mwao, na kuchochea vita siku zote.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia amabe ase chinkoro chiabo ime, baba bakona‐korwana esegi botambe.

English: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
Kiswahili: Wao hufanya ndimi zao kali kama za nyoka, sumu ya nyoka iko midomoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Chimeme chiabo nigo chire chinyoge buna echie ching’iti chingeenda inse; obosongo bw’amarubi nigo bore ase ebikoba bi’emenwa yaabo.

English: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, niepushe na mikono ya waovu; nilinde na watu wenye jeuri wanaopanga kunikwaza miguu yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, indende korwa ase amaboko y’abakori amabe; intoorie korwa ase abanto abatindi, abwo barobeirie kobeeka ebigoocha ase ’ngoeta.

English: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
Kiswahili: Wenye kiburi wameficha mtego wa kuninasa, wametandaza kamba za wavu wao, wametega mitego kwenye njia yangu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaenenu babeekire oboreba bobisi ase ’ngoetera, bantegeire ebichanga bimbwate, babeekire emeeto ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.

English: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ninakuambia, “Wewe ni Mungu wangu.” Ee Bwana, usikie kilio changu na kunihurumia.
Ekegusii: Nateebirie Omonene: Aye Nyasae one, aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane.

English: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, Mwokozi wangu mwenye nguvu, unikingaye kichwa changu siku ya vita:
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, Omonene, Omotooria one omokong’u, aye nigo ogotuba omotwe one ase engaki y’eseegi.

English: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, usiwape waovu matakwa yao, usiache mipango yao ikafanikiwa, wasije wakajisifu.
Ekegusii: Omonene, tobaisa koa abakori amabe aya baganetie; tobaisa gosesenia emeroberio yaabo emebe, baabaise gwetogia.

English: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
Kiswahili: Vichwa vya wanaonizunguka vifunikwe na shida zinazosababishwa na midomo yao.
Ekegusii: Totiga ababisa abwo bang’etananire babue, tiga obobe bw’amang’ana bagokwana bobairanere abanyene.

English: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
Kiswahili: Makaa ya mawe ya moto na yawaangukie! Na watupwe motoni, katika mashimo ya matope, wasiinuke tena kamwe.
Ekegusii: Tiga omorero bw’amakara obagwere, barabwo batugutwe ase omorero, barutwe ase chingoro chintambe tibaruao.

English: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
Kiswahili: Wasingiziaji wasifanikiwe katika nchi; maafa na yawawinde watu wenye jeuri.
Ekegusii: Totiga abagenki bagenderere koba ase ense. Obobe nigo bogotwara abanto abatindi ase omoayerero bw’abasiria.

English: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
Kiswahili: Najua kwamba Bwana huwapatia maskini haki, na kuitegemeza njia ya mhitaji.
Ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a aye Omonene norwanerere abagokorerwa bobe, noe abataka oboronge bwabo.

English: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
Kiswahili: Hakika wenye haki watalisifu jina lako, na waadilifu wataishi mbele zako.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, abanyene oboronge ’mbaake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, abare ne chinkoro chindonge ’mbamenye ase obosio bwao.

English: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, ninakuita wewe, uje kwangu hima. Sikia sauti yangu ninapokuita.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa Daudi) Omonene, nigo ’ngokorangeria, ayerera oche bwango! Tegerera oigwe eriogi riane ekero ’ngokorangeria.

English: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
Kiswahili: Maombi yangu na yafike mbele zako kama uvumba; kuinua mikono yangu juu na kuwe kama dhabihu ya jioni.
Ekegusii: Bwanchere ogosaba kwane buna ubani, na amaboko aane aimokereirie igoro oyanchere buna ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba!

English: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, weka mlinzi kinywani mwangu, weka ulinzi mlangoni mwa midomo yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, beeka omorendi ase omonwa one, abe okorenda ebikoba biane.

English: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
Kiswahili: Usiuache moyo wangu uvutwe katika jambo baya, nisije nikashiriki katika matendo maovu pamoja na watu watendao mabaya, wala nisije nikala vyakula vyao vya anasa.
Ekegusii: Totiga enkoro yane egobere yanche amang’ana amabe. Tontiga inare gokora ayaare amabe amo nabwo bagokora ebibe; tingosanga amo nabarabwo ase emeyega.

English: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye haki na anipige: ni jambo la huruma; na anikemee: ni mafuta kichwani mwangu. Kichwa changu hakitalikataa. Hata hivyo, maombi yangu daima ni kinyume cha watenda mabaya,
Ekegusii: Tiga oyore omonyaboronge ang’ake na antogonyere ase obwanchani, okwo nigo konga buna amaguta akweakwa, na omotwe one toyaanga. Botambe nigo ogosaba kwane kore mamincha y’abakori amabe.

English: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
Kiswahili: watawala wao watatupwa chini kutoka kwenye majabali, waovu watajifunza kwamba maneno yangu yalikuwa kweli.
Ekegusii: Ekero abagaambi baabo baraturunkanigwe ase egetare, abanto ’mbaanche amang’ana aane ng’a n’amaya.

English: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
Kiswahili: Watasema, “Kama mtu anavyolima na kuvunja ardhi, ndivyo mifupa yetu imetawanywa kwenye mlango wa kaburi.”
Ekegusii: Amauga aito nigo asiareire ase egesieri n’erieta riikoro engencho yaye egesieri gose omogwa bw’embeera, buna ebisamunye bie chiinko, gose ebi’amagena bigosiarerwa ase riroba igoro.

English: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
Kiswahili: Lakini nimekaza macho yangu kwako, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, ndani yako nimekimbilia, usiniache nife.
Ekegusii: Korende amaiso aane nigo arigereretie goocha asore, aye Omonene; naye ’ngotamera, tibwanga omoyo one.

English: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
Kiswahili: Niepushe na mitego waliyonitegea, kutokana na mitego iliyotegwa na watenda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Indende korwa ase emeeto bantegeire; na korwa ase amareba y’abakori amabe.

English: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
Kiswahili: Waovu na waanguke kwenye nyavu zao wenyewe, wakati mimi ninapita salama.
Ekegusii: Tiga abakori amabe abwo bagwe ase ebichanga biabo abanyene, korende inche ’ntooreke.

English: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
Kiswahili: Utenzi wa Daudi. Alipokuwa pangoni. Maombi. Namlilia Bwana kwa sauti, nainua sauti yangu kwa Bwana anihurumie.
Ekegusii: (Ogosaba gwa Daudi ekero arenge ase rikuruma) Nigo ’nkorera neriogi ase ogokorangeri’Omonene, naaka eriogi ase okomosaba amaabera.

English: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
Kiswahili: Namimina malalamiko yangu mbele zake, mbele zake naeleza shida zangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorenta obokong’u bwane ase obosio bwaye na komoteebia emechando yane.

English: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
Kiswahili: Wakati roho yangu inapozimia ndani yangu, wewe ndiwe unajua njia zangu. Katika njia ninayopita watu wameniwekea mtego.
Ekegusii: Ekero ’nkoba buna oyo okogireka, aye nomanyete ase ’ngoetera. Agwo ase ’ngoeta ababisa bambeekeire amareba.

English: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
Kiswahili: Tazama kuume kwangu na uone, hakuna hata mmoja anayejihusisha nami. Sina kimbilio, hakuna anayejali maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ’nkorigereria ase ensemo yane y’okorio, tindi korora monto aroro ogonkonya; gose tindi korora aase ’ndatamere, monto onde tari okonyechaandera.

English: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, nakulilia wewe, nasema, “Wewe ni kimbilio langu, fungu langu katika nchi ya walio hai.”
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkorera asore; nigo ’ngoteeba: Naye ore obotamero bwane, na egetare kiane aiga ase ense y’ abanto bare moyo.

English: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza kilio changu, kwa sababu mimi ni mhitaji sana; niokoe na wale wanaonifuatilia, kwa kuwa wamenizidi nguvu.
Ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe ekerero kiane, ekiagera nachaandekire mono! Ntoorie korwa ase abanto abwo bagonchaanda, ekiagera nigo babwate chinguru kombua.

English: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
Kiswahili: Nifungue kutoka kifungo changu, ili niweze kulisifu jina lako. Ndipo wenye haki watanizunguka, kwa sababu ya wema wako kwangu.
Ekegusii: Osibore omoyo one korwa ase obosibwa, erinde imbe ’ngotogia erieta riao. Abanyene oboronge ’mbang’etanane, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya.

English: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, sikia sala yangu, sikiliza kilio changu unihurumie; katika uaminifu na haki yako njoo unisaidie.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, oigwe ogosaba kwane; ase engencho y’oboronge bwao otegerere ogosorora kwane, ong’iranerie ase engencho y’obwegenwa bwao.

English: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
Kiswahili: Usimhukumu mtumishi wako, kwa kuwa hakuna mtu anayeishi aliye mwenye haki mbele zako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kong’ira inche omosomba oo ase ekegambero, ekiagera ase abwo bare moyo onde tari ore omooronge asore.

English: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
Kiswahili: Adui hunifuatilia, hunipondaponda chini; hunifanya niishi gizani kama wale waliokufa zamani.
Ekegusii: Omobisa one obeire okorigia omoyo one; obeire ogontiringera inse ase amaroba, ong’ikaransirie ase omosunte, nabeire buna omonto okwete kare.

English: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo roho yangu inazimia ndani yangu, moyo wangu ndani yangu unakata tamaa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omoika ore ime yane oborirwe chinguru, na enkoro yane yairianyekire.

English: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
Kiswahili: Nakumbuka siku za zamani; natafakari juu ya kazi zako zote, naangalia juu ya kazi ambazo mikono yako imezifanya.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoinyora amatuko a kare, na korengereria igoro y’ogokora kwao gwonsi, naba ’nkona‐koiranerera emeremo y’amaboko ao.

English: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.
Kiswahili: Nanyoosha mikono yangu kwako, nafsi yangu inakuonea kiu kama ardhi kame.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorambora amaboko aane goocha asore, omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore, buna riroba rirang’ete embura.

English: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, unijibu haraka, roho yangu inazimia. Usinifiche uso wako, ama sivyo nitafanana na wale washukao shimoni.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’iranerie bwango! Omoika ’nkong’erera ore! Tombisa obosio bwao mbaise koba buna abwo bakogeenda ase abakuure.

English: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi uniletee neno la upendo wako usiokoma, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu kwako. Nionyeshe njia nitakayoiendea, kwa kuwa kwako nainua nafsi yangu.
Ekegusii: Kera emambia omanyie obwanchani bwao bogenderere botambe, ekiagera naye ’nyegenete. Inyorokererie enchera ’ngwenerete kobwatia, ekiagera narure omoyo one asore.

English: Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uniokoe na adui zangu, kwa kuwa nimejificha kwako.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane; nagotameire ombise.

English: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
Kiswahili: Nifundishe kufanya mapenzi yako, kwa maana wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu, Roho wako mwema na aniongoze katika nchi tambarare.
Ekegusii: Inyorokererie imanye gokora ogwancha kwao, ekiagera naye ore Nyasae one! Tiga Omoika oo omuya ondaae ase enchera ere endonge.

English: Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, kwa ajili ya jina lako, hifadhi maisha yangu, kwa haki yako nitoe katika taabu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’erieta riao; na ase engencho y’oboronge bwao rusia omoyo one korwa ase emechando.

English: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.
Kiswahili: Kwa upendo wako usiokoma, nyamazisha adui zangu; waangamize watesi wangu wote, kwa kuwa mimi ni mtumishi wako.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, siria ababisa baane; basirie kegima bonsi abagochaanda omoyo one, ekiagera inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo.

English: By David. Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—
Kiswahili: Zaburi ya Daudi. Sifa ni kwa Bwana Mwamba wangu, aifundishaye mikono yangu vita, na vidole vyangu kupigana.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera kwa Daudi) Atogigwe Omonene, oyore egetare kiane; bworokereirie amaboko aane amanye korwana esegi, ne ebiara bimanye korwana.

English: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni Mungu wangu wa upendo na boma langu, ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu, ngao yangu ninayemkimbilia, ambaye huwatiisha mataifa chini yangu.
Ekegusii: Ere nomwegenwa ase ’nde, naende norwaki rwane, obwebiso bwane obokong’u na Omobooria one. Ere nenguba yane, nere ’ngotamera, ekiagera nabeeke abanto baane inse yane banyigwere.

English: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, mwanadamu ni nini hata umjali, Binadamu ni nini hata umfikirie?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, omonto ninki aisaine goika okomwechaandera, gose Mwanyabaanto ninki are, aye okomorengereria?

English: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
Kiswahili: Mwanadamu ni kama pumzi, siku zake ni kama kivuli kinachopita.
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo are buna omooki, amatuko aye nigo anga buna omorengari ogoeta.

English: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, pasua mbingu zako, ushuke, gusa milima ili itoe moshi.
Ekegusii: Omonene, kumba igoro chiao ochiche inse aa! Kuna ebitunwa, erinde bisokie erioki.

English: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
Kiswahili: Peleka umeme uwatawanye adui, lenga mishale yako uwashinde.
Ekegusii: Mesia chinkoba chiao oserebanie ababisa, ruta chinsara chiao obasirie kegima!

English: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
Kiswahili: Nyoosha mkono wako kutoka juu, nikomboe na kuniokoa kutoka maji makuu, kutoka mikononi mwa wageni
Ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao korwa agwo igoro, ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amaache aya amange, na korwa ase amaboko y’ abanto b’echinse chingeni,

English: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
Kiswahili: ambao vinywa vyao vimejaa uongo, na mikono yao ya kuume ni midanganyifu.
Ekegusii: abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yaabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora obong’ainereria.

English: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
Kiswahili: Ee Mungu, nitakuimbia wimbo mpya, kwa zeze yenye nyuzi kumi nitakuimbia,
Ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ningoterere ogoteera okoyia, ninkobugerie obokano bore ne chinge ikomi.

English: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
Kiswahili: kwa Yule awapaye wafalme ushindi, ambaye humwokoa Daudi, mtumishi wake kutokana na upanga hatari.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okoa abarwoti obobui, naye gwatooretie Daudi, omosomba oo, korwa ase omoro bw’obobe.

English: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
Kiswahili: Nikomboe na uniokoe kutoka mikononi mwa wageni ambao vinywa vyao vimejaa uongo, na mikono yao ya kuume ni midanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amaboko y’ abanto b’echinse chingeni, abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yaabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora obong’ainereria.

English: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
Kiswahili: Kisha wana wetu wakati wa ujana wao watakuwa kama mimea iliyotunzwa vizuri, binti zetu watakuwa kama nguzo zilizoviringwa kurembesha jumba la kifalme.
Ekegusii: Tiga abamura baito ase oboke bwabo babe buna ebimeri biakinire bire ne’chinguru, na abaiseke baito babe buna ebisigisa bie chikoona bibaachire buya bikogwenera chinyomba chi’oborwoti.

English: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
Kiswahili: Ghala zetu zitajazwa aina zote za mahitaji. Kondoo zetu watazaa kwa maelfu, kwa makumi ya maelfu katika mashamba yetu;
Ekegusii: Tiga ebiage biaito biichore chindagera, bigaache chindagera ao ao, ne ching’ondi chiaito chire ase ebitii chibiare chilifu ne chilifu.

English: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
Kiswahili: maksai wetu watakokota mizigo mizito. Hakutakuwa na kubomoka kuta, hakuna kuchukuliwa mateka, wala kilio cha taabu katika barabara zetu.
Ekegusii: Tiga chiombe chiaito chibe ne’chinguru, ende tebaisa korekera, gose goochia bogima. Ekerero kende gionsi tikeba ase chinchera chiaito.

English: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Heri watu ambao hili ni kweli; heri wale ambao Bwana ni Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Mbare n’omogooko abanto bakonyora ogosesenigwa okwo. Ee, ’mbare n’omogooko abanto abw’Omonene are Nyasae obo.

English: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Wimbo wa Sifa. Wa Daudi. Nitakutukuza wewe, Mungu wangu Mfalme, nitalisifu jina lako milele na milele.
Ekegusii: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae one na omorwoti one, ninkobaake, nimbe ’ngotogia erieta riao goika kare na kare.

English: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Kila siku nitakusifu na kulitukuza jina lako milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Kera rituko nimbe ’nkogotogia, nintogie erieta riao goika kare na kare.

English: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mkuu, anayestahili kusifiwa sana, ukuu wake haupimiki.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene, nagwenerete atogigwe mono; obonene bwaye tibokomanyekana buna bore.

English: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
Kiswahili: Kizazi kimoja kitasifia kazi zako kwa kizazi kingine, watasimulia matendo yako makuu.
Ekegusii: Emeremo yao netogigwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Mbirarie ogokora kwao kore okonene.

English: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
Kiswahili: Watasema juu ya utukufu wa fahari ya ukuu wako, nami nitatafakari juu ya kazi zako za ajabu.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkorengereria mono igoro y’obonene bwao bw’ogosikwa okonene, na igoro y’emeremo yao y’ogokumia.

English: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
Kiswahili: Watasimulia uwezo wa kazi zako za kutisha, nami nitatangaza matendo yako makuu.
Ekegusii: Abanto ’mbabe bakoraria ogokora kwao okonene gw’okoirokia, nainche nimbe ’nkoraria obonene bwao.

English: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
Kiswahili: Wataadhimisha wema wako mwingi, na wataimba kwa shangwe juu ya haki yako.
Ekegusii: Mbararie chinkuma chi’obuya bwao obonge, babe bagotera namariogi amanene gotogia oboronge bwao.

English: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwenye neema na mwingi wa huruma, si mwepesi wa hasira, bali ni mwingi wa upendo.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobwanchani obonge, na amaabera amange; tari omwango ase okoba n’endamwamu, nigo aichire nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.

English: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwema kwa wote, ana huruma kwa vyote alivyovifanya.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya ase abanto bonsi, naende nigo are namaabera ase ebitongwa biaye bionsi.

English: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, vyote ulivyovifanya vitakusifu, watakatifu wako watakutukuza.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ebitongwa biao bionsi nigo bikogoakera ng’a mbuya mono, na abachenu bao bonsi mbagotogie.

English: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
Kiswahili: Watasimulia utukufu wa ufalme wako na kusema juu ya ukuu wako,
Ekegusii: Mbabe bakoraria obonene bw’oborwoti bwao, naende babe bagokwana igoro y’okobua kwao,

English: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
Kiswahili: ili watu wote wajue matendo yako makuu na utukufu wa fahari ya ufalme wako.
Ekegusii: bamanyie Mwanyabaanto ogokora kwao okonene, na obonene bw’ogosikwa kw’oborwoti bwao.

English: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
Kiswahili: Ufalme wako ni ufalme wa milele, mamlaka yako hudumu vizazi vyote. Bwana ni mwaminifu kwa ahadi zake zote na mwenye upendo kwa vyote alivyovifanya.
Ekegusii: Oborwoti bwao nobwa kare na kare, na okogambera kwao nigo kogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi. Omonene nigo are omwegenwa ase amang’ana aye onsi, na oichire nobuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.

English: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwategemeza wote waangukao, na huwainua wote waliolemewa na mizigo yao.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobwata bonsi abakogwa, nigo akogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse.

English: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
Kiswahili: Macho yao wote yanakutazama wewe, nawe huwapa chakula chao wakati wake.
Ekegusii: Amaiso y’ebitongwa bionsi nigo akorigereretie nogosemeria, naye nigo okobia chindagera chiabo ase chingaki chigwenerete.

English: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
Kiswahili: Waufumbua mkono wako, watosheleza haja ya kila kitu kilicho hai.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo okomaanora okoboko kwao, kwarua ebisio na goisanekia kera egetongwa kere moyo.

English: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwenye haki katika njia zake zote, na mwenye upendo kwa vyote alivyovifanya.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge ase chinchera chiaye chionsi, na omuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.

English: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
Kiswahili: Bwana yu karibu na wote wamwitao, karibu na wote wamwitao kwa uaminifu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang’e ase abanto abwo bakomorangeria; abwo bonsi bakomorangeria ase ekeene.

English: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
Kiswahili: Huwatimizia wamchao matakwa yao, husikia kilio chao na kuwaokoa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoikeraneria abamoirogete okogania kwabo; boigo nigo akoigwa ekerero kiabo na kobatooria.

English: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwalinda wote wampendao, bali waovu wote atawaangamiza.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arendete bonsi abamwanchete; korende nasirie abakori amabe bonsi.

English: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Kinywa changu kitazinena sifa za Bwana. Kila kiumbe na kilisifu jina lake takatifu milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Omonwa one nobe ogokwana ogotogigwa kw’Omonene; tiga ebitongwa bionsi bitogie erieta riaye richenu bono na goika kare na kare.

English: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana! Ee nafsi yangu, umsifu Bwana,
Ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!

English: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
Kiswahili: Nitamsifu Bwana maisha yangu yote; nitamwimbia Mungu wangu sifa wakati wote niishipo.
Ekegusii: Nimbe ngotogia Omonene kongendererete koba moyo, ninterere Nyasae one ase okomotogia kondagenderere kobao.

English: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
Kiswahili: Usiweke tumaini lako kwa wakuu, kwa wanadamu ambao hufa, ambao hawawezi kuokoa.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gosemeria abagaambi, gose Mwanyabaanto abwo batanyaare gokonya kende.

English: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
Kiswahili: Roho yao itokapo hurudi mavumbini, siku hiyo hiyo mipango yao yote hukoma.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoika orure ase omonto, ere nigo akoirana ase amaroba, ase arwete. Ase rituko erio erio emeroberio yaye nigo egosira.

English: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God,
Kiswahili: Heri yeye ambaye Mungu wa Yakobo ni msaada wake, ambaye tumaini lake ni katika Bwana, Mungu wake,
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae o Yakobo are ogokonywa kwaye, oyio osemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oye,

English: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
Kiswahili: Muumba wa mbingu na nchi, na bahari na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake: Bwana anayedumu kuwa mwaminifu milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oria otongete igoro na ense, na enyancha, na ebinto bionsi bire imeo. Ere nigo agendererete koba omwegenwa goika kare na kare.

English: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
Kiswahili: Naye huwapatia haki walioonewa na kuwapa wenye njaa chakula. Bwana huwaweka wafungwa huru,
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoa abwo bagokorerwa bobe oboronge bwabo, na abare nenchara nigo akobaa endagera. Omonene nigo agosibora abwo basibire.

English: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwafumbua vipofu macho, Bwana huwainua waliolemewa na mizigo yao, Bwana huwapenda wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoramokia emeuko amaiso na kogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse. Omonene nigo anchete abanyaboronge.

English: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwalinda wageni na kuwategemeza yatima na wajane, lakini hupinga njia za waovu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorenda abanto abageni, nigo akoa chintakana na ababoraka ogosemeria, korende chinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo agochisiria.

English: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: Bwana atamiliki milele, Mungu wako, ee Sayuni, kwa vizazi vyote. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene nagambe goika kare na kare; aye Sayoni, Nyasae oo nagambere ebiaare bionsi.

English: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Tazama jinsi ilivyo vyema kumwimbia Mungu wetu sifa, jinsi inavyopendeza na kustahili kumsifu yeye!
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Nigo ere buya komoterera Nyasae oito ase okomotogia, ayio naro amaya mono na atogwenerete.

English: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
Kiswahili: Bwana hujenga Yerusalemu, huwakusanya Israeli walio uhamishoni.
Ekegusii: Omonene naagache Yerusalemu naende, nasangererie amo Abaisraeli abwo baserebaanetigwe.

English: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
Kiswahili: Anawaponya waliovunjika mioyo na kuvifunga vidonda vyao.
Ekegusii: Nigo akogwenia abwo chinkoro chiabo chiasionoirwe, na koboa amaote abo.

English: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
Kiswahili: Huzihesabu nyota na huipa kila moja jina lake.
Ekegusii: Nigo amanyete omobaro bwe ching’enang’eni chionsi; boigo kera eyemo nigo ayerogete erieta.

English: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
Kiswahili: Bwana wetu ni mkuu na mwenye uwezo mwingi, ufahamu wake hauna kikomo.
Ekegusii: Omonene oito nigo are omonene mono, ne’chinguru chiaye nechinyinge; obong’aini bwaye tibokorengeka.

English: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwahifadhi wanyenyekevu lakini huwashusha waovu mpaka mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, korende abakori amabe nigo akobaiyeria inse.

English: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana kwa shukrani, mpigieni Mungu wetu kinubi.
Ekegusii: Moterere Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono; bugeria Nyasae oito amakano n’amariogi amaya!

English: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
Kiswahili: Yeye huzifunika anga kwa mawingu, huinyeshea ardhi mvua, na kuzifanya nyasi kuota juu ya vilima.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotuba igoro n’amare, bwariganeria ense embura, nigo akomeria obonyansi ase ebitunwa.

English: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
Kiswahili: Huwapa chakula mifugo na pia makinda ya kunguru yanapolia.
Ekegusii: Nere okoa ching’iti chionsi endagera yaabo, naende orageria amage y’ebigonkoru ekero akorera.

English: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
Kiswahili: Furaha yake haipo katika nguvu za farasi, wala furaha yake kwenye miguu ya mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Omonene tagokiri ne’chinguru chi’echibarasi, gose ase omoayerero bw’omonto,

English: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
Kiswahili: Bwana hupendezwa na wale wamchao, wale wanaoweka tumaini lao katika upendo wake usiokoma.
Ekegusii: korende nigo agokirie n’abanto abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.

English: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
Kiswahili: Mtukuze Bwana, ee Yerusalemu, msifu Mungu wako, ee Sayuni,
Ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, togia Omonene! Aye Sayoni, togia Nyasae oo!

English: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
Kiswahili: kwa maana huimarisha makomeo ya malango yako na huwabariki watu wako walio ndani yako.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agokong’ia emekorogoto y’ebiita biaino; nigo agosesenia abana bamenyete ime yao.

English: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
Kiswahili: Huwapa amani mipakani mwenu na kukushibisha kwa ngano safi kabisa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobeeka omorembe oba ase chimbebe chiao, naende nigo agoichoria engano ere engiya mono.

English: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
Kiswahili: Hutuma amri yake duniani, neno lake hukimbia kasi.
Ekegusii: Nigo agotoma amachiiko aye goocha ase ense, ne ring’ana riaye riaranda bwango.

English: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
Kiswahili: Anatandaza theluji kama sufu na kutawanya umande kama majivu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenta amagena y’embura agwekaine amarionya amarabu, oyasiarera buna agosiara ribu.

English: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
Kiswahili: Huvurumisha mvua yake ya mawe kama changarawe. Ni nani awezaye kustahimili ukali wa baridi yake?
Ekegusii: Nigo agosiarera amagena ayio buna amaemba enkomba. Ning’o oraremererie obokendu bwaye?

English: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
Kiswahili: Hutuma neno lake na kuviyeyusha, huvumisha upepo wake, nayo maji hutiririka.
Ekegusii: Nigo agotoma ring’ana riaye, na amagena ayio amakendu anyititoke. Erio ogusia embeo amaache ageenda.

English: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
Kiswahili: Amemfunulia Yakobo neno lake, sheria zake na maagizo yake kwa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akomanyia abanto ba Yakobo ring’ana riaye, ee, Abaisraeli emeroberio yaye n’amachiiko aye.

English: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: Hajafanya hivyo kwa taifa lingine lolote, hawazijui sheria zake. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene tana‐gokorera abanto b’ebisaku binde amang’ana buna ayio, barabwo tibamanyeti amachiiko aye. Motogie Omonene!

English: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Msifuni Bwana kutoka mbinguni, msifuni juu vileleni.
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene korwa agwo igoro! Momotogie agwo igoro mono!

English: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!
Kiswahili: Msifuni, enyi malaika wake wote, msifuni yeye, enyi jeshi lake lote la mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamalaika baye mwensi, motogie, nainwe emeganda yaye yonsi, motogie!

English: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
Kiswahili: Msifuni yeye, enyi jua na mwezi, msifuni yeye, enyi nyota zote zingʼaazo.
Ekegusii: Aye risase, na aye omotienyi, motogie, nainwe ching’enang’eni chionsi chikobara, motogie.

English: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
Kiswahili: Msifuni yeye, enyi mbingu zilizo juu sana, na ninyi maji juu ya anga.
Ekegusii: Inwe igoro ya igoro chionsi, motogie Nainwe amaache are igoro ya igoro, motogie!

English: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
Kiswahili: Vilisifu jina la Bwana kwa maana aliamuru navyo vikaumbwa.
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebio bionsi tiga bitogie erieta ri’Omonene, ekiagera nere ochiigete, na ebio bigatongwa.

English: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
Kiswahili: Aliviweka mahali pake milele na milele, alitoa amri ambayo haibadiliki milele.
Ekegusii: Omonene obibeekire bigenderere kobao goika kare na kare; nigo abibeekerete ogochika okwo gotaetanigwe.

English: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,
Kiswahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana kutoka duniani, ninyi viumbe vikubwa vya baharini na vilindi vyote vya bahari,
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene korwa ase ense, nainwe ebitongwa bie chinyancha ne chindiba chionsi!

English: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,
Kiswahili: umeme wa radi na mvua ya mawe, theluji na mawingu, pepo za dhoruba zinazofanya amri zake,
Ekegusii: Motogie, inwe omorero na amagena y’embura, na obokeng’entu, na amare, na aye omwaga omotindi ogoikerania aya achiigete!

English: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
Kiswahili: ninyi milima na vilima vyote, miti ya matunda na mierezi yote,
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, inwe ebitunwa na ebigoro bionsi, nainwe emete ekwama amatunda, na emecharake yonsi,

English: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,
Kiswahili: wanyama wa mwituni na mifugo yote, viumbe vidogo na ndege warukao,
Ekegusii: nainwe ching’iti chi’orosana na echitugire chionsi, nainwe echikwagura amo ne chinyoni chionsi!

English: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
Kiswahili: wafalme wa dunia na mataifa yote, ninyi wakuu na watawala wote wa dunia,
Ekegusii: Motogie inwe abarwoti b’ense na abanto bonsi, nainwe abagaambi na abanachi ebiina mwensi,

English: both young men and maidens, old men and children.
Kiswahili: wanaume vijana na wanawali, wazee na watoto.
Ekegusii: nainwe abamura na abaiseke mwensi, nainwe abanto abagotu na abana.

English: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
Kiswahili: Wote na walisifu jina la Bwana, kwa maana jina lake pekee limetukuka, utukufu wake uko juu ya nchi na mbingu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwensi, togia erieta ri’Omonene, ekiagera erieta riaye nario rioka rire rinene rikobakwa; obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine ense na igoro.

English: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: Amewainulia watu wake pembe, sifa ya watakatifu wake wote, ya Israeli, watu walio karibu na moyo wake. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene omeririe abanto baye ching’unchara, erinde abachenu baye bonsi bamotogie; ee, Abaisraeli abwo bare ang’e nere bamotogie! Motogie Omonene!

English: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, sifa zake katika kusanyiko la watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Terera Omonene ogoteera okoyia, motogie ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto abegenwa.

English: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Kiswahili: Israeli na washangilie katika Muumba wao, watu wa Sayuni na wafurahi katika Mfalme wao.
Ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli bagokere Omotongi obo; abanto ba Sayoni tiga bachengere Omorwoti obo!

English: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
Kiswahili: Na walisifu jina lake kwa kucheza na wampigie muziki kwa matari na kinubi.
Ekegusii: Batogie erieta riaye ase ogotenga, babe bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano.

English: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana anapendezwa na watu wake, anawavika wanyenyekevu taji ya wokovu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agokirie n’abanto baye; abwo bare abaitongo nigo akobachabera ogotooreka.

English: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
Kiswahili: Watakatifu washangilie katika heshima hii, na waimbe kwa shangwe vitandani mwao.
Ekegusii: Tiga abegenwa bachenge ase obonene, babe bagotera n’omogooko kobare ase amarere abo.

English: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
Kiswahili: Sifa za Mungu na ziwe vinywani mwao na upanga ukatao kuwili mikononi mwao,
Ekegusii: Tiga ogotogigwa okonene kwa Nyasae kobe ase emenwa yaabo, na ase amaboko abo babogorie emeyio ya birende ere nobwoge chinsemo ibere,

English: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
Kiswahili: ili walipize mataifa kisasi na adhabu juu ya mataifa,
Ekegusii: erinde barusie egesiomba ase egesaku, na bae abanto egesusuro.

English: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
Kiswahili: wawafunge wafalme wao kwa minyororo, wakuu wao kwa pingu za chuma,
Ekegusii: Boigo banyaare gosiba abarwoti baabo nebinyuri, na abanene baabo ne chingataare chi’ekioma,

English: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: ili kuwafanyia hukumu iliyoandikwa dhidi yao. Huu ndio utukufu wa watakatifu wake wote. Msifuni Bwana.
Ekegusii: erinde baabanachere ekiina keriikire. Obo nabwo obonene bw’abegenwa bonsi bw’Omonene. Motogie Omonene!

English: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
Kiswahili: Msifuni Bwana. Msifuni Mungu katika patakatifu pake, msifuni katika mbingu zake kuu.
Ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Motogie Nyasae agwo ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, motogie agwo igoro eyio yatongetwe ase okobua kwaye!

English: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
Kiswahili: Msifuni kwa matendo yake makuu, msifuni kwa kadiri ya wingi wa ukuu wake.
Ekegusii: Motogie ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okonene; motogie koreng’ana nobonene bwaye bore ne’chinguru chinyinge goetania!

English: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
Kiswahili: Msifuni kwa mvumo wa tarumbeta, msifuni kwa kinubi na zeze,
Ekegusii: Motogie ase okobugia ebitureeri; motogie ase okobugia amakano onsi!

English: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
Kiswahili: msifuni kwa matari na kucheza, msifuni kwa kinanda cha nyuzi na filimbi,
Ekegusii: Motogie ase okobugia chinchigiri na gotenga; motogie ase okobugia amakano na ebiroria!

English: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
Kiswahili: msifuni kwa matoazi yaliayo, msifuni kwa matoazi yavumayo sana.
Ekegusii: Motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are inse; motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are igoro!

English: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
Kiswahili: Kila chenye pumzi na kimsifu Bwana. Msifuni Bwana!
Ekegusii: Tiga ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo bitogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene!

English: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
Kiswahili: Mithali za Solomoni mwana wa Daudi, mfalme wa Israeli:
Ekegusii: Eye nero emebayeno ya Sulemani mosinto o Daudi, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.

English: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
Kiswahili: Kwa kupata hekima na nidhamu; kwa kufahamu maneno ya busara;
Ekegusii: Emebayeno eyio eragere abanto bamanye obong’aini na amorokererio y’okorongeyia, naende bamanye amang’ana are nengeencho.

English: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
Kiswahili: kwa kujipatia nidhamu na busara, kufanya lililo sawa, haki na bila kupendelea;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ero abanto mbanyore amorokererio akorenta obong’aini, na oboronge, na ekeene, na ogokora kw’oboronge.

English: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
Kiswahili: huwapa busara wajinga, maarifa na akili kwa vijana;
Ekegusii: Emebayeno eyio nigo erae abatamanyeti amaange bamanye chiseemi, naende nigo erorokererie ekegori egeke getware obomanyi na emeroberio emiya.

English: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;
Kiswahili: wenye hekima na wasikilize nao waongeze elimu yao, wenye kupambanua na wapate mwongozo;
Ekegusii: Ase okoigwa emebayeno eyio omonto omong’aini nigo akong’ainia goetania, na oyore nobomanyi bwenyorera ogosemigwa okuya.

English: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
Kiswahili: kwa kufahamu mithali na mifano, misemo na vitendawili vya wenye hekima.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase emebayeno eyio abanto ’mbanyaare kweorokereria emebayeno na eki egoteeba; boigo ’mbamanye amang’ana y’abanto abang’aini na emebayeno yabo.

English: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana ndicho chanzo cha maarifa, lakini wapumbavu hudharau hekima na adabu.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, n’oro omochakano bwe chiseemi. Abariri nigo bagochaaya obong’aini na amorokererio.

English: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, sikiliza mwongozo wa baba yako, wala usiyaache mafundisho ya mama yako.
Ekegusii: Omwana one, igwera amorokererio a iso, na tobaisa gotiga aria nyoko akogochika.

English: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
Kiswahili: Hayo yatakuwa taji la maua la neema kichwani pako, na mkufu wa kuipamba shingo yako.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe buna egetinti gechabeire ase omotwe oo, na buna chisonoi chingiya chire ase rigoti ria’o.

English: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, kama wenye dhambi wakikushawishi, usikubaliane nao.
Ekegusii: Omwana one, abanyabibe kobarakoebererie ng’a mobwatane nabarabwo, tobaisa gwancha.

English: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
Kiswahili: Kama wakisema, “Twende tufuatane; tukamvizie mtu na kumwaga damu, njoo tukavizie nafsi isiyo na hatia;
Ekegusii: Baise kogoteebia, “Inchuo ogeende amo naintwe; toboere abanto tobaite, toumokere onde bwensi otari na komocha.

English: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
Kiswahili: tuwameze wakiwa hai kama kaburi, wakiwa wazima kama wale wanaotumbukia shimoni.
Ekegusii: Inchuo tobamere kobare moyo, buna aase abakuure akomera, bageende abagima ase embeera.

English: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
Kiswahili: Tutapata aina zote za vitu vya thamani na kujaza nyumba zetu kwa nyara.
Ekegusii: Erio tonyore chinibo chionsi chie rigori rinene, toichorie chinyomba chiaito nebisakorwa ebio.

English: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—
Kiswahili: Njoo ushirikiane nasi, vitu vyote tutakavyopata tutagawana.”
Ekegusii: Inchuo obwatane amo naintwe; tobe n’ekegaancha ekemo.”

English: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, usiandamane nao. Usiweke mguu wako katika njia zao,
Ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa gotaara amo nabarabwo. Otange okogoro kwao tikobaisa gotacha ase bagoeta,

English: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa miguu yao hukimbilia kwenye dhambi, ni wepesi kumwaga damu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera amagoro abo nigo akominyoka gochia ase ogokora amabe, na nigo bare abaango ase ogoitera amanyinga.

English: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
Kiswahili: Tazama ni jinsi gani ilivyo kazi bure kutandaza wavu wakati ndege wote wanakuona!
Ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa gotegera chinyoni ebisugunia ekero chibiroche.

English: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
Kiswahili: Watu hawa huvizia kumwaga damu yao wenyewe; hujivizia tu wenyewe!
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoboera goitera amanyinga abo abanyene, na koumokera obogima bwabo abanyene.

English: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mwisho wa wote ambao wanajipatia mali kwa hila; huuondoa uhai wa wale wenye mali.
Ekegusii: Naboigo omoerio bwe chiinchera chiabo ore, baria baganetie konyora chinibo ase ribero. Chinibo chiria nigo chigosiria obogima bw’abwo bagochinyora.

English: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
Kiswahili: Hekima huita kwa sauti kuu barabarani, hupaza sauti yake kwenye viwanja vikubwa;
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase chiinchera, boigo nase chichiiro.

English: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
Kiswahili: kwenye makutano ya barabara za mji zenye makelele mengi hupaza sauti, kwenye malango ya mji hutoa hotuba yake:
Ekegusii: Nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase emesangererekano emenene y’abanto, naende ase ebiita bi’emechie, bwateeba.

English: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
Kiswahili: “Enyi wajinga, mtangʼangʼania ujinga wenu hadi lini? Mpaka lini wenye mizaha watafurahia mizaha, na wapumbavu kuchukia maarifa?
Ekegusii: “Ngoika ririri inwe abamotamanyeti amaange moranche ogotamanya kwaino? Ngoika ririri abachecheria baregokie nogochecheria kwabo, na abariri bageche chiseemi?

English: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
Kiswahili: Kama mngekuwa mmeitikia karipio langu, ningekuwa nimemimina roho yangu kwenu na kuwafahamisha maneno yangu.
Ekegusii: Moise koonchoka moigwe ogokuurera kw’ane, rirorio nimbaiterere omoika one, ’mbamanyie amang’ana ane.

English: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kuwa mlinikataa nilipowaita na hakuna yeyote aliyekubali niliponyoosha mkono wangu,
Ekegusii: Nabeire ’nkobarangeria, korende mwangire konyigwera; nabeire ’nkorambora okoboko kw’ane, korende monto onde tari okorigereirie.

English: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa mliyapuuza mashauri yangu yote na hamkukubali karipio langu,
Ekegusii: Mwachaayire ogoseemia kw’ane gwonsi, gose onde tari oigwerete ogokuurera kw’ane.

English: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
Kiswahili: mimi nami nitawacheka katika maafa yenu, nitawadhihaki wakati janga litawapata:
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nimbasekerere ekero emechando erabachere. Nimbachecherie ekero obwoba borabaachere;

English: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
Kiswahili: wakati janga litawapata kama tufani, wakati maafa yatawazoa kama upepo wa kisulisuli, wakati dhiki na taabu zitawalemea.
Ekegusii: ee, ekero obwoba borabaachere buna ekembugu‐mbugu, na emechando buna ekerambauti, boigo ekero obokong’u na omoichano birabaachere.

English: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,
Kiswahili: “Ndipo watakaponiita lakini sitawajibu; watanitafuta lakini hawatanipata.
Ekegusii: Erio barabwo ’mbandangerie, korende tinkobaigwa; ’mbandigie, korende tibakonyora inche.

English: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa walichukia maarifa, wala hawakuchagua kumcha Bwana,
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bageechete chiseemi tibancheti komoiroka Omonene.

English: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa hawakukubali mashauri yangu, na kukataa maonyo yangu,
Ekegusii: Tibancheti koigwera ring’ana riane ri’okobaseemia nonya nerimo; nigo bachaayete ogokuurera kw’ane gwonsi.

English: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
Kiswahili: watakula matunda ya njia zao, na watashibishwa matunda ya hila zao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ’mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo, baisaneke n’emeroberio yabo abanyene

English: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ukaidi wa wajinga utawaua, nako kuridhika kwa wajinga kutawaangamiza.
Ekegusii: Okoirana magega kw’abwo batamanyeti amaange ’nkobaite, na ogoisaneka kw’abariri ’nkobasirie barabwo abanyene.

English: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeyote anisikilizaye ataishi kwa usalama, atatulia, bila kuwa na hofu ya madhara.”
Ekegusii: Korende monto onde bwensi oranyigwere namenye ase omorembe, ere nabe n’obotoereru na takoiroka bobe bonde.”

English: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, kama utayakubali maneno yangu na kuyaweka akiba maagizo yangu ndani mwako,
Ekegusii: Omwana one, ancha amang’ana ane, ogache amachiiko ane ase enkoro yao,

English: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
Kiswahili: kutega sikio lako kwenye hekima na kuweka moyo wako katika ufahamu,
Ekegusii: erinde oigwe obong’aini, naende orue enkoro yao ebe nokomanya.

English: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
Kiswahili: na kama ukiita busara na kuita kwa sauti ufahamu,
Ekegusii: Obe gokorangeria korigia chiseemi, naende osorore onyore okomanya.

English: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;
Kiswahili: na kama utaitafuta kama fedha na kuitafuta sana kama hazina iliyofichwa,
Ekegusii: Origie obong’aini buna okorigia chifeta, oboriga‐rigie buna okoriga‐rigia chinibo chibisire.

English: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
Kiswahili: ndipo utakapoelewa kumcha Bwana na kupata maarifa ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Oise gokora bo, rirorio nomanye komoiroka Omonene, naende nigo oranyaare komomanya Nyasae.

English: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana hutoa hekima, na kinywani mwake hutoka maarifa na ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere okoa abanto obong’aini; chiseemi na okomanya nigo bikorwa ase omonwa oye.

English: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
Kiswahili: Anahifadhi ushindi kwa ajili ya mwadilifu, yeye ni ngao kwa wale wasio na lawama,
Ekegusii: Abare ne chinkoro chindonge Omonene nigo abagacherete obong’aini oboikeranu. Ere nigo are enguba ase abanto abwo bagotaara ase oboronge.

English: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa hulinda mwenendo wa mwenye haki na kuhifadhi njia ya waaminifu wake.
Ekegusii: Nigo arendete chiinchera chi’abagokora ekeene, naende orenda chiinchera chi’abamoirogete.

English: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
Kiswahili: Ndipo utafahamu lipi lililo kweli na haki na sawa: yaani kila njia nzuri.
Ekegusii: Koranyigwere, rirorio nomanye ayaare boronge na ekeene, na ayagwenerete: ee, nomanye chiinchera chionsi chire chingiya,

English: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hekima itaingia moyoni mwako, nayo maarifa yataifurahisha nafsi yako.
Ekegusii: na obong’aini ’mbosoe ase enkoro yao, ne chiseemi nigo chiragokie omoyo oo.

English: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
Kiswahili: Busara itakuhifadhi na ufahamu utakulinda.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio y’ebirengererio ebiya nekorende, na okomanya okuya ’ngokorende boigo.

English: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
Kiswahili: Hekima itakuokoa kutoka njia za waovu, kutoka kwa watu ambao maneno yao yamepotoka,
Ekegusii: Obong’aini ’mbokorusie korwa ase chiinchera chi’obobe na korwa ase abanto bagokwana amang’ana y’obosiru.

English: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
Kiswahili: wale waachao mapito yaliyonyooka wakatembea katika njia za giza,
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotiga chiinchera chi’oboronge, babwatia chiinchera chi’omosunte.

English: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
Kiswahili: wale wapendao kutenda mabaya na kufurahia upotovu wa ubaya,
Ekegusii: Nigo bakogookera ase ogokora amabe, naende bagookera chingencho chi’oborubanu.

English: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
Kiswahili: ambao mapito yao yamepotoka na ambao ni wapotovu katika njia zao.
Ekegusii: Chinchera chiabo nigo chire chinkorekanu, nigo bagotaara ase chiinchera chire borogochi.

English: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
Kiswahili: Itakuokoa pia kutokana na mwanamke kahaba, kutokana na mke aliyepotoka mwenye maneno ya kushawishi kutenda ubaya,
Ekegusii: Obong’aini obwo ’mbogokonye kwebachera omokungu onde bwensi omotayayi, oyio ogokwana amang’ana ogweansia korwa ase omonwa oye,

English: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
Kiswahili: aliyemwacha mwenzi wa ujana wake na kupuuza agano alilofanya mbele ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: oyio otigire omwanchi bw’oboke bwaye, naende bwebire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa Nyasae oye.

English: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nyumba yake huelekea kwenye kifo na mapito yake kwenye roho za waliokufa.
Ekegusii: Ere amo nab’enyomba yaye nigo bagotirimboka gochia ase amakweri, ne chiinchera chiaye nigo chikobaraa gochia aase abakuure.

English: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yeyote aendaye kwake akarudi, au kufikia mapito ya uzima.
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi ogochiera omokungu oyio tari koirana naende, takoiranera chiinchera chi’obogima.

English: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
Kiswahili: Hivyo utatembea katika njia za watu wema na kushikamana na mapito ya wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, obwatie enchera y’abanto abaya, na otaare ase oboeto bw’abanyaboronge.

English: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wanyofu wataishi katika nchi, nao wasio na lawama watabakia ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera abare ne chinkoro chindonge ’mbamenye ase ense, na abaikeranu ’mbageenderere komenya aroro.

English: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
Kiswahili: Bali waovu watakatiliwa mbali kutoka nchi, nao wasio waaminifu watangʼolewa kutoka humo.
Ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe ’mbaitwe barue ase ense, na abasaria ’mbasirigwe kegima.

English: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, usisahau mafundisho yangu, bali zitunze amri zangu moyoni mwako,
Ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa kweba amorokererio ane, korende tiga enkoro yao ebwate amachiiko ane.

English: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa zitakuongezea miaka mingi ya maisha yako na kukuletea mafanikio.
Ekegusii: Ayio nagere omenye amatuko amaange, na emiaka emenge, naende ogeendererete koba nomorembe.

English: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
Kiswahili: Usiache kamwe upendo na uaminifu vitengane nawe; vifunge shingoni mwako, viandike katika ubao wa moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Totiga obuya na ekeene birue ase ore; obisibe ase rigoti ria’o, na obiriike ase enkoro yao.

English: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
Kiswahili: Ndipo utapata kibali na jina zuri mbele za Mungu na mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Igo nario oranyore ogwancherwa na okomanya okuya ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
Kiswahili: Mtumaini Bwana kwa moyo wako wote wala usizitegemee akili zako mwenyewe;
Ekegusii: Osemerie Omonene n’enkoro yao yonsi; tobaisa gosemeria okomanya kwao.

English: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
Kiswahili: katika njia zako zote mkiri yeye, naye atayanyoosha mapito yako.
Ekegusii: Orengererie Omonene, omoorokie ase chiinchera chiao chionsi, nere narongeyie oboeto bwao.

English: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
Kiswahili: Usiwe mwenye hekima machoni pako mwenyewe; mche Bwana ukajiepushe na uovu.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gwekora omong’aini ase okorora kwao omonyene; omoiroke Omonene na bweatanane korwa ase amabe.

English: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
Kiswahili: Hii itakuletea afya mwilini mwako, na mafuta kwenye mifupa yako.
Ekegusii: Korakore igo, ayio nagwenie omobere oo abeeke emeseto y’amauga ao chinguru.

English: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;
Kiswahili: Mheshimu Bwana kwa mali zako na kwa malimbuko ya mazao yako yote;
Ekegusii: Osike Omonene ne chinibo chiao chionsi na ogotongora kwao gwonsi kw’endagera.

English: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
Kiswahili: ndipo ghala zako zitakapojaa hadi kufurika, viriba vyako vitafurika kwa mvinyo mpya.
Ekegusii: Erio ebiage biao mbiichore n’endagera enyinge na ebimitero biao biichore n’edivai engiya.

English: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, usiidharau adhabu ya Bwana na usichukie kukaripiwa naye,
Ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa kwanga gose gochaaya okorongeyia kw’Omonene.

English: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu Bwana huwaadibisha wale awapendao, kama vile baba afanyavyo kwa mwana apendezwaye naye.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi Omonene anchete nigo akomorongeyia, buna ise omwana akorongeyia omwana oria agokirie nere.

English: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule aonaye hekima, mtu yule apataye ufahamu,
Ekegusii: Nare n’omogooko omonto oyio onyorire obong’aini naende ore n’okomanya.

English: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
Kiswahili: kwa maana hekima ana faida kuliko fedha na mapato yake ni bora kuliko ya dhahabu safi.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bobwate ebitoki ebinge kobua ebie chifeta na ebie chitaabu.

English: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
Kiswahili: Hekima ana thamani kuliko marijani; hakuna chochote unachokitamani kinachoweza kulinganishwa naye.
Ekegusii: Nigo bore n’engeencho enene kobua amagena akomeka‐meka ye rigori rinene, gose tokoboreng’ania na kende gionsi oganetie.

English: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
Kiswahili: Maisha marefu yako katika mkono wake wa kuume; katika mkono wake wa kushoto kuna utajiri na heshima.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bobwate obogima bw’amatuko amaange ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na ase okoboko kwaye gw’okobee nigo bobwate obonda obonge amo n’ogosikwa.

English: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
Kiswahili: Njia zake zinapendeza, mapito yake yote ni amani.
Ekegusii: Chinchera chiaye nigo chire echi’omogooko, na oboeto bwaye bwonsi nigo bore obw’omorembe.

English: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni mti wa uzima kwa wale wanaomkumbatia; wale wamshikao watabarikiwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo bore omote bw’obogima ase abwo babobwatererete; na kera omonto ogendererete kobobwata bokong’u nasesenirie.

English: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
Kiswahili: Kwa hekima Bwana aliiweka misingi ya dunia, kwa ufahamu aliziweka mbingu mahali pake;
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo abeegete oboroso bw’ense n’obong’aini bwaye, na agakong’ia igoro nokomanya kwaye.

English: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
Kiswahili: kwa maarifa yake vilindi viligawanywa, nayo mawingu yanadondosha umande.
Ekegusii: Ase obong’aini bwaye chindiba nigo chikobochoria, na amare atonyia riime.

English: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, hifadhi maamuzi mema na busara, usiache vitoke machoni pako;
Ekegusii: Omwana one, bwata bokong’u obong’aini obuya na okomanya; tobaisa gotiga ebio birue ase obosio bwao.

English: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
Kiswahili: ndipo vitakapokuwa uzima nafsini mwako na pambo la neema shingoni mwako.
Ekegusii: Igo ebio mbibe obogima ase omoyo oo, na ogwechabera okuya ase rigoti ria’o.

English: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
Kiswahili: Kisha utaenda katika njia yako salama, wala mguu wako hautajikwaa;
Ekegusii: Erio notaare ase enchera yao kore n’oborendi obuya, gose tokogoochwa okogoro kwao.

English: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
Kiswahili: ulalapo, hautaogopa; ulalapo usingizi wako utakuwa mtamu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ogochia korara, toba n’obwoba, koraire nonyore chitoro chingiya.

English: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
Kiswahili: Usiogope maafa ya ghafula au maangamizi yanayowapata waovu,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kwoboa okogosa kogocha mobosokano, gose ogosirigwa kw’abanyabibe kogocha buna omoubera.

English: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Bwana atakuwa tumaini lako na kuepusha mguu wako kunaswa katika mtego.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabe ogosemeria kwao, ere narende okogoro kwao tikobaisa kobwatwa ase omotego.

English: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
Kiswahili: Usizuie wema kwa wale wanaostahili ikiwa katika uwezo wako kutenda.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa korina abaremerwa amaya ayabagwenerete konyora, onye ayio are ase okobua kwao kobakoonya.

English: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
Kiswahili: Usimwambie jirani yako, “Njoo baadaye, nitakupa kesho”: wakati wewe unacho kitu kile karibu nawe.
Ekegusii: Ekero obwate egento ase engaki eyio kware koa omonto omino, tobaisa komoteebia, “Genda ochiche ankio, nario ndagekoe.”

English: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
Kiswahili: Usifanye hila ya kumdhuru jirani yako, ambaye anaishi karibu na wewe akikuamini.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora emeroberio gokorera omonto omino bobe; oyio omenyete amo naye, ogosemeretie ng’a anyore oborendi obuya.

English: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
Kiswahili: Usimshtaki mtu bila sababu, wakati hajakutenda dhara lolote.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koamererania na monto onde engencho ende etaiyo, onye taragokorera bobe bonde.

English: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
Kiswahili: Usimwonee wivu mtu mwenye jeuri wala kuchagua njia yake iwayo yote,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gosanera amang’ana yomonto otari gokora ay’oboronge, gose tobaisa kwega chiinchera chiaye,

English: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Bwana humchukia mtu mpotovu, lakini siri yake iko kwa mwenye haki.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abanto abasareku nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende obobisi bwaye nigo bore ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

English: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
Kiswahili: Laana ya Bwana i juu ya nyumba ya mwovu, lakini yeye huibariki nyumba ya mwenye haki.
Ekegusii: Okoragereria kw’Omonene nigo kore ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe, korende nigo agosesenia chinka chi’abanyene oboronge.

English: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
Kiswahili: Huwadhihaki wale wanaodhihaki, lakini huwapa neema wale wanyenyekevu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agochecheria abwo bagochecheria, korende abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya na amaabera.

English: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
Kiswahili: Wenye hekima hurithi heshima, bali huwaaibisha wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abang’aini ’mbanyore omwando bw’obonene, korende abariri ’mbabogorie obosooku.

English: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni wanangu, mafundisho ya baba yenu; sikilizeni kwa makini na mpate ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abana bane, igwa amorokererio ane inche iso; tegerera mono, erinde monyaare koba n’okomanya.

English: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
Kiswahili: Ninawapa mafundisho ya maana, kwa hiyo msiyaache mafundisho yangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nkobaa amorokererio amaya; timotiga aya nabachiikeire.

English: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
Kiswahili: Nilipokuwa mvulana mdogo katika nyumba ya baba yangu, ningali mchanga na mtoto pekee kwa mama yangu,
Ekegusii: Nigo narenge omwana, narenge na tata; nigo narenge omwororo nanchire na baba, ekiagera nigo narenge omomoima.

English: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
Kiswahili: baba alinifundisha akisema, “Yashike maneno yangu yote kwa moyo wako wote; yashike maagizo yangu na wewe utaishi.
Ekegusii: Tata akanyorokereria, aganteebia, “Tiga amang’ana ane abeere ase enkoro yao ime; orende amachiiko ane, erio nario or’abe moyo.”

English: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
Kiswahili: Pata hekima, pata ufahamu; usiyasahau maneno yangu wala usiyaache.
Ekegusii: Enyorere obong’aini na okomanya, tobaisa kobieba! Tibwanga koigwera amang’ana ’ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one.

English: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
Kiswahili: Usimwache hekima naye atakuweka salama; mpende, naye atakulinda.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga obong’aini, ekiagera borobwo ’mbokorende. Obwanche, na borobwo ’mbogere ogeenderere koba buya.

English: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
Kiswahili: Hekima ni bora kuliko vitu vyote; kwa hiyo jipe hekima. Hata ikikugharimu vyote ulivyo navyo, pata ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obw’engeencho enene. Ase ayio, enyorere obong’aini, na kende gionsi okorigia, rigia obe n’okomanya.

English: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
Kiswahili: Mstahi, naye atakukweza; mkumbatie, naye atakuheshimu.
Ekegusii: Obobare koba n’engeencho enene, na borobwo ’mbogokinie; koraboboanie nigo borakorentere ogosikwa.

English: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
Kiswahili: Atakuvika shada la neema kichwani mwako na kukupa taji ya utukufu.”
Ekegusii: Mbobeke ase omotwe oo ekiore gechabeire, naende bokoe eguutwa y’obonene.

English: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza mwanangu, kubali ninachokuambia, nayo miaka ya maisha yako itakuwa mingi.
Ekegusii: Aye omwana one, igwa amang’ana ane, oyaanche, igo nario emiaka y’obogima bwao er’abe emenge.

English: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
Kiswahili: Ninakuongoza katika njia ya hekima na kukuongoza katika mapito yaliyonyooka.
Ekegusii: Inche nakworokereirie enchera y’obong’aini; nakoraaire ase oboeto bore oboronge.

English: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
Kiswahili: Utembeapo, hatua zako hazitazuiliwa; ukimbiapo, hutajikwaa.
Ekegusii: Ekero oraabe kogotaara, togotererigwa, na ekero oraabe gokominyoka, tokogoochwa.

English: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
Kiswahili: Mkamate sana elimu, usimwache aende zake; mshike, maana yeye ni uzima wako.
Ekegusii: Bwata amorokererio bokong’u, toyatiga arue ase ore; yarende, ekiagera n’aro obogima bwao.

English: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
Kiswahili: Usiuweke mguu wako katika njia ya waovu wala usitembee katika njia ya watu wabaya.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kobwatia enchera y’abakori amabe, gose tobwatia chiinchera chi’abaanto ababe.

English: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
Kiswahili: Epukana nayo, usisafiri katika njia hiyo; achana nayo, na uelekee njia yako.
Ekegusii: Bweatanane korwa ase enchera eyio, toyebwatia, korende ogobere oetere ensemo, ogeende bosio.

English: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hawawezi kulala mpaka watende uovu; wanashindwa hata kusinzia mpaka wamwangushe mtu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari korara goika barore ng’a bakorire amabe. Onye tibarakorera omonto amabe, tibari korara chitoro.

English: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
Kiswahili: Wanakula mkate wa uovu, na kunywa mvinyo wa jeuri.
Ekegusii: Endagera yabo bakoria n’ogokora amabe, na edivai yabo bakonywa n’obotindi.

English: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
Kiswahili: Njia ya wenye haki ni kama nuru ya kwanza ya mapambazuko, ambayo hungʼaa zaidi na zaidi mpaka mchana mkamilifu.
Ekegusii: Korende enchera y’abanyene oboronge nigo enga buna amasase a mambia; ayio akogeenderera koraba goetania goika bwakia se.

English: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
Kiswahili: Lakini njia ya waovu ni kama giza nene; hawajui kinachowafanya wajikwae.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’abakori amabe nigo enga buna omosunte ekerima; tibari komanya ebinto bikobagocha.

English: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, yasikilize kwa makini yale ninayokuambia; sikiliza kwa makini maneno yangu.
Ekegusii: Omwana one, tegerera oigwe amang’ana ane! Igwera amang’ana ’nkogoteebia.

English: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
Kiswahili: Usiruhusu yaondoke machoni pako, yahifadhi ndani ya moyo wako;
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio tabaisa korua ase amaiso ao. Yagache ime ase enkoro yao.

English: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ni uzima kwa wale wanaoyapata na afya kwa mwili wote wa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo are obogima ase oyio oyanyorire, naende nigo akogwenia omobere oye bwonsi.

English: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya yote, linda moyo wako, kuliko yote uyalindayo, maana ndiko zitokako chemchemi za uzima.
Ekegusii: Renda enkoro yao kobua ande onsi orendete, ekiagera nao chinsoko chi’obogima chikorua.

English: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
Kiswahili: Epusha kinywa chako na ukaidi; weka mazungumzo machafu mbali na midomo yako.
Ekegusii: Tuguta chinkwana chi’obokorekanu korwa ase omonwa oo, na amang’ana y’obong’ainereria korwa ase ebikoba biao.

English: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
Kiswahili: Macho yako na yatazame mbele, kaza macho yako moja kwa moja mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Tiga amaiso ao arigererie gochia bosio, na ebioge bi’amaiso ao biramokigwe boronge.

English: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
Kiswahili: Sawazisha mapito ya miguu yako na njia zako zote ziwe zimethibitika.
Ekegusii: Rongeyia oboeto bw’amagoro ao, ne chiinchera chiao chionsi chibe chindonge.

English: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
Kiswahili: Usigeuke kulia wala kushoto; epusha mguu wako na ubaya.
Ekegusii: Togobera gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Rusia okogoro kwao korwa ase ebibe.

English: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
