Kiswahili: Mwanangu, sikiliza kwa makini hekima yangu, sikiliza vizuri maneno yangu ya busara,
Ekegusii: Omwana one, tegerera oigwe obong’aini bwane! Igwera okomanya kw’ane!

English: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
Kiswahili: ili uweze kutunza busara na midomo yako ihifadhi maarifa.
Ekegusii: Erio nario oramanye korenda ebirengererio biao, na ebikoba biao birende chiseemi.

English: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana midomo ya mwanamke kahaba hudondoza asali, na maneno ya kinywa chake ni laini kuliko mafuta;
Ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omokuungu omonyaka nigo bigotonyia ayaare amansu buna obooke, na omonwa oye nigo ore omoterere kobua amaguta akweakwa.

English: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
Kiswahili: lakini mwisho wake ni mchungu kama nyongo, mkali kama upanga ukatao kuwili.
Ekegusii: Korende omoerio bw’omokuungu oyio nigo ore omoororo buna ekemeri ekeroro, na omwoge buna omoyio o birende otieririe chinsemo chionsi ibere.

English: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
Kiswahili: Miguu yake hushuka kuelekea kwenye kifo; hatua zake huelekea moja kwa moja kaburini.
Ekegusii: Amagoro aye nigo akoraa gochia ase amakweri, na ogotacha kwaye kwaraa gochia aase abakuure.

English: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
Kiswahili: Yeye hafikiri juu ya njia ya uzima; njia zake zimepotoka, lakini yeye hajui.
Ekegusii: Ere tari gotaara enchera ekogeenda ase obogima; orogendo rw’aye nigo rokona‐koonchaonchoka, ere tamanyeti ayio.

English: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
Kiswahili: Sasa basi wanangu, nisikilizeni; msiache ninalowaambia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abana bane, ’ntegerere; timobaisa gotiga amang’ana ane.

English: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
Kiswahili: Njia zenu ziwe mbali naye, msiende karibu na mlango wa nyumba yake,
Ekegusii: Erende obeere aare korwa ase omokungu oyio; tobaisa goika ang’e negesieri ki’enyomba yaye.

English: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
Kiswahili: usije ukatoa nguvu zako nzuri kwa wengine na miaka yako kwa aliye mkatili,
Ekegusii: Oise gokora bo, nigo orae abanto abaao amasikani ao, na emiaka yao ebaise konachwa n’abanto batari n’amaabera.

English: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
Kiswahili: wageni wasije wakasherehekea utajiri wako na jitihada yako ikatajirisha nyumba ya mwanaume mwingine.
Ekegusii: Naende abanto abaao nigo baraire chinibo chiao chionsi, na bionsi ebi gwakoreire emeremo biirwe nabaanto abwo.

English: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
Kiswahili: Mwishoni mwa maisha yako utalia kwa uchungu, wakati nyama na mwili wako vimechakaa.
Ekegusii: Omoerio oye norere, obokie amagombo ekero chinyama chi’omobere oo chiaerire,

English: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.
Kiswahili: Utasema, “Tazama jinsi gani nilivyochukia adhabu! Tazama jinsi moyo wangu ulivyodharau maonyo!
Ekegusii: ’noteebe, “Inaki nakorete ’nkageecha ogokuurerwa, na enkoro y’ane egachaaya okorongeigwa!

English: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
Kiswahili: Sikuwatii walimu wangu wala kuwasikiliza wakufunzi wangu.
Ekegusii: Tinaigwerete amorokererio yaborokia bane, gose tinategererete koigwera abarenge konyorokereria.

English: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
Kiswahili: Nimefika ukingoni mwa maangamizi kabisa katikati ya kusanyiko lote.”
Ekegusii: Nigo nabeete ang’e gosira ase obosooku kegima bosio bw’omogaanda ondigereretie.”

English: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
Kiswahili: Kunywa maji kutoka kwenye kisima chako mwenyewe, maji yanayotiririka kutoka kwenye kisima chako mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Kanywe amaache okobucha korwa ase egesima kiao, na aya agosoka korwa ase ensoko yao.

English: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
Kiswahili: Je, chemchemi zako zifurike katika barabara za mji na vijito vyako vya maji viwanjani?
Ekegusii: Inee! Chinsooko chiao ’nchigwenerete gwesiarera gochia aare, ne chindooche chiao chi’amaache ase chiinchera?

English: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
Kiswahili: Na viwe vyako mwenyewe, kamwe visishirikishwe wageni.
Ekegusii: Tiga chinsoko echio chibe echiao aye bweka na tari echi’abaanto abaao.

English: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
Kiswahili: Chemchemi yako na ibarikiwe na umfurahie mke wa ujana wako.
Ekegusii: Tiga ensoko yao esesenigwe, naye ogookere omokungu bw’oboke bwao,

English: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
Kiswahili: Kulungu jike apendaye, kulungu mzuri: matiti yake na yakutosheleze siku zote, nawe utekwe daima na upendo wake.
Ekegusii: oyore buna ensune eyanchire na buna engabi ensiani. Tiga obosiani bwaye bokong’use, na ogokigwe nere chingaki chionsi. Obwanchani bwaye tiga bokogokie kogeenderera.

English: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mwanangu, utekwe na mwanamke kahaba? Kwa nini ukumbatie kifua cha mke wa mwanaume mwingine?
Ekegusii: Omwana one, nase ki okogokigwa nomokuungu omonyaka? Nase ki okoboania omokungu bw’omonto omoao?

English: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana njia za mtu ni wazi kabisa mbele za Bwana, naye huyapima mapito yake yote.
Ekegusii: Chinchera chi’omonto nigo chirorekanete maiso marore ase Omonene, n’Omonene nigo arigereretie ogokora kwaye gwonsi.

English: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
Kiswahili: Matendo mabaya ya mtu mwovu humnasa yeye mwenyewe; kamba za dhambi yake humkamata kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ebibe bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomobwata omonyene; nasibwe ne chingori chire ebibe biaye.

English: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
Kiswahili: Atakufa kwa kukosa nidhamu, akipotoshwa kwa upumbavu wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arakwe, ekiagera angete ogokuurerwa, na ase engencho y’oboriri bwaye obonene ’nasire.

English: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, kama umekuwa mdhamini wa jirani yako, ikiwa umeshika mikono kwa kuweka ahadi kwa ajili ya mwingine,
Ekegusii: Omwana one, ande kweruure koba intenenera ase omonto omino, na kwarire eira ase omonto omoao na kobwatana nere amaboko.

English: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
Kiswahili: kama umetegwa na ulichosema, umenaswa kwa maneno ya kinywa chako,
Ekegusii: Bono amang’ana gwakwanete korwa ase omonwa oo akobwatire buna omotego.

English: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
Kiswahili: basi fanya hivi mwanangu, ili ujiweke huru, kwa kuwa umeanguka mikononi mwa jirani yako: Nenda ukajinyenyekeshe kwake; msihi jirani yako!
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omwana one, bono nigo ore inse y’okobua kw’omonto oyio, na onye korigetie gwetooria korwa ase are okore iga: Kabe omoitongo, ogende ase are omosorore, erinde agosibore korwa ase eira eyio.

English: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
Kiswahili: Usiruhusu usingizi machoni pako, usiruhusu kope zako zisinzie.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa korara gose gosundoka;

English: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
Kiswahili: Jiweke huru, kama swala mkononi mwa mwindaji, kama ndege kutoka kwenye mtego wa mwindaji.
Ekegusii: minyoka buna engabi egotama erue ase omotwari, na buna enyoni egotama erue ase omotegi.

English: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
Kiswahili: Ewe mvivu, mwendee mchwa; zitafakari njia zake ukapate hekima!
Ekegusii: Aye ore omworo, geenda ase amage, origererie orore buna agokora emeremo n’omokia onyore obong’aini.

English: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye hana msimamizi, wala mwangalizi, au mtawala,
Ekegusii: Aro tabwati omogambi, gose omoteneneri, gose omoraai,

English: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
Kiswahili: lakini hujiwekea akiba wakati wa kiangazi na hukusanya chakula chake wakati wa mavuno.
Ekegusii: korende nigo agosangereria chindagera chiabo chingaki chi’egura gura, achigacha goika ekero ki’eguru‐gura.

English: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
Kiswahili: Ewe mvivu, utalala hata lini? Utaamka lini kutoka usingizi wako?
Ekegusii: Aye omworo, ’ngoika ririri oragenderere korara? Ndiriri orabooke korwa ase chitoro chiao?

English: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—
Kiswahili: Bado kulala kidogo, kusinzia kidogo, bado kukunja mikono kidogo upate kupumzika:
Ekegusii: Okoraara ake, okwegondia ake; okoringania amaboko gotimoka,

English: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
Kiswahili: hivyo umaskini utakuja juu yako kama mnyangʼanyi, na kupungukiwa kutakujia kama mtu mwenye silaha.
Ekegusii: obotaka ’mbogoochere buna omouri agoocha, na oboremerwa booche buna omonto obwate ebirwanero agocha.

English: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
Kiswahili: Mtu mbaya sana na mlaghai, ambaye huzungukazunguka na maneno ya upotovu,
Ekegusii: Omonto otagwenereti kende ore omokori amabe nigo agoeta‐eta, ogokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye.

English: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
Kiswahili: ambaye anakonyeza kwa jicho lake, anayetoa ishara kwa miguu yake na kuashiria kwa vidole vyake,
Ekegusii: Nigo agosumera ebioge bi’amaiso aye, naende nigo agosumera amagoro, na okworokia ebimanyererio n’amaboko aye.

English: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
Kiswahili: ambaye hupanga ubaya kwa udanganyifu moyoni mwake: daima huchochea fitina.
Ekegusii: Ogoitania abanto nigo goichire ase enkoro yaye, botambe nigo akoroberia korenta amabe; nigo agosimeka chimbusuro chi’ogotaigwana.

English: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo maafa yatamkumba ghafula; ataangamizwa mara, pasipo msaada.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio emechando nemoochere mobosokano; nigo arasirigwe mobasokano atanyaare gotoorigwa.

English: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
Kiswahili: Kuna vitu sita anavyovichukia Bwana, naam, viko saba vilivyo chukizo kwake:
Ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bitano nakemo Omonene ageechete, ee, mbire bitan’abibere bire okogeecha ase are, nabio ebi:

English: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
Kiswahili: macho ya kiburi, ulimi udanganyao, mikono imwagayo damu isiyo na hatia,
Ekegusii: Okorigereria kw’oboenenu, na oromeme rogokwana oborimo, amaboko agoitera amanyinga atari na komocha;

English: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
Kiswahili: moyo uwazao mipango miovu, miguu iliyo myepesi kukimbilia uovu,
Ekegusii: enkoro ekoroberia amabe, na amagoro akominyoka gochia gokora amabe;

English: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
Kiswahili: shahidi wa uongo ambaye humwaga uongo, na mtu ambaye huchochea fitina kati ya ndugu.
Ekegusii: kirori bw’oborimo, ogokwana oborimo, na omonto ogosimeka chimbusuro chi’ogoitania ase egati y’abanto abamo.

English: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, zishike amri za baba yako, wala usiyaache mafundisho ya mama yako.
Ekegusii: Omwana one, igwera aya inche iso ’nkogochika, na totiga amorokererio a nyoko.

English: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
Kiswahili: Yafunge katika moyo wako daima, yakaze kuizunguka shingo yako.
Ekegusii: Yasibe, ageenderere kobeera ase enkoro yao botambe, naende oyasibe ase rigoti ria’o.

English: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
Kiswahili: Wakati utembeapo, yatakuongoza; wakati ulalapo, yatakulinda; wakati uamkapo, yatazungumza nawe.
Ekegusii: Ekero or’abe kogotaara, aro nakoraae; ekero or’abe koraire, ’nakorende, na ekero or’abe gokoboka, ayio nakwane naye.

English: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana amri hizi ni taa, mafundisho haya ni mwanga na maonyo ya maadili ni njia ya uzima,
Ekegusii: Amachiiko nigo are etaya, na amorokererio nigo are oborabu; ogokuurera gw’okorongeigwa nigo kore enchera y’obogima.

English: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
Kiswahili: yakikulinda na mwanamke aliyepotoka, kutokana na maneno laini ya mwanamke aliyepotoka.
Ekegusii: Nigo korakorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka, na korwa ase amang’ana y’oromeme rw’aye oroterere rokoebereria.

English: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
Kiswahili: Moyo wako usitamani uzuri wake wala macho yake yasikuteke,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa komogania ase enkoro yao ime ase engencho y’ekieni kiaye ekiya; amaiso aye tabaisa gokong’usa.

English: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
Kiswahili: kwa maana kahaba atakufanya uwe maskini, hata ukose kipande cha mkate, naye mwanamke mzinzi huwinda maisha yako hasa.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omokuungu omotayayi omonto nigo akoremerwa oborwa nonya negesamunye ki’omogati, na omokungu bw’omonto omoao nigo akorigia obogima bw’omonto obosaria.

English: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
Kiswahili: Je, mtu aweza kuchotea moto kwenye paja lake bila nguo zake kuungua?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nabogorie omorero ayobeeke ase egekuba kiaye, ne chianga chiaye tichiyia?

English: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
Kiswahili: Je, mtu aweza kutembea juu ya makaa ya moto yanayowaka bila miguu yake kuungua?
Ekegusii: Gose nataare ase rieera ri’omorero, na amagoro aye tayia?

English: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
Kiswahili: Ndivyo alivyo mtu alalaye na mke wa mwanaume mwingine; hakuna yeyote amgusaye huyo mwanamke ambaye hataadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo er’abe ase omonto ogotomana n’omokungu bw’omonto onde; onde bwensi okoba nomokuungu oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.

English: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,
Kiswahili: Watu hawamdharau mwizi kama akiiba kukidhi njaa yake wakati ana njaa.
Ekegusii: Abanto tibari gochaaya omoibi onye ore koiba endagera ekiagera are n’enchara.

English: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hayo, kama akikamatwa, lazima alipe mara saba, ingawa inamgharimu utajiri wote wa nyumba yake.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo omoibi oria kanyorirwe, goika airanie ara gatano na kabere; nigo araakane ebinto bionsi abwate nyomba mwaye.

English: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwanaume aziniye na mwanamke hana akili kabisa; yeyote afanyaye hivyo hujiangamiza mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogotomana nomokuungu onde bwensi, oyio tabwati chiseemi; oyo ogokora ayio nigo agwesaria ere omonyene.

English: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
Kiswahili: Mapigo na aibu ni fungu lake na aibu yake haitafutika kamwe;
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arabe n’amaakwa naende asirie amasikani onsi. Obosooku bwaye tibogotinyigwa boere.

English: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
Kiswahili: kwa maana wivu huamsha ghadhabu ya mume, naye hataonyesha huruma alipizapo kisasi.
Ekegusii: Risemi nigo rigokora omosacha oba nekeririanda, na takoba n’amaabera ekero akorusia egesiomba.

English: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
Kiswahili: Hatakubali fidia yoyote; atakataa malipo, hata yakiwa makubwa kiasi gani.
Ekegusii: Ere tagwancha embooria ende yonsi, naegwa ebiegwa ebinge takobiancha.

English: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, shika maneno yangu na kuzihifadhi amri zangu ndani yako.
Ekegusii: Omwana one, renda amang’ana ane, na obeke amachiiko ane abeere ime yao.

English: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
Kiswahili: Shika amri zangu nawe utaishi; linda mafundisho yangu kama mboni ya jicho lako.
Ekegusii: Bwata amachiiko ane, erinde obe moyo; orende amorokererio ane buna orendete endorero y’eriiso ria’o.

English: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
Kiswahili: Yafunge katika vidole vyako; yaandike katika kibao cha moyo wako.
Ekegusii: Oyasibe ase ebiara bi’amaboko ao, na oyariike oyabeeke ase enkoro ya’o.

English: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
Kiswahili: Mwambie hekima, “Wewe ni dada yangu,” uite ufahamu jamaa yako;
Ekegusii: Teebia obong’aini, “Aye naye mosubati ominto”, na obomanyi oboroke omosani oo momanyaine,

English: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
Kiswahili: watakuepusha na mwanamke mzinzi, kutokana na mwanamke mpotovu na maneno yake ya kubembeleza.
Ekegusii: erinde bikorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka ogokwana amang’ana y’okoebereria.

English: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
Kiswahili: Kwenye dirisha la nyumba yangu nilitazama nje kupitia upenyo kwenye mwimo wa dirisha.
Ekegusii: Nigo narigereretie isiko goetera ase ekebao ki’enyomba ya’ne na ebichanga bi’aroro.

English: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
Kiswahili: Niliona miongoni mwa wajinga, nikagundua miongoni mwa wanaume vijana, kijana asiye na akili.
Ekegusii: Ase egati y’abanto batamanyeti amaange, ’nkarora omomura ore ase egati y’abamura bande otabwati chiseemi.

English: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
Kiswahili: Alikuwa akishuka njiani karibu na pembe ya kwake, akielekea kwenye nyumba ya huyo mwanamke
Ekegusii: Oyio nigo arenge goeta ase enchera yarenge ang’e nekoona agwo ase omokungu oria omonyaka amenyete agechoba‐chobania gochia ase enyomba yaye

English: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
Kiswahili: wakati wa machweo, jua likipungua nuru yake, giza la usiku lilipokuwa likiingia.
Ekegusii: mogoroba kobokomura‐mura, ekero ki’omosuunte bw’obotuko.

English: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
Kiswahili: Ndipo huyo mwanamke akatoka kumlaki, hali amevaa kama kahaba akiwa na nia ya udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Rora, omokungu agacha akaumerana n’omomura oria. Omokungu oria nigo abeegete chianga chi’obotayayi orenge omong’ainereria ase enkoro yaye.

English: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
Kiswahili: (Ni mwanamke mwenye makelele na mkaidi, miguu yake haitulii nyumbani;
Ekegusii: Nigo arenge omonyariogi otari kogoma nyomba mwaye.

English: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
Kiswahili: mara kwenye barabara za mji, mara kwenye viwanja vikubwa, kwenye kila pembe huvizia.)
Ekegusii: Nigo agosioma‐siomia aande onsi ase chiinchera na ase chichiiro, na ase kera amatabekania oba oganyete.

English: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanamke alimkumbatia kijana na kumbusu, na kwa uso usio na haya akamwambia:
Ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akaboania omomura oria na komonyunyunta, akomorigereria n’amaiso, atari nobosooku, akomoteebia,

English: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
Kiswahili: “Nina sadaka za amani nyumbani; leo nimetimiza nadhiri zangu.
Ekegusii: “Nariete eira korua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe; rituko ria reero nayeikeranirie.

English: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nimetoka nje kukulaki; nimekutafuta na nimekupata!
Ekegusii: Ayio naro agera naacha gokorotota, nigo nakorigirie n’omokia ng’a ’nkorore, na bono nakonyorire.

English: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Nimetandika kitanda changu kwa kitani za rangi kutoka Misri.
Ekegusii: Naarire oborere bwane nebirarero ebiya, na ebitambaa bimatonto bikorwa Misiri.

English: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
Kiswahili: Nimetia manukato kitanda changu kwa manemane, udi na mdalasini.
Ekegusii: Naboumoreire manemane, na amaguta y’omogaka, na ay’omodalasini botioke buya.

English: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
Kiswahili: Njoo, tuzame katika mapenzi mpaka asubuhi; tujifurahishe wenyewe kwa mapenzi!
Ekegusii: Inchuo togokanie ase obotuko bwonsi goika mambia; inchwo twegokie n’obwanchani.

English: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
Kiswahili: Mume wangu hayupo nyumbani; amekwenda safari ya mbali.
Ekegusii: Omosacha one taiyo, ochiire orogendo orotambe.

English: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
Kiswahili: Amechukua mkoba uliojazwa fedha na hatakuwepo nyumbani karibuni.”
Ekegusii: Nigo aira chitaabu chichire omobuko na nigo arairane omotienyi oikire gochia gati,”

English: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
Kiswahili: Kwa maneno laini yule mwanamke akampotosha; alimshawishi kwa maneno yake laini.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaebereria omomura oria namang’ana amansu ao ao, na ase amang’ana y’ebikoba ebiterere akamobua.

English: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
Kiswahili: Mara huyo kijana alimfuata yule mwanamke kama fahali aendaye machinjoni, kama kulungu aingiaye kwenye kitanzi,
Ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo omomura oria agatunyana omokungu oria buna eng’ombe ekoirwa konyenywa, gose buna omosibwa obwatirwe ogochia kobekwa chingataare.

English: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
Kiswahili: mpaka mshale umchome ini lake, kama ndege anayenaswa kwenye mtego, bila kujua itamgharimu maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Ee, akamotunyana goika ensara ekamobeta egaika riini ime. Nigo abeete buna enyoni ekoayerera gochia ase ebisugunia na tamanyete ng’a ayio nobogima bwaye agosiria.

English: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
Kiswahili: Sasa basi wanangu, nisikilizeni; sikilizeni kwa makini nisemalo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abana bane, ’ntegerera morengererie mono amang’ana ’nkobateebia.

English: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
Kiswahili: Usiruhusu moyo wako ugeukie njia za huyo mwanamke, wala usitangetange katika mapito yake.
Ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaino tichibaisa koonchorwa na kobwatia chingencho chi’omokuungu buna oyio; gose orogendo rw’aye tirobaisa gosiria obogima bwaino.

English: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
Kiswahili: Aliowaangusha ni wengi; aliowachinja ni kundi kubwa.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oyio oiyeirie abanto abange, ee, oitire omogaanda omonene.

English: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
Kiswahili: Nyumba yake ni njia kuu iendayo kaburini, ielekeayo chini kwenye vyumba vya mauti.
Ekegusii: Enyomba yaye nero enchera ekogeenda aase abakuure; ee, enchera eyio nigo egosoa ase chiero chi’amakweri.

English: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
Kiswahili: Je, hekima haitani? Je, ufahamu hapazi sauti?
Ekegusii: Inee! Obong’aini tibori korangeria? Okomanya tikori goaka eriogi rinene?

English: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
Kiswahili: Juu ya miinuko karibu na njia, penye njia panda, ndipo asimamapo;
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogotenena aase aimokererete igoro, ang’e n’enchera engendi, nigo bokobeera ase amatabekania ye chiinchera.

English: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
Kiswahili: kando ya malango yaelekeayo mjini, kwenye maingilio, hulia kwa sauti kubwa, akisema:
Ekegusii: Mbarabare ase ebiita bosio bw’omochie ase ebisoero bi’ebiita nigo bogokwana neriogi rinene, bwateeba;

English: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
Kiswahili: “Ni ninyi wanaume, ninaowaita; ninapaza sauti yangu kwa wanadamu wote.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto, ninwe ’nkorangeria; eriogi riane nigo rigochera Mwanyabaanto.

English: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
Kiswahili: Ninyi ambao ni wajinga, pateni akili; ninyi mlio wapumbavu, pateni ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamotamanyeti amaange, egera obong’aini; na inwe abariri, egera okomanya.

English: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni, kwa maana nina mambo muhimu ya kusema; ninafungua midomo yangu kusema lililo sawa.
Ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe, ekiagera nigo ’ndakwane amang’ana amaya mono; amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa one nay’oboronge.

English: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
Kiswahili: Kinywa changu husema lililo kweli, kwa maana midomo yangu huchukia uovu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ’ngokwana nay’ekeene; amang’ana y’obobe nigo are okogechia ase ebikoba biane.

English: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
Kiswahili: Maneno yote ya kinywa changu ni haki; hakuna mojawapo lililopotoka wala ukaidi.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ane onsi ’ngokwana nigo are ay’oboronge, ande tari are ay’oborimo, gose ay’obokorekanu.

English: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
Kiswahili: Kwa wenye kupambanua yote ni sahihi; hayana kasoro kwa wale wenye maarifa.
Ekegusii: Nigo akoigweka buya ase omonto oyio okoyamanya, naende namaronge ase abwo banyorire chiseemi.

English: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
Kiswahili: Chagua mafundisho yangu badala ya fedha, maarifa badala ya dhahabu safi,
Ekegusii: Ancha amorokererio ane kobua efeta, ne chiseemi kobua etaabu echenire.

English: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
Kiswahili: kwa maana hekima ina thamani kuliko marijani na hakuna chochote unachohitaji kinacholingana naye.
Ekegusii: “Obong’aini nigo bore obuya kobua amagena akomeka‐meka aye rigori rinene, tibokoreng’anigwa n’ebinto bionsi bire ebiya biganeirie.

English: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
Kiswahili: “Mimi hekima, nakaa pamoja na busara; ninamiliki maarifa na busara.
Ekegusii: Inche obong’aini nakorire okomanya kwabeire obomenyo bwane, nigo inde ne chiseemi, naende nimanyete kogamba buya.

English: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana ni kuchukia uovu; ninachukia kiburi na majivuno, tabia mbaya na mazungumzo potovu.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nokogecha obobe; nigo ’ngechete oboenenu, na obwerori, norogendo orobe, boigo namang’ana y’obong’ainereria.

English: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
Kiswahili: Ushauri na hukumu sahihi ni vyangu; nina ufahamu na nina nguvu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nkorua ogoseemia na obong’aini bw’ekeene; nigo inde nokomanya na okobua.

English: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
Kiswahili: Kwa msaada wangu wafalme hutawala na watawala hutunga sheria zilizo za haki,
Ekegusii: Ase obokonyi bwane abarwoti nigo bakogaamba, na abagaambi nigo bakobeeka amachiiko y’ekeene.

English: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
Kiswahili: kwa msaada wangu wakuu hutawala, na wenye vyeo wote watawalao dunia.
Ekegusii: Ase obokonyi bwane abagaambi nigo bakorwa oboronge, boigo nabanene na abanachi ebiina bonsi.

English: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
Kiswahili: Nawapenda wale wanipendao, na wale wanitafutao kwa bidii wataniona.
Ekegusii: Nigo nyanchete abwo banyanchete; na abwo bakondigia n’omokia ’mbanyore.

English: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
Kiswahili: Utajiri na heshima viko kwangu, utajiri udumuo na mafanikio.
Ekegusii: Ninche ’nkorua obonda, na esiko, boigo obotenenku na oboronge bitari koera.

English: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
Kiswahili: Tunda langu ni bora kuliko dhahabu safi; kile nitoacho hupita fedha iliyo bora.
Ekegusii: Okwama nkorua nigo kore okuya kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu engiya, na ebitoki ’nkorua ’mbibuete efeta enchore.

English: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
Kiswahili: Natembea katika njia ya unyofu katika mapito ya haki,
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobwatia enchera y’oboronge, naba ’ngotaara ase oboeto bw’ekeene.

English: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
Kiswahili: nawapa utajiri wale wanipendao na kuzijaza hazina zao.
Ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoa abwo banyanchete obotenenku na goichoria chikungo chiabo.

English: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
Kiswahili: “Bwana aliniumba mwanzoni mwa kazi yake, kabla ya matendo yake ya zamani;
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge nainche korwa omochakano bwe chiinchera chiaye, agwo kare konya ataratonga kende gionsi;

English: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
Kiswahili: niliteuliwa tangu milele, tangu mwanzoni, kabla ya dunia kuumbwa.
Ekegusii: nao narenge korwa agwo kare na kare, nonya nense konya etarabao.

English: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
Kiswahili: Wakati hazijakuwepo bahari, nilikwishazaliwa, wakati hazijakuwepo chemchemi zilizojaa maji;
Ekegusii: Inche nigo naiboretwe chindiba chitarabao, nonya ne chinsoko chi’amaache.

English: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
Kiswahili: kabla milima haijawekwa mahali pake, kabla vilima havijakuwepo, nilikwishazaliwa,
Ekegusii: Nigo naiboretwe oboroso bw’ebitunwa botarabekwa, na ebigoro bitarabao,

English: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
Kiswahili: kabla hajaumba dunia wala mashamba yake au vumbi lolote la dunia.
Ekegusii: ekero ataratonga ense ne riroba riaye, nonya norotu.

English: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
Kiswahili: Nilikuwepo alipoziweka mbingu mahali pake, wakati alichora mstari wa upeo wa macho juu ya uso wa kilindi,
Ekegusii: Ekero atongete igoro chionsi nao narenge, boigo nekero abeekerete amaache chimbebe.

English: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
Kiswahili: wakati aliweka mawingu juu na kuziweka imara chemchemi za bahari,
Ekegusii: Ekero abeegete igoro ekabao, na ekero abeegete chinsoko chigosokia amaache korwa ase chindiba ne chinguru,

English: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
Kiswahili: wakati aliiwekea bahari mpaka wake ili maji yasivunje agizo lake, na wakati aliweka misingi ya dunia.
Ekegusii: na ekero abeekerete chinyancha chimbebe, amaache tabaisa goetania ogochika kwaye; na ekero abeegete amaroso y’ense nao narenge.

English: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
Kiswahili: Wakati huo nilikuwa fundi stadi kando yake. Nilijazwa na furaha siku baada ya siku, nikifurahi daima mbele zake,
Ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge amo nere buna oyomanyete emeremo eyio buya. Kera rituko nigo arenge kogokigwa nainche, na inche ’nkaba inde nomogooko ase obosio bwaye botambe.

English: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
Kiswahili: nikifurahi katika dunia yake yote nami nikiwafurahia wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nagokerete ense yaye emenyire nabaanto, na nkaba nsasokerete Mwanyabaanto.

English: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
Kiswahili: “Basi sasa wanangu, nisikilizeni; heri wale wanaozishika njia zangu.
Ekegusii: “Na bono, inwe abana bane, ’ntegerere moigwe, mbare n’omogooko abwo barendete chiinchera chiane,

English: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni mafundisho yangu mwe na hekima; msiyapuuze.
Ekegusii: Igwera amorokererio! Ancha obong’aini, timobwanga!

English: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule anisikilizaye mimi, akisubiri siku zote malangoni mwangu, akingoja kwenye vizingiti vya mlango wangu.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio okonyigwera; oyio okorenda ase ebiita biane kera rituko, oganyete ase ebisieri biane.

English: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeyote anipataye mimi amepata uzima na kujipatia kibali kutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto onyorire inche, oyio onyorire obogima; naende nancherwe n’Omonene.

English: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeyote ashindwaye kunipata hujiumiza mwenyewe; na wote wanichukiao mimi hupenda mauti.”
Ekegusii: Korende oyio otari nainche nigo akwenachera ekiina ere omonyene. Bonsi abangechete nigo banchete amakweri.”

English: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
Kiswahili: Hekima amejenga nyumba yake; amechonga nguzo zake saba.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bweagacherete enyomba. Nigo bwebaacherete chisiiro isano na ibere.

English: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
Kiswahili: Ameandaa nyama na kuchanganya divai yake; pia ameandaa meza yake.
Ekegusii: Bwanyenyire ching’iti chiaye; bwochoganirie edivai yaye, bwariganirie emesa yaye.

English: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
Kiswahili: Amewatuma watumishi wake wa kike, naye huita kutoka mahali pa juu sana pa mji.
Ekegusii: Bwatomire abasomba baye abaiseke gochia aase aimokererete igoro mono yomochie korangeria abanto, bogoteeba:

English: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
Kiswahili: Anawaambia wale wasio na akili, “Wote ambao ni wajinga na waje hapa!
Ekegusii: “Oyo otamanyeti amaange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri bwateeba:

English: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
Kiswahili: Njooni, mle chakula changu na mnywe divai niliyoichanganya.
Ekegusii: “Inchuo orie endagera y’ane, na onywe edivai nochoganirie!

English: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
Kiswahili: Acheni njia zenu za ujinga nanyi mtaishi; tembeeni katika njia ya ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Tiga oboriri bwao, erinde obe moyo! Obwatie enchera y’okonyora okomanya!”

English: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote anayemkosoa mwenye mzaha hukaribisha matukano; yeyote anayekemea mtu mwovu hupatwa na matusi.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokuurera omonyacheche, nigo akwenyorera obororo; na oyogotogonyera omonto omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera ogochaaywa.

English: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
Kiswahili: Usimkemee mwenye mzaha la sivyo atakuchukia; mkemee mwenye hekima naye atakupenda.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gokuurera omonto omochaayi; oyio nigo arakogeche. Kuurera omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo aragwanche.

English: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
Kiswahili: Mfundishe mtu mwenye hekima naye atakuwa na hekima zaidi; mfundishe mtu mwadilifu naye atazidi kufundishika.
Ekegusii: Orokereria omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo arageenderere koba omong’aini goetania. Orokereria omonto omooronge, oyio namente koba ne chiseemi.

English: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
Kiswahili: “Kumcha Bwana ndicho chanzo cha hekima, na kumjua Aliye Mtakatifu ni ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, oyio n’oro omochakano bw’obong’aini, na okomomanya Oyore Omochenu nabwo obomanyi.

English: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa msaada wangu siku zako zitakuwa nyingi, na miaka itaongezwa katika maisha yako.
Ekegusii: Ase ogokonywa kw’ane amatuko ao nabe amaange, na emiaka y’obogima bwao nementwe.

English: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
Kiswahili: Kama wewe una hekima, hekima yako itakupa tuzo; kama wewe ni mtu wa mzaha, wewe mwenyewe ndiwe utateseka.”
Ekegusii: Korabe nobong’aini, borobwo ’mbooboseemia; korende korabe omochaayi, obochaayi obwo ’mbokoiranere.

English: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke aitwaye Mpumbavu ana kelele; hana adabu na hana maarifa.
Ekegusii: Omokungu omoriri nigo are omonyariogi. Ere nigo are bosa, na tamanyeti ring’ana rinde.

English: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
Kiswahili: Huketi kwenye mlango wa nyumba yake, juu ya kiti katika mahali pa juu sana pa mji,
Ekegusii: Nigo agoikaransera ekerogo ase egesieri ki’enyomba yaye, agwo aase aimokererete igoro ase omochie,

English: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
Kiswahili: akiita wale wapitao karibu, waendao moja kwa moja kwenye njia yao.
Ekegusii: aba okorangeria abaeti bare ase orogendo rwabo,

English: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
Kiswahili: Anawaambia wale wasio na akili, “Wote ambao ni wajinga na waje hapa ndani!”
Ekegusii: oteeba, “Onde bwensi otamanyeti amaange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri oteeba,

English: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
Kiswahili: “Maji yaliyoibiwa ni matamu; chakula kinacholiwa sirini ni kitamu!”
Ekegusii: “Amaache aibire nigo are amansu, na omogati okorierwa aase abobisi nigo ogwansa.”

English: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawajui hata kidogo kuwa wafu wako humo, kwamba wageni wake huyo mwanamke wako katika vilindi vya kuzimu.
Ekegusii: Korende oyio ogosoa aroro tamanyeti ng’a amakweri nareo, naende ng’a abageni b’omokuungu oyio nigo bare agwo aase abakuure.

English: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
Kiswahili: Mithali za Solomoni: Mwana mwenye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, lakini mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni kwa mama yake.
Ekegusii: Eye nemebayeno ya Sulemani. Omwana omomura omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo akorentera ng’ina omoichano.

English: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
Kiswahili: Hazina zilizopatikana kwa njia mbaya hazifai, lakini uadilifu huokoa kutoka mautini.
Ekegusii: Chinibo chi’ogokora okobe tichiri gokonya kende, korende oboronge nigo bogotooria korwa ase amakweri.

English: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Bwana hawaachi waadilifu kukaa njaa, lakini hupinga tamaa ya mtu mwovu.
Ekegusii: Omonene tari gotiga omonyene oboronge abe nenchara; korende nigo akwanga okogania kw’abakori amabe.

English: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
Kiswahili: Mikono mivivu hufanya mtu kuwa maskini lakini mikono yenye bidii huleta utajiri.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo n’amaboko amoro nigo akoba omotaka, korende amaboko are nomokia nigo akorenta obotenenku.

English: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
Kiswahili: Yeye akusanyaye mazao wakati wa kiangazi ni mwana mwenye hekima, lakini yeye alalaye wakati wa mavuno ni mwana mwenye kuaibisha.
Ekegusii: Omwana omomura ogosangereria chindagera engaki ye rigesa nigo are omong’aini, korende oyo okorara engaki eyio nigo akorenta obosooku.

English: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Baraka huwa taji kichwani mwa mwenye haki, lakini jeuri hufunika kinywa cha mwovu.
Ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa nigo gokobera ase omotwe bw’omonyene oboronge, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.

English: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
Kiswahili: Kumbukumbu ya mwenye haki itakuwa baraka, lakini jina la mwovu litaoza.
Ekegusii: Okoinyorwa kw’omonyene oboronge nigo gokorenta ogosesenigwa, korende erieta ri’omokori amabe nigo riragunde.

English: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
Kiswahili: Mwenye hekima moyoni hupokea maagizo, lakini mpumbavu apayukaye huangamia.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye nigo anchete amachiiko, korende oyogokwana amang’ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.

English: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwadilifu hutembea salama, lakini mtu aendaye katika njia zilizopotoka atagunduliwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto okobwatia chiinchera chi’oboronge nigo araarendwe buya, korende oyo okobwatia chiinchera chimbe nigo aramanyekane.

English: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
Kiswahili: Yeye akonyezaye kwa nia mbaya husababisha huzuni, naye mpumbavu apayukaye huangamia.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogosumera amaiso ase okogenka nigo akorenta emechando, na oyogokwana amang’ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.

English: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Kinywa cha mwenye haki ni chemchemi ya uzima, lakini jeuri hufunika kinywa cha mwovu.
Ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonyene oboronge nigo onga buna ensoko y’obogima, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.

English: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
Kiswahili: Chuki huchochea faraka, lakini upendo husitiri mabaya yote.
Ekegusii: Obogechani nigo bokorenta eriomana, korende obwanchani nigo bogotuba ebibe bionsi.

English: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
Kiswahili: Hekima hupatikana katika midomo ya wenye kupambanua, lakini fimbo ni kwa ajili ya mgongo wake asiye na ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase omonwa bw’omonto omomanyi, korende oyo otari n’okomanya nigo agwenerete aakwe enyimbo ase omogongo oye.

English: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
Kiswahili: Wenye hekima huhifadhi maarifa, bali kinywa cha mpumbavu hualika maangamizi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abang’aini nigo bakogaacha chiseemi, korende omonwa bw’omonto omoriri nigo okorenta ogosirigwa ang’e.

English: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
Kiswahili: Mali ya tajiri ni mji wake wenye ngome, bali ufukara ni maangamizi ya maskini.
Ekegusii: Obotenenku bw’omonto omonda nigo bore ase are buna omochie ogiteire chindwaki, korende obotaka nabwo ogosirigwa kw’abataka.

English: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
Kiswahili: Ujira wa wenye haki huwaletea uzima, lakini mapato ya waovu huwaletea adhabu.
Ekegusii: Okonyora kw’omonyene oboronge nigo gokomoraa gochia ase obogima, korende ebitoki bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomoraa gochia ase ebibe.

English: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
Kiswahili: Anayekubali kuadibishwa yuko katika njia ya uzima, lakini yeyote anayepuuza maonyo hupotosha wengine.
Ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera okorongeigwa nigo akorobera ase enchera y’obogima, korende oyo okwanga korongeigwa nigo agosoa ase obosiru.

English: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
Kiswahili: Yeye afichaye chuki yake ana midomo ya uongo, na yeyote anayeeneza uchonganishi ni mpumbavu.
Ekegusii: Omonto obisete okogecha ime yaye nigo agokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye, na oyo ogotaaria obogenki nigo are omoriri.

English: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
Kiswahili: Wakati maneno ni mengi, dhambi haikosekani, lakini yeye ambaye huzuia ulimi wake ni mwenye busara.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokwana amang’ana amaange tari komocha korenta ogosaria, korende oyo orendete omonwa oye nigo are omong’aini.

English: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wa mwenye haki ni fedha iliyo bora, bali moyo wa mwovu una thamani ndogo.
Ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonyene oboronge nigo ronga buna efeta echenire korende ebirengererio bi’omokori amabe tibiri na igori rinde.

English: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
Kiswahili: Midomo ya mwenye haki hulisha wengi, lakini wapumbavu hufa kwa kukosa ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bikorenta amaya ase abanto abange, korende oboriri nigo bogoita.

English: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
Kiswahili: Baraka ya Bwana hutajirisha, wala haichanganyi huzuni.
Ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa kw’Omonene nakwo gokorenta obotenenku, na ere tari kobeeka obororo ase ogosesenigwa okwo.

English: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu hufurahia tabia mbaya, lakini mtu mwenye ufahamu hupendezwa na hekima.
Ekegusii: Omonto omoriri nigo agokora ebibe buna egosori, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo agokora ayare ay’obong’aini.

English: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
Kiswahili: Kile anachoogopa mwovu ndicho kitakachompata; kile anachoonea shauku mwenye haki atapewa.
Ekegusii: Aria omokori amabe airogete naro akomochera, korende omonyene oboronge ’naikeranerigwe amagania aye.

English: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
Kiswahili: Tufani inapopita, waovu hutoweka, lakini wenye haki husimama imara milele.
Ekegusii: Ekero omwaga ekembugu‐mbugu ogoeta, omokori amabe nigo agosirigwa, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agotenena bokong’u kare na kare.

English: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
Kiswahili: Kama siki ilivyo kwa meno na moshi kwa macho, ndivyo alivyo mvivu kwa wale waliomtuma.
Ekegusii: Buna obokang’iti bokoba ase amaino na erioki rikoba ase amaiso, naboigo omonto omworo akoba ase abwo bakomotoma abakorere emeremo.

English: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana huongeza urefu wa maisha, lakini miaka ya mwovu inafupishwa.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokomenta obomenyo ase obogima, korende emiaka y’omokori amabe nigo ekweng’eigwa.

English: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
Kiswahili: Tarajio la mwenye haki ni furaha, bali matumaini ya mwovu huwa si kitu.
Ekegusii: Ogosemeria kw’abanyene oboronge nigo kogoikeranigwa ase omogooko, korende okw’abakori amabe nokwabosa.

English: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
Kiswahili: Njia ya Bwana ni kimbilio kwa wenye haki, lakini ni maangamizi ya wale watendao mabaya.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’Omonene nigo ere egekengero egekong’u ase abanyene oboronge, korende nigo ere obosiru ase abanyabibe.

English: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
Kiswahili: Kamwe wenye haki hawataondolewa, bali waovu hawatasalia katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge takonyegerigwa, korende omokori amabe takogeenderera komenya ase ense.

English: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
Kiswahili: Kinywa cha mwenye haki hutoa hekima, bali ulimi wa upotovu utakatwa.
Ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonyene oboronge nigo ogokwana ay’obong’aini, korende oromeme rokong’ainereria ’ndonachwe.

English: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
Kiswahili: Midomo ya wenye haki inajua kile kinachofaa, bali kinywa cha mwovu hujua kile kilichopotoka tu.
Ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bimanyete ayagwenerete, korende omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogokwana ay’atagwenereti.

English: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
Kiswahili: Bwana huchukia sana mizani za udanganyifu, bali vipimo sahihi ni furaha yake.
Ekegusii: Egepimo ki’oborito ki’oborianania nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende egi’ekeene nigo gekomogokia.

English: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
Kiswahili: Kiburi kinapokuja, ndipo huja aibu, bali unyenyekevu huja na hekima.
Ekegusii: Ekero oboenenu bwachire, nobosooku nario bogocha, korende obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase abanto abaitongo.

English: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
Kiswahili: Uadilifu wa wenye haki huwaongoza, bali wasio waaminifu huharibiwa na hila yao.
Ekegusii: Obwegenwa bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokobaraa, korende obokorekanu bw’abatari abegenwa nigo bokobasiria.

English: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
Kiswahili: Utajiri haufaidi kitu katika siku ya ghadhabu, bali haki huokoa kutoka mautini.
Ekegusii: Chinibo tichiri gokonya kende ase rituko ri’endamwamu, korende oboronge nigo boratoorie korwa ase amakweri.

English: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
Kiswahili: Haki ya wasio na lawama, huwatengenezea njia iliyonyooka, bali waovu huangushwa kwa uovu wao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bw’omonto omoikeranu nigo borarongeyie chiinchera chiaye, korende omokori amabe, obobe bwaye ’mbomoiyerie.

English: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
Kiswahili: Haki ya wanyofu huwaokoa, bali wasio waaminifu hunaswa na tamaa mbaya.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bw’abaanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbobatoorie, korende abasaria nigo barabwatwe n’okogania kwabo okobe.

English: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
Kiswahili: Wakati mtu mwovu anapokufa, matumaini yake hutoweka; yote aliyoyatazamia kutokana na nguvu zake huwa si kitu.
Ekegusii: Ekero omokori amabe agokwa, ogosemeria kwaye nigo kogokwa amo nere, ee, aya abwo batamoirogeti Nyasae basemeretie nigo agosira.

English: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye haki huokolewa kutoka taabu, naye mtu mwovu huingia humo badala yake.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akorusigwa ase emechando, erio omokori amabe osoa ase emechando ribaga riaye.

English: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
Kiswahili: Kwa kinywa chake mtu asiyemwamini Mungu humwangamiza jirani yake, bali kwa maarifa mwenye haki huokolewa.
Ekegusii: Oyo otamoirogeti Nyasae nigo agosiria abanto bande n’amang’ana agokwana korwa ase omonwa oye, korende goetera ase obong’aini abanyene oboronge ’mbatoorigwe.

English: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
Kiswahili: Wakati mwenye haki anapofanikiwa, mji hufurahi; mwovu atowekapo, kuna kelele za furaha.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bageendererete koba buya, abanto b’omochie nigo bakogoka, na ekero abakori amabe bagosira nigo bagoaka amariogi y’omochengo.

English: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na baraka ya mtu mnyofu mji hukwezwa, bali kwa kinywa cha mwovu mji huharibiwa.
Ekegusii: Goetera ase ogosesenia kw’abanyene oboronge omochie nigo okoimokererigwa igoro, korende goetera ase chinkwana chi’abakori amabe nigo okoiyerigwa.

English: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
Kiswahili: Mtu asiye na akili humdharau jirani yake, bali mtu mwenye ufahamu huuzuia ulimi wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya omonto onde, oyio nigo aborire obong’aini, korende omonto omong’aini nigo agokira‐kiri.

English: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
Kiswahili: Masengenyo husaliti tumaini, bali mtu mwaminifu hutunza siri.
Ekegusii: Omonto okona‐goeta‐etia obogenki nigo akoorokia obobisi, korende oyobwate omoika bw’obwegenwa tari koorokia obobisi.

English: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
Kiswahili: Pasipo ushauri wa hekima taifa huanguka, bali washauri wengi hufanya ushindi uwe wa hakika.
Ekegusii: Ase ogoseemia okuya gotari, egesaku nigo gekogwa, korende ase abasemia abange abaya bare, oborendi obuya ’mboreo.

English: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
Kiswahili: Yeye amdhaminiye mgeni hakika atateseka, bali yeyote akataaye kuunga mkono dhamana ni salama.
Ekegusii: Omonto okwerua koba intenenera ase omonto omoao nigo agwesoyia ase emechando, korende oyo okwanga koba intenenera nigo erendete buya.

English: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke mwenye moyo wa huruma hupata heshima, bali wanaume wakorofi hupata mali tu.
Ekegusii: Omokungu omwesiki nigo akogeenderera gosikwa botambe. Abanto abatindi nabwo bakobogoria chinibo ase chinguru.

English: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
Kiswahili: Mwenye huruma hujinufaisha mwenyewe, bali mkatili hujiletea taabu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore n’amaabera nigo akwerentera amaya, korende omonto omotindi nigo agwechaanda ere omonyene.

English: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu hupata ujira wa udanganyifu, bali yeye apandaye haki huvuna tuzo ya uhakika.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’oborianania, korende oyo ogosimeka oboronge nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’ekeene.

English: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye haki kweli kweli hupata uzima, bali yeye afuatiliaye ubaya huendea kifo chake.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omwegenwa, ase oboronge bwaye nabe moyo, korende oyo okorigia obobe na kobobwatia nakwe.

English: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwachukia sana watu wenye moyo wa upotovu, bali hupendezwa na wale ambao njia zao hazina lawama.
Ekegusii: Abanto abakorekanu ase chinkoro chiabo nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare n’orogendo ororonge nigo bakomogokia.

English: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
Kiswahili: Uwe na hakika na hili: Waovu hawataepuka kuadhibiwa, bali wenye haki watakuwa huru.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonto omobe goika anyore egesusuro, korende oroiboro rw’abanyene oboronge ’ndotoorigwe.

English: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
Kiswahili: Kama pete ya dhahabu katika pua ya nguruwe ndivyo alivyo mwanamke mzuri ambaye hana busara.
Ekegusii: Omokungu omonyakieni otari nechiseemi nigo anga buna ebonyi y’etaabu ere ase chimioro chi’embeche.

English: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
Kiswahili: Shauku ya mwenye haki huishia tu kwenye mema, bali tumaini la mwovu huishia tu kwenye ghadhabu.
Ekegusii: Okogania kw’abanyene oboronge nigo gokorenta amaya, korende okw’abakori amabe nigo gokobarentera egesusuro.

English: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
Kiswahili: Kuna mtu atoaye kwa ukarimu, hata hivyo hupata zaidi, mwingine huzuia, lakini huwa maskini.
Ekegusii: Ere omonto okorua ebinto ebinge, nigo akomenteranigwa ebinge goetania, na nere oria omogooko otari korua, nigo akogeenderera kona‐koremerwa.

English: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
Kiswahili: Mtu mkarimu atastawi; yeye awaburudishaye wengine ataburudishwa mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorua n’omoyo bw’ogwancha natenenkigwe; nere oyokorua amaache agokendia erang’o, nere boigo ’naegwe amaache agokendia erang’o yaye.

English: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
Kiswahili: Watu humlaani mtu awanyimae watu nafaka, bali baraka itamkalia kichwani kama taji yeye aliye radhi kuiuza.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria okwegimeria endagera ase obong’iti, nigo akoragererigwa nabaanto, korende ogosesenigwa nigo kore igoro ase omotwe bw’oria okoyeoonia.

English: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
Kiswahili: Yeye atafutaye mema hupata ukarimu, bali ubaya huja kwake yeye autafutaye.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokora omokia korigia ayare amaya, oyio nigo akonyora ayare amaya, korende oyokorigia ay’obobe, obobe nigo bokomonyoora.

English: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
Kiswahili: Yeyote ategemeaye utajiri wake ataanguka, bali mwenye haki atastawi kama jani bichi.
Ekegusii: Omonto osemeretie chinibo chiaye nigo aragwe, korende abanyene oboronge ’mbareerete buna amato amarere y’emete.

English: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
Kiswahili: Yeye aletaye taabu kwa jamaa yake atarithi tu upepo, naye mpumbavu atakuwa mtumishi wa wenye hekima.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye nigo aranyore ayare buna embeo bosa; oyore omoriri nigo arabe omosomba bw’omonto omong’aini.

English: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
Kiswahili: Tunda la mwenye haki ni mti wa uzima, naye mwenye hekima huvuta roho za watu.
Ekegusii: Okwama kw’omonyaboronge nigo kore omote bw’obogima, nere oyokong’usa emioyo y’abanto n’omonto omong’aini.

English: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
Kiswahili: Kama wenye haki watapokea ujira wao duniani, si zaidi sana yule asiyemcha Mungu na mwenye dhambi?
Ekegusii: Onye omonyene oboronge okonyora eng’eria yaye aiga ase ense, Inee, omokori amabe na omonyabibe, abwo tibakoegwa eng’eria yabo goetania?

English: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
Kiswahili: Yeyote apendaye kuadibishwa hupenda maarifa, bali yeye achukiaye kuonywa ni mpumbavu.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi bwanchete amorokererio yokomoorongeyia, oyio nigo anchete chiseemi, korende oyo ogechete ogokuurerwa n’omoriri.

English: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwema hupata kibali kutoka kwa Bwana, bali Bwana humhukumu mwenye hila.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akomonyoorera monto omuya ogwancherwa, korende omonachera ekiina oyogokora emeroberio y’obobe.

English: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
Kiswahili: Mtu hathibitiki kutokana na uovu, bali mwenye haki hataondolewa.
Ekegusii: Ogotamoiroka Nyasae tigokoagaacha omonto na komokong’ia, korende omori bw’omonyaboronge tokonyegerigwa.

English: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
Kiswahili: Mke mwenye tabia nzuri ni taji ya mumewe, bali aaibishaye ni kama uozo katika mifupa ya mumewe.
Ekegusii: Omokungu omuya nigo are eguutwa y’omosaacha oye, korende omokungu okorenta obosooku nigo are buna oboguundo ase amauga y’omosaacha oye.

English: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
Kiswahili: Mipango ya mtu mwadilifu ni ya haki, bali ushauri wa mwovu ni udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bire ebi’ekeene, korende ogoseemia kw’abakori amabe nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.

English: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya waovu huotea kumwaga damu, bali maneno ya waadilifu huwaokoa.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana yabakori amabe nigo akoboera na goitera amanyinga, korende aria abanyene oboronge bagokwana nigo agotooria abanto.

English: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
Kiswahili: Watu waovu huondolewa na kutoweka, bali nyumba ya mwenye haki husimama imara.
Ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bakoiyerigwa basira kegima, korende enyomba y’omonyene oboronge ’nemenye na gotenena.

English: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
Kiswahili: Mtu husifiwa kulingana na hekima yake, bali watu wenye akili zilizopotoka hudharauliwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo agotogigwa buna obong’aini bwaye bore, korende oyore nebirengererio ebikorekanu nigo agochaaywa.

English: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu wa hali ya chini mwenye mtumishi, kuliko kujifanya mtu wa hali ya juu nawe huna chakula.
Ekegusii: Omonto omoitongo ogwekorera emeremo yaye omonyene nigo are omuya kobua omonto ogwekora koba omonene, korende tabwati endagera.

English: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye haki hujali mahitaji ya mnyama wake, bali matendo ya huruma ya mwovu ni ukatili.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo agochaandekera nonya n’obogima bwe chitugo chiaye, korende oboseera bw’enkoro y’omokori amabe nigo bore ase ogotogonya.

English: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
Kiswahili: Yeye alimaye shamba lake atakuwa na chakula tele, bali yeye afuataye mambo ya upuzi hana akili.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo ase omogondo oye ’natware ebinge akoria, korende oyo ogotunyana amang’ana atagwenereti, ere ’mbosa.

English: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
Kiswahili: Waovu hutamani mateka ya watu wabaya, bali shina la mwenye haki hustawi.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akogania ebionga bi’abaanto ababe, korende omori bw’omonyene oboronge nigo ogoseboka bwama.

English: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu hunaswa kwa mazungumzo yake ya dhambi, bali mwenye haki huepuka taabu.
Ekegusii: Omonto omobe nigo agotegwa n’ogosaria gokorwa ase ebikoba biaye, korende omonyene oboronge natooreke korwa ase emechando.

English: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na tunda la midomo yake mtu hujazwa na mambo mema, hakika kama ilivyo kazi ya mikono yake humtunza.
Ekegusii: Okwama kw’amang’ana y’omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya akomoisanekia, na emeremo y’amaboko ’omonto nigo ekomoiranera.

English: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
Kiswahili: Njia ya mpumbavu huonekana sawa machoni pake mwenyewe, bali mtu mwenye hekima husikiliza ushauri.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omoriri nigo ekororekana ase amaiso aye ng’a nendonge, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoigwera ogoseemigwa.

English: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu huonyesha kuudhika kwake mara moja, bali mtu wa busara hupuuza matukano.
Ekegusii: Okobeea kw’omonto omoriri nigo gokomanyekana rimo rioka, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoombia otuba obobe.

English: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
Kiswahili: Shahidi wa kweli hutoa ushuhuda wa kuaminika, bali shahidi wa uongo husema uongo.
Ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete gokwana ekeene nigo akoorokia oboronge, korende kirori bw’oborimo nigo agokwana obong’ainereria.

English: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya kipumbavu huchoma kama upanga, bali ulimi wa mwenye hekima huleta uponyaji.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana omonto otari korengereria agokwana, nigo anga buna omoro ogokeba, korende oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rokorenta amang’ana akogwenia.

English: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
Kiswahili: Midomo isemayo kweli hudumu milele, bali ulimi wa uongo hudumu kwa muda mfupi tu.
Ekegusii: Ebikoba bigokwana ekeene ’mbigeenderere kobao botambe, korende oromeme rogokwana oborimo nigo rokobao ase engaki enke yoka.

English: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
Kiswahili: Upo udanganyifu katika mioyo ya wale ambao hupanga mabaya, bali kuna furaha kwa wale wanaoleta amani.
Ekegusii: Obong’ainereria nigo bore ase chinkoro chi’abwo bakoroberia amabe, korende abwo bakoroberia ay’omorembe nigo bakogera omogooko oba.

English: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
Kiswahili: Hakuna dhara linalompata mwenye haki, bali waovu wana taabu nyingi.
Ekegusii: Amabe takobanyora abanyene oboronge, korende abakori amabe ’mbanyorwe n’amabe amaange.

English: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
Kiswahili: Bwana anachukia sana midomo idanganyayo, bali hufurahia watu ambao ni wa kweli.
Ekegusii: Ebikoba bigokwana oborimo nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare abegenwa ase ogokora kwabo nigo bakomogokia.

English: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye busara hujihifadhia maarifa yeye mwenyewe, bali moyo wa wapumbavu hububujika upumbavu.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akobisa ay’amanyete, korende abariri nigo bakoraria oboriri korwa ase chinkoro chiabo.

English: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
Kiswahili: Mikono yenye bidii itatawala, bali uvivu huishia katika kazi za utumwa.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw’omonto omonyamokia ’nkogambe, korende oyore omworo nabetererigwe akore emeremo y’obosomba.

English: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa wasiwasi humlemea mtu, bali neno la huruma humfurahisha.
Ekegusii: Ogoichana kore ase enkoro y’omonto nigo gokomoiyeria, korende ring’ana rigiya nigo rikomorentera omogooko.

English: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye haki ni mwangalifu katika urafiki, bali njia ya waovu huwapotosha.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo are omoraai omuya bw’omogisangio oye, korende chiinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo chikobatang’ana chiabasiria.

English: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
Kiswahili: Mtu mvivu haoki mawindo yake, bali mtu mwenye bidii ana mali za thamani.
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo tari koiyeka nonya n’eki arusirie ase orotwari rw’aye, korende omonyamokia nigo akoyerioseria enibo yaye rigori rekerengo ekenene.

English: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
Kiswahili: Katika njia ya haki kuna uzima; katika mapito hayo kuna maisha ya milele.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera y’oboronge obogima ’mboreo, na amakweri tari gotooka ase boeto obwo.

English: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
Kiswahili: Mwana mwenye hekima husikia mafundisho ya babaye, bali mwenye dharau hasikilizi maonyo.
Ekegusii: Omwana omong’aini nigo akoigwera amorokererio a ise, korende oyore omochaayi tari gwancha ogokuurerwa.

English: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
Kiswahili: Kutoka tunda la midomo yake mtu hufurahia mambo mema, bali wasio waaminifu wanatamani sana jeuri.
Ekegusii: Okwama kw’amang’ana omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya, korende okogania kw’abatari abegenwa nigo gokorigia obotindi.

English: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
Kiswahili: Yeye alindaye midomo yake hulinda nafsi yake, bali yeye asemaye kwa haraka ataangamia.
Ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyogokwana amang’ana ateriteti, goika asoe ase obosiru.

English: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
Kiswahili: Mvivu hutamani sana na hapati kitu, bali nafsi ya mwenye bidii hutoshelezwa kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agosanera ebinto, korende takonyora kende, ere o’yore omonyamokia nigo akonyora amagania aye onsi.

English: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
Kiswahili: Mwenye haki huchukia uongo, bali waovu huleta aibu na fedheha.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo ageechete oborimo, korende omokori amabe nigo agokora echaayo n’obosooku.

English: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
Kiswahili: Haki humlinda mtu mwadilifu, bali uovu humwangusha mwenye dhambi.
Ekegusii: Oboronge nigo bokorenda omonto omosike, korende ebibe nigo bikomosiria omokori amabe.

English: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja hujifanya tajiri, kumbe hana chochote; mwingine hujifanya maskini, kumbe ana utajiri mwingi.
Ekegusii: Omonto nare ogwekora ng’a n’omonda are, korende nigo are omotaka, na oyonde bwekora ng’a nomotaka are, korende nigo are omonda mono.

English: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
Kiswahili: Utajiri wa mtu waweza kukomboa maisha yake, bali mtu maskini hasikii kitisho.
Ekegusii: Chinibo nachio chikobooria obogima bw’omonto omonda, korende omonto omotaka tari n’onde okomogosa.

English: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
Kiswahili: Nuru ya mwenye haki hungʼaa sana, bali taa ya mwovu itazimwa.
Ekegusii: Oborabu bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokomoreka n’omogooko, korende etaya y’abakori amabe nigo enga ekebeya gekorima.

English: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
Kiswahili: Kiburi huzalisha magomvi tu, bali hekima hupatikana kwa wale wanaozingatia ushauri.
Ekegusii: Oboenenu nigo bokorenta okoamererania, korende baria bakoigwera ogoseemigwa nigo bakoba n’obong’aini.

English: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
Kiswahili: Fedha isiyo ya halali hupungua, bali yeye akusanyaye fedha kidogo kidogo huongezeka.
Ekegusii: Enibo enyorire ase obwango ase enchera y’obobe nigo egosira, korende ey’ekonyorekana ase okoyekorera emeremo ’nementekane.

English: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
Kiswahili: Kilichotarajiwa kikikawia kuja moyo huugua, bali tumaini lililotimizwa ni mti wa uzima.
Ekegusii: Egesemeirie kogiatebanire nigo gekogera enkoro yarwara, korende ogosemeria kogwaikeraniigwe nigo kore omote bw’obogima.

English: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayedharau mafundisho anajiletea maangamizi, bali yeye anayeheshimu agizo hupewa tuzo.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya Ring’ana nigo arasirigwe narirorio, korende oyokoiroka ogochika nanyore eng’eria y’obuya.

English: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
Kiswahili: Mafundisho ya mwenye busara ni chemchemi ya uzima, ili kumwepusha mtu na mitego ya mauti.
Ekegusii: Amorokererio y’omonto omong’aini nigo are ensoko y’obogima, ekiagera nigo agokoonya omonto tabwatwa n’omotego bw’amakweri.

English: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
Kiswahili: Ufahamu mzuri hupata upendeleo, bali njia ya asiye mwaminifu ni ngumu.
Ekegusii: Okomanya okuya nigo gokorenta ogwancherwa, korende enchera y’abatari abegenwa nigo ekoraa gochia ase obosiru.

English: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
Kiswahili: Kila mwenye busara hutenda kwa maarifa, bali mpumbavu hudhihirisha upumbavu wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo agokora emeremo yaye ne chiseemi, korende omonto omoriri nigo akoraria oboriri bwaye.

English: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
Kiswahili: Mjumbe mwovu huanguka kwenye taabu, bali mjumbe mwaminifu huleta uponyaji.
Ekegusii: Omotomwa otari omwegenwa nigo akogwa ase emechando, korende oyore omwegenwa nigo akogwenia.

English: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayedharau maonyo hupata umaskini na aibu, bali yeye anayekubali maonyo huheshimiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto okwanga koigwera amorokererio akomoorongeyia, obotaka na obosooku nigo biramonyore, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nanyore amasikani.

English: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
Kiswahili: Tarajio lililotimizwa ni tamu kwa nafsi, bali wapumbavu huchukia sana kuacha ubaya.
Ekegusii: Okogania gwaikeranigwe nigo kore ogwansu ase omoyo, korende okoonchoka gotiga amabe, okwo nigo kore okogechigwa ase abariri.

English: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Kiswahili: Yeye atembeaye na mwenye hekima atapata hekima, bali rafiki wa mpumbavu hupata madhara.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogotaara n’abanto abang’aini nigo arabe omong’aini, korende oyo ogosanga nabariri nanyorwe n’amabe.

English: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
Kiswahili: Balaa humwandama mtenda dhambi, bali mafanikio ni thawabu kwa mwenye haki.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana amabe nigo agotunyana abanyene ebibe, korende abanyene oboronge ’nabaegwe amaya.

English: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwema huwaachia wana wa wanawe urithi, bali mali ya wenye dhambi imehifadhiwa kwa ajili ya wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Omonto omuya nigo agotiga omwando ase abana baye, na ase abachokoro baye, korende obotenenku bw’abanyene ebibe nigo bogacheire abanyene oboronge.

English: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
Kiswahili: Shamba la mtu maskini laweza kuzalisha chakula kingi, bali dhuluma hukifutilia mbali.
Ekegusii: Oboremo oboyia bw’omonto omotaka nigo bokwama endagera enyinge, korende ase engencho y’obobe, enyinge yasiara‐siarerwa yasira.

English: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
Kiswahili: Yeye aizuiaye fimbo yake hampendi mwanawe, bali yeye ampendaye huwa mwangalifu kumwadibisha.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorina omwana oye ekeranya nigo amogechete, korende oy’omwanchete tari goteebana komoorongeyia.

English: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
Kiswahili: Mwenye haki hula mpaka akaridhisha moyo wake, bali tumbo la mwovu hutaabika kwa njaa.
Ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo abwate endagera ekomoisanekia, korende enda y’omokori amabe nigo egotigara n’okogania.

English: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke mwenye hekima huijenga nyumba yake, bali mpumbavu huibomoa nyumba yake kwa mikono yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omokungu omong’aini nigo akoagaacha mwaye, korende oyore omoriri nigo agotagora mwaye na maboko aye omonyene.

English: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye njia zake ni nyofu humcha Bwana, bali yeye ambaye njia zake zimepotoka humdharau Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonto omoirogete Omonene nigo akobwatia enchera y’oboronge, korende oyo omochaayete nigo are omokorekanu ase chiinchera chiaye.

English: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
Kiswahili: Mazungumzo ya mpumbavu huleta fimbo mgongoni mwake, bali mwenye hekima hulindwa na maneno ya midomo yake.
Ekegusii: Aya omoriri agokwana nigo are enyimbo y’oboenenu, korende aya abang’aini bagokwana nigo akobarenda.

English: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
Kiswahili: Pale ambapo hakuna mafahali, hori ni tupu, bali kutokana na nguvu za fahali huja mavuno mengi.
Ekegusii: Ase chiombe chi’okorema chitari, ebiage nigo bikoba bosa, korende ase okong’usa gwe chintang’ana, endagera enyinge nigo ekonyorekana.

English: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
Kiswahili: Shahidi mwaminifu hadanganyi, bali shahidi wa uongo humimina uongo.
Ekegusii: Kirori ore omwegenwa tari gokwana oborimo, korende oy’otari omwegenwa nigo akoroka oborimo bwoka.

English: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
Kiswahili: Mwenye mzaha huitafuta hekima na haipati, bali maarifa huja kwa urahisi kwa anayepambanua.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omochecheria narigia obong’aini takobonyora, korende chiseemi nigo chikonyorekana bwango ase omonto ore omong’aini.

English: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
Kiswahili: Kaa mbali na mtu mpumbavu, kwa maana hutapata maarifa katika midomo yake.
Ekegusii: Karue ase omonto omoriri, ekiagera tokonyora obong’aini ase aria agokwana.

English: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
Kiswahili: Hekima ya mwenye busara ni kufikiria njia zake, bali upumbavu wa wapumbavu ni udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini bw’omonto ore n’okomanya nigo bokomokonya omanya buna chiinchera chiaye chire, korende obosooku bw’abaanto abariri nigo bokobang’aina.

English: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
Kiswahili: Wapumbavu hudhihaki kujirekebisha kutoka dhambi, bali wema hupatikana miongoni mwa wanyofu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abariri nigo bagokora echeche n’ebibe, korende abanyene oboronge nigo bagwancherana barabwo ase barabwo.

English: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
Kiswahili: Kila moyo hujua uchungu wake wenyewe, wala hakuna yeyote awezaye kushiriki furaha yake.
