Ekegusii: Enkoro enyene nigo emanyete obororo bwaye, na omonto omoao takonyaara gosanga ase omogooko bw’enkoro eyio.

English: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
Kiswahili: Nyumba ya mwovu itaangamizwa, bali hema la mnyofu litastawi.
Ekegusii: Enyomba y’omokori amabe ’nesirigwe, korende ekegutu ki’omonyene oboronge ’nkegeenderere gosesenigwa.

English: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
Kiswahili: Iko njia ionekanayo kuwa sawa kwa mtu, bali mwisho wake huelekeza mautini.
Ekegusii: Enchera nere ekororekana ase omonto ng’a nendonge, korende omoerio bw’enchera eyio namakweri.

English: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
Kiswahili: Hata katika kicheko moyo waweza kuuma, nayo furaha yaweza kuishia katika majonzi.
Ekegusii: Nonya omonto ogoseka, enkoro yaye nabo eranyaare koba nomoichano, na omoerio bw’omogooko oyio nobororo.

English: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
Kiswahili: Wasio na imani watapatilizwa kikamilifu kwa ajili ya njia zao, naye mtu mwema atapewa thawabu kwa ajili ya njia yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogure korwa ase okwegena kwaye, nabo araisaneke nechiinchera chiaye omonyene, na omonto omuya nigo agoisanekigwa n’omoyo oye.

English: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
Kiswahili: Mtu mjinga huamini kila kitu, bali mwenye busara hufikiria hatua zake.
Ekegusii: Omonto otamanyeti amaange nigo akwegena kera ring’ana, korende omong’aini nigo agoitona aase agochia.

English: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye hekima humcha Bwana na kuepuka mabaya, bali mpumbavu hukasirika kwa hamaki na uzembe.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akwoboa na kwerenda korwa ase amabe, korende omoriri nigo akoba omoremu ase ogokora amabe.

English: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
Kiswahili: Mtu anayekasirika kwa haraka hufanya mambo ya upumbavu, naye mtu wa hila huchukiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto okogechigwa bwango nigo agokora ay’oboriri, na omonto okoroberia ay’obobe nigo akogechwa.

English: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
Kiswahili: Mjinga hurithi upumbavu, bali wenye busara huvikwa maarifa kichwani kama taji.
Ekegusii: Abatamanyeti amaange, oboriri nigo bokoba omwando obo, korende abare nokomanya nigo bakoegwa chiseemi chiaba eguutwa yabo.

English: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
Kiswahili: Watu wabaya watasujudu mbele ya watu wema, nao waovu kwenye malango ya wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Abanto ababe goika bekumbe ase amasio y’abanto abaya, na abakori amabe bekumbe ase ebiita bi’abanyene oboronge.

English: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
Kiswahili: Maskini huepukwa hata na majirani zao, bali matajiri wana marafiki wengi.
Ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo agechire nonya nase abanto bamwabo, korende omonda nigo abwate abasani abange.

English: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayemdharau jirani yake hutenda dhambi, bali amebarikiwa yeye aliye na huruma kwa mhitaji.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya omonto onde nigo agokora ebibe, korende oyokororera abachaandegete amaabera ’nasesenigwe.

English: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
Kiswahili: Je, wale wanaopanga ubaya hawapotoki? Bali wale wanaopanga kilicho chema hupata upendo na uaminifu.
Ekegusii: Inee! Abwo bakoroberia ayare amabe tibari gosira? Na abwo bakoroberia amaya, Inee, tibari konyora amaabera na ekeene?

English: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
Kiswahili: Kazi zote zinazofanywa kwa bidii huleta faida, bali mazungumzo matupu huelekea umaskini tu.
Ekegusii: Emeremo ende yonsi egokorwa nigo ekorenta ebitoki, korende amang’ana amasa agokwanwa nigo gokorenta obotaka.

English: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
Kiswahili: Utajiri wa wenye hekima ni taji yao, bali upumbavu wa wapumbavu huzaa upumbavu.
Ekegusii: Eguutwa y’abanto abang’aini n’obonda bwabo, korende oboriri bwoka nabwo okonyora kwa abanto abariri.

English: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
Kiswahili: Shahidi wa kweli huokoa maisha, bali shahidi wa uongo ni mdanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Kirori ogokwana ekeene nigo agotooria obogima, korende oy’ogokwana oborimo nigo akorwa abande.

English: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
Kiswahili: Yeye amchaye Bwana ana ngome salama, na kwa watoto wake itakuwa kimbilio.
Ekegusii: Oyo okomoiroka Omonene nigo are n’ogosemeria gw’okorendwa bokong’u, na abana baye ’mbanyore aase bagotamera.

English: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana ni chemchemi ya uzima, ili kumwepusha mtu na mitego ya mauti.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nakwo ensoko y’obogima eragere omonto eatanane korwa ase emetego y’amakweri.

English: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
Kiswahili: Wingi wa watu ni utukufu wa mfalme, bali pasipo watu mkuu huangamia.
Ekegusii: Obonge bw’abaanto nabwo bore esiko y’omorwoti, korende ase abanto bare abake omogambi obo nigo agosirigwa.

English: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye subira ana ufahamu mwingi, bali anayekasirika haraka huonyesha upumbavu.
Ekegusii: Omonto otari kogechigwa bwango nigo abwate okomanya okonene, korende oyo okoberoroka bwango nigo agokinia oboriri bwaye.

English: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
Kiswahili: Moyo wenye amani huupa mwili uzima, bali wivu huozesha mifupa.
Ekegusii: Enkoro y’omogooko nigo ere obogima bw’omobere, korende ogosanera nigo kore oboguundo bw’amauga.

English: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
Kiswahili: Yeye amwoneaye maskini huonyesha dharau kwa Muumba wao, bali yeyote anayemhurumia mhitaji humheshimu Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokorera omotaka bobe nigo agochaaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oyio, korende oyore omwororo ase oria oremeire nigo asigete Omotongi oye.

English: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
Kiswahili: Waovu huangamizwa kwa matendo yao maovu, bali hata katika kifo wenye haki hupata kimbilio.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotugutwa riarua ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okobe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agokwa ore n’ogosemeria.

English: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
Kiswahili: Hekima hukaa katika moyo wa mwenye ufahamu bali haijulikani miongoni mwa wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bomenyete ase enkoro y’omonto ore n’okomanya, korende ase enkoro y’omoriri tibomanyekaneti nonya ’ng’ake.

English: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
Kiswahili: Haki huinua taifa, bali dhambi ni aibu kwa watu wote.
Ekegusii: Oboronge nigo bogokinia egesaku, korende ebibe nobosooku ase abanto bande bonsi.

English: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
Kiswahili: Mfalme hupendezwa na mtumishi mwenye hekima, bali ghadhabu yake humwangukia mtumishi mwenye kuaibisha.
Ekegusii: Omosomba ogokora emeremo n’obong’aini nigo agwancherwa n’omorwoti, korende endamwamu y’omorwoti nigo ekoba igoro ase oria okomorentera obosooku.

English: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
Kiswahili: Jawabu la upole hugeuza ghadhabu, bali neno liumizalo huchochea hasira.
Ekegusii: Okoiraneria kw’obwororo nigo kogokendia endamwamu, korende amang’ana y’obotindi nigo agoseegeta endamwamu.

English: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.
Kiswahili: Ulimi wa mwenye hekima husifu maarifa, bali kinywa cha mpumbavu hufoka upumbavu.
Ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rogokwana chiseemi chingiya, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekoumora oboriri.

English: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
Kiswahili: Macho ya Bwana yako kila mahali, yakiwaangalia waovu na wema.
Ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie kera ase, nigo arooche ababe amo n’abaya.

English: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
Kiswahili: Ulimi uletao uponyaji ni mti wa uzima, bali ulimi udanganyao huponda roho.
Ekegusii: Oromeme rokoiraneria n’obokanyeku nigo rokogwenia, korende orokorubania nigo rogotandora enkoro.

English: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu hubeza maonyo ya baba yake, bali yeyote akubaliye maonyo huonyesha busara.
Ekegusii: Omoriri nigo agochaaya amorokererio a ise y’okomorongeyia, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nigo akong’ainia.

English: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
Kiswahili: Nyumba ya mwenye haki ina hazina kubwa, bali mapato ya waovu huwaletea taabu.
Ekegusii: Enyomba y’omonyene oboronge nigo ere n’obonge bw’obonda, korende ebitoki bi’abakori amabe nigo bire n’obonge bw’emechando.

English: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
Kiswahili: Midomo ya mwenye hekima hueneza maarifa, bali sivyo ilivyo mioyo ya wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’abang’aini nigo bikoraria chiseemi, korende chinkoro chi’abariri tichigokora boigo.

English: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
Kiswahili: Bwana huchukia sana dhabihu za waovu, bali maombi ya wanyofu humfurahisha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ki’abakori amabe nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende ogosaba kw’abare ne chinkoro chindonge nigo gokomogokia.

English: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
Kiswahili: Bwana huchukia sana njia ya waovu, bali huwapenda wale wafuatao haki.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’omokori amabe nigo ere okogechia ase Omonene, korende nigo anchete oy’okobwatia oboronge.

English: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.
Kiswahili: Adhabu kali humngoja yeye aachaye njia; yeye achukiaye maonyo atakufa.
Ekegusii: Egesusuro ekenene ’nkemonyore oyotigire enchera y’oboronge, nere oy’ogechete ogokuurerwa goika akwe.

English: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
Kiswahili: Mauti na Uharibifu viko wazi mbele za Bwana: je, si zaidi sana mioyo ya wanadamu!
Ekegusii: Onye aase abakuure ne’chioora chi’obosiru bire maiso marore ase Omonene, inee! Tamanyeti chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto mono kobua?

English: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
Kiswahili: Mwenye mzaha huchukia maonyo; hatataka shauri kwa mwenye hekima.
Ekegusii: Omonyacheche tancheti omonto okomokuurera, ere tagwancha kogeenda ase abang’aini.

English: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
Kiswahili: Moyo wenye furaha hufanya uso uchangamke, bali maumivu ya moyoni huponda roho.
Ekegusii: Enkoro ere n’omosasoko nigo ekorenta omogooko ase obosio, korende onye enkoro ere n’omoichano, omoyo nigo okoba nobororo.

English: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mwenye ufahamu hutafuta maarifa, bali kinywa cha mpumbavu hujilisha upumbavu.
Ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto ore nokomanya nigo ekorigia chiseemi, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekwerageria oboriri.

English: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
Kiswahili: Siku zote za wanaoonewa ni za taabu, bali moyo mchangamfu una karamu ya kudumu.
Ekegusii: Amatuko onsi ay’omonto ochaandegete nigo are amabe, korende oyore n’enkoro y’omosasoko nigo akogeenderera koba n’omoyega o botambe.

English: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
Kiswahili: Afadhali kuwa na kidogo pamoja na kumcha Bwana, kuliko mali nyingi pamoja na ghasia.
Ekegusii: Mbuya koba n’ebinto ebike amo n’okomoiroka Omonene, kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge amo nemechando.

English: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
Kiswahili: Afadhali chakula cha mboga mahali palipo na upendo kuliko nyama ya ndama iliyonona pamoja na chuki.
Ekegusii: Mbuya koria chinyeni more nobwanchani, kobua koria chinyama chi’echiombe chinoru na mogechaine.

English: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwepesi wa hasira huchochea ugomvi, bali mtu mvumilivu hutuliza ugomvi.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore n’enkoro ekoberoroka bwango nigo agoseegeta eriomana, korende oyore omwororo nigo agokanya eriomana.

English: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
Kiswahili: Njia ya mvivu imezibwa na miiba, bali njia ya mwenye haki ni barabara kuu.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omworo nigo eribete buna orobago rw’amagwa, korende ey’abanyene oboronge nigo ere endonge naende engare.

English: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
Kiswahili: Mwana mwenye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, bali mtu mpumbavu humdharau mama yake.
Ekegusii: Omwana omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo agochaaya ng’ina.

English: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
Kiswahili: Upumbavu humfurahisha mtu ambaye hana akili, bali mtu mwenye ufahamu hushika njia iliyonyooka.
Ekegusii: Oboriri nigo bore omogooko ase omonto otabwati obomanyi, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akobwatia chiinchera chi’oboronge.

English: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
Kiswahili: Mipango hushindwa kufanikiwa kwa ajili ya kukosa ushauri, bali kukiwa na washauri wengi hufanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ogosemania gotari, emeroberio nigo egosareka, korende ase abaseemia abange abaya bare nigo egokiinigwa.

English: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
Kiswahili: Mtu hupata furaha katika kutoa jibu linalofaa: je, ni zuri namna gani neno lililotoka kwa wakati wake!
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo akogookera okoiraneria okuya gokorua ase omonwa oye, ne ring’ana rigokwanwa ase engaki egwenerete, nigo rire rigiya mono.

English: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
Kiswahili: Mapito ya uzima huelekea juu kwa ajili ya wenye hekima kumwepusha asiende chini kaburini.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omong’aini nigo egotiira gochia ase obogima, erinde omonto oyio tabaisa kogeenda inse agwo aase abakuure.

English: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
Kiswahili: Bwana hubomoa nyumba ya mtu mwenye kiburi, bali huilinda mipaka ya mjane isiguswe.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotagora enyomba y’omonto omoenenu, korende arenda chimbebe chi’omotakaanwa.

English: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
Kiswahili: Bwana huchukia sana mawazo ya mwovu, bali mawazo ya wale walio safi humfurahisha yeye.
Ekegusii: Ebirengererio ebibe nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende amang’ana amaya nigo akomogokia.

English: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye tamaa huletea jamaa yake taabu, bali yeye achukiaye rushwa ataishi.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore ne ribero ase okorigia ebitoki ase enchera etari endonge nigo akorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye, korende oyo ogechete riaaki nabe moyo.

English: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mwenye haki hupima majibu yake, bali kinywa cha mwovu hufoka ubaya.
Ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonyene oboronge nigo ekorengereria aya ekoiraneria, korende emenwa y’abakori amabe nigo egoitororoka ayare amabe.

English: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
Kiswahili: Bwana yuko mbali na waovu, bali husikia maombi ya wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are aare korwa ase abakori amabe, korende nigo agotegerera ogosaba kw’abanyene oboronge.

English: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa tabasamu huleta furaha moyoni, nazo habari njema huipa mifupa afya.
Ekegusii: Okorigereria kore nomosasoko nigo gokogokia enkoro, na amang’ana amaya nigo akogokia amauga.

English: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
Kiswahili: Yeye asikilizaye maonyo yatoayo uzima atakuwa miongoni mwa wenye hekima.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogotegerera na koigwera ogokuurerwa gokorenta obogima ’namenye amo n’abanto abang’aini.

English: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayedharau maonyo hujidharau mwenyewe, bali yeyote anayekubali maonyo hupata ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Omonto okwanga ogokuurera, oyio nigo agochaaya obogima bwaye omonyene, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nigo akoba n’okomanya.

English: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana humfundisha mtu hekima, nao unyenyekevu huja kabla ya heshima.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, nakwo amorokererio akorenta obong’aini, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera esiko.

English: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mipango ya moyoni ni ya mwanadamu, bali jibu la ulimi hutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo agokora emeroberio ase enkoro yaye, korende aya oromeme rokoiraneria nigo akorwa ase Omonene.

English: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the motives.
Kiswahili: Njia zote za mtu huonekana safi machoni pake mwenyewe, bali makusudi hupimwa na Bwana.
Ekegusii: Chinchera chionsi chi’omonto nigo chikororekana ase are omonyene ng’a neching’ikeranu, korende Omonene nigo akorenga omoika o Mwanyabaanto.

English: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
Kiswahili: Mkabidhi Bwana lolote ufanyalo, nayo mipango yako itafanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Motweke Omonene emeremo yao, na emeroberio yao nesesenigwe.

English: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
Kiswahili: Bwana hufanya kila kitu kwa kusudi lake mwenyewe; hata waovu kwa siku ya maangamizi.
Ekegusii: Omonene okoreire kera egento engencho yaye, nonya nabakori amabe babeo ase engencho ye rituko ri’emechando.

English: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
Kiswahili: Bwana huwachukia sana wote wenye kiburi cha moyo. Uwe na hakika kwa hili: Hawataepuka kuadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto ore omoenenu nigo are kogechia ase Omonene; omonto oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.

English: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
Kiswahili: Kwa upendo na uaminifu uovu huondolewa; kwa kumcha Bwana mtu hujiepusha na ubaya.
Ekegusii: Ase amaabera, na obwegenwa, embooria yaakanirwe ase engencho y’ebibe, na ase okomoiroka Omonene, omonto nigo agweatanana korwa ase amabe.

English: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
Kiswahili: Njia za mtu zinapompendeza Bwana, huwafanya hata adui zake waishi naye kwa amani.
Ekegusii: Ekero chiinchera chi’omonto chiamogokirie Omonene Nyasae nigo agokora nonya nababisa b’omonto oyio babwatana nere.

English: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
Kiswahili: Afadhali kitu kidogo pamoja na haki kuliko mapato mengi pamoja na udhalimu.
Ekegusii: Mbuya koba n’ebinto ebike ase oboronge kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge chikonyorwa ase oborianania.

English: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mtu huifikiri njia yake, bali Bwana huelekeza hatua zake.
Ekegusii: Ase enkoro yaye ime omonto nigo akoroberia chiinchera chiaye, korende Omonene nere okoraa amabarato aye.

English: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
Kiswahili: Midomo ya mfalme huzungumza kwa hekima ya kiungu, wala kinywa chake hakipotoshi haki.
Ekegusii: Chinkwana chinchenu ’nchigwenerete koba ase ebikoba bi’omorwoti, na omonwa oye tomocha ekero akonacha ebiina.

English: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
Kiswahili: Vipimo na mizani za halali hutoka kwa Bwana; mawe yote ya kupimia yaliyo katika mfuko ameyafanya yeye.
Ekegusii: Ekerengero ki’oborito gi’ekeene nigo gekorwa ase Omonene, na ebirengero bionsi bire ase chisaro nigo bire ogokora kwaye.

English: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
Kiswahili: Wafalme huchukia sana kutenda maovu, kwa maana kiti cha ufalme hufanywa imara kwa njia ya haki.
Ekegusii: Ekero abarwoti bagokora amabe nigo bakorenta okogechia, ekiagera goetera ase oboronge ekerogo ki’obogambi nigo kegokong’igwa.

English: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
Kiswahili: Wafalme hufurahia midomo ya uaminifu; humthamini mtu asemaye kweli.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana amaronge agokwanwa nigo akogokia omorwoti, nere nigo abanchete abwo bagokwana oboronge.

English: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni mjumbe wa mauti, bali mtu mwenye hekima ataituliza.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu y’omorwoti nigo enga buna abatomwa bakorenta amakweri, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoyekanya.

English: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
Kiswahili: Uso wa mfalme ungʼaapo, inamaanisha uhai; upendeleo wake ni kama wingu la mvua wakati wa vuli.
Ekegusii: Omosasoko ore ase obosio bw’omorwoti nigo ore obogima, na ogwancherwa kwaye nigo konga buna amare agotwa embura y’okwamia endagera.

English: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
Kiswahili: Ni bora kiasi gani kupata hekima kuliko dhahabu, kuchagua ufahamu kuliko fedha!
Ekegusii: Konyora obong’aini, ayio namaya kobua konyora etaabu, na okoba nobomanyi nigo kogwenerete kobua koba nefeta.

English: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
Kiswahili: Njia kuu ya wanyofu huepuka ubaya; yeye aichungaye njia yake, huchunga maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Ogweatanana korwa ase amabe, eyio nero enchera enene y’abanyene oboronge; na omonto orendete enchera yaye, nigo arendete obogima bwaye.

English: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
Kiswahili: Kiburi hutangulia maangamizi, roho ya majivuno hutangulia maanguko.
Ekegusii: Oboenenu nigo bogotang’anera obosiru, na omoika bw’obomwenu nigo ogotang’anera okogwa.

English: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
Kiswahili: Ni afadhali kuwa mnyenyekevu katika roho miongoni mwa walioonewa kuliko kugawana nyara pamoja na wenye kiburi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya koba n’omoyo bw’oboitongo na komenya amo nabataka kobua koria ebisakorwa amo nabaenenu.

English: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayekubali mafundisho hustawi, tena amebarikiwa yeye anayemtumaini Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera Ring’ana nanyore amaya, na oyo okomosemeri’Omonene nasesenirie.

English: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
Kiswahili: Wenye hekima moyoni huitwa wenye ufahamu, na maneno ya kupendeza huchochea mafundisho.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye narokwe omomanyi, ne chinkwana chingiya nigo chikomenta chiseemi.

English: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
Kiswahili: Ufahamu ni chemchemi ya uzima kwa wale walio nao, bali upumbavu huleta adhabu kwa wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore ensoko y’obogima ase omong’aini, korende oboriri nigo bore egesusuro ase abariri.

English: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mtu mwenye hekima huongoza kinywa chake, na midomo yake huchochea mafundisho.
Ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekworokereria omonwa oye oboseemia, naende yamenta ogotegererwa kw’ebikoba biaye.

English: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya kupendeza ni kama sega la asali, ni matamu kwa nafsi na uponyaji kwenye mifupa.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana y’okogokia nigo anga obooke bokorwa ase richoe, nigo are amansu ase omoyo naende nigo akogwenia omobere.

English: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
Kiswahili: Iko njia ionekanayo kuwa sawa kwa mtu, bali mwisho wake huelekeza mautini.
Ekegusii: Enchera nere ekororekana ase omonto ng’a nengiya, korende omoerio bw’enchera eyio namakweri.

English: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.
Kiswahili: Shauku ya mfanyakazi humhimiza kufanya kazi; njaa yake humsukuma aendelee.
Ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto nigo gokomobetereria gokora emeremo, ekiagera naganetie goisanekia enchara yaye omonyene.

English: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
Kiswahili: Mtu mbaya kabisa hupanga mabaya, maneno yake ni kama moto uunguzao.
Ekegusii: Omonto otaisaini nigo akona‐gotukoria amabe, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chinga omorero okorura.

English: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
Kiswahili: Mtu mpotovu huchochea ugomvi, nayo maongezi ya upuzi hutenganisha marafiki wa karibu.
Ekegusii: Omonto omonyaborimo nigo akona‐gotaara‐taaria amang’ana akorenta eriomana, na omogenki nigo akorenta obobisa ase abanto banchaine.

English: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
Kiswahili: Mtu mkali humvuta jirani yake na kumwongoza katika mapito yale mabaya.
Ekegusii: Omonto omotindi nigo akoebereria omonto onde omoraa gochia ase enchera embe.

English: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
Kiswahili: Yeye akonyezaye kwa jicho lake anapanga upotovu; naye akazaye midomo yake amenuia mabaya.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogosumera ebioge bi’amaiso aye nigo akoroberia amabe, na oyo ogotakuna omonwa oye nigo agoikerania amabe.

English: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Mvi ni taji ya utukufu; hupatikana kwa maisha ya uadilifu.
Ekegusii: Chimbuche chire ase omotwe neguutwa y’obonene, eyio nigo ekonyorwa n’abanyaboronge.

English: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
Kiswahili: Ni afadhali mtu mstahimilivu kuliko shujaa, mtu anayeitawala hasira yake kuliko yule autekaye mji.
Ekegusii: Omonto otari omwango ase okogechigwa nigo abuete omorwani egeata, na oyomanyete kogambera enkoro yaye nigo abuete oyo okobua omochie na koyoira.

English: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kura hupigwa kwa siri, lakini kila uamuzi wake hutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Obomera nigo bokorutwa ase esaro ime, korende Omonene nere ogochora oyo bokogwera.

English: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
Kiswahili: Afadhali kula ukoko mkavu ukiwa na amani na utulivu kuliko kukaa kwenye nyumba ya karamu kukiwa na magomvi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya konyora ritoronge eriomo ri’obokima na koba n’obotoereru kobua kobeera ase enyomba eichire endagera y’omoyega ere neriomana.

English: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
Kiswahili: Mtumishi mwenye hekima atatawala juu ya mwana aaibishaye, naye atashirikiana katika urithi kama mmoja wa hao ndugu.
Ekegusii: Omosomba omong’aini nagambere omwana bw’omonene oye, oyio ogokora amang’ana ’obosooku, naende naatananerwe omwando amo nabana b’omonene oye.

English: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
Kiswahili: Kalibu ni kwa ajili ya fedha na tanuru ni kwa ajili ya dhahabu, bali Bwana huujaribu moyo.
Ekegusii: Efeta nigo egoteemerwa ase enyongo ekoyenyititora, na etaabu yateemerwa ase omorero ekebemberi, korende Omonene nere okorenga chinkoro.

English: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu husikiliza midomo mibaya; mwongo husikiliza kwa makini ulimi wa madhara.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotegerera oigwera amang’ana y’obokorekanu, na omonyaborimo nigo akoigwera chinkwana chi’ogosiria.

English: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
Kiswahili: Yeye anaye mdhihaki maskini huonyesha dharau kwa Muumba wake; yeyote afurahiaye maafa hataepuka kuadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogochecheria omotaka nigo agochaaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oye, na oyokogookera emechando yanyorire abande, takomocha konyora egesusuro.

English: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.
Kiswahili: Wana wa wana ni taji la wazee, nao wazazi ni fahari ya watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Abachokoro nigo bare eguutwa ye chisokoro chiabo, na obonene bw’abana nigo bore ase abaibori babo.

English: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
Kiswahili: Midomo yenye uwezo wa ushawishi haimfai mpumbavu: je, ni mibaya kiasi gani zaidi midomo ya uongo kwa mtawala!
Ekegusii: Inaki omoriri tagosemerigwa koba n’amang’ana amaya, boigo n’omogaambi tagwenereti nonya ’ng’ake chinkwana chi’oborimo.

English: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
Kiswahili: Kipawa ni kama kito cha thamani machoni pake yeye aliye nacho; kokote kigeukiapo, hufanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Riaaki nigo ringa buna rigena ri’ebisio ase amaiso y’omonto oria okoriegwa. Ere nigo akorengereria ng’a kende gionsi ararikorere nigo keramorentere ebisio.

English: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayesamehe kosa hudumisha upendo, bali yeyote arudiaye jambo hutenganisha marafiki wa karibu.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorigia obwanchani nigo akwabera aya akomocherwa, korende oria okona‐koinyora nigo agosaria obasani.

English: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
Kiswahili: Karipio humwingia sana mtu mwenye kutambua kuliko mapigo mia kwa mpumbavu.
Ekegusii: Kobua omonto omoriri otari kweorokereria korwa ase ogoakwa ebiranya rigana erimo, omonto omong’aini nigo akweorokereria korwa ase ogotogonyerwa okomo.

English: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
Kiswahili: Mtu mbaya hupenda kuasi tu; mjumbe asiye na huruma atatumwa dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Omosaria okona-korigia gokora amabe oka, ere ’natomerwe omonto omotindi amoe egesusuro.

English: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
Kiswahili: Ni afadhali ukutane na dubu aliyenyangʼanywa watoto wake, kuliko mpumbavu katika upumbavu wake.
Ekegusii: Mbuya omonto aumerane n’obontindi bw’edubu enkuungu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye, kobua koumerana n’omonto omoriri ase oboriri bwaye.

English: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atalipa baya kwa jema, kamwe ubaya hautaondoka katika nyumba yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogoakana amabe ase amaya, obobe tibokorua ase enyomba yaye.

English: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
Kiswahili: Kuanzisha ugomvi ni kama kutoboa bwawa la maji; kwa hiyo acha jambo hilo kabla mabishano hayajaanza.
Ekegusii: Ogochaaka eriomana nigo konga buna amaache aigoreirwe, ase ayio tiga amang’ana y’eriomana atarabucha.

English: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Yeye asemaye kuwa asiye na haki ana haki, naye asemaye kuwa mwenye haki hana haki: Bwana huwachukia sana wote wawili.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogwanchereria omokori amabe ng’a nomonyaboronge, nere oria okonachera omonyakeene ekiina, abwo bonsi nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene.

English: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
Kiswahili: Fedha ina faida gani mikononi mwa mpumbavu, wakati yeye hana haja ya kupata hekima?
Ekegusii: Inee! Chibesa omonto omoriri abwate ase okoboko kwaye agochia kogora obong’aini nechia ki, na ere tari n’enkoro y’okomanya?

English: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
Kiswahili: Rafiki hupenda wakati wote naye ndugu amezaliwa kwa ajili ya wakati wa shida.
Ekegusii: Omosani nigo akoba nobwanchani ase chingaki chionsi, na oyomino nigo aiboire agokoonye ase engaki y’emechando.

English: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
Kiswahili: Mtu mjinga hupana mkono ili kuweka rehani, naye huweka dhamana kwa jirani yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oremeire chiseemi nigo akobwatana amaboko na kwerua koba intenenera ase omonto onde.

English: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
Kiswahili: Yeye apendaye ugomvi apenda dhambi; naye ainuaye sana lango lake hutafuta uharibifu.
Ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete eriomana nigo anchete ogosaria, na oyokweimokereria igoro nigo akwerigeria ogosirigwa.

English: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye moyo mpotovu hawezi kufanikiwa; naye ambaye ulimi wake ni mdanganyifu huanguka kwenye taabu.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omokorekanu ase enkoro yaye tari goseseneka, na oyobwate oromeme rw’ogotantania nigo akonyorwa n’emechando.

English: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
Kiswahili: Kuwa na mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni; hakuna furaha kwa baba wa mpumbavu.
Ekegusii: Oyo oiboire omwana omoriri nigo akoba n’omoichano, na ise omwana oyio tari koba n’omogooko.

English: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
Kiswahili: Moyo wenye furaha ni dawa nzuri, bali roho iliyopondeka hukausha mifupa.
Ekegusii: Enkoro ere n’omogooko nigo ekogwenia buna eriogo, korende omoichano ore ase enkoro nigo okwomia emeseto y’amauga.

English: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu hukubali rushwa kwa siri ili kupotosha njia ya haki.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoegwa riaaki bobisi, erinde asarie chiinchera chi’ekina.

English: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
Kiswahili: Mtu wa ufahamu huitazama hekima, lakini macho ya mpumbavu huhangaika hadi kwenye miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Botambe omonto omong’aini nigo akorora ay’obong’aini amoetanaine, korende omonto omoriri nigo akomaga-maga gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense.

English: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
Kiswahili: Mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni kwa baba yake na uchungu kwa yeye aliyemzaa.
Ekegusii: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo agoichania ise, naende nigo akorenta obororo ase ng’ina oy’omoiborete.

English: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
Kiswahili: Si vizuri kumwadhibu mtu asiye na hatia, au kuwapiga sana maafisa kwa ajili ya uadilifu wao.
Ekegusii: Tari buya komoa egesusuro omonto omooronge, boigo tari buya kwaguria abanto abasike ase engencho y’oboronge bwabo.

English: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye maarifa hutumia maneno kwa kujizuia, naye mtu mwenye ufahamu ana moyo wa utulivu.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akwerita ase amang’ana agokwana, na omonto omong’aini nigo abwate omoika bw’oboremereria.

English: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
Kiswahili: Hata mtu mpumbavu hudhaniwa kuwa na hekima kama akinyamaza, na mwenye ufahamu kama akiuzuia ulimi wake.
Ekegusii: Nonya nomonto omoriri, ekero agokira, nigo akobarwa ng’a nomong’aini are. Ekero akomumeka omonwa oye nigo akorokwa omong’aini.

English: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
Kiswahili: Mtu ajitengaye na wengine hufuata matakwa yake mwenyewe; hupiga vita kila shauri jema.
Ekegusii: Omonto bweanchete omonyene, nigo akweganeria ayaye oka; nigo akwanga otindia nonya nase onsi ayare amaya.

English: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu hafurahii ufahamu, bali hufurahia kutangaza maoni yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omoriri tari kogokigwa nay’obong’aini, korende nigo anchete gokwana ayare ase enkoro yaye omonyene.

English: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
Kiswahili: Wakati uovu unapokuja, dharau huja pia, pamoja na aibu huja lawama.
Ekegusii: Ekero ogokora amabe kogocha, ogochaaywa nigo kogocha nakorokwo, na ogochaaywa okwo nigo kogocha n’obosooku.

English: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya kinywa cha mwanadamu ni kina cha maji, bali chemchemi ya hekima ni kijito kinachobubujika.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana akorua ase omonwa bw’omonto nigo anga buna amaache ye chindiba. Ensoko y’obong’aini nigo enga buna amaache y’orooche akominyoka.

English: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
Kiswahili: Sio vizuri kumpendelea mtu mwovu, au kumnyima haki asiye na hatia.
Ekegusii: Tari buya gwanchereria omokori amabe na gosaria ekiina ki’omonto omooronge.

English: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
Kiswahili: Midomo ya mpumbavu humletea ugomvi na kinywa chake hualika kipigo.
Ekegusii: Chinkwana chi’omoriri nigo chikorenta eriomana, na omonwa oye nigo okorangeria ogoakwa.

English: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
Kiswahili: Kinywa cha mpumbavu ni uharibifu wake na midomo yake ni mtego kwa nafsi yake.
Ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omoriri nigo okomorentera ogosareka, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chikoba omoeto ase are.

English: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya mchongezi ni kama chakula kitamu; huingia sehemu za ndani sana za mtu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana y’omogenki nigo are buna endagera enyansu; naro nigo agotirimboka gochia ase enkoro ime.

English: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
Kiswahili: Mtu aliye mlegevu katika kazi yake ni ndugu na yule anayeharibu.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo yaye nobworo nigo are oyomwabo omosaria.

English: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
Kiswahili: Jina la Bwana ni ngome imara, wenye haki huikimbilia na kuwa salama.
Ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene nigo rire orwaki orokong’u; omonyene oboronge nigo akorotamera oba orendire buya.

English: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
Kiswahili: Mali ya tajiri ni mji wake wenye ngome, wanaudhania kuwa ukuta usioweza kurukwa.
Ekegusii: Obotenenku bw’omonto omonda nigo bonga buna omochie omokong’u, naende nigo bonga orwaki orotambe gochia igoro rokomorenda.

English: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya anguko moyo wa mtu hujaa kiburi, bali unyenyekevu hutangulia heshima.
Ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’enkoro y’omonto nigo bogotang’anera ogosarigwa, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera ogosikwa.

English: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
Kiswahili: Yeye ajibuye kabla ya kusikiliza, huo ni upumbavu wake na aibu yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto okoiraneria ring’ana atarariigwa buya, obwo noboriri ase are, na nigo akonyora obosooku.

English: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
Kiswahili: Roho ya mtu itastahimili katika ugonjwa bali roho iliyovunjika ni nani awezaye kuistahimili?
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’oboremu nigo okogera omonto oremereria ogochaandeka, korende ning’o orayoremererie omoika ore n’omoichano?

English: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mwenye ufahamu hujipatia maarifa, masikio ya mwenye hekima huyatafuta maarifa.
Ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekonyora chiseemi, na ogoto kwaye nigo kogochirigia.

English: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
Kiswahili: Zawadi humfungulia njia mtoaji, nayo humleta mbele ya wakuu.
Ekegusii: Ebiegwa bi’omonto nigo bikomoigorera enchera na komobeeka amo n’abanto abanene.

English: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliye wa kwanza kuleta mashtaka huonekana sahihi, hadi mwingine ajitokezapo na kumuuliza maswali.
Ekegusii: Omonto gekwaneire ritang’ani nigo akororekana ng’a noboronge agokwana, korende omonto omoao gachire, nigo akoorokia amang’ana ayio buna are.

English: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
Kiswahili: Kupiga kura hukomesha mashindano na kutenganisha wapinzani wakuu wanaopingana.
Ekegusii: Obomera nabwo bogokoora okoamererania na gwatanana abanene abwo bakoamererania.

English: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
Kiswahili: Ndugu aliyechukizwa ni mgumu kuridhika kuliko mji uliozungushiwa ngome, nayo mabishano ni kama malango ya ngome yenye makomeo.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere aakong’u koirania ase obosani omonto omocheirwe, kobua koirania omochie omokong’u, na eriomana nigo ringa buna emekorogoto y’ebiita bi’orwaki orokong’u.

English: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
Kiswahili: Tumbo la mtu litajaa kutokana na tunda la kinywa chake, atashibishwa mavuno yanayotokana na midomo yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto nigo agoisanekia enda yaye n’ogokwana kw’omonwa oye, okwama kw’omonwa oye kwamoigotia.

English: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
Kiswahili: Mauti na uzima viko katika uwezo wa ulimi, nao waupendao watakula matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Amakweri na obogima nigo bire ase chinguru chi’oromeme, na abwo banchete korokorera emeremo ’mbanyore okwama kwaye.

English: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Apataye mke apata kitu chema naye ajipatia kibali kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto onyorire omokungu omuya, oyio onyorire ekeegwa ekiya na ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene.

English: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
Kiswahili: Mtu maskini huomba kuhurumiwa bali tajiri hujibu kwa ukali.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto omotaka agokwana nigo agosorora, korende omonda nigo akoiraneria ase obotindi.

English: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye marafiki wengi wanaweza kumharibu, bali yuko rafiki aambatanaye na mtu kwa karibu kuliko ndugu.
Ekegusii: Omonto obwate abasani abange nigo akwerentera emechando, korende n’are omosani bw’ekeene baigwanaine kobua oyomwabo.

English: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
Kiswahili: Afadhali mtu maskini ambaye mwenendo wake hauna lawama, kuliko mpumbavu ambaye midomo yake imepotoka.
Ekegusii: Omonto omotaka ore omwegenwa nigo are omuya kobua oyore omong’ainereria ase chinkwana chiaye naende omoriri.

English: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.
Kiswahili: Sio vizuri kuwa na juhudi bila maarifa, wala kufanya haraka na kuikosa njia.
Ekegusii: Tari buya omonto aborwe okomanya ase omoyo oye, na oy’okegeenda bwango, nigo agosira.

English: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Upumbavu wa mtu mwenyewe huharibu maisha yake hata hivyo moyo wake humkasirikia Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase oboriri bw’omonto nigo agwesiria ase chiinchera chiaye omonyene, erio enkoro y’omonto oyio yamomochia Omonene.

English: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
Kiswahili: Mali huleta marafiki wengi, bali rafiki wa mtu maskini humwacha.
Ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akonyora abasani abange, korende omotaka nigo akwangwa nomosani oye.

English: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
Kiswahili: Shahidi wa uongo hataacha kuadhibiwa, naye amwagaye uongo hataachwa huru.
Ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro, na omonto ogokwana oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro kiaye.

English: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
Kiswahili: Wengi hujipendekeza kwa mtawala na kila mmoja ni rafiki wa mtu atoaye zawadi.
Ekegusii: Abanto abange nigo bakorigia ogwanchwa na abanene, na abange nigo bakoba abasani b’omonto okorua ebiegwa n’omoyo omorabu.

English: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
Kiswahili: Mtu maskini huepukwa na ndugu zake wote: Je, marafiki zake watamkwepa kiasi gani! Ingawa huwafuata kwa kuwasihi, hawapatikani popote.
Ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo akogechwa nabaanto bamwabo bonsi, gose tikori ogokumia ng’a abasani baye bamotigire. Nigo egenete amang’ana abo, ko aba bosa ase are.

English: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
Kiswahili: Yeye apataye hekima huipenda nafsi yake mwenyewe, yeye ahifadhiye ufahamu hustawi.
Ekegusii: Omonto okonyora obong’aini, oyio nere obwanchire obogima bwaye, na oyo okorenda obomanyi bwaye nanyore amaya.

English: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
Kiswahili: Shahidi wa uongo hataacha kuadhibiwa, naye amwagaye uongo ataangamia.
Ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro, na oyo ogokwana oborimo goika asire.

English: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
Kiswahili: Haistahili mpumbavu kuishi katika anasa, itakuwa vibaya kiasi gani kwa mtumwa kuwatawala wakuu.
Ekegusii: Tari buya omonto omoriri amenye ase obogima bw’okwegokia; onye ere bo, tari buya nonya ng’ake ng’a omosomba agaambere abagaambi.

English: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
Kiswahili: Hekima ya mtu humpa uvumilivu, ni kwa utukufu wake kusamehe makosa.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini bw’omonto nigo bokogera oremereria okogechigwa, na okoombia okomocha nigo kore obonene bwaye.

English: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni kama mngurumo wa simba, bali wema wake ni kama umande juu ya nyasi.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti abeire nekeririanda nigo anga buna endo ekoruma, korende ogwancherwa kwaye nigo konga buna riime rire ase obonyansi.

English: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
Kiswahili: Mwana mpumbavu ni maangamizi ya babaye, naye mke mgomvi ni kama kutonatona kusikoisha.
Ekegusii: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo akorentera ise amabe, na omokungu okona‐kwomana nigo anga buna amatoima y’embura akona‐gotonya.

English: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Nyumba na mali hurithiwa kutoka kwa wazazi, bali mke mwenye busara hutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Chinyomba ne chinibo nigo chire omwando abana bakonyora korwa ase abaise korende omokungu omong’aini nigo are ekeegwa korwa ase Omonene.

English: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
Kiswahili: Uvivu huleta usingizi mzito, naye mtu mzembe huona njaa.
Ekegusii: Obworo nigo bokorentera omonto chitoro chindito, na omonto buna oyio goika abe nenchara.

English: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye hutii mafundisho huulinda uhai wake, bali yeye anayezidharau njia zake atakufa.
Ekegusii: Omonto orendete amachiiko, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyo otari korenda chiinchera chiaye nigo arakwe.

English: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
Kiswahili: Yeye amhurumiaye maskini humkopesha Bwana, naye atamtuza kwa aliyotenda.
Ekegusii: Omonto okororera omotaka amaabera, oyio nigo akorua singo ase Omonene, n’Omonene ’namoakane ase ogokora okwo kwaye.

English: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
Kiswahili: Mrudi mwanao, kwa maana katika hiyo kuna tumaini, usiwe mshirika katika mauti yake.
Ekegusii: Orokereria omwana oo omomura ase okomorongeyia ekero ogosemeria koreo, gose tobaisa komoganeria amakweri.

English: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye kukasirika haraka ni lazima atapata adhabu yake, kama utamwokoa, itakubidi kufanya hivyo tena.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore n’ekeririanda, ekeene goika anyore egesusuro; oise komotanga kagokora bobe nigo okomoseegeta.

English: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza mashauri na ukubali mafundisho, nawe mwishoni utakuwa na hekima.
Ekegusii: Igwera ogosemigwa naende bwanche okworokererigwa, igo nario oranyore obong’aini boragokoonye ase chingaki chire bosio.

English: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
Kiswahili: Kuna mipango mingi ndani ya moyo wa mtu, lakini kusudi la Bwana ndilo litakalosimama.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio emenge nere ase enkoro y’omonto, korende nonya naboigo emeroberio y’Omonene nero eraikerane.

English: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
Kiswahili: Lile mtu alionealo shauku ni upendo usio na mwisho, afadhali kuwa maskini kuliko kuwa mwongo.
Ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto nigo gokworokia obuya bwaye, na omonto omotaka nigo are omuya mono kobua omonyaborimo.

English: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
Kiswahili: Kumcha Bwana huongoza kwenye uzima, kisha mtu hupumzika akiwa ameridhika, bila kuguswa na shida.
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokorenta obogima, na omonto ore nokoiroka okwo nigo agoisaneka, gose amabe takomonyoora.

English: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
Kiswahili: Mtu mvivu hutumbukiza mkono wake kwenye sahani, lakini hawezi hata kuupeleka kwenye kinywa chake!
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, gose tagokoimokia gocha ase omonwa oye.

English: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
Kiswahili: Mpige mwenye mzaha, naye mjinga atajifunza busara, mkemee mwenye ufahamu naye atapata maarifa.
Ekegusii: Aka omonto omonyacheche, na abanto batamanyeti amaange mbeorokererie korwa ase ayio; togonyera omonto ore n’okomanya, ere nigo aranyore chiseemi.

English: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
Kiswahili: Yeye amwibiaye baba yake na kumfukuza mama yake ni mwana aletaye aibu na fedheha.
Ekegusii: Omwana ore omotindi ase ise na ogoseria ng’ina, nigo akorenta obosooku na ogochaaya.

English: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
Kiswahili: Mwanangu, ukiacha kusikiliza mafundisho, utatangatanga mbali na maneno ya maarifa.
Ekegusii: Omwana one, onye tokoigwera amorokererio nigo orasire korwa ase amang’ana akorenta chiseemi.

English: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
Kiswahili: Shahidi mla rushwa hudhihaki hukumu na kinywa cha mtu mwovu humeza ubaya kwa upesi.
Ekegusii: Kirori omobe nigo agochecheria oboronge, na omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogworerete ebibe.

English: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
Kiswahili: Adhabu zimeandaliwa kwa ajili ya wenye dhihaka na mapigo kwa ajili ya migongo ya wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: Ekiina ki’abanyacheche nigo kenachire, na abariri ’mbang’wanigwe ebiranya ase emegongo yabo.

English: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
Kiswahili: Mvinyo ni mdhihaki na kileo ni mgomvi; yeyote apotoshwaye navyo hana hekima.
Ekegusii: Edivai nigo ekorenta echeche, ekenyugwa egetindi nigo gekorenta eriomana; na onde bwensi otari gokianga nigo akoborwa obong’aini.

English: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni kama ngurumo ya simba; yeye amkasirishaye hupoteza uhai wake.
Ekegusii: Okogosa kw’omorwoti nigo konga buna okoruma kw’endo, na oyo okomogechia oba n’endamwamu, oyio nigo akogera obogima bwaye bosirigwe.

English: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
Kiswahili: Ni kwa heshima ya mtu kujitenga ugomvi, bali kila mpumbavu ni mwepesi kugombana.
Ekegusii: Nigo are amasikani ase omonto ogwetanga korwa ase eriomana, korende kera omonto ore omoriri nigo akona‐kwomana.

English: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
Kiswahili: Mvivu halimi kwa majira; kwa hiyo wakati wa mavuno hutazama lakini hapati chochote.
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo tari korema omogondo ase engaki egwenerete, na ekero rigesa riaikire, ere gakogeenda korata, takonyora gento.

English: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
Kiswahili: Makusudi ya moyo wa mwanadamu ni maji yenye kina, lakini mtu mwenye ufahamu huyachota.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio ere ase enkoro y’omonto nigo enga buna amaache are ase endiba, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo akoyabuucha korwa aroro.

English: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
Kiswahili: Watu wengi hujidai kuwa na upendo usiokoma, bali mtu mwaminifu ni nani awezaye kumpata?
Ekegusii: Abanto abange nigo bakweraria ng’a nabaya bare, korende ning’o oranyaare konyora omonto omwegenwa bori?

English: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye haki huishi maisha yasiyo na lawama, wamebarikiwa watoto wake baada yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto omonyene oboronge obwatetie chiinchera chindonge, abana baye ’mbasesenigwe korwa magega yaye.

English: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
Kiswahili: Wakati mfalme aketipo katika kiti chake cha enzi kuhukumu, hupepeta ubaya wote kwa macho yake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti ogoikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye gi’ekegaambero nigo agoserebania amabe onsi namaiso aye.

English: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?
Kiswahili: Ni nani awezaye kusema, “Nimeuweka moyo wangu safi; mimi ni safi na sina dhambi?”
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyaare goteeba, “Nasibekire ase enkoro y’ane; nachenekire korwa ase ebibe biane”?

English: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Mawe ya kupimia yaliyo tofauti na vipimo tofauti, Bwana huchukia vyote viwili.
Ekegusii: Ebirengero bi’oborito, na ebi’obonge, bire ara kabere, nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene.

English: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
Kiswahili: Hata mtoto hujulikana kwa matendo yake, kama tabia yake ni safi na adili.
Ekegusii: Nonya nomwana nigo amanyekanete ase ogokora kwaye, gose orogendo rw’aye nigo rorabe ororonge na orw’ekeene.

English: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.
Kiswahili: Masikio yasikiayo na macho yaonayo, Bwana ndiye alivifanya vyote viwili.
Ekegusii: Ogoto gokoigwa, na eriiso rikorora, bionsi bibere ’Omonene obikorete.

English: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
Kiswahili: Usiupende usingizi la sivyo utakuwa maskini, uwe macho nawe utakuwa na chakula cha akiba.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gwancha chitoro, obaise koba omotaka; ramokia amaiso ao, naye ’nonyore endagera enyinge.

English: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
Kiswahili: “Haifai, haifai!” asema mnunuzi, kisha huondoka akijisifia ununuzi wake.
Ekegusii: Omogori egento nigo agoteeba: “Eke tigeisaini gento”, na ekero akeirire bwetogia.

English: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
Kiswahili: Dhahabu kunayo, na marijani kwa wingi, lakini midomo inenayo maarifa ni kito cha thamani kilicho adimu.
Ekegusii: Etaabu nereo, na amagena amaange ye rigori rinene, korende ebikoba bigokwana ay’obong’aini nigo binga buna amagena ye rigori rinene akomeka‐meka.

English: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
Kiswahili: Chukua vazi la yule awekaye dhamana kwa ajili ya mgeni; lishikilie iwe dhamana kama anafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya mwanamke mpotovu.
Ekegusii: Bogoria eanga y’omonto bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto onde, ira biria abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y’omonto otamanyekaneti.

English: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
Kiswahili: Chakula kilichopatikana kwa hila ni kitamu kwa mwanadamu, bali huishia na kinywa kilichojaa changarawe.
Ekegusii: Endagera ekonyorwa ase enchera y’obong’ainereria, nigo ekoba enyansu ase omonto, korende magega yaye omonwa bw’omonto oyio nigo ogoichorwa n’omokenye.

English: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
Kiswahili: Fanya mipango kwa kutafuta mashauri, ukipigana vita, tafuta maelekezo.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio nigo egoikeranigwa goetera ase ogoseemia okuya na gokorwana esegi, yerwane n’obosemia obuya.

English: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
Kiswahili: Maneno ya kusengenya husababisha kutokuaminika, kwa hiyo mwepuke mtu anayezungumza kupita kiasi.
Ekegusii: Omonto okona‐goeta‐etia obogenki nigo akoorokia obobisi, ase ayio tobaisa kobwatana n’omonto otari kweriita ase amang’ana aye.

English: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atamlaani baba yake au mama yake, taa yake itazimwa katika giza nene.
Ekegusii: Omonto oraragererie ise, gose ng’ina, oyio etaya yaye nerimigwe ekero ki’omosuunte ekerima.

English: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.
Kiswahili: Urithi upatikanao haraka mwanzoni, hautabarikiwa mwishoni.
Ekegusii: Oise gosanera konyora omwando bwango korwa omochakano, omoerio oye tori gosesenigwa.

English: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.
Kiswahili: Usiseme, “Nitakulipiza kwa ajili ya kosa hili!” Mngojee Bwana, naye atakuokoa.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa goteeba, “Goika ng’akane amabe nakoreirwe.” Oganye Omonene, nere oragokoonye.

English: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
Kiswahili: Bwana anachukia sana mawe ya kupimia ya udanganyifu, nazo mizani zisizo halali hazimpendezi.
Ekegusii: Ebirengo bi’oborito bire ara kabere nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, na ekerengero kioboriania nigo kere ekebe.

English: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
Kiswahili: Hatua za mtu huongozwa na Bwana. Anawezaje basi mtu yeyote kuelewa njia yake mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Omonene nere okoraa chiinchera chi’omonto, ase ayio ’naki omonto aranyare komanya chiinchera chiaye?

English: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
Kiswahili: Ni mtego kwa mtu kuweka wakfu kitu kwa haraka na baada ya kitambo kidogo kufikiria tena nadhiri zake.
Ekegusii: Nigo ekoba omoeto ase omonto karabe omwango ase ogwatanana egento kebe egechenu, na magega yaye oba okorengereria aya arierete eira.

English: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
Kiswahili: Mfalme mwenye hekima hupepeta waovu, hulipitisha gurudumu la kupuria juu yao.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti ore omong’aini nigo akomanya abakori amabe obaatanana, erio obatacha n’amagoro ye chigaari.

English: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
Kiswahili: Taa ya Bwana huchunguza roho ya mwanadamu, huchunguza utu wake wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Omoika ore ase omonto, n’oro etaya y’Omonene; nigo ekomoreka na komanya amang’ana onsi are ime y’enkoro y’omonto.

English: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
Kiswahili: Upendo na uaminifu humweka mfalme salama, kwa njia ya upendo, kiti chake cha enzi huwa salama.
Ekegusii: Obuya na obwegenwa, nabio bikorenda omorwoti, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obogaambi nigo kegokong’igwa namaabera.

English: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
Kiswahili: Utukufu wa vijana ni nguvu zao, mvi ni fahari ya uzee.
Ekegusii: Chinguru nachio chire obonene bw’abamura, korende chimbuche nigo chire obwari bw’abaanto abagotu.

English: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
Kiswahili: Mapigo na majeraha huusafisha ubaya, nayo michapo hutakasa utu wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Obororo bw’ogoakwa nenyimbo nigo bogosibia ebibe, boigo ogoakwa kw’ebiranya nigo kogosoa ase enkoro ime kwayesibia.

English: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mfalme uko katika mkono wa Bwana; huuongoza kama mkondo wa maji, popote apendapo.
Ekegusii: Enkoro y’omorwoti nigo enga buna orooche rore ase okoboko kw’Omonene; n’Omonene nigo akomoraa gochia aande onsi buna aganetie.

English: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.
Kiswahili: Njia zote za mwanadamu huonekana sawa kwake, bali Bwana huupima moyo.
Ekegusii: Kera enchera y’omonto nigo ekororekana ng’a neya boronge ase are, korende Omonene nigo akorenga chinkoro.

English: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
Kiswahili: Kufanya yaliyo sawa na haki inakubalika zaidi kwa Bwana kuliko dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Ogokora oboronge na ekeene, ayio naro Omonene agwancha kobua ebing’wanso.

English: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
Kiswahili: Macho ya kudharau na moyo wa kiburi, ambavyo ni taa ya waovu, vyote ni dhambi!
Ekegusii: Amaiso are noboenenu, na enkoro y’obomwenu, ebio nigo bire etaya y’abakori amabe, bikobaraa bakora ebibe.

English: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
Kiswahili: Mipango ya mwenye bidii huelekeza kwenye faida, kama vile kwa hakika pupa huelekeza kwenye umaskini.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomorentera ebitoki ebinge, korende omonto okoayerera nigo akogeenderera koremerwa.

English: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
Kiswahili: Mali iliyopatikana kwa ulimi wa uongo ni mvuke upitao upesi na mtego wa kufisha.
Ekegusii: Chinibo chikonyorwa ase oromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo chikoera buna omooki, nigo chire n’obosongo buna emetego ya amakweri.

English: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
Kiswahili: Jeuri ya waovu itawaburuta mbali, kwa kuwa wanakataa kufanya yaliyo sawa.
Ekegusii: Obourereria bw’abakori amabe ’mbobasirie barueo, ekiagera bangire gokora ayare ay’oboronge.

English: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
Kiswahili: Njia ya mwenye hatia ni ya upotovu, bali tabia ya mtu asiye na hatia ni nyofu.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’omomochi nigo ere enkorekanu, korende ogokora kw’oyore n’enkoro endonge nigo kore okoronge.

English: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
Kiswahili: Ni afadhali kuishi pembeni mwa paa la nyumba, kuliko kuishi nyumba moja na mke mgomvi.
Ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ekenunchi kia irongo, kobua komenya amo ase enyomba n’omokuungu omonyariomana.

English: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu hutamani sana ubaya, jirani yake hapati huruma kutoka kwake.
Ekegusii: Omoyo bw’omokori amabe nigo okogania gokora ebibe, na omonto oyio tari kororera omonto onde amaabera.

English: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
Kiswahili: Wakati mwenye mzaha ameadhibiwa, mjinga hupata hekima; wakati mtu mwenye hekima afundishwapo, hupata maarifa.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto omonyacheche akonyora egesusuro, oria otamanyeti amaange nigo akoba omong’aini; na ekero omonto omong’aini akworokererigwa nigo akonyora chiseemi.

English: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
Kiswahili: Mwenye Haki huyajua yanayotendeka katika nyumba za waovu, naye atawaangamiza waovu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae omonyene oboronge nigo akorigereria enyomba y’omokori amabe; ere nigo akoiyeria abakori amabe inse basire.

English: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
Kiswahili: Mtu akiziba masikio asisikie kilio cha maskini, yeye pia atalia, wala hatajibiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria ogosieka amato aye ng’a taigwa ekerero ki’omotaka, nere ekero ararere takoiguugwa.

English: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
Kiswahili: Zawadi itolewayo kwa siri hutuliza hasira na rushwa iliyofichwa kwenye nguo hutuliza ghadhabu kali.
Ekegusii: Ekeegwa gekoruegwa bobisi nigo kegokendia endamwamu, ne riaaki ribisire ase eanga ime nigo rigokendia ekeririanda.

English: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
Kiswahili: Wakati haki imetendeka, huleta furaha kwa wenye haki, bali kitisho kwa watenda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekeene giakorirwe, ayio nigo akoba omogooko bw’abanyene oboronge, korende ase abakori amabe nomoichano.

English: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
Kiswahili: Mtu anayepotea kutoka mapito ya ufahamu, hupumzika katika kundi la waliokufa.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogotiga enchera y’obomanyi, oyio nabeere ase omosangererekano bw’abaanto bakwete.

English: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
Kiswahili: Mtu apendaye anasa atakuwa maskini, yeyote apendaye mvinyo na mafuta kamwe hatakuwa tajiri.
Ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete emegoko goika abe omotaka; na oyobwanchete kwegokia nedivai na amaguta takoba omonda.

English: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
Kiswahili: Waovu huwa fidia kwa ajili ya wenye haki, nao wasio waaminifu kwa ajili ya wanyofu.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agosoa ase emechando y’omonyene oboronge, oba embooria yaye, na oyo otari omwegenwa oba embooria y’oyore n’enkoro endonge.

English: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
Kiswahili: Ni afadhali kuishi jangwani kuliko kuishi na mke mgomvi na mkorofi.
Ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ense y’erooro, kobua komenya n’omokuungu omonyariomana, naende omonyandamwamu.

English: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.
Kiswahili: Katika nyumba ya mwenye hekima kuna akiba ya vyakula vizuri na mafuta, lakini mtu mpumbavu hutafuna vyote alivyo navyo.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akorenda chinibo chi’engeencho enene amo namaguta ase enka yaye, korende omoriri nigo agochiria bobe chiaera.

English: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
Kiswahili: Yeye afuatiaye haki na upendo hupata uzima, mafanikio na heshima.
Ekegusii: Omonto okorigia oboronge na obwororo, oyio ’nanyore obogima, na amasikani, na oboronge.

English: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye hekima huushambulia mji wa wenye nguvu, na kuangusha ngome wanazozitegemea.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akoumokera omochie ore nabarwani esegi chituoni oyobua, erio otagora chindwaki chiria abanto abwo basemeretie.

English: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
Kiswahili: Yeye alindaye kinywa chake na ulimi wake hujilinda na maafa.
Ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, na oromeme rw’aye, oyio nigo etangerete emechando.

English: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye kiburi na majivuno, “Mdhihaki” ndilo jina lake; hutenda mambo kwa kiburi kilichozidi.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omoenenu na omwerori, na ogokora kwaye kore okw’obomwenu, nigo akorokwa “Omochecheria”.

English: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
Kiswahili: Kutamani sana kwa mvivu kutakuwa kifo chake, kwa sababu mikono yake haitaki kufanya kazi.
Ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto omworo nigo gokomoita okwa, ekiagera nigo akwanga gokora emeremo namaboko aye.

English: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
Kiswahili: Mchana kutwa hutamani zaidi, lakini mnyofu hutoa pasipo kuzuia.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’iti nigo akweganeria kera egento botambe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo akorua na tari kong’itia.

English: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
Kiswahili: Dhabihu ya mtu mwovu ni chukizo, si zaidi sana itolewapo kwa nia mbaya!
Ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ki’omokori amabe nigo kere okogechia, Inee, tari bobe mono goetania ekero agokerua nebirengererio ebibe?

English: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
Kiswahili: Shahidi wa uongo ataangamia, bali maneno ya mwenye kusikia yatadumu.
Ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo nasire, korende omotegereri omuya nageenderere gokwana.

English: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwovu ana uso wa ushupavu, bali mtu mnyofu huzifikiria njia zake.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agokong’ia obosio bwaye, korende oyore nenkoro endonge nigo akorenda orogendo rw’aye.

English: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hakuna hekima, wala akili, wala mpango unaoweza kufaulu dhidi ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini tibori, gose okomanya, gose ogoseemia, biranyaare koamererania n’Omonene.

English: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Farasi huandaliwa kwa ajili ya siku ya vita, bali ushindi huwa kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Chibarasi nigo chikobekwa ang’e kogeenda korwana esegi, korende obobui nigo bokorua ase Omonene.

English: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
Kiswahili: Heri kuchagua jina jema kuliko utajiri mwingi, kuheshimiwa ni bora kuliko fedha au dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Erieta rigiya nigo rigwenerete gochorwa kobua chinibo chinyinge, na ogwakwaneka okuya nigo kobuete efeta na etaabu.

English: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
Kiswahili: Tajiri na maskini wanafanana kwa hili: Bwana ni Muumba wao wote.
Ekegusii: Omonda na omotaka nigo bamenyete ase obogima obomo; Omonene nere omotongi o bonsi.

English: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye busara huona hatari na kujificha, bali mjinga huendelea mbele kama kipofu nayo ikamtesa.
Ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akororera emechando korwa aare, bwebisa, korende oy’otamanyeti amaange nigo akogeenderera gochia bosio, oumerana nero, erio ochaandeka.

English: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
Kiswahili: Unyenyekevu na kumcha Bwana huleta utajiri, heshima na uzima.
Ekegusii: Abare abaitongo bamoirogete Omonene nigo bakonyora obotenenku, na ogosikwa, na obogima.

English: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.
Kiswahili: Katika mapito ya waovu kuna miiba na mitego, bali yeye ailindaye nafsi yake hukaa mbali nayo.
Ekegusii: Amagwa na emeeto nigo bitegire ase chiinchera chi’abaanto abakorekanu, korende oyo orendete omoyo oye goika eatanane korwa ase bire.

English: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
Kiswahili: Mfundishe mtoto njia impasayo kuiendea, naye hataiacha hata akiwa mzee.
Ekegusii: Orokereria omwana abwatie enchera egwenerete, na ekero abeire omogotu takoyetiga.

English: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
Kiswahili: Matajiri huwatawala maskini naye akopaye ni mtumwa wa akopeshaye.
Ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akogambera omotaka; na omonto ogosaba aegwe singo nigo akoba omosomba bw’oria omoa singo.

English: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
Kiswahili: Yeye aupandaye uovu huvuna taabu, nayo fimbo ya ghadhabu yake itaangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Oy’ogosimeka obobe, nagese ogosareka, na enyimbo y’endamwamu yaye nigo erasire bosa.

English: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.
Kiswahili: Mtu mkarimu yeye mwenyewe atabarikiwa kwa kuwa hushiriki chakula chake na maskini.
Ekegusii: Omonto obwate eriiso ri’amaabera nasesenigwe, ekiagera bwatananeire omotaka endagera.

English: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
Kiswahili: Mfukuze mwenye dhihaka, na mvutano utatoweka; ugomvi na matukano vitakoma.
Ekegusii: Seria omonyacheche, na eriomana ndiere, ee, eriomana na ogochaaya ’mbisire.

English: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
Kiswahili: Yeye apendaye moyo safi na yeye ambaye maneno yake ni ya neema, mfalme atakuwa rafiki yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete enkoro echenegete, na ebikoba biaye bigokwana ayare ay’obuya, omorwoti nabe omosani oye.

English: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
Kiswahili: Macho ya Bwana hulinda maarifa, bali huyapinga maneno ya asiye mwaminifu.
Ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie na korenda oyore nokomanya, korende nigo akoonchorana na gosaria amang’ana ya abatari abegenwa.

English: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
Kiswahili: Mvivu husema, “Yuko simba nje!” au, “Nitauawa katika mitaa!”
Ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agoteeba, “Endo nere isiko! Nigo ndabaise gochia goiterwa ase chiinchera.”

English: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
Kiswahili: Kinywa cha mwanamke kahaba ni shimo refu; yeye aliye chini ya ghadhabu ya Bwana atatumbukia ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omokuungu omotayayi nigo ore eirima entambe, na omonto onde bwensi Omonene agechiigwe nere goika agwe ase eirima eyio.

English: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
Kiswahili: Upumbavu umefungwa ndani ya moyo wa mtoto, bali fimbo ya adhabu itaufukuzia mbali naye.
Ekegusii: Oboriri nigo bosiberanirie ime ase enkoro y’omwana, korende ekeranya gekorongeyia amamocho nigo gekoborusiao.

English: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
Kiswahili: Yeye amwoneaye maskini ili kujiongezea mali, naye ampaye tajiri zawadi, wote huwa maskini.
Ekegusii: Ere oyo ogokorera abataka bobe ase ogwetenenkia ere omonyene, gose okorua ebiegwa ase abanda, goika aremerwe.

English: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
Kiswahili: Tega sikio na usikie misemo ya wenye hekima, elekeza moyo wako kwenye yale nifundishayo,
Ekegusii: Tega ogoto kwao oigwe amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana, na obeke amorokererio ane ime ase enkoro yao.

English: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
Kiswahili: kwa maana inapendeza unapoyahifadhi moyoni mwako na kuwa nayo yote tayari midomoni mwako.
Ekegusii: Nigo erabe buya korayarende ime yao, erinde abe ang’e ase ebikoba biao koyakwana.

English: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ili tumaini lako liwe katika Bwana, hata wewe, ninakufundisha leo.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria reero nakoyamanyirie, ee, nakoyamanyirie, erinde omosemerie Omonene.

English: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
Kiswahili: Je, sijakuandikia misemo thelathini, misemo ya mashauri na maarifa,
Ekegusii: Inee! Tinkoriikereti amang’ana amanene ay’ogoseemia na ay’amorokererio?

English: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
Kiswahili: kukufundisha maneno ya kweli na ya kuaminika, ili uweze kutoa majibu sahihi kwake yeye aliyekutuma?
Ekegusii: Ayio nakworokererie ayare ay’oboronge na ay’ekeene, erinde okwane ay’oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bagotomete.

English: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
Kiswahili: Usiwadhulumu maskini kwa sababu ni maskini, wala kumdhulumu mhitaji mahakamani,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koura omotaka ekiaye, ekiagera are omotaka, gose agwo ase egeita tobaisa komokorera bobe omonto ochaandegete.

English: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu Bwana atalichukua shauri lao naye atawateka wao waliowateka.
Ekegusii: Omonene narwanerere abataka, na abwo bakobaurereria nabasirie.

English: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,
Kiswahili: Usifanye urafiki na mtu mwenye hasira ya haraka, usishirikiane na yule aliye mwepesi kukasirika,
Ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora obosani n’omonto ore omwango ase okobeea gose tobaisa kogeenda amo n’omonto ore nekeririanda.

English: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.
Kiswahili: la sivyo utajifunza njia zake na kujiingiza mwenyewe kwenye mtego.
Ekegusii: Oise kobwatana noyio, nigo orenarie chiinchera chiaye, erio obwatwe ase omotego.

English: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
Kiswahili: Usiwe mwenye kupana mikono katika rehani, au kuweka dhamana kwa ajili ya madeni.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa koba oyomo bw’abaanto abwo bakobwatana amaboko, gose bakwerua koba intenenera ase chisira chi’abaanto bande.

English: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
Kiswahili: Kama ukikosa njia ya kulipa, kitanda chako kitachukuliwa ukiwa umekilalia.
Ekegusii: Nobaise kourwa oborere bwao okoraarera, ekiagera tobwati gento ogoakana.

English: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
Kiswahili: Usisogeze jiwe la mpaka wa zamani lililowekwa na baba zako.
