Kiswahili: Lakini waasi na wenye dhambi wote wataangamizwa, nao wanaomwacha Bwana wataangamia.
Ekegusii: Korende abasaria na abanyabibe nigo barasirigwe amo; na abwo batigire Omonene mbasirigwe boigo.

English: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
Kiswahili: “Mtaaibika kwa sababu ya hiyo mialoni ambayo mlifurahia, mtafadhaika kwa sababu ya bustani mlizozichagua.
Ekegusii: Inwe namobe nobosooku ase emete eyio ekorokwa emialuni mwagokerete, na ase emegondo eyio mwetogeretie.

English: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.
Kiswahili: Mtakuwa kama mwaloni wenye majani yanayonyauka, kama bustani isiyokuwa na maji.
Ekegusii: Inwe namobe buna Omoaluni oyo amato aye omire, na buna omogondo oborirwe amaache.

English: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”
Kiswahili: Mtu mwenye nguvu atatoweka kama majani makavu yawakayo moto, na kazi yake kama cheche ya moto; vyote vitaungua pamoja, wala hakuna wa kuuzima huo moto.”
Ekegusii: Abanto bare ne chinguru nababe buna amasakwe amomo, na emeremo yabo ebe buna chinsase chi’omorero, abwo mbasaambwe bayiere amo n’ebibe biabo, na onde tari orarimie omorero oyio.

English: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo aliloliona Isaya mwana wa Amozi kuhusu Yuda na Yerusalemu:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nario Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, aroche igoro ya Yuda na Yerusalemu:

English: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.
Kiswahili: Katika siku za mwisho mlima wa Hekalu la Bwana utaimarishwa kama mlima mkuu miongoni mwa milima yote, utainuliwa juu ya vilima, na mataifa yote yatamiminika huko.
Ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko ’agochi gocha, ng’a egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene ngekong’igwe kebe eki’engencho enene kobua ebinde; naende keimokererigwe igoro geetanie ebigoro, na ebisaku bionsi mbiendoke gochiao.

English: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Mataifa mengi yatakuja na kusema, “Njooni, twendeni mlimani mwa Bwana, kwenye nyumba ya Mungu wa Yakobo. Atatufundisha njia zake, ili tuweze kuenenda katika mapito yake.” Sheria itatoka Sayuni, neno la Bwana litatoka Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ee, abanto abange mbagendeo bateebanie: “Inchuo, totiire gochia ase egetunwa kia Omonene, togende ase enyomba ya Nyasae o Yakobo, erinde atworokererie chinchera chiaye, na intwe tonyare kobwatia oboeto bwaye.” Amachiiko ’Omonene nasoke korwa Sayoni, ne ring’ana riaye ndirue Yerusalemu.

English: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
Kiswahili: Atahukumu kati ya mataifa na ataamua migogoro ya mataifa mengi. Watafua panga zao ziwe majembe, na mikuki yao kuwa miundu ya kukata matawi. Taifa halitainua upanga dhidi ya taifa jingine, wala hawatajifunza vita tena.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene nanache ekiina ase egati y’ebisaku, nae abanto abange oboronge bwabo, barabwo mbature emioro yabo ebe amakombe akorema, na amatimo abo abe emeyio chinkuro; egesaku tigekoimokera egesaku kende nemioro, gose abanto tibakweorokereria korwana esegi naende.

English: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Njooni, enyi nyumba ya Yakobo, tutembeeni katika nuru ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo inchwo totaare ase omobaso Omonene.

English: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.
Kiswahili: Umewatelekeza watu wako, nyumba ya Yakobo. Wamejaa ushirikina utokao Mashariki, wanapiga ramli kama Wafilisti na wanashikana mikono na wapagani.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwangire abanto bao, abwo bare ab’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, ekiagera barabwo baichoirwe ne chingencho chi’abaanto ba moocha, na nigo bagokora oboringoria buna obw’Abafilisti; boigo babwatanire nabaanto b’echinse chingeni.

English: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.
Kiswahili: Nchi yao imejaa fedha na dhahabu, hakuna mwisho wa hazina zao. Nchi yao imejaa farasi, hakuna mwisho wa magari yao.
Ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chifeta ne chitaabu, ne chinibo chiabo tichiri nomoerio. Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chibarasi, ne chigari chiabo tichikoera.

English: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
Kiswahili: Nchi yao imejaa sanamu, wanasujudia kazi za mikono yao, vitu vile vidole vyao vimevitengeneza.
Ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo eichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, nigo bagotung’ama inse basasiima emeremo y’amaboko abo, eyio bakorire nebiara biabo abanyene.

English: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mwanadamu atashushwa na binadamu atanyenyekezwa: usiwasamehe.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio abanto bonsi nigo barakeeigwe, tobaisa kobaabera nonya ngake aye Omonene.

English: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.
Kiswahili: Ingieni kwenye miamba, jificheni ardhini kutokana na utisho wa Bwana na utukufu wa enzi yake!
Ekegusii: Inwe soa ase egetare ime, moreme chingoro mwebiseo, motame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene.

English: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.
Kiswahili: Macho ya mtu mwenye majivuno yatanyenyekezwa na kiburi cha wanadamu kitashushwa, Bwana peke yake ndiye atakayetukuzwa siku hiyo.
Ekegusii: Rituko ngocha rire ekero obomwenu bwa Mwanyabaanto borairanigwe inse, na oboenenu bwabo mbokeeigwe, na ase rituko eri’Omonene bweka naimokererigwe igoro.

English: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low—
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote anayo siku aliyoiweka akiba kwa wote wenye kujivuna na wenye kiburi, kwa wote wanaojikweza (nao watanyenyekezwa),
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda ochikiire rituko erimo arasirie abwo bonsi bare abaenenu na abamwenu, na bonsi abakweimokereria igoro mbairanigwe inse.

English: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,
Kiswahili: kwa mierezi yote ya Lebanoni iliyo mirefu sana, na mialoni yote ya Bashani,
Ekegusii: Rituko erio nisirie emecharake yonsi ya Lebanoni ere emetambe echongororogete gochia igoro mono; boigo ne Emealuni yonsi ya Basani,

English: for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,
Kiswahili: kwa milima yote mirefu na vilima vyote vilivyoinuka,
Ekegusii: na ebitunwa bionsi ebitambe, na ebigoro bionsi biimokererete igoro,

English: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,
Kiswahili: kwa kila mnara ulio mrefu sana na kila ukuta wenye ngome,
Ekegusii: na emerobiri yonsi emetambe, ne chindwaki chinkong’u,

English: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.
Kiswahili: kwa kila meli ya biashara, na kila chombo cha baharini cha fahari.
Ekegusii: ne chimeeri chionsi chia Tarisisi, n’Echimeri chionsi chingiya.

English: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.
Kiswahili: Majivuno ya mwanadamu yatashushwa, na kiburi cha wanadamu kitanyenyekezwa, Bwana peke yake ndiye atatukuzwa siku hiyo,
Ekegusii: Obomwenu bwa Mwanyabaanto mbokeeigwe, na oboenenu bwabo mbosirigwe. Na ase rituko eri’Omonene bweka naimokererigwe igoro.

English: The idols shall utterly pass away.
Kiswahili: nazo sanamu zitatoweka kabisa.
Ekegusii: Emegwekano yonsi egosasimwa nesirigwe kegima.

English: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
Kiswahili: Watu watakimbilia kwenye mapango ndani ya miamba, na kwenye mahandaki ardhini kutokana na utisho wa Bwana na utukufu wa enzi yake, ainukapo kuitikisa dunia.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbasoe ase amakuruma ’ebitare, na ase chingoro chire ase riroba; mbatame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene, ekero araimoke kwoboyia ense.

English: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats,
Kiswahili: Siku ile, watu watawatupia panya na popo sanamu zao za fedha na za dhahabu, walizozitengeneza ili waziabudu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abanto mbatugute emegwekano yabo ye chifeta na eye chitaabu, ebinto ebio beroiseretie ase okobisasiima, mbabitugutere ching’uko na ebitabora mato.

English: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.
Kiswahili: Watakimbilia kwenye mapango miambani na kwenye nyufa za miamba kutokana na utisho wa Bwana na utukufu wa enzi yake, ainukapo kuitikisa dunia.
Ekegusii: Erio basoe ase emienya y’ebitare, na ase obotandoku bw’aroro, mbatame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene mono, ekero araimoke kwoboyia ense.

English: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
Kiswahili: Acheni kumtumainia mwanadamu, ambaye hana kitu ila pumzi katika pua zake. Yeye ana thamani gani?
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, batige Mwanyabaanto, abwo okoeyana kwabo gwe chimioro kore embeo bosa. Omonto, ninki aisaine?

English: For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;
Kiswahili: Tazama sasa, Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, yu karibu kuwaondolea Yerusalemu na Yuda upatikanaji wa mahitaji na misaada, upatikanaji wote wa chakula na tegemeo lote la maji,
Ekegusii: Naama! Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, narusie korwa ase Yerusalemu, na korwa ase Abayuda, kera egento basemeretie na ebi begenete; narusieo endagera yonsi, na amaache onsi.

English: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,
Kiswahili: shujaa na mtu wa vita, mwamuzi na nabii, mwaguzi na mzee,
Ekegusii: Narusie korwao abanto bare chituoni na abarwani bande b’esegi, na abagaambi ebiina, na ababani, na abaringoria, na abagaaka,

English: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.
Kiswahili: jemadari wa kikosi cha watu hamsini na mtu mwenye cheo, mshauri, fundi stadi na mlozi mjanja.
Ekegusii: na abatang’ani b’abarwani emerongo etano, na abanto abasike, na abasemia, na abaroisia abang’aini, na abaragori bamanyete oborogi mono.

English: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya wavulana wawe maafisa wao, watoto ndio watakaowatawala.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabeeke abasae babe abanene babo, na abana abake baabagambere.

English: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.
Kiswahili: Watu wataoneana wao kwa wao: mtu dhidi ya mtu, na jirani dhidi ya jirani yake. Kijana atainuka dhidi ya mzee, mtu mnyonge dhidi ya mtu mwenye heshima.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbachandane, kera omonto nabe ogochanda oyonde, na kera omonto nabe ogochanda omogisangio oye; omwana omoke naenenere omonto omogotu, na omonto otaroochi nchera nachaye omonto osikire.

English: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”
Kiswahili: Mtu atamkamata mmoja wa ndugu zake katika nyumba ya baba yake na kusema, “Unalo joho, sasa uwe kiongozi wetu, tawala lundo hili la magofu!”
Ekegusii: Engaki eyio omonto nabwate oyomwabo baiboire komo amoteebie, “Aye nobwate chianga okobeeka, ase ayio kabe omogambi oito, otenenere obogaambi obo bwanyegerigwe.”

English: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”
Kiswahili: Lakini siku hiyo atapiga kelele akisema, “Sina uponyaji. Sina chakula wala mavazi katika nyumba yangu, msinifanye niwe kiongozi wa watu.”
Ekegusii: Korende ase rituko erio oyio nakane ateebe: “Inche tinkonyara koba omogwenia; ase enyomba yane endagera teiyo, gose eanga, ase ayio timokonyara kombeeka imbe omoraai bw’abaanto.”

English: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Yahweh, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
Kiswahili: Yerusalemu inapepesuka, Yuda inaanguka; maneno yao na matendo yao ni kinyume na Bwana, wakiudharau uwepo wake uliotukuka.
Ekegusii: Yerusalemu otagoirwe, na Abayuda bagure, ekiagera chinkwana chiabo na ogokora kwabo biabeire mamincha y’Omonene, basiereiri, Obonene bwa Nyasae gati yabo.

English: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.
Kiswahili: Nyuso zao zinavyoonekana zinashuhudia dhidi yao, hujivunia dhambi yao kama Sodoma, wala hawaifichi. Ole wao! Wamejiletea maafa juu yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Okororekana kw’amaiso abo kwababereire kirori; nigo bakoraria ebibe biabo buna Abasodomu bakorete, tibari kobibisa. Obobe nobwabo! Barabwo abanyene berenteire obobe obwo.

English: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.
Kiswahili: Waambie wanyofu itakuwa heri kwao, kwa kuwa watafurahia tunda la matendo yao.
Ekegusii: Teebia abanyene oboronge ng’a amang’ana nabe amaya ase bare, barabwo mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo.

English: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.
Kiswahili: Ole kwa watu waovu! Maafa yapo juu yao! Watalipwa kwa ajili ya yale mikono yao iliyotenda.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abakori amabe! Amang’ana nabe amabe ase bare, ekiagera aya amaboko abo abeire agokora, naro barakorerwe abanyene.

English: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanawatesa watu wangu, wanawake wanawatawala. Enyi watu wangu, viongozi wenu wanawapotosha, wanawapoteza njia.
Ekegusii: Abanto baane nigo bagochandwa nabana, na abakungu nabwo bakobagaambera. Inwe abanto baane, abaraai baino baabatantanirie enchera, babasiririe ase enchera mogoeta.

English: Yahweh stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.
Kiswahili: Bwana anachukua nafasi yake mahakamani, anasimama kuhukumu watu.
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire ang’e korenta ekiina, otenenire konachera ebisaku ekiina.

English: Yahweh will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.
Kiswahili: Bwana anaingia katika hukumu dhidi ya wazee na viongozi wa watu wake: “Ninyi ndio mlioharibu shamba langu la mizabibu, mali zilizonyangʼanywa maskini zimo nyumbani mwenu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nachake kogambia abagaaka na abagaambi b’abaanto baye, ateebe, “Ninwe mwasaririe omogondo one bw’emesabibu, na ebisakorwa bi’abataka nigo bire ase chinyomba chiaino.

English: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Mnamaanisha nini kuwaponda watu wangu na kuzisaga nyuso za maskini?” asema Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda, nigo nkoboria iga: Ninki mokorengereria goika mwasunyuntire abanto baane na gosia amasio ’abataka?”

English: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;
Kiswahili: Bwana asema, “Wanawake wa Sayuni wana kiburi, wanatembea na shingo ndefu, wakikonyeza kwa macho yao, wanatembea kwa hatua za madaha, wakiwa na mapambo ya njuga kwenye vifundo vya miguu yao.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba, “Abakungu ba Sayoni nigo bare aberori, nigo bagotaara basongorete amagoti, na bagoaka‐akania amaiso are nokogania okobe; nigo bagotira‐tiria kobakogenda na kwogia chinchigiri chire amagoro abo.

English: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana ataleta majipu kwenye vichwa vya wanawake wa Sayuni; Bwana atazifanya ngozi za vichwa vyao kuwa vipara.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene nae abakungu ba Sayoni oborwaire bw’ogosunyora chitukia chiabo, naende abaasiorie chianga abatige bare getirianda.”

English: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile Bwana atawanyangʼanya uzuri wao: bangili, tepe za kichwani, mikufu yenye alama za mwezi mwandamo,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko eri’Omonene nabaure ebinto bionsi bechaberete: ebitange bi’amagoro, na ebitinti, ne chisonoi chi’amagoti,

English: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,
Kiswahili: vipuli, vikuku, shela,
Ekegusii: na ebigera bi’amato, ne chitaai chi’amaboko, na ebiechabero bia metwe,

English: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,
Kiswahili: vilemba, mikufu ya vifundo vya miguu, mshipi, chupa za manukato na hirizi,
Ekegusii: na ebinyuri bi’amagoro, ne chinkini chi’okweboeria, ne chichuba chire namaguta agotioka, na ebite bi’ogwekong’era,

English: the signet rings, the nose rings,
Kiswahili: pete zenye muhuri, pete za puani,
Ekegusii: ne chibonyi chire nebimanyererio, na ebigera bie chimioro,

English: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,
Kiswahili: majoho mazuri, mitandio, mavazi, kifuko cha kutilia fedha,
Ekegusii: ne chiganchwa chi’emeyega, ne chigoti chi’okwambara, na ebiambaro bi’amareko, na emebuko ya koboko,

English: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.
Kiswahili: vioo, mavazi ya kitani, taji na shali.
Ekegusii: na ebirore, ne chianga chi’egatani chie rigori rinene, na ebigogwa, na ebietubo.

English: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.
Kiswahili: Badala ya harufu ya manukato kutakuwa na uvundo; badala ya mishipi, ni kamba; badala ya nywele zilizotengenezwa vizuri, ni upara; badala ya mavazi mazuri, ni nguo za magunia; badala ya uzuri, ni alama ya aibu kwa chuma cha moto.
Ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ogotioka okuya nobogundo borabeo, ne ribaga ri’orokini nengori eraabeo, ne ribaga ri’etukia eroisirie buya nerisio rirabeo, ne ribaga ri’okobeeka chiganchwa chi’emeyega mweboyie chigunia, obuya bwabo mboonchoke bobe obosoku.

English: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wako watauawa kwa upanga, nao mashujaa wako watauawa vitani.
Ekegusii: Abanto baino mbaitwe nemioro, na abarwani baino chituoni mbakwere ase esegi.

English: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.
Kiswahili: Malango ya Sayuni yataomboleza na kulia, ataketi mavumbini akiwa fukara.
Ekegusii: Ebiita bi’omochie oyio mbirere na kobokia amagombo; n’omochie oyio nobe buna omokungu ourirwe kera egento oinkaransete amaroba igoro.

English: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile wanawake saba watamshika mwanaume mmoja wakisema, “Tutakula chakula chetu wenyewe na kuvaa nguo zetu wenyewe, ila wewe uturuhusu tu tuitwe kwa jina lako. Utuondolee aibu yetu!”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abakungu batano na babere mbabwate omosacha oyomo, mbeteebie: “Intwe abanyene ntwenyorere endagera tokoria ne chianga tokobeeka, korende tiga rioka torokwe abakungu bao, erinde otoruserie obosooku.”

English: In that day, Yahweh’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile Tawi la Bwana litakuwa zuri na lenye utukufu, nalo tunda la nchi litakuwa fahari na utukufu wa wale Waisraeli watakaonusurika.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omoseboka bw’Omonene noseboke ore omoseera na ore nobonene, na okwama gw’ense nkobe obonene na obosiani bw’Abaisraeli abaratooreke.

English: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,
Kiswahili: Wale watakaoachwa Sayuni, watakaobaki Yerusalemu, wataitwa watakatifu, wale wote ambao wameorodheshwa miongoni mwa walio hai huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Erio neebe ng’a kera omonto otigarete ase Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, narokwe omochenu, kera oyomo oyorikire ase egati y’abwo bare moyo ase Yerusalemu.

English: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.
Kiswahili: Bwana atausafisha uchafu wa wanawake wa Sayuni, atatakasa madoa ya damu kutoka Yerusalemu kwa Roho ya hukumu na Roho ya moto.
Ekegusii: Ase omoika bw’okonacha ekiina na gochena, Omonene nasibie obobe bw’abakuungu ba Sayoni, naende achene abanto ba Yerusalemu korwa ase okomocha kwabo kw’ogoitera amanyinga.

English: Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana ataumba juu ya Mlima wote wa Sayuni, na juu ya wale wote wanaokusanyika hapo, wingu la moshi wakati wa mchana, na kungʼaa kwa miali ya moto wakati wa usiku, nako juu ya huo utukufu wote kutatanda kifuniko cha ulinzi.
Ekegusii: Igoro y’egetunwa gia Sayoni gionsi, na igoro y’abanto bonsi basangererekaneteo, Omonene natonge riire na erioki bibeo mobaso, na omorero okomesa obeo botuko; na igoro y’obonene obwo bwonsi egietubo gi’okorenda nkebekweo.

English: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.
Kiswahili: Utakuwa sitara na kivuli kutokana na joto la mchana, na kuwa mahali pa kujificha kutokana na dhoruba na mvua.
Ekegusii: Ekiriri ’nkebeo ki’ogokenderera korwa ase omobaso, naende kebe obotamero na oborendi bw’ogwekengera korwa ase embura y’omoubera.

English: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.
Kiswahili: Nitaimba wimbo kwa ajili ya mmoja nimpendaye, kuhusu shamba lake la mizabibu: Mpendwa wangu alikuwa na shamba la mizabibu kwenye kilima chenye rutuba.
Ekegusii: Bono nimoterere omwanchi one, nintere igoro y’omwanchi one na igoro y’omogondo oye bw’emesabibu. Omwanchi one nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu ase ekegoro egetobu.

English: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.
Kiswahili: Alililima na kuondoa mawe na akaliotesha mizabibu bora sana. Akajenga mnara wa ulinzi ndani yake, na kutengeneza shinikizo la kukamulia divai pia. Kisha akatazamia kupata mazao ya zabibu nzuri, lakini lilizaa matunda mabaya tu.
Ekegusii: Akayorema, agachora amagena ase okoyobonga, akarigia emesabibu emiya akayesimeka aroro; ase egati yaye akaagacha omoorobiri bw’okoyorendera, agakunya egeteera gi’okomitera amasabibu. Erio akaganya ore nogosemeria ng’a omogondo mbwame amasabibu amaya, korende okama amasabibu amegarori.

English: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.
Kiswahili: “Basi enyi wakazi wa Yerusalemu na watu wa Yuda, hukumuni kati yangu na shamba langu la mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, inwe abanto momenyete Yerusalemu, na inwe Abayuda, nababoririe monache ekiina ase egati yane na omogondo one.

English: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?
Kiswahili: Ni nini zaidi ambacho kingeweza kufanyika kwa shamba langu la mizabibu kuliko yale niliyofanya? Nilipotazamia kupata zabibu nzuri, kwa nini lilizaa zabibu mbaya tu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ngento ki nanga nayokorerete goetania, ekio ntakorete? Ekero nasemeretie ng’a mbwame amasabibu amaya, Inee, nase ki bwamete amasabibu amegarori?

English: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.
Kiswahili: Sasa nitawaambia lile nitakalolitendea shamba langu la mizabibu: Nitaondoa uzio wake, nalo litaharibiwa, nitabomoa ukuta wake, nalo litakanyagwa.
Ekegusii: Bono nkobateebia inde eki ngochia gokora ase omogondo oyio one bw’emesabibu: Nintagore orobago rwaye, ntagore na orwaki rwaye, na omogondo oyio obe okorisigwa na gotiringwa.

English: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”
Kiswahili: Nitalifanya nchi ya ukiwa isiyokaliwa na watu, halitakatiwa matawi wala kulimwa, nayo michongoma na miiba itamea huko, nitaamuru mawingu yasinyeshe mvua juu yake.”
Ekegusii: Ninyotige ogenderere gosareka; emesabibu tegososwa gose koburugerwa; amageri na amagwa mbikineo na koyotuba; boigo ninchike amare tayotweria embura.

English: For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.
Kiswahili: Shamba la mzabibu la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ni nyumba ya Israeli, na watu wa Yuda ni bustani yake ya kumpendeza. Alitazamia haki, lakini akaona umwagaji damu, alitazamia uadilifu, lakini akasikia vilio vya taabu.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli nabwo omogondo bw’emesabibu Omonene bw’Emeganda, na Abayuda nabwo ekemeri kiaye asimegete na gokegokera. Ekero asemeretie arore ogokora kw’oboronge, akarora abande bagokorerwa bobe, na ekero asemeretie arore oboronge, akaigwa ebirero.

English: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!
Kiswahili: Ole wenu mnaoongeza nyumba baada ya nyumba na kuunganisha mashamba baada ya mashamba hadi hakuna nafasi iliyobaki, nanyi mnaishi peke yenu katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakwementera enyomba ase enyomba, naende bementera oboremo ase oboremo, goika bakoora aase onsi, erinde ng’a barabwo boka bamenye ase ense eyio engima.

English: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amesema nikisikia: “Hakika nyumba kubwa zitakuwa ukiwa, nayo majumba ya fahari yatabaki bila kukaliwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda otianire ase inche inyigwete ogoteeba, “Ekeene, chinyomba chinyinge, chinene ne chingiya, goika chitigare bosa chitamenyiri nabaanto.

English: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”
Kiswahili: Shamba la mizabibu la eka kumi litatoa bathi moja ya divai, na homeri ya mbegu zilizopandwa itatoa efa moja tu ya nafaka.”
Ekegusii: Omogondo bw’emesabibu ore chieka ikomi nigo orame amasabibu akomitwa aisaine egetonga ekemo gioka, na embusuro eichire ebitonga ikomi nigo erame eyeisaine egetonga ekemo gioka.”

English: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!
Kiswahili: Ole wao wale waamkao asubuhi na mapema wakikimbilia kunywa vileo, wale wakawiao sana mpaka usiku, mpaka wamewaka kwa mvinyo.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakoimoka mambia chuni, baminyoka gochia konywa ebinyugwa bigotindia, abwo bakogenderera kobeera agwo goika obotuko bokia, erinde edivai eyio yabasamba na kobaonchorana.

English: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.
Kiswahili: Wana vinubi na zeze kwenye karamu zao, matari, filimbi na mvinyo, lakini hawayajali matendo ya Bwana, wala hawana heshima kwa ajili ya kazi ya mikono yake.
Ekegusii: Ase emeyega yabo nigo bakoba bare namakano ao ao, ne chinchigiri, na ebiroria, na edivai, korende tibari korengereria ogokora kw’Omonene, gose tibari korora emeremo y’amaboko aye.

English: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo watu wangu watakwenda uhamishoni kwa sababu ya kukosa ufahamu, watu wao wenye vyeo watakufa kwa njaa na watu wao wengi watakauka kwa kiu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto baane nigo bugooswa na koirwa ase obosomba ase ogotaba nobong’aini; abanene babo abasike nigo bagokwa nenchara, na omoganda obo ore neburu‐buru orang’ire mono ase okoborwa amaache.

English: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kaburi limeongeza hamu yake na kupanua mdomo wake bila kikomo, ndani mwake watashuka wakuu wao na wingi wa watu, pamoja na wagomvi wao, na wafanyao sherehe wote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aase abakuure atoonire na gwasamia omonwa oye goetania ekerengo, na abare nobonene ase omochie oyio, na emeganda ere aroro, na ebiombe bire neburu‐buru, na bonsi abagochenga ime yaye, mbatirimboke gochia aase agwo.

English: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;
Kiswahili: Hivyo mwanadamu atashushwa, na binadamu kunyenyekezwa, macho ya wenye majivuno yatanyenyekezwa.
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi nigo arakumbwe, na abanto abanene bakeeigwe gocha inse, na amaiso ’obomwenu nigo arakanywe.

English: but Yahweh of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atatukuzwa kwa ajili ya haki yake, naye Mungu Mtakatifu atajionyesha mwenyewe kuwa mtakatifu kwa haki yake.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo akoimokererigwa igoro goetera ase ekiina gi’ekeene, na Nyasae ore Omochenu bweorokia ng’a nomochenu are ase oboronge bwaye.

English: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.
Kiswahili: Kondoo watajilisha kwenye malisho yao wenyewe, wana-kondoo watajilisha katika magofu ya matajiri.
Ekegusii: Aase agwo nao ching’ondi chirabe chikorisia abe buna oborisia bwabo, na amatuuri atigirwe nabanda nairwe nabarisia bakonakong’anya‐ng’anya.

English: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,
Kiswahili: Ole wao wanaovuta dhambi kwa kamba za udanganyifu na uovu kama kwa kamba za mkokoteni,
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakweng’usera obobe ne chingori chi’obong’ainereria, abwo bakweng’usera ebibe buna ne chingori chie chigari,

English: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”
Kiswahili: kwa wale wanaosema, “Mungu na afanye haraka, aharakishe kazi yake ili tupate kuiona. Huo mpango wa Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli na ukamilike, tena udhihirike ili tupate kuujua.”
Ekegusii: bateeba, “Tiga Omonene ache bwango, aayererie emeremo yaye, erinde toyerore. Tiga aya Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli aroberetie asuke gocha ang’e aikerane, erio nario toranyare koyamanya.”

English: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
Kiswahili: Ole wao wanaoita ubaya ni wema, na wema ni ubaya, wawekao giza badala ya nuru, na nuru badala ya giza, wawekao uchungu badala ya utamu, na utamu badala ya uchungu.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakoroka ayare amabe amaya, na ayare amaya amabe, na babeeka omosunte ase oborabu bore, na oborabu ase omosunte ore, na babeeka obororo ribaga ri’obwansu, na obwansu ribaga ri’obororo.

English: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
Kiswahili: Ole wao walio na hekima machoni pao wenyewe, na kujiona wenye akili machoni pao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bagwekora abang’aini, naende bagwekora abamanyi.

English: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;
Kiswahili: Ole wao walio mashujaa kwa kunywa mvinyo, nao walio hodari katika kuchanganya vileo,
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bare chituoni ase okonywa edivai, naende bare abaremu ase ogwochogania amo ebinyugwa bigotindia,

English: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!
Kiswahili: wale wanaoachilia wenye hatia kwa kupokea hongo, lakini huwanyima haki wasio na hatia.
Ekegusii: abwo bakoegwa riaaki baa oyore nokomocha oboronge, erio barina omonyene oboronge bwaye.

English: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of Yahweh of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kama ndimi za moto zirambavyo nyasi, na kama vile majani makavu yazamavyo katika miali ya moto, ndivyo mizizi yao itakavyooza na maua yao yatakavyopeperushwa kama mavumbi; kwa kuwa wameikataa sheria ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote na kulisukumia mbali neno la Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna koreng’ana chimeme chi’omorero chigosamba amasakwe, na buna obonyansi obwomo bokoyia bwasira, naboigo na omori bw’abaanto abwo oragunde, na ebisicha biabo birurukigwe buna orotu, ekiagera bangire amachiiko ’Omonene bw’Emeganda, na bachayire ring’ana ria Nyasae Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hasira ya Bwana inawaka dhidi ya watu wake, mkono wake umeinuliwa na anawapiga. Milima inatetemeka, maiti ni kama takataka kwenye barabara. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene yokire ase abanto baye, na ere oramboire okoboko kwaye ase bare obaakire. Ebitunwa biatengechigwe, na emebere y’abanto bakwete nebe buna eubi ase chinchera. Nonya ayio onsi agochia koba igo, endamwamu yaye tekoera; okoboko kwaye nigo koragenderere korua egesururo.

English: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.
Kiswahili: Yeye anainua bendera kwa ajili ya mataifa yaliyo mbali, anapiga filimbi kwa ajili ya wale walio kwenye miisho ya dunia. Tazama wamekuja, kwa kasi na kwa haraka!
Ekegusii: Omonene natenenie ekemanyererio gi’okorangeria egesaku kemenyete aare, nabugie omoororia akerangerie geche korwa ensinyo y’ense, na rora, nkeminyoke geche bwango.

English: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wao anayechoka wala kujikwaa, hakuna hata mmoja anayesinzia wala kulala, hakuna mkanda uliolegezwa kiunoni, hakuna gidamu ya kiatu iliyokatika.
Ekegusii: Ase abanto abwo onde takorosa, gose kogochwa, gose gosundoka, gose korara chitoro, gose orokini rwa kenema tirokonyanyoka, gose chinuga chi’ebikoroto tichikobutoka.

English: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.
Kiswahili: Mishale yao ni mikali, pinde zao zote zimevutwa, kwato za farasi wao ziko kama jiwe la gumegume, magurudumu ya magari yao ya vita ni kama upepo wa kisulisuli.
Ekegusii: Emegwe yabo nigo ere emioge, na amata abo nigo atingire; ebitaago bie chibarasi chiabo nigo binga buna amagena amakong’u, na amagoro e chigari chiabo nigo akominyoka buna ekerambauti.

English: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.
Kiswahili: Ngurumo yao ni kama ile ya simba, wananguruma kama wana simba, wanakoroma wanapokamata mawindo yao, na kuondoka nayo pasipo yeyote wa kuokoa.
Ekegusii: Okoruma kwabo nigo konga buna okw’endo, nigo bakoruma buna chindo chinsae na koronya; nigo bakobwata na koira ebisakore na abooswa, na onde tari oranyare gotooria.

English: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile watanguruma juu yake kama ngurumo za bahari. Kama mtu akiitazama nchi, ataona giza na dhiki; hata nuru itatiwa giza kwa mawingu.
Ekegusii: Ee, ase rituko erio nigo bararumere abanto buna enyancha ekoruma. Omonto kararigererie ense, nigo ararore omosunte na emechando, na oborabu mbotubwe nomosunte.

English: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka ule Mfalme Uzia alikufa, nilimwona Bwana ameketi katika kiti cha enzi, kilicho juu na kilichotukuzwa sana, nalo pindo la joho lake likajaza Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria omorwoti Usia akwete, nkarora Omonene oikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene kiaimokererete igoro. Egesicho kiaye nigo kiarenge kegokurura inse nigo giaichorete ase Hekalu yonsi.

English: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
Kiswahili: Juu yake walikuwepo maserafi, kila mmoja alikuwa na mabawa sita: Kwa mabawa mawili walifunika nyuso zao, kwa mengine mawili walifunika miguu yao, na kwa mawili walikuwa wakiruka.
Ekegusii: Goetanana ase Omonene, abaserafi mbateneine aroro; kera oyomo obo nigo abwate chimbaaba isano nemo, na kera oyomo nigo atubete obosio bwaye ne chimbaaba ibere, na amagoro aye ne chimbaaba ibere, na akairurukera chimbaaba chinde ibere.

English: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
Kiswahili: Nao walikuwa wakiitana kila mmoja na mwenzake: “Mtakatifu, Mtakatifu, Mtakatifu ni Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote; dunia yote imejaa utukufu wake.”
Ekegusii: Bakarangerania, bagateeba, “Omochenu, Omochenu, Omochenu, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda; obonene bwaye bwaichoire ase ense engima.”

English: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
Kiswahili: Kwa sauti zao, miimo ya milango na vizingiti vilitikisika, nalo Hekalu likajaa moshi.
Ekegusii: Amariogi ay’okorangerania koria agatengechia oboroso bw’emetobwa ya inse y’ebisieri bie Hekalu, na erioki rigaichora ime ase enyomba eria.

English: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikalia, “Ole wangu! Nimeangamia! Kwa kuwa mimi ni mtu mwenye midomo michafu, nami ninaishi katikati ya watu wenye midomo michafu, nayo macho yangu yamemwona Mfalme, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.”
Ekegusii: Erio ngateeba, “Obobe nobwane, ekiagera nasirire! Inche nigo mbwate ebikoba bitachenegeti, na nigo imenyete ase egati y’abanto babwate ebikoba bitachenegeti; naende amaiso aane arorire Omorwoti, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda.”

English: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mmoja wa wale maserafi akaruka kunijia akiwa na kaa la moto linalowaka mkononi mwake, ambalo alikuwa amelichukua kwa koleo kutoka madhabahuni.
Ekegusii: Erio omoserafi oyomo akairuruka gocha ase ’nde, obogoretie ase okoboko kwaye rikara rire nomorero, erio arusetie ne rigami korwa ase egesasiimero.

English: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
Kiswahili: Akanigusa nalo kinywa changu na kusema, “Tazama, hili limegusa midomo yako, uovu wako umeondolewa, nayo dhambi yako imesamehewa.”
Ekegusii: Erio agakuna omonwa one ne rikara riria, agateeba: “Rora, rikara eri ri’omorero riakunire ebikoba biao; ogosaria kwao kwarusigweo, na ebibe biao biaabeirwe.”

English: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasikia sauti ya Bwana ikisema, “Nimtume nani? Ni nani atakayekwenda kwa ajili yetu?” Nami nikasema, “Mimi hapa. Nitume mimi!”
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio nkaigwa Omonene okoboria, “Ning’o ngotoma, na ning’o oranyare koba omotomwa oito?” Nkairaneria ngateeba, “Nao inde aa, ntome.”

English: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Nenda ukawaambie watu hawa: “ ‘Mtaendelea daima kusikiliza, lakini kamwe hamtaelewa; mtaendelea daima kutazama, lakini kamwe hamtatambua.’
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Genda oteebie abanto aba: Okoigwa, nkoigwa more, korende timori komanya gento, na okorora, nkorora more, korende timori korengereria.

English: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”
Kiswahili: Fanya mioyo ya watu hawa kuwa migumu, fanya masikio yao yasisikie, na upofushe macho yao. Wasije wakaona kwa macho yao, na wakasikiliza kwa masikio yao, wakaelewa kwa mioyo yao, nao wakageuka, nikawaponywa.”
Ekegusii: Okore chinkoro chi’abaanto aba chibe chinkong’u, na amato abo abe amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo aukore, erinde tibaabaisa korora namaiso abo, gose koigwa namato abo, gose komanya ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, bagwenigwe.”

English: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikasema, “Hadi lini, Ee Bwana?” Naye akanijibu: “Hadi miji iwe imeachwa magofu na bila wakazi, hadi nyumba zitakapobaki bila watu, na mashamba yatakapoharibiwa na kuangamizwa,
Ekegusii: Erio nkaboria, “Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri amang’ana ayio arabe igo?” Nere akairaneria, aganteebia, “Ngoika ekero emechie erabe yasarigwe etamenyiri nabaanto, ne chinyomba chiatigirwe bosa, na ense ebe yasarigwe kegima na yabeire amatongo.

English: and Yahweh has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.
Kiswahili: hadi Bwana atakapokuwa amekwisha kumpeleka kila mmoja mbali sana, na nchi itakapokuwa imeachwa kabisa.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene ning’anyie abanto abwo korwa ase ense eyio bagende aare, na aase agwo aratigwe are bosa, nabe aange mono ase ense eyio.

English: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”
Kiswahili: Hata kama sehemu ya kumi ya watu watabaki katika nchi, itaharibiwa tena. Lakini kama vile mvinje na mwaloni ibakizavyo visiki inapokatwa, ndivyo mbegu takatifu itakavyokuwa kisiki katika nchi.”
Ekegusii: Nebe ng’a ensemo eyemo ya ikomi yatigaire ere aroro, barabwo boigo mbasirigwe, buna koreng’ana Omoaluni otemirwe, egesike giatigaireo.” Egesike ekio nigo kerabe embusuro enchenu.

English: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
Kiswahili: Wakati Ahazi mwana wa Yothamu, mwana wa Uzia, alipokuwa mfalme wa Yuda, Mfalme Resini wa Aramu, na Peka mwana wa Remalia mfalme wa Israeli walipanda kupigana dhidi ya Yerusalemu, lakini hawakuweza kuushinda.
Ekegusii: Ekero Ahasi, mosinto o Yotamu mosinto o Usia, arenge omorwoti bw’Abayuda, Resini, omorwoti bw’Abasiiria, na Peka, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, mosinto o Remalia, abwo babere bagatiira gochia Yerusalemu koyorwania, korende tibanyarete koyobua.

English: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu nyumba ya Daudi iliambiwa, “Aramu wameungana na Efraimu.” Kwa hiyo mioyo ya Ahazi na watu wake ilitikiswa, kama miti ya msituni inavyotikiswa na upepo.
Ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana aigete ase abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi ng’a Abasiiria babwatanire n’Abaefraimu, enkoro y’omorwoti amo nechi’abaanto baye chikanyegerigwa buna emete ye rinani ekonyegerigwa nomwaga.

English: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Isaya, “Toka uende, wewe na mwanao Shear-Yashubu, mkutane na Ahazi huko mwisho wa mfereji wa Bwawa la Juu, kwenye barabara iendayo Shamba la Dobi.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Isaya: “Genda amo na Seari‐Yasuba, momura oo, morotote Ahasi agwo ase omotaro bw’amaache e ritibo ria rogoro ase enchera ekogenda egetii ki’omosibia ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga,

English: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
Kiswahili: Mwambie, ‘Uwe mwangalifu, utulie na usiogope. Usife moyo kwa ajili ya watu hawa wawili walio kama visiki vya kuni vifukavyo moshi, kwa ajili ya hasira kali ya Resini na Aramu na ya mwana wa Remalia.
Ekegusii: omoteebie: Erende, kabe n’obotoereru toiroka. Tokwa omoyo ase engencho y’endamwamu enene ya Resini oyio ore amo n’Abasiiria, na eya mosinto o Remalia, abwo bare buna ebigenga bibere bikoimokia erioki.

English: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
Kiswahili: Aramu, Efraimu na mwana wa Remalia wamepanga shauri baya ili wakuangamize, wakisema,
Ekegusii: Abasiiria amo n’Abaefraimu, na mosinto o Remalia, bakorire emeroberio emebe igoro yao bagoteeba:

English: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”
Kiswahili: “Tuishambulie Yuda, naam, tuirarue vipande vipande na kuigawa miongoni mwetu, na kumtawaza mwana wa Tabeeli awe mfalme juu yake.”
Ekegusii: Inchuo togende torwanie ense y’Abayuda toyioboyie, toyebue ebe eyaito, erinde tobeeke mosinto o Tabeeli abe omorwoti aroro.

English: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana Mwenyezi asema hivi: “ ‘Jambo hili halitatendeka, halitatokea,
Ekegusii: “Korende ’nche omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Ayio tagokorekana, gose tagoikeranigwa.

English: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa kichwa cha Aramu ni Dameski, na kichwa cha Dameski ni Resini peke yake. Katika muda wa miaka sitini na mitano, Efraimu atakuwa ameharibiwa kiasi kwamba hataweza tena kuwa taifa.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Damesiki noro omochie omonene bw’Abasiiria, na Resini nere omogambi o Damesiki; na ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano, Abaefraimu mbasenyentwe basirigwe kegima, tibagenderera koba egesaku.

English: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”
Kiswahili: Kichwa cha Efraimu ni Samaria, na kichwa cha Samaria ni mwana wa Remalia peke yake. Kama hamtasimama thabiti katika imani yenu, hamtaimarika kamwe.’ ”
Ekegusii: Samaria noro omochie omonene bw’Abaefraimu, na mosinto o Remalia nere omogambi o Samaria. “Onye timori nokwegena timokogenderera kobao.”

English: Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema na Ahazi tena,
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Ahasi naende, akamoteebia,

English: “Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
Kiswahili: “Mwombe Bwana Mungu wako ishara, iwe kwenye vina virefu sana, au kwenye vimo virefu sana.”
Ekegusii: “Bori’Omonene, Nyasae oo, akoe ekemanyererio; tiga kerwe aase abakuure inse, gose kerwe igoro mono.”

English: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Ahazi akasema, “Sitaomba; sitamjaribu Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Korende Ahasi akairaneria: “Tinkonyara koboria, na tinkonyara komoteema Omonene.”

English: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Isaya akasema, “Sikia sasa, ewe nyumba ya Daudi! Je, haitoshi kujaribu uvumilivu wa wanadamu? Je, mtaujaribu uvumilivu wa Mungu wangu pia?
Ekegusii: Erio Isaya agateeba: “Inwe ab’ororeeria rwa Daudi, igwa bono! Inee! Namang’ana amasinini mono ase more korosia abanto, na bono mwamorosirie na Nyasae one boigo?

English: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana mwenyewe atawapa ishara: Bikira atachukua mimba, naye atamzaa mwana, na ataitwa Imanueli.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene omonyene nabae ekemanyererio eke: Naama! Omoiseke omwekuungi nabe morito, erio aibore omwana omoisia, namoroke erieta riaye Imanueli.

English: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
Kiswahili: Atakula jibini na asali atakapokuwa ameweza kukataa mabaya na kuchagua mema.
Ekegusii: Ekero omwana oyio arabe omanyire kwanga amabe na gochora amaya, nabe okoria amaguta ’amabeere na obooke.

English: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
Kiswahili: Lakini kabla mtoto hajajua kukataa mabaya na kuchagua mema, nchi ya wafalme hao wawili unaowaogopa itafanywa ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero omwana oria ataramanya kwanga amabe, na gochora amaya, ense y’abarwoti abwo babere bagokogechia yatigirwe bosa.

English: Yahweh will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataleta juu yako, juu ya watu wako, na juu ya nyumba ya baba yako wakati ambao haujawahi kuwako tangu Efraimu alipojitenga na Yuda: yeye atawaleteeni mfalme wa Ashuru.”
Ekegusii: “Omonene narente amatuko amabe igoro na ase abanto bao, na ase abanto b’ororeeria rwa iso, amatuko buna ayio atana koba bo rinde korwa ekero Abaefraimu beatananete korwa ase Abayuda; narente omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.”

English: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile Bwana atawapigia filimbi mainzi kutoka vijito vya mbali vya Misri, na nyuki kutoka nchi ya Ashuru.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eye Omonene nabugie omoororia, arangerie chingi echio chimenyete ase omochakano bw’ebirooche bia Misiri, naende arangerie chinchoke chire ase ense y’Abaasuri.

English: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.
Kiswahili: Wote watakuja na kukaa kwenye mabonde yenye miteremko, na kwenye nyufa za miamba, kwenye vichaka vyote vyenye miiba, na kwenye mashimo yote ya maji.
Ekegusii: Echio chionsi nchiche chimenye ase amagoko, na ase chingako chi’ebitare, na ase ebitutu bi’amagwa, na ase ebitii bionsi.

English: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile Bwana atatumia wembe ulioajiriwa kutoka ngʼambo ya Mto, yaani mfalme wa Ashuru, kunyoa nywele za kichwa chako na malaika ya miguu yako, na kuziondoa ndevu zako pia.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene narente omoyio o tukia korwa ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Eufarati, noro omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, akigitere chitukia chi’emetwe yabo, na agingire amarionya ’amagoro ne chinderu chiabo.

English: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, mtu atahifadhi hai ndama mmoja na kondoo wawili.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio omonto nabe otugete ritororo erimo, ne ching’ondi ibere;

English: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya wingi wa maziwa watakayotoa, atapata jibini ya kula. Wote watakaobakia katika nchi watakula jibini na asali.
Ekegusii: echio nchikamwe amabeere amange, nere abe okonyora amaguta amange, na kera omonto orabe otigaire ore moyo ase ense eyio nabe okoria amaguta na obooke.

English: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, kila mahali palipokuwa na mizabibu elfu moja yenye thamani ya shekeli 1,000 za fedha, patakuwa na michongoma na miiba tu.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, aase arenge kwama emesabibu elifu eyemo, aisanete chisekeli chi’echifeta elifu eyemo, namere amageri na amagwa.

English: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.
Kiswahili: Watu watakwenda huko wakiwa na upinde na mshale, kwa maana nchi itafunikwa na michongoma na miiba.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbache agwo babwate amata ne chinsara, ekiagera orogongo orwo rwonsi rwamerire amageri na amagwa.

English: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”
Kiswahili: Kuhusu vilima vyote vilivyokuwa vikilimwa kwa jembe, hamtakwenda huko tena kwa ajili ya hofu ya michongoma na miiba. Patakuwa mahali ambapo ngʼombe wataachiwa huru, na kondoo kukimbia kimbia.
Ekegusii: Ase ebigoro bionsi mwarenge korema namakombe, timokogendao korema naende, ekiagera nigo morairoke amageri na amagwa; aase agwo nabe ase chiombe chigochwarwa ne ching’ondi chiaatiringe.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Chukua gombo kubwa, uandike juu yake kwa kalamu ya kawaida jina: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Bazi.
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Imokia ebao enene ekorikwa, orike amariko aya Mwanyabaanto baranyare gosoma buya, orike: Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.”

English: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”
Kiswahili: Nami nitawaita kuhani Uria, na Zekaria mwana wa Yeberekia kama mashahidi wangu waaminifu.”
Ekegusii: Inche nkerigeria abanto abegenwa babe birori, nabwo Uria Omokuani, na Zakaria, mosinto o Yeberekia.

English: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’
Kiswahili: Kisha nikaenda kwa nabii mke, naye akapata mimba, akazaa mwana. Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Mwite huyo mtoto Maher-Shalal-Hash-Bazi.
Ekegusii: Erio nkaba nomokuungu one orenge omobani, na ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, n’Omonene aganteebia, “Moroke Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.

English: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”
Kiswahili: Kabla mtoto hajaweza kusema ‘Baba yangu’ au ‘Mama yangu,’ utajiri wa Dameski na nyara za Samaria zitachukuliwa na mfalme wa Ashuru.”
Ekegusii: Nebe ekero omwana oyio ataramanya gwatora Tata gose Baba, nonyore ng’a obotenenku bwonsi bwa Damesiki, na ebisakorwa bia Samaria, biaikire koirwa ase omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.”

English: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema nami tena:
Ekegusii: Omonene agakwana eria kabere, aganteebia,

English: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
Kiswahili: “Kwa sababu watu hawa wamekataa maji ya Shilo yatiririkayo taratibu wakamfurahia Resini na mwana wa Remalia,
Ekegusii: “Abanto aba bangire amaache a Silo akwongora ng’ora, bagokire na kobwatana na Resini, naende na mosinto o Remalia.

English: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo Bwana yu karibu kuleta dhidi yao mafuriko makubwa ya Mto: yaani mfalme wa Ashuru na fahari yake yote. Yatafurika juu ya mifereji yake yote, yatamwagikia juu ya kingo zake zote,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, rora inche Omonene nkorenta inde igoro y’abanto abwo amaache ’orooche are amange, naende are ne chinguru, ayio naro omorwoti bw’Abaasuri amo nobonene bwaye bwonsi. Amache ayio naichore aete chingegu igoro, aiteke gochia aande onsi.

English: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.
Kiswahili: na kufika hadi Yuda, yakizunguka kwa kasi juu yake, yakipita katikati na yakifika hadi shingoni. Mabawa yake yaliyokunjuliwa yatafunika upana wa nchi yako, Ee Imanueli!”
Ekegusii: Aro naminyoke ne chinguru igoro y’ense y’Abayuda, aichore, agenderere gochia bosio aike ase rigoti.” Ee, aye Imanueli, amaache ayio nigo ararambore chimbaaba chiaye atube obogare bw’ense yao.

English: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!
Kiswahili: Inueni kilio cha vita, enyi mataifa, na mkavunjwevunjwe! Sikilizeni, enyi nyote nchi za mbali. Jiandaeni kwa vita, nanyi mkavunjwevunjwe! Jiandaeni kwa vita, nanyi mkavunjwevunjwe!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto aba, kora eburu‐buru, nonya naboigo goika mosenyentwe! Ee, inwe mwensi abamore ase chinse chi’aare, igwa ayio! Eboyie mokong’e, goika mosenyentwe! Ee, eboyie goika mosenyentwe!

English: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
Kiswahili: Wekeni mikakati yenu, lakini itashindwa; fanyeni mipango yenu, lakini haitafanikiwa, kwa maana Mungu yu pamoja nasi.
Ekegusii: Inchuo amo mosemanie, korende nigo korabe bosa; kwana ring’ana riaino, korende tirikoba, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naintwe.

English: For Yahweh spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
Kiswahili: Bwana alisema nami mkono wake wenye nguvu ukiwa juu yangu, akinionya nisifuate njia za taifa hili. Akasema:
Ekegusii: Omonene akabeeka igoro ase ’nde okoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru, agakwana nainche, agankurera ng’a timbaisa kobwatia chinchera chi’abaanto aba, agateeba,

English: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.
Kiswahili: “Usiite fitina kila kitu ambacho watu hawa hukiita fitina, usiogope kile wanachokiogopa, wala usikihofu.
Ekegusii: “Timobaisa koroka emeroberio ng’a nemebe, eyio abanto aba bakoroka ng’a nemebe, gose timobaisa kwoboa amang’ana boboete, gose kende tikebaondokia inwe.

English: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndiye peke yake ikupasaye kumheshimu kuwa mtakatifu, ndiye peke yake utakayemwogopa, ndiye peke yake utakayemhofu,
Ekegusii: Korende inwe tiga inche Omonene bw’Emeganda imbe nchenegete ase more; ninche bweka morairoke na konyoboa.

English: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.
Kiswahili: naye atakuwa mahali patakatifu; lakini kwa nyumba zote mbili za Israeli atakuwa jiwe lile linalosababisha watu kujikwaa na mwamba wa kuwaangusha. Kwa watu wa Yerusalemu, atakuwa mtego na tanzi.
Ekegusii: Ere nabe aase aino aachenu, korende ase ebisaku ebi bibere bi’Abaisraeli nabe rigena rikogocha, na egetare gekoiyeria inse, naende abe omoeto na oboreba ase abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu.

English: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”
Kiswahili: Wengi wao watajikwaa; wataanguka na kuvunjika, watategwa na kunaswa.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abange mbagochwe na kogwa, mbasenyentwe, mbategwe na kobwatwa.”

English: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
Kiswahili: Funga ushuhuda na kutia muhuri sheria miongoni mwa wanafunzi wangu.
Ekegusii: Eboeranie oborori, na obeke amachiiko aane ekemanyererio, ime ase chinkoro chi’aborokigwa baane.

English: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
Kiswahili: Nitamngojea Bwana, ambaye ameificha nyumba ya Yakobo uso wake. Nitaliweka tumaini langu kwake.
Ekegusii: Nimoganyete Omonene, oyio otubire obosio bwaye korwa ase ororeeria rwa Yakobo; nimbe imosemeretie.

English: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.
Kiswahili: Niko hapa, pamoja na watoto ambao Bwana amenipa. Sisi ni ishara na mfano wake katika Israeli, kutoka kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, anayeishi juu ya Mlima Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Naama! Inche amo nabana aba Omonene ang’eire nigo tore ebimanyererio na emegwekano ase egati y’Abaisraeli, ebio bikorwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, oyio omenyete ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni.

English: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?
Kiswahili: Wakati watu wanapowaambia ninyi kutafuta ushauri kwa waaguzi na wenye kuongea na mizimu, ambao hunongʼona na kunungʼunika, je, watu wasingeuliza kwa Mungu wao? Kwa nini watake shauri kwa wafu kwa ajili ya walio hai?
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto barabateebie: “Genda moboorie abwo bakorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakuure, naende moboorie abaragori, abwo bakomonyererana na okong’ung’ura,” inwe mobairanerie iga: “Inee! Tegwenereti abanto komorigia Nyasae obo? Naki eraabe ng’a toboorie emeika y’abakuure ase engencho y’abanto bare moyo?”

English: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
Kiswahili: Kwa sheria na kwa ushuhuda! Kama hawatasema sawasawa na neno hili, hawana mwanga wa mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Moiranere amachiiko na oborori! Abanto batari gokwana koreng’ana namang’ana ayio, ekeene, omobaso o mambia torabaabarera.

English: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,
Kiswahili: Watazunguka katika nchi yote, wakiwa na dhiki na njaa. Watakapotaabika kwa njaa, watapatwa na hasira kali, nao, wakiwa wanatazama juu, watamlaani mfalme wao na Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbaetanane ase ense yonsi, bare nemechando emenene mono, na enchara, na ekero babeire nenchara mbabe nekeririanda ekenene, baragererie omorwoti obo na Nyasae obo. Mbaonchore amasio abo barigererie gochia igoro,

English: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
Kiswahili: Kisha wataangalia duniani na kuona tu dhiki na giza, hofu na huzuni tupu, nao watasukumiwa kwenye giza nene kabisa.
Ekegusii: naende baonchoke barigererie ense inse, korende nigo bararore obororo, na omosunte, na ogoichanigwa okonene, erio basoigwe ase omosunte ekerima.

English: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, hapatakuwepo huzuni tena kwa wale waliokuwa katika dhiki. Wakati uliopita aliidhili nchi ya Zabuloni na nchi ya Naftali, lakini katika siku zijazo ataiheshimu Galilaya ya Mataifa, karibu na njia ya bahari, kando ya Yordani:
Ekegusii: Omosunte tokogenderera koba ase ogochandeka kore bono. Amatuko a kare Omonene nigo atigete ense ya Sabuloni, na eya Nafutali, na chirochio chigachaywa, korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha narente obonene bw’ogosikwa ase ense ere ang’e nenchera ekogenda ase enyancha, ng’umbu ya Yorodani, nero Galili, ense y’abanto b’ebisaku.

English: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.
Kiswahili: Watu wanaotembea katika giza wameona nuru kuu, wale wanaoishi katika nchi ya uvuli wa mauti, nuru imewazukia.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo baarenge gotaara ase omosunte, bono barorire omobaso omonene; abwo bamenyete ase ense y’ekiriri ki’amakweri omobaso obabareire.

English: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.
Kiswahili: Umelikuza taifa, na kuzidisha furaha yao, wanafurahia mbele zako, kama watu wanavyofurahia wakati wa mavuno, kama watu wafurahivyo wagawanyapo nyara.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene gwasesenirie egesaku, na kerokio kiabuchire, kwarure omogooko, na oro obeire omonge; abanto abwo nigo bare nomochengo ase obosio bwao, buna abanto bakoba nomochengo ase engaki ye rigesa, na buna bakogoka ekero bagwatanana ebisakorwa.

English: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.
Kiswahili: Kama vile siku ya kushindwa kwa Wamidiani, umevunja nira iliyowalemea, ile gongo mabegani mwao na fimbo yake yeye aliyewaonea.
Ekegusii: Aye kwabunire rikorogoto riarenge ririto ase bare, kwabunire enyimbo eria yarenge goaka amareko abo, enyimbo eyio yarenge ey’abachandi babo, buna gwakorete ase engaki y’Abamidiani.

English: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
Kiswahili: Kila kiatu cha askari kilichotumiwa vitani, na kila vazi lililovingirishwa katika damu vitawekwa kwa ajili ya kuchomwa, vitakuwa kuni za kuwasha moto.
Ekegusii: Ebikoroto bi’abasikari bagotitiria aase esegi, ne chianga chionsi chiaakirwe amanyinga, ebio bionsi mbisambwe nomorero.

English: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kwa ajili yetu mtoto amezaliwa, tumepewa mtoto mwanaume, nao utawala utakuwa mabegani mwake. Naye ataitwa Mshauri wa Ajabu, Mungu Mwenye Nguvu, Baba wa Milele, Mfalme wa Amani.
Ekegusii: Omwana oiboirwe ase engencho yaito, intwe twaeirwe omwana omomura; obogaambi mbobe ase amareko aye, ere nigo ararokwe: “Omosemia bw’Ogokumia, Nyasae bw’Okobua, Tata o Kare na Kare, Omogambi bw’omorembe.”

English: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.
Kiswahili: Kuongezeka kwa utawala wake na amani hakutakuwa na mwisho. Atatawala katika kiti cha enzi cha Daudi na juu ya ufalme wake, akiuthibitisha na kuutegemeza kwa haki na kwa adili, tangu wakati huo na hata milele. Wivu wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote utatimiza haya.
Ekegusii: Obogaambi bwaye nigo borabe obonene, na omorembe oye tokoba nomoerio igoro ase ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi na ase oborwoti bwaye. Obwo nigo borakong’igwe ase ekeene na oboronge, korwa bono na goika kare na kare. Risemi ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda ndikore amang’ana ayio.

English: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametuma ujumbe dhidi ya Yakobo, utamwangukia Israeli.
Ekegusii: Omonene otomire ring’ana kogambia ororeeria rwa Yakobo, narirorio ndibaikere Abaisraeli.

English: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
Kiswahili: Watu wote watajua hili: Efraimu na wakazi wa Samaria, wanaosema kwa kiburi na majivuno ya mioyo,
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi mbarimanye, nonya nabamenyete ase ense y’Abaefraimu, na ey’Abasamaria, abwo bagokwana noboenenu na obomwenu bwe chinkoro, bateeba,

English: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”
Kiswahili: “Matofali yameanguka chini, lakini tutajenga tena kwa mawe yaliyochongwa, mitini imeangushwa, lakini tutapanda mierezi badala yake.”
Ekegusii: “Amaagacho ’amatabori agure inse, korende nigo torayaagache namagena abaachire. Emeko yagechirwe, korende ntosimeke emecharake ribaga ri’eyio.”

English: Therefore Yahweh will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana amemtia nguvu adui wa Resini dhidi yao na kuchochea watesi wao.
Ekegusii: Omonene oseegetire na korenta ababisa ba Resini bache kobarwania.

English: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Kiswahili: Waashuru kutoka upande wa mashariki na Wafilisti kutoka upande wa magharibi wameila Israeli kwa kinywa kilichopanuliwa. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Abasiiria bamenyete moocha, na Abafirisiti bamenyete bosongo, baasamirie emenwa yabo bamere Abaisraeli. Nonya ayio are bo, Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.

English: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu hawajamrudia yeye aliyewapiga, wala hawajamtafuta Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Abanto tibamoiranerete oria obaete egesusuro, gose tibamorigetie Omonene bw’Emeganda.

English: Therefore Yahweh will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana atakatilia mbali kutoka Israeli kichwa na mkia, tawi la mtende na tete katika siku moja.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ase rituko erimo rioka Omonene nanache omotwe bw’Abaisraeli na ekemincha, boigo nanache orosagia rw’omokendo na esaka.

English: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
Kiswahili: Wazee na watu mashuhuri ndio vichwa, nao manabii wanaofundisha uongo ndio mkia.
Ekegusii: Omogaka bw’amasikani nere omotwe, na omobani okworokereria oborimo nere ekemincha.

English: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaowaongoza watu hawa wanawapotosha, nao wale wanaoongozwa wamepotoka.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakoraa abanto aba baabasirie, na abwo bakoraagwa nabaanto abwo mbasirigwe.

English: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana hatawafurahia vijana, wala hatawahurumia yatima na wajane, kwa kuwa kila mmoja wao hamchi Mungu, nao ni waovu, na kila kinywa kinanena upotovu. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene tari nomogooko ase abasae babo, na tari namaabera ase chintakana na ababoraka babo, ekiagera kera omonto nomosaria ase Nyasae, na omokori amabe, na kera oyomo nigo agokwana ay’oboriri. Ase engencho y’ayio onsi Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.

English: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
Kiswahili: Hakika uovu huwaka kama moto; huteketeza michongoma na miiba, huwasha moto vichaka vya msituni, hujiviringisha kuelekea juu kama nguzo ya moshi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nigo bogosamba buna omorero; noro nigo ogosamba amageri na amagwa, nigo ogosamba rinani rinoru, riaerera ase erioki richongororogete gochia igoro.

English: Through Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.
Kiswahili: Kwa hasira ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote nchi itachomwa kwa moto, nao watu watakuwa kuni za kuchochea moto. Hakuna mtu atakayemhurumia ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Endamwamu y’Omonene bw’Emeganda yasambire ense; abanto nigo banga buna chinko chigwokia omorero, na monto onde takororera oyomwabo amaabera.

English: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:
Kiswahili: Upande wa kuume watakuwa wakitafuna, lakini bado wataona njaa; upande wa kushoto watakuwa wakila, lakini hawatashiba. Kila mmoja atajilisha kwa nyama ya mtoto wake mwenyewe:
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakona‐gotaboria ebinto ase ensemo ya borio, korende nigo bagendererete koba nenchara; nigo bakwenyorera ebinto korwa ase ensemo ya bomosi, korende tibari koigota. Kera oyomo nigo akoria chinyama chi’omobere bw’oyomwabo.

English: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Kiswahili: Manase atamla Efraimu, naye Efraimu atamla Manase; nao pamoja watakuwa kinyume na Yuda. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Manase mbarie abaefraimu, na abaefraimu mbarie Abamanase, na abwo amo mbaonchokere Abayuda. Ase engencho y’ayi’Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.

English: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees
Kiswahili: Ole wao wawekao sheria zisizo za haki, kwa wale watoao amri za kuonea,
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakobeeka amachiiko atari ayaboronge, na abariki abakona‐koriika amang’ana ay’ogokorera abande bobe.

English: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
Kiswahili: kuwanyima maskini haki zao na kuzuilia haki za watu wangu walioonewa, kuwafanya wajane mawindo yao na kuwanyangʼanya yatima.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakoonchorana ebiina bi’abaremeire na koura abataka b’abaanto baane oboronge bwabo, erinde ababoraka babe ebisakorwa biabo, ne chintaaka chiaurererigwa.

English: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
Kiswahili: Mtafanya nini siku ya kutoa hesabu, wakati maafa yatakapokuja kutoka mbali? Mtamkimbilia nani awape msaada? Mtaacha wapi mali zenu?
Ekegusii: Ngento ki morakore ase rituko riria egesusuro kegocha? Ninki morakore ekero ekembugu‐mbugu kerache korwa aare? Ning’o moratamere abakoonye? Ning’o moratigere obotenenku bwaino?

English: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Kiswahili: Hakutasalia kitu chochote, isipokuwa kujikunyata miongoni mwa mateka, au kuanguka miongoni mwa waliouawa. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Kende tikegotigara otatiga moragwe inse, mweringanie ase egati y’abasibwa, gose mogwe ase egati y’ebitondo. Nonya ayio are bo, Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.

English: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
Kiswahili: “Ole kwa Ashuru, fimbo ya hasira yangu, ambaye mkononi mwake ana rungu ya ghadhabu yangu!
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobw’Abaasuri, abwo bare enyimbo y’endamwamu yane; okogechigwa kwane nigo kore enungu ase amaboko abo.

English: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
Kiswahili: Ninamtuma dhidi ya taifa lisilomjua Mungu, ninamtuma dhidi ya taifa linalonikasirisha, kukamata mateka na kunyakua nyara, pia kuwakanyaga chini kama matope ya barabarani.
Ekegusii: Nimbatome gochia korwania egesaku ekio giasaririe ase Nyasae, ee, nimbachike bagende korwania abanto abwo nabeire nendamwamu ase bare, mbasakore ebinto bi’abaanto abwo bibe ebiabo, naende mbaabatiringere inse buna esike ere ase chinchera.

English: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.
Kiswahili: Lakini hili silo analokusudia, hili silo alilo nalo akilini; kusudi lake ni kuangamiza, kuyakomesha mataifa mengi.
Ekegusii: “Korende omorwoti bw’Abaasuri takagerete ayio, gose tayarengereretie. Ere nigo aganetie goita na gosiria ebisaku ebinge.

English: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
Kiswahili: Maana asema, ‘Je, wafalme wote si majemadari wangu?
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agoteeba iga: Inee! Abachiki baane bonsi tibari abarwoti?

English: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”
Kiswahili: Je, Kalno hakutendwa kama Karkemishi? Hamathi si kama Arpadi, nayo Samaria si kama Dameski?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omochie o Kalino tobuetwe buna Kari‐Kemisi, na Hamati buna Aripadi, na Samaria buna Damesiki?

English: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,
Kiswahili: Kama vile mkono wangu ulivyotwaa falme za sanamu, falme ambazo vinyago vyao vilizidi vile vya Yerusalemu na Samaria:
Ekegusii: Onye okoboko kwane kwaigete ase amarwoti arenge gosasiima emegwekano, emegwekano eyio yabombire yarenge emenene kobua eya Yerusalemu na Samaria.

English: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
