Kiswahili: je, nisiishughulikie Yerusalemu na sanamu zake kama nilivyoshughulikia Samaria na vinyago vyake?’ ”
Ekegusii: Inee, tingokora ase Yerusalemu, na ase emegwekano yaye egosasimwa, buna nakorete ase Samaria na ase emegwekano yaye?”

English: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakapokuwa amemaliza kazi yake yote dhidi ya Mlima Sayuni na Yerusalemu, atasema, “Nitamwadhibu mfalme wa Ashuru kwa ajili ya majivuno ya ukaidi wa moyo wake na kutazama kwa macho yenye dharau.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arabe okoorire gokora emeremo yaye yonsi ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, nae omorwoti bw’Abaasuri egesusuro ase engencho y’ogwetogia kwaye, na oboenenu bw’okweimokereria igoro.

English: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa anasema: “ ‘Kwa nguvu za mkono wangu nimefanya hili, kwa hekima yangu, kwa sababu nina ufahamu. Niliondoa mipaka ya mataifa, niliteka nyara hazina zao, kama yeye aliye shujaa niliwatiisha wafalme wao.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti oyio nigo agoteeba: “Ase chinguru chi’amaboko aane nakorire ayio, boigo nase obong’aini bwane, ekiagera nimbwate okomanya. Nasukirie chimbebe chi’abaanto na kobaura chinibo chiabo, na ase chinguru chiane chire buna echi’eeri nabeire nkoiyeria abagaambi korwa ase ebirogo biabo.

English: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
Kiswahili: Kama mtu atiavyo mkono kwenye kiota, ndivyo mkono wangu ulivyochukua utajiri wa mataifa; kama watu wakusanyavyo mayai yaliyoachwa, ndivyo nilivyokusanya nchi zote; wala hakuna hata mmoja aliyepiga bawa au kufungua kinywa chake kutoa mlio.’ ”
Ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna omonto akorambora okoboko kwaye igoro ase egesera g’echinyoni, naboigo okoboko kwane kwairete chinibo chi’abaanto buna ebiswa bie chinyoni bikoirwa. Nigo nkoboongania ense yonsi buna amagena e chinyoni atigirwe akobonganigwa; onde tanyegeretie orobaaba rwaye, gose komaanora omonwa oye, gose kwemunyia.”

English: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.
Kiswahili: Je, shoka laweza kujigamba kuwa na nguvu zaidi kuliko yule anayelitumia, au msumeno kujisifu dhidi ya yule anayeutumia? Ni kana kwamba fimbo ingeweza kumwinua yeye aichukuaye, au mkongojo ungemwinua mwenye kuutumia!
Ekegusii: Inee! Egesire nkenyare gwetogia igoro y’oyio okogekorera emeremo? Gose omosumeno mbwekore koba nengencho enene kobua oyio okonacha noro? Aise koba bo, nanga nigo are goteebwa ng’a enyimbo nebogorie oyio oyebogoretie, gose egete nkebogorie oyio otari omote.

English: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, atatuma ugonjwa wa kudhoofisha kwa askari wake walio hodari, katika fahari yake moto utawaka kama mwali wa moto.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, natome oborwaire bw’okoreeyia abanto abanoru, na obonene bw’omorwoti oyio botongigwe boyie buna omorero.

English: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
Kiswahili: Nuru ya Israeli itakuwa moto, Aliye Mtakatifu wao mwali wa moto; katika siku moja utaunguza na kuteketeza miiba na michongoma yake.
Ekegusii: Oborabu bw’Abaisraeli mboonchoke bobe omorero, na oyore Omochenu obo nabe ekebemberi ki’omorero. Omorero oyio nosambe na gosiria amagwa na amageri ase rituko erimo.

English: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.
Kiswahili: Fahari ya misitu yake na mashamba yenye rutuba utateketeza kabisa, kama vile mtu mgonjwa adhoofikavyo.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana oborwaire bokoria omobere bw’omonto bwayokoora, naboigo obonene bwe rinani ri’Abaisraeli amo nemegondo yabo ekwama birasirigwe kegima. Omonene nigo arasirie omoyo amo nomobere.

English: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.
Kiswahili: Nayo miti inayobaki katika misitu yake itakuwa michache sana hata mtoto mdogo angeweza kuihesabu.
Ekegusii: Emete ye rinani riaye eratigare, nigo erabe emeke mono, eyio nonya nomwana aranyare kobara na koyeriika.

English: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, mabaki ya Israeli, walionusurika wa nyumba ya Yakobo, hawatamtegemea tena yeye aliyewapiga, lakini watamtegemea kwa kweli Bwana Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko ayio abatigari b’Abaisraeli na abwo b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo baratooreke, tibakogenderera kweegeka ase egesaku ekio kiabaagete, korende ase obwegenwa nigo bareegeke ase Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
Kiswahili: Mabaki watarudi, mabaki wa Yakobo watamrudia Mungu Mwenye Nguvu.
Ekegusii: Abatigari, abwo bare b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, mbamoiranere Nyasae Omobui.

English: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.
Kiswahili: Ingawa watu wako, ee Israeli, ni wengi kama mchanga wa pwani, ni mabaki yao tu watakaorudi. Maangamizi yamekwisha amriwa, ni mengi tena ni haki.
Ekegusii: Nonya Abaisraeli bare abange buna omokenye ore nyancha, abatigari boka nabwo barairane. Ogosirigwa gwachikirwe ogokong’u nigo korache buna eooro kore noboronge.

English: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.
Kiswahili: Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, atatekeleza maangamizi yaliyoamriwa juu ya nchi yote.
Ekegusii: Omonene oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, narente ogosirigwa ase ense yonsi, buna achiikire.

English: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: “Enyi watu wangu mkaao Sayuni, msiwaogope Waashuru, wanaowapiga ninyi kwa fimbo na kuinua rungu dhidi yenu, kama Misri ilivyofanya.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, agoteeba: “Inwe abanto baane momenyete Sayoni, timoiroka Abaasuri nonya bakobaaka nenyimbo na koyeimokereria igoro, buna Abamisiri bakorete.

English: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”
Kiswahili: Bado kitambo kidogo sana hasira yangu dhidi yenu itakoma, na ghadhabu yangu itaelekezwa kwenye maangamizi yao.”
Ekegusii: Engaki enke yatigaire, endamwamu yane ase more eere, erio eonchoke gosiria Abaasuri.

English: Yahweh of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atawachapa kwa mjeledi, kama alivyowapiga Wamidiani katika mwamba wa Orebu, naye atainua fimbo yake juu ya maji, kama alivyofanya huko Misri.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ninyimokererie omocharichi one igoro, ’ng’wanie Abanto abwo buna nang’wanetie Abamidiani agwo ase egetare ki’Orebu. Ninyimokererie enyimbo yane igoro y’enyancha, buna nakorete igoro y’Abamisiri.

English: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo mzigo wao utainuliwa kutoka mabegani mwenu, na nira yao kutoka shingoni mwenu; nira itavunjwa kwa sababu ya kutiwa mafuta.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio chigurube Abaasuri babeegete ase amareko aino nchirusigweo, na amakorogoto babeegete ase amagoti aino nabunwe ase obonetu bwaino.”

English: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
Kiswahili: Wanaingia Ayathi, wanapita katikati ya Migroni, wanahifadhi mahitaji huko Mikmashi.
Ekegusii: Ababisa bachire Ayati, baetire ase egati ya Migironi; babeekire ebinto biabo ebirito aaria Mikimasi.

English: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.
Kiswahili: Wanavuka kivukoni, nao wanasema, “Tutapiga kambi huko Geba usiku kucha.” Rama inatetemeka; Gibea ya Sauli inakimbia.
Ekegusii: Baeteire ase ekiambokero, batoorire agwo Geba babere aroro ase obotuko obwo; abanto ba Rama babeire nobwoba, na Abagibea, omochie o Saulo, batamire.

English: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!
Kiswahili: Piga kelele, ee Binti Galimu! Sikiliza, ee Laisha! Maskini Anathothi!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Galimu, rera neriogi rinene! Inwe aba Laisa, tegerera moigwe! Obee! Inwe ab’Anatoti abaremerwa!

English: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
Kiswahili: Madmena inakimbia; watu wa Gebimu wanajificha.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Madimena nigo bagendererete gotama, na abamenyete Gebimu ngotama bare ase ogwetooria.

English: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya leo watasimama Nobu; watatikisa ngumi zao kwa mlima wa Binti Sayuni, kwa kilima cha Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Rituko erio ababisa mbabeere agwo Nobu, barambore amaboko abo na koyasungusia igoro y’egetunwa ki’abaanto ba Sayoni, ekio kere egetunwa kia Yerusalemu.

English: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.
Kiswahili: Tazama, Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, atayakata matawi kwa nguvu kuu. Miti mirefu sana itaangushwa, ile mirefu itashushwa chini.
Ekegusii: Rora, Omonene, oyore Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabutore chinsagia ne chinguru chi’okwoboyia; emete ere emetambe mono negechwe egwe inse, na eyechongororogete gochia igoro kegima nekumbwe gochia inse.

English: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
Kiswahili: Atakata vichaka vya msitu kwa shoka; Lebanoni itaanguka mbele zake yeye Mwenye Nguvu.
Ekegusii: Naimokie egesire agechere emete ye rinani rire rinoru, na Lebanoni amo nemete ereo neiyerigwe inse ne chinguru chi’Oyore Omobui.

English: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
Kiswahili: Chipukizi litatokea kutoka shina la Yese, kutoka mizizi yake Tawi litazaa tunda.
Ekegusii: Omoseboka norue ase ritina ria Yese riabutoretwe, na egesebo keramere korwa ase emeri yaye, nkiame amatunda.

English: Yahweh’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Roho wa Bwana atakaa juu yake, Roho wa hekima na wa ufahamu, Roho wa shauri na wa uweza, Roho wa maarifa na wa kumcha Bwana
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene nobeere igoro asare; omoika bw’obong’aini na okomanya, omoika bw’ogosemia na bw’okomanya; omoika bwe chisemi na okomoiroka bw’Omonene.

English: His delight will be in the fear of Yahweh. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;
Kiswahili: naye atafurahia kumcha Bwana. Hatahukumu kwa yale ayaonayo kwa macho yake, wala kuamua kwa yale ayasikiayo kwa masikio yake,
Ekegusii: Omogoko oye nobe ase okomoiroka Omonene. Ere takogaamba ebiina buna amaiso aye ararore, gose takonacha ebiina buna araigwe namato aye.

English: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.
Kiswahili: bali kwa uadilifu atahukumu wahitaji, kwa haki ataamua wanyenyekevu wa dunia. Ataipiga dunia kwa fimbo ya kinywa chake, kwa pumzi ya midomo yake atawaua waovu.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo arabae abataka oboronge bwabo ase okonacha ebiina, tagokora ogwanchereria ase abaitongo b’ense. Naake ense nenyimbo y’omonwa oye, naite abakori amabe n’Omoika bw’omonwa oye.

English: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.
Kiswahili: Haki itakuwa mkanda wake na uaminifu utakuwa mshipi kiunoni mwake.
Ekegusii: Oboronge nabwo borabe orokini rw’ekenema kiaye, na obwegenwa bobe orokini rw’okweboeria.

English: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.
Kiswahili: Mbwa mwitu ataishi pamoja na mwana-kondoo, naye chui atalala pamoja na mbuzi, ndama, mwana simba na ngʼombe wa mwaka mmoja watakaa pamoja, naye mtoto mdogo atawaongoza.
Ekegusii: Esese y’orosana nemenye amo nemaanwa y’eng’ondi, na engo neraare amo nemaanwa y’embori; emori, na endo, na eng’ombe enoru nachibe chikogosoria amo, na omwana omoke nabe ogochiraa.

English: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.
Kiswahili: Ngʼombe na dubu watalisha pamoja, watoto wao watalala pamoja, na simba atakula majani makavu kama maksai.
Ekegusii: Eng’ombe na edubu nchiriserie amo, emori y’eng’ombe na emaanwa y’edubu nchiraare amo. Endo neebe ekorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe.

English: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.
Kiswahili: Mtoto mchanga atacheza karibu na shimo la nyoka, naye mtoto mdogo ataweka mkono wake kwenye kiota cha fira.
Ekegusii: Omwana okogonka nabe okogosoria ase engoro ye rirubi, boigo omwana omotache nabe ogosoyia okoboko kwaye ase engoro ye ring’ere.

English: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.
Kiswahili: Hawatadhuru wala kuharibu juu ya mlima wangu mtakatifu wote, kwa kuwa dunia itajawa na kumjua Bwana kama maji yajazavyo bahari.
Ekegusii: Aase onsi ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, ayare amabe, gose ayagosiria tagokorekana aroro; ekiagera ense neichorwe nabaanto bamomanyete Omonene, buna amaache aichire ase enyancha.

English: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo, Shina la Yese atasimama kama bendera kwa ajili ya mataifa. Mataifa yatakusanyika kwake, na mahali pake pa kupumzikia patakuwa utukufu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Oyore Egesebo kie ritina ria Yese natenene abe ekemanyererio ase abanto; abanto b’ebisaku mbamorigie, na obomenyo bwaye mbobe nobonene obonge.

English: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo Bwana atanyoosha mkono wake mara ya pili kurudisha mabaki ya watu wake waliosalia kutoka Ashuru, Misri, Pathrosi, Kushi, Elamu, Babeli, Hamathi na kutoka visiwa vya baharini.
Ekegusii: Nebe ase engaki eyi’Omonene narambore okoboko kwaye eria kabere koirania abatigari b’abaanto baye korwa Asuri, na Misiri, na Patirosi, na Ethiopia, na Elamu, na Shinari, na Hamati, na korwa ase ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha.

English: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
Kiswahili: Atainua bendera kwa mataifa na kuwakusanya Waisraeli walioko uhamishoni; atawakusanya watu wa Yuda waliotawanyika kutoka pembe nne za dunia.
Ekegusii: Natenenie ekemanyererio ase abanto b’ebisaku, na asangererie Abaisraeli abwo baseretigwe, naende asangererie Abayuda bonsi besiarerete ase chinsinyo inye chi’ense.

English: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.
Kiswahili: Wivu wa Efraimu utatoweka, na adui wa Yuda watakatiliwa mbali; Efraimu hatamwonea Yuda wivu, wala Yuda hatakuwa na uadui na Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Ribero Abaefraimu babwate ndisire, na abwo bakwoboyia Abayuda mbasirigwe; Abaefraimu tibakogenderera koba ne ribero ase Abayuda, na Abayuda tibakogenderera kwoboyia Abaefraimu.

English: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.
Kiswahili: Watawashukia katika miteremko ya Wafilisti hadi upande wa magharibi, kwa pamoja watawateka watu nyara hadi upande wa mashariki. Watawapiga Edomu na Moabu, na Waamoni watatawaliwa nao.
Ekegusii: Abayuda na Abaefraimu mbaumokere Abafirisiti korwa ensemo ya bosongo, naende mbasakore abanto ba moocha. Erio barwanie Abaedomu na Abamoabu; Abaamoni mbabe bakoigwera.

English: Yahweh will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.
Kiswahili: Bwana atakausha ghuba ya bahari ya Misri; kwa upepo mkavu ataupeleka mkono wake juu ya Mto Frati. Ataugawanya katika vijito saba ili watu waweze kuuvuka wakiwa wamevaa viatu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nasarie kegima omosomo bw’Enyancha ya Misiri; nasungusie okoboko kwaye arente omwaga oguse igoro ase Orooche rwa Eufarati, erio arwatanane robe ebiambokero bitano na bibere, erinde abanto bambokere aroro buna ase ense enyomo.

English: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Itakuwepo njia kuu kwa mabaki ya watu wake wale waliosalia kutoka Ashuru, kama ilivyokuwa kwa Israeli walipopanda kutoka Misri.
Ekegusii: Enchera enene neroiserigwe abatigari b’abaanto baye abatoorigwe korwa Asuri. Enchera eyio neebe buna eria Abaisraeli baeterete kobakorua Misiri.

English: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile utasema: “Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana. Ingawa ulinikasirikia, hasira yako imegeukia mbali nawe umenifariji.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio noteebe: “Aye Omonene, ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, nonya kwarenge nendamwamu ase ’nde, bono endamwamu eyio yantigire, na aye kwandemirie.

English: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
Kiswahili: Hakika Mungu ni wokovu wangu; nitamtumaini wala sitaogopa. Bwana, Bwana, ni nguvu zangu na wimbo wangu; amekuwa wokovu wangu.”
Ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nere ogotooreka kwane; nimosemerie, tinkwoboa. Omonene nere chinguru chiane, ere nimoterere; ere obeire ogotooreka kwane.”

English: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
Kiswahili: Kwa furaha mtachota maji kutoka visima vya wokovu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mobuuche amaache korwa ase chinsoko chire nogotooreka, more nomogooko.

English: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo mtasema: “Mshukuruni Bwana, mliitie jina lake; julisheni miongoni mwa mataifa yale aliyoyafanya, tangazeni kuwa jina lake limetukuka.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria moteebe: Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, rangeria erieta riaye; raria ogokora kwaye ase egati y’ebisaku, raria ng’a erieta riaye nerinene mono.

English: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana, kwa kuwa ametenda mambo makuu, hili na lijulikane duniani kote.
Ekegusii: “Tera amatera ay’okomotogia Omonene, ekiagera okorire ayare amaya mono. Amang’ana ayio tiga amanyekane ase ense yonsi.

English: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
Kiswahili: Pazeni sauti mwimbe kwa furaha, watu wa Sayuni, kwa maana mkuu ni yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli miongoni mwenu.”
Ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete Sayoni, aka eriogi, motere nomogooko, ekiagera ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nigo are omonene ase egati yaino.”

English: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Babeli ambalo Isaya mwana wa Amozi aliliona:
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, aroche igoro ya Babiloni.

English: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
Kiswahili: Twekeni bendera juu ya mlima usio na kitu, wapazieni sauti, wapungieni mkono waingie katika malango ya wenye heshima.
Ekegusii: Tenenia ebendera igoro ase egetunwa getari na mete; aka eriogi rinene ase abasikari, basime namaboko basoe ase ebiita bi’abaanto abasike.

English: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.
Kiswahili: Nimewaamuru watakatifu wangu; nimewaita mashujaa wangu waitimize hasira yangu: wale wanaoshangilia ushindi wangu.
Ekegusii: Inche omonyene nachiikire aba neatananeire koba abachenu, narangeirie abanto baane bare chituoni baikeranie aya nachiikire ase endamwamu yane. Abanto abwo bagokerete obobui bwane.

English: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! Yahweh of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni kelele juu ya milima, kama ile ya umati mkubwa wa watu! Sikilizeni, makelele katikati ya falme, kama mataifa yanayokusanyika pamoja! Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote anakusanya jeshi kwa ajili ya vita.
Ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe amariogi ’emeganda y’abanto bakwoga igoro ase ebitunwa! Tegerera moigwe amariogi ay’ookong’ung’ura kw’amarwoti ’ebisaku asangererekanire amo. Omonene bw’Emeganda nkoroberia are emeganda y’esegi.

English: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even Yahweh, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
Kiswahili: Wanakuja kutoka nchi za mbali sana, kutoka miisho ya mbingu, Bwana na silaha za ghadhabu yake, kuangamiza nchi yote.
Ekegusii: Omonene ngocha are amo nebirwanero bi’endamwamu yaye korwa ense y’aare, ase chinsinyo chia igoro, erinde asirie ense yonsi.

English: Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
Kiswahili: Ombolezeni, kwa maana siku ya Bwana i karibu, itakuja kama uharibifu kutoka kwa Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Inwe rera nobororo, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene riabereire ang’e; nigo rirachiche buna ogosiria gokorwa ase Omonene Omobui.

English: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya hili, mikono yote italegea, moyo wa kila mtu utayeyuka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, amaboko ’abaanto bonsi nigo araborwe chinguru, ne chinkoro chiabo chirianyeke ase obwoba.

English: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.
Kiswahili: Hofu itawakamata, uchungu na maumivu makali yatawashika, watagaagaa kama mwanamke aliye na utungu wa kuzaa. Watatazamana kwa hofu kila mtu na mwenzake, nyuso zao zikiwaka kama moto.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbabe nobwoba obonene; inababe nomoichano na obororo. Ee, mbabe nobororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina agonkie, mbarigereranie bare nogokumia na omoichano na amaiso abo amwame ti.

English: Behold, the day of Yahweh comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
Kiswahili: Tazameni, siku ya Bwana inakuja, siku katili, yenye ghadhabu na hasira kali, kuifanya nchi kuwa ukiwa na kuwaangamiza wenye dhambi waliomo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Rora, rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ritindi ri’ekeririanda na endamwamu ekobera, ndisarie ense ebe bosa na gosiria kegima abanyabibe bamenyeteo.

English: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.
Kiswahili: Nyota za mbinguni na makundi ya nyota havitatoa mwanga wake. Jua linalochomoza litatiwa giza na mwezi hautatoa nuru yake.
Ekegusii: Ching’enang’eni chire igoro, na ebiombe biamwabo, tichikorua oborabu bwabo; erioba naribe omosunte ekero rigosoka mambia, na omotienyi tokobara.

English: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.
Kiswahili: Nitauadhibu ulimwengu kwa ajili ya uovu wake, waovu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao. Nitakomesha majivuno ya wenye kiburi, na nitakishusha kiburi cha watu wakatili.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene ning’ee ense egesusuro ase engencho y’obobe bwaye, na abanyabibe ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo. Ninsirie obomwenu bw’abwo bare abatindi, ninkeyie oboenenu bw’abaichire nobochege.

English: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya wanadamu kuwa adimu kuliko dhahabu safi, watakuwa wachache sana kuliko dhahabu ya Ofiri.
Ekegusii: Ninkore omobaro o Mwanyabaanto obe omoke kobua oyo bw’etaabu echenire, ee, omobaro obo nobe omoke kobua oyo bw’etaabu ekorwa Ofiri.

English: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitazifanya mbingu zitetemeke, nayo dunia itatikisika kutoka mahali pake katika ghadhabu ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, katika siku ya hasira yake iwakayo.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’ekeririanda kiane inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nintengechie igoro chionsi na inyegerie ense erue aase aye goetera ase endamwamu yane ekobera.

English: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.
Kiswahili: Kama swala awindwaye, kama kondoo wasio na mchungaji, kila mmoja atarudi kwa watu wake mwenyewe, kila mmoja atakimbilia nchi yake ya kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto nabe buna engabi egoserigwa, na buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia; kera oyomo nairane ase abanto baye, na kera oyomo natame gochia ase ense yaye.

English: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
Kiswahili: Yeyote atakayetekwa atapasuliwa tumbo, wote watakaokamatwa watauawa kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oranyorwe, nabetwe ritimo, na onde bwensi orabwatwe, naitwe n’omoro.

English: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
Kiswahili: Watoto wao wachanga watavunjwa vipande vipande mbele ya macho yao; nyumba zao zitatekwa na wake zao watatendwa jeuri.
Ekegusii: Abana babo ebing’werere mbasenyentwe ase amasio ’abaibori babo, chinyomba chiabo nchisakorwe, na abakungu babo mbakorerwe ay’obosooku.

English: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
Kiswahili: Tazama, nitawachochea Wamedi dhidi yao, ambao hawajali fedha wala hawafurahii dhahabu.
Ekegusii: Rora, inche Omonene ninseegete Abamedi abwo batabare chifeta ne chitaabu koba nengencho enene.

English: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.
Kiswahili: Mishale yao itawaangusha vijana, hawatakuwa na huruma kwa watoto wachanga wala hawataangalia watoto kwa huruma.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbaite abamura b’abwo ase okobabeta chinsara, tibakororera abana bare inda, gose abana bande, amaabera.

English: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
Kiswahili: Babeli, johari ya falme, utukufu wa kiburi cha Wababeli, itaangushwa na Mungu kama Sodoma na Gomora.
Ekegusii: Babiloni oyio ore obonene bw’amarwoti, na obwari na obonene bw’Abakalidayo, nobe buna Sodomu na Gomora, ekero Nyasae konya ayosaririe.

English: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.
Kiswahili: Hautakaliwa na watu kamwe wala watu hawataishi humo kwa vizazi vyote. Hakuna Mwarabu atakayepiga hema lake huko, hakuna mchungaji atakayepumzisha makundi yake huko.
Ekegusii: Babiloni tokomenywa nonya ng’ake nebiaare binde bionsi, nonya n’Omoarabu tagotenenia eema yaye agwo, gose abarisia tibakorenta ching’ondi ne chimbori chitimokereo.

English: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.
Kiswahili: Lakini viumbe wa jangwani watalala huko, mbweha watajaza nyumba zake, bundi wataishi humo nao mbuzi-mwitu watarukaruka humo.
Ekegusii: Ching’iti chi’orosana nchimenyeo, ne chinyakweumia nchiichore ase chinyomba chireo, chisagero nchibe chimenyeteo, na amarengari nabe akona‐gotenga aroro.

English: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.
Kiswahili: Fisi watalia ndani ya ngome zake, mbweha ndani ya majumba yake ya kifahari. Wakati wake umewadia, na siku zake hazitaongezwa.
Ekegusii: Chinyang’au nchibe chikwamuma ase emerobiri yabo, ne chisese chi’orosana nchibe chikorera ase chinyomba chiabo chi’obonene. Engaki yaye yaikire ang’e; amatuko aye tagotambeeigwa.

English: For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.
Kiswahili: Bwana atamhurumia Yakobo, atamchagua Israeli tena, na kuwakalisha katika nchi yao wenyewe. Wageni wataungana nao na kujiunga na nyumba ya Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Omonene narorere ororeeria rwa Yakobo amaabera, nachore Abaisraeli abwo naende, abarente bamenye ase ense yabo. Abanto abaao mbabwatane nab’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, bamenye amo nabarabwo.

English: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
Kiswahili: Mataifa watawachukua na kuwaleta mahali pao wenyewe. Nayo nyumba ya Israeli itamiliki mataifa kama watumishi na wajakazi katika nchi ya Bwana. Watawafanya watekaji wao kuwa mateka, na kutawala juu ya wale waliowaonea.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku binde mbikonye Abaisraeli koirana ase ense yabo, na Abaisraeli mbaabakore babe abasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, mbabe bakobakorera agwo ase ense y’Omonene. Abaisraeli mboose abwo baboosete kare, na bagambere abwo baarenge kobakorera bobe.

English: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
Kiswahili: Katika siku Bwana atakapokuondolea mateso, udhia na utumwa wa kikatili,
Ekegusii: Nebe ekero Omonene abaeire ogotimoka korwa ase emechando yaino, na obokong’u, na emeremo emekong’u mwarenge gokorigwa,

English: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”
Kiswahili: utaichukua dhihaka hii dhidi ya mfalme wa Babeli: Tazama jinsi mtesi alivyofikia mwisho! Tazama jinsi ghadhabu yake kali ilivyokoma!
Ekegusii: erio mokwane amang’ana aya y’ogochecheria omorwoti o Babiloni, moteebe: “Naki omochandi oria akirigwe! Obotindi bw’ogochandwa gwaito bwaerire!

English: Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
Kiswahili: Bwana amevunja fimbo ya mwovu, fimbo ya utawala ya watawala,
Ekegusii: Omonene obunire enyimbo y’abakori amabe, enyimbo eyio y’abagaambi,

English: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
Kiswahili: ambayo kwa hasira waliyapiga mataifa kwa mapigo yasiyo na kikomo, nao kwa ghadhabu kali waliwatiisha mataifa kwa jeuri pasipo huruma.
Ekegusii: abwo baagete abanto nendamwamu, na bakaba bakobaaka batari gotiga. Nigo bagamberete ebisaku nendamwamu, bakaba bakobichanda batari namaabera.

English: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.
Kiswahili: Nchi zote ziko kwenye mapumziko na kwenye amani, wanabubujika kwa kuimba.
Ekegusii: Bono ense engima nigo etimogete na gotoerera. Abanto bagokire na goteera.

English: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”
Kiswahili: Hata misunobari na mierezi ya Lebanoni inashangilia mbele yako na kusema, “Basi kwa sababu umeangushwa chini, hakuna mkata miti atakayekuja kutukata.”
Ekegusii: Nonya nemetarakwa nigo egokerete okobugwa kwao, na emecharake ya Lebanoni nigo egoteeba: Gese gwakaiyeretigwe inse, omotemi emete onde tana gotochera.

English: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
Kiswahili: Kuzimu kote kumetaharuki kukulaki unapokuja, kunaamsha roho za waliokufa ili kukupokea, wote waliokuwa viongozi katika ulimwengu, kunawafanya wainuke kwenye viti vyao vya kifalme: wale wote waliokuwa wafalme juu ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: “Aase abakuure abeire nomoegaego gocha gokorotota ekero okogenda aroro; emerengari y’abakuure yaturirwe ase engencho yao, ee, abwo bonsi baarenge abatang’ani b’ense. Abwo bonsi baarenge abarwoti b’ebisaku batenenigwe barue ase ebirogo biabo.

English: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”
Kiswahili: Wote wataitikia, watakuambia, “Wewe pia umekuwa dhaifu, kama sisi tulivyo; wewe umekuwa kama sisi.”
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi mbakwane, bagoteebie: Bono naye kwaurirwe chinguru buna intwe, gwatogwekanire.

English: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
Kiswahili: Majivuno yako yote yameshushwa mpaka kuzimu, pamoja na kelele ya vinubi vyako, mafunza yametanda chini yako, na minyoo imekufunika.
Ekegusii: Obonene bwao amo namariogi ’amakano ao biarentirwe aiga aase abakuure; ebinyegera nabio ekeraarero kiao na amakonde naro ekiebisio kiao.

English: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi ulivyoanguka kutoka mbinguni, ewe nyota ya asubuhi, mwana wa mapambazuko! Umetupwa chini duniani, wewe uliyepata kuangusha mataifa!
Ekegusii: “Aye eng’enang’eni ya mambia, omwana bw’ogokiamoka, naki kwagure korwa igoro! Aye oria kwaiyeretie ebisaku, naki gwatugutetwe gocha inse?

English: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!
Kiswahili: Ulisema moyoni mwako, “Nitapanda juu hadi mbinguni, nitakiinua kiti changu cha enzi juu ya nyota za Mungu, nitaketi nimetawazwa juu ya mlima wa kusanyiko, kwenye vimo vya juu sana vya Mlima Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nigo gwateebete ase enkoro yao ime: Inche nintiire gochia igoro aaria, ngende ng’etanie ching’enang’eni chia Nyasae, nimbeeke ekerogo kiane ki’obonene aaria igoro. Ning’ikaranse ase egetunwa ki’omosangererekano aaria sugusu aare.

English: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”
Kiswahili: Nitapaa juu kupita mawingu, nitajifanya kama Yeye Aliye Juu Sana.”
Ekegusii: Nintiire ngende ng’etanie amare are igoro mono, ninyekore imbe buna Oyore Igoro Mono.

English: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.
Kiswahili: Lakini umeshushwa chini hadi kuzimu, hadi kwenye vina vya shimo.
Ekegusii: Korende bono aye kwairirwe gochia aase abakuure ase engoro entambe.

English: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,
Kiswahili: Wale wanaokuona wanakukazia macho, wanatafakari hatima yako: “Je, huyu ndiye yule aliyetikisa dunia na kufanya falme zitetemeke,
Ekegusii: “Abanto abwo barakorore mbakorigererie baasamie emenwa yabo bakumie, mbabe bakorengereria igoro yao, bateebe: Inee! Omonto oyo nere oria otengechetie ense, oria onyegeretie amarwoti?

English: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
Kiswahili: yule aliyeifanya dunia kuwa jangwa, aliyeipindua miji yake, na ambaye hakuwaachia mateka wake waende nyumbani?”
Ekegusii: Nere oyio osaretie ense ekaba erooro, naende akaonchorana emechie y’ense, oria otarenge gosibora abasibwa baye bagende ase chinka chiabo?

English: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.
Kiswahili: Wafalme wote wa mataifa wamelala kwa heshima kila mmoja katika kaburi lake.
Ekegusii: “Abarwoti bonsi b’ebisaku nigo baraire nobonene bwabo, kera oyomo ase embeera yaye,

English: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe umetupwa nje ya kaburi lako kama tawi lililokataliwa, umefunikwa na waliouawa pamoja na wale waliochomwa kwa upanga, wale washukao mpaka kwenye mawe ya shimo. Kama mzoga uliokanyagwa chini ya nyayo,
Ekegusii: korende aye totindekiri; nigo otugutire buna orosagia rotanchiri. Nigo oraire ase egati y’abanto baitetwe nemioro, bagatugutwa ase chingoro chi’amagena buna ebitondo bigotachwa namagoro.

English: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.
Kiswahili: Hutajumuika nao kwenye mazishi, kwa kuwa umeharibu nchi yako na kuwaua watu wako. Mzao wa mwovu hatatajwa tena kamwe.
Ekegusii: Aye togotindekwa buna abarwoti bande, ekiagera gwasaririe ense yao, naende gwaitire abanto bao. Ororeria rw’abakori amabe tirogwatorwa nonya ng’ake.

English: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
Kiswahili: Andaa mahali pa kuwachinjia wanawe kwa ajili ya dhambi za baba zao, wasije wakainuka ili kuirithi nchi na kuijaza dunia kwa miji yao.
Ekegusii: Beka abanto ang’e, baite abamura b’omorwoti oyio; abana abwo nigo baraitwe ase engencho y’okomocha gwa chisokoro chiabo, tibaabaisa koimokerera igoro baire ense na koyeichoria nemechie.”

English: “I will rise up against them,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asema, “Nitainuka dhidi yao, nitalikatilia mbali jina lake kutoka Babeli pamoja na watu wake walionusurika, watoto wake na wazao wake,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Nimbaimokere, nsarie Babiloni kegima, ninsirie erieta riaye na abatigari bare aroro. Tingotiga abana aroro gose abachokoro. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nateebire ayio.

English: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: “Nitaifanya kuwa mahali pa bundi, na kuwa nchi ya matope; nitaifagia kwa ufagio wa maangamizi,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Ninkore Babiloni obe obomenyo bw’ebirongo, naende obe ne chitente chi’amaache. Ninyoabusere ekiabuso ki’ogosiria. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nateebire ayio.”

English: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ameapa, “Hakika, kama vile nilivyopanga, ndivyo itakavyokuwa, nami kama nilivyokusudia, ndivyo itakavyosimama.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda otianire, ogoteeba, “Ekeene, buna narobeirie, nabo arabe, na buna nachiikire, goika aikerane.

English: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
Kiswahili: Nitamponda Mwashuru katika nchi yangu, juu ya milima yangu nitawakanyagia chini. Nira yake itaondolewa kutoka kwa watu wangu, nao mzigo wake utaondolewa kutoka mabegani mwao.”
Ekegusii: Ninsenyente Abaasuri aiga ase ense yane, nimbatiri-tiringere inse agwo ase ebitunwa biane. Ase enchera eyio amakorogoto abo narusigwe ase amagoti ’Abaisraeli, n’echigurube chiabo chirusigwe ase amareko abo.”

English: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mpango uliokusudiwa kwa ajili ya ulimwengu wote, huu ni mkono ulionyooshwa juu ya mataifa yote.
Ekegusii: Aya naro achikirwe igoro y’ense yonsi, na oko nakwo okoboko koramboire igoro ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

English: For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amekusudia, ni nani awezaye kumzuia? Mkono wake umenyooshwa, ni nani awezaye kuurudisha?
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda ochikiire gokora amang’ana ayio, ning’o oranyare koyatanga taba? Oramboire okoboko kwaye, ning’o oranyare gokoringa?

English: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.
Kiswahili: Neno hili lilikuja mwaka ule Mfalme Ahazi alipofariki:
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria Ahasi omorwoti akwete, amang’ana aya naro araaretigwe.

English: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
Kiswahili: Msifurahi, enyi Wafilisti wote, kwamba fimbo iliyowapiga imevunjika; kutoka mzizi wa huyo nyoka atachipuka nyoka mwenye sumu kali, uzao wake utakuwa joka lirukalo, lenye sumu kali.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abafirisiti mwensi, timobaisa kogoka ng’a enyimbo eria yabaagete yabunirwe; korwa ase ritina ri’eng’iti eria ende ere nobosongo obotindi nesoke, na korwa ase eyio enchoka ekoiruruka netuboke.

English: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.
Kiswahili: Maskini kuliko maskini wote watapata malisho, nao wahitaji watalala salama. Lakini mzizi wako nitauangamiza kwa njaa, nayo njaa itawaua walionusurika.
Ekegusii: Abare abataka mono mbaragerigwe, na abaremeire bamenye n’obotoereru. Korende abare ritina riaino mbaite nenchara, na abatigari baino nimbaite.

English: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
Kiswahili: Piga yowe, ee lango! Bweka, ee mji! Yeyukeni, enyi Wafilisti wote! Wingu la moshi linakuja toka kaskazini, wala hakuna atakayechelewa katika safu zake.
Ekegusii: Aye egeita, eumie! Aye omochie, rera! Inwe Abafirisiti mwensi, ichana ase obwoba! Erioki nkorwa rire sugusu, na ase egati yabo onde tari oranyorwe.

English: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.
Kiswahili: Ni jibu gani litakalotolewa kwa wajumbe wa taifa hilo? “Bwana ameifanya imara Sayuni, nako ndani yake watu wake walioonewa watapata kimbilio.”
Ekegusii: Mang’ana ki omonto arabairanerie abatomwa b’egesaku keria? Obairanerie ng’a Omonene obekire oboroso bwa Sayoni, na abanto baye abachandire mbanyore obotamero aroro.

English: The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Moabu: Ari iliyo Moabu imeangamizwa: imeharibiwa kwa usiku mmoja! Kiri iliyo Moabu imeangamizwa, imeharibiwa kwa usiku mmoja!
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana y’ogokumia igoro y’ense ya Moabu. Ekiagera Ari o Moabu nosarigwe ase obotuko obomo, nosirigwe kegima! Ee, ekiagera na Kiri o Moabu osarigwe ase obotuko obomo, osirigwe kegima!

English: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.
Kiswahili: Diboni anakwea hadi kwenye hekalu lake, mpaka mahali pake pa juu ili walie, Moabu anaombolezea Nebo na Medeba. Kila kichwa kimenyolewa na kila ndevu limeondolewa.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Diboni batiirire gochia aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, barereo. Nigo bakweumia ase engencho ya Nebo na Medeba; kera omonto okiigitire etukia yaye, ogingire ne chinderu.

English: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.
Kiswahili: Wamevaa nguo za magunia barabarani, juu ya mapaa na kwenye viwanja wote wanaomboleza, wamelala kifudifudi kwa kulia.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo beboyetie chigunia baichanete agwo ase chinchera, abande nigo bariinete ebirama igoro, na abande bare ase ebiraario; kera omonto nigo akweumia na koiyeria amariga.

English: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.
Kiswahili: Heshboni na Eleale wanalia, sauti zao zinasikika hadi Yahazi. Kwa hiyo watu wenye silaha wa Moabu wanapiga kelele, nayo mioyo yao imezimia.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Hesiboni na Eleale nigo bakorera neriogi rinene. Eriogi riabo nigo rikoigweka goikera Yahasi. Ase ayio abasikari ba Moabu bakorera neriogi rinene; chinkoro chiabo chiaondokire.

English: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu unamlilia Moabu; wakimbizi wake wanakimbilia Soari, hadi Eglath-Shelishiya. Wanapanda njia ya kwenda Luhithi, wanakwenda huku wanalia; barabarani iendayo Horonaimu wanaombolezea maangamizi yao.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane nkoreera ere ense ya Moabu. Abanto baye ngotamera bare Soari na Egilati‐Selisia; nigo bagotiira gochia Luhiti bakorera. Nigo bagoaka amariogi ay’okorera kw’ogosirigwa agwo ase enchera ekogenda Horonaimu.

English: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.
Kiswahili: Maji ya Nimrimu yamekauka na majani yamenyauka; mimea imekauka wala hakuna kitu chochote kibichi kilichobaki.
Ekegusii: Orooche rwa Nimurimu rwakamire amaache; obonyansi bwomire, na bonde tibori komera, ekemeri kende ekebese tikeri aroro.

English: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mali waliyoipata na kujiwekea akiba wamezichukua na kuvuka Bonde la Mierebi.
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebinge konya benyoreire, ne chinibo chionsi babeire bagachete mbabibogorie bamboke nabirobio ase Orooche rw’Emesobeti.

English: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.
Kiswahili: Mwangwi wa kilio chao umefika hadi mpakani mwa Moabu, kilio chao cha huzuni kimefika hadi Eglaimu, maombolezo yao hadi Beer-Elimu.
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’okorera kwabo riaichoire ase ense ya Moabu; ekerero ekio giaikire Egilaimu na Beeri‐Elimu.

English: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.
Kiswahili: Maji ya Dimoni yamejaa damu, lakini bado nitaleta pigo jingine juu ya Dimoni: simba juu ya wakimbizi wa Moabu na juu ya wale wanaobaki katika nchi.
Ekegusii: Nonya nechindooche chia Dimoni chiaichoire namanyinga, ningenderere korenta amabe ande ase Dimoni. Nindete endo eite Abamoabu, abwo bagotama na abwo batigarete ase ense yabo.

English: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
Kiswahili: Pelekeni wana-kondoo kama ushuru kwa mtawala wa nchi, Kutoka Sela, kupitia jangwani, hadi mlima wa Binti Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Tomera omogambi bw’ense ebango y’echimanwa chi’eching’ondi korwa ase omochie o Sela, goetera ase erooro, gochia ase egetunwa ki’omoiseke o Sayoni.

English: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
Kiswahili: Kama ndege wanaopapatika waliofukuzwa kutoka kwenye kiota, ndivyo walivyo wanawake wa Moabu kwenye vivuko vya Arnoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’emechie ya Moabu mbabe bakonakoong’anya gochia ase chingegu chi’orooche rw’Arinoni, babe buna chinyoni chikoiruruka chiaserigwe korwa ase ebiswa biabo.

English: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!
Kiswahili: “Tupeni shauri, toeni uamuzi. Wakati wa adhuhuri, fanyeni kivuli chenu kama usiku. Waficheni watoro, msisaliti wakimbizi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: “Tosemie, tokorere ay’oboronge, tokendererie inse y’ekiriri kiaino mobaso gati. Tobise intwe abatwaserigwe, timobaisa gotorua intwe abatwatamire.

English: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.
Kiswahili: Waacheni watoro wa Moabu wakae pamoja nanyi; kuweni mahali pao pa salama ili kuepuka mharabu.” Mtesi atafikia mwisho na maangamizi yatakoma, aletaye vita atatoweka kutoka nchi.
Ekegusii: Tiga Abamoabu, abanto baito, abwo baserigwe bamenye amo nainwe; kabe obotamero bwabo korwa ase abwo bakogania kobasiria, goika abachandi babo babe basirire, na abwo baarenge kobatiringera inse babe basirigwe korwa ase ense eyio.

English: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.
Kiswahili: Kwa upendo kiti cha enzi kitaimarishwa, kwa uaminifu mtu ataketi juu yake, yeye atokaye nyumba ya Daudi: yeye ambaye katika kuhukumu hutafuta haki, na huhimiza njia ya haki.
Ekegusii: Erio ekerogo ki’obonene ngetenenigwe ase obwanchani bogendererete botambe. Oyomo ore omwegenwa naikaransere ekerogo ekio, oyomo korwa ase obomenyo bwa Daudi. Ere nabe okogaamba ase ekeene, na gokora ayare ay’oboronge.”

English: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.
Kiswahili: Tumesikia juu ya kiburi cha Moabu: kiburi chake cha kujivuna na udanganyifu, kiburi chake na ufidhuli wake, lakini majivuno yake si kitu.
Ekegusii: Twaigure buna Abamoabu bare abetogia, barabwo nigo bare aberori mono, na abamwenu, na abaenenu, na abanyandamwamu, korende ogwetogia kwabo nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.

English: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Wamoabu wanaomboleza, wanaiombolezea Moabu kwa pamoja. Wanaomboleza na kuhuzunika kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-Haresethi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abamoabu mbarere; kera omonto tiga areere ense ya Moabu. Eng’ererie moichane, ekiagera mwaborirwe amabomba ’amasabibu amomo akwama Kiri‐Hareseti.

English: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.
Kiswahili: Mashamba ya Heshboni yananyauka, pia na mizabibu ya Sibma. Watawala wa mataifa wamekanyaga mizabibu iliyo mizuri sana, ambayo ilipata kufika Yazeri na kuenea kuelekea jangwani. Machipukizi yake yalienea yakafika hadi baharini.
Ekegusii: Emegondo ere Hesiboni yasusanire amo nemesabibu ere Sibuma. Abaanene b’ebisaku babutoire chinsagia chi’emesabibu, echio chiarandete chigaika Yaeseri, na chikagenderera goika ase erooro. Emerande yaye nigo yarandete, ekaamboka enyancha.

English: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ninalia kama Yazeri aliavyo, kwa ajili ya mizabibu ya Sibma. Ee Heshboni, ee Eleale, ninakulowesha kwa machozi! Kelele za furaha kwa ajili ya tunda lako lililoiva na kwa ajili ya mavuno zimekomeshwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nkorera ase engencho y’emesabibu ya Sibuma, buna aba Yaeseri bakoyereera. Inwe Abahesiboni na ab’Eleale, nigo nkobaiyereria amariga amange, ekiagera ekero mogotora amatunda na kogesa endagera, eriogi ri’esegi riabachera.

English: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.
Kiswahili: Furaha na shangwe zimeondolewa kutoka mashamba ya matunda; hakuna yeyote aimbaye wala apazaye sauti katika mashamba ya mizabibu; hakuna yeyote akanyagaye zabibu shinikizoni, kwa kuwa nimekomesha makelele.
Ekegusii: Omogoko na omochengo biasirigwe korwa ase emegondo ekwama mono; bono amatera tari goterwa ase emegondo y’emesabibu, amariogi ’omogooko tari goakwa aroro; monto onde tari okomita amasabibu ase ebiteera bi’okomitera aroisie edivai. Nasiririe amariogi ’omochengo e rigesa.

English: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu unaomboleza kwa ajili ya Moabu kama kinubi, nafsi yangu yote kwa ajili ya Kir-Haresethi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, enkoro yane nigo ekoreera Abamoabu neriogi buna eri’obokano, nkoreera nde aba Kiri‐Heresi ase omoyo one ime.

English: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.
Kiswahili: Wakati Moabu anapojitokeza mahali pake pa juu, anajichosha mwenyewe tu; anapokwenda mahali pake pa kuabudia miungu ili kuomba, haitamfaidi lolote.
Ekegusii: Nonya Abamoabu bagwechanda na kwerosia gotiira gochia aase aimokererete igoro bagosasiima, gose babe bakogenda ase chie Hekalu chiabo gosaba, tibakonyara konyora ogokonywa konde gwonsi.

English: This is the word that Yahweh spoke concerning Moab in time past.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo neno ambalo Bwana ameshasema kuhusu Moabu.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana erio nario Omonene akwanete igoro y’ense ya Moabu agwo kare.

English: But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa Bwana anasema: “Katika miaka mitatu, kama vile mtumishi aliyefungwa na mkataba angeihesabu, fahari ya Moabu na watu wake wengi watadharauliwa, nao walionusurika watakuwa wachache sana, tena wanyonge.”
Ekegusii: Korende bono Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase engaki y’emiaka etato, emiaka buna ey’omorikwa emeremo, nonyore ng’a obonene bw’Abamoabu bwachayirwe amo nemeganda yabo emenene boigo. Abatigari babo nigo barabe abake mono abataisanere gento kende.”

English: The burden of Damascus. “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Dameski: “Tazama, Dameski haitakuwa tena mji bali itakuwa lundo la magofu.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Damesiki: “Naama! Damesiki tokogenderera koba omochie; nosarigwe, otumbwe amo obe ebinge.

English: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.
Kiswahili: Miji ya Aroeri itaachwa na itaachiwa mifugo ambayo italala huko, bila yeyote wa kuyaogopesha.
Ekegusii: Emechie y’Aroeri neng’anywe etigwe ere bosa. Nigo eraabe amarisio. Chitugo nchibe chikorara aroro, na onde tari orachioboyie.

English: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Mji wenye ngome utatoweka kutoka Efraimu, nao uweza wa ufalme kutoka Dameski; mabaki ya Aramu yatakuwa kama utukufu wa Waisraeli,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Chiburi chi’Efraimu nchisarigwe kegima, na oborwoti bwa Damesiki mbosirigwe; na abatigari b’Abasiiria mbaurwe obonene bwabo buna Abaisraeli bauretwe.

English: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.
Kiswahili: “Katika siku ile utukufu wa Yakobo utafifia, unono wa mwili wake utadhoofika.
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eyio obonene bw’abaanto ba Yakobo mbokeeigwe kegima, na obonetu bw’emebere yabo mboree.

English: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.
Kiswahili: Itakuwa kama mvunaji akusanyavyo nafaka na kuvuna nafaka kwa mikono yake, kama wakati mtu aokotapo masazo ya masuke katika Bonde la Warefai.
Ekegusii: Nigo eraabe buna ekero omogesi akogesa namaboko aye ebigara bi’endagera eteneine, na buna ekero omonto agochora ebigara bi’endagera ase ense omweremu y’Abarefai.

English: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says Yahweh, the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo baadhi ya masazo yatabaki, kama vile mti wa mzeituni unavyopigwa, kukiachwa zeituni mbili au tatu juu ya matawi kileleni, nne au tano katika matawi yazaayo sana,” asema Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ee, abanto abake mono mbatigareo, banga buna ekero omote bw’emezeituni okonyegerigwa, amazeituni abere, gose atato, atigare ase omote igoro, na ane, gose atano, atigare ase chinsagia. Nab’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba.”

English: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile watu watamwangalia Muumba wao, na kuelekeza macho yao kwa yule Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto mbarigie ogokonywa korwa ase Omotongi obo, mbabe namasikani ase Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.
Kiswahili: Hawataziangalia tena madhabahu, kazi za mikono yao, nao hawataheshimu nguzo za Ashera, na madhabahu za kufukizia uvumba zilizofanywa kwa mikono yao.
Ekegusii: Tibagosemeria ebisasimero ebire emeremo y’amaboko abo, gose tibakorigereria emete eteneneirie Asera, enyasae yabo enkuungu, gose ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani, ebi baroisirie nebiara biabo.

English: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile miji yao iliyo imara, ambayo waliihama kwa sababu ya Waisraeli, itakuwa kama mahali palipoachwa pa vichaka na magugu. Nayo yote itakuwa ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio emechie yabo egiteire chindwaki neebe buna amatombe are ase amanani na ase ebitunwa igoro, ayio atigetwe ekero Abaisraeli bachete aroro. Emechie eyio nesarigwe etigare ere bosa.

English: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.
Kiswahili: Mmemsahau Mungu Mwokozi wenu, hamkumkumbuka Mwamba aliye ngome yenu. Kwa hiyo, hata ingawa mlipandikiza mimea iliyo mizuri sana na kuotesha mizabibu ya kigeni,
Ekegusii: Inwe mwebire Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwaino, na timori koinyora Egetare kere obotamero bwaino. Ase ayio nigo mokoroisia emegondo emiya, mwasimeka emesabibu emiegarori.

English: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
Kiswahili: hata kama siku ile unapoipandikiza, unaifanya iote na asubuhi ile ile unayoipanda, unaifanya ichipue, hata hivyo mavuno yatakuwa kama si kitu katika siku ile ya ugonjwa na maumivu yasiyoponyeka.
Ekegusii: Nonya y’are koba ng’a ase rituko erio okoyesimeka noyegitere orobago, na mambia yaye esiche, okwama kwaye nigo korasirigwe ekero rituko ri’emechando rirache, rire nobororo botari gokwaneka.

English: Ah, the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!
Kiswahili: Lo! Ghadhabu ya mataifa mengi, wanaghadhibika kama bahari iliyochafuka! Lo! Makelele ya mataifa wanavuma kama ngurumo za maji mengi!
Ekegusii: Obee! Okwogana okwo kw’abaanto abange nogwa ki? Nigo bakwogana buna amaache ’enyancha. Okong’ung’ura okwo kw’ebisaku nogwa ki? Nigo baokong’ung’ura buna amaache are ne chinguru.

English: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.
Kiswahili: Ingawa mataifa yanavuma kama ngurumo za maji yanayofanya mawimbi, wakati anapoyakemea yanakimbia mbali, yanafukuzwa mbele ya upepo kama makapi juu ya milima, kama jani livingirishwapo na dhoruba.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku nigo baokong’ung’ura buna amaache amange, korende Omonene nabatogonyere, nabarabwo batame gochia aare: mbaserigwe, babe buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga igoro ase ebitunwa, na buna orotu rokoirurukigwa nekembugu‐mbugu.

English: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa jioni, hofu ya ghafula! Kabla ya asubuhi, wametoweka! Hili ndilo fungu la wale wanaotupora, fungu la wale wanaotunyangʼanya mali zetu.
Ekegusii: Ekero kia mogoroba, rora, obwoba mboreo, na mambia botarakiamoka, abakwoboyia tibaiyo. Eke nakio egetari ki’abachandi baito, abwo bagotosakora.

English: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;
Kiswahili: Ole kwa nchi ya mvumo wa mabawa, kando ya mito ya Kushi,
Ekegusii: Obobe nobw’ense eyio ogoakanigwa gwe chimbaaba gokoigweka, ense ere ng’umbu ye chindooche chi’Ethiopia,

English: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”
Kiswahili: iwapelekayo wajumbe wake kwa njia ya bahari kwa mashua za mafunjo juu ya maji. Nendeni, wajumbe wepesi, kwa taifa la watu warefu wenye ngozi nyororo, kwa taifa linaloogopwa mbali na karibu, taifa gomvi lenye lugha ngeni, ambalo nchi yao imegawanywa kwa mito.
Ekegusii: eyio egotoma abatomwa goetera ase orooche rwa Naeli bariinete amaato aroisirie korwa ase amauncho! Inwe abatomwa more abaango, genda ase abanto b’egesaku bare abatambe babwate emebere emeterere ekomeka‐meka, bairokire nabaanto bare ang’e, na abare aare. Egesaku ekio nigo kere ne chinguru, naende gekona‐kobua, na ense yabo chindooche chinachete.

English: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!
Kiswahili: Enyi mataifa yote ya ulimwengu, ninyi mnaoishi duniani wakati bendera itakapoinuliwa milimani, mtaiona, nayo tarumbeta itakapolia, mtaisikia.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwensi ababiare b’ense, inwe abamomenyeteo, ekero ebendera ekoimokererigwa ase egetunwa igoro, morigererie! Ekero egetureeri gekobugigwa, motegerere!

English: For Yahweh said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana aliloniambia: “Nitatulia kimya na kutazama kutoka maskani yangu, kama joto linalometameta katika mwanga wa jua, kama wingu la umande katika joto la wakati wa mavuno.”
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene antebetie: “Nintegerere korwa aiga ase obomenyo bwane inde n’obotoereru, imoreke buna amasase ’erioba akomoreka. Nigo ndabe buna riire rigotonya riime ase engaki y’omobaso omoororo bwe rigesa.”

English: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kabla ya mavuno, wakati wa kuchanua ukishapita na maua yakawa zabibu zinazoiva, atayakata machipukizi kwa mundu wa kupogolea matawi, naye atakata na kuyaondoa matawi yaliyopanuka.
Ekegusii: Ekero chindagera chiakoorire gosicha ne rigesa ritaraika, na amasabibu achakire kwama, Omonene nasose chinsagia nomoyio enkuro, na ebisebo bigokina abirusieo.

English: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.
Kiswahili: Yote yataachwa kwa ajili ya ndege wawindao wa mlimani na wanyama pori, ndege watajilisha juu yake wakati wote wa kiangazi, nao wanyama pori wakati wote wa masika.
Ekegusii: Chinsagia echio chionsi nchitigerwe chinyoni chi’ebitunwa ne ching’iti chi’ense. Chinyoni chintindi nchimenyeo ase engaki y’eguragura, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’ense ase engaki y’eteigo.

English: In that time, a present will be brought to Yahweh of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of Yahweh of Armies, Mount Zion.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo matoleo yataletwa kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote kutoka kwa taifa la watu warefu wenye ngozi nyororo, kutoka kwa taifa linaloogopwa mbali na karibu, kutoka taifa gomvi lenye lugha ngeni, ambalo nchi yao imegawanywa kwa mito, matoleo yataletwa katika Mlima Sayuni, mahali pa Jina la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene bw’Emeganda narenterwe ebiegwa nabaanto abwo bare abatambe babwate emebere emeterere ekomeka‐meka, abwo bairokire nabaanto bare ang’e na abare aare. Egesaku ekio nigo kere ne chinguru, naende nigo gekona‐kobua, na ense yabo nigo ere ne chindooche chinyinge. Ebiegwa ebio nigo biraarentwe ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, agwo ase erieta ri’Omonene rimenyete.

English: The burden of Egypt. “Behold, Yahweh rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt within it.
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Misri: Tazama, Bwana amepanda juu ya wingu liendalo kwa haraka naye anakuja Misri. Sanamu za Misri zinatetemeka mbele yake, nayo mioyo ya Wamisri inayeyuka ndani yao.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Misiri. Rora, Omonene nigo ariinete riire rikominyoka bwango ogocha Misiri. Erio agwo emegwekano egosasimwa y’Abamisiri nenyegerigwe ase obosio bwaye, ne chinkoro chi’Abamisiri nigo chirairianyeke.

English: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
Kiswahili: “Nitamchochea Mmisri dhidi ya Mmisri, ndugu atapigana dhidi ya ndugu, jirani dhidi ya jirani, mji dhidi ya mji, ufalme dhidi ya ufalme.
Ekegusii: “Inche Omonene ninseegete Abamisiri baitane boka abanyene; kera omonto nigo ararwane noyomwabo, na kera omoamate arwane nomoamate omwabo. Ninseegete abanto b’omochie oyomo barwane nab’omochie onde, na oborwoti borwane noborwoti bonde.

English: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.
Kiswahili: Wamisri watakufa moyo, na nitaibatilisha mipango yao. Watatafuta ushauri kwa sanamu na kwa roho za waliokufa, kwa waaguzi na kwa wale waongeao na mizimu.
Ekegusii: Nindusie omoika bw’Abamisiri orue ase bare, ninsarie emeroberio yabo; barabwo mbabe bakogenda korigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emegwekano egosasimwa, na korwa ase abaragori, na korwa ase abwo bakorangeria emeika y’abakuure, na korwa ase abarogi.

English: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Nitawatia Wamisri mikononi mwa bwana mkatili na mfalme mkali atatawala juu yao,” asema Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Nimbeeke Abamisiri ase amaboko ’omonene ore omotindi; omorwoti bw’okobaondokia nabagambere.” Nab’Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, atebiire.

English: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.
Kiswahili: Maji ya mito yatakauka, chini ya mto kutakauka kwa jua.
Ekegusii: Amache ’orooche rwa Naeli nakame pi, na orooche orwo ndokame kegima.

English: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.
Kiswahili: Mifereji itanuka; vijito vya Misri vitapungua na kukauka. Mafunjo na nyasi vitanyauka,
Ekegusii: Chindooche chigochiao nigo chiragunde chitioke, na amaache ’emetaro agwo Misiri nakee aere; ebitonto na amauncho mbiome.

English: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.
Kiswahili: pia mimea iliyoko kando ya Mto Naili, pale mto unapomwaga maji baharini. Kila shamba lililopandwa kando ya Mto Naili litakauka, litapeperushwa na kutoweka kabisa.
Ekegusii: Amaranya amo nemegondo ere mbarabare y’orooche rwa Naeli mbiome bisareke kegima.

English: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.
Kiswahili: Wavuvi watalia na kuomboleza, wale wote watupao ndoano katika Mto Naili, watadhoofika kwa majonzi.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakoruba ne chindobio ase orooche rwa Naeli mbarere na kobokia amagombo, na abwo bakoruta ebionga aroro mbaumate.

English: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.
Kiswahili: Wale watu wafanyao kazi ya kitani kilichochambuliwa watakata tamaa, wafumaji wa kitani safi watavunjika moyo.
Ekegusii: Abwo bakoroisia chiusi chi’egatani, na abakoroisia ebitambaa bi’ebamba, mberusie moyo.

English: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.
Kiswahili: Wafanyao kazi ya kufuma nguo watahuzunishwa, nao vibarua wataugua moyoni.
Ekegusii: Abwo bare chisiiro chi’abaanto b’ense mbasenyentwe, na bonsi abarikire gokora emeremo mbaichane.

English: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa Soani ni wapumbavu kabisa, washauri wa Farao wenye busara wanatoa ushauri wa kijinga. Unawezaje kumwambia Farao, “Mimi ni mmojawapo wa watu wenye hekima, mwanafunzi wa wafalme wa zamani”?
Ekegusii: Abagaambi ba Soani nigo bare abariri kegima; na abasemia abang’aini ba Farao nigo bagosemia ay’oboriri. Naki moranyare goteebia Farao: “Intwe nabana b’abaanto abang’aini, abana b’abarwoti abakoro?”

English: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what Yahweh of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.
Kiswahili: Wako wapi sasa watu wako wenye hekima? Wao wakuonyeshe na kukufahamisha ni nini Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amepanga dhidi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Ng’ai abanto bao abang’aini bare? Onye bareo, tiga bagoteebie na gokomanyia ay’Omonene bw’Emeganda arobeirie igoro ya Misiri.

English: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa Soani wamekuwa wapumbavu, viongozi wa Memfisi wamedanganyika, walio mawe ya pembe ya taifa lake wameipotosha Misri.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi ba Soani babeire abariri, na aba Memifisi bang’ainirwe. Abwo bare buna amagena e chikoona ase ebisaku biabo batantanirie ense ya Misiri.

English: Yahweh has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.
Kiswahili: Bwana amewamwagia roho ya kizunguzungu; wanaifanya Misri iyumbayumbe katika yale yote inayoyafanya, kama vile mlevi ayumbayumbavyo katika kutapika kwake.
Ekegusii: Omonene obekire omoika bw’obotantanu ase egati y’abanto b’aroro, nabarabwo bakorire ense ya Misiri yatindire ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi, nigo ekogaragara, buna omonto otindire okwegaragaria ase amaroki aye.

English: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.
Kiswahili: Misri haiwezi kufanya kitu chochote, cha kichwa wala cha mkia, cha tawi la mtende wala cha tete.
Ekegusii: Ense ya Misiri tegosesenigwa ase ogokora konde gwonsi, kobe ogokora kw’omotwe gose ogw’ekemincha, okw’orosagia rw’omokendo gose orw’egetonto.

English: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of Yahweh of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile Wamisri watakuwa kama wanawake. Watatetemeka kwa hofu mbele ya mkono wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote anaoinua dhidi yao.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abamisiri mbabe buna abakungu, baiguswe bare nobwoba ase obosio Omonene bw’Emeganda, ekero ararambore okoboko kwaye agosungusie igoro yabo.

English: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of Yahweh of Armies, which he determines against it.
Kiswahili: Nayo nchi ya Yuda itawatia hofu Wamisri, kila mmoja atakayetajiwa Yuda ataingiwa na hofu, kwa sababu ya kile ambacho Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote anapanga dhidi yao.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri mbabe bakoiroka abanto b’ense y’Abayuda; ekero Omomisiri araigwe ense y’Abayuda egwatorwa nabe nobwoba obonene, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda okorire omooroberio ore mamincha y’Abamisiri.

English: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo miji mitano ya Misri, itazungumza lugha ya Kanaani, na kuapa kumtii Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. Mji mmojawapo utaitwa Mji wa Uharibifu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto b’emechie etano y’ense ya Misiri mbabe bagokwana omonwa bw’Abakanaani, naende babe bakobwatana n’Omonene bw’Emeganda na gotiana ase erieta riaye. Oyomo bw’emechie eyio nigo orarokwe Omochie bw’Erioba.

English: In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo patakuwepo madhabahu ya Bwana katikati ya Misri na mnara wa kumbukumbu kwa Bwana kwenye mpaka wa Misri.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio egesasiimero nkeagacherwe Omonene agwo ase egatigati ya Misiri, boigo rigena rire buna esiiro nditenenerigwe Omonene agwo ase ribebe ri’ense eyio.

English: It will be for a sign and for a witness to Yahweh of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to Yahweh because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.
Kiswahili: Itakuwa alama na ushahidi kwa ajili ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote katika nchi ya Misri. Watakapomlilia Bwana kwa sababu ya watesi wao, Mungu atawapelekea mwokozi na mtetezi, naye atawaokoa.
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebio mbibe ekemanyererio na kirori ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, agwo ase ense ya Misiri. Ekero abanto ba Misiri barabe bakorera ase Omonene kobagokorerwa bobe, ere nabatomere omotooria abarwanerere abatoorie.

English: Yahweh will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know Yahweh in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to Yahweh, and will perform it.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Bwana atajijulisha mwenyewe kwa Wamisri, nao katika siku hiyo watamkubali Bwana. Wataabudu kwa kumtolea dhabihu na sadaka za nafaka, watamwekea Bwana nadhiri na kuzitimiza.
Ekegusii: Omonene nemanyekanie ase Abamisiri; na Abamisiri mbabe bakomomany’Omonene ase amatuko ayio. Mbabe bakomosasiima na komoruera ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, naende mbabe bakoriera Omonene chiira na gochiikerania.

English: Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataipiga Misri kwa tauni; atawapiga na kuwaponya. Watamgeukia Bwana, naye atayasikia maombi yao na kuwaponya.
Ekegusii: Omonene naake ense ya Misiri, nayeake na koyegwenia, na abanto b’aroro mbamoiranere Omonene, ere naigwe ogosaba kwabo abagwenie.

English: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo kutakuwepo na njia kuu kutoka Misri hadi Ashuru. Waashuru watakwenda Misri, na Wamisri watakwenda Ashuru. Wamisri na Waashuru wataabudu pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio enchera enene neebeo ekorwa Misiri goika Asuri. Abaasuri mbabe bakogenda Misiri, na Abamisiri babe bakogenda Asuri; Abamisiri na Abaasuri mbabe bagosasimera amo.

English: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo Israeli itakuwa ya tatu, pamoja na Misri na Ashuru, nao watakuwa baraka kwa dunia.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli mbabwatane n’Abamisiri na Abaasuri, na ebisaku ebio bitato mbibe ogosesenigwa ase ense engima,

English: because Yahweh of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atawabariki, akisema, “Baraka iwe kwa Misri watu wangu, kwa Ashuru kazi ya mikono yangu, na kwa Israeli urithi wangu.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nabasesenie, ateebe: “Imosesenirie inwe Abamisiri, abamore abanto baane, nainwe Abaasuri, abamore emeremo y’amaboko aane, nainwe Abaisraeli, abamore omwando one.”

English: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka ule ambao jemadari mkuu alitumwa na Mfalme Sargoni wa Ashuru, naye akaja mpaka Ashdodi, akaushambulia na kuuteka,
