Ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria Taritani, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani b’Abaasuri, atometwe na Sarigoni, omorwoti obo, agende ase omochie bw’Asidodi; ere akayorwania esegi, akayobua.

English: at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.
Kiswahili: wakati ule Bwana alisema kwa kinywa cha Isaya mwana wa Amozi. Akamwambia, “Vua nguo ya gunia kutoka mwilini mwako na viatu kutoka miguuni mwako.” Naye akafanya hivyo, akatembea huku na huko uchi, bila viatu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene agakwana na Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, akamoteebia: “Genda orusie egunia obegete ase omobere oo, na ebikoroto obegete ase amagoro ao.” Isaya agakora bo, akaba ogotaara getirianda, na tabegete ebikoroto.

English: Yahweh said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akasema, “Kama vile mtumishi wangu Isaya alivyotembea uchi na bila viatu kwa miaka mitatu, kama ishara na dalili mbaya dhidi ya nchi ya Misri na Kushi,
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba: “Buna koreng’ana Isaya, omosomba one, abeire okona‐gotaara goetanana aaria na aaria ase emiaka etato yaetire, ore getirianda na atabegeti bikoroto, obeire ekemanyererio na omogwekano bw’amang’ana arabe ase Abamisiri na ase Abaetiopia,

English: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
Kiswahili: vivyo hivyo mfalme wa Ashuru atawaongoza mateka wa Wamisri, na watu wa uhamisho wa Kushi, uchi na bila viatu, vijana hata wazee, wakiwa matako wazi, kwa aibu ya Wamisri.
Ekegusii: naboigo omorwoti bw’Abaasuri araire abasomba korwa Misiri, naire na Abaetiopia abooswa. Nigo baraire abanto abake na abanene bare getirianda na batabegeti bikoroto, gose batatubeti chinyonga chiabo, na igo ense y’Abamisiri erenterwe obosooku.

English: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
Kiswahili: Wale waliotegemea Kushi na kujivunia Misri wataogopa na kuaibika.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo basemeretie Abamisiri na betogeretie Abaetiopia mbabe baichanete na gosooka.

English: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile watu wanaoishi katika pwani hii watasema, ‘Tazama lililowapata wale tuliowategemea, wale tuliowakimbilia kwa msaada na wokovu kutoka mikononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru! Tutawezaje basi kupona?’ ”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto bamenyete ase ense ere ang’e nenyancha mbakwane, bateebe: Rora amang’ana abanyorire abanto abwo intwe twasemeretie na kobatamera ng’a batokonye korwa ase omorwoti bw’Abaasuri! Bono, naki intwe toranyare gotooreka?”

English: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Jangwa kando ya Bahari: Kama upepo wa kisulisuli unaopita katika nchi hadi kusini, mshambuliaji anakuja kutoka jangwani, kutoka nchi inayotisha.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro y’erooro ere ang’e nenyancha. Koreng’ana buna ekembugu‐mbugu gekobongia ase ense ya Irianyi naboigo na obobe bokorwa ase erooro, ense eyio ekoondokia mono.

English: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.
Kiswahili: Nimeonyeshwa maono ya kutisha: Msaliti anasaliti, mteka nyara anateka nyara. Elamu, shambulia! Umedi, izunguke kwa jeshi! Nitakomesha huzuni zote alizosababisha.
Ekegusii: Inche norokigwe okorora kore ogokong’u mono; abaurereria nigo bagendererete kourereria, na abasaria bagendererete gosaria. Inwe Abaelamu, genda morwane! Inwe Abamedia, genda moboere! Ninsirie obororo bwonsi bwarentirwe n’Abaababeli.

English: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.
Kiswahili: Katika hili mwili wangu umeteswa na maumivu, maumivu makali ya ghafula yamenishika, kama yale ya mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa. Nimeduwazwa na lile ninalolisikia, nimeshangazwa na lile ninaloliona.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio chibachwa chiane chianyegerigwe, obororo bwansoire, obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore; naichanire mono, tindi koigwa; nabeire nobwoba obonene, tindi korora.

English: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
Kiswahili: Moyo wangu unababaika, woga unanifanya nitetemeke, gizagiza la jioni nililolitamani sana, limekuwa hofu kuu kwangu.
Ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, omoondoko ombwatire; engaki ya mogoroba eyio naganyete yang’onchokeire na kondetera obwoba.

English: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!
Kiswahili: Wanaandaa meza, wanatandaza mazulia, wanakula, wanakunywa! Amkeni, enyi maafisa, zitieni ngao mafuta!
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakwarigania endagera bayebeeka ase emesa, babeeka abarendi bakorenda, naende baria na konywa. Bono inwe abagaambi, imoka, moake chinguba chiaino ebitinya.

English: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana analoniambia: “Nenda, weka mlinzi, na atoe taarifa ya kile anachokiona.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nar’Omonene antebetie, “Genda mobeke omorendi atengere, nere oyio nabaraarerie abateebie amang’ana ararore.

English: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
Kiswahili: Anapoona magari ya vita pamoja na kundi la farasi, wapanda punda au wapanda ngamia, na awe macho, awe macho kikamilifu.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio kararore abariini chibarasi bagocha babere babere, na abariini chitigere, na abe chingamia, tiga ategerere mono, ee, ategerere buya kegima.”

English: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.
Kiswahili: Naye mlinzi alipaza sauti, “Mchana baada ya mchana, bwana wangu, ninasimama katika mnara wa ulinzi, kila usiku ninakaa mahali pangu nilipoamriwa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio ontengerete akarangeria neriogi buna eri’endo, “Aye Omonene, nigo ngotenena igoro ase egetengero omobaso boira; nigo inde ase emeremo yane ase obotuko bwonsi.

English: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.
Kiswahili: Tazama, yuaja mtu anayepanda gari la vita pamoja na kundi la farasi. Naye anajibu: ‘Babeli umeanguka, umeanguka! Vinyago vyote vya miungu yake vimelala chini vikiwa vimevunjwa!’ ”
Ekegusii: “Bono abariini chibarasi ngocha bare babere babere.” Na omotengeri oria agaaka eriogi riaye naende, agateeba: “Babiloni ogure! Ogure kegima! Emegwekano yaye yonsi y’ogosasimwa yasenyentirwe na gotiringerwa inse.”

English: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.
Kiswahili: Ee watu wangu, mliopondwa kwenye sakafu ya kupuria, ninawaambia kile nilichokisikia kutoka kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, kutoka kwa Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, aba mwaoorirwe ase ekeooreri buna obori na koirurwa, amang’ana naigure korwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, naro nkobaraareria.

English: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Duma: Mtu fulani ananiita kutoka Seiri, “Mlinzi, usiku utaisha lini? Mlinzi, usiku utaisha lini?”
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Edomu. Omonto nkondangeria are korwa Edomu, okoboria, “Omorendi, mang’ana ki igoro y’obotuko? Omorendi, mang’ana ki igoro y’obotuko?”

English: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
Kiswahili: Mlinzi anajibu, “Asubuhi inakuja, lakini pia usiku. Kama ungeliuliza, basi uliza; bado na urudi tena.”
Ekegusii: Omorendi nigo akoiraneria: “Emambia yachire, nonya naboigo obotuko nao bore. Onye moganetie koboria erinde momanye, boria; moirane moche naende.”

English: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Arabia: Enyi misafara ya Wadedani, mnaopiga kambi katika vichaka vya Arabia,
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro y’Abaarabu. Inwe abagendi b’ense ya Dedani, mobe mokorara ase amanani ’ense y’Arabia.

English: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.
Kiswahili: leteni maji kwa wenye kiu, ninyi mnaoishi Tema, leteni chakula kwa ajili ya wakimbizi.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete ase ense ya Tema, abwo bare nerang’o, bae amaache, na abwo bagotama, bae endagera.

English: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.
Kiswahili: Wanaukimbia upanga, kutoka upanga uliochomolewa alani, kutoka upinde uliopindwa, na kutoka kwenye joto la vita.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo batamire korwa ase ogoitwa nemioro, na korwa ase emeyio yasomoirwe, na korwa ase amata atingirwe, na korwa ase emechando y’esegi.

English: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana analoniambia: “Katika muda wa mwaka mmoja, kama vile mtumishi aliyefungwa na mkataba angeihesabu, majivuno yote ya Kedari yatafikia mwisho.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene ontebirie iga: “Ekero omwaka oyomo otaraera omwaka onga buna oyo bw’omorikwa, obonene bwonsi bwa Kedari mbosirigwe boere.

English: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
Kiswahili: Wanaume wavutao pinde walionusurika, mashujaa wa Kedari, watakuwa wachache.” Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, amesema.
Ekegusii: Abanto chituoni b’Abakedari, abamanyete koruta chinsara, nigo baratigare abake mono. Inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nateebire amang’ana ayio.”

English: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Bonde la Maono: Nini kinachokutaabisha sasa, kwamba ninyi nyote mmepanda juu ya mapaa?
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ye Rikura ri’Amaroro. Mang’ana ki abeire inwe mwensi mwariinire gochia birama igoro?

English: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
Kiswahili: Ewe mji uliojaa ghasia, ewe mji wa makelele na sherehe! Watu wenu waliokufa hawakuuawa kwa upanga, wala hawakufa vitani.
Ekegusii: Aye omochie oichire neburu‐buru na okwogana, aye ore nomochengo bw’obobe, abanto bao abaitirwe tibaitiri nemioro, gose tibakweti ase esegi.

English: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wako wote wamekimbia pamoja, wamekamatwa bila kutumia upinde. Ninyi nyote mliokamatwa mlichukuliwa wafungwa pamoja, mlikimbia wakati adui alipokuwa bado mbali.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi bao bonsi batamire bare amo, nigo babwatirwe batararaswa chinsara. Abanto bao bonsi banyoretwe nigo babwatetwe, nonya konya batamire gochia aare.

English: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nilisema, “Geukia mbali nami, niache nilie kwa uchungu. Usijaribu kunifariji juu ya maangamizi ya watu wangu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inche ngateeba: “Tobaisa kondigereria, ntige ndere nobororo ing’iyerie amariga; tobaisa gwechanda kondemia ase engencho y’ogosarigwa kw’omochie bw’abaanto baane.”

English: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”
Kiswahili: Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, anayo siku ya ghasia, ya kukanyaga, na ya kuogofya katika Bonde la Maono, siku ya kuangusha kuta na ya kupiga kelele mpaka milimani.
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ochorire engaki ere nobotantanu, na ogotiringerwa inse, na omoichano, na engaki eyio nigo erache igoro ye Rikura ri’Amaroro. Ase engaki eyio chindwaki nchitagorwe chigwe inse, na ebirero mbiigweke gochia ase ebitunwa.

English: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
Kiswahili: Elamu analichukua podo, pamoja na waendesha magari ya vita na farasi. Kiri anaifungua ngao.
Ekegusii: Abaelamu nigo babogoretie chinsara, bagacha amo nabariini chigari na abe chibarasi; na abanto ba Kiri bagasokia chinguba chiabo.

English: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.
Kiswahili: Mabonde yako yaliyo mazuri sana yamejaa magari ya vita, nao wapanda farasi wamewekwa kwenye malango ya mji;
Ekegusii: Amakura aino are amaya mono aichoirwe ne chigari, na abariini chibarasi mbateneine ase ebiita.

English: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
Kiswahili: ulinzi wa Yuda umeondolewa. Nawe ulitazama siku ile silaha katika Jumba la Kifalme la Mwituni,
Ekegusii: Egekengero ki’Abayuda nigo kiarusetigweo kegima. Ase engaki eyio mokarigia ebirwanero biarenge kogachwa ase Enyomba ye Rinani.

English: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
Kiswahili: mkaona kuwa Mji wa Daudi una matundu mengi katika ulinzi wake, mkaweka akiba ya maji kwenye Bwawa la Chini.
Ekegusii: Erio mokanyora ng’a obotandoku bwe chindwaki chi’Omochie o Daudi bwabeire obonge; inwe mogatanga amaache tarua ase Ritibo ria Maate.

English: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
Kiswahili: Mlihesabu majengo katika Yerusalemu nanyi mkabomoa nyumba ili kuimarisha ukuta.
Ekegusii: Mokabara chinyomba chia Yerusalemu, na mogachitagora ase okoroisia orwaki robe orokong’u.

English: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.
Kiswahili: Mlijenga bwawa la maji katikati ya kuta mbili kwa ajili ya maji ya Bwawa la Zamani, lakini hamkumtazama Yule aliyelitengeneza, au kuwa na heshima kwa Yule aliyeubuni tangu zamani za kale.
Ekegusii: Mokaagacha etangi y’amaache agwo ase egati ye chindwaki chiria ibere, erinde monyore amaache akorwa ase ritibo rikoro, korende timwamorigeretie Oyio okorete ayio, gose timwamorengereretie Oyio okorete omooroberio oyio agwo kare.

English: In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
Kiswahili: Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, aliwaita siku ile ili kulia na kuomboleza, kungʼoa nywele zenu na kuvaa nguo ya gunia.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo abateebeetie ng’a morere na kobokia amagombo, na mokigite chitukia chi’emetwe yaino, na kweboyia chigunia.

English: and behold, there is joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”
Kiswahili: Lakini tazama, kuna furaha na sherehe, kuchinja ngʼombe na kuchinja kondoo, kula nyama na kunywa mvinyo! Mnasema, “Tuleni na kunywa, kwa kuwa kesho tutakufa!”
Ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ogokora igo mokagoka na gochenga; mokanyenya chiombe ne ching’ondi, mokaba mokoria chinyama na konywa edivai, mogateeba: “Tiga torie na konywa, ekiagera ankio natokwe.”

English: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amelifunua hili nikiwa ninasikia: Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, asema: “Mpaka siku ya kufa kwenu, dhambi hii haitafanyiwa upatanisho.”
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nere onyorokirie amang’ana ayio na gonteebia, “Ekeene, timokwaberwa ebibe ebio nonya ng’ake.” Omonene bw’Emeganda oteebire ayio.

English: The Lord, Yahweh of Armies says, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, asemalo: “Nenda ukamwambie huyu wakili Shebna, ambaye ni msimamizi wa jumba la kifalme:
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, agoteeba: “Inchuo ogende ase Sebuna, oyio ore omogachi na omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’obogaambi, omoteebie:

English: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”
Kiswahili: Unafanya nini hapa, na ni nani aliyekupa ruhusa kujikatia kaburi lako mwenyewe, ukichonga kaburi lako mahali palipo juu, na kutoboa kwa patasi mahali pako pa kupumzikia katika mwamba?
Ekegusii: Aye ninki ogokora aiga, na monto ki obwate aa? Nase ki ogwekunyera oboina aase are igoro mono? Inee! Nigo okwebaachera oboina aiga ase egetare bobe obomenyo bwao?

English: Behold, Yahweh will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.
Kiswahili: “Jihadhari, Bwana yu karibu kukukamata thabiti, na kukutupa mbali, ewe mtu mwenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Aye nonya kore omonto bw’echinguru, Naama, Omonene nakobwate bokong’u, akorute gochia aare mono.

English: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord’s house.
Kiswahili: Atakuvingirisha uwe kama mpira na kukutupa katika nchi kubwa. Huko ndiko utakakofia, na huko ndiko magari yako ya vita ya fahari yatabakia, wewe unayeifedhehesha nyumba ya bwana wako!
Ekegusii: Nigo arakoborongose buna omopira, akorute gochia ase ense ere engare; agwo nao orakwere. Naende nao chigari chiao chi’obonene chirabe, ekiagera aye kwabeire omonto bw’obosooku ase enyomba y’omonene oo.

English: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
Kiswahili: Nitakuondoa kutoka kazi yako, nawe utaondoshwa kutoka nafasi yako.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene ninkorusie orue ase emeremo yao, naende nkoiyerie korwa aase ao.

English: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
Kiswahili: “Katika siku ile, nitamwita mtumishi wangu, Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia.
Ekegusii: “Ase engaki eyio nindangerie omosomba one Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia,

English: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
Kiswahili: Nitamvika joho lako, nami nitamfunga mshipi wako kiunoni mwake, na kumkabidhi mamlaka yako. Yeye atakuwa baba kwa wale wanaoishi Yerusalemu na kwa nyumba ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: imobekere eganchwa yao y’obogaambi, naende imoboerie orokini rwao. Nimbeeke obogaambi bwao ase okoboko kwaye, ere nabe ise bw’abaanto ba Yerusalemu na Abayuda.

English: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
Kiswahili: Nitaweka mabegani mwake ufunguo wa nyumba ya Daudi. Kile afunguacho hakuna awezaye kufunga, na kile afungacho hakuna awezaye kufungua.
Ekegusii: Nimbeeke ekeigorero ki’enyomba ya Daudi ase amareko aye; ere nabe okoigora, na onde tari oranyare gosieka; nabe ogosieka na onde tari oranyare koigora.

English: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
Kiswahili: Nitamgongomea kama kigingi kilicho mahali palipo imara, naye atakuwa kiti cha enzi cha heshima kwa ajili ya nyumba ya baba yake.
Ekegusii: Nimokong’ontere akong’e buna omosumari okong’onteire ase enyasi enkong’u, na ere nabe ekerogo ki’amasikani ase enyomba ya ise.

English: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.
Kiswahili: Utukufu wote wa jamaa yake utakuwa juu yake: Watoto wa jamaa hiyo na machipukizi yake, vyombo vyake vyote vidogo, tangu bakuli hadi magudulia yote.”
Ekegusii: “Abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya ise, na abana baye, ne chinderia chiabo, mbabe bakomosemeria abakoonye. Ebikorero bionsi, ebisinini na ebinene, mbimosung’unane.

English: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asema, “Katika siku ile, kigingi kilichogongomewa mahali imara kitaachia njia. Kitakatwa, nacho kitaanguka na mzigo ulioningʼinia juu yake utaanguka chini.” Bwana amesema.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engaki eyio omosumari oria okong’onteretwe ase enyasi enkong’u nosimorwe korwao ogwe inse, ne chigurube chiasungireo nchigwe, chisamunyokane.” Nab’Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.

English: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu Tiro: Ombolezeni, enyi meli za Tarshishi! Kwa kuwa Tiro imeangamizwa, imeachwa bila nyumba wala bandari. Kuanzia nchi ya Kitimu neno limewajia.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Turo. Inwe abe chimeeri chia Tarisisi, rera, ekiagera Turo osarigwe, chinyomba tichiyo, gose ekiambokero. Abanto b’ense ya Kuporo baabamanyirie amang’ana ayio.

English: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.
Kiswahili: Nyamazeni kimya, enyi watu wa kisiwani, pia ninyi wafanyabiashara wa Sidoni, ambao mabaharia wamewatajirisha.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase egesinka, tegerera mokire‐kiri! Abaonchoreria ba Sidoni, abwo bagotaara ne chimeeri, kare nigo baichorete ase ense yaino.

English: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.
Kiswahili: Kwenye maji makuu nafaka za Shihori zilikuja; mavuno ya Naili yalikuwa mapato ya Tiro, naye akawa soko la mataifa.
Ekegusii: Nigo bataarete ase chinyancha chinene, na ebitoki biaino nigo biarenge chimbusuro chia Sihori, na okwama kwe riranya ri’Orooche rwa Naeli. Ninwe mwarenge abaonchoreria b’ebisaku bionsi.

English: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”
Kiswahili: Uaibishwe ee Sidoni, nawe ee ngome la bahari, kwa kuwa bahari imesema: “Sijapata kuwa na uchungu wa kuzaa wala sijapata kuzaa, wala sijapata kulea wana wala kutunza mabinti.”
Ekegusii: Aye Sidoni, rora obosooku; enyancha ere neburi enkong’u y’enyancha yatebiire iga: “Inche tinana kobina, gose koibora, tinana korera abana abamura, gose gokinia abaiseke abekungi.”

English: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.
Kiswahili: Habari ifikapo Misri, watakuwa katika maumivu makuu kwa ajili ya taarifa kutoka Tiro.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abamisiri baraigwe amang’ana ayio igoro ya Turo, nigo baraichane mono.

English: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!
Kiswahili: Vukeni mpaka Tarshishi, ombolezeni, enyi watu wa kisiwani.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase egesinka, amboka, mogende Tarisisi, morere!

English: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?
Kiswahili: Je, huu ndio mji wenu uliojaa sherehe, mji wa zamani, zamani kabisa ambao miguu yake imeuchukua kufanya makao nchi za mbali sana?
Ekegusii: Inee! Oyo nomochie oria oino oichire nomogooko, omochie oyio oagachetwe ase chingaki chia kare, oyio amagoro ’abaanto baye abogoretie gochia komenya ase chinse chi’aare?

English: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?
Kiswahili: Ni nani amepanga hili dhidi ya Tiro, mji utoao mataji, ambao wafanyabiashara wake ni wana wa mfalme na wachuuzi wake ni watu mashuhuri wa dunia?
Ekegusii: Ning’o oroberetie amang’ana aya onsi mamincha ya Turo? Omochie oyio orenge kobekera abarwoti chigutwa, na abaonchoreria baye nigo baarenge abagaambi, na abaoonia baye nigo basikire ase ense.

English: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndiye alipanga jambo hili, ili kukishusha kiburi cha utukufu wote na kuwanyenyekesha wale wote ambao ni mashuhuri duniani.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nere oroberetie ayio ase okoiyeria inse oboenenu bw’obonene na gochaaya abanene bonsi b’ense.

English: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
Kiswahili: Ee Binti Tarshishi, pita katika nchi yako kama vile Mto Naili kwa kuwa huna tena bandari.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Tarisisi, menteka, moichore ase ense yaino, mobe buna amaache ’orooche rwa Naeli; kende tikeri kerabatange.

English: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.
Kiswahili: Bwana amenyoosha mkono wake juu ya bahari na kuzifanya falme zake zitetemeke. Ametoa amri kuhusu Kanaani kwamba ngome zake ziangamizwe.
Ekegusii: Omonene oramboire okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha, onyegeirie amarwoti; orure ogochika igoro ya Kaanani ng’a chiburi chiaye chitagorwe.

English: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”
Kiswahili: Alisema, “Usizidi kufurahi, ee Bikira Binti Sidoni, sasa umepondwa! “Simama, vuka uende Kitimu; hata huko hutapata pumziko.”
Ekegusii: Ere agateeba, “Aye omochie o Sidoni orenge buna omoiseke omwekuungi, korende bono gwakoreirwe bobe, tokonyara koba nomogooko naende. Imoka ogende Kuporo, nonya naroro tokonyara gotimoka.”

English: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.
Kiswahili: Tazama katika nchi ya Wakaldayo, watu hawa ambao sasa hawaonekani kama wapo! Waashuru wameifanya nchi hiyo kuwa mahali pa viumbe wa jangwani. Wamesimamisha minara yao ya vita kuuzunguka, wameziteka ngome zake na kuziacha tupu na kuufanya kuwa magofu.
Ekegusii: Rigereria ense y’Abakalidayo! Abanto aba tibaarenge egesaku. Abaasuri nabwo barentete ching’iti chi’orosana komenya aroro. Abwo bakaagacha chindwaki chi’okoboera, bakaonchorana chinyomba chi’obogaambi. Chi’omochie oyio, bakayotagora okaba etui.

English: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!
Kiswahili: Ombolezeni, enyi meli za Tarshishi; ngome yenu imeangamizwa!
Ekegusii: Inwe abe chimeeri chia Tarisisi rera, ekiagera chiburi chiaino chiatagoirwe.

English: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Tiro utasahauliwa kwa miaka sabini, muda wa maisha ya mfalme. Lakini mwisho wa miaka hiyo sabini, itakuwa kwa Tiro kama ilivyo katika wimbo wa kahaba:
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio omochie o Turo mbwebwe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, emiaka ereng’aine ey’obogima bw’omorwoti oyomo. Emiaka eyio emerongo etano na ebere ekoera, neebe ase Turo buna ariikire ase ogoteera kw’omotayayi;

English: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.
Kiswahili: “Twaa kinubi, tembea mjini kote, ewe kahaba uliyesahauliwa; piga kinubi vizuri, imba nyimbo nyingi, ili upate kukumbukwa.”
Ekegusii: “Aye omokungu omotayayi konya kwebirwe, imokia obokano, oetanane ase omochie bwonsi, otere neriogi rigiya, otere amatera amange, erio nario orainyorwe.”

English: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.
Kiswahili: Mwishoni mwa miaka sabini, Bwana atashughulika na Tiro. Naye atarudia ajira yake ya ukahaba, na atafanya biashara yake na falme zote juu ya uso wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Emiaka eyio emerongo etano na ebere koyaerire, Omonene nachiche korora omochie o Turo; omochie oyio noiranere chingencho chiaye chinkoro, ochake gokora obonyaka amo namarwoti onsi are ase ense.

English: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
Kiswahili: Lakini faida na mapato yake yatawekwa wakfu kwa Bwana; hayatahifadhiwa wala kufichwa. Faida zake zitakwenda kwa wale wakaao mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya chakula tele na mavazi mazuri.
Ekegusii: Ebikonyorekana korwa ase oboonchoreria bwaye, na ebitoki bi’ogokora kwaye kw’obonyaka mbiatananwe ase Omonene, tibigosangererigwa na kogachwa. Ebio banyorire ase oboonchoreria nigo biranyorere abanto abwo bamenyete ase obosio vw’Omonene endagera eisaine, ne chianga chingiya chikobekwa.

English: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
Kiswahili: Tazama, Bwana ataifanya dunia kuwa ukiwa na kuiharibu, naye atauharibu uso wake na kutawanya wakaao ndani yake:
Ekegusii: Naama! Omonene nasarie ense, ayetige ere bosa; nayeonchorane ayeumamie, na abanto bamenyeteo abasiarere gochia aaria na aaria.

English: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.
Kiswahili: ndivyo itakavyokuwa kwa makuhani na kwa watu, kwa bwana na kwa mtumishi, kwa bibi na kwa mtumishi wake wa kike, kwa muuzaji na kwa mnunuzi, kwa mkopaji na kwa mkopeshaji, kwa mdaiwa na kwa mdai.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana nayamo arabanyorere abanto bonsi; buna arabe ase abanto, naboigo arabe ase abakuani; buna arabe ase omosomba, naboigo arabe ase omonene oye; buna arabe ase omosomba omokungu, naboigo arabe ase omokungu ore omonene oye; buna arabe ase oyokogora, naboigo arabe ase oyokoonia; buna arabe ase oyokorua singo, naboigo arabe ase oyokoegwa singo; buna arabe ase oyogotura esira, naboigo arabe ase oyogoturwa esira.

English: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.
Kiswahili: Dunia itaharibiwa kabisa na kutekwa nyara kabisa. Bwana amesema neno hili.
Ekegusii: Ense nesarigwe kegima ebe bosa, ekiagera n’Omonene oteebire ring’ana erio.

English: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
Kiswahili: Dunia inakauka na kunyauka, dunia inanyongʼonyea na kunyauka, waliotukuzwa wa dunia wananyongʼonyea.
Ekegusii: Ense nigo ekweumia na kogenderera gosira; oboiko bwonsi bwagoyire, ngochia gosira bore, na abare abanene b’ense baereirwe chinguru.

English: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
Kiswahili: Dunia imetiwa unajisi na watu wake; wameacha kutii sheria, wamevunja amri na kuvunja agano la milele.
Ekegusii: Ense yasarigwe nabaanto bamenyeteo; barabwo basaririe amachiiko, bangire koigwera emeroberio echiikire, naende basaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwa kare na kare.

English: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo laana inaiteketeza dunia, watu wake lazima waichukue hatia yao. Kwa hiyo wakazi wa dunia wameteketezwa, nao waliosalia ni wachache sana.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio okoragererigwa nkogendererete gosiria ense; abanto bamenyeteo nigo bachandegete ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo kw’ebibe, basambirwe, na abanto abake boka batigaireo.

English: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
Kiswahili: Divai mpya inakauka na mzabibu unanyauka, watu wote wafurahishao wanalia kwa huzuni.
Ekegusii: Edivai enyia nigo ekobokia amagombo, na emesabibu yasusanire, na abanto bonsi baarenge nomogooko bw’enkoro nigo baichanete.

English: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
Kiswahili: Furaha ya matoazi imekoma, kelele za wenye furaha zimekoma, shangwe za kinubi zimenyamaza.
Ekegusii: Omogoko bw’eriogi rie chinchigiri oerire, na eriogi ri’abwo bagochenga riaerire, na omogooko bw’eriogi ri’amakano oerire.

English: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
Kiswahili: Hawanywi tena mvinyo pamoja na wimbo, kileo ni kichungu kwa wanywaji wake.
Ekegusii: Bono abanto tibagenderereti goteera ekero bakonywa edivai; ebinyugwa bigotindia biabeire ebiroro ase abwo bakobinywa.

English: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
Kiswahili: Mji ulioharibiwa umekuwa ukiwa, mlango wa kila nyumba umefungwa.
Ekegusii: Omochie oyio obwate eburu‐buru otagoirwe; kera enyomba ereo yasiekirwe, monto onde tari ogosoa aroro.

English: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
Kiswahili: Barabarani wanalilia kupata mvinyo, furaha yote imegeuka kuwa majonzi, furaha yote imefukuziwa mbali na dunia.
Ekegusii: Okorera okonene kwaigwekanire ase chinchera, ekiagera edivai teiyo; omogooko bwonsi oerire, na omochengo bw’ense osirire.

English: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
Kiswahili: Mji umeachwa katika uharibifu, lango lake limevunjwa vipande.
Ekegusii: Omochie osarigwe kegima; ebiita biatagoirwe na konacha‐nachanwa.

English: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
Kiswahili: Ndivyo itakavyokuwa duniani na miongoni mwa mataifa, kama vile wakati mzeituni upigwavyo, au kama vile wakati masazo yabakiavyo baada ya zabibu kuvunwa.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio naro arabinyore ebisaku bire ase ense; ense neebe buna ekero emezeituni ekonyegerigwa ase okoarora amatunda, na buna ogochorwa kw’amazeituni amatigari.

English: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.
Kiswahili: Wanainua sauti zao, wanapiga kelele kwa furaha, kutoka magharibi wanasifu kwa ukelele utukufu wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto mbaake amariogi batere nomogooko, mbaake amariogi korwa bosongo batogie obonene bw’Omonene.

English: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo upande wa mashariki mpeni Bwana utukufu, liadhimisheni jina la Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, katika visiwa vya bahari.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe abamore moocha, motogie Omonene; abamore ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, togia erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
Kiswahili: Kutoka miisho ya dunia tunasikia uimbaji: “Utukufu kwa Yule Mwenye Haki.” Lakini nilisema, “Ninadhoofika, ninadhoofika! Ole wangu! Watenda hila wanasaliti! Kwa hila watenda hila wanasaliti!”
Ekegusii: Korwa chinsinyo chi’ense twaigure amatera ay’ogotogia obonene bw’Oyore Omonyene Oboronge. Korende nigo ngoteeba, “Naki nachandekire! Naki nachandekire! Obobe nobwane! Abakorekanu nigo bagendererete gokorekania, ee, nigo bagendererete gokorekania mono.”

English: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.
Kiswahili: Hofu, shimo na mtego vinakungojea, ewe mtu ukaaye duniani.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase ense, obwoba, na eirima, na omoeto, nigo bibaganyete.

English: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
Kiswahili: Kila akimbiaye asikiapo sauti ya hofu atatumbukia shimoni, naye yeyote apandaye kutoka shimoni, atanaswa kwenye mtego. Malango ya gharika ya mbinguni yamefunguliwa, misingi ya dunia inatikisika.
Ekegusii: Nebe ng’a oyogotama kaigure eriogi ri’okogosa nagwe ase eirima, na oyo orasoke korwa ase eirima eyio nabwatwe nomoeto, ekiagera chitirisa chia igoro chiaigoirwe, oboroso bw’ense bwanyegerigwe.

English: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
Kiswahili: Dunia imepasuka, dunia imechanika, dunia imetikiswa kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ense yabwerekire, ee, yabwerekire kegima, yatandoirwe ebing’ese; ense yatengechigwe ne chinguru chintindi.

English: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
Kiswahili: Dunia inapepesuka kama mlevi, inayumbayumba kama kibanda kwenye upepo; imelemewa sana na mzigo wa hatia ya uasi wake na ikianguka kamwe haitainuka tena.
Ekegusii: Ense yatindire buna oyotindire amarwa; nigo ekorunda‐rundigwa buna oborunda‐rundia bw’omote. Ogosaria kwaye kwayeritoereire, negwe, tekonyara koboka naende.

English: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile Bwana ataadhibu nguvu zilizoko mbinguni juu, na wafalme walioko duniani chini.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene narue egesusuro ase emeganda ere igoro, aaria igoro, narue egesusuro ase abarwoti b’ense, aiga ase ense.

English: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.
Kiswahili: Watakusanywa pamoja kama wafungwa waliofungwa gerezani, watafungiwa gerezani na kuadhibiwa baada ya siku nyingi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbasangererigwe amo buna abasibwa, babekwe ase engoro eyemo; mbasiekerwe buna abasibwa, na ekero amatuko amange aerire mbaegwe egesusuro.

English: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
Kiswahili: Mwezi utatiwa haya, nalo jua litaaibishwa; kwa maana Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atawala juu ya Mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu, tena mbele ya wazee wake kwa utukufu.
Ekegusii: Erio omotienyi tokorua oborabu bwaye, na erioba tirikobara, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nabe okogaamba ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, na ase abagaaka b’aroro naorokie obonene bwaye.

English: Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni Mungu wangu, nitakutukuza na kulisifu jina lako, kwa maana katika ukamilifu wa uaminifu umetenda mambo ya ajabu, mambo yaliyokusudiwa tangu zamani.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye Nyasae one; ninkoimokererie igoro, nintogie erieta riao; aye gwakorire amang’ana ’ogokumia emeroberio yao korwa kare nigo ere ey’obwegenwa na ekeene.

English: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
Kiswahili: Umeufanya mji kuwa lundo la kifusi, mji wenye ngome kuwa magofu, ngome imara ya wageni kuwa si mji tena, wala hautajengwa tena kamwe.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatagoire omochie, kwayokorire obeire etui y’amagena, omochie oyio konya ogiteire chindwaki obeire ritongo. Gwasaririe chinyomba chinene chi’omochie bw’abamenyi, omochie oyio tokoagachwa naende.

English: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mataifa yenye nguvu yatakuheshimu, miji ya mataifa katili itakuheshimu wewe.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto bare ne chinguru mbagotogie, emechie y’ebisaku ebitindi nekoiroke.

English: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.
Kiswahili: Umekuwa kimbilio la watu maskini, kimbilio la mhitaji katika taabu yake, hifadhi wakati wa dhoruba na kivuli wakati wa hari. Kwa maana pumzi ya wakatili ni kama dhoruba ipigayo ukuta
Ekegusii: Aye kwabeire egekengero egekong’u ase abataka, ee, kwabeire egekengero ase abaremeire ekero bare nemechando; kwabeire obotamero ase engaki y’embura omoubera, na ekiriri ekero ki’omobaso omoororo. Okogosa kw’abaanto abatindi nigo konga embura omoubera egotwoma enyasi,

English: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
Kiswahili: na kama joto la jangwani. Wewe wanyamazisha makelele ya wageni; kama vile hari ipunguzwavyo na kivuli cha wingu, ndivyo wimbo wa wakatili unyamazishwavyo.
Ekegusii: na buna omobaso bw’eguru‐gura. Aye gwakiririe amariogi ’ababisa; buna omobaso omoororo ogokendigwa ne riire, naboigo namatera ’abaanto abwo abatindi arakendigwe.

English: In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.
Kiswahili: Juu ya mlima huu Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ataandaa karamu ya vinono kwa mataifa yote, karamu ya mvinyo wa zamani, nyama nzuri sana na divai zilizo bora sana.
Ekegusii: Aiga ase egetunwa eke Omonene bw’Emeganda naroiserie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi omoyega bw’ebinto ebinoru, omoyega bw’edivai engiya mono, ee, oyo bw’ebinto ebinoru biichire emeseto, na edivai engiya ekenonoire.

English: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
Kiswahili: Juu ya mlima huu ataharibu sitara ihifadhiyo mataifa yote, kile kifuniko kifunikacho mataifa yote,
Ekegusii: Aiga ase egetunwa eke Omonene nasarie na korusia egietubo getubete abanto bonsi, ee, egietubo ekio keramboire igoro y’ebisaku bionsi.

English: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.
Kiswahili: yeye atameza mauti milele. Bwana Mwenyezi atafuta machozi katika nyuso zote; ataondoa aibu ya watu wake duniani kote. Bwana amesema hili.
Ekegusii: Omonene nasirie amakweri goika kare na kare, natinyie amariga korwa ase amaiso ’abaanto bonsi, nasirie ogochaywa kw’abaanto baye korwa ase ense yonsi. Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is Yahweh! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile watasema, “Hakika huyu ndiye Mungu wetu; tulimtumaini, naye akatuokoa. Huyu ndiye Bwana, tuliyemtumaini; sisi tushangilie na kufurahia katika wokovu wake.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio mbateebe iga: “Rora, oyo nere Nyasae oito; oyo nere twakaganyire, erinde anyare gototooria. Oyo nere Omonene, twakaganyire; tiga togoke na gochenga, ekiagera otorenteire ogotooreka.”

English: For Yahweh’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Bwana utatulia juu ya mlima huu, bali Moabu atakanyagwa chini kama majani makavu yakanyagwavyo kwenye shimo la mbolea.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene nkobeere igoro y’egetunwa eke, korende Abamoabu mbatiringerwe inse aase abo buna obonyansi obwomo bogotiringeranigwa ase engoro y’esike.

English: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.
Kiswahili: Watakunjua mikono yao katikati yake, kama vile mwogeleaji akunjuavyo mikono yake ili aogelee. Mungu atashusha kiburi chao licha ya ujanja wa mikono yao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbarambore amaboko abo buna omonto akorambora amaboko aye ase ogoaka entimbu, korende Omonene nasirie oboenenu bwabo amo nobong’ainereria bw’emeremo y’amaboko abo.

English: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
Kiswahili: Atabomoa kuta ndefu za maboma yako na kuziangusha chini, atazishusha chini ardhini, mpaka mavumbini kabisa.
Ekegusii: Natagore emerobiri emetambe y’ogwekengera ere ase chindwaki chiabo, nayeiyerie inse kegima, ee, negwe inse ase riroba.

English: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, wimbo huu utaimbwa katika nchi ya Yuda: Tuna mji ulio na nguvu, Mungu huufanya wokovu kuwa kuta zake na maboma yake.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ogoteera oko ngoterwe ase ense y’Abayuda; “Intwe nigo tomenyete ase omochie omokong’u. Omonene otoeire ogotooreka kobe chindwaki ne chiburi chiaito.

English: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
Kiswahili: Fungua malango ili taifa lenye haki lipate kuingia, taifa lile lidumishalo imani.
Ekegusii: Igora ebiita bi’omochie oyio, erinde egesaku kere noboronge na obwegenwa kenyare gosoa imeo.

English: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Kiswahili: Utamlinda katika amani kamilifu yeye ambaye moyo wake ni thabiti kwa sababu anakutumaini wewe.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore nebirengererio ebironge asore, aye Omonene nigo okomoa omorembe omoikeranu, ekiagera agosemeretie.

English: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
Kiswahili: Mtumaini Bwana milele, kwa kuwa Bwana, Bwana, ni Mwamba wa milele.
Ekegusii: Mosemerie Omonene botambe, ekiagera Omonene nere egetare gia kare na kare.

English: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
Kiswahili: Huwashusha wale wajikwezao, huushusha chini mji wenye kiburi, huushusha hadi ardhini na kuutupa chini mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Ere okeeirie abanto abwo beimokereretie igoro, otagoire omochie oria ochongororogete gochia igoro, oyoiyeirie inse kegima, ee, oyoiyeirie inse ase riroba.

English: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”
Kiswahili: Miguu huukanyaga chini, miguu ya hao walioonewa, hatua za hao maskini.
Ekegusii: Amagoro ’abaanto abataka nayotiringere inse, na ay’abaremerwa nayotache.”

English: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
Kiswahili: Mapito ya wenye haki yamenyooka. Ewe uliye Mwenye Haki, waisawazisha njia ya mtu mnyofu.
Ekegusii: Enchera y’abanyene oboronge nenteremu; naye okoyekora yaba enteremu.

English: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
Kiswahili: Naam, Bwana, tukienenda katika sheria zako, twakungojea wewe, jina lako na sifa zako ndizo shauku za mioyo yetu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, intwe nigo tokoganyete kogocha konacha ebiina biao; okona‐koinyora erieta riao nakwo kore okogania kw’emioyo yaito.

English: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
Kiswahili: Nafsi yangu yakutamani wakati wa usiku, wakati wa asubuhi roho yangu yakuonea shauku. Wakati hukumu zako zinapokuja juu ya dunia, watu wa ulimwengu hujifunza haki.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ogokogania ase obotuko, omoika ore ime yane nigo ogokorigia kobogokiamoka. Ekero orarente ebiina biao igoro ase ense, abanto bamenyeteo nigo bakweorokereria oboronge.

English: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.
Kiswahili: Ingawa neema yaonyeshwa kwa waovu, hawajifunzi haki, hata katika nchi ya unyofu huendelea kutenda mabaya wala hawazingatii utukufu wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omokori amabe naisa gwanchererigwa, takweorokereria oboronge; ekero are ase ense egokora oboronge nigo arakore ay’obokorekanu, takorora obonene bw’Omonene.

English: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, mkono wako umeinuliwa juu, lakini hawauoni. Wao na waone wivu wako kwa ajili ya watu wako tena waaibishwe, moto uliowekwa akiba kwa ajili ya adui zako na uwateketeze.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwaramboire okoboko kwao, korende barabwo tibagokorora. Tiga barore risemi obwate ase abanto bao, erinde basooke; omorero osambete ababisa bao, tiga obasambe nabarabwo.

English: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
Kiswahili: Bwana, unaamuru amani kwa ajili yetu, yale yote tuliyoweza kuyakamilisha ni wewe uliyetenda kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, notorentere omorembe, ekiagera emeremo twabeire togokora, naye kwabeire gokoyetokorera.

English: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wetu, mabwana wengine zaidi ya wewe wametutawala, lakini jina lako pekee ndilo tunaloliheshimu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, abanene bande babeire bagotogaambera, korende erieta riao rioka nario tomanyete.

English: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
Kiswahili: Wao sasa wamekufa, wala hawako tena hai, roho za waliokufa hazitarudi tena. Uliwaadhibu na kuwaangamiza, umefuta kumbukumbu lao lote.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakuure, tibakoba moyo naende, babeire amarengari, tibakoboka; ase ayio kwabaeire egesusuro na kobasiria, kwabasiririe, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake.

English: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
Kiswahili: Umeliongeza hilo taifa, Ee Bwana, umeliongeza hilo taifa. Umejipatia utukufu kwa ajili yako mwenyewe, umepanua mipaka yote ya nchi.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, gwakorire egesaku eke kementekane; ee, gwakementekanirie; ase ayio aye gwatogigwe, kwagareeirie ense y’egesaku eke.

English: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
Kiswahili: Bwana, walikujia katika taabu yao, wewe ulipowarudi, waliweza kuomba kwa kunongʼona tu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero baarenge nemechando nigo bakorigetie, ekero kwabaete egesusuro, nigo bagosabeete mono.

English: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kama mwanamke mwenye mimba aliyekaribia kuzaa anavyogaagaa na kulia kwa ajili ya maumivu yake, ndivyo tulivyokuwa mbele zako, Ee Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo twabeete asore buna omokungu ore morito, okobina aibore, ekero engaki yaye yaikire, nigo akoromwa nobororo.

English: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
Kiswahili: Tulikuwa na mimba, tuligaagaa kwa maumivu, lakini tulizaa upepo. Hatukuleta wokovu duniani, hatujazaa watu katika ulimwengu huu.
Ekegusii: Intwe twabeire tore barito, twabeire tokobina na kweganchorana, korende ekero twaiborete tokaibora embeo bosa. Titorenteti ogotooreka konde ase ense, gose abanto tibaiboretwe ase ense.

English: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
Kiswahili: Lakini wafu wenu wataishi, nayo miili yao itafufuka. Ninyi mnaokaa katika mavumbi, amkeni mkapige kelele kwa furaha. Umande wenu ni kama umande wa asubuhi, dunia itawazaa wafu wake.
Ekegusii: Abanto baino bakwete mbabe moyo naende; emebere y’abakwete neboke. Inwe abwo moraire ase amaroba ime, boka, motere nomogooko! Riime riao nigo rire eri’oborabu; riroba ndibairanie abakwete.

English: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
Kiswahili: Nendeni, watu wangu, ingieni vyumbani mwenu na mfunge milango nyuma yenu, jificheni kwa kitambo kidogo mpaka ghadhabu yake ipite.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, inchwo mosoe ase chiero chiaino mwesiekere aroro; mwebise aroro ase engaki enke, goika endamwamu eyio ebe yaetire.

English: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
Kiswahili: Tazama, Bwana anakuja kutoka makao yake ili kuwaadhibu watu wa dunia kwa ajili ya dhambi zao. Dunia itadhihirisha umwagaji damu juu yake, wala haitaendelea kuwaficha watu wake waliouawa.
Ekegusii: Rora, Omonene ngosoka are korwa aase aye, ae abanto bamenyete ase ense egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo. Okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ase ense nkobe maiso marore, na ense tekogenderera kobisa abanto abwo baitetwe.

English: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, Bwana ataadhibu kwa upanga wake, upanga wake mkali, mkubwa na wenye nguvu, ataadhibu Lewiathani yule nyoka apitaye kwa mwendo laini, Lewiathani yule nyoka mwenye kujipinda; atamuua joka huyo mkubwa sana wa baharini.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene nae Leviatani, eng’iti eria y’okwoboyia, enyango ekwemiina, egesusuro. Nayeite n’omoro oye ore omokong’u na omonene, na ore ne chinguru; boigo naite enchoka eria ere ime ase enyancha.

English: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile: “Imbeni kuhusu shamba la mizabibu lililozaa:
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio omogondo bw’emesabibu ore nedivai enyinge nobeo. Notererwe ogoteera oko:

English: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
Kiswahili: Mimi, Bwana, ninalitunza, nalinyweshea maji mfululizo. Ninalichunga usiku na mchana ili mtu yeyote asije akalidhuru.
Ekegusii: “Inche Omonene, ninche inde omorendi bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu, nigo nkoyoitororera amaache kera engaki; nigo inyorendete obotuko na omobaso, erinde onde tabaisa koyosaria.

English: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
Kiswahili: Mimi sijakasirika. Licha pangekuwepo michongoma na miiba kunikabili! Ningepambana dhidi yake katika vita, ningeliichoma moto yote.
Ekegusii: Inche tindi nendamwamu. Nonya amagwa na amageri are gocha kondwania nigo nare koyarwania na koyasambera amo.

English: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”
Kiswahili: Au niwaache waje kwangu kwa ajili ya kupata kimbilio, wao na wafanye amani nami, naam, wafanye amani nami.”
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto babwaterere oborendi bwane mbarende ne chinguru chiane; tiga bakore omorembe nainche, ee, barabwo mbabe nomorembe nainche.”

English: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
Kiswahili: Katika siku zijazo, Yakobo atatia mizizi, Israeli atatoa chipukizi na kuchanua maua, naye atajaza ulimwengu wote kwa matunda.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko agochi‐gocha Omonene nae abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo ribaga baseboke, ee, Abaisraeli mbasokie ebisicha na ebisebo, mbaame amatunda aichore ase ense yonsi.

English: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?
Kiswahili: Je, Bwana amempiga vile alivyowapiga wale waliompiga? Je, yeye ameuawa vile walivyouawa wale waliomuua yeye?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonene naagete Abaisraeli buna aagete ababisa babo? Gose Abaisraeli mbaitetwe buna ababisa babo baitetwe?

English: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
Kiswahili: Kwa vita na kwa kumfukuza unapingana naye: kwa mshindo wake mkali anamfukuza, kama siku ile uvumapo upepo wa mashariki.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaamereranetie nabarabwo okabaa egesusuro ase ekerengo, okarenta omwaga omotindi korwa moocha, okabaseria.

English: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.
Kiswahili: Kwa hili, basi, hatia ya Yakobo itafanyiwa upatanisho, nalo hili litakuwa matunda ya utimilizo wa kuondolewa kwa dhambi yake: Wakati atakapoyafanya mawe yote ya madhabahu kuwa kama mawe ya chokaa yaliyopondwa vipande vipande, hakuna nguzo za Ashera au madhabahu za kufukizia uvumba zitakazobaki zimesimama.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo mbachenwe korwa ase ogosaria kwabo, na okorusigwa okwo kw’ebibe nkorente okwama ogoikeranu, ekero amagena onsi ay’ebisasimero arasenyentwe buna amagena ’echooka, na emete y’Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu, na ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani, biratagorwe bionsi.

English: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.
Kiswahili: Mji ulio na boma umebaki ukiwa, makao yaliyotelekezwa, yaliyoachwa kama jangwa. Huko ndama hulisha, huko hujilaza, wanakwanyua matawi yake.
Ekegusii: Omochie ogiteire chindwaki ong’anyirwe, otamirwe na gotigwa bosa, obeire buna erooro; agwo nao chimori chikorisia na korara, chiaba chikoria amato e chinsagia chireo.

English: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.
Kiswahili: Wakati vijiti vyake vimekauka, huvunjwa nao wanawake huja na kuwasha navyo moto. Kwa kuwa hili ni taifa lisilo na ufahamu, kwa hiyo yeye aliyewafanya hana huruma juu yao, Muumba wao hawaonyeshi fadhili.
Ekegusii: Ekero chinsagia chiomire, nigo chikobuneka, abakungu bacha bachiira bachiutera omorero. Abanto b’egesaku eke tibari nobong’aini, ase ayio oria obatongete takobarorera amabeebe, gose kobarorera amaabera.

English: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile Bwana atapura kutoka matiririko ya Mto Frati hadi Kijito cha Misri, nanyi ee Waisraeli, mtakusanywa mmoja mmoja.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene nabaswage inwe Abaisraeli buna chinyeke chi’endagera na kobachora oyomo oyomo. Nigo arachakere ase orooche rwa Eufarati na goikera ase akarooche ka Misiri.

English: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile tarumbeta kubwa italia. Wale waliokuwa wakiangamia katika nchi ya Ashuru, nao wale waliokuwa uhamishoni katika nchi ya Misri watakuja na kumwabudu Bwana katika mlima mtakatifu huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ekero engaki eyio eraike, engoma nebugigwe, na abanto abwo basirerete ase ense y’Abaasuri, na baria baseretigwe gochia ase ense ya Misiri, mbache gosasiima Omonene ase egetunwa egechenu agwo Yerusalemu.

English: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!
Kiswahili: Ole kwa lile taji la maua, kiburi cha walevi wa Efraimu, kwa ua linalosinyaa, uzuri wa utukufu wake, uliowekwa kwenye kichwa cha bonde lenye rutuba: kwa ule mji, kiburi cha wale walioshushwa na mvinyo!
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwao aye ore egutwa y’oboenenu bw’abaanto ba Efraimu batindire. Nigo ore buna egesicha giasusanire, obwari bw’obonene bwao bwasirire. Nigo ore ase egetunwa igoro, igoro ye rikura ritobu ri’abwo babuirwe nedivai.

English: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.
Kiswahili: Tazama, Bwana anaye mmoja aliye na uwezo na nguvu. Kama dhoruba ya mvua ya mawe na upepo uharibuo, kama mvua inyeshayo kwa nguvu na mafuriko yashukayo, atakiangusha chini kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Rora, Omonene nabwate oyomo ore nokobua ne chinguru; oyio nigo anga buna embura y’amagena, na buna omwaga omotindi ogosaria, na buna omoubera ore nembura enyinge oraiyerie ebinto bionsi inse ne chinguru.

English: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.
Kiswahili: Lile taji la maua, kiburi cha walevi cha Efraimu, kitakanyagwa chini ya nyayo.
Ekegusii: Egutwa y’oboenenu y’abanto b’Efraimu batindire netiringwe namagoro;

English: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.
Kiswahili: Lile ua linalosinyaa, uzuri wa utukufu wake, uliowekwa kwenye kichwa cha bonde lenye rutuba, litakuwa kama tini iliyoiva kabla ya mavuno: mara mtu aionapo, huichuma na kuila.
Ekegusii: na egesicha giasusanire kere obwari bw’obonene bwaye, ekio kere ase egetunwa igoro agwo ase rikura ritobu nkebe buna ogotongorwa kw’amako agotang’anera rigesa, ayio omonto akorora oyatwa, na ekero ayabeekire koboko oyaria.

English: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuwa taji la utukufu, taji zuri la maua kwa mabaki ya watu wake.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene bw’Emeganda nabe egutwa y’obonene, na ekiore ki’obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,

English: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
Kiswahili: Atakuwa roho ya haki kwa yeye aketiye katika kiti cha hukumu, chanzo cha nguvu kwa wale wazuiao vita langoni.
Ekegusii: naende nabe omoika bw’ogokora ayare ay’ekeene ase abwo bakogaamba ekiina, naende nabe chinguru chiabo abwo bagoseria ababisa agwo ase egeita.

English: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.
Kiswahili: Hawa pia wanapepesuka kwa sababu ya mvinyo, wanayumbayumba kwa sababu ya kileo: Makuhani na manabii wanapepesuka kwa sababu ya kileo, wanachanganyikiwa kwa sababu ya mvinyo; wanapepesuka wanapoona maono, wanajikwaa wanapotoa maamuzi.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nabarabwo batindire edivai; nigo bakoong’anya ase okonywa ebinyugwa bigotindia; abakuani na ababani batindire nebinyugwa bigotindia, na ekero bakorora amaroro nigo bakomocha, nigo bagotantana ekero bakonacha ebiina.

English: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.
Kiswahili: Meza zote zimejawa na matapishi wala hakuna sehemu hata ndogo isiyokuwa na uchafu.
Ekegusii: Chimesa chiabo chionsi chiaichoire namaroki, na aase ande tari atari nobonyinyeri.

English: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?
Kiswahili: “Yeye anajaribu kumfundisha nani? Yeye anamwelezea nani ujumbe wake? Je, ni kwa watoto walioachishwa kunyonya? Je, ni wale ambao ndipo tu wametolewa matitini?
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoteeba: “Ning’o Isaya aganetie kworokereria obong’aini, na ning’o ere aranyare komanyia amang’ana aye amaya? Inee! Nabana abake abwo batachirwe, abwo batigigwe kogonka?

English: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni: Amri juu ya amri, amri juu ya amri, kanuni juu ya kanuni, kanuni juu ya kanuni; hapa kidogo, kule kidogo.”
Ekegusii: Nigo agotoa ogochika igoro ase ogochika, ee, ogochika igoro ase ogochika; ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana, ee, ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana; aiga make, na aaria make.”

English: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,
Kiswahili: Sawa kabisa, kwa midomo migeni na kwa lugha ngeni, Mungu atasema na watu hawa,
Ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene nakwane nabaanto aba goetera ase abanto b’ebisaku ebiao, abwo bagokwana omonwa omogeni.

English: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.
Kiswahili: wale ambao aliwaambia, “Hapa ni mahali pa kupumzika, waliochoka na wapumzike,” na, “Hapa ni mahali pa mapumziko,” lakini hawakutaka kusikiliza.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo atebeetie abanto abwo: “Aiga nase agotimokerwa, tiga abwo barosire batimokere aiga, erinde banyore chinguru naende.” Korende abanto abwo tibaigwerete.

English: Therefore Yahweh’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, neno la Bwana kwao litakuwa: Amri juu ya amri, amri juu ya amri, kanuni juu ya kanuni, kanuni juu ya kanuni, hapa kidogo, kule kidogo: ili waende na kuanguka chali, wakijeruhiwa, wakinaswa na kukamatwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ring’ana ri’Omonene ase bare nigo rirabe iga: “Ogochika igoro ase ogochika, ee, ogochika igoro ase ogochika; ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana, ee, ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana; aiga make, na aaria make,” erinde kobagotaara babe bakogwa kemagega‐magega, babutokane, babe bagotegwa na kobwatwa.

English: Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sikieni neno la Bwana, enyi watu wenye dharau mnaotawala watu hawa wa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abachecheria aba mokogaambera abanto ba Yerusalemu, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

English: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnajisifu, “Tumefanya agano na mauti, tumefanya mapatano na kuzimu. Wakati pigo lifurikalo litakapopita, haliwezi kutugusa sisi, kwa kuwa tumefanya uongo kuwa kimbilio letu na miungu ya uongo kuwa mahali petu pa kujificha.”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba, “Intwe twakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namakweri, na twabwatanire nase abakuure; ekero emechando eyio emebe erache tegotoika ang’e, ekiagera twakorire oborimo bwabeire obotamero bwaito, na obong’ainereria bwabeire egekengero giaito.”

English: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana Mwenyezi asemavyo: “Tazama, ninaweka jiwe katika Sayuni, jiwe lililojaribiwa, jiwe la pembeni la thamani kwa ajili ya msingi thabiti. Yeye atumainiye kamwe hatatiwa hofu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Rora inche nkobeeka nde rigena ri’oboroso ase Sayoni, rigena rikong’u riateemirwe, rigena ri’ekoona ri’engencho enene rire oboroso obokong’u; na onde bwensi orariegene, takorua aroro.

English: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya haki kuwa kamba ya kupimia na uadilifu kuwa timazi; mvua ya mawe itafagia kimbilio lenu, huo uongo, nayo maji yatafurikia mahali penu pa kujificha.
Ekegusii: Ninkore ekeene kebe ekerengo gi’okorenga, na oboronge bobe ekebiro gekorenga. “Nindete embura y’amagena yabuse kegima oborimo bore obotamero bwaino, na emegoko ebonganie obwebiso bwaino.”

English: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
Kiswahili: Agano lenu na kifo litabatilishwa, patano lenu na kuzimu halitasimama. Wakati pigo lifurikalo litakapowakumba, litawaangusha chini.
Ekegusii: Erio okobwatana kw’ogotianania koria mwakorete namakweri ngosarigwe, na okobwatana kwaino mwakorete nase abakuure tigokogenderera kobao; ekero emechando eyio emebe erache, goika motiringerwe inse

English: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”
Kiswahili: Kila mara lijapo litawachukua, asubuhi baada ya asubuhi, wakati wa mchana na wakati wa usiku, litawakumba tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho.” Kuuelewa ujumbe huu utaleta hofu tupu.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana emechando eyio eraabe ekona‐gocha nebanyore inwe, neebe ekona‐gocha emambia ase emambia, ee, omobaso na obotuko. Nigo eraabe emechando emebe y’okoondokia ase okoigwa amang’ana ayio atomirwe.

English: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
Kiswahili: Kitanda ni kifupi mno kujinyoosha juu yake, nguo ya kujifunikia ni nyembamba mno mtu hawezi kujifunikia.
Ekegusii: Oborere nigo bore obweng’e omonto agosinywa kwerambora igoro ase borobwo, na ekiebisio nigo kere ekenyerere mono omonto atanyare kwebisia.

English: For Yahweh will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.
Kiswahili: Bwana atainuka kama alivyofanya kwenye Mlima Perasimu, ataghadhibika kama alivyofanya katika Bonde la Gibeoni: ili kufanya kazi yake, kazi yake ya ajabu, ili kutimiza kazi yake, kazi yake ngeni.
Ekegusii: Omonene naimoke akore buna akorete ase egetunwa gia Perasimu; nabe nendamwamu buna abeete ase Rikura ria Gibeoni; nakore ogokora kwaye kore okogeni, nakore emeremo yaye ere ey’ogokumia.

English: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, on the whole earth.
Kiswahili: Sasa acheni dharau zenu, la sivyo minyororo yenu itakuwa mizito zaidi. Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ameniambia habari za maangamizi yaliyoamriwa dhidi ya nchi yote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono timogenderera gochecheria, ebisibo biaino tibibaisa gokong’igwa, ekiagera naigure korwa ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ogochika kw’ogosirigwa gw’ense engima, okwo gotanyare gotigwa.

English: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni msikie sauti yangu, tegeni masikio na msikie niyasemayo.
Ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe eriogi riane; igwera amang’ana aane ngokwana!

English: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
Kiswahili: Wakati mkulima alimapo ili apande, je, hulima siku zote? Je, huendelea kubomoa ardhi na kusawazisha udongo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto okorema ng’a asimeke chimbusuro nigo akogenderera kona‐korema rioka? Inee! Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera kona‐koboosa rioka?

English: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?
Kiswahili: Akiisha kusawazisha shamba, je, hatapanyi mbegu za bizari na kutawanya jira? Je, hapandi ngano katika sehemu yake, shayiri katika eneo lake, na nafaka nyingine katika shamba lake?
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio ekero akoorire koroisia riroba, Inee, tari kobusura obotu bw’ebinsari bikorokwa dili na komini; naende obusura engano ase chindwaro, na esairi aase aye, na engano ende ase chingito?

English: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.
Kiswahili: Mungu wake humwelekeza na kumfundisha njia iliyo sahihi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oye nigo akomworokereria enchera engiya y’ogokora emeremo eyio.

English: For the dill isn’t threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.
Kiswahili: Iliki haipurwi kwa nyundo, wala gurudumu la gari halivingirishwi juu ya jira; iliki hupurwa kwa fimbo, na jira kwa ufito.
Ekegusii: Dili teri koorerwa nekeoorero gi’ekioma, gose komini teri koorwa namagoro e chigari, korende bionsi bibere nigo bigosusurerwa omote.

English: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.
Kiswahili: Nafaka lazima isagwe ili kutengeneza mkate, kwa hiyo mtu haendelei kuipura daima. Ingawa huendesha magurudumu ya gari lake la kupuria juu yake, farasi wake hawasagi.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoora engano, Inee, nkoyesunyunta are? Yaya, tari kogenderera koyeoora naende, nigo arabaise koyesenyenta namagoro ’egari ekong’uswa ne chibarasi chiaye.

English: This also comes out from Yahweh of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
Kiswahili: Haya yote pia hutoka kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, mwenye mashauri ya ajabu, na anayepita wote kwa hekima.
Ekegusii: Amorokererio ayio nigo akorwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere nigo are omosemia bw’ogokumia, na obong’aini bwaye nobonene mono.

English: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;
Kiswahili: Ole wako, wewe Arieli, Arieli, mji alimokaa Daudi! Ongezeni mwaka kwa mwaka, na mzunguko wa sikukuu zenu uendelee.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwao aye Arieli, Arieli, omochie ase Daudi arenge gotoora. Omwaka ase omwaka imogenderere korenda Amatuko aino Amanene, na emeyega yaino.

English: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo nitauzunguka Arieli kwa jeshi, utalia na kuomboleza, utakuwa kwangu kama mahali pa kuwashia moto madhabahuni.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nindete emechando asore Arieli, okorera na okweumia mbibe ime yao, na aye omochie nobe ase ’nde Arieli bori.

English: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.
Kiswahili: Nitapiga kambi pande zote dhidi yako, nitakuzunguka kwa minara na kupanga mazingirwa yangu dhidi yako.
Ekegusii: Nintoore asore ngoetanane, ng’agache chiburi chi’okoboera na gokorwania.

English: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.
Kiswahili: Utakaposhushwa, utanena kutoka ardhini, utamumunya maneno yako kutoka mavumbini. Sauti yako itatoka katika nchi kama vile ya mzimu, utanongʼona maneno yako toka mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto bamenyete ime yao mbaiyerigwe inse, babe bagokwana korwa riroba inse, na amang’ana abo naigweke korwa ase orotu ime ng’ora ng’ora, ee, amariogi abo narwe inse ye riroba buna eriogi ri’ekerecha, nigo barabe bakomonya korwa ase orotu ime.

English: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.
Kiswahili: Lakini adui zako wengi watakuwa kama vumbi laini, kundi la wakatili watakuwa kama makapi yapeperushwayo. Naam, ghafula, mara moja,
Ekegusii: Korende ababisa bao bare omoganda omonene mbairurukigwe buna orotu; na omoganda bw’abare abatindi noirurukigwe buna omoiriro gochia aare. Amang’ana ayio nigo arabe mobosokano, ee, nigo arabe mobosokano mono.

English: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuja na ngurumo, tetemeko la ardhi, na kwa sauti kuu, atakuja na dhoruba, tufani na miali ya moto iteketezayo.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda naake abanto bao ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw’ense, na egeturi ekenene, na ekerambauti, na embura omoubera, na amasaria ’omorero ogosamba.

English: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
Kiswahili: Kisha makundi ya mataifa yote yale yapiganayo dhidi ya Arieli, yale yanayomshambulia yeye na ngome zake, na kumzunguka kwa jeshi, watakuwa kama ilivyo ndoto, kama maono wakati wa usiku:
Ekegusii: Abanto abange b’ebisaku bionsi abwo bakorwania Arieli, ee, bonsi abakorwania omochie oyio, na gotagora chiburi chiaye, na koyorentera emechando, nigo barasirigwe, beebwe buna okorota gokwebwa, ee, buna okorora kwa botuko gokwebwa.

English: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.
Kiswahili: kama vile mtu aliye na njaa aotavyo kuwa anakula, lakini huamka, bado njaa yake ingalipo, kama vile mtu mwenye kiu aotavyo kuwa anakunywa maji, lakini huamka akiwa anazimia, akiwa bado angali ana kiu. Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa kwa makundi yote ya mataifa yanayopigana dhidi ya Mlima Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, abwo bakorwania Egetunwa gia Sayoni, nigo barabe buna omonto ore nenchara akorota ng’a nkoragera are, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nenchara, gose buna oyore nerang’o akorota ng’a nkonywa are amaache, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nerang’o.

English: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
Kiswahili: Duwaeni na kushangaa, jifanyeni vipofu wenyewe na msione, leweni, lakini si kwa mvinyo, pepesukeni lakini si kwa kileo.
Ekegusii: Tenena mokumie, ee, mokumie! Ekore mobe emeuko, mogenderere goukora! Etindie, korende tari ase okonywa edivai; ong’anya, korende tari ase okonywa ekenyugwa kegotindia.

English: For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.
Kiswahili: Bwana amewaleteeni usingizi mzito: Ameziba macho yenu (ninyi manabii); amefunika vichwa vyenu (ninyi waonaji).
