Ekegusii: Omonene obaitereire inwe omoika bw’okorara chitoro chindito; oukoirie amaiso ’ababani, abwo bare amaiso aino, na otubire emetwe y’abarori, abwo bare emetwe yaino.

English: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwenu ninyi, maono haya yote si kitu ila maneno yaliyotiwa lakiri katika kitabu. Kama mkimpa mtu yeyote awezaye kusoma kitabu hiki, nanyi mkamwambia, “Tafadhali kisome,” yeye atajibu, “Mimi siwezi, kwa kuwa kimetiwa lakiri.”
Ekegusii: Amaroro ayio onsi ay’obobani ebei re ase more buna amang’ana ’egetabu memumekeirie na kobekwa ekemanyererio. Ekero abanto bakoira egetabu eyio ase omonto omanyete gosoma, bamoteebia: “Soma amang’ana ’egetabu eke,” ere nigo agokana oteeba: “Tinkonyara, ekiagera amang’ana aya nigo abeire buna ey’egetabu kemumekeire ebekire ekemanyererio.”

English: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”
Kiswahili: Au kama mkimpa mtu yeyote kitabu hiki asiyeweza kusoma na kumwambia, “Tafadhali kisome,” atajibu, “Mimi sijui kusoma.”
Ekegusii: Naende bayea oyotamanyeti gosoma, bamoteebia: “Soma amang’ana ’egetabu eke,” nere nigo agokana, oteeba, “Timanyeti gosoma.”

English: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;
Kiswahili: Bwana anasema: “Watu hawa hunikaribia kwa vinywa vyao na kuniheshimu kwa midomo yao, lakini mioyo yao iko mbali nami. Ibada yao kwangu inatokana na maagizo waliyofundishwa na wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Abanto aba nigo bakong’ika ang’e ase ogokwana nemenwa yabo na gonsika nebikoba biabo, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa ase ’nde, na okonyiroka kwabo nigo kore amachiiko Mwanyabaanto borokereretie.

English: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mara nyingine tena nitawashangaza watu hawa, kwa ajabu juu ya ajabu. Hekima ya wenye hekima itapotea, nayo akili ya wenye akili itatoweka.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, rora, ningenderere gokora amang’ana ay’ogokumia ase abanto aba, ee, amang’ana ayio nigo arabe ay’ogokumigwa na goichanwa; obong’aini bw’abaanto babo bare abang’aini mbosire, na okomanya kw’abamanyete mono nkobiswe.

English: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”
Kiswahili: Ole kwa wale wanaokwenda kwenye vilindi virefu kumficha Bwana mipango yao, wafanyao kazi zao gizani na kufikiri, “Ni nani anayetuona? Ni nani atakayejua?”
Ekegusii: Obobe nobw’abaanto abwo bagokora emeroberio yabo erio bayebisa aase aatambe ng’a Omonene tayerora. Abanto abwo nigo bagokora ogokora kwabo ase chinchera chi’omosunte, erio bateeba, “Ning’o otorooche? Ning’o otomanyete?”

English: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?
Kiswahili: Mnapindua mambo juu chini, kana kwamba mfinyanzi aweza kufikiriwa kuwa kama udongo wa mfinyanzi! Je, kile kilichofinyangwa chaweza kumwambia yule aliyekifinyanga, “Wewe hukunifinyanga mimi?” Je, chungu kinaweza kumwambia mfinyanzi, “Wewe hujui chochote?”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoonchorana amang’ana bobe. Inee! Omokori chinyongo nareng’anigwe nesike? Egento keroisirie ngetebie oyokeroisetie, “Tari aye kwandoisetie”; gose egento omonto abombete nkemoteebie, “Tomanyeti kende”?

English: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?
Kiswahili: Kwa muda mfupi sana, je, Lebanoni haitageuzwa kuwa shamba lenye rutuba, na shamba lenye rutuba liwe kama msitu?
Ekegusii: Engaki netigarete enke, erio rinani ria Lebanoni riraonchorwe ribe omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge; na omogondo oria orenge kwama chindagera chinyinge oonchorwe obe rinani.

English: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile viziwi watasikia maneno ya kitabu, na katika utusitusi na giza macho ya kipofu yataona.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio emetino neebe ekoigwa amang’ana ariikire ase egetabu, na emeuko yarenge ekorora buna rikongori na omosunte, nerore buya namaiso abo.

English: The humble also will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mara nyingine tena wanyenyekevu watafurahi katika Bwana, wahitaji watafurahi katika yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abaitongo nabanyore omogooko omoyia kobare ime ase Omonene, na abataka bare ase Mwanyabaanto mbagokere Omonene ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—
Kiswahili: Wakatili watatoweka na wenye kudhihaki watatokomea, nao wote wenye jicho la uovu watakatiliwa mbali,
Ekegusii: Abakoirokia abande mbasirigwe, na abachecheria tibakobao; abwo bonsi bakorigia gokora amabe mbaitwe tibaabao.

English: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.
Kiswahili: wale ambao kwa neno humfanya mtu kuwa mwenye hatia, wamtegeao mtego mtetezi katika mahakama, na kwa ushuhuda wa uongo humnyima haki yeye asiye na hatia.
Ekegusii: Omonene nasirie abanto abwo bagosiria abande namang’ana abo, abwo bakobeeka omoeto ase oyo okogaamba ebiina agwo ase egeita, bakwana oborimo na koonchorana oboronge bw’omonto ore omooronge.

English: Therefore Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana, aliyemkomboa Abrahamu, analosema kwa nyumba ya Yakobo: “Yakobo hataaibishwa tena, wala nyuso zao hazitabadilika sura tena.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene, oria obooretie Aburaamu, okwanire amang’ana aya igoro y’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, “Abanto ba Yakobo tibakogenderera koba nobosooku; amasio abo takoirura nonya ng’ake naende.

English: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Wakati watakapoona watoto wao miongoni mwao, kazi ya mikono yangu, watalitakasa Jina langu takatifu; wataukubali utakatifu wa yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Yakobo, nao watamcha Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ekero abana babo bararore emeremo y’amaboko aane, eye nakorete ase egati yabo, mbachene erieta riane ime yabo, naende banche ng’a inche n’Omochenu o Yakobo inde, mbabe bateneine banyirogete inche Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”
Kiswahili: Wale wanaopotoka rohoni watapata ufahamu, nao wale wanaolalamika watayakubali mafundisho.”
Ekegusii: Erio abwo basirire ase omoika mbaegwe okomanya, na abwo bakwemurungania mbanche amorokererio.”

English: “Woe to the rebellious children”, says Yahweh, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin;
Kiswahili: Bwana asema, “Ole kwa watoto wakaidi, kwa wale wanaotimiza mipango ambayo si yangu, wakifanya makubaliano, lakini si kwa Roho wangu, wakilundika dhambi juu ya dhambi,
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Obobe nobwaino inwe abana baane abamore abasaria, aba mogokora emeroberio etari eyaane, nigo mogokora okobwatana okwo gotari okw’omoika one, na mwamenta ebibe igoro ase ebibe binde.

English: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice, to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!
Kiswahili: wale washukao kwenda Misri bila kutaka shauri langu, wanaotafuta msaada wa ulinzi wa Farao, watafutao kivuli cha Misri kwa ajili ya kimbilio.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogenda ase Misiri korigia ogokonywa korwa ase Farao, korende timori korigia ogosemigwa korwa ase ’nde. Nigo mokorigia obotamero ase ekiriri kia Misiri.

English: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
Kiswahili: Lakini ulinzi wa Farao utakuwa kwa aibu yenu, kivuli cha Misri kitawaletea fedheha.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio chinguru chia Farao nchionchoke chibe obosooku bwaino; na obotamero bwaino ase ekiriri kia Misiri mbobarentere ogochaywa.

English: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.
Kiswahili: Ingawa wana maafisa katika Soani na wajumbe wamewasili katika Hanesi,
Ekegusii: Nonya abagaambi baino bare ase omochie o Soani, na abatomirwe baikire ase omochie o Hanesi,

English: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”
Kiswahili: kila mmoja ataaibishwa kwa sababu ya taifa lisilowafaa kitu, ambalo haliwaletei msaada wala faida, bali aibu tu na fedheha.”
Ekegusii: kera oyomo nasooke, ekiagera mosemeretie abanto b’egesaku batanyare kobaa ebitoki binde, korende nobosooku na ogochaywa.”

English: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.
Kiswahili: Neno kuhusu wanyama wa Negebu: Katika nchi ya taabu na shida, ya simba za dume na jike, ya nyoka mwenye sumu kali na nyoka warukao, wajumbe huchukua utajiri wao juu ya migongo ya punda, hazina zao juu ya nundu za ngamia, kwa lile taifa lisilokuwa na faida,
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ye ching’iti chia Irianyi. Abanto abwo nigo bagoeta ase ense ere nemechando na omoichano, ase chindo chiaberi ne chindo chinde chimenyete amo namarubi, ne chinchoka chikoiruruka. Nigo bakobeerekia chitigere chinibo chiabo, ne chikungo chiabo bachibeeka ase chisukubi chie chingamia, bagenda ase abanto batabae bitoki binde.

English: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.
Kiswahili: kuvipeleka Misri, ambaye msaada wake haufai kabisa. Kwa hiyo nimemwita “Rahabu Asiyefanya Chochote.”
Ekegusii: Ogokonywa kwa Misiri nigo kore bosa; ase ayio narokire ense eyio “Rahabu etari gokora gento.”

English: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Nenda sasa, liandike neno hili juu ya kibao kwa ajili yao, liandike kwenye kitabu, ili liweze kuwa shahidi milele kwa ajili ya siku zijazo.
Ekegusii: Bono genda, orike amang’ana ayio ase ebao agwo ase amasio abo, na oyarike ime ase egetabu, erinde abe kirori ase amatuko agochi‐gocha goika kare na kare.

English: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear Yahweh’s law;
Kiswahili: Hawa ni watu waasi, watoto wadanganyifu, watoto ambao hawataki kusikiliza mafundisho ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bare abasaria, abana abanyaborimo, abana batari koigwera amachiiko ’Omonene.

English: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.
Kiswahili: Wanawaambia waonaji, “Msione maono tena!” Nako kwa manabii wanasema, “Msiendelee kutupatia maono ambayo ni ya kweli! Tuambieni mambo ya kupendeza, tabirini mambo ya uongo.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoteebia abarori b’amaroro: “Timobaisa korora amang’ana,” na bateebia ababani: “Timobaisa gotobaanera amang’ana amaronge; toteebie amang’ana amororo aya agotwansera, motobaanere ay’obong’ainereria.

English: Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”
Kiswahili: Acheni njia hii, ondokeni katika mapito haya, nanyi acheni kutukabili pamoja na yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli!”
Ekegusii: Karue inchera, gobera korwa ase oboeto, morusie ase tore Oyio ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.”

English: Therefore the Holy One of Israel says, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo asemalo yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli: “Kwa sababu mmekataa ujumbe huu, mkategemea uonevu na kutumainia udanganyifu,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli oteebire iga: “Inwe mwachayire ring’ana eri, mwanchire amang’ana ’obobe na obong’ainereria, naro mosemeretie.

English: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.
Kiswahili: dhambi hii itakuwa kwenu kama ukuta mrefu, wenye ufa na wenye kubetuka, ambao unaanguka ghafula, mara moja.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, okomocha oko kw’ebibe nkobe ase more buna obotandoku bore ase orwaki orotambe rwekumbire, rore ang’e kogwa, na okogwa kwaye nigo korache bwango mobosokano.

English: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”
Kiswahili: Utavunjika vipande vipande kama chombo cha udongo ukipasuka pasipo huruma ambapo katika vipande vyake hakuna kipande kitakachopatikana kwa kuukulia makaa kutoka jikoni au kuchotea maji kisimani.”
Ekegusii: Okogwa okwo nkobe buna ogwatwa kw’enyongo y’omokori chinyongo egotinerwa inse, nonya norogio oromo rw’enyongo eyio tirori gotoka omonto araancharere omorero, gose arabuchere amaache korwa ase ensoko.”

English: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli, asemalo: “Katika kutubu na kupumzika ndio wokovu wenu, katika kutulia na kutumaini ndizo nguvu zenu, lakini hamkutaka.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Nyasae, Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli agoteeba: “Komorang’iranere mobe abatoereru imotooreke; ase oboremereria na ogosemeria monyore chinguru.” Korende inwe mwangire gokora bo.

English: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.
Kiswahili: Mlisema, ‘Hapana, tutakimbia kwa farasi.’ Kwa hiyo mtakimbia! Mlisema, ‘Tutakimbia kwa farasi waendao kasi.’ Kwa hiyo wanaowafukuza watakwenda kasi!
Ekegusii: Nigo mogoteeba ng’a moriine chibarasi chikominyoka mono, motame. Ee, goika motame. Inwe moganetie gotama ne chibarasi chinyango, korende ababisa baino abwo bakobabwatia nigo bare abaminyoki kobabua.

English: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.
Kiswahili: Watu 1,000 watakimbia kwa ajili ya kitisho cha mtu mmoja, kwa vitishio vya watu watano wote mtakimbia, hadi mtakapoachwa kama mlingoti wa bendera juu ya kilele cha mlima, kama bendera juu ya kilima.”
Ekegusii: Abanto baino elifu eyemo mbaserigwe ase okogoswa nomonto oyomo, gose nabaanto batano, goika abatigari baino babe buna omoenga oyomo ore ase egetunwa igoro, na buna ekemanyererio keimokereirie ase ekerogo igoro.

English: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo Bwana anatamani kutupatia neema, anainuka ili kuwaonyesha huruma. Kwa kuwa Bwana ni Mungu wa haki. Wamebarikiwa wote wanaomngojea yeye!
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene nigo aganyete ng’a anyare kobakorera amaya; na ase ayio, neimokererie igoro mono goika abe okobarorera amaabera, ekiagera Omonene nigo are Nyasae bw’oboronge. Mbarenomogooko abanto bonsi abamoganyete.

English: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.
Kiswahili: Enyi watu wa Sayuni, mnaoishi Yerusalemu, hamtalia tena. Tazameni jinsi atakavyokuwa na huruma mtakapolia kwa kumwomba msaada! Mara asikiapo, atawajibu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete Sayoni agwo Yerusalemu, timokogenderera korera naende. Ekeene, Omonene nabakorere amaya ekero mokorera asare; ekero araigwe eriogi ri’okorera kwaino nabairanerie.

English: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;
Kiswahili: Ingawa Bwana huwapa chakula cha shida na maji ya taabu, walimu wenu hawatafichwa tena, kwa macho yenu wenyewe mtawaona.
Ekegusii: Nony’Omonene ogochia kobaa inwe omogati ekero more nemechando, na amaache ekero more nobororo, aborokia baino tibakogenderera kwebisa, korende mobe mokobarora namaiso aino.

English: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”
Kiswahili: Mkigeuka kuume au kushoto, masikio yenu yatasikia sauti nyuma yenu ikisema, “Hii ndiyo njia, ifuateni.”
Ekegusii: Komorabe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera gochia ensemo y’okorio, gose ey’okobee, inwe namoigwe korwa magega yaino amang’ana aya: “Enchera neye, yebwatie.”

English: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”
Kiswahili: Kisha mtanajisi sanamu zenu zilizofunikwa kwa fedha, na vinyago vyenu vilivyofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Mtazitupilia mbali kama vitambaa vya wakati wa hedhi na kuziambia, “Haya, tokeni hapa!”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio moimokie emegwekano yaino mogosasiima, eyio ebachire na koomwa ne chifeta, na eyende ebombire na koomwa netaabu, moyetugute buna ebinto bitachenegeti, moyetebie: “Karue aa ase tore!”

English: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.
Kiswahili: Pia atawapa mvua kwa ajili ya mbegu mnazootesha ardhini, chakula kinachotoka ardhini kitakuwa kizuri sana, tena tele. Katika siku ile, ngʼombe wenu watalisha katika shamba pana la majani.
Ekegusii: Erio ekero morabe mogosimeka chimbusuro chiaino, Omonene nachitwerie embura, erinde chindagera chiaino chiame, nainwe monyore chindagera chinyinge chingiya. Ekero ekio chitugo chiaino nchinyore amarisio amagare.

English: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.
Kiswahili: Maksai na punda walimao watakula majani makavu na vyakula vilivyotengenezwa, vinavyotandazwa kwa uma na sepeto.
Ekegusii: Chiombe ne chitigere chiaino, echio mokoremia ase emegondo yaino, nchinyore chindagera chingiya chisongire noroteru na goswagwa, chiochoganirie nomonyoo, chirie.

English: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ile ya mauaji makuu, wakati minara itakapoanguka, vijito vya maji vitatiririka juu ya kila mlima mrefu na kila kilima kilichoinuka sana.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ekero ogoitwa okonene korabe, ne chindwaki chinkong’u chiraiyerigwe, chindooche nchituboke korwa ase ebitunwa ebitambe bionsi na ebigoro biimokererete igoro.

English: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.
Kiswahili: Mwezi utaangaza kama jua, nao mwanga wa jua utangʼaa mara saba zaidi, kama nuru ya siku saba, wakati Bwana atakapoyafunga majeraha ya watu wake na kuwaponya vidonda alivyowatia.
Ekegusii: Oborabu bw’omotienyi mborabe se buna omobaso bw’erioba, na omobaso bw’erioba nobare ara gatano na kabere, buna okobara kw’amatuko atano na abere. Amang’ana ayio nigo arakorekane ekero Omonene araboe chingoma na agwenie amaakwa aagete abanto baye.

English: Behold, Yahweh’s name comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation. His tongue is as a devouring fire.
Kiswahili: Tazama, Jina la Bwana linakuja kutoka mbali, likiwa na hasira kali inayowaka pamoja na wingu zito la moshi, midomo yake imejaa ghadhabu na ulimi wake ni moto ulao.
Ekegusii: Rora, erieta ri’Omonene ngocha rire korwa aare. Nigo agocha ore nendamwamu ekobera, ne rikundesi rinene ri’erioki; amang’ana ’ebikoba biaye nigo aichire nekeririanda, na oromeme rwaye nigo rore buna omorero ogosiria.

English: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.
Kiswahili: Pumzi yake ni kama mkondo wa maji yaendayo kasi, yakipanda hadi shingoni. Hutikisa mataifa katika chekecheke ya uharibifu, huweka lijamu katika mataya ya mataifa ambayo huwaongoza upotevuni.
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene oye nigo onga orooche roichire goika ebigoti. Nasonge abanto b’ebisaku negesongero ki’ogosiria; ase emenwa yabo nigo arabeeke ebinto ase emenwa yabo bi’okobatantania.

English: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to Yahweh’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mtaimba kama usiku ule mnaadhimisha sikukuu takatifu. Mioyo yenu itashangilia kama vile watu wanapokwea na filimbi kwenye mlima wa Bwana, kwa Mwamba wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Inwe motere ogoteera buna nokw’omoyega omochenu bw’obotuko; chinkoro chiaino nchibe nomogooko buna ekero abanto bakobugia ebiroria kobagotiira gochia ase egetunwa ki’Omonene, ere oyore Egetare ki’Abaisraeli.

English: Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.
Kiswahili: Bwana atawasababisha watu waisikie sauti yake ya utukufu, naye atawafanya wauone mkono wake ukishuka pamoja na hasira yake kali na moto ulao, kukiwa na tufani ya mvua, ngurumo za radi na mvua ya mawe.
Ekegusii: Omonene naake eriogi riaye ri’obonene na abanto bariigwe, na ogoaka kw’endamwamu gokorwa ase okoboko kwaye kororekane. Nigo araake goetera ase omorero ogosamba na gosiria, na omwaga bw’echinguru, na embura y’omoubera, na amagena ’embura.

English: For through Yahweh’s voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya Bwana itaivunjavunja Ashuru, kwa fimbo yake ya utawala atawapiga.
Ekegusii: Ase eriogi ri’Omonene, na ase ogoaka nenyimbo yaye, Abaasuri mbaondoke mono.

English: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which Yahweh will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.
Kiswahili: Kila pigo Bwana atakaloliweka juu yao kwa fimbo yake ya kuadhibu, litakuwa kwa wimbo wa matari na vinubi, anapopigana nao katika vita kwa mapigo ya mkono wake.
Ekegusii: Omonene naimokie enyimbo yaye abae egesusuro, na ekero arabe ogoaka abanto abwo, abanto baye mbabe bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano. Omonene omonyene nere orabarwanie esegi aande onsi.

English: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, it is prepared for the king. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. Yahweh’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.
Kiswahili: Tofethi imeandaliwa toka zamani, imewekwa tayari kwa ajili ya mfalme. Shimo lake la moto limetengenezwa kwa kina kirefu na kwa upana mkubwa, likiwa na moto na kuni tele; pumzi ya Bwana, kama kijito cha kiberiti, huuwasha moto.
Ekegusii: Aase ogosambera ebing’wanso bi’okogechia nigo aroisetigwe kare; ee aase agwo nigo aroiseretigwe omorwoti. Aase agwo nigo are aatambe na aagare, aichorigwe chinko na omorero. Omoika bw’omonwa Omonene, onga buna omorero bw’amagena akoyia, noro orayouterere.

English: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek Yahweh!
Kiswahili: Ole wao wale washukao Misri kwa ajili ya msaada, wale wategemeao farasi, wanaoweka tumaini katika wingi wa magari yao ya vita, na katika nguvu nyingi za wapanda farasi, lakini hawamwangalii yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli, wala hawatafuti msaada kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bagotirimboka gochia Misiri korigia ogokonywa, abwo basemeretie chibarasi ne chigari, ekiagera chire chinyinge, na abariini chibarasi, ekiagera bare ne chinguru, korende tibari korigia Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, gose korigia ogosesenigwa korwa ase Omonene oyio.

English: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo yeye pia ana hekima na anaweza kuleta maafa, wala hayatangui maneno yake. Yeye atainuka dhidi ya nyumba ya mwovu, dhidi ya wale ambao huwasaidia watenda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo are omong’aini na nigo akorenta obobe gose tari koonchora amang’ana aye. Nae eamate y’abakori amabe egesusuro, boigo nae abakoonyi b’abagokora amabe egesusuro.

English: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahweh stretches out his hand, both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wamisri ni wanadamu, wala si Mungu, farasi wao ni nyama, wala si roho. Wakati Bwana atakaponyoosha Mkono wake, yeye anayesaidia atajikwaa, naye anayesaidiwa ataanguka, wote wawili wataangamia pamoja.
Ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo bare Mwanyabaanto, tibari Nyasae; chibarasi chiabo nigo chire emebere, tichiri emeika. Ekero Omonene ararambore okoboko kwaye, abwo bagokonya mbagochwe, na abwo bagokonywa bagwe; bonsi nigo barasirigwe amo.

English: For Yahweh says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so Yahweh of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana analoniambia: “Kama vile simba angurumavyo, simba mkubwa juu ya mawindo yake: hata ingawa kundi lote la wachunga mifugo huitwa pamoja dhidi yake, hatiwi hofu na kelele zao wala kusumbuliwa na ghasia zao; ndivyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakavyoshuka kufanya vita juu ya Mlima Sayuni na juu ya vilele vyake.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene antebetie; “Buna koreng’ana endo ensae ekoronya ase eng’iti yaitire, na teri kogoswa namariogi ’omoganda bw’abarisia, gose teri kwoboa egeturi kiabo, naboigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ndache korwana ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase ekegoro kiaye.

English: As birds hovering, so Yahweh of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”
Kiswahili: Kama ndege warukao, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ataukinga Yerusalemu; ataukinga na kuuokoa, atapita juu yake na kuufanya salama.”
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana chinyoni chikorambora chimbaaba chiabo, naboigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ndaegere Yerusalemu; ninyorende na koyobooria; ninyororere amaabera na koyotooria.”

English: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Mrudieni yeye ambaye nyumba ya Israeli imemwasi sana.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, moiranere oria mwasaretie asare mokamotiga.

English: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa katika siku ile kila mmoja wenu atazikataa sanamu za fedha na za dhahabu zilizotengenezwa kwa mikono yenu yenye dhambi.
Ekegusii: Engaki ngocha ere kera omonto aratugute emegwekano yaye agosasiima eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitaabu, eyio mwaroisetie namaboko aino, na igo mogakora ebibe.

English: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.
Kiswahili: “Ashuru itaanguka kwa upanga ambao si wa mwanadamu; upanga usio wa kibinadamu utawaangamiza. Watakimbia mbele ya upanga na vijana wao wa kiume watafanyizwa kazi kwa lazima.
Ekegusii: “Abaasuri mbaitwe nemioro, korende tari eya Mwanyabaanto, ee, emioro etari eya Mwanyabaanto nebasirie. Abanto abwo mbatame korwa ase esegi, na abamura babo mbairwe ase obosomba, bakore emeremo ase okobetererigwa.

English: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says Yahweh, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Ngome zao zitaanguka kwa sababu ya hofu; kwa kuona bendera ya vita, majemadari wao watashikwa na hofu ya ghafula,” asema Bwana, ambaye moto wake uko Sayuni, nayo tanuru yake iko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Oyore egetare kiabo natame ore nomoondoko omonge; na abakogaamba amo nere mbatame ase okogoswa ekero bararore ebendera y’esegi.” Omonene, oyio omorero oye ore ase Sayoni, na ekebemberi kiaye ki’omorero kere Yerusalemu, oteebire amang’ana ayio.

English: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.
Kiswahili: Tazama, mfalme atatawala kwa uadilifu na watawala watatawala kwa haki.
Ekegusii: Rora, omorwoti naoroke oragaambe ase oboronge, na abagaambi b’obogaambi mbagambe bakore ay’ekeene.

English: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu atakuwa kama kivuli cha kujificha kutokana na upepo na kimbilio kutokana na dhoruba, kama vijito vya maji jangwani na kivuli cha mwamba mkubwa katika ardhi yenye kiu.
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo nabe buna obwebiso ekero omwaga okogusa, na buna ekeigamero ekero embura y’omoubera egotwa; boigo mbabe buna chindooche chire ase ense enyomo, na buna ekiriri ki’egetare ekenene ase ense etari namaache.

English: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
Kiswahili: Ndipo macho ya wale wanaoona hayatafumbwa tena, nayo masikio ya wale wanaosikia yatasikiliza.
Ekegusii: Erio amaiso ’abaanto abwo bakorora tagoukora, na amato ’abaanto abwo bakoigwa naigwe.

English: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.
Kiswahili: Moyo wa mtu mwenye hamaki utafahamu na kuelewa, nao ulimi wenye kigugumizi utanena kwa ufasaha.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo batarenge ne chinkoro chi’oboremereria mbabe nebirengererio bi’okomanya, na abwo baarenge gotutura mbamanye gokwana buya na koigugwa buya.

English: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.
Kiswahili: Mpumbavu hataitwa tena muungwana, wala mtu mbaya kabisa kupewa heshima ya juu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio omonto omoriri takorokwa omosike, gose omong’ainereria takorokwa omonto omwegenwa.

English: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against Yahweh, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mpumbavu hunena upumbavu, moyo wake hushughulika na uovu: Hutenda mambo yasiyo ya kumcha Mungu, na hueneza habari za makosa kuhusu Bwana; yeye huwaacha wenye njaa bila kitu, na wenye kiu huwanyima maji.
Ekegusii: Omonto omoriri nigo agokwana amang’ana ’oboriri; ebirengererio biaye nigo bigokora emeroberio y’ogokora ebibe; nigo akwenaria gokora aya atari e chingencho chinchenu; nigo agokwana bobe igoro y’Omonene, na otiga korageria abare nenchara, na orina abare nerang’o amaache.

English: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
Kiswahili: Taratibu za mtu mbaya kabisa ni ovu, hufanya mipango miovu ili kumwangamiza maskini kwa uongo, hata wakati ambapo hoja za mhitaji ni za haki.
Ekegusii: Ebirwanero bi’omong’ainereria nigo bire ebi’obobe; ere nigo agokora emeroberio y’obosooku gosiria abachandegete ase okobateebera oborimo, nonya nekero barabwo bagokwana ay’oboronge bwabo.

English: But the noble devises noble things, and he will continue in noble things.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu muungwana hufanya mipango ya kiungwana, na kwa matendo ya kiungwana yeye hufanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Korende omonto omosike nigo akoroberia ay’obosike, na nigo agotenena ase ay’obosike.

English: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
Kiswahili: Enyi wanawake wenye kuridhika sana, amkeni na mnisikilize. Enyi binti mnaojisikia kuwa salama, sikieni lile ninalotaka kuwaambia!
Ekegusii: Inwe abakungu mweisanegetie, imoka, montegerere! Inwe abaiseke motechandereti kende, tegerera, moigwe amang’ana ngokwana!

English: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail. The harvest won’t come.
Kiswahili: Muda zaidi kidogo ya mwaka mmoja, ninyi mnaojisikia salama mtatetemeka, mavuno ya zabibu yatakoma na mavuno ya matunda hayatakuwepo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abakungu motechandereti kende, ekero amatuko aetanetie omwaka aerire mobe mogochandeka, ekiagera emesabibu tekwama, ne rigesa rie chindagera tirikoba.

English: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.
Kiswahili: Tetemekeni, enyi wanawake wenye kuridhika, tetemekeni kwa hofu, enyi binti mnaojisikia salama! Vueni nguo zenu, vaeni nguo ya gunia viunoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe abakungu motechandereti kende, iguswa, mwechabore chianga chiaino mobe getirianda, erio mweboyie chigunia.

English: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
Kiswahili: Pigeni matiti yenu kwa ajili ya mashamba mazuri, kwa ajili ya mizabibu iliyozaa vizuri
Ekegusii: Moake‐ake ebikuba biaino, ekiagera emegondo yaino emiya, na emesabibu yaino ekwama mono, yasarigwe,

English: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
Kiswahili: na kwa ajili ya nchi ya watu wangu, nchi ambayo miiba na michongoma imemea: naam, ombolezeni kwa ajili ya nyumba zote za furaha na kwa ajili ya mji huu wenye kufanya sherehe.
Ekegusii: na ekiagera amagwa na amageri biamerire ase ense y’abanto baane, mweake‐ake ase engencho ye chinyomba chi’emegoko chire ase omochie oyio oichire nomochengo.

English: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks,
Kiswahili: Ngome itaachwa, mji wenye kelele nyingi utahamwa, ngome ndani ya mji na mnara wa ulinzi vitakuwa ukiwa milele, mahali pazuri pa punda na malisho ya makundi ya kondoo,
Ekegusii: Chinyomba chi’oborwoti nchitigwe chire bosa, omochie oichire nabaanto nong’anywe, eburi na emerobiri y’obotengerero mbibe amakuruma kare na kare; agwo nao chitigere chi’orosana chiregokerie, na omochie oyio obe oborisia bw’amaicho e ching’iti.

English: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.
Kiswahili: mpaka Roho amwagwe juu yetu kutoka juu, nalo jangwa kuwa shamba lenye rutuba, na shamba lenye rutuba kuwa kama msitu.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio ntoitererwe Omoika korwa igoro, na aase arenge erooro abe omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge, na omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge noonchorwe obe rinani.

English: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.
Kiswahili: Haki itakaa katika jangwa, na uadilifu utakaa katika shamba lenye rutuba.
Ekegusii: Erio ekeene ngekorwe ase ense y’erooro, na oboronge bokorwe ase omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge.

English: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
Kiswahili: Matunda ya haki yatakuwa amani, matokeo ya haki yatakuwa utulivu na matumaini milele.
Ekegusii: Ayaratoke korwa ase oboronge nomorembe, na okwama kw’oboronge n’obotoereru na ogosemeria kwa botambe.

English: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,
Kiswahili: Watu wangu wataishi katika makao ya mahali pa amani, katika nyumba zilizo salama, katika mahali pa kupumzika pasipo na usumbufu.
Ekegusii: Abanto baane mbamenye ase chinyomba chire nomorembe babe barendire buya, mbabe batimogete ase obotoereru.

English: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.
Kiswahili: Hata kama mvua ya mawe iangushe msitu na mji ubomolewe kabisa,
Ekegusii: Ekero embura y’amagena eraabe egotwa neiyerie emete ye rinani, na omochie oino noiranigwe inse mono.

English: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
Kiswahili: tazama jinsi utakavyobarikiwa, ukipanda mbegu yako katika kila kijito, na kuwaacha ngʼombe wako na punda wajilishe kwa uhuru.
Ekegusii: Imosesenirie inwe aba mogosimeka chimbusuro mbarabare ase amaache onsi, mogotiga chiombe ne chitigere chiagenda aande onsi.

English: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.
Kiswahili: Ole wako wewe, ee mharabu, wewe ambaye hukuharibiwa! Ole wako, ee msaliti, wewe ambaye hukusalitiwa! Utakapokwisha kuharibu, utaharibiwa; utakapokwisha kusaliti, utasalitiwa.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino inwe aba mogosiria, ko inwe timwana gosirigwa! Obobe nobwaino inwe abaurereria, ko inwe timwana kourererigwa! Ekero morabe mwakoorire gosiria, nainwe mosirigwe, na ekero morabe mwakoorire kourereria, nainwe mourererigwe.

English: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, uturehemu, tunakutamani. Uwe nguvu yetu kila asubuhi na wokovu wetu wakati wa taabu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tororere amaabera; twabeire togosemeretie. Kabe chinguru chiaito kera rituko, na ototoorie ase engaki y’emechando.

English: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
Kiswahili: Kwa ngurumo ya sauti yako, mataifa yanakimbia; unapoinuka, mataifa hutawanyika.
Ekegusii: Ekero aye gwakanire neriogi ringa buna eri’okogukura, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bagotama, na ekero kwaimokereire igoro, barabwo nigo bagoserebekana.

English: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.
Kiswahili: Mateka yenu, enyi mataifa, yamevunwa kama vile wafanyavyo madumadu, kama kundi la nzige watu huvamia juu yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagocha baabasakora buna chingeeti chigosakora, na buna chingige chikoumokera, nabarabwo nabo bakobaumokera.

English: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametukuka, kwa kuwa anakaa mahali palipoinuka, ataijaza Sayuni kwa haki na uadilifu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo aimokererete igoro, ekiagera nigo amenyete igoro mono; naichorie Sayoni nekeene na oboronge.

English: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.
Kiswahili: Atakuwa msingi ulio imara kwa wakati wenu, ghala za wokovu tele, hekima na maarifa; kumcha Bwana ni ufunguo wa hazina hii.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki chiria Omonene nabae oborendi obuya, na obonge bw’ogotooreka, na obong’aini, na okomanya; okomoiroka Omonene nakwo korabe enibo yaino.

English: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
Kiswahili: Angalia, watu wake mashujaa wanapiga kelele kwa nguvu barabarani, wajumbe wa amani wanalia kwa uchungu.
Ekegusii: Igwa, abanto abwo bare chituoni nigo bakorera mono agwo isiko, na abwo batomirwe bare namang’ana ’omorembe nigo bakorera bare nobororo.

English: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
Kiswahili: Njia kuu zimeachwa, hakuna wasafiri barabarani. Mkataba umevunjika, mashahidi wake wamedharauliwa, hakuna yeyote anayeheshimiwa.
Ekegusii: Chinchera chinene chiasarekire, omoeti tari ogoeta aroro. Okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwasarigwe; emechie yachayirwe, na abanto tibasikiri.

English: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.
Kiswahili: Ardhi inaomboleza na kuchakaa, Lebanoni imeaibika na kunyauka, Sharoni ni kama Araba, nayo Bashani na Karmeli wanapukutisha majani yao.
Ekegusii: Ense nigo ekweumia, yaereirwe chinguru; rinani ria Lebanoni riasookire na gosusana; rikura ria Saroni riabeire buna Ekerubo Ekiomo, na emete ya Basani na Karimeli yaarorokire amato.

English: “Now I will arise,” says Yahweh. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.
Kiswahili: “Sasa nitainuka,” asema Bwana. “Sasa nitatukuzwa; sasa nitainuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Bono ningororoke ntenene, bono ninyimokerere igoro inyetogie.

English: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.
Kiswahili: Mlichukua mimba ya makapi, mkazaa mabua, pumzi yenu ni moto uwateketezao.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo morabe barito bw’obonyansi obwomo, moibore amasakwe. Omoika oino bw’okoeyana noro omorero orabasambe moere.

English: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yatachomwa kama ichomwavyo chokaa, kama vichaka vya miiba vilivyokatwa ndivyo watakavyochomwa.”
Ekegusii: Abanto mbasambwe bayie babe ribu, na buna amagwa akobutorwa asambwa nomorero.”

English: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”
Kiswahili: Ninyi mlio mbali sana, sikieni lile nililofanya; ninyi mlio karibu, tambueni uweza wangu!
Ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete aare, igwa aya nakorire; nainwe abamomenyete ang’e ancha na koorokia okobua kwane.

English: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
Kiswahili: Wenye dhambi katika Sayuni wametiwa hofu, kutetemeka kumewakumba wasiomcha Mungu: “Ni nani miongoni mwetu awezaye kuishi na moto ulao? Ni nani miongoni mwetu awezaye kuishi na moto unaowaka milele?”
Ekegusii: Abanyabibe bare Sayoni basoirwe nobwoba; omoondoko obabwatire abwo batamoirogeti Nyasae. “Monto ki oito oranyare koremereria amenye nomorero ogosiria? Ning’o ore ase tore oranyare komenya ime ase omorero oyio ogendererete gwoka kare na kare?”

English: He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—
Kiswahili: Yeye aendaye kwa uadilifu na kusema lililo haki, yeye anayekataa faida ipatikanayo kwa dhuluma na kuizuia mikono yake isipokee rushwa, yeye azuiaye masikio yake dhidi ya mashauri ya mauaji, na yeye afumbaye macho yake yasitazame sana uovu:
Ekegusii: Omonto okobwatia oboronge na gokwana amang’ana ’oboronge, oyio ogechete okonyora kw’ogokorera abande bobe na otangete amaboko aye tabwata riaaki, oyio otichete amato aye tabaisa koigwa amang’ana igoro y’ogoitera amanyinga, naende otari korigereria amang’ana ’obobe,

English: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.
Kiswahili: huyu ndiye mtu atakayeishi mahali pa juu, ambaye kimbilio lake litakuwa ngome ya mlimani. Atapewa mkate wake, na maji yake hayatakoma.
Ekegusii: oyio nere oramenye aase are igoro. Ebitare ebikong’u mbibe ebikengero biaye; naegwe endagera yaye, na amaache aye tagosira.

English: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.
Kiswahili: Macho yenu yatamwona mfalme katika uzuri wake na kuiona nchi inayoenea mbali.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aino arore omorwoti ore ase obwari bwaye; narore ense ere engare mono.

English: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?
Kiswahili: Katika mawazo yenu mtaifikiria hofu iliyopita: “Yuko wapi yule afisa mkuu? Yuko wapi yule aliyechukua ushuru? Yuko wapi afisa msimamizi wa minara?”
Ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaino nchirengererie igoro y’obwoba boria na goteeba: “Inee! Oria orenge kobeeka ebango, ng’ai are? Oria orenge korusia ebango, ng’ai are? Oria orenge kobara emerobiri, ng’ai are?”

English: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.
Kiswahili: Hutawaona tena wale watu wenye kiburi, wale watu wenye usemi wa mafumbo, wenye lugha ngeni, isiyoeleweka.
Ekegusii: Timokorora abanto baria abatindi naende, abanto babwate ogokwana ogokong’u motari komanya, abwo bagokwana emenwa emeao ase okong’ung’ura motari komanya.

English: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
Kiswahili: Mtazame Sayuni, mji wa sikukuu zetu; macho yenu yatauona Yerusalemu, mahali pa amani pa kuishi, hema ambalo halitaondolewa, nguzo zake hazitangʼolewa kamwe, wala hakuna kamba yake yoyote itakayokatika.
Ekegusii: Rigereria Sayoni, omochie oyio ase togosangererekana ase Amatuko aito Amanene! Erio amaiso ao narore Yerusalemu, obomenyo bw’obotoereru, eema etari kona‐kong’anya‐ng’anyigwa; eyio ebirochi biaye bitari gosimorwa, gose chingori chiaye chitari kobutoka.

English: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.
Kiswahili: Huko Bwana atakuwa Mwenye Nguvu wetu. Patakuwa kama mahali pa mito mipana na vijito. Hakuna jahazi lenye makasia litakalopita huko, wala hakuna meli yenye nguvu itakayopita huko.
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo Omonene natoorokere ore nobonene, nabe ase tore buna chindooche na ebirooche, ase amaato agosukigwa nemegango ataete, gose chimeeri chinene chitaete.

English: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mwamuzi wetu, Bwana ndiye mtoa sheria wetu, Bwana ni mfalme wetu, yeye ndiye atakayetuokoa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nere omonachi ebiina oito, nere omogambi oito. Omonene nere omorwoti oito, natotoorie.

English: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.
Kiswahili: Kamba zenu za merikebu zimelegea: Mlingoti haukusimama imara, nalo tanga halikukunjuliwa. Wingi wa mateka yatagawanywa, hata yeye aliye mlemavu atachukua nyara.
Ekegusii: Chingori chi’omoenga bw’emeeri chianyega‐nyegire, tichikonyara gosiberania omoenga bokong’u aase aye, gose korambora ebitambaa. Erio ebinto ebinge mbisakorwe biatananwe, nonya nebisegora mbisakore ebinto.

English: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yeyote aishiye Sayuni atakayesema, “Mimi ni mgonjwa”; nazo dhambi za wale waishio humo zitasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Onde tari bw’omochie oyio orateebe: “Inche nigo nindwarete”, ekiagera abanto abamenyete aroro mbabe baabeirwe obobe bwabo.

English: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything that comes from it.
Kiswahili: Njooni karibu, enyi mataifa, nanyi msikilize; sikilizeni kwa makini, enyi kabila za watu! Dunia na isikie, navyo vyote vilivyo ndani yake, ulimwengu na vyote vitokavyo ndani yake!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku, inchwo ang’e, motegerere moigwe; inwe abanto, igwera! Tiga ense etegerere amo na bionsi ebireo, ee, oboiko bwonsi na ebigosoka korwao.

English: For Yahweh is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.
Kiswahili: Bwana ameyakasirikia mataifa yote; ghadhabu yake ni juu ya majeshi yao yote. Atawaangamiza kabisa, atawatia mikononi mwa wachinjaji.
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire nendamwamu enene ase ebisaku bionsi, na obeire nekeririanda ase emeganda yabo yonsi y’esegi; obanacheire ekiina gi’okobasiria, obarure baitwe.

English: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up. The mountains will melt in their blood.
Kiswahili: Waliouawa watatupwa nje, maiti zao zitatoa uvundo, milima itatota kwa damu zao.
Ekegusii: Emebere y’abanto baraitwe nigo eratugutwe isiko, na ogotioka kw’obogundo bw’ebitondo ebio nigo koratioke aande onsi; amanyinga ’emebere eyio natirimboke korwa ase ebitunwa igoro.

English: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.
Kiswahili: Nyota zote za mbinguni zitayeyuka na anga litasokotwa kama kitabu, jeshi lote la angani litaanguka kama majani yaliyonyauka kutoka kwenye mzabibu, kama tini iliyonyauka kutoka kwenye mtini.
Ekegusii: Erioba, na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni mbisirigwe; igoro neringwe buna amakaratasi, ee, ebitongwa ebio bia igoro mbiiyerigwe inse buna amato amomo ay’emesabibu na ay’emeko akogwa.

English: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.
Kiswahili: Upanga wangu umekunywa na kushiba huko mbinguni, tazama, unashuka katika hukumu juu ya Edomu, wale watu ambao nimeshawahukumu, kuwaangamiza kabisa.
Ekegusii: Omoro one onyure na koigota aiga igoro; rora, ngotirimboka ore oe Abaedomu egesusuro, abanto abwo nanacheire ekiina.

English: Yahweh’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Yahweh has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
Kiswahili: Upanga wa Bwana umeoga katika damu, umefunikwa na mafuta ya nyama: damu ya kondoo na mbuzi, mafuta kutoka figo za kondoo dume. Kwa maana Bwana ana dhabihu huko Bosra, na machinjo makuu huko Edomu.
Ekegusii: Omoro Omonene oichoirwe namanyinga, otubirwe nebitinya, ee, oichoirwe namanyinga e chimanwa chi’eching’ondi, na aye chimbori, na otubirwe nebitinya bie chinyigo chie chimingichi. Omonene ngokora are ekeng’wanso agwo Bosira, na ogoitwa okonene nkobe ase ense y’Abaedomu.

English: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.
Kiswahili: Nyati wataanguka pamoja nao, ndama waume na mafahali wakubwa. Nchi yao italowana kwa damu, nayo mavumbi yataloa mafuta ya nyama.
Ekegusii: Ching’era nachirochio nchiiyerigwe inse, ne chieri chinene ne chinke boigo. Ense yabo nenyiigwe namanyinga, ne riroba riabo rinore nebitinya, ekiagera

English: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu Bwana anayo siku ya kulipiza kisasi, mwaka wa malipo, siku ya kushindania shauri la Sayuni.
Ekegusii: erio nerituko ri’Omonene ri’ogoakana egesiomba, ee, oyio nomwaka bw’ogoakana amabe akoretwe ase Sayoni.

English: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, and its land will become burning pitch.
Kiswahili: Vijito vya Edomu vitageuka kuwa lami, mavumbi yake yatakuwa kiberiti kiunguzacho, nchi yake itakuwa lami iwakayo!
Ekegusii: Amache e chindooche chia Edomu naonchoke abe buna eramu, ne riroba ri’ense eyio ndibe buna eramu ekoyia omorero.

English: It won’t be quenched night or day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Haitazimishwa usiku wala mchana, moshi wake utapaa juu milele. Kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi itakuwa ukiwa, hakuna mtu yeyote atakayepita huko tena.
Ekegusii: Omorero oyio nogenderere koyia obotuko na omobaso, tokorimigwa; erioki riaye ndichongororoke gochia igoro kogenderera botambe. Ense eyio neebe esaregete ekiaare ase ekiaare; monto onde tari oraete ase egati y’ense eyio nonya ndinde.

English: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.
Kiswahili: Bundi wa jangwani na bundi mwenye sauti nyembamba wataimiliki, bundi wakubwa na kunguru wataweka viota humo. Mungu atanyoosha juu ya Edomu kamba ya kupimia ya machafuko matupu, na timazi ya ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Chinsoti na ebirongo mbimenye aroro; ense eyio nebe eye chinyakweumia na ebigonkoru. Omonene narambore igoro yaye ekerengero gi’okoyetantania na ekebiro gi’okoyerentera obosiru.

English: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.
Kiswahili: Watu wake wa kuheshimiwa hawatakuwa na chochote kitakachoitwa ufalme huko, nao wakuu wao wote watatoweka.
Ekegusii: Abanto abasike tibagotokao baranyare kobekwa bagambe; abagaambi babo bonsi nigo barasire.

English: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.
Kiswahili: Miiba itaenea katika ngome za ndani, viwawi na michongoma itaota kwenye ngome zake. Itakuwa maskani ya mbweha, makao ya bundi.
Ekegusii: Amagwa namere ase chinyomba chi’oborwoti, amasa na amageri mbimere ase chiburi chi’aroro. Nabe obomenyo bwe chisese chi’orosana ne chisagero.

English: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.
Kiswahili: Viumbe vya jangwani vitakutana na fisi, nao mbuzi-mwitu watalia wakiitana; huko viumbe vya usiku vitastarehe pia na kujitafutia mahali pa kupumzika.
Ekegusii: Aase agwo ching’iti chi’orosana nchiumeraneo ne chinyang’au ase obotuko amarengari nabe akorangerania, na ekerecha gete ngeche aroro kenyore aase kegotimokera.

English: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.
Kiswahili: Bundi wataweka viota huko na kutaga mayai, atayaangua na kutunza makinda yake chini ya uvuli wa mabawa yake; pia huko vipanga watakusanyika, kila mmoja na mwenzi wake.
Ekegusii: Aase agwo chinyakweumia nchiagache ebiswa biabo, chibiare amagena na goturagia ebichuchu, na chibisangererie ase ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiabo ime; ee agwo amakoru nasangererekaneo, kera erimo neriamwabo.

English: Search in the book of Yahweh, and read: not one of these will be missing. None will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.
Kiswahili: Angalieni katika gombo la Bwana na msome: Hakuna hata mmoja katika hawa atakayekosekana, hakuna hata mmoja atakayemkosa mwenzi wake. Kwa kuwa ni kinywa chake Mungu kimeagiza, na Roho wake atawakusanya pamoja.
Ekegusii: Rigia korwa ase egetabu y’Omonene, mosome: Nonya nekemo ki’ebitongwa ebio tigekobora kobeera aroro, kera ekemo goika kebe nekiamwabo. Omonene ochikiire amang’ana ayio, na Omoika oye nobisangererieo.

English: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.
Kiswahili: Huwagawia sehemu zao, mkono wake huwagawanyia kwa kipimo. Wataimiliki hata milele na kuishi humo kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi.
Ekegusii: Omonene oakeire ebitongwa ebio obomera, na okoboko kwaye kwabiatananeire ense nekerengero, ebe eyabo kogenderera botambe, mbigenderere komenya aroro ekiaare ase ekiaare.

English: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
Kiswahili: Jangwa na nchi kame vitafurahi; nyika itashangilia na kuchanua maua. Kama waridi,
Ekegusii: Erooro na ense enyomo nchibe nomogooko; ee, erooro nechenge na gosicha buna ebisicha ebiya.

English: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see Yahweh’s glory, the excellence of our God.
Kiswahili: litachanua maua, litashangilia sana na kupaza sauti kwa furaha. Litapewa utukufu wa Lebanoni, fahari ya Karmeli na Sharoni; wataona utukufu wa Bwana, fahari ya Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Nigo erasiche ebisicha ebinge, erio echenge na goteera nomogooko. Neegwe obonene buna obw’ebitunwa bia Lebanoni, na obwari buna obwa Karimeli na Saroni. Abanto mbarore obonene bw’Omonene, ee, mbarore obonene bwa Nyasae oito na obonguru bwaye.

English: Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm.
Kiswahili: Itieni nguvu mikono iliyo dhaifu, yafanyeni imara magoti yaliyolegea,
Ekegusii: Amaboko are amoro yabeeke chinguru; kong’ia amaru arosire.

English: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong! Don’t be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.
Kiswahili: waambieni wale wenye mioyo ya hofu, “Kuweni hodari, msiogope; tazama, Mungu wenu atakuja, pamoja na malipo ya Mungu, atakuja na kuwaokoa ninyi.”
Ekegusii: Teebia abanto abwo babwate chinkoro chinyoba: “Mobe abaremu, timwoboa! Naama! Nyasae oino nache korusia egesiomba. Rora, Nyasae nache kobaruseria egesiomba. Ere nache kobatooria.”

English: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.
Kiswahili: Ndipo macho ya vipofu yatafumbuliwa na masikio ya viziwi yatazibuliwa.
Ekegusii: Erio amaiso ’emeuko aramokigwe, na amato ’emetino atinorwe.

English: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
Kiswahili: Ndipo kilema atarukaruka kama kulungu, nao ulimi wa aliye bubu utapaza sauti kwa shangwe. Maji yatatiririka kwa kasi katika nyika, na vijito katika jangwa.
Ekegusii: Ebisegora mbichara‐charoke buna chinsune, ne chimeme chi’amamama nchitere nomogooko. Chindooche nchisoke ase erooro, na ebirooche ase ekerubo ekiomo.

English: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.
Kiswahili: Mchanga wa moto utakuwa bwawa la maji, ardhi yenye kiu itabubujika chemchemi. Maskani ya mbweha walikolala hapo awali patamea majani, matete na mafunjo.
Ekegusii: Ense y’omokenye ogosamba neebe ritibo ri’amaache, na ase ense enyomo chinsoko chi’amaache nchitubokeo; aase chisese chi’orosana chiamenyete, obonyansi, na ebitonto, na amauncho mbimereo.

English: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there.
Kiswahili: Nako kutakuwa na njia kuu, nayo itaitwa Njia ya Utakatifu. Wasio safi hawatapita juu yake; itakuwa ya wale watembeao katika Njia ile; yeye asafiriye juu yake, ajapokuwa mjinga, hatapotea.
Ekegusii: Enchera enene eroisirie buya nebeo; eyio nigo erarokwe “Enchera Enchenu”. Abanto batachenegeti tibagoetao; enchera eyio nigo erabe ey’abaanto aba boka. Abagoeta aroro, nonya bare abariri, tibagosira.

English: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.
Kiswahili: Huko hakutakuwepo na simba, wala mnyama mkali hatapita njia hiyo, wala hawatapatikana humo. Ila waliokombolewa tu ndio watakaopita huko,
Ekegusii: Endo tekobao ase enchera eyio, gose eng’iti ende y’orosana tegochao, chirochio tichikonyorekana aroro, korende abanto baboorigwe nabwo barataare ase enchera eyio.

English: Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”
Kiswahili: waliokombolewa na Bwana watarudi. Wataingia Sayuni wakiimba; furaha ya milele itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao. Watapata furaha na shangwe; huzuni na majonzi vitakimbia.
Ekegusii: Abanto abw’Omonene abooririe mbairane, baike Sayoni bagotera; omogooko o kare na kare nobe igoro ase emetwe yabo buna egutwa; mbabe nomogooko na omochengo, obororo na omoichano mbiere kegima ase bare.

English: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na nne wa utawala wa Mfalme Hezekia, Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru akaishambulia miji yote ya Yuda yenye ngome na kuiteka.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kane bw’okogaamba kw’omorwoti Hezekia, Senakeribu, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, akagenda, akarwania emechie yonsi y’Abayuda yagiteire chindwaki, akayebua.

English: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.
Kiswahili: Kisha mfalme wa Ashuru akamtuma jemadari wa jeshi pamoja na jeshi kubwa kutoka Lakishi hadi kwa Mfalme Hezekia huko Yerusalemu. Jemadari wa jeshi akasimama kwenye mfereji wa Bwawa la Juu, lililojengwa katika barabara iendayo kwenye Uwanja wa Dobi.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti oyio bw’Abaasuri agatoma Rabi‐Sake korwa Lakisi amo nabasikari abange agende ase Hezekia agwo Yerusalemu. Rabi‐Sake agatenena ase omotaro bwe ritibo ria rogoro ase enchera ekogenda ase egetii ki’omosibia bw’ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga.

English: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder came out to him.
Kiswahili: Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia aliyekuwa msimamizi wa jumba la kifalme, Shebna aliyekuwa katibu, na Yoa mwana wa Asafu mwandishi wakamwendea.
Ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omorwoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw’Asafu, oyorenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bagacha aroro.

English: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa jeshi akawaambia, “Mwambieni Hezekia, “ ‘Hili ndilo asemalo mfalme mkuu, mfalme wa Ashuru: Ni wapi unapoweka hili tumaini lako?
Ekegusii: Rabi‐Sake akabateebia ng’a bateebie Hezekia iga: “Aya naro omorwoti omonene, oria bw’Abaasuri, agokwana: Niigoro yang’o obegete ogosemeria kwao?

English: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?
Kiswahili: Unasema mnayo mikakati na nguvu za kijeshi, lakini unasema maneno matupu tu. Je, wewe unamtegemea nani, hata ukaniasi mimi?
Ekegusii: Nigo okorengereria ng’a ogokwana kw’amang’ana gwoka nakwo koganeirie ase okomanya korwana esegi na koyebua? Ning’o osemeretie oraoboseemia goika kwangire konyingwera inche?

English: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
Kiswahili: Tazama sasa, unaitegemea Misri, fimbo ile ya mwanzi uliopasuka, ambayo huuchoma na kuujeruhi mkono wa mtu akiiegemea! Hivyo ndivyo alivyo Farao mfalme wa Misri, kwa wote wanaomtegemea.
Ekegusii: Rora bono, aye nigo osemeretie ense y’Abamisiri, eyio enga buna egetonto kebunegete. Omonto onde bwensi okogiesiirera, ekio nigo keramokebe okoboko. Naboigo Farao omorwoti o Misiri are ase abanto bonsi abwo bamosemeretie.

English: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?”
Kiswahili: Nawe kama ukiniambia, “Tunamtumainia Bwana Mungu wetu”: je, siyo yeye ambaye Hezekia aliondoa mahali pake pa juu pa kuabudia miungu na madhabahu zake, akiwaambia Yuda na Yerusalemu, “Ni lazima mwabudu mbele ya madhabahu haya”?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe nigo mogonteebia ng’a nigo mosemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oino? Tari ere oria aase aye aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa amo nebisasimero biaye Hezekia atagoire, agateebia Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu: Mobe mogosasiima bosio bw’egesasiimero eke!

English: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Njooni sasa, fanyeni mapatano na bwana wangu, mfalme wa Ashuru: Nitakupa farasi elfu mbili, kama unaweza kuwapandisha waendesha farasi juu yao!
Ekegusii: Inchuo moigwane mobeke rigori n’Omonene one, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri. Nimbae chibarasi chilifu ibere komoranyare konyora abariini be chibarasi echio.

English: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
Kiswahili: Utawezaje kumzuia hata afisa mmoja aliye mdogo kati ya maafisa wa bwana wangu, ijapo unategemea Misri kwa magari ya vita na wapanda farasi?
Ekegusii: Naki moranyare kobua omoteneneri oyomo ore omoke ase egati y’abasomba b’omonene one, ekero mosemeretie ense ya Misiri ase okonyora chigari na abariini chibarasi?

English: Have I come up now without Yahweh against this land to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, je, nimekuja kushambulia na kuangamiza nchi hii bila Bwana? Bwana mwenyewe ndiye aliniambia niishambulie nchi hii na kuiangamiza.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mokagete ng’a inche nigo nachire korwania ense eye na koyesari’Omonene atancheti? Taibo; Omonene nere onteebia: Genda orwanie ense eria oyesarie!”

English: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Eliakimu, Shebna na Yoa wakamwambia yule jemadari wa jeshi, “Tafadhali zungumza na watumishi wako kwa lugha ya Kiaramu, kwa kuwa tunaifahamu. Usiseme nasi kwa Kiebrania watu walioko juu ya ukuta wakiwa wanasikia.”
Ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, na Sebuna, na Yoa, bagateebia Rabi‐Sake: “Koranche okwane naintwe, abasomba bao, ase omonwa bw’Ekearamaiki, ekiagera ntoyomanyete; tobaisa gokwana naintwe ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda ekero abanto bare ase orwaki igoro bategererete.”

English: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”
Kiswahili: Lakini yule jemadari wa jeshi akajibu, “Je, bwana wangu amenituma kutoa ujumbe huu kwa bwana wenu na kwenu tu? Je, hakunituma pia kwa watu walioketi ukutani, ambao, kama ninyi, itawabidi kula mavi yao na kunywa mikojo yao wenyewe?”
Ekegusii: Rabi‐Sake agateeba, “Inee! Omonene one nigo antoma nkwane amang’ana aya ase Omonene oino na ase more mweka? Yaya, tantomete ase inwe mweka, korende nase abanto baikaransete ase orwaki igoro, abwo banacheirwe ekiina amo nainwe bagochia koria obonyira bwabo na konywa amasinyoro abo bagoitera.”

English: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
Kiswahili: Kisha yule jemadari wa jeshi akasimama na kuita kwa lugha ya Kiebrania, akasema: “Sikieni maneno ya mfalme mkuu, mfalme wa Ashuru!
Ekegusii: Erio Rabi‐Sake agatenena, agaaka eriogi rinene ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda, agateeba: “Igwa ring’ana ri’omorwoti omonene, ore omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.

English: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo mfalme: Msikubali Hezekia awadanganye. Hawezi kuwaokoa!
Ekegusii: Aya naro omorwoti agokwana: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abang’aine, ekiagera ere takonyara kobatooria.

English: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’
Kiswahili: Msikubali Hezekia awashawishi kumtumaini Bwana kwa kuwaambia, ‘Hakika Bwana atatuokoa. Mji huu hautaangukia mikononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru.’
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abasirie ng’a mosemerie Omonene ekero agoteeba: Ekeene, Omonene natotoorie, na omochie oyo tokobekwa ase okoboko kw’omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.

English: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;
Kiswahili: “Msimsikilize Hezekia. Hili ndilo mfalme wa Ashuru asemalo: Fanyeni amani nami na mje kwangu. Kisha kila mmoja wenu atakula kutoka kwa mzabibu wake na mtini wake mwenyewe, na kunywa maji kutoka kisima chake mwenyewe,
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gotegerera amang’ana a Hezekia. Aya naro omorwoti bw’Abaasuri agoteeba: Kora omorembe nainche, moche ase ’nde. Erio kera omonto ase more narie okwama kw’emesabibu na okw’emeko yaye omonyene, na kera oyomo oino nanywe amaache ’ensoko yaye omonyene,

English: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
Kiswahili: mpaka nije nikawapeleke katika nchi iliyo kama nchi yenu wenyewe, nchi ya nafaka na divai mpya, nchi ya mkate na ya mashamba ya mizabibu.
Ekegusii: goika inchiche imbarusie agwo mbaire ase ense egwekaine buna ense eyio yaino, ense ere ne chindagera, na edivai, ense ere nemegati na emegondo y’emesabibu.

English: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?
Kiswahili: “Msikubali Hezekia awapotoshe asemapo, ‘Bwana atatuokoa.’ Je, yuko mungu wa taifa lolote aliyewahi kuokoa nchi yake kutoka mkononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru?
Ekegusii: Morende mono, ekero Hezekia akobang’aina, ogoteeba: Omonene natotoorie. Inee! Enyasae ende yonsi y’ebisaku yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane inche omorwoti bw’Abaasuri?

English: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
Kiswahili: Iko wapi miungu ya Hamathi na ya Arpadi? Iko wapi miungu ya Sefarvaimu? Je, imeokoa Samaria kutoka mkononi mwangu?
Ekegusii: Ng’ai chinyasae chia Hamati na Aripadi chire? Inee! Chinyasae chia Sefariwaimu, ng’ai chire? Chiatooririe ense ya Samaria korwa ase okoboko kwane?

English: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”
Kiswahili: Ni yupi miongoni mwa miungu yote ya nchi hizi ameweza kuokoa nchi yake mkononi mwangu? Inawezekanaje basi Bwana aiokoe Yerusalemu mkononi mwangu?”
Ekegusii: Nereri ase egati ye chinyasae chionsi chie chinse echio yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane? Nainwe nigo mokorengereria ng’a Omonene natoorie Yerusalemu korwa ase okoboko kwane?”

English: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wale watu wakakaa kimya, wala hawakujibu lolote, kwa kuwa mfalme alikuwa amewaamuru, “Msimjibu lolote.”
Ekegusii: Korende abanto bagakira‐kiri, tibamoiraneria nonya ne ring’ana erimo, ekiagera omorwoti konya ochikiire iga: “Timobaisa komoiraneria.”

English: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
Kiswahili: Kisha Eliakimu mwana wa Hilkia msimamizi wa jumba la kifalme, Shebna katibu, na Yoa mwana wa Asafu, mwandishi wakamwendea Hezekia, nguo zao zikiwa zimeraruliwa, na kumwambia yale jemadari wa jeshi aliyoyasema.
Ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, oria orenge omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omorwoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw’Asafu, omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bagacha ase Hezekia bare ne chianga chitandogete, bakamoteebia amang’ana ayio Rabi‐Sake akwanete.

English: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh’s house.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Hezekia aliposikia haya, akararua nguo zake na kuvaa nguo ya gunia, naye akaenda katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Hezekia aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chianga chi’echigunia, erio agasoa ase enyomba y’Omonene.

English: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
Kiswahili: Akawatuma Eliakimu msimamizi wa nyumba ya mfalme, Shebna mwandishi, na viongozi wa makuhani, wote wakiwa wamevaa nguo za magunia, waende kwa nabii Isaya mwana wa Amozi.
Ekegusii: Agatoma Eliakimu, oria orenge omoteneneri bw’enyomba yaye, na Sebuna omoriki, na abakuani abagaaka, beboyetie chianga chi’echigunia, bagende ase Isaya omobani, mosinto bw’Amosi.

English: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Hili ndilo asemalo Hezekia: Siku hii ni siku ya dhiki, ya kukaripiwa na ya aibu, kama wakati watoto wanapofikia karibu kuzaliwa na kumbe hakuna nguvu ya kuwazaa.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakamoteebia: “Aya naro Hezekia agoteeba: Rituko ria reero neri’obororo, na egesusuro, na ogochaywa, buna ekero abana babeire ang’e baiborwe, korende chinguru chi’okobasukia basoke chiaborire.

English: It may be Yahweh your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”
Kiswahili: Yamkini Bwana, Mungu wako atayasikia maneno ya jemadari wa jeshi, ambaye bwana wake, mfalme wa Ashuru, amemtuma kumdhihaki Mungu aliye hai, tena kwamba atamkemea kwa maneno ambayo Bwana, Mungu wako ameyasikia. Kwa hiyo omba kwa ajili ya mabaki ambao bado wako.”
Ekegusii: Ande nabo erabe ng’a ekero omorwoti bw’Abaasuri atomete Rabi‐Sake korama Nyasae ore moyo, ere Omonene, Nyasae oino naigwete ayio. Ere nabae egesusuro ase amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio sabera abanto abwo batigarete bare moyo.”

English: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘Yahweh says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
Kiswahili: Isaya akawaambia, “Mwambieni bwana wenu, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Usiogope kwa hayo uliyoyasikia, yale maneno ambayo watumishi wa mfalme wa Ashuru wamenitukana nayo.
Ekegusii: Isaya akabateebia, “Moteebie omonene oino ng’a Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Tobaisa kwoboa ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio kwaigure abasomba b’omorwoti bw’Abaasuri batebiire na kondama.

English: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”
Kiswahili: Sikiliza! Nitatia roho fulani ndani yake ili kwamba atakaposikia taarifa fulani, atarudi nchi yake mwenyewe, nami huko nitafanya auawe kwa upanga.’ ”
Ekegusii: Rora, nimbeeke omoika gete ime yaye, erio ekero araigwe chinkuma nairoke, airane gochia ase ense yaye; nimorue aitwe n’omoro, agwo ase ense yaye omonyene.”

English: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa jeshi aliposikia kwamba mfalme wa Ashuru ameondoka Lakishi, alirudi, akamkuta mfalme akipigana na Libna.
Ekegusii: Rabi‐Sake akairana, ekiagera aigwete ng’a omorwoti bw’Abaasuri orure Lakisi, akamonyora okorwana na Libuna.

English: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
Kiswahili: Basi Senakeribu akapata taarifa kwamba Tirhaka, Mkushi mfalme wa Misri, alikuwa anaenda kupigana naye. Aliposikia jambo hili akatuma wajumbe kwa Hezekia na neno hili:
Ekegusii: Na ekero omorwoti bw’Abaasuri aigwete amang’ana ng’a Tirihaka, omorwoti bw’Abaetiopia, ochire korwana esegi nere, agatoma abanto ase Hezekia naende, akabateebia,

English: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”
Kiswahili: “Mwambieni Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda: Usikubali huyo Mungu unayemtumainia akudanganye wakati anaposema, ‘Yerusalemu haitatiwa mkononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru.’
Ekegusii: “Aya naro morateebie Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda: Tobaisa gwancha Nyasae oyio oo osemeretie akong’aine, erinde orengererie ng’a Yerusalemu tokobekwa ase okoboko kw’omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.

English: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?
Kiswahili: Hakika umesikia yale ambayo wafalme wa Ashuru wametenda kwa nchi zote, wakiwaangamiza kabisa. Je, wewe utaokolewa?
Ekegusii: Rora, aye kwaigure aya abarwoti b’Abaasuri bakoreire chinse chionsi, bachisaririe kegima. Inee! Aye bono notooreke?

English: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?
Kiswahili: Je, miungu ya mataifa ambayo yaliangamizwa na baba zangu iliweza kuwaokoa? Yaani miungu ya Gozani, Harani, Resefu, na ya watu wa Edeni waliokuwa Telasari?
Ekegusii: Inee! Chinyasae chi’ebisaku chiatooririe ebisaku biria chisokoro chiane chiasiretie, ebisaku bia Gosani, na Harani, na Resefu, na abanto ba Edeni, baria baarenge agwo Telasari?

English: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”
Kiswahili: Yuko wapi mfalme wa Hamathi, mfalme wa Arpadi, mfalme wa mji wa Sefarvaimu, au wa Hena au wa Iva?”
Ekegusii: Ng’ai omorwoti o Hamati are, gose omorwoti bw’Aripadi, na oyo bw’omochie o Sefariwaimu, na oyo o Hena, na oyo o Iwa?”

English: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to Yahweh’s house, and spread it before Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hezekia akapokea barua kutoka kwa wale wajumbe naye akaisoma. Kisha akapanda katika Hekalu la Bwana, akaikunjua mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Hezekia akaegwa riruube korwa ase abanto baria batometwe, akarisoma, erio akagenda ase enyomba y’Omonene, akarirambora ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: Hezekiah prayed to Yahweh, saying,
Kiswahili: Naye Hezekia akamwomba Bwana akisema:
Ekegusii: Hezekia agasaba Omonene, agateeba,

English: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
