Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, uketiye juu ya kiti cha enzi kati ya makerubi, wewe peke yako ndiwe Mungu juu ya falme zote za dunia. Wewe umeumba mbingu na nchi.
Ekegusii: “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aye omenyete nobonene bwao igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, aye naye Nyasae, aye bweka, igoro y’amarouti onsi ay’ense; naye gwatongete igoro na ense

English: Turn your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.
Kiswahili: Tega sikio, Ee Bwana, usikie; fungua macho yako, Ee Bwana, uone; sikiliza maneno yote ambayo Senakeribu ametuma kumtukana Mungu aliye hai.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe! Aye Omonene, rigereria orore! Oigwe amang’ana onsi a Senakeribu, aya atomire ase ogokorama aye Nyasae ore moyo.

English: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,
Kiswahili: “Ni kweli, Ee Bwana, kwamba wafalme wa Ashuru wameyaangamiza mataifa haya yote pamoja na nchi zao.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekeene, abarwoti b’Abaasuri basiririe abanto b’ebisaku ne chinse chiabo,

English: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.
Kiswahili: Wameitupa miungu yao kwenye moto na kuiangamiza, kwa kuwa haikuwa miungu, bali miti na mawe tu, iliyotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: batugutire chinyasae chi’abaanto abwo ase omorero, ekiagera chirochio tichiri Nyasae, korende nemeremo y’amaboko ’abaanto, chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena, na ase ayio chigasarigwa.

English: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahweh, even you only.”
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, Ee Bwana Mungu wetu, tuokoe kutoka mkononi mwake, ili kwamba falme zote duniani zipate kujua kwamba wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, ndiwe Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Bono Omonene, Nyasae oito, totoorie korwa ase okoboko kwaye, erinde amarwoti onsi are ase ense anyare komanya ng’a aye naye bweka ore Omonene.”

English: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,
Kiswahili: Kisha Isaya mwana wa Amozi akapeleka ujumbe kwa Hezekia, akasema: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: Kwa sababu umeniomba kuhusu Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru,
Ekegusii: Erio Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, agatoma amang’ana ase Hezekia, akomoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Aye gwansabire igoro ya Senakeribu, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.

English: this is the word which Yahweh has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
Kiswahili: hili ndilo neno ambalo Bwana amelisema dhidi yake: “Bikira binti Sayuni anakudharau na kukudhihaki. Binti Yerusalemu anatikisa kichwa chake unapokimbia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, eri nario ring’an’Omonene akwanire: Aye Senakeribu, Sayoni, omochie ore buna omoiseke omwekuungi, nigo agochayete na kogosekerera; omochie o Yerusalemu nigo okogosingiseria omotwe magega yao.

English: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Ni nani uliyemtukana na kumkufuru? Ni nani uliyeinua sauti yako dhidi yake, na kumwinulia macho yako kwa kiburi? Ni dhidi ya yule Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli!
Ekegusii: Aye ning’o gwasekereire na korama? Ning’o gwaakeire eriogi riao ase ’oboenenu na kweimokereria igoro namaiso ’oboenenu? Aye kwabeire mamincha ya Nyasae Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.
Kiswahili: Kupitia kwa wajumbe wako umelundika matukano juu ya Bwana. Nawe umesema, ‘Kwa magari yangu mengi ya vita, nimepanda juu ya vilele vya milima, vilele vya juu sana katika Lebanoni. Nami nimeiangusha mierezi yake mirefu, misunobari yake iliyo bora sana. Nimefikia sehemu zake zilizoinuka juu sana, misitu yake iliyo mizuri sana.
Ekegusii: Goetera ase abasomba bao gwachecheirie Omonene ekero gwateebire iga: Nase chigari chiane chinyinge nariinire goika ebichuria bi’ebitunwa, goika igoro kegima ya Lebanoni. Ngatema emecharake yaye yare emetambe goetania eyende, na emetarakwa yaye emiya mono. Ngasoa ase ebinunchi biaye ime, na ime ase rinani rinoru.

English: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”
Kiswahili: Nimechimba visima katika nchi za kigeni na kunywa maji yake. Kwa nyayo za miguu yangu nimekausha vijito vyote vya Misri.’
Ekegusii: Ngakunya, nkanyora amaache nkonywa, ngakamia chindooche chionsi chia Misiri ne chimbaratero chi’amagoro aane.

English: “‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities, turning them into ruinous heaps.
Kiswahili: “Je, hujasikia? Zamani sana niliamuru hili. Siku za kale nilipanga hili; sasa nimelifanya litokee, kwamba umegeuza miji yenye ngome kuwa malundo ya mawe.
Ekegusii: “Inee! Aye tikwana koigwa ng’a nigo nachiigete ayio kare, ngakora emeroberio eyio ase amatuko a kare? Bono ngoikerania inde amang’ana ayio ng’a aye osarie emechie egiteire chindwaki ebe amaturi are ebinge chi’amagena.

English: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like a field before its crop has grown.
Kiswahili: Watu wa miji hiyo wameishiwa nguvu, wanavunjika mioyo na kuaibishwa. Wao ni kama mimea katika shamba, kama machipukizi mororo ya kijani, kama majani yachipuayo juu ya paa la nyumba, ambayo hukauka kabla ya kukua.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’echinse echio nigo baarenge abareu batari na nguru, bakaondoka na gosookigwa, bakaba buna ebimeri bire mogondo, na buna obonyansi oborere bomerete kerama igoro bogosusana botarakina.

English: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ninajua mahali ukaapo, kutoka kwako na kuingia kwako, na jinsi unavyoghadhibika dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: “Nimanyete ekero oikaransete na ekero ogosoka isiko, na ekero okoirana. Boigo nimanyete buna ore nekeririanda ase ’nde.

English: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu unaghadhibika na ufidhuli dhidi yangu, na kwa sababu ufidhuli wako umefika masikioni mwangu, nitaweka ndoana yangu puani mwako na hatamu yangu kinywani mwako, nami nitakufanya urudi kwa njia ile uliyoijia.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabeire na kerokio ase ’nde, na oboenenu bwao bwaikire ase amato aane, nimbeeke ekegobanio ase chimioro chiao ime, na egento kiane ki’ogokoraa ase omonwa oo, ninkoiranie ogendere enchera eria gwacherete.

English: “‘This shall be the sign to you: You will eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from it; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo itakuwa ishara kwako, ee Hezekia: “Mwaka huu utakula kile kiotacho chenyewe, na mwaka wa pili utakula kutoka machipukizi yake. Lakini katika mwaka wa tatu panda na uvune, panda mashamba ya mizabibu na ule matunda yake.
Ekegusii: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio asore Hezekia: Omwaka oyo inamorie endagera ekwemeria yoka enyene, na omwaka o kabere boigo. Erio omwaka o gatato imobusure na kogesa, imosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo na morie okwama kwabo.

English: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
Kiswahili: Mara nyingine tena mabaki ya nyumba ya Yuda wataeneza mizizi chini na kuzaa matunda juu.
Ekegusii: Na abatigari b’enyomba ya Yuda abaratooreke mbaame babe buna ebimeri biirete emeri inse mono na gokina gochia igoro, bikwama amatunda,

English: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.’
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kutoka Yerusalemu watakuja mabaki, na kutoka Mlima Sayuni kundi la walionusurika. Wivu wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ndio utatimiza jambo hili.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abatigari mbache korwa Yerusalemu, na korwa ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, ekeombe ki’abaanto baratooreke. Risemi ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda ndiikeranie amang’ana ayio.

English: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana kuhusu mfalme wa Ashuru: “Hataingia katika mji huu wala hatapiga mshale hapa. Hatakuja mbele yake na ngao wala kupanga majeshi kuuzingira.
Ekegusii: “Ase igo, aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro y’omorwoti bw’Abaasuri: Ere tagocha ase omochie oyo, gose takoruta omogwe aroro; tagocha ase omochie oyo ne chinguba, gose takoagacha eburi bosio bwaye.

English: He will return the way that he came, and he won’t come to this city,’ says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia ile aliyoijia ndiyo atakayorudi; hataingia katika mji huu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteeba ng’a enchera eria acherete, eyio nero arairanere, gose takonyara gosoa ase omochie oyo.

English: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’”
Kiswahili: “Nitaulinda mji huu na kuuokoa, kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, na kwa ajili ya Daudi mtumishi wangu!”
Ekegusii: Inche ning’egere omochie oyo na koyotooria ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one.”

English: Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.
Kiswahili: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana akaenda, akawaua wanajeshi 185,000 katika kambi ya Waashuru. Wenzao walipoamka asubuhi yake, walikuta maiti kila mahali!
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene akagenda ase egetwori ki’Abaasuri agaita abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato na isano (185,000). Ekero abanto babogeete mambia, bakarora emebere y’abanto bakwete ere aande onsi.

English: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.
Kiswahili: Basi Senakeribu mfalme wa Ashuru akavunja kambi na kuondoka. Akarudi Ninawi na kukaa huko.
Ekegusii: Senakeribu, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, akarua agwo, akagenda nka bwoye, akamenya Ninawi.

English: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
Kiswahili: Siku moja, alipokuwa akiabudu katika hekalu la mungu wake Nisroki, wanawe Adrameleki na Shareza wakamuua kwa upanga, nao wakakimbilia nchi ya Ararati. Naye Esar-Hadoni mwanawe akawa mfalme badala yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gosasiima ime ase enyomba ya Nisiroki, enyasae yaye, Adarameleki na Sareseri, abamura baye, bakamoita nemioro, erio bagatama gochia ase ense y’Ararati. Ezra‐Hadoni, omomura oye, akaba omorwoti ribaga riaye.

English: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo Hezekia akaugua, naye akawa karibu kufa. Nabii Isaya mwana wa Amozi akaenda kwake na kumwambia, “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Tengeneza mambo ya nyumba yako, kwa sababu utakufa, hutapona.”
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Hezekia akarwara, akaba ang’e nogokwa. Isaya omobani, mosinto bw’Amosi, agacha asare, akamoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Ebeke ang’e, amo nenyomba yao, ekiagera aye goika okwe, tokogwena.”

English: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh,
Kiswahili: Hezekia akaelekeza uso wake ukutani, akamwomba Bwana:
Ekegusii: Hezekia akaonchora obosio bwaye gochia ase enyasi, agasaba Omonene,

English: and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.
Kiswahili: “Ee Bwana, kumbuka jinsi nilivyoenenda mbele zako kwa uaminifu na kujitoa kwa moyo wangu wote, na kufanya yaliyo mema machoni pako.” Naye Hezekia akalia kwa uchungu.
Ekegusii: akabora, “bono Omonene nagosoroire, inyora buna nabeire ngokobwatia ase obwegenwa, na ase enkoro yane yonsi, naende nakorire ayare amaronge ase obosio bwao.” Erio. Hezekia akarera nobororo.

English: Then Yahweh’s word came to Isaiah, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likamjia Isaya, kusema:
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Isaya, rikamoteebia,

English: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
Kiswahili: “Nenda ukamwambie Hezekia, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa baba yako Daudi: Nimeyasikia maombi yako na nimeona machozi yako. Nitakuongezea miaka kumi na mitano katika maisha yako.
Ekegusii: “Irana oteebie Hezekia ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi sokoro yaye, nigo ngoteeba iga: Naigure ogosaba kwao, narorire amariga ao. Rora, nakomentire emiaka ikomi na etano ase obogima bwao.

English: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.
Kiswahili: Nami nitakuokoa wewe pamoja na mji huu mkononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru. Nitaulinda mji huu.
Ekegusii: Ningotoorie aye amo nomochie oyo, korwa ase okoboko kw’omorwoti bw’Abaasuri; ning’egere omochie oyo.

English: This shall be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do this thing that he has spoken.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hii ndiyo ishara ya Bwana kwako ya kwamba Bwana atafanya kile alichoahidi:
Ekegusii: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio asore korwa ase Omonene, ng’a naikeranie amang’ana ayio atebiire:

English: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.”’” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.
Kiswahili: Nitafanya kivuli cha jua kwenye ngazi iliyojengwa na Ahazi kirudi nyuma madaraja kumi.’ ” Hivyo jua likarudi nyuma madaraja kumi ambayo lilikuwa limeshuka.
Ekegusii: Rora, ase ekerengero gie chinsa ki’Ahasi ninkore omorengari oria otambeire ekero erioba riereerire oirane gochia magega ebitambokero ikomi.” Ase ayio erioba rikairania omorengari oye ebitambokero ikomi ase ekerengero keria.

English: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness:
Kiswahili: Maandiko ya Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda baada ya kuugua kwake na kupona:
Ekegusii: Magega Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, kagwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwaye, akariika ogoteera oko:

English: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”
Kiswahili: Nilisema, “Katika ustawi wa maisha yangu, je, ni lazima nipite katika malango ya mauti, na kupokonywa miaka yangu iliyobaki?”
Ekegusii: Nigo narengereretie ng’a ngochia gokwa inde ase emiaka y’oboke bwane; ningende ase ebiita bi’aase abakuure, naurirwe emiaka yane yatigarete.

English: I said, “I won’t see Yah, Yah in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
Kiswahili: Nilisema, “Sitamwona tena Bwana, Bwana katika nchi ya walio hai, wala sitamtazama tena mwanadamu, wala kuwa na wale ambao sasa wanakaa katika ulimwengu huu.
Ekegusii: Ngateeba, “Tinkorora Omonene naende ase ense y’abare moyo, gose korora monto onde bwensi ase aba bamenyete ase ense eye y’obosiru.

English: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
Kiswahili: Kama hema la mchunga mifugo, nyumba yangu imebomolewa na kutwaliwa kutoka kwangu. Kama mfumaji nimevingirisha maisha yangu, naye amenikatilia mbali kutoka kitanda cha mfumi. Mchana na usiku uliyakomesha maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Obomenyo bwane bwatagoirwe na korusigwa ase ’nde buna eema y’omorisia, naringire obogima bwane buna omooroisia ebitambaa akobiringa; nabutoirwe korwa ase egekorero; ekero botaraira, aye nigo okoeria obogima bwane.

English: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
Kiswahili: Nilingoja kwa uvumilivu hadi mapambazuko, lakini alivunja mifupa yangu yote kama simba. Mchana na usiku uliyakomesha maisha yangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkorera ase obotuko bwonsi ng’a nkonywe; Omonene obunire amauga aane buna endo ekobuna ebi yaitire; ekero botaraira ere nigo akoeria obogima bwane.

English: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”
Kiswahili: Nililia kama mbayuwayu au korongo, niliomboleza kama hua aombolezaye. Macho yangu yalififia nilipotazama mbinguni. Ee Bwana, ninataabika, njoo unisaidie!”
Ekegusii: Nigo nkorera buna egesingororo gose ebarara; nigo nkweumia buna riruma. Amaiso aane arosire ase okorigereria gochia igoro. Aye Omonene, nigo inde nemechando emenene, indwanerere!”

English: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
Kiswahili: Lakini niseme nini? Amesema nami, naye yeye mwenyewe amelitenda hili. Nitatembea kwa unyenyekevu katika miaka yangu yote kwa sababu ya haya maumivu makali ya nafsi yangu.
Ekegusii: Inki bono ngokwana? Omonene nere okwanire nainche, nere omonyene okorire amang’ana aya. Ase igo nintaare inde nobokanyeku ase emiaka yane yonsi, ase engencho y’obororo bwonsi bw’omoyo one.

English: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live.
Kiswahili: Bwana, kwa mambo kama haya watu huishi, nayo roho yangu hupata uzima katika hayo pia. Uliniponya na kuniacha niishi.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase okoba namang’ana buna ayio, abanto nigo bakoba moyo, na obogima bw’omoika one nao bore ase ayio, na bono ingwenie kegima na onkore imbe moyo.

English: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
Kiswahili: Hakika ilikuwa ya faida yangu ndiyo maana nikapata maumivu makali. Katika upendo wako ukaniokoa kutoka shimo la uharibifu; umeziweka dhambi zangu zote nyuma yako.
Ekegusii: Naama! Nigo narenge nobororo obonge, na obororo obwo bokandetera omorembe. Ase obwanchani bwao gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase engoro y’obosareku; gwatugutire ebibe biane bionsi gochia magega yao.

English: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kaburi haliwezi kukusifu, mauti haiwezi kuimba sifa zako; wale washukao chini shimoni hawawezi kuutarajia uaminifu wako.
Ekegusii: Abare aase abakuure tibagokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, abwo bakuure tibakogotogia; abwo bakogenda ase chimbeera ime tibagosemeria obwegenwa bwao.

English: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
Kiswahili: Walio hai, walio hai: hao wanakusifu, kama ninavyofanya leo. Baba huwaambia watoto wao habari za uaminifu wako.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore moyo nere orakoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, buna inche ngokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase rituko ria reero; ise abana nere agokora obwegenwa bwao bwamanyekana ase abana baye.

English: Yahweh will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in Yahweh’s house.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataniokoa, nasi tutaimba kwa vyombo vya nyuzi siku zote za maisha yetu katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene nantoorie; ase ayio ntobe togoteera amatera, ase okobugia amakano aane, ase obogima bwaito bwonsi, agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene.

English: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”
Kiswahili: Isaya alikuwa amesema, “Tengenezeni dawa ya kubandika ya tini, mweke juu ya jipu, naye atapona.”
Ekegusii: Bono Isaya konya oteebire iga: “Tiga baimokie ribomba ri’amako, baribeke ase rigumba ria Hezekia, erinde agwene.”

English: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to Yahweh’s house?”
Kiswahili: Hezekia alikuwa ameuliza, “Kutakuwa na ishara gani kwamba nitapanda kwenda Hekalu la Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Boigo Hezekia konya oboririe iga: “Nkemanyererio ki gekonyorokia ng’a ningende ase enyomba y’Omonene?”

English: At that time, Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Merodaki-Baladani, mwana wa Baladani mfalme wa Babeli, akamtumia Hezekia barua na zawadi, kwa sababu alikuwa amesikia habari za kuugua na kupona kwake.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omorwoti o Babiloni Merodaki‐Baladani, mosinto o Baladani, agatoma abanto bakaira riruube na ebiegwa ase Hezekia, ekiagera aigwete ng’a Hezekia nabeete omorwaire, naende ng’a konya ogwenire.

English: Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.
Kiswahili: Hezekia akawapokea wale wajumbe kwa furaha na kuwaonyesha vitu vile vilivyokuwa katika ghala zake: yaani fedha, dhahabu, vikolezo na mafuta safi, ghala la silaha lote, na kila kitu kilichokuwa katika hazina zake. Hapakuwa na kitu chochote katika jumba lake la kifalme au katika ufalme wake wote ambacho Hezekia hakuwaonyesha.
Ekegusii: Hezekia akabaroisia buya, erio akaborokia chimonga chiaye chionsi, ne chifeta, ne chitaabu, na ebinsari, na amaguta e rigori rinene, na ebirwanero biaye bionsi, na ebinto bionsi biagachire ase chinyomba chiaye. Tatigete gento kende gionsi ase enyomba yaye, gose ase chikungo chi’oborwoti bwaye, ataborogetie.

English: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo nabii Isaya akaenda kwa Mfalme Hezekia na kumuuliza, “Watu hao walisema nini, na wametoka wapi?” Hezekia akamjibu, “Wametoka nchi ya mbali. Walikuja kwangu kutoka Babeli.”
Ekegusii: Erio omobani Isaya agacha ase Hezekia, omorwoti akamobooria: “Ngento ki abanto aba bakwana? Ng’ai barwa bagacha asore?” Hezekia akamoiraneria: “Barabwo nigo barwa Babiloni, ense y’aare, bagacha ase ’nde.”

English: Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”
Kiswahili: Nabii akauliza, “Waliona nini katika jumba lako la kifalme?” Hezekia akajibu, “Waliona kila kitu katika jumba langu la kifalme. Hakuna kitu chochote katika hazina yangu ambacho sikuwaonyesha.”
Ekegusii: Isaya akamobooria: “Ngento ki barora ase enyomba yao?” Hezekia akairaneria: “Nigo barora ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba yane, tikeri nonya negento ekemo ase amagachero aane ntaborokia.”

English: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of Yahweh of Armies:
Kiswahili: Ndipo Isaya akamwambia Hezekia, “Sikia neno la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote:
Ekegusii: Erio Isaya agateebia Hezekia: “Bono igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda:

English: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hakika wakati unakuja ambapo vitu vyote katika jumba lako la kifalme, na vyote ambavyo baba zako waliweka akiba mpaka siku hii, vitachukuliwa kwenda Babeli. Hakuna chochote kitakachosalia, asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko ngocha are, ekero ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba yao, na ebinto bionsi chisokoro chiao chiagachete goika reero iga nabiimokigwe biirwe Babiloni. Nonya negento ekemo tikegotigara. Aya nar’Omonene atebiire.

English: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”
Kiswahili: Nao baadhi ya wazao wako, nyama yako na damu yako mwenyewe watakaozaliwa kwako, watachukuliwa mbali, nao watakuwa matowashi katika jumba la mfalme wa Babeli.”
Ekegusii: Boigo abana bande bao abamura, abwo kwaiboreirwe, inabairwe, bachie koba abakoreri ase enyomba y’omorwoti o Babiloni.”

English: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”
Kiswahili: Hezekia akamjibu Isaya, “Neno la Bwana ulilosema ni jema.” Kwa kuwa alifikiri, “Patakuwepo amani na usalama wakati wa uhai wangu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Hezekia agateebia Isaya: “Ring’ana ri’Omonene aye gwakwanire nerigiya.” Naende akamoteebia: “Omorembe na okorendwa okuya nigo bigochia koba ase obogima bwane.”

English: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
Kiswahili: Wafarijini, wafarijini watu wangu, asema Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Remia abanto baane! Ee, remia abanto baane! Nabo Nyasae oino atebiire.

English: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of Yahweh’s hand double for all her sins.”
Kiswahili: Sema na Yerusalemu kwa upole, umtangazie kwamba kazi yake ngumu imekamilika, kwamba dhambi yake imefanyiwa fidia, kwamba amepokea kutoka mkononi mwa Bwana maradufu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake zote.
Ekegusii: Kwana amang’ana ’obwororo ase Yerusalemu, moyorarerie ng’a emechando yaye yaerire, na ebibe biaye biabeirwe, naende ng’a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene ase ebibe biaye bionsi.

English: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
Kiswahili: Sauti ya mtu aliaye: “Itengenezeni jangwani njia ya Bwana, nyoosheni njia kuu nyikani kwa ajili ya Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ogoteeba: “Roisia enchera y’Omonene ase erooro; rongeyia enchera enene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, agwo ase erooro.

English: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.
Kiswahili: Kila bonde litainuliwa, kila mlima na kilima kitashushwa; penye mabonde patanyooshwa, napo palipoparuza patasawazishwa.
Ekegusii: Kera rigoko nditichwe rimokerere igoro, na kera egetunwa na ekegoro nabiiranigwe inse, aase atareng’aini nareng’anigwe, na aase are ebitunwa‐tunwa naaranigwe.

English: Yahweh’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”
Kiswahili: Utukufu wa Bwana utafunuliwa, nao wanadamu wote watauona pamoja. Kwa maana kinywa cha Bwana kimenena.”
Ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene mboorokigwe, na Mwanyabaanto bonsi mbaborore bare amo. Omonene nere okwanire amang’ana ayio.”

English: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.
Kiswahili: Sauti husema, “Piga kelele.” Nami nikasema, “Nipige kelele gani?” “Wanadamu wote ni kama majani, nao utukufu wao wote ni kama maua ya kondeni.
Ekegusii: Eriogi rigoteeba, “Raria amang’ana!” Na erinde rikoboria, “Mang’ana ki nkoraria?” “Raria ng’a Mwanyabaanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, obuya bwabo bwonsi nigo bonga egesicha kere mogondo.

English: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
Kiswahili: Majani hunyauka na maua huanguka, kwa sababu pumzi ya Bwana huyapuliza. Hakika wanadamu ni majani.
Ekegusii: Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo, ekero Omonene abiuteire omoika oye; naboigo na Mwanyabaanto banga buna obonyansi.

English: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
Kiswahili: Majani hunyauka na maua huanguka, lakini neno la Mungu wetu ladumu milele.”
Ekegusii: Ee, obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo, korende ring’ana ria Nyasae oito nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.”

English: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”
Kiswahili: Wewe uletaye habari njema Sayuni, panda juu ya mlima mrefu. Wewe uletaye habari njema Yerusalemu, inua sauti yako kwa kupiga kelele, inua sauti, usiogope; iambie miji ya Yuda, “Yuko hapa Mungu wenu!”
Ekegusii: Aye Sayoni, omoraria bw’amang’ana amaya, tiira gochia ase ebitunwa ebitambe igoro. Aye Yerusalemu, omoraria bw’amang’ana amaya, aka eriogi riao ne chinguru; ee, aka eriogi mono, toiroka; teebiaemechie y’Abayuda iga: “Rora Nyasae oino!”

English: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
Kiswahili: Tazameni, Bwana Mwenyezi anakuja na nguvu, nao mkono wake ndio utawalao kwa ajili yake. Tazameni, ujira wake u pamoja naye, nayo malipo yake yanafuatana naye.
Ekegusii: Rora, Omonene ngocha are ore nokobua, okoboko kwaye nkobe gokogaamba. Naama! Nigo agocha obwate eng’eria yaye, na ebiasakoire nigo bire ase obosio bwaye.

English: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
Kiswahili: Huchunga kundi lake kama mchungaji wa mifugo: Hukusanya wana-kondoo katika mikono yake na kuwachukua karibu na moyo wake, huwaongoza taratibu wale wanyonyeshao.
Ekegusii: Narisie riicho riaye buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye, nasangererie chimanwa chi’eching’ondi achiagate, nachibogorie ase egekuba kiaye, na echi chire ne chimanwa ching’are nachiraae ng’ora ng’ora.

English: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyepima maji ya bahari kwenye konzi ya mkono wake, au kuzipima mbingu kwa shibiri yake? Ni nani aliyeyashika mavumbi ya dunia katika kikapu, au kupima milima kwenye kipimio na vilima kwenye mizani?
Ekegusii: Ning’o orengire amaache e chinyancha noroe rw’okoboko kwaye? Ning’o oramboire ebiara bi’amaboko aye korenga igoro? Ning’o obekire orotu rw’ense ase ekerengero, gose ning’o orengire ebitunwa na ebigoro nekerengero?

English: Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyeyafahamu mawazo ya Bwana, au kumfundisha akiwa kama mshauri wake?
Ekegusii: Ning’o okoraa Omoika bw’Omonene, gose ning’o okomosemia na komoteebereria?

English: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?
Kiswahili: Ni nani ambaye Bwana ametaka shauri kwake ili kumwelimisha, naye ni nani aliyemfundisha njia iliyo sawa? Ni nani aliyemfundisha maarifa au kumwonyesha mapito ya ufahamu?
Ekegusii: Ning’Omonene akoboria amosemie amang’ana buya? Ning’o omworokereretie oboeto bw’oboronge, na komworokia okomanya, gose komworokia enchera y’okomanya?

English: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.
Kiswahili: Hakika mataifa ni kama tone ndani ya ndoo, ni kama vumbi jembamba juu ya mizani, huvipima visiwa kana kwamba vilikuwa vumbi laini.
Ekegusii: Naama! Ebisaku nigo binga buna entonyi y’amaache egotonya korwa ase enyongo. Nigo bireng’anirie norotu orosinini rore ase esani ekorengera; rora, nigo akoimokia ebisinka buna orotu orosinini.

English: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.
Kiswahili: Lebanoni hautoshi kwa moto wa madhabahuni, wala wanyama wake hawatoshi kwa sadaka za kuteketezwa.
Ekegusii: Emete ye rinani ria Lebanoni tegoisana ebe chinko chigouterwa omorero, ne ching’iti chionsi chireo tichigoisana chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa.

English: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
Kiswahili: Mbele yake mataifa yote ni kama si kitu, yanaonekana yasio na thamani na zaidi ya bure kabisa.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nigo bire bosa ase obosio bwaye, nigo abibarete buna negento bosa, bitaisaini kende.

English: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
Kiswahili: Basi, utamlinganisha Mungu na nani? Utamlinganisha na kitu gani?
Ekegusii: Nyasae, ning’o moramoreng’anie, gose mogwekano ki moramoreng’anie?

English: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya sanamu, fundi huisubu, naye mfua dhahabu huifunika kwa dhahabu na kuitengenezea mikufu ya fedha.
Ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa nigo okobombwa nomooroisia ebinto, erio omoturi oyooma netaabu, naende oyoroiseria ebinyuri bi’efeta.

English: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.
Kiswahili: Mtu aliye maskini sana asiyeweza kuleta sadaka kama hii huuchagua mti usiooza. Humtafuta fundi stadi wa kusimamisha sanamu ambayo haitatikisika.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore omotaka otabwati ebinge akorua nigo agochora omote otari kogunda, origia omooroisia omong’aini omanyete kobaacha, ere omobaachera omogwekano otari gosuka.

English: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?
Kiswahili: Je, hujui? Je, hujasikia? Je, hujaambiwa tangu mwanzo? Je, hujafahamu tangu kuumbwa kwa dunia?
Ekegusii: Inee! Timwana komanya? Timwana koigwa? Timwana goteebigwa amang’ana ayio korwa omochakano? Timwana koyamanya korwa omochakano bw’oboroso bw’ense?

English: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,
Kiswahili: Anakaa kwenye kiti cha enzi juu ya duara ya dunia, nao watu wakaao ndani yake ni kama panzi. Huzitandaza mbingu kama chandarua, na kuzitandaza kama hema la kuishi.
Ekegusii: Ere nere oikaransete ase orosingo rw’ense, na abamenyete ase ense nigo banga buna ebisase; nere okorambora igoro chionsi buna egetambaa gekoramborwa, ee, nigo agochirambora buna eema ekomenywa ekoramborwa.

English: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.
Kiswahili: Huwafanya wakuu kuwa si kitu, na kuwashusha watawala wa dunia hii kuwa kitu bure.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agokeyia abagaambi baba bosa, na abagaambi ebiina b’ense boigo baba bosa.

English: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.
Kiswahili: Mara baada ya kupandwa, mara baada ya kutiwa ardhini, mara baada ya kutoa mizizi yao ardhini, ndipo huwapulizia nao wakanyauka, nao upepo wa kisulisuli huwapeperusha kama makapi.
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo banga buna ebimeri bisimekire masomberera, bitaireti emeri inse. Omonene nigo akobaguseria embeo, boma, na omoubera noro obairurukia buna okoirurukia obonyansi obwomo.

English: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
Kiswahili: “Utanilinganisha mimi na nani? Au ni nani anayelingana nami?” asema yeye Aliye Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Oyore Omochenu nigo akoboria iga: “Ning’o rende moranyare kondeng’ania, ng’a imbe buna oyio?”

English: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, not one is lacking.
Kiswahili: Inueni macho yenu mtazame mbinguni: Ni nani aliyeumba hivi vyote? Ni yeye aletaye nje jeshi la nyota moja baada ya nyingine na kuziita kila moja kwa jina lake. Kwa sababu ya uweza wake mkuu na nguvu zake kuu, hakuna hata mojawapo inayokosekana.
Ekegusii: Rigereria gochia igoro morore! Ning’o otongete ebinto ebio bionsi? Nere oria okoraa emeganda y’ebitongwa ebio ase omobaro obo, na koroka kera ekemo erieta riaye. Okobua kwaye nokonene mono, ne chinguru chiaye nigo chire nokobua, ase ayio kende tikeremeti nonya nekemo.

English: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unasema, ee Yakobo, nanyi ee Israeli, kulalamika, “Njia yangu imefichwa Bwana asiione, Mungu wangu hajali shauri langu?”
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki mogoteeba ng’a Omonene taroochi chinchera chiaino, naende ng’a ere Nyasae obarinire oboronge bwaino?

English: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
Kiswahili: Je wewe, hufahamu? Je wewe, hujasikia? Bwana ni Mungu wa milele, Muumba wa miisho ya dunia. Hatachoka wala kulegea, wala hakuna hata mmoja awezaye kuupima ufahamu wake.
Ekegusii: Inee! Timwana komanya gose koigwa, ng’a Omonene nigo are Nyasae o kare na kare, na Omotongi bwe chinsinyo chi’ense? Ere tari kogoya gose korosa. Obong’aini bwaye tibokorigigwa bomanyekane buna bore.

English: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
Kiswahili: Huwapa nguvu waliolegea na huongeza nguvu za wadhaifu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akoa omonto oyo ogoyire chinguru, na oyo otari na nguru nigo akomomentera chinguru.

English: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
Kiswahili: Hata vijana huchoka na kulegea, nao vijana wanaume hujikwaa na kuanguka,
Ekegusii: Abasae mbagoye na korosa, na abamura mbagochwe bagwe inse,

English: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
Kiswahili: bali wale wamtumainio Bwana atafanya upya nguvu zao. Watapaa juu kwa mbawa kama tai; watapiga mbio wala hawatachoka, watatembea kwa miguu wala hawatazimia.
Ekegusii: korende abwo baganyete na gosemeri’Omonene mbaegwe chinguru chinyia, mbairuruke gochia igoro ne chimbaaba buna echi’ebiongo; mbabe bakominyoka batari korosa, mbabe bagotaara batari kogoya.

English: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.
Kiswahili: “Nyamazeni kimya mbele zangu, enyi visiwa! Mataifa na wafanye upya nguvu zao! Wao na wajitokeze, kisha waseme, tukutane pamoja mahali pa hukumu.
Ekegusii: “Inwe ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, mokire‐kiri, montegerere, tiga abanto b’ebisaku banyore chinguru chinyia, tiga basuke gocha ang’e, bakwane; toche amo, toike ang’e ase ekiina.

English: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.
Kiswahili: “Ni nani aliyemchochea mmoja kutoka mashariki, akimwita katika haki kwa utumishi wake? Huyatia mataifa mikononi mwake, na kuwatiisha wafalme mbele zake. Huwafanya kuwa mavumbi kwa upanga wake, huwafanya makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo kwa upinde wake.
Ekegusii: “Ning’o orangeretie n’oboronge oyomo korwa moocha, oria oumeranete nobobui aande onsi ase agendete? Ere nigo akobeeka abanto b’ebisaku inse y’okobua kwaye, erinde atachere abarwoti inse y’amagoro aye; oyio nigo agoita abanto b’ebisaku n’omoro, obakora baba buna orotu, na ase obota bwaye nigo akobasiarera buna obonyansi obwomo.

English: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.
Kiswahili: Huwafuatia na kuendelea salama, katika njia ambayo miguu yake haijawahi kupita.
Ekegusii: Nigo akobabwatia, oeta na orendire buya, ase chinchera atana goeta rinde.

English: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am he.”
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyefanya jambo hili na kulitimiliza, akiita vizazi tangu mwanzo? Mimi, Bwana, ni wa kwanza nami nitakuwa pamoja na wa mwisho: mimi Bwana ndiye.”
Ekegusii: Ning’o okorete na goikerania aya? Ning’o orangeretie ebiaare bi’abaanto korwa omochakano? Ninche Omonene, ninche oyo bw’omochakano; ninche oyo bw’omoerio, ninche Ere.”

English: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.
Kiswahili: Visiwa vimeliona na kuogopa, miisho ya dunia inatetemeka. Wanakaribia na kuja mbele,
Ekegusii: Ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha chiarorire ayio chiamwoboire, chinsinyo chi’ense nigo chigotengechigwa; chiasukire gocha ang’e.

English: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”
Kiswahili: kila mmoja humsaidia mwingine na kusema kwa ndugu yake, “Uwe hodari!”
Ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo agokonya omogisangio oye; oyomo oteebiaoyonde, “Kabe omoremu!”

English: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good;” and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.
Kiswahili: Fundi humtia moyo sonara, yeye alainishaye kwa nyundo humhimiza yeye agongeaye kwenye fuawe, Humwambia yeye aunganishaye, “Ni kazi njema.” Naye huikaza sanamu kwa misumari ili isitikisike.
Ekegusii: Omosenia bwe chibao nigo akobeeka omoturi bw’etaabu omokia, na omoturi ebioma obeeka omoturagi chinguru, oteeba, “Oborembo bw’okobwatania nobuya.” Erio babwatania omogwekano nemesumari tonyegera.

English: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,
Kiswahili: “Lakini wewe, ee Israeli, mtumishi wangu, Yakobo, niliyemchagua, ninyi wazao wa Abrahamu rafiki yangu,
Ekegusii: “Korende inwe Abaisraeli, abasomba baane, inwe nabaanto ba Yakobo nachorete, inwe nigo more ab’ororeeria rwa Aburaamu, omosani one.

English: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’
Kiswahili: nilikuchukua toka miisho ya dunia, nilikuita kutoka pembe zake za mbali. Nilisema, ‘Wewe ni mtumishi wangu’; nimekuchagua, wala sikukukataa.
Ekegusii: Nigo nabarusetie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense, nkabarangeria korwa ase chinsinyo chi’aare mono, nkabateebia: Inwe nabasomba baane, nabachorire, timbaangeti.

English: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
Kiswahili: Hivyo usiogope, kwa maana niko pamoja nawe; usifadhaike, kwa maana mimi ni Mungu wako. Nitakutia nguvu na kukusaidia; nitakutegemeza kwa mkono wa kuume wa haki yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio timoiroka, inche nigo inde amo nainwe, timoichana, inche ninche Nyasae oino; nimbabeeke chinguru, mbakonye, nimbasiire nokoboko gw’okorio kw’oboronge bwane.

English: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.
Kiswahili: “Wote walioona hasira dhidi yako hakika wataaibika na kutahayarika, wale wakupingao watakuwa kama vile si kitu, na kuangamia.
Ekegusii: “Rora, abwo bonsi baabagechete mbasookigwe na gotantanigwa; abwo bakobaengereria mbabe bosa basirigwe.

English: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.
Kiswahili: Ingawa utawatafuta adui zako, hutawaona. Wale wanaopigana vita dhidi yako watakuwa kama vile si kitu kabisa.
Ekegusii: Nigo morabarigie abwo bakobasoera, ko timokobanyora; abwo baarenge kobarwania nigo barabe bosa kegima.

English: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wako, nikushikaye mkono wako wa kuume na kukuambia, Usiwe na hofu, nitakusaidia.
Ekegusii: Ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nimbabwate amaboko aino a borio. Ninche nkobateebia inwe: Timoiroka, nimbakonye.

English: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Usiogope, ee Yakobo uliye mdudu, ee Israeli uliye mdogo, kwa kuwa Mimi mwenyewe nitakusaidia,” asema Bwana, Mkombozi wako, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Inwe ororeeria rwa Yakobo ronga buna rikonde, inwe ekeombe egeke ki’Abaisraeli, timoiroka! Inche Omonene nimbakonye. Ninche Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli inde Omobooria oino.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.
Kiswahili: “Tazama, nitakufanya chombo cha kupuria, kipya na chenye makali, chenye meno mengi. Utaipura milima na kuiponda na kuvifanya vilima kuwa kama makapi.
Ekegusii: “Rora, nimbakore inwe mobe egekorero gi’okoora, kere ekiya na kere namaara amoge; inwe moore ebitunwa, mobisamunyore, imokore ebigoro bibe buna omoiriro.

English: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in Yahweh. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Utaipepeta, nao upepo utaichukua, dhoruba itaipeperushia mbali. Bali wewe utajifurahisha katika Bwana na katika utukufu wa yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Mobisiare, na omwaga obirurukie gochia aare, erio ekembugu‐mbugu kebisiarere. Inwe abanyene mogoke ase Omonene na komwetogeria oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, Yahweh, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
Kiswahili: “Maskini na wahitaji wanatafuta maji, lakini hayapo, ndimi zao zimekauka kwa kiu. Lakini Mimi Bwana nitawajibu, Mimi, Mungu wa Israeli, sitawaacha.
Ekegusii: “Ekero abataka na abaremeire barabe bakorigia amaache na tibayanyora, ekero chimeme chiabo chirabe chiabwatanire namang’ang’ura; inche Omonene nimbaigwe, inche Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tinkobatiga.

English: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya mito itiririke juu ya vilima vilivyo kame, nazo chemchemi ndani ya mabonde. Nitaligeuza jangwa liwe mabwawa ya maji, nayo ardhi iliyokauka kuwa chemchemi za maji.
Ekegusii: Nindete chindooche korwa ase ebigoro ebiomo, ne chinsoko nchituboke ase amagoko ime; ning’onchore erooro ebe ritibo ri’amaache, na ense enyomo ebe ne chinsoko chire namaache.

English: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;
Kiswahili: Katika jangwa nitaotesha mwerezi, mshita, mhadasi na mzeituni. Nitaweka misunobari, mivinje na misanduku pamoja huko nyikani,
Ekegusii: Nimerie emecharake ase erooro, boigo nimerie aroro emekonge, na emeadasi, na emezeituni. Ee, nimerie emetarakwa na emete

English: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that Yahweh’s hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba watu wapate kuona na kujua, wapate kufikiri na kuelewa, kwamba mkono wa Bwana umetenda hili, kwamba yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli ndiye alilifanya.”
Ekegusii: ende egwekaine emeuru, na emebeno amo, erinde abanto mbarore na komanya, naende mbaarengererie bamanye bonsi amo, ng’a nokoboko kw’Omonene gwakorire ayio, ee, ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nere otongete ebio bionsi.”

English: Produce your cause,” says Yahweh. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.
Kiswahili: Bwana asema, “Leta shauri lako. Toa hoja yako,” asema Mfalme wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Omonene, Omorwoti bw’abaanto ba Yakobo, nigo agoteeba iga: Renta amang’ana aino, renta oborori bwaino botoenekerie.

English: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.
Kiswahili: “Leteni sanamu zenu zituambie ni nini kitakachotokea. Tuambieni mambo ya zamani yalikuwa nini, ili tupate kuyatafakari na kujua matokeo yake ya mwisho. Au tutangazieni mambo yatakayokuja,
Ekegusii: Tiga baborente bototeebie aya agochia koba; tiga bototeebie amang’ana a kare buna arenge, erinde tonyare koyarengereria na komanya buna aikeranetigwe, naende botoorokerie buna amang’ana agochia koba.

English: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.
Kiswahili: tuambieni ni nini kitakachotokea baadaye, ili tupate kujua kuwa ninyi ni miungu. Fanyeni jambo lolote zuri au baya, ili tupate kutishika na kujazwa na hofu.
Ekegusii: Toteebie aya agochi‐gocha, erinde tomanye ng’a inwe ne chinyasae; kora amang’ana amaya, gose amabe erinde tokorora ayio tokumie.

English: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi ni zaidi ya bure kabisa, na kazi zenu hazifai kitu kabisa; yeye awachaguaye ni chukizo sana.
Ekegusii: Naama! Inwe nigo more bosa kegima, na emeremo yaino nero mbosa kegima; oyo obachorire inwe na kobasasiima nigo are okogechia.

English: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.
Kiswahili: “Nimemchochea mtu mmoja kutoka kaskazini, naye yuaja, mmoja toka mawio ya jua aliitaye Jina langu. Huwakanyaga watawala kana kwamba ni matope, kama mfinyanzi akanyagavyo udongo wa kufinyangia.
Ekegusii: “Inarangeretie omonto korwa sugusu, ere ochire; ee, nigo namorusirie korwa moocha, ere narangerie erieta riane akonywe, natiringere abagaambi inse buna esike egotiringwa, na buna omokori chinyongo agotiringa esike.

English: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and before, that we may say, ‘He is right’? Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyenena hili tokea mwanzoni, ili tupate kujua, au kabla, ili tuweze kusema, ‘Alikuwa sawa’? Hakuna aliyenena hili, hakuna aliyetangulia kusema hili, hakuna yeyote aliyesikia maneno kutoka kwenu.
Ekegusii: Ning’o obaanete amang’ana ayio agwo kare, erinde tonyare komanya ng’a amang’ana oyio ateebete n’ayoboronge? Onde tari nonya noyomo oyaorogetie na koyararia; onde tari oigwete komokoyakwana.

English: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Nilikuwa wa kwanza kumwambia Sayuni, ‘Tazama, wako hapa!’ Nilimpa Yerusalemu mjumbe wa habari njema.
Ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nigo narenge omotang’ani goteebia Sayoni: Rigereria, morore abwo! Ninche narenterete Yerusalemu abwo bararetie amang’ana amaya.

English: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask, can answer a word.
Kiswahili: Ninatazama, lakini hakuna yeyote: hakuna yeyote miongoni mwao awezaye kutoa shauri, hakuna yeyote wa kutoa jibu wakati ninapowauliza.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero narigereretie tinaroche monto onde, nonya nase egati yabo mosemia onde tarengeo; ekero naboretie, onde tarengeo ongiraneretie.

English: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
Kiswahili: Tazama, wote ni ubatili! Matendo yao ni bure; vinyago vyao ni upepo mtupu na machafuko.
Ekegusii: Naama! Chinyasae echio chionsi mbosa. Emeremo eyio y’abanto nigo ere bosa kegima, ee, emegwekano eyio abanto babombete nigo enga embeo bosa.”

English: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.
Kiswahili: “Huyu hapa mtumishi wangu, ninayemtegemeza, mteule wangu, ambaye ninapendezwa naye; nitaweka Roho yangu juu yake, naye ataleta haki kwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: “Rora, omosomba one oyio inche nabekire chinguru ime yaye; omochore one omoyo one ogokirie nere. Namobekeire Omoika one, nere oraarente oboronge ase abanto b’ebisaku.

English: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.
Kiswahili: Hatapaza sauti wala kupiga kelele, wala hataiinua sauti yake barabarani.
Ekegusii: Ere takorera, gose tagoaka eriogi rinene, gose takoritiga riigugwe ase chinchera.

English: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
Kiswahili: Mwanzi uliopondeka hatauvunja, na utambi unaofuka moshi hatauzima. Kwa uaminifu ataleta haki,
Ekegusii: Egetonto giatachetwe tagokebuna, gose orotambe rw’etaya rokoimoka erioki takororimia. Ase obwegenwa bwaye narente oboronge.

English: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice on the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”
Kiswahili: hatazimia roho wala kukata tamaa, mpaka atakaposimamisha haki juu ya dunia. Visiwa vitaweka tumaini lao katika sheria yake.”
Ekegusii: Ere takorosa gose gokwa omoyo; goika abe orentire oboronge ase ense na kobokong’ia, na ebisinka, ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha nchibe chiganyete amachiiko aye.”

English: God Yahweh, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says:
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Mungu, Bwana, yeye aliyeziumba mbingu na kuzitanda, aliyeitandaza dunia na vyote vitokavyo humo, awapaye watu wake pumzi, na uzima kwa wale waendao humo:
Ekegusii: Nyasae, oyotongete igoro chionsi na gochirambora, oyo bwarete ense na bionsi ebikorwao, oyo oete abanto bareo obogima, na kobaa omoika abwo bagotaara aroro, nigo agoteeba iga:

English: “I, Yahweh, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,
Kiswahili: “Mimi, Bwana, nimekuita katika haki; nitakushika mkono wako. Nitakulinda na kukufanya kuwa Agano kwa ajili ya watu na nuru kwa Mataifa,
Ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, nakorangeirie ase oboronge; nakobwatire okoboko kwao nkorendete. Goetera asore ninkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabaanto, obe omobaso bw’abaanto b’ebisaku.

English: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.
Kiswahili: kuwafungua macho wale wasioona, kuwaacha huru kutoka kifungoni waliofungwa jela, na kuwafungua kutoka gerezani wale wanaokaa gizani.
Ekegusii: Oramokie amaiso ’emeuko, osibore abasibwa korwa ase echela, na abwo bamenyete ase omosunte korwa ase obosibwa bwabo.

English: “I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana; hilo ndilo Jina langu! Sitampa mwingine utukufu wangu wala sanamu sifa zangu.
Ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, erio nario erieta riane; tindi koa omonto onde obonene bwane; tinkoa emegwekano egosasimwa ogotogigwa kwane.

English: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”
Kiswahili: Tazama, mambo ya kwanza yametokea, nami natangaza mambo mapya; kabla hayajatokea nawatangazia habari zake.”
Ekegusii: Rora, amang’ana nateebete agwo kare aikeranire, na bono nigo nkobaraareria amang’ana amayia, nkobayamanyia atarakorekana.”

English: Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.
Kiswahili: Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, sifa zake toka miisho ya dunia, ninyi mshukao chini baharini, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, enyi visiwa na wote wakaao ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia; motogie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense! Inwe abaeti ase enyancha amo n’ebinto bionsi bire imeo, inwe abamomenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, motogie Omonene!

English: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!
Kiswahili: Jangwa na miji yake na vipaze sauti zao; makao anamoishi Kedari na yashangilie. Watu wa Sela waimbe kwa furaha, na wapige kelele kutoka vilele vya milima.
Ekegusii: Tiga erooro na emechie ereo biake amariogi, na abamenyete ase emechie ya Kedari boigo. Abanto bamenyete ase omochie o Sela mbatere nomogooko, baake eriogi korwa ase ebichuria bi’ebitunwa igoro.

English: Let them give glory to Yahweh, and declare his praise in the islands.
Kiswahili: Wampe Bwana utukufu, na kutangaza sifa zake katika visiwa.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi batogie Omonene na koraria obonene bwaye ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha.

English: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataenda kama mtu mwenye nguvu, kama shujaa atachochea shauku yake, kwa kelele ataamsha kilio cha vita, naye atashinda adui zake.
Ekegusii: Omonene naoroke buna etuoni y’esegi, na buna omorwani esegi abokie omokia oye; nigo agoaka eriogi ri’esegi na kwoga mono, nigo akweorokia ng’a nare nokobua igore y’ababisa baye.

English: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.
Kiswahili: “Kwa muda mrefu nimenyamaza kimya, nimekaa kimya na kujizuia. Lakini sasa, kama mwanamke wakati wa kujifungua, ninapiga kelele, ninatweta na kushusha pumzi.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire nkirete‐kiri ase engaki entambe, nabeire ngendererete gwetanga na gokira; korende bono ning’ake eriogi buna eri’omokuungu okobina aibore; ning’use omoika na goita egekoe.

English: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.
Kiswahili: Nitaharibu milima na vilima na kukausha mimea yako yote; nitafanya mito kuwa visiwa na kukausha mabwawa.
Ekegusii: Ninsarie kegima ebitunwa na ebigoro, ninyomie ebimeri biabo bionsi; ning’onchore chindooche chibe ense enyomo, ninkamie amatibo.

English: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.
Kiswahili: Nitawaongoza vipofu kwenye njia ambayo hawajaijua, kwenye mapito wasiyoyazoea nitawaongoza; nitafanya giza kuwa nuru mbele yao, na kufanya mahali palipoparuza kuwa laini. Haya ndiyo mambo nitakayofanya; mimi sitawaacha.
Ekegusii: “Nindaae abanto bare emeuko ase enchera batana komanya, nimbatang’ane ase oboeto batana komanya. Ning’onchore omosunte ore bosio bwabo obe oborabu, aase atareng’aini naaranigwe. Ayio naro ndabakorere, tingotiga goikerania amang’ana aane.

English: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale wanaotumaini sanamu, wanaoviambia vinyago, ‘Ninyi ndio miungu yetu,’ watarudishwa nyuma kwa aibu kubwa.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto basemeretie emegwekano egosasimwa mbairanigwe magega, basookigwe, ekiagera nigo bagoteebia emegwekano eyio ebombire; Inwe ninwe chinyasae chiaito.”

English: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.
Kiswahili: “Sikieni, enyi viziwi; tazameni, enyi vipofu, mpate kuona!
Ekegusii: “Inwe abamore emetino, tegerera moigwe, nainwe abamore emeuko, rigereria monyare korora!

English: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as Yahweh’s servant?
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliye kipofu isipokuwa mtumishi wangu, na kiziwi kama mjumbe ninayemtuma? Ni nani aliye kipofu kama yeye aliyejitoa kwangu, aliye kipofu kama mtumishi wa Bwana?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ore omouko otatiga omosomba one? Ning’o ore omotino buna omonto one natomire? Ning’o ore omouko buna omwegenwa one, gose buna omosomba one inche Omonene?

English: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.
Kiswahili: Mmeona vitu vingi, lakini hamkuzingatia; masikio yenu yako wazi, lakini hamsikii chochote.”
Ekegusii: Omosomba one nigo akorora ebinto ebinge, korende tari kobirengereria ng’a nebi’engencho enene; nigo atinogete amato aye, korende tari koigwa.”

English: It pleased Yahweh, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.
Kiswahili: Ilimpendeza Bwana kwa ajili ya haki yake kufanya sheria yake kuwa kuu na tukufu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye Omonene nigo agogete koa amachiiko aye okobua na ogosikwa.

English: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers, and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’
Kiswahili: Lakini hili ni taifa lililoibwa na kutekwa nyara, wote wamenaswa katika mashimo, au wamefichwa katika magereza. Wamekuwa nyara, wala hapana yeyote awaokoaye. Wamefanywa mateka, wala hapana yeyote asemaye, “Warudishe.”
Ekegusii: Korende abanto aba baibirwe na gosakorwa, bonsi bategirwe na kogwa ase chiirima; nigo babisire ase chinyomba chi’obosibwa; bairirwe, onde tari orabatoorie, boosirwe, onde tari ogoteeba: “Tiga bairanigwe.”

English: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?
Kiswahili: Ni nani miongoni mwenu atakayesikiliza hili, au atakayezingatia kwa makini katika wakati ujao?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ase more oranyare gotegerera amang’ana aya, erio ayarengererie na koyaigwera ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha.

English: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t Yahweh, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliyemtoa Yakobo kuwa mateka, na Israeli kwa wateka nyara? Je, hakuwa yeye, Bwana, ambaye tumetenda dhambi dhidi yake? Kwa kuwa hawakufuata njia zake, hawakutii sheria zake.
Ekegusii: Ning’o oruete abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo ase amaboko ’abasakori? Ning’o oruete Abaisraeli ase amaboko ’abauri? Inee! Tari Omonene oria twakorete ebibe asare? Tokaanga kobwatia chinchera chiaye, naende tokaanga koigwera amachiiko aye.

English: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle. It set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know. It burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo akawamwagia hasira yake inayowaka, ukali wa vita. Iliwazunguka kwa miali ya moto, lakini hata hivyo hawakuelewa; iliwateketeza, lakini hawakuyatia moyoni.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akaumora ekeririanda kiaye ase abanto, akabaumorera endamwamu yaye ekobera, na esegi entindi. Abanto bakaba bagosambwa nomorero ase chinsemo chionsi, ko tibamanyete kende, ee, omorero oria okabasamba, korende tibaarengereretie ayio ime ase chinkoro chiabo.

English: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, yeye aliyekuumba, ee Yakobo, yeye aliyekuhuluku, ee Israeli: “Usiogope kwa maana nimekukomboa, nimekuita wewe kwa jina lako, wewe u wangu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, aya nar’Omonene oria obatongete na kobabomba agoteeba; “Timoiroka, ekiagera inche nababooririe; nabarangeirie ase amarieta aino; inwe nabaane.

English: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
Kiswahili: Unapopita kwenye maji makuu, nitakuwa pamoja nawe, unapopita katika mito ya maji, hayatakugharikisha. Utakapopita katika moto, hutaungua, miali ya moto haitakuunguza.
Ekegusii: Ekero morabe mogoeta ase amaache ime, nimbe amo nainwe; namoba mogoeta ase chindooche, tichikobamera. Namoete ase omorero, timogosambwa, gose omorero ekebemberi tokobasiria.

English: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wako, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli, Mwokozi wako. Ninaitoa Misri kuwa fidia yako, Kushi na Seba badala yako.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ninche Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, ninche Omotooria oino. Nigo naruete Abamisiri bakaba embooria ase engencho yaino, nkarua Abaetiopia na Abaseba ribaga riaino.

English: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you, therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wewe ni wa thamani na wa kuheshimiwa machoni pangu, nami kwa kuwa ninakupenda, nitatoa watu badala yako na mataifa badala ya maisha yako.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo more ab’engencho enene ase amaiso aane, mwabeire mosikire, nainche nigo mbanchete; ase ayio nindue abanto b’ebisaku basirigwe ribaga riaino, erinde obogima bwaino botoorigwe.

English: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.
Kiswahili: Usiogope, kwa kuwa mimi nipo pamoja nawe, nitawaleta watoto wako kutoka mashariki, na kukukusanya kutoka magharibi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, timoiroka, inche nigo inde amo nainwe. “Nindete abanto b’ororeeria rwaino korwa moocha, na korwa bosongo nimbasangererie.

English: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
Kiswahili: Nitaiambia kaskazini, ‘Watoe!’ nayo kusini, ‘Usiwazuie.’ Walete wana wangu kutoka mbali, na binti zangu kutoka miisho ya dunia:
Ekegusii: Nintebie chinse chia sugusu: Tiga abanto baane barue agwo, ne chinse chia Irianyi: Timobatanga! Renta abamura baane korwa aare, na abaiseke baane korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense.

English: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”
Kiswahili: kila mmoja ambaye ameitwa kwa Jina langu, niliyemuumba kwa utukufu wangu, niliyemhuluku na kumfanya.”
Ekegusii: Kera omonto okorokwa ase erieta riane, oyio inche natongete anyore obonene bwane, kera oyomo oyio inche nabombete na komotonga, tiga ache.”

English: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.
Kiswahili: Uwaongoze wale wenye macho lakini hawaoni, wenye masikio lakini hawasikii.
Ekegusii: Renta abanto bonsi bare emeuko nonya babwate amaiso, na abare emetino nonya babwate amato.

English: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified, or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote yanakutanika pamoja, na makabila yanakusanyika. Ni nani miongoni mwao aliyetangulia kutuambia haya, na kututangazia mambo yaliyopita? Walete mashahidi wao ili kuwathibitisha kuwa walikuwa sahihi, ili wengine waweze kusikia, waseme, “Ni kweli.”
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bache amo, ee, tiga abanto bonsi basangererekane bache. Ning’o ore ase egati yabo oranyare koraria amang’ana aya? Ning’o oranyare gotworokia amang’ana ayabeete kare? Tiga barente birori biabo, erinde baorokie oboronge bwabo, na ekero baraigwe bateebe: “Nekeene mogoteeba.”

English: “You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.
Kiswahili: “Ninyi ni mashahidi wangu,” asema Bwana, “na mtumishi wangu niliyemchagua, ili mpate kunijua na kuniamini, na kutambua kwamba Mimi ndiye. Kabla yangu hakuna mungu aliyefanyizwa, wala hatakuwepo mwingine baada yangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Inwe nigo more birori baane, abasomba baane nachorire, erinde monyare komanya inche na konyegena, naende momanye ng’a inche ninche Ere. Enyasae ende teri yantang’anerete, ende teri erabombwe magega yane.

English: I myself am Yahweh. Besides me, there is no savior.
Kiswahili: Mimi, naam mimi, ndimi Bwana, zaidi yangu hakuna mwokozi.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, ninche bweka inde Omotooria, naende onde tari.

English: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown, and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says Yahweh, “and I am God.
Kiswahili: Nimedhihirisha, kuokoa na kutangaza: Mimi, wala si mungu mgeni katikati yenu. Ninyi ni mashahidi wangu,” asema Bwana, “kwamba Mimi ndimi Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nigo narentete ogotooreka, nkabarareria ayio, nainwe mokayaigwa, na enyasae engeni tiyarenge ase egati yaino; inwe nigo more birori baane ng’a inche ninche Nyasae.” Naboigo Omonene atebiire.

English: Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
Kiswahili: Naam, tangu siku za kale, Mimi ndiye. Hakuna hata mmoja awezaye kuokoa kutoka mkononi wangu. Mimi ninapotenda, ni nani awezaye kutangua?”
Ekegusii: Ee, inche ninche Nyasae; nigo ngendererete koba oyio oyio. Omonto tari oranyare gotooria omonto onde korwa ase okoboko kwane, nigo ngokora emeremo, na onde tari oranyare koyetanga.

English: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo, Mkombozi wako, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli: “Kwa ajili yenu nitatumana Babeli na kuwaleta Wakaldayo wote kama wakimbizi, katika meli walizozionea fahari.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene, Omobooria oino oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: “Ase engencho yaino nintome abasikari gochia Babiloni baserie abanto b’aroro, erinde batame; ee, Abakalidayo abwo baserigwe gochia ase chimeeri chiabo echio bagokerete.

English: I am Yahweh, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”
Kiswahili: Mimi ndimi Bwana, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wako, Muumba wa Israeli, Mfalme wako.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Omochenu oino, ninche omotongi oino inwe Abaisraeli, ninche inde omorwoti oino.”

English: Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, yeye aliyefanya njia baharini, mahali pa kupita kwenye maji mengi,
Ekegusii: Omonene oroisetie enchera ase enyancha ime, ee, oboeto ase amaache amange are ne chinguru,

English: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:
Kiswahili: aliyeyakokota magari ya vita na farasi, jeshi pamoja na askari wa msaada, nao wakalala huko, wala hawatainuka tena kamwe, wakakomeshwa, na wakazimika kama utambi:
Ekegusii: akarenta aroro chigari chi’esegi ne chibarasi, na abasikari amo ne chituoni chiabo, erio akabaiyeria inse, tibatenena naende; nigo basiretigwe bakarima buna orotambe rw’etaya. Aya nar’Omonene oyio agoteeba:

English: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
Kiswahili: “Msiyakumbuke mambo yaliyopita, wala msiyatafakari mambo ya zamani.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa koinyora amang’ana a kare, gose korengereria igoro y’ebinto biaetire.

English: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
Kiswahili: Tazama, nitafanya jambo jipya! Sasa litachipuka, je, hamtalitambua? Nitafanya njia jangwani na vijito vya maji katika nchi kame.
Ekegusii: Naama! Ninkore ring’ana riyia; ring’ana erio riachakire kooroka; Inee! Timorirochi? Nindoisie enchera ase erooro, nintubokie chindooche ase ense enyomo,

English: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
Kiswahili: Wanyama wa mwituni wataniheshimu, mbweha na bundi, kwa sababu ninawapatia maji jangwani, na vijito katika nchi kame, ili kuwapa watu wangu maji, wale niliowachagua,
Ekegusii: erinde ching’iti chi’orosana amo nebibwe ne chisagero chinywe chintogie. Ekero ekio nintubokie amaache ase erooro, ne chindooche ase ense enyomo, ng’ee abanto baane, abwo nachorire, amaache banywe,

English: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
Kiswahili: watu wale niliowaumba kwa ajili yangu, ili wapate kutangaza sifa zangu.
Ekegusii: abanto abwo netongeire, erinde bararie ogotogigwa kwane.

English: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo hukuniita mimi, ee Yakobo, hujajitaabisha kwa ajili yangu, ee Israeli.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, timwandangeretie, ee, inwe Abaisraeli, timwanyechanderete.

English: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
Kiswahili: Hujaniletea kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa, wala kuniheshimu kwa dhabihu zako. Sikukulemea kwa sadaka za nafaka wala kukuchosha kwa kuhitaji uvumba.
Ekegusii: Inwe timwandeterete ching’ondi chiaino chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, gose timwansigete ase okonduera ebing’wanso biaino. Inche timbaroseti ase okonduera okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timbachandeti ase ogonsambera ubani.

English: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.
Kiswahili: Hukuninunulia uvumba wowote wenye manukato, wala hukunipa kwa ukarimu mafuta ya wanyama wa dhabihu zako. Lakini umenilemea kwa dhambi zako, na kunitaabisha kwa makosa yako.
Ekegusii: Timwangorerete ebinto bigotioka buya ne chitaabu chiaino. Timwang’isanegetie nebitinya bi’ebing’wanso biaino. Taibo! Korende nigo mwandosirie nebibe biaino; mwanchandire nogosaria kwaino.

English: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
Kiswahili: “Mimi, naam mimi, ndimi nizifutaye dhambi zako, kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, wala sizikumbuki dhambi zako tena.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche bweka ngotinyia ogosaria kwao, ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na tinkoinyora ebibe biao.

English: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
Kiswahili: Tafakari mambo yaliyopita, njoo na tuhojiane, leta shauri lako uweze kupewa haki yako.
Ekegusii: Ong’inyorie, tokwane komo, aye na inche; okwane amang’ana ao, erinde onyore oboronge bwao.

English: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.
Kiswahili: Baba yako wa kwanza alitenda dhambi, wasemaji wako wameasi dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Sokoro yao bw’eritang’ani nigo akorete ebibe, na abaarenge abakwani b’amang’ana ao bagasaria ase ’nde,

English: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitawaaibisha wakuu wa Hekalu lako, nami nitamtoa Yakobo aangamizwe, na Israeli adhihakiwe.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ngatiga abanene b’Aase Achenu bakaba abatachenegeti, nkarua abanto ba Yakobo bakaba okoragererigwa, ee, nkarua Abaisraeli ase ogochaywa.

English: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.
Kiswahili: “Lakini sasa sikiliza, ee Yakobo, mtumishi wangu, Israeli, niliyemchagua.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yakobo, omosomba one, aye Israeli nagochorire, bono igwa!

English: This is what Yahweh who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, yeye aliyekuhuluku, aliyekuumba tumboni, yeye atakayekusaidia: Usiogope, ee Yakobo, mtumishi wangu, Yeshuruni, niliyekuchagua.
Ekegusii: Omonene, oria ogotongete ase enda ya nyoko, naende okogokonya, nigo agoteeba iga: Aye Yakobo, omosomba one, aye Yerusalemu, omochore one, toiroka.

English: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nitamimina maji juu ya nchi yenye kiu, na vijito vya maji juu ya ardhi iliyokauka; nitamimina Roho wangu juu ya watoto wako, nayo baraka yangu juu ya wazao wako.
Ekegusii: “Ning’umore amaache ase abare nerang’o, nintubokie chindooche ase ense enyomo. Ning’umore Omoika one igoro ase abanto b’ororeeria rwao, ninsesenie abana bao.

English: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.
Kiswahili: Nao watachipua kama manyasi katika shamba la majani, kama mierezi kando ya vijito vya maji yatiririkayo.
Ekegusii: Abwo mbakine buna obonyansi, bakine buna emesobeti ere ase chindooche mbarabare.

English: One will say, ‘I am Yahweh’s.’ Another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand ‘to Yahweh,’ and honor the name of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Mmoja atasema, ‘Mimi ni wa Bwana’; mwingine atajiita kwa jina la Yakobo; vilevile mwingine ataandika juu ya mkono wake, ‘Wa Bwana,’ na kujiita kwa jina la Israeli.
Ekegusii: Oyomo nateebe ng’a noyo bw’Omonene are, na oyonde eroke erieta ria Yakobo, na oyonde arike ase okoboko kwaye ng’a ere noyo bw’Omonene, erio eroke Omoisraeli, erieta ri’ogosikwa.”

English: This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mfalme wa Israeli na Mkombozi, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: Mimi ni wa kwanza na Mimi ni wa mwisho; zaidi yangu hakuna Mungu.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli na Omobooria obo, oyore Omonene b’Emeganda, agoteeba: “Ninche oyo bw’eritang’ani, na oyo bw’omoerio; onde tari, otatiga inche bweka inde Nyasae.

English: Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? Let them declare the things that are coming, and that will happen.
Kiswahili: Ni nani basi aliye kama mimi? Yeye na atangaze. Yeye atangaze na kuweka mbele yangu ni kitu gani kilichotokea tangu nilipoumba watu wangu wa kale, tena ni nini kitakachotokea: naam, yeye na atoe unabii ni nini kitakachokuja.
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobana buna inche, buna nabaanete korwa ekero keria nabegete abanto abwo ba kare? Tiga ararie amang’ana ayio na koyanyorokia. Oyio tiga ateebie abanto amang’ana are bosio agochia gokoreka.
