English: “‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way.”
Kiswahili: je, utakasirika siku zote? Je, ghadhabu yako itaendelea milele?’ Hivi ndivyo unavyozungumza, lakini unafanya maovu yote uwezayo.”
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonene nigo aratobee goika kare na kare, na endamwamu yaye nigo eragenderere kobao goika omoerio? Ee, inwe nabo mogoteeba, naende nigo mogendererete gokora amabe onsi buna moranyare.”

English: Moreover, Yahweh said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has played the prostitute there.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Yosia, Bwana aliniambia, “Umeona kile Israeli asiye mwaminifu amekifanya? Amepanda juu ya kila kilima kirefu, na chini ya kila mti uliotanda na amefanya uzinzi huko.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Yosia arenge kogamba, Omonene agakwana nainche, aganteebia, “Kwarorire amang’ana aya Abaisraeli batari abegenwa bakorire? Nigo batiirire gochia ase kera ekegoro egetambe, na bakagenda inse ya kera omote omobese, bagakorera obonyaka aroro.

English: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
Kiswahili: Mimi nilifikiri kuwa baada ya kuyafanya yote haya angelinirudia, lakini hakurudi, naye dada yake Yuda mdanganyifu aliona hili.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo narengereretie ng’a ekero bakoorire gokora amang’ana ayio onsi, nigo barang’iranere, korende tibang’iranereti; na Abayuda, abwo batarenge abegenwa, abare abasubati bamwabo Abaisraeli, mbaroche amang’ana ayio.

English: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear, but she also went and played the prostitute.
Kiswahili: Nilimpa Israeli asiye mwaminifu hati yake ya talaka, na kumfukuza kwa ajili ya uzinzi wake wote. Hata hivyo nikaona kuwa Yuda dada yake mdanganyifu hakuogopa. Yeye pia alitoka na kufanya uzinzi.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo naseretie Abaisraeli, abwo bairanete magega, nkabaa riruube ri’ogotigana, ekiagera tibarenge abegenwa ase ’nde. Nonya naboigo Abayuda abanyaborimo, abwo bare abasubati bamwabo Israeli, tibaroche obosooku, korende barabwo boigo bakagenda gokora obonyaka.

English: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu uasherati wa Israeli haukuwa kitu kwake, Yuda aliinajisi nchi kwa kuzini na mawe na miti.
Ekegusii: Tibaabarete obonyaka gose ngento; ase ayio bagakora ense eye ekaba entwambu ase ogotaba abegenwa ase ’nde, bakaba bagosasiima amagena na emete.

English: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hayo yote, Yuda dada yake mdanganyifu hakunirudia kwa moyo wake wote, bali kwa kujifanya tu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Amo nayio onsi Abayuda, abwo bare abasubati bamwabo Abaisraeli, batarenge abegenwa, tibang’iranerete ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi, korende ase okong’ainereria gwoka.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: Yahweh said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
Kiswahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Israeli asiye mwaminifu ana haki kuliko Yuda mdanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene aganteebia: “Abaisraeli batarenge abegenwa babeire abaronge kobua Abayuda baria bare abang’ainereria.

English: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says Yahweh; ‘I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful,’ says Yahweh. ‘I will not keep anger forever.
Kiswahili: Nenda, ukatangaze ujumbe huu kuelekea kaskazini: “ ‘Rudi, Israeli usiye mwaminifu,’ asema Bwana, ‘sitakutazama tena kwa uso uliokunjamana, kwa kuwa mimi ni mwenye huruma,’ asema Bwana, ‘Sitashika hasira yangu milele.
Ekegusii: Genda orarie amang’ana aya ase Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Inwe Abaisraeli motari abegenwa, ing’iranere; tinkogenderera koba nendamwamu ase more ekiagera ninde namaabera.

English: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahweh your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ungama dhambi zako tu: kwamba umemwasi Bwana Mungu wako, umetapanya wema wako kwa miungu ya kigeni chini ya kila mti unaotanda, nawe hukunitii mimi,’ ” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe ancha rioka ng’a nabamochi more, naende ng’a mwasaririe ase ’nde inche Omonene, Nyasae oino; mwabeire mokogenda gochia aaria na aaria inse y’emete yonsi emebese mogosasiima chinyasae ching’ao, timwaigwerete eriogi riane.” Omonene oteebire ayio.

English: “Return, backsliding children,” says Yahweh, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.
Kiswahili: “Rudini, enyi watu msio waaminifu, kwa kuwa mimi ni mume wenu,” asema Bwana. “Nitawachagua ninyi, mmoja kutoka kwenye mji, na wawili kutoka kwenye ukoo, nami nitawaleta Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene oteebire iga: Inwe abana baane motari abegenwa, ing’iranere, ekiagera ninche Omonene oino. Nindusie oyomo oino korwa ase kera omochie, na babere korwa ase kera eamate, mbarente ase egetunwa gia Sayoni.

English: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
Kiswahili: Kisha nitawapeni wachungaji wanipendezao moyo wangu, ambao watawaongoza kwa maarifa na ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Nimbae inwe abarisia abaya, abarangokie ase enkoro yane, abarabaragerie bare nobong’ani na okomanya.

English: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days,” says Yahweh, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of Yahweh’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo, idadi yenu itakapokuwa imeongezeka sana katika nchi, watu hawatasema tena, ‘Sanduku la Agano la Bwana,’ ” asema Bwana. “Halitaingia tena kwenye mawazo yao wala kukumbukwa, hawatalihitaji wala halitatengenezwa jingine.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba ng’a ase amatuko ayio, ekero morabuche na komentekana ase ense eyio, abanto tibagokwana nonya ng’ake igoro y’Esanduki y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene. Eyio tekoinyorwa naende, gose korengererigwa; gose eyende tekoroisigwa.

English: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘Yahweh’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to Yahweh’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, wataita Yerusalemu kuwa Kiti cha Enzi cha Bwana, nayo mataifa yote watakusanyika Yerusalemu kuliheshimu jina la Bwana. Hawatafuata tena ukaidi wa mioyo yao miovu.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Yerusalemu norokwe Oboikaranso bw’Omonene. Ebisaku bionsi nabisangererekane agwo Yerusalemu, ase obosio bw’Omonene, na tibikogania gotunyana naende oboenenu bwe chinkoro chi’obobe.

English: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo, nyumba ya Yuda itaungana na nyumba ya Israeli, wao kwa pamoja watakuja kutoka nchi ya kaskazini hadi nchi niliyowapa baba zenu kama urithi.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, Abayuda na Abaisraeli nababe amo nabarabwo, bachiche korwa ase ense ya sugusu goika ase ense eria naete chisokoro chiaino ekaba omwando obo.

English: “But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies of the nations!’ and I said, ‘You shall call me “My Father”, and shall not turn away from following me.’
Kiswahili: “Mimi mwenyewe nilisema, “ ‘Tazama jinsi nitakavyowatunza kwa furaha kama wana na kuwapa nchi nzuri, urithi ulio mzuri kuliko wa taifa jingine lolote.’ Nilidhani mngeniita ‘Baba,’ na msingegeuka, mkaacha kunifuata.
Ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nigo narengereretie buna nare konyara kobabeeka inwe ase egati y’abana baane, erinde mbae ense ere engiya mono, ense y’omwando ere engiya kobua ey’ebisaku binde bionsi. Nigo narengereretie ng’a inwe namondoke Tata, na timware koonchoka montige.

English: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mwanamke asiye mwaminifu kwa mumewe, vivyo hivyo mmekosa uaminifu kwangu pia, ee nyumba ya Israeli,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende koreng’ana buna omokungu otari omwegenwa agotiga omosacha oye, naboigo nainwe timori abegenwa ase ’nde, mogantiga. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”

English: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten Yahweh their God.
Kiswahili: Kilio kinasikika juu ya miinuko iliyo kame, kulia na kuomboleza kwa watu wa Israeli, kwa sababu wamepotoka katika njia zao na wamemsahau Bwana Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Eriogi riaigurwe igoro ase ebitunwa bire bosa, eriogi ri’Abaisraeli ri’okorera na ogosorora, ekiagera barubanirie chinchera chiabo, banyebire inche Omonene, Nyasae obo.

English: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are Yahweh our God.
Kiswahili: “Rudini, enyi watu msio waaminifu, nami nitawaponya ukengeufu wenu.” “Naam, tutakuja kwako, kwa maana wewe ni Bwana Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto motari abegenwa, ing’iranere, nainche ningwenie ogotegena kwaino. Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Intwe twakoiraneire, ekiagera naye Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.
Kiswahili: Hakika zile ghasia za kuabudu sanamu kwenye vilima na milimani ni udanganyifu; hakika katika Bwana, Mungu wetu, uko wokovu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Amaene nigo ere bosa koba nogosemeria ase ebigoro na ase chigosori chimbe chire aroro. Omonene, Nyasae oito, nere ore ogotooreka kw’Abaisraeli.

English: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
Kiswahili: Tangu ujana wetu miungu ya aibu imeyala matunda ya kazi za baba zetu: makundi yao ya kondoo na ngʼombe, wana wao na binti zao.
Ekegusii: Korwa amatuko a kare ay’obwana bwaito, enyasae eria y’obosooku Baal yasiririe emeremo eye chisokoro chiaito chiakorete; yasiririe chitugo chiabo, na abana babo, abamura na abaiseke.

English: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Yahweh our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice.”
Kiswahili: Sisi na tulale chini katika aibu yetu, na fedheha yetu itufunike. Tumetenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana Mungu wetu, sisi na mababa zetu; tangu ujana wetu hadi leo hatukumtii Bwana Mungu wetu.”
Ekegusii: Tiga toraare inse tobe nobosooku, na echayo ebe ase tore, ekiagera twasaririe ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, korwa obwana bwaito goika reero iga, intwe amo ne chisokoro chiaito. Titwamoigwerete Omonene, Nyasae Nyasae oito.

English: “If you will return, Israel,” says Yahweh, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you will not be removed;
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa utataka kurudi, ee Israeli, nirudie mimi,” asema Bwana. “Ikiwa utaondoa sanamu zako za kuchukiza mbele ya macho yangu na usiendelee kutangatanga,
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire iga: “Inwe Abaisraeli, onye morigetie koirana ase ’nde, ing’iranere. Motugute emegwekano yaino mogosasiima ere okogechia ase obosio bwane, motari nechitang’u‐tang’u.

English: and you will swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”
Kiswahili: ikiwa kwa kweli, kwa haki na kwa unyofu utaapa, ‘Kwa hakika kama vile Bwana aishivyo,’ ndipo mataifa yatakapobarikiwa naye na katika yeye watajitukuza.”
Ekegusii: Komoratiane ase ekeene na oboronge, mogoteeba: Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, rirorio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbesesenie ime yaye, naende mbetogie asare.”

English: For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana kwa watu wa Yuda na kwa Yerusalemu: “Vunjeni mabonge kwenye mashamba yenu, wala msipande katikati ya miiba.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteebia Abayuda na abamenyi ba Yerusalemu: “Chaka korema emegondo yaino na timobaisa kobusura ase amagwa ime.

English: Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
Kiswahili: Jitahirini katika Bwana, tahirini mioyo yenu, enyi wanaume wa Yuda na watu wa Yerusalemu, la sivyo ghadhabu yangu itatoka kwa nguvu na kuwaka kama moto kwa sababu ya uovu mliotenda, ikiwaka pasipo wa kuizima.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu, earokie inwe abanyene, mwerue ase Omonene! Arokia chinkoro chiaino! Motakoreti bo, rirorio endamwamu yane nigo eraoroke igoro ase more buna omorero, na omonto tari orayerimie. Ayio onsi nigo arabe nase engencho y’ogokora kwaino okobe.”

English: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let’s go into the fortified cities!’
Kiswahili: “Tangaza katika Yuda na upige mbiu katika Yerusalemu na kusema: ‘Piga tarumbeta katika nchi yote!’ Piga kelele na kusema: ‘Kusanyikeni pamoja! Tukimbilie katika miji yenye maboma!’
Ekegusii: Teebia Abayuda, na morarie ase Yerusalemu: “Bugia egetureeri ase ense eye yonsi, moake eriogi rinene, motebe: Sangererekana amo, togende ase emechie egiteire chindwaki.

English: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”
Kiswahili: Onyesheni ishara ili kwenda Sayuni! Kimbilieni usalama pasipo kuchelewa! Kwa kuwa ninaleta maafa kutoka kaskazini, maangamizi ya kutisha.”
Ekegusii: Imokia ekemanyererio kiorokie enchera egochia Sayoni; tama motooreke, timobaisa goteebana, ekiagera nkorenta nde obobe na ogosaria okonene korwa sugusu.”

English: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.
Kiswahili: Simba ametoka nje ya pango lake, mharabu wa mataifa amejipanga. Ametoka mahali pake ili aangamize nchi yenu. Miji yenu itakuwa magofu pasipo mtu wa kuishi humo.
Ekegusii: Endo yaimokire korwa ase riraro riaye; oria ogosiria ebisaku oimokire, orure aase aye, akore ense yaino ebe bosa; emechie yaino nesarigwe ebe amaturi, atamenyiri nabaanto.

English: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn’t turned back from us.
Kiswahili: Hivyo vaeni nguo za magunia, ombolezeni na kulia kwa huzuni, kwa kuwa hasira kali ya Bwana haijaondolewa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, eboyie chigunia, morere na kweng’ereria, ekiagera endamwamu enene y’Omonene nigo ere ase tore, teraonchoka etotige.

English: “It will happen at that day,” says Yahweh, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the princes. The priests will be astonished, and the prophets will wonder.”
Kiswahili: “Katika siku ile,” asema Bwana “mfalme na maafisa watakata tamaa, makuhani watafadhaika, na manabii watashangazwa mno.”
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio abarwoti amo nabanene b’oborwoti tibakoba noboremu, abakuani mbaondoke na ababani mbakumie.”

English: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo niliposema, “Aa, Bwana Mwenyezi, umewadanganyaje kabisa watu hawa na Yerusalemu kwa kusema, ‘Mtakuwa na amani,’ wakati upanga uko kwenye koo zetu!”
Ekegusii: Erio ngateba, “Aye Omonene, kwabang’ainire abanto aba ba Yerusalemu, ekiagera kwabateebeetie ng’a mbabe nomorembe, korende bono omoro obeire ang’e kobaita.”

English: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo watu hawa na Yerusalemu wataambiwa, “Upepo wa moto kutoka miinuko iliyo kame katika jangwa unavuma kuelekea watu wangu, lakini sio kupepeta au kutakasa,
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto aba amo naba Yerusalemu mbateebigwe ring’ana eri: “Omwaga ogosamba buna omorero noguse korwa ase ebigoro bi’erooro gochia ase abanto baane. Omwaga oyio tokoba oyo bw’okoirurera gose bw’ogosonga,

English: A full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”
Kiswahili: upepo wenye nguvu sana kuliko wa kupepeta na kutakasa utakuja kwa amri yangu. Sasa natangaza hukumu zangu dhidi yao.”
Ekegusii: korende omwaga oyio ninyotome obe omotindi mono goetania. Bono ninche ndabanachere ekiina.”

English: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.
Kiswahili: Tazama! Anakuja kama mawingu, magari yake yanakuja kama upepo wa kisulisuli, farasi wake wana mbio kuliko tai. Ole wetu! Tunaangamia!
Ekegusii: Rora, omobisa nigo agotochera buna amare, nigo abwate chigari chi’esegi chinga buna ekerambauti; chibarasi chiaye nigo chikominyoka chimbero kobua ekeongo. Obobe nobwaito! Ee, twasirigwe.

English: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
Kiswahili: Ee Yerusalemu, usafishe uovu kutoka moyoni mwako na uokolewe. Utaendelea kuficha mawazo mapotovu mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, chena chinkoro chiaino korwa ase obobe, erinde motoorigwe. Ngoika ririri moragenderere kogaacha ebirengererio bi’obobe ime yaino?

English: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:
Kiswahili: Sauti inatangaza kutoka Dani, ikipiga mbiu ya maafa kutoka vilima vya Efraimu.
Ekegusii: Omonto orure ase orogongo rwa Dani, orentire amang’ana neriogi rinene, nigo akoraria obobe korwa ase ense y’Efraimu.

English: “Tell the nations, behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.
Kiswahili: “Waambie mataifa jambo hili, piga mbiu hii dhidi ya Yerusalemu: ‘Jeshi la kuzingira linakuja kutoka nchi ya mbali, likipiga kelele ya vita dhidi ya miji ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: Kurera abanto b’ebisaku ng’a amabe ngocha are; raria ase Yerusalemu, motebe: Abagochia koboera ngocha bare korwa ase ense y’aare, bagoaka eriogi ase emechie y’Abayuda.

English: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wamemzunguka kama watu walindao shamba, kwa sababu amefanya uasi dhidi yangu,’ ” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Abayuda basaririe ase ’nde, ababisa babo mbaabaetanane buna abarendi b’omogondo bakoyoetanana. Omonene okwanire.

English: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”
Kiswahili: “Mwenendo wako na matendo yako mwenyewe yameleta haya juu yako. Hii ndiyo adhabu yako. Tazama jinsi ilivyo chungu! Tazama jinsi inavyochoma moyo!”
Ekegusii: Chinchera chiaino, na ogokora kwaino, nabio biagerire amang’ana ayio abanyorire inwe. Oko nakwo ogosirigwa kwaino, na nigo kore nobororo obonge. Obororo obwo bwasoire ime ase chinkoro chiaino.

English: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
Kiswahili: Ee mtima wangu, mtima wangu! Ninagaagaa kwa maumivu. Ee maumivu makuu ya moyo wangu! Moyo wangu umefadhaika ndani yangu, siwezi kunyamaza. Kwa sababu nimesikia sauti ya tarumbeta, nimesikia kelele ya vita.
Ekegusii: Obee! Obee! Obororo bw’enda yane bwabeire obonene. Enkoro yane nigo egontwoma mono, tinkonyara gokira; naigure eriogi ri’egetureeri, ogotaboborwa gw’esegi.

English: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.
Kiswahili: Maafa baada ya maafa, nchi yote imekuwa magofu. Kwa ghafula mahema yangu yameangamizwa, makazi yangu kwa muda mfupi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nigo bokoromeng’ana obobe bonde, ense yonsi yasarigwe. Chiema chiane chiasarigwe mobosokano; ebietubo bie chiema chiane biatandoirwe.

English: How long will I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?
Kiswahili: Hata lini nitaendelea kuona bendera ya vita na kusikia sauti za tarumbeta?
Ekegusii: Ngoika ririri ndagenderere korora ekemanyererio gi’esegi, na koigwa eriogi ri’egetureeri rikobugigwa?

English: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but they don’t know how to do good.”
Kiswahili: “Watu wangu ni wapumbavu, hawanijui mimi. Ni watoto wasio na akili, hawana ufahamu. Ni hodari kutenda mabaya, hawajui kutenda yaliyo mema.”
Ekegusii: “Abanto baane nigo bare abariri, tibamanyeti inche. Barabwo nigo bare buna abana batari nobong’aini, tibamanyeti gento kende. Nigo bare aboge mono ase ogokora ebibe, korende tibamanyeti gokora amaya.”

English: I saw the earth and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.
Kiswahili: Niliitazama dunia, nayo haikuwa na umbo tena ni tupu; niliziangalia mbingu, mianga ilikuwa imetoweka.
Ekegusii: Nkarigereria ense, nkarora yabeire bosa, gento tikiarengeo; nkarigereria gochia igoro, na oborabu bonde tibwarengeo.

English: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.
Kiswahili: Niliitazama milima, nayo ilikuwa ikitetemeka, vilima vyote vilikuwa vikiyumbayumba.
Ekegusii: Nkarigereria gochia ase ebitunwa, nkarora birobio bigotengechigwa, na ebigoro bionsi bikonyegerigwa gochia aaria na aaria.

English: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.
Kiswahili: Nilitazama, wala watu hawakuwepo; kila ndege wa angani alikuwa ameruka zake.
Ekegusii: Nkarigereria, nkarora omonto taiyo nonya noyomo; chinyoni chionsi konya chiatamire.

English: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of Yahweh, before his fierce anger.
Kiswahili: Nilitazama, hata nchi iliyokuwa imestawi vizuri imekuwa jangwa, miji yake yote ilikuwa magofu mbele za Bwana, mbele ya hasira yake kali.
Ekegusii: Nkarigereria, nkarora ense yarenge kwama, yabeire erooro, emechie yaye yonsi yasarigwe, ekaba amatombe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye enene.

English: For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo Bwana asemavyo: “Nchi yote itaharibiwa, ingawa sitaiangamiza kabisa.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Ense yonsi nesarigwe etigare bosa, korende tinkoyesiria kegima.

English: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black, because I have spoken it. I have planned it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo dunia itaomboleza na mbingu zilizo juu zitakuwa giza, kwa sababu nimesema nami sitarudi nyuma, nimeamua na wala sitageuka.”
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ense nereere na kweumia, igoro nchionchoke chimwame ti, ekiagera ninche nakwanire, naganirie gokora ayio; tinkonyara gweitia gose koonchora ebirengererio biane.”

English: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.
Kiswahili: Kwa sauti ya wapanda farasi na wapiga upinde kila mji unakimbia. Baadhi wanakimbilia vichakani, baadhi wanapanda juu ya miamba. Miji yote imeachwa, hakuna aishiye ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba kera omochie mbatame ekero baraigwe amariogi ’abariini chibarasi na ay’abwo babwate amata, mbatame gochia ase amanani, bebise ase ebitare ime. Emechie yonsi netigare bosa, nonya nomonto oyomo tagotigara aroro.

English: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with makeup, you make yourself beautiful in vain. Your lovers despise you. They seek your life.
Kiswahili: Unafanya nini, ewe uliyeharibiwa? Kwa nini unajivika vazi jekundu na kuvaa vito vya dhahabu? Kwa nini unapaka macho yako rangi? Unajipamba bure. Wapenzi wako wanakudharau, wanautafuta uhai wako.
Ekegusii: Aye oyo gwatigirwe bosa na gwasarigwe, ninki orengereretie ekero okobeeka chianga chimonyinga, naende ogwechabera n’ebinto bie chitaabu, na gosata amaiso ao? Nigo ogwechabera bosa. Abanchi bao bagochayire, na nigo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwao.

English: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”
Kiswahili: Nasikia kilio kama cha mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa, kilio cha uchungu kama cha anayemzaa mtoto wake wa kwanza: kilio cha Binti Sayuni akitweta ili aweze kupumua, akiinua mikono yake, akisema, “Ole wangu! Ninazimia; maisha yangu yamekabidhiwa kwa wauaji.”
Ekegusii: Naigure okorera buna okw’omokuungu okobina aibore; ekerero ekenene buna eki’oyo okoibora omwana omotangi. Okorera okwo nigo kore okorera gwa Sayoni, omoiseke one, ngwesacha are ang’use omoika, okorambora amaboko aye, okorera: “N akuure! Nkong’ita bare!”

English: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.
Kiswahili: “Pandeni na kushuka katika mitaa ya Yerusalemu, tazameni pande zote na mtafakari, tafuteni katika viwanja vyake. Kama mtaweza kumpata hata mtu mmoja tu atendaye kwa uaminifu na kutafuta kweli, nitausamehe mji huu.
Ekegusii: Minyoka gochia aaria na aaria ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu, morigererie na komanya. Moriga‐rigie ase chichiiro morore gose monyore omonto oyomo ogokora oboronge na korigia ekeene, erinde inche Omonene inyare kwabera omochie oyo.

English: Though they say, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”
Kiswahili: Ingawa wanasema, ‘Kwa hakika kama Bwana aishivyo,’ bado wanaapa kwa uongo.”
Ekegusii: Nonya bagokwana, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo,” nigo bagotiana ase obong’ainereria.

English: O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, je, macho yako hayaitafuti kweli? Uliwapiga, lakini hawakusikia maumivu, uliwapondaponda, lakini walikataa maonyo. Walifanya nyuso zao kuwa ngumu kuliko jiwe nao walikataa kutubu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Inee, amaiso ao tari korigereria ay’ekeene? Aye okobaaka, korende tibaigwete obororo; aye okobaa egesusuro, korende bangire korongea. Bakaba bakong’etie amasio abo pa, bakaanga gweitia bairane.

English: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikasema, “Hawa ni maskini tu; wao ni wapumbavu, kwa maana hawaijui njia ya Bwana, sheria ya Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Erio nkarengereria, “Abanto aba nabataka. Barabwo tibari nobong’aini, ekiagera tibamanyeti enchera y’Omonene, gose ogochika kwa Nyasae obo.

English: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitakwenda kwa viongozi na kuzungumza nao, hakika wao wanaijua njia ya Bwana, sheria ya Mungu wao.” Lakini kwa nia moja nao pia walikuwa wameivunja nira na kuvivunja vifungo.
Ekegusii: Ningende ase abanto abanene, nkwane nabarabwo, ekiagera barabwo mbamanyete enchera y’Omonene na ogochika kwa Nyasae obo.” Korende nabarabwo bonsi boigo konya babunire rikorogoto na kobutora ebisibo basiberetwe,

English: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo simba kutoka mwituni atawashambulia, mbwa mwitu kutoka jangwani atawaangamiza, chui atawavizia karibu na miji yao, ili kumrarua vipande vipande yeyote atakayethubutu kutoka nje, kwa maana maasi yao ni makubwa, na kukengeuka kwao kumekuwa ni kwingi.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio endo nerue rinani ebaite; esese y’orosana nerue erooro ebasirie; engo nebaboere ase emechie yabo. Kera omonto ogosoka korwa aroro natandoranwe, ekiagera ogosaria kwabo nokonge, na okogwa kwabo kw’ogontiga nokonene.

English: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini niwasamehe? Watoto wenu wameniacha na kuapa kwa miungu ambayo si miungu. Niliwapatia mahitaji yao yote, lakini bado wamefanya uzinzi na kusongana katika nyumba za makahaba.
Ekegusii: “Naki ndakore mbaabere? Abana baino bantigire, nigo bagotiana ase chinyasae ching’ao. Ekero nabaete ebinto biisaine nigo babete bagotomana, bakagenda ase chinyomba chi’abakungu abanyaka.

English: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
Kiswahili: Wamelishwa vizuri, kama farasi waume wenye tamaa nyingi, kila mmoja akimlilia mke wa mwanaume mwingine.
Ekegusii: Nigo barenge buna chibarasi chiaragerigwe buya chire nokogania, kera omonto akaba okogania omokungu bw’omogisangio oye.”

English: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
Kiswahili: Je, nisiwaadhibu kwa ajili ya hili?” asema Bwana. “Je, nisijilipizie kisasi juu ya taifa kama hili?
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akaboria: Inee! Tinkobaa egesusuro ase amang’ana aya? Tinkweruseria egesiomba ase egesaku buna eke?

English: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.
Kiswahili: “Piteni katika mashamba yake ya mizabibu na kuyaharibu, lakini msiangamize kabisa. Pogoeni matawi yake, kwa kuwa watu hawa sio wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Genda moriine ase chindwaki chi’omochie oyio moyosarie, korende timoyokoora kegima. Moarorie chinsagia chi’emesabibu yaye chirueo, ekiagera echio tichiri echi’Omonene.

English: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda wamekuwa si waaminifu kwangu kamwe,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’enyomba ya Israeli na eya Yuda tibari abegenwa ase ’nde nonya ng’ake. Inche Omonene nakwanire.

English: They have denied Yahweh, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.
Kiswahili: Wamedanganya kuhusu Bwana. Wamesema, “Yeye hatafanya jambo lolote! Hakuna dhara litakalotupata; kamwe hatutaona upanga wala njaa.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakwanire oborimo igoro ase Omonene, batebiire, “Omonene tagokora gento kende. Intwe titokorenterwa amabe; titogocherwa korwanigwa nemioro, gose enchara tegocha ase tore.

English: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”
Kiswahili: Manabii ni upepo tu, wala neno halimo ndani yao, kwa hiyo hayo wayasemayo na yatendeke kwao.”
Ekegusii: Abaabani nigo barabe buna embeo ekogusa, tibabwati ring’ana ria Nyasae. Ase ayio barabwo mbakorerwe amang’ana ayio.”

English: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Kwa sababu watu hawa wamesema maneno haya, nitayafanya maneno yangu vinywani mwenu kuwa moto, na watu hawa wawe kuni zinazoliwa na huo moto.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, agoteeba: “Ekiagera bakwanire ring’ana eri: Naama, inche ninkore amang’ana aane are ime ase omonwa oo abe buna omorero; abanto aba nababe buna chinko, na omorero oria nobasambe.”

English: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says Yahweh. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.
Kiswahili: Ee nyumba ya Israeli,” asema Bwana, “Ninaleta taifa toka mbali dhidi yako, taifa la kale na linaloendelea kudumu, taifa ambalo lugha yao huijui, wala msemo wao huwezi kuuelewa.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Inwe abanto b’enyomba ya Israeli, nkorenta nde egesaku kerue ense y’aare, kere nechinguru, naende kiarengeo korwa chingaki chia kare, ekio motamanyeti omonwa obo, gose timokomanya ogokwana kw’omonwa obo.

English: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.
Kiswahili: Podo zao ni kama kaburi lililo wazi, wote ni mashujaa hodari wa vita.
Ekegusii: Chigochi chie chinsara chiabo nigo chinga buna chimbeera chiasie, bonsi nigo bare abanto chituoni.

English: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.
Kiswahili: Watayaangamiza mazao yenu na chakula chenu, wataangamiza wana wenu na mabinti zenu; wataangamiza makundi yenu ya kondoo na ya ngʼombe, wataangamiza mizabibu yenu na mitini yenu. Kwa upanga wataangamiza miji yenye maboma mliyoitumainia.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbarie okwama gwe chindagera chiaino, na abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiaino, na amasabibu na emeko yaino. Emechie yaino egiteire chindwaki, eyio mosemeretie, barabwo nabayetagore nemioro.”

English: “But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end of you.
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo katika siku hizo, sitakuangamiza kabisa,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene oteebire, “Nonya nase amatuko ayio tinkobasiria inwe kegima.

English: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has Yahweh our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’
Kiswahili: “Nao watu watakapouliza, ‘Kwa nini Bwana, Mungu wetu ametufanyia mambo haya yote?’ utawaambia, ‘Kama vile mlivyoniacha mimi na kutumikia miungu migeni katika nchi yenu wenyewe, ndivyo sasa mtakavyowatumikia wageni katika nchi ambayo si yenu.’
Ekegusii: Abanto baino kobarakoborie: Nase ki Omonene, Nyasae oito, atokoreire amang’ana aya onsi? Aye oiranerie ng’a inche natebiire: Koreng’ana buna mwaonchokire mwantigire, naende mwasasimire chinyasae ching’ao aiga ase ense yaino, naboigo mogochia koba abasomba b’abaanto abaao ase ense etari eyaino.”

English: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
Kiswahili: “Itangazie nyumba ya Yakobo hili na ulipigie mbiu katika Yuda:
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Teebia abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo amang’ana aya, oyararie ase Abayuda:

English: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:
Kiswahili: Sikieni hili, enyi watu wapumbavu, msio na akili, mlio na macho lakini hamwoni, mlio na masikio lakini hamsikii:
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto abariri motari nobong’aini, igwa amang’ana aya, mobwate amaiso, ko timori korora, mobwate amato, ko timori koigwa.

English: Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’
Kiswahili: Je, haiwapasi kuniogopa mimi?” asema Bwana. “Je, haiwapasi kutetemeka mbele zangu? Niliufanya mchanga kuwa mpaka wa bahari, kizuizi cha milele ambacho haiwezi kupita. Mawimbi yanaweza kuumuka, lakini hayawezi kuupita; yanaweza kunguruma, lakini hayawezi kuuvuka.
Ekegusii: Inee! Inwe timokonyiroka inche Omonene? Timokoiguswa ase obosio bwane? Nigo nabegete omokenye okaba orobebe rw’enyancha, egetango kia botambe enyancha etanyare gotamboka. Nonya nemerindo ekorotwoma, tekonyara korotagora. Nonya ekoimokerera igoro, tekonyara goeta orobebe roria.

English: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu hawa wana mioyo ya ukaidi na ya uasi, wamegeukia mbali na kwenda zao.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto aba nigo bare ne chinkoro chinkong’u chi’ogotaigwera, baonchokire bantigire.

English: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear Yahweh our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’
Kiswahili: Wao hawaambiani wenyewe, ‘Sisi na tumwogope Bwana Mungu wetu, anayetupatia mvua za masika na za vuli kwa majira yake, anayetuhakikishia majuma ya mavuno kwa utaratibu.’
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibari gokwana ase chinkoro chiabo: Tiga tomoiroke Omonene, Nyasae oito, oyogotoa embura ase engaki yaye egwenerete; embura y’omochakano na ey’okwamia endagera, naende nere ogotorendera chichuma chibekire ase rigesa.

English: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.
Kiswahili: Matendo yenu mabaya yamezuia haya yote, dhambi zenu zimewazuia msipate mema.
Ekegusii: Na bono amamocho aino abatangire timonyora ebinto ebio, na ebibe biaino biatangire ebinto ebiya mwarenge gocha koegwa.

English: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
Kiswahili: “Miongoni mwa watu wangu wamo walio waovu wanaovizia kama watu wanaotega ndege, na kama wale wanaoweka mitego kuwakamata watu.
Ekegusii: “Abakori amabe nigo bakonyorekana ase egati y’abanto baane; abwo nigo bagotega buna abategi be chinyoni, nigo bakobeeka amareba babwate abanto.

English: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.
Kiswahili: Kama vitundu vilivyojaa ndege, nyumba zao zimejaa udanganyifu; wamekuwa matajiri na wenye nguvu,
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana egesera geichire ne chinyoni, naboigo ne chinyomba chiabo chiaichoire n’ebinto bisakoire; ase engencho eyio babeire ne chinguru, na abanda mono.

English: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.
Kiswahili: wamenenepa na kunawiri. Matendo yao maovu hayana kikomo; hawatetei mashauri ya yatima wapate kushinda, hawatetei haki za maskini.
Ekegusii: Banorire na koneta. Tibari gotiga gokora amabe. Tibari kogambera chintakana ebiina bi’oboronge bagere bakire, gose tibari gokorera abataka oboronge.”

English: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
Kiswahili: Je, nisiwaadhibu kwa ajili ya hili?” asema Bwana. “Je, nisijilipizie kisasi juu ya taifa kama hili?
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene okwanire iga: “Inee! Tinkobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora okwo? Tinkweruseria egesiomba igoro ase egesaku kegokora amang’ana buna ayio?

English: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.
Kiswahili: “Jambo la kutisha na kushtusha limetokea katika nchi hii:
Ekegusii: Ogokora gw’okogechia na ogw’okoirokia gwakorekanire ase ense eye.

English: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?
Kiswahili: Manabii wanatabiri uongo, makuhani wanatawala kwa mamlaka yao wenyewe, nao watu wangu wanapenda hivyo. Lakini mtafanya nini mwisho wake?
Ekegusii: Abaabani nigo bakobana oborimo, na abakuani nigo bagwancherana namang’ana abo. Abanto baane nigo banchete amang’ana ayio, korende ninki morakore ekero omoerio orache?”

English: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.
Kiswahili: “Kimbieni kwa usalama wenu, enyi watu wa Benyamini! Kimbieni kutoka Yerusalemu! Pigeni tarumbeta katika Tekoa! Inueni ishara juu ya Beth-Hakeremu! Kwa kuwa maafa yanaonekana yakitoka kaskazini, na uharibifu wa kutisha.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Benjamini, sangererekana amo, motame korwa ase Yerusalemu, erinde mwetoorie. Bugia egetureeri ase Tekoa, imokereria ekemanyererio igoro ase Beti‐Hakeremu, ekiagera obobe na ogosaria okonene biarorekanire korwa sugusu.

English: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.
Kiswahili: Nitamwangamiza Binti Sayuni, aliye mzuri sana na mwororo.
Ekegusii: Sayoni oria ogwekaine omoiseke omuya, naende omwereria, ninyosarie.

English: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place.”
Kiswahili: Wachungaji pamoja na makundi yao watakuja dhidi yake; watapiga mahema yao kumzunguka, kila mmoja akichunga kundi lake mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Abarisia mbachiche aroro namaicho abo, batenenie chiema chiabo chinsemo chiaye chionsi; kera omorisia nenyorere aroro aase aye akorisia ching’ondi chiaye.

English: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
Kiswahili: “Jiandaeni kwa vita dhidi yake! Inukeni tumshambulie mchana! Lakini, ole wetu, mchana unaisha, na vivuli vya jioni vinazidi kuwa virefu.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagoteeba: “Twebeke ang’e korwania Sayoni. Imoka togende toyorwanie mobaso gati! Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera nkoira bore, na emerengari ya mogoroba yamentire koba emetambe.

English: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo inukeni, tufanye mashambulizi usiku, na kuharibu ngome zake!”
Ekegusii: Imoka togende toyorwanie botuko, totagore chinyomba chiaye chi’oborwoti.”

English: For Yahweh of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Kateni miti mjenge boma kuzunguka Yerusalemu. Mji huu ni lazima uadhibiwe, umejazwa na uonevu.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Gecha emete, agacha eburi, moboere Yerusalemu. Omochie oyio goika oegwe egesusuro, ekiagera nomochie omobe, ogendererete gochanda abanto bareo.

English: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me.
Kiswahili: Kama vile kisima kinavyomwaga maji yake, ndivyo anavyomwaga uovu wake. Ukatili na maangamizi yasikika ndani yake, ugonjwa wake na majeraha yake viko mbele yangu daima.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana ensoko ekorua amaache aye amakenonoku, naboigo na Yerusalemu ogendererete gokora obobe bwaye, obotindi na ogosaria nigo biichire imeo. Amarwaire na amaote aye nigo bire ase obosio bwane botambe.

English: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”
Kiswahili: Pokea onyo, ee Yerusalemu, la sivyo nitageukia mbali nawe na kuifanya nchi yako kuwa ukiwa, asiweze mtu kuishi ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, tiga amang’ana aya abe ogokuurerwa ase more; motaigwereti, inche nigo ndarue ase more mbatige, erio mbasirie, na ense yaino ebe buna erooro etamenyiri nabaanto.”

English: Yahweh of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Wao na wayakusanye mabaki ya Israeli kwa uangalifu kama kwenye mzabibu; pitisha mkono wako kwenye matawi tena, kama yeye avunaye zabibu.”
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Chora abatigari b’Abaisraeli, buna amasabibu amatigari agochorwa. Kabe gokorambora okoboko kwao naende, buna omosangereria amasabibu akoyarusia ase chinsagia.

English: To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, Yahweh’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.
Kiswahili: Niseme na nani na kumpa onyo? Ni nani atakayenisikiliza mimi? Masikio yao yameziba, kwa hiyo hawawezi kusikia. Neno la Bwana ni chukizo kwao, hawalifurahii.
Ekegusii: “Ning’o ngoteebia aigwe gonkom okuurera? Naama! Nigo basiegete amato abo, tibakonyara gotegerera. Amang’ana ’Omonene abeire echeche ase bare, tibari kogokigwa naro.

English: Therefore I am full of Yahweh’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife will be taken, the aged with him who is full of days.
Kiswahili: Lakini nimejaa ghadhabu ya Bwana, nami siwezi kuizuia. “Wamwagie watoto walioko barabarani, na juu ya vijana waume waliokusanyika; mume na mke watakumbwa pamoja ndani yake, hata nao wazee waliolemewa na miaka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio naichoirwe nendamwamu ekorwa ase Omonene, narosire ase okoyetanga. “Yeumore igoro ase abana bare ase enchera y’omochie, na igoro ase ebiombe bi’abasae. Omosacha na omokungu mbairwe, boigo abanto abagotu amo nabwo bagotire mono.

English: Their houses will be turned to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Nyumba zao zitapewa watu wengine, pamoja na mashamba yao na wake zao, nitakapounyoosha mkono wangu dhidi ya wale waishio katika nchi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto abaao mbaire chinyomba chiabo, amo nabakungu babo na emegondo yabo. Ee, nindambore okoboko kwane, ing’ee abanto b’ense eye egesusuro.

English: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.
Kiswahili: “Kuanzia aliye mdogo kabisa hadi aliye mkubwa kabisa, wote wana tamaa ya kupata faida zaidi; manabii na makuhani wanafanana, wote wanafanya udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Naki abanto babo bonsi, korwa omoke goika omonene, nigo bare ne ribero ri’okonyora ebitoki bi’obong’ainereria. Abakuani na ababani boigo nigo bagokora amang’ana ’oborimo.

English: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.
Kiswahili: Wanafunga majeraha ya watu wangu bila uangalifu. Wanasema, ‘Amani, amani,’ wakati hakuna amani.
Ekegusii: Batubire amaote ’abaanto baane rioka, bagoteeba: Omorembe, omorembe, na omorembe tori aande.

English: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. When I visit them, they will be cast down,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Je, wanaona aibu kwa ajili ya tabia yao inayochukiza mno? Hapana, hawana aibu hata kidogo; hawajui hata kuona haya. Kwa hiyo wataanguka miongoni mwa hao walioanguka, watashushwa chini nitakapowaadhibu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inee! Ekero bakorete ebinto ebi bi’okogechia, m babete nobosooku? Yaya, tibabete nobosooku nonya ng’ake, gose tibaorogetie amasio are nobosooku. Ase engencho eyio nabagwe amo nabaanto baria bande baragwe, ekero ndarue egesusuro ase bare, nabarabwo nabagwe. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”

English: Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: “Simama kwenye njia panda utazame, ulizia mapito ya zamani, ulizia wapi ilipo njia nzuri, uifuate hiyo, nanyi mtapata raha nafsini mwenu. Lakini ninyi mlisema, ‘Hatutaipita hiyo.’
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Tenena ase chinchera, morigererie, moborie momanye chinchera chia kare, ase enchera engiya ere; moyebwatie, nario moranyore obotoereru ase obogima bwaino. “Korende abanto bakaanga, bagateeba: Intwe titorigeti koyebwatia.

English: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’
Kiswahili: Niliweka walinzi juu yenu na kusema, ‘Sikieni sauti ya tarumbeta!’ Lakini mkasema, ‘Hatutasikiliza.’
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nkabeeka abarendi igoro ase more, nkabachika ng’a bategerere eriogi ri’egetureeri, korende barabwo bakaanga, bakaboora: Titokoritegerera.”

English: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sikilizeni, enyi mataifa, angalieni, enyi mashahidi, lile litakalowatokea.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abanto b’ebisaku, na inwe omoganda bwonsi, tegerera moigwe amang’ana agochia kobanyora abwo bangire.

English: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.
Kiswahili: Sikia, ee nchi: Ninaleta maafa juu ya watu hawa, matunda ya mipango yao, kwa sababu hawakusikiliza maneno yangu na wameikataa sheria yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye ense, igwa! Naama! Nkorenta inde obobe igoro ase abanto aba, obobe obwo bore okwama kw’emeroberio yabo emebe, ekiagera bangire koigwa amang’ana aane; na ogochika kwane bakwangire.

English: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”
Kiswahili: Unanifaa nini uvumba kutoka Sheba, au udi wa harufu nzuri kutoka nchi ya mbali? Sadaka zako za kuteketezwa hazikubaliki, dhabihu zako hazinifurahishi mimi.”
Ekegusii: Ubani eria bakondetera korwa Seba, ninki erangwenere, gose ebinto bigotioka buya bakorenta korwa ase ense y’aare? Ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa nabiangire, nonya nebing’wanso biaino binde tibingogeti.

English: Therefore Yahweh says, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend will perish.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: “Nitaweka vikwazo mbele ya watu hawa. Baba na wana wao watajikwaa juu yake, majirani na marafiki wataangamia.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Naama! Nimbeke ebigocha ase amasio ’abaanto aba, erio bibagoche bagwe. Abaise na abana babo abamura nabagwe amo: naboigo abagisangio babo na abasani babo amo.”

English: Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: “Tazama, jeshi linakuja kutoka nchi ya kaskazini, taifa kubwa linaamshwa kutoka miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Rora, abanto ngocha bare korwa ense ya sugusu. Egesaku ekenene kere ne chinguru gekorwa aare ase chinsinyo chi’ense.

English: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”
Kiswahili: Wamejifunga pinde na mkuki, ni wakatili na hawana huruma. Wanatoa sauti kama bahari inayonguruma wanapoendesha farasi zao. Wanakuja kama watu waliojipanga tayari kwa vita ili kukushambulia, ee Binti Sayuni.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagocha babwate amata na amatimo. Nigo bare abatindi batari namaabera. Eriogi ri’ebititiro biabo nigo rikoeera buna enyancha ekoeera. Nigo bariinete chibarasi, baroberete buna abanto bagochia korwana esegi, bachire kobarwania inwe abanto ba Sayoni.”

English: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
Kiswahili: Tumesikia taarifa zao, nayo mikono yetu imelegea. Uchungu umetushika, maumivu kama ya mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa.
Ekegusii: Twaigure amang’ana igoro y’esegi eyio, amaboko aito aborirwe chinguru; twasoirwe nomoondoko, na obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore bwatosoire.

English: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.
Kiswahili: Usitoke kwenda mashambani au kutembea barabarani, kwa kuwa adui ana upanga, na kuna vitisho kila upande.
Ekegusii: Timosoka isiko kogenda ase emegondo, gose timotaara ase enchera, ekiagera ababisa baino babwate emioro nao bare, na obwoba bwabeire ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.
Kiswahili: Enyi watu wangu, vaeni magunia mjivingirishe kwenye majivu, ombolezeni kwa kilio cha uchungu kama amliliaye mwana pekee, kwa maana ghafula mharabu atatujia.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, eboyie chigunia, egara‐garie ase ribu, morere na kobokia amagombo buna omonto okoreera omwana oye omomoima okuure. Morere mono, ekiagera oria ogosiria nigo arabachere mobosokano.

English: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.
Kiswahili: “Nimekufanya wewe kuwa kitu cha kujaribu chuma, nao watu wangu kama mawe yenye madini, ili upate kuzijua na kuzijaribu njia zao.
Ekegusii: “Nakobekire aye obe gokorenga abanto baane, naende obateeme buna omoturi ebioma agoteema ebioma biaye, erio obamanye na goteema chinchera chiabo.

English: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.
Kiswahili: Wote ni waasi sugu, wakienda huku na huko kusengenya. Wao ni shaba na chuma, wote wanatenda upotovu.
Ekegusii: Bonsi nigo bare abasaria na abanyabigoti bikong’u; nigo bagotaaria obogenki; nigo bare buna etai na ekioma, bonsi nigo bagokora ay’ogosaria.

English: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.
Kiswahili: Mivuo inavuma kwa nguvu, kinachoungua kwa huo moto ni risasi, lakini pamoja na kusafisha kote huku ni bure; waovu hawaondolewi.
Ekegusii: Omoguba ogouta omorero nigo ogouterera mono, korende ribiria tiriri gwatananwa. Ogochenwa okwo nigo kore okwa bosa, ekiagera obobe tibori korusigwao.

English: Men will call them rejected silver, because Yahweh has rejected them.”
Kiswahili: Wanaitwa fedha iliyokataliwa, kwa sababu Bwana amewakataa.”
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bararokwe chifeta chiangirwe ekiagera inche Omonene nabangire.”

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo neno lililomjia Yeremia kutoka kwa Bwana:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana rigacha ase Yeremia korwa ase Omonene, rikamoteebia

English: “Stand in the gate of Yahweh’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship Yahweh.’”
Kiswahili: “Simama kwenye lango la nyumba ya Bwana, na huko upige mbiu ya ujumbe huu: “ ‘Sikieni neno la Bwana, enyi watu wote wa Yuda mliokuja kupitia malango haya ili kumwabudu Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Genda agwo ase egeita ki’enyomba y’Omonene, na aroro agwo orarie ring’ana eri: Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene, inwe abanto bonsi ba Yuda aba mogosoa ase ebiita ebio komosasiima.

English: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli: Tengenezeni njia zenu na matendo yenu, nami nitawaacha mkae mahali hapa.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Onchora chinchera chiaino, na ogokora kwaino, na inche nimbatige mogenderere komenya aase aiga.

English: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, are these.’
Kiswahili: Msitumainie maneno ya udanganyifu na kusema, “Hili ni Hekalu la Bwana, Hekalu la Bwana, Hekalu la Bwana!”
Ekegusii: Timobaisa kwegena amang’ana ’obong’ainereria ayio agotebwa: Mbuya tore. Eye nero Hekalu y’Omonene, eye nero Hekalu y’Omonene, eye nero Hekalu y’Omonene!

English: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
Kiswahili: Kama kweli mkibadili njia zenu na matendo yenu, mkatendeana haki kila mmoja na mwenzake,
Ekegusii: “Onchora chinchera chiaino na ogokora kwaino, naende mokorerane oboronge, kera omonto noyonde.

English: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,
Kiswahili: kama msipomwonea mgeni, yatima wala mjane, na kumwaga damu isiyo na hatia mahali hapa, nanyi kama msipofuata miungu mingine kwa madhara yenu wenyewe,
Ekegusii: Motige gokorera bobe omonto omomenyi ore ase more, ne chintakana, na ababoraka, gose aase aiga timoitera amanyinga ’abaanto batari na komocha, naende motige gosasiima chinyasae ching’ao chiria chirabarentere ogosirigwa.

English: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.
Kiswahili: ndipo nitawaacha mkae mahali hapa, katika nchi niliyowapa baba zenu milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Komoraonchoke, erio inche nimbatige mogenderere komenya aase aiga ase ense naete chisokoro chiaino agwo kare ng’a ebe eyabo kogenderera botambe.

English: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.
Kiswahili: Lakini tazama, mnatumainia maneno ya udanganyifu yasiyo na maana.
Ekegusii: “Bono inwe nigo mwegenete amang’ana ’obong’ainereria atari kobakonya.

English: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Je, mtaiba na kuua, mtazini na kuapa kwa uongo, na kufukiza uvumba kwa Baali, na kufuata miungu mingine ambayo hamkuijua,
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mogochia kogenderera koiba, na goita, na gotomana, na gotiana ase oborimo, na gosamba ubani ase enyasae eria Baali, naende gosasiima chinyasae chinde ching’ao, echio motamanyeti.

English: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?
Kiswahili: kisha mje na kusimama mbele yangu katika nyumba hii inayoitwa kwa Jina langu, mkisema, “Tuko salama.” Salama kwa kufanya mambo haya yote ya kuchukiza?
Ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo mokoyakora, naende mwachicha ase obosio bwane ase enyomba eye ekorokwa ase erieta riane mwateba: Twatoorigwe! Erio mogendererete gokora okogechia okwo?

English: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Je, nyumba hii, iitwayo kwa Jina langu, imekuwa pango la wanyangʼanyi kwenu? Lakini nimekuwa nikiona yanayotendeka! asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inee! Enyomba eye ekorokwa ase erieta riane iyabeire rikuruma ri’abauri ase more? Inche omonyene narorire amang’ana ayio mogokora. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.

English: “But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nendeni sasa mahali pangu palipokuwa huko Shilo, mahali ambapo nilipafanya pa kwanza kuwa makao ya Jina langu, nanyi mwone lile nililopafanyia kwa ajili ya uovu wa watu wangu Israeli.
Ekegusii: Genda bono aase nechorerete agwo Silo; agwo nao ritang’ani nabegete erieta riane rimenyeo. Mwerorere egento nakorete aase aria ase engencho y’obokayayu bw’abaanto baane Abaisraeli.

English: Now, because you have done all these works,” says Yahweh, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer;
Kiswahili: Mlipokuwa mnafanya yote haya, asema Bwana, nilisema nanyi tena na tena, lakini hamkusikiliza; niliwaita, lakini hamkujibu.
Ekegusii: Naende inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Bono mwakorire amang’ana aya onsi, timorigeti koigwera ekero ngendererete gokwana nainwe, na ekero nabarangeretie timwaitabete.

English: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, nililolifanyia Shilo, nitalifanya sasa kwa nyumba hii iitwayo kwa Jina langu, Hekalu mnalolitumainia, mahali nilipowapa ninyi na baba zenu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ninkore enyomba eye ekorokwa ase erieta riane, eye inwe mwegenete, buna nakorete Silo, na ense eye naete chisokoro chiaino amo nainwe ebe boigo.

English: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring of Ephraim.
Kiswahili: Nitawafukuza mbele yangu, kama nilivyowafanyia ndugu zenu, watu wa Efraimu.’
Ekegusii: Nimbaserie morue ase obosio bwane, buna naseretie abanto bamino, ororeria rwonsi rw’Efraimu.

English: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo usiombe kwa ajili ya watu hawa, wala usinililie, na usifanye maombi kwa ajili yao; usinisihi, kwa sababu sitakusikiliza.
Ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, tobaisa gosabera abanto aba, gose korera ase engencho y’abwo. Tobaisa gocha gonsorora ase engencho y’abwo, ekiagera tingokoigwa.

English: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
Kiswahili: Je, huyaoni hayo wanayoyatenda katika miji ya Yuda na katika barabara za Yerusalemu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye torochi amang’ana bagokora agwo ase emechie y’Abayuda, na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu?

English: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanakusanya kuni, baba zao wanawasha moto, na wanawake wanakanda unga na kuoka mikate kwa ajili ya Malkia wa Mbinguni. Wanamimina sadaka za vinywaji kwa miungu mingine ili kunikasirisha.
Ekegusii: Abana nigo bagochora chinko, na abaise bauta omorero, na abakungu bagokonya obosie koroisia emegati ase enyasae enkungu eria ekorokwa Eting’ana ya Igoro. Naende baumora okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa ase chinyasae ching’ao, bangechia naba nendamwamu.

English: Do they provoke me to anger?” says Yahweh. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”
Kiswahili: Lakini je, mimi ndiye wanayenikasirisha? asema Bwana. Je, hawajiumizi wenyewe na kujiaibisha?
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo nkoboria: Inee! Ninche bakogechia? Tibari gwekorera barabwo abanyene amabe na konyora obosooku?

English: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched.”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenyezi: Hasira yangu na ghadhabu yangu itamwagwa mahali hapa, juu ya mwanadamu na mnyama, juu ya miti ya shambani na juu ya matunda ya ardhini, nayo itaungua pasipo kuzimwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Ning’umore endamwamu yane enene, na okogechia kwane igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro ase Mwanyabaanto, ne ching’iti, na emete y’orosana, na ase chindagera chionsi chi’emegondo. Endamwamu eyio yane nigo eroke buna omorero, na onde tari oranyare koyerimia.”

English: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli: Endeleeni, ongezeni sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa juu ya dhabihu zenu nyingine, mle nyama hiyo wenyewe!
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Menta ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa ase ebing’wanso binde, morie chinyama echio.

English: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nilipowaleta baba zenu kutoka Misri na kusema nao, sikuwapa amri kuhusu sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu tu,
Ekegusii: Rituko riria narusetie chisokoro chiaino korwa ase ense ya Misiri, tinabateebeetie gose tinabachigete igoro ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde.

English: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’
Kiswahili: lakini niliwapa amri hii nikisema: Nitiini mimi, nami nitakuwa Mungu wenu nanyi mtakuwa watu wangu. Enendeni katika njia zote ninazowaamuru ili mpate kufanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Korende nkabachika, nkabateebia: Monyigwere, na inche nimbe Nyasae oino, na inwe mobe abanto baane. Mobwatie chinchera chionsi nabachiikire, erio nario erabe buya ase more.

English: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakusikiliza wala kujali. Badala yake, walifuata ukaidi wa mioyo yao miovu. Walirudi nyuma badala ya kusonga mbele.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo tibanyigwerete, korende bakabwatia ogosemania kwabo abanyene, na oboenenu bwe chinkoro chiabo chi’ebibe. Bakairana gochia magega, gose tibagendererete gochia bosio.

English: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati ule baba zenu walipotoka Misri hadi sasa, siku baada ya siku, tena na tena nimewatumia watumishi wangu manabii.
Ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria chisokoro chiaino chiaruete ase ense ya Misiri goika rituko ria reero nabeire nkogenderera gotoma abasomba baane ababani ase more, rituko ase rituko.

English: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakunisikiliza wala hawakujali. Walikuwa na shingo ngumu na kufanya maovu kuliko baba zao.’
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo tibanyigwerete, gose gotegerera amang’ana aane, korende bakaba abanyabigoti bikong’u. Bakagenderera gokora amabe mono kobua chisokoro chiabo.

English: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.
Kiswahili: “Utakapowaambia haya yote, hawatakusikiliza; utakapowaita, hawatajibu.
Ekegusii: Aye Yeremia, obateebie amang’ana ayio onsi, korende barabwo tibakogotegerera. Nobarangerie, korende tibakogoitabera.

English: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to Yahweh their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo waambie, ‘Hili ni taifa ambalo halimtii Bwana, Mungu wao, wala kukubali maonyo. Kweli imekufa, imetoweka midomoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Erio obateebie ng’a egesaku eke nakio getamoigwereti Omonene, Nyasae obo, naende tigiancheti Omonene akerongeyie. Ekeene giasirire korwa ase emenwa yabo.

English: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Yahweh has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
Kiswahili: Nyoeni nywele zenu na kuzitupa, ombolezeni katika miinuko iliyo kame, kwa kuwa Bwana amekikataa na kukiacha kizazi hiki kilichomkasirisha.
Ekegusii: “Kigita chitukia chiaino, mochitugute, aka eriogi ri’okweng’ereria agwo ase ebigoro bire bosa, ekiagera Omonene bwangire na otigire abanto b’ekegori eke, kiagerire ere abeire nendamwamu.

English: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says Yahweh. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Watu wa Yuda wamefanya maovu machoni pangu, asema Bwana. Wameziweka sanamu zao za machukizo ndani ya nyumba iitwayo kwa Jina langu, na wameitia unajisi.
Ekegusii: “Omonene oteebire: Abanto ba Yuda bakorire ebibe ase obosio bwane, babekire emegwekano y’okogechia ase enyomba eria ekorokwa ase erieta riane, bayekorire yabeire eyetachenegeti.

English: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.
Kiswahili: Wamejenga mahali pa juu pa kuabudia sanamu pa Tofethi kwenye Bonde la Ben-Hinomu ili kuwateketeza wana wao na binti zao kwenye moto, kitu ambacho sikuamuru, wala hakikuingia akilini mwangu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo baroisirie aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo ase Tofeti, aaria ase Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu. Agwo basambire abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, nomorero, amang’ana inche ntachigete gose atana koba ase ebirengererio biane.

English: Therefore behold, the days come”, says Yahweh, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mjihadhari, siku zinakuja, asema Bwana, wakati watu watakapokuwa hawapaiti Tofethi au Bonde la Ben-Hinomu, lakini watapaita Bonde la Machinjo, kwa sababu watawazika wafu huko Tofethi mpaka pasiwe tena nafasi.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene oteebire: Rora, amatuko ngocha are, aase aria atarokwe Tofeti, gose Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, korende ndirokwe Rikura ri’Okonyenyera. Abanto mbatindekwe agwo Tofeti, ekiagera aase ande tari.

English: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mizoga ya watu hawa itakuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na wanyama wa nchi, wala hapatakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwafukuza.
Ekegusii: Emebere yabo ekwete nebe endagera ye chinyoni chia igoro ne ching’iti chi’orosana. Omonto tagochiseria ekero chikoria emebere eyio.

English: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”
Kiswahili: Nitazikomesha sauti za shangwe na furaha, na sauti za bwana arusi na bibi arusi katikati ya miji ya Yuda na barabara za Yerusalemu, kwa sababu nchi itakuwa ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Ase emechie y’Abayuda na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu ninsirie eriogi ri’omogooko na eri’omochengo, na eriogi ri’omonywomi na eri’omoriakari, ekiagera ense yabo nebe bosa.”

English: “At that time,” says Yahweh, “they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of his princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wakati huo, asema Bwana, mifupa ya wafalme na maafisa wa Yuda, mifupa ya makuhani na manabii, na mifupa ya watu wa Yerusalemu itaondolewa kutoka makaburi yao.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase engaki eyio amauga ’abarwoti b’Abayuda, na ay’abanene b’oborwoti obwo, na ay’abakuani, na ay’ababani, na aya bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, narusigwe ime ase chimbeera chiabo.

English: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.
Kiswahili: Itawekwa wazi kwa jua, na mwezi, na nyota zote za mbingu, ambazo walizipenda na kuzitumikia, na ambazo wamezifuata kutafuta ushauri na kuziabudu. Hawatakusanywa pamoja au kuzikwa, lakini watakuwa kama mavi yaliyotapakaa juu ya ardhi.
Ekegusii: Nasiarerwe inse y’erioba, na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni chionsi, ebinto ebio abanto aba banchete gokorera, bakabirigia mono na kobitunyana, naende bakabisasiima. Amauga ayio tagosangererigwa amo, gose gotindekwa, korende nabe buna obwoyo bore ase riroba.

English: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Popote nitakapowafukuzia, mabaki wote wa kizazi hiki kiovu watatamani kufa kuliko kuishi, asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.’
Ekegusii: Abanto abaratigare b’egesaku eke ekebe, baria bare moyo ase chinsemo chionsi ase nabaseretie gochia, mbaganie ogokwa kobua koba moyo. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nakwanire.

English: “Moreover you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh says: “‘Do men fall, and not rise up again? Does one turn away, and not return?
Kiswahili: “Waambie, ‘Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: “ ‘Je, watu wanapoanguka hawainuki? Je, mtu anapopotea harudi?
Ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, okwane nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteeba: Ekero abanto bakogwa, inee, tibari koimoka naende? Onye omonto oonchokire na otigire enchera, tari koonchoka oirana?

English: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini basi watu hawa walipotea? Kwa nini Yerusalemu inapotea kila mara? Wanangʼangʼania udanganyifu na wanakataa kurudi.
Ekegusii: Nase ki inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu mogendererete gontiga iga? Mwancheranire nokong’ainererigwa, na mwangire kong’iranera.

English: I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, “What have I done?” Everyone turns to his course, as a horse that rushes headlong in the battle.
Kiswahili: Nimewasikiliza kwa makini, lakini hawataki kusema lililo sawa. Hakuna anayetubia makosa yake akisema, “Nimefanya nini?” Kila mmoja hufuata njia yake mwenyewe kama farasi anayekwenda vitani.
Ekegusii: Nabeire ngotegerera buya mono, korende timori gokwana ekeene. Onde tari ogweitia na koonchoka atige obobe bwaye na koboria: Ngento ki nakorire? Kera omonto nigo agendererete gokora buna anchete, ogwekanire ebarasi ekominyoka gochia ase okorwana esegi.

English: Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people don’t know Yahweh’s law.
Kiswahili: Hata korongo aliyeko angani anayajua majira yake yaliyoamriwa, nao njiwa, mbayuwayu na koikoi hufuata majira yao ya kurudi. Lakini watu wangu hawajui Bwana anachotaka kwao.
Ekegusii: Nonya ne riagonga nigo rimanyete chingaki chiaye, boigo riruma, na egesingororo, na ekeongo nigo chikomanyereria chingaki chiabo chi’okoirana, korende abanto baane tibamanyeti emeroberio inche Omonene nachiikire.

English: “‘How do you say, “We are wise, and Yahweh’s law is with us”? But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that a lie.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mwawezaje kusema, “Sisi tuna busara kwa sababu tunayo sheria ya Bwana,” wakati ambapo kwa hakika kalamu ya uongo ya waandishi imeandika kwa udanganyifu?
Ekegusii: Naki moranyare goteeba ng’a nabang’aini more, naende ng’a mobwate amachiiko o Omonene ase egati yaino? Rora aborokia b’amariko abare abang’ainereria barikire amachiiko o Omonene na koyaonchorana ase okong’ainereria.

English: The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected Yahweh’s word. What kind of wisdom is in them?
Kiswahili: Wenye hekima wataaibika, watafadhaika na kunaswa. Kwa kuwa wamelikataa neno la Bwana, hiyo hekima waliyo nayo ni ya namna gani?
Ekegusii: Abanto abang’aini mbasookigwe mbaichanigwe na gotang’ang’a, ekiagera bangire ring’ana ri’Omonene. Mbong’aini ki bore ase bare?

English: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to those who will possess them. For everyone from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness; from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitawapa watu wengine wake zao, na mashamba yao kwa wamiliki wengine. Kuanzia aliye mdogo kabisa hadi aliye mkubwa kabisa, wote wana tamaa ya kupata zaidi; manabii na makuhani wanafanana, wote wanafanya udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ning’ee abanto abaao abakungu babo, na emegondo yabo ninyee abanto barababue. Abanto aba bonsi, korwa omoke goika omonene, nigo bare neribero ri’okonyora ebitoki bi’obong’ainereria. Abakuani na ababani boigo nigo bagokora amang’ana ’oborimo.

English: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, “Peace, peace,” when there is no peace.
Kiswahili: Wanafunga majeraha ya watu wangu bila uangalifu. Wanasema, “Amani, amani,” wakati hakuna amani.
Ekegusii: Batubire amaote ’abaanto baane rioka, bagoteeba: Omorembe, omorembe, na omorembe tori aande.

English: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. In the time of their visitation they will be cast down, says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Je, wanaona aibu kwa ajili ya tabia yao inayochukiza mno? Hapana, hawana aibu hata kidogo, hawajui hata kuona haya. Kwa hiyo wataanguka miongoni mwa hao walioanguka, watashushwa chini watakapoadhibiwa, asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inee! Ekero bakorete ebinto ebi bi’okogechia, m babete nobosooku? Yaya, tibabete nobosooku nonya ng’ake, gose tibaorogetie amasio are nobosooku. Ase engencho eyio nabagwe amo nabaanto baria bande baragwe; ekero ndarue egesusuro ase bare nabarabwo nabagwe. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”

English: “‘I will utterly consume them, says Yahweh. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them will pass away from them.’”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nitayaondoa mavuno yao, asema Bwana. Hapatakuwepo zabibu kwenye mzabibu. Hapatakuwepo na tini kwenye mtini, majani yake yatanyauka. Kile nilichowapa watanyangʼanywa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Nimbarusie mbasirie kegima. Amasabibu takonyorekana ase emesabibu yabo, gose amako ase emeko yabo. Nonya namato ’emete asusanire na kwoma. Ebinto nabaete konya biasirire korwa ase bare.”

English: “Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for Yahweh our God has put us to silence, and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini tunaketi hapa? Kusanyikeni pamoja! Tukimbilie kwenye miji yenye maboma, tukaangamie huko! Kwa kuwa Bwana, Mungu wetu ametuhukumu kuangamia, na kutupa maji yenye sumu tunywe, kwa sababu tumemtenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Nase ki toikaransete tokirete‐kiri? Inchuo tosangererekane amo, togende tosoe ase emechie egiteire chindwaki, erinde tokwere aroro. Omonene, Nyasae oito, otonacheire ekiina tosire, otoeire amaache abekire obosongo tonywe, ekiagera twakorire ebibe asare.

English: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!
Kiswahili: Tulitegemea amani, lakini hakuna jema lililokuja, tulitegemea wakati wa kupona, lakini kulikuwa hofu tu.
Ekegusii: Nigo twasemeretie ng’a tonyore omorembe, korende amabe agacha. Tokagania togwenigwe, korende obwoba bogatochera.
