Kiswahili: Kimbieni! Okoeni maisha yenu, kuweni kama kichaka jangwani.
Ekegusii: Tama! Motoorie obogima bwaino, mobe buna etigere y’orosana etigarete yoka ase erooro.

English: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mmetumainia matendo yenu na mali zenu, ninyi pia mtachukuliwa mateka, naye Kemoshi atakwenda uhamishoni, pamoja na makuhani wake na maafisa wake.
Ekegusii: “Ekiagera inwe mosemeretie emeremo yaino, na obotenenku bwaino, inamwoswe moirwe ase obosomba, na enyasae eria Kemosi neirwe ase obosomba, amo nabakuani baye na abanene b’obogambi bwaye.

English: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as Yahweh has spoken.
Kiswahili: Mharabu atakuja dhidi ya kila mji, wala hakuna mji utakaookoka. Bonde litaangamizwa na uwanda utaharibiwa, kwa sababu Bwana amesema.
Ekegusii: Oyio ogosaria na gosiria nachiche ase kera omochie, mochie onde togotooreka. Rikura amo nense omweya nabisarigwe, buna Omonene atebiire.

English: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.
Kiswahili: Wekeni chumvi kwa ajili ya Moabu, kwa kuwa ataangamizwa; miji yake itakuwa ukiwa, pasipo kuwa na mtu atakayeishi ndani yake.
Ekegusii: “Kae ense ya Moabu chimbaaba, eirurukere etame; emechie yaye yonsi nesirigwe, ebe amaturi atamenyiri na monto.

English: “Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.
Kiswahili: “Alaaniwe yeye afanyaye kazi ya Bwana kwa hila! Alaaniwe yeye auzuiaye upanga wake usimwage damu!
Ekegusii: Oragererigwe omonto oria ogokora emeremo y’Omonene nobworo, na oragererigwe oria ogotanga omoro oye toitera amanyinga.

English: “Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.
Kiswahili: “Moabu amestarehe tangu ujana wake, kama divai iliyoachwa kwenye machujo yake, haikumiminwa kutoka chombo kimoja hadi kingine, hajaenda uhamishoni. Kwa hiyo ana ladha ile ile kama aliyokuwa nayo, nayo harufu yake haijabadilika.
Ekegusii: “Abamoabu babeire barendire bamenyete ase obotoereru korwa ase oboke bwabo. Babeire buna edivai etarakenonorwa korwa ase eturubo. Tibana koumorwa korwa ase ekebekerero ekemo gochia ase ekende, gose tibana gwoswa bairwe ase obosomba. Ase ayio rimisu riabo nabo rigendererete koba buna riarenge, na ogotioka kwabo tikwana koonchoka.

English: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.
Kiswahili: Lakini siku zinakuja,” asema Bwana, “nitakapotuma watu wamiminao kutoka kwenye magudulia, nao watamimina; wataacha magudulia yake yakiwa matupu na kuvunja mitungi yake.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, bono amatuko ngocha are, ndatome abaumori baabaumore, erinde ebibekerero ebio bitigare bibe bosa, erio biatwe.

English: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.
Kiswahili: Kisha Moabu atamwonea aibu mungu wao Kemoshi, kama vile nyumba ya Israeli walivyoona aibu walipotegemea mungu wa Betheli.
Ekegusii: Na abanto ba Moabu nabarore obosooku ase enyasae eria Kemosi, buna Abaisraeli baroche obosooku ase enyasae ya Beteli oyio basemeretie.

English: “How do you say, ‘We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war’?
Kiswahili: “Mwawezaje kusema, ‘Sisi ni mashujaa, watu jasiri katika vita’?
Ekegusii: “Naki mogoteeba: Intwe nabarwani chituoni, abanto tore ne chinguru ase okorwana esegi?

English: Moab is laid waste, and they have gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Moabu ataangamizwa na miji yake itavamiwa, vijana wake waume walio bora sana watachinjwa,” asema Mfalme, ambaye jina lake ni Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Oyogosaria na gosiria ense ya Moabu na emechie yaye ochire; abamura baye bare abaya mono baitirwe. Nabo omorwoti, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, oteebire.

English: “The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.
Kiswahili: “Kuanguka kwa Moabu kumekaribia, janga kubwa litamjia kwa haraka.
Ekegusii: Emechando y’Abamoabu yabeire ang’e mono, na egeku nigo gekoayerera kobacheera.

English: All you who are around him, bemoan him; and all you who know his name, say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!’
Kiswahili: Ombolezeni kwa ajili yake, ninyi nyote mnaomzunguka, ninyi nyote mnaojua sifa zake, semeni, ‘Tazama jinsi ilivyovunjika fimbo ya kifalme yenye nguvu, tazama jinsi ilivyovunjika fimbo iliyotukuka!’
Ekegusii: “Inwe abwo momenyete ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, nainwe abwo momanyete erieta riaye, morere! Motebe: Naki enyimbo eria ere nokobua na obonene yabunirwe!

English: “You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you. He has destroyed your strongholds.
Kiswahili: “Shuka kutoka fahari yako na uketi katika ardhi iliyokauka, enyi wenyeji wa Binti wa Diboni, kwa maana yeye aangamizaye Moabu atakuja dhidi yako, na kuangamiza miji yako iliyozungushiwa maboma.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Diboni, ika korwa ase obonene bwaino, moikaranse inse ase amaroba; oyio ogocha gosiria Abamoabu nabachere inwe; atagore chindwaki chiaino chinkong’u.

English: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, ‘What has been done?’
Kiswahili: Simama kando ya barabara na utazame, wewe unayeishi Aroeri. Muulize mwanaume anayekimbia na mwanamke anayetoroka, waulize, ‘Kumetokea nini?’
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete Aroeri, tenena ase enchera ensemo, motengere! Moborie abasacha abwo bagotama, na abakungu abagwetooria: Mang’ana ki ayio akorekire?

English: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
Kiswahili: Moabu amefedheheshwa, kwa kuwa amevunjavunjwa. Lieni kwa huzuni na kupiga kelele! Tangazeni kando ya Arnoni kwamba Moabu ameangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Ense ya Moabu yasookigwe, ekiagera yasirigwe; rera na kweumia! Teebia abamenyete ase chinsemo chi’orooche rw’Arinoni ng’a ense ya Moabu yasirigwe kegima.

English: Judgment has come on the plain country— on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath,
Kiswahili: Hukumu imefika kwenye uwanda wa juu: katika Holoni, Yahasa na Mefaathi,
Ekegusii: “Ekiina kianachirwe igoro y’ense eraire eimokererete igoro ya Holoni, na Yahasa, na Mefaati,

English: on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,
Kiswahili: katika Diboni, Nebo na Beth-Diblathaimu,
Ekegusii: na Diboni, na Nebo, na Beti‐Dibulataimu,

English: on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon,
Kiswahili: katika Kiriathaimu, Beth-Gamuli na Beth-Meoni,
Ekegusii: na Kiriataimu, na Beti‐Gamuli, na Beti‐Meoni,

English: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
Kiswahili: katika Keriothi na Bosra; kwa miji yote ya Moabu, iliyoko mbali na karibu.
Ekegusii: na Kerioti, na Bosira, na emechie yonsi y’ense ya Moabu ere aare na ang’e.

English: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Pembe ya Moabu imekatwa, mkono wake umevunjwa,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ching’unchara chi’Abamoabu chiabutoirwe, na amaboko abo abunirwe.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: “Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against Yahweh. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision.
Kiswahili: “Mlevye, kwa kuwa amemdharau Bwana. Moabu na agaegae katika matapishi yake, yeye na awe kitu cha dhihaka.
Ekegusii: “Kae Abamoabu banywe batinde, ekiagera beimokereirie igoro mamincha y’Omonene. Barabwo mbaroke, naende begara‐garie ime ase amaroki abo, abanto mbaabasekerere.

English: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.
Kiswahili: Je, Israeli hakuwa kitu chako cha kudhihakiwa? Je, alikamatwa miongoni mwa wezi, kiasi cha kutikisa kichwa chako kwa dharau kila mara unapozungumza juu yake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inwe timwabasekererete Abaisraeli? Abwo banyorekanete bare ase ekeombe ki’abaibi? Gose nase ki mwarenge gosinga‐singisia emetwe yaino ekero mware gokwana igoro yabo?

English: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.
Kiswahili: Ondokeni kwenye miji yenu, mkaishi katikati ya miamba, enyi mnaoishi Moabu. Kuweni kama huwa ambaye hutengeneza kiota chake kwenye mdomo wa pango.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto momenyete Moabu, karue ase emechie yaino, mogende komenya ase ebitare, mobe buna riruma rikoagacha egeswa kiaye ime y’omwenya bw’egetare.

English: “We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.
Kiswahili: “Tumesikia juu ya kiburi cha Moabu: kutakabari kwake kwa kiburi na majivuno, kiburi chake na ufidhuli wake, na kujivuna kwa moyo wake.
Ekegusii: Twaigure igoro y’oboenenu bw’Abamoabu; nigo bare abaenenu mono. Twaigure buna beimokereirie igoro, na buna bagwekaga na koba nobomwenu, na buna bare ne chinkoro chi’obwerori.

English: I know his wrath,” says Yahweh, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.
Kiswahili: Ninaujua ujeuri wake, lakini ni bure,” asema Bwana, “nako kujisifu kwake hakumsaidii chochote.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo imanyete ribero riabo. Ogwetogia kwabo nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria, naboigo nogokora kwabo kore.

English: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo namlilia Moabu, kwa ajili ya Moabu yote ninalia, ninaomboleza kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-Haresethi.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, nindeere ense ya Moabu, nindeere abanto bonsi ba Moabu, boigo nindeere abanto ba Kiri‐Heresi.

English: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage.
Kiswahili: Ninalia machozi kwa ajili yenu, kama Yazeri aliavyo, enyi mizabibu ya Sibma. Matawi yako yameenea hadi baharini; yamefika hadi bahari ya Yazeri. Mharabu ameyaangukia matunda yako yaliyoiva na mizabibu yako iliyoiva.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sibuma, nimbareere mono kobua koreera abanto ba Yaeseri. Aye omochie o Sibuma nigo onga buna omosabibu, ne chinsagia chiao chiarandire gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha, chiaikire enyancha ya Yaeseri. Korende ekero kie rigesa omosaria ochire gosaria emesabibu na okwama kwabo.

English: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.
Kiswahili: Shangwe na furaha vimetoweka kutoka bustani na mashamba ya Moabu. Nimekomesha kutiririka kwa divai kutoka mashinikizo; hakuna hata mmoja ayakanyagaye kwa kelele za shangwe. Ingawa kuna kelele, sio kelele za shangwe.
Ekegusii: Omogoko na omochengo biarusigwe korwa ase ense ya Moabu eyio ekwama ase obonge. Nasiririe edivai korwa ase ebimitero; monto onde tari okomita edivai ogoteera ore nomochengo. Eriogi rigoakwa tiriri eri’omogooko.

English: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate.
Kiswahili: “Sauti ya kilio chao inapanda kutoka Heshboni hadi Eleale na Yahazi, kutoka Soari hadi Horonaimu na Eglath-Shelishiya, kwa kuwa hata maji ya Nimrimu yamekauka.
Ekegusii: “Abanto ba Hesiboni na ab’Eleale nigo bakorera, na eriogi riabo riaigurwe goika Eleale na Yahasi; boigo ndigugwe korwa ase Soari goika Horonaimu na Egilati‐Selisia. Na amaache a Nimirimi nakame na gosira.

English: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says Yahweh, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.
Kiswahili: Nitakomesha wale wote katika Moabu watoao sadaka mahali pa juu, na kufukiza uvumba kwa miungu yao,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie Abamoabu, abwo bakorua ebing’wanso agwo aase aimokererete igoro na gosamba ubani ase enyasae yabo.

English: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like flutes, and my heart sounds like flutes for the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the abundance that he has gotten has perished.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unaomboleza kwa ajili ya Moabu kama filimbi; unaomboleza kama filimbi kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-Haresethi. Utajiri waliojipatia umetoweka.
Ekegusii: “Ase igo enkoro yane nigo ekobareera Abamoabu na abanto ba Kireresi, ase eriogi buna eri’ekeroria. Obonda benyorerete bwasirigwe.

English: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.
Kiswahili: Kila kichwa kimenyolewa na kila mwenye ndevu zimekatwa; kila mkono umekatwa na kila kiuno kimefunikwa kwa nguo ya gunia.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto akigite etukia y’omotwe oye, ogingire ne chinderu chiaye boigo. Abanto bonsi nabeekebe amaboko abo, na kweboyia chigunia ebinema biabo.

English: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Juu ya mapaa yote katika Moabu na katika viwanja hakuna kitu chochote isipokuwa maombolezo, kwa kuwa nimemvunja Moabu kama gudulia ambalo hakuna mtu yeyote anayelitaka,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase chinyomba chionsi chi’ense ya Moabu, na ase chinchera chiaye, okorera gw’okweumia gwoka nakoigweke aroro, ekiagera naatire ense ya Moabu buna enyongo egwatwa, eyio monto onde atari gwechandera. Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: “How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So will Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.”
Kiswahili: “Tazama jinsi alivyovunjikavunjika! Jinsi wanavyolia kwa huzuni! Tazama jinsi Moabu anavyogeuka kwa aibu! Moabu amekuwa kitu cha kudhihakiwa, kitu cha kutisha kwa wale wote wanaomzunguka.”
Ekegusii: Abanto nkorera bare, bagoteeba: Naki Abamoabu baitirwe na gosirigwa. Naki Abamoabu baonchoire amagega abo bare nobosooku, babeire egento ki’ogosekererigwa na eki’ogoichanerwa ase abanto bonsi abaabaetanaine.”

English: For Yahweh says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Tazama! Tai anashuka chini, akitanda mabawa yake juu ya Moabu.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Egesaku gete nkeiruruke bwango buna ekeongo, kerambore chimbaaba chiaye igoro y’Abamoabu.

English: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
Kiswahili: Miji itatekwa na ngome zake zitatwaliwa. Katika siku hiyo, mioyo ya mashujaa wa Moabu itakuwa kama moyo wa mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa.
Ekegusii: Emechie amo ne chindwaki chire chinkong’u mbibwatwe. Ase rituko erio chinkoro chi’abasikari ba Moabu bare chituoni nachiondoke; barabwo babe buna abakungu bakobina ase okoibora.

English: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Moabu ataangamizwa kama taifa kwa sababu amemdharau Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Moabu nabasirigwe kegima tibagenderera koba egesaku, ekiagera beimokereretie igoro mamincha y’Omonene.

English: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hofu kuu, shimo na mtego vinawangojea, enyi watu wa Moabu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete Moabu, omoondoko, na eirima, na omoeto, nigo bibaganyete. Omonene oteebire ayio.

English: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote atakayeikimbia hiyo hofu kuu ataanguka ndani ya shimo, yeyote atakayepanda kutoka shimoni, atanaswa katika mtego, kwa sababu nitaletea Moabu mwaka wa adhabu yake,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oratame ase engencho y’omoondoko nagwe ase eirima, na oyo orasoke korwa ase eirima nabwatwe nomoeto. Nindete ayio igoro y’Abamoabu ase omwaka ndabae egesusuro kiabo. Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: “Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the middle of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
Kiswahili: “Katika kivuli cha Heshboni, wakimbizi wamesimama pasipo msaada, kwa kuwa moto umezimika huko Heshboni, mwali wa moto kutoka katikati ya Sihoni; unaunguza vipaji vya nyuso za Moabu, mafuvu yao wenye kujivuna kwa kelele.
Ekegusii: Abare gotama bagatenena ase ekiriri kia Hesiboni batari ne chinguru. Omorero okarua ase Hesiboni, chimeme chi’omorero korwa ase ense ya Sihoni, ogasaria amasio ’Abamoabu, na ogasamba ebiototeri bi’emetwe y’abanto banchete esegi.

English: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.
Kiswahili: Ole wako, ee Moabu! Watu wa Kemoshi wameangamizwa; wana wako wamepelekwa uhamishoni na binti zako wamechukuliwa mateka.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe abanto ba Moabu! Abanto bagosasiima Kemosi basirigwe. Abana baino abamura boosirwe, na abaiseke baino bairirwe obosomba.

English: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
Kiswahili: “Lakini nitarudisha mateka wa Moabu, katika siku zijazo,” asema Bwana. Huu ndio mwisho wa hukumu juu ya Moabu.
Ekegusii: Korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha ning’iranerie Abamoabu amaya abo. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire. Ayio naro arakoreke ase Abamoabu.

English: Of the children of Ammon. Yahweh says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Waamoni: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Je, Israeli hana wana? Je, hana warithi? Kwa nini basi Moleki amechukua milki ya Gadi? Kwa nini watu wake wanaishi katika miji yake?
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro y’Abaamoni: “Inee! Abaisraeli tibabwati abana? Tibabwati abakoira omwando? Nase ki enyasae Milikomu yairire omwando o Gadi, na abanto baye bamenyete ase emechie ya Gadi?

English: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and it will become a desolate heap, and her daughters will be burned with fire; then Israel will possess those who possessed him,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Lakini siku zinakuja,” asema Bwana, “nitakapopiga kelele ya vita dhidi ya Raba mji wa Waamoni; utakuwa kilima cha magofu, navyo vijiji vinavyouzunguka vitateketezwa kwa moto. Kisha Israeli atawafukuza wale waliomfukuza,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Rora, amatuko ngocha are inche ndarente esegi, na ekerero gi’esegi keigugwe ase omochie o Raba, ase ense y’Abaamoni. Omochie oyio otigare amaturi ore bosa, na emechie yaye esambwe nomorero. Erio Abaisraeli mbaire omwando korwa ase abwo baabayourete. Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah! Clothe yourself in sackcloth. Lament, and run back and forth among the fences; for Malcam will go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
Kiswahili: “Lia kwa huzuni, ee Heshboni, kwa kuwa Ai umeangamizwa! Pigeni kelele, enyi wakazi wa Raba! Vaeni nguo za gunia na kuomboleza, kimbieni hapa na pale ndani ya kuta, kwa kuwa Moleki atakwenda uhamishoni, yeye pamoja na makuhani na maafisa wake.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Hesiboni, rera mono, ekiagera Ai osarigwe! Inwe abakungu ba Raba, rera! Mweboyie chigunia, mobokie amagombo, mobe mokominyoka gochia aaria na aaria ase chinka chionsi, ekiagera enyasae eyio Milikomu neirwe ase obosomba amo nabakuani baye, na abanene abakogamba nero.

English: Why do you boast in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? You trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come to me?’
Kiswahili: Kwa nini unajivunia mabonde yako, kujivunia mabonde yako yaliyozaa sana? Ee binti usiye mwaminifu, unayeutumainia utajiri wako na kusema, ‘Ni nani atakayenishambulia?’
Ekegusii: Inwe abaiseke baane ababiare motari abegenwa, nase ki mogwetogia ng’a amakura aino naichire chindagera? Inwe mwegenete obonda bwaino mogoteeba ng’a onde tari oranyare kobarwania.

English: Behold, I will bring a terror on you,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, “from all who are around you. All of you will be driven completely out, and there will be no one to gather together the fugitives.
Kiswahili: Nitaleta hofu kuu juu yako kutoka kwa wale wote wanaokuzunguka,” asema Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Kila mmoja wenu ataondolewa, wala hakuna hata mmoja atakayekusanya wakimbizi.
Ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, oteebire iga: Rora, nindete omoondoko igoro ase more korwa ase abanto bonsi baabaetanaine. Inwe moserigwe, na kera omonto atame gochia bosio rioka, gose monto onde tagotoka orasangererie abwo batamire.

English: “But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Lakini hatimaye, nitarudisha mateka wa Waamoni,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Korende magega y’ayio ning’iranerie Abaamoni amaya abo. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”

English: Of Edom, Yahweh of Armies says: “Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Edomu: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Je, hakuna tena hekima katika Temani? Je, shauri limewapotea wenye busara? Je, hekima yao imechakaa?
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba igoro y’Abaedomu: “Inee! Obong’aini mbwaerire korwa Temani? Ogosemia ngwasirire korwa ase abanyasemi? Obong’aini bwabo mbwasirire kegima?

English: Flee! Turn back! Dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him when I visit him.
Kiswahili: Geuka na ukimbie, jifiche katika mapango marefu kabisa, wewe uishiye Dedani, kwa kuwa nitaleta maafa juu ya Esau wakati nitakapomwadhibu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete Dedani, onchoka motame, mwebise aase aakong’u, ekiagera ning’ee ororeria rw’Esau emechando ase rituko erio ndamoe egesusuro.

English: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves came by night, wouldn’t they steal until they had enough?
Kiswahili: Je, kama wachuma zabibu wangekuja kwako, wasingebakiza zabibu chache? Kama wezi wangekujia usiku, je, si wangeiba tu kiasi ambacho wangehitaji?
Ekegusii: Inee! Abasangereria amasabibu baare gocha ase more, tibarenge kobatigera nonya naria agotigara? Na abaibi bagocha botuko tibarenge gosakora ebi baganetie bioka?

English: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he will not be able to hide himself. His offspring is destroyed, with his brothers and his neighbors; and he is no more.
Kiswahili: Lakini nitamvua Esau nguo abaki uchi, nitayafunua maficho yake, ili asiweze kujificha. Watoto wake, jamaa na majirani wataangamia, naye hatakuwepo tena.
Ekegusii: Nachoboire abanto b’Esau na kobatiga bosa; nasioririe aase bakwebisa, bono tibakonyora aase bakwebisa. Abanto b’ororeria rwabo na abamwabo basirigwe, boigo nabaanto bamenyete ang’e, bonsi basirigwe gose nonya noyomo tatigareti.

English: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”
Kiswahili: Waache yatima wako; nitayalinda maisha yao. Wajane wako pia wanaweza kunitumaini mimi.”
Ekegusii: Batige abana abwo batabwati abaise, inche nimbarende bagenderere koba moyo, na ababoraka baino, tiga bansemerie.”

English: For Yahweh says: “Behold, they to whom it didn’t pertain to drink of the cup will certainly drink; and are you he who will altogether go unpunished? You won’t go unpunished, but you will surely drink.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kama wale wasiostahili kukinywea kikombe ni lazima wakinywe, kwa nini wewe usiadhibiwe? Hutakwepa kuadhibiwa, ni lazima ukinywe.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Onye abanto baria batagwenerete konywa egekombe ki’egesusuro bakenywerete, Inee, inwe nigo moratigwe timonyora egesusuro? Goika monyore egesusuro; ase ayio goika mokenywere.

English: For I have sworn by myself,” says Yahweh, “that Bozrah will become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. All its cities will be perpetual wastes.”
Kiswahili: Ninaapa kwa nafsi yangu,” asema Bwana, “kwamba Bosra utakuwa magofu na kitu cha kutisha, cha aibu na cha kulaania; miji yake yote itakuwa magofu milele.”
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Inche omonyene natianire ng’a omochie o Bosira nobe bosa. Ekero abanto bakoyorora mbaondoke na koyochecheria, naende babe bakoragereria ase erieta riaye. Na emechie yaye yonsi nesirigwe ebe amaturi kogenderera botambe.”

English: I have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!”
Kiswahili: Nimesikia ujumbe kutoka kwa Bwana: Mjumbe alitumwa kwa mataifa kusema, “Jikusanyeni ili kuushambulia! Inukeni kwa ajili ya vita!”
Ekegusii: Naigure amang’ana korwa ase Omonene; omonto otomirwe ase egati y’ebisaku, kobiteebia: “Sangererekana amo, mochiche korwania omochie o Bosira, imoka moyorwanie!

English: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.
Kiswahili: “Sasa nitakufanya uwe mdogo miongoni mwa mataifa, aliyedharauliwa miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Naki ningokore obe omoke ase egati y’ebisaku. Abanto bonsi nabagochaye.

English: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill, though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Vitisho vyako na kiburi cha moyo wako vimekudanganya, wewe unayeishi katika majabali ya miamba, wewe unayedumu katika miinuko ya kilima. Ujapojenga kiota chako juu sana kama cha tai, nitakushusha chini kutoka huko,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okogosa kwao na oboenenu bw’enkoro yao biakong’ainire. Aye omenyete ime ase emienya y’ebitare, aye obwaterererete egetunwa egetambe, korende nonya koagachete egeswa kiao aaria igoro mono buna ekeongo, inche ninkorusie aroro ngotabokanie gocha inse. Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.
Kiswahili: “Edomu atakuwa kitu cha kuogofya; wote wapitao karibu watashangaa na kuzomea kwa sababu ya majeraha yake yote.
Ekegusii: “Edomu nosarigwe obe ekiorokererio gi’okoondokia. Kera omonto oraetere aase agwo naondoke na goichanigwa ase engencho y’amaakwa aye.

English: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Sodoma na Gomora zilivyoangamizwa, pamoja na miji iliyokuwa jirani nayo,” asema Bwana, “vivyo hivyo hakuna mtu yeyote atakayeishi humo. Naam, hakuna mtu yeyote atakayekaa humo.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba ng’a koreng’ana buna Sodomu na Gomora na emechie yarenge ang’e noro yasiretigwe, naboigo Edomu orasirigwe; monto onde takomenya aroro, gose omoeti takogobera aroro.

English: “Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it, and whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it. For who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who will stand before me?”
Kiswahili: “Kama simba anayepanda kutoka vichaka vya Yordani kuja kwenye nchi ya malisho mengi, ndivyo nitamfukuza Edomu kutoka nchi yake ghafula. Ni nani aliye mteule nitakayemweka kwa ajili ya jambo hili? Ni nani aliye kama mimi, na ni nani awezaye kunipinga? Tena ni mchungaji yupi awezaye kusimama kinyume nami?”
Ekegusii: Rora, buna koreng’ana endo egosoka korwa ase rinani rinoru ria Yorodani, erinde yagenda goita ching’ondi chire ime ase obweri obokong’u, naboigo na inche ndachiere Abaedomu mobosokano, mbaserie batame korwa aroro. Onde bwensi ndachore nimobeke abe omorisia igoro ase bare. Ning’o oranyare koreng’anigwa nainche? Ning’o orambekere rituko indue omobaro? Morisia ki oranyare kweegerera ase obosio bwane?

English: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Edom, and his purposes that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they will drag them away, the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, sikia kile Bwana alichokipanga dhidi ya Edomu, kile alichokusudia dhidi ya wale waishio Temani: Aliye mchanga katika kundi ataburutwa mbali; yeye ataharibu kabisa malisho yao kwa sababu yao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio tegerera moigwe omooroberio inche Omonene nakorire igoro y’Abaedomu, na okogania kwane mbwate igoro ase abanto ba Temani: Ekeene, nonya nabana babo mbakururwe buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi chigokururwa chiairwa. Ekeene, ense yabo nebaichanere.

English: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.
Kiswahili: Kwa sauti ya anguko lao, dunia itatetemeka. Kilio chao kitasikika hadi Bahari ya Shamu.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’Edomu baragwe, eriogi riabo naritengechie ense; na eriogi ri’okorera kwabo narigugwe gochia ase Enyancha Embariri.

English: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
Kiswahili: Tazama! Tai atapaa juu angani na kuruka chini kwa ghafula, akitandaza mabawa yake juu ya Bosra. Katika siku hiyo, mioyo ya mashujaa wa Edomu itakuwa kama moyo wa mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa.
Ekegusii: Naama! Egesaku gete nkeimokerere igoro keiruruke bwango buna ekeongo, kerambore chimbaaba chiaye igoro y’omochie o Bosira. Ase rituko erio chinkoro chi’abasikari b’Edomu bare chituoni nachiondoke, na barabwo babe buna omokungu okobina ase okoibora.”

English: Of Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard evil news. They have melted away. There is sorrow on the sea. It can’t be quiet.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Dameski: “Hamathi na Arpadi imetahayarika, kwa kuwa wamesikia habari mbaya. Wamevunjika moyo na wametaabika kama bahari iliyochafuka.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana igoro ya Damesiki naro aya: “Abanto ba Hamati na ab’Aripadi basookire, ekiagera baigure amang’ana amabe; chinkoro chiabo chiabeire nobwoba. Nigo bachandegete babeire buna enyancha yaburukanigwe etanyare gotoerera.

English: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.
Kiswahili: Dameski amedhoofika, amegeuka na kukimbia, hofu ya ghafula imemkamata sana; amepatwa na uchungu na maumivu, maumivu kama ya mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Damesiki babeire aboro tibari na nguru; beonchoire gotama, ekiagera obwoba bwabasoire. Basoirwe nomoichano na ogochandeka buna omokungu okobina ase okoibora.

English: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini mji ambao unajulikana haujaachwa, mji ambao ninaupenda?
Ekegusii: Naki omochie oria omanyekanete mono, naende inche nagokerete, ong’anyirwe iga na otigirwe bosa?

English: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all the men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Hakika, vijana wake wanaume wataanguka barabarani; askari wake wote watanyamazishwa siku hiyo,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase rituko riria abamura b’omochie oyio nabaitwe bagwe ase chinchera chiaye, na abasikari baye bonsi mbaitwe. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda natebiire.

English: “I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.”
Kiswahili: “Nitatia moto kuta za Dameski; utaangamiza ngome za Ben-Hadadi.”
Ekegusii: Nintongie omorero ase chindwaki chia Damesiki, noro nosambe chinyomba chi’omorwoti Beni‐Hadadi.”

English: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, Yahweh says: “Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.
Kiswahili: Kuhusu Kedari na falme za Hazori, ambazo Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alizishambulia: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Inuka, ushambulie Kedari na kuwaangamiza watu wa mashariki.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro ya Kedari, na igoro y’amarwoti a Hasori, ayio Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, abuete: “Imoka, mogende Kedari! Mosirie abanto ba moocha.

English: They will take their tents and their flocks. they will carry away for themselves their curtains, all their vessels, and their camels; and they will cry to them, ‘Terror on every side!’
Kiswahili: Hema zao na makundi yao ya kondoo yatachukuliwa; vibanda vyao vitatwaliwa pamoja na mali zao zote na ngamia zao. Watu watawapigia kelele, ‘Hofu kuu iko kila upande!’
Ekegusii: Mosakore chiema chiabo na amaicho abo, na ebietubo bie chiema chiabo, na ebinto biabo bionsi; boigo moire chingamia chiabo. Morere igoro yabo, motebe: Obwoba nigo bore ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: Flee! Wander far off! Dwell in the depths, you inhabitants of Hazor,” says Yahweh; “for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.
Kiswahili: “Kimbieni haraka! Kaeni kwenye mapango marefu sana, ninyi mkaao Hazori,” asema Bwana. “Nebukadneza, mfalme wa Babeli amepanga shauri baya dhidi yenu; amebuni hila dhidi yenu.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Hasori, tama, mogende mwebise aase aakong’u, ekiagera Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, okorire omooroberio bw’okobarwania, na nigo are nebirengererio bi’okobakora bobe. Nab’Omonene atebiire:

English: Arise! Go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care,” says Yahweh; “that has neither gates nor bars, that dwells alone.
Kiswahili: “Inuka na ulishambulie taifa lililo starehe, linaloishi kwa kujiamini,” asema Bwana, “taifa lisilo na malango wala makomeo; watu wake huishi peke yao.
Ekegusii: Imoka, mogende korwania egesaku ekio kemenyete ase obotoereru getechandereti ing’ana rinde, ekio getabwati ebiita gose emekorogoto y’ogosiekera, egesaku ekio kemenyete gioka. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.

English: Their camels will be a booty, and the multitude of their livestock a plunder. I will scatter to all winds those who have the corners of their beards cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ngamia wao watakuwa nyara, nayo makundi yao makubwa ya ngʼombe yatatekwa. Wale walio maeneo ya mbali nitawatawanya pande zote, nami nitaleta maafa juu yao kutoka kila upande,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Mosakore, moire chingamia chiabo, ne chiombe chiabo chibe echiaino. Abanto abwo bakogingira chitukia chiabo nimbaserie mbasiarere gochia ase kera ensemo y’ense. Nimbarentere emechando korwa ase kera ensemo. Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals, a desolation forever. No man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.”
Kiswahili: “Hazori itakuwa makao ya mbweha, mahali pa ukiwa milele. Hakuna yeyote atakayeishi humo; hakuna mtu atakayekaa ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Hasori nosareke, omenywe ne chisese chi’orosana, obe amaturi kogenderera botambe, gose monto onde takomenya aroro, gose omoeti takogobera aroro.”

English: Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo neno la Bwana lililomjia nabii Yeremia kuhusu Elamu, mapema katika utawala wa Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda:
Ekegusii: Ase omochakano bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia omobani igoro y’ense y’Elamu, rikamoteebia,

English: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: “Tazama, nitavunja upinde wa Elamu, ulio tegemeo la nguvu zao.
Ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Rora, nimbune amata ’Abaelamu, ayio are chinguru chi’okobua kwabo.

English: I will bring on Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds. There will be no nation where the outcasts of Elam will not come.
Kiswahili: Nitaleta pepo nne dhidi ya Elamu toka pande nne za mbingu, nitawatawanya katika hizo pande nne, wala hapatakuwa na taifa ambalo watu wa Elamu waliofukuzwa hawatakwenda.
Ekegusii: Nindete chimbeo inye korwa ase chinsemo inye chia igoro, erinde nsiarere abanto b’Elamu bagende ase chinsinyo echio chionsi; gose egesaku tikeri keratigare ekio abanto b’Elamu batatamere.

English: I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before those who seek their life. I will bring evil on them, even my fierce anger,’ says Yahweh; ‘and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.
Kiswahili: Nitamfadhaisha Elamu mbele ya adui zao, mbele yao wale wanaotafuta uhai wao; nitaleta maafa juu yao, naam, hasira yangu kali,” asema Bwana. “Nitawafuatia kwa upanga mpaka nitakapowamaliza.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ningere abanto b’Elamu boboe ababisa babo, boigo boboe nabaanto baria bakorigia basirie obogima bwabo. Nimbarentere amabe, na endamwamu yane yoke igoro yabo. Nimbatunyanerie emioro, baitwe basirigwe kegima.

English: I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes,’ says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Nitaweka kiti changu cha enzi huko Elamu na kumwangamiza mfalme wake na maafisa wake,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nimbeke oboikaranso bwane bw’obonene agwo ase ense y’Abaelamu, nsirie omorwoti obo amo nabanene babo b’oborwoti. Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: ‘But it will happen in the latter days that I will reverse the captivity of Elam,’ says Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: “Lakini nitarudisha mateka wa Elamu katika siku zijazo,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha ning’iranerie Abaelamu amaya abo. Nab’Omonene atebiire.”

English: The word that Yahweh spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo neno alilosema Bwana kupitia nabii Yeremia kuhusu Babeli na nchi ya Wakaldayo:
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene akwanete goetera ase Yeremia omobani igoro y’omochie o Babiloni na ense engima y’Abakalidayo:

English: “Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal; say, ‘Babylon has been taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed! Her images are disappointed. Her idols are dismayed.’
Kiswahili: “Tangazeni na mhubiri katikati ya mataifa, twekeni bendera na mkahubiri; msiache kitu chochote, bali semeni, ‘Babeli utatekwa; Beli ataaibishwa, Merodaki atajazwa na hofu kuu. Sanamu zake zitaaibishwa na vinyago vyake vitajazwa hofu kuu.’
Ekegusii: “Kwana ase egati y’ebisaku, mobiraarerie! Imokereria igoro ebendera na morarie! Timobaisa kobisa amang’ana aya, korende motebe: Babiloni obwatirwe, enyasae Beli yasookigwe, na Merodaki yatirwe. Emegwekano egosasimwa ereo yasookigwe, ne chinyasae chi’aroro chiatirwe.

English: For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it. They have fled. They are gone, both man and animal.
Kiswahili: Taifa kutoka kaskazini litamshambulia, na kuifanya nchi yake ukiwa. Hakuna hata mmoja atakayeishi ndani yake, watu na wanyama wataikimbia.
Ekegusii: “Egesaku kiarure sugusu gocha korwania Babiloni. Nagesarie ense eyio ebe buna erooro, na monto onde takomenya aroro; abanto nabatame ne ching’iti boigo.”

English: “In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek Yahweh their God.
Kiswahili: “Katika siku hizo, wakati huo,” asema Bwana, “watu wa Israeli pamoja na watu wa Yuda wataenda wakilia ili kumtafuta Bwana Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda nabache amo babe bakorera na kondigia inche, Nyasae obo.

English: They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, and join yourselves to Yahweh in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.’
Kiswahili: Wataiuliza njia iendayo Sayuni na kuelekeza nyuso zao huko. Watakuja na kuambatana na Bwana katika agano la milele ambalo halitasahaulika.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbaborie bamanye enchera ekogenda Sayoni, babe bakoonchora amasio abo gochia aroro, batebania: Inchuo tobwatane n’Omonene, tokore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere, okwo koragenderere botambe gotanyare kwebwa.

English: My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting place.
Kiswahili: “Watu wangu wamekuwa kondoo waliopotea; wachungaji wao wamewapotosha na kuwasababisha kuzurura juu ya milima. Walitangatanga juu ya mlima na kilima, na kusahau mahali pao wenyewe pa kupumzikia.
Ekegusii: “Abanto baane babeire buna ching’ondi chinsiru. Abarisia babo baabasiririe, ekiagera babeire bakona‐kobaong’anyia ase ebitunwa. Nigo bakona‐koong’anya buna ching’ondi, bakobaetanania korwa ase ebitunwa goika ase ebigoro; ase igo abanto baane bebire obweri bwabo.

English: All who found them have devoured them. Their adversaries said, ‘We are not guilty, because they have sinned against Yahweh, the habitation of righteousness, even Yahweh, the hope of their fathers.’
Kiswahili: Yeyote aliyewakuta aliwala; adui zao walisema, ‘Sisi hatuna hatia, kwa kuwa wao walitenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana, malisho yao halisi, Bwana, aliye tumaini la baba zao.’
Ekegusii: Abanto bande bonsi baabanyorete nigo baabakorete bobe. Ababisa babo babeire bagoteeba: Intwe titori nokomocha ase ogokora iga, ekiagera barabwo bakorire ebibe ase Omonene obo, oyore obomenyo bwabo bw’ekeene, Omonene oyio orenge ogosemeria gwe chisokoro chiabo.

English: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.
Kiswahili: “Kimbieni kutoka Babeli; ondokeni katika nchi ya Wakaldayo tena kuweni kama mbuzi wale waongozao kundi.
Ekegusii: “Tama korwa Babiloni, morue ase ense y’Abakalidayo, mobe buna chigoree chigotang’ana bosio bwe riicho.

English: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they will set themselves in array against her. She will be taken from there. Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man. None of them will return in vain.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nitaamsha na kuleta dhidi ya Babeli muungano wa mataifa makubwa kutoka nchi ya kaskazini. Watashika nafasi zao dhidi yake, naye kutokea kaskazini atatekwa. Mishale yao itakuwa kama mishale ya mashujaa walio hodari, ambao hawawezi kurudi mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Naama! Inche ngoseegeta nde omoganda bw’ebisaku ebinene, korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na barabwo bebeke ang’e korwania Babiloni bayobue korwa ensemo eria ya sugusu. Chinsara chiabo nigo chinga buna omorwani omong’aini ore neganga otari koirana bosa.

English: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Ukaldayo utatekwa nyara; wote wamtekao nyara watapata za kutosha,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ense y’Abakalidayo nesakorwe, nabwo bonsi bakoyesakora nabaisaneke nebisakorwa ebio.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: “Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that treads out the grain, and neigh as strong horses,
Kiswahili: “Kwa sababu hushangilia na kufurahi, wewe utekaye urithi wangu, kwa sababu unachezacheza kama mtamba anayepura nafaka, na kulia kama farasi dume,
Ekegusii: “Inwe aba mwasakorete omwando one, nonya mwagogete na gochenga, naende more nokogania buna ritororo riarisirie obonyansi, na mogokwana buna chibarasi chituoni,

English: your mother will be utterly disappointed. She who bore you will be confounded. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
Kiswahili: mama yako ataaibika mno, yeye aliyekuzaa atatahayari. Atakuwa mdogo kuliko mataifa mengine yote, atakuwa nyika, nchi kame na jangwa.
Ekegusii: nyoko nabe nobosooku obonene, ee, omochie oyo okoiborete noichanigwe. Rora, ase egati ye chinse chi’ense oyio obe omoke mono kobua, nobe erooro enyomo ere bosa.

English: Because of Yahweh’s wrath she won’t be inhabited, but she will be wholly desolate. Everyone who goes by Babylon will be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya hasira ya Bwana hatakaliwa na mtu, lakini ataachwa ukiwa kabisa. Wote watakaopita Babeli watatiwa hofu na kudhihaki kwa sababu ya majeraha yake yote.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’endamwamu y’Omonene Babiloni nosirigwe kegima, gose tokomenywa rinde. Kera omonto orabe ogoeta Babiloni nakumie na goichana mono ase engencho y’amaakwa aye.

English: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her. Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Shikeni nafasi zenu kuzunguka Babeli, enyi nyote mvutao upinde. Mpigeni! Msibakize mshale wowote, kwa kuwa ametenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Inwe mwensi momanyete gokumba amata, ebeke ang’e morwanie Babiloni ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi. Yorute chinsara, timotiga nonya neyemo, ekiagera okorire ebibe ase Omonene.

English: Shout against her all around. She has submitted herself. Her bulwarks have fallen. Her walls have been thrown down, for it is the vengeance of Yahweh. Take vengeance on her. As she has done, do to her.
Kiswahili: Piga kelele dhidi yake kila upande! Anajisalimisha, minara yake inaanguka, kuta zake zimebomoka. Kwa kuwa hiki ni kisasi cha Bwana, mlipizeni kisasi; mtendeeni kama alivyowatendea wengine.
Ekegusii: Imoka, aka eriogi ri’esegi ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi. Babiloni bwerure omonyene; chiburi chiaye chiagure, chindwaki chiatagoirwe na koiyerigwa inse. Ekio negesiomba Omonene akorusia. Ase ayio, rusia egesiomba ase omochie oyio. Buna koreng’ana Babiloni okorete moyokore boigo.

English: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him who handles the sickle in the time of harvest. For fear of the oppressing sword, they will each return to their own people, and they will each flee to their own land.
Kiswahili: Katilieni mbali mpanzi kutoka Babeli, pamoja na mvunaji na mundu wake akivuna. Kwa sababu ya upanga wa mdhalimu kila mmoja na arejee kwa watu wake mwenyewe, kila mmoja na akimbilie kwenye nchi yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Siria kegima korwa Babiloni omobusuri na oyokoimokia omoyio bwe rigesa, ekero engaki eyio yaikire. Ase engencho y’obwoba bw’omochandi, kera omomenyi nairane ase abanto baye, kera oyomo natame gochia ase ense yaye omonyene.

English: “Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.”
Kiswahili: “Israeli ni kundi lililotawanyika ambalo simba wamelifukuzia mbali. Wa kwanza kumla alikuwa mfalme wa Ashuru, wa mwisho kuponda mifupa yake alikuwa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli.”
Ekegusii: “Abaisraeli nigo banga buna ching’ondi chigoserigwa ne chindo na goserebanigwa gochia aaria na aaria. Ritang’ani omorwoti bw’Abaasuri akababua na kobasiria, na bono omoerio Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, otakunire amauga abo.

English: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo: “Nitamwadhibu mfalme wa Babeli na nchi yake kama nilivyomwadhibu mfalme wa Ashuru.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Naama! Nindetere omorwoti o Babiloni, amo nense yaye, egesusuro, buna nakorete ase omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.

English: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he will feed on Carmel and Bashan. His soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.
Kiswahili: Lakini nitamrudisha Israeli katika malisho yake mwenyewe naye atalisha huko Karmeli na Bashani; njaa yake itashibishwa juu ya vilima vya Efraimu na Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Ning’iranie Abaisraeli gocha ase obomenyo bwabo naende. Nabarabwo nabarie chindagera chiabo agwo ase egetunwa gia Karimeli, na ase orogongo rwa Basani, na okogania kwabo nagoisanekigwe agwo ase ebigoro bi’Efraimu, na ase Gileadi.

English: In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the iniquity of Israel will be sought for, and there will be none, also the sins of Judah, and they won’t be found; for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo, wakati huo,” asema Bwana, “uchunguzi utafanyika kwa ajili ya kosa la Israeli, lakini halitakuwepo, kwa ajili ya dhambi za Yuda, lakini haitapatikana hata moja, kwa kuwa nitawasamehe mabaki nitakaowaacha.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, ogosaria nakorigigwe ase Abaisraeli, ko tigokonyorekana, na ebibe ase Abayuda, ko tibikonyorekana, ekiagera inche Omonene ninyabere abanto abwo ndatigarie koba abatigari.”

English: “Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod. Kill and utterly destroy after them,” says Yahweh, “and do according to all that I have commanded you.
Kiswahili: “Shambulieni nchi ya Merathaimu na wale waishio huko Pekodi. Wafuatieni, waueni na kuwaangamiza kabisa,” asema Bwana. “Fanyeni kila kitu nilichowaamuru.
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire, Genda morwanie ense ya Merataimu na abanto ba Pekodi. Mobabwatie korwa magega, mobaite na kobasiria kegima, mokore onsi aya nabachiikire.

English: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
Kiswahili: Kelele ya vita iko ndani ya nchi, kelele ya maangamizi makuu!
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’esegi riachire ase ense amo nogosirigwa okonene.

English: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi nyundo ya dunia yote ilivyovunjika na kuharibika! Tazama jinsi Babeli ilivyokuwa ukiwa miongoni mwa mataifa!
Ekegusii: Naki enturago eria yaagete ense engima yaakirwe na gwateka! Naki Babiloni osirigwe, na abanto baichanigwe ase okoyorora igo!

English: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren’t aware. You are found, and also caught, because you have fought against Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Nimetega mtego kwa ajili yako, ee Babeli, nawe ukakamatwa kabla haujafahamu; ulipatikana na ukakamatwa kwa sababu ulimpinga Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aye Babiloni, nagotegire noboreba, kwabwatirwe, nonya tikwamanyete ayio; kwanyorirwe na kobwatwa, ekiagera nkwamorwanetie Omonene.

English: Yahweh has opened his armory, and has brought out the weapons of his indignation; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.
Kiswahili: Bwana amefungua ghala lake la silaha na kuzitoa silaha za ghadhabu yake, kwa kuwa Bwana Mwenyezi Mwenye Nguvu Zote anayo kazi ya kufanya katika nchi ya Wakaldayo.
Ekegusii: Omonene oigoire ase agachete ebirwanero biaye, na ase endamwamu yaye obisokirie, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabwate emeremo agokora ase ense y’Abakalidayo.

English: Come against her from the farthest border. Open her storehouses. Cast her up as heaps. Destroy her utterly. Let nothing of her be left.
Kiswahili: Njooni dhidi yake kutoka mbali. Zifungueni ghala zake za nafaka; mlundikeni kama lundo la nafaka. Mwangamizeni kabisa na msimwachie mabaki yoyote.
Ekegusii: Inchuo morwanie ense eyio korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, moigore ebiage biaye; mobeke ebinto bire imeo amo, bibe buna ebinge chi’endagera. Mosirie ense eyio kegima; timobaisa gotigaria nonya negento ekemo.

English: Kill all her bulls. Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their visitation.
Kiswahili: Waueni mafahali wake wachanga wote; waacheni washuke machinjoni! Ole wao! Kwa kuwa siku yao imewadia, wakati wao wa kuadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Moite abarwani babo b’esegi banga buna chieri, mobaite bonsi pi. Obobe nobwabo, ekiagera rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwabo riachire, eyio nengaki yabo y’okonyora egesusuro.

English: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahweh our God, the vengeance of his temple.
Kiswahili: Wasikilizeni watoro na wakimbizi kutoka Babeli wakitangaza katika Sayuni jinsi Bwana, Mungu wetu alivyolipiza kisasi, kisasi kwa ajili ya Hekalu lake.
Ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’abaanto bagotama korwa ase ense ya Babiloni, bakoraria ase Sayoni igoro y’Omonene, Nyasae oito, buna akoruseria Hekalu yaye egesiomba.

English: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her work. According to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against Yahweh, against the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Waiteni wapiga mishale dhidi ya Babeli, wote wale wavutao upinde. Pigeni kambi kumzunguka kabisa, asitoroke mtu yeyote. Mlipizeni kwa matendo yake; mtendeeni kama alivyotenda. Kwa kuwa alimdharau Bwana, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Rangeria abanto bamanyete korwanera amata bachiche korwania Babiloni. Moyoboere ase chinsemo chionsi, timotiga nonya nomonto oyomo atame atooreke. Yoakane koreng’ana nogokora kwaye. Buna koreng’ana oro okorete tiga okorerwe boigo, ekiagera omochie oyio oenenire ase Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets. All her men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, vijana wake wanaume wataanguka barabarani; askari wake wote watanyamazishwa siku ile,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abamura b’omochie oyio, nabaitwe, bakwere agwo ase chinchera, na abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi nabasirigwe kegima. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.

English: “Behold, I am against you, you proud one,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies; “for your day has come, the time that I will visit you.
Kiswahili: “Tazama, niko kinyume nawe, ewe mwenye majivuno,” asema Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, “kwa kuwa siku yako imewadia, yaani, wakati wako wa kuadhibiwa.
Ekegusii: Naende inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, natebiire: Aye Babiloni ore omoenenu, igwa, inche nabeire mamincha yao; rituko riao riaikire, engaki eye ngokoa egesusuro.

English: The proud one will stumble and fall, and no one will raise him up. I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all who are around him.”
Kiswahili: Mwenye majivuno atajikwaa na kuanguka, wala hakuna yeyote atakayemuinua; nitawasha moto katika miji yake, utakaowateketeza wote wanaomzunguka.”
Ekegusii: Oyio ore omoenenu nagochwe na kogwa, gose monto onde takomogororokia. Nintongie omorero ase emechie y’ense eyio noro nosambe chinsemo chiaye chionsi.

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together. All who took them captive hold them fast. They refuse to let them go.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Watu wa Israeli wameonewa, nao watu wa Yuda pia. Wote waliowateka wamewashikilia sana, wanakataa kuwaachia waende.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda nigo bachandire. Abanto abwo baabairete ase obosomba nigo baababwatete bokong’u, bangire kobaa ribaga bagende sobo.

English: Their Redeemer is strong. Yahweh of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mkombozi wao ana nguvu; Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndilo jina lake. Atatetea kwa nguvu shauri lao ili alete raha katika nchi yao, lakini ataleta msukosuko kwa wale waishio Babeli.
Ekegusii: Korende omobooria obo nigo are ne chinguru. Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye. Ekeene, ere nabarwanerere, erinde arente obotoereru na omotimoko ase ense, korende narente omorero ase abanto bamenyete Babiloni.

English: “A sword is on the Chaldeans,” says Yahweh, “and on the inhabitants of Babylon, on her princes, and on her wise men.
Kiswahili: “Upanga dhidi ya Wakaldayo!” asema Bwana, “dhidi ya wale waishio Babeli na dhidi ya maafisa wake na watu wenye busara!
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Omoro obe igoro ase Abakalidayo, na igoro ase abanto bamenyete Babiloni, na igoro ase abanene b’oborwoti obwo, na igoro ase abanto abang’aini b’ense eyio!

English: A sword is on the boasters, and they will become fools. A sword is on her mighty men, and they will be dismayed.
Kiswahili: Upanga dhidi ya manabii wake wa uongo! Watakuwa wapumbavu. Upanga dhidi ya mashujaa wake! Watajazwa na hofu kuu
Ekegusii: Omoro obe igoro ase abaringoria, erinde babe abariri! Omoro obe igoro ase abarwani baye bare chituoni, erinde basirigwe!

English: A sword is on their horses, on their chariots, and on all the mixed people who are in the middle of her; and they will become as women. A sword is on her treasures, and they will be robbed.
Kiswahili: Upanga dhidi ya farasi na magari yake ya vita pamoja na askari wake wote wa kigeni katika safu zake! Wao watakuwa kama wanawake. Upanga dhidi ya hazina zake! Hizo zitatekwa nyara.
Ekegusii: Omoro obe igoro ase chibarasi ne chigari chia Babiloni! Omoro obe igoro ase abasikari b’ense eng’ao, abare ase egati yabo, erinde obakore babe buna abakungu! Omoro obe igoro ase chinibo chiabo erinde chisakorwe!

English: A drought is on her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.
Kiswahili: Ukame juu ya maji yake! Nayo yatakauka. Kwa kuwa ni nchi ya sanamu, wao wanaenda wazimu kwa ajili ya sanamu.
Ekegusii: Egurugura nebe igoro ase chindooche chiaye, erinde chikame amaache! Ense eyio nigo eichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, na abanto mbabe buna chibarimo ase ogosasiima emegwekano eyio!

English: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein. It will be inhabited no more forever, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, viumbe vya jangwani na fisi wataishi humo, nao bundi watakaa humo. Kamwe haitakaliwa tena wala watu hawataishi humo kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ching’iti chi’orosana, amo ne chinyang’au, ne chisagero nachimenye ase ense eyio. Abanto tibagocha komenyao nonya ng’ake, korwa ekiaare goika ekiaare kogenderera botambe.

English: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “so no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Mungu alivyoangamiza Sodoma na Gomora pamoja na miji iliyokuwa jirani nayo,” asema Bwana, “vivyo hivyo hakuna mtu yeyote atakayeishi humo. Naam, hakuna mtu yeyote atakayekaa humo.
Ekegusii: Buna yabeete ekero keria Nyasae asiretie emechie ya Sodomu na Gomora, amo nemechie yarenge ang’e neyio, naboigo monto onde takomenya Babiloni, gose Mwanyabaanto onde takomenya aroro. Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: “Behold, a people comes from the north. A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
Kiswahili: “Tazama! Jeshi linakuja kutoka kaskazini; taifa kubwa na wafalme wengi wanaamshwa kutoka miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Naama! Abanto ngocha bare korwa sugusu, egesaku ekenene mono amo nabarwoti abange baseegetirwe korwa chinsinyo chi’ense.

English: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.
Kiswahili: Wamejifunga pinde na mikuki; ni wakatili na wasio na huruma. Wanatoa sauti kama bahari inayonguruma wanapoendesha farasi zao; wanakuja kama watu waliojipanga tayari kwa vita ili kukushambulia, ee Binti Babeli.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babwate amata na amatimo, nigo bare abatindi, abatari namaabera. Amariogi abo nigo akoeera buna okoeera kw’enyancha. Nigo bariinete chibarasi, berobeirie buna omonto bwebekire ang’e ase esegi, erinde baabarwanie inwe, abanto ba Babiloni.

English: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them, and his hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of him, pains as of a woman in labor.
Kiswahili: Mfalme wa Babeli amesikia habari kuwahusu, nayo mikono yake imelegea. Uchungu umemshika, maumivu kama ya mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa.
Ekegusii: “Omorwoti o Babiloni oigure amang’ana igoro yabo, amaboko aye aborirwe chinguru, omoichano omosoire, na obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore.

English: Behold, the enemy will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it. Whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it, for who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?”
Kiswahili: Kama simba anayepanda kutoka vichaka vya Yordani kuja kwenye nchi ya malisho mengi, ndivyo nitamfukuza Babeli kutoka nchi yake ghafula. Ni nani aliye mteule, nitakayemweka kwa ajili ya jambo hili? Ni nani aliye kama mimi, na ni nani awezaye kunipinga? Tena ni mchungaji yupi awezaye kusimama kinyume nami?”
Ekegusii: “Rora, buna koreng’ana endo egosoka korwa ase rinani rinoru ria Yorodani, erinde yagenda goita ching’ondi chire ime ase obweri obokong’u, naboigo na inche ndachiere abanto ba Babiloni mobosokano, mbaserie batame korwa aroro. Onde bwensi ndachore nimobeke abe omorisia igoro ase bare. Ning’o oranyare koreng’anigwa nainche? Ning’o orambekere rituko indue omobaro? Morisia ki oranyare kweegera ase obosio bwane?

English: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they will drag them away, even the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, sikia kile Bwana alichokipanga dhidi ya Babeli, kile alichokusudia dhidi ya nchi ya Wakaldayo: Aliye mchanga katika kundi ataburutwa mbali. Yeye ataharibu kabisa malisho yao kwa sababu yao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, tegerera moigwe omooroberio inche Omonene nakorire igoro y’abanto ba Babiloni, na okogania kwane mbwate igoro y’ense y’Abakalidayo. Ekeene, nonya nabana babo mbakururwe buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi chigokururwa chiairwa. Ee, ekeene, ense yabo nebaichanere.

English: The earth trembles at the noise of the taking of Babylon. The cry is heard among the nations.
Kiswahili: Kwa sauti ya kutekwa kwa Babeli, dunia itatetemeka; kilio chake kitasikika pote miongoni mwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Babiloni orabwatwe, ense netengechigwe, na eriogi riaye narigugwe ase egati y’ebisaku.”

English: Yahweh says: “Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Tazama nitaamsha roho ya mwangamizi dhidi ya Babeli na watu wakaao Leb-Kamai.
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Rora, inche ninseegete omoika bw’ogosiria Babiloni na abanto bamenyete aroro bare mamincha yane.

English: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around.
Kiswahili: Nitawatuma wageni Babeli kumpepeta na kuiharibu nchi yake; watampinga kila upande katika siku ya maafa yake.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ri’emechando nintomere abanto ba Babiloni abairuri baabairure, batige ense yabo ebe bosa.

English: Against him who bends, let the archer bend his bow, also against him who lifts himself up in his coat of mail. Don’t spare her young men! Utterly destroy all her army!
Kiswahili: Usimwache mpiga upinde afunge kamba upinde wake, wala usimwache avae silaha zake. Usiwaonee huruma vijana wake; angamiza jeshi lake kabisa.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gotiga abarwani bakumbe amata na korasa chinsara chiabo, gose kobeeka chigoti chi’ebioma. Timororera abamura b’aroro amaabera. Mosirie abarwani baye b’esegi bonsi pi.

English: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.
Kiswahili: Wataanguka waliouawa katika Babeli, wakiwa na majeraha ya kutisha barabarani zake.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo mbaitwe ase ense y’Abakalidayo, babe bakwete ase chinchera chi’emechie yabo.

English: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, by his God, by Yahweh of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Israeli na Yuda hawajaachwa na Mungu wao, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ingawa nchi yao imejaa uovu mbele zake yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, Omonene bw’Emeganda, tatigeti Abaisraeli na Abayuda, nonya ense yabo yabeire nebibe ebinge ase Nyasae ore omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

English: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity, for it is the time of Yahweh’s vengeance. He will give to her a recompense.
Kiswahili: “Kimbieni kutoka Babeli! Okoeni maisha yenu! Msiangamizwe kwa sababu ya dhambi zake. Ni wakati wa kisasi cha Bwana, atamlipa kile anachostahili.
Ekegusii: Tama korwa Babiloni, kera omonto atoorie obogima bwaye. Timobaisa gosirigwa ekero ense eyio eraegwe egesusuro kiaye, ekiagera eye nero engaki Omonene akorusia egesiomba, ayeakane buna koreng’ana nogokora kwaye kore.

English: Babylon has been a golden cup in Yahweh’s hand, who made all the earth drunk. The nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations have gone mad.
Kiswahili: Babeli alikuwa kikombe cha dhahabu katika mkono wa Bwana; aliufanya ulimwengu wote ulewe. Mataifa walikunywa mvinyo wake; kwa hiyo sasa wameingiwa na wazimu.
Ekegusii: Babiloni nigo yarenge buna egekombe gi’etaabu ase okoboko kw’Omonene; ebisaku bionsi bi’ense bikanywera korwa ase kerokio bigatinda. Ebisaku bikanywa edivai ya Babiloni, erio bigatinda, bikaba buna chibarimo.

English: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.
Kiswahili: Babeli ataanguka ghafula na kuvunjika. Mwombolezeni! Tafuteni zeri ya kutuliza maumivu yake, labda anaweza kupona.
Ekegusii: Babiloni ogure mobosokano na gosirigwa, Yoreere mobogorie amaguta akogwenia amaote aye, ande nabo ense eria erabaise kogwenigwa.

English: “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her, and let’s each go into his own country; for her judgment reaches to heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Tungemponya Babeli, lakini hawezi kuponyeka; tumwacheni, na kila mmoja wetu aende nchi yake mwenyewe, kwa kuwa hukumu yake inafika angani, inapanda juu hadi mawinguni.’
Ekegusii: Nanga nabo twagwenetie Babiloni, korende togwenetigwe. Togende, totige Babiloni; kera omonto agende ase ense yaye, ekiagera obobe bwa Babiloni bwaikire igoro nonya nase amare.

English: ‘Yahweh has produced our righteousness. Come, and let’s declare in Zion the work of Yahweh our God.’
Kiswahili: “ ‘Bwana amethibitisha haki yetu; njooni, tutangaze katika Sayuni kitu ambacho Bwana Mungu wetu amefanya.’
Ekegusii: “Omonene otorenteire oboronge bwaito. Inchuo torarie ase Sayoni emeremo y’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

English: “Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it; for it is the vengeance of Yahweh, the vengeance of his temple.
Kiswahili: “Noeni mishale, chukueni ngao! Bwana amewaamsha wafalme wa Wamedi, kwa sababu nia yake ni kuangamiza Babeli. Bwana atalipiza kisasi, kisasi kwa ajili ya Hekalu lake.
Ekegusii: “Tieria chinsara! Imokia chinguba! Omonene oseegetire emeika y’abarwoti b’Abamedi, ekiagera nigo aroberetie gosiria Babiloni. Ekio negesiomba Omonene akoruseria Hekalu yaye.

English: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon! Make the watch strong! Set the watchmen, and prepare the ambushes; for Yahweh has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.
Kiswahili: Twekeni bendera juu ya kuta za Babeli! Imarisheni ulinzi, wekeni walinzi, andaeni waviziao! Bwana atatimiza kusudi lake, amri yake juu ya watu wa Babeli.
Ekegusii: Tenenia ebendera ase chindwaki chia Babiloni! Kora oborendi bobe obokong’u ase okobeeka abarendi. Beka abanto bebise na koboa, ekiagera Omonene orobeirie na goikerania amang’ana aria akwanete ase abanto bamenyete Babiloni.

English: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness.
Kiswahili: Wewe uishiye kando ya maji mengi na uliye na wingi wa hazina, mwisho wako umekuja, wakati wako wa kukatiliwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Aye omenyete aase amaache amange are, ore omonda bwe chinibo chinyinge, korende omoerio oo oikire, naboigo na okogania kwao okonge.

English: Yahweh of Armies has sworn by himself, saying, ‘Surely I will fill you with men, as with locusts, and they will lift up a shout against you.’
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ameapa kwa nafsi yake mwenyewe: ‘Hakika nitakujaza na watu, kama kundi la nzige, nao watapiga kelele za ushindi juu yako.’
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda bwetianirie ogoteeba: Ekeene, ninkorentere abanto abange mono buna chingige, bachiche gokorwania, na barabwo nabakobue na baake eriogi ri’obobui.”

English: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.
Kiswahili: “Aliiumba dunia kwa uweza wake; akaweka misingi ya ulimwengu kwa hekima yake na akazitandaza mbingu kwa ufahamu wake.
Ekegusii: “Omonene nere otongete ense ase okobua kwaye, nere oyetenenetie goetera ase obong’aini bwaye, na ase okomanya kwaye akarambora igoro.

English: When he utters his voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.
Kiswahili: Atoapo sauti yake, maji yaliyo katika mbingu hunguruma, huyafanya mawingu yainuke kutoka miisho ya dunia. Hupeleka umeme wa radi pamoja na mvua, naye huuleta upepo kutoka ghala zake.
Ekegusii: Ekero agokwana neriogi riaye, amaache are igoro nigo akoruma. Nigo agokora ritaturi riaimokerera igoro korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Nigo akomesia na korenta embura, naende orenta omwaga ogusa korwa ase ebigachero biaye.

English: “Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
Kiswahili: “Kila mtu ni mjinga na hana maarifa; kila sonara ameaibishwa na sanamu zake. Vinyago vyake ni vya udanganyifu, havina pumzi ndani yavyo.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo are omoriri, tamanyeti gento, na kera omooroisia etaabu nigo agosookigwa nemegwekano yaye y’ogosasimwa, ekiagera emegwekano eyio ney’obong’ainereria, tebwati omoika ime yaye.

English: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish.
Kiswahili: Havifai kitu, ni vitu vya kufanyia mzaha, hukumu yavyo itakapowadia, vitaangamia.
Ekegusii: Eyio nigo ere bosa, nesekererwe, ekero eraegwe egesusuro, nesirigwe.

English: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he formed all things, including the tribe of his inheritance. Yahweh of Armies is his name.
Kiswahili: Yeye Aliye Fungu la Yakobo sivyo alivyo, kwani ndiye Muumba wa vitu vyote, pamoja na kabila la urithi wake: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndilo jina lake.
Ekegusii: Korende oyore egetari o Yakobo tagwekaini emegwekano eyio; nere otongete ebinto bionsi. Abaisraeli nigo bare egesaku ki’omwando oye; Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye.”

English: “You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces. With you I will destroy kingdoms.
Kiswahili: “Wewe ndiwe rungu langu la vita, silaha yangu ya vita: kwa wewe navunjavunja mataifa, kwa wewe naangamiza falme,
Ekegusii: “Aye nenturago na ekerwanero kiane gi’esegi; goetera asore ning’ake ebisaku bibe ebisamunye, ninsirie amarwoti.

English: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider.
Kiswahili: kwa wewe navunjavunja farasi na mpanda farasi, kwa wewe navunjavunja gari la vita na mwendeshaji wake,
Ekegusii: Goetera asore ninsamunyore chibarasi na abanto bachiriinete; ninsamunyore ne chigari na abagochigendia.

English: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.
Kiswahili: kwa wewe napondaponda mwanaume na mwanamke, kwa wewe napondaponda mzee na kijana, kwa wewe napondaponda kijana wa kiume na mwanamwali,
Ekegusii: Goetera asore ninsamunyore abasacha na abakungu, ninsamunyore abanto abagotu na abake, ninsamunyore abamura na abaiseke;

English: With you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock. With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke. With you I will break in pieces governors and deputies.
Kiswahili: kwa wewe nampondaponda mchungaji na kundi, kwa wewe nampondaponda mkulima na maksai, kwa wewe nawapondaponda watawala na maafisa.
Ekegusii: goetera asore ninsamunyore abarisia ne riicho riabo, ninsamunyore abaremi ne chiombe chiabo; boigo goetera asore ninsamunyore abagabana na abachiki.”

English: “I will give to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Mbele ya macho yako nitamlipiza Babeli na wote waishio Ukaldayo kwa ajili ya makosa yote waliyofanya katika Sayuni,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Agwo ase amasio aino ning’akane Babiloni na Abakalidayo bonsi obobe bwabo bwonsi bakorete ase Sayoni.

English: “Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain,” says Yahweh, “which destroys all the earth. I will stretch out my hand on you, roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burned mountain.
Kiswahili: “Mimi niko kinyume nawe, ee mlima unaoharibu, wewe uangamizaye dunia yote,” asema Bwana. “Nitanyoosha mkono wangu dhidi yako, nikuvingirishe kutoka kwenye kilele cha mwamba, na kukufanya mlima ulioteketezwa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Aye egetunwa kegosiria, gwasiririe ense yonsi, rora, inche nabeire mamincha yao; nindambore okoboko kwane asore; nkobwate ngoturunkanie korwa ase emienya y’ebitare, erio nkoonchore obe egetunwa giasambirwe.

English: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hakuna jiwe litakalochukuliwa kutoka kwako kwa ajili ya kufanywa jiwe la pembeni, wala jiwe lolote kwa ajili ya msingi, kwa maana utakuwa ukiwa milele,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Igena rinde tirikorusigwa asore ribe eri’ekoona, gose kobekwa ase oboroso, korende aye nosarigwe ogenderere koba ritongo kogenderera botambe.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: “Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz! Appoint a marshal against her! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts!
Kiswahili: “Twekeni bendera katika nchi! Pigeni tarumbeta katikati ya mataifa! Andaeni mataifa kwa ajili ya vita dhidi yake, iteni falme hizi dhidi yake: Ararati, Mini na Ashkenazi. Wekeni jemadari dhidi yake, pelekeni farasi wengi kama kundi la nzige.
Ekegusii: “Tenenia ebendera y’esegi igoro ase ense! Bugia egetureeri ase egati y’ebisaku! Beka ebisaku ang’e birwanie Babiloni. Rangeria amarwoti ayorwanie, ee, rangeria Ararati, na Mini, na Asikenasi. Chora abatang’ani b’esegi bayoumokere. Renta chibarasi chinyinge buna chingige chikogosa.

English: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion!
Kiswahili: Andaeni mataifa kwa ajili ya vita dhidi yake, wafalme wa Wamedi, watawala wao na maafisa wao wote, pamoja na nchi zote wanazotawala.
Ekegusii: Beka ebisaku ang’e biche korwania Babiloni. Rangeria abarwoti b’Abamedi amo nabagabana na abakoonyi babo, na kera ense ere ase obogambi bwaye.

English: The land trembles and is in pain; for the purposes of Yahweh against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.
Kiswahili: Nchi inatetemeka na kugaagaa, kwa kuwa makusudi ya Bwana dhidi ya Babeli yanasimama: yaani, kuangamiza nchi ya Babeli ili pasiwe na yeyote atakayeishi humo.
Ekegusii: Erio ense etengeche na koiguswa ase obororo, ekiagera omooroberio Omonene bw’ogosaria Babiloni noikeranigwe, na ere nasirie ense eyio ebe bosa temenywa na monto.

English: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.
Kiswahili: Mashujaa wa Babeli wameacha kupigana, wamebaki katika ngome zao. Nguvu zao zimekwisha, wamekuwa kama wanawake. Makazi yake yameteketezwa kwa moto, makomeo ya malango yake yamevunjika.
Ekegusii: Abarwani chituoni ba Babiloni batigire korwana esegi. Nigo bagendererete kobeera ase chiburi ime, ekiagera tibari ne chinguru, babeire buna abakungu. Chinyomba chia Babiloni chiasambirwe, na emekorogoto yabo y’ebiita yabunirwe.

English: One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter.
Kiswahili: Tarishi mmoja humfuata mwingine, na mjumbe humfuata mjumbe, kumtangazia mfalme wa Babeli kwamba mji wake wote umetekwa,
Ekegusii: Omominyoki oyomo naminyoke aumerane noyonde, na omotomwa oyomo naminyoke aumerane noyonde, kogenda goteebia omorwoti o Babiloni ng’a omochie obwatirwe ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi,

English: So the passages are seized. They have burned the reeds with fire. The men of war are frightened.”
Kiswahili: Vivuko vya mito vimekamatwa, mabwawa yenye mafunjo yametiwa moto, nao askari wameingiwa na hofu kuu.”
Ekegusii: naende ng’a ebiambokero biabwatirwe, amaagacho ogwekengera asambirwe nomorero, na abasikari baondokire.

English: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden. Yet a little while, and the time of harvest comes for her.”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo: “Binti Babeli ni kama sakafu ya kupuria wakati inapokanyagwa; wakati wa kumvuna utakuja upesi.”
Ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Abanto ba Babiloni babeire buna ekeooreri gi’okoorera kiaroisigwe ase ogotachwa. Engaki netigarete enke, erio rigesa riaye riike.

English: “Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me. He has crushed me. He has made me an empty vessel. He has, like a monster, swallowed me up. He has filled his mouth with my delicacies. He has cast me out.
Kiswahili: “Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli ametula, ametufanya tuchangayikiwe, ametufanya tuwe gudulia tupu. Kama nyoka ametumeza na kujaza tumbo lake kwa vyakula vyetu vizuri, kisha akatutapika.
Ekegusii: “Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, ondiire, onsegenyire; ontigire inde bosa buna ekebekerero getabwati gento. Omerire inche buna enchoka ekomera egento. Oichoirie enda yaye n’ebinto biane ebiya, ontigire inde bosa.
