English: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon!” the inhabitant of Zion will say; and, “May my blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea!” will Jerusalem say.
Kiswahili: Jeuri iliyofanyiwa miili yetu na iwe juu ya Babeli,” ndivyo wasemavyo wakaao Sayuni. “Damu yetu na iwe juu ya wale waishio Babeli,” asema Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Obobe bw’obotindi bwakoretwe ase ’nde na ase abaminto nabobekwe igoro ya Babiloni. Tiga abanto ba Sayoni bateebe: Okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga aito, tiga kobe igoro ase Abakalidayo.”

English: Therefore Yahweh says: “Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: “Tazama, nitatetea shauri lako na kulipiza kisasi kwa ajili yako; nitaikausha bahari yake na kuzikausha chemchemi zake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Naama! Nimbarwanerere inwe, mbaruserie egesiomba. Ninkamie enyancha ya Babiloni, nkamie ne chinsoko chiaye chionsi.

English: Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.
Kiswahili: Babeli utakuwa lundo la magofu na makao ya mbweha, kitu cha kutisha na kudharauliwa, mahali asipoishi mtu.
Ekegusii: Babiloni nosirigwe obe etui y’amatongo ase chisese chi’orosana chiramenye. Abanto tibakomenya aroro, korende nigo barabe bagoichanigwa na koyochecheria.

English: They will roar together like young lions. They will growl as lions’ cubs.
Kiswahili: Watu wake wote wananguruma kama simba wadogo, wanakoroma kama wana simba.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Babiloni nabaronye amo buna chindo chikoronya; nabarere buna chindo chinsae.

English: When they are inflamed, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunk, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati wakiwa wameamshwa, nitawaandalia karamu na kuwafanya walewe, ili wapige kelele kwa kicheko, kisha walale milele na wasiamke,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero bare ne ribero rinene, nimbakorere omoyega, erinde banywe, batinde na kogoka. Erio baraare chitoro chintambe, tibaboka. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.

English: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.
Kiswahili: “Nitawateremsha kama wana-kondoo waendao machinjoni, kama kondoo dume na mbuzi.
Ekegusii: Nimbarente banyenywe buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi, ne chimingichi amo ne chigoree chikonyenywa.”

English: “How Sheshach is taken! How the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
Kiswahili: “Tazama jinsi Sheshaki atakamatwa, majivuno ya dunia yote yatakavyonyakuliwa. Babeli atakuwa mwenye hofu kiasi gani kati ya mataifa!
Ekegusii: “Naki Sesaki, nero Babiloni, eyere ogotogigwa gw’ense yonsi, yabwatirwe na koondokia ebisaku binde!

English: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.
Kiswahili: Bahari itainuka juu ya Babeli; mawimbi yake yenye kunguruma yatamfunika.
Ekegusii: Enyancha yaumokire igoro ase Babiloni, emerindo y’enyancha yayetubire.

English: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by it.
Kiswahili: Miji yake itakuwa ukiwa, kame na jangwa, nchi ambayo hakuna yeyote anayeishi ndani yake, ambayo hakuna mtu anayepita humo.
Ekegusii: Emechie y’ense eyio yasirigwe yabeire ey’okoondokia, yabeire enyomo na erooro, ense etamenyiri na monto onde, na Mwanyabaanto onde tagoeta aroro.

English: I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon, and I will bring out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up. The nations will not flow any more to him. Yes, the wall of Babylon will fall.
Kiswahili: Nitamwadhibu Beli katika Babeli, na kumfanya atapike kile alichokimeza. Mataifa hayatamiminika tena kwake. Nao ukuta wa Babeli utaanguka.
Ekegusii: Ning’ee enyasae Beli ya Babiloni egesusuro, nindusie korwa ase omonwa oye ebi yamerete. Ebisaku tibikogenderera gocha ase enyasae eyio. “Chindwaki chia Babiloni chiagure.

English: “My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from Yahweh’s fierce anger.
Kiswahili: “Tokeni ndani yake, enyi watu wangu! Okoeni maisha yenu! Ikimbieni hasira kali ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, tama morue aroro! Kera omonto atoorie obogima bwaye korwa ase endamwamu enene y’Omonene.

English: Don’t let your heart faint. Don’t fear for the news that will be heard in the land. For news will come one year, and after that in another year news will come, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
Kiswahili: Msikate tamaa wala msiogope tetesi zitakaposikika katika nchi; tetesi moja inasikika mwaka huu, nyingine mwaka unaofuata; tetesi juu ya jeuri katika nchi, na ya mtawala dhidi ya mtawala.
Ekegusii: Timokwa emioyo, gose timoiroka, ekero moraigwe amang’ana agocha ase ense. Omwaka oyomo nigo moraigwe amang’ana gete, na omwaka onde moigwe ayande. Boigo obotindi nigo bore ase ense, na omogambi oyomo nigo akorwana noyonde.

English: Therefore behold, the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land will be confounded. All her slain will fall in the middle of her.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hakika wakati utawadia nitakapoziadhibu sanamu za Babeli; nchi yake yote itatiwa aibu, na watu wake wote waliouawa wataangukia ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndarente egesusuro ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa ya Babiloni. Ense eyio yonsi nenyore obosooku, na abanto baye mbaiterwe aroro agwo.

English: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mbingu na dunia na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake vitapiga kelele za shangwe juu ya Babeli, kwa kuwa kutoka kaskazini waharabu watamshambulia,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio igoro na ense, na ebinto bionsi bireo, mbitere nomochengo, ekero abasaria bararue sugusu gocha gosaria Babiloni. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.

English: “As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon.
Kiswahili: “Babeli ni lazima aanguke kwa sababu ya kuwaua Waisraeli, kama vile waliouawa duniani kote walivyoanguka kwa sababu ya Babeli.
Ekegusii: Babiloni goika esirigwe, ekiagera yagerete Abaisraeli abange bagakwa, naende boigo yaitete abanto abange mono b’ense yonsi.”

English: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember Yahweh from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.”
Kiswahili: Wewe uliyepona upanga, ondoka wala usikawie! Mkumbuke Bwana ukiwa katika nchi ya mbali, na utafakari juu ya Yerusalemu.”
Ekegusii: “Inwe abamwatoorekire korwa ase emioro, genda, timobaisa goteebana. Mong’inyore inche Omonene, ekero more ase ense y’aare, moyorengererie mono Yerusalemu.

English: “We are confounded because we have heard reproach. Confusion has covered our faces, for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of Yahweh’s house.”
Kiswahili: “Tumetahayari, kwa maana tumetukanwa na aibu imefunika nyuso zetu, kwa sababu wageni wameingia mahali patakatifu pa nyumba ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Intwe twanyorire obosooku, ekiagera twabeire togochecherigwa. Obosooku bw’ogochaywa bwatubire amaiso aito, ekiagera abanto b’egesaku ekegeni basoire Aase Aachenu ime ye hekalu y’Omonene oito.

English: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will execute judgment on her engraved images; and through all her land the wounded will groan.
Kiswahili: “Lakini siku zinakuja,” asema Bwana, “nitakapoadhibu sanamu zake, na katika nchi yake yote waliojeruhiwa watalia kwa maumivu makali.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Ase engencho eyio, rora, amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndanachere emegwekano egosasimwa ya Babiloni ekiina na abanto bonsi baakirwe chingoma nababe bakonakweumia ase ense eyio yonsi.

English: Though Babylon should mount up to the sky, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet destroyers will come to her from me,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Hata kama Babeli ikifika angani na kuziimarisha ngome zake ndefu, nitatuma waharabu dhidi yake,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Babiloni, noisa gotiira gochia igoro, noisa kwegitera chindwaki chinkong’u, ne chintambe gochia igoro, inche nintome abagosiria bayosirie. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”

English: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!
Kiswahili: “Sauti ya kilio inasikika kutoka Babeli, sauti ya uharibifu mkuu kutoka nchi ya Wakaldayo.
Ekegusii: “Tegerera moigwe ekerero gekorwa Babiloni. Eriogi ri’ogosirigwa okonene riarure ase ense y’Abakalidayo.

English: For Yahweh lays Babylon waste, and destroys out of her the great voice! Their waves roar like many waters. The noise of their voice is uttered.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataiangamiza Babeli, atanyamazisha makelele ya kishindo chake. Mawimbi ya adui yatanguruma kama maji makuu, ngurumo ya sauti zao itavuma.
Ekegusii: Inche Omonene nasiririe Babiloni; nakiririe amariogi amanene arengeo. Emerindo egocha aroro nigo ekoeera buna amaache amange, eriogi riabo rinene nigo riraigugwe.

English: For the destroyer has come on her, even on Babylon. Her mighty men are taken. Their bows are broken in pieces, for Yahweh is a God of retribution. He will surely repay.
Kiswahili: Mharabu atakuja dhidi ya Babeli, mashujaa wake watakamatwa, nazo pinde zao zitavunjwa. Kwa kuwa Bwana ni Mungu wa kisasi, yeye atalipiza kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Abagosiria bachire gosiria Babiloni; abarwani baye chituoni bairirwe, amata abo abunirwe. Inche Omonene nigo inde Nyasae bw’ogoakana egesiomba, ekeene goika ngeakane kegima.

English: I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya maafisa wake na wenye busara walewe, watawala wao, maafisa, pamoja na wapiganaji wao; watalala milele na hawataamka,” asema Mfalme, ambaye jina lake ni Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Ninyoisie na gotindia abanene b’oborwoti bwa Babiloni na abanto baye abang’aini; na abagaambi baye, na abachiki baye, na abarwani baye chituoni. Barabwo mbaraare chitoro chintambe, tibaboka. Nabo inche omorwoti inde Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteeba.”

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire. The peoples will labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they will be weary.”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: “Ukuta mnene wa Babeli utasawazishwa, na malango yaliyoinuka yatateketezwa kwa moto; mataifa yanajichosha bure, taabu ya mataifa ni nishati tu ya miali ya moto.”
Ekegusii: Aya naro inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteeba: Chindwaki chinetu chia Babiloni nachiyerigwe inse, na ebiita biaye ebitambe gochia igoro mbisambwe nomorero. Emeremo abanto bagokora nebe bosa; ebisaku nigo bikwerosia bosa ase emeremo erasambwe nomorero.

English: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio ujumbe Yeremia aliompa afisa Seraya mwana wa Neria mwana wa Maaseya, alipokwenda Babeli pamoja na Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda, katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wake.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana Yeremia omobani achigete Seraya mosinto o Neria, omochokoro o Maaseya, ekero agendete Babiloni amo na Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia. Seraya nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’aase agotimokerwa.

English: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.
Kiswahili: Yeremia alikuwa ameandika ndani ya kitabu kuhusu maafa yote yatakayoipata Babeli, yaani yote yaliyokuwa yameandikwa kuhusu Babeli.
Ekegusii: Yeremia akarika ase egetabu obobe bwonsi bware gocha konyora Babiloni, amo namang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Babiloni.

English: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “When you come to Babylon, then see that you read all these words,
Kiswahili: Yeremia akamwambia Seraya, “Utakapofika Babeli, hakikisha kwamba umesoma maneno haya yote kwa sauti kubwa.
Ekegusii: Yeremia agateebia Seraya, “Ekero oraike Babiloni, orore ng’a gwasomire amang’ana aya onsi.

English: and say, ‘Yahweh, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that no one will dwell in it, neither man nor animal, but that it will be desolate forever.’
Kiswahili: Kisha sema, ‘Ee Bwana, umesema utaangamiza mahali hapa ili mtu wala mnyama asiishi ndani yake, napo patakuwa ukiwa milele.’
Ekegusii: Erio otebe: Aye Omonene gwateebire ng’a nosirie aase aiga kegima, gento kende tikemenyao, Mwanyabaanto gose ching’iti, na ense eye nesirigwe ebe erooro kogenderera botambe.

English: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.
Kiswahili: Utakapomaliza kusoma hiki kitabu, kifungie jiwe kisha ukitupe ndani ya Mto Frati.
Ekegusii: Na ekero gwakoorire gosoma egetabu eke, oyesiberanie rigena, oyerute ime ase orooche rw’Eufarati.

English: Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.’” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
Kiswahili: Kisha sema, ‘Hivi ndivyo Babeli utakavyozama na usiinuke tena, kwa sababu ya maafa nitakayoleta juu yake. Nao watu wake wataanguka.’ ” Maneno ya Yeremia yanaishia hapa.
Ekegusii: Erio otebe iga: Naboigo Babiloni erarimere, gochia inse, teimoka naende nonya ng’ake, ase engencho y’obobe nkorenta ase ense eyio, goika obwo bobagoyie.” Amang’ana a Yeremia aereire aiga.

English: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
Kiswahili: Sedekia alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na mmoja. Jina la mama yake aliitwa Hamutali binti Yeremia, kutoka Libna.
Ekegusii: Zedekia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere nomo, ekero aetwe oborwoti, akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Hamutali, mosubati o Yeremia, omonto korwa Libuna.

English: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
Kiswahili: Alifanya maovu machoni pa Bwana, kama alivyofanya Yehoyakimu.
Ekegusii: Zedekia oyio agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana buna aria onsi Yehoyakimu akorete.

English: For through Yahweh’s anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa ni kwa sababu ya hasira ya Bwana haya yote yalitokea Yerusalemu na Yuda, naye mwishoni akawaondoa mbele zake. Basi, Sedekia akaasi dhidi ya mfalme wa Babeli.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, endamwamu y’Omonene ase Yerusalemu na ase Abayuda nigo yagerete akabarusia ase obosio bwaye. Ase engaki eyio Zedekia akaanga koigwera omorwoti o Babiloni.

English: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.
Kiswahili: Hivyo katika mwaka wa tisa wa utawala wa Sedekia, katika siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa kumi, Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli akiwa na jeshi lake lote alifanya vita dhidi ya Yerusalemu. Wakapiga kambi nje ya mji na kuuzunguka mji pande zote.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kianda, rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi o ikomi bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, amo nabarwani baye bonsi b’esegi bagacha korwania Yerusalemu. Barabwo bakayonaaria na bakaagacha orwaki rw’ogwekengera rokayoetanana.

English: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
Kiswahili: Mji ulizungukwa na jeshi mpaka mwaka wa kumi na moja wa utawala wa Mfalme Sedekia.
Ekegusii: Igo omochie oria okaba onaaririe goika omwaka o ikomi nomo bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia omorwoti.

English: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
Kiswahili: Ilipowadia siku ya tisa ya mwezi wa nne, njaa ikazidi kuwa kali sana ndani ya mji, hadi hapakuwa na chakula kwa ajili ya watu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kianda ri’omotienyi o kane, enchera ekaba enene mono ase omochie oria ime, goika endagera akabora kegima ey’abaanto bakoria.

English: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden. Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around. The men of war went toward the Arabah,
Kiswahili: Kisha ukuta wa mji ukavunjwa na jeshi lote likakimbia. Wakaondoka mjini usiku kupitia lango lililokuwa kati ya kuta mbili karibu na bustani ya mfalme, ingawa Wakaldayo walikuwa wameuzunguka mji. Wakakimbia kuelekea Araba.
Ekegusii: Erio chindwaki chi’omochie chikabochorwa, na abanto bonsi b’esegi bagatama botuko, bagaetera ase egeita kiarenge gati‐gati ye chindwaki ibere, ang’e nomogondo bw’omorwoti, nonya Abakalidayo banaaretie omochie ase chinsemo chionsi. Bagatama gochia ase Ekerubo Ekiomo.

English: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
Kiswahili: Lakini jeshi la Wakaldayo likamfuatia Mfalme Sedekia na kumpata katika sehemu tambarare za Yeriko. Askari wake wote wakatengwa naye na kutawanyika,
Ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abakalidayo bakabwatia Zedekia omorwoti, bakamoikeera agwo ase ense omweya ya Yeriko, ekero abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi konya bamotigire na goserebekana.

English: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.
Kiswahili: naye akakamatwa. Akapelekwa kwa mfalme wa Babeli huko Ribla, katika nchi ya Hamathi, mahali ambapo alimtangazia hukumu.
Ekegusii: Erio bakabwata omorwoti oria, bakamoira ase omorwoti o Babiloni agwo ase omochie o Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati, na ere akamonachera ekiina.

English: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
Kiswahili: Huko Ribla mfalme wa Babeli aliwachinja wana wa Sedekia mbele ya macho yake. Pia akawaua maafisa wote wa Yuda.
Ekegusii: Agwo Ribula omorwoti oria agaita abana abamura ba Zedekia ase amaiso aye, agaita nabanene bonsi b’oborwoti bw’Abayuda.

English: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.
Kiswahili: Kisha akayangʼoa macho ya Sedekia, akamfunga kwa pingu za shaba na kumpeleka Babeli, alipomweka gerezani mpaka siku ya kifo chake.
Ekegusii: Naende agakonora amaiso a Zedekia, akamosiba nebinyuri, akamoira Babiloni, akamobeka ase echela, akamotiga aroro goika rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye.

English: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Mnamo siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa tano, katika mwaka wa kumi na tisa wa utawala wa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, Nebuzaradani jemadari wa askari walinzi wa mfalme, aliyemtumikia mfalme wa Babeli, alikuja Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi o gatano, ase omwaka o ikomi na kianda bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, Nebusaradani, oyorenge omoteneneri bw’abarendi na omosomba bw’omorwoti o Babiloni, agacha Yerusalemu.

English: He burned Yahweh’s house, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.
Kiswahili: Alichoma moto Hekalu la Bwana, jumba la kifalme, na nyumba zote za Yerusalemu. Aliteketeza kila jengo muhimu.
Ekegusii: Ere agasamba enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’Omorwoti, ne chinyomba chionsi chia Yerusalemu; agasamba kera enyomba enene.

English: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.
Kiswahili: Jeshi lote la Wakaldayo chini ya jemadari wa askari walinzi wa mfalme walivunja kuta zote zilizoizunguka Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Abarwani esegi bonsi b’Abakalidayo, na baria barenge amo nomoteneneri oria bw’abarendi, bagatagora chindwaki chionsi chiaetanaine Yerusalemu.

English: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who defected to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
Kiswahili: Nebuzaradani, jemadari wa askari walinzi, akawapeleka uhamishoni baadhi ya watu maskini sana na wale waliobaki katika mji, pamoja na mabaki ya watu wa kawaida, na wale waliojisalimisha kwa mfalme wa Babeli.
Ekegusii: Erio Nebusaradani, omoteneneri oria bw’abarendi, agoosa akaira ase obosomba abanto bande baria barenge abataka mono, amo nabaanto bande konya batigaire ase omochie; boigo akaira abanto baria konya batameire omorwoti o Babiloni bamokorere, akaira nabaroisia b’ebinto abatigarete.

English: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.
Kiswahili: Lakini Nebuzaradani akawaacha mabaki ya wale watu maskini kabisa ili watunze mashamba ya mizabibu na mashamba mengine.
Ekegusii: Korende Nebusaradani oria omoteneneri bw’abarendi agatiga abanto bande barenge abataka mono b’ense eria babeere aroro. Abwo bakaba bakoroiseria emegondo y’emesabibu na gokora emeremo y’okorema.

English: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh’s house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.
Kiswahili: Wakaldayo walivunja vipande zile nguzo za shaba, vile vishikilio vya shaba vilivyohamishika, na ile Bahari ya shaba, ambavyo vyote vilikuwa katika Hekalu la Bwana. Hivyo wakaichukua hiyo shaba yote na kuipeleka Babeli.
Ekegusii: Abakalidayo bakabuna chisiiro chie chitaai chiria chiarenge ime ase enyomba y’Omonene, na ebibekerero bi’ebituba, na egetuba keria ekenene mono kiaroisirie korwa ase etai ebiarenge ase enyomba y’Omonene. Kobabibunire bikaba ebing’ese, bakaira etai eria yonsi Babiloni.

English: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.
Kiswahili: Wakachukua pia vyungu, masepetu, mikasi ya kusawazishia tambi, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, sahani na vyombo vyote vya shaba vilivyotumika katika huduma ya Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Boigo bakaira chindogio, na ebichiko, na ebiinachi, ne chisani, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, na ebikorero bionsi bie chitaai biarenge gokorerwa emeremo ase Hekalu.

English: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, as gold, and that which was of silver, as silver.
Kiswahili: Jemadari wa askari walinzi wa mfalme akachukua yale masinia, vile vyetezo, yale mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, zile sufuria, vile vinara vya taa, zile sahani na yale mabakuli yaliyotumika kwa sadaka za vinywaji, vitu vyote vile vilivyokuwa vimetengenezwa kwa dhahabu safi au fedha.
Ekegusii: Bakaira ne chibakuria chinke, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero, ne chisani, ne chinyongo, na ebibekerero bie chitaaya, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, na ebikombe bi’okoruerwa kw’ebinyugwa. Omoteneneri oria bw’abarendi akaira ebinto bionsi bie chitaabu chichenire, na ebie chifeta chichenire.

English: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.
Kiswahili: Shaba iliyotokana na zile nguzo mbili, ile Bahari na wale mafahali kumi na mawili wa shaba waliokuwa chini yake, pamoja na vile vishikilio vilivyohamishika, ambavyo Mfalme Solomoni alikuwa ametengeneza kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Bwana, ilikuwa na uzito usioweza kupimika.
Ekegusii: Oborito bwe chitaai chiaroisetie chisiiro chiria ibere, na egetuba keria ekenene mono, na emegwekano ye chieri ikomi na ebere yeroisirie korwa ase chitaai eyio yaimokereretie egetuba keria igoro, amo nebibekerero bionsi biria Sulemani omorwoti aroisetie ase enyomba y’Omonene, nigo bwaetanetie ekerengo.

English: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.
Kiswahili: Kila nguzo ilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa kumi na nane, kimo chake na mzunguko dhiraa kumi na mbili, na unene wa nyanda nne, na zote zilikuwa wazi ndani.
Ekegusii: Kera eyemo ye chisiiro chiria nigo yarenge nobotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na atano na atato, na engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na abere ekayeetanana. Nigo yaroisetigwe buna omobirangwa na obonetu bw’etai yaroisetie omobirangwa oria nigo bwarenge obogare bw’ebiara bine.

English: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates.
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya shaba juu ya ile nguzo moja ilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa tano, na ilikuwa imepambwa kwa wavu na makomamanga ya shaba kuizunguka kote. Ile nguzo nyingine pamoja na makomamanga yake ilifanana na hiyo ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Na igoro ase kera esiiro, egesure nkiarengeo kiaroiseirie etai, na obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano. Egechanga na emegwekano y’amatunda amakomomanga biaroisirie korwa ase chitaai, nigo biaetanaine egesure keria.

English: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na makomamanga tisini na sita pembeni; jumla ya makomamanga juu ya wavu uliokuwa umezunguka yalikuwa mia moja.
Ekegusii: Ase chinsemo chiaye narengeo amakomomanga emerongo kianda, na atano na rimo. Amakomomanga onsi arenge igoro ase egesure ekemo ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi nigo arenge rigana erimo.

English: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold,
Kiswahili: Yule jemadari wa askari walinzi akawachukua kama wafungwa Seraya kuhani mkuu, kuhani Sefania aliyefuata kwa cheo, na mabawabu watatu.
Ekegusii: Omoteneneri oria bw’abarendi akaira Seraya, Omokuani omonene, na Safania, Omokuani o kabere, na abarendi b’egesieri batato.

English: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwa wale watu waliokuwa wamesalia katika mji, alimchukua afisa kiongozi wa wapiganaji, na washauri saba wa mfalme. Akamchukua pia mwandishi aliyesimamia uandikishaji wa watu wa nchi, pamoja na watu wake sitini waliopatikana ndani ya mji.
Ekegusii: Naende akaira korwa ase omochie oria omonto oyomo orenge omochiki bw’abasikari, na abanto batano na babere b’ekegambero ki’omorwoti, abanyoretwe ase omochie ime, na omoriki bw’omochiki oria bw’abasikari, oria orenge gokora omobaro bw’abaanto b’ense eria, amo nabaanto emerongo etano nomo b’ense eria, abanyorekanete ase omochie ime.

English: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.
Kiswahili: Huko Ribla, katika nchi ya Hamathi, mfalme wa Babeli akaamuru wanyongwe. Hivyo Yuda wakaenda utumwani, mbali na nchi yao.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti o Babiloni akabaita bagakwera agwo Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati. Ase igo Abayuda bakarusigwa ase ense yabo, bakairwa ase obosomba.

English: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews;
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo hesabu ya watu ambao Nebukadneza aliwachukua kwenda uhamishoni: katika mwaka wa saba, Wayahudi 3,023;
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’abaanto Nebukadinesaro airete ase obosomba: ase omwaka o gatano na kabere akaira Abayahudi chilifu isato, na emerongo ebere, na batato (3,023).

English: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;
Kiswahili: katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa utawala wa Nebukadneza, watu 832 kutoka Yerusalemu;
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato. Nebukadinesaro akaira korwa Yerusalemu abanto amagana atano na atato, na emerongo etato na babere (832).

English: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five people. All the people numbered four thousand six hundred.
Kiswahili: katika mwaka wa ishirini na tatu wa utawala wake, Wayahudi 745 walichukuliwa kwenda uhamishoni na Nebuzaradani jemadari wa askari walinzi wa mfalme. Jumla ya watu wote walikuwa 4,600.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na gatato, bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro Nebusaradani, omoteneneri bw’abarendi, akaira Abayahudi amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ene na batano (745); bonsi Abanto abairetwe nigo barenge chilifu inye, na amagana atano na rimo (4,600).

English: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba tangu Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda apelekwe uhamishoni, katika mwaka ule ambao Evil-Merodaki alifanyika mfalme wa Babeli, alimwacha huru Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda, na kumfungua kutoka gerezani siku ya ishirini na tano ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato netano nebere (37) korwa Yehoyakini omorwoti o Yuda airetwe obosomba ase ense ya Babiloni ase omotienyi o ikomi na kabere (12) chitariki emerongo ebere na isano (25), Omorwoti Ewili Merodaki o Babiloni ase omwaka oria achagete kogamba akarorera Yehoyakini Omorwoti o Yuda amaabera akamorusia echera.

English: He spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,
Kiswahili: Alizungumza naye kwa upole na kumpa kiti cha heshima zaidi kuliko wale wafalme wengine aliokuwa nao huko Babeli.
Ekegusii: Ewili‐Merodaki agakwana amang’ana ’obwororo nere, naende akamoa amasikani amanene kobua ayio aete abarwoti bande barenge amo nere agwo Babiloni.

English: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yehoyakini akayavua mavazi yake ya mfungwa, na siku zote za maisha yake zilizobaki alikula mezani mwa mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Yehoyakini akaonchoreria chianga chiaye chi’obosibwa, na kera rituko ase obogima bwaye bwonsi akaba okoragera nomorwoti.

English: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
Kiswahili: Siku kwa siku mfalme wa Babeli alimpa Yehoyakini posho siku zote za maisha yake, hadi siku ya kifo chake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akamoa endagera yaye botambe na kera egento arenge kogania ase kera rituko ase obogima bwaye bwonsi goika ekero ki’ogokwa kwaye.

English: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people! She has become as a widow, who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi mji ulivyoachwa ukiwa, mji ambao zamani ulikuwa umejaa watu! Jinsi ambavyo umekuwa kama mama mjane, ambaye wakati fulani alikuwa maarufu miongoni mwa mataifa! Yule ambaye alikuwa malkia miongoni mwa majimbo sasa amekuwa mtumwa.
Ekegusii: Naki omochie oyo otigaire bosa, oyio orenge oichire n’abanto! Naki otigaire buna omokungu omotakanwa oyio orenge omonene ase egati y’ebisaku! Oyio orenge buna eting’ana ase egati-gati y’emechie, bono obeire omosomba ase emechie ende.

English: She weeps bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her. They have become her enemies.
Kiswahili: Kwa uchungu, hulia sana usiku, machozi yapo kwenye mashavu yake. Miongoni mwa wapenzi wake wote hakuna yeyote wa kumfariji. Rafiki zake wote wamemsaliti, wamekuwa adui zake.
Ekegusii: Nigo okorera nobororo botuko bokia, na amariga nigo agoiteka ase chimboto chiaye; ase abanchi baye bonsi onde tari okomoremia; abasani baye bamong’ainire, babeire ababisa baye.

English: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude. She dwells among the nations. She finds no rest. All her persecutors overtook her in her distress.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mateso na kufanyishwa kazi kikatili, Yuda amekwenda uhamishoni. Anakaa miongoni mwa mataifa, hapati mahali pa kupumzika. Wote ambao wanamsaka wamemkamata katikati ya dhiki yake.
Ekegusii: Abayuda bairirwe ase obosomba, babeire nemechando na obokong’u batari gotimoka. Nigo bamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku; abakobabwatia baabaikereire kobare nemechando.

English: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.
Kiswahili: Barabara zielekeazo Sayuni zaomboleza, kwa kuwa hakuna yeyote anayekuja kwenye sikukuu zake zilizoamriwa. Malango yake yote yamekuwa ukiwa, makuhani wake wanalia kwa uchungu, wanawali wake wanahuzunika, naye yuko katika uchungu wa maumivu makuu.
Ekegusii: Chinchera chikogenda Sayoni nigo chiichanete, ekiagera onde tari ogocha ase Amatuko Amanene achiikire; ebiita biaye bionsi nigo bitigarete bosa, na abakuani baye bonsi nigo baichanete. Abaiseke baye abekungi nigo baumatete, na omochie omonyene nigo ore nobororo obonge.

English: Her adversaries have become the head. Her enemies prosper; for Yahweh has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions. Her young children have gone into captivity before the adversary.
Kiswahili: Adui zake wamekuwa mabwana zake, watesi wake wana raha. Bwana amemletea huzuni kwa sababu ya dhambi zake nyingi. Watoto wake wamekwenda uhamishoni, mateka mbele ya adui.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baye babeire abanene baye, ee, ababisa baye nigo bagendererete goseseneka. Omonene oyotomeire emechando ase engencho y’ogosaria kwaye okonge, na ababisa baye bairire abana baye ase obosomba.

English: All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion. Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture. They have gone without strength before the pursuer.
Kiswahili: Fahari yote imeondoka kutoka kwa Binti Sayuni. Wakuu wake wako kama ayala ambaye hapati malisho, katika udhaifu wamekimbia mbele ya anayewasaka.
Ekegusii: Ogosikwa gwonsi kwarure ase abanto ba Sayoni; abagaambi baye babeire buna chingabi chitabwati ase chikorisia; batamire korwa ase abakobabwatia, tibari ne chinguru.

English: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her. The adversaries saw her. They mocked at her desolations.
Kiswahili: Katika siku za mateso yake na kutangatanga, Yerusalemu hukumbuka hazina zote ambazo zilikuwa zake siku za kale. Wakati watu wake walipoanguka katika mikono ya adui, hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kumsaidia. Watesi wake walimtazama na kumcheka katika maangamizi yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto ba Yerusalemu baarenge nemechando na obokong’u, bakaba bakoinyora ebinto ebiya mono baarenge nabio ase amatuko a kare. Agwo ekero bagwete ase amaboko y’abachandi, onde tarenge ore kobakonya, abachandi babo bakobachecheria ase engencho y’okogwa kwabo.

English: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.
Kiswahili: Yerusalemu ametenda dhambi sana kwa hiyo amekuwa najisi. Wote waliomheshimu wanamdharau, kwa maana wameuona uchi wake. Yeye mwenyewe anapiga kite na kugeukia mbali.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Yerusalemu bakorire ebibe ebinene; ase ayio babeire okogechia, bonsi abaabasigete baabachayire, ekiagera barorire obogetirianda bwabo. Ee, omochie omonyene nkweumia ore, bweonchoire gochia magega.

English: Her filthiness was in her skirts. She didn’t remember her latter end. Therefore she has come down astoundingly. She has no comforter. “See, Yahweh, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.”
Kiswahili: Uchafu wake umegandamana na nguo zake; hakuwaza juu ya maisha yake ya baadaye. Anguko lake lilikuwa la kushangaza, hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kumfariji. “Tazama, Ee Bwana, teso langu, kwa maana adui ameshinda.”
Ekegusii: Riko riaye nigo riarenge ase chianga chiaye, tarengereretie igoro y’omoerio oye. Ase ayio okogwa kwaye gokaba ogw’okoondokia, tarenge nonde okomoremia. “Aye Omonene, rigereria emechando yane, ekiagera omobisa one ngwetogia are!”

English: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly.
Kiswahili: Adui ametia mikono juu ya hazina zake zote, aliona mataifa ya kipagani wakiingia mahali patakatifu pake, wale uliowakataza kuingia kwenye kusanyiko lako.
Ekegusii: Omobisa oyio oramboire amaboko aye gochia gosakora ebinto bionsi bi’erigori rinene bire ase omochie ime; ee, omochie oyio ororire abanto b’ebisaku bagosoa Aase aye Aachenu, agwo aye Omonene gwakanete ng’a tibasoa ase omosangererekano oo.

English: All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. “Look, Yahweh, and see, for I have become despised.”
Kiswahili: Watu wake wote wanalia kwa uchungu watafutapo chakula; wanabadilisha hazina zao kwa chakula ili waweze kuendelea kuishi. “Tazama, Ee Bwana, ufikiri, kwa maana nimedharauliwa.”
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’omochie nigo baumatete, ekero barigereretie endagera; barabwo baoonirie chinibo chiabo bagore endagera barie, erinde banyore chinguru. “Aye Omonene, koranche ondigererie, ekiagera nachayirwe.”

English: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, with which Yahweh has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
Kiswahili: “Je, si kitu kwenu, ninyi nyote mpitao kando? Angalieni kote mwone. Je, kuna maumivu kama maumivu yangu yale yaliyotiwa juu yangu, yale Bwana aliyoyaleta juu yangu katika siku ya hasira yake kali?
Ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe mwensi aba mogoeta inchera aa, aya nigo are amang’ana abosa ase more? Rigereria morore gose emechando ende ere buna eyane, eyio yarentetwe ase ’nde, eyi’Omonene andeterete, ekero arenge n’endamwamu ekobera.

English: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has turned me back. He has made me desolate and I faint all day long.
Kiswahili: “Kutoka juu alipeleka moto, akaushusha katika mifupa yangu. Aliitandia wavu miguu yangu na akanirudisha nyuma. Akanifanya mkiwa, na mdhaifu mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: “Otomire omorero korwa igoro osambire amauga aane oyabuire, otegire oboreba ase amagoro aane; ong’iranirie magega; ontigire inde bosa, ntari ne chinguru nde n’obororo omobaso boira.

English: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.
Kiswahili: “Dhambi zangu zimefungwa kwenye nira, kwa mikono yake zilifumwa pamoja. Zimefika shingoni mwangu na Bwana ameziondoa nguvu zangu. Amenitia mikononi mwa wale ambao siwezi kushindana nao.
Ekegusii: “Nigo abarete amamocho aane onsi akayasangereria amo akayasiba ase ebigoti biane buna rikorogoto, na ase enchera eyio akang’uura chinguru ase oborito bwaye. Omonene nigo ambegete ase amaboko ay’abwo ntanyare kobua.

English: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me. He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men. The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press.
Kiswahili: “Bwana amewakataa wapiganaji wa vita wote walio kati yangu, ameagiza jeshi dhidi yangu kuwaponda vijana wangu wa kiume. Katika shinikizo lake la divai Bwana amemkanyaga Bikira Binti Yuda.
Ekegusii: “Omonene bwangire abanto bonsi chituoni, abamenyete ime yane, orangeirie omosangererekano bw’abaanto, erinde osenyente abamura bane. Abayuda abwo banga buna omoiseke omwekuungi, Omonene obatiringeire inse, babeire buna amasabibu agotiringwa ase ekemitero.

English: “For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me. My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.”
Kiswahili: “Hii ndiyo sababu ninalia na macho yangu yanafurika machozi. Hakuna yeyote aliye karibu kunifariji, hakuna yeyote wa kuhuisha roho yangu. Watoto wangu ni wakiwa kwa sababu adui ameshinda.”
Ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’amang’ana aya nigo nkorera, amaiso aane nigo akoiyeria amariga, oyio okondemia nigo are aare korwa ase ’nde, oyio okong’a chinguru chinyia; abana bane batigaire bare boka, ekiagera ababisa bane bambuire.”

English: Zion spreads out her hands. There is no one to comfort her. Yahweh has commanded concerning Jacob, that those who are around him should be his adversaries. Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.
Kiswahili: Sayuni ananyoosha mikono yake, lakini hakuna yeyote wa kumfariji. Bwana ametoa amri kwa ajili ya Yakobo kwamba majirani zake wawe adui zake; Yerusalemu umekuwa kitu najisi miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Sayoni basamunsire amaboko abo, korende onde tari okobaremia. Omonene ochikiire igoro y’abanto ba Yakobo ng’a abanto abwo baabaetananire babe ababisa babo; Yerusalemu obeire okogechia ase bare.

English: “Yahweh is righteous, for I have rebelled against his commandment. Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow. My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.
Kiswahili: “Bwana ni mwenye haki, hata hivyo niliasi dhidi ya amri yake. Sikilizeni, enyi mataifa yote, tazameni maumivu yangu. Wavulana wangu na wasichana wangu wamekwenda uhamishoni.
Ekegusii: Omonene nomonyene oboronge, nonya naboigo inche tinyigwereti amachiiko aye. Inwe abanto bonsi, tegerera moigwe, morigererie emechando yane, abaiseke bane abekungi, na abamura bane, boosirwe na koirwa ase obosomba.

English: “I called for my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls.
Kiswahili: “Niliita washirika wangu lakini walinisaliti. Makuhani wangu na wazee wangu waliangamia mjini walipokuwa wakitafuta chakula ili waweze kuishi.
Ekegusii: “Inche nkarangeria abanchi bane ng’a bankonye, korende bakang’aina; abakuani bane na abagaaka bagakwera ase omochie ime, ekero baarenge korigia endagera barie banyore chinguru chinyia.

English: “Look, Yahweh; for I am in distress. My heart is troubled. My heart turns over within me, for I have grievously rebelled. Abroad, the sword bereaves. At home, it is like death.
Kiswahili: “Angalia, Ee Bwana, jinsi nilivyo katika dhiki! Nina maumivu makali ndani yangu, nami ninahangaika moyoni mwangu, kwa kuwa nimekuwa mwasi sana. Huko nje, upanga unaua watu, ndani, kipo kifo tu.
Ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, rigereria buna inde ase emechando, omoyo one oonchokanire, na enkoro yane yaonchoranirwe, ekiagera nabeire oyo otari omoigweri. Abana bane baitirwe nemioro ase chinchera, na amakweri abeire ase enka yane.

English: “They have heard that I sigh. There is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble. They are glad that you have done it. You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they will be like me.
Kiswahili: “Watu wamesikia ninavyolia kwa uchungu, lakini hakuna yeyote wa kunifariji. Adui zangu wote wamesikia juu ya dhiki yangu, wanafurahia lile ulilolitenda. Naomba uilete siku uliyoitangaza ili wawe kama mimi.
Ekegusii: “Abanto baigure buna ng’umatete, na onde tari nonya noyomo okondemia. Ababisa bane bonsi baigure igoro y’emechando yane, bagokire ng’a naye gwakorire aya. Renta rituko riria gwateebete ng’a orarente, na barabwo babe buna inche.

English: “Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
Kiswahili: “Uovu wao wote na uje mbele zako; uwashughulikie wao kama vile ulivyonishughulikia mimi kwa sababu ya dhambi zangu zote. Kulia kwangu kwa uchungu ni kwingi na moyo wangu umedhoofika.”
Ekegusii: “Tiga obobe bwabo bwonsi bororekane ase obosio bwao, obae egesusuro; buna kwang’ete inche ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nigo ng’umatete mono, na enkoro yane yanyarekire.”

English: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the earth, and hasn’t remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi Bwana alivyomfunika Binti Sayuni kwa wingu la hasira yake! Ameitupa chini fahari ya Israeli kutoka mbinguni mpaka duniani, hakukumbuka kiti chake cha kuwekea miguu katika siku ya hasira yake.
Ekegusii: Naki Omonene atubire omochie o Sayoni nomosunte, ekero arenge n’endamwamu! Otugutire obonene bokomeka‐meka bw’Abaisraeli korwa igoro gocha inse aa. Ere tainyoreti egeteni ki’amagoro aye, ase rituko ri’endamwamu yaye.

English: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity. He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.
Kiswahili: Bila huruma Bwana ameyameza makao yote ya Yakobo; katika ghadhabu yake amebomoa ngome za Binti Yuda. Ameuangusha ufalme wake na wakuu wake chini kwa aibu.
Ekegusii: Omonene oiyeirie inse obomenyo bwonsi bw’abaanto ba Yakobo atari namaabera, otagoire chiburi chi’ense y’Abayuda, ekero arenge nendamwamu; osiririe oborwoti, na ourire abanene baye amasikani.

English: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger. He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy. He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around.
Kiswahili: Katika hasira kali amevunja kila pembe ya Israeli. Ameuondoa mkono wake wa kuume alipokaribia adui. Amemteketeza Yakobo kama moto uwakao ule uteketezao kila kitu kinachouzunguka.
Ekegusii: Obutoire ching’unchara chionsi chi’Abaisraeli ore nendamwamu yaye entindi, orusirie okoboko kwaye gw’okorio korwa ase bare ase amasio ’ababisa babo: ere osambire abanto ba Yakobo buna omorero ekebemberi ogosamba ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his wrath like fire.
Kiswahili: Ameupinda upinde wake kama adui, mkono wake wa kuume uko tayari. Kama vile adui amewachinja wote waliokuwa wanapendeza jicho, amemwaga ghadhabu yake kama moto juu ya hema la Binti Sayuni.
Ekegusii: Ere otingire obota bwaye buna omobisa agotinga, otenenire na kobong’usa nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio buna omochandi; agaita bonsi aba twetogeretie. Igoro y’obomenyo bw’abaanto ba Sayoni, oumoire ekeririanda kiaye kere buna omorero.

English: The Lord has become as an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed his strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation in the daughter of Judah.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni kama adui; amemmeza Israeli. Amemeza majumba yake yote ya kifalme na kuangamiza ngome zake. Ameongeza huzuni na maombolezo kwa ajili ya Binti Yuda.
Ekegusii: Omonene obeire buna omobisa, osiririe Abaisraeli; osiririe chinyomba chiaye chionsi chi’oborwoti, otagoire chiburi chiaye chinkong’u; naende omenteire abanto ba Yuda okorera na okweumia.

English: He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were a garden. He has destroyed his place of assembly. Yahweh has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion. In the indignation of his anger, he has despised the king and the priest.
Kiswahili: Ameharibu maskani yake kama bustani, ameharibu mahali pake pa mkutano. Bwana amemfanya Sayuni kusahau sikukuu zake zilizoamriwa na Sabato zake; katika hasira yake kali amewadharau mfalme na kuhani.
Ekegusii: Ere oiyeirie inse orobago rwaye rore buna orw’omogondo, ee, osaririe aase emesangererekano y’ogosasiima ekobeera. Omonene otigire abanto bebire Amatuko Amanene ne Chisabato agwo Sayoni, na ase okogechigwa kwaye okonene bwangire omorwoti na Omokuani.

English: The Lord has cast off his altar. He has abhorred his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in Yahweh’s house, as in the day of a solemn assembly.
Kiswahili: Bwana amekataa madhabahu yake na kuacha mahali patakatifu pake. Amemkabidhi adui kuta za majumba yake ya kifalme; wamepiga kelele katika nyumba ya Bwana kama katika siku ya sikukuu iliyoamriwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene bwangire egesasiimero kiaye, otigire Aase aye Aachenu asarigwe; otigire chindwaki chiaye ase amaboko ’ababisa. Abanto bakuurire ime ase enyomba y’Omonene, buna nase rituko ri’omosangererekano bw’ogosasiima.

English: Yahweh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out the line. He has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall lament. They languish together.
Kiswahili: Bwana alikusudia kuangusha ukuta uliomzunguka Binti Sayuni. Ameinyoosha kamba ya kupimia na hakuuzuia mkono wake usiangamize. Alifanya maboma na kuta ziomboleze, vyote vikaharibika pamoja.
Ekegusii: Omonene onachire ase ebirengererio biaye gosaria chindwaki chi’omochie o Sayoni, oramboire engori y’okorengera. Tagotanga okoboko kwaye tayosaria; otigire chiburi ne chindwaki chikweumia, chionsi amo nigo chiumatete.

English: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Malango yake yamezama ardhini, makomeo yake ameyavunja na kuyaharibu. Mfalme wake na wakuu wake wamepelekwa uhamishoni miongoni mwa mataifa, sheria haipo tena, na manabii wake hawapati tena maono kutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ebiita biaye biarimeire ase riroba, emekorogoto yaye yabunirwe na gosarigwa. Omorwoti oye, na abagaambi baye, nigo bamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku bitabwati amachiiko, na ababani baye tibari konyora amaroro korwa ase Omonene.

English: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
Kiswahili: Wazee wa Binti Sayuni wanaketi chini kimya, wamenyunyiza mavumbi kwenye vichwa vyao na kuvaa nguo za gunia. Wanawali wa Yerusalemu wamesujudu hadi ardhini.
Ekegusii: Abagaaka b’omochie o Sayoni nigo baikaransete inse bakirete‐kiri, besiarerete ebuse ase emetwe yabo na kweboyia chigunia, abaiseke abekungi ba Yerusalemu nigo baturegete emetwe yabo gochia inse.

English: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yamedhoofika kwa kulia, nina maumivu makali ndani, moyo wangu umemiminwa ardhini kwa sababu watu wangu wameangamizwa, kwa sababu watoto na wanyonyao wanazimia kwenye barabara za mji.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoiyeria amariga, omoyo one oonchokanire, na enkoro yane yachandekire ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’omochie bw’abaanto bane, ekiagera abana, nonya nabakogonka, nigo bakona‐kogireka ase chinchera chi’omochie.

English: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
Kiswahili: Wanawaambia mama zao, “Wapi mkate na divai?” wazimiapo kama watu waliojeruhiwa katika barabara za mji, maisha yao yadhoofikavyo mikononi mwa mama zao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakoboria abang’ina: “Ng’ai endagera ere, na edivai?” Nigo bakona‐kogireka na korara ase chinchera chi’omochie buna abaakirwe chingoma, batweka mo ase amaboko ’abang’ina.

English: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?
Kiswahili: Ninaweza kusema nini kwa ajili yako? Nikulinganishe na nini, ee Binti Yerusalemu? Nitakufananisha na nini, ili nipate kukufariji, ee Bikira Binti Sayuni? Jeraha lako lina kina kama bahari. Ni nani awezaye kukuponya?
Ekegusii: Aye omochie o Yerusalemu, ninki ndagoteebie? Ninki ndakoreng’anie? Mang’ana ki anga buna ayao ndagoteebie, erinde nkoremie, aye Sayoni ore buna omoiseke omwekuungi? Ogosarigwa kwao nokonene buna enyancha ere enene, ning’o oranyare gokogwenia?

English: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.
Kiswahili: Maono ya manabii wako yalikuwa ya uongo na yasiyofaa kitu, hawakuifunua dhambi yako ili kukuzuilia kwenda utumwani. Maneno waliyokupa yalikuwa ya uongo na ya kupotosha.
Ekegusii: Abaabani bao nigo bakobarorera amaroro ’obong’ainereria are bosa, tibakoorokeretie obobe bwao, erinde nario orairanerigwe amaya ao; korende aya amaroro abo ayakworogetie, nigo arenge ay’oborimo, agerete ogatantanigwa.

English: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth’?”
Kiswahili: Wote wapitiao njia yako wanakupigia makofi, wanakudhihaki na kutikisa vichwa vyao kwa Binti Yerusalemu: “Huu ndio ule mji ulioitwa mkamilifu wa uzuri, furaha ya dunia yote?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagoeta inchera nigo bagoaka chinkobi ase okogochaaya, nigo bakobugia emeroria na gosingiseria omochie o Yerusalemu emetwe, bakobora: “Inee! Omochie oyio noro orenge korokwa omoikeranu bw’obosiani, na omogooko bw’ense yonsi?”

English: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up. Certainly this is the day that we looked for. We have found it. We have seen it.”
Kiswahili: Adui zako wote wanapanua vinywa vyao dhidi yako, wanadhihaki na kusaga meno yao na kusema, “Tumemmeza. Hii ndiyo siku tuliyoingojea, tumeishi na kuiona.”
Ekegusii: Ababisa bao bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gokobugeria emeroria na gokoriananeria amaino, bakobora: “Twayosaririe! Ee, rituko eri nario twaganetie, bono twariikeire, twarirorire!”

English: Yahweh has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
Kiswahili: Bwana amefanya lile alilolipanga; ametimiza neno lake aliloliamuru siku za kale. Amekuangusha bila huruma, amewaacha adui wakusimange, ametukuza pembe ya adui yako.
Ekegusii: Omonene okorire aya achiigete ng’a ayakore, oikeranirie ring’ana riaye aroberetie agwo kare, otagoire atari namaabera, otigire ababisa bao bagochenga igoro yao, ere okinirie ching’unchara chi’ababisa bao.

English: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.
Kiswahili: Mioyo ya watu inamlilia Bwana. Ee ukuta wa Binti Sayuni, machozi yako na yatiririke kama mto usiku na mchana; usijipe nafuu, macho yako yasipumzike.
Ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chikorera ase Omonene. Ee, aye orwaki rw’omochie o Sayoni, tiga amariga ao aiteke buna orooche, omobaso na obotuko! Tobaisa korosa, gose gotimokia amaiso ao.

English: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.
Kiswahili: Inuka, lia usiku, zamu za usiku zianzapo; mimina moyo wako kama maji mbele za Bwana. Mwinulie yeye mikono yako kwa ajili ya maisha ya watoto wako, ambao wanazimia kwa njaa kwenye kila mwanzo wa barabara.
Ekegusii: Imoka, orere botuko bokie! Ekero oborendi bw’obotuko bogochaka, oumore ayare ase enkoro yao ime ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna okoumora amaache! Rambora amaboko ao asare osabere obogima bw’abana bao, abwo bagoyire nenchara ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.

English: “Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
Kiswahili: “Tazama, Ee Bwana, ufikirie: Ni nani ambaye umepata kumtendea namna hii? Je, wanawake wakule wazao wao, watoto waliowalea? Je, kuhani na nabii auawe mahali patakatifu pa Bwana?
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, rigereria orore! Ning’o gwakorerete buna ayio? Inee! Abakungu mbarie oroiboro rwabo, abana abwo barerete ase amaboko abo? Inee! Abakuani na ababani mbaiterwe agwo Aase Aachenu a Omonene?

English: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of your anger. You have slaughtered, and not pitied.
Kiswahili: “Vijana na wazee hujilaza pamoja katika mavumbi ya barabarani, wavulana wangu na wasichana wameanguka kwa upanga. Umewaua katika siku ya hasira yako, umewachinja bila huruma.
Ekegusii: Abamura na abagaaka nigo baraire ase chinchera inse, abaiseke bane, na abamura bane, baitirwe nemioro; ase rituko ri’endamwamu yao kwabaitire otari namaabera.

English: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of Yahweh’s anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.
Kiswahili: “Kama ulivyoita siku ya karamu, ndivyo ulivyoagiza hofu kuu dhidi yangu kila upande. Katika siku ya hasira ya Bwana hakuna yeyote aliyekwepa au kupona; wale niliowatunza na kuwalea, adui yangu amewaangamiza.”
Ekegusii: Buna ase rituko ri’omoyega omonene okarangeria ababisa bane bakanyoboyia korwa chinsemo chionsi; ase rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene onde tatooregete, gose gotigara, ase abwo nabogoretie na kobareera. Ababisa bane baabasiririe.

English: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
Kiswahili: Mimi ndiye mtu aliyeona mateso kwa fimbo ya ghadhabu yake.
Ekegusii: Inche nomonto narorire emechando inse y’endamwamu y’Omonene ere buna enyimbo.

English: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
Kiswahili: Amenifukuzia mbali na kunifanya nitembee gizani wala si katika nuru;
Ekegusii: Ontang’anire na kong’etia ase omosunte, gose tari ase omobaso

English: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
Kiswahili: hakika, amegeuza mkono wake dhidi yangu tena na tena, mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, nigo akona‐koonchora okoboko kwaye igoro yane, ekero ase ekero omobaso boira.

English: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
Kiswahili: Amefanya ngozi yangu na nyama yangu kuchakaa na ameivunja mifupa yangu.
Ekegusii: Otigire chinyama chi’omobere one, ne risankwa, bigosareka; obunire amauga aane.

English: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
Kiswahili: Amenizingira na kunizunguka kwa uchungu na taabu.
Ekegusii: Onsibire ase eburi ime na ong’etananeirie obororo na obokong’u.

English: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
Kiswahili: Amenifanya niishi gizani kama wale waliokufa.
Ekegusii: Ombekire imenye ase omosunte, buna abanto baria bakwete kare.

English: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
Kiswahili: Amenizungushia ukuta ili nisiweze kutoroka, amenifunga kwa minyororo mizito.
Ekegusii: Onsiekeire ase chinsemo chionsi, tinkonyara gosoka; onsibeire ebinyuri ebirito.

English: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
Kiswahili: Hata ninapoita au kulia ili kuomba msaada, anakataa kupokea maombi yangu.
Ekegusii: Nonya nkorera neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe, ere bwangire koigwa ogosaba kwane.

English: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
Kiswahili: Ameizuia njia yangu kwa mapande ya mawe, amepotosha njia zangu.
Ekegusii: Oribirie chinchera chiane namagena abaachire, oonchoranire oboeto bwane.

English: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.
Kiswahili: Kama dubu aviziaye, kama simba mafichoni,
Ekegusii: Nigo amboerete buna edubu, enyang’au entindi, ekoboera, na buna endo eboerete eite.

English: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.
Kiswahili: ameniburuta kutoka njia, akanirarua na kuniacha bila msaada.
Ekegusii: Oonchoranire chinchera chiane na kombutorana ebing’ese, ontigire ntang’ang’ete bosa.

English: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
Kiswahili: Amevuta upinde wake na kunifanya mimi niwe lengo kwa ajili ya mishale yake.
Ekegusii: Otingire obota bwaye, na ombekire imbe ekerenga akoruta chinsara.

English: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
Kiswahili: Alinichoma moyo wangu kwa mishale iliyotoka kwenye podo lake.
Ekegusii: Ere ondasire ne chinsara chi’egochi yaye, chiasoire ase chinyigo chiane.

English: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa kichekesho kwa watu wangu wote, wananidhihaki kwa wimbo mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire oyo ogosekererwa nabaanto bane bonsi, na engeero y’ogochaaya kwabo omobaso boira.

English: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
Kiswahili: Amenijaza kwa majani machungu na kunishibisha kwa nyongo.
Ekegusii: Ong’ichoirie nobororo, ong’eire ekenyugwa ekeroro nanyure.

English: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
Kiswahili: Amevunja meno yangu kwa changarawe, amenikanyagia mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Obunire amaino aane ase ogontakunia chinche chi’amagena, ontubire neribu.

English: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
Kiswahili: Amani yangu imeondolewa, nimesahau kufanikiwa ni nini.
Ekegusii: Aye kwarusirie omorembe ase omoyo one, na inche nebire ayare ay’omogooko.

English: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nasema, “Fahari yangu imeondoka na yale yote niliyokuwa nimetarajia kutoka kwa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ngateeba, “Chinguru chiane chiaerire, na ogosemeria kwane ase Omonene boigo.”

English: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
Kiswahili: Nayakumbuka mateso yangu na kutangatanga kwangu, uchungu na nyongo.
Ekegusii: Inyora emechando yane, na obokong’u bwane, buna nanyure ay’obororo na obosongo.

English: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
Kiswahili: Ninayakumbuka vyema, nayo nafsi yangu imezimia ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ogendererete koyainyora, na bwekeeirie ime yane.

English: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo najikumbusha neno hili na kwa hiyo ninalo tumaini.
Ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aya nigo nkoyainyora ase omoyo one, ase ayio ninde nogosemeria.

English: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana, hatuangamii, kwa kuwa huruma zake hazikomi kamwe.
Ekegusii: Nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera ng’a titosiriri, ekiagera amaabera aye tari koera;

English: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
Kiswahili: Ni mpya kila asubuhi, uaminifu wako ni mkuu.
Ekegusii: nigo bire ebiyia ase kera emambia, ee, obwegenwa bwao nigo bore obonene.

English: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
Kiswahili: Nimeiambia nafsi yangu, “Bwana ni fungu langu, kwa hiyo nitamngojea.”
Ekegusii: Omonene nere egetari kiane, ayio naro omoyo one ontebirie, ase ayio nimosemeretie.

English: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
Kiswahili: Bwana ni mwema kwa wale ambao tumaini lao ni kwake, kwa yule ambaye humtafuta;
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya ase onde bwensi omoganyete, ee, nomuya ase oyo okomorigia.

English: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: ni vyema kungojea kwa utulivu kwa ajili ya wokovu wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ase omonto okoba n’obotoereru na koganya ogotooreka gokorwa ase Omonene.

English: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
Kiswahili: Ni vyema mtu kuchukua nira bado angali kijana.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ase omonto okobogoria rikorogoto ekero are omoke.

English: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
Kiswahili: Na akae peke yake awe kimya, kwa maana Bwana ameiweka juu yake.
Ekegusii: Tiga aikaranse ao bweka akire‐kiri, ekiagera Omonene nere omotwekire egurube eyio.

English: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
Kiswahili: Na azike uso wake mavumbini bado panawezekana kuwa na matumaini.
Ekegusii: Tiga abeete omonwa oye ase riroba akire‐kiri, aande nabo ogosemeria korabeo.

English: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
Kiswahili: Na atoe shavu lake kwa yule ampigaye, na ajazwe na aibu.
Ekegusii: Tiga aonchore orosea rwaye gochia ase oyio okomoaka, na oyio aisaneke noborami.

English: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa watu hawakatiliwi mbali na Bwana milele.
Ekegusii: Omonene tagotuguta omonto goika kare na kare.

English: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
Kiswahili: Ingawa huleta huzuni, ataonyesha huruma, kwa kuwa upendo wake usiokoma ni mkuu.
Ekegusii: Nonya omobekire ase omoichano, namororere amaabera naende, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye obonene bwa botambe.

English: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hapendi kuwaletea mateso au huzuni watoto wa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Ere tari gwancha gochanda Mwanyabaanto, gose kobaichania.

English: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
Kiswahili: Kuwaponda chini ya nyayo wafungwa wote katika nchi,
Ekegusii: Omonto ogotiringera inse abasibwa bonsi bare ase ense,

English: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
Kiswahili: Kumnyima mtu haki zake mbele za Aliye Juu Sana,
Ekegusii: gose koonchorana oboronge bw’omonto ase obosio bw’Oyore Igoro Mono,

English: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
Kiswahili: kumnyima mtu haki: Je, Bwana asione mambo kama haya?
Ekegusii: gose gokorekania ekiina ki’omonto onde bwensi. Inee! Ayi’Omonene nkoyaanchera are?

English: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
Kiswahili: Nani awezaye kusema nalo likatendeka kama Bwana hajaamuru?
Ekegusii: Ning’o okwanete ring’ana, na rirorio rigakoreka, onye Omonene tarichiigete rikorwe?

English: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
Kiswahili: Je, si ni kwenye kinywa cha Aliye Juu Sana ndiko yatokako maafa na mambo mema?
Ekegusii: Inee! Amabe na amaya, tari korwa ase omonwa bw’Oyore Igoro Mono?

English: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
Kiswahili: Mwanadamu yeyote aliye hai aweza kulalamika wakati anapoadhibiwa kwa ajili ya dhambi zake?
Ekegusii: Nase ki rende Mwanyabaanto ore moyo akwemurunganeria? Nase ki akwemurungania ekero akonyora egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaye.

English: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Tuzichunguze njia zetu na kuzijaribu, na tumrudie Bwana Mungu.
Ekegusii: Tiga twetuke intwe abanyene na toteeme chinchera chiaito, erio tomoiranere Omonene!

English: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
Kiswahili: Tuinue mioyo yetu pamoja na mikono yetu kwa Mungu mbinguni, na tuseme:
Ekegusii: Tiga toimokererie chinkoro chiaito igoro, na amaboko aito, gochia ase Nyasae ore igoro, totebe:

English: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.
Kiswahili: “Tumetenda dhambi na kuasi nawe hujasamehe.
Ekegusii: “Intwe twasaririe asore, twabeire abatari abaigweri, naye togotwabera.

English: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
Kiswahili: “Umejifunika mwenyewe kwa hasira na kutufuatilia; umetuchinja bila huruma.
Ekegusii: “Aye gwetubire endamwamu na gwatochandire, gwaitire, gose tobeti namaabera.

English: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
Kiswahili: Unajifunika mwenyewe kwa wingu, ili pasiwe na ombi litakaloweza kupenya.
Ekegusii: Aye omonyene gwetubire riire, ng’a ogosaba gwaito tikogoika ang’e.

English: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
Kiswahili: Umetufanya takataka na uchafu miongoni mwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: Aye gwatokorire twabeire eubi na abaangire, ase egati y’ebisaku bi’ense.

English: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
Kiswahili: “Adui zetu wote wamefumbua vinywa vyao wazi dhidi yetu.
Ekegusii: “Ababisa baito bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gotosekerera.

English: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
Kiswahili: Tumeteseka kwa hofu kuu na shida ya ghafula, uharibifu na maangamizi.”
Ekegusii: Obwoba ne chiirima biatocheire amo nogosaria na ogosirigwa.

English: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Kiswahili: Vijito vya machozi vinatiririka kutoka machoni mwangu, kwa sababu watu wangu wameangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane nigo agoitera amariga amange buna amaache a rooche, ase engencho y’ogosirigwa kw’omochie bw’abaanto bane.

English: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
Kiswahili: Macho yangu yatatiririka machozi bila kukoma, bila kupata nafuu,
Ekegusii: “Amaiso aane abeire agoitera amariga atari gokama, gose korosa,

English: until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.
Kiswahili: hadi Bwana atazame chini kutoka mbinguni na kuona.
Ekegusii: goika ekero Omonene ararigererie korwa igoro na arore ayio onsi.

English: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
Kiswahili: Lile ninaloliona huniletea huzuni nafsini kwa sababu ya wanawake wote wa mji wangu.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aane agerire nabeire nomoichano ase omoyo one ase engencho y’abaiseke bonsi b’omochie one.

English: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa adui zangu bila sababu wameniwinda kama ndege.
Ekegusii: “Nigo narenge korigigwa buna enyoni nabwo baarenge ababisa bane engencho ende etaiyo.

English: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
Kiswahili: Walijaribu kukomesha maisha yangu ndani ya shimo na kunitupia mawe;
Ekegusii: Bakanduta ase engoro ime inde moyo, na konduta amagena.

English: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
Kiswahili: maji yalifunika juu ya kichwa changu, nami nikafikiri nilikuwa karibu kukatiliwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Amaache agaichora agaeta ase omotwe one igoro, ngateeba: Omoerio one oikire.

English: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
Kiswahili: Nililiitia jina lako, Ee Bwana, kutoka vina vya shimo.
Ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, nigo narangeretie erieta riao korwa ase engoro entambe,

English: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
Kiswahili: Ulisikia ombi langu: “Usikizibie masikio yako kilio changu nikuombapo msaada.”
Ekegusii: na aye okaigwa okorera kwane; toticha amato ao ase ogwechanda kwane ekero nkorera.

English: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
Kiswahili: Ulikuja karibu nilipokuita, nawe ukasema, “Usiogope.”
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwang’igete ang’e ase rituko riria narerete asore, oganteebia: Toondoka!

English: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, ulichukua shauri langu, ukaukomboa uhai wangu.
Ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, kwarwanereire omoyo one na gwatooririe obogima bwane.

English: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
Kiswahili: Umeona, Ee Bwana, ubaya niliotendewa. Tetea shauri langu!
Ekegusii: Kwarorire obobe obo nakoreirwe, onache ekiina kiane ase oboronge.

English: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.
Kiswahili: Umeona kina cha kisasi chao, mashauri yao yote mabaya dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye kwarorire buna ababisa bane baganetie korusia egesiomba, na buna bakorire emeroberio emebe ase ’nde.

English: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their plans against me,
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, umesikia matukano yao, mashauri yao yote mabaya dhidi yangu:
Ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, noigwete okorama kwabo, na emeroberio yabo yonsi igoro yane.

English: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.
Kiswahili: kile adui zangu wanachonongʼona na kunungʼunikia dhidi yangu mchana kutwa.
Ekegusii: Aya abwo bakondwania bagokwana na korengereria, nigo bare mamincha yane omobaso boira.

English: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
Kiswahili: Watazame! Wakiwa wameketi au wamesimama, wananidhihaki katika nyimbo zao.
Ekegusii: Rora, ekero abwo baikaransete, na ekero bakoimoka, ninche engeero yabo bagochaaya.

English: You will pay them back, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.
Kiswahili: Uwalipe kile wanachostahili, Ee Bwana, kwa yale ambayo mikono yao imetenda.
Ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, nobaakane koreng’ana nogokora kw’amaboko abo.

English: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
Kiswahili: Weka pazia juu ya mioyo yao, laana yako na iwe juu yao!
Ekegusii: Otube chinkoro chiabo nomosunte; okoragereria kwao kobe igoro yabo.

English: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Wafuatilie katika hasira na uwaangamize kutoka chini ya mbingu za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, babwatie nendamwamu yao, obasirie, basire korwa inse y’erioba!”

English: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
Kiswahili: Jinsi dhahabu ilivyopoteza mngʼao wake, dhahabu iliyo safi haingʼai! Vito vya thamani vimetawanywa kwenye mwanzo wa kila barabara.
Ekegusii: Naki etaabu yasiririe obomeka‐meku bwaye! Naki etaabu echenire yaonchokire! Amagena aya Aase Aachenu asiareirwe ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.

English: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
Kiswahili: Wana wa Sayuni wenye thamani, ambao mwanzo uzito wa thamani yao ulikuwa wa dhahabu, sasa wanaangaliwa kama vyungu vya udongo, kazi ya mikono ya mfinyanzi!
Ekegusii: Abamura ba Sayoni abare nengencho enene, abwo bareng’anirie ne chitaabu chingiya, naki yabeire ng’a bareng’anigwe ne chinyongo chi’amaroba, echire emeremo y’amaboko ’abakori chinyongo?

English: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Hata mbweha hutoa matiti yao kunyonyesha watoto wao, lakini watu wangu wamekuwa wasio na huruma kama mbuni jangwani.
Ekegusii: Nonya ne chisese chi’orosana nkogonkia chire chimanwa chiabo, korende abakungu b’omochie bw’abaanto bane babeire abatindi, buna chisagero chire ase erooro.

English: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya kiu ulimi wa mtoto mchanga umegandamana na kaakaa la kinywa chake, watoto huomba mkate, lakini hakuna yeyote awapaye.
Ekegusii: Chimeme chi’abana bakogonka chiabwatanire namang’ang’ura ase engencho y’erang’o; abana abake nigo bagosaba endagera, korende monto onde tari okobaa.

English: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokula vyakula vya kifahari ni maskini barabarani. Wale waliokuzwa wakivaa nguo za zambarau sasa wanalalia majivu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo baarenge koria endagera engiya mono bakwereire ase chinchera; na abwo barenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga, nigo baraire ase ebinge bi’eribu.

English: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.
Kiswahili: Adhabu ya watu wangu ni kubwa kuliko ile ya Sodoma, ambayo ilipinduliwa ghafula bila kuwepo mkono wa msaada.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo abanyorete, ekiagera ebibe biakorire ase omochie bw’abaanto bane nigo biarenge ebinene kobua ebi’abaanto ba Sodomu, omochie oyio nigo oonchoranetwe ase etagika eyemo, na okoboko kw’onde tikwayokunete.

English: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wao walikuwa wamengʼaa kuliko theluji na weupe kuliko maziwa, miili yao ilikuwa myekundu kuliko marijani, kuonekana kwao kama yakuti samawi.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi baye nigo baarenge komeka-meka kobua amagena ’embura, nigo baarenge abarabu se kobua amabeere, emebere yabo nigo yarenge emebariri kobua amagena amabariri, na okororekana kwabo nigo kwarenge buna safiro, rigena rie rigori rinene.

English: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa ni weusi kuliko masizi; hawatambulikani barabarani. Ngozi yao imeshikamana juu ya mifupa yao, imekuwa mikavu kama fimbo.
Ekegusii: Bono amaiso abo abeire amamwamuti kobua embiro, tibari komanywa agwo ase chinchera; amasankwa ’emebere yabo abwatanire namauga abo, omire pa buna amasabo amomo.

English: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.
Kiswahili: Wale waliouawa kwa upanga ni bora kuliko wale wanaokufa njaa; wanateseka kwa njaa, wanatokomea kwa kukosa chakula kutoka shambani.
Ekegusii: Mbare negesio abwo bagokwa ase ogoitwa nemioro kobua abwo enchara egoita, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakogenderera korea na korea, ase okoborwa gw’okwama kw’emegondo.

English: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Kiswahili: Kwa mikono yao wenyewe wanawake wenye huruma wanapika watoto wao wenyewe, waliokuwa chakula chao watu wangu walipoangamizwa.
