Ekegusii: Amaboko ’abakuungu abare namayianda aiyekire abana babo abanyene; abwo nigo babete endagera yabo, ekero omochie bw’abaanto bane orenge gosirigwa.

English: Yahweh has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.
Kiswahili: Bwana ametoa nafasi kamilifu ya ghadhabu yake; ameimwaga hasira yake kali. Amewasha moto katika Sayuni ambao umeteketeza misingi yake.
Ekegusii: Omonene oumoire okogechigwa kwaye, ee, oumoire endamwamu yaye entindi; na ase Sayoni otongirie omorero, osambire amaroso aye.

English: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Wafalme wa dunia hawakuamini, wala mtu yeyote wa duniani, kwamba adui na watesi wangeweza kuingia kwenye malango ya Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense, na abanto bonsi bamenyeteo, tibegenete ng’a omochandi, gose omobisa onde bwensi, nkonyara arenge gosoa ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu.

English: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.
Kiswahili: Lakini hili lilitokea kwa sababu ya dhambi za manabii wake, na maovu ya makuhani wake, waliomwaga ndani yake damu ya wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe bi’ababani baye, na ebi’abakuani baye, abwo baiterete amanyinga ’abanyene oboronge, agwo ase omochie ime.

English: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.
Kiswahili: Sasa wanapapasa papasa barabarani kama watu ambao ni vipofu. Wamenajisiwa kabisa kwa damu, hata hakuna anayethubutu kugusa mavazi yao.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakoong’anya ase chinchera bare buna emeuko bakaba bakwegindia amanyinga, na onde tarenge gokuna chianga chiabo.

English: “Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, “They can’t live here any more.”
Kiswahili: Watu wanawapigia kelele, “Ondokeni! Ninyi ni najisi! Ondokeni! Ondokeni! Msituguse!” Wanapokimbia na kutangatanga huku na huko, watu miongoni mwa mataifa wanasema, “Hawawezi kukaa hapa zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Abanto bakagobera, bakaboora: “Karue aa! Inwe timochenegeti! Karue aa! Karue aa! Timokuna abanto!” Ase ayio barabwo bagatama na koombogana. Abanto b’ebisaku bakabakwana bakaboora, “Tibakogenderera komenya ase tore.”

English: Yahweh’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.
Kiswahili: Bwana mwenyewe amewatawanya; hawaangalii tena. Makuhani hawaonyeshwi heshima, wazee hawakubaliki.
Ekegusii: Okobea kw’Omonene kwabasiareire, takobechandera naende; abakuani tibasigetwe, na abagaaka tibaroreretwe amaabera.

English: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, macho yetu yalichoka, kwa kutazamia bure msaada; tuliangalia kutoka minara yetu kwa taifa lisiloweza kutuokoa.
Ekegusii: Amaiso aito arosire ase okorigereria, na okoganya bosa ng’a natokonywe; korwa ase ebitengero biaito, nigo twaganyete egesaku getanyare gototooria.

English: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.
Kiswahili: Watu walituvizia katika kila hatua hata hatukuweza kutembea katika barabara zetu. Mwisho wetu ulikuwa karibu, siku zetu zilikuwa zimetimia, kwa maana mwisho wetu ulikuwa umefika.
Ekegusii: Ababisa baito nigo batoboerete, titwarenge konyara gotaara ase chinchera chiaito. Engaki yaito nigo ere ang’e koera; amatuko aito abarirwe; ee, omoerio oito oikire.

English: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Waliotufuatia walikuwa wepesi kuliko tai angani; walitusaka juu milimani na kutuvizia jangwani.
Ekegusii: Abachandi baito nigo baare abaango kobua ebiongo bikoiruruka, nigo batoseretie gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, bagatoboera ase erooro.

English: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.
Kiswahili: Mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana, pumzi ya uhai wetu hasa, alinaswa katika mitego yao. Tulifikiri kwamba chini ya kivuli chake tungeliweza kuishi miongoni mwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: Omoakwa amaguta Omonene, oyio orenge omoika bw’obogima bwaito, akabwatwa ne chiirima chiabo, oyio nere twateebete ng’a ase ekiriri kiaye nao toramenye ase egati y’ebisaku.

English: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will be drunken, and will make yourself naked.
Kiswahili: Shangilia na ufurahi, ee Binti Edomu, wewe unayeishi nchi ya Usi. Lakini kwako pia kikombe kitapitishwa, Utalewa na kuvuliwa nguo ubaki uchi.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Edomu, inwe abamomenyete ase ense ya Usi, goka na gochenga! Nonya nasemore egekombe nkebaikere, monywe motinde goika motigare getirianda.

English: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.
Kiswahili: Ee Binti Sayuni, adhabu yako itaisha, hatarefusha muda wako wa kukaa uhamishoni. Lakini, ee Binti Edomu, ataadhibu dhambi yako, na atafunua uovu wako.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, egesusuro ki’ebibe biaino giaikeranigwe. Omonene takogenderera gokoira ase obosomba; korende inwe abanto ba Edomu, Omonene nabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaino, ee, naorokie ebibe biaino maiso marore.

English: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka, Ee Bwana, yaliyotupata, tazama, nawe uione aibu yetu.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora aya atonyorire, origererie orore ogochaywa gwaito.

English: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.
Kiswahili: Urithi wetu umegeuziwa kwa wageni, na nyumba zetu kwa wageni.
Ekegusii: Omwando oito oeirwe abanto abaao, chinyomba chiaito chiaeirwe abamenyi.

English: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.
Kiswahili: Tumekuwa yatima wasio na baba, mama zetu wamekuwa kama wajane.
Ekegusii: Twabeire buna chintakana, chitari nabaise, abaababa nigo banga buna ababoraka.

English: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima tununue maji tunayokunywa, kuni zetu zapatikana tu kwa kununua.
Ekegusii: Amaache tokonywa goika toakane chitaabu, ne chinko togwota nigo tokogora.

English: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.
Kiswahili: Wanaotufuatilia wapo kwenye visigino vyetu, tumechoka na hakuna pumziko.
Ekegusii: Abachandi baito nigo batobwatete amogoti, nigo tokorosa mono, titori konyora ogotimoka.

English: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
Kiswahili: Tumejitolea kwa Misri na Ashuru tupate chakula cha kutosha.
Ekegusii: Twaramboreire Abamisiri na Abaasuri amaboko batoe endagera egotoisana.

English: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
Kiswahili: Baba zetu walitenda dhambi na hawapo tena, na sisi tunachukua adhabu yao.
Ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiakorete ebibe, bono tichiyo; goika tobogorie egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo.

English: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.
Kiswahili: Watumwa wanatutawala na hakuna wa kutuokoa mikononi yao.
Ekegusii: Abasomba nabwo bagotogaambera, na onde tari ogototooria korwa ase amaboko abo.

English: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Tunapata chakula chetu kwa kuhatarisha maisha yetu kwa sababu ya upanga jangwani.
Ekegusii: Nigo tokonyora endagera yaito ase okobeeka obogima bwaito ase emechando, ekiagera emioro nere ase erooro.

English: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
Kiswahili: Ngozi yetu ina joto kama tanuru, kwa sababu ya fadhaa itokanayo na njaa.
Ekegusii: Amasankwa ’emebere yaito nigo are ne riberera buna erie riko, ekiagera enchara nigo egotosamba buna omorero.

English: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wametendwa jeuri katika Sayuni, na mabikira katika miji ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: Abakungu baito bare Sayoni bakoreirwe amabe, boigo nabaiseke abekungi abare ase emechi y’Abayuda.

English: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wametungikwa juu kwa mikono yao, wazee hawapewi heshima.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi baito babwatirwe na gosungwa, na abagaaka baito tibasikiri.

English: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanataabika kwenye mawe ya kusagia, wavulana wanayumbayumba chini ya mizigo ya kuni.
Ekegusii: Abamura baito nabwo bakobogoria chingena chigoserwa, na abana abake nigo bakoritoerwa ase okobogoria chinko, bagwa.

English: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
Kiswahili: Wazee wameondoka langoni la mji, vijana wameacha kuimba nyimbo zao.
Ekegusii: Abagaaka tibari goikaransa geita ki’omochie, na abamura batigire kobugia amakano abo.

English: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
Kiswahili: Furaha imeondoka mioyoni mwetu, kucheza kwetu kumegeuka maombolezo.
Ekegusii: Omogoko bwe chinkoro chiaito osirire; ogotenga gwaito kwaonchokire kwabeire ebirero.

English: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
Kiswahili: Taji imeanguka kutoka kichwani petu. Ole wetu, kwa maana tumetenda dhambi!
Ekegusii: Chigutwa chiarenge ase emetwe yaito chiagure inse. Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera twakorire ebibe!

English: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hiyo, mioyo yetu inazimia, kwa sababu ya hayo, macho yetu yamefifia,
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio chinkoro chiaito chiarwarire, na ase engencho y’ayio amaiso aito abeire orotutu.

English: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.
Kiswahili: kwa ajili ya Mlima Sayuni, ambao unakaa ukiwa, nao mbweha wanatembea juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera egetunwa gia Sayoni giatigaire kere bosa, chisese chi’orosana nao chigotaara.

English: You, Yahweh, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
Kiswahili: Wewe, Ee Bwana unatawala milele, kiti chako cha enzi chadumu kizazi hadi kizazi.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo oragaambe kare na kare, ekerogo kiao ki’obogaambi nigo kerabeo ebiaare ase ebiaare.

English: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini watusahau siku zote? Kwa nini umetuacha kwa muda mrefu?
Ekegusii: Naki gwatwebire kogenderera botambe? Naki gwatotigire ase engaki entambe iga?

English: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
Kiswahili: Turudishe kwako mwenyewe, Ee Bwana, ili tupate kurudi. Zifanye mpya siku zetu kama siku za kale,
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toiranie gocha asore, erinde toiranigwe, onchora amatuko aito oyakore abe amayia, abe buna aria a kare!

English: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
Kiswahili: isipokuwa uwe umetukataa kabisa na umetukasirikia pasipo kipimo.
Ekegusii: Gose ngwatotangire kegima? Nigo ogendererete kogechigwa mono naintwe?

English: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa thelathini, mwezi wa nne, siku ya tano ya mwezi, wakati nilipokuwa miongoni mwa hao waliokuwa uhamishoni kando ya Mto Kebari, mbingu zilifunguka nami nikaona maono ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o kane, omwaka bw’emerongo etato, ekero inche Ezekieli namenyete ang’e norooche rwa Kebari amo nabooswa bande, igoro ekamaanoka, nkarora amaroro akorwa ase Nyasae.

English: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya tano ya mwezi, ilikuwa mwaka wa tano wa kuhamishwa kwa Mfalme Yehayakini,
Ekegusii: Ee, ase rituko ria gatano ase omotienyi oyio, omwaka o gatano bw’ogwoswa kwa Yehoyakimu omorwoti,

English: Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and Yahweh’s hand was there on him.
Kiswahili: neno la Bwana lilimjia Ezekieli kuhani, mwana wa Buzi, kando ya Mto Kebari, katika nchi ya Wakaldayo. Huko mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa juu yake.
Ekegusii: ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende inche Ezekieli Omokuani, mosinto o Busi, agwo ang’e norooche rwa Kebari, ase ense y’Abakalidayo, na okoboko kw’Omonene gokang’ikera aroro.

English: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.
Kiswahili: Nilitazama, nikaona dhoruba kubwa ikitoka kaskazini, wingu kubwa sana pamoja likiwa na umeme wa radi likiwa limezungukwa na mwanga mkali. Katikati ya huo moto kulikuwa kama rangi ya manjano ya chuma kinapokuwa ndani ya moto.
Ekegusii: Ekero narigereretie nkarora ekembugu‐mbugu gekorwa sugusu. Riire rinene riaare gwoka omorero rigaacha, na obomeka‐meku bokarietanana ase chinsemo chionsi. Boigo korwa ime ase omorero oyio, obomeka‐meku bonga buna obw’etai bokarorekana.

English: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
Kiswahili: Katika ule moto kulikuwa na kitu kinachofanana na viumbe vinne vyenye uhai. Katika kuonekana kwake vilikuwa na umbo mfano wa mwanadamu,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase egati y’omorero oria bikarorekanao ebitongwa bine bire moyo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okororekana kwabo: Nigo biagwekaine Mwanyabaanto,

English: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.
Kiswahili: lakini kila kimoja kilikuwa na nyuso nne na mabawa manne.
Ekegusii: korende kera ekemo nigo kiabwate amasio ane, ne chimbaaba inye.

English: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
Kiswahili: Miguu yao ilikuwa imenyooka, nyayo za miguu yao zilikuwa kama kwato za miguu ya ndama, nazo zilimetameta kama shaba iliyosuguliwa.
Ekegusii: Amagoro abo nigo arongeete, na ebisanyi bi’amagoro abo nigo biagwekaine ebi’emori. Ebitongwa ebio nigo biarenge komeka‐meka buna etai ekomeka‐meka.

English: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:
Kiswahili: Chini ya mabawa yao katika pande zao nne walikuwa na mikono ya mwanadamu. Wote wanne walikuwa na nyuso na mabawa,
Ekegusii: Inse ye chimbaaba chiabo, ase chinsemo chiabo inye, nigo biabwate amaboko buna aya Mwanyabaanto. Amasio abo ne chimbaaba chiabo nigo biarenge iga:

English: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.
Kiswahili: nayo mabawa yao yaligusana. Kila mmoja alikwenda kuelekea mbele moja kwa moja, hawakugeuka walipokuwa wanatembea.
Ekegusii: Chimbaaba chiabo nigo chiakunaine, na ebitongwa biria tibiarenge koonchoka, korende bikaba bikogenda gochia bosio rioka.

English: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.
Kiswahili: Kuonekana kwa nyuso zao kulikuwa hivi: Kila mmoja wa wale wanne alikuwa na uso wa mwanadamu na kwa upande wa kulia kila mmoja alikuwa na uso wa simba, upande wa kushoto alikuwa na uso wa ngʼombe pia kila mmoja alikuwa na uso wa tai.
Ekegusii: Okororekana kw’amasio a kera ekemo ki’ebitongwa ebio bine nigo kwarenge iga: Amasio abo a bosio nigo arenge buna aya Mwanyabaanto, na aya a borio nigo arenge buna aye chindo, na aya a bomosi nigo arenge buna aye chiombe; boigo kera ekemo nigo kiabwate obosio buna obw’ebiongo.

English: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ndivyo zilivyokuwa nyuso zao. Mabawa yao yalikunjuliwa kuelekea juu, kila mmoja alikuwa na mabawa mawili ambayo kila moja liligusa bawa la mwenzake kila upande na mabawa mengine mawili yakifunika mwili wake.
Ekegusii: Amasio abo nabo arenge igo. Chimbaaba chiabo nigo chiaramboire gochia igoro; chimbaaba ibere chia kera ekemo chigakunana nechi’ekende, na ibere chinde chia kera ekemo chigatuba emebere yabo.

English: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja alikwenda kuelekea mbele moja kwa moja. Popote roho alipotaka kwenda, ndipo walipokwenda pasipo kugeuka.
Ekegusii: Kera ekemo gekaba gekogenda gochia bosio rioka; aase omoika orenge kogenda gochia, nao biarenge kogenda. Ekero biarenge kogenda tibiarenge koonchoka, korende bikaba bikogenda bosio rioka.

English: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.
Kiswahili: Kuonekana kwa vile viumbe hai katikati kulikuwa kama makaa ya mawe yanayowaka au kama mienge. Moto ule ulikuwa ukienda mbele na nyuma katikati ya vile viumbe, ulikuwa na mwangaza mkali na katikati ya ule moto kulitoka kimulimuli kama umeme wa radi.
Ekegusii: Okororekana kw’ebitongwa ebio nigo kwarenge buna omorero bw’amakara ogwoka buna ebimore bigoetanana ase egati yabo. Omorero oria nigo orenge komoreka mono, na korwa ase omorero oyio okomesa gw’enkoba gokaruao.

English: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
Kiswahili: Vile viumbe vilipiga mbio kwenda na kurudi, kama vimulimuli vya umeme wa radi.
Ekegusii: Erio ebitongwa biria bire moyo bikaba bikominyoka gochia aaria na aaria, buna okomesa gw’enkoba.

English: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
Kiswahili: Nilipokuwa nikitazama vile viumbe hai, niliona gurudumu moja juu ya ardhi kando ya kila kiumbe kikiwa na nyuso zake nne.
Ekegusii: Ekero narigereretie ebitongwa biria, nkarora amagoro ’egari ane, kera okomo kore bosio bwa kera egetongwa goteneine inse.

English: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo ilivyokuwa kuonekana kwa hayo magurudumu na muundo wake: yalingʼaa kama zabarajadi, nayo yote manne yalifanana. Kila gurudumu lilikuwa na gurudumu jingine ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Amagoro ayio onsi nigo areng’aine. Ebieni biabo nigo biarenge buna berulo, rigena rikomeka‐meka. Kera okogoro nigo kwaroisirie kogasoanigwa nokonde.

English: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.
Kiswahili: Yalipokwenda yalielekea upande wowote wa pande nne walipoelekea wale viumbe, magurudumu hayakuzunguka wakati viumbe vile vilipokwenda.
Ekegusii: Ekero amagoro ayio arenge kogenda, nigo arenge kogenda ase chinsemo inye chionsi, tarenge koonchoka, akaba akogenda gochia bosio rioka.

English: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
Kiswahili: Kingo zake zilikuwa ndefu kwenda juu na za kutisha, nazo zote nne zilijawa na macho pande zote.
Ekegusii: Amagoro ayio ane nigo arenge ne chibonyi chingare chi’okoondokia, chiaichire namaiso ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
Kiswahili: Vile viumbe hai vilipokwenda, magurudumu yaliyokuwa kando yao yalisogea na wakati hivyo viumbe hai vilipoinuka kutoka ardhini magurudumu nayo yaliinuka.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa biria biarenge gosuka, naboigo na amagoro aria naro arenge gosuka amo nabirobio mbarabare, na ekero ebitongwa biria biarenge koimokerera igoro korwa ase riroba, naboigo na amagoro aria arenge koimokerera igoro.

English: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
Kiswahili: Mahali popote roho alipokwenda wale viumbe nao walikwenda, nayo magurudumu yaliinuka pamoja navyo, kwa sababu roho ya vile viumbe hai alikuwa ndani ya hayo magurudumu.
Ekegusii: Aande onsi ase omoika orenge kogenda, nao na ebitongwa biria biarenge kogenda; naboigo na amagoro aria arenge kogenda amo nabirobio, ekiagera omoika bw’ebitongwa biria nigo orenge ime y’amagoro aria.

English: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
Kiswahili: Wakati viumbe vile viliposogea, nayo magurudumu yalisogea, viumbe viliposimama kimya, nayo pia yalisimama kimya, viumbe vilipoinuka juu ya nchi magurudumu yaliinuliwa pamoja navyo kwa kuwa roho ya hivyo viumbe hai alikuwa ndani ya hayo magurudumu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa biria biarenge gosuka, na amagoro aria nabo arenge gosuka; ekero biarenge gotenena, naro nabo arenge gotenena; ekero biarenge koimokerera igoro korwa inse ase riroba, naro nabo arenge koimokerera igoro mbarabare yabo, ekiagera omoika bw’ebitongwa biria bire moyo nigo orenge ime ase amagoro aria.

English: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
Kiswahili: Juu ya vichwa vya hao viumbe hai palikuwa na kitu mfano wa eneo lililokuwa wazi, lililokuwa angavu kabisa na lenye kutisha.
Ekegusii: Igoro ase emetwe y’ebitongwa biria, egento nkiarengeo kenga buna eaanga igoro yaroiseirie ebirore bikomekameka na komesa, na kerokio nigo kiaarire igoro ase emetwe yabo.

English: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
Kiswahili: Chini ya hiyo nafasi mabawa yao yalitanda moja kuelekea jingine, kila mmoja alikuwa na mabawa mengine mawili yaliyofunika mwili wake.
Ekegusii: Inse y’eaanga eria kera egetongwa nigo kiaramborete chimbaaba chiaye ibere chigakunana nechi’ekende, na kera ekemo kegatuba omobere oye ne chimbaaba chinde ibere.

English: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
Kiswahili: Viumbe wale waliposogea nilisikia sauti ya mabawa yao, kama ngurumo ya maji yaendayo kasi, kama sauti ya Mwenyezi, kama makelele ya jeshi. Waliposimama kimya walishusha mabawa yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa ebio biarenge kogenda, okoeera gwe chimbaaba chiabo nigo kwarenge ase amato ane buna okw’amaache amaange, buna eriogi ri’Omonguru, ee, nigo kwarenge buna okwoga kw’emeganda y’eseegi. Ekero biarenge gotenena, nigo biarenge kwororobia chimbaaba chiabo gochia inse.

English: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
Kiswahili: Ndipo ikaja sauti toka juu ya ile nafasi ya wazi iliyokuwa juu ya vichwa vyao, waliposimama mabawa yao yakiwa yameshushwa.
Ekegusii: Korwa igoro y’eaanga eria yarenge igoro y’emetwe y’ebitongwa ebio okwoga gokaruao, na birobio bigatenena na kwororobia chimbaaba chiabo gochia inse.

English: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
Kiswahili: Juu ya ile nafasi ya wazi iliyokuwa juu ya vichwa vyao kulikuwa na kitu mfano wa kiti cha enzi cha yakuti samawi. Na juu ya kile kiti cha enzi kulikuwa na umbo mfano wa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Igoro y’eaanga eria yarenge igoro y’emetwe yabo norengeo omogwekano bw’ekerogo ki’obonene keroisirie korwa ase esafiro. Ase omogwekano oria bw’ekerogo ki’obonene naikaranseteo oyomo ekieni kiaye kiarenge buna eki’omonto.

English: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
Kiswahili: Nikaona kwamba kutokana na kile nilichoona kama kiuno chake kuelekea juu alionekana kama chuma inayowaka kana kwamba imejaa moto na kuanzia kiuno kwenda chini alionekana kama moto na mwanga mkali ulimzunguka.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase ensemo ekororekana buna nekebono ki’omogwekano oyio na gochia igoro nkarora obomeka‐meku buna obw’etai boetananire negento kenga buna omorero, na korwa ase ekebono kiaye gochia inse ’nkarora egento kenga omorero. Omogwekano oria nigo oetananire n’oborabu bware komoreka.

English: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of Yahweh’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
Kiswahili: Kama vile kuonekana kwa upinde wa mvua mawinguni siku ya mvua, ndivyo ulivyokuwa ule mngʼao uliomzunguka. Hivi ndivyo ilivyokuwa kuonekana kwa utukufu wa Bwana. Nilipouona, nikaanguka kifudifudi, nikasikia sauti ya mtu anaongea.
Ekegusii: Oborabu boria bwarenge komoreka chinsemo chiaye chionsi, nigo bwagwekaine nomokubinyongo ase engaki y’embura. Okororekana okwo nakw’obonene bw’Omonene. Ekero narooche ayio ngatung’ama inse maumama; erio nkaigwa eriogi ri’oyomo ogokwana.

English: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”
Kiswahili: Akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, simama kwa miguu yako nami nitasema nawe.”
Ekegusii: Ere aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, tenena namagoro ao, inche nkwane naye.”

English: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akiongea nami, Roho akanijia na kunisimamisha wima, nikamsikia akisema nami.
Ekegusii: Ekero akwanete nainche, Omoika ogasoa ime y’ane, ogantenenia, erio nkamotegerera oria orenge gokwana nainche.

English: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.
Kiswahili: Akaniambia: “Mwanadamu, ninakutuma kwa Waisraeli, kwa taifa asi ambalo limeniasi mimi, wao na baba zao wananikosea mimi hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Ere aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, nkogotoma inde gochia ase Abaisraeli, egesaku ekio getari koigwera, ekio giantigire inche. Abanto abwo amo ne chisokoro chiabo babeire bagosaria asende nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’
Kiswahili: Watu ambao ninakutuma kwao ni wapotovu na wakaidi. Waambie, ‘Hivi ndivyo anavyosema Bwana Mwenyezi.’
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo banyiretie amasio abo ne chinkoro chiabo. Nao nkogotoma gochia ase bare, goika obateebie iga: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba.

English: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.
Kiswahili: Kama watasikiliza au hawatasikiliza, kwa kuwa wao ni nyumba ya kuasi, watajua nabii amekuwa miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Kobaraigwe, gose bange koigwa (ekiagera barabwo negesaku getari koigwera), mbamanye ng’a omobani obeire ase egati yabo.

English: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.
Kiswahili: Nawe mwanadamu, usiwaogope wao wala maneno yao, usiogope, ingawa michongoma na miiba vinakuzunguka na unaishi katikati ya nge. Usiogope yale wasemayo wala usitishwe nao, ingawa wao ni nyumba ya uasi.
Ekegusii: “Korende aye Mwanyabaanto, tobaisa kobairoka, gose koiroka amang’ana abo, nonya goetananire namageri na amagwa, naende komenyete ase egati y’ebiuge. Ee, tobaisa kwoboa ekero orarore amasio abo, gose kwoboa amang’ana abo, ekiagera abwo nigo bare egesaku getari koigwera.

English: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
Kiswahili: Wewe lazima uwaambie maneno yangu, ikiwa wanasikiliza au hawasikilizi, kwa kuwa wao ni watu waasi.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana nkogoteebia naro orabateebie kobarayategerere gose bayaange, ekiagera barabwo negesaku getari koigwera.

English: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe mwanadamu, sikiliza ninalokuambia. Usiwe mwenye kuasi kama hiyo nyumba ya kuasi. Fungua kinywa chako na ule nikupacho.”
Ekegusii: “Korende aye Mwanyabaanto, tegerera aya nkogoteebia; tobaisa koba oyo otari koigwera buna egesaku eke getari koigwera. Asamia omonwa oo, orie egento eke ngokoa.”

English: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikatazama, nami nikaona mkono ulionyooshwa kunielekea. Nao ulikuwa na ukurasa wa kitabu,
Ekegusii: Ekero narigereretie, nkarora okoboko koramboire gocha asende, na ase okoboko okwo egetabu yaringire yarengeo.

English: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.
Kiswahili: ambao aliukunjua mbele yangu. Pande zote mbili ulikuwa umeandikwa maneno ya maombolezo, vilio na ole.
Ekegusii: Egetabu keria gekaramborwa ase obosio bwane; nero nigo yariikire bosio na magega. Amang’ana ariikire aroro nigo arenge ay’amagombo, na okweumia, na okorera kw’obobe.

English: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Naye akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, kula kile kilichoko mbele yako, kula huu ukurasa wa kitabu, kisha uende ukaseme na nyumba ya Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, karie egento ekio kwaeirwe; karie egetabu eke, erio ogende gokwana n’Abaisraeli.”

English: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikafungua kinywa changu, naye akanilisha ule ukurasa wa kitabu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ngaasamia omonwa one, na ere akang’a egetabu eria in’yerie.

English: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, kula ukurasa huu wa kitabu ninaokupa ujaze tumbo lako.” Kwa hiyo nikaula, ulikuwa mtamu kama asali kinywani mwangu.
Ekegusii: Naende aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, karie egetabu eke ngokoa eichore ase enda yao.” Erio nkayeria, egansa ase omonwa one buna obooke.

English: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, sasa nenda katika nyumba ya Israeli ukaseme nao maneno yangu.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, imoka ogende ase Abaisraeli, okwane nabarabwo amang’ana ane.

English: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—
Kiswahili: Hukutumwa kwa taifa lenye maneno ya kutatiza na lugha ngumu, bali kwa nyumba ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Tindi kogotoma ase abanto bagokwana omonwa omoao otamanyeti, korende ase Abaisraeli.

English: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
Kiswahili: Sikukutuma kwa mataifa mengi yenye maneno ya kutatiza na lugha ngumu ambao maneno yao hutayaelewa. Hakika ningekutuma kwa watu hao, wangekusikiliza.
Ekegusii: Gose tindi kogotoma ase abanto b’ebisaku ebinge bagokwana emenwa emekong’u, abwo ogokwana kwabo otanyare komanya. Ekeene, onye narenge kogotoma gochia ase abanto buna abwo, nigo barenge gokoigwera.

English: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.
Kiswahili: Lakini nyumba ya Israeli haitakusikiliza kwa kuwa hawako radhi kunisikiliza mimi, kwa kuwa nyumba yote ya Israeli ni wenye vipaji vya nyuso vigumu na mioyo ya ukaidi.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibagokoigwera aye, ekiagera tibari konyigwera inche; Abaisraeli bonsi banyiririe amasio abo, ne chinkoro chiabo boigo.

English: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.
Kiswahili: Tazama nimefanya uso wako mgumu dhidi ya nyuso zao na kipaji cha uso wako kigumu dhidi ya vipaji vya nyuso zao.
Ekegusii: Rora, nakorire obosio bwao bobe obokong’u buna ayabo, na obosio bwao igoro bobe obokong’u buna ayabo.

English: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”
Kiswahili: Kama vile almasi ilivyo ngumu kuliko gumegume, ndivyo nilivyokifanya kipaji cha uso wako. Usiwaogope wala usiwahofu, ijapokuwa ni nyumba ya kuasi.”
Ekegusii: Ee, nakorire obosio bwao igoro bobe obokong’u buna rigena rikorokwa elimasi, rire rikong’u kobua amagena ande. Tobairoka gose koboboa ekero orarore amasio abo, ekiagera abwo nigo bare egesaku getari koigwera.”

English: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.
Kiswahili: Naye akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, sikiliza kwa makini na uyatie moyoni mwako maneno yote nitakayosema nawe.
Ekegusii: Omonene akagenderera gokwana nainche, aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, amang’ana onsi nkogotebia oyagache ase enkoro yao ime, oyaigwe buya.

English: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”
Kiswahili: Kisha nenda kwa watu wa taifa lako walio uhamishoni, ukaseme nao. Waambie, ‘Hivi ndivyo Bwana Mwenyezi asemavyo,’ kwamba watasikiliza au hawatasikiliza.”
Ekegusii: Oimoke ogende ase abanto bamino abwo boosetwe, obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba, kobaragotegerere gose bange kogotegerera.”

English: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be Yahweh’s glory from his place.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Roho akaniinua, nikasikia sauti kubwa nyuma yangu ya ngurumo. (Utukufu wa Bwana na utukuzwe katika mahali pa makao yake!)
Ekegusii: Erio Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, nkaigwa korwa magega y’ane eriogi buna eri’ogoaka gw’enkoba, rigoteeba: “Obonene bw’Omonene botogigwe korwa agwo ase bore!”

English: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa ni sauti ya mabawa ya wale viumbe hai yakisuguana moja kwa jingine, sauti kama ya ngurumo.
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa na eriogi rie chimbaaba chi’ebitongwa biria bire moyo chigokunana, na eriogi ri’amagoro aria arenge mbarabare yabo riarenge buna eri’ogoaka gw’enkoba.

English: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was strong on me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Roho aliponiinua na kunipeleka mbali. Nikaenda nikiwa na uchungu na hasira moyoni mwangu, nao mkono wa Bwana ukiwa juu yangu.
Ekegusii: Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, okang’ira aase aao, na inche nkagenda inde nobororo bogwoka ase omoika one, korende okoboko kw’Omonene gokambeka chinguru.

English: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.
Kiswahili: Nikafika kwa wale watu waliokuwa uhamishoni huko Tel-Abibu karibu na Mto Kebari. Nikakaa miongoni mwao kwa muda wa siku saba, nikiwa nimejawa na mshangao.
Ekegusii: Ngaika Telabibu ase abanto baria boosetwe bamenyete, ang’e norooche rwa Kebari; nkagenderera kobeera amo nabarabwo aase agwo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere inde nomoichano omonene.

English: At the end of seven days, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Mwishoni mwa hizo siku saba neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko atano na abere aerete, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:

English: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, nimekufanya uwe mlinzi wa nyumba ya Israeli, kwa hiyo sikia neno nisemalo, ukawape onyo litokalo kwangu.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, nakobekire obe omorendi bw’Abaisraeli. Ekero kende gionsi oraigwe ring’ana rikorwa ase omonwa one, aye obateebie ring’ana erio riane ri’okobakuurera.

English: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.
Kiswahili: Nimwambiapo mtu mwovu, ‘Hakika utakufa,’ na wewe usipomwonya mtu huyo au kumshauri aache njia zake mbaya ili kuokoa maisha yake, huyo mtu mwovu atakufa katika dhambi yake na damu yake nitaidai mkononi mwako.
Ekegusii: Kondateebe ase omokori amabe: Ekeene aye goika okwe, na aye koratige tomokuurera, gose tokwana nomokori amabe oyio ase okomokuurera, erinde atige chinchera chiaye chi’obobe atoorie obogima bwaye, rirorio omokori amabe oyio nakwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende amanyinga aye nin’yaganie korwa ase okoboko kwao.

English: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ukimwonya mtu mwovu naye akakataa kuacha uovu wake na njia zake mbaya, atakufa katika dhambi yake, lakini wewe utakuwa umejiokoa nafsi yako.
Ekegusii: Korende aye korakuurere omokori amabe oyio, na ere aange koonchoka korwa ase ebibe biaye, ne chinchera chiaye chi’obobe, oyio goika akwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende aye omonyene nobe gwatooririe obogima bwao.

English: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.
Kiswahili: “Tena, mtu mwenye haki akiacha haki yake na kutenda maovu, nami nikaweka kikwazo mbele yake mtu huyo atakufa. Kwa kuwa hukumwonya, atakufa katika dhambi yake. Mambo ya haki aliyotenda, hayatakumbukwa, damu yake nitaidai mkononi mwako.
Ekegusii: “Naende omonyaboronge karaonchoke atige oboronge bwaye na akore ebibe, inche nimobekere ekegocha ase enchera yaye goika akwe. Onye tikwamokuurerete, ere nakwe ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na ogokora kwaye kw’oboronge akorete ritang’ani tigokoinyorwa, korende amanyinga aye nin’yaganie korwa ase okoboko kwao.

English: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ukimwonya mwenye haki asitende dhambi na akaacha kutenda dhambi, hakika ataishi kwa sababu alipokea maonyo na utakuwa umejiokoa nafsi yako.”
Ekegusii: Korende korakuurere omonyaboronge ng’a takora ebibe, na ere abe takora ebibe, ekeene, ere nabe moyo, ekiagera aigwerete ogokuurerwa, na aye nobe gwatooririe obogima bwao.”

English: Yahweh’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa juu yangu huko, naye akaniambia, “Simama uende mpaka sehemu tambarare, nami nitasema nawe huko.”
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo okoboko kw’Omonene gokambeka chinguru, ere aganteebia, “Imoka, ogende ase ense omweya, na aroro aaria inche ninkwane naye.”

English: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, Yahweh’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo niliinuka nikaenda mpaka mahali pa tambarare. Utukufu wa Bwana ulikuwa umesimama huko, kama utukufu ule niliouona kando ya Mto Kebari, nami nikaanguka kifudifudi.
Ekegusii: Erio nkaimoka, ’nkagenda aaria ase ense omweya, na obonene bw’Omonene bogatenena aroro buna boria konya narorire ang’e norooche rwa Kebari; ekero naborooche, ngatung’ama, nkagwa inse maumama.

English: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Roho akaja ndani yangu akanisimamisha kwa miguu yangu. Akasema nami akaniambia: “Nenda ukajifungie ndani ya nyumba yako.
Ekegusii: Erio Omoika ogasoa ime y’ane, ogantenenia, n’Omonene agakwana nainche, aganteebia, “Genda bwesiekere nyomba mwao.

English: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.
Kiswahili: Nawe, ee mwanadamu, watakufunga kwa kamba, watakufunga ili usiweze kutoka na kuwaendea watu.
Ekegusii: Korende aye Mwanyabaanto, rora nosibwe ne chingori, erinde tonyara kogenda ase egati y’ abanto bao.

English: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.
Kiswahili: Nitaufanya ulimi wako ushikamane kwenye kaa la kinywa chako, ili uwe kimya usiweze kuwakemea, wajapokuwa ni nyumba ya kuasi.
Ekegusii: Inche nimbwatanie oromeme rwao namang’ang’ura, na aye obe rimama osinywe kobakuurera; barabwo nigo bare egesaku getari koigwera.

English: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nitakaposema nawe, nitafungua kinywa chako nawe utawaambia, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo.’ Yeyote atakayesikiliza na asikilize, na yeyote atakayekataa na akatae; kwa kuwa wao ni nyumba ya kuasi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero ’ndakwane naye, nimaanore omonwa oo, na aye obateebie iga: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba; Omonto oganetie koigwera, tiga aigwere, na oyo otaganeti koigwera, tiga aange, ekiagera barabwo negesaku getari koigwera.

English: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, sasa chukua tofali, uliweke mbele yako na uchore juu yake ramani ya mji wa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, imokia ritabori, oribeke bosio bwao, erio orimang’ere omogwekano bw’omochie o Yerusalemu.

English: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.
Kiswahili: Kisha uuzingire: Simamisha askari dhidi yake kuuzunguka, uzunguke kwa majeshi, weka kambi dhidi yake pande zote pamoja na magogo ya kubomolea boma vitani.
Ekegusii: Oyogitere orwaki rw’okoyoboera ase chinsemo chionsi, na oyoetananie neburi boigo, naende oyobekere ebitwori bi’abarwani esegi, na otenenie ebikorero bi’ogotagorera ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kisha chukua bamba la chuma, ukalisimamishe liwe kama ukuta wa chuma kati yako na huo mji, nawe uuelekeze uso wako. Huo mji utakuwa katika hali ya kuzingirwa, nawe utauzingira. Hii itakuwa ishara kwa nyumba ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Oimokie esani y’ekioma, oyetenenie buna orwaki ase egati yao na omochie oyio; oyorigererie, oyoboere na ogenderere koyoboera. Ayio nabe ekemanyererio ase Abaisraeli.

English: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
Kiswahili: “Kisha ulale kwa upande wako wa kushoto na uweke dhambi za nyumba ya Israeli juu yake. Utazibeba dhambi zao kwa idadi ya siku utakazolala kwa huo upande mmoja.
Ekegusii: “Erio aye oraarere orobega rwao rw’okobee, obe kobogoretie obobe bw’Abaisraeli igoro yao. Koreng’ana namatuko ayio orabe koraire igo, naboigo orabogorie obobe bwabo.

English: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Nimekupangia idadi ya siku kama miaka ya dhambi yao. Kwa hiyo kwa siku 390 utabeba dhambi za nyumba ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Nagochikeire amatuko amagana atato, na emerongo kianda (390); amatuko ayio nigo anga buna emiaka y’egesusuro ki’obobe bwabo, eyio nero engaki orabe kobogoretie obobe bw’Abaisraeli.

English: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.
Kiswahili: “Baada ya kumaliza hili, lala chini tena, wakati huu ulale chini kwa upande wa kuume, uchukue dhambi za nyumba ya Yuda. Nimekupangia siku arobaini, siku moja kwa kila mwaka mmoja.
Ekegusii: Ekero orabe gwakoorire korara engaki eyio, naende oraarere orobega rwao rw’okorio, na obe kobogoretie obobe bw’Abayuda. Nagochiikeire amatuko emerongo ene, rituko erimo ndibe buna omwaka oyomo.

English: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.
Kiswahili: Geuza uso wako uelekeze kwenye kuzingirwa kwa Yerusalemu na mkono wako ambao haukuvikwa nguo tabiri dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: “Bwasiorie eanga korwa ase okoboko kwao, origererie Yerusalemu oyio oboeire, erio obaane mamincha y’oro.

English: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.
Kiswahili: Nitakufunga kwa kamba ili usiweze kugeuka kutoka upande mmoja hadi upande mwingine, mpaka hapo utakapokuwa umetimiza siku za kuzingirwa kwako.
Ekegusii: Ningosibe ne chingori, erinde tonyara koonchoka gochia ensemo ende yonsi goika obe gwakoorire amatuko ao ay’okoyoboera.

English: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.
Kiswahili: “Chukua ngano na shayiri, maharagwe na dengu, mtama na mawele, uviweke na kuvihifadhi vyote kwenye gudulia la kuhifadhia, na uvitumie kujitengenezea mkate. Utaula mkate huo kwa hizo siku 390 utakazokuwa umelala kwa upande mmoja.
Ekegusii: Oimokie engano, na esairi, ne ching’ende, ne chinchorogo, na amaemba, na engano ende, erio obeke ebinto ebio ase ekebekerero ekemo, obiochoganie, obiroisie emegati. Eyio nero or’abe gokoria ase engaki eyio y’amatuko amagana atato, na emerongo kianda, or’abe koraire.

English: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.
Kiswahili: Pima shekeli ishirini za chakula utakachokula kwa kila siku, nawe utakula kwa wakati uliopangwa.
Ekegusii: Endagera yao or’abe gokoria nigo eraarengwe, nigo er’abe ey’ekerengo gie chisekeli emerongo ebere ase rituko erimo. Eyio nero or’abe gokoria rituko ase rituko.

English: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.
Kiswahili: Pia pima maji moja ya sita ya hini, nawe utakunywa kwa wakati uliopangwa.
Ekegusii: Amaache or’abe gokonywa naro goika arengwe, abe inse y’elita eyemo ase rituko erimo; naboigo orabe gokonywa rituko ase rituko.

English: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”
Kiswahili: Nawe utakula chakula kama vile ambavyo ungekula mkate wa shayiri, uoke mkate mbele ya macho ya watu, ukitumia kinyesi cha mwanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Oroisie endagera yao buna emegati y’esairi, oyeroiserie ase abanto barooche igoro y’omorero bw’obonyira obwomo bwa Mwanyabaanto.”

English: Yahweh said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Hivi ndivyo watu wa Israeli watakavyokula chakula kilicho najisi miongoni mwa mataifa ninakowapeleka.”
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene agateeba, “Naboigo Abaisraeli bararie endagera etachenegeti ekero barabe bare ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku biria ase ndabaserie gochia.”

English: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikasema, “Sivyo Bwana Mwenyezi! Kamwe mimi sijajitia unajisi. Tangu ujana wangu hadi sasa sijala kamwe kitu chochote kilichokufa au kilichoraruliwa na wanyama wa mwituni. Hakuna nyama yeyote najisi iliyoingia kinywani mwangu.”
Ekegusii: Erio nkamoiraneria, nkamoteebia, “Yaya, Omonene, Naama, inche tinana gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka; korwa obwana bwane goika bono iga, tinana koria enyama y’eng’iti ekwete enyene, gose eyeitire ne ching’iti chinde; enyama ende yonsi y’okogechia tiyana gosoa ase omonwa one.”

English: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Vema sana, basi nitakuruhusu uoke mkate wako kwa kutumia kinyesi cha ngʼombe badala ya kinyesi cha mwanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene aganteebia, “Bono ninkoe ribaga okoroiseria endagera yao igoro y’omorero bw’obwoyo obwomo bwe chiombe ribaga ri’omorero bw’obonyira bwa Mwanyabaanto.”

English: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, mimi nitakatilia mbali upatikanaji wa chakula katika Yerusalemu. Watu watakula chakula cha kupimwa kwa wasiwasi pamoja na maji ya kupimiwa kwa kukata tamaa,
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, ngochia inde gokeyia endagera ase Yerusalemu. Nigo baraarengerwe endagera bakoria, na bayerie bare n’obwoba. Boigo goika barengerwe amaache bakonywa, na bayanywe bare n’omoichano.

English: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa chakula na maji vitakuwa adimu. Watastajabiana kila mmoja, nao watadhoofika kwa sababu ya dhambi yao.
Ekegusii: Ninkore ayio, erinde baborwe endagera na amaache, na baichanerane omonto n’oyomwabo, na barabwo nigo bararee na kogireka ase engencho y’egesusuro ki’obobe bwabo.

English: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, sasa chukua upanga mkali na uutumie kama wembe wa kinyozi ili kunyolea nywele za kichwa chako na ndevu zako. Kisha uchukue mizani ya kupimia ukazigawanye nywele hizo.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, imokia omoyio o birende omwoge, bwekigite etukia y’omotwe oo, ne chinderu chiao; erio orente ekerengero orengere etukia eyio na oyiatanane.

English: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.
Kiswahili: Wakati siku zako za kuzingirwa zitakapokwisha, choma theluthi moja ya hizo nywele zako kwa moto ndani ya mji. Chukua theluthi nyingine ya hizo nywele uzipige kwa upanga kuuzunguka mji wote na theluthi nyingine ya mwisho utaitawanya kwa upepo. Kwa kuwa nitawafuatia kwa upanga uliofutwa.
Ekegusii: Ensemo eyemo ya isato y’etukia eyio oyesambere gati‐gati y’omochie, ekero amatuko ay’okoyoboera kaerire; na ensemo ende ya isato oyeake n’omoyio oria goetanana ase omochie oria; na ensemo ende ya isato oyesiarere eirurukigwe nomwaga, na inche nin’yebwatie n’omoro one.

English: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.
Kiswahili: Lakini chukua nywele chache uzifungie ndani ya pindo la vazi lako.
Ekegusii: Oimokie etukia inke igo, oyesiberanie ase omokoba bw’eganchwa yao.

English: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Tena chukua nywele nyingine chache uzitupe motoni uziteketeze. Moto utaenea kutoka humo na kufika katika nyumba yote ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Naende oimokie inke igo korwa ase eyio, oyerute ase omorero oyesambe, na korwa ase eyio omorero norueo bwesiarere gochia ase Abaisraeli bonsi.”

English: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Huu ndio Yerusalemu ambao nimeuweka katikati ya mataifa ukiwa umezungukwa na nchi pande zote.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Oyo n’oro Yerusalemu; nayobekire ase egati‐gati y’ abanto b’ebisaku, ne chinse chinde chiyoetanaine.

English: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’
Kiswahili: Lakini katika uovu wake umeasi sheria na amri zangu kuliko mataifa na nchi zinazouzunguka. Umeasi sheria zangu wala haukufuata amri zangu.
Ekegusii: Korende Yerusalemu okorire ebibe kobua abanto b’ebisaku na bwangire koigwera amachiiko ane, naende okorire ebibe kobua chinse echio chiyoetanaine, ekiagera bwangire koigwera aya nachiigete, gose kobwatia emeroberio y’ane echiikire.”

English: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ninyi mmekuwa wakaidi kuliko mataifa yanayowazunguka na hamkufuata amri zangu wala kuzishika sheria zangu. Wala hamkuweza hata kuzifuata kawaida za mataifa yanayowazunguka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Inwe mwabeire abebura‐buria kobua ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine, gose timobwateti emeroberio y’ane echiikire, gose timorendeti amachiiko ane, na timobwateti nonya namachiiko y’ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine.”

English: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo, Mimi mwenyewe, niko kinyume nanyi Yerusalemu, nitawapiga kwa adhabu yangu mbele ya mataifa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Rora, inche ninche inde mamincha yaino, nimbaachere, ’mbanachere ekiina agwo ase egati yaino, ase amasio y’ abanto b’ebisaku.

English: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya sanamu zenu zote za machukizo, nitawafanyia kile ambacho kamwe sijawafanyia kabla wala kamwe sitawafanyia tena.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ogosaria kwaino gwonsi gw’okogechia nimbae egesusuro ’ntana korua kero kende gionsi, gose tinkonyara gokerua nonya ng’ake naende.

English: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo katikati yenu baba watakula watoto wao na watoto watakula baba zao. Nitawapiga kwa adhabu, nami nitawatawanya watu wenu walionusurika pande zote za dunia.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio abaibori ’mbarie abana babo, na abana ’mbarie abaibori babo, agwo ase egati yaino. Nimbanachere ekiina, na abatigari baino nimbasiarere gochia ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense.”

English: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, kwa kuwa mmenajisi mahali pangu patakatifu kwa sanamu zenu mbaya sana na desturi zenu za machukizo, mimi mwenyewe nitaondoa fadhili zangu kwenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: “Ekeene, buna inde moyo ekiagera inwe mwakorire Obomenyo, bwane Obochenu bwabeire obotachenegeti ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino kw’obokaayayu, na okogechia kwaino gwonsi, nimbaserie kegima; eriiso riane tirikobarigereria namabeebe, gose inche tinkobarorera amaabera.

English: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.
Kiswahili: Theluthi ya watu wako watakufa kwa tauni au kwa njaa humu ndani yako, theluthi nyingine itaanguka kwa upanga nje ya kuta zako, nayo theluthi nyingine nitaitawanya kwenye pande nne kuwafuatia kwa upanga uliofutwa.
Ekegusii: Ensemo eyemo ya isato y’ abanto baino ’mbaitwe namarwaire agoita, na bakwe nenchara, agwo ase omochie ime, na ensemo ende ya isato ’’mbakenywe nemioro agwo ase chinsemo chionsi isiko y’omochie; na ensemo ende ya isato nimbasiarere gochia ase chinsemo chionsi, mbabwatie inde n’omoro.

English: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo hasira yangu itakapokoma na ghadhabu yangu dhidi yao itatulia, nami nitakuwa nimelipiza kisasi. Baada ya kuimaliza ghadhabu yangu juu yao, watajua kuwa mimi Bwana nimenena katika wivu wangu.
Ekegusii: “Ase enchera eyio ning’umore endamwamu y’ane, na obotindi bwane, igoro ase bare, erinde ’ng’isaneke. Ekero ’ndabe naumoire endamwamu y’ane ase bare, ’mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio inde ne risemi.

English: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.
Kiswahili: “Nitakuangamiza na kukufanya kitu cha kudharauliwa miongoni mwa mataifa yanayokuzunguka, machoni pa watu wote wapitao karibu nawe.
Ekegusii: Aye omochie, ningosirie obe amaturi na oyo ogochaaywa n’abanto b’ebisaku bigoetanaine, na ase amasio y’ abanto bonsi abagoeta ase ore.

English: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, Yahweh, have spoken it—
Kiswahili: Utakuwa kitu cha kudharauliwa na cha aibu, cha dhihaka, ovyo na kitu cha kutisha kwa mataifa yanayokuzunguka, nitakapokupiga kwa adhabu yangu katika hasira na ghadhabu yangu kwa kukukemea kwa ukali. Mimi Bwana nimesema.
Ekegusii: “Ekero nd’abe nendamwamu na obotindi na gokonachera ekiina na gokoa egesusuro ki’ogokorongeyia, aye n’obe kogochaaywa na gosekererwa, na ekero abanto b’ebisaku biria bigoetanaine barakorore, nigo barorokererigwe na goichanigwa. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.

English: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.
Kiswahili: Nitakapokupiga kwa mishale yangu ya kufisha na yenye kuharibu ya njaa, nitaipiga ili kukuangamiza. Nitaleta njaa zaidi na zaidi juu yako na kukomesha upatikanaji wa chakula kwako.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio nindase abanto bao chinsara chiane chi’enchara, chibaite na kobasiria kegima. Ekero ndakore ayio ninkeyie endagera yabo bakoria ebe enke na enchara egenderere komenteka.

English: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’”
Kiswahili: Nitapeleka njaa na wanyama wa mwituni dhidi yenu, navyo vitawaacha bila watoto. Tauni na umwagaji wa damu utapita katikati yenu, nami nitaleta upanga juu yenu. Mimi Bwana nimenena haya.”
Ekegusii: Nintome enchara ne ching’iti chi’orosana ase ore, ebio ’mbiite abana bao; boigo ningotomere amarwaire agoita na ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga amo n’omoro. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.”

English: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema,
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia,

English: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, elekeza uso wako kukabili milima ya Israeli, utabiri dhidi yake
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, rigereria gochia ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, obaane mamincha yabo,

English: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.
Kiswahili: na useme: ‘Ee milima ya Israeli, sikia neno la Bwana Mwenyezi. Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi aliambiayo milima na vilima, magenge na mabonde: Ninakaribia kuleta upanga dhidi yenu, nami nitapaharibu mahali penu pote pa juu pa kuabudia miungu.
Ekegusii: oteebe: Inwe ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene! Aya n’aro Omonene agoteebia inwe ebitunwa, na ebigoro, ne chindooche, na amakura: Rora, inche nindete omoro ase more na ninsarie aase aino aimokererete igoro mogosasiimera.

English: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
Kiswahili: Madhabahu yenu yatabomolewa na madhabahu yenu ya kufukizia uvumba yatavunjavunjwa, nami nitawachinja watu wenu mbele ya sanamu zenu.
Ekegusii: Ebisasimero biaino mbisarigwe kegima, naboigo na ebisasimero biaino bi’ogosambera ubani. Abanto abwo baraitwe mbatugutwe bosio bw’emegwekano yaino mogosasiima.

English: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.
Kiswahili: Nitazilaza maiti za Waisraeli mbele ya sanamu zao, nami nitatawanya mifupa yenu kuzunguka madhabahu yenu.
Ekegusii: Nimbeeke emebere ekwete y’Abaisraeli bosio bw’emegwekano yabo bagosasiima, na amauga aino nin’yasiarere chinsemo chionsi chiebisasimero biaino.

English: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
Kiswahili: Popote mnapoishi, miji hiyo itafanywa ukiwa na mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu patabomolewa, ili madhabahu yenu ifanywe ukiwa na kuharibiwa, sanamu zenu zitavunjavunjwa na kuharibiwa, madhabahu yenu ya kufukizia uvumba yatabomolewa na kila mlichokifanya kitakatiliwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Aase aande onsi mor’abe momenyete, emechie yaino nesirigwe, na aase aino aimokererete igoro mogosasiimera natagorwe na atigwe bosa, na emegwekano yaino mogosasiima nebutoranwe tebao naende; boigo na amatenenerio aino aya mogosasiimera erioba nabutorwe agwo inse, naboigo na ebisasimero biaino bi’ogosambera ubani, na emeremo yaino yonsi mwakorire esirigwe.

English: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Watu wenu watachinjwa katikati yenu, nanyi mtatambua Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto baraitwe mbagwe ase egati yaino, na inwe monyare komanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

English: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini nitawabakiza hai baadhi yenu, kwa kuwa baadhi yenu watanusurika kuuawa watakapokuwa wametawanyika katika nchi na mataifa.
Ekegusii: “Korende nonya naboigo nintige abande baino babe moyo. Abande b’abwo baratooreke korwa ase emioro ’mbasiarerwe gochia ase chinse chinde, babe bamenyete ase egati y’ebisaku.

English: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
Kiswahili: Ndipo katika mataifa ambamo watakuwa wamechukuliwa mateka, wale ambao watanusurika watanikumbuka, jinsi ambavyo nimehuzunishwa na mioyo yao ya uzinzi, ambayo imegeukia mbali nami na macho yao ambayo yametamani sanamu zao. Watajichukia wenyewe kwa ajili ya uovu walioutenda na kwa ajili ya desturi zao za kuchukiza.
Ekegusii: Abwo baratooreke korwa ase emioro na koirwa ase obosomba ase egati y’ebisaku mbabe bakong’inyora, ekiagera nasenyentete chinkoro chiabo chi’obokaayayu, echio chiantigete, na ngaukoria amaiso abo, ayio atengerete ase okogania emegwekano yabo bagosasiima. Mbachandeke na kwegecha boka abanyene, ase engencho y’ebibe bakorire, na ase engencho y’okogechia kwabo gwonsi.

English: They will know that I am Yahweh. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’
Kiswahili: Nao watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, sikuwaonya bure kuwa nitaleta maafa hayo yote juu yao.
Ekegusii: Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Amang’ana nakwanete ng’a nimbarentere amabe ayio tarenge amang’ana abosa.”

English: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Piga makofi, kanyaga chini kwa mguu na upige kelele, “Ole!” kwa sababu ya maovu yote na machukizo yote yanayofanywa na nyumba ya Israeli, kwa kuwa wataanguka kwa upanga, njaa na tauni.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba, “Samusa amaboko aino, na motinere amagoro aino inse, morere: Obee! Obee! Nase engencho y’obobe bwonsi bw’okogechia kw’Abaisraeli obwo bwagerire ng’a baitwe nemioro, na enchara, na amarwaire.

English: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliye mbali sana atakufa kwa tauni, naye aliye karibu atauawa kwa upanga, naye yule atakayenusurika na kubaki atakufa kwa njaa. Hivyo ndivyo nitakavyotimiza ghadhabu yangu dhidi yao.
Ekegusii: Omonto orabe okare aare, oborwaire mbomoite, na oyore ang’e naitwe n’omoro, na oyo otigaire na orendire, enchara nemoite. Ase enchera eyio inche Omonene ning’umore ekeririanda kiane igoro yabo.

English: You will know that I am Yahweh when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.
Kiswahili: Nao watajua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana, wakati maiti za watu wao zitakapokuwa zimelala katikati ya sanamu zao kuzunguka madhabahu yao, juu ya kila kilima kilichoinuka na juu ya vilele vyote vya milima, chini ya kila mti uliotanda na kila mwaloni wenye majani, yaani, sehemu walizofukizia uvumba kwa sanamu zao zote.
Ekegusii: Ekero emebere y’ abanto baitirwe er’abe eraire ase egati y’emegwekano yabo bagosasiima eetanaine ebisasimero biabo igoro y’ebigoro bionsi, na igoro y’ebichuria bi’ebitunwa bionsi, na inse y’emete yonsi emebese, na inse ya kera omoaruni, agwo aase aande onsi ase baruerete ebinto bigosokia rimisu rigiya ase emegwekano yabo bagosasiima, erio nario baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

English: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
Kiswahili: Nami nitanyoosha mkono wangu dhidi yao na kuifanya nchi yao ukiwa, kuanzia jangwani hadi Dibla, kila mahali wanapoishi. Ndipo watakapojua ya kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nindambore okoboko kw’ane mbaake, insirie ense yabo n’yetige bosa, ee, aase aande onsi bamenyete nabe bosa kobua erooro ya Dibula. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”

English: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha ase ’nde, riganteebia:

English: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo kwa nchi ya Israeli: Mwisho! Mwisho umekuja juu ya pembe nne za nchi.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, aya naro Omonene agoteebia ense y’Abaisraeli: Oyo nomoerio! Omoerio ngocha ore ase chinsemo inye chi’ense eye.

English: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
Kiswahili: Sasa mwisho umekuja juu yenu nami nitamwaga hasira yangu dhidi yenu. Nitawahukumu sawasawa na matendo yenu na kuwalipiza kwa ajili ya desturi zenu zote za kuchukiza.
Ekegusii: “Bono omoerio ogocheire, na inche ’nkorenta ’nde endamwamu y’ane ebe igoro ase ore, na ninkonachere ekiina koreng’ana nogokora kwao; ninkoe egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwao gwonsi gw’okogechia.

English: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’
Kiswahili: Sitawaonea huruma wala sitawarehemu, hakika nitalipiza kwa ajili ya matendo yenu na desturi zenu za machukizo miongoni mwenu. Ndipo mtakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tinkoombia ng’a tinkoroochi, gose tingokororera amaabera, korende ninkoe egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwao, na ogokora kwao gw’okogechia ’ngokoiranere. Erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”

English: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Maafa! Maafa ambayo hayajasikiwa yanakuja.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Rora, obobe ngoocha bore, obobe borabe bogoetania bonde bwonsi.

English: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.
Kiswahili: Mwisho umewadia! Mwisho umewadia! Umejiinua wenyewe dhidi yenu. Umewadia!
Ekegusii: Omoerio ’ngoocha ore, ee, omoerio ’ngoocha ore okonyore! Naama! Ngoocha ore!

English: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
Kiswahili: Maangamizi yamekuja juu yenu, ninyi mnaoishi katika nchi. Wakati umewadia, siku imekaribia, kuna hofu kuu ya ghafula, wala si furaha, juu ya milima.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete ase ense eye, bono egeku nkobacheera kere. Engaki yao yaikire; rituko ri’omoichano ngocha rire; tirikoba rituko ri’ogoaka amariogi y’omogooko igoro ase ebitunwa.

English: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
Kiswahili: Ninakaribia kumwaga ghadhabu yangu juu yenu na kumaliza hasira yangu dhidi yenu, nitawahukumu sawasawa na matendo yenu na kuwalipiza kwa ajili ya desturi zenu zote za machukizo.
Ekegusii: “Bono yatigaire engaki enke, inche ng’umore okogechigwa kwane na goikerania endamwamu y’ane igoro ase more. Nimbanachere ekiina koreng’ana nogokora kwaino, nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’okogechia kwaino gwonsi.

English: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, strike.
Kiswahili: Sitawaonea huruma wala sitawarehemu; nitawalipiza sawasawa na matendo yenu na desturi zenu za machukizo miongoni mwenu. Ndipo mtajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana ambaye huwapiga kwa mapigo.
Ekegusii: Tinkoombia ng’a timbarochi, gose tinkobarorera amaabera, korende nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino, na ogokora kwaino gw’okogechia nkobairanere. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene nabaakire.

English: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
Kiswahili: “Siku imefika! Imewadia! Maangamizi yamezuka ghafula, fimbo imechanua majivuno yamechipua!
Ekegusii: “Naama! Rituko riria ngocha rire! Ngocha rire! Egeku nkobacheera kere! Enyimbo y’okobaaka yasebokire, na obomwenu bwareeretire.

English: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.
Kiswahili: Jeuri imeinuka kuwa fimbo ya kuadhibu uovu, hakuna hata mmoja wa hao watu atakayeachwa, hata mmoja wa kundi lile, hakuna utajiri, hakuna chenye thamani.
Ekegusii: Okorega okwo gwakiinire, kwabeire enyimbo igoro y’abwo bagokora amabe. Omonto obo tagotigara nonya noyomo; obotenenku bwabo mbosirigwe amo na kende gionsi babwate, na obonene bwabo bwonsi mboere.

English: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.
Kiswahili: Wakati umewadia, siku imefika. Mnunuzi na asifurahi wala muuzaji asihuzunike, kwa maana ghadhabu iko juu ya kundi lote.
Ekegusii: Rituko riria riakire ang’e; omogori tabaisa kogooka, gose omoonia tabasa korera ekiagera endamwamu y’ane

English: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
Kiswahili: Muuzaji hatajipatia tena ardhi aliyoiuza wakati wote wawili wangali hai, kwa kuwa maono kuhusu kundi lote hayatatanguka. Kwa sababu ya dhambi zao, hakuna hata mmoja atakayeokoa maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Omoonia tari gocha koiranerigwa egento ekio aoonetie nonya ogendererete koba moyo. Aya abaanetwe igoro y’omoganda bwonsi tagotigwa taikeranigwa. Onde tari ase abwo bagokora ebibe oranyare gotooria obogima bwaye.

English: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.
Kiswahili: Wajapopiga tarumbeta na kuweka kila kitu tayari, hakuna hata mmoja atakayekwenda vitani, kwa maana ghadhabu yangu iko juu ya kundi lote.
Ekegusii: Babugirie ebitureeri na kobeeka ebinto bionsi ang’e, korende nonya n’oyomo tari oragende ase esegi eyio, ekiagera endamwamu y’ane nigo ere igoro y’omoganda bwonsi.

English: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.
Kiswahili: “Nje ni upanga, ndani ni tauni na njaa, wale walioko shambani watakufa kwa upanga, nao wale waliomo mjini njaa na tauni vitawala.
Ekegusii: “Ogoitwa nemioro nigo kore isiko, na oborwaire bogoita, na enchara, nigo bire ase omochie ime. Omonto okare isiko y’omochie naitwe n’omoro, na oyore ase omochie ime, enchara na oborwaire ’mbimoite.

English: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.
Kiswahili: Wale wote watakaopona na kutoroka watakuwa milimani, wakiomboleza kama hua wa mabondeni, kila mmoja kwa sababu ya dhambi zake.
Ekegusii: Korende abaratigare bare moyo mbatame gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, babe buna amaruma are ase amakuruma, bonsi mbabe bakorera, kera oyomo ase engencho y’ebibe biaye.

English: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.
Kiswahili: Kila mkono utalegea na kila goti litakuwa dhaifu kama maji.
Ekegusii: Mbairianyeke amaboko abo aborwe chinguru, na amaru abo ororobe, abe buna amaache.

English: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
Kiswahili: Watavaa nguo ya gunia na kufunikwa na hofu. Nyuso zao zitafunikwa na aibu na nywele za vichwa vyao zitanyolewa.
Ekegusii: Mbeboyie chigunia, batubwe nomoondoko. Amasio abo nabe nobosooku, na emetwe yabo esunyoke etukia ebe amasio.

English: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.
Kiswahili: Watatupa fedha yao barabarani, nayo dhahabu yao itakuwa najisi. Fedha yao na dhahabu yao havitaweza kuwaokoa katika siku hiyo ya ghadhabu ya Bwana. Hawatashibisha njaa yao au kujaza matumbo yao kwa hiyo fedha wala dhahabu, kwa sababu imewaponza wajikwae dhambini.
Ekegusii: Mbatugute chifeta chiabo ase chinchera; chitaabu chiabo nchibarwe koba buna egento ki’eubi. Chifeta ne chitaabu chiabo tichikonyara kobatooria ase rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene. Ebinto ebio tibigoisanekia okogania kwabo, gose tibikobaigotia, ekiagera nigo biabete ebigocha bikagera bagakora ebibe.

English: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.
Kiswahili: Walijivunia vito vyao vizuri na kuvitumia kufanya sanamu za machukizo na vinyago vya upotovu. Kwa hiyo nitavifanya vitu hivyo kuwa najisi kwao.
Ekegusii: Nigo baenenerete obwari bw’ebinto ebio, na korwa ase ebio bakaroisia emegwekano yabo y’okogechia na ey’obosooku. Ase ayio ninkore ebinto ebio bibe buna eubi ase bare.

English: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.
Kiswahili: Nitavitia vyote mikononi mwa wageni kuwa nyara na kuwa vitu vilivyotekwa mikononi mwa watu waovu wa dunia, nao watavinajisi.
Ekegusii: “Inche nindete abanto abaao basakore ebinto ebio, na abakori amabe b’ense mbabiegwe, babikore bibe ebitachenegeti.

English: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.
Kiswahili: Nitageuza uso wangu mbali nao, nao waovu wa dunia watapanajisi mahali pangu pa thamani, wanyangʼanyi watapaingia na kupanajisi.
Ekegusii: Ning’onchore obosio bwane korwa ase bare, erinde bakore ekungo y’ane ebe eyetachenegeti; abauri mbasoe aroro na koyekora ebe eyetachenegeti.

English: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
Kiswahili: “Andaa minyororo, kwa sababu nchi imejaa umwagaji wa damu na mji umejaa udhalimu.
Ekegusii: “Roisia ebinyuri, ekiagera ense yaichoirwe nogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, na obotindi bwaichoire ase omochie ime.

English: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.
