Kiswahili: Je, mti wake kamwe huchukuliwa na kutengeneza chochote cha manufaa? Je, watu hutengeneza vigingi vya kuningʼinizia vitu kutokana na huo mti wake?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omote oyio nonachwe okorerwe moremo onde? Gose abanto mbaroisie egekongo korwa ase omote oyio basungere egento kende gionsi.

English: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?
Kiswahili: Nao baada ya kutiwa motoni kama nishati na moto ukateketeza ncha zote mbili na kuunguza sehemu ya kati, je, unafaa kwa lolote?
Ekegusii: Nigo okoba chinko orutwa riko. Ekero omorero osambire chinsinyo chiaye chionsi, na obogati bwaye bwarurirwe, Inee, bono moremo ki orakorerwe?

English: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”
Kiswahili: Kama haukufaa kitu chochote ulipokuwa mzima, je, si zaidi sana sasa ambapo hauwezekani kufanyishwa chochote cha kufaa baada ya moto kuuchoma na kuuunguza?
Ekegusii: Naama! Onye ekero omosabibu oyio orenge omogima togwenerete gokorerwa moremo onde bwensi, bono ekero oyire na korurwa nomorero, ’moremo ki orakorerwe?

English: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kama nilivyoutoa mti wa mzabibu miongoni mwa miti ya msituni kuwa nishati kwa ajili ya moto, hivyo ndivyo nitakavyowatendea watu waishio Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Buna koreng’ana naruure omote bw’omosabibu ore ase egati y’emete ende ere ase rinani outerwe omorero oyie, naboigo ndatugute abanto ba Yerusalemu.

English: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, when I set my face against them.
Kiswahili: Nitaukaza uso wangu dhidi yao. Ingawa watakuwa wameokoka kwenye moto, bado moto utawateketeza. Nami nitakapoukaza uso wangu dhidi yao, ninyi mtajua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nigo ndababee; nonya bagochia gotooreka korwa ase omorero, naende omorero n’oro orabasirie. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, nababeeire.

English: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Nitaifanya nchi kuwa ukiwa kwa sababu wamekuwa si waaminifu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”
Ekegusii: Ninsirie ense eyio ebe bosa, ekiagera bakorire aya atari ay’obwegenwa. Nabo Omonene ateebire.”

English: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:

English: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, ijulishe Yerusalemu kuhusu mwenendo wake wa machukizo
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, manyia Yerusalemu okogechia kwaye.

English: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.
Kiswahili: na useme, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi, analomwambia Yerusalemu: Wewe asili yako na kuzaliwa kwako ni katika nchi ya Kanaani, baba yako alikuwa Mwamori, naye mama yako alikuwa Mhiti.
Ekegusii: Teebia Yerusalemu ng’a aya naro Omonene akoyoteebia. “Aye nigo kwaiboreretwe ase ense ya Kaanani. Iso nigo arenge Omoamori, na nyoko n’Omohiti orenge.

English: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.
Kiswahili: Siku uliyozaliwa kitovu chako hakikukatwa, wala hukuogeshwa kwa maji ili kukufanya safi, wala hukusuguliwa kwa chumvi wala kufunikwa kwa nguo.
Ekegusii: Rituko kwaiboretwe ororera rwao tirwanachetwe, gose tigwasibetigwe namaache orabe, gose tikwaagetwe omonyoo, gose tikwabeekeretwe eanga y’obwana.

English: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yeyote aliyekuonea huruma au kukusikitikia kiasi cha kukutendea mojawapo ya mambo haya. Badala yake, ulipozaliwa ulitupwa nje penye uwanja, kwa kuwa katika siku uliyozaliwa ulidharauliwa.
Ekegusii: Monto onde takororerete amabeebe agokorere ring’ana nonya n’erimo ase ayio, gose gokororera amaabera; korende nigo gwatugutetwe isiko aarabu, ekiagera rituko erio kwaiboretwe nigo kwangetwe.

English: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ndipo nilipopita karibu nawe nikakuona ukigaagaa kwenye damu yako, nawe ulipokuwa umelala hapo penye hiyo damu nikakuambia, “Ishi!”
Ekegusii: “Ekero naetete agwo ase kwarenge, ngakorora gokwegara‐garia ime ase amanyinga ao, nkagoteebia: Buna oraire ase amanyinga ao ime, obe moyo; ee, nkagoteebia: Buna oraire ase amanyinga ao ime, obe moyo.

English: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.
Kiswahili: Nilikufanya uote kama mmea wa shambani. Ukakua na kuongezeka sana, ukawa kito cha thamani kuliko vyote. Matiti yako yakatokeza na nywele zako zikaota, wewe uliyekuwa uchi na bila kitu chochote.
Ekegusii: Nkagokiinia okamenteka okaba chilifu ne chilifu, buna ebimeri bire ase riroba. Ogakiina okaba omonene na omonyakieni: chimbeere chiao chigakina, na etukia yao boigo; korende nonya naboigo, nigo kwarenge getirianda, tikwabegete kende.

English: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and you became mine.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Baadaye nikapita karibu nawe, nilipokutazama na kukuona kuwa umefikia umri wa kupendwa, nililitandaza vazi langu juu yako na kuufunika uchi wako. Nikakuapia na kuingia kwenye Agano na wewe, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, nawe ukawa wangu.
Ekegusii: “Ekero naende naetete ase ore, ngakorigereria, nkarora ng’a gwaikire engaki y’ogwanchwa. Nkagotuba nomwambaro one, nkabisia obogetirianda bwao. Naende ngakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania naye, erio aye okaba oy’one. Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nilikuogesha kwa maji, nikakuosha ile damu na kukupaka mafuta.
Ekegusii: “Erio nkagosibia n’amaache, ngasibia amanyinga ao onsi na kogoaka amaguta.

English: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
Kiswahili: Nikakuvika vazi lililotariziwa na kukuvalisha viatu vya kamba vya ngozi. Nikakuvika nguo za kitani safi na kukufunika kwa mavazi ya thamani kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ngakobekera eanga eroisirie ere nebieni ao ao, ngakobekera na ebikoroto bie risankwa riterere ri’eng’iti ya rooche. Ngakoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani engiya, naende ngakobekera egietubo ki’ariri.

English: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.
Kiswahili: Nikakupamba kwa vito: nikakuvika bangili mikononi mwako na mkufu shingoni mwako,
Ekegusii: Nkagochabera n’ebinto bi’obwari, na ase amaboko ao ngakobekera chibangiri, ne chisonoi ase rigoti ria’o.

English: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
Kiswahili: nikaweka hazama puani mwako, vipuli masikioni mwako na taji nzuri sana kichwani mwako.
Ekegusii: Nkabeka ebonyi ase emioro yao, na ebigera ase amato ao, na eguutwa enseera ase omotwe oo.

English: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ulipambwa kwa dhahabu na fedha, nguo zako zilikuwa za kitani safi, hariri na nguo iliyokuwa imetariziwa. Chakula chako kilikuwa unga laini, asali na mafuta ya zeituni. Ukawa mzuri sana ukainuka kuwa malkia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye ogaachaberwa ne chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chianga chiao nigo chiarenge echi’egatani engiya, na echi’ariri, na echiroisirie chire nebieni ao ao. Boigo okaria endagera yaroiseretigwe nobosie obonuke, na okaria obooke, na amaguta. Erio okaba omonyakieni mono, ogasesenigwa, ogaikera ekerengo ki’oborwoti.

English: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Umaarufu wako ulifahamika miongoni mwa mataifa kwa ajili ya uzuri wako, kwani ulikuwa mkamilifu kwa ajili ya utukufu wangu niliokuwa nimeuweka juu yako, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Okamanyekana ase ebisaku ase engencho y’oboseera bwao. Oboseera bwao nigo bwarenge oboikeranu, ekiagera ninche nakoboete.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini ulitumainia uzuri wako na kutumia umaarufu wako kuwa kahaba. Ulifanya uzinzi kwa kila mtu aliyepita, uzuri wako ukawa kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: “Korende aye nigo gwasemeretie oboseera bwao, erio ogekora omotaayayi, ekiagera kwamanyekanete mono, ogekaayayia ase abaeti bonsi, ogechwara ase onde bwensi.

English: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.
Kiswahili: Ulichukua baadhi ya mavazi yako ukayatumia kupamba mahali pako pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, mahali ambapo ulifanyia ukahaba wako. Mambo ya namna hiyo hayastahili kutendeka wala kamwe kutokea.
Ekegusii: Okaira chianga chiao, ogaachabera aase aimokererete igoro akaba nebieni ao ao, na aroro agwo ogakorera obonyaka bwao. Amang’ana anga buna ayio tana gokorekana korwa kare, na tagokorekana aande nonya ng’ake.

English: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.
Kiswahili: Pia ulichukua vito vizuri nilivyokupa, vito vilivyotengenezwa kwa dhahabu yangu na fedha yangu, ukajitengenezea navyo sanamu za kiume na ukafanya ukahaba nazo.
Ekegusii: Naende okaimokia ebinto biao ebiya bie chitaabu na ebie chifeta nakoete, erio okeroiseria emegwekano yogosasiima enga abasacha, erio ogakora obonyaka n’ero.

English: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.
Kiswahili: Ukayachukua mavazi yako niliyokupa yaliyotariziwa na ukazivalisha hizo sanamu, ukatoa mbele ya hizo sanamu mafuta yangu na uvumba wangu.
Ekegusii: Naende okaira chianga chiao chiare n’ebieni ao ao, ogatuba emegwekano eria, na okabeka amaguta ane na ubani y’ane ase amasio abo.

English: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Pia chakula changu nilichokupa ili ule: unga laini, mafuta ya zeituni na asali, ulivitoa mbele yao kuwa uvumba wa harufu nzuri. Hayo ndiyo yaliyotokea, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Omogati one nakoete, na obosie obonuke, na amaguta amaya, na obooke, ebio okabirua ase emegwekano eyio koba rimisu rigiya rikoyegwenera; ee, nabo gwakorete.” Nab’Omonene ateebire.

English: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nawe uliwachukua wanao na binti zako ulionizalia mimi na kuwatoa kafara kuwa chakula kwa sanamu. Je, ukahaba wako haukukutosha?
Ekegusii: “Naende okaira abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, abwo kwanyiborerete, okabarua bakaba ebing’wanso ase emegwekano eyio, okabasiria. Inee! Obonyaka obwo bwao ne ring’ana riike?

English: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?
Kiswahili: Uliwachinja watoto wangu na kuwatoa kafara kwa sanamu.
Ekegusii: Nering’ana riike aye kwaruete abana bane bakaba ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase emegwekano eyio?

English: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.
Kiswahili: Katika matendo yako yote ya machukizo, pamoja na ukahaba wako hukukumbuka siku za ujana wako, wakati ulipokuwa uchi kabisa bila kitu chochote, ulipokuwa ukigaagaa kwenye damu yako.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio kwarenge gokora ebibe bi’okogechia, na obotaayayi, tikwainyorete amatuko aria y’oboke bwao, ekero kwarenge getirianda otabegete kende, na kwarenge kwegaragaria ime ase amanyinga ao.”

English: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord Yahweh—
Kiswahili: “ ‘Ole! Ole wako! Asema Bwana Mwenyezi. Pamoja na maovu yako yote mengine,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene nigo agoteeba iga, “Obobe nobwao! Magega kogwakorire amabe aya onsi,

English: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.
Kiswahili: Ukajijengea jukwaa na kujifanyia mahali pa fahari pa ibada za miungu kwenye kila uwanja wa mikutano.
Ekegusii: okeagachera ebinyomba bi’emegwekano ogosasiima, na ase kera enchera kwaagachire aase aimokererete igoro ogosasiimera.

English: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
Kiswahili: Katika kila mwanzo wa barabara ulijenga mahali pa fahari pa ibada za miungu na kuaibisha uzuri wako, ukiutoa mwili wako kwa kuzidisha uzinzi kwa kila apitaye.
Ekegusii: Ase kera amatabekania ye chinchera kwaagachire aase aimokererete igoro ogosasiimera, kwanyakairie oboseera bwao, gwechwarire ase onde bwensi ogoeta, na gwakorire obonyaka obonge.

English: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.
Kiswahili: Ulifanya ukahaba wako na Wamisri, jirani zako waliojaa tamaa, ukaichochea hasira yangu kwa kuongezeka kwa uzinzi wako.
Ekegusii: Nigo gwakorete obonyaka n’Abamisiri, abanto abwo mosinyaine bare nokogania okobe; okamenta obonyaka bwao, na okagera nkagechigwa nkaba n’endamwamu.

English: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nilinyoosha mkono wangu dhidi yako na kuipunguza nchi yako, nikakutia kwenye ulafi wa adui zako, binti za Wafilisti, walioshtushwa na tabia yako ya uasherati.
Ekegusii: “Rora, naramboire okoboko kw’ane kogoaka, nakeeirie endagera yao, naende nakorure nakobekire ase abakungu b’Abafilisti, abwo bakogechete naende barorire obosooku ase ogokora kwao kw’obonyaka, erinde bagokorere buna banchete.

English: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.
Kiswahili: Ulifanya ukahaba na Waashuru pia, kwa kuwa hukuridhika, hata baada ya hayo, ukawa bado hukutosheleka.
Ekegusii: “Naende ngwakorete obonyaka n’Abaasuri, ekiagera tigwaisanegete, ee, ngwakorete obotaayayi nabarabwo, nonya naboigo tigwaisanegete.

English: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.
Kiswahili: Ndipo ukaongeza uzinzi wako kwa Wakaldayo nchi ya wafanyabiashara, hata katika hili hukutosheka.
Ekegusii: Nkwamentete obotaayayi bwao, okagenda nonya ngochia ase ense y’Abakalidayo, abwo bare abaonchoreria, na barabwo boigo tibagoisanegetie.”

English: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord Yahweh, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Tazama jinsi ulivyo na dhamiri dhaifu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, unapofanya mambo haya yote, ukifanya kama kahaba asiyekuwa na aibu!
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Naki enkoro yao ere nokogania okonene kw’ogwanchwa, ekiagera gwakorire aya onsi, ayare buna ogokora kw’omokuungu omonyaka otari korora obosooku.

English: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.
Kiswahili: Unapojenga jukwaa lako kila mwanzo wa barabara na kufanyiza mahali pa fahari pa ibada za miungu katika kila kiwanja cha wazi, lakini hukuwa kama kahaba, kwa sababu ulidharau malipo.
Ekegusii: Kweagacheire ebinyomba bi’emegwekano ogosasiima ase amatabekania onsi ye chinchera, na ase kera enchera kwaagachire aase aimokererete igoro ogosasimera. Nonya naboigo tikwarenge buna omokungu omotaayayi onde bwensi, ekiagera nigo gwachaayete ogoakanerwa gwe chitaabu.

English: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wewe mke mzinzi! Unapenda wageni, kuliko mume wako mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Aye omokungu omotomani nigo gwatigete omosacha oo okaba kore nabasaacha abaao!

English: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.
Kiswahili: Kila kahaba hupokea malipo, lakini wewe hutoa zawadi kwa wapenzi wako wote, ukiwahonga ili waje kwako kutoka kila mahali kwa ajili ya ukahaba wako.
Ekegusii: Abasacha nigo bakorwa chitaabu baa abakungu abatayayi, korende aye nigo okorua echiao kwaa abanchi bao ase okobaebereria bache korwa chinsemo chionsi bakore obonyaka naye.

English: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wewe ulikuwa tofauti na wanawake wengine kwenye ukahaba wako, hakuna aliyekutongoza ili kuzini naye, wewe ndiye uliyelipa wakati hakuna malipo uliyolipwa wewe. Wewe ulikuwa tofauti.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo ore nogwatananeka korwa ase abakungu bande abatayayi. Monto onde tagotuny’anete arigie gokora obonyaka naye, korende naye omonyene kwaruete chitaabu ase obonyaka obwo. Ase ayio nigo ore nogwatananeka korwa ase abatayayi bande.

English: “Therefore, prostitute, hear Yahweh’s word:
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo, wewe kahaba, sikia neno la Bwana!
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye omotayayi, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!

English: ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa kuwa umemwaga tamaa zako na kuonyesha uchi wako katika uzinzi wako kwa wapenzi wako na kwa sababu ya sanamu zako zote za machukizo na kwa sababu uliwapa damu ya watoto wako,
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Obosooku bwao bwaorokigwe isiko, na obogetirianda bwao tibotubiri ekero ogokora obonyaka nabanchi bao. Naende nigo gwasasimete emegwekano yao y’okogechia na okarua abana bao bakaba ekeng’wanso ase emegwekano eyio.

English: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
Kiswahili: kwa hiyo nitawakusanya wapenzi wako wote, wale ambao ulijifurahisha nao, wale uliowapenda na wale uliowachukia pia. Nitawakusanya wote dhidi yako kutoka pande zote na nitakuvua nguo mbele yao, nao wataona uchi wako wote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ninsangererie abanchi bao abwo kwegokeretie, na bonsi abwo gwanchete, na abwo kwageechete; nimbasangererie korwa ase chinsemo chionsi bagoetanane, ngwasiorie, erinde barore obogetirianda bwao.

English: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
Kiswahili: Nitakuhukumia adhabu wanayopewa wanawake wafanyao uasherati na hao wamwagao damu, nitaleta juu yenu kisasi cha damu cha ghadhabu yangu na wivu wa hasira yangu.
Ekegusii: Ninkonachere ekiina buna abakungu basaririe chiira chi’okonyuomana kwabo na buna abaiteri amanyinga bakonacherwa ekiina; amanyinga ao ninyaitere inde nendamwamu ne risemi.

English: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.
Kiswahili: Kisha nitakutia mikononi mwa wapenzi wako, nao watabomoa majukwaa yako na kuharibu mahali pako pa fahari pa ibada ya miungu. Watakuvua nguo zako na kuchukua vito vyako vya thamani na kukuacha uchi na bila kitu.
Ekegusii: Ninkobeke ase amaboko ’abanchi bao; barabwo mbatagore ebinyomba biria kweagacherete bi’emegwekano ogosasiima amo nase ao aimokererete igoro. Naende mbakorusie chianga chiao, na baire ebinto biao ebiya bi’ogwechabera, bagotige kore getirianda otabegeti eanga.

English: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.
Kiswahili: Wataleta kundi la watu dhidi yako, watakaokupiga kwa mawe na kukukatakata vipande vipande kwa panga zao.
Ekegusii: “Abwo mbagochere amo nomoganda omonene, bagoake amagena na gokobutorana nemioro.

English: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.
Kiswahili: Watachoma nyumba zako na kutekeleza adhabu juu yako machoni pa wanawake wengi. Nitakomesha ukahaba wako, nawe hutawalipa tena wapenzi wako.
Ekegusii: Mbasambe chinyomba chiao, naende bakonachere ekiina ase amasio ’abakuungu abange. Ningotange tokora obonyaka, na tokogenderera korua chitaabu ase obonyaka naende.

English: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.
Kiswahili: Ndipo ghadhabu yangu dhidi yako itakapopungua na wivu wa hasira yangu utaondoka kwako. Nitatulia wala sitakasirika tena.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ning’isanekie endamwamu y’ane ase ore, ne risemi riane ndirue ase ore, erio nario ndabe n’obotoereru, gose tinkogechigwa naende.

English: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord Yahweh: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa sababu hukuzikumbuka siku za ujana wako, lakini ulinikasirisha kwa mambo haya yote, hakika nitaleta juu ya kichwa chako yale uliyotenda, asema Bwana Mwenyezi. Je hukuongeza uasherati juu ya matendo yako yote ya kuchukiza?
Ekegusii: Ekiagera otainyorete amatuko aria ay’oboke bwao, korende kwabeire gokongechia nogokora kwao gwonsi, rora, ningoakane ogokora kwao gokoiranere, na igo togokora ogokora okwo kw’obosooku gokomenta ase ebibe binde bi’okogechia gwakorire.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kila mtu atumiaye maneno ya mithali hii, atayatumia juu yako: “Alivyo mama, ndivyo alivyo bintiye.”
Ekegusii: “Rora, omonto onde bwensi oganetie gokwana omoreng’anio, nigo arakwane igoro yao, atebe: Buna ng’ina omosubati are, nabo nomosubati oye are.

English: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni binti halisi wa mama yako, ambaye alimchukia kabisa mume wake na watoto wake, tena wewe ni dada halisi wa dada zako, waliowachukia kabisa waume zao na watoto wao. Mama yako alikuwa Mhiti na baba yako alikuwa Mwamori.
Ekegusii: Aye omosubati nigo onga nyoko, oria bwangete omosacha oye, na abana baye; naende nigo onga basubati bamino, abwo bangete abasacha babo, na abana babo. Nyoko nigo arenge Omohiti na iso n’Omoamiori orenge.

English: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.
Kiswahili: Dada yako mkubwa alikuwa Samaria, aliyeishi upande wako wa kaskazini na binti zake, pamoja na dada yake, naye dada yako mdogo, aliyeishi kusini yako pamoja na binti zake, alikuwa Sodoma.
Ekegusii: “Mosubati omino omonene nere Samaria, oyio omenyete amo nabaiseke baye ensemo yao ya sugusu, na mosubati omino omoke nere Sodomu, oyio omenyete amo nabaiseke baye ensemo ya Irianyi.

English: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.
Kiswahili: Hukuziendea njia zao tu na kuiga matendo yao ya kuchukiza, bali kwa muda mfupi katika njia zako zote uliharibika tabia zaidi kuliko wao.
Ekegusii: Aye tigwaisanegete ase okobwatia chinchera chiabo, gose aria gwakorete koreng’ana nokogechia kwabo, korende ase engaki enke yoka aye ogakora ayare amabe kobua ayabo, ase chinchera chiao chionsi.

English: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
Kiswahili: Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, dada yako Sodoma pamoja na binti zake, kamwe hawakufanya yale ambayo wewe na binti zako mmefanya.
Ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, Sodomu, mosubati omino, na abaiseke baye, tibarakora buna aye gwakorire amo nabaiseke bao.

English: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Sasa hii ilikuwa ndiyo dhambi ya dada yako Sodoma: yeye na binti zake walikuwa na majivuno, walafi na wazembe, hawakuwasaidia maskini na wahitaji.
Ekegusii: Naama! Ebi nabio biarenge ebibe bia Sodomu, mosubati omino: Ere amo nabaiseke baye nigo barenge abaenenu na abaigotu b’endagera, naende nigo barenge n’obotoereru, korende tibechanderete abataka na abaremerwa.

English: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
Kiswahili: Walijivuna na kufanya mambo ya machukizo sana mbele zangu. Kwa hiyo niliwakatilia mbali nami kama mlivyoona.
Ekegusii: Nigo barenge abamwenu, na bakaba bagokora ay’okogechia ase obosio bwane, Ase ayio, ekero narooche amang’ana ayio, nigo nabarusetieo.

English: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.
Kiswahili: Samaria hakufanya hata nusu ya dhambi ulizofanya. Wewe umefanya mambo mengi sana ya kuchukiza kuwaliko wao, nawe umewafanya dada zako waonekane kama wenye haki kwa ajili ya mambo haya yote uliyoyafanya.
Ekegusii: “Samaria tiyakorete ebibe, nonya nekeng’ese kereng’aine ebiao; aye gwakorire ebibe ebinge bi’okogechia kobua emechie eyio. Ase engencho eyio kwagerire basubati bamino barorekanire bare abanyaboronge, ekero ebibe biao bikoreng’anigwa nebiabo.

English: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
Kiswahili: Chukua aibu yako, kwa kuwa umefanya uovu wa dada zako uwe si kitu, nao waonekane kama wenye haki. Kwa kuwa dhambi zako zilikuwa mbaya zaidi kuliko zao, wameonekana wenye haki zaidi kuliko wewe. Kwa hiyo basi, chukua aibu yako, kwa kuwa umewafanya dada zako waonekane wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Bono aye bogoria obosooku bwao bw’ogochaaywa, ekiagera kwagerire basubati bamino banyorire obotamero. Ebibe biao bi’okogechia biabeire ebinge kobua ebiabo; bono barabwo nigo bakororekana ng’a nabanyaboronge bare gokobua. Ase ayio, kabe nobosooku bw’ogochaaywa, ekiagera kwagerire basubati bamino barorekanire bare abanyaboronge.

English: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini nitarudisha baraka za Sodoma na binti zake na za Samaria na binti zake, nami nitarudisha baraka zako pamoja na zao,
Ekegusii: “Inche ninsibore abasibwa b’emechie eye: abasibwa ba Sodomu amo nab’abaiseke baye, na Abasamaria amo nab’abaiseke baye. Boigo naye Yerusalemu ningosibore kore ase egati yabo,

English: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.
Kiswahili: ili upate kuchukua aibu yako na kufedheheka kwa ajili ya yote uliyotenda ambayo yamekuwa faraja kwao wakijilinganisha na wewe.
Ekegusii: erinde obogorie ogochaaywa kwao orore obosooku ase engencho y’ayio onsi gwakorire, na ase enchera eyio nobaretere okoremia.

English: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.
Kiswahili: Nao dada zako, Sodoma na binti zake na Samaria na binti zake, watarudishwa kama vile walivyokuwa mwanzoni, nawe pamoja na binti zako mtarudishwa kama mlivyokuwa hapo awali.
Ekegusii: Aya naro arabe ase abasubati bamino: Sodomu na abaiseke baye nabairanerigwe amaya abo, babe buna barenge ritang’ani, na Samaria na abaiseke baye mbairanerigwe amaya abo, babe buna barenge ritang’ani. Naye boigo na abaiseke bao moiranerigwe amaya aino, mobe buna mwarenge ritang’ani.

English: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
Kiswahili: Hukuweza hata kumtaja dada yako Sodoma kwa sababu ya dharau yako katika siku za kiburi chako,
Ekegusii: Inee! Sodomu, mosubati omino, tabeete omobayeeno kwarenge gokwana ase okomochaaya, ekero kwarenge noboenenu.

English: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.
Kiswahili: kabla uovu wako haujafunuliwa. Hata hivyo, sasa unadhihakiwa na binti za Edomu na jirani zake wote, na binti za Wafilisti, wale wote wanaokuzunguka wanakudharau.
Ekegusii: Ekero keria ebibe biao konya bitaraorokigwa maiso marore? Bono kwabeire buna ere. Abaiseke b’ense ya Edomu, na ab’Abafilisti, abwo bagoetanaine ase chinsemo chiao chionsi, nigo bagochaayete.

English: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Utachukua matokeo ya uasherati wako na matendo yako ya kuchukiza, asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Bono goika obogorie egesusuro ki’ogokora kwao okobe, na okogechia kwao gwonsi.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitakushughulikia kama unavyostahili, kwa kuwa umedharau kiapo changu kwa kuvunja Agano.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ningokorere koreng’ana buna gwakorire, ekiagera gwachaayire eira gwatianete, na gwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania.

English: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
Kiswahili: Lakini nitakumbuka Agano nililolifanya nawe wakati wa ujana wako, nami nitaweka nawe Agano imara la milele.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo ning’inyore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete naye ase amatuko aria y’obobe bwao, ninkore naye okobwatana kw’ogotianania koragenderere goika kare na kare.

English: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
Kiswahili: Ndipo utakapozikumbuka njia zako na kuona aibu utakapowapokea dada zako, wale walio wakubwa wako na wadogo wako. Nitakupa hao wawe binti zako, lakini si katika msingi wa Agano langu na wewe.
Ekegusii: Erio aye oinyore ogokora kwao obe nobosooku, ekero oraire basubati bamino abanene na abake. Ninkobae babe abaiseke bao, korende tari ase engencho y’okobwatana kw’ane kw’ogotianania koria nakorete naye.

English: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;
Kiswahili: Hivyo nitalifanya imara Agano langu na wewe, nawe utajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ninkong’ie okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania koria nakorete naye; erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

English: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”
Kiswahili: Basi, nitakapofanya upatanisho kwa ajili yako, kwa yale yote uliyoyatenda, utakumbuka na kuaibika, nawe kamwe hutafumbua tena kinywa chako kwa sababu ya aibu yako, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ekero ’ndabe nakwabeire aya onsi gwakorire, aye noyainyore erinde oumate okirekiri, tomumora omonwa oo, ase engencho y’obosooku bwao. Nabo Omonene ateebire.”

English: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, tega kitendawili, ukawaambie nyumba ya Israeli fumbo.
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, kwana omobayeeno, oteebie Abaisraeli omoreng’anio.

English: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.
Kiswahili: Waambie hivi, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Tai mkubwa mwenye mabawa yenye nguvu, yaliyojaa manyoya marefu ya rangi mbalimbali, alikuja Lebanoni. Akatua kwenye kilele cha mwerezi,
Ekegusii: Obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ekeongo ekenene kiabwate chimbaaba chinene, na amarionya ye chimbaaba chiaye namatambe, na omobere oye nigo otubire n’amarionya arenge nebieni ao ao, kegaacha Lebanoni, gekabutora enkoro y’omocharake.

English: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.
Kiswahili: akakwanyua ncha yake na kuichukua mpaka nchi ya wafanyabiashara, akaipanda huko katika mji wa wachuuzi.
Ekegusii: Erio gekabutora n’enkoro y’omote oria mesia, gekayeira gochia ase ense y’oboonchoreria, gekayebeeka ase omochie bw’abaonchoreria.

English: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Akachukua baadhi ya mbegu za nchi yako na kuziweka katika udongo wenye rutuba. Akazipanda kama mti umeao kando ya maji mengi,
Ekegusii: Naende gekaimokia embusuro y’ense eyio gekayesimeka ase riroba ritobu, gekayesimeka ase egati y’emete enga emesobeti ase amaache amaange arenge.

English: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.
Kiswahili: nazo zikaota na kuwa mzabibu mfupi, unaoeneza matawi yake. Matawi yake yakamwelekea huyo tai, mizizi yake ikabaki chini ya huo mzabibu. Kwa hiyo ukawa mzabibu na kutoa matawi na vitawi vyenye majani mengi.
Ekegusii: Embusuro eria ekamera, ekaba omosabibu omweng’e orandete mono; emerande yaye ekaranda gochia ase ekeongo keria nemeri yaye, ekabeera ase giateneine. Ase igo ekaba omosabibu ore ne chinsagia na ebisabo.

English: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini kulikuwa na tai mwingine mkubwa, mwenye mabawa yenye nguvu yaliyojaa manyoya. Tazama! Huu mzabibu ukatoa mizizi yake kumwelekea huyo tai kutoka mle kwenye shamba lile ulikopandwa na kutanda matawi yake kumwelekea kwa ajili ya kupata maji.
Ekegusii: “Korende nkiarengeo ekeongo kende ekenene kiabwate chimbaaba chinene, na amarionya amaange. Korwa aase omosabibu oria osimekire okaroria emeri yaye gochia ase ekeongo keria, naende ogakumba chinsagia chiaye gochia ase kiarenge ng’a keyonyorere amaache.

English: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’
Kiswahili: Ulikuwa umepandwa katika udongo mzuri wenye maji mengi ili uweze kutoa matawi, kuzaa matunda na uweze kuwa mzabibu mzuri sana.’
Ekegusii: Korende omosabibu oyio konya osimekirwe ase riroba ritobu, ase amaache amaange arenge, erinde onyare gosokia chinsagia, bwame amasabibu na obe omosabibu omuya.

English: “Say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.
Kiswahili: “Waambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Je, utastawi? Je, hautangʼolewa na kuondolewa matunda yake, ili uweze kunyauka? Majani yake mapya yanayochipua yote yatanyauka. Hautahitaji mkono wenye nguvu au watu wengi kuungʼoa na mizizi yake.
Ekegusii: “Aye oteebe ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Inee! Omosabibu oria nogenderere gokiina buya? Togosimorwa amo nemeri yaye, na amasabibu aye ataborwe, otigwe okwoma? Ee, amato aye onsi nome. Tokogania chinguru chinyinge, gose abanto abange, ase okoyosimora amo nemeri yaye.

English: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”
Kiswahili: Hata kama utapandwa pengine, Je, utastawi? Je, hautanyauka kabisa wakati upepo wa mashariki utakapoupiga, yaani, hautanyauka kabisa katika udongo mzuri ambamo ulikuwa umestawi vizuri?’ ”
Ekegusii: Naama! Nonya osimekirwe naende, Inee, nogenderere gokiina buya? Tokwoma kegima ekero omwaga okorwa moocha orayoguserere? Gose bwome kegima agwo ase osimekire?”

English: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:

English: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.
Kiswahili: “Waambie nyumba hii ya kuasi, ‘Je, mnajua hii ina maana gani?’ Waambie: ‘Mfalme wa Babeli alikwenda Yerusalemu na kumchukua mfalme na watu maarufu, akarudi nao na kuwaleta mpaka Babeli.
Ekegusii: “Boria egesaku eke getari koigwera: Timomanyeti engencho y’amang’ana aya? Bateebie: Rora, omorwoti o Babiloni nachete Yerusalemu, akaira omorwoti na abagaambi b’aroro goika Babiloni.

English: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,
Kiswahili: Ndipo akamchukua mmoja wa jamaa ya mfalme na kufanya mapatano naye, akamfanya aape. Akawachukua pia viongozi wa nchi,
Ekegusii: Ere akaimokia omoiborwa bw’enyomba y’omorwoti, agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere, na akamoteebia arie eira y’ogwetiania, (Abanto b’ense eria baare nokobua akabaira

English: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
Kiswahili: ili kuudhoofisha ufalme huo, usiweze kuinuka tena, ila uweze kuendelea tu chini ya mapatano yake.
Ekegusii: ng’a oborwoti boria tiboba ne chinguru na kweimokereria igoro, korende okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere onye boganetie kogenderera:)

English: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?
Kiswahili: Lakini mfalme aliasi dhidi yake kwa kutuma wajumbe wake kwenda Misri ili kupatiwa farasi na jeshi kubwa. Je, atashinda? Je, atafanikiwa? Je, mtu afanyaye mambo kama hayo ataokoka? Je, atavunja mapatano na bado aokoke?
Ekegusii: Ere oyio agasaria okobwatana koria, agatoma abanto ase ense ya Misiri gosaba aegwe chibarasi na abarwani esegi abange. Inee! Omonto ogokora amang’ana buna ayio nasesenigwe? Natooreke? Omonto osaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania natooreke?

English: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, atafia huko Babeli, katika nchi ya mfalme aliyemketisha katika kiti cha enzi, ambaye alidharau kiapo chake na kuvunja mapatano yake.
Ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, omorwoti oyio ochaayire eira yaye atianete ase omorwoti o Babiloni, oria omobegete akaba omorwoti, na osaririe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, oyio goika akwere aaria Babiloni.

English: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.
Kiswahili: Farao na jeshi lake kubwa, na wingi wake wa watu hawataweza kusaidia chochote katika vita, wakati watakapozungukwa na jeshi ili kukatilia mbali maisha ya watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Farao na abarwani baye b’esegi abange tibakonyara gokonya omorwoti oyio ase esegi, ekero chiburi chiraagachwe, amo ne chindwaki chi’okoboera ase ogosiria abanto abange.

English: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.
Kiswahili: Alidharau kiapo kwa kuvunja Agano. Kwa sababu aliahidi kwa mkono wake mwenyewe na bado akafanya mambo haya yote, hataokoka.
Ekegusii: Takonyara gotooreka abe moyo, ekiagera achaayete eira yaye atianete, na agasaria okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.

English: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Hakika kama niishivyo, nitaleta juu ya kichwa chake kiapo changu, alichokidharau na Agano langu lile alilolivunja.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteeba: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ekiagera achaayete eira eria atianete asende, na agasaria okobwatana kw’ane kw’ogotianania, nimoakane ogokora kwaye komoiranere.

English: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.
Kiswahili: Nitautandaza wavu wangu kwa ajili yake, naye atanaswa katika mtego wangu. Nitamleta mpaka Babeli na kutekeleza hukumu juu yake huko kwa kuwa hakuwa mwaminifu kwangu.
Ekegusii: Nimobekere ekeonga kiane, abwatwe ase oboreba bwane; erio imoire Babiloni, na aroro agwo nimonachere ekiina ase engencho y’okomocha kw’ogotaba omwegenwa asende.

English: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’
Kiswahili: Askari wake wote wanaotoroka wataanguka kwa upanga, nao watakaonusurika watatawanyika katika pande zote za dunia. Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi Bwana nimesema.
Ekegusii: Abarwani baye b’esegi abaratame ’mbakenywe nemioro, na abatigari mbasiarerwe gochia ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense. Erio nario moramanye ng’a ninche Omonene nakwanire.”

English: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Mimi mwenyewe nitachukua chipukizi kutoka kwenye kilele cha juu sana cha mwerezi na kukipanda, nitavunja kitawi kichanga kutoka matawi yake ya juu kabisa na kukipanda juu ya mlima mrefu ulioinuka sana.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Nonya ninche nimbutore enkoro y’omocharake omotambe, ee, nimbutore enkoro y’omote oria mesia egesabo ekerere, inche omonyene ngesimeke ase egetunwa egetambe igoro.

English: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.
Kiswahili: Katika vilele vya mlima mrefu wa Israeli nitakipanda, kitatoa matawi na kuzaa matunda na kuwa mwerezi mzuri sana. Ndege wa kila aina wataweka viota vyao ndani yake, nao watapata makazi katika kivuli cha matawi yake.
Ekegusii: Ningesimeke igoro ase egetunwa egetambe ki’Abaisraeli, na omote oria nosokie chinsagia na kwama amatunda, obe omocharake omuya. Chinyoni chia kera egesaku nchimenye ase chinsagia chiaye na gokenderera ase ekiriri kiaye.

English: All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘I, Yahweh, have spoken and have done it.’”
Kiswahili: Miti yote ya kondeni itajua kuwa Mimi Bwana ninaishusha miti mirefu na kuikuza miti mifupi kuwa miti mirefu. Mimi naikausha miti mibichi na kuifanya miti mikavu istawi. “ ‘Mimi Bwana nimesema, nami nitatenda.’ ”
Ekegusii: Emete yonsi egokiina korwa ase riroba nemanye ng’a ninche Omonene, ninche ngokeyia emete emetambe, naende natambeia eyere emieng’e. Nigo nkwomia emete ere emebese, naende nasebokia na koreeretia eyomire. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio, goika n’yakore.

English: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende naende, riganteebia:

English: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
Kiswahili: “Je, ninyi watu mna maana gani kutumia mithali hii inayohusu nchi ya Israeli: “ ‘Baba wamekula zabibu zenye chachu, nayo meno ya watoto yametiwa ganzi’?
Ekegusii: Ninki engencho y’omorabaaro oyo okoiranererwa gokwanwa ase ense y’Abaisraeli: Abaise barire amasabibu amabese amaroro, na amaino y’abana babo abeire n’obokang’iti?

English: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.
Kiswahili: “Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, hamtatumia tena mithali hii katika Israeli.
Ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: Ekeene buna inche inde moyo, timokogenderera gokwana omorabaaro oyo ase ense y’Abaisraeli.

English: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kila roho ni mali yangu, kama vile ilivyo roho ya baba, vivyo hivyo roho ya mtoto ni mali yangu. Roho itendayo dhambi ndiyo itakayokufa.
Ekegusii: Naama! Emioyo y’ abanto bonsi ney’ane; koreng’ana buna omoyo o ise ore oyone, boigo noyo bw’omwana ore oyone. Omonto oyio ogokora ebibe, nere orakwe.

English: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,
Kiswahili: “Mtu aweza kuwa ni mwenye haki atendaye yaliyo haki na sawa.
Ekegusii: Origererie orore omonto ore omooronge, ogokora ayare boronge na ekeene.

English: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,
Kiswahili: Hakula katika mahali pa ibada za miungu kwenye milima wala hakuziinulia macho sanamu za nyumba ya Israeli. Hakumtia unajisi mke wa jirani yake, wala hakukutana kimwili na mwanamke wakati wa siku zake za hedhi.
Ekegusii: Ere tari koria ebing’wanso bikoruegwa igoro ase ebitunwa, gose tari korigereria emegwekano y’Abaisraeli bagosasiima; tari gokora obonyaka n’omokuungu bw’omonto onde, gose tari koba nomokuungu ekero are nomotienyi,

English: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
Kiswahili: Hamwonei mtu yeyote, bali hurudisha kilichowekwa rehani kwake. Hanyangʼanyi, bali huwapa wenye njaa chakula chake na huwapa nguo walio uchi.
Ekegusii: gose tari gokorera monto onde bobe, korende nigo akoirania egento omonto amoete koba intenenera ase esiira. Ere tari koura onde gento kiaye, korende nigo akoa oyore nenchara endagera, na oyore getirianda omobekera eanga.

English: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,
Kiswahili: Hakopeshi kwa riba wala hajipatii faida ya ziada. Huuzuia mkono wake usifanye mabaya, naye huhukumu kwa haki kati ya mtu na mtu.
Ekegusii: Ekero akorua singo tari kwementera gento gose koboria ebitoki. Nigo agotanga amaboko aye takora obobe; nigo akonacha ekiina kia boronge ase egati y’omonto na omonto onde.

English: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Huzifuata amri zangu na kuzishika sheria zangu kwa uaminifu. Huyo mtu ni mwenye haki; hakika ataishi, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio aise gokora bo, na abwatie emeroberio y’ane echiikire, na abwate amachiiko ane, na akore ayare boronge, oyio nigo are omonyaboronge; ekeene, nabe moyo. Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,
Kiswahili: “Aweza kuwa ana mwana jeuri, amwagaye damu au atendaye mojawapo ya mambo haya
Ekegusii: Ande omonto oyio nabe ng’a oiboire omwana omomura oyore omoibi na omoiti, gose abe ogokora erimo ri’ayio

English: or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor’s wife,
Kiswahili: (ingawa baba yake hakufanya mojawapo ya haya): “Hula katika mahali pa ibada za miungu kwenye milima. Humtia unajisi mke wa jirani yake.
Ekegusii: ise omonyene atakorete, korende arie ebing’wanso bikoruegwa ase ebitunwa igoro, naende akore obonyaka nomokuungu bw’omonto onde.

English: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,
Kiswahili: Huwaonea maskini na wahitaji. Hunyangʼanyana. Harudishi kile kilichowekwa rehani kwake. Huziinulia sanamu macho. Hufanya mambo ya machukizo.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agokorera abataka na abaremerwa bobe, na kourereria abanto ebinto biabo, gose tari koirania egento aetwe koba intenenera, ere nigo akorigereria emegwekano egosasiimwa na gokora ay’okogechia.

English: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.
Kiswahili: Hukopesha kwa riba na kutafuta faida ya ziada. Je, mtu wa namna hii ataishi? Hapana, hataishi! Kwa sababu amefanya mambo haya yote ya machukizo, hakika atauawa na damu yake itakuwa juu ya kichwa chake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ekero akorua singo nigo akwementera egento ase okoboria ebitoki. Inee! Omonto buna oyio nabe moyo? Yaya takoba moyo. Ekiagera akorire okogechia okwo gwonsi goika akwe. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye ’nkobe igoro yaye.

English: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,
Kiswahili: “Lakini yawezekana mwana huyo ana mwana aonaye dhambi hizi zote anazofanya baba yake, naye ingawa anaziona, yeye hafanyi mabaya kama haya:
Ekegusii: Ande omonto oyio nabe ng’a oiboire omwana omomura, ere arore ebibe bionsi ise akorete, korende airoke na takora amang’ana buna ayio.

English: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,
Kiswahili: “Hakula katika mahali pa ibada za miungu kwenye milima, wala hainulii macho sanamu za nyumba ya Israeli. Hakumtia unajisi mke wa jirani yake.
Ekegusii: Ere taria ebing’wanso bikoruerwa ase ebitunwa igoro, gose tarigereria emegwekano y’Abaisraeli bagosasiima, gose takora obonyaka n’omokuungu bw’omonto onde;

English: hasn’t wronged any, hasn’t taken anything to pledge, hasn’t taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
Kiswahili: Hakumwonea mtu yeyote wala hakutaka rehani kwa ajili ya mkopo. Hanyangʼanyi, bali huwapa wenye njaa chakula chake na huwapa nguo walio uchi.
Ekegusii: tagokorera monto onde bobe, gose takoira egento koba intenenera, gose takourereria omonto enibo yaye, korende nigo arabe okoa oyore nenchara endagera, na oyore getirianda amobekere eanga.

English: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.
Kiswahili: Huuzuia mkono wake usitende dhambi, hakopeshi kwa riba wala hajipatii faida ya ziada. Huzishika amri zangu na kuzifuata sheria zangu. Hatakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi za baba yake; hakika ataishi.
Ekegusii: Naende nigo aratange okoboko kwaye takorera oyochandegete bobe, na abe tari koboria ebitoki gose kwementera egento, korende nigo arendete amachiiko ane na kobwatia emeroberio y’ane echiikire. Oyio tagokwa ase engencho y’ebibe bia ise, korende ekeene, goika abe moyo.

English: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.
Kiswahili: Lakini baba yake atakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe, kwa sababu alitoza bei isiyo halali kwa nguvu, akamnyangʼanya ndugu yake na kufanya yaliyo mabaya miongoni mwa watu wake.
Ekegusii: Ise ere ekiagera akorerete abanto bobe ase obotindi, na akaurereria oyomwabo, naende agakora aya atarenge amaya ase egati y’ abanto baye, ekeene, ere goika akwe ase engencho y’ebibe biaye.

English: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.
Kiswahili: “Lakini mnauliza, ‘Kwa nini mwana asiadhibiwe kwa uovu wa baba yake?’ Kwa vile mwana ametenda yaliyo haki na sawa na amekuwa mwangalifu kuzishika amri zangu zote, hakika ataishi.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ninki keragere omwana atanyore emechando ase engencho y’ebibe bia ise? Nigo nkobairaneria iga: Ekero omwana akorire ayare amaya na amaronge, na obeire okorenda emeroberio y’ane echiikire na ayekore, ekeene, nabe moyo.

English: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.
Kiswahili: Roho itendayo dhambi ndiyo itakayokufa. Mwana hataadhibiwa kwa ajili ya makosa ya baba yake, wala baba hataadhibiwa kwa ajili ya makosa ya mwanawe. Haki ya mtu mwenye haki itahesabiwa juu yake na uovu wa mtu mwovu utalipizwa juu yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto ogokora ebibe nere orakwe. Omwana tagochandwa ase engencho y’ebibe bia ise, gose ise tagochandwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’omwana oye. Omonyaboronge nanyore eng’eria y’oboronge bwaye, na omonyabibe nanyore eng’eria y’obobe bwaye.

English: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
Kiswahili: “Lakini mtu mwovu akiacha dhambi zake zote alizozitenda na kushika amri zangu zote na kufanya lililo haki na sawa, hakika ataishi, hatakufa.
Ekegusii: Korende omokori amabe karatige ebibe biaye bionsi ebio akorire, na arende emeroberio y’ane yonsi echiikire, naende akore ayare amaya na amaronge, ekeene, nabe moyo, tagokwa.

English: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.
Kiswahili: Hakuna kosa lolote alilotenda litakalokumbukwa juu yake. Kwa ajili ya mambo ya haki aliyoyatenda, ataishi.
Ekegusii: Ebibe biaye bionsi akorete tibikoinyorwa, erinde agambigwe, korende nabe moyo, ekiagera akorire ayare ay’oboronge.

English: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord Yahweh, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
Kiswahili: Je, mimi ninafurahia kifo cha mtu mwovu? Asema Bwana Mwenyezi. Je, si mimi ninafurahi wanapogeuka kutoka njia zao mbaya na kuishi?
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene akoboria; Inee! Aye nigo okagete ng’a inche nigo ingokirie nogokwa kw’omokori amabe? Yaya, nigo ’nganetie omokori amabe aonchoke, atige enchera yaye embe abe moyo.

English: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.
Kiswahili: “Lakini kama mtu mwenye haki akiacha haki yake na kutenda dhambi na kufanya mambo ya machukizo ambayo mtu mwovu hufanya, Je, ataishi? Hakuna hata mojawapo ya matendo ya haki aliyotenda litakalokumbukwa. Kwa sababu ya kukosa uaminifu kwake anayo hatia na kwa sababu ya dhambi alizozitenda, atakufa.
Ekegusii: “Korende omonyaboronge karatige oboronge bwaye na akore ebibe, naende akore okogechia okwo omokori amabe agokora, Inee, oyio nabe moyo? Yaya, oboronge bwaye bwonsi obwo konya akorire tibokoinyorwa; goika akwe, ekiagera atabeete omwegenwa, korende agakora ebibe.

English: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?
Kiswahili: “Lakini mnasema, ‘Njia ya Bwana si ya haki.’ Sikia, ee nyumba ya Israeli: Njia yangu siyo iliyo ya haki? Je, si njia zenu ndizo ambazo si za haki?
Ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Enchera y’Omonene teri endonge. Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa bono: Inee! Enchera y’ane nero etari endonge? Chinchera chiaino, tari chirochio chitari chindonge?

English: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu mwenye haki akiacha haki yake na kutenda dhambi, atakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake, kwa sababu ya dhambi alizotenda, atakufa.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto omonyaboronge akoonchoka otiga gokora ay’oboronge, erio okora ebibe, oyio goika akwe ase engencho y’ayio; ee, ase engencho y’ebibe akorire goika akwe.

English: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu mwovu akigeuka kutoka maovu aliyoyatenda na kufanya yaliyo haki na sawa, ataokoa maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Korende omokori amabe karaonchoke atige ebibe akorire, na akore ayare amaya na ayare boronge, oyio natoorie omoyo oye.

English: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa anayafikiria na kugeuka kutoka makosa yake yote aliyoyatenda na kuyaacha, hakika ataishi, hatakufa.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera arengereirie aya akorete na aonchokire korwa ase ogosaria kwaye gwonsi akorete, ekeene, nabe moyo, tagokwa.

English: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?
Kiswahili: Lakini nyumba ya Israeli inasema, ‘Njia za Bwana si haki.’ Je, njia zangu si za haki, ee nyumba ya Israeli? Je, si njia zenu ndizo ambazo si za haki?”
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli nigo bagoteeba: Enchera y’Omonene teri endonge. Inwe Abaisraeli, chinchera chiane nachio chitari chindonge? Inee! Chinchera chiaino tari chirochio chitari chindonge?

English: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, ee nyumba ya Israeli, nitawahukumu, kila mmoja sawasawa na njia zake, asema Bwana Mwenyezi. Tubuni! Geukeni kutoka makosa yenu yote, ndipo dhambi haitakuwa anguko lenu.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro inche Omonene, ’ngoteeba: Inwe Abaisraeli ase engencho y’ayio nimbanachere ekiina, kera omonto anacherwe buna chinchera chiaye chire. Onchoka! Motige ogosaria kwaino gwonsi, erinde obobe bwaino tiboba ekegocha gi’okobasiria.

English: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?
Kiswahili: Tupilieni mbali makosa yenu yote mliyoyatenda, nanyi mpate moyo mpya na roho mpya. Kwa nini mfe, ee nyumba ya Israeli?
Ekegusii: Motugute ogosaria kwaino gwonsi, okwo mwakorire asende, mwenyorere chinkoro chinyia na omoika omoyia. Inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki moganetie gokwa?

English: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sifurahii kifo cha mtu awaye yote afaye katika uovu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi. Tubuni basi, mkaishi!
Ekegusii: Inche tingokiri nogokwa kw’omonto onde bwensi ase ayio oonchoka mobe moyo. Nabo Omonene ateebire.”

English: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
Kiswahili: “Wewe fanya maombolezo kuhusu wakuu wa Israeli
Ekegusii: Aye tera ogoteera gw’okobokia amagombo igoro y’abagaambi b’Abaisraeli,

English: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.
Kiswahili: na useme: “ ‘Tazama jinsi gani mama yako alivyokuwa simba jike miongoni mwa simba! Alilala katikati ya wana simba na kulisha watoto wake.
Ekegusii: oteebe: “Nyoko naki arenge? Nigo arenge endo eaberi! Nigo arenge korara na koramama ase egati ye chindo, akaba okorera abana baye ase egati ye chindo chire ne chinguru.

English: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
Kiswahili: Alimlea mmoja wa watoto wake, naye akawa simba mwenye nguvu. Akajifunza kurarua mawindo naye akala watu.
Ekegusii: Endo eria eaberi egakiinia emanwa yaye eyemo, ero ekaba endo ere ne chinguru, ekeorokereria gotwara, ekaba ekoria abanto.

English: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Mataifa wakasikia habari zake, naye akanaswa katika shimo lao. Wakamwongoza kwa ndoana mpaka nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bakaigwa chinkuma chiaye; bakayeremera eirima, ero ekagwa imeo, bakayegobania nekegobanio, bakayeira Misiri.

English: “‘Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mama yake alipongoja na kuona tumaini lake halitimiziki, nayo matarajio yake yametoweka, akamchukua mwanawe mwingine na kumfanya simba mwenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ekero eng’ina yaganyete, na ogosemeria kwaye gokaera, ekaimokia emanwa yaye ende, ekayetuga ekaba endo ere nechinguru.

English: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
Kiswahili: Alizungukazunguka miongoni mwa simba, kwa kuwa sasa alikuwa simba mwenye nguvu. Akajifunza kurarua mawindo naye akala watu.
Ekegusii: Ero ekaba kegotaara ase egati ye chindo, ee, ekaba endo ere ne chinguru, ekeorokereria gotwara, nero ekaba ekoria abanto.

English: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.
Kiswahili: Akabomoa ngome zao na kuiharibu miji yao. Nchi na wote waliokuwa ndani yake wakatiwa hofu kwa kunguruma kwake.
Ekegusii: Egatagora chiburi chiabo chinkong’u, egasiria emechie yabo ekaba bosa. Ekero endo eyio yarenge koruma, ense yonsi ekaba kegoichana amo n’abanto bonsi bamenyeteo.

English: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.
Kiswahili: Kisha mataifa wakaja dhidi yake kutoka sehemu zilizomzunguka. Wakatanda nyavu zao kwa ajili yake, naye akanaswa katika shimo lao.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ebisaku bakarua ase chinsemo chiabo, bakeroberia ase okoyerwania, bakayebekera ekeonga, ero ekagwa ase eirima yabo ime.

English: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutumia ndoana wakamvutia kwenye tundu na kumleta mpaka kwa mfalme wa Babeli. Wakamtia gerezani, hivyo kunguruma kwake hakukusikika tena katika milima ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Bakayegobania nekegobanio, bakayebeka ase egesaisero, bakayeira ase omorwoti o Babiloni. Aroro agwo bakayesiekera ase eburi enkong’u, ng’a eriogi riaye tiribaisa koigweka ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli.

English: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mama yako alikuwa kama mzabibu katika shamba lako la mizabibu uliopandwa kando ya maji, ukiwa unazaa sana na wenye matawi mengi kwa sababu ya wingi wa maji.
Ekegusii: “Nyoko nigo arenge buna omosabibu ase egati y’emesabibu, osimekire ase amaache mbarabare, Okaba okwama mono na okaba ne chinsagia chinyinge, ekiagera osimegetwe ase amaache amaange are.

English: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.
Kiswahili: Matawi yake yalikuwa na nguvu, yaliyofaa kuwa fimbo ya enzi ya mtawala. Ulikuwa mrefu kupita miti mingine katikati ya matawi manene; ulionekana kwa urahisi kwa ajili ya urefu wake na wingi wa matawi yake.
Ekegusii: Omosabibu oyio ogakiinia chinsagia chinkong’u, chiaisanete gokorwa chinyimbo chi’abagaambi. Ritina riaye rigatambea gochia igoro ase egati ye chinsagia chiaye chinyinge mono. Omote oyio okarorekana gochia aare ore ritutu rinene.

English: But it was plucked up in fury. It was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were broken off and withered. The fire consumed them.
Kiswahili: Lakini ulingʼolewa kwa hasira kali na kutupwa chini. Upepo wa mashariki uliufanya usinyae, matunda yake yakapukutika, matawi yake yenye nguvu yakanyauka na moto ukayateketeza.
Ekegusii: Korende omosabibu oria ogasimorwa ase engencho y’endamwamu, ogatugutwa inse; omwaga okagusa korwa moocha, okayuomia; amasabibu aye akang’urorwa korwao, ritina riaye rikong’u rikoma, rigasambwa n’omorero rikaera.

English: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
Kiswahili: Sasa umepandwa jangwani katika nchi kame na ya kiu.
Ekegusii: Bono omote oyio osimekirwe ase erooro, ense enyomo etari namaache.

English: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”
Kiswahili: Moto ulienea kuanzia katika mmojawapo ya matawi yake makubwa na kuteketeza matunda yake. Hakuna tawi lenye nguvu lililobaki juu yake lifaalo kuwa fimbo ya enzi ya mtawala.’ Hili ndilo ombolezo, na litumike kama ombolezo.”
Ekegusii: Omorero okarua ase chinsagia chiaye, okagenderera gosamba amasabibu aye, totigaretie orosagia rwaisanete koba enyimbo y’omogaambi. “Oko nakwo ogoteera gw’okobokia amagombo koragenderere goterwa ase okobokia amagombo.”

English: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Yahweh, and sat before me.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa saba, mwezi wa tano siku ya kumi, baadhi ya wazee wa Israeli wakaja ili kutaka ushauri kwa Bwana, wakaketi mbele yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi, omotienyi o gatano, omwaka o gatano na kabere, abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli bagaacha koboria amang’ana korwa ase Omonene, bagaikaransa ase obosio bwane.

English: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia,

English: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will not be inquired of by you.”’
Kiswahili: “Mwanadamu, sema na wazee wa Israeli uwaambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa nini mmekuja? Je, ni kutaka ushauri kwangu? Hakika kama niishivyo, sitawaruhusu mtake ushauri toka kwangu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, kwana n’abagaaka abwo b’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteeba: Inee! Nigo mwachire koboria momanye amang’ana korwa asende? Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, tingwancha mborigwe amang’ana nainwe. Ninche Omonene natebire ayio.

English: “Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.
Kiswahili: “Je, utawahukumu? Je, mwanadamu, utawahukumu? Basi uwakabili kwa ajili ya machukizo ya baba zao
Ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, Inee, noganetie kobanachera ekiina? Aye nobanachere ekiina? Onye naboigo rirorio bamanyie ogokora kw’okogechia gwe chisokoro chiabo,

English: Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am Yahweh your God;’
Kiswahili: na uwaambie: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Siku ile nilipochagua Israeli, niliwaapia wazao wa nyumba ya Yakobo kwa mkono ulioinuliwa nami nikajidhihirisha kwao huko Misri. Kwa mkono ulioinuliwa niliwaambia, “Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wenu.”
Ekegusii: obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ase rituko riria nachorete Abaisraeli, nigo nariete eira y’ogotiana ase ororeria rwa Yakobo, nkeorokia na kwemanyekania ase bare, agwo ase ense ya Misiri. Nigo natianete ase bare, ngateeba: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.
Kiswahili: Siku ile niliwaapia wao kwamba nitawatoa katika nchi ya Misri na kuwaleta katika nchi niliyowachagulia, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, nchi nzuri kupita zote.
Ekegusii: Rituko riria nigo natianete ase bare, nkabateebia ng’a nimbarusie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, mbaire ase ense konya nabanyoreire, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, ense ere nobonene goetania chinse chionsi.

English: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’
Kiswahili: Nami nikawaambia, “Kila mmoja wenu aondolee mbali sanamu za chukizo ambazo mmekazia macho, nanyi msijitie unajisi kwa sanamu za Misri. Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wenu.”
Ekegusii: Nkabateebia iga: Kera oyomo oino tiga atugute korwa ase are ebinto bi’okogechia ebio anchete korigereria, timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’emegwekano eyio Abamisiri bagosasiima. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: “‘“But they rebelled against me and wouldn’t listen to me. They didn’t all throw away the abominations of their eyes. They also didn’t forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini waliniasi na hawakunisikiliza, hawakuondolea mbali sanamu za machukizo ambazo walikuwa wamezikazia macho, wala kuondolea mbali sanamu za Misri. Ndipo nikasema, nitawamwagia ghadhabu yangu na kutimiza hasira yangu dhidi yao huko Misri.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo bagasaria asende, bakaanga konyigwera. Nonya noyomo tatugutete ebinto ebio bi’okogechia banchete korigereria, gose onde tatigete emegwekano eyio Abaisraeli barenge gosasiima. Erio nkarengereria kobaumorera endamwamu y’ane, agwo ase ense ya Misiri.

English: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa ajili ya Jina langu nilifanya kile ambacho kingelifanya lisitiwe unajisi machoni mwa mataifa waliyoishi miongoni mwao na ambao machoni pao nilikuwa nimejifunua kwa Waisraeli kwa kuwatoa katika nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Korende ayio nakorete nigo nayakorete ase okorenda erieta riane tirikorwa ribe eritachenegeti nebisaku ebio Abaisraeli bamenyete ase egati yabo. Ase amasio y’ebisaku ebio inemanyekanetie ase Abaisraeli ase okobarusia ase ense ya Misiri.

English: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nikawaongoza watoke Misri na kuwaleta jangwani.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio nkabarusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nkabarenta ase erooro.

English: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
Kiswahili: Nikawapa amri zangu na kuwajulisha sheria zangu, kwa kuwa mtu anayezitii ataishi kwa hizo.
Ekegusii: Agwo ’nkabaa emeroberio y’ane echiikire, na nkaborokereria amachiiko ane, na omonto orayabwate nabe moyo goetera asaro.

English: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.
Kiswahili: Pia niliwapa Sabato zangu kama ishara kati yangu nao, ili wapate kujua kuwa Mimi Bwana niliwafanya kuwa watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naende ’nkabaa Chisabato chiane chikaba ekemanyererio ase egati y’ane na barabwo, erio banyare komanya ng’a ninche Omonene nkobachena.

English: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in them. They greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini watu wa Israeli waliniasi Mimi jangwani. Hawakufuata amri zangu, bali walikataa sheria zangu, ingawa mtu yule anayezitii ataishi kwa hizo sheria, nao walizinajisi Sabato zangu kabisa. Hivyo nilisema ningemwaga ghadhabu yangu juu yao na kuwaangamiza huko jangwani.
Ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagasaria asende, agwo ase erooro; tibabwatetie emeroberio y’ane echiikire, korende bakaanga amachiiko ane ayio omonto karayabwate nabe moyo goetera ase aro. Bagasaria mono Chisabato chiane, bagachikora chikaba echitachenegeti. Erio ’nkarengereria kobaumorera endamwamu y’ane agwo ase erooro, ’mbasirie kegima.

English: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa ajili ya Jina langu nikafanya kile ambacho kitalifanya Jina langu lisitiwe unajisi machoni mwa mataifa ambao mbele yao nilikuwa nimewatoa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Korende ayio nakorete nigo nayakorete ase okorenda erieta riane tirikorwa ribe eritachenegeti ase amasio y’ abanto b’ebisaku, abwo ase narusetie Abaisraeli korwa.

English: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,
Kiswahili: Tena kwa mkono ulioinuliwa nikawaapia huko jangwani kwamba nisingewaingiza katika nchi niliyokuwa nimewapa, yaani, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, nchi nzuri kuliko zote,
Ekegusii: Naende nkaria eira y’ogotiana agwo ase erooro ng’a tinkobaira ase ense eria konya nabaeire, ense entenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke, ense ere nobonene goetania chinse chinde chionsi.

English: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu walikataa sheria zangu na hawakufuata amri zangu na wakazinajisi Sabato zangu. Kwa kuwa mioyo yao iliandama sanamu zao.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo nayakorete, ekiagera baangete amachiiko ane, bakaanga kobwatia emeroberio y’ane echiikire; bagakora Chisabato chiane chikaba echitachenegeti. Chinkoro chiabo nigo chianchete emegwekano yabo barenge gosasiima.

English: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn’t destroy them. I didn’t make a full end of them in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Lakini niliwahurumia wala sikuwaangamiza wala hakuwafuta kabisa jangwani.
Ekegusii: “Nonya naboigo nkabarorera amaabera, gose tinabasiretie kegima agwo ase erooro.

English: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
Kiswahili: Niliwaambia watoto wao kule jangwani, “Msifuate amri za baba zenu wala kushika sheria zao au kujinajisi kwa sanamu zao.
Ekegusii: Nigo n akuurerete abana babo agwo ase erooro, nkabateebia: Inwe timobaisa kobwatia emeroberio eyio chisokoro chiaino chiachiigete, gose timobaisa konara chingencho chiabo, gose timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasiima emegwekano yabo.

English: I am Yahweh your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.
Kiswahili: Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wenu, fuateni amri zangu tena kuweni waangalifu kushika sheria zangu.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino; mobwatie emeroberio y’ane echiikire. Mobwatie amachiiko ane na koyakora!

English: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.’
Kiswahili: Zitakaseni Sabato zangu ili ziwe ishara kati yangu nanyi. Ndipo mtakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wenu.”
Ekegusii: Morende Chisabato chiane chibe chinchenu, erinde chibe ekemanyererio ase egati y’ane nainwe; erio nario moranyare komanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.

English: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Lakini watoto hao wakaniasi: Hawakufuata amri zangu, wala hawakuwa waangalifu kushika sheria zangu, ingawa mtu anayezitii anaishi kwa hizo sheria, nao wakazinajisi Sabato zangu. Hivyo nikasema ningemwaga ghadhabu yangu juu yao na kutimiza hasira yangu dhidi yao huko jangwani.
Ekegusii: “Korende abana baria bagasaria asende; tibabwatetie emeroberio y’ane echiikire, na tibarendete amachiiko ane na tibayakorete, amachiiko ayio omonto orabwate abe moyo goetera asaro. Bagakora Chisabato chiane chikaba echitachenegeti. Erio nkarengereria kobaumorera ekeririanda kiane, erinde endamwamu y’ane eerere igoro yabo agwo ase erooro.

English: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
Kiswahili: Lakini nikauzuia mkono wangu na kwa ajili ya Jina langu nikafanya kile ambacho kingelifanya Jina langu lisitiwe unajisi machoni mwa mataifa ambao mbele yao nilikuwa nimewatoa Waisraeli.
