Ekegusii: “Abanto aba basaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, buna Adamu agosaretie. Ase amang’ana ayio babeire abatari abegenwa ase ’nde.

English: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
Kiswahili: Gileadi ni mji wenye watu waovu, umetiwa madoa kwa nyayo za damu.
Ekegusii: Omochie o Gileadi nigo oichire nabaanto abakori amabe, chimbaratero chiabo nigo chiichire amanyinga.

English: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.
Kiswahili: Kama wanyangʼanyi wamviziavyo mtu, ndivyo magenge ya makuhani wafanyavyo; wanaulia watu kwenye njia iendayo Shekemu, wakifanya uhalifu wa aibu.
Ekegusii: Abakuani nigo banga buna ekeombe ki’abauri keboerete abanto, nigo bagoitera abanto ase enchera ekogenda Sekemu. Ee, nigo bagokora ayare amabe mono.

English: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.
Kiswahili: Nimeona jambo la kutisha katika nyumba ya Israeli. Huko Efraimu amejitolea kwa ukahaba na Israeli amenajisika.
Ekegusii: Narorire ase Abaisraeli egento ekebe gi’okogechia; agwo nao Abaefraimu bagokorera obonyaka, ee, Abaisraeli besoirie ase ogotacheneka.

English: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
Kiswahili: “Pia kwa ajili yako, Yuda, mavuno yameamriwa. “Wakati wowote ningerejesha neema ya watu wangu,
Ekegusii: “Nainwe Abayuda boigo, mwarikeirwe engaki ye rigesa ri’ogokora kwaino, ekero ndasibore abooswa b’abaanto baane.

English: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
Kiswahili: kila mara nilipotaka kumponya Israeli, dhambi za Efraimu zinafichuliwa na maovu ya Samaria yanafunuliwa. Wanafanya udanganyifu, wevi huvunja nyumba, maharamia hunyangʼanya barabarani,
Ekegusii: “Ekero nganetie kogwenia Abaisraeli, ogosaria kw’Abaefraimu na ogokora okobe kw’Abasamaria nigo gokororekana maiso marore. Barabwo nigo bagokora ay’obong’ainereria; abaibi nigo bagotagora chinyomba basoa ime, na ebiombe bi’abauri nigo bikourereria isiko.

English: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.
Kiswahili: lakini hawafahamu kwamba ninakumbuka matendo yao yote mabaya. Dhambi zao zimewameza, ziko mbele zangu siku zote.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibari korengereria ng’a inche nigo ng’inyorete ogokora kwabo gwonsi okobe. Bono ogokora okwo kwabo okobe kwabaetananire na nigo kore ase obosio bwane.

English: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
Kiswahili: “Wanamfurahisha sana mfalme kwa maovu yao, wakuu wao kwa uongo wao.
Ekegusii: “Nigo bakogokia omorwoti nogokora kwabo okobe, na kogokia abagaambi nobong’ainereria bwabo.

English: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
Kiswahili: Wote ni wazinzi, wanawaka kama tanuru ambayo moto wake mwokaji hana haja ya kuuchochea kuanzia kukanda unga hadi umekwisha kuumuka.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bare abatomani. Nigo banga buna eriko ri’okogekera emegati riutire omorero, na omooroisia bw’emegati nigo agotiga koigereria omorero goika abe okonyire ribomba ri’obosie na ememera ebe yaribotirie.

English: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
Kiswahili: Katika sikukuu ya mfalme wetu wakuu wanawaka kwa mvinyo, naye anawaunga mkono wenye mizaha.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rinene ri’omorwoti oito abagaambi bakanywa edivai endoro goika ekabarwaria, na ere omonyene akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabwatana nabanyacheche.

English: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
Kiswahili: Mioyo yao ni kama tanuru, wanamwendea kwa hila. Hasira yao inafoka moshi usiku kucha, wakati wa asubuhi inalipuka kama miali ya moto.
Ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chiare gwoka nokogania okobe buna eriko rigwoka omorero. Ase obotuko bwonsi, okogania okwo nigo gokorara, na mambia kobwakire kwaba kogwoka buna omorero ekebemberi.

English: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.
Kiswahili: Wote ni moto kama tanuru; wanawaangamiza watawala wao. Wafalme wake wote wanaanguka, wala hakuna yeyote kati yao aniitaye mimi.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bagwoka buna omorero o riko, bagosiria abagaambi babo b’ebiina. Abarwoti babo bonsi bagure, na onde tari ase abwo okondangeria imokonye.

English: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
Kiswahili: “Efraimu anajichanganya na mataifa; Efraimu ni mkate ambao haukuiva.
Ekegusii: “Abaefraimu bochoganire nabaanto b’ebisaku. Nigo banga buna omogati otaonchoiri kogekeire.

English: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.
Kiswahili: Wageni wananyonya nguvu zake, lakini hafahamu hilo. Nywele zake zina mvi hapa na pale, lakini hana habari.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni bakoorire chinguru chiaye, na ere tamanyeti amang’ana ayio; chimbuche chiamerire ase omotwe oye, nere tamanyeti ayio.

English: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.
Kiswahili: Kiburi cha Israeli kinashuhudia dhidi yake, lakini pamoja na haya yote harudi kwa Bwana Mungu wake wala kumtafuta.
Ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’Abaisraeli bwababereire kirori. Nonya naboigo, tibari komoiranera Omonene, Nyasae obo, gose komorigia.

English: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.
Kiswahili: “Efraimu ni kama hua, hudanganywa kwa urahisi na hana akili: mara anaita Misri, mara anageukia Ashuru.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo banga buna riruma ririri, ritari nokomanya. Nigo bagosaba ogokonywa korwa Misiri, naende bagenda Asuri.

English: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
Kiswahili: Wakati watakapokwenda, nitatupa wavu wangu juu yao; nitawavuta chini waanguke kama ndege wa angani. Nitakaposikia wakikusanyika pamoja, nitawanasa.
Ekegusii: Ekero barabe bakogendao, nindambore ekeonga kiane mbabwatere imeo buna chinyoni chikobwatwa. Nimbae egesusuro ase okobarongeyia, koreng’ana buna omosangererekano obo bworokererigwe.

English: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
Kiswahili: Ole wao, kwa sababu wamepotoka kutoka kwangu! Maangamizi ni yao kwa sababu wameniasi! Ninatamani kuwakomboa, lakini wanasema uongo dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwabo, ekiagera batamire korwa ase ’nde. Mbasirigwe, ekiagera basaririe ase ’nde bantigire. Nanga nabatooria, korende babeire bagokwana oborimo igoro yane.

English: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.
Kiswahili: Hawanililii mimi kutoka mioyoni mwao, bali wanaomboleza vitandani mwao. Hukusanyika pamoja kwa ajili ya nafaka na divai mpya, lakini hugeukia mbali nami.
Ekegusii: Tibari korera asende korwa ase chinkoro chiabo, korende nigo bakona‐kwerera ase amarere abo. Nigo bagosangererekana amo bachandekerete endagera na edivai, ekero bagendererete gosaria asende.

English: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
Kiswahili: Niliwafundisha na kuwatia nguvu, lakini wanapanga mabaya dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Nonya naborokereretie na gokong’ia amaboko abo, nigo bagendererete koroberia amabe igoro yane.

English: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
Kiswahili: Hawamgeukii Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, wako kama upinde wenye kasoro. Viongozi wao wataanguka kwa upanga kwa sababu ya maneno yao ya jeuri. Kwa ajili ya hili watadhihakiwa katika nchi ya Misri.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakoonchoka, korende tari gochia ase Oyore Igoro Mono, nigo banga buna obota bootokanete. Abagaambi babo mbaitwe nemioro ase engencho y’obotindi bwe chimeme chiabo. Ring’ana erio ndigere ense ya Misiri ebasekerere na kobachaya.

English: “Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over Yahweh’s house, because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.
Kiswahili: “Wekeni tarumbeta midomoni mwenu! Tai yuko juu ya nyumba ya Bwana kwa sababu watu wamevunja Agano langu, wameasi dhidi ya sheria yangu.
Ekegusii: “Beka egetureeri monwa mokebugie! Omobisa ngocha are igoro y’enyomba y’Omonene buna ekeongo, ekiagera abanto basaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, na batigire amachiiko aane.

English: They cry to me, ‘My God, we, Israel, acknowledge you!’
Kiswahili: Israeli ananililia, ‘Ee Mungu wetu, tunakukubali!’
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli nigo bakorera ase ’nde, kera oyomo oteeba: Aye Nyasae one, intwe Abaisraeli ntokomanyete.

English: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Israeli amekataa lile lililo jema, adui atamfuatia.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bangire amang’ana are amaya, ase ayio ababisa mbaababwatie.

English: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
Kiswahili: Wanaweka wafalme bila idhini yangu, wamechagua wakuu bila kibali changu. Kwa fedha zao na dhahabu wamejitengenezea sanamu kwa ajili ya maangamizi yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Abaisraeli bebeekeire abarwoti, batamboreti, bebeekeire abagaambi abwo ntamanyeti, na korwa ase chifeta ne chitaabu chiabo beroiseirie emegwekano bagosasiima; ayio nigo arabarentere ogosirigwa.

English: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
Kiswahili: Ee Samaria, tupilieni mbali sanamu yenu ya ndama! Hasira yangu inawaka dhidi yao. Watakuwa najisi mpaka lini?
Ekegusii: Aye Samaria, omogwekano oria bw’emori ore ase egati yao yabeire okogechia ase ’nde. Endamwamu yane nigo egwoka igoro y’abanto abwo. Ngoika ririri baragenderere koba iga bataracheneka?

English: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
Kiswahili: Zimetoka katika Israeli! Ndama huyu: ametengenezwa na fundi, si Mungu. Atavunjwa vipande vipande, yule ndama wa Samaria.
Ekegusii: Omogwekano oyio nigo oruete ase Abaisraeli. Nigo oroisetigwe nomooroisia bw’ebinto, oyio tari oro Nyasae. Omogwekano oria bw’emori ore Samaria nosenyentwe obe ebisamunye.

English: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.
Kiswahili: “Wanapanda upepo na kuvuna upepo wa kisulisuli. Bua halina suke, halitatoa unga. Kama lingetoa nafaka, wageni wangeila yote.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo babusuire embeo, mbagese ekembugu‐mbugu. Ebimeri bigokina ase emegondo yabo tibigosomoria, ase ayio tibikwama chindagera. Biise kwama, abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni mbache bachigese.

English: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
Kiswahili: Israeli amemezwa; sasa yupo miongoni mwa mataifa kama kitu kisicho na thamani.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli bamerirwe. Bono nigo bare ase egati y’ebisaku baabarire koba buna egekorero getagwenereti kende.

English: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wamepanda kwenda Ashuru kama punda-mwitu anayetangatanga peke yake. Efraimu amejiuza mwenyewe kwa wapenzi.
Ekegusii: Bagendire Asuri, babeire buna etigere y’orosana ere ao yoka; ee, Abaefraimu benyoreire abanchi.

English: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.
Kiswahili: Ingawa wamejiuza wenyewe miongoni mwa mataifa, sasa nitawakusanya pamoja. Wataanza kudhoofika chini ya uonevu wa mfalme mwenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ee, nonya benyoreire abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao ng’a baabakonye, nimbasangererie amo bwango, mbakeyie babe inse y’ogochandwa kw’omorwoti oria bw’abagaambi.

English: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
Kiswahili: “Ingawa Efraimu alijenga madhabahu nyingi kwa ajili ya sadaka za dhambi, hizi zimekuwa madhabahu za kufanyia dhambi.
Ekegusii: “Ekiagera Abaefraimu beagacheire ebisasimero ebinge bikogera bakore ebibe, ebio biabeire ebibe ase bare.

English: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing.
Kiswahili: Nimeandika kwa ajili yao mambo mengi kuhusu sheria yangu, lakini wameziangalia kama kitu cha kigeni.
Ekegusii: Nonya nare korika amachiiko aane ase bare ara chilifu ikomi, tibaare koyancha, korende bayabarire koba egento ekegeni ase bare.

English: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but Yahweh doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.
Kiswahili: Wanatoa dhabihu nilizopewa mimi nao wanakula hiyo nyama, lakini Bwana hapendezwi nao. Sasa ataukumbuka uovu wao na kuadhibu dhambi zao: Watarudi Misri.
Ekegusii: Nigo banchete korua ebing’wanso ase ’nde, erinde barie chinyama chi’ebing’wanso ebio, korende inche Omonene timbagokereti. Bono ning’inyore okomocha kwabo mbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo; barabwo bairane gochia Misiri.

English: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”
Kiswahili: Israeli amemsahau Muumba wake na kujenga majumba ya kifalme, Yuda amejengea miji mingi ngome. Lakini nitatuma moto kwenye miji yao utakaoteketeza ngome zao.”
Ekegusii: “Abaisraeli bebire Omotongi obo, baagachire chinyomba chi’obonene, na Abayuda baagachire emechie emenge egiteire chindwaki, korende nindete omorero ase emechie eyio, na oro nosambe amaagacho abo bagwekengera.”

English: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.
Kiswahili: Usifurahie, ee Israeli; usishangilie kama mataifa mengine. Kwa kuwa hukuwa mwaminifu kwa Mungu wako; umependa ujira wa kahaba kwenye kila sakafu ya kupuria nafaka.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, timobaisa kogoka gose gochenga buna abanto b’ebisaku bagokora, ekiagera inwe mwakorire obotomani, mwatigire Nyasae oino. Mwagokeire eng’eria y’obotomani ase kera ekeooreri gi’okoorera.

English: The threshing floor and the wine press won’t feed them, and the new wine will fail her.
Kiswahili: Sakafu za kupuria nafaka na mashinikizo ya kukamulia divai havitalisha watu, divai mpya itawapungukia.
Ekegusii: Korende ebiooreri bi’okoorera na ebimitero bi’edivai tibigoisanekia abanto, na edivai enyia tekonyorekana ase bare.

English: They won’t dwell in Yahweh’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.
Kiswahili: Hawataishi katika nchi ya Bwana, Efraimu atarudi Misri na atakula chakula kilicho najisi huko Ashuru.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibakogenderera komenya ase ense y’Omonene; Abaefraimu mbairane gochia ase ense ya Misiri, na agwo Asuri babe bakoria endagera etachenegeti.

English: They won’t pour out wine offerings to Yahweh, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into Yahweh’s house.
Kiswahili: Hawatammiminia Bwana sadaka ya divai wala dhabihu zao hazitampendeza. Dhabihu kama hizo zitakuwa kwao kama mkate wa waombolezaji; nao wote wazilao watakuwa najisi. Chakula hiki kitakuwa kwa ajili yao wenyewe; kisije katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tibakorua okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gi’edivai ase Omonene, ere takogokera ebing’wanso bararue asare. Okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera bararue asare nigo korabe buna endagera y’ebirero; na omonto onde bwensi orayerie nigo arabe oyo otachenegeti, ekiagera endagera eyio erabe egoisanekia oyore nenchara rioka, tekorentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene.

English: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of Yahweh?
Kiswahili: Mtafanya nini katika siku ya sikukuu zenu zilizoamriwa, katika siku za sikukuu za Bwana?
Ekegusii: Ninki morakore ekero Rituko Rinene ri’omoyega o Omonene riraike?

English: For, behold, when they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.
Kiswahili: Hata ikiwa wataokoka maangamizi, Misri atawakusanya, nayo Memfisi itawazika. Hazina zao za fedha zitasongwa na michongoma, nayo miiba itafunika mahema yao.
Ekegusii: Rora, abanto abwo batamire ng’a tibaabaisa gosirigwa; ense ya Misiri nebasangererie amo, na omochie o Memifisi nobatindeke. Amasa namere aase babeegete chinibo chiabo chi’echifeta, chiria chianchire, na amagwa namere ase chinyomba chiabo ime.

English: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
Kiswahili: Siku za adhabu zinakuja, siku za malipo zimewadia. Israeli na afahamu hili. Kwa sababu dhambi zenu ni nyingi sana na uadui wenu ni mkubwa sana, nabii anadhaniwa ni mpumbavu, mtu aliyeongozwa na Mungu anaonekana mwendawazimu.
Ekegusii: Amatuko ’egesusuro aikire, ee, amatuko ay’ogoakanera ogokora kw’abaanto aikire. Abaisraeli mbamanye ayio. Omobani obeire omoriri, na omonto ore n’Omoika obeire ebarimo, ekiagera obobe bwaino bwabeire obonge, na okogecha kwaino kwabeire okonene.

English: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.
Kiswahili: Nabii, pamoja na Mungu wangu, ndiye mlinzi juu ya Efraimu, hata hivyo mitego inamngojea katika mapito yake yote, na uadui katika nyumba ya Mungu wake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae ontomire buna omobaabi gochia ase abanto baye Abaisraeli. Korende kera ekero ngotema kogenda nigo babeire emeeto y’obotegi ase chinchera chiabo chionsi; obobisa bwabo nigo bore ime ase enyomba ya Nyasae obo.

English: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.
Kiswahili: Wamezama sana katika rushwa, kama katika siku za Gibea. Mungu atakumbuka uovu wao na kuwaadhibu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao.
Ekegusii: Besaririe kegima buna yabeete ase amatuko aria a kare agwo Gibea. Omonene nainyorete ebibe biabo, abae egesusuro.

English: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.
Kiswahili: “Nilipompata Israeli, ilikuwa kama kupata zabibu jangwani; nilipowaona baba zenu, ilikuwa kama kuona matunda ya kwanza katika mtini. Lakini walipofika Baal-Peori, walijiweka wakfu kwa ile sanamu ya aibu, nao wakawa najisi kama kitu kile walichokipenda.
Ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nigo nanyorete Abaisraeli banga buna emesabibu ase erooro; nigo naroche chisokoro chiaino chinga buna okwama ogotang’ani kw’emeko. Korende bakagenda Baali‐Peori, bakerua abanyene gosasiima enyasae eria y’obosooku, bakaba okogechia buna enyasae eria banchete ere.

English: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.
Kiswahili: Utukufu wa Efraimu utaruka kama ndege: hakuna kuzaa, hakuna kuchukua mimba, hakuna kutunga mimba.
Ekegusii: Obonene bw’Abaefraimu mboiruruke buna enyoni bogende. Okoibora tigokoba ase bare, gose abakungu tibakoba barito, bonsi mbagombae.

English: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!
Kiswahili: Hata wakilea watoto, nitamuua kila mmoja. Ole wao nitakapowapiga kisogo!
Ekegusii: Baise gokinia abana, ning’ite abana abwo, onde tagotigara ore moyo nonya noyomo. Obobe nobwabo abanyene, ekero inche ndabatige.

English: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.
Kiswahili: Nimemwona Efraimu, kama Tiro, aliyeoteshwa mahali pazuri. Lakini Efraimu wataleta watoto wao kwa mchinjaji.”
Ekegusii: “Nkarora Abaefraimu banga buna omogondo omuya buna Turo orenge, korende ase rituko erimo mbabe bakoira abana babo gochia goitwa.

English: Give them—Yahweh what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
Kiswahili: Wape, Ee Bwana, je, utawapa nini? Wape matumbo ya kuharibu mimba na matiti yaliyokauka.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, bae eki ogwenerete kobaa, ogombayie chinda chiabo, ne chimbeere chiabo chiome pa.

English: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds, I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.
Kiswahili: “Kwa sababu ya uovu wao wote huko Gilgali, niliwachukia huko. Kwa sababu ya matendo yao ya dhambi, nitawafukuza katika nyumba yangu. Sitawapenda tena, viongozi wao wote ni waasi.
Ekegusii: “Obobe bwabo bwonsi nigo bore Giligali, agwo nao nachakerete kobagecha. Nimbaserie barue ase enyomba yane ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe. Tinkogenderera kobancha; abagaambi babo bonsi nigo bare abasaria.

English: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”
Kiswahili: Efraimu ameharibiwa, mzizi wao umenyauka, hawazai tunda. Hata kama watazaa watoto, nitawachinja watoto wao waliotunzwa vizuri.”
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu baakirwe, omori obo bwomire, tibakonyara kwama okwama. Nabaisa koibora, goika ing’ite abana abwo banchete.”

English: My God will cast them away, because they didn’t listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.
Kiswahili: Mungu wangu atawakataa kwa sababu hawakumtii; watakuwa watu wa kutangatanga miongoni mwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: Nyasae one nabaange, ekiagera baangete komoigwera; mbabe bakonagotayaya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku.

English: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.
Kiswahili: Israeli alikuwa mzabibu uliostawi sana, alijizalia matunda mwenyewe. Kadiri matunda yake yalivyoongezeka, alijenga madhabahu zaidi; kadiri nchi yake ilivyostawi, alipamba mawe yake ya ibada.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli nigo banga buna omosabibu okororekana ore omuya mono okwama amasabibu. Buna koreng’ana okwama kwabo kwamentekanete, naboigo bagendererete koagacha ebisasimero ebinge; na buna bagendererete gotenenka, naboigo bagendererete gotenenia chisiiro bagosasiima.

English: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.
Kiswahili: Moyo wao ni mdanganyifu, nao sasa lazima wachukue hatia yao. Bwana atabomoa madhabahu zao na kuharibu mawe yao ya ibada.
Ekegusii: Nigo bare abang’ainereria ase chinkoro chiabo; ase ayio goika baegwe egesusuro gi’okomocha kwabo. Omonene natagore ebisasimero biabo, atagore ne chisiiro chiabo bagosasiima.

English: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear Yahweh; and the king, what can he do for us?”
Kiswahili: Kisha watasema, “Hatuna mfalme kwa sababu hatukumheshimu Bwana. Lakini hata kama tungelikuwa na mfalme, angeweza kutufanyia nini?”
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo mbateebe, “Titobwati omorwoti, ekiagera titomoirogeti Omonene. Inee! Toraba nomorwoti, ngento ki aratokorere?”

English: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
Kiswahili: Wanaweka ahadi nyingi, huapa viapo vya uongo wanapofanya mapatano; kwa hiyo mashtaka huchipuka kama magugu ya sumu katika shamba lililolimwa.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagokwana amang’ana atari nengencho, naende betiania ase oborimo ekero bagokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania; ase igo ekiina nigo gekobacheera buna ekemeri kere nobosongo ase emetaro ya mogondo.

English: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven, for its people will mourn over it, along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.
Kiswahili: Watu wanaoishi Samaria huogopa kwa ajili ya sanamu ya ndama ya Beth-Aveni. Watu wake wataiombolezea, vivyo hivyo kuhani wake wa kuabudu sanamu, wale waliokuwa wamefurahia fahari yake, kwa sababu itaondolewa kutoka kwao kwenda uhamishoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete Samaria mbatengechigwe ase engencho y’omogwekano bw’emori bagosasiima agwo Beti‐Aveni. Abwo bakoyosasiima mbarere, na abakuani baye mbeng’ererie, ekiagera obonene bwaye bwasirigwe.

English: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.
Kiswahili: Itachukuliwa kwenda Ashuru kama ushuru kwa mfalme mkuu. Efraimu atafedheheshwa; Israeli ataaibika kwa ajili ya sanamu zake za mti.
Ekegusii: Omogwekano oyio noirwe Asuri, oegwe omorwoti Yarebu buna ekeegwa. Abaefraimu mbabe nobosooku, na Abaisraeli mbasookigwe boigo ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.

English: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water.
Kiswahili: Samaria na mfalme wake wataelea kama kijiti juu ya uso wa maji.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti o Samaria nasirigwe arueo buna riuro rigosira korwa ase amaache igoro.

English: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”
Kiswahili: Mahali pa kuabudia sanamu pa uovu pataharibiwa: ndiyo dhambi ya Israeli. Miiba na mibaruti itaota na kufunika madhabahu zao. Kisha wataiambia milima, “Tufunikeni!” na vilima, “Tuangukieni!”
Ekegusii: Aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo Aveni, ase Abaisraeli bakoreire ebibe, nasirigwe. Amagwa na amageri mbimere ase ebisasimero biabo; erio abanto abwo bateebie ebitunwa: “Totube”, na ebigoro: “Togwere”.

English: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.
Kiswahili: “Tangu siku za Gibea, mmetenda dhambi, ee Israeli, huko ndiko mlikobaki. Je, vita havikuwapata watenda mabaya huko Gibea?
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, nigo mwagendererete gokora ebibe korwa ase amatuko aria mwarenge Gibea, na goika bono nigo mogendererete gokora bo. Inee! Esegi y’okorusia egesiomba igoro y’abakori amabe tiyababuete agwo Gibea?

English: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them when they are bound to their two transgressions.
Kiswahili: Wakati nitakapopenda, nitawaadhibu; mataifa yatakusanywa dhidi yao ili kuwaweka katika vifungo kwa ajili ya dhambi zao mbili.
Ekegusii: Ekero ndaganie, nimbae egesusuro gi’okobarongeyia, erio abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao mbasangererekane amo, baabachere amo baabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bibere.

English: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.
Kiswahili: Efraimu ni mtamba wa ngʼombe aliyefundishwa ambaye hupenda kupura, hivyo nitamfunga nira juu ya shingo yake nzuri. Nitamwendesha Efraimu, Yuda lazima alime, naye Yakobo lazima avunjavunje mabonge ya udongo.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo baarenge buna ritororo riorokereretigwe buya, rianchete koora, inche nigo nabegete rikorogoto ase ebigoti biabo ebiya. Bono nimbeekere Abaefraimu rikorogoto, nonya n’Abayuda goika babe bakorema, na Abayakobo goika babe bakobosa.

English: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek Yahweh, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
Kiswahili: Jipandieni wenyewe haki, vuneni matunda ya upendo usio na kikomo, vunjeni ardhi yenu isiyolimwa; kwa kuwa ni wakati wa kumtafuta Bwana, mpaka atakapokuja na kuwanyeshea juu yenu haki.
Ekegusii: Ebusurere oboronge, mogese ayare ay’obwanchani, eremere chimbuna chiaino, ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okomorigia Omonene, erinde ache abatwerie oboronge buna embura egotwa.

English: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.
Kiswahili: Lakini mmepanda uovu, mkavuna ubaya, mmekula tunda la udanganyifu. Kwa sababu mmetegemea nguvu zenu wenyewe na wingi wa mashujaa wenu,
Ekegusii: Mwasimekire ayare amabe, mwagesire aya atari ay’oboronge, mwarire ayare okwama kw’oborimo. Nigo mwasemeretie ogokora kwaino, na obonge bw’abasikari baino chituoni.

English: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.
Kiswahili: mngurumo wa vita utainuka dhidi ya watu wako, ili kwamba ngome zako zote zitaharibiwa: kama Shalmani alivyoharibu Beth-Arbeli katika siku ile ya vita, wakati mama pamoja na watoto wao walipotupwa kwa nguvu ardhini.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio eriomana rie chiseegi ndibe ase egati y’abanto baino, ne chiburi chiaino chisarigwe, buna omorwoti Salimani asaretie Beti‐Aribeli ase rituko riria ri’esegi, abang’ina amo nabana babo banachanetwe bakaba ebing’ese.

English: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.
Kiswahili: Ndivyo itakavyotokea kwako, ee Betheli, kwa sababu uovu wako ni mkuu. Siku ile itakapopambazuka, mfalme wa Israeli ataharibiwa kabisa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo na abanto ba Beteli barabakore ase engencho y’obobe bwaino obonene. Kobogokiamoka omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli naitwe akwe.

English: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
Kiswahili: “Wakati Israeli alipokuwa mtoto, nilimpenda, nilimwita mwanangu kutoka Misri.
Ekegusii: “Ekero Israeli arenge omwana, nigo namwanchete, na korwa Misiri nkarangeria omwana one.

English: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.
Kiswahili: Lakini kadiri nilivyomwita Israeli, ndivyo walivyokwenda mbali nami. Walitoa dhabihu kwa Mabaali na kufukiza uvumba kwa vinyago.
Ekegusii: Buna bagendererete korangerigwa, nabo bagendererete kona‐kwerusanania. Nigo babete bakorua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae Baali, na bagasamba ubani ase emegwekano baarenge gosasiima.

English: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.
Kiswahili: Mimi ndiye niliyemfundisha Efraimu kutembea, nikiwashika mikono; lakini hawakutambua kuwa ni mimi niliyewaponya.
Ekegusii: Ninche norokereretie Abaefraimu gotaara, nkababogoria namaboko aane, korende abanto abwo tibamanyete ng’a nigo naganetie kobagwenia.

English: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.
Kiswahili: Niliwaongoza kwa kamba za huruma ya kibinadamu, kwa vifungo vya upendo; niliondoa nira shingoni mwao nami nikainama kuwalisha.
Ekegusii: Nigo nabang’usete ne chingori chinyororo, ee, ne chingori chi’obwanchani. Nigo nororobetie rikorogoto igoro ye chinsea chiabo, ngekumba gochia inse nkabarageria.

English: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.
Kiswahili: “Je, hawatarudi Misri, nayo Ashuru haitawatawala kwa sababu wamekataa kutubu?
Ekegusii: “Barabwo mbairane gochia ase ense ya Misiri, na Abaasuri mbaabagambere, ekiagera bangire koirana gocha ase ’nde.

English: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.
Kiswahili: Panga zitametameta katika miji yao, zitaharibu makomeo ya malango yao na kukomesha mipango yao.
Ekegusii: Omoro nogwere emechie yabo nobotindi, nosarie emekorogoto y’ebiita biabo na gosaria kende gionsi ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.

English: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
Kiswahili: Watu wangu wamedhamiria kuniacha. Hata kama wakimwita Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, kwa vyovyote hatawainua.
Ekegusii: Abanto baane nigo banchete gontiga, nonya bakorangerigwa gochia ase Oyore Igoro Mono, onde tari okomotogia, nonya noyomo.

English: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.
Kiswahili: “Efraimu, ninawezaje kukuacha? Ee Israeli, ninawezaje kukutoa? Nitawezaje kukutendea kama Adma? Nitawezaje kukufanya kama Seboimu? Moyo wangu umegeuka ndani yangu, huruma zangu zote zimeamshwa.
Ekegusii: “Inwe Abaefraimu, naki ndakore mbatige? Inwe Abaisraeli, naki ndakore mbatige morue asende? Naki ndakore mbatige buna natigete Adima? Naki ndakore mbakorere buna nakorerete Seboimu? Enkoro yane nigo egwoka, na amaabera aane onsi abokire ime yane.

English: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.
Kiswahili: Sitatimiza hasira yangu kali, wala sitageuka na kumharibu Efraimu. Kwa kuwa mimi ndimi Mungu, wala si mwanadamu, Aliye Mtakatifu miongoni mwenu. Sitakuja kwa ghadhabu.
Ekegusii: Tinkobaa egesusuro konde nendamwamu egwoka, gose tingosiria Abaefraimu naende, ekiagera inche nigo ’nde Nyasae, tindi Mwanyabaanto. Inche nigo inde Omochenu imenyete ase egati yaino, na tingocha ase more inde nekeririanda.

English: They will walk after Yahweh, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.
Kiswahili: Watamfuata Bwana; atanguruma kama simba. Wakati angurumapo, watoto wake watakuja wakitetemeka kutoka magharibi.
Ekegusii: “Abanto abwo mbabwatie Omonene; ere narume buna endo, ee, narume, na abanto baye mbache korwa bosongo bakoiguswa.

English: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Watakuja wakitetemeka kama ndege wakitoka Misri, kama hua wakitoka Ashuru. Nitawakalisha katika nyumba zao,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Mbairuruke buna chinyoni korwa Misiri, bache bakoiguswa, na buna amaruma korwa ase ense y’Asuri. Nimbabeeke bamenye ase chinka chiabo.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.

English: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.
Kiswahili: Efraimu amenizunguka kwa uongo, nyumba ya Israeli kwa udanganyifu. Naye Yuda ni mkaidi dhidi ya Mungu, hata kinyume cha yule mwaminifu Aliye Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bang’etananire n’amang’ana ’oborimo, na Abaisraeli boigo n’amang’ana ’obong’ainereria; n’Abayuda nigo bagendererete gosaria ase Nyasae, oria ore Omochenu na Omwegenwa.

English: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.
Kiswahili: Efraimu anajilisha upepo; hufukuzia upepo wa mashariki kutwa nzima na kuzidisha uongo na jeuri. Anafanya mkataba na Ashuru na kutuma mafuta ya zeituni Misri.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bakwerageria embeo, nigo bakobwatia embeo ya moocha omobaso bwonsi. Kera rituko nigo bakomenta gokwana oborimo, na gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakobwatana n’Abaasuri, babe bakoira amaguta ’amazeituni ase ense ya Misiri.

English: Yahweh also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.
Kiswahili: Bwana analo shtaka dhidi ya Yuda, atamwadhibu Yakobo kwa kadiri ya njia zake na kumlipa kwa kadiri ya matendo yake.
Ekegusii: Omonene nabwate amang’ana akwomania Abayuda, nae abanto ba Yakobo egesusuro koreng’ana ne chinchera chiabo, nabaakane koreng’ana nogokora kwabo.

English: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.
Kiswahili: Yakobo akiwa tumboni alishika kisigino cha kaka yake; kama mwanadamu, alishindana na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo arenge ase enda ya ng’ina, nigo abwatete egetingiro kia momura omwabo, na ekero abeete omonto omonene, agakinana na Nyasae.

English: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us—
Kiswahili: Alishindana na malaika na kumshinda; alilia na kuomba upendeleo wake. Alimkuta huko Betheli na kuzungumza naye huko:
Ekegusii: Ee, nigo akinanete nomomalaika, akamobua; akarera, akamosorora ng’a amororere amaabera. Agwo Beteli Yakobo akaumerana na Nyasae, erio agakwana naintwe.

English: even Yahweh, the God of Armies. Yahweh is his name of renown!
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Bwana ndilo jina lake!
Ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae bw’Emeganda. Omonene nario erieta riaye.

English: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.
Kiswahili: Lakini ni lazima urudi kwa Mungu wako; dumisha upendo na haki, nawe umngojee Mungu wako siku zote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye irana ase Nyasae oo. Obwatie obwanchani na oboronge bwaye, erio obe komosemeretie Nyasae oo botambe.

English: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
Kiswahili: Mfanyabiashara hutumia vipimo vya udanganyifu; hupenda kupunja.
Ekegusii: Omoonchoreria nigo abwate ebirengero bi’obong’ainereria ase amaboko aye, nigo anchete gokora oborianania.

English: Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”
Kiswahili: Efraimu hujisifu akisema, “Mimi ni tajiri sana; nimetajirika. Pamoja na utajiri wangu wote hawatakuta ndani yangu uovu wowote au dhambi.”
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bagoteeba: “Amaene twabeire abanda, twenyoreire obotenenku; ase emeremo yaito yonsi monto onde tari oranyare gotosoera ng’a nigo twanyorire obonda obo ase enchera y’ebibe bi’oborianania.”

English: “But I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu niliyewaleta kutoka Misri; nitawafanya mkae tena kwenye mahema, kama vile katika siku za sikukuu zenu zilizoamriwa.
Ekegusii: Korende inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero keria mwarenge Misiri, nimbabeeke momenye ase chiema naende, buna yarenge Amatuko Amanene aria achiikire.

English: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.
Kiswahili: Niliongea na manabii, nikawapa maono mengi na kusema mifano kupitia wao.”
Ekegusii: “Nigo narenge gokwana nababani, nkaba nkobaorokeria amaroro amange ao ao, na goetera ase ababani nkaba ngokwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio.

English: If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.
Kiswahili: Je, Gileadi si mwovu? Watu wake hawafai kitu! Je, hawatoi dhabihu za mafahali huko Gilgali? Madhabahu zao zitakuwa kama malundo ya mawe katika shamba lililolimwa.
Ekegusii: Onye ebibe bire ime ya Gileadi, abanto b’aroro goika basire. Onye abanto ba Giligali bakoruera ebing’wanso bie chieri aroro ase ebisasimero biabo, birobio mbisarigwe bibe buna obonge bwa amagena ase emetaro y’emegondo.”

English: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.
Kiswahili: Yakobo alikimbilia katika nchi ya Aramu; Israeli alitumika ili apate mke, ili aweze kulipa kwa ajili yake alichunga kondoo.
Ekegusii: Yakobo nigo atamete gochia ase ense y’Aramu, ere Israeli agakora emeremo ase okonyora omokungu, ee, akarisia ching’ondi ase okonyora omokungu.

English: By a prophet Yahweh brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
Kiswahili: Bwana alimtumia nabii kumpandisha Israeli kutoka Misri, kwa njia ya nabii alimtunza.
Ekegusii: Goetera ase omobani Omonene akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na goetera ase omobani abanto abwo bakaba barendire.

English: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt.
Kiswahili: Lakini Efraimu amemchochea sana hasira; Bwana wake ataleta juu yake hatia yake ya kumwaga damu naye atamlipiza kwa ajili ya dharau yake.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu abwo bagechetie Omonene goika ere akaba nendamwamu enene mono; ase ayio Omonene obo nabeeke okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kobe igoro yabo; nabairanerie okogechia kwabo.

English: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died.
Kiswahili: Wakati Efraimu alipozungumza, watu walitetemeka, alikuwa ametukuzwa katika Israeli. Lakini alikuwa na hatia ya kumwabudu Baali naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Abaefraimu baarenge gokwana, abanto nigo baarenge koiguswa; nigo beimokereretie igoro ase egati y’Abaisraeli; korende bakarenta okomocha ase ogosasiima enyasae Baali, na ase ayio bagakwa.

English: Now they sin more and more, and have made themselves molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen. They say of them, ‘They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves.’
Kiswahili: Sasa wanatenda dhambi zaidi na zaidi; wanajitengenezea sanamu kutokana na fedha yao, vinyago vilivyotengenezwa kwa uhodari, vyote kazi ya fundi stadi. Inasemekana kuhusu hawa watu, “Hutoa dhabihu za binadamu na kubusu sanamu za ndama.”
Ekegusii: Nigo bagendererete gokora ebibe goetania, bakaroisia emegwekano ye chifeta bagosasiima, eyio babombete nobong’aini. Eyio yonsi nemeremo yaroisirie nabaroisia b’ebinto. Nigo bagoteeba igoro y’abwo: “Abwo bakorua abanto baba ebing’wanso, nigo bakonyunyunta emegwekano eyio ye chimori.”

English: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor, and like the smoke out of the chimney.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo watakuwa kama ukungu wa asubuhi, kama umande wa alfajiri utowekao, kama makapi yapeperushwayo kutoka sakafu ya kupuria nafaka, kama moshi utorokao kupitia dirishani.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo nabasire buna ritaturi ria mambia, gose buna riime rigosira bwango, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga korwa ase ekeooreri, gose buna erioki rigoetera ase ekebao riasira.

English: “Yet I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.
Kiswahili: “Bali mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, niliyewaleta ninyi toka Misri. Msimkubali Mungu mwingine ila mimi, hakuna Mwokozi isipokuwa mimi.
Ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero mwarenge ase ense ya Misiri. Timwabeete momanyete enyasae ende yonsi otatiga inche; omotooria onde tari otatiga inche.

English: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
Kiswahili: Niliwatunza huko jangwani, katika nchi yenye joto liunguzalo.
Ekegusii: Ninche nabarendete ase erooro, ense eria enyomo pa egosamba.

English: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me.
Kiswahili: Nilipowalisha, walishiba, waliposhiba, wakajivuna, kisha wakanisahau mimi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero banyorete endagera eisaine, bakaria bakaigota, erio bakaenena na kweimokereria igoro; ase ayio bakanyeba.

English: Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitakuja juu yao kama simba, kama chui nitawavizia kando ya njia.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nkaba buna endo ase bare, nkababoera ase chinchera chiabo buna engo ekoboera.

English: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.
Kiswahili: Kama dubu aliyenyangʼanywa watoto wake, nitawashambulia na kurarua vifua vyenu. Kama simba nitawala; mnyama pori atawararua vipande vipande.
Ekegusii: Nimbaumokere buna edubu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye, mbatandore ebikuba biabo, erinde mbaite mbarie buna endo ekoria, ee, nimbe buna eng’iti y’orosana mbatandorane.

English: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.
Kiswahili: “Ee Israeli, umeangamizwa, kwa sababu wewe u kinyume nami, kinyume na msaidizi wako.
Ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli mwesiririe inwe abanyene ase okoba mamincha yane, inche oyo narenge ooboseemiaka kwaino.

English: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?
Kiswahili: Yuko wapi mfalme wako, ili apate kukuokoa? Wako wapi watawala wako katika miji yako yote ambao ulisema kuwahusu, ‘Nipe mfalme na wakuu’?
Ekegusii: Bono ng’ai omorwoti oino are, erinde abatoorie ase emechie yaino yonsi? Ng’ai abagaambi ebiina baino bare, inwe abamwateebete: Toe omorwoti na abagaambi batogambere?

English: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.
Kiswahili: Hivyo katika hasira yangu nilikupa mfalme na katika ghadhabu yangu nilimwondoa.
Ekegusii: Nkabaa omorwoti inde nendamwamu, naende namorusirie inde nekeririanda.

English: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.
Kiswahili: Kosa la Efraimu limehifadhiwa, dhambi zake zimewekwa katika kumbukumbu.
Ekegusii: “Obobe bw’Abaefraimu nigo bosibire amo, na ebibe biabo nigo birikire bigachire.

English: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him. He is an unwise son, for when it is time, he doesn’t come to the opening of the womb.
Kiswahili: Utungu kama wa mwanamke anayejifungua mtoto humjia, lakini yeye ni mtoto asiyekuwa na hekima; wakati utakapowadia hatatoka katika tumbo la mama yake.
Ekegusii: Obororo bonga buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore mbobachere, nigo bonga buna omwana otari nokomanya osinyirwe gosoka korwa ase enda ya ng’ina ekero engaki yaye yaikire.

English: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where is your destruction? “Compassion will be hidden from my eyes.
Kiswahili: “Nitawakomboa watu hawa kutoka nguvu za kaburi, nitawakomboa kutoka mautini. Yako wapi, ee mauti, mateso yako? Uko wapi, ee kuzimu, uharibifu wako? “Sitakuwa na huruma,
Ekegusii: Nimbaboorie korwa ase okobua gw’aase abakuure, na nimbatoorie korwa ase amakweri. Aye amakweri, amaako ao ng’ai are? Aye aase abakuure, ng’ai ogosiria kwao kore? Ogweitia gwasirire korwa ase amaiso aane?

English: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of Yahweh coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.
Kiswahili: hata ingawa Efraimu atastawi miongoni mwa ndugu zake. Upepo wa mashariki kutoka kwa Bwana utakuja, ukivuma kutoka jangwani, chemchemi yake haitatoa maji na kisima chake kitakauka. Ghala lake litatekwa hazina zake zote.
Ekegusii: Abaefraimu nabaisa koibora babuche ase egati y’abamwabo, omwaga korwa moocha noche, ee, omwaga o Omonene noche korwa ase erooro. Erio ebisima biabo bi’amaache biome, ne chinsoko chiabo chikame. Omwaga oyio nosirie kegima chinibo chiabo banchete.

English: Samaria will bear her guilt, for she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women will be ripped open.”
Kiswahili: Watu wa Samaria ni lazima wabebe hatia yao, kwa sababu wameasi dhidi ya Mungu wao. Wataanguka kwa upanga; watoto wao wadogo watatupwa kwa nguvu ardhini, wanawake wao walio na mimba watatumbuliwa.”
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Samaria mbaegwe egesusuro, ekiagera basaririe ase Nyasae obo, mbaitwe nemioro, na abana babo banachanwe ebing’ese. Abakungu babo bare barito mbatandorwe chinda.”

English: Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
Kiswahili: Rudi, ee Israeli, kwa Bwana Mungu wako. Dhambi zako zimekuwa ndilo anguko lako!
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, irana ase Omonene Nyasae oino, ekiagera ebibe biaino nabio biabagochire na kobaiyeria.

English: Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.
Kiswahili: Chukueni maneno pamoja nanyi, mkamrudie Bwana. Mwambieni: “Samehe dhambi zetu zote na utupokee kwa neema, ili tuweze kutoa matunda yetu kama sadaka za mafahali.
Ekegusii: Irana ase Omonene, momoteebie amang’ana aya: Toruserie obobe bwaito bwonsi obwo twakorire, bwanchere ayare amaya, naintwe torue asore ogotogia kw’ebikoba biaito konga buna okoruegwa kw’ebing’wanso bie chieri.

English: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”
Kiswahili: Ashuru hawezi kutuokoa, hatutapanda farasi wa vita. Kamwe hatutasema tena ‘Miungu yetu’ kwa kile ambacho mikono yetu wenyewe imetengeneza, kwa kuwa kwako wewe yatima hupata huruma.”
Ekegusii: Abaasuri tibakonyara gototooria; titokoriina chibarasi gose titokogenderera koroka emeremo y’amaboko aito Nyasae oito. Aye Omonene nigo okoorokia amaabera ase oyore entakana.

English: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.
Kiswahili: “Nitaponya ukaidi wao na kuwapenda kwa hiari yangu, kwa kuwa hasira yangu imeondoka kwao.
Ekegusii: “Ningwenie abwo batigire obwegenwa bwabo. Nimbanche nenkoro yane yonsi, ekiagera endamwamu yane yabatigire.

English: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
Kiswahili: Nitakuwa kama umande kwa Israeli; atachanua kama yungiyungi. Kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni atashusha mizizi yake chini;
Ekegusii: Niimbe buna riime ase Abaisraeli, na barabwo mbasiche buna ebisicha ebiya, mbakinie emeri buna emete ya Lebanoni.

English: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
Kiswahili: matawi yake yatatanda. Fahari yake itakuwa kama mti wa mzeituni, harufu yake nzuri kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni.
Ekegusii: Ebisabo biabo mbirande, na obwari bwabo nabobe buna obw’emezeituni, ne rimisu riabo ndiesiarere buna eri’emete ya Lebanoni.

English: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.
Kiswahili: Watu wataishi tena kwenye kivuli chake. Atastawi kama nafaka. Atachanua kama mzabibu, nao umaarufu wake utakuwa kama divai itokayo Lebanoni.
Ekegusii: Abwo baramenye inse ase ekiriri kiabo bairane, bagenderere koreereta buna ebimeri bia mogondo mbasiche, na obonene bwabo bobe buna obw’emesabibu ya Lebanoni.

English: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”
Kiswahili: Ee Efraimu, nina shughuli gani tena na sanamu? Nitamjibu na kumtunza. Mimi ni kama msunobari wenye majani mabichi; kuzaa kwako matunda kunatoka kwangu.”
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaefraimu, naki ngokora nemegwekano yaino mogosasiima? Ninche omonyene naigure ogosaba kwaino inwe Abaefraimu, nimbairanerie, naende ninche mbarendete. Inche nigo inde buna omotarakwa omobese; na okwama kwaino nigo gokonyorekana ime yane.”

English: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
Kiswahili: Ni nani mwenye hekima? Atayatambua mambo haya. Ni nani mwenye ufahamu? Huyu atayaelewa. Njia za Bwana ni adili; wenye haki huenda katika njia hizo, lakini waasi watajikwaa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Oyore omong’aini, nere oramanye amang’ana aya; oyore nokomanya, nere orayarengererie. Chinchera chi’Omonene nigo chire chindonge, na abanyene oboronge nabwo baraetere aroro, korende abasaria nigo baragochwe bagwe ase chirochio.

English: Yahweh’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana ambalo lilimjia Yoeli mwana wa Pethueli.
Ekegusii: Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete ase Yoel, mosinto o Petueli.

English: Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni hili, enyi wazee; sikilizeni, ninyi nyote mnaoishi katika nchi. Je, jambo kama hili lilishawahi kutokea katika siku zenu au katika siku za babu zenu?
Ekegusii: Inwe abagaaka, igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe abanto bonsi abamomenyete ase ya Yuda, tegerera moigwe! Inee! Amang’ana buna aya anagokorekana ase amatuko aino, gose ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino?

English: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.
Kiswahili: Waelezeni watoto wenu, na watoto wenu wawaambie watoto wao, na watoto wao kwa kizazi kitakachofuata.
Ekegusii: Yateebie abana baino amang’ana aya, na abana baino bayateebie abana babo, na abana babo bayateebie ekegori kende.

English: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.
Kiswahili: Kilichosazwa na kundi la tunutu nzige wakubwa wamekula, kilichosazwa na nzige wakubwa parare wamekula, kilichosazwa na parare madumadu wamekula.
Ekegusii: Ogosongerera ase obonge gw’echingige, chiagwereire ebimeri, biria chinyanchaba chiatigaretie, chingige chikayeria, na eye chingige chiatigaretie, ebisase bikayeria, na eye ebisase biatigaretie, chingeeti chikayeria.

English: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
Kiswahili: Amkeni, enyi walevi, mlie! Pigeni yowe enyi wanywaji wote wa mvinyo, pigeni yowe kwa sababu ya mvinyo mpya, kwa kuwa mmenyangʼanywa kutoka midomoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamwatindire nebinyugwa ebiroro, boka morere! Inwe mwensi aba mokonywa edivai, bokia amagombo, ase engencho amasabibu onsi y’okoroisia edivai enyia, asarigwe.

English: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.
Kiswahili: Taifa limevamia nchi yangu, lenye nguvu tena lisilo na idadi; lina meno ya simba, magego ya simba jike.
Ekegusii: Risaga ri’echingige chinyinge riaumokeire ense yaito, nigo rire n’echinguru chi’ogokumia na nigo rire rinene mono; amaino aye nigo agwekaine ay’Endo, na amagegu aye nigo anga buna ay’endo eaberi.

English: He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.
Kiswahili: Limeharibu mizabibu yangu na kuangamiza mitini yangu. Limebambua magome yake na kuyatupilia mbali, likayaacha matawi yake yakiwa meupe.
Ekegusii: Giasaririe emesabibu yaito, kiabunire emeko yaito; kiayesaboire, na gotuguta amasabo inse, ne chinsagia chi’emete eyio chiarabire se.

English: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!
Kiswahili: Omboleza kama bikira aliyevaa nguo ya gunia anayehuzunika kwa ajili ya mume wa ujana wake.
Ekegusii: Rera na kobokia amagombo buna omoiseke omwekungi obegete chianga chi’echigunia, okwereirwe nomosaacha bw’oboke bwaye.

English: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from Yahweh’s house. The priests, Yahweh’s ministers, mourn.
Kiswahili: Sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji zimekatiliwa mbali kutoka nyumba ya Bwana. Makuhani wanaomboleza, wale wanaohudumu mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biatangirwe, tibirentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene. Abakuani abare abakoreri b’Omonene nigo bakorera.

English: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.
Kiswahili: Mashamba yameharibiwa, ardhi imekauka; nafaka imeharibiwa, mvinyo mpya umekauka, mafuta yamekoma.
Ekegusii: Emegondo yatigaire bosa; riroba nigo rikorera ekiagera endagera yasirigwe, edivai tekobao na amaguta ’emezeituni akeeire kegima.

English: Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.
Kiswahili: Kateni tamaa, enyi wakulima, lieni, enyi mlimao mizabibu; huzunikeni kwa ajili ya ngano na shayiri, kwa sababu mavuno ya shambani yameharibiwa.
Ekegusii: Inwe abaremi ichana na gosooka, nainwe abaroiseria b’emesabibu, rera, ekiagera engano na esairi biasirigwe amo nokwama gwonsi kw’emegondo.

English: The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.
Kiswahili: Mzabibu umekauka na mtini umenyauka; mkomamanga, mtende na mtofaa, miti yote shambani, imekauka. Hakika furaha yote ya mwanadamu imeondoka.
Ekegusii: Emesabibu yomire, na emeko boigo. Emekomomanga, na emekendo, na emete y’amapera, ee, emete ende yonsi y’emegondo yomire. Ogochenga kwaerire ase egati y’abanto.

English: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.
Kiswahili: Vaeni nguo ya gunia, enyi makuhani, muomboleze; pigeni yowe, enyi mnaohudumu madhabahuni. Njooni, vaeni nguo ya gunia usiku kucha, enyi mnaohudumu mbele za Mungu wangu; kwa kuwa sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji zimezuiliwa kufika katika nyumba ya Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abakuani, eboyie chigunia, morere, nainwe abakoreri b’egesasiimero, bokia amagombo! Eboyie chigunia, morere ase Hekalu ime ase obotuko bwonsi, ekiagera okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biaborire, ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of Yahweh, your God, and cry to Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Tangazeni saumu takatifu; liiteni kusanyiko takatifu. Iteni wazee na wote waishio katika nchi waende katika nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wenu, wakamlilie Bwana.
Ekegusii: Raria engaki y’okweng’ata; rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasiima! Sangereria abagaaka na abanto bonsi b’ense eye, bache ase enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, erinde morere ase Omonene.

English: Alas for the day! For the day of Yahweh is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
Kiswahili: Ole kwa siku hiyo! Kwa kuwa siku ya Bwana iko karibu; itakuja kama uharibifu kutoka kwa Mwenyezi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire ang’e, riraarente ogosirigwa korwa ase Omonguru.

English: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
Kiswahili: Je, chakula hakikukatiliwa mbali mbele ya macho yetu: furaha na shangwe kutoka nyumba ya Mungu wetu?
Ekegusii: Endagera yasiriigwe torigereretie na amaiso aito. Omogooko na amaseko arusiigwe korwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.
Kiswahili: Mbegu zinakauka chini ya mabonge ya udongo. Ghala zimeachwa katika uharibifu, ghala za nafaka zimebomolewa, kwa maana hakuna nafaka.
Ekegusii: Chimbusuro chagundeire riroba ime; ebiage biatigaire bosa na ebigancha biasarekire, ekiagera endagera ekogachwa yaborire.

English: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
Kiswahili: Jinsi gani ngʼombe wanavyolia! Makundi ya mifugo yanahangaika kwa sababu hawana malisho; hata makundi ya kondoo yanateseka.
Ekegusii: Rigereria chitugo buna chikwana chichandegete, amaicho e chiombe achandekire, ekiagera obonyansi bwaborire chikorisia, nonya namaicho e ching’ondi achandekire.

English: Yahweh, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.
Kiswahili: Kwako, Ee Bwana, naita, kwa kuwa moto umeteketeza malisho ya mbugani na miali ya moto imeunguza miti yote shambani.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inche nigo nkorera asore, ekiagera omorero bwomirie obonyansi ase ebitii, n’echimeme chi’omorero chiasiririe emete y’orosana.

English: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Hata wanyama wa porini wanakuonea shauku; vijito vya maji vimekauka, na moto umeteketeza malisho yote ya mbugani.
Ekegusii: Nonya ne ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chikorera asore, ekiagera chindooche chiakamire, amaache taiyo, ee, omorero oria osambire amarisio ’erooro.

English: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of Yahweh comes, for it is close at hand:
Kiswahili: Pigeni tarumbeta katika Sayuni; pigeni mbiu katika mlima wangu mtakatifu. Wote waishio katika nchi na watetemeke, kwa kuwa siku ya Bwana inakuja. Iko karibu,
Ekegusii: Bugia egetureeri ase Sayoni, ee, bugia egetureeri ki’ogotabobora ase egetunwa egechenu. Tiga abanto bonsi ba Yuda baiguswe, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ang’e.

English: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.
Kiswahili: siku ya giza na huzuni, siku ya mawingu na utusitusi. Kama mapambazuko yasambaavyo toka upande huu wa milima hata upande mwingine jeshi kubwa na lenye nguvu linakuja. Jambo kama hili halijakuwepo tangu zamani wala halitakuwepo tena kamwe kwa vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Nigo rirabe rituko ri’omosunte na eri’amataturi, rituko ri’amare na omosunte ekerima. Omoganda omonene bw’echingige nochiche, nigo orarande buna omosunte igoro ase ebitunwa. Omogwekano bw’amang’ana ayio tana koba korwa kare, gose takoba nonya ng’ake ase ebigori bigochi‐gocha.

English: A fire devours before them, and behind them, a flame burns. The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them, a desolate wilderness. Yes, and no one has escaped them.
Kiswahili: Mbele yao moto unateketeza, nyuma yao miali ya moto inawaka kwa nguvu. Mbele yao nchi iko kama bustani ya Edeni, nyuma yao ni jangwa lisilofaa: hakuna kitu kinachowaepuka.
Ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omorero ogosamba noboigo omoganda oyio ogosaria kera egento kere bosio bwaye, na magega gotiga kera egento gekoyia; ekero chitaraeta, ense eyio nigo enga buna omogondo o Eden, korende ekero chiaetire yatigara erooro bosa ase echio kende tikeri kerachitamboke.

English: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses, and they run as horsemen.
Kiswahili: Wanaonekana kama farasi; wanakwenda mbio kama askari wapanda farasi.
Ekegusii: Okororekana kwabo nigo konga buna ogwe chibarasi; nigo chikominyoka buna chibarasi chi’okorwana esegi.

English: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array.
Kiswahili: Wanatoa sauti kama magari ya vita, wanaporukaruka juu ya vilele vya milima, kama mlio wa miali ya moto ilayo mabua, kama jeshi kubwa lililojipanga kwa ajili ya vita.
Ekegusii: Ekero chigoeta igoro ase ebitunwa, ebititiro biabo nigo binga buna ebie chigari, naende nigo binga buna ogotoreka kw’omorero ogosamba amasakwe; chirochio nigo chire buna abasikari bare ne chinguru baroberigwe.

English: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.
Kiswahili: Wanapoonekana, mataifa yanakuwa katika maumivu makuu; kila uso unabadilika rangi.
Ekegusii: Ekero chigocha abanto nigo bagoichorwa nobwoba, amaiso ’abaanto bonsi nigo akoonchoka arachoka.

English: They run like mighty men. They climb the wall like warriors. They each march in his line, and they don’t swerve off course.
Kiswahili: Wanashambulia kama wapiganaji wa vita; wanapanda kuta kama askari. Wote wanatembea katika safu, hawapotoshi safu zao.
Ekegusii: Nigo chikominyoka gochia korwana esegi buna abasikari chituoni; nigo chikoriina chindwaki igoro buna abasikari. Kera eyemo nigo eragenderere gochia bosio, ende teri eragobere esire enchera ebwatetie.

English: One doesn’t jostle another. They each march in their own path. They burst through the defenses and don’t break ranks.
Kiswahili: Hakuna anayemsukuma mwenzake; kila mmoja anakwenda mbele moja kwa moja. Wanapita katika vizuizi bila kuharibu safu zao.
Ekegusii: Tichikomigererania, kera eyemo nigo egoeta omong’ororia oye; nigo chigoeta gati‐gati y’ebirwanero, tichigotangeka.

English: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.
Kiswahili: Wanaenda kasi kuingia mjini; wanakimbia ukutani. Wanaingia ndani ya nyumba; kwa kuingilia madirishani kama wevi.
Ekegusii: Nigo chikorindokera omochie, na kominyoka ase chindwaki igoro; nigo chikoriina ase chinyomba chisoa ime na chietera ase chitirisa buna abaibi.

English: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
Kiswahili: Mbele yao dunia inatikisika, anga linatetemeka, jua na mwezi vinatiwa giza, na nyota hazitoi mwanga wake tena.
Ekegusii: Ense nigo egotengecha bosio bwabo, na igoro yanyegerigwa. Erioba na omotienyi nabibekwe omosunte; ne ching’enang’eni tichikobara.

English: Yahweh thunders his voice before his army, for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for the day of Yahweh is great and very awesome, and who can endure it?
Kiswahili: Bwana anatoa mshindo wa ngurumo mbele ya jeshi lake; majeshi yake hayana idadi, ni wenye nguvu nyingi wale ambao hutii agizo lake. Siku ya Bwana ni kuu, ni ya kutisha. Ni nani anayeweza kuistahimili?
Ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigugwa bosio bw’omoganda oye bw’esegi, ekiagera omoganda oye bw’esegi oyio okomoigwera nigo ore omonene mono; Rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire eri’okoirokia. Ning’o oranyare koriremereria?

English: “Yet even now,” says Yahweh, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”
Kiswahili: “Hata sasa,” asema Bwana, “nirudieni kwa mioyo yenu yote, kwa kufunga, kwa kulia na kuomboleza.”
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire, “Nonya mbono ng’iranere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, ase okweng’ata, na okorera, na okweng’ereria.

English: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
Kiswahili: Rarueni mioyo yenu na siyo mavazi yenu. Mrudieni Bwana, Mungu wenu, kwa maana yeye ndiye mwenye neema na mwingi wa huruma, si mwepesi wa hasira, ni mwingi wa upendo, huona huruma, hujizuia kuleta maafa.
Ekegusii: Tandora chinkoro chiaino ase ogweitia, gose tari ogotandora chianga chiaino.” Irana gochia ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekiagera ere nomuya na omonyamaabera; ere tari omwango ase okoba nendamwamu; obwanchani bwaye nobwa botambe, nigo akoonchoka otiga kobarentera amabe.

English: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to Yahweh, your God.
Kiswahili: Ni nani ajuaye? Yeye aweza kugeuka na kuwa na huruma na kuacha baraka nyuma yake: sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji kwa ajili ya Bwana Mungu wenu.
Ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete, ande gose Omonene naonchoke atige kobarentera amabe, korende abatigere ogosesenigwa, erinde moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa?

English: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.
Kiswahili: Pigeni tarumbeta katika Sayuni, tangazeni saumu takatifu, liiteni kusanyiko takatifu.
Ekegusii: Bugia egetureeri ase Sayoni; raria engaki y’okweng’ata, rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasiima!

English: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber.
Kiswahili: Wakusanyeni watu, wekeni wakfu kusanyiko; waleteni pamoja wazee, wakusanyeni watoto, wale wanyonyao maziwa. Bwana arusi na atoke chumbani mwake na bibi arusi naye atoke katika chumba chake.
Ekegusii: Sangereria abanto amo, ochene omosangererekano oyio; sangereria abagaaka, sangereria nabana, nonya nabakogonka. Tiga nonya mbaria banyuomanire bwango iga basoke korwa mwabo,

English: Let the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, Yahweh, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”
Kiswahili: Makuhani, ambao wanahudumu mbele za Bwana, na walie katikati ya ukumbi wa Hekalu na madhabahu. Waseme, “Wahurumie watu wako, Ee Bwana. Usifanye urithi wako kitu cha kudharauliwa, neno la dhihaka kati ya mataifa. Kwa nini wasemezane miongoni mwao, ‘Yuko wapi Mungu wao?’ ”
Ekegusii: Abakuani abwo bakomokorera Omonene tiga barere ase egati y’egesona na egesasiimero, bakwane iga, “Aye Omonene, rorera abanto bao amaabera; totiga abanto abwo bare omwando oo bachecherigwe, bakwanwe bobe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku. Nase ki abanto baraborie: Ng’ai Nyasae obo are”?

English: Then Yahweh was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana atakuwa na wivu kwa ajili ya nchi yake na kuwa na huruma juu ya watu wake.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaba ne risemi ase engencho y’ense yaye, akarorera abanto baye amabeebe.

English: Yahweh answered his people, “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied with them; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.
Kiswahili: Bwana atawajibu: “Ninawapelekea nafaka, mvinyo mpya na mafuta, vya kuwatosha ninyi hadi mridhike kabisa; kamwe sitawafanya tena kitu cha kudharauliwa na mataifa.
Ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria abanto baye, akabateebia, Rora, nkobatomera nde endagera, na edivai, na amaguta, na inwe namoisaneke; tinkobatiga mogenderere gochaywa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku.

English: But I will remove the northern army far away from you, and will drive it into a barren and desolate land, its front into the eastern sea, and its back into the western sea; and its stench will come up, and its bad smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things.
Kiswahili: “Nitafukuza jeshi la kaskazini likae mbali nanyi, nikilisukuma ndani ya jangwa, askari wa safu za mbele wakienda ndani ya bahari ya mashariki na wale wa safu za nyuma katika bahari ya magharibi. Uvundo wake utapaa juu; harufu yake itapanda juu.” Hakika ametenda mambo makubwa.
Ekegusii: Ninserie omoganda bw’echingige okorwa sugusu orue ase more, obeere are korwa ase more, ninyoserie ogende ase ense enyomo ere bosa, ensemo etang’aine egende gochia ase Enyancha y’omonyo, na ensemo ekorwa magega egende gochia ase Enyancha ya Mediterania. Ogotioka kw’ebitondo biabo nkoimokerere igoro, ekiagera okorire ayare amanene mono.

English: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for Yahweh has done great things.
Kiswahili: Usiogope, ee nchi; furahi na kushangilia. Hakika Bwana ametenda mambo makubwa.
Ekegusii: Aye ense, toiroka! Korende goka na gochenga, ekiagera Omonene okorire ayare amanene.

English: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.
Kiswahili: Msiogope, enyi wanyama pori, kwa kuwa mbuga za malisho yenu zinarudia ubichi. Miti nayo inazaa matunda, mtini na mzabibu inatoa utajiri wake.
Ekegusii: Inwe ching’iti chi’orosana, timoiroka, ekiagera amarisio are ase erooro amerire obonyansi; emete yamire amatunda, emeko na emesabibu yamire okwama kwabo okonene.

English: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.
Kiswahili: Furahini, enyi watu wa Sayuni, shangilieni katika Bwana Mungu wenu, kwa kuwa amewapa mvua za vuli kwa kipimo cha haki. Anawapelekea mvua nyingi, mvua ya vuli na ya masika, kama mwanzoni.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, goka, mochenge ase ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino abakoreire, ekiagera obaeire embura entang’ani ebaisaine; nere okobatweria embura botambe, eye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.

English: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
Kiswahili: Sakafu za kupuria zitajaa nafaka, mapipa yatafurika mvinyo mpya na mafuta.
Ekegusii: Ebiooreri bikoorerwa mbiichorwe ne chindagera; na ebimitero mbiichore nedivai na amaguta goika biiteke.

English: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.
Kiswahili: “Nitawalipa kwa ajili ya miaka ile iliyoliwa na nzige: parare, madumadu na tunutu, jeshi langu kubwa ambalo nililituma katikati yenu.
Ekegusii: Nimbairanerie ebi’emiaka eria biasaretigwe, ne chingige, na ebisase, ne chingeeti, omoganda oyio omonene natomete gocha ase egati yaino.

English: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of Yahweh, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.
Kiswahili: Mtakuwa na wingi wa vyakula mpaka mshibe, na mtalisifu jina la Bwana Mungu wenu, ambaye amefanya maajabu kwa ajili yenu; kamwe watu wangu hawataaibishwa tena.
Ekegusii: Bono monyore endagera enyinge mokoria moigote, erio motogie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyio obakoreire amakumia. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende.

English: You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am Yahweh, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtakapojua kwamba mimi niko katika Israeli kwamba mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, na kwamba hakuna mwingine; kamwe watu wangu hawataaibika tena.
Ekegusii: Erio namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ase egati yaino inwe Abaisraeli, naende ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, naende Nyasae onde omoao tari. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende.

English: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions.
Kiswahili: “Hata itakuwa, baada ya hayo, nitamimina Roho wangu juu ya wote wenye mwili. Wana wenu na binti zenu watatabiri, wazee wenu wataota ndoto, na vijana wenu wataona maono.
Ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, nimbaiterere abanto bonsi Omoika one; abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inabaabaane, na abagaaka baino nabarote chindoto, na abamura baino nabarore amaroro.

English: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.
Kiswahili: Hata juu ya watumishi wangu, wanaume kwa wanawake, katika siku zile nitamimina Roho wangu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase amatuko ayio nimbaiterere abasomba baane, abasacha na abakungu, Omoika one.

English: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.
Kiswahili: Nami nitaonyesha maajabu katika mbingu na duniani: damu, moto na mawimbi ya moshi.
Ekegusii: Ning’orokie ebikone igoro na ase ense; amanyinga, na omorero, ne rikundesi ri’erioki.

English: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.
Kiswahili: Jua litageuzwa kuwa giza na mwezi kuwa mwekundu kama damu, kabla ya kuja siku ya Bwana ile kuu na ya kutisha.
Ekegusii: Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi noonchoke obe buna amanyiga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene, erire rinene, na eri’okoondokia, ritaracha.

English: It will happen that whoever will call on Yahweh’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as Yahweh has said, and among the remnant, those whom Yahweh calls.
Kiswahili: Na kila mtu atakayeliitia jina la Bwana ataokolewa. Kwa maana juu ya Mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu kutakuwepo wokovu, kama Bwana alivyosema, miongoni mwa walionusurika ambao Bwana awaita.
Ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera oyorarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe, ekiagera ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ime ya Yerusalemu, mbabe aroro abanto baratooreke, buna Omonene atebiire, na ase egati y’abwo baratigare nigo barabe abwo Omonene achorire.

English: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
Kiswahili: “Katika siku hizo na wakati huo, nitakaporejesha neema ya Yuda na Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: “Rora, ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, inche Omonene ning’iranerie Abayuda, na abanto ba Yerusalemu, bare ase obosomba, amaya abo.

English: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,
Kiswahili: nitayakusanya mataifa yote na kuyaleta katika Bonde la Yehoshafati Hapo nitaingia kwenye hukumu dhidi yao kuhusu urithi wangu, watu wangu Israeli, kwa kuwa waliwatawanya watu wangu miongoni mwa mataifa na kuigawa nchi yangu.
Ekegusii: Ninsangererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, mbatirimbokie gochia ase Rikura ri’ekegambero ria Jehoshaphat; aroro agwo nimbanachere ekiina, ase onsi eria bakorerete abanto bane. Ekiagera mbasiarerete Abaisraeli, gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, naende baatananire ense yane Israeli.

English: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
Kiswahili: Wanawapigia kura watu wangu na kuwauza wavulana ili kupata makahaba; waliwauza wasichana ili wapate kunywa mvinyo.
Ekegusii: Baakeire abanto baane obomera, erio korigia ning’o okoira abooswa baoonirie abana abamura, erinde banyore abakungu abatayayi, na baoonirie abana abaiseke, erinde banyore edivai bakonywa.

English: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.
Kiswahili: “Sasa una nini dhidi yangu, ee Tiro na Sidoni, nanyi nchi zote za Ufilisti? Je, mnanilipiza kwa yale niliyoyafanya? Kama mnalipa, mimi nitalipiza juu ya vichwa vyenu kwa kasi na kwa haraka yale mliyoyatenda.
Ekegusii: “Inwe Turo na Sidoni, ne chingongo chionsi chi’Abafilisti, ngento ki mogonkorera? Inee! Nigo moganetie kong’iraneria egento? Moise korusia egesiomba igoro yane, nimbairanerie ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino bwango mono.
