Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Noisa koagacha egeswa kiao aaria igoro buna ekeongo, ee, nokebeke ase egati‐gati ye ching’enang’eni, inche ninkoiyerie korwa aroro.

English: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa wevi wangekuja kwako, ikiwa wanyangʼanyi wangekujia usiku: Lo! Tazama ni maafa kiasi gani yangekuwa yanakungojea: je, si wangeiba tu kiasi ambacho wangehitaji? Kama wachuma zabibu wangekuja kwako, je, wasingebakiza zabibu chache?
Ekegusii: “Abaibi gose abasakori baise kogochera botuko, aye nosirigwe kegima. Ekeene, nigo baraibe binde bionsi baganetie. Inee! Abasangereria b’amasabibu baare kogochera, tibarenge kogotigera nonya naria agotigara? Korende asore aye ababisa bao bagosiririe kegima.

English: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!
Kiswahili: Lakini tazama jinsi Esau atakavyotekwa, jinsi hazina zake zilizofichwa zitatekwa nyara!
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Esau chinibo chiaino chiasakoirwe; na obonda bwaino bwaibirwe bwonsi!

English: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”
Kiswahili: Wote ulioungana nao watakufukuza hadi mpakani, rafiki zako watakudanganya na kukushinda, wale wanaokula mkate wako watakutegea mtego, lakini hutaweza kuugundua.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bonsi kwabwatanete nabarabwo bagoseririe gochia ase orobebe, abanto baria gwakorete omorembe nabarabwo bakong’ainire na gokobua. Abasani bao mokoria komo bagotegeire oboreba, bagoteeba: Ng’ai obong’aini bwao bore?”

English: “Won’t I in that day”, says Yahweh, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?
Kiswahili: “Katika siku hiyo,” asema Bwana, “je, sitaangamiza watu wenye hekima wa Edomu, watu wenye ufahamu katika milima ya Esau?
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ase rituko erio ninsirie abanto abang’aini ba Edomu, naende ninsirie okomanya gwonsi korwa ase Egetunwa gia Esau.

English: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.
Kiswahili: Ee Temani, mashujaa wako watatiwa hofu, kila mmoja katika milima ya Esau ataangushwa chini kwa kuchinjwa.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abatemani, abarwani baino b’esegi bare chituoni mbaondoke, na kera oyomo ore ase Egetunwa gia Esau naitwe asirigwe kegima.

English: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya jeuri uliyofanya dhidi ya ndugu yako Yakobo, aibu itakufunika; utaangamizwa milele.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera mwaureretie na goita abanto bamino b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, namosookigwe na gosirigwa goika kare na kare.

English: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.
Kiswahili: Siku ile ulisimama mbali ukiangalia wakati wageni walipojichukulia utajiri wake na watu wa nchi nyingine walipoingia malango yake wakipiga kura kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu, ulikuwa kama mmoja wao.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwatenenete ensemo ase rituko riria, ekero abanto b’ense engeni bairete chinibo chiabo, bagasoa ebiita bia Yerusalemu, bakayoakera obomera. Naboigo nainwe mwarenge buna barabwo.

English: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.
Kiswahili: Usingemdharau ndugu yako katika siku ya msiba wake, wala kufurahia juu ya watu wa Yuda katika siku ya maangamizi yao, wala kujigamba sana katika siku ya taabu yao.
Ekegusii: Anga timware kogoka ase rituko riria amabe acherete abanto bamino. Gose timware gochenga ase rituko ri’ogosirigwa kw’Abayuda, gose timware gokwana noboenenu ase rituko ri’emechando yabo.

English: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.
Kiswahili: Usingeingia katika malango ya watu wangu katika siku ya maafa yao, wala kuwadharau katika janga lao katika siku ya maafa yao, wala kunyangʼanya mali zao katika siku ya maafa yao.
Ekegusii: Inwe anga timwasoete ase egeita ki’abaanto baane ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo; gose anga timwagokerete emechando yabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo, gose anga timwaramborete amaboko aino koira chinibo chiabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo.

English: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.
Kiswahili: Usingengoja kwenye njia panda na kuwaua wakimbizi wao, wala kuwatoa watu wake waliosalia katika siku ya shida yao.
Ekegusii: Inwe anga timwatenenete ase amatabekania e chinchera goita abanto ba Edomu kobagotama, gose anga timwabegete abatooregete babo bache gosirigwa ase rituko riria ri’emechando yabo.

English: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.
Kiswahili: “Siku ya Bwana iko karibu kwa mataifa yote. Kama ulivyofanya, nawe utafanyiwa vivyo hivyo, matendo yako yatakurudia juu ya kichwa chako.
Ekegusii: Rituko ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire gochera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi. Buna mwabeire mogokora, naboigo nainwe morakorerwe. Ogokora kwaino nkobairanere inwe abanyene.

English: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.
Kiswahili: Kama vile ulivyokunywa juu ya mlima wangu mtakatifu, vivyo hivyo mataifa yote watakunywa mfululizo, watakunywa na kunywa, nao watatoweka kana kwamba hawajawahi kuwepo.
Ekegusii: Buna babeire bakonywera egekombe ki’endamwamu yane igoro ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, naboigo nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi baragenderere konywa botambe, ee, mbanywe bakoore pi basire kegima.

English: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.
Kiswahili: Lakini katika Mlima Sayuni kutakuwepo na wale watakaookoka; nao utakuwa mtakatifu, nayo nyumba ya Yakobo itamiliki urithi wake.
Ekegusii: “Korende ase egetunwa gia Sayoni mbabe aroro abaratooreke na aase agwo nabe aachenu. Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo nabairanerigwe ense yabo.

English: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, Yahweh has spoken.
Kiswahili: Nyumba ya Yakobo itakuwa moto, na nyumba ya Yosefu itakuwa mwali wa moto; nayo nyumba ya Esau itakuwa bua kavu, nao wataiwasha moto na kuiteketeza. Hakutakuwa na watakaosalimika kutoka nyumba ya Esau.” Bwana amesema.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo mbabe omorero, na ab’enyomba ya Yusufu mbabe buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, mbasirie ab’enyomba ya Esau buna omorero ogosamba amasakwe amomo. Nonya n’oyomo obo tagotoreeka. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.

English: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.
Kiswahili: Watu kutoka nchi ya Negebu wataikalia milima ya Esau, na watu kutoka miteremko ya vilima watamiliki nchi ya Wafilisti. Watayakalia mashamba ya Efraimu na Samaria, naye Benyamini atamiliki Gileadi.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ense ya Negebu mbaire Egetunwa gia Esau, na ab’ense omweya mbaire ense y’Abafilisti. Abaisraeli mbaire ense y’Abaefraimu na ey’Abasamaria chibe echiabo; na abanto ba Benjamini mbaire Gileadi ebe eyabo.

English: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.
Kiswahili: Kundi la Waisraeli walioko uhamishoni Kanaani watarudi na kumiliki nchi mpaka Sarepta. Walioko uhamishoni Sefaradi kutoka Yerusalemu watamiliki miji ya Negebu.
Ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli abwo bairetwe ase obosomba mbairane bamenye ase ense babue omochie o Foiniki goika Sarefata. Abanto ba Yerusalemu bairetwe ase obosomba, abwo bamenyete Sefaradi, mbaire emechie ya sugusu ya Yuda ebe eyabo.

English: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be Yahweh’s.
Kiswahili: Waokoaji watakwea juu ya Mlima Sayuni kutawala milima ya Esau. Nao ufalme utakuwa wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio abatooria mbariine ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, bagambere Egetunwa gia Esau. Omonene omonyene nere orabe omorwoti.”

English: Now Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana lilimjia Yona mwana wa Amitai:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yona mosinto bw’Amitai, rikamoteebia:

English: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”
Kiswahili: “Nenda katika mji mkubwa wa Ninawi ukahubiri juu yake, kwa sababu uovu wake umekuja juu mbele zangu.”
Ekegusii: “Imoka ogende Ninawi, omochie oria omonene, oake eriogi ri’okoyokuurera, ekiagera ogokora kwaye okobe gwaikire ase obosio bwane.”

English: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yona alimkimbia Bwana na kuelekea Tarshishi. Alishuka mpaka Yafa, ambapo alikuta meli iliyokuwa imepangwa kuelekea bandari ile. Baada ya kulipa nauli, akapanda melini na kuelekea Tarshishi ili kumkimbia Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende Yona akaimoka, agatama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio Omonene. Agatirimboka gochia Yopa, na agwo akanyora emeeri ekogenda Tarisisi. Erio agaakana chitaabu chi’orogendo, agasoa ime, akagenda amo nabaanto bande gotama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio Omonene.

English: But Yahweh sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akatuma upepo mkali baharini, nayo dhoruba kali sana ikavuma hata meli ikawa hatarini kuvunjika.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akagusia omwaga omonene mono igoro ase enyancha, na ekembugu‐mbugu gie chinguru kegacha ase enyancha, na emeeri ekaba ang’e kobuneka.

English: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.
Kiswahili: Mabaharia wote waliogopa na kila mmoja akamlilia mungu wake mwenyewe. Nao wakatupa mizigo baharini ili meli ipungue uzito. Lakini Yona alikuwa ameteremkia chumba cha ndani ya meli, mahali ambapo alilala na kupatwa na usingizi mzito.
Ekegusii: Erio abagendia b’emeeri bakaondoka, na kera oyomo akarangeria enyasae yaye ng’a emokonye. Abanto abwo bakaimokia chigurube chiarenge ase emeeri ime, bagachituguta gochia ase enyancha ime, ng’a nario emeeri eragusue. Bono Yona ere konya otirimbokire gochia nyaro ime y’emeeri, na aroro nigo araire chitoro chinene mono.

English: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God will notice us, so that we won’t perish.”
Kiswahili: Nahodha akamwendea na kusema, “Wewe unawezaje kulala? Amka ukamwite mungu wako! Huenda akatuangalia, tusiangamie.”
Ekegusii: Omochiki bw’emeeri akagenda asare akamobooria, “Naki oraire chitoro iga okirete‐kiri? Imoka orangerie Nyasae oo! Ande Nyasae oyio nabo arabaise gotorengereria atokonye titosira.”

English: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
Kiswahili: Kisha mabaharia wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Njooni, tupige kura tumtafute anayehusika na maafa haya.” Wakapiga kura, kura ikamwangukia Yona.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bagateebania, “Tiga toake obomera tomanye gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atocheire.” Erio bagaaka obomera, na obomera obwo bokagwera Yona.

English: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo walimuuliza, “Tuambie, ni nani anayehusika kwa kutuletea tatizo hili lote? Unafanya kazi gani? Umetoka wapi? Nchi yako ni ipi? Wewe ni kutoka taifa lipi?”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakamobooria, “Toteebie gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atonyorire. Meremo ki ogokora aye? Ng’ai kwarure? Ense yao nereri? Ngesaku ki ore?”

English: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear Yahweh, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Mimi ni Mwebrania, nami namwabudu Bwana, Mungu wa Mbinguni, aliyeumba bahari na nchi kavu.”
Ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Inche n’Omoiberania inde, na nigo inyirogete Omonene, Nyasae o igoro, oyo otongete enyancha na ense enyomo.”

English: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of Yahweh, because he had told them.
Kiswahili: Hili liliwaogopesha nao wakamuuliza, “Umefanya nini?” (Walijua alikuwa anamkimbia Bwana, kwa sababu alishawaambia hivyo.)
Ekegusii: Erio Jona akabateebia ng’a nigo are gotama korwa ase Omonene Nyasae. Ekero baigwete ayio, abanto baria bakairoka mono, bakamobooria, “Mang’ana ki aya gwakorire?”.

English: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.
Kiswahili: Bahari ilikuwa inazidi kuchafuka. Kwa hiyo walimuuliza, “Tukutendee nini ili kufanya bahari itulie kwa ajili yetu?”
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio chionsi enyancha nigo yagendererete gosareka mono. Erio abanto baria bakabooria Jona, “Ngento ki tokogokorera, erinde enyancha etotoerere?”

English: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Niinueni mnitupe baharini, nayo itakuwa shwari. Ninajua mawimbi haya makubwa yamewatokea kwa ajili ya kosa langu.”
Ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Inyimokie, mondute ase enyancha ime; ero netoerere ase more, ekiagera namanyire ng’a ninche nagerire ekembugu‐mbugu kiabacheire.”

English: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, wale watu walijitahidi kupiga makasia wawezavyo ili wapate kurudi pwani. Lakini hawakuweza, kwa kuwa bahari ilizidi kuchafuka kuliko mwanzo.
Ekegusii: Nonya naboigo abanto baria bagateema ne chinguru gosukia emeeri eria gochia ase engegu, korende tibanyarete, ekiagera ekembugu‐mbugu keria nigo kiagendererete koburukania enyancha mono goetania.

English: Therefore they cried to Yahweh, and said, “We beg you, Yahweh, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, Yahweh, have done as it pleased you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakamlilia Bwana, “Ee Bwana, tafadhali usituue kwa kuondoa uhai wa mtu huyu. Usituhesabie hatia kwa kuutoa uhai wa mtu asiyekuwa na hatia, kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umefanya kama ilivyokupendeza.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakarera ase Omonene, bagateeba, “Aye Omonene, totoa egesusuro ki’ogokwa ase engencho y’ogosiria obogima bw’omonto oyo. Ekiagera aye Omonene gwakorire buna bwanchete.”

English: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.
Kiswahili: Kisha walimchukua Yona, wakamtupa baharini nayo bahari iliyokuwa imechafuka ikatulia.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia Yona, bakamoruta ase enyancha ime; na agwo kegima enyancha egatoerera.

English: Then the men feared Yahweh exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to Yahweh and made vows.
Kiswahili: Katika jambo hili watu wakamwogopa Bwana sana, wakamtolea Bwana dhabihu na kumwekea nadhiri.
Ekegusii: Eke gekagera abanto baria bakairoka Omonene mono, bakamoruera ekeng’wanso na koria chiira chi’okomokorera.

English: Yahweh prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamwandaa nyangumi kummeza Yona, naye Yona alikuwa ndani ya tumbo la nyangumi kwa siku tatu, usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene enswe enene ekamera Yona, na Yona akabeera ime ase enda y’enswe eria amatuko atato, omobaso na obotuko.

English: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.
Kiswahili: Akiwa ndani ya tumbo la nyangumi, Yona alimwomba Bwana Mungu wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yona arenge ime ase enda y’enswe eria, akaba ogosa Omonene, Nyasae oye,

English: He said, “I called because of my affliction to Yahweh. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.
Kiswahili: Akasema: “Katika shida yangu nalimwita Bwana, naye akanijibu. Kutoka kina cha kaburi niliomba msaada, nawe ukasikiliza kilio changu.
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Ekero narenge ase emechando, aye Omonene, ngakorangeria naye okangiraneria inche. Korwa ase endiba y’ense y’abakuure ’nkarera onkoye naye okanyigwa inche.

English: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.
Kiswahili: Ulinitupa kwenye kilindi, ndani kabisa ya moyo wa bahari, mikondo ya maji ilinizunguka, mawimbi yako yote na viwimbi vilipita juu yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye nigo kwandutete gochia ase chindiba, inse kegima y’enyancha, ne chiooro chi’enyancha chiang’etananete inche. Na emerindo yao yonsi emetindi ekaimokerera igoro egantuba.

English: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
Kiswahili: Nikasema, ‘Nimefukuziwa mbali na uso wako, hata hivyo nitatazama tena kuelekea Hekalu lako takatifu.’
Ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nkarengereria ng’a natugutirwe korwa ase obosio bwao, naende ng’a tikonyara koyerora Hekalu yao Enchenu.

English: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.
Kiswahili: Maji yaliyonimeza yalinitisha, kilindi kilinizunguka; mwani ulijisokota kichwani pangu.
Ekegusii: Amache agacha agantuba naende agantokeria inche; enyancha egantuba inche kegima enderema ya nyancha ekarandererwa omotwe one.

English: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, Yahweh my God.
Kiswahili: Nilizama chini sana mpaka pande za mwisho za milima, makomeo ya hiyo nchi yalinifungia hata milele. Lakini uliuleta uhai wangu kutoka shimoni, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nagendete inse kegima goika ase emeri y’ebitunwa agwo ase ense eyio ebisiekero bi’ebiita biaye bigosieka kare na kare. Nonya naboigo, aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo kwangiranetie korwa ase chindiba inde moyo.

English: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
Kiswahili: “Wakati uhai wangu ulipokuwa unatoka, nilikukumbuka wewe, Bwana, nayo maombi yangu yalikufikia wewe, katika Hekalu lako takatifu.
Ekegusii: Ekero obomoyo bwane bwachagete gosoka gochia aria are erio aye Omonene ngasaba gocha ase ore na korwa ime y’Hekalu yao enchenu okanyigwa inche.

English: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.
Kiswahili: “Wale watu wanaongʼangʼana na sanamu zisizofaa hupoteza neema ile ambayo ingekuwa yao.
Ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagosasiima emegwekano eyio ere bosa barabwo batigire oboigweri gocha ase ore.

English: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi, kwa wimbo wa shukrani, nitakutolea dhabihu. Lile nililowekea nadhiri nitalitimiza. Wokovu watoka kwa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Korende inche ningoterere ’ngokobaka aye; nikoruere aye ekengwanso na goikerania aria nakoriereire chiira. Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Omonene!”

English: Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana akamwamuru yule nyangumi, naye akamtapika Yona katika nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akayechiika enswe eria emoroke Yona, igoro ase engegu, nero egakora boigo.

English: Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likamjia Yona mara ya pili:
Ekegusii: Nainde, Omonene agakwana na Yona.

English: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
Kiswahili: “Ondoka uende katika mji mkubwa wa Ninawi, ukautangazie ujumbe ninaokupa.”
Ekegusii: Ere agateeba, “Imoka ogende Ninawi, omochie oria omonene, erio obararerie abanto amang’ana ayio nakoeire.”

English: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to Yahweh’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.
Kiswahili: Yona akalitii neno la Bwana naye akaenda Ninawi. Basi Ninawi ulikuwa mji maarufu sana, ilichukua siku tatu kuuzunguka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Yona akamoigwera Omonene akagenda Ninawi omochie omogare kegima, akaira amatuko atato koyotara bwonsi.

English: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza, Yona aliingia mjini. Akatangaza: “Baada ya siku arobaini Ninawi utaangamizwa.”
Ekegusii: Yona agachaaka gotara ime y’omochie oria, nyuma y’ogotara ase rituko rigima, ere agaaka eriogi agateeba “Atigaire amatuko emerongo ene oka, erio Ninawi esarigwe!”

English: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Ninawi wakamwamini Mungu, wakatangaza kufunga, watu wote kuanzia mkubwa sana hadi yule mdogo kabisa, wakavaa nguo za gunia.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Ninawi bakegena amang’ana a Nyasae, bagaetia buna kera oyomo eng’ate, na abanto bonsi pi, korwa omonene kegima goika omoke, bakeboyia chigunia koorokia buna beitirie.

English: The news reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
Kiswahili: Habari zilipomfikia mfalme wa Ninawi, aliondoka kwenye kiti chake cha enzi, akavua majoho yake ya kifalme, akajifunika nguo ya gunia kisha akaketi chini mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ayio aigete ase omorwoti, ere akaimoka korwa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akarusia engobo yaye y’obonene, akeboyia chigunia, agaikaransa inse ase ribu igoro.

English: He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, “Let neither man nor animal, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;
Kiswahili: Ndipo akatoa tangazo katika Ninawi yote: “Kwa amri ya mfalme na wakuu wake: “Msiruhusu mtu yeyote au mnyama, makundi ya ngʼombe au wanyama wengine wafugwao, kuonja kitu chochote, msiwaruhusu kula wala kunywa.
Ekegusii: Erio agatoma okoraria gochia ase abanto ba Ninawi: “Oko n’ogochika korwa ase omorwoti n’abanene baye: onde tabaisa koria kende; abanto bonsi, chiombe, amo n’echingondi tibiancheiri koria gose konywa.

English: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.
Kiswahili: Bali wanadamu na wanyama wafunikwe kwa nguo za gunia. Kila mmoja afanye hima kumwomba Mungu. Waziache njia zao mbaya na udhalimu ulio mikononi mwao.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi pi amo n’echingiti babeke chianga chi’echigunia. Kera oyomo goika amosabe Nyasae ase ekeene naende boigo goika atige chinchera chiaye chi’obobe namakora aye y’ebibe.

English: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”
Kiswahili: Ni nani ajuaye? Huenda Mungu akaghairi kwa huruma yake akaacha hasira yake kali ili tusiangamie.”
Ekegusii: Kero kende Nyasae nabo abaise koonchoreria ebirengererio biaye; kero kende nabaise gotiga koba n’ekeririanda, naitwe titogokwa!”

English: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.
Kiswahili: Mungu alipoona walivyofanya na jinsi walivyogeuka kutoka njia zao mbaya, akawa na huruma wala hakuleta maangamizi juu yao kama alivyokuwa ameonya.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akarora aria bakorete; akarora nga batigire chinchera chiabo chi’ebibe. Erio ere agaonchoreria ebirengererio biaye naende agatiga kobaa egesusuro keria ere atebeete nga nabae.

English: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yona alichukizwa sana akakasirika.
Ekegusii: Yona akagechigwa namang’ana ayio, akaba nendamwamu.

English: He prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please, Yahweh, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.
Kiswahili: Akamwomba Bwana, “Ee Bwana, hili si lile nililolisema nilipokuwa ningali nyumbani? Hii ndiyo sababu niliharikisha kukimbilia Tarshishi. Nikifahamu kuwa wewe ni Mungu mwenye neema na huruma, si mwepesi wa hasira na umejaa upendo, ni Mungu ambaye hughairi katika kupeleka maafa.
Ekegusii: Erio agasaba Omonene, agateeba, “Aye Omonene, Inee, amang’ana aya tari aro nateebete ekero narenge ase ense yane? Naende nakio kiagerete ngatama gochia Tarisisi, ekiagera nigo namanyete ng’a aye nigo ore Nyasae oichire nobuya na amaabera; tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, na obwanchani bwao obonene nigo bogendererete botambe, naende nigo okoonchora ebirengererio biao, tokobakorera amabe.

English: Therefore now, Yahweh, take, I beg you, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
Kiswahili: Sasa, Ee Bwana, niondolee uhai wangu, kwa kuwa ni afadhali mimi nife kuliko kuishi.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye Omonene, bono nagosoroire ng’a orusieo obogima bwane ontige inkwe, ekiagera nigo ere buya ase ’nde gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”

English: Yahweh said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Je unayo haki yoyote kukasirika?”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamobooria, “Inee! Igo mboronge ogokora ase okogechigwa igo?”

English: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.
Kiswahili: Yona akatoka nje akaketi mahali upande wa mashariki wa mji. Hapo akajitengenezea kibanda, akaketi kwenye kivuli chake na kungojea ni nini kitakachotokea katika mji.
Ekegusii: Bono Yona agasoka korwa ase omochie oria, agaikaransa ase ensemo ya moocha y’omochie. Agwo akeagachera ekegutu, agaikaransa imeo gokenderera koganya arore ayare gochia gokorekana ase omochie oria.

English: Yahweh God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana, Mungu akaweka tayari mzabibu na kuufanya uote, kumpa Yona kivuli kilichomfunika kichwa ili kuondoa taabu yake, naye Yona akafurahi sana kwa ajili ya ule mzabibu.
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akameria omobono ogakina, na Yona agakenderera inse yaye, agatimoka korwa ase okorosa kwaye. Ase ayio akagokigwa mono nomobono oria.

English: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered.
Kiswahili: Lakini kesho yake asubuhi na mapema Mungu akaamuru buu, autafune mzabibu huo nao ukanyauka.
Ekegusii: Korende rituko ria kabere mambia, Nyasae agachiika rikonde rikaria omobono oria, erinde ogasusana.

English: When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
Kiswahili: Wakati jua lilipochomoza, Mungu akautuma upepo wa hari wa mashariki, nalo jua likawaka juu ya kichwa cha Yona mpaka akazimia. Akatamani kufa, naye akasema, “Ni afadhali mimi nife kuliko kuishi.”
Ekegusii: Ekero erioba riatiirire gocha igoro, Nyasae akarenta omwaga okagusa korwa moocha orenge nomobaso omoororo se, na omobaso oria ogasamba Yona bobe ase omotwe goika akagireka. Erio akagania akwe, agateeba, “Nigo ere buya ase ’nde gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”

English: God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alimwambia Yona, “Je, unayo haki kukasirika kuhusu mzabibu huo?” Akasema, “Ndiyo, ninayo haki. Nimekasirika kiasi cha kufa.”
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaboria Yona, “Inee! Mboronge igo aye okogechigwa ase engencho y’omobono oyio?” Yona akairaneria, akamoteebia, “Ee, nigo inde noboronge kogechigwa, nonya ngoika ogokwa.”

English: Yahweh said, “You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia, “Wewe unakasirika kwa ajili ya mzabibu huu, nawe hukuusababisha kuota wala kuutunza. Uliota usiku mmoja, nao ukafa usiku mmoja.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Aye kwaroreire omobono oyo amaabera, nonya tikwaywechanderete ase ogokora emeremo asoro, gose ase okoyokinia; nigo omerete ase obotuko obomo, naende ogasira ase obotuko obomo.

English: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Ninawi ina zaidi ya watu 120,000 ambao hawawezi kupambanua kulia au kushoto, pamoja na ngʼombe wengi. Je, hainipasi kufikiri juu ya mji ule mkubwa?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Inche tingwenereti koba namabeebe ase Ninawi, omochie oyio omonene, agwo ase abanto goetania chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000) bamenyeteo? Abanto abwo tibamanyete gwatanana ayare ensemo ya borio na ayare ase eya bomosi. Boigo omochie oyio nobwate ching’iti chinyinge mono chitugireo.”

English: Yahweh’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana lilimjia Mika, Mmoreshethi, wakati wa utawala wa Yothamu, Ahazi na Hezekia, wafalme wa Yuda; ufunuo aliouona kuhusu Samaria na Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete ase Mika, oyo omenyete agwo Moreseti, ekero Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hezekia, barenge abarwoti b’Abayuda. Omonene akamomaanorera Mika ayare gochia koba igoro ya Samaria na Yerusalemu.

English: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord Yahweh be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
Kiswahili: Sikieni, enyi mataifa, enyi nyote, sikilizeni, ee dunia na wote mliomo ndani yake, ili Bwana Mwenyezi ashuhudie dhidi yenu, Bwana kutoka Hekalu lake takatifu.
Ekegusii: Igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, tegerera moigwe Inwe mwensi abwo momenyete ase ense, Omonene nabe kirori mamincha yaino. Tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya! Nigo agokwana korwa ase Hekalu yaye ya igoro.

English: For behold, Yahweh comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
Kiswahili: Tazama! Bwana anakuja kutoka mahali pake; anashuka na kukanyaga mahali palipoinuka juu pa dunia.
Ekegusii: Rora, Omonene ngosoka are korwa aase aye achenu; ere ngoika are gocha aa, atare ebitunwa bi’ense.

English: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.
Kiswahili: Milima inayeyuka chini yake na mabonde yanagawanyika kama nta mbele ya moto, kama maji yatiririkayo kasi kwenye mteremko.
Ekegusii: Ebitunwa ebio mbinyititoke inse yaye, binyititoke buna obochoe bokonyititoka ase omorero, na bibe buna amaache akoba ekero aumoirwe ase egetirimboko.

English: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?
Kiswahili: Yote haya ni kwa sababu ya kosa la Yakobo, ni kwa sababu ya dhambi za nyumba ya Israeli. Kosa la Yakobo ni lipi? Je, sio Samaria? Je, mahali pa juu pa Yuda pa kuabudia miungu ni nini? Je, sio Yerusalemu?
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe ase engencho abanto ba Israeli bakorete ebibe bakaba mamincha ya Nyasae. Inee! Niing’o orabogorie ogosaria okwo kore ase abanto ba Israeli? ’Samaria omochie omonene omonyene! Na ase ogosaria okwo kw’ogosasiima emegwekano ase Abayuda? ’Yerusalemu enyene!

English: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo nitaufanya Samaria kuwa lundo la kokoto, mahali pa kuotesha mizabibu. Nitayamwaga mawe yake katika bonde na kuacha wazi misingi yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene otebire “nintagore Samaria obe obonge bw’amagena, obe omogondo ase emesabibu erasimekwe. Ninturunkanie amagena ’omochie oyio gochia ase rigoko, nintubore amaroso aye atigwe maiso marore.

English: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”
Kiswahili: Sanamu zake zote zitavunjwa vipande vipande; zawadi zake zote za Hekalu zitachomwa kwa moto; nitaharibu vinyago vyake vyote. Kwa kuwa alikusanya zawadi zake kutokana na ujira wa kahaba, nazo zitatumika tena kulipa mishahara ya kahaba.”
Ekegusii: Emegwekano yaye yonsi yerigori rinene egosasimwa nesamunyoranwe ebe ebisamunye, kera egento keria gekoegwa abatayayi be Hekalu ng’esarigwen’omorero, na emegwekano yaye yonsi nebe amatombe atigire. Samaria nigo yanyorete ebinto ebio bionsi ase emeyega y’okomenta oroiboro, bono ababisa baye mbababogorie korwa aroro gochia ase abatayayi b’echikalu b’echinsemo chinde.”

English: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya hili nitalia na kuomboleza; nitatembea bila viatu na tena uchi. Nitabweka kama mbweha na kuomboleza kama bundi.
Ekegusii: Erio Mika agateeba, “ase engencho y’amang’ana aya nigo ndarere na kweumia. Ase o koorokia amagombo ane nigo ndatare ’ntabegeti bikoroto naende ’inde getirianda. Nigo ndaorie buna ekebwe naende ’mbuge buna esagero.

English: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu jeraha lake halitibiki; limekuja Yuda. Limefika hasa kwenye lango la watu wangu, hata Yerusalemu kwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Amaote a Samaria takonyara kobwenigwa nabo igo Yuda yabereiri ange gochandeka enchera eyio eyio; ogotagorwa gwaikire ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu enyene agwo ase abanto bane bamenyete.”

English: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.
Kiswahili: Usiliseme hili huko Gathi; usilie hata kidogo. Huko Beth-le-Afra gaagaa mavumbini.
Ekegusii: Tiga goteebia ababisa baito ime ya Gati igoro y’okobugwa gwaito; timobaisa gotiga barore mokorera. Abanto ba Beti‐Le‐Afura orokia okorusia moyo kwaiko ase okwegaragaria igoro ase ebuse!

English: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.
Kiswahili: Piteni mkiwa uchi na wenye aibu, ninyi mkaao Shafiri. Wale waishio Saanani hawatatoka nje. Beth-Eseli iko katika maombolezo; kinga yake imeondolewa kwako.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Safiri genda ase obooswa, getirianda more n’obosoku. Baria momenyete Saanani timweba mosoke korwa ase omochie obo omonene. Ekero moraigwe abanto ba Beti‐Hasaeli bakorera, agwo momanye ng’a botamero tibori aroro agwo.

English: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Yahweh to the gate of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Wale waishio Marothi wanagaagaa kwa maumivu wakingoja msaada, kwa sababu maangamizi yamekuja kutoka kwa Bwana, hata katika lango la Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Maroti ganyerera obokonyi n’obwoba ase engencho Omonene oretire amaakwa ange na Yerusalemu.

English: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
Kiswahili: Enyi mkaao Lakishi, fungeni farasi kwenye magari ya vita. Mlikuwa chanzo cha dhambi kwa Binti Sayuni, kwa kuwa makosa ya Israeli yalikutwa kwako.
Ekegusii: Inwe baria momenyete ime ya Lakisi agia chibarasi chiaino chi’esegi ebisibero. Inwe nigo mweegetie ebibe bi’Abaisraeli mokagera Yerusalemu egakora ebibe.

English: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo utaipa Moresheth-Gathi zawadi za kuagana. Mji wa Akzibu utaonyesha wazi udanganyifu kwa wafalme wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Na bono, abanto ba Yuda batebie batigare buya omochie o Mosereti‐Gati. Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli tibakonyora gokonywa konde korwa ase omochie o Akisibuse.

English: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
Kiswahili: Nitawaleteeni atakayewashinda ninyi mnaoishi Maresha. Yeye aliye utukufu wa Israeli atakuja Adulamu.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Maresa Omonene nabaererie omobisa, oyio orachie koira omochie oino. Abarai b’Abaisraeli mbagende bebise ime ase rikuruma rire Adulamu.

English: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!
Kiswahili: Nyoeni nywele zenu katika kuomboleza kwa ajili ya watoto wenu mnaowafurahia; jifanyieni upara kama tai, kwa kuwa watawaacha na kwenda uhamishoni.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Yuda kigita chitukia chiaino moreree abana baria mwanchete. Kora emetwe yaino erabe se buna ey’echinsoti ekiagera abana baino mbairwe obooswa are korwa ase more.

English: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.
Kiswahili: Ole kwa wale wapangao uovu, kwa wale wafanyao shauri la hila vitandani mwao! Kunapopambazuka wanalitimiza kwa sababu uko katika uwezo wao kutekeleza.
Ekegusii: Naki erabe akong’u ase baria bakogeesa ase okoroberia amabe! Ekero bogokiamoka buna bakonyora ribaga rike baikerania obebe boria baroberetie.

English: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
Kiswahili: Wanatamani mashamba na kuyakamata, pia nyumba na kuzichukua. Wanamlaghai mwanaume nyumba yake, mwanadamu mwenzake urithi wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero barabwo batagete emegondo baurereria; ekero batagete chinyomba bachiira rioka. Eamate teiyo gose enibo bire n’oborendi.

English: Therefore Yahweh says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, Bwana asema: “Ninapanga maangamizi dhidi ya watu hawa, ambayo hamwezi kujiokoa wenyewe. Hamtatembea tena kwa majivuno, kwa kuwa utakuwa ni wakati wa maafa.
Ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene nigo agoteeba, nigo ndoberetie koreta amaakwa ase more, nainwe timokonyaara koyatamboka. Ngochia more kwenyora ase obokong’u, naende timogochia konyara gotara n’obwerori naende.

English: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo watu watawadhihaki, watawafanyia mzaha kwa wimbo huu wa maombolezo: ‘Tumeangamizwa kabisa; mali ya watu wangu imegawanywa. Ameninyangʼanya! Ametoa mashamba yetu kwa wasaliti.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ekero chingaki chirache, abanto mbabogorie omogano oino koba ekiorokererio k’iobobe, na nigo baratere ogoteera gw’okwerusia moyo igoro ase ayio mwaeteire: “Twatagokire kegima! Omonene otourire ense yaito naende oyeire abanto baria batoosete.”

English: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in Yahweh’s assembly.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hutakuwa na yeyote katika kusanyiko la Bwana wa kugawanya mashamba kwa kura.
Ekegusii: Na bono ekero engaki eraike ense ekoiranigwa gochia ase abanto b’Omonene, onde oino taiyo oranyore egatari aroro.

English: “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”
Kiswahili: Manabii wao husema, “Usitabiri. Usitabiri kuhusu vitu hivi; aibu haitatupata.”
Ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakondanderia bateeba, Tobaisa gotorandia. Tobaisa korandia ayio onsi Omonene tari gochia gotoa obosoku.

English: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is Yahweh’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”
Kiswahili: Je, ingesemwa, ee nyumba ya Yakobo: “Je, Roho wa Bwana amekasirika? Je, yeye hufanya vitu kama hivyo?” “Je, maneno yangu hayamfanyii mema yeye ambaye njia zake ni nyofu?
Ekegusii: Nigo okorengereria buna Abaisraeli nigo bare inse y’okoragererigwa? Nigo Omoika bw’Omonene asirie okoremereria kwaye? Ekeene ere nakore ebinto ebio? Tari gokwana ase obwororo ase baria bagokora ay’ekeene?

English: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.
Kiswahili: Siku hizi watu wangu wameinuka kama adui. Unawavua joho la kitajiri wale wanaopita pasipo kujali, kama watu warudio kutoka vitani.
Ekegusii: Omonene airaneria, “Nigo mokoboera abanto bane buna ababisa. Abasacha nigo bakoirana korwa ase esegi, bakagerete ng’a mbare n’oborendi ase enka, korende nao more agwo moganyererete kobaboria chigoti chiabo korwa mareko.

English: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.
Kiswahili: Unawahamisha wanawake wa watu wangu kutoka kwenye nyumba zao za kupendeza. Unaondoa baraka yangu kwa watoto wao milele.
Ekegusii: Mwaseria abakungu b’abanto bane korwa ase chinka chiabo banchete, naende mwaunereirie abana babo ogosesenigwa kwane.

English: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.
Kiswahili: Inuka, nenda zako! Kwa maana hapa sio mahali pako pa kupumzikia, kwa sababu pametiwa unajisi, pameharibiwa, wala hapatengenezeki tena.
Ekegusii: Imoka mogende; borendi tiboiyo aiga naende. Ebibe biano biaragereirie aase aa gochia ase obosareku.

English: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mwongo na mdanganyifu atakuja na kusema, ‘Nitawatabiria divai na pombe kwa wingi,’ angekuwa ndiye nabii anayekubalika na watu hawa!
Ekegusii: “Abanto aba nigo batagete omobani ogoetanana n’oborimo amo n’obong’ainereria boigo ogoteeba, ’nababaneire buna Edivai n’amarwa naumoke ase more.

English: I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.
Kiswahili: “Hakika nitawakusanya ninyi nyote, ee Yakobo, Hakika nitawaleta pamoja mabaki ya Israeli. Nitawaleta pamoja kama kondoo ndani ya zizi, kama kundi kwenye malisho yake, mahali hapa patakuwa na msongamano wa watu.
Ekegusii: “Korende nimbasangererie mbabeke amo inwe abanto bonsi ba Israeli abwo batigarete. Nimbarete amo buna ching’ondi chikoirana gocha ase riicho. Buna oboriisia boichire ching’ondi, ense yaino neichorwe naende n’abanto abange.”

English: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with Yahweh at their head.
Kiswahili: Yeye afunguaye njia atawatangulia; watapita kwenye lango na kutoka nje. Mfalme wao atawatangulia, Bwana atakuwa kiongozi.”
Ekegusii: Omonene naigore chinchera ase bare naende abarae korwa ase obooswa. Mbasoke korwa ase ebiita bi’omochie omonene bagende bare n’obosibore. Omorwoti obo, Omonene obo bweka nere orabarae gochia isiko.

English: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasema, “Sikilizeni enyi viongozi wa Yakobo, enyi watawala wa nyumba ya Israeli. Je, hampaswi kujua hukumu,
Ekegusii: Tegerera inwe abarai b’Abaisraeli! Eganga yaino nigo egwenerete koba okorigereria oboronge,

English: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;
Kiswahili: ninyi mnaochukia mema na kupenda maovu; ninyi mnaowachuna watu wangu ngozi na kuondoa nyama kwenye mifupa yao;
Ekegusii: Korende nwe nigo mwangete aria are amaya naende nigo mwanhete ayare amabe. Nigo bogosabora abanto risankwa bare moyo naende mwarusia chinyama korwa amauga abo.

English: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.
Kiswahili: ninyi mnaokula nyama ya watu wangu, mnaowachuna ngozi na kuvunja mifupa yao vipande vipande; mnaowakatakata kama nyama ya kuwekwa kwenye sufuria na kama nyama ya kuwekwa kwenye chungu?”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoria abanto baane. Mwabachobora risankwa, mwabuna amauga abo, mwababutorana buna chinyama chikobekwa enyongo.

English: Then they will cry to Yahweh, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”
Kiswahili: Kisha watamlilia Bwana, lakini hatawajibu. Wakati huo atawaficha uso wake kwa sababu ya uovu waliotenda.
Ekegusii: Engaki neike ekero morarere gochia ase Omonene korende takobairaneria inwe. Ere tagotegerera amasabo aino, ekiagera mwakorire amabe.

English: Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kuhusu manabii wanaowapotosha watu wangu, mtu akiwalisha, wanatangaza ‘amani’; kama hakufanya hivyo, wanaandaa kupigana vita dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Abanto bane nigo bakong’ainwa n’ababani abwo bakobariera chiira chi’omorembe baria bakobaakana, korende bagosereria baria batari kobaakana egesi. Ase ababani abwo Omonene nigo agoteeba,

English: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo usiku utawajieni, msiweze kuwa na maono, na giza, msiweze kubashiri. Jua litawachwea manabii hao, nao mchana utakuwa giza kwao.
Ekegusii: “Inwe ababani, amatuko aino igo are ange koera; risase riabarimereire gochia inse. Ase engencho inwe mogosiria abanto bane, inwe timokonyora naende amaroro y’obobani, naende timokonyara kobana kende gionsi.”

English: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”
Kiswahili: Waonaji wataaibika na waaguzi watafedheheka. Wote watafunika nyuso zao kwa sababu hakuna jibu litokalo kwa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Baria bakobana aria agochia gocha mbasokigwe ase ogotaikerana kw’ayio. Abwo bonsi mbasookigwe ekiagera Nyasae takobairaneria barabwo kende.

English: But as for me, I am full of power by Yahweh’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
Kiswahili: Lakini kuhusu mimi, nimejazwa nguvu, nimejazwa Roho wa Bwana, haki na uweza, kumtangazia Yakobo kosa lake, na Israeli dhambi yake.
Ekegusii: Korende ase inde inche, Omonene nigo akongichoria n’Omoika oye n’echinguru, naende ong’a inche eki’orokererio ki’oboronge nabo igo oboremu bw’ogotebia abanto ba Israeli keria kere ebibe biabo.

English: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,
Kiswahili: Sikieni hili, enyi viongozi wa nyumba ya Yakobo, enyi watawala wa nyumba ya Israeli, mnaodharau haki na kupotosha kila lililo sawa;
Ekegusii: Integerera inwe abarai b’Abaisraeli, inwe baria mwangete oboronge naende mogonchorana ekeene koba egetari boronge.

English: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
Kiswahili: mnaojenga Sayuni kwa kumwaga damu na Yerusalemu kwa uovu.
Ekegusii: Nigo mogendererete koagacha Yerusalemu omochie omonene o Nyasae, ase oboroso bw’ogoita n’borimo.

English: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on Yahweh, and say, “Isn’t Yahweh among us? No disaster will come on us.”
Kiswahili: Viongozi wake wanahukumu kwa rushwa, na makuhani wake wanafundisha kwa malipo, nao manabii wake wanatabiri kwa fedha. Hata hivyo wanamwegemea Bwana na kusema, “Je, Bwana si yumo miongoni mwetu? Hakuna maafa yatakayotupata.”
Ekegusii: Abarai b’omochie omonene nigo bakogamba goetera ase amaaki, abakuani b’abana richiiko ase ogoakanwa, ababani barwa amaroro abo ase chitaabu boigo abwo bonsi bataamera buna Omonene nigo are amo na barabwo. Nigo bagoteeba, “bobe bonde tiboiyo boratochere.” Nainde bateeba “Omonene nigo are amo naitwe.”

English: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kwa sababu yenu, Sayuni italimwa kama shamba, Yerusalemu itakuwa lundo la kokoto, na kilima cha Hekalu kitakuwa kichuguu kilichofunikwa na vichaka.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase engencho yaino Sayoni noremwe buna omogondo, Yerusalemu nobe amaturi, na egetunwa gie Hekalu ’nkebe rinani.

English: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.
Kiswahili: Katika siku za mwisho mlima wa Hekalu la Bwana utaimarishwa kama mlima mkuu miongoni mwa milima yote; utainuliwa juu ya vilima, na watu wa mataifa watamiminika humo.
Ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio ng’a egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene ngekong’igwe, kebe ekenene goetania ebitunwa binde, nkeimokererigwe igoro goetania ebigoro binde; abanto abange mbaendoke gochiao.

English: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem;
Kiswahili: Mataifa mengi yatakuja na kusema, “Njooni, twendeni mlimani mwa Bwana, kwenye nyumba ya Mungu wa Yakobo. Atatufundisha njia zake, ili tuweze kuenenda katika mapito yake.” Sheria itatoka Sayuni, neno la Bwana litatoka Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebinge mbabe bakogendao bagoteeba: “Inchuo totiire gochia ase egetunwa ki’Omonene, gochia ase enyomba ya Nyasae o Yakobo, erinde atworokererie chinchera chiaye, na intwe tochibwatie.” Amachiiko narue Sayoni, ne ring’ana ri’Omonene ndiiche korwa Yerusalemu.

English: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.
Kiswahili: Atahukumu kati ya mataifa mengi, na ataamua migogoro ya mataifa yenye nguvu na yaliyo mbali. Watafua panga zao ziwe majembe, na mikuki yao kuwa miundu ya kukata matawi. Taifa halitainua upanga dhidi ya taifa jingine, wala hawatajifunza vita tena.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene nanache ekiina ase egati y’abanto abange, nagambie boronge ebisaku bire ne chinguru bimenyete aare. Abanto mbature emioro yabo y’esegi ebe amakombe, na amatimo abo abe emeyio chinkuro. Egesaku ekemo tigekoimoka korwania ekende, gose abanto tibakweorokereria korwana esegi nonya ng’ake.

English: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of Yahweh of Armies has spoken.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu ataketi chini ya mzabibu wake na chini ya mtini wake, wala hakuna mtu atakayewaogopesha, kwa kuwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amesema.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo araikaranse inse y’emesabibu yaye na ase emeko yaye, na onde takoboboyia, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nere okwanire ayio.

English: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote yanaweza kutembea katika jina la miungu yao; sisi tutatembea katika jina la Bwana Mungu wetu milele na milele.
Ekegusii: Kera egesaku nigo kerabwatie erieta ri’enyasae yaye, korende intwe nigo torabwatie erieta ri’Omonene Nyasae oito goika kare na kare.

English: “In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;
Kiswahili: “Katika siku hiyo,” asema Bwana, “nitawakusanya walemavu; nitawakusanya walio uhamishoni na wale niliowahuzunisha.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsangererie ebirema, naende ninsangererie abwo naseretie, na bonsi abwo naete amaakwa.

English: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”
Kiswahili: Nitawafanya walemavu kuwa mabaki, wale waliofukuzwa kuwa taifa lenye nguvu. Bwana atatawala juu yao katika Mlima Sayuni kuanzia siku hiyo na hata milele.
Ekegusii: Nintige abare ebirema babe abatigari, na abwo baseretigwe babe egesaku kere ne chinguru. Omonene nabagambere agwo ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

English: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Lakini kuhusu wewe, ee mnara wa ulinzi wa kundi, ee ngome ya Binti Sayuni, milki ya awali itarudishwa kwako, ufalme utakuja kwa Binti Yerusalemu.”
Ekegusii: “Naye Omorobiri bw’oborendi, aye ekegoro ki’omochie o Sayoni, obogambi bwao obokoro mbokoiranere, ee, obogambi bw’omochie o Yerusalemu.”

English: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini sasa unalia kwa nguvu: kwani huna mfalme? Je, mshauri wako amekufa, hata maumivu yakukamate kama ya mwanamke aliye na utungu wa kuzaa?
Ekegusii: Bono, ninki okorera neriogi rinene? Inee! Omorwoti tari ime yao? Abasemia bao mbasirigwe goika kwabeire nobororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore?

English: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
Kiswahili: Gaagaa kwa utungu, ee Binti Sayuni, kama mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa, kwa kuwa sasa ni lazima uuache mji ukapige kambi uwanjani. Utakwenda Babeli; huko utaokolewa. Huko Bwana atakukomboa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zako.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, bina moigwe obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore; korwa bono karue ase omochie, momenye ase chinsana. Mogende Babiloni, na aroro motoorigwe. Aroro agwo Omonene nabatoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baino.

English: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa mataifa mengi yamekusanyika dhidi yako. Wanasema, “Mwache anajisiwe, macho yetu na yatazame Sayuni kwa furaha!”
Ekegusii: Bono abanto b’ebisaku ebinge basangererekanire amo baabarwanie esegi, bagoteeba: “Tiga omochie oyio okorwe obe oyotachenegeti, naintwe tobe torigereretie Sayoni.”

English: But they don’t know the thoughts of Yahweh, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawayajui mawazo ya Bwana; hawauelewi mpango wake, yeye awakusanyaye kama miganda kwenye sakafu ya kupuria.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo tibamanyeti ebirengererio bi’Omonene, gose tibamanyeti omooroberio oye ng’a obasangereirie amo buna emesaima ere ase ekeooreri gi’okoorera.

English: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples. I will devote their gain to Yahweh, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
Kiswahili: “Inuka upure, ee Binti Sayuni, kwa kuwa nitakupa pembe za chuma; nitakupa kwato za shaba na utavunja vipande vipande mataifa mengi.” Utatoa mapato yao waliopata kwa udanganyifu kwa Bwana, utajiri wao kwa Bwana wa dunia yote.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, imoka moore, ekiagera ninkore ching’unchara chiaino chibe echi’ebioma, na ebitaago biaino bibe ebi’etai, erinde moake abanto abange, mobasamunyore.” Ebinto biabo morasakore mobiatanane bibe ebichenu ase Omonene, ne chinibo chiabo chibe echi’Omonene bw’ense engima.

English: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.
Kiswahili: Panga majeshi yako, ee mji wa majeshi, kwa kuwa kuzingirwa kumepangwa dhidi yetu. Watampiga mtawala wa Israeli shavuni kwa fimbo.
Ekegusii: Aye Omochie bw’emeganda, sangereria emeganda yao y’esegi. Ababisa banaaririe omochie oito bayorwanie esegi. Barabwo mbaake omogambi bw’Abaisraeli orosea rwaye nenyimbo.

English: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
Kiswahili: “Lakini wewe, Bethlehemu Efrathi, ingawa u mdogo miongoni mwa koo za Yuda, kutoka kwako atatokea kwa ajili yangu yeye atakayekuwa mtawala katika Israeli, ambaye asili yake ni kutoka zamani, kutoka milele.”
Ekegusii: “Korende aye Bethlehemu Efarata, aye ore omoke ase egati ye chiamate chi’egesaku ki’Abayuda, korwa asore nang’orokere oyomo orabe omogambi bw’Abaisraeli. Oyio nao arenge korwa agwo kare, ee, korwa kare na kare.”

English: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Israeli utaachwa mpaka wakati mwanamke aliye na utungu atakapozaa na ndugu zake wengine warudi kujiunga na Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene natige abanto baye goika engaki eike, ekero oyio okobina araibore; erio nario abanto bamwabo abatigari barairane gocha ase Abaisraeli.

English: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God. They will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.
Kiswahili: Atasimama na kulichunga kundi lake katika nguvu ya Bwana, katika utukufu wa jina la Bwana Mungu wake. Nao wataishi kwa usalama, kwa kuwa wakati huo ukuu wake utaenea hadi miisho ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Ekero oyio oraiborwe arache, narisie riicho riaye ore ne chinguru chi’Omonene, ee, narisie nobonene bw’erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye. Riicho riaye ndibe rirendire buya, ekiagera bono ere nabe omonene goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense.

English: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.
Kiswahili: Naye atakuwa amani yao. Wakati Mwashuru atakapovamia nchi yetu na kupita katika ngome zetu, tutawainua wachungaji saba dhidi yake, hata viongozi wanane wa watu.
Ekegusii: Omorisia oyio nabe omorembe oito. Ekero Abaasuri barache ase ense yaito gotorwania na basoe ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, intwe ntosokie abarisia batano na babere, na abagaambi batano na batato, baabatange.

English: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.
Kiswahili: Wataitawala nchi ya Ashuru kwa upanga, nchi ya Nimrodi kwa upanga. Atatuokoa kutoka kwa Mwashuru atakapoivamia nchi yetu na kuingia katika mipaka yetu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbasirie ense y’Abaasuri nemioro, na ense ya Nimurodi bayesirie nemeyio ya birende. Boigo mbatotoorie korwa ase Abaasuri ekero barasoe ase ense yaito goetera ase chimbebe chiaito.

English: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man nor wait for the sons of men.
Kiswahili: Mabaki ya Yakobo yatakuwa katikati ya mataifa mengi kama umande kutoka kwa Bwana, kama manyunyu juu ya majani, ambayo hayamngoji mtu wala kukawia kwa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Erio abatigari ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, buna riime rigotonya korwa ase Omonene, na buna embura engiya egotwera obonyansi, embura eria tegoteebana koganya monto gete, gose Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi.

English: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.
Kiswahili: Mabaki ya Yakobo yatakuwa miongoni mwa mataifa, katikati ya mataifa mengi, kama simba miongoni mwa wanyama wa msituni, kama mwana simba miongoni mwa makundi ya kondoo, ambaye anaumiza vibaya na kuwararua kila anapopita katikati yao, wala hakuna awezaye kuokoa.
Ekegusii: Ee, abatigari abwo ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, babe buna endo ere ase egati ye ching’iti chire ase rinani, na buna endo ensae ere ase egati ye riicho rie ching’ondi, eyio ekero yasoire ase riicho nigo egotachera inse na gotandorana eyaitire, na onde tari oranyare koyetooria.

English: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.
Kiswahili: Mkono wako utainuliwa juu kwa ushindi juu ya watesi wako, nao adui zako wote wataangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio amaboko aino naimokererigwe igoro y’abachandi baino, na inwe mosirie kegima ababisa baino bonsi.

English: “It will happen in that day”, says Yahweh, “that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots.
Kiswahili: “Katika siku ile,” asema Bwana, “nitaangamiza farasi zenu katikati yenu na kubomoa magari yenu ya vita.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsirie chibarasi chiaino, ne chigari chiaino chirue ase more kegima.

English: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds.
Kiswahili: Nitaiangamiza miji ya nchi yenu na kuziangusha chini ngome zenu zote.
Ekegusii: Ninsarie emechie yonsi ere ase ense yaino, naende nintagore chindwaki chiaino echio mogwekengera.

English: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.
Kiswahili: Nitaangamiza uchawi wenu na hamtapiga tena ramli.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie oborogi korwa ase amaboko aino, na abaringoria tibakonyorekana ase more nonya ng’ake.

English: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.
Kiswahili: Nitaangamiza vinyago vyenu vya kuchonga na mawe yenu ya ibada yatoke katikati yenu; hamtasujudia tena kazi ya mikono yenu.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie emegwekano yaino yonsi amo, ne chisiiro chiaino, ebinto ebio mogosasiima, na inwe timokogenderera gosasiima emeremo y’amaboko aino.

English: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities.
Kiswahili: Nitangʼoa nguzo za Ashera katikati yenu na kubomoa miji yenu.
Ekegusii: Ninsimore emete y’Asera eyio mogosasiima, ninyerusie korwa ase more, ninkore emechie yaino ebe bosa.

English: I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”
Kiswahili: Nitalipiza kisasi kwa hasira na ghadhabu juu ya mataifa ambayo hayajanitii.”
Ekegusii: Ninyeruserie egesiomba ase abanto b’ebisaku, abwo batari koigwera, inde nendamwamu na ekeririanda.”

English: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza asemalo Bwana: “Simama, tetea shauri lako mbele ya milima; vilima na visikie lile unalotaka kusema.
Ekegusii: Bono inwe tegerera moigwe ay’Omonene agoteeba: Imoka, mwekwanere agwo bosio bw’ebitunwa, na motige ebigoro biigwe amariogi aino.

English: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni, ee milima, mashtaka ya Bwana, sikilizeni, enyi misingi ya milele ya dunia. Kwa kuwa Bwana ana shauri dhidi ya watu wake; anatoa mashtaka dhidi ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: “Inwe ebitunwa, nainwe ebitare, ninwe more oboroso bw’ense, tegerera moigwe ogosoera kw’Omonene! Ere nabwate amang’ana nabaanto baye, nare nekina n’Abaisraeli.

English: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
Kiswahili: “Watu wangu, nimewatendea nini? Nimewalemea kwa jinsi gani? Mnijibu.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, ngento ki nabakoreire? Nase amang’ana ki nabarosirie? Ng’iranerie!

English: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
Kiswahili: Nimewatoa kutoka Misri na kuwakomboa kutoka nchi ya utumwa. Nilimtuma Mose awaongoze, pia Aroni na Miriamu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri; nkababooria korwa ase ense y’obosomba, inche ngatoma Musa, na Aroni, na Miriamu, bakaba bakobaraa.

English: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Watu wangu, kumbukeni jinsi Balaki mfalme wa Moabu alivyofanya shauri na kile Balaamu mwana wa Beori alichojibu. Kumbukeni safari yenu kutoka Shitimu mpaka Gilgali, ili mfahamu matendo ya haki ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, inyora egento Balaki, omorwoti o Moabu, aroberetie gokora, na buna Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, amoiraneretie. Boigo inyora amang’ana akoregete ekero mwarenge ase orogendo korwa Sitimu gochia Giligali, erinde monyare komanya ogokora kw’oboronge kwane inche Omonene.”

English: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
Kiswahili: Nimjie Bwana na kitu gani na kusujudu mbele za Mungu aliyetukuka? Je, nije mbele zake na sadaka za kuteketezwa, nije na ndama za mwaka mmoja?
Ekegusii: “Ngento ki ndarentere Omonene, na ntung’ame ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro? Inee! Nigo ndache ase obosio bwaye, ndetane ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose chimori chiakoorire omwaka oyomo?

English: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
Kiswahili: Je, Bwana atafurahishwa na kondoo dume elfu, au mito elfu kumi ya mafuta? Je, nimtoe mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza kwa ajili ya kosa langu, mtoto wangu mwenyewe kwa ajili ya dhambi ya nafsi yangu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonene nagokigwe ne chimingichi chilifu, gose ne chindooche chi’amaguta chilifu ikomi? Inee! Nindue omwana one omotangi ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane, omwana oyio ore okwama kw’obogima bwane, abe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoyo one?”

English: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
Kiswahili: Amekuonyesha yaliyo mema, ee mwanadamu. Bwana anataka nini kwako? Ila kutenda kwa haki na kupenda rehema, na kwenda kwa unyenyekevu na Mungu wako.
Ekegusii: Aye Mwanyabaanto, Omonene okworokirie ayare amaya. Ninki Omonene aganetie korwa asore otatiga okore ayare ay’oboronge, na bwanche gokora ayare ay’obwanchani, naende otaare ase oboitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oo.

English: Yahweh’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
Kiswahili: Sikiliza! Bwana anauita mji: kulicha jina lako ni hekima: “Tii hiyo fimbo na yeye aliyeiamuru.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorangeria abare ase omochie, na omonto oirogete erieta riaye nere omong’aini. Eriogi riaye nigo rigoteeba: “Igwa igoro y’egesusuro na ning’o ogechikiire.

English: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
Kiswahili: Je, bado nisahau, ee nyumba ya uovu, hazina yako uliyopata kwa udanganyifu na vipimo vilivyopunguka, ambavyo vimelaaniwa?
Ekegusii: Inee! Chinibo chi’obourereria nchigenderere kobeera ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe? Na ebirengero bitaikeraneti biragereirie mbibeereo?

English: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?
Kiswahili: Je, naweza kuhukumu kuwa mtu mwenye mizani ya udanganyifu hana hatia, aliye na mfuko wa mawe ya kupimia ya uongo?
Ekegusii: Ninyare gwanchera ebirengero bi’obourereria, gose amagena ’obong’ainereria ay’okorengera abeere ase chisaro ime?

English: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.
Kiswahili: Matajiri wake ni wajeuri; watu wake ni waongo na ndimi zao zinazungumza kwa udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Abanto abanda bare ase egati yaino baichire nobourereria, na abwo bamenyete agwo nigo bagokwana oborimo, ne chimeme chiabo nigo chire echi’obong’ainereria.

English: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, nimeanza kukuharibu, kuwaangamiza kwa sababu ya dhambi zenu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ebibe biaino nimbaake timogwena rinde, mbasirie kegima.

English: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you. You will store up, but not save, and that which you save I will give up to the sword.
Kiswahili: Mtakula lakini hamtashiba; matumbo yenu bado yatakuwa matupu. Mtaweka akiba lakini hamtaokoa chochote, kwa sababu mtakachoweka akiba nitatoa kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Ekero morabe mokoragera, timokoigota; nigo moragenderere koba nenchara. Mosangererie na kwegachera ebinto, korende ebio mwegacheire nimbirue bisirigwe nemioro.

English: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.
Kiswahili: Mtapanda lakini hamtavuna; mtakamua zeituni lakini hamtatumia mafuta yake. Mtakamua zabibu lakini hamtakunywa hiyo divai.
Ekegusii: Imosimeke chindagera, korende timogochigesa. Imomite amazeituni, korende timokweaka amaguta korwao; imomite amasabibu, korende timokonywa edivai ekorwao.

English: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and your inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of my people.”
Kiswahili: Mmezishika sheria za Omri na matendo yote ya nyumba ya Ahabu, tena umefuata desturi zao. Kwa hiyo nitakutoa kwa maangamizi na watu wako kuwa dhihaka; mtachukua dharau za mataifa.”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwabeire mokobwatia amachiiko ’Omuri, na ogokora gwonsi kw’enyomba y’Ahabu, naende mwabeire mokoigwera ogosemia kwabo. Ase ayio nimbasirie kegima, na abamenyete ime yao babe bagochaywa, na igo mobogorie okoramwa okwo abanto baane barametwe.”

English: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.
Kiswahili: Taabu gani hii niliyo nayo! Nimefanana na yule akusanyaye matunda ya kiangazi, aokotaye masazo baada ya kuvunwa shamba la mizabibu; hakuna kishada chenye matunda ya kula, hakuna hata ile tini ya mwanzoni ninayoitamani.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwane, ekiagera nabeire nkororekana buna ekero amatunda ’omorakera agosangererigwa, na ayatigaire ase emesabibu achorirwe. Ebisago bi’amasabibu bikoriegwa tibiyo, na amako amatang’ani, aya nganetie, taiyo.

English: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.
Kiswahili: Wanaomcha Mungu wameondolewa kutoka nchi; hakuna mtu mnyofu hata mmoja aliyebaki. Watu wote wanavizia kumwaga damu, kila mmoja anamwinda ndugu yake kwa wavu.
Ekegusii: Abanto bamoirogete Nyasae basirire korwa ase ense, na oyore nenkoro endonge tari ase egati y’abanto. Bonsi nigo bakoboera abanto baitere amanyinga abo. Kera omonto nigo akobwata, oyomwabo noboreba.

English: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.
Kiswahili: Mikono yote miwili ni hodari katika kufanya ubaya, mtawala anadai zawadi, hakimu anapokea rushwa, wenye nguvu wanaamuru wanachotaka: wote wanafanya shauri baya pamoja.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bare nomokia gokora ayare amabe namaboko abo. Omogambi nigo anchete aegwe riaaki, na omogambi ebiina boigo; omonto ore nokobua nigo agosaba aegwe ebi aganetie ase okogania kwaye okobe, na nigo babwateranete amo.

English: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.
Kiswahili: Aliye mwema kupita wote kati yao ni kama mchongoma, anayeonekana mnyofu zaidi miongoni mwao ni mbaya kuliko uzio wa miiba. Siku ya walinzi wako imewadia, siku atakayokutembelea Mungu. Sasa ni wakati wao wa kuchanganyikiwa.
Ekegusii: Oyore omuya goetania abande ase egati yabo nigo anga buna egetutu kere namagwa, na oyore nenkoro endonge nigo are nobobe kobua orobago rogiteire amagwa. Ekero rituko ri’abarendi bao, riria ri’egesusuro kiao riraike, abanto mbabe nomoichano.

English: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!
Kiswahili: Usimtumaini jirani; usiweke matumaini kwa rafiki. Hata kwa yule alalaye kifuani mwako uwe mwangalifu kwa maneno yako.
Ekegusii: Tobaisa kwegena omogisangio oo, gose gosemeria omosani oo. Orende amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo, nonya mokao tayamanya.

English: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mwana humdharau baba yake, naye binti huinuka dhidi ya mama yake, mkwe kuwa kinyume na mama mkwe wake: adui wa mtu ni wale wa nyumbani mwake hasa.
Ekegusii: Omwana omomura nigo agochaaya ise, na omwana omoiseke nigo akoamererania na ng’ina, na moka momura oamererania na ng’ina biara. Ababisa b’omonto nabaanto b’enyomba yaye omonyene.

English: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi, namtazama Bwana kwa matumaini, namngoja Mungu Mwokozi wangu; Mungu wangu atanisikia mimi.
Ekegusii: Korende inche omonyene nindigererie Omonene; ninganye inde nogosemeria ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane; Nyasae one nanyigwe.

English: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
Kiswahili: Usifurahie msiba wangu, ee adui yangu! Ingawa nimeanguka, nitainuka. Japo ninaketi gizani, Bwana atakuwa nuru yangu.
Ekegusii: Aye omobisa one, togokera okogwa kwane; ekero ndagwe, nintenene naende; ekero ndabe inde ase omosunte, Omonene nabe etaya yane.

English: I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu nimetenda dhambi dhidi yake, nitabeba ghadhabu ya Bwana, mpaka atakaponitetea shauri langu na kuithibitisha haki yangu. Atanileta nje kwenye mwanga, nami nitaiona haki yake.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera nakorire ebibe ase Omonene, nindemererie endamwamu yaye, goika ere agambe amang’ana aane na ang’e oboronge bwane. Ere nandete ase omobaso, na inche ningokere oboronge bwaye.

English: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is Yahweh your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.
Kiswahili: Kisha adui yangu ataliona naye atafunikwa na aibu, yule aliyeniambia, “Yu wapi Bwana Mungu wako?” Macho yangu yataona kuanguka kwake, hata sasa atakanyagwa chini ya mguu kama tope barabarani.
Ekegusii: Erio oria ore omobisa one arore ayio, na obosooku mbomotube oria omboretie, “Ng’ai Omonene, Nyasae oo, are?” Nimorigererie ngoke; ere natiringerwe inse buna esike ere inchera.

English: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kujenga kuta zako itawadia, siku ya kupanua mipaka yako.
Ekegusii: Rituko ndiche ekero chindwaki chiao chiraagachwe. Ase rituko erio chimbebe chiao nchigareeigwe.

English: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo watu watakuja kwako kutoka Ashuru na miji ya Misri, hata kutoka Misri hadi Frati na kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutoka mlima hadi mlima.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abanto mbagochere korwa Asuri na korwa ase emechie ya Misiri, ee, korwa Misiri goika orooche rwa Eufarati, na korwa ase enyancha eyemo goika ase eyende, na korwa ase egetunwa ekemo goika ase ekende.

English: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
Kiswahili: Dunia itakuwa ukiwa kwa sababu ya wakazi wake, kwa sababu ya matunda ya matendo yao.
Ekegusii: Korende ense netigwe ebe bosa ase engencho y’abanto bamenyeteo; okwo korabe okwama kw’ogokora kwabo okobe.

English: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
Kiswahili: Wachunge watu wako kwa fimbo yako, kundi la urithi wako, ambalo linaishi peke yake msituni, katika nchi ya malisho yenye rutuba. Waache walishe katika Bashani na Gileadi kama ilivyokuwa siku za kale.
Ekegusii: Risia abanto bao nenyimbo yao abanto abwo bare riicho ri’omwando oo, rimenyete ao rioka ase rinani ime agwo Karimeli. Oritige rikorisia agwo Basani na Gileadi, buna yarenge ase amatuko a kare.

English: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”
Kiswahili: “Kama siku zile mlipotoka Misri, nitawaonyesha maajabu yangu.”
Ekegusii: “Nimborokie amakumia buna nakorete ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri.”

English: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yataona na kuaibika, waliondolewa nguvu zao zote. Wataweka mikono yao kwenye vinywa vyao na masikio yao yatakuwa na uziwi.
