English: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa sababu yenu mbingu zimezuia umande wake na ardhi mavuno yake.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, riime rikorwa igoro riatangirwe na ense tekwama endagera.

English: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”
Kiswahili: Niliita ukame mashambani na milimani, kwenye nafaka, mvinyo mpya, mafuta pamoja na chochote kinachozalishwa na ardhi, juu ya watu na ngʼombe, pamoja na kazi za mikono yenu.”
Ekegusii: Narentire eguru‐gura ase ense, na ase ebitunwa, na ase endagera, na ase emesabibu, na ase emezeituni, na ase kende gionsi kegokina ase riroba. Boigo nayerentire ase abanto, na ase emeremo yonsi abanto bagokora.”

English: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed Yahweh their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahweh their God had sent him; and the people feared Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, Yoshua kuhani mkuu mwana wa Yehosadaki, pamoja na mabaki yote ya watu wakaitii sauti ya Bwana Mungu wao pamoja na ujumbe wa nabii Hagai, kwa sababu alikuwa ametumwa na Bwana Mungu wao. Watu walimwogopa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, amo nabatigari bonsi b’abaanto bakaigwera eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae obo, na amang’ana ’omobani Hagai, oyio Omonene, Nyasae obo, atomete; abanto bakaba bakomoiroka Omonene.

English: Then Haggai, Yahweh’s messenger, spoke Yahweh’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kisha Hagai, mjumbe wa Bwana, akawapa watu ujumbe huu wa Bwana: “Mimi niko pamoja nanyi,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio Hagai, omotomwa bw’ Omonene, agakwana nabaanto amang’ana ’Omonene, akabateebia, “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Inche nigo inde amo nainwe.”

English: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of Yahweh of Armies, their God,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akachochea roho ya Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, mtawala wa Yuda, na roho ya kuhani mkuu Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, pamoja na roho za mabaki yote ya watu. Walikuja wakaanza kufanya kazi katika nyumba ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wao,
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene agasukia omoika o Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogabana bw’Abayuda, na oyo o Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na oyo bw’abatigari bonsi b’abaanto. Bonsi amo bagacha bagakora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae obo.

English: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
Kiswahili: katika siku ya ishirini na nne mwezi wa sita, katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Mfalme Dario.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo akorekanete ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Dario.

English: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na moja ya mwezi wa saba, neno la Bwana lilikuja kupitia nabii Hagai, kusema:
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na rimo, omotienyi o gatano na kabere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rigateba:

English: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
Kiswahili: “Sema na Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, mtawala wa Yuda, kuhani mkuu Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, na mabaki ya watu. Uwaulize,
Ekegusii: “Kwana na Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, omogabana bw’Abayuda, na Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na abatigari bonsi b’abaanto, obaborie:

English: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?
Kiswahili: ‘Ni nani miongoni mwenu aliyebaki ambaye aliiona hii nyumba katika utukufu wake wa mwanzo? Sasa inaonekanaje kwenu? Je, haionekani kwenu kama si kitu?
Ekegusii: Ning’o otigarete ase egati yaino oyo orooche obonene bw’enyomba eria entang’ani? Moise koreng’ania eye neria ya kare, naki eye ekororekana ase amaiso aino? Inee! Teri kororekana ase more ng’a negento bosa?

English: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Yahweh, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa uwe imara, ee Zerubabeli,’ asema Bwana. ‘Kuwa imara, ee kuhani mkuu Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki. Mwe imara, enyi watu wote wa nchi,’ asema Bwana, ‘na mfanye kazi. Kwa kuwa mimi nipo pamoja nanyi,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Aye Serubabeli, obe omokong’u na aye Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, obe omokong’u, nainwe abanto bonsi abamore ase ense eye, mobe abakong’u ase ogokora emeremo, ekiagera inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo inde amo nainwe.

English: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’
Kiswahili: ‘Hili ndilo nililoagana nanyi mlipotoka katika nchi ya Misri. Pia Roho wangu anadumu katikati yenu. Msiogope.’
Ekegusii: Ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri nigo nabarierete eira ng’a botambe nigo ndabe amo nainwe; ase ayio Omoika one nigo ogendererete komenya ase egati yaino; timoiroka.

English: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Baada ya muda kidogo kwa mara nyingine nitazitikisa mbingu na nchi, bahari na nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Ara rimo naende, engaki enke yatigaire nintengechie igoro chionsi, na ense, na enyancha, amo nense enyomo.

English: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Nitatikisa mataifa yote, nacho kile kinachotamaniwa na mataifa yote kitakuja, nami nitaujaza utukufu katika nyumba hii,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Boigo nintengechie ebisaku bionsi, erinde ayaganeirie nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi aoroke, na inche ing’ichorie enyomba yane nobonene.

English: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: ‘Fedha ni mali yangu na dhahabu ni mali yangu,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Chifeta nechiane, ne chitaabu nechiane. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.

English: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”
Kiswahili: ‘Utukufu wa nyumba hii ya sasa utakuwa mkubwa kuliko utukufu wa ile nyumba ya mwanzoni,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. ‘Na mahali hapa nitawapa amani,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.”
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba ng’a obonene bw’enyomba eye ya bono nabobe obonene goetania obw’eria ya kare. Aase aiga nindete omorembe obe okogambao. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.”

English: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi wa tisa, katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Mfalme Dario, neno la Bwana lilikuja kwa nabii Hagai:
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, omwaka o kabere, bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Hagai omobani, rikamoteebia:

English: “Yahweh of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Ulizeni makuhani jinsi sheria inavyosema:
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Boria abakuani naki amachiiko agoteeba.

English: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akibeba nyama iliyowekwa wakfu katika pindo la vazi lake, kisha lile pindo likagusa mkate au mchuzi, divai, mafuta au chakula kingine, je, kitu hicho kitakuwa kimewekwa wakfu?’ ” Makuhani wakajibu, “La hasha.”
Ekegusii: Omonto aise kobogoria enyama enchenu ase omogo bw’eanga yaye akwambara, na akune nomogo bw’eanga eria omogati, gose endagera eiyekire, gose edivai, gose amaguta ’amazeituni, gose endagera ende yonsi, Inee, ekio giakunwa nkebe egechenu?” Abakuani bakairaneria, “Yaya.”

English: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Hagai akasema, “Je, kama mtu aliyetiwa unajisi kwa kugusa maiti akigusa mojawapo ya vitu hivi, kitu hicho kitakuwa kimetiwa unajisi?” Makuhani wakajibu, “Ndiyo, huwa kimenajisiwa.”
Ekegusii: Naende Hagai akaboria, “Onye omonto obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo karakune ekemo ase ebinto ebio, Inee, ekio nakebe egetachenegeti?” Abakuani bakairaneria, bagateeba, “Ee, nkebe egetachenegeti.”

English: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says Yahweh; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.
Kiswahili: Kisha Hagai akasema, “ ‘Basi ndivyo walivyo machoni pangu hawa watu na taifa hili,’ asema Bwana. ‘Lolote wafanyalo na chochote watoacho hapo ni najisi.
Ekegusii: Erio Hagai akairaneria, agateeba, “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Naboigo nabaanto aba, na egesaku eke, bare ase obosio bwane, na kera omoremo bagokora namaboko abo nabo ore, na kende gionsi eke bakorua aroro nigo kere egetachenegeti.

English: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Yahweh’s temple.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Sasa fikirini kwa uangalifu kuanzia leo na kuendelea: tafakarini jinsi mambo yalivyokuwa kabla halijawekwa jiwe moja juu ya lingine katika Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio nigo nkobaboria ng’a korwa rituko ria reero mobe mokorengereria buna yarenge ekero keria rigena konya ritarabekwa igoro ase rigena rinde, ase okoagacha Hekalu y’Omonene.

English: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.
Kiswahili: Wakati mtu alipoendea lundo la nafaka la vipimo ishirini, kulikuwa na vipimo kumi tu. Wakati mtu alipoendea pipa la mvinyo ili kuchota vipimo hamsini, kulikuwa na vipimo ishirini tu.
Ekegusii: Ninki kiabeete ase amatuko aria? Ekero omonto arenge kogenda ase etui y’emesaima ng’a anyore emesaima emerongo ebere, onyora ikomi yoka, na ekero arenge kogenda ase amasabibu akomiterwa ng’a anyore ebibekerero emerongo etano biichire edivai, onyora emerongo ebere bioka.

English: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Kazi zenu zote za mikono nilizipiga kwa ukame, ukungu na mvua ya mawe, lakini hata hivyo, hamkunigeukia mimi,’ asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nigo nabaagete ase okobarentera oborwaire enyagetabo, na obw’okorigisia, na embura y’amagena ase chindagera chiaino mwakorerete emeremo. Nonya naboigo timwang’iranerete. Nabo Omonene atebiire.

English: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid, consider it.
Kiswahili: ‘Tangu leo na kuendelea, kuanzia siku hii ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi wa tisa, tafakarini siku ambayo msingi wa Hekalu la Bwana uliwekwa. Tafakarini:
Ekegusii: Korwa rituko ria reero, rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, ekero oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene bwabegetwe, na kogenderera, morengererie buna arabe!

English: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”
Kiswahili: Je, bado kuna mbegu iliyobakia ghalani? Mpaka sasa, hakuna mzabibu au mtini, mkomamanga wala mzeituni uliozaa tunda. “ ‘Kuanzia leo na kuendelea, nitawabariki.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inee! Chimbusuro nchire ase ebiage? Inee! Emesabibu, na emeko, na emekomomanga, na emezeituni tiyangeti kwama? Korende korwa rituko ria reero nimbasesenie.”

English: Yahweh’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likamjia Hagai kwa mara ya pili katika siku ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi kusema:
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi oria o kianda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Hagai naende, rikamoteebia,

English: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.
Kiswahili: “Mwambie Zerubabeli mtawala wa Yuda kwamba nitazitikisa mbingu na nchi.
Ekegusii: “Kwana na Serubabeli, omogabana bw’Abayuda, omoteebie ng’a inche nintengechie igoro chionsi amo nense.

English: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.
Kiswahili: Nitapindua viti vya enzi vya falme, na kuziharibu kabisa nguvu za falme za kigeni. Nitapindua magari ya vita pamoja na waendeshaji wake; farasi na wapanda farasi wataanguka, kila mmoja kwa upanga wa ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Ning’onchorane ebirogo bi’obonene bw’abarwoti, ninsirie chinguru chi’amarwoti ’abaanto b’ebisaku. Ning’onchorane chigari na abachiriini; chibarasi nchigwe amo nabachiriinete, kera omonto naite oyomwabo n’omoro.

English: In that day, says Yahweh of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Yahweh, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku ile,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ‘nitakuchukua wewe, mtumishi wangu Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli,’ asema Bwana. ‘Nitakufanya kama pete yangu ya muhuri, kwa kuwa nimekuchagua,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.”
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Ase rituko riria ninkoire aye Serubabeli omosomba one, mosinto o Sealitieli. Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ningokore obe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio kiane, ekiagera nagochorire. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.”

English: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,
Kiswahili: Katika mwezi wa nane wa mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Mfalme Dario, neno la Bwana lilimjia nabii Zekaria mwana wa Berekia, mwana wa Ido, kusema:
Ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Dario ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase omobani Zakaria, mosinto o Berekia o Ido, rikamoteebia,

English: “Yahweh was very displeased with your fathers.
Kiswahili: “Bwana aliwakasirikia sana baba zako wa zamani.
Ekegusii: “Omonene nigo agechetigwe mono ne chisokoro chiaino.

English: Therefore tell them, Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo waambie watu: Hivi ndivyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemavyo: ‘Nirudieni mimi,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ‘nami nitawarudia ninyi,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio teebia abanto: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Ing’iranere inche Omonene bw’Emeganda, nainche nimbairanere. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.

English: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: Msiwe kama baba zenu, ambao manabii waliotangulia waliwatangazia: Hivi ndivyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemavyo: ‘Geukeni, mziache njia zenu mbaya na matendo yenu maovu.’ Lakini hawakunisikiliza wala kufuata maelekezo yangu, asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa koba buna chisokoro chiaino, abwo ababani ba kare barerete ase bare, bakabateebia: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Onchoka, motige chinchera chiaino chimbe, na ogokora kwaino okobe. Korende chisokoro chiaino tichiategererete chinyigwere. Nabo Omonene agoteeba.

English: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
Kiswahili: Wako wapi baba zako sasa? Nao manabii, je, wanaishi milele?
Ekegusii: Bono chisokoro chiaino ng’ai chire? Na ababani baino, ng’ai bare? Inee! Mbagendererete koba moyo botambe?

English: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as Yahweh of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”
Kiswahili: Je, maneno yangu na amri zangu nilizowaagiza manabii watumishi wangu, hayakuwapata baba zenu?” “Kisha walitubu na kusema, ‘Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ametutenda sawasawa na njia zetu na matendo yetu yalivyostahili, kama alivyokusudia kufanya.’ ”
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aane na emeroberio yane echiikire, ayio naruete goetera ase abasomba baane ababani nigo yasoete ase chinkoro chie chisokoro chiaino. Barabwo nigo beitetie bagateeba: Bun’Omonene bw’Emeganda arengereretie gotokorera ase engencho ye chinchera chiaito na ogokora gwaito, naboigo atokoreire.”

English: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi wa kumi na moja, yaani mwezi uitwao Shebati, katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Mfalme Dario, neno la Bwana lilimjia nabii Zekaria mwana wa Berekia mwana wa Ido.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o ikomi nomo, noro okorokwa Sebati, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde inche omobani Zakaria, mosinto o Berekia o Ido.

English: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa usiku nilipata maono, mbele yangu alikuwepo mtu akiendesha farasi mwekundu! Alikuwa amesimama katikati ya miti ya mihadasi kwenye bonde. Nyuma yake walikuwepo farasi wekundu, wa kikahawia na weupe.
Ekegusii: Nkarora ase okorora kwa botuko omonto oriinete ebarasi embariri. Omonto oyio nigo ateneine ase egati y’emete ekorokwa emehadasi yarenge ase rigoko. Na magega yaye nchiarengeo chibarasi chinde chimbariri, na echire chincherati, ne chindabu.

English: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’” The angel who talked with me said to me, “I will show you what these are.”
Kiswahili: Nikauliza, “Hivi ni vitu gani bwana wangu?” Malaika aliyekuwa akizungumza na mimi akanijibu, “Nitakuonyesha kuwa ni nini.”
Ekegusii: Erio nkabori’Omonene one, ninki engencho ye chibarasi echi? Omomalaika oria okwanete nainche, aganteebia. “Ninkworokie engencho ye chibarasi echi.”

English: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones Yahweh has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”
Kiswahili: Kisha yule mtu aliyesimama katikati ya miti ya mihadasi akaeleza, “Ni wale ambao Bwana amewatuma waende duniani kote.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto oria oteneine ase egati y’emehadasi eria akang’iraneria, aganteebia, “Chibarasi echio nachio Omonene atomire chietanane ase ense yonsi.”

English: They reported to Yahweh’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”
Kiswahili: Nao wakatoa taarifa kwa yule malaika wa Bwana, aliyekuwa amesimama katikati ya miti ya mihadasi, “Tumepita duniani kote na kukuta ulimwengu wote umepumzika kwa amani.”
Ekegusii: Chibarasi chigateebia omomalaika bw’Omonene, oria oteneine ase egati y’emehadasi eria, “Twaetananire ase ense yonsi, twarorire ng’a ense yonsi nigo etoererete ekirete‐kiri.”

English: Then Yahweh’s angel replied, “O Yahweh of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika wa Bwana akasema, “Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, utazuia mpaka lini rehema kutoka Yerusalemu na miji ya Yuda, ambayo umeikasirikia kwa miaka hii sabini?”
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria bw’Omonene akaboria, “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, ngoika ririri orabe otari kororera Yerusalemu, na emechie y’Abayuda amaabera, eyio kwabeire kogechirie mono nero ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70)?”

English: Yahweh answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akazungumza maneno ya upole na ya kufariji kwa malaika aliyezungumza nami.
Ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria amang’ana amaya na ay’okoremia ase omomalaika oria okwanete nainche.

English: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika yule aliyekuwa akizungumza nami akasema, “Tangaza neno hili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: ‘Nina wivu sana kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu na Sayuni,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omomalaika oria aganteebia, “Raria, otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Nigo inde ne risemi rinene ase engencho ya Yerusalemu na Sayoni.

English: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”
Kiswahili: lakini nimeyakasirikia sana mataifa yanayojisikia kuwa yako salama. Nilikuwa nimewakasirikia Israeli kidogo tu, lakini mataifa hayo yaliwazidishia maafa.’
Ekegusii: Nigo ngechirie mono nabaanto b’ebisaku ebio batoererete, bakirete‐kiri, ekiagera ekero nagechetigwe ake nabarabwo, nigo bamentete korenta emechando.

English: Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: ‘Nitairudia Yerusalemu kwa rehema na huko nyumba yangu itajengwa tena. Nayo kamba ya kupimia itanyooshwa Yerusalemu,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Inche nairanire Yerusalemu na koyororera amaabera. Enyomba neagachwe imeo, na engori y’okorengera eramborwe igoro ya Yerusalemu. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.

English: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and Yahweh will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”
Kiswahili: “Endelea kutangaza zaidi kwamba: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Miji yangu itafurika tena ustawi na Bwana atamfariji tena Sayuni na kumchagua Yerusalemu.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Raria naende, otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Emechie yane neichorigwe nogosesenigwa okonge, na inche Omonene nindemie Sayoni naende, na ninchore Yerusalemu obe oyone naende.”

English: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.
Kiswahili: Kisha nikatazama juu, na pale mbele yangu nikaona pembe nne!
Ekegusii: Naende nkarigereria, nkarora ching’unchara inye.

English: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”
Kiswahili: Nikamuuliza yule malaika aliyekuwa akizungumza nami, “Ni nini hivi?” Akanijibu, “Hizi ni zile pembe zilizowatawanya Yuda, Israeli na Yerusalemu.”
Ekegusii: Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria konya okwanire nainche, “Ninki engencho ye ching’unchara echi?” Ere akairaneria, aganteebia, “Ching’unchara echi nachio chiasiarerete Abayuda, na Abaisraeli, na abanto ba Yerusalemu.”

English: Yahweh showed me four craftsmen.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana akanionyesha mafundi wanne.
Ekegusii: Erio Omonene akanyorokia abaturi b’ebioma baane.

English: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
Kiswahili: Nikauliza, “Hawa wanakuja kufanya nini?” Akanijibu, “Hizi ndizo pembe zilizowatawanya Yuda ili asiwepo atakayeweza kuinua kichwa chake, lakini mafundi wamekuja kuzitia hofu na kuzitupa chini hizi pembe za mataifa ambayo yaliinua pembe zao dhidi ya nchi ya Yuda na kuwatawanya watu wake.”
Ekegusii: Naende nkaboria, “Abanto aba, ninki bacha gokora aa?” Ere akairaneria, aganteebia, “Ching’unchara chiria chiasiarerete Abayuda gochia aaria na aaria, goika monto onde tanyarete koimokia omotwe oye igoro. Bono abanto aba bachire gochiondokia na kobutora ching’unchara chi’abaanto b’ebisaku, baria baimokereretie ching’unchara chiabo igoro y’ense y’Abayuda, chigasiarera abamenyeteo.”

English: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
Kiswahili: Kisha nikatazama juu: pale mbele yangu alikuwepo mtu mwenye kamba ya kupimia mkononi mwake!
Ekegusii: Naende nkarigereria, nkarora omonto obwate engori y’okorengera ase okoboko kwaye.

English: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”
Kiswahili: Nikamuuliza, “Unakwenda wapi?” Akanijibu, “Kupima Yerusalemu, kupata urefu na upana wake.”
Ekegusii: Erio nkamoboria, “Ng’ai okogenda?” Ere akairaneria aganteebia, “Yerusalemu ngochia korenga, erinde imanye obogare bwaye, na obotambe bwaye.”

English: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika aliyekuwa akizungumza nami akaondoka, malaika mwingine akaja kukutana naye
Ekegusii: Erio nkarora omomalaika oria konya okwanire nainche ogocha, na omomalaika onde agacha koumerana nere,

English: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.
Kiswahili: na kumwambia: “Kimbia, umwambie yule kijana, ‘Yerusalemu utakuwa mji usio na kuta kwa sababu ya wingi wa watu na mifugo iliyomo.
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Minyooka, oteebie omomura oria obwate engori y’okorengera ng’a Yerusalemu nomenywe buna emechie etagiteiri chindwaki, ekiagera nobe nabaanto abange ne chitugo chinyinge.

English: For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe nitakuwa ukuta wa moto kuuzunguka,’ asema Bwana, ‘nami nitakuwa utukufu wake ndani yake.’
Ekegusii: Omonene oteebire ng’a nere bweka omonyene orabe orwaki rw’omorero ase chinsemo chionsi chi’omochie oyio, ere neorokie imeo abe obonene bwaye.”

English: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Njooni! Njooni! Kimbieni mtoke katika nchi ya kaskazini,” asema Bwana, “Kwa kuwa nimewatawanya kwenye pande nne za mbingu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Imoka! Imoka motame, morue ase ense ya sugusu, ekiagera ninche nabasiarerete buna ngosiarera chimbeo inye chia igoro.” Nab’Omonene agoteeba.

English: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
Kiswahili: “Njoo, ee Sayuni! Kimbia, wewe ukaaye ndani ya Binti Babeli!”
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, inwe abamomenyete amo nabaanto ba Babiloni, imoka motame, mwetoorie!”

English: For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Baada ya yeye kuniheshimu na kunituma mimi dhidi ya mataifa yaliyokuteka nyara, kwa kuwa yeyote awagusaye ninyi, anaigusa mboni ya jicho lake,
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Ere oyontomire ase abanto b’ebisaku abwo baabasakorete ing’orokie obonene bwaye, ekiagera oyo orabakune inwe, oyio nabe okunire endorero y’eriso riaye.

English: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me.
Kiswahili: hakika nitauinua mkono wangu dhidi yao ili watumwa wao wawateke nyara. Ndipo mtakapojua ya kwamba Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amenituma.
Ekegusii: Rora, ninsamunse amaboko aane igoro yabo, barabwo mbabe abasomba b’abwo barenge kobakorera.” Erio nario moramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda ontomire.

English: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: “Piga kelele na ufurahie, ee Binti Sayuni, kwa maana ninakuja, nami nitaishi miongoni mwenu,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, goka na gochenga! Naama! Ngocha inde komenya ase egati yaino.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

English: Many nations shall join themselves to Yahweh in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.
Kiswahili: “Mataifa mengi yataunganishwa na Bwana siku hiyo, nao watakuwa watu wangu. Nitaishi miongoni mwenu nanyi mtajua kwamba Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amenituma kwenu.
Ekegusii: “Ase ekero ekio abanto b’ebisaku ebinge mbabwatane nainche Omonene; barabwo mbabe abanto baane. Ee, inche nimenye ase egati yaino.” Erio nario moramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda nere ontomire gocha ase more.

English: Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Bwana atairithi Yuda kama fungu lake katika nchi takatifu na atachagua tena Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Omonene naire Abayuda babe omwando oye ore ase ense eye enchenu, nachore Yerusalemu obe omochie oye naende.

English: Be silent, all flesh, before Yahweh; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”
Kiswahili: Tulieni mbele za Bwana, enyi watu wote, kwa sababu ameinuka kutoka makao yake matakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto bonsi, tegerera mokire‐kiri ase obosio Omonene, ekiagera otenenire ngosoka are korwa ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu.

English: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.
Kiswahili: Kisha akanionyesha Yoshua, kuhani mkuu, akiwa amesimama mbele ya malaika wa Bwana, naye Shetani amesimama upande wake wa kuume ili amshtaki.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene akanyorokia Yoshua, Omokuani omonene, oteneine ase obosio bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene, na Saitani oteneine ase ensemo ya borio ya Yoshua okomosoera.

English: Yahweh said to Satan, “Yahweh rebuke you, Satan! Yes, Yahweh who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Bwana akukemee Shetani! Bwana, ambaye ameichagua Yerusalemu, akukemee! Je, mtu huyu siyo kijinga kinachowaka kilichonyakuliwa kwenye moto?”
Ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Saitani, “Aye Saitani, inche Omonene ningotogonyere! Ee, inche Omonene nachorire Yerusalemu, ningotogonyere! Inee! Omonto oyo tari ekegenga giataboretigwe korwa ase omorero ime?”

English: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu, Yoshua alikuwa amevaa nguo chafu alipokuwa amesimama mbele ya malaika.
Ekegusii: Bono Yoshua nigo ateneine ase obosio bw’omomalaika, obegete chianga chire ne riko.

English: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”
Kiswahili: Malaika akawaambia wale waliokuwa wamesimama mbele yake, “Mvueni hizo nguo zake chafu.” Kisha akamwambia Yoshua, “Tazama, nimeiondoa dhambi yako, nami nitakuvika mavazi ya kitajiri.”
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria agachiika abwo bateneineo ase okomokorera, akabateebia, “Morusie chianga echio chire ne riko.” Nyuma y’ayio omomalaika oria agateebia Yoshua, “Naama! Narusirie ebibe biao korwa asore, ninkobekere chianga chingiya chi’omoyega.”

English: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and Yahweh’s angel was standing by.
Kiswahili: Kisha nikasema, “Mvike kilemba kilicho safi kichwani mwake.” Kwa hiyo wakamvika kilemba safi kichwani na kumvika yale mavazi mengine, wakati malaika wa Bwana akiwa amesimama karibu.
Ekegusii: Erio inche ngateba, “Bono mobekere egetambaa ekerabu motwe.” Ase igo bakamobekera egetambaa ekerabu motwe na bakamobekera ne chianga chiria chingiya, ekero omomalaika oria Omonene ateneineo.

English: Yahweh’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,
Kiswahili: Malaika wa Bwana akamwamuru Yoshua:
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria Omonene akamoenekeria Yoshua, akamoteebia,

English: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.
Kiswahili: “Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Ikiwa utakwenda katika njia zangu na kushika masharti yangu, basi utaitawala nyumba yangu na kuwa na amri juu ya nyua zangu, nami nitakupa nafasi miongoni mwa hawa wasimamao hapa.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Korabwatie chinchera chiane, na obwate aya nagochikeire, rirorio nogambere enyomba yane, na orende chiraaro chiane. Ninkoe ribaga ogochera ase ’nde amo nabwo bagonkorera aiga.

English: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Sikiliza, ee Yoshua kuhani mkuu, pamoja na wenzako walioketi mbele yako, ambao ni watu walio ishara ya mambo yatakayokuja: Ninakwenda kumleta mtumishi wangu, Tawi.
Ekegusii: Aye Yoshua, Omokuani omonene, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aya, aye amo nabagisangio bao, abwo baikaransete ase obosio bwao, ekiagera abwo nabaanto bare ekemanyererio ki’amang’ana agochi gocha: Naama! Inche nintome omosomba one okorokwa Omoseboko.

English: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
Kiswahili: Tazama, jiwe nililoliweka mbele ya Yoshua! Kuna macho saba juu ya jiwe lile moja, nami nitachora maandishi juu yake,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ‘nami nitaiondoa dhambi ya nchi hii kwa siku moja.
Ekegusii: Rigereria, ase obosio bwa Yoshua nabekire rigena erimo; nareo amaiso atano na abere arigereretie rigena erio. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ngoteeba iga: Nimang’ere ase rigena erio ririiko ririgwenerete, na nindusie ebibe bi’ense eye ase rituko erimo.

English: In that day,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku hiyo kila mmoja wenu atamwalika jirani yake akae chini ya mzabibu wake na mtini wake,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erio kera oyomo oino narangerie oyomwabo ache, baikaranse komo inse y’emesabibu na emeko yaye. “Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.”

English: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.
Kiswahili: Kisha malaika aliyezungumza nami akarudi na kuniamsha, kama mtu aamshwavyo kutoka usingizi wake.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika oria okwanete nainche ritang’ani agacha naende, agantura buna omonto oraire agoturwa korwa ase chitoro.

English: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;
Kiswahili: Akaniuliza, “Unaona nini?” Nikajibu, “Ninaona kinara cha taa cha dhahabu tupu, nacho kina bakuli juu yake na taa zake saba juu yake, tena iko mirija saba ya kuleta mafuta, kwenye taa zote zilizo juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ere akamboria, “Ninki orooche?” Nkairaneria, nkamoteebia, “Nigo ndoche ekebekerero gie chitaaya keroiseirie etaabu yoka, na igoro yaye egetaabo ki’amaguta ngeterekereireo, ne chitaaya isano na ibere nchireo, na emebirangwa etano na ebere ekorenta amaguta nigo esoete ase kera etaya ebekire igoro yaye.

English: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”
Kiswahili: Pia kuna mizeituni miwili karibu yake, mmoja upande wa kuume wa bakuli na mwingine upande wa kushoto.”
Ekegusii: Mbarabare ase ekebekerero keria gie chitaaya nereo emezeituni ebere, oyomo ensemo y’okorio na oyonde ensemo y’okobee.”

English: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”
Kiswahili: Nikamuuliza malaika aliyezungumza nami, “Hivi ni vitu gani, bwana wangu?”
Ekegusii: Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria okwanete nainche, “Omonene one, ninki engencho y’ebinto ebi?”

English: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
Kiswahili: Akanijibu, “Hujui kuwa hivi ni vitu gani?” Nikajibu, “Hapana, bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Erio akang’iraneria, akamboria, “Inee! Tomanyeti engencho y’ebinto ebi?” Nkamoiraneria, “Yaya, omonene one, timanyeti.”

English: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaniambia, “Hili ni neno la Bwana kwa Zerubabeli: ‘Si kwa uwezo, wala si kwa nguvu, bali ni kwa Roho yangu,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Erio akairaneria, aganteebia, “Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachierete Serubabeli, rikamoteebia: Ayio tagokoreka ase chinguru, gose ase okobua kw’omonto, korende nase Omoika one. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.

English: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”
Kiswahili: “Wewe ni kitu gani, ee mlima mkubwa sana? Mbele ya Zerubabeli wewe utakuwa ardhi tambarare. Kisha ataweka jiwe la juu kabisa la mwisho na watu wakipiga kelele wakisema, ‘Mungu libariki! Mungu libariki!’ ”
Ekegusii: Aye egetunwa ekenene, ninki oisaine ase obosio bwa Serubabeli? Noiranigwe inse obe buna ense omweya. Serubabeli nabeeke rigena ri’ogokoorera, abanto kobaakire eriogi, bagoteeba: Obuya, obuya bobe igoro yaye!”

English: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha neno la Bwana likanijia:
Ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia,

English: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.
Kiswahili: “Mikono ya Zerubabeli iliweka msingi wa Hekalu hili, mikono yake pia italimalizia. Kisha mtajua ya kuwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amenituma mimi kwenu.
Ekegusii: “Serubabeli obekire oboroso bw’enyomba eye namaboko aye, boigo nere orayekoore namaboko aye. Erio nario oramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda nere ontomete ase more.

English: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”
Kiswahili: “Ni nani anayeidharau siku ya mambo madogo? Watu watashangilia watakapoona timazi mkononi mwa Zerubabeli. “(Hizi saba ni macho ya Bwana ambayo huzunguka duniani kote.)”
Ekegusii: Ning’o orachaye rituko ri’amang’ana amake kagochaka, ekero amaiso aria atano na abere ararore ekebiro ase okoboko gwa Serubabeli, nagoke? “Ayio atano na abere namaiso ’Omonene arigereretie chinsemo chionsi chi’ense.”

English: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”
Kiswahili: Kisha nikamuuliza yule malaika, “Hii mizeituni miwili iliyoko upande wa kuume na wa kushoto wa kinara cha taa ni nini?”
Ekegusii: Naende nkaboria omomalaika oria, “Emezeituni eye ebere, oyomo ore ensemo y’okorio na oyonde ensemo y’okobee y’ekebekerero keria gie chitaaya, neya ki?”

English: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”
Kiswahili: Tena nikamuuliza, “Haya matawi mawili ya mizeituni karibu na hiyo mirija miwili ya dhahabu inayomimina mafuta ya dhahabu ni nini?”
Ekegusii: Nkamoboria okoboria gwa kabere, “Ninki engencho ye chinsagia echio ibere chi’emezeituni chire mbarabare ase emebirangwa eyio ebere eroiseirie etaabu, eyio amaguta agoetera?”

English: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Hujui kuwa haya ni nini?” Nikamjibu, “Hapana, bwana wangu.”
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, akamboria, “Inee! Tomanyeti engencho y’ebinto ebi?” Nkamokania, “Yaya, omonene one, timanyeti.”

English: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akasema, “Hawa ni wawili ambao wamepakwa mafuta ili kumtumikia Bwana wa dunia yote.”
Ekegusii: Erio aganteebia, “Aba nabwo abaakwa amaguta babere, abagotenena ase okomokorera Omonene bw’ense engima.”

English: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
Kiswahili: Nikatazama tena: na hapo mbele yangu kulikuwa na kitabu kilichoruka!
Ekegusii: Nkaimokia amaiso aane naende, nkarora egetabu eringanirie ekoiruruka.

English: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”
Kiswahili: Akaniuliza, “Unaona nini?” Nikamjibu, “Naona kitabu kinachoruka chenye, urefu wa dhiraa ishirini na upana wa dhiraa kumi.”
Ekegusii: Omomalaika oria akamboria, “Ninki orooche?” Nkairaneria, nkamoteebia, “Nigo ndoche egetabu eringanirie ekoiruruka; obotambe bwaye nobw’amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare bwaye amaboko ikomi.”

English: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.
Kiswahili: Akaniambia, “Hii ni laana inayotoka kwenda juu ya nchi yote, kwa kuwa kufuatana na yale yaliyoandikwa katika upande mmoja, kila mwizi atafukuziwa mbali, pia kufuatana na yaliyo upande wa pili, kila aapaye kwa uongo atafukuziwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Erio aganteebia, “Okwo nokoragererigwa gwachiereire ense yonsi. Kera oyokoiba narusigwe korwa aiga, buna koreng’ana ariikire ase egetabu eyio, na kera oyogotiana narusigwe boigo korwa aiga, buna koreng’ana ariikire ase egetabu eyio.

English: I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asema, ‘Nitaituma hiyo laana, nayo itaingia katika nyumba ya mwizi na nyumba ya huyo aapaye kwa uongo kwa Jina langu. Itabaki katika nyumba yake na kuiharibu, pamoja na mbao zake na mawe yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Nintome egetabu eyio ase enyomba y’omoibi, na ase enyomba y’oyo ogotiana kw’oborimo ase erieta riane; egetabu eyio nebeere ase chinyomba chi’abaanto abwo echisirie kegima, chibao chiabo amo namagena abo.”

English: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”
Kiswahili: Kisha yule malaika aliyekuwa akizungumza nami akanijia na kuniambia, “Tazama juu uone ni nini kile kinachojitokeza.”
Ekegusii: Omomalaika oria orenge gokwana nainche agacha naende, aganteebia, “Imokia amaiso ao, orore ngento ki keria kegocha.”

English: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—
Kiswahili: Nikamuuliza, “Ni kitu gani?” Akanijibu, “Ni kikapu cha kupimia.” Kisha akaongeza kusema, “Huu ni uovu wa watu katika nchi nzima.”
Ekegusii: Nkamoboria, “Ngento ki keria?” Akang’iraneria aganteebia, “Keria negetonga gi’okorenga kegocha; kerokio nigo getenenerete obobe bw’abaanto b’ense yonsi.”

English: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”
Kiswahili: Kisha kifuniko kilichotengenezwa kwa madini ya risasi kilichokuwa kimefunika kile kikapu, kiliinuliwa na ndani ya kile kikapu alikuwako mwanamke ameketi!
Ekegusii: Nkarigereria, nkarora ekemumeko kiaroiseirie risasi gekomumoka, na omokungu oikaransete ase egetonga keria ime.

English: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Huu ni uovu,” tena akamsukumia ndani ya kikapu na kushindilia kifuniko juu ya mdomo wa kikapu.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika oria agateeba, “Obo nabwo Obobe.” Erio akaigatera omokungu oria ime ase egetonga keria, agakong’ontera ekemumeko igoro ase omonwa bw’egetonga keria.

English: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.
Kiswahili: Kisha nikatazama juu: na pale mbele yangu, walikuwepo wanawake wawili, wakiwa na upepo katika mabawa yao! Walikuwa na mabawa kama ya korongo, nao wakainua kile kikapu na kuruka nacho kati ya mbingu na nchi.
Ekegusii: Erio nkaimokia amaiso aane, nkarora abakungu babere bakooroka. Embeo egasoa ase chimbaaba chiabo chiarenge buna echie riagonga. Abakungu abwo bakaimokia egetonga keria, bakairuruka nakerokio gochia gati‐gati y’ense na igoro.

English: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”
Kiswahili: Nikamuuliza yule malaika aliyekuwa akizungumza nami, “Wanakipeleka wapi hicho kikapu?”
Ekegusii: Nkaboria omomalaika oria orenge gokwana nainche, “Ng’ai bakoira egetonga keria?”

English: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”
Kiswahili: Akanijibu, “Wanakipeleka katika nchi ya Babeli na kujenga nyumba kwa ajili yake. Itakapokuwa tayari, kikapu kitawekwa pale mahali pake.”
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, aganteebia, “Nigo bagokeira ase ense ya Sinari, na aroro agwo baagachere omokungu oria enyomba, erinde ekoera bamobekeo, abeere aase aye.”

English: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.
Kiswahili: Nikatazama juu tena: nikaona mbele yangu magari manne ya vita yakija kutoka kati ya milima miwili, milima ya shaba!
Ekegusii: Naende nkarigereria nkarora chigari inye chigosoka korwa ase egati y’ebitunwa bibere, na ebitunwa biria nigo biarenge ebi’etai.

English: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.
Kiswahili: Gari la kwanza lilivutwa na farasi wekundu, la pili lilivutwa na farasi weusi,
Ekegusii: Egari ye ritang’ani nigo yarenge kong’uswa ne chibarasi chimbariri, na eya kabere ne chibarasi chimwamu,

English: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.
Kiswahili: la tatu lilivutwa na farasi weupe na gari la nne lilivutwa na farasi wa madoadoa ya kijivu, wote wenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: na eya gatato ne chibarasi chindabu, na eya kane ne chibarasi chire matonto, chionsi nigo chiarenge ne chinguru mono.

English: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”
Kiswahili: Nikamuuliza malaika aliyekuwa akizungumza nami, “Hawa ni nani bwana wangu?”
Ekegusii: Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria orenge gokwana nainche, “Omonene one, ninki engencho ye chibarasi echi?”

English: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
Kiswahili: Malaika akanijibu, “Hizi ni roho nne za mbinguni zisimamazo mbele ya uwepo wa Bwana wa dunia yote, zinatoka kwenda kufanya kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, aganteebia, “Echi nechimbeo inye chia igoro chikogenda korwa ase konya chiteneine agwo ase obosio Omonene bw’ense yonsi.

English: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”
Kiswahili: Gari linalovutwa na farasi weusi linaelekea katika nchi ya kaskazini, la farasi weupe linaelekea magharibi na la farasi wa madoadoa ya kijivu linaelekea kusini.”
Ekegusii: “Egari eria ekong’uswa ne chibarasi chimwamu nigo ekogenda ase ense ya bosongo, na eria ye chibarasi chindabu eyebwatie, na eria ye chibarasi chire matonto nigo ekogenda gochia ase ense ya Irianyi.”

English: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.
Kiswahili: Wakati hao farasi wenye nguvu walipokuwa wakitoka, walikuwa wakijitahidi kwenda duniani kote. Akasema, “Nenda duniani kote!” Kwa hiyo wakaenda duniani kote.
Ekegusii: Ekero chibarasi chiria chiarenge ne chinguru mono chiasogete chikagania kogenda goetanana ase ense yonsi. Omomalaika oria agachiteebia, “Genda moetanane ase ense yonsi.” Nachirochio chigakora bo.

English: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akaniita, “Tazama, wale wanaokwenda kuelekea nchi ya kaskazini wamepumzisha Roho yangu katika nchi ya kaskazini.”
Ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria agaaka eriogi, aganteebia, “Naama! Chibarasi echio chiagendete ase ense ya sugusu chiatoereirie omoika one ase ense eria.”

English: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia:

English: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.
Kiswahili: “Chukua fedha na dhahabu kutoka kwa watu waliohamishwa, yaani Heldai, Tobia na Yedaya ambao wamefika kutoka Babeli. Siku iyo hiyo nenda nyumbani kwa Yosia mwana wa Sefania.
Ekegusii: “Oegwe ebiegwa korwa ase Helidai na Tobia, na Yedaya, abanto abwo bairane korwa Babiloni ase barenge abasomba. Ase rituko erio erio ogende ase enyomba ya Yosia, mosinto o Sefania, ase basoete.

English: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
Kiswahili: Chukua fedha na dhahabu utengeneze taji, nawe uiweke kichwani mwa kuhani mkuu Yoshua, mwana wa Yehosadaki.
Ekegusii: Ekero kwaeirwe chifeta ne chitaabu oroisie egutwa korwa ase ebinto ebio, oyebeke ase omotwe o Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki.

English: and speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build Yahweh’s temple.
Kiswahili: Umwambie, hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Huyu ndiye mtu ambaye jina lake ni Tawi, naye atachipua kutoka mahali pake na kujenga Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okwane nere, omoteebie ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Naama! Oyomo nachiche okorokwa Omoseboka, ere naseboke korwa aase aye, aagache Hekalu y’Omonene

English: He will build Yahweh’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.
Kiswahili: Ni yeye atakayejenga Hekalu la Bwana, naye atavikwa utukufu na ataketi kumiliki katika kiti cha enzi naye atakuwa kuhani katika kiti chake cha enzi. Hapo patakuwa amani kati ya hao wawili.’
Ekegusii: Ee, ere naagache Hekalu y’Omonene, abe omorwoti osikire, aikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti. Naende nere orabe Omokuani ase ekerogo kiaye; na abwo babere mbaigwane babe bakogamba amang’ana ay’omorembe.

English: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.
Kiswahili: Taji itatolewa kwa Heldai, Tobia, Yedaya na Heni mwana wa Sefania kama kumbukumbu ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Egutwa eyio negenderere kobeera ime ase Hekalu y’Omonene koba ekeinyorio kia Helidai, na Tobia, na Yedaya, na Heni, mosinto o Sefania.

English: Those who are far off shall come and build in Yahweh’s temple; and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey Yahweh your God’s voice.”’”
Kiswahili: Wale walio mbali sana watakuja na kusaidia kulijenga Hekalu la Bwana, nanyi mtajua ya kwamba Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amenituma kwenu. Hili litatokea ikiwa mtamtii Bwana Mungu wenu kwa bidii.”
Ekegusii: “Abanto bamenyete aare mbachiche gokonya koagacha Hekalu y’Omonene. Erio nario moramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda nere ontomete ase more. Amang’ana ayio nigo araikerane koraigwe eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae oino.”

English: In the fourth year of King Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wa Mfalme Dario, neno la Bwana lilimjia Zekaria siku ya nne ya mwezi wa tisa, mwezi wa Kisleu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kane, omotienyi o kianda noro Kisilevu, omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde inche Zakaria.

English: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat Yahweh’s favor,
Kiswahili: Watu wa Betheli walikuwa wamemtuma Shareza na Regem-Meleki pamoja na watu wao, kumsihi Bwana
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Beteli konya batomire Sareseri, na Regemu‐Meleki, na abanto bande babo bagende gosaba Omonene, erinde banyore ogwancherwa korwa asare;

English: and to speak to the priests of the house of Yahweh of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”
Kiswahili: kwa kuwauliza makuhani wa nyumba ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote na manabii, “Je, imempasa kuomboleza na kufunga katika mwezi wa tano, kama ambavyo nimekuwa nikifanya kwa miaka mingi?”
Ekegusii: boigo baborie abakuani b’enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda na ababani. “Inee! Ntogenderere korera na kweng’ata ase omotienyi o gatano, buna twabeire togokora ase engaki y’emiaka emenge?”

English: Then the word of Yahweh of Armies came to me, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha neno la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote likanijia kusema:
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia,

English: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?
Kiswahili: “Waulize watu wote wa nchi na makuhani, ‘Je, mlipofunga na kuomboleza katika mwezi wa tano na wa saba kwa miaka sabini iliyopita, mlifunga kweli kwa ajili yangu?
Ekegusii: “Kwana nabaanto bonsi b’ense eye, na abakuani, obaborie: Ekero mwarenge kweng’ata na korera ase kera omotienyi o gatano, na oyo o gatano na kabere, ase chingaki echi chionsi chi’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, Inee, nigo mwarenge kweng’ata ase engencho yane?

English: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?
Kiswahili: Na mlipokuwa mkila na kunywa, je, hamkuwa mnasherehekea kwa ajili ya nafsi zenu?
Ekegusii: Na ekero mokoria na konywa, Inee, timori gokora ayio ase ogweisanekia inwe abanyene?

English: Aren’t these the words which Yahweh proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”
Kiswahili: Je, haya sio maneno ya Bwana aliyosema kupitia manabii waliotangulia, wakati Yerusalemu pamoja na miji inayoizunguka ilipokuwa katika hali ya utulivu na ya mafanikio, wakati Negebu na Shefala zikiwa zimekaliwa na watu?’ ”
Ekegusii: “Inee! Amang’ana ayio agwenerete mono tari aro Omonene arenge gokwana goetera ase ababani ba kare, ekero ekio Yerusalemu omenyire nabaanto, na igo orenge osesenirie ore nemechie yaye yayoetanaine, naende abanto bamenyete ase ense ya Irianyi na ase ense omweya?”

English: Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah, saying,
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likamjia tena Zekaria:
Ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde inche Zakaria, riganteebia,

English: “Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.
Kiswahili: “Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Fanyeni hukumu za haki, onyesheni rehema na huruma ninyi kwa ninyi.
Ekegusii: “Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Monache ebiina bia boronge, na kera omonto abe nobwanchani na amaabera ase oyomwabo.

English: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’
Kiswahili: Msimwonee mjane wala yatima, mgeni wala maskini. Msiwaziane mabaya mioyoni mwenu ninyi kwa ninyi.’
Ekegusii: Timokorera ababoraka bobe, gose chintakana, gose abamenyi bare ase egati yaino, gose abataka. Omonto tabaisa koroberia ase enkoro yaye akorere oyomwabo bobe.

English: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
Kiswahili: “Lakini wakakataa kusikiliza, wakanipa kisogo kwa ukaidi na kuziba masikio yao.
Ekegusii: “Korende abanto bakaba abamwenu, bakaanga koigwera, bagaticha amato abo ng’a tibaabaisa koigwa.

English: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which Yahweh of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Wakaifanya mioyo yao migumu kama jiwe gumu na hawakuisikiliza sheria au maneno ambayo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote aliyatuma kwa njia ya Roho wake kupitia manabii waliotangulia. Kwa hiyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote alikasirika sana.
Ekegusii: Bagakong’ia chinkoro chiabo pa buna rigena rikorokwa elimasi ng’a tibaabaisa koigwera amachiiko na amang’ana ’Omonene bw’Emeganda atomete n’Omoika oye goetera ase ababani ba kare. Ase engencho eyio Omonene bw’Emeganda akaba nendamwamu enene.

English: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said Yahweh of Armies;
Kiswahili: “ ‘Wakati nilipoita, hawakusikiliza, kwa hiyo walipoita, sikusikiliza,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Buna koreng’ana barabwo bataigwerete ekero nabarangeretie, bono nainche tinkoigwa ekero barandangerie.

English: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”
Kiswahili: ‘Niliwatawanya kwa upepo wa kisulisuli miongoni mwa mataifa yote, mahali ambapo walikuwa wageni. Nchi ikaachwa ukiwa nyuma yao kiasi kwamba hakuna aliyeweza kuingia au kutoka. Hivi ndivyo walivyoifanya ile nchi iliyokuwa imependeza kuwa ukiwa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo ndarente ekembugu‐mbugu mbasiarere gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku, abwo batabamanyeti. Ense eye egatigwa ere bosa, na omonto onde tarenge goeta ase egati yaye, gose koiranao, ekiagera ense eyio engiya nigo egotigwa ere bosa.”

English: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote likanijia tena.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia:

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Nina wivu sana kwa ajili ya Sayuni, ninawaka wivu kwa ajili yake.”
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Inche nigo inde ne risemi rinene mono ase engencho ya Sayoni; ee, risemi erio riagerire nabeire nendamwamu enene ase engencho yaye.

English: Yahweh says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of Yahweh of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Nitarudi Sayuni na kufanya makao Yerusalemu. Kisha Yerusalemu utaitwa mji wa kweli, mlima wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote utaitwa Mlima Mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ning’irane gocha ase Sayoni, imenye ase egati‐gati ya Yerusalemu, na Yerusalemu norokwe Omochie bw’Obwegenwa, na egetunwa ki’Omonene bw’Emeganda nakerokwe Egetunwa Egechenu.

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Kwa mara nyingine tena wazee wanaume kwa wanawake walioshiba umri wataketi katika barabara za Yerusalemu, kila mmoja akiwa na mkongojo wake mkononi kwa sababu ya umri wake.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Abagaaka na abang’ina nabanyorekane ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu naende, kera oyomo nabe nenyimbo yaye agwesiirera, ekiagera babeire abagotu mono.

English: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”
Kiswahili: Barabara za mji zitajaa wavulana na wasichana wanaocheza humo.”
Ekegusii: Naende ase chinchera chi’omochie oyio abana abange, abamura na abaiseke, inababe bakogosoreria aroro.

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Mambo haya yanaweza kuonekana ya ajabu kwa mabaki ya watu wakati huo, lakini yaweza kuwa ya ajabu kwangu?” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Onye amang’ana ayio are ay’ogokumia ase abatigari b’egesaku eke, Inee, nabe ay’ogokumia ase ’nde boigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda?

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Nitawaokoa watu wangu kutoka nchi za mashariki na magharibi.
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Rora, nintoorie abanto baane, mbarente korwa ase chinse chia moocha na bosongo.

English: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”
Kiswahili: Nitawarudisha waje kuishi Yerusalemu, watakuwa watu wangu nami nitakuwa mwaminifu na wa haki kwao kama Mungu wao.”
Ekegusii: Ekero nabarentire, nabamenye ase egati‐gati ya Yerusalemu babe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo ase obwegenwa na oboronge.

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of Yahweh of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Ninyi ambao sasa mnasikia maneno haya yanayozungumzwa na manabii ambao walikuwepo wakati wa kuwekwa kwa msingi wa nyumba ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, mikono yenu na iwe na nguvu ili Hekalu liweze kujengwa.
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Mobe abaremu! Inwe bono mwabeire mokoigwa amang’ana ayio ababani barenge gokwana, ekero oboroso bw’enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda bware kobekwa, ng’a Hekalu neagachwe naende.

English: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya wakati huo, hapakuwepo na ujira kwa mtu wala mnyama. Hakuna mtu aliyeweza kufanya shughuli yake kwa usalama kwa sababu ya adui yake, kwa kuwa nilikuwa nimemfanya kila mtu adui wa jirani yake.
Ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani ase amatuko ayio, monto onde bwensi tarenge konyora eng’eria ende ase emeremo arenge gokora, gose ng’iti ende yonsi yarenge gokora emeremo tiyarenge goakanerwa. Ase engencho y’obobisa onde tarenge na morembe kagosoka gose gakoirana, ekiagera nigo naseegetete kera omonto kwomana noyomwabo.

English: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa sitawatendea mabaki ya watu hawa kama nilivyowatenda zamani,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Korende bono tingokorera abatigari b’abaanto aba buna nakorerete ab’amatuko aria a kare. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.

English: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.
Kiswahili: “Mbegu itakua vizuri, mzabibu utazaa matunda yake, ardhi itatoa mazao yake, na mbingu zitadondosha umande wake. Vitu hivi vyote nitawapa mabaki ya watu kama urithi wao.
Ekegusii: Bono mbasimeke chimbusuro chiabo bare nomorembe; emesabibu inayame amasabibu, ne riroba narirente okwama kwaye, boigo na igoro nachirente riime. Nimbae abanto aba abatigari ebinto bionsi bibe ebiabo.

English: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”
Kiswahili: Jinsi mlivyokuwa kitu cha laana katikati ya mataifa, ee Yuda na Israeli, ndivyo nitakavyowaokoa, nanyi mtakuwa baraka. Msiogope, bali iacheni mikono yenu iwe na nguvu.”
Ekegusii: Inwe Abayuda na Abaisraeli, buna koreng’ana abanto b’ebisaku barenge koragereria ase erieta riaino, bono ekero ndabatoorie, abanto mbabe bagosesenia ase erieta riaino, Timoiroka, korende mobe abaremu!

English: For Yahweh of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Kama nilivyokuwa nimekusudia kuleta maangamizi juu yenu, wakati baba zenu waliponikasirisha na sikuonyesha huruma,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote,
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Buna koreng’ana naroberetie kobarentera amabe, ekero chisokoro chiaino chiakorete ebibe chikagera nkaba nendamwamu, gose tinaonchorete omooroberio oyio,

English: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.
Kiswahili: “hivyo sasa nimeazimia kufanya mema tena kwa Yerusalemu na Yuda. Msiogope.
Ekegusii: boigo ase amatuko aya narobeirie gokora amaya ase abanto ba Yerusalemu na ase Abayuda. Ase ayio timoiroka!

English: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo mtakayoyafanya: Semeni kweli kila mtu kwa mwenzake, na mtoe hukumu ya kweli na haki kwenye mahakama zenu,
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro morakore: Kera omonto akwane ekeene noyomwabo; monache ebiina bia boronge na ebi’omorembe agwo ase ebiita biaino.

English: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says Yahweh.
Kiswahili: usipange mabaya dhidi ya jirani yako, wala msipende kuapa kwa uongo. Nayachukia yote haya,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa gokora emeroberio emebe ase chinkoro chiaino ase ogokorerana bobe inwe ase inwe, gose timobaisa gwancha gotiana ogotiana kw’oborimo, ekiagera amang’ana ayio onsi nigo inyagechete. Nabo Omonene atebiire.”

English: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote likanijia tena.
Ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia:

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Saumu za miezi ya nne, tano, saba na kumi itakuwa sikukuu za furaha na za shangwe kwa Yuda. Kwa hiyo uipende kweli na amani.”
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Chingaki chi’okweng’ata ase omotienyi o kane, na oyo o gatano, na oyo o gatano na kabere, na oyo o ikomi, nachibe ase Abayuda chingaki chi’omogooko na omochengo, na Amatuko Amanene ay’okwegokia. Ase ayio mwanche ekeene na omorembe.

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Mataifa mengi na wakazi wa miji mingi watakuja,
Ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Engaki ngocha ere, ekero abanto abange bararue ase emechie emenge, bache aa.

English: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of Yahweh, and to seek Yahweh of Armies. I will go also.’
Kiswahili: na wenyeji wa mji mmoja watakwenda kwenye mji mwingine na kusema, ‘Twende mara moja na tukamsihi Bwana, na kumtafuta Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. Mimi mwenyewe ninakwenda.’
Ekegusii: Abanto b’omochie oyomo mbagende bateebie ab’omochie onde: Inchuo togende bwango, torigie ogwancherwa ase obosio Omonene, ee, inchwo torigie Omonene bw’Emeganda! Nainche nkogenda inde.

English: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek Yahweh of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of Yahweh.”
Kiswahili: Pia watu wa kabila nyingi na mataifa yenye nguvu yatakuja Yerusalemu kumtafuta Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote na kumsihi.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abange, na abanto b’ebisaku ebinge bire ne chinguru, mbachiche Yerusalemu korigia Omonene bw’Emeganda, na korigia ogwancherwa ase obosio bwaye.

English: Yahweh of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Katika siku hizo watu kumi kutoka lugha zote na mataifa, watangʼangʼania upindo wa joho la Myahudi mmoja na kusema, ‘Twende pamoja nawe kwa sababu tumesikia kwamba Mungu yu pamoja nawe.’ ”
Ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Ase amatuko ayio abanto ikomi ba kera egesaku bagokwana emenwa ao ao mbache babwate omokoba bw’omwambaro bw’Omoyahudi, bateebe: Intwe ntorigetie kogenda amo nainwe, ekiagera twaigure ng’a Nyasae nigo are amo nainwe.”

English: A revelation. Yahweh’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward Yahweh—
Kiswahili: Neno: Neno la Bwana liko kinyume na nchi ya Hadraki na Dameski itakuwa mahali pa kupumzika, kwa kuwa macho ya watu na ya kabila zote za Israeli yako kwa Bwana,
Ekegusii: Eri nering’ana rikong’u riakwanetwe n’Omonene igoro y’ense ya Hadaraki, riikere nonya nomochie o Damesiki. Amaiso ’abaanto b’ebisaku amo nay’Abaisraeli nigo arigereretie Omonene.

English: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
Kiswahili: pia juu ya Hamathi inayopakana nayo, juu ya Tiro na Sidoni, ingawa wana ujuzi mwingi sana.
Ekegusii: Boigo ring’ana erio riikere ense ya Hamati esinyaine na Damesiki, riikere na Turo na Sidoni, nonya abanto b’aroro bare abang’aini mono.

English: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.
Kiswahili: Tiro amejijengea ngome imara, amelundika fedha kama mavumbi na dhahabu kama taka za mitaani.
Ekegusii: Turo bweagacheire chiburi chinkong’u, naende osangereirie chindwenyi chi’echifeta chinyinge buna orotu, ne chitaabu chinyinge buna eubi ere ase chinchera.

English: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana atamwondolea mali zake na kuuangamiza uwezo wake wa baharini, naye atateketezwa kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Korende rora, Omonene nayoure chinibo chiaye, na atugute okobua kwaye ase enyancha, na omochie oyio omonyene nosambwe nomorero.

English: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
Kiswahili: Ashkeloni ataona hili na kuogopa; Gaza atagaagaa kwa maumivu makali, pia Ekroni, kwa sababu matumaini yake yatanyauka. Gaza atampoteza mfalme wake na Ashkeloni ataachwa pweke.
Ekegusii: Ekero Asikeloni orarore ayio, noiroke mono; Gasa boigo noro noiroke na goichana; naboigo n’Ekironi, ekiagera ogosemeria kwaye gwasirigwe. Omorwoti o Gasa nasirigwe, na abanto tibakomenya Asikeloni.

English: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
Kiswahili: Wageni watakalia mji wa Ashdodi, nami nitakatilia mbali kiburi cha Wafilisti.
Ekegusii: Asidodi nomenywe nabaanto batarochi inchera, na inche Omonene ninsirie kegima oboenenu bw’Abafilisti.

English: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
Kiswahili: Nitaondoa damu vinywani mwao, chakula kile walichokatazwa kati ya meno yao. Mabaki yao yatakuwa mali ya Mungu wetu, nao watakuwa viongozi katika Yuda, naye Ekroni atakuwa kama Wayebusi.
Ekegusii: Nindusie amanyinga ’ebing’wanso korwa ase emenwa yabo, na okogechia koria korwa ase amaino abo; na barabwo nababe abatigari ba Nyasae oito, nababe buna abagaambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda, abanto b’Ekironi nababe abatigari ba Nyasae oito, nababe buna abagaambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda, abanto b’Ekironi nababe buna Abayebusi.

English: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.
Kiswahili: Lakini nitailinda nyumba yangu dhidi ya majeshi ya wanyangʼanyi. Kamwe mdhalimu hatashambulia watu wangu tena, kwa maana sasa ninawachunga.
Ekegusii: Erio inche Omonene nindende enyomba yane, erinde abarwani b’esegi tibaabaisa goeterao gose koiranerao; na abachandi b’abaanto baane tibaabaisa gochao, ekiagera bono inche ninyerigererie namaiso aane.

English: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
Kiswahili: Shangilia sana, ee Binti Sayuni! Piga kelele, Binti Yerusalemu! Tazama, Mfalme wako anakuja kwako, ni mwenye haki, naye ana wokovu, ni mpole, naye amepanda punda, mwana-punda, mtoto wa punda.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni goka mono! Ee, inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, aka eriogi ri’omochengo! Rora, omorwoti oino nkobacheera are; ere nomonyene oboronge na Omobui. Nigo are omokanyeku oriinete etigere, ee, oriinete emori y’etigere, akamori g’etigere.

English: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
Kiswahili: Nitaondoa magari ya vita kutoka Efraimu na farasi wa vita kutoka Yerusalemu, nao upinde wa vita utavunjwa. Atatangaza amani kwa mataifa. Utawala wake utaenea kutoka bahari hadi bahari, na kutoka Mto Frati hadi mwisho wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Ninsirie chigari chi’esegi korwa ase abanto ba Efraimu, ne chibarasi chi’esegi korwa Yerusalemu. Ninsirie na amata ’esegi. Omorwoti oyio naraarerie abanto b’ebisaku omorembe. Obogambi bwaye nabobe korwa enyancha eyemo goika eyende, na korwa ase Orooche rwa Eufarati goika ase chinsinyo chi’ense.

English: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.
Kiswahili: Kwako wewe, kwa sababu ya damu ya Agano langu nawe, nitawaacha huru wafungwa wako watoke kwenye shimo lisilo na maji.
Ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’amanyinga ’okobwatana okwo nakorire naye ninsibore abasibwa bao, mbarusie ase engoro etari namaache.

English: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
Kiswahili: Rudieni ngome yenu, enyi wafungwa wa tumaini; hata sasa ninatangaza kwamba nitawarejesheeni maradufu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abasibwa more nogosemeria, irana ase eburi yaino. Ase rituko ria reero nigo nkobaraareria inwe ng’a nimbae amaya ara kabere.

English: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
Kiswahili: Nitampinda Yuda kama nipindavyo upinde wangu, nitamfanya Efraimu mshale wangu. Nitawainua wana wako, ee Sayuni, dhidi ya wana wako, ee Uyunani, na kukufanya kama upanga wa shujaa wa vita.
Ekegusii: Nakumbire Abayuda buna nkumbete obota bwane, naagirie Abaefraimu buna ensara ng’agetie ase obota bwane. Aye Sayoni, ninkore abana bao abamura babe buna amatimo, barwanerie abamura b’Abagiriki; ningokore obe buna omoro bw’omorwani esegi etuoni.”

English: Yahweh will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
Kiswahili: Kisha Bwana atawatokea; mshale wake utamulika kama umeme wa radi. Bwana Mwenyezi atapiga tarumbeta, naye atatembea katika tufani za kusini,
Ekegusii: Omonene naoroke igoro y’abanto baye, ne chinsara chiaye chisoke buna okomesa gw’enkoba. Omonene nabugie egetureeri, achiche nekembugu‐mbugu gekorwa Irianyi.

English: Yahweh of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.
Kiswahili: na Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atawalinda. Wataangamiza na kushinda kwa mawe ya kutupa kwa kombeo. Watakunywa na kunguruma kama waliolewa mvinyo; watajaa kama bakuli linalotumika kunyunyizia kwenye pembe za madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nakengere abanto baye, barabwo mbasirie ababisa babo, batiringe amagena e chinduruche chiabo. Mbanywe batinde, baake amariogi, babe buna abanto batindire edivai. Mbaichorigwe buna ebitaabo bi’amanyinga ’ebing’wanso, na babe buna chikoona chi’egesasiimero chiichire amanyinga.

English: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mungu wao atawaokoa siku hiyo kama kundi la watu wake. Watangʼara katika nchi yake kama vito vya thamani kwenye taji.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riri’Omonene, Nyasae obo, nabatoorie, ekiagera nigo bare abanto be riicho riaye. Barabwo nigo bare buna amagena e rigori rinene abekire ase egutwa, akomeka‐meka na komoreka ase ense yaye.

English: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
Kiswahili: Jinsi gani watavutia na kuwa wazuri! Nafaka itawastawisha vijana wanaume, nayo divai mpya vijana wanawake.
Ekegusii: Ee, naki obuya bwaye na obosiani bwaye bore bw’ogokumia! Endagera yaye nenorie abamura baye bagirigente, na edivai yaye enyia nenorie abaiseke baye bagirigente.
