Kiswahili: Mfalme Herode aliposikia jambo hili aliingiwa na hofu sana pamoja na watu wote wa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Herode achia koigwa aya ere agaichana mono, nabo igo kera omonto ime ya Yerusalemu.

English: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
Kiswahili: Herode akawaita pamoja viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria, akawauliza ni mahali gani ambapo Kristo angezaliwa.
Ekegusii: Ere akabarangeria amo abakuani abanene bonsi amo n’aborokia b’amachiiko akababoria, “Narai gose Kristo araiborerwe?”

English: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
Kiswahili: Nao wakamwambia, “Katika Bethlehemu ya Uyahudi, kwa maana hivyo ndivyo ilivyoandikwa na nabii:
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria. Ase omochie o Bethlehemu ime ya Boyahudi, ekiagera aya naro omobani ariigete:

English: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nawe, Bethlehemu, katika nchi ya Yuda, wewe si mdogo miongoni mwa watawala wa Yuda; kwa maana kutoka kwako atakuja mtawala atakayekuwa mchungaji wa watu wangu Israeli.’ ”
Ekegusii: ’Bethlehemu ase ense ya Yuda, ase enchera ende yonsi aye tori moke ase egati y’emechie emenene ya Yuda; ekiagera korwa ime yao nache omorai oyio orarae abanto baane ba Israeli.

English: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Herode akawaita wale wataalamu wa nyota kwa siri na kutaka kujua kutoka kwao uhakika kamili wa wakati ile nyota ilionekana.
Ekegusii: Erio Herode akarangeria abageni baria barwete moocha agatwara okoumerana kwa bobisi nabarabwo, erio akamanya korwa ase bare kegima chingaki eng’enang’eni eria yarorekanete.

English: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akawatuma waende Bethlehemu akiwaambia, “Nendeni mkamtafute kwa bidii huyo mtoto. Nanyi mara mtakapomwona, mniletee habari ili na mimi niweze kwenda kumwabudu.”
Ekegusii: Akabatoma goika Bethlehemu, n’amang’ana akobwatia: “Genda morigie buya omwana oyio, ekero moramonyore ere, nainche momanyie, erio nainche boigo ingende komosasiima ere.”

English: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumsikia mfalme, wale wataalamu wa nyota wakaenda zao, nayo ile nyota waliyoiona mashariki ikawatangulia, nao wakaifuata mpaka iliposimama mahali pale alipokuwa mtoto.
Ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo bakarwa aroro, kobare nchera kogenda bakarora naende eng’enang’eni eria eria baroche ase ensemo ya moocha. Ekero barabwo bayeroche omogoko obo okabucha, inaki omogoko obo obete omonge! Ekabatang’ana, goika egatenena igoro aase omwana oria arenge.

English: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
Kiswahili: Walipoiona ile nyota wakajawa na furaha kubwa mno.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda bagasoa nyomba, bakarora omwana amo na Mariamu ng’ina, bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasiima. Erio bagakuunora chinibo chiabo, bakamokwaneria ebinto ebiya, etaabu, na ubani, na manemane.

English: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
Kiswahili: Walipoingia ndani ya ile nyumba, wakamwona mtoto pamoja na Maria mama yake, wakamsujudu na kumwabudu yule mtoto Yesu. Ndipo wakafungua hazina zao, wakamtolea zawadi za dhahabu, uvumba na manemane.
Ekegusii: Erio bakairana gochia soobo bakabwatia enchera eng’ao ekiagera Nyasae konya obakuureire ase chindoto nga tibairanera ase Herode.

English: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
Kiswahili: Nao wakiisha kuonywa katika ndoto wasirudi kwa Herode, wakarudi kwenda katika nchi yao kwa njia nyingine.
Ekegusii: Magega k’abageni baria bachiire, omomalaika bw’Omonene akaorokera Yusufu ase chindoto, akamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aa, oire omwana na ng’ina, otame gochia Misiri, omenye aroro goika ngoteebie, ekiagera Herode narigie omwana oyo anyare komoita.”

English: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kwenda zao, malaika wa Bwana akamtokea Yosefu katika ndoto akamwambia, “Ondoka, mchukue mtoto na mama yake mkimbilie Misri. Kaeni huko mpaka nitakapowaambia, kwa maana Herode anataka kumtafuta huyu mtoto ili amuue.”
Ekegusii: Ere akaimoka botuko, akaira omwana oria na ng’ina, akagenda Misiri,

English: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,
Kiswahili: Kisha Yosefu akaondoka, akamchukua mtoto pamoja na mama yake wakati wa usiku, nao wakaenda Misri
Ekegusii: akamenya aroro goika Herode agakwa, erinde rinyare goikerana eriateebetwe n’Omonene ase omonwa bw’omobani, “Korwa Misiri nkarangeria omwana one.”

English: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”
Kiswahili: ambako walikaa mpaka Herode alipofariki. Hili lilifanyika ili litimie lile lililonenwa na Bwana kwa kinywa cha nabii kusema: “Nilimwita mwanangu kutoka Misri.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Herode achia korora ng’a ochaayirwe n’ abaringoria baria b’eching’enang’eni, akaba nekeririanda ekenene mono, agatoma abanto goita abana abaisia bonsi abarenge Bethlehemu ne chinsemo chiaye chionsi, abwo barenge inse y’emiaka ebere, koreng’ana n’ekero keria atebetigwe n’abanto baria abang’aini.

English: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.
Kiswahili: Herode alipongʼamua kwamba wale wataalamu wa nyota wamemshinda kwa akili, alikasirika sana, naye akatoa amri ya kuwaua watoto wote wa kiume wenye umri wa miaka miwili kurudi chini katika mji wa Bethlehemu na sehemu zote za jirani, kufuatana na ule muda alioambiwa na wale wataalamu wa nyota.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio rigaikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia,

English: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo lilipotimia neno lililonenwa na nabii Yeremia.
Ekegusii: “Eriogi riaigurwe Rama, okorera na okweumia. Raeli nkoreera are abana baye, tancheti akirigwe, ekiagera bonsi bakuure.”

English: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”
Kiswahili: “Sauti ilisikika huko Rama, maombolezo na kilio kikubwa, Raheli akilia kwa ajili ya wanawe, akikataa kufarijiwa, kwa sababu hawako tena.”
Ekegusii: Magega Herode gakuure, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera Yusufu aria Misiri ase chindoto, akamoteebia,

English: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
Kiswahili: Baada ya Herode kufa, malaika wa Bwana akamtokea Yosefu katika ndoto huko Misri
Ekegusii: “Imoka, oire omwana na ng’ina, mogende ase ense ya Israeli, ekiagera baria barenge korigia obogima bw’omwana bakuure.”

English: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”
Kiswahili: na kusema, “Ondoka, mchukue mtoto na mama yake mwende, mrudi katika nchi ya Israeli kwa sababu wale waliokuwa wanatafuta uhai wa mtoto wamekufa.”
Ekegusii: Akaimoka, akaira omwana amo na ng’ina, akagenda ase ense ya Israeli.

English: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
Kiswahili: Basi Yosefu, akaondoka akamchukua mtoto na mama yake wakaenda mpaka nchi ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende agachia koigwa ng’a Arikelau obekirwe oborwoti Boyahudi ase ribaga ria Herode ise, akairoka kogenda aroro, korende erio gakuureirwe na Nyasae ase okorota, akagenda ensemo ya Galili.

English: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,
Kiswahili: Lakini aliposikia kwamba Arkelao alikuwa anatawala huko Uyahudi mahali pa Herode baba yake, aliogopa kwenda huko. Naye akiisha kuonywa katika ndoto, akaenda zake sehemu za Galilaya,
Ekegusii: Akagenda, akamenya omochie oyomo okorokwa Nazareti, rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nababani, “Igo ararokwe Omonazareti.”

English: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
Kiswahili: Siku hizo Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja akihubiri katika nyika ya Uyahudi, akisema,
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro ya Boyahudi agachaaka korandia, ogoteeba,

English: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
Kiswahili: “Tubuni, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.”
Ekegusii: “Onchoka, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e!”

English: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye yule aliyenenwa habari zake na nabii Isaya aliposema: “Sauti ya mtu aliaye huko nyikani, ‘Tayarisheni njia kwa ajili ya Bwana, yanyoosheni mapito yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Oyo Yohana nere oteebetwe n’omobani Isaya, ekero ateebete, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.”

English: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
Kiswahili: Basi Yohana alivaa mavazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa singa za ngamia, akiwa na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni mwake. Chakula chake kilikuwa nzige na asali ya mwitu.
Ekegusii: Ere Yohana nigo arenge kobeeka chianga chiaroiseirie amarionya y’engamia na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenama kiaye, na endagera yaye nigo yarenge chingige na obooke bw’orosana.

English: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.
Kiswahili: Watu walikuwa wakimwendea kutoka Yerusalemu, Uyahudi yote na nchi zote za kandokando ya Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto ba Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi yonsi, ne chinsemo chionsi chia Yorodani bakamochiera.

English: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
Kiswahili: Nao wakaziungama dhambi zao, akawabatiza katika Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Bakangama ebibe biabo erio bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodani.

English: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
Kiswahili: Lakini alipowaona Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wengi wakija ili kubatizwa, aliwaambia: “Ninyi watoto wa nyoka! Ni nani aliyewaonya kuikimbia ghadhabu inayokuja?
Ekegusii: Ekero Yohana arora abanto abange ase Abafarisai na Abasadukai bakomochiera erio ababatise, akabateebia, “Inwe oroiboro rwe chinchoka, ning’o obakuureire ng’a motame korwa ase endamwamu egochia‐gocha?

English: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
Kiswahili: Basi zaeni matunda yastahiliyo toba.
Ekegusii: Gaki, orokia ase ebikorwa buna ekeene mwaonchokire;

English: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
Kiswahili: Wala msidhani mnaweza kusema mioyoni mwenu kuwa, ‘Sisi tunaye Abrahamu, baba yetu.’ Nawaambia kuwa Mungu anaweza kumwinulia Abrahamu watoto kutoka kwa mawe haya.
Ekegusii: gose timona goteeba ase emioyo yaino ime: Ntore na sokoro yaito Aburaamu, ekiagera nabateebirie, ng’a Nyasae n’are nokobua ase amagena aya gokorera Aburaamu abana.

English: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
Kiswahili: Hata sasa shoka limeshawekwa tayari kwenye shina la kila mti, basi kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri, hukatwa na kutupwa motoni.
Ekegusii: Nonya mbono egesire kiabekirwe ase emeri y’emete; nabo kera omote otaameti okwama okuya nonachwe, otugutwe ase omorero.

English: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: “Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji kwa ajili ya toba. Lakini nyuma yangu anakuja yeye aliye na uwezo kuliko mimi, ambaye sistahili hata kuvichukua viatu vyake. Yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu na kwa moto.
Ekegusii: “Inche n’amaache nkobabatisera ase okoonchoka, korende ere, oyoraache magega y’ane, nare ne chinguru kombua. Ting’isaini koimokia ebikoroto biaye. N’ere orababatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.

English: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”
Kiswahili: Pepeto lake liko mkononi mwake, naye atasafisha sakafu yake ya kupuria, na kuikusanya ngano ghalani na kuyateketeza makapi kwa moto usiozimika.”
Ekegusii: Oroteru rw’aye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kia’ye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiruro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.”

English: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akaja kutoka Galilaya mpaka Mto Yordani ili Yohana ambatize.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio Yeso akarua Galili, akagenda ase Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodani abatiswe nere.

English: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yohana akajitahidi kumzuia, akimwambia, “Mimi ninahitaji kubatizwa na wewe, nawe waja kwangu nikubatize?”
Ekegusii: Korende Yohana akarigia kwanga, agateeba, “Inche ndigetie kobatiswa naye, na aye kogocha ase ’nde?”

English: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akamjibu, “Kubali hivi sasa, kwa maana ndivyo itupasavyo kwa njia hii kuitimiza haki yote.” Hivyo Yohana akakubali.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ancha ebe iga bono, ekiagera naboigo etogwenerete goikerania oboronge bwonsi.” Erio agwo Yohana akamwanchera.

English: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.
Kiswahili: Naye Yesu alipokwisha kubatizwa, mara alipotoka ndani ya maji, ghafula mbingu zikafunguka, akamwona Roho wa Mungu akishuka kama hua na kutulia juu yake.
Ekegusii: Na Yeso, ekero abatisirwe, agendererete gotiira korwa ase amaache ime; igoro ekamaanoka, na ere akarora Omoika o Nyasae ogoika buna riruma, ogocha igoro ase are.

English: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
Kiswahili: Nayo sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa, ambaye ninapendezwa sana naye.”
Ekegusii: Na rora, eriogi rikarwa igoro rigateeba, “Oyo nere Omwana one omwanchwa, oyio ngokirie nere.”

English: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akaongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu kwenda nyikani ili akajaribiwe na ibilisi.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akaragwa n’Omoika gochia ase erooro gochia goteemwa na Saitani.

English: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kufunga siku arobaini usiku na mchana, hatimaye akaona njaa.
Ekegusii: Akeng’ata ase egeka ki’amatuko emerongo ene, obotuko n’omobaso. Magega ase aya, enchara ekamoria.

English: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”
Kiswahili: Mjaribu akamjia na kumwambia, “Ikiwa wewe ndiye Mwana wa Mungu, amuru mawe haya yawe mikate.”
Ekegusii: Omoteemi agacha, akamoteebia, “Onye aye kore Omwana o Nyasae, teebia amagena aya abe omogati.”

English: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akajibu, “Imeandikwa: ‘Mtu haishi kwa mkate tu, ila kwa kila neno litokalo katika kinywa cha Mungu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akairaneria, “Neriikire: Omonto takomenya ase omogati bwoka, korende ase kera ring’ana rikorwa ase omonwa o Nyasae.”

English: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
Kiswahili: Ndipo ibilisi akamchukua Yesu mpaka mji mtakatifu na kumweka juu ya mnara mrefu wa Hekalu,
Ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamoira goika Yerusalemu omochie omochenu, akamobeka igoro ase egechuuria egetambe mono gie Hekalu.

English: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”
Kiswahili: akamwambia, “Kama wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu jitupe chini. Kwa kuwa imeandikwa: “ ‘Atakuagizia malaika zake, nao watakuchukua mikononi mwao ili usije ukajikwaa mguu wako katika jiwe.’ ”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, Onye aye kore Omwana o Nyasae, etugute gochia inse, ekiagera neriikire Nyasae nagochiikere abamalaika baye bakorende, na barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.

English: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Pia imeandikwa: ‘Usimjaribu Bwana Mungu wako.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Naende neriikire Toteema Omonene Nyasae oo.”

English: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
Kiswahili: Kwa mara nyingine, ibilisi akamchukua Yesu mpaka kwenye kilele cha mlima mrefu na kumwonyesha falme zote za dunia na fahari zake,
Ekegusii: Naende Saitani akamoira ase ekegoro egetambe mono, akamworokia amarwoti onsi y’ense, na obonene bwabo,

English: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
Kiswahili: kisha akamwambia, “Nitakupa hivi vyote kama ukinisujudia na kuniabudu.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Ebi bionsi ninkoe, koratung’amere onsasiime.”

English: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Ondoka mbele yangu, Shetani! Kwa maana imeandikwa, ‘Mwabudu Bwana Mungu wako, na umtumikie yeye peke yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoteebia, Karue aa, Saitani! Ekiagera neriikire, “Osasiime Omonene Nyasae oo, omokorere ere bweka.”

English: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo ibilisi akamwacha, nao malaika wakaja na kumhudumia.
Ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamotiga, na rora, abamalaika bagaacha, bakamokorera.

English: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia kwamba Yohana Mbatizaji alikuwa ametiwa gerezani, alirudi Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koigwa ng’a Yohana osibirwe echela, akaimoka, akagenda Galili.

English: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
Kiswahili: Akaondoka Nazareti akaenda kuishi Kapernaumu, mji ulioko karibu na bahari, katika mipaka ya nchi ya Zabuloni na Naftali,
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Nazareti, akagenda, akamenya Kapernaumu, omochie ore ang’e n’enyancha ase chimbebe chia Sabuloni na Nafutali,

English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
Kiswahili: ili kutimiza unabii wa nabii Isaya, kama alivyosema:
Ekegusii: rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya,

English: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
Kiswahili: “Nchi ya Zabuloni na nchi ya Naftali, kwenye njia ya kuelekea baharini, ngʼambo ya Yordani, Galilaya ya watu wa Mataifa:
Ekegusii: “Ense ya Sabuloni na ense ya Nafutali, enchera egochia enyancha ng’umbu ya Yorodani, Galili, ense y’ abanto b’Ebisaku,

English: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
Kiswahili: watu wale waliokaa gizani wameona nuru kuu; nao wale walioishi katika nchi ya uvuli wa mauti, nuru imewazukia.”
Ekegusii: abanto abamenyete omosunte ime, barorire omobaso omonene, na abamenyete ensemo y’ekiriri ki’amakweri, omobaso obabareire.”

English: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati huo, Yesu alianza kuhubiri akisema: “Tubuni, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.”
Ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio Yeso agachaaka korandia, ogoteeba, “Onchoka, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e.”

English: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa anatembea kando ya Bahari ya Galilaya, aliwaona ndugu wawili, Simoni aitwaye Petro, na Andrea ndugu yake. Walikuwa wakizitupa nyavu zao baharini kwa kuwa wao walikuwa wavuvi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso arenge gotaara ase engegu y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora abamura babere bamwabo abwo barenge abarubi, Simioni (oyokorokwa Petero), na Anderea omwabo, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, erio barube chinswe.

English: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Njooni, nifuateni nami nitawafanya mwe wavuvi wa watu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo montuny’ane na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’abaanto.”

English: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
Kiswahili: Mara wakaziacha nyavu zao, wakamfuata.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo kegima bagatiga ebionga biabo, bakamotunyana.

English: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
Kiswahili: Alipoendelea mbele kutoka pale, akawaona ndugu wengine wawili, Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo na Yohana nduguye, wakiwa wamekaa kwenye mashua pamoja na baba yao Zebedayo, wakizitengeneza nyavu zao. Yesu akawaita.
Ekegusii: Erio akagenda gochia motwe korwa aroro, akarora abamura babere bande bamwabo, Yakobo omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana omwabo, barenge obwato ime amo na Zebedi ise bakoroisia ebionga biabo, na barabwo akabarangeria.

English: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
Kiswahili: Nao mara wakaiacha mashua yao, pamoja na baba yao, wakamfuata.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima bagatiga obwato boria, bagatiga na ise, bakamotunyana.

English: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
Kiswahili: Yesu akapita katika Galilaya yote, akifundisha katika masinagogi yao, akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme, na akiponya kila ugonjwa na kila aina ya maradhi miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Yeso nigo arenge kona goetanana ase ense engima ya Galili, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang’ana amaya y’oborwoti, okogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi obwarenge ase abanto.

English: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sifa zake zikaenea sehemu zote za Shamu, nao watu wakamletea wote waliokuwa na magonjwa mbalimbali na maumivu, waliopagawa na pepo wachafu, wenye kifafa na waliopooza, naye akawaponya.
Ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Siiria; bakamorentera abarwaire bonsi ababwatire namarwaire ao ao, y’obosareru, na ababwatire n’ebirecha, na abaare ne chindurume, na abarenge amagata, akabagwenia.

English: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
Kiswahili: Makutano makubwa ya watu yakawa yanamjia kutoka Galilaya, Dekapoli, Yerusalemu, Uyahudi na kutoka ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Emeganda emenge ekamotunyana korwa Galili, na Dekapoli, na Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi, na ng’umbu ya Yorodani.

English: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu alipoona makutano, alipanda mlimani akaketi chini, nao wanafunzi wake wakamjia.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora emeganda eria y’abanto, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro; na ekero aikaransire, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera.

English: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo akaanza kuwafundisha, akisema:
Ekegusii: Agachaaka koborokereria, ogoteeba.

English: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
Kiswahili: “Heri walio maskini wa roho, maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni wao.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare abataka ase omoika, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro nobwabo.

English: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Kiswahili: Heri wale wanaohuzunika, maana hao watafarijiwa.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abaichanete, ekiagera inabaache koremigwa.

English: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
Kiswahili: Heri walio wapole, maana hao watairithi nchi.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare noboitongo, ekiagera barabwo ’nabaire omwando bw’ense.

English: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
Kiswahili: Heri wenye njaa na kiu ya haki, maana hao watatoshelezwa.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare nenchara na erang’o y’okonyora okogania kwa Nyasae, ekiagera barabwo ’nabaigotigwe.

English: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
Kiswahili: Heri wenye huruma, maana hao watapata rehema.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abakororera abande amaabera, ekiagera barabwo ’nabarorerwe amaabera.

English: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
Kiswahili: Heri walio na moyo safi, maana hao watamwona Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare abachenu ase chinkoro, ekiagera barabwo ’nabarore Nyasae.

English: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
Kiswahili: Heri walio wapatanishi, maana hao wataitwa wana wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abagokora omorembe, ekiagera barabwo ’nabarokwe abana ba Nyasae.

English: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
Kiswahili: Heri wanaoteswa kwa sababu ya haki, maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni wao.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abagochandwa ase engencho y’oboronge, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro nobwabo.

English: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
Kiswahili: “Heri ninyi watu watakapowashutumu, na kuwatesa na kunena dhidi yenu mabaya ya aina zote kwa uongo kwa ajili yangu.
Ekegusii: Imosesenirie inwe, ekero abanto bakobarama na kobachaanda, na kobateebera kera ring’ana riibe ase oborimo, ase engencho y’ane.

English: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
Kiswahili: Furahini na kushangilia kwa maana thawabu yenu ni kubwa mbinguni, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo walivyowatesa manabii waliokuwa kabla yenu.
Ekegusii: Goka na gochenga, ekiagera eng’eria yaino n’enene igoro. Inaki naboigo bachaandete ababani abarengeo ritang’ani konya motarabao.

English: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
Kiswahili: “Ninyi ni chumvi ya ulimwengu. Lakini chumvi ikipoteza ladha yake, yawezaje kurudishiwa ladha yake tena? Haifai tena kwa kitu chochote, ila kutupwa nje ikanyagwe na watu.
Ekegusii: Inwe nomonyoo bw’ense; korende omoonyo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki orabekwe bwanse? Togwenereti gento kende otatiga ogotugutwa isiko, otirindachwe n’abanto.

English: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
Kiswahili: “Ninyi ni nuru ya ulimwengu. Mji uliojengwa kilimani hauwezi kufichika.
Ekegusii: Inwe noborabu bw’ense. Omochie tokobiseka koagachire ase egetunwa igoro.

English: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
Kiswahili: Wala watu hawawashi taa na kuifunika kwa bakuli. Badala yake, huiweka kwenye kinara chake, nayo hutoa mwanga kwa kila mtu aliyemo ndani ya ile nyumba.
Ekegusii: Nonya n’abanto tibagotongia etaya na koyemumeka negetonga, korende nigo bakoyebeeka igoro ase egetangora, ebae oborabu bonsi abare nyomba ime.

English: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, nuru yenu iangaze mbele ya watu, ili wapate kuona matendo yenu mema wamtukuze Baba yenu aliye mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio eyio, tiga omobaso oino obare boigo ase abanto, erio barore emeremo yaino emiya, batogie Iso oino ore igoro.

English: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
Kiswahili: “Msidhani kwamba nimekuja kufuta Sheria au Manabii; sikuja kuondoa bali kutimiza.
Ekegusii: Timokaga ng’a nigo nachire gosaria amachiiko, gose amang’ana y’ababani; tincheti kobisaria, korende ase okobiikerania.

English: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, amin nawaambia, mpaka mbingu na dunia zitakapopita, hakuna hata herufi moja ndogo wala nukta itakayopotea kwa namna yoyote kutoka kwenye Sheria, mpaka kila kitu kiwe kimetimia.
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie ng’a, goika igoro na ense biete, korende tegoeta enuguta eyemo gose agatone akamo ase amachiiko, goika bionsi biikerane.

English: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, yeyote atakayevunja mojawapo ya amri ndogo kuliko zote ya amri hizi, naye akawafundisha wengine kufanya hivyo, ataitwa mdogo kabisa katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni, lakini yeyote azitendaye na kuzifundisha hizi amri ataitwa mkuu katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ase igo monto onde bwensi orasarie richiiko erimo erire rike ase amachiiko aya, na kworokereria abanto kogosaria okwo, oyio narokwe omoke mono ase oborwoti bwa igoro, korende oyorayakore na koyorokereria, oyio nere orarokwe omonene ase oborwoti bwa igoro.

English: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, haki yenu isipozidi haki ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria, kamwe hamtaingia katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Inaki nabateebirie inwe, onye oboronge bwaino tibokobua obw’aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, timogosoa nonya ng’ake ase oborwoti bwa igoro.

English: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’
Kiswahili: “Mmesikia walivyoambiwa watu wa zamani kwamba, ‘Usiue. Yeyote atakayeua atapaswa hukumu.’
Ekegusii: Mwaigwete ng’a abanto ba kare ’mbateebetigwe: Toita; na oyoraite nabe omonto okonacherwa ekiina.

English: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia kwamba, yeyote atakayemkasirikia ndugu yake, atapaswa hukumu. Tena, yeyote atakayemwambia ndugu yake, ‘Raka,’atapaswa kujibu kwa Baraza la Wayahudi.Lakini yeyote atakayesema ‘Wewe mpumbavu!’ atapaswa hukumu ya moto wa jehanamu.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie ng’a onde bwensi orageeche oyomwabo, nabe omonto okonacherwa ekiina, na oyoramogorere oyomwabo nabe omonto okoirwa ase ekegaambero, na oyoramoroke oyonde Omoriri! Nagwenere omorero o kare na kare.

English: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, kama unatoa sadaka yako madhabahuni, ukakumbuka kuwa ndugu yako ana kitu dhidi yako,
Ekegusii: Nabo gokorenta okorua kwao ase egesasiimero, korainyore ng’a oyomino nare ne ring’ana ase ore,

English: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
Kiswahili: iache sadaka yako hapo mbele ya madhabahu. Enda kwanza ukapatane na ndugu yako; kisha urudi na ukatoe sadaka yako.
Ekegusii: otige okorwa kwao agwo ase egesasiimero, ogende ritang’ani mwanchane noyomino, erio oirane ase okorua kwao.

English: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
Kiswahili: “Patana na mshtaki wako upesi wakati uwapo njiani pamoja naye kwenda mahakamani, ili mshtaki wako asije akakutia mikononi mwa hakimu, naye hakimu akakutia mikononi mwa askari, nawe ukatupwa gerezani.
Ekegusii: Bwatana nomosoeri oo bwango, ekero more nere inchera gochia ase ekegaambero, erinde omosoeri oo tabaisa gokobeeka ase okoboko kw’omogaambi, na omogambi akobeke ase omorendi bw’echela, naye norutwe ime yechela.

English: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.
Kiswahili: Amin, nakuambia, hautatoka humo hadi uwe umelipa senti ya mwisho.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nagoteebirie: Tokorwa aroro nonya ng’ake goika oakane ebesa y’omoerio.

English: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
Kiswahili: “Mmesikia kwamba ilinenwa, ‘Usizini.’
Ekegusii: Mwaigwete ng’a ndiateebetwe: Totomana.

English: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia kwamba, yeyote amtazamaye mwanamke kwa kumtamani, amekwisha kuzini naye moyoni mwake.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie, ng’a onde bwensi orarigererie omokungu na korengereria gotomana nere otomanire nere ime ase enkoro yaye.

English: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
Kiswahili: Jicho lako la kuume likikusababisha kutenda dhambi, lingʼoe ulitupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kupoteza kiungo kimoja cha mwili wako kuliko mwili wako mzima ukatupwa jehanamu.
Ekegusii: Onye eriiso riao ria borio rikogera okore ebibe, rirusie, oritugute are, ekiagera mbuya ase ore ekiimo kiao ekemo gesire, kobua omobere oo omogima gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.

English: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
Kiswahili: Kama mkono wako wa kuume ukikusababisha kutenda dhambi, ukate, uutupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kupoteza kiungo kimoja cha mwili wako kuliko mwili wako mzima utupwe jehanamu.
Ekegusii: Onye nokoboko kwao gw’okorio gokogera okore ebibe, konache, ogotugute are, ekiagera mbuya ase ore ekiimo kiao ekemo gesire, kobua omobere oo omogima gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.

English: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
Kiswahili: “Pia ilinenwa kwamba, ‘Mtu yeyote amwachaye mkewe sharti ampe hati ya talaka.’
Ekegusii: Naende ndiateebetwe; Oyoratige mok’aye, tiga amoe riruube ri’ogotigana.

English: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia, yeyote amwachaye mkewe isipokuwa kwa kosa la uasherati, amfanya mkewe kuwa mzinzi. Na yeyote amwoaye yule mwanamke aliyeachwa, anazini.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie, ng’a onde bwensi oratige mok’aye, otatiga ase engencho y’obotomani, ogerire abe omotomani; na oyoramonyuome oyotigirwe, oyio otomanire.

English: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
Kiswahili: “Tena mmesikia walivyoambiwa watu wa zamani kwamba, ‘Usiape kwa uongo, bali timiza kiapo kile ulichofanya kwa Bwana.’
Ekegusii: Naende mwaigwete ng’a abanto ba kare mbateebetigwe: Totiana bosa, korende oikeranerie ase Omonene chiira chiao.

English: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia, msiape kabisa: iwe kwa mbingu, kwa kuwa ni kiti cha enzi cha Mungu;
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie: Totiana ase egento kende gionsi; nonya nase igoro, ekiagera nao ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae;

English: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
Kiswahili: au kwa dunia, kwa kuwa ndipo mahali pake pa kuwekea miguu; au kwa Yerusalemu, kwa kuwa ndio mji wa Mfalme Mkuu.
Ekegusii: gose ase ense, ekiagera nao ekerogo kiaye gi’okobekerera amagoro; gose ase Yerusalemu, ekiagera n’oro omochie bw’Omorwoti omonene.

English: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
Kiswahili: Nanyi msiape kwa vichwa vyenu, kwa kuwa hamwezi kuufanya hata unywele mmoja kuwa mweupe au mweusi.
Ekegusii: Na totiana ase omotwe oo, ekiagera tokonyara gokora agatukia akamo kabe akarabu gose akamwamu.

English: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
Kiswahili: ‘Ndiyo’ yenu iwe ‘Ndiyo,’ na ‘Hapana’ yenu iwe ‘Hapana.’ Lolote zaidi ya hili latoka kwa yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aino abe: Ee, gose: Yaaya; naki ayakomenteka ase aya, nigo akorwa ase oria omobe.

English: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
Kiswahili: “Mmesikia kwamba ilinenwa, ‘Jicho kwa jicho na jino kwa jino.’
Ekegusii: Mwaigwete ng’a ndiateebetwe: “Eriso ase eriiso, na erino ase erino.”

English: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia, msishindane na mtu mwovu. Lakini kama mtu akikupiga kwenye shavu la kuume, mgeuzie na la pili pia.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie: Timobaisa koamererania noyore omobe. Korende omonto karagoake orosea rwa borio, omoonchorere norw’okobee.

English: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akitaka kukushtaki na kuchukua joho lako, mwachie achukue na koti pia.
Ekegusii: Na omonto karigetie gokoira ase ekegambero kogosoera na koira eyanga yao ya ime, omotigere neya isiko boigo.

English: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akikulazimisha kwenda maili moja, nenda naye maili mbili.
Ekegusii: Na onye omonto ogokobetereria kogenda nere emaeli eyemo, genda nere goika chimaeli ibere.

English: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
Kiswahili: Mpe yeye akuombaye, wala usimgeuzie kisogo yeye atakaye kukukopa.
Ekegusii: Oyokogosaba, moe; na oyorigetie singo, tomorina.

English: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
Kiswahili: “Mmesikia kwamba ilinenwa, ‘Mpende jirani yako na umchukie adui yako.’
Ekegusii: Mwaigwete ng’a ndiateebetwe: “Ancha omogisangio oo, na ogeche omobisa oo.”

English: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
Kiswahili: Lakini ninawaambia: Wapendeni adui zenu na waombeeni wanaowatesa ninyi,
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie: Ancha ababisa baino, mobasabere abakobachanda,

English: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
Kiswahili: ili mpate kuwa watoto wa Baba yenu aliye mbinguni. Kwa maana yeye huwaangazia jua lake watu waovu na watu wema, naye huwanyeshea mvua wenye haki na wasio haki.
Ekegusii: nario moranyare koba abana ba Iso oino ore igoro, ekiagera ere nigo akobabareria omobaso oye ababe na abaya, obatweria embura abakori oboronge, na abatari gokora oboronge.

English: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
Kiswahili: Kama mkiwapenda tu wale wanaowapenda, mtapata thawabu gani? Je, hata watoza ushuru hawafanyi hivyo?
Ekegusii: Inaki komoranche abaabanchete inwe, ing’eria ki more nero? Inee! Nonya mbaria bakorusia ebango tibari gokora bo?

English: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
Kiswahili: Nanyi kama mkiwasalimu ndugu zenu tu, je, mnafanya nini zaidi ya wengine? Je, hata watu wasiomjua Mungu, hawafanyi hivyo?
Ekegusii: Na inwe komorakwanie abamino boka, mbuya ki mwakora kobua abande? Nonya n’abanto b’Ebisaku tibari gokora boigo?

English: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kuweni wakamilifu kama Baba yenu wa mbinguni alivyo mkamilifu.
Ekegusii: Gaki inwe mobe abaikeranu buna Iso oino ore igoro are omoikeranu.

English: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: “Angalieni msitende wema wenu mbele ya watu ili wawaone. Kwa maana mkifanya hivyo, hamna thawabu kutoka kwa Baba yenu aliye mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Mwerende timokora ogokora kwaino okuya ase amasio y’abanto, erinde mororwe nabarabwo, ekiagera komogookora ayio, timori neng’eria ya Iso oino ore igoro.

English: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo mnapowapa wahitaji, msipige panda mbele yenu kama wafanyavyo wanafiki katika masinagogi na mitaani, ili wasifiwe na watu. Amin nawaambia wao wamekwisha kupokea thawabu yao.
Ekegusii: Gaki gokorua ebiegwa, tobugia engoma, buna baria abang’ainereria bagokora ase chisinagogi na ase chinchera chinene chi’emechie, erinde batogigwe n’abanto. Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a barabwo banyorire eng’eria yabo.

English: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi mtoapo sadaka, fanyeni kwa siri, hata mkono wako wa kushoto usijue mkono wako wa kuume unachofanya,
Ekegusii: Korende aye, gokorua obokonyi gochia ase omotaka, kora ayio korende, nonya n’omosani oo oime tamanya ayio gwakora,

English: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
Kiswahili: ili sadaka yako iwe ni siri. Ndipo Baba yako wa mbinguni, yeye aonaye sirini atakupa thawabu kwa wazi.
Ekegusii: Obokonyi bwao bonyare koba bobisi; na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane.

English: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.
Kiswahili: “Nanyi msalipo, msiwe kama wanafiki, maana wao hupenda kusali wakiwa wamesimama katika masinagogi na kando ya barabara ili waonekane na watu. Amin nawaambia, wao wamekwisha kupata thawabu yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero mogosaba, timoba buna baria abang’ainereria; ekiagera barabwo nigo banchete gotenena na gosaba ase chisinagogi na ase amatabekania ye chinchera, banyare kororwa n’abanto. Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a banyorire eng’eria yabo.

English: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe unaposali, ingia chumbani mwako, funga mlango na umwombe Baba yako aliye sirini. Naye Baba yako aonaye sirini atakupa thawabu yako.
Ekegusii: Korende aye ekero ogosaba, soa nyomba mwao ime, osieke egesieri, omosabe Iso oo ore bobisi; na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane.

English: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mnaposali msiseme maneno kama wafanyavyo watu wasiomjua Mungu. Kwa maana wao hudhani kwamba watasikiwa kwa sababu ya wingi wa maneno yao.
Ekegusii: Ase ogosaba kwaino timokwana amang’ana amange abosa buna abanto b’Ebisaku; naki barabwo nigo bagokaga ng’a Nyasae nabaigwe ase obonge bw’amang’ana abo.

English: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
Kiswahili: Msiwe kama wao, kwa sababu Baba yenu anajua kile mnachohitaji kabla hamjamwomba.
Ekegusii: Gaki timoba omogwekano oyomo nabarabwo, ekiagera Iso oino namanyete aya moganetie, ritang’ani motaramosaba.

English: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
Kiswahili: “Hivi basi, ndivyo iwapasavyo kuomba: “ ‘Baba yetu uliye mbinguni, Jina lako litukuzwe.
Ekegusii: “Bono inwe nigo mogwenerete gosaba iga: Tata oito ore igoro, Erieta riao risikwe.

English: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
Kiswahili: Ufalme wako uje. Mapenzi yako yafanyike hapa duniani kama huko mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Oborwoti bwao boche, Ogwancha kwao gokoreke ense, Buna kogokoreka igoro.

English: Give us today our daily bread.
Kiswahili: Utupatie riziki yetu ya kila siku.
Ekegusii: Otoe intwe reero endagera yaito ya kera rituko.

English: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
Kiswahili: Utusamehe deni zetu, kama sisi nasi tulivyokwisha kuwasamehe wadeni wetu.
Ekegusii: Otwabere ebibe biaito, Buna intwe tokobaabera abagotokorera bobe.

English: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
Kiswahili: Usitutie majaribuni, bali utuokoe kutoka kwa yule mwovu kwa kuwa Ufalme ni wako, na nguvu, na utukufu, hata milele. Amen.’
Ekegusii: Totoira ase ogoteemwa, Korende ototoorie korwa ase oria omobe.

English: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama mkiwasamehe watu wengine wanapowakosea, Baba yenu wa mbinguni atawasamehe ninyi pia.
Ekegusii: Inaki inwe kamoraabere abanto ogosaria kwabo, naboigo na Iso oino ore igoro nabaabere inwe.

English: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
Kiswahili: Lakini msipowasamehe watu wengine makosa yao, naye Baba yenu hatawasamehe ninyi makosa yenu.
Ekegusii: Korende motaabereti abanto okomocha kwabo, na Iso oino takobaabera okomocha kwaino.

English: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
Kiswahili: “Mnapofunga, msiwe wenye huzuni kama wafanyavyo wanafiki. Maana wao hukunja nyuso zao ili kuwaonyesha wengine kwamba wamefunga. Amin, amin nawaambia wao wamekwisha kupata thawabu yao kamilifu.
Ekegusii: “Ekero mokweng’ata timokonyiria amasio aino buna abang’ainereria, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakonyiria amasio abo, erinde banyare kororwa n’abanto ng’a mbeng’atete. Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a banyorire eng’eria yabo.

English: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
Kiswahili: Lakini mnapofunga, jipakeni mafuta kichwani na kunawa nyuso zenu
Ekegusii: Korende aye, gokweng’ata, eake amaguta omotwe oo, bwesibie obosio bwao,

English: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
Kiswahili: ili kufunga kwenu kusionekane na watu wengine ila Baba yenu aketiye mahali pa siri; naye Baba yenu aonaye sirini atawapa thawabu yenu kwa wazi.
Ekegusii: erio tobaisa kororwa n’abanto ng’a mbweng’atete, korende ororekane ase Iso oo ore bobisi, na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane.

English: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;
Kiswahili: “Msijiwekee hazina duniani, mahali ambapo nondo na kutu huharibu, nao wevi huvunja na kuiba.
Ekegusii: “Timogacha chinibo chiaino ase ense, aase ebigwankwa na oboboosu bigosaria, na abaibi bagotaagora na koiba;

English: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;
Kiswahili: Lakini jiwekeeni hazina mbinguni, mahali ambapo nondo na kutu haviharibu, wala wevi hawavunji na kuiba.
Ekegusii: korende mogache chinibo chiaino igoro, aase ebigwankwa na oboboosu bitagosoa, na abaibi batagotaagora na koiba.

English: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu mahali hazina yako ilipo, hapo ndipo pia moyo wako utakapokuwa.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera aase enibo yao ere, nao nenkoro yao ekoba.

English: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
Kiswahili: “Jicho ni taa ya mwili. Kama jicho lako ni nyofu, mwili wako wote utajaa nuru.
Ekegusii: “Etaya y’omobere n’eriiso. Nabo onye eriiso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi noichorwe noborabu;

English: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
Kiswahili: Lakini kama jicho lako ni ovu, mwili wako wote utajawa na giza. Kwa hiyo basi, kama nuru iliyomo ndani yako ni giza, hilo ni giza kuu namna gani!
Ekegusii: korende onye eriiso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi noichorwe nomosunte. Onye oborabu boria bore ime yao bwabeire omosunte, omosunte oyio nomonene mono.

English: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mtu awezaye kuwatumikia mabwana wawili. Kwa kuwa atamchukia huyu na kumpenda yule mwingine, au atashikamana sana na huyu na kumdharau yule mwingine. Hamwezi kumtumikia Mungu pamoja na Mali.
Ekegusii: “Onde tari oranyare gokorera abanene babere, ekiagera nageche oyomo, na anche oyonde, gose nabwatane noyomo, na achaaye oyonde. Timokonyara gokorera Nyasae na enibo.

English: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia, msisumbukie maisha yenu kwamba mtakula nini au mtakunywa nini; au msumbukie miili yenu kwamba mtavaa nini. Je, maisha si zaidi ya chakula, na mwili zaidi ya mavazi?
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio nabateebirie ng’a timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie, gose eki moranywe, gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeeke. Inee! Obogima tibori obonene kobua endagera? Na omobere tori omonene kobua chianga?

English: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
Kiswahili: Waangalieni ndege wa angani; wao hawapandi wala hawavuni au kuweka ghalani, lakini Baba yenu wa mbinguni huwalisha. Je, ninyi si wa thamani zaidi kuliko hao ndege?
Ekegusii: Morigererie chinyoni chia igoro! Chirochio tichiri gosimeka, tichiri kogesa, tichiri gosangereria gochia biage, na Iso oino ore igoro nigo agochirageria. Inee! Inwe timobueti rigori riabo?

English: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
Kiswahili: Ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye kwa kujitaabisha kwake anaweza kujiongezea hata saa moja zaidi katika maisha yake?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ase more goetera ase ogwechanda kwaye oranyare komenta chingaki ase obogima bwaye?

English: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
Kiswahili: “Nanyi kwa nini mnajitaabisha kwa ajili ya mavazi? Fikirini maua ya shambani yameavyo. Hayafanyi kazi wala hayafumi.
Ekegusii: Ne chianga, nase ki mogochiechandera? Morigererie ebisicha bi’orosana buna bigokiina; tibiri gokora emeremo, gose tibiri gwesisa;

English: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
Kiswahili: Lakini nawaambia, hata Solomoni katika fahari yake yote hakuvikwa vizuri kama mojawapo ya hayo maua.
Ekegusii: korende nabateebirie, nonya Sulemani omonyene ase obonene bwaye bwonsi tabegete chianga buna ekemo ki’ebi.

English: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa Mungu huyavika hivi majani ya shambani, ambayo leo yapo na kesho yanatupwa motoni, je, hatawavika ninyi vizuri zaidi, enyi wa imani haba?
Ekegusii: Korende onye Nyasae okoboyia obonyansi bw’egetii oboreo reero, na ankio botugutwe ase omorero, Inee, takomenta kobaboyia inwe, abamore nokwegena ogoke?

English: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo msiwe na wasiwasi, mkisema, ‘Tutakula nini?’ au ‘Tutakunywa nini?’ au ‘Tutavaa nini?’
Ekegusii: Gaki, timona gwechanda mogoteeba: Ninki torarie? Gose: Ninki toranywe? Gose: Ninki torabeeke?

English: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
Kiswahili: Watu wasiomjua Mungu ndio wanaoshindania hayo, lakini Baba yenu wa mbinguni anafahamu kuwa mnahitaji haya yote.
Ekegusii: Inaki abanto b’Ebisaku nigo bakorigia ebio bionsi; korende Iso oino ore igoro namanyete ng’a ’moganetie ebinto ebio bionsi.

English: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
Kiswahili: Lakini utafuteni kwanza Ufalme wa Mungu na haki yake, na haya yote atawapa pia.
Ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani rigia oborwoti bwa Nyasae na oboronge bwaye, na ebinto ebio bionsi ’namobiegwe.

English: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo msiwe na wasiwasi kuhusu kesho, kwa sababu kesho itajitaabikia yenyewe. Yatosha kwa siku masumbufu yake.
Ekegusii: “Gaki, timwechandera ay’ankio, ekiagera ankio inariechande rinyene. Kera rituko ndiisaine nogwechanda kwaye.

English: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
Kiswahili: “Usihukumu ili usije ukahukumiwa.
Ekegusii: “Timogaambia, nainwe timokogaambigwa.

English: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana jinsi unavyowahukumu wengine, ndivyo utakavyohukumiwa, na kwa kipimo kile upimiacho, ndicho utakachopimiwa.
Ekegusii: Inaki ekiina mokonacha, nakio morache konacherwa. Na ekerengo keria mokorengera, nakio morache korengerwa.

English: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
Kiswahili: “Mbona unatazama kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako, na wala huoni boriti iliyo ndani ya jicho lako mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Inaki okorigereria ekeogoto kere ase eriiso ri’oyomino, na omoriibo ore ase eriiso riao ime toyorochi?

English: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
Kiswahili: Au unawezaje kumwambia ndugu yako, ‘Acha nitoe kibanzi kwenye jicho lako,’ wakati kuna boriti kwenye jicho lako mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Gose ’naki orateebie oyomino: ’Ntige ’nkorusie ekeogoto kere ase eriiso riao, na rora omoriibo nore ase eriiso riao?

English: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.
Kiswahili: Ewe mnafiki, ondoa boriti ndani ya jicho lako kwanza, ndipo utaweza kuona dhahiri jinsi ya kuondoa kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako.
Ekegusii: Aye omonga’inereria, rusia ritang’ani omoriibo ore ase eriiso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto korwa ase eriiso ri’oyomino.

English: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
Kiswahili: “Msiwape mbwa vitu vilivyo vitakatifu; wala msitupie nguruwe lulu zenu. Kama mkifanya hivyo, watazikanyagakanyaga na kisha watawageukia na kuwararua vipande vipande.
Ekegusii: “Timoa chisese ekere egechenu, gose timoitera chiruru chiaino ase chimbeche, tichicha gochitacha namagoro abo, naende chibaonchokere inwe, chibarie.

English: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
Kiswahili: “Ombeni nanyi mtapewa; tafuteni nanyi mtapata; bisheni nanyi mtafunguliwa mlango.
Ekegusii: “Saba, ’namoegwe; rigia, ’namonyore; tura, ’namoigorerwe egesieri.

English: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kila aombaye hupewa; naye kila atafutaye hupata; na kila abishaye hufunguliwa mlango.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera kera oyogosaba nigo akoegwa, na ere oyokorigia nigo akonyora, na ere oyogotura nigo akoigorerwa.

English: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
Kiswahili: “Au ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye mwanawe akimwomba mkate atampa jiwe?
Ekegusii: Gose monto onde n’are ase more, na omwana oye amosabe omogati, Inee, namoe rigena?

English: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
Kiswahili: Au mwanawe akimwomba samaki atampa nyoka?
Ekegusii: Gose karamosabe enswe, namoe eng’iti?

English: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
Kiswahili: Ikiwa ninyi basi mlio waovu mnajua kuwapa watoto wenu vitu vizuri, si zaidi sana Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawapa vitu vizuri wale wamwombao?
Ekegusii: Onye inwe, abamore ababe, momanyete koa abana baino ebiegwa ebiya, Inee, Iso oino ore igoro takomenta mono kobaa amaya abwo bakomosaba?

English: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo chochote mnachotaka mtendewe na watu, ninyi nanyi watendeeni vivyo hivyo. Kwa kuwa hii ndiyo Sheria na Manabii.
Ekegusii: “Nabo ande onsi morigetie abanto babakorere inwe, nainwe mobakorere boigo. Ekiagera ayio naro amachiiko na amang’ana y’ababani.

English: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.
Kiswahili: “Ingieni kupitia mlango mwembamba, kwa maana lango ni pana na njia ni pana ielekeayo upotevuni, nao ni wengi waingiao kwa kupitia lango hilo.
Ekegusii: “Soa ase egesieri kere ekegote, ekiagera egesieri gekogenda ase obosiru nekegare, na enchera ekogendao nengare, na abagosoa gochiao nabange.

English: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.
Kiswahili: Lakini mlango ni mwembamba na njia ni finyu ielekeayo kwenye uzima, nao ni wachache tu waionao.
Ekegusii: Korende egesieri gekogenda ase obogima nekegote, na enchera ekogendao nenyerere, na abakoyenyora nabake.

English: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
Kiswahili: “Jihadharini na manabii wa uongo, wanaowajia wakiwa wamevaa mavazi ya kondoo, lakini ndani ni mbwa mwitu wakali.
Ekegusii: “Mwerende nababani b’oborimo abwo bagocha ase more beboyetie chingobo chi’eching’ondi, na ime yabo nigo bare chisese chi’orosana chintindi mono.

English: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?
Kiswahili: Mtawatambua kwa matunda yao. Je, watu huchuma zabibu kwenye miiba, au tini kwenye michongoma?
Ekegusii: Ase amaamo abo ’namobamanye. Inee! Abanto nigo bagotwa amasabibu korwa ase emetobo, gose amako korwa ase amageri?

English: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, mti mwema huzaa matunda mazuri, na mti mbaya huzaa matunda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Naboigo kera omote omuya nigo okwama amatunda amaya, na omote omobe nigo okwama amatunda amabe.

English: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
Kiswahili: Mti mwema hauwezi kuzaa matunda mabaya, wala mti mbaya hauwezi kuzaa matunda mazuri.
Ekegusii: Omote omuya tokonyara kwama amatunda amabe, na omote omobe tokonyara kwama amatunda amaya.

English: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
Kiswahili: Kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri hukatwa na kutupwa motoni.
Ekegusii: Kera omote otameti amatunda amaya nigo okogechwa, otugutwa ase omorero.

English: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, mtawatambua kwa matunda yao.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, momanye ababani b’oborimo ase okwama kwabo.

English: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: “Si kila mtu aniambiaye, ‘Bwana, Bwana,’ atakayeingia katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni, bali ni yeye afanyaye mapenzi ya Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.
Ekegusii: “Tari kera omonto ogonteebia: Omonene Nyasae, orasoe ase oborwoti bwa igoro, korende n’oyogokora ogwancha gwa Tata one ore igoro.

English: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’
Kiswahili: Wengi wataniambia siku ile, ‘Bwana, Bwana, hatukutoa unabii kwa jina lako, na kwa jina lako kutoa pepo wachafu na kufanya miujiza mingi?’
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria nabange baranteebie: Omonene Nyasae, titware kobana ase erieta riao, na ase erieta riao goseria ebirecha, na ase erieta riao togakora ebikone ebinge bie chinguru?

English: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
Kiswahili: Ndipo nitakapowaambia wazi, ‘Sikuwajua kamwe. Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi watenda maovu!’
Ekegusii: Erio nainche nimbateebie maiso marore abanto baria: Timbamanyeti inwe nonya ng’ake; karue ase ’nde, inwe abakori amabe!

English: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo kila mtu ayasikiaye haya maneno yangu na kuyatenda, ni kama mtu mwenye busara aliyejenga nyumba yake kwenye mwamba.
Ekegusii: “Kera oyomo oyokoigwa amang’ana aya aane, na koyakora, nagwekanigwe n’omonto orenge omong’aini, oagachete mwaye igoro ase egetare;

English: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
Kiswahili: Mvua ikanyesha, mafuriko yakaja, na upepo ukavuma ukaipiga hiyo nyumba. Lakini haikuanguka; kwa sababu msingi wake ulikuwa kwenye mwamba.
Ekegusii: embura egatwa amo nomwaga, na eooro egaacha, egatwoma enyomba eria, korende tiyagwa, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.

English: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
Kiswahili: Naye kila anayesikia haya maneno yangu wala asiyatende, ni kama mtu mjinga aliyejenga nyumba yake kwenye mchanga.
Ekegusii: Na kera oyomo oyokoigwa amang’ana aya aane, ko tayakora, nagwekanigwe n’omonto omoriri, oagachete mwaye ase amaroba;

English: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”
Kiswahili: Mvua ikanyesha, mafuriko yakaja, nao upepo ukavuma ukaipiga hiyo nyumba, nayo ikaanguka kwa kishindo kikubwa.”
Ekegusii: embura egatwa amo nomwaga, na eooro egaacha, bigatwoma enyomba eria, ekagwa; okogwa kwaye gokaba okonene.”

English: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomaliza kusema maneno haya, makutano ya watu wakashangazwa sana na mafundisho yake,
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire amang’ana aya, emeganda egakumia ase okworokereria kwaye,

English: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu alifundisha kama yeye aliye na mamlaka, wala si kama walimu wao wa sheria.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo arenge koborokereria buna oyore nokobua, na tari buna aborokia babo b’amariiko.

English: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposhuka kutoka mlimani, makutano makubwa ya watu yakamfuata.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, emeganda emenge ekamotunyana.

English: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma akaja na kupiga magoti mbele yake, akasema, “Bwana, kama ukitaka, unaweza kunitakasa.”
Ekegusii: Rora, omonto orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma akamochiera, akamotung’amera, akamoteebia, “Omonene, oise gwancha nabo ogonsibia.”

English: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
Kiswahili: Yesu akanyoosha mkono wake akamgusa yule mtu, akamwambia, “Nataka. Takasika!” Mara yule mtu akatakasika ukoma wake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bogasibigwa.

English: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akamwambia, “Hakikisha humwambii mtu yeyote. Lakini nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani, na utoe sadaka aliyoamuru Mose, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Rigereria, toteebia monto onde ing’ana; korende genda, bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso egiachigetwe na Musa, erinde kebe kirori ase abanto.”

English: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoingia Kapernaumu, jemadari mmoja alimjia, kumwomba msaada,
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gosoa Kapernaumu, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana akamochiera, akamosorora,

English: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”
Kiswahili: akisema, “Bwana, mtumishi wangu amelala nyumbani na amepooza, tena ana maumivu makali ya kutisha.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Omonene, omosomba one nyomba araire, oborwaire bomogataetie, akoromwa mono.”

English: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Nitakuja na kumponya.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ninchiche komogwenia.”

English: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule jemadari akamwambia, “Bwana, mimi sistahili wewe kuingia chini ya dari yangu. Lakini sema neno tu, naye mtumishi wangu atapona.
Ekegusii: Oria omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inche tinyisaini aye orasoe inse y’ekerama kiane; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.

English: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mimi mwenyewe ni mtu niliyewekwa chini ya mamlaka, nikiwa na askari chini yangu. Nikimwambia huyu, ‘Nenda,’ yeye huenda; na mwingine nikimwambia, ‘Njoo,’ yeye huja. Nikimwambia mtumishi wangu, ‘Fanya hivi,’ yeye hufanya.”
Ekegusii: Inaki inche nomonto inde inse ase okobua, naende ninde nabarwani inse ase ’nde. Kondateebie oyo: Genda, ogenda; na oyonde: Inchuo, ocha; na omosomba one: Kora iga, okora.”

English: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia maneno haya, alishangaa, akawaambia wale waliomfuata, “Amin, nawaambia, hata katika Israeli sijapata kuona yeyote mwenye imani kubwa namna hii.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso amoigwa agakumia, agateebia abamotunyanete, “Nekeene nabateebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.

English: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,
Kiswahili: Ninawaambia kwamba wengi watatoka mashariki na magharibi, nao wataketi karamuni pamoja na Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie ng’a abange nabache korwa moocha na bosongo, ’nabaikaranse ase emesa na koria amo na Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, ase oborwoti bwa igoro,

English: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
Kiswahili: Lakini warithi wa Ufalme watatupwa katika giza la nje, ambako kutakuwako kilio na kusaga meno.”
Ekegusii: korende abana b’oborwoti ’nabatugutwe isiko ase omosunte; na aroro abanto mbabe nekerero na okoriania amaino.”

English: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akamwambia yule jemadari, “Nenda na iwe kwako sawasawa na imani yako.” Naye yule mtumishi akapona saa ile ile.
Ekegusii: Yeso agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, “Genda bwoo, nabe ase ore koreng’ana nokwegena kwao.” Omosomba oria akagwenigwa ase ekero keria.

English: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoingia nyumbani kwa Petro, alimkuta mama mkwe wa Petro amelala kitandani, akiwa ana homa.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso asoete nyomba mwa Petero, akarora ng’ina biara Petero oraire, orwarete esosera.

English: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.
Kiswahili: Akamgusa mkono wake na homa ikamwacha, naye akainuka na kuanza kumhudumia.
Ekegusii: Akamokuna okoboko kwaye. Esosera ekamotiga, na ere akaimoka akamokorera.

English: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,
Kiswahili: Jioni ile, wakamletea watu wengi waliopagawa na pepo wachafu, naye akawatoa wale pepo wachafu kwa neno lake, na kuwaponya wagonjwa wote.
Ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, bakamoirera abanto abange ababwatire nebirecha, na ere akarusia ebirecha ase ring’ana, na bonsi abarenge abarwaire akabagwenia;

English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
Kiswahili: Haya yalifanyika ili litimie lile lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kwamba: “Mwenyewe alitwaa udhaifu wetu na alichukua magonjwa yetu.”
Ekegusii: rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya, ogoteeba, “Ere akaimokia oboreu bwaito, na akabogoria amarwaire aito.”

English: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoona makutano mengi wamemzunguka, aliwaamuru wanafunzi wake wavuke mpaka ngʼambo ya ziwa.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso achia korora emeganda emenge yamoetananire, agachiika ng’a baimoke korwa aroro bagende ng’umbu.

English: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
Kiswahili: Kisha mwalimu mmoja wa sheria akamjia Yesu na kumwambia, “Mwalimu, nitakufuata kokote uendako.”
Ekegusii: Omworokia oyomo bw’amariiko akamochiera, akamoteebia, “Omworokia, ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”

English: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”
Kiswahili: Naye Yesu akamjibu, “Mbweha wana mapango, nao ndege wa angani wana viota, lakini Mwana wa Adamu hana mahali pa kulaza kichwa chake.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ebibwe mbire namakuruma, ne chinyoni chia igoro nchire nebiswa, korende Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto tari nase akobeeka omotwe oye.”

English: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
Kiswahili: Mwanafunzi mwingine akamwambia, “Bwana, niruhusu kwanza nikamzike baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Na oyonde ase aborokigwa baye akamoteebia, “Omonene, ritang’ani ing’a ribaga ngende gotindeka tata”

English: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Nifuate, uwaache wafu wawazike wafu wao.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoteebia, “Ntunyana, tiga abakuure batindeke abakuure babo.”

English: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
Kiswahili: Naye alipoingia kwenye mashua, wanafunzi wake wakamfuata.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koriina obwato, aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.

English: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
Kiswahili: Ghafula, kukainuka dhoruba kali baharini hata mashua ikaanza kufunikwa na mawimbi, lakini Yesu alikuwa amelala usingizi.
Ekegusii: Rora, omwaga omonene okaimoka ase enyancha, goika obwato bogatubwa nemerindo; korende ere konya oraarire.

English: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumwamsha, wakisema, “Bwana, tuokoe! Tunazama!”
Ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakamoteebia, “Omonene, totoorie, ngosira tore!”

English: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.
Kiswahili: Naye Yesu akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnaogopa, enyi wa imani haba?” Kisha akaamka na kukemea dhoruba na mawimbi, nako kukawa shwari kabisa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inaki mokwoboa, inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke?” Erio akaimoka, agatogonyera omwaga na enyancha; gokaba ogotoerera okonene.

English: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakashangaa, wakisema, “Ni mtu wa namna gani huyu? Hata upepo na mawimbi vinamtii!”
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bagakumia, bagateeba, “Monto ki oyo, nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”

English: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.
Kiswahili: Walipofika ngʼambo katika nchi ya Wagerasi, watu wawili waliopagawa na pepo wachafu walitoka makaburini nao wakakutana naye. Watu hawa walikuwa wakali mno kiasi kwamba hakuna mtu aliyeweza kupita njia ile.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ng’umbu y’ense y’Abageraseni, abanto babere ababwatire nebirecha bakaumerana nere, na barabwo nigo baare korwa ase chimbeera, nigo barenge abatindi mono, goika monto onde tarenge konyara goeta enchera eria.

English: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
Kiswahili: Wakapiga kelele, “Una nini nasi, Mwana wa Mungu? Umekuja hapa kututesa kabla ya wakati ulioamriwa?”
Ekegusii: Na rora, barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakaboora, “Inki obwate naintwe, Omwana o Nyasae? Inee! Ngwachire aiga gotoita ekero engaki etaraika?”

English: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.
Kiswahili: Mbali kidogo kutoka pale walipokuwa, kulikuwa na kundi kubwa la nguruwe wakilisha.
Ekegusii: Ang’e nagwo ndiarengeo riicho rie chimbeche chinyinge, riare korisia.

English: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”
Kiswahili: Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi Yesu, “Ukitutoa humu, turuhusu twende kwenye lile kundi la nguruwe.”
Ekegusii: Ebirecha biria bikamosorora, bikabora, “Onye kogotorusia aa, rirorio toe ribaga tosoe ase riicho rie chimbeche.”

English: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Nendeni!” Hivyo wakatoka na kuwaingia wale nguruwe, nalo kundi lote likateremka gengeni kwa kasi, likaingia katika ziwa na kufa ndani ya maji.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabiteebia, “Genda!” Bigasooka, bigasoa ase chimbeche. Na rora, riicho rionsi rigatirimboka, rigasoa enyancha ime, rigasirera aroro.

English: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.
Kiswahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wakiwachunga hao nguruwe wakakimbia wakaingia mjini, wakaeleza yote kuhusu yale yaliyowatokea wale waliokuwa wamepagawa na pepo wachafu.
Ekegusii: Na abarisia b’echimbeche chiria bagatama, bakagenda omochie bakararia amang’ana onsi ayakoregete ase baria babwatire nebirecha.

English: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
Kiswahili: Kisha watu wote wa mji huo wakatoka kwenda kukutana na Yesu. Nao walipomwona wakamsihi aondoke kwenye nchi yao.
Ekegusii: Na rora, abanto bonsi b’omochie oria bakagenda koumerana na Yeso; bagachia komoorora, bakamosorora arue orogongo rwabo.

English: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaingia kwenye chombo, akavuka na kufika katika mji wa kwao.
Ekegusii: Agasoa obwato, akaamboka, agaika omochie oye.

English: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo wakamletea mtu aliyepooza, akiwa amelazwa kwenye mkeka. Yesu alipoiona imani yao, alimwambia yule mtu aliyepooza, “Mwanangu, jipe moyo mkuu. Dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
Ekegusii: Na rigereria, bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata, oraire borere; na, ekero Yeso achia korora okwegena kwabo, agateebia oria rigata, “Remia enkoro, omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

English: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya jambo hili, baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakasema mioyoni mwao, “Huyu mtu anakufuru!”
Ekegusii: Na rora, abande ase aborokia b’amariiko bakaboora ase emioyo yabo, “Omonto oyo ’nkorama are Nyasae.”

English: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akiyafahamu mawazo yao, akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnawaza maovu mioyoni mwenu?
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso namanyete ebirengererio biabo, akababoria, “Nase ki inwe mokorengereria ebirengererio ebibe ase chinkoro chiaino?

English: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?
Kiswahili: Je, ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi: kusema, ‘Umesamehewa dhambi zako,’ au kusema, ‘Inuka, uende’?
