Ekegusii: Ndiriri rire riango, goteeba: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka ogende?

English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
Kiswahili: Lakini, ili mpate kujua kwamba Mwana wa Adamu anayo mamlaka duniani kusamehe dhambi…” Ndipo akamwambia yule aliyepooza, “Inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”
Ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria orenge rigata, “Imoka, bwetweke egeseero ki’ao, ogende bwoo.”

English: He arose and departed to his house.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akasimama, akaenda nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda bwoye.

English: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
Kiswahili: Makutano walipoyaona haya, wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, wakamtukuza Mungu ambaye alikuwa ametoa mamlaka kama haya kwa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora aya, bakooboa, bakamotogia Nyasae, oy’oete Mwanyabaanto okobua konga buna oko.

English: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akienda kutoka huko, alimwona mtu mmoja jina lake Mathayo akiwa ameketi forodhani mahali pa kutoza ushuru. Yesu akamwambia, “Nifuate.” Mathayo akaondoka, akamfuata.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia goeta korwa aroro akarora omonto oyomo okorokwa Matayo, oikaransete aase enyomba ekoruserigwa ebango, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana!” Akaimoka, akamotunyana.

English: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akila chakula ndani ya nyumba ya Mathayo, watoza ushuru wengi na “wenye dhambi” wakaja kula pamoja naye na wanafunzi wake.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikaransire nyomba koragera, rora, abarusia ebango abange amo n’abanyabibe bagaacha, bagaikaransa amo na Yeso na aborokigwa baye.

English: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo walipoona mambo haya, wakawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Kwa nini Mwalimu wenu anakula pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi’?”
Ekegusii: Ekero Abafarisai bachia korora aya, bakabooria aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki Omworokia oino akoria amo nabarusia ebango n’a banyabibe?”

English: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu aliposikia hayo, akawaambia, “Watu wenye afya hawahitaji tabibu, lakini wale walio wagonjwa ndio wanaohitaji tabibu.
Ekegusii: Agachia koyaigwa, akabateebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete.

English: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
Kiswahili: Nendeni mkajifunze maana ya maneno haya: ‘Nataka rehema, wala si dhabihu.’ Kwa maana sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi.”
Ekegusii: Genda mweorokererie engencho yaye ninki: Inche nigo ndigetie amaabera, gose tari ekeng’wanso. Inaki tincheti korangeria abanyaboronge, korende abanyabibe.”

English: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Yohana Mbatizaji wakaja na kumuuliza Yesu, “Imekuwaje kwamba sisi na Mafarisayo tunafunga, lakini wanafunzi wako hawafungi?”
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio aborokigwa ba Yohana bakamochiera, bakamoboria, Nase ki intwe na Abafarisai tokweng’ata ekero ase ekero, ko aborokigwa bao tibari kweng’ata

English: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Wageni wa bwana arusi wawezaje kuomboleza wakati angali pamoja nao? Wakati utafika ambapo bwana arusi ataondolewa kwao. Hapo ndipo watakapofunga.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Abarangerigwa b’enyangi inabanyare korera ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo? Korende amatuko nache, barache kourwa omonywomi; erio nario barache kweng’ata.

English: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mtu anayeshonea kiraka kipya kwenye nguo iliyochakaa, kwa maana kile kiraka kitachanika kutoka kwenye hiyo nguo, nayo hiyo nguo itachanika zaidi.
Ekegusii: Onde tari okobeka ekeraka ki’egetambaa ekeyia ase eyanga engotu, ekiagera keria kiabekwa nigo kegotandora eyanga eria, na ase yatandogete ake nigo ekona‐gochiererera.

English: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”
Kiswahili: Wala watu hawaweki divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Kama wakifanya hivyo, viriba vitapasuka nayo divai itamwagika, navyo viriba vitaharibika. Lakini divai mpya huwekwa kwenye viriba vipya, na hivyo divai na viriba huwa salama.”
Ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa. Eise kobekwa bo, ebirandi biria nigo biratandoke, na edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bisareke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia, bionsi bibere biasirana.”

English: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akiwaambia mambo haya, mara akaingia kiongozi wa sinagogi akapiga magoti mbele yake, akamwambia, “Binti yangu amekufa sasa hivi. Lakini njoo uweke mkono wako juu yake, naye atakuwa hai.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are gokwana aya, omonene oyomo agacha, akabeeka amaru inse asare, okobora, “Omwana one omoiseke okuure bono iga, korende inchwo aye, omobekere okoboko, na ere nabe moyo.”

English: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaondoka akafuatana naye, nao wanafunzi wake pia wakaandamana naye.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaimoka agatunyana omonto oria, ere na aborokigwa baye.

English: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, mwanamke mmoja, ambaye alikuwa na ugonjwa wa kutokwa damu kwa muda wa miaka kumi na miwili, akaja nyuma ya Yesu, akagusa upindo wa vazi lake,
Ekegusii: Na rora, omokungu oyomo oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, akamochiera korwa magega, agakuna omokoba bw’eyanga yaye.

English: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
Kiswahili: kwa maana alisema moyoni mwake, “Kama nikigusa tu vazi lake, nitaponywa.”
Ekegusii: Igo arengereretie ase omoyo oye ime, “Inse gokuna eyanga yaye, ningwene.”

English: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
Kiswahili: Yesu akageuka, naye alipomwona akamwambia, “Binti, jipe moyo mkuu, imani yako imekuponya.” Naye yule mwanamke akapona kuanzia saa ile ile.
Ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akamorora, akamoteebia, “Moiseke one, remia enkoro; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Omokungu oria akagwena erio kegima.

English: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipofika nyumbani kwa yule kiongozi wa sinagogi na kuwaona waombolezaji wakipiga filimbi za maombolezo na watu wengi wakipiga kelele,
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia gosoa enyomba y’omonto oria omonene, akarora ababugia ebiroria, na abanto basangererekaneteo bakorera.

English: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
Kiswahili: akawaambia, “Ondokeni! Kwa maana binti huyu hakufa, bali amelala.” Wakamcheka kwa dhihaka.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Karuo aa! Omoiseke oyo takweti, okorara araire gwoka.” Bakamosekerera.

English: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu walipokwisha kutolewa nje, akaingia mle ndani na kumshika yule binti mkono, naye akaamka.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero baria basangererekanete amo basogetigwe isiko, agasoa ime, akamobwata okoboko, na omoiseke oria akaimoka.

English: The report of this went out into all that land.
Kiswahili: Habari hizi zikaenea katika maeneo yale yote.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya agasarera ase ense eria yonsi.

English: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akiondoka mahali pale, vipofu wawili wakamfuata wakipiga kelele kwa nguvu na kusema, “Mwana wa Daudi, tuhurumie!”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso arenge goeta korwa aase aria, abanto babere barenge emeuko bakamotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Tororere amaabera, aye omwana o Daudi!”

English: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
Kiswahili: Alipoingia mle nyumbani wale vipofu wakamjia. Naye Yesu akawauliza, “Mnaamini kwamba ninaweza kufanya jambo hili?” Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo, Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia gosoa nyomba, emeuko eria ekamochiera. Yeso akababoria, “Inee! Mwegenire ng’a inche ninyare gokora ring’ana eri?” Bakamoteebia, “Ee, Omonene.”

English: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akagusa macho yao na kusema, “Iwe kwenu sawasawa na imani yenu.”
Ekegusii: Erio agwo agakuna amaiso abo, akabateebia, “Abe ase more koreng’ana nokwegena kwaino.”

English: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
Kiswahili: Macho yao yakafunguka. Yesu akawaonya vikali, akisema, “Angalieni mtu yeyote asijue kuhusu jambo hili.”
Ekegusii: Amaiso abo akaramokigwa. Yeso akabatianera bokong’u, “Rigereria monto onde tabaisa komanya amang’ana aya.”

English: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao wakaenda na kueneza habari zake katika eneo lile lote.
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagasoka isiko, bagasareria amang’ana aye ase ense eria yonsi.

English: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanatoka, mtu mmoja aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu na ambaye hakuweza kuongea aliletwa kwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia gosoka isiko, rora, abanto bakamorentera omonto orenge rimama, naende nigo ere abwatire nekerecha.

English: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
Kiswahili: Yule pepo mchafu alipotolewa, yule mtu aliyekuwa bubu akaongea. Ule umati wa watu ukastaajabu na kusema, “Jambo kama hili kamwe halijapata kuonekana katika Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Ekero ekerecha giachia goserigwa, omonto oria rimama agakwana. Emeganda egakumia, ekabora, “Amang’ana anga buna aya tana kororekana nonya ng’ake ase Abaisraeli.”

English: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mafarisayo wakasema, “Huyo anatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa mkuu wa pepo wachafu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bakaboora, “Ere nase chinguru chi’omonene bw’ebirecha agoseria ebirecha.”

English: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
Kiswahili: Yesu akazunguka katika miji yote na vijiji vyote, akifundisha katika masinagogi yao, akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme, na akiponya kila ugonjwa na kila aina ya maradhi.
Ekegusii: Yeso agaetanana emechie yonsi na ebinyoro, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang’ana amaya y’oborwoti na kogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi.

English: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
Kiswahili: Alipoona makutano, aliwahurumia kwa sababu walikuwa wanasumbuka bila msaada, kama kondoo wasiokuwa na mchungaji.
Ekegusii: Agachia korora emeganda y’ abanto, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera konya bachandekire, baserebekanire buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia.

English: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Mavuno ni mengi lakini watendakazi ni wachache.
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Rigesa nerinene, korende abakori emeremo nabake;

English: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mwombeni Bwana wa mavuno, ili apeleke watendakazi katika shamba lake la mavuno.”
Ekegusii: gaki mosabe Omonene bwe rigesa atome abakori emeremo ase rigesa riaye.”

English: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili, naye akawapa mamlaka juu ya pepo wachafu, ili waweze kuwatoa na kuponya kila ugonjwa na maradhi ya kila aina.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere bache asare, akabaa okobua ase ebirecha ebibe na kobiseria, na kogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi.

English: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya hao mitume kumi na wawili: wa kwanza, Simoni aitwaye Petro, na Andrea nduguye; Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo, na Yohana nduguye;
Ekegusii: Na amarieta abotomwa baria ikomi na babere naro aya: Oyo bw’eritang’ani, Simioni, oyio ore korokwa naende Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi na Yohana momura omwabo;

English: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;
Kiswahili: Filipo, na Bartholomayo; Tomaso, na Mathayo mtoza ushuru; Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, na Thadayo;
Ekegusii: Filipo na Batholomayo; Thomas na Matayo, omorusia ebango; Yakobo bw’Alufayo na Tadayo;

English: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
Kiswahili: Simoni Mkananayo, na Yuda Iskariote aliyemsaliti Yesu.
Ekegusii: Simioni omoKaanani, na Yudasi Iskariota, ere oria omoruete.

English: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.
Kiswahili: Hawa kumi na wawili, Yesu aliwatuma akawaagiza: “Msiende miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa, wala msiingie mji wowote wa Wasamaria.
Ekegusii: Aba ikomi na babere Yeso akabatoma, akabachiika, “Timogenda enchera ende yonsi y’ abanto b’Ebisaku, timosoa nonya nomochie onde bwonsi bw’Abasamaria,

English: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini afadhali mshike njia kuwaendea kondoo wa nyumba ya Israeli waliopotea.
Ekegusii: korende mbuya mochiere ching’ondi chinsiru chi’enyomba ya Israeli.

English: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
Kiswahili: Wakati mnapokwenda, hubirini mkisema, ‘Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.’
Ekegusii: Na inwe ase okogenda kwaino, randia, moteebe: Oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e.

English: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
Kiswahili: Ponyeni wagonjwa, fufueni wafu, takaseni wenye ukoma, toeni pepo wachafu. Mmepata bure, toeni bure.
Ekegusii: Abarwaire bagwenie, abakuure babokie, abare noborwaire bwa ukoma basibie, na ebirecha birusie. Mwaeirwe bosa, nainwe karue bosa.

English: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
Kiswahili: Msichukue dhahabu, wala fedha, wala shaba kwenye vifuko vyenu.
Ekegusii: Timobogoria chitaabu, gose chifeta, gose chitaai ase ebimoya biaino,

English: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
Kiswahili: Msichukue mkoba wa safari, wala kanzu mbili, wala jozi ya pili ya viatu, wala fimbo, kwa maana mtendakazi anastahili posho yake.
Ekegusii: gose esaro ase orogendo, gose chianga ibere, gose ebikoroto, nonya nenyimbo, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete endagera yaye.

English: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.
Kiswahili: “Mji wowote au kijiji chochote mtakapoingia, tafuteni humo mtu anayestahili, nanyi kaeni kwake mpaka mtakapoondoka.
Ekegusii: Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, na ase ekenyoro gionsi, morigie ning’o ogwenerete aroro, mobeere nere goika moruo.

English: As you enter into the household, greet it.
Kiswahili: Mkiingia kwenye nyumba, itakieni amani.
Ekegusii: Ekero mogosoa enyomba eria, yekwanie.

English: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
Kiswahili: Kama nyumba hiyo inastahili, amani yenu na iwe juu yake. La sivyo, amani yenu na iwarudie ninyi.
Ekegusii: Onye enyomba eria egwenerete, tiga omorembe oino oyeikere; ko onye tegwenereti, omorembe oino nobairanere inwe.

English: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote hatawakaribisha ninyi, wala kusikiliza maneno yenu, kungʼuteni mavumbi kutoka kwenye miguu yenu mtakapokuwa mnatoka kwenye nyumba hiyo au mji huo.
Ekegusii: Onye onde tari orabaroisie inwe, gose koigwa amang’ana aino, kamokorua enyomba eria gose omochie oria, orotu rw’amagoro aino morokong’ontereo.

English: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa miji ya Sodoma na Gomora kustahimili katika hukumu kuliko mji huo.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Nebe aororo ase Sodomu na Gomora ase rituko ri’ekiina kobua ase omochie oria.

English: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.
Kiswahili: “Tazama, ninawatuma kama kondoo katikati ya mbwa mwitu. Kwa hiyo mwe werevu kama nyoka na wapole kama hua.
Ekegusii: “Rigereria, nabatomire inwe buna ching’ondi gati‐gati ye chisese chi’orosana. Ase ayio mobe abang’aini buna ching’iti, na abororo buna amaruma.

English: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
Kiswahili: “Jihadharini na wanadamu; kwa maana watawapeleka katika mabaraza yao na kuwapiga kwenye masinagogi yao.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwerende ase Mwanyabaanto, ekiagera barabwo nabaabaire ase ebigambero, babang’wanie emecharichi ase chisinagogi chiabo.

English: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mtaburutwa mbele ya watawala na wafalme kwa ajili yangu, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao na kwa watu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: Na inwe namoirwe ase abagabana na ase abarwoti ase engencho y’ane, koba kirori ase bare na ase abanto b’Ebisaku.

English: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
Kiswahili: Lakini watakapowapeleka humo, msisumbuke kufikiria mtakalosema, kwa maana mtapewa la kusema wakati huo.
Ekegusii: Ekero bakobaira, timoichana buna mogochia koiraneria, gose eki mogochia gokwana, ekiagera ase ekero keria inamoegwe aya morakwane;

English: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu si ninyi mtakaokuwa mkinena, bali ni Roho wa Baba yenu atakayekuwa akinena kupitia kwenu.
Ekegusii: inaki tari inwe morakwane, korende n’Omoika o Iso oino orakwane goetera ase more.

English: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
Kiswahili: “Ndugu atamsaliti ndugu yake ili auawe, naye baba atamsaliti mtoto wake. Watoto nao wataasi dhidi ya wazazi wao na kusababisha wauawe.
Ekegusii: Na momura omwabo omonto narue oyomwabo, erinde aitwe, na ise nomwana oye, na abana nabaimokere abaibori babo babaite,

English: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
Kiswahili: Watu wote watawachukia kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Lakini yule atakayevumilia hadi mwisho ataokolewa.
Ekegusii: na inwe namogechwe n’abanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane, korende oyoraaremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.

English: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.
Kiswahili: Wakiwatesa katika mji mmoja, kimbilieni mji mwingine. Amin, amin nawaambia, hamtamaliza miji yote ya Israeli kabla Mwana wa Adamu kuja.
Ekegusii: Ekero barabwo barabachande ase omochie oyomo, motame gochia ase oyonde; nekeene nabateebirie: Timogokoora emechie y’Abaisraeli Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ataracha.

English: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
Kiswahili: “Mwanafunzi hawezi kumzidi mwalimu wake, wala mtumishi hamzidi bwana wake.
Ekegusii: “Omworokigwa tari omonene kobua Omworokia oye, gose omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye.

English: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!
Kiswahili: Yatosha mwanafunzi kuwa kama mwalimu wake, na mtumishi kuwa kama bwana wake. Ikiwa mkuu wa nyumba ameitwa Beelzebuli,je, si watawaita zaidi wale wa nyumbani mwake!
Ekegusii: Yamoisanire omworokigwa koba buna Omworokia oye, na omosomba buna omonene oye. Inee! Onye bamorogete omonyene enyomba Beelizebuli, tibakobachecheria baria b’enyomba yaye mono komobua ere?

English: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo msiwaogope hao, kwa maana hakuna kilichofichika ambacho hakitafunuliwa, wala hakuna siri ambayo haitajulikana.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, timoiroka baria, ekiagera ing’ana rinde tiriri ribisire ritache koorokigwa, gose erikenganete ritache komanyekana.

English: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
Kiswahili: Ninalowaambia gizani, ninyi lisemeni mchana peupe. Na lile mnalosikia likinongʼonwa masikioni mwenu, lihubirini juu ya nyumba.
Ekegusii: Eri nkobateebia ase omosunte ime, ritebe ase omobaso; na eri mokoigwa rikomonywa, rirarie igoro ase ebirama.

English: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
Kiswahili: Msiwaogope wale wauao mwili lakini hawawezi kuua roho. Afadhali mwogopeni yeye awezaye kuiangamiza roho na mwili katika jehanamu.
Ekegusii: Timoiroka abagoita omobere, abatanyare goita omoyo; kobua moiroke oyo oranyare goita omobere na omoyo ase omorero o kare na kare.

English: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.
Kiswahili: Je, shomoro wawili hawauzwi kwa senti moja tu? Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeanguka chini pasipo Baba yenu kujua.
Ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro ibere tichiri koonigwa ase ebesa eyemo? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tigakogwa inse, Iso oino atancheti.

English: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
Kiswahili: Hata nywele za vichwa vyenu zote zimehesabiwa.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya nechitukia chionsi chi’emetwe yaino chiabarirwe.

English: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
Kiswahili: Hivyo msiogope; kwa maana ninyi ni wa thamani kubwa kuliko shomoro wengi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.

English: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: “Kila mtu atakayenikiri mbele ya watu, mimi nami nitamkiri yeye mbele za Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Inaki kera omonto oranyatore ase Mwanyabaanto, nainche boigo nimwatore ase Tata one ore igoro,

English: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeyote atakayenikana mimi mbele ya watu, mimi nami nitamkana mbele za Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: korende oyorankane ase Mwanyabaanto, nainche nimokane ase Tata one ore igoro.

English: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
Kiswahili: “Msidhani kwamba nimekuja kuleta amani duniani. Sikuja kuleta amani bali upanga.
Ekegusii: “Timokaga ng’a nigo naachire korenta omorembe ase ense; tincheti korenta omorembe, korende omoro bw’eseegi.

English: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nimekuja kumfitini “ ‘mtu na babaye, binti na mamaye, mkwe na mama mkwe wake;
Ekegusii: Eke nacheire nakio eke: nogwatanana omonto na ise, omwana omoiseke na ng’ina, na moka momura na ng’ina biara.

English: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.
Kiswahili: nao adui za mtu watakuwa ni wale watu wa nyumbani kwake.’
Ekegusii: Na abanto b’enyomba y’omonto inababe ababisa baye.

English: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote ampendaye baba yake au mama yake kuliko anavyonipenda mimi, hastahili kuwa wangu. Yeyote ampendaye mwanawe au binti yake kuliko anavyonipenda mimi, hastahili kuwa wangu.
Ekegusii: Oyo bwanchete ise gose ng’ina kombua, oyio tangwenereti, na oyo bwanchete omwana oye omomura gose omoiseke kombua, oyio tangwenereti.

English: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.
Kiswahili: Tena yeyote asiyeuchukua msalaba wake na kunifuata, hastahili kuwa wangu.
Ekegusii: Na oyo otabogoreti omosalaba oye na gontunyana, tangwenereti.

English: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu atayapata.
Ekegusii: Oyorarigie koegera obogima bwaye nabosirie, na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho y’ane nabonyore.

English: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote atakayewapokea ninyi atakuwa amenipokea mimi, na yeyote atakayenipokea mimi atakuwa amempokea yeye aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: “Oyobanchire inwe, onyanchire na inche, na oyo oranyanche inche, omwanchire ere oyontomete.

English: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote anayempokea nabii kwa kuwa ni nabii atapokea thawabu ya nabii, naye mtu anayempokea mwenye haki kwa kuwa ni mwenye haki atapokea thawabu ya mwenye haki.
Ekegusii: Oyobwanchire omobani ekiagera ere nomobani, nanyore eng’eria y’omobani; na oyo bwanchire omonto omooronge ekiagera ere nomonto omooronge, nanyore eng’eria y’omonto omooronge.

English: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”
Kiswahili: Kama yeyote akimpa hata kikombe cha maji baridi mmoja wa hawa wadogo kwa kuwa ni mwanafunzi wangu, amin, nawaambia, hataikosa thawabu yake.”
Ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi oramoe oyomo obo bw’aba abake egekombe kiamaache amakendu ekiagera are omworokigwa one, nekeene nabatebirie: Takoyesiria eng’eria yaye nonya ng’ake.”

English: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu kumaliza kutoa maagizo kwa wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili, aliondoka hapo akaenda kufundisha na kuhubiri katika miji yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire gochiika aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere, akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda kworokereria na korandia ase emechie yabo.

English: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
Kiswahili: Yohana aliposikia akiwa gerezani mambo ambayo Kristo alikuwa akiyafanya, aliwatuma wanafunzi wake
Ekegusii: Ekero Yohana achia koigwa aaria ase echela ebitage bia Kristo, agatoma aborokigwa baye komoboria,

English: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”
Kiswahili: ili wakamuulize, “Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?”
Ekegusii: “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”

English: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Rudini mkamwambie Yohana yale mnayosikia na kuyaona:
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Genda moteebie Yohana aya mwaigwa na korora:

English: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
Kiswahili: Vipofu wanapata kuona, viwete wanatembea, wenye ukoma wanatakaswa, viziwi wanasikia, wafu wanafufuliwa, na maskini wanahubiriwa habari njema.
Ekegusii: Abarenge emeuko nkorora bare, abarenge amagata ngotaara bare, abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma basibekire, abarenge emetino nkoigwa bare, abare ebitondo nkobokigwa bare, na abataka nkoranderigwa bare amang’ana amaya.

English: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
Kiswahili: Amebarikiwa mtu yule asiyechukizwa na mimi.”
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie onde bwensi otagochiri nainche.”

English: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wa Yohana walipokuwa wanaondoka, Yesu akaanza kusema na makutano kuhusu Yohana Mbatizaji. Akawauliza, “Mlipokwenda kule nyikani, mlikwenda kuona nini? Je, ni unyasi ukipeperushwa na upepo?
Ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda, Yeso agachaaka gokwana nemeganda igoro ya Yohana, Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Negetonto gekonyegerigwa nomwaga?

English: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
Kiswahili: Kama sivyo, mlikwenda kuona nini basi? Mtu aliyevaa mavazi ya kifahari? La hasha, watu wanaovaa mavazi ya kifahari wako katika majumba ya wafalme.
Ekegusii: Gose inki mwachiete korora isiko? Omonto bweboyetie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chinterere nigo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi’abarwoti.

English: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
Kiswahili: Basi mlikwenda kuona nini? Mlikwenda kumwona nabii? Naam, nawaambia, yeye ni zaidi ya nabii.
Ekegusii: Nase ki rende mwasogete isiko? Korora omobani? Ee, nabateebirie, oyore omonene kobua omobani.

English: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye ambaye habari zake zimeandikwa: “ ‘Tazama nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako, atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako.’
Ekegusii: Inaki oyio nere amang’ana aya ariikire igoro yaye: Rigereria, natomire omotomwa one ase obosio bwao, oyo oratang’ane koroisia enchera yao!

English: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, miongoni mwa wale waliozaliwa na wanawake, hajatokea mtu aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana Mbatizaji. Lakini aliye mdogo kabisa katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni mkuu kuliko Yohana.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie inwe ng’a ase baria baiboire nomokuungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana Omobatisi; korende oyore omoke ase oborwoti bwa igoro nomonene komobua.

English: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
Kiswahili: Tangu siku za Yohana Mbatizaji hadi sasa, Ufalme wa Mbinguni hupatikana kwa nguvu, nao wenye nguvu wanauteka.
Ekegusii: Korwa amatuko a Yohana Omobatisi goika bono oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogosogwa neburuburu, na abwo abanyaburuburu nigo bakobosoa ne chinguru.

English: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana manabii wote na Sheria walitabiri mpaka wakati wa Yohana.
Ekegusii: Inaki ababani bonsi mbaabanete, na amachiiko boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana.

English: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mko tayari kukubali hilo, yeye ndiye yule Eliya ambaye manabii walikuwa wamesema angekuja.
Ekegusii: Na inwe onye morigetie gwancha, ere nere Elija otebetwe ore gocha.

English: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliye na masikio, na asikie.
Ekegusii: Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.

English: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions
Kiswahili: “Lakini kizazi hiki nikifananishe na nini? Kinafanana na watoto waliokaa sokoni wakiwaita wenzao na kuwaambia,
Ekegusii: Korende inaki ndakegwekanie ekegori eke? Nigo kegwekaine abana baikaransete ase chichiiro, bakorangeria abagisangio babo, bagoteeba;

English: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’
Kiswahili: “ ‘Tuliwapigia filimbi, lakini hamkucheza; tuliwaimbia nyimbo za maombolezo, lakini hamkuomboleza.’
Ekegusii: “Twababugeirie ebiroria, na inwe timotengeti; tweumirie, na inwe timorereti”.

English: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja, alikuwa hali wala hanywi, nao wanasema, ‘Yeye ana pepo mchafu.’
Ekegusii: Inaki Yohana nigo achete, tare koria gose tare konywa: bagateeba; Nare nekerecha.

English: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu alikuja akila na kunywa, nao wanasema, ‘Tazameni huyu mlafi na mlevi, rafiki wa watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi.” ’ Lakini hekima huthibitishwa kuwa kweli kwa matendo yake.”
Ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nigo achete okoria na konywa, na barabwo bateebire: Rora, rinyandambe na omotindu bw’edivai, omosani bw’abarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe! Na obong’aini bwa Nyasae bwamanyekanire koba oboronge ase abana baye bonsi.

English: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akaanza kushutumu miji ambamo alifanya miujiza yake mingi kuliko kwingine, kwa maana watu wake hawakutubu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachaaka gotogonyera emechie eria, aase ebikone biaye ebinge bie chinguru biakorekire, ekiagera etaonchogete:

English: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
Kiswahili: “Ole wako, Korazini! Ole wako Bethsaida! Kwa maana kama miujiza iliyofanyika kwenu, ingefanyika Tiro na Sidoni, miji hiyo ingekuwa imetubu zamani kwa kuvaa magunia na kujipaka majivu.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwao, Korasini! Obobe nobwao, Bethisaida! Ekiagera onye ebikone bie chinguru biakoregete ase more mbiakorekanete ase Turo na Sidoni, anga abanto b’aroro mbaonchogete kare, ase okobeeka chianga chi’echigunia, na kweaka riibu.

English: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
Kiswahili: Lakini nawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Tiro na Sidoni kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu, kuliko ninyi.
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie inwe, n’ebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko ri’ekiina kobua ase more.

English: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.
Kiswahili: Nawe Kapernaumu, je, utainuliwa hadi mbinguni? La hasha, utashushwa mpaka kuzimu.Miujiza iliyofanyika kwako ingefanyika huko Sodoma, mji huo ungalikuwepo hadi leo.
Ekegusii: N’aye Kapernaumu, noimokererigwe igoro? Noche goikigwa goika Eora y’Amakweri, ekiagera onye ebikone bie chinguru ebiakoregete ase ore mbiakoregete ase Sodomu, anga omochie oyio noteneine goika reero.

English: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nakuambia kwamba, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Sodoma kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu kuliko wewe.”
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie inwe ng’a n’ebe aororo ase ense ya Sodomu ase rituko ri’ekiina kobua ase ore.”

English: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yesu alisema, “Nakuhimidi Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na nchi, kwa kuwa umewaficha mambo haya wenye hekima na wenye elimu, nawe ukawafunulia watoto wadogo.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso agakwana, “Nakobaakire aye Tata, Omonene o igoro na ense, ng’a kwababisire abare nobong’aini ne chisemi amang’ana aya, na kwayamaanoire ase abana abake.

English: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
Kiswahili: Naam, Baba, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo ilivyokupendeza.
Ekegusii: Ee, Tata, oko nakwo kwarenge ogwancha kwao okuya.

English: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.
Kiswahili: “Nimekabidhiwa vitu vyote na Baba yangu: Hakuna mtu amjuaye Mwana ila Baba, wala hakuna amjuaye Baba ila Mwana na yeyote ambaye Mwana anapenda kumfunulia.
Ekegusii: “Naeirwe ebinto bionsi na Tata one; monto onde tari omomanyete Omwana otatiga Tata; na onde tari omomanyete Tata otatiga Omwana, na ere oria Omwana agochora komomaanorera.

English: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
Kiswahili: “Njooni kwangu, ninyi nyote mnaotaabika na kulemewa na mizigo, nami nitawapumzisha.
Ekegusii: Inchuo ase ’nde inwe mwensi aba mwarosigwe ase emeremo emerito, na abwo mwabunekire ne chigurube, na inche nimbatimokie.

English: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
Kiswahili: Jifungeni nira yangu, mjifunze kutoka kwangu, kwa maana mimi ni mpole na mnyenyekevu wa moyo, nanyi mtapata raha nafsini mwenu.
Ekegusii: Bogoria rikorogoto riane, mwegere ase ’nde, ekiagera inche nomokanyeku na omoitongo ase enkoro, na inwe namonyore ogotimoka ase emioyo yaino,

English: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nira yangu ni laini na mzigo wangu ni mwepesi.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera rikorogoto riane neriororo, na egurube y’ane nengusu.”

English: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yesu alipitia kwenye mashamba ya nafaka siku ya Sabato. Wanafunzi wake walikuwa na njaa, nao wakaanza kuvunja masuke ya nafaka na kuyala.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso ngoeta arenge gati y’emegondo ase rituko ri’Esabato, aborokigwa baye mbarenge nenchara, bagachaaka kobutora ebigara, bakoria.

English: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mafarisayo walipoona jambo hili, wakamwambia, “Tazama! Wanafunzi wako wanafanya jambo lisilo halali kufanywa siku ya Sabato.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Abafarisai bachia korora aya, bakamoteebia, “Rigereria, aborokigwa bao buna bagokora eritari boronge gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato.”

English: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, hamjasoma alichofanya Daudi na wenzake walipokuwa na njaa?
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete, ekero arenge nenchara, ere na abarenge amo nere,

English: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?
Kiswahili: Aliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, akala mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, yeye na wenzake, jambo ambalo halikuwa halali kwao kufanya, isipokuwa makuhani peke yao.
Ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akaria emegati yarenge korugwa ase Nyasae, nero tiyarenge boronge asare ayerie, gose ase abwo barenge amo nere, otatiga ase abakuani boka?

English: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
Kiswahili: Au hamjasoma katika Sheria kwamba siku ya Sabato makuhani huvunja sheria ya Sabato Hekaluni lakini hawahesabiwi kuwa na hatia?
Ekegusii: Gose timwana gosoma ase amachiiko buna ase rituko ri’ Esabato abakuani be Hekalu nigo bagosaria Esabato, na barabwo tibakoba nokomocha?

English: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.
Kiswahili: Nawaambia wazi kwamba, yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Hekalu yupo hapa.
Ekegusii: Inche nabateebirie, nkere aiga egento ekenene kobua Hekalu.

English: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.
Kiswahili: Kama mngekuwa mmejua maana ya maneno haya, ‘Nataka rehema, wala si dhabihu,’ msingewalaumu watu wasio na hatia,
Ekegusii: Korende onye mwamanyete engencho y’amang’ana aya: Inche nigo ndigetie amaabera, gose tari ekeng’wanso, anga timwagambia abatari nokomocha,

English: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
Kiswahili: kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.”

English: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaondoka mahali hapo, akaingia ndani ya sinagogi lao,
Ekegusii: Akarua aroro, agasoa ase esinagogi yabo.

English: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.
Kiswahili: na huko alikuwepo mtu aliyepooza mkono. Wakitafuta sababu ya kumshtaki Yesu, wakamuuliza, “Je, ni halali kuponya siku ya Sabato?”
Ekegusii: Na rora, narengeo omonto, okoboko kwaye kwagataete. Bakaboria Yeso, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri’Esabato?” Nigo bamoboretie igo erio banyare komosoera.

English: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ni nani miongoni mwenu, mwenye kondoo wake ambaye huyo kondoo akitumbukia shimoni siku ya Sabato hatamtoa?
Ekegusii: Nere akababoria, “Ning’o ase more ore neng’ondi eyemo, na eng’ondi eyio onye yagure ime ase engoro rituko ri’Esabato, takoyebwata ayerusieo?

English: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
Kiswahili: Mtu ana thamani kubwa kuliko kondoo. Kwa hiyo ni halali kutenda mema siku ya Sabato.”
Ekegusii: Inee! Omonto tabueti rigori ri’eng’ondi? Ase igo mboronge gokora amaya ase rituko ri’Esabato.”

English: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akamwambia yule mtu, “Nyoosha mkono wako.” Akaunyoosha, nao ukaponywa ukawa mzima kama ule mwingine.
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao.” Agakorambora; gokagwena, gokaba okogima buna okonde.

English: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mafarisayo wakatoka nje, wakafanya shauri baya juu ya Yesu jinsi watakavyoweza kumuua.
Ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bagasoka isiko, bakagaamba igoro ya Yeso buna barakore bamoite.

English: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu alipoyatambua mawazo yao, akaondoka mahali hapo. Watu wengi wakamfuata, naye akawaponya wagonjwa wao wote,
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia komanya aya, akarua aroro. Abanto abange bakamotunyana, akabagwenia bonsi.

English: and commanded them that they should not make him known,
Kiswahili: akiwakataza wasiseme yeye ni nani.
Ekegusii: Akabachika tibatebia abande igoro yaye.

English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa ili litimie lile neno lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kusema:
Ekegusii: Eri nigo riabeete, erinde rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya,

English: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
Kiswahili: “Tazama mtumishi wangu niliyemchagua, mpendwa wangu, ninayependezwa naye. Nitaweka Roho wangu juu yake, naye atatangaza haki kwa mataifa.
Ekegusii: “Rora, omosomba one oyo nachoorire, omwanchwa one, omoyo one ogokirie nere. Nimobekere Omoika one, nere naraarerie abanto b’Ebisaku ekiina.

English: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
Kiswahili: Hatagombana wala hatapiga kelele, wala hakuna atakayesikia sauti yake njiani.
Ekegusii: Takwomana, gose tagoaka eriogi; nonya nomonto takoigwa eriogi riaye ase chinchera chinene.

English: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
Kiswahili: Mwanzi uliopondeka hatauvunja, na utambi unaofuka moshi hatauzima, mpaka atakapoifanya haki ishinde.
Ekegusii: Egetonto giatachetwe tagokebuna, gose orotambe rw’etaya rokoimoka erioki, takororimia, goika arete oboronge ase okobua;

English: In his name, the nations will hope.”
Kiswahili: Katika Jina lake mataifa wataweka tumaini lao.”
Ekegusii: na ase erieta riaye abanto b’Ebisaku mbasemerie.”

English: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakamletea mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu, na alikuwa kipofu na bubu. Yesu akamponya, hata akaweza kusema na kuona.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio akarenterwa omonto obwatire nekerecha; ere nomouko orenge, naende nigo arenge rimama. Akamogwenia, goika oria orenge omouko ne rimama agakwana na korora.

English: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakashangaa na kusema, “Je, yawezekana huyu ndiye Mwana wa Daudi?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagakumia, bakaboorania, “Inee! Oyo nanyare koba omwana o Daudi?”

English: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mafarisayo waliposikia jambo hili wakasema, “Mtu huyu anatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa Beelzebuli, mkuu wa pepo wachafu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bagachia koyaigwa, bagateeba, “Oyo tari korusia ebirecha otatiga ase chinguru chia Beelizebuli omonene bw’ebirecha.”

English: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
Kiswahili: Yesu alijua walichokuwa wakiwaza, hivyo akawaambia, “Kila ufalme ukigawanyika dhidi yake wenyewe huangamia. Hali kadhalika kila mji au watu wa nyumba moja waliogawanyika dhidi yao wenyewe hawawezi kusimama.
Ekegusii: Yeso Konya omanyire ebirengererio biabo, akabateebia, “Kera oborwoti kobwatananekire borobwo obonyene tibogotenena; na kera omochie na enyomba kobiatananekanire, birobio ebinyene tibigotenena;

English: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
Kiswahili: Kama Shetani akimtoa Shetani, atakuwa amegawanyika yeye mwenyewe. Basi ufalme wake utawezaje kusimama?
Ekegusii: na Saitani karaserie Saitani, igo bweatananire ere omonyene, Inee, oborwoti bwaye, naki boratenene?

English: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
Kiswahili: Nami kama natoa pepo wachafu kwa nguvu za Beelzebuli, watu wenu je, wao hutoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa nani? Hivyo basi, wao ndio watakaowahukumu.
Ekegusii: Na inche, onye ngoseeria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli, Inee, abana baino nase ng’o bakobiseeria? Ase engencho eyio, barabwo inababe abagaambi baino.

English: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa Roho wa Mungu, basi Ufalme wa Mungu umekuja juu yenu.
Ekegusii: Korende onye ngoseeria ebirecha ase Omoika o Nyasae, igo oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwabacheire.

English: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.
Kiswahili: “Au tena, mtu awezaje kuingia katika nyumba ya mtu mwenye nguvu na kuteka nyara mali zake asipomfunga kwanza yule mwenye nguvu? Akishamfunga, ndipo hakika anaweza kuteka nyara mali zake.
Ekegusii: Gose inaki omonto aranyare gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani omonto oria omonyene chinguru? Erio magega anyare gosakora enyomba yaye.

English: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
Kiswahili: “Mtu asiyekuwa pamoja nami yu kinyume nami, na mtu ambaye hakusanyi pamoja nami, hutawanya.
Ekegusii: Omonto otari amo nainche nigo are mamincha ase ’nde. Nere oyotari gosangereria amo nainche nigo agoserebania.

English: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nawaambia, kila dhambi na kufuru watu watasamehewa, lakini mtu atakayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nabateebirie, kera ebibe na okorama Mwanyabaanto nabaaberwe, korende onye bagochecheria Omoika tibakwaberwa.

English: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote atakayesema neno dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu atasamehewa, lakini yeyote anenaye neno dhidi ya Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa, iwe katika ulimwengu huu au katika ulimwengu ujao.
Ekegusii: Na omonto onde bwensi orakwane ring’ana riibe ase Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto, naaberwe; korende onde bwensi orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa ase ense eye, nonya nase eria egochi‐gocha.

English: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.
Kiswahili: “Ufanye mti kuwa mzuri, nayo matunda yake yatakuwa mazuri. Au ufanye mti kuwa mbaya, na matunda yake yatakuwa mabaya. Kwa maana mti hutambulika kwa matunda yake.
Ekegusii: “Kora omote obe omuya, na amatunda aye abe amaya; gose kora omote obe omobe, na amatunda aye abe amabe; naki omote nigo okomanyekana ase okwama kwaye.

English: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.
Kiswahili: Enyi uzao wa nyoka! Mnawezaje kunena mambo mema, wakati ninyi ni waovu? Kwa maana kinywa cha mtu huyanena yale yaliyoujaza moyo wake.
Ekegusii: Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti! Naki moranyare gokwana amaya ekero more ababe? Ekiagera ebiichire ase enkoro, nabio omonwa ogokwana.

English: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.
Kiswahili: Mtu mwema hutoa yaliyo mema kutoka hazina ya mambo mema yaliyohifadhiwa ndani yake, naye mtu mwovu hutoa yaliyo maovu kutoka hazina ya mambo maovu yaliyohifadhiwa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto omuya, ase emonga yaye engiya nigo akorua amaya, na omonto omobe, ase emonga yaye embe nigo akorua amabe.

English: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
Kiswahili: Lakini nawaambia, katika siku ya hukumu watu watatoa hesabu kuhusu kila neno lisilo maana walilonena.
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie, ng’a ase kera ring’ana ritari nengencho Mwanyabaanto barakwane, ase rituko ri’ekiina ’nabache korua omobaro.

English: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa maneno yako utahesabiwa haki, na kwa maneno yako utahukumiwa.”
Ekegusii: Inaki ase amang’ana ao noegwe oboronge, na ase amang’ana ao nogaambigwe.”

English: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
Kiswahili: Kisha baadhi ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, tunataka kuona ishara kutoka kwako.”
Ekegusii: Erio abande ase aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bakamoteebia, “Omwarimu, ntorigetie torore egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa ase ore.”

English: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye akawajibu, “Kizazi kiovu na cha uzinzi kinaomba ishara! Lakini hakitapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ile ishara ya nabii Yona.
Ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria, “Ekegori ekebe ki’obotomani kerigetie egekone, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga eki’omobani Yona.

English: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile Yona alivyokuwa ndani ya tumbo la nyangumikwa siku tatu, usiku na mchana, vivyo hivyo Mwana wa Adamu atakuwa katika moyo wa nchi siku tatu, usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: Inaki buna Yona abeete ime ase enda y’enswe enene ase engaki y’emebaso etato na amatuko atato, nabo na Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere arabe ime ase enkoro y’ense emebaso etato na amatuko atato.

English: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.
Kiswahili: Siku ya hukumu watu wa Ninawi watasimama pamoja na kizazi hiki na kukihukumu; kwa maana wao walitubu waliposikia mahubiri ya Yona. Na tazama, hapa yupo yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Yona.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Ninawi nabatenene ase rituko ri’ekiina amo n’abanto b’ekegori eke, na barabwo nabakenachere ekiina, ekiagera barabwo nigo baonchogete ase okorandia kwa Yona, na rora, oyobuete Yona naiga are.

English: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.
Kiswahili: Malkia wa Kusini atasimama wakati wa hukumu na kukihukumu kizazi hiki. Kwa kuwa yeye alikuja kutoka miisho ya dunia ili kuisikiliza hekima ya Solomoni. Na hapa yupo aliye mkuu kuliko Solomoni.”
Ekegusii: Enting’ana ya Irianyi netenene ase ekiina amo n’abanto b’ekegori eke; ere nabanachere ekiina, ekiagera arwete ase chinsinyo chi’ense anyare koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani, na rora, oyobuete Sulemani naiga are.

English: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
Kiswahili: “Pepo mchafu amtokapo mtu, hutangatanga katika sehemu zisizo na maji akitafuta mahali pa kupumzika, lakini hapati.
Ekegusii: “Ekero ekerecha ki’eubi kiarure ase omonto, nigo kegoeta gati aase atari namaache, kiarigia aase kegotimokera, korende tigekonyora.

English: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
Kiswahili: Ndipo husema, ‘Nitarudi kwenye nyumba yangu nilikotoka.’ Naye arudipo huikuta ile nyumba ikiwa tupu, imefagiliwa na kupangwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Erio kiabora: ‘Ning’irane ase enyomba y’ane aase narwete.’ Gakegocha kiayenyora nenchwa, yaabusirwe, yaroisigwe.

English: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”
Kiswahili: Kisha huenda na kuwaleta pepo wachafu wengine saba wabaya kuliko yeye mwenyewe, nao huingia na kukaa humo. Nayo hali ya mwisho ya yule mtu huwa ni mbaya kuliko ile ya kwanza. Ndivyo itakavyokuwa kwa kizazi hiki kiovu.”
Ekegusii: Erio kiagenda, kiarentana ebirecha binde bitano na bibere (7), ebire ebibe kobua kerokio ekenyene. Nabirobio biasoa na komenya aroro; okoba kw’omoerio kw’omonto oyio kwaba okobe kobua okwe ritang’ani. Naboigo erache koba ase ekegori eke ekebe.”

English: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
Kiswahili: Wakati alikuwa angali anazungumza na makutano, mama yake na ndugu zake wakasimama nje wakitaka kuongea naye.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana n’abanto, rora, ng’ina na bamura bamwabo nigo bateneine isiko, barigetie gokwana nere.

English: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtu mmoja akamwambia, “Tazama, mama yako na ndugu zako wamesimama nje, wanataka kuongea na wewe.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo akamoteebia, “Rora, nyoko na bamura bamino mbateneine isiko, barigetie gokwana naye.”

English: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye akamjibu na kumwambia yule mtu, “Mama yangu ni nani, nao ndugu zangu ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Korende akairaneria oria omotebetie, akabora, “Baba nere ng’o? Na bamura baminto mbarabi?”

English: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
Kiswahili: Akawanyooshea mkono wanafunzi wake, akasema, “Hawa hapa ndio mama yangu na ndugu zangu!
Ekegusii: Akarambora okoboko kwaye ase aborokigwa baye, akabora, “Rora baba na bamura baminto!

English: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeyote afanyaye mapenzi ya Baba yangu wa mbinguni, huyo ndiye ndugu yangu, na dada yangu na mama yangu.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera oyorakore ogwancha gwa Tata one ore igoro, oyio nere momura ominto, na mosubati ominto, na baba.”

English: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.
Kiswahili: Siku iyo hiyo Yesu akatoka nje ya nyumba, akaketi kando ya bahari.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riria Yeso akarua nyomba agaikaransa ase enyancha mbarabare.

English: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa mno wa watu ukakusanyika kumzunguka, hata ikabidi aingie katika chombo na kuketi humo, nao watu wote wakawa wamesimama ukingoni mwa bahari.
Ekegusii: Emeganda emenene ekamosangererekanera, goika ere akariina obwato ime, agaikaransa aroro, na omoganda bwonsi ogatenena ase engegu.

English: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akawaambia mambo mengi kwa mifano, akisema: “Mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia amang’ana amange ase emebayeeno, okobora, “Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura.

English: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia, nao ndege wakaja na kuzila.
Ekegusii: Ekero are kobusura, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigaacha, chigachiria,

English: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
Kiswahili: Nyingine zilianguka kwenye ardhi yenye mwamba isiyo na udongo wa kutosha. Zikaota haraka, kwa kuwa udongo ulikuwa haba.
Ekegusii: na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, aase amaroba arenge amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.

English: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.
Kiswahili: Lakini jua lilipozidi, mimea ikanyauka na kukauka kwa kuwa mizizi yake haikuwa na kina.
Ekegusii: Omobaso ogachia kobara, chigasusana, na ekiagera chitarenge nemeri, chikooma.

English: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
Kiswahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye miiba, nayo miiba hiyo ikakua, ikaisonga hiyo mimea.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakiina, agachimiga.

English: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.
Kiswahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri ambapo zilitoa mazao, nyingine mara mia moja, nyingine mara sitini, na nyingine mara thelathini.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikaama echinde rigana, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, na echinde emerongo etato.

English: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
Kiswahili: Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”
Ekegusii: Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe!”

English: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea, wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini unasema na watu kwa mifano?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamoboria, “Nase ki kware gokwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno?”

English: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Ninyi mmepewa kuzifahamu siri za Ufalme wa Mbinguni, lakini wao hawajapewa.
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oborwoti bwa igoro, korende barabwo tibaeiri.

English: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yule aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi, naye atakuwa navyo tele. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.
Ekegusii: Inaki oyore na gento naegwe, nere namenteranigwe; korende oyotabwati gento naurwe nonya nkeria abwate.

English: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu nasema nao kwa mifano: “Ingawa wanatazama, hawaoni; wanasikiliza, lakini hawasikii, wala hawaelewi.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio gekogera ngokwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno, ekiagera okorigereria ’nabarigererie, korende tibakorora, na ogotegerera nabategerere, korende tibakoigwa, nonya nokomanya, tibakomanya.

English: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;
Kiswahili: Kwao unatimia ule unabii wa Isaya aliposema: “ ‘Hakika mtasikiliza lakini hamtaelewa; na pia mtatazama lakini hamtaona.
Ekegusii: Ase barabwo obobani bwa Isaya bwaikeranire, obogoteeba: Okoigwa namoigwe, korende timokomanya nonya ng’ake, na okorigereria namorigererie, korende timokorora nonya ng’ake.

English: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mioyo ya watu hawa imekuwa migumu; hawasikii kwa masikio yao, na wamefumba macho yao. Wasije wakaona kwa macho yao, na wakasikiliza kwa masikio yao, wakaelewa kwa mioyo yao, na kugeuka nami nikawaponya.’
Ekegusii: Inaki chinkoro chi’ abanto aba chiabeire chinyoro, na amato abo nigo are amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo bayamiamirie, tibacha korora namaiso abo gose koigwa namato abo, gose bamanye ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, na inche mbagwenie.

English: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
Kiswahili: Lakini heri macho yenu kwa sababu yanaona, na heri masikio yenu kwa sababu yanasikia.
Ekegusii: Korende amaiso aino nasesenirie, ekiagera nkorora are, na amato aino, ekiagera nkoigwa are.

English: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, manabii wengi na wenye haki walitamani kuona yale mnayoyaona lakini hawakuyaona, na walitamani kusikia yale mnayoyasikia lakini hawakuyasikia.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Abaabani abange na abanyene oboronge mbaganetie korora aya morooche inwe, tibayarora, na koigwa aya mokoigwa inwe, tibayaigwa.

English: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
Kiswahili: “Sikilizeni basi maana ya ule mfano wa mpanzi:
Ekegusii: “Gaki, igwa omobayeeno bw’omobusuri.

English: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote anaposikia neno la Ufalme naye asilielewe, yule mwovu huja na kunyakua kile kilichopandwa moyoni mwake. Hii ndiyo ile mbegu iliyopandwa kando ya njia.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoigwa ring’ana ri’oborwoti, na ere takorimanya, nigo agocha oria omobe, otaboria riria riasimekirwe ase enkoro yaye, oyo nere obusuirwe ase enchera ensemo.

English: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;
Kiswahili: Ile mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye sehemu yenye mawe ni mtu yule ambaye hulisikia neno na mara hulipokea kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase egetare nere oria okoigwa ring’ana, erio kegima oribwata nomogooko,

English: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kuwa hana mizizi yenye kina ndani yake, lile neno hudumu kwa muda mfupi tu. Kisha dhiki au mateso yanapoinuka kwa ajili ya lile neno, yeye mara huchukizwa.
Ekegusii: korende tari nemeri ime yaye, ogenderera ekero egeke; na ekero emechando egochi‐gocha, gose okorosigwa ase engencho ye ring’ana, erio bwango ogwa korwa ase okwegena kwaye.

English: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
Kiswahili: Ile mbegu iliyopandwa katika miiba ni yule mtu alisikiaye neno, lakini masumbufu ya maisha haya na udanganyifu wa mali hulisonga lile neno na kulifanya lisizae matunda.
Ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase amagwa, oyo nere okoigwa ring’ana; okorengereria gw’ense na obong’ainereria bw’eniibo biaba nkomiga bire ring’ana, riaba tirikwama.

English: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ile mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye udongo mzuri ni yule mtu ambaye hulisikia neno na kulielewa. Naye hakika huzaa matunda, akizaa mara mia, au mara sitini, au mara thelathini ya mbegu iliyopandwa.”
Ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase amaroba amaya, nere oria okoigwa ring’ana, orimanya; nere ekeene bwama okwama. Oyomo bwama rigana, na oyonde emerongo etano nomo, na oyonde emerongo etato.”

English: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia mfano mwingine, akasema: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unaweza kufananishwa na mtu aliyepanda mbegu nzuri katika shamba lake.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, agateeba, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oye;

English: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati kila mtu alipokuwa amelala, adui yake akaja na kupanda magugu katikati ya ngano, akaenda zake.
Ekegusii: korende ekero abanto bararire, omobisa oye agacha akabusura amabanchore ime ase engano, akagenda.

English: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.
Kiswahili: Ngano ilipoota na kutoa masuke, magugu nayo yakatokea.
Ekegusii: Egachia komera ekama chinyeke, erio amabanchore naro akarorekana.

English: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’
Kiswahili: “Watumishi wa yule mwenye shamba wakamjia na kumwambia, ‘Bwana, si tulipanda mbegu nzuri shambani mwako? Basi, magugu yametoka wapi?’
Ekegusii: Erio abasomba b’omonyene enyomba bagaacha, bakamobooria: Omonene, tikwabusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oo? Inaki rende ororekanire namabanchore?

English: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’
Kiswahili: “Akawajibu, ‘Adui ndiye alifanya jambo hili.’ “Wale watumishi wakamuuliza, ‘Je, unataka twende tukayangʼoe?’
Ekegusii: Akabateebia: Nomobisa okorete ayio. Abasomba bakamobooria: Inee! Norigetie tochie toyasimore?

English: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
Kiswahili: “Lakini akasema, ‘Hapana, msiyangʼoe, kwa maana wakati mkingʼoa magugu mnaweza mkangʼoa na ngano pamoja nayo.
Ekegusii: Akabakania: Yaya; moise koyasimora amabanchore namoiye engano amo naro.

English: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”
Kiswahili: Acheni ngano na magugu vikue vyote pamoja mpaka wakati wa mavuno. Wakati huo nitawaambia wavunaji wayakusanye magugu kwanza, wayafunge matita matita ili yachomwe moto; kisha wakusanye ngano na kuileta ghalani mwangu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Bitige bikiine bionsi bibere goika rigesa, na ekero kie rigesa ninteebie abakogesa: Ritang’ani sangereria amabanchore, moyaboe emesaima monyare koyasamba; korende engano moyesangererie gochia kiage kiane.”

English: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,
Kiswahili: Akawaambia mfano mwingine, akasema, “Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama punje ya haradali, ambayo mtu aliichukua, akaipanda shambani mwake.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, agateeba, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nentetere y’omosirapi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye;

English: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”
Kiswahili: Ingawa mbegu hiyo ni ndogo kuliko mbegu zote, lakini inapokua ni mmea mkubwa kuliko yote ya bustanini, nao huwa mti mkubwa, hadi ndege wa angani wanakuja na kutengeneza viota katika matawi yake.”
Ekegusii: ero nenke mono kobua chimbusuro chionsi, korende koyakiinire yaba enene kobua ebimeri bionsi, eba omote, goika chinyoni chia igoro chichia koroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”

English: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia mfano mwingine, “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na chachu ambayo mwanamke aliichukua akaichanganya katika kiasi kikubwa cha unga mpaka wote ukaumuka.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nememera omokungu abogoretie, akayebeka ase ebirengo bitato bi’obosie, goika bionsi bikabota.”

English: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
Kiswahili: Yesu alinena mambo haya yote kwa makutano kwa mifano. Wala hakuwaambia lolote pasipo mfano.
Ekegusii: Aya onsi Yeso nigo ayakwanete ase emeganda eria ase emereng’anio; na tabateebeetie ring’ana otatiga ase emebayeeno,

English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa ili kutimiza lile lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii aliposema: “Nitafungua kinywa changu niseme nao kwa mifano; nitahubiri mambo yaliyofichika tangu kuumbwa kwa misingi ya ulimwengu.”
Ekegusii: erinde rinyare goikeranigwa eriatebetwe nomobani, “Nimaanore omonwa one ase emebayeeno, inyatore ayabisegete korwa ogotongwa gw’ense.”

English: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akaagana na makutano, akaingia nyumbani. Wanafunzi wake wakamjia wakamwambia, “Tueleze maana ya ule mfano wa magugu shambani.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatiga emeganda, akagenda nyomba. Aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakobora, “Totebererie omobayeeno bw’amabanchore a mogondo.”

English: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Aliyepanda mbegu nzuri ni Mwana wa Adamu.
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Oyogosimeka embusuro engiya n’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto;

English: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
Kiswahili: Shamba ni ulimwengu na mbegu nzuri ni wana wa Ufalme. Magugu ni wana wa yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: omogondo nense; embusuro eyio engiya nabana b’oborwoti; na amabanchore nabwo abana boria omobe.

English: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
Kiswahili: Yule adui aliyepanda magugu ni ibilisi. Mavuno ni mwisho wa dunia, nao wavunaji ni malaika.
Ekegusii: Omobisa oria oyasimegete nere Saitani; rigesa nomoerio bw’ense, na abaraache kogesa nabamalaika.

English: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
Kiswahili: “Kama vile magugu yangʼolewavyo na kuchomwa motoni, ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa mwisho wa dunia.
Ekegusii: Buna amabanchore agosangererigwa asambwa nomorero, naboigo nomoerio bw’ense orache koba.

English: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu atawatuma malaika zake, nao watakusanya kutoka Ufalme wake kila kitu kinachosababisha dhambi na watenda maovu wote.
Ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto natome abamalaika baye, na barabwo nabasangererie na kobarusia korwa ase oborwoti bwaye abakogera abande bagochwe, na abagokora ebibe bonsi,

English: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Kiswahili: Nao watawatupa katika tanuru la moto ambako kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.
Ekegusii: nababatugute ase eriiko ri’omorero. Aroro agwo abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.

English: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wenye haki watangʼaa kama jua katika Ufalme wa Baba yao. Yeye aliye na masikio, na asikie.
Ekegusii: Erio abanyene oboronge nabagirigente buna erioba ase oborwoti bwa Ise obo. Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.

English: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
Kiswahili: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na hazina iliyofichwa shambani, ambayo mtu mmoja alipoiona akaificha tena. Kisha katika furaha yake, akaenda akauza vyote alivyokuwa navyo, akalinunua lile shamba.”
Ekegusii: “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine neniibo yabisire ase omogondo, eye omonto anyorete, akayebisa; erio ase omogooko oye akagenda, akaoonia ebi abwate bionsi, akagora omogondo oria.

English: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
Kiswahili: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na mfanyabiashara aliyekuwa akitafuta lulu safi.
Ekegusii: “Naende oborwoti bwa igoro mbogwekanirie nomonto omoonchoreria, okorigia chiruru chingiya.

English: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.
Kiswahili: Alipoipata lulu moja ya thamani kubwa, alikwenda akauza vyote alivyokuwa navyo akainunua.”
Ekegusii: Ere agachia korora eruru eyemo ye rigori rinene, akaimoka akagenda, akaoonia ebi abwate bionsi, akayegora.

English: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,
Kiswahili: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama wavu wa kuvua samaki uliotupwa baharini ukavua samaki wa kila aina.
Ekegusii: “Naende oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bonga buna ekeonga ekiarutetwe ase enyancha ime, kegasangereria chinswe chia kera egesaku.

English: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
Kiswahili: Ulipojaa, wavuvi wakavuta pwani, wakaketi na kukusanya samaki wazuri kuwaweka kwenye vyombo safi, lakini wale samaki wabaya wakawatupa.
Ekegusii: Ekero giaichoire, abanto bagakeng’usa gocha engegu; bagaikaransa, bagasangereria chiria chingiya ase amakuru, na chiria chimbe bagachituguta.

English: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa mwisho wa dunia. Malaika watakuja na kuwatenganisha watu waovu na watu wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Naboigo eraache koba ase omoerio bw’ense. Abamalaika nabaoroke bache gwatanana baria ababe korwa ase abanyene oboronge,

English: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
Kiswahili: Nao watawatupa hao waovu katika tanuru la moto ambako kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.”
Ekegusii: babatugute ase eriiko ri’omorero. Aroro agwo abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.”

English: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akauliza, “Je, mmeyaelewa haya yote?” Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Mwamanyire aya onsi?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee.”

English: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Basi kila mwalimu wa sheria aliyefundishwa elimu ya Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama mwenye nyumba anayetoa kutoka ghala yake mali mpya na mali ya zamani.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ase engencho eyio kera Omwarimu bw’amariiko oyokorirwe koba omworokigwa bw’oborwoti bwa igoro, obeire omogwekano bw’omonyene enyomba, oyokorua ase emonga yaye ebinto ebiyia na ebikoro.”

English: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomaliza kutoa mifano hii, akaondoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire emebayeeno eyio, akarua aroro, akagenda aase aande.

English: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
Kiswahili: Alipofika mji wa kwao, akawafundisha watu katika sinagogi lao. Nao wakastaajabu, wakauliza, “Mtu huyu amepata wapi hekima hii na uwezo huu wa kufanya miujiza?”
