Ekegusii: Agachia goika ense yaye omonyene, akaborokereria ase esinagogi yabo, goika bagakumia, bagateebania, “Oyo ng’ai anyorire obong’aini obo na ogokora oko gwe chinguru?

English: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
Kiswahili: “Huyu si yule mwana wa seremala? Mama yake si yeye aitwaye Maria, nao ndugu zake si Yakobo, Yosefu, Simoni na Yuda?
Ekegusii: Oyo tari omwana bw’omobaachi? Ngi’na tari oria okorokwa Mariamu? Na bamura bamwabo tibari Yakobo, na Yusufu na Simioni, na Yuda?

English: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
Kiswahili: Nao dada zake wote, hawako hapa pamoja nasi? Mtu huyu amepata wapi basi mambo haya yote?”
Ekegusii: Na basubati bamwabo bonsi tibari aa seito? Gaki oyo ng’ai ayanyorire aya onsi?”

English: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”
Kiswahili: Wakachukizwa naye. Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Nabii hakosi heshima, isipokuwa katika nchi yake na nyumbani kwake.”
Ekegusii: Bakagechigwa asare. Korende Yeso akabateebia, “Omobani takoborwa ogosikwa otatiga ase abanto baye na ime ase ense yaye.”

English: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
Kiswahili: Naye hakufanya miujiza mingi huko kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwao.
Ekegusii: Ere takorete amakumia amange agwo, ekiagera batarenge nokwegena.

English: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, Mfalme Herode, mtawala wa Galilaya, alisikia habari za Yesu,
Ekegusii: Ekero keria Herode omorwoti o Galili akaigwa chinkuma igoro ya Yeso;

English: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
Kiswahili: akawaambia watumishi wake, “Huyu ni Yohana Mbatizaji; amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu! Hii ndiyo sababu nguvu za kutenda miujiza zinafanya kazi ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: agateebia abasomba baye, “Oyo nere Yohana Omobatisi, obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure, eke nakio gekogera chinguru echio chigokora emeremo asare.”

English: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
Kiswahili: Herode alikuwa amemkamata Yohana, akamfunga na kumweka gerezani kwa sababu ya Herodia, mke wa Filipo, ndugu yake,
Ekegusii: Inaki Herode konya obwatire Yohana, omosibire, omobekire echela ase engencho ya Herodia, moka Filipo, momura omwabo,

English: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa Yohana alikuwa amemwambia Herode: “Si halali kwako kuwa na huyo mwanamke.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Yohana amotebetie, “Teri boronge ase ore komenyana nere.”

English: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
Kiswahili: Herode alitaka sana kumuua Yohana, lakini akaogopa watu, kwa maana walimtambua kuwa ni nabii.
Ekegusii: Goika akarigia komoita, korende akairoka abanto, ekiagera konya banchire ng’a Yohana n’omobani orenge.

English: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.
Kiswahili: Katika siku ya kuadhimisha sikukuu ya kuzaliwa kwa Herode, binti wa Herodia alicheza mbele ya watu waliohudhuria, akamfurahisha sana Herode,
Ekegusii: Rigachia goika rituko ri’okoinyora okoiborwa kwaye Herode, omoiseke bwe Herodia agatenga gati‐gati y’ abanto, akagokia Herode.

English: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.
Kiswahili: kiasi kwamba aliahidi kwa kiapo kumpa huyo binti chochote angeomba.
Ekegusii: Erio Herode agatiana ase okomoriera eira ng’a namoe kende gionsi araborie.

English: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
Kiswahili: Huyo binti, akiwa amechochewa na mama yake, akasema, “Nipe kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji kwenye sinia.”
Ekegusii: Kobwatekana n’obosemia bwa ng’ina omoiseke oria agateeba, “Ing’a omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi aiga ase esani.”

English: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
Kiswahili: Mfalme akasikitika, lakini kwa sababu ya viapo alivyoapa mbele ya wageni, akaamuru kwamba apatiwe ombi lake.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agaichana, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye na abageni baye ase omoyega, agachiika ayoegwe.

English: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akaagiza Yohana Mbatizaji akatwe kichwa mle gerezani.
Ekegusii: Agatoma omonto ase echela ime anache Yohana omotwe.

English: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.
Kiswahili: Kichwa chake kikaletwa kwenye sinia, akapewa yule binti, naye akampelekea mama yake.
Ekegusii: Omotwe oye okarentwa ase esani, okaegwa omoiseke oria, na ere akayoira ase ng’ina.

English: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Yohana wakaja na kuuchukua mwili wake kwenda kuuzika. Kisha wakaenda wakamwambia Yesu.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagachia bakabogoria omobere, bakayotindeka, bakagenda, bagateebia Yeso amang’ana ayio.

English: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia yaliyokuwa yametukia, aliondoka kwa chombo akaenda mahali pasipo na watu ili awe peke yake. Lakini watu walipopata habari, wakamfuata kwa miguu kupitia nchi kavu kutoka miji.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akarua agwo nobwato, akagenda ere bweka aase abanto batari. Korende ekero emeganda yachia koigwa aya, bakamotunyana namagoro korwa ase emechie.

English: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipofika kando ya bahari, aliona makutano makubwa ya watu, akawahurumia na akawaponya wagonjwa wao.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikire engegu, akarora omoganda omonene, akabarorera amaabera, akagwenia abarwaire babo.

English: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”
Kiswahili: Ilipofika jioni, wanafunzi wake walienda kwake, wakamwambia, “Mahali hapa ni nyikani, na muda sasa umekwisha. Waage makutano ili waende zao vijijini wakajinunulie chakula.”
Ekegusii: Ekero riachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Aase aa negesomo, ngochia koira bore, batige abanto bagende ebinyoro begorere endagera.”

English: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Hakuna sababu ya wao kuondoka. Ninyi wapeni chakula.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tibagwenereti kogenda; inwe bae endagera barie.”

English: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Tuna mikate mitano na samaki wawili tu.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoteebia, “Titobwati gento aiga, otatiga emegati etano ne chinswe ibere.”

English: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Nileteeni hivyo vitu hapa.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Bindetere aiga.”

English: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaagiza makutano wakae chini kwenye nyasi. Akaichukua ile mikate mitano na wale samaki wawili, akainua macho yake akatazama mbinguni, akavibariki na kuimega ile mikate. Kisha akawapa wanafunzi, nao wanafunzi wakawagawia makutano.
Ekegusii: Agachiika emeganda eikaranse inse ase obonyansi; akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati, akaa aborokigwa emegati eria, na aborokigwa bakayea emeganda.

English: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
Kiswahili: Wote wakala, wakashiba. Nao wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili.
Ekegusii: Bakaria bonsi, bakaigota. Bagasangereria ebisamunye bi’emegati ebiatigarete, ebitonga ikomi na bibere biichire.

English: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
Kiswahili: Idadi ya watu waliokula walikuwa wanaume wapatao 5,000, bila kuhesabu wanawake na watoto.
Ekegusii: Na abwo bariete nigo barenge abasacha ange chilifu isano (5,000), otatiga abakungu na abana.

English: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
Kiswahili: Mara Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake waingie kwenye mashua watangulie kwenda ngʼambo ya bahari, wakati yeye alikuwa akiwaaga wale makutano.
Ekegusii: Erio agachiika aborokigwa baye bariine obwato, bamotang’anere kogenda ng’umbu ende, goika akaa emeganda ribaga egende.

English: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwaaga, akaenda zake mlimani peke yake kuomba. Jioni ilipofika, Yesu alikuwa huko peke yake.
Ekegusii: Na nyuma kaeire emeganda ribaga kogenda, akariina ebitunwa igoro ere bweka gochia gosaba. Riachia koba mogoroba akaba agwo bweka.

English: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo ile mashua ilikuwa mbali kutoka nchi kavu ikisukwasukwa na mawimbi, kwa sababu upepo ulikuwa wa mbisho.
Ekegusii: Korende obwato konya bwaikire enyancha gati bokorunda‐rundigwa nemerindo, ekiagera omwaga nigo obatangete.

English: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa zamu ya nne ya usiku, Yesu akawaendea wanafunzi wake akiwa anatembea juu ya maji.
Ekegusii: Na ekero kiabotuko ange gokiamoka, Yeso agacha ase bare, ogotaara ase enyancha igoro.

English: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake walipomwona akitembea juu ya maji, waliingiwa na hofu kuu, wakasema, “Ni mzimu.” Wakapiga yowe kwa kuogopa.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa bachia komorora ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, bakaondoka, bakaboora, “Eri nerirengari!” Bagaaka eriogi ase okoiroka.

English: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mara Yesu akasema nao, akawaambia, “Jipeni moyo! Ni mimi. Msiogope.”
Ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso agakwana nabarabwo, akabora, “Remia chinkoro! Ninche. Timoiroka!”

English: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
Kiswahili: Petro akamjibu, “Bwana, ikiwa ni wewe, niambie nije kwako nikitembea juu ya maji.”
Ekegusii: Petero akamoiraneria, “Omonene, onye naye, ’nchiike nchiche agwo ase ore igoro ase amaache.”

English: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Njoo.” Basi Petro akatoka kwenye chombo, akatembea juu ya maji kumwelekea Yesu.
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Inchuo!” Petero agaika korwa ase obwato, agataara igoro ase amaache, gochia ase Yeso.

English: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
Kiswahili: Lakini alipoona upepo mkali aliingiwa na hofu, naye akaanza kuzama, huku akipiga kelele, “Bwana, niokoe!”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero achia korora omwaga bw’echinguru, akairoka, agachaaka korimera amaache ime, agaaka eriogi, agateeba, “Omonene ntooria!”

English: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
Kiswahili: Mara Yesu akaunyoosha mkono wake na kumshika, akamwambia, “Wewe mwenye imani haba, kwa nini uliona shaka?”
Ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamobwata akamoteebia, “Aye omonto bw’okwegena ogoke, nase ki okwoboa?”

English: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
Kiswahili: Nao walipoingia ndani ya mashua, upepo ukakoma.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koriina obwato ime, omwaga ogakira.

English: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wote waliokuwa ndani ya ile mashua wakamwabudu Yesu, wakisema, “Hakika, wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: N’abwo abarenge ase obwato ime bakamosasiima, bagateeba, “Ekeene, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuvuka, wakafika nchi ya Genesareti.
Ekegusii: Ekero bambokire, bagaika ense ya Genesareti.

English: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;
Kiswahili: Watu wa eneo lile walipomtambua Yesu, walipeleka habari sehemu zote za jirani. Watu wakamletea wagonjwa wao wote,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’orogongo roria bachia komomanya, bagatoma amang’ana ase chinsemo chionsi, bamorentere bonsi abarenge abarwaire;

English: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
Kiswahili: wakamsihi awaruhusu wagonjwa waguse tu pindo la vazi lake, nao wote waliomgusa, wakaponywa.
Ekegusii: bakamosorora ng’a abae ribaga bakune nonya nomokoba bw’eyanga yaye; na bonsi abayokunete bakagwenigwa.

English: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo baadhi ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakamjia Yesu kutoka Yerusalemu na kumuuliza,
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariiko bakarwa Yerusalemu, bagachiera Yeso, bakamoboria,

English: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
Kiswahili: “Mbona wanafunzi wako wanakiuka mapokeo ya wazee? Kwa maana wao hawanawi mikono yao kabla ya kula!”
Ekegusii: “Nase ki aborokigwa bao bagosaria chingencho chi’abagaaka? Inaki kobakoragera tibari goisaaba amaboko abo buna egwenerete.”

English: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mbona ninyi mnavunja amri ya Mungu kwa ajili ya mapokeo yenu?
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, Nase ki inwe mogosaria ogochika kwa Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino?

English: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu alisema, ‘Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,’ na, ‘Yeyote amtukanaye baba yake au mama yake, na auawe.’
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae nigo achiigete, agateeba: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng’ina, ogokwa nakwe.

English: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi mwafundisha kwamba mtu akimwambia baba yake au mama yake, ‘Kile ambacho ningeweza kukusaidia kimewekwa wakfu kwa Mungu,’
Ekegusii: Korende inwe moteba: Oyoratebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa ase ’nde biaeirwe Nyasae, ere temogwenereti gosika ise.

English: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.
Kiswahili: basi hana tena sababu ya kumheshimu baba yake nacho. Basi kwa ajili ya mafundisho yenu mnavunja amri ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase chingencho chiaino chia kare nigo mogosaria ring’ana ria Nyasae.

English: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
Kiswahili: Ninyi wanafiki! Isaya alikuwa sawa alipotabiri juu yenu kwamba:
Ekegusii: Inwe abang’ainereria! Mbuya Isaya abanete igoro ase more, ekero ateebete:

English: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Watu hawa huniheshimu kwa midomo yao, lakini mioyo yao iko mbali nami.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bansigete ase ebikoba biabo igoro, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa ase ’nde.

English: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”
Kiswahili: Huniabudu bure; nayo mafundisho yao ni maagizo ya wanadamu tu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagonsasiima ogosasiima kwa bosa kobakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiiko a Mwanyabaanto oka.

English: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaita ule umati wa watu, akawaambia, “Sikilizeni na mwelewe:
Ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto bache asare, akabateebia, “Igwa na manya:

English: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”
Kiswahili: kinachomfanya mtu kuwa najisi mbele za Mungu si kile kiingiacho kinywani mwake, bali ni kile kitokacho kinywani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Tari ekio kegosoa omonwa gekobekera omonto ogotacheneka, korende egekorwa ase omonwa nakio ekio gekobekera omonto ogotacheneka.”

English: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”
Kiswahili: Kisha wanafunzi wake wakamjia na kumuuliza, “Je, unajua kwamba Mafarisayo walichukizwa sana waliposikia yale uliyosema?”
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamoboria, “Inee! Kwamanyire ng’a Abafarisai, ekero baigwete ring’ana riria, mbagechetigwe?”

English: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Kila pando ambalo Baba yangu wa mbinguni hakulipanda, litangʼolewa.
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Kera ekemeri getasimekiri na Tata one ore igoro ngesimorwe.

English: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
Kiswahili: Waacheni; wao ni viongozi vipofu, wanaoongoza vipofu. Kama kipofu akimwongoza kipofu mwenzake, wote wawili watatumbukia shimoni.”
Ekegusii: Batige; barabwo nabaraai emeuko. Omouko oise koraa omouko onde, nigo baragwe ase engoro bonsi babere.”

English: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”
Kiswahili: Petro akasema, “Tueleze maana ya huu mfano.”
Ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoteebia, “Totebererie omobayeeno oyio.”

English: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Je, bado ninyi hamfahamu?
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Inee! Nonya mbono nainwe timori nobong’aini?

English: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?
Kiswahili: Je, hamwelewi kwamba chochote kiingiacho kinywani huenda tumboni, na hatimaye hutolewa nje kikiwa uchafu?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a kende gionsi kegosoa ase omonwa nigo kegoeta enda, kiagwa kebara?

English: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.
Kiswahili: Lakini kitokacho kinywani hutoka moyoni, na hiki ndicho kimtiacho mtu unajisi.
Ekegusii: Korende ebikorwa ase omonwa nigo bikorwa ase enkoro; nabio bikobekera omonto ogotacheneka.

English: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ndani ya moyo hutoka mawazo mabaya, uuaji, uzinzi, uasherati, wizi, ushahidi wa uongo na masingizio.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase enkoro nao bikorwa ebirengerio ebibe, oboiti, obotomani, obonyaka, oboibi, amang’ana y’oborimo, na okorama.

English: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo yamtiayo mtu unajisi; lakini kula bila kunawa mikono hakumtii mtu unajisi.”
Ekegusii: Ayio naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka korende okoria namaboko ataisaabiri tikori kobekera omonto ogotacheneka.”

English: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliondoka mahali pale, akaenda sehemu za Tiro na Sidoni.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarua aroro, akagenda chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni.

English: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”
Kiswahili: Mwanamke mmoja Mkanaani aliyeishi sehemu jirani na hizo akaja kwake akilia, akasema, “Nihurumie, Ee Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi! Binti yangu amepagawa na pepo mchafu, na anateseka sana.”
Ekegusii: Na rora, omokungu o Kaanani korwa ase ensemo eria akaoroka, agakaa eriogi, akabora, “Omonene, omwana o Daudi, indorere amaabera; enyaroka y’ane yachandirwe mono nekerecha.”

English: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu hakumjibu neno. Hivyo wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumsihi sana, wakisema, “Mwambie aende zake, kwa maana anaendelea kutupigia kelele.”
Ekegusii: Korende tamoiraneria ing’ana. Aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Mokanie, agende, ekiagera akona‐gototunyana ogotoakera eriogi.”

English: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Nimetumwa tu kwa ajili ya kondoo wa Israeli waliopotea.”
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nigo natometwe ase ching’ondi chinsiru chi’enyomba ya Israeli chioka.”

English: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mwanamke akaja, akapiga magoti mbele ya Yesu, akasema, “Bwana, nisaidie!”
Ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria akamochiera agatugama inse ase are, akabora, “Omonene, nkonya.”

English: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Si haki kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Tari buya kobogoria endagera y’abana na koyerutera chisese.”

English: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akajibu, “Ndiyo, Bwana, lakini hata mbwa hula makombo yanayoanguka kutoka kwenye meza za bwana zao.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akabora, “Ee, Omonene, korende nonya ne chisese nkoria chire amatori ayakogwa korwa ase chimesa chi’abanene babo.”

English: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Mwanamke, imani yako ni kubwa! Iwe kwako kama unavyotaka.” Naye binti yake akapona tangu saa ile.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aye omong’ina, okwegena kwao nokonene! Tiga abe buna oganetie.” Na ekero ekio enyaroka yaye ekagwenigwa.

English: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaondoka na kwenda kando ya Bahari ya Galilaya. Kisha akapanda mlimani, akaketi huko.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarua aroro akagenderera, agacha ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akariina ebitunwa igoro, agaikaransa aroro.

English: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamjia, wakiwaleta vilema, vipofu, viwete, bubu na wengine wengi, wakawaweka miguuni pake; naye akawaponya.
Ekegusii: Emeganda emenge ekamochiera, ekarenta amagata, na ebirema, na emeuko, na amamama, na abande abange, bakababeeka ase amagoro a Yeso, na ere akabagwenia.

English: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.
Kiswahili: Hao watu wakashangaa walipoona bubu wakisema, vilema wakipona, viwete wakitembea na vipofu wakiona, wakamtukuza Mungu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Goika emeganda egakumia ekero bachia korora abarenge amamama bagokwana, abarenge ebirema babeire buya, abarenge amagata bakogenda, na abarenge emeuko bakorora; bakamotogia Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

English: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Ninauhurumia huu umati wa watu, kwa sababu sasa wamekuwa pamoja nami kwa muda wa siku tatu, na hawana chakula chochote. Nami sipendi kuwaaga wakiwa na njaa, wasije wakazimia njiani.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye bache asare, akabora, “Inche naroreire emeganda amaabera, ekiagera babeire amo nainche amatuko atato, batari nendagera; na tindigeti kobatiga bagende nenchara, baabaise kogoya inchera.”

English: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakasema, “Tutapata wapi mikate ya kutosha kuwalisha umati huu wa watu mkubwa namna hii, nasi tuko nyikani?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Aa nerooro, ng’ai toranyore emegati emenge eraisane abanto abange buna aba baigote?”

English: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Mnayo mikate mingapi?” Wakamjibu, “Tunayo mikate saba na visamaki vichache.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere, ne chinswe chinsinini nke igo.”

English: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia ule umati wa watu waketi chini.
Ekegusii: Agachiika omoganda oikaranse inse.

English: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
Kiswahili: Kisha akachukua ile mikate saba na wale samaki, naye akiisha kumshukuru Mungu, akavimega na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, nao wakawapa ule umati wa watu.
Ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano n’ebere, ne chinswe chiria. Ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, na barabwo bakayea emeganda eria.

English: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.
Kiswahili: Wote wakala na kushiba. Baadaye wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu saba.
Ekegusii: Bakaria bonsi, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye bi’emegati ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere biichire.

English: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.
Kiswahili: Idadi ya watu walikuwa wanaume 4,000, bila kuhesabu wanawake na watoto.
Ekegusii: Na abwo bariete nigo barenge abasacha chilifu inye, otatiga abakungu na abana.

English: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuaga ule umati wa watu, Yesu aliingia katika mashua, akaenda sehemu za Magadani.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso gatigire emeganda egende, akariina obwato ime, akagenda chinsemo chia Magadani.

English: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wakamjia Yesu na kumjaribu kwa kumwomba awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Abafarisai na Abasadukai bagaacha ase ogoteema Yeso, bakamosaba aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro.

English: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ifikapo jioni, mnasema, ‘Hali ya hewa itakuwa nzuri, kwa kuwa anga ni nyekundu.’
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Rikoba mogoroba, mwaboora: Reero nerakeere, ekiagera igoro abariirire.

English: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!
Kiswahili: Nanyi wakati wa asubuhi mnasema, ‘Leo kutakuwa na dhoruba, kwa sababu anga ni nyekundu na mawingu yametanda.’ Mnajua jinsi ya kupambanua kule kuonekana kwa anga, lakini hamwezi kupambanua dalili za nyakati.
Ekegusii: Na mambia mwaboora: Reero netwe ey’omwaga, ekiagera igoro yababariirire na gosung’unana. Inwe imomanyete korora obosio bwa igoro, korende timomanyeti ebimanyererio bi’ebiro.

English: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.
Kiswahili: Kizazi kiovu na cha uzinzi kinatafuta ishara, lakini hakitapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ishara ya Yona.” Yesu akawaacha, akaenda zake.
Ekegusii: Ekegori egeturutumbu geteegeneti kerigetie egekone, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga ekia Yona.” Erio akabatiga, akagenda.

English: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake walipofika ngʼambo ya bahari, walikuwa wamesahau kuchukua mikate.
Ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa baika ng’umbu, konya beebire koirana emegati.

English: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Jihadharini. Jilindeni na chachu ya Mafarisayo na ya Masadukayo.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Rigereria, mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.”

English: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”
Kiswahili: Wakajadiliana wao kwa wao, wakisema, “Ni kwa sababu hatukuleta mikate.”
Ekegusii: Bakaboorania, bagoteeba, “Titwarentete emegati.”

English: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?
Kiswahili: Yesu, akifahamu majadiliano yao, akauliza, “Enyi wa imani haba! Mbona mnajadiliana miongoni mwenu kuhusu kutokuwa na mikate?
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabora, “Inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke, inki gekogera mokona‐koborania ng’a timori nemegati?

English: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,
Kiswahili: Je, bado hamwelewi? Je, hamkumbuki ile mikate mitano iliyolisha watu 5,000 na idadi ya vikapu vingapi vya mabaki mlivyokusanya?
Ekegusii: Timokomanya gose koinyora emegati eria etano ase baria chilifu isano, na ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie?

English: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
Kiswahili: Au ile mikate saba iliyolisha watu 4,000 na idadi ya vikapu vingapi vya mabaki mlivyokusanya?
Ekegusii: Nonya nemegati eria etano n’ebere ase baria chilifu inye, na ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie?

English: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
Kiswahili: Inakuwaje mnashindwa kuelewa kwamba nilikuwa sisemi nanyi habari za mikate? Jilindeni na chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo.”
Ekegusii: Inaki inwe motari komanya ng’a tindi gokwana igoro y’emegati? Mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.”

English: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakaelewa kwamba alikuwa hasemi juu ya chachu ya kutengeneza mikate, bali juu ya mafundisho ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo.
Ekegusii: Erio bakamanya ng’a tare kobateebia okwerenda nememera y’emegati, korende nokworokereria kw’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.

English: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu alipofika katika eneo la Kaisaria-Filipi, akawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Watu husema kwamba mimi Mwana wa Adamu ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso acha ensemo ya Kaisaria Filipi, akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Inee! Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere ng’o?”

English: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Baadhi husema ni Yohana Mbatizaji; wengine husema ni Eliya; na bado wengine husema ni Yeremia au mmojawapo wa manabii.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Abande nigo bagoteeba: Yohana Omobatisi; na abande: Elija; na abande: Yeremia gose oyomo bw’ababani.”

English: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza, “Je, ninyi mnasema mimi ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Nainwe mokobora ng’a ninche ning’o?”

English: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akamjibu, “Wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu aliye hai.”
Ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamoiraneria, “Aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae ore moyo.”

English: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: Naye Yesu akamwambia, “Heri wewe, Simoni Bar-Yona,kwa maana hili halikufunuliwa kwako na mwanadamu, bali na Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Nosesenirie aye Simioni, mosinto o Yona, ekiagera eri tomaanoreiri nomobere na amanyinga, korende na Tata one ore igoro.

English: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
Kiswahili: Nami nakuambia, wewe ndiwe Petro na juu ya mwamba huu nitalijenga kanisa langu, hata malango ya Kuzimu hayataweza kulishinda.
Ekegusii: Na inche nagotebirie, ng’a aye naye Petero, na igoro ase egetare eke ning’agache ekanisa y’ane, ne chinguru chi’amakweri tichikoyebua.

English: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”
Kiswahili: Nitakupa funguo za Ufalme wa mbinguni, na lolote utakalolifunga duniani litakuwa limefungwa Mbinguni, nalo lolote utakalofungua duniani litakuwa limefunguliwa mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninkoe ebigorero bi’oborwoti bwa igoro, na ande onsi orasibe ase ense nabe asibirwe na igoro, na ande onsi orasibore ase ense nabe asiboirwe na igoro.”

English: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawakataza wanafunzi wake wasimwambie mtu yeyote kwamba yeye ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Erio akabatianera bokong’u aborokigwa baye ng’a tibateebia onde nere Kristo.

English: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati huo, Yesu alianza kuwaeleza wanafunzi wake kwamba hana budi kwenda Yerusalemu na kupata mateso mengi mikononi mwa wazee, viongozi wa makuhani, na walimu wa sheria, na kwamba itampasa auawe lakini siku ya tatu kufufuliwa.
Ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio Yeso agachaaka kworokereria aborokigwa baye ng’a nemogwenerete kogenda Yerusalemu, agwo ase aranyare gochandwa mono ase amaboko y’abagaaka, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na goitwa; ase rituko ria gatato naboke.

English: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
Kiswahili: Petro akamchukua kando, akaanza kumkemea akisema, “Haiwezekani, Bwana! Jambo hili kamwe halitakupata!”
Ekegusii: Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaaka komokania, akabora, “Omonene, ayio tabaisa gokonyora! Takoba ase ore buna ayio.”

English: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akageuka na kumwambia Petro, “Rudi nyuma yangu, Shetani! Wewe ni kikwazo kwangu. Moyo wako hauwazi yaliyo ya Mungu, bali ya wanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akeonchora, agateebia Petero, “Irana magega y’ane, Saitani! Aye nigo origetie koba egetango ase inde, ekiagera ebirengererio biao tibiri ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase Mwanyabaanto.”

English: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Mtu yeyote akitaka kunifuata, ni lazima ajikane mwenyewe, auchukue msalaba wake, anifuate.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “monto onde bwensi origetie koba omotunyani one, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye, antunyane.

English: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu atayapata.
Ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi orarigie koegerera obogima bwaye, oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho y’ane, oyio naboegerere.

English: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, je, itamfaidi nini mtu kuupata ulimwengu wote, lakini akayapoteza maisha yake? Au mtu atatoa nini badala ya nafsi yake?
Ekegusii: Ninki eragwenere omonto konyora ense yonsi, ko asirie omoyo oye? Gose omonto inki ararue ase ribaga ri’omoyo oye?

English: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu atakuja katika utukufu wa Baba yake pamoja na malaika zake, naye ndipo atakapomlipa kila mtu kwa kadiri ya matendo yake.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto naoroke nabamalaika baye ore nobonene bwa Ise, na ekero ekio ng’ae kera omonto koreng’ana buna are gokora.

English: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Nawaambia kweli, baadhi yenu hapa hawataonja mauti kabla ya kumwona Mwana wa Adamu akija katika Ufalme wake.”
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Abanto mbare aiga ase aba bateneine, barabwo bataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake goika barore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ogocha ase oborwoti bwaye.”

English: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
Kiswahili: Siku sita baada ya jambo hili, Yesu akawachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana ndugu yake Yakobo, akawapeleka juu ya mlima mrefu peke yao.
Ekegusii: Na nyuma y’amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo, bakagenda nabarabwo igoro ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka.

English: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa huko, Yesu alibadilika sura mbele yao. Uso wake ukangʼaa kama jua na nguo zake zikawa na weupe wa kuumiza macho.
Ekegusii: Akaonchoka ekieni kiaye ase bare, obosio bwaye bokagirigenta buna erioba, ne chianga chiaye chikaraba buna omobaso.

English: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
Kiswahili: Ghafula wakawatokea mbele yao Mose na Eliya, wakizungumza na Yesu.
Ekegusii: Na rora, Musa na Elija bakabaorokera, bagakwana nere.

English: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamwambia Yesu, “Bwana, ni vyema sisi tukae hapa. Ukitaka, nitafanya vibanda vitatu: kimoja chako, kingine cha Mose na kingine cha Eliya.”
Ekegusii: Petero agateebia Yeso, “Omonene, mbuya intwe koba aiga; onye ngwancha, ninkore aiga ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija.”

English: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”
Kiswahili: Petro alipokuwa angali ananena, ghafula wingu lililongʼaa likawafunika, na sauti ikatoka kwenye hilo wingu ikisema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa. Ninapendezwa naye sana. Msikieni yeye.”
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, rora, riire rirabu rikababisia, na eriogi rikarwa ase riire riria, rigateba, “Oyo n’Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere; moigwere ere.”

English: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi waliposikia haya, wakaanguka chini kifudifudi, wakajawa na hofu.
Ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bakagwa inse maumama, bakabwatwa nomoondoko omonene.

English: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akaja na kuwagusa, akawaambia, “Inukeni na wala msiogope.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso agacha akabakuna, akabora, “Imoka, timobaisa kwoboa.”

English: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.
Kiswahili: Walipoinua macho yao, hawakumwona mtu mwingine yeyote isipokuwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koimokia amaiso abo, tibarora monto otatiga Yeso bweka.

English: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakishuka kutoka mlimani, Yesu akawaagiza, “Msimwambie mtu yeyote mambo mliyoyaona hapa, mpaka Mwana wa Adamu atakapofufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu.”
Ekegusii: Kobagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, Yeso akabatianera, akabora, “Timoteebia monto onde okorora oko goika Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto aboke korwa ase abakuure.”

English: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini basi walimu wa sheria husema kwamba ni lazima Eliya aje kwanza?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Nase ki rende aborokia b’amariiko bagoteeba ng’a negwenerete Elija ache ritang’ani?”

English: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ni kweli, Eliya lazima aje kwanza, naye atatengeneza mambo yote.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nekeene, n’Elija ogochia gocha ritang’ani, na ere naroisie onsi.

English: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nawaambia, Eliya amekwisha kuja, nao hawakumtambua, bali walimtendea kila kitu walichotaka. Vivyo hivyo Mwana wa Adamu pia atateswa mikononi mwao.”
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ng’a Elija oikire gocha; na barabwo tibamomanyete, korende bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie. Naboigo n’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nachie konyora emechando ase amaboko abo.”

English: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wale wanafunzi wakaelewa kuwa alikuwa anazungumza nao habari za Yohana Mbatizaji.
Ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa baye bakamanya ng’a ere nigo are kobateebia igoro ya Yohana Omobatisi.

English: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,
Kiswahili: Walipofika penye umati wa watu, mtu mmoja akamjia Yesu na kupiga magoti mbele yake, akasema,
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ase omoganda, omonto oyomo akamochiera agwo, akamotung’amera, akabora,

English: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
Kiswahili: “Bwana, mhurumie mwanangu. Yeye ana kifafa na anateseka sana. Mara kwa mara huanguka kwenye moto au kwenye maji.
Ekegusii: “Omonene, ororere omomura one amaabera, ekiagera nare nendurume, nigo achandegete mono. Inaki ere, kero kende nigo akogwa ase omorero ime, na kero kende ase amaache ime.

English: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”
Kiswahili: Nilimleta kwa wanafunzi wako, lakini hawakuweza kumponya.”
Ekegusii: Namorenta ase aborokigwa bao, tibanyara komogwenia.”

English: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Enyi kizazi kisichoamini na kilichopotoka! Nitakaa nanyi mpaka lini? Nitawavumilia mpaka lini? Mleteni mvulana hapa kwangu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, naende ekebe, nimbe amo nainwe goika ririri? Nindemererie nainwe goika ririri? Mondetere aiga.”

English: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamkemea yule pepo mchafu, akamtoka yule kijana, naye akapona saa ile ile.
Ekegusii: Yeso agatogonyera ekerecha, na kerokio kegatiga omwana oria na ere akagwenigwa ekero keria.

English: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
Kiswahili: Kisha wanafunzi wakamwendea Yesu wakiwa peke yao, wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini sisi hatukuweza kumtoa?”
Ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso bobisi, bakaboora, “Ninki kiagera intwe titwanyara korusia ekerecha keria?”

English: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Kwa sababu ya imani yenu ndogo. Ninawaambia kweli, mkiwa na imani ndogo kama punje ya haradali, mtauambia mlima huu, ‘Ondoka hapa uende pale,’ nao utaondoka. Wala hakutakuwa na jambo lisilowezekana kwenu.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nase engencho y’okwegena kwaino kore ogoke. Ekeene nabateebirie: Moise koba nokwegena koreng’aine buna entetere y’Omosirapi, inamoteebie egetunwa eke: Karue agwo, ogende aaria, na kerokio inakeruo, tirikoba ring’ana ritanyarekane ase more.

English: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”
Kiswahili: Lakini hali kama hii haitoki ila kwa kuomba na kufunga.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekerecha kenga buna eke tikegosoka otatiga ase ogosaba na okweng’ata.”

English: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,
Kiswahili: Siku moja walipokuwa pamoja huko Galilaya, Yesu akawaambia, “Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Ekero basangererekanete Galili, Yeso akabateebia, “Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ngochia are kobekwa ase amaboko y’ abanto.

English: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
Kiswahili: Nao watamuua, lakini siku ya tatu atafufuliwa.” Wanafunzi wakahuzunika sana.
Ekegusii: Barabwo inabamoite, ne rituko ria gatato nabooke.” Bagaichana mono.

English: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu na wanafunzi wake kufika Kapernaumu, wakusanya kodi ya Hekalu wakamjia Petro na kumuuliza, “Je, Mwalimu wenu halipi kodi ya Hekalu?”
Ekegusii: Kobaikire Kapernaumu, abaare korusia ebango ye Hekalu bagachiera Petero, bakamobooria, “Inee! Omworokia oino nkorua are ebango?”

English: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”
Kiswahili: Petro akajibu, “Ndiyo, yeye hulipa.” Petro aliporudi nyumbani, Yesu akawa wa kwanza kulizungumzia, akamuuliza, “Unaonaje Simoni? Wafalme wa dunia hupokea ushuru na kodi kutoka kwa nani? Je, ni kutoka kwa watoto wao au kutoka kwa watu wengine?”
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Ee, nkorua are.” Goika agasoa nyomba, Yeso agatang’ana gokwana na Petero, akamobooria, “Inki okorengereria Simioni? Nase ng’o abarwoti b’ense bakorusia ebango n’echoogo? Nkorwa ase abana babo, gose nase abanto bande?”

English: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.
Kiswahili: Petro akamjibu, “Kutoka kwa watu wengine.” Yesu akamwambia, “Kwa hiyo watoto wao wamesamehewa.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Petero amoiraneria, “Nkorwa ase abande,” Yeso akamoteebia, “Rirorio abana babo barabwo nabasibore.

English: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ili tusije tukawaudhi, nenda baharini ukatupe ndoana. Mchukue samaki wa kwanza utakayemvua. Fungua kinywa chake nawe utakuta humo fedha, ichukue ukalipe kodi yako na yangu.”
Ekegusii: Korende titobaisa kobagechia, genda nyancha orute endobio na enswe eraache ritang’ani oyebwate; na ekero okoyiasamia omonwa oye norore egesamunye kiebesa kereo, okerusie, obae abwo ase engencho y’ane amo naye.”

English: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, wanafunzi wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Je, nani aliye mkuu kuliko wote katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni?”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria aborokigwa bagaacha ase Yeso, bakamobooria, “Ning’o ore omonene kobua abande ase oborwoti bwa igoro?”

English: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwita mtoto mdogo na kumsimamisha katikati yao.
Ekegusii: Akarangeria omwana, akamobeka gati‐gati yaabo,

English: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
Kiswahili: Naye akasema: “Amin, nawaambia, msipookoka na kuwa kama watoto wadogo, kamwe hamtaingia katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.
Ekegusii: akabora, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Motaonchogeti mobe buna omwana, timogosoa ase oborwoti bwa igoro nonya ng’ake.

English: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mtu yeyote anyenyekeaye kama huyu mtoto, ndiye aliye mkuu kuliko wote katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Gaki, onde bwensi oyo orekeyie omonyene koba buna omwana oyo, oyio nere ore omonene kobua abande ase oborwoti bwa igoro.

English: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
Kiswahili: “Yeyote amkaribishaye mtoto mdogo kama huyu kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraariganie omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyariganirie inche.

English: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mtu yeyote akimsababisha mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo wanaoniamini kutenda dhambi, ingekuwa bora kwake afungiwe jiwe kubwa la kusagia shingoni mwake, na kutoswa katika kilindi cha bahari.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oramochere oyomo bw’aba abake, abanyegenete, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe ase endiba y’enyancha.

English: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
Kiswahili: “Ole kwa ulimwengu kwa sababu ya yale mambo yanayosababisha watu kutenda dhambi! Mambo hayo lazima yawepo, lakini ole wake mtu yule ambaye huyasababisha.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobw’ense ase engencho y’amateemwa ayakorenta ebibe! Inaki amateemwa takomocha kobao, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oyio okorenta ogoteemwa!

English: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mkono wako au mguu wako unakusababisha utende dhambi, ukate na uutupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa huna mkono mmoja au mguu mmoja, kuliko kuwa na mikono miwili au miguu miwili, na kutupwa katika moto wa milele.
Ekegusii: Na onye okoboko kwao gokogera okore ebibe, gose nokogoro kwao, konache, ogotugute are; mbuya ase ore osoe ase obogima kore omonungu, gose egesegora, kobua koba namaboko abere, na amagoro abere, na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.

English: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.
Kiswahili: Nalo jicho lako likikusababisha kutenda dhambi, lingʼoe, ulitupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa na jicho moja, kuliko kuwa na macho mawili lakini ukatupwa katika moto wa jehanamu.
Ekegusii: Onye neriso riao rikogera okore ebibe, orirusie, oritugute are; mbuya ase ore osoe ase obogima kore egetong’o kobua koba namaiso abere na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.

English: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: “Angalia ili usimdharau mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo, kwa maana nawaambia, malaika wao mbinguni daima wanauona uso wa Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.
Ekegusii: “Rigereria, timobaisa gochaaya oyomo bw’aba abake; naki nabateebirie inwe, nonya nabamalaika babo igoro tibanagotiga korigereria obosio bwa Tata one ore igoro.

English: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu alikuja kuokoa kile kilichopotea.
Ekegusii: Inaki Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nigo achete gotooria egiasirete.

English: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
Kiswahili: “Mwaonaje? Ikiwa mtu ana kondoo mia moja, na mmoja wao akapotea, je, hatawaacha wale tisini na tisa vilimani na kwenda kumtafuta huyo mmoja aliyepotea?
Ekegusii: “Inki mokorengereria? Omonto obwate ching’ondi rigana erimo, na eyemo kerasire; Inee, tagotiga chiria emerongo kianda na kianda ase ebitunwa, achie korigia eria yasirire?

English: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
Kiswahili: Naye akishampata, amin, nawaambia, hufurahi zaidi kwa ajili ya huyo kondoo mmoja kuliko wale tisini na tisa ambao hawakupotea.
Ekegusii: Kayenyorire, nekeene nabateebirie: Nagoke ase eria kobua ase chiria emerongo kianda na kianda chitasirete.

English: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, Baba yenu wa mbinguni hapendi hata mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo apotee.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, tari ogwancha gwa iso oino ore igoro ng’a oyomo bw’aba abake asire.

English: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
Kiswahili: “Kama ndugu yako akikukosea, nenda ukamwonyeshe kosa lake, kati yenu ninyi wawili peke yenu. Kama akikusikiliza, utakuwa umempata tena ndugu yako.
Ekegusii: “Oyomino karakore ebibe, genda omoteebie okomocha kwaye, aye nere, inwe mweka. Karagotegerere, igo kwamonyorire.

English: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hatakusikiliza, nenda na mtu mwingine mmoja au wawili ili kila neno lithibitishwe kwa ushahidi wa mashahidi wawili au watatu.
Ekegusii: Korende atagotegerereti, ira omonto oyomo, gose babere, mogende asare mwensi, ng’a kera ring’ana rinyare gwancheranwa ase oborori bwa babere gose batato.

English: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
Kiswahili: Kama akikataa kuwasikiliza hao, liambie kanisa. Naye kama akikataa hata kulisikiliza kanisa, basi awe kwenu kama mtu asiyeamini au mtoza ushuru.
Ekegusii: Ere atabategerereti abwo, teebia ekanisa; naende ataigwereti ekanisa nero, ase ore aye tiga abe buna omonto bw’ense, na buna omorusia ebango.

English: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
Kiswahili: “Amin, nawaambia, lolote mtakalolifunga duniani litakuwa limefungwa mbinguni, na lolote mtakalolifungua duniani litakuwa limefunguliwa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Ande onsi morasibe ase ense, nabe asibirwe na igoro; na ande onsi morasibore ase ense, nabe asiboirwe na igoro.

English: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: “Tena nawaambia, ikiwa wawili wenu watakubaliana duniani kuhusu jambo lolote watakaloomba, watafanyiwa na Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.
Ekegusii: “Naende nabateebirie: Onye babere ase more bagwancherana ase ense igoro yering’ana rinde rionsi barasabe, inabakorerwe rirorio na Tata one ore igoro.

English: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wanapokusanyika pamoja watu wawili au watatu kwa Jina langu, mimi niko papo hapo pamoja nao.”
Ekegusii: Inaki ase bare babere gose batato basangererekanire ase erieta riane, nainche nao inde agwo gati‐gati yabo.”

English: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Bwana, ndugu yangu anikosee mara ngapi nami nimsamehe? Je, hata mara saba?”
Ekegusii: Erio Petero agacha, akamobooria, “Omonene, ng’ara karenga oyominto arankorere bobe, na inche ’mwabere? Ngoika chintunda isano na ibere gose?”

English: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Sikuambii hata mara saba, bali hata saba mara sabini.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tindi goteeba omwabere chintunda isano na ibere, mwabere nonya ne chintunda isano na ibere ara emerongo etano n’ebere.

English: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo Ufalme wa Mbinguni unaweza kufananishwa na mfalme aliyetaka kufanya hesabu zake za fedha na watumishi wake.
Ekegusii: “Ase ayio, oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomorwoti origetie gokora omobaro bw’abasomba baye.

English: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
Kiswahili: Alipoanza kufanya hesabu zake, mtu mmoja aliyekuwa anadaiwa talanta10,000, aliletwa kwake.
Ekegusii: Ekero achaakire gokora omobaro akarenterwa omosomba oyomo omoriete chitalanta chilifu ikomi.

English: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa alikuwa hawezi kulipa deni hilo, bwana wake akaamuru kwamba auzwe, yeye, mkewe, watoto wake na vyote alivyokuwa navyo, ili lile deni lipate kulipwa.
Ekegusii: Ekero asinyetwe goakana, omonene oye agachiika aoonigwe, ere na mokaye, na abana baye, na ebi abwate bionsi, na esiira eria eakanwe.

English: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’
Kiswahili: “Yule mtumishi akampigia magoti, akamsihi yule bwana akisema, ‘Naomba univumilie, nami nitakulipa deni lako lote.’
Ekegusii: Omosomba oria akagwa inse, akamosorora, agateeba: Omonene one, ing’ira ng’ora, na inche ningoakane bionsi.

English: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.
Kiswahili: Yule bwana wa huyo mtumishi akamwonea huruma, akafuta deni lake lote, akamwacha aende zake.
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’omosomba oria agasogwa namaabera, akamosibora, akamwabera ase esiira yaye.

English: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
Kiswahili: “Lakini yule mtumishi alipokuwa anatoka nje, akakutana na mtumishi mwenzake aliyekuwa amemkopesha dinarimia moja. Akamkamata, akamkaba koo akimwambia, ‘Nilipe kile ninachokudai!’
Ekegusii: Korende omosomba oyio, ekero achia korua aroro, akarora ase abasomba bande oyomo omoriete chidinari rigana erimo, akamobwata ebigoti, akabora: Ng’akane ebi kwariete.

English: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
Kiswahili: “Yule mtumishi mwenzake akapiga magoti akamsihi akisema, ‘Naomba univumilie, nami nitakulipa deni lako lote.’
Ekegusii: Omosomba oria agatung’ama inse, akamosorora, agateeba: Ing’ira ng’ora, na inche ningoakane.

English: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.
Kiswahili: “Lakini akakataa. Badala yake, alienda akamtupa gerezani hata atakapolipa hilo deni.
Ekegusii: Akanga, agachia akamoruta echela ime goika aakane esira eria.

English: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wenzake walipoona haya yaliyotukia wakaudhika sana, nao wakaenda na kumwambia bwana wao kila kitu kilichokuwa kimetukia.
Ekegusii: Ekero abasomba bande bachia korora aya akoreka, bagaichana mono, bakagenda, bagateebia omonene obo onsi ayakorekire.

English: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
Kiswahili: “Yule bwana akamwita yule mtumishi akamwambia, ‘Wewe mtumishi mwovu! Mimi nilikusamehe deni lako lote uliponisihi.
Ekegusii: Erio omonene oye akamorangeria, akamoteebia: Aye omosomba omobe! Inche ngakwabera esira yonsi, ekiagera gwansororete.

English: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
Kiswahili: Je, haikukupasa kumhurumia mtumishi mwenzako kama mimi nilivyokuhurumia wewe?’
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye tikwagwenerete kwabera omosomba oria onde, buna nainche nakwaberete?

English: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hasira, yule bwana wake akamtia yule mtumishi mikononi mwa askari wa gereza ili ateswe mpaka atakapolipa yote aliyokuwa anadaiwa.
Ekegusii: Omonene oye akabea mono, akamobeka ase abarendi b’echela, goika aakane ebi ariete bionsi.

English: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
Kiswahili: “Hivi ndivyo Baba yangu wa mbinguni atakavyomfanyia kila mmoja wenu ikiwa hatamsamehe ndugu yake kutoka moyoni mwake.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo na Tata one ore igoro arabakorere nainwe, onye timokwabera abamino ase chinkoro chiaino ime.”

English: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomaliza kusema maneno haya, aliondoka Galilaya, akaenda sehemu za Uyahudi, ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gokoora gokwana amang’ana ayio, akarua Galili, agasoa ensemo ya Boyahudi ng’umbu ya Yorodani;

English: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamfuata, naye akawaponya huko.
Ekegusii: na emeganda emenene ekamotunyana, akabagwenia aroro.

English: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakamjia ili kumjaribu, wakamuuliza, “Ni halali mtu kumwacha mke wake kwa sababu yoyote?”
Ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteema ase okomoboria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto atige mok’aye ase ring’ana rinde rionsi?”

English: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Je, hamkusoma kwamba hapo mwanzo Muumba aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke,
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timwana gosoma buna ere oyobatongete korwa omochakano, nere obatongete omosacha na omokungu,

English: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?
Kiswahili: naye akasema, ‘Kwa sababu hii mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake, naye ataambatana na mkewe, na hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja’?
Ekegusii: agateeba: Ase engencho eyio omonto natige ise na ng’ina, abwatane na mok’aye, na abwo babere nigo barabe omobere oyomo?

English: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo si wawili tena, bali mwili mmoja. Kwa hiyo alichokiunganisha Mungu, mwanadamu asikitenganishe.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo tibakoba babere naende, korende omobere oyomo. Naboigo, ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, Mwanyabaanto tabiatanana.”

English: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini basi Mose aliagiza mtu kumpa mkewe hati ya talaka na kumwacha?”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Nase ki rende Musa achiigete komoa omokungu riruube ri’ogotigana, na komotiga?”

English: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mose aliwaruhusu kuwaacha wake zenu kwa sababu ya ugumu wa mioyo yenu. Lakini tangu mwanzo haikuwa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiaino Musa abaete ribaga gotiga abakungu baino, korende ayio tarenge bo korwa omochakano.

English: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
Kiswahili: Mimi nawaambia, yeyote amwachaye mkewe isipokuwa kwa sababu ya uasherati naye akaoa mke mwingine, anazini. Naye amwoaye yule mwanamke aliyeachwa pia anazini.”
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie, oyoratige mok’aye, otatiga ase engencho y’obotomani, na konyuoma oyonde, oyio otomanire; naende oy’oranyuome omokungu oyotigirwe, otomanire.”

English: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Kama hali ndiyo hii kati ya mume na mke, ni afadhali mtu asioe!”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakamoteebia, “Amang’ana igoro y’omonto na mok’aye k’arabe engencho eye, tegwenereti konywoma.”

English: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Si watu wote wanaoweza kupokea neno hili, isipokuwa wale tu waliojaliwa na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende akabateebia, “Tari bonsi baranyare gwancha ring’ana eri, otatiga abwo baeirwe.

English: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wengine ni matowashi kwa sababu wamezaliwa hivyo; wengine wamefanywa matowashi na wanadamu; na wengine wamejifanya matowashi kwa ajili ya Ufalme wa Mbinguni. Yeye awezaye kulipokea neno hili na alipokee.”
Ekegusii: Inaki mbare abagomba abaiboretwe bo, naende mbare abagomba aba abanto bagombaetie, naende mbare abagomba abekorete abanyene koba abagomba ase engencho y’oborwoti bwa igoro. Oyoranyare gwancha ring’ana eri, tiga arianche.”

English: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
Kiswahili: Kisha watoto wadogo wakaletwa kwa Yesu ili aweke mikono yake juu yao na awaombee. Lakini wanafunzi wake wakawakemea wale waliowaleta.
Ekegusii: Erio abana abake bakarentwa ase Yeso, erinde ababeekere amaboko aye na kobasabera. Aborokigwa baye bagatanga abanto,

English: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Waacheni watoto wadogo waje kwangu, wala msiwazuie, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni wa wale walio kama hawa.”
Ekegusii: korende Yeso agateeba, “Batige abana bache ase ’nde, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oborwoti bwa igoro n’obwabo.”

English: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
Kiswahili: Naye akaweka mikono yake juu yao, na akaondoka huko.
Ekegusii: Akababeekera amaboko aye, akaimoka korwa aroro, akagenda.

English: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja akamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Mwalimu mwema, nifanye jambo gani jema ili nipate uzima wa milele?”
Ekegusii: Na rora, omonto oyomo akamochiera, akamobooria, “Omworokia ’mboseera ki ndakore ’nyore obogima bwa kare na kare?”

English: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mbona unaniuliza habari ya mema? Aliye mwema ni Mmoja tu. Lakini ukitaka kuingia uzimani, zitii amri.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Nase ki okomboria ninki kere ekiya? Nareo oyomo bweka oyore omuya. Onye korigetie gosoa ase obogima, bwata amachiiko.”

English: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akamuuliza, “Amri zipi?” Yesu akamjibu, “Usiue, usizini, usiibe, usishuhudie uongo,
Ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Ayare buna arari?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Toita, Totomana, Toiba, Toteba oborimo,

English: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”
Kiswahili: waheshimu baba yako na mama yako, na umpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.”
Ekegusii: sika iso na nyoko; naende: Ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”

English: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
Kiswahili: Yule kijana akasema, “Hizi zote nimezishika. Je, bado nimepungukiwa na nini?”
Ekegusii: Omomura oria akamoteebia, “Ayio onsi nayabwatire; ing’ana ki rimochete?”

English: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Kama ukitaka kuwa mkamilifu, nenda, ukauze vitu vyote ulivyo navyo, na hizo fedha uwape maskini, nawe utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Kisha njoo, unifuate.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Onye korigetie koba omoikeranu, gachie, oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi, oe abataka, na aye n’obe neniibo igoro; erio oche ontunyane.”

English: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
Kiswahili: Yule kijana aliposikia hayo, akaenda zake kwa huzuni, kwa sababu alikuwa na mali nyingi.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia koigwa ring’ana riria, omomura oria akagenda nobororo, ekiagera arenge neniibo enyinge.

English: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Amin, nawaambia, itakuwa vigumu kwa mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nekeene nabateebirie: Nabe aakong’u ase omonto omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa igoro.

English: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Tena nawaambia, ni rahisi zaidi kwa ngamia kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kuliko mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Naende nabateebirie inwe, naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani, kobua omonto omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake waliposikia haya, walishangaa sana na kuuliza, “Ni nani basi awezaye kuokoka?”
Ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bagakumia mono, bagateeba, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

English: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawatazama, akawaambia, “Kwa mwanadamu jambo hili haliwezekani, lakini mambo yote yanawezekana kwa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarigereria, akabateebia, “Aya takonyarekana ase Mwanyabaanto, korende ase Nyasae onsi nigo akonyarekana.”

English: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamjibu, “Tazama, sisi tumeacha kila kitu na kukufuata! Tutapata nini basi?”
Ekegusii: Erio Petero akamoiraneria, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire, inki rende toranyore?”

English: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, wakati wa kufanywa upya vitu vyote, Mwana wa Adamu atakapoketi kwenye kiti chake kitukufu cha enzi, ninyi mlionifuata pia mtaketi katika viti vya enzi kumi na viwili, mkiyahukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nekeene nabateebirie: Ase ense enyia, ekero Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto agochi‐gocha gaikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, inwe abamwantunyanire inamoche goikaransera ebirogo bi’obonene ikomi na bibere, mokogaambera ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.

English: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu aliyeacha nyumba, au ndugu zake wa kiume au wa kike, baba au mama, watoto au mashamba kwa ajili yangu, atapokea mara mia zaidi ya hayo, na ataurithi uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Na onde bwensi otigete chinyomba, gose bamura bamwabo, gose basubati bamwabo, gose ise, gose ng’ina, gose abana, gose emegondo ase engencho y’erieta riane, namenteranigwe ara rigana, na obogima bwa kare na kare nabonyore.

English: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.
Kiswahili: Lakini wengi walio wa kwanza watakuwa wa mwisho, na walio wa mwisho watakuwa wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Korende abange abare ab’eritang’ani inababe abamagega, na abamagega inababe ab’eritang’ani.

English: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
Kiswahili: “Kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na mtu mwenye shamba aliyetoka alfajiri ili kwenda kuajiri vibarua kufanya kazi katika shamba lake la mizabibu.
Ekegusii: “Inaki oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine n’omonto omonyene enyomba oyosoogete mambia chuni kogenda koriika abaremi ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.

English: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukubaliana na hao vibarua kuwalipa ujira wa dinarimoja kwa siku, akawapeleka kwenye shamba lake la mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Agancherana nabaremi kobaakana edinari eyemo ase rituko, erio akabaira ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.

English: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.
Kiswahili: “Mnamo saa tatu akatoka tena, akawakuta wengine wamesimama sokoni bila kazi.
Ekegusii: Agasoka chinsa isato, akarora abande bateneine echiiro, batari nemeremo,

English: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, ‘Ninyi nanyi nendeni mkafanye kazi katika shamba langu la mizabibu, nami nitawalipa chochote kilicho haki yenu.’
Ekegusii: akabateebia nabarabwo: Genda nainwe ase omogondo one bw’emesabibu na inche nimbae ekebagwenerete. Bakagenda.

English: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakaenda. “Akatoka tena mnamo saa sita na pia saa tisa akafanya vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Agasoka naende chinsa isano nemo, ne chinsa kianda, agakora boigo.

English: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’
Kiswahili: Mnamo saa kumi na moja akatoka tena akawakuta wengine bado wamesimama bila kazi. Akawauliza, ‘Kwa nini mmesimama hapa kutwa nzima pasipo kufanya kazi?’
Ekegusii: Goika chinsa ikomi nemo agasoka, akarora abande bateneine, akababoria nabarabwo: Ninki mwatenenera aa bwaira, motari nameremo?

English: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’
Kiswahili: “Wakamjibu, ‘Ni kwa sababu hakuna yeyote aliyetuajiri.’ “Akawaambia, ‘Ninyi nanyi nendeni mkafanye kazi katika shamba langu la mizabibu.’
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: Ekiagera monto onde tatoriigeti. Akabateebia: Genda nainwe boigo ase omogondo one bw’emesabibu.

English: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’
Kiswahili: “Ilipofika jioni, yule mwenye shamba la mizabibu akamwambia msimamizi, ‘Waite hao vibarua na uwalipe ujira wao, ukianzia na wale walioajiriwa mwisho na kuishia na wale walioajiriwa kwanza.’
Ekegusii: Ekero riagorobire, omonyene omogondo agateebia omoteneneri oye: Rangeria abaremi, obae eng’eria yabo, ochaakere korwa abamagega goika ab’eritang’ani.

English: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.
Kiswahili: “Wale vibarua walioajiriwa mnamo saa kumi na moja, wakaja na kila mmoja wao akapokea dinari moja.
Ekegusii: Ekero baria barigetwe chinsa ikomi nemo baachete, bakanyora kera oyomo edinari eyemo.

English: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wale walioajiriwa kwanza walipofika, walidhani watalipwa zaidi. Lakini kila mmoja wao pia alipokea dinari moja.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero ab’eritang’ani bacha, bagakaga ng’a barabwo nabaegwe kobua abande, bakanyora nabarabwo kera oyomo edinari eyemo.

English: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,
Kiswahili: Walipoipokea, wakaanza kulalamika dhidi ya yule mwenye shamba,
Ekegusii: Erio kabaeirwe, bakaba nkwemurungania bare ase omonyene enyomba,

English: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’
Kiswahili: wakisema, ‘Hawa watu walioajiriwa mwisho wamefanya kazi kwa muda wa saa moja tu, nawe umewafanya sawa na sisi ambao tumestahimili taabu na joto lote la mchana kutwa?’
Ekegusii: bakaboora: Abwo ba magega nigo bakora emeremo y’ensa eyemo yoka, na aye kwabatoreng’aneria naintwe abatwaremereretie emechando ne riberera ri’omobaso bwonsi?

English: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?
Kiswahili: “Yule mwenye shamba akamjibu mmoja wao, ‘Rafiki, sijakudhulumu. Je, hukukubaliana nami kwa ujira wa kawaida wa dinari moja?
Ekegusii: Ere akairaneria oyomo obo: Omosani, tingokorereti bobe. Titwancheranete naye ase edinari eyemo?

English: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.
Kiswahili: Chukua ujira wako na uende. Mimi nimeamua kumlipa huyu mtu aliyeajiriwa mwisho kama nilivyokupa wewe.
Ekegusii: Bwata ekere ekiao, ogende; nindigetie koa oyo o magega koreng’ana naye.

English: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
Kiswahili: Je, sina haki yangu kufanya kile nitakacho na mali yangu mwenyewe? Au unaona wivu kwa kuwa nimekuwa mkarimu?’
Ekegusii: Inee! Tindi neribaga gokora buna ndigetie omonyene n’ebinto biane? Gose naki okorigereria neriso riibe, ekiagera inche inde omuya?

English: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”
