Kiswahili: “Vivyo hivyo, wa mwisho watakuwa wa kwanza, na wa kwanza watakuwa wa mwisho.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo abamagega inababe ab’eritang’ani, na ab’eritang’ani inababe abamagega.”

English: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu alipokuwa anapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, aliwachukua kando wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili na kuwaambia,
Ekegusii: Nabo, ekero Yeso arenge gotiira gochia Yerusalemu, akabaira aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere ensemo.

English: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,
Kiswahili: “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na Mwana wa Adamu atatiwa mikononi mwa viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria. Nao watamhukumu kifo
Ekegusii: Kobare inchera, akabateebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore gochia Yerusalemu, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto naruugwe ase amaboko y’abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko, na barabwo ’nabamonachere ekiina ki’ogokwa,

English: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”
Kiswahili: na kumtia mikononi mwa watu wa Mataifa ili wamdhihaki na kumpiga mijeledi na kumsulubisha msalabani. Naye atafufuliwa siku ya tatu!”
Ekegusii: naende nabamorue ase amaboko y’ abanto b’Ebisaku; nakorerwe echeche, naende naakwe emecharichi na kobambwa; na ase rituko ria gatato nabokigwe.”

English: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.
Kiswahili: Kisha mama yao wana wa Zebedayo akamjia Yesu pamoja na wanawe, naye akapiga magoti mbele yake, akamwomba Yesu amfanyie jambo fulani.
Ekegusii: Erio ng’ina abana ba Zebedi akamochiera Yeso amo nabana baye, akamotung’amera na komosaba ring’ana.

English: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamuuliza, “Unataka nini?” Akajibu, “Tafadhali, wajalie wanangu hawa ili mmoja aketi upande wako wa kuume, na mwingine upande wako wa kushoto katika Ufalme wako.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Inki origetie?” Akamoiraneria, “Chiika ng’a abana bane babere baikaranse, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio, n’oyonde ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okobee ase oborwoti bwao.”

English: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi hamjui mnaloliomba. Je, mnaweza kukinywea kikombe nitakachonywea mimi?” Wakajibu, “Tunaweza.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe timomanyeti eri mogosaba. Inee! Namonyare konywera egekombe ’ndache konywera inche?” Bakamoteebia, “Natonyare.”

English: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Kwa kweli kikombe changu mtakinywea, lakini kuketi upande wangu wa kuume au wa kushoto si langu mimi kuwapa. Nafasi hizo ni za wale ambao wameandaliwa na Baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Egekombe ’nkonywera inche, namokenywere, korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio ney’okobee, tindi nokobua gw’okobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire na Tata one nabwo barariegwe.”

English: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wengine kumi waliposikia haya, waliwakasirikia hao ndugu wawili.
Ekegusii: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bakababea abamura baria babere.

English: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawaita wote pamoja na kuwaambia, “Mnafahamu kuwa watawala wa watu wa Mataifa huwatawala kwa nguvu, nao wenye vyeo huonyesha mamlaka yao.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, akabora, “Mwamanyire ng’a abagaambi b’Ebisaku bakogaambera abanto, na abanene babo nigo bare n’okobua igoro ase bare.

English: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.
Kiswahili: Isiwe hivyo kwenu. Badala yake, yeyote anayetaka kuwa mkuu miongoni mwenu hana budi kuwa mtumishi wenu,
Ekegusii: Korende ase more inwe, ayio takoba bo. Korende, oyorarigie koba omonene ase more, goika abe omokoreri oino;

English: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,
Kiswahili: naye anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza miongoni mwenu hana budi kuwa mtumwa wenu:
Ekegusii: na oyorarigie koba omotang’ani ase more, goika abe omosomba oino,

English: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
Kiswahili: kama vile ambavyo Mwana wa Adamu hakuja ili kutumikiwa, bali kutumika na kuutoa uhai wake uwe fidia kwa ajili ya wengi.”
Ekegusii: buna Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto atachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y’abange.”

English: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
Kiswahili: Yesu na wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakiondoka Yeriko, umati mkubwa wa watu ulimfuata.
Ekegusii: Ekero baare korua Yeriko, omoganda omonene okamotunyana.

English: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”
Kiswahili: Vipofu wawili walikuwa wameketi kando ya barabara. Waliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa anapita, wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi, tuhurumie!”
Ekegusii: Rora, abanto babere emeuko baikaransete ase enchera ensemo, na ekero bachia koigwa Yeso ogoeta, bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Omonene omwana o Daudi! Tororere amaabera.”

English: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukawakemea na kuwaambia wanyamaze, lakini wao wakazidi kupaza sauti, wakisema, “Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi, tuhurumie.”
Ekegusii: Omoganda oria okabatogonyera ng’a banyare gokira, korende bakamenta kwoga mono, bakaboora, “Omonene, tororere amaabera, aye Omwana o Daudi.”

English: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akasimama na kuwaita, akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafanyie nini?”
Ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, akabarangeria, akababoria, “Ninki morigetie mbakorere?”

English: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Bwana, tunataka kuona.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Omonene, otoramokie amaiso aito.”

English: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawahurumia na kuwagusa macho yao. Mara macho yao yakapata kuona, nao wakamfuata.
Ekegusii: Yeso agasogwa namaabera, agakuna amaiso abo. Erio kegima bakarora, bakamotunyana.

English: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
Kiswahili: Walipokaribia Yerusalemu, wakafika Bethfage katika Mlima wa Mizeituni. Ndipo Yesu akawatuma wanafunzi wake wawili,
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni. Erio Yeso agatoma aborokigwa baye babere,

English: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.
Kiswahili: akawaambia, “Nendeni katika kijiji kilichoko mbele yenu, nanyi mtamkuta punda amefungwa hapo, na mwana-punda pamoja naye. Wafungueni na mniletee.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Genda ase ekenyoro keria kere bosio bwaino, erio kegima namorore etigere esibire, na emori yaye amo nero; mochisibore mochindetere.

English: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akiwasemesha lolote, mwambieni kwamba Bwana ana haja nao, naye atawaruhusu mwalete mara.”
Ekegusii: Na omonto karabateebie ring’ana, momoteebie: Omonene nachiganetie; erio kegima nachitome.”

English: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
Kiswahili: Haya yalitukia ili litimie lile lililonenwa na nabii, akisema:
Ekegusii: Aya onsi agakoreka, erinde anyare goikeranigwa ayatebetwe nomobani, ogoteeba,

English: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”
Kiswahili: “Mwambieni Binti Sayuni, ‘Tazama, mfalme wako anakuja kwako, ni mnyenyekevu, naye amepanda punda, juu ya mwana-punda, mtoto wa punda.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Teebia abanto ba Sayoni, Rigereria, Omorwoti oino nkobaachera are, nomokanyeku, oriinire etigere, nase emori y’etigere, akamori g’etigere.”

English: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wakaenda, wakafanya kama Yesu alivyokuwa amewaagiza.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakagenda, bagakora buna Yeso abachiigete.

English: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.
Kiswahili: Wakamleta yule punda na mwana-punda, nao wakatandika mavazi yao juu ya hao punda, naye Yesu akaketi juu yake.
Ekegusii: Bakamorentera etigere amo nemori yaye, bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ya chirochio, na Yeso akayeriina.

English: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ukatandaza mavazi yao barabarani, na wengine wakakata matawi kutoka kwenye miti, wakayatandaza barabarani.
Ekegusii: Na abange b’emeganda bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete bagachiaara nchera.

English: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu uliomtangulia na ule uliomfuata ukapiga kelele ukisema, “Hosana, Mwana wa Daudi!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Hosana juu mbinguni!”
Ekegusii: Emeganda eria yatang’aine, na eyare komotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi! Nasesenirie oyio ogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Hosana, aye ore igoro mono!”

English: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoingia Yerusalemu, mji wote ukataharuki, watu wakauliza, “Huyu ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Yerusalemu, omochie omogima ogasega‐sega, abanto bakabooria, “Ning’o oyio?”

English: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukajibu, “Huyu ni Yesu, yule nabii kutoka Nazareti katika Galilaya.”
Ekegusii: Emeganda ekairaneria, “Oyio nere Yeso, omobani o Nazareti ya Galili.”

English: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaingia katika eneo la Hekalu na kuwafukuza wote waliokuwa wakinunua na kuuza vitu Hekaluni. Akazipindua meza za wale waliokuwa wakibadilisha fedha, na pia viti vya wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ya Nyasae, akabasokia isiko bonsi abarenge koonia na kogora ime ase Hekalu, akaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare koonchoreria chitaabu, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma.

English: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Imeandikwa, ‘Nyumba yangu itaitwa nyumba ya sala,’ lakini ninyi mmeifanya kuwa pango la wanyangʼanyi.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Neriikire: Enyomba y’ane nerokwe enyomba y’ogosaba, na inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”

English: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
Kiswahili: Vipofu na vilema wakamwendea kule Hekaluni, naye akawaponya.
Ekegusii: Emeuko na amagata bakamochiera aria ase Hekalu, na ere akabagwenia.

English: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,
Kiswahili: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walipoona mambo ya ajabu aliyofanya na kuwasikia watoto wakishangilia katika eneo la Hekalu wakisema, “Hosana Mwana wa Daudi,” walikasirika.
Ekegusii: Korende abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakabea, ekero bachia korora ebirage bi’ogokumia akorete, na abana bagoaka eriogi ase Hekalu ime, bakobora, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi!”

English: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza Yesu, “Je, unasikia hayo hawa wanayosema?” Akawajibu, “Naam; kwani hamkusoma, “ ‘Midomoni mwa watoto wachanga na wanyonyao umeamuru sifa’?”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Kwaigure abana buna bakobora?” Yeso akabateebia, Ee; timwana gosoma: Nase emenwa y’abana na ey’abakogonka kwerenteire ogotogia ogoikeranu?

English: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.
Kiswahili: Akawaacha, akatoka nje ya mji, akaenda hadi Bethania, akalala huko.
Ekegusii: Akabatiga, agasoka korwa ase omochie, akagenda Bethania, akarara aroro.

English: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi na mapema, Yesu alipokuwa akirudi mjini, alikuwa na njaa.
Ekegusii: Mambia gakoirana omochie, akaigwa enchara.

English: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.
Kiswahili: Akauona mtini kando ya barabara, naye akaukaribia, lakini hakupata tunda lolote ila majani. Ndipo akauambia, “Wewe usizae matunda tena kamwe!” Papo hapo ule mtini ukanyauka.
Ekegusii: Akarora omoko oyomo ase enchera ensemo, akayochiera, tarora gento asoro otatiga amato oka. Akayoteebia, “Korwa bono tokwama amatunda nonya ndinde.” Erio kegima omoko oyio okoma.

English: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake walipoona jambo hili, wakashangaa, wakamuuliza, “Imekuwaje mtini huu kunyauka ghafula?”
Ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia korora ogokora oko, bagakumia, bakabooria, “Inaki bono omoko oyo bwoma bwango iga?”

English: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Amin, nawaambia, kama mkiwa na imani wala msiwe na shaka, si kwamba mtaweza kufanya tu yale yaliyofanyika kwa huu mtini, bali hata mkiuambia huu mlima, ‘Ngʼoka, ukatupwe baharini,’ litafanyika.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nekeene nabateebirie; Komorabe nokwegena motabeti na tangutangu chinde, tari erio ri’omoko rioka morakore, korende ’namoteebie egetunwa eke: Tegoka, otugutwe enyancha ime, na rikoreke.

English: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
Kiswahili: Yoyote mtakayoyaomba mkisali na mkiamini, mtayapokea.”
Ekegusii: Kende gionsi moraborie ase ogosaba, komoregeene namokenyore.”

English: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoingia Hekaluni, viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu wakamjia alipokuwa anafundisha na kusema, “Unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani? Na ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka hayo?”
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Hekalu ime na kworokereria, agachierwa nabakuani abanene na etureti y’abanto, bakamobooria, “Nase okobua ki ogokora amang’ana aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”

English: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nami nitawauliza swali moja. Kama mkinijibu, nami nitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninafanya mambo haya.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nainche boigo nimbaboorie ring’ana erimo, komorang’iranerie, nainche boigo nimbateebie nase okobua ki ngokora aya.

English: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
Kiswahili: Ubatizo wa Yohana, ulitoka wapi? Je, ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?” Wakahojiana wao kwa wao na kusema, “Tukisema ulitoka mbinguni atatuuliza, ‘Mbona basi hamkumwamini?’
Ekegusii: Inee! Ebatiso ya Yohana, ng’ai yarwete? Igoro yarwete, gose nase Mwanyabaanto?” Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, igo aratoborie: Inaki rende motamwegenete?

English: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”
Kiswahili: Lakini tukisema, ‘Ulitoka kwa wanadamu,’ tunawaogopa hawa watu, maana wote wanamtambua Yohana kuwa ni nabii.”
Ekegusii: Naende toise goteeba: Nase Mwanyabaanto yarwete, nkoiroka tore omoganda, ekiagera abanto bonsi banchete ng’a Yohana nomobani orenge.”

English: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakamjibu Yesu, “Sisi hatujui.” Naye akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Titomanyeti.” Ere akabateebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase kobua ki ngokora aya.

English: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
Kiswahili: “Lakini mwaonaje? Mtu mmoja alikuwa na wana wawili. Akamwendea yule wa kwanza akamwambia, ‘Mwanangu, nenda ukafanye kazi kwenye shamba la mizabibu leo.’
Ekegusii: “Inaki morooche? Omonto gete narenge nabana babere abamura. Akamochiera oria bw’eritang’ani, akamoteebia: Omwana one, genda reero okore emeremo ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.

English: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.
Kiswahili: “Yule mwanawe akamjibu ‘Mimi sitakwenda.’ Baadaye akabadili mawazo yake akaenda.
Ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Tindigeti kogenda, korende magega yaye akaonchoka, akagenda.

English: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.
Kiswahili: “Kisha yule baba akamwendea yule mwanawe mwingine akamwambia vilevile. Yeye akajibu, ‘Nitakwenda, bwana,’ lakini hakwenda.
Ekegusii: Akamochiera oy’okabere, akamoteebia boigo. Nere akamoiraneria: Nkogenda inde, omonene; ko tagenda.

English: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.
Kiswahili: “Ni yupi kati yao hao wawili aliyetimiza kile alichotaka baba yake?” Wakamjibu, “Ni yule wa kwanza.” Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, watoza ushuru na makahaba wanawatangulia kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inee! Norori ase baria babere okorete ogwancha gwa ise?” Bakaboora, “Noria bw’eritang’ani.” Yeso akabateebia, “Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a abarusia ebango na abakungu abatayayi nkobatang’anera bare gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

English: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Yohana alikuja kwenu kuwaonyesha njia ya haki, lakini hamkumsadiki, lakini watoza ushuru na makahaba wakamsadiki. Nanyi hata mlipoona hayo, baadaye hamkutubu na kumsadiki.
Ekegusii: Inaki Yohana nigo achete ase more ase enchera y’oboronge, timwamwegena; korende abarusia ebango na abakungu abatayayi bakamwegena; na inwe nonya nekero mwaroche ayio, timwaonchoka na komwegena.

English: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.
Kiswahili: “Sikilizeni mfano mwingine: Kulikuwa na mtu mmoja mwenye shamba ambaye alipanda shamba la mizabibu. Akajenga ukuta kulizunguka, akatengeneza shinikizo ndani yake na akajenga mnara wa ulinzi. Kisha akalikodisha hilo shamba la mizabibu kwa wakulima fulani, naye akaondoka, akasafiri kwenda nchi nyingine.
Ekegusii: “Tegerera omobayeeno onde. Narenge omonto omonyene omochie; ere akarema omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akayoetananeria orobago, agakuunya ime aroro egeteera akomitera amasabibu, akaagaacha orwaki, akaywatananera abaremi, akagenda orogendo.

English: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mavuno ulipokaribia, akawatuma watumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili kukusanya matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’amatunda yachia goika ang’e, agatoma abasomba baye ase abaremi, banyore amatunda aye.

English: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
Kiswahili: “Wale wapangaji wakawakamata wale watumishi, wakampiga mmoja, wakamuua mwingine, na yule wa tatu wakampiga mawe.
Ekegusii: Abaremi bakabwata abasomba baye, oyomo bakamoaka, oyonde bakamoita, na oyonde bakamoaka amagena.

English: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawatuma kwao watumishi wengine, wengi kuliko wale wa kwanza, nao wale wapangaji wakawatendea vilevile.
Ekegusii: Naende agatoma abasomba bande, abange kobua baria b’eritang’ani; bakabakorera boigo.

English: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
Kiswahili: Mwisho wa yote, akamtuma mwanawe kwao, akisema, ‘Watamheshimu mwanangu.’
Ekegusii: Omoerio oye agatoma omwana oye ase bare, ogoteeba: Inabasike omwana one.

English: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’
Kiswahili: “Lakini wale wapangaji walipomwona mwanawe, wakasemezana wao kwa wao, ‘Huyu ndiye mrithi. Njooni tumuue, ili tuchukue urithi wake.’
Ekegusii: Korende abaremi baria, ekero bachia korora omwana oria, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando; gaki tomoite, omwando oye toyoire.

English: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakamchukua, wakamtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, wakamuua.
Ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita.

English: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo, huyo mwenye shamba la mizabibu atakapokuja, atawafanyia nini hao wakulima?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Karache omonyene omogondo, naki arakore abaremi baria?”

English: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Kwa huzuni kuu atawaangamiza kabisa hao wadhalimu na kulipangisha shamba lake la mizabibu kwa wakulima wengine ambao watampatia fungu lake la matunda wakati wa mavuno.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Igo araite abamwamu baria ogoita okobe, na aatananere abaremi bande omogondo oria bw’emesabibu, abarache komoa amatunda ekero amire.”

English: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Je, hamjasoma katika Maandiko kwamba: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni. Bwana ndiye alitenda jambo hili, nalo ni la ajabu machoni petu’?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, Timwana gosoma ase amariiko: Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona. Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?

English: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo ninawaambia, Ufalme wa Mungu utaondolewa kwenu na kupewa watu wengine wawezao kuzaa matunda yake.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eye nabateebirie, ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae naborusigwe ase more, boegwe egesaku egekwama amatunda aye.

English: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”
Kiswahili: Yeye aangukaye juu ya jiwe hili atavunjika vipande vipande, lakini yule litakayemwangukia atasagwa kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Oyoragwe igoro ase rigena eri nabunekane, na ere oyo rigena riria riragwere inarimosenyente.

English: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa Makuhani na Mafarisayo waliposikia mifano ya Yesu, walitambua kuwa alikuwa akiwasema wao.
Ekegusii: Ekero abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bachia koigwa emebayeeno yaye, bakamanya ng’a nabwo agoteeba.

English: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.
Kiswahili: Wakatafuta njia ya kumkamata, lakini wakaogopa umati wa watu, kwa kuwa watu walimwona Yesu kuwa ni nabii.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero bachia korigia komobwata, bakairoka emeganda, ekiagera abanto konya banchire ng’a ere nomobani.

English: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema nao tena kwa mifano, akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Naende Yeso agakwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno akabora,

English: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,
Kiswahili: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unaweza kufananishwa na mfalme mmoja aliyemwandalia mwanawe karamu ya arusi.
Ekegusii: “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomorwoti okorete omoyega bw’enyangi y’omwana oye.

English: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
Kiswahili: Akawatuma watumishi wake kuwaita wale waliokuwa wamealikwa karamuni, lakini wakakataa kuja.
Ekegusii: Agatoma abasomba baye batuunye baria konya barangerigwe ase enyangi, korende barabwo bakaanga gocha.

English: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’
Kiswahili: “Kisha akawatuma watumishi wengine akisema, ‘Waambieni wale walioalikwa kwamba nimeandaa chakula. Nimekwisha kuchinja mafahali wangu na vinono, karamu iko tayari. Karibuni kwa karamu ya arusi.’
Ekegusii: Naende agatoma abasomba bande, agateeba: Bateebie abarangerigwe: Rigereria, naroisirie endagera y’ane, chieri amo n’echimori chiane chianyenyirwe, na bionsi biabeire ang’e; inchwo ase omoyega bw’enyangi.

English: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;
Kiswahili: “Lakini hawakuzingatia, wakaenda zao: huyu shambani mwake na mwingine kwenye biashara zake.
Ekegusii: Korende bagachaaya amang’ana aya, bakagenda, oyomo ase omogondo oye, na oyonde ase oboonchoreria bwaye;

English: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.
Kiswahili: Wengine wao wakawakamata wale watumishi wake, wakawatesa na kuwaua.
Ekegusii: na abatigarete bakabwata abasomba baye, bakabakorera bobe bakabaita.

English: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
Kiswahili: Yule mfalme akakasirika sana, akapeleka jeshi lake likawaangamiza wale wauaji na kuuteketeza mji wao kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti oria akaba nendamwamu, agatoma emeganda y’abarwani, egasiria abaiti baria, na koyosamba omochie obo nomorero.

English: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
Kiswahili: “Kisha akawaambia watumishi wake, ‘Karamu ya arusi imeshakuwa tayari, lakini wale niliowaalika hawakustahili kuja.
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia abasomba baye: Ekeene enyangi yabeire ang’e, korende abaariganetigwe tibagwenereti.

English: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nendeni katika njia panda mkamwalike karamuni yeyote mtakayemwona.’
Ekegusii: Gaki, genda ase chinchera chinene, aba moranyore bonsi mobarangerie gocha ase omoyega bw’enyangi.

English: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
Kiswahili: Wale watumishi wakaenda barabarani, wakawakusanya watu wote waliowaona, wema na wabaya. Ukumbi wa arusi ukajaa wageni.
Ekegusii: Abasomba baria bagasoka, bagaika ase chinchera, bagasangereria abanyorete bonsi, ababe na abaya; igo enyomba y’enyangi egaichorwa nabageni.

English: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,
Kiswahili: “Lakini mfalme alipoingia ndani ili kuwaona wageni, akamwona mle mtu mmoja ambaye hakuwa amevaa vazi la arusi.
Ekegusii: “Korende ekero omorwoti achia gosoa korigereria abageni, akarora omonto oyomo aroro otabegete eyanga y’enyangi.

English: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akamuuliza, ‘Rafiki, uliingiaje humu bila vazi la arusi?’ Yule mtu hakuwa na la kusema.
Ekegusii: Akamoboria: Mosani, naki gwakorete ogasoa aiga, na aye otari neyanga y’enyangi? Agakira‐kiri.

English: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’
Kiswahili: “Ndipo mfalme akawaambia watumishi wake, ‘Mfungeni mikono na miguu mkamtupe nje, kwenye giza. Huko kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.’
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agateebia abakoreri: Moboe amaboko na amagoro, momotugute ase omosunte isiko; aroro abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.

English: For many are called, but few chosen.”
Kiswahili: “Kwa maana walioitwa ni wengi, lakini walioteuliwa ni wachache.”
Ekegusii: Inaki abarangerigwe nabaange, korende abachorirwe nabake.”

English: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mafarisayo wakatoka nje wakaandaa mpango wa kumtega Yesu katika maneno yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakagenda, bakaroberia buna bagochia gotega Yeso ase amang’ana aye.

English: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.
Kiswahili: Wakatuma wanafunzi wao kwake pamoja na Maherode. Nao wakasema, “Mwalimu, tunajua kwamba wewe ni mtu mwadilifu na unafundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli bila kuyumbishwa na mtu wala kuonyesha upendeleo.
Ekegusii: Bagatoma aborokigwa babo ase are, amo n’Abaherode, bakaboora, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ore omonto bw’ekeene, na enchera ya Nyasae nigo okoyiorokereria ase ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto; ekiagera torengerereti obonene bw’ abanto.

English: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
Kiswahili: Tuambie basi, wewe unaonaje? Je, ni halali kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?”
Ekegusii: Gaki toteebie naki orooche aye? Mboronge komoa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo.”

English: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu, akijua makusudi yao mabaya, akawaambia, “Enyi wanafiki, kwa nini mnajaribu kunitega?
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire obong’ainereria bwabo, akabora, “Inaki mogonteema, inwe abang’ainereria?

English: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.
Kiswahili: Nionyesheni hiyo sarafu inayotumika kwa kulipia kodi.” Wakamletea dinari.
Ekegusii: Inyorokie ebesa y’ebango.” Bakamorentera ebesa.

English: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”
Kiswahili: Naye akawauliza, “Sura hii ni ya nani? Na maandishi haya ni ya nani?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Ekieni eke na amariiko aya nebiang’o?”

English: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Ni vya Kaisari.” Basi Yesu akawaambia, “Mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Nebia Kaisari.” Erio akabateebia, “Nabo, ebire ebia Kaisari moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae moe Nyasae.”

English: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia hili, wakashangaa. Hivyo wakamwacha, wakaenda zao.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa ring’ana riria, bagakumia; bakamotiga, bakagenda.

English: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo hiyo Masadukayo, wale wasemao kwamba hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza swali, wakisema,
Ekegusii: Rituko erio erio Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bagoteeba ng’a okobokigwa tikoiyo, bakamobooria,

English: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
Kiswahili: “Mwalimu, Mose alisema, ‘Kama mtu akifa bila kuwa na watoto, ndugu yake inampasa amwoe huyo mjane ili ampatie watoto huyo nduguye aliyekufa.’
Ekegusii: bakobora, “Omworokia, Musa nateebete: Omonto karakwe, na ere tari n’abana, momura omwabo atware omoboraka oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.

English: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwa na ndugu saba miongoni mwetu. Yule wa kwanza akaoa mke, naye akafa, na kwa kuwa hakuwa na watoto, akamwachia nduguye yule mjane.
Ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise oyomo batano na babere egati yaito. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma, erio agakwa, na ekiagera atarenge nabana, agatigera momura omwabo mok’aye.

English: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
Kiswahili: Ikatokea vivyo hivyo kwa yule ndugu wa pili, na wa tatu, hadi wote saba.
Ekegusii: Naboigo noyo o kabere akamotwara, na oyo o gatato, goika bonsi batano na babere bakaera.

English: After them all, the woman died.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, yule mwanamke naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Omoerio o bonsi omokungu oria nere agakwa.

English: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, siku ya ufufuo, yeye atakuwa mke wa nani miongoni mwa wale ndugu saba, kwa kuwa wote walikuwa wamemwoa huyo mwanamke?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa, mokang’o arabe ase baria batano na babere; naki bonsi mbameny’anete nere?”

English: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mwapotoka kwa sababu hamjui Maandiko wala uweza wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabairaneria, “Mwasirire inwe, ekiagera timomanyeti amariiko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae.

English: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa ufufuo, watu hawataoa wala kuolewa, bali watakuwa kama malaika wa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase okobokigwa tibakonyuoma gose tibakonyuomwa, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika ba Nyasae bare igoro.

English: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,
Kiswahili: Lakini kuhusu ufufuo wa wafu, hamjasoma kile Mungu alichowaambia, kwamba,
Ekegusii: Na ase okobokigwa kw’abakuure timwana gosoma eri mwatebetigwe na Nyasae:

English: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
Kiswahili: ‘Mimi ni Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo’? Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali ni Mungu wa walio hai.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Nyasae o Aburaamu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo? Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo.”

English: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu uliposikia hayo, ulishangaa sana kwa mafundisho yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoganda ochia koigwa aya, ogakumia ase okworokereria kwaye.

English: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo waliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewanyamazisha Masadukayo, Mafarisayo wakakusanyika pamoja.
Ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai, ekero bachia koigwa ng’a Yeso obakiririe Abasadukai, bagasangererekana amo.

English: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao, mtaalamu wa sheria, akamuuliza swali ili kumjaribu, akisema,
Ekegusii: Oyomo ase barabwo, omonto bw’amachiiko, akamobooria ase okomoteema,

English: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
Kiswahili: “Mwalimu, ni amri ipi katika Sheria iliyo kuu kuliko zote?”
Ekegusii: “Omworokia, ngochiika ki kore okonene ase amachiiko onsi?”

English: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “ ‘Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote na kwa akili zako zote.’
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Mwanche Omonene Nyasae oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi.

English: This is the first and great commandment.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo amri iliyo kuu, tena ni ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika okonene, naende nakwo kw’eritang’ani.

English: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
Kiswahili: Nayo ya pili ni kama hiyo, nayo ni hii: ‘Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.’
Ekegusii: Nogwa kabere gokoreng’aine noko: Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete aye omonyene.

English: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
Kiswahili: Amri hizi mbili ndizo msingi wa Sheria na Manabii.”
Ekegusii: Ase amachiiko aya abere naro atenenerete amachiiko onsi na ababani.”

English: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,
Kiswahili: Wakati Mafarisayo walikuwa wamekusanyika pamoja, Yesu akawauliza,
Ekegusii: Abafarisai kobasangererekanire amo, Yeso akababoria,

English: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”
Kiswahili: “Mnaonaje kuhusu Kristo?Yeye ni mwana wa nani?” Wakamjibu, “Yeye ni mwana wa Daudi.”
Ekegusii: “Inaki inwe mokorengereria ase Kristo? Nomwana o ng’o are?” Bakamoiraneria, “Nomwana o Daudi.”

English: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Inakuwaje basi kwamba Daudi, akinena kwa kuongozwa na Roho, anamwita Kristo ‘Bwana’? Kwa maana asema,
Ekegusii: Akababoria, Inki rende gekogera Daudi, akoraagwa n’Omoika, akamoroka Omonene, okobora:

English: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?
Kiswahili: “ ‘Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Omonene one: Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika ’mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao?

English: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”
Kiswahili: Kama basi Daudi anamwita yeye ‘Bwana,’ awezaje kuwa mwanawe?”
Ekegusii: Gaki, onye Daudi okomooroka Kristo, naki rende arabe omwana oye?

English: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu aliyeweza kumjibu Yesu neno. Tena tangu siku hiyo hakuna aliyethubutu kumuuliza tena maswali.
Ekegusii: Onde tarenge ore konyara komoiraneria ing’ana; nonya nkorwa rituko riria monto onde tarenge na boremu komoboria maborio ande.

English: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akauambia umati wa watu pamoja na wanafunzi wake:
Ekegusii: Naende Yeso agateebia emeganda na aborokigwa baye,

English: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.
Kiswahili: “Walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wameketi katika kiti cha Mose,
Ekegusii: “Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai baikaransire ase ekerogo kia Musa.

English: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.
Kiswahili: hivyo inawapasa kuwatii na kufanya kila kitu wanachowaambia. Lakini msifuate yale wanayotenda, kwa sababu hawatendi yale wanayohubiri.
Ekegusii: Gaki, amang’ana onsi bakobateebia, moyanare na koyabwata; korende, timokora buna barabwo bagokora.

English: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.
Kiswahili: Wao hufunga mizigo mikubwa na kuiweka mabegani mwa watu, lakini wao wenyewe hawako radhi hata kuinua kidole ili kuisogeza.
Ekegusii: Inaki nigo bakoboa chigurube chindito, bachitweka ase amareko y’abanto, korende barabwo abanyene tibari gwancha gochitigeria nekiara kiabo.

English: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,
Kiswahili: “Wao hutenda mambo yao yote ili waonekane na watu. Hupanua vikasha vyao vyenye maandiko ya sheria na kurefusha matamvua ya mavazi yao.
Ekegusii: Na ogokora kwabo gwonsi nigo bagokora ng’a barorwe nabaanto; nigo bakogareyia ebitinti biabo biriikire amariiko, naende batambeyia emebareero y’ogochabera chianga chiabo.

English: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
Kiswahili: Wanapenda kukalia viti vya heshima katika karamu, na vile viti maalum sana katika masinagogi.
Ekegusii: Naende nigo banchete aase amasikani ase emeyega, na goikaransa aase ebirogo bi’amasikani ase chisinagogi,

English: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.
Kiswahili: Hupenda kusalimiwa masokoni na kutaka watu wawaite ‘Rabi.’
Ekegusii: na gokwanigwa n’amasikani ase chichiiro, na korokwa Omwarimu n’abanto.

English: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ninyi msiitwe ‘Rabi,’ kwa sababu mnaye Bwana mmoja na ninyi nyote ni ndugu.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe timobaisa korokwa Omworokia, ekiagera Omwarimu oino noyomo, na inwe mwensi nabamo.

English: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: Nanyi msimwite mtu yeyote ‘Baba,’ hapa duniani, kwa maana mnaye Baba mmoja, naye yuko mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Naende timobaisa koroka monto ase ense tata, ekiagera Iso oino noyomo, oyore igoro.

English: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.
Kiswahili: Wala msiitwe ‘Mwalimu,’ kwa maana mnaye mwalimu mmoja tu, ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Gose timobaisa korokwa abanene, ekiagera Omonene oino noyomo, nere Kristo.

English: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliye mkuu kuliko ninyi nyote miongoni mwenu atakuwa mtumishi wenu.
Ekegusii: Nere oyore omonene mono kobua ase more, nigo arabe omokoreri oino,

English: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa yeyote anayejikweza atashushwa, na yeyote anayejinyenyekeza atakwezwa.
Ekegusii: na oyo okweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.

English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ole wenu, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, enyi wanafiki! Kwa maana mnawafungia watu milango ya Ufalme wa Mbinguni. Ninyi wenyewe hamuingii humo, nao wale wanaotaka kuingia mnawazuia.
Ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera mwasiekeire abanto oborwoti bwa igoro; naki inwe abanyene timori gosoa, na baria barigeti gosoa, timori kobaa ribaga basoe.

English: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.
Kiswahili: Ole wenu walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, enyi wanafiki! Mnakula katika nyumba za wajane, nanyi kwa kujifanya kuwa wema, mnasali sala ndefu. Kwa hiyo hukumu yenu itakuwa kuu zaidi.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera mokounereria chinyomba chi’abatakaanwa, na ase obong’ainereria mwasaba ogosaba ogotambe. Ase ayio, inamonyore ekiina ekere ekenene kobua.

English: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, enyi wanafiki! Ninyi mnasafiri baharini na nchi kavu ili kumfanya mtu mmoja mwongofu, lakini baada ya kumpata, mnamfanya mwana wa jehanamu mara mbili kuliko ninyi!
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosiongorokana enyancha na ense enyomo korigia omotunyani oyomo, na ekero abeire omotunyani, mwagera oba omwana bw’omorero o kare na kare ara kabere kobua inwe abanyene.

English: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu, viongozi vipofu! Ninyi mwasema, ‘Mtu akiapa kwa Hekalu, kiapo hicho si kitu; lakini mtu akiapa kwa dhahabu ya Hekalu, amefungwa kwa kiapo chake.’
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, abaraai emeuko, inwe abamogoteeba: Onde bwensi kararie emuma ase Hekalu, tari gento, korende onde bwensi kararie emuma ase etaabu ye Hekalu, bwesibire n’emuma yaye.

English: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
Kiswahili: Ninyi vipofu wapumbavu! Ni kipi kilicho kikuu zaidi: ni ile dhahabu, au ni lile Hekalu linaloifanya hiyo dhahabu kuwa takatifu?
Ekegusii: Inwe abariri emeuko! Nkereki kere ekenene kobua: netaabu, gose ne Hekalu egokora etaabu ebe enchenu?

English: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’
Kiswahili: Pia mnasema, ‘Mtu akiapa kwa madhabahu, si kitu; lakini mtu akiapa kwa sadaka iliyo juu ya madhabahu, amefungwa kwa kiapo chake’
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Onde bwensi kararie emuma ase egesasiimero tari gento; korende onde bwensi kararie emuma ase ekeng’wanso kere igoro ase egesasiimero bwesibire nemuma yaye.

English: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
Kiswahili: Ninyi vipofu! Ni kipi kikuu zaidi: ni sadaka, au ni madhabahu yanayoifanya hiyo sadaka kuwa takatifu?
Ekegusii: Inwe emeuko! Nkere ki kere ekenene kobua: nesadaka, gose negesasiimero kegokora esadaka ebe enchenu?

English: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, mtu aapaye kwa madhabahu, huapa kwa hayo madhabahu na vitu vyote vilivyo juu yake.
Ekegusii: Gaki, oyorarie emuma ase egesasiimero nigo ararie ase ekio, na ase ebinto bionsi ebire igoro yaye.

English: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.
Kiswahili: Naye mtu aapaye kwa Hekalu, huapa kwa hilo Hekalu na kwa huyo akaaye ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Na oyo orarie emuma ase Hekalu, nigo ararie ase eyio na ase oyo omenyete imeo.

English: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.
Kiswahili: Naye aapaye kwa mbingu, huapa kwa kiti cha enzi cha Mungu na kwa yeye aketiye juu ya kiti hicho.
Ekegusii: Na oyo orarie emuma ase igoro, nigo ararie ase ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae na ase oria ogeikaranserete.

English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, ninyi wanafiki! Kwa maana mnatoa zaka ya mnanaa, bizari na jira, lakini mmeacha mambo makuu zaidi ya sheria, yaani haki, huruma na uaminifu. Iliwapasa kufanya haya makuu ya sheria bila kupuuza hayo matoleo.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria ekiagera nigo mokorua ensemo ya ikomi ye chiarare, na ebinsari, ne chinyeni chinde, na mwatiga amang’ana ayare amanene y’ogochika na oboronge, na amaabera, na okwegena. Naro ayio nabagwenerete moyakore, amo na gotatiga ayande.

English: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!
Kiswahili: Ninyi viongozi vipofu, mnachuja kiroboto lakini mnameza ngamia!
Ekegusii: Inwe abaraai emeuko, mwakenonora egechuni, mwamera engamia!

English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, ninyi wanafiki! Kwa maana mnasafisha kikombe na sahani kwa nje, lakini ndani mmejaa unyangʼanyi na kutokuwa na kiasi.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime biaichoire nobouri na okogania gotari nekerengo.

English: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
Kiswahili: Ewe Farisayo kipofu! Safisha ndani ya kikombe na sahani kwanza, ndipo nje itakuwa safi pia.
Ekegusii: Aye Omofarisai omouko! Sibia ritang’ani egekombe na esani ime, erio nonya nisiko binyare koba ebirabu.

English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, ninyi wanafiki! Mnafanana na makaburi yaliyopakwa chokaa, ambayo yanapendeza kwa nje, lakini ndani yamejaa mifupa ya wafu na kila aina ya uchafu.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogwekaine nechimbeera chiakire echooka; na chirochio isiko chirorekana ng’a nechingiya, korende ime nigo chiichire namauga y’ebitondo, na euramba yonsi.

English: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, kwa nje ninyi mnaonekana kwa watu kuwa wenye haki, lakini kwa ndani mmejaa unafiki na uovu.
Ekegusii: Nainwe nabo more, isiko mwarorekana ase abanto ng’a nabaronge more, korende ime yaino mwaichoirwe nobong’ainereria na ebibe ebinge.

English: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, ninyi wanafiki! Mnajenga makaburi ya manabii na kuyapamba makaburi ya wenye haki.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mokoagaacha chimbeera chi’ababani, na kobaria chimbeera chi’abaronge,

English: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
Kiswahili: Nanyi mwasema, ‘Kama tungaliishi wakati wa baba zetu, tusingalikuwa tumeshiriki katika kumwaga damu ya manabii!’
Ekegusii: mogoteeba: Onye ntwarengeo kare ase amatuko ye chisokoro chiaito, anga titwabwatanete nabarabwo ase ogoitera amanyinga y’ababani.

English: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mnajishuhudia wenyewe kwamba ninyi ni wana wa wale waliowaua manabii.
Ekegusii: Igo mwetebire inwe abanyene, ng’a inwe nabana babo more, baria baitete ababani.

English: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.
Kiswahili: Haya basi, kijazeni kipimo cha dhambi ya baba zenu!
Ekegusii: Gaki bono, ichoria ekerengo gie chisokoro chiaino.

English: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?
Kiswahili: “Ninyi nyoka, ninyi uzao wa nyoka wenye sumu! Mtaiepukaje hukumu ya jehanamu?
Ekegusii: Inwe ching’iti, oroiboro rw’echinchoka, naki morakore motame ekiina ki’omorero o kare na kare!

English: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, tazameni, natuma kwenu manabii na wenye hekima na walimu. Baadhi yao mtawaua na kuwasulubisha, na wengine wao mtawapiga mijeledi katika masinagogi yenu na kuwafuatia kutoka mji mmoja hadi mji mwingine.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio natomire ababani ase more, na abanto abang’aini, na aborokia b’amariiko; abande babo inamobaite na kobaabamba, na abande babo inamobang’wanie emecharichi ase chisinagogi chiaino, na kobachanda omochie ase omochie.

English: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ile damu ya wenye haki wote iliyomwagwa hapa duniani, tangu damu ya Abeli, ambaye alikuwa hana hatia, hadi damu ya Zekaria mwana wa Barakia, mliyemuua kati ya patakatifu na madhabahu, itawajia juu yenu.
Ekegusii: Erio nario arabachere amanyinga onsi ayaboronge ayaitegete ase ense, korwa amanyinga y’Abeli, oria omonyene oboronge, goika amanyinga a Zakaria, omwana o Barakia, oria mwaiterete gati ye Hekalu na egesasiimero.

English: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, haya yote yatakuja juu ya kizazi hiki.
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie ng’a amang’ana aya onsi naache igoro ase ekegori eke.

English: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!
Kiswahili: “Ee Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, uwauaye manabii na kuwapiga mawe wale waliotumwa kwako! Mara ngapi nimetamani kuwakusanya watoto wako pamoja, kama vile kuku akusanyavyo vifaranga wake chini ya mabawa yake, lakini hukutaka!
Ekegusii: “Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, omochie ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe ase ore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao, buna engoko egosangereria ebichuchu biaye ase chimbaaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!

English: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
Kiswahili: Tazama nyumba yenu imeachwa ukiwa.
Ekegusii: Rora, enyomba yaino mwatigeirwe ritombe.

English: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, hamtaniona tena tangu sasa mpaka mtakaposema, ‘Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Na inche nabateebirie, timokondora naende nonya ng’ake goika ekero keria morache goteeba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene.”

English: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
Kiswahili: Yesu akatoka Hekaluni na alipokuwa akienda zake, wanafunzi wake wakamwendea ili kumwonyesha majengo ya Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Yeso agatiga Hekalu, akaba nkogenda are, na aborokigwa baye bakamochiera komworokia amaagacho ye Hekalu.

English: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawauliza, “Je, mnayaona haya yote? Amin, nawaambia, hakuna hata jiwe moja hapa litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali kila moja litabomolewa.”
Ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria, “Inee! Mwarorire aya onsi? Nekeene nabateebirie: Tirigotigara rigena erimo aiga igoro ase erinde, eritatagorwe.”

English: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa ameketi kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni, wanafunzi wake wakamjia faraghani, wakamuuliza, “Tuambie, mambo haya yatatukia lini, nayo dalili ya kuja kwako na ya mwisho wa dunia ni gani?”
Ekegusii: Gaikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera bobisi, bakamoboria, “Toteebie, aya indiriri arabe? Naende ninki ekemanyererio ki’ogocha kwao, na ay’omoerio bw’ense?”

English: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Jihadharini, mtu yeyote asiwadanganye.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina.

English: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wengi watakuja kwa Jina langu, wakidai, ‘Mimi ndiye Kristo,’nao watawadanganya wengi.
Ekegusii: Inaki abange inabaache ase erieta riane, babore: Inche ninche Kristo; baraae abange na kobasiria.

English: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.
Kiswahili: Mtasikia habari za vita na matetesi ya vita. Angalieni msitishike, kwa maana haya hayana budi kutukia. Lakini ule mwisho bado.
Ekegusii: Na inwe inamoigwe esegi, ne chinkuma, chi’esegi; rigereria timoichanigwa, ekiagera ekeene, aya onsi nabe; korende omoerio toracha.

English: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.
Kiswahili: Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa, na ufalme dhidi ya ufalme. Kutakuwa na njaa na mitetemeko ya ardhi sehemu mbalimbali.
Ekegusii: Inaki egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti inaborwane noborwoti bonde; enchara na emetengecho y’ense inabibe ase chinsemo ne chinsemo.

English: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.
Kiswahili: Haya yote yatakuwa ndio mwanzo wa utungu.
Ekegusii: Ayio onsi naro omochakano bw’obororo.

English: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo mtasalitiwa, ili mteswe na kuuawa, nanyi mtachukiwa na mataifa yote kwa ajili yangu.
Ekegusii: Erio inabaabarue monyare gochandwa na goitwa, na inwe inamwangwe nebisaku bionsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.

English: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, wengi wataacha imani yao, nao watasalitiana kila mmoja na mwenzake na kuchukiana.
Ekegusii: Na ekero ekio abanto abange inabagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, inabasigaanane na kobeekana ase ababisa babo, naende nabagechane,

English: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.
Kiswahili: Watatokea manabii wengi wa uongo, nao watawadanganya watu wengi.
Ekegusii: na ababani b’oborimo abange mbaimoke, baraae abange na kobasiria.

English: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya kuongezeka kwa uovu upendo wa watu wengi utapoa,
Ekegusii: Nase engencho y’okomenteka kw’ebibe, obwanchani bw’abange ’nabokende.

English: But he who endures to the end will be saved.
Kiswahili: lakini yule atakayevumilia hadi mwisho ataokolewa.
Ekegusii: Korende oy’oraaremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.

English: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.
Kiswahili: Injili ya Ufalme itahubiriwa ulimwenguni kote kuwa ushuhuda kwa mataifa yote. Ndipo mwisho utakapokuja.
Ekegusii: Naende, amang’ana aya amaya y’oborwoti narandigwe ase ense yonsi koba kirori ase ebisaku bionsi; erio omoerio ochiche.

English: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),
Kiswahili: “Hivyo mtakapoona lile ‘chukizo la uharibifu’ lililonenwa na nabii Danieli limesimama mahali patakatifu (asomaye na afahamu),
Ekegusii: Gaki, naboigo kamogocha korora okogechia kw’ogosaria gwatebetwe nomobani Danieli, kogotenena Aase Aachenu (oy’ogosoma amanye),

English: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
Kiswahili: basi wale walioko Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani.
Ekegusii: erio abare Boyahudi batame gochia ase ebitunwa.

English: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.
Kiswahili: Yeyote aliye juu ya dari ya nyumba asishuke ili kuchukua chochote kutoka ndani ya nyumba.
Ekegusii: Ere oyore kerama igoro taika kogenda kobogoria gento ekere nyomba mwaye,

English: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.
Kiswahili: Aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua vazi lake.
Ekegusii: na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eyanga yaye.

English: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!
Kiswahili: Ole wao wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto siku hizo!
Ekegusii: Korende nebe aakong’u ase abare morito na abakogonkia ase amatuko aria.

English: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,
Kiswahili: Ombeni ili kukimbia kwenu kusiwe wakati wa baridi au siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Korende saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero gi’etoigo, gose ase rituko ri’Esabato,

English: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wakati huo kutakuwa na dhiki kuu ambayo haijapata kuwako tangu mwanzo wa dunia mpaka sasa: wala haitakuwako tena kamwe.
Ekegusii: ekiagera agwo n’ebe emechando emenene, etana koba korwa omochakano bw’ense goika bono, gose tekoba bo naende nonya ng’ake.

English: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.
Kiswahili: Kama siku hizo zisingefupishwa, hakuna hata mtu mmoja ambaye angeokoka. Lakini kwa ajili ya wateule, siku hizo zitafupizwa.
Ekegusii: Naende onye amatuko ayio atanachetwe, anga monto onde bwensi tatooregete; korende ase engencho y’abachore amatuko ayio nanachwe.

English: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo kama mtu yeyote akiwaambia, ‘Tazama, Kristo huyu hapa!’ Au, ‘Kristo yuko kule,’ msisadiki.
Ekegusii: Na ekero ekio omonto karabateebie: Rora, Kristo naa are! Gose: Ooria! Timwancha.

English: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana watatokea makristo wa uongo na manabii wa uongo, nao watafanya ishara kubwa na maajabu mengi ili kuwapotosha, ikiwezekana, hata wale wateule hasa.
Ekegusii: Inaki nabaoroke abakristo b’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo, nabaorokie ebikone ebinene na amakumia, goika keranyarekane, nabang’aine nonya nabachore.

English: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.
Kiswahili: Angalieni, nimekwisha kuwaambia mapema.
Ekegusii: Rora, nabateebirie aya ritang’ani.

English: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo mtu yeyote akiwaambia, ‘Yule kule nyikani,’ msiende huko. Au akisema, ‘Yuko kwenye chumba,’ msisadiki.
Ekegusii: Gaki, kobarabateebie: Rora, oyo ore ase erooro, timosoka isiko; kobarabateebie: Oyo ore ebinunchi bia bobisi, timwancha.

English: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile umeme utokeavyo mashariki na kuonekana hata magharibi, ndivyo itakavyokuwa kuja kwake Mwana wa Adamu.
Ekegusii: Inaki buna okomesa gokorwa moocha kwabara gochia bosongo, naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto korache koba.

English: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana popote ulipo mzoga, huko ndiko wakusanyikapo tai.
Ekegusii: Inaki aase ribego rire, nao chinsoti chigosangererekana.

English: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
Kiswahili: “Mara baada ya dhiki ya siku zile, “ ‘jua litatiwa giza, nao mwezi hautatoa nuru yake; nazo nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani, na nguvu za anga zitatikisika.’
Ekegusii: Korende bwango magega y’emechando y’amatuko aria, erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi tokobara, ne ching’enang’eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chia igoro nachitengechigwe.

English: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo itakapotokea ishara ya Mwana wa Adamu angani, na makabila yote ya dunia yataomboleza. Nao watamwona Mwana wa Adamu akija juu ya mawingu ya angani, katika uwezo na utukufu mkuu.
Ekegusii: Erio nario ekemanyererio ki’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto kerache kororekana igoro, na ebisaku bionsi bi’ense nario biraarere; naende nabarore omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ogocha ase amare a igoro ne chinguru, na obonene obonge.

English: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
Kiswahili: Naye atawatuma malaika zake kwa sauti kuu ya tarumbeta, nao watawakusanya wateule wake kutoka pande zote nne za dunia, kutoka mwisho mmoja wa mbingu hadi mwisho mwingine.
Ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye na egeturi ekenene ki’egetuureri, na barabwo mbasangererie abachoore baye korwa ase chinsinyo inye, korwa ensinyo eyemo ya igoro goika eyende.

English: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.
Kiswahili: “Basi jifunzeni somo hili kutokana na mtini: Matawi yake yanapoanza kuchipua na kutoa majani, mnatambua kwamba wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.
Ekegusii: Eorokererie omobayeeno oyo korwa ase omoko: Orosagia rwaye korwachaakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, egura gura ng’ang’e ere.

English: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yote, mnatambua kwamba wakati u karibu, hata malangoni.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe komokorora aya aorokire, momanye ng’a omoerio obeire ang’e na gesieri.

English: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi anyare koba.

English: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
Kiswahili: Mbingu na nchi zitapita, lakini maneno yangu hayatapita kamwe.
Ekegusii: Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake.

English: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
Kiswahili: “Kwa habari ya siku ile na saa, hakuna ajuaye, hata malaika walio mbinguni wala Mwana, ila Baba peke yake.
Ekegusii: Korende amang’ana ye rituko riria, na ensa eria onde tari omanyete, nonya nabamalaika ba igoro, nonya n’Omwana, otatiga Tata bweka.

English: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyokuwa wakati wa Noa, ndivyo itakavyokuwa kuja kwake Mwana wa Adamu.
Ekegusii: Korende buna amatuko aria a Nuhu abeete, naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto korache koba.

English: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana siku zile kabla ya gharika, watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakioa na kuolewa, mpaka siku ile Noa alipoingia katika safina.
Ekegusii: Inaki buna barenge ase amatuko aria etoigo etaracha, baare koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato,

English: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
Kiswahili: Nao hawakujua lolote mpaka gharika ilipokuja ikawakumba wote. Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa atakapokuja Mwana wa Adamu.
Ekegusii: na barabwo tibamanya goika etoigo egaacha, ekabasiria bonsi; naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto koraache koba.

English: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.
Kiswahili: Watu wawili watakuwa shambani, naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.
Ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto babere inababe mogondo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.

English: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wawili watakuwa wanasaga pamoja, naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.
Ekegusii: Abakungu babere inababe bagoseera orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.

English: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
Kiswahili: “Basi kesheni, kwa sababu hamjui ni siku gani atakapokuja Bwana wenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, renda, ekiagera timomanyeti ituko ki Omonene oino agocha.

English: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
Kiswahili: Lakini fahamuni jambo hili: Kama mwenye nyumba angejua ni wakati gani wa usiku ambao mwizi atakuja, angekesha na hangekubali nyumba yake kuvunjwa.
Ekegusii: Korende manya aya, onye omonyene enyomba namanyete nkero ki ase obotuko omoibi agocha, anga narendete taiberwa.

English: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ninyi pia hamna budi kuwa tayari, kwa sababu Mwana wa Adamu atakuja saa msiyotazamia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nainwe, kabe ang’e; naki ase ensa eria motakagereti nario Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto araache.

English: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
Kiswahili: “Ni nani basi aliye mtumishi mwaminifu na mwenye busara, ambaye bwana wake amemweka kusimamia watumishi wengine katika nyumba yake, ili awape chakula chao kwa wakati unaofaa?
Ekegusii: Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, obegetwe nomonene oye igoro ase enyomba yaye, ae abanto endagera ase ekero kegwenerete?

English: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.
Kiswahili: Heri mtumishi yule ambaye bwana wake atakaporudi atamkuta akifanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omosomba oria, ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.

English: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, atamweka mtumishi huyo kuwa msimamizi wa mali yake yote.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.

English: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
Kiswahili: Lakini kama huyo mtumishi ni mwovu, naye akasema moyoni mwake, ‘Bwana wangu atakawia muda mrefu,’
Ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria omobe, karateebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire goocha,

English: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,
Kiswahili: kisha akaanza kuwapiga watumishi wenzake, na kula na kunywa pamoja na walevi.
Ekegusii: achaake goaka abasomba b’omonene oye, na koria na konywa amo nabagotinda,

English: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,
Kiswahili: Basi bwana wa mtumishi huyo atakuja siku asiyodhani na saa asiyoijua.
Ekegusii: omonene bw’omosomba oria nigo araache rituko atakagereti, na ensa atamanyeti;

English: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.
Kiswahili: Atamkata vipande vipande na kumweka katika sehemu moja pamoja na wanafiki, mahali ambako kutakuwa ni kulia na kusaga meno.
Ekegusii: ere namonachane abe ebing’ese namobeeke amo nabang’ainereria. Aroro abanto ’mbabe nekerero na okoriania amaino.

English: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
Kiswahili: “Wakati huo, Ufalme wa Mbinguni utakuwa kama wanawali kumi waliochukua taa zao na kwenda kumlaki bwana arusi.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio, oborwoti bwa igoro nigo boragwekanigwe n’abaiseke ikomi ababogoretie chitaaya chiabo, bagasoka gochia korotota omonywomi.

English: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
Kiswahili: Watano wao walikuwa wapumbavu na watano walikuwa wenye busara.
Ekegusii: Batano ase barabwo nigo barenge abariri, na batano abang’aini.

English: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
Kiswahili: Wale wapumbavu walichukua taa zao lakini hawakuchukua mafuta ya akiba,
Ekegusii: Na ekero baria abariri baimogetie chitaaya chiabo, korende tibaimokia y’ogochi komenta;

English: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
Kiswahili: lakini wale wenye busara walichukua taa zao na mafuta ya akiba kwenye vyombo.
Ekegusii: korende baria abang’aini bakaimokia amaguta ase ebinto biabo amo ne chitaaya chiabo.

English: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
Kiswahili: Bwana arusi alipokawia kuja wale wanawali wote wakasinzia na kulala.
Ekegusii: Ekero omonywomi atebana gocha, bagasundoka bonsi, bakarara.

English: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
Kiswahili: “Usiku wa manane pakawa na kelele: ‘Tazameni, huyu hapa bwana arusi! Tokeni nje mkamlaki!’
Ekegusii: Korende botuko gati gekaba egeturi: Rigereria, omonywomi oyo! Soka momorotote!

English: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo wale wanawali wote wakaamka na kuzitengeneza taa zao.
Ekegusii: Erio abaiseke baria bonsi bakaimoka koroisia chitaaya chiabo.

English: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
Kiswahili: Wale wapumbavu wakawaambia wale wenye busara, ‘Tupatieni mafuta yenu kidogo; taa zetu zinazimika.’
Ekegusii: Baria abariri bagateebia baria abang’aini: Twatanere amaguta aino, ekiagera chitaaya chiaito chiarimire.

English: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
Kiswahili: “Lakini wale wenye busara wakawajibu, ‘Sivyo, hayatutoshi sisi na ninyi pia. Afadhali mwende kwa wauzao mkajinunulie mafuta yenu.’
Ekegusii: Korende baria abang’aini bakabairaneria: Taibo. Takonyara gotoisana intwe amo nainwe, mbuya mogende mwegorere ase abaonia.

English: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
Kiswahili: “Nao walipokuwa wakienda kununua mafuta, bwana arusi akafika. Wale wanawali waliokuwa tayari wakaingia ndani pamoja naye kwenye karamu ya arusi na mlango ukafungwa.
Ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda kogora, omonywomi agacha, na baria bebegete ang’e bagasoa amo nere ase omoyega bw’enyangi; na egesieri kegasiekwa.

English: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
Kiswahili: “Baadaye wale wanawali wengine nao wakaja, wakaita, ‘Bwana! Bwana! Tufungulie mlango!’
Ekegusii: Naende magega yaye abaiseke baria bande bagaacha, bakaboora: Omonene, toigorere!

English: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
Kiswahili: “Lakini yeye bwana arusi akawajibu, ‘Amin, amin nawaambia, siwajui ninyi!’
Ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria: Nekeene nabateebirie: Timbamanyeti inwe.

English: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo kesheni, kwa sababu hamjui siku wala saa.
Ekegusii: Yeso agakoora ogoteeba “Ase igo renda, ekiagera timomanyeti rituko, nonya nensa.

English: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.
Kiswahili: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama mtu aliyetaka kusafiri, naye akawaita watumishi wake na kuweka mali yake kwenye uangalizi wao.
Ekegusii: “Ase chingaki echio nigo erache koba buna omonto ore kogenda orogendo, akarangeria abasomba baye, akabeeka enibo yaye ase bare.

English: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
Kiswahili: Mmoja akampa talantatano, mwingine talanta mbili, na mwingine talanta moja. Kila mmoja alipewa kwa kadiri ya uwezo wake. Kisha yeye akasafiri.
Ekegusii: Akaa oyomo chitalanta isano, na oyonde ibere, na oyonde eyemo, kera omonto koreng’ana nokonyara kwaye. Erio akagenda.

English: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
Kiswahili: Yule aliyepewa talanta tano akaenda mara moja akafanya nazo biashara akapata talanta nyingine tano zaidi.
Ekegusii: Oria oetwe chitalanta isano akagenda erio kegima, agachionchoreria, akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde isano.

English: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
Kiswahili: Yule aliyepewa talanta mbili akafanya vivyo hivyo, akapata nyingine mbili zaidi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo noria oetwe chitalanta ibere akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.

English: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mtumishi aliyekuwa amepokea talanta moja, alikwenda akachimba shimo ardhini na kuificha ile fedha ya bwana wake.
Ekegusii: Korende oria oetwe etalanta eyeemo akagenda, agakuunya inse, akabisa ebesa y’omonene oye.

English: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.
Kiswahili: “Baada ya muda mrefu, yule bwana wa wale watumishi akarudi na kufanya hesabu nao.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amange omonene bw’abasomba baria agacha, akarigia gokora omobaro nabarabwo.

English: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’
Kiswahili: Yule mtumishi aliyepokea talanta tano akaja, akaleta nyingine tano zaidi. Akasema, ‘Bwana uliweka kwenye uangalizi wangu talanta tano. Tazama, nimepata faida ya talanta tano zaidi.’
Ekegusii: Oria oetwe chitalanta isano agacha ne chitalanta chinde isano, akabora: Omonene, nkwang’ete chitalanta isano, rora nanyorire ebitoki, chitalanta chinde isano.

English: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
Kiswahili: “Bwana wake akamwambia, ‘Umefanya vizuri sana, mtumishi mwema na mwaminifu! Umekuwa mwaminifu kwa vitu vichache; nami nitakuweka kuwa msimamizi wa vitu vingi. Njoo ushiriki katika furaha ya bwana wako!’
