Ekegusii: Omonene oye akamoteebia: Gwakorire buya aye, omosomba omuya naende omwegenwa; kwabeire omwegenwa ase ebire ebike, ninkobeke igoro ase ebire ebinge. Soa ase omogooko bw’omonene oo.

English: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’
Kiswahili: “Yule mwenye talanta mbili naye akaja. Akasema, ‘Bwana, uliweka kwenye uangalizi wangu talanta mbili. Tazama nimepata hapa talanta mbili zaidi.’
Ekegusii: Naende oria oetwe chitalanta ibere agacha, akabora: Omonene, nkwang’ete chitalanta ibere, rora, nanyorire ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.

English: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
Kiswahili: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Umefanya vizuri sana, mtumishi mwema na mwaminifu. Umekuwa mwaminifu kwa vitu vichache; nami nitakuweka kuwa msimamizi wa vitu vingi. Njoo ushiriki katika furaha ya bwana wako!’
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: Gwakorire buya aye, omosomba omuya naende omwegenwa; kwabeire omwegenwa ase ebire ebike, ninkobeke igoro ase ebire ebinge. Soa ase omogooko bw’omonene oo.

English: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.
Kiswahili: “Kisha yule mtumishi aliyepokea talanta moja akaja, akasema, ‘Bwana, nilijua kwamba wewe ni mtu mgumu, unayevuna mahali usipopanda na kukusanya mahali usipotawanya mbegu.
Ekegusii: Na oria oetwe etalanta eyemo agacha, akabora: Omonene, nakomanyete ng’a nigo ore omonto omokong’u, okogesa aase otasimegete, na gosangereria aase otabusurete;

English: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo niliogopa, nikaenda, nikaificha talanta yako ardhini. Tazama, hii hapa ile iliyo mali yako.’
Ekegusii: erio nkoboa, nkagenda nkabisa etalanta yao inse. Nero eye.

English: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
Kiswahili: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Wewe mtumishi mwovu na mvivu! Ulijua kwamba ninavuna mahali nisipopanda na kukusanya mahali nisipotawanya mbegu.
Ekegusii: Korende omonene oye akamoiraneria: Aye omosomba omobe naende omworo! Nkwamanyete ng’a nigo nkogesa aase ntasimegete, naende nigo ngosangereria aase ntabusureti?

English: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
Kiswahili: Vyema basi, ingekupasa kuweka fedha yangu kwa watoa riba, ili nirudipo, nichukue ile iliyo yangu na faida yake.
Ekegusii: Gaki nkwagwenerete kobeeka chitaabu chiane ase abakorua efaida, na inche ngocha, anga nanyora echiane amo nefaida y’ane.

English: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Basi mnyangʼanyeni hiyo talanta, mkampe yule mwenye talanta kumi.
Ekegusii: Bono moure etalanta yaye, moe oria obwate chitalanta ikomi.

English: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila mtu aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi, naye atakuwa navyo tele. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.
Ekegusii: Inaki kera oyore negento naegwe, naende amenteranigwe; korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.

English: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
Kiswahili: Nanyi mtupeni huyo mtumishi asiyefaa nje, kwenye giza, mahali ambako kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.’
Ekegusii: Na omosomba oria otagwenereti, motugute isiko ase omosunte, aroro narere na koriania amaino.

English: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
Kiswahili: “Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuja katika utukufu wake na malaika wote watakatifu pamoja naye, ndipo atakapoketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: “Ekero Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto agochi‐goocha ase obonene bwaye, na abamalaika bonsi amo nere, erio naikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.

English: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
Kiswahili: Mataifa yote watakusanyika mbele zake, naye atawatenga kama mchungaji anavyotenga kondoo na mbuzi.
Ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nabisangererie ase obosio bwaye; ere naatanane abanto buna omorisia agwatanana ching’ondi ne chimbori.

English: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
Kiswahili: Atawaweka kondoo upande wake wa kuume, na mbuzi upande wake wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Ching’ondi nachibeeke ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, korende chimbori ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.

English: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
Kiswahili: “Ndipo Mfalme atawaambia wale walioko upande wake wa kuume, ‘Njooni, ninyi mliobarikiwa na Baba yangu; urithini Ufalme ulioandaliwa kwa ajili yenu tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti nateebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio: Inchuo inwe abamwasesenetigwe na Tata one, soa ase omwando bw’oborwoti mwaroiseretigwe korwa ogotongwa gw’ense,

English: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nilikuwa na njaa mkanipa chakula, nilikuwa na kiu mkaninywesha, nilikuwa mgeni mkanikaribisha,
Ekegusii: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, mokang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, mokang’a nkanywa; inarenge omogeni, mokandoisia;

English: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’
Kiswahili: nilikuwa uchi mkanivika, nilikuwa mgonjwa mkanitunza, nami nilikuwa kifungoni mkaja kunitembelea.’
Ekegusii: inarenge getirianda, mokamboyia; inarwarete, mogaacha kondora; inasibetwe echela, moganchichera.

English: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?
Kiswahili: “Ndipo wale wenye haki watakapomjibu, ‘Bwana, ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa tukakulisha, au ukiwa na kiu tukakunywesha?
Ekegusii: Erio abanyene oboronge nabamoiranerie: A! Omonene, indi twakorooche kore nenchara, togakorageria? Gose indi twakorooche kore nerang’o, togakoa okanywa?

English: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?
Kiswahili: Lini tulikuona ukiwa mgeni tukakukaribisha, au ukiwa uchi tukakuvika?
Ekegusii: Indi twakorooche kore omogeni, togakoroisia, gose getirianda, togakoboyia?

English: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’
Kiswahili: Tena ni lini tulikuona ukiwa mgonjwa tukakutunza, au ukiwa kifungoni tukakutembelea?’
Ekegusii: Naende indi twakorooche kore omorwaire, gose gosibire echela, togaacha gokorora?

English: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
Kiswahili: “Naye Mfalme atawajibu, ‘Amin nawaambia, kwa jinsi mlivyomtendea mmojawapo wa hawa ndugu zangu walio wadogo, mlinitendea mimi.’
Ekegusii: Na Omorwoti nabairanerie: Nekeene nabateebirie: Koreng’ana buna mware gokorera oyomo bw’aba abaminto abare abake, ninche mwakorerete.

English: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;
Kiswahili: “Kisha atawaambia wale walio upande wake wa kushoto, ‘Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi mliolaaniwa, nendeni kwenye moto wa milele ulioandaliwa kwa ajili ya ibilisi na malaika zake.
Ekegusii: Erio nateebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee: Karue ase ’nde inwe abamwaragereretigwe, mogende ase omorero o kare na kare, oyoroiseretigwe Saitani na abamalaika baye,

English: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nilikuwa na njaa hamkunipa chakula, nilikuwa na kiu hamkuninywesha,
Ekegusii: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, timwang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, timwang’a inywe.

English: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’
Kiswahili: nilikuwa mgeni nanyi hamkunikaribisha, nilikuwa uchi hamkunivika, nilikuwa mgonjwa hamkunitunza, na nilikuwa gerezani nanyi hamkuja kunitembelea.’
Ekegusii: Inarenge omogeni, timwandoisia; inarenge getirianda, timwamboyia; inarwarete, naende inarenge echela ime, timwacha kondora.

English: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’
Kiswahili: “Ndipo wao pia watajibu, ‘Bwana ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa au kiu, au ukiwa mgeni au uchi, au ukiwa mgonjwa na kifungoni na hatukukuhudumia?’
Ekegusii: Erio barabwo nabamoiranerie: Omonene, indi twakorooche aye kore nenchara, gose kore nerang’o, gose kore omogeni, gose kore getirianda, gose kore omorwaire, gose kore echela ime, na titwagokorera?

English: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’
Kiswahili: “Naye atawajibu, ‘Amin nawaambia, kwa jinsi ambavyo hamkumtendea mmojawapo wa hawa ndugu zangu walio wadogo, hamkunitendea mimi.’
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti nabairanerie: Nekeene nabateebirie: Koreng’ana buna motare gokorera oyomo bw’aba abare abake, timwankorerete inche.

English: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
Kiswahili: “Ndipo hawa watakapoingia kwenye adhabu ya milele, lakini wale wenye haki wataingia katika uzima wa milele.”
Ekegusii: Na abanto aba nabagende ase egesusuro gia kare na kare, korende abanyene oboronge inabagende ase obogima bwa kare na kare.”

English: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomaliza kusema hayo yote, akawaambia wanafunzi wake,
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya onsi, agateebia aborokigwa baye,

English: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”
Kiswahili: “Kama mnavyojua, baada ya siku mbili itakuwa Pasaka, naye Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa ili asulubiwe.”
Ekegusii: “Mwamanyire ng’a magega y’amatuko abere n’ebe Epasaka, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto naruegwe kobambwa.”

English: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.
Kiswahili: Basi viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu wakakusanyika katika jumba la utawala la kuhani mkuu, jina lake Kayafa.
Ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene n’etureti y’ abanto bagasangererekana ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene oyore korokwa Kayafa;

English: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.
Kiswahili: Wakafanya shauri ili kumkamata Yesu kwa siri na kumuua.
Ekegusii: erio bakaigwana bagakora omoroberio banyare komobwata Yeso bobisi, na komoita.

English: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wakasema, “Isiwe wakati wa Sikukuu, kusitokee ghasia miongoni mwa watu.”
Ekegusii: Korende bakaboora, “Taba ase rituko rinene, tiribaisa goocha koba rirorooche ase abanto.”

English: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
Kiswahili: Yesu alikuwa Bethania nyumbani mwa Simoni aliyekuwa na ukoma,
Ekegusii: Na Yeso, ekero arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simioni, oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma,

English: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.
Kiswahili: naye mwanamke mmoja akamjia akiwa na chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato ya thamani kubwa; akayamimina kichwani mwa Yesu alipokuwa ameketi mezani kula chakula.
Ekegusii: agaacherwa n’omokuungu orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta ye rigori rinene ne rimisu rigiya; gaikaransete ase endagera, akamonyororokeria ase omotwe oye.

English: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?
Kiswahili: Lakini wanafunzi wake walipoona hayo wakakasirika, wakasema, “Upotevu huu wote ni wa nini?
Ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa baye bachia korora aya, bakagechigwa, bakaboora, “Nobwa ki obosiru obo:

English: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”
Kiswahili: Manukato haya yangeuzwa kwa bei kubwa, na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini.”
Ekegusii: Inaki amaguta aya anga taonigwa ase chisiringi chinyinge na chiegwe abataka?”

English: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.
Kiswahili: Yesu, akijua jambo hili, akawaambia, “Mbona mnamsumbua huyu mwanamke? Yeye amenitendea jambo zuri sana.
Ekegusii: Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabateebia, “Nase ki mokorosia omokungu oyo? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya,

English: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.
Kiswahili: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote, lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.
Ekegusii: ekiagera amatuko onsi nigo more nabataka amo nainwe, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.

English: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
Kiswahili: Alipomiminia haya manukato kwenye mwili wangu, amefanya hivyo ili kuniandaa kwa ajili ya maziko yangu.
Ekegusii: Buna anyororokeria amaguta aya ase omobere one, onkoreire aya ase okombeeka ang’e ase ogotindekwa kwane.

English: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, mahali popote ulimwenguni ambapo hii Injili itahubiriwa, jambo hili alilolitenda huyu mwanamke litatajwa pia kwa ukumbusho wake.”
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Kera aase enchiri eye erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.”

English: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
Kiswahili: Kisha mmojawapo wa wale kumi na wawili, aitwaye Yuda Iskariote, alikwenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani
Ekegusii: Na ekero ekio oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, nere, oyokorokwa Yudasi Iskariota, agachiera abakuani abanene,

English: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.
Kiswahili: na kuuliza, “Mtanipa nini nikimtia Yesu mikononi mwenu?” Wakamlipa vipande thelathini vya fedha.
Ekegusii: akababoria, “Inki morang’e onye nkorua Yeso ase more?” Bakamoa chitaabu chi’echifeta emerongo etato.

English: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati huo Yuda akawa anatafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti Yesu.
Ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio akaba nkorigia are ribaga ri’okomorua.

English: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, wanafunzi walimjia Yesu wakamuuliza, “Unataka twende wapi ili tukuandalie mahali pa kula Pasaka?”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso, bakamobooria, “Ng’ai origetie tokoroisie oriere Epasaka?”

English: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Nendeni kwa mtu fulani huko mjini, mkamwambie, ‘Mwalimu asema hivi: Saa yangu imekaribia. Nitaiadhimisha Pasaka pamoja na wanafunzi wangu katika nyumba yako.’ ”
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Genda ase omochie ase omonto gete, momoteebie: Omworokia oteebire: Engaki y’ane yaikire ang’e; nyomba mwao nao ndariere Epasaka amo naborokigwa bane.”

English: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wanafunzi wakafanya kama vile Yesu alivyokuwa amewaelekeza, nao wakaandaa Pasaka.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa bagakora buna bachiigetwe na Yeso, bakaarigania Epasaka.

English: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.
Kiswahili: Ilipofika jioni, Yesu alikuwa ameketi mezani pamoja na wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili.
Ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, agaikaransa ase endagera, amo naborokigwa baria ikomi na babere.

English: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
Kiswahili: Nao walipokuwa wakila, Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti.”
Ekegusii: Kobaikaransire koragera, akabora, “Nekeene nabateebirie: oyomo oino nandue.”

English: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”
Kiswahili: Wakahuzunika sana, wakaanza kumuuliza mmoja baada ya mwingine, “Je, ni mimi Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Bagaichana mono, bagachaaka kera oyomo komoboria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche?”

English: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Yule aliyechovya mkono wake katika bakuli pamoja nami ndiye atakayenisaliti.
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Oyo ogotobeka okoboko kwaye amo nainche ase esani, oyio nere orandue.

English: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama vile alivyoandikiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu yule amsalitiye Mwana wa Adamu. Ingekuwa heri kwake mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa!”
Ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna amariiko agoteeba, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto arurwe nere! Nigo ere buya kobua asare omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.”

English: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yuda, yule mwenye kumsaliti, akasema, “Je, ni mimi Rabi?” Yesu akajibu, “Naam, wewe mwenyewe umesema.”
Ekegusii: Yudasi, nere oyokomorua, akamobooria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche? Akamoiraneria: Naboigo. Aye gwateebire.”

English: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanakula, Yesu akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega, na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, akisema, “Twaeni, mle; huu ndio mwili wangu.”
Ekegusii: Kobakoragera, Yeso akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, akabora, “Bogoria, morie; oyo noro omobere one.”

English: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,
Kiswahili: Kisha akakitwaa kikombe, akashukuru, akawapa, akisema, “Nyweni nyote katika kikombe hiki.
Ekegusii: Akabogoria na egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa, akabora, “Kanywe aya inwe mwensi,

English: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo damu yangu ya Agano, imwagikayo kwa ajili ya wengi kwa ondoleo la dhambi.
Ekegusii: naki aya naro amanyinga aane y’okobwatana okoyia, aitekire ase engencho y’abange ase okwaberwa kw’ebibe.

English: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ninawaambia, tangu sasa sitakunywa tena katika uzao huu wa mzabibu, hadi siku ile nitakapounywa mpya pamoja nanyi katika Ufalme wa Baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Nabateebirie, tinkonywa naende okwama oko kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa oboyia amo nainwe ase oborwoti bwa Tata.”

English: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuimba wimbo, wakatoka wakaenda Mlima wa Mizeituni.
Ekegusii: Kobakoorire goteera Ogoteera, bagasoka kogenda egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.

English: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Usiku huu, ninyi nyote mtaniacha, kwa maana imeandikwa: “ ‘Nitampiga mchungaji, nao kondoo wa hilo kundi watatawanyika.’
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ase obotuko bwa reero inwe mwensi inamogochwe ase engencho y’ane na gontiga; naki nariikire: Ning’ake omorisia, ne ching’ondi chie riicho inachiserebekane.

English: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya kufufuka kwangu, nitawatangulia kwenda Galilaya.”
Ekegusii: Korende magega y’okobooka kwane nimbatang’anere kogenda Galili.”

English: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
Kiswahili: Petro akajibu, “Hata kama wote watakuacha, kamwe mimi sitakuacha.”
Ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Neba inabagochwe bonsi ase engencho yao na bagotige, inche tinkogochwa na kogotiga nonya ng’ake.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, nakuambia, usiku huu, kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagoteebirie: Ase obotuko obo, ekero etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.”

English: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akasisitiza, “Hata kama itabidi kufa pamoja nawe, sitakukana kamwe.” Nao wanafunzi wale wengine wote wakasema vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na aborokigwa bonsi bagateeba boigo.

English: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akaenda pamoja na wanafunzi wake mpaka kwenye bustani iitwayo Gethsemane, akawaambia, “Kaeni hapa, nami niende kule nikaombe.”
Ekegusii: Naende Yeso akagenda nabarabwo goika aase akorokwa Gethisemane, agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa ekero nkogenda aria gosaba.”

English: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
Kiswahili: Akamchukua Petro pamoja na wale wana wawili wa Zebedayo, akaanza kuhuzunika na kufadhaika.
Ekegusii: Akaira Petero na abana baria ba Zebedi babere, agachaaka goichana na gwechanda mono.

English: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Moyo wangu umejawa na huzuni kiasi cha kufa. Kaeni hapa na mkeshe pamoja nami.”
Ekegusii: Erio akabateebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, nonya ngoika ogokwa; ikaransa aa, morende amo nainche.”

English: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
Kiswahili: Akaenda mbele kidogo, akaanguka kifudifudi, akaomba akisema, “Baba yangu, kama inawezekana, kikombe hiki na kiniondokee. Lakini si kama nipendavyo mimi, bali kama upendavyo wewe.”
Ekegusii: Akagenderera ake, akagwa maumama, agasaba, “Tata one, onye ekonyarekana, tiga egekombe eke kerusigwe ase ’nde; korende taba buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.”

English: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
Kiswahili: Kisha akarudi kwa wanafunzi wake, akawakuta wamelala. Akamuuliza Petro, “Je, ninyi hamkuweza kukesha pamoja nami hata kwa saa moja?
Ekegusii: Agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabanyora bararire, agateebia Petero, “Inee! Iga timokonyara korenda amo nainche nonya nensa eyemo?

English: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
Kiswahili: Kesheni na mwombe, msije mkaingia majaribuni. Roho iko radhi, lakini mwili ni mdhaifu.”
Ekegusii: Renda, mosabe, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika oro nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”

English: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”
Kiswahili: Akaenda tena mara ya pili na kuomba, “Baba yangu, kama haiwezekani kikombe hiki kiniepuke nisikinywe, basi mapenzi yako yafanyike.”
Ekegusii: Naende akagenda eria kabere, agasaba, “Tata one, onye tekonyarekana egekombe eke keng’etere ntakenywereti, abe buna bwanchete aye.”

English: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
Kiswahili: Aliporudi, akawakuta tena wamelala kwa sababu macho yao yalikuwa mazito.
Ekegusii: Agacha naende, akabanyora bararire; ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito.

English: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akawaacha akaenda zake tena mara ya tatu na kuomba akisema maneno yale yale.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabatiga naende, akagenda, agasaba eria gatato agakwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.

English: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
Kiswahili: Kisha akarudi kwa wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Bado mmelala na kupumzika? Tazameni, saa imefika ambapo Mwana wa Adamu anasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa wenye dhambi.
Ekegusii: Erio agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabateebia, “Nonya mbono nigo moraire na gotimoka? Rora ensa yaikire, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto obekirwe ase amaboko y’abanyene ebibe.

English: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
Kiswahili: Inukeni, twende zetu! Tazameni, msaliti wangu yuaja!”
Ekegusii: Imoka, togende, rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.”

English: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa bado anazungumza, Yuda, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili, akafika. Alikuwa amefuatana na umati mkubwa wa watu wenye panga na marungu, waliokuwa wametumwa na viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agacha, na omoganda omonene amo nere bare nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene n’etureti y’ abanto.

English: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
Kiswahili: Basi msaliti alikuwa amewapa hao watu ishara, kwamba: “Yule nitakayembusu ndiye. Mkamateni.”
Ekegusii: Ere oyokomorua, konya obaeire ekemanyererio, agateeba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate.”

English: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
Kiswahili: Mara Yuda akamjia Yesu na kumsalimu, “Salamu, Rabi!” Akambusu.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima agachiera Yeso, agateeba, “omorembe obe naye, Omonene!” Akamonyunyunta.

English: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Rafiki, fanya kile ulichokuja kufanya hapa.” Kisha wale watu wakasogea mbele, wakamkamata Yesu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Mosani, kora bwango eki giakoreta aa?” Erio bagaacha, bakamobwata Yeso, bakamoira.

English: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
Kiswahili: Ghafula mmoja wa wale waliokuwa na Yesu alipoona hivyo, akaushika upanga wake, akauchomoa na kumpiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio.
Ekegusii: Na rora, oyomo obo bw’abarenge amo na Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.

English: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Rudisha upanga wako mahali pake, kwa maana wote watumiao upanga watakufa kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoteebia, “Irania omoyio oo o birende aase aye, ekiagera bonsi abakoimokia omoyio o birende inabasire ase omoyio o birende.

English: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
Kiswahili: Je, unadhani siwezi kumwomba Baba yangu naye mara moja akaniletea zaidi ya majeshi kumi na mawili ya malaika?
Ekegusii: Gose tomanyeti ng’a ninyare gosaba Tata, na ere nantomere abamalaika kobua emeganda ikomi na ebere?

English: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”
Kiswahili: Lakini je, yale Maandiko yanayotabiri kwamba ni lazima itendeke hivi yatatimiaje?”
Ekegusii: Korende naki rende nanga amariiko aikeranigwa, ng’a nabo egwenerete koba?”

English: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, Yesu akawaambia ule umati wa watu, “Je, mmekuja na panga na marungu kunikamata kana kwamba mimi ni mnyangʼanyi? Siku kwa siku niliketi Hekaluni nikifundisha, mbona hamkunikamata?
Ekegusii: Ensa eria Yeso agateebia emeganda y’ abanto, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna abamokoumokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu gocha kong’ira? Kera rituko naikaransete amo nainwe ime ase Hekalu ase okworokereria, ko timwambwata.

English: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.
Kiswahili: Lakini haya yote yametukia ili maandiko ya manabii yapate kutimia.” Ndipo wanafunzi wake wote wakamwacha na kukimbia.
Ekegusii: Korende aya onsi abeire, erinde amariiko y’ababani aikeranigwe.” Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama.

English: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa wamemkamata Yesu wakampeleka kwa Kayafa, kuhani mkuu, mahali ambapo walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee walikuwa wamekusanyika.
Ekegusii: Baria babwatete Yeso bakamoira ase enyomba ya Kayafa Omokuani omonene, aase aborokia b’amariiko na abagaaka basangererekanete.

English: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akamfuata kwa mbali hadi uani kwa kuhani mkuu. Akaingia ndani, akaketi pamoja na walinzi ili aone litakalotukia.
Ekegusii: Na Petero akamotunyana korwa magega ore egeka, goika ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene, agasoa ime, agaikaransa amo nabarendi, erinde arore eki gekoba omoerio.

English: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na Baraza la Wayahudi lote wakatafuta ushahidi wa uongo dhidi ya Yesu ili wapate kumuua.
Ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na ab’ekegaambero bonsi bakarigia amang’ana y’oborimo y’ogosoera Yeso, banyare komoita;

English: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakupata jambo lolote, ingawa mashahidi wengi wa uongo walijitokeza. Hatimaye wakajitokeza mashahidi wawili wa uongo
Ekegusii: korende nonya abarori abange b’oborimo bachete, tibayanyora. Omoerio abarori babere bagaacha,

English: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”
Kiswahili: na kusema, “Huyu mtu alisema, ‘Ninaweza kulivunja Hekalu la Mungu na kulijenga tena kwa siku tatu.’ ”
Ekegusii: bakaboora, “Omonto oyo nigo ateebete: Ninyare gotagora Hekalu ya Nyasae, na koyeagaacha ase amatuko atato.”

English: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani mkuu akasimama na kumwambia Yesu, “Je, wewe hutajibu? Ni ushahidi gani hawa watu wanauleta dhidi yako?”
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene agatenena akamobooria Yeso, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”

English: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akakaa kimya. Ndipo kuhani mkuu akamwambia, “Nakuapisha mbele za Mungu aliye hai. Tuambie kama wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso agakira. Na Omokuani omonene akamoteebia, “Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ore moyo, ototeebie gose naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Wewe umenena. Lakini ninawaambia nyote: Siku za baadaye, mtamwona Mwana wa Adamu akiwa ameketi mkono wa kuume wa Mwenye Nguvu, na akija juu ya mawingu ya mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Naboigo aye gwateebire, korende nabateebirie inwe, korwa bono inamorore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto oikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore nokobua, ogocha ase amare a igoro.”

English: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
Kiswahili: Ndipo kuhani mkuu akararua mavazi yake na kusema, “Amekufuru! Tuna haja gani tena ya mashahidi zaidi? Tazama, sasa ninyi mmesikia hayo makufuru.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Oramire Nyasae; abarori naba ki tokorigia? Mwaigure emerumi yaye akorama.

English: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
Kiswahili: Uamuzi wenu ni gani?” Wakajibu, “Anastahili kufa.”
Ekegusii: Inaki morooche?” Bakairaneria, “Omonto oyo nigo agwenerete akwe.”

English: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
Kiswahili: Kisha wakamtemea mate usoni na wengine wakampiga ngumi. Wengine wakampiga makofi
Ekegusii: Erio agwo bakamotwera amate obosio, bakamoaka chinkundi; abande bakamoaka chindoe,

English: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
Kiswahili: na kusema, “Tutabirie, wewe Kristo! Ni nani aliyekupiga?”
Ekegusii: bakobora, “Kristo, tobanere! Ning’o ogoaka?”

English: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Petro alikuwa amekaa nje uani. Mtumishi mmoja wa kike akamjia na kumwambia, “Wewe pia ulikuwa pamoja na Yesu wa Galilaya.”
Ekegusii: Bono Petero nigo aikaransete egoora isiko. Omoiseke oyomo omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene akamochiera, akabora, “Aye naye kwarenge amo na Yeso Omogalili.”

English: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akakana mbele yao wote akisema, “Sijui hilo usemalo.”
Ekegusii: Korende ere agakaana ase amasio abo bonsi, akabora “Timanyeti ayio ogokwana.”

English: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
Kiswahili: Alipotoka nje kufika kwenye lango, mtumishi mwingine wa kike alimwona, akawaambia watu waliokuwepo, “Huyu mtu alikuwa pamoja na Yesu, Mnazareti.”
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoka gesieri, omoiseke onde akamorora, agateebia abarengeo, “Omonto oyo nigo arenge amo na Yeso, Omonazareti.”

English: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”
Kiswahili: Akakana tena kwa kiapo akisema, “Mimi simjui huyo!”
Ekegusii: Agakaana naende, na gotiana, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.”

English: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda mfupi, wale waliokuwa wamesimama pale wakamwendea Petro, wakamwambia, “Hakika wewe ni mmoja wao, kwa maana usemi wako ni kama wao.”
Ekegusii: Magega ase egeka egeke abateneine aroro bagaacha, bagateebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye noyomo obo ore, ekiagera ogokwana kwao gwakoorokirie.”

English: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akaanza kujilaani na kuwaapia, “Mimi simjui mtu huyo!” Papo hapo jogoo akawika.
Ekegusii: Erio agachaaka kweragereria na gotiana, okobora, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.” Agwo kegima etuoni ekabuga.

English: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akakumbuka lile neno Yesu alilokuwa amesema: “Kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.” Naye akaenda nje, akalia kwa majonzi.
Ekegusii: Erio Petero akainyora ring’ana riria Yeso ateebete, “Ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.” Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo.

English: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi na mapema, viongozi wa makuhani wote na wazee wa watu wakafanya shauri pamoja dhidi ya Yesu ili kumuua.
Ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bonsi na abatureti bagakora omoroberio bw’ogoita Yeso.

English: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
Kiswahili: Wakamfunga, wakampeleka na kumkabidhi kwa Pilato, ambaye alikuwa mtawala wa Kirumi.
Ekegusii: Bakamosiba, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato, oyorenge gabana o Rumi.

English: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
Kiswahili: Yuda, ambaye alikuwa amemsaliti Yesu, alipoona kuwa Yesu amehukumiwa, akajuta na akarudisha vile vipande thelathini vya fedha alivyopewa na viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yudasi, oria omoruete achia korora ng’a onacheirwe ekiina, ageitia, akairania chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta emerongo etato ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka,

English: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Nimetenda dhambi, kwa maana nimeisaliti damu isiyo na hatia.” Wakamjibu, “Hilo latuhusu nini sisi? Ni shauri yako.”
Ekegusii: okobora, “Namochire ase okorua omonto otari na bobe bonde aitwe.” Barabwo bakaboora, “Ninki aya are ase tore? Echio n’echigurube chiao!”

English: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.
Kiswahili: Basi Yuda akavitupa vile vipande vya fedha ndani ya Hekalu akaondoka akaenda kujinyonga.
Ekegusii: Yudasi agatuguta chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta ase Hekalu ime, akaimoka, akagenda akeng’enta.

English: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
Kiswahili: Wale viongozi wa makuhani wakazichukua zile fedha wakasema, “Si halali kuchanganya fedha hizi na sadaka kwa sababu hizi ni fedha zenye damu.”
Ekegusii: Korende abakuani abanene bakaimokia chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta bakaboora, “Tari boronge gochibeeka ase ekungo y’esadaka ya Nyasae, ekiagera chirochio nechie rigori ri’amanyinga.”

English: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo baada ya kushauriana, waliamua kuzitumia kununulia shamba la mfinyanzi, liwe mahali pa kuzikia wageni.
Ekegusii: Bakanacha ekiina giokogora omogondo bw’omokori chinyongo, obe aase bagotindeka abageni.

English: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu lile shamba likaitwa Shamba la Damu hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omogondo oyo nigo okorokwa Omogondo bw’Amanyinga goika reero.

English: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,
Kiswahili: Ndipo likatimia lile lililonenwa na nabii Yeremia, kwamba, “Walichukua vile vipande thelathini vya fedha, thamani aliyopangiwa na watu wa Israeli,
Ekegusii: Erio rigaikeranigwa eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia, ogoteeba, “Bakaimokia chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta emerongo etato, rigori riaye oria obegetwe rigori n’abanto bande b’Abaisraeli,

English: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”
Kiswahili: wakanunulia shamba la mfinyanzi, kama vile Bwana alivyoniagiza.”
Ekegusii: bagachiira ase okogora omogondo bw’omokori chinyongo, buna Omonene achigeete.”

English: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yesu akiwa amesimama mbele ya mtawala, mtawala akamuuliza, “Wewe ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi?” Yesu akasema, “Wewe wasema hivyo.”
Ekegusii: Nere Yeso agatenena ase gabana bw’Abarumi; oyio omobooretie, “Naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?” Yeso akamoteebia, “Naboigo, aye gwateebire.”

English: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
Kiswahili: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani na wazee walipomshtaki, hakujibu neno.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Abakuani abanene na abagaaka bamosoerete, tairaneria ing’ana rinde.

English: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Pilato akamuuliza, “Je, husikii ni mambo mangapi wanayokushtaki nayo?”
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamoteebia, “Toigweti amang’ana aya amange bakona‐goteeba igoro yao?”

English: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu hakumjibu hata kwa shtaka moja, kiasi kwamba mtawala alishangaa sana.
Ekegusii: Korende ere tairaneria rinde, nonya nase ring’ana erimo, na gabana agakumia mono.

English: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.
Kiswahili: Basi ilikuwa ni desturi ya mtawala kumfungua mfungwa mmoja aliyechaguliwa na umati wa watu wakati wa sikukuu.
Ekegusii: Bono ekero kie rituko rinene nigo yarenge engencho ya gabana gosiborera Abayahudi omosibwa oyomo oyo barigetie.

English: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo alikuwepo mfungwa mmoja mwenye sifa mbaya, aliyeitwa Baraba.
Ekegusii: Mbabwate omosibwa oyomo omanyekanete, okorokwa Baraba.

English: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
Kiswahili: Hivyo umati wa watu walipokusanyika, Pilato akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafungulie nani, Baraba au Yesu yeye aitwaye Kristo?”
Ekegusii: Erio kobasangererekanire, Pilato akababoria, “Norori morigetie mbasiborere ase abasibwa aba babere Baraba gose Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?”

English: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa alitambua Yesu alikuwa amekabidhiwa kwake kwa ajili ya wivu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng’a Abayahudi nigo baruete Yeso ase obogechi.

English: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”
Kiswahili: Pilato akiwa ameketi kwenye kiti cha hukumu, mkewe akampelekea ujumbe huu: “Usiwe na jambo lolote juu ya mtu huyu asiye na hatia, kwa kuwa leo nimeteseka sana katika ndoto kwa sababu yake.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Pilato aikaransire ase ekerogo gi’ekiina, akarenterwa amang’ana na mok’aye, ogoteeba, “Oyio nomonto omonyene oboronge, tobaisa kwebwatia asare, ekiagera reero inachandetwe namange ase okorota ase engencho yaye.”

English: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.
Kiswahili: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wakaushawishi ule umati wa watu kwamba waombe Baraba afunguliwe, naye Yesu auawe.
Ekegusii: Bono abakuani abanene na abagaaka bakagenka emeganda ng’a baborie baegwe Baraba, na Yeso bamoite.

English: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
Kiswahili: Mtawala akawauliza tena, “Ni yupi kati ya hawa wawili mnayetaka niwafungulie?” Wakajibu, “Baraba.”
Ekegusii: Korende Pilato akaboria omoganda oria naende, “Ase abanto aba babere, norori morigetie mbasiborere?” Bakamoteebia, “Baraba.”

English: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”
Kiswahili: Pilato akawaambia, “Basi nifanye nini na huyu Yesu aitwaye Kristo?” Wakajibu wote, “Msulubishe!”
Ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Imokore naki Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?” Bakamoteebia bonsi, “Tiga abambwe!”

English: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
Kiswahili: Pilato akauliza, “Kwa nini? Amefanya kosa gani?” Lakini wao wakazidi kupiga kelele, wakisema, “Msulubishe!”
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Barabwo bakamenta goaka egeturi, bakobora, “Tiga abambwe!”

English: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”
Kiswahili: Pilato alipoona kwamba hawezi kufanya lolote, lakini badala yake ghasia zilikuwa zinaanza, akachukua maji, akanawa mikono yake mbele ya ule umati wa watu, akasema, “Sina hatia juu ya damu ya mtu huyu, hili ni jukumu lenu!”
Ekegusii: Ekero Pilato achia korora ng’a gento tikenyarekaneti asare, ne rirorooche rioka rikona‐kobucha, akaimokia amaache, agaisaba amaboko aye ase obosio bw’omoganda, ogoteeba, “Inche tindi na komocha ase amanyinga y’omonto oyo omonyene oboronge. Niigoro yaino abanyene.”

English: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakajibu, “Damu yake na iwe juu yetu na juu ya watoto wetu!”
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakairaneria, “Amanyinga aye, tiga abe igoro ase tore, na ase abana baito!”

English: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
Kiswahili: Basi akawafungulia Baraba. Lakini baada ya kuamuru Yesu achapwe mijeledi, akamtoa ili asulubishwe.
Ekegusii: Erio akabasiborera Baraba, na magega gaakire Yeso emecharichi, akabamotigera anyare kobambwa.

English: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.
Kiswahili: Kisha askari wa mtawala wakampeleka Yesu kwenye Praitorio na wakakusanya kikosi kizima cha askari kumzunguka.
Ekegusii: Erio abarwani ba Pilato bakaira Yeso ime ase enyomba y’egabana, bakamosangererekanera omoganda omogima bw’abarwani.

English: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.
Kiswahili: Wakamvua nguo zake na kumvika vazi la rangi nyekundu, kisha
Ekegusii: Bakamorusia chianga chiaye, bakamobeekera eyanga embariri.

English: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
Kiswahili: wakasokota taji ya miiba, wakaiweka kichwani pake. Wakamwekea fimbo katika mkono wake wa kuume, na wakapiga magoti mbele zake na kumdhihaki, wakisema, “Salamu, mfalme wa Wayahudi!”
Ekegusii: Bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobeekera motwe, na egetonto bakamobekera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio; bagatung’ama asare, bakamochecheria na kobora, “Ochie kare, Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi!”

English: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
Kiswahili: Wakamtemea mate, wakachukua ile fimbo wakampiga kichwani tena na tena.
Ekegusii: Erio bakamotwera amate, bakaimokia egetonto keria, bakamoaka ase omotwe.

English: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumdhihaki, wakamvua lile joho, wakamvika tena nguo zake. Kisha wakampeleka ili wakamsulubishe.
Ekegusii: Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eyanga eria embariri, bakamobeekera chianga chiaye omonyene, bakamoira isiko abambwe.

English: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakienda, wakakutana na mtu mmoja kutoka Kirene, jina lake Simoni, nao wakamlazimisha kuubeba ule msalaba.
Ekegusii: Kobagosoka korwa ase omochie, bakarora omonto oyomo, Omokurene, okorokwa Simioni; erio abasikari bakabetereria omonto oyio abogorerie Yeso omosalaba.

English: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”
Kiswahili: Wakafika mahali palipoitwa Golgotha (maana yake ni Mahali pa Fuvu la Kichwa).
Ekegusii: Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore),

English: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.
Kiswahili: Hapo wakampa Yesu divai iliyochanganywa na nyongo ili anywe; lakini alipoionja, akakataa kuinywa.
Ekegusii: bakamoa edivai esang’anirie egento ekeroro, anywe; Agachia koyeigwa, tancha konywa.

English: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kumsulubisha wakagawana mavazi yake kwa kuyapigia kura. Hili lilifanyika ili litimie lile neno lililonenwa na nabii, “Waligawa nguo zangu miongoni mwao na vazi langu wakalipigia kura.”
Ekegusii: Kobamobambire bagakora obomera, bagaatanana chianga chiaye.

English: and they sat and watched him there.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaketi, wakamchunga.
Ekegusii: Erio bagaikaransa komorigereria aria.

English: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
Kiswahili: Juu ya kichwa chake, kwenye msalaba, wakaandika shtaka lake hivi: Huyu ni Yesu, Mfalme wa Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Igoro ase omotwe oye bakabeeka ogosoerwa kwaye, koriikire, “OYO NERE YESO, OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI”.

English: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.
Kiswahili: Wanyangʼanyi wawili walisulubiwa pamoja naye, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Erio abauri babere bakabambwa amo nere, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.

English: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads
Kiswahili: Watu waliokuwa wakipita njiani wakamtukana huku wakitikisa vichwa vyao
Ekegusii: Na barabwo abaare goeta, bakamorama, bagosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo, bakobora,

English: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
Kiswahili: na kusema, “Wewe ambaye utalivunja Hekalu na kulijenga kwa siku tatu, jiokoe mwenyewe basi! Kama wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu, shuka kutoka msalabani.”
Ekegusii: “Aye oyogotagora Hekalu na koyeagaacha ase amatuko atato, etoorie! Onye naye Omwana o Nyasae, ika korwa ase omosalaba.”

English: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee wakamdhihaki wakisema,
Ekegusii: Na baria abakuani abanene bagakora boigo, bakamokorera echeche amo naborokia b’amariiko na abagaaka, bakobora,

English: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
Kiswahili: “Aliwaokoa wengine, lakini hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe! Yeye ni Mfalme wa Israeli! Ashuke sasa kutoka msalabani, nasi tutamwamini.
Ekegusii: “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria. Ere n’Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, tiga aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, na intwe rirorio ntomwegene.

English: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
Kiswahili: Anamwamini Mungu, basi Mungu na amwokoe sasa kama anamtaka, kwa maana alisema, ‘Mimi ni Mwana wa Mungu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nigo asemeretie Nyasae, tiga Nyasae amotoorie bono, onye omoganetie, ekiagera nateebete: Inche n’Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.
Kiswahili: Hata wale wanyangʼanyi waliosulubiwa pamoja naye wakamtukana vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Na baria abauri, abaabambetwe amo nere, bakamorama boigo.

English: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
Kiswahili: Tangu saa sita hadi saa tisa giza liliifunika nchi yote.
Ekegusii: Bono korwa chinsa isano nemo omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.

English: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
Kiswahili: Ilipofika saa tisa, Yesu akapaza sauti akalia, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?” (maana yake, “Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha?”)
Ekegusii: Chiachia koba ang’e chinsa kianda, Yeso, akarera neriogi rinene, akabora, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani?” Okoonchorwa kwaye, “Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire?”

English: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwa wamesimama pale waliposikia hayo, wakasema, “Anamwita Eliya.”
Ekegusii: Na abande b’abwo bateneine aroro, bakayaigwa, bakaboora, “Omonto oyo n’Elija akorangeria.”

English: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.
Kiswahili: Ghafula mmoja wao akaenda mbio na kuleta sifongo, akaichovya kwenye siki, akaiweka kwenye mwanzi na akampa Yesu ili anywe.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima oyomo obo akaimokia esifunchi, akayeichoria chinkama, akayebeeka ase egetonto, akamoa anywe.

English: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”
Kiswahili: Wengine wakasema, “Basi mwacheni. Hebu tuone kama Eliya atakuja kumwokoa.”
Ekegusii: Korende baria abande bakaboora, “Tiga torore gose Elija ngocha are komotooria.”

English: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipolia tena kwa sauti kuu, akaitoa roho yake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarera naende neriogi rinene, erio agatweka mo.

English: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili, kuanzia juu hadi chini. Dunia ikatetemeka na miamba ikapasuka.
Ekegusii: Na rora, egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere, ense egatengecha, ebitare bigatandoka.

English: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
Kiswahili: Makaburi yakafunguka na miili ya watakatifu waliokuwa wamekufa ikafufuliwa.
Ekegusii: Chimbeera chikamaanoka chigaasama, na abanto abange abachenu konya bakuure bakabokigwa.

English: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.
Kiswahili: Wakatoka makaburini, na baada ya Yesu kufufuka, waliingia kwenye Mji Mtakatifu na kuwatokea watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Kabaruure ase chimbeera, magega y’okoboka kwa Yeso bagasoa ase omochie omochenu agwo ase abanto abange babaroche.

English: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”
Kiswahili: Basi yule jemadari na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye wakimlinda Yesu walipoona lile tetemeko na yale yote yaliyokuwa yametukia, waliogopa, wakasema, “Hakika huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!”
Ekegusii: Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, na abwo barenge amo nere korenda Yeso, bachia korora omotengecho bw’ense na ebiakorekire, bakairoka mono, bakaboora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae!”

English: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
Kiswahili: Walikuwako wanawake huko wakiangalia kwa mbali. Hawa walikuwa wamemfuata Yesu tangu Galilaya ili kushughulikia mahitaji yake.
Ekegusii: Mbarengeo boigo abakungu abange, barigereretie korwa are, abatunyanete Yeso korwa Galili, bakomokorera.

English: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwao walikuwepo Maria Magdalene, na Maria mama yao Yakobo na Yosefu, na mama yao wana wa Zebedayo.
Ekegusii: Ase abwo nigo barenge Mariamu Magadalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na Yusufu, na ng’ina ’abana ba Zebedi.

English: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.
Kiswahili: Ilipofika jioni, alifika mtu mmoja tajiri kutoka Arimathaya aitwaye Yosefu, ambaye pia alikuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, omonto omonda bw’Arimathaya, okorokwa Yusufu, agacha; ere nomworokigwa o Yeso orenge.

English: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
Kiswahili: Akamwendea Pilato ili kumwomba mwili wa Yesu. Pilato akaamuru apewe.
Ekegusii: Oyio akagenda ase Pilato, akarigia omobere o Yeso. Erio Pilato agachiika ayoegwe.

English: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
Kiswahili: Yosefu akauchukua mwili wa Yesu, akaufunga katika kitambaa cha kitani safi,
Ekegusii: Yusufu akaimokia omobere, akayoboyia egetambaa ekiya ki’egatani,

English: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.
Kiswahili: na kuuweka katika kaburi lake mwenyewe jipya, alilokuwa amelichonga kwenye mwamba. Kisha akavingirisha jiwe kubwa katika ingilio la kaburi, akaenda zake.
Ekegusii: akayobeka ase oboina bwaye oboyia, obwabachete ase egetare; naende agaturunkania rigena rinene gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina, akagenda.

English: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
Kiswahili: Maria Magdalene na yule Maria mwingine walikuwepo mahali pale, wakiwa wameketi mkabala na kaburi.
Ekegusii: Mbarengeo Mariamu Magadalena na Mariamu onde, baikaransete bosio bw’oboina.

English: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,
Kiswahili: Kesho yake, yaani siku iliyofuata ile ya Maandalizi ya Sabato, viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo wakamwendea Pilato
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, erio riare rituko ri’Esabato, abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase Pilato,

English: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
Kiswahili: na kusema, “Bwana, tumekumbuka kwamba yule mdanganyifu wakati alikuwa bado hai alisema, ‘Baada ya siku tatu nitafufuka.’
Ekegusii: bakaboora, “Omonene, twainyoire ng’a omong’ainereria oria nateebete ekero arenge moyo: Magega ase amatuko atato nimboke.

English: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo uamuru kaburi lilindwe kwa uthabiti mpaka baada ya siku tatu. La sivyo, wanafunzi wake wanaweza kuja kuuiba mwili wake na kuwaambia watu kwamba amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu. Udanganyifu huu wa mwisho utakuwa mbaya kuliko ule wa kwanza.”
Ekegusii: Gaki, chiika oboina borendwe buya goika rituko ria gatato, aborokigwa baye tibaabaisa gocha komoiba, bateebie abanto ng’a obokire korwa ase abakuure; oborimo bw’omoerio inabobue boria bw’eritang’ani.”

English: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”
Kiswahili: Pilato akawaambia, “Ninyi mnao askari walinzi. Nendeni, liwekeeni ulinzi kadri mwezavyo.”
Ekegusii: Pilato akabateebia, “More nabarendi; genda morende mono oboina buna moranyaare.”

English: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakaenda na walinzi ili kulilinda kaburi kwa uthabiti, wakatia muhuri kwenye lile jiwe na kuweka ulinzi.
Ekegusii: Ase igo bakagenda bakarenda oboina mono ase okobeeka rigena riria ekemanyererio, naende bakabeeka abarendi.

English: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Sabato, alfajiri mapema siku ya kwanza ya juma, Maria Magdalene na yule Maria mwingine walikwenda kulitazama kaburi.
Ekegusii: Esabato egachia koera, kobogokiamoka rituko ria Jumapili, Mariamu Magadalena na oria Mariamu onde bakagenda korora oboina.

English: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.
Kiswahili: Ghafula, pakawa na tetemeko kubwa la ardhi, kwa sababu malaika wa Bwana alishuka kutoka mbinguni, akaenda penye kaburi, akalivingirisha lile jiwe na kulikalia.
Ekegusii: Na rora, norengeo omotengecho omonene, ekiagera omomalaika bw’Omonene aigete korwa igoro, agachia agatigeria rigena riria, akariikaransera.

English: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
Kiswahili: Sura ya huyo malaika ilikuwa kama umeme, na mavazi yake yalikuwa meupe kama theluji.
Ekegusii: Ekieni kiaye nigo kiarenge buna okomesa kw’embura, na eyanga yaye nendabu buna amagena y’embura.

English: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.
Kiswahili: Wale walinzi wa kaburi walimwogopa sana, wakatetemeka hata wakawa kama wafu.
Ekegusii: Ase okomoiroka ere abarendi bakaiguswa, bakaba buna abanto bakuure.

English: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.
Kiswahili: Yule malaika akawaambia wale wanawake, “Msiogope, kwa maana ninajua kuwa mnamtafuta Yesu aliyesulubiwa.
Ekegusii: Korende omomalaika agateebia abakungu baria, “Timoiroka inwe, ekiagera namanyire ng’a Yeso mokorigia, oria obambetwe.

English: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
Kiswahili: Hayupo hapa, kwa kuwa amefufuka, kama vile alivyosema. Njooni mpatazame mahali alipokuwa amelazwa.
Ekegusii: Tari aiga, ekiagera obokire, buna ateebete. Inchuo, morigererie aase Omonene araire.

English: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”
Kiswahili: Kisha nendeni upesi mkawaambie wanafunzi wake kwamba, ‘Amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu, naye awatangulia kwenda Galilaya. Huko ndiko mtamwona. Sasa nimekwisha kuwaambia.’ ”
Ekegusii: Na genda bwango, moteebie aborokigwa baye ng’a obokire korwa ase abakuure; na rora, obatang’aneire kogenda Galili; agwo nao moramorore. Rora, inche nabatebirie ayio.”

English: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wale wanawake wakaondoka pale kaburini wakiwa wamejawa na hofu, bali wakiwa na furaha nyingi. Wakaenda mbio kuwaeleza wanafunzi wake habari hizo.
Ekegusii: Bakaimoka korwa ase oboina bwango, bare nokoiroka na omogooko omonene, bakaminyoka, bakairera aborokigwa baye amang’ana.

English: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
Kiswahili: Ghafula, Yesu akakutana nao, akasema, “Salamu!” Wale wanawake wakamkaribia, wakaishika miguu yake, wakamwabudu.
Ekegusii: Na rora, Yeso akaumerana na barabwo, akabakwania, “Omorembe obe nainwe!” Na barabwo bagaacha, bakamobwata amagoro, bakamosasiima.

English: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Msiogope. Nendeni mkawaambie ndugu zangu waende Galilaya, ndiko watakakoniona.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Timoiroka! Genda moteebie abaminto bagende Galili, nao barandore.”

English: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.
Kiswahili: Wakati wale wanawake walikuwa njiani wakienda, baadhi ya wale askari waliokuwa wakilinda kaburi walienda mjini na kuwaeleza viongozi wa makuhani kila kitu kilichokuwa kimetukia.
Ekegusii: Ekero abakungu baria bachire, rora abande b’abarendi baria boboina bagasoa ase omochie, bagateebia abakuani abanene amang’ana onsi ayakoregete.

English: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
Kiswahili: Baada ya viongozi wa makuhani kukutana na wazee na kutunga hila, waliwapa wale askari kiasi kikubwa cha fedha
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakaumerana amo n’abagaaka, bakaroisia omoroberio erio bakaa abarendi baria chitaabu chinyinge,

English: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.
Kiswahili: wakiwaambia, “Inawapasa mseme, ‘Wanafunzi wake walikuja wakati wa usiku na kumwiba sisi tulipokuwa tumelala.’
Ekegusii: bakaboora, “Moteebie abanto: Aborokigwa baye mbachete botuko, bakamoiba ekero twararire.

English: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”
Kiswahili: Kama habari hizi zikimfikia mtawala, sisi tutamwondolea mashaka nanyi hamtapata tatizo lolote.”
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri koriraigweke ase gabana, intwe natoche tokwane nere, tomoebererie, na kobarusia inwe ase emechando.”

English: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wale askari wakazipokea hizo fedha nao wakafanya kama walivyoelekezwa. Habari hii imeenea miongoni mwa Wayahudi mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Bakabogoria chitaabu chiria, bagakora buna bateebetigwe, na omogano oyo okumire ase Abayahudi goika reero iga.

English: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.
Kiswahili: Basi wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja wakaenda hadi Galilaya kwenye ule mlima ambao Yesu alikuwa amewaagiza.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baria ikomi nomo bakagenda Galili, bagaika egetunwa keria Yeso abachiigete.

English: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.
Kiswahili: Walipomwona, wakamwabudu; lakini baadhi yao wakaona shaka.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia komorora, bakamosasiima; korende abande mbabete n’echitang’utang’u.

English: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajia na kusema, “Nimepewa mamlaka yote mbinguni na duniani.
Ekegusii: Yeso agacha ange nabarabwo akabateebia, “Naeirwe okobua gwonsi igoro na ense.

English: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, enendeni mkawafanye mataifa yote kuwa wanafunzi, mkiwabatiza kwa Jina la Baba na la Mwana na la Roho Mtakatifu,
Ekegusii: Gaki genda mokore ebisaku bionsi koba aborokigwa, mokobaabatisa ase erieta ria Tata, neri’Omwana, neri’Omoika Omochenu,

English: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
Kiswahili: nanyi wafundisheni kuyashika mambo yote niliyowaamuru ninyi. Hakika mimi niko pamoja nanyi siku zote, hadi mwisho wa nyakati.”
Ekegusii: mokoborokereria kobwata aya onsi nabachiikire; na rora, inche nigo inde amo nainwe amatuko onsi goika omoerio bw’ense.”

English: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
Kiswahili: Mwanzo wa Injili ya Yesu Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Eye nero enchiri igoro ya Yeso Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae,

English: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha nabii Isaya: “Tazama, nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako, atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako”:
Ekegusii: nigo yachaagete buna eriikire ase egetabu y’omobani Isaya. “Nyasae agateeba,” rora, natomire omotomwa one agotang’anere, oyo oraroisie enchera yao;

English: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”
Kiswahili: “sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani. ‘Itengenezeni njia ya Bwana, yanyoosheni mapito yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: eriogi ri’omonto ogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye!

English: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
Kiswahili: Yohana alikuja, akibatiza huko nyikani, akihubiri ubatizo wa toba kwa ajili ya msamaha wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Erio Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro, okorandia, okobateebia, “Onchoka, mobatiswe, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe.”

English: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.
Kiswahili: Watu kutoka Uyahudi wote na sehemu zote za Yerusalemu walikuwa wakimwendea. Nao wakaziungama dhambi zao, akawabatiza katika Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na bonsi aba Yerusalemu bakamochiera, bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodani, bakoorokia ebibe biabo.

English: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
Kiswahili: Yohana alivaa mavazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa singa za ngamia na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni mwake. Chakula chake kilikuwa nzige na asali ya mwitu.
Ekegusii: Na Yohana nigo arenge kobeeka chianga chi’amarionya y’engamia, na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenema kiaye. Nigo arenge koria chingige n’obooke bw’orosana.

English: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
Kiswahili: Naye alihubiri akisema, “Baada yangu atakuja yeye aliye na uwezo kuniliko mimi, ambaye sistahili hata kuinama na kulegeza kamba za viatu vyake.
Ekegusii: Akarandia, okobora, “Nache korwa magega y’ane oyore ne chinguru kombua, oyio inche ntaisaini gotung’ama na gosibora chiusi chi’ebikoroto biaye.

English: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
Kiswahili: Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji, lakini yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobaabatisa ase amaache, korende ere nabaabatise ase Omoika Omochenu.”

English: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yesu akaja kutoka Nazareti ya Galilaya, naye akabatizwa na Yohana katika Mto Yordani.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Yeso agacha korwa Nazareti ya Galili, akabatiswa na Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodani.

English: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akitoka ndani ya maji, aliona mbingu zikifunguka na Roho akishuka juu yake kama hua.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima, Yeso kagotiira korwa ase amaache, akarora igoro amaanokire, na Omoika buna riruma ogoika igoro asare,

English: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
Kiswahili: Nayo sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema, “Wewe ni Mwanangu mpendwa; nami nimependezwa nawe sana.”
Ekegusii: na eriogi rikarwa igoro, rigateeba, “Aye naye Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie naye.”

English: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, Roho akamwongoza Yesu kwenda nyikani,
Ekegusii: Erio kegima Omoika okamoira ase erooro.

English: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
Kiswahili: naye akawa huko nyikani kwa muda wa siku arobaini, akijaribiwa na Shetani. Alikaa na wanyama wa mwituni, nao malaika wakamhudumia.
Ekegusii: Akaba ase erooro amatuko emerongo ene, ogoteemwa na Saitani; ere nigo arenge amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana; na abamalaika bakaba nkomokorera bare.

English: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yohana kukamatwa na kutiwa gerezani, Yesu aliingia Galilaya akaanza kuhubiri habari njema ya Mungu,
Ekegusii: Magega Yohana kabekirwe echela ime, Yeso akagenda Galili, akarandia enchiri ya Nyasae,

English: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
Kiswahili: akisema, “Wakati umewadia, Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia. Tubuni na kuiamini Habari Njema.”
Ekegusii: okobora, “Engaki yaikeranire, na oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e; onchoka na mwegene enchiri.”

English: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akitembea kando ya Bahari ya Galilaya, aliwaona Simoni na Andrea nduguye wakizitupa nyavu zao baharini, kwa kuwa wao walikuwa wavuvi.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are goeta ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora Simioni na Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, ekiagera nabarubi barenge.

English: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Njooni, nifuateni nami nitawafanya mwe wavuvi wa watu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo montunyane, na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’ abanto.”

English: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
Kiswahili: Mara wakaacha nyavu zao, wakamfuata.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima bagatiga ebionga biabo, bakamotunyana.

English: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
Kiswahili: Alipokwenda mbele kidogo, akamwona Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo na Yohana nduguye, wakiwa kwenye mashua yao wakizitengeneza nyavu zao.
Ekegusii: Akagenderera bosio ake, akarora Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana momura omwabo; barabwo nigo barenge obwato ime bakobareera ebionga biabo.

English: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
Kiswahili: Papo hapo akawaita, nao wakamwacha Zebedayo baba yao kwenye mashua pamoja na watumishi wa kuajiriwa, nao wakamfuata Yesu.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima akabarangeria; barabwo bagatiga Zebedi ise amo n’abanto b’eng’eria ime ase obwato, bakamotunyana.

English: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
Kiswahili: Wakaenda mpaka Kapernaumu. Ilipofika siku ya Sabato, mara Yesu akaingia sinagogi, akaanza kufundisha.
Ekegusii: Bakabwatia enchera goika Kapernaumu, na erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato Yeso agasoa ase esinagogi akorokereria.

English: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
Kiswahili: Watu wakashangaa sana kwa mafundisho yake, kwa maana aliwafundisha kama yeye aliye na mamlaka, wala si kama walimu wa sheria.
Ekegusii: Bagakumia ase okworokereria kwaye, ekiagera arenge koborokereria buna oyore nokobua, gose tari buna aborokia b’amariiko.

English: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo katika sinagogi lao palikuwa na mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu,
Ekegusii: Erio kegima omonto obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi agacha ase esinagogi, ere agaaka eriogi,

English: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”
Kiswahili: naye akapiga kelele akisema, “Tuna nini nawe, Yesu wa Nazareti? Je, umekuja kutuangamiza? Ninakujua wewe ni nani. Wewe ndiwe Aliye Mtakatifu wa Mungu!”
Ekegusii: akabora, “Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Inee! Nigo gwachire gotosiria? Namanyire aye ning’o, aye n’Omochenu o Nyasae.”

English: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akamkemea, akamwambia, “Nyamaza kimya! Nawe umtoke!”
Ekegusii: Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Karwe ase omonto oyo!”

English: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
Kiswahili: Yule pepo mchafu akamtikisatikisa huyo mtu kwa nguvu, kisha akamtoka akipiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ekerecha keria ki’eubi gekamogaragaria, gekarera ase eriogi rinene, gekamorwa.

English: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakashangaa, hata wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Haya ni mambo gani? Ni mafundisho mapya, tena yenye mamlaka! Anaamuru hata pepo wachafu, nao wanamtii!”
Ekegusii: Bagaichana bonsi, goika bakaborania, bakobora, “Inki eke? Nokworokereria okoyia! Omonto oyo nigo abwate okobua kw’ogochika nonya nebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio bikomoigwera.”

English: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
Kiswahili: Sifa zake zikaanza kuenea haraka katika eneo lote la karibu na Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Erio chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense ya Galili.

English: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
Kiswahili: Mara walipotoka katika sinagogi, walikwenda pamoja na Yakobo na Yohana hadi nyumbani kwa Simoni na Andrea.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo kobasokire korwa ase esinagogi, bakagenda goika nyomba mwa Simioni na Anderea: Yakobo na Yohana bakagenda nere.

English: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
Kiswahili: Mama mkwe wa Simoni alikuwa kitandani, ana homa, nao wakamweleza Yesu habari zake.
Ekegusii: Ng’ina biara Simioni nigo araire, arwarete esosera. Erio kegima Yeso gaikire bakamoteebia amang’ana igoro yaye.

English: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akamwendea, akamshika mkono na kumwinua. Kisha homa ikamwacha, naye akaanza kuwahudumia.
Ekegusii: Yeso agaika omong’ina oria ang’e, akamoimokia ase okomobwata okoboko. Erio esosera ekamotiga na ere akabakorera.

English: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.
Kiswahili: Jioni ile baada ya jua kutua, watu wakamletea Yesu wagonjwa wote na waliopagawa na pepo wachafu.
Ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, erioba korikogwa, abanto bakarentera Yeso abarwaire bonsi, na ababwatire nebirecha.

English: All the city was gathered together at the door.
Kiswahili: Mji wote ukakusanyika mbele ya nyumba hiyo.
Ekegusii: Na omochie bwonsi okaba ngosangererekana ore gesieri.

English: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaponya watu wengi waliokuwa na magonjwa ya aina mbalimbali. Akawatoa pepo wachafu wengi, lakini hakuwaacha hao pepo wachafu waseme, kwa sababu walimjua yeye ni nani.
Ekegusii: Yeso akagwenia abange abarenge namarwaire ao ao, na agaseria ebirecha ebinge; tatiga ebirecha bikwane, ekiagera biamomanyete.

English: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
Kiswahili: Alfajiri na mapema sana kulipokuwa bado kuna giza, Yesu akaamka, akaondoka, akaenda mahali pa faragha ili kuomba.
Ekegusii: Mambia, botarakiamoka, akaimoka, agasooka, akagenda aase atari nabaanto, agasabera aroro.
