English: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.
Kiswahili: Simoni na wenzake wakaenda kumtafuta,
Ekegusii: Simioni na abarenge amo nere bakamotunyana,

English: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
Kiswahili: nao walipomwona, wakamwambia, “Kila mtu anakutafuta!”
Ekegusii: ekero bamonyorete, bakamoteebia, “Abanto bonsi ngokorigia bare.”

English: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Twendeni mahali pengine kwenye vijiji jirani, ili niweze kuhubiri huko pia, kwa sababu hicho ndicho nilichokuja kukifanya.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Togende aase aande goika ebinyoro bire ang’e, ninyare korandia na aroro boigo, ekiagera ase ayio naro nachicheire.”

English: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akazunguka Galilaya kote, akihubiri katika masinagogi yao na kutoa pepo wachafu.
Ekegusii: Agasoa ase chisinagogi chiabo ase ense yonsi ya Galili, okorandia na goseria ebirecha.

English: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma alimjia Yesu, akamwomba akipiga magoti, akamwambia, “Ukitaka, waweza kunitakasa.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma agacha asare, akamosorora na komotung’amera, akamoteebia, “Onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”

English: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
Kiswahili: Yesu, akiwa amejawa na huruma, akanyoosha mkono wake akamgusa, akamwambia, “Nataka. Takasika!”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamororera amaabera, akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.”

English: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.
Kiswahili: Mara ukoma ukamtoka, naye akatakasika.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamotiga, agasibeka.

English: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu kumwonya vikali, akamruhusu aende zake
Ekegusii: Akamotianera bokong’u, kamosokirie agende,

English: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
Kiswahili: akimwambia, “Hakikisha humwambii mtu yeyote habari hizi, bali nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani, na ukatoe sadaka alizoagiza Mose kwa utakaso wako, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Rigereria, toteebia monto onde bwensi amang’ana aya; korende genda bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso egiachigetwe na Musa ase ogosibeka kwao, erinde kebe kirori ase abanto.”

English: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mtu akaenda akaanza kutangaza habari za kuponywa kwake waziwazi. Kwa hiyo, Yesu hakuweza tena kuingia katika miji waziwazi lakini alikaa sehemu zisizo na watu. Hata hivyo watu wakamfuata huko kutoka kila upande.
Ekegusii: Korende agasoka, agachaaka koraria amang’ana aya na gosareria ring’ana riria, goika Yeso tanyara naende gosoa ase omochie ime maiso marore, korende akabeera isiko aase atari nabaanto; na abanto bakamochiera korwa kera aase.

English: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku kadhaa Yesu alirudi Kapernaumu, watu wakasikia kwamba amerudi nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amake Yeso akairana gochia Kapernaumu, abanto bakanyora amang’ana ng’a nao are nyomba.

English: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo watu wengi wakakusanyika kiasi kwamba hapakubaki nafasi yoyote hata mlangoni! Naye akawahubiria Neno.
Ekegusii: Erio abanto abange bagasangererekana amo, tiriatigara ribaga ase bare, nonya ngoika gesieri; na Yeso akaba ogokwana ring’ana ase bare.

English: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo baadhi ya watu wakaja wakamletea Yesu mtu aliyepooza, akiwa amebebwa na watu wanne.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagaacha; bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata obogoirie nabaanto bane.

English: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa walikuwa hawawezi kumfikisha kwa Yesu kwa ajili ya umati wa watu, walitoboa tundu kwenye paa mahali pale alipokuwa Yesu, wakamshusha yule aliyepooza kwa kitanda alichokuwa amelalia.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera batanyarete komoikia ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda, bakabochora ekerama aase aaria Yeso arenge. Kobakoorire kogetagora, bagaikia oborere boria oria orenge rigata araire.

English: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoiona imani yao, alimwambia yule mtu aliyepooza, “Mwanangu, dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora okwegena kwabo agateebia oria orenge rigata, “Omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

English: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
Kiswahili: Basi baadhi ya walimu wa sheria waliokuwa wameketi huko wakawaza mioyoni mwao,
Ekegusii: Abande ase aborokia b’amariiko baikaransete aroro, bakeboria ase chinkoro chiabo,

English: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini mtu huyu anasema hivi? Huyu anakufuru! Ni nani awezaye kusamehe dhambi isipokuwa Mungu peke yake?”
Ekegusii: “Inaki oyo agoteeba iga? Nkorama are! Ning’o oranyare kwabera ebibe, otatiga oyomo, nere Nyasae?”

English: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
Kiswahili: Mara moja Yesu akatambua rohoni mwake kile walichokuwa wanawaza mioyoni mwao, naye akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnawaza hivyo mioyoni mwenu?
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso namanyete ase omoika oye ime buna baare korengereria ase chinkoro chiabo, akabateebia, “Inaki mokorengereria iga ase chinkoro chiaino?

English: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?
Kiswahili: Je, ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi: kumwambia huyu aliyepooza, ‘Umesamehewa dhambi zako,’ au kusema, ‘Inuka, uchukue mkeka wako, uende’?
Ekegusii: Ndiriri rire eriango, goteebia oyore rigata: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende?

English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—
Kiswahili: Lakini ili mpate kujua ya kwamba Mwana wa Adamu anayo mamlaka duniani kusamehe dhambi…” Yesu akamwambia yule aliyepooza,
Ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria orenge rigata,

English: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
Kiswahili: “Nakuambia, inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”
Ekegusii: “Nagotebirie, imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”

English: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”
Kiswahili: Yule mtu aliyekuwa amepooza akasimama, akachukua mkeka wake, akatembea machoni pao wote! Jambo hili likawashangaza wote, wakamtukuza Mungu, wakisema, “Hatujapata kuona jambo kama hili kamwe!”
Ekegusii: Erio kegima akaimoka, agetweka oborere bwaye, akarua ase amasio abo bonsi; goika bagakumia bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae, bakoboora, “Ayare buna aya, titwana koyarora rinde nonya ng’ake!”

English: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaenda tena kandokando ya Bahari ya Galilaya. Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamfuata, naye akaanza kuwafundisha.
Ekegusii: Yeso naende akairana gochia ensemo y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi okamochiera, ere agachaaka koborokereria.

English: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akitembea, akamwona Lawi mwana wa Alfayo ameketi forodhani mahali pa kutoza ushuru, akamwambia, “Nifuate.” Lawi akaondoka, akamfuata Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia goeta, akarora Lawi, omwana bw’Alufayo, oikaransete aase bakoruseria ebango, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana!” Akaimoka, akamotunyana.

English: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akila chakula nyumbani mwa Lawi, watoza ushuru wengi pamoja na “wenye dhambi” walikuwa wakila pamoja naye na wanafunzi wake, kwa maana kulikuwa na watu wengi waliokuwa wakimfuata.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Yeso aikaransete nyomba mw’omonto oria, okoria endagera, abarusia ebango abange na abanyene ebibe bagaikaransa amo na Yeso na aborokigwa baye; inaki barenge abange bamotuny’anete.

English: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria waliokuwa Mafarisayo walipomwona akila pamoja na watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi,” wakawauliza wanafunzi wake: “Mbona Yesu anakula pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi’?”
Ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bagachia komoorora okoria amo n’abanyene ebibe na abarusia ebango, bagateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki akoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”

English: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia haya akawaambia, “Watu wenye afya hawahitaji tabibu, bali walio wagonjwa. Sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, akabateebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete; tincheti korangeria abanyaboronge, korende abanyene ebibe.”

English: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”
Kiswahili: Basi wanafunzi wa Yohana pamoja na Mafarisayo walikuwa wakifunga. Baadhi ya watu wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Mbona wanafunzi wa Yohana na wa Mafarisayo hufunga lakini wanafunzi wako hawafungi?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa ba Yohana na Abafarisai nigo barenge kweng’ata. Abanto bande bagaacha, bakamobooria, “Nase ki aborokigwa ba Yohana na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai bakweng’ata, ko aborokigwa bao tibari kweng’ata?”

English: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Wageni wa bwana arusi wawezaje kufunga wakati angali pamoja nao? Wakati bwana arusi bado yuko pamoja nao, hawawezi kufunga.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Abatuunyire enyangi inabanyare kweng’ata ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo? Ekero omonywomi are amo na barabwo, tibakonyara kweng’ata.

English: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati utafika ambapo bwana arusi ataondolewa kwao. Siku hiyo ndipo watakapofunga.
Ekegusii: Korende amatuko naache baraache kourwa omonywomi, erio nario baraache kweng’ata ase rituko riria.

English: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mtu ashoneaye kiraka cha nguo mpya kwenye nguo iliyochakaa. Akifanya hivyo, kile kiraka kipya kitachanika kutoka ile nguo iliyochakaa, nayo itachanika zaidi.
Ekegusii: Gose tari monto onde okobareera ekeraka ki’egetambaa ekeyia ase eanga engotu ekiagera keria kiabekwa nigo kegotandora eanga eria, keria ekeyia kiagendereria eanga eria engotu etandoke kobua.

English: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”
Kiswahili: Wala hakuna mtu awekaye divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Akifanya hivyo, ile divai mpya itavipasua hivyo viriba, nayo hiyo divai itamwagika na viriba vitaharibika. Lakini divai mpya huwekwa kwenye viriba vipya.”
Ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria nebiate ebirandi, edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia.”

English: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.
Kiswahili: Siku moja ya Sabato, Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakipita katikati ya mashamba ya nafaka. Walipokuwa wakitembea, wanafunzi wake wakaanza kuvunja masuke.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koba ngoeta arenge ase emegondo y’engano ase rituko ri’Esabato; aborokigwa baye bagachaaka kobutora ebigara kobakogenda.

English: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo wakamwambia, “Tazama, mbona wanafanya jambo lisilo halali kufanywa siku ya Sabato?”
Ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamoboria, “Rora, naki bagokora eritari boronge gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato?”

English: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, hamjasoma kamwe alivyofanya Daudi wakati yeye na wenzake walikuwa na njaa, wakahitaji chakula?
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete ekero aremeretwe endagera, akaba nenchara, ere na abwo barenge amo nere,

English: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”
Kiswahili: Daudi aliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, wakati Abiathari alikuwa kuhani mkuu, akaila ile mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, ambayo ni halali kuliwa na makuhani peke yao. Naye pia akawapa wenzake.”
Ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ekero Abiatari arenge Omokuani omonene, akaria emegati yarenge korugwa ase Nyasae, etare boronge koriegwa nonde otatiga abakuani, naende akaa abarenge amo nere?”

English: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Sabato ilifanyika kwa ajili ya mwanadamu, lakini si mwanadamu kwa ajili ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Esabato nigo yakoretwe ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, tari Mwanyabaanto ase engencho y’Esabato;

English: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo, Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.”
Ekegusii: naki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.”

English: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaingia tena ndani ya sinagogi, na huko palikuwa na mtu aliyepooza mkono.
Ekegusii: Yeso agasoa naende ase esinagogi. Agwo narengeo omonto, okoboko kwaye kwagataete.

English: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
Kiswahili: Wakawa wanamwangalia waone kama atamponya siku ya Sabato, ili wapate sababu ya kumshtaki.
Ekegusii: Agwo mbarenge oo abanto gete abwo baganetie gotega Yeso barore gose nagwenie omonto oria ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.

English: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia yule mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Njoo hapa mbele ya watu wote.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Tenena gati aa!”

English: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, “Je, ni lipi lililo halali siku ya Sabato: Ni kutenda mema au kutenda mabaya? Ni kuokoa maisha au kuua?” Lakini wao wakanyamaza kimya.
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mboronge ase rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya, gose gokora amabe; gotooria obogima, gose koboita?” Bagakira.

English: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawatazama pande zote kwa hasira, akahuzunika sana kwa ajili ya ugumu wa mioyo yao. Akamwambia yule mtu mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Nyoosha mkono wako.” Akaunyoosha, nao ukaponywa kabisa!
Ekegusii: Akabamogoreria amaiso chinsemo chionsi ase okobea, akaigwa obororo ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiabo, agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakorambora, na okoboko kwaye gokagwena.

English: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Mafarisayo wakatoka nje, nao wakaanza kufanya shauri la kumuua Yesu wakiwa na Maherode.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima Abafarisai baria bagasoka, bakagamba amo n’Abaherodiani buna barakore baite Yeso.

English: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,
Kiswahili: Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake wakaondoka huko wakaenda baharini, nao umati mkubwa wa watu kutoka Galilaya ukamfuata.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarwa agwo amo n’Aborokigwa baye, bakagenda goika engegu ye’nyancha ya Galili, na omoganda omonene korwa Galili, naboigo korwa ase Boyahudi,

English: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia mambo yote aliyokuwa akiyafanya, umati mkubwa wa watu ukamjia kutoka Uyahudi, Yerusalemu, Idumaya, na ngʼambo ya Yordani, pamoja na wale wa sehemu za karibu na Tiro na Sidoni.
Ekegusii: na Yerusalemu, na Idumea, na ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ne chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni okabatunyana. Ochia koigwa ebirage bi’amang’ana onsi arenge gokora, omoganda oyio omonene, okamochiera.

English: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya umati mkubwa wa watu, aliwaambia wanafunzi wake waweke tayari mashua ndogo kwa ajili yake, ili kuwazuia watu kumsonga.
Ekegusii: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye bamobekere obwato ang’e ase engencho y’abanto; erio omoganda tomomiga.

English: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa alikuwa amewaponya wagonjwa wengi, wale wenye magonjwa walikuwa wanasukumana ili wapate kumgusa.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera agwenetie abanto, bonsi abarenge nemechando bakamosongerera, banyare komokuna.

English: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”
Kiswahili: Kila mara pepo wachafu walipomwona, walianguka chini mbele yake na kupiga kelele wakisema, “Wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Na abanto barenge n’ebirecha bi’eubi bagachia komoorora, bakagwa ase obosio bwaye, bakarera bagateeba, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.
Kiswahili: Lakini aliwaonya wasimseme yeye ni nani.
Ekegusii: Akabitianera mono tibimoorokia.

English: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akapanda mlimani na kuwaita wale aliowataka, nao wakamjia.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akarangeria abwo arigetie ere omonyene; na barabwo bakamochiera.

English: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach
Kiswahili: Akawachagua kumi na wawili, ambao aliwaita mitume, ili wapate kuwa pamoja naye, na awatume kwenda kuhubiri
Ekegusii: Agachoora ikomi na babere, abwo arogete abatomwa erio banyare koba amo nere, erinde abatome bagende korandia,

English: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
Kiswahili: na kuwa na mamlaka ya kutoa pepo wachafu.
Ekegusii: na babe nokobua kw’ogoseria ebirecha.

English: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wale kumi na wawili aliowachagua: Simoni (ambaye alimwita Petro);
Ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere achoorete nabwo aba: Simioni nere arogete erieta rinde Petero,

English: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);
Kiswahili: Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo, na Yohana nduguye (ambao aliwaita Boanerge, maana yake Wana wa Ngurumo);
Ekegusii: na Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana, momura omwabo Yakobo, akabaroka erieta Boanergi, engencho yaye: Abana b’enkoba;

English: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;
Kiswahili: Andrea, Filipo, Bartholomayo, Mathayo, Tomaso, Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, Thadayo, Simoni Mkananayo,
Ekegusii: Anderea na Filipo, na Baritholomayo, na Matayo, na Thomas, na Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Tadayo, na Simioni, oyomo bw’Abazelote,

English: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.
Kiswahili: na Yuda Iskariote aliyemsaliti Yesu.
Ekegusii: na Yudasi Iskariota, nere oyomoruete. Erio agasoa nyomba.

English: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu aliporudi nyumbani, umati wa watu ukakusanyika tena, kiasi kwamba yeye na wanafunzi wake hawakuweza kula chakula.
Ekegusii: Na omoganda ogasangerereka naende; barabwo abanyene tibanyara nonya nokoria.

English: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”
Kiswahili: Ndugu zake walipopata habari wakaja ili kumchukua kwa maana watu walikuwa wakisema, “Amerukwa na akili.”
Ekegusii: Abaamate baye bagachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagasoka kogenda komobwata, ekiagera bateebete, “Obakirwe n’eosi.”

English: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”
Kiswahili: Walimu wa sheria walioteremka kutoka Yerusalemu walisema, “Amepagawa na Beelzebuli! Anatoa pepo wachafu kwa kutumia mkuu wa pepo wachafu!”
Ekegusii: Na aborokia b’amariiko, abarwete Yerusalemu, bakaboora, “Nabwatire na Beelizebuli, naende agoseria ebirecha ase okobua kw’omonene bw’ebirecha.”

English: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu akawaita na kuzungumza nao kwa mifano akasema: “Shetani awezaje kumtoa Shetani?
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, akabateebia ase emebayeeno, “Inaki Saitani aranyare goseria Saitani?

English: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
Kiswahili: Kama ufalme ukigawanyika dhidi yake wenyewe, ufalme huo hauwezi kusimama.
Ekegusii: Na oborwoti kaboraatananeke ase borobwo obonyene, oborwoti boria tibokonyara gotenena.

English: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
Kiswahili: Nayo nyumba kama ikigawanyika dhidi yake yenyewe, nyumba hiyo haiwezi kusimama.
Ekegusii: Na enyomba keraatananeke enyene, enyomba eria tekonyara gotenena.

English: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.
Kiswahili: Naye Shetani kama akijipinga mwenyewe na awe amegawanyika, hawezi kusimama bali mwisho wake umewadia.
Ekegusii: Na onye Saitani bweimokeire ere omonyene, na gweatanana, takonyara gotenena, korende nabe nomoerio.

English: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kuingia kwenye nyumba ya mtu mwenye nguvu na kuteka nyara mali zake asipomfunga kwanza yule mwenye nguvu. Ndipo ataweza kuteka nyara mali zake.
Ekegusii: Omonto takonyara gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani oria omonyene chinguru; nario aranyare gosakora enyomba yaye.

English: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, dhambi zote na makufuru yote ya wanadamu watasamehewa.
Ekegusii: “Ekeene nabateebirie: Ebibe bionsi Mwanyabaanto nabaaberwe, na okorama gwonsi bararame,

English: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeyote anayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa kamwe, atakuwa na hatia ya dhambi ya milele.”
Ekegusii: korende monto onde bwensi orarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa nonya ng’ake, korende nigo arabe nebibe goika kare na kare.”

English: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alisema hivi kwa sababu walikuwa wanasema, “Ana pepo mchafu.”
Ekegusii: Nigo abateebetie ayio ekiagera bateebete, “Nabwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.”

English: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaja ndugu zake Yesu pamoja na mama yake. Wakasimama nje, wakamtuma mtu kumwita.
Ekegusii: Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo Yeso bagaacha, bagatenena isiko, bagatoma omonto komorangeria.

English: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”
Kiswahili: Umati wa watu ulikuwa umeketi kumzunguka, nao wakamwambia, “Mama yako na ndugu zako wako nje, wanakutafuta.”
Ekegusii: Na omoganda nigo orenge oikaransete omoetanaine, okamoteebia, “Rora nyoko na bamura bamino isiko bare, mbagotagete.”

English: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza, “Mama yangu na ndugu zangu ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Baba na bamura baminto mbarabi?”

English: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
Kiswahili: Kisha akawatazama wale watu waliokuwa wameketi kumzunguka pande zote, akasema, “Hawa ndio mama yangu na ndugu zangu.
Ekegusii: Akabarigereria abwo baikaransete bamoetanaine, akabora, “Rora aba nabwo baba na bamura baminto!

English: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote anayetenda mapenzi ya Mungu, huyo ndiye ndugu yangu, na dada yangu na mama yangu.”
Ekegusii: Inaki oyorakore ogwancha kwa Nyasae, oyio nere baba na momura ominto, na mosubati ominto.”

English: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaanza kufundisha tena kando ya bahari. Umati wa watu uliokuwa umekusanyika kumzunguka ulikuwa mkubwa, kiasi kwamba ilimbidi Yesu aingie kwenye mashua iliyokuwa baharini na kuketi humo, nao watu wote walikuwa ufuoni mwa bahari.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachaaka kworokereria naende ase enyancha mbarabare, na omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera, goika ere akariina obwato, agaikaransa imeo igoro y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi nao orenge ase ense enyomo enyancha mbarabare.

English: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
Kiswahili: Akawafundisha mambo mengi kwa mifano, naye katika mafundisho yake akasema:
Ekegusii: Akaborokereria amang’ana amange ase emebayeeno, akabateebia ase okworokereria kwaye,

English: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.
Kiswahili: “Sikilizeni! Mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake.
Ekegusii: “Tegerera! Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura.

English: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia, nao ndege wakaja na kuzila.
Ekegusii: Agachia koba nkobusura are, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigaacha chigachiria.

English: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
Kiswahili: Nyingine zilianguka kwenye ardhi yenye mwamba isiyo na udongo wa kutosha. Zikaota haraka, kwa kuwa udongo ulikuwa haba.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa aase egetare kere, aase amaroba are amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.

English: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
Kiswahili: Lakini jua lilipozidi, mimea ikanyauka na kukauka kwa kuwa mizizi yake haikuwa na kina.
Ekegusii: Omobaso ogachia kobara, chigasusana, na ekiagera chitarenge nemeri, chikooma.

English: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
Kiswahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye miiba, nayo miiba hiyo ikakua, ikaisonga hiyo mimea, hivyo haikutoa mazao.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakiina, agachimiga, tichiama amatunda.

English: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”
Kiswahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri, zikaota vizuri na kukua, zikatoa mazao, moja mara thelathini, nyingine mara sitini, na nyingine mara mia moja.”
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikaama endagera, chikamera na gokina, na kwama; echinde emerongo etato, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, naende echinde rigana.”

English: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akasema, “Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera tiga aigwe.”

English: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa peke yake, watu waliokuwepo naye pamoja na wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili wakamuuliza kuhusu mifano yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge bweka, abanto baria bamoetanaine amo nabaria ikomi na babere bakamobooria amang’ana y’emebayeeno eria.

English: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,
Kiswahili: Naye akawaambia, “Ninyi mmepewa kujua siri ya Ufalme wa Mungu. Lakini kwa wale walioko nje, kila kitu husemwa kwao kwa mifano,
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, korende ase abanto bare isiko, amang’ana onsi nigo are emebayeeno ase bare,

English: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”
Kiswahili: ili, “ ‘daima waone lakini wasitambue, daima wasikie lakini wasielewe; wasije wakageuka, wakatubu na kusamehewa!’ ”
Ekegusii: erio okorigereria nabarigererie, ko tibakorora, na okoigwa nabaigwe, ko tibakomanya; tibacha koonchoka, baaberwe ebibe biabo.”

English: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, “Hamwelewi maana ya mfano huu? Basi mtaelewaje mifano mingine?
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Timomanyeti omobayeeno oyo? Gaki emebayeeno yonsi naki morayemanye?

English: The farmer sows the word.
Kiswahili: Yule mpanzi hupanda neno.
Ekegusii: Omobusuri nering’ana akobusura.

English: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wale walio kando ya njia ambako neno lilipandwa. Walisikiapo neno, Shetani huja mara na kulinyakua lile neno lililopandwa ndani yao.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo bare buna embusuro eyio ekogwa enchera ensemo; na barabwo kobaikire koriigwa ring’ana, bwango Saitani ocha orusia ring’ana riria riabusuirwe ase emioyo yabo ime.

English: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.
Kiswahili: Nazo zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye udongo wenye miamba, ni wale wanaolisikia neno, na mara hulipokea kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo banga buna chimbusuro chiria chiaguete ase egetare, ekiagera kobaigure ring’ana riria, erio kegima baribwata nomogooko;

English: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kuwa hawana mizizi, wao hudumu kwa muda mfupi tu. Kisha dhiki au mateso yanapoinuka kwa ajili ya lile neno, mara wao huiacha imani.
Ekegusii: na abwo tibari nemeri ime yabo abanyene, korende bagenderera ekero egeke, na ekero emechando gose okorosigwa bikooroka ase engencho ye ring’ana riria, bwango bagwa.

English: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,
Kiswahili: Lakini wengine, kama mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye miiba, hulisikia lile neno;
Ekegusii: Naende abande nabwo baria babusuirwe ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoigwa ring’ana,

English: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
Kiswahili: lakini masumbufu ya maisha haya, na udanganyifu wa mali na tamaa ya mambo mengine huja na kulisonga lile neno na kulifanya lisizae.
Ekegusii: naende okorengereria gw’ense na obong’ainereria bw’eniibo, na okogania kw’amang’ana ande kogosoa, biamiga ring’ana riria, riaba tirikwama.

English: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
Kiswahili: Wengine, kama mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye udongo mzuri, hulisikia lile neno, wakalipokea na kuzaa mazao. Wao huzaa mara thelathini, au mara sitini, au mara mia ya mbegu iliyopandwa.”
Ekegusii: Naende aba nabwo babusuirwe ase amaroba amaya, abwo n’abanto baria bakoigwa ring’ana riria, na koribwata, na kwama okwama, oyomo emerongo etato, oyomo emerongo etano nomo, na oyonde rigana.”

English: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Je, taa huwashwa na kufunikwa chini ya kikapu au mvunguni mwa kitanda? Je, haiwashwi na kuwekwa juu ya kinara chake?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Etaya nigo ekorentwa erinde yamumekwa negetonga gose yabekwa nyaro y’oborere? Teri kobekwa igoro ase ekebekerero?

English: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hakuna kilichofichika ambacho hakitafunuliwa, wala hakuna jambo lolote la siri ambalo halitaletwa nuruni.
Ekegusii: Inaki ring’ana tiriri ria bobisi ritache koorokigwa, gose eribisegete ritache koorokigwa maiso marore.

English: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”
Kiswahili: Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”
Ekegusii: Onye omonto ore n’amato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”

English: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.
Kiswahili: Naye akawaambia, “Kuweni waangalifu na yale mnayosikia. Kipimo kile mpimacho, ndicho mtakachopimiwa ninyi, hata na zaidi.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rigereria aya mokoigwa; na ekerengo keria mokorengera nakio morache korengerwa inwe, naende namomenterwe.

English: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila mtu aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi, naye atakuwa navyo tele. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.”
Ekegusii: Inaki oyobwate naegwe; korende oyotabwati naurwe nonya nekio abwate.”

English: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
Kiswahili: Pia akawaambia, “Ufalme wa Mungu unafanana na mtu apandaye mbegu shambani.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabora, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro ase riroba.

English: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
Kiswahili: Akiisha kuzipanda, usiku na mchana, akiwa amelala au ameamka, mbegu huota na kukua pasipo yeye kujua ikuavyo.
Ekegusii: Akaba okoraara botuko na koboka, mobaso, na embusuro eyio ekamera na gokiina, ere atamanyeti buna egokoreka.

English: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
Kiswahili: Udongo huifanya iote kuwa mche, halafu suke, kisha nafaka kamili kwenye suke.
Ekegusii: Inaki ense nigo ekwama enyene, ritang’ani rinyansi, naende ekegara, erio enyeke ase ekegara.

English: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nafaka inapokuwa imekomaa, mara mkulima huingia shambani na mundu wa kuvunia, maana mavuno yamekuwa tayari.”
Ekegusii: Na endagera koyamire, omonto oyio bwango nigo akoira omoyio bwokogesa, ekiagera rigesa riaikire ang’e.”

English: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
Kiswahili: Akawaambia tena, “Tuufananishe Ufalme wa Mungu na nini? Au tutumie mfano gani ili kuueleza?
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akagenderera koboora, “Ninki torabogwekanie oborwoti bwa Nyasae? Gose tobobeke ase mobayeeno ki?

English: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
Kiswahili: Ni kama punje ya haradali, ambayo ni mbegu ndogo sana kuliko mbegu zote zinazopandwa ardhini.
Ekegusii: Nigo bonga entetere y’omoaruni, ekero egosimekwa ase amaroba nenke kobua chimbusuro chionsi ase ense,

English: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikishaota, hukua ikawa mmea mkubwa kuliko yote ya bustanini, ikawa na matawi makubwa hata ndege wa angani wanaweza kujenga viota kwenye matawi yake.”
Ekegusii: korende koyasimekirwe, yakiina, yaba enene kobua emete yonsi y’amato, yaba ne chinsagia chinene; goika chinyoni chia igoro chinyare gokenderera ase ekiriri kiaye.”

English: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
Kiswahili: Kwa mifano mingine mingi kama hii Yesu alinena nao neno lake, kwa kadiri walivyoweza kulielewa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaranderia abanto ring’ana riaye ase emebayeeno emenge ere buna eye; nigo arenge gokwana ring’ana ase bare, koreng’ana buna baare konyara koigwa,

English: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
Kiswahili: Hakusema nao neno lolote pasipo mfano. Lakini alipokuwa na wanafunzi wake, aliwafafanulia kila kitu.
Ekegusii: gose taare kobateebia ring’ana otatiga ase omobayeeno, korende ekero arenge ensemo n’Aborokigwa baye nigo arenge kobateebia obobisi bwonsi.

English: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo ilipokaribia jioni, aliwaambia wanafunzi wake, “Tuvukeni twende mpaka ngʼambo.”
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria, rigachia koba mogoroba, akabateebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu.”

English: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
Kiswahili: Wakauacha ule umati wa watu, na wakamchukua vile alivyokuwa kwenye mashua. Palikuwa pia na mashua nyingine nyingi pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Bagatiga omoganda, bakamoira amo nabarabwo, buna arenge, ase obwato boria. Na amaato ande narenge amo nere

English: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
Kiswahili: Kukawa na dhoruba kali, nayo mawimbi yakaipiga ile mashua hata ikawa karibu kujaa maji.
Ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu ekenene ki’omwaga gekaoroka, emerindo egaaka‐aka obwato goika amaache agachaaka goichora obwato ime.

English: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
Kiswahili: Yesu alikuwa katika shetri, akiwa analala juu ya mto. Wanafunzi wake wakamwamsha, wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, hujali kama tunazama?”
Ekegusii: Ere omonyene nigo arenge ase obwato ime magega oraire igoro ase omoito. Bakamotura, bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, tari gento ase ore gatogosira?”

English: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.
Kiswahili: Akaamka, akaukemea ule upepo, akayaambia yale mawimbi, “Uwe kimya! Tulia!” Ule upepo ukatulia, kukawa shwari kabisa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga, agateebia enyancha, “Kira, otoerere!” Omwaga okaera; gokaba ogotoerera okonene.

English: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Kwa nini mnaogopa hivyo? Je, bado hamna imani?”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Inaki mokwoboa inwe? Timori nokwegena?”

English: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
Kiswahili: Nao wakawa wameogopa sana, wakaulizana, “Ni nani huyu ambaye hata upepo na mawimbi vinamtii?”
Ekegusii: Bagasogwa nomoondoko omonene, bagateebania, “Oyo ning’o rende, goika nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”

English: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
Kiswahili: Wakafika upande wa pili wa ziwa wakaingia katika nchi ya Wagerasi.
Ekegusii: Bagaika ng’umbu y’enyancha, goika ense y’Abageraseni.

English: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipotoka kwenye mashua, mara mtu mmoja mwenye pepo mchafu akatoka makaburini akakutana naye.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia goika korwa obwato; agwo akaumerana nomonto okorwa ase chimbeera obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.

English: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,
Kiswahili: Mtu huyu aliishi makaburini, wala hakuna aliyeweza kumzuia hata kwa kumfunga minyororo.
Ekegusii: Obomenyo bwaye nigo bwarenge aria ase chimbeera. Monto onde tarenge ore konyara komosiba nonya nase ebinyuri,

English: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mara kwa mara alikuwa amefungwa minyororo mikononi na miguuni, lakini akaikata hiyo minyororo na kuzivunja zile pingu miguuni mwake. Hapakuwa na mtu yeyote aliyekuwa na nguvu za kumzuia.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo arenge konya osibirwe ara aange ne chingataare na ebinyuri, abibutora ebinyuri biria, na kobuna‐buna chingataare chiria, na onde tarenge ore ne chinguru chi’okomobua.

English: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
Kiswahili: Usiku na mchana alikuwa makaburini na milimani, akipiga kelele na kujikatakata kwa mawe.
Ekegusii: Na botambe, botuko na mobaso, nao arenge ase chimbeera na ebitunwa, okona‐korera na gwekeba‐keba namagena.

English: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,
Kiswahili: Alipomwona Yesu kwa mbali, alimkimbilia, akapiga magoti mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Agachia korora Yeso korwa are, akaminyoka chimbero, akamosasiima;

English: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”
Kiswahili: Akapiga kelele kwa nguvu akisema, “Una nini nami, Yesu, Mwana wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana? Ninakusihi kwa jina la Mungu, usinitese!”
Ekegusii: agaaka eriogi, okobora, “Inaki inde naye aye Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono? Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ng’a tonchanda”,

English: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Yesu alikuwa amemwambia, “Mtoke mtu huyu, wewe pepo mchafu!”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Yeso konya ogetebirie, “Aye ekerecha ki’eubi, karwe ase omonto oyo!”

English: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamuuliza, “Jina lako ni nani?” Akamjibu, “Jina langu ni Legioni, kwa kuwa tuko wengi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Erieta riao naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Erieta riane n’Elegioni abasigari chilifu isano nemo na goetani erombe y’ abanto, ekiagera nabange tore.”

English: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
Kiswahili: Akamsihi Yesu sana asiwapeleke nje ya nchi ile.
Ekegusii: Erio ere agasorora Yeso mono tabiira isiko y’ense eria.

English: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.
Kiswahili: Palikuwa na kundi kubwa la nguruwe lililokuwa likilisha karibu kando ya kilima.
Ekegusii: Aria ase egetunwa ndiarengeo riicho rinene rie chimbeche riare korisia.

English: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”
Kiswahili: Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi Yesu wakisema, “Tuamuru twende kwenye wale nguruwe. Turuhusu tuwaingie.”
Ekegusii: Ebirecha bionsi bikamosorora, bikaboora, “Toire ase chimbeche, tonyare gosoa ase chirochio.”

English: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu akawaruhusu, nao wale pepo wachafu wakatoka, wakawaingia hao nguruwe. Lile kundi lilikuwa na nguruwe wapatao 2,000, nao wote wakateremkia gengeni kwa kasi, nao wakatumbukia ziwani na kuzama.
Ekegusii: Akabia ribaga. Ebirecha biria bi’eubi bigasoka, bigasoa ase chimbeche chiria; riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano, goika chikagwa enyancha ime. Igo chiarenge koreng’ana chilifu ibere, chikarimera nyancha ime.

English: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.
Kiswahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wakichunga hao nguruwe wakakimbilia mjini na vijijini kueleza yaliyotukia. Watu wakatoka kwenda kuona hayo yaliyokuwa yametukia.
Ekegusii: Abarisia bagatama, bakararia amang’ana aya ase omochie na ebinyoro. Abanto bagasooka barore amang’ana aorokire.

English: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.
Kiswahili: Walipofika kwa Yesu, wakamwona yule mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo wachafu legioni akiwa ameketi hapo, amevaa nguo na mwenye akili timamu. Wakaogopa.
Ekegusii: Bagachiera Yeso, bakarora omonto oria obwatire nomoganda bw’ebirecha oikaransete, bweboyetie chianga, ore nebirengererio ebironge bakairoka.

English: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
Kiswahili: Wale walioyaona mambo hayo wakawaeleza watu wengine yaliyomtokea yule mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo wachafu, na habari za lile kundi la nguruwe pia.
Ekegusii: Na baria abayaroche bakaorokia amang’ana amonyorire oria obwatire nebirecha, na amang’ana ye chimbeche.

English: They began to beg him to depart from their region.
Kiswahili: Basi watu wakaanza kumwomba Yesu aondoke katika nchi yao.
Ekegusii: Bagachaaka gosorora Yeso arue ase ense yabo.

English: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa anaingia kwenye mashua, yule mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo wachafu akamsihi Yesu waende pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koriina obwato ime, oria obwatire nebirecha akamosorora ng’a abe amo nere.

English: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu hakumruhusu, bali alimwambia, “Nenda nyumbani kwa jamaa yako ukawaeleze mambo makuu aliyokutendea Bwana, na jinsi alivyokuhurumia.”
Ekegusii: Yeso tamwanchera, korende akamoteebia, “Genda nka bwoo ase abamino, obateebie amang’ana amanene ay’Omonene agokoreire, naende buna akororeire amaabera.”

English: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akaenda zake, akaanza kutangaza katika Dekapoli mambo makuu Yesu aliyomtendea. Nao watu wote wakastaajabu.
Ekegusii: Akagenda bwoye, agachaaka koraria ase Dekapoli amang’ana aya Yeso amokoreire. Abanto bonsi bagakumia.

English: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokwisha kuvuka tena na kufika ngʼambo, umati mkubwa wa watu ukamzunguka yeye akiwa hapo kando ya bahari.
Ekegusii: Yeso kambokire naende koirana ng’umbu nobwato boria, omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera; ere nigo arenge ensemo y’enyancha.

English: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet
Kiswahili: Kisha mmoja wa viongozi wa sinagogi aliyeitwa Yairo akafika pale. Naye alipomwona Yesu, akapiga magoti miguuni pake,
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’abanene b’esinagogi agacha, erieta riaye Yairo. Agachia komoorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye,

English: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”
Kiswahili: akamsihi akisema, “Binti yangu mdogo ni mgonjwa mahututi. Tafadhali nakusihi, njoo uweke mikono yako juu yake ili apate kupona, naye atakuwa hai.”
Ekegusii: akamosorora mono, akabora, “Omonene, omoiseke one omoke oisire gokwa. Nagosabire, oche obeke okoboko kwao igoro yaye, anyare kogwena, abe moyo.”

English: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akaenda pamoja naye. Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamfuata, nao watu wakawa wanamsonga.
Ekegusii: Bono Yeso akaimoka akagenda amo nere. Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, okamomiga‐miga korwa ase chinsemo chionsi.

English: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,
Kiswahili: Hapo palikuwa na mwanamke aliyekuwa amesumbuliwa na tatizo la kutokwa damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili.
Ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere.

English: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,
Kiswahili: Mwanamke huyu alikuwa ameteseka sana kwa mikono ya matabibu wengi, na kutumia kila kitu alichokuwa nacho. Lakini badala ya kupona, hali yake ilizidi kuwa mbaya.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo achandegete mono ase amaboko y’abarwaria abange. Ere konya osiareire ebinto bionsi arenge nabio, tagwenigwa nonya ng’ake, korende obogima bwaye bokamentekana koba obobe kobua.

English: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa amesikia habari za Yesu, naye akaja kwa nyuma yake kwenye umati wa watu, akaligusa vazi lake,
Ekegusii: Konya oigure amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agaeta ase omoganda korwa magega, agakuna eanga yaye,

English: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”
Kiswahili: kwa maana alisema moyoni mwake, “Kama nikiweza kuligusa vazi lake tu, nitaponywa.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo ateebete, “Kondakune chianga chiaye chioka, ningwene.”

English: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
Kiswahili: Mara kutoka damu kwake kukakoma, naye akajisikia mwilini mwake amepona kabisa.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima ensoko y’amanyinga aye egakama: akaigwa omobere oye ng’a ogwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwaye.

English: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
Kiswahili: Ghafula Yesu akatambua kuwa nguvu zimemtoka. Akaugeukia ule umati wa watu na kuuliza, “Ni nani aliyegusa mavazi yangu?”
Ekegusii: Erio agwo Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a chinguru chiarure asare, akeonchora gati ase omoganda, akabora, “Ning’o okuna chianga chiane?”

English: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamjibu, “Unaona jinsi umati wa watu unavyokusonga. Wawezaje kuuliza, ‘Ni nani aliyenigusa?’ ”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Norooche omoganda oyo buna okomigete, na aye gokoboria: Ning’o onkuna?”

English: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akaangalia pande zote ili aone ni nani aliyemgusa.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, erinde arore oria okora ring’ana erio.

English: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke, akijua kilichomtokea, akaja, akaanguka miguuni pake akitetemeka kwa hofu, akamweleza ukweli wote.
Ekegusii: Na omokungu oria agasogwa nomoondoko na okoiguswa, akamanya eriamonyorire, agacha akamogwera, akamoorokeria ekeene gionsi.

English: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Binti, imani yako imekuponya. Nenda kwa amani, upone kabisa ugonjwa wako.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie, genda nomorembe, ogwene korwa ase oborwaire bwao.”

English: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa bado anaongea, watu wakafika kutoka nyumbani kwa Yairo. Wakamwambia, “Binti yako amekufa. Kwa nini kuendelea kumsumbua Mwalimu?”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso agendererete gokwana, abanto korwa ase enyomba y’omotang’ani bw’esinagogi bagaacha, bakaboora, “Enyaroka yao yakuure. Inki okona‐koroseria Omworokia rende?”

English: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
Kiswahili: Aliposikia hayo waliyosema, Yesu akamwambia huyo kiongozi wa sinagogi, “Usiogope. Amini tu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso tancha gotegerera ring’ana riria rigotebwa, agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’esinagogi, “Toiroka, egene rioka.”

English: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
Kiswahili: Hakumruhusu mtu mwingine yeyote amfuate isipokuwa Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, nduguye Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Gose tanchete monto onde amotuny’ane, otatiga Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo.

English: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
Kiswahili: Walipofika nyumbani kwa yule kiongozi wa sinagogi, Yesu akaona ghasia, watu wakilia na kuomboleza kwa sauti kubwa.
Ekegusii: Bagaika enyomba y’omonene oria bw’esinagogi; akarora rirorooche, na abanto bakorera nokweumia okonge.

English: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”
Kiswahili: Alipokwisha kuingia ndani, akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnafanya ghasia na kulia? Mtoto hajafa, bali amelala tu.”
Ekegusii: Agachia gosoa, akabateebia, “Inaki mogokora rirorooche na korera? Omwana takweti, korende nigo araire.”

English: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakamcheka kwa dharau. Lakini yeye akawatoa wote nje, akawachukua baba na mama wa yule mtoto, pamoja na wale wanafunzi aliokuwa nao. Wakaingia ndani mpaka pale alipokuwa yule mtoto.
Ekegusii: Bakamosekerera. Korende gaikire kobasokia isiko bonsi, akaira ise omwana, na ng’ina, na aborokigwa baye batato abwo barenge amo nere, agasoa ime ase omwana oria arenge.

English: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”
Kiswahili: Akamshika mtoto mkono, akamwambia, “Talitha koum!” (maana yake ni, “Msichana, nakuambia: amka!”)
Ekegusii: Akamobwata okoboko omoiseke oria omoke, akamoteebia, “Talitha kumi”, okoonchorwa kwaye, “Tenena aye enyaroka.”

English: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
Kiswahili: Mara yule msichana akasimama, akaanza kutembea (alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili). Walipoona haya, wakastaajabu sana.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo omoiseke oria omoke akaimoka akagenda, ere konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere. Erio bagakumia ogokumia okonene.

English: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaagiza kwa ukali wasimweleze mtu yeyote jambo hilo, naye akawaambia wampe yule msichana chakula.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabakuurera ng’a monto onde tamanya amang’ana ayio, akabachiika bae omoiseke oria endagera arie.

English: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaondoka huko na kwenda mji wa kwao, akiwa amefuatana na wanafunzi wake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarua agwo, agaika ase ense yaye omonyene; aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.

English: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?
Kiswahili: Ilipofika siku ya Sabato, akaanza kufundisha katika sinagogi, na wengi waliomsikia wakashangaa. Nao wakauliza, “Mtu huyu ameyapata wapi mambo haya yote? Tazama ni hekima ya namna gani hii aliyopewa? Tazama matendo ya miujiza ayafanyayo kwa mikono yake!
Ekegusii: Na ekero gi’Esabato agachaaka kworokereria ase esinagogi; abange abamoigwete bagakumia, bagateebania, “Oyo ng’ai anyorire aya? Mbong’aini ki obo aeirwe oyo? Ogokora gwe chinguru ki oko okonene kogokoreka ase amaboko aye?

English: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.
Kiswahili: Huyu si yule seremala, mwana wa Maria? Na ndugu zake si Yakobo, Yose, Yuda na Simoni? Dada zake wote si tuko nao hapa kwetu?” Nao wakachukizwa sana kwa ajili yake, wakakataa kumwamini.
Ekegusii: Oyo tari oria omobaachi, omwana o Mariamu, momura omwabo Yakobo, na Yose, na Yuda, na Simioni, na basubati bamwabo tibari aiga seito?” Bakagechigwa nere.

English: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Nabii hakosi heshima isipokuwa katika mji wake mwenyewe, na miongoni mwa jamaa na ndugu zake, na nyumbani kwake.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Omobani takomocha gosikwa, otatiga ase ense yaye, na ase eamate yaye, na ase enka yaye.”

English: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.
Kiswahili: Hakufanya miujiza yoyote huko isipokuwa kuweka mikono yake juu ya wagonjwa wachache na kuwaponya.
Ekegusii: Gose tanyara gokora ogokora gwe chinguru aroro, otatiga abegete amaboko aye igoro ase abarwaire bake, akabagwenia.

English: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.
Kiswahili: Naye akashangazwa sana kwa jinsi wasivyokuwa na imani. Kisha Yesu akawa anakwenda kutoka kijiji kimoja hadi kingine akifundisha.
Ekegusii: Agakumia ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo. Agaetanana ase ebinyoro biaetanaineo okworokereria.

English: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
Kiswahili: Akawaita wale kumi na wawili, akawatuma wawili wawili, na kuwapa mamlaka kutoa pepo wachafu.
Ekegusii: Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere, agachaaka kobatoma babere babere, akabaa okobua igoro ase ebirecha bi’eubi;

English: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
Kiswahili: Akawaagiza akisema, “Msichukue chochote kwa ajili ya safari isipokuwa fimbo tu. Msichukue mkate, wala mkoba, wala fedha kwenye mikanda yenu.
Ekegusii: akabakaania tibaira gento ase orogendo rwabo, otatiga enyimbo yoka. Tibaira nonya nomogati, nonya nesaro, nonya nechitaabu ase ebimoya biabo.

English: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
Kiswahili: Vaeni viatu, lakini msivae nguo ya ziada.”
Ekegusii: Korende babeeke ebikoroto, ko tibeboyia chianga ibere.

English: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Mkiingia kwenye nyumba yoyote, kaeni humo hadi mtakapoondoka katika mji huo.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Enyomba ende yonsi ase moraroisigwe, mobeere aroro goika ekero moraimoke korwa aase aria.

English: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”
Kiswahili: Kama mahali popote hawatawakaribisha wala kuwasikiliza, mtakapoondoka huko, kungʼuteni mavumbi kutoka kwenye miguu yenu ili kuwa ushuhuda dhidi yao.”
Ekegusii: Na kera aase abanto batabaroiseti inwe, gose kobaigwa, komokorua aroro, mokong’onte orotu rore inse ase amagoro aino, robe kirori ase bare.”

English: They went out and preached that people should repent.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakatoka na kuhubiri kwamba inawapasa watu kutubu na kuacha dhambi.
Ekegusii: Bagasoka, bakarandia ng’a abanto baonchoke.

English: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.
Kiswahili: Wakatoa pepo wachafu wengi, wakawapaka wagonjwa wengi mafuta na kuwaponya.
Ekegusii: Bagaseria ebirecha ebinge, bagaaka abanto abange amaguta, abwo barenge abarwaire, bakabagwenia.

English: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme Herode akasikia habari hizi, kwa maana jina la Yesu lilikuwa limejulikana sana. Watu wengine walikuwa wakisema, “Yohana Mbatizaji amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, ndiyo sababu nguvu za kutenda miujiza zinafanya kazi ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Herode akaigwa amang’ana, ekiagera erieta ria Yeso konya riakumire kera ase. Abanto bande bakaboora, “Yohana Omobatisi obokire korwa ase abakuure, nakio gekogera chinguru echi chigokora emeremo ime asare.”

English: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
Kiswahili: Wengine wakasema, “Yeye ni Eliya.” Nao wengine wakasema, “Yeye ni nabii, kama mmojawapo wa wale manabii wa zamani.”
Ekegusii: Korende abande bakaboora, “N’Elija.” Na abande bakaboora, “Oyo nomobani, gose nigo anga buna oyomo bw’ababani.”

English: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Herode aliposikia habari hizi, akasema, “Huyo ni Yohana Mbatizaji, niliyemkata kichwa, amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu!”
Ekegusii: Korende Herode agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oyio Yohana oria nanachete omotwe, obokire.”

English: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Herode alikuwa ameagiza kwamba Yohana Mbatizaji akamatwe, afungwe na kutiwa gerezani. Alifanya hivi kwa sababu ya Herodia, mke wa Filipo, ndugu yake, ambaye Herode alikuwa amemwoa.
Ekegusii: Inaki Herode omonyene nigo atomete abanto kobwata Yohana, akamosiba echela ase engencho ya Herodia moka Filipo momura omwabo, oria Herode atwarete,

English: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
Kiswahili: Yohana alikuwa amemwambia Herode, “Si halali kwako kuwa na mke wa ndugu yako.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Yohana amokanetie Herode, “Tai boronge ase ore komenyana na moka momura omino.”

English: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Herodia alikuwa amemwekea Yohana kinyongo akataka kumuua. Lakini hakuweza,
Ekegusii: Nabo oria Herodia akaba nokogecha asare, akarigia komoita, korende tanyara,

English: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu Herode alimwogopa Yohana akijua kwamba ni mtu mwenye haki na mtakatifu, hivyo akamlinda. Herode alifadhaika sana alipomsikia Yohana, lakini bado alipenda kumsikiliza.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Herode nairogete Yohana, konya omanyire ng’a nomonto omooronge, omochenu, akamorenda. Nigo anchete komoigwa, nonya orenge goichana mono kamoigure.

English: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
Kiswahili: Mfalme Herode alifanya karamu kubwa wakati wa sikukuu ya kuzaliwa kwake. Akawaalika maafisa wake wakuu, majemadari wa jeshi na watu mashuhuri wa Galilaya. Hatimaye Herodia alipata wasaa aliokuwa akiutafuta.
Ekegusii: Rituko rigwenerete rigaika Herodia akanyora ribaga ekero Herode ase rituko ri’okoinyora okoiborwa kwaye ekero akora omoyega ase abatang’ani bare inse yaye, na abatang’ani b’esegi, na abanto abanene ba Galili.

English: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”
Kiswahili: Binti yake Herodia alipoingia na kucheza, akamfurahisha Herode pamoja na wageni wake walioalikwa chakulani. Mfalme Herode akamwambia yule binti, “Niombe kitu chochote utakacho, nami nitakupa.”
Ekegusii: Erio omoiseke bwe Herodia gasoa gotenga, akagokia Herode amo nabwo baikaransete nere ase omoyega. Omorwoti agateebia omoiseke oria, “Nsabe kende gionsi ekio origetie, na inche ninkoe.”

English: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Tena akamwahidi kwa kiapo, akamwambia, “Chochote utakachoomba nitakupa, hata kama ni nusu ya ufalme wangu.”
Ekegusii: Akamoriera eira, “Kende gionsi ekio orarigie korwa ase ’nde ninkoe, nonya nekeng’ese ki’oborwoti bwane.”

English: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
Kiswahili: Yule binti akatoka nje, akaenda kumuuliza mama yake, “Niombe nini?” Mama yake akamjibu, “Omba kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji.”
Ekegusii: Omoiseke oria agasoka, akaboria ng’ina, “Inki ’ndasabe?” Ng’ina akamoiraneria, “Omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi.”

English: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”
Kiswahili: Yule binti akarudi haraka kwa mfalme, akamwambia, “Nataka unipe sasa hivi kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji kwenye sinia.”
Ekegusii: Erio kegima agasoa nomoayerero ase obosio bw’omorwoti, agasaba, akabora, “Nindigetie ong’e omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi bono iga ase esani.”

English: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.
Kiswahili: Mfalme akasikitika sana, lakini kwa sababu alikuwa ameapa viapo mbele ya wageni wake, hakutaka kumkatalia.
Ekegusii: Omorwoti akaba nomoichano mono, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye, na ase engencho y’abwo baikaransete ase omoyega, tarigetie kwanga.

English: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
Kiswahili: Mara mfalme akatuma askari mmojawapo wa walinzi wake kukileta kichwa cha Yohana. Akaenda na kumkata Yohana kichwa humo gerezani,
Ekegusii: Erio kegima omorwoti agatoma omorwani oyomo, agachiika ng’a omotwe o Yohana orentwe. Omorwani oria akagenda akamonacha omotwe aria echela ime,

English: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
Kiswahili: akakileta kichwa chake kwenye sinia na kumpa yule msichana, naye yule msichana akampa mama yake.
Ekegusii: akayorenta ore ase esani, akayoa omoiseke oria, na omoiseke oria akayoa ng’ina.

English: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Yohana walipopata habari hizi, wakaja na kuuchukua mwili wake, wakauzika kaburini.
Ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa ba Yohana baigwete amang’ana aya, bakagenda bakabogoria egetondo, bakagetindeka.

English: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
Kiswahili: Wale mitume wakakusanyika kwa Yesu na kumpa taarifa ya mambo yote waliyokuwa wamefanya na kufundisha.
Ekegusii: Abatomwa bakairana ase Yeso, bakamoteebia onsi ayabakorete, na amang’ana onsi aya aborokereretie.

English: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa kuwa watu wengi mno walikuwa wakija na kutoka, hata wakawa hawana nafasi ya kula, Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Twendeni peke yetu mahali pa faragha, mpate kupumzika.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inchuo inwe mweka, togende aase abanto batari, motimoke ake.” Inaki abanto abange mbarengeo, bagocha na bakogenda; goika Yeso n’aborokigwa baye tibanyora ribaga ri’okoria.

English: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakaondoka kwa mashua peke yao, wakaenda mahali pasipo na watu.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda ase obwato, aase abobisi, atari nabaanto.

English: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wengi waliowaona wakiondoka, wakawatambua, nao wakaenda haraka kwa miguu kutoka miji yote, nao wakatangulia kufika.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakabarora bakogenda, abange ase abwo bakabamanya, bakaminyoka bwango korwa ase emechie yonsi, batang’ane goika asare.

English: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipofika kando ya bahari, aliona makutano makubwa ya watu, akawahurumia kwa maana walikuwa kama kondoo wasiokuwa na mchungaji. Kwa hiyo akaanza kuwafundisha mambo mengi.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia goika korwa ase obwato, akarora omoganda omonene, akabarorera amaabera, ekiagera barenge buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia: agachaaka koborokereria amang’ana amange.

English: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
Kiswahili: Mchana ulipokuwa umeendelea sana, wanafunzi wake walienda kwake, wakamwambia, “Mahali hapa ni nyikani, nazo saa zimekwenda sana.
Ekegusii: Goika chinsa chinyinge chi’omobaso chigaeta, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Aase aa negesomo, na bono riagorobire.

English: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
Kiswahili: Waage watu ili waende mashambani na vijijini jirani, wakajinunulie chakula.”
Ekegusii: Kae abanto aba ribaga, erinde bagende emechie na ebinyoro, aria na aaria, begorere endagera.”

English: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawajibu, “Ninyi wapeni chakula.” Wakamwambia, “Je, twende tukanunue mikate ya dinari 200 ili tuwape watu hawa wale?”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabairaneria, “Inwe bae endagera.” Bakamobooria “Inee! Togende togore emegati ye chidinari amagana abere, tobae barie?”

English: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza, “Kuna mikate mingapi? Nendeni mkaangalie.” Walipokwisha kujua wakarudi, wakamwambia, “Kuna mikate mitano na samaki wawili.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate? Genda morore!” Bagachia komanya bakaboora, “Netano, ne chinswe ibere.”

English: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaamuru wawaketishe watu makundi makundi kwenye majani,
Ekegusii: Yeso akabachiika aborokigwa baye baabaikaransie bonsi, ebiombe, ebiombe, ase obonyansi obobese.

English: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
Kiswahili: nao wakaketi kwenye makundi ya watu mia mia na wengine hamsini hamsini.
Ekegusii: Bagaikaransa ase chindwaro, echinde rigana erimo na echinde emerongo etano.

English: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaichukua ile mikate mitano na wale samaki wawili, akainua macho yake akatazama mbinguni, akavibariki na kuimega ile mikate. Kisha akawapa wanafunzi wake ili wawagawie wale watu wote. Pia akawagawia wote wale samaki wawili.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati eria, akaa aborokigwa baye babiterekere abanto, ne chinswe chiria ibere, akabagabera bonsi.

English: They all ate and were filled.
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakala, wakashiba.
Ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota.

English: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
Kiswahili: Nao wanafunzi wake wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia vya mikate na samaki, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili.
Ekegusii: Bagasangereria ebisamunye biasamunyogete, na ebio bigaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere, naboigo nebisamunye bie chinswe.

English: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
Kiswahili: Idadi ya wanaume waliokula walikuwa 5,000.
Ekegusii: Na abasacha abariete emegati eria nigo barenge chilifu isano.

English: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
Kiswahili: Mara Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake waingie kwenye mashua watangulie kwenda Bethsaida, wakati yeye alikuwa akiwaaga wale makutano.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabetereria aborokigwa baye bariine obwato, bamotang’anere kogenda ng’umbu goika Bethisaida ekero are koa omoganda ribaga ogende.

English: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwaaga wale watu, akaenda mlimani kuomba.
Ekegusii: Magega gakorire gokwana nabarabwo, akagenda egetunwa gosaba.

English: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
Kiswahili: Ilipofika jioni, ile mashua ilikuwa imefika katikati ya bahari, na Yesu alikuwa peke yake katika nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, obwato bokaba enyancha gati, na ere bweka ase ense enyomo.

English: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,
Kiswahili: Akawaona wanafunzi wake wanahangaika na kupiga makasia kwa nguvu, kwa sababu upepo ulikuwa wa mbisho. Wakati wa zamu ya nne ya usiku, Yesu akawaendea wanafunzi wake, akiwa anatembea juu ya maji. Alikuwa karibu kuwapita,
Ekegusii: Akabarora bagwechanda bagwata amaache nemegango, ekiagera omwaga nigo obatangete. Koreng’ana ekero ki’oborendi bwa kane bwa botuko agacha ase bare, ogotaara igoro ase enyancha, akarigia kobaetania.

English: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
Kiswahili: lakini walipomwona akitembea juu ya maji, wakadhani ni mzimu. Wakapiga yowe,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia komorora ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari, bagaaka eriogi,

English: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
Kiswahili: kwa sababu wote walipomwona waliogopa. Mara Yesu akasema nao, akawaambia, “Jipeni moyo! Ni mimi. Msiogope!”
Ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi abamorooche mbaondogete. Bwango Yeso agakwana nabarabwo, akabateebia, “Remia chinkoro! Ninche. Timoiroka!”

English: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
Kiswahili: Akapanda ndani ya mashua nao, na ule upepo ukakoma! Wakashangaa kabisa,
Ekegusii: Akariina ime ase obwato ase bare; omwaga ogakira. Aborokigwa bagaichana mono,

English: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa walikuwa hawajaelewa kuhusu ile mikate. Mioyo yao ilikuwa migumu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera tibamanyete amang’ana y’emegati eria, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chiarenge chinkong’u.

English: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuvuka, wakafika nchi ya Genesareti, wakatia nanga.
Ekegusii: Ekero bambokire bagaika ense ya Genesareti, bakabeeka ekeroochi.

English: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
Kiswahili: Mara waliposhuka kutoka mashua yao, watu wakamtambua Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bagachia gosoka korwa ase obwato, abanto bakamanya Yeso bwango,

English: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.
Kiswahili: Wakaenda katika vijiji vyote upesi, wakawabeba wagonjwa kwenye mikeka ili kuwapeleka mahali popote waliposikia kuwa Yesu yupo.
Ekegusii: bakaminyoka, bagaetanana ense eria yonsi, bagachaaka kobogoria abarwaire bare ase amarere abo, bakagenda kera aase baigwete ng’a nao are.

English: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.
Kiswahili: Kila mahali Yesu alipokwenda, iwe vijijini, mijini au mashambani, watu waliwaweka wagonjwa wao masokoni. Wakamwomba awaruhusu hao wagonjwa waguse japo upindo wa vazi lake. Nao wote waliomgusa waliponywa.
Ekegusii: Kera aase are kogenda ase ebinyoro, gose emechie, gose emegondo, bakabeeka abarwaire ase chichiiro, bakamosorora ng’a abae ribaga bakune nonya nomokoba bw’eanga yaye; na abwo bonsi abamokunete bakagwena.

English: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo na baadhi ya walimu wa sheria waliokuwa wametoka Yerusalemu wakakusanyika mbele ya Yesu.
Ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai na abande ase aborokia b’amariiko barwete Yerusalemu, bagasangererekana asare.

English: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
Kiswahili: Wakawaona baadhi ya wanafunzi wake wakila chakula kwa mikono iliyo najisi, yaani, bila kunawa kama ilivyotakiwa na sheria ya dini ya Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Bakarora abande baborokigwa baye bakoragera namaboko are neriko, engencho yaye ataisabiri.

English: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
Kiswahili: (Kwa kuwa Mafarisayo na Wayahudi wote hawali chakula pasipo kunawa kwa kufuata desturi za wazee wao.
