Ekegusii: (Inaki Abafarisai na Abayahudi bonsi tibakoragera ritang’ani bataraisaba amaboko. Igo babwatetie engencho y’abagaaka babo.

English: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)
Kiswahili: Wanapotoka sokoni hawawezi kula pasipo kunawa. Pia kuna desturi nyingine nyingi wanazofuata kama vile jinsi ya kuosha vikombe, vyungu na vyombo vya shaba.)
Ekegusii: Naende kobakorwa echiiro, tibakoria batesibetie. Naende nchire chingencho chinde babwate buna ogosibia ebikombe ne chinyongo, na ebinto bie chitaai.)

English: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wale Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakamuuliza Yesu, “Mbona wanafunzi wako hawafuati desturi za wazee, na badala yake wanakula kwa mikono najisi?”
Ekegusii: Bono Abafarisai baria na aborokia b’amariiko bakabooria Yeso, “Nase ki aborokigwa bao batari kobwata chingencho chi’abagaaka, korende bakoragera namaboko are neriko?”

English: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nabii Isaya alisema ukweli alipotabiri juu yenu, ninyi wanafiki. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “ ‘Watu hawa huniheshimu kwa midomo yao, lakini mioyo yao iko mbali nami.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia Isaya nigo abaanete buya igoro yaino, inwe abang’ainereria, buna eriikire; Abanto aba nigo bansigete ase ebikoba biabo igoro, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa ase ’nde.

English: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
Kiswahili: Huniabudu bure, nayo mafundisho yao ni maagizo ya wanadamu tu.’
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagonsasiima ogosasiima kwa bosa, bakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiiko a Mwanyabaanto oka.

English: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
Kiswahili: Ninyi mmeziacha amri za Mungu na kushika desturi za watu.”
Ekegusii: Igo mogotiga richiiko ria Nyasae, mwabwata chingencho chia Mwanyabaanto.

English: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.
Kiswahili: Naye akawaambia, “Ninyi mnayo njia nzuri ya kukataa amri za Mungu ili mpate kuyashika mapokeo yenu!
Ekegusii: Yeso akagenderera kobateebia, “Mwangire richiiko ria Nyasae ng’a monyare kobwata chingencho chiaino.

English: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, Mose alisema, ‘Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,’ na, ‘Yeyote amtukanaye baba yake au mama yake, na auawe.’
Ekegusii: Inaki Musa nigo ateebete: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng’ina, ogokwa nakwe.

English: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi mwafundisha kwamba mtu akimwambia baba yake au mama yake, ‘Kile ambacho ningeweza kukusaidia ni Korbani’ (yaani kimewekwa wakfu kwa Mungu),
Ekegusii: Korende inwe moteeba: Omonto karateebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa ase ’nde nakio Korbani (engencho yaye: Ebiarurwe ase Nyasae) —

English: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,
Kiswahili: basi hawajibiki tena kumsaidia baba yake au mama yake.
Ekegusii: timori komotiga naende amokorere ise gose ng’ina ring’ana rinde.

English: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hiyo ninyi mnabatilisha neno la Mungu kwa mapokeo yenu mliyojiwekea. Nanyi mnafanya mambo mengi ya aina hiyo.”
Ekegusii: Igo mogosaria ring’ana ria Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino chia kare. Naende amange mwakorire mware koenana omogwekano bw’ayio.”

English: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaita tena ule umati wa watu, akawaambia, “Nisikilizeni, kila mmoja wenu na mwelewe jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria omoganda naende, akayoteebia, “Nyigwe mwensi, naende manya:

English: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
Kiswahili: Hakuna kitu kinachomwingia mtu kimtiacho unajisi, lakini kile kimtokacho ndicho kimtiacho unajisi.
Ekegusii: Tari egento kere isiko y’omonto, na gekomosoa, keranyare komobekera ogotacheneka, korende ebikorwa ase omonto nabio bikomobekera ogotacheneka.

English: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote ana masikio ya kusikia na asikie.”
Ekegusii: Omonto kare namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”

English: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
Kiswahili: Akiisha kuuacha ule umati wa watu na kuingia ndani, wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza maana ya mfano ule.
Ekegusii: Goika agachia gosoa nyomba, gatigire omoganda, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria amang’ana y’omobayeeno oria.

English: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Je, hata nanyi hamwelewi? Je, hamfahamu kwamba kitu kimwingiacho mtu hakimtii unajisi?
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nonya ninwe timori nobong’aini? Timomanyeti ng’a kera egento kere isiko y’omonto gokeramosoe, tigekonyara komobekera ogotacheneka,

English: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”
Kiswahili: Mtu akila kitu hakiingii moyoni mwake bali tumboni, na baadaye hutolewa nje ya mwili wake.” (Kwa kusema hivi, Yesu alivihalalisha vyakula vyote kuwa ni “safi.”)
Ekegusii: ekiagera tigekomosoa enkoro, otatiga ase enda yoka, erio kiagwa kebara?” (Ase ogoteeba igo, osibirie chindagera chionsi.)

English: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Kile kimtokacho mtu ndicho kimtiacho unajisi.
Ekegusii: Akabora “Ekegosoka korwa ase omonto nakio gekomobekera ogotacheneka.

English: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kutoka ndani ya moyo wa mtu hutoka mawazo mabaya, uasherati, wizi, uuaji, uzinzi,
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ime ase chinkoro chi’ abanto nigo bikorwao ebirengererio ebibe, obonyaka, oboibi, oboiti, obotomani,

English: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
Kiswahili: tamaa mbaya, uovu, udanganyifu, ufisadi, wivu, matukano, kiburi na upumbavu.
Ekegusii: okogania okobe, obobe, obong’ainereria, oboenenu, ribero, oborami, obwerori, oboriri.

English: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”
Kiswahili: Maovu haya yote hutoka ndani ya mtu, nayo ndiyo yamtiayo mtu unajisi.”
Ekegusii: Aya onsi amabe nigo akorwa ime, naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka.”

English: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akaondoka hapo akaenda sehemu za Tiro. Akaingia katika nyumba moja, naye hakutaka mtu yeyote ajue kwamba yuko humo. Lakini hakuweza kujificha.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda goika omochie o Turo. Agasoa ase enyomba, akarigia tamanyekana na monto, korende tanyara kobiseka.

English: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
Kiswahili: Mara mwanamke mmoja, ambaye binti yake mdogo alikuwa na pepo mchafu, akaja na kumpigia magoti miguuni pake.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo omokungu oyomo, omwana oye enyaroka obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi, akaigwa amang’ana aye, agacha akamogwera ase amagoro aye.

English: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
Kiswahili: Basi huyo mwanamke alikuwa Myunani, aliyezaliwa Foinike ya Siria. Akamsihi Yesu amtoe binti yake huyo pepo mchafu.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria n’Omogiriki orenge, egesaku kiaye n’Omosurofenisia. Akamosaba amosererie ekerecha korwa ase enyaroka yaye.

English: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Waache watoto washibe kwanza, kwa maana si vyema kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang’ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria endagera y’abana, gotugutera chisese.”

English: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mwanamke akamjibu, “Bwana, hata mbwa walio chini ya meza hula makombo ya chakula cha watoto.”
Ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Nab’Omonene, nonya nechisese nyaro ye chimesa nigo chikoria amatori y’abana.”

English: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamjibu, “Kwa sababu ya jibu lako, nenda zako nyumbani; yule pepo mchafu amemtoka binti yako.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ase engencho ye ring’ana eri, genda bwoo, ekerecha kiarure ase enyaroka yao.”

English: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
Kiswahili: Akaenda zake nyumbani akamkuta binti yake amelala kitandani, yule pepo mchafu akiwa amemtoka.
Ekegusii: Akagenda mwaye, akanyora omwana oria bwareirie borere, na ekerecha keria kiamorure.

English: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akaondoka sehemu za Tiro, akapita katikati ya Sidoni, hadi Bahari ya Galilaya na kuingia eneo la Dekapoli.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarua agwo ase ensemo ya Turo, agaeta gati‐gati ya Sidoni, akagenda goika enyancha ya Galili, egati y’ensemo ya Dekapoli.

English: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
Kiswahili: Huko, watu wakamletea Yesu mtu mmoja kiziwi, ambaye pia alikuwa na kigugumizi, wakamwomba aweke mkono wake juu ya huyo mtu na amponye.
Ekegusii: Bakamorentera omonto ore omotiino, naende nigo are gotutura kagokwana; bagasorora Yeso abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro asare.

English: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.
Kiswahili: Baadaye Yesu akampeleka yule kiziwi kando mbali na watu, Yesu akatia vidole vyake masikioni mwa yule mtu. Kisha akatema mate na kuugusa ulimi wa yule mtu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamwatanana korwa ase omoganda bobisi, akabeeka ebiara biaye ase amato aye, agatwa amate, akamokuna oromeme.

English: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akatazama mbinguni, akavuta hewa ndani kwa nguvu akamwambia, “Efatha!” (yaani, “Funguka!”)
Ekegusii: Erio akarigereria gochia igoro, agaita egekoe, akamoteebia, “Efatha,” engencho yaye, “Igoreka.”

English: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
Kiswahili: Mara masikio yake yakafunguka na ulimi wake ukaachiliwa, akaanza kuongea sawasawa.
Ekegusii: Bwango amato aye agatiinoka, egesibo ki’oromeme rwaye gekororoba, agakwana buya.

English: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaamuru wasimwambie mtu yeyote habari hizi. Lakini kadiri alivyowazuia, ndivyo walivyozidi kutangaza kwa bidii.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabatianera tibateebia monto, korende buna amentete kobakania, naboigo bamentete koraria amang’ana aya.

English: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
Kiswahili: Walistaajabu mno. Wakasema, “Amefanya mambo yote vizuri mno! Amewawezesha viziwi wasikie na bubu waseme!”
Ekegusii: Abanto bagakumia mono kobua, bakaboora, “Okorire onsi buya. Abarenge emetiino obatiinoire, na abarenge amamama bakwane.”

English: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo, umati mkubwa wa watu ulikusanyika tena. Kwa kuwa walikuwa hawana chakula, Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na barabwo tibarenge na gento bakoria, Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia,

English: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.
Kiswahili: “Ninauhurumia huu umati wa watu, kwa sababu sasa wamekuwa nami kwa muda wa siku tatu na hawana chakula.
Ekegusii: “Naroreire abanto aba amaabera, ekiagera barabwo babeire amatuko atato baikaransete amo nainche batari na gento bakoria;

English: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
Kiswahili: Nikiwaaga waende nyumbani bila kula, watazimia njiani kwa sababu baadhi yao wametoka mbali.”
Ekegusii: ninsa koa abanto aba ribaga bagende chinsobo n’enchara, nabagoye ’nchera, na abande ase egati yabo ng’are barwete.”

English: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamjibu, “Lakini hapa nyikani tutapata wapi mikate ya kutosha kuwalisha?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoiraneria, “Inaki omonto aranyare koigotia abanto aba, na aiga nerooro?”

English: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Mna mikate mingapi?” Wakajibu, “Tuna mikate saba.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere.”

English: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia watu waketi chini. Akiisha kuichukua mikate saba na kushukuru, akaimega na kuwapa wanafunzi wake ili wawagawie watu. Wanafunzi wake wakafanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Agachiika omoganda oikaranse inse, akabogoria emegati eria etano na ebere. Kayesesenirie, akayesamunyora, akaa aborokigwa baye bayebagere abanto, na barabwo bakayegagera omoganda.

English: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa pia na visamaki vichache, Yesu akavibariki, akawaamuru wanafunzi wake wawagawie watu.
Ekegusii: Igo barenge ne chinswe chinsinini nke igo. Gachisesenirie, akabora, “Nechi bagagere”!

English: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
Kiswahili: Wale watu walikula na kutosheka. Baadaye wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu saba.
Ekegusii: Bakaria, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere.

English: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
Kiswahili: Watu waliokula walikuwa wapata 4,000. Akiisha kuwaaga,
Ekegusii: Na barabwo nigo barenge ang’e chilifu inye (4,000).

English: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
Kiswahili: aliingia kwenye mashua pamoja na wanafunzi wake, akaenda sehemu za Dalmanutha.
Ekegusii: Akabaa ribaga bagende, na erio bwango akariina obwato amo naborokigwa baye, akagenda chinsemo chia Dalumanuta.

English: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo wakaja, wakaanza kumhoji Yesu. Ili kumtega, wakamwomba awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Abafarisai bakaoroka, bagachaaka koamererania na Yeso, bakarigia aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro, bakomoteema.

English: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
Kiswahili: Akahuzunika moyoni, akawaambia, “Kwa nini kizazi hiki kinataka ishara? Amin nawaambieni, hakitapewa ishara yoyote.”
Ekegusii: Agaichana ase omoika oye, akabora, “Inaki ekegori eke gekorigia egekone? Ekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tigekoegwa egekone buna eke.”

English: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaacha, akarudi kwenye mashua, akavuka hadi ngʼambo.
Ekegusii: Akabatiga, akariina obwato naende, akamboka ng’umbu.

English: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi walikuwa wamesahau kuchukua mikate ya kutosha. Walikuwa na mkate mmoja tu kwenye mashua.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakeeba koirana emegati; nonya nase obwato tibarenge na gento, otatiga omogati oyomo bwoka.

English: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaonya: “Jihadharini na chachu ya Mafarisayo na ya Herode.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabachiika, akabora, “Rigereria, mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na ememera ya Herode.”

English: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
Kiswahili: Wakajadiliana wao kwa wao, na kusema, “Anasema hivi kwa sababu hatukuleta mikate.”
Ekegusii: Bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakobora, “Nigo agokwana igo ase engencho totari n’emegati.”

English: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?
Kiswahili: Yesu, akifahamu majadiliano yao, akawauliza: “Mbona mnajadiliana kuhusu kutokuwa na mikate? Je, bado hamtambui wala hamwelewi? Je, mbona mioyo yenu ni migumu kiasi hicho?
Ekegusii: Yeso akamanya aya, akabateebia, “Inaki mokoborania, ekiagera motari nemegati? Timokoinyora gose timokomanya? Chinkoro chiaino nigo chire chinkong’u goika bono?

English: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
Kiswahili: Je, mna macho lakini mnashindwa kuona, na mna masikio lakini mnashindwa kusikia? Je, hamkumbuki?
Ekegusii: ’More namaiso, ko timori korora? ’More namato, ko timori koigwa? Gose timoinyoreti?

English: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
Kiswahili: Nilipoimega ile mikate mitano kuwalisha watu 5,000, mlikusanya vikapu vingapi vilivyojaa vya masazo?” Wakamjibu, “Kumi na viwili.”
Ekegusii: Ekero nasamunyorete emegati eria etano nkaa baria chilifu isano, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangererete biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamoteebia, “Ikomi na bibere.”

English: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”
Kiswahili: “Je, nilipoimega ile mikate saba kuwalisha watu 4,000, mlikusanya vikapu vingapi vilivyojaa vya masazo?” Wakamjibu, “Saba.”
Ekegusii: “Na eria etano na ebere nkaa baria chilifu inye, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamoteebia, “Mbitano na bibere.”

English: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo akawauliza, “Je, bado hamwelewi?”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki motaramanya?”

English: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.
Kiswahili: Wakafika Bethsaida na baadhi ya watu wakamleta mtu mmoja kipofu wakamsihi Yesu amguse.
Ekegusii: Bagaika Bethisaida. Bakarentera Yeso omonto omouko, bakamosorora amokune.

English: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamshika mkono huyo kipofu akampeleka nje ya kijiji. Baada ya kuyatemea mate macho ya yule kipofu na kumwekea mikono, Yesu akamuuliza, “Unaona chochote?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabwata omouko oria okoboko, akamoira isiko y’ekenyoro, Kamotwereire amate ase amaiso, akabeeka amaboko aye igoro asare, akamobooria, “Kwarorire gento?”

English: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”
Kiswahili: Yule kipofu akaangalia, akasema, “Ninaona watu, wanaonekana kama miti inayotembea.”
Ekegusii: Omouko oria akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Narorire abanto, ko nigo banga buna emete bakogenda.”

English: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwekea tena mikono machoni. Kisha macho yake yakafunguka, kuona kwake kukarejea naye akaona kila kitu dhahiri.
Ekegusii: Erio naende Yeso akabeeka amaboko aye igoro ase amaiso aye. Omouko oria akarigereria mono, akagwena, akarora ebinto bionsi buya.

English: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamuaga aende nyumbani kwake, akimwambia, “Hata kijijini usiingie.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda bwoo, tosoa nonya nekenyoro!”

English: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”
Kiswahili: Yesu na wanafunzi wake wakaondoka kwenda katika vijiji vya Kaisaria-Filipi. Walipokuwa njiani, Yesu akawauliza, “Watu husema mimi ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Yeso agasoka amo naborokigwa baye, bakagenda ebinyoro bia Kaisaria Filipi. Ekero baare nchera akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ning’o?”

English: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Baadhi husema wewe ni Yohana Mbatizaji, wengine husema ni Eliya, na bado wengine husema wewe ni mmojawapo wa manabii.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yohana Omobatisi; na abande: Elija; na abande: Oyomo ase ababani.”

English: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza, “Je, ninyi mnasema mimi ni nani?” Petro akajibu, “Wewe ndiwe Kristo.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nainwe nigo mokobora ng’a ninche ng’o?” Petero akamoiraneria, “Aye naye Kristo.”

English: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaonya wasimwambie mtu yeyote habari zake.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabatianera tibateebia monto amanya amang’ana aye.

English: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akaanza kuwafundisha wanafunzi wake kuwa Mwana wa Adamu lazima atapata mateso mengi na kukataliwa na wazee, viongozi wa makuhani, na walimu wa sheria, na kwamba itampasa auawe lakini baada ya siku tatu afufuke.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachaaka koborokereria, ng’a negwenerete Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na goitwa, na magega y’amatuko atato nabooke.

English: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.
Kiswahili: Aliyasema haya waziwazi, ndipo Petro akamchukua kando na akaanza kumkemea.
Ekegusii: Agakwana amang’ana aya maiso marore. Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaaka komokania.

English: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu alipogeuka na kuwaangalia wanafunzi wake, akamkemea Petro. Akasema, “Rudi nyuma yangu, Shetani! Moyo wako hauwazi yaliyo ya Mungu, bali ya wanadamu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akarigereria aborokigwa baye, agatogonyera Petero, akabora, “Irana magega y’ane Saitani, ekiagera tori ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase Mwanyabaanto.”

English: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akauita ule umati wa watu pamoja na wanafunzi wake, akasema, “Mtu yeyote akitaka kunifuata, ni lazima ajikane mwenyewe, auchukue msalaba wake, anifuate.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria omoganda na aborokigwa baye, akabateebia, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye, antunyane.

English: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu na kwa ajili ya Injili atayaokoa.
Ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi orarigie koegera obogima bwaye, oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho y’ane, na ase engencho y’enchiri, oyio naboegere.

English: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?
Kiswahili: Je, itamfaidi nini mtu kuupata ulimwengu wote, lakini akayapoteza maisha yake?
Ekegusii: Ninki eragwenere omonto konyora ense yonsi, ko asirie omoyo oye?

English: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
Kiswahili: Au mtu atatoa nini badala ya nafsi yake?
Ekegusii: Gose inki omonto ararue ribaga ri’omoyo oye?

English: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote akinionea aibu mimi na maneno yangu katika kizazi hiki cha uzinzi na dhambi, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamwonea aibu wakati atakapokuja katika utukufu wa Baba yake pamoja na malaika watakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Inaki oyio oranyare kondorera obosooku inche, na amang’ana aane, ase ekegori eke ki’obotomani na ebibe, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto namororere obosooku ere, ekero agocha n’obonene bwa Ise amo nabamalaika abachenu.”

English: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akaendelea kuwaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, kuna watu waliosimama hapa ambao hawataonja mauti kabla ya kuuona Ufalme wa Mungu ukija kwa nguvu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akagenderera kobateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Mbare abanto bande ase aba bateneine aiga, abataetere amakweri goika barorire oborwoti bwa Nyasae bogocha ne chinguru.”

English: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku sita, Yesu akawachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, akawapeleka juu ya mlima mrefu, mahali walipokuwa faraghani. Huko, Yesu akageuka sura mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Na magega ase amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana, ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka, akaonchoka ekieni kiaye ase bare.

English: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
Kiswahili: Mavazi yake yakawa na weupe wa kuzima macho, meupe kuliko ambavyo mtu yeyote duniani angaliweza kuyangʼarisha.
Ekegusii: Chianga chiaye chikameka‐meka, chikaba chindabu mono, buna omosibia onde ase ense atanyare gochisibia chibe chindabu.

English: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
Kiswahili: Mose na Eliya wakawatokea, wakawa wanazungumza na Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bakaorokerwa na Elija amo na Musa; na barabwo nigo barenge gokwana na Yeso.

English: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
Kiswahili: Petro akamwambia Yesu, “Rabi, ni vyema sisi tukae hapa. Turuhusu tujenge vibanda vitatu: kimoja chako, kingine cha Mose na kingine cha Eliya.”
Ekegusii: Petero agateebia Yeso, “Omwarimu, mbuya intwe koba aiga, tiga tokore ebigutu bitato: ekemo ekiao, ekemo kia Musa, na ekemo ki’Elija.”

English: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
Kiswahili: Petro hakujua aseme nini kwa maana yeye na wenzake walikuwa wameogopa sana.
Ekegusii: Inaki tamanyete eki agokwana, ekiagera babete nomoondoko omonene.

English: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo pakatokea wingu, likawafunika, nayo sauti kutoka lile wingu ikasema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa. Msikieni yeye.”
Ekegusii: Korende riire rigaacha rikababisia; eriogi rikarwa ase riire riria, rigateeba, “Oyo n’Omwana one omwanchwa, moigwere ere!”

English: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.
Kiswahili: Mara walipotazama huku na huku, hawakuona tena mtu mwingine yeyote pamoja nao isipokuwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Erio bwango kobarigereirie aria na aaria, tibarora monto onde, otatiga Yeso bweka amo nabarabwo.

English: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakishuka kutoka mlimani, Yesu akawakataza wasimwambie mtu yeyote mambo waliyoona, mpaka Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuwa amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Kabagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa akabakania tibatorera monto ayabaroche, goika Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto kabokire korwa ase abakuure.

English: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
Kiswahili: Wakalihifadhi jambo hilo wao wenyewe, lakini wakawa wanajiuliza, “Huku kufufuka kwa wafu maana yake nini?”
Ekegusii: Bakabwata ring’ana riria, bakaboorania barabwo ase barabwo, ng’a okoboka korwa ase abakuure, engencho yaye ninki.

English: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini walimu wa sheria husema kwamba ni lazima Eliya aje kwanza?”
Ekegusii: Bakabooria Yeso, “Nase ki aborokia b’amariiko bagoteeba ng’a negwenerete Elija ache ritang’ani?”

English: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ni kweli, Eliya yuaja kwanza ili kutengeneza mambo yote. Mbona basi imeandikwa kwamba Mwana wa Adamu ni lazima ateseke sana na kudharauliwa?
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nekeene Elija ogocha ritang’ani, na koroisia onsi; korende amo naya, ekiagera ariikire ng’a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nachandwe namange na gochaaywa?

English: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ninawaambia, Eliya amekwisha kuja, nao wakamtendea walivyopenda, kama ilivyoandikwa kumhusu yeye.”
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie: Elija oikire gocha, na barabwo bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie, buna ariikeretwe.”

English: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.
Kiswahili: Walipowafikia wale wanafunzi wengine, wakawakuta wamezungukwa na umati mkubwa wa watu na baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakibishana nao.
Ekegusii: Kobaikire ase aborokigwa bande, bakarora omoganda omonene obaetanaine; aborokia b’amariiko bakaengererania nabarabwo.

English: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.
Kiswahili: Mara wale watu walipomwona Yesu, wakastaajabu sana, wakamkimbilia ili kumsalimu.
Ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi, ogachia korora Yeso, ogakumia mono; abwo bakamochiera bwango, bakamokwania.

English: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Mnabishana nao kuhusu nini?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Ninki mokoengererania nabarabwo?”

English: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja miongoni mwa ule umati wa watu akajibu, “Mwalimu, nilimleta kwako mwanangu ambaye ana pepo mchafu anayemfanya asiweze kuongea.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase omoganda akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, namorenta omomura one ase ore, obwatire nekerecha kemokorete rimama;

English: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”
Kiswahili: Kila mara huyo pepo mchafu ampagaapo mwanangu, humwangusha chini na kumfanya atokwe povu mdomoni na kusaga meno, kisha mwili wake hukauka. Niliwaomba wanafunzi wako wamtoe huyo pepo mchafu, lakini hawakuweza.”
Ekegusii: ekero kiamobokire nigo gekomogaragaria inse, asokia risombogoku, na koriania amaino; ase ayio chinguru chiaye chisira. Ngakwana naborokigwa bao bageserie, tibanyara.”

English: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Enyi kizazi kisicho na imani! Nitakuwa pamoja nanyi mpaka lini? Nitawavumilia mpaka lini? Mleteni mvulana kwangu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, nimbe nainwe goika ririri? Nindemererie nainwe goika ririri? Mondetere aa!”

English: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.
Kiswahili: Nao wakamleta yule mvulana. Yule pepo mchafu alipomwona Yesu, mara akamtia yule mvulana kifafa, akaanguka, akagaagaa chini huku akitokwa na povu kinywani.
Ekegusii: Bakamorenta asare. Ekero kiarora Yeso, bwango ekerecha keria gekaigusia omomura oria, na ere akagwa inse akegaragaria, agasokia risombogoku.

English: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamuuliza baba yake, “Mwanao amekuwa katika hali hii tangu lini?” Akamjibu, “Tangu utoto wake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaboria ise, “Nkorwa kero ki anyoretwe naya?” Agateeba, “Nkorwa obwana bwaye.

English: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
Kiswahili: Mara kwa mara huyo pepo mchafu amekuwa akimwangusha kwenye moto au kwenye maji ili kumwangamiza. Lakini kama unaweza kufanya jambo lolote, tafadhali tuhurumie utusaidie.”
Ekegusii: Ara aange kemoruta ase omorero na ase amaache, erinde kemosirie, korende koranyare gokora ring’ana, tororere amaabera, otokonye.”

English: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Kama ukiweza kuamini, yote yawezekana kwake yeye aaminiye.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Koranyare! Onsi nigo akonyarekana asare ere oyobwegenire.”

English: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
Kiswahili: Mara baba yake yule mvulana akapiga kelele akisema, “Ninaamini. Nisaidie kutokuamini kwangu!”
Ekegusii: Bwango ise omwana oria agaaka eriogi, akarera, akabora, “Negenire, korende okwegena kwane n’ogoke nkoonye!”

English: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoona kwamba umati wa watu unakusanyika pamoja mbio, akamkemea yule pepo mchafu, akimwambia, “Wewe pepo bubu na kiziwi, nakuamuru umtoke, wala usimwingie tena!”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora ng’a omoganda ngosangererekana ore bwango, agakania ekerecha keria ki’eubi, akageteebia, “Aye ekerecha rimama na egetiino, inche nagochiikire, morwe, tomoiranera naende!”

English: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
Kiswahili: Yule pepo mchafu akiisha kupiga kelele, akamtia kifafa kwa nguvu, na akamtoka. Yule mvulana alikuwa kama maiti, hivyo watu wengi wakasema, “Amekufa.”
Ekegusii: Erio gekarera, gekamogaragaria mono gekamorwa. Omwana oria akaba buna oyokuure, goika abange bakaboora, “Okuure.”

English: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akamshika mkono, akamwinua, naye akasimama.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamobwata okoboko, akamoimokia, na ere agatenena.

English: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu kuingia ndani ya nyumba, wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza wakiwa peke yao, “Mbona sisi hatukuweza kumtoa huyo pepo mchafu?”
Ekegusii: Gasoire ase enyomba, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria bobisi, “Inaki intwe totanyara kogeseria?”

English: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Hali hii haiwezi kutoka isipokuwa kwa kuomba na kufunga.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekerecha kenga buna eke tigekonyara korwa ase ring’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ase ogosaba.”

English: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka huko, wakapitia Galilaya. Yesu hakutaka mtu yeyote afahamu mahali walipo,
Ekegusii: Yeso akarua aria, na’borokigwa baye bagaeta gati‐gati ya Galili; Yeso tancha omonto amanye ase are,

English: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
Kiswahili: kwa maana alikuwa anawafundisha wanafunzi wake. Akawaambia, “Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa watu. Nao watamuua, lakini siku tatu baada ya kuuawa atafufuka.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera arenge kworokereria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia ng’a, “Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are kobekwa ase amaboko y’ abanto, na barabwo nabamoite, na ekero aitirwe naboke magega y’amatuko atato.”

English: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao hawakuelewa kile alimaanisha, nao waliogopa kumuuliza maana yake.
Ekegusii: Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, bakairoka komoboria.

English: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
Kiswahili: Basi wakafika Kapernaumu na baada ya kuingia nyumbani akawauliza, “Mlikuwa mnabishana nini kule njiani?”
Ekegusii: Bagaika Kapernaumu. Ekero arenge nyomba ime, Yeso akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Ninki mware koamererania inchera?”

English: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakumjibu, kwa sababu njiani walikuwa wakibishana kuhusu nani miongoni mwao alikuwa mkuu zaidi ya wote.
Ekegusii: Bagakira, ekiagera ekero barenge inchera baare koamererania barabwo ase barabwo ning’o ore omonene kobua abande.

English: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
Kiswahili: Akaketi chini, akawaita wote kumi na wawili, akawaambia: “Kama mtu yeyote akitaka kuwa wa kwanza, hana budi kuwa wa mwisho na mtumishi wa wote.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agaikaransa inse, akarangeria baria ikomi na babere, akabateebia, “Omonto origetie koba oyo bw’eritang’ani nabe oyo bw’omoerio kobua bonsi, na boigo omosomba o bonsi.”

English: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
Kiswahili: Kisha akamchukua mtoto mdogo, akamsimamisha katikati yao. Akamkumbatia, akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Akabogoria omwana, akamotenenia gati‐gati yaabo, akamoagata, akabateebia,

English: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote amkaribishaye mmoja wa hawa watoto wadogo kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi. Naye anikaribishaye mimi, amkaribisha Baba yangu aliyenituma.”
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, tanyancheti inche, korende ere oyontomete.”

English: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”
Kiswahili: Yohana akamwambia, “Mwalimu, tumemwona mtu akitoa pepo wachafu kwa jina lako, nasi tukamkataza, kwa sababu yeye si mmoja wetu.”
Ekegusii: Yohana akamoteebia, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao; tokamokania, ekiagera tare gototunyana intwe.”

English: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Msimkataze, kwa kuwa hakuna yeyote atendaye miujiza kwa Jina langu ambaye baada ya kitambo kidogo aweza kunena lolote baya dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Timomokania, ekiagera monto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ase erieta riane, anyare erio bwango gonteeba bobe,

English: For whoever is not against us is on our side.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeyote asiye kinyume chetu, yuko upande wetu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaito, oyio nenseemo yaito are.

English: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, yeyote awapaye ninyi kikombe cha maji kwa Jina langu kwa sababu ninyi ni mali ya Kristo, hakika hataikosa thawabu yake.”
Ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi orabae inwe amaache negekombe ase erieta riane, ekiagera inwe more abanto ba Kristo, nekeene nabateebirie: Tagosiria eng’eria yaye nonya ng’ake.

English: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.
Kiswahili: “Kama mtu yeyote akimsababisha mmojawapo wa wadogo hawa wanaoniamini kutenda dhambi, ingekuwa bora kwake afungiwe jiwe kubwa la kusagia shingoni mwake, na kutoswa baharini.
Ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oragere oyomo bw’aba abake abanyegenete akore ebibe, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, na gotugutwa ime y’enyancha.

English: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,
Kiswahili: Kama mkono wako ukikusababisha kutenda dhambi, ukate. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa na mkono mmoja, kuliko kuwa na mikono miwili lakini ukaingia jehanamu, mahali ambako moto hauzimiki.
Ekegusii: Na onye okoboko kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore ekerema, kobua koba namaboko abere, na kogenda Yeanamu ase omorero o kare na kare oyo otakorimeka,

English: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
Kiswahili: Mahali ambako funza wake hawafi wala moto wake hauzimiki.
Ekegusii: naboigo amakonde abo tagokwa.

English: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—
Kiswahili: Kama mguu wako ukikusababisha kutenda dhambi, ukate. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa kiwete, kuliko kuwa na miguu miwili lakini ukaingia jehanamu.
Ekegusii: Na onye okogoro kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore egesegora, kobua koba n’amagoro abere, na gotugutwa Yeanamu ase omorero o kare na kare

English: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
Kiswahili: Mahali ambako funza wake hawafi wala moto hauzimiki.
Ekegusii: aase amakonde abo atagokwa, na omorero otakorimeka.

English: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,
Kiswahili: Nalo jicho lako likikusababisha kutenda dhambi, lingʼoe. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu ukiwa na jicho moja, kuliko kuwa na macho mawili lakini ukatupwa jehanamu,
Ekegusii: Na onye neriso riao rikogera okore ebibe, orirusie oritugute; mbuya gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae kore egetong’o, kobua koba namaiso abere, na gotugutwa Yeanamu ase omorero o kare na kare,

English: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
Kiswahili: mahali ambako “ ‘funza wake hawafi, wala moto wake hauzimiki.’
Ekegusii: aase amakonde abo atagokwa na omorero otakorimeka.

English: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja atatiwa chumvi kwa moto.
Ekegusii: “Inaki kera omonto nabekwe omoonyo ase omorero.

English: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
Kiswahili: “Chumvi ni nzuri, lakini ikipoteza ladha yake utaifanyaje ili iweze kukolea tena? Mwe na chumvi ndani yenu, mkaishi kwa amani, kila mmoja na mwenzake.”
Ekegusii: Omoonyo nomuya, korende omonyoo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki morayobeke bwanse? Mobe n’omoonyo ime ase more, momenye ase omorembe inwe ase inwe.”

English: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaondoka huko, akavuka Mto Yordani, akaenda sehemu za Uyahudi. Umati mkubwa wa watu ukaenda kwake tena, naye kama ilivyokuwa desturi yake, akawafundisha.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaimoka korwa agwo, agaika chimbebe chia Boyahudi, ng’umbu ya Yorodani. Abanto abange bakamosangererekanera naende; akaborokereria aroro, buna anarete botambe.

English: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakaja ili kumjaribu kwa kumuuliza, “Je, ni halali mtu kumwacha mke wake?”
Ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamobooria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto gotiga mok’aye?” Bakamoteema.

English: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, Mose aliwaamuru nini?”
Ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Inki Musa abachiigete?”

English: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”
Kiswahili: Wakajibu, “Mose aliruhusu kwamba mume anaweza kumwandikia mkewe hati ya talaka na kumwacha.”
Ekegusii: Bagateeba, “Musa nigo aruete ribaga koriika riruube ri’ogotigana, na komotiga.”

English: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mose aliwaandikia sheria hiyo kwa sababu ya ugumu wa mioyo yenu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiaino nakio kiagerete abariikerete ogochika oko.

English: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
Kiswahili: Lakini tangu mwanzo wa uumbaji, ‘Mungu aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Korende korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa gw’ense Nyasae nigo atongete omosacha na omokungu.

English: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake na kuambatana na mkewe, na hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.’
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio omonto natige ise na ng’ina, abwatane na mok’aye,

English: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hawatakuwa wawili tena, bali mwili mmoja.
Ekegusii: na abwo babere nigo barabe omobere oyomo. Ase igo tibakoba babere naende, korende omobere oyomo.

English: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”
Kiswahili: Basi, alichokiunganisha Mungu, mwanadamu asikitenganishe.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, Mwanyabaanto tabiatanana.”

English: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa tena ndani ya nyumba, wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza kuhusu jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Naende nyomba ime aborokigwa bakabooria Yeso engencho ye ring’ana erio.

English: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Mtu yeyote amwachaye mkewe na kuoa mke mwingine, anazini naye.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Kera omonto oratige mok’aye, na kunyuoma oyonde, otomanire igoro asare:

English: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”
Kiswahili: Naye mwanamke amwachaye mumewe na kuolewa na mume mwingine, anazini.”
Ekegusii: na omokungu karatige omosacha oye, na konyuomwa nomonto onde, nere otomanire.”

English: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.
Kiswahili: Watu walikuwa wakimletea Yesu watoto wadogo ili awaguse, lakini wanafunzi wake wakawakemea.
Ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana abake, erinde anyare kobakuna; aborokigwa baye bakabatanga.

English: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoona yaliyokuwa yakitukia, akachukizwa. Akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Waacheni watoto wadogo waje kwangu, wala msiwazuie, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu ni wa wale walio kama hawa.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso agachia korora, akabea mono, akabateebia, “Batige abana abake bache ase ’nde, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oborwoti bwa Nyasae nobwabo

English: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, mtu yeyote asiyeupokea Ufalme wa Mungu kama mtoto mdogo, hatauingia kamwe.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Onde bwensi otanyoreti oborwoti bwa Nyasae buna omwana omoke, takobosoa nonya ng’ake.”

English: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
Kiswahili: Akawachukua watoto mikononi mwake, akawakumbatia, akaweka mikono yake juu yao, akawabariki.
Ekegusii: Akabaimokia, akabaagata ase amaboko aye, akabasesenia, okobeeka amaboko aye igoro ase bare.

English: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa anaondoka, mtu mmoja akamkimbilia, akapiga magoti mbele yake, akamuuliza, “Mwalimu mwema, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achaaka orogendo rwaye kogenda enchera, omonto oyomo agacha bwango, akamotung’amera, akamobooria, “Omworokia omuya, inki ndakore inyare koba nomwando bw’obogima bwa kare na kare?”

English: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mbona unaniita mwema? Hakuna yeyote aliye mwema ila Mungu peke yake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inaki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.

English: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”
Kiswahili: Unazijua amri: ‘Usiue, usizini, usiibe, usishuhudie uongo, usidanganye, waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.’ ”
Ekegusii: Kwamanyire amachiiko: toita, totomana, toiba, toteba oborimo, tong’aina, sika iso na nyoko.”

English: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”
Kiswahili: Akamjibu, “Mwalimu, amri hizi zote nimezishika tangu nikiwa mtoto.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omworokia, ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”

English: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamtazama na kumpenda, akamwambia, “Umepungukiwa na kitu kimoja. Nenda ukauze kila kitu ulicho nacho uwape maskini hizo fedha, nawe utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Kisha njoo, unifuate.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamobeta amaiso, akamwancha, akamoteebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremete; genda, oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi, oe abataka, na aye n’obe nenibo igoro; erio oche ontunyane.”

English: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu aliposikia hayo, akasikitika sana. Akaondoka kwa huzuni kwa sababu alikuwa na mali nyingi.
Ekegusii: Korende ere akanyiria obosio ase ring’ana riria, akagenda n’obororo, ekiagera arenge n’eniibo enyinge.

English: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”
Kiswahili: Yesu akatazama pande zote, akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Itakuwa vigumu sana kwa wenye mali kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu!”
Ekegusii: Yeso akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakashangazwa sana na maneno hayo. Lakini Yesu akawaambia tena, “Wanangu, tazama jinsi ilivyo vigumu kwa wale wanaotumainia mali kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa bagaichana ase amang’ana aya. Yeso akairaneria naende, akabateebia, “Abana, nabe aakong’u ase abasemeretie enibo gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae!

English: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Ni rahisi zaidi kwa ngamia kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kuliko mtu tajirikuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani kobua omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakashangaa sana. Wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Ni nani basi awezaye kuokoka?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagaichana mono, bakaboorania, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

English: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawatazama, akawaambia, “Kwa mwanadamu jambo hili haliwezekani, lakini kwa Mungu sivyo. Mambo yote yanawezekana kwa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabarigereria, akabora, “Ase Mwanyabaanto takonyarekana, korende ase Nyasae taibo, ekiagera onsi nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”

English: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamjibu, “Tazama, tumeacha kila kitu na kukufuata wewe!”
Ekegusii: Petero agachaaka komoteebia, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire.”

English: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, hakuna mtu yeyote aliyeacha nyumba, ndugu wa kiume au wa kike, au mama au baba, au watoto au mashamba kwa ajili yangu na kwa ajili ya Injili,
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Monto onde otigire enyomba, gose bamura bamwabo, gose basubati bamwabo, gose ng’ina, gose ise, gose abana, gose emegondo ase engencho y’ane, gose ase engencho y’enchiri, chinyomba, na bamura bamwabo, na basubati bamwabo, na abang’ina, na abana, na emegondo, ase emechando,

English: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.
Kiswahili: ambaye hatalipwa mara mia katika ulimwengu huu: nyumba, ndugu wa kiume na wa kike, mama na baba na watoto, mashamba pamoja na mateso, kisha uzima wa milele katika ulimwengu ujao.
Ekegusii: ere naegwe ebinge ase chingaki echi chia bono, na ase ense egochi-gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wengi walio wa kwanza watakuwa wa mwisho, na wa mwisho watakuwa wa kwanza.”
Ekegusii: Korende abange abare ab’eritang’ani, ’nababe abamagega; na abamagega babe ab’eritang’ani.”

English: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa njiani wakipanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na Yesu alikuwa ametangulia. Wanafunzi wake walishangaa, nao watu waliowafuata walijawa na hofu. Yesu akawachukua tena wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili kando na kuwaambia yatakayompata.
Ekegusii: Bakaba inchera, bagotiira kogenda Yerusalemu. Yeso nigo arenge obatang’aine, na barabwo bagaichana, na abamotunyanete bakairoka. Naende akaira baria ikomi na babere, agachaaka kobateebia ebirage bi’amang’ana agochia komonyoora,

English: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa kwa viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria. Wao watamhukumu kifo na kumtia mikononi mwa watu wa Mataifa,
Ekegusii: akabora, “Rigereria, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nabekwe ase amaboko y’abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko. Abwo nabamogambie, na bamobeke ase amaboko abanto b’Ebisaku,

English: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”
Kiswahili: ambao watamdhihaki na kumtemea mate, watampiga na kumuua. Siku tatu baadaye atafufuka.”
Ekegusii: na barabwo nabamochecherie, na komoaka chinkini, na komotwera amate, na komoita akwe; magega y’amatuko atato nabooke.”

English: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yakobo na Yohana, wana wa Zebedayo, wakaja kwake na kumwambia, “Mwalimu, tunataka utufanyie lolote tutakalokuomba.”
Ekegusii: Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, bakamochiera, bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, ntorigetie otokorere rinde rionsi toragosabe.”

English: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
Kiswahili: Naye akawaambia, “Je, mwataka niwafanyie jambo gani?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Inki morigetie mbakorere?”

English: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Tupe kukaa mmoja upande wako wa kuume na mwingine upande wako wa kushoto katika utukufu wako.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Otwanchere intwe toikaranse, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okobee, ase obonene bwao.”

English: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi hamjui mnaloliomba. Je, mnaweza kukinywea kikombe ninyweacho mimi, au kubatizwa ubatizo nibatizwao mimi?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Timomanyeti eki mogosaba. Inee! Namonyare konywera egekombe nkonywera inche, na kobatiswa ebatiso inche mbatisire?”

English: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;
Kiswahili: Wakajibu, “Tunaweza.” Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Kikombe nikinyweacho mtakinywea na ubatizo nibatizwao mtabatizwa,
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Ntonyare.” Yeso akabateebia, “Egekombe nkonywera inche imokenywere, na ebatiso ’mbatisire inche imobatiswe,

English: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
Kiswahili: lakini kuketi mkono wangu wa kuume au wa kushoto si juu yangu mimi kuwapa. Nafasi hizi ni kwa ajili ya wale walioandaliwa.”
Ekegusii: korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kw’ane gw’okorio na okoboko nogw’okobee tinkonyara kobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire barariegwe.”

English: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wengine kumi waliposikia hayo, wakaanza kuwakasirikia Yakobo na Yohana.
Ekegusii: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bagachaaka kobea Yakobo na Yohana.

English: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawaita wote pamoja na kuwaambia, “Mnafahamu kuwa wale wanaodhaniwa kuwa watawala wa watu wa Mataifa huwatawala watu kwa nguvu, nao wenye vyeo huonyesha mamlaka yao.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabarangeria, akabateebia, “Mwamanyire ng’a baria baabarirwe koba abagaambi b’ abanto b’Ebisaku nigo bakobagaambera ne chinguru, na abanene babo nigo bakobachiika.

English: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
Kiswahili: Lakini isiwe hivyo kwenu. Badala yake, yeyote anayetaka kuwa mkuu miongoni mwenu hana budi kuwa mtumishi wenu,
Ekegusii: Korende takoba bo ase more. Omonto origetie koba omonene ase more, nabe omokoreri oino.

English: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.
Kiswahili: na yeyote anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza, hana budi kuwa mtumwa wa wote.
Ekegusii: Na omonto orarigie koba oyo bw’eritang’ani ase more, nabe omosomba o bonsi.

English: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hata Mwana wa Adamu hakuja ili kutumikiwa, bali kutumika na kuutoa uhai wake uwe fidia kwa ajili ya wengi.”
Ekegusii: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto tachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y’abange.”

English: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakafika Yeriko. Yesu alipokuwa akiondoka mjini na wanafunzi wake pamoja na umati mkubwa wa watu, kipofu mmoja, jina lake Bartimayo, mwana wa Timayo, alikuwa ameketi kando ya njia akiomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Bagaika Yeriko. Goika Yeso agachia koba okobwatia enchera korwa Yeriko amo naborokigwa baye na omoganda omonene, omwana o Timayo, Baritimayo, oyio orenge omouko, nigo arenge oikaransete enchera ensemo, ogosaba ebiegwa.

English: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
Kiswahili: Aliposikia kuwa ni Yesu wa Nazareti aliyekuwa anapita, akaanza kupaza sauti akisema, “Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”
Ekegusii: Agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso Omonazareti ogoeta, agachaaka goaka eriogi, ogoteeba, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorere amaabera!”

English: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
Kiswahili: Watu wengi wakamkemea, wakamwambia akae kimya, lakini yeye akazidi kupaza sauti, akisema, “Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”
Ekegusii: Abanto abange bakamotogonyera, bakamoteebia ng’a anyare gokira, korende akamenta goaka eriogi kobua, ogoteeba “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”

English: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”
Kiswahili: Yesu akasimama na kusema, “Mwiteni.” Hivyo wakamwita yule mtu kipofu, wakamwambia, “Jipe moyo! Inuka, anakuita.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, akabora, “Morangerie!” Bakarangeria omouko oria, bakamoteebia, “Remia enkoro yao, imoka, okorangeirie.”

English: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
Kiswahili: Akiwa analivua lile joho lake, alisimama na kumwendea Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ere agatuguta eanga yaye, agacharoka, agachiera Yeso.

English: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamuuliza, “Unataka nikufanyie nini?” Yule kipofu akajibu, “Mwalimu, nataka kuona.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Omonto oria orenge omouko akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, inyare korora.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Nenda zako, imani yako imekuponya.” Mara akapata kuona, akamfuata Yesu njiani.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda! Okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, agatunyana Yeso kwagachia.

English: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples
Kiswahili: Walipokaribia Yerusalemu, wakafika Bethfage na Bethania katika Mlima wa Mizeituni. Yesu akawatuma wawili wa wanafunzi wake,
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, Yeso agatoma babere baborokigwa baye,

English: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.
Kiswahili: akawaambia, “Nendeni katika kijiji kilichoko mbele yenu. Na hapo mtakapoingia kijijini, mtamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa hapo, ambaye hajapandwa na mtu bado. Mfungueni, mkamlete hapa.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Genda ase ekenyoro keria mokoorokera, erio kamogosoa aroro, namorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyendetere.

English: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akiwauliza, ‘Mbona mnamfungua?’ Mwambieni, ‘Bwana anamhitaji, na atamrudisha hapa baada ya muda mfupi.’ ”
Ekegusii: Na omonto karababorie: Inaki mogokora iga? Momoteebie: Omonene nayeganetie, na bwango nayeiranie naende aa.”

English: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.
Kiswahili: Wakaenda, wakamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa kando ya barabara, karibu na mlango wa nyumba.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda, bakarora emori y’etigere esibire geita isiko ase enchera enene; bakayesibora.

English: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanamfungua, watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu wakawauliza, “Mna maana gani mnapomfungua huyo mwana-punda?”
Ekegusii: Abanto bande bateneine aroro, bakababoria, “Inki ekio mogokora, mogosibora emori y’etigere?”

English: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.
Kiswahili: Wakawajibu kama vile Yesu alivyokuwa amewaagiza, nao wale watu wakawaruhusu.
Ekegusii: Bakabateebia buna Yeso abachiigete; na abwo bakabatiga bagende.

English: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakamleta huyo mwana-punda kwa Yesu na kutandika mavazi yao juu yake, naye akampanda.
Ekegusii: Bakarentera Yeso emori eria y’etigere, bakaara chianga igoro asero, na Yeso akayeriina.

English: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.
Kiswahili: Watu wengi wakatandaza mavazi yao barabarani, na wengine wakatandaza matawi waliyokuwa wamekata mashambani.
Ekegusii: Abanto abange bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete na gochiara inchera.

English: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
Kiswahili: Kisha wale waliokuwa wametangulia mbele na wale waliokuwa wakifuata nyuma wakapaza sauti, wakisema, “Hosana!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!”
Ekegusii: Abanto abatang’aine na baria baare komotunyana bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Hosana! Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene!

English: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
Kiswahili: “Umebarikiwa Ufalme unaokuja wa baba yetu Daudi!” “Hosana kwake yeye aliye juu!”
Ekegusii: Mbosesenirie oborwoti bogocha, oborwoti bwa sokoro yaito Daudi! Hosana aye ore igoro!”

English: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaingia Yerusalemu na kwenda Hekaluni. Akaangalia kila kitu kilichokuwamo, lakini kwa kuwa ilishakuwa jioni, akaenda zake Bethania pamoja na wale kumi na wawili.
Ekegusii: Yeso agasoa Yerusalemu agaika ase Hekalu ime; akarigereria buya chinsemo chionsi kera egento. Korende ase engencho nigo kiarenge ekero kia mogoroba, agasoka, akagenda Bethania amo na baria ikomi na babere.

English: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake walipokuwa wakitoka Bethania, Yesu alikuwa na njaa.
Ekegusii: Rituko riare kobwatia kobakorwa Bethania Yeso akaigwa enchara.

English: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
Kiswahili: Akauona mtini kwa mbali, naye akaenda ili aone kama ulikuwa na matunda. Alipoufikia, akakuta una majani tu, kwa kuwa hayakuwa majira ya tini.
Ekegusii: Akarora korwa are omoko ore namato, akagenda arore gose amako nareo. Agachia goika aroro tarora gento otatiga amato, ekiagera tikiarenge ekero ki’amako.

English: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.
Kiswahili: Akauambia ule mti, “Tangu leo mtu yeyote asile kamwe matunda kutoka kwako.” Wanafunzi wake walimsikia akisema hayo.
Ekegusii: Yeso agateebia omoko oria, “Korwa bono monto taria amatunda ao nonya ndinde.” Aborokigwa baye bakaigwa aya.

English: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
Kiswahili: Walipofika Yerusalemu, Yesu akaingia katika eneo la Hekalu, akaanza kuwafukuza wale waliokuwa wakinunua na kuuza humo ndani. Akazipindua meza za wale waliokuwa wakibadilisha fedha, na pia viti vya wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa,
Ekegusii: Bagaika Yerusalemu. Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ime, agachaaka goseria abanto abarenge koonia na kogora aroro, agaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare goonchoreria chitaabu, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma;

English: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
Kiswahili: wala hakumruhusu mtu yeyote kuchukua bidhaa kupitia ukumbi wa Hekalu.
Ekegusii: tatiga monto abogorie gento ase egati ye Hekalu.

English: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”
Kiswahili: Naye alipokuwa akiwafundisha, akasema, “Je, haikuandikwa kuwa: “ ‘Nyumba yangu itaitwa nyumba ya sala kwa mataifa yote’? Lakini ninyi mmeifanya kuwa ‘pango la wanyangʼanyi.’ ”
Ekegusii: Akorokereria, okobateebia, “Inee! Teriikiri iga: Enyomba y’ane nerokwe enyomba y’ogosaba ase ebisaku bionsi? Korende inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”

English: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria wakapata habari hizi, nao wakaanza kutafuta njia ya kumuua, kwa kuwa walikuwa wakimwogopa, kwa sababu umati wote ulikuwa unashangazwa na mafundisho yake.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakanyora amang’ana, bakarigia enchera y’okomosiria, ekiagera bamoirogete; naki emeganda yonsi egakumia ase okworokereria kwaye.

English: When evening came, he went out of the city.
Kiswahili: Ilipofika jioni, Yesu na wanafunzi wake wakatoka nje ya mji.
Ekegusii: Koriaba mogoroba akarua ase omochie.

English: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi yake walipokuwa wakipita, wakauona ule mtini umenyauka kutoka juu hadi kwenye mizizi yake.
Ekegusii: Na mambia kobagoeta, bakarora omoko oria bwomire bwonsi korwa ase emeri yaye.

English: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
Kiswahili: Petro akakumbuka na kumwambia Yesu, “Rabi, tazama! Ule mtini ulioulaani umenyauka!”
Ekegusii: Petero akainyora amang’ana aria, agateebia Yeso, “Rabii, rora, omoko oria kwaragereretie bwomire.”

English: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mwaminini Mungu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Mobe nokwegena ase Nyasae.

English: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, mtu yeyote atakayeuambia mlima huu, ‘Ngʼoka ukatupwe baharini,’ wala asione shaka moyoni mwake, bali aamini kwamba hayo asemayo yametukia, atatimiziwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Onde bwensi orateebie egetunwa eke: Tegoka, otugutwe enyancha ime; oyo atabeeti nogosiereria ase enkoro yaye, korende egene ng’a ayio ateeba nabe, ayio nakoreke.

English: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hiyo nawaambia, yoyote mtakayoyaomba mkisali, aminini ya kwamba mmeyapokea, nayo yatakuwa yenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nabateebirie, ebinto bionsi morasabe, egene ng’a mwabinyorire, nabirobio inabibe ebiaino.

English: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
Kiswahili: Nanyi kila msimamapo kusali, sameheni mkiwa na neno na mtu, ili naye Baba yenu aliye mbinguni awasamehe ninyi makosa yenu.
Ekegusii: Na inwe, ekero mogotenena na gosaba, onye more ne ring’ana ase omonto, mwabere, erinde na Iso oino ore igoro abaabere nainwe amamocho aino.

English: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama ninyi msiposamehe, wala Baba yenu aliye mbinguni hatawasamehe ninyi makosa yenu.”
Ekegusii: Onye inwe timokwabera, nonya n’Iso oino ore igoro takobaabera inwe amamocho aino.”

English: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,
Kiswahili: Wakafika tena Yerusalemu, na Yesu alipokuwa akitembea Hekaluni, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee wa watu wakamjia.
Ekegusii: Bagaika Yerusalemu naende. Ekero Yeso are gotaara Hekalu ime, abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na abagaaka bakamochiera,

English: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani? Na ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka ya kufanya hayo?”
Ekegusii: bakamobooria, “Nase okobua ki ogokorera aya?”

English: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nitawauliza swali moja. Nijibuni, nami nitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninafanya mambo haya.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nainche nimbaborie ring’ana erimo, nainwe mong’iranerie, erio nimbateebie ase okobua ki ngokorera aya.

English: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”
Kiswahili: Niambieni, je, ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?”
Ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, niigoro yarwete igoro, gose nase Mwanyabaanto? Ng’iranerie.”

English: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
Kiswahili: Wakahojiana wao kwa wao, wakisema, “Kama tukisema, ‘Ulitoka mbinguni,’ atatuuliza, ‘Mbona hamkumwamini?’
Ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, nigo aratoboorie: Inaki rende motamwegenete?

English: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.
Kiswahili: Lakini tukisema, ‘Ulitoka kwa wanadamu,’…” (Waliwaogopa watu, kwa sababu kila mtu aliamini kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii wa kweli.)
Ekegusii: Gose toise goteeba: Nase Mwanyabaanto yarwete?” — Bakairoka abanto, ekiagera abanto bonsi mbaroche ng’a Yohana nomobani bw’ekeene.

English: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakamjibu Yesu, “Hatujui.” Naye Yesu akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio bakairaneria Yeso, “Titomanyeti.” Na Yeso akabateebia “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.”

English: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaanza kusema nao kwa mifano, akawaambia: “Mtu mmoja alipanda shamba la mizabibu. Akajenga ukuta kulizunguka, akachimba shimo ndani yake kwa ajili ya shinikizo la kusindika divai, na akajenga mnara wa ulinzi. Kisha akalikodisha shamba hilo la mizabibu kwa wakulima fulani, kisha akasafiri kwenda nchi nyingine.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachaaka gokwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno. “Omonto naremete omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akayogitera orobago, agakunya egetera akomitera amasabibu, akaagacha orwaki, akaywatananera abaremi, akamanora akagenda orogendo.

English: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mavuno ulipofika, mwenye shamba akamtuma mtumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili kuchukua sehemu yake ya mavuno ya shamba la mizabibu kutoka kwa hao wapangaji.
Ekegusii: Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde anyore korwa ase abaremi ensemo y’amatunda y’emesabibu.

English: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale wakulima walimkamata yule mtumishi, wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Abaremi baria bakabwata omosomba oria, bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.

English: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
Kiswahili: Kisha yule mwenye shamba akamtuma mtumishi mwingine kwao; nao wale wakulima wakampiga kichwani na kumfanyia mambo ya aibu.
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agatoma naende ase bare omosomba onde, na oyio bakamoaka chingoma ase omotwe, bakamosokia bakamokora bobe.

English: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamtuma mtumishi mwingine, naye huyo wakamuua. Akawatuma wengine wengi; baadhi yao wakawapiga, na wengine wakawaua.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria naende agatoma omosomba onde naende, na oyio bakamoita agakwa. Naboigo babakorerete abande abange; bagaaka abande, na abande bakabaita bagakwa.

English: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
Kiswahili: “Mwenye shamba alikuwa bado na mmoja wa kumtuma, mwanawe aliyempenda. Hatimaye akamtuma akisema, ‘Watamheshimu mwanangu.’
Ekegusii: Narenge nomwana oyomo konya ataratoma, omwanchwa oye; oyo nere akamotoma ase bare magega, okobora: Inabasike omwana one.

English: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
