Kiswahili: “Lakini wale wapangaji wakasemezana pamoja, ‘Huyu ndiye mrithi. Njooni tumuue, nao urithi utakuwa wetu.’
Ekegusii: Abaremi baria bagateebania: Oyo nomonyamwando; inchwo tomoite, omwando oye obe oyoito.

English: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakamchukua na kumuua, wakamtupa nje ya lile shamba la mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoita agakwa, bakaimokia omobere oye bakayotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.

English: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
Kiswahili: “Sasa basi yule mwenye shamba atafanya nini? Atakuja na kuwaua hao wapangaji, kisha atawapa wapangaji wengine hilo shamba la mizabibu.
Ekegusii: Bono inki rende omonene oria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu arakore? Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.

English: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.
Kiswahili: Je, hamjasoma Andiko hili: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni;
Ekegusii: Nonya neririiko eri timorarisoma: “Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.

English: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”
Kiswahili: Bwana ndiye alitenda jambo hili, nalo ni ajabu machoni petu’?”
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?”

English: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.
Kiswahili: Walipotambua kuwa amesema mfano huo kwa ajili yao, wakataka kumkamata, lakini wakaogopa ule umati wa watu. Wakamwacha, wakaondoka, wakaenda zao.
Ekegusii: Erio Abakuani abanene, aborokia b’amariiko n’abagaaka bakarigia kobwata Yeso ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omobayeeno oria nabwo ogoteeba; korende bakairoka omoganda, bakamotiga, bakagenda.

English: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
Kiswahili: Baadaye wakawatuma baadhi ya Mafarisayo na Maherode ili kwenda kumtega Yesu katika yale anayosema.
Ekegusii: Bagatoma asare abande b’Abafarisai na Abaherodia, erinde bamotege ase amang’ana.

English: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
Kiswahili: Wakamjia, wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, tunajua kwamba wewe ni mtu mwadilifu. Wewe huyumbishwi na wanadamu, kwa kuwa huna upendeleo. Lakini wewe huifundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli. Je, ni halali kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?
Ekegusii: Bagachia goika bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a aye nigo ore omonto bw’ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto, naki torengerereti obonene bw’ abanto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae. Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?

English: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”
Kiswahili: Je, tulipe kodi au tusilipe?” Lakini Yesu alijua unafiki wao. Akawauliza “Mbona mnajaribu kunitega? Nileteeni hiyo dinariniione.”
Ekegusii: Tomoe, gose titomoa?” Korende Yeso ere konya omanyire obong’ainereria bwabo, akabateebia: Nase ki mogonteema? Yendetere ebesa inyerore!

English: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
Kiswahili: Wakamletea hiyo sarafu. Naye akawauliza, “Sura hii ni ya nani? Na maandishi haya ni ya nani?” Wakamjibu, “Ni vya Kaisari.”
Ekegusii: Bakayerenta. Ere akababoria, “Ekieni eke na amariiko aya nebiang’o?” Bakamoiraneria, “Nebia Kaisari.”

English: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.” Nao wakamstaajabia sana.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ebire bia Kaisari, moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae, moe Nyasae.” Bakamokumia mono.

English: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,
Kiswahili: Kisha Masadukayo, wale wasemao kuwa hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu,
Ekegusii: Na Abasadukai bagachiera Yeso, baria bakoboora ng’a okobokigwa tikori, bakamobooria,

English: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
Kiswahili: wakasema, “Mwalimu, Mose alituandikia kuwa kama ndugu wa mtu akifa na kumwacha mkewe bila mtoto, basi huyo mtu inampasa amwoe huyo mjane ili amzalie ndugu yake watoto.
Ekegusii: “Omworokia, Musa natoriikerete ng’a momura omwabo omonto karakwe atige omokungu oye; onye tari n’omwana, momura omwabo atware omokungu oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.

English: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwepo ndugu saba. Yule wa kwanza akaoa mke, naye akafa pasipo kuwa na mtoto yeyote.
Ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana.

English: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;
Kiswahili: Wa pili akamwoa yule mjane, lakini naye akafa bila kuacha mtoto yeyote. Ikawa vivyo hivyo kwa yule wa tatu.
Ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere akamotwara, agakwa; nonya nere tatiga abana; nonya noyo o gatato boigo.

English: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmojawapo wa hao ndugu wote saba aliyeacha mtoto. Hatimaye yule mwanamke naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Bonsi batano na babere bakamotwara, tibatiga abana. Omoerio o bonsi omokungu oria nere agakwa.

English: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakati wa ufufuo, yeye atakuwa mke wa nani, maana aliolewa na ndugu wote saba?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa ’mokang’o arabe ase aba? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”

English: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, hampotoki kwa sababu hamfahamu Maandiko wala uweza wa Mungu?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Timori gosira ase aya, ekiagera timomanyeti amariiko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae?

English: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
Kiswahili: Wafu watakapofufuka, hawataoa wala kuolewa, bali watakuwa kama malaika wa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Inaki kobaraboke korwa ase abakuure, tibakonyuoma, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika bare igoro.

English: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
Kiswahili: Basi kuhusu wafu kufufuliwa, je hamjasoma katika Kitabu cha Mose jinsi Mungu alivyosema na Mose kutoka kile kichaka akisema, ‘Mimi ni Mungu wa Abrahamu, na Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo?’
Ekegusii: Nase amang’ana y’abakuure, buna bakobokigwa, timwana gosoma ase egetabu ya Musa, ase ring’ana ri’egetutu, buna Nyasae amotebetie, akabora: Inche ninche Nyasae bw’Aburaamu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo?

English: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”
Kiswahili: Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali ni Mungu wa walio hai. Kwa hiyo mmekosea kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende bw’abare moyo; ase ayio nigo mogosira mono.”

English: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
Kiswahili: Mwalimu mmoja wa sheria akaja, akawasikia wakijadiliana. Akiona kwamba Yesu amewajibu vyema, naye akamuuliza, “Katika amri zote, ni ipi iliyo kuu?”
Ekegusii: Oyomo ase aborokia b’amariiko agacha akabaigwa bakoamererania nere, akamanya ng’a obairaneirie buya, akamobooria, “Ase amachiiko onsi ndiriri rire rie ritang’ani?”

English: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Amri iliyo kuu ndiyo hii: ‘Sikia ee Israeli. Bwana Mungu wetu, Bwana ndiye mmoja.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Erie ritang’ani nario eri: Igwa, Abaisraeli, Omonene oito, Nyasae, Nere Omonene oyomo;

English: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.
Kiswahili: Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, kwa roho yako yote, kwa akili zako zote, na kwa nguvu zako zote.’
Ekegusii: naye mwanche Omonene oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi.

English: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
Kiswahili: Ya pili ndiyo hii: ‘Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.’ Hakuna amri nyingine iliyo kuu kuliko hizi.”
Ekegusii: Na ogwa kabere nakwo oko: Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete. Amachiiko ande tari amanene kobua aya.”

English: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;
Kiswahili: Yule mwalimu wa sheria akamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, umejibu vyema kwamba Mungu ni mmoja, wala hakuna mwingine ila yeye.
Ekegusii: Omworokia oria bw’amariiko agateebia Yeso, “Ekeene, Omworokia, gwateebire buya ng’a Nyasae noyomo, na onde tari otatiga ere;

English: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
Kiswahili: Kumpenda Mungu kwa moyo wote na kwa akili zote na kwa nguvu zote, na kumpenda jirani kama mtu anavyojipenda mwenyewe ni bora zaidi kuliko kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu zote.”
Ekegusii: na komwancha nenkoro yonsi, na okomanya gwonsi, ne chinguru chionsi, na gwancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete, nkogwenerete kobua omosango bw’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde.”

English: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoona kwamba amejibu kwa busara, akamwambia, “Wewe hauko mbali na Ufalme wa Mungu.” Tangu wakati huo, hakuna mtu yeyote aliyethubutu kumuuliza maswali tena.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora ng’a nigo airaneria ase obong’aini, akamoteebia, “Aye tori are korwa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.” Korwa erio monto onde tanyara komoboria ring’ana naende.

English: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akifundisha Hekaluni, akauliza, “Imekuwaje walimu wa sheria wanasema kwamba Kristoni Mwana wa Daudi?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora gakworokereria ime ase Hekalu, “Inaki aborokia b’amariiko bakobora ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?

English: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Daudi mwenyewe, akinena kwa kuongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu, alisema: “ ‘Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’
Ekegusii: Daudi omonyene nigo ateebete, buna arenge koraagwa n’Omoika Omochenu: “Agateeba Omonene agakwana n’Omonene one Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao”.

English: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi mwenyewe anamwita ‘Bwana.’ Awezaje basi yeye kuwa mwanawe?” Ule umati wote wa watu wakamsikiliza kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Daudi omonyene nigo akomoroka Omonene; inaki rende Masihi aba omwana oye? Na omoganda oria omonene nigo orenge komoigwa ase omogooko.

English: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akifundisha, Yesu alisema, “Jihadharini na walimu wa sheria. Wao hupenda kutembea wakiwa wamevaa mavazi marefu, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia ase okworokereria kwaye, “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariiko, abwo banchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro,

English: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,
Kiswahili: Pia wao hupenda kukaa kwenye viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kupewa nafasi za heshima katika karamu.
Ekegusii: na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega.

English: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
Kiswahili: Wao hula nyumba za wajane, na ili waonekane kuwa wema wanasali sala ndefu. Watu kama hawa watapata hukumu iliyo kuu sana.”
Ekegusii: Abwo bakounereria chinyomba ch’ababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria basaba ogosaba ogotambe; aba nabanyore ekiina ekere ekenene kobua.”

English: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akaketi mkabala na sehemu ambapo sadaka zilikuwa zinawekwa na kuangalia umati wa watu wakiweka fedha zao kwenye sanduku la hazina ya Hekalu. Matajiri wengi wakaweka kiasi kikubwa cha fedha.
Ekegusii: Yeso agaikaransa korigereria ekebekerero gi’esadaka, akarigereria buna omoganda okobeeka chitaabu ase ekebekerero. Abande abarenge abanda bakabeeka chinyinge.

English: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
Kiswahili: Lakini mjane mmoja maskini akaja na kuweka sarafu mbili ndogo za shaba zenye thamani ya senti mbili.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oyomo agacha, oyorenge omoboraka na omotaka, akabeeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai, rigori ri’ekeng’ese ki’ebesa eyemo.

English: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, huyu mjane maskini ameweka katika sanduku la hazina zaidi ya watu wengine wote.
Ekegusii: Akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Oyo omoboraka omotaka obekire chinyinge kobua bonsi ababeeka ase ekebeekerero gi’esadaka,

English: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
Kiswahili: Wengine wote wametoa kutokana na ziada ya mali zao. Lakini huyu mjane ametoa kutokana na umaskini wake, akaweka kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, hata kile alichohitaji ili kuishi.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera aba bonsi nigo babeeka korwa ase ogoiteka kw’obonda bwabo; korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obekire bionsi ebiarenge nabio, nonya n’enibo y’obogima bwaye bwonsi.”

English: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akitoka Hekaluni, mmojawapo wa wanafunzi wake akamwambia, “Mwalimu! Tazama jinsi mawe haya yalivyo makubwa, na majengo haya yalivyo mazuri!”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are gosoka korwa Hekalu, oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye akamoteebia, “Omworokia, rora buna amagena na amaagacho aya are amaya!”

English: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akajibu akasema, “Je, unayaona majengo haya yalivyo makubwa? Hakuna hata jiwe moja litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali yote yatabomolewa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Norooche amaagacho aya amanene? Aiga tirigotigara rigena erimo igoro ase erinde, eritanyaare gotaagorwa.”

English: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa ameketi kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni mkabala na Hekalu, Petro, Yakobo, Yohana na Andrea wakamuuliza faraghani,
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni korigereria Hekalu, Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana, na Anderea, bakamobooria bobisi,

English: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”
Kiswahili: “Tafadhali tuambie, mambo haya yatatukia lini? Nayo dalili ya kuwa hayo yote yanakaribia kutimia itakuwa gani?”
Ekegusii: “Toteebie, aya indiriri arabe? Ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi arabe ang’e goikerana?”

English: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia: “Jihadharini mtu yeyote asiwadanganye.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachaaka kobateebia, “Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina,

English: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.
Kiswahili: Wengi watakuja kwa Jina langu wakidai, ‘Mimi ndiye,’ nao watawadanganya wengi.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abange inabache ase erieta riane, babore: Inche ninche ere; inabasirie abange.

English: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.
Kiswahili: Msikiapo habari za vita na uvumi wa vita, msiwe na hofu. Mambo haya hayana budi kutukia, lakini ule mwisho bado.
Ekegusii: Naende komoraigwe esegi, na ebirage bi’esegi, timoichanigwa, ekiagera bori, aya onsi nabe, ko moerio toracha.

English: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.
Kiswahili: Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa na ufalme dhidi ya ufalme. Kutakuwa na mitetemeko sehemu mbalimbali na njaa. Haya yatakuwa ndio mwanzo wa utungu.
Ekegusii: Inaki egesaku nkeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti mborwane noborwoti bonde. Emetengecho y’ense n’ebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara. Amang’ana ayio nigo arabe buna obororo bw’eritang’ani bw’okoibora.

English: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ninyi jihadharini. Kwa maana watawapeleka katika mabaraza yao na kupigwa mijeledi katika masinagogi. Mtashtakiwa mbele ya watawala na wafalme kwa ajili yangu, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.
Ekegusii: “Mwerende inwe abanyene, ekiagera nababaire ase ebigambero, na ase chisinagogi, moakwe. Naende inamoirwe gotenena ase amasio y’abagabana na ase abarwoti ase engencho y’ane, koba kirori ase bare.

English: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.
Kiswahili: Nayo habari njema lazima ihubiriwe kwanza kwa mataifa yote kabla ule mwisho haujawadia.
Ekegusii: Naende negwenerete enchiri erandigwe ritang’ani ase ebisaku bionsi.

English: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Mtakapokamatwa na kushtakiwa, msisumbuke awali kuhusu mtakalosema. Semeni tu lolote mtakalopewa wakati huo, kwa kuwa si ninyi mtakaokuwa mkinena, bali ni Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bakobaira ase ekiina, na kobabeeka ase amaboko y’ abanto, timochaaka gwechanda korengereria ayamorigetie gokwana; korende rinde rionsi moraegwe ase ensa eria, morikwane, ekiagera tari inwe morakwane, korende n’Omoika Omochenu.

English: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
Kiswahili: “Ndugu atamsaliti ndugu yake ili auawe, naye baba atamsaliti mtoto wake. Watoto nao wataasi dhidi ya wazazi wao na kusababisha wauawe.
Ekegusii: Na momura omwabo omonto narue oyomwabo, erinde aitwe, na ise narue omwana oye; na abana nabaimokere abaibori babo kobaita.

English: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
Kiswahili: Watu wote watawachukia kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Lakini yule atakayevumilia hadi mwisho ataokolewa.
Ekegusii: Nainwe namogechwe n’abanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane, korende oyoraremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.

English: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,
Kiswahili: “Mtakapoona ‘chukizo la uharibifu’ limesimama mahali pasipolipasa (asomaye na afahamu), basi wale walioko Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani.
Ekegusii: “Korende komorakorore okogechia kw’ogosaria kogotenena aase atagwenereti, (oyogosoma amanye), erio abare Boyahudi batame gochia ase ebitunwa;

English: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.
Kiswahili: Yeyote aliye juu ya dari ya nyumba asishuke au kuingia ndani ili kuchukua chochote.
Ekegusii: na ere oyore kerama igoro taika gosoa nyomba ime, gose tasoa kobogoria egento korwa mwaye;

English: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
Kiswahili: Aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua vazi lake.
Ekegusii: na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eanga yaye.

English: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!
Kiswahili: Ole wao wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto siku hizo!
Ekegusii: N’abe aakong’u ase abare morito na barabwo abakogonkia ase amatuko aria.

English: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.
Kiswahili: Ombeni mambo haya yasitokee wakati wa baridi.
Ekegusii: Saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero gi’etoigo,

English: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana siku hizo zitakuwa za dhiki kuu ambayo haijapata kuwako tangu mwanzo, hapo Mungu alipoumba ulimwengu, mpaka leo, na wala haitakuwako tena kamwe.
Ekegusii: ekiagera amatuko aria n’ebe emechando, buna etana koba korwa omochakano bw’ogotonga oko Nyasae atongete, goika bono, gose tekoba bo naende nonya ng’ake.

English: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.
Kiswahili: Kama Bwana asingelifupisha siku hizo, kamwe asingeliokoka mtu yeyote. Lakini kwa ajili ya wateule, wale aliowachagua, amezifupisha siku hizo.
Ekegusii: Naende onye Omonene atanachete amatuko aria, anga monto onde bwensi tatooregete, korende ase engencho y’abachore, abachorete, onachire amatuko aria.

English: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo mtu yeyote akiwaambia, ‘Tazama, Kristohuyu hapa!’ au, ‘Tazama, yuko kule,’ msisadiki.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio omonto karabatebie: Rora, oyo nere Kristo, gose: Oria aaria, timwegena,

English: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana watatokea makristo wa uongo na manabii wa uongo, nao watafanya ishara na maajabu ili kuwapotosha, ikiwezekana, hata wale wateule.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abakristo b’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo nabaorokie ebikone na amakumia, banyare gosiria nonya nabachore ko eranyarekane.

English: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
Kiswahili: Hivyo jihadharini. Nimekwisha kuwaambia mambo haya yote mapema kabla hayajatukia.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe mwerende! Rora, nakoorire koborokia onsi ritang’ani.

English: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,
Kiswahili: “Lakini katika siku hizo, baada ya hiyo dhiki, “ ‘jua litatiwa giza nao mwezi hautatoa nuru yake;
Ekegusii: “Korende amatuko aria, magega y’emechando eria, erioba naribekwe omosunte, na omotienyi tokobara,

English: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
Kiswahili: nazo nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani, na nguvu za anga zitatikisika.’
Ekegusii: ne ching’enang’eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chire igoro nachitengechigwe.

English: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo watu wote watakapomwona Mwana wa Adamu akija mawinguni kwa nguvu nyingi na utukufu.
Ekegusii: Erio nario bararore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ogocha ase amare ime amo ne chinguru chinyinge na obonene.

English: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.
Kiswahili: Naye atawatuma malaika wake wawakusanye wateule wake kutoka pande zote nne za dunia, kutoka miisho ya dunia hadi miisho ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye basangererie abachore baye korwa chinsemo chie chinsinyo inye, na korwa chinsinyo chi’ense goika chinsinyo chia igoro.

English: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;
Kiswahili: “Basi jifunzeni somo hili kutokana na mtini: Matawi yake yanapoanza kuchipua na kutoa majani, mnatambua kwamba wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.
Ekegusii: “Korwa ase omoko eorokererie omobayeeno oyo. Orosagia rwaye korwachaakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, egura gura ng’ang’e ere.

English: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yakitukia, mnatambua kwamba wakati u karibu, hata malangoni.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe, komorarore aya aorokire, momanye ng’a obeire ang’e na gesieri.

English: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi anyare koba.

English: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
Kiswahili: “Kwa habari ya siku ile na saa hakuna yeyote ajuaye, hata malaika walio mbinguni wala Mwana, ila Baba peke yake.
Ekegusii: “Korende amang’ana ye rituko riria na ensa eria onde tari omanyete, nonya nabamalaika bare igoro, nonya n’Omwana, otatiga Tata.

English: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
Kiswahili: Jihadharini! Kesheni! Kwa maana hamjui wakati ule utakapowadia.
Ekegusii: Rigereria, renda, saba, ekiagera timomanyeti engaki eria indi eranyare koba.

English: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.
Kiswahili: Ni kama mtu anayesafiri. Anaiacha nyumba yake na kuwaachia watumishi wake kuiangalia, kila mtu na kazi yake, kisha akamwamuru yule bawabu aliye mlangoni akeshe.
Ekegusii: Igo enga buna omonto ore kogenda ense eng’ao konya otigire enyomba yaye, oeire abasomba baye okobua, na kera omonto emeremo yaye; agachiika omorendi bw’egesieri arende.

English: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;
Kiswahili: “Basi kesheni kwa sababu hamjui ni lini mwenye nyumba atakaporudi: iwapo ni jioni, au ni usiku wa manane, au alfajiri awikapo jogoo, au mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Renda boigo, ekiagera timomanyeti ekero omonene bw’enyomba agochi‐gocha, gose mogoroba, gose mbotuko gati, gose etuoni gekobuga, gose mambia,

English: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.
Kiswahili: Kama akija ghafula, asije akawakuta mmelala.
Ekegusii: tacha ababasokanie, abanyore mwararire.

English: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”
Kiswahili: Lile ninalowaambia ninyi, nawaambia watu wote: ‘Kesheni!’ ”
Ekegusii: Na erio nabateebirie inwe, nabateebirie bonsi: Renda!”

English: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.
Kiswahili: Zilikuwa zimebaki siku mbili tu kabla ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka, na Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu. Viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wakitafuta njia ya kumkamata Yesu kwa hila na kumuua.
Ekegusii: Konya atigaire amatuko abere ne rituko rinene ri’Epasaka ribe, na eri ’Emegati etabekiri memera. Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakarigia enchera bakobwatera Yeso nobong’ainereria, banyare komoita,

English: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”
Kiswahili: Lakini walisema, “Tusilifanye jambo hili wakati wa Sikukuu, maana watu wanaweza wakafanya ghasia.”
Ekegusii: korende barabwo bagateeba, “Titomobwata ekero kie rituko rinene, ekiagera abanto nigo bararente rirorooche.”

English: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.
Kiswahili: Yesu alikuwa Bethania nyumbani kwa Simoni aliyekuwa na ukoma. Wakati alipokuwa ameketi mezani akila chakula cha jioni, mwanamke mmoja aliingia akiwa na chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato ya nardo safi ya thamani kubwa. Akaivunja hiyo chupa, akamiminia hayo manukato kichwani mwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Yeso nigo arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simioni oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ekero Yeso aikaransire ase endagera, omokungu agacha orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta agotioka buya, aye rigori rinene, agaata echuba eria, akamonyororokeria omotwe oye.

English: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwepo pale walikuwa wakisemezana wao kwa wao, “Upotevu huu wote ni wa nini?
Ekegusii: Abanto bake ase abwo barenge oo bakagechigwa ase emioyo yabo, bakaboora, “Nase ki ogosiria amaguta engencho buna eye?

English: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.
Kiswahili: Mafuta haya yangeweza kuuzwa kwa zaidi ya dinari 300, na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini.” Wakamkemea vikali huyo mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Inaki amaguta aya anga naoonigwa chidinari amagana atato na kobua, abataka baegwe.” Bakamwemurunganeria omokungu oria mono.

English: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Mbona mnamsumbua huyu mwanamke? Mwacheni! Yeye amenitendea jambo zuri sana.
Ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Motige! Nase ki mokomorosia? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya.

English: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
Kiswahili: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote na mnaweza kuwasaidia wakati wowote mnaotaka. Lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.
Ekegusii: Inaki amatuko onsi nigo more nabataka amo nainwe, na kero kende gionsi mwanchete, namonyare kobakorera amaya, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.

English: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
Kiswahili: Huyu mwanamke amenitendea lile aliloweza. Ameumiminia mwili wangu manukato ili kuniandaa kwa maziko yangu.
Ekegusii: Okorire eki abuete, goaka omobere one ase ogotindekwa kwane.

English: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, mahali popote ulimwenguni ambapo Injili itahubiriwa, jambo hili alilolitenda huyu mwanamke litatajwa pia kwa ukumbusho wake.”
Ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Kera aase enchiri erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.”

English: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yuda Iskariote, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi kumi na wawili, akaenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani ili kumsaliti Yesu kwao.
Ekegusii: Yudasi Iskariota, ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, akagenda ase abakuani abanene, anyare komorua ase bare.

English: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
Kiswahili: Walifurahi sana kusikia jambo hili na wakaahidi kumpa fedha. Hivyo yeye akawa anatafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachia koyaigwa bakagoka, bakamoriera eira komoa chitaabu. Akarigia enchera akomoruera ekero aranyore ribaga rigiya.

English: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, siku ambayo kwa desturi mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka huchinjwa, wanafunzi wa Yesu wakamuuliza, “Unataka twende wapi ili tukuandalie mahali pa kula Pasaka?”
Ekegusii: Goika rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ekero gi’okonyenya emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Ng’ai origetie togende tokoroiserie oriere Epasaka?”

English: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,
Kiswahili: Basi akawatuma wawili miongoni mwa wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Nendeni mjini. Huko mtakutana na mwanaume amebeba mtungi wa maji. Mfuateni.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatoma babere baborokigwa baye akabateebia, “Genda ase omochie na moumerane nomosaacha obogoretie enyongo ere namaache; momotuny’ane,

English: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
Kiswahili: Mwambieni mwenye nyumba ile atakayoingia, ‘Mwalimu anauliza: Kiko wapi chumba changu cha wageni, ambamo mimi na wanafunzi wangu tutakula Pasaka?’
Ekegusii: na aande onsi arasoe moteebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia oteebire: Ng’ai ere enyomba y’abageni ndiere Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?

English: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
Kiswahili: Atawaonyesha chumba kikubwa ghorofani, kilichopambwa tena kilicho tayari. Tuandalieni humo.”
Ekegusii: Na ere omonyene naborokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo igoro, karoisigwe kabeire ang’e; agwo motoroiserie.”

English: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wakaondoka na kwenda mjini, nao wakakuta kila kitu kama Yesu alivyowaambia. Hivyo wakaiandaa Pasaka.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa bagasoka, bakagenda omochie, bakarora buna abateebetie, bakaroisia Epasaka.

English: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
Kiswahili: Ilipofika jioni, Yesu akaja pamoja na wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili.
Ekegusii: Ekero riaba mogoroba agacha amo na baria ikomi na babere.

English: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”
Kiswahili: Walipoketi mezani wakila, Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti, mmoja anayekula pamoja nami.”
Ekegusii: Na barabwo kobaikaransire ase endagera bakoria, Yeso akabora, “Nekeene, nabateebirie: Oyomo oino oyokoria amo nainche nandue.”

English: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
Kiswahili: Wakaanza kuhuzunika na kumuuliza mmoja baada ya mwingine, “Je, ni mimi Bwana?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagachaaka goichana, bakamobooria oyomo ase oyomo “Inee! Ninche?”

English: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Ni mmoja miongoni mwenu ninyi kumi na wawili, yule anayechovya mkate kwenye bakuli pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Noyomo bw’aba ikomi na babere, ere oyogotobeka amo nainche omogati ase esani.

English: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama vile alivyoandikiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu yule amsalitiye Mwana wa Adamu! Ingekuwa heri kwake mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa.”
Ekegusii: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna ariikeretwe korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria orure Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto. Nanga mbuya ase are omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.”

English: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanakula, Yesu akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, akisema, “Twaeni mle; huu ndio mwili wangu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero barenge koria, Yeso akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akaa aborokigwa baye, akabora, “Bogoria! Oyo noro omobere one.”

English: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
Kiswahili: Kisha akakitwaa kikombe, akashukuru, akawapa, nao wote wakanywa kutoka humo.
Ekegusii: Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa. Bagakenywera bonsi.

English: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Hii ndiyo damu yangu ya agano, imwagikayo kwa ajili ya wengi.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Aya naro amanyinga aane, ay’okobwatana okoyia, aitekire ase engencho y’abange.

English: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, sitakunywa tena katika uzao wa mzabibu, hadi siku ile nitakapounywa mpya katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Tinkonywa naende nonya ng’ake okwama kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa okoyia ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi nyote mtaniacha, kwa maana imeandikwa: “ ‘Nitampiga mchungaji, nao kondoo watatawanyika.’
Ekegusii: Na Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Inwe mwensi inamogochwe na gontiga, naki nariikire: Ning’ake omorisia, ne ching’ondi nachiserebekane.

English: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya kufufuka kwangu, nitawatangulia kwenda Galilaya.”
Ekegusii: Korende magega y’okobooka kw’ane, nimbatang’anere kogenda Galili.”

English: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
Kiswahili: Petro akasema, “Hata kama wengine wote watakuacha, mimi sitakuacha.”
Ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Neba imbagochwe bonsi na kogotiga, korende tari inche.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Amin, nakuambia; leo, usiku huu, kabla jogoo hajawika mara mbili, wewe mwenyewe utanikana mara tatu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Reero, ase obotuko obo, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkane ara gatato.”

English: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akasisitiza zaidi, “Hata kama itabidi kufa pamoja nawe, sitakukana kamwe.” Nao wale wengine wote wakasema vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Korende Petero ere akamenta gokwana mono, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na bonsi bagateeba boigo.

English: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
Kiswahili: Wakaenda mahali paitwapo Gethsemane. Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Kaeni hapa, nami niende nikaombe.”
Ekegusii: Naende bagaika aase akorokwa Gethisemane: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa, ekero ngosaba.”

English: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawachukua pamoja naye Petro, Yakobo na Yohana. Akaanza kuhuzunika sana na kutaabika.
Ekegusii: Akaira Petero na Yakobo na Yohana amo nere, agachaaka goichana na gwechanda mono.

English: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Moyo wangu umejawa na huzuni kiasi cha kufa. Kaeni hapa na mkeshe.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, goika ogokwa; ikaransa aiga, morende.”

English: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
Kiswahili: Akaenda mbele kidogo, akaanguka kifudifudi, akaomba kwamba kama ingewezekana saa hiyo ya mateso imwondokee.
Ekegusii: Akagenderera bosio ake, akagwa maumama, ogosaba ng’a onye ekonyarekana, ensa eye emoetere.

English: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Abba,Baba, mambo yote yawezekana kwako. Niondolee kikombe hiki. Lakini si kama nipendavyo mimi, bali vile upendavyo wewe.”
Ekegusii: Agateeba, Abba! Engencho yaye “Tata”, onsi nigo akonyarekana ase ore, onduserie egekombe eke, korende tari buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.

English: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
Kiswahili: Akarudi kwa wanafunzi wake, akawakuta wamelala. Akamwambia Petro, “Simoni, umelala? Je, hukuweza kukesha hata kwa saa moja?
Ekegusii: Erio akairana gocha ase aborokigwa baria baye batato akabanyora bararire. Agateebia Petero, “Simioni, nkwararire? Tokonyara korenda nonya nensa eyemo?

English: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
Kiswahili: Kesheni na mwombe, msije mkaingia majaribuni. Roho iko radhi, lakini mwili ni mdhaifu.”
Ekegusii: Renda, saba, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”

English: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
Kiswahili: Akaenda tena kuomba, akisema maneno yale yale.
Ekegusii: Akagenda naende, agasaba, ogokwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.

English: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.
Kiswahili: Aliporudi, akawakuta tena wamelala kwa sababu macho yao yalikuwa mazito. Nao hawakujua la kumwambia.
Ekegusii: Erio naende akairana gocha ase aborokigwa akabanyora bararire, ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito, gose tibamanya eri bakomoiraneria.

English: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
Kiswahili: Akaja mara ya tatu, akawaambia, “Bado mmelala na kupumzika? Imetosha! Saa imewadia. Tazameni, Mwana wa Adamu anasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa wenye dhambi.
Ekegusii: Agacha eria gatato, akabateebia, “Nonya mbono moraire, na gotimoka? Aisanire. Engaki yaikire. Rora, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto obekirwe ase amaboko y’abanyene ebibe.

English: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
Kiswahili: Inukeni, twende zetu! Tazameni, msaliti wangu yuaja!”
Ekegusii: Imoka, togende; rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.”

English: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa bado anazungumza, Yuda, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi Kumi na Wawili, akatokea. Alikuwa amefuatana na umati wa watu wenye panga na marungu, waliokuwa wametumwa na viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria, na wazee.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso kagokwana, Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agaika, na omoganda ore amo nere nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na abagaaka.

English: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”
Kiswahili: Basi msaliti alikuwa amewapa hao watu ishara, kwamba: “Yule nitakayembusu ndiye. Mkamateni, mkamchukue chini ya ulinzi.”
Ekegusii: Ere oyokomorua konya obaeire ekemanyererio, ogoteeba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate, momoire momorendete.”

English: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
Kiswahili: Mara Yuda akamjia Yesu na kusema, “Rabi.” Akambusu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yudasi aigete akagenda bwango, goika ase Yeso, akabora, “Rabii!” Akamonyunyunta.

English: They laid their hands on him and seized him.
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakamkamata Yesu, wakamweka chini ya ulinzi.
Ekegusii: Erio bakabwata Yeso, bakamoira.

English: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mmoja wa wale waliokuwa wamesimama karibu aliuchomoa upanga wake na kumpiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio.
Ekegusii: Na oyomo ase baria bateneine ang’e akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.

English: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Mmekuja na panga na marungu kunikamata kana kwamba mimi ni mnyangʼanyi?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna mokoimokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu, gocha kong’ira?

English: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
Kiswahili: Siku kwa siku nilikuwa pamoja nanyi nikifundisha Hekaluni, wala hamkunikamata. Lakini Maandiko sharti yatimie.”
Ekegusii: Inarenge amo nainwe kera rituko ase Hekalu ime kworokereria, ko timwambwata. Korende aya akorirwe, erinde amariiko anyare goikerana.”

English: They all left him, and fled.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wanafunzi wake wote wakamwacha, wakakimbia.
Ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama.

English: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,
Kiswahili: Kijana mmoja, ambaye hakuwa amevaa kitu isipokuwa alijitanda nguo ya kitani, alikuwa akimfuata Yesu. Walipomkamata,
Ekegusii: Omomura oyomo akamotunyana, bweboyetie egetambaa ki’egatani gioka. Bagatema kamobwata,

English: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.
Kiswahili: alikimbia uchi, akaliacha vazi lake.
Ekegusii: korende ere agatiga egetambaa keria ki’egatani, agatama ore getirianda.

English: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.
Kiswahili: Wakampeleka Yesu kwa kuhani mkuu, nao viongozi wa makuhani wote, na wazee na walimu wa sheria wote wakakusanyika pamoja.
Ekegusii: Bakaira Yeso ase Omokuani omonene; bakamosangererekanera bonsi, abakuani abanene na abagaaka, na aborokia b’amariiko.

English: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.
Kiswahili: Petro akamfuata kwa mbali, hadi uani kwa kuhani mkuu. Huko akaketi pamoja na walinzi, akiota moto.
Ekegusii: Na Petero akamotunyana korwa magega ore egeka, goika ime ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene, agaikaransa amo nabasomba gwota omorero.

English: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na Baraza la Wayahudi lote wakatafuta ushahidi dhidi ya Yesu ili wapate kumuua. Lakini hawakupata jambo lolote.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na ab’ekegambero bonsi bakarigia oborori igoro ase Yeso banyare komoita, korende tibabonyora,

English: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.
Kiswahili: Wengi walitoa ushahidi wa uongo dhidi yake, lakini maelezo yao hayakukubaliana.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abange bakomoteebera oborimo, na oborori bwabo tibwabwatana.

English: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo wengine wakasimama wakatoa ushahidi wa uongo dhidi yake, wakisema:
Ekegusii: Na abande bagatenena bakamoteebera oborimo, bakaboora,

English: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”
Kiswahili: “Sisi tulimsikia akisema, ‘Mimi nitalibomoa Hekalu hili lililojengwa na wanadamu, na katika siku tatu nitajenga jingine ambalo halikujengwa na wanadamu.’ ”
Ekegusii: “Ntwamoigwete ogoteeba: Inche nintagore Hekalu eye yakoregete n’amaboko, na ase amatuko atato ning’agache eyende etakoregeti n’amaboko.”

English: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata hivyo, ushahidi wao haukukubaliana.
Ekegusii: Nonya nabo oborori bwabo tibwabwatana.

English: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
Kiswahili: Basi kuhani mkuu akasimama mbele yao, akamuuliza Yesu, “Je, wewe hutajibu? Ni ushahidi gani hawa watu wanauleta dhidi yako?”
Ekegusii: Omokuani omonene agatenena gati‐gati, akaboria Yeso okobora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”

English: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akakaa kimya, hakusema neno lolote. Kuhani mkuu akamuuliza tena, “Je, wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu Aliyebarikiwa?”
Ekegusii: Korende agakira, tairaneria ing’ana. Omokuani omonene akamobooria naende, akamoteebia, “Aye naye Kristo, Omwana bw’Omosesenigwa?”

English: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Mimi ndimi. Nanyi mtamwona Mwana wa Adamu akiwa ameketi mkono wa kuume wa Mwenye Nguvu, na akija juu ya mawingu ya mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Ee, ninche ere; na inwe namorore Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore nokobua, ogocha namare a igoro.”

English: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?
Kiswahili: Kuhani mkuu akararua mavazi yake, akasema, “Tuna haja gani tena ya mashahidi zaidi?
Ekegusii: Omokuani omonene agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Ninki tokorigeria abarori bande?

English: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mmesikia hayo makufuru. Uamuzi wenu ni gani?” Wote wakamhukumu kwamba anastahili kifo.
Ekegusii: Mwaigure okorama kwaye. Inaki morooche?” Bonsi bakamonachera ekiina ng’a nagwenerete akwe.

English: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.
Kiswahili: Kisha baadhi ya watu wakaanza kumtemea mate; wakamfunga kitambaa machoni, wakampiga kwa ngumi na kumwambia, “Tabiri!” Walinzi wakamchukua na kumpiga makofi.
Ekegusii: Abande bagachaaka komotwera amate, na komotuba obosio, na komoaka chinkundi, na komoteebia, “Bana!” Abarendi nabarabwo bakamoaka chindoe.

English: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
Kiswahili: Petro alipokuwa bado yuko chini kwenye ua wa jumba la kifalme, tazama akaja mmoja wa watumishi wa kike wa kuhani mkuu.
Ekegusii: Na Petero nigo arenge egoora inse, na oyomo bw’abaiseke abasomba b’Omokuani omonene agacha,

English: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
Kiswahili: Alipomwona Petro akiota moto, akamtazama sana, akamwambia, “Wewe pia ulikuwa pamoja na Yesu, Mnazareti.”
Ekegusii: akarora Petero ogwota omorero, akamorigereria, agateeba, “Aye naye kwarenge amo noria Omonazareti, Yeso.”

English: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akakana, akasema, “Sijui wala sielewi unalosema.” Naye akaondoka kuelekea kwenye njia ya kuingilia.
Ekegusii: Agakana, akabora, “Timanyeti, gose tinyigweti eki ogokwana.” Agasoka gesieri; etuoni ekabuga.

English: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
Kiswahili: Yule mtumishi wa kike alipomwona mahali pale, akawaambia tena wale waliokuwa wamesimama hapo, “Huyu mtu ni mmoja wao.”
Ekegusii: Omoiseke oria omosomba akamorora naende, agachaaka goteebia abateneine ang’e, “Oyo n’oyomo obo.”

English: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akakana tena. Baada ya muda kidogo wale waliokuwa wamesimama hapo karibu na Petro wakamwambia, “Hakika wewe ni mmoja wao, kwa maana wewe pia ni Mgalilaya!”
Ekegusii: Agakaana naende. Magega y’egeka egeke naende, baria bateneine ang’e bagateebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye n’oyomo obo ore, ekiagera nigo ore Omogalili.”

English: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
Kiswahili: Petro akaanza kujilaani na kuwaapia, “Mimi simjui huyu mtu mnayesema habari zake!”
Ekegusii: Agachaaka kweragereria na gotiana, “Timanyeti omonto oyio mogoteeba.”

English: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
Kiswahili: Papo hapo jogoo akawika mara ya pili. Ndipo Petro akakumbuka lile neno Yesu alikuwa amemwambia: “Kabla jogoo hajawika mara mbili, utanikana mara tatu.” Akavunjika moyo, akalia sana.
Ekegusii: Erio etuoni ekabuga eria kabere. Petero akainyora ring’ana riria atebetigwe na Yeso, “Ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkaane ara gatato.” Agachia agetugutana, akarera.

English: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi na mapema, viongozi wa makuhani, pamoja na wazee, walimu wa sheria na Baraza lote, wakafikia uamuzi. Wakamfunga Yesu, wakamchukua na kumkabidhi kwa Pilato.
Ekegusii: Erio kobwachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bagakora ekiina amo nabagaaka na aborokia b’amariiko, na ekegambero ekegima. Bagasiba Yeso, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato.

English: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
Kiswahili: Pilato akamuuliza, “Je, wewe ndiye Mfalme wa Wayahudi?” Yesu akajibu, “Wewe umesema.”
Ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria, “Aye naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?” Akamoiraneria, “Naboigo, aye gwateebire.”

English: The chief priests accused him of many things.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani wakamshtaki kwa mambo mengi.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakamosoera ase amang’ana amange.

English: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
Kiswahili: Pilato akamuuliza tena, “Je, huna la kujibu? Tazama ni mashtaka mangapi wanayaleta juu yako.”
Ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria naende, akabora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Rora amang’ana aya amange bagosoereire.”

English: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu hakujibu lolote, hivyo Pilato akashangaa.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso tairaneria ing’ana rinde naende, goika Pilato agakumia.

English: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa desturi wakati wa Sikukuu ya Pasaka kumfungulia mfungwa yeyote ambaye watu wangemtaka.
Ekegusii: Nabo ase rituko rinene nigo anarete kobasiborera omosibwa oyomo, oyobarigetie.

English: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, mtu aliyeitwa Baraba alikuwa amefungwa gerezani pamoja na waasi wengine waliokuwa wametekeleza uuaji wakati wa maasi.
Ekegusii: Narengeo omonto ore korokwa Baraba, osibetwe amo nabaanto abakorete eburuburu, na gokora oboiti ase eburuburu.

English: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukamjia Pilato na kumwomba awafanyie kama ilivyokuwa desturi yake.
Ekegusii: Omoganda ogotiira gochiao, na barabwo bagachaaka gosaba Pilato abakorere buna anarete kobakorera.

English: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
Kiswahili: Pilato akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafungulie huyu Mfalme wa Wayahudi?”
Ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Morigetie mbasiborere Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”

English: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye alitambua kuwa viongozi wa makuhani walikuwa wamemtia Yesu mikononi mwake kwa ajili ya wivu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera amanyete ng’a abakuani abanene nigo bamorure ase obogechi.

English: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
Kiswahili: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani wakauchochea ule umati wa watu wamwombe awafungulie Baraba badala yake.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakagenka abanto b’omoganda, erinde anche kobasiborera Baraba.

English: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”
Kiswahili: Pilato akawauliza tena, “Basi mnataka nifanye nini na huyu mtu mnayemwita Mfalme wa Wayahudi?”
Ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria naende, akabateebia, “Imokore naki oyo mogoteeba ng’a n’Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”

English: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”
Kiswahili: Wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Msulubishe!”
Ekegusii: Bagaaka eriogi naende, “Mobambe!”

English: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”
Kiswahili: Pilato akawauliza, “Kwa nini? Amefanya kosa gani?” Lakini wao wakapiga kelele kwa nguvu zaidi, wakisema, “Msulubishe!”
Ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Bakamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Mobambe!”

English: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
Kiswahili: Pilato, akitaka kuuridhisha ule umati wa watu, akawafungulia Baraba. Naye baada ya kuamuru Yesu achapwe mijeledi, akamtoa ili asulubishwe.
Ekegusii: Pilato agancha gokora ayaragwenere omoganda, akabasiborera Baraba, na ekero aakire Yeso chinkini, akamorua abambwe.

English: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.
Kiswahili: Askari wakampeleka Yesu hadi kwenye ukumbi wa ndani wa jumba la kifalme, ndio Praitorio, wakakusanya kikosi kizima cha askari.
Ekegusii: Abarwani bakaira Yeso ime ase enyomba y’ekegambero (nero Praitorio), bagasangererekana amo ekeombe ekegima.

English: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
Kiswahili: Wakamvalisha Yesu joho la zambarau, wakasokota taji ya miiba, wakamvika kichwani.
Ekegusii: Bakamoboyia eanga emonyinga, bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera motwe,

English: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
Kiswahili: Wakaanza kumsalimu kwa dhihaka, “Salamu, mfalme wa Wayahudi!”
Ekegusii: bagachaaka komokwania, “Masoge, Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi!”

English: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
Kiswahili: Wakampiga kwa fimbo ya mwanzi tena na tena kichwani na kumtemea mate. Wakapiga magoti mbele yake, wakamsujudia kwa kumdhihaki.
Ekegusii: Bakamoaka omotwe negetonto, bakamotwera amate, bakabeka amaru inse, bakamosasiima.

English: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kumdhihaki, wakamvua lile joho la zambarau, wakamvika tena nguo zake. Kisha wakamtoa nje ili wakamsulubishe.
Ekegusii: Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eanga eria emonyinga, bakamoboyia chianga chiaye omonyene. Bakamoira isiko komobamba.

English: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja kutoka Kirene, jina lake Simoni, baba yao Aleksanda na Rufo, alikuwa anapita zake kuingia mjini kutoka shamba, nao wakamlazimisha kuubeba ule msalaba.
Ekegusii: Bakabetereria omonto orenge goeta, Simioni Omokurene, ore korwa borabu, ise Alekisanda na Rufo, abogorie omosalaba o Yeso.

English: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”
Kiswahili: Kisha wakampeleka Yesu mpaka mahali palipoitwa Golgotha (maana yake ni Mahali pa Fuvu la Kichwa).
Ekegusii: Bakamoira aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore).

English: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
Kiswahili: Nao wakampa divai iliyochanganywa na manemane, lakini hakuinywa.
Ekegusii: Bakamoa edivai yochoganirie na manemane anywe, ko tancha konywa.

English: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.
Kiswahili: Basi wakamsulubisha, nazo nguo zake wakagawana miongoni mwao kwa kuzipigia kura ili kuamua ni gani kila mtu ataichukua.
Ekegusii: Bakamobamba, bagaatanana chianga chiaye, bagachiakera obomera eye kera omonto araire.

English: It was the third hour when they crucified him.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa yapata saa tatu asubuhi walipomsulubisha.
Ekegusii: Nigo chiare chinsa isato ekero bamobambete.

English: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
Kiswahili: Tangazo likaandikwa la mashtaka dhidi yake lenye maneno haya: “Mfalme wa Wayahudi.”
Ekegusii: Na amariiko y’ogosoerwa kwaye nigo ariikire igoro, “OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”

English: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.
Kiswahili: Pamoja naye walisulubiwa wanyangʼanyi wawili, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Amo nere bakabamba abauri babere, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na oyonde okoboko gw’okobee.

English: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”
Kiswahili: Nayo maandiko yakatimizwa, yale yasemayo, “Alihesabiwa pamoja na watenda dhambi.”
Ekegusii: Nabo ririiko rigaikerana, erigoteeba, “Obareraniigwe amo nabasaria.”

English: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,
Kiswahili: Watu waliokuwa wakipita njiani wakamtukana huku wakitikisa vichwa vyao na kusema, “Aha! Wewe ambaye utalivunja Hekalu na kulijenga kwa siku tatu,
Ekegusii: Na abanto abaare goeta bakamorama, bagosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo, bagoteeba, “A! Aye oyogotagora Hekalu na koyeagacha ase amatuko atato,

English: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”
Kiswahili: basi shuka kutoka msalabani na ujiokoe mwenyewe!”
Ekegusii: etoorie, ika korwa ase omosalaba!”

English: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, viongozi wa makuhani pamoja na walimu wa sheria wakamdhihaki miongoni mwao wakisema, “Aliwaokoa wengine, lakini hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe!
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabakuani abanene bakamosekereria barabwo ase barabwo, amo naborokia b’amariiko, bagateeba, “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria.

English: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.
Kiswahili: Basi huyu Kristo, huyu Mfalme wa Israeli, ashuke sasa kutoka msalabani, ili tupate kuona na kuamini.” Wale waliosulubiwa pamoja naye pia wakamtukana.
Ekegusii: Tiga Kristo, Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, tonyare korora na kwegena!” Na barabwo abaabambetwe amo nere bakamoraama.

English: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
Kiswahili: Ilipofika saa sita, giza liliifunika nchi yote hadi saa tisa.
Ekegusii: Ekero chinsa isano nemo chiaika omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.

English: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
Kiswahili: Mnamo saa tisa, Yesu akapaza sauti, akalia, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?” (maana yake, “Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha?”)
Ekegusii: Ne chinsa kianda Yeso akarera ase eriogi rinene, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani?” Okoonchorwa kwaye: “Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire?”

English: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu waliposikia hayo, wakasema, “Msikieni, anamwita Eliya.”
Ekegusii: Na abande b’abwo bateneine ang’e koyaigwa bakaboora, “Rora, nkorangeria are Elija.”

English: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja akaenda mbio, akachovya sifongo kwenye siki, akaiweka kwenye mwanzi na akampa Yesu ili anywe, akisema, “Basi mwacheni. Hebu tuone kama Eliya atakuja kumshusha kutoka hapo msalabani.”
Ekegusii: Omonto akaminyoka bwango, akaimokia esifunchi, akayeichoria chinkama, akayebeka igoro ase egetonto, akamoa anywe, okobora, “Tiga torore gose Elija ngocha are komoikia.”

English: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akatoa sauti kuu, akakata roho.
Ekegusii: Yeso agaaka eriogi rinene, agatweka mo.

English: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.
Kiswahili: Pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili kuanzia juu hadi chini.
Ekegusii: Egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatondoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere.

English: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
Kiswahili: Basi yule jemadari aliyekuwa amesimama hapo mbele ya msalaba wa Yesu aliposikia ile sauti yake na kuona jinsi alivyokata roho, akasema, “Hakika mtu huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!”
Ekegusii: Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana ateneine amorigereretie, agachia korora ng’a otwekire mo, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
Kiswahili: Walikuwepo pia wanawake waliokuwa wakiangalia kwa mbali. Miongoni mwao walikuwepo Maria Magdalene, na Maria mama yao Yakobo mdogo na Yose, pia na Salome.
Ekegusii: Mbarengeo abakungu barigereretie korwa are. Ase abwo nigo barenge Mariamu Magadalena na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo omoke na Yose, na Salome.

English: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Hawa walifuatana na Yesu na kushughulikia mahitaji yake alipokuwa Galilaya. Pia walikuwepo wanawake wengine wengi waliokuwa wamekuja pamoja naye Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Aba nabwo bamotuny’anete ekero arenge Galili na komokorera, amo nabande abange abakungu abatiirete amo nere goika Yerusalemu.

English: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
Kiswahili: Ilipofika jioni, kwa kuwa ilikuwa Siku ya Maandalizi, yaani siku moja kabla ya Sabato,
Ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, ekiagera nerituko ri’okwebeka ang’e, nario rituko ri’ogotang’anera Esabato,

English: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
Kiswahili: Yosefu wa Arimathaya, mtu aliyeheshimiwa katika Baraza, na ambaye alikuwa anautarajia Ufalme wa Mungu, akamwendea Pilato kwa ujasiri na kumwomba mwili wa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Yusufu omonto bw’Arimathaya agacha, oyorenge omosike, omonto bw’ekegambero. Ere omonyene nigo aganyete oborwoti bwa Nyasae; agasoa noboremu ase obosio bwa Pilato, agasaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.

English: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.
Kiswahili: Pilato alikuwa akijiuliza kama Yesu alikuwa amekwisha kufa. Hivyo akamwita yule jemadari, akamuuliza iwapo Yesu alikuwa amekwisha kufa.
Ekegusii: Pilato agakumia, ekiagera aikire gokwa, akarangeria omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, akamobooria gose nkare akwete.

English: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kupata habari kutoka kwa yule jemadari kwamba kweli amekwisha kufa, Pilato akampa Yosefu ruhusa ya kuuchukua huo mwili.
Ekegusii: Goika agachia konyora ekeene ng’a okuure, akaa Yusufu omobere.

English: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yosefu akanunua kitambaa cha kitani safi, akaushusha mwili kutoka msalabani, akaufunga katika kile kitambaa cha kitani, na kuuweka ndani ya kaburi lililochongwa kwenye mwamba. Kisha akavingirisha jiwe kwenye ingilio la kaburi.
Ekegusii: Yusufu akagora egetambaa ki’egatani, akamoikia, akamoboyia egetambaa keria, akamobeka ase oboina bwabaachetwe ase egetare. Naende agaturunkania rigena gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina.

English: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.
Kiswahili: Maria Magdalene na Maria mamaye Yose walipaona mahali pale alipolazwa.
Ekegusii: Mariamu Magadalena na Mariamu ng’ina Yose bakarigereria aase abegetwe.

English: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
Kiswahili: Sabato ilipomalizika, Maria Magdalene, Maria mama yake Yakobo, na Salome walinunua manukato ili wakaupake mwili wa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Goika Esabato koyaerire, Mariamu Magidalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo, na Salome, bakagora amaguta yamanukato, banyare kogenda komoaka.

English: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi na mapema, siku ya kwanza ya juma, mara tu baada ya kuchomoza jua, walikwenda kaburini.
Ekegusii: Goika mambia chuni, rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, bakagenda ase oboina, erioba korikooroka.

English: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
Kiswahili: Njiani wakawa wanaulizana wao kwa wao, “Ni nani atakayetuvingirishia lile jiwe kutoka kwenye ingilio la kaburi?”
Ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ning’o oranyare gototigereria rigena riria korwa ase egesieri ki’oboina?”

English: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
Kiswahili: Lakini walipotazama, wakaona lile jiwe, ambalo lilikuwa kubwa sana, limekwisha kuvingirishwa kutoka pale penye ingilio la kaburi.
Ekegusii: Goika bagachia korigereria bakarora ng’a rigena riria riatigerigwe, na rirorio nigo riarenge rinene mono.

English: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakiingia mle kaburini, wakamwona kijana mmoja aliyevaa joho jeupe akiwa ameketi upande wa kuume, nao wakastaajabu.
Ekegusii: Bagasoa oboina ime, bakarora omomura oikaransete ensemo y’okorio, bweboyetie eanga endabu, bakegosa.

English: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!
Kiswahili: Yule malaika akawaambia, “Msistaajabu. Mnamtafuta Yesu, Mnazareti, aliyesulubiwa. Amefufuka! Hayuko hapa. Tazameni mahali walipomlaza.
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, “Timoichana; Yeso Omonazareti mokorigia, oria obambetwe. Ere obookire, tari aiga. Rigereria aase bamobegete!

English: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini nendeni mkawaambie wanafunzi wake pamoja na Petro, kwamba, ‘Anawatangulia kwenda Galilaya. Huko ndiko mtamwona, kama alivyowaambia.’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende genda, moteebie aborokigwa baye, na Petero, ng’a obatang’aneire kogenda Galili. Agwo nao moramorore, buna abateebeetie.”

English: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakatoka, wakakimbia kutoka mle kaburini wakiwa na hofu kuu na mshangao. Nao hawakumwambia mtu yeyote neno lolote, kwa sababu waliogopa.
Ekegusii: Bakarua agwo, bagatama korwa ase oboina, ekiagera basoetwe nekeondoko na ogokumia. Tibateebetie monto ing’ana, ekiagera bairogete.

English: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipofufuka alfajiri na mapema siku ya kwanza ya juma alimtokea kwanza Maria Magdalene, yule ambaye alikuwa amemtoa pepo wachafu saba.
Ekegusii: Yeso ekero abookire, mambia rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma akaorokera ritang’ani Mariamu Magidalena, ere oria arusetie ebirecha bitano na bibere.

English: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
Kiswahili: Maria akaenda, naye akawaambia wale waliokuwa wamefuatana na Yesu, waliokuwa wanaomboleza na kulia.
Ekegusii: Oyo akagenda agateebia baria barenge amo nere korwa kare, baare kweumia na korera.

English: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.
Kiswahili: Lakini waliposikia kwamba Yesu yu hai na kwamba Maria alikuwa amemwona, hawakusadiki.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo, bagachia koigwa ng’a moyo are, na ororirwe nere, tibegena.

English: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.
Kiswahili: Baadaye Yesu akawatokea wawili miongoni mwa wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakienda shambani akiwa katika sura nyingine.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya akaorokera abanto babere ase barabwo, ore nekieni kende ekeao, ekero barenge gotaara kogenda borabu.

English: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.
Kiswahili: Nao wakarudi na kuwaambia wenzao. Lakini hawakuwasadiki wao pia.
Ekegusii: Nabarabwo bakagenda bagateebia abande amang’ana aria, korende abwo tibabegena.

English: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
Kiswahili: Baadaye Yesu akawatokea wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja walipokuwa wakila chakula. Akawakemea kwa kutoamini kwao na kwa ugumu wa mioyo yao kwa kutosadiki wale waliomwona baada yake kufufuka.
Ekegusii: Naende akaorokera baria ikomi nomo, ekero barenge koragera; akabatogonyera ase ogotegena kwabo na obokong’u bw’emioyo yabo, ekiagera bategenete abamorooche kabokire.

English: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Enendeni ulimwenguni kote, mkaihubiri Injili kwa kila kiumbe.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Genda ase ense yonsi, morandie enchiri ase kera egetongwa.

English: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
Kiswahili: Yeyote aaminiye na kubatizwa ataokoka. Lakini yeyote asiyeamini atahukumiwa.
Ekegusii: Oyoregene na kobatiswa, natooreke, ko oyotegeneti, nagambigwe.

English: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;
Kiswahili: Nazo ishara hizi zitafuatana na wanaoamini: Kwa Jina langu watatoa pepo wachafu; watasema kwa lugha mpya;
Ekegusii: Na ebimanyererio ebi bie chinguru nabibatunyane abwo begenire: Ase erieta riane nabaserie ebirecha, nabakwane ase emenwa emeyia,

English: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”
Kiswahili: watashika nyoka kwa mikono yao; na hata wakinywa kitu chochote cha kuua, hakitawadhuru kamwe; wataweka mikono yao juu ya wagonjwa, nao watapona.”
Ekegusii: nababwata ching’iti, gose nabanywa egento kegoita, ko tigekobaita nonya ng’ake; nababeeke amaboko abo igoro ase abarwaire, na barabwo nabagwene.”

English: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Bwana Yesu kusema nao, alichukuliwa juu mbinguni na kuketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabo Omonene Yeso, gakwanire nabarabwo, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, agaikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.

English: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
Kiswahili: Kisha wanafunzi wake wakatoka, wakahubiri kila mahali, naye Bwana akatenda kazi pamoja nao na kulithibitisha neno lake kwa ishara zilizofuatana nalo.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bakaimoka, bakarandia chinsemo chionsi. Omonene akaba ogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo, na goikerania ring’ana ase ebimanyererio bie chinguru ebiabatuny’anete. Amina.

English: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa watu wengi wamekaa ili kuandika habari za mambo yaliyotukia katikati yetu,
Ekegusii: Abanto abange beruete koriika ebirage bi’amang’ana aria aikeranetigwe egati yaito.

English: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
Kiswahili: kama vile yalivyokabidhiwa kwetu na wale waliokuwa mashahidi walioyaona na watumishi wa Bwana,
Ekegusii: Nigo barigete buna intwe twatebetigwe nabwo barenge abarori korwa omochakano na abakori emeremo be ring’ana batorenteire.

English: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;
Kiswahili: mimi nami baada ya kuchunguza kila kitu kwa uangalifu kuanzia mwanzo, niliamua kukuandikia habari za mambo hayo, ewe mtukufu Theofilo,
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainche narorire buya, magega konatukire amang’ana onsi boronge korwa ritang’ani, gokoriikera aye Theofilo bw’amasikani,

English: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.
Kiswahili: ili upate kujua ukweli kuhusu yale uliyofundishwa.
Ekegusii: erinde onyare komanya oboene bw’amang’ana aria kwegeretigwe.

English: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa Herode mfalme wa Uyahudi, palikuwa na kuhani mmoja jina lake Zekaria, ambaye alikuwa wa ukoo wa kikuhani wa Abiya. Elizabeti mkewe alikuwa pia mzao wa Aroni.
Ekegusii: Ekero Herode arenge omorwoti o Boyahudi, narenge Omokuani oyomo, erieta riaye Zakaria, oyo orongebw’ororeria rwa Abiya. Mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Elisabeti oyio orenge omoiseke bw’ororeria rw’ Omokuani Aroni.
