English: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Zekaria na Elizabeti mkewe wote walikuwa watu wanyofu mbele za Mungu, wakizishika amri zote za Bwana na maagizo yote bila lawama.
Ekegusii: Na bonsi babere nigo barenge abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae; nigo babwatetie amachiiko ne chinchera chionsi chi’Omonene batari na komocha.

English: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
Kiswahili: Lakini walikuwa hawana watoto, kwa sababu Elizabeti alikuwa tasa; nao wote wawili walikuwa wazee sana.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibarenge nomwana, ekiagera Elisabeti nigo arenge omogomba, na barabwo bonsi babere konya bagotire mono.

English: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division
Kiswahili: Siku moja ilipokuwa zamu ya kikundi cha Zekaria, yeye akifanya kazi ya ukuhani Hekaluni mbele za Mungu,
Ekegusii: Na ekero riika ria Zakaria ri’ogokora emeremo y’obokuani ase obosio bwa Nyasae riarenge,

English: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
Kiswahili: alichaguliwa kwa kura kwa kufuata desturi za ukuhani, kuingia Hekaluni mwa Bwana ili kufukiza uvumba.
Ekegusii: kobwatekana nengencho y’obokuani, obomera bokamogwera asoe ase Hekalu y’Omonene asambe ubani.

English: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
Kiswahili: Nao wakati wa kufukiza uvumba ulipowadia, wale wote waliokuwa wamekusanyika ili kuabudu walikuwa nje wakiomba.
Ekegusii: Na omoganda bwonsi bw’abaanto nigo orenge isiko gosaba ekero ki’ogosamba ubani.

English: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
Kiswahili: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana, akiwa amesimama upande wa kuume wa madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba, akamtokea Zekaria.
Ekegusii: Zakaria akaorokerwa nomomalaika bw’Omonene, oteneine ensemo ya borio y’egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ubani.

English: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
Kiswahili: Zekaria alipomwona huyo malaika, akafadhaika sana, akajawa na hofu.
Ekegusii: Ere agaichana gachia komorora, na omoondoko okamobwata.

English: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
Kiswahili: Lakini malaika akamwambia, “Usiogope, Zekaria, kwa maana Mungu amesikia maombi yako. Mkeo Elizabeti atakuzalia mtoto wa kiume, nawe utamwita jina lake Yohana.
Ekegusii: Korende omomalaika oria akamoteebia, Toiroka, Zakaria, ekiagera ogosaba kwao kwaigurwe, na mokao Elisabeti nakoiborere omwana omoisia, na erieta riaye nomoroke Yohana.

English: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
Kiswahili: Yeye atakuwa furaha na shangwe kwako, nao watu wengi watashangilia kwa sababu ya kuzaliwa kwake.
Ekegusii: Aye nobe nomogooko na ogosasooka, na abanto abange nabagokere okoiborwa kwaye,

English: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa atakuwa mkuu mbele za Bwana, kamwe hataonja mvinyo wala kinywaji chochote cha kulevya, naye atajazwa Roho Mtakatifu hata kabla ya kuzaliwa kwake.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nabe omonene ase obosio bw’Omonene. Takonywa edivai gose ekenyugwa kegotindia; ere naichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu, nonya nkorwa enda ya ng’ina.

English: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.
Kiswahili: Naye atawageuza wengi wa wana wa Israeli warudi kwa Bwana Mungu wao.
Ekegusii: Naonchore abange b’Abaisraeli gocha ase Omonene, Nyasae obo.

English: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”
Kiswahili: Naye atatangulia mbele za Bwana katika roho na nguvu ya Eliya, ili kuigeuza mioyo ya baba kuwaelekea watoto wao, na wasiotii warejee katika hekima ya wenye haki, ili kuliweka tayari taifa lililoandaliwa kwa ajili ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ere natang’ane bosio bwaye ase omoika ne chinguru chi’Elija, aonchore chinkoro chi’abaise ase abana baabo, na aonchore abamochi ase obong’aini bw’abanyene oboronge, abeekere ang’e Omonene abanto baroisiigwe.

English: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
Kiswahili: Zekaria akamuuliza malaika, “Jambo hilo linawezekanaje? Mimi ni mzee na mke wangu pia ana umri mkubwa.”
Ekegusii: Zakaria agateebia omomalaika, “Naki ndakore imanye ayio? Ekiagera inche nomogotu, na mokane nagendererete kogota.”

English: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
Kiswahili: Malaika akamjibu, akamwambia, “Mimi ni Gabrieli, nisimamaye mbele za Mungu, nami nimetumwa kwako ili nikuambie habari hizi njema.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoiraneria, “Ninche Gabirieli, ngotenena ase obosio bwa Nyasae; ninche natomwa nkwane naye, ngoteebie amang’ana aya amaya.

English: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”
Kiswahili: Basi sasa kwa kuwa hujaamini maneno yangu ambayo yatatimizwa kwa wakati wake, utakuwa bubu hadi siku ile mambo haya yatakapotukia.”
Ekegusii: Korende bono aye ekiagera otegena amang’ana aane ayio agochia kooroka chingaki chiaye rora aye nobe rimama, tonyara gokwana goika rituko riria ayio agocha kooroka.”

English: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo watu walikuwa wanamngojea Zekaria nje huku wakishangaa kukawia kwake mle Hekaluni.
Ekegusii: Chingaki echio abanto baria baganyete Zakaria, bagakumia ase ogotebana kwaye ime ase Hekalu.

English: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.
Kiswahili: Alipotoka akawa hawezi kusema nao, wao wakatambua kuwa ameona maono ndani ya Hekalu. Lakini kwa kuwa alikuwa bubu, akawa anawaashiria kwa mikono.
Ekegusii: Ekero asogete isiko, tanyarete gokwana nabarabwo; erio barabwo bakamanya ng’a nigo arora okorora aria Hekalu ime. Ere nigo arenge kobateeberia nokoboko, akagenderera koba rimama.

English: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
Kiswahili: Muda wake wa kuhudumu Hekaluni ulipomalizika, akarudi nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye y’ogokora emeremo aerete, ere akagenda bwoye.

English: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda usio mrefu, Elizabeti mkewe akapata mimba, naye akajitenga kwa miezi mitano.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko aria mokaye Elisabeti akaba morito, akebisa emetienyi etano, ogoteeba,

English: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Hili ndilo Bwana alilonitendea aliponiangalia kwa upendeleo na kuniondolea aibu yangu mbele ya watu.”
Ekegusii: “Igo nabo Omonene ankoreire ase amatuko aya andigereretie, na konduseria obosooku bwane ase amasio y’abanto.”

English: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,
Kiswahili: Mwezi wa sita baada ya Elizabeti kupata mimba, Mungu alimtuma malaika Gabrieli aende Galilaya katika mji wa Nazareti,
Ekegusii: Omotienyi bw’etano nomo omomalaika Gabirieli agatomwa na Nyasae kogenda omochie o Galili, okorokwa Nazareti,

English: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
Kiswahili: kwa mwanamwali bikira aliyekuwa ameposwa na mtu mmoja jina lake Yosefu wa nyumba ya Daudi. Jina la huyu mwanamwali bikira ni Maria.
Ekegusii: ase omoiseke omwekungi oriereire boko nomosaacha, erieta riaye Yusufu, bw’eamate ya Daudi, na erieta ri’omoiseke oria Mariamu.

English: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
Kiswahili: Naye malaika akaja kwake akamwambia: “Salamu, wewe uliyebarikiwa, Bwana yu pamoja nawe!”
Ekegusii: Agacha asare, akabora, “Mbuya ore aye, oyobwanchererie. Omonene nigo are amo naye.”

English: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
Kiswahili: Maria akafadhaishwa sana na maneno haya, akajiuliza moyoni, “Salamu hii ni ya namna gani?”
Ekegusii: Mariamu agaichana mono ase ring’ana eri, erio ere akebooria, “Ngokwania ki oko?”

English: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
Kiswahili: Ndipo malaika akamwambia, “Usiogope, Maria, umepata kibali kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoteebia, Toiroka Mariamu, ekiagera kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase Nyasae.

English: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’
Kiswahili: Tazama, utachukua mimba, nawe utamzaa mtoto mwanaume na utamwita jina lake Yesu.
Ekegusii: Rora, nobe morito, noibore omwana omoisia, nomoroke erieta riaye Yeso.

English: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,
Kiswahili: Yeye atakuwa mkuu, naye ataitwa Mwana wa Aliye Juu Sana. Bwana Mungu atampa kiti cha enzi cha Daudi baba yake.
Ekegusii: Oyio nabe omonene, narokwe Omwana o Nyasae ore Igoro Mono; n’Omonene namoe ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi sokoro yaye;

English: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Ataimiliki nyumba ya Yakobo milele, na ufalme wake hautakuwa na mwisho.”
Ekegusii: nagaambere enyomba ya Yakobo goika kare na kare; nonya noborwoti bwaye tibokoba nomoerio.

English: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
Kiswahili: Maria akamuuliza huyo malaika, “Maadamu mimi ni bikira, jambo hili litawezekanaje?”
Ekegusii: Mariamu akabooria omomalaika oria, “Naki rirabe ring’ana eri, ekiagera tindaba nomosaacha?”

English: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
Kiswahili: Malaika akamjibu, “Roho Mtakatifu atakujilia juu yako, nazo nguvu zake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana zitakufunika kama kivuli. Kwa hiyo mtoto atakayezaliwa atakuwa mtakatifu, naye ataitwa Mwana wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoteebia, “Omoika Omochenu nogochere, ne chinguru chiaye Oyore Igoro Mono nachikobekere ekiriri. Ase ayio, oyoraiborwe narokwe Omochenu, Omwana o Nyasae.

English: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
Kiswahili: Tazama, jamaa yako Elizabeti amechukua mimba katika uzee wake, na huu ni mwezi wake wa sita, yeye aliyeitwa tasa.
Ekegusii: Rora, Elisabeti omoamate oo, nere boigo nare noborito bw’omwana omoisia ase obogotu bwaye; na omotienyi oyo noyo bw’etano nomo asare ere oyorogetwe omogomba.

English: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa Mungu hakuna lisilowezekana.”
Ekegusii: Naki ing’ana tiriri ritanyarekane ase Nyasae.”

English: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.
Kiswahili: Maria akasema, “Tazama, mimi ni mtumishi wa Bwana. Na iwe kwangu kama ulivyosema.” Kisha malaika akaondoka, akamwacha.
Ekegusii: Mariamu akabora, “Rora, inche nomosomba bw’Omonene; abe ase ’nde buna ring’ana riao.” Omomalaika akaimoka akarua asare.

English: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Maria akajiandaa, akaharakisha kwenda katika mji mmoja kwenye vilima vya Uyahudi.
Ekegusii: Mariamu akaimoka ase amatuko ayio, akagenda bwango ase ebitunwa goika omochie oyomo o Yuda,

English: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
Kiswahili: Akaingia nyumbani kwa Zekaria na kumsalimu Elizabeti.
Ekegusii: agasoa nyomba mwa Zakaria, agakwania Elisabeti.

English: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Naye Elizabeti aliposikia salamu ya Maria, mtoto aliyekuwa tumboni mwake akaruka. Elizabeti akajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu,
Ekegusii: Ekaba Elisabeti agachia koigwa ogokwania kwa Mariamu, omwana omoke agatuma ase enda yaye ime; Elisabeti agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu,

English: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
Kiswahili: akapaza sauti kwa nguvu akasema, “Umebarikiwa wewe miongoni mwa wanawake, naye mtoto utakayemzaa amebarikiwa.
Ekegusii: agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, agakwana, “Gwaseseniigwe aye ase abakungu, na oroiboro rw’enda yao rwasesenigwe.

English: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
Kiswahili: Lakini ni kwa nini mimi nimepata upendeleo kiasi hiki, hata mama wa Bwana wangu afike kwangu?
Ekegusii: Ng’ai ring’ana eri riarure, ng’ina Omonene one anchicheire inche?

English: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
Kiswahili: Mara tu niliposikia sauti ya salamu yako, mtoto aliyeko tumboni mwangu aliruka kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera rora, eriogi ri’ogokwania kwao riachia gosoa ase amato aane, omwana omoke otuma ase omosasoko ase enda yane ime.

English: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
Kiswahili: Amebarikiwa yeye aliyeamini kwamba lile Bwana alilomwambia litatimizwa.”
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyobwegenete ng’a amang’ana ayio ateebigwe n’Omonene naikeranigwe.”

English: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
Kiswahili: Naye Maria akasema: “Moyo wangu wamwadhimisha Bwana,
Ekegusii: Mariamu agateeba, “Omoyo one otogirie Omonene,

English: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
Kiswahili: nayo roho yangu inamfurahia Mungu Mwokozi wangu,
Ekegusii: omoika one ogokeire Nyasae, Omotoria one,

English: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa ameangalia kwa fadhili unyonge wa mtumishi wake. Hakika tangu sasa vizazi vyote vitaniita aliyebarikiwa,
Ekegusii: ekiagera origereirie obwororo bw’omoiseke omosomba oye. Naki ekeene, korwa reero ebigori bionsi nabindoke omosesenigwa,

English: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
Kiswahili: kwa maana yeye Mwenye Nguvu amenitendea mambo ya ajabu: jina lake ni takatifu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera ere oyore ne chinguru onkoreire amanene, na erieta riaye nerichenu.

English: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.
Kiswahili: Rehema zake huwaendea wale wamchao, kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi.
Ekegusii: Amaabera aye nigo are ase abwo bamoirogete korwa ebigori goika ebigori.

English: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ametenda mambo ya ajabu kwa mkono wake; amewatawanya wale wenye kiburi ndani ya mioyo yao.
Ekegusii: Okorire ogokora gwe chinguru, oserebanirie abaenenu ase ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo.

English: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
Kiswahili: Amewashusha watawala toka kwenye viti vyao vya enzi, lakini amewainua wanyenyekevu.
Ekegusii: Okeeirie abanene korwa ase ebirogo biabo bi’obonene, oimokereirie igoro abaitongo.

English: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
Kiswahili: Amewashibisha wenye njaa kwa vitu vizuri, bali matajiri amewafukuza mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Abare nenchara obaigotirie amaya; abanyene enibo obaseririe bare namaboko amasa.

English: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
Kiswahili: Amemsaidia mtumishi wake Israeli, kwa kukumbuka ahadi yake ya kumrehemu
Ekegusii: Okonyire Israeli, omosomba oye, ase okoinyora amaabera aye,

English: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
Kiswahili: Abrahamu na uzao wake milele, kama alivyowaahidi baba zetu.”
Ekegusii: buna atebeetie chisokoro chiaito, Aburaamu na oroiboro rwaye, goika kare na kare.”

English: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
Kiswahili: Maria akakaa na Elizabeti karibu miezi mitatu, kisha akarudi nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Mariamu akamenya nere emetienyi etato, akairana sobo.

English: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
Kiswahili: Ulipowadia wakati wa Elizabeti kujifungua, alizaa mtoto mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Engaki yokoibora kwa Elisabeti egaika, ere akaibora omwana omoisia.

English: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
Kiswahili: Majirani zake na jamii zake wakasikia jinsi Bwana alivyomfanyia rehema kuu, nao wakafurahi pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Abairi na eamate yaye bakaigwa ng’a Omonene omororeire amaabera amange, bakagoka amo nere.

English: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
Kiswahili: Siku ya nane wakaja kumtahiri mtoto, wakataka yule mtoto aitwe Zekaria, ambalo ndilo jina la baba yake.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaira omwana komwarokia, bakarigia bamoroke erieta ria ise, Zakaria,

English: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mama yake akakataa na kusema, “Hapana! Jina lake ataitwa Yohana.”
Ekegusii: korende ng’ina akairaneria, akabora, “Taibo; nigo ararokwe Yohana.”

English: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Hakuna mtu yeyote katika jamaa yako mwenye jina kama hilo.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Tari nonya noyomo ase eamate yao okorokwa erieta erio.”

English: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
Kiswahili: Basi wakamfanyia Zekaria baba yake ishara ili kujua kwamba yeye angependa kumpa mtoto jina gani.
Ekegusii: Bakorokia ise ase ogokwana kw’ebimanyererio bi’amaboko, komoboria buna arigetie arokwe.

English: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.
Kiswahili: Akaomba wampe kibao cha kuandikia na kwa mshangao wa kila mtu akaandika: “Jina lake ni Yohana.”
Ekegusii: Agasaba ebao y’okorika, akarika “Yohana, nario erieta riaye.” Bagakumia bonsi.

English: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
Kiswahili: Papo hapo kinywa chake kikafunguliwa na ulimi wake ukaachiwa, akawa anaongea akimsifu Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima agasiborwa omonwa na oromeme rwaye, agakwana, ogotogia Nyasae.

English: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
Kiswahili: Majirani wote wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, na katika nchi yote ya vilima vya Uyahudi watu walikuwa wakinena juu ya mambo haya yote.
Ekegusii: Obwoba bogasoa ase abairi babo bonsi. Amang’ana aya onsi agasaarera ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa bia Boyahudi.

English: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
Kiswahili: Kila aliyesikia habari hizi alishangaa akauliza, “Je, mtoto huyu atakuwa mtu wa namna gani?” Maana mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Na bonsi abayaigwete bakayabeeka ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakaboora, “Mwana ki rende arabe oyo?” Naki okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nere.

English: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
Kiswahili: Zekaria, baba yake, akajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu, naye akatoa unabii, akisema:
Ekegusii: Zakaria ise agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, akabana, okobora,

English: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
Kiswahili: “Ahimidiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa kuwa amewajilia watu wake na kuwakomboa.
Ekegusii: “Omonene, Nyasae o Israeli, atogigwe, ekiagera obacheire abanto baye na kobabooria.

English: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
Kiswahili: Naye ametusimamishia pembe ya wokovu katika nyumba ya Daudi mtumishi wake,
Ekegusii: Naende ototeneneirie Omotooria bw’okobua ase eamate ya Daudi, omosomba oye.

English: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
Kiswahili: kama alivyonena kwa vinywa vya manabii wake watakatifu tangu zamani,
Ekegusii: Buna ateebete korwa omochakano goetera ase emenwa y’ababani baye abachenu,

English: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;
Kiswahili: kwamba atatuokoa kutoka kwa adui zetu, na kutoka mikononi mwao wote watuchukiao:
Ekegusii: ng’a natotoorigwe korwa ase ababisa baito, na korwa ase amaboko abo bonsi abatogechete,

English: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
Kiswahili: ili kuonyesha rehema kwa baba zetu na kukumbuka Agano lake takatifu,
Ekegusii: erinde abarorere amaabera chisokoro chiaito, na koinyora okobwatana kwaye ogochenu.

English: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,
Kiswahili: kiapo alichomwapia baba yetu Abrahamu:
Ekegusii: Emuma eria arierete sokoro yaito Aburaamu,

English: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
Kiswahili: kutuokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zetu, tupate kumtumikia yeye pasipo hofu
Ekegusii: ng’a natoe ribaga ri’okomosasiima totari nobwoba, gatoratoorigwe korwa ase amaboko y’ababisa baito,

English: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
Kiswahili: katika utakatifu na haki mbele zake, siku zetu zote.
Ekegusii: ase obochenu na ase oboronge ase obosio bwaye amatuko aito onsi.

English: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
Kiswahili: “Nawe mtoto wangu, utaitwa nabii wa Aliye Juu Sana; kwa kuwa utamtangulia Bwana na kuandaa njia kwa ajili yake,
Ekegusii: Naye, Omwana, norokwe omobani bw’Oyore Igoro Mono, ekiagera notang’ane ase obosio bw’Omonene. Oroisie chinchera chiaye,

English: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,
Kiswahili: kuwajulisha watu wake juu ya wokovu utakaopatikana kwa kusamehewa dhambi zao,
Ekegusii: omanyie abanto baye ogotooreka ase okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo.

English: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,
Kiswahili: kwa ajili ya wingi wa rehema za Mungu wetu, nuru itokayo juu itatuzukia
Ekegusii: Ase amaabera aye Nyasae oito, ekero amasase a igoro aratochere,

English: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
Kiswahili: ili kuwaangazia wale waishio gizani na katika uvuli wa mauti, kuiongoza miguu yetu katika njia ya amani.”
Ekegusii: ababerere abamenyete ase omosunte na ase ekiriri ki’amakweri, na koraa amagoro aito ase enchera y’omorembe.”

English: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
Kiswahili: Yule mtoto akakua na kuongezeka nguvu katika roho; akaishi nyikani hadi siku ile alipojionyesha hadharani kwa Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Omwana oria agakiina, akamenteka chinguru ase omoika, akaba ase erooro goika rituko riria aorogete ase Abaisraeli.

English: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.
Kiswahili: Siku zile Kaisari Augusto alitoa amri kwamba watu wote waandikishwe katika ulimwengu wa Kirumi.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ogochika gokarua ase Kaisari Augusto, ng’a omobaro bw’abaanto oriikwe ase ense yonsi.

English: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
Kiswahili: (Orodha hii ndiyo ya kwanza iliyofanyika wakati Krenio alikuwa mtawala wa Shamu).
Ekegusii: Oyo noro orenge omobaro bw’eritang’ani oriigetwe ekero Kurenio arenge gabana o Siiria.

English: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu alikwenda kuandikishwa katika mji wake alikozaliwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakagenda koriikwa, kera omonto ase omochie oye.

English: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yosefu akapanda kutoka mji wa Nazareti ulioko Galilaya kwenda Uyahudi, mpaka Bethlehemu, mji wa Daudi, kwa sababu yeye alikuwa wa ukoo na wa nyumba ya Daudi.
Ekegusii: Na Yusufu nere akaimoka korwa Galili korwa ase omochie o Nazareti, agatiira kogenda Boyahudi, goika Omochie o Daudi, okorokwa Bethlehemu, ekiagera nigo arenge oyo bw’enyomba na eamate ya Daudi,

English: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
Kiswahili: Alikwenda huko kujiandikisha pamoja na Maria, ambaye alikuwa amemposa naye alikuwa mjamzito.
Ekegusii: erinde ariikwe amo na Mariamu, ekiagera konya omoriereire boko, na Mariamu nigo arenge morito.

English: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa Bethlehemu, wakati wa Maria wa kujifungua ukawa umetimia,
Ekegusii: Ekero barenge aroro engaki yaye y’okoibora egaika.

English: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
Kiswahili: naye akamzaa mwanawe, kifungua mimba. Akamfunika nguo za kitoto na kumlaza katika hori ya kulia ngʼombe, kwa sababu hapakuwa na nafasi katika nyumba ya wageni.
Ekegusii: Akaibora omwana oye omoisia omotangi, akamobekera chianga chi’obwana, akamwareria ase orotuba chiombe chiare koriera, ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ase enyomba y’abageni.

English: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
Kiswahili: Katika eneo lile walikuwako wachungaji waliokuwa wakikaa mashambani, wakilinda makundi yao ya kondoo usiku.
Ekegusii: Ase ense eyio mbarengeo abarisia baikaransete ase ebitii, bakorenda amaicho abo botuko.

English: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
Kiswahili: Ghafula tazama, malaika wa Bwana akawatokea, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukawangʼaria kotekote, wakaingiwa na hofu.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene akabaorokera, na obonene bw’Omonene bokabaabarera; bagasogwa nomoondoko omonge.

English: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
Kiswahili: Lakini malaika akawaambia: “Msiogope. Kwa maana tazama nawaletea habari njema za furaha itakayokuwa kwa watu wote.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika akabateebia, “Timoiroka, ekiagera nabarenteire amang’ana amaya ay’omogooko omonene, oraabe ase abanto bonsi,

English: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
Kiswahili: Leo katika mji wa Daudi kwa ajili yenu amezaliwa Mwokozi, ndiye Kristo Bwana.
Ekegusii: naki reero ase Omochie o Daudi oiboirwe Omotooria ase engencho yaino, nere Kristo Omonene.

English: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo itakayokuwa ishara kwenu: Mtamkuta mtoto mchanga amefunikwa nguo za kitoto na kulazwa katika hori ya kulia ngʼombe.”
Ekegusii: Na eke nekemanyererio ase more: Namonyore omwana ekeng’werere obekeire chianga chi’obwana, bwareirie ase orotuba.”

English: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,
Kiswahili: Ghafula pakawa na jeshi kubwa la mbinguni pamoja na huyo malaika wakimsifu Mungu wakisema,
Ekegusii: Bwango igo mbarengeo amo nomomalaika oria omoganda o igoro, bagotogia Nyasae, bakoboora,

English: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
Kiswahili: “Atukuzwe Mungu juu mbinguni, na duniani iwe amani kwa watu aliowaridhia.”
Ekegusii: “Obonene ase Nyasae ore Igoro Mono, na ase ense omorembe, ase abanto abwo bancheirwe nere.”

English: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
Kiswahili: Hao malaika walipokwisha kuondoka na kwenda zao mbinguni, wale wachungaji wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Twendeni Bethlehemu tukaone mambo haya ya ajabu yaliyotukia, ambayo Bwana ametuambia habari zake.”
Ekegusii: Ekero abamalaika abwo bachia koimoka kogenda igoro, abarisia baria bagateebania, “Gaki togende goika Bethlehemu, torore ring’ana eri riakorekire, eri Omonene atomanyirie.”

English: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakaenda haraka Bethlehemu, wakawakuta Maria na Yosefu na yule mtoto mchanga akiwa amelala katika hori la kulia ngʼombe.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda nomoayerero, bakanyora Mariamu na Yusufu, na omwana oria ekeng’werere bwareirie ase orotuba.

English: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
Kiswahili: Walipomwona yule mtoto, wakawaeleza yale waliyokuwa wameambiwa kuhusu huyo mtoto.
Ekegusii: Bagachia komorora, bakaorokia ring’ana bateebetigwe igoro y’omwana oyio.

English: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
Kiswahili: Nao wote waliosikia habari hizi wakastaajabia yale waliyoambiwa na wale wachungaji wa kondoo.
Ekegusii: Bonsi abaigwete bagakumia ase aria bateebetigwe nabarisia.

English: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
Kiswahili: Lakini Maria akayaweka mambo haya yote moyoni mwake na kuyatafakari.
Ekegusii: Korende Mariamu akagacha amang’ana aya onsi, okoyarengereria ase enkoro yaye.

English: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
Kiswahili: Wale wachungaji wakarudi, huku wakimtukuza Mungu na kumsifu kwa ajili ya mambo yote waliyokuwa wameambiwa na kuyaona.
Ekegusii: Abarisia bakairana, bagotogia Nyasae na komobaka ase amang’ana onsi baigwete, na ayabaroche, buna bateebetigwe.

English: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
Kiswahili: Hata zilipotimia siku nane, ulikuwa ndio wakati wa kumtahiri mtoto, akaitwa Yesu, jina alilokuwa amepewa na malaika kabla hajatungwa mimba.
Ekegusii: Rigachia goika rituko ria gatano na gatato, rituko ri’okomwarokia, akarokwa erieta riaye Yeso, riria riatoretwe nomomalaika ritang’ani atarabogorigwa oborito.

English: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord
Kiswahili: Ulipotimia wakati wa utakaso wake Maria kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Mose, basi Yosefu na Maria walimpeleka mtoto Yerusalemu, ili kumweka wakfu kwa Bwana
Ekegusii: Na ekero amatuko ogwesibia kwabo achia goika, ayachikiire ase amachiiko a Musa, bakamoira Yerusalemu, bamobeke ase Omonene

English: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
Kiswahili: (kama ilivyoandikwa katika Sheria ya Bwana, kwamba, “Kila mtoto wa kiume kifungua mimba atawekwa wakfu kwa Bwana”),
Ekegusii: (buna ariikire ase amachiiko y’Omonene, “Kera omoisia omotangi okoigora enda ya ng’ina narokwe omochenu ase Omonene”),

English: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
Kiswahili: na pia kutoa dhabihu kulingana na yale yaliyonenwa katika Sheria ya Bwana: “Hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa.”
Ekegusii: barue ekeng’wanso buna ariikire ase amachiiko o Omonene, “Amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere.”

English: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
Kiswahili: Basi alikuwako huko Yerusalemu mtu mmoja jina lake Simeoni, ambaye alikuwa mwenye haki na mcha Mungu, akitarajia faraja ya Israeli, na Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa juu yake.
Ekegusii: Rora narengeo omonto Yerusalemu, erieta riaye Simioni. Oyio nigo arenge omonto omooronge, na nigo asigete Nyasae, ere nigo aganyete ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli; na Omoika Omochenu nigo orenge igoro asare.

English: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
Kiswahili: Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa amemfunulia kuwa hatakufa kabla hajamwona Kristo wa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo aorokereretigwe n’Omoika Omochenu, ng’a takorora amakweri atararora Kristo Omonene.

English: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
Kiswahili: Simeoni, akiwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu, alikwenda Hekaluni. Wazazi walipomleta mtoto Yesu ili kumfanyia kama ilivyokuwa desturi ya Sheria,
Ekegusii: Nabo akaraagwa n’Omoika gocha ase Hekalu ime; na ekero abaibori bachia korenta omwana Yeso, bamokorere buna yarenge engencho y’amachiiko,

English: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,
Kiswahili: ndipo Simeoni akampokea mtoto mikononi mwake na kumsifu Mungu, akisema:
Ekegusii: Simioni akamonyora, akamoagata ase amaboko aye, agatogia Nyasae, akabora,

English: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
Kiswahili: “Bwana Mwenyezi, kama ulivyoahidi, sasa wamruhusu mtumishi wako aende zake kwa amani.
Ekegusii: “Omonene, bono otige omosomba oo agende nomorembe, koreng’ana nering’ana riao.

English: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana macho yangu yameuona wokovu wako,
Ekegusii: Ekiagera amaiso aane arorire ogotooreka kwao,

English: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
Kiswahili: ulioweka tayari machoni pa watu wote,
Ekegusii: oko kwabekire ase amaiso y’abanto bonsi,

English: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
Kiswahili: nuru kwa ajili ya ufunuo kwa watu wa Mataifa na kwa ajili ya utukufu kwa watu wako Israeli.”
Ekegusii: omobaso okomorekera abanto b’Ebisaku, na obonene bw’abaanto bao Abaisraeli.”

English: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.
Kiswahili: Naye Yosefu na mama yake mtoto wakastaajabu kwa yale yaliyokuwa yamesemwa kumhusu huyo mtoto.
Ekegusii: Ise na ng’ina bagakumia ase aria akwanwa igoro asare.

English: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
Kiswahili: Kisha Simeoni akawabariki, akamwambia Maria mama yake, “Mtoto huyu amewekwa kwa makusudi ya kuanguka na kuinuka kwa wengi katika Israeli. Atakuwa ishara ambayo watu watanena dhidi yake,
Ekegusii: Simioni akabasesenia, agateebia Mariamu ng’ina, “Rora, Omwana oyo otenenigwe ase ogosira na ogotoreka ase abange b’Abaisraeli, abe ekiorokererio kerabe kegokwanwa mamincha,

English: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
Kiswahili: ili mawazo ya mioyo mingi yadhihirike. Nao upanga utauchoma moyo wako.”
Ekegusii: erinde ebirengererio bie chinkoro chinyinge biorokigwe. Boigo omoro nokobete omoyo oo.”

English: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
Kiswahili: Tena alikuwako Hekaluni nabii mmoja mwanamke, jina lake Ana binti Fanueli, wa kabila la Asheri. Alikuwa mzee sana; naye alikuwa ameolewa na kuishi na mume kwa miaka saba tu, kisha mumewe akafa.
Ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu omobani, Anna, omoiseke o Fanueli, bw’egesaku ki’Asheri. Ere nomong’ina bw’amatuko amange, obete nomosaacha oye emiaka etano na ebere magega y’okoera kw’oboiseke bwaye.

English: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.
Kiswahili: Hivyo alikuwa mjane na umri wake ulikuwa miaka themanini na minne. Yeye hakuondoka humo Hekaluni usiku wala mchana, bali alikuwa akimwabudu Mungu, akifunga na kuomba.
Ekegusii: Ere agatigara ore omoboraka goika emiaka emerongo etano etato na ene (84), atana korua ase Hekalu ime, korende akaba okweng’ata, na ogosaba, na ogosasiima obotuko na omobaso.

English: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, Ana alikuja akaanza kusifu, akimshukuru Mungu na kusema habari za huyo mtoto kwa watu wote waliokuwa wakitarajia ukombozi wa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero keria ere akaoroka, agatogia Nyasae, agateebia abanto bonsi abarenge baganyete okoboorigwa kwa Yerusalemu amang’ana igoro y’Omwana oria.

English: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
Kiswahili: Yosefu na Maria walipokuwa wamekamilisha mambo yote yaliyotakiwa na Sheria ya Bwana, walirudi mjini kwao Nazareti huko Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia gokoora goikerania onsi koreng’ana namachiiko Omonene, bakairana Galili goika omochie obo Nazareti.

English: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
Kiswahili: Naye yule mtoto akakua na kuongezeka nguvu, akiwa amejaa hekima, na neema ya Mungu ilikuwa juu yake.
Ekegusii: Omwana oria agakiina, akamenteka chinguru, agaichorwa nobong’aini ne chisemi; na akanyora ogwancherwa ase Nyasae.

English: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
Kiswahili: Kila mwaka Yosefu na Maria mama yake Yesu walikuwa na desturi ya kwenda Yerusalemu kwa ajili ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka.
Ekegusii: Nabo abaibori baye barenge kogenda Yerusalemu kera omwaka ase rituko rinene ri’Epasaka.

English: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili, walipanda kwenda kwenye Sikukuu hiyo kama ilivyokuwa desturi.
Ekegusii: Goika agachia koba nemiaka ikomi na ebere, bagatiira kogenda aroro, buna yarenge engencho ye Rituko Rinene.

English: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,
Kiswahili: Baada ya Sikukuu kumalizika, wakati Yosefu na Maria mama yake walipokuwa wakirudi nyumbani, Yesu alibaki Yerusalemu lakini hawakutambua.
Ekegusii: Ekero Epasaka yaera, ekero barenge koirana, omwana Yeso agatigara magega agwo Yerusalemu, na abaibori baye tibamanya.

English: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
Kiswahili: Wao wakidhani kuwa yuko miongoni mwa wasafiri, walienda mwendo wa kutwa nzima. Ndipo wakaanza kumtafuta miongoni mwa jamaa zao na marafiki.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagakaga ng’a nigo are ase omoganda obo, bakagenda orogendo rw’omobaso oyomo, bakamorigia ase abairi babo boigo nabasani.

English: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
Kiswahili: Walipomkosa walirudi Yerusalemu ili kumtafuta.
Ekegusii: Ekero batamonyorete, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakamorigia.

English: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku tatu wakamkuta ndani ya Hekalu, akiwa ameketi katikati ya walimu wa sheria, akiwasikiliza na kuwauliza maswali.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riagatato bakamonyora Hekalu ime, oikaransete gati ase aborokia, obategererete na kobaboria amaborio.

English: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
Kiswahili: Wote waliomsikia walistaajabishwa na uwezo wake mkubwa wa kuelewa, na majibu aliyoyatoa.
Ekegusii: Na bonsi abamoigwete bagakumia ase okomanya kwaye na okoiraneria kwaye.

English: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
Kiswahili: Yosefu na Maria mama yake walipomwona walishangaa. Mama yake akamuuliza, “Mwanangu, mbona umetufanyia hivi? Tazama, mimi na baba yako tumekuwa tukikutafuta kwa wasiwasi mkubwa kila mahali.”
Ekegusii: Abaibori baye bagachia komoorora bagaichana mono. Ng’ina akamoteebia, “Omwana one, naki gwatokorire iga? Rora, iso na inche twarenge gokorigia nomoichano.”

English: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Kwa nini kunitafuta? Hamkujua kwamba imenipasa kuwa katika nyumba ya Baba yangu?”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naki mokondigia? Timomanyeti ng’a nengwenerete koba ase enyomba ya Tata one?”

English: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao hawakuelewa maana ya lile alilowaambia.
Ekegusii: Tibamanya ring’ana riria abateebia.

English: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akashuka pamoja nao hadi Nazareti, naye alikuwa mtiifu kwao. Lakini mama yake akayaweka moyoni mwake mambo haya yote.
Ekegusii: Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agaika Nazareti, akaba nkobaigwera are. Ng’ina akagacha amang’ana aya onsi ase enkoro yaye ime.

English: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
Kiswahili: Naye Yesu akakua katika hekima na kimo, akimpendeza Mungu na wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamenteka gokina ase obong’aini ne chisemi, na ase omobere, akanyora ogwancherwa ase Nyasae na Mwanyabaanto.

English: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na tano wa utawala wa Kaisari Tiberio, Pontio Pilato akiwa mtawala wa Uyahudi, Herode akiwa mfalme wa Galilaya, Filipo ndugu yake akiwa mfalme wa Iturea na nchi ya Trakoniti, na Lisania akiwa mfalme wa Abilene,
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano bw’okogamba gwa Kaisari Tiberio, Pontio Pilato orenge gabana o Boyahudi, na Herode omorwoti o Galili, na Filipo momura omwabo arenge omorwoti o Iturea na ense ya Tarakoniti, na Lusania omorwoti o Abileni,

English: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: nao Anasi na Kayafa wakiwa makuhani wakuu, neno la Mungu likamjia Yohana, mwana wa Zekaria huko jangwani.
Ekegusii: ekero ki’obokuani obonene bw’Anasi na Kayafa, ring’ana ria Nyasae rigaikera Yohana, omwana o Zakaria, ase erooro.

English: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
Kiswahili: Akaenda katika nchi yote kandokando ya Mto Yordani, akihubiri ubatizo wa toba kwa ajili ya msamaha wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Akagenda chinse chionsi chi’ensemo ya Yorodani, okorandia ebatiso y’okoonchoka ekorenta okwaberwa kw’ebibe.

English: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha nabii Isaya: “Sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani, ‘Itengenezeni njia ya Bwana, yanyoosheni mapito yake.
Ekegusii: Buna eriikire ase egetabu y’amang’ana ’omobani Isaya, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro, Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.

English: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
Kiswahili: Kila bonde litajazwa, kila mlima na kilima vitashushwa. Njia zilizopinda zitanyooshwa, na zilizoparuza zitasawazishwa.
Ekegusii: Kera rigooko nariichorigwe, na kera ekegoro na egetunwa nabikeeigwe; aare bogeka inarongeigwe, na enchera ere ebitunwa‐tunwa nereng’anigwe;

English: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”
Kiswahili: Nao watu wote watauona wokovu wa Mungu.’ ”
Ekegusii: na abanto bonsi nabarore ogotooreka gokorwa ase Nyasae.”

English: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
Kiswahili: Yohana akauambia ule umati wa watu uliokuwa unakuja ili kubatizwa naye, “Ninyi watoto wa nyoka! Ni nani aliyewaonya kuikimbia ghadhabu inayokuja?
Ekegusii: Nabo agateebia emeganda eyachete, erinde ebatiswe nere, “Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti, ning’o obakuureire ng’a motame korwa ase endamwamu egochi‐gocha?

English: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!
Kiswahili: Basi zaeni matunda yastahiliyo toba. Wala msianze kusema mioyoni mwenu kuwa, ‘Sisi tunaye Abrahamu, baba yetu.’ Kwa maana nawaambia kuwa Mungu anaweza kumwinulia Abrahamu watoto kutoka mawe haya.
Ekegusii: Gaki, ama okwama kogwenerete okoonchoka, gose timochaaka kobora emioyo yaino ime: Ntore na sokoro yaito, nere Aburaamu. Naki nabateebirie ng’a Nyasae nare nokobua ase amagena aya gokorera Aburaamu abana.

English: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”
Kiswahili: Hata sasa shoka limeshawekwa tayari kwenye shina la kila mti. Basi kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri hukatwa na kutupwa motoni.”
Ekegusii: Nonya mbono egesire kiabekirwe ase emeri y’emete; nabo kera omote otameti okwama okuya nonachwe, otugutwe ase omorero.”

English: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukamuuliza, “Inatupasa tufanyeje basi?”
Ekegusii: Emeganda eria ekamoboria, “Ninki rende torakore?”

English: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
Kiswahili: Yohana akawaambia, “Aliye na kanzu mbili amgawie asiye nayo, naye aliye na chakula na afanye vivyo hivyo.”
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Oyore ne chianga ibere ae ere oyotari nero; na oyore nendagera akore boigo.”

English: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”
Kiswahili: Watoza ushuru nao wakaja ili wabatizwe, wakamuuliza, “Bwana na sisi inatupasa tufanyeje?”
Ekegusii: Abarusia ebango bagacha erinde babatiswe, bakamobooria, “Omworokia, inki rende naintwe torakore?”

English: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Msichukue zaidi ya kiwango mlichopangiwa.”
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timorusia kobua ebi mwachigetwe.”

English: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”
Kiswahili: Askari nao wakamuuliza, “Je, nasi inatupasa tufanye nini?” Akawaambia, “Msimdhulumu mtu wala msimshtaki mtu kwa uongo, bali mridhike na mishahara yenu.”
Ekegusii: Abasikari nabarabwo bakamobooria, “Naintwe inki torakore?” Akabairaneria, “Timourereria monto onde ase chinguru gose ase obosoeri bw’oborimo; naende moisaneke neng’eria yaino.”

English: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
Kiswahili: Watu walikuwa na matazamio makubwa. Wakawa wanajiuliza mioyoni mwao iwapo Yohana angeweza kuwa ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baganyete na konakorengereria, bonsi bakeboria ase chinkoro chiabo ime gose Yohana nere Kristo.

English: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.
Kiswahili: Yohana akawajibu akawaambia, “Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji. Lakini atakuja aliye na nguvu kuniliko mimi, ambaye sistahili hata kufungua kamba za viatu vyake. Yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu na kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria abwo bonsi, “Inche nigo nkobabatisa ase amaache, korende oyore ne chinguru kombua ngocha are, ting’isaini gosibora chiusi chi’ebikoroto biaye; oyio nere orabaabatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.

English: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
Kiswahili: Pepeto lake liko mkononi, tayari kusafisha sakafu yake ya kupuria na kuikusanya ngano ghalani, lakini makapi atayateketeza kwa moto usiozimika.”
Ekegusii: Oroteru rwaye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kiaye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiriro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.”

English: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
Kiswahili: Basi, kwa maonyo mengine mengi Yohana aliwasihi na kuwahubiria watu Habari Njema.
Ekegusii: Nabo ase ogokuurera okonge Yohana akaranderia abanto amang’ana amaya.

English: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
Kiswahili: Lakini Yohana alipomkemea Mfalme Herode kuhusu uhusiano wake na Herodia, mke wa ndugu yake, na maovu mengine aliyokuwa amefanya,
Ekegusii: Korende Yohana agatogonyera Herode omorwoti, ase engencho y’okonyuoma Herodia, moka momura omwabo, na ase engencho y’amabe onsi Herode akorire,

English: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
Kiswahili: Herode aliongezea jambo hili kwa hayo mengine yote: alimfunga Yohana gerezani.
Ekegusii: Korende Herode agakora rinene kobua, ase okoruta ase Yohana echela.

English: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,
Kiswahili: Baada ya watu wote kubatizwa, Yesu naye akabatizwa. Naye alipokuwa akiomba, mbingu zilifunguka.
Ekegusii: Egachia koba abanto bonsi kobaabatisirwe, na Yeso boigo kabatisirwe, na ekero agosaba, igoro akamaanoka.

English: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
Kiswahili: Roho Mtakatifu akashuka juu yake kwa umbo kama la hua, nayo sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema: “Wewe ni Mwanangu mpendwa; nami nimependezwa nawe sana.”
Ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu ogaika igoro asare ase omogwekano bwe riruma, eriogi rikarwa igoro, rigoteeba, “Aye naye Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie naye.”

English: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
Kiswahili: Yesu alikuwa na umri wa miaka thelathini alipoanza huduma yake. Alikuwa akidhaniwa kuwa mwana wa Yosefu, Yosefu alikuwa mwana wa Eli,
Ekegusii: Yeso nere ekero achagete kworokereria, emiaka yaye igo yarenge ang’e emerongo etato, agakagwa ng’a mosinto o Yusufu, o Eli,

English: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
Kiswahili: Eli alikuwa mwana wa Mathati, Mathati alikuwa mwana wa Lawi, Lawi alikuwa mwana wa Melki, Melki alikuwa mwana wa Yanai, Yanai alikuwa mwana wa Yosefu,
Ekegusii: o Mathati, o Lawi, o Meliki, o Yana, o Yusufu,

English: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
Kiswahili: Yosefu alikuwa mwana wa Matathia, Matathia alikuwa mwana wa Amosi, Amosi alikuwa mwana wa Nahumu, Nahumu alikuwa mwana wa Esli, Esli alikuwa mwana wa Nagai,
Ekegusii: o Matathia, o Amos, o Nahum, o Esili, o Nagai,

English: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,
Kiswahili: Nagai alikuwa mwana wa Maathi, Maathi alikuwa mwana wa Matathia, Matathia alikuwa mwana wa Semeini, Semeini alikuwa mwana wa Yoseki, Yoseki alikuwa mwana wa Yoda,
Ekegusii: o Maathi, o Matathia, o Semei, o Yoseki, o Yoda,

English: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
Kiswahili: Yoda alikuwa mwana wa Yoanani, Yoanani alikuwa mwana wa Resa, Resa alikuwa mwana wa Zerubabeli, Zerubabeli alikuwa mwana wa Shealtieli, Shealtieli alikuwa mwana wa Neri,
Ekegusii: o Yohana, o Resa, o Serubabeli, o Salatieli, o Neri,

English: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,
Kiswahili: Neri alikuwa mwana wa Melki, Melki alikuwa mwana wa Adi, Adi alikuwa mwana wa Kosamu, Kosamu alikuwa mwana wa Elmadamu, Elmadamu alikuwa mwana wa Eri,
Ekegusii: o Meliki, o Adi, o Kosamu, o Elimadamu, o Eri,

English: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
Kiswahili: Eri alikuwa mwana wa Yoshua, Yoshua alikuwa mwana wa Eliezeri, Eliezeri alikuwa mwana wa Yorimu, Yorimu alikuwa mwana wa Mathati, Mathati alikuwa mwana wa Lawi,
Ekegusii: o Yoshua, o Eliezeri, o Yorimu, o Mathati, o Lawi,

English: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
Kiswahili: Lawi alikuwa mwana wa Simeoni, Simeoni alikuwa mwana wa Yuda, Yuda alikuwa mwana wa Yosefu, Yosefu alikuwa mwana wa Yonamu, Yonamu alikuwa mwana wa Eliakimu, Eliakimu alikuwa mwana wa Melea,
Ekegusii: o Simioni, o Yuda, o Yusufu, o Yonam, o Eliakimu,

English: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
Kiswahili: Melea alikuwa mwana wa Mena, Mena alikuwa mwana wa Matatha, Matatha alikuwa mwana wa Nathani, Nathani alikuwa mwana wa Daudi,
Ekegusii: o Melea, o Mainani, o Mattatha, o Nathani, o Daudi,

English: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
Kiswahili: Daudi alikuwa mwana wa Yese, Yese alikuwa mwana wa Obedi, Obedi alikuwa mwana wa Boazi, Boazi alikuwa mwana wa Salmoni, Salmoni alikuwa mwana wa Nashoni,
Ekegusii: o Yese, o Obedi, o Boazi, o Salimoni, o Nashoni,

English: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
Kiswahili: Nashoni alikuwa mwana wa Aminadabu, Aminadabu alikuwa mwana wa Aramu, Aramu alikuwa mwana wa Hesroni, Hesroni alikuwa mwana wa Peresi, Peresi alikuwa mwana wa Yuda,
Ekegusii: o Aminadabu, o Admin, o Aramu, o Hezironi, o Peresu, o Yuda,

English: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
Kiswahili: Yuda alikuwa mwana wa Yakobo, Yakobo alikuwa mwana wa Isaki, Isaki alikuwa mwana wa Abrahamu, Abrahamu alikuwa mwana wa Tera, Tera alikuwa mwana wa Nahori,
Ekegusii: o Yakobo, o Isaka, o Aburaamu, o Tera, o Nahori,

English: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
Kiswahili: Nahori alikuwa mwana wa Serugi, Serugi alikuwa mwana wa Reu, Reu alikuwa mwana wa Pelegi, Pelegi alikuwa mwana wa Eberi, Eberi alikuwa mwana wa Sala,
Ekegusii: o Serugi, o Reu, o Pelegi, o Eberi, o Sala,

English: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
Kiswahili: Sala alikuwa mwana wa Kenani, Kenani alikuwa mwana wa Arfaksadi, Arfaksadi alikuwa mwana wa Shemu, Shemu alikuwa mwana wa Noa, Noa alikuwa mwana wa Lameki,
Ekegusii: o Kainani, o Arifakisadi, o Shemu, o Nuhu, o Lameki,

English: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
Kiswahili: Lameki alikuwa mwana wa Methusela, Methusela alikuwa mwana wa Enoki, Enoki alikuwa mwana wa Yaredi, Yaredi alikuwa mwana wa Mahalaleli, Mahalaleli alikuwa mwana wa Kenani,
Ekegusii: o Metusela, o Enoku, o Yaredi, o Malaleeli, o Kainani,

English: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
Kiswahili: Kenani alikuwa mwana wa Enoshi, Enoshi alikuwa mwana wa Sethi, Sethi alikuwa mwana wa Adamu, Adamu alikuwa mwana wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: o Enosu, o Seti, o Adamu, o Nyasae.

English: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
Kiswahili: Yesu, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, akarudi kutoka Yordani. Akaongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu hadi nyikani,
Ekegusii: Na Yeso oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akairana korwa Yorodani, agatang’anwa n’Omoika kogenda ase erooro,

English: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.
Kiswahili: mahali ambako kwa siku arobaini alikuwa akijaribiwa na ibilisi. Kwa siku zote hizo hakula chochote, hivyo baada ya muda huo akaona njaa.
Ekegusii: agateemwa na Saitani ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene. Na amatuko aria tariete gento. Goika agachia koera, akaigwa enchara.

English: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”
Kiswahili: Ibilisi akamwambia, “Ikiwa wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu, amuru jiwe hili liwe mkate.”
Ekegusii: Saitani akamoteebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, teebia rigena eri ribe omogati.”

English: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu akamwambia, “Imeandikwa: ‘Mtu haishi kwa mkate tu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Neriikire. Omonto takoba moyo ase omogati bwoka.”

English: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
Kiswahili: Ibilisi akampeleka hadi juu ya mlima mrefu akamwonyesha milki zote za dunia kwa mara moja.
Ekegusii: Saitani akamoira aase aimokererete igoro, akamworokia amarwoti onsi ay’ense ase egeka ekemo,

English: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, “Nitakupa mamlaka juu ya milki hizi na fahari zake zote, kwa maana zimekabidhiwa mkononi mwangu nami ninaweza kumpa yeyote ninayetaka.
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Ninkoe okobua oko gwonsi, na obonene bwaye, ekiagera nabieirwe, na inche iga nkoa oyo ngwancha.

English: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo ikiwa utanisujudia na kuniabudu, vyote vitakuwa vyako.”
Ekegusii: Nabo koransasiime, bionsi nabibe ebiao.”

English: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Imeandikwa: ‘Mwabudu Bwana Mungu wako na umtumikie yeye peke yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Neriikire: Mosasiime Omonene Nyasae oo, omokorere ere bweka.”

English: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,
Kiswahili: Kisha ibilisi akampeleka mpaka Yerusalemu, akamweka juu ya mnara mrefu wa Hekalu, akamwambia, “Kama wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu, jitupe chini kutoka hapa,
Ekegusii: Saitani akamoira goika Yerusalemu, akamotenenia igoro ase egechuria gie Hekalu egetambe mono, akamoteebia, Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, etugute gochia inse korwa aa,

English: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’
Kiswahili: kwa maana imeandikwa: “ ‘Atakuagizia malaika zake ili wakulinde;
Ekegusii: ekiagera neriikire: Ere nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende,

English: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”
Kiswahili: nao watakuchukua mikononi mwao, usije ukajikwaa mguu wako katika jiwe.’ ”
Ekegusii: naende: Nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde tobaisa kogochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.

English: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Imesemwa, ‘Usimjaribu Bwana Mungu wako.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Neteebire, Toteema Omonene Nyasae oo.”

English: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.
Kiswahili: Ibilisi alipomaliza kila jaribu, akamwacha Yesu mpaka wakati mwingine ufaao.
Ekegusii: Saitani agachia gokoora ogoteema kwaye gwonsi, akaimoka korwa asare, akamotiga ase egeka.

English: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akarudi mpaka Galilaya, akiwa amejaa nguvu za Roho Mtakatifu, nazo habari zake zikaenea katika sehemu zote za nchi za kandokando.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairana gochia Galili ne chinguru chi’Omoika, chinkuma chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria.

English: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
Kiswahili: Akaanza kufundisha kwenye masinagogi yao, na kila mmoja akamsifu.
Ekegusii: Ere akorokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, ogotogigwa nabaanto bonsi.

English: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaenda Nazareti, alipolelewa, na siku ya Sabato alikwenda katika sinagogi kama ilivyokuwa desturi yake. Akasimama ili asome,
Ekegusii: Akagenda Nazareti, aria ase arereretwe; na ase rituko ri’Esabato agasoa ase esinagogi yabo, buna engencho yaye yarenge, agatenena gosoma.

English: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
Kiswahili: naye akapewa kitabu cha nabii Isaya, akakifungua na kukuta mahali palipoandikwa:
Ekegusii: Akaegwa egetabu y’omobani Isaya. Nabo akaigora egetabu eyio, akanyora aase ariikire,

English: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,
Kiswahili: “Roho wa Bwana yu juu yangu, kwa sababu amenitia mafuta kuwahubiria maskini habari njema. Amenituma kuwatangazia wafungwa kufunguliwa kwao, na vipofu kupata kuona tena, kuwaweka huru wanaoonewa,
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene nigo ore igoro yane, ekiagera ong’akire amaguta koranderia abataka amang’ana amaya. Ontomire koranderia abasibwa ogosiborwa, na koa abare emeuko banyare korora naende, na gosibora abasionoirwe.

English: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
Kiswahili: na kutangaza mwaka wa Bwana uliokubalika.”
Ekegusii: Na korandia omwakabwo Omonene bwancheretwe.

English: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
Kiswahili: Kisha akakifunga kitabu, akamrudishia mtumishi na akaketi. Watu wote waliokuwamo katika sinagogi wakamkazia macho.
Ekegusii: Akamumekeria egetabu eria akayea omokori emeremo bw’esinagogi, agaikaransa. Abanto bonsi abarenge ase esinagogi bakamobeta amaiso.

English: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo akaanza kwa kuwaambia, “Leo Andiko hili limetimia mkiwa mnasikia.”
Ekegusii: Agachaaka kobateebia, “Reero ririiko eri riaikeranigwe ase more buna mwarigwa rigosomwa.”

English: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”
Kiswahili: Wote waliokuwako wakamsifu na kuyastaajabia maneno yake yaliyojaa neema, wakaulizana, “Je, huyu si mwana wa Yosefu?”
Ekegusii: Bonsi bakamokwana buya bagakumia amang’ana obuya aruete ase omonwa oye, bagateebania, “Oyo tari ere omwana o Yusufu?”

English: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Bila shaka mtatumia mithali hii: ‘Tabibu, jiponye mwenyewe! Mambo yale tuliyosikia kwamba uliyafanya huko Kapernaumu, yafanye na hapa kwenye mji wako.’ ”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene, namonteebie omoreng’anio oyo: Omogwenia, egwenie aye omonyene; amang’ana onsi twaigure akorekire Kapernaumu, yakore aiga ase ense yao.”

English: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, hakuna nabii anayekubalika katika mji wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Omobani tari oranyare gwanchwa ase ense yaye omonyene.

English: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.
Kiswahili: Lakini ukweli ni kwamba palikuwa na wajane wengi katika Israeli wakati wa Eliya, mbingu zilipofungwa kwa miaka mitatu na miezi sita pakawa na njaa kuu katika nchi nzima.
Ekegusii: Korende ekeene nabateebirie ng’a mbarenge ababoraka abange ase Israeli ase amatuko ’Elija, ekero igoro yasiegetwe emiaka etato na emetienyi etano nomo, ekero enchara enene yasoete ase ense yonsi;

English: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo Eliya hakutumwa hata kwa mmoja wao, bali kwa mjane mmoja wa Sarepta katika nchi ya Sidoni.
Ekegusii: na Elija tatometwe ase oyomo obo, otatiga ase omokungu oyorenge omoboraka agwo Sarefata, ase ense ya Sidoni.

English: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”
Kiswahili: Pia palikuwa na wengi wenye ukoma katika Israeli katika siku za nabii Elisha, lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyetakaswa, isipokuwa Naamani mtu wa Shamu.”
Ekegusii: Naende mbarenge ase Abaisraeli abanto abange abaare noborwaire bwa ukoma ase ekero ki’omobani Elisha; onde tari osibegete otatiga Naamani, omonto o Siiria.”

English: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.
Kiswahili: Watu wote katika sinagogi waliposikia maneno haya, wakakasirika sana.
Ekegusii: Bagachia koigwa aya, bonsi ase esinagogi bagaichorwa nendamwamu.

English: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
Kiswahili: Wakasimama, wakamtoa nje ya mji, wakamchukua hadi kwenye kilele cha mlima mahali ambapo mji huo ulikuwa umejengwa, ili wamtupe chini kutoka kwenye mteremko mkali.
Ekegusii: Bakaimoka bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoira goika igoro y’egetunwa keria omochie obo oagachire erio, banyare komoturunkania.

English: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye akapita papo hapo katikati ya huo umati wa watu akaenda zake.
Ekegusii: Korende ere agaeta egati‐gati yabo, akagenda.

English: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akashuka kwenda Kapernaumu, mji wa Galilaya, na katika siku ya Sabato akawa anafundisha.
Ekegusii: Agatirimboka goika Kapernaumu, omochie o Galili. Akaba nkoborokereria are rituko ri’Esabato.

English: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
Kiswahili: Wakashangazwa sana na mafundisho yake, maana maneno yake yalikuwa na mamlaka.
Ekegusii: Bagakumia mono ase okworokereria kwaye, ekiagera ring’ana riaye riarenge nokobua.

English: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
Kiswahili: Ndani ya sinagogi palikuwa na mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu. Naye akapiga kelele kwa nguvu akisema,
Ekegusii: Naende ase esinagogi narengeo omonto obwatire n’Omoika bw’ekerecha ki’eubi. Ere agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, akabora,

English: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”
Kiswahili: “Tuache! Tuna nini nawe, Yesu wa Nazareti? Je, umekuja kutuangamiza? Ninakujua wewe ni nani. Wewe ndiwe Aliye Mtakatifu wa Mungu!”
Ekegusii: “Ah! Totige intwe Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Ngwachire gotosiria? Nakomanyire aye, Omochenu o Nyasae.”

English: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu akamkemea yule pepo mchafu, akisema, “Nyamaza kimya! Nawe umtoke!” Yule pepo mchafu akamwangusha yule mtu chini mbele yao wote, akatoka pasipo kumdhuru.
Ekegusii: Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Kira, omorwe!” Ekerecha keria gekamoiyeria agwo gati‐gati, gekamorwa, tikiamokorera gento.

English: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakashangaa, wakaambiana, “Mafundisho haya ni ya namna gani? Anawaamuru pepo wachafu kwa mamlaka na nguvu, nao wanatoka!”
Ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ing’ana ki eri? Naki ase chinguru na okobua kiagochika ebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio biasoka.”

English: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.
Kiswahili: Habari zake zikaanza kuenea kila mahali katika sehemu ile.
Ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria.

English: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.
Kiswahili: Yesu akatoka katika sinagogi, akaenda nyumbani kwa Simoni. Basi huko alimkuta mama mkwe wa Simoni akiwa ameshikwa na homa kali, nao wakamwomba Yesu amsaidie.
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase esinagogi, agasoa ase enyomba ya Simioni. Nabo ng’ina biara Simioni konya orwarire esosera; bakamosaba ase engencho yaye.

English: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akamwinamia na kukemea ile homa, nayo ikamwacha. Akaamka saa ile ile, naye akaanza kuwahudumia.
Ekegusii: Agatenena ang’e nere, agatogonyera esosera eria; ekamotiga. Bwango ere akaimoka akabakorera.

English: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
Kiswahili: Jua lilipokuwa linatua, watu wakamletea Yesu watu wote waliokuwa na maradhi mbalimbali, naye akaweka mikono yake juu ya kila mgonjwa, naye akawaponya.
Ekegusii: Goika erioba rigachia kogwa bakarenta asare abanto bonsi abarenge nabarwaire bare namarwaire ao ao, na ere akabeeka amaboko aye igoro ase kera oyomo, akabagwenia.

English: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
Kiswahili: Pepo wachafu pia wakawatoka watu wengi, nao walipokuwa wakitoka wakapiga kelele, wakisema: “Wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu!” Lakini Yesu akawakemea na kuwazuia wasiseme, kwa maana walimjua kuwa yeye ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ebirecha bigasoka korwa ase abange, bigaaka eriogi, bikabora, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabitogonyera, tabitiga bikwane, ekiagera biamanyete ng’a nere Kristo.

English: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake, kulipopambazuka, Yesu alikwenda mahali pa faragha. Watu wengi wakawa wanamtafuta kila mahali, nao walipomwona wakajaribu kumzuia asiondoke.
Ekegusii: Goika ekaba mobaso, agasoka, akagenda aase atari nabaanto. Na abanto bakamoriga‐rigia, bakamoikera, bakarigia komotanga taimoka korwa ase bare.

English: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye akawaambia, “Imenipasa kuhubiri habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu katika miji mingine pia, kwa maana kwa kusudi hili nilitumwa.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nengwenerete korandia amang’ana amaya ay’oborwoti bwa Nyasae ase emechie ende boigo, ekiagera natometwe ase engencho eyio.”

English: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
Kiswahili: Naye aliendelea kuhubiri katika masinagogi ya Uyahudi.
Ekegusii: Akaba nkorandia are ase chisinagogi chia Boyahudi.

English: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
Kiswahili: Siku moja Yesu alipokuwa amesimama karibu na Ziwa la Genesareti, watu wengi wakiwa wanasongana kumzunguka ili wapate kusikia neno la Mungu,
Ekegusii: Ekaba abanto nkomomiga baare, erinde baigwe ring’ana ria Nyasae, agatenena ase engegu y’enyancha ya Genesareti,

English: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
Kiswahili: akaona mashua mbili ukingoni mwa ziwa, zikiwa zimeachwa hapo na wavuvi waliokuwa wanaosha nyavu zao.
Ekegusii: Akarora amaato abere ateneine engegu y’enyancha, na abarubi basokire korwa aroro, ngosibia bare ebionga biabo.

English: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
Kiswahili: Akaingia katika mojawapo ya hizo mashua ambayo ilikuwa ya Simoni, akamwomba aisogeze ndani ya maji kidogo kutoka ufuoni. Kisha akaketi na kufundisha watu akiwa mle ndani ya mashua.
Ekegusii: Akariina obwato obomo obwarenge bwa Simioni akamobooria abotigerie are ake korwa ase engegu. Agaikaransa, akorokereria omoganda korwa ase obwato.

English: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”
Kiswahili: Alipomaliza kunena, akamwambia Simoni, “Sasa peleka mashua hadi kilindini kisha mshushe nyavu zenu mkavue samaki.”
Ekegusii: Goika agachia gokoora ogokwana kwaye, agateebia Simioni, “Sukia obwato goika endiba, moikie ebionga biaino ase okoruba.”

English: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
Kiswahili: Simoni akamjibu, “Bwana, tumefanya kazi ya kuchosha usiku kucha na hatukuvua chochote. Lakini, kwa neno lako nitazishusha nyavu.”
Ekegusii: Simioni akamoiraneria, “Omonene, nabo twakorire emeremo obotuko obogima, titonyoreti gento, korende ase ring’ana riao natoikie ebionga.”

English: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
Kiswahili: Nao walipozishusha nyavu zao, wakavua samaki wengi sana, nyavu zao zikajaa zikaanza kukatika.
Ekegusii: Kobakorire iga, bakanyora chinswe chinyinge mono, na ekero ebionga biabo biachaaka gotandoka,

English: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.
Kiswahili: Wakawaashiria wavuvi wenzao kwenye ile mashua nyingine ili waje kuwasaidia. Wakaja, wakajaza mashua zote mbili samaki hata zikaanza kuzama.
Ekegusii: bagasuma abagisangio babo, abarenge ase obwato bwa kabere, bache kobakonya. Bagacha, bagaichoria amaato onsi abere, goika agachaaka korimera.

English: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro alipoona haya yaliyotukia, alianguka miguuni mwa Yesu na kumwambia, “Bwana, ondoka kwangu. Mimi ni mtu mwenye dhambi!”
Ekegusii: Korende Simioni Petero, agachia korora aya, akagwa ase amaru a Yeso, akabora, “Omonene, karue ase ’nde, ekiagera inche nomonto omonyene ebibe!”

English: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa yeye na wavuvi wenzake walikuwa wameshangazwa sana na wingi wa samaki waliokuwa wamepata.
Ekegusii: Naki igo akumetie, ere na bonsi abarenge amo nere, ase oborubi bwe chinswe barubete;

English: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo wenzake Simoni, yaani Yakobo na Yohana, wana wa Zebedayo, walishangazwa pia. Ndipo Yesu akamwambia Simoni, “Usiogope, tangu sasa utakuwa mvuvi wa watu.”
Ekegusii: naboigo Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, abarenge ababwatani ba Simioni. Yeso agateebia Simioni, “Toiroka; korwa bono nobe omorubi bw’abaanto.”

English: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakasogeza mashua zao mpaka ufuoni mwa bahari, wakaacha kila kitu na kumfuata.
Ekegusii: Naende kobarentire amaato abo gochia engegu, bagatiga bionsi, bakamotunyana.

English: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku moja Yesu alipokuwa katika mji fulani, mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma mwili mzima akamjia. Alipomwona Yesu, alianguka chini mpaka uso wake ukagusa ardhi, akamsihi akisema, “Bwana, ukitaka, waweza kunitakasa.”
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge ase omochie oyomo, rora, narengeo omonto omosacha oichire noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ere agachia korora Yeso, akagwa maumama, akamosorora, okomoteebia, “Omonene, onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”

English: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akanyoosha mkono wake, akamgusa yule mtu, akamwambia, “Nataka. Takasika!” Na mara ukoma wake ukatakasika.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamorua.

English: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwagiza akisema, “Usimwambie mtu yeyote, bali nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani na ukatoe sadaka alizoagiza Mose kwa utakaso wako, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Toteebia monto onde ing’ana, korende genda, bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso ase ogosibeka kwao buna Musa achiigete, kebe kirori ase abanto.”

English: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
Kiswahili: Lakini habari zake Yesu zikazidi sana kuenea kotekote kuliko wakati mwingine wowote. Makutano makubwa ya watu yalikuwa yakikusanyika ili kumsikiliza na kuponywa magonjwa yao.
Ekegusii: Korende chinkuma chiaye chikamenteka gokuma. Emeganda emenge egasangererekana gocha komoigwa, na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.

English: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.
Kiswahili: Lakini mara kwa mara Yesu alijitenga nao ili kwenda mahali pa faragha kuomba.
Ekegusii: Korende ere akerusanania, akagenda aase atari nabaanto, agasaba.

English: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.
Kiswahili: Siku moja Yesu alipokuwa akifundisha, Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria, waliokuwa wametoka kila kijiji cha Galilaya na kutoka Uyahudi na Yerusalemu, walikuwa wameketi huko. Nao uweza wa Bwana ulikuwa juu yake kuponya wagonjwa.
