Ekegusii: Rituko erimo ri’amatuko aria ekero arenge kworokereria, Abafarisai na aborokia b’amachiiko barenge aroro baikaransete. Abwo baruete ase kera omochie o Galili na Boyahudi, na korwa Yerusalemu. Na okobua kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nere anyare kogwenia.

English: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
Kiswahili: Wakaja watu wamembeba mgonjwa aliyepooza kwenye mkeka. Wakajaribu kumwingiza ndani ili wamweke mbele ya Yesu.
Ekegusii: Na rigereria, abanto mbabogoretie noborere omonto orenge rigata, bakarigia komoira nyomba ime na komobeka ase obosio bwaye.

English: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa hawawezi kufanya hivyo kwa sababu ya umati wa watu, wakapanda juu ya paa, wakaondoa baadhi ya matofali, wakamteremsha yule mgonjwa kwa mkeka wake hadi katikati ya ule umati pale mbele ya Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ri’okomoira ime ase engencho y’omoganda oria bw’abaanto, bakariina kerama igoro, bakamoikia korwa kerama noborere bwaye goika gati‐gati ase obosio bwa Yeso.

English: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoiona imani yao, akamwambia yule mgonjwa, “Rafiki, dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
Ekegusii: Agachia korora okwegena kwabo, akamoteebia, “Mosani, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

English: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo na wale walimu wa sheria wakaanza kuuliza, “Ni nani mtu huyu anayesema maneno ya kukufuru? Ni nani awezaye kusamehe dhambi isipokuwa Mungu peke yake?”
Ekegusii: Aborokia baria b’amariiko na Abafarisai bagachaaka korengereria, bakobora, “Ning’o oyo ogokwana okorama? Ning’o oranyare kwabera ebibe, otatiga oyomo, nere Nyasae?”

English: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?
Kiswahili: Yesu akijua mawazo yao akawauliza, “Kwa nini mnawaza hivyo mioyoni mwenu?
Ekegusii: Yeso akamanya ebirengererio biabo, akairaneria, “Naki mokorengereria ase chinkoro chiaino?

English: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?
Kiswahili: Je, ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi, kumwambia, ‘Umesamehewa dhambi zako,’ au kusema, ‘Inuka, uende’?
Ekegusii: Ndiriri rire eriango, goteeba: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka, ogende?

English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ili mpate kujua kwamba Mwana wa Adamu anayo mamlaka duniani kusamehe dhambi…” Akamwambia yule aliyepooza, “Nakuambia, inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”
Ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria rigata, “Nagoteebirie: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”

English: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
Kiswahili: Mara yule mtu aliyekuwa amepooza akasimama mbele yao wote, akachukua mkeka wake, akaenda zake nyumbani, huku akimtukuza Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima agatenena ase obosio bwabo, akabogoria ekeraarero kiaye arenge koraarera, akagenda bwoye, ogotogia Nyasae.

English: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja akashangaa na kumtukuza Mungu. Wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, wakasema, “Leo tumeona mambo ya ajabu.”
Ekegusii: Ogokumia gokabwata bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae; bagaichorwa nokoiroka, bakaboora, “Twarorire amakumia reero.”

English: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu alitoka na kumwona mtoza ushuru mmoja jina lake Lawi akiwa amekaa forodhani, mahali pake pa kutoza ushuru. Akamwambia, “Nifuate.”
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya akaimoka, akarora omorusia ebango, erieta riaye Lawi, oikaransete aase bakoruseria ebango, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana!”

English: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
Kiswahili: Naye Lawi akaacha kila kitu, akaondoka, akamfuata.
Ekegusii: Agatiga bionsi, akaimoka, akamotunyana.

English: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.
Kiswahili: Kisha Lawi akamfanyia Yesu karamu kubwa nyumbani kwake, nao umati mkubwa wa watoza ushuru na watu wengine walikuwa wakila pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Nere Lawi akamokorera omoyega omonene nyomba mwaye, naende mbarengeo omoganda bw’abarusia ebango na abanto bande baikaransete amo nabarabwo ase endagera.

English: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria waliokuwa wa dhehebu lao wakawalalamikia wanafunzi wa Yesu, wakisema, “Mbona mnakula na kunywa pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi’?”
Ekegusii: Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariiko babo bakemurunganeria aborokigwa baye, bakaboora, “Nase ki mokoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”

English: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Wenye afya hawahitaji tabibu, bali walio wagonjwa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete.

English: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
Kiswahili: Sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi wapate kutubu.”
Ekegusii: Tincheti korangeria ababoronge korende abanyene ebibe baonchoke.”

English: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia Yesu, “Wanafunzi wa Yohana na wa Mafarisayo mara kwa mara hufunga na kuomba, lakini wanafunzi wako wanaendelea kula na kunywa.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Aborokigwa ba Yohana nigo bakweng’ata ebiro ebinge na gosaba, na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai nabo bagokora, korende abao nigo bakoria na konywa.”

English: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, mnaweza kuwafanya wageni wa bwana arusi kufunga wakati yuko pamoja nao?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Inamonyare gotiga abachire ase enyangi beng’ate ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo?

English: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati utafika ambapo bwana arusi ataondolewa kwao. Hapo ndipo watakapofunga.”
Ekegusii: Korende amatuko nache, barache kourwa omonywomi, erio nario barache kweng’ata ase amatuko aria.”

English: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawapa mfano huu, akawaambia: “Hakuna mtu achanaye kiraka kutoka kwenye nguo mpya na kukishonea kwenye nguo iliyochakaa. Akifanya hivyo, atakuwa amechana nguo mpya, na kile kiraka hakitalingana na ile nguo iliyochakaa.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio: “Onde tari ogotandora ekeraka ki’eanga enyia na gokebeeka ase eanga engotu; aise gokora bo, natandore eria enyia, na ekeraka keria ki’eanga enyia tigekobwatana neanga eria engotu.

English: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu awekaye divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Akifanya hivyo, hiyo divai mpya itavipasua hivyo viriba, nayo yote itamwagika.
Ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria enyia nayaate ebirandi biria; edivai enyene eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke.

English: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.
Kiswahili: Divai mpya lazima iwekwe kwenye viriba vipya.
Ekegusii: Korende edivai enyia negwenerete ebeekwe ase ebirandi ebiya.

English: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
Kiswahili: Wala hakuna mtu anayependelea divai mpya baada ya kunywa divai ya zamani, bali husema, ‘Ile ya zamani ni nzuri zaidi.’ ”
Ekegusii: Gose omonto tari onyure edivai yaroisetigwe kare, naende arigie edivai enyia, ekiagera nigo agoteeba: Eria ya kare nengiya kobua.”

English: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku moja ya Sabato Yesu alikuwa akipita katika mashamba ya nafaka, nao wanafunzi wake wakaanza kuvunja masuke ya nafaka, wakayafikicha kwa mikono yao na kula punje zake.
Ekegusii: Rituko ri’Esabato Yeso ngoeta arenge ase emegondo y’engano; aborokigwa baye bakabutora ebigara, bakabibunga namaboko abo, bakaria.

English: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakawauliza, “Mbona mnafanya mambo yasiyo halali kufanywa siku ya Sabato?”
Ekegusii: Korende abande ase Abafarisai bakababoria, “Naki mogokora aya’atagwenereti gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato?”

English: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, ninyi hamjasoma kamwe alivyofanya Daudi wakati yeye na wenzake walikuwa na njaa?
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete, ekero arenge nenchara, ere na abarenge amo nere,

English: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”
Kiswahili: Aliingia ndani ya nyumba ya Mungu, akaichukua na kuila ile mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, ambayo ni halali kuliwa na makuhani peke yao. Naye pia akawapa wenzake.”
Ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akabogoria na koria emegati yarenge koruegwa ase Nyasae, etare boronge koriegwa nonde otatiga nabakuani boka, naende akaa abwo barenge amo nere?”

English: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere Omonene bw’Esabato.”

English: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku nyingine ya Sabato, Yesu aliingia ndani ya sinagogi na akawa anafundisha. Huko palikuwa na mtu ambaye mkono wake wa kuume ulikuwa umepooza.
Ekegusii: Esabato ende agasoa ase esinagogi, akaorokereria. Narengeo omonto agwo, okoboko kwaye gw’okorio kwagataete.

English: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wakitafuta sababu ya kumshtaki Yesu. Kwa hivyo wakawa wanamwangalia sana ili waone kama ataponya katika siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bakamotega korora gose namogwenie ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.

English: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu alijua mawazo yao, hivyo akamwambia yule mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Inuka usimame mbele ya watu wote.” Hivyo yule mtu akainuka, akasimama mbele yao wote.
Ekegusii: Korende akamanya ebirengererio biabo, agateebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Imoka, otenene gati aa!” Akaimoka agatenena.

English: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia wale walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, “Nawauliza ninyi, ni lipi lililo halali siku ya Sabato? Ni kutenda mema au kutenda mabaya? Ni kuokoa maisha au kuyaangamiza?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nkobaboria nde ring’ana erimo: Mboronge rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya gose amabe, gotooria obogima gose kobosiria?”

English: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.
Kiswahili: Akawatazama watu wote waliokuwepo, kisha akamwambia yule aliyepooza mkono, “Nyoosha mkono wako!” Akaunyoosha na mkono wake ukaponywa kabisa.
Ekegusii: Akabarigereria bonsi, agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakora bo; okoboko kwaye gokagwenigwa.

English: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
Kiswahili: Wale wakuu wakakasirika sana, wakashauriana wao kwa wao ni nini watakachomtendea Yesu.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagaichorwa nokobea, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, buna baramokore Yeso.

English: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
Kiswahili: Ikawa katika siku hizo Yesu alikwenda mlimani kuomba, akakesha usiku kucha akimwomba Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria akaimoka akagenda ase egetunwa gosaba; akabao obotuko bwonsi ase ogosaba Nyasae.

English: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka, akawaita wanafunzi wake, naye akachagua kumi na wawili, ambao pia aliwaita mitume:
Ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia akarangeria aborokigw baye, agachora korwa ase bare ikomi na babere, abwo arogete abatomwa.

English: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;
Kiswahili: Simoni aliyemwita Petro, Andrea nduguye, Yakobo, Yohana, Filipo, Bartholomayo,
Ekegusii: Simioni nere arogete Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo na Yohana, Filipo na Baritholomayo,

English: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;
Kiswahili: Mathayo, Tomaso, Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, Simoni aliyeitwa Zelote,
Ekegusii: na Matayo na Thomas, Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Simioni oyomo bw’Abazelote,

English: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
Kiswahili: Yuda mwana wa Yakobo, na Yuda Iskariote ambaye alikuwa msaliti.
Ekegusii: na Yuda o Yakobo, na Yudasi Iskariota, nere oyo omoruete.

English: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,
Kiswahili: Akashuka pamoja nao, akasimama mahali penye uwanja tambarare. Hapo palikuwa na idadi kubwa ya wanafunzi wake na umati mkubwa wa watu kutoka sehemu zote za Uyahudi, kutoka Yerusalemu, na kutoka pwani ya Tiro na Sidoni.
Ekegusii: Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agatenena aase ateremu, amo nomoganda bw’aborokigwa baye; na omoganda bw’abaanto abaruete Boyahudi yonsi, na Yerusalemu, na engegu ya Turo na Sidoni, bagacha komoigwa na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.

English: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wamekuja kumsikiliza na kuponywa magonjwa yao. Wale waliokuwa wakiteswa na pepo wachafu akawaponya.
Ekegusii: Bagacha koigwa amang’ana aye boigo nakogwenigwa amarwaire abo, na abwo bachandire nebirecha bi’eubi bakagwenigwa.

English: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
Kiswahili: Watu wote walikuwa wanajitahidi kumgusa kwa sababu nguvu zilikuwa zikimtoka na kuwaponya wote.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi okarigia komokuna, ekiagera chinguru chiare korua asare, chikabagwenia bonsi.

English: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.
Kiswahili: Akawatazama wanafunzi wake, akasema: “Mmebarikiwa ninyi mlio maskini, kwa sababu Ufalme wa Mungu ni wenu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye ase aborokigwa baye, akabora, Imosesenirie inwe abamore abataka, ekiagera oborwoti bwa Nyasae nobwaino.

English: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
Kiswahili: Mmebarikiwa ninyi mlio na njaa sasa, kwa sababu mtashibishwa. Mmebarikiwa ninyi mnaolia sasa, kwa sababu mtacheka.
Ekegusii: Imosesenirie inwe abamore nenchara bono, ekiagera namoigotigwe. “Imosesenirie inwe abamokorera bono, ekiagera namoseke.

English: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.
Kiswahili: Mmebarikiwa ninyi, watu watakapowachukia, watakapowatenga na kuwatukana na kulikataa jina lenu kama neno ovu, kwa ajili ya Mwana wa Adamu.
Ekegusii: “Imosesenirie inwe ekero Mwanyabaanto bakobagecha, na kobarusanania, na kobachaya, na gosaria amarieta aino buna nababe more, ase engencho y’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.

English: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.
Kiswahili: “Furahini na kurukaruka kwa shangwe, kwa sababu thawabu yenu ni kubwa mbinguni, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo baba zao walivyowatenda manabii.
Ekegusii: Goka ase rituko riria, na gochenga, ekiagera ekeene eng’eria yaino nenene igoro; naki chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani engencho eyio eyio.

English: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ole wenu ninyi mlio matajiri, kwa sababu mmekwisha kupokea faraja yenu.
Ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino inwe abanda, ekiagera mwanyorire omogooko oino.

English: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
Kiswahili: Ole wenu ninyi mlioshiba sasa, maana mtaona njaa. Ole wenu ninyi mnaocheka sasa, maana mtaomboleza na kulia.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamoigotete bono, ekiagera namoche koba nenchara. “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamogoseka bono, ekiagera namoche goichana na korera.

English: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
Kiswahili: Ole wenu watu watakapowasifu, kwani ndivyo baba zao walivyowasifu manabii wa uongo.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino inwe, ekero abanto bakobatogia, ekiagera chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani b’oborimo engencho eyio eyio.

English: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
Kiswahili: “Lakini nawaambia ninyi mnaonisikia: Wapendeni adui zenu. Watendeeni mema wanaowachukia.
Ekegusii: “Korende nabateebirie inwe abamokoigwa: Ancha ababisa baino, bakorere amaya abwo baabagechete,

English: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
Kiswahili: Wabarikini wale wanaowalaani, waombeeni wale wanaowatendea mabaya.
Ekegusii: basesenie abwo bakobaragereria, basabere abwo bakobakorera bobe.

English: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akikupiga shavu moja, mgeuzie na la pili pia. Mtu akikunyangʼanya koti lako, usimzuie kuchukua joho pia.
Ekegusii: Oyo okogoaka orosea oromo, moonchorere noronde, na ere oyogokoura eanga ya isiko, tomorina neya ime.

English: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
Kiswahili: Mpe kila akuombaye, na kama mtu akichukua mali yako usitake akurudishie.
Ekegusii: Moe kera oyokogosaba; na oyogokoura ebinto biao tomoboria naende.

English: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
Kiswahili: Watendeeni wengine kama ambavyo mngetaka wawatendee ninyi.
Ekegusii: Naende buna morigetie abanto babakorere inwe, nainwe mobakorere bo.

English: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
Kiswahili: “Kama mkiwapenda tu wale wanaowapenda, mwapata sifa gani? Hata ‘wenye dhambi’ huwapenda wale wawapendao.
Ekegusii: “Komoranche abaabanchete inwe, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo banchete abwo baabanchete.

English: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
Kiswahili: Tena mkiwatendea mema wale tu wanaowatendea ninyi mema, mwapata sifa gani? Hata ‘wenye dhambi’ hufanya vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Komorabakorere amaya abwo abakobakorera inwe amaya, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nabo bagokora.

English: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
Kiswahili: Tena mnapowakopesha wale tu mnaotegemea wawalipe, mwapata sifa gani? Hata ‘wenye dhambi’ huwakopesha ‘wenye dhambi’ wenzao wakitarajia kulipwa mali yao yote.
Ekegusii: Naende komorarue singo ase abanto mosemeretie konyora egento korwa ase bare naende, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo bakorua singo ase abanyene ebibe, erinde banyore koreng’ana.

English: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
Kiswahili: Lakini wapendeni adui zenu, watendeeni mema, wakopesheni bila kutegemea kurudishiwa mlichokopesha. Ndipo thawabu yenu itakapokuwa kubwa, nanyi mtakuwa wana wa Aliye Juu Sana, kwa sababu yeye ni mwema kwa watu wasio na shukrani na kwa wale waovu.
Ekegusii: Korende mwanche ababisa baino, bakorere amaya, na korua singo, motari korengereria konyora egento gi’okoiranerigwa, eng’eria yaino nebe enene, na inwe namobe abana b’Oyore Igoro Mono, ekiagera ere nomuya ase abanto batari nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, nonya nase abang’iti.

English: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
Kiswahili: Kuweni na huruma, kama Baba yenu alivyo na huruma.
Ekegusii: Mobe namaabera, buna Iso oino are namaabera.

English: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
Kiswahili: “Msihukumu, nanyi hamtahukumiwa. Msilaumu, nanyi hamtalaumiwa. Sameheni, nanyi mtasamehewa.
Ekegusii: “Timogambia, nainwe timokogambigwa; timonachera, nainwe timokonacherwa; abera, nainwe namwaberwe;

English: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
Kiswahili: Wapeni watu vitu, nanyi mtapewa. Kipimo cha kujaa na kushindiliwa na kusukwasukwa hata kumwagika, ndicho watu watakachowapa vifuani mwenu. Kwa kuwa kipimo kile mpimacho, ndicho mtakachopimiwa.”
Ekegusii: karue, nainwe namoegwe. Ekerengo ekiya keigateire, keinyageire, geichire, nakio abanto barabae inwe ase amaboko aino, ekiagera ekerengo keria mokorengera, nakio morache korengerwa nainwe.”

English: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?
Kiswahili: Pia akawapa mfano akasema, “Je, kipofu aweza kumwongoza kipofu? Je, wote wawili hawatatumbukia shimoni?
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio, “Inee! Omouko nonyare koraa omouko onde? Tibakogwa bonsi babere ase engoro?

English: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
Kiswahili: Mwanafunzi hawezi kumzidi mwalimu wake, ila yule aliyehitimu aweza kuwa kama mwalimu wake.
Ekegusii: Omworokigwa tari omonene kobua omworokia oye, korende kera oyomo gakoorire kworokererigwa nabe buna omworokia oye.

English: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
Kiswahili: “Mbona unatazama kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako, wala huoni boriti iliyo ndani ya jicho lako mwenyewe?
Ekegusii: Inaki okorigereria ekeogoto kere ase eriso ri’oyomino, na omoribo ore ase eriso riao ime toyorochi?

English: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.
Kiswahili: Utawezaje kumwambia ndugu yako, ‘Ndugu yangu, acha nitoe kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho lako,’ wakati wewe mwenyewe huoni boriti iliyo ndani ya jicho lako? Ewe mnafiki, ondoa boriti ndani ya jicho lako kwanza, ndipo utaweza kuona dhahiri jinsi ya kuondoa kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako.
Ekegusii: Gose naki orateebie oyomino: Oyominto, ntige nkorusie ekeogoto kere ase eriso riao ime, na aye omonyene torochi omoriibo ore ase eriso riao? Aye omong’ainereria, rusia ritang’ani omoribo ore ase eriso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto kere ase eriso ri’oyomino.

English: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mti mzuri uzaao matunda mabaya, wala hakuna mti mbaya uzaao matunda mazuri.
Ekegusii: “Naki tori omote omuya okwama amatunda amabe, gose omote omobe okwama amatunda amaya.

English: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
Kiswahili: Kila mti hujulikana kwa matunda yake. Kwa maana watu hawachumi tini kwenye miiba, wala zabibu kwenye michongoma.
Ekegusii: Kera omote nigo okomanyekana ase amatunda aye. Naki ase emetobo abanto tibari gotwa amako, gose ase emenyenya tibari gotwa amasabibu.

English: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo mtu mwema hutoa mambo mema kutoka kwenye hazina ya moyo wake, naye mtu mwovu hutoa mambo maovu kutoka kwenye hazina ya moyo wake. Kwa kuwa mtu hunena kwa kinywa chake yale yaliyoujaza moyo wake.
Ekegusii: Omonto omuya ase emonga engiya y’enkoro yaye nigo akorua ayare amaya; na omonto omobe ase emonga yaye embe nigo akorua ayare amabe, ekiagera ebiichire ase enkoro, nabio omonwa ogokwana.

English: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini mnaniita, ‘Bwana, Bwana,’ nanyi hamfanyi ninayowaambia?
Ekegusii: “Nase ki mokondoka Omonene Nyasae, na inwe timori gokora aya ngoteeba?

English: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.
Kiswahili: Nitawaonyesha jinsi alivyo mtu yule anayekuja kwangu na kusikia maneno yangu na kuyatenda.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto ogocha ase ’nde, na koigwa amang’ana aane, na koyakora, nimborokie buna are:

English: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni kama mtu aliyejenga nyumba, akachimba chini sana, na kuweka msingi kwenye mwamba. Mafuriko yalipokuja, maji ya ghafula yaliipiga ile nyumba, lakini haikutikisika, kwa sababu ilikuwa imejengwa vizuri.
Ekegusii: Nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba, agakunya gochia inse mono, akabeeka oboroso bwaye igoro ase egetare. Ekero etoigo yachia gocha, eooro egaaka enyomba eria ne chinguru, tiyanyara koyenyegeria, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.

English: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye anayesikia maneno yangu wala asiyatende, ni kama mtu aliyejenga nyumba juu ya ardhi bila kuweka msingi. Mafuriko yalipoikumba nyumba ile, ikaanguka mara na kubomoka kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Nere oyokoigwa otari gokora iga, nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba igoro ase amaroba, etabegetwe oboroso. Nabo eooro ekayeaka ne chinguru, ekagwa bwango, na okogwa kw’enyomba eria gokaba okonene.”

English: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu kumaliza kusema haya yote watu wakiwa wanamsikiliza, akaingia Kapernaumu.
Ekegusii: Magega Yeso gakorire gokwana amang’ana onsi aria arigetie abanto baigwe, agasoa Kapernaumu.

English: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
Kiswahili: Mtumishi wa jemadari mmoja wa Kirumi, ambaye bwana wake alimthamini sana, alikuwa mgonjwa sana karibu kufa.
Ekegusii: Omosomba oyomo bw’omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana konya onyarekire nigo arenge ang’e nogokwa; ere nomonto anchete mono.

English: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
Kiswahili: Jemadari huyo aliposikia habari za Yesu, aliwatuma wazee wa Kiyahudi kwake, wakamwomba aje kumponya mtumishi wa huyo jemadari.
Ekegusii: Agachia koigwa amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agatoma asare abagaaka b’Abayahudi komoboria ache agwenie omosomba oye.

English: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
Kiswahili: Wale wazee walipofika kwa Yesu, wakamsihi sana amsaidie yule jemadari wakisema, “Mtu huyu anastahili wewe umfanyie jambo hili,
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachia goika ase Yeso, bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Nagwenerete omokorere ring’ana eri,

English: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
Kiswahili: kwa sababu analipenda taifa letu tena ametujengea sinagogi.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera nanchete abanto baito, naende natoagacherete esinagogi yaito.”

English: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akaongozana nao, lakini alipokuwa hayuko mbali na nyumbani, yule jemadari akatuma rafiki zake kumwambia Yesu, “Bwana, usijisumbue, kwani mimi sistahili wewe kuingia chini ya dari yangu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akagenda amo nabarabwo. Goika agachia koba tari are ase enyomba yaye, oria omotang’ani bw’abarwani agatoma abasani asare, okomoteebia, “Omonene, tibwerosia, ekiagera inche ting’isaini aye orasoe inse y’ekerama kiane.

English: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo maana sikujiona hata ninastahili kuja kwako wewe. Lakini sema neno tu, naye mtumishi wangu atapona.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo neroche ng’a ting’isaini gocha ase ore; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.

English: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mimi mwenyewe ni mtu niliyewekwa chini ya mamlaka, nikiwa na askari chini yangu. Nikimwambia huyu, ‘Nenda,’ yeye huenda; na mwingine nikimwambia, ‘Njoo,’ yeye huja. Nikimwambia mtumishi wangu, ‘Fanya hivi,’ yeye hufanya.”
Ekegusii: Naki inche nomonto mbekire inse ase okobua, naende ninde nabasikari inse yane. Kondateebie oyo: Genda, ogenda, na oyonde: Inchuo, ocha; na omosomba one: Kora iga, okora.”

English: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia maneno haya, alishangazwa naye sana. Akaugeukia ule umati wa watu uliokuwa unamfuata, akawaambia, “Sijaona imani kubwa namna hii hata katika Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, agakumia asare, akeonchorera omoganda orenge komotunyana, akabora, “Nabatebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.”

English: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.
Kiswahili: Nao wale watu waliokuwa wametumwa kwa Yesu waliporudi nyumbani walimkuta yule mtumishi amepona.
Ekegusii: Nabo baria batometwe bagachia koirana nyomba mwaye, bakanyora omosomba oria otimokire.

English: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
Kiswahili: Baadaye kidogo, Yesu alikwenda katika mji mmoja ulioitwa Naini. Nao wanafunzi wake na umati mkubwa wa watu walikwenda pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya akagenda omochie okorokwa Naini; aborokigwa baye bakagenda amo nere, na abanto abange.

English: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.
Kiswahili: Alipokaribia lango la mji, alikutana na watu waliokuwa wamebeba maiti wakitoka nje ya mji. Huyu aliyekufa alikuwa mwana pekee wa mwanamke mjane. Umati mkubwa wa watu wa mji ule ulikuwa pamoja na huyo mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Nabo, agachia goika ang’e ase egeita ki’omochie, rora, agwo nkiarengeo egetondo kebogoirie gocha isiko, omwana omomoima ase ng’ina, na ng’ina nomoboraka orenge, na abanto abange b’omochie mbarenge amo nere.

English: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
Kiswahili: Bwana Yesu alipomwona yule mjane, moyo wake ulimhurumia, akamwambia, “Usilie.”
Ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene achia komoorora akamororera amaabera, akamoteebia, “Torera!”

English: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
Kiswahili: Kisha akasogea mbele akaligusa lile jeneza na wale waliokuwa wamelibeba wakasimama kimya. Akasema, “Kijana, nakuambia inuka.”
Ekegusii: Akagenda ang’e, agakuna esanduki; baria babogoretie esanduki bagatenena. Erio agakwana, “Omomura, nagotebirie, imoka!”

English: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.
Kiswahili: Yule aliyekuwa amekufa akaketi akaanza kuongea, naye Yesu akamkabidhi kwa mama yake.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria egetondo akaboka, agaikaransa, agachaaka gokwana. Yeso akamomoa ng’ina.

English: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, nao wakamtukuza Mungu wakisema, “Nabii mkuu ametokea miongoni mwetu, Mungu amekuja kuwakomboa watu wake.”
Ekegusii: Omoondoko okabwata bonsi, bagatogia, Nyasae, bakaboora, “Omobani omonene oorokire ase egati yaito!” Na “Nyasae ocheire abanto baye!”

English: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.
Kiswahili: Habari hizi za mambo aliyoyafanya Yesu zikaenea Uyahudi wote na sehemu zote za jirani.
Ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na ense yonsi yaetanaine.

English: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Yohana Mbatizaji wakamweleza Yohana mambo haya yote. Hivyo Yohana akawaita wanafunzi wake wawili
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa ba Yohana bakamoteebia aya onsi,

English: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
Kiswahili: na kuwatuma kwa Bwana ili kumuuliza, “Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?”
Ekegusii: erio Yohana akarangeria babere ase aborokigwa baye, akabatoma ase Omonene komoboria, “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”

English: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”
Kiswahili: Wale watu walipofika kwa Yesu wakamwambia, “Yohana Mbatizaji ametutuma tukuulize, ‘Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?’ ”
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo baikire asare, bakamoteebia, “Yohana Omobatisi ototomire ase ore, okobora: Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”

English: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, Yesu aliwaponya wengi waliokuwa na magonjwa, maradhi na pepo wachafu, na pia akawafungua vipofu wengi macho wakapata kuona.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Yeso akagwenia abanto abange abarenge namarwaire, na emechando, na babwatire n’Omoika omobe; na abange abarenge emeuko akabaramokia amaiso abo, bakarora.

English: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akawajibu wale wajumbe, “Rudini mkamwambie Yohana yote mnayoyaona na kuyasikia: Vipofu wanapata kuona, viwete wanatembea, wenye ukoma wanatakaswa, viziwi wanasikia, wafu wanafufuliwa na maskini wanahubiriwa habari njema.
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Genda moteebie Yohana ayamwarora na aya mwaigwa: Abarenge emeuko nkorora bare, abarenge amagata ngotaara bare, abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma basibekire, abarenge emetino nkoigwa bare, abare ebitondo nkobokigwa bare, na abataka nkoranderigwa bare amang’ana amaya.

English: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
Kiswahili: Wajumbe wa Yohana walipoondoka, Yesu akaanza kusema na makutano kuhusu Yohana Mbatizaji. Akawauliza, “Mlipokwenda kule nyikani, mlikwenda kuona nini? Je, ni unyasi ukipeperushwa na upepo?
Ekegusii: Na abatomwa baria ba Yohana bachia kogenda, agachaaka goteebia omoganda igoro ya Yohana, “Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Egetonto gekonyegerigwa nembeo?

English: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.
Kiswahili: Kama sivyo, mlikwenda kuona nini basi? Mtu aliyevaa mavazi ya kifahari? La hasha, watu wanaovaa mavazi ya kifahari na kuishi maisha ya anasa wako katika majumba ya kifalme.
Ekegusii: Ninki mwachiete korora? Nomonto oboyirie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chingiya mono, na koria obwansu bw’omogooko, nigo bare ase chinyomba chi’abarwoti.

English: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
Kiswahili: Lakini mlikwenda kuona nini? Mlikwenda kumwona nabii? Naam, nawaambia, yeye ni zaidi ya nabii.
Ekegusii: Ninki mwachiete korora? Omobani? Ee, nabateebirie: Oyore omonene kobua omobani,

English: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye ambaye habari zake zimeandikwa: “ ‘Tazama, nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako, atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako.’
Ekegusii: ekiagera oyio nere amang’ana aya ariikire igoro yaye, “Rigereria, inche natomire omotomwa one ase obosio bwao, oyo oratang’ane koroisia enchera yao.

English: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”
Kiswahili: Nawaambia, miongoni mwa wale waliozaliwa na wanawake, hakuna aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana. Lakini yeye aliye mdogo kabisa katika Ufalme wa Mungu ni mkuu kuliko Yohana.”
Ekegusii: Nigo nkobateebia: Ase baria baiboire nabakungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana, korende oyore omoke ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae nomonene komobua.”

English: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
Kiswahili: (Watu wote hata watoza ushuru waliposikia maneno ya Yesu, walikubali kwamba mpango wa Mungu ni haki, maana walikuwa wamebatizwa na Yohana.
Ekegusii: (Abanto bonsi na abarusia ebango bagachia koigwa aya, bakaorokia oboronge bwa Nyasae, ekiagera baabatisetwe ase ebatiso ya Yohana;

English: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mafarisayo na wataalamu wa sheria walikataa mpango wa Mungu kwao kwa kutokubali kubatizwa na Yohana.)
Ekegusii: korende Abafarisai na abanto b’amachiiko bagakana omooroberio o Nyasae ase bare abanyene, ekiagera tibaabatisetwe na Yohana.)

English: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Niwafananishe na nini watu wa kizazi hiki? Wanafanana na nini?
Ekegusii: Yeso akagenderera gokwana akabora, “Ninki ndagwekanie abanto b’ekegori eke? Barabwo ninki bagwekaine?

English: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
Kiswahili: Wao ni kama watoto waliokaa sokoni wakiitana wao kwa wao, wakisema: “ ‘Tuliwapigia filimbi, lakini hamkucheza; tuliwaimbia nyimbo za maombolezo, lakini hamkulia.’
Ekegusii: Nigo bagwekaine nabana baikaransete ase echiiro, bakorangerania, bakobora, “Twababugeirie ebiroria, na inwe timotengeti; tweumirie, na inwe timorereti.

English: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja, alikuwa hali mkate wala hanywi divai, nanyi mkasema, ‘Yeye ana pepo mchafu.’
Ekegusii: Naki Yohana Omobatisi nigo achete, tare koria omogati, gose tare konywa edivai; na inwe mogoteeba: Nabwatire nekerecha.

English: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu alikuja akila na kunywa, nanyi mnasema: ‘Tazameni huyu mlafi na mlevi, rafiki wa watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi.” ’
Ekegusii: Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ochire, okoria na konywa, na inwe mogoteeba: Rora, nomonto omoribobe, ogotinda edivai, omosani bw’ababarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe!

English: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”
Kiswahili: Nayo hekima huthibitishwa kuwa kweli na watoto wake wote.”
Ekegusii: Korende obong’aini bwa Nyasae bwamanyekanire koba oboronge ase abana baye bonsi.”

English: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.
Kiswahili: Basi Farisayo mmoja alimwalika Yesu nyumbani kwake kwa chakula. Hivyo Yesu akaenda nyumbani mwa yule Farisayo na kukaa katika nafasi yake mezani.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’Abafarisai akamoarigania ache koria endagera amo nere. Agasoa ase enyomba y’Omofarisai oria, agaikaransa ase endagera.

English: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
Kiswahili: Naye mwanamke mmoja kwenye ule mji, ambaye alikuwa mwenye dhambi, alipojua kwamba Yesu alikuwa akila chakula nyumbani kwa yule Farisayo, akaleta chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato.
Ekegusii: Na rora, omokungu oyomo ase omochie oria, oyorenge omonyene ebibe, agachia konyora amang’ana ng’a oikaransire ase enyomba y’Omofarisai oria, akarenta echuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta e rimisu rigiya,

English: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akasimama nyuma ya miguu ya Yesu akilia. Akailowanisha miguu yake kwa machozi yake, kisha akaifuta kwa nywele zake, akaibusu na kuimiminia manukato.
Ekegusii: agatenena korwa magega, ang’e namagoro aye, okorera. Agachaaka komoiyereria amariga aye ase amagoro aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye, okonyunyunta amagoro aye, na koyaaka amaguta aria.

English: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”
Kiswahili: Yule Farisayo aliyemwalika Yesu alipoona yanayotendeka, akawaza moyoni mwake, “Kama huyu mtu angekuwa nabii, angejua kwamba ni nani anayemgusa, na kwamba yeye ni mwanamke wa namna gani, na ya kuwa huyu mwanamke ni mwenye dhambi.”
Ekegusii: Omofarisai, oria omoariganetie, agachia koyarora akeboria ase omoyo oye ime, ogoteeba, “Omonto oyo, onye nomobani orenge, anga namomanya oyo ng’a nere ng’o, gose mokuungu ki oyo okomokuna, ng’a nomonyene ebibe.”

English: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akanena akamwambia, “Simoni, nina jambo la kukuambia.” Simoni akajibu, “Mwalimu, sema.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Simioni, ninde ne ring’ana nkogoteebia.” Akabora, “Omworokia, kwana.”

English: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
Kiswahili: “Palikuwa na mtu mmoja aliyewakopesha watu wawili fedha: Mmoja alidaiwa dinari 500na mwingine dinari hamsini.
Ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo omorua singo orenge nabasira babere; oyomo omoriete esira ye chidinari amagana atano (500), na oyo o kabere emerongo etano (50).

English: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
Kiswahili: Wote wawili walipokuwa hawawezi kulipa, aliyafuta madeni yao wote wawili. Sasa ni yupi kati yao atakayempenda yule aliyewasamehe zaidi?”
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibarenge na gento bagoakana. Akabaabera bonsi babere. Gaki, ase abwo, ning’o oramwanche kobua?”

English: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
Kiswahili: Simoni akajibu, “Nadhani ni yule aliyesamehewa deni kubwa zaidi.” Naye Yesu akamwambia, “Umehukumu kwa usahihi.”
Ekegusii: Simioni akairaneria, “Igo ndabore ng’a, noria bwaberetwe ebinge.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Kwanachire boronge.”

English: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamgeukia yule mwanamke, akamwambia Simoni, “Je, unamwona mwanamke huyu? Nilipoingia nyumbani mwako, hukunipa maji ya kunawa miguu yangu, lakini huyu ameninawisha miguu kwa machozi yake, na kunifuta kwa nywele zake.
Ekegusii: Akaonchoka gochia ase omokungu oria, agateebia Simioni, “Kwarorire omokungu oyo? Inasoa mwao, tikwang’a amaache ay’ogwesibia amagoro, korende oyo osibirie amagoro aane namariga aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye.

English: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
Kiswahili: Hukunisalimu kwa busu, lakini huyu mwanamke hajaacha kuibusu miguu yangu tangu nilipoingia.
Ekegusii: Tonyunyunteti, korende ere korwa ekero nasoete aa tatigeti konyunyunta amagoro aane.

English: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
Kiswahili: Hukunipaka mafuta kichwani mwangu, lakini yeye ameipaka miguu yangu manukato.
Ekegusii: Tong’ageti omotwe one amaguta, korende ere ong’akire amagoro aane amaguta agotioka buya.

English: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, nakuambia, dhambi zake zilizokuwa nyingi zimesamehewa, kwani ameonyesha upendo mwingi. Lakini yule aliyesamehewa kidogo, hupenda kidogo.”
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nagotebirie, obwanchani bwaye bworokirie ng’a ebibe biaye ebinge biabeirwe; ere oyokwaberwa ebike nigo anchete ake.”

English: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia yule mwanamke, “Dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia omokungu oria, “Kwabeirwe ebibe biao.”

English: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
Kiswahili: Lakini wale waliokuwa wameketi pamoja naye chakulani wakaanza kusemezana wao kwa wao, “Huyu ni nani ambaye hata anasamehe dhambi?”
Ekegusii: Na baria baikaransete amo nere bagachaaka goteeba ase emioyo yabo ime, “Nere ng’o oyo oranyare kwabera ebibe?”

English: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia yule mwanamke, “Imani yako imekuokoa; nenda kwa amani.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia omokungu oria, “Okwegena kwao kwagotooririe; genda nomorembe.”

English: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya Yesu alikwenda, akawa anazunguka katika miji na vijiji akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu. Wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili walikuwa pamoja naye,
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya, akaba ngoetanana are ase emechie na ebichie, okorandia na kobateebia amang’ana amaya ay’oborwoti bwa Nyasae. Na baria ikomi na babere nigo barenge amo nere,

English: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;
Kiswahili: pia baadhi ya wanawake waliokuwa wametolewa pepo wachafu na kuponywa magonjwa. Miongoni mwao alikuwepo Maria Magdalene, aliyetolewa pepo wachafu saba;
Ekegusii: na abakungu bande ababwatire n’emeika emebe bakagwenigwa nere: Mariamu ore korokwa Magidalena, oria orusetigwe ebirecha bitano na bibere,

English: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.
Kiswahili: Yoana mkewe Kuza, msimamizi wa nyumba ya watu wa nyumbani mwa Herode; Susana; na wengine wengi waliokuwa wakimhudumia kwa mali zao.
Ekegusii: na Yoana moka Kusa, omorendi bwe Herode, na Susana, na abande abange. Abwo nigo barenge kobakorera ne chinibo chiabo.

English: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulipokuwa ukija kwa Yesu kutoka kila mji, akawaambia mfano huu:
Ekegusii: Ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na abanto ba kera omochie bakamochiera, agakwana ase omoreng’anio:

English: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
Kiswahili: “Mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake. Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia; zikakanyagwa, nao ndege wa angani wakazila.
Ekegusii: “Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura embusuro yaye: Ekero akobusura, echinde chikagwa enchera ensemo, chigatiringwa namagoro, chinyoni chia igoro chigachiria.

English: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
Kiswahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka penye miamba, nazo zilipoota, hiyo mimea ikakauka kwa kukosa unyevu.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, chikamera, chikooma ase okomocha amaache.

English: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.
Kiswahili: Nazo mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye miiba, nayo ile miiba ikakua pamoja nazo, na kuisonga hiyo mimea.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakina amo na chirochio, agachimiga.

English: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”
Kiswahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri. Zikaota na kuzaa mara mia moja zaidi ya mbegu alizopanda.” Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu akapaza sauti, akasema, “Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”
Ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikamera, chikama rigana.” Ekero are kobateebia aya, agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”

English: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza maana ya mfano huo.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Omoreng’anio oyio ninki ogoteeba?”

English: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’
Kiswahili: Naye akasema, “Ninyi mmepewa kufahamu siri za Ufalme wa Mungu, lakini kwa wengine nazungumza kwa mifano, ili, “ ‘ingawa wanatazama, wasione; ingawa wanasikiliza, wasielewe.’
Ekegusii: Agateeba, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae; korende abande nabateebigwe ase emereng’anio, erinde okong’ereria bariingererie, korende tibarora, naende ogotegerera bategerere, korende tibaigwa.

English: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
Kiswahili: “Maana ya mfano huu ni hii: Mbegu ni neno la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omoreng’anio noro oyo: Embusuro nering’ana ria Nyasae.

English: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.
Kiswahili: Zile zilizoanguka kando ya njia ni wale ambao husikia neno, naye ibilisi anakuja na kuliondoa neno kutoka mioyoni mwao, ili wasije wakaamini na kuokoka.
Ekegusii: Baria b’enchera ensemo, nabwo baikire koriigwa; erio Saitani ochicha, na korusia ring’ana riria ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde tibacha kwegena batooreke.

English: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.
Kiswahili: Zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye mwamba ni wale ambao hulipokea neno kwa furaha wanapolisikia, lakini hawana mizizi. Wanaamini kwa muda mfupi, lakini wakati wa kujaribiwa huiacha imani.
Ekegusii: Na baria bare ase egetare nabwo baria bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata nomogooko, korende barabwo tibari nemeri, begena ase ekero egeke, na ekero ki’ogoteemwa beatanana.

English: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.
Kiswahili: Zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye miiba ni mfano wa wale wanaosikia, lakini wanapoendelea husongwa na masumbufu ya maisha haya, utajiri na anasa, nao hawakui.
Ekegusii: Na echio chiagwete ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoriigwa, na barabwo kobakogenderera bamigwa nokorengereria kw’enibo, na omogooko bw’ense eye, tibakwama ase ogoikerania.

English: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.
Kiswahili: Lakini zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye udongo mzuri ni mfano wa wale ambao hulisikia neno la Mungu na kulishika kwa moyo mnyofu wa utiifu, nao kwa kuvumilia kwingi huzaa matunda.
Ekegusii: Na echinde chire ase amaroba amaya; aba nabwo bare ne chinkoro chingiya naende echi’ekeene, bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata, bama okwama noboremereria.

English: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mtu awashaye taa na kuificha ndani ya gudulia au kuiweka mvunguni mwa kitanda. Badala yake, huiweka juu ya kinara, ili wale waingiao ndani waone mwanga.
Ekegusii: “Omonto onde tari ogotongia etaya na koyemumeka negento, gose koyebeeka nyaro y’oborere; korende nigo akoyebeeka igoro ase ekebekerero kiaye, erinde abagosoa barore oborabu.

English: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hakuna jambo lolote lililofichika ambalo halitafichuliwa, wala lolote lililositirika ambalo halitajulikana na kuwekwa wazi.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ring’ana tiriri ribisegete, ritache koorokigwa, gose eria bobisi ritache komanyekana maiso marore.

English: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kuweni waangalifu mnavyosikia. Kwa maana yeyote aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile anachodhani anacho atanyangʼanywa.”
Ekegusii: Mwerende gaki inwe buna mokoigwa, ekiagera ere oyobwate naegwe, korende oyotabwati, naurwe nonya nkeria arengereretie abwate.”

English: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.
Kiswahili: Wakati mmoja mama yake Yesu na ndugu zake walikuja kumwona, lakini hawakuweza kumfikia kwa sababu ya msongamano wa watu.
Ekegusii: Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo bakamochiera, korende tibanyara komoika ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda.

English: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja akamwambia, “Mama yako na ndugu zako wako nje wanataka kukuona.”
Ekegusii: Akairerwa amang’ana agateebigwa, “Nyoko na bamura bamino mbateneine isiko, baganetie kororana naye.”

English: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mama yangu na ndugu zangu ni wale wote wanaolisikia neno la Mungu na kulifanya.”
Ekegusii: Korende akabateebia, “Baba na bamura baminto nabwo aba abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na korikora.”

English: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.
Kiswahili: Siku moja Yesu alipanda ndani ya mashua pamoja na wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Tuvukeni twende mpaka ngʼambo ya ziwa.” Nao wakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo akariina obwato, ere na aborokigwa baye, akabateebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha.” Bakamanora.

English: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.
Kiswahili: Hivyo walipokuwa wakienda, akalala usingizi. Dhoruba kali ikatokea mle ziwani, hata mashua ikawa inajaa maji, nao walikuwa katika hatari kubwa.
Ekegusii: Kobachia kogenda, akarara chitoro; omwaga ogaacha, na emerindo ase enyancha, obwato bogaachaka goichorwa namaache, bakaba ase emechando.

English: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumwamsha, wakisema, “Bwana, Bwana, tunaangamia!” Yeye akaamka, akaukemea ule upepo na yale mawimbi; dhoruba ikakoma, nako kukawa shwari.
Ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakaboora, “Omonene Nyasae, ngosira tore!” Erio ere akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga na emerindo y’amaache, na birobio bigakira, gokaba ogotoerera.

English: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Imani yenu iko wapi?” Kwa woga na mshangao wakaulizana, “Huyu ni nani, ambaye anaamuru hata upepo na maji, navyo vikamtii?”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Okwegena kwaino, ng’ai kore?” Bakairoka, bagakumia bagateebania, “Oyo nere ng’o, ogochika nonya nomwaga na enyancha, bikomoigwera?”

English: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.
Kiswahili: Basi wakafika katika nchi ya Wagerasi, ambayo iko upande wa pili wa ziwa kutoka Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Bagaika engegu y’ense y’Abageraseni, erigereretie Galili.

English: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposhuka kutoka mashua na kukanyaga ufuoni, alikutana na mtu mmoja wa mji ule aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu, naye kwa muda mrefu alikuwa havai nguo wala kuishi nyumbani, bali aliishi makaburini.
Ekegusii: Agachia goika engegu, akaumerana nomonto oyomo bw’omochie oria, obwatire nebirecha; na ase amatuko amange tarenge kweboyia chianga, tarenge komenya nyomba, otatiga ase chimbeera.

English: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”
Kiswahili: Alipomwona Yesu, alipiga kelele, akajitupa chini mbele yake na kusema kwa sauti kuu, “Una nini nami, Yesu, Mwana wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana? Nakuomba, usinitese!”
Ekegusii: Agachia korora Yeso, agaaka egeturi, akagwa ase obosio bwaye, agakwana neriogi rinene, okobora, “Inaki inde naye, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono? Nagosabire, tonchanda.”

English: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yesu alikuwa amemwamuru yule pepo mchafu amtoke huyo mtu. Mara nyingi huyo pepo mchafu alimpagaa, na hata alipofungwa kwa minyororo mikono na miguu na kuwekwa chini ya ulinzi, alikata hiyo minyororo na kupelekwa na huyo pepo mchafu kwenda nyikani.
Ekegusii: Naki konya ochikiire ekerecha keria ki’eubi gesoke korwa ase omonto oria. (Ekiagera ebiro ebinge nigo kiare komobwata; nonya orenge gosibwa nebinyuri ne chingataare na korendwa, nigo arenge kobutora ebisibo biria oirwa nekerecha keria goika ase erooro.)

English: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamuuliza, “Jina lako ni nani?” Akamjibu, “Legioni,” kwa kuwa alikuwa ameingiwa na pepo wachafu wengi mno.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Elegioni”, ekiagera ebirecha ebinge biamosoete.

English: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.
Kiswahili: Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi sana asiwaamuru kwenda katika Shimo.
Ekegusii: Bikamosorora tabichika bigende goika ase eora entambe.

English: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.
Kiswahili: Palikuwa na kundi kubwa la nguruwe hapo likilisha kando ya kilima. Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi Yesu awaruhusu wawaingie hao nguruwe, naye akawaruhusu.
Ekegusii: Ndiarengeo riicho rinene rie chimbeche, chiare korisia ase egetunwa, bikamosorora abie ribaga bichisoe. Akabia ribaga.

English: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.
Kiswahili: Wale pepo wachafu walipomtoka yule mtu, wakawaingia wale nguruwe, nalo kundi lote likateremkia gengeni kwa kasi, likatumbukia ziwani na kuzama.
Ekegusii: Ebirecha biria bigasoka korwa ase omonto oria, bigasoa chimbeche. Riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano goika chikagwa enyancha ime, chikarimera.

English: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
Kiswahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wakichunga lile kundi la nguruwe walipoona yaliyotukia, wakakimbia, wakaeneza habari hizi mjini na mashambani.
Ekegusii: Abarisia bagachia korora ayio, bagatama, bakararia amang’ana ase omochie na ebichie.

English: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
Kiswahili: Nao watu wakatoka kwenda kujionea wenyewe yaliyotukia. Walipofika hapo alipokuwa Yesu, wakamkuta yule mtu aliyetokwa na pepo wachafu amekaa karibu na Yesu, akiwa amevaa nguo na mwenye akili timamu! Wakaogopa.
Ekegusii: Abanto bagasoka barore amang’ana aorokire; bagachiera Yeso, bakarora omonto oria orusetigwe ebirecha biria oikaransete ase amagoro a Yeso obegete chianga, ore nebirengererio ebironge, bakairoka.

English: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.
Kiswahili: Wale walioyaona mambo hayo wakawaeleza watu wengine jinsi yule mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo wachafu alivyoponywa.
Ekegusii: Na baria bayaroche bakabateebia buna oria obwatire nebirecha agwenetigwe.

English: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wote wa nchi ile ya Wagerasi wakamwomba Yesu aondoke kwao, kwa sababu walikuwa wamejawa na hofu. Basi akaingia katika mashua, akaondoka zake.
Ekegusii: Naboigo abanto bonsi b’ense y’Abageraseni bakamobooria arue ase bare, ekiagera basoetwe nokoiroka okonene. Erio akariina obwato, akairana.

English: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,
Kiswahili: Yule mtu aliyetokwa na pepo wachafu akamsihi Yesu afuatane naye, lakini Yesu akamuaga, akamwambia:
Ekegusii: Na omonto oria orusetigwe ebirecha akamosorora abe amo nere, korende Yeso akamokania, akabora,

English: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.
Kiswahili: “Rudi nyumbani ukawaeleze mambo makuu Mungu aliyokutendea.” Kwa hiyo yule mtu akaenda, akatangaza katika mji wote mambo makuu ambayo Yesu alimtendea.
Ekegusii: “Irana nka bwoo orarie amang’ana amanene aya Nyasae agokoreire.” Akagenda bwoye, akararia ase omochie omogima amang’ana amanene aya Yeso amokoreire.

English: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu aliporudi, umati mkubwa wa watu ukampokea kwa furaha, kwani walikuwa wakimngojea.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koirana, omosangererekano okamogokera, ekiagera abanto bonsi bamoganyete.

English: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,
Kiswahili: Kisha mtu mmoja, jina lake Yairo, aliyekuwa kiongozi wa sinagogi, akaja na kuanguka miguuni mwa Yesu, akimwomba afike nyumbani kwake,
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yairo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, agacha, akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, akamosorora asoe nyomba mwaye,

English: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa binti yake wa pekee, mwenye umri wa miaka kumi na miwili, alikuwa anakufa. Yesu alipokuwa akienda, umati wa watu ukamsonga sana.
Ekegusii: ekiagera narenge nomoiseke, omwana omomoima, konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere, na ere nigo arenge ang’e ogokwa. Ekero Yeso arenge kogenda abanto bakaba bakomomiga‐miga.

English: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,
Kiswahili: Katika umati huo palikuwa na mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa na tatizo la kutokwa damu kwa muda wa miaka kumi na miwili. Tena alikuwa amegharimia yote aliyokuwa nayo kwa ajili ya matibabu, wala hakuna yeyote aliyeweza kumponya.
Ekegusii: Naende omokungu oyomo oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, konya oonirie ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio ase abarwaria, tanyara kogwenigwa nonde.

English: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.
Kiswahili: Huyo mwanamke akaja kwa nyuma ya Yesu na kugusa upindo wa vazi lake. Mara kutokwa damu kwake kukakoma.
Ekegusii: Ere agatunyana Yeso korwa magega, agakuna omokoba bw’eanga yaye; erio kegima amanyinga aye agakama.

English: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
Kiswahili: Yesu akauliza, “Ni nani aliyenigusa?” Watu wote walipokana, Petro akasema, “Bwana, huu umati wa watu unakusonga na kukusukuma kila upande.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabooria, “Ning’o onkuna?” Ekero abanto bonsi bagakana, Petero na baria barenge amo nere bakamoteebia, “Omonene, omoganda nigo ogoetanaine na gokomiga.”

English: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akasema, “Kuna mtu aliyenigusa, kwa maana nimetambua kuwa nguvu zimenitoka.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Omonto onkunire, ekiagera naigure ng’a chinguru chiandure.”

English: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke alipofahamu ya kuwa hawezi kuendelea kujificha, alikuja akitetemeka, akaanguka miguuni mwa Yesu. Akaeleza mbele ya watu wote kwa nini alimgusa na jinsi alivyoponywa mara.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria ekero achia korora ng’a tabisekaneti, agacha okoiguswa, akamogwera, na ase amasio ’abaanto bonsi akamworokia engencho yagera omokuna, naende buna agwenetigwe ara rimo.

English: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu akamwambia, “Binti, imani yako imekuponya. Nenda kwa amani.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie; genda nomorembe.”

English: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa bado anasema, akaja mtumishi kutoka nyumbani kwa Yairo, yule kiongozi wa sinagogi, kumwambia, “Binti yako amekwisha kufa. Usiendelee kumsumbua Mwalimu.”
Ekegusii: Erio kagokwana, omonto agacha korwa ase enyomba y’oria omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, akamoteebia, “Enyaroka yao yakuure, torosia omworokia naende.”

English: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia jambo hili, akamwambia Yairo, “Usiogope. Amini tu, naye binti yako atapona.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, erio akamoiraneria, “Toiroka; egene rioka, ere nagwenigwe.”

English: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.
Kiswahili: Walipofika nyumbani kwa Yairo, hakumruhusu mtu yeyote aingie ndani naye isipokuwa Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, pamoja na baba na mama wa yule binti.
Ekegusii: Agachia goika nyomba, tancha monto onde asoe amo nere otatiga Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, na ise na ng’ina b’omwana oria.

English: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule watu wote walikuwa wakilia na kuomboleza kwa ajili ya huyo binti. Yesu akawaambia, “Acheni kulia. Huyu binti hajafa, ila amelala.”
Ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi nigo barenge komoreera, bakweng’ereria, korende Yeso akabora, “Timorera, ekiagera takweti, korende nigo araire.”

English: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.
Kiswahili: Wao wakamcheka kwa dharau, wakijua kuwa amekwisha kufa.
Ekegusii: Bakamosekerera, bamanyete ng’a okuure.

English: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamshika yule binti mkono na kuita, “Binti, amka!”
Ekegusii: Korende ere akamobwata okoboko kwaye, agateeba, “Omwana, imoka!”

English: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.
Kiswahili: Roho yake ikamrudia, naye akainuka mara moja. Akaamuru apewe kitu cha kula.
Ekegusii: Omoika oye okairana, agatenena erio kegima Yeso akabachiika bamoe endagera arie.

English: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wake wakastaajabu sana, lakini Yesu akawakataza wasimwambie mtu yeyote juu ya yale yaliyotukia.
Ekegusii: Abaibori baye bagakumia, mono, korende akabachiika tibateebia monto ayakoreka.

English: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
Kiswahili: Yesu kisha akawaita wale kumi na wawili pamoja, akawapa mamlaka na uwezo wa kutoa pepo wachafu wote na kuponya magonjwa yote,
Ekegusii: Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere akabaa chinguru na okobua igoro ase ebirecha bionsi na ase okogwenia amarwaire.

English: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.
Kiswahili: kisha akawatuma waende wakahubiri Ufalme wa Mungu na kuponya wagonjwa.
Ekegusii: Akabatoma korandia oborwoti bwa Nyasae na kogwenia abarwaire.

English: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.
Kiswahili: Akawaagiza akisema, “Msichukue chochote safarini: sio fimbo, wala mkoba, wala mkate, wala fedha, hata msichukue kanzu ya ziada.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Timobogoria gento ase orogendo rwaino, nonya nenyimbo, gose esaro, gose omogati, gose chitaabu; naende timoba ne chianga ibere.

English: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.
Kiswahili: Katika nyumba yoyote mwingiayo, kaeni humo hadi mtakapoondoka katika mji huo.
Ekegusii: Naende enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, mobeere aroro goika moruo.

English: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”
Kiswahili: Kama watu wasipowakaribisha, mnapoondoka katika mji wao, kungʼuteni mavumbi kutoka kwenye miguu yenu ili kuwa ushuhuda dhidi yao.”
Ekegusii: Naende abatabaroiseti, komogosoka korwa omochie oria, mokong’onte orotu rw’amagoro aino, erinde robe kirori ase bare.”

English: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wale wanafunzi wakaondoka wakaenda kutoka kijiji hadi kijiji, wakihubiri habari njema na kuponya wagonjwa kila mahali.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda, bagaetanana ase emechie, bakorandia enchiri, na kogwenia abanto chinsemo chionsi.

English: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,
Kiswahili: Basi Mfalme Herode, mtawala wa Galilaya, alisikia habari za yote yaliyotendeka. Naye akafadhaika, kwa kuwa baadhi ya watu walikuwa wakisema Yohana Mbatizaji amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Bono Herode omorwoti akaigwa onsi ayakorekire, agaichanigwa mono, ekiagera abande baare goteeba ng’a Yohana obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure,

English: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.
Kiswahili: Wengine wakasema Eliya amewatokea, na wengine wakasema kwamba mmoja wa manabii wa kale amefufuka.
Ekegusii: na abande ng’a n’Elija oorokire, na abande ng’a noyomo bw’ababani abakoro obokire.

English: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.
Kiswahili: Herode akasema, “Yohana nilimkata kichwa. Lakini ni nani huyu ambaye ninasikia mambo kama haya kumhusu?” Akatamani sana kumwona.
Ekegusii: Herode agateeba, “Yohana inamonachete omotwe, korende ning’o oyo rende naigure amang’ana are buna aya?” Akarigia komorora.

English: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.
Kiswahili: Mitume wake waliporudi, wakamweleza Yesu yote waliyofanya. Akawachukua, akaenda nao faraghani mpaka mji uitwao Bethsaida.
Ekegusii: Abatomwa baria ekero bachia koirana bagateebia Yeso amang’ana onsi ayabakorire. Erio akagenda amo nabarabwo bobisi akabaira, gochia ase omochie okorokwa Bethisaida.

English: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.
Kiswahili: Lakini umati wa watu ukafahamu alikokwenda, ukamfuata. Akawakaribisha na kunena nao kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu na kuwaponya wale wote waliokuwa wanahitaji uponyaji.
Ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora, ekamotunyana, na ere akabaroisia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, akagwenia abarenge nokogania gw’okogwenigwa.

English: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”
Kiswahili: Ilipokaribia jioni, wale mitume kumi na wawili wakaenda kwa Yesu na kumwambia, “Waage makutano ili waende vijijini jirani na mashambani, ili wapate chakula na mahali pa kulala, kwa maana hapa tuko nyikani.”
Ekegusii: Rigachaaka kogoroba, na baria ikomi na babere bakamochiera, bakamoteebia, “Tiga omoganda ogende goika ase ebichie ne chinsemo chietanaine, banyore aase bakorara amo nendagera, ekiagera aiga nigo tore aase erooro.”

English: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ninyi wapeni chakula.” Nao wakajibu, “Hatuna zaidi ya mikate mitano na samaki wawili. Labda twende tukanunue chakula cha kuwatosha watu hawa wote.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe bae endagera!” Bakaboora, “Titobwati kende kobua emegati etano ne chinswe ibere. Gose togende kogorera abanto aba bonsi endagera?”

English: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
Kiswahili: Walikuwako wanaume wapatao 5,000. Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Waketisheni katika makundi ya watu hamsini hamsini.”
Ekegusii: Naki mbarengeo abasacha chilifu isano iga. Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Baikaransie abanto aba ase ebiombe, na kera ekeombe koreng’ana emerongo etano.”

English: They did so, and made them all sit down.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wakafanya hivyo, wakawaketisha wote.
Ekegusii: Bagakora boigo, bakabaikaransia bonsi.

English: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaichukua ile mikate mitano na wale samaki wawili, akatazama mbinguni, akavibariki na kuvimega. Kisha akawapa wanafunzi ili wawagawie watu.
Ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa babiterekere abanto.

English: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
Kiswahili: Wote wakala, wakashiba. Nao wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili.
Ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota. Na ebisamunye biria biatigarete bigasangererigwa, bigaichora ebitonga ikomi na bibere.

English: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”
Kiswahili: Wakati mmoja, Yesu alipokuwa akiomba faraghani, nao wanafunzi wake wakiwa pamoja naye, akawauliza, “Watu husema mimi ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Engaki eyemo ekero Yeso are gosaba are ere bweka, aborokigwa baye nigo barenge ange nere, akababooria, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”

English: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Baadhi husema wewe ni Yohana Mbatizaji, wengine husema ni Eliya, na bado wengine husema kwamba ni mmoja wa manabii wa kale amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu.”
Ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Yohana Omobatisi; abande Elija, na abande ng’a oyomo ase ababani abakoro obokire.”

English: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akawauliza, “Je, ninyi mnasema mimi ni nani?” Petro akajibu, “Wewe ndiwe Kristo wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nainwe nigo mokobora ng’a ninche ng’o?” Petero akairaneria, “Kristo o Nyasae.”

English: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,
Kiswahili: Yesu akawakataza wasimwambie mtu yeyote jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Akabachiika na kobakania tibateebia monto ring’ana eri,

English: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”
