Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Imempasa Mwana wa Adamu kupata mateso mengi na kukataliwa na wazee, viongozi wa makuhani, na walimu wa sheria, na itampasa auawe, lakini siku ya tatu kufufuliwa kutoka mauti.”
Ekegusii: ogoteeba, “Negwenerete Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, naende aitwe, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.”

English: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia wote, “Mtu yeyote akitaka kunifuata, ni lazima ajikane mwenyewe, auchukue msalaba wake kila siku, anifuate.
Ekegusii: Agateebia bonsi, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye kera rituko antunyane.

English: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu atayaokoa.
Ekegusii: Naki onde bwensi orarigie koegera obogima bwaye oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho yane, oyio naboegere.

English: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?
Kiswahili: Je, itamfaidi nini mtu kuupata ulimwengu wote, lakini akapoteza au kuangamiza nafsi yake?
Ekegusii: Ekiagera inki eragwenere omonto karanyore ense yonsi, ko esirie gose gwesaria ere omonyene?

English: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote akinionea aibu mimi na maneno yangu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamwonea aibu atakapokuja katika utukufu wake na katika utukufu wa Baba, pamoja na malaika watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naki kera omonto orandorere obosooku inche na amang’ana aane, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto kagocha ase obonene bwaye, namororere obosooku ase Ise na ase abamalaika abachenu.

English: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, wako baadhi ya watu waliosimama hapa ambao hawataonja mauti kabla ya kuuona Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ekeene, mbare abanto ase aba bateneine aa, abataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake, goika barore oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.
Kiswahili: Yapata siku nane baada ya Yesu kusema hayo, aliwachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, akaenda nao mlimani kuomba.
Ekegusii: Agachia koba amatuko ang’e atano na atato magega ase amang’ana aya, akaira Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro gosaba.

English: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akiomba, sura ya uso wake ikabadilika, nayo mavazi yake yakametameta kama mwanga wa umeme wa radi.
Ekegusii: Na ekero arenge gosaba, ekieni ki’obosio bwaye gekaonchoka, ne chianga chiaye chikaba chindabu, chikameka‐meka.

English: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,
Kiswahili: Ghafula wakawaona watu wawili, ndio Mose na Eliya, wakizungumza naye.
Ekegusii: Na agwo, abanto babere bakarorekana bagakwana nere, nabwo Musa na Elija.

English: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Walionekana katika utukufu wakizungumza na Yesu kuhusu kifo chake ambacho kingetokea huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Abwo barorekanete ase obonene, na gokwana amang’ana ay’ogokwa kwaye, aya agwenerete goikerania Yerusalemu.

English: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.
Kiswahili: Petro na wenzake walikuwa wamelala usingizi mzito. Walipoamka, wakaona utukufu wa Yesu na wale watu wawili waliokuwa wamesimama pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Petero na baria barenge amo nere, konya babwatirwe ne chitoro, korende nigo bategesetie, bakarora obonene bwaye, na abanto baria babere bateneine amo nere.

English: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.
Kiswahili: Mose na Eliya walipokuwa wanaondoka, Petro akamwambia Yesu, “Bwana, ni vizuri tukae hapa! Tutajenga vibanda vitatu: kimoja chako, kingine cha Mose na kingine cha Eliya.” Lakini Petro alikuwa hajui asemacho.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto aba baare korua asare, Petero agateebia Yeso, “Omonene, imbuya intwe koba aiga; tokore ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, na ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija”; tamanyete aya agokwana.

English: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa bado anazungumza, pakatokea wingu, likawafunika, nao wakaogopa walipoingia mle kwenye wingu.
Ekegusii: Ekero agokwana amang’ana aya riire rigacha rikababisia, bakairoka kobachia gosoa ase riire.

English: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”
Kiswahili: Sauti ikatoka kwenye lile wingu ikisema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa, niliyemchagua. Msikieni yeye.”
Ekegusii: Eriogi rigasoka korwa ase riire riria rigoteeba, “Oyo n’Omwana one, Omochorwa one; moigwere ere!”

English: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.
Kiswahili: Baada ya sauti hiyo kusema, walimkuta Yesu akiwa peke yake. Wale wanafunzi wakalihifadhi jambo hili, wala kwa wakati huo hawakumwambia mtu yeyote yale waliyokuwa wameyaona.
Ekegusii: Ekero eriogi riakwanire, Yeso akarorekana ore bweka. Na barabwo bagakira, tibateebia monto ase amatuko aria ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’ayio baroche.

English: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake waliposhuka kutoka mlimani, alikutana na umati mkubwa wa watu.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere ekero baare gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, omoganda omonene okaumerana nere.

English: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja katika ule umati wa watu akapaza sauti, akasema, “Mwalimu, naomba umwangalie mwanangu, kwani ndiye mtoto wangu wa pekee.
Ekegusii: Naende rora, omonto oyomo ase omoganda oria agaaka egeturi, okobora, “Omworokia, nagosabire, origererie omomura one, ekiagera ere nomwana one omomoima.

English: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.
Kiswahili: Mara kwa mara pepo mchafu humpagaa na kumfanya apige kelele, kisha humwangusha na kumtia kifafa hata akatokwa na povu kinywani. Huyo pepo mchafu anamtesa sana, na hamwachi ila mara chache.
Ekegusii: Na rora ekerecha nigo gekomobwata, na ere bwango nigo akorera, naende kemogaragaria, erinde asokia amasombogoku, korende tikeri komorua otatiga ase okomosionora mono.

English: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”
Kiswahili: Niliwaomba wanafunzi wako wamtoe huyo pepo mchafu, lakini hawakuweza.”
Ekegusii: Nasaba aborokigwa bao bageserie, korende tibanyara.”

English: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Enyi kizazi kisichoamini na kilichopotoka! Nitakaa nanyi na kuwavumilia mpaka lini? Mlete mwanao hapa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, naende ekebe, nimbe amo nainwe goika ririri, na koremereria nainwe? Renta omomura oo aiga.”

English: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
Kiswahili: Hata yule mtoto alipokuwa akija, yule pepo mchafu akamwangusha, akamtia kifafa. Lakini Yesu akamkemea yule pepo mchafu amtoke, akamponya yule mtoto, na akamrudisha kwa baba yake.
Ekegusii: Agachia koba nkomochiera are ekerecha keria gekamoigusia na komoiyeria. Yeso agakania ekerecha keria, akagwenia omomura oria, akamoirania ase ise.

English: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,
Kiswahili: Watu wote wakastaajabia uweza mkuu wa Mungu. Wakati bado watu walikuwa wanastaajabia hayo yote aliyokuwa akiyafanya Yesu, yeye akawaambia wanafunzi wake:
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagakumia ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Korende ekero bonsi babete nogokumia ase amang’ana onsi akorete, agateebia aborokigwa baye,

English: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”
Kiswahili: “Sikilizeni kwa makini haya nitakayowaambia sasa: Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa watu.”
Ekegusii: “Tiga amang’ana aya asoe ase amato aino, ekiagera Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ngochia are kobekwa ase amaboko ’abaanto.”

English: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao hawakuelewa alimaanisha nini. Maana ya maneno hayo ilifichika kwao, hivyo hawakuyaelewa, nao wakaogopa kumuuliza maana yake.
Ekegusii: Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, rikaba ndiabiseka ase bare, erinde tibarimanya. Bakaba nobwoba komoboria engencho ye ring’ana riria.

English: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.
Kiswahili: Kukazuka mabishano miongoni mwa wanafunzi kuhusu ni nani miongoni mwao atakayekuwa mkuu kuliko wote.
Ekegusii: Okoengererania kogatuboka ase egati yabo ng’a ning’o ase bare ore omonene kobua abande.

English: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akayatambua mawazo yao, naye akamchukua mtoto mdogo, akamsimamisha kando yake.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Yeso achia komanya ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo, akabogoria omwana, akamobeka ang’e asare,

English: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia, “Yeyote amkaribishaye mtoto huyu mdogo kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi, na yeyote atakayenikaribisha mimi, atakuwa amemkaribisha yeye aliyenituma. Kwa maana yeye aliye mdogo miongoni mwenu, ndiye aliye mkuu kuliko wote.”
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyo ase erieta riane, onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, omwanchire ere oyontomete. Ekiagera ere oyore omoke ase egati yaino, oyio nere omonene.”

English: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”
Kiswahili: Yohana akasema, “Bwana, tumemwona mtu akitoa pepo wachafu kwa jina lako, nasi tukamzuia, kwa sababu yeye si mmoja wetu.”
Ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao, tokamokania, ekiagera tabwataini naintwe.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Msimzuie, kwa sababu yeyote ambaye si kinyume nanyi, yu upande wenu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoteebia, “Timomokania, ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaino nigo are ensemo yaino.”

English: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
Kiswahili: Wakati ulipokaribia wa yeye kuchukuliwa mbinguni, alikaza uso wake kwenda Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye aika ang’e kogenda igoro, akamanora kogenda Yerusalemu.

English: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
Kiswahili: Akatuma watu wamtangulie, nao wakaenda katika kijiji kimoja cha Samaria kumwandalia kila kitu;
Ekegusii: Agatoma abatomwa komotang’anera, bagende na gosoa ase agachie k’Abasamaria, bamoroiserie aase.

English: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: lakini watu wa kijiji kile hawakumkaribisha kwa sababu alikuwa anakwenda zake Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’omochie oria tibamoroisia, ekiagera arenge kogenda Yerusalemu.

English: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake, yaani Yakobo na Yohana, walipoona hayo, wakasema: “Bwana, unataka tuagize moto kutoka mbinguni ili uwaangamize?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye Yakobo na Yohana bagachia korora, aya, bakaboora, “Omonene, norigetie toborie omorero oike korwa igoro obasirie?”

English: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.
Kiswahili: Yesu akageuka na kuwakemea,
Ekegusii: Akeonchora, akabakania.

English: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.
Kiswahili: nao wakaenda kijiji kingine.
Ekegusii: Erio Bakagenda ase agachie kande.

English: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa njiani wakienda, mtu mmoja akamwambia Yesu, “Nitakufuata kokote uendako.”
Ekegusii: Ekero baare kogenda nchera omonto oyomo akamoteebia, “Ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”

English: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mbweha wana mapango, nao ndege wa angani wana viota, lakini Mwana wa Adamu hana mahali pa kulaza kichwa chake.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ebibwe mbire namakuruma, ne chinyoni chia igoro nchire nebiswa, korende Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto tari nase akobeeka omotwe oye.”

English: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia mtu mwingine, “Nifuate.” Mtu huyo akamjibu, “Bwana, niruhusu kwanza nikamzike baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia oyonde, “Ntunyana!” Ere akabora, “Omonene, ritang’ani ing’a ribaga ngende gotindeka tata”.

English: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Waache wafu wawazike wafu wao, bali wewe nenda ukautangaze Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Tiga abakuure batindeke abakuure babo, korende aye genda orandie oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”
Kiswahili: Mtu mwingine akamwambia, “Bwana, nitakufuata lakini naomba kwanza nikawaage jamaa yangu.”
Ekegusii: Naende oyonde nere akabora, “Omonene, ningotunyane, korende ritang’ani ing’a ribaga mbaakere ng’a batigare buya abanto b’enyomba yane.”

English: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mtu yeyote atiaye mkono wake kulima, kisha akatazama nyuma, hafai kwa Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omonto tari orabeeke okoboko kwaye ase obokombe bwe chieri, naende arigererie magega, oragwenere ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo, Bwana akawachagua wengine sabini na wawili, akawatuma wawili wawili katika kila mji na kila sehemu aliyokusudia kwenda baadaye.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Omonene agachora abande emerongo etano na ebere na babere (72), akabatoma babere babere bamotang’anere kogenda kera omochie na kera aase arengereretie kogenda ere omonyene.

English: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Mavuno ni mengi, lakini watendakazi ni wachache. Kwa hiyo mwombeni Bwana wa mavuno, ili apeleke watendakazi katika shamba lake la mavuno.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rigesa nerinene, korende abakori emeremo nabake; gaki mosabe Omonene bwe rigesa atome abakori emeremo ase rigesa riaye.

English: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
Kiswahili: Haya! nendeni. Ninawatuma kama wana-kondoo katikati ya mbwa mwitu.
Ekegusii: Bwatia enchera; rigereria, nabatomire inwe buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi gati‐gati ye chisese chi’orosana.

English: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
Kiswahili: Msichukue mkoba, wala mfuko, wala viatu, na msimsalimu mtu yeyote njiani.
Ekegusii: Timobogoria ekemoya, gose esaro, gose ebikoroto; gose timokwania monto nchera.

English: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
Kiswahili: “Mkiingia katika nyumba yoyote, kwanza semeni, ‘Amani iwe kwenu.’
Ekegusii: Na enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, ritang’ani mobore: Omorembe obe ase enyomba eye.

English: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
Kiswahili: Kama kuna mtu wa amani humo, basi amani yenu itakuwa juu yake. La sivyo, itawarudia.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto bw’omorembe oreo, omorembe oino noikaranse asare; korende onye taibo, nobairanere inwe.

English: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.
Kiswahili: Kaeni katika nyumba hiyo, mkila na kunywa kile watakachowapa, kwa sababu kila mtendakazi anastahili malipo yake. Msihamehame kutoka nyumba hadi nyumba.
Ekegusii: Mobeere ase enyomba eyio, morie na konywa ebi bakobaa, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete aegwe eng’eria yaye. Timoetanana enyomba ase enyomba.

English: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
Kiswahili: “Mkienda katika mji na watu wake wakawakaribisha, kuleni chochote kiwekwacho mbele yenu,
Ekegusii: Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, na abanto b’omochie oyio baabaariganie, karie eki barabae.

English: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
Kiswahili: waponyeni wagonjwa waliomo na waambieni: ‘Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.’
Ekegusii: Mogwenie abarwaire abareo, mobateebie: Oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwabaikeire ang’e.

English: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
Kiswahili: Lakini mkiingia katika mji, nao hawakuwakaribisha, tokeni mwende katika barabara zake mkaseme:
Ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi mogosoa omochie, na barabwo batabaariganeti, soka korwa aroro, eta ase chinchera chiaye, motebe:

English: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
Kiswahili: ‘Hata mavumbi ya mji wenu yaliyoshikamana na miguu yetu, tunayakungʼuta dhidi yenu. Lakini mjue kwamba Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.’
Ekegusii: Nonya norotu rw’omochie oino rwabwatereire amagoro aito twarwabusire ase more, korende manya aya, ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e.

English: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.
Kiswahili: Ninawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Sodoma kustahimili katika siku ile kuliko mji ule.
Ekegusii: Nabateebirie, nabe aororo ase Sodomu ase rituko riria kobua omochie oria.”

English: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
Kiswahili: “Ole wako Korazini! Ole wako Bethsaida! Kwa kuwa kama miujiza iliyofanyika kwenu ingefanyika Tiro na Sidoni, miji hiyo ingekuwa imetubu zamani, kwa kuvaa magunia na kujipaka majivu.
Ekegusii: “Obobe nobwao, Korasini! Obobe nobwao, Bethisaida! Ekiagera onye mbiakoregete ase Turo na Sidoni ebikone bie chinguru ebiakoregete ase more, abanto b’aroro anga mbaonchogete kare na goikaransa babegete chianga chi’echigunia na beagete ribu.

English: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
Kiswahili: Lakini itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Tiro na Sidoni kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu, kuliko ninyi.
Ekegusii: Korende nebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko riria ri’ekiina kobua ase more.

English: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
Kiswahili: Nawe, Kapernaumu, je, utainuliwa hadi mbinguni? La hasha, utashushwa mpaka kuzimu.”
Ekegusii: Naye Kapernaumu, noimokererigwe igoro? Noche goikigwa goika Eora y’amakweri.

English: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
Kiswahili: “Yeye awasikilizaye ninyi anisikiliza mimi; naye awakataaye ninyi amenikataa mimi. Lakini yeye anikataaye mimi amkataa yeye aliyenituma.”
Ekegusii: “Oyorabaigwere inwe, nanyigwere nainche, na ere oyorabaange inwe, onyangire nainche, na ere oyoranyange inche, omwangire ere oyontomete.”

English: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
Kiswahili: Wale sabini na wawili wakarudi kwa furaha, na kusema, “Bwana, hata pepo wachafu wanatutii kwa jina lako.”
Ekegusii: Baria emerongo etano na ebere na babere (72) bakairana nomogooko, bagateeba, “Omonene, nonya nebirecha biatoigwereire ase erieta riao.”

English: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Nilimwona Shetani akianguka kutoka mbinguni kama umeme wa radi.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naroche Saitani okogwa korwa igoro buna okomesa.

English: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
Kiswahili: Tazama nimewapa mamlaka ya kukanyaga nyoka na nge na juu ya nguvu zote za adui; wala hakuna kitu chochote kitakachowadhuru.
Ekegusii: Rora, nabaeire okobua gotindacha ching’iti chionsi, na ebiuge, ne chinguru chionsi chi’oria omobisa; gose gento kende tikeri kerabaite.

English: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
Kiswahili: Basi, msifurahi kwa kuwa pepo wachafu wanawatii, bali furahini kwa kuwa majina yenu yameandikwa mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: Nonya nabo timogoka ase aya, ng’a ebirecha biabaigwereire, korende goka ekiagera amarieta aino arikirwe igoro.”

English: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Yesu akashangilia katika Roho Mtakatifu, akasema, “Nakuhimidi Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na nchi, kwa kuwa umewaficha mambo haya wenye hekima na wenye elimu, nawe ukawafunulia watoto wadogo. Naam, Baba, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo ilivyokupendeza.
Ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso agasasoka ase Omoika Omochenu, akabora, “Nakobakire aye Tata, Omonene o igoro na ense, ng’a kwabisire amang’ana aya ase abare nobong’aini ne chisemi, na koyamaanora ase abana abake. Ee, Tata, oko nakwo kwarenge ogwancha kwao okuya.

English: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”
Kiswahili: “Nimekabidhiwa vitu vyote na Baba yangu. Hakuna mtu amjuaye Mwana ni nani ila Baba, wala hakuna amjuaye Baba ni nani ila Mwana na yeyote ambaye Mwana anapenda kumfunulia.”
Ekegusii: Naeirwe ebinto bionsi na Tata one; monto onde tari omomanyete Omwana gose nere ng’o, otatiga Tata, gose Tata nere ng’o, otatiga Omwana, na onde bwensi Omwana anchire komoorokeria.”

English: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu akawageukia wanafunzi wake akanena nao faraghani, akawaambia, “Heri macho yanayoona yale mambo mnayoyaona.
Ekegusii: Akaonchokera aborokigwa baye, akabateebia bobisi, “Nasesenirie amaiso aya arorire ayamwarorire inwe!

English: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, manabii wengi na wafalme walitamani kuona yale mnayoyaona lakini hawakuyaona, na walitamani kusikia yale mnayoyasikia lakini hawakuyasikia.”
Ekegusii: Naki nabateebirie, ababani abange na abarwoti bakarigia korora ayamwarorire inwe, tibayarora, na koigwa aya mwaigure, tibayaigwa.”

English: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo mtaalamu mmoja wa sheria alisimama ili kumjaribu Yesu, akamuuliza, “Mwalimu, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?”
Ekegusii: Na rora, omworokia bw’amachiiko agatenena okomoteema, okobora, “Omworokia, inki ndakore nyore obogima bwa kare na kare?”

English: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Imeandikwaje katika Sheria? Kwani unasoma nini humo?”
Ekegusii: Ere akamobooria, “Ase amachiiko inki keriikire? Naki ogosoma?”

English: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “ ‘Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, kwa roho yako yote, kwa nguvu zako zote, na kwa akili zako zote’; tena, ‘Mpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe.’ ”
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Mwanche Omonene Nyasae oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi, na omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”

English: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Umejibu vyema. Fanya hivyo nawe utaishi.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Kwairaneirie buya. Kora iga, nario oramenye amatuko amange.”

English: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mtaalamu wa sheria, akitaka kujionyesha kuwa mwenye haki, akamuuliza Yesu, “Jirani yangu ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akarigia gwekora omonyene oboronge, akaboria Yeso, “Omogisangio one nere ng’o?”

English: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu akasema, “Mtu mmoja alikuwa akiteremka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Yeriko, naye akaangukia mikononi mwa wanyangʼanyi. Wakampiga, wakaondoka, wakamwacha akiwa karibu kufa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Narenge omonto ore gotirimboka korwa Yerusalemu kogenda Yeriko. Ere akaumera abauri, na barabwo bakamoumokera, bakamorusia chianga, bakamoaka chingoma, bakagenda, bakamotiga oisire gokwa.

English: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
Kiswahili: Kuhani mmoja alikuwa akipitia njia ile, alipomwona huyo mtu, akapita upande mwingine, akamwacha hapo barabarani.
Ekegusii: Ekaba agwo Omokuani oyomo akaoroka, ogoeta ase enchera eria, akamorora, agaeta ensemo.

English: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, Mlawi mmoja naye alipofika mahali pale, alimwona, akapita upande mwingine, akamwacha hapo barabarani
Ekegusii: Na Omolawi boigo agachia goika aase aria, akamorora; nere agaeta ensemo.

English: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
Kiswahili: Lakini Msamaria mmoja aliyekuwa akisafiri alipomwona, alimhurumia.
Ekegusii: Korende Omosamaria oyomo, kagoeta, agacha aase arenge; ere agachia komoorora, akamororera amaabera.

English: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
Kiswahili: Akaenda alipokuwa na akasafisha majeraha yake kwa divai na mafuta, kisha akayafunga. Ndipo akampandisha kwenye punda wake, akampeleka mpaka kwenye nyumba ya wageni na kumtunza.
Ekegusii: Nabo akamoika ang’e, akamoboa chingoma chiaye, akamoaka amaguta na edivai; akamoriinia ase etigere yaye igoro, akamoira ase enyomba y’abageni, akamorwaria.

English: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’
Kiswahili: Kesho yake, yule Msamaria akachukua dinari mbiliakampa yule mwenye nyumba ya wageni na kusema, ‘Mtunze, nami nirudipo nitakulipa gharama yoyote ya ziada uliyotumia kwa ajili yake.’
Ekegusii: Goika mambia yaye akarua chisiringi ibere, akaa omonyene enyomba, akamoteebia: Morende buya; na kende gionsi orarue kobua, kondairane naende, ningoakane.

English: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
Kiswahili: “Ni yupi basi miongoni mwa hawa watatu wewe unadhani ni jirani yake yule mtu aliyeangukia mikononi mwa wanyangʼanyi?”
Ekegusii: Naki rende orooche ase aba iga batato, norori orenge omoamate oye ere oyogwete ase amaboko y’abauri?”

English: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
Kiswahili: Yule mtaalamu wa sheria akajibu, “Ni yule aliyemhurumia.” Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Nenda, ukafanye vivyo hivyo.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Noria omoororerete amaabera.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda naye okore boigo.”

English: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
Kiswahili: Ikawa Yesu na wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakienda Yerusalemu, akaingia kwenye kijiji kimoja ambapo mwanamke mmoja aliyeitwa Martha alimkaribisha nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Ekero bare kogenda orogendo rwabo, agasoa ase agachie akamo, na omokungu oyomo, erieta riaye Martha, akamoarigania nyomba mwaye.

English: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.
Kiswahili: Martha alikuwa na mdogo wake aliyeitwa Maria, ambaye aliketi chini miguuni mwa Bwana akisikiliza yale aliyokuwa akisema.
Ekegusii: Ere narenge nomosubati omwabo ore korokwa Mariamu oyio oikaransete ase amagoro a Yeso, koigwa amang’ana aye.

English: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Martha alikuwa akihangaika na maandalizi yote yaliyokuwa yafanyike. Martha akaja kwa Yesu na kumuuliza, “Bwana, hujali kwamba ndugu yangu ameniachia kazi zote mwenyewe? Basi mwambie anisaidie.”
Ekegusii: Korende Martha nigo arenge gochandeka ase ogokora okonge, akamochiera, akabora, “Omonene, torochi aye buna oyominto antigire ngokora kera egento inche bweka? Moteebie ankonye.”

English: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Martha, Martha, mbona unasumbuka na kuhangaika na mengi?
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Martha, Martha, nigo okwerosia na gweichania ase engencho y’ebinto ebinge,

English: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kunahitajika kitu kimoja tu. Maria amechagua kile kilicho bora, wala hakuna mtu atakayemwondolea.”
Ekegusii: korende egento ekemo gioka keganeirie. Mariamu ochorire ensemo ere engiya, eye ataurwe nonde.”

English: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
Kiswahili: Siku moja, Yesu alikuwa mahali fulani akiomba. Alipomaliza kuomba, mmoja wa wanafunzi wake akamwambia, “Bwana, tufundishe kuomba, kama vile Yohana alivyowafundisha wanafunzi wake.”
Ekegusii: Ngosaba arenge aase gete. Gakoorire, oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye akamoteebia, “Omonene, twegerie ogosaba buna Yohana aegeretie aborokigwa baye.”

English: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Mnapoomba, semeni: “ ‘Baba yetu (uliye mbinguni), jina lako litukuzwe, ufalme wako uje. (Mapenzi yako yafanyike hapa duniani kama huko mbinguni.)
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, Komogosaba, teba iga: Tata, Erieta riao risikwe, Oborwoti bwao boche,

English: Give us day by day our daily bread.
Kiswahili: Utupatie kila siku riziki yetu.
Ekegusii: Otoe kera rituko endagera yaito.

English: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
Kiswahili: Utusamehe dhambi zetu, kwa kuwa na sisi huwasamehe wote wanaotukosea. Wala usitutie majaribuni (bali utuokoe kutoka kwa yule mwovu).’ ”
Ekegusii: Otwabere ebibe biaito, ekiagera intwe tokwabera kera oyomo otokorire bobe. Totoira ase ogoteemwa.

English: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia, “Ni nani miongoni mwenu mwenye rafiki yake, naye akamwendea usiku wa manane na kumwambia, ‘Rafiki, nikopeshe mikate mitatu.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ning’o ase more ore nomosani oramochiere botuko gati amoteebie: Mosani, ing’a singo emegati etato,

English: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu rafiki yangu amekuja kutoka safarini, nami sina kitu cha kumpa.’
Ekegusii: ekiagera omosani one ochire ase ’nde korwa orogendo, na inche tindi na gento nkomoa;

English: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
Kiswahili: “Kisha yule aliyeko ndani amjibu, ‘Usinisumbue. Mlango umefungwa, nami na watoto wangu tumelala. Siwezi kuamka nikupe chochote.’
Ekegusii: na oria ore ime namoiranerie, na goteeba: Tondosia, egesieri giasiekirwe, na inche amo nabana baane twararire borere, tinkonyara koimoka nkoe?

English: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
Kiswahili: Nawaambia, ingawa huyo mtu hataamka na kumpa hiyo mikate kwa sababu ni rafiki yake, lakini kwa sababu ya kuendelea kwake kuomba, ataamka na kumpa kiasi anachohitaji.
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie, nataimoka amoe ekiagera nomosani oye, korende ekiagera oria tari gotiga ogosaba, naimoke na komoa ebio bionsi arigetie.

English: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia: Ombeni nanyi mtapewa; tafuteni nanyi mtapata; bisheni nanyi mtafunguliwa mlango.
Ekegusii: Na inche nkobateebia nde inwe: Saba, namoegwe; rigia, namonyore; tura, namoigorerwe.

English: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kila aombaye hupewa; naye kila atafutaye hupata; na kila abishaye hufunguliwa mlango.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera kera oyogosaba, nigo akoegwa, na ere oyokorigia, nigo akonyora, na ere oyogotura, nigo akoigorerwa.

English: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
Kiswahili: “Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye mtoto wake akimwomba samaki, atampa nyoka badala yake?
Ekegusii: Naki monto onde nare ase more oyore ise, na omwana oye amosabe omogati, Inee, namoe rigena? Gose karamosabe enswe, ase ribaga ri’enswe namoe eng’iti?

English: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
Kiswahili: Au mtoto akimwomba yai atampa nge?
Ekegusii: Gose karamosabe rigena ri’engoko namoe riagaga?

English: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa ninyi mlio waovu, mnajua kuwapa watoto wenu vitu vizuri, si zaidi sana Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawapa Roho Mtakatifu wale wamwombao!”
Ekegusii: Onye inwe, abamore ababe, momanyete koa abana baino ebiegwa ebiya, Inee, Iso oino ore igoro takomenta mono kobaa bonsi, abakomosaba, Omoika Omochenu?”

English: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu alikuwa anamtoa pepo mchafu kutoka kwa mtu aliyekuwa bubu. Yule pepo mchafu alipomtoka yule mtu aliyekuwa bubu, akaanza kuongea, nao umati wa watu ukashangaa.
Ekegusii: Bono ngoseria arenge ekerecha ekio giakorete omonto oyomo koba rimama. Ekero ekerecha keria giasogete, omonto oria rimama agakwana; abanto bagakumia.

English: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wengine wakasema, “Anatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa Beelzebuli, yule mkuu wa pepo wachafu wote.”
Ekegusii: Abande babo bagateeba, “Nase Beelizebuli, omonene bw’ebirecha, akorusia ebirecha.”

English: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
Kiswahili: Wengine ili kumjaribu wakataka awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Abande ase okomoteema bakarigia aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro.

English: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.
Kiswahili: Yesu akajua mawazo yao, naye akawaambia, “Kila ufalme ukigawanyika dhidi yake wenyewe huangamia. Nayo nyumba iliyogawanyika dhidi yake yenyewe itaanguka.
Ekegusii: Ere konya omanyire ebirengererio biabo, akabateebia, “Kera oborwoti kobwatananekanire borobwo obonyene nigo b’ogosareka, na enyomba yaatananekire ero enyene nigo ekogwa.

English: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
Kiswahili: Kama Shetani amegawanyika mwenyewe, ufalme wake utasimamaje? Nawaambia haya kwa sababu ninyi mnadai ya kuwa mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa Beelzebuli.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Saitani karaatananeke ere omonyene, oborwoti bwaye naki boratenene? Naki inwe iga mogoteeba ng’a nigo ngoseria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli.

English: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
Kiswahili: Kama mimi natoa pepo wachafu kwa nguvu za Beelzebuli, wafuasi wenu nao je, wao hutoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa nani? Hivyo basi, wao ndio watakaowahukumu.
Ekegusii: Na inche onye ngoseria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli, Inee, abana baino nase ng’o bakobiseria? Ase engencho eyio, barabwo nababe abagaambi baino.

English: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa kidole cha Mungu, basi Ufalme wa Mungu umewajia.
Ekegusii: Korende kondaserie ebirecha ase ekiara kia Nyasae, nabo oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwabacheire.

English: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
Kiswahili: “Mtu mwenye nguvu aliyejifunga silaha anapoilinda nyumba yake, mali yake iko salama.
Ekegusii: Omonto bw’echinguru ore n’ebinto bi’esegi, gakorenda enyomba yaye, enibo yaye nigo ekoba ase omorembe,

English: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu mwenye nguvu zaidi kumliko akimshambulia na kumshinda, yeye humnyangʼanya silaha zake zote alizozitegemea, na kuchukua nyara.
Ekegusii: korende oyore ne chinguru kobua, ere karamochiere na komobua, nigo akomoura ebinto biaye bi’esegi bionsi ebiegenerete, na ebisakorwa biaye obiatanana.

English: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
Kiswahili: “Mtu asiyekuwa pamoja nami yu kinyume nami, na mtu ambaye hakusanyi pamoja nami, hutawanya.
Ekegusii: Omonto otari amo nainche nigo are mamincha ase ’nde, na ere oyotari gosangereria amo nainche nigo agoserebania.

English: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’
Kiswahili: “Pepo mchafu amtokapo mtu, hutangatanga katika sehemu zisizo na maji akitafuta mahali pa kupumzika, lakini hapati. Ndipo husema, ‘Nitarudi kwenye nyumba yangu nilikotoka.’
Ekegusii: “Ekero ekerecha ki’eubi kiarure ase omonto, nigo kegoeta gati aase atari namaache, gekorigia aase kegotimokera; getanyoreti kiabora: Ning’irane ase enyomba yane ase narwete.

English: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
Kiswahili: Naye arudipo na kuikuta ile nyumba imefagiliwa na kupangwa vizuri,
Ekegusii: Gakegocha, kiayenyora yaabusirwe, yaroisigwe.

English: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”
Kiswahili: ndipo huenda na kuchukua pepo wachafu wengine saba wabaya kuliko yeye mwenyewe, nao huingia na kukaa humo. Nayo hali ya mwisho ya yule mtu huwa ni mbaya kuliko ile ya kwanza.”
Ekegusii: Erio kiagenda, kiarentana ebirecha bitano na bibere binde ebire ebibe gokebua kerokio ekenyene. Birobio bigosoa na komenya aroro; okoba kw’omoerio kw’omonto oyio kwaba okobe kobua okwe ritang’ani.”

English: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”
Kiswahili: Ikawa Yesu alipokuwa akisema hayo, mwanamke mmoja katikati ya ule umati wa watu akapaza sauti akasema, “Limebarikiwa tumbo lililokuzaa na matiti uliyonyonya!”
Ekegusii: Ekero agokwana aya, omokungu oyomo ase omoganda agaaka eriogi, akamoteebia, “Nesesenirie enda yakobogoretie, ne chimbeere kwagongete!”

English: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Wamebarikiwa zaidi wale wanaolisikia neno la Mungu na kulitii.”
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabora, “Mbuya kobua, basesenirie abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na koribwata!”

English: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
Kiswahili: Umati wa watu ulipokuwa unazidi kuongezeka, Yesu akaendelea kusema, “Hiki ni kizazi kiovu. Kinatafuta ishara, lakini hakitapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ile ya Yona.
Ekegusii: Ekero emeganda yamentekanete, agachaaka gokwana, “Ekegori eke nekegori ekebe, gekorigia egekone buna ekemanyererio, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga eki’omobani Yona.

English: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile Yona alivyokuwa ishara kwa watu wa Ninawi, ndivyo Mwana wa Adamu atakavyokuwa ishara kwa kizazi hiki.
Ekegusii: Naki buna Yona abeete ekemanyererio ase abanto ba Ninawi, naboigo Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto arache koba ase ekegori eke.

English: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.
Kiswahili: Malkia wa Kusini atasimama wakati wa hukumu na kuwahukumu watu wa kizazi hiki. Kwa kuwa yeye alikuja kutoka miisho ya dunia ili kuisikiliza hekima ya Solomoni. Na hapa yupo aliye mkuu kuliko Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Enting’ana ya Irianyi netenene ase rituko ri’ekiina amo nabaanto b’ekegori eke; ere nabanachere ekiina, ekiagera nigo arwete ase chinsinyo chi’ense anyare koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani; na rora, oyobuete Sulemani naiga are.

English: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.
Kiswahili: Siku ya hukumu, watu wa Ninawi watasimama pamoja na kizazi hiki na kukihukumu; kwa maana wao walitubu waliposikia mahubiri ya Yona. Na tazama, hapa yupo yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Yona.
Ekegusii: Abanto ba Ninawi nabatenene ase rituko ri’ekiina amo nabaanto b’ekegori eke, na barabwo nabakenachere ekiina ekegori eke, ekiagera baonchogete ase okorandia kwa Yona; na rora, oyobuete Yona naiga are.

English: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mtu yeyote awashaye taa na kuiweka mahali palipofichika au kuifunikia chini ya bakuli. Badala yake huiweka juu ya kinara chake, ili watu wote wanaoingia waone nuru.
Ekegusii: “Omonto gatongirie etaaya tari koyebeeka ase ekenunchi gose ayemumeke negetonga, korende nigo akoyebeeka igoro ase ekebekerero, erinde abagosoa barore oborabu.

English: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
Kiswahili: Jicho lako ni taa ya mwili wako. Kama jicho lako ni zima, mwili wako wote pia umejaa nuru. Lakini kama jicho ni bovu, mwili wako wote pia umejaa giza.
Ekegusii: Etaaya y’omobere oo neriiso riao; ekero eriso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire noborabu; korende ekero eriiso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire nomosunte.

English: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hakikisha kwamba nuru iliyoko ndani yako isiwe giza.
Ekegusii: Gaki renda, oborabu obwo bore ime yao tibocha koba omosunte.

English: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa mwili wako wote umejaa nuru, bila sehemu yake yoyote kuwa gizani, basi utakuwa na nuru kama vile taa ikuangazavyo kwa nuru yake.”
Ekegusii: Nabo omobere oo bwonsi korabe noborabu, ensemo ende teba omosunte, omobere oo noichore noborabu kegima, buna etaya ase amasase aye egwoka oborabu.”

English: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomaliza kuzungumza, Farisayo mmoja alimwalika nyumbani mwake kwa chakula. Yesu akaingia na kuketi katika sehemu yake mezani.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, Omofarisai oyomo akamorangeria aragere amo nere. Agasoa, agaikaransa koragera.

English: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
Kiswahili: Yule Farisayo akashangaa kwamba Yesu hakunawa kwanza kabla ya kula.
Ekegusii: Omofarisai oria agachia korora, agakumia ekiagera ataisabete ritang’ani atararagera.

English: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, “Sasa, enyi Mafarisayo, mnasafisha kikombe na sahani kwa nje, lakini ndani mmejaa unyangʼanyi na uovu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Bono inwe Abafarisai iga mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime yaino nigo moichire obouri na obobe.

English: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
Kiswahili: Enyi wapumbavu! Hamjui kuwa yeye aliyetengeneza nje ndiye alitengeneza na ndani pia?
Ekegusii: Inwe abariri, ere oyokorete egia isiko, tari ere okorete nekia ime nakerokio?

English: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
Kiswahili: Basi toeni sadaka ya vile mlivyo navyo, na tazama, vitu vyote vitakuwa safi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Korende karue esadaka y’ebire ime; naende rora, ebinto bionsi nebichenu ase more.

English: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ole wenu, Mafarisayo, kwa maana mnampa Mungu zaka za mnanaa, mchicha na kila aina ya mboga, lakini mnapuuza haki na upendo wa Mungu. Iliwapasa kufanya haya ya pili bila kupuuza hayo ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino Abafarisai, ekiagera mokorua ensemo ya ikomi ye chiarare, na kera egesaku gie chinyeni, mogotiga oboronge na obwanchani bwa Nyasae. Naro aya nabagwenerete moyakore, motari gotiga ayande.

English: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu Mafarisayo, kwa sababu ninyi mnapenda kukalia viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, Abafarisai! Ekiagera mwanchete goikaransa ebirogo bia bosio ase chisinagogi, na gokwanigwa namasikani ase chichiiro.

English: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu, kwa sababu ninyi ni kama makaburi yasiyokuwa na alama, ambayo watu huyakanyaga pasipo kujua.”
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mogwekaine chimbeera chitari kororekana, na abanto baeta igoro yaye batamanyeti.”

English: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
Kiswahili: Mtaalamu mmoja wa sheria akamjibu, akasema, “Mwalimu, unaposema mambo haya, unatutukana na sisi pia.”
Ekegusii: Omworokia oyomo bw’amachiiko akairaneria, akamoteebia, “Omworokia, kogoteeba aya, nigo ogotochaaya naintwe.”

English: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Nanyi wataalamu wa sheria, ole wenu, kwa sababu mnawatwika watu mizigo mizito ambayo hawawezi kubeba, wala ninyi wenyewe hamwinui hata kidole kimoja kuwasaidia.
Ekegusii: Agateeba, “Nainwe aborokia b’amachiiko, obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mogotweka abanto chigurube chindito, na inwe abanyene timori gokuna chigurube echio nonya nase ekemo ki’ebiara biaino.

English: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu, kwa sababu ninyi mnajenga makaburi ya manabii waliouawa na baba zenu.
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mokoagacha chimbeera chi’ababani, abwo chisokoro chiaino chiaitete.

English: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ninyi mwashuhudia na mnathibitisha kile baba zenu walichofanya. Wao waliwaua manabii, nanyi mnawajengea makaburi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo inwe mwabeire abarori na gwanchera ogokora gwe chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera nabwo baabaitete, na inwe mokoagacha chimbeera chiabo.

English: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya jambo hili, Mungu katika hekima yake alisema, ‘Tazama, nitatuma kwao manabii na mitume, nao watawaua baadhi yao na wengine watawatesa.’
Ekegusii: Nase ayio obong’aini bwa Nyasae nigo bwateebete: Nintome ase bare ababani na abatomwa; baite abande babo na kobachanda,

English: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kizazi hiki kitawajibika kwa ajili ya damu ya manabii iliyomwagwa tangu kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu,
Ekegusii: erinde amanyinga y’ababani bonsi, ayaitegete korwa omochakano bw’ense naganigwe korwa ase ekegori eke,

English: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
Kiswahili: tangu damu ya Abeli mpaka damu ya Zekaria, aliyeuawa kati ya madhabahu na mahali patakatifu. Naam, nawaambia, kizazi hiki kitawajibika kwa haya yote.
Ekegusii: korwa amanyinga y’Abeli goika amanyinga a Zakaria; oria oiteretwe gati y’egesasiimero ne Hekalu. Ee, nabateebirie, narigigwe korwa ase ekegori eke.

English: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
Kiswahili: “Ole wenu ninyi wataalamu wa sheria, kwa sababu mmeuondoa ufunguo wa maarifa. Ninyi wenyewe hamkuingia, na wale waliokuwa wanaingia mkawazuia.”
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe aborokia b’amachiiko! Ekiagera mwarusirie ekeigorero gie chisemi; inwe abanyene timwasoa, na baria abaare gosoa mwabatangire.”

English: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoondoka huko, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wakaanza kumpinga vikali na kumsonga kwa maswali,
Ekegusii: Agachia gosoka korwa aroro, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bagachaaka komomiga namaborio amakong’u, na komochegia akwane igoro y’ebinto ebinge;

English: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
Kiswahili: wakivizia kumkamata kwa kitu atakachosema ili wamshtaki.
Ekegusii: bakomotega, banyore ring’ana korwa ase omonwa oye, erinde banyare komosoera.

English: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, umati mkubwa wa watu maelfu, walipokuwa wamekusanyika hata wakawa wanakanyagana, Yesu akaanza kuzungumza kwanza na wanafunzi wake, akawaambia: “Jihadharini na chachu ya Mafarisayo, yaani, unafiki wao.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio omosangererekano bw’abaanto chilifu chinyinge bagachia gosangerereka goika bagatachana. Yeso agachaaka goteebia aborokigwa baye ritang’ani, Mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai, engencho yaye nobong’ainereria.

English: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.
Kiswahili: Hakuna jambo lolote lililositirika ambalo halitafunuliwa, au lililofichwa ambalo halitajulikana.
Ekegusii: Korende ing’ana rinde tiriri rimumekeirie, ritache koorokigwa, gose eribisekanete ritache komanyekana.

English: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, lolote mlilosema gizani litasikiwa nuruni. Na kile mlichonongʼona masikioni mkiwa kwenye vyumba vya ndani, kitatangazwa juu ya paa.
Ekegusii: Nabo onsi aya mogokwana ase omosunte, naigugwe ase omobaso; naro aya mokomonyererana ase ebinyomba ime nararigwe igoro ase ebirama.

English: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
Kiswahili: “Nawaambieni rafiki zangu, msiwaogope wale wauao mwili, lakini baada ya hilo hawawezi kufanya lolote zaidi.
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie inwe abasani baane, timoiroka abwo bagoita omobere, na magega ase ayio tibari negento baranyare gokora kobua.

English: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.
Kiswahili: Lakini nitawaambia nani wa kumwogopa: Mwogopeni yule ambaye baada ya kuua mwili, ana mamlaka ya kuwatupa motoni. Naam, nawaambia, mwogopeni huyo!
Ekegusii: Korende nimbakuurere oyo morairoke: Moiroke oria ore nokobua, magega ase ogoita omonto omoruta ase omorero o kare na kare. Ee, nabateebirie, moiroke oria!

English: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
Kiswahili: Mnajua kwamba shomoro watano huuzwa kwa senti mbili? Lakini Mungu hamsahau hata mmoja wao.
Ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro isano tichiri koonigwa ase chitaabu ibere? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tikari kwebwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
Kiswahili: Naam, hata nywele za vichwa vyenu zote zimehesabiwa. Hivyo msiogope, kwa maana ninyi ni wa thamani kubwa kuliko shomoro wengi.
Ekegusii: Nonya nechitukia chi’emetwe yaino chiabarirwe chionsi. Timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.

English: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;
Kiswahili: “Ninawaambia kwamba yeyote atakayenikiri mbele ya watu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamkiri mbele za malaika wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobateebia, kera oyomo oranyatore ase Mwanyabaanto, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere namwatore ase abamalaika ba Nyasae;

English: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye atakayenikana mimi mbele ya watu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamkana mbele ya malaika wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: korende oyorankaane ase Mwanyabaanto, nere nakaanwe ase abamalaika ba Nyasae.

English: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Naye kila atakayenena neno baya dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu atasamehewa, lakini yeyote atakayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Na kera oyomo orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto, naaberwe; korende ere oyorarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa.

English: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;
Kiswahili: “Watakapowapeleka katika masinagogi, na mbele ya watawala na wenye mamlaka, msiwe na wasiwasi kuhusu namna mtakavyojitetea au mtakavyosema.
Ekegusii: Naende kobakobaira ase chisinagogi, na ase abagaambi, na ase abare nokobua, timochandeka buna morachie koiraneria gose buna morakwane,

English: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Roho Mtakatifu atawafundisha wakati huo huo mnachopaswa kusema.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera Omoika Omochenu noborokererie ensa eyio eyio ayamogwenerete gokwana.

English: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja katika umati wa watu akamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, mwambie ndugu yangu tugawane naye urithi wetu.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase omoganda akamoteebia, “Omworokia, teebia momura ominto anyatanere omwando oito.”

English: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Rafiki, ni nani aliyeniweka mimi kuwa hakimu wenu au msuluhishi juu yenu?”
Ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Omonto oyo, ning’o ombekire koba omogambi gose omwatanani igoro ase more?”

English: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Jihadharini! Jilindeni na aina zote za choyo. Kwa maana maisha ya mtu hayatokani na wingi wa mali alizo nazo.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rigereria, erende korwa ase okogania okobe, ekiagera obogima bw’omonto tibori ase obonge bw’enibo yaye abwate.”

English: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia mfano huu: “Shamba la mtu mmoja tajiri lilizaa sana.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio, akabora, “Omogondo bw’omonto omonda okama mono.

English: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’
Kiswahili: Akawaza moyoni mwake, ‘Nifanye nini? Sina mahali pa kuhifadhi mavuno yangu.’
Ekegusii: Agachaaka korengereria ase omoyo oye ime: Inki ngokora, ekiagera tindi nase nkobeeka okwama kwane?

English: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo huyo tajiri akasema, ‘Nitafanya hivi: Nitabomoa ghala zangu za nafaka na kujenga nyingine kubwa zaidi na huko nitayahifadhi mavuno yangu yote na vitu vyangu.
Ekegusii: Akabora: Ninkore iga: Nintagore ebiage biane, mbiagache ebinene kobua, na aroro ningache endagera yane yonsi, na ebinto biane.

English: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’
Kiswahili: Nami nitaiambia nafsi yangu, “Nafsi, unavyo vitu vingi vizuri ulivyojiwekea akiba kwa miaka mingi. Pumzika; kula, unywe, ufurahi.” ’
Ekegusii: Erio ninteebie omoyo one: Aye omoyo, nore nenibo enyinge kwegacheire emonga y’emiaka emenge; timoka, orie, onywe, ogoke.

English: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’
Kiswahili: “Lakini Mungu akamwambia, ‘Mpumbavu wewe! Usiku huu uhai wako unatakiwa. Sasa hivyo vitu ulivyojiwekea akiba vitakuwa vya nani?’
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamoteebia: Omoriri oyo, obotuko obo omoyo oo oraganigwa, na enibo kwegacheire ang’e, neya ng’o erabe?

English: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”
Kiswahili: “Hivyo ndivyo ilivyo kwa wale wanaojiwekea mali lakini hawajitajirishi kwa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo are ere oyokwegachera emonga omonyene, na ere tari omonda ase Nyasae.”

English: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia, msisumbukie maisha yenu kwamba mtakula nini; au msumbukie miili yenu kwamba mtavaa nini.
Ekegusii: Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Ase aya nabateebirie, timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie; gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeeke.

English: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
Kiswahili: Maisha ni zaidi ya chakula, na mwili ni zaidi ya mavazi.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera obogima nobonene kobua endagera, na omobere nomonene kobua chianga.

English: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!
Kiswahili: Fikirini ndege! Wao hawapandi wala hawavuni, hawana ghala wala popote pa kuhifadhi nafaka; lakini Mungu huwalisha. Ninyi ni wa thamani zaidi kuliko ndege!
Ekegusii: Rigereria ebigonkoru, tibiri gosimeka, tibiri kogesa, tibiri nemonga gose ekiage, korende Nyasae nigo akobirageria. Na inwe imobuete rigori rie chinyoni!

English: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
Kiswahili: Ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye kwa kujitaabisha kwake anaweza kujiongezea hata saa moja zaidi katika maisha yake?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ore ase more oranyare gwechanda komenta ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo ase obotambe bwaye?

English: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?
Kiswahili: Kama hamwezi kufanya jambo dogo kama hilo, kwa nini basi kuyasumbukia hayo mengine?
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye timori konyara gokora nonya ne ring’ana erire riike buna eri, nase ki mogwechandera amang’ana ande?

English: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
Kiswahili: “Angalieni maua jinsi yameavyo: Hayafanyi kazi wala hayafumi. Lakini nawaambia, hata Solomoni katika fahari yake yote hakuvikwa vizuri kama mojawapo ya hayo maua.
Ekegusii: Rigereria ebisicha buna bigokina; tibiri gokora emeremo gose gwesisa, korende nabateebirie, nonya n’Sulemani ase obonene bwaye bwonsi tabegete chianga buna ekemo ki’ebi.

English: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa Mungu huyavika hivi majani ya shambani, ambayo leo yapo, na kesho yanatupwa motoni, si atawavika ninyi vizuri zaidi, enyi wa imani haba!
Ekegusii: Onye Nyasae okoboyia obonyansi bw’egetii oboreo reero, na ankio botugutwe ase omorero, Inee, takomenta kobaboyia inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke?

English: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
Kiswahili: Wala msisumbuke mioyoni mwenu mtakula nini au mtakunywa nini. Msiwe na wasiwasi juu ya haya.
Ekegusii: Inwe, timorigia eki morarie, gose eki moranywe; gose timoba nomoyo bw’ogwechanda.

English: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.
Kiswahili: Watu wa mataifa ya duniani husumbuka sana kuhusu vitu hivi vyote, lakini Baba yenu anafahamu kuwa mnahitaji haya yote.
Ekegusii: Naki abanto b’ebisaku bi’ense nigo bakorigia ebinto ebio bionsi, korende Iso oino omanyire ng’a moganetie ebio bionsi,

English: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.
Kiswahili: Bali utafuteni Ufalme wa Mungu, na haya yote atawapa pia.
Ekegusii: Korende rigia oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na ebinto ebio namomenterwe inwe.

English: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
Kiswahili: “Msiogope enyi kundi dogo, kwa maana Baba yenu ameona vyema kuwapa ninyi Ufalme.
Ekegusii: “Timoiroka inwe abamore omoganda omoke, ekiagera Iso oino ororire buya kobaa oborwoti.

English: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
Kiswahili: Uzeni mali zenu mkawape maskini. Jifanyieni mifuko isiyochakaa, mkajiwekee hazina mbinguni isiyokwisha, mahali ambapo mwizi hakaribii wala nondo haharibu.
Ekegusii: Oonia ebio more nabio, morue ebiegwa; mwekorere ebimoya bitari kogota amo nenibo etari gokea igoro, aase omoibi atagoika, gose ebigwankwa gosaria.

English: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu mahali hazina yako ilipo, hapo ndipo moyo wako utakapokuwa pia.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera aase chinibo chiaino chire nao chinkoro chiaino chikoba.

English: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.
Kiswahili: “Kuweni tayari mkiwa mmevikwa kwa ajili ya huduma na taa zenu zikiwa zinawaka,
Ekegusii: “Tiga ebinema biaino biboyigwe, ne chitaaya chiaino chioke;

English: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.
Kiswahili: kama watumishi wanaomngojea bwana wao arudi kutoka kwenye karamu ya arusi, ili ajapo na kubisha mlango waweze kumfungulia mara.
Ekegusii: na inwe mobe buna abanto baganyete omonene obo, gakoirana korwa ase omoyega bw’enyangi, erinde kagocha na gotura, erio kegima bamoigorere.

English: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.
Kiswahili: Heri wale watumishi ambao bwana wao atakapokuja atawakuta wakiwa wanakesha. Amin, nawaambia, atajifunga mkanda wake na kuwaketisha ili wale, naye atakuja na kuwahudumia.
Ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abasomba baria ekero omonene obo agocha abanyore barendete. Ekeene nabateebirie: Neboyie, abaikaransie ase endagera, ache abakorere.

English: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.
Kiswahili: Itakuwa heri kwa watumwa hao ikiwa bwana wao atakapokuja atawakuta wamekesha hata kama atakuja mnamo usiku wa manane, au karibu na mapambazuko.
Ekegusii: Naende karache ase oborendi bwa kabere gose oborendi bwa gatato, abanyore barendete, mbare nomogooko abasomba baria.

English: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.
Kiswahili: Lakini fahamuni jambo hili: Kama mwenye nyumba angalijua saa mwizi atakuja, asingaliiacha nyumba yake kuvunjwa.
Ekegusii: Korende manya aya, onye omonyene enyomba namanyete ensa omoibi agocha, anga narendete, taiberwa.

English: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”
Kiswahili: Ninyi nanyi hamna budi kuwa tayari, kwa sababu Mwana wa Adamu atakuja saa msiyotazamia.”
Ekegusii: Nainwe nabo, mobe ang’e, ekiagera ensa motakagereti, nero Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto arache.”

English: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamuuliza, “Bwana, mfano huu unatuambia sisi peke yetu au watu wote?”
Ekegusii: Petero akamobooria, “Omonene, nintwe ogoteebia omoreng’anio oyo, gose nase abanto bonsi?”

English: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Ni yupi basi wakili mwaminifu na mwenye busara, ambaye bwana wake atamfanya msimamizi juu ya watumishi wake wote, ili awape watumishi wengine chakula chao wakati unaofaa?
Ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, omonene oye arabeeke igoro ase enyomba yaye yonsi, ae abanto endagera ekerengo kiabo ase ekero kegwenerete?

English: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.
Kiswahili: Heri mtumishi yule ambaye bwana wake atakaporudi atamkuta akifanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omosomba oria ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.

English: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
Kiswahili: Amin nawaambia, atamweka mtumishi huyo kuwa msimamizi wa mali yake yote.
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie, namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.

English: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,
Kiswahili: Lakini kama yule mtumishi atasema moyoni mwake, ‘Bwana wangu anakawia kurudi,’ kisha akaanza kuwapiga wale watumishi wa kiume na wa kike, na kula na kunywa na kulewa.
Ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria karateebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire gocha, naende achake goaka abasomba bande, abasacha na abakungu, na koria, na konywa, na gotinda,

English: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.
Kiswahili: Basi bwana wa mtumishi huyo atakuja siku asiyodhani na saa asiyoijua. Atamkata vipande vipande na kumweka katika sehemu moja pamoja na wale wasioamini.
Ekegusii: omonene bw’omosomba oria nachiche rituko atakagereti, na ensa atamanyeti, nigo aramonachane abe ebing’ese, namoe ensemo yaye amo nabategeneti.

English: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
Kiswahili: “Yule mtumishi anayefahamu vyema mapenzi ya bwana wake na asijiandae wala kufanya kama apendavyo bwana wake, atapigwa kwa mapigo mengi.
Ekegusii: Naende omosomba oria omanyete ogwancha kw’omonene oye, na tebeka ang’e, gose gokora ogwancha kwaye, naakwe ebiranya ebiroro,

English: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeyote ambaye hakujua naye akafanya yale yastahiliyo kupigwa, atapigwa kidogo. Yeyote aliyepewa vitu vingi, atadaiwa vingi; na yeyote aliyekabidhiwa vingi, kwake vitatakiwa vingi.
Ekegusii: korende oria otamanyeti, ko ere okorire ayagwenerete ogoakwa, naakwe ebiranya ebiororo. Kera oyoeirwe ebinge, korwa asare ere nabiganigwe ebinge; na ere oyoeirwe ebinge kobua, korwa asare nabiganigwe ebinge kobua.

English: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
Kiswahili: “Nimekuja kuleta moto duniani; laiti kama ungekuwa tayari umewashwa!
Ekegusii: “Nigo nachire gotongia omorero ase ense; onye ngwoka ore, anga ninki ndigetie naende?

English: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
Kiswahili: Lakini ninao ubatizo ambao lazima nibatizwe, nayo dhiki yangu ni kuu mpaka ubatizo huo ukamilike!
Ekegusii: Ninde nebatiso nkobatiswa, naende ninchandeke mono goika eikeranigwe!

English: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
Kiswahili: Mnadhani nimekuja kuleta amani duniani? La, nawaambia sivyo, nimekuja kuleta mafarakano.
Ekegusii: Inee! Mokagete ng’a nigo nachire ng’ee ense omorembe? Nabatebirie, taibo, korende nogwatanana.

English: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia sasa, kutakuwa na watu watano katika nyumba moja, watatu dhidi ya wawili, na wawili dhidi ya watatu.
Ekegusii: Naki korwa bono ase enyomba nababe abanto batano baatananeke, batato ase babere, naende babere ase batato.

English: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
Kiswahili: Watafarakana baba dhidi ya mwanawe na mwana dhidi ya babaye, mama dhidi ya bintiye na binti dhidi ya mamaye, naye mama mkwe dhidi ya mkwewe na mkwe dhidi ya mama mkwe wake.”
Ekegusii: Mbaatananeke, ise na omwana omomura, na omwana omomura na ise, ng’ina na omwana omoiseke, na omwana omoiseke na ng’ina; ng’ina biara, na moka momura oye, moka momura oye na ng’ina biara.”

English: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
Kiswahili: Pia Yesu akauambia ule umati wa watu, “Mwonapo wingu likitokea magharibi, mara mwasema, ‘Mvua itanyesha,’ nayo hunyesha.
Ekegusii: Naende agateebia emeganda, “Ekero mokorora riire rikoimoka bosongo, erio mwateeba bwango: Embura netwe; yaba bo.

English: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mwonapo upepo wa kusini ukivuma, ninyi husema, ‘Kutakuwa na joto,’ na huwa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Naende ekero mokorora embeo ekorwa Irianyi mwabora. Nebe eguru‐gura; yaba bo.

English: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?
Kiswahili: Enyi wanafiki! Mnajua jinsi ya kutambua kuonekana kwa dunia na anga. Inakuwaje basi kwamba mnashindwa kutambua wakati huu wa sasa?
Ekegusii: Inwe abang’ainereria! Imomanyete ense na igoro, buna bikororekana, korende naki rende, motamanyeti ekero eke?

English: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini hamwamui wenyewe lililo haki?
Ekegusii: “Naende naki ase emioyo yaino motari gwatanana ayare boronge?

English: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
Kiswahili: Uwapo njiani na mshtaki wako kwenda kwa hakimu, jitahidi kupatana naye mkiwa njiani. La sivyo, atakupeleka kwa hakimu, naye hakimu atakukabidhi kwa afisa, naye afisa atakutupa gerezani.
Ekegusii: Nabo ekero okogenda nomogosoeri oo ase omogambi, kora omokia kobwatana nere komore ’nchera, tachicha kogokurura ase omogambi, na omogambi oria akobeke ase amaboko ’omorendi bw’echela, na omorendi oria akorute echela.

English: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”
Kiswahili: Nakuambia, hautatoka humo hadi uwe umelipa senti ya mwisho.”
Ekegusii: Nagotebirie, tokorwa agwo nonya ng’ake goika oakane kegima ebesa y’omoerio.”

English: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, kulikuwa na watu waliomwambia Yesu habari za Wagalilaya ambao Pilato aliwaua, na damu ya hao watu akaichanganya na dhabihu yao waliyokuwa wanatoa.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio mbachete aroro abanto bamotebetie amang’ana igoro y’Abagalili, baria Pilato asang’ananetie amanyinga abo nebing’wanso biabo.

English: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Mnadhani kwamba hawa Wagalilaya ambao walikufa kifo cha namna hiyo walikuwa na dhambi kuwazidi Wagalilaya wengine wote?
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Mokagete ng’a Abagalili abwo nigo barenge abanyene ebibe kobua Abagalili bande bonsi, ekiagera banyorete emechando buna eyio?

English: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
Kiswahili: La hasha! Ninyi nanyi msipotubu, mtaangamia vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi namosire boigo.

English: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?
Kiswahili: Au wale watu kumi na wanane waliokufa walipoangukiwa na mnara huko Siloamu: mnadhani wao walikuwa waovu kuliko watu wote waliokuwa wanaishi Yerusalemu?
Ekegusii: Gose baria ikomi na batano na batato bagweretwe norwaki orotambe ase Siloamu, rokabaita, mokagete ng’a nigo barenge abasaria kobua abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu?

English: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
Kiswahili: Nawaambia, la hasha! Ninyi nanyi msipotubu, wote mtaangamia vivyo hivyo.”
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi, namosire boigo.”

English: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia mfano huu: “Mtu mmoja alikuwa na mtini uliopandwa katika shamba lake la mizabibu, akaja ili kutafuta tini kwenye mti huo, lakini hakupata hata moja.
Ekegusii: Agakwana omoreng’anio oyo, “Omonto oyomo narenge nomoko osimekire ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu; akagenda korigia amatunda ase omoko oria, korende tanyora gento.

English: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’
Kiswahili: Hivyo akamwambia mtunza shamba: ‘Tazama, kwa muda wa miaka mitatu sasa nimekuwa nikija kutafuta matunda kwenye mtini huu, nami sikupata hata moja. Ukate! Kwa nini uendelee kuharibu ardhi?’
Ekegusii: Agateebia omooroiseria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu: Rora, emiaka eye etato nachire korigia amatunda ase omoko oyo, na tindanyora gento. Yonache! Nase ki ogosaria riroba?

English: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
Kiswahili: “Yule mtunza shamba akamjibu, ‘Bwana, uache tena kwa mwaka mmoja zaidi, nami nitaupalilia na kuuwekea mbolea.
Ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Omonene, yotige omwaka oyo naende, goika nyoburugere na koyobekera obwoyo.

English: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
Kiswahili: Kama ukizaa matunda mwaka ujao, vyema, la sivyo uukate.’ ”
Ekegusii: Noro korame amatunda, mbuya; onye taibo, erio oyonache.”

English: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
Kiswahili: Basi Yesu alikuwa akifundisha katika sinagogi mojawapo siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Akaba okworokereria ase esinagogi eyemo ase rituko ri’Esabato.

English: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.
