Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo akaja mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa na pepo mchafu, naye alikuwa amepinda mgongo kwa muda wa miaka kumi na minane, wala alikuwa hawezi kunyooka wima.
Ekegusii: Naende rora, narengeo omokungu obwatire nekerecha ki’oboreu ase emiaka ikomi na etano na etato, na ere konya okogotaire, taare konyara kwerambora nonya ng’ake.

English: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomwona, akamwita, akamwambia, “Mwanamke, uwe huru, umepona ugonjwa wako.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia komoorora, akamorangeria, akamoteebia, “Aye omokungu, gwasiboirwe korwa ase oboreu bwao.”

English: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomwekea mikono yake, mara akasimama wima akaanza kumtukuza Mungu.
Ekegusii: Akabeka amaboko aye igoro asare, na ere akaramboka erio kegima, akamotogia Nyasae.

English: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”
Kiswahili: Lakini kiongozi wa sinagogi akakasirika kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa ameponya mtu siku ya Sabato. Akaambia ule umati wa watu, “Kuna siku sita ambazo watu wanapaswa kufanya kazi. Katika siku hizo, njooni mponywe, lakini si katika siku ya Sabato.”
Ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani bw’esinagogi eria akabea, ekiagera Yeso agwenia omonto ase rituko ri’Esabato, agateebia abanto, “Nare amatuko atano na rimo agwenerete Mwanyabaanto bakore emeremo; ase ayio, inchwo ase amatuko ayio mogwenigwe, korende tari ase rituko ri’Esabato.”

English: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Enyi wanafiki! Je, kila mmoja wenu hamfungulii ngʼombe wake au punda wake kutoka zizini akampeleka kumnywesha maji siku ya Sabato?
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoiraneria, “Inwe abang’ainereria, Inee, kera oyomo oino tari gosibora eng’ombe yaye gose etigere yaye korwa bweri ase rituko ri’Esabato, ogenda nero koyenyoisia?

English: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
Kiswahili: Je, huyu mwanamke, ambaye ni binti wa Abrahamu, aliyeteswa na Shetani akiwa amemfunga kwa miaka yote hii kumi na minane, hakustahili kufunguliwa kutoka kifungo hicho siku ya Sabato?”
Ekegusii: Oyo nenyaroka ya Aburaamu; ekiagera Saitani omosibire emiaka eye ikomi na etano na etato, temogwenereti asiborwe korwa ase egesibo eke ase rituko ri’Esabato?”

English: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
Kiswahili: Aliposema haya, wapinzani wake wakaaibika, lakini watu wakafurahi kwa ajili ya mambo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya.
Ekegusii: Naende ekero are gokwana aya, abanto bonsi abare koamererania nere bagasookigwa. Abanto bonsi bakagoka ase engencho y’amang’ana onsi amanene akorire.

English: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akauliza, “Ufalme wa Mungu unafanana na nini? Nitaufananisha na nini?
Ekegusii: Naende akabora, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo boreng’anirie naki? Ninki nkoboreng’ania?

English: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”
Kiswahili: Umefanana na punje ya haradali ambayo mtu aliichukua na kuipanda katika shamba lake. Nayo ikakua, ikawa mti nao ndege wa angani wakatengeneza viota vyao kwenye matawi yake.”
Ekegusii: Mboreng’anie nentetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye; egakina, ekaba omote. Chinyoni chia igoro chikaroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”

English: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?
Kiswahili: Yesu akauliza tena, “Nitaufananisha Ufalme wa Mungu na nini?
Ekegusii: Agakwana eria kabere, “Ninki nkoreng’ania oborwoti bwa Nyasae?

English: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
Kiswahili: Unafanana na chachu ambayo mwanamke aliichukua akaichanganya katika kiasi kikubwa cha unga mpaka wote ukaumuka.”
Ekegusii: Igo boreng’anirie nememera omokungu abogoretie, akayebeka ase ebirengo bitato bi’obosie, goika bionsi bikabota.”

English: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Yesu akapita katika miji na vijiji, akifundisha wakati alisafiri kwenda Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge kogenda Yerusalemu, agaeta ase emechie na ebichie okworokereria.

English: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja akamuuliza, “Bwana, ni watu wachache tu watakaookolewa?”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo akamobooria, “Omonene, barabwo abaratoorigwe nabake?” Akabateebia,

English: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Jitahidini sana kuingia kupitia mlango mwembamba, kwa maana nawaambia wengi watajaribu kuingia, lakini hawataweza.
Ekegusii: “Teema mono gosoa ase egesieri kere ekegote, ekiagera nabateebirie: Abanto abange nabarigie gosoa, na barabwo tibakonyara.

English: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
Kiswahili: Wakati mwenye nyumba atakapoondoka na kufunga mlango, mtasimama nje mkibisha mlango na kusema, ‘Bwana! Tufungulie mlango!’ “Lakini yeye atawajibu, ‘Siwajui ninyi, wala mtokako.’
Ekegusii: Ekero omonyene enyomba araimoke na gosieka egesieri, inwe namochake gotenena isiko na gotura gesieri, mokobora, Omonene, toigorere, na ere nabairanerie: Timbamanyeti aase mokorwa.

English: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
Kiswahili: “Ndipo mtamjibu, ‘Tulikula na kunywa pamoja nawe, tena ulifundisha katika mitaa yetu.’
Ekegusii: Erio namochake goteeba: Nigo tware koria na konywa ase obosio bwao, naye nkworokereria kwarenge ase chinchera chiaito.

English: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
Kiswahili: “Lakini yeye atawajibu, ‘Siwajui ninyi, wala mtokako. Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi watenda maovu!’
Ekegusii: Korende ere natebe: Nabatebirie, timbamanyeti aase mokorwa; karue ase ’nde, inwe mwensi abakori amabe.

English: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo kutakuwako kilio na kusaga meno, mtakapowaona Abrahamu, Isaki, Yakobo na manabii wote wakiwa katika Ufalme wa Mungu, lakini ninyi mkiwa mmetupwa nje.
Ekegusii: Erio namobe nokorera na okoriania amaino, ekero morarore Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, na ababani bonsi ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na inwe abanyene namotugutwe isiko.

English: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
Kiswahili: Watu watatoka mashariki na magharibi, kaskazini na kusini, nao wataketi kwenye sehemu walizoandaliwa karamuni katika Ufalme wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naende mbache abanto korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na Irianyi, na barabwo mbaikaranse ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

English: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
Kiswahili: Tazama, kunao walio wa mwisho watakaokuwa wa kwanza, nao wa kwanza watakaokuwa wa mwisho.”
Ekegusii: Na rora, mbare ab’omoerio barache koba ab’eritang’ani, naende mbare ab’eritang’ani barache koba ab’omoerio.”

English: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakamwendea Yesu na kumwambia, “Ondoka hapa uende mahali pengine kwa maana Herode anataka kukuua.”
Ekegusii: Ekero keria abande b’Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aa, ogende, ekiagera Herode narigetie kogoita.”

English: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nendeni mkamwambie yule mbweha, ‘Ninafukuza pepo wachafu na kuponya wagonjwa leo na kesho, nami siku ya tatu nitaikamilisha kazi yangu.’
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Genda moteebie ekebwe ekio: Rora ngoseria nde ebirecha, ngokora nde emeremo y’okogwenia abanto reero na ankio, ne rituko ria gatato ninkoore emeremo yane.

English: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’
Kiswahili: Sina budi kuendelea na safari yangu leo, kesho na kesho kutwa: kwa maana haiwezekani nabii kufa mahali pengine isipokuwa Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Korende ningwenerete kobwatia enchera yane reero, na ankio, na ankio ende, naki temogwenereti omobani asirere isiko ya Yerusalemu.

English: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
Kiswahili: “Ee Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, uwauaye manabii na kuwapiga mawe wale waliotumwa kwako! Mara ngapi nimetamani kuwakusanya watoto wako pamoja, kama vile kuku akusanyavyo vifaranga wake chini ya mabawa yake, lakini hukutaka!
Ekegusii: “Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe ase ore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao buna engoko egosangereria ebichuchu biaye aase chimbaaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!

English: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
Kiswahili: Tazama nyumba yenu imeachwa ukiwa. Ninawaambia, hamtaniona tena mpaka wakati ule mtakaposema, ‘Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa jina la Bwana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Rora, enyomba yaino mwatigeirwe ere ritombe; na inche nabateebirie ng’a timokondora nonya ng’ake, goika ekero keria morache goteeba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri ’Omonene.”

English: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku moja Yesu alipokuwa amekwenda kula chakula kwa mmoja wa viongozi wa Mafarisayo siku ya Sabato, watu walikuwa wakimchunguza kwa bidii.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo ri’Esabato, ekero asoete ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo, omonene bw’Abafarisai, arie endagera, nigo barenge bamorigereretie.

English: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
Kiswahili: Papo hapo mbele yake palikuwa na mtu mmoja mwenye ugonjwa wa kuvimba mwili.
Ekegusii: Na rora, ase obosio bwaye narengeo omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okobimbia omobere.

English: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawauliza wale Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria, “Je, ni halali kuponya watu siku ya Sabato au la?”
Ekegusii: Yeso agateebia abanto b’amachiiko na Abafarisai, akababoria, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri’Esabato, gose taibo?”

English: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
Kiswahili: Wakakaa kimya. Hivyo Yesu akamshika yule mgonjwa mkono na kumponya, akamruhusu aende zake.
Ekegusii: Bagakira. Akamobwata, akamogwenia, akamoa ribaga agende.

English: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
Kiswahili: Kisha akawauliza, “Kama mmoja wenu angekuwa na mtoto au ngʼombe wake aliyetumbukia katika kisima siku ya Sabato, je, hamtamvuta mara moja na kumtoa?”
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ning’o ase more ore netigere gose eng’ombe yagure ase engoro, otari koyerusia erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato?”

English: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
Kiswahili: Nao hawakuwa na la kusema.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibanyara komoiraneria ase amang’ana aria.

English: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
Kiswahili: Alipoona jinsi wageni walivyokuwa wanachagua mahali pa heshima wakati wa kula, akawaambia mfano huu:
Ekegusii: Agateebia baria barangeretigwe omoreng’anio, gachia korora buna bachorire ebirogo bi’eritang’ani, akabateebia,

English: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
Kiswahili: “Mtu akikualika arusini, usikae mahali pa mgeni wa heshima kwa kuwa inawezekana amealikwa mtu mheshimiwa kuliko wewe.
Ekegusii: “Gokorangerigwa nomonto ase omoyega bw’enyangi, toikaransa ase ekerogo kie ritang’ani; onye omonto bw’amasikani kobua aye orangeretigwe nere,

English: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.
Kiswahili: Kama mkifanya hivyo yule aliyewaalika ninyi wawili atakuja na kukuambia, ‘Mpishe huyu mtu kiti chako.’ Ndipo kwa aibu utalazimika kukaa katika nafasi ya chini kabisa.
Ekegusii: oria obarangeretie inwe babere nache kogoteebia aye: Motigerere oyo ekerogo eke; erio nochake koba nobosooku gokoiranigwa goikaransa magega.

English: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, unapoalikwa, chagua nafasi ya chini, ili yule mwenyeji wako atakapokuona atakuja na kukuambia, ‘Rafiki yangu, nenda kwenye nafasi iliyo bora zaidi.’ Kwa jinsi hii utakuwa umepewa heshima mbele ya wageni wenzako wote.
Ekegusii: Korende gokorangerigwa, genda oikaranse magega, erinde kagocha oyokorangeretie, agoteebie: Mosani, tigera gocha aa aase e ritang’ani. Erio nobe nogosikwa ase amasio abo bonsi abaikaransete amo naye.

English: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila mtu ajikwezaye atashushwa, naye ajishushaye atakwezwa.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera kera oyokweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.”

English: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akamwambia yule aliyewaalika, “Uandaapo karamu ya chakula cha mchana au cha jioni, usialike rafiki zako au ndugu zako au jamaa zako au majirani zako walio matajiri tu. Ukifanya hivyo, wao nao wanaweza kukualika kwao, nawe ukawa umelipwa kile ulichofanya na kupata thawabu yako.
Ekegusii: Agateebia oria omorangeretie, “Kogokora endagera ya mambia gose eya mogoroba, torangeria abasani bao, gose abamino, gose eamate yao, gose abagisangio bao abanda; baabaise gokorangeria banyare gokoakana.

English: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;
Kiswahili: Bali ufanyapo karamu, waalike maskini, vilema na vipofu,
Ekegusii: Korende kogokora omoyega, barangerie abataka, na ebirema, na amagata, na emeuko;

English: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”
Kiswahili: nawe utabarikiwa kwa sababu hawa hawana uwezo wa kukulipa. Mungu atakulipa wakati wa ufufuo wa wenye haki.”
Ekegusii: aye nosesenigwe, ekiagera tibari na gento bagokoakana. Naki aye noche goakanwa ase okobokigwa kw’abanyene oboronge.”

English: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa wale waliokuwa pamoja naye mezani aliposikia hivi akamwambia Yesu, “Amebarikiwa mtu yule atakayekula katika karamu ya Ufalme wa Mungu!”
Ekegusii: Ekero oyomo ase abwo baikaransete ase endagera amo nere achia koyaigwa akamoteebia, “Nasesenirie oyoranyare koria omogati ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae!”

English: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu mmoja alikuwa anaandaa karamu kubwa, akaalika watu wengi.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omonto oyomo okorete omoyega omonene; akarangeria abanto abange.

English: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’
Kiswahili: Wakati wa karamu ulipofika, akamtuma mtumishi wake akawaambie wale walioalikwa, ‘Karibuni, kila kitu ki tayari sasa.’
Ekegusii: Ekero ki’omoyega agatoma omosomba oye kogenda goteebia baria konya barangerigwe: Inchuo, ekiagera ebinto bionsi biabeire ang’e.

English: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’
Kiswahili: “Lakini wote, kila mmoja, wakaanza kutoa udhuru: Wa kwanza akasema, ‘Nimenunua shamba, lazima niende kuliona. Tafadhali niwie radhi.’
Ekegusii: Bagachaaka bonsi korigia chintamero. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akamoteebia: Nagorire omogondo, nindigetie kogenda koyorora; nagosabire, onyabere.

English: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’
Kiswahili: “Mwingine akasema, ‘Ndipo tu nimenunua jozi tano za ngʼombe wa kulimia, nami ninakwenda kuwajaribu, tafadhali niwie radhi.’
Ekegusii: Oyonde akabora: Nagorire chintang’ana amachoki atano, nkogenda nde gochiteema; nagosabire, onyabere.

English: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’
Kiswahili: Naye mwingine akasema, ‘Nimeoa mke, kwa hiyo siwezi kuja.’
Ekegusii: Oyonde akabora: Nanyuomire omokungu, na ase engencho eye tinkonyara gocha.

English: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’
Kiswahili: “Yule mtumishi akarudi, akampa bwana wake taarifa. Ndipo yule mwenye nyumba akakasirika, akamwagiza yule mtumishi wake, akisema, ‘Nenda upesi kwenye mitaa na vichochoro vya mjini uwalete maskini, vilema, vipofu na viwete.’
Ekegusii: Omosomba oria agacha, akorokia omonene oye amang’ana aya. Erio oria omonyene enyomba akabea, agateebia omosomba oye: Soka bwango, ogende ase chinchera na ebinchera bi’emechie, orente abataka, na ebirema, na emeuko, na amagata.

English: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’
Kiswahili: “Yule mtumishi akamwambia, ‘Bwana, yale uliyoniagiza nimefanya, lakini bado ipo nafasi.’
Ekegusii: Na omosomba oria akabora: Omonene, ayio gwachika aikire gokoreka, ko nonya mbono ribaga ndireo.

English: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo yule bwana akamwambia mtumishi wake, ‘Nenda kwenye barabara na vijia vilivyoko nje ya mji na uwalazimishe watu waingie ili nyumba yangu ipate kujaa.
Ekegusii: Omonene oria agateebia omosomba oye: Genda ase chinchera ne chimbebe, obabetererie basoe, erinde enyomba yane enyare goichora.

English: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, hakuna hata mmoja wa wale walioalikwa atakayeionja karamu yangu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera nagotebirie ng’a ase abanto baria barangeretigwe onde tari nonya noyomo oranyare koigwa omoyega one.”

English: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulikuwa ukisafiri pamoja na Yesu, naye akageuka, akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Emeganda emenge nigo yarenge amo na Yeso; ere akeonchora, akabateebia,

English: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote anayekuja kwangu hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu kama hatanipenda mimi zaidi ya baba yake na mama yake, mke wake na watoto wake, ndugu zake na dada zake, naam, hata maisha yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: “Omonto kagocha ase ’nde, nere atagecheti ise na ng’ina, na mokaye, na abana baye, na abamura bamwabo, na abasubati bamwabo, ee, nonya nobogima bwaye, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.

English: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
Kiswahili: Yeyote asiyeuchukua msalaba wake na kunifuata hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu.
Ekegusii: Naende monto onde bwensi otabogoreti omosalaba oye na gontunyana, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.

English: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
Kiswahili: “Ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye kama anataka kujenga nyumba, hakai kwanza chini na kufanya makisio ya gharama aone kama ana fedha za kutosha kukamilisha?
Ekegusii: Naki ning’o ase more, onye origetie koagacha oboagacho, otaikaranse ritang’ani kobara rigori ri’oboagacho obo, gose nabwate ebinto biisaine kobokoora?

English: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,
Kiswahili: La sivyo, akiisha kuweka msingi, naye akiwa hana uwezo wa kuikamilisha, wote waionao wataanza kumdhihaki,
Ekegusii: Aise gosinywa gokoora oboagacho boria kabekire oboroso, abanto bonsi bachake komosekerera,

English: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’
Kiswahili: wakisema, ‘Mtu huyu alianza kujenga lakini hakuweza kukamilisha.’
Ekegusii: bagokwana: Omonto oyo nigo achagete oboagacho, korende tabokoora.

English: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
Kiswahili: “Au ni mfalme gani atokaye kwenda kupigana vita na mfalme mwingine, ambaye hakai chini kwanza na kufikiri iwapo akiwa na jeshi la watu 10,000 ataweza kupigana na yule anayekuja na jeshi la watu 20,000?
Ekegusii: Gose morwoti ki, gakogenda korwana nomorwoti onde, otaikaranse ritang’ani na korengereria onye ere amo nabaanto chilifu ikomi nanyare koumerana nere oyokomocheera nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere?

English: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.
Kiswahili: Kama hawezi, basi wakati yule mwingine akiwa bado yuko mbali, yeye hutuma ujumbe wa watu na kuomba masharti ya amani.
Ekegusii: Onye taibo, nigo agotoma abanto korigia enchera y’omorembe, omonto oria gakare aare.

English: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye hawezi kuacha vyote alivyo navyo, hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu.
Ekegusii: Nabo kera oyomo oino otatigeti ebinto bionsi are nabio, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.

English: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?
Kiswahili: “Chumvi ni nzuri, lakini chumvi ikiwa imepoteza ladha yake, itafanywaje ili iweze kukolea tena?
Ekegusii: “Omonyo nomuya, korende omonyoo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki orabekwe bwanse?

English: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
Kiswahili: Haifai ardhi wala kwa lundo la mbolea, bali hutupwa nje. “Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”
Ekegusii: Togwenereti riroba gose etui; abanto nigo bakoyotuguta isiko. Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”

English: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.
Kiswahili: Basi watoza ushuru na wenye dhambi wote walikuwa wanakusanyika ili wapate kumsikiliza Yesu.
Ekegusii: Nabo abarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe bonsi nigo baare komoika Yeso ang’e komotegerera.

English: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakanungʼunika wakisema, “Huyu mtu anawakaribisha wenye dhambi na kula nao.”
Ekegusii: Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariiko bakemurungania, bakaboora, “Oyo nigo akoroisia abanyene ebibe, na koria amo nabarabwo.”

English: He told them this parable:
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia mfano huu:
Ekegusii: Erio akabateebia omoreng’anio oyo:

English: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa mmoja wenu ana kondoo mia moja, naye akapoteza mmoja wao, je, hawaachi wale tisini na tisa nyikani na kwenda kumtafuta huyo aliyepotea mpaka ampate?
Ekegusii: “Monto ki oino oyore ne ching’ondi rigana erimo, na eyemo esire, tagotiga chiria emerongo kianda na kianda ase erooro, na gochia korigia eria yasirire, goika ayenyore?

English: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
Kiswahili: Naye akishampata, humbeba mabegani mwake kwa furaha
Ekegusii: Nabo kayenyorire ayebeka amareko aye nomogooko.

English: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
Kiswahili: na kwenda nyumbani. Kisha huwaita rafiki zake na majirani, na kuwaambia, ‘Furahini pamoja nami; nimempata kondoo wangu aliyepotea.’
Ekegusii: Na ekero akoirana inka, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abateebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire eng’ondi yane eria yasirete.

English: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
Kiswahili: Nawaambieni, vivyo hivyo kutakuwa na furaha zaidi mbinguni kwa sababu ya mwenye dhambi mmoja atubuye, kuliko kwa wenye haki tisini na tisa ambao hawana haja ya kutubu.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabateebirie, nobe omogooko igoro ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire, kobua ase abanyene oboronge emerongo kianda na kianda, abatarigeti okoonchoka.

English: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?
Kiswahili: “Au ikiwa mwanamke ana sarafu za fedha kumi, naye akapoteza moja, je, hawashi taa na kufagia nyumba na kuitafuta kwa bidii mpaka aipate?
Ekegusii: “Gose mokuungu ki ore ne chisiringi ikomi chi’echifeta, na eyemo esire, tagotongia etaya na kwabusa enyomba, arigie nomokia goika ayenyore?

English: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’
Kiswahili: Naye akiisha kuipata, huwaita rafiki zake na majirani na kuwaambia, ‘Furahini pamoja nami; nimeipata ile sarafu yangu ya fedha iliyopotea.’
Ekegusii: Kayenyorire, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abateebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire esiringi eria nasiria.

English: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, nawaambia, kuna furaha mbele ya malaika wa Mungu juu ya mwenye dhambi mmoja atubuye.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo, nabateebirie, nore omogooko ase abamalaika ba Nyasae ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire.”

English: He said, “A certain man had two sons.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaendelea kusema: “Kulikuwa na mtu mmoja aliyekuwa na wana wawili.
Ekegusii: Naende agateeba, “Omonto oyomo narenge nabamura babere.

English: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.
Kiswahili: Yule mdogo akamwambia baba yake, ‘Baba, nipe urithi wangu.’ Hivyo akawagawia wanawe mali yake.
Ekegusii: Oria omoke agateebia ise: Tata, ing’a ensemo y’enibo entungetie. Ise akabaatanera ebinto biaye.

English: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.
Kiswahili: “Baada ya muda mfupi, yule mdogo akakusanya vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo, akaenda nchi ya mbali, na huko akaitapanya mali yake kwa maisha ya anasa.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atai mange oria omoke agasangereria ebinto biaye bionsi, akaimoka akagenda orogendo gochia ense y’aare; agasiarera agwo enibo yaye ase ogokora kw’obokayayu.

English: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kutumia kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, kukawa na njaa kali katika nchi ile yote, naye akawa hana chochote.
Ekegusii: Gakoorire bionsi, enchara enene egasoa ase ense eria, ere akaremerwa.

English: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akaenda akaajiriwa na mwenyeji mmoja wa nchi ile ambaye alimpeleka shambani kwake kulisha nguruwe.
Ekegusii: Akagenda akabwatana nomonto oyomo bw’abanyene ense eria; ere akamoira ebitii biaye korageria chimbeche.

English: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.
Kiswahili: Akatamani kujishibisha kwa maganda waliyokula wale nguruwe, wala hakuna mtu aliyempa chochote.
Ekegusii: Akaba nkogania are koigotia enda yaye ase amasabo aria chimbeche chiarenge koria; monto onde tarenge komoa gento.

English: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!
Kiswahili: “Lakini alipozingatia moyoni mwake, akasema, ‘Ni watumishi wangapi walioajiriwa na baba yangu ambao wana chakula cha kuwatosha na kusaza, bali mimi hapa nakufa kwa njaa!
Ekegusii: Goika agachia kweiranerera kweboria ere omonyene, akabora: Abasomba b’eng’eria ba tata mbarenga bakare koria endagera na gotigaria, na inche aiga ngokwa nenchara!

English: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.
Kiswahili: Nitaondoka na kurudi kwa baba yangu na kumwambia: Baba, nimetenda dhambi mbele za Mungu na mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Ninyimoke, ngende ase tata, imoteebie: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao,

English: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’
Kiswahili: Sistahili tena kuitwa mwanao; nifanye kama mmoja wa watumishi wako.’
Ekegusii: tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo, tiga imbe buna oyomo bw’abasomba bao b’eng’eria.

English: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.
Kiswahili: Basi akaondoka, akaenda kwa baba yake. “Lakini alipokuwa bado yuko mbali, baba yake akamwona, moyo wake ukajawa na huruma. Akamkimbilia mwanawe, akamkumbatia na kumbusu.
Ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda ase ise. Agachia koba okare are, ise akamorora, akamororera amaabera, akaminyoka, akamoboania rigoti, akamonyunyunta mono.

English: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
Kiswahili: “Yule mwana akamwambia baba yake, ‘Baba, nimekosa mbele za Mungu na mbele yako. Sistahili kuitwa mwanao tena.’
Ekegusii: Omwana oria akamoteebia: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao, tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo.

English: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.
Kiswahili: “Lakini baba yake akawaambia watumishi, ‘Leteni upesi joho lililo bora sana, tieni pete kidoleni mwake na viatu miguuni mwake.
Ekegusii: Korende ise agateebia abasomba baye: Renta bwango eganchwa ere engiya, momobekere; mobekere nebonyi ase ekiara kiaye, na ebikoroto ase amagoro aye.

English: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;
Kiswahili: Leteni ndama aliyenona, mkamchinje ili tuwe na karamu, tule na kufurahi.
Ekegusii: Nyerente emori eria ere enoru, moyenyenye, torie na kogoka,

English: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana huyu mwanangu alikuwa amekufa na sasa yu hai tena; alikuwa amepotea na sasa amepatikana!’ Nao wakaanza kufanya tafrija.
Ekegusii: ekiagera oyo omwana one konya okuure, naende moyo are; konya osirire, korende bono ororekanire. Bagachaaka gochenga.

English: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
Kiswahili: “Wakati huo, yule mwana mkubwa alikuwa shambani. Alipokaribia nyumbani, akasikia sauti ya nyimbo na watu wakicheza.
Ekegusii: “Nabo oria omomura oye omonene nigo arenge mogondo; agachia goika ang’e nenyomba, akaigwa egeturi ki’ogoteera na ogotenga.

English: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.
Kiswahili: Akamwita mmoja wa watumishi na kumuuliza, ‘Kuna nini?’
Ekegusii: Akarangeria oyomo bw’abasomba, akamobooria amang’ana ayio, engencho yaye inki.

English: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’
Kiswahili: Akamwambia, ‘Ndugu yako amekuja, naye baba yako amemchinjia ndama aliyenona kwa sababu mwanawe amerudi nyumbani akiwa salama na mzima.’
Ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria: Momura omino ochire, na iso omonyenyeire emori enoru, ekiagera amonyora ore omogima.

English: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.
Kiswahili: “Yule mwana mkubwa akakasirika, akakataa kuingia ndani. Basi baba yake akatoka nje na kumsihi.
Ekegusii: Korende akabea, tarigia gosoa. Erio ise agasoka, akamosorora,

English: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye akamjibu baba yake, ‘Tazama! Miaka yote hii nimekutumikia na hata siku moja sijaacha kutii amri zako, lakini hujanipa hata mwana-mbuzi ili nifurahi na rafiki zangu.
Ekegusii: korende ere akamoiraneria: Rora, inche nagokoreire emiaka eye emenge, tinsareti ogochika kwao kero kende gionsi; korende tikwana kong’a emanwa y’embori, erinde ingoke amo nabasani baane.

English: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
Kiswahili: Lakini huyu mwanao ambaye ametapanya mali yako kwa makahaba aliporudi nyumbani, wewe umemchinjia ndama aliyenona!’
Ekegusii: Korende ochia gocha omwana oo oyo, oriire ebinto biao nabakuungu abatayayi, kwamonyenyeire emori enoru.

English: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
Kiswahili: “Baba yake akamjibu, ‘Mwanangu, umekuwa nami siku zote na vyote nilivyo navyo ni vyako.
Ekegusii: Ise akamoteebia: Omwana one, aye amatuko onsi nigo ore amo nainche, na ebinto bionsi inde nabirobio nebiao.

English: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini ilitubidi tufurahi na kushangilia kwa sababu huyu ndugu yako alikuwa amekufa na sasa yu hai; alikuwa amepotea naye amepatikana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Mboronge gokora omogooko na gochenga, ekiagera oyo momura omino konya okuure, na bono moyo are; konya osirire, na bono ororekanire.”

English: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Palikuwa na tajiri mmoja na msimamizi wake. Ilisemekana kwamba huyo msimamizi alikuwa anatumia vibaya mali ya tajiri yake.
Ekegusii: Naende agateebia aborokigwa baye, Narenge omonto omonda, orenge nomorendi. Oyio agasoerwa asare ng’a osiareire enibo yaye.

English: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
Kiswahili: Hivyo huyo tajiri akamwita na kumuuliza, ‘Ni mambo gani haya ninayoyasikia kukuhusu? Toa taarifa ya usimamizi wako, kwa sababu huwezi kuendelea kuwa msimamizi.’
Ekegusii: Akamorangeria, akamoteebia: Ninki eke naigure ase ore? Orokia amang’ana y’oborendi bwao, ekiagera tokonyara kogenderera koba omorendi.

English: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.
Kiswahili: “Yule msimamizi akawaza moyoni mwake, ‘Nitafanya nini sasa? Bwana wangu ananiondoa katika kazi yangu. Sina nguvu za kulima, nami ninaona aibu kuombaomba.
Ekegusii: Omorendi oria akabora ase omoyo oye: Ninki ndakore, ekiagera omonene one ondusirie ase oborendi bwane? Tindi ne chinguru chi’okorema; ogosaba nobosooku ase ’nde.

English: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’
Kiswahili: Najua nitakalofanya ili nikiachishwa kazi yangu hapa, watu wanikaribishe nyumbani kwao.’
Ekegusii: Namanyire eke ndakore, erinde abanto bandoisie ase chinyomba chiabo, ekero nkorusigwa ase oborendi.

English: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo akawaita wadeni wote wa bwana wake, mmoja mmoja. Akamuuliza wa kwanza, ‘Deni lako kwa bwana wangu ni kiasi gani?’
Ekegusii: Erio akarangeria abasiira b’omonene oye, oyomo ase oyomo, akaboria oyo bw’eritang’ani: Ninki oriete ki’omonene one?

English: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
Kiswahili: “Akajibu, ‘Galoni 800za mafuta ya mizeituni.’ “Msimamizi akamwambia, ‘Chukua hati ya deni lako, ibadilishe upesi, uandike galoni 400.’
Ekegusii: Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’amaguta. Akamoteebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, ikaransa bwango, oriike emerongo etano.

English: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
Kiswahili: “Kisha akamuuliza wa pili, ‘Wewe deni lako ni kiasi gani?’ “Akajibu, ‘Vipimo 1,000vya ngano.’ “Yule msimamizi akamwambia, ‘Chukua hati yako, andika vipimo 800!’
Ekegusii: Naende akaboria oyonde: Naye ninki oriete? Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’engano. Akamoteebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, orike emerongo etano na etato.

English: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
Kiswahili: “Yule bwana akamsifu yule msimamizi dhalimu kwa jinsi alivyotumia ujanja. Kwa maana watu wa dunia hii wana ujanja zaidi wanapojishughulisha na mambo ya dunia kuliko watu wa nuru.
Ekegusii: Omonene oria agatogia omorendi otarenge omooronge, ekiagera akorete ase obong’aini. Naki abana b’ense eye nabang’aini kobua abana b’omobaso, ase ekegori kiabo abanyene.

English: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.
Kiswahili: Nawaambia, tumieni mali ya kidunia kujipatia marafiki, ili itakapokwisha, mkaribishwe katika makao ya milele.
Ekegusii: Nkobateebia nde inwe: Ekorere abasani nenibo y’ense eye etari boronge, erinde ekero egochia gokea, baabaroisie inwe ase obomenyo bwa kare na kare.

English: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
Kiswahili: “Yeyote aliye mwaminifu katika mambo madogo, pia ni mwaminifu hata katika mambo makubwa, naye mtu ambaye si mwaminifu katika mambo madogo pia si mwaminifu katika mambo makubwa.
Ekegusii: Oyore omwegenwa ase ekere egeke, nabo are omwegenwa ase ekere ekenene; na oyotari omooronge ase ekere egeke, naboigo tari omooronge ase ekere ekenene.

English: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa hamkuwa waaminifu katika mali ya kidunia, ni nani atakayewaaminia mali ya kweli?
Ekegusii: Onye timobeti abegenwa ase enibo y’ense eye etari boronge, ning’o oranyare kobegena koba nenibo y’ekeene?

English: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
Kiswahili: Nanyi kama hamkuwa waaminifu na mali ya mtu mwingine, ni nani atakayewapa iliyo yenu wenyewe?
Ekegusii: Onye timobeti abegenwa ase ekio ki’omonto onde, ning’o oranyare kobaa ekio ekere kiaino abanyene?

English: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
Kiswahili: “Hakuna mtumishi awezaye kuwatumikia mabwana wawili. Kwa kuwa atamchukia huyu na kumpenda yule mwingine, au atashikamana sana na huyu na kumdharau yule mwingine. Hamwezi kumtumikia Mungu pamoja na Mali.”
Ekegusii: Mosomba onde tari oranyaare gokorera abanene babere, ekiagera nageeche oyomo, na anche oyonde, gose nabwatane noyomo, na achaaye oyonde. Timokonyara gokorera Nyasae na enibo.

English: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo, waliokuwa wapenda fedha, waliyasikia hayo yote na wakamcheka kwa dharau.
Ekegusii: Abafarisai abarenge abanchi enibo bakaigwa amang’ana aya onsi, bakamosekereria.

English: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi mnajionyesha kuwa wenye haki mbele za wanadamu, lakini Mungu anaijua mioyo yenu. Kwa maana vile vitu ambavyo wanadamu wanavithamini sana, kwa Mungu ni machukizo.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe nabaanto mogwetogia ng’a nigo more abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Mwanyabaanto, korende Nyasae omanyire chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ekeimokererete igoro ase Mwanyabaanto, Nyasae nigo akegechete.

English: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
Kiswahili: “Sheria na Manabii vilihubiriwa mpaka kuja kwa Yohana Mbatizaji. Tangu wakati huo habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu zinahubiriwa, na kila mmoja hujiingiza kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: “Amachiiko narengeo, na ababani boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana. Korwa ekero keria amang’ana amaya ay’oborwoti bwa Nyasae nkorandigwa are, na kera omonto nigo akobosoa ne chinguru.

English: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.
Kiswahili: Lakini ni rahisi zaidi mbingu na dunia kupita kuliko hata herufi moja kuondoka katika Sheria.
Ekegusii: Korende naango kobua igoro na ense goeta, kobua enuguta eyemo y’amachiiko korua aroro.

English: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
Kiswahili: “Mtu yeyote amwachaye mkewe na kumwoa mwanamke mwingine anazini, naye mwanaume amwoaye mwanamke aliyetalikiwa anazini.
Ekegusii: “Kera oyogotiga mokaye na konyuoma oyonde otomanire, nere oyokonyuoma oyotigirwe nomosaacha oye, noyio otomanire.

English: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
Kiswahili: “Palikuwa na mtu mmoja tajiri aliyevaa nguo za rangi ya zambarau na kitani safi, ambaye aliishi kwa anasa kila siku.
Ekegusii: “Narenge omonto gete omonda, orenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga na echi’egatani engiya, na kwegokia kera rituko ase okoria.

English: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,
Kiswahili: Hapo penye mlango wake aliishi maskini mmoja, jina lake Lazaro, mwenye vidonda mwili mzima.
Ekegusii: Na ase egesieri kiaye narengeo omonto oyomo omotaka, erieta riaye Lazaro, orenge namaote amange.

English: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
Kiswahili: Huyo Lazaro alitamani kujishibisha kwa makombo yaliyoanguka kutoka mezani kwa yule tajiri. Hata mbwa walikuwa wakija na kuramba vidonda vyake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge kogania kweigotia namatori are kogwa korwa ase emesa y’omonda oria, ne chisese nachirochio chicha chiamomena amaote aye.

English: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.
Kiswahili: “Wakati ukafika yule maskini akafa, nao malaika wakamchukua akae pamoja na Abrahamu. Yule tajiri naye akafa na akazikwa.
Ekegusii: Omotaka oria agakwa, akabogorigwa nabamalaika, akabeekwa ase egekuba kia Aburaamu. Na oria omonda agakwa boigo, agatindekwa,

English: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
Kiswahili: Kule kuzimu alipokuwa akiteseka, alitazama juu, akamwona Abrahamu kwa mbali, naye Lazaro alikuwa karibu yake.
Ekegusii: na ekero aare agwo aase Eora y’amakweri akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora Aburaamu okare aare, na Lazaro ore ase egekuba kiaye.

English: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’
Kiswahili: Hivyo yule tajiri akamwita, ‘Baba Abrahamu, nihurumie na umtume Lazaro achovye ncha ya kidole chake ndani ya maji aupoze ulimi wangu, kwa sababu nina maumivu makuu kwenye moto huu.’
Ekegusii: Akarera, akabora: Tata Aburaamu, indorera amaabera, toma Lazaro atobeke ekiara kiaye mesia ase amaache, akendie oromeme rwane, ekiagera nachandekire ase omorero oyo.

English: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.
Kiswahili: “Lakini Abrahamu akamjibu, ‘Mwanangu, kumbuka kwamba wakati wa uhai wako ulipata mambo mazuri, lakini Lazaro alipata mambo mabaya. Lakini sasa anafarijiwa hapa na wewe uko katika maumivu makuu.
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: Omwana one, inyora buna kwanyorete amaya ao ase obogima bwao, na Lazaro boigo akanyora amabe, korende ere bono aiga oremiigwe, na aye ngochandeka ore.

English: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, kati yetu na ninyi huko kumewekwa shimo kubwa, ili wale wanaotaka kutoka huku kuja huko wasiweze, wala mtu yeyote asiweze kuvuka kutoka huko kuja kwetu.’
Ekegusii: Na kobua aya onsi, egati yaito na inwe eoromomo nereo yabeekirwe, erinde abanto abarigetie korua aiga bamboke gocha ase ore tibanyara, gose baria bare agwo tibanyara kwamboka gocha ase tore.

English: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—
Kiswahili: “Akasema, ‘Basi, nakuomba, umtume Lazaro aende nyumbani kwa baba yangu,
Ekegusii: Akabora: Nagosabire tata, omotome ase enyomba ya tata,

English: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
Kiswahili: maana ninao ndugu watano. Awaonye, ili wasije nao wakafika mahali hapa pa mateso.’
Ekegusii: ekiagera ninkare nabamura baminto batano; tiga agende abakuurere, erinde barabwo tibacha aa ase emechando.

English: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
Kiswahili: “Abrahamu akamjibu, ‘Ndugu zako wana Maandiko ya Mose na Manabii, wawasikilize hao.’
Ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: Mbare na Musa na ababani; tiga baigwere barabwo.

English: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
Kiswahili: “Yule tajiri akasema, ‘Hapana, baba Abrahamu, lakini mtu kutoka kwa wafu akiwaendea, watatubu.’
Ekegusii: Akabora: Yaya, tata Aburaamu, korende oyomo korwa ase abakuure aise kobachiera, inabaonchoke.

English: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”
Kiswahili: “Abrahamu akamwambia, ‘Kama wasipowasikiliza Mose na Manabii, hawataweza kushawishika hata kama mtu akifufuka kutoka kwa wafu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia: Bataigwereti Musa na ababani, naisa koboka omonto korwa ase abakuure, tibakoebererigwa banche.”

English: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Mambo yanayosababisha watu watende dhambi hayana budi kutukia. Lakini ole wake mtu yule anayeyasababisha.
Ekegusii: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Amang’ana ’okogocha takomocha kooroka, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okoyarenta!

English: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
Kiswahili: Ingekuwa heri kama mtu huyo angefungiwa jiwe la kusagia shingoni na kutoswa baharini, kuliko kumsababisha mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo kutenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe enyancha ime, kobua aragere oyomo bw’aba abake akore ebibe.

English: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, jilindeni. “Kama ndugu yako akikukosea mwonye, naye akitubu, msamehe.
Ekegusii: Erende; oyomino karakore ebibe, mokanie; karaonchoke, mwabere.

English: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”
Kiswahili: Kama akikukosea mara saba kwa siku moja na mara saba kwa siku moja akaja kwako akisema, ‘Ninatubu,’ msamehe.”
Ekegusii: Naende karakore ebibe ase ore ara gatano na kabere ase rituko erimo, karakoiranere ara gatano na kabere na goteeba: Naonchokire, mwabere.”

English: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
Kiswahili: Mitume wake wakamwambia Bwana, “Tuongezee imani.”
Ekegusii: Abatomwa bakamoteebia, “Omonene, tomentere okwegena gwaito.”

English: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
Kiswahili: Bwana akawajibu, “Kama mkiwa na imani ndogo kama punje ya haradali, mngeweza kuuambia mti huu wa mkuyu, ‘Ngʼoka ukaote baharini,’ nao ungewatii.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Onye mwarenge nokwegena koreng’aine buna entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi, anga mwateebia omokenene oyo: Simoka, bwesimeke nyancha, noro anga nobaigwera.

English: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?
Kiswahili: “Ikiwa mmoja wenu ana mtumishi anayelima shambani au anayechunga kondoo, je, mtumishi huyo arudipo atamwambia, ‘Karibu hapa keti ule chakula?’
Ekegusii: “Korende ning’o ase more oyore nomosomba okorema, gose okorisia ching’ondi, oramoteebie ekero akorwa mogondo agosoa nyomba: Inchuo bwango oikaranse, orie endagera?

English: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?
Kiswahili: Je, badala yake, hatamwambia, ‘Niandalie chakula, nile, jifunge unitumikie ninapokula na kunywa; baadaye waweza kula na kunywa?’
Ekegusii: Inee! Takomoteebia: Ebeke ang’e, ondoiserie endagera goika indie inywe, na magega yaye, naye orie na konywa?

English: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.
Kiswahili: Je, huyo mtu atamshukuru mtumishi huyo kwa kutimiza yale aliyoamriwa?
Ekegusii: Gose nkomoteebia are omosomba oria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera akora eki achikwa?

English: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo nanyi mkiisha kufanya mliyoagizwa, semeni, ‘Sisi tu watumishi tusiostahili; tumefanya tu yale tuliyopaswa kufanya.’ ”
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe, komorakore onsi aya mwachiikirwe, teba: ‘Intwe nabasomba bataisaneti; twakorire aya atogwenerete gokora.’”

English: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa njiani akienda Yerusalemu, alipitia mpakani mwa Samaria na Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera ekogenda Yerusalemu Yeso ngoeta arenge egati ya Samaria na Galili.

English: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akiingia kwenye kijiji kimoja, watu kumi waliokuwa na ukoma wakakutana naye. Wakasimama mbali,
Ekegusii: Ekero are gosoa omochie oyomo, akaumerana nabaanto ikomi abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma, bateneine are;

English: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
Kiswahili: wakapaza sauti, wakasema, “Yesu, Bwana, tuhurumie!”
Ekegusii: na barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakaboora, “Yeso, Omonene, tororere amaabera!”

English: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
Kiswahili: Alipowaona akawaambia, “Nendeni mkajionyeshe kwa makuhani.” Nao walipokuwa njiani wakienda, wakatakasika.
Ekegusii: Agachia kobarora, akabateebia, “Genda mweorokie ase abakuani.” Kobakogenda bagasibeka.

English: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao alipoona kwamba amepona, akarudi kwa Yesu, akimsifu Mungu kwa sauti kuu.
Ekegusii: Oyomo obo agachia korora ng’a osibekire, akairana okomobaaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene,

English: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
Kiswahili: Akajitupa miguuni mwa Yesu akamshukuru. Yeye alikuwa Msamaria.
Ekegusii: akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, okomoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, na ere n’Omosamaria orenge.

English: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
Kiswahili: Yesu akauliza, “Je, hawakutakaswa wote kumi? Wako wapi wale wengine tisa?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tari bonsi ikomi basibeka? Baria kianda, ng’ai bare?

English: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja aliyeonekana kurudi ili kumshukuru Mungu isipokuwa huyu mgeni?”
Ekegusii: Onde tanyorekanete oiranete komotogia Nyasae, otatiga omogeni oyo?”

English: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Inuka na uende zako, imani yako imekuponya.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Tenena, ogende; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.”

English: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoulizwa na Mafarisayo Ufalme wa Mungu utakuja lini, yeye akawajibu, “Ufalme wa Mungu hauji kwa kuchunguza kwa bidii,
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koborigwa n’Abafarisai, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae indi borache?” Akabairaneria, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae tibori gocha ase ebimanyererio bikororekana,

English: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
Kiswahili: wala watu hawatasema, ‘Huu hapa,’ au ‘Ule kule,’ kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu umo ndani yenu.”
Ekegusii: gose tibakobora: Rora naiga bore, gose: Naaria! Rora, oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo bore ime ase more.”

English: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Wakati utafika ambapo mtatamani kuiona moja ya siku ya Mwana wa Adamu, lakini hamtaiona.
Ekegusii: Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Amatuko nache morarigie korora rituko erimo ri’amatuko y’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto, korende timokorirora.

English: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,
Kiswahili: Watu watawaambia, ‘Yule kule!’ Au, ‘Huyu hapa!’ Msiwakimbilie.
Ekegusii: Naende nabaabateebie: Rora aaria, gose: Rora aiga! Timogenda, gose timobatunyana.

English: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile umeme wa radi umulikavyo katika anga kuanzia mwisho mmoja hadi mwingine, ndivyo atakavyokuwa Mwana wa Adamu katika siku yake.
Ekegusii: Naki buna okomesa gokomesa korwa igoro ensemo eyemo goika ensemo ende, nabo Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto araache koba ase rituko riaye.

English: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwanza itampasa kuteseka katika mambo mengi na kukataliwa na kizazi hiki.
Ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani nagwenerete konyora ogochandwa okonge, na kwangwa nekegori eke.

English: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.
Kiswahili: “Kama ilivyokuwa siku za Noa, ndivyo itakavyokuwa katika siku za Mwana wa Adamu.
Ekegusii: Naende buna yabeete ase amatuko a Nuhu, naboigo eraabe nase amatuko y’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.

English: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
Kiswahili: Watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakioa na kuolewa, mpaka siku ile Noa alipoingia katika safina. Ndipo gharika ikaja na kuwaangamiza wote.
Ekegusii: Barenge koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato; etoigo egaacha, egasiria bonsi.

English: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
Kiswahili: “Ndivyo ilivyokuwa katika siku za Loti: Watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakinunua na kuuza, wakilima na kujenga.
Ekegusii: Naboigo buna yabeete ase amatuko a Loti: Barenge koria na konywa, bakogora, koonia, bagosimeka, bakoagacha.

English: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.
Kiswahili: Lakini siku ile Loti alipoondoka Sodoma, ikanyesha mvua ya moto na kiberiti kutoka mbinguni ukawaangamiza wote.
Ekegusii: Korende ase rituko riria Loti aruete Sodomu omorero na ekebiriti bigatwa korwa igoro, bigasiria bonsi.

English: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa siku ile Mwana wa Adamu atakapofunuliwa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo erache koba ase rituko riria Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto araoroke.

English: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo, mtu yeyote aliye juu ya dari ya nyumba yake, hata vitu vyake vikiwa ndani ya hiyo nyumba, asishuke kuvichukua. Vivyo hivyo mtu aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua chochote.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria oyore kerama igoro, na ebinto biaye bire nyomba ime, taika abibogorie; nere oyore mogondo naboigo tairana inka.

English: Remember Lot’s wife!
Kiswahili: Mkumbukeni mke wa Loti!
Ekegusii: Moinyore moka Loti.

English: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote anayejaribu kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, na yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake atayaokoa.
Ekegusii: Oyorarigie koegera obogima bwaye nabosirie, korende oyorasirie obogima bwaye nabonyoore.

English: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.
Kiswahili: Nawaambia, usiku huo watu wawili watakuwa wamelala kitanda kimoja; naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie, obotuko boria abanto babere nababe ase oborere obomo, oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.

English: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”
Kiswahili: Wanawake wawili watakuwa wanasaga nafaka pamoja; naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.
Ekegusii: Abakungu babere nababe bagoseera ase orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.

English: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”
Kiswahili: Wanaume wawili watakuwa wanafanya kazi pamoja shambani; mmoja atachukuliwa na mwingine ataachwa.”
Ekegusii: Abanto babere inababe mogondo, oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.”

English: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawapa wanafunzi wake mfano ili kuwaonyesha kuwa yawapasa kuomba pasipo kukata tamaa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia omoreng’anio ng’a nebagwenerete komosaba Nyasae botambe, tibakwa emioyo,

English: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Katika mji mmoja alikuwepo hakimu ambaye hakumwogopa Mungu wala kumjali mtu.
Ekegusii: akabora, “Narenge omogambi ase omochie gete, otasigete Nyasae, gose taare koyiera monto.

English: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
Kiswahili: Katika mji huo alikuwako mjane mmoja ambaye alikuwa akija kwake mara kwa mara akimwomba, ‘Tafadhali nipatie haki kati yangu na adui yangu.’
Ekegusii: Na ase omochie oyio narengeo omoboraka orenge komochiera botambe, ogoteeba: Ngambera boronge ase omosiira one.

English: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,
Kiswahili: “Kwa muda mrefu yule hakimu alikataa. Lakini hatimaye akasema moyoni mwake, ‘Ijapokuwa simwogopi Mungu wala simjali mwanadamu,
Ekegusii: Omogambi oria ase ekero egeke tancha; magega agateeba ase omoyo oye: Nonya inche tinsigeti Nyasae, gose tindi koyiera monto,

English: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
Kiswahili: lakini kwa kuwa huyu mjane ananisumbuasumbua, nitahakikisha amepata haki yake ili asiendelee kunichosha kwa kunijia mara kwa mara!’ ”
Ekegusii: korende ekiagera omoboraka oyo andosirie, nimogambere boronge, tacha kondosia ase ogonchichera botambe.”

English: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
Kiswahili: Bwana akasema, “Sikilizeni asemavyo huyu hakimu dhalimu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Igwa aya omogambi otari omooronge agoteeba.

English: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
Kiswahili: Je, Mungu hatawatendea haki wateule wake wanaomlilia usiku na mchana? Je, atakawia kuwasaidia?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae takobanyorera oboronge abachore baye, abakomoreera omobaso na obotuko? Na ere takoba omoremereria ase bare?

English: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
Kiswahili: Ninawaambia, atawapatia haki upesi. Lakini je, Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuja ataikuta imani duniani?”
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie nabanyorere oboronge ase obwango. Korende Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto kagocha, Inee, nanyore okwegena ase ense?”

English: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:
Kiswahili: Yesu akatoa mfano huu kwa wale waliojiamini kuwa wao ni wenye haki na kuwadharau wengine:
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio oyo ase abanto baare gwekaga ng’a nabanyene oboronge, bagochaaya abande bonsi:

English: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
Kiswahili: “Watu wawili walikwenda Hekaluni kusali, mmoja wao alikuwa Farisayo na mwingine alikuwa mtoza ushuru.
Ekegusii: “Abanto babere bagatiira gochia Hekalu gosaba; oyomo n’Omofarisai na oyonde omorusia ebango.

English: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
Kiswahili: Yule Farisayo, akasimama, akasali hivi na kuomba kwake mwenyewe: ‘Mungu, nakushukuru kwa sababu mimi si kama watu wengine ambao ni wanyangʼanyi, wadhalimu, na wazinzi, wala kama huyu mtoza ushuru.
Ekegusii: Oria Omofarisai agatenena, agasaba iga ase omoyo oye: Nyasae, nakoiraneirie ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera inche tindi buna abanto bande, abauri, abatari boronge, abatomani, gose buna oyo omorusia ebango.

English: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
Kiswahili: Mimi nafunga mara mbili kwa juma, na natoa sehemu ya kumi ya mapato yangu.’
Ekegusii: Igo nkweng’ata ara kabere ase echuma; ’ndua ensemo ya ikomi y’okonyora kwane gwonsi.

English: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
Kiswahili: “Lakini yule mtoza ushuru akasimama mbali, wala hakuthubutu hata kuinua uso wake kutazama mbinguni, bali alijipigapiga kifuani na kusema: ‘Mungu, nihurumie, mimi mwenye dhambi.’
Ekegusii: Na oria omorusia ebango agatenena are, tarigia nonya nkoimokia amaiso aye igoro, korende ageaka‐aka egekuba kiaye, okobora: Nyasae, indorera amaabera inche omonyene ebibe!

English: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
Kiswahili: “Nawaambia, huyu mtoza ushuru alirudi nyumbani akiwa amehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu zaidi ya yule Farisayo. Kwa maana yeyote ajikwezaye atashushwa, na yeyote ajishushaye atakwezwa.”
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie inwe: Omonto oria nigo aigete bwoye konya obareirwe oboronge kobua oria onde, ekiagera oyokweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.”

English: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
Kiswahili: Pia, watu walikuwa wakimletea Yesu watoto wachanga ili awaguse. Wanafunzi wake walipoona hivyo, wakawakemea.
Ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana ebing’werere, erinde abakune; korende aborokigwa baye bagachia kobarora, bakabatanga.

English: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawaita wale watoto waje kwake, akasema, “Waacheni watoto wadogo waje kwangu, wala msiwazuie, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu ni wa wale walio kama hawa.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, ogoteeba, “Batige abana bache ase ’nde, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oborwotinbwa Nyasae nobwabo.

English: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
Kiswahili: Amin, nawaambia, mtu yeyote asiyeupokea Ufalme wa Mungu kama mtoto mdogo, hatauingia kamwe.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Onde bwensi otancheti oborwoti bwa Nyasae buna omwana omoke, takobosoa nonya ng’ake.”

English: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
Kiswahili: Mtawala mmoja akamuuliza Yesu, “Mwalimu mwema, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?”
Ekegusii: Na omogambi gete akamobooria, “Omworokia omuya, ninki ndakore inyare koba nomwando bw’obogima bwa kare na kare?”

English: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mbona unaniita mwema? Hakuna yeyote aliye mwema ila Mungu peke yake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Naki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.

English: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
Kiswahili: Unazijua amri: ‘Usizini, usiue, usiibe, usishuhudie uongo, waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.’ ”
Ekegusii: Kwamanyire amachiiko; Totomana, Toita, Toiba, Toteba oborimo, sika iso na nyoko.”

English: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
Kiswahili: Akajibu, “Amri hizi zote nimezishika tangu nikiwa mtoto.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”

English: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia haya, akamwambia, “Bado kuna jambo moja ulilopungukiwa. Nenda ukauze kila kitu ulicho nacho, uwape maskini, nawe utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Kisha njoo, unifuate.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akamoteebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremete; oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi ogabere abataka, na aye nobe nenibo igoro. Erio ochiche ontunyane.”

English: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
Kiswahili: Aliposikia jambo hili, alisikitika sana kwa maana alikuwa mtu mwenye mali nyingi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero achia koigwa aya akaba nomoichano, ekiagera arenge omonda mono.

English: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
Kiswahili: Yesu akamtazama, akasema, “Tazama jinsi ilivyo vigumu kwa tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu!
Ekegusii: Nabo Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae!

English: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Hakika ni rahisi zaidi kwa ngamia kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kuliko mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Naki naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esiindani, kobua omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
Kiswahili: Wale waliosikia haya wakauliza, “Ni nani basi awezaye kuokoka?”
Ekegusii: Na abwo abayaigwete bakaboora, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

English: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Yasiyowezekana kwa wanadamu yanawezekana kwa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Aya takonyarekana ase Mwanyabaanto, nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”

English: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamjibu, “Tazama, tumeacha vyote tulivyokuwa navyo tukakufuata!”
Ekegusii: Petero akabora, “Rora, intwe twatigire chinka chiaito, twagotunyanire aye.”

English: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Amin, nawaambia, hakuna hata mtu aliyeacha nyumba yake, au mke, au ndugu, au wazazi au watoto kwa ajili ya Ufalme wa Mungu
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Monto onde tari otigire enyomba, gose mokaye, gose abamwabo, gose abaibori, gose abana, ase engencho y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae,

English: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
Kiswahili: ambaye hatapewa mara nyingi zaidi ya hivyo katika maisha haya, na hatimaye kupata uzima wa milele ujao.”
Ekegusii: otanyore kobua ara aange bono, naende ase ense egochi‐gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.”

English: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawachukua wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili kando na kuwaambia, “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na kila kitu kilichoandikwa na manabii kumhusu Mwana wa Adamu kitatimizwa.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akaira baria ikomi na babere, akabateebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, naende amang’ana onsi ayariikeretwe Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nababani naikeranigwe.

English: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa atatiwa mikononi mwa watu wasiomjua Mungu, nao watamdhihaki, watamtukana na kumtemea mate, watampiga mijeledi na kumuua.
Ekegusii: Naki nabekwe ase amaboko y’abanto b’Ebisaku, nakorerwe echeche, na gokorerwa bobe, na gotwerwa amate;

English: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
Kiswahili: Naye siku ya tatu atafufuka.”
Ekegusii: naende inabamoake emecharichi na komoita, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.”

English: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake hawakuelewa mambo haya, kwa kuwa maana yake ilikuwa imefichika kwao, nao hawakujua Yesu alikuwa anazungumzia nini.
Ekegusii: Korende tibamanya nonya nering’ana erimo ase aya. Ring’ana eri rikabiseka ase bare, na tibamanya ayateebetwe.

English: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa anakaribia Yeriko, kipofu mmoja alikuwa ameketi kando ya njia akiomba msaada.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ang’e na Yeriko omonto oyomo omouko naikaransete enchera ensemo ogosaba ebiegwa.

English: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
Kiswahili: Kipofu huyo aliposikia umati wa watu ukipita, akauliza, “Kuna nini?”
Ekegusii: Agachia koigwa omoganda ogoeta, akaboria, “Inki ekio?”

English: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Yesu wa Nazareti anapita.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso o Nazareti ogoeta.”

English: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
Kiswahili: Akapaza sauti, akasema, “Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”
Ekegusii: Agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”

English: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwa wametangulia mbele wakamkemea, wakamwambia akae kimya. Lakini yeye akapaza sauti zaidi, “Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”
Ekegusii: Nabwo batang’aine bakamokania, bakamoteebia akire, korende ere akamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”

English: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
Kiswahili: Yesu akasimama, akawaamuru wamlete huyo mtu kwake. Alipokaribia, Yesu akamuuliza,
Ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, agachiika arentwe asare. Agachia komoika ang’e, akamobooria,

English: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
Kiswahili: “Unataka nikufanyie nini?” Akajibu, “Bwana, nataka kuona.”
Ekegusii: “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inyare korora.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Basi upate kuona. Imani yako imekuponya.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Oegwe okorora; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.”

English: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
Kiswahili: Akapata kuona saa ile ile, akamfuata Yesu, huku akimsifu Mungu. Watu wote walipoona mambo hayo, nao wakamsifu Mungu.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, akamotunyana, okomotogia Nyasae; na abanto bonsi bagachia korora aya, bakamotogia Nyasae.

English: He entered and was passing through Jericho.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaingia Yeriko, naye alikuwa anapita katikati ya huo mji.
Ekegusii: Yeso agasoa Yeriko, akaba ngoeta are egati‐gati yaye.

English: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
Kiswahili: Tazama, palikuwa na mtu mmoja mkuu wa watoza ushuru naye alikuwa tajiri, jina lake Zakayo.
Ekegusii: Narenge aroro omonto oyomo ore korokwa Zakayo, omonene bw’abarusia ebango; ere nomonda orenge.

English: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
Kiswahili: Yeye alikuwa akijitahidi kumwona Yesu ni mtu wa namna gani. Lakini kutokana na umati mkubwa wa watu hakuweza kwa sababu alikuwa mfupi wa kimo.
Ekegusii: Akarigia korora Yeso, gose ’monto ki; ko tanyara ase engencho y’omoganda, ekiagera arenge omweng’e.

English: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akatangulia mbio mbele ya umati wa watu akapanda juu ya mkuyu ili amwone Yesu, kwa sababu angeipitia njia ile.
Ekegusii: Agatang’ana bwango, akariina igoro ase omoko anyare komorora, ekiagera ngoetera arenge ase enchera eria.

English: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipofika pale chini ya huo mkuyu, akatazama juu, akamwambia, “Zakayo, shuka upesi, kwa maana leo nitakuwa mgeni nyumbani kwako!”
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia goika aase aria, akarigereria igoro, akamoteebia, “Zakayo, ika bwango, ekiagera reero ningwenerete goikaransa nyomba mwao.”

English: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Zakayo akashuka upesi, akamkaribisha Yesu nyumbani kwake kwa furaha kubwa.
Ekegusii: Agaika bwango, akamoroisia nomogooko.

English: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
Kiswahili: Watu wote walipoona hivyo, wakaanza kunungʼunika wakisema, “Amekwenda kuwa mgeni wa ‘mtu mwenye dhambi.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bachia korora aya, bakemurungania bonsi, bakobora, “Osoire koba omogeni bw’omonyene ebibe.”

English: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Zakayo akasimama na kumwambia Bwana, “Tazama, Bwana! Sasa hivi nusu ya mali yangu ninawapa maskini, nami kama nimemdhulumu mtu yeyote kitu chochote, nitamrudishia mara nne ya hicho kiwango.”
Ekegusii: Zakayo agatenena, agateebia Omonene, “Rora, Omonene, ekeng’ese ki’enibo yane ning’ee abataka; naende onye naureretie omonto egento nimoiranerie ara kane.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Leo, wokovu umeingia nyumbani humu, kwa sababu huyu naye ni mwana wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Reero ogotooreka gwaikire enyomba eye, ekiagera oyo boigo nomwana o Aburaamu.

English: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu amekuja kutafuta na kuokoa kile kilichopotea.”
Ekegusii: Naki Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nigo achete korigia egiasirete na kogetooria.”

English: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanasikiliza haya, Yesu akaendelea kuwaambia mfano, kwa sababu alikuwa anakaribia Yerusalemu na watu walikuwa wakidhani ya kuwa Ufalme wa Mungu ulikuwa unakuja saa iyo hiyo.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bagachia koigwa aya, Yeso akamenta kobateebia omoreng’anio, ekiagera konya oikire ang’e na Yerusalemu, na barabwo bagakaga ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo borarorekane ekero ekio kegima.

English: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akawaambia: “Mtu mmoja mwenye cheo kikubwa alisafiri kwenda nchi ya mbali ili akapokee madaraka ya kuwa mfalme, kisha arudi.
Ekegusii: Nabo akabora, “Omonto oyomo omosike akagenda ense y’aare, erinde anyare kwenyorera oborwoti, naende airane.

English: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’
