Kiswahili: Hivyo akawaita kumi miongoni mwa watumishi wake, na akawapa kila mmoja fungu la fedha. Akawaambia, ‘Fanyeni biashara na fedha hizi mpaka nitakaporudi.’
Ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto ikomi korwa ase abasomba baye, akabaa ebirengo ikomi bie chiropia, akabateebia: Biire mobionchorerie goika ekero nkoirana.

English: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
Kiswahili: “Lakini raiya wa nchi yake walimchukia wakapeleka ujumbe na kusema, ‘Hatutaki huyu mtu awe mfalme wetu.’
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ense yaye bakamogecha, bagatoma abatomwa komotunyana na komoteebia, Titorigeti omonto oyo atogambere.

English: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo alirudi akiwa amekwisha kupokea mamlaka ya ufalme, akawaita wale watumishi wake aliokuwa amewaachia fedha, ili afahamu ni faida kiasi gani kila mmoja wao aliyopata kwa kufanya biashara.
Ekegusii: “Ekero achia koirana, kanyorire oborwoti, agachiika abasomba baria aete chiropia barangerigwe, erinde anyare komanya ebitoki banyorire ase okoonchoreria kwabo.

English: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’
Kiswahili: “Wa kwanza akaja na kusema, ‘Bwana, kutokana na fedha uliyoniachia, nimepata faida mara kumi zaidi.’
Ekegusii: Oyo bw’eritang’ani agacha, okobora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo ikomi binde.

English: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
Kiswahili: “Yule bwana akamjibu, ‘Umefanya vizuri mtumishi mwema! Kwa sababu umekuwa mwaminifu katika wajibu mdogo sana, nakupa mamlaka juu ya miji kumi.’
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia: Gwakorire buya, aye omosomba omuya! Ekiagera kwabeire omwegenwa ase egento kere egeke, nabo nobe nokobua igoro ase emechie ikomi.

English: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’
Kiswahili: “Wa pili naye akaja. Akasema, ‘Bwana, fedha yako imeleta faida mara tano zaidi.’
Ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere agacha, akabora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo bitano.

English: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
Kiswahili: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Nakupa mamlaka juu ya miji mitano.’
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia nere boigo: Aye nobe igoro ase emechie etano.

English: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,
Kiswahili: “Kisha akaja yule mtumishi mwingine, akasema, ‘Bwana, hii hapa fedha yako. Niliitunza vizuri kwenye kitambaa.
Ekegusii: Naende oyonde agacha, akabora: Omonene, eke nakio ekerengo kiao nagachete ase egetambaa;

English: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’
Kiswahili: Nilikuogopa, kwa sababu wewe ni mtu mgumu. Unachukua ambapo hukuweka kitu, na unavuna mahali ambapo hukupanda kitu.’
Ekegusii: nigo nakoirogete, ekiagera aye nigo ore omonto omokong’u. Nigo okobogoria eki otagachete, na kogesa eki otasimegete.

English: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.
Kiswahili: “Bwana wake akamjibu, ‘Nitakuhukumu kwa maneno yako mwenyewe, wewe mtumishi mwovu! Kama ulifahamu kwamba mimi ni mtu mgumu, nichukuaye mahali ambapo sikuweka kitu na kuvuna mahali ambapo sikupanda,
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia: Ase enkwana y’omonwa oo ninkogambie, aye omosomba omobe. Nkwamanyete ng’a inche nomonto omokong’u, nkobogoria eki ntagachete, na kogesa eki ntasimegete.

English: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’
Kiswahili: kwa nini basi hukuweka fedha zangu kwa watoa riba, ili nitakaporudi nichukue iliyo yangu na riba yake?’
Ekegusii: Naki rende otabeegete chitaabu chiane ase aba bakorua ebitoki, ninche ngocha anga nachinyora amo nebitoki?

English: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’
Kiswahili: “Ndipo akawaambia wale waliokuwa wamesimama karibu, ‘Mnyangʼanyeni fungu lake la fedha, mkampe yule mwenye kumi.’
Ekegusii: Agateebia abarengeo: Moure ekerengo kiaye, moe oria oyore nebirengo ikomi.

English: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’
Kiswahili: “Wakamwambia, ‘Bwana, mbona; tayari anayo mafungu kumi!’
Ekegusii: (Bakamoteebia: Omonene, oyo nare nebirengo ikomi).

English: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
Kiswahili: “Akawajibu, ‘Nawaambia kwamba kila aliye na kitu, ataongezewa. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie: Kera oyore negento naegwe, korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.

English: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”
Kiswahili: Lakini wale adui zangu ambao hawakutaka mimi niwe mfalme juu yao. Waleteni hapa mkawaue mbele yangu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Korende baria ababisa baane batarigeti mbagambere, barente aiga, mobaite ase obosio bwane.”

English: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu kusema haya, alitangulia kupanda kwenda Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, agatang’ana gotiira kogenda Yerusalemu.

English: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,
Kiswahili: Naye alipokaribia Bethfage na Bethania kwenye mlima uitwao Mlima wa Mizeituni, aliwatuma wanafunzi wake wawili, akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Agachia goika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, agatoma babere baborokigwa baye,

English: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.
Kiswahili: “Nendeni katika kijiji kilichoko mbele yenu. Na mtakapokuwa mnaingia kijijini, mtamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa hapo, ambaye hajapandwa na mtu bado. Mfungueni, mkamlete hapa.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, Genda goika agachie karia mokoorokera; kamwasoire ime, inamorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyesibore moyendetere.

English: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akiwauliza, ‘Mbona mnamfungua?’ Mwambieni, ‘Bwana anamhitaji.’ ”
Ekegusii: Naende omonto karababorie: Naki, mokoyesibora? Momoteebie iga, “Omonene nayeganetie.”

English: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.
Kiswahili: Wale waliotumwa wakaenda, wakakuta kila kitu kama vile Yesu alivyokuwa amewaambia.
Ekegusii: Nabo baria batometwe bakagenda, bakayenyora buna abateebeetie.

English: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanamfungua yule mwana-punda, wenyewe wakawauliza, “Mbona mnamfungua huyo mwana-punda?”
Ekegusii: Ekero baare gosibora emori eria y’etigere, abanyene bakababoria, “Nase ki mogosibora emori?”

English: They said, “The Lord needs it.”
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wakajibu, “Bwana anamhitaji.”
Ekegusii: Bakaboora, “Omonene nayeganetie.”

English: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.
Kiswahili: Wakamleta kwa Yesu, nao baada ya kutandika mavazi yao juu ya huyo mwana-punda, wakampandisha Yesu juu yake.
Ekegusii: Bakayerenta ase Yeso; bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ase emori eria, bakariinia Yeso igoro aseero.

English: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akienda akiwa amempanda, watu wakatandaza mavazi yao barabarani.
Ekegusii: Ere gakogenda, bakaara chianga chiabo inchera.

English: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,
Kiswahili: Alipokaribia mahali yanapoanzia materemko ya Mlima wa Mizeituni, umati wote wa wafuasi wake wakaanza kumsifu Mungu kwa furaha kwa sauti kuu kwa ajili ya matendo yote ya miujiza waliyoyaona. Wakasema:
Ekegusii: Agachia goika egetirimboko ki’egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, omoganda bwonsi bw’aborokigwa baye bagachaaka kogooka na komobaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene ase ebikone bie chinguru bionsi barorire,

English: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”
Kiswahili: “Amebarikiwa Mfalme ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Amani mbinguni na utukufu huko juu sana.”
Ekegusii: bakobora, “Nasesenirie Omorwoti oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Omorembe igoro, na obonene bore igoro mono!”

English: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo waliokuwamo miongoni mwa ule umati wa watu wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, waamuru wanafunzi wako wanyamaze.”
Ekegusii: Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge ase omosangererekano bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, togonyera aborokigwa bao!”

English: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nawaambia ninyi, kama hawa wakinyamaza, mawe yatapiga kelele.”
Ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nabatebirie: Aba nabaisa gokira, amagena aya naake eriogi.”

English: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,
Kiswahili: Alipokaribia Yerusalemu na kuuona mji, aliulilia,
Ekegusii: Ere agachia goika ang’e akarora omochie, akayoiyereria amariga,

English: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
Kiswahili: akisema, “Laiti ungalijua hata wewe leo yale ambayo yangeleta amani, lakini sasa yamefichika machoni pako.
Ekegusii: okobora, “Onye nkwamanya reero ayare korenta omorembe! Korende bono abisekire ase amaiso ao!

English: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,
Kiswahili: Hakika siku zinakujia, ambazo adui zako watakuzingira, nao watakuzunguka pande zote na kukuzuilia ndani.
Ekegusii: Naki amatuko nagochere, ababisa bao barakoagachere orwaki bagoetanane, bagotangerane ase chinsemo chionsi,

English: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”
Kiswahili: Watakuponda chini, wewe na watoto walioko ndani ya kuta zako. Nao hawataacha hata jiwe moja juu ya jingine, kwa sababu hukutambua wakati wa kujiliwa kwako.”
Ekegusii: na bakoiyerie inse, na abana bao ime ase ore. Tibagotiga ime ase ore riigena erimo igoro ase erinde, ekiagera otamanyeti engaki y’ogocherwa kwao.”

English: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
Kiswahili: Ndipo akaingia eneo la Hekalu, akaanza kuwafukuza wale waliokuwa wakiuza vitu humo.
Ekegusii: Agasoa Hekalu ime, agachaaka gosokia baria barenge koonia aroro,

English: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
Kiswahili: Naye akawaambia, “Imeandikwa, ‘Nyumba yangu itakuwa nyumba ya sala,’ lakini ninyi mmeifanya kuwa ‘pango la wanyangʼanyi.’ ”
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Neriikire: Enyomba yane nebe enyomba y’ogosaba, korende inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”

English: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.
Kiswahili: Kila siku alikuwa akifundisha Hekaluni. Lakini viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria na viongozi wa watu walikuwa wakitafuta njia ili kumuua.
Ekegusii: Akaba okworokereria kera rituko ase Hekalu. Abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na abanene b’abaanto bakarigia komoita;

English: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakupata nafasi kwa sababu watu wote walimfuata wakiyasikiliza maneno yake kwa usikivu mwingi.
Ekegusii: na barabwo tibanyora eki bagokora, ekiagera abanto bonsi bamotegererete.

English: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.
Kiswahili: Siku moja, Yesu alipokuwa akifundisha watu Hekaluni na kuhubiri habari njema, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria, pamoja na wazee wa watu wakamjia.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero Yeso arenge kworokereria abanto Hekalu ime, na korandia enchiri, abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko amo nabagaaka bakamoorokera,

English: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Tuambie, unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani? Ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka haya?”
Ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Toteebie nase okobua ki ogokora aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”

English: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Nami nitawauliza swali.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nainche nkobaboria nde inwe ring’ana erimo, monteebie:

English: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”
Kiswahili: Je, ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?”
Ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, niigoro yarwete, gose nase Mwanyabaanto?”

English: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
Kiswahili: Wakahojiana wao kwa wao wakisema, “Kama tukisema, ‘Ulitoka mbinguni,’ atatuuliza, ‘Mbona hamkumwamini?’
Ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakobora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, nigo aratoborie: Naki motamwegenete rende?

English: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”
Kiswahili: Lakini tukisema, ‘Ulitoka kwa wanadamu,’ watu wote watatupiga mawe, kwa sababu wanaamini kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii.”
Ekegusii: Korende toise goteeba: Nase Mwanyabaanto yarwete, abanto bonsi nabatoake amagena; ekiagera banchire ng’a Yohana nomobani orenge.”

English: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.
Kiswahili: Basi wakajibu, “Hatujui ulikotoka.”
Ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Titomanyeti aase yarwete.”

English: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.”

English: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kuwaambia watu mfano huu: “Mtu mmoja alipanda shamba la mizabibu, akalikodisha kwa wakulima fulani, kisha akasafiri kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Agachaaka goteebia abanto omoreng’anio oyo: “Omonto akarema omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akaywatananera abaremi, akagenda orogendo ase engaki entambe.

English: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mavuno ulipofika, akamtuma mtumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili wampe sehemu ya mavuno ya shamba la mizabibu. Lakini wale wakulima wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
Ekegusii: Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde bamoe ensemo yaye y’amatunda y’emesabibu. Abaremi bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.

English: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
Kiswahili: Akamtuma mtumishi mwingine, huyo naye wakampiga, wakamfanyia mambo ya aibu na kumfukuza.
Ekegusii: Naende agatoma omosomba onde; bakamoaka oyio boigo, bakamokora bobe, bakamoseria atari na gento.

English: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.
Kiswahili: Bado akamtuma na mwingine wa tatu, huyu pia wakamjeruhi na kumtupa nje ya shamba.
Ekegusii: Agatoma naende oyo o gatato, bakamoaka chingoma, bakamotuguta isiko.

English: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’
Kiswahili: “Basi yule mwenye shamba la mizabibu akasema, ‘Nifanye nini? Nitamtuma mwanangu mpendwa, huenda yeye watamheshimu.’
Ekegusii: Oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu akabora: Inki ndakore? Nintome omwana one, omwanchwa one, aande ere inabamosike.

English: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’
Kiswahili: “Lakini wale wapangaji walipomwona, wakasemezana wao kwa wao. Wakasema, ‘Huyu ndiye mrithi. Basi na tumuue ili urithi uwe wetu.’
Ekegusii: Korende abaremi baria bagachia komoorora, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando, tomoite gaki, omwando onyare koba oyoito.

English: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakamtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, wakamuua.” “Sasa basi yule mwenye shamba la mizabibu atawafanyia nini wapangaji hawa?
Ekegusii: Bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita. Naki rende oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu arabakore?

English: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”
Kiswahili: Atakuja na kuwaua hao wapangaji, na kuwapa wapangaji wengine hilo shamba la mizabibu.” Watu waliposikia hayo wakasema, “Mungu apishie mbali jambo hili lisitokee!”
Ekegusii: Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.” Bagachia koigwa aya, bakaboora, “Taba bo.”

English: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawakazia macho, akasema, “Basi ni nini maana ya yale yaliyoandikwa: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi, limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni’?
Ekegusii: Akabarigereria, akabora, Engencho yaye ninki, ring’ana eri ririikeire: Rigena abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona?

English: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”
Kiswahili: Kila mtu aangukaye juu ya jiwe hilo atavunjika vipande vipande, lakini yule litakayemwangukia atasagwa kabisa.”
Ekegusii: Kera omonto oragwe igoro ase rigena erio nabunanekane, na ere oyo riragwere narimosenyente.

English: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.
Kiswahili: Walimu wa sheria na viongozi wa makuhani wakatafuta njia ya kumkamata mara moja, kwa sababu walifahamu kwamba amesema mfano huo kwa ajili yao. Lakini waliwaogopa watu.
Ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na abakuani abanene bakarigia komobwata ensa eyio eyio, ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omoreng’anio oria nabwo akobayeena, korende bakairoka abanto.

English: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakawa wanamchunguza na kutuma wapelelezi waliojifanya kuwa wenye haki ili wapate kumtega kwa maneno asemayo, ili wamtie katika uwezo na mamlaka ya mtawala.
Ekegusii: Erio bakamoboera Yeso, bagatoma chirooti, na barabwo bagekora buna nabanyene oboronge, erinde bamobwate ase ogokwana kwaye, bamobeke ase okobua kwa gabana na obogambi bwaye.

English: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wale wapelelezi wakamuuliza, “Mwalimu, tunajua unasema na kufundisha yaliyo kweli wala humpendelei mtu, bali wafundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli.
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ogokwana na kworokereria ayare boronge, gose tori koyiera monto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae.

English: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
Kiswahili: Je, ni halali sisi kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?”

English: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akatambua hila yao, kwa hiyo akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Korende akamanya obong’ainereria bwabo, akabateebia,

English: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”
Kiswahili: “Nionyesheni dinari. Je, sura hii na maandishi haya yaliyoko juu yake ni vya nani?”
Ekegusii: “Inyorokie ebesa! Ekieni eke na amariiko aya nebiang’o?” Bakaboora, “Nebia Kaisari.”

English: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Ni vya Kaisari.” Akawaambia, “Basi mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nabo, ebia Kaisari moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae moe Nyasae.”

English: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.
Kiswahili: Wakashindwa kumkamata kwa yale aliyokuwa amesema hadharani. Nao wakashangazwa mno na majibu yake, wakanyamaza kimya.
Ekegusii: Tibanyaara komobwata ase ring’ana riaye ase obosio bw’abaanto; bagakumia ase okoiraneria kwaye, bagakira.

English: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Masadukayo, wale wasemao kwamba hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza,
Ekegusii: Erio abande ase Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bakoboora ng’a okobokigwa tikori,

English: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.
Kiswahili: “Mwalimu, Mose alituandikia kwamba kama ndugu wa mtu akifa na kumwacha mkewe bila mtoto, basi huyo mtu inampasa amwoe huyo mjane ili amzalie ndugu yake watoto.
Ekegusii: bakamobooria, “Omworokia, Musa natoriikerete ng’a momura omwabo omonto karakwe, na ere nare nomokuungu, korende tari nabana, nagwenerete momura omwabo atware omokungu oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.

English: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwepo ndugu saba. Yule wa kwanza akaoa, akafa bila kuzaa mtoto.
Ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana;

English: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.
Kiswahili: Kisha yule wa pili akamwoa huyo mjane, naye akafa bila mtoto,
Ekegusii: na oyio o kabere akamotwara, na ere agakwa, tatiga bana;

English: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.
Kiswahili: naye wa tatu pia akamwoa. Vivyo hivyo ndugu wote saba wakawa wamemwoa huyo mwanamke, na wote wakafa pasipo yeyote kupata mtoto.
Ekegusii: nonya noyo o gatato akamotwara. Naboigo bonsi batano na babere bagakwa, tibatiga abana.

English: Afterward the woman also died.
Kiswahili: Mwishowe, yule mwanamke naye akafa.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio omokungu oria nere agakwa.

English: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, siku ya ufufuo huyo mwanamke atakuwa mke wa nani, maana aliolewa na ndugu wote saba?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa mokang’o arabe? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”

English: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Katika maisha haya watu huoa na kuolewa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Abana b’ense eye nigo bakonyuoma na konyuomwa;

English: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale ambao wamehesabiwa kwamba wanastahili kupata nafasi katika ulimwengu ule na katika ufufuo wa wafu, hawaoi wala hawaolewi.
Ekegusii: korende barabwo abaabarirwe bagwenerete konyora ense eria, na kobokigwa korwa ase abakuure, tibakonyuoma, gose tibakonyuomwa.

English: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
Kiswahili: Hawa hawawezi kufa tena, kwa maana wao ni kama malaika. Wao ni watoto wa Mungu, kwa sababu ni watoto wa ufufuo.
Ekegusii: Naende tibagokwa, ekiagera nigo barabe koreng’ana buna abamalaika, na abana ba Nyasae bare, ekiagera nabana b’okobokigwa.

English: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
Kiswahili: Hata Mose alidhihirisha kuwa wafu wanafufuka, kwa habari ya kile kichaka kilichokuwa kikiwaka moto bila kuteketea, alipomwita Bwana, ‘Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo.’
Ekegusii: Nonya Musa naorokereretie ng’a abakuure nkobokigwa bare. Ayio nabo ateebete agwo ase ring’ana ri’egetutu, ekero agwatora Omonene ng’a nere Nyasae o Aburaamu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo.

English: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”
Kiswahili: Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali wa walio hai, kwa kuwa kwake wote ni hai.”
Ekegusii: Nabo ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo, ekiagera bonsi nigo bare moyo asare.”

English: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakasema, “Mwalimu, umesema sawasawa kabisa!”
Ekegusii: Abande ase aborokia b’amariiko bakairaneria, “Omworokia, gwakwanire buya.”

English: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo hakuna mtu aliyethubutu kumuuliza maswali tena.
Ekegusii: Naki monto onde taaba okomoboria ring’ana magega ase aya.

English: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Imekuwaje basi wao husema Kristoni Mwana wa Daudi?
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, Naki abanto bagoteeba ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?

English: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
Kiswahili: Daudi mwenyewe anasema katika Kitabu cha Zaburi: “ ‘Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume,
Ekegusii: Naki Daudi nigo agoteeba ase Egetabu gia Zaburi, Omonene agateebia Omonene one, Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio,

English: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
Kiswahili: hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’
Ekegusii: goika mbeeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.

English: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Daudi anamwita yeye ‘Bwana,’ basi atakuwaje mwanawe?”
Ekegusii: Daudi nigo akomoroka Omonene, naki rende aba omwana oye?

English: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,
Kiswahili: Wakati watu wote walikuwa wanamsikiliza, Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi bamotegererete agateebia aborokigwa baye,

English: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;
Kiswahili: “Jihadharini na walimu wa sheria. Wao hupenda kutembea wakiwa wamevaa mavazi marefu, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni. Hupenda kukaa kwenye viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kukaa kwenye nafasi za heshima katika karamu.
Ekegusii: “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariiko, abanchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro, na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega,

English: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
Kiswahili: Wao hula nyumba za wajane, na ili waonekane kuwa wema, wanasali sala ndefu. Watu kama hawa watapata hukumu iliyo kuu sana.”
Ekegusii: abakourereria chinyomba chiababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria basaba ogosaba ogotambe. Abwo nabanyore ekiina kere ekenene kobua.”

English: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipoinua macho yake, aliwaona matajiri wakiweka sadaka zao kwenye sanduku la hazina ya Hekalu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora abanto abanda bakobeeka ebiegwa biabo ase ekebekerero gi’esadaka.

English: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
Kiswahili: Akamwona pia mjane mmoja maskini akiweka humo sarafu mbili ndogo za shaba.
Ekegusii: Akarora omoboraka oyomo omotaka, okobeeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai.

English: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, huyu mjane maskini ameweka humo zaidi ya watu wengine wote.
Ekegusii: Erio akabora, “Ekeene nabateebirie, Omoboraka oyo omotaka obekire ebinge kobua bonsi,

English: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”
Kiswahili: Hawa watu wengine wote wametoa sadaka kutokana na wingi wa mali zao. Lakini huyu mjane ametoa kutokana na umaskini wake vyote alivyokuwa navyo, hata kile alichohitaji ili kuishi.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera aba bonsi babeekire korwa ase obonge bwe chinibo chiabo, korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obeekire ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio.”

English: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wanafunzi wake wakawa wanamwonyesha jinsi Hekalu lilivyopambwa kwa mawe mazuri na kwa vitu vilivyotolewa kuwa sadaka kwa Mungu. Lakini Yesu akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bande barenge gokwana amang’ana igoro ye Hekalu, buna echabeire namagena amaya na ebiegwa, agateeba.

English: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”
Kiswahili: “Kuhusu haya mnayoyaona hapa, wakati utafika ambapo hakuna jiwe moja litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali kila moja litabomolewa.”
Ekegusii: “Aya morooche; amatuko nache ritatigare rigena erimo igoro ase erinde eritatagorwe.”

English: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Mwalimu, mambo haya yatatukia lini? Ni dalili gani itaonyesha kwamba yanakaribia kutendeka?”
Ekegusii: Erio bakamobooria, “Omworokia, aya indi arabe rende? Naende ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi araabe ang’e goikerana?”

English: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Jihadharini msije mkadanganywa. Maana wengi watakuja kwa Jina langu, wakidai, ‘Mimi ndiye,’ na, ‘Wakati umekaribia.’ Msiwafuate.
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Mwerende, timong’ainwa, ekiagera abange nabaache ase erieta riane babore: Ninche ere! Nengaki yaikire! Nabo, timobabwatia abwo.

English: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
Kiswahili: Lakini msikiapo habari za vita na machafuko, msiogope. Kwa maana hayo ni lazima yatokee kwanza, ila ule mwisho hautakuja wakati huo.”
Ekegusii: Na inwe ekero moraigwe amang’ana y’esegi na eburu‐buru, timogoswa, ekiagera aya bori nache kooroka ritang’ani, korende omoerio toraba ang’e.”

English: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia: “Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa jingine, na ufalme mmoja dhidi ya ufalme mwingine.
Ekegusii: Erio akabateebia, “Egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti naborwane noborwoti bonde;

English: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
Kiswahili: Kutakuwa na mitetemeko mikubwa ya ardhi, na njaa kali, na magonjwa ya kuambukiza katika sehemu mbalimbali. Pia kutakuwa na matukio ya kutisha na ishara kuu kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: emetengecho emenene y’ense nebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara, na emechando emenene; nabe namang’ana y’ogoichania, na ebimanyererio ebinene bikorwa igoro.

English: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
Kiswahili: “Lakini kabla yote hayajatokea, watawakamata ninyi na kuwatesa. Watawatia mikononi mwa wakuu wa masinagogi na kuwafunga magerezani. Nanyi mtapelekwa mbele ya wafalme na watawala kwa ajili ya Jina langu.
Ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani ase aya onsi nabababwaate na kobachanda, nabaabaire ase chisinagogi, na ase chichela, namoirwe ase abarwoti na ase abagabana ase engencho y’erieta riane.

English: It will turn out as a testimony for you.
Kiswahili: Hii itawapa nafasi ya kushuhudia.
Ekegusii: Eke nekero kiaino koba kirori.

English: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
Kiswahili: Lakini kusudieni mioyoni mwenu msisumbuke awali kuhusu mtakalosema mbele ya mashtaka.
Ekegusii: Manya gaki ase emioyo yaino, ng’a timorengereria ritang’ani eki morairanerie,

English: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nitawapa maneno na hekima ambayo hakuna hata adui yenu mmoja atakayeweza kushindana nayo wala kuipinga.
Ekegusii: ekiagera inche nimbae chinkwana na obong’aini, abachandi baino batanyare gokana gose koamererania nabio.

English: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.
Kiswahili: Mtasalitiwa hata na wazazi, ndugu, jamaa na marafiki, na baadhi yenu watawaua.
Ekegusii: Na inwe namoruegwe nabaibori baino, na bamura bamino, na eamate yaino, na abasani baino, na barabwo nababeeke abande baino ase ogoitwa.

English: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
Kiswahili: Mtachukiwa na watu wote kwa ajili ya Jina langu.
Ekegusii: Inamogechwe nabaanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.

English: And not a hair of your head will perish.
Kiswahili: Lakini hapatakuwa na unywele mmoja wa kichwa chenu utakaoangamia.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya nagatukia akamo k’emetwe yaino tikagosira.

English: “By your endurance you will win your lives.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuvumilia mtaokoa roho zenu.
Ekegusii: Na ase okoremereria kwaino namonyoore obogima bwaino.

English: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
Kiswahili: “Mtakapoona mji wa Yerusalemu umezungukwa na majeshi, basi fahamuni kwamba kuharibiwa kwake kumekaribia.
Ekegusii: “Korende, komorarore Yerusalemu oetananirwe nemeganda y’abarwani b’esegi, erio momanye ng’a ogosareka kwaye gwaikire ang’e.

English: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo, wale walio Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani, walio mjini Yerusalemu watoke humo, nao wale walioko mashambani wasiingie mjini.
Ekegusii: Erio abare Boyahudi tiga batame gochia ase ebitunwa, na abare ime ase omochie basoke isiko, na abare isiko tibasoa aroro,

English: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu huu utakuwa ni wakati wa adhabu ili kutimiza yote yaliyoandikwa.
Ekegusii: ekiagera aya namatuko egesiomba, onsi ayarigetwe anyare goikerana.

English: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.
Kiswahili: Ole wao wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto siku hizo! Kutakuwa na dhiki kuu katika nchi na ghadhabu juu ya hawa watu.
Ekegusii: Nabe aakong’u ase abare barito na abakogonkia ase amatuko aria, ekiagera nebe emechando emenene igoro ase ense, na endamwamu ase egesaku eke.

English: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
Kiswahili: Wataanguka kwa makali ya upanga, na wengine watachukuliwa kuwa mateka katika mataifa yote. Nao mji wa Yerusalemu utakanyagwa na watu wa Mataifa hadi muda wa hao watu wa Mataifa utimie.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nabagwe ase chinsonga chi’emioro, nabooswe bairwe ase ebisaku bionsi, na Yerusalemu notachwe nabaanto b’Ebisaku, goika ebiro biabo biikeranigwe.

English: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;
Kiswahili: “Kutakuwa na ishara katika jua, mwezi na nyota. Hapa duniani, mataifa yatakuwa katika dhiki na fadhaa kutokana na ngurumo na misukosuko ya bahari.
Ekegusii: “Naende nabibe ebimanyererio ase erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, na ase ense emechando ase ebisaku, nabatang’ang’e ase okoeera kw’enyancha na emerindo yaye.

English: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
Kiswahili: Watu watazimia roho kutokana na hofu kuu na kuyaona yale mambo yanayotokea duniani, kwa maana nguvu za angani zitatikisika.
Ekegusii: Abanto mbakwe ekeondoko na okoiroka kobaganyete ayagoochera ense, ekiagera chinguru chia igoro nachitengechigwe.

English: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo ndipo watakapomwona Mwana wa Adamu akija mawinguni pamoja na uweza na utukufu mkuu.
Ekegusii: Erio nabanyare korora Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ogochaase riire ase chinguru na obonene obonge.

English: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
Kiswahili: Mambo haya yatakapoanza kutendeka, simameni na mkaviinue vichwa vyenu, kwa sababu ukombozi wenu umekaribia.”
Ekegusii: Nabo karachake koba ayio, rigereria igoro, ekiagera okoboorigwa kwaino gwaikire ang’e.”

English: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia mfano huu: “Uangalieni mtini na miti mingine yote.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio, “Rigereria omoko na emete ende yonsi;

English: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
Kiswahili: Inapochipua majani, ninyi wenyewe mnaweza kuona na kutambua wenyewe ya kuwa wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.
Ekegusii: ekero egochaka goseboka mwarora na komanya ase emioyo yaino ng’a egura gura ng’ang’e ere.

English: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yakitukia, mnatambua kwamba Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.
Ekegusii: Nainwe boigo komorarore ayio agokoreka, momanye ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae ng’ang’e bore.

English: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
Kiswahili: “Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.
Ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi aikeranire.

English: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
Kiswahili: Mbingu na nchi zitapita, lakini maneno yangu hayatapita kamwe.”
Ekegusii: Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake.

English: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
Kiswahili: “Jihadharini mioyo yenu isije ikalemewa na anasa, ulevi na fadhaa za maisha haya, nayo siku ile ikawakuta ninyi bila kutazamia kama vile mtego unasavyo.
Ekegusii: “Nabo mwerende chinkoro chiaino tichicha koengerwa nokoria bobe na ogotinda, na okwerosia kw’obogima obo, rituko riria ribachere mobosokano, buna omoeto okobwata.

English: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile mtego unasavyo, ndivyo siku hiyo itakavyowapata wanadamu wote waishio katika uso wa dunia yote.
Ekegusii: Naki naboigo eranyaare goochera abanto bonsi abamenyete igoro ase ense yonsi.

English: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
Kiswahili: Kesheni daima na mwombe ili mweze kuokoka na yale yote yatakayotokea na kusimama mbele ya Mwana wa Adamu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, renda kera ekero na gosaba, monyoore chinguru chi’ogoeta ase aya onsi araache koba, naende gotenena ase obosio bw’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.”

English: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
Kiswahili: Kila siku Yesu alikuwa akifundisha Hekaluni, na jioni ilipofika, alikwenda zake kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni na kukaa huko usiku kucha.
Ekegusii: Na kera rituko nigo arenge kworokereria Hekalu ime, korende botuko ogenda isiko obeera ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.

English: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
Kiswahili: Nao watu wote walikuja asubuhi na mapema Hekaluni ili kumsikiliza.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakamochiera mambia chuni aria Hekalu ime, erinde banyaare komoigwa.

English: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, iitwayo Pasaka, ilikuwa imekaribia.
Ekegusii: Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, rikorokwa Epasaka, rigaika.

English: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wanatafuta njia ya kumuua Yesu, kwa sababu waliwaogopa watu.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakarigia enchera y’okomoita, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto.

English: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.
Kiswahili: Shetani akamwingia Yuda, aliyeitwa Iskariote, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili.
Ekegusii: Saitani agasoa Yudasi okorokwa Iskariota. Yudasi nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.

English: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.
Kiswahili: Yuda akaenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani na kwa maafisa wa walinzi wa Hekalu, akazungumza nao jinsi ambavyo angeweza kumsaliti Yesu.
Ekegusii: Akagenda agakwana nabakuani abanene na abatang’ani b’abarendi buna aranyare komobeeka ase amaboko abo.

English: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.
Kiswahili: Wakafurahi na wakakubaliana kumpa fedha.
Ekegusii: Bakagoka bakabwatana nere komoa chiropia.

English: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.
Kiswahili: Naye akakubali, akaanza kutafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti Yesu kwao, wakati ambapo hakuna umati wa watu.
Ekegusii: Agancha, akarigia ribaga akomoruera ase bare emeganda etaiyo.

English: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.
Kiswahili: Basi ikawadia siku ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, siku ambayo mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka huchinjwa.
Ekegusii: Rituko ri’Emegati etabekiri memera rigaika, eri’emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka egwenerete konyenywa.

English: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akawatuma Petro na Yohana, akisema, “Nendeni mkatuandalie chakula cha Pasaka ili tuweze kuila.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatoma Petero na Yohana, akabora, “Genda motoroiserie Epasaka, erinde toyerie.”

English: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Unataka tukuandalie wapi?”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng’ai origetie toyeroiserie?”

English: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Tazameni, mtakapokuwa mkiingia mjini, mtakutana na mwanaume amebeba mtungi wa maji. Mfuateni mpaka kwenye nyumba atakayoingia.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rora, ekero mwasoire omochie, namoumerane nomosaacha obogoretie enyongo ere namaache; momotunyane goika enyomba agosoa,

English: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
Kiswahili: Nanyi mwambieni mwenye nyumba, ‘Mwalimu anauliza: Kiko wapi chumba cha wageni, ambamo mimi na wanafunzi wangu tutakula Pasaka?’
Ekegusii: moteebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia nkoboria are: Ng’ai enyomba y’abageni ere, inyare koriera Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?

English: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”
Kiswahili: Atawaonyesha chumba kikubwa ghorofani, kikiwa kimepambwa vizuri. Andaeni humo.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oria naboorokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo karoisirie; agwo moariganie.”

English: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
Kiswahili: Wakaenda, nao wakakuta kila kitu kama Yesu alivyowaambia. Hivyo wakaiandaa Pasaka.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda, bakanyora buna abateebetie, bakaarigania Epasaka.

English: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.
Kiswahili: Wakati ulipowadia, Yesu akaketi mezani pamoja na wale mitume wake.
Ekegusii: Erio ensa egachia goika ang’e, agaikaransa amo nabatomwa.

English: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia, “Nimetamani sana kuila Pasaka hii pamoja nanyi kabla ya kuteswa kwangu.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ninganetie mono koria Epasaka eye amo nainwe ritang’ani ntarachaandwa,

English: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, nawaambia, sitaila tena Pasaka mpaka itakapotimizwa katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera nabateebirie, tinkoyeria naende goika yaikeranigwe ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,
Kiswahili: Akiisha kukichukua kikombe, akashukuru, akasema, “Chukueni hiki mnywe wote.
Ekegusii: Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabora, “Bogoria eke, mosaange inwe ase inwe;

English: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nawaambia tangu sasa sitakunywa tena katika uzao wa mzabibu, hadi Ufalme wa Mungu utakapokuja.”
Ekegusii: naki nabateebirie, korwa bono tinkonywa okwama kw’omosabibu goika oborwoti bwa Nyasae boche.”

English: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega, na kuwapa, akisema, “Huu ni mwili wangu unaotolewa kwa ajili yenu. Fanyeni hivi kwa ukumbusho wangu.”
Ekegusii: Akabogoria omogati, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akayosamunyora, akabaa, akabora, “Oyo nomobere one orurwe ase engencho yaino. Kora iga ase okong’inyora.”

English: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo baada ya kula, akakitwaa kikombe, akisema, “Kikombe hiki ni agano jipya katika damu yangu, imwagikayo kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo akabogoria egekombe magega ase okoria, akabora, “Egekombe eke nokobwatana okoyia ase amanyinga aane, aitekire ase engencho yaino.

English: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.
Kiswahili: Lakini mkono wake huyo atakayenisaliti uko hapa mezani pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Korende rigereria, okoboko kwaye ere oyokondua nigo kore amo nainche ase emesa.

English: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”
Kiswahili: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama ilivyokusudiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu huyo amsalitiye.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna yachiigetwe; korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okomorua!”

English: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.
Kiswahili: Wakaanza kuulizana wenyewe ni nani miongoni mwao angeweza kufanya jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, gose ning’o ase bare orakore ring’ana eri.

English: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.
Kiswahili: Pia yakazuka mabishano katikati ya wanafunzi kwamba ni nani aliyeonekana kuwa mkuu kuliko wote miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Gokaba okoamererania ase egati yabo, gose ning’o ase bare obarirwe koba omonene kobua abande.

English: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wafalme na watu wa Mataifa huwatawala watu kwa nguvu. Nao wenye mamlaka juu yao hujiita ‘Wafadhili.’
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Abarwoti b’abaanto b’ebisaku nigo bakogambera abanto; naende abare nokobua igoro ase bare barokwa Abakori Abaya.

English: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi msifanane nao. Bali yeye aliye mkuu kuliko wote miongoni mwenu, inampasa kuwa kama yeye aliye mdogo wa wote, naye atawalaye na awe kama yeye ahudumuye.
Ekegusii: Korende ase more inwe taibo, otatiga oyore omonene oino nabe buna oyore omoke; na ere oyokobatang’ana nabe buna omokoreri abande.

English: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.
Kiswahili: Kwani ni nani aliye mkuu? Ni yule aketiye mezani au ni yule ahudumuye? Si ni yule aliyekaa mezani? Lakini mimi niko miongoni mwenu kama yule ahudumuye.
Ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore omonene, noyoikaransete ase endagera, gose noyogokorera? Tari ere oyogoikaransa ase endagera? Korende inche nigo inde ase egati yaino buna omokoreri.

English: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mmekuwa pamoja nami katika majaribu yangu.
Ekegusii: “Inwe ninwe mwabeire mogendererete amo nainche ase ogoteemwa kwane,

English: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
Kiswahili: Nami kama Baba yangu alivyonipa ufalme, kadhalika mimi nami ninawapa ninyi,
Ekegusii: na inche nabaeire inwe oborwoti buna Tata ang’ete,

English: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”
Kiswahili: ili mpate kula na kunywa mezani pangu katika karamu ya ufalme wangu, na kukaa katika viti vya enzi, mkihukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.”
Ekegusii: monyaare koria na konywa ase emesa yane ase oborwoti bwane, na goikaransa ase ebirogo bi’obonene, na kogambia abanto b’ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.”

English: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Simoni, Simoni, sikiliza, Shetani ameomba kuwapepeta ninyi wote kama ngano.
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Simioni, Simioni, rora Saitani nabarigetie abaire anyaare kobasoonga buna engano,

English: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nimekuombea wewe Simoni ili imani yako isishindwe, nawe ukiisha kunirudia, uwaimarishe ndugu zako.”
Ekegusii: korende nagosabeire, erinde okwegena kwao tikoera, na aye gokwaonchokire, obeeke abamiino chinguru.”

English: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”
Kiswahili: Petro akajibu, “Bwana, niko tayari kwenda pamoja nawe gerezani na hata kifoni.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omonene nigo inde ang’e kogenda amo naye echela, nonya nase ogokwa.”

English: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Ninakuambia Petro, kabla jogoo hajawika usiku wa leo, utakana mara tatu kwamba hunijui mimi.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Nagotebirie Petero, reero etuoni etarabuga nonkane ara gatato ng’a tomanyeti.”

English: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, “Nilipowatuma bila mfuko, wala mkoba, wala viatu, mlipungukiwa na kitu chochote?” Wakajibu, “La, hatukupungukiwa na kitu chochote.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Inee! Ekero nabatomete motari nebimoya, ne chisaaro, na ebikoroto, imwaremeretwe na gento?” Bakamoiraneria, “Yaya”.

English: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Lakini sasa, aliye na mfuko na auchukue, na aliye na mkoba vivyo hivyo. Naye asiye na upanga, auze joho lake anunue mmoja.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Korende bono oyore nekemoya akebogorie, na esaro boigo, na ere oyotari nomoyio o birende aoonie eganchwa yaye, agore oyomo.

English: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu, nawaambia, andiko hili lazima litimizwe juu yangu, kwamba, ‘Alihesabiwa pamoja na wakosaji’; kwa kweli yaliyoandikwa kunihusu mimi hayana budi kutimizwa.”
Ekegusii: Naki nabateebirie, eriarigetwe ndigwenerete goikeranigwa ase ’nde. Ere nigo abareranetigwe amo nabasaria, ekiagera ayarigetwe igoro ase ’nde aikeranigwe.”

English: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Bwana, tazama hapa kuna panga mbili.” Akawajibu, “Inatosha.”
Ekegusii: Bagateeba, “Omonene, rora ntore nemeyio ya birende ebere aa.” Akabateebia, “Nabo aisanire.”

English: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akatoka, akaenda kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni kama ilivyokuwa kawaida yake, nao wanafunzi wake wakamfuata.
Ekegusii: Agasooka, akagenda goika egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, buna engencho yaye yarenge, na aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.

English: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”
Kiswahili: Walipofika huko, akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Ombeni, msije mkaingia majaribuni.”
Ekegusii: Agachia goika aase aria akabateebia, “Saba, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.”

English: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,
Kiswahili: Akajitenga nao kama umbali wa kutupa jiwe, akapiga magoti, akaomba
Ekegusii: Ageatanana korwa ase bare, ekerengo gi’okoruta rigena, akabeeka amaru inse, agasaba,

English: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”
Kiswahili: akisema, “Baba, kama ni mapenzi yako, niondolee kikombe hiki. Lakini si kama nipendavyo, bali mapenzi yako yatendeke.”
Ekegusii: ogoteeba, “Tata, koranche, onduserie egekombe eke, korende tari buna ndigetie inche, korende buna origetie aye, bikoreke.”

English: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.
Kiswahili: Malaika kutoka mbinguni akamtokea, akamtia nguvu.
Ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoorokera korwa, igoro, akamobeka chinguru.

English: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
Kiswahili: Naye akiwa katika maumivu makuu, akaomba kwa bidii, nalo jasho lake likawa kama matone ya damu yakidondoka ardhini.
Ekegusii: Na ere ekiagera arenge nomoichano mono, akamenta ogosaba nomokia; ebigeri biaye bikaba buna amatoima y’amanyinga agoiteka inse.

English: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuomba, akawarudia wanafunzi wake akawakuta wamelala, wakiwa wamechoka kutokana na huzuni.
Ekegusii: Agachia koimoka korwa ase ogosaba agachiera aborokigwa baye, akabanyora bararire ase ogoichana.

English: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”
Kiswahili: Naye akawauliza, “Mbona mmelala? Amkeni, mwombe ili msije mkaingia majaribuni.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki mwararire? Boka, mosabe, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.”

English: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa bado anazungumza, umati mkubwa wa watu ukaja. Uliongozwa na Yuda, ambaye alikuwa mmoja wa wale wanafunzi Kumi na Wawili. Akamkaribia Yesu ili ambusu.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, rora, omoganda ogaacha, na oria okorokwa Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, obatang’aine. Ere akamoika Yeso ang’e komonyunyunta.

English: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Yuda, je, unamsaliti Mwana wa Adamu kwa busu?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Yudasi, nkomorua ore Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ase okomonyunyunta?”

English: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”
Kiswahili: Wafuasi wa Yesu walipoona yale yaliyokuwa yanakaribia kutokea, wakasema, “Bwana, tuwakatekate kwa panga zetu?”
Ekegusii: Na abwo barenge amo nere bagachia korora ayakorigia koba, bakaboora, “Omonene, inatorwane nomoyio o birende?”

English: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao akampiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu kwa upanga, akamkata sikio la kuume.
Ekegusii: Oyomo obo agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto gw’okorio.

English: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akasema, “Acheni!” Akaligusa lile sikio la yule mtu na kumponya.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tiga tokora igo.” Akamokuna ogoto, akamogwenia.

English: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wale viongozi wa makuhani, maafisa wa walinzi wa Hekalu, pamoja na wazee waliokuwa wamekuja kumkamata, “Mmekuja na panga na marungu, kana kwamba mimi ni mnyangʼanyi?
Ekegusii: Yeso agateebia abakuani abanene, na abanene b’abarendi be Hekalu, na abagaaka, baria bamoocherete, “Iga mwachire nemeyio ya birende ne chinungu buna mogochiera omouri.

English: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”
Kiswahili: Siku kwa siku nilikuwa pamoja nanyi Hekaluni lakini hamkunikamata. Lakini hii ni saa yenu, wakati giza linatawala!”
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge amo nainwe ase Hekalu kera rituko timwaramborete amaboko mombwate, korende bono ensa eye neyaino, ekero omosunte okogamba.”

English: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakamkamata Yesu, wakamchukua, wakaenda naye mpaka nyumbani kwa kuhani mkuu. Lakini Petro akafuata kwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoira, bakagenda nere nyomba ime ase Omokuani omonene. Na Petero akamotunyana korwa magega ore egeka.

English: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuwasha moto katikati ya ua na kuketi pamoja, Petro naye akaketi pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Bagachia gouta omorero egati y’egoora, bagaikaransa amo, na Petero agaikaransa ase egati yabo.

English: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”
Kiswahili: Mtumishi mmoja wa kike akamwona kwa mwanga wa moto akiwa ameketi pale. Akamtazama sana, akasema, “Huyu mtu pia alikuwa pamoja na Yesu!”
Ekegusii: Erio omoiseke oyomo akamorora oikaransete ang’e nomorero, akamobeta amaiso akabora, “Oyo nere igo arenge amo nere.”

English: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akakana, akasema, “Ewe mwanamke, hata simjui!”
Ekegusii: Agakana, akabora, “Omokungu, timomanyeti.”

English: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”
Kiswahili: Baadaye kidogo, mtu mwingine alimwona Petro akasema, “Wewe pia ni mmoja wao!” Petro akajibu, “Wewe mtu, mimi sio mmoja wao!”
Ekegusii: Naende ake omonto onde akamorora, akabora, “Aye noyomo obo ore.” Petero akabora, “Omonto oyo, tai inche.”

English: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda wa kama saa moja hivi, mtu mwingine akazidi kusisitiza, “Kwa hakika huyu mtu naye alikuwa pamoja na Yesu, kwa maana yeye pia ni Mgalilaya.”
Ekegusii: Na magega y’ensa eyemo, omonto onde akabetereria mono, akabora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge amo nere, ekiagera nere n’Omogalili.”

English: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
Kiswahili: Petro akajibu, “Wewe mtu, mimi sijui unalosema!” Wakati huo huo, akiwa bado anazungumza, jogoo akawika.
Ekegusii: Petero akabora, “Omonto oyo, timanyeti eri ogokwana.” Erio kegima kagokwana, etuoni ekabuga.

English: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”
Kiswahili: Naye Bwana akageuka, akamtazama Petro. Ndipo Petro akakumbuka lile neno ambalo Bwana alimwambia: “Kabla jogoo hajawika leo, utanikana mara tatu.”
Ekegusii: Omonene akeonchora, akarigereria Petero. Petero akainyora ring’ana ri’Omonene, buna amoteebetie, “Reero, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga nonkaane ara gatato.”

English: He went out, and wept bitterly.
Kiswahili: Naye akaenda nje, akalia kwa majonzi.
Ekegusii: Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo.

English: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.
Kiswahili: Watu waliokuwa wanamlinda Yesu wakaanza kumdhihaki na kumpiga.
Ekegusii: Abanto baria babwatete Yeso, bakamosekereria, na komoaka.

English: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
Kiswahili: Wakamfunga kitambaa machoni na kumuuliza, “Tabiri! Tuambie ni nani aliyekupiga?”
Ekegusii: Bakamotuba amaiso, bakamobooria, “Bana! Ning’o ogoaka?”

English: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.
Kiswahili: Wakaendelea kumtukana kwa matusi mengi.
Ekegusii: Bakamokwana bobe amang’ana ande amange ay’okomorama.

English: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka, baraza la wazee wa watu, yaani viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria, wakakutana pamoja, naye Yesu akaletwa mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaaka b’abaanto, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko bagasangererekana amo, bakamorenta ase ekegambero kiabo, bakoboora,

English: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Kama wewe ndiye Kristo, tuambie.” Yesu akawajibu, “Hata nikiwaambia hamtaamini.
Ekegusii: “Onye aye naye Kristo, toteebie.” Korende akabateebia, “Ninsa kobateebia, timokonyaara gwancha;

English: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.
Kiswahili: Nami nikiwauliza swali, hamtanijibu.
Ekegusii: naende nimbaboria, timokong’iraneria.

English: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kuanzia sasa, Mwana wa Adamu ataketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu Mwenye Nguvu.”
Ekegusii: Korende korwa bono Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto naikaranse ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.”

English: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”
Kiswahili: Wote wakauliza, “Wewe basi ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu?” Yeye akawajibu, “Ninyi mwasema kwamba mimi ndiye.”
Ekegusii: Bakaboora bonsi, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabateebia, “Inwe mwateebire ng’a ninche ere.”

English: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”
Kiswahili: Kisha wakasema, “Tuna haja gani tena ya ushahidi zaidi? Tumesikia wenyewe kutoka kinywani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Bakaboora, “Mborori ki torigetie goetania obo? Naki intwe abanyene twaigure amang’ana korwa ase omonwa oye.”

English: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
Kiswahili: Kisha umati wote wa watu ukainuka na kumpeleka Yesu kwa Pilato.
Ekegusii: Bakaimoka bonsi, bakaira Yeso ase Pilato.

English: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”
Kiswahili: Nao wakaanza kumshtaki wakisema: “Tumemwona huyu mtu akipotosha taifa letu, akiwazuia watu wasilipe kodi kwa Kaisari na kujiita kuwa yeye ni Kristo, mfalme.”
Ekegusii: Bagachaaka komosoera, bakobora, “Twanyorire omonto oyo oonchoire ense yaito, otokanirie titoa Kaisari ebango, okobora ng’a ere omonyene nere Kristo omorwoti.”

English: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”
Kiswahili: Basi Pilato akamuuliza Yesu, “Wewe ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi?” Yesu akajibu, “Wewe wasema.”
Ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria, “Naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?” Yeso akaimoiraneria, “Naye gwateebire.”

English: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
Kiswahili: Pilato akawaambia viongozi wa makuhani na watu wote waliokuwepo, “Sioni sababu ya kutosha kumshtaki mtu huyu!”
Ekegusii: Pilato agateebia abakuani abanene na emeganda, “Inche tindochi komocha konde ase omonto oyo.”

English: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wao wakakazana kusema, “Anawachochea watu kwa mafundisho yake katika Uyahudi yote, tangu Galilaya alikoanzia, hadi sehemu hii!”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobetereria, bakaboora, “Oburukanirie abanto, goetera ase amorokererio aye ase Boyahudi yonsi, korwa Galili ase achaakerete na goika bono oikire aiga.”

English: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
Kiswahili: Pilato aliposikia hayo akauliza, “Huyu mtu ni Mgalilaya?”
Ekegusii: Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana eri, akaboria, “Omonto oyo n’Omogalili?”

English: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
Kiswahili: Alipofahamu kwamba Yesu alikuwa chini ya mamlaka ya Herode, akampeleka kwa Herode, ambaye wakati huo alikuwa pia Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Agachia komanya ng’a nigo are inse ase obogambi bwa Herode, akamotoma gochia ase Herode. Na Herode omonyene nigo arenge Yerusalemu ase amatuko aria.

English: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.
Kiswahili: Herode alipomwona Yesu alifurahi sana, kwa sababu kwa muda mrefu alikuwa amesikia mambo mengi kumhusu yeye. Pia alitarajia kumwona akifanya miujiza kadha wa kadha.
Ekegusii: Ekero Herode achia korora Yeso akagokigwa mono, ekiagera korwa kare nigo arigetie komoorora, ekiagera aigwete chinkuma chiaye, naende nigo asemeretie korora egekone kegokorwa nere.

English: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
Kiswahili: Herode akamuuliza maswali mengi, lakini Yesu hakumjibu lolote.
Ekegusii: Akamoboria amaborio ase engaki entambe, korende Yeso tamoiraneria ing’ana rinde rionsi.

English: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwepo wakitoa mashtaka yao kwa nguvu sana.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bagatenena, bakomosoera ne chinguru.

English: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
Kiswahili: Herode na askari wake wakamdhihaki Yesu na kumfanyia mzaha. Wakamvika vazi zuri sana, wakamrudisha kwa Pilato.
Ekegusii: Herode na abarwani baye bakamochaya, bakamosekereria, bakamobekera chianga chingiya mono, akamoirania ase Pilato.

English: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo, Herode na Pilato wakawa marafiki; kabla ya jambo hili walikuwa na uadui kati yao.
Ekegusii: Erio Herode na Pilato abwo barenge ababisa agwo ritang’ani bakabwatana korwa rituko riria bakaba abasani.

English: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
Kiswahili: Basi Pilato akawaita pamoja viongozi wa makuhani, viongozi wengine na watu,
Ekegusii: Pilato akarangeria amo abakuani abanene, na abagaambi, na abanto,

English: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.
Kiswahili: akawaambia, “Ninyi mlimleta huyu mtu kwangu kana kwamba ni mtu anayewachochea watu ili waasi. Nimemhoji mbele yenu nami nimeona hakuna msingi wowote wa mashtaka yenu dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: akabateebia, “Mwandeterete omonto oyo, buna oyo baonchoire abanto; naunirie amang’ana aye ase amasio aino, na tindochi bobe ase omonto oyo ase aria mwamosoerete,

English: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
Kiswahili: Wala Herode hakumwona na kosa lolote, ndiyo sababu amemrudisha kwetu. Kama mnavyoona, mtu huyu hakufanya jambo lolote linalostahili kifo.
Ekegusii: nonya n’Herode tarochi, ekiagera omoiranirie gocha ase tore. Rora, ere takorete gento kemogwenerete akwe.

English: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitaamuru apigwe mijeledi na kumwachia.”
Ekegusii: Erio konamoakire, nimosibore.”

English: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ilikuwa lazima kuwafungulia mfungwa mmoja wakati wa Sikukuu.
Ekegusii: Bono igo yamogwenerete kobasiborera omonto oyomo ekero kie rituko rinene.

English: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wote wakapiga kelele kwa pamoja, “Mwondoe mtu huyo! Tufungulie Baraba!”
Ekegusii: Bagaaka eriogi bonsi amo, bakaboora, “Morusie oyo, tosiborere Baraba!”

English: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.
Kiswahili: (Baraba alikuwa amefungwa gerezani kwa sababu ya maasi yaliyokuwa yametokea mjini, na kwa ajili ya uuaji.)
Ekegusii: (Ere nomonto obegetwe ase echela ase engencho y’eriomana riakoregete ase omochie ime, na ase oboiti.)

English: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
Kiswahili: Pilato, akitaka kumwachia Yesu, akasema nao tena.
Ekegusii: Nabo eria kabere Pilato agakwana nabarabwo, akarigia gosibora Yeso.

English: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”
Kiswahili: Lakini wao wakaendelea kupiga kelele wakisema, “Msulubishe! Msulubishe!”
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Mobambe, mobambe!”

English: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
Kiswahili: Kwa mara ya tatu, Pilato akawauliza, “Kwani amefanya kosa gani huyu mtu? Sikuona kwake sababu yoyote inayostahili adhabu ya kifo. Kwa hiyo nitaamuru apigwe mijeledi, na kisha nitamwachia.”
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia eria gatato, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete oyo? Tindochi nonya ne ring’ana erimo asare rigwenerete akwe. Ase igo, nanchire komoaka na komosibora.”

English: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wakazidi kupiga kelele kwa nguvu zaidi, wakidai kwamba Yesu asulubiwe. Hivyo, kelele zao zikashinda.
Ekegusii: Korende bakagenderera kobora ase eriogi rinene ng’a goika abambwe. Eriogi riabo rikabua.

English: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Pilato akatoa hukumu kwamba madai yao yatimizwe.
Ekegusii: Pilato akanacha amang’ana akoreke buna barigetie.

English: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
Kiswahili: Akamfungua yule mtu aliyekuwa amefungwa gerezani kwa kuhusika katika uasi dhidi ya serikali na mauaji. Akamkabidhi Yesu mikononi mwao, wamfanyie watakavyo.
Ekegusii: Agasibora ere oyobegetwe echela ase eriomana na oboiti, oyobarigetie; akarua Yeso ase bare buna ogwancha kwabo kwarenge.

English: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakienda naye, wakamkamata mtu mmoja aitwaye Simoni mwenyeji wa Kirene, aliyekuwa anapita zake kuingia mjini kutoka shambani. Wakambebesha msalaba, wakamlazimisha auchukue nyuma ya Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bagachia komoira, bakabwata Simioni Omokurene, oyorenge korwa borabu, bakamotweka omosalaba, ayobogorie magega ya Yeso.

English: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
Kiswahili: Idadi kubwa ya watu wakamfuata Yesu, wakiwamo wanawake waliokuwa wakimlilia na kumwombolezea.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bw’abaanto okamotunyana, na abakungu baare kweaka‐aka, na komweng’erereria.

English: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawageukia, akawaambia, “Enyi binti za Yerusalemu, msinililie mimi bali jililieni ninyi wenyewe na watoto wenu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabeonchorera, akabora, “Abaiseke ba Yerusalemu, timondeera inche, korende ereere inwe abanyene, na abana baino.

English: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wakati utafika mtakaposema, ‘Wamebarikiwa wanawake tasa, ambao matumbo yao hayakuzaa, wala matiti yao hayakunyonyesha!’
Ekegusii: Naki amatuko naache ekero abanto barateebe: Mbasesenirie abare abagomba, ne chinda chitaiboreti, ne chimbeere chitana kogonkwa!

English: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’
Kiswahili: Ndipo “ ‘wataiambia milima, “Tuangukieni!” na vilima, “Tufunikeni!” ’
Ekegusii: Erio nabachaake goteebia ebitunwa: Togwere, na ebigoro: Totube.

English: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama wamefanya hivi kwa mti mbichi, kwa mti mkavu itakuwaje?”
Ekegusii: Onye bagokora aya ekero omote ore omobese, naki eraabe ekero bwomire?”

English: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
Kiswahili: Watu wengine wawili wahalifu, walipelekwa pamoja na Yesu ili wakasulubiwe.
Ekegusii: Abande babere abasaria bakairwa, baitwe amo nere.

English: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
Kiswahili: Walipofika mahali paitwapo Fuvu la Kichwa, hapo ndipo walipomsulubisha Yesu pamoja na hao wahalifu, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wake wa kushoto.
Ekegusii: Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Ekeore, bakamobamba aroro, na baria abasaria, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko gw’okobee.

English: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Baba, wasamehe, kwa maana hawajui walitendalo!” Wakagawana nguo zake kwa kupiga kura.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tata, baabere, ekiagera tibamanyeti eke bagokora.” Bakagabana chianga chiaye, bagachiakera obomera.

English: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”
Kiswahili: Watu wakasimama hapo wakimwangalia, nao viongozi wa Wayahudi wakamdhihaki wakisema, “Aliokoa wengine! Ajiokoe mwenyewe basi, kama yeye ndiye Kristo wa Mungu, Mteule wake.”
Ekegusii: Abanto bagatenena, bakarigereria. Na barabwo abanyene bakamokorera echeche, bakaboora, “Natooretie abande, tiga etoorie ere omonyene, onye oyo nere Kristo o Nyasae, Omochore oye.”

English: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
Kiswahili: Askari nao wakaja, wakamdhihaki. Wakamletea siki ili anywe,
Ekegusii: Abarwani boigo bakamosekereria, bakamochiera, bakamoa chinkama,

English: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”
Kiswahili: na wakamwambia, “Kama wewe ni Mfalme wa Wayahudi, jiokoe mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: bakaboora, “Onye aye naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi, etoorie.”

English: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
Kiswahili: Kwenye msalaba juu ya kichwa chake, kulikuwa na maandishi haya: Huyu ndiye Mfalme wa Wayahudi. Maandishi haya yalikuwa yameandikwa kwa lugha za Kiyunani, Kilatini na Kiebrania.
Ekegusii: Igoro asare nkiarengeo ekemanyererio keriikire ase omonwa bw’Ekegiriki, na Ekerumi, na Ekeiberania “OYO NERE OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”

English: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa wale wahalifu waliosulubiwa pamoja naye akamtukana, akasema: “Wewe si ndiye Kristo? Jiokoe mwenyewe na utuokoe na sisi.”
Ekegusii: Oyomo bwa baria abasaria baabambetwe akamorama, akabora, “Inee! Tari aye Kristo? Etoorie aye omonyene, naintwe ototoorie.”

English: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
Kiswahili: Lakini yule mhalifu mwingine akamkemea mwenzake, akasema, “Je, wewe humwogopi Mungu, wakati uko kwenye adhabu iyo hiyo?
Ekegusii: Oyo o kabere akamokania, akabora, “Aye tori komoiroka nonya Nyasae, aye kore ase ekiina keria keria?

English: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”
Kiswahili: Sisi tumehukumiwa kwa haki kwa kuwa tunapata tunayostahili kwa ajili ya matendo yetu. Lakini huyu mtu hajafanya kosa lolote.”
Ekegusii: Intwe ekeene mboronge; ekiagera twaeirwe eng’eria ya boronge y’ogokora gwaito, korende oyo takoreti gento kende kebe.”

English: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akasema, “Yesu, unikumbuke utakapokuja katika Ufalme wako.”
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia Yeso, “Yeso, ong’inyore ekero ogocha ase oborwoti bwao!”

English: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, nakuambia, leo hii utakuwa pamoja nami Paradiso.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Reero nobe amo nainche Paradiso.”

English: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
