Kiswahili: Ilikuwa kama saa sita mchana, nalo giza likafunika nchi yote hadi saa tisa,
Ekegusii: Bono nigo chiarenge ang’e chinsa isano nemo, omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda,

English: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu jua liliacha kutoa nuru. Pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili.
Ekegusii: ekero omobaso orimire. Na egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka gati‐gati.

English: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.
Kiswahili: Yesu akapaza sauti yake akasema, “Baba, mikononi mwako naikabidhi roho yangu.” Baada ya kusema haya, akakata roho.
Ekegusii: Yeso akarera ase eriogi rinene, akabora, “Tata, ase amaboko ao nabekire omoika one!” Magega gakwanire aya agatweka mo.

English: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”
Kiswahili: Yule jemadari alipoona yaliyotukia, akamsifu Mungu, akasema, “Hakika, mtu huyu alikuwa mwenye haki.”
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana agachia korora aya, agatogia Nyasae, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge omonyene oboronge.”

English: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.
Kiswahili: Watu wote waliokuwa wamekusanyika hapo kushuhudia tukio hili walipoyaona hayo, wakapigapiga vifua vyao kwa huzuni na kwenda zao.
Ekegusii: Naende emeganda yonsi, abasangererekanete korora aya, kobachia korora ayakoreka, bakairana chinka chiabo, bakweaka ebikuba.

English: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale wote waliomfahamu, pamoja na wale wanawake waliokuwa wamemfuata kutoka Galilaya, walisimama kwa mbali wakiyatazama mambo haya.
Ekegusii: Abasani baye bonsi na abakungu abamotunyanete korwa Galili, bagatenenera are, bakarora ayio.

English: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
Kiswahili: Basi kulikuwa na mtu mmoja mwema na mwenye haki, jina lake Yosefu. Yeye alikuwa mjumbe wa Baraza la Wayahudi,
Ekegusii: Rora, narengeo omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yusufu, omonto bw’Arimathaya, omochie o Boyahudi, ere nomonto bw’ekegambero kiabo, omonto omuya, naende omooronge.

English: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.
Kiswahili: lakini yeye hakuwa amekubaliana na maamuzi na vitendo vya viongozi wenzake. Huyu alikuwa mwenyeji wa Arimathaya huko Uyahudi, naye alikuwa anaungojea Ufalme wa Mungu kwa matarajio makubwa.
Ekegusii: Ere tanchete amang’ana abo, nonya nogokora kwabo, nigo aganyete oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

English: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
Kiswahili: Yosefu alikwenda kwa Pilato, akaomba apewe mwili wa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyo agachiera Pilato, akamosaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.

English: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.
Kiswahili: Akaushusha kutoka msalabani, akaufunga katika kitambaa cha kitani safi, na kuuweka katika kaburi lililochongwa kwenye mwamba, ambalo halikuwa limezikiwa mtu mwingine bado.
Ekegusii: Akayoikia, akayoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani, akayobeeka ase oboina bwabaachetwe ase egetare, aase monto onde atana kobekwa.

English: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa Siku ya Maandalizi, nayo Sabato ilikuwa karibu kuanza.
Ekegusii: Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Okwearigania, na Esabato egachaaka gosoa.

English: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.
Kiswahili: Wale wanawake waliokuwa wamekuja pamoja na Yesu wakimfuata kutoka Galilaya wakamfuata Yosefu, wakaliona kaburi na jinsi mwili wa Yesu ulivyolazwa.
Ekegusii: Abakungu abaachete amo nere korwa Galili, nigo batunyanete korwa magega, bakarigereria oboina na buna omobere oye bwareretigwe.

English: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakarudi nyumbani, wakaandaa manukato na marhamu ya kuupaka huo mwili. Lakini wakapumzika siku ya Sabato kama ilivyoamriwa.
Ekegusii: Bakairana, bakaroisia amanukato na amaguta ye rimisu rigiya. Ne rituko ri’Esabato bagatimoka buna yachiigetwe.

English: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.
Kiswahili: Mnamo siku ya kwanza ya juma, alfajiri na mapema, wale wanawake walichukua yale manukato waliyokuwa wameyaandaa, wakaenda kaburini.
Ekegusii: Korende rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, kobogokiamoka, abakungu baria bakagenda ase oboina, bakaira amanukato aria, ayababegete ang’e.

English: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
Kiswahili: Wakakuta lile jiwe limevingirishwa kutoka kwenye kaburi,
Ekegusii: Bakanyoora rigena riria riatigerigwe korwa ase oboina,

English: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.
Kiswahili: lakini walipoingia ndani, hawakuuona mwili wa Bwana Yesu.
Ekegusii: korende ekero basoa, tibanyoora omobere Omonene Yeso.

English: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wanashangaa juu ya jambo hili, ghafula watu wawili waliokuwa wamevaa mavazi yanayongʼaa kama umeme wakasimama karibu nao.
Ekegusii: Ekero baichanete ase aya, rora, abanto babere bagatenena ang’e ase bare, beboyetie chianga chikomeka‐meka.

English: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?
Kiswahili: Wale wanawake, wakiwa na hofu, wakainamisha nyuso zao mpaka chini. Lakini wale watu wakawaambia, “Kwa nini mnamtafuta aliye hai miongoni mwa wafu?
Ekegusii: Abakungu baria bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagatung’ama inse. Abanto baria bakabateebia, “Nase ki mokorigia oyore moyo ase ebitondo? Tari aa, korende obokire.

English: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,
Kiswahili: Hayuko hapa; amefufuka! Kumbukeni alivyowaambia alipokuwa bado yuko pamoja nanyi huko Galilaya kwamba:
Ekegusii: Inyora buna abatebeetie ekero arenge Galili,

English: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”
Kiswahili: ‘Ilikuwa lazima Mwana wa Adamu atiwe mikononi mwa watu wenye dhambi na waovu ili asulubiwe, na siku ya tatu afufuke.’ ”
Ekegusii: ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto abekwe ase amaboko y’abanto abanyene ebibe, na kobambwa, na ase rituko ria gatato nabooke.”

English: They remembered his words,
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakayakumbuka maneno ya Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bakainyora amang’ana aye.

English: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.
Kiswahili: Waliporudi kutoka huko kaburini, wakawaeleza wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja pamoja na wengine wote mambo haya yote.
Ekegusii: Bakairana korwa ase oboina, bagateebia baria ikomi nomo na baria abande bonsi amang’ana ayio onsi.

English: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.
Kiswahili: Basi Maria Magdalene, Yoana, na Maria mama yake Yakobo, pamoja na wanawake wengine waliofuatana nao ndio waliwaelezea mitume habari hizi.
Ekegusii: Na baria bateebetie abatomwa amang’ana aya nabwo aba: Mariamu Magidalena, na Yoana, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na abakungu bande abarenge amo nabarabwo.

English: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakuwasadiki hao wanawake, kwa sababu maneno yao yalionekana kama upuzi.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana abo akarorekana koba ng’a naya bosa ase bare, gose tibayancha.

English: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Petro akainuka na kukimbia kwenda kule kaburini. Alipoinama kuchungulia, akaona vile vitambaa vya kitani, ila hakuona kitu kingine. Naye akaenda zake akijiuliza nini kilichotokea.
Ekegusii: Korende Petero akaimoka, akagenda bwango ase oboina, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime, akarora ebitambaa biria bireo bioka, akairana bwoye, okumetie ase aya akorekire.

English: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Ikawa siku iyo hiyo, wanafunzi wawili wa Yesu walikuwa njiani wakienda kijiji kilichoitwa Emau, yapata maili saba kutoka Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Rituko riria babere ase bare nkogenda baare ase omochie okorokwa Emau, orenge oboare korwa Yerusalemu ang’e chimaeli isano na isato.

English: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa wakizungumza wao kwa wao kuhusu mambo yote yaliyotukia.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo ngokwana baare barabwo ase barabwo igoro ase aya onsi akorekire.

English: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakizungumza na kujadiliana, Yesu mwenyewe akaja akatembea pamoja nao,
Ekegusii: Kabagokwana na koborania, Yeso omonyene agaika ang’e, akagenda amo nabarabwo.

English: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
Kiswahili: lakini macho yao yakazuiliwa ili wasimtambue.
Ekegusii: Amaiso abo agatubwa, tibanyara komomanya.

English: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza, “Ni mambo gani haya mnayozungumza wakati mnatembea?” Wakasimama, nyuso zao zikionyesha huzuni.
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki aya mokoborania ase orogendo rwaino?” Bagatenena, baichanete.

English: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao, aliyeitwa Kleopa, akamuuliza, “Je, wewe ndiye peke yako mgeni huku Yerusalemu ambaye hufahamu mambo yaliyotukia humo siku hizi?”
Ekegusii: Oyomo obo, erieta riaye Kiliopa, akamoiraneria, “Inee! Naye bweka ore omogeni ase Yerusalemu, otamanyeti ayare ime yaye amatuko aya?”

English: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;
Kiswahili: Akawauliza, “Mambo gani?” Wakamjibu, “Mambo ya Yesu wa Nazareti. Yeye alikuwa nabii, mwenye uwezo mkuu katika maneno yake na matendo yake, mbele za Mungu na mbele ya wanadamu wote.
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki?” Bakamoteebia, “Amang’ana a Yeso Omonazareti, oyorenge omobani, omonyene chinguru ase ogokora na ase ring’ana, ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase abanto bonsi;

English: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na viongozi wetu walimtoa ahukumiwe kufa, nao wakamsulubisha.
Ekegusii: na buna abakuani abanene na abanene baito bamoruete ase ekiina ki’ogokwa, bakamobaamba.

English: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
Kiswahili: Lakini tulikuwa tumetegemea kwamba yeye ndiye angelikomboa Israeli. Zaidi ya hayo, leo ni siku ya tatu tangu mambo haya yatokee.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe nigo twasemeretie ng’a nere oraboorie Abaisraeli. Kobua aya onsi, reero nerituko ria gatato korwa ekero ayio akorekanete.

English: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;
Kiswahili: Isitoshe, baadhi ya wanawake katika kundi letu wametushtusha. Walikwenda kaburini leo alfajiri,
Ekegusii: Naende abakungu bande ba seito nigo batoichanetie. Abwo barenge ase oboina mambia,

English: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
Kiswahili: lakini hawakuukuta mwili wake. Walirudi wakasema wameona maono ya malaika ambao waliwaambia kwamba Yesu yu hai.
Ekegusii: na ekero batanyorete omobere oye, bakairana, bakaboora ng’a baorokeirwe nabamalaika ababatebetie ng’a moyo are.

English: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”
Kiswahili: Kisha baadhi ya wenzetu walikwenda kaburini wakalikuta kama vile wale wanawake walivyokuwa wamesema, lakini yeye hawakumwona.”
Ekegusii: Naende abande abarenge amo naintwe bakagenda ase oboina, bakarora buna abakungu bateebete, korende ere tibamorora.”

English: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi ni wajinga kiasi gani, nanyi ni wazito mioyoni mwenu kuamini mambo yote yaliyonenwa na manabii!
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, “Inwe abanto abariri, nabanyene chinkoro chinyoro ase okwegena onsi aya ababani bateebete.

English: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
Kiswahili: Je, haikumpasa Kristokuteswa kwa njia hiyo na kisha aingie katika utukufu wake?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Tiyamogwenerete Kristo konyora emechando eye ritang’ani atarasoa ase obonene bwaye?”

English: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
Kiswahili: Naye akianzia na Sheria ya Mose na Manabii wote, akawafafanulia jinsi Maandiko yalivyosema kumhusu yeye.
Ekegusii: Agachaakera korwa Musa na ababani bonsi akabateebereria korwa ase amariiko onsi amang’ana ariikire igoro yaye.

English: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.
Kiswahili: Nao walipokaribia kile kijiji walichokuwa wakienda, Yesu akawa kama anaendelea mbele.
Ekegusii: Bagaika omochie oria ase baare kogenda, na ere agekora buna nigo arigetie kobaetania.

English: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao wakamsihi sana akae nao, wakisema, “Kaa hapa nasi, kwa maana sasa ni jioni na usiku unaingia.” Basi akaingia ndani kukaa nao.
Ekegusii: Bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Kabe amo naintwe, ekiagera bwairire, na omobaso oerire bono.” Agasoa koba amo nabarabwo.

English: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa mezani pamoja nao, akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega, akaanza kuwagawia.
Ekegusii: Ekero aikaransire amo nabarabwo koragera, akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akabaa.

English: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.
Kiswahili: Ndipo macho yao yakafumbuliwa, nao wakamtambua, naye akatoweka machoni pao. Hawakumwona tena.
Ekegusii: Erio amaiso abo akaramokigwa, bakamomanya; na agwo kegima agasira, tarorekana ase bare.

English: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
Kiswahili: Wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Je, mioyo yetu haikuwakawaka kwa furaha ndani yetu alipokuwa anazungumza nasi njiani na kutufafanulia Maandiko?”
Ekegusii: Bakaboorania, “Inee! Emioyo yaito tiyarenge gwoka ekero aba ngokwana are naintwe inchera na gotworokereria amariiko?”

English: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,
Kiswahili: Wakaondoka mara, wakarudi Yerusalemu. Wakawakuta wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja na wale waliokuwa pamoja nao, wamekusanyika
Ekegusii: Bakaimoka ensa eria eria, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakanyoora baria ikomi nomo basangererekanete, na baria abarenge amo nabarabwo,

English: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
Kiswahili: wakisema, “Ni kweli! Bwana amefufuka, naye amemtokea Simoni.”
Ekegusii: bakaboora, “Ekeene, Omonene obokire, oorokeire Simioni.”

English: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
Kiswahili: Kisha wale wanafunzi wawili wakaeleza yaliyotukia njiani na jinsi walivyomtambua Yesu alipoumega mkate.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bakabateebia aya akoreka inchera, buna emanyekania ase bare ase ogosamunyora omogati.

English: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa bado wanazungumza hayo, Yesu mwenyewe akasimama katikati yao, akasema, “Amani iwe nanyi!”
Ekegusii: Ekero baare gokwana iga, Yeso omonyene agatenena egati yabo, akabateebia, “Omorembe obe ase more!”

English: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
Kiswahili: Wakashtuka na kuogopa wakidhani kwamba wameona mzuka.
Ekegusii: Bakegosa, bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari barorire.

English: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawauliza, “Kwa nini mnaogopa? Kwa nini mna shaka mioyoni mwenu?
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki mogoichana? Naende inaki ogosiereria kwaimokire ase chinkoro chiaino?

English: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
Kiswahili: Tazameni mikono yangu na miguu yangu, mwone kuwa ni mimi hasa. Niguseni mwone; kwa maana mzuka hauna nyama na mifupa, kama mnionavyo kuwa navyo.”
Ekegusii: Rora amaboko aane na amagoro aane, ng’a ninche omonyene; mbwata‐bwate, morore, ekiagera rirengari tiriri nomobere na amauga buna mondoche inche inde nabio.”

English: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
Kiswahili: Aliposema haya, akawaonyesha mikono na miguu yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero akoorire gokwana aya akaborokia amaboko aye na amagoro aye.

English: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
Kiswahili: Wakashindwa kuamini kwa ajili ya furaha na mshangao waliokuwa nao. Akawauliza, “Mna chakula chochote hapa?”
Ekegusii: Ekero bataregena ase engencho y’omogooko, na ogokumia, akababoria, “More na gento mokoria aa?”

English: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
Kiswahili: Wakampa kipande cha samaki aliyeokwa,
Ekegusii: Bakamoa egesamunye gi’enswe gesambire na obooke boke.

English: He took them, and ate in front of them.
Kiswahili: naye akakichukua na kukila mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Akabibogoria, akabiria ase amaiso abo.

English: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Haya ndiyo yale niliyowaambia nilipokuwa bado niko pamoja nanyi, kwamba yote yaliyoandikwa kunihusu mimi katika Sheria ya Mose, Manabii na Zaburi hayana budi kutimizwa.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Aya naro amang’ana aane nare kona‐kobateebia ekero narenge amo nainwe, buna onsi agwenerete goikeranigwa, ayarigetwe igoro yane ase amachiiko a Musa, na ase ababani, na ase Zaburi.”

English: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akafungua fahamu zao ili waweze kuyaelewa Maandiko.
Ekegusii: Erio akaigora chinkoro chiabo, banyare komanya amariiko.

English: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Haya ndiyo yaliyoandikwa: Kristo atateswa na siku ya tatu atafufuka kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naboigo yarigetwe ng’a nemogwenerete Kristo gochandwa, na koboka korwa ase abakuure ase rituko ria gatato;

English: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Toba na msamaha wa dhambi zitatangaziwa mataifa yote kupitia jina lake kuanzia Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: na ebisaku bionsi mbiranderigwe ase erieta riaye okoonchoka na okorusigwa kw’ebibe, gochaakera Yerusalemu.

English: You are witnesses of these things.
Kiswahili: Ninyi ni mashahidi wa mambo haya.
Ekegusii: Inwe mbirori b’amang’ana aya.

English: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”
Kiswahili: “Tazama nitawatumia ahadi ya Baba yangu; lakini kaeni humu mjini hadi mtakapovikwa uwezo utokao juu.”
Ekegusii: Rigereria, nintome ase more aya Tata abarierete eira, korende ikaransa ase omochie oyo Yerusalemu goika mobekwe chinguru chikorwa igoro.”

English: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
Kiswahili: Akiisha kuwaongoza mpaka kwenye viunga vya Bethania, akainua mikono yake juu na kuwabariki.
Ekegusii: Akabatang’ana gochia isiko goika Bethania; akaimokia amaboko aye, akabasesenia.

English: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa anawabariki, akawaacha, akachukuliwa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Kabasesenirie ageatanana korwa ase bare akabogorigwa gochia igoro.

English: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
Kiswahili: Kisha wakamwabudu na kurudi Yerusalemu wakiwa wamejawa na furaha kuu.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bakamosasiima, bakairana Yerusalemu nomogooko omonene;

English: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
Kiswahili: Nao wakadumu ndani ya Hekalu wakimtukuza Mungu. Amen.
Ekegusii: bakaba botambe ime ase Hekalu, bakomotogia Nyasae.

English: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
Kiswahili: Hapo mwanzo alikuwako Neno, huyo Neno alikuwa pamoja na Mungu, naye Neno alikuwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Agwo omochakano ndiarengeo Ring’ana, ne Ring’ana nigo riarenge amo na Nyasae, na rirorio Ring’ana nigo riarenge Nyasae.

English: The same was in the beginning with God.
Kiswahili: Tangu mwanzo huyo Neno alikuwa pamoja na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Oyio agwo omochakano nigo arenge amo na Nyasae.

English: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
Kiswahili: Vitu vyote viliumbwa kwa yeye, wala pasipo yeye hakuna chochote kilichoumbwa ambacho kimeumbwa.
Ekegusii: Goetera ase are ebinto bionsi bigakoreka; gento kende gionsi tigiakoregete otatiga goetera ase are.

English: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
Kiswahili: Ndani yake ndimo ulimokuwa uzima na huo uzima ulikuwa nuru ya watu.
Ekegusii: Ime yaye nao bwarenge obogima; na obogima obwo nigo bwarenge oborabu ase mwanyabaanto.

English: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
Kiswahili: Nuru hungʼaa gizani nalo giza halikuishinda.
Ekegusii: Noro omobaso obarire ase omosunte, erio omosunte toyorimia.

English: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.
Kiswahili: Alikuja mtu mmoja aliyetumwa kutoka kwa Mungu, jina lake Yohana.
Ekegusii: Narengeo omonto oyomo, otometwe korwa ase Nyasae, erieta riaye Yohana.

English: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
Kiswahili: Alikuja kama shahidi apate kuishuhudia hiyo nuru, ili kwa kupitia kwake watu wote waweze kuamini.
Ekegusii: Oyo nigo achete abe kirori, erinde aorokie omobaso, bonsi banyare kwegena goetera asere.

English: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
Kiswahili: Yeye mwenyewe hakuwa ile nuru, bali alikuja kuishuhudia hiyo nuru.
Ekegusii: Oyio tarenge omobaso oria, korende nigo achete aorokie omobaso.

English: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
Kiswahili: Kwamba nuru halisi, imwangaziayo kila mtu ilikuwa inakuja ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: Omobaso bw’ekeene, oria okobarera kera omonto, ngocha orenge ase ense.

English: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
Kiswahili: Huyo Neno alikuwako ulimwenguni na ingawa ulimwengu uliumbwa kupitia kwake, haukumtambua.
Ekegusii: Nao arenge ase ense ime, ense egatongwa goetera asere, na abanto b’ense tibamomanya.

English: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
Kiswahili: Alikuja kwa walio wake, lakini wao hawakumpokea.
Ekegusii: Agaacha ase abaye, na barabwo abaare abaye tibamwancha.

English: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
Kiswahili: Bali wote waliompokea, aliwapa uwezo wa kufanyika watoto wa Mungu, ndio wale waliaminio jina lake.
Ekegusii: Korende bonsi abamoitabete na kwegena erieta riaye, akabaa okobua babe abana ba Nyasae.

English: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
Kiswahili: Hawa ndio wasiozaliwa kwa damu, wala kwa mapenzi ya mwili au kwa mapenzi ya mtu, bali kwa mapenzi ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abwo baiboirwe, tari korwa ase amanyinga a Mwanyabaanto, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omobere, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omonto, korende nigo baiboirwe na Nyasae.

English: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
Kiswahili: Neno alifanyika mwili, akakaa miongoni mwetu, nasi tukauona utukufu wake, utukufu kama wa Mwana pekee atokaye kwa Baba, amejaa neema na kweli.
Ekegusii: Na rirorio Ring’ana rigakoreka koba omobere, akamenya ase egati yaito. Tokarora obonene bwaye, obonene buna obw’Omwana omomoima oruure ase Tata, oichire nobuya na ekeene.

English: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
Kiswahili: Yohana alishuhudia habari zake, akapaza sauti, akisema, “Huyu ndiye yule niliyewaambia kwamba, ‘Yeye ajaye baada yangu ni mkuu kuniliko mimi, kwa kuwa alikuwepo kabla yangu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yohana agakwana igoro yaye, agaaka egeturi, akabora, “Oyo nere nateebete igoro yaye ng’a: Oyorache magega yane nigo are omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani ase ’nde.”

English: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na ukamilifu wake, sisi sote tumepokea neema juu ya neema.
Ekegusii: Na ase oboikeranu bwaye intwe twensi twanyorire obuya igoro ase obuya.

English: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa sheria ilitolewa kwa mkono wa Mose, lakini neema na kweli imekuja kupitia Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki amachiiko arwerete ase amaboko a Musa, obuya na ekeene nigo biachete goetera ase Yeso Kristo.

English: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Mungu wakati wowote, ila ni Mungu Mwana pekee, aliye kifuani mwa Baba ndiye ambaye amemdhihirisha.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi; Omwana omomoima ore ase egekuba gia Tata, nere omoorokirie.

English: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
Kiswahili: Huu ndio ushuhuda wa Yohana wakati Wayahudi walipowatuma makuhani na Walawi kutoka Yerusalemu kumuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Naende obo nabwo oborori bwa Yohana, ekero Abayahudi batomete abakuani na Abalawi korwa Yerusalemu bamoboorie, “Aye naye ng’o?”

English: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
Kiswahili: Yohana alikiri waziwazi pasipo kuficha akasema, “Mimi si Kristo.”
Ekegusii: Ere akaorokia, takaana, agateeba, “Inche tari Kristo.”

English: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Wewe ni nani basi? Je, wewe ni Eliya?” Yeye akajibu, “Hapana, mimi siye.” “Je, wewe ni yule Nabii?” Akajibu, “Hapana.”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Naki rende? Naye Elija?” Akaboora, “Inche tindi ere.” “Aye naye omobani oria?” Akairaneria, “Yaya.”

English: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakasema, “Basi tuambie wewe ni nani ili tupate jibu la kuwapelekea wale waliotutuma. Wewe wasemaje juu yako mwenyewe?”
Ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Naye ng’o rende? Toe abatotomete okoiraneria. Naki ogweteeba?”

English: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
Kiswahili: Akawajibu kwa maneno ya nabii Isaya, akisema, “Mimi ni sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani, ‘Yanyoosheni mapito ya Bwana.’ ”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Inche neriogi ri’oyo ogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Rongeyia enchera y’Omonene, buna omobani Isaya ateebete.”

English: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
Kiswahili: Basi walikuwa wametumwa watu kutoka kwa Mafarisayo
Ekegusii: Na barabwo abatometwe nigo barwete ase Abafarisai.

English: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
Kiswahili: wakamuuliza, “Kama wewe si Kristo, wala si Eliya na wala si yule Nabii, kwa nini basi unabatiza?”
Ekegusii: Bakaboria Yohana, “Naki rende okobatisa, onye aye tori Kristo, gose Elija, gose omobani?”

English: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
Kiswahili: Yohana akawajibu, “Mimi ninabatiza kwa maji, lakini katikati yenu yupo mtu msiyemjua.
Ekegusii: Yohana akabairaneria, “Inche nigo nkobatisa ase amaache, korende egati yaino nateneineo oyomotamanyeti inwe.

English: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
Kiswahili: Yeye ajaye baada yangu, sistahili hata kufungua kamba za viatu vyake.”
Ekegusii: Nere oyoraache magega yane, inche tinyisaini nyesibore enuga y’egekoroto kiaye.”

English: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
Kiswahili: Mambo haya yote yalitukia huko Bethania, ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani, mahali Yohana alipokuwa akibatiza.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo akoregete Bethania ng’umbu ya Yorodani, aase Yohana arenge kobatisera.

English: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata, Yohana alimwona Yesu akimjia akasema, “Tazama, Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu aichukuaye dhambi ya ulimwengu!
Ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Yohana akarora Yeso ogocha asaare, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae, oyokorusia ebibe bi’ense!

English: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye yule niliyewaambia kwamba, ‘Mtu anakuja baada yangu ambaye ni mkuu kuniliko mimi, kwa kuwa alikuwepo kabla yangu.’
Ekegusii: Oyo nere naare goteeba igoro yaye: Ngocha are omonto magega yane oyore omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani ase ’nde.

English: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe sikumfahamu, lakini sababu ya kuja nikibatiza kwa maji ni ili yeye apate kufunuliwa kwa Israeli.”
Ekegusii: Inche tinamomanyete; korende aorokigwe ase Abaisraeli, nabo ase ayio ngacha na kobatisa ase amaache.”

English: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yohana akatoa ushuhuda huu: “Nilimwona Roho akishuka kutoka mbinguni kama hua, akakaa juu yake.
Ekegusii: Naende Yohana akaorokia, “Narorire Omoika ogoika korwa igoro buna riruma, okobeera igoro asare.

English: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
Kiswahili: Mimi nisingemtambua, lakini yeye aliyenituma nibatize kwa maji alikuwa ameniambia, ‘Yule mtu utakayemwona Roho akimshukia na kukaa juu yake, huyo ndiye atakayebatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu.’
Ekegusii: Na inche tinamomanya, korende ere oyontomete kobatisa ase amaache, oyio nere ontebetie: Ere oyo oranyare korora Omoika ogoika na goikaransa igoro yaye, oyio nere okobatisa n’Omoika Omochenu.

English: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
Kiswahili: Mimi mwenyewe nimeona jambo hili na ninashuhudia kuwa huyu ndiye Mwana wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Na inche narorire, naende naorokirie ng’a oyo nere Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata, Yohana alikuwa huko tena pamoja na wanafunzi wake wawili.
Ekegusii: Naende rituko riare kobwatia Yohana nigo arenge oteneine amo na babere baborokigwa baye.

English: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
Kiswahili: Alipomwona Yesu akipita, akasema, “Tazama, Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu!”
Ekegusii: Akarigereria Yeso ogotaara, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae!”

English: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wawili walipomsikia Yohana akisema haya, wakamfuata Yesu.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baria babere bakamoigwa ogoteeba aya, bagatunyana Yeso.

English: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akageuka, akawaona wakimfuata akawauliza, “Mnataka nini?” Wakamwambia, “Rabi,” (maana yake Mwalimu), “Unaishi wapi?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akabarora bakomotunyana, akababoria, “Ninki mokorigia?” Bakamoteebia, “Rabii” (okoonchorwa kwaye Omworokia), “nga’i omenyete?”

English: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Njooni, nanyi mtapaona!” Hivyo wakaenda na kupaona mahali alipokuwa anaishi, wakakaa naye siku ile, kwa kuwa ilikuwa yapata saa kumi.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inchuo morore.” Bagaacha, bakarora aase amenyete, bakaba nere rituko riria; nigo chiarenge ang’e chinsa ikomi.

English: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
Kiswahili: Andrea nduguye Simoni Petro, alikuwa mmoja wa wale wawili waliosikia yale Yohana aliyokuwa amesema, naye ndiye alimfuata Yesu.
Ekegusii: Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni Petero, nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria babere baigwete Yohana, na gotunyana Yeso.

English: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
Kiswahili: Kitu cha kwanza Andrea alichofanya ni kumtafuta Simoni nduguye na kumwambia, “Tumemwona Masiya” (yaani, Kristo).
Ekegusii: Oyo akanyora ritang’ani Simioni momura omwabo omonyene, akamoteebia, “Twanyorire Masihi” (okoonchorwa kwaye Kristo).

English: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
Kiswahili: Naye akamleta kwa Yesu. Yesu akamwangalia na kusema, “Wewe ni Simoni mwana wa Yohana. Utaitwa Kefa” (ambalo limetafsiriwa Petro).
Ekegusii: Akamoira ase Yeso. Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Aye Simioni, omwana o Yohana, norokwe Kefa” (okoonchorwa kwaye Petero, gose rigena).

English: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata Yesu aliamua kwenda Galilaya. Akamkuta Filipo, akamwambia, “Nifuate.”
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia Yeso akarigia koimoka kogenda Galili. Akanyoora Filipo, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana.”

English: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
Kiswahili: Basi Filipo alikuwa mwenyeji wa Bethsaida, mji alikotoka Andrea na Petro.
Ekegusii: Nere Filipo nigo arenge omonto o Bethisaida, omochie bw’Anderea na Petero.

English: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
Kiswahili: Filipo naye akamkuta Nathanaeli na kumwambia, “Tumemwona yeye ambaye Mose aliandika habari zake katika Sheria na ambaye pia manabii waliandika kumhusu, yaani, Yesu wa Nazareti, mwana wa Yosefu.”
Ekegusii: Filipo akanyoora Natanaeli, akamoteebia, “Twanyorire ere oyo amang’ana aye arigetwe na Musa ase amachiiko, naende nababani, Yeso omwana o Yusufu, omonto o Nazareti.”

English: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
Kiswahili: Nathanaeli akauliza, “Nazareti! Je, kitu chochote chema chaweza kutoka Nazareti?” Filipo akamwambia, “Njoo uone.”
Ekegusii: Natanaeli akamobooria, “Egento ekiya nakenyare korwa Nazareti?” Filipo akamoteebia, “Inchuo orore.”

English: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomwona Nathanaeli anakaribia, akanena habari zake akasema, “Tazama huyu ni Mwisraeli kweli kweli; hana hila ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akarora Natanaeli ogocha asare, agakwana igoro yaye, “Rora oyo n’Omoisraeli ekeene, otari nobong’ainereria ime yaye!”

English: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
Kiswahili: Nathanaeli akamuuliza, “Umenifahamuje?” Yesu akamjibu, “Nilikuona ulipokuwa bado uko chini ya mtini, kabla hata Filipo hajakuita.”
Ekegusii: Natanaeli akamobooria, “Ing’ai kwamanyera?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ritang’ani Filipo atarakorangeria, ekero kwarenge inse ase omoko, konya nakororire.”

English: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
Kiswahili: Nathanaeli akamwambia, “Rabi, wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu! Wewe ni Mfalme wa Israeli!”
Ekegusii: Natanaeli akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae, naye Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.”

English: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Unaamini kwa kuwa nilikuambia nilikuona ulipokuwa bado uko chini ya mtini? Basi utaona mambo makuu zaidi kuliko hilo.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Kwegenire ekiagera nagoteebia ng’a nakorooche inse ase omoko? Norore amang’ana amanene kobua aya.”

English: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, ninyi mtaona mbingu ikifunguka na malaika wa Mungu wakipanda na kushuka juu ya Mwana wa Adamu.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Inamorore igoro akoigoka, na abamalaika ba Nyasae bakoriina na goika igoro ase Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.”

English: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
Kiswahili: Siku ya tatu kulikuwa na arusi katika mji wa Kana ya Galilaya, naye mama yake Yesu alikuwepo pale.
Ekegusii: Naende rituko ria gatato ’yarenge enyangi agwo Kana ya Galili, na ng’ina Yeso nao arenge.

English: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
Kiswahili: Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wamealikwa arusini pia.
Ekegusii: Yeso nere konya orangeriigwe amo naborokigwa baye ase enyangi.

English: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
Kiswahili: Divai ilipokwisha, mama yake Yesu akamwambia, “Wameishiwa na divai.”
Ekegusii: Goika edivai egachia kobaremera, ng’ina Yeso akamoteebia, “Tibari nedivai.”

English: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mwanamke, nina nini nawe? Saa yangu haijawadia.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omong’ina, inki inche nde naye? Ensa yane teraika.”

English: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
Kiswahili: Mama yake akawaambia wale watumishi, “Lolote atakalowaambia, fanyeni.”
Ekegusii: Ng’ina agateebia abasomba, “Rinde rionsi arabateebie, morikore.”

English: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
Kiswahili: Basi ilikuwepo mitungi sita ya kuhifadhia maji iliyotengenezwa kwa mawe kwa ajili ya kujitakasa kwa desturi ya Kiyahudi; kila mtungi ungeweza kuchukua vipipa viwili au vitatu.
Ekegusii: Nchiarenge aroro chinsiongo isano nemo chi’amagena, chiabekire aroro ase engencho y’ogwesiberia kw’Abayahudi; kera eyemo nigo yarenge ekerengo gie chigalani emerongo ebere gose etato.

English: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia wale watumishi, “Ijazeni hiyo mitungi maji.” Nao wakaijaza ile mitungi mpaka juu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ichoria chinsiongo echi amaache.” Bagachiichoria goika igoro.

English: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaambia, “Sasa choteni hayo maji kidogo, mpelekeeni mkuu wa meza.” Hivyo wakachota, wakampelekea.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, Bono taoria, “moirere omonene bw’omoyega.” Bakamoirera.

English: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
Kiswahili: Yule mkuu wa meza akayaonja yale maji ambayo yalikuwa yamebadilika kuwa divai. Hakujua divai hiyo ilikotoka ingawa wale watumishi waliochota yale maji wao walifahamu. Basi akamwita bwana arusi kando
Ekegusii: Omonene bw’omoyega agachia koigwa amaache aria aonchoretwe koba edivai, tamanya aase yarwa, (korende abasomba ababuuchete amaache mbamanyete). Omonene oria bw’omoyega akarangeria omonywomi,

English: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
Kiswahili: akamwambia, “Watu wote hutoa kwanza divai nzuri, kisha huleta ile divai hafifu wageni wakisha kunywa vya kutosha, lakini wewe umeiweka ile nzuri kupita zote mpaka sasa.”
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Kera omonto ritang’ani nigo agochaaka nedivai ere engiya, goika abanto kobanyuure mono, erio orenta eyetari engiya; aye gese nigo ogachete edivai engiya goika bono.”

English: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
Kiswahili: Huu, ndio uliokuwa muujiza wa kwanza Yesu aliofanya Kana ya Galilaya. Hivyo Yesu alidhihirisha utukufu wake, nao wanafunzi wake wakamwamini.
Ekegusii: Oyio noro omochakano bw’ebikone Yeso akorete, agwo Kana ya Galili, akaorokia obonene bwaye; aborokigwa baye bakamwegena.

English: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hayo, Yesu pamoja na mama yake, ndugu zake na wanafunzi wake, walishuka mpaka Kapernaumu, wakakaa huko siku chache.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya akagenda goika Kapernaumu, ere, na ng’ina, na abamwabo, na aborokigwa baye; bakamenya aroro amatuko amake.

English: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Ilipokaribia wakati wa Pasaka ya Wayahudi, Yesu alipanda kwenda Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Naende Epasaka y’Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang’e, na Yeso agatiira goika Yerusalemu.

English: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
Kiswahili: Huko Hekaluni aliwakuta watu wakiuza ngʼombe, kondoo na njiwa, nao wengine walikuwa wameketi mezani wakibadili fedha.
Ekegusii: Akarora ase Hekalu ime abanto barenge koonia chiombe, ne ching’ondi, na amaruma, na abaare koonchora chifeta, baikaransete.

English: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.
Kiswahili: Akatengeneza mjeledi kutokana na kamba, akawafukuza wote kutoka kwenye eneo la Hekalu, pamoja na kondoo na ngʼombe. Akazipindua meza za wale wabadili fedha na kuzimwaga fedha zao.
Ekegusii: Agakora omocharichi bwe chingori, akabasokia bonsi korwa ase Hekalu, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe; agaitera chitaabu chiabo abaare koonchora chitaabu, akaonchorana chimesa chiabo.

English: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
Kiswahili: Akawaambia wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa, “Waondoeni hapa! Mnathubutuje kuifanya nyumba ya Baba yangu kuwa mahali pa biashara?”
Ekegusii: Naende akabateebia baria barenge koonia amaruma, “Rusia ebinto ebi aa timokora enyomba ya Tata one koba enyomba y’okoonchoreria.”

English: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakakumbuka kuwa imeandikwa: “Wivu wa nyumba yako utanila.”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng’a neriikire, “Risemi ri’enyomba yao riandire.”

English: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakamuuliza, “Unaweza kutuonyesha ishara gani ili kuthibitisha mamlaka uliyo nayo ya kufanya mambo haya?”
Ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamobooria, “Ngekone ki ogotworokia, ng’a nore noboronge bw’ogokora aya?”

English: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Libomoeni hili Hekalu, nami nitalijenga tena kwa siku tatu!”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tagora Hekalu eye, na inche ase amatuko atato ninyetenenie.”

English: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
Kiswahili: Wale Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Hekalu hili lilijengwa kwa muda wa miaka arobaini na sita, nawe wasema utalijenga kwa siku tatu?”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaboora, “Hekalu eye yaagachetwe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene na etano nomo, na aye oyetenenie ase amatuko atato?”

English: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye Hekalu alilozungumzia ni mwili wake.
Ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akwanete igoro ye Hekalu y’omobere oye.

English: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, wanafunzi wake wakakumbuka yale aliyokuwa amesema. Ndipo wakayaamini Maandiko na yale maneno Yesu aliyokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Nabo ekero abogetigwe korwa ase abakuure aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng’a nigo ateebete ring’ana eri, bakegena ririiko riria, ne ring’ana riria Yeso ateebete.

English: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
Kiswahili: Ikawa Yesu alipokuwa Yerusalemu kwenye Sikukuu ya Pasaka, watu wengi waliona ishara na miujiza aliyokuwa akifanya, wakaamini katika jina lake.
Ekegusii: Goika agachia kobao Yerusalemu ekero ki’Epasaka ase Rituko Rinene, abanto abange bakariegena erieta riaye, kobarorire ebikone arenge gokora.

English: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu hakujiaminisha kwao kwa sababu aliwajua wanadamu wote.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso tegenete ase bare, ekiagera nabamanyete bonsi,

English: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
Kiswahili: Hakuhitaji ushuhuda wa mtu yeyote kuhusu mtu, kwa kuwa alijua yote yaliyokuwa moyoni mwa mtu.
Ekegusii: naende ekiagera tarigetie onde amobere kirori igoro ya Mwanyabaanto; naki ere omonyene amanyete ayare ime ya Mwanyabaanto.

English: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwa na mtu mmoja Farisayo, jina lake Nikodemo, mmoja wa Baraza la Wayahudi lililotawala.
Ekegusii: Narengeo omonto oyomo bw’Abafarisai, erieta riaye Nikodemo, omonene bw’Abayahudi.

English: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
Kiswahili: Huyu alimjia Yesu usiku akamwambia, “Rabi, tunajua kuwa wewe ni mwalimu uliyetumwa na Mungu, kwa maana hakuna mtu awezaye kufanya miujiza hii uifanyayo wewe, kama Mungu hayuko pamoja naye.”
Ekegusii: Oyo nigo achete ase Yeso botuko, akamoteebia, “Rabii twamanyire ng’a nomworokia ore, kwarure ase Nyasae, ekiagera omonto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ebi ogokora aye, otatiga Nyasae abe amo nere.”

English: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, amin nakuambia, hakuna mtu anayeweza kuuona Ufalme wa Mungu kama hajazaliwa mara ya pili.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri eria kabere, takonyara korora oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

English: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
Kiswahili: Nikodemo akauliza, “Awezaje mtu kuzaliwa wakati akiwa mzee? Hakika hawezi kuingia mara ya pili kwenye tumbo la mama yake ili azaliwe!”
Ekegusii: Nikodemo akamobooria, “Naki omonto aranyare koiborwa kabeire omogaka? Nanyaare gosoa enda ya ng’ina eria kabere aiborwe?”

English: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Amin, amin nakuambia, hakuna mtu yeyote anayeweza kuingia Ufalme wa Mungu kama hajazaliwa kwa maji na kwa Roho.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri ase amaache na Omoika, takonyaara gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

English: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
Kiswahili: Mwili huzaa mwili, lakini Roho huzaa roho.
Ekegusii: Ekeiboire ase omobere n’omobere; na ekeiboire ase Omoika n’Omoika.

English: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo usishangae ninapokuambia huna budi ‘kuzaliwa mara ya pili.’
Ekegusii: Tokumia ekiagera nagoteebia: Goika oiborwe naende.

English: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
Kiswahili: Upepo huvuma popote upendapo. Mvumo wake unausikia lakini huwezi ukafahamu utokako wala uendako. Ndivyo ilivyo kwa kila mtu aliyezaliwa na Roho.”
Ekegusii: Embeo nigo ekogusa aase erigetie, na egeturi kiaye nigo ogokeigwa, korende tomanyeti aase ekorwa gose aase ekogenda; naboigo na kera omonto oiboirwe ase Omoika.”

English: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
Kiswahili: Nikodemo akamuuliza, “Mambo haya yanawezekanaje?”
Ekegusii: Nikodemo akamobooria, “Naki aranyare koba aya?”

English: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Wewe ni mwalimu mashuhuri wa Waisraeli, nawe huelewi mambo haya?
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, akamoteebia, “Inee! Aye nomworokia bw’Abaisraeli, na aya toyamanyeti?

English: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin ninakuambia, sisi tunazungumza lile tunalolijua na tunashuhudia lile tuliloliona. Lakini ninyi watu hamkubali ushuhuda wetu.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, nagotebirie: Eri tomanyete nario togokwana, na eri torooche twariorokia; na oborori bwaito timori kobwancha.

English: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
Kiswahili: Nimewaambia mambo ya duniani, nanyi hamkuniamini, mtaniaminije basi nitakapowaambia mambo ya mbinguni?
Ekegusii: Onye nkobateebia amang’ana ense, na inwe timokoyeegena, naki moreegene kondabateebie amang’ana a igoro?

English: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyekwenda mbinguni isipokuwa yeye aliyeshuka kutoka mbinguni, yaani, Mwana wa Adamu.
Ekegusii: Naende monto onde tari ogendete igoro, otatiga ere oyoigete korwa igoro, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.

English: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
Kiswahili: Kama vile Mose alivyomwinua yule nyoka kule jangwani, vivyo hivyo Mwana wa Adamu hana budi kuinuliwa juu.
Ekegusii: Naende buna Musa aimokereretie eng’iti ase erooro, naboigo na Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto goika aimokererigwe igoro;

English: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
Kiswahili: Ili kila mtu amwaminiye awe na uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.”

English: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
Kiswahili: “Kwa maana jinsi hii Mungu aliupenda ulimwengu hata akamtoa Mwanawe wa pekee, ili kila mtu amwaminiye asipotee, bali awe na uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: “Naki Nyasae ayianchete ense, goika akarua Omwana oye omomoima, erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.

English: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu hakumtuma Mwanawe kuuhukumu ulimwengu, bali kupitia kwake ulimwengu upate kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tatomete Omwana oye ase ense agambie ense, korende ense etoorigwe nere.

English: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
Kiswahili: Yeyote amwaminiye hahukumiwi, lakini asiyeamini amekwisha kuhukumiwa, kwa sababu hakuliamini jina la Mwana pekee wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Oyomwegenire takogambigwa oyotegeneti oikire kogambigwa, ekiagera atariegeneti erieta ri’Omwana omomoima o Nyasae.

English: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo hukumu kwamba: Nuru imekuja ulimwenguni, nao watu wakapenda giza kuliko nuru kwa sababu matendo yao ni maovu.
Ekegusii: Na eke nakio ekiina ng’a omobaso ochire ase ense, korende abanto bagancha omosunte kobua omobaso, ekiagera ogokora kwabo kwarenge okobe.

English: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kila atendaye maovu huchukia nuru, wala haji kwenye nuru ili matendo yake maovu yasifichuliwe.
Ekegusii: Naki kera oyogokora amabe nigo agechete omobaso, gose tagocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye tikobaisa koorokigwa.

English: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yule aishiye kwa ukweli huja kwenye nuru, ili ionekane wazi kwamba matendo yake yametendeka katika Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Korende oyogokora ekeene nigo agocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye kororekane ng’a nigo gwakorirwe ase Nyasae.”

English: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu na wanafunzi wake walikwenda katika nchi ya Uyahudi, nao wakakaa huko kwa muda na kubatiza.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso na aborokigwa baye bakagenda goika ense ya Boyahudi. Akabeera aroro amo nabarabwo, akabatisa.

English: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;
Kiswahili: Yohana naye alikuwa akibatiza huko Ainoni karibu na Salimu kwa sababu huko kulikuwa na maji tele. Watu wazima wakamjia huko ili kubatizwa.
Ekegusii: Yohana nere nigo arenge kobatisera aria Ainoni, ang’e na Salimu, ekiagera amaache amange narengeo. Abanto bakamochiera bakabatiswa.

English: for John was not yet thrown into prison.
Kiswahili: (Hii ilikuwa kabla Yohana hajatiwa gerezani).
Ekegusii: Naki Yohana konya tarabekwa echela.

English: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
Kiswahili: Mashindano yakazuka kati ya baadhi ya wanafunzi wa Yohana na Myahudi mmoja kuhusu suala la desturi ya kunawa kwa utakaso.
Ekegusii: Nabo okoamererania gokaoroka ase egati yaborokigwa ba Yohana na Omoyahudi oyomo ase amang’ana ogwesibia.

English: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwendea Yohana wakamwambia, “Rabi, yule mtu aliyekuwa pamoja nawe ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani, yule uliyeshuhudia habari zake, sasa anabatiza na kila mtu anamwendea!”
Ekegusii: Bagachiera Yohana, bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, ere oyorenge amo naye ng’umbu ya Yorodani, oyio kwaorogetie aye, oyio nao are akobatisa, na abanto bonsi nkomochiera bare.”

English: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
Kiswahili: Yohana akawajibu, “Hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kupata kitu chochote isipokuwa kile tu alichopewa kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omonto takonyara konyora ring’ana rinde rionsi otatiga aegwe korwa igoro.

English: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
Kiswahili: Ninyi wenyewe ni mashahidi wangu kwamba nilisema, ‘Mimi si Kristo, ila nimetumwa nimtangulie.’
Ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwambereire kirori ng’a nateebete: Inche tari Kristo, korende natomirwe imotang’anere.

English: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
Kiswahili: Bibi arusi ni wa bwana arusi. Lakini rafiki yake bwana arusi anayesimama karibu naye na kusikiliza kutoka kwake, hufurahi sana aisikiapo sauti ya bwana arusi. Kwa sababu hii furaha yangu imekamilika.
Ekegusii: Oyore nomoriakari nere omonywomi, korende omong’wansi oye nigo agotenena na komoigwa, ogookera eriogi ri’omonywomi; naboigo omogooko one oikeranire bono.”

English: He must increase, but I must decrease.
Kiswahili: Yeye hana budi kuwa mkuu zaidi na mimi nizidi kuwa mdogo.”
Ekegusii: Ere goika amenteke, korende inche nkee.

English: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
Kiswahili: “Yeye ajaye kutoka juu yu juu ya yote, yeye aliye wa duniani ni wa dunia, naye huzungumza mambo ya duniani. Yeye aliyekuja kutoka mbinguni, yu juu ya yote.
Ekegusii: “Oyochire korwa igoro, oyio nigo are igoro ase onsi; oyore bw’ense noyo bw’ense, nigo agokwana amang’ana ’ense; ere oyochire korwa igoro nigo are igoro ase onsi.

English: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
Kiswahili: Yeye hushuhudia yale aliyoyaona na kuyasikia, lakini hakuna yeyote anayekubali ushuhuda wake.
Ekegusii: Nigo akoba kirori ase aya arorire na koyaigwa; gose onde tari oyobwanchire oborori bwaye.

English: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeyote anayekubali huo ushuhuda anathibitisha kwamba, Mungu ni kweli.
Ekegusii: Oyobwanchire oborori bwaye oorokirie Nyasae maiso marore, ng’a noyo bw’ekeene.

English: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliyetumwa na Mungu husema maneno ya Mungu, kwa kuwa Mungu humtoa Roho pasipo kipimo.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyotometwe na Nyasae nigo agokwana amang’ana a Nyasae; naki Nyasae tari komoa Omoika ase ekerengo.

English: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
Kiswahili: Baba anampenda Mwana, naye ametia vitu vyote mikononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Tata omwanchire Omwana, omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye.

English: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayemwamini Mwana ana uzima wa milele, lakini yeye asiyemwamini Mwana hatauona uzima, bali ghadhabu ya Mungu itakuwa juu yake.”
Ekegusii: Oyoramwegene Omwana nare nobogima bwa kare na kare; oyotaigwereti Omwana takorora obogima, korende endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo emoikaranserete.”

English: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo wakasikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa anapata na kubatiza wanafunzi wengi zaidi kuliko Yohana,
Ekegusii: Nabo Omonene agachia komanya ng’a Abafarisai baigure ng’a Yeso okorire aborokigwa abange kobua Yohana, na kobatisa,

English: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
Kiswahili: ingawa kwa kweli si Yesu mwenyewe aliyekuwa akibatiza, ila ni wanafunzi wake.
Ekegusii: (nonya Yeso omonyene tare kobatisa, otatiga aborokigwa baye),

English: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.
Kiswahili: Bwana alipojua mambo haya, aliondoka Uyahudi akarudi tena Galilaya.
Ekegusii: akarua Boyahudi, akagenda Galili naende.

English: He needed to pass through Samaria.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo ilimlazimu apitie Samaria.
Ekegusii: Naende yamogwenerete goika aete Samaria.

English: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
Kiswahili: Akafika kwenye mji mmoja wa Samaria uitwao Sikari, karibu na lile shamba ambalo Yakobo alimpa mwanawe Yosefu.
Ekegusii: Igo agaika omochie o Samaria, okorokwa Sikari, ang’e nomogondo oria Yakobo aete Yusufu omwana oye;

English: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
Kiswahili: Huko ndiko kulikokuwa na kile kisima cha Yakobo. Naye Yesu alikuwa amechoka kwa kuwa alikuwa ametoka safarini. Akaketi karibu na hicho kisima. Ilikuwa yapata saa sita mchana.
Ekegusii: agwo yarengeo ensoko ya Yakobo. Nabo Yeso, konya orosire ase orogendo rwaye, agaikaransa iga ase ensoko. Konya chiabeire ang’e chinsa isano nemo.

English: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
Kiswahili: Mwanamke mmoja Msamaria akaja kuteka maji, Yesu akamwambia, “Naomba maji ninywe.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu o Samaria agacha kobuucha amaache. Yeso akamoteebia, “Ing’a amaache inywe.”

English: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
Kiswahili: (Wakati huo wanafunzi wake walikuwa wamekwenda mjini kununua chakula.)
Ekegusii: Naki aborokigwa baye konya bachiire omochie kogora endagera.

English: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke Msamaria akamjibu, “Wewe ni Myahudi na mimi ni Msamaria. Yawezekanaje uniombe nikupe maji ya kunywa?” (Wayahudi walikuwa hawashirikiani kabisa na Wasamaria.)
Ekegusii: Nabo omokungu oria bw’Abasamaria akamobooria, “Naki yaba aye Omoyahudi ogonsaba amaache, na inche nomokuungu bw’Abasamaria?” (Abayahudi tibari gosanga n’Abasamaria).

English: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu akamwambia, “Kama ungelijua karama ya Mungu, naye ni nani anayekuambia, Nipe maji ninywe, wewe ungelimwomba yeye, naye angelikupa maji yaliyo hai.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nkwamanya ekeegwa kia Nyasae, naende nere ng’o oyo okogosaba amaache anywe, anga nkwamosaba ere, na ere anga nakoa amaache are moyo.”

English: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akamjibu, “Bwana, wewe huna chombo cha kutekea maji na kisima hiki ni kirefu. Hayo maji ya uzima utayapata wapi?
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, tori negento gi’okobuuchera, na ensoko yachiire inse mono; ng’ai kwanyorire amaache aya are moyo?

English: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
Kiswahili: Kwani wewe ni mkuu kuliko baba yetu Yakobo ambaye alitupatia kisima hiki, ambacho yeye pamoja na watoto wake na mifugo yake walikitumia?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Aye nomonene ore kobua sokoro yaito Yakobo, oyotoete ensoko eye, nere omonyene akanywa amaache aya, na abana baye bonsi, na etugo yaye?”

English: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Kila mtu anayekunywa maji ya kisima hiki ataona kiu tena.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Kera oyokonywa amaache aya naigwe erang’o naende;

English: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeyote anywaye maji nitakayompa hataona kiu kamwe. Maji nitakayompa yatakuwa ndani yake chemchemi ya maji, yakibubujika uzima wa milele.”
Ekegusii: korende onde bwensi oyoranywe amaache aria ndamoe inche, takorang’a nonya ng’ake; korende amaache aria ndanyaare komoa, nabe ime yaye ensoko y’amaache agosoka na komoa obogima bwa kare na kare.”

English: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akamwambia, “Bwana, tafadhali nipe maji hayo ili nisipate kiu tena na wala nisije tena hapa kuteka maji!”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, ing’a amaache ayio tindang’a, gose timbaisa gocha aiga kobuucha.”

English: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Nenda ukamwite mumeo, uje naye hapa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda, orangerie omosacha oo, oche nere aiga.”

English: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akajibu, “Sina mume.” Yesu akamwambia, “Umesema kweli kuwa huna mume.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Tindi nomosaacha.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Gwakwanire boronge ng’a tori nomosaacha,

English: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana umeshakuwa na wanaume watano na mwanaume unayeishi naye sasa si mume wako! Umesema ukweli.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera kwabeire nabasaacha batano, na ere oyore nere bono tari omosacha oo, ase ayio gwakwanire ekeene.”

English: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akasema, “Bwana, naona bila shaka wewe ni nabii.
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, narorire ng’a nomobani ore.

English: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
Kiswahili: Baba zetu waliabudu kwenye mlima huu, lakini ninyi Wayahudi mnasema ni lazima tukaabudu huko Yerusalemu.”
Ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiarenge gosasiima ase egetunwa eke, na inwe nigo mogoteeba ng’a Yerusalemu nao aase atogwenerete togosasiimera.”

English: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mwanamke, niamini, wakati unakuja ambapo hamtamwabudu Baba katika mlima huu, wala huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Aye omokungu, inyegene, ensa neche, motamosasiime Tata ase egetunwa eke, nonya nase Yerusalemu.

English: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
Kiswahili: Ninyi Wasamaria mnaabudu msichokijua. Sisi Wayahudi tunamwabudu Mungu tunayemjua kwa sababu wokovu unatoka kwa Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogosasiima eki motamanyeti; intwe nigo togosasiima eki tomanyete, ekiagera ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Abayahudi.

English: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
Kiswahili: Lakini saa yaja, tena ipo, ambapo wale waabuduo halisi, watamwabudu Baba katika roho na kweli. Watu wanaoabudu namna hii, ndio Baba anawatafuta.
Ekegusii: Korende ensa neche, na bono nere, ekero abasasiimi b’ekeene barasasiime Tata ase omoika na ekeene, ekiagera Tata nigo akorigia abanto buna abwo bamosasime.

English: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
Kiswahili: Mungu ni Roho na wote wanaomwabudu imewapasa kumwabudu katika roho na kweli.”
Ekegusii: Nyasae n’Omoika, na abwo bakomosasiima nebagwenerete komosasiima ase omoika na ekeene.”

English: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akamwambia, “Ninafahamu kwamba Masiya (aitwaye Kristo) anakuja. Yeye akija, atatueleza mambo yote.”
Ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Namanyire ng’a ngocha are Masihi (oyokorokwa Kristo); karache ere, natoorokerie onsi.”

English: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mimi ninayezungumza nawe, ndiye.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inche, oyo ngokwana naye, nere.”

English: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo wanafunzi wake wakarudi, wakashangaa sana kumwona akizungumza na mwanamke. Lakini hakuna aliyemuuliza, “Unataka nini kwake?” Au “Kwa nini unazungumza naye?”
Ekegusii: Erio kegima aborokigwa baye bagaacha. Bagakumia ekiagera arenge gokwana nomokuungu; korende onde tamoboretie, “Inki okorigia?” Gose, “Naki ogokwana nere?”

English: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akaacha mtungi wake, akarudi mjini akawaambia watu,
Ekegusii: Nabo omokungu oria agatiga enyongo yaye, akagenda omochie, agateebia abanto,

English: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”
Kiswahili: “Njooni mkamwone mtu aliyeniambia kila kitu nilichotenda! Je, yawezekana huyu ndiye Kristo?”
Ekegusii: “Inchuo, morore omonto ontebirie amang’ana onsi aya nakorire! Inee! Oyio tari ere Kristo?”

English: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
Kiswahili: Basi wakamiminika watu kutoka mjini wakamwendea Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bakaimoka korwa omochie, bakamochiera.

English: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakimsihi, “Rabi, kula angalau chochote.”
Ekegusii: Agwo ekero bataracha, aborokigwa bakamosorora bakaboora, “Rabii, ragera?”

English: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye akawajibu, “Mimi ninacho chakula ambacho ninyi hamkifahamu.”
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inche ninde nendagera nkoria, eye motamanyeti inwe.”

English: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
Kiswahili: Basi wanafunzi wakaanza kuulizana, “Kuna mtu ambaye amemletea chakula?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakaboorania, “Inee! Nomonto omorentera endagera?”

English: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawajibu, “Chakula changu ni kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu ambaye amenituma na kuikamilisha kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Endagera yaane neye: ogokora ogwancha kwaye oyontomete na goikerania emeremo yaye.

English: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
Kiswahili: Je, ninyi hamsemi, ‘Bado miezi minne tuvune?’ Inueni macho yenu myaangalie mashamba jinsi mazao yalivyo tayari kuvunwa!
Ekegusii: Inwe timori goteeba: Yatigaire emetienyi ene, erio rigesa riiche? Rora nabateebirie: Imokia amaiso aino, morigererie emegondo, ng’a yaikire koba emerabu ang’e ase rigesa.

English: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
Kiswahili: Mvunaji tayari anapokea mshahara wake, naye anakusanya mazao kwa ajili ya uzima wa milele. Ili yeye apandaye na yeye avunaye wafurahi pamoja.
Ekegusii: Oyo okogesa nkonyora are eng’eria na gosangereria amatunda ase obogima bwa kare na kare, erinde oyo okobusura na ere oyokogesa bagoke amo.

English: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
Kiswahili: Hivyo kule kusema, ‘Mmoja hupanda na mwingine huvuna,’ ni kweli kabisa.
Ekegusii: Naki ring’ana riria: Oyomo obusura, na oyonde okogesa, nigo rire ekeene.

English: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
Kiswahili: Niliwatuma mkavune mazao ambayo hamkupanda, wengine walifanya kazi ngumu, nanyi mmevuna faida ya taabu yao.”
Ekegusii: Inche nabatomete mogese aya motakorerete emeremo; abande bakorire emeremo, na inwe mwasoire ase emeremo yabo.”

English: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”
Kiswahili: Wasamaria wengi katika mji ule wakamwamini Yesu kwa sababu ya ushuhuda wa yule mwanamke alipowaambia kwamba, “Ameniambia kila kitu nilichotenda.”
Ekegusii: Naende ase omochie oria Abasamaria abange bakamwegena ase engencho y’oborori bw’omokuungu oria ekero abateebetie ng’a, “Onteebirie amang’ana onsi aya nakorire.”

English: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wale Wasamaria walipomjia, wakamsihi akae kwao. Naye akakaa huko siku mbili.
Ekegusii: Nabo ekero Abasamaria baria bachia komochiera, bakamosorora aikaranse amo nabarabwo; akabeera aroro amatuko abere.

English: Many more believed because of his word.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya neno lake, watu wengi wakaamini.
Ekegusii: Abanto abange kobua bakeegena ase engencho ye ring’ana riaye;

English: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia yule mwanamke, “Sasa tunaamini, wala si kwa sababu ya maneno yako tu, bali kwa kuwa tumemsikia sisi wenyewe. Tumejua hakika kweli ya kwamba huyu ndiye Kristo, Mwokozi wa ulimwengu.”
Ekegusii: bagateebia omokungu oria, “Bono twegenire, tari ase engencho y’amang’ana ao, korende ekiagera tweigwereire intwe abanyene, naende twamanyire ekeene ng’a oyo n’Omotooria bw’ense.”

English: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
Kiswahili: Baada ya zile siku mbili, Yesu aliondoka kwenda Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko abere akaimoka akagenda Galili.

English: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
Kiswahili: (Basi Yesu mwenyewe alikuwa amesema kwamba nabii hapati heshima katika nchi yake mwenyewe.)
Ekegusii: Naki Yeso omonyene aorogetie ng’a omobani tari gosikwa ase ense yaye omonyene.

English: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
Kiswahili: Alipofika Galilaya, Wagalilaya walimkaribisha, kwani walikuwa wameona yale aliyoyatenda huko Yerusalemu wakati wa Sikukuu ya Pasaka. Kwa maana wao pia walikuwa wamehudhuria hiyo Sikukuu.
Ekegusii: Nabo ekero achia goika Galili, Abagalili bakamoroisia, ekiagera baroche amang’ana onsi ayakorete Yerusalemu ekero kie rituko rinene; naki nabarabwo boigo mbagendete ase rituko rinene.

English: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akaja tena mpaka Kana ya Galilaya, kule alikokuwa amebadili maji kuwa divai. Huko kulikuwepo na afisa mmoja wa mfalme, ambaye mwanawe alikuwa mgonjwa huko Kapernaumu.
Ekegusii: Agaika naende Kana ya Galili, agwo ase aonchorete amaache koba edivai. Narengeo omonto omosike ase Kapernaumu, oyorenge n’omwana omorwaire.

English: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
Kiswahili: Huyo mtu aliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewasili Galilaya kutoka Uyahudi, alimwendea na kumwomba ili aje kumponya mwanawe, aliyekuwa mgonjwa karibu ya kufa.
Ekegusii: Oyio agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ochire korwa Boyahudi goika Galili, akamochiera, akamosorora achiche agwenie omwana oye, ekiagera konya oisire gokwa.

English: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Ninyi watu msipoona ishara na miujiza kamwe hamtaamini.”
Ekegusii: Nabo Yeso akamoteebia, “Motarochi ebikone na amakumia, timori kwegena nonya ng’ake.”

English: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
Kiswahili: Yule afisa wa mfalme akamwambia, “Bwana, tafadhali shuka kabla mwanangu hajafa.”
Ekegusii: Omosike oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, tirimboka ritang’ani omwana one atarakwa.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Enenda zako, mwanao yu hai.” Yule afisa akaamini yale maneno Yesu aliyomwambia, akaondoka akaenda zake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda, omwana oo nabe moyo.” Omonto oria akegena ring’ana riria ateebetigwe na Yeso, akabwatia enchera yaye.

English: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa bado yuko njiani, akakutana na watumishi wake wakamwambia kwamba mwanawe yu mzima.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge gotirimboka abasomba baaye bagaacha komorootota, bakamoteebia, “Omwana oo moyo are.”

English: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza saa ambayo alianza kupata nafuu. Wakamwambia, “Jana yapata saa saba, homa ilimwacha.”
Ekegusii: Erio akababoria amang’ana ensa achaagete koba buya. Bakamoteebia, “Niigoro, chinsa isano na ibere esosera yamotigete.”

English: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
Kiswahili: Ndipo baba wa huyo mtoto akakumbuka kuwa huo ndio wakati ambapo Yesu alikuwa amemwambia, “Mwanao yu hai.” Kwa hiyo yeye pamoja na wote wa nyumbani mwake wakamwamini Yesu.
Ekegusii: Erio ise akamanya ng’a nensa eria eria ateebetigwe na Yeso, “Omwana oo nabe moyo!” Akeegena ere, na enyomba yaye yonsi.

English: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa ishara ya pili ambayo Yesu alifanya aliporudi Galilaya kutoka Uyahudi.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio egekone gia kabere Yeso akorete korwa ekero arwete Boyahudi kogenda Galili.

English: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, kulikuwa na Sikukuu ya Wayahudi, naye Yesu akapanda kwenda Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya ndiarenge Rituko Rinene ri’Abayahudi; Yeso agatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.

English: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
Kiswahili: Huko Yerusalemu, karibu na mlango uitwao Mlango wa Kondoo, palikuwa na bwawa moja lililoitwa kwa Kiebrania Bethzatha, ambalo lilikuwa limezungukwa na kumbi tano.
Ekegusii: Naende aaria Yerusalemu ase Egeita gie Ching’ondi ndiarengeo ritibo rikorokwa ase Ekeiberania Betiseda, na rirorio ndiabwate ebisoero bitano.
