English: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
Kiswahili: Hapa palikuwa na idadi kubwa ya wasiojiweza, yaani, vipofu, viwete, na waliopooza wakingojea maji yatibuliwe.
Ekegusii: Ime ase ebio mbarenge abanto abange abarwaire baare koraara, emeuko, ebirema, na amagata, baganyete amaache aturubanigwe.

English: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana malaika alikuwa akishuka wakati fulani, akayatibua maji. Yule aliyekuwa wa kwanza kuingia ndani baada ya maji kutibuliwa alipona ugonjwa wowote aliokuwa nao.
Ekegusii: Naki ekero gete omomalaika ngoika arenge osoa ase ritibo riria, oturubania amaache. Nabo ere oyorenge gosoa ritang’ani magega ase amaache gaturubaniigwe, nigo arenge kogwena oborwaire bonde bwonsi obwamonyorete.

English: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja alikuwako huko ambaye alikuwa ameugua kwa miaka thelathini na minane.
Ekegusii: Narenge aroro omonto gete oyorenge noborwaire bw’emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato.

English: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomwona akiwa amelala hapo, naye akijua kuwa amekuwa hapo kwa muda mrefu, akamwambia, “Je, wataka kuponywa?”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia komorora oraire, konya omanyire ng’a obeire engencho eye amatuko amange, akamobooria, “Norigetie koba omogima?”

English: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
Kiswahili: Yule mgonjwa akamjibu, “Bwana, mimi sina mtu wa kuniingiza bwawani maji yanapotibuliwa. Nami ninapotaka kutumbukia bwawani, mtu mwingine huingia kabla yangu.”
Ekegusii: Omorwaire oria akamoiraneria, “Omonene, tindi nomonto okombeka ase ritibo, ekero amaache agoturubanigwa; korende ekero ngochicha inche, omonto onde asoa ritang’ani ase ’nde.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Inuka! Chukua mkeka wako na uende.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tenena, etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”

English: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.
Kiswahili: Mara yule mtu akapona, akachukua mkeka wake, akaanza kutembea. Basi siku hiyo ilikuwa siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima omonto oria akaba omogima, agetweka egesero kiaye, akagenda. Nabo yarenge Esabato rituko riria.

English: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Wayahudi wakamwambia yule mtu aliyeponywa, “Leo ni Sabato, si halali wewe kubeba mkeka wako.”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bagateebia omonto oria ogwenetigwe, “Reero n’Esabato, tari boronge ase ore gwetweka egesero kiao.”

English: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”
Kiswahili: Yeye akawajibu, “Yule mtu aliyeniponya aliniambia, ‘Chukua mkeka wako na uende.’ ”
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Ere oyonkora koba omogima nere onteebia: Etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”

English: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Ni mtu gani huyo aliyekuambia uchukue mkeka wako uende?”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Oria ogoteebia: Etweke egesero kiao ogende, nere ng’o?”

English: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
Kiswahili: Basi yule mtu aliyeponywa hakufahamu ni nani aliyemponya, kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa amejiondoa katika ule umati wa watu uliokuwa hapo.
Ekegusii: Korende oria ogwenetigwe tamomanyete gose ning’o. Yeso nigo erusananetie, ekiagera abanto abange barenge aase aria.

English: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
Kiswahili: Baadaye Yesu akamkuta yule mtu aliyemponya ndani ya Hekalu na kumwambia, “Tazama umeponywa, usitende dhambi tena. La sivyo, lisije likakupata jambo baya zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akamonyora ore Hekalu ime, akamoteebia. “Rora, kwabeire omogima; tokora ebibe naende, ring’ana rire riibe kobua tiricha gokonyoora.”

English: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akaenda, akawaambia wale Wayahudi kuwa ni Yesu aliyemponya.
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akagenda, agateebia Abayahudi amang’ana, ng’a Yeso nere omokorete koba omogima.

English: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Wayahudi wakaanza kumsumbua Yesu, kwa sababu alikuwa anafanya mambo kama hayo siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Abayahudi bagachaaka gochanda Yeso, bakarigia komoita, ekiagera akora aya ase rituko ri’Esabato.

English: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Baba yangu anafanya kazi yake daima hata siku hii ya leo, nami pia ninafanya kazi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tata ngokora are emeremo nonya ngoika bono, na inche ngokora nde emeremo.”

English: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
Kiswahili: Maneno haya yaliwaudhi sana viongozi wa Wayahudi. Wakajaribu kila njia wapate jinsi ya kumuua, kwani si kwamba alivunja Sabato tu, bali alikuwa akimwita Mungu Baba yake, hivyo kujifanya sawa na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabo ekiagera ase aya Abayahudi bakamenta korigia komoita, ekiagera tasaretie Esabato yoka, korende amo naya narogete Nyasae ng’a n’Ise, ogwekora koreng’ana buna Nyasae.

English: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, Mwana hawezi kufanya jambo lolote peke yake, yeye aweza tu kufanya lile analomwona Baba yake akifanya, kwa maana lolote afanyalo Baba, Mwana pia hufanya vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omwana takonyara gokora ring’ana ere bweka, otatiga riria aroche Ise agokora; naki onsi aya agokora ere, ayio naro n’Omwana agokora.

English: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
Kiswahili: Baba ampenda Mwana na kumwonyesha yale ambayo yeye Baba mwenyewe anayafanya, naye atamwonyesha kazi kuu kuliko hizi ili mpate kushangaa.
Ekegusii: Tata nigo amwanchete Omwana, na komworokia onsi ayagokora omonyene; na emeremo emenene kobua eye iga namworokie, erinde inwe monyaare gokumia.

English: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
Kiswahili: Hakika kama vile Baba awafufuavyo wafu na kuwapa uzima, vivyo hivyo Mwana huwapa uzima wale anaopenda.
Ekegusii: Na buna Tata akobokia ebitondo obia obogima, naboigo n’Omwana akobaa obogima aba arigetie.

English: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
Kiswahili: Wala Baba hamhukumu mtu yeyote, lakini hukumu yote amempa Mwana,
Ekegusii: Naki Tata tari kogambia monto onde bwensi, korende oeire Omwana obogambi bwonsi,

English: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
Kiswahili: ili wote wamheshimu Mwana kama vile wanavyomheshimu Baba. Yeyote asiyemheshimu Mwana, hamheshimu Baba aliyemtuma.
Ekegusii: erinde bonsi basike Omwana buna basigete Tata. Oyotasigeti Omwana tasigeti Tata oyo omotomete.

English: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
Kiswahili: “Amin, amin nawaambia, yeyote anayesikia maneno yangu na kumwamini yeye aliyenituma, anao uzima wa milele, naye hatahukumiwa, bali amepita kutoka mautini, na kuingia uzimani.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyokoigwa ring’ana riane, na komwegena ere oyontomete nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, gose tagoika ase ekiina, korende oetire korwa ase amakweri, oikire ase obogima.

English: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, saa yaja, nayo saa ipo, wafu watakapoisikia sauti ya Mwana wa Mungu, nao watakaoisikia watakuwa hai.
Ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ensa ngocha ere, na bono nereo, ebitondo biraigwe eriogi ri’Omwana o Nyasae, na baria barariigwe nababe moyo.

English: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Baba alivyo na uzima ndani yake, vivyo hivyo amempa Mwana kuwa na uzima ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Naki buna Tata are nobogima ime yaye omonyene; naboigo oeire na Omwana koba nobogima ime yaye omonyene.

English: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
Kiswahili: Naye amempa Mwanawe mamlaka ya kuhukumu kwa kuwa yeye ni Mwana wa Adamu.
Ekegusii: Omoeire okobua kw’ogokora ekiina, ekiagera ere n’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.

English: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice
Kiswahili: “Msishangae kusikia haya, kwa maana saa inakuja ambapo wale walio makaburini wataisikia sauti yake.
Ekegusii: Timokumia ase aya! Naki ensa ngocha ere, ekero abanto bonsi bare ase chimbeera ime baraigwe eriogi riaye,

English: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
Kiswahili: Nao watatoka nje, wale waliotenda mema watafufuka wapate uzima na wale waliotenda maovu, watafufuka wahukumiwe.
Ekegusii: na barabwo inabasoke, baria abaare gokora amaya ase okobokigwa kw’obogima, na baria abaare gokora amabe ase okobokigwa gw’ekiina.

English: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
Kiswahili: “Mimi siwezi kufanya jambo lolote peke yangu. Ninavyosikia ndivyo ninavyohukumu, nayo hukumu yangu ni ya haki kwa kuwa sitafuti kufanya mapenzi yangu mwenyewe, bali mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: “Inche omonyene tinkonyaara gokora kende gionsi. Buna nkoigwa nabo nkogamba, na ekiina kiane nigo kere boronge, ekiagera tindi korigia ogwancha kwane, korende nogwancha gwa Tata oyontomete.

English: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
Kiswahili: “Kama ningejishuhudia mimi mwenyewe, ushuhuda wangu si kweli.
Ekegusii: Inche kondeorokie omonyene, oborori bwane tibori obw’ekeene.

English: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
Kiswahili: Lakini yuko mwingine anishuhudiaye na ninajua kwamba ushuhuda wake ni wa kweli.
Ekegusii: Nare oyonde oy’okombera kirori; na inche namanyire ng’a oborori bwaye agonteeba nobw’ekeene.

English: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
Kiswahili: “Mlituma wajumbe kwa Yohana, naye akashuhudia juu ya kweli.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwatomete abanto ase Yohana, na oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene.

English: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba naukubali ushuhuda wa mwanadamu, la, bali ninalitaja hili kusudi ninyi mpate kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Korende inche tindi konyora oborori korwa ase abanto; korende nigo ngokwana aya, erinde inwe motooreke.

English: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
Kiswahili: Yohana alikuwa taa iliyowaka na kutoa nuru, nanyi kwa muda mlichagua kuifurahia nuru yake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge etaaya egwoka na komoreka, na inwe mwanchire gosasokera omobaso oye ase ekero egeke.

English: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
Kiswahili: “Lakini ninao ushuhuda mkuu zaidi kuliko wa Yohana. Kazi zile nizifanyazo, zinashuhudia juu yangu, zile ambazo Baba amenituma nizikamilishe, naam, ishara hizi ninazofanya, zinashuhudia kuwa Baba ndiye alinituma.
Ekegusii: Korende oborori inde nabwo nobonene kobua boria bwa Yohana, naki emeremo eria naetwe na Tata inyekoore. Emeremo eyio ngokora, yambereire kirori, ng’a Tata nere ontomete.

English: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
Kiswahili: Naye Baba mwenyewe ameshuhudia juu yangu. Hamjapata kamwe kuisikia sauti yake wala kuona umbo lake,
Ekegusii: Nere Tata oyontomete obeire kirori ase ’nde. Eriogi riaye timwana koriigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timwana gokerora

English: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
Kiswahili: wala hamna neno lake ndani yenu, kwa sababu hamkumwamini yeye aliyetumwa naye.
Ekegusii: naende ring’ana riaye timori narirorio ime yaino, ekiagera timomwegeneti ere oyotomirwe nere.

English: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnachunguza Maandiko mkidhani ya kuwa ndani yake mna uzima wa milele, maandiko haya ndiyo yanayonishuhudia Mimi.
Ekegusii: Igo mokorigarigia mono amariiko, ekiagera mokagete ng’a nigo more nobogima bwa kare na kare ime y’aro; na ayio naro are kirori ase ’nde,

English: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
Kiswahili: Lakini mnakataa kuja kwangu ili mpate uzima.
Ekegusii: ko mwangire gocha ase ’nde monyare koba nobogima.

English: I don’t receive glory from men.
Kiswahili: “Mimi sitafuti kutukuzwa na wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Tindi konyora obonene korwa ase abanto.

English: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninajua kwamba hamna upendo wa Mungu mioyoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Korende nabamanyire inwe ng’a timori nobwanchani bwa Nyasae ime yaino.

English: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
Kiswahili: Mimi nimekuja kwa jina la Baba yangu, nanyi hamnipokei, lakini mtu mwingine akija kwa jina lake mwenyewe, mtampokea.
Ekegusii: Inche nachire ase erieta ria Tata one, na inwe timori konyancha; oyonde karaache ase erieta riaye omonyene, oyio namomwanche.

English: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
Kiswahili: Ninyi mwawezaje kuamini ikiwa mnapeana utukufu ninyi kwa ninyi, lakini hamna bidii kupata utukufu utokao kwa Mungu?
Ekegusii: Naki moranyare kwegena, inwe abamokoenana obonene inwe ase inwe, na obonene boria bokorwa ase Nyasae ore bweka, timori koborigia?

English: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
Kiswahili: “Lakini msidhani kuwa mimi nitawashtaki mbele za Baba, mshtaki wenu ni Mose, ambaye mmemwekea tumaini lenu.
Ekegusii: Timokaga ng’a inche nimbasoere ase Tata; nare oyo okobasoera, nere Musa, oyomosemeretie inwe.

English: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
Kiswahili: Kama mngelimwamini Mose, mngeliniamini na mimi kwa maana aliandika habari zangu.
Ekegusii: Naki onye mwamwegenete Musa anga mwanyegena nainche, ekiagera nere origete amang’ana igoro yane.

English: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa hamwamini aliyoandika Mose, mtaaminije ninayoyasema?”
Ekegusii: Korende onye timwegeneti amariiko aye, naki moregene amang’ana aane?”

English: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu alikwenda ngʼambo ya Bahari ya Galilaya, ambayo pia huitwa Bahari ya Tiberia.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akagenda ng’umbu y’enyancha ya Galili, nero enyancha ya Tiberia.

English: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu uliendelea kumfuata, kwa sababu waliona ishara nyingi za miujiza alizofanya kwa wagonjwa.
Ekegusii: Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, ekiagera baroche ebikone abakorerete abarwaire.

English: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akapanda mlimani akaketi huko pamoja na wanafunzi wake.
Ekegusii: Yeso agatiira gochia egetunwa, agaikaransa aroro amo naborokigwa baye.

English: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
Kiswahili: Pasaka ya Wayahudi ilikuwa imekaribia.
Ekegusii: Na Epasaka, rituko rinene ri’Abayahudi, nigo yarenge ang’e.

English: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipotazama na kuuona ule umati mkubwa wa watu ukimjia, akamwambia Filipo, “Tutanunua wapi mikate ili watu hawa wale?”
Ekegusii: Nabo Yeso agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora omoganda omonene ogocha asare, akaboria Filipo, “Ng’ai togochia kogora emegati, aba banyare koria?”

English: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
Kiswahili: Aliuliza swali hili kumpima, kwa maana alishajua la kufanya.
Ekegusii: Igo amoboretie aya, erinde amoteeme, ekiagera namanyete ere omonyene eki arakore.

English: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”
Kiswahili: Filipo akamjibu, “Hata fedha kiasi cha dinari mia mbili, hazitoshi kununua mikate ya kuwapa watu hawa ili kila mtu apate kidogo.”
Ekegusii: Filipo akamoiraneria, “Emegati ye chidinari amagana abere tekobaisana, kera oyomo anyore moke igo.”

English: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa wanafunzi wake aitwaye Andrea, ndugu yake Simoni Petro, akamwambia,
Ekegusii: Oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni Petero, akamoteebia,

English: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
Kiswahili: “Hapa kuna mvulana mmoja mwenye mikate mitano ya shayiri na samaki wawili wadogo. Lakini hivi vitatosha nini kwa umati huu wote?”
Ekegusii: “Nare aa omosae, obwate emegati etano y’esairi ne chinswe ibere, korende ebi inki biraisane ase abanto abange buna aba?”

English: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Waketisheni watu chini.” Palikuwa na majani mengi katika eneo lile, nao watu wakaketi. Palikuwa na wanaume wapatao 5,000.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Ikaransia abanto.” Mbwarenge aroro obonyansi obonge aase aria. Igo abasacha bagaikaransa, barabwo nigo barenge chilifu isaano.

English: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akachukua ile mikate, akamshukuru Mungu na kuwagawia wale watu waliokuwa wameketi. Akafanya vivyo hivyo na wale samaki. Kila mtu akapata kadiri alivyotaka.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabogoria emegati; kayesesenirie, akagabera abaikaransete; naboigo ne chinswe chiria, koreng’ana buna barigetie.

English: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
Kiswahili: Watu wote walipokwisha kula na kushiba, akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Kusanyeni vipande vilivyobaki vya ile mikate, kisipotee chochote.”
Ekegusii: Kobachia koigota, agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Sangereria ebisamunye biatigaire, gento tigesira.”

English: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakavikusanya, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili kwa vipande vya ile mikate mitano ya shayiri na samaki wale wawili wadogo vilivyobakishwa na waliokula.
Ekegusii: Nabo bakabisangereria, bagaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere ase ebisamunye bi’emegati etano y’esairi, ebiatigaretigwe na baria bariete.

English: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya watu kuona muujiza ule Yesu aliofanya, walianza kusema, “Hakika huyu ndiye Nabii ajaye ulimwenguni!”
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baria bachia korora egekone keria Yeso akorete, bakaboora, “Oyo ekeene nomobani oria orenge gocha ase ense!”

English: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
Kiswahili: Yesu akijua kwamba walitaka kuja kumfanya awe mfalme wao, kwa nguvu, akajitenga nao akaenda milimani peke yake.
Ekegusii: Nabo Yeso namanyete ng’a mbarigetie gocha komoira, erinde bamobeeke abe omorwoti. Ase ayio akerusanania, akagenda naende egetunwa ere bweka.

English: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
Kiswahili: Ilipofika jioni, wanafunzi wake waliteremka kwenda baharini.
Ekegusii: Rigachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bagatirimboka gochia nyancha,

English: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
Kiswahili: Wakaingia kwenye mashua, wakaanza kuvuka bahari kwenda Kapernaumu. Wakati huu kulikuwa tayari giza na Yesu alikuwa hajajumuika nao.
Ekegusii: bakariina obwato ime, bagachaaka kwamboka enyancha kogenda Kapernaumu. Naende omosunte konya obeire, na Yeso konya taracha ase bare.

English: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
Kiswahili: Bahari ikachafuka kwa sababu upepo mkali ulikuwa unavuma.
Ekegusii: Enyancha egachaaka koimoka ase engencho y’omwaga omonge orenge kogusa.

English: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi walipokuwa wamekwenda mwendo wa karibu maili tatu au nne, walimwona Yesu akitembea juu ya maji akikaribia mashua, nao wakaogopa sana.
Ekegusii: Nabo kabang’usire obwato chimaeli isato gose inye bakarora Yeso ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, ogoika ang’e ase obwato. Erio bakairoka,

English: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Ni mimi. Msiogope.”
Ekegusii: korende Yeso akabateebia, “Ninche. Timoiroka!”

English: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakamkaribisha kwa furaha ndani ya mashua, na mara wakafika ufuoni walikokuwa wakienda.
Ekegusii: Bagancha komosoyia obwato ime, erio kegima obwato bogaika ase barenge kogenda.

English: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata, wale watu waliokuwa wamebaki ngʼambo waliona kwamba palikuwepo na mashua moja tu na kwamba Yesu hakuwa ameondoka pamoja na wanafunzi wake, ila walikuwa wameondoka peke yao.
Ekegusii: Ankio yaye omoganda oteneine ng’umbu y’enyancha bakarora ng’a obwato bonde tibwarenge aroro, otatiga boria obomo bwoka, naende ng’a Yeso tasoete ase obwato boria amo naborokigwa baye, korende naborokigwa baye bagendete boka.

English: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
Kiswahili: Lakini zikaja mashua nyingine kutoka Tiberia zikafika karibu na mahali pale walipokula mikate baada ya Bwana kumshukuru Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende amaato ande agacha korwa Tiberia ang’e nase aria bariete emegati ekero Omonene ayesesenetie.

English: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
Kiswahili: Mara wale watu wakatambua kwamba Yesu hakuwepo hapo, wala wanafunzi wake. Wakaingia kwenye mashua hizo, wakaenda Kapernaumu ili kumtafuta Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero omoganda ochia korora ng’a Yeso tari aroro, nonya naborokigwa baye, barabwo abanyene bagasoa amaato ime, bakagenda Kapernaumu, bakorigia Yeso.

English: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
Kiswahili: Walipomkuta Yesu ngʼambo ya bahari wakamuuliza, “Rabi, umefika lini huku?”
Ekegusii: Goika bagachia komoorora ng’umbu y’enyancha bakamobooria, “Omworokia, indi gwachete aa?”

English: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Amin, amin nawaambia, ninyi hamnitafuti kwa kuwa mliona ishara na miujiza, bali kwa sababu mlikula ile mikate mkashiba.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Iga mokondigia, tari ekiagera mwaroche ebikone, korende nekiagera mwariete emegati eria, mokaigota.

English: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
Kiswahili: Msishughulikie chakula kiharibikacho, bali chakula kidumucho hata uzima wa milele, ambacho Mwana wa Adamu atawapa. Yeye ndiye ambaye Mungu Baba amemtia muhuri.”
Ekegusii: Timokorera endagera egosareka korende, endagera ekobao goika obogima bwa kare na kare, eye Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto aranyare kobaa, ekiagera Nyasae Tata obekire ekemanyererio kiaye asare.”

English: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakamuuliza, “Tufanye nini ili tupate kuitenda kazi ya Mungu?”
Ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Ninki togokora tonyare gokora emeremo ya Nyasae?”

English: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Kazi ya Mungu ndiyo hii: Mwaminini yeye aliyetumwa naye.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Eye nero emeremo ya Nyasae, ng’a momwegene ere oyotomirwe nere.”

English: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakamuuliza, “Utafanya ishara gani ya muujiza, ili tuione tukuamini? Utafanya jambo gani?
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Mbikone ki ogokora, erinde torore tokwegene? Meremo ki ogokora?

English: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
Kiswahili: Baba zetu walikula mana jangwani, kama ilivyoandikwa, ‘Aliwapa mikate kutoka mbinguni ili wale.’ ”
Ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nchiariete mana ase erooro, buna yarigetwe: Nabaete omogati korwa igoro bakaria.”

English: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, si Mose aliyewapa mikate kutoka mbinguni, bali Baba yangu ndiye anawapa mkate wa kweli kutoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Tari Musa obaete omogati oria orwete igoro, korende n’Tata one ore kobaa omogati bw’ekeene okorwa igoro.

English: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mkate wa Mungu ni yule ashukaye kutoka mbinguni na kuupa ulimwengu uzima.”
Ekegusii: Naki omogati o Nyasae noria ogoika korwa igoro na koa ense obogima.”

English: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia, “Bwana, kuanzia sasa tupatie huo mkate siku zote.”
Ekegusii: Nabo bakamoteebia, “Omonene, amatuko onsi otoe omogati oyio.”

English: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mimi ndimi mkate wa uzima. Yeye ajaye kwangu, hataona njaa kamwe na yeye aniaminiye, hataona kiu kamwe.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inche nomogati bw’obogima; ere oyogocha ase ’nde takoigwa enchara nonya ng’ake, na ere oyoranyegene takorang’a nonya ng’ake.

English: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama nilivyowaambia, mmeniona lakini bado hamwamini.
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ng’a mwandorire, ko timonyegeneti.

English: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
Kiswahili: Wale wote anipao Baba watakuja kwangu na yeyote ajaye kwangu, sitamfukuzia nje kamwe.
Ekegusii: Bonsi aba Tata akong’a nabache ase ’nde, na ere oyogocha ase ’nde tinkomotuguta isiko nonya ng’ake.

English: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nimeshuka kutoka mbinguni si ili kufanya mapenzi yangu, bali mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: Naki naikire korwa igoro, tari ase ogokora ogwancha kwane omonyene, korende ogwancha kwaye oyontomete.

English: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma, kwamba, nisimpoteze hata mmoja wa wale alionipa, bali niwafufue siku ya mwisho.
Ekegusii: Naende ogwancha kwaye Tata oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a ase bonsi ang’eire tinsiria nonya noyomo, korende mbabokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.

English: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mapenzi ya Baba yangu ni kwamba kila mmoja amtazamaye, Mwana na kumwamini awe na uzima wa milele, nami nitawafufua siku ya mwisho.”
Ekegusii: Nogwancha kwaye oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a kera oyokorigereria Omwana na komwegena, nabe nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.”

English: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakaanza kunungʼunika kwa kuwa alisema, “Mimi ndimi mkate ulioshuka kutoka mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamwemurunganeria, ekiagera ateebete, “Inche nomogati oigete korwa igoro.”

English: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”
Kiswahili: Wakasema, “Huyu si Yesu, mwana wa Yosefu, ambaye baba yake na mama yake tunawajua? Anawezaje basi sasa kusema, ‘Nimeshuka kutoka mbinguni’?”
Ekegusii: Bakaboora, “Oyo tari Yeso, omwana o Yusufu? Ntomanyete ise na ng’ina. Naki rende akobora: Naikire korwa igoro?”

English: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akawaambia, “Acheni kunungʼunikiana ninyi kwa ninyi.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Timwemurunganerania inwe ase inwe.

English: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu awezaye kuja kwangu kama asipovutwa na Baba aliyenituma, nami nitamfufua siku ya mwisho.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde tari oranyare gocha ase ’nde, atang’usiri na Tata oyontomete, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.

English: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.
Kiswahili: Imeandikwa katika Manabii, ‘Wote watafundishwa na Mungu.’ Yeyote amsikilizaye Baba na kujifunza kutoka kwake, huyo huja kwangu.
Ekegusii: Nerikire nababani: Bonsi naborokererigwe na Nyasae. Kera oyoigure na kworokererigwa na Tata, nigo agocha ase ’nde.

English: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Baba isipokuwa yeye atokaye kwa Mungu, yeye ndiye peke yake aliyemwona Baba.
Ekegusii: Tari ng’a monto ororire Tata, otatiga ere oyorure ase Nyasae, oyio nere ororire Tata.

English: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeye anayeamini anao uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ere oyonyegenete inche nare nobogima bwa kare na kare.

English: I am the bread of life.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mkate wa uzima.
Ekegusii: Inche nomogati bw’obogima.

English: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.
Kiswahili: Baba zenu walikula mana jangwani, lakini wakafa.
Ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaino nchiariete mana ase erooro, na barabwo bagakwa.

English: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
Kiswahili: Lakini hapa kuna mkate utokao mbinguni, ambao mtu yeyote akiula, hatakufa.
Ekegusii: Oyo noro omogati oikire korwa igoro ng’a monto onde bwensi orayorie, tagokwa.

English: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mkate wa uzima ule uliotoka mbinguni. Mtu yeyote akiula mkate huu, ataishi milele. Mkate huu ni mwili wangu, ambao nitautoa kwa ajili ya uzima wa ulimwengu.”
Ekegusii: Inche nomogati bw’obogima oyoigete korwa igoro; omonto kararie omogati oyio, nabe moyo goika kare na kare; na omogati ndarue inche, ase engencho y’obogima bw’ense, nomobere one.”

English: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakaanza kuhojiana vikali wao kwa wao wakisema, “Mtu huyu awezaje kutupatia mwili wake tuule?”
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Naki omonto oyo aranyare gotoa omobere oye toyorie?”

English: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, msipoula mwili wa Mwana wa Adamu na kuinywa damu yake, hamna uzima ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene nabateebirie: Motarieti omobere oye Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto na konywa amanyinga aye, timori nobogima ime yaino.

English: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote aulaye mwili wangu na kunywa damu yangu, anao uzima wa milele. Nami nitamfufua siku ya mwisho.
Ekegusii: Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio,

English: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mwili wangu ni chakula cha kweli na damu yangu ni kinywaji cha kweli.
Ekegusii: ekiagera omobere one nendagera y’ekeene, na amanyinga aane nekenyugwa gi’ekeene.

English: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
Kiswahili: Yeyote alaye mwili wangu na kunywa damu yangu, atakaa ndani yangu nami nitakaa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nigo akomenya ime yane, na inche ime yaye.

English: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Baba aliye hai alivyonituma mimi, na kama nami ninavyoishi kwa sababu ya Baba, hivyo anilaye mimi ataishi kwa sababu yangu.
Ekegusii: Buna Tata are moyo antomete, na inche inde moyo ase engencho ya Tata, naboigo oyokondia, nabe moyo ase engencho yane.

English: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
Kiswahili: Huu ndio mkate ushukao kutoka mbinguni, si kama ule mkate baba zenu waliokula nao wakafa. Lakini yeye aulaye mkate huu ataishi milele.”
Ekegusii: Oyio nomogati oigete korwa igoro, tari buna chisokoro chiaino chiariete mana, bagakwa; oyorarie omogati oyio nabe moyo goika kare na kare.”

English: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
Kiswahili: Yesu alisema maneno haya alipokuwa akifundisha katika sinagogi huko Kapernaumu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nigo ayakwanete ase esinagogi, kaare kworokereria aria Kapernaumu.

English: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
Kiswahili: Wengi wa wafuasi wake waliposikia jambo hili wakasema, “Mafundisho haya ni magumu. Ni nani awezaye kuyapokea?”
Ekegusii: Abange ase aborokigwa baye ekero bariigwa, bakaboora, “Ring’ana eri nerikong’u, ning’o oranyare koritegerera?”

English: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
Kiswahili: Yesu alipojua kwamba wafuasi wake wananungʼunika kuhusu mafundisho yake, akawaambia, “Je, jambo hili limewaudhi?
Ekegusii: Ko Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a aborokigwa baye bemurunganeirie ring’ana eri, akababoria, “Ring’ana eri ndiabagochire?

English: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
Kiswahili: Ingekuwaje basi kama mngemwona Mwana wa Adamu akipaa kwenda zake huko alipokuwa kwanza?
Ekegusii: Naki erabe rende, komorarore Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto okogenda aaria aase arenge ritang’ani?

English: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
Kiswahili: Roho ndiye atiaye uzima, mwili haufai kitu. Maneno haya niliyowaambia ni Roho tena ni uzima.
Ekegusii: Omoika noro okobeeka obogima, omobere togwenereti gento; amang’ana nabateebirie n’Omoika, naende nobogima.

English: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
Kiswahili: Lakini baadhi yenu hamwamini.” Kwa maana Yesu alifahamu tangu mwanzo wale ambao hawangemwamini miongoni mwao na yule ambaye angemsaliti.
Ekegusii: Korende mbare abande ase egati yaino bategeneti.” Naki Yeso amanyete korwa omochakano mbarabi abategeneti, naende ning’o orache komorua.

English: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Hii ndiyo sababu niliwaambia kwamba hakuna mtu awezaye kuja kwangu isipokuwa amejaliwa na Baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Eke nakio gekogera nabateebia, ng’a omonto onde tari oranyare gocha ase ’nde, otatiga oeirwe na Tata one.”

English: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati huo wafuasi wake wengi wakarejea nyuma wakaacha kumfuata.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio abange ase aborokigwa baye bakairana magega, tibamotunyana naende.

English: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yesu akawauliza wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili, “Je, ninyi pia mnataka kuondoka?”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akaboria baria ikomi na babere, “Nainwe boigo morigetie kogenda?”

English: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akamjibu, “Bwana, tuondoke twende kwa nani? Wewe unayo maneno ya uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamoiraneria, “Omonene! Togende ase ng’o? Aye nore namang’ana y’obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Kiswahili: Tunaamini na kujua kuwa wewe ndiwe Aliye Mtakatifu wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Na intwe twegenire na komanya ng’a aye naye Omochenu o Nyasae.”

English: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akajibu, “Je, sikuwachagua ninyi kumi na wawili? Lakini mmoja wenu ni ibilisi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Tinabachorete inwe ikomi na babere, na oyomo oino Saitani?”

English: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
Kiswahili: (Hapa alikuwa anasema juu ya Yuda, mwana wa Simoni Iskariote. Ingawa alikuwa mmoja wa wale kumi na wawili, ndiye ambaye baadaye angemsaliti Yesu.)
Ekegusii: Nigo akwanete igoro ya Yudasi, omwana o Simioni Iskariota, ekiagera oyo nere orache komorua; na ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.

English: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mambo haya, Yesu alikwenda sehemu mbalimbali za Galilaya. Hakutaka kwenda Uyahudi kwa sababu Wayahudi huko walitaka kumuua.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akaba ogotaara ase Galili; naki tarigetie gotaara ase Boyahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi nigo barenge korigia komoita.

English: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
Kiswahili: Sikukuu ya Vibanda ya Wayahudi ilikuwa imekaribia.
Ekegusii: Naende rituko rinene ri’Ebigutu ri’Abayahudi nigo riarenge ang’e.

English: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ndugu zake Yesu wakamwambia, “Ondoka hapa uende Uyahudi ili wanafunzi Wako wapate kuona miujiza unayofanya.
Ekegusii: Bamura bamwabo bakamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aiga, ogende Boyahudi, erinde aborokigwa bao banyare korora emeremo yao ogokora.

English: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
Kiswahili: Mtu anayetaka kujulikana hafanyi mambo yake kwa siri. Kama unafanya mambo haya, jionyeshe kwa ulimwengu.”
Ekegusii: Naki monto onde tari ogokora ring’ana bobisi onye ere omonyene origetie komanyekana. Kogokora aya eorokie ase ense.”

English: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
Kiswahili: Hata ndugu zake mwenyewe hawakumwamini.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya mbamura bamwabo tibamwegenete.

English: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wakati wangu bado haujawadia, lakini wakati wenu upo siku zote.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekero kiane tikeraika, korende ekero kiaino botambe nkereo.

English: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
Kiswahili: Ulimwengu hauwezi kuwachukia ninyi, lakini unanichukia mimi kwa sababu ninawashuhudia kwamba matendo yao ni maovu.
Ekegusii: Ense tekonyara kobagecha inwe, korende nigo engechete inche, ekiagera inche nkoyeorokia ng’a emeremo yaye nemebe.

English: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
Kiswahili: Ninyi nendeni kwenye Sikukuu, lakini mimi sitahudhuria Sikukuu hii kwa sababu wakati wangu haujawadia.”
Ekegusii: Genda inwe abanyene ase rituko rinene; tindi gotiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, ekiagera ekero kiane tikeraika.”

English: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
Kiswahili: Akiisha kusema hayo, akabaki Galilaya.
Ekegusii: Agachia gokoora kobateebia aya, agatigara Galili.

English: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu zake walipokwisha kuondoka kwenda kwenye Sikukuu, yeye pia alikwenda lakini kwa siri.
Ekegusii: Goika ekero abamwabo bachia gotiira, nere boigo agatiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, tari maiso marore, korende ase bobisi.

English: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi walikuwa wakimtafuta huko kwenye Sikukuu na kuulizana, “Yuko wapi huyu mtu?”
Ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamorigia ase rituko erio bakobora, “Ng’ai are oyio?”

English: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na minongʼono iliyoenea kumhusu Yesu katika umati wa watu, wakati wengine wakisema, “Ni mtu mwema.” Wengine walikuwa wakisema, “La, yeye anawadanganya watu.”
Ekegusii: Okwemurungania okonene gokaba ase egati y’omoganda ase engencho yaye. Abande bakaboora, “Nigo are omonto omuya,” na abande bakaboora, “Taibo, korende nigo agotantania omoganda.”

English: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
Kiswahili: Lakini hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemsema waziwazi kumhusu kwa sababu ya kuwaogopa Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Korende omonto tari omwatorete maiso marore ase engencho y’okoiroka Abayahudi.

English: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
Kiswahili: Ilipokaribia katikati ya Sikukuu, Yesu alipanda kwenda Hekaluni na kuanza kufundisha.
Ekegusii: Goika egachia koba gati‐gati ye Rituko Rinene Yeso agatiira, agasoa Hekalu ime akorokereria.

English: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakastaajabia mafundisho yake wakasema, “Mtu huyu amepataje kujua mambo haya bila kufundishwa?”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bagakumia ase aya, bakaboora, “Naki amanyete chisemi, na ere tasometigwe?”

English: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawajibu, “Mafundisho yangu si yangu mwenyewe, bali yanatoka kwake yeye aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Okworokereria kwane tari okwane, korende nokwaye ere oyontomete.

English: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote akipenda kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu, atajua kama mafundisho yangu yanatoka kwa Mungu au ninasema kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Omonto karanche gokora ogwancha kwaye, namanye gose okworokereria oko nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae, gose nigo ngokwana ase okobua kwane omonyene.

English: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
Kiswahili: Wale wanenao kwa ajili yao wenyewe hufanya hivyo kwa kutaka utukufu wao wenyewe. Lakini yeye atafutaye utukufu wa yule aliyemtuma ni wa kweli, wala hakuna uongo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Ere oyogokwana ase okobua kwaye omonyene nigo akorigia obonene bwaye omonyene; korende ere oyokorigia obonene bw’oria omotomete, nigo are oyo bw’ekeene, na asare obong’ainereria tiboiyo.

English: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
Kiswahili: Je, Mose hakuwapa ninyi sheria? Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wenu anayeishika hiyo sheria. Kwa nini mnataka kuniua?”
Ekegusii: Inee! Musa tabaete amachiiko? Korende onde oino tari oyobwatete amachiiko. Nase ki mokorigia kong’ita?”

English: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukamjibu, “Wewe una pepo mchafu! Ni nani anayetaka kukuua?”
Ekegusii: Omoganda okairaneria, “Nore nekerecha! Ning’o okorigia kogoita?”

English: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nimefanya muujiza mmoja na nyote mkastaajabu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nakorete ogokora okomo, na inwe mwensi nigo mogokumetie.

English: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kuwa Mose aliwaamuru tohara (ingawa kwa kweli haikutoka kwa Mose bali kwa baba zenu wakuu), mnamtahiri mtoto hata siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Musa akabaa okwaroka (tari ng’a nigo korwete ase Musa, korende ase chisokoro chiaino), na inwe nigo mogosara omonto ase rituko ri’Esabato.

English: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtoto aweza kutahiriwa siku ya Sabato kusudi sheria ya Mose isivunjwe, kwa nini mnanikasirikia kwa kumponya mtu mwili wake wote siku ya Sabato?
Ekegusii: Gaki onye omonto okwarokigwa rituko ri’Esabato, erinde amachiiko a Musa tasareka; naki mokombea ekiagera nakora omobere bwonsi bw’omonto koba omogima kegima rituko ri’Esabato?

English: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
Kiswahili: Acheni kuhukumu mambo kwa jinsi mnavyoona tu, bali hukumuni kwa haki.”
Ekegusii: Timogamba ekiina ase engencho y’ekieni, korende nacha ekiina ase oboronge.”

English: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
Kiswahili: Ndipo baadhi ya watu wa Yerusalemu wakawa wanasema, “Tazameni, huyu si yule mtu wanayetaka kumuua?
Ekegusii: Abande ase abanto ba Yerusalemu bakaboora, “Oyo tari ere omonto oria bakorigia goita?

English: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
Kiswahili: Mbona yuko hapa anazungumza hadharani na wala hawamwambii neno lolote? Je, inawezekana viongozi wanafahamu kuwa huyu ndiye Kristo?
Ekegusii: Nao are aa gokwana maiso marore gose tibari komoteebia ing’ana? Aande gose abanene bamanyire bori ng’a nere Kristo?

English: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
Kiswahili: Tunafahamu huyu mtu anakotoka, lakini Kristo atakapokuja, hakuna yeyote atakayejua atokako.”
Ekegusii: Na oyo twamomanyire aase arure, korende Kristo karache, onde tari oramanye aase akorwa.”

English: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu, akaendelea kufundisha Hekaluni, akisema, “Ninyi mnanifahamu na kujua nitokako. Mimi sikuja kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, bali yeye aliyenituma ni wa kweli na ninyi hammjui.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agaaka eriogi riaye ase Hekalu ime, okworokereria, okobora, “Inche momanyete, na aase narure mwaamanyire, naende tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene, oyio motamanyeti inwe.

English: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
Kiswahili: Mimi namjua kwa kuwa nimetoka kwake, naye ndiye alinituma.”
Ekegusii: Korende inche nimomanyete, ekiagera naruete asare, nere ontomire.”

English: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakatafuta kumkamata, lakini hakuna mtu yeyote aliyethubutu kumshika kwa sababu saa yake ilikuwa bado haijawadia.
Ekegusii: Igo bakarigia komobwata, korende onde tari oramborete okoboko kwaye, erinde amobwate, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika.

English: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
Kiswahili: Nao watu wengi wakamwamini, wakasema, “Je, Kristo atakapokuja, atafanya miujiza mikuu zaidi kuliko aliyoifanya mtu huyu?”
Ekegusii: Abanto abange ase omoganda bakamwegena, bakaboora, “Inee! Kristo ekero arachiche nakore ebikone ebinge mono kobua ebi iga oyo akorire?”

English: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo wakasikia watu wakinongʼona mambo kama hayo kuhusu Yesu, ndipo wao pamoja na viongozi wa makuhani wakatuma walinzi wa Hekalu waende kumkamata.
Ekegusii: Abafarisai bakaigwa omoganda okwemurungania igoro yaye. Erio abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagatoma abarendi erinde bamobwate.

English: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Mimi bado niko pamoja nanyi kwa kitambo kidogo, kisha nitarudi kwake yeye aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabora, “Nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe, erio ningende asare ere oyontomete.

English: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
Kiswahili: Mtanitafuta lakini hamtaniona, nami niliko ninyi hamwezi kuja.”
Ekegusii: Namondigie, korende timokonyoora; na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao.”

English: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Huyu mtu anataka kwenda wapi ambako hatuwezi kumfuata? Je, anataka kwenda kwa Wayunani ambako baadhi ya watu wetu wametawanyikia, akawafundishe Wayunani?
Ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Oyo ng’ai aragende goika intwe titomonyoora? Nigo aragende ase Abagiriki abwo abaatananekire na kworokereria Abagiriki abwo?

English: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”
Kiswahili: Yeye ana maana gani anaposema, ‘Mtanitafuta lakini hamtaniona,’ na, ‘nami niliko ninyi hamwezi kuja’?”
Ekegusii: Ing’ana ki erio akwana: Namondigie, korende timokoonyora, na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao?”

English: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
Kiswahili: Siku ile ya mwisho ya Sikukuu, siku ile kuu, wakati Yesu akiwa amesimama huko, akapaza sauti yake akasema, “Kama mtu yeyote anaona kiu na aje kwangu anywe.
Ekegusii: Nase rituko ri’omoerio, Rituko riria Rinene, Yeso agatenena, agakwana neriogi rinene akabora, “Onye omonto ore nerang’o, tiga ache ase ’nde anywe!

English: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
Kiswahili: Yeyote aniaminiye mimi, kama Maandiko yasemavyo, vijito vya maji ya uzima vitatiririka ndani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Oyonyegenire inche, buna amariiko agoteeba, chindooche chi’amaache are moyo nachirue ase enkoro yaye.”

English: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposema haya alimaanisha Roho Mtakatifu ambaye wote waliomwamini wangempokea, kwani mpaka wakati huo, Roho alikuwa hajatolewa, kwa kuwa Yesu alikuwa bado hajatukuzwa.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo arikwanete igoro y’Omoika, ekiagera baria bamwegenire nabayonyore magega, ekiagera Omoika Omochenu konya toraruegwa, ekiagera Yeso konya taraegwa obonene.

English: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
Kiswahili: Waliposikia maneno hayo, baadhi ya watu miongoni mwa ule umati wakasema, “Hakika huyu ndiye yule Nabii.”
Ekegusii: Nabo abanto bande ase omoganda bagachia koigwa amang’ana ayio, bakaboora, “Oyo ase ekeene nomobani oria.”

English: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
Kiswahili: Wengine wakasema, “Huyu ndiye Kristo!” Lakini wengine wakauliza, “Je, Kristo kwao ni Galilaya?
Ekegusii: Abande bakaboora, “Oyo nere Kristo.” Korende abande bakaboora, “Inee! Kristo nigo ararwe Galili?

English: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
Kiswahili: Je, Maandiko hayasemi kwamba Kristo atakuja kutoka jamaa ya Daudi na kutoka Bethlehemu, mji alioishi Daudi?”
Ekegusii: Ririko tiriri goteeba ng’a Kristo nigo ararwe ase oroiboro rwa Daudi, naende ase Bethlehemu, agachie karia Daudi amenyete?”

English: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo watu wakagawanyika kwa ajili ya Yesu.
Ekegusii: Erio ogwatananekana kogasoa ase omoganda ase engencho yaye.

English: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
Kiswahili: Baadhi yao walitaka kumkamata, lakini hakuna aliyethubutu kumgusa.
Ekegusii: Abande ase barabwo bakarigia komobwata; korende monto onde taramborete okoboko kwaye erinde amobwate.

English: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
Kiswahili: Hatimaye wale walinzi wa Hekalu wakarudi kwa viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo waliokuwa wamewatuma ili kumkamata Yesu, wakaulizwa, “Mbona hamkumkamata?”
Ekegusii: Abarendi baria bakairana ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, na barabwo bakababoria, “Naki motamorenta?”

English: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
Kiswahili: Wale walinzi wakajibu, “Kamwe hajanena mtu yeyote kama yeye anenavyo.”
Ekegusii: Abarendi baria bakairaneria, “Tana gokwana monto onde bwensi buna oyo agokwana!”

English: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo wakajibu, “Je, nanyi pia mmedanganyika?
Ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakabairaneria, Inee! Nainwe boigo mwatantanigwe?

English: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?
Kiswahili: Je, kuna kiongozi yeyote au mmoja wa Mafarisayo ambaye amemwamini?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ase abanene baito omwegenire, gose ase Abafarisai?

English: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”
Kiswahili: Lakini huu umati wa watu wasiojua Sheria ya Mose, wamelaaniwa.”
Ekegusii: Korende omoganda oyio, otamanyeti amachiiko, oragererigwe.

English: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Nikodemo, yule aliyekuwa amemwendea Yesu siku moja usiku, ambaye alikuwa mmoja wao akauliza,
Ekegusii: Nikodemo, oria omochierete botuko, oyorenge oyomo ase bare, akababoria,

English: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
Kiswahili: “Je, sheria zetu zinaturuhusu kumhukumu mtu kabla ya kumsikiliza na kufahamu alilotenda?”
Ekegusii: “Inee! Ogochika gwaito nkonachera kore omonto ekiina ritang’ani totaramoigwa na komanya egiakora?”

English: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Je, wewe pia unatoka Galilaya? Chunguza nawe utaona kwamba hakuna nabii atokae Galilaya!”
Ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Inee! Naye boigo Galili kwarwa? Rigia, orore ng’a mobani takorwa Galili.”

English: Everyone went to his own house,
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaondoka, kila mtu akarudi nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Bakagenda kera omonto bwoye.

English: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu akaenda katika Mlima wa Mizeituni.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso akagenda ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.

English: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.
Kiswahili: Alfajiri na mapema Yesu akaja tena Hekaluni, watu wote wakakusanyika, akakaa akaanza kuwafundisha.
Ekegusii: Mambia chuni agasoa naende Hekalu ime. Abanto bonsi bakamochiera, na ere agaikaransa, akaborokereria.

English: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,
Kiswahili: Walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wakamleta mwanamke mmoja aliyefumaniwa akizini. Wakamsimamisha katikati ya umati wa watu wote.
Ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bakarenta omokungu obwatetwe ase obotomani. Kabamobekire gati‐gati,

English: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, huyu mwanamke amekutwa akizini.
Ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, omokungu oyo nigo abwatwa kagokora obotomani.

English: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
Kiswahili: Katika sheria, Mose alituamuru kuwapiga kwa mawe wanawake wa namna hii, mpaka wafe. Sasa wewe wasemaje?”
Ekegusii: Nabo ase amachiiko Musa atochigeete kobaaka amagena abakungu banga buna oyo, naki aye ogoteeba igoro asare?”

English: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
Kiswahili: Walimuuliza swali hili kama mtego ili wapate sababu ya kumshtaki. Lakini Yesu akainama akaanza kuandika ardhini kwa kidole chake.
Ekegusii: Bagateeba ring’ana eri ase okomoteema, banyore enchera bakomosoera. Korende Yeso agekumba, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.

English: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
Kiswahili: Walipoendelea kumuulizauliza akainuka, akawaambia, “Kama kuna mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye hana dhambi na awe wa kwanza kumtupia jiwe.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo kobamentire komoboria, akagororoka, akabateebia, “Ere oyotari nebibe ase egati yaino abe oyo bw’eritang’ani komoruta rigena.”

English: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
Kiswahili: Akainama tena na kuandika ardhini.
Ekegusii: Agekumba naende, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.

English: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia haya, wakaanza kuondoka mmoja mmoja, wakianzia wazee, hadi Yesu akabaki peke yake na yule mwanamke akiwa amesimama mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia koyaigwa, bagasoka oyomo ase oyomo, abagaaka nabwo bachaagete. Yeso bweka agatigara, na omokungu oria oteneine gati‐gati.

English: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akainuka na kumwambia, “Wako wapi wale waliokuwa wanakuhukumu kuwa mwenye hatia?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akagororoka tarora monto onde otatiga omokungu oria, akamobooria, “Omokungu, ng’ai abasoeri bao bare? Onde tari ogokogambia?”

English: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
Kiswahili: Yule mwanamke akajibu, “Hakuna hata mmoja Bwana.” Yesu akamwambia, “Hata mimi sikuhukumu. Nenda zako, kuanzia sasa usitende dhambi tena.”
Ekegusii: Akamoiraneria, “Onde tari, Omonene.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Na inche tingokogambia. Genda, korende tokora ebibe naende.”

English: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akasema nao tena akawaambia, “Mimi ni nuru ya ulimwengu. Mtu yeyote akinifuata hatatembea gizani kamwe, bali atakuwa na nuru ya uzima.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agakwana nabarabwo naende, akabora, “Inche nomobaso bw’ense; oyogontunyana takogenda ase omosunte, korende nabe nomobaso bw’obogima.”

English: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo wakamwambia, “Ushuhuda wako haukubaliki kwa kuwa unajishuhudia mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakamoteebia, “Aye nigo okwebera kirori omonyene, na oborori bwao tibori obw’ekeene.”

English: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Hata kama najishuhudia mwenyewe, ushuhuda wangu ni kweli kwa sababu najua nilikotoka na ninakokwenda. Lakini ninyi hamjui nilikotoka wala ninakokwenda.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Nonya ngwekwana inche omonyene, oborori bwane nobw’ekeene, ekiagera namanyire aase narure, na aase nkogenda; korende inwe timomanyeti aase narure, gose aase ngochia.

English: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnahukumu kwa kufuata vipimo vya kibinadamu, mimi simhukumu mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogambia ase okobwatia amang’ana a Mwanyabaanto; inche tindi kogambia omonto.

English: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata kama nikihukumu, uamuzi wangu ni sahihi kwa sababu sitoi hukumu yangu peke yangu, bali niko pamoja na Baba, aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: Naende ninsa kogamba, okogamba kwane nogw’ekeene, ekiagera tari inche bweka nkogamba, korende ninche na Tata oyontomete.

English: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
Kiswahili: Imeandikwa katika Sheria yenu kwamba, ushahidi wa watu wawili ni thabiti.
Ekegusii: Naende ase amachiiko aino nigo ariikire ng’a oborori bw’abaanto babere nobw’ekeene,

English: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
Kiswahili: Mimi najishuhudia mwenyewe, naye Baba aliyenituma hunishuhudia.”
Ekegusii: Inche ninche nkweorokia omonyene, nere Tata oyontomete nigo akong’orokia.”

English: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakamuuliza, “Huyo Baba yako yuko wapi?” Yesu akawajibu, “Ninyi hamnifahamu mimi ni nani, wala hammfahamu Baba yangu. Kama mngenifahamu mimi, mngemfahamu na Baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Erio bakamobooria, “Ng’ai Iso are?” Yeso akairaneria, “Timokomanya inche, nonya n’Tata timokomomanya, onye momanyete inche, anga mwamomanyire na Tata one.”

English: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
Kiswahili: Yesu alisema maneno haya alipokuwa akifundisha katika chumba cha hazina Hekaluni. Lakini hakuna mtu aliyemkamata kwa kuwa saa yake ilikuwa haijawadia.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya Yeso nigo ayakwanete, gakworokereria ase Hekalu, ase enyomba y’ekebekerero gi’esadaka; omonto tari omobwatete, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika.

English: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia tena, “Ninaenda zangu, nanyi mtanitafuta, lakini mtakufa katika dhambi zenu. Niendako mimi ninyi hamwezi kuja.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia naende, “Inche nkogenda nde, na inwe namondigie, namokwe ase ebibe biaino; aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao.”

English: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo wale Wayahudi wakasema, “Je, atajiua? Je, hii ndiyo sababu amesema, ‘Niendako mimi ninyi hamwezi kuja’?”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaboora, “Inee! Nigo areite, ekiagera akobora: Aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao?”

English: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Ninyi mmetoka chini, mimi nimetoka juu. Ninyi ni wa ulimwengu huu, mimi si wa ulimwengu huu.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe naba inse; inche noyo o igoro; inwe nab’ense eye; inche tindi oyo bw’ense eye.

English: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
Kiswahili: Niliwaambia kuwa mtakufa katika dhambi zenu, kwa maana msipoamini ya kwamba ‘Mimi Ndiye,’ mtakufa katika dhambi zenu.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nabateebia ng’a namokwe ase ebibe biaino. Onye timokwegena ng’a inche nere, namokwe ase ebibe biaino.”

English: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?” Naye Yesu akawajibu, “Mimi ndiye yule ambaye nimekuwa nikiwaambia tangu mwanzo.
Ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Naye ng’o?” Yeso akabairaneria, “Nonya nayio nabateebirie inwe korwa omochakano.

English: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
Kiswahili: Nina mambo mengi ya kusema juu yenu na mengi ya kuwahukumu. Lakini yeye aliyenituma ni wa kweli, nami nanena na ulimwengu niliyoyasikia kutoka kwake.”
Ekegusii: Ninde namange ngokwana na kogamba ase engencho yaino, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene; na inche aya naigwete korwa asare, naro nkoorokia ase ense.”

English: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
Kiswahili: Hawakuelewa kuwa alikuwa akiwaambia juu ya Baba yake wa Mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Tibamanya ng’a nigo are gokwana ase bare aya Ise.

English: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Mtakapokwisha kumwinua juu Mwana wa Adamu, ndipo mtakapojua kuwa, ‘Mimi ndiye yule niliyesema na kwamba mimi sitendi jambo lolote peke yangu bali ninasema yale tu ambayo Baba yangu amenifundisha.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ekero mwakoorire koimokereria igoro Omwana‐o‐mwanya banto, erio namomanye ng’a ninche ere, naende tindi gokora kende ase okobua kwane omonyene, korende buna Tata anyorokereretie, nabo ngokwana.

English: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
Kiswahili: Yeye aliyenituma yu pamoja nami, hajaniacha, kwa kuwa siku zote nafanya mapenzi yake.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ere oyontomete nigo are amo nainche, tantigeti inche bweka, ekiagera botambe nigo ngokora ayakomogwenera.”

English: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
Kiswahili: Wengi waliomsikia Yesu akisema maneno haya wakamwamini.
Ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, abange bakamwegena.

English: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
Kiswahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wale Wayahudi waliomwamini, “Kama mkidumu katika maneno yangu, mtakuwa wanafunzi wangu kweli kweli.
Ekegusii: Nabo Yeso agateebia Abayahudi baria bamwegenete, “Komoramenye ase ring’ana riane, nigo more aborokigwa baane b’ekeene,

English: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtaijua kweli nayo kweli itawaweka huru.”
Ekegusii: naende namomanye ekeene, na kerokio nakebasibore.”

English: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
Kiswahili: Wao wakamjibu, “Sisi tu wazao wa Abrahamu, nasi hatujawa watumwa wa mtu yeyote. Wawezaje kusema kwamba tutawekwa huru?”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Igo tore oroiboro rwa Aburaamu, na titoraba abasomba b’omonto kero kende gionsi, inaki rende ogoteeba: Namokorwe abasibore?”

English: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Amin, amin nawaambia, kila atendaye dhambi ni mtumwa wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Onde bwensi ogokora ebibe, oyio nomosomba bw’ebibe,

English: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
Kiswahili: Mtumwa hakai nyumbani anakotumika siku zote, lakini mwana hukaa nyumbani daima.
Ekegusii: naende omosomba tari komenya nyomba botambe, korende omobiare nigo akomenya botambe.

English: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mwana akiwaweka huru mtakuwa huru kweli kweli.
Ekegusii: Gaki Omwana karabasibore, namobe abasibore kegima.

English: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
Kiswahili: Ninajua ya kuwa ninyi ni wazao wa Abrahamu, lakini mnatafuta wasaa wa kuniua kwa sababu ndani yenu hamna nafasi ya neno langu.
Ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a nigo more oroiboro rwa Aburaamu; korende nigo mokorigia kong’ita, ekiagera ring’ana riane tirinyoreti ibaga ime yaino.

English: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
Kiswahili: Ninasema yale niliyoyaona mbele za Baba yangu, nanyi inawapa kufanya yale mliyosikia kutoka kwa baba yenu.”
Ekegusii: Aya narorire ase Tata naro ngokwana; nainwe naboigo ayamwarorire ase iso oino, naro mogokora.”

English: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
Kiswahili: Wakajibu, “Baba yetu ni Abrahamu.” Yesu akawaambia, “Kama mngekuwa wazao wa Abrahamu mngefanya mambo yale aliyofanya Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Tata oito nere Aburaamu.” Yeso akabateebia, “Onye nabana ba Aburaamu mware, anga mwakora emeremo ya Aburaamu.

English: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa ninyi mnatafuta kuniua, mtu ambaye nimewaambia kweli ile niliyosikia kutoka kwa Mungu, Abrahamu hakufanya jambo la namna hii.
Ekegusii: Korende bono morigetie kong’ita, ninche oyo nabateebirie ekeene keria naigure korwa ase Nyasae. Aburaamu takorete igo.

English: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnafanya mambo afanyayo baba yenu.” Wakamjibu, “Sisi hatukuzaliwa kwa uzinzi. Tunaye Baba mmoja, Mungu pekee.”
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogokora emeremo ya iso oino.” Bakamoteebia, “Intwe titoiboiri ase obonyaka; nigo tore na Tata oyomo, nere Nyasae.”

English: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Kama Mungu angekuwa Baba yenu, mngenipenda, kwa maana nilitoka kwa Mungu na sasa niko hapa. Sikuja kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, ila yeye alinituma.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Onye Nyasae n’Iso oino are, anga imonyanchete inche; naki narure ase Nyasae, na igo nachire; gose tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende nere ontomire.

English: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini hamwelewi ninayowaambia? Ni kwa sababu hamwezi kusikia nisemacho.
Ekegusii: Naki motamanyeti amang’ana aane aya ngokwana? Nekiagera motancheti koigwa ring’ana riane.

English: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
Kiswahili: Ninyi ni watoto wa baba yenu ibilisi, nanyi mnataka kutimiza matakwa ya baba yenu. Yeye alikuwa muuaji tangu mwanzo, wala hakushikana na kweli maana hamna kweli ndani yake. Asemapo uongo husema yaliyo yake mwenyewe kwa maana yeye ni mwongo na baba wa huo uongo.
Ekegusii: Inwe n’aba iso oino Saitani, na ogwancha kwaino nogokora okogania gwa iso. Ere nigo arenge omoiti korwa omochakano, gose tatenenete ase ekeene, ekiagera ekeene tikeri ime yaye. Kagokwana oborimo, nigo agokwana ayare ayaye omonyene, ekiagera nomonyaborimo, na ise bw’oborimo.

English: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu nimewaambia kweli hamkuniamini!
Ekegusii: Ekiagera inche ngokwana ekeene, timori konyegena.

English: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
Kiswahili: Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu awezaye kunithibitisha kuwa mwenye dhambi? Kama nawaambia yaliyo kweli, mbona hamniamini?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ase egati yaino okong’orokia ng’a ninde nebibe? Kongokwana ekeene, naki inwe motakonyegena?

English: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
Kiswahili: Yeye atokaye kwa Mungu husikia kile Mungu asemacho. Sababu ya ninyi kutosikia ni kwa kuwa hamtokani na Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Oyore o Nyasae nigo akoigwa amang’ana a Nyasae; nakio gekogera inwe motari koyaigwa: nekiagera motari aba Nyasae.”

English: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakamjibu Yesu, “Je, hatuko sahihi tunaposema ya kwamba wewe ni Msamaria na ya kwamba una pepo mchafu?”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titori gokwana boronge ng’a aye nigo ore Omosamaria, naende nigo obwatire nekerecha?”

English: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mimi sina pepo mchafu, bali ninamheshimu Baba yangu, nanyi mnanidharau.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inche timbwatiri nekerecha, korende nigo nsigete Tata one, na inwe timonsigeti.

English: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi sitafuti utukufu wangu mwenyewe, bali yuko anayetaka kunitukuza, naye ndiye mwamuzi.
Ekegusii: Inche tindi korigia obonene bwane; nare oyomo oyokoborigia, nere orabe omogambi.

English: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, mtu yeyote akilitii neno langu hataona mauti milele.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takorora amakweri nonya ng’ake.”

English: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
Kiswahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakamwambia, “Sasa tumejua kwamba una pepo mchafu. Ikiwa Abrahamu alikufa na vivyo hivyo manabii, nawe unasema ‘Mtu akitii neno langu hatakufa milele.’
Ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Bono twamanyire ng’a nigo obwatire nekerecha, Aburaamu okuure, na ababani, na aye nigo ogoteeba: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takoigwa amakweri nonya ng’ake.

English: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
Kiswahili: Je, wewe ni mkuu kuliko baba yetu Abrahamu ambaye alikufa na manabii ambao nao pia walikufa? Hivi wewe unajifanya kuwa nani?”
Ekegusii: Aye nomonene kobua sokoro yaito Aburaamu, oyo okuure? Naende nababani bakuure. Naye kogwekora obe ng’o?”

English: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Kama nikijitukuza utukufu wangu hauna maana. Baba yangu, huyo ambaye ninyi mnadai kuwa ni Mungu wenu, ndiye anitukuzaye mimi.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Kondetogie inche omonyene, obonene bwane tibori gento; oyogontogia n’Tata one, oyo mogoteeba ng’a nere Nyasae oino.

English: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.
Kiswahili: Ingawa hamkumjua, mimi ninamjua. Kama ningesema simjui, ningekuwa mwongo kama ninyi, lakini mimi ninamjua na ninalitii neno lake.
Ekegusii: Na inwe timomanyeti, korende inche nimomanyete. Kondatebe ng’a timomanyeti nimbe omonyaborimo buna inwe, korende nimomanyete, naende ring’ana riaye nindibwatete.

English: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”
Kiswahili: Baba yenu Abrahamu alishangilia kwamba angaliiona siku yangu, naye akaiona na akafurahi.”
Ekegusii: Aburaamu sokoro yaino nigo agogete ng’a nanyare korora rituko riane; akarirora, akagoka.”

English: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakamwambia, “Wewe hujatimiza hata miaka hamsini, wewe wasema umemwona Abrahamu?”
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Torakoora emiaka emerongo etano, na Aburaamu kwamororire?”

English: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, kabla Abrahamu hajakuwako, ‘Mimi niko.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ritang’ani Aburaamu atarabao, inche nao naare.”

English: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakaokota mawe ili kumpiga, lakini Yesu akajificha, naye akatoka Hekaluni.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia amagena bamorute, korende Yeso akebisa, agasoka korwa ase Hekalu.
