English: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipokuwa akipita, akamwona mtu aliyekuwa kipofu tangu kuzaliwa.
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia goeta akarora omonto orenge omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye.

English: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza, “Rabi, ni nani aliyetenda dhambi, ni huyu mtu au wazazi wake hata azaliwe kipofu?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Rabii, ning’o okorete ebibe, nomonto oyo, gose nabaibori baye, goika akaiborwa ore omouko?”

English: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Huyu mtu wala wazazi wake hawakutenda dhambi. Alizaliwa kipofu ili kazi za Mungu zidhihirishwe katika maisha yake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Oyo takorete ebibe, nonya nabaibori baye, korende aya akorekire, erinde emeremo ya Nyasae eorokigwe asare.

English: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
Kiswahili: Yanipasa kuzifanya kazi zake yeye aliyenituma wakati bado ni mchana, kwa kuwa usiku waja ambapo hakuna mtu awezaye kufanya kazi.
Ekegusii: Netogwenerete tokore emeremo yaye oyontomete ekero rire mobaso; obotuko ngocha bore, omonto atanyare gokora emeremo.

English: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
Kiswahili: Wakati niko ulimwenguni, mimi ni nuru ya ulimwengu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero inde ase ense, inche nomobaso bw’ense.”

English: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema haya, akatema mate ardhini, akatengeneza tope kwa mate na kumpaka yule mtu kipofu machoni.
Ekegusii: Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, agatwera amate inse, agakora etintira ase amate aria, agaaka omouko oria amaiso netintira eria,

English: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia, “Nenda ukanawe katika bwawa la Siloamu.” (Siloamu maana yake ni aliyetumwa.) Ndipo yule kipofu akaenda, akanawa, naye akarudi akiwa anaona.
Ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Genda bwesibie ase ritibo ria Siloamuu” (okoonchorwa kwaye, oyotomirwe). Erio akagenda agesibia, akairana okorora.

English: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
Kiswahili: Majirani zake na wale wote waliokuwa wamemwona hapo awali akiombaomba wakaanza kuuliza, “Je, huyu si yule aliyekuwa akiketi akiombaomba?”
Ekegusii: Nabo abagisangio baye, na baria bamorooche ekero arenge omosabereri bakaboora, “Inee! Oyo tari ere oria orenge oikaransete gosaberera?”

English: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
Kiswahili: Wengine wakasema, “Ndiye.” Wengine wakasema, “Siye, bali wamefanana.” Lakini yeye akawaambia, “Mimi ndiye.”
Ekegusii: Abande bakaboora, “Nere”; abande bakaboora, “Yaya, nigo agwekaine nere.” Ere omonyene akabora, “Ninche ere.”

English: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Basi macho yako yalifumbuliwaje?”
Ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Amaiso ao naki rende aramogetigwe?”

English: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
Kiswahili: Yeye akawajibu, “Yule mtu aitwaye Yesu alitengeneza tope, akanipaka machoni mwangu, naye akaniambia nenda ukanawe katika Bwawa la Siloamu, ndipo nikanawa nami nikapata kuona!”
Ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Omonto okorokwa Yeso okorete etintira, akang’aka amaiso aane, aganteebia: Genda ase ritibo ria Siloamuu, bwesibie; nabo nkagenda ngesibia, nkanyara korora.”

English: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
Kiswahili: Wale wakamuuliza, “Yeye huyo mtu yuko wapi?” Akawajibu, “Sijui.”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng’ai are oyio?” Akabora, “Timanyeti.”

English: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
Kiswahili: Wakamleta kwa Mafarisayo yule mtu aliyekuwa kipofu hapo awali.
Ekegusii: Bakamoira oria orenge omouko ritang’ani ase Abafarisai.

English: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
Kiswahili: Basi siku hiyo Yesu alipotengeneza tope na kuyafungua macho ya huyo mtu ilikuwa Sabato.
Ekegusii: Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Esabato ekero Yeso akorete etintira na komoramokia amaiso.

English: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
Kiswahili: Mafarisayo nao wakaanza kumuuliza alivyopata kuponywa. Naye akawaambia, “Alinipaka tope kwenye macho yangu, nikanawa na sasa ninaona.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai nabarabwo bakamobooria naende buna anyorete okorora. Akabateebia, “Nigo abegete etintira igoro ase amaiso aane, ngesibia, na bono nkorora nde.”

English: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakasema, “Huyu mtu hatoki kwa Mungu, kwa sababu hashiki Sabato.” Lakini wengine wakasema, “Awezaje mtu mwenye dhambi kufanya miujiza kama hii?” Wakagawanyika.
Ekegusii: Erio abande b’Abafarisai bakaboora, “Omonto oyo tarwete ase Nyasae, ekiagera tabwateti Esabato.” Abande bakaboora, “Naki omonto omonyene ebibe aranyare gokora ebikone buna ebi?” Ogwatananekana gokaba ase egati yabo.

English: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakamwambia tena yule mtu aliyekuwa kipofu, “Wewe ndiwe uliyefumbuliwa macho, wasemaje kuhusu mtu huyo?” Maana macho yako ndiyo yaliyofumbuliwa. Yeye akawajibu, “Yeye ni nabii.”
Ekegusii: Bakaboria omouko oria eria kabere, “Aye naki okobora asare, ekiagera akoramokia amaiso?” Akabora, “Nigo are omobani.”

English: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
Kiswahili: Wale Wayahudi hawakuamini ya kuwa mtu huyo alikuwa kipofu, akapata kuona, mpaka walipowaita wazazi wake.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi tibeegena amang’ana aye, ng’a nigo arenge omouko, naende anyarete korora, goika bakarangeria abaibori baye oria onyorete okorora,

English: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
Kiswahili: Wakawauliza, “Je, huyu ni mtoto wenu, ambaye mnasema alizaliwa kipofu? Imekuwaje basi sasa anaona?”
Ekegusii: bakababoria, “Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteeba ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko? Naki akora orora bono?”

English: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
Kiswahili: Wazazi wake wakajibu, “Tunajua ya kuwa huyu ni mtoto wetu na ya kuwa alizaliwa kipofu.
Ekegusii: Abaibori baye bakairaneria, “Twamanyire ng’a oyo nomwana oito, naende ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko;

English: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi hatujui ni kwa jinsi gani kwamba sasa anaona, wala hatujui ni nani aliyemfungua macho yake. Muulizeni, yeye ni mtu mzima na anaweza kujieleza mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: korende buna anyara korora bono, titomanyeti, gose ning’o omoramokia amaiso, titomanyeti. Ere nomonto omogima, moborie omonyene, nekwanere.”

English: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wake walisema hivi kwa sababu waliwaogopa Wayahudi kwani walikuwa wamekubaliana kuwa mtu yeyote atakayemkiri Yesu kuwa ndiye Kristo atafukuzwa kutoka sinagogi.
Ekegusii: Abaibori baye nigo bakwanete aya ase okoiroka Abayahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi konya babwatanire, ng’a monto onde bwensi oramoorokie ng’a nere Kristo aserigwe korwa ase esinagogi.

English: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wazazi wake wakasema, “Yeye ni mtu mzima. Muulizeni.”
Ekegusii: Nero engencho yagerete abaibori baye bakaboora, “Ere nomonto omogima, moborie.”

English: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo kwa mara ya pili wakamwita yule aliyekuwa kipofu, nao wakamwambia, “Mpe Mungu utukufu! Sisi tunafahamu kuwa mtu huyu aliyekuponya ni mwenye dhambi.”
Ekegusii: Erio eria kabere bakarangeria omonto oria orenge omouko, bakamoteebia, “Moe Nyasae ogotogia; intwe twamanyire ng’a omonto oyio nomonyene ebibe.”

English: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Mimi sijui kama yeye ni mwenye dhambi. Lakini jambo moja ninalojua, nilikuwa kipofu na sasa ninaona.”
Ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akairaneria, “Onye ere nomonyene ebibe, timanyeti; ring’ana erimo namanyire, inche nigo narenge omouko, korende bono nkorora nde.”

English: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza, “Alikufanyia nini? Aliyafumbuaje macho yako?”
Ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Naki agokorerete? Naki akoramogetie amaiso?”

English: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”
Kiswahili: Akawajibu, “Tayari nimekwisha kuwaambia, nanyi hamtaki kunisikiliza. Mbona mnataka kusikia tena? Je, ninyi nanyi mnataka kuwa wanafunzi wake?”
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Naikire kobateebia, ko timontegerereti. Naki morigetie koyaigwa eria kabere? Inwe boigo morigetie koba aborokigwa baye?”

English: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakamtukana na kusema, “Wewe ndiwe mwanafunzi wake, Sisi ni wanafunzi wa Mose.
Ekegusii: Erio bakamorama, bakaboora, “Naye ore omworokigwa oye, korerende intwe nigo tore aborokigwa ba Musa.

English: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”
Kiswahili: Tunajua kwamba Mungu alisema na Mose, lakini kwa habari ya mtu huyu hatujui atokako.”
Ekegusii: Intwe twamanyire ng’a Nyasae nigo arenge gokwana na Musa, korende oyo titomanyeti aase arure.”

English: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akawajibu, “Hili ni jambo la ajabu! Hamjui anakotoka, naye amenifungua macho yangu!
Ekegusii: Omonto oria akairaneria, “Ring’ana eri neri’ogokumia, ng’a inwe timomanyeti aase arure, na ere ondamokirie amaiso.

English: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.
Kiswahili: Tunajua ya kuwa Mungu hawasikilizi wenye dhambi, lakini huwasikiliza wote wanaomcha na kumtii.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Nyasae tari koigwa abanyene ebibe; korende omonto karabe omosasimi Nyasae, na gokora ogwancha kwaye, oyio nere Nyasae akoigwa.

English: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
Kiswahili: Tangu zamani hatujasikia kwamba mtu amemponya yeyote aliyezaliwa kipofu.
Ekegusii: Korwa omochakano teraigugwa ng’a omonto oramokirie amaiso ’omouko oiboretwe engencho eye.

English: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
Kiswahili: Kama huyu mtu hakutoka kwa Mungu, asingeweza kufanya lolote.”
Ekegusii: Onye oyo tarwete ase Nyasae, anga takonyara gokora gento.”

English: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.
Kiswahili: Wao wakamjibu, “Wewe ulizaliwa katika dhambi kabisa, nawe unajaribu kutufundisha?” Wakamfukuza atoke nje.
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwaiboretwe ase ebibe ebinene, na intwe ngotworokereria ore?” Bakamosokia isiko.

English: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
Kiswahili: Yesu aliposikia kuwa wamemfukuzia nje yule mtu aliyemfumbua macho, alimkuta akamuuliza, “Je, unamwamini Mwana wa Adamu?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akaigwa ng’a bamosokirie isiko, akamorora, akamobooria, “Aye kwamwegenire Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto?”

English: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akamjibu, “Yeye ni nani, Bwana? Niambie ili nipate kumwamini.”
Ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Ning’o oyio, Omonene, inyare komwegena?”

English: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Umekwisha kumwona, naye anayezungumza nawe, ndiye.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Kwamororire, naende nere oyogokwana naye nere oyio.”

English: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
Kiswahili: Yule mtu akasema, “Bwana, naamini.” Naye akamwabudu.
Ekegusii: Akabora, “Omonene, negenire”; akamosasiima.

English: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Nimekuja ulimwenguni humu kwa ajili ya kuhukumu, ili wale walio vipofu wapate kuona, nao wale wanaoona, wawe vipofu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Inche nigo nachire ase ense eye ase ekiina, erinde abatari korora barore, na barabwo abakorora babe emeuko.”

English: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo waliokuwa karibu naye wakamsikia na kumwambia, “Je, kweli sisi ni vipofu?”
Ekegusii: Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge amo nere bakaigwa aya, bakamobooria, “Inee! Naintwe nigo tore emeuko?”

English: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Kama mngekuwa vipofu kweli, msingekuwa na hatia ya dhambi, lakini kwa kuwa mnasema, ‘Tunaona,’ basi mna hatia.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Onye mwarenge emeuko, anga timori nebibe; korende bono nigo mogoteeba: Nkorora tore; gaki ebibe biaino biagendereire kobao.

English: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.
Kiswahili: “Amin, amin nawaambia, yeye asiyeingia katika zizi la kondoo kwa kupitia kwenye lango, lakini akwea kuingia ndani kwa njia nyingine, ni mwizi na mnyangʼanyi.
Ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyotasoereti egesieri ki’eero ye ching’ondi, korende aetere aao, oyio nomoibi naende nomokurumi.

English: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayeingia kwa kupitia kwenye lango ndiye mchungaji wa kondoo.
Ekegusii: Korende oyogosoera gesieri oyio nomorisia bwe ching’ondi.

English: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
Kiswahili: Mlinzi humfungulia lango na kondoo huisikia sauti yake. Huwaita kondoo wake kwa majina yao na kuwatoa nje ya zizi.
Ekegusii: Omorendi bw’egesieri nigo akomoigorera, ne ching’ondi nigo chikoigwa eriogi riaye; ere nigo akorangeria ching’ondi chiaye ase amarieta abo na gochiira isiko.

English: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
Kiswahili: Akiisha kuwatoa wote nje, hutangulia mbele yao na kondoo humfuata kwa kuwa wanaijua sauti yake.
Ekegusii: Gakorusia isiko ching’ondi echire echiaye, nigo agochitang’ana, ne ching’ondi nigo chikomotunyana, ekiagera nchimanyete eriogi riaye.

English: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kondoo hawatamfuata mgeni bali watamkimbia, kwa sababu hawaijui sauti ya mgeni.”
Ekegusii: Omonto omoao tichikomotunyana nonya ng’ake, korende nigo chiramotame, ekiagera tichimanyeti eriogi ri’abaanto abaao.”

English: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.
Kiswahili: Yesu alitumia mfano huu, lakini wao hawakuelewa hayo aliyokuwa akiwaambia.
Ekegusii: Omoreng’anio oyo Yeso akabateebia, korende barabwo tibamanyete amang’ana ayio abateebeetie.

English: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akasema nao tena akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, mimi ndimi lango la kondoo.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia naende, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ninche inde egesieri gie ching’ondi.

English: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
Kiswahili: Wote walionitangulia ni wevi na wanyangʼanyi, lakini kondoo hawakuwasikia.
Ekegusii: Bonsi abantang’anerete nabaibi na abakurumi, korende ching’ondi tichiabaigwete.

English: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.
Kiswahili: Mimi ndimi lango, yeyote anayeingia zizini kwa kupitia kwangu ataokoka, ataingia na kutoka, naye atapata malisho.
Ekegusii: Ninche inde egesieri; omonto karasoe goetera ase ’nde, natooreke, nasoe na gosoka, na konyora oborisia.

English: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
Kiswahili: Mwizi huja ili aibe, kuua na kuangamiza. Mimi nimekuja ili wapate uzima kisha wawe nao tele.
Ekegusii: Omoibi tagocha, otatiga aibe, na konyenya, na gosaria; inche nigo nachete erio babe nobogima, naende babe naborobwo ase obonge.

English: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi mchungaji mwema. Mchungaji mwema huutoa uhai wake kwa ajili ya kondoo.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche Omorisia omuya; omorisia omuya nigo akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho ye ching’ondi.

English: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.
Kiswahili: Mtu wa kuajiriwa sio mchungaji mwenye kondoo. Amwonapo mbwa mwitu akija, yeye hukimbia na kuwaacha kondoo. Naye mbwa mwitu hulishambulia kundi na kulitawanya.
Ekegusii: Omonto orikire, tari ere omorisia, gose ching’ondi tichiri echiaye; gakorora esese y’orosana egocha, nigo agotiga ching’ondi, otama, na esese y’orosana yachisakora, na gochiserebania.

English: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.
Kiswahili: Yeye hukimbia kwa sababu ameajiriwa wala hawajali kondoo.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agotama ekiagera nomorikwa, gose tarengerereti amang’ana e ching’ondi.

English: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi mchungaji mwema. Ninawajua kondoo wangu nao kondoo wangu wananijua.
Ekegusii: Inche ninche omorisia omuya, na echire echiane ninchimanyete,

English: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Baba anavyonijua mimi, nami ninavyomjua Baba, nami nautoa uhai wangu kwa ajili ya kondoo.
Ekegusii: buna Tata amanyete inche, na inche nimomanyete Tata, na obogima bwane naborure ase engencho ye ching’ondi.

English: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
Kiswahili: Ninao kondoo wengine ambao si wa zizi hili, inanipasa kuwaleta, nao wataisikia sauti yangu, hivyo patakuwa na kundi moja na mchungaji mmoja.
Ekegusii: Naende ching’ondi chinde mbwate, chitari chie riicho eri, na chirochio nabo engwenerete gochirenta, na eriogi riane nachiriigwe. Igo nachibe riicho erimo na omorisia oyomo.

English: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
Kiswahili: Baba yangu ananipenda kwa kuwa ninautoa uhai wangu ili niupate tena.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Tata nanyanchete, ekiagera narure obogima bwane, erinde inyare koboirania naende.

English: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu aniondoleaye uhai wangu, bali ninautoa kwa hiari yangu mwenyewe. Ninao uwezo wa kuutoa uhai wangu na pia ninao uwezo wa kuutwaa tena. Amri hii nimepewa na Baba yangu.”
Ekegusii: Tari omonto okobonduera, korende ninche omonyene naborure. Ninde nokobua koborua; naende ninde nokobua koboirania. Ogochika oko nigo nakonyorire ase Tata one.”

English: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
Kiswahili: Kwa maneno haya Wayahudi waligawanyika.
Ekegusii: Erio gokaba naende ogwatananekana ase Abayahudi ase engencho y’amang’ana aya.

English: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
Kiswahili: Wengi wao wakasema, “Huyu amepagawa na pepo mchafu, naye amechanganyikiwa.”
Ekegusii: Abange babo bakaboora, “Nigo abwatire nekerecha, naende nigo are ebarimo; nase ki mokomotegerera?”

English: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”
Kiswahili: Wengine wakasema, “Haya si maneno ya mtu aliyepagawa na pepo mchafu. Je, pepo mchafu aweza kufungua macho ya kipofu?”
Ekegusii: Abande bakaboora “Amang’ana aya tari ay’omonto obwatire nekerecha. Inee! Ekerecha nkenyare koramokia ’emeuko amaiso?”

English: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo ilikuwa Sikukuu ya Kuwekwa wakfu kwa Hekalu huko Yerusalemu, nao ulikuwa wakati wa majira ya baridi.
Ekegusii: Ndiarenge Rituko Rinene ri’okoinyora okoigorwa na ogosaberwa gwe Hekalu aria Yerusalemu.

English: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
Kiswahili: Naye Yesu alikuwa akitembea ndani ya Hekalu katika ukumbi wa Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Nigo kiarenge ekero ki’obokendu, na Yeso nigo arenge gotaara ase Hekalu ime, ase egoora ya Sulemani.

English: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakamkusanyikia wakamuuliza, “Utatuweka katika hali ya mashaka mpaka lini? Kama wewe ndiye Kristo tuambie waziwazi.”
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakamoetanana, bakamobooria, “Ngoika ririri oratoichanie emioyo yaito? Onye naye Kristo, toteebia maiso marore.”

English: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nimewaambia, lakini hamwamini. Mambo ninayoyatenda kwa jina la Baba yangu yananishuhudia.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nabatebirie, na inwe timori kwegena; emeremo eye ngokora ase erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori.

English: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
Kiswahili: Lakini hamwamini, kwa sababu ninyi si wa kundi la kondoo wangu.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe timori kwegena, ekiagera timori abamo ase ching’ondi chiane.

English: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
Kiswahili: Kondoo wangu huisikia sauti yangu nami nawajua, nao hunifuata,
Ekegusii: Ching’ondi chiane nigo chikoigwa eriogi riane, na inche ninchimanyete, na chirochio nigo chigontunyana;

English: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
Kiswahili: nami ninawapa uzima wa milele, hawataangamia kamwe wala hakuna mtu atakayewapokonya kutoka mikono yangu.
Ekegusii: inche nachieire obogima bwa kare na kare, na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng’ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa ase okoboko kwane.

English: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
Kiswahili: Baba yangu aliyenipa hawa ni mkuu kuliko wote na hakuna awezaye kuwapokonya kutoka mikononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Tata one oching’eire nomonene kobua bonsi, na onde takonyara gochitaboria korwa ase okoboko gwa Tata.

English: I and the Father are one.”
Kiswahili: Mimi na Baba yangu tu umoja.”
Ekegusii: Inche na Tata nigo tore oyomo.”

English: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
Kiswahili: Kwa mara nyingine Wayahudi wakainua mawe ili wampige nayo,
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaimokia amagena naende, erinde bamoake.

English: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
Kiswahili: lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Nimewaonyesha miujiza mingi mikubwa kutoka kwa Baba yangu. Ni ipi katika hiyo mnataka kunipiga mawe?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Naborokirie emeremo emiya emenge erwete ase Tata; nereri ase emeremo eyio mokong’akera amagena?”

English: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Hatukupigi mawe kwa sababu ya mambo mema uliyotenda, bali ni kwa kuwa umekufuru. Wewe ingawa ni mwanadamu unajifanya kuwa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titogokoaka amagena ase emeremo emiya, korende nase okorama, ekiagera aye nomonto ogwekora omonyene ng’a naye Nyasae.”

English: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, haikuandikwa katika Sheria ya kwamba, ‘Nimesema kuwa, ninyi ni miungu?’
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tarikiri ase amachiiko aino ng’a: Inche nateebete ng’a inwe nigo more chinyasae?

English: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
Kiswahili: Kama aliwaita ‘miungu,’ wale ambao neno la Mungu liliwafikia, nayo Maandiko hayawezi kutanguka,
Ekegusii: Onye orogete baria chinyasae, abacheretwe ne ring’ana ria Nyasae (na amariiko takonyara gosareka),

English: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
Kiswahili: je, mwawezaje kusema kwamba yule ambaye Baba amemweka wakfu na kumtuma ulimwenguni anakufuru, kwa sababu nilisema, ‘Mimi ni Mwana wa Mungu?’
Ekegusii: inee, nigo mogoteeba igoro yaye, ere oyo Tata aatananete akamotoma ase ense: Nkorama are, ekiagera nateba: Inche n’Omwana o Nyasae?

English: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa sifanyi kazi za Baba yangu, basi msiniamini,
Ekegusii: Onye tindi gokora emeremo ya Tata one, timonyegena.

English: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
Kiswahili: lakini ikiwa nazifanya kazi za Mungu, hata kama hamniamini mimi ziaminini hizo kazi, ili mpate kujua na kuelewa kwamba Baba yu ndani yangu, nami ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Korende konda yekore, nonya timonyegeneti inche, egene emeremo eria, monyare komanya na kwegena ng’a Tata nigo are ime yane, na inche ime ase Tata.”

English: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakajaribu kumkamata kwa mara nyingine, lakini akaponyoka kutoka mikononi mwao.
Ekegusii: Bakarigia eria kabere komobwata, korende akarua ase amaboko abo.

English: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
Kiswahili: Akaenda tena ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani mpaka mahali pale ambapo Yohana alikuwa akibatiza hapo awali, naye akakaa huko.
Ekegusii: Akagenda naende ng’umbu ya Yorodani goika aase aria Yohana arenge kobatisera ritang’ani, akabeera aroro.

English: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
Kiswahili: Watu wengi wakamjia, nao wakawa wakisema, “Yohana hakufanya muujiza wowote, lakini kila jambo alilosema kumhusu huyu mtu ni kweli.”
Ekegusii: Abanto abange bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Yohana takorete egekone kende gionsi, korende onsi aya Yohana ateebete igoro y’omonto oyo nigo are ay’ekeene.”

English: Many believed in him there.
Kiswahili: Nao wengi wakamwamini Yesu huko.
Ekegusii: Abange bakamwegena aroro.

English: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
Kiswahili: Basi mtu mmoja jina lake Lazaro alikuwa mgonjwa. Yeye alikuwa akiishi Bethania kijiji cha Maria na Martha dada zake.
Ekegusii: Nabo omonto gete narenge omorwaire, erieta riaye Lazaro o Bethania, omonto bw’omochie o Mariamu na Martha mosubati omwabo.

English: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
Kiswahili: Huyu Maria, ambaye Lazaro kaka yake alikuwa mgonjwa, ndiye yule ambaye alimpaka Bwana mafuta na kuifuta miguu yake kwa nywele zake.
Ekegusii: Mariamu nere oyo oagete Omonene amaguta na komotinyia amagoro aye netukia yaye. Bono Lazaro momura omwabo nigo arenge omorwaire.

English: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo hawa dada wawili walituma ujumbe kwa Yesu kumwambia, “Bwana, yule umpendaye ni mgonjwa.”
Ekegusii: Nabo baria basubati bamwabo bagatoma amang’ana asare, bakaboora, “Omonene, ere oyobwanchete orwarire.”

English: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Yesu aliposikia hayo, akasema, “Ugonjwa huu hautaleta mauti bali umetokea ili kudhihirisha utukufu wa Mungu, ili Mwana wa Mungu apate kutukuzwa kutokana na ugonjwa huu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oborwaire obwo tari obw’amakweri, korende ase okoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae, erinde Omwana o Nyasae abakwe ase obwo.”

English: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na hivyo, ingawa Yesu aliwapenda Martha, Maria na Lazaro ndugu yao,
Ekegusii: Na Yeso nigo anchete Martha, na mosubati omwabo, na Lazaro.

English: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
Kiswahili: baada ya kusikia kwamba Lazaro ni mgonjwa, aliendelea kukawia huko alikokuwa kwa siku mbili zaidi.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia koigwa ng’a nomorwaire, agateebana amatuko abere aria aase arenge.

English: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Haya, turudi Uyahudi.”
Ekegusii: Erio magega ase aya agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Togende Boyahudi naende.”

English: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Rabi, Wayahudi walikuwa wanataka kukupiga mawe, nawe unataka kurudi huko?”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakamoteebia, “Rabii, moisonde Abayahudi nigo barenge gokorigia gokoaka amagena, na aye gokogenda aroro naende?”

English: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Si kuna saa kumi na mbili za mchana katika siku moja? Wala watembeao mchana hawawezi kujikwaa kwa maana wanaona nuru ya ulimwengu huu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Chinsa chi’omobaso tichiri ikomi na ibere? Omonto karagende mobaso takogochwa, ekiagera aroche omobaso bw’ense eye.

English: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wale watembeao usiku hujikwaa kwa sababu hakuna nuru ndani yao.”
Ekegusii: Korende omonto karagende botuko, igo akogochwa, ekiagera omobaso tori ime yaye.”

English: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu akawaambia, “Rafiki yetu Lazaro amelala, lakini naenda kumwamsha.”
Ekegusii: Agakwana aya; erio magega ase aya akabateebia, “Lazaro omosani oito orarire, korende nkogenda nde inyare komotura.”

English: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wakamwambia, “Bwana, kama amelala usingizi ataamka.”
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Omonene, onye orarire, nagwene.”

English: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, Yesu alikuwa anazungumzia kuwa Lazaro amekufa, lakini wanafunzi wake hawakuelewa, walidhani kwamba anasema Lazaro amelala usingizi tu.
Ekegusii: Korende Yeso nigo akwanete amang’ana ’amakweri aye; na barabwo bagakaga ng’a nigo agokwana amang’ana y’okorara chitoro.

English: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akawaambia waziwazi, “Lazaro amekufa.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo Yeso akabateebia maiso marore, “Lazaro okuure.

English: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo nafurahi kwa kuwa sikuwepo huko kabla ya Lazaro kufa, ili mpate kuamini. Lakini sasa twendeni kwake.”
Ekegusii: Na inche nagokire ase engencho yaino, ekiagera ntarenge aroro, erinde monyare kwegena. Korende bono togende asare.”

English: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”
Kiswahili: Tomaso aliyeitwa Pacha akawaambia wanafunzi wenzake, “Sisi nasi twendeni tukafe pamoja naye.”
Ekegusii: Nabo Thomas, ore korokwa Barongo, agateebia aborokigwa bamwabo, “Togende naintwe, tokwe amo nere.”

English: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipowasili huko alikuta Lazaro amekuwa kaburini siku nne.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia goika aroro akanyora Lazaro ng’a oikire koba ase embeera amatuko ane.

English: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
Kiswahili: Basi Bethania ulikuwa karibu na Yerusalemu umbali wa karibu maili mbili,
Ekegusii: Bethania nigo orenge ang’e na Yerusalemu, koreng’ana chimaeli ibere.

English: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
Kiswahili: na Wayahudi wengi walikuwa wamekuja kuwafariji Martha na Maria kwa ajili ya kufiwa na ndugu yao.
Ekegusii: Na abanto abange ase Abayahudi bagacha ase Martha na Mariamu, erinde baabaremie ase engencho y’ogokwa kw’oyomwabo.

English: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
Kiswahili: Martha aliposikia kwamba Yesu anakuja, alitoka kwenda kumlaki, ila Maria alibaki nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Nabo Martha agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are, akagenda komoorotota, korende Mariamu nigo aikaransete nyomba ime.

English: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
Kiswahili: Martha akamwambia Yesu, “Bwana, kama ungalikuwa hapa, ndugu yangu hangalikufa.
Ekegusii: Erio Martha agateebia Yeso, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.

English: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa ninajua kuwa chochote utakachomwomba Mungu, atakupa.”
Ekegusii: Korende nonya mbono namanyire ng’a kende gionsi orasabe Nyasae, Nyasae nakoe.”

English: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Ndugu yako atafufuka.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Momura omino naboke.”

English: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
Kiswahili: Martha akamjibu, “Ninajua ya kuwa atafufuka wakati wa ufufuo wa wafu siku ya mwisho.”
Ekegusii: Martha akamoteebia, “Namanyire ng’a nache kobokigwa ase okobokigwa rituko ri’omoerio.”

English: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mimi ndiye huo ufufuo na uzima. Yeye aniaminiye mimi, hata akifa atakuwa anaishi
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inche ninche okobokigwa na obogima; oyonyegenire inche, naisa gokwa, nabe moyo.

English: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
Kiswahili: na yeyote aishiye na kuniamini hatakufa kabisa hata milele. Je, unasadiki haya?”
Ekegusii: Na onde bwensi ore moyo na onyegenire, tagokwa nonya ng’ake. Inee! Kwegenire aya?”

English: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”
Kiswahili: Martha akamwambia, “Ndiyo Bwana, ninaamini ya kuwa wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu, yeye ajaye ulimwenguni.”
Ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Ee, Omonene; inche negenire ng’a aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae, oria ogocha ase ense.”

English: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema haya Martha alikwenda, akamwita Maria dada yake faraghani na kumwambia, “Mwalimu yuko hapa anakuita.”
Ekegusii: Naende gakwanire aya, akagenda, akarangeria Mariamu mosubati omwabo, agakwana ng’ora igo, “Omworokia ochire, ngokorangeria are.”

English: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.
Kiswahili: Maria aliposikia hivyo, akaondoka upesi akaenda mpaka alipokuwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Mariamu agachia koigwa, akaimoka bwango, akamochiera.

English: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.
Kiswahili: Yesu alikuwa hajaingia kijijini, bali alikuwa bado yuko mahali pale alipokutana na Martha.
Ekegusii: Na Yeso konya taraika omochie ime, korende nigo arenge aase aria arototeretwe na Martha.

English: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
Kiswahili: Wale Wayahudi waliokuwa pamoja na Maria nyumbani wakimfariji walipoona ameondoka haraka na kutoka nje, walimfuata wakidhani ya kwamba alikuwa anakwenda kule kaburini kulilia huko.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi baria barenge amo nere nyomba ime bakomoremia, bagachia korora Mariamu buna aimoka bwango na gosoka, bakamotunyana, bakagete ng’a nigo akogenda embeera erinde arere aroro.

English: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
Kiswahili: Maria alipofika mahali pale Yesu alipokuwa, alipiga magoti miguuni Pake na kusema, “Bwana, kama ungalikuwa hapa, ndugu yangu hangalikufa.”
Ekegusii: Erio Mariamu agachia goika aase aria Yeso arenge, akamorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye, akamoteebia, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.”

English: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomwona Maria akilia na wale Wayahudi waliokuja pamoja naye pia wakilia, Yesu alisikia uchungu moyoni, akafadhaika sana.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia komoorora okorera, na Abayahudi baria bachete amo nere bakorera; agasogwa nobororo ase omoyo oye, agaichana.

English: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
Kiswahili: Akauliza, “Mmemweka wapi?” Wakamwambia, “Bwana, njoo upaone.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ng’ai mwamobeka?” Bakamoteebia, “Omonene, inchwo orore!”

English: Jesus wept.
Kiswahili: Yesu akalia machozi.
Ekegusii: Yeso akaiyeria amariga.

English: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakasema, “Tazama jinsi alivyompenda Lazaro!”
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaboora, “Rora buna amwanchete.”

English: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
Kiswahili: Lakini wengine wakasema, “Je, yule aliyefungua macho ya kipofu, hakuweza kumfanya na huyu asife?”
Ekegusii: Korende abande bakaboora, “Inee! Oyo oramogetie amaiso ’omouko oria, tare konyara kogwenia oyo takwa?”

English: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
Kiswahili: Yesu kwa mara nyingine akiwa amefadhaika sana, akafika penye kaburi. Hilo kaburi lilikuwa pango ambalo jiwe lilikuwa limewekwa kwenye ingilio lake.
Ekegusii: Nabo Yeso oichanete naende ase omoyo oye, agaika ase embeera. Ero nigo yarenge rikuruma, naende rigena ndiabegetwe igoro yaye.

English: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Liondoeni hilo jiwe.” Martha ndugu yake yule aliyekuwa amekufa akasema, “Lakini Bwana, wakati huu atakuwa ananuka kwani amekwisha kuwa kaburini siku nne.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tigeria rigena.” Martha, mosubati omwabo bw’oria okwete, akamoteebia, “Omonene, otiokire bono, ekiagera obeire egetondo ase amatuko ane.”

English: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Sikukuambia kwamba kama ukiamini utauona utukufu wa Mungu?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tinagoteebia ng’a koregene norore obonene bwa Nyasae?”

English: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakaliondoa lile jiwe kutoka kaburini. Yesu akainua macho yake juu akasema, “Baba, ninakushukuru kwa kuwa wanisikia.
Ekegusii: Nabo bakarusia rigena riria. Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye igoro, akabora, “Tata, nakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera okonyigwa.

English: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
Kiswahili: Ninajua ya kuwa wewe hunisikia siku zote, lakini nimesema haya kwa ajili ya umati huu uliosimama hapa, ili wapate kuamini ya kuwa wewe umenituma.”
Ekegusii: Na inche nimanyete ng’a nigo okonyigwa amatuko onsi; korende ase engencho y’omoganda oyo ong’etanaine konya nakwanire aya, banyare gwancha ng’a naye gwantomete.”

English: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu akapaza sauti yake akaita, “Lazaro, njoo huku!”
Ekegusii: Ekero akwanire igo, agaaka eriogi rinene, “Lazaro, soka isiko!”

English: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”
Kiswahili: Yule aliyekuwa amekufa akatoka nje, mikono yake na miguu yake ikiwa imeviringishiwa vitambaa vya kitani na leso usoni pake. Yesu akawaambia, “Mfungueni, mwacheni aende zake.”
Ekegusii: Oria okwete agasoka, oboyirie egetambaa amagoro na amaboko; obosio bwaye boboyirie egetambaa. Yeso akabateebia, “Mosansore, momotige agende.”

English: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Wayahudi wengi waliokuwa wamekuja kumfariji Maria, walipoona yale Yesu aliyoyatenda wakamwamini.
Ekegusii: Nabo abange ase Abayahudi abachete amo na Mariamu na korora aya Yeso akorete, bakamwegena.

English: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.
Kiswahili: Lakini baadhi yao wakaenda kwa Mafarisayo na kuwaambia mambo Yesu aliyoyafanya.
Ekegusii: Korende abande babo bakagenda ase Abafarisai, bakabateebia aya Yeso akorete.

English: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo wakaita mkutano wa baraza. Wakaulizana, “Tufanyeje? Huyu mtu anafanya ishara nyingi.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase ekegambero, bakaboora, “Ninki togokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo nigo agokora ebikone ebinge.

English: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
Kiswahili: Kama tukimwacha aendelee hivi, kila mtu atamwamini, nao Warumi watakuja na kupaharibu mahali petu patakatifu na taifa letu.”
Ekegusii: Toise komotiga iga, abanto bonsi mbamwegene; na Abarumi mbache, batoure Aase aito Aachenu na egesaku giaito.”

English: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao aliyeitwa Kayafa, ambaye alikuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka huo, akasema, “Ninyi hamjui kitu chochote!
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase bare, Kayafa, oyorenge Omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabateebia, “Inwe timomanyeti kende gionsi.

English: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
Kiswahili: Hamjui kwamba ni afadhali mtu mmoja afe kwa ajili ya watu, kuliko taifa lote liangamie?”
Ekegusii: Gose timorengerereti ng’a mbuya omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y’abanto, erinde egesaku ekegima tigesira.”

English: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
Kiswahili: Hakusema haya kutokana na mawazo yake mwenyewe bali kama kuhani mkuu mwaka huo, alitabiri kuwa Yesu angelikufa kwa ajili ya taifa la Wayahudi,
Ekegusii: Naende eri takwanete ase omoyo oye omonyene, korende ekiagera arenge Omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabana ng’a Yeso nakwe ase engencho y’egesaku keria;

English: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
Kiswahili: wala si kwa ajili ya taifa hilo pekee, bali pia kwa ajili ya watoto wa Mungu waliotawanyika, ili kuwaleta pamoja na kuwafanya wawe wamoja.
Ekegusii: gose tari ase engencho y’egesaku keria gioka, korende amo naya asangererie abana ba Nyasae baria baatananekire, babe abamo.

English: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
Kiswahili: Hivyo tangu siku hiyo wakawa wanafanya mipango ili wamuue Yesu.
Ekegusii: Nabo korwa rituko riria bakarengereria buna baranyare komoita.

English: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akawa hatembei hadharani miongoni mwa Wayahudi, bali alijitenga akaenda sehemu iliyo karibu na jangwa kwenye kijiji kiitwacho Efraimu. Akakaa huko na wanafunzi wake.
Ekegusii: Yeso tataarete naende maiso marore ase egati y’Abayahudi, korende akarua aria akagenda aase ang’e nerooro, goika omochie okorokwa Efraimu; akamenya aroro amo naborokigwa baye.

English: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
Kiswahili: Basi Pasaka ya Wayahudi ilipokuwa imekaribia, watu wengi walitoka vijijini wakaenda Yerusalemu kabla ya Pasaka ili wakajitakase.
Ekegusii: Naende Epasaka y’Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang’e; abange bagatiira korwa chinka chiabo kogenda Yerusalemu gotang’anera Epasaka, erinde besibie.

English: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”
Kiswahili: Watu wakawa wanamtafuta Yesu, nao waliposimama kwenye eneo la Hekalu waliulizana, Je, mtu huyu hatakuja kamwe kwenye Sikukuu?
Ekegusii: Nabo bakarigia Yeso, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bagotenena ase Hekalu, “Naki morooche? Tagocha‐gocha ase rituko rinene nonya ng’ake?”

English: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo walikuwa wametoa amri kuwa yeyote atakayejua mahali Yesu aliko, lazima atoe taarifa ili wapate kumkamata.
Ekegusii: Bono abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bakarua ogochika ng’a onye monto onde omanyete aase are, arente amang’ana, banyare komobwata.

English: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
Kiswahili: Siku sita kabla ya Pasaka, Yesu alikwenda Bethania mahali ambako Lazaro aliyekuwa amefufuliwa na Yesu alikuwa anaishi.
Ekegusii: Nabo amatuko atano na rimo ritang’ani ri’Epasaka Yeso agaika Bethania, agwo aase Lazaro arenge, oria okwete, akabokigwa na Yeso.

English: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
Kiswahili: Wakaandaa karamu kwa heshima ya Yesu. Martha akawahudumia wakati Lazaro alikuwa miongoni mwa waliokaa mezani pamoja na Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bakamoroiseria endagera aria. Martha ere agakora emeremo eyio, korende Lazaro nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria baikaransete ase endagera amo nere.

English: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
Kiswahili: Kisha Maria akachukua chupa ya painti moja yenye manukato ya nardo safi ya thamani kubwa, akayamimina miguuni mwa Yesu na kuifuta kwa nywele zake. Nyumba nzima ikajaa harufu nzuri ya manukato.
Ekegusii: Erio Mariamu akabogoria ekerengo ki’eratili eyemo y’amanukato e rigori rinene, agaaka Yeso amagoro, akayatinyia netukia yaye; enyomba egaichora rimisu ri’amaguta aria.

English: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yuda Iskariote mwana wa Simoni, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi ambaye ndiye angemsaliti Yesu, akasema,
Ekegusii: Korende Yudasi Iskariota mosinto o Simioni, oyomo bw’aborokigwa ba Yeso oyoramorue, akabora,

English: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
Kiswahili: “Kwa nini manukato haya hayakuuzwa kwa dinari 300 na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini?”
Ekegusii: “Nase ki amaguta aya ataoonigwa chidinari amagana atato, na echio chiegwe abataka?”

English: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
Kiswahili: Yuda alisema hivi si kwa kuwa aliwajali maskini, bali kwa kuwa alikuwa mwizi, kwani ndiye alikuwa akitunza mfuko wa fedha akawa anaiba kile kilichowekwa humo.
Ekegusii: Aya igo akwanete, tari ng’a arorerete abataka amaabera, korende nekiagera arenge omoibi, naende abwate esanduki ye chibesa, na igo anarete korusia echiabekire aroro.

English: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
Kiswahili: Yesu akasema, “Mwacheni. Aliyanunua manukato hayo ili ayaweke kwa ajili ya siku ya maziko yangu.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateeba, “Motige, agache aya goika rituko ri’ogotindekwa kwane.

English: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
Kiswahili: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote, lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.”
Ekegusii: Naki igo more nabataka amo nainwe amatuko onsi, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.”

English: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
Kiswahili: Umati mkubwa wa Wayahudi walipojua kwamba Yesu alikuwa huko Bethania, walikuja si tu kwa ajili ya Yesu, lakini pia kumwona Lazaro ambaye Yesu alikuwa amemfufua.
Ekegusii: Nabo omoganda omonene bw’Abayahudi bakamanya ng’a ere nao are aria; bagacha, tari ase engencho ya Yeso yoka, korende barore Lazaro, oyio Yeso abogetie korwa ase abakuure.

English: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo viongozi wa makuhani wakafanya mpango wa kumuua Lazaro pia,
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bagakora ekiina baite Lazaro boigo,

English: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa kutokana na habari za kufufuliwa kwake Wayahudi wengi walikuwa wanamwendea Yesu na kumwamini.
Ekegusii: ekiagera ase engencho yaye abange b’Abayahudi bakagenda bakamwegena Yeso.

English: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata umati mkubwa uliokuwa umekuja kwenye Sikukuu walisikia kwamba Yesu angekuja Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia abanto abange abachete ase Rituko Rinene, kobachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are Yerusalemu,

English: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
Kiswahili: Basi wakachukua matawi ya mitende, wakatoka kwenda kumlaki, huku wakipaza sauti wakisema, “Hosana!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Amebarikiwa Mfalme wa Israeli!”
Ekegusii: bakabogoria chinsagia chi’emekendo, bagasoka isiko kogenda komoorotota, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba, “Hosana! Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene, Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.”

English: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
Kiswahili: Yesu akamkuta mwana-punda akampanda, kama ilivyoandikwa,
Ekegusii: Yeso akanyora emori y’etigere, akayeriina, buna yarigetwe,

English: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
Kiswahili: “Usiogope, Ewe binti Sayuni; tazama, Mfalme wako anakuja, amepanda mwana-punda!”
Ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, timoiroka! Rigereria, Omorwoti oino ngocha are, igo ariinete emori y’etigere.”

English: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake Yesu mwanzoni hawakuelewa mambo haya, lakini Yesu alipotukuzwa, ndipo walipokumbuka kuwa mambo haya yalikuwa yameandikwa kwa ajili yake na alitendewa yeye.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya aborokigwa baye tibayamanyete agwo ritang’ani, korende magega Yeso gatogigwe, erio bakainyora ng’a narikeire aya, naende ng’a mbamokorere aya.

English: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.
Kiswahili: Wale waliokuwepo wakati Yesu alipomwita Lazaro kutoka kaburini na kumfufua kutoka kwa wafu, waliendelea kushuhudia.
Ekegusii: Nabo omoganda bw’abaanto abwo barenge amo nere ekero arangeretie Lazaro korwa ase embeera ime, na komobokia, bakaba bakomoorokia.

English: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
Kiswahili: Ni kwa sababu pia walikuwa wamesikia kwamba alikuwa ametenda muujiza huu ndiyo maana umati wa watu ukaenda kumlaki.
Ekegusii: Ekio nakio kiagerete omoganda okagenda komoorotota, ekiagera baigwete ng’a okorire egekone eke.

English: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Mafarisayo walipoona hayo wakaambiana, “Mnaona, hamwezi kufanya lolote. Angalieni, ulimwengu wote unamfuata yeye!”
Ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mwarorire ng’a timokonyara gokora gento; ense yagendire komotunyana.”

English: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwa Wayunani fulani miongoni mwa wale waliokuwa wamekwenda kuabudu wakati wa Sikukuu.
Ekegusii: Naende mbarenge Abagiriki bande ase abanto abwo batiirete kogenda gosasiima ase ekero kie Rituko Rinene.

English: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
Kiswahili: Hawa wakamjia Filipo, ambaye alikuwa mwenyeji wa Bethsaida huko Galilaya, wakiwa na ombi. Wakamwambia, “Tungependa kumwona Yesu.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagachiera Filipo o Bethisaida bw’ensemo ya Galili, bakamosaba, bakobora, “Omosike, ntorigetie korora Yeso.”

English: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
Kiswahili: Filipo akaenda akamweleza Andrea, nao wote wawili wakamwambia Yesu.
Ekegusii: Filipo akagenda, agateebia Anderea; erio Anderea na Filipo bagateebia Yeso.

English: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Saa imewadia ya Mwana wa Adamu kutukuzwa.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, akabora, “Ensa yaikire, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto abakwe.

English: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, mbegu ya ngano isipoanguka ardhini na kufa, hubakia kama mbegu peke yake. Lakini ikifa huzaa mbegu nyingi.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie; Enyeke y’engano etagweti esoe inse ase riroba ekwe, nigo ekobao yoka; korende kerakwe, nigo ekwama okwama okonge.

English: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote anayependa maisha yake atayapoteza, naye ayachukiaye maisha yake katika ulimwengu huu atayaokoa hata kwa uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Oyoranche obogima bwaye, nabosirie; oyorageche obogima bwaye ase ense eye, nabogache goika obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote akinitumikia lazima anifuate, nami mahali nilipo ndipo mtumishi wangu atakapokuwa. Mtu akinitumikia, Baba yangu atamheshimu.
Ekegusii: Omonto karankorere, antunyane; na aase inde inche, nomosomba one nao arabe; naende omonto karankorere, Tata namosike.

English: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.
Kiswahili: “Sasa roho yangu imefadhaika sana. Niseme nini? ‘Baba, niokoe katika saa hii.’ Lakini ni kwa kusudi hili nimeufikia wakati huu.
Ekegusii: “Bono omoyo one oichanire; ninki ngokwana? Tata, ontoorie korwa ase ense eye! Yaya, korende ase engencho y’ayio naikeire ensa eye.

English: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”
Kiswahili: Baba, litukuze jina lako.” Ndipo ikaja sauti kutoka mbinguni, “Nimelitukuza, nami nitalitukuza tena.”
Ekegusii: Tata, obake erieta riao!” Erio eriogi rigacha korwa igoro, rigateba, “Naribakire, na inche nindibake naende.”

English: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu uliokuwa mahali pale uliisikia nao ukasema, “Hiyo ni sauti ya radi,” wengine wakasema, “Malaika ameongea naye.”
Ekegusii: Nabo abanto abateneine ang’e bakaigwa, bakaboora ng’a kwabeire okogukura; abande bakaboora, “Nomomalaika ogokwana nere.”

English: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Sauti hii imesikika kwa faida yenu, wala si kwa faida yangu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akabora, “Eriogi eri tiricheti ase engencho yane, korende nase engencho yaino.

English: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
Kiswahili: Sasa ni saa ya hukumu kwa ajili ya ulimwengu huu, sasa mkuu wa ulimwengu huu atatupwa nje.
Ekegusii: Bono ekiina gi’ense eye nkere; bono omogambi bw’ense eye natugutwe isiko.

English: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi, nikiinuliwa kutoka nchi, nitawavuta watu wote waje kwangu.”
Ekegusii: Na inche kondaimokererigwe igoro korwa ase ense, nimbang’use bonsi ase ’nde.”

English: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
Kiswahili: Yesu aliyasema haya akionyesha ni kifo gani atakachokufa.
Ekegusii: Agakwana aya, erinde aorokie imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.

English: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ukapiga kelele ukasema, “Tumesikia kutoka Sheria kwamba ‘Kristo adumu milele,’ wewe wawezaje kusema, ‘Mwana wa Adamu hana budi kuinuliwa juu’? Huyu ‘Mwana wa Adamu’ ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Erio omoganda okamoiraneria, “Nigo tokoigwa ase amachiiko ng’a Kristo nigo arabeo goika kare na kare, na aye naki okobora ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto aimokererigwe igoro? Oyo Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere ng’o?”

English: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Bado kitambo kidogo nuru ingalipo pamoja nanyi. Enendeni maadamu mna nuru, msije mkakumbwa na giza. Mtu anayetembea gizani hajui anakokwenda.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Omobaso nigo ore amo nainwe egeka egeke bosio. Genda ekero more nomobaso oria, omosunte tocha kobabua; ere oyokogenda ase omosunte ime tamanyeti aase akogenda.

English: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
Kiswahili: Wekeni tumaini lenu katika nuru hiyo ili mpate kuwa wana wa nuru.” Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu aliondoka, akajificha wasimwone.
Ekegusii: Ekero more nomobaso yuegene, erinde monyare koba abana b’omobaso.” Ekero Yeso akwanete ayio akagenda akebisa korwa ase bare.

English: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
Kiswahili: Hata baada ya Yesu kufanya miujiza hii yote mbele yao, bado hawakumwamini.
Ekegusii: Nonya okorete ebikone ebinge ase amasio abo, tibamwegenete,

English: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
Kiswahili: Hili lilikuwa ili kutimiza lile neno la nabii Isaya lililosema: “Bwana, ni nani aliyeamini ujumbe wetu, na mkono wa Bwana umefunuliwa kwa nani?”
Ekegusii: erinde riikeranigwe ring’ana riria omobani Isaya ateebete, “Omonene, ning’o bwegenire amang’ana aito? Naende ning’o okoboko kw’Omonene kwamaanoreirwe?”

English: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo hawakuamini, kwa sababu Isaya anasema mahali pengine:
Ekegusii: Nakio kiagerete tibanyara kwegena. Naki Isaya nigo ateebete naende,

English: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”
Kiswahili: “Amewafanya vipofu, na kuifanya mioyo yao kuwa migumu, ili wasiweze kuona kwa macho yao, wala kuelewa kwa mioyo yao, wasije wakageuka nami nikawaponya.”
Ekegusii: “Obaukoirie amaiso, okorire chinkoro chiabo chiakong’ire, tibacha korora namaiso abo, na komanya ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke na inche mbagwenie.”

English: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
Kiswahili: Isaya alisema haya alipoona utukufu wa Yesu na kunena habari zake.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio Isaya nigo ayakwanete, ekiagera aroche obonene bwaye; agaatora amang’ana aye.

English: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
Kiswahili: Lakini wengi miongoni mwa viongozi wa Wayahudi walimwamini, lakini kwa sababu ya Mafarisayo hawakukiri waziwazi kwa maana waliogopa kufukuzwa katika masinagogi.
Ekegusii: Korende abange nonya nabanene bakamwegena, korende ase engencho y’Abafarisai tibamoorogetie, tibacha korusigwa ase esinagogi,

English: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
Kiswahili: Wao walipenda sifa za wanadamu kuliko sifa zitokazo kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera mbanchete ogotogia kw’abaanto kobua ogotogia kwa Nyasae.

English: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akapaza sauti akasema, “Yeyote aniaminiye, haniamini mimi peke yangu, bali yeye aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: Yeso agaaka eriogi akabora, “Oyonyegenire inche, tanyegeneti inche omonyene, korende ere oyontomete.

English: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anionaye mimi, amemwona yeye aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: Na ere oyondoche inche nigo aroche ere oyontomete.

English: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
Kiswahili: Mimi nimekuja kama nuru ulimwenguni, ili kwamba kila mtu aniaminiye asibaki gizani.
Ekegusii: Inche nachire imbe omobaso ase ense, erinde kera oyonyegenire, tamenya ase omosunte ime.

English: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
Kiswahili: “Mimi simhukumu mtu yeyote anayesikia maneno yangu na asiyatii, kwa maana sikuja kuuhukumu ulimwengu, bali kuuokoa.
Ekegusii: Naende omonto karaigwe amang’ana aane, ko tayabwata, inche tinkomogambia, ekiagera tincheti kogambia ense, korende nyetoorie.

English: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.
Kiswahili: Yuko amhukumuye yeye anikataaye mimi na kutokuyapokea maneno yangu, yaani, yale maneno niliyosema yenyewe yatamhukumu siku ya mwisho.
Ekegusii: Oyo oranyange na otancheti amang’ana aane, nare noyo oramogambie. Ring’ana riria nakwanete, nario riranyare komogambia ase rituko ri’omoerio.

English: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sisemi kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, bali Baba aliyenituma aliniamuru ni nini cha kusema na jinsi ya kukisema.
Ekegusii: Naki tinakwanete ase okobua kwane omonyene, korende Tata oyontomete onchikiire aya ngokwana.

English: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
Kiswahili: Nami ninajua amri zake huongoza hadi kwenye uzima wa milele. Hivyo lolote nisemalo, ndilo lile Baba aliloniambia niseme.”
Ekegusii: Na inche namanyire ng’a ogochika kwaye nobogima bwa kare na kare. Ase ayio nigo ngokwana buna Tata antebetie.”

English: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa mara tu kabla ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka. Yesu alijua ya kuwa wakati wake wa kuondoka ulimwenguni ili kurudi kwa Baba umewadia. Alikuwa amewapenda watu wake waliokuwa ulimwenguni, naam, aliwapenda hadi kipimo cha mwisho.
Ekegusii: Ekero rituko rinene ri’Epasaka ritaraba, Yeso akamanya ng’a ensa yaye yaikire akorua ase ense eye na kogenda ase Ise, akaba nanchete abanto baye abarenge ase ense, naboigo akabancha goika omoerio.

English: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
Kiswahili: Wakati alipokuwa akila chakula cha jioni na wanafunzi wake, ibilisi alikuwa amekwisha kutia ndani ya moyo wa Yuda Iskariote, mwana wa Simoni, wazo la kumsaliti Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ki’endagera ya mogoroba, Saitani gaikire kobeeka Yudasi omwana o Simioni Iskariota enkoro y’okomorua,

English: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,
Kiswahili: Yesu akijua ya kwamba Baba ameweka vitu vyote chini ya mamlaka yake na kwamba yeye alitoka kwa Mungu na alikuwa anarudi kwa Mungu,
Ekegusii: Yeso omanyete ng’a Ise omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye, naende ng’a nigo arwete ase Nyasae, naende nkoirana are ase Nyasae.

English: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
Kiswahili: hivyo aliondoka chakulani, akavua vazi lake la nje, akajifunga kitambaa kiunoni.
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase endagera, akabeeka chianga chiaye ensemo, akabogoria egetambaa, akeboyia.

English: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
Kiswahili: Kisha akamimina maji kwenye sinia na kuanza kuwanawisha wanafunzi wake miguu na kuikausha kwa kile kitambaa alichokuwa amejifunga kiunoni.
Ekegusii: Erio akabeeka amaache ase esani, agachaaka gosibia aborokigwa baye amagoro abo, na koyatinyia negetambaa keria eboyetie.

English: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
Kiswahili: Alipomfikia Simoni Petro, Petro akamwambia, “Bwana, je, wewe utaninawisha mimi miguu?”
Ekegusii: Nabo agaika ase Simioni Petero, Oyo akamoteebia, “Omonene! Aye ngosibia ore amagoro aane?”

English: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Hivi sasa hutambui lile ninalofanya, lakini baadaye utaelewa.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akamoteebia, “Aya ngokora inche, tokoyamanya bono, korende noyamanye magega.”

English: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
Kiswahili: Petro akamwambia, “La, wewe hutaninawisha miguu kamwe.” Yesu akamjibu, “Kama nisipokunawisha, wewe huna sehemu nami.”
Ekegusii: Petero akamokania, “Togonsibia amagoro aane nonya ng’ake.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Ntagosibeti, tori nobomo amo nainche.”

English: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Simoni Petro akajibu, “Usininawishe miguu peke yake, Bwana, bali pamoja na mikono na kichwa pia!”
Ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero akamoteebia, “Omonene, tari amagoro aane oka, korende nonya namaboko na omotwe one.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu aliyekwisha kuoga anahitaji kunawa miguu tu, kwani mwili wake wote ni safi. Ninyi ni safi, ingawa si kila mmoja wenu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Oyoikire gwesibia tagwenereti gwesibia naende, otatiga amagoro oka, korende obeire omochenu omobere bwonsi; na inwe mwabeire abachenu, korende tai mwensi.”

English: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa yeye alijua ni nani ambaye angemsaliti, ndiyo sababu akasema si kila mmoja aliyekuwa safi.
Ekegusii: Naki amomanyete oyogocha komorua; ase ayio agateeba, “Timori abachenu mwensi.”

English: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
Kiswahili: Alipomaliza kuwanawisha miguu yao, alivaa tena mavazi yake, akarudi alikokuwa ameketi, akawauliza, “Je, mmeelewa nililowafanyia?
Ekegusii: Nabo agachia gokoora kobasibia amagoro abo na kobogoria chianga chiaye, agaikaransa naende, akabateebia, “Mwamanyire eki nabakorera?

English: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnaniita mimi ‘Mwalimu’ na ‘Bwana,’ hii ni sawa, maana ndivyo nilivyo.
Ekegusii: Inwe iga mokondoka Omworokia, naende Omonene; na igo mbuya mokobora, naki naboigo inde.

English: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ikiwa mimi niliye Bwana wenu na Mwalimu wenu nimewanawisha ninyi miguu, pia hamna budi kunawishana miguu ninyi kwa ninyi.
Ekegusii: Nabo onye inche, inde Omonene naende Omworokia, nabasibirie amagoro aino, nebagwenerete gosibania amagoro inwe ase inwe.

English: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
Kiswahili: Mimi nimewawekea kielelezo kwamba imewapasa kutenda kama vile nilivyowatendea ninyi.
Ekegusii: Naki nabaeire ekiorokererio ekiya, erinde ayio nabakorera inwe, nainwe moyakore.

English: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, mtumishi si mkuu kuliko bwana wake, wala aliyetumwa si mkuu kuliko yule aliyemtuma.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye, gose omotomwa tari omonene kobua ere oyomotomete.

English: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
Kiswahili: Sasa kwa kuwa mmejua mambo haya, heri yenu ninyi kama mkiyatenda.
Ekegusii: Komoramanye ayio, mosesenirie komorayakore.

English: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
Kiswahili: “Sisemi hivi kuhusu ninyi nyote. Ninawajua wale niliowachagua. Lakini ni ili Andiko lipate kutimia, kwamba, ‘Yeye aliyekula chakula changu, ameinua kisigino chake dhidi yangu.’
Ekegusii: Tindi gokwana ase more mwensi; nabamanyire aba nachorire, erinde amariiko anyare goikeranigwa, ayagoteeba: Oyokoria omogati amo nainche oimokereirie egetingiro kiaye igoro ase ’nde.

English: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
Kiswahili: “Ninawaambia mambo haya kabla hayajatukia, ili yatakapotukia mpate kuamini ya kuwa Mimi ndiye.
Ekegusii: Nabatebirie aya korwa bono ritang’ani ataraba, erio ekero arache koba monyare kwegena ng’a ninche ere.

English: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeyote anayempokea yule niliyemtuma anipokea mimi, naye anipokeaye mimi ampokea yeye aliyenituma mimi.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ere oyoramwanche onde bwensi oyo ndatome, onyanchire inche; nere oyoranyanche inche omwanchire ere oyontomete.”

English: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu alifadhaika sana moyoni, akasema, “Amin, amin nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti.”
Ekegusii: Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, Yeso agaichana ase omoika oye, akaorokia, agakwana, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyomo oino nandue.”

English: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wake wakatazamana bila kujua kuwa alikuwa anamsema nani.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakarigererania, bagasinywa komanya gose ning’o atora.

English: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa wanafunzi wake ambaye Yesu alimpenda sana, alikuwa ameegama kifuani mwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Narenge aroro oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, oyobweegegete Yeso egekuba kiaye, oyo Yeso anchete.

English: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akampungia mkono yule mwanafunzi, akamwambia, “Muulize anamaanisha nani.”
Ekegusii: Nabo Simioni Petero akamoraga, akamobooria, “Moborie ning’o atora?”

English: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
Kiswahili: Yule mwanafunzi akamwegemea Yesu, akamuuliza, “Bwana, tuambie, ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Ere oria akamweegeka buna arenge ase egekuba kia Yeso, akamobooria, “Omonene, ning’o?”

English: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Ni yule nitakayempa hiki kipande cha mkate baada ya kukichovya kwenye bakuli.” Hivyo baada ya kukichovya kile kipande cha mkate, akampa Yuda Iskariote, mwana wa Simoni.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akairaneria, “Nomonto oria ngotongereria egesamunye ki’omogati na komoa.” Agatongereria Yudasi, mosinto o Simioni Iskariota, egesamunye, agakemoa.

English: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
Kiswahili: Mara tu baada ya kukipokea kile kipande cha mkate, Shetani akamwingia. Yesu akamwambia Yuda, “Lile unalotaka kulitenda litende haraka.”
Ekegusii: Naende magega kanyorire egesamunye keria, Saitani akamosoa. Erio Yeso akamoteebia, “Aya ogokora, yakore bwango.”

English: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wa wale waliokuwa wameketi naye mezani aliyeelewa kwa nini Yesu alimwambia hivyo.
Ekegusii: Onde tarenge ase baria baikaransete ase emesa omanyete engencho yagerete amotebetie iga.

English: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Yuda alikuwa mtunza fedha, wengine walifikiri Yesu alikuwa amemwambia akanunue vitu vilivyohitajika kwa ajili ya Sikukuu, au kuwapa maskini chochote.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Yudasi arenge kobogoria esanduki ye chitaabu, baria bande bagakaga ng’a Yeso nigo are komoteebia, “Gora ebitorigetie ase Rituko Rinene”, gose ng’a abae abataka egento.

English: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
Kiswahili: Mara tu baada ya kupokea ule mkate, Yuda akatoka nje. Wakati huo ulikuwa ni usiku.
Ekegusii: Nabo oyo, kanyorire egesamunye keria agasoka bwango; na igo bwarenge botuko.

English: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yuda kutoka nje, Yesu akasema, “Sasa Mwana wa Adamu ametukuzwa, naye Mungu ametukuzwa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Erio oyio gasokire, Yeso akabora, “Bono Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto obakirwe, na Nyasae obakirwe ime yaye.

English: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Mungu ametukuzwa ndani ya Mwana, Mungu atamtukuza Mwana ndani yake mwenyewe naye atamtukuza mara.
Ekegusii: Onye Nyasae okobakwa ime yaye, Nyasae boigo namobake ime yaye omonyene, na komobaka erio kegima.

English: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
Kiswahili: “Watoto wangu, mimi bado niko pamoja nanyi kwa kitambo kidogo. Mtanitafuta, na kama vile nilivyowaambia Wayahudi, vivyo hivyo sasa nawaambia na ninyi. Niendako, ninyi hamwezi kuja.
Ekegusii: Abana abake, nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe. Namondigie; korende buna natebeetie Abayahudi, ng’a aase ngochia inche, inwe timokonyara gochao, bono nabateebirie nainwe.

English: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
Kiswahili: “Amri mpya nawapa: Mpendane kama mimi nilivyowapenda ninyi, vivyo hivyo nanyi mpendane.
Ekegusii: Ogochika okoyia nabaeire nakwo oko, mwanchane. Buna nabanchete inwe, nainwe mwanchane boigo.

English: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
Kiswahili: Kama mkipendana ninyi kwa ninyi, kwa njia hii, watu wote watajua kuwa ninyi ni wanafunzi wangu.”
Ekegusii: Igo abanto bonsi nabamanye ng’a naborokigwa baane more, komorabe nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.”

English: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akamuuliza, “Bwana, unakwenda wapi?” Yesu akamjibu, “Ninakokwenda huwezi kunifuata sasa, lakini utanifuata baadaye.”
Ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamobooria, “Omonene, ng’ai okogenda?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aase ngochia tokonyara gontunyana bono, korende nontunyane magega.”

English: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
Kiswahili: Petro akamuuliza tena, “Bwana, kwa nini siwezi kukufuata sasa? Mimi niko tayari kuutoa uhai wangu kwa ajili yako.”
Ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Omonene, nase ki ntanyare kogotunyana bono? Nindue obogima bwane ase engencho yao.”

English: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
