Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Je, ni kweli uko tayari kuutoa uhai wako kwa ajili yangu? Amin, amin nakuambia, kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Obogima bwao noborue ase engencho yane? Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Etuoni tekobuga goika gwankanire ara gatato.

English: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Msifadhaike mioyoni mwenu, mnamwamini Mungu, niaminini na mimi pia.
Ekegusii: “Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino; momwegene Nyasae, nainche monyegene.

English: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
Kiswahili: Nyumbani kwa Baba yangu kuna makao mengi. Kama sivyo, ningeliwaambia. Naenda kuwaandalia makao.
Ekegusii: Ase enyomba ya Tata nere nobomenyo obonge; onye taibo, anga nabateebia. Nkogenda nde kobaroiseria aase.

English: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
Kiswahili: Nami nikienda na kuwaandalia makao, nitarudi tena na kuwachukua mkae pamoja nami, ili mahali nilipo, nanyi mpate kuwepo.
Ekegusii: Kondagende kobaroiseria aase, ninchiche naende, nimbaroisie ase ’nde, erinde ase ’nde inche, nainwe mobeo.

English: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnajua njia ya kufika ninakokwenda.”
Ekegusii: Nase nkogenda inche, mwamanyire enchera.”

English: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
Kiswahili: Tomaso akamwambia, “Bwana, sisi hatujui unakokwenda, tutaijuaje njia?”
Ekegusii: Thomas akamobooria, “Omonene, titomanyeti aase ogochia, naki toramanye enchera?”

English: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mimi ndimi njia na kweli na uzima. Mtu hawezi kuja kwa Baba isipokuwa kwa kupitia kwangu.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche ninche enchera, na ekeene, na obogima; monto onde tagocha ase Tata otatiga goetera ase ’nde.

English: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”
Kiswahili: Kama mngenijua mimi, mngemjua na Baba pia. Tangu sasa, mnamjua Baba yangu, tena mmemwona.”
Ekegusii: Onye imwamanyete inche, anga imwamomanyete Tata boigo; korwa bono mwamomanyire, naende mwamororire.”

English: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
Kiswahili: Filipo akamwambia, “Bwana, tuonyeshe Baba yako yatosha.”
Ekegusii: Filipo akamoteebia, “Omonene, tworokie Tata, toisaneke.”

English: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Filipo, nimekaa nanyi muda huu wote hata usinijue? Mtu yeyote aliyeniona mimi, amemwona Baba. Sasa wawezaje kusema, ‘Tuonyeshe Baba’?
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Nabeire amo nainwe amatuko aya onsi, na aye tomanyeti, Filipo? Oyondorire inche, ororire na Tata; naki aye ogoteeba: Tworokie Tata?

English: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
Kiswahili: Je, huamini ya kuwa mimi niko ndani ya Baba, naye Baba yuko ndani yangu? Maneno ninayowaambia siyasemi kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, bali Baba akaaye ndani yangu ndiye atendaye hizi kazi.
Ekegusii: Tibwegeneti ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane? Amang’ana aya inche nkobateebia, tindi gokwana ase okobua kwane, korende n’Tata ore ime yane nigo agokora emeremo yaye.

English: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
Kiswahili: Nisadiki mimi kwamba niko ndani ya Baba na Baba yuko ndani yangu, la sivyo, niaminini kwa sababu ya zile kazi nizitendazo.
Ekegusii: Inyegene ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane; gose inyegene ase engencho y’emeremo emenyene.

English: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeyote aniaminiye mimi, kazi nizifanyazo yeye atazifanya, naam na kubwa kuliko hizi atazifanya, kwa sababu mimi ninakwenda kwa Baba.
Ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyoranyegene inche, emeremo ngokora inche, nere nayekore; nakore naende emenene kobua eye, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.

English: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mkiomba lolote kwa Jina langu, hilo nitalifanya, ili Baba apate kutukuzwa katika Mwana.
Ekegusii: Kende gionsi morasabe ase erieta riane, ekio nangekore, erinde Tata abakwe ime ase Omwana.

English: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
Kiswahili: Kama mkiniomba lolote kwa Jina langu nitalifanya.
Ekegusii: Komorasabe kende gionsi ase erieta riane, ekio ningekore.

English: If you love me, keep my commandments.
Kiswahili: “Kama mnanipenda, mtazishika amri zangu.
Ekegusii: “Komoranyanche namobwate amachiiko aane.

English: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
Kiswahili: Nami nitamwomba Baba, naye atawapa Msaidizi mwingine akae nanyi milele.
Ekegusii: Naende inche ninsambe Tata, na ere nabae Omokonyi onde oyoramenye amo nainwe goika kare na kare,

English: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
Kiswahili: Huyo ndiye Roho wa kweli ambaye ulimwengu hauwezi kumpokea, kwa sababu haumwoni wala haumjui. Ninyi mnamjua kwa kuwa yuko pamoja nanyi naye anakaa ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: Omoika bw’ekeene. Ense etanyare komwancha, ekiagera temorochi, nonya nkomomanya. Korende inwe mwamomanyire, ekiagera namenyete amo nainwe, naende nabe ime yaino.

English: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
Kiswahili: Sitawaacha ninyi yatima, naja kwenu.
Ekegusii: “Tinkobatiga inwe buna chintakana; ninchiche ase more.

English: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
Kiswahili: Bado kitambo kidogo ulimwengu hautaniona tena, ila ninyi mtaniona, kwa kuwa mimi ni hai, ninyi nanyi mtakuwa hai.
Ekegusii: Nkere ekero egeke, ense etandore naende; korende inwe namondore, ekiagera inche moyo inde, na inwe namobe moyo.

English: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo mtajua ya kuwa mimi niko ndani ya Baba na ninyi mko ndani yangu na mimi niko ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ime ase Tata, na inwe ime yane, na inche ime yaino.

English: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
Kiswahili: Yeyote mwenye amri zangu na kuzishika ndiye anipendaye, naye anipendaye atapendwa na Baba yangu, nami nitampenda na kujidhihirisha kwake.”
Ekegusii: Oyore namachiiko aane, na koyabwata, oyio nere onyanchete; ere oyonyanchete nanchwe na Tata one, na inche nimwanche na kweorokia asare.”

English: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yuda, siyo Iskariote, akamwambia, “Bwana, itakuwaje kwamba utajidhihirisha kwetu na si kwa ulimwengu?”
Ekegusii: Yudasi (tari oria o Iskariota) akamobooria, “Omonene, naki yaba ng’a norigetie kweorokia ase tore, gose tari ase ense?”

English: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu yeyote akinipenda atalishika neno langu na Baba yangu atampenda, nasi tutakuja kwake na kufanya makao yetu kwake.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Omonto karanyanche, abwate ring’ana riane, naende Tata one namwanche, na intwe natoche asare, tokore obomenyo bwaito amo nere.

English: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asiyenipenda hayashiki maneno yangu na maneno niliyowapa si yangu bali ni ya Baba aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: Oyotanyancheti, tabwateti amang’ana aane; naende ring’ana mwaigure tari eriane, korende neria Tata oyontomete.

English: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
Kiswahili: “Nimewaambia mambo haya yote wakati bado niko pamoja nanyi.
Ekegusii: “Aya nabateebirie ekero inde ase more.

English: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
Kiswahili: Lakini huyo Msaidizi, yaani, huyo Roho Mtakatifu, ambaye Baba atamtuma kwenu kwa Jina langu, atawafundisha mambo yote na kuwakumbusha yote niliyowaambia.
Ekegusii: Korende Omokonyi, Omoika Omochenu, oyo Tata aratome ase erieta riane, ere naborokererie onsi, na kobainyoria onsi aya nabateebirie.

English: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
Kiswahili: Amani nawaachia, amani yangu nawapa, amani hii niwapayo si kama ile ulimwengu utoayo. Msifadhaike mioyoni mwenu, wala msiogope.
Ekegusii: Omorembe nabatigeire; omorembe one nabaeire; tinkoyobaa buna ense ekoyobaa. Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino, gose timoba nobwoba.

English: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
Kiswahili: “Mlinisikia nikisema, ‘Ninakwenda zangu, lakini nitarudi tena.’ Kama kweli mngelinipenda mngelifurahi kwa kuwa naenda kwa Baba, kwani Baba ni mkuu kuniliko mimi.
Ekegusii: Mwaigwete inche nkobateebia: Nkogenda nde, na ninchiche naende ase more. Onye mwanyanchete, anga mwagogete, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, ekiagera Tata nomonene kombua.

English: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
Kiswahili: Nimewaambia mambo haya kabla hayajatukia, ili yatakapotukia mpate kuamini.
Ekegusii: Na bono nabateebirie ritang’ani ataraba, erinde ekero akoba, mwegene.

English: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
Kiswahili: Sitasema nanyi zaidi, kwa sababu yule mkuu wa ulimwengu huu anakuja, naye hana kitu kwangu,
Ekegusii: Tingokwana nainwe amang’ana amange naende, ekiagera omonene bw’ense ngocha are. Tari nokobua ase ’nde;

English: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
Kiswahili: lakini ulimwengu upate kujua kuwa ninampenda Baba, nami hufanya vile Baba alivyoniamuru. “Haya inukeni; twendeni zetu.
Ekegusii: korende nigo ngokora buna Tata achigeete, erinde ense emanye ng’a nimwanchete Tata. Imoka, torue aa!

English: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ndimi mzabibu wa kweli na Baba yangu ndiye mkulima.
Ekegusii: “Inche ninche omosabibu bw’ekeene, na Tata one nomooroiseria.

English: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
Kiswahili: Kila tawi ndani yangu lisilozaa matunda, Baba yangu hulikata, nalo kila tawi lizaalo, hulisafisha ili lipate kuzaa matunda zaidi.
Ekegusii: Kera orosagia ime ase ’nde orotameti, nigo akoronacha, na kera orokwama nigo akorososa, erinde romente kwama.

English: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mmekwisha kuwa safi kwa sababu ya lile neno nililonena nanyi.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwaikire koba abachenu ase engencho ye ring’ana nabateebirie.

English: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
Kiswahili: Kaeni ndani yangu, nami nikae ndani yenu. Kama vile tawi lisivyoweza kuzaa matunda lisipokaa ndani ya mzabibu, vivyo hivyo ninyi msipokaa ndani yangu hamwezi kuzaa matunda.
Ekegusii: Menya ime yane, na inche ime yaino. Buna orosagia rotanyare kwama rwoka oronyene, rotabeti ime ase omosabibu, naboigo nainwe motamenyeti ime yane.

English: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ni mzabibu, ninyi ni matawi. Akaaye ndani yangu, nami ndani yake, huyo huzaa sana, maana pasipo mimi ninyi hamwezi kufanya jambo lolote.
Ekegusii: Inche nomosabibu, na inwe nechinsagia. Oyo omenyete ime yane, na inche ime yaye, oyio name mono, ekiagera ntaiyo inche, timokonyara gokora kende gionsi.

English: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asipokaa ndani yangu, hutupwa nje kama tawi na kunyauka. Matawi kama hayo hukusanywa na kutupwa motoni, yakateketea.
Ekegusii: Omonto otamenyeti ime yane, nigo aratugutwe isiko buna orosagia rwomete. Chinsagia chiomete nigo chigosangererigwa, na korutwa ase omorero, na koyia.

English: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mkikaa ndani yangu na maneno yangu yakikaa ndani yenu, ombeni lolote mtakalo, nanyi mtatendewa.
Ekegusii: Komoramenye ime yane, na amang’ana aane karabe ime yaino, saba kera ekemoganetie na inwe namokorerwe.

English: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Baba yangu hutukuzwa, kwa vile mzaavyo matunda mengi, nanyi mtakuwa wanafunzi wangu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Tata abakwe ekero mwamire mono; na inwe namobe aborokigwa baane.

English: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
Kiswahili: “Kama vile Baba alivyonipenda mimi, hivyo ndivyo mimi nilivyowapenda ninyi. Basi kaeni katika pendo langu.
Ekegusii: Buna Tata anyanchete inche, na inche nabanchire inwe, menya ase obwanchani bwane.

English: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
Kiswahili: Mkizishika amri zangu mtakaa katika pendo langu, kama mimi nilivyozishika amri za Baba yangu na kukaa katika pendo lake.
Ekegusii: Komorabwate amachiiko aane, namomenye ase obwanchani bwane, buna inche nabwatete amachiiko a Tata one na komenya ase obwanchani bwaye.

English: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
Kiswahili: Nimewaambia mambo haya ili furaha yangu iwe ndani yenu na furaha yenu iwe kamili.
Ekegusii: Aya nabateebirie, erinde omogooko one obe ime yaino, naende ng’a omogooko oino oikeranigwe.

English: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
Kiswahili: Amri yangu ndiyo hii: Mpendane kama mimi nilivyowapenda ninyi.
Ekegusii: “Richiko riane nario eri: Mwanchane buna nabanchete inwe.

English: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu mwenye upendo mkuu kuliko huu, mtu kuutoa uhai wake kwa ajili ya rafiki zake.
Ekegusii: Onde tari ore nobwanchani obonene kobua obo, obw’omonto akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho y’abasani baye.

English: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
Kiswahili: Ninyi ni rafiki zangu mkifanya ninayowaamuru.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo more abasani baane, komorakore aya nabachiikire.

English: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
Kiswahili: Siwaiti ninyi watumishi tena, kwa sababu watumishi hawajui bwana wao analofanya, bali nimewaita ninyi rafiki, kwa maana nimewajulisha mambo yote niliyoyasikia kutoka kwa Baba yangu.
Ekegusii: Tinkobaroka naende abasomba, ekiagera omosomba tamanyeti eki omonene oye agokora; korende inwe nabarokire abasani, ekiagera onsi aya naigwete korwa ase Tata nabaorokeirie.

English: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
Kiswahili: Si ninyi mlionichagua, bali mimi ndiye niliyewachagua ninyi na kuwaweka mwende mkazae matunda, na matunda yenu yapate kudumu. Ili nalo lolote mtakalomwomba Baba katika Jina langu, awape ninyi.
Ekegusii: Tari inwe mwanchorire inche, korende ninche nabachorire inwe, nababekire mogende kwama, okwama kwaino goikaranse; erio rinde rionsi mogosaba Tata ase erieta riane, nigo arabae.

English: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
Kiswahili: Amri yangu ndiyo hii: Mpendane.
Ekegusii: “Aya nabachiikire naro aya: mwanchane.

English: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
Kiswahili: “Kama ulimwengu ukiwachukia ninyi, kumbukeni kwamba ulinichukia mimi kabla yenu.
Ekegusii: Ense kerabageche, momanyete ng’a yangechire inche etarabagecha inwe.

English: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
Kiswahili: Kama mngekuwa wa ulimwengu, ulimwengu ungeliwapenda kama vile unavyowapenda walio wake. Kwa sababu ninyi si wa ulimwengu, lakini mimi nimewachagua kutoka ulimwengu, hii ndiyo sababu ulimwengu unawachukia.
Ekegusii: Onye nab’ense mware, anga ense ’yancha abare abaye, korende ekiagera inwe timori ab’ense, otatiga inche nabachorire korwa ase ense, ase ayio ense yabagechire.

English: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni lile neno nililowaambia, ‘Hakuna mtumishi aliye mkuu kuliko bwana wake.’ Kama wamenitesa mimi, nanyi pia watawatesa. Kama wamelishika neno langu, watalishika na neno lenu pia.
Ekegusii: Inyora ring’ana riria nabateebeetie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye. Onye banchandete inche, nabaabachande nainwe; onye babwatete ring’ana riane nabwate neriaino.

English: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
Kiswahili: Watawatendea ninyi haya yote kwa ajili ya Jina langu, kwa sababu hawamjui yeye aliyenituma.
Ekegusii: Korende aya onsi nabaabakorere ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera tibamomanyeti oyontomete.

English: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
Kiswahili: Kama sikuja na kusema nao wasingalikuwa na hatia ya dhambi. Lakini sasa hawana udhuru kwa ajili ya dhambi zao.
Ekegusii: Onye ntachete gokwana nabarabwo, anga tibarenge nebibe, korende bono tibari nogwekengera ase ebibe biabo.

English: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayenichukia mimi, anamchukia pia na Baba yangu.
Ekegusii: Oyongechete inche, nigo amogechete na Tata one.

English: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.
Kiswahili: Kama sikuwa nimefanya miujiza ambayo haijapata kufanywa na mtu mwingine yeyote, wasingalikuwa na hatia ya dhambi. Lakini sasa wameiona miujiza hii na bado wakatuchukia mimi na Baba yangu.
Ekegusii: Onye ntakorete emeremo ase bare eye monto onde atakoreti, anga tibabete nebibe, korende bono barorire, naende batogechire inche na Tata.

English: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
Kiswahili: Lakini hii ni kutimiza lile neno lililoandikwa kwenye Sheria kwamba, ‘Walinichukia pasipo sababu.’
Ekegusii: Korende igo riikerane ring’ana eriarigetwe ase amachiiko abo: Nigo bangechete bosa.

English: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
Kiswahili: “Lakini atakapokuja huyo Msaidizi nitakayemtuma kwenu kutoka kwa Baba, yaani, huyo Roho wa kweli atokaye kwa Baba, yeye atanishuhudia mimi.
Ekegusii: Korende karache Omokonyi, oyo ndabatomere korwa ase Tata, Omoika bw’Ekeene okorwa ase Tata, ere nambere kirori.

English: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
Kiswahili: Ninyi nanyi itawapasa kushuhudia kwa sababu mmekuwa pamoja nami tangu mwanzo.
Ekegusii: Na inwe boigo mwambereire birori, ekiagera korwa omochakano mwarenge amo nainche.

English: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
Kiswahili: “Nimewaambia mambo haya yote ili msije mkaiacha imani.
Ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya nabateebirie timocha kogochwa.

English: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
Kiswahili: Watawatenga na masinagogi. Naam, saa yaja ambayo mtu yeyote atakayewaua atadhani kwa kufanya hivyo anamtumikia Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabaabaserie korwa ase chisinagogi; nabo engaki neche ekero onde bwensi arabaite akage ng’a okoreire Nyasae emeremo.

English: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
Kiswahili: Nao watawatenda haya kwa sababu hawamjui Baba wala mimi.
Ekegusii: Naende ayio nabaabakorere, ekiagera tibamomanyeti Tata, nonya ninche.

English: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
Kiswahili: Lakini nimewaambia ninyi mambo haya, ili saa hiyo ikiwadia mpate kukumbuka ya kuwa nilikuwa nimewaambia. Sikuwaambia mambo haya tangu mwanzo kwa sababu nilikuwa pamoja nanyi.
Ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie aya, erio engaki eria egocha, moyainyore ng’a inche nabateebeetie. “Tinabateebeetie aya korwa omochakano, ekiagera narenge amo nainwe.

English: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
Kiswahili: “Sasa mimi ninakwenda kwake yeye aliyenituma, lakini hakuna hata aniulizaye, ‘Unakwenda wapi?’
Ekegusii: Korende bono nkogenda nde asare ere oyontomete; gose onde tari ase more okomboria: Ing’ai ogochia?

English: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu nimewaambia mambo haya, mioyo yenu imejawa na huzuni.
Ekegusii: Korende ekiagera nabateebirie aya, omoichano oichoire chinkoro chiaino.

English: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
Kiswahili: Lakini nawaambia kweli, yafaa mimi niondoke, kwa kuwa nisipoondoka, huyo Msaidizi hatakuja kwenu, lakini nikienda nitamtuma kwenu.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie erire ri’ekeene: Nebe buya ase more inche ngende, ekiagera ntagendeti, Omokonyi oria tagocha ase more; korende kondagende, nimotome ase more.

English: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
Kiswahili: Naye atakapokuja, atauthibitishia ulimwengu kuhusu dhambi, haki na hukumu.
Ekegusii: Naende ekero arache ere, naenekerie ense ase amang’ana ’ebibe, naende oboronge, naende ekiina;

English: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya dhambi, kwa sababu hawaniamini mimi,
Ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’ebibe, ekiagera tibanyegeneti inche;

English: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
Kiswahili: kwa habari ya haki, kwa sababu ninakwenda kwa Baba, nanyi hamtaniona tena,
Ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’oboronge, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, gose timokondora naende;

English: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
Kiswahili: kwa habari ya hukumu, kwa sababu yule mkuu wa ulimwengu huu amekwisha kuhukumiwa.
Ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’ekina, ekiagera omonene bw’ense eye okoorire kogambigwa.

English: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
Kiswahili: “Bado ninayo mambo mengi ya kuwaambia, lakini hamwezi kuyastahimili sasa.
Ekegusii: “Ninde nayande amange atigarete nkobateebia, korende timokonyara koyaremereria bono.

English: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
Kiswahili: Atakapokuja huyo Roho wa kweli atawaongoza awatie katika kweli yote. Yeye hatanena kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, bali atanena yale yote atakayosikia, naye atawaonyesha mambo yajayo.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero arache ere, Omoika bw’Ekeene, nobaraae ase onsi ayare ay’ekeene, ere tagokwana ayare ayaye, korende onsi ayaranyare koigwa nayakwane, naende amang’ana agochi‐gocha nabateebie engencho yaye.

English: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
Kiswahili: Atanitukuza mimi, kwa maana atayachukua yaliyo yangu na kuwajulisha ninyi.
Ekegusii: Ere nambake inche, ekiagera nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie.

English: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
Kiswahili: Vyote alivyo navyo Baba ni vyangu. Ndiyo maana nimesema Roho atachukua yaliyo yangu na kuwajulisha ninyi.
Ekegusii: Onsi ayare aya Tata nayane; ase ayio ngateba ng’a nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie.

English: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
Kiswahili: “Bado kitambo kidogo nanyi hamtaniona na tena bado kitambo kidogo nanyi mtaniona.”
Ekegusii: “Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.”

English: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wanafunzi wakaulizana, “Ana maana gani asemapo, ‘Bado kitambo kidogo nanyi hamtaniona na tena bado kitambo kidogo nanyi mtaniona’? Naye ana maana gani asemapo, ‘Kwa sababu ninakwenda kwa Baba’?”
Ekegusii: Nabo abande baborokigwa baye bagateebania, “Ing’ana ki eri agoteeba: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore; na: Nkogenda nde ase Tata?”

English: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
Kiswahili: Wakaendelea kuulizana, “Ana maana gani asemapo, ‘Kitambo kidogo’? Hatuelewi hilo analosema.”
Ekegusii: Nabo bagateeba, “Ing’ana ki eri agoteeba, ng’a nkere ekero egeke? Titomanyeti eri agokwana.”

English: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
Kiswahili: Yesu akatambua kuwa walitaka kumuuliza juu ya hilo, hivyo akawaambia, “Je, mnaulizana nina maana gani niliposema, ‘Bado kitambo kidogo nanyi hamtaniona na tena bado kitambo kidogo nanyi mtaniona’?
Ekegusii: Yeso akamanya ng’a mbarigetie komoboria, akabateebia, “Inee! Nigo mokoborania inwe ase inwe ase erio natebiire: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore, naende nkere ekero egeke morandore?

English: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, ninyi mtalia na kuomboleza, lakini ulimwengu utafurahi. Ninyi mtahuzunika, lakini huzuni yenu itageuka kuwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Inwe namorere na kweng’ereria, korende ense negoke; inwe namoichanigwe, korende ogoichana kwaino nakoonchoke koba omogooko.

English: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke anapokuwa na utungu wa kuzaa huwa na maumivu kwa sababu saa yake imewadia. Lakini mtoto akiisha kuzaliwa, yule mwanamke husahau maumivu hayo kwa sababu ya furaha ya kuzaliwa mtoto ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: Omokungu gakobina ase okoibora, nigo are nomoichano, ekiagera ensa yaye yaikire; korende gaikire koibora omwana, tari koinyora obororo bwaye naende, ase engencho y’omogooko bw’okoiborwa kw’omonto ase ense.

English: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ninyi mna maumivu sasa, lakini nitawaona tena, nayo mioyo yenu itafurahi na furaha yenu hakuna awaondoleaye.
Ekegusii: Nabo nainwe bono nigo more nomoichano; korende nimbarore naende, ne chinkoro chiaino nachigoke, na omogooko oino onde tari orabaure.

English: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
Kiswahili: Katika siku hiyo hamtaniuliza neno lolote. Amin, amin nawaambia, kama mkimwomba Baba jambo lolote kwa jina langu, yeye atawapa.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria timokomboria ring’ana. Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Komorasabe Tata kende gionsi ase erieta riane nabae.

English: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
Kiswahili: Mpaka sasa hamjaomba jambo lolote kwa Jina langu. Ombeni nanyi mtapewa, ili furaha yenu ipate kuwa kamili.
Ekegusii: Goika reero timorasaba gento ase erieta riane; saba, namonyore, erinde omogooko oino obe omoikeranu.

English: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
Kiswahili: “Nimewaambia mambo haya kwa mafumbo. Saa yaja ambapo sitazungumza nanyi tena kwa mafumbo bali nitawaeleza waziwazi kuhusu Baba.
Ekegusii: “Aya nakwanire nainwe ase emereng’anio; engaki neche ntakwane naende ase emereng’anio, korende nimborokie maiso marore amang’ana a Tata.

English: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
Kiswahili: Siku hiyo mtaomba kwa Jina langu. Wala sitawaambia kwamba nitamwomba Baba kwa ajili yenu,
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria namosabe ase erieta riane; tinkobateebia ng’a nimbasabere ase Tata,

English: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
Kiswahili: kwa maana Baba mwenyewe anawapenda, kwa sababu mmenipenda mimi na mmeamini kwamba nimetoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Tata omonyene nigo abanchete inwe, ekiagera inwe mwanyanchire inche, na mwegenire ng’a inche nigo narwete ase Tata.

English: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
Kiswahili: Nilitoka kwa Baba na kuja ulimwenguni, sasa naondoka ulimwenguni na kurudi kwa Baba.”
Ekegusii: Narwete ase Tata, ngacha ase ense; naende ngotiga nde ense na nkoirana nde ase Tata.”

English: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wanafunzi wake wakasema, “Sasa unazungumza waziwazi, wala si kwa mafumbo.
Ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakaboora, “Rora, bono ngokwana ore maiso marore, gose tori gokwana omobayeeno onde bwonsi.

English: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
Kiswahili: Sasa tumejua kwamba wewe unajua mambo yote, wala hakuna haja ya mtu kukuuliza maswali. Kwa jambo hili tunaamini kwamba ulitoka kwa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Bono twamanyire ng’a kwamanyire onsi, torigeti omonto akoborie. Ase ayio twegenire ng’a nigo kwarwete ase Nyasae.”

English: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
Kiswahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, sasa mnaamini?
Ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Igo bono mwegenire?

English: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
Kiswahili: Saa inakuja, naam, imekwisha kuwadia, mtakapotawanyika kila mmoja kwenda nyumbani kwake na kuniacha peke yangu. Lakini mimi siko peke yangu kwa sababu Baba yu pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Rora engaki neche, ee nabo yaikire gocha, namwatananeke, kera oyomo ase mwaye, namontige inche bweka, korende tindi inche bweka, ekiagera Tata nigo are amo nainche.

English: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
Kiswahili: Nimewaambia mambo haya, ili mpate kuwa na amani mkiwa ndani yangu. Ulimwenguni mtapata dhiki. Lakini jipeni moyo, kwa maana mimi nimeushinda ulimwengu.”
Ekegusii: Aya nabateebirie, erinde monyare koba nomorembe ime yane. Ase ense namonyore emechando, korende remia emioyo; inche nabuire ense.”

English: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
Kiswahili: Baada ya Yesu kusema haya, alitazama kuelekea mbinguni akawaombea na kusema: “Baba, saa imewadia. Umtukuze Mwanao, ili Mwanao apate kukutukuza wewe.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akwanete amang’ana ayio akaimokia amaiso aye, akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Tata, ensa yaikire. Mobake Omwana oo, erinde Omwana nere akobake aye,

English: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa umempa mamlaka juu ya wote wenye mwili ili awape uzima wa milele wale uliompa.
Ekegusii: buna kwamoete okobua igoro ase Mwanyabaanto bonsi, erinde bonsi aba kwamoeire, abae obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Nao uzima wa milele ndio huu, wakujue wewe uliye Mungu wa pekee, wa kweli na Yesu Kristo uliyemtuma.
Ekegusii: Na obogima bwa kare na kare nabwo obo: bakomanye aye Nyasae bw’ekeene bweka, naende Yeso Kristo gwatomete.

English: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
Kiswahili: Nimekutukuza wewe duniani kwa kuitimiza ile kazi uliyonipa niifanye.
Ekegusii: Inche nakobakire ase ense, emeremo eria kwang’ete gokora nayekoorire.

English: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
Kiswahili: Hivyo sasa, Baba, unitukuze mbele zako kwa ule utukufu niliokuwa nao pamoja na wewe kabla ulimwengu haujakuwepo.
Ekegusii: Na bono Tata, ombake inche amo naye, ase obonene boria narenge nabwo amo naye ritang’ani ense etaratongwa.

English: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
Kiswahili: “Nimelidhihirisha jina lako kwa wale ulionipa kutoka ulimwengu. Walikuwa wako, nawe ukanipa mimi, nao wamelitii neno lako.
Ekegusii: “Erieta riao nariorokeirie abanto baria kwang’ete korwa ase ense. Barabwo nigo barenge abao, okabang’a inche, ne ring’ana riao baribwatire.

English: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
Kiswahili: Sasa wamejua ya kuwa vyote ulivyonipa vimetoka kwako,
Ekegusii: Bono bamanyire ng’a onsi aya kwang’ete nigo akorwa ase ore.

English: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa maneno yale ulionipa nimewapa wao, nao wameyapokea na kujua kwamba kweli nimetoka kwako, nao wameamini kuwa wewe ulinituma.
Ekegusii: Naki amang’ana kwang’ete nabayaeire, na barabwo bayabwatire, mbamanyete ekeene ng’a nigo narure ase ore, bakeegena ng’a naye gwantomete.

English: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
Kiswahili: Ninawaombea wao. Mimi siuombei ulimwengu, bali nawaombea wale ulionipa kwa sababu wao ni wako.
Ekegusii: Inche nabasabeire barabwo; tindi gosabera ense, korende barabwo aba kwang’eire ekiagera barabwo nabao.

English: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
Kiswahili: Wote walio wangu ni wako na walio wako ni wangu, nami nimetukuzwa ndani yao.
Ekegusii: Na bonsi abare abaane nabao, na abare abao nabaane, na inche nabakirwe ime yabo.

English: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
Kiswahili: Mimi sasa simo tena ulimwenguni, lakini wao bado wamo ulimwenguni, nami naja kwako. Baba Mtakatifu, uwalinde kwa uweza wa jina lako ulilonipa, ili wawe na umoja kama sisi tulivyo wamoja.
Ekegusii: Inche tinkoba ase ense ime naende, korende aba nao bare ase ense ime, na inche ngocha nde ase ore. Tata Omochenu, obarende ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete, babe abamo buna intwe tore oyomo.

English: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
Kiswahili: Nilipokuwa pamoja nao, niliwalinda, wakawa salama kwa lile jina ulilonipa. Hakuna hata mmoja aliyepotea, isipokuwa yule aliyekusudiwa upotevu, ili Maandiko yapate kutimia.
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge amo nabarabwo ase ense, nigo nabarendete ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete. Igo nabaritete, gose tari nonya noyomo obo osirire, otatiga oria omwana bw’obosiru, erinde ririiko rinyare goikeranigwa.

English: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
Kiswahili: “Lakini sasa naja kwako, nami ninasema mambo haya wakati bado nikiwa ulimwenguni, ili wawe na furaha yangu kamili ndani yao.
Ekegusii: Na bono ngocha nde ase ore, na aya nkoyakwana, inde ase ense ime, erinde omogooko one obe oikeranigwe ime yabo.

English: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
Kiswahili: Nimewapa neno lako, nao ulimwengu umewachukia kwa kuwa wao si wa ulimwengu kama mimi nisivyo wa ulimwengu huu.
Ekegusii: Inche nabaeire ring’ana riao; ense yabagechire, ekiagera barabwo tibari abanto b’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.

English: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
Kiswahili: Siombi kwamba uwaondoe ulimwenguni, bali uwalinde dhidi ya yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: Tinsabeti ng’a obarusie korwa ase ense, korende obarende korwa ase oria omobe.

English: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
Kiswahili: Wao si wa ulimwengu huu, kama vile mimi nisivyo wa ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibari ab’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.

English: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
Kiswahili: Uwatakase kwa ile kweli, neno lako ndilo kweli.
Ekegusii: Obachene ase ekeene; ring’ana riao nario ekeene.

English: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
Kiswahili: Kama vile ulivyonituma mimi ulimwenguni, nami nawatuma vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Buna gwantomete inche ime ase ense, na inche naboigo nabatomire barabwo ase ense ime.

English: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili yao najiweka wakfu ili wao nao wapate kutakaswa katika ile kweli.
Ekegusii: Na ase engencho yabo nechenire, erinde nabarabwo bachenwe ase ekeene.

English: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
Kiswahili: “Siwaombei hawa peke yao, bali nawaombea na wale wote watakaoniamini kupitia neno lao
Ekegusii: “Gose tari barabwo boka nasabeire, korende na baria baranyegene ase engencho ye ring’ana riabo,

English: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
Kiswahili: ili wawe na umoja kama vile wewe Baba ulivyo ndani yangu na mimi nilivyo ndani yako, wao nao wawe ndani yetu, ili ulimwengu upate kuamini ya kuwa wewe ndiye uliyenituma mimi.
Ekegusii: bonsi babe abamo, buna aye Tata ore ime ase ’nde, na inche ime yao, erinde na aba babe abamo ime yaito; ense enyare kwengena ng’a naye gwantomete.

English: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,
Kiswahili: Utukufu ule ulionipa nimewapa wao, ili wawe na umoja kama sisi tulivyo wamoja.
Ekegusii: Na obonene boria kwang’ete nabaeire, babe abamo, buna intwe tore oyomo;

English: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
Kiswahili: Mimi ndani yako na wewe ndani yangu, ili wawe wamekamilika katika umoja na ulimwengu upate kujua ya kuwa umenituma, nami nimewapenda wao kama unavyonipenda mimi.
Ekegusii: inche ime yabo, na aye ime yane, banyare goikerana babe abamo. Igo ense emanye ng’a naye gwantomete, okabancha barabwo, buna kwanyanchete inche.

English: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
Kiswahili: “Baba, shauku yangu ni kwamba, wale ulionipa wawe pamoja nami pale nilipo, ili waweze kuuona utukufu wangu, yaani, utukufu ule ulionipa kwa kuwa ulinipenda hata kabla ya kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Tata, abwo kwang’ete, ninganetie babe amo nainche aase aande onsi inde, banyare korigereria obonene bwane kwang’ete, ekiagera nigo kwanyanchete ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso.

English: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
Kiswahili: “Baba Mwenye Haki, ingawa ulimwengu haukujui, mimi ninakujua, nao wanajua ya kuwa umenituma.
Ekegusii: Tata omonyene oboronge, ense tiyakomanyete, korende inche nakomanyete; na aba bamanyire ng’a naye gwantomete.

English: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
Kiswahili: Nimefanya jina lako lijulikane kwao nami nitaendelea kufanya lijulikane, ili kwamba upendo ule unaonipenda mimi uwe ndani yao na mimi mwenyewe nipate kuwa ndani yao.”
Ekegusii: Nabamanyetie erieta riao, naende nimbarimanyie, erinde obwanchani boria kwanyanchete inche bobe ime yabo, na inche imbe ime yabo.”

English: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomaliza kuomba, akaondoka na wanafunzi wake wakavuka Bonde la Kidroni. Upande wa pili palikuwa na bustani, yeye na wanafunzi wake wakaingia humo.
Ekegusii: Yeso gakwanire amang’ana aya, akaimoka amo naborokigwa baye kogenda ng’umbu y’akarooche Kedron, aase omogondo orenge. Ere na aborokigwa baye bagasoa aroro.

English: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
Kiswahili: Basi Yuda, yule aliyemsaliti alipafahamu mahali hapo kwani Yesu alikuwa akikutana humo na wanafunzi wake mara kwa mara.
Ekegusii: Na Yudasi, oria omoruete naamanyete aase aria, ekiagera Yeso are kogenda aroro ekero ase ekero amo naborokigwa baye.

English: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yuda akaja bustanini. Aliongoza kikosi cha askari wa Kirumi, na baadhi ya maafisa kutoka kwa viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo. Nao walikuwa wamechukua taa, mienge na silaha.
Ekegusii: Nabo Yudasi gaikire konyora omoganda bw’abarwani, na abarendi baruete ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, akagenda aroro ne chitaaya na ebieri, na ebinto bi’esegi.

English: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akijua yale yote yatakayompata, akajitokeza mbele yao akawauliza, “Mnamtafuta nani?”
Ekegusii: Nabo Yeso, kamanyete onsi ayagochia komonyoora, akaoroka, akababoria, “Ning’o mokorigia?”

English: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
Kiswahili: Wao wakamjibu, “Yesu wa Nazareti.” Yesu akawajibu, “Mimi ndiye.” Yuda, yule aliyemsaliti alikuwa amesimama pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso Omonazareti.” Yeso akabateebia, “Ninche ere.” Yudasi nere oyomoruete nigo ateneine amo nabarabwo.

English: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.
Kiswahili: Yesu alipowaambia, “Mimi ndiye,” walirudi nyuma na kuanguka chini!
Ekegusii: Nabo ekero Yeso achia kobateebia, “Ninche ere,” bakairana magega, bagaaka inse.

English: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
Kiswahili: Akawauliza tena, “Mnamtafuta nani?” Nao wakamjibu, “Yesu wa Nazareti.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria eria kabere, “Ning’o mokorigia?” Bakaboora, “Yeso Omonazareti.”

English: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Nimekwisha kuwaambia kuwa, mimi ndiye; kwa hiyo kama mnanitafuta mimi, waacheni hawa watu waende zao.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Naikire kobateebia ng’a ninche ere; nabo onye mokondigia inche, batige aba bagende.”

English: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa ili litimie lile neno alilosema, “Sikumpoteza hata mmoja miongoni mwa wale ulionipa.”
Ekegusii: Erio riikeranigwe ring’ana riria akwanete, “Aba kwang’ete tinsireti nonya noyomo obo.”

English: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro, aliyekuwa na upanga, akaufuta na kumkata sikio la kuume mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu. Jina la mtumishi huyo aliitwa Malko.
Ekegusii: Nabo Simioni Petero narenge nomoyio o birende, akayong’usa, agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto kwaye gw’okorio. Na omosomba oria erieta riaye nigo are korokwa Maliko.

English: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia Petro, “Rudisha upanga wako kwenye ala yake. Je, hainipasi kukinywea kikombe alichonipa Baba?”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia Petero, “Irania omoyio oo ase ekeraano kiaye. Inee! Egekombe eke Tata ang’eire, tinkenywera?”

English: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
Kiswahili: Hivyo wale askari, wakiwa pamoja na majemadari wao na maafisa wa Wayahudi, wakamkamata Yesu na kumfunga.
Ekegusii: Abarwani b’esegi amo nomotang’ani obo, na abarendi baria b’Abayahudi bakabwata Yeso, bakamosiba.

English: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
Kiswahili: Kwanza wakampeleka kwa Anasi, mkwewe Kayafa, aliyekuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka ule.
Ekegusii: Erio bakamoira ritang’ani ase Anasi oyorenge ise biara Kayafa, oria orenge Omokuani omonene omwaka oria.

English: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
Kiswahili: Kayafa ndiye alikuwa amewashauri Wayahudi kwamba imempasa mtu mmoja kufa kwa ajili ya watu.
Ekegusii: Na Kayafa nere oete Abayahudi amang’ana ng’a negwenerete omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y’abanto.

English: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro pamoja na mwanafunzi mwingine walikuwa wakimfuata Yesu. Huyu mwanafunzi mwingine alikuwa anafahamika kwa kuhani mkuu, hivyo aliingia ndani ya ukumbi pamoja na Yesu.
Ekegusii: Simioni Petero na omworokigwa onde bagatunyana Yeso. Omworokigwa oria onde nigo amanyekanete n’Omokuani omonene, agasoa amo na Yeso ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene,

English: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro alisimama nje karibu na lango, ndipo yule mwanafunzi mwingine, aliyejulikana na kuhani mkuu, akazungumza na msichana aliyekuwa analinda lango, akamruhusu Petro aingie ndani.
Ekegusii: korende Petero agatenena gesieri isiko. Nabo omworokigwa oria onde, oyomanyekanete n’Omokuani omonene agasoka agakwana nomoiseke orenge korenda gesieri, akarenta Petero ime.

English: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
Kiswahili: Yule msichana akamuuliza Petro, “Je, wewe pia si mmoja wa wanafunzi wa mtu huyu?” Petro akajibu, “Sio mimi.”
Ekegusii: Erio omoiseke oria orenge korenda gesieri akaboria Petero, “Aye tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye omonto oyo?” Ere agakana, “Tari inche.”

English: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
Kiswahili: Wale watumishi na askari walikuwa wamesimama wakiota moto wa makaa kwa sababu palikuwa na baridi, Petro naye alikuwa amesimama pamoja nao akiota moto.
Ekegusii: Abasomba baria na abarwani nigo barenge bateneine, bautete omorero bw’amakara, ekiagera obokendu mbwarenge, bakaba ngwota bare omorero. Petero nere nigo arenge amo nabarabwo, ogwota omorero.

English: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo kuhani mkuu akawa anamuuliza Yesu kuhusu wanafunzi wake na mafundisho yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene akaboria Yeso amang’ana igoro yaborokigwa baye, na amang’ana ’okworokereria kwaye.

English: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Nimekuwa nikizungumza waziwazi mbele ya watu wote. Siku zote nimefundisha katika masinagogi na Hekaluni, mahali ambapo Wayahudi wote hukusanyika. Sikusema jambo lolote kwa siri.
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche nakwanire nense maiso marore. Amatuko onsi nigo narenge kworokereria ase chisinagogi na ase Hekalu, aase Abayahudi bonsi baare gosangererekana, gose tintebeti ing’ana bobisi.

English: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
Kiswahili: Mbona unaniuliza mimi maswali? Waulize wale walionisikia yale niliyowaambia. Wao wanajua niliyosema.”
Ekegusii: Nase ki okomboria? Boria baria baigwete aya nakwanete nabarabwo; barabwo mbamanyete aya nabateebeetie.”

English: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
Kiswahili: Alipomaliza kusema hayo, mmoja wa askari aliyekuwa amesimama karibu naye, akampiga Yesu kofi usoni, kisha akasema, “Je, hivyo ndivyo unavyomjibu kuhani mkuu?”
Ekegusii: Gachia gokwana amang’ana aya, oyomo bw’abarendi baria oteneine ang’e, agaaka Yeso oroe, akabora, “Naboigo okoiraneria Omokuani omonene?”

English: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu akasema, “Kama nimesema jambo baya, shuhudia huo ubaya niliousema. Lakini kama nimesema yaliyo kweli, mbona umenipiga?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nakwana bobe, orokia obobe boria, korende onye nakwana buya, ninki okong’akera?”

English: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Anasi akampeleka Yesu kwa kuhani mkuu Kayafa, akiwa bado amefungwa.
Ekegusii: Nabo Anasi akamoira osibire ase Kayafa, Omokuani omonene.

English: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Simoni Petro alikuwa amesimama akiota moto. Baadhi ya wale waliokuwepo wakamuuliza, “Je, wewe si mmoja wa wanafunzi wake?” Petro akakana, akasema, “Sio mimi.”
Ekegusii: Na Simioni Petero nigo arenge oteneine ogwota omorero. Bakamoteebia, “Aye boigo tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye?” Ere agakana, akabora, “Tari inche.”

English: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa watumishi wa kuhani mkuu, ndugu yake yule mtu ambaye Petro alikuwa amemkata sikio, akamuuliza, “Je, mimi sikukuona kule bustanini ukiwa na Yesu?”
Ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba b’Omokuani Omonene, omoamate bw’oria onachetwe ogoto na Petero, akabora, “Inche tinakorooche ime ase omogondo amo nere?”

English: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
Kiswahili: Kwa mara nyingine tena Petro akakana, naye jogoo akawika wakati huo huo.
Ekegusii: Petero agakana naende. Erio kegima etuoni ekabuga.

English: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakamchukua Yesu kutoka kwa Kayafa na kumpeleka kwenye jumba la kifalme la mtawala wa Kirumi. Wakati huo ilikuwa ni alfajiri, ili kuepuka kuwa najisi kwa taratibu za ibada, Wayahudi hawakuingia ndani kwa sababu ya sheria za Kiyahudi. Wangehesabiwa kuwa najisi kama wangeingia nyumbani mwa mtu asiye Myahudi na wasingeruhusiwa kushiriki katika Sikukuu ya Pasaka.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaira Yeso korwa ase Kayafa goika enyomba enene y’ekegambero. Bokaba bogokiamoka, na barabwo abanyene tibasoa ime ase ekegambero, tibaabaisa gocha kobekwa ogotacheneka korende bararia Epasaka.

English: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
Kiswahili: Hivyo Pilato akatoka nje walikokuwa akawauliza, “Mmeleta mashtaka gani kumhusu mtu huyu?”
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato akabachiera isiko, akababoria, “Ngosoera ki mobwate ase omonto oyo?”

English: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
Kiswahili: Wao wakamjibu, “Kama huyu mtu hakuwa mhalifu tusingemleta kwako.”
Ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Onye oyo atarenge omokori amabe, anga titwamorenta ase ore.”

English: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”
Kiswahili: Pilato akawaambia, “Basi mchukueni ninyi mkamhukumu kwa kufuata sheria zenu.” Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Sisi haturuhusiwi kutoa hukumu ya kifo kwa mtu yeyote.”
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato akabateebia, “Moire inwe, momogambie ase ogochika kwaino.” Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Intwe titori ne ribaga goita omonto.”

English: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
Kiswahili: Walisema hivyo ili yale maneno aliyosema Yesu kuhusu kifo atakachokufa yapate kutimia.
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ria Yeso riikeranigwe, eri akwanete ase okoorokia imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.

English: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Pilato akaingia ndani ya jumba la kifalme, akamwita Yesu, akamuuliza, “Wewe ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi?”
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato agasoa ekegambero naende, akarangeria Yeso, akamobooria, “Inee! Naye omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”

English: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Je, unauliza swali hili kutokana na mawazo yako mwenyewe, au uliambiwa na watu kunihusu mimi?”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Naye gwateebire ayio aye omonyene, gose nabaanto bande bagotebirie amang’ana aya igoro yane?”

English: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
Kiswahili: Pilato akamjibu, “Mimi si Myahudi, ama sivyo? Taifa lako mwenyewe na viongozi wa makuhani wamekukabidhi kwangu. Umefanya kosa gani?”
Ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria, “Inee! Inche n’Omoyahudi nde? Abanto b’egesaku kiao na abakuani abanene bakorentire ase ’nde. Inki gwakorete?”

English: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akajibu, “Ufalme wangu si wa ulimwengu huu. Ufalme wangu ungekuwa wa ulimwengu huu, wafuasi wangu wangenipigania ili nisitiwe mikononi mwa Wayahudi. Lakini kama ilivyo, ufalme wangu hautoki hapa ulimwenguni.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Oborwoti bwane tibori obw’ense eye. Onye oborwoti bwane mbwarenge obw’ense eye, abasomba baane anga mbandwanerera, tinyara kobekwa ase amaboko ’Abayahudi, korende bono oborwoti bwane tibori obw’aa.”

English: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
Kiswahili: Pilato akamuuliza, “Kwa hiyo wewe ni mfalme?” Yesu akajibu, “Wewe wasema kwamba mimi ni mfalme. Kwa kusudi hili nilizaliwa, na kwa ajili ya hili nilikuja ulimwenguni, ili niishuhudie kweli. Mtu yeyote aliye wa kweli husikia sauti yangu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamobooria, “Aye nomorwoti rende?” Yeso akairaneria, “Aye gwateebete ng’a inche nomorwoti. Inche nigo naiboretwe ase engencho y’aya, na ase engencho y’aya, ngacha ase ense, erinde imbe kirori ase ekeene. Kera oyore oyo bw’ekeene nigo akoigwa eriogi riane.”

English: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
Kiswahili: Pilato akamuuliza Yesu, “Kweli ni nini?” Baada ya kusema haya Pilato akaenda nje tena akawaambia wale viongozi wa Wayahudi waliomshtaki Yesu, “Sioni kosa lolote alilotenda mtu huyu.
Ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria, “Ekeene ngento ki?” Gakwanire ring’ana eri agachiera Abayahudi isiko eria kabere, akabateebia, “Inche tindochi bobe bonde asare.

English: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi mna desturi yenu kwamba wakati wa Pasaka nimwachie huru mfungwa mmoja mnayemtaka. Je, mnataka niwafungulie huyu ‘Mfalme wa Wayahudi’?”
Ekegusii: Korende inwe more nengencho ng’a nabasiborera omonto oyomo ase ekero ki’Epasaka; nabo morigetie mbasiborere Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”

English: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
Kiswahili: Wao wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Si huyu mtu, bali tufungulie Baraba!” Yule Baraba alikuwa mnyangʼanyi.
Ekegusii: Erio bagaaka eriogi naende, bakaboora, “Tari oyo, korende Baraba!” Baraba ere nigo arenge omouri.

English: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Pilato akamtoa Yesu akaamuru apigwe mijeledi.
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato akaira Yeso, akamoaka emecharichi.

English: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
Kiswahili: Askari wakasokota taji ya miiba, wakamvika Yesu kichwani. Wakamvalisha joho la zambarau.
Ekegusii: Abarwani bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera ase omotwe, bakamobekera na eanga embariri,

English: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
Kiswahili: Wakawa wanapanda pale alipo tena na tena, wakisema, “Salamu! Mfalme wa Wayahudi!” Huku wakimpiga makofi usoni.
Ekegusii: bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Masoge, Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi!” Bakamoaka chindoe.

English: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
Kiswahili: Pilato akatoka tena nje akawaambia wale waliokusanyika, “Tazameni, namkabidhi Yesu kwenu kuwajulisha kwamba mimi sikumwona ana hatia.”
Ekegusii: Pilato akaoroka naende isiko, akabateebia, “Rora, inche namorentire ase more, monyare komanya ng’a tindochi komocha konde asare.”

English: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akatoka nje akiwa amevaa ile taji ya miiba na lile vazi la zambarau. Pilato akawaambia, “Tazameni, huyu hapa huyo mtu!”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agasoka isiko, obekeire egutwa eria y’amagwa na eanga eria y’oborwoti embariri. Pilato akabateebia, “Rora omonto oyo!”

English: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
Kiswahili: Wale viongozi wa makuhani na maafisa walipomwona, wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Msulubishe! Msulubishe!” Pilato akawaambia, “Mchukueni ninyi mkamsulubishe, mimi sioni hatia juu yake.”
Ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na abarendi bagachia komoorora, bagaaka eriogi, bakobora, “Mobambe! Mobambe!” Pilato akabateebia, “Moire inwe, momobambe, ekiagera inche tindochi okomocha asare.”

English: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Sisi tunayo sheria na kutokana na sheria hiyo, hana budi kufa kwa sababu yeye alijiita Mwana wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Intwe ntore nogochika, naende ase ogochika okwo nagwenerete akwe, ekiagera agwekora koba Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
Kiswahili: Pilato aliposikia haya, akaogopa zaidi.
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana erio, akaba nobwoba kobua.

English: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
Kiswahili: Akaingia tena ndani ya jumba la kifalme, akamuuliza Yesu, “Wewe umetoka wapi?” Lakini Yesu hakumjibu.
Ekegusii: Agasoa ase ekegambero, akaboria Yeso naende, “Ing’ai kwarure aye?” Korende Yeso tamoiraneria.

English: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
Kiswahili: Pilato akamwambia, “Wewe unakataa kuongea na mimi? Hujui ya kuwa nina mamlaka ya kukuachia huru au kukusulubisha?”
Ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamobooria, “Togokwana nainche? Tomanyeti ng’a ninde nokobua gokobamba, naende ninde nokobua kogosibora?”

English: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Wewe hungekuwa na mamlaka yoyote juu yangu kama hungepewa kutoka juu. Kwa hiyo yeye aliyenitia mikononi mwako ana hatia ya dhambi iliyo kubwa zaidi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Anga tori nokobua konde gwonsi, onye otaeiri korwa igoro; ase ayio ere oyombegete ase amaboko ao nare nebibe ebinene kobua.”

English: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati huo, Pilato akajitahidi kutafuta njia ya kumfungua Yesu, lakini Wayahudi wakazidi kupiga kelele wakisema, “Ukimwachia huyu mtu, wewe si rafiki wa Kaisari. Mtu yeyote anayedai kuwa mfalme anampinga Kaisari.”
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo Pilato akarigia komosibora, korende Abayahudi bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Koramosibore, aye tori omosani o Kaisari; kera oyogwekora koba omorwoti nigo are mamincha ase Kaisari.”

English: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
Kiswahili: Pilato aliposikia maneno haya akamtoa Yesu nje tena akaketi katika kiti chake cha hukumu, mahali palipoitwa Sakafu ya Jiwe, kwa Kiebrania paliitwa Gabatha
Ekegusii: Erio ekero Pilato achia koigwa amang’ana aya, akarenta Yeso isiko, agaikaransa igoro ase ekerogo gi’ekina, aase akorokwa Atichire n’Amagena, naende ase Ekeiberania, Gabata.

English: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
Kiswahili: Basi ilikuwa siku ya Maandalio ya Pasaka, yapata kama saa sita hivi. Pilato akawaambia Wayahudi, “Huyu hapa mfalme wenu!”
Ekegusii: Nigo yarenge Okwearigania gw’Epasaka; naende nigo yarenge koreng’ana chinsa isano nemo. Agateebia Abayahudi, “Rora omorwoti oino!”

English: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
Kiswahili: Wao wakapiga kelele, “Mwondoe! Mwondoe! Msulubishe!” Pilato akawauliza, “Je, nimsulubishe mfalme wenu?” Wale viongozi wa makuhani wakamjibu, “Sisi hatuna mfalme mwingine ila Kaisari.”
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, “Morusie, morusie, mobambe!” Pilato akababoria, “Imobambe omorwoti oino?” Abakuani abanene bakairaneria, “Titori nomorwoti otatiga Kaisari.”

English: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Pilato akamkabidhi Yesu kwao ili wamsulubishe. Kwa hiyo askari wakamchukua Yesu.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo akamobeka ase amaboko abo abambwe. Barabwo bakabwata Yeso.

English: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
Kiswahili: Yesu, akiwa ameubeba msalaba wake, akatoka kuelekea mahali palipoitwa Fuvu la Kichwa (kwa Kiebrania ni Golgotha).
Ekegusii: Ere agasoka bwebogoreretie omosalaba oye, goika aase akorokwa Ekeore; ase Ekeiberania akorokwa Gologotha.

English: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
Kiswahili: Hapo ndipo walipomsulubisha. Pamoja naye walisulubisha watu wengine wawili, mmoja kila upande wake, naye Yesu katikati.
Ekegusii: Bakamobamba aroro amo nabaanto bande babere, oyonde ensemo, na oyonde ensemo, na Yeso gati‐gati.

English: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
Kiswahili: Pilato akaamuru tangazo liandikwe na liwekwe juu kwenye msalaba wa Yesu, likasema: “Yesu wa Nazareti, Mfalme wa Wayahudi.”
Ekegusii: Pilato akarika ekemanyererio, agakebeka igoro ase omosalaba. Igo kiarigetwe, “YESO OMONAZARETI, OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”

English: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mahali hapo Yesu aliposulubiwa palikuwa karibu na mjini, Wayahudi wengi walisoma maandishi haya yaliyokuwa yameandikwa kwa lugha za Kiebrania, Kiyunani na Kilatini.
Ekegusii: Nabo amariiko ayio abange b’Abayahudi mbayasomete, ekiagera aase aria Yeso abamberetwe nigo arenge ang’e nomochie; naro nigo arigetwe ase Ekeiberania, na Ekerumi, na Ekegiriki.

English: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa makuhani wa Wayahudi wakapinga, wakamwambia Pilato, “Usiandike ‘Mfalme wa Wayahudi,’ bali andika kwamba mtu huyu alisema yeye ni mfalme wa Wayahudi.”
Ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na Abayahudi bagateebia Pilato, “Torika ng’a, n’Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi, korende ng’a nigo arenge kobora: Inche nomorwoti bw’Abayahudi.”

English: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
Kiswahili: Pilato akawajibu, “Nilichokwisha kuandika, nimeandika!”
Ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria, “Aya nariikire, nariikire.”

English: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
Kiswahili: Askari walipokwisha kumsulubisha Yesu, walichukua nguo zake wakazigawa mafungu manne, kila askari fungu lake. Ila walikubaliana wasilichane lile vazi lake kwa maana lilikuwa halina mshono bali limefumwa tangu juu hadi chini.
Ekegusii: Erio abarwani kobaabambire Yeso, bakabogoria chianga chiaye, bagachiatanana chinsemo inye, kera omorwani anyore ensemo yaye. Bakabogoria eganchwa nero. Korende eganchwa eyio tiyasonire; igo yabwatanirie korwa igoro goika inse.

English: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.
Kiswahili: Wakaambiana, “Tusilichane ila tulipigie kura ili kuamua ni nani atalichukua.” Hili lilitukia ili Maandiko yapate kutimizwa yale yaliyosema, “Wanagawana nguo zangu, na vazi langu wanalipigia kura.” Hayo ndiyo waliyoyafanya wale askari.
Ekegusii: Erio bagateebania, “Titoyetandora, korende toyeakere obomera, torore gose neya ng’o ekoba.” Erio ririiko riikerane, eri rigoteeba, “Mbaatananete chianga chiane, naende eganchwa yane mbayekorerete obomera.”

English: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo karibu na msalaba wa Yesu walikuwa wamesimama mama yake, na dada wa mamaye, na Maria mke wa Klopa, na Maria Magdalene.
Ekegusii: Naboigo abarwani bakorete. Korende ase omosalaba o Yeso ng’ina, na ng’ina moke, Mariamu moga Kiliopa, na Mariamu Magidalena bagatenenao.

English: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”
Kiswahili: Yesu alipomwona mama yake mahali pale pamoja na yule mwanafunzi aliyempenda wamesimama karibu, akamwambia mama yake, “Mwanamke, huyo hapo ndiye mwanao,”
Ekegusii: Erio ekero Yeso achia korora ng’ina na omworokigwa oria anchete bateneine ang’e agateebia ng’ina, “Omong’ina, rora omwana oo!”

English: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
Kiswahili: kisha akamwambia yule mwanafunzi, “Nawe huyo hapo ndiye mama yako.” Tangu wakati huo yule mwanafunzi akamchukua mama yake Yesu nyumbani kwake.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio agateebia omworokigwa oria, “Rora nyoko!” Erio korwa ensa eria omworokigwa oria akamoira bwoye.

English: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu hali akijua kuwa mambo yote yamemalizika, alisema ili kutimiza Maandiko, “Naona kiu.”
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso, kamanyete ng’a onsi aikire gokorwa, erinde ririiko riikeranigwe, akabora, “Ninde nerang’o.”

English: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
Kiswahili: Hapo palikuwa na bakuli lililojaa siki. Kwa hiyo wakachovya sifongo kwenye hiyo siki, wakaiweka kwenye ufito wa mti wa hisopo, wakampelekea mdomoni.
Ekegusii: Nkiarenge aroro egetaabo giaichire chinkama, erio bakabeeka esifunchi eichire chinkama igoro ase egetonto, bakamobekera monwa.

English: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuionja hiyo siki, Yesu akasema, “Imekwisha.” Akainamisha kichwa chake, akaitoa roho yake.
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia konyora chinkama, agateeba, “Yaikeranire!” Agatureka omotwe, agatweka mo.

English: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ilikuwa siku ya Maandalio ya Pasaka, Wayahudi hawakutaka miili ibaki msalabani siku ya Sabato, hasa kwa kuwa hiyo Sabato ingekuwa Sikukuu. Wakamwomba Pilato aamuru miguu ya wale waliosulubiwa ivunjwe ili wafe haraka miili iondolewe kwenye misalaba.
Ekegusii: Igo riarenge rituko ri’Okwearigania, na Abayahudi tibarigetie emebere ebe ase emesalaba igoro ase rituko ri’Esabato, ekiagera Esabato eria nigo yarenge enene. Ase ayio bagasaba Pilato ng’a amagoro y’abaanto abwo baabambetwe abunwe, na emebere yabo erusigweo.

English: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo askari wakaenda wakavunja miguu ya mtu wa kwanza aliyesulubiwa pamoja na Yesu na yule mwingine pia.
Ekegusii: Erio abarwani bakagenda, bakabuna amagoro abo, oyo bw’eritang’ani, na oyo o kabere, abwo baabambetwe amo na Yeso.

English: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
Kiswahili: Lakini walipomkaribia Yesu, wakaona ya kuwa amekwisha kufa, hivyo hawakuvunja miguu yake.
Ekegusii: Bagachia gochiera Yeso, bakarora ng’a oikire gokwa, tibamobuna amagoro aye.

English: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
Kiswahili: Badala yake mmoja wa wale askari akamchoma mkuki ubavuni na mara pakatoka damu na maji.
Ekegusii: Korende oyomo bw’abarwani akamobeta ritimo rikere riaye, akaruao bwango amanyinga na amaache.

English: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
Kiswahili: Mtu aliyeona mambo hayo ndiye alitoa ushuhuda, nao ushuhuda wake ni kweli. Anajua kuwa anasema kweli, naye anashuhudia ili pia nanyi mpate kuamini.
Ekegusii: Nere oyoyaroche akaba kirori, na oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene, nere omanyire ng’a igo agokwana ekeene, erinde inwe monyare kwegena.

English: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mambo haya yalitukia ili Maandiko yapate kutimia, yale yasemayo, “Hakuna hata mfupa wake mmoja utakaovunjwa.”
Ekegusii: Naki aya nigo akoregete erinde ririiko riikerane, eriateebete, “Riuga riaye tirikobunwa.”

English: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
Kiswahili: Tena Andiko lingine lasema, “Watamtazama yeye waliyemchoma.”
Ekegusii: Naende rituko rinde ribora, “Nabamorigererie oyobabetete.”

English: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mambo haya, Yosefu wa Arimathaya, aliyekuwa mfuasi wa Yesu, ingawa kwa siri kwa sababu ya kuwaogopa Wayahudi, alimwomba Pilato ruhusa ili kuuchukua mwili wa Yesu. Pilato alimruhusu, hivyo akaja, akauchukua.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yusufu bw’Arimathaya agasaba Pilato ribaga arusie omobere o Yeso. Ere nigo arenge omworokigwa o Yeso, korende bobisi, ekiagera airogete Abayahudi. Pilato akamoa ribaga. Igo agacha, akarusia omobere oye.

English: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
Kiswahili: Naye Nikodemo, yule ambaye kwanza alimwendea Yesu usiku, akaja, akaleta mchanganyiko wa manemane na manukato, yenye uzito wa zaidi ya kilo thelathini
Ekegusii: Na Nikodemo oria omochierete botuko agwo ritang’ani, nere akagenda boigo, akarenta ebinto bisang’ananirie manemane na uudi, oborito bwaye chiratili rigana erimo.

English: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
Kiswahili: Wakauchukua mwili wa Yesu, wakaufunga katika sanda ya kitani safi pamoja na yale manukato, kama ilivyokuwa desturi ya Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Erio bakabogoria omobere o Yeso, bakayoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani, bakayoaka amaguta aria amanukato, buna yarenge engencho y’Abayahudi ase ogotindeka.

English: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwa na bustani karibu na mahali pale aliposulubiwa, na pale ndani ya ile bustani palikuwa na kaburi jipya, ambalo halikuwa limezikiwa mtu bado.
Ekegusii: Naende aase aria abamberetwe norengeo omogondo, na ime ase omogondo oboina oboyia, aase monto onde konya atarabekwa.

English: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa ilikuwa siku ya Wayahudi ya Maandalio, nalo kaburi hilo lilikuwa karibu, wakamzika Yesu humo.
Ekegusii: Na ase engencho y’Okwearigania kw’Abayahudi bakabeeka Yeso aroro, ekiagera oboina boria bwarenge ang’e.

English: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
Kiswahili: Alfajiri na mapema siku ya kwanza ya juma, kulipokuwa kungali giza bado, Maria Magdalene alikwenda kaburini na kukuta lile jiwe limeondolewa penye ingilio.
Ekegusii: Bono ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma Mariamu; Magidalena akagenda ase oboina kobogokiamoka, ekero botarakiamoka buya, akarora ng’a rigena riarusigwe korwa ase oboina.

English: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”
Kiswahili: Hivyo akaja akikimbia kwa Simoni Petro pamoja na yule mwanafunzi mwingine ambaye Yesu alimpenda, na kusema, “Wamemwondoa Bwana kaburini, na hatujui walikomweka!”
Ekegusii: Erio akagenda bwango goika ase Simioni Petero, na ase omworokigwa oria onde, oria Yeso anchete, akabateebia, “Barusirie Omonene korwa ase oboina, korende titomanyeti aase bamobeka.”

English: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
Kiswahili: Petro na yule mwanafunzi mwingine wakaondoka mara kuelekea kaburini.
Ekegusii: Petero agasoka, akagenda amo nomworokigwa oria onde, bakabwatia enchera kogenda oboina.

English: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
Kiswahili: Wote wawili walikuwa wanakimbia, lakini yule mwanafunzi mwingine akakimbia mbio zaidi kuliko Petro, akatangulia kufika kaburini.
Ekegusii: Bakaminyoka chimbero bonsi babere amo. Omworokigwa oria onde akaminyoka bwango kobua Petero, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani goika ase oboina,

English: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.
Kiswahili: Alipofika, akainama na kuchungulia mle kaburini, akaona vile vitambaa vya kitani mle ndani, lakini hakuingia.
Ekegusii: agatung’ama, akarora ebitambaa bireo, korende tasoa ime.

English: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Simoni Petro akaja, akimfuata nyuma akaenda moja kwa moja hadi ndani ya kaburi. Naye akaona vile vitambaa vya ile sanda vikiwa pale chini
Ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero agacha, akamotunyana, agasoa oboina ime, akarora ebitambaa bireo,

English: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
Kiswahili: na kile kitambaa kilichokuwa kichwani mwa Yesu. Kitambaa hicho kilikuwa kimekunjwa mahali pa peke yake, mbali na vile vitambaa vya kitani vya ile sanda.
