Ekegusii: na egetambaa keria ki’omotwe oye tikiabekire amo nebitambaa binde, korende nigo kiaringire, kebekire ao gioka.

English: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
Kiswahili: Kisha yule mwanafunzi aliyetangulia kufika kaburini naye akaingia ndani, akaona, akaamini,
Ekegusii: Erio agwo omworokigwa oria onde orenge bw’eritang’ani goika ase oboina agasoa, akarora, akeegena.

English: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
Kiswahili: (kwa kuwa mpaka wakati huo walikuwa bado hawajaelewa kutoka Maandiko kwamba ilikuwa lazima Yesu afufuke kutoka kwa wafu).
Ekegusii: Naki konya tibaramanya ririiko, ng’a nemogwenerete koboka korwa ase abakuure.

English: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.
Kiswahili: Kisha hao wanafunzi wakaondoka wakarudi nyumbani kwao.
Ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa baria bakagenda chinsobo.

English: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
Kiswahili: Lakini Maria Magdalene akasimama nje ya kaburi akilia. Alipokuwa akilia, akainama, kuchungulia mle kaburini,
Ekegusii: Korende Mariamu nigo ateneine isiko ang’e noboina, okorera; nabo gakorera, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime ase oboina.

English: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
Kiswahili: naye akaona malaika wawili wamevaa mavazi meupe, wameketi pale mwili wa Yesu ulipokuwa umelazwa, mmoja upande wa kichwani na mwingine upande wa miguuni.
Ekegusii: Erio akarora abamalaika babere, barenge ne chianga chindabu, baikaransete, oyomo ase omotwe, naende oyomo ase amagoro, agwo aase omobere o Yeso obegetwe.

English: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”
Kiswahili: Wakamuuliza Maria, “Mwanamke, mbona unalia?” Akawaambia, “Nalia kwa kuwa wamemchukua Bwana wangu na sijui walikomweka.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobooria, “Omokungu, inki okorera?” Akabairaneria, “Nekiagera barusirie Omonene one, na timanyeti aase bamobeka.”

English: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema hayo, akageuka, akamwona Yesu amesimama, lakini hakumtambua.
Ekegusii: Kagokwana aya akeonchora gochia magega, akarora Yeso oteneine, tamanya ng’a n’Yeso.

English: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mwanamke, mbona unalia? Unamtafuta nani?” Maria akidhani ya kuwa aliyekuwa anaongea naye ni mtunza bustani, kwa hiyo akamwambia, “Bwana, kama ni wewe umemchukua, tafadhali nionyeshe ulikomweka, nami nitamchukua.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omong’ina, ninki okorera? Ning’o okorigia?” Ere agakaga ng’a nomorendi bw’omogondo, akamoteebia, “Omonene, onye naye kwamoira, nteebia aase kwamobeka, na inche nimorusie.”

English: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwita, “Maria!” Ndipo Maria akamgeukia Yesu na kusema naye kwa Kiebrania, “Rabboni!” (maana yake Mwalimu).
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Mariamu.” Ere akeonchora, akamoteebia ase Ekeiberania, “Raboni!” (Okoonchorwa kwaye, Omworokia).

English: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Usinishike, kwa maana sijapaa kwenda kwa Baba. Lakini nenda kwa ndugu zangu ukawaambie, ‘Ninapaa kwenda kwa Baba yangu ambaye ni Baba yenu, kwa Mungu wangu ambaye ni Mungu wenu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tonkuna, ekiagera tindagenda ase Tata one, korende genda ase abaminto, obateebie, ng’a nkogenda nde ase Tata one oyore Iso oino, ase Nyasae one oyore Nyasae oino.”

English: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Maria Magdalene akaenda kuwatangazia wanafunzi wa Yesu, akisema, “Nimemwona Bwana!” Naye akawaambia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amemweleza mambo hayo yote.
Ekegusii: Mariamu Magidalena akagenda, agateebia aborokigwa amang’ana ng’a, “Narorire Omonene”, naende ng’a omotebirie aya.

English: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
Kiswahili: Ikawa jioni ya ile siku ya kwanza ya juma, wanafunzi wake walikuwa pamoja, milango ikiwa imefungwa kwa kuwaogopa Wayahudi. Naye Yesu aliwatokea, akasimama katikati yao, akasema, “Amani iwe nanyi!”
Ekegusii: Ase omogoroba bwe rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, na ebisieri kobiasiekirwe aase agwo aborokigwa barenge, ekiagera bairogete Abayahudi, Yeso agacha, agatenena gati‐gati akabateebia, “Omorembe obe ase more!”

English: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema haya, akawaonyesha mikono yake na ubavu wake. Wanafunzi wake wakafurahi sana walipomwona Bwana.
Ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, akaborokia amaboko aye ne rikere riaye. Erio aborokigwa bakagoka kobachia korora Omonene.

English: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia tena, “Amani iwe nanyi! Kama vile Baba alivyonituma mimi, mimi nami nawatuma ninyi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia eria kabere, “Omorembe obe ase more! Buna Tata antomete, naboigo nainche nabatomire inwe.”

English: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
Kiswahili: Naye alipokwisha kusema haya, akawavuvia, akawaambia, “Pokeeni Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, akabautera omoika, akabateebia, “Nyora Omoika Omochenu.

English: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
Kiswahili: Mkimwondolea mtu yeyote dhambi zake, zitaondolewa, na yeyote msiyemwondolea dhambi zake, hazitaondolewa.”
Ekegusii: Bande bonsi morabere ebibe, baabeirwe; naende bande bonsi morasiekere ebibe, basiekeirwe.”

English: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
Kiswahili: Lakini Tomaso, aliyeitwa Didimasi, yaani Pacha, mmoja wa wale kumi na wawili, hakuwa pamoja nao Yesu alipokuja.
Ekegusii: Ko Thomas, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, oyokorokwa Barongo, tarenge amo nabarabwo ekero Yeso achete.

English: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo wale wanafunzi wengine wakamwambia, “Tumemwona Bwana.” Lakini yeye akawaambia, “Nisipoona zile alama za misumari mikononi mwake, na kuweka kidole changu kwenye hizo alama za misumari na mkono wangu ubavuni mwake, sitaamini.”
Ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bande bakamoteebia, “Twarorire Omonene.” Korende ere akabateebia, “Ntarochi amaboko aye na ebimanyererio bi’emesumari, na kobeeka ekiara kiane aase emesumari yamobetete, na kobeeka okoboko kwane rikere riaye ime, tinkwegena nonya ng’ake.”

English: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku nane, wanafunzi wake walikuwa tena pamoja ndani ya nyumba, naye Tomaso alikuwa pamoja nao. Ndipo Yesu akaja milango ikiwa imefungwa na kusimama katikati yao akasema, “Amani iwe nanyi.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atano na atato aborokigwa baye nao barenge naende ase enyomba eria ime, na Thomas amo nabarabwo. Yeso agacha ekero ebisieri bisiekire, agatenena gati‐gati, akabora, “Omorembe obe ase more!”

English: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
Kiswahili: Kisha akamwambia Tomaso, “Weka kidole chako hapa na uone mikono yangu, nyoosha mkono wako uguse ubavuni mwangu. Usiwe na shaka, bali uamini tu.”
Ekegusii: Erio agateebia Thomas, “Renta aiga ekiara kiao. Orore amaboko aane. Renta okoboko kwao, okobeke ase rikere riane; toba oyotegeneti, korende oyo bwegenete.”

English: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
Kiswahili: Tomaso akamwambia, “Bwana wangu na Mungu wangu!”
Ekegusii: Thomas akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, na Nyasae one!”

English: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Umeamini kwa kuwa umeniona? Wamebarikiwa wale ambao hawajaona lakini wameamini.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Iga kwegena ekiagera kwandora; mbare nomogooko abatarochi ko begenire.”

English: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
Kiswahili: Yesu alifanya miujiza mingine mingi mbele za wanafunzi wake, ambayo haikuandikwa katika kitabu hiki.
Ekegusii: Nabo mbire ebikone binde ebinge Yeso akorete ase amasio y’aborokigwa baye bitarikiri ase egetabu eke,

English: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
Kiswahili: Lakini haya yameandikwa ili mweze kuamini ya kuwa Yesu ndiye Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu, na kwa kumwamini mpate uzima katika jina lake.
Ekegusii: korende ebi biarikirwe, erinde monyare kwegena ng’a Yeso nere Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae; naende ase okwegena mobe nobogima ase erieta riaye.

English: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya Yesu akawatokea tena wanafunzi wake kando ya Bahari ya Tiberia. Yeye alijionyesha kwao hivi:
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akeorokia naende ase aborokigwa baye ase enyancha ya Tiberia. Ayio nigo akorekanete iga:

English: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro, Tomaso aitwaye Didimasi, yaani Pacha, Nathanaeli wa Kana ya Galilaya, wana wa Zebedayo na wanafunzi wengine wawili walikuwa pamoja.
Ekegusii: Simioni Petero, na Thomas oyokorokwa Barongo, na Natanaeli o Kana ya Galili, na abamura ba Zebedi, na babere bande baborokigwa baye barenge amo.

English: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akawaambia wenzake, “Mimi naenda kuvua samaki.” Nao wakamwambia, “Tutakwenda pamoja nawe.” Wakatoka, wakaingia ndani ya mashua, lakini usiku ule hawakupata chochote.
Ekegusii: Simioni Petero akabateebia, “Nkogenda nde koruba chinswe.” Bakamoteebia, “Naintwe natogende amo naye.” Bagasoka, bakariina obwato ime, korende obotuko boria tibanyora gento.

English: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
Kiswahili: Mara baada ya kupambazuka, Yesu akasimama ufuoni, lakini wanafunzi hawakumtambua kwamba alikuwa Yesu.
Ekegusii: Goika bogachia gokia mambia, Yeso agatenena ase engegu, korende aborokigwa tibamanya ng’a n’Yeso.

English: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wanangu, je, mna samaki wowote?” Wakamjibu, “La.”
Ekegusii: Erio Yeso akababoria, “Abana, more neki mokoria?” Bakamoiraneria, “Yaya.”

English: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Shusheni nyavu upande wa kuume wa mashua yenu nanyi mtapata samaki.” Wakashusha nyavu na tazama wakapata samaki wengi mno hata wakashindwa kuvutia zile nyavu zilizojaa samaki ndani ya mashua.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ruta ekeonga ensemo ya borio y’obwato, na inwe namonyore chinswe.” Erio bagakeruta, korende tibanyara gokeng’usa ase engencho y’obonge bwe chinswe.

English: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
Kiswahili: Yule mwanafunzi aliyependwa na Yesu akamwambia Petro, “Huyu ni Bwana!” Simoni Petro aliposikia haya, akajifunga nguo yake kwa kuwa alikuwa uchi, naye akajitosa baharini.
Ekegusii: Omworokigwa oria Yeso anchete agateebia Petero, “Nere Omonene.” Erio Simioni Petero, agachia koigwa ng’a n’Omonene, akeboyia eanga yaye (ekiagera arenge getirianda), akeruta enyancha ime.

English: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
Kiswahili: Wale wanafunzi wengine wakaja kwa ile mashua huku wakikokota ule wavu uliyojaa samaki, maana hawakuwa mbali na nchi kavu, ilikuwa yapata dhiraa 200
Ekegusii: Korende aborokigwa bande bagacha ase obwato, bagakurura ekeonga geichire chinswe, ekiagera tibarenge are ase ense enyomo, ang’e chifuti amagana atato.

English: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
Kiswahili: Walipofika ufuoni, wakaona moto wa makaa na samaki wakiokwa juu yake na mikate.
Ekegusii: Erio kobachia goika engegu, bakarora omorero bw’amakara aroro, na enswe ebekire igoro yaye, na omogati.

English: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Leteni baadhi ya hao samaki mliovua sasa hivi.”
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Renta aiga echinde chie chinswe echi mwarubire bono.”

English: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro akapanda kwenye mashua na kuukokota ule wavu pwani. Ulikuwa umejaa samaki wakubwa 153. Ingawa samaki walikuwa wengi kiasi hicho, ule wavu haukuchanika.
Ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero akariina obwato ime, akang’usa ekeonga gochia engegu geichire chinswe chinene, rigana erimo, na emerongo etano, na isato; nonya chiarenge chinyinge buna iga, ekeonga tigiatandogete.

English: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Njooni mpate kifungua kinywa.” Hakuna hata mmoja wa wanafunzi aliyethubutu kumuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?” Kwa sababu walijua ya kuwa ni Bwana.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo morie!” Gose onde tarenge ase aborokigwa baria orenge na boremu komoboria, “Aye naye ng’o?” Ekiagera mbamanyete ng’a n’Omonene.

English: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
Kiswahili: Yesu akaja, akachukua ule mkate, akawapa na vivyo hivyo akawagawia pia wale samaki.
Ekegusii: Yeso akagenda akabogoria omogati, akabaa, ne chinswe boigo.

English: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa mara ya tatu Yesu kuwatokea wanafunzi wake baada yake kufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Eke nekero kia gatato Yeso arorekanete ase aborokigwa baye magega y’okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure.

English: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kula, Yesu akamuuliza Simoni Petro, “Je, Simoni mwana wa Yohana, unanipenda kweli kuliko hawa?” Yeye akamjibu, “Ndiyo Bwana, wewe unajua ya kuwa ninakupenda.” Yesu akamwambia, “Lisha wana-kondoo wangu.”
Ekegusii: Erio kobakoorire koragera, Yeso akaboria Simioni Petero, “Simioni mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete kobua aba?” Akamoiraneria, “Ee, Omonene, aye nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Akamoteebia, “Risia chimanwa chi’eching’ondi chiane.”

English: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamwambia tena, “Simoni, mwana wa Yohana, wanipenda?” Petro akamjibu, “Ndiyo Bwana, wewe unajua ya kuwa ninakupenda.” Yesu akamwambia, “Chunga kondoo zangu.”
Ekegusii: Akamoboria eria kabere, “Simioni mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete?” Akamoiraneria, “Ee, Omonene, aye nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Akamoteebia, “Risia ching’ondi chiane.”

English: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
Kiswahili: Kwa mara ya tatu Yesu akamuuliza Petro, “Simoni mwana wa Yohana, unanipenda?” Petro akahuzunika sana kwa kuwa Yesu alimuuliza mara ya tatu, “Unanipenda?” Akamjibu, “Bwana, wewe unajua yote, unajua ya kuwa ninakupenda.” Yesu akamwambia, “Lisha kondoo wangu.
Ekegusii: Akamoboria eria gatato, “Simioni mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete inche?” Petero agaichana ekiagera amoboretie eria gatato, “Nonyanchete?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, aye nomanyete onsi, nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Risia ching’ondi chiane.

English: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
Kiswahili: Amin, amin nakuambia, ulipokuwa kijana ulivaa na kwenda unakotaka, lakini utakapokuwa mzee utanyoosha mikono yako na mtu mwingine atakuvika na kukupeleka usipotaka kwenda.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Ekero kwarenge omosae, nigo kwarenge kweboyia, kwagenda aase origetie, korende ekero orache koba omogaka, norambore amaboko ao, na oyonde nagosibe, akoire aase otancheti.”

English: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
Kiswahili: Yesu alisema haya ili kuashiria ni kifo cha aina gani Petro atakachomtukuza nacho Mungu. Kisha Yesu akamwambia Petro, “Nifuate!”
Ekegusii: (Agakwana eri ase okworokia imakweri ki aramotogie Nyasae). Erio gakoorire gokwana aya, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana?”

English: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
Kiswahili: Petro akageuka, akamwona yule mwanafunzi aliyependwa na Yesu akiwafuata. (Huyu ndiye yule mwanafunzi aliyeegama kifuani mwa Yesu walipokula naye chakula cha mwisho na kuuliza, “Bwana, ni nani atakayekusaliti?”)
Ekegusii: Petero akeonchora, akarora omworokigwa oria Yeso anchete okobatunyana; nere oria bweegegete egekuba kiaye ekero gi’okoria endagera ya mogoroba na gokwana, “Omonene, ning’o orakorue?”

English: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
Kiswahili: Petro alipomwona huyo mwanafunzi, akamuuliza Yesu, “Bwana na huyu je?”
Ekegusii: Petero agachia komoorora oyio, akaboria Yeso, “Omonene, noyo rende?”

English: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
Kiswahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Ikiwa nataka aishi mpaka nitakaporudi, inakuhusu nini? Wewe inakupasa unifuate!”
Ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Kondarigie oyo abeo goika inchiche, inki ogwechandera ayio? Aye ntunyane inche.”

English: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya maneno haya ya Yesu, uvumi ukaenea miongoni mwa ndugu kwamba huyu mwanafunzi hangekufa. Lakini Yesu hakusema kuwa hangekufa. Yeye alisema tu kwamba, “Ikiwa nataka aishi mpaka nitakaporudi, inakuhusu nini?”
Ekegusii: Erio ring’ana eri rigasarera ase abamwabo ng’a omworokigwa oria tagokwa, korende Yeso tamotebetie ng’a tagokwa, otatiga, “Kondarigie abeo goika inchiche, inki ogwechandera ayio?”

English: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye yule mwanafunzi anayeshuhudia mambo haya na ndiye ambaye ameandika habari hizi. Nasi tunajua ya kuwa ushuhuda wake ni kweli.
Ekegusii: Oyo nomworokigwa oria orooche aya, na koyarika, naende twamanyire ng’a oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene.

English: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
Kiswahili: Lakini kuna mambo mengine mengi ambayo Yesu alifanya. Kama yote yangeliandikwa, nadhani hata ulimwengu wote usingekuwa na nafasi ya kutosha kuweka vitabu vyote ambavyo vingeandikwa. Amen.
Ekegusii: Nare naende ayande amange aya Yeso akorete; naro kararikwe erimo erimo, nigo ngokaga ng’a nonya nense yonsi tegoisana chibuku echiranyare korikwa chibekwe.

English: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
Kiswahili: Katika kitabu changu cha kwanza nilikuandikia, mpendwa Theofilo, kuhusu mambo yote Yesu aliyofanya na kufundisha tangu mwanzo,
Ekegusii: Aye Theofilo, ase egetabu keria kie ritang’ani nariigete igoro y’amang’ana onsi aya Yeso akorete na kworokereria ekero achaagete emeremo yaye,

English: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.
Kiswahili: hadi siku ile alipochukuliwa kwenda mbinguni, baada ya kuwapa maagizo kupitia kwa Roho Mtakatifu wale mitume aliowachagua.
Ekegusii: goika rituko riria abogoretigwe gochia igoro. Ritang’ani ri’ayio agachiika goetera ase Omoika Omochenu abatomwa baria achoorete.

English: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mateso yake, alijionyesha kwao na kuwathibitishia kwa njia nyingi kwamba yeye yu hai. Katika muda wa siku arobaini baada ya kufufuka kwake aliwatokea na kunena kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ogochandwa kwaye akeorokia ase bare ase ebiorokererio ebinge ng’a moyo are. Akaba okobaorokera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, na gokwana nabarabwo igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

English: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.
Kiswahili: Wakati mmoja alipokuwa pamoja nao, aliwapa amri hii, “Msitoke Yerusalemu, bali ingojeni ahadi ya Baba, ambayo mmenisikia nikisema habari zake.
Ekegusii: Ekero asangererekanete amo nabarabwo, akabachiika tibabaisa korua Yerusalemu, akabateebia: “Moganye eira ya Tata, eria mwaigwete korwa ase ’nde.

English: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
Kiswahili: Yohana aliwabatiza kwa maji, lakini baada ya siku chache mtabatizwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Yohana nigo arenge kobatisa ase amaache, korende inwe inamobatiiswe ase Omoika Omochenu magega y’amatuko amake.”

English: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
Kiswahili: Mitume walipokuwa wamekusanyika pamoja, wakamuuliza Yesu, “Bwana, je, huu ndio wakati wa kuwarudishia Israeli ufalme?”
Ekegusii: Erio ekero basangererekanete amo, bakamobooria: “Omonene, ekero eke nakio okoiraneria Abaisraeli oborwoti bwabo?”

English: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Si juu yenu kujua nyakati na majira ambayo Baba ameyaweka katika mamlaka yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Akabairaneria: “Tari igoro yaino komanya ebiro gose chingaki. Tata obibeekire ase okobua kwaye omonyene.

English: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mtapokea nguvu akiisha kuwajilia juu yenu Roho Mtakatifu, nanyi mtakuwa mashahidi wangu katika Yerusalemu, Uyahudi kote na Samaria, hadi miisho ya dunia.”
Ekegusii: Korende namonyore chinguru, ekero Omoika Omochenu abacheire, na inwe inamobe kirori baane ase Yerusalemu, na ase chinsemo chionsi chia Boyahudi na Samaria, na goika chinsinyo chi’ense.”

English: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema mambo haya, walipokuwa wanatazama, akachukuliwa juu mbinguni mbele ya macho yao na wingu likampokea wasimwone tena.
Ekegusii: Ekero akwanete aya, kobarigereretie, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, riire rikamoira korwa ase amaiso abo.

English: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa bado wakikaza macho yao kuelekea juu alipokuwa akienda zake Mbinguni, tazama ghafula, wanaume wawili waliovaa mavazi meupe wakasimama karibu nao,
Ekegusii: Kobarigereretie mono gochia igoro, ekero are kogenda, rora, abasacha babere, babeekeire chianga chindabu, bagatenena ang’e nabarabwo,

English: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”
Kiswahili: wakasema, “Enyi watu wa Galilaya, mbona mnasimama mkitazama juu angani? Huyu Yesu aliyechukuliwa kutoka kwenu kwenda Mbinguni, atarudi tena jinsi iyo hiyo mlivyomwona akienda zake Mbinguni.”
Ekegusii: bakaboora: “Inwe abasacha ba Galili, nase ki moteneine morigereretie gochia igoro? Oyo Yeso, obogorigwe korwa as more kogenda igoro, naboigo naende arairane koreng’ana buna mwamorora akogenda igoro.”

English: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
Kiswahili: Ndipo waliporudi Yerusalemu kutoka Mlima wa Mizeituni, uliokuwa karibu na Yerusalemu, umbali wa mwendo wa Sabato kutoka mjini.
Ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bakairana gochia Yerusalemu korwa ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, ekio kiarenge ang’e na Yerusalemu, oboare bw’orogendo rw’ekiromita eyemo.

English: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
Kiswahili: Walipowasili mjini Yerusalemu, walikwenda ghorofani kwenye chumba walichokuwa wakiishi. Wale waliokuwepo walikuwa: Petro, Yohana, Yakobo, Andrea, Filipo, Tomaso, Bartholomayo, Mathayo, Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, Simoni Zelote na Yuda mwana wa Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia gosoa, bakariina akanyomba ka irongo aase baikaransete: Petero na Yohana, Yakobo na Anderea, Filipo na Thomas, Baritholomayo na Matayo, Yakobo bw’Alufayo na Simioni, oyomo bw’Abazelote, na Yuda o Yakobo.

English: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
Kiswahili: Hawa wote waliungana pamoja katika maombi. Pamoja nao walikuwepo wanawake kadha, na Maria mama yake Yesu, pamoja na ndugu zake Yesu.
Ekegusii: Aba iga bonsi nigo bagendererete n’ogosaba ase omoyo oyomo, amo nabakungu bande, na Mariamu ng’ina Yeso, na bamura bamwabo Yeso.

English: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,
Kiswahili: Katika siku hizo Petro akasimama katikati ya waumini (jumla yao wote walikuwa watu wapatao 120), akasema,
Ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko make gokaba okoumerana kw’abeegeni, abwo barenge ange (omobaro bw’abaanto ang’e rigana erimo na emerongo ebere) akabora,

English: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.
Kiswahili: “Ndugu zangu, ilibidi Andiko litimie ambalo Roho Mtakatifu alitabiri kupitia kwa Daudi kumhusu Yuda aliyewaongoza wale waliomkamata Yesu.
Ekegusii: Abeegeni baminto, negwenerete ririiko erio riikeranigwe, eri Omoika Omochenu okwanete kare ase omonwa o Daudi igoro ya Yudasi, oyotang’anete abanto abwo babwatete Yeso.

English: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.
Kiswahili: Yuda alikuwa mmoja wetu, kwa maana na yeye alichaguliwa ashiriki katika huduma hii.”
Ekegusii: Naki Yudasi konya obarirwe amo naintwe, akanyora ensemo y’obokoreri amo naitwe.

English: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.
Kiswahili: (Basi Yuda alinunua shamba kwa zile fedha za uovu alizopata; akiwa huko shambani akaanguka, akapasuka na matumbo yote yakatoka nje.
Ekegusii: (Naboigo, goetera ase engeria eria aakanetwe ase egekoro kiaye ki’obobe, ere Yudasi akagora omogondo agwo ase agwete goika agakwa; akoreka, erio amara aye onsi agasoka.

English: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’
Kiswahili: Kila mtu Yerusalemu akasikia habari hizi, kwa hiyo wakapaita mahali hapo kwa lugha yao, Akeldama, yaani Shamba la Damu).
Ekegusii: Ayio akamanyekana n’abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, goika omogondo oria okarokwa ase omonwa obo Akeldama, engencho yaye: Omogondo bw’Amanyinga.)

English: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’
Kiswahili: “Kama vile ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Zaburi, “ ‘Mahali pake na pawe ukiwa, wala asiwepo yeyote atakayeishi humo,’ na, “ ‘Mtu mwingine aichukue nafasi yake ya uongozi.’
Ekegusii: Naki nariikire ase egetabu gia Zaburi: Obomenyo bwaye botigare bosa, nonya monto onde tabaisa komenyao; naende nerikiire: Oboteneneri bwaye omoao aboire.

English: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo inatubidi tumchague mtu mwingine miongoni mwa wale ambao wamekuwa pamoja nasi wakati wote Bwana Yesu alipoingia na kutoka katikati yenu,
Ekegusii: Naboigo natonyore oyomo okobwatana naitwe koba kirori ase okobokigwa kw’omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Ere goika abe korwa ase egati yabaanto barenge gotaara amo naintwe ase ekero gionsi eki Omonene Yeso arenge gosoa na gosoka ase egati yaito,

English: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”
Kiswahili: kuanzia ubatizo wa Yohana mpaka siku aliyochukuliwa kutoka kwetu kwenda Mbinguni. Kwa kuwa mmoja wao inabidi awe shahidi pamoja nasi wa ufufuo wake.”
Ekegusii: korwa ase okobatisa kwa Yohana goika rituko riria Yeso abogoretigwe korwa ase tore gochia igoro.

English: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.
Kiswahili: Wakapendekeza majina ya watu wawili: Yosefu, aitwaye Barsaba (ambaye pia alijulikana kama Yusto) na Mathiya.
Ekegusii: Bagaatora babere, Yusufu ore korokwa Barsaba, naende erieta rinde Yusto, na Matia.

English: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen
Kiswahili: Kisha wakaomba, wakasema, “Bwana, wewe waujua moyo wa kila mtu. Tuonyeshe ni yupi kati ya hawa wawili uliyemchagua
Ekegusii: Bagasaba, bakaboora: “Aye omonene, oyomanyete chinkoro chi’abaanto bonsi, tworokie ning’o gwachorire ase aba iga babere

English: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”
Kiswahili: ili achukue nafasi ya huduma ya utume ambayo Yuda aliiacha ili aende mahali pake mwenyewe.”
Ekegusii: abogorie ensemo y’ogokora oko na obotomwa obo Yudasi atigete, akagenda aase aye.”

English: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakawapigia kura, nayo kura ikamwangukia Mathiya, naye akaongezwa kwenye wale mitume kumi na mmoja.
Ekegusii: Bakabarutera obomera, na obomera bokagwera Matia; erio ere agachorwa koba amo nabatomwa ikomi nomo.

English: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Pentekoste ilipowadia, waamini wote walikuwa mahali pamoja.
Ekegusii: Ekero rituko ria Pentekosti riaigete, aborokigwa ba Yeso bonsi nigo barenge aase aamo.

English: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
Kiswahili: Ghafula sauti kama mvumo mkubwa wa upepo mkali uliotoka mbinguni ukaijaza nyumba yote walimokuwa wameketi.
Ekegusii: Mobosokano okogusa kogaacha korwa igoro, okogusa buna ogw’ekerambauti gekogusa ne chinguru, kogaichora enyomba yonsi aase baikaransete.

English: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.
Kiswahili: Zikatokea ndimi kama za moto zilizogawanyika na kukaa juu ya kila mmoja wao.
Ekegusii: Chimeme buna echi’omorero chikabaorokera, chikabaatananekera, naende chikabaikaransera kera oyomo obo.

English: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
Kiswahili: Wote wakajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu, wakaanza kunena kwa lugha nyingine, kama Roho alivyowajalia.
Ekegusii: Bonsi bagaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, bagachaaka gokwana ase emenwa emeao, buna Omoika obaete gwatora.

English: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.
Kiswahili: Basi walikuwepo Yerusalemu Wayahudi wanaomcha Mungu kutoka kila taifa chini ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Mbamenyete Yerusalemu Abayahudi abasigete Nyasae, abanto korwa ase kera egesaku inse y’erioba.

English: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia sauti hii, umati wa watu ulikusanyika pamoja wakistaajabu, kwa sababu kila mmoja wao aliwasikia wakisema kwa lugha yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ekero eriogi eri riaigwetwe, omoganda ogasangererekana amo, okaba nogokumia, ekiagera kera oyomo abaigwete bagokwana ase omonwa oye omonyene.

English: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?
Kiswahili: Wakiwa wameshangaa na kustaajabu wakauliza, “Je, hawa wote wanaozungumza si Wagalilaya?
Ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi na goichana, bagateebania: “Inee! Aba bonsi bagokwana, tibari Abagalili?

English: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?
Kiswahili: Imekuwaje basi kila mmoja wetu anawasikia wakinena kwa lugha yake ya kuzaliwa?
Ekegusii: Naki yaba iga, intwe toigwete kera egento bagokwana kera oyomo ase omonwa oye aiboretwe noro?

English: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
Kiswahili: Wapathi, Wamedi, Waelami, wakazi wa Mesopotamia, Uyahudi, Kapadokia, Ponto na Asia,
Ekegusii: Abapariti, Abamedi na Abaelamiti, na abwo bamenyete Mesopotamia, Boyahudi na Kapadokia, Ponto na Asia,

English: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
Kiswahili: Frigia, Pamfilia, Misri na pande za Libya karibu na Kirene na wageni kutoka Rumi,
Ekegusii: Furugia na Pamfulia, Misiri ne chinsemo chia Libia ya Kurene, amo nabageni korwa Rumi,

English: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi na waongofu, Wakrete na Waarabu, sote tunawasikia watu hawa wakisema mambo makuu ya ajabu ya Mungu katika lugha zetu wenyewe.”
Ekegusii: Abayahudi na abanto b’ebisaku binde abaonchogete, Abakirete na Abaarabu, intwe twensi twaigure aba iga bagokwana ase emenwa yaito igoro y’ogokora gwe chinguru kwa Nyasae.”

English: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
Kiswahili: Wakiwa wameshangaa na kufadhaika wakaulizana, “Ni nini maana ya mambo haya?”
Ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi, bagaichana na koborania: “Amang’ana aya, engencho yaye ninki?”

English: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
Kiswahili: Lakini wengine wakawadhihaki wakasema, “Hawa wamelewa divai!”
Ekegusii: Abande bagasekereria, bagoteeba: “Nigo batindire nedivai enyia.”

English: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akasimama pamoja na wale mitume kumi na mmoja, akainua sauti yake na kuhutubia ule umati wa watu, akasema: “Wayahudi wenzangu na ninyi nyote mkaao Yerusalemu, jueni jambo hili mkanisikilize.
Ekegusii: Korende Petero agatenena amo na baria ikomi nomo, agaaka eriogi riaye, akabateebia: “Inwe abasacha ba Boyahudi, na inwe mwensi abamomenyete Yerusalemu, tiga ring’ana eri rimanyekane ase more, tegerera amang’ana aane.

English: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.
Kiswahili: Hakika watu hawa hawakulewa kama mnavyodhania, kwa kuwa sasa ni saa tatu asubuhi!
Ekegusii: Taibo buna mokagete; abanto aba tibatindeti, ekiagera bono nechinsa isato chioka chia mobaso,

English: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
Kiswahili: La, hili ni jambo lililotabiriwa na nabii Yoeli, akisema:
Ekegusii: korende ring’ana eri ndiria riakwanetwe nomobani Yoel:

English: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Katika siku za mwisho, asema Mungu, nitamimina Roho wangu juu ya wote wenye mwili. Wana wenu na binti zenu watatabiri, vijana wenu wataona maono, na wazee wenu wataota ndoto.
Ekegusii: “Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio, Omonene oteebire, nimbaiterere abanto bonsi Omoika one, na abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inababane. Abamura baino nabarore amaroro, na abagaaka baino nabarote chindoto.

English: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
Kiswahili: Hata juu ya watumishi wangu, wanaume kwa wanawake, katika siku zile nitamimina Roho wangu, nao watatabiri.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, ase amatuko ayio nimbaiterere abasomba baane, abasacha na abakungu, Omoika one, na barabwo inababane.

English: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
Kiswahili: Nami nitaonyesha maajabu juu mbinguni, na ishara chini duniani: damu, moto, na mawimbi ya moshi.
Ekegusii: Ning’orokie amakumia ase igoro, na ebikone ase ense inse, amanyinga na omorero, ne rikundesi ri’erioki.

English: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
Kiswahili: Jua litakuwa giza na mwezi utakuwa mwekundu kama damu, kabla ya kuja siku ile kuu ya Bwana iliyo tukufu.
Ekegusii: Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi nobe amanyinga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene ritaracha, rituko erire rinene, na erire maiso marore.

English: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
Kiswahili: Na kila mtu atakayeliitia jina la Bwana, ataokolewa.’
Ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera oyorarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe”.

English: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,
Kiswahili: “Enyi Waisraeli, sikilizeni maneno haya nisemayo: Yesu wa Nazareti alikuwa mtu aliyethibitishwa kwenu na Mungu kwa miujiza, maajabu na ishara, ambayo Mungu alitenda miongoni mwenu kupitia kwake, kama ninyi wenyewe mjuavyo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, igwa amang’ana aya, Yeso o Nazareti, omonto o orogetigwe ase more na Nyasae ase ogokora gwe chinguru, na amakumia, na ebikone ebi Nyasae akorete nere egati yaino, buna inwe abanyene momanyete,

English: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;
Kiswahili: Huyu mtu akiisha kutolewa kwa shauri la Mungu lililokusudiwa kwa kujua kwake Mungu tangu zamani, ninyi, kwa mikono ya watu wabaya, mlimuua kwa kumgongomea msalabani.
Ekegusii: Yeso oyio nigo aruetwe ase amang’ana aroberetigwe na Nyasae, oyo oyamanyete korwa kare, na inwe mokamobamba na komoita ase amaboko ’abaanto batari namachiiko.

English: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu akamwondolea uchungu wa mauti, kwa sababu haikuwezekana yeye kushikiliwa na nguvu za mauti.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamobokia ekero ororobirie obororo bw’amakweri, ekiagera tare konyarekana abwatwe naro.

English: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Daudi asema kumhusu yeye: “ ‘Nalimwona Bwana mbele yangu daima. Kwa sababu yuko mkono wangu wa kuume, sitatikisika.
Ekegusii: Naki igo Daudi agokwana igoro yaye: Naroche Omonene ase obosio bwane botambe, ekiagera nigo are ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, erinde tinyoboa.

English: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unafurahia, na ulimi wangu unashangilia; mwili wangu nao utapumzika kwa tumaini.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio enkoro yane nigo ere nomosasooko, oromeme rwane narogooke; na kobua, omobere one noro notimoke ase ogosemeria,

English: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hutaniacha kaburini, wala hutamwacha Aliye Mtakatifu wako kuona uharibifu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera aye togotiga omoyo one agwo aase abakuure, gose togotiga Omochenu oo arore ogosareka.

English: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
Kiswahili: Umenionyesha njia za uzima, utanijaza na furaha mbele zako.’
Ekegusii: Kwanyorokereirie chinchera chi’obogima; nong’ichorie omogooko ase obosio bwao.

English: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
Kiswahili: “Ndugu zangu Waisraeli, nataka niwaambie kwa uhakika kwamba baba yetu Daudi alikufa na kuzikwa, nalo kaburi lake lipo hapa mpaka leo.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, ninyare gokwana nainwe maiso marore igoro y’omogaka oito o kare, Daudi, ng’a nigo akwete, naende agatindekwa, na embeera yaye nao ere aiga goika reero.

English: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
Kiswahili: Lakini alikuwa nabii na alijua ya kuwa Mungu alikuwa amemwahidi kwa kiapo kwamba angemweka mmoja wa wazao wake penye kiti chake cha enzi.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Daudi arenge omobani, naende amanyete ng’a Nyasae namotianetie ase emuma ng’a ase oroiboro rwaye nabeeke oyomo ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene,

English: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.
Kiswahili: Daudi, akiona mambo yaliyoko mbele, akanena juu ya kufufuka kwa Kristo, kwamba hakuachwa kaburini, wala mwili wake haukuona uharibifu.
Ekegusii: agatang’ana korora aya, agakwana igoro y’okoboka kwaye Kristo, ng’a tagotigwa agwo aase abakuure, nonya nomobere oye tokorora ogosareka.

English: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
Kiswahili: Mungu alimfufua huyu Yesu na sisi sote ni mashahidi wa jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Oyo Yeso Nyasae akamobokia na ase aya intwe twensi nigo tore kirori.

English: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa yeye ametukuzwa kwa mkono wa kuume wa Mungu, amepokea kutoka kwa Baba ahadi ya Roho Mtakatifu, naye amemimina kile mnachoona sasa na kusikia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, kaimokererigwe igoro ase ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae, naende kanyorire korwa ase Tata Omoika Omochenu oria arieretwe eira oiteire ayamwarorire na koyaigwa.

English: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Daudi hakupaa kwenda mbinguni, lakini anasema, “ ‘Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume,
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Daudi tagendete igoro, korende ere omonyenye nigo agoteeba: “Omonene agateebia Omonene one, Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio,

English: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’
Kiswahili: hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’
Ekegusii: goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao”.

English: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo Israeli wote na wajue jambo hili kwa uhakika kwamba: Mungu amemfanya huyu Yesu, ambaye ninyi mlimsulubisha, kuwa Bwana na Kristo.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo, tiga enyomba yonsi ya Israeli emanye ekeene ng’a Nyasae obekire Yeso, oyio mwabambete, obeire Omonene naende Kristo.

English: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
Kiswahili: Watu waliposikia maneno haya yakawachoma mioyo yao, wakawauliza Petro na wale mitume wengine, “Ndugu zetu tufanye nini?”
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya, bagasambwa ase chinkoro chiabo, bakabooria Petero na abatomwa bande: “Abaminto, inki torakore?”

English: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Petro akawajibu, “Tubuni, mkabatizwe kila mmoja wenu kwa jina la Yesu Kristo, ili mpate kusamehewa dhambi zenu, nanyi mtapokea kipawa cha Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Petero akabairaneria: “Onchoka, mobatiswe kera oyomo ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biaino, na inwe inamoegwe ekeegwa ki’Omoika Omochenu.

English: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ahadi hii ni kwa ajili yenu na watoto wenu, na kwa wote walio mbali, na kila mtu ambaye Bwana Mungu wetu atamwita amjie.”
Ekegusii: Naki eira eye nigo ere ase more na ase abana baino, na ase abanto bonsi abare aare, na bonsi abarangerigwe n’Omonene nyasae oito.”

English: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
Kiswahili: Petro akawaonya kwa maneno mengine mengi na kuwasihi akisema, “Jiepusheni na kizazi hiki kilichopotoka.”
Ekegusii: Petero akabaorokeria ase amang’ana ande amange na kobakuurera, ogoteeba: “Etoorie korwa ase ekegori eke getari ekeronge.”

English: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
Kiswahili: Wale wote waliopokea ujumbe wa Petro kwa furaha wakabatizwa na siku ile waliongezeka watu wapatao 3,000.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo abanchete ring’ana riaye bakabatiswa, ne rituko riria bakamentekana abanto koreng’ana chilifu isato.

English: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
Kiswahili: Nao wakawa wanadumu katika mafundisho ya mitume, katika ushirika, katika kumega mkate na katika kusali.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenderera ase okworokereria kw’abatomwa na ase obomo, ase ogosamunyora omogati na ase ogosaba.

English: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu akaingiwa na hofu ya Mungu, nayo miujiza mingi na ishara zikafanywa na mitume.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto agasogwa nomoondoko, na amakumia amange na ebikone bigakorwa nabatomwa.

English: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.
Kiswahili: Walioamini wote walikuwa mahali pamoja, nao walikuwa na kila kitu shirika.
Ekegusii: Na bonsi abeegenete nigo barenge aase aamo, naende bakaba n’ebinto bionsi ase obomo;

English: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
Kiswahili: Waliuza mali zao na vitu walivyokuwa navyo, kila mtu akagawiwa kadiri ya mahitaji yake.
Ekegusii: bakaoonia chinibo chiabo na ebinto ebibarenge nabio, na kobigabera abanto bonsi koreng’ana buna kera oyomo aremeire.

English: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
Kiswahili: Siku zote kwa moyo mmoja walikutana ndani ya ukumbi wa Hekalu, wakimega mkate nyumba kwa nyumba, wakila chakula chao kwa furaha na moyo mweupe,
Ekegusii: Kera rituko bakagenderera gosangererekana amo ase Hekalu ime, bagosamunyora emegati enyomba ase enyomba na koragerera amo ase omogooko na ase chinkoro chi’oboitongo,

English: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
Kiswahili: wakimsifu Mungu na kuwapendeza watu wote. Kila siku Bwana akaliongeza kanisa wale waliokuwa wakiokolewa.
Ekegusii: bakomotogia Nyasae na kogwenera abanto bonsi. Omonene akabamentera kera rituko ase okorenta baria barenge gotoorigwa.

English: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
Kiswahili: Siku moja Petro na Yohana walikuwa wanapanda kwenda Hekaluni kusali yapata saa tisa alasiri.
Ekegusii: Rituko erimo Petero na Yohana nigo barenge gotiira gochia ase Hekalu chinsa chi’ogosaba, chinsa kianda.

English: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.
Kiswahili: Basi palikuwa na mtu mmoja aliyekuwa kiwete tangu kuzaliwa. Alichukuliwa na kuwekwa kwenye lango la Hekalu liitwalo Zuri, kila siku ili aombe msaada kwa watu wanaoingia Hekaluni.
Ekegusii: Na omonto oyomo, orenge rigata korwa okoiborwa kwaye, ore kobogorigwa n’abanto na kobeekwa kera rituko ase egesieri gie Hekalu kiare korokwa Egesieri Ekiya, erinde asabe ebiegwa ase abwo baare gosoa ase Hekalu.

English: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.
Kiswahili: Huyu mtu alipowaona Petro na Yohana wakikaribia kuingia Hekaluni, akawaomba wampe sadaka.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio agachia korora Petero na Yohana kobagosoa Hekalu ime, agasaba bamoe ebiegwa.

English: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
Kiswahili: Wakamkazia macho, kisha Petro akamwambia, “Tutazame sisi.”
Ekegusii: Petero akamobeta amaiso, amo na Yohana, akabora: “Torigererie intwe!”

English: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo yule mtu akawatazama, akitazamia kupata kitu kutoka kwao.
Ekegusii: Akabarigereria, osemeretie ng’a naegwe egento korwa ase bare.

English: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamwambia, “Sina fedha wala dhahabu, lakini nilicho nacho ndicho nikupacho. Kwa jina la Yesu Kristo wa Nazareti, tembea!”
Ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoteebia: “Efeta timbwati, nonya netaabu, korende eki mbwate nakio ngokoa: Ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo o Nazareti, tenena ogende!”

English: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
Kiswahili: Petro akamshika yule mtu kwa mkono wa kuume akamwinua, mara nyayo zake na vifundo vya miguu yake vikapata nguvu.
Ekegusii: Akamobwata okoboko gw’okorio, akamoimokia igoro. Erio kegima amagoro aye ne chinengo chi’amagoro aye bikanyora chinguru.

English: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
Kiswahili: Akaruka juu na kusimama, akaanza kutembea. Kisha akaingia Hekaluni pamoja na Petro na Yohana, huku akitembea na kurukaruka na kumsifu Mungu.
Ekegusii: Akaimoka bwango, agatenena, agachaaka kogenda, agasoa Hekalu ime amo nabarabwo, ogotaara na gotuma‐tuma, na komotogia Nyasae.

English: All the people saw him walking and praising God.
Kiswahili: Watu wote walipomwona akitembea na kumsifu Mungu,
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakamorora ogotaara na komotogia Nyasae.

English: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
Kiswahili: wakamtambua kuwa ni yule mtu aliyekuwa akiketi nje ya Hekalu penye lango liitwalo Zuri akiomba msaada, nao wakajawa na mshangao, wakastaajabu juu ya yale yaliyomtukia.
Ekegusii: Bakamomanya ng’a nere oria orenge goikaransa na gosaba ebiegwa aria ase Egesieri Ekiya gie Hekalu. Erio bagaichorwa nogokumia na ogoichana ase amang’ana aria akoregete asare.

English: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
Kiswahili: Aliyeponywa alipokuwa akiambatana na Petro na Yohana, watu wote walishangaa mno, wakaja wakiwakimbilia pale ukumbi wa Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Ekero are kobwata‐bwata Petero na Yohana, abanto bonsi ase ogokumia bakaminyoka na gosangererekana amo ase bare ase egesona kiare korokwa Egesona gia Sulemani.

English: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
Kiswahili: Petro alipoona watu wamekusanyika akawaambia, “Enyi Waisraeli, kwa nini mnastaajabu kuhusu jambo hili? Mbona mnatukazia macho kwa mshangao kana kwamba ni kwa uwezo wetu au utakatifu wetu tumemfanya mtu huyu kutembea?
Ekegusii: Ekero Petero arora aya akaboria abanto: “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, inki mogokumeria aya gose nase ki inwe mogotobeta amaiso, ng’a buna intwe ase chinguru chiaito abanyene, gose ase obuya bwaito, twamokora oyo ogenda?

English: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
Kiswahili: Mungu wa Abrahamu na Isaki na Yakobo, Mungu wa baba zetu amemtukuza Mwanawe Yesu, ambaye ninyi mlimtoa ahukumiwe kifo na mkamkana mbele ya Pilato, ingawa yeye alikuwa ameamua kumwachia aende zake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, oeire Omosomba oye Yeso obonene, ere inwe mokamorua na komwanga ase obosio bwa Pilato, ekero agambete ekiina kiaye ng’a amosibore.

English: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
Kiswahili: Ninyi mlimkataa huyo Mtakatifu na Mwenye Haki mkaomba mpewe yule muuaji.
Ekegusii: Korende mokamwanga oria Omochenu, Omonyene Oboronge, na mokaboria moegwe omoiti.

English: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mkamuua aliye chanzo cha uzima, lakini Mungu akamfufua kutoka kwa wafu. Sisi tu mashahidi wa mambo haya.
Ekegusii: Mogaita Omotongi bw’obogima. Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure, na ase ayio intwe nigo tore kirori.

English: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani katika jina la Yesu, huyu mtu mnayemwona na kumfahamu ametiwa nguvu. Ni kwa jina la Yesu na imani itokayo kwake ambayo imemponya kabisa huyu mtu, kama ninyi wote mnavyoona.
Ekegusii: Na ase okwegena kw’erieta riaye, erieta riaye riamobekire chinguru omonto oyo mwarorire aiga na komomanya; na okwegena koria kore ase enchera ya Yeso kwamonyoreire obogima oboikeranu, buna mwarorire mwensi.

English: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
Kiswahili: “Sasa ndugu zangu, najua ya kuwa ninyi mlitenda bila kujua, kama walivyofanya viongozi wenu.
Ekegusii: “Na bono baminto, namanyire ng’a nigo mwakorete aya ase ogotamanya kwaino, buna abanene baino bakorete.

English: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa njia hii Mungu alitimiza kile ambacho alikuwa ametabiri kwa vinywa vya manabii wake wote, kwamba Kristo atateswa.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agaikereania amang’ana aya akwanete ase emenwa y’ababani bonsi, ng’a Kristo Omwana oye nachandwe, oyio oyaikeranirie ase enchera eye.

English: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,
Kiswahili: Tubuni basi mkamgeukie Mungu, dhambi zenu zifutwe, ili zipate kuja nyakati za kuburudishwa kwa kuwepo kwake Bwana,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio onchoka, moirane, erinde ebibe biaino bitinyigwe, erio chingaki chi’ogotimokigwa chinyare gocha korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene,

English: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,
Kiswahili: naye apate kumtuma Kristo, ambaye ameteuliwa kwa ajili yenu, yaani Yesu.
Ekegusii: anyare gotoma Yeso, oria mwarageretwe korwa kare, nere Kristo.

English: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
Kiswahili: Ilimpasa mbingu zimpokee mpaka wakati wa kufanywa upya kila kitu, kama Mungu alivyoahidi zamani kupitia kwa vinywa vya manabii wake watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ere igoro yagwenerete komonyoora, goika chichiche chingaki chi’ebinto bionsi bigokorwa ebiyia, ebiakwanetwe na Nyasae ase emenwa y’ababani baaye abachenu korwa kare.

English: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mose alisema, ‘Bwana Mungu wenu atawainulia nabii kama mimi kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zenu. Itawapasa kumtii huyo kwa kila jambo atakalowaambia.
Ekegusii: Musa nateebete: Omonene Nyasae oino nabatomere omobani buna antomete korwa ase egati y’abamino. Momoigwere ase amang’ana onsi arabateebie.

English: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote ambaye hatamsikiliza huyo nabii, atatupiliwa mbali kabisa na watu wake.’
Ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera omonto otaigwereti omobani oyio nigo arasirigwe na gwatananwa korwa ase egati y’abanto ba Nyasae.

English: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.
Kiswahili: “Naam, manabii wote tangu Samweli na waliokuja baada yake, wote walitabiri kuhusu siku hizi.
Ekegusii: Na ababani bonsi abakwanete korwa Samweli, na baria bachete korwa magega yaye, bakararia igoro yaria agokoreka ase amatuko aya.

English: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’
Kiswahili: Ninyi ndio wana wa manabii na wa Agano ambalo Mungu alifanya na baba zenu, akimwambia Abrahamu, ‘Kupitia kwa uzao wako, watu wote wa ulimwengu watabarikiwa.’
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo more oroiboro rw’echiira chiria Nyasae akorete goetera ase ababani baye gocha ase more naende nigo more abasangi ase okobwatana koria Nyasae akorete ne chisokoro chiaino, ekero ateebetie Aburaamu: Ase oroiboro rwao ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe.

English: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”
Kiswahili: Mungu alipomfufua Yesu Mwanawe, alimtuma kwenu kwanza, ili awabariki kwa kumgeuza kila mmoja wenu kutoka njia yake mbaya.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae abogetie Omosomba oye, akamotoma ase more ritang’ani, erinde abasesenie ase ogwatanana kera oyomo oino korwa ase obobe bwaye.”

English: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,
Kiswahili: Wakati Petro na Yohana walipokuwa wakisema na watu, makuhani, mkuu wa walinzi wa Hekalu na Masadukayo wakawajia,
Ekegusii: Ekero barenge gokwana n’abanto, abakuani abanene, na omonene bw’abarendi be Hekalu, na Abasadukai bagaacha.

English: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
Kiswahili: huku wakiwa wamekasirika sana kwa sababu mitume walikuwa wanawafundisha watu na kuhubiri kwamba kuna ufufuo wa wafu ndani ya Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bakabea ase engencho abatomwa abwo babere nigo bare kworokereria abanto ng’a Yeso nabogete korwa ase abakuure, eyio ekworokia ng’a abanto bakuure mbabokigwe babe moyo.

English: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
Kiswahili: Wakawakamata Petro na Yohana na kuwatia gerezani mpaka kesho yake kwa kuwa ilikuwa jioni.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakababwata, bakababeeka echela ime goika rituko riare kobwatia ekiagera konya riagorobire.

English: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
Kiswahili: Lakini wengi waliosikia lile neno waliamini, idadi yao ilikuwa yapata wanaume 5,000.
Ekegusii: Korende abange ase abwo abaigwete amang’ana aya bakeegena; na omobaro bw’abasaacha nigo obete koreng’ana chilifu isano.

English: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake, viongozi wa Kiyahudi, wazee na walimu wa sheria wakakusanyika Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia rituko riare kobwatia, abarai ba Abayahudi, abanene, amo n’Aborokia b’amachiiko bagasangererekana ime ya Yerusalemu.

English: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
Kiswahili: Walikuwepo kuhani mkuu Anasi, Kayafa, Yohana, Iskanda, na wengi wa jamaa ya kuhani mkuu.
Ekegusii: Barobwo bakaumerana na Anasi Omokuani omonene, na Kayafa, na Yohana, na Alekisanda, na bonsi abarenge b’eamate y’Omokuani omonene.

English: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwasimamisha Petro na Yohana katikati yao, wakawauliza, “Ni kwa uwezo gani au kwa jina la nani mmefanya jambo hili?”
Ekegusii: Bakababeka abatomwa batenene ase obosio bwabo, erio bakababoria “’ngaki mwanyara gokora aya? Ase kobua ki gose nase erieta riango mwarangeria?”

English: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,
Kiswahili: Petro, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, akajibu, “Enyi watawala na wazee wa watu,
Ekegusii: Erio Petero oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akabateebia: Abaanene b’abaanto, na abagaaka,

English: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,
Kiswahili: kama leo tukihojiwa kwa habari ya mambo mema aliyotendewa yule kiwete na kuulizwa jinsi alivyoponywa,
Ekegusii: onye intwe tokoborigwa reero iga ase ogokora okuya gwakorekana ase omonto oyo ekerema naende ng’aki abwenigwa,

English: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.
Kiswahili: ijulikane kwenu nyote na kwa watu wote wa Israeli kwamba: Ni kwa jina la Yesu Kristo wa Nazareti, ambaye ninyi mlimsulubisha lakini Mungu akamfufua kutoka kwa wafu, kwa jina hilo mtu huyu anasimama mbele yenu akiwa mzima kabisa.
Ekegusii: tiga emanyekane ase more mwensi, amo nase abanto bonsi ba Israeli, buna omonto oyo nigo ateneine bosio bwaino ore omogima kegima ase chinguru chi’erieta ria Yeso Kristo omo Nazareti—oria inwe mwabambete, nere oyio Nyasae abogetie korwa ase abakuure.

English: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye “ ‘jiwe ambalo ninyi wajenzi mlilikataa, ambalo limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.’
Ekegusii: Yeso nere oyio amariiko agokwanera iga rigena riria inwe abaagachi mwachaayete riaonchokire koba rigena riengencho enene kobua onsi.

English: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
Kiswahili: Wala hakuna wokovu katika mwingine awaye yote, kwa maana hakuna jina jingine chini ya mbingu walilopewa wanadamu litupasalo sisi kuokolewa kwalo.”
Ekegusii: Ogotoreka nigo gokonyorekana ase are ere bweka; nase ase ense engima onde taiyo naende oyio Nyasae aruure oranyare gototoria.

English: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.
Kiswahili: Wale viongozi na wazee walipoona ujasiri wa Petro na Yohana na kujua ya kuwa walikuwa watu wa kawaida, wasio na elimu, walishangaa sana, wakatambua kwamba hawa watu walikuwa na Yesu.
Ekegusii: Abagaaka b’ekegambero bakegosa mono korora buna Petero na Yohana batenenete ase oboremu na boigo kwemanyia buna barabwo n’abanto batachiete ande kemasomo. Erio barabwo bakamanya ng’a Petero na Yohana noo barenge amo na Yeso ase orogendo rwaye.

English: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kuwa walikuwa wanamwona yule kiwete aliyeponywa amesimama pale pamoja nao, hawakuweza kusema lolote kuwapinga.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia korora omonto oria ogwenetigwe, oteneine amo nabarabwo, tibaaba na ing’ana rinde rionsi bagokwana.

English: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
Kiswahili: Wakawaamuru watoke nje ya Baraza la Wayahudi wakati wakisemezana jambo hilo wao kwa wao.
Ekegusii: Bakabachiika basoke korwa ase ekegambero, erio bagachaaka gokwana barabwo ase barabwo.

English: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.
Kiswahili: Wakaulizana, “Tuwafanyie nini watu hawa? Hatuwezi kukanusha muujiza huu mkubwa walioufanya ambao ni dhahiri kwa kila mtu Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Bagoteeba: “Inki torakorere abanto aba? Ekiagera egekone eke giakorirwe nabarabwo kere maiso marore ase abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, titokonyara kogekaana.

English: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ili kuzuia jambo hili lisiendelee kuenea zaidi kwa watu, ni lazima tuwaonye watu hawa ili wasiseme tena na mtu yeyote kwa jina la Yesu.”
Ekegusii: Korende gokiria ring’ana eri tiricha gosiarerwa egati y’abanto; tiga tobagose, tibakwana na monto onde bwensi ase erieta ria Yeso.”

English: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakawaita tena ndani na kuwaamuru wasiseme wala kufundisha kamwe kwa hili jina la Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bakabarangeria, bakabatianera tibaabaisa gokwana gose kworokereria ase erieta ria Yeso.

English: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro na Yohana wakajibu, “Amueni ninyi wenyewe iwapo ni haki mbele za Mungu kuwatii ninyi kuliko kumtii Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende Petero na Yohana bakabairaneria: “nacha inwe abanyene ndiriri rironge ase obosio bwa Nyasae—-kobaigwera inwe gose komoigwera Nyasae.

English: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi hatuwezi kuacha kusema yale tuliyoyaona na kuyasikia.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera intwe titokonyara gotiga gokwana ayatweroreire na kweigwera.”

English: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.
Kiswahili: Baada ya vitisho vingi, wakawaacha waende zao. Hawakuona njia yoyote ya kuwaadhibu, kwa sababu ya watu, kwa kuwa watu wote walikuwa wakimsifu Mungu kwa kile kilichokuwa kimetukia.
Ekegusii: Erio ekegambero gekabatianera n’echinguru erio bakabaigorera bagende. Barobwo bakanyora buna tekonyarekana babae egesusuro ekiagera abanto bonsi nigo bagendererete gotogia Nyasae ase ogokora koria kwabete.

English: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa umri wa yule mtu aliyekuwa ameponywa kwa muujiza ulikuwa zaidi ya miaka arobaini.
Ekegusii: Emiaka y’omonto oria egekone eke giokogwenigwa kiaberete nigo yarenge goetania emerongo ene.

English: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
Kiswahili: Punde Petro na Yohana walipoachiliwa, walirudi kwa waumini wenzao wakawaeleza waliyoambiwa na viongozi wa makuhani na wazee.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima ekero Petero na Yohana baigoreretwe, barabwo bakairana goika ase omoganda erio bakabateebia aria abakuani abanene na abagaaka baabateebetie.

English: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
Kiswahili: Watu waliposikia hayo, wakainua sauti zao, wakamwomba Mungu kwa pamoja, wakisema, “Bwana Mwenyezi, uliyeziumba mbingu na nchi na bahari, na vitu vyote vilivyomo.
Ekegusii: Ekero abegeeni baigwete ayio, bakaba amo ase ogosaba Nyasae bakobora: Omonene na omotongi o igoro n’ense n’enyancha, na bionsi ebigotoka imeo!

English: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
Kiswahili: Wewe ulisema kwa Roho Mtakatifu kupitia kwa kinywa cha baba yetu Daudi, mtumishi wako, ukasema: “ ‘Mbona mataifa wanaghadhibika, na kabila za watu zinawaza ubatili?
Ekegusii: Naye gwakwanete n’Omoika Omochenu goetera ase omonwa o sokoro yaito Daudi, omosomba oo, ekero atebeete Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bakorete rirorooche, inki gekogera abanto baroberetie emeroberio ere bosa?

English: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’
Kiswahili: Wafalme wa dunia wamejipanga, na watawala wanakusanyika pamoja dhidi ya Bwana na dhidi ya Mpakwa Mafuta wake.’
Ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense bakebeeka ang’e, na abagaambi nigo baumeranete amo erio barwanie Omonene amo na Kristo oye.

English: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,
Kiswahili: Ni kweli Herode na Pontio Pilato pamoja na watu wa Mataifa na Waisraeli, walikusanyika katika mji huu dhidi ya mwanao mtakatifu Yesu uliyemtia mafuta.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ekeene Herode na Pontio Pilato nigo baumeranete ase omochie omonene amo n’abanto b’Ebisaku, na Abaisraeli boigo mamaincha ya Yeso Omosomba oo omochenu oyo gwakorete koba Kristo.

English: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.
Kiswahili: Wao wakafanya yale ambayo uweza wako na mapenzi yako yalikuwa yamekusudia yatokee tangu zamani.
Ekegusii: Barobwo bakaumerana gokora kera ring’ana erio goetera ase chinguru amo n’ogwancha kwao kwaroberetie korwa omochakano anyare koba.

English: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
Kiswahili: Sasa, Bwana angalia vitisho vyao na utuwezeshe sisi watumishi wako kulinena neno lako kwa ujasiri mkuu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo bono, aye Omonene, rora ogotianerwa okwo kwabeire, erio aye otwanchere, intwe abasomba bao tokwane ring’ana riao n’oboremu bwonsi.

English: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
Kiswahili: Nyoosha mkono wako ili kuponya wagonjwa na kutenda ishara na miujiza kwa jina la Mwanao mtakatifu Yesu.”
Ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao, naende ancha buna ebikone binyare gokorekana goetera ase erieta ri’Omosomba oo omochenu, Yeso.

English: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kuomba, mahali walipokuwa wamekutanika pakatikiswa, wote wakajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu, wakanena neno la Mungu kwa ujasiri.
Ekegusii: Ekero barabwo bakorete gosaba ase agwo barabwo basangerekanete agatengechigwa. Barobwo bonsi bagaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu na boigo bagachaaka gokwana ring’ana ria Nyasae noboremu.

English: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
Kiswahili: Wale walioamini wote walikuwa na moyo mmoja na nia moja. Wala hakuna hata mmoja aliyesema chochote alichokuwa nacho ni mali yake mwenyewe, lakini walishirikiana kila kitu walichokuwa nacho.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwabegeeni nigo obwataine ase ebirengererio na ase chinkoro. Tari nonya n’oyomo ase egati yabo orenge gokwana buna kende gionsi abwate ere omonyene n’ekiaye, korende nigo babete bagosanga ase oboamo kera ekemo ekio babwate.

English: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
Kiswahili: Mitume wakatoa ushuhuda wa kufufuka kwa Bwana Yesu kwa nguvu nyingi na neema ya Mungu ilikuwa juu yao wote.
Ekegusii: Abatomwa bakagenderera koba kirori igoro y’okoboka kwa Yeso Kristo na Omonene akabaitororera bonsi obotenenku bw’ogosesenigwa kwaye.

English: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
Kiswahili: Wala hapakuwepo mtu yeyote miongoni mwao aliyekuwa mhitaji, kwa sababu mara kwa mara wale waliokuwa na mashamba na nyumba waliviuza, wakaleta thamani ya vitu vilivyouzwa,
Ekegusii: Na monto onde tarenge ase egati yabo oyorenge nokoremerwa, ekiagera abanto bonsi abarenge nemegondo ne chinyomba nigo babioonetie, bakarenta chitaabu chi’ebinto biria biaoonetigwe,

English: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.
Kiswahili: wakaiweka miguuni pa mitume, kila mtu akagawiwa kadiri ya mahitaji yake.
Ekegusii: bagachibeeka ase amagoro ’abatomwa; na kera omonto akagaberwa koreng’ana buna aremeire.

English: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
Kiswahili: Yosefu, Mlawi kutoka Kipro, ambaye mitume walimwita Barnaba (maana yake Mwana wa Faraja),
Ekegusii: Na Yusufu ore korokwa nabatomwa Barnaba (engencho yaye: “Omwana bw’Oboremia”), Omolawi, omonto o Kuporo,

English: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
Kiswahili: aliuza shamba alilokuwa nalo, akaleta hizo fedha alizopata na kuziweka miguuni pa mitume.
Ekegusii: akaonia omogondo oye, akarenta chitaabu, agachibeeka ase amagoro yabatomwa.

English: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu mmoja jina lake Anania pamoja na mkewe Safira waliuza kiwanja.
Ekegusii: Korende narenge omosacha oyomo ore korokwa Anania, oyio amo na mokaye Sabira baoonetie ensemo y’omogondo obo.

English: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
Kiswahili: Huku mkewe akijua kikamilifu, Anania alificha sehemu ya fedha alizopata, akaleta kiasi kilichobaki na kukiweka miguuni pa mitume.
Ekegusii: Korende ere ase ogwancherana na mokaye akabisa ensemo ye chitaabu echio baonetie, erio akaa abatomwa ensemo eria yatigarete.

English: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?
Kiswahili: Petro akamuuliza, “Anania, mbona Shetani ameujaza moyo wako ili kumwambia uongo Roho Mtakatifu, ukaficha sehemu ya fedha ulizopata kutokana na kiwanja?
Ekegusii: Erio Petero akamobooria: “Anania, nase ki ogwancha Saitani gokobogoria okong’aina Omoika Omochenu na kobisa ensemo ye chitaabu kwanyora korwa ase omogondo?

English: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”
Kiswahili: Je, kabla hujauza hicho kiwanja si kilikuwa mali yako? Hata baada ya kukiuza, fedha ulizopata si zilikuwa kwenye uwezo wako? Kwa nini basi umewaza hila hii moyoni mwako kufanya jambo kama hili? Wewe hukumwambia uongo mwanadamu bali Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Nyuma otaraonia omogondo oyo noyoo orenge; Na ekero oonetigwe chitaabu nechiao chiarenge. Nase ki kwarengereretie gokora ring’ana eri? Totebeti Mwanyabaanto oborimo, korende Nyasae.”

English: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.
Kiswahili: Anania aliposikia maneno haya akaanguka chini na kufa. Hofu kuu ikawapata wote waliosikia jambo lililokuwa limetukia.
Ekegusii: Ekero Anania achia koigwa amang’ana aya, agaaka inse, agakwa. Omoondoko omonene ogasoa ase abanto bonsi abaigwete aya.

English: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
Kiswahili: Vijana wakaja, wakaufunga mwili wake sanda, wakamchukua nje kumzika.
Ekegusii: Abamura bagacha bagatuba omobere oye egetambaa, bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka.

English: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
Kiswahili: Saa tatu baadaye mkewe Anania akaingia, naye hana habari ya mambo yaliyotukia.
Ekegusii: Magega ye chinsa isato mokaye agasoa, ere tamanyete aya akoregete.

English: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”
Kiswahili: Petro akamuuliza, “Niambie, je, mliuza kiwanja kwa thamani hii?” Akajibu, “Ndiyo, tuliuza kwa thamani hiyo.”
Ekegusii: Petero akamobooria: “Nteebia, eri nario rigori aye n’omosacha oo mwaonetie omogondo ase?” Akairaneria: “Ee, ase rigori oino.”

English: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akamwambia, “Imekuwaje mkakubaliana kumjaribu Roho wa Bwana? Tazama! Nyayo za vijana waliomzika mumeo ziko mlangoni, wewe nawe watakuchukua nje.”
