Ekegusii: Petero akamobooria: “Naki abeete aye n’omosacha oo mogancherana goteema Omoika bw’Omonene? Abasacha abwo batindeka omosacha oo nao bare agwo gesieri, na barabwo nabakobogorie aye gochia isiko.”

English: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
Kiswahili: Saa ile ile akaanguka chini miguuni mwake na kufa. Nao wale vijana wakaingia, wakamkuta amekufa, wakamchukua wakamzika kando ya mumewe.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima akagwa ase amagoro aye, agakwa. Abamura baria bagasoa, bakamonyora okuure. Erio bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka ase omosacha oye ensemo.

English: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
Kiswahili: Hofu kuu ikalipata kanisa lote pamoja na watu wote waliosikia juu ya matukio haya.
Ekegusii: Omoondoko omonene okabwata ekanisa yonsi na abanto bonsi abaigwete aya.

English: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
Kiswahili: Mitume wakafanya ishara nyingi na miujiza miongoni mwa watu. Walioamini wote walikuwa wakikusanyika katika ukumbi wa Solomoni.
Ekegusii: Ebikone ebinge na amakumia bikagenderera gokoreka ase egati y’abanto amo n’abatomwa. Ebegeeni bonsi bagasangererekana amo ase Egesona gia Sulemani.

English: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu mwingine aliyethubutu kuambatana nao ijapokuwa waliheshimiwa sana na watu.
Ekegusii: Onde tarenge korwa isiko obete noboremu kobwatana nabarabwo, korende abanto bakabasika ogosika okonene.

English: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, waliomwamini Bwana wakazidi kuongezeka, wanaume na wanawake.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abange bakamentwa ase abegeeni omoganda omonene bw’abasacha na’abakuungu abwo begenete omonene.

English: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
Kiswahili: Hata wakawa wanawaleta wagonjwa na kuwalaza kwenye magodoro na kwenye vitanda barabarani ili yamkini Petro akipita kivuli chake kiwaguse baadhi yao.
Ekegusii: Goetera ase emeremo eye abatomwa bare gokora, abarwaire nigo barenge kobogorigwa isiko ase amarere n’ebisero biabo erinde ekero Petero agoeta, omorengari oye okune abande b’abwo.

English: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.
Kiswahili: Pia watu wakakusanyika kutoka miji iliyokuwa karibu na Yerusalemu, wakileta wagonjwa na watu walioteswa na pepo wachafu. Hao wote wakaponywa.
Ekegusii: Nonya n’abanto korwa ase emechie eria yaetanaine Yerusalemu bagesangereria, bakarenta abarwaire amo nabwo babwatire nebirecha bi’eubi, na bonsi bakagwenigwa.

English: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy
Kiswahili: Kisha kuhani mkuu na wenzake wote waliokuwa pamoja naye, waliokuwa wa kundi la Masadukayo, wakajawa na wivu.
Ekegusii: Omokuani omonene akaimoka, na bonsi abarenge amo nere; abwo nabwo barenge b’Abasadukai. Bagaichorwa ne ribero rinene ase Abatomwa ase igo bakaroberia kobaimokeria egetambokero.

English: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.
Kiswahili: Wakawakamata mitume na kuwatia gerezani.
Ekegusii: Bakabwata abatomwa, bakababeeka ime ase echela y’abanto bonsi ime.

English: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati wa usiku, malaika wa Bwana akaja, akafungua milango ya gereza na akawatoa nje. Akawaambia,
Ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko boria omomalaika bw’Omonene akaigora ebisieri bi’echela, akabasokia isiko, erio akabateebia,

English: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
Kiswahili: “Nendeni, mkasimame Hekaluni mkawaambie watu maneno yote ya uzima huu mpya.”
Ekegusii: “Genda, motenene ase Hekalu ime, moteebie abanto bonsi amang’ana onsi igoro y’Obogima obo oboyia.”

English: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia haya wakaenda Hekaluni alfajiri wakaendelea kufundisha watu. Kuhani mkuu na wale waliokuwa pamoja nao walipowasili, alikusanya baraza na wazee wote wa Israeli wakatuma wale mitume waletwe kutoka gerezani.
Ekegusii: Abatomwa bakaigwera, mambia kobogokiamoka bagasoa Hekalu ime bagachaaka kworokereria. Omokuani omonene n’ababwatani baye bakarangeria abanene b’Abayahudi goika ase omosangererekano goika ase ekegambero ki’abaanto bonsi; erio bagatoma ogochika gochia ase echela erinde barente abatomwa baria ase ekegambero.

English: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
Kiswahili: Lakini wale walinzi wa Hekalu walipokwenda gerezani hawakuwakuta mitume mle. Kwa hiyo wakarudi na kutoa habari.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero abarendi bachia goika, tibaabanyora echela ime. Bakairana, bagateeba,

English: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
Kiswahili: Wakasema, “Tumekuta milango ya gereza imefungwa sawasawa na askari wa gereza wamesimama nje ya mlango, lakini tulipofungua milango hakuwepo mtu yeyote ndani.”
Ekegusii: “Echela nigo twayenyora esiekire buya kegima, na abarendi bateneine bisieri, korende twachia koigora ebiita titwanyora monto onde ime.”

English: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
Kiswahili: Basi mkuu wa walinzi wa Hekalu na viongozi wa makuhani waliposikia haya, wakafadhaika na kushangaa sana kwa ajili yao kwamba jambo hili litakuwaje.
Ekegusii: Na ekero omonene bw’abarendi be Hekalu na abakuani abanene bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagasogwa nomoichano omonene ase engencho yabo, naki arabe amang’ana aya.

English: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo mtu mmoja akaja akawaambia, “Tazameni watu mliowatia gerezani wako Hekaluni wakiwafundisha watu.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo agaacha, akabateebia: “Rora, abanto baria mwabeegete echela ime nigo bateneine ase Hekalu ime kworokereria abanto.”

English: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule mkuu wa walinzi wa Hekalu wakaenda pamoja na askari wakawaleta wale mitume, lakini bila ghasia kwa sababu waliogopa kupigwa mawe na watu.
Ekegusii: Erio omonene bw’abarendi akagenda amo n’abanto baaye, bakabarenta, korende tari ase chinguru, ekiagera barenge nobwoba ng’a mbaakwe amagena n’abanto.

English: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
Kiswahili: Wakiisha kuwaleta mitume wakawaamuru kusimama mbele ya baraza ili kuhani mkuu awahoji.
Ekegusii: Ekero baabarentire bakababeeka ase ekegambero. Omokuani omonene akababoria,

English: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
Kiswahili: “Tuliwaonya kwa nguvu msifundishe kwa jina hili, lakini ninyi mmeijaza Yerusalemu yote mafundisho yenu na tena mmekusudia kuleta damu ya mtu huyu juu yetu.”
Ekegusii: “Inee! Titwabakanetie bokong’u ng’a timworokereria ase erieta ri’omonto oyo? Korende rora aya mwakorire! Akababoria. Mwaichoirie Yerusalemu nokworokereria kwaino, naende morigetie gotororekania koba buna nintwe twaretete ogokwa kwaye.”

English: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
Kiswahili: Petro na wale mitume wengine wakajibu, “Imetupasa kumtii Mungu kuliko wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Korende Petero na abatomwa bande bakairaneria: “Goika intwe toigwere Nyasae kobua Mwanyabaanto.

English: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
Kiswahili: Mungu wa baba zetu alimfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu, ambaye ninyi mlimuua kwa kumtundika kwenye msalaba.
Ekegusii: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito nigo abogetie Yeso korwa ase amakweri, nyuma inwe mwamoitire ase okomosunga ase omosalaba.

English: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
Kiswahili: Mungu alimtukuza, akamweka mkono wake wa kuume kuwa Kiongozi na Mwokozi ili awape Israeli toba na msamaha wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Nyasae akamoimokereria igoro ase ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio buna Omoraai na Omotooria, erinde abae abanto ba Israeli ribaga riokoonchoka erinde banyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo.

English: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
Kiswahili: Nasi tu mashahidi wa mambo haya, vivyo hivyo na Roho Mtakatifu ambaye Mungu amewapa wale wanaomtii.”
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore kirori ase amang’ana aya onsi—intwe amo n’Omoika Omochenu, oyio ore ekeegwa kia Nyasae ase baria bonsi bakomoigwera ere.”

English: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
Kiswahili: Wale wajumbe wa baraza la wazee waliposikia haya, walijawa na ghadhabu, wakataka kuwaua mitume.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto baria b’ekegambero bachia koigwa aya bakagechigwa, bakarigia goita abatomwa bakwe.

English: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
Kiswahili: Lakini Farisayo mmoja, jina lake Gamalieli, aliyekuwa mwalimu wa sheria, aliyeheshimiwa na watu wote, akasimama mbele ya baraza akaamuru mitume watolewe nje kwa muda.
Ekegusii: Korende Omofarisai oyomo ore korokwa Gamalieli, oyomo bw’ekegambero, omworokia bw’amachiiko, omonto osikire n’abanto bonsi, agachiika ng’a abanto aba babekwe isiko ake,

English: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
Kiswahili: Ndipo alipowaambia wajumbe wa baraza, “Enyi watu wa Israeli, fikirini kwa uangalifu mnayotaka kuwatendea watu hawa.
Ekegusii: erio agakwana ase ekegambero keria, “Inwe abasacha b’Abaisraeli, erende buna morakorere abanto aba.

English: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wakati uliopita, aliinuka mtu mmoja jina lake Theuda, alijidai kuwa yeye ni mtu maarufu, akapata wafuasi wapatao 400 walioambatana naye. Lakini aliuawa, na wafuasi wake wote wakatawanyika, wakawa si kitu.
Ekegusii: Naki ase amatuko aetire Theuda naimoka, agetogia ng’a ere nomonto omonene; abanto koreng’ana amagana ane bakabwatana nere, korende ere agaitwa, na abatunyani baye bonsi bagaserebekana, n’ekeombe kiaye kegasira.

English: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
Kiswahili: Baada yake, alitokea Yuda Mgalilaya wakati wa kuorodhesha watu, naye akaongoza kundi la watu kuasi. Yeye pia aliuawa, nao wafuasi wake wakatawanyika.
Ekegusii: Magega yaye, Yudasi Omogalili nere akaimoka ase amatuko aria ekero abanto baare koriikwa, akang’usa abanto abange bamotunyane. Nere boigo agasira, na bonsi abamotunyanete bagaserebekana.

English: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa habari ya jambo hili nawashauri, jiepusheni na watu hawa. Waacheni waende zao! Kwa maana kama kusudi lao na shughuli yao imetokana na mwanadamu, haitafanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Na bono nabateebirie, timobaisa koira getambokero kende gionsi ase abanto aba. Batige! Ekiagera onye ring’ana eri, gose emeremo eye, neya Mwanyabaanto, nesarigwe,

English: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa imetoka kwa Mungu, hamtaweza kuwazuia watu hawa. Badala yake mtajikuta mnapigana na Mungu.”
Ekegusii: korende onye neya Nyasae, timokonyaara koyesaria nonya ng’ake; mobaise kororekana ng’a Nyasae mokorwania!”

English: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
Kiswahili: Wakapokea ushauri wa Gamalieli. Wakawaita mitume ndani, wakaamuru wachapwe mijeledi, kisha wakawaagiza wasinene tena kwa jina la Yesu, wakawaachia waende zao.
Ekegusii: Bagancha amang’ana aye, na ekero barangeretie abatomwa, bakabachwata, bakabachiika tibakwana ase erieta ria Yeso. Erio bakabatiga bagende.

English: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
Kiswahili: Nao mitume wakatoka nje ya baraza, wakiwa wamejaa furaha kwa sababu wamehesabiwa kustahili kupata aibu kwa ajili ya jina la Yesu.
Ekegusii: Abatomwa bakarua ase ekegambero keria, bagogete ekiagera konya baabarirwe ng’a bagweneire korenterwa obosooku ase engencho y’Erieta ria Yeso.

English: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
Kiswahili: Kila siku, Hekaluni na nyumba kwa nyumba, hawakuacha kufundisha na kuhubiri habari njema kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Na kera rituko, ase Hekalu ime na ase chinyomba chiabo tibatigete kworokereria na korandia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso, oyio ore Kristo.

English: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
Kiswahili: Basi ikawa katika siku hizo, wakati idadi ya wanafunzi ilipokuwa ikiongezeka sana, palitokea manungʼuniko kati ya Wayahudi wa Kiyunani, dhidi ya Waebrania kwa sababu wajane wao walisahaulika katika mgawanyo wa chakula wa kila siku.
Ekegusii: Bono ase amatuko aria, ekero aborokigwa barenge komentekana omobaro obo, nkwabeete okwemurungania kw’Abayahudi abarenge gokwana Ekegiriki igoro ase Abayahudi baria barenge gokwana Ekearamaiki, ekiagera ababoraka baabo bebetwe ase okogaberwa gwa kera rituko.

English: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.
Kiswahili: Wale mitume kumi na wawili wakakusanya wanafunzi wote pamoja wakasema, “Haitakuwa vyema sisi kuacha huduma ya neno la Mungu ili kuhudumu mezani.
Ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere bakarangeria omoganda bw’aborokigwa, bagateeba: “Tetogwenereti intwe gotiga ring’ana ria Nyasae na gokora emeremo ye chimesa.

English: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu, chagueni watu saba miongoni mwenu, watu wenye sifa njema, waliojawa na Roho Mtakatifu na hekima, ambao tunaweza kuwakabidhi kazi hii,
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, chora abanto batano na babere korwa ase egati yaino, abamanyekanete ng’a nabaya, baichire n’Omoika na obong’aini, erinde tobabeeke ase emeremo eye.

English: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
Kiswahili: nasi tutatumia muda wetu kuomba na huduma ya neno.”
Ekegusii: Korende intwe inatogenderere ase ogosaba na gokorera ring’ana ria Nyasae.”

English: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,
Kiswahili: Yale waliyosema yakawapendeza watu wote, nao wakamchagua Stefano (mtu aliyejawa na imani na Roho Mtakatifu) pamoja na Filipo, Prokoro, Nikanori, Timoni, Parmena na Nikolao, mwongofu kutoka Antiokia.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rikagwenera omosangererekano bwonsi. Bagachora Stefano, omonto oichire nokwegena na Omoika Omochenu, na Filipo, na Prokoro, na Nikanora, na Timoni, na Parmena, na Nikolao bw’Antiokia, omonto oonchogete.

English: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
Kiswahili: Wakawaleta watu hawa mbele ya mitume, nao wakawaombea na kuwawekea mikono juu yao.
Ekegusii: Bakababeeka bosio bw’abatomwa, na barabwo bakabasabera na kobabeekera amaboko.

English: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
Kiswahili: Neno la Mungu likazidi kuenea. Idadi ya wanafunzi ikazidi kuongezeka sana katika Yerusalemu hata makuhani wengi wakaitii ile imani.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ria Nyasae rikaranda, na omobaro bw’aborokigwa okamentekana mono ase Yerusalemu, na abakuani abange bakaigwera okwegena.

English: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
Kiswahili: Stefano, akiwa amejaa neema na nguvu za Mungu, alifanya ishara na miujiza mikubwa miongoni mwa watu.
Ekegusii: Na Stefano, oichire obuya na okobua, nigo arenge gokora amakumia amanene na ebikone egati y’abanto.

English: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ukainuka upinzani wa watu wa Sinagogi la Watu Huru (kama lilivyokuwa linaitwa), la Wayahudi wa Kirene na wa Iskanderia, na wengine kutoka Kilikia na Asia. Watu hawa wakaanza kupingana na Stefano.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto bande b’esinagogi yare korokwa Esinagogi y’Abasibore, aba nigo barenge Abakuurene na Abaaleksanderia, na baria korwa ase Kilikia na Asia, bakaimoka bakaamererania na Stefano.

English: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawakuweza kushindana na hekima yake wala huyo Roho ambaye alisema kwake.
Ekegusii: Korende tibanyara kobua obong’aini na Omoika oyo are gokwana noro.

English: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo kwa siri wakawashawishi watu fulani waseme, “Tumemsikia Stefano akisema maneno ya kufuru dhidi ya Mose na dhidi ya Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Goika bakagenka abanto bateebe: “Ntwaigwa omonto oyo ogokwana amang’ana ’oborami igoro ya Musa na Nyasae.”

English: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,
Kiswahili: Wakawachochea watu, wazee na walimu wa Sheria, nao wakamkamata Stefano wakamfikisha mbele ya baraza.
Ekegusii: Bagaseega abanto na abagaaka na aborokia b’amariiko, bagachiera Stefano bakamobwata, bakamoira bosio bw’ekegambero.

English: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
Kiswahili: Wakaweka mashahidi wa uongo ambao walishuhudia wakisema, “Mtu huyu kamwe haachi kusema dhidi ya mahali hapa patakatifu na dhidi ya Sheria.
Ekegusii: Bagatenenia kirori b’oborimo abaare goteeba: “Omonto oyo tatigeti gokwana bobe igoro y’aase Aa Aachenu na igoro y’amachiiko.

English: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tumemsikia akisema kwamba Yesu wa Nazareti atapaharibu mahali patakatifu na kubadili desturi zote tulizopewa na Mose.”
Ekegusii: Naki ntwamoigwa ogoteeba ng’a Yeso oyio o Nazareti inasarie aase aa, na koonchora chingencho echi twaetwe na Musa.”

English: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
Kiswahili: Watu wote waliokuwa wameketi katika baraza wakimkazia macho Stefano, wakaona uso wake unangʼaa kama uso wa malaika.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi, abaikaransete ase ekegambero eke, bakamobeta amaiso, bakarora obosio bwaye ng’a nigo bwabeire buna obosio bw’omomalaika.

English: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo kuhani mkuu akamuuliza Stefano, “Je, mashtaka haya ni ya kweli?”
Ekegusii: Omokuani omonene akaboria Stefano: “Inee! Amang’ana ayio naboigo are?”

English: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
Kiswahili: Stefano akajibu, “Ndugu zangu na baba zangu, nisikilizeni! Mungu wa utukufu alimtokea baba yetu Abrahamu, alipokuwa bado yuko Mesopotamia, kabla hajaishi Harani,
Ekegusii: Stefano akairaneria. Abaminto na abatata, ntegerere. Nyasae bw’obonene naorokerete sokoro yaito Aburaamu, ekero arenge ase Mesopotamia, ritang’ani ataramenya Harani,

English: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’
Kiswahili: akamwambia, ‘Ondoka kutoka nchi yako na kutoka kwa jamii yako, uende hadi nchi nitakayokuonyesha.’
Ekegusii: akamoteebia: Karue ase ense yao, na ase eamate yao, ogende goika ase ense ndakworokie.

English: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.
Kiswahili: “Hivyo aliondoka katika nchi ya Wakaldayo akaenda kukaa Harani. Baada ya kifo cha baba yake, Mungu akamtoa huko akamleta katika nchi hii ambayo mnaishi sasa.
Ekegusii: Erio akarua ase ense y’Abakalidayo, akamenya Harani. Magega ise gakuure, Nyasae akamong’anyia korwa aroro goika ense eye inwe momenyete bono.

English: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.
Kiswahili: Mungu hakumpa urithi wowote katika nchi hii, hakumpa hata mahali pa kuweka wayo mmoja. Bali Mungu alimwahidi kuwa yeye na uzao wake baada yake wangeirithi hii nchi, ingawa wakati huo Abrahamu hakuwa na mtoto.
Ekegusii: Tamoete omwando ime aa, nonya koreng’ana ase akobeeka okogoro, korende akamoriera eira ng’a namoe ense eria ebe obomenyo bwaye, na obw’oroiboro rwaye magega yaye, nonya tarenge nomwana.

English: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema naye hivi: ‘Wazao wako watakuwa wageni kwenye nchi ambayo si yao, nao watafanywa watumwa na kuteswa kwa miaka mia nne.’
Ekegusii: Nyasae agakwana iga: Oroiboro rwa Aburaamu inababe abamenyi ase ense y’abanto bande, na barabwo inababakore babe abasomba babo, na kobakorera bobe, ase engaki y’emiaka amagana ane.

English: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’
Kiswahili: Mungu akasema, ‘Lakini mimi nitaliadhibu taifa watakalolitumikia kama watumwa, na baadaye watatoka katika nchi hiyo na wataniabudu mahali hapa.’
Ekegusii: Nyasae agateeba: Ninkegambie ekiina egesaku keria kerabakore babe abasomba babo, na magega y’ayio nabaruo, na barabwo nabansasiimere aase aiga.

English: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akampa Abrahamu Agano la tohara. Naye Abrahamu akamzaa Isaki na kumtahiri siku ya nane. Baadaye Isaki akamzaa Yakobo, naye Yakobo akawazaa wale wazee wetu kumi na wawili.
Ekegusii: Akamoa okwaroka buna ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana. Erio Aburaamu akaibora Isaka, akamosara rituko ria gatano na gatato. Isaka akaibora Yakobo, na Yakobo akaibora baria ikomi na babere, abagaaka baito ba kare.

English: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him
Kiswahili: “Kwa sababu wazee wetu walimwonea wivu Yosefu ndugu yao, walimuuza kama mtumwa huko Misri. Lakini Mungu alikuwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Baria abagaaka baito ba kare bakarorera Yusufu ribero, bakamoonia gochia Misiri. Korende Nyasae akaba amo nere,

English: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
Kiswahili: Akamwokoa kutoka mateso yote yaliyompata, tena akampa kibali na hekima aliposimama mbele ya Farao, mfalme wa Misri, ambaye alimweka kuwa mtawala juu ya Misri na juu ya jumba lote la kifalme.
Ekegusii: akamorusia ase emechando yaye yonsi, akamoa ogwancherwa na obong’aini ase obosio bwa Farao, omorwoti o Misiri; ere akamobeka akaba gabana igoro ya Misiri na enyomba yaye yonsi.

English: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
Kiswahili: “Basi kukawa na njaa katika nchi yote ya Misri na Kanaani, ikasababisha dhiki kubwa, nao baba zetu wakawa hawana chakula.
Ekegusii: Erio enchara ekaba igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na Kaanani, na emechando emenge, ne chisokoro chiaito tichianyora endagera echiisanete.

English: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yakobo aliposikia kwamba kuna nafaka huko Misri, aliwatuma baba zetu, wakaenda huko kwa mara yao ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Korende Yakobo gachia koigwa ng’a endagera nekare Misiri, agatoma chisokoro chiaito aroro ase orogendo rwe ritang’ani.

English: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.
Kiswahili: Walipokwenda mara ya pili, Yosefu alijitambulisha kwa ndugu zake, nao ndugu zake Yosefu wakajulishwa kwa Farao.
Ekegusii: Ase orogendo rwa kabere Yusufu akemanyekania ase bamura bamwabo, na eamate ya Yusufu egaacha, ekamanyekana ase Farao.

English: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawatuma kumleta Yakobo baba yake pamoja na jamaa yake yote, jumla yao walikuwa watu sabini na watano.
Ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agatoma abanto gochia korangeria Yakobo ise, na eamate yaye yonsi, abanto emerongo etano na ebere na batano.

English: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;
Kiswahili: Hivyo Yakobo akaenda Misri ambako yeye na baba zetu walifia.
Ekegusii: Yakobo agatirimboka, agaika Misiri; ere agakwera aroro, ere omonyene ne chisokoro chiaito.

English: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
Kiswahili: Miili yao ilirudishwa Shekemu na kuzikwa katika kaburi ambalo Abrahamu alinunua kutoka kwa wana wa Hamori kwa kiasi fulani cha fedha.
Ekegusii: Bakabogorigwa goika Sekemu, bagatindekwa ase embeera eria Aburaamu agorete ase chifeta korwa ase abana ba Hamori, aaria Sekemu.

English: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
Kiswahili: “Lakini wakati ulipokuwa unakaribia wa kutimizwa kwa ile ahadi ambayo Mungu alikuwa amempa Abrahamu, watu wetu walizidi kuongezeka sana huko Misri.
Ekegusii: Ekero eira eria Nyasae aete Aburaamu yachia goika ang’e goikeranigwa, abanto baria bakamenteka na kobucha mono aaria Misiri,

English: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mfalme mwingine ambaye hakujua lolote kuhusu Yosefu akatawala Misri.
Ekegusii: goika omorwoti onde akabeekwa Misiri, oyotamomanyete Yusufu.

English: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
Kiswahili: Huyu mfalme akawatendea watu wetu hila na kuwatesa baba zetu kwa kuwalazimisha wawatupe watoto wao wachanga ili wafe.
Ekegusii: Oyio agakorera egesaku giaito obong’ainereria, na agakorera chisokoro chiaito amabe, na barabwo bagachiikwa ng’a batugute abana babo ebing’werere, erinde tibaaba moyo.

English: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
Kiswahili: “Wakati huo Mose alizaliwa, naye hakuwa mtoto wa kawaida. Akalelewa nyumbani kwa baba yake kwa muda wa miezi mitatu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekio Musa akaiborwa, ere nigo arenge omuya mono, akagwenera Nyasae. Akarererwa nyomba mwa ise ase engaki y’emetienyi etato.

English: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.
Kiswahili: Waliposhindwa kumficha zaidi, wakamweka nje mtoni na binti Farao akamchukua akamtunza kama mtoto wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gotugutwa, omoiseke o Farao akamoira, ’akamotuga na komorera buna omwana oye.

English: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
Kiswahili: Mose akafundishwa hekima yote ya Wamisri, akawa mtu hodari kwa maneno na matendo.
Ekegusii: Musa akaorokererigwa chiseemi chionsi chia Misiri, akaba omokong’u ase amang’ana na ase ogokora.

English: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: “Mose alipokuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini aliamua kuwatembelea ndugu zake Waisraeli.
Ekegusii: Ekero akoorire emiaka emerongo ene, akarengereria ase enkoro yaye kogenda korora abamwabo, Abaisraeli.

English: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
Kiswahili: Aliona mmoja wao akidhulumiwa na Mmisri, akamtetea yule aliyeonewa, akampiga yule Mmisri akamuua kulipiza kisasi.
Ekegusii: Akarora oyomo obo ogokorerwa bobe n’Omomisiri, akamokonya; agaakanera oria orenge gochandwa egesiomba, agaaka Omomisiri oria akamoita.

English: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
Kiswahili: Mose alidhani kuwa ndugu zake wangetambua kwamba Mungu anamtumia ili kuwaokoa, lakini wao hawakuelewa.
Ekegusii: Nigo akagete ng’a abamwabo mbamanye ng’a Nyasae nabae obosibore goetera ase okoboko kwaye, korende tibamanya.

English: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata Mose aliwakuta Waisraeli wawili wakigombana, akajaribu kuwapatanisha kwa kuwaambia, ‘Enyi watu, ninyi ni ndugu, mbona mnataka kudhulumiana?’
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia akaorokera Abaisraeli babere ekero baare korwana, akarigia kobatorania agateeba: Abaminto, inwe nabamo, nase ki mokorwana?

English: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
Kiswahili: “Lakini yule mtu aliyekuwa akimdhulumu mwenzake akamsukuma Mose kando, akamuuliza, ‘Ni nani aliyekufanya mtawala na mwamuzi juu yetu?
Ekegusii: Korende oria orenge gokorera oyomwabo bobe, akamosukeria are, agateeba: Ning’o okobegete koba omonene gose omogambi ase tore?

English: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
Kiswahili: Je, unataka kuniua kama ulivyomuua yule Mmisri jana?’
Ekegusii: Inee! Norigetie kong’ita buna gwaita Omomisiri oria igoro?

English: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
Kiswahili: Mose aliposikia maneno haya, alikimbilia huko Midiani alikokaa kama mgeni, naye akapata watoto wawili wa kiume.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’amang’ana aya Musa agatama gochia ase ense ya Midiani, akamenya aroro buna omomenyi. Akaiborera abana babere abamura aroro.

English: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
Kiswahili: “Basi baada ya miaka arobaini kupita, malaika wa Mungu akamtokea Mose jangwani karibu na Mlima Sinai katika kichaka kilichokuwa kinawaka moto.
Ekegusii: Ekero emiaka emerongo ene yachia koera, omomalaika akamoorokera ase ogwoka kw’omorero ase egetutu aaria erooro y’egetunwa gia Sinai.

English: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,
Kiswahili: Alipoona mambo haya, alishangaa yale maono. Aliposogea ili aangalie kwa karibu, akaisikia sauti ya Bwana, ikisema:
Ekegusii: Musa agakumia ase okorora koria, na ekero achia goika ang’e gokorora, eriogi ri’Omonene rikamocheera, rigateeba:

English: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.
Kiswahili: ‘Mimi ndimi Mungu wa baba zako, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.’ Mose alitetemeka kwa hofu na hakuthubutu kutazama.
Ekegusii: Ninche Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiao, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo. Musa akaiguswa, tarenge na boremu bw’okorigereria.

English: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
Kiswahili: “Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, ‘Vua viatu vyako kwa maana mahali unaposimama ni patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: Rusia ebikoroto biao korwa ase amagoro ao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine nase aachenu.

English: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
Kiswahili: Hakika nimeona mateso ya watu wangu huko Misri. Nimesikia kilio chao cha uchungu, nami nimeshuka ili niwaokoe. Basi sasa njoo, nami nitakutuma Misri.’
Ekegusii: Ekeene, narorire ogokorerwa bobe kw’abaanto baane abare Misiri, naigure okorera kwabo, naikire mbasibore. Inchuo bono, ngotome goika Misiri.

English: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
Kiswahili: “Huyu ndiye Mose yule waliyemkataa wakisema, ‘Ni nani aliyekufanya mtawala na mwamuzi juu yetu?’ Alikuwa ametumwa na Mungu mwenyewe kuwa mtawala na mkombozi wao, kwa njia ya yule malaika aliyemtokea katika kile kichaka.
Ekegusii: Musa nere oyio bangete, bagateeba: Ning’o okobegete koba omonene gose omogambi? Nere otometwe na Nyasae, goetera ase amaboko ’omomalaika oria omoorokerete ase egetutu keria, koba omonene na omosibori.

English: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
Kiswahili: Aliwaongoza wana wa Israeli kutoka Misri, baada ya kufanya ishara na maajabu mengi huko Misri, katika Bahari ya Shamu, na katika jangwa kwa muda wa miaka arobaini.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nere obarusetie korwa aroro magega gakorire amakumia na ebikone ase ense ya Misiri, na ase Enyancha Embariri, naende ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.

English: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’
Kiswahili: “Huyu ndiye yule Mose aliyewaambia Waisraeli, ‘Mungu atawainulia nabii kama mimi kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zenu wenyewe.’
Ekegusii: Musa oyio nere oteebetie Abaisraeli ng’a: Nyasae nabaimokerie omobani onga buna inche korwa ase egati y’abamino.

English: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye yule Mose aliyekuwa katika kusanyiko huko jangwani, ambaye malaika alisema naye pamoja na baba zetu kwenye Mlima Sinai, naye akapokea maneno yaliyo hai ili atupatie.
Ekegusii: Naende nere orenge ase baria basangererekanete ase erooro amo nomomalaika oyokwanete nere ase egetunwa gia Sinai, naende amo ne chisokoro chiaito; nere oetwe amang’ana ’obogima atoe.

English: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
Kiswahili: “Lakini baba zetu walikataa kumtii Mose, badala yake wakamkataa na kuielekeza mioyo yao Misri tena.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio chisokoro chiaito chikaanga koimoigwera, chikamosukeria are. Na ase ebirengererio biabo bakairana Misiri,

English: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia Aroni, ‘Tufanyie miungu watakaotuongoza, kwa maana mtu huyu Mose aliyetutoa nchi ya Misri, hatujui yaliyompata.’
Ekegusii: bagateebia Aroni: Tokorere chinyasae echiranyare gototang’ana. Titomanyeti eriamonyorire Musa, oyotorusetie ase ense ya Misiri.

English: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
Kiswahili: Huu ni ule wakati walitengeneza sanamu katika umbo la ndama, wakailetea sadaka kufanya maadhimisho kwa ajili ya kile kitu walichokitengeneza kwa mikono yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria bagakora omogwekano bw’emori, bakarenta ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano oria basasiimete, bakagokera emeremo y’amaboko abo.

English: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
Kiswahili: Ndipo Mungu akageuka, akawaacha waabudu jeshi lote la mbinguni, kama ilivyoandikwa katika Kitabu cha Manabii: “ ‘Je, mliniletea dhabihu na sadaka kwa miaka arobaini kule jangwani, ee nyumba ya Israeli?
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akeonchora korwa ase bare, akabatiga basasiime erioba na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni chia igoro, buna ariikire ase egetabu y’ababani: Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, eyio mwarenge ase erooro, mwandeterete ebing’wanso amo nokoruegwa konde?

English: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
Kiswahili: La, ninyi mliinua madhabahu ya Moleki, na nyota ya mungu wenu Refani, vinyago mlivyotengeneza ili kuviabudu. Kwa hiyo nitawapeleka mbali’ kuliko Babeli.
Ekegusii: Yaya, nigo mwabogoretie Moleki, enyasae yaino, na eng’enang’eni y’enyasae Refani, emegwekano eyio mwakorete, erinde moyesasime. Ase ayio nimbang’anyie goika ng’umbu ya Babiloni.

English: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;
Kiswahili: “Baba zetu walikuwa na lile Hema la Ushuhuda huko jangwani. Lilikuwa limetengenezwa kama Mungu alivyokuwa amemwelekeza Mose, kulingana na kielelezo alichoona.
Ekegusii: Eema y’oborori nigo yarenge amo ne chisokoro chiaito ase erooro, buna Nyasae achigete, ekero atebeetie Musa ng’a ayekore buna ekiorokererio keria aroche.

English: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,
Kiswahili: Baba zetu wakiisha kulipokea hema kwa kupokezana wakiongozwa na Yoshua katika milki ya nchi kutoka kwa yale mataifa ambayo Mungu aliyafukuza mbele yao, nalo likadumu katika nchi mpaka wakati wa Daudi,
Ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nchiayenyorete buna omwando, chikayesoyia amo na Yoshua, ekero bairete ense y’ebisaku biria Nyasae aseretie korwa ase obosio bwe chisokoro chiaito. Nigo babete nero goika amatuko a Daudi,

English: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
Kiswahili: ambaye alipata kibali kwa Mungu, naye akaomba kwamba ampatie Mungu wa Yakobo maskani.
Ekegusii: oyio onyorete ogwancherwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae, agasaba ng’a anyorere Nyasae o Yakobo obomenyo.

English: But Solomon built him a house.
Kiswahili: Lakini alikuwa Solomoni ndiye alimjengea Mungu nyumba.
Ekegusii: Korende Sulemani nere omoagacherete enyomba.

English: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
Kiswahili: “Hata hivyo, Yeye Aliye Juu Sana hakai kwenye nyumba zilizojengwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu. Kama nabii alivyosema:
Ekegusii: Korende Ere Oyore Igoro Mono tari komenya ase chinyomba chiagachire namaboko, buna omobani agoteeba:

English: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
Kiswahili: “ ‘Mbingu ni kiti changu cha enzi, nayo dunia ni mahali pa kuweka miguu yangu. Mtanijengea nyumba ya namna gani? asema Bwana. Au mahali pangu pa kupumzikia patakuwa wapi?
Ekegusii: Igoro nekerogo kiane ki’obonene, na ense negeteni kiane ki’amagoro. Omonene oteebire: Inyomba ki moranyaare kong’agachera? Gose ng’ai aase are ndanyaare gotimokera?

English: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
Kiswahili: Je, mkono wangu haukufanya vitu hivi vyote?’
Ekegusii: Inee! Tari okoboko kwane gwakorete ebinto ebi bionsi?

English: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
Kiswahili: “Enyi watu wenye shingo ngumu, msiotahiriwa mioyo wala masikio, daima hamwachi kumpinga Roho Mtakatifu, kama walivyofanya baba zenu.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abamore nebigoti ebikong’u, motarogeti ase chinkoro, nonya namato, motaonchogeti; botambe nigo mokoamereria Omoika Omochenu. Buna chisokoro chiaino chiarenge gokora, nainwe nabo mogokora.

English: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
Kiswahili: Je, kuna nabii gani ambaye baba zenu hawakumtesa? Waliwaua wale waliotabiri habari za kuja kwake yule Mwenye Haki. Nanyi sasa mmekuwa wasaliti wake na wauaji.
Ekegusii: Ning’o ase ababani chisokoro chiaino chitachandete? Na barabwo mbaitete baria babanete amang’ana igoro y’ogocha kw’oria Omonyene Oboronge. Inwe bono mwabeire abamorua na abamoiti.

English: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
Kiswahili: Ninyi ndio mlipokea sheria zilizoletwa kwenu na malaika, lakini hamkuzitii.”
Ekegusii: Inwe abamwanyorete amachiiko ayarentetwe nabamalaika, korende timwayabwata.”

English: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia haya wakaghadhibika, wakamsagia meno.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bakagechigwa ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakamoromananeria amaino.

English: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye Stefano, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, alikaza macho mbinguni, akaona utukufu wa Mungu, na Yesu akiwa amesimama mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende ere oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akarigereria mono gochia igoro, akarora obonene bwa Nyasae, na Yeso oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.

English: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
Kiswahili: Akasema, “Tazameni! Naona mbingu zimefunguka, na Mwana wa Adamu amesimama upande wa kuume wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Agateeba: “Rora, narorire igoro amaanokire, na Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.”

English: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.
Kiswahili: Lakini wao wakapiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa, wakaziba masikio yao, wakamrukia kwa nia moja.
Ekegusii: Korende bagaaka egeturi ase eriogi rinene, bagakuneka amato abo, bakamorindokera bonsi amo,

English: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
Kiswahili: Wakamtupa nje ya mji, wakampiga kwa mawe. Nao mashahidi wakaweka mavazi yao miguuni mwa kijana mmoja ambaye jina lake aliitwa Sauli.
Ekegusii: bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoaka amagena. Na kirori bakabeeka chianga chiabo ase amagoro ’omomura oyomo, ore korokwa Saulo.

English: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakimpiga mawe, Stefano aliomba, “Bwana Yesu, pokea roho yangu.”
Ekegusii: Bagaaka Stefano amagena ekero arenge gosaba, ogoteeba: “Omonene Yeso, ira omoika one.”

English: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
Kiswahili: Kisha akapiga magoti, akalia kwa sauti kubwa akasema, “Bwana usiwahesabie dhambi hii.” Baada ya kusema hayo, akalala.
Ekegusii: Akabeeka amaru inse, akarera ase eriogi rinene: “Omonene, tobabare ebibe ebi!” Ochia gokoora gokwana aya, agakwa. Na Saulo nigo aroche buya ase ogoitwa kwaye.

English: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.
Kiswahili: Naye Sauli alikuwepo pale, akiridhia kuuawa kwa Stefano. Siku ile kukatukia mateso makuu dhidi ya kanisa huko Yerusalemu, waumini wote isipokuwa mitume wakatawanyika, wakakimbilia Uyahudi na Samaria.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko riria emechando emenene egaacha igoro ase ekanisa ya Yerusalemu; bonsi bagaserebanigwa gochia chinse chia Boyahudi na Samaria, otatiga abatomwa bataserebaanetigwe.

English: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.
Kiswahili: Watu wacha Mungu wakamzika Stefano na kumwombolezea sana.
Ekegusii: Abanto abeegeni bagatindeka Stefano, bakamoreera okorera okonene.

English: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa habari ya Sauli alikuwa analiharibu kanisa, akiingia nyumba kwa nyumba, akiwaburuta wanawake na wanaume na kuwatupa gerezani.
Ekegusii: Korende Saulo agasaria ekanisa, agasoa kera enyomba akaba ogokurura abasacha na abakungu, na kobaira ase echela.

English: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wale waliotawanyika wakalihubiri neno la Mungu kila mahali walipokwenda.
Ekegusii: Na baria baserebaanetigwe bakagenda chinsemo ne chinsemo, bakarandia ring’ana ria Nyasae.

English: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.
Kiswahili: Filipo akateremkia mji mmoja wa Samaria akawahubiria habari za Kristo
Ekegusii: Filipo agatirimboka, agasoa omochie o Samaria, akabaranderia Kristo.

English: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
Kiswahili: Watu walipomsikia Filipo na kuona ishara na miujiza aliyofanya, wakasikiliza kwa bidii yale aliyosema.
Ekegusii: Emeganda yonsi ase omoyo oyomo bagategerera amang’ana onsi Filipo are gokwana, ekero bamoigwete na korora ebikone ebiarenge gokora.

English: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.
Kiswahili: Pepo wachafu wakawa wakiwatoka watu wengi huku wakipiga kelele na wengi waliopooza na viwete wakaponywa.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera abange babwatire nebirecha bi’eubi, na ebirecha ebi bikarwa ase bare, bikarera ase egeturi ekenene; abanto abarenge amagata, na baria barenge ebirema bakagwenigwa.

English: There was great joy in that city.
Kiswahili: Hivyo pakawa na furaha kuu katika mji huo.
Ekegusii: Ase igo omogooko omonene okaba ase omochie oria.

English: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
Kiswahili: Basi mtu mmoja jina lake Simoni alikuwa amefanya uchawi kwa muda mrefu katika mji huo akiwashangaza watu wote wa Samaria. Alijitapa kwamba yeye ni mtu mkuu,
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ore korokwa Simioni, agwo ritang’ani nigo arenge gokora oborogi ase omochie oria; abanto ba Samaria bakamokumia, ekero are goteeba ng’a ere omonyene nomonto omonene.

English: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”
Kiswahili: nao watu wote wakubwa kwa wadogo wakamsikiliza na kumaka, wakisema “Mtu huyu ndiye uweza wa Mungu ujulikanao kama ‘Uweza Mkuu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Bonsi, abake na abanene, bakamotegerera, bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nigo are okobua koria kwa Nyasae gokorokwa Okobua Okonene.”

English: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
Kiswahili: Wakamfuata kwa sababu kwa muda mrefu alikuwa amewashangaza kwa uchawi wake.
Ekegusii: Bakamotegerera, ekiagera ase amatuko amange nigo barenge gokumia ase oborogi bwaye.

English: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu walipomwamini Filipo alipohubiri habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu na jina la Yesu Kristo, wakabatizwa wanaume na wanawake.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero bachia kwegena Filipo, gakorandia amang’ana amaya igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae na erieta ria Yeso Kristo, bakabatiswa, abasacha na abakungu.

English: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
Kiswahili: Simoni naye akaamini na akabatizwa. Akamfuata Filipo kila mahali, akistaajabishwa na ishara kuu na miujiza aliyoiona.
Ekegusii: Nonya n’Simioni omonyene akeegena, na magega kabatisirwe akagenderera koba amo na Filipo. Ekero aroche ebikone na ogokora okonene gwe chinguru biakoretwe, agakumia.

English: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
Kiswahili: Basi mitume waliokuwa Yerusalemu waliposikia kuwa Samaria wamelipokea neno la Mungu, wakawatuma Petro na Yohana waende huko.
Ekegusii: Na ekero abatomwa ba Yerusalemu bachia koigwa ng’a Abasamaria banchire ring’ana ria Nyasae, bakabatomera Petero na Yohana.

English: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;
Kiswahili: Nao walipofika wakawaombea ili wampokee Roho Mtakatifu,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagatirimboka, bakabasabera, erinde banyore Omoika Omochenu,

English: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa bado hajawashukia hata mmoja ila wamebatizwa tu katika jina la Bwana Yesu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera konya torabaikera nonya noyomo obo. Barabwo nigo baabatisetwe rioka ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.

English: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro na Yohana wakaweka mikono yao juu ya wale waliobatizwa, nao wakapokea Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Erio Petero na Yohana bakababeekera amaboko abo, na barabwo bakanyora Omoika Omochenu.

English: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
Kiswahili: Simoni alipoona kuwa watu wanapokea Roho Mtakatifu mitume walipoweka mikono juu yao, akataka kuwapa fedha
Ekegusii: Ekero Simioni achia korora ng’a abanto nigo bakoegwa Omoika ase okobeekerwa amaboko nabatomwa, akabarentera chitaabu,

English: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
Kiswahili: akisema, “Nipeni na mimi uwezo huu ili kila mtu nitakayeweka mikono yangu juu yake apate kupokea Roho Mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: agateeba: “Ing’a nainche okobua oko, ng’a kera omonto ndabeekere amaboko aane anyore Omoika Omochenu.”

English: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!
Kiswahili: Petro akamjibu, “Fedha yako na iangamie pamoja nawe, kwa sababu ulidhani unaweza kununua karama ya Mungu kwa fedha!
Ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoteebia: “Chifeta chiao chisire amo naye, ekiagera okagete ng’a nonyore ekeegwa kia Nyasae ase chitaabu!

English: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.
Kiswahili: Wewe huna sehemu wala fungu katika huduma hii kwa kuwa moyo wako si mnyofu mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Tori negetari gose nensemo ase ring’ana eri, ekiagera enkoro yao teri boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tubu kwa uovu huu wako na umwombe Bwana. Yamkini aweza kukusamehe mawazo uliyo nayo moyoni mwako.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio onchoka korwa ase obobe bwao obo, osabe Omonene, erinde, keranyarekane, bwaberwe ebirengererio bi’enkoro yao.

English: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninaona kwamba wewe umejawa na uchungu na ni mfungwa wa dhambi.”
Ekegusii: Naki nakororire ng’a nore nobororo buna endorwe, naende nigo ore ase egesibo ki’ebibe.”

English: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Simoni akajibu, “Niombeeni kwa Bwana, ili hayo mliyosema lolote yasinitukie.”
Ekegusii: Simioni akairaneria: “Insabera inwe ase Omonene, ng’a amang’ana aya mwakwanire tabaisa gocha konyora nonya nerimo riabo.”

English: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
Kiswahili: Nao walipokwisha kutoa ushuhuda na kuhubiri neno la Bwana, wakarudi Yerusalemu wakihubiri Injili katika vijiji vingi vya Samaria.
Ekegusii: Erio kabaorokirie oborori na korandia ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakorandia amang’ana amaya ase ebichie ebinge bi’Abasamaria.

English: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”
Kiswahili: Basi malaika wa Bwana akamwambia Filipo, “Nenda upande wa kusini kwenye ile barabara itokayo Yerusalemu kuelekea Gaza ambayo ni jangwa.”
Ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene agateebia Filipo: “Imoka ogende ensemo ya Irianyi goika enchera eria egotirimboka korwa Yerusalemu ekogenda Gasa.” Eye nenchera y’erooro.

English: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akaondoka. Akiwa njiani akakutana na towashi wa Kushi, aliyekuwa afisa mkuu, mwenye mamlaka juu ya hazina zote za Kandake, Malkia wa Kushi. Huyu towashi alikuwa amekwenda Yerusalemu ili kuabudu,
Ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda. Na rora, ekero are inchera, akarora omonto bw’Ethiopia, omokoreri, oyobegetwe igoro y’enibo yonsi ya Kandake, enting’ana ya Ethiopia. Ere nigo agendete Yerusalemu gosasiima.

English: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
Kiswahili: naye akiwa njiani kurudi nyumbani alikuwa ameketi garini mwake akisoma kitabu cha nabii Isaya.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge koirana na oikaransete ase egari yaye, nigo arenge gosoma egetabu y’omobani Isaya.

English: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”
Kiswahili: Roho Mtakatifu akamwambia Filipo, “Nenda kwenye lile gari ukae karibu nalo.”
Ekegusii: Erio Omoika ogateebia Filipo: “Genda ang’e negari eyio, ogende nero.”

English: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Filipo akakimbilia lile gari na kumsikia yule mtu anasoma kitabu cha nabii Isaya. Filipo akamuuliza, “Je, unaelewa hayo usomayo?”
Ekegusii: Filipo akaminyoka gochia asare, akamoigwa ogosoma egetabu y’omobani Isaya, akamobooria: “Inee! Kwamanyire buya aya ogosoma?”

English: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.
Kiswahili: Yule towashi akasema, “Nitawezaje kuelewa mtu asiponifafanulia?” Hivyo akamkaribisha Filipo ili apande na kuketi pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Naki ndanyare komanya otatiga omonto antang’ane?” Agateebia Filipo ariine, aikaranse amo nere.

English: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.
Kiswahili: Huyu towashi alikuwa anasoma fungu hili la Maandiko: “Aliongozwa kama kondoo aendaye machinjoni, kama mwana-kondoo anyamazavyo mbele yake yule amkataye manyoya, hivyo hakufungua kinywa chake.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana e ririiko ayarenge gosoma naro aya: “Akairwa buna eng’ondi egochia konyenywa, na buna emanwa etari kwana ase omonachi bw’amarionya, naboigo tamaanorete omonwa oye.

English: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
Kiswahili: Katika kufedheheshwa kwake alinyimwa haki yake. Nani awezaye kueleza juu ya kizazi chake? Kwa maana maisha yake yaliondolewa kutoka duniani.”
Ekegusii: Ase ogwekeyia kwaye ekiina kiaye gekarusigwa. Ning’o oranyare gototeebia ororeria rwaye? Ekiagera obogima bwaye bwarusigwe ase ense.”

English: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”
Kiswahili: Yule towashi akamuuliza Filipo, “Tafadhali niambie, nabii huyu anena habari zake mwenyewe au habari za mtu mwingine?”
Ekegusii: Omogomba oria akaboria Filipo: “Koranche onteebie igoro ya ng’o omobani oyo agokwana, igoro yaye omonyene gose igoro y’omonto onde?”

English: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Filipo akaanza kutumia fungu lile la Maandiko, akamweleza habari njema za Yesu.
Ekegusii: Filipo agachaaka gokwana; agachakera korwa ase ririiko eri, akamoranderia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso.

English: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakiendelea na safari wakafika mahali palipokuwa na maji, yule towashi akamuuliza Filipo, “Tazama, hapa kuna maji. Kitu gani kitanizuia nisibatizwe?”
Ekegusii: Ekero bagendererete inchera, bagaika aase amaache arenge. Oria omogomba akabora: “Rora amaache aya! Inki kegontanga timbatiswa?”

English: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
Kiswahili: Filipo akamwambia, “Kama ukiamini kwa moyo wako wote unaweza kubatizwa.” Akajibu, “Naamini kuwa Yesu Kristo ni Mwana wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Filipo akamoteebia: “Koregene nenkoro yao yonsi, nenyarekane.” Akairaneria: “Negenire ng’a Yeso Kristo nere Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
Kiswahili: Naye akaamuru lile gari lisimamishwe. Wakateremka kwenye maji wote wawili, yule towashi na Filipo, naye Filipo akambatiza.
Ekegusii: Agachiika egari eria etenene, na bonsi babere, Filipo na oria omogomba, bagatirimboka gochia ase amaache ime, erio Filipo akamobatisa.

English: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.
Kiswahili: Nao walipopanda kutoka kwenye maji, ghafula Roho wa Bwana akamnyakua Filipo, naye towashi hakumwona tena, lakini akaenda zake akifurahi.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia korwa ase amaache, Omoika bw’Omonene ogataboria Filipo; omogomba oria tamorora naende, korende nigo agendete enchera yaye ore nomogooko.

English: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, Sauli alikuwa bado anazidisha vitisho vya kuua wanafunzi wa Bwana, akamwendea kuhani mkuu,
Ekegusii: Korende ase chingaki echio Saulo akamenta kobagosa na korengereria goita aborokigwa bw’Omonene. Akagenda ase Omokuani omonene,

English: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: naye akamwomba kuhani mkuu ampe barua za kwenda kwenye masinagogi huko Dameski, ili akimkuta mtu yeyote wa Njia Ile, akiwa mwanaume au mwanamke, aweze kuwafunga na kuwaleta Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: akamobooria amoe amarube ariikire ase chisinagogi chia Damesiki, erinde onye okonyora abanto b’Enchera eye, abasacha gose abakungu, abasibe na kobarenta Yerusalemu.

English: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
Kiswahili: Basi akiwa katika safari yake, alipokaribia Dameski, ghafula nuru kutoka mbinguni ikamwangaza kotekote.
Ekegusii: Ekero arenge kogenda, gaikire ang’e na Damesiki, erio mobasokano amasase akarwa igoro, akamomesera korwa chinsemo chionsi.

English: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
Kiswahili: Akaanguka chini, akasikia sauti ikimwambia, “Sauli, Sauli, mbona unanitesa?”
Ekegusii: Akagwa inse, akaigwa eriogi rikomoteebia: “Saulo, Saulo, nase ki ogonchanda iga?”

English: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
Kiswahili: Sauli akajibu, “U nani wewe, Bwana?” Ile sauti ikajibu, “Mimi ni Yesu unayemtesa.
Ekegusii: Akamoboria: “Naye ng’o Omonene?” Akairaneria: “Ninche Yeso, oyo gwachandire aye,

English: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”
Kiswahili: Sasa inuka uingie mjini, nawe utaambiwa yakupasayo kutenda.”
Ekegusii: korende imoka osoe omochie, noteebigwe ayarakogwenere okore.”

English: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
Kiswahili: Watu waliokuwa wakisafiri pamoja na Sauli wakasimama bila kuwa na la kusema, kwa sababu walisikia sauti lakini hawakumwona aliyekuwa akizungumza.
Ekegusii: Abanto abagendete amo nere bagatenena, bagakira‐kiri; bakaigwa eriogi, korende tibarora monto.

English: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
Kiswahili: Sauli akainuka kutoka pale chini na alipojaribu kufungua macho yake hakuweza kuona kitu chochote. Basi wakamshika mkono wakamwongoza mpaka Dameski.
Ekegusii: Saulo akaimoka korwa inse, korende ekero achia koramokia amaiso aye tarora gento. Bakamobwata okoboko, bakamoira Damesiki.

English: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
Kiswahili: Naye kwa muda wa siku tatu alikuwa kipofu naye hakula wala kunywa chochote.
Ekegusii: Akaba omouko amatuko atato, atari koria, nonya nkonywa.

English: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
Kiswahili: Huko Dameski alikuwepo mwanafunzi mmoja jina lake Anania. Bwana alimwita katika maono, “Anania!” Akajibu, “Mimi hapa Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ase Damesiki narengeo omworokigwa ore korokwa Anania. Omonene akamoteebia ase chindoto: “Anania!” Ere akairaneria: “Omonene nao inde aiga.”

English: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
Kiswahili: Bwana akamwambia, “Ondoka uende katika barabara iitwayo Nyofu ukaulize katika nyumba ya Yuda mtu kutoka Tarso, jina lake Sauli, kwa maana wakati huu anaomba,
Ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Imoka ogende enchera eria Endonge, origie ime ase enyomba ya Yudasi omonto okorokwa Saulo o Tariso; rora, nao are agosaba.

English: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
Kiswahili: katika maono amemwona mtu aitwaye Anania akija na kuweka mikono juu yake ili apate kuona tena.”
Ekegusii: Na ere ase okorora ororire omonto okorokwa Anania ogosoa, okomobekera amaboko, anyare korora.”

English: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Anania akajibu, “Bwana, nimesikia kutoka kwa watu wengi habari nyingi kuhusu mtu huyu na madhara yote aliyowatendea watakatifu wako huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Korende Anania akairaneria: “Omonene, naigure korwa ase abanto abange igoro y’omonto oyo, buna akoreire abachenu bao Yerusalemu amabe amange.

English: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
Kiswahili: Naye amekuja hapa Dameski akiwa na mamlaka kutoka kwa viongozi wa makuhani ili awakamate wote wanaotaja jina lako.”
Ekegusii: Aiga nigo are nokobua korwa ase abakuani abanene asibe abanto bonsi baria bakorangeria erieta riao.”

English: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Anania, “Nenda! Mtu huyu ni chombo changu kiteule nilichokichagua, apate kulichukua Jina langu kwa watu wa Mataifa na wafalme wao na mbele ya watu wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoteebia: “Genda aye rioka, ekiagera oyio nomokoreri one omochore, aire erieta riane gochia ase abanto b’Ebisaku, na ase abarwoti, na ase Abaisraeli.

English: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
Kiswahili: Nami nitamwonyesha jinsi impasavyo kuteseka kwa ajili ya Jina langu.”
Ekegusii: Inche nimworokie onsi ayaramogwenere gochandwa ase engencho y’erieta riane.”

English: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
Kiswahili: Kisha Anania akaenda kwenye ile nyumba, akaingia ndani. Akaweka mikono yake juu ya Sauli akasema, “Ndugu Sauli, Bwana Yesu aliyekutokea njiani amenituma kwako ili upate kuona tena na ujazwe Roho Mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Anania akagenda, agasoa nyomba ime. Akamobekera amaboko aye, akabora: “Oyominto Saulo, Omonene Yeso, ere oyokoorokerete ase enchera kware gochera, ontomire, erinde onyare korora naende, na oichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu.”

English: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
Kiswahili: Ghafula vitu kama magamba vikaanguka chini, kutoka machoni mwa Sauli, akapata kuona tena. Akasimama, akabatizwa.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima ebinto buna amasabo bikagwa korwa ase amaiso aye, akanyora okorora, agatenena, akabatiswa,

English: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kula chakula, akapata nguvu tena. Sauli akakaa siku kadhaa pamoja na wanafunzi huko Dameski.
Ekegusii: akaragera, akanyora chinguru. Akaba agwo amatuko atari make amo naborokigwa abarenge Damesiki.

English: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
Kiswahili: Papo hapo akaanza kuhubiri kwenye masinagogi kwamba “Yesu Kristo ni Mwana wa Mungu”
Ekegusii: Erio agwo kegima akamorandia Yeso ase chisinagogi, okobora: “Ere n’Omwana o Nyasae.”

English: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”
Kiswahili: Watu wote waliomsikia Sauli walishangaa na kuuliza, “Huyu si yule mtu aliyesababisha maangamizi makuu huko Yerusalemu miongoni mwa watu waliolitaja jina hili? Naye si amekuja hapa kwa kusudi la kuwakamata na kuwapeleka wakiwa wafungwa mbele ya viongozi wa makuhani?”
Ekegusii: Na bonsi abamoigwete bagakumia, bagateeba: “Tari ere oyo orenge Yerusalemu goteema goita abare korangeria erieta eri? Naende aiga, erinde abasibe, abaire ase abakuani abanene?”

English: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
Kiswahili: Sauli akazidi kuwa hodari na kuwashangaza Wayahudi walioishi Dameski kwa kuthibitisha kuwa Yesu ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende Saulo akagenderera komenteka koba ne chinguru, agatantania Abayahudi abamenyete Damesiki, ase okoorokia ekeene ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.

English: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku nyingi kupita, Wayahudi wakafanya shauri kumuua Sauli.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko amange aetire, Abayahudi bakamogamba, erinde banyare komoita,

English: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
Kiswahili: Lakini shauri lao likajulikana kwa Sauli. Wayahudi wakawa wanalinda malango yote ya mji, usiku na mchana ili wapate kumuua.
Ekegusii: korende okogamba kwabo gokamanyekana na Saulo. Bakamoboera ase ebiita omobaso na obotuko, erinde banyare komoita.

English: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
Kiswahili: Lakini wafuasi wake wakamchukua usiku wakamshusha akiwa ndani ya kapu kupitia mahali penye nafasi ukutani.
Ekegusii: Korende aborokigwa baye bakamoira botuko na komoikeria ase orwaki, ore egetonga ime.

English: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
Kiswahili: Sauli alipofika Yerusalemu akajaribu kujiunga na wanafunzi lakini wote walimwogopa, kwa maana hawakuamini kwamba kweli naye alikuwa mwanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia goika Yerusalemu agateema kobwatana naborokigwa; na barabwo bonsi bakamoiroka, ekiagera tibanchete ng’a ere nomworokigwa arenge.

English: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
Kiswahili: Lakini Barnaba akamchukua, akampeleka kwa wale mitume. Akawaeleza jinsi Sauli akiwa njiani alivyomwona Bwana, jinsi Bwana alivyosema naye na jinsi alivyohubiri kwa ujasiri kwa jina la Yesu huko Dameski.
Ekegusii: Korende Barnaba akamobwata okoboko, akamoira ase abatomwa, akabateebereria buna Saulo aroche Omonene nchera, naende ng’a Omonene nakwanete nere, na buna arandetie noboremu ase Damesiki ase erieta ria Yeso.

English: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Sauli akakaa nao akitembea kwa uhuru kila mahali huko Yerusalemu, akihubiri kwa ujasiri katika jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Saulo akaba amo nabarabwo ase Yerusalemu, agasoa na gosoka,

English: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
Kiswahili: Alinena na kuhojiana na Wayahudi wenye asili ya Kiyunani lakini wao walijaribu kumuua.
Ekegusii: akarandia noboremu ase erieta ri’Omonene. Agakwana na koamererania n’Abayahudi abarenge gokwana Ekegiriki, korende barabwo bakarigia komoita.

English: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
Kiswahili: Wale ndugu walipopata habari wakampeleka hadi Kaisaria, wakamsafirisha kwenda Tarso.
Ekegusii: Ekero abamwabo bachia konyora amang’ana aya, bakamoira goika Kaisaria, bakamotoma agende Tariso.

English: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Ndipo kanisa katika Uyahudi wote, Galilaya na Samaria likafurahia wakati wa amani. Likatiwa nguvu, na kwa faraja ya Roho Mtakatifu, idadi yake ikazidi kuongezeka, na likaendelea kudumu katika kumcha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Erio ekanisa ekanyora omorembe ase chinsemo chionsi chia Boyahudi, na Galili, na Samaria. Ekagenderera koagachwa ase okoiroka kw’Omonene, na ase okoremia kw’Omoika Omochenu ekamentekana.

English: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
Kiswahili: Petro alipokuwa akisafiri sehemu mbalimbali, alikwenda kuwatembelea watakatifu walioishi huko Lida.
Ekegusii: Ekero Petero are goetanana ase chinsemo chionsi, agatirimboka gochia ase abachenu abamenyete Lida.

English: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.
Kiswahili: Huko alimkuta mtu mmoja aitwaye Ainea, ambaye alikuwa amepooza na kwa muda wa miaka minane alikuwa hajaondoka kitandani.
Ekegusii: Akanyora omonto oyomo aroro ore korokwa Ainea. Omonto oyio konya obeire ekeoru borere ase engaki y’emiaka etano na etato, are rigata.

English: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
Kiswahili: Petro akamwambia, “Ainea, Yesu Kristo anakuponya, inuka utandike kitanda chako.” Mara Ainea akainuka.
Ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia: “Ainea, Yeso Kristo okogwenirie; imoka bware oborere bwao!” Erio kegima akaimoka.

English: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Watu wote wa Lida na Sharoni walipomwona Ainea akitembea wakamgeukia Bwana.
Ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi abamenyete Lida na Saroni bakamorora, bakaonchokera Omonene.

English: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
Kiswahili: Huko Yafa palikuwa na mwanafunzi jina lake Tabitha (ambalo kwa Kiyunani ni Dorkasi). Huyu alikuwa mkarimu sana, akitenda mema na kuwasaidia maskini.
Ekegusii: Ase Yopa narengeo omworokigwa oyomo ore korokwa Tabitha, engencho yaye Dorika, gose Engabi. Omokungu oyio nigo arenge oichire nogokora okuya na ebiegwa ebi arenge korua.

English: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo akaugua, akafa na wakiisha kuuosha mwili wake wakauweka katika chumba cha ghorofani.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria akarwara, agakwa. Ekero bamosibirie bakamobeka akanyomba ka irongo.

English: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Yafa hapakuwa mbali sana na Lida, wanafunzi waliposikia kwamba Petro yuko huko waliwatuma watu wawili kwake ili kumwomba, “Tafadhali njoo huku pasipo kukawia.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Lida nigo orenge ang’e na Yopa, na aborokigwa konya baigure ng’a Petero nao are aria, bagatoma abanto babere asare komosorora na komoteebia: “Koranche, totebana gocha ase tore.”

English: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Petro akainuka akaenda nao, naye alipowasili, wakampeleka hadi kwenye chumba cha ghorofani alipokuwa amelazwa. Wajane wengi walisimama karibu naye wakilia na kuonyesha majoho na nguo nyingine ambazo Dorkasi alikuwa amewashonea alipokuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Petero akaimoka, akagenda amo nabarabwo. Ekero aikire aroro, bakamoira akanyomba ka irongo. Ababoraka bonsi bagatenena ang’e nere bakorera, na komworokia chiganchwa ne chianga echi Dorika arenge koroisia ekero arenge amo nabarabwo.

English: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
Kiswahili: Petro akawatoa wote nje ya kile chumba, kisha akapiga magoti akaomba, akaugeukia ule mwili akasema, “Tabitha, inuka.” Akafumbua macho yake na alipomwona Petro, akaketi.
Ekegusii: Petero akabasokia bonsi isiko, agatung’ama, agasaba. Akeonchora gochia ase egetondo, agateeba: “Tabitha, imoka!” Na ere akaramokia amaiso aye; ekero arora Petero, akaboka, agaikaransa.

English: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
Kiswahili: Petro akamshika mkono akamwinua, ndipo akawaita wale watakatifu na wajane akamkabidhi kwao akiwa hai.
Ekegusii: Petero akamoa okoboko kwaye, akamoimokia. Erio akarangeria abachenu baria na ababoraka, akamorenta ase bare ore moyo.

English: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Habari hizi zikajulikana sehemu zote za Yafa na watu wengi wakamwamini Bwana.
Ekegusii: Aya akamanyekana ase Yopa, ase omochie omogima, na abanto abange bakamwege n’Omonene.

English: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
Kiswahili: Petro akakaa Yafa kwa siku nyingi akiishi na Simoni mtengenezaji ngozi.
Ekegusii: Petero akamenya Yopa amatuko atai make ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo ore korokwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao.

English: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
Kiswahili: Katika mji wa Kaisaria palikuwa na mtu jina lake Kornelio, ambaye alikuwa jemadari wa kile kilichojulikana kama kikosi cha Kiitalia.
Ekegusii: Ase Kaisaria narengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Kornelio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana bw’ekeombe ekemo ki’abarwani kiare korokwa Abaitalia.

English: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
Kiswahili: Yeye alikuwa mcha Mungu pamoja na wote wa nyumbani mwake. Aliwapa watu sadaka nyingi na kumwomba Mungu daima.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omonto omuya, nere amo n’abanto b’enyomba yaye bonsi nigo bamoirogete Nyasae. Nigo are koa abanto ebiegwa ebinge n’omoyo oyomo na kogenderera gosaba Nyasae botambe.

English: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
Kiswahili: Siku moja alasiri, yapata saa tisa, aliona maono waziwazi, malaika wa Mungu akimjia na kumwambia, “Kornelio!”
Ekegusii: Ang’e chinsa kianda iga chia mobaso akaba buna oy’okorota erio akarora omomalaika O Nyasae okomoochera, akamoteebia: “Kornelio!”

English: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.
Kiswahili: Kornelio akamkazia macho kwa hofu akasema, “Kuna nini, Bwana?” Malaika akamwambia, “Sala zako na sadaka zako kwa maskini zimefika juu na kuwa ukumbusho mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Akamorigereria mono, akairoka, akamobooria: “Naki Omonene?” Akamoiraneria: “Ogosaba kwao na ebiegwa biao biaikire igoro, na biabeire ekeinyorio ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.
Kiswahili: Sasa tuma watu waende Yafa wakamwite mtu mmoja jina lake Simoni aitwaye Petro.
Ekegusii: Gaki, bono toma abanto Yopa barangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero.

English: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
Kiswahili: Yeye anaishi na Simoni mtengenezaji ngozi ambaye nyumba yake iko kando ya bahari.”
Ekegusii: Ere nomogeni bw’omonto oyomo okorokwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao; enyomba yaye nigo ere ang’e nengegu y’enyancha.”

English: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
Kiswahili: Yule malaika aliyekuwa akizungumza naye alipoondoka, Kornelio akawaita watumishi wake wawili pamoja na askari mmoja mcha Mungu aliyekuwa miongoni mwa wale waliomtumikia.
Ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika, oria okwanete nere, aimoka korwa aroro, Kornelio akarangeria abasomba baye babere na omorwani oyomo osigete Nyasae korwa ase baria bare komokorera botambe,

English: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia mambo yote yaliyotukia, kisha akawatuma waende Yafa.
Ekegusii: akabateebia amang’ana onsi, erio akabatoma Yopa.
