English: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
Kiswahili: Siku ya pili yake, walipokuwa wameukaribia mji, wakati wa adhuhuri, Petro alipanda juu ya nyumba kuomba.
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia, ekero baare kogenda, kobaikire ang’e nomochie, Petero akariina kerama igoro gochia gosaba koreng’ana chinsa isano nemo chia mobaso.

English: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa akiomba akahisi njaa, akatamani kupata chakula. Lakini wakati walikuwa wakiandaa chakula, akalala usingizi mzito sana.
Ekegusii: Akaba nenchara, akagania endagera arie. Korende ekero barenge koyeroisia, akabwatwa nobogondereria,

English: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
Kiswahili: Akaona mbingu zimefunguka na kitu kama nguo kubwa kikishushwa duniani kwa ncha zake nne.
Ekegusii: akarora igoro amaanokire, na egento kegoika, kere buna egetambaa ekenene, kebwatire emekoba ene, kegoikigwa gocha inse.

English: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
Kiswahili: Ndani yake walikuwepo aina zote za wanyama wenye miguu minne, nao watambaao nchini, na ndege wa angani.
Ekegusii: Ime yaye nigo biarengeo ebisaku bionsi bie ching’iti chire namagoro ane, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, na echikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro.

English: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
Kiswahili: Ndipo sauti ikamwambia “Petro, ondoka, uchinje na ule.”
Ekegusii: Eriogi rikamocheera, rikamoteebia: “Petero, imoka onyenye orie!”

English: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
Kiswahili: Petro akajibu, “La hasha Bwana! Sijawahi kamwe kula kitu chochote kilicho najisi.”
Ekegusii: Korende Petero akabora: “Yay’Omonene, ekiagera tinana koria nonya ng’ake egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi.”

English: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
Kiswahili: Ile sauti ikasema naye mara ya pili, “Usikiite najisi kitu chochote Mungu alichokitakasa.”
Ekegusii: Eriogi rikamochera eria kabere, rikamoteebia: “Eki Nyasae achenire tokeroka ng’a tikeri egechenu.”

English: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.
Kiswahili: Jambo hili lilitokea mara tatu na ghafula ile nguo ikarudishwa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Eri rigakoreka ara gatato, na egento keria gekabogorigwa gochia igoro naende.

English: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
Kiswahili: Wakati Petro akiwa bado anajiuliza kuhusu maana ya maono haya, wale watu waliokuwa wametumwa na Kornelio wakaipata nyumba ya Simoni mtengenezaji wa ngozi wakawa wamesimama mbele ya lango.
Ekegusii: Ekero Petero arenge ne chitang’u‐tang’u ase omoyo oye ime ase okorora okwo aroche, engencho yaye inki, rora, abanto baria batometwe na Kornelio, kobaboririe enyomba ya Simioni, bagatenena geita.

English: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.
Kiswahili: Wakabisha hodi na kuuliza kama Simoni aliyeitwa Petro alikuwa anaishi hapo.
Ekegusii: Bakarangeria neriogi bakabooria gose Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero, nao are ime.

English: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
Kiswahili: Wakati Petro akiwa anafikiria juu ya yale maono, Roho Mtakatifu akamwambia, “Simoni, wako watu watatu wanaokutafuta.
Ekegusii: Na Petero, karengereretie okorora koria, Omoika okamoteebia: “Rora, abanto batato bagokorigia.

English: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
Kiswahili: Inuka na ushuke, usisite kwenda nao kwa kuwa mimi nimewatuma.”
Ekegusii: Imoka, oike, ogende amo nabarabwo, toba ne chitang’u‐tang’u ekiagera ninche nabatoma.”

English: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
Kiswahili: Petro akashuka na kuwaambia wale watu waliokuwa wametumwa kutoka kwa Kornelio, “Mimi ndiye mnayenitafuta. Mmekuja kwa sababu gani?”
Ekegusii: Petero agaika ase abanto baria, agateeba: “Ninche ere oyo mokorigia. Igo mwacha ase engencho ki?”

English: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakamjibu, “Tumetumwa na Kornelio yule jemadari. Yeye ni mtu mwema anayemcha Mungu, na anaheshimiwa na Wayahudi wote. Yeye ameagizwa na malaika mtakatifu akukaribishe nyumbani kwake, ili asikilize maneno utakayomwambia.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Nigo twatomirwe na Kornelio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, omonto omooronge, omoirogete Nyasae, oyogokwanwa buya negesaku gionsi ki’Abayahudi. Nateebigwa n’omomalaika omochenu ng’a atome abanto ase ore gokorangeria ogende bwoye, anyare koigwa amang’ana korwa ase ore.”

English: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
Kiswahili: Basi Petro akawakaribisha wakafuatana naye ndani, akawapa pa kulala. Kesho yake akaondoka pamoja nao, na baadhi ya ndugu kutoka Yafa wakafuatana naye.
Ekegusii: Erio Petero akabateebia basoe nyomba, babe abageni baye. Rituko rikobwatia akaimoka akagenda amo nabarabwo, na abande bamwabo korwa Yopa bakagenda amo nere.

English: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata wakawasili Kaisaria. Kornelio alikuwa akiwangoja pamoja na jamaa yake na marafiki zake wa karibu.
Ekegusii: Rituko rigotunya erio bagasoa Kaisaria. Na Kornelio nigo arenge obaganyete, konya osangereirie eamate yaye amo nabanchi baye.

English: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
Kiswahili: Petro alipokuwa akiingia ndani, Kornelio alikuja kumlaki, akaanguka miguuni pake kwa heshima.
Ekegusii: Ekero Petero achia gosoa omochie, Kornelio agasoka komoorotota, akagwa inse ase amagoro aye, akamosasiima.

English: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro akamwinua akamwambia, “Simama, mimi ni mwanadamu tu.”
Ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoimokia, akamoteebia: “Tenena! Inche boigo Mwanyabaanto inde.”

English: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
Kiswahili: Petro alipokuwa akizungumza naye akaingia ndani na kukuta watu wengi wamekusanyika.
Ekegusii: Ekero are gokwana na Kornelio, agasoa ime, akanyora abanto abange basangererekaneteo.

English: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.
Kiswahili: Akawaambia, “Mnajua kabisa kwamba ni kinyume cha sheria yetu Myahudi kuchangamana na mtu wa Mataifa au kumtembelea. Lakini Mungu amenionyesha kwamba nisimwite mtu yeyote kuwa najisi au asiye safi.
Ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Mwamanyire ng’a tari boronge omonto Omoyahudi abwatane nomonto ore bw’egesaku ekeao, nonya nokomochiera, korende Nyasae onyorokirie ng’a timoroka onde bwensi ng’a tari omochenu, gose tachenegeti.

English: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu ulipotuma niitwe nilikuja bila kupinga lolote. Basi sasa naomba unieleze kwa nini umeniita?”
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ekero narangeretigwe ngacha, tinaanga. Nkoboria nde: Ing’ana ki mwandangereretie?”

English: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing
Kiswahili: Kornelio akajibu, “Siku nne zilizopita, nilikuwa nyumbani nikisali saa kama hii, saa tisa alasiri. Ghafula mtu aliyevaa nguo zilizongʼaa akasimama mbele yangu,
Ekegusii: Kornelio akamoiraneria: “Reero nerituko ria kane, korwa ekero narenge gosaba nyomba mwane chinsa buna echi, chinsa kianda. Ani! Omonto nateneine bosio bwane obekeire chianga chikomeka‐meka.

English: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
Kiswahili: akasema, ‘Kornelio, maombi yako yamesikiwa na sadaka zako kwa maskini zimekumbukwa mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Aganteebia: Kornelio, ogosaba kwao kwaigurwe, na ebiegwa biao biainyoirwe ase Nyasae.

English: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
Kiswahili: Basi tuma watu waende Yafa wakaulize mtu mmoja Simoni aitwaye Petro, yeye ni mgeni katika nyumba ya Simoni mtengenezaji ngozi, ambaye nyumba yake iko kando ya bahari.’
Ekegusii: Ase igo, toma abanto Yopa, orangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero; ere nomogeni are nyomba mwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao, nigo amenyete ang’e nengegu y’enyancha.

English: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
Kiswahili: Nilituma watu kwako mara moja, nawe umefanya vyema kuja. Basi sasa sisi sote tuko hapa mbele za Mungu kuyasikiliza yote ambayo Bwana amekuamuru kutuambia.”
Ekegusii: Erio bwango ngatoma abanto orangerigwe, na aye gwakorire buya gwachire. Na bono twensi nao tore aiga ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tonyare koigwa aya onsi Omonene agochikiire gokwana.”

English: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akafungua kinywa chake akasema, “Mungu hana upendeleo,
Ekegusii: Erio Petero agachaaka gokwana, akabora: “Ase ekeene naikire komanya ng’a Nyasae tari nogwanchereria,

English: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
Kiswahili: Lakini katika kila taifa, kila mtu amchaye na kutenda yaliyo haki hukubaliwa naye.
Ekegusii: korende ase kera egesaku omonto omoirogete na gokora oboronge nigo agwancherwa nere.

English: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnajua ule ujumbe uliotumwa kwa Israeli, ukitangaza habari njema za amani kwa Yesu Kristo. Yeye ni Bwana wa wote.
Ekegusii: Agatoma ring’ana eri ase Abaisraeli, akarandia amang’ana amaya ay’omorembe korwa ase Yeso Kristo, oyore Omonene o bonsi.

English: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
Kiswahili: Mnajua yale yaliyotukia katika Uyahudi wote kuanzia Galilaya baada ya mahubiri ya Yohana Mbatizaji:
Ekegusii: Inwe momanyete, ng’a ring’ana eri riaraaretigwe ase Boyahudi yonsi, rigachaakera Galili magega y’ebatiso eria Yohana arandetie,

English: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
Kiswahili: Jinsi Mungu alivyomtia Yesu wa Nazareti mafuta katika Roho Mtakatifu na jinsi alivyokwenda huku na huko akitenda mema na kuponya wote waliokuwa wameonewa na nguvu za ibilisi, kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: igoro ya Yeso o Nazareti, buna Nyasae amoete Omoika Omochenu ne chinguru, na buna ataarete na gokora emeremo emiya, na kogwenia bonsi abaregetwe na Saitani, ekiagera Nyasae nigo arenge amo nere.

English: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
Kiswahili: “Sisi ni mashahidi wa mambo yote aliyoyafanya katika Uyahudi na Yerusalemu. Wakamuua kwa kumtundika msalabani.
Ekegusii: Na intwe nigo tore kirori b’amang’ana onsi aya arenge gokora ase ense y’Abayahudi na ime ya Yerusalemu. Bakamoita, bakamosunga ase omote,

English: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu siku ya tatu na akamwezesha kuonekana na watu.
Ekegusii: korende Nyasae akamobokia ase rituko ria gatato, akamwanchera kooroka,

English: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
Kiswahili: Hakuonekana kwa watu wote, lakini kwetu sisi tuliochaguliwa na Mungu kuwa mashahidi, ambao tulikula na kunywa naye baada ya kufufuka kwake kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: tari ase abanto bonsi, korende nasetore, abatwachoretwe na Nyasae tobe kirori. Intwe nigo tware koria na konywa amo nere magega y’okoboka kwaye.

English: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
Kiswahili: Naye alituamuru kuhubiri kwa watu wote na kushuhudia kwamba ndiye alitiwa mafuta na Mungu kuwa hakimu wa walio hai na wafu.
Ekegusii: Agatochiika toranderie abanto, na tobe kirori ng’a nere ochoretwe na Nyasae abe omogambi bw’abare moyo na abakuure.

English: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
Kiswahili: Manabii wote walishuhudia juu yake kwamba kila mtu amwaminiye hupokea msamaha wa dhambi katika Jina lake.”
Ekegusii: Oyo ababani bonsi baberete kirori, ng’a onde bwensi omwegenire nigo aranyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe ase erieta riaye.”

English: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
Kiswahili: Wakati Petro alikuwa akisema maneno haya, Roho Mtakatifu aliwashukia wote waliokuwa wakisikiliza ule ujumbe.
Ekegusii: Ekero Petero arenge gokwana aya Omoika Omochenu ogaikera bonsi abaigwete amang’ana aya.

English: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Wale wa tohara walioamini waliokuja na Petro walishangaa kwa kuona kuwa kipawa cha Roho Mtakatifu kimemwagwa juu ya watu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: Abegenete korwa ase abaarogete abachete amo na Petero, bagakumia, ekiagera nonya n’abanto b’Ebisaku banyorire ekeegwa ki’Omoika Omochenu.

English: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa waliwasikia wakinena kwa lugha mpya na kumwadhimisha Mungu. Ndipo Petro akasema,
Ekegusii: Naki baabaigwete bagokwana ase emenwa ao ao, bagotogia Nyasae. Erio Petero akabora,

English: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
Kiswahili: “Je, kuna mtu yeyote anayeweza kuzuia watu hawa wasibatizwe kwa maji? Wamempokea Roho Mtakatifu kama sisi tulivyompokea.”
Ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto nanyare kobatanga abanto aba, tibaabatiswa ase amache? Abanto abwo nabarabwo banyorire Omoika Omochenu koreng’ana buna intwe?”

English: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo akaamuru wabatizwe kwa jina la Yesu Kristo. Wakamsihi Petro akae nao kwa siku chache.
Ekegusii: Agachiika baabatiswe ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo. Erio bakamobooria amente komenya amo nabarabwo amatuko atari make.

English: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
Kiswahili: Mitume na ndugu walioamini waliokuwa huko Uyahudi wakasikia kuwa watu wa Mataifa nao wamepokea neno la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naende abatomwa na abaminto abarenge Boyahudi bakaigwa ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku nabarabwo banyorire ring’ana ria Nyasae.

English: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
Kiswahili: Hivyo Petro alipopanda Yerusalemu, wale wa tohara waliokuwa wameamini wakamshutumu,
Ekegusii: Erio ekero Petero achete ase Yerusalemu, baria abare ensemo y’okwaroka bakaamererania nere,

English: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”
Kiswahili: wakisema, “Ulikwenda kwa watu wasiotahiriwa na kula pamoja nao.”
Ekegusii: bakamoteebia: “Aye ngwasoa ase abanto batarogeti, okaragera amo nabarabwo!”

English: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akaanza kuwaeleza kuhusu mambo yote yalivyotokea hatua kwa hatua akisema,
Ekegusii: Korende Petero agachaaka kobateebia amang’ana onsi buna abeete,

English: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.
Kiswahili: “Nilikuwa katika mji wa Yafa nikiomba, nami nikapitiwa na usingizi wa ghafula, nikaona maono. Kulikuwa na kitu kama nguo kubwa ikishuka kutoka mbinguni, ikishushwa kwa ncha zake nne, nayo ikanikaribia.
Ekegusii: “Nigo narenge ase omochie okorokwa Yopa, ngosaba nare, nkaba buna oyobwatire nobogondereria, nkarora ase okorora egento kere buna egetambaa kiabwatire emekoba ene, kegoikigwa korwa igoro gocha ase ’nde.

English: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
Kiswahili: Nilipoangalia ndani yake kwa karibu niliona wanyama wenye miguu minne wa nchini, wanyama wa mwitu, watambaao na ndege wa angani.
Ekegusii: Ngakerigereria mono, nkarora ching’iti chire n’amagoro ane, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, amo n’echikwagura, n’chinyoni chia igoro.

English: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikasikia sauti ikiniambia, ‘Petro, ondoka uchinje na ule.’
Ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia: Petero, imoka, onyenye orie!

English: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
Kiswahili: “Nikajibu, ‘La hasha Bwana! Kitu chochote kilicho najisi hakijaingia kinywani mwangu.’
Ekegusii: Korende nkabora: Yay’Omonene, ekiagera egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi, tibiana gosoa ase omonwa one nonya ng’ake.

English: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
Kiswahili: “Sauti ikasema kutoka mbinguni mara ya pili, ‘Usikiite najisi kitu chochote Mungu alichokitakasa.’
Ekegusii: Eriogi riganteebia eria kabere korwa igoro: Eki Nyasae achenire tokeroka ng’a tikeri egechenu.

English: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
Kiswahili: Jambo hili lilitokea mara tatu, ndipo kile kitu kikavutwa tena mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rigakoreka ara gatato, naende ebinto biria bionsi bikang’uswa gochia igoro.

English: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
Kiswahili: “Wakati ule ule watu watatu, waliokuwa wametumwa kutoka Kaisaria waliwasili katika nyumba niliyokuwa nikikaa.
Ekegusii: Ani! Ekero ekio abanto batato baikire ase enyomba eria namenyete, na barabwo nigo batometwe ase ’nde korwa Kaisaria.

English: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
Kiswahili: Roho Mtakatifu akaniambia niende nao bila kuwa na ubaguzi kati yao na sisi. Hawa ndugu sita pia walifuatana nami, nasi tukaingia nyumbani mwa huyo Kornelio.
Ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu oganteebia ngende amo nabarabwo, timbaisa koba ne chitang’u‐tang’u. Na abaminto aba batano nomo bakagenda amo nainche, togasoa ase enyomba y’omonto oria;

English: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,
Kiswahili: Akatuambia jinsi alivyoona malaika aliyekuwa amesimama katika nyumba yake na kusema, ‘Tuma watu waende Yafa wakamlete Simoni aitwaye Petro.
Ekegusii: ere agatoteebia buna aroche omomalaika oteneine mwaye, na komoteebia: Toma abanto bagende Yopa, barangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero.

English: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
Kiswahili: Yeye atakupa ujumbe ambao kwa huo wewe na wa nyumbani mwako wote mtaokoka.’
Ekegusii: Nere oragoteebie amang’ana ayarakorentere ogotooreka, aye na ab’enyomba yao yonsi.

English: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
Kiswahili: “Nami nilipoanza kusema, Roho Mtakatifu akashuka juu yao kama vile alivyotushukia sisi hapo mwanzo.
Ekegusii: Ekero nachaagete gokwana, Omoika Omochenu okabaikera buna otoikerete intwe agwo ritang’ani.

English: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
Kiswahili: Nami nikakumbuka neno la Bwana alivyosema, ‘Yohana alibatiza kwa maji, lakini ninyi mtabatizwa katika Roho Mtakatifu.’
Ekegusii: Nkainyora ring’ana riria ri’Omonene, buna ateebete: Yohana nigo arenge kobatisa ase amaache, korende inwe inamobatiswe ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa Mungu aliwapa hawa watu kipawa kile kile alichotupa sisi tuliomwamini Bwana Yesu Kristo, mimi ni nani hata nifikirie kuwa ningeweza kumpinga Mungu?”
Ekegusii: Gaki, onye Nyasae obaeire barabwo ekeegwa keria keria atoete intwe, ekero twamwegenete Omenene oito Yeso Kristo, inche ninche ng’o, ndanyaare koamereria Nyasae?”

English: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
Kiswahili: Waliposikia haya hawakuwa na la kupinga zaidi. Nao wakamwadhimisha Mungu wakisema, “Basi, Mungu amewapa hata watu wa Mataifa toba iletayo uzima wa milele.”
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagakira‐kiri. Na barabwo bagatogia Nyasae, bagoteeba: “Gaki, Nyasae oeire abanto b’Ebisaku boigo okoonchoka okwo gokorenta obogima.”

English: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
Kiswahili: Basi wale waliotawanyika kwa ajili ya mateso yaliyotokana na kifo cha Stefano, wakasafiri hadi Foinike na Kipro na Antiokia. Nao hawakuhubiri lile Neno kwa mtu yeyote isipokuwa Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Baria baatananegete magega y’emechando eria yabeete igoro ya Stefano bakagenda Foiniki na Kuporo, na Antiokia, bakarandia ring’ana ase Abayahudi boka, tari ase abanto bande.

English: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
Kiswahili: Lakini baadhi yao walikuwepo watu wa Kipro na Kirene, ambao walipokuja Antiokia walinena na Wayunani pia wakiwahubiria habari njema za Bwana Yesu.
Ekegusii: Korende mbarengeo ase egati yabo abanto ba Kuporo na Kurene, barabwo ekero bachia goika Antiokia bagakwana n’Abagiriki, bakabaranderia amang’ana amaya igoro y’Omonene Yeso.

English: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa pamoja nao, nayo idadi kubwa ya watu wakaamini na kumgeukia Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nabarabwo; abanto abange bakamwege n’Omonene, na komoonchokera.

English: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
Kiswahili: Habari hizi zilipofika masikioni mwa kanisa huko Yerusalemu, wakamtuma Barnaba aende Antiokia.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’ekanisa ya Yerusalemu bakaigwa amang’ana aya, bagatoma Barnaba agende Antiokia.

English: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Alipofika na kuona madhihirisho ya neema ya Mungu, akafurahi na kuwatia moyo waendelee kuwa waaminifu kwa Bwana kwa mioyo yao yote.
Ekegusii: Ere, ekero achia goika na korora buna obuya bwa Nyasae bwakorire, akagoka, agasorora bonsi babe abegenwa ase Omonene ase okogania gwe chinkoro.

English: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Barnaba alikuwa mtu mwema, aliyejaa Roho Mtakatifu, mwenye imani, nayo idadi kubwa ya watu wakaongezeka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omonto omuya, oichire n’Omoika Omochenu na okwegena. Abanto abange bakamenteka ase Omonene.

English: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
Kiswahili: Kisha Barnaba akaenda Tarso kumtafuta Sauli,
Ekegusii: Barnaba akarua agwo, akagenda Tariso korigia Saulo,

English: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
Kiswahili: naye alipompata akamleta Antiokia. Hivyo kwa mwaka mzima Barnaba na Sauli wakakutana na kanisa na kufundisha idadi kubwa ya watu. Ilikuwa ni katika kanisa la Antiokia kwa mara ya kwanza wanafunzi waliitwa Wakristo.
Ekegusii: na ekero amonyorete akamorenta Antiokia. Ase engaki y’omwaka omogima bagasangererekana amo ase ekanisa na kworokereria abanto abange. Agwo Antiokia nao aborokigwa batang’anete korokwa Abakristo.

English: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo manabii walishuka toka Yerusalemu hadi Antiokia.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ababani bagatirimboka korwa Yerusalemu gochia Antiokia.

English: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
Kiswahili: Mmoja wao, jina lake Agabo, akasimama akatabiri kwa uweza wa Roho Mtakatifu kwamba njaa kubwa itaenea ulimwengu mzima. Njaa hiyo ilitokea wakati wa utawala wa Klaudio.
Ekegusii: Oyomo obo, ore korokwa Agabo, agatenena akabana ase Omoika Omochenu, ng’a enchara enene nechiche ase ense engima; ero ekaba ekero Klaudio are kogamba.

English: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
Kiswahili: Mitume wakaamua kwamba kila mtu, kulingana na uwezo alio nao, atoe msaada kwa ajili ya ndugu wanaoishi Uyahudi.
Ekegusii: Na aborokigwa baria, kera oyomo koreng’ana buna okonyara kwaye, bakang’ea gotoma ogokonywa ase abamwabo abamenyete Boyahudi.

English: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
Kiswahili: Wakafanya hivyo, misaada yao ikapelekwa kwa wazee kwa mikono ya Barnaba na Sauli.
Ekegusii: Bagakora bo, bagatoma ebiegwa ase abagaaka ase amaboko a Barnaba na Saulo.

English: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo Mfalme Herode Agripa aliwakamata baadhi ya watu wa kanisa.
Ekegusii: Nabo ase engaki eria, omorwoti Herode akarambora amaboko aye agachanda abanto bande b’ekanisa.

English: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
Kiswahili: Akaamuru Yakobo, ndugu yake Yohana, auawe kwa upanga.
Ekegusii: Agaita Yakobo omwabo Yohana nomoyio o birende.

English: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
Kiswahili: Alipoona jambo hilo limewapendeza Wayahudi, akaendelea, akamkamata pia Petro. Hii ilitokea wakati wa Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu.
Ekegusii: Ekero aroche ng’a aya agweneire Abayahudi, akagenderera, Petero nere akabwatwa. Amatuko ayio naro amatuko emegati etabekiri memera.

English: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumkamata alimtia gerezani, chini ya ulinzi wa vikundi vinne vya askari, vyenye askari wanne kila kimoja. Herode alikuwa amekusudia kumtoa na kumfanyia mashtaka mbele ya watu baada ya Pasaka.
Ekegusii: Akamobwata akamobeka echela ime. Akamobeka ase ebiombe bine bi’abarwani; kera ekeombe nigo kiare nabarwani bane. Barabwo bakamorenda. Akarigia komosokia ase abanto magega y’Epasaka.

English: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Petro akawekwa gerezani, lakini kanisa lilikuwa likimwombea kwa Mungu kwa bidii.
Ekegusii: Nabo Petero arendetwe ase echela ime, abanto b’ekanisa bakamosabera ase Nyasae nomoyo bw’omokia.

English: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule kabla ya siku ambayo Herode Agripa alikuwa amekusudia kumtoa na kumfanyia mashtaka, Petro alikuwa amelala kati ya askari wawili, akiwa amefungwa kwa minyororo miwili. Nao walinzi wa zamu walikuwa wakilinda penye lango la gereza.
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria bwatang’anerete rituko riria Herode arengereretie komoira ase ekegambero, Petero nigo arenge oraire gati y’abarendi babere, osibire nebinyuri bibere, na abarwani nigo barenge gesieri barendete echela.

English: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.
Kiswahili: Ghafula malaika wa Bwana akatokea na nuru ikamulika mle ndani ya gereza. Yule malaika akampiga Petro ubavuni na kumwamsha, akisema, “Ondoka upesi!” Mara ile minyororo ikaanguka kutoka mikononi mwa Petro.
Ekegusii: Na rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera, na amasase akamoreka akanyomba ime. Omomalaika oria agaaka Petero rikere riaye, akamotura, agateeba: “Imoka bwango!” Ebinyuri bigasansoka korwa ase amaboko aye.

English: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”
Kiswahili: Yule malaika akamwambia, “Vaa nguo zako na viatu vyako.” Petro akafanya hivyo. Kisha akamwambia, “Jifunge vazi lako na unifuate.”
Ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoteebia: “Eboyie, obeke ebikoroto biao.” Agakora bo. Naende akamoteebia: “Beka eganchwa yao, ontunyane!”

English: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.
Kiswahili: Petro akatoka mle gerezani akiwa amefuatana na yule malaika. Hakujua wakati huo kuwa yaliyokuwa yakitukia yalikuwa kweli. Alidhani kuwa anaona maono.
Ekegusii: Agasoka, akamotunyana, gose tamanyete ng’a ayakoretwe nomomalaika nay’ekeene, korende agakaga ng’a nokorora arorire.

English: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
Kiswahili: Wakapita lindo la kwanza na la pili, ndipo wakafika kwenye lango la chuma linaloelekea mjini. Lango likawafungukia lenyewe, nao wakapita hapo wakatoka nje. Baada ya kutembea umbali wa mtaa mmoja, ghafula yule malaika akamwacha Petro.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia goetania ensemo ye ritang’ani na ensemo ya kabere ase abarendi barendete, bagaika egeita ki’ebioma kegosoerwa omochie ime. Eke gekabaigokera, na barabwo bagaeta ase enchera eyemo. Erio kegima omomalaika oria agatiga Petero.

English: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Petro akarudiwa na fahamu, akasema, “Sasa ninajua bila shaka yoyote kuwa Bwana amemtuma malaika wake na kuniokoa kutoka makucha ya Herode Agripa na kutoka matazamio yote ya Wayahudi.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Petero achia komanya, agateeba: “Bono namanyire bori ng’a Omonene nere otoma omomalaika oye ochia kondusia ase okoboko kwa Herode, na korwa ase ogosemeria gwonsi kw’abaanto b’Abayahudi.”

English: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
Kiswahili: Mara Petro alipotambua hili alikwenda nyumbani kwa Maria, mama yake Yohana aliyeitwa pia Marko, ambako watu wengi walikuwa wamekutana kwa maombi.
Ekegusii: Erio kayarengereretie aya, agaika ase enyomba ya Mariamu ng’ina Yohana, oyokorokwa naende Mariko; na abanto abange nao basangererekanete gosaba.

English: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.
Kiswahili: Petro alipobisha hodi kwenye lango la nje, mtumishi wa kike jina lake Roda, akaja kumfungulia.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Petero achia gotura egesieri kia geita, omoiseke omosomba, okorokwa Roda, agaacha koigwa.

English: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.
Kiswahili: Alipoitambua sauti ya Petro, alifurahi mno akarudi bila kufungua na kuwaeleza kwamba, “Petro yuko langoni!”
Ekegusii: Kamanyire eriogi ria Petero, akaba nomogooko, taigora egesieri, korende akaminyoka, agasoa nyomba, akabateebia ng’a Petero ngesieri ateneine.

English: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia yule mtumishi wa kike, “Umerukwa na akili.” Alipozidi kusisitiza kuwa ni kweli, wakasema, “Lazima awe ni malaika wake.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Nebarimo ore!” Korende akaamereria mono, agateeba ng’a naboigo are. Bakaboora: “Nomomalaika oye!”

English: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro aliendelea kugonga langoni, nao walipofungua lango na kumwona Petro, walistaajabu sana.
Ekegusii: Petero akagenderera gokong’onta egesieri. Erio bakamoigorera, bakamorora, bagakumia.

English: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.
Kiswahili: Yeye akawaashiria kwa mkono wake wanyamaze kimya, akawaeleza jinsi Bwana alivyomtoa gerezani. Naye akaongeza kusema, “Waelezeni Yakobo na ndugu wengine habari hizi.” Kisha akaondoka akaenda sehemu nyingine.
Ekegusii: Ere akabakania nokoboko, ng’a bakire, tibakwana, akabateebereria buna Omonene amosokia korwa ase echela. Akabora: “Genda, moteebie Yakobo na abaminto amang’ana aya.” Agasoka, akagenda ensemo ende.

English: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
Kiswahili: Kulipokucha kukawa na fadhaa kubwa miongoni mwa wale askari kuhusu yaliyomtukia Petro.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia abarendi bagasogwa nomoondoko omonge igoro ya Petero, naki abeete.

English: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Herode kuamuru atafutwe kila mahali na bila kumpata, aliwahoji wale askari walinzi kisha akatoa amri wauawe. Basi Herode Agripa akatoka Uyahudi akaenda Kaisaria, akakaa huko kwa muda.
Ekegusii: Herode akamorigia, tamonyora. Akana‐kounia abarendi, agachiika ng’a baitwe. Erio agatirimboka korwa Boyahudi, akagenda Kaisaria, akamenya aroro.

English: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
Kiswahili: Basi Herode Agripa alikuwa amekasirishwa sana na watu wa Tiro na Sidoni. Hivyo watu wa miji hiyo miwili wakaungana pamoja wakatafuta kukutana naye. Wakiisha kuungwa mkono na Blasto, mtumishi maalum wa Mfalme Herode Agripa aliyeaminika, wakaomba mapatano ya amani maana nchi zao zilitegemea nchi ya huyo mfalme kwa mahitaji yao ya chakula.
Ekegusii: Herode nigo abeete mono abanto ba Turo na Sidoni. Korende barabwo bakamochiera ase obomo, na ekero baebereirie Blasto, oyorenge korenda enyomba y’omorwoti, bakarigia omorembe, ekiagera ense yabo nigo yare konyora endagera korwa ase ense y’omorwoti.

English: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
Kiswahili: Katika siku iliyochaguliwa Herode Agripa akavaa mavazi yake ya kifalme, akaketi kwenye kiti chake cha enzi na kuwahutubia watu.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko erimo eriabekire, Herode akeboyia chianga chi’oborwoti, agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti, agakwana ase bare.

English: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
Kiswahili: Watu waliokuwa wamekusanyika wakapiga kelele, wakisema, “Hii si sauti ya mwanadamu, bali ni ya Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Abanto bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Eri neriogi ri’enyasae, tari eri’omonto!”

English: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
Kiswahili: Ghafula, kwa kuwa Herode hakumpa Mungu utukufu, malaika wa Bwana akampiga, naye akaliwa na chango, akafa.
Ekegusii: Erio bwango omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoaka ekiagera atasigete Nyasae; akariegwa namakonde, agatweka mo.

English: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
Kiswahili: Lakini neno la Mungu likaendelea mbele na kuenea, nao wengi wakaambatana nalo.
Ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rikagenderera komentekana.

English: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
Kiswahili: Barnaba na Sauli walipomaliza ile huduma yao iliyowapeleka, wakarudi Yerusalemu wakiwa pamoja na Yohana aitwaye Marko.
Ekegusii: Barnaba na Saulo, ekero bakoorire obotomwa bwabo, bakairana korwa Yerusalemu, bakarentana Yohana ore korokwa Mariko.

English: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
Kiswahili: Katika kanisa huko Antiokia ya Shamu walikuwako manabii na walimu, yaani: Barnaba, Simeoni aitwaye Nigeri, Lukio Mkirene, Manaeni aliyekuwa amelelewa pamoja na Mfalme Herode Agripa, na Sauli.
Ekegusii: Ase ekanisa ya Abantiokia mbarengeo ababani amo aborokia: Barnaba na Simioni, oyo ore korokwa Nigeri, na Lukio Omokurene, na Manaeni oyo orereretwe amo nomorwoti Herode, na Saulo.

English: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakimwabudu Bwana na kufunga, Roho Mtakatifu akasema, “Nitengeeni Sauli na Barnaba kwa kazi ile maalum niliyowaitia.”
Ekegusii: Aba iga, ekero barenge gosasiima Omonene, na kweng’ata, Omoika Omochenu agateeba: “Nchorere Barnaba na Saulo ase emeremo eria nabarangereretie bayekore.”

English: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
Kiswahili: Ndipo baada ya kufunga na kuomba, wakawawekea mikono yao na wakawatuma waende zao.
Ekegusii: Erio kobakoorire okweng’ata na ogosaba bakababeekera amaboko, bakabatiga bagende.

English: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, wakiwa wametumwa na Roho Mtakatifu, wakashuka kwenda Seleukia na kutoka huko wakasafiri baharini mpaka kisiwa cha Kipro.
Ekegusii: Abwo babere bagatomwa n’Omoika Omochenu, bagatirimboka gochia Selukia, na korwa agwo bakaamboka n’emeeri gochia Kuporo.

English: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.
Kiswahili: Walipowasili katika mji wa Salami, wakahubiri neno la Mungu katika sinagogi la Wayahudi. Pia walikuwa na Yohana Marko kuwa msaidizi wao.
Ekegusii: Bagaika Salami, bakarandia ring’ana ria Nyasae ase chisinagogi chi’Abayahudi, na barabwo nigo barenge na Yohana okobakonya.

English: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kupita katika nchi zote hizo wakafika Pafo, ambapo walikutana na Myahudi mmoja mchawi aliyekuwa nabii wa uongo, jina lake Bar-Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire goeta gati‐gati y’egesinka gionsi goika Pafo, bakanyora aroro omonto oyomo Omoyahudi omoriingoria, omobani bw’oborimo, ore korokwa Bar-Yeso.

English: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
Kiswahili: Mtu huyu alikuwa pamoja na Sergio Paulo, mtu mwenye hekima aliyekuwa msaidizi wa mwakilishi wa mtawala wa kile kisiwa. Sergio Paulo akawaita Sauli na Barnaba akitaka kusikia neno la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arenge amo na gabana Sergio Paulo, omonto bw’obong’aini. Ere akarangeria Barnaba na Saulo bache asare, akarigia koigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae.

English: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
Kiswahili: Lakini Elima yule mchawi (hii ndiyo maana ya jina lake), aliwapinga Barnaba na Sauli na kujaribu kumpotosha yule mkuu wa kile kisiwa aiache imani.
Ekegusii: Korende Elima, oria omoringoria (okoonchorwa kw’erieta riaye nakwo oko) akaamererania nabarabwo, akarigia koonchora gabana oria atige okwegena.

English: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him
Kiswahili: Ndipo Sauli, ambaye pia aliitwa Paulo, akiwa amejawa na Roho Mtakatifu, akamkazia macho Elima huyo mchawi,
Ekegusii: Korende Saulo, oyokorokwa naende Paulo, agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, akamotogoreria amaiso, akabora,

English: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
Kiswahili: akamwambia, “Ewe mwana wa ibilisi, wewe ni adui wa kila kilicho haki! Umejaa kila aina ya udanganyifu na ulaghai. Je, hutaacha kuzipotosha njia za Bwana zilizonyooka?
Ekegusii: “Aye omwana o Saitani omobisa bw’oboronge bwonsi, oichire nobong’ainereria n’obobe bwonsi, torigeti gotiga gokora bogeka chinchera chia Nyasae Omobui chire boronge?

English: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
Kiswahili: Nawe sasa sikiliza, mkono wa Bwana u dhidi yako. Utakuwa kipofu, wala hutaona jua kwa muda.” Mara ukungu na giza vikamfunika, naye akaenda huku na huko akitafuta mtu wa kumshika mkono ili amwonyeshe njia.
Ekegusii: Rora bono, okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kore igoro ase ore, aye nobe omouko, torora erioba ase engaki.” Erio kegima akabwatwa norotutu na omosunte, agataba‐taba akarigia abanto bamobwate okoboko bamoraae.

English: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Yule mkuu wa kile kisiwa alipoona yaliyotukia, akaamini kwa sababu alistaajabishwa na mafundisho kuhusu Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ekero gabana achia korora ayakoreka, akeegena, agakumia ase okworokereria kw’Omonene.

English: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kisha Paulo na wenzake wakasafiri toka Pafo wakafika Perga huko Pamfilia. Lakini, Yohana Marko akawaacha huko, akarejea Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Erio Paulo na abamwabo bakamanora n’emeeri korwa Pafo, bagaika Perga ase Pamfulia. Yohana akabatiga, akairana Yerusalemu,

English: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Perga wakaendelea hadi Antiokia ya Pisidia. Siku ya Sabato wakaingia ndani ya sinagogi, wakaketi.
Ekegusii: korende barabwo bakarua Perga, bakagenda Antiokia, omochie o Pisidia. Rituko ria Esabato bagasoa ase esinagogi, bagaikaransa aroro.

English: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya Sheria ya Mose na Kitabu cha Manabii kusomwa, viongozi wa sinagogi wakawatumia ujumbe wakisema, “Ndugu, kama mna neno la kuwafariji watu hawa, tafadhali lisemeni.”
Ekegusii: Magega kabasomire amachiiko na egetabu y’ababani, abatang’ani b’esinagogi bagatoma amang’ana ase bare kobateebia: “Abaminto, onye more ne ring’ana ri’okoremia, rikwane!”

English: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
Kiswahili: Paulo akasimama, akawapungia mkono na kusema: “Enyi wanaume wa Israeli na ninyi nyote mnaomcha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Paulo agatenena, akarambora okoboko, agakwana: Inwe abasacha b’Abaisraeli, na inwe abamoirogete Nyasae, ntegerera.

English: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
Kiswahili: Mungu wa watu hawa wa Israeli aliwachagua baba zetu, akawafanya kustawi walipokuwa huko Misri, kwa uwezo mwingi akawaongoza na kuwatoa katika nchi ile.
Ekegusii: Nyasae bw’abaanto aba Abaisraeli agachora chisokoro chiaito, na ekero barabwo bamenyete buna abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri, akabaimokereria igoro. Ase okobua kwaye akabarusia aroro,

English: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda wa miaka arobaini alivumilia matendo yao walipokuwa jangwani.
Ekegusii: na koreng’ana engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene akaremereria nabarabwo ase erooro.

English: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.
Kiswahili: Naye baada ya kuyaangamiza mataifa saba waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, akawapa Waisraeli nchi yao iwe urithi wao.
Ekegusii: Agasiria ebisaku bitano na bibere ase ense ya Kaanani, na ense yabo akabaa ebe omwando obo,

English: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
Kiswahili: Haya yote yalichukua kama muda wa miaka 450. “Baada ya haya, Mungu akawapa waamuzi mpaka wakati wa nabii Samweli.
Ekegusii: koreng’ana engaki y’emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etano. Magega y’ayio akabaa abagaambi goika ekero ki’omobani Samweli.

English: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
Kiswahili: Ndipo watu wakaomba wapewe mfalme, naye Mungu akawapa Sauli mwana wa Kishi wa kabila la Benyamini, aliyetawala kwa miaka arobaini.
Ekegusii: Erio magega yaye bagasaba baegwe omorwoti. Nyasae akabaa Saulo, mosinto o Kishi, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini, oyio obagamberete engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.

English: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
Kiswahili: Baada ya kumwondoa Sauli katika ufalme, akawainulia Daudi kuwa mfalme wao. Mungu pia alimshuhudia, akisema, ‘Nimemwona Daudi mwana wa Yese, mtu anayeupendeza moyo wangu, atakayetimiza mapenzi yangu yote.’
Ekegusii: Ekero konya amorusirie oyo, akaimokereria Daudi igoro koba omorwoti obo. Akabateebia igoro yaye: Nanyorire Daudi, mosinto o Yese; nere omonto ongweneire ase enkoro yane, naende nere oraanyare gokora ogwancha kwane gwonsi.

English: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
Kiswahili: “Kutoka uzao wa mtu huyu, Mungu amewaletea Israeli Mwokozi Yesu, kama alivyoahidi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase oroiboro rw’omonto oyio Nyasae orenteire Abaisraeli Omotooria, nere Yeso. Nabo abarierete eira.

English: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kuja kwa Yesu, Yohana alihubiri toba na ubatizo kwa watu wote wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ritang’ani ere ataraacha, Yohana konya obarandeirie abanto bonsi ba Israeli ebatiso y’okoonchoka.

English: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
Kiswahili: Yohana alipokuwa anakamilisha kazi yake, alisema: ‘Ninyi mnadhani mimi ni nani? Mimi si yeye. La hasha, lakini yeye yuaja baada yangu, ambaye mimi sistahili kufungua kamba za viatu vya miguu yake.’
Ekegusii: Ekero Yohana abeire ang’e gokoora orogendo rwaye akabora, Nigo mokagete ng’a ninche ng’o? Inche tari Kristo. Korende magega yane ngocha are oyomo, ere oyo inche ntaisaini gosibora chinuga ch’ebikoroto bi’amagoro aye.

English: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
Kiswahili: “Ndugu zangu, wana wa Abrahamu, nanyi watu wa Mataifa mnaomcha Mungu, ujumbe huu wa wokovu umeletwa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, abanto b’ororeria rwa Aburaamu, amo nabande ase more inwe abamoirogete Nyasae, ring’ana ri’ogotooreka riatomirwe ase tore.

English: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu wakaao Yerusalemu na viongozi wao hawakumtambua wala kuelewa maneno ya manabii yasomwayo kila Sabato, bali waliyatimiza maneno hayo kwa kumhukumu yeye.
Ekegusii: Naki abamenyete Yerusalemu, na abanene babo tibamomanyete, ekiagera tibamanyete nonya namang’ana y’ababani. Ase okomogambia baikeranirie ayare gosomwa ase chibuku chi’ababani kera Esabato.

English: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
Kiswahili: Ijapokuwa hawakupata sababu yoyote ya kumhukumu kifo, walimwomba Pilato aamuru auawe.
Ekegusii: Nonya tibanyorete engencho y’okomoita, bagasaba Pilato aitwe.

English: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
Kiswahili: Walipokwisha kufanya yale yote yaliyoandikwa kumhusu, walimshusha kutoka msalabani na kumzika kaburini.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia goikerania onsi ayariikire igoro yaye, bakamoikia korwa ase omote, bakamobeka ase oboina.

English: But God raised him from the dead,
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure.

English: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
Kiswahili: Naye kwa siku nyingi akawatokea wale waliokuwa pamoja naye kuanzia Galilaya hadi Yerusalemu. Nao sasa wamekuwa mashahidi wake kwa watu wetu.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko amange akarorekana ase abwo barenge gotiira komo korwa Galili goika Yerusalemu. Bono barabwo kirori baye bare ase abanto.

English: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
Kiswahili: “Nasi tunawaletea habari njema, kwamba yale Mungu aliyowaahidi baba zetu
Ekegusii: Na intwe twabarenteire amang’ana amaya aria Nyasae arierete chisokoro chiaito eira.

English: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
Kiswahili: sasa ameyatimiza kwetu sisi watoto wao, kwa kumfufua Yesu, kama ilivyoandikwa katika Zaburi ya pili: “ ‘Wewe ni Mwanangu; leo mimi nimekuzaa.’
Ekegusii: Aya Nyasae atoikeraneirie intwe abana babo ase okobokia Yeso. Naende buna ariikire ase Zaburi ibere: Aye naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire.

English: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu asioze kamwe, alitamka maneno haya: “ ‘Nitakupa wewe baraka takatifu zilizo za hakika nilizomwahidi Daudi.’
Ekegusii: Naende ng’a nigo amobogetie korwa ase abakuure, erinde tanyara koirana naende ase ogosareka, okwanire iga, Nimbae ogosesenigwa ogochenu na ogw’ekeene, koria narierete Daudi eira.

English: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyosemwa mahali pengine katika Zaburi, “ ‘Hutamwacha Aliye Mtakatifu wako kuona uharibifu.’
Ekegusii: Ase ayio okwanire naende ase Zaburi ende, Togotiga Omochenu oo arore ogosareka.

English: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
Kiswahili: “Kwa maana Daudi akiisha kulitumikia kusudi la Mungu katika kizazi chake, alilala; akazikwa pamoja na baba zake na mwili wake ukaoza.
Ekegusii: Naki Daudi, ekero akoorire gokorera ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase ekegori kiaye, agakwa, agatindekwa ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, akarora ogosareka.

English: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
Kiswahili: Lakini yule ambaye Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu hakuona uharibifu.
Ekegusii: Korende oyo obogetigwe na Nyasae taroche ogosareka.

English: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, nataka ninyi mjue kwamba kwa kupitia huyu Yesu msamaha wa dhambi unatangazwa kwenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio baminto, tiga amanyekane ase more ng’a goetera ase oyio nigo mokoranderigwa okwaberwa kw’ebibe,

English: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
Kiswahili: Kwa kupitia yeye, kila mtu amwaminiye anahesabiwa haki kwa kila kitu ambacho asingeweza kuhesabiwa haki kwa sheria ya Mose.
Ekegusii: na asere kera oyomwegenire nigo akobarerwa oboronge ase amang’ana aria atakonyarekana kobarerwa oboronge ase amachiiko a Musa.

English: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo jihadharini ili yale waliyosema manabii yasiwapate:
Ekegusii: Gaki, erende, tabaisa kobaikera amang’ana aria akwanetwe nababani:

English: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”
Kiswahili: “ ‘Angalieni, enyi wenye dhihaka, mkastaajabu, mkaangamie, kwa maana nitatenda jambo wakati wenu ambalo hamtasadiki, hata kama mtu akiwaambia.’ ”
Ekegusii: Rigereria, inwe abachaayi, mokumie na mosire, ekiagera ngochia gokora ’nde ring’ana ase amatuko aino, eri motegene nonya ’monto onde bwensi naisa kobateebia.

English: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
Kiswahili: Paulo na Barnaba walipokuwa wakitoka nje ya sinagogi, watu wakawaomba wazungumze tena mambo hayo Sabato iliyofuata.
Ekegusii: Kabasokire, abanto bakabasorora bache kobateebia amang’ana aya Esabato ya kabere.

English: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusanyiko la Sinagogi kutawanyika, wengi wa Wayahudi na waongofu wa dini ya Kiyahudi wakawafuata Paulo na Barnaba, wakazungumza nao na kuwahimiza wadumu katika neema ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekero omosangererekano bw’esinagogi oera, Abayahudi abange na abegeni b’ebisaku binde abaonchogete bakabwatana na Paulo na Barnaba, abakwanete nabarabwo, na kobaremia bagenderere ase obuya bwa Nyasae.

English: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
Kiswahili: Sabato iliyofuata, karibu watu wote wa mji walikuja kusikiliza neno la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase Esabato ya kabere abanto abange, ang’e omochie bwonsi, bagasangererekana baigwe ring’ana ria Nyasae.

English: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wayahudi walipoona ule umati mkubwa wa watu walijawa na wivu, wakayakanusha maneno Paulo aliyokuwa akisema.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Abayahudi bachia korora emeganda, bagaichorwa ne ribero, bagakaana amang’ana ayare gokwanwa na Paulo, bakamorama.

English: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo na Barnaba wakawajibu kwa ujasiri, wakisema, “Ilitupasa kunena nanyi neno la Mungu kwanza. Lakini kwa kuwa mmelikataa, mkajihukumu wenyewe kuwa hamstahili uzima wa milele, sasa tunawageukia watu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: Paulo na Barnaba bagakwana noboremu, bagateeba: Igo yagwenerete ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae rikwanwe ase more ritang’ani. Korende ekiagera mwarisukeirie are mwenacheire inwe abanyene ng’a timogwenereti obogima bwa kare na kare, tweonchoreire abanto b’Ebisaku.

English: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hili ndilo Bwana alilotuamuru: “ ‘Nimewafanya ninyi kuwa nuru kwa watu wa Mataifa, ili mpate kuuleta wokovu hadi miisho ya dunia.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nabo twachigetwe n’Omonene, Nakobekire obe omobaso ase abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde ogotooreka kwane kogende, goike ase chinsinyo chi’ense.

English: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
Kiswahili: Watu wa Mataifa waliposikia haya wakafurahi na kulitukuza neno la Bwana; nao wote waliokuwa wamekusudiwa uzima wa milele wakaamini.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’Ebisaku bachia koigwa ayio bakagoka, bagatogia ring’ana ri’Omonene, na abwo bachiikeretwe konyora obogima bwa kare na kare bakeegena.

English: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
Kiswahili: Neno la Bwana likaenea katika eneo lile lote.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaranda ase ense eria yonsi.

English: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wayahudi wakawachochea wanawake wenye kumcha Mungu, wenye vyeo pamoja na watu maarufu katika mji, wakachochea mateso dhidi ya Paulo na Barnaba na kuwafukuza kutoka eneo hilo.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaburukania abakungu abamoirogete Nyasae, abasikire n’abanto, na abanene b’omochie, bakagenka abanto bachande Paulo na Barnaba, na kobaseria korwa ensemo yabo.

English: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Paulo na Barnaba wakakungʼuta mavumbi ya miguu yao ili kuwapinga, nao wakaenda Ikonio.
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo na Barnaba bakabakong’ontera orotu rw’amagoro abo, bakagenda Ikonio.

English: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wakajawa na furaha na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Na aborokigwa bagaichorwa nomogooko na Omoika Omochenu.

English: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.
Kiswahili: Huko Ikonio Paulo na Barnaba waliingia pamoja katika sinagogi la Wayahudi kama ilivyokuwa desturi yao. Huko wakahubiri kwa uwezo mkubwa kiasi kwamba Wayahudi pamoja na watu wa Mataifa wakaamini.
Ekegusii: Aaria Ikonio Paulo na Barnaba bagasoa esinagogi amo buna engencho yarenge, bagakwana n’oboikeranu goika abanto abange b’Abayahudi na b’Ebisaku bakeegena.

English: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale Wayahudi waliokataa kuamini, wakawachochea watu wa Mataifa, wakatia chuki ndani ya mioyo yao dhidi ya wale walioamini.
Ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi abategenete bakaburukania emioyo y’abanto b’Ebisaku na gosaria emioyo yabo igoro ase abaminto.

English: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Paulo na Barnaba wakakaa huko kwa muda wa kutosha wakihubiri kwa ujasiri juu ya Bwana, ambaye alithibitisha ujumbe wa neema yake kwa kuwawezesha kufanya ishara na miujiza.
Ekegusii: Ase engaki entambe Paulo na Barnaba bakamenya aroro, bagakwana noboremu igoro ase Omonene, oyorenge koorokia ring’ana ri’obuya bwaye na kobanchera ebikone na amakumia bikoreke ase amaboko abo.

English: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu wa mji ule waligawanyika, wengine wakakubaliana na Wayahudi na wengine na mitume.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto b’omochie oria bagaatananekana. Abande bakabwatana n’Abayahudi na abande nabatomwa.

English: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
Kiswahili: Watu wa Mataifa na Wayahudi wakajiunga na baadhi ya viongozi, wakafanya mpango wa kuwatendea mitume mabaya na kuwapiga mawe.
Ekegusii: Ekero okong’orerwa kw’abaanto b’Ebisaku na Abayahudi amo n’abanene babo gwakoretwe igoro y’abatomwa ase okobakorera amabe na kobaaka amagena,

English: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.
Kiswahili: Lakini mitume walipopata habari hizi wakakimbilia Listra na Derbe, miji ya Likaonia na sehemu zilizopakana nayo.
Ekegusii: barabwo bakanyora amang’ana, bagatama gochia Listra na Deribe, emechie ya Lukania, ne chinsemo chionsi echiarenge ang’e.

English: There they preached the Good News.
Kiswahili: Huko wakaendelea kuhubiri habari njema.
Ekegusii: Aroro bakagenderera korandia enchiri.

English: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
Kiswahili: Katika mji wa Listra, alikuwako kiwete, ambaye alikuwa amelemaa tangu kuzaliwa na hakuwa ametembea kamwe.
Ekegusii: Agwo Listra narengeo omonto oyomo ekerema. Ere nigo arenge rigata korwa ase okoiborwa kwaye, tana kogenda nonya ng’ake.

English: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
Kiswahili: Alimsikiliza Paulo alipokuwa akihubiri. Paulo alipomtazama akaona ana imani ya kuponywa.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio akaigwa Paulo kagokwana. Paulo akamobeta amaiso, akarora ng’a nare nokwegena gw’okogwenigwa,

English: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.
Kiswahili: Paulo akapaza sauti, “Simama kwa miguu yako!” Mara yule mtu akasimama upesi akaanza kutembea!
Ekegusii: agakwana neriogi rinene, agateeba: “Tenena boronge namagoro ao.” Agatenena bwango, agataarataara.

English: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu ulipoona yaliyokuwa yamefanywa na Paulo, wakapiga kelele kwa lugha yao ya Kilikaonia wakasema, “Miungu imetushukia katika umbo la binadamu!”
Ekegusii: Ekero emeganda yachia korora aya Paulo akora, bagaaka amariogi abo, bagakwana ase Ekelukania: “Chinyasae chiatoikeire ase emegwekano ya Mwanyabaanto!”

English: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.
Kiswahili: Wakamwita Barnaba Zeu na Paulo wakamwita Herme kwa kuwa ndiye alikuwa msemaji mkuu.
Ekegusii: Bakaroka Barnaba Zeu, na Paulo Herme, ekiagera nere orenge omonene ase ogokwana.

English: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.
Kiswahili: Kuhani wa Zeu, ambaye hekalu lake lilikuwa nje kidogo tu ya mji, akaleta mafahali na mashada ya maua penye lango la mji kwa sababu yeye na ule umati wa watu walitaka kuwatolea dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Omokuani o Zeu, oyo Hekalu yaye yarenge isiko y’omochie, akarenta chieri na ebisembe bi’ebisicha goika ase ebiita; ere amo n’abanto bakarigia korua ekeng’wanso.

English: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,
Kiswahili: Lakini mitume Paulo na Barnaba waliposikia haya, wakararua nguo zao, wakawaendea wale watu kwa haraka, wakawapigia kelele, wakisema,
Ekegusii: Korende abatomwa Barnaba na Paulo, ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana ayio bagatandora chianga chiabo, bakaayerera, bagasoa ase omoganda, bagaaka egeturi, bagoteeba,

English: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
Kiswahili: “Enyi watu, kwa nini mnafanya mambo haya? Sisi ni wanadamu tu kama ninyi! Tunawaletea habari njema, tukiwaambia kwamba mgeuke mtoke katika mambo haya yasiyofaa, mmwelekee Mungu aliye hai, aliyeziumba mbingu na nchi na bahari na vitu vyote vilivyomo.
Ekegusii: “Inwe abasacha! Nase ki mogokora aya? Intwe nigo tore Mwanyabaanto koreng’ana buna inwe. Twabarandeirie inwe amang’ana amaya, erinde motige chinyasae echi chia bosa, moonchokere Nyasae ore moyo, oyotongete igoro na ense, na enyancha, na ebinto ebire imeo.

English: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.
Kiswahili: Zamani aliwaachia mataifa waishi walivyotaka.
Ekegusii: Kare ase ebigori biaetire nigo atigete ebisaku bionsi bitaare ase chinchera chiabo abanyene,

English: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”
Kiswahili: Lakini hakuacha kuwaonyesha watu uwepo wake: Ameonyesha wema kwa kuwanyeshea mvua toka mbinguni na kuwapa mazao kwa majira yake, naye amewapa chakula tele na kuijaza mioyo yenu na furaha.”
Ekegusii: korende ere omonyene tetigete atari na kirori. Ere nigo are gokora amaya na kobaa embura korwa igoro, ne chingaki chi’erigesa, agaisanekia chinkoro chiaino nendagera na omogooko.”

English: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.
Kiswahili: Hata kwa maneno haya yote, ilikuwa vigumu kuuzuia ule umati wa watu kuwatolea dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Na ase amang’ana aya bagatanga abanto baria bokong’u, tibaabaruseria ebing’wanso.

English: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wakaja baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka Antiokia na Ikonio wakawashawishi wale watu, wakampiga Paulo kwa mawe, wakamburuta hadi nje ya mji, wakidhani amekufa.
Ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi korwa Antiokia na Ikonio bagaacha, na ekero bagenkire abanto bagaaka Paulo amagena, bakamokurura gochia isiko y’omochie, bagakaga ng’a okuure,

English: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya wanafunzi kukusanyika akainuka na kurudi mjini. Kesho yake yeye na Barnaba wakaondoka kwenda Derbe.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa bamoetananire ase chinsemo chionsi, agatenena, agasoa omochie ime, ne rituko ria kabere riaye agasoka, akagenda Deribe amo na Barnaba.

English: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
Kiswahili: Wakahubiri habari njema katika mji huo na kupata wanafunzi wengi. Kisha wakarudi Listra, Ikonio na Antiokia,
Ekegusii: Magega kobarandirie amang’ana amaya ase omochie oria, na kobakorire abange koba aborokigwa, bakairana goika Listra, na Ikonio, na Antiokia,

English: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.
Kiswahili: wakiwaimarisha wanafunzi na kuwatia moyo waendelee kudumu katika imani. Wakawaonya wakisema, “Imetupasa kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu kwa kupitia katika taabu nyingi.”
Ekegusii: bakabeeka emioyo yaborokigwa chinguru na kobaremia bagenderere ase okwegena, bakabateebia ng’a: “Netogwenerete gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae ase enchera y’emechando emenge.”

English: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.
Kiswahili: Nao baada ya kuwateua wazee katika kila kanisa, kwa kufunga na kuomba wakawakabidhi kwa Bwana waliyemwamini.
Ekegusii: Erio kobachorire abagaaka ase kera ekanisa ase ogosaba na okweng’ata, bakababeeka ase amaboko y’Omonene, oyio begenete.

English: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.
Kiswahili: Kisha wakapitia Pisidia wakafika Pamfilia.
Ekegusii: Bagaeta gati ya Pisidia, bagasoa Pamfulia.

English: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuhubiri neno la Mungu huko Perga, wakateremkia Atalia.
Ekegusii: Na magega kobarandirie ring’ana ase Perga, bagatirimboka gochia Atalia,

English: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.
Kiswahili: Kutoka Atalia wakasafiri baharini wakarudi Antiokia, ambako walikuwa wamesifiwa kwa ajili ya neema ya Mungu kutokana na ile huduma waliyokuwa wameikamilisha.
Ekegusii: na korwa agwo bakairwa n’emeeri ase enyancha, bagaika Antiokia. Agwo nao babeekeretwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae ase emeremo eria banyarete goikerania.

English: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.
Kiswahili: Walipowasili Antiokia wakaliita kanisa pamoja na kutoa taarifa ya yale yote Mungu aliyokuwa ametenda kupitia kwao na jinsi alivyokuwa amefungua mlango wa imani kwa ajili ya watu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika aroro bagasangereria ekanisa amo, bakaorokia amang’ana onsi Nyasae akorete nabarabwo, na buna aigoreire abanto b’Ebisaku egesieri gi’okwegena.

English: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.
Kiswahili: Nao wakakaa huko pamoja na wanafunzi kwa muda mrefu.
Ekegusii: Bakaba agwo amatuko atai make amo naborokigwa.

English: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya watu wakashuka Antiokia kutoka Uyahudi, nao wakawa wanawafundisha wandugu: “Msipotahiriwa kufuatana na desturi aliyofundisha Mose, hamwezi kuokoka.”
Ekegusii: Abanto gete batirimbogete korwa Boyahudi bakorokereria abaminto ng’a: “Motarogeti koreng’ana buna Musa atochigeete, timokonyaara gotooreka.”

English: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Paulo na Barnaba kutokubaliana nao kukawa na mabishano makali, Paulo na Barnaba na baadhi ya wengine miongoni mwao wakachaguliwa kwenda Yerusalemu ili kujadiliana jambo hili na mitume na wazee.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akarenta ogwatananekana okonene, na Paulo na Barnaba bakaamererania n’abanto aba. Erio Paulo, na Barnaba, na abande korwa ase egati yabo bagachiikwa batiire gochia Yerusalemu ase abatomwa na abagaaka ase engencho y’okoamererania okwo.

English: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakasafirishwa na kanisa, wakiwa njiani wakapitia nchi ya Foinike na Samaria, wakawaeleza jinsi watu wa Mataifa walivyookoka. Habari hizi zikaleta furaha kubwa kwa ndugu wote.
Ekegusii: Bagatomwa ekanisa, bagaeta gati ya Foiniki na Samaria, bakararia amang’ana ’okoonchoka kw’abaanto b’Ebisaku, bakagokia abaminto bonsi.

English: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.
Kiswahili: Walipofika Yerusalemu, walipokelewa na kanisa na mitume pamoja na wazee, ndipo Paulo na Barnaba wakawaarifu kila kitu Mungu alichokuwa amefanya kupitia kwao.
Ekegusii: Ekero baigete Yerusalemu bakaroisigwa n’ekanisa amo n’Abatomwa na abagaaka, bakaboorokia amang’ana onsi aya Nyasae akorete nabarabwo.

English: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo baadhi ya walioamini wa madhehebu ya Mafarisayo wakasimama na kusema, “Hao watu wa Mataifa lazima watahiriwe na waagizwe kutii sheria ya Mose.”
Ekegusii: Korende abande ase Abafarisai, abwo begenete, bagatenena, bagateeba: “Negwenerete kobaorokia na kobachiika babwate amachiiko a Musa.”

English: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.
Kiswahili: Mitume na wazee wakakutana pamoja ili kufikiri jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Abatomwa na abagaaka bagasangererekana amo, erinde banyare korengereria igoro ye ring’ana erio.

English: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.
Kiswahili: Baada ya majadiliano mengi, Petro akasimama na kusema, “Ndugu zangu, mnajua kwamba siku za kwanza Mungu alinichagua ili kwa midomo yangu watu wa Mataifa wapate kusikia ujumbe wa Injili na kuamini.
Ekegusii: Na magega y’okoamererania okonge Petero agatenena akabateebia: “Abaminto, inwe mwamanyire ng’a ase ekero giaetire Nyasae nakorete ogochora egati yaino, ng’a korwa ase omonwa one abanto b’Ebisaku baigwe ring’ana ri’enchiri na koriegena.

English: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.
Kiswahili: Mungu, yeye ajuaye mioyo, alionyesha kwamba anawakubali kwa kuwapa Roho Mtakatifu kama vile alivyotupa sisi.
Ekegusii: Na Nyasae, oyomanyete chinkoro chi’abaanto, akabanchera, akabaa Omoika Omochenu, koreng’ana buna atoete intwe,

English: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
Kiswahili: Mungu hakutofautisha kati yetu na wao, bali alitakasa mioyo yao kwa imani.
Ekegusii: gose takorete gwatananekana ase egati yaito na barabwo, korende agasibia chinkoro chiabo ase okwegena.

English: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, mbona mnataka kumjaribu Mungu kwa kuweka kongwa shingoni mwa wanafunzi ambalo baba zetu wala sisi hatukuweza kulibeba?
Ekegusii: Gaki, bono inaki mogoteema Nyasae na kobeeka rikorogoto igoro ase amagoti ’aborokigwa, eri chisokoro chiaito chitanyarete kobogoria, nonya nintwe totanyaare.

English: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi tunaamini ya kuwa tunaokolewa kwa neema ya Bwana Yesu Kristo, kama wao wanavyookolewa.”
Ekegusii: Korende twegenire ng’a ase amaabera a Yeso, Omonene intwe natotoorigwe buna barabwo.”

English: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.
Kiswahili: Kusanyiko lote likakaa kimya, wakawasikiliza Paulo na Barnaba wakieleza jinsi Mungu alivyowatumia kutenda ishara na maajabu kwa watu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi ogakira, ogategerera Barnaba na Paulo, ekero baare koraria amang’ana igoro y’ebikone na amakumia Nyasae akorete goetera ase bare ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku.

English: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.
Kiswahili: Walipomaliza kunena, Yakobo akasema, “Ndugu zangu, nisikilizeni.
Ekegusii: Kobakoorire gokwana, Yakobo akairaneria: Abaminto, ntegerera.

English: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.
Kiswahili: Simoni amekwisha kutueleza jinsi Mungu, kwa mara ya kwanza alivyoonyesha kuhusika kwa kujichagulia watu kutoka watu wa Mataifa kwa ajili ya Jina lake.
Ekegusii: Simioni otworokirie buna Nyasae ritang’ani acheire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde achore abanto korwa ase bare babogorie erieta riaye.

English: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,
Kiswahili: Maneno ya manabii yanakubaliana na jambo hili, kama ilivyoandikwa:
Ekegusii: Na amang’ana ’ababani nigo abwataine nayio, buna ariikire,

English: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up
Kiswahili: “ ‘Baada ya mambo haya nitarudi, nami nitajenga upya nyumba ya Daudi iliyoanguka. Nitajenga tena magofu yake na kuisimamisha,
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya ning’irane, ning’agache naende obomenyo bwa Daudi, boria bwagwete. Ning’agache naende aase agwo atagogete, nimbotenenie,

English: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’
Kiswahili: ili wanadamu wengine wote wapate kumtafuta Bwana, hata wale watu wa Mataifa wote ambao wanaitwa kwa Jina langu, asema Bwana, afanyaye mambo haya’
Ekegusii: erinde Mwanyabaanto abatigaire barigie Omonene amo n’abanto b’Ebisaku bionsi, aba narangeirie ase erieta riane.

English: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.
Kiswahili: ambayo yamejulikana tangu zamani.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene agoteeba, oyo oorogetie aya korwa kare.

English: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,
Kiswahili: “Kwa hivyo uamuzi wangu ni kwamba, tusiwataabishe watu wa Mataifa wanaomgeukia Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nanachire iga, ng’a titochanda abanto baria b’Ebisaku abaonchokeire Nyasae,

English: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, tuwaandikie kwamba wajiepushe na vyakula vilivyonajisiwa kwa kutolewa sanamu, wajiepushe na uasherati, au kula mnyama aliyenyongwa, na damu.
Ekegusii: korende tobarikere riruube ng’a beatanane korwa ase ebinto bitachenegeti bi’emegwekano y’ogosaasimwa, na obotomani, na enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase amanyinga.

English: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana katika kila mji kwa vizazi vilivyopita, Mose amekuwa na wale wanaotangaza sheria yake kwa kuwa imekuwa ikisomwa kwa sauti kubwa katika masinagogi kila Sabato.”
Ekegusii: Naki korwa ebigori bia kare Musa narenge n’abanto baare korandia amang’ana aye, na ase kera omochie nigo are gosomwa kera Esabato ase chisinagogi.

English: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
Kiswahili: Mitume na wazee pamoja na kanisa lote, wakaamua kuwachagua baadhi ya watu wao na kuwatuma Antiokia pamoja na Paulo na Barnaba. Wakamchagua Yuda aitwaye Barsaba pamoja na Sila, watu wawili waliokuwa viongozi miongoni mwa ndugu.
Ekegusii: Erio akagwenera abatomwa na abagaaka amo na ekanisa yonsi gochora abanto korwa ase egati yabo na kobatoma Antiokia amo na Paulo na Barnaba. Bagatoma Yuda ore korokwa Barsaba, na Sila, abatang’ani b’abamwabo,

English: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.
