Kiswahili: Wakatumwa na barua ifuatayo: Sisi mitume na wazee, ndugu zenu, Kwa ndugu Mataifa mlioamini mlioko Antiokia, Shamu na Kilikia: Salamu.
Ekegusii: bakabaa baire riruube ririikire iga: “Ase abaminto b’Ebisaku abamore ase Antiokia, na Siiria, na Kilikia. Intwe abamino, abatomwa na abagaaka, twabakwanirie.

English: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;
Kiswahili: Tumesikia kwamba kuna baadhi ya watu waliokuja huko kutoka kwetu bila ruhusa yetu na kuwasumbua, wakiyataabisha mawazo yenu.
Ekegusii: Twaigure ng’a abanto baruure aa ase tore abaabachandire ase amang’ana abo na koonchorana emioyo yaino, na intwe titwabachiigete ng’a bakore bo.

English: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
Kiswahili: Hivyo tumekubaliana wote kuwachagua baadhi ya watu na kuwatuma kwenu pamoja na wapendwa wetu Barnaba na Paulo,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, intwe twarorire buya ase omosangererekano oito gochora abanto na kobatoma ase more amo nabanchwa baito Barnaba na Paulo,

English: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: watu ambao wamehatarisha maisha yao kwa ajili ya jina la Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: abanto ababekire obogima bwabo ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tunawatuma Yuda na Sila, kuthibitisha kwa maneno ya mdomo mambo haya tunayowaandikia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio twatomire Yuda na Sila, abaranyare kobateebia amang’ana ayio ayio ase emenwa yabo.

English: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imempendeza Roho Mtakatifu na sisi tusiwatwike mzigo wowote mkubwa zaidi ya mambo haya yafuatayo ambayo ni ya lazima:
Ekegusii: Iga yarorekanete buya ase Omoika Omochenu amo naintwe, titobatweka egurube ende otatiga eyio egwenerete:

English: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”
Kiswahili: Kwamba mjiepushe na vyakula vilivyotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu, na damu, au kula nyama ya mnyama aliyenyongwa, na mjiepushe na uasherati. Mkiyaepuka mambo haya, mtakuwa mmefanya vyema. Kwaherini.
Ekegusii: Mweatanane korwa ase ebinto biruure ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa, na korwa ase amanyinga, na korwa ase enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase obotomani. Kamoretange nayio, namokore buya. Motigare buya.”

English: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakaagwa, wakashuka kwenda Antiokia. Baada ya kulikusanya kanisa pamoja, wakawapa ile barua.
Ekegusii: Ekero baria baegwa ribaga, bagatirimboka gochia Antiokia, bagasangereria abanto b’ekanisa y’aroro, bakabaa riruube riria.

English: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.
Kiswahili: Nao hao watu wakiisha kuisoma, wakafurahishwa sana kwa ujumbe wake wa kutia moyo.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo kobarisomire, bakagoka ase engencho y’okoremigwa okwo.

English: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
Kiswahili: Yuda na Sila, ambao wenyewe walikuwa manabii, wakanena maneno mengi ya kuwatia moyo na kuwajenga katika imani wale ndugu walioamini.
Ekegusii: Yuda na Sila, ekiagera nababani barenge, bakaremia emioyo y’abaminto ase amang’ana amange, bakababeeka chinguru.

English: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukaa huko Antiokia kwa muda, wakaagwa kwa amani na wale ndugu ili waende kwa wale waliowatuma.
Ekegusii: Magega kobamenyire agwo ase engaki etai ’nke, bakaegwa ribaga nabaminto bagende nomorembe ase baria baabatomete.

English: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
Kiswahili: Lakini Sila bado akaendelea kukaa huko.
Ekegusii: Korende Sila akarora buya atigare aroro.

English: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo na Barnaba walibaki Antiokia ambako wao pamoja na wengine wengi walifundisha na kuhubiri neno la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Paulo na Barnaba bakamenya agwo Antiokia amo n’abanto bande abange, bakaba bakworokereria na korandia ring’ana ri’Omonene.

English: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
Kiswahili: Baada ya muda, Paulo akamwambia Barnaba, “Turudi tukawatembelee ndugu katika miji yote tuliyohubiri neno la Bwana tuone jinsi wanavyoendelea.”
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amake Paulo agateebia Barnaba: “Toirane, tochie korora abaminto ase kera omochie twarandirie ring’ana ri’Omonene, gose mbuya bare.”

English: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.
Kiswahili: Barnaba alitaka wamchukue Yohana aitwaye Marko waende naye.
Ekegusii: Barnaba agancha koirana Yohana, ore korokwa Mariko, amo nabarabwo.

English: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo aliona si vyema kwa sababu aliwahi kuwaacha walipokuwa huko Pamfilia, hakutaka kuendelea kufanya kazi naye.
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo tarora buya bairane oyio obatigete aaria Pamfulia, na tagendete amo nabarabwo gokora emeremo eria.

English: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
Kiswahili: Pakatokea ubishi mkali kati ya Paulo na Barnaba kuhusu jambo hili, hivyo wakagawanyika. Barnaba akamchukua Yohana Marko wakasafiri baharini kwenda Kipro.
Ekegusii: Erio eriomana rigatuboka ase egati yabo goika bagaatananekana. Barnaba akaira Mariko, akagenda n’emeeri gochia Kuporo,

English: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akamchagua Sila na akaondoka baada ya ndugu kuwatakia neema ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: korende Paulo agachora Sila, na ekero abegeni bamobekeire amaboko, akaimoka akagenda.

English: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.
Kiswahili: Paulo akafika Derbe na kisha Listra, ambako kulikuwa na mwanafunzi mmoja jina lake Timotheo, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Myahudi aliyeamini, lakini baba yake alikuwa Myunani.
Ekegusii: Agaika Deribe na Listra, ase omworokigwa oyomo amenyete, erieta riaye Timotheo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omoyahudi, korende ise n’Omogiriki orenge.

English: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa amesifiwa sana na wale ndugu waliokuwa wameamini huko Listra na Ikonio
Ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arenge gokwanwa buya nabaminto abamenyete Listra na Ikonio.

English: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
Kiswahili: Paulo alitaka Timotheo afuatane naye, hivyo akamchukua na kumtahiri kwa sababu ya Wayahudi waliokuwa wanaishi eneo lile kwa maana wote walimjua baba yake ni Myunani.
Ekegusii: Paulo agancha Timotheo agende nere, erio akamoira, akamwarokia ase engencho y’Abayahudi abarenge chinsemo chiria, ekiagera bonsi mbamanyete ng’a ise n’Omogiriki orenge.

English: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakienda mji kwa mji, wakawa wanawapa maamuzi yaliyotolewa na mitume na wazee huko Yerusalemu ili wayafuate.
Ekegusii: Nabo, ekero barenge goeta egati y’emechie eria, bakabaa amachiiko aria achiigetwe nabatomwa n’abagaaka abarenge Yerusalemu, erinde bayabwate.

English: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
Kiswahili: Hivyo makanisa yakawa imara katika imani na kuongezeka kiidadi kila siku.
Ekegusii: Nabo, Chikanisa chikabekwa chinguru ase okwegena; omobaro obo okamentekana kera rituko.

English: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
Kiswahili: Paulo pamoja na wenzake wakasafiri sehemu za Frigia na Galatia, kwa kuwa Roho Mtakatifu hakuwaruhusu kulihubiri neno huko Asia.
Ekegusii: Paulo na Timotheo bagaeta ase ense ya Furugia na Galatia, ekiagera bakanetigwe n’Omoika Omochenu ng’a tibarandia ring’ana agwo ase ense y’Asia.

English: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.
Kiswahili: Walipofika mpaka wa Misia, wakajaribu kuingia Bithinia lakini Roho wa Yesu hakuwaruhusu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika chimbebe chi’ense ya Misia, bagateema kogenda Bitinia, korende Omoika o Yeso tobaa ribaga;

English: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakapita Misia, wakafika Troa.
Ekegusii: ase igo, bagaeta ime ya Misia, bagatirimbokera gochia Teroa.

English: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
Kiswahili: Wakati wa usiku Paulo akaona maono, mtu wa Makedonia amesimama akimsihi, “Vuka uje huku Makedonia utusaidie.”
Ekegusii: Ase obotuko Paulo akaorokerwa n’endoto, akarora omonto o Makedonia oteneine okomosorora, okomoteebia: “Koranche, amboka gocha aa Makedonia otokoonye.”

English: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Paulo kuona maono haya, tulijiandaa kwa haraka kuondoka kwenda Makedonia tukiwa tumesadiki kuwa Mungu alikuwa ametuita kuhubiri habari njema huko.
Ekegusii: Magega y’okorora koria, erio bwango kegima tokarigia kogenda Makedonia, ekiagera twaroche ekeene ng’a Nyasae otorangeirie tobaranderie enchiri.

English: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;
Kiswahili: Tukasafiri kwa njia ya bahari kutoka Troa na kwenda moja kwa moja hadi Samothrake, kesho yake tukafika Neapoli.
Ekegusii: Tokamanoria emeeri korwa Teroa, tokagenda boronge goika Samotraki. Rituko rikobwatia togaika Neapoli,

English: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.
Kiswahili: Kutoka huko tukasafiri hadi Filipi, mji mkuu wa jimbo hilo la Makedonia, uliokuwa koloni ya Warumi. Nasi tukakaa huko siku kadhaa.
Ekegusii: na korwa aroro togaika Filipi, omochie ore omonene ase ensemo ya Makedonia, ense yare kogamberwa n’Abarumi. Tokamenya ase omochie oyo amatuko amake.

English: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Sabato tukaenda nje ya lango la mji kando ya mto, mahali ambapo tulitarajia tungepata mahali pa kufanyia maombi. Tukaketi, tukaanza kuongea na baadhi ya wanawake waliokuwa wamekusanyika huko.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria Esabato togasoka isiko y’egeita ase orooche mbarabare, ase ensemo twarengereretie ng’a tonyore aase togosabera. Togaikaransa, togakwana nabakungu abasangererekanete aria.

English: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.
Kiswahili: Mmoja wa wale wanawake waliotusikiliza aliitwa Lidia, mfanyabiashara wa nguo za zambarau, mwenyeji wa mji wa Thiatira, aliyekuwa mcha Mungu. Bwana akaufungua moyo wake akaupokea ujumbe wa Paulo.
Ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo ore korokwa Lidia; ere nigo arenge omosasiimi Nyasae. Nigo arwete omochie o Tiatira; naende nigo arenge omoonia bw’ebitambaa bimonyinga. Omokungu oyo nigo arenge omosasiima o Nyasae. Ere agatotegerera. Omonene akaigora enkoro y’omokuungu oria, erinde akaigwa na gwancha amang’ana Paulo arenge gokwana.

English: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.
Kiswahili: Basi alipokwisha kubatizwa yeye na watu wa nyumba yake, alitukaribisha nyumbani kwake akisema, “Kama mmeona kweli mimi nimemwamini Bwana, karibuni mkae nyumbani mwangu.” Naye akatushawishi.
Ekegusii: Goika omokungu oria ochia kobatiswa, ere amo nab’enyomba yaye, agatosorora na gotobetereria ogoteeba: “Onye mwandorire ng’a n’omwegeni nde ase Omonene, soa nyomba mwane, moikaranse.”

English: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.
Kiswahili: Siku moja, tulipokuwa tukienda mahali pa kusali, tulikutana na mtumwa mmoja wa kike ambaye alikuwa na pepo wa uaguzi. Naye alikuwa amewapa mabwana zake mapato makubwa ya fedha kwa ubashiri.
Ekegusii: Riruko erimo, ekero tware kogenda aase aria tware gosabera, tokaumerana n’omoiseke omosomba oyobwatire n’ekerecha ki’oboringoria. Omoiseke oyio nigo arenge konyorera abanene baye enibo enyinge ase oboringoria bwaye.

English: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”
Kiswahili: Huyu msichana alikuwa akimfuata Paulo na sisi akipiga kelele, “Watu hawa ni watumishi wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, wao wanawatangazieni njia ya wokovu.”
Ekegusii: Omoiseke oyio agatunyana Paulo amo naintwe, ogoaka eriogi ogoteeba: “Abanto aba nabasomba ba Nyasae more, Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, bakoranderia inwe enchera y’ogotooreka.”

English: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.
Kiswahili: Akaendelea kufanya hivi kwa siku nyingi, lakini Paulo akiwa ameudhika sana, akageuka na kumwambia yule pepo mchafu, “Ninakuamuru katika jina la Yesu Kristo, umtoke!” Yule pepo mchafu akamtoka saa ile ile.
Ekegusii: Akana‐gokora ayio amatuko amange. Korende Paulo agakoona, akeonchora, agateebia ekerecha keria: “Nagochikiire ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo. Karue ase omoiseke oyo!” Gekamorua ensa eria eria.

English: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.
Kiswahili: Basi mabwana wa yule mtumwa wa kike walipoona kuwa tumaini lao la kuendelea kujipatia fedha limetoweka, wakawakamata Paulo na Sila wakawaburuta mpaka sokoni mbele ya viongozi wa mji.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero abanene baye bachia korora ng’a ogosemeria kw’enibo yabo gwasirire, bakabwata Paulo na Sila, bakabakurura goika echiiro ase obosio bw’abanene b’omochie.

English: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwafikisha mbele ya mahakimu wakawashtaki wakisema, “Hawa watu wanaleta ghasia katika mji wetu, nao ni Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Bakabaira ase abagaambi, bagateeba: “Abanto aba basaririe omochie oito, na barabwo n’Abayahudi.

English: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”
Kiswahili: Wanafundisha desturi ambazo sisi raiya wa Kirumi hatuwezi kuzikubali au kuzitimiza.”
Ekegusii: Naende nigo bakworokereria chingencho chitari boronge ng’a tochianche gose gochienaria, ekiagera intwe n’Abarumi tore.”

English: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.
Kiswahili: Umati wa watu waliokuwepo wakajiunga katika kuwashambulia Paulo na Sila na wale mahakimu wakaamuru wavuliwe nguo zao na wachapwe viboko.
Ekegusii: Omoganda okabwatana ase okobogerera, na abagaambi bakabatandorera chianga chiabo na gochirusia, bagachiika ng’a baakwe ne chinyimbo.

English: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwachapa sana, wakawatupa gerezani na kumwagiza mkuu wa gereza awalinde kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Kobabaakire amaakwa amange, bakabaruta echela ime, bagachiika omorendi bw’echela abarende mono.

English: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.
Kiswahili: Kufuata maelekezo haya, yule mkuu wa gereza akawaweka katika chumba cha ndani sana mle gerezani, na akawafunga miguu yao kwa minyororo.
Ekegusii: Ere ekero anyorire ogochika oko akabaruta ase akanyomba ka ime, agasoyia amagoro abo ase amakorogoto.

English: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
Kiswahili: Ilipokaribia usiku wa manane, Paulo na Sila walikuwa wakiomba na kuimba nyimbo za kumsifu Mungu, nao wafungwa wengine walikuwa wakiwasikiliza.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero kia botuko gati Paulo na Sila nigo barenge gosaba Nyasae na komoterera amatera, na abasibwa bande nigo babategererete.

English: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.
Kiswahili: Ghafula pakatokea tetemeko kubwa la ardhi, hata msingi wa gereza ukatikisika. Mara milango ya gereza ikafunguka na ile minyororo iliyowafunga kila mmoja ikafunguka.
Ekegusii: Erio mobosokano omotengecho omonene okaba aroro, goika amaroso ’echela agatengechigwa; bwango ebisieri bionsi bikaigoka, na ebisibo bia bonsi bigasansoka.

English: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
Kiswahili: Yule mkuu wa gereza alipoamka na kuona milango ya gereza iko wazi, akachomoa upanga wake akataka kujiua, akidhani ya kuwa wafungwa wote wametoroka.
Ekegusii: Omorendi bw’echela akaboka na akarora ebisieri bi’echela biaigokire, akang’usa omoyio o birende, akarigia gweita, ekiagera akagete ng’a abasibwa mbatamire.

English: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akapiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa, akasema, “Usijidhuru kwa maana sisi sote tuko hapa!”
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaaka eriogi rinene, agateeba: “Tibweita, ekiagera intwe twensi nao tore aa.”

English: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
Kiswahili: Yule askari wa gereza akaagiza taa ziletwe, akaingia ndani ya kile chumba cha gereza, akapiga magoti akitetemeka mbele ya Paulo na Sila.
Ekegusii: Akarigia chitaaya chirentwe, akarindoka gochia ime, okoiguswa ase obwoba, akagwa inse ase amagoro a Paulo na Sila;

English: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
Kiswahili: Kisha akawaleta nje akisema, “Bwana zangu, nifanye nini nipate kuokoka?”
Ekegusii: akabarenta isiko, akababoria: “Abaanene baane, inki ndakore ntooreke?”

English: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Mwamini Bwana Yesu Kristo, nawe utaokoka, pamoja na watu wa nyumbani mwako.”
Ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Mwegene Omonene Yeso, na aye notooreke amo nab’enyomba yao.”

English: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.
Kiswahili: Wakamwambia neno la Bwana yeye pamoja na wote waliokuwako nyumbani mwake.
Ekegusii: Bagakwana ring’ana ri’Omonene asare na ase abanto bonsi abarenge mwaye.

English: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.
Kiswahili: Wakati ule ule, yule mkuu wa gereza akawachukua, akawaosha majeraha yao, kisha akabatizwa yeye pamoja na wote waliokuwa nyumbani mwake bila kuchelewa.
Ekegusii: Akabaroisia ensa eria ya botuko, akabasibia chingoma chiabo, akabatiswa ekero ekio, ere na abanto bonsi ba mwaye.

English: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.
Kiswahili: Akawapandisha nyumbani mwake akawaandalia chakula, yeye pamoja na nyumba yake yote wakafurahi sana kwa kuwa sasa walikuwa wamemwamini Mungu.
Ekegusii: Akabaira mwaye, akabarageria, akagoka mono amo na bonsi b’enyomba yaye, ekiagera konya bamwegenire Nyasae.

English: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka wale mahakimu wakawatuma maafisa wao kwa mkuu wa gereza wakiwa na agizo linalosema, “Wafungue wale watu, waache waende zao.”
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaambi bagatoma abanyanyimbo, bagoteeba: “Tiga abanto abwo bagende!”

English: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”
Kiswahili: Mkuu wa gereza akamwambia Paulo “Mahakimu wameagiza niwaache huru, kwa hiyo tokeni na mwende zenu kwa amani.”
Ekegusii: Omorendi oria bw’echela akairera Paulo amang’ana ayio, agateeba: “Abagaambi batomire amang’ana ng’a mosiborwe; gaki bono, soka isiko, mogende nomorembe!”

English: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akawaambia wale maafisa, “Wametupiga hadharani bila kutufanyia mashtaka na kutuhoji, nao wakatutupa gerezani, hata ingawa sisi ni raiya wa Rumi. Nao sasa wanataka kututoa gerezani kwa siri? Hapana! Wao na waje wenyewe watutoe humu gerezani.”
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo akabateebia: “Bagatosusura maiso marore bataratogambia kina, na intwe n’Abarumi tore, naende bagatoruta echela ime. Inee! Bono barigetie gotosokia bobisi? Yaya! Tari bo; tiga baache abanyene batosokie.”

English: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,
Kiswahili: Wale maafisa wakarudi na kuwaambia wale mahakimu maneno haya, wakaogopa sana walipofahamu kuwa Paulo na Sila ni raiya wa Rumi.
Ekegusii: Abanyanyimbo bakairera abagaambi amang’ana aya, na barabwo bakoboa ekero baigwa ng’a Paulo na Sila n’Abarumi bare.

English: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakaja wakawaomba msamaha, wakawatoa gerezani, wakawaomba waondoke katika ule mji.
Ekegusii: Bagaacha bakabasaba okwaberwa. Erio kobaabasokirie isiko bakababoria barue ase omochie oria.

English: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Paulo na Sila kutoka gerezani walikwenda nyumbani kwa Lidia, ambapo walikutana na wale ndugu walioamini, wakawatia moyo, ndipo wakaondoka.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagasooka korwa ase echela, bagasoa nyomba mwa Lidia. Aroro bakanyorana nabamwabo, bakabaremia. Erio bakaimoka, bakagenda.

English: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
Kiswahili: Wakasafiri kupitia Amfipoli na Apolonia wakafika Thesalonike, ambako kulikuwa na sinagogi la Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Erio kobaetire egati y’Amfipoli na Apolonia, bagaika Tesaloniki aase esinagogi y’Abayahudi yarenge.

English: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
Kiswahili: Kama desturi yake, Paulo aliingia ndani ya sinagogi, na kwa muda wa Sabato tatu akawa anahojiana nao kutoka kwenye Maandiko,
Ekegusii: Na Paulo, buna anarete, agasoa ime aase barenge. Agwo ase Chisabato isato agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana korwa ase amariiko,

English: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”
Kiswahili: akidhihirisha wazi na kuthibitisha kwamba ilikuwa lazima Kristo ateswe na afufuke kutoka kwa wafu. Akasema, “Huyu Yesu ninayewaambia habari zake, ndiye Kristo.”
Ekegusii: akaborokereria na kobateebereria ng’a Kristo nagwenerete gochandwa na koboka korwa ase abakuure, agateeba: “Yeso, oyo nkobaraareria inwe amang’ana igoro yaye, nere Kristo.”

English: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya Wayahudi wakasadiki, wakaungana na Paulo na Sila, wakiwepo idadi kubwa ya Wayunani waliomcha Mungu na wanawake wengi mashuhuri.
Ekegusii: Abande bakang’useka, bakabwatana na Paulo na Sila, naboigo Abagiriki abange abasigete Nyasae amo nabakungu abasike batari bake.

English: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wayahudi ambao hawakuwa wameamini wakawa na wivu, wakawakodi watu waovu kutoka sokoni, wakakutanisha umati wa watu, wakaanzisha ghasia mjini. Wakaenda mbio nyumbani kwa Yasoni wakiwatafuta Paulo na Sila ili kuwaleta nje penye ule umati wa watu.
Ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi bakaba ne ribero, bakaira abanto ababe korwa ase abaomboganu, bagasangereria omoganda, na bagakora eburu‐buru ase omochie. Bagachiera abanto b’enyomba ya Yasoni, bakarigia koira Paulo na Sila isiko ase abanto.

English: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
Kiswahili: Lakini walipowakosa wakamburuta Yasoni na ndugu wengine mbele ya maafisa wa mji, wakipiga kelele: “Watu hawa ni wale walioupindua ulimwengu wamekuja huku,
Ekegusii: Ekero batabanyora, bagakurura Yasoni na abande baminto gochia ase abanene b’omochie, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Abanto aba abaonchoranire ense baikire nonya naa,

English: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”
Kiswahili: naye Yasoni amewakaribisha nyumbani mwake. Hawa wote wanaasi amri za Kaisari wakisema yuko mfalme mwingine aitwaye Yesu.”
Ekegusii: na Yasoni akabaroisia. Barabwo bonsi nigo bagokora chingencho chire mamincha ya Kaisari, bagoteeba ng’a omorwoti onde nareo, okorokwa Yeso.”

English: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia haya, ule umati wa watu na maafisa wa mji wakaongeza ghasia.
Ekegusii: Omoganda oria na abanene b’omochie bagaichana ekero baigwete aya.

English: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
Kiswahili: Nao baada ya kuchukua dhamana kwa ajili ya Yasoni na wenzake wakawaacha waende zao.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo kobanyorire eira y’okobatenenera korwa ase Yasoni na abamwabo, bakabatiga bagende.

English: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
Kiswahili: Usiku ule ule, wale ndugu walioamini wakawapeleka Paulo na Sila waende zao Beroya. Walipowasili huko wakaenda kwenye sinagogi la Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Erio bwango kegima ase obotuko boria abaminto bagatoma Paulo na Sila gochia Beroya. Kobaikire aroro, bagasoa ase esinagogi y’Abayahudi.

English: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
Kiswahili: Hawa Waberoya walikuwa waungwana zaidi kuliko wale wa Thesalonike, kwa kuwa waliupokea ule ujumbe kwa shauku kubwa na kuyachunguza Maandiko kila siku ili kuona kama yale Paulo aliyosema yalikuwa kweli.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi aba nigo baare abaya ase ogotegerera kobua baria ba Tesaloniki; nigo babwatete Ring’ana ase obwanchani, bare kona‐koriga‐rigia amariiko kera rituko, erinde barore gose amang’ana ayio nabo are.

English: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wengi wakaamini pamoja na wanawake na wanaume wa Kiyunani wa tabaka la juu.
Ekegusii: Abange b’abaanto korwa ase bare bakeegena amo nabakungu Abagiriki abaare abasike, na abasacha batari bake.

English: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale Wayahudi wa Thesalonike waliposikia kuwa Paulo anahubiri neno la Mungu huko Beroya, wakaenda huko ili kuwashawishi watu na kuwachochea.
Ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi ba Tesaloniki, ekero baigwete ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae riarandigwe na Paulo ase Beroya, bakagenda aroro bakaburukania abanto na kobarubania.

English: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
Kiswahili: Mara hiyo, wale ndugu wakamsafirisha Paulo hadi pwani, lakini Sila na Timotheo wakabaki Beroya.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima abaminto baria bagatoma Paulo agende goika nyancha, korende Sila na Timotheo bagatigara aroro.

English: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.
Kiswahili: Wale waliomsindikiza Paulo wakaenda naye mpaka Athene, kisha wakarudi Beroya wakiwa na maagizo kutoka kwa Paulo kuhusu Sila na Timotheo kwamba wamfuate upesi iwezekanavyo.
Ekegusii: Baria bakoobete Paulo bakamoikia Atene, na ekero banyorire ogochika koirera Sila na Timotheo ng’a bache asare bwango buna eranyarekane, bakarua aroro.

English: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
Kiswahili: Paulo alipokuwa akiwasubiri huko Athene, alisumbuka sana moyoni mwake kuona vile mji huo ulivyojaa sanamu.
Ekegusii: Ekero Paulo abaganyete aria Atene, akarora buna omochie oria oichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, akaigwa bobe ase omoika oye.

English: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akahojiana kwenye sinagogi na Wayahudi pamoja na Wayunani waliomcha Mungu, na pia sokoni kila siku na watu aliopatana nao huko.
Ekegusii: Nabo ase esinagogi agakwana n’Abayahudi na abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, na kera rituko ase echiiro nabaria abaare gocha aroro.

English: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.
Kiswahili: Kisha baadhi ya Waepikureo na Wastoiko wenye falsafa wakakutana naye. Baadhi yao wakasema, “Je, huyu mpayukaji anajaribu kusema nini?” Wengine wakasema, “Inaonekana anasema habari za miungu ya kigeni.” Walisema haya kwa sababu Paulo alikuwa anahubiri habari njema kuhusu Yesu na ufufuo wa wafu.
Ekegusii: Abande abanyasemi b’Abaepikurio na Abastoiki bakaamererania nere. Abande bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nomonyamang’ana mange, inki arigetie goteeba?” Na abande: “Ororekanire ng’a nigo are buna omorandia bw’amang’ana e chinyasae chingeni”, ekiagera nigo arenge korandia amang’ana a Yeso na okobokigwa kw’abakuure.

English: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?
Kiswahili: Hivyo wakamchukua na kumleta kwenye mkutano wa Areopago, walikomwambia, “Je, tunaweza kujua mafundisho haya mapya unayofundisha ni nini?
Ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoira goika Areopago, bakamobooria: “Inee! Nonyare gototeebia engencho y’okworokereria okwo okoyia ogokwana?

English: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”
Kiswahili: Wewe unaleta mambo mapya masikioni mwetu, hivyo tungetaka kujua maana yake ni nini.”
Ekegusii: Nigo okorenta amang’ana amageni ase amato aito; gaki ntorigetie komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio.”

English: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
Kiswahili: (Waathene na wageni wote walioishi humo hawakutumia muda wao kufanya chochote kingine isipokuwa kueleza au kusikia mambo mapya).
Ekegusii: Abaatene bonsi na abamenyi abamenyete agwo tibarenge ne ribaga ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ogokwana na gotegerera amang’ana amayia.

English: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo akasimama katikati ya Areopago akasema, “Enyi watu wa Athene! Ninaona kwamba katika kila jambo ninyi ni watu wa dini sana.
Ekegusii: Paulo agatenena gati‐gati y’Areopago, akabora: Inwe abasacha b’Atene! Narorire ng’a nigo more abanto abamorengereretie mono amang’ana e chinyasae,

English: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nilipokuwa nikitembea mjini na kuangalia kwa bidii vitu vyenu vya kuabudiwa, niliona huko madhabahu moja iliyoandikwa: Kwa Mungu Asiyejulikana. Basi sasa kile ambacho mmekuwa mkikiabudu kama kisichojulikana, ndicho ninachowahubiria.
Ekegusii: ekiagera ekero narenge goetanana aria na aria, na korora ebisasimero biaino, nkarora egesasiimero keriikire amang’ana aya: GOCHIA ASE NYASAE ORIA OTAMANYEKANETI. Gaki inche nigo nkobaraareria chingencho chiaye ere oria inwe mogosasiima motamanyeti.

English: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.
Kiswahili: “Mungu aliyeumba dunia na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, yeye ndiye Bwana wa mbingu na nchi, hakai katika mahekalu yaliyojengwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, oyotongete ense na ebinto bionsi ebireo, tari komenya ase ebie Hekalu biagachire namaboko, ekiagera nere Omonene o igoro na ense,

English: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.
Kiswahili: Wala hatumikiwi na mikono ya wanadamu kana kwamba anahitaji chochote, kwa sababu yeye mwenyewe ndiye awapaye watu wote uhai na pumzi na vitu vyote.
Ekegusii: gose tari gokorerwa namaboko a Mwanyabaanto, buna oyo oremeire gento, ekiagera nere okobaa bonsi obogima na omoika, na ebinto bionsi.

English: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa mtu mmoja, yeye aliumba mataifa yote ya wanadamu ili waikalie dunia yote, naye akaweka nyakati za kuishi.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase omonto oyomo nere otongete kera egesaku kia Mwanyabaanto kemenye ase ense engima, akababeekera chingaki ne chimbebe chi’Obomenyo bwabo,

English: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.
Kiswahili: Mungu alifanya hivyo ili wanadamu wamtafute na huenda wakamfikia ingawa kwa kupapasapapasa ijapokuwa kwa kweli hakai mbali na kila mmoja wetu.
Ekegusii: erinde barigie Nyasae, nonya nase ogotaba‐taba bamonyore. Nonya nigo tari are korwa ase kera oyomo oito,

English: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
Kiswahili: ‘Kwa kuwa katika yeye tunaishi, tunatembea na kuwa na uzima wetu.’ Kama baadhi ya watunga mashairi wenu walivyosema, ‘Sisi ni watoto wake.’
Ekegusii: ekiagera: Ime asare nigo tore moyo, na togotaara, naende nigo tore nobogima bwaito; koreng’ana buna abarenti chingero bande baino bakwanete: Naki intwe twensi nigo tore ababiare baye.

English: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.
Kiswahili: “Kwa kuwa sisi ni watoto wa Mungu, haitupasi kudhani kuwa uungu ni kama sanamu ya dhahabu au ya fedha au ya jiwe, mfano uliotengenezwa kwa ubunifu na ustadi wa mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: Gaki, onye tore ababiare ba Nyasae, tetogwenereti gokaga ng’a obonyasae nigo bonga buna omogwekano bw’etaabu, gose efeta, gose rigena, buna ebinto bibaachire ase chisemi na obong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto.

English: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
Kiswahili: Zamani wakati wa ujinga, Mungu alijifanya kama haoni, lakini sasa anawaamuru watu wote kila mahali watubu.
Ekegusii: Ebiro biria bi’ogotamanya Nyasae nigo aombetie buna tarochi, korende bono nkoranderia are abanto bonsi ba kera aase baonchoke,

English: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ameweka siku ambayo atauhukumu ulimwengu kwa haki akimtumia mtu aliyemchagua. Amewahakikishia watu wote mambo haya kwa kumfufua Kristo kutoka kwa wafu.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera obekire rituko eri agocha konachera abanto b’ense ekiina ase oboronge ase omonto oria aragete. Ase ayio oeire abanto bonsi ogosemeria ase okomobokia korwa ase abakuure.

English: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”
Kiswahili: Waliposikia habari za ufufuo wa wafu, baadhi yao wakadhihaki, lakini wengine wakasema, “Tunataka kukusikia tena ukizungumza juu ya jambo hili.”
Ekegusii: Nabo ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana ’okobokigwa kw’abakuure abande bagasekereria, na abande bagateeba: “Inatogotegerere naende ase amang’ana ayio.”

English: Thus Paul went out from among them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Paulo akaondoka katikati yao.
Ekegusii: Erio Paulo akaimoka akabatiga.

English: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
Kiswahili: Lakini baadhi yao wakaungana naye wakaamini. Kati yao alikuwepo Dionisio, Mwareopago na mwanamke mmoja aliyeitwa Damari na wengine wengi.
Ekegusii: Abasacha bande bakabwatana nere, bakeegena, na ase abwo narengeo Dionuso, oyomo bw’ekegambero ki’Areopago, naende omokungu oyomo ore korokwa Damari, na abande amo nabarabwo.

English: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, Paulo akaondoka Athene akaenda Korintho.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Paulo akarua Atene, akagenda Korinto.

English: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,
Kiswahili: Huko akakutana na Myahudi mmoja jina lake Akila, mwenyeji wa Ponto, ambaye alikuwa amewasili karibuni kutoka Italia pamoja na mkewe Prisila, kwa sababu Klaudio alikuwa ameamuru Wayahudi wote waondoke Rumi. Paulo akaenda kuwaona,
Ekegusii: Akanyora Omoyahudi oyomo, erieta riaye Akwila, omobiare o Ponto. Ere nigo achete korwa ase ense ya Italia ase amatuko a bwango amo na Priskila mokaye, ekiagera Klaudio konya ochiikire Abayahudi bonsi barue Rumi. Paulo agaika ase bare,

English: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.
Kiswahili: naye kwa kuwa alikuwa mtengeneza mahema kama wao, akakaa na kufanya kazi pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: na ekiagera emeremo yaye na emeremo yabo neyemo, akamenya nabarabwo, bagakora emeremo eye y’okoroisia chiema.

English: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.
Kiswahili: Kila Sabato Paulo alikuwa akihojiana nao katika sinagogi, akijitahidi kuwashawishi Wayahudi na Wayunani.
Ekegusii: Akaborokereria ase chisinagogi kera Esabato, agateema koebereria Abayahudi na Abagiriki.

English: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.
Kiswahili: Sila na Timotheo walipowasili kutoka Makedonia, walimkuta Paulo akiwa amejitolea muda wake wote katika kuhubiri, akiwashuhudia Wayahudi kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Sila na Timotheo bachia gotirimboka korwa Makedonia, Paulo agasukigwa mono ase okorandia ring’ana na koorokia ase Abayahudi nomokia ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.

English: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”
Kiswahili: Wayahudi walipompinga Paulo na kukufuru, yeye aliyakungʼuta mavazi yake, akawaambia, “Damu yenu na iwe juu ya vichwa vyenu! Mimi sina hatia, nimetimiza wajibu wangu. Kuanzia sasa nitawaendea watu wa Mataifa.”
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koamererania nere na komorama, agasamusa chianga chiaye, akabateebia: “Amanyinga aino nabe igoro ase emetwe yaino! Inche tindi na komocha. Korwa bono ningende ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”

English: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaondoka mle kwenye sinagogi, akaenda nyumbani kwa mtu mmoja jina lake Tito Yusto, aliyekuwa mcha Mungu. Nyumba yake ilikuwa karibu na sinagogi.
Ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, agasoa enyomba y’omonto ore korokwa Tito Yusto, omosasiimi Nyasae. Mwaye nigo yasinyaine nesinagogi.

English: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.
Kiswahili: Kiongozi wa hilo sinagogi, aliyeitwa Krispo, akamwamini Bwana, yeye pamoja na watu wote wa nyumbani mwake. Nao Wakorintho wengi waliomsikia Paulo pia wakaamini na kubatizwa.
Ekegusii: Krispo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, akamwege n’Omonene amo nab’enyomba yaye bonsi; na Abakorinto abange kobachia koigwa Paulo, bakeegena, bakabatiswa.

English: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
Kiswahili: Usiku mmoja Bwana akamwambia Paulo katika maono, “Usiogope, lakini endelea kusema wala usinyamaze,
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Paulo botuko ase okorora: “Toiroka, korende kwana, tokira,

English: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
Kiswahili: kwa maana mimi niko pamoja nawe, wala hakuna mtu atakayeweza kukushambulia ili kukudhuru, kwa kuwa ninao watu wengi katika mji huu ambao ni watu wangu.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye, nonya monto onde tari oragoochere, erinde agokore bobe. Naki inche nigo inde n’abanto abange ase omochie oyo.”

English: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Paulo akakaa huko kwa muda wa mwaka mmoja na nusu, akiwafundisha neno la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Akamenya agwo omwaka oyomo na emetienyi etano nomo, akoborokereria ring’ana ria Nyasae ase egati yabo.

English: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati Galio alipokuwa msaidizi wa mwakilishi wa mtawala huko Akaya, Wayahudi waliungana kumshambulia Paulo, wakamkamata na kumpeleka mahakamani.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Galio arenge gabana bw’Akaya, Abayahudi bakarindokera Paulo ase obomo, bakamoira bosio bw’ekegambero,

English: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”
Kiswahili: Wakamshtaki wakisema, “Mtu huyu anawashawishi watu wamwabudu Mungu kinyume cha sheria.”
Ekegusii: bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nigo akoebereria abanto ng’a basasiime Nyasae mamincha y’amachiiko.”

English: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;
Kiswahili: Paulo alipotaka kujitetea, Galio akawaambia Wayahudi, “Kama ninyi Wayahudi mlikuwa mkilalamika kuhusu makosa makubwa ya uhalifu ingekuwa haki kwangu kuwasikiliza.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo achia korigia komaanora omonwa oye, Galio agateebia Abayahudi: “Inwe Abayahudi, onye ring’ana ri’okorega gose okong’ainereria okobe ndiakoregete, rirorio anga naremereria nainwe,

English: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kuwa linahusu maneno, majina na sheria yenu, amueni ninyi wenyewe. Mimi sitakuwa mwamuzi wa mambo haya.”
Ekegusii: korende onye nokoboria igoro ase amang’ana, na amarieta, na amachiiko aino, yarigererie inwe abanyene. Inche tindigeti koba omotorania bw’amang’ana ayio.”

English: So he drove them from the judgment seat.
Kiswahili: Akawafukuza kutoka mahakamani.
Ekegusii: Akabaseria korwa ase ekegambero.

English: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wote wakamkamata Sosthene kiongozi wa sinagogi, wakampiga mbele ya mahakama, lakini Galio hakujali kitendo chao hata kidogo.
Ekegusii: Erio bonsi bakabwata Sostene, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, bakamoaka ase obosio bw’ekegambero. Korende Galio tarora ng’a amang’ana ayio gose ngento.

English: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukaa Korintho kwa muda, Paulo akaagana na wale ndugu walioamini, akasafiri kwa njia ya bahari kwenda Shamu akiwa amefuatana na Prisila na Akila. Walipofika Kenkrea, Paulo alinyoa nywele zake kwa kuwa alikuwa ameweka nadhiri.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya Paulo akamenta komenya agwo amatuko amange, erio agatigana nabamwabo, akamanora agasoa emeeri, akagenda Siiria, na Priskila na Akwila bakagenda amo nere. Ase Kenkrea agakigita etukia yaye, ekiagera ariete eira gete.

English: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
Kiswahili: Walipofika Efeso, Paulo aliwaacha Prisila na Akila huko, lakini yeye akaingia kwenye sinagogi akawa anajadiliana na Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Bagaika Efeso, akabatiga agwo; ere omonyene agasoa esinagogi, agakwana n’Abayahudi.

English: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;
Kiswahili: Walipomwomba akae nao kwa muda mrefu zaidi hakukubali.
Ekegusii: Ekero bamoboretie amente amatuko ande komenya amo nabarabwo, akaanga.

English: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.
Kiswahili: Lakini alipokuwa akiondoka, akaahidi, “Nitarudi kama Mungu akipenda.” Kisha akasafiri kwa njia ya bahari kutoka Efeso.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero agotigana nabarabwo agateeba: “Ning’irane ase more naende, Nyasae karanche.” Akamanora korwa Efeso, akagenda n’emeeri.

English: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.
Kiswahili: Alitia nanga Kaisaria, akaenda Yerusalemu na kulisalimu kanisa, kisha akaenda Antiokia.
Ekegusii: Gaikire Kaisaria, agatiira gochia gokwania abanto b’ekanisa. Erio agatirimboka gochia Antiokia.

English: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukaa huko kwa muda, akaondoka na kwenda sehemu moja hadi nyingine huko Galatia na Frigia, akiwaimarisha wanafunzi wote.
Ekegusii: Magega kamenyire amatuko atai make akaimoka, agaeta egati y’ense ya Galatia na Furugia, agasoa omochie ase omochie, na gokong’ia aborokigwa bonsi.

English: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.
Kiswahili: Basi akaja Efeso Myahudi mmoja, jina lake Apolo, mwenyeji wa Iskanderia. Yeye alikuwa na elimu kubwa, pia alikuwa hodari katika Maandiko.
Ekegusii: Nabo Omoyahudi oyomo, ore korokwa Apolo, omobiare bw’Aleksanderia, agaika Efeso. Ere nigo arenge omonto omanyete gokwana buya, naende nigo arenge omonto omanyete amariiko buya kegima.

English: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa amefundishwa katika njia ya Bwana, naye alikuwa na bidii katika roho, akafundisha kwa usahihi juu ya Yesu, ingawa alijua tu ubatizo wa Yohana.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyo konya bworokererigwe enchera y’Omonene. Ase ayio omoika oye nigo orenge gwoka, agakwana na kworokereria boronge amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, korende ere nigo amanyete ebatiso ya Yohana yoka.

English: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
Kiswahili: Apolo alianza kunena kwa ujasiri mkubwa katika sinagogi. Lakini Prisila na Akila walipomsikia, walimchukua kando na kumweleza njia ya Mungu kwa ufasaha zaidi.
Ekegusii: Agachaaka gokwana noboremu ase esinagogi. Korende ekero Priskila na Akwila bachia komoigwa bakamoira mwabo, bakamworokia enchera ya Nyasae boronge kegima.

English: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
Kiswahili: Naye Apolo alipotaka kwenda Akaya, ndugu wa Efeso walimtia moyo, wakawaandikia wanafunzi huko ili wamkaribishe. Alipofika huko, aliwasaidia sana wale ambao, kwa neema ya Mungu, walikuwa wameamini.
Ekegusii: Ekero arigia kwamboka enyancha gochia Akaya, abaminto bakamoremia, bakariikera aborokigwa b’aroro riruube bamoroisie. Ere gaikire aroro agakonya mono baria abegenete goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae,

English: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa uwezo mkubwa aliwakanusha hadharani Wayahudi waliokuwa wakipinga, akionyesha kwa njia ya Maandiko kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abuete Abayahudi kegima maiso marore, okoborokia korwa ase amariiko ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.

English: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.
Kiswahili: Apolo alipokuwa huko Korintho, Paulo alisafiri sehemu za bara, akafika Efeso. Huko akawakuta wanafunzi kadhaa,
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Apolo arenge Korinto, Paulo agaeta egati y’ense ya rogoro, agaika Efeso. Aroro akanyorana naborokigwa batari bake.

English: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
Kiswahili: akawauliza, “Je, mlipokea Roho Mtakatifu mlipoamini?” Wakajibu, “Hapana, hata hatukusikia kuwa kuna Roho Mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria: “Mwanyorete Omoika Omochenu ekero mwegenete?” Bakamoiraneria: “Yaya, titwana koigwa nonya ng’ake ng’a Omoika Omochenu noreo.”

English: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo akawauliza, “Je, mlibatizwa kwa ubatizo gani?” Wakajibu, “Kwa ubatizo wa Yohana.”
Ekegusii: Akababoria: “Mbatiiso ki mwabatisetwe?” Bakamoiraneria: “Ase ebatiiso ya Yohana.”

English: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”
Kiswahili: Paulo akasema, “Ubatizo wa Yohana ulikuwa wa toba, aliwaambia watu wamwamini yeye atakayekuja baada yake, yaani, Yesu.”
Ekegusii: Paulo akabateebia: “Yohana nigo aare kobatiisa ebatiso y’okoonchoka, ogoteebia abanto bamwegene ere oyorache gocha magega yaye, oyio nere Yeso.”

English: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
Kiswahili: Waliposikia haya, wakabatizwa katika jina la Bwana Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya, bakabatiiswa ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.

English: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.
Kiswahili: Paulo alipoweka mikono yake juu yao, Roho Mtakatifu akawashukia, nao wakanena kwa lugha mpya na kutabiri.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo abekire amaboko aye igoro ase bare, Omoika Omochenu okabaikera; bagachaaka gokwana ase emenwa na kobana.

English: They were about twelve men in all.
Kiswahili: Walikuwa kama wanaume kumi na wawili.
Ekegusii: Na bonsi nigo barenge abasacha koreng’ana ikomi na babere.

English: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.
Kiswahili: Paulo akaingia katika sinagogi na kunena humo kwa ujasiri kwa muda wa miezi mitatu, akijadiliana na watu na kuwashawishi katika mambo ya Ufalme wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Agasoa ase esinagogi ime, agakwana noboremu, akaorokereria abanto engaki y’emetienyi etato, okobaebereria ase amang’ana y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

English: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
Kiswahili: Lakini baadhi yao walikaidi. Walikataa kuamini, na wakakashifu ujumbe wake mbele ya umati wa watu. Basi Paulo aliachana nao. Akawachukua wanafunzi naye, akahojiana nao kila siku katika darasa la Tirano.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero abande bakong’etie chinkoro chiabo, na tibegena, na bagakwana bobe igoro y’Enchera y’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano, akaimoka akabatiga, akarusanania aborokigwa, akaba nkoborokereria are kera rituko ase enyomba y’amorokererio ya Tiriano.

English: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
Kiswahili: Jambo hili likaendelea kwa muda wa miaka miwili, kiasi kwamba Wayahudi na Wayunani wote walioishi huko Asia wakawa wamesikia neno la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akagenderera ase engaki y’emiaka ebere, goika bonsi abamenyete Asia, Abayahudi na Abagiriki, bakaigwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

English: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
Kiswahili: Mungu akafanya miujiza mingi isiyo ya kawaida kwa mkono wa Paulo,
Ekegusii: Nyasae agakora ebikone ebinene mono ase amaboko a Paulo,

English: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
Kiswahili: hivi kwamba leso au vitambaa vilivyokuwa vimegusa mwili wa Paulo viliwekwa juu ya wagonjwa, nao wakapona magonjwa yao, na pepo wachafu wakawatoka.
Ekegusii: goika chianga na ebitambaa ebiakunete omobere oye bikairwa ase abarwaire, na igo bakagwenigwa amarwaire abo, na emeika emebe ekarua ase bare.

English: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”
Kiswahili: Basi baadhi ya Wayahudi wenye kutangatanga huku na huko wakitoa pepo wachafu wakajaribu kutumia jina la Bwana Yesu wale wenye pepo wakisema, “Kwa jina la Yesu, yule anayehubiriwa na Paulo, nakuamuru utoke.”
Ekegusii: Abande b’Abayahudi, abaseria b’emeika emebe, abarenge abaetanani, bagateema gwatora erieta ri’Omonene Yeso igoro y’ababwatire nebirecha ebibe, bagoteeba: “Twabitianirie ase Yeso oria okorandigwa na Paulo.”

English: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.
Kiswahili: Wana saba wa Skewa, Myahudi aliyekuwa kiongozi wa makuhani, walikuwa wanafanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Abakorete ayio nabamura batano na babere ba Sikewa, Omoyahudi orenge Omokuani omonene.

English: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”
Kiswahili: Lakini pepo mchafu akawajibu, “Yesu namjua na Paulo pia namjua, lakini ninyi ni nani?”
Ekegusii: Omoika oria omobe okabairaneria: “Yeso nimomanyete, na Paulo namomanyire, korende inwe mbarabi?”

English: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
Kiswahili: Kisha yule mtu aliyekuwa na pepo mchafu akawarukia, akawashambulia vikali, akawashinda nguvu wote, wakatoka ndani ya ile nyumba wakikimbia wakiwa uchi na wenye majeraha.
Ekegusii: Na omonto oria obwatire n’Omoika omobe akabarindokera, akabanyara, akababua, goika bagatama korwa ase enyomba eria getirianda, bare ne chingoma baakirwe.

English: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
Kiswahili: Habari hii ikajulikana kwa Wayahudi wote na Wayunani waliokaa Efeso, hofu ikawajaa wote, nalo jina la Bwana Yesu likaheshimiwa sana.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akamanyekana ase Abayahudi na Abagiriki bonsi abamenyete Efeso; obwoba bokabasoa bonsi, na erieta ri’Omonene Yeso rikabakwa.

English: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.
Kiswahili: Wengi wa wale waliokuwa wameamini wakati huu wakaja na kutubu waziwazi kuhusu matendo yao maovu.
Ekegusii: Abange babo, abachaagete kwegena, bagaacha, bakaorokia chingencho chiabo chimbe baare gokora.

English: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
Kiswahili: Idadi kubwa ya wale waliofanya mambo ya uganga wakaleta vitabu vyao na kuviteketeza kwa moto hadharani. Walipofanya hesabu ya thamani ya vitabu vilivyoteketezwa ilikuwa drakma 50,000 za fedha.
Ekegusii: Abange ase baria abaare gokora chingencho chi’oboragori, bagasangereria ebitabu biabo, bakabisamba ase amasio y’abaanto bonsi. Kobakorire omobaro bw’erigori ri’ebitabu ebio, bakanyora ng’a mbiisanete chiropia chi’echifeta chilifu emerongo etano.

English: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.
Kiswahili: Hivyo neno la Bwana likaenea sana na kuwa na nguvu.
Ekegusii: Nabo ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaranda, rikabua.

English: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya mambo haya kutukia, Paulo akakusudia rohoni kwenda Yerusalemu kupitia Makedonia na Akaya. Akasema, “Baada ya kufika huko, yanipasa pia kwenda Rumi.”
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya achia koera, Paulo akarengereria ase omoika oye ime goeta egati ya Makedonia na Akaya gochia Yerusalemu, ogoteeba: “Magega konabeire agwo ningwenerete korora omochie o Rumi noro.”

English: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
Kiswahili: Hivyo akatuma wasaidizi wake wawili, Timotheo na Erasto, waende Makedonia, wakati yeye mwenyewe alibaki kwa muda kidogo huko Asia.
Ekegusii: Agatoma abanto babere korwa ase baria baare komokoonya bagende Makedonia, nabwo Timotheo na Erasto. Ere omonyene agatigara Asia ase engaki enke.

English: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo pakatokea dhiki kubwa kwa sababu ya Njia ile ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio eburu‐buru etari nke ekaimoka ase amang’ana ’enchera y’Omonene.

English: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja jina lake Demetrio mfua fedha aliyekuwa akitengeneza vinyago vya fedha vya Artemi na kuwapatia mafundi wake biashara kubwa,
Ekegusii: Ekiagera omonto oyomo ore korokwa Demeturio, omoturi bw’echifeta, oyorenge gokora ebie Hekalu bie chifeta bi’Aritemi, nigo arenge konyorera abaroisia eniibo enyinge.

English: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.
Kiswahili: aliwaita pamoja watu wengine waliofanya kazi ya ufundi kama yake na kusema, “Enyi watu, mnajua ya kuwa utajiri wetu unatokana na biashara hii!
Ekegusii: Akabasangereria abwo amo nabande ab’emeremo eria, akabora: “Inwe abasacha, mwamanyire ng’a obotenenku bwaito nigo bokorwa ase emeremo eye.

English: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.
Kiswahili: Pia ninyi mmeona na kusikia jinsi ambavyo si huku Efeso peke yake lakini ni karibu Asia yote, huyu Paulo amewashawishi na kuvuta idadi kubwa ya watu kwa kusema kuwa miungu iliyotengenezwa na watu si miungu.
Ekegusii: Naende mwarorire na koigwa ng’a Paulo, oyio oebereirie abanto na kobaonchora, tari ase Efeso oka, korende nonya nase Asia yonsi pi, okobateebia ng’a chinyasae chigokorwa namaboko tari chirochio chinyasae.

English: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kuna hatari si kwa kazi yetu kudharauliwa tu, bali pia hata hekalu la mungu mke Artemi, aliye mkuu, anayeabudiwa Asia yote na ulimwengu wote, litakuwa limepokonywa fahari yake ya kiungu.”
Ekegusii: Nabo ere aakong’u ase tore, tari ng’a nemeremo yaito yoka erachaywe, korende nonya ne Hekalu y’Aritemi, enyasae enkuungu ere enene, nigo erabarwe ng’a teri gento. Naende enyasae eria, egosasimwa n’abanto b’Asia yonsi na ab’ense yonsi nigo eraurwe obonene bwaye.”

English: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
Kiswahili: Waliposikia maneno haya, wakaghadhibika, wakaanza kupiga kelele, “Artemi wa Waefeso ni mkuu!”
Ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya bagaichorwa nendamwamu, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Aritemi y’Abaefeso nenene!”

English: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.
Kiswahili: Mara mji wote ukajaa ghasia. Wakawakamata Gayo na Aristarko, watu wa Makedonia waliokuwa wakisafiri pamoja na Paulo, na watu wakakimbilia katika ukumbi wa michezo kama mtu mmoja.
Ekegusii: Omochie bwonsi ogaichorwa neburu‐buru, bakabwata Gayo na Aristariko, abanto ba Makedonia, baare gotaara amo na Paulo, bakabakurura na bakaminyoka amo gochia aase chigosori chigokorerwa.

English: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.
Kiswahili: Paulo akataka kuingia katikati ya umati huo, lakini wanafunzi hawakumruhusu.
Ekegusii: Na Paulo akarigia gosoa ase egati y’abanto, korende aborokigwa tibamwanchera.

English: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.
Kiswahili: Hata baadhi ya viongozi wa sehemu ile, waliokuwa rafiki zake Paulo, wakatuma watu wakitamani asiingie katika ule ukumbi.
Ekegusii: Abande b’abanene b’Asia, abarenge abasani baye, bagatoma abanto asare, bakamosorora tabaisa kweorokia omonyene aase chigosori chigokorerwa.

English: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.
Kiswahili: Ule umati ulikuwa na taharuki. Wengine walikuwa wakipiga kelele, hawa wakisema hili na wengine lile. Idadi kubwa ya watu hawakujua hata ni kwa nini walikuwa wamekusanyika huko.
Ekegusii: Bono abande nigo barenge korera iga, na abande iga, ekiagera omosangererekano oria konya obeire neburu‐buru. Abange ase bare tibamanyete nase ki basangererekanete amo.

English: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wakamsukumia Aleksanda mbele na baadhi ya watu kwenye ule umati wakampa maelekezo. Akawaashiria kwa mkono ili watulie aweze kujitetea mbele ya watu.
Ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagatebereria Alekisanda, oyo Abayahudi bakamosukia ase amaiso ’abaanto. Alekisanda akaimokia okoboko kwaye, akarigia gwekengera.

English: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
Kiswahili: Lakini walipotambua kwamba alikuwa Myahudi, wote wakapiga kelele kwa sauti moja kwa karibu muda wa saa mbili, wakisema, “Artemi wa Efeso ni mkuu!”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero bamomanya ng’a ere n’Omoyahudi, bagakuura bonsi amo ase egeka ki’ang’e chinsa ibere chingima, bakorera: “Aritemi y’Abaefeso nenene!”

English: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?
Kiswahili: Baadaye karani wa mji akaunyamazisha ule umati wa watu na kusema, “Enyi watu wa Efeso, je, ulimwengu wote haujui ya kuwa mji wa Efeso ndio unaotunza hekalu la Artemi aliye mkuu na ile sanamu yake iliyoanguka kutoka mbinguni?
Ekegusii: Omoriki bw’omochie agakiria abanto agateeba: “Inwe abasacha b’Efeso, monto ki ore aa otamanyeti ng’a omochie bw’Abaefeso noro omorendi bwe Hekalu y’Aritemi eria enene, na obw’omogwekano oria ogwete korwa igoro?

English: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa mambo haya hayakanushiki, inawapasa mnyamaze na wala msifanye lolote kwa haraka.
Ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera amang’ana aya takonyara gokanwa, mogwenerete gokira, timokora ring’ana ria bwango.

English: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mmewaleta hawa watu hapa, ingawa hawajaiba hekaluni wala kumkufuru huyu mungu wetu wa kike.
Ekegusii: Naki iga mwarenta abanto aba bataibeti ebinto bie Hekalu gose korama enyasae yaito enkuungu.

English: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.
Kiswahili: Basi, ikiwa Demetrio na mafundi wenzake wana jambo zito dhidi ya mtu yeyote, mahakama ziko wazi na wasaidizi wa mwakilishi wa mtawala. Wanaweza kufungua mashtaka.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, onye Demeturio na ababaachi abare amo nere bare ne ring’ana igoro ase omonto, amatuko ’yokogambigwa nare, na abagaambi mbareo, tiga basoerane.

English: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama kuna jambo jingine lolote zaidi mnalotaka kulileta, itabidi lisuluhishwe katika kusanyiko halali.
Ekegusii: Korende onye more namang’ana ande, nigo araroisigwe nabagaambi ba botambe.

English: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyo sasa, tuko hatarini kushtakiwa kwa kufanya ghasia kwa sababu ya tukio la leo. Kwa kuwa hakuna sababu tutakayoweza kutoa kuhalalisha msukosuko huu.”
Ekegusii: Ekeene obokong’u mbore ase tore, aande mbarigetie gotosoera ase engencho y’eburu‐buru eye ya reero. Karabe igo, rirorio titokonyaara gwekengera ase engencho y’omosangererekano oyo.”

English: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema haya akavunja mkutano.
Ekegusii: Ekero akoorire gokwana aya, akaa omosangererekano ribaga ogende.

English: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
Kiswahili: Baada ya zile ghasia kumalizika, Paulo aliwaita wanafunzi pamoja akawatia moyo, akawaaga, akaanza safari kwenda Makedonia.
Ekegusii: Eburu‐buru eria egachia koera, Paulo akarangeria aborokigwa, akabaremia, agatigana nabarabwo, akaimoka akagenda Makedonia.

English: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.
Kiswahili: Alipita katika sehemu zile, akinena na watu maneno mengi ya kuwatia moyo. Ndipo hatimaye akawasili Uyunani,
Ekegusii: Erio gaetire chinsemo chiria na gokwana amang’ana amange ase okobaremia, agaika Bogiriki.

English: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
Kiswahili: ambako alikaa kwa muda wa miezi mitatu. Alipokuwa anakaribia kuanza safari kwa njia ya bahari kwenda Shamu, kwa sababu Wayahudi walikuwa wamefanya shauri baya dhidi yake, aliamua kurudi kupitia njia ya Makedonia.
Ekegusii: Akamenya aroro emetienyi etato. Ekiagera Abayahudi bamoboerete, konya omanoire kogenda ase enyancha gochia Siiria, agachoora koiranera goetera Makedonia.

English: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
Kiswahili: Paulo alikuwa amefuatana na Sopatro mwana wa Piro, Mberoya, Aristarko na Sekundo kutoka Thesalonike na Gayo, mtu wa Derbe, Timotheo pamoja na Tikiko na Trofimo kutoka sehemu ya Asia.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba bakagenda nere: Sopater Omoberoya, mosinto o Piro, Aristariko na Sekundo, abanto ba Tesaloniki, na Gayo, omonto o Deribe, na Timotheo, na abanto b’Asia, Tukiko na Torofimo.

English: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.
Kiswahili: Hawa watu walitutangulia wakaenda kutungojea Troa.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba bagatang’ana, bagatoganyera Teroa.

English: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi tukasafiri kwa njia ya bahari kwa siku tano kutoka Filipi baada ya siku za Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, nasi tukaungana na wengine huko Troa, ambako tulikaa kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Intwe tokarua Filipi n’emeeri magega y’amatuko y’Emegati etabekiri memera, tokagenda orogendo rw’amatuko atano, tokabaikeera Teroa. Tokabeera aroro amatuko atano na abere.

English: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza ya juma tulikutana pamoja kwa ajili ya kumega mkate. Paulo akaongea na watu, naye kwa kuwa alikuwa amekusudia kuondoka kesho yake, aliendelea kuongea mpaka usiku wa manane.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, ekero twasangererekanete ase ogosamunyora omogati, Paulo agakwana nabarabwo, agachiererera namang’ana aye goika botuko gati, ekiagera arengereretie komanora rituko ria kabere.

English: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.
Kiswahili: Kwenye chumba cha ghorofani walimokuwa wamekutania kulikuwa na taa nyingi.
Ekegusii: Nchiarengeo chitaaya chinyinge ase enyomba ya irongo aase twasangererekanete.

English: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.
Kiswahili: Kijana mmoja jina lake Eutiko, alikuwa amekaa dirishani, wakati Paulo alipokuwa akihubiri kwa muda mrefu, alipatwa na usingizi mzito, akaanguka kutoka ghorofa ya tatu, wakamwinua akiwa amekufa.
Ekegusii: Omomura oyomo, erieta riaye Eutiko, oikaransete ase ekebao, akabwatwa ne chitoro chindito ekero Paulo agendererete gokwana; akabugwa ne chitoro chinyinge akagwa korwa rirongo ria gatato, akabogorigwa konya okuure.

English: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”
Kiswahili: Paulo akashuka chini, akajitupa juu yake na kumkumbatia, akasema, “Msishtuke, uzima wake bado umo ndani yake.”
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaika, akamoumamera, akamoagata, akabora: “Timoichana, ekiagera obogima bwaye nao bore ime yaye.”

English: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.
Kiswahili: Kisha Paulo akapanda tena ghorofani, akamega mkate na kula. Baada ya kuongea mpaka mapambazuko, akaondoka.
Ekegusii: Paulo akariina igoro naende, agasamunyora omogati akaria, agakwana nabarabwo goika bogakia mambia. Erio akaimoka, akagenda.

English: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.
Kiswahili: Watu wakamrudisha yule kijana nyumbani akiwa hai nao wakafarijika sana.
Ekegusii: Bakarenta omomura oria, ore moyo, bakaba nokoremigwa okonene.

English: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.
Kiswahili: Tukatangulia melini tukasafiri mpaka Aso ambako tungempakia Paulo. Alikuwa amepanga hivyo kwa maana alitaka kufika kwa miguu.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe togatang’ana kogenda n’emeeri, tokagenda goika Asosi. Tokarengereria ng’a ntonyore Paulo aria, ekiagera ere nabo achiigete. Ere omonyene nigo arengereretie kogenda namagoro.

English: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.
Kiswahili: Alipotukuta huko Aso, tulimpakia melini, tukasafiri wote mpaka Mitilene.
Ekegusii: Ekero achia gotoikeera aaria Asosi, tokamosoyia ase emeeri, togaika Metilene.

English: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.
Kiswahili: Kutoka huko tuliendelea kwa njia ya bahari, na kesho yake tukafika mahali panapokabili Kio. Siku iliyofuata tukavuka kwenda Samo, na kesho yake tukawasili Mileto.
Ekegusii: Tokamanora korwa agwo, ne rituko ria kabere togaika kororia Kio. Rituko ria gatato togaika Samo, tokabeera Torogilo, ne rituko ria kane togaika Mileto.

English: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
Kiswahili: Paulo alikuwa ameamua tusipitie Efeso ili asitumie muda mwingi huko sehemu za Asia, kwa sababu alikuwa anatamani kama ikiwezekana kufika Yerusalemu kabla ya siku ya Pentekoste.
Ekegusii: Naki Paulo nigo arengereretie goeta Efeso mbarabare, tabaisa goteebana ase Asia, ekiagera nigo are koayerera kogenda Yerusalemu rituko ria Pentekosti, keranyarekane.

English: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
Kiswahili: Paulo akiwa Mileto, alituma mjumbe kwenda Efeso kuwaita wazee wa kanisa waje wakutane naye.
Ekegusii: Korwa Mileto Paulo agatoma abanto kogenda Efeso barangerie abagaaka b’ekanisa.

English: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,
Kiswahili: Walipofika akawaambia, “Ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi nilivyoishi katikati yenu muda wote tangu siku ya kwanza nilipokanyaga hapa Asia.
Ekegusii: Bagachia goika asare, akabateebia. “Inwe abanyene mwamanyire buna narenge egati yaino ekero gionsi korwa rituko rie ritang’ani nachaagete gotacha aiga Asia,

English: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;
Kiswahili: Nilimtumikia Bwana kwa unyenyekevu wote na kwa machozi nikivumilia taabu na mapingamizi yaliyonipata kutokana na hila za Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: buna nakorerete Omonene ase obokanyeku bwonsi, na ase amariga, na ase amateemwa nanyorete ase ogotega kw’Abayahudi.

English: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
Kiswahili: Mnajua kwamba sikusita kuhubiri jambo lolote ambalo lingekuwa la kuwafaa ninyi, lakini nilifundisha hadharani na nyumba kwa nyumba.
Ekegusii: Inche tinabisete ring’ana rinde rionsi eriranyare kobakonya, korende inaborogetie inwe maiso marore enyomba ase enyomba,

English: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
Kiswahili: Nimewashuhudia Wayahudi na Wayunani kwamba inawapasa kumgeukia Mungu kwa kutubu dhambi na kumwamini Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: na ngakuurera Abayahudi na Abagiriki baonchokere Nyasae, na komwegen’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
Kiswahili: “Nami sasa nimesukumwa na Roho, ninakwenda Yerusalemu wala sijui ni nini kitakachonipata huko.
Ekegusii: Gaki bono rora, nkogenda nde Yerusalemu, nasibirwe n’Omoika. Timanyeti ayarachie konyoora aaria,

English: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
Kiswahili: Ila ninachojua tu ni kwamba Roho Mtakatifu amenionya kuwa vifungo na mateso vinaningoja.
Ekegusii: otatiga ng’a Omoika Omochenu nigo okoorokia omochie ase omochie ng’a ogosibwa na emechando mbinganyete.

English: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
Kiswahili: Lakini siyahesabu maisha yangu kuwa ya thamani kwangu, kama kuyamaliza mashindano na kukamilisha ile kazi Bwana Yesu aliyonipa, yaani, kazi ya kuishuhudia Injili ya neema ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende obogima bwane timbobareti ng’a negento kie rigori rinene ase ’nde, erinde nkoore orogendo rwane, na obosomba boria nanyorete ase Omonene Yeso koorokia enchiri y’amaabera a Nyasae.

English: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.
Kiswahili: “Nami sasa najua ya kuwa hakuna hata mmoja miongoni mwenu ambaye nimemhubiria Ufalme wa Mungu katika kwenda kwangu huku na huko, atakayeniona uso tena.
Ekegusii: Bono rora, namanyire ng’a timokondora obosio bwane naende, inwe mwensi aba nabeire ngotaara ase egati yaino na kobaranderia amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

English: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nawatangazia leo, sina hatia ya damu ya mtu awaye yote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nabaorokeirie bonsi ase rituko ria reero, ng’a inche tindi na komocha ase amanyinga a monto onde bwensi,

English: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa sikusita kuwatangazia mapenzi yote ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera tinangete kobaranderia amang’ana ’okworokereria gwonsi kwa Nyasae.

English: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.
Kiswahili: Jilindeni nafsi zenu na mlilinde lile kundi lote ambalo Roho Mtakatifu amewaweka ninyi kuwa waangalizi wake. Lichungeni kanisa lake Mungu alilolinunua kwa damu yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Mwerende inwe abanyene amo ne riicho riria Omoika Omochenu obabegete mobe abarendi korisia ekanisa ya Nyasae, eye enyorerete namanyinga aye omonyene.

English: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
Kiswahili: Najua kwamba baada yangu kuondoka, mbwa mwitu wakali watakuja katikati yenu ambao hawatalihurumia kundi.
