Ekegusii: Namanyire inche ng’a magega ase okoimoka kwane chisese chi’orosana chintindi nachiche ase more, tichirorera riicho amaabera,

English: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
Kiswahili: Hata kutoka miongoni mwenu watainuka watu na kuupotosha ukweli ili wawavute wanafunzi wawafuate.
Ekegusii: naende korwa ase egati yaino abanto mbaimoke bagokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria, bang’use aborokigwa babatunyane.

English: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.
Kiswahili: Hivyo jilindeni! Kumbukeni kwamba kwa miaka mitatu sikuacha kamwe kuwaonya kila mmoja kwa machozi usiku na mchana.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio renda, moinyore ng’a ase emiaka etato, obotuko na omobaso, tinatigete gokuurera kera omonto ase amariga.

English: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
Kiswahili: “Sasa nawakabidhi kwa Mungu na kwa neno la neema yake, linaloweza kuwajenga na kuwapa ninyi urithi miongoni mwa wote ambao wametakaswa.
Ekegusii: Gaki bono nababekire ase amaboko a Nyasae, na ase ring’ana ri’obuya bwaye, asare ere oyoranyaare kobaagacha na kobaa omwando amo nabwo bonsi abachenirwe.

English: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.
Kiswahili: Sikutamani fedha wala dhahabu wala vazi la mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Tinaganetie efeta, nonya netaabu gose chianga.

English: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
Kiswahili: Ninyi wenyewe mnajua kwamba mikono yangu hii imetumika kwa mahitaji yangu na ya wale waliokuwa pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwamanyire ng’a amaboko aya aane ankoreire okorigia kwane, na okw’abwo barenge amo nainche.

English: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”
Kiswahili: Katika kila jambo nimewaonyesha kwamba kwa njia hii ya kufanya kazi kwa bidii imetupasa kuwasaidia wadhaifu, mkikumbuka maneno ya Bwana Yesu mwenyewe jinsi alivyosema, ‘Ni heri kutoa kuliko kupokea.’ ”
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana aya onsi nabaorokeirie ng’a ase ogokora emeremo iga, nebagwenerete mokonye abatari ne chinguru, na koinyora amang’ana ’Omonene Yeso, buna akwanete omonyene: Nasesenirie oyokorua kobua oyokonyoora.”

English: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
Kiswahili: Paulo alipomaliza kusema haya akapiga magoti pamoja nao wote akaomba.
Ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana aya agatung’ama inse, agasaba amo nabarabwo bonsi.

English: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,
Kiswahili: Wote wakalia, wakamkumbatia Paulo na kumbusu,
Ekegusii: Na bonsi bakaiyeria amariga, bakaboania Paulo rigoti riaye, bakamonyunyunta.

English: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
Kiswahili: Kilichowahuzunisha zaidi ni kwa sababu ya yale maneno aliyosema kwamba kamwe hawatauona uso wake tena. Wakaenda naye mpaka kwenye meli.
Ekegusii: Bagaichana kobua ase engencho ye ring’ana riaye, ateebete ng’a: “Timokondora obosio bwane naende.” Bakamokooba goika ase emeeri.

English: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
Kiswahili: Tulipokwisha kujitenga nao, tukaanza safari kwa njia ya bahari moja kwa moja mpaka Kosi. Siku ya pili yake tukafika Rodo na kutoka huko tukaenda Patara.
Ekegusii: Ekero twatananekire nabarabwo na komanora n’emeeri, tokagenda boronge goika Kosi, na ase rituko ria kabere togaika Rodo, na korwa aroro togaika Patara.

English: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
Kiswahili: Hapo tukapata meli iliyokuwa inavuka kwenda Foinike tukapanda tukasafiri nayo.
Ekegusii: Tokanyoora emeeri eyeranyaare kwamboka goika Foiniki, tokariina emeeri eria, tokagenda.

English: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
Kiswahili: Tulipokiona kisiwa cha Kipro, tukakizunguka tukakiacha upande wetu wa kushoto, tukasafiri mpaka Shamu, tukatia nanga katika bandari ya Tiro ambapo meli yetu ilikuwa ipakue shehena yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero twachia korora egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, tokagetiga ensemo y’okobee; tokagenda goika Siiria, togaika Turo; na agwo chigurube chikarusigwa ase emeeri.

English: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwatafuta wanafunzi wa huko, tukakaa nao kwa siku saba. Wale wanafunzi wakiongozwa na Roho wakamwambia Paulo asiende Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Gatwanyorire aborokigwa, tokabeera aroro amatuko atano na abere. Na barabwo bagateebia Paulo ase okobua kw’Omoika Omochenu tatiira gochia Yerusalemu.

English: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.
Kiswahili: Lakini muda wetu ulipokwisha, tukaondoka tukaendelea na safari yetu. Wale wanafunzi pamoja na wake zao na watoto wakatusindikiza hadi nje ya mji. Wote tukapiga magoti pale pwani tukaomba.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aito achia koera, tokaimoka, tokagenda ase orogendo rwaito; na abwo bonsi, na abakungu babo, na abana, bagatokooba goika isiko y’omochie; togatung’ama ase engegu y’enyancha, togasaba.

English: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuagana, tukapanda melini, nao wakarudi majumbani mwao.
Ekegusii: Gatwatebanirie ng’a motigare buya, intwe tokariina emeeri, na barabwo bakairana gochia sobo.

English: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.
Kiswahili: Tukaendelea na safari yetu toka Tiro tukafika Tolemai, tukawasalimu ndugu wa huko, tukakaa nao kwa siku moja.
Ekegusii: Gotwachia gokoora orogendo rwaito korwa Turo, togaika Tolemai, togakwania abaminto, togaikaransa nabarabwo rituko erimo.

English: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata tukaondoka, tukafika Kaisaria. Huko tukaenda nyumbani kwa mwinjilisti mmoja jina lake Filipo, aliyekuwa mmoja wa wale Saba, tukakaa kwake.
Ekegusii: Mambia yaye tokaimoka tokagenda Kaisaria, togasoa enyomba ya Filipo, omorandia bw’enchiri. Nere orenge oyomo bwa baria batano na babere; tokamenya bwoye.

English: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
Kiswahili: Filipo alikuwa na binti wanne mabikira waliokuwa wanatoa unabii.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyo narenge nabaiseke bane abekungi, baare kobana.

English: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kukaa kwa siku kadhaa, akateremka nabii mmoja kutoka Uyahudi jina lake Agabo.
Ekegusii: Gatwamenyire aroro amatuko atai make, omobani oyomo, erieta riaye Agabo, agatirimboka korwa Boyahudi.

English: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”
Kiswahili: Alipotufikia akachukua mshipi wa Paulo akajifunga, akautumia kufunga mikono na miguu yake mwenyewe akasema, “Roho Mtakatifu anasema: ‘Hivi ndivyo Wayahudi wa Yerusalemu watakavyomfunga mwenye mshipi huu na kumkabidhi kwa watu wa Mataifa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Agaacha ase tore, akabogoria orokini rwa Paulo, agesibera amagoro na amaboko, akabora: “Omoika Omochenu oteebire iga: Naboigo Abayahudi ba Yerusalemu barache gosiba omonto omonyene orokini oro, na barabwo nabamobeke ase amaboko ’abaanto b’Ebisaku.”

English: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Tuliposikia maneno haya sisi na ndugu wengine tukamsihi Paulo asiende Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Togachia koigwa aya, intwe na abanto baria tokamosorora tabaisa gotiira gochia Yerusalemu.

English: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akajibu, “Kwa nini mnalia na kunivunja moyo? Mimi niko tayari si kufungwa tu, bali hata kufa huko Yerusalemu kwa ajili ya jina la Bwana Yesu.”
Ekegusii: Erio Paulo akairaneria: “Inki eke mogokora, mokorera na kong’ita omoyo? Nigo inde ang’e, tari ase ogosibwa gwoka, korende nonya nogoitwa ase Yerusalemu ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.”

English: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
Kiswahili: Alipokuwa hashawishiki, tukaacha kumsihi, tukasema, “Mapenzi ya Bwana na yatendeke.”
Ekegusii: Erio kangire amang’ana aito togakira togateeba: “Ogwancha kw’Omonene tiga gokoreke.”

English: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Baada ya haya, tukajiandaa, tukaondoka kwenda Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Magega ase amatuko ayio tokeebeka ang’e togatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.

English: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wanafunzi kutoka Kaisaria wakafuatana nasi na kutupeleka nyumbani kwa Mnasoni, ambaye tungekaa kwake. Yeye alikuwa mtu wa Kipro, mmoja wa wanafunzi wa zamani.
Ekegusii: Abande baborokigwa ba Kaisaria bakagenda amo naintwe, bagatoira mwa Mnasoni, omonto o Kuporo, omworokigwa o kare, tokarara bwoye.

English: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
Kiswahili: Tulipofika Yerusalemu ndugu wakatukaribisha kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Ekero twaigete Yerusalemu abaminto bagatoroisia ase omogooko.

English: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake Paulo pamoja na wengine wetu tulikwenda kumwona Yakobo, na wazee wote walikuwepo.
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia Paulo agasoa mwa Yakobo amo naintwe, na abagaaka bonsi nao barenge.

English: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuwasalimu, Paulo akatoa taarifa kamili ya mambo yote ambayo Mungu alikuwa amefanya miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa kupitia huduma yake.
Ekegusii: Kabakwanirie, akaborokia amang’ana onsi erimo erimo, aya Nyasae akorire ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku ase obosomba bwaye.

English: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusikia mambo haya wakamwadhimisha Mungu. Ndipo wakamwambia Paulo, “Ndugu, unaona kulivyo na maelfu ya Wayahudi walioamini, nao wote wana juhudi kwa ajili ya sheria.
Ekegusii: Barabwo, ekero bachia koigwa, bagatogia Nyasae, bakamoteebia: “Oyominto, kwarorire ng’a Abayahudi chilifu chinyinge begenire; na barabwo bonsi nigo bare nomokia ng’a amachiiko abwatwe.

English: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.
Kiswahili: Lakini wameambiwa habari zako kwamba unafundisha Wayahudi wote waishio miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa kumkataa Mose, na kwamba unawaambia wasiwatahiri watoto wao wala kufuata desturi zetu.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo mbateebetigwe ng’a kworokereirie Abayahudi bonsi abamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku ng’a batige Musa, gokobakania tibarokia abana babo, gose tibabwatia chingencho chiaito.

English: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
Kiswahili: Sasa tufanyeje? Bila shaka watasikia kwamba umekuja Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Inki rende kegwenerete gekorwe? Ekeene, nabo baraigwe ng’a gwachire aiga.

English: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo fanya lile tunalokuambia. Tunao watu wanne hapa ambao wameweka nadhiri.
Ekegusii: Gaki kora ring’ana eri toragoteebie. Mbare aiga ase tore abanto baane abariete eira gete.

English: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na watu hawa, mfanye utaratibu wa ibada ya kujitakasa pamoja nao, na ulipe gharama ili wanyoe nywele zao. Kwa njia hii kila mtu atafahamu ya kuwa mambo waliyosikia si ya kweli na kwamba wewe unaishika sheria.
Ekegusii: Ira abanto aba okore buna engencho y’ogwesibia ere amo nabarabwo, obaakanere chitaabu, erinde bakigite chitukia chiabo. Igo abanto bonsi banyare komanya ng’a amang’ana aria bateebetigwe igoro yao tari ay’ekeene, korende aye omonyene nigo okogenderera buya na kobwata amachiiko.

English: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kuhusu wale watu wa Mataifa walioamini, tumewaandikia uamuzi wetu: kwamba wajitenge na vyakula vilivyotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu, na damu, au kula nyama ya mnyama aliyenyongwa, na wajiepushe na uasherati.”
Ekegusii: Korende ase abanto b’Ebisaku abegenete, twatomire riruube buna twanacha, ng’a beatanane korwa ase ebinto biruure ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa, na korwa ase amanyinga, na korwa ase enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase obotomani.”

English: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
Kiswahili: Ndipo kesho yake Paulo akawachukua wale watu na akajitakasa pamoja nao. Akaingia ndani ya hekalu ili atoe taarifa ya tarehe ambayo siku zao za utakaso zingemalizika na sadaka ingetolewa kwa ajili ya kila mmoja wao.
Ekegusii: Erio Paulo akaira abasacha baria, ne rituko ria kabere agakora buna engencho yare y’ogwesibia amo nabarabwo. Erio agasoa Hekalu ime, ase okoraria amang’ana ’ogwesibia na engaki y’okorua esadaka ase engencho ya kera oyomo obo.

English: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,
Kiswahili: Zile siku saba zilipokaribia kumalizika, baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka sehemu za Asia waliokuwa wamemwona Paulo ndani ya Hekalu, wakachochea umati wote wa watu, nao wakamkamata.
Ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aria atano na abere achia koba ang’e goikeranigwa Abayahudi abarwete Asia bakamorora ase Hekalu ime, bagaseegeta abanto bonsi, bakamobwata,

English: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”
Kiswahili: Wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Waisraeli wenzetu, tusaidieni! Huyu ndiye yule mtu anayefundisha kila mtu na kila mahali, kinyume na watu wetu, sheria zetu na hata Hekalu hili. Zaidi ya hayo amewaleta Wayunani ndani ya Hekalu na kupanajisi mahali hapa patakatifu.”
Ekegusii: bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, tokonye! Omonto oyo nere oria okworokereria abanto ase kera ensemo mamincha y’egesaku giaito, na amachiiko, na aase aiga. Kobua ase aya orentire Abagiriki ase Hekalu ime ogindirie Aase aiga Aachenu riko.”

English: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
Kiswahili: (Walikuwa wamemwona Trofimo, mwenyeji wa Efeso, akiwa mjini pamoja na Paulo wakadhani kuwa Paulo alikuwa amemwingiza Hekaluni.)
Ekegusii: Ekiagera baroche Torofimo Omoefeso amo nere ase omochie, bagakaga ng’a Paulo namosoirie ase Hekalu ime.

English: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.
Kiswahili: Mji wote ukataharuki, watu wakaja wakikimbia kutoka pande zote wakamkamata Paulo, wakamburuta kutoka Hekaluni. Milango ya Hekalu ikafungwa.
Ekegusii: Omochie bwonsi ogatitira, na abanto bakaminyoka gocha amo, bakabwata Paulo, bakamokurura, bakamosokia korwa ase Hekalu. Erio ebisieri bigasiekwa.

English: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakitaka kumuua, habari zikamfikia jemadari wa jeshi la askari wa Kirumi kwamba mji wa Yerusalemu wote ulikuwa katika machafuko.
Ekegusii: Ekero bateemire komoita, amang’ana agaikera omotang’ani bw’abarwani elifu ng’a omochie omogima o Yerusalemu osarekire.

English: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
Kiswahili: Mara yule jemadari akachukua maafisa wengine wa jeshi pamoja na askari wakakimbilia kwenye ile ghasia, wale watu waliokuwa wakifanya ghasia walipomwona yule jemadari na askari wakija, wakaacha kumpiga Paulo.
Ekegusii: Erio bwango akaira abarwani na abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akaminyoka gochia ase bare. Na barabwo bagachia korora omotang’ani oria omonene na abarwani, bagatiga goaka Paulo.

English: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.
Kiswahili: Yule jemadari akaja, akamkamata Paulo akaamuru afungwe kwa minyororo miwili. Akauliza yeye ni nani, na alikuwa amefanya nini.
Ekegusii: Erio omotang’ani oria omonene agaika aroro, akamobwata, agachiika asibwe nebinyuri bibere. Akababoria: “Nere ng’o oyo, naende inki akora?”

English: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya watu katika ule umati wakapiga kelele, hawa wakisema hili na wengine lile. Yule jemadari alipoona kuwa hawezi kupata hakika ya habari kwa sababu ya zile kelele, akaamuru Paulo apelekwe katika ngome ya jeshi.
Ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagaaka eriogi bagoteeba iga, na abande iga. Ekero atanyarete komanya oboronge bw’amang’ana aria ase engencho y’egeturi keria, agachiika arentwe ime ase enyomba y’abarwani.

English: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;
Kiswahili: Paulo alipofika penye ngazi, ilibidi askari wambebe juu juu kwa sababu fujo za ule umati wa watu zilikuwa kubwa.
Ekegusii: Nabo agachia goika ase ebiriinero akabogorigwa nabarwani ase engencho y’obotindi bw’omoganda,

English: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”
Kiswahili: Umati wa watu ulikuwa ukifuata ukiendelea kupiga kelele ukisema, “Mwondoe huyu!”
Ekegusii: ekiagera omoganda bw’abaanto omotunyanete, ogoaka egeturi, ogateba: “Morusieo oyo!”

English: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?
Kiswahili: Mara tu Paulo alipokaribia kuingizwa kwenye ngome ya jeshi, akamwambia yule jemadari, “Je, naweza kukuambia jambo moja?” Yule jemadari akamjibu, “Je, unajua Kiyunani?
Ekegusii: Na Paulo, ekero aikigwe ang’e gosoigwa ime ase enyomba y’abarwani, akaboria omotang’ani oria omonene: “Ninyore ribaga ngoteebie ring’ana?” Omotang’ani oria akabora: “Inee! Nomanyete Ekegiriki?

English: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
Kiswahili: Je, wewe si yule Mmisri ambaye siku hizi za karibuni alianzisha uasi akaongoza kundi la magaidi 4,000 wenye silaha jangwani?”
Ekegusii: Aye tori Omomisiri oria, ere reero iga oseegeta abanto baria Abaiti chilifu inye, akabatang’ana gochia ase erooro?”

English: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
Kiswahili: Paulo akajibu, “Mimi ni Myahudi, mzaliwa wa Tarso, huko Kilikia, raiya wa mji maarufu. Tafadhali niruhusu nizungumze na hawa watu.”
Ekegusii: Paulo akamoiraneria: “Inche n’Omoyahudi, omonto o Tariso, omochie o Kilikia, omobiare bw’omochie otari moke; nagosabire ong’e ribaga nkwane n’abanto aba.”

English: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,
Kiswahili: Akiisha kupata ruhusa ya yule jemadari, Paulo akasimama penye ngazi akawapungia watu mkono ili wanyamaze. Wote waliponyamaza kimya, Paulo akazungumza nao kwa lugha ya Kiebrania, akasema:
Ekegusii: Erio ekero amoete ribaga, Paulo agatenena ase ebiriinero igoro, akabakiria nokoboko abanto baria. Kabakiririe kegima, agakwana nabarabwo ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania, agateeba.

English: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
Kiswahili: “Ndugu zangu na baba zangu, sikilizeni utetezi wangu.”
Ekegusii: “Inwe abaminto, na abatata, ntegerera aya ngwekengera omonyene ase more bono.”

English: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,
Kiswahili: Waliposikia akisema kwa lugha ya Kiebrania, wakanyamaza kimya kabisa. Ndipo Paulo akasema,
Ekegusii: Na ekero bachia koigwa ng’a nigo agokwana nabarabwo ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania, bakamenta gokira. Agakwana.

English: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.
Kiswahili: “Mimi ni Myahudi, niliyezaliwa Tarso huko Kilikia, lakini nimelelewa katika mji huu. Miguuni mwa Gamalieli, nilifundishwa kikamilifu katika sheria ya baba zetu, na nikawa mwenye juhudi kwa ajili ya Mungu kama kila mmoja wenu alivyo leo.
Ekegusii: “Inche n’Omoyahudi, naiboreretwe Tariso, omochie o Kilikia, nkarererwa ase omochie oyo ase amagoro a Gamalieli, nkorokererigwa bokong’u amachiiko ye chisokoro chiaito. Nkaba omonto oyore nomokia ase Nyasae, buna inwe mwensi more reero iga.

English: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,
Kiswahili: Niliwatesa watu wa Njia hii hadi kufa, nikiwakamata waume kwa wake na kuwatupa gerezani,
Ekegusii: Ngachanda abanto b’Enchera eye goika nkabaita bagakwa, ngasiba abasacha na abakungu na kobabeeka echela ime,

English: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.
Kiswahili: kama kuhani mkuu na baraza zima la wazee wanavyoweza kushuhudia kunihusu. Hata nilipokea barua kutoka kwao kwenda kwa ndugu wale wa Dameski, nami nikaenda huko ili kuwaleta watu hawa Yerusalemu kama wafungwa ili waadhibiwe.
Ekegusii: buna Omokuani omonene na abagaaka bonsi b’ekegambero bare kirori ase ’nde. Naetwe amarube nabarabwo ing’ire ase abaminto abarenge Damesiki, erio mbarente abarenge agwo, mbaire Yerusalemu basibire erinde baegwe egesusuro.

English: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.
Kiswahili: “Nilipokuwa njiani kuelekea Dameski, yapata saa sita mchana, ghafula nuru kubwa kutoka mbinguni ikanimulika kotekote.
Ekegusii: “Erio ekero nare kogenda, konaikire ang’e na Damesiki, ekero kia mobaso gati mobosokano amasase akarwa igoro akambarera chinsemo chionsi.

English: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
Kiswahili: Nikaanguka chini, nikasikia sauti ikiniambia, ‘Sauli, Sauli! Mbona unanitesa?’
Ekegusii: Nkagwa inse, nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia: Saulo, Saulo, nase ki gwanchandire?

English: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’
Kiswahili: “Nikajibu, ‘Wewe ni nani Bwana?’ “Naye akaniambia, ‘Mimi ni Yesu wa Nazareti unayemtesa.’
Ekegusii: Nkairaneria: Naye ng’Omonene? Aganteebia: Ninche Yeso o Nazareti oyogwachandire aye.

English: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.
Kiswahili: Basi wale watu waliokuwa pamoja nami waliiona ile nuru, lakini hawakuisikia sauti ya yule aliyekuwa akisema nami.
Ekegusii: Na baria barenge amo nainche mbaroche amasase aria, korende tibaigwete eriogi ri’oria ore gokwana nainche.

English: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’
Kiswahili: “Nikauliza, ‘Nifanye nini Bwana?’ “Naye Bwana akaniambia, ‘Inuka uingie Dameski, huko utaambiwa yote yakupasayo kufanya.’
Ekegusii: Nkaboria: Ninki ndakore Omonene? Omonene aganteebia: Imoka ogende goika Damesiki, agwo noteebigwe onsi aya gwachiikirwe oyakore.

English: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nilikuwa siwezi kuona kwa ajili ya mngʼao wa ile nuru, wenzangu wakanishika mkono wakaniongoza kuingia Dameski.
Ekegusii: Na ekero nasinyetwe korora ase engencho y’oborabu bw’amasase aria, nkaraagwa namaboko abo abarenge amo nainche, ngaika Damesiki.

English: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,
Kiswahili: “Mtu mmoja mcha Mungu, jina lake Anania, alikuja kuniona. Alizishika sana sheria zetu, na aliheshimiwa sana na Wayahudi waliokuwa wakiishi huko Dameski.
Ekegusii: “Erio omonto oyomo ore korokwa Anania, omoiroki Nyasae ase ogotunyana amachiiko, ore gokwanwa buya n’Abayahudi bonsi abamenyete agwo,

English: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.
Kiswahili: Akasimama karibu nami, akasema, ‘Ndugu Sauli, pata kuona tena!’ Saa ile ile nikapata kuona tena, nami nikaweza kumwona.
Ekegusii: aganchichera agatenena ang’e nainche, aganteebia: Oyominto Saulo, nyora okorora. Ase ensa eria eria nkanyora okorora, nkamorora.

English: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.
Kiswahili: “Akasema, ‘Mungu wa baba zetu amekuchagua wewe ili ujue mapenzi yake, umwone yeye Aliye Mwenye Haki na upate kusikia maneno kutoka kinywani mwake.
Ekegusii: Aganteebia: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito ogochorire onyare komanya ogwancha kwaye, na korora Omonyene Oboronge, na koigwa eriogi rikorwa ase omonwa oye.

English: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa utakuwa shahidi wake kwa watu kuhusu kile ulichokiona na kukisikia.
Ekegusii: Naki nomobeere kirori ase abanto bonsi igoro y’amang’ana aya kwarorire na koyaigwa.

English: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, mbona unakawia? Inuka, ukabatizwe na dhambi zako zikasafishwe, ukiliita Jina lake.’
Ekegusii: Gaki bono, inki ogotebanera? Tenena obatiswe, bwesibie ebibe biao, orangerie erieta riaye.

English: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance
Kiswahili: “Baada ya kurudi Yerusalemu, nilipokuwa ninaomba Hekaluni, nilipitiwa na usingizi wa ghafula
Ekegusii: “Ekero nairanete Yerusalemu, ngosaba narenge ase Hekalu ime, nkabwatwa nobogondereria,

English: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’
Kiswahili: nikamwona Bwana akiniambia, ‘Harakisha utoke Yerusalemu upesi, maana hawataukubali ushuhuda wako kunihusu mimi.’
Ekegusii: nkarora Omonene aroro, ogonteebia: Ayerera, karue Yerusalemu bwango, ekiagera tibagwancha oborori bwao igoro yane.

English: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.
Kiswahili: “Nami nikasema, ‘Bwana, wao wenyewe wanajua jinsi nilivyokwenda kwenye kila sinagogi ili kuwatupa gerezani na kuwapiga wale waliokuamini.
Ekegusii: Na inche nkaboora: Omonene, barabwo mbamanyete ng’a nigo narenge gosiba baria bakwegenete na kobaaka ase chisinagogi chionsi.

English: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’
Kiswahili: Wakati damu ya shahidi wako Stefano ilipomwagwa, mimi mwenyewe nilikuwa nimesimama kando, nikikubaliana na kitendo hicho na kutunza mavazi ya wale waliomuua.’
Ekegusii: Ekero amanyinga a Stefano, kirori oo, agoiterwa, inche nao narenge nateneine ang’e, ngancha aitwe, nkarenda chianga chiabo baria abamoitete.

English: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”
Kiswahili: “Ndipo Bwana akaniambia, ‘Nenda, kwa maana nitakutuma mbali, kwa watu wa Mataifa.’ ”
Ekegusii: Nere aganteebia: Genda, ekiagera inche ningotome aare ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”

English: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”
Kiswahili: Ule umati wa watu wakamsikiliza Paulo mpaka aliposema neno hilo, ndipo wakapaza sauti zao na kupiga kelele wakisema, “Mwondoeni duniani, hafai kuishi!”
Ekegusii: Bagategerera Paulo goika ring’ana riria rigakwanwa. Erio bagaaka eriogi riabo, bagateeba: “Morusieo oyo ase ense, ekiagera tagwenereti abe moyo.”

English: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakipiga kelele na kutoa mavazi yao huku wakirusha mavumbi juu hewani,
Ekegusii: Bagachia kona‐goaka egeturi na gotandora chianga chiabo na gosiara‐siara ebuse gochia igoro.

English: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.
Kiswahili: yule jemadari akaamuru Paulo aingizwe kwenye ngome. Akaelekeza kwamba achapwe viboko na aulizwe ili kujua kwa nini watu walikuwa wanampigia kelele namna hiyo.
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’abarwani elifu agachiika arentwe ime ase enyomba enene y’abarwani, agachiika aborigwe amang’ana aye ase okong’wanigwa emecharichi, erinde amanye engencho bakomwogerera eriogi buna eri.

English: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”
Kiswahili: Lakini walipokwisha kumfunga kwa kamba za ngozi ili wamchape viboko, Paulo akamwambia kiongozi wa askari aliyekuwa amesimama pale karibu naye, “Je, ni halali kwenu kwa mujibu wa sheria kumchapa mtu ambaye ni raiya wa Rumi hata kabla hajapatikana na hatia?”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero bamosibire engori, Paulo akaboria omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, oyo oteneine ang’e nere: “Inee! Mboronge kong’wania omonto Omorumi emecharichi, na ere ataranacherwa ekiina?”

English: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”
Kiswahili: Yule kiongozi aliposikia maneno haya, alimwendea yule jemadari na kumwambia, “Unataka kufanya nini? Kwa maana huyu mtu ni raiya wa Rumi.”
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria ochia koigwa aya, akagenda akoorokia omotang’ani oria omonene, akabora: “Naki origetie gokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo n’Omorumi are.”

English: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”
Kiswahili: Yule jemadari akaja akamuuliza Paulo, “Niambie, wewe ni raiya wa Rumi?” Paulo akajibu, “Naam, hakika ndiyo.”
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria omonene agacha, akamoteebia: “Nteebia, n’Omorumi ore?” Agateeba: “Ee.”

English: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo yule jemadari akasema, “Mimi ilinigharimu kiasi kikubwa cha fedha kupata uraia wangu.” Paulo akasema “Lakini mimi ni raiya wa Rumi kwa kuzaliwa.”
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria, omonene akairaneria: “Inche nigo nagorete obobiare obo ase chitaabu chinyinge.” Paulo agateeba: “Inche n’Omorumi omobiare.”

English: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.
Kiswahili: Mara wale waliokuwa wanataka kumhoji wakajiondoa haraka, naye yule jemadari akaingiwa na hofu alipotambua ya kuwa amemfunga Paulo, ambaye ni raia wa Rumi, kwa minyororo.
Ekegusii: Erio baria barenge ang’e komoboria bakaimoka, bakamotiga bwango, na oria omotang’ani omonene akoboa ekero aigwa ng’a n’Omorumi are, na konya omosibire.

English: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake, kwa kuwa yule jemadari alitaka kujua hakika kwa nini Paulo alikuwa anashutumiwa na Wayahudi, alimfungua, na akawaagiza viongozi wa makuhani na baraza lote likutane. Kisha akamleta Paulo, akamsimamisha mbele yao.
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia akarengereria komanya boronge nase engencho ki asoeirwe n’Abayahudi, akamosibora, agachiika abakuani abanene na abanto b’ekegambero bonsi bache. Agatirimbokia Paulo, akamobeka ase amasio abo.

English: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”
Kiswahili: Paulo akawakazia macho wale wajumbe wa baraza, akasema, “Ndugu zangu, nimetimiza wajibu wangu kwa Mungu kwa dhamiri safi kabisa hadi leo.”
Ekegusii: Paulo akarigereria mono abanto b’ekegambero, akabora: “Baminto, nabeireo ase obosio bwa Nyasae goika reero iga, na enkoro yane tekongambia.”

English: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya jambo hili kuhani mkuu Anania akaamuru wale waliokuwa karibu na Paulo wampige kofi kinywani.
Ekegusii: Anania, Omokuani omonene, agachiika baria bateneine ang’e nere bamoake omonwa oye.

English: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo akamwambia, “Mungu atakupiga wewe, ewe ukuta uliopakwa chokaa! Wewe umeketi hapo ili kunihukumu kwa mujibu wa sheria, lakini wewe mwenyewe unakiuka sheria kwa kuamuru kwamba nipigwe kinyume cha sheria!”
Ekegusii: Erio Paulo akamoteebia: “Nyasae nagoake aye, enyasi eakire echooka! Aye gwaikaransire konachera inche ekiina boronge koreng’ana buna ogochika, naende kogoteeba mamincha y’amachiiko ng’a ng’akwe?”

English: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”
Kiswahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu na Paulo wakamwambia, “Je, wewe wathubutu kumtukana kuhani mkuu wa Mungu?”
Ekegusii: Baria bateneine ang’e nere bakaboora: “Inee! Naye okorama Omokuani omonene o Nyasae?”

English: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”
Kiswahili: Paulo akajibu, “Ndugu zangu, sikujua kwamba yeye alikuwa kuhani mkuu. Kwa maana imeandikwa, ‘Usimnenee mabaya kiongozi wa watu wako.’ ”
Ekegusii: Paulo agateeba ng’a: “Tinamanyete baminto ng’a ere n’Omokuani omonene, naki nariikire: Tokwana bobe omogambi bw’abaanto bao.”

English: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”
Kiswahili: Paulo alipotambua ya kuwa baadhi yao walikuwa Masadukayo na wengine ni Mafarisayo, akapaza sauti kwenye baraza, “Ndugu zangu, mimi ni Farisayo, mwana Farisayo. Hapa nimeshtakiwa kuhusu tumaini langu katika ufufuo wa wafu.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Paulo achia komanya ng’a ensemo eyemo n’Abasadukai, na ensemo ya kabere n’Abafarisai, agaaka eriogi ase ekegambero keria, agateeba: “Abaminto, inche n’Omofarisai, omwana bw’Abafarisai; inche nigo nkogambigwa ase engencho y’ogosemeria na ase okobokigwa kw’abakuure.”

English: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.
Kiswahili: Aliposema haya, farakano likaanza kati ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo na baraza lote likagawanyika.
Ekegusii: Erio gakwanire aya, ogwatananekana gokaba egati y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai, na omosangererekano ogaatananekana.

English: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.
Kiswahili: (Kwa maana Masadukayo wanasema kwamba hakuna ufufuo, wala hakuna malaika au roho, lakini Mafarisayo wanaamini haya yote.)
Ekegusii: Naki Abasadukai nigo bagokana ng’a kobokigwa tikori, nonya nabamalaika, nonya nemeika, korende Abafarisai nigo bagwancha onsi.

English: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”
Kiswahili: Kukawa na ghasia kubwa, nao baadhi ya walimu wa sheria ambao ni Mafarisayo, wakasimama wakapinga kwa nguvu wakisema, “Hatuoni kosa lolote la mtu huyu! Huenda ikawa roho au malaika amezungumza naye”
Ekegusii: Bikaba ebituri ebinge; aborokia b’amariiko b’ensemo y’Abafarisai bagatenena, bakamobuna, bagoteeba: “Titorochi bobe bonde ase omonto oyo. Aande onye n’Omoika gose omomalaika okwanire nere?”

English: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.
Kiswahili: Ugomvi ukawa mkubwa kiasi kwamba yule jemadari akahofu kuwa wangemrarua Paulo vipande vipande, akaamuru vikosi vya askari vishuke na kumwondoa Paulo katikati yao kwa nguvu na kumleta ndani ya ngome ya jeshi.
Ekegusii: Ekero eriomana rinene riachia kooroka, omotang’ani oria omonene akoboa ng’a Paulo nabaise kobutoranwa nabarabwo, agachiika abarwani baike na komotaboria korwa ase amaboko abo, na komorenta ase enyomba enene y’abarwani.

English: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”
Kiswahili: Usiku uliofuata, Bwana akasimama karibu naye akamwambia, “Jipe moyo! Kama vile ulivyonishuhudia hapa Yerusalemu, hivyo imekupasa kunishuhudia huko Rumi pia.”
Ekegusii: Obotuko bori’Omonene agatenena ang’e nere, akamoteebia: “Remia enkoro, ekiagera buna kwamberete kirori Yerusalemu, nekogwenerete kombera boigo Rumi.”

English: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka Wayahudi wakafanya shauri pamoja na kujifunga kwa kiapo kwamba hawatakula wala kunywa mpaka wawe wamemuua Paulo.
Ekegusii: Bogachia gokiamoka, Abayahudi bakabwatana komoboera Paulo, bagatianania ng’a tibakoria gose tibakonywa goika bamoitire.

English: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.
Kiswahili: Waliofanya mpango huo walikuwa zaidi ya watu arobaini.
Ekegusii: Abwo batiananetie nigo barenge abanto kobua emerongo ene.

English: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
Kiswahili: Wakawaendea viongozi wa makuhani na wazee na kusema, “Tumejifunga pamoja kwa kiapo kwamba hatutakula wala kunywa mpaka tuwe tumemuua Paulo.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka, bakaboora: “Ntwatiananetie bokong’u ng’a titoria gento goika twaitire Paulo.

English: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, wewe pamoja na baraza, inawapasa mkamjulishe jemadari ili amteremshe Paulo kwenu, mjifanye kama mnataka kufanya uchunguzi wa kina zaidi wa shauri lake. Nasi tuko tayari kumuua kabla hajafika hapa.”
Ekegusii: Gaki bono inwe amo nab’ekegambero moteebie omotang’ani oria omonene amotirimbokie gocha ase more, buna inwe morigetie komanya chingencho chiaye buya kobua; na intwe nigo tore ang’e komoita ritang’ani ataraika ase more.”

English: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtoto wa dada yake Paulo aliposikia juu ya shauri hilo baya, alikwenda kule kwenye ngome ya askari na kumweleza Paulo.
Ekegusii: Omoigwa o Paulo akaigwa amang’ana igoro y’okoboera kwabo, akagenda, agasoa ime ase enyomba enene, akamanyia Paulo amang’ana ayio.

English: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo akamwita mmoja wa viongozi wa askari, akamwambia, “Mpeleke huyu kijana kwa jemadari, analo jambo la kumweleza.”
Ekegusii: Paulo akarangeria oyomo bw’abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akamoteebia: “Ira omomura oyo ase omotang’ani omonene, ekiagera nabwate ring’ana akomoteebia.”

English: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo yule kiongozi wa askari akampeleka yule kijana kwa jemadari, akamwambia, “Paulo yule mfungwa aliniita na kuniomba nimlete huyu kijana kwako, kwa sababu ana neno la kukueleza.”
Ekegusii: Erio akamoimokia, akamoira ase omotang’ani oria omonene, akamoteebia: “Paulo, oria omosibwa nandangeria, omboria nkorentere omomura oyo, ekiagera nare ne ring’ana akogoteebia.”

English: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”
Kiswahili: Yule jemadari akamshika yule kijana mkono, akampeleka kando na kumuuliza, “Unataka kuniambia nini?”
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria omonene akamobwata okoboko, akagenda nere ensemo, akamobooria bobisi: “Ing’ana ki obwate origetie gonteebia?”

English: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.
Kiswahili: Yule kijana akasema, “Wayahudi wamekubaliana wakuombe umpeleke Paulo kwenye baraza lao kesho kwa kisingizio kwamba wanataka kufanya uchunguzi wa kina wa shauri lake.
Ekegusii: Akabora: “Abayahudi babwatanire kogosaba otirimbokie Paulo gochia bosio bw’ekegambero ankio, buna igo barigetie komanya chingencho chiaye buya kobua.

English: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”
Kiswahili: Lakini usishawishiwe nao kwa maana zaidi ya watu arobaini wanamvizia. Wamejifunga kwa kiapo kwamba hawatakula wala kunywa mpaka wawe wamemuua Paulo. Sasa wako tayari, wanangoja idhini yako kwa ajili ya ombi lao.”
Ekegusii: Gaki aye tibwancha, ekiagera abanto kobua emerongo ene bamoboeire, batiananirie ng’a tibakoria gose tibakonywa goika bamoitire; na barabwo nigo bare ang’e baganyete eira korwa ase ore.”

English: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”
Kiswahili: Yule jemadari akamruhusu yule kijana aende na akamwonya, akisema, “Usimwambie mtu yeyote kwamba umenieleza habari hizi.”
Ekegusii: Erio omotang’ani oria omonene agatiga omomura oria agende, akamoteebia: “Toteebia monto onde ng’a kwamanyirie aya.”

English: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”
Kiswahili: Kisha yule jemadari akawaita viongozi wake wawili wa askari akawaambia, “Jiandaeni kuondoka saa tatu usiku huu kuelekea Kaisaria pamoja na askari 200, wapanda farasi sabini na watu 200 wenye mikuki.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio akarangeria babere b’abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akabateebia: “Beka ang’e abarwani amagana abere, na abarwani abariini chibarasi emerongo etano na ebere, na abare namatimo amagana abere ase okogenda Kaisaria chinsa isato chia botuko.

English: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
Kiswahili: Pia tayarisheni na farasi watakaotumiwa na Paulo, mkampeleke salama kwa mtawala Feliksi.”
Ekegusii: Naende beka ang’e chibarasi bariinie Paulo, momoire buya ase Feliki, gabana.”

English: He wrote a letter like this:
Kiswahili: Kisha akaandika barua kwa Feliksi kama ifuatavyo:
Ekegusii: Akarika riruube iga:

English: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.
Kiswahili: Klaudio Lisia, Kwa Mtawala, Mtukufu Feliksi: Salamu.
Ekegusii: “Ase omosike gabana Feliki. Inche Klaudio Lisia, nagokwanirie.

English: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.
Kiswahili: Mtu huyu alikamatwa na Wayahudi wakakaribia kumuua, lakini nikaja na vikosi vyangu vya askari nikamwokoa, kwa kuwa nilipata habari kwamba yeye ni raiya wa Rumi.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyo nigo abwatwa n’Abayahudi, na barabwo bakaba ang’e komoita. Erio ngacha nomoganda bw’abarwani, nkamotooria, konya nanyorire amang’ana ng’a n’Omorumi are.

English: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.
Kiswahili: Nilitaka kujua kwa nini walikuwa wanamshutumu, hivyo nikamleta mbele ya baraza lao.
Ekegusii: Naende nkarigia komanya engencho yaye bakomosoera, nkamotirimbokia na komobeka bosio bw’ekegambero kiabo.

English: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.
Kiswahili: Ndipo nikaona kuwa alikuwa anashutumiwa kwa mambo yanayohusu sheria yao, lakini hakuwa ameshtakiwa kwa jambo lolote linalostahili kifo au kifungo.
Ekegusii: Nkanyora ng’a nigo asoeirwe ase engencho y’amaborio ’amachiiko abo, korende tasoeiri ase ring’ana rigwenerete agoitwa nonya ngosibwa.

English: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”
Kiswahili: Nilipoarifiwa kuwa kulikuwa na shauri baya dhidi ya mtu huyu, nilimtuma kwako mara moja. Niliwaagiza washtaki wake pia waeleze mashtaka yao dhidi yake mbele yako.
Ekegusii: Ekero nanyora amang’ana ng’a Abayahudi bamoboereire omonto oyo, ngachora komotoma ase ore erio kegima, ngachiika abamosoeri bache bakwane amang’ana igoro yaye ase obosio bwao.”

English: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
Kiswahili: Hivyo askari, kwa kufuata maelekezo waliyopewa, wakamchukua Paulo wakati wa usiku na kumleta mpaka Antipatri.
Ekegusii: Erio abarwani baria bakaimokia Paulo buna bachiigetwe, bakamoira gochia Antipatiri ase obotuko boria.

English: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake wakawaacha wale wapanda farasi waendelee na safari wakiwa na Paulo, wao wakarudi kwenye ngome ya askari.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwakia mambia bagatiga abarwani be chibarasi bagenderere norogendo na Paulo, na barabwo abanyene bakairana ase enyomba enene y’abarwani.

English: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.
Kiswahili: Askari walipofika Kaisaria, walimpa mtawala ile barua, na kumkabidhi Paulo kwake.
Ekegusii: Abarwani baria be chibarasi bagachia goika Kaisaria, bakaa gabana riruube riria, bakabeeka na Paulo ase obosio bwaye.

English: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,
Kiswahili: Mtawala alipokwisha kuisoma ile barua alimuuliza Paulo alikuwa mtu wa jimbo gani. Alipojua kuwa anatoka Kilikia,
Ekegusii: Ekero arisomire, akaboria: “Omonto oyo noyo bw’ense ki?” Ekero aigwete ng’a nomonto o Kilikia, agateeba,

English: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.
Kiswahili: alisema, “Nitasikiliza shauri lako washtaki wako watakapofika hapa.” Kisha akaamuru Paulo awekwe chini ya ulinzi kwenye jumba la kifalme la Herode.
Ekegusii: “Ninche nyigwe amang’ana ao ekero abagosoeri bao barache.” Agachiika arendwe ase enyomba y’ekegambero kia Herode.

English: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku tano, kuhani mkuu Anania akashuka akiwa amefuatana na baadhi ya wazee pamoja na mwanasheria mmoja aitwaye Tertulo, nao wakaleta mashtaka yao dhidi ya Paulo mbele ya mtawala.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atano, Anania, Omokuani omonene, agatirimboka amo nabande b’abagaaka na Omokuani oyomo, Teritulo; barabwo bagateebereria gabana amang’ana igoro ya Paulo.

English: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,
Kiswahili: Paulo alipoitwa aingie ndani, Tertulo akaanza kutoa mashtaka akisema, “Mtukufu Feliksi, kwa muda mrefu tumefurahia amani na matengenezo mengi mazuri yamefanywa kwa ajili ya watu hawa kwa sababu ya upeo wako wa kuona mambo ya mbele.
Ekegusii: Ekero Teritulo achia korangerigwa, agachaaka komosoera, agateeba: “Aye, omosike Feliki, ase okogamba kwao twanyorire omorembe omonge, na ase okorigereria kwao gwakoreire egesaku giaito ebinto ebinge ebiya,

English: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.
Kiswahili: Wakati wote na kila mahali, kwa namna yoyote, mtukufu sana Feliksi, tumeyapokea mambo haya yote kwa shukrani nyingi.
Ekegusii: gaki iga tokobinyora kera ekero na kera aase, na gokoakera ng’a mbuya mono.

English: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.
Kiswahili: Lakini nisije nikakuchosha zaidi, ningekuomba kwa hisani yako utusikilize kwa kifupi.
Ekegusii: Korende tinkogochanda kobua, nagosoroire ototegerere ase amang’ana amake ase ogwancha kwao.

English: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
Kiswahili: “Tumemwona mtu huyu kuwa ni msumbufu, anayechochea ghasia miongoni mwa Wayahudi duniani pote. Yeye ndiye kiongozi wa dhehebu la Wanazarayo,
Ekegusii: Naki twanyorire omonto oyo ng’a nomochege are, na omochaaki bw’eriomana ase Abayahudi abare ase ense yonsi, naende nomotang’ani bw’ekeombe ki’Abanazareti.

English: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.
Kiswahili: na hata amejaribu kulinajisi Hekalu, hivyo tukamkamata; tukataka kumhukumu kufuatana na sheria zetu.
Ekegusii: Naende nigo ateemete kogindia Hekalu riko. Ase ayio tokamobwata, tokarigia komogambia ase amachiiko aito.

English: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini jemadari Lisia alitujia na nguvu nyingi, akamwondoa mikononi mwetu,
Ekegusii: Korende Lisia, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani, agaika, akamorusia ase amaboko aito ne chinguru,

English: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.
Kiswahili: akiwaamuru washtaki wake waje mbele yako: ili kwa kumchunguza wewe mwenyewe unaweza kujua kutoka kwake mambo yote tunayomshtaki kwayo.”
Ekegusii: agachiika abamosoeri baria bache ase ore. Aye omonyene nonyare komoboria, onyore engencho y’amang’ana onsi twamosoereire intwe.”

English: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,
Kiswahili: Pia wale Wayahudi wakaunga mkono wakithibitisha kuwa mashtaka yote haya ni kweli.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi nabarabwo bakamosoera, bakaboora ng’a amang’ana ayio naboigo are.

English: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Mtawala Feliksi alipompungia Paulo mkono ili ajitetee, yeye akajibu, “Najua kwamba wewe umekuwa hakimu katika taifa hili kwa miaka mingi, hivyo natoa utetezi wangu kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: Erio gabana akarutera Paulo okoboko erinde akwane. Paulo akairaneria, “Amaene namanyire ng’a aye kwabeire omogambi ase egesaku eke ase ekero ki’emiaka emenge, igo ninyare gwekengera ase omoyo bw’omosasoko.

English: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.
Kiswahili: Unaweza kuhakikisha kwa urahisi kuwa hazijapita zaidi ya siku kumi na mbili tangu nilipopanda kwenda Yerusalemu kuabudu.
Ekegusii: Naki buna oranyare komanya, amatuko taraeta kobua ikomi na abere korwa ekero natiirete kogenda Yerusalemu gosasiima.

English: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.
Kiswahili: Hawa wanaonishtaki hawakunikuta nikibishana na mtu yeyote Hekaluni au kuchochea umati wa watu katika sinagogi au mahali pengine popote mjini.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba tibanyoreti nkoamererania na monto, gose koburukania omosangererekano ase Hekalu ime, nonya nase chisinagogi gose ase omochie ime.

English: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;
Kiswahili: Wala hawawezi kabisa kukuthibitishia mashtaka haya wanayonishtaki kwayo.
Ekegusii: Gose tibakonyara koorokia amang’ana aya bansoera bono ng’a namaene are.

English: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
Kiswahili: Lakini, ninakubali kwamba mimi namwabudu Mungu wa baba zetu, mfuasi wa Njia, ile ambayo wao wanaiita dhehebu. Ninaamini kila kitu kinachokubaliana na Sheria na kile kilichoandikwa katika Manabii,
Ekegusii: Korende ring’ana eri ndaorokie ase ore, ng’a ase enchera eyio bakoroka ensemo y’ogweatanana, inche nigo nkomosaisima Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, na kwegena ayariikire ase amachiiko na ase chibuku chi’ababani.

English: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
Kiswahili: nami ninalo tumaini kwa Mungu, ambalo hata wao wenyewe wanalikubali kwamba kutakuwa na ufufuo wa wafu, kwa wenye haki na wasio na haki.
Ekegusii: Ninde nogosemeria ase Nyasae buna barabwo bare nakorokwo, ng’a okobokigwa kw’abakuure nakobe ase abanyene oboronge, na ase abatari abanyene oboronge boigo.

English: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ninajitahidi siku zote kuwa na dhamiri safi mbele za Mungu na mbele za wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Inche boigo nateemire koba nenkoro etari kongambia ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase obosio bw’abaanto.

English: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.
Kiswahili: “Basi, baada ya kutokuwepo kwa miaka mingi nilikuja Yerusalemu ili kuwaletea watu wangu msaada kwa ajili ya maskini na kutoa dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Bono yaetire emiaka etai meke ngacha ndetere abanto b’egesaku kiane ebiegwa, naende indue chisadaka.

English: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.
Kiswahili: Nilikuwa nimeshatakaswa kwa taratibu za kiibada waliponikuta Hekaluni nikifanya mambo haya. Hapakuwa na umati wa watu, pamoja nami wala aliyehusika kwenye fujo yoyote.
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge gokora aya, bakaanyora ime ase Hekalu nesibirie, timbeti nomoganda gose rirorooche. Korende Abayahudi bande, abarwete Asia mbarengeo.

English: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,
Kiswahili: Lakini kulikuwa na baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka Asia, ambao wangelazimika wawepo hapa mbele yako ili watoe mashtaka kama wanalo jambo lolote dhidi yangu.
Ekegusii: Abwo mbagwenerete koba aiga ase obosio bwao na gonsoera, onye bare ne ring’ana igoro ase ’nde.

English: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”
Kiswahili: Au, watu hawa walioko hapa waseme ni uhalifu gani walioniona nao waliponisimamisha mbele ya baraza,
Ekegusii: Gose abanto aba bare aa abanyene bateebe nkomocha ki banyorete ase ’nde ekero natenena ase ekegambero,

English: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”
Kiswahili: isipokuwa ni kuhusu jambo hili moja nililopiga kelele mbele yao kwamba, ‘Mimi nashtakiwa mbele yenu leo kwa sababu ya ufufuo wa wafu.’ ”
Ekegusii: otatiga ase engencho ye ring’ana erimo nateebete neriogi rinene, ekero natenenete egati yabo. Ngateba: Ase engencho y’okobokigwa kw’abakuure nakio nkogamberigwa ase obosio bwaino iga reero.”

English: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.
Kiswahili: Basi Feliksi ambaye alikuwa anafahamu vizuri habari za Njia ile, akaahirisha shauri lile kwa maelezo yake akisema, “Wakati jemadari Lisia atakapoteremka huku, nitaamua shauri lako.”
Ekegusii: Korende Feliki, ekiagera amanyete boronge amang’ana ’Enchera eria, agatiga ekiina keraare, akabora: “Lisia, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani karatirimboke, rirorio ninyigwe amang’ana aino.”

English: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Ndipo akaamuru kiongozi wa askari amweke chini ya ulinzi lakini ampe uhuru na kuwaruhusu rafiki zake wamhudumie.
Ekegusii: Agachiika omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana arende Paulo, korende amoe ribaga rike, gose tamokania nonya noyomo bw’abasani baye komokorera, gose gocha komorora.

English: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku kadhaa, Feliksi alikuja pamoja na Drusila mkewe, ambaye alikuwa Myahudi. Alituma aitiwe Paulo, naye akamsikiliza alipokuwa akinena juu ya imani katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atari make, Feliki agaika na Durusila mokaye, oyorenge Omoyahudi. Akarangeria Paulo, akamoigwa ogokwana amang’ana igoro y’okomwegena Kristo Yeso.

English: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.
Kiswahili: Naye Paulo alipokuwa akinena juu ya haki, kuwa na kiasi na juu ya hukumu ijayo, Feliksi aliingiwa na hofu na kusema, “Hiyo yatosha sasa! Waweza kuondoka. Nitakapokuwa na wasaa nitakuita.”
Ekegusii: Ekero Paulo are gokwana amang’ana igoro y’oboronge, na okweriita, na ekiina kegochi‐gocha, Feliki akaba nobwoba, akamoteebia: “Ase ekero eke bono, karagenda; ekero ndanyore ribaga, ninkorangerie naende.”

English: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo Feliksi alitazamia kwamba Paulo angempa rushwa. Hivyo akawa anamwita mara kwa mara na kuzungumza naye.
Ekegusii: Amo nayio nigo asemeretie ng’a naegwe chifeta na Paulo. Nabo akana‐komorangeria ekero ase ekero gokwana nere.

English: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.
Kiswahili: Siku tatu baada ya Festo kuwasili Kaisaria kuchukua wajibu wake mpya, alipanda kwenda Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: Bono Festo gasoire ase obogambi bwaye, magega y’amatuko atato agatiira gochia Yerusalemu korwa Kaisaria.

English: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,
Kiswahili: ambako viongozi wa makuhani na viongozi wa Wayahudi walikuja mbele yake na kuleta mashtaka yao dhidi ya Paulo.
Ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na abanene b’Abayahudi bakamomanyia amang’ana igoro ya Paulo. Bagasorora Festo,

English: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.
Kiswahili: Wakamsihi sana Festo, kama upendeleo kwao, aamuru Paulo ahamishiwe Yerusalemu, kwa kuwa walikuwa wanaandaa kumvizia ili wamuue akiwa njiani.
Ekegusii: na bakamosaba abanchere, arue ogochika ng’a Paulo arentwe Yerusalemu, konya barobeirie komoboera na komoitera nchera.

English: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.
Kiswahili: Festo akawajibu, “Paulo amezuiliwa huko Kaisaria, nami mwenyewe ninakwenda huko hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Festo akairaneria ng’a Paulo narendire aria Kaisaria; ere omonyene nigo arengereretie kogenda aroro bwango.

English: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya viongozi wenu wafuatane nami na kutoa mashtaka dhidi ya mtu huyo huko, kama amekosa jambo lolote.”
Ekegusii: Agakwana: “Baria bare nokobua ase egati yaino, tiga batirimboke amo nainche, onye ring’ana rire riibe ase omonto oria, bamosoere.”

English: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.
Kiswahili: Baada ya Festo kukaa miongoni mwao kwa karibu siku nane au kumi, akashuka kwenda Kaisaria na siku iliyofuata akaitisha mahakama, akaketi penye kiti chake cha hukumu, akaamuru Paulo aletwe mbele yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero abeire amo nabarabwo tari kobua amatuko atano na atato gose ikomi, agatirimboka gochia Kaisaria; ne rituko ria kabere agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye gi’ekegambero, agachiika Paulo arentwe.

English: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,
Kiswahili: Paulo alipotokea, wale Wayahudi waliokuwa wameteremka toka Yerusalemu wakasimama wakiwa wamemzunguka, wakileta mashtaka mengi mazito dhidi yake ambayo hawakuweza kuyathibitisha.
Ekegusii: Ekero Paulo achire, Abayahudi abarwete Yerusalemu bagatenena, bakamoetanana, bakarenta amasoero amange amarito igoro yaye, ayabatanyare koorokia oboene ng’a mboronge are.

English: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo akajitetea, akasema, “Mimi sikufanya jambo lolote kinyume cha sheria ya Wayahudi au dhidi ya Hekalu au kinyume cha Kaisari.”
Ekegusii: Paulo agekengera iga: “Inche timocheti ring’ana igoro ase amachiiko ’Abayahudi, gose ase Hekalu, nonya nase Kaisari.”

English: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”
Kiswahili: Festo, akitaka kuwapendeza Wayahudi, akamuuliza Paulo, “Je, ungependa kwenda Yerusalemu na kukabili mashtaka mbele yangu huko?”
Ekegusii: Korende Festo akarigia gwekora omuya ase Abayahudi, akaboria Paulo: “Norigetie kogenda Yerusalemu ogamberigwe aroro ase obosio bwane?”

English: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.
Kiswahili: Paulo akasema, “Mimi sasa nimesimama mbele ya mahakama ya Kaisari, ambako ndiko ninakostahili kushtakiwa. Kama vile wewe mwenyewe ujuavyo vyema kabisa sijawatendea Wayahudi kosa lolote.
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo agateeba: “Inche nigo nteneine aiga bosio bw’ekegambero gia Kaisari, ase ngwenerete kogamberigwa; timochereti Abayahudi ring’ana buna aye omanyete buya.

English: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”
Kiswahili: Basi kama mimi nina hatia ya kutenda kosa lolote linalostahili kifo, sikatai kufa. Lakini kama mashtaka yaliyoletwa dhidi yangu na hawa Wayahudi si kweli, hakuna yeyote aliye na haki ya kunikabidhi mikononi mwao. Naomba rufaa kwa Kaisari!”
Ekegusii: Onye namochire, gose nakorire ring’ana ringwenerete ogokwa, tinyangeti ogokwa, korende onye tari ekeene ring’ana eri bansoereire, onde tari oranyare kombeka ase amaboko abo. Nindigetie ekiina kiane keirwe ase Kaisari.”

English: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”
Kiswahili: Baada ya Festo kufanya shauri pamoja na baraza lake, akatangaza, “Wewe umeomba rufaa kwa Kaisari, nako kwa Kaisari utakwenda!”
Ekegusii: Erio Festo agachia gokoora gokwana n’abanto b’ekegambero, akairaneria: “Norigetie ekiina kiao keirwe ase Kaisari, nabo oragende ase Kaisari.”

English: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.
Kiswahili: Baada ya siku kadhaa Mfalme Agripa na Bernike wakapanda kuja Kaisaria kumsalimu Festo.
Ekegusii: Amatuko atai make gaetire, Agripa omorwoti na Bereniki bagaika Kaisaria gokwania Festo.

English: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa walikuwa wakae huko Kaisaria kwa siku nyingi, Festo alijadili shauri la Paulo na mfalme, akisema, “Kuna mtu mmoja hapa ambaye Feliksi alimwacha gerezani.
Ekegusii: Na ekero baikaransire aroro amatuko amange, Festo agateebia omorwoti amang’ana igoro ya Paulo, agateeba: “Nare aa omonto oyomo omosibwa, otigetwe na Feliki.

English: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.
Kiswahili: Nilipokuwa huko Yerusalemu, viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa Wayahudi walinijulisha habari zake na wakaomba hukumu dhidi yake.
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge Yerusalemu, abakuani abanene na abagaaka b’Abayahudi baganteebia amang’ana igoro yaye, bakarigia agambigwe.

English: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.
Kiswahili: “Lakini mimi nikawaambia kwamba si desturi ya Kirumi kumtoa mtu yeyote auawe kabla mshtakiwa kuonana uso kwa uso na washtaki wake, naye awe amepewa nafasi ya kujitetea kuhusu mashtaka anayoshutumiwa.
Ekegusii: Nkabairaneria ng’a tari engencho y’Abarumi korua omonto onde bwensi aitwe ritang’ani omonto oria omosoerwa atararorana nabamosoeri baye obosio ase obosio, na koegwa ribaga gwekengera ase ogosoerwa kwaye.

English: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.
Kiswahili: Hivyo walipokutana hapa, sikukawia, kesho yake niliitisha baraza, nikaketi penye kiti changu cha hukumu, nikaagiza huyo mtu aletwe.
Ekegusii: Ase igo ekero basangererekanete aiga, tintebaaneti, korende rituko ria kabere ngaikaransa ase ekerogo kiane gi’ekegambero, ngachiika omonto oyo arentwe.

English: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;
Kiswahili: Washtaki wake waliposimama, hawakushtaki kwa uhalifu wowote niliokuwa ninatarajia.
Ekegusii: Na baria abamosoeri ekero batenenete, tibamosoera ase ing’ana riibe, buna nakagete,

English: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
Kiswahili: Badala yake walikuwa na vipengele fulani vya kutokukubaliana naye kuhusu dini yao na juu ya mtu mmoja aitwaye Yesu, ambaye alikufa, lakini yeye Paulo alidai kwamba yu hai.
Ekegusii: korende iga barenge namaborio gete, okoamererania igoro asare ase edini yabo abanyene, na ase amang’ana igoro y’omonto oyomo, Yeso, oyoikire gokwa, korende oyo Paulo akona‐goteeba ng’a moyo are.

English: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa sikujua jinsi ya kupeleleza jambo hili, nilimuuliza kama angependa kwenda Yerusalemu na kuhojiwa huko kuhusu mashtaka haya.
Ekegusii: Inche ngasinywa komanya buna nkorigia ekeene ki’amang’ana aya, nkamobooria gose narigetie kogenda Yerusalemu agamberigwe aroro ase amang’ana aya.

English: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo alipoomba afadhiliwe ili rufaa yake isikilizwe na Mfalme Agusto, nilimwamuru alindwe mpaka nitakapoweza kumpeleka kwa Kaisari.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Paulo arigia ng’a arendwe goika agamberigwe ase Omorwoti omonene, ngachiika arendwe goika inyare komoira ase Kaisari.”

English: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Agripa akamwambia Festo, “Ningependa kumsikiliza mtu huyo mimi mwenyewe.” Yeye akajibu, “Kesho utamsikia.”
Ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Festo: “Nainche omonyene nindigetie koigwa omonto oyio.” Akabora: “Noche omoigwe ankio.”

English: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.
Kiswahili: Siku iliyofuata Agripa na Bernike walifika kwa fahari kubwa wakaingia katika ukumbi wa mahakama, pamoja na majemadari wa jeshi na watu mashuhuri wa mji. Ndipo kwa amri ya Festo, Paulo akaletwa ndani.
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia Agripa agaacha amo na Bereniki ase obonene obonge, bagasoa ase ekegambero amo nabatang’ani b’abarwani elifu na abanto abanene b’omochie. Festo akarua ogochika ng’a Paulo arentwe ime.

English: Festus said, “King Agrippa, and all men who are here present with us, you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me, both at Jerusalem and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.
Kiswahili: Festo akasema, “Mfalme Agripa, nanyi nyote mlio hapa pamoja nasi, mnamwona mtu huyu! Jumuiya yote ya Kiyahudi wamenilalamikia kuhusu mtu huyu huko Yerusalemu na hapa Kaisaria, wakipiga kelele kwamba haimpasi kuendelea kuishi.
Ekegusii: Festo agateeba: “Omorwoti Agripa, na inwe mwensi abamore aa amo naintwe, mwarorire omonto oyo! Ase engencho yaye omogaanda bwonsi bw’Abayahudi aaria Yerusalemu na aiga mbamboria mbakoonye, bagaaka eriogi ng’a temogwenereti abe moyo.

English: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,
Kiswahili: Sikuona kwamba ametenda jambo lolote linalostahili kifo, ila kwa kuwa alikuwa ameomba rufaa yake kwa mfalme, niliamua kumpeleka Rumi.
Ekegusii: Korende ngachia korora ng’a takoreti gento ekebe kegwenerete aitwe; na ere omonyene karigetie agamberigwe ase Omorwoti omonene, nkarengereria komotoma asare.

English: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi sina kitu maalum cha kumwandikia Bwana Mtukufu kumhusu mtu huyu. Kwa hiyo nimemleta mbele yenu ninyi nyote, hasa mbele yako, Mfalme Agripa, ili kutokana na matokeo ya uchunguzi huu, niweze kupata kitu cha kuandika.
Ekegusii: Na inche tindi ne ring’ana ri’ekeene nkoriikera omonene one igoro asare. Ase ayio namorentire aiga ase obosio bwaino, kobua mono ase obosio bwao, aye omorwoti Agripa, erinde gotwakoorire komobooria, inyore ring’ana nkorika.

English: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa naona hakuna sababu ya kumpeleka mfungwa bila kuainisha mashtaka dhidi yake.”
Ekegusii: Naki narorire ng’a nering’ana ritari boronge koira omosibwa otatiga koorokia amasoerwa aria asoereire.”

English: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Agripa akamwambia Paulo, “Unayo ruhusa kujitetea.” Hivyo Paulo akawaashiria kwa mkono wake, akaanza kujitetea, akasema:
Ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Paulo: “Nore ne ribaga gokwana amang’ana ao.” Erio Paulo akarambora okoboko kwaye, agekengera:

English: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things that I am accused by the Jews,
Kiswahili: “Mfalme Agripa, najiona kuwa na heri kusimama mbele yako leo ninapojitetea kuhusu mashtaka yote ya Wayahudi,
Ekegusii: “Omorwoti Agripa, nerorire omonyene ng’a ninde negesio, ekiagera ninyekengere ase obosio bwao reero, ase amang’ana aria onsi nasoerwa n’Abayahudi.

English: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.
Kiswahili: hasa kwa sababu unajua vyema desturi zote za Kiyahudi na ya kuwa wewe unajua kwa undani mila na masuala ya mabishano. Kwa hiyo, nakusihi unisikilize kwa uvumilivu.
Ekegusii: Nabo ekiagera aye kwamanyire mono chingencho chionsi na amaborio onsi Abayahudi bare naro, nagosabire ontegerere ase oboremereria.

English: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;
Kiswahili: “Wayahudi wote wanajua jinsi nilivyoishi tangu nilipokuwa mtoto, kuanzia mwanzo wa maisha yangu katika nchi yangu na pia huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: “Abayahudi bonsi mbamanyete obogima bwane korwa obosae bwane buna bwarenge korwa omochakano, ase egesaku kiane na ase Yerusalemu.

English: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
Kiswahili: Wao wamefahamu kwa muda mrefu na wanaweza kushuhudia kama wakipenda, ya kwamba kutokana na misimamo mikali sana ya dhehebu letu kwenye dini yetu, niliishi nikiwa Farisayo.
Ekegusii: Mbamanyete korwa ase ekero egetambe, na onye barigetie, banyare koorokia buna narenge oyomo bw’ekeombe keria gi’okobetererigwa bokong’u kobwata engencho yaito y’okomoiroka Nyasae, nakio ekeombe ki’Abafarisai.

English: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,
Kiswahili: Nami sasa ni kwa sababu ya tumaini langu katika kile ambacho Mungu aliwaahidi baba zetu, ninashtakiwa leo.
Ekegusii: Na bono ninteneine aiga ngambigwe ase engencho y’ogosemeria kw’eira eria chisokoro chiaito chiaetwe na Nyasae,

English: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo ahadi ambayo makabila yetu kumi na mawili yanatarajia kuiona ikitimizwa wanapomtumikia Mungu kwa bidii usiku na mchana. Ee mfalme, ninashtakiwa na Wayahudi kwa ajili ya tumaini hili.
Ekegusii: eira eyio eyio ebisaku biaito ikomi na bibere biasemeretie koyeikera, kobiragenderere komosasiima Nyasae obotuko na omobaso. Aye omorwoti! Ase engencho y’ogosemeria okwo nasoereirwe n’Abayahudi.

English: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?
Kiswahili: Kwa nini yeyote miongoni mwenu afikiri kwamba ni jambo lisilosadikika Mungu kufufua wafu?
Ekegusii: Nase ki motari gwancha nga Nyasae nkobabookia are abakuure?

English: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
Kiswahili: “Mimi pia nilikuwa nimeshawishika kwamba imenipasa kufanya yote yale yaliyowezekana kupinga Jina la Yesu wa Nazareti.
Ekegusii: “Ekeene inche omonyene naroche ng’a nengwenerete gokora amang’ana amange mamincha y’erieta ria Yeso o Nazareti.

English: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.
Kiswahili: Nami hayo ndiyo niliyoyafanya huko Yerusalemu. Kwa mamlaka ya viongozi wa makuhani, niliwatia wengi wa watakatifu gerezani na walipokuwa wakiuawa, nilipiga kura yangu kuunga mkono.
Ekegusii: Ngakora aya aria Yerusalemu: Ngasiba abachenu abange ase echela, ekero naeirwe okobua nabakuani abanene; tari ayio oka, korende kobagoitwa, nigo narenge gwancha abe bo ase bare.

English: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.
Kiswahili: Mara nyingi nilikwenda kutoka sinagogi moja hadi ingine nikiamuru waadhibiwe, nami nilijaribu kuwalazimisha wakufuru. Katika shauku yangu dhidi yao, hata nilikwenda miji ya kigeni ili kuwatesa.
Ekegusii: Nkabasusura ebiro ebinge ase chisinagogi chionsi, naende mbabetereria korama, nkababwaterwa endamwamu enene mono, nkabatunya na kobachanda goika emechie y’ense engeni.

English: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,
Kiswahili: “Siku moja nilipokuwa katika mojawapo ya safari hizi nikiwa ninakwenda Dameski, nilikuwa na mamlaka na agizo kutoka kwa kiongozi wa makuhani.
Ekegusii: “Nabo ase emeremo eyio nigo narenge kogenda Damesiki, nigo naetwe okobua na amachiiko korwa ase abakuani abanene.

English: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.
Kiswahili: Ilikuwa yapata adhuhuri, ee mfalme, nilipokuwa njiani, niliona nuru kutoka mbinguni kali kuliko jua, ikingʼaa kunizunguka pande zote mimi na wale niliokuwa pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Aye omorwoti, ekero kia mobaso gati, kande enchera kogenda, nkarora amasase akorwa igoro abuete okobara kw’erioba, akambarera chinsemo chionsi amo nabaria barenge amo nainche.

English: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’
Kiswahili: Wote tulipokuwa tumeanguka chini, nikasikia sauti ikisema nami kwa lugha ya Kiebrania, ‘Sauli, Sauli, mbona unanitesa? Ni vigumu kwako kuupiga teke mchokoo.’
Ekegusii: Tokagwa inse twensi, nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania: Saulo, Saulo, nase ki gwanchandire? Naakong’u ase ore goaka ensonga y’esimisi chintacho.

English: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
Kiswahili: “Nikauliza, ‘Ni nani wewe, Bwana?’ “Naye Bwana akajibu, ‘Ni Mimi Yesu unayemtesa.
Ekegusii: Na inche nkaboora: Naye ng’Omonene? Omonene aganteebia: Ninche Yeso, oyogwachandire aye.
