English: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;
Kiswahili: Sasa inuka usimame kwa miguu yako. Nimekutokea ili nikuteue uwe mtumishi na shahidi wa mambo ambayo umeyaona, na yale nitakayokuonyesha.
Ekegusii: Korende imoka, otenene namagoro ao, ekiagera nakoorokeire ase engencho eye: nkobeke obe omokori na kirori bw’amang’ana aya kwarora, na amang’ana ayio ndeorokerie ase ore.

English: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,
Kiswahili: Nitakuokoa kutoka kwa watu wako na watu wa Mataifa ambao ninakutuma kwao,
Ekegusii: Ningotoorie korwa ase abanto bao, na korwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku, ase abwo ndagotome.

English: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’
Kiswahili: uyafumbue macho yao ili wageuke kutoka gizani waingie nuruni, na kutoka kwenye nguvu za Shetani wamgeukie Mungu, ili wapate msamaha wa dhambi na sehemu miongoni mwa wale waliotakaswa kwa kuniamini mimi.’
Ekegusii: Nigo oraramokie amaiso abo baonchoke korwa ase omosunte, bache ase omobaso, batige okobua gwa Saitani na baonchokere Nyasae, banyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo, na omwando ase egati yabo abachenirwe ase okonyegena.

English: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,
Kiswahili: “Hivyo basi, Mfalme Agripa, sikuacha kuyatii yale maono yaliyotoka mbinguni,
Ekegusii: “Aye omorwoti Agripa! Ase ayio tinare kwanga koigwera okorora koria kwarwete igoro,

English: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.
Kiswahili: bali niliyatangaza kwanza kwa wale wa Dameski, kisha Yerusalemu na katika vijiji vyote vya Uyahudi na pia kwa watu wa Mataifa, kwamba inawapasa kutubu na kumgeukia Mungu na kuthibitisha toba yao kwa matendo yao.
Ekegusii: korende ritang’ani nigo naranderetie baria ba Damesiki, na Yerusalemu, na ase ense ya Boyahudi, na abanto b’Ebisaku, baonchoke, baonchokere Nyasae bakore ogokora kobwataine okoonchoka kwabo.

English: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.
Kiswahili: Ni kwa sababu hii Wayahudi walinikamata nilipokuwa Hekaluni, wakataka kuniua.
Ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio Abayahudi bakambwatera ime ase Hekalu, bagateema kong’ita.

English: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,
Kiswahili: Hadi leo nimepata msaada kutoka kwa Mungu, na hivyo nasimama hapa nikishuhudia kwa wakubwa na wadogo. Sisemi chochote zaidi ya yale ambayo manabii na Mose walisema yatatukia:
Ekegusii: Goika reero iga nanyorire ogokonywa korwa ase Nyasae. Ase igo ninteneine na koba kirori ase abake na abanene. Tindi gokwana amang’ana ande otatiga aria ababani na Musa bakwanete ng’a nabe,

English: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”
Kiswahili: kwamba Kristo atateswa, na kwamba yeye atakuwa wa kwanza kufufuka kutoka kwa wafu, na atatangaza nuru kwa watu wake na kwa watu wa Mataifa.”
Ekegusii: buna Kristo agwenerete achandwe, naende ase okoba omotang’ani ase okobokigwa kw’abakuure, nararie amang’ana ’omobaso ase abanto baye, na ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”

English: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”
Kiswahili: Paulo alipokuwa akifanya utetezi huu, Festo akasema kwa sauti kubwa, “Paulo, wewe umerukwa na akili! Kusoma kwingi kunakufanya uwe kichaa!”
Ekegusii: Agachia gwekengera iga, Festo agakwana neriogi rinene: “Paulo, nebarimo ore! Ogosoma kwao okonge kwaonchoire obong’aini bwao.”

English: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akajibu, “Mimi sijarukwa na akili, mtukufu sana Festo, bali nanena kweli nikiwa na akili zangu timamu.
Ekegusii: Korende Paulo agakwana: “Omosike Festo, tindi ebarimo, korende nigo ngokwana amang’ana ’ekeene na ay’obong’aini kegima.

English: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.
Kiswahili: Naam, Mfalme anajua kuhusu mambo haya yote, nami nasema naye kwa uhuru. Kwa sababu nina hakika kwamba hakuna hata mojawapo ya mambo haya asilolijua, kwa kuwa hayakufanyika mafichoni.
Ekegusii: Naki omorwoti namanyete engencho y’amang’ana aya, naende ninyare gokwana nere ntari nokoiroka, ekiagera namanyire mono ng’a ring’ana tiriri nonya nerimo ase ayio otamanyeti, ekiagera erio tiriakoregete bobisi.

English: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”
Kiswahili: Mfalme Agripa, je, unaamini manabii? Najua kuwa unaamini.”
Ekegusii: Omorwoti Agripa, Inee, mbwegenete ababani? Namanyire ng’a nobegenete.”

English: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”
Kiswahili: Agripa akamwambia Paulo, “Je, unanishawishi kwa haraka namna hii niwe Mkristo?”
Ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Paulo: “Ase amang’ana amake norigetie gonkora imbe Omokristo.”

English: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”
Kiswahili: Paulo akasema, “Ikiwa ni kwa haraka au la, namwomba Mungu, si wewe peke yako bali pia wale wote wanaonisikiliza leo, wawe kama mimi nilivyo, kasoro minyororo hii.”
Ekegusii: Paulo akamoiraneria: “Nasabire Nyasae ng’a ase amang’ana amake, gose amange, tari aye bweka, korende naba bonsi abantegererete reero, babe buna inche otatiga ase ebinyuri ebi.”

English: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema hayo, mfalme akainuka pamoja na mtawala na Bernike na wale waliokuwa wameketi pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti, na gabana, na Bereniki, na baria baikaransete amo nabarabwo bagatenena,

English: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”
Kiswahili: Walipokuwa wakiondoka, wakaambiana, “Mtu huyu hafanyi jambo lolote linalostahili kufa au kufungwa.”
Ekegusii: bakagenda are ake, bagateebania, bakaboora: “Omonto oyo takoreti ring’ana rigwenerete ogokwa gose ogosibwa.”

English: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”
Kiswahili: Agripa akamwambia Festo, “Mtu huyu angeachwa huru kama hangekuwa amekata rufaa kwa Kaisari.”
Ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Festo: “Omonto oyo nanga nasiborwa onye atarigia ekiina kiaye keirwe ase Kaisari.”

English: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.
Kiswahili: Ilipoamuliwa kwamba tungesafiri kwa njia ya bahari kwenda Italia, Paulo na wafungwa wengine wakakabidhiwa kwa kiongozi mmoja wa askari aliyeitwa Juliasi, aliyekuwa wa Kikosi cha Walinzi wa Kaisari.
Ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana achiikwa ng’a togende n’emeeri goika Italia, bakabeeka Paulo na abasibwa bande ase amaboko a Yulio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana ase ekeombe ki’abarwani ki’omogambi Augusto.

English: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.
Kiswahili: Tulipanda meli iliyotoka Adramitio, iliyokuwa inakaribia kusafiri kwenda kwenye bandari zilizopo pwani ya Asia, tukaanza safari yetu tukiwa pamoja na Aristarko, Mmakedonia kutoka Thesalonike.
Ekegusii: Togasoa ase emeeri y’Aderamiti eyarenge ang’e kogenda goika emechie ye chingegu chi’Asia, tokaimoka. Aristariko, Omomakedonia o Tesaloniki, nigo arenge amo naintwe.

English: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake tukatia nanga Sidoni, naye Juliasi akamfanyia wema Paulo, akamruhusu aende kwa rafiki zake ili wamtimizie mahitaji yake.
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia togaika Sidoni. Yulio akarenda Paulo buya, akamoa ribaga agende ase abasani baye akonywe nabarabwo.

English: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
Kiswahili: Kutoka huko tukaingia baharini tena na tukapita upande wa chini wa kisiwa cha Kipro kwa sababu upepo ulikuwa wa mbisho.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo tokagenda ase enyancha, togakengana ase egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, ekiagera chimbeo chiarenge korua bosio.

English: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
Kiswahili: Baada ya sisi kuvuka bahari iliyoko upande wa Kilikia na Pamfilia, tukafika Mira huko Likia.
Ekegusii: Togaeta enyancha ensemo ya Kilikia na Pamfulia, togaika Mira, omochie o Likia.

English: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.
Kiswahili: Huko yule kiongozi wa askari akapata meli ya Iskanderia ikielekea Italia, akatupandisha humo.
Ekegusii: Aria omotang’ani oria akanyora emeeri y’Aleksanderia eyarenge ang’e kogenda gochia Italia, agatoriinia.

English: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.
Kiswahili: Tukasafiri polepole kwa siku nyingi na kwa shida, hatimaye tukafika karibu na Nido. Kwa kuwa upepo wa mbisho ulituzuia tusiweze kushika mwelekeo tuliokusudia, tukapita chini ya Krete mkabala na Salmone.
Ekegusii: Tokagenda ng’ora ase ekero ki’amatuko amange, togaika Kinido ase obokong’u, na ekiagera embeo yatotangete, togaeta ang’e na Kirete maate, erinde tokengane embeo ang’e na Salimone.

English: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.
Kiswahili: Tukaambaa na pwani kwa shida, tukafika sehemu iitwayo Bandari Nzuri, karibu na mji wa Lasea.
Ekegusii: Togaeta ase obokong’u engegu ase engegu, togaika aase akorokwa Ebiambokero Ebiya. Ang’e nagwo norengeo omochie ore korokwa Lasaya.

English: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them
Kiswahili: Muda mwingi ulikuwa umepotea na kusafiri baharini kulikuwa hatari kwa sababu wakati huu ulikuwa baada ya siku za kufunga. Hivyo Paulo akawaonya akasema,
Ekegusii: Naende ekero ekenge konya giaetire, na orogendo rwabeire nobokong’u, ekiagera amatuko ’okweng’ata konya aetire, Paulo akabateebia,

English: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”
Kiswahili: “Mabwana, naona kuwa hii safari ni yenye maafa na ya kuleta hasara kubwa kwa meli na shehena, pia kwa maisha yetu.”
Ekegusii: “Inwe abasacha, narorire ng’a orogendo oro narobe nemechando na ogosira okonge, tari ase chigurube na emeeri bioka, korende nonya nase obogima bwaito boigo.”

English: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.
Kiswahili: Lakini badala ya yule kiongozi wa askari kusikiliza yale Paulo aliyosema, akafuata zaidi ushauri wa nahodha na mwenye meli.
Ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani oria akaigwera omoraai na omonyene emeeri kobua aya Paulo akwanete.

English: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ile bandari ilikuwa haifai kukaa wakati wa majira ya baridi, wengi wakashauri kwamba tuendelee na safari wakitarajia kufika Foinike na kukaa huko kwa majira ya baridi. Hii ilikuwa bandari iliyoko katika kisiwa cha Krete ikikabili upande wa kusini-magharibi na kaskazini-magharibi.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ekiambokero eke tikiarenge ekiya ase abanto komenya aroro ekero gi’etoigo, abange babo bakarigia mono korua aroro, erinde keranyarekane, baike Foiniki na kobeera aroro ekero ki’obokendu. Na kerokio nekiambokero gia Kirete, kerigereretie gati ya Irianyi ya bosongo na sugusu ya bosongo.

English: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.
Kiswahili: Upepo mtulivu ulipoanza kuvuma toka kusini, wakadhani kuwa wangeweza kufikia lengo lao, hivyo wakangʼoa nanga na kusafiri wakipita kandokando ya pwani ya kisiwa cha Krete.
Ekegusii: Naende embeo ya Irianyi egachia kogusa ake, bagakaga ng’a banyorire eki barigetie konyora, bakang’usa ekeroochi, bakagenda ang’e na Kirete, ang’e mono nengegu.

English: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.
Kiswahili: Lakini baada ya muda mfupi ikavuma tufani kubwa iitwayo “Eurakilo” toka kisiwa cha Krete.
Ekegusii: Magega ase ekero egeke omwaga bw’echinguru okorokwa Eurakilo, ore gocha buna ekembugu‐mbugu ogaaka emeeri.

English: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.
Kiswahili: Meli ikapigwa na dhoruba na haikuweza kushindana na ule upepo, tukarudishwa baharini upepo ulikokuwa unaelekea.
Ekegusii: Ekero emeeri yatwometwe na tiyare konyara goeta ase omwaga, tokayetiga etoire ase ekoirwa gochia.

English: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye tukisafiri kupita chini ya kisiwa kidogo kiitwacho Kauda, ambapo kwa kuwa tulikuwa tumekingiwa upepo na hicho kisiwa, tuliweza kwa shida kuifunga mashua ya kuokolea watu.
Ekegusii: Togaeta togakengana ase egesinka egeke gekorokwa Kilaudia, tokanyara ase obokong’u kobogoria obwato oboke.

English: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.
Kiswahili: Watu walipokwisha kuivuta mashua hiyo na kuiingiza katika meli, waliifunga kwa kamba chini ya meli yenyewe ili kuzishikanisha pamoja. Wakiogopa kupelekwa kwenye mchanga karibu na pwani ya Sirti, wakashusha matanga wakaiacha meli isukumwe na huo upepo.
Ekegusii: Magega kobakoorire kobotiria bakabogoria chingori chi’ogokonya, bagachietanania emeeri. Bakairoka ng’a tibaabaisa korateera ase omokenye okorokwa Siriti, bagasibora ebitambaa, bakairwa bosa.

English: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.
Kiswahili: Tulikuwa tunapigwa na dhoruba kwa nguvu, kiasi kwamba kesho yake walianza kutupa shehena toka melini.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera konya twatwomirwe mono nomwaga oria, rituko ria kabere bagachaaka gotuguta chigurube nyancha ime.

English: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.
Kiswahili: Siku ya tatu, wakatupa vyombo vya meli baharini kwa mikono yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato bagatuguta ebinto bi’emeeri namaboko abo abanyene.

English: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.
Kiswahili: Kulipokuwa hakuna kuonekana kwa jua wala nyota kwa siku nyingi, nayo dhoruba ikiwa inaendelea kuwa kali, hatimaye tulikata kabisa tamaa ya kuokoka.
Ekegusii: Ekero erioba ne ching’enang’eni bitarorekanete ase amatuko amange, na omwaga omonene mono ogatotuba, tokerusia moyo ase ogotooreka.

English: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.
Kiswahili: Baada ya watu kukaa siku nyingi bila kula chakula, Paulo akasimama katikati yao akasema, “Enyi watu, iliwapasa kunisikiliza na kuacha kusafiri baharini kutoka Krete, ndipo ninyi mngekuwa mmejinusuru na uharibifu huu na hasara hii.
Ekegusii: Bagachia koba ekero egetambe batari koria endagera, Paulo agatenena gati‐gati yabo, akabora: “Inwe abasacha, onye mwanyigwerete timorua Kirete, nanga titwanyora emechando na ogosira buna oko.

English: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
Kiswahili: Sasa ninawasihi sana, jipeni moyo mkuu kwa kuwa hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayepoteza maisha yake, ila meli itaangamia.
Ekegusii: Bono nabateebirie, remia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera monto tagosira, otatiga emeeri yoka.

English: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,
Kiswahili: Jana usiku, malaika wa Mungu yule ambaye mimi ni wake na ambaye ninamwabudu alisimama karibu nami,
Ekegusii: Ekiagera obotuko obo bwa reero omomalaika o Nyasae, oria inche inde omonto oye, naende nere ngosasiima,

English: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’
Kiswahili: naye akasema, ‘Paulo usiogope, kwa kuwa ni lazima usimame mbele ya Kaisari, naye Mungu amekupa kwa neema uhai wa wote wanaosafiri pamoja nawe.
Ekegusii: natenenete ang’e nainche aganteebia: Paulo toiroka, nogwenerete gotenena ase obosio bwa Kaisari. Naende rora, Nyasae okoeire abanto bonsi, abakogenda amo naye.

English: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.
Kiswahili: Hivyo jipeni moyo, enyi watu, kwa kuwa ninamwamini Mungu kwamba yatakuwa kama vile alivyoniambia.’
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abasacha, remia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ninde nokwegena ase Nyasae, ng’a nabe buna natebetigwe.

English: But we must run aground on a certain island.”
Kiswahili: Lakini hata hivyo meli yetu itakwama kwenye kisiwa fulani.”
Ekegusii: Korende netogwenerete goikigwa ase egesinka gete.”

English: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.
Kiswahili: Usiku wa kumi na nne ulipofika, tulikuwa bado tunasukumwa na upepo katika Bahari ya Adria. Ilipokuwa yapata usiku wa manane, mabaharia wakahisi kwamba walikuwa wanakaribia nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: Goika obotuko bwa ikomi na kane bogachia goika tokairwa gochia aria na aria ase enyancha y’Adiria. Botuko gati abagendia b’emeeri bagakaga ng’a baikire ang’e ase ense enyomo.

English: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakapima kina cha maji na kukuta kilikuwa pima ishirini, baada ya kuendelea mbele kidogo wakapima tena wakapata kina cha pima kumi na tano.
Ekegusii: Bakaruta ekerengo, bakanyora ebirengo bi’amaboko emerongo ebere. Bakagenderera ake, bakaruta ekerengo naende, bakanyora ebirengo bi’amaboko ikomi na bitano.

English: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.
Kiswahili: Wakiogopa kwamba meli yetu ingegonga kwenye miamba, wakashusha nanga nne za nyuma ya meli, wakawa wanaomba kupambazuke.
Ekegusii: Bakoboa ng’a mbaabaise gotwomerigwa ase ebitare, bakaruta ebirochi bine bia magega, bagasaba ng’a bokie.

English: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,
Kiswahili: Katika jaribio la kutoroka kutoka kwenye meli, mabaharia wakashusha mashua ya kuokolea watu baharini, wakijifanya kwamba wanakwenda kushusha nanga za omo.
Ekegusii: Naende abagendia bagachia korigia gotama na gotiga emeeri, bagaikia obwato oboke gochia nyancha, bakang’ainereria buna mbarigetie koruta ebirochi korwa bosio bw’emeeri.

English: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Paulo akamwambia yule jemadari na askari, “Hawa watu wasipobaki katika meli, hamtaweza kuokoka.”
Ekegusii: Paulo agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, na abarwani: “Aba bataikaranseti ase emeeri ime timokonyara gotooreka.”

English: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi wale askari wakakata kamba zilizoshikilia ile mashua ya kuokolea watu kwenye meli, wakaiacha ianguke humo baharini.
Ekegusii: Erio abarwani bakanacha chingori chi’obwato, bakabotiga bogwe amaache ime.

English: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya mapambazuko, Paulo akawasihi watu wote wale chakula akisema, “Leo ni siku ya kumi na nne mmekuwa katika wasiwasi mkiwa mmefunga na bila kula chochote.
Ekegusii: Bogachia gokiamoka Paulo agasorora bonsi barie endagera, akabora: “Reero nerituko ria ikomi na kane moganyete na mogendererete motana koria gento.

English: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nawasihi mle chakula, kwa maana itawasaidia ili mweze kuishi. Kwa kuwa hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayepoteza unywele hata mmoja kutoka kichwani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Gaki nabasoroire morie endagera, nebe ase ogotooreka kwaino; naki tikagosira nonya nagatukia akamo k’omotwe bw’oyomo oino.”

English: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kusema maneno haya, Paulo akachukua mkate, akamshukuru Mungu mbele yao wote, akaumega akaanza kula.
Ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana aya, akabogoria omogati akairaneria ng’a mbuya mono ase Nyasae ase amasio abo bonsi, akayosamunyora, agachaaka koria.

English: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.
Kiswahili: Ndipo wote wakatiwa moyo, wakaanza kula chakula.
Ekegusii: Erio bonsi bakagonkomoka, na barabwo bakaria endagera.

English: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.
Kiswahili: Ndani ya meli tulikuwa jumla ya watu 276.
Ekegusii: (Na ase emeeri ime nigo twarenge abanto amagana abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batano nomo.)

English: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
Kiswahili: Baada ya watu wote kula chakula cha kutosha, wakapunguza uzito wa meli kwa kutupa ngano baharini.
Ekegusii: Kobaigotire bakagusuyia emeeri ase ogotuguta engano ase enyancha ime.

English: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.
Kiswahili: Kulipopambazuka, mabaharia hawakuitambua ile nchi, lakini waliona ghuba yenye ufuko wa mchanga, ambako waliamua kuipweleza meli kama ingewezekana.
Ekegusii: Kobwachia gokia, tibamanya ense eria, otatiga baroche omosomo ore nengegu, bagateebania gosoyia emeeri aroro, keranyarekane.

English: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wakatupa nanga zote na kuziacha baharini, na wakati huo huo wakalegeza kamba zilizokuwa zikishikilia usukani wa meli. Kisha wakatweka tanga la mbele lishike upepo na kuisukuma meli kuelekea pwani.
Ekegusii: Bakaruta ebirochi biria, bakabitiga nyancha ime, bakaororobia chingori chi’ebionchori, bagatiiria egetambaa kia bosio embeo ekeguserere, bakaonchora emeeri gochia engegu.

English: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakafika mahali ambapo bahari mbili zinakutana, wakaipweleza meli ufuoni, omo ikakwama sana, ikawa haiwezi kuondolewa, lakini sehemu ya shetri ikavunjika vipande vipande kwa kule kupiga kwa mawimbi yenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Bagaika aase chinsanganio chie chinyancha ibere, bakaroria emeeri aroro goika ekarateera; obosio bw’emeeri bogasensema omokenye, ekabwatwa kegima, korende korwa magega egatagorwa ne chinguru chi’emerindo.

English: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.
Kiswahili: Wale askari wakapanga kuwaua wale wafungwa ili kuzuia hata mmoja wao asiogelee na kutoroka.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’abarwani nigo orenge ng’a baite abasibwa, omonto tareema abaise gotama.

English: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;
Kiswahili: Lakini yule jemadari alitaka kuokoa maisha ya Paulo, basi akawazuia askari wasitekeleze mpango wao. Akaamuru wale wanaoweza kuogelea wajitupe baharini kwanza, waogelee mpaka nchi kavu.
Ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani oria akarigia gotooria Paulo, akabataanga, tibakora buna barengereretie. Agachiika baria baranyare komura berute nyancha ime, bagende ense enyomo.

English: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.
Kiswahili: Waliosalia wangefika nchi kavu kwa kutumia mbao au vipande vya meli iliyovunjika, hivyo ikatimia kwamba wote wakaokoka na kufika nchi kavu salama.
Ekegusii: Abaratigare bagende, abande ase chibao, na abande ase ebinto binde bi’emeeri. Naboigo abanto bonsi bagaika ase ense enyomo buya.

English: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kufika nchi kavu salama, ndipo tukafahamu kwamba jina la kile kisiwa ni Malta.
Ekegusii: Gatwatoorekire twensi, erio tokamanya ng’a egesinka keria nigo kiare korokwa Melita.

English: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.
Kiswahili: Wenyeji wa kile kisiwa wakatufanyia ukarimu usio wa kawaida. Waliwasha moto na kutukaribisha sisi sote kwa sababu mvua ilikuwa inanyesha na kulikuwa na baridi.
Ekegusii: Abanyene ense eria bagatokorera obuya boetete engencho, ekiagera bagatoutera omorero, bagatoroisia intwe twensi, ekiagera embura yatwete na obokendu mbwarenge.

English: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.
Kiswahili: Paulo alikuwa amekusanya mzigo wa kuni na alipokuwa anaweka kwenye moto kwa ajili ya joto, nyoka mwenye sumu akatoka humo na kujisokotea mkononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Paulo nigo arenge gosangereria chinko na gochibeka ase omorero, eng’iti egasoka ase engencho y’omorero oria, ekamwenarerera okoboko kwaye.

English: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”
Kiswahili: Wale wenyeji wa kile kisiwa walipomwona yule nyoka akiningʼinia mkononi mwa Paulo, wakaambiana, “Huyu mtu lazima awe ni muuaji, ingawa ameokoka kutoka baharini, haki haijamwacha aishi.”
Ekegusii: Abanyene ense eria, ekero barora eng’iti eria esung’unaine ase okoboko kwaye, bagateebania: “Takomocha omonto oyo koba omoiti, nonya otooregete korwa ase enyancha, oboronge tibokomotiga abe moyo.”

English: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.
Kiswahili: Lakini Paulo akamkungʼutia yule nyoka ndani ya moto wala yeye hakupata madhara yoyote.
Ekegusii: Korende akayesamunsera riko, taba na bobe bonde.

English: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.
Kiswahili: Watu walikuwa wanangoja avimbe au aanguke ghafula na kufa. Lakini baada ya kungoja kwa muda mrefu na kuona kwamba hakuna chochote kisicho cha kawaida kilichomtokea, wakabadili mawazo yao na kuanza kusema kwamba yeye ni mungu.
Ekegusii: Bakamorigereria mono, bagakaga ng’a nabimbe, gose nagwe inse na gokwa bwango, korende ekero baganya engaki entambe, na bobe bonde tibomonyooreti, bakaonchora ebirengererio biabo, bakaboora ng’a ere nenyasae.

English: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.
Kiswahili: Basi karibu na sehemu ile, palikuwa na shamba kubwa la mtu mmoja kiongozi wa kile kisiwa, aliyeitwa Publio. Alitupokea na akatuhudumia kwa ukarimu mkubwa kwa muda wa siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Ang’e nase aria yarengeo emegondo y’omonene bw’egesinka keria, erieta riaye Pubilio. Omonto oyo agatoroisia ase omoyo bw’obosani, tokaba abageni baye ase ekero ki’amatuko atato.

English: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.
Kiswahili: Baba yake Publio alikuwa mgonjwa kitandani, akiwa anaumwa homa na kuhara damu. Paulo akaingia ndani ili kumwona na baada ya maombi, akaweka mikono juu yake na kumponya.
Ekegusii: Ekaba ng’a ise Publio narenge omonyareku ase esosera na gosaa amanyinga. Paulo agasoa asare akamosabera, akabeeka amaboko aye igoro yaye, akamogwenia.

English: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.
Kiswahili: Jambo hili lilipotukia, watu wote wa kisiwa kile waliokuwa wagonjwa wakaja, nao wakaponywa.
Ekegusii: Ayio agachia gokoreka, abande ase egesinka keria, abarenge namarwaire, bagacha, bakagwenigwa.

English: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.
Kiswahili: Wakatupa heshima nyingi, nasi tulipokuwa tayari kusafiri kwa njia ya bahari, wakapakia melini vitu vyote tulivyokuwa tunavihitaji.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo bagatosika ase ogosika okonene; naende ekero twachia gosoa emeeri bagatoa ebinto biria twaremeire.

English: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”
Kiswahili: Miezi mitatu baadaye tukaanza safari kwa meli iliyokuwa imetia nanga kwenye kisiwa hicho kwa ajili ya majira ya baridi. Hii ilikuwa meli ya Iskanderia yenye alama ya miungu pacha waitwao Kasta na Poluksi.
Ekegusii: Magega y’emetienyi etato tokagenda n’emeeri y’Aleksanderia, eyabegetwe kobeera aria ase egesinka ekero gi’etoigo, na ekemanyererio kiaye kiarenge Diosikuri (engencho yaye abamura chibarongo).

English: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.
Kiswahili: Kituo chetu cha kwanza kilikuwa Sirakusa na tukakaa huko siku tatu.
Ekegusii: Togaika Sirakusa, tokamenyao amatuko atato.

English: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,
Kiswahili: Kisha tukangʼoa nanga, tukafika Regio. Siku iliyofuata, upepo mkali wa kusi ukavuma, na siku ya pili yake tukafika Puteoli.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo togaetanana, togaikera Regiumu. Magega ye rituko erimo embeo ya Irianyi ekagusa; rituko ria kabere togaika Puteoli.

English: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.
Kiswahili: Huko tukawakuta ndugu, nasi tukakaribishwa tukae nao kwa siku saba. Hivyo tukaendelea na safari mpaka Rumi.
Ekegusii: Agwo tokanyora abaminto, bagatosorora tomenye amo nabarabwo amatuko atano, na abere; erio togaika Rumi.

English: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.
Kiswahili: Ndugu wa huko Rumi waliposikia habari zetu, walikuja mpaka Soko la Apio na mahali paitwapo Mikahawa Mitatu kutulaki. Paulo alipowaona, alimshukuru Mungu akatiwa moyo.
Ekegusii: Abaminto b’aroro, ekero baigwete amang’ana igoro yaito, bagacha goika Apioforo na Tiretaberne gotorototera aroro. Paulo ekero achia kobarora, akamobaka Nyasae, akaremigwa.

English: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.
Kiswahili: Tulipofika Rumi, Paulo aliruhusiwa kuishi peke yake akiwa na askari wa kumlinda.
Ekegusii: Ekero twasoa Rumi, Paulo akaegwa ribaga komenya ere bweka, amo nomorendi ore komorenda.

English: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,
Kiswahili: Siku tatu baadaye Paulo akawaita pamoja viongozi wa Kiyahudi. Walipokwisha kukusanyika akawaambia, “Ndugu zangu, ingawa sikufanya jambo lolote dhidi ya watu wetu au dhidi ya desturi za baba zetu, lakini nilikamatwa huko Yerusalemu nikakabidhiwa kwa Warumi.
Ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato, akarangeria abanene b’Abayahudi amo. Ekero basangererekanire akabateebia: “Baminto, nonya tinkoreti ring’ana riibe ase abanto baito, gose ring’ana riatananegete korwa ase chingencho chie chisokoro chiaito, korwa Yerusalemu nkabekwa ase amaboko ’Abarumi buna omosibwa.

English: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.
Kiswahili: Wao walipokwisha kunihoji, wakataka kuniachia huru kwa sababu hawakuona kosa lolote nililolifanya linalostahili adhabu ya kifo.
Ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire komboria bakarigia gonsibora, ekiagera tibanyorete engencho ende yonsi yangwenerete ng’itwe.

English: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.
Kiswahili: Lakini Wayahudi walipopinga uamuzi huo, nililazimika kukata rufaa kwa Kaisari, ingawa sikuwa na lalamiko lolote juu ya taifa langu.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Abayahudi bangete aya, nkabetererigwa korigia ekiina kiane keirwe ase Kaisari, tari ng’a narenge ne ring’ana ri’ogosoera abanto b’egesaku kiane.

English: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”
Kiswahili: Basi hii ndiyo sababu nimewatumania, ili niseme nanyi. Kwa kuwa ni kwa ajili ya tumaini la Israeli nimefungwa kwa minyororo.”
Ekegusii: Nabo ase engencho eyio nero nabarangereirie, erinde mbarore, na gokwana nainwe, ekiagera nasibirwe ase ekenyuri eke ase engencho y’ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli.”

English: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.
Kiswahili: Wakamjibu, “Hatujapokea barua zozote kutoka Uyahudi zinazokuhusu, wala hapana ndugu yeyote aliyekuja hapa ambaye ametoa taarifa au kuzungumza jambo lolote baya juu yako.
Ekegusii: Baria bakamoteebia: “Intwe titwana konyora amarube ande agokwana amang’ana igoro yao korwa Boyahudi, gose onde ominto tari nonya noyomo oikire aiga na gototeebia amang’ana, gose okwanire ring’ana riibe igoro yao.

English: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”
Kiswahili: Lakini tungependa kusikia kutoka kwako unalofikiri kwa sababu tunajua kwamba kila mahali watu wanazungumza mabaya kuhusu jamii hii.”
Ekegusii: Korende ntorigetie koigwa korwa ase ore buna orooche aye, ekiagera ase ekeombe keria twamanyire ng’a giakwanirwe bobe kera aase.”

English: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kupanga siku ya kuonana naye, watu wengi wakaja kuanzia asubuhi hadi jioni akawaeleza na kutangaza kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu akijaribu kuwahadithia juu ya Yesu kutoka Sheria ya Mose na kutoka Manabii.
Ekegusii: Kobachorire rituko nere, abanto abange mono bagacha asare aase amenyete. Akabateebereria korwa mambia goika mogoroba, na koorokia amang’ana igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, agateema kobateebereria amang’ana igoro ya Yeso korwa ase amang’ana ’amachiiko a Musa na korwa ase ababani.

English: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.
Kiswahili: Baadhi wakasadiki yale aliyosema, lakini wengine hawakuamini.
Ekegusii: Abande bagancha ayakwanete, abande tibayaancha.

English: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,
Kiswahili: Hivyo hawakukubaliana, nao walipokuwa wanaondoka, Paulo akatoa kauli moja zaidi: “Roho Mtakatifu alinena kweli na baba zenu aliposema mambo yale yaliyomhusu Bwana Yesu kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kwamba:
Ekegusii: Ekiagera batabwatanete barabwo ase barabwo, bakagenda ekero Paulo akwanete ring’ana eri erimo ng’a: Omoika Omochenu nokwanete buya ne chisokoro chiaito goetera ase omonwa bw’omobani Isaya, ogoteeba,

English: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.
Kiswahili: “ ‘Nenda kwa watu hawa na useme, “Hakika mtasikiliza lakini hamtaelewa; na pia mtatazama, lakini hamtaona.”
Ekegusii: Genda ase abanto aba, obateebie: Okoigwa namoigwe, korende timokomanya nonya ng’ake, na okorora namorore, korende timoyarengereria nonya ng’ake.

English: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mioyo ya watu hawa imekuwa migumu; hawasikii kwa masikio yao, na wamefumba macho yao. Wasije wakaona kwa macho yao, na wakasikiliza kwa masikio yao, wakaelewa kwa mioyo yao, na kugeuka nami nikawaponya.’
Ekegusii: Naki chinkoro chi’abaanto aba chiabeire chinyoro, na amato abo nigo are amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo bayamiamirie, tibacha korora namaiso abo, gose baigwe namato abo, gose bamanye ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, na inche mbagwenie.

English: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”
Kiswahili: “Basi na ijulikane kwenu kwamba, huu wokovu wa Mungu umepelekwa kwa watu wa Mataifa, nao watasikiliza.”
Ekegusii: Naki amanyekane ase more ng’a ogotooreka oko kwa Nyasae kwairirwe ase abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarabwo nabaigwe.

English: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.
Kiswahili: Naye akiisha kusema maneno haya, Wayahudi wakaondoka wakiwa na hoja nyingi miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Ekero akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, Abayahudi bakagenda, bakaamererania amang’ana amange barabwo ase barabwo.

English: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka miwili mizima Paulo alikaa huko kwa nyumba aliyokuwa amepanga. Akawakaribisha wote waliokwenda kumwona.
Ekegusii: Paulo akamenya engaki y’emiaka ebere ase enyomba amenyete, eye are goakanera, akaba okoroisia abanto bonsi abarenge komochiera,

English: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
Kiswahili: Akahubiri Ufalme wa Mungu na kufundisha mambo yale yaliyomhusu Bwana Yesu Kristo, kwa ujasiri wote na bila kizuizi chochote.
Ekegusii: okorandia amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na kworokereria abanto amang’ana igoro y’Omonene Yeso Kristo noboremu obonge, takanigwa na monto.

English: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,
Kiswahili: Paulo, mtumishi wa Kristo Yesu, aliyeitwa kuwa mtume na kutengwa kwa ajili ya Injili ya Mungu,
Ekegusii: Korwa ase inche Paulo, omosomba o Kristo Yeso, n’omotomwa nachoretwe nakorangerigwa, korandia enchiri ya Nyasae,

English: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
Kiswahili: Injili ambayo Mungu alitangulia kuiahidi kwa vinywa vya manabii wake katika Maandiko Matakatifu,
Ekegusii: eye Nyasae atang’anete koria eira ase emenwa y’ababani baye ase amariiko amachenu.

English: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
Kiswahili: yaani, Injili inayomhusu Mwanawe, yeye ambaye kwa uzao wa mwili alikuwa mzao wa Daudi,
Ekegusii: Eye nenchiri igoro y’Omwana oye Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito. Ere akaiborwa buna Mwanyabaanto ase ororeria rwa Daudi,

English: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
Kiswahili: na ambaye kwa uwezo wa Roho wa utakatifu alidhihirishwa kuwa Mwana wa Mungu kwa ufufuo wake kutoka kwa wafu, yaani, Yesu Kristo, Bwana wetu.
Ekegusii: naende ase okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure na ase chinguru chi’Omoika bw’Obochenu akaorokigwa koba Omwana o Nyasae.

English: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;
Kiswahili: Kwa kupitia kwake na kwa ajili ya Jina lake, tumepokea neema na utume ili kuwaita watu miongoni mwa watu wa mataifa yote, waje kwenye utii utokanao na imani.
Ekegusii: Asare ere ntwanyorete obuya na obotomwa, erio ase engencho y’erieta riaye tworokererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, erinde banyare koba nokoigwera gw’okwegena

English: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;
Kiswahili: Ninyi nyote pia mko miongoni mwa watu walioitwa ili mpate kuwa mali ya Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: amo nainwe abanyene, inwe abamwarangeretigwe koba aba Yeso Kristo.

English: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa wote walioko Rumi wapendwao na Mungu na kuitwa kuwa watakatifu: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
Ekegusii: Nabariikeire inwe mwensi abamomenyete Rumi, abanchwa ba Nyasae, abamwarangeretigwe koba abachenu. Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
Kiswahili: Kwanza kabisa, namshukuru Mungu wangu kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo kwa ajili yenu nyote, kwa sababu imani yenu inatangazwa duniani kote.
Ekegusii: Ritang’ani naakeire Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono ase Yeso Kristo ase engencho yaino inwe mwensi, ekiagera okwegena kwaino kwamanyekanire ase ense yonsi.

English: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu ninayemtumikia kwa moyo wangu wote katika kuhubiri Injili ya Mwanawe, ni shahidi wangu jinsi ninavyowakumbuka
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae, oyo ’ngokorera ase omoika one korandia enchiri y’Omwana oye, nere kirori one ng’a tintigeti kobaatora botambe ase ogosaba kwane.

English: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
Kiswahili: katika maombi yangu siku zote, nami ninaomba kwamba hatimaye sasa kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, njia ipate kufunguliwa kwa ajili yangu ili nije kwenu.
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo ngosaba ng’a Nyasae karanche konyigorera enchera engiya, inchiche ase more.

English: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
Kiswahili: Ninatamani sana kuwaona ili nipate kuweka juu yenu karama za rohoni ili mwe imara,
Ekegusii: Nigo inde n’amaiga kororana nainwe na kobaa ekeegwa ase enchera y’Omoika Omochenu, erio mobekwe chinguru,

English: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
Kiswahili: au zaidi, ninyi pamoja nami tuweze kutiana moyo katika imani sisi kwa sisi.
Ekegusii: erinde toremanie inche nainwe, kera omonto ase okwegena kw’oyonde, okwaino na okwane.

English: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, napenda mfahamu kwamba mara nyingi nimekusudia kuja kwenu (ingawa mpaka sasa nimezuiliwa), ili nipate kuvuna mavuno miongoni mwenu kama nilivyovuna miongoni mwa wengine ambao ni watu wa Mataifa wasiomjua Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende abaminto, nindigetie momanye ng’a ekero ase ekero nigo narengereretie gocha ase more (korende ngatangeka goika bono) erinde inyore okwama ase egati yaino, buna inde nakwo ase abanto b’Ebisaku binde.

English: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
Kiswahili: Mimi ni mdeni kwa Wayunani na kwa wasio Wayunani, kwa wenye hekima na kwa wasio na hekima.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ninde n’esiira ase Abagiriki na ase abatari Abagiriki, ase abanyasemi na ase abariri.

English: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu ninatamani sana kuihubiri Injili kwenu pia ninyi mlioko Rumi.
Ekegusii: Ase ensemo yane nigo nganetie mono korandia enchiri nonya nase more abamomenyete Rumi.

English: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.
Kiswahili: Mimi siionei haya Injili ya Kristo kwa maana ni uweza wa Mungu uletao wokovu kwa kila aaminiye, kwanza kwa Myahudi na kwa Myunani pia.
Ekegusii: Inaki tinkororera enchiri obosooku, ekiagera ero n’okobua kwa Nyasae gokorenta ogotooreka ase onde bwensi oyo bwegenete, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo.

English: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana katika Injili haki itokayo kwa Mungu imedhihirishwa, haki ile iliyo kwa njia ya imani hadi imani. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Mwenye haki ataishi kwa imani.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ime yaye oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae bwaorokiigwe korwa okwegena goika okwegena, buna eriikire, “Omonyene oboronge nabe moyo ase okwegena.”

English: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
Kiswahili: Ghadhabu ya Mungu imedhihirishwa kutoka mbinguni dhidi ya uasi wote na uovu wa wanadamu ambao huipinga kweli kwa uovu wao,
Ekegusii: Inaki endamwamu ya Nyasae yaorokiigwe korwa igoro, ase ogotamoiroka Nyasae gwonsi na obobe bwa Mwanyabaanto, abagotanga ekeene nobobe bwabo.

English: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.
Kiswahili: kwa maana yote yanayoweza kujulikana kumhusu Mungu ni dhahiri kwao, kwa sababu Mungu mwenyewe ameyadhihirisha kwao.
Ekegusii: Bono ayaranyare komanywa igoro ya Nyasae aorokigwe ase bare, ekiagera Nyasae nabaorokeretie.

English: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu, asili ya Mungu asiyeonekana kwa macho, yaani, uweza wake wa milele na asili yake ya Uungu, imeonekana waziwazi, ikitambuliwa kutokana na yale aliyoyafanya ili wanadamu wasiwe na udhuru.
Ekegusii: Inaki chingencho chiaye, echi chitari kororekana, engencho yaye okobua kwaye gwa kare na kare, na obonyasae bwaye, nchimanyekanete korwa ase ogotongwa gw’ense ase ebinto atongete. Ase igo tibari naya bagotaamera.

English: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ingawa walimjua Mungu, hawakumtukuza yeye kama ndiye Mungu wala hawakumshukuru, bali fikira zao zimekuwa batili na mioyo yao ya ujinga ikatiwa giza.
Ekegusii: Inaki nonya bamanyete Nyasae, tibamosigete buna Nyasae, gose komoakera ng’a mbuya mono; korende ebirengererio biabo bikaba bosa, na emioyo yabo y’oboriri ekabekwa omosunte.

English: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
Kiswahili: Ingawa walijidai kuwa wenye hekima, wakawa wajinga
Ekegusii: Bagateeba ng’a mbare nobong’aini, korende bakaririeka.

English: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.
Kiswahili: na kubadili utukufu wa Mungu aishiye milele kwa sanamu zilizofanywa zifanane na mwanadamu ambaye hufa, na mfano wa ndege, wanyama na viumbe vitambaavyo.
Ekegusii: Bakaonchoreria obonene bwa Nyasae, oyotari n’ogosareka, ase omogwekano bw’ekieni kia Mwanyabaanto oyore nogosareka, na oyobwechinyoni, na bwe ching’iti chire n’amagoro ane, na bwe ching’iti chikwagura.

English: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, Mungu akawaacha wazifuate tamaa mbaya za mioyo yao katika uasherati, hata wakavunjiana heshima miili yao wao kwa wao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akabatiga ase okogania okobe gwe chinkoro chiabo, batunyane obonyaka goika bagasarerania ogosika ase emebere yabo barabwo ase barabwo,

English: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu waliibadili kweli ya Mungu kuwa uongo, wakaabudu na kutumikia kiumbe badala ya Muumba, ahimidiwaye milele! Amen.
Ekegusii: ekiagera batigete ekeene kia Nyasae, bagachoora oborimo, bagasasiima na gokorera ebitongwa ribaga ri’Omotongi, oyorabaakwe kare na kare! Amina.

English: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, Mungu aliwaacha wavunjiane heshima kwa kufuata tamaa zao za aibu. Hata wanawake wao wakabadili matumizi ya asili ya miili yao wakaitumia isivyokusudiwa.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio Nyasae akabatiga batunyane okogania kwabo kw’obosooku, goika abakungu babo bakaonchoreria okomenyana kw’omobere kwa boronge ase oko gotari kwa boronge.

English: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo wanaume pia wakiacha matumizi ya asili ya wanawake wakawakiana tamaa wao kwa wao. Wanaume wakafanyiana matendo ya aibu na wanaume wengine nao wakapata katika maisha yao adhabu iliyowastahili kwa ajili ya upotovu wao.
Ekegusii: Na abasacha boigo bagatiga okomenyana nabakungu kwa boronge, bagasambwa ase okorigania abasacha ase abasacha, bagakora ogokora kw’obosooku, bakanyora abanyene ogoakanwa kwa boronge kw’ogosaria kwabo.

English: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
Kiswahili: Nao kwa kuwa hawakuona umuhimu wa kudumisha ufahamu wa Mungu, yeye akawaachilia wafuate akili za upotovu, watende mambo yale yasiyostahili kutendwa.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera batabarete ng’a ngento komomanya Nyasae, Nyasae akabatiga ase ebirengererio bie chingencho chiabo chimbe, bakore aya’atagwenereti.

English: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
Kiswahili: Wakiwa wamejawa na udhalimu wa kila namna, uasherati, uovu, tamaa mbaya na hila. Wamejawa na husuda, uuaji, ugomvi, udanganyifu, hadaa na nia mbaya. Wao pia ni wasengenyaji,
Ekegusii: Bagaichorwa ne chingencho chionsi chitari boronge, na obobe, na okogania okobe, na okorengereria okobe, ne ribero, na oboiti, na eriomana, na obong’ainereria, na okogeechana. Bakaba abagenkani,

English: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
Kiswahili: wasingiziaji, wanaomchukia Mungu, wajeuri, wenye kiburi na majivuno, wenye hila, wasiotii wazazi wao,
Ekegusii: abaitania, abamogechete Nyasae, abachaayi, abaenenu, abetogia, abaroisia amabe, abatari koigwera abaibori babo,

English: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;
Kiswahili: wajinga, wasioamini, wasio na huruma na wakatili.
Ekegusii: abariri, abatari abegenwa, abatari nobwanchani, abatari n’amaabera.

English: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
Kiswahili: Ingawa wanafahamu sheria ya haki ya Mungu kwamba watu wanaofanya mambo kama hayo wanastahili mauti, si kwamba wanaendelea kutenda hayo tu, bali pia wanakubaliana na wale wanaoyatenda.
Ekegusii: Barabwo abanyene mbamanyete mono ekiina kia Nyasae kia boronge, ng’a abagokora ayaiga nebagwenerete amakweri; tibakorete aya oka, korende nigo bagwancherana nabwo bakoyakora.

English: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo huna udhuru wowote, wewe utoaye hukumu kwa mwingine, kwa maana katika jambo lolote unalowahukumu wengine, unajihukumu wewe mwenyewe kwa sababu wewe unayehukumu unafanya mambo hayo hayo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye onde bwensi, tori naya ogotaamera, ekero okogaambia oyonde ekiina, ekiagera ase okomogaambia oyonde ekiina, naye okwegaambia omonyene. Inaki okomogaambia, na aye naro ayio ogokora?

English: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
Kiswahili: Basi tunajua kwamba hukumu ya Mungu dhidi ya wale wafanyao mambo kama hayo ni ya kweli.
Ekegusii: Intwe twamanyire ng’a ekiina kia Nyasae nigo kere boronge igoro ase abwo bagokora ayio.

English: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
Kiswahili: Hivyo wewe mwanadamu, utoapo hukumu juu yao na bado unafanya mambo yale yale, unadhani utaepuka hukumu ya Mungu?
Ekegusii: Aye omonto oyokogaambia baria bagokora ayio, naye omonyene naro ayio ogokora, Inee, nokagete ng’a aye notame korwa ase ekiina kia Nyasae?

English: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
Kiswahili: Au waudharau wingi wa wema, ustahimili na uvumilivu wake, bila kujua kuwa wema wa Mungu wakuelekeza kwenye toba?
Ekegusii: Gose ngwachaayire obonge bw’obuya bwaye, na oboremereria bwaye, na okoganya kwaye, na tomanyeti ng’a obuya bwa Nyasae nigo borigetie gokoraa gochia ase okoonchoka?

English: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu ya ukaidi wenu na mioyo yenu isiyotaka kutubu, mnajiwekea akiba ya ghadhabu dhidi yenu wenyewe kwa siku ile ya ghadhabu ya Mungu, wakati hukumu yake ya haki itakapodhihirishwa.
Ekegusii: Korende ase obokong’u bwao na enkoro yao etari nokoonchoka, kwegacheire endamwamu ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu, ekero ekiina kia boronge kia Nyasae kerache koorokigwa,

English: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu atamlipa kila mtu sawasawa na matendo yake.
Ekegusii: ekiagera ere naache komoa kera omonto koreng’ana nogokora kwaye;

English: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
Kiswahili: Wale ambao kwa kuvumilia katika kutenda mema hutafuta utukufu, heshima na maisha yasiyoharibika, Mungu atawapa uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: nabae obogima bwa kare na kare baria bakorigia obonene, na ogosika, na ogotasareka, na gokora amaya ase oboremereria.

English: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa wale watafutao mambo yao wenyewe na wale wanaokataa kweli na kuzifuata njia mbaya, kutakuwa na ghadhabu na hasira ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende endamwamu na ekeririanda inabibe igoro ase baria beanchete abanyene, batari koigwera ekeene, korende bakoigwera ayatari boronge.

English: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
Kiswahili: Kutakuwa na taabu na dhiki kwa kila mmoja atendaye maovu, Myahudi kwanza na mtu wa Mataifa pia,
Ekegusii: Emechando na obororo inabibe igoro ase kera oyomo bw’abana ba Mwanyabaanto oyogokora amabe, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo;

English: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
Kiswahili: bali utukufu, heshima na amani kwa ajili ya kila mmoja atendaye mema, kwa Myahudi kwanza, kisha kwa mtu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: korende obonene na ogosika, na omorembe nigo bire ase kera oyomo oyogokora amaya, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo.

English: For there is no partiality with God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu hana upendeleo.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera gwanchereria tikori ase Nyasae.

English: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
Kiswahili: Watu wote waliotenda dhambi pasipo sheria wataangamia pasipo sheria, nao wote wale waliotenda dhambi chini ya sheria watahukumiwa kwa sheria.
Ekegusii: Inaki Abagiriki bakorire ebibe batari namachiiko a Musa, inabasire batari namachiiko; na Abayahudi bakorire ebibe bare namachiiko, nabo baranacherwe ekiina ase amachiiko.

English: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
Kiswahili: Kwa maana si wale wanaoisikia sheria ambao ni wenye haki mbele za Mungu, bali ni wale wanaoitii sheria ndio watakaohesabiwa haki.
Ekegusii: Inaki tari abwo bakoigwa amachiiko bare abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende mbaria bagoikerania amachiiko, nabwo baraegwe oboronge.

English: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
Kiswahili: (Naam, wakati wa watu wa Mataifa, ambao hawana sheria, wanapofanya kwa asili mambo yatakiwayo na sheria, wao ni sheria kwa nafsi zao wenyewe, hata ingawa hawana sheria.
Ekegusii: Abanto b’Ebisaku batari namachiiko, ekero bagokora buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ere aya amachiiko are korigia, nonya abwo tibari namachiiko, babeire amachiiko boka abanyene.

English: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
Kiswahili: Wao wanaonyesha kwamba lile linalotakiwa na sheria limeandikwa kwenye mioyo yao, ambayo pia dhamiri zao zikiwashuhudia, nayo mawazo yao yenye kupingana yatawashtaki au kuwatetea.)
Ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakoorokia ng’a aya amachiiko are korigia ariikirwe ime ase chinkoro chiabo. Okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime nigo gokobabera kirori, na ebirengererio biabo nigo bikobasoera gose kobaegerera.

English: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Hili litatukia siku hiyo Mungu atakapozihukumu siri za wanadamu kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo, kama isemavyo Injili yangu.
Ekegusii: Nabo arache koba ase rituko riria, koreng’ana nenchiri eye nkorandia, Nyasae kagochi‐gocha nanachere obobisi bwa Mwanyabaanto ekiina, goetera ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
Kiswahili: Tazama, wewe ukiwa unaitwa Myahudi na kuitegemea sheria na kujisifia uhusiano wako na Mungu,
Ekegusii: Korende aye okweroka Omoyahudi, na gosemeretie amachiiko, na gwetogia ase Nyasae.

English: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
Kiswahili: kama unajua mapenzi ya Mungu na kukubali lililo bora kwa sababu umefundishwa na hiyo sheria,
Ekegusii: Kwamanyire ogwancha kwaye, naende nomanyete buya amang’ana ayare amaya, ekiagera kworokererigwe amachiiko.

English: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
Kiswahili: kama unatambua kuwa wewe ni kiongozi wa vipofu, na mwanga kwa wale walio gizani,
Ekegusii: Nore nobomaene ng’a aye omonyene nigo ore omoraai bw’emeuko, na omobaso bw’abare ase omosunte ime.

English: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
Kiswahili: mkufunzi wa wajinga na mwalimu wa watoto wachanga, kwa kuwa una maarifa ya kweli katika hiyo sheria,
Ekegusii: Omotebereria bw’abariri, na omworokia bw’abana abake, ekiagera kwanyorire okworokereria okuya gwe chisemi na ekeene bire ime ase amachiiko.

English: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
Kiswahili: basi wewe, uwafundishaye wengine, mbona hujifunzi mwenyewe? Wewe uhubiriye kwamba mtu asiibe, wewe mwenyewe waiba?
Ekegusii: Aye okworokereria abande, Inee, tokweorokereria aye omonyene? Aye okorandia ng’a omonto taiba, tori koiba aye omonyene?

English: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
Kiswahili: Wewe usemaye mtu asizini, wewe mwenyewe wazini? Wewe uchukiaye miungu ya sanamu, wafanya jambo la kumchukiza katika mahekalu?
Ekegusii: Aye ogoteeba ng’a omonto tatomana, tori gotomana aye omonyene? Aye ogechete emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, aye tori koiba korwa ase chi Hekalu?

English: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
Kiswahili: Wewe ujivuniaye sheria, wamwaibisha Mungu kwa kuvunja sheria?
Ekegusii: Aye ogwetogeria amachiiko, Inee, nigo ogosareria Nyasae ogosika ase ogosaria kwao kw’amachiiko?

English: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa, “Kwa ajili yenu ninyi, Jina la Mungu linatukanwa miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa.”
Ekegusii: Inaki amariiko nigo agoteeba, “Erieta ria Nyasae nigo rikoramwa ase egati y’ abanto b’Ebisaku ase engencho yaino.”

English: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
Kiswahili: Kutahiriwa kuna thamani ikiwa unatii sheria, lakini kama unavunja sheria, kutahiriwa kwako kumekuwa kutokutahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Okwaroka nigo kogwenerete onye kore omoigweri bw’amachiiko, korende onye kore omosaria bw’amachiiko, okwaroka kwao kwabeire ogotaaroka.

English: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
Kiswahili: Hivyo, ikiwa wale wasiotahiriwa wanatimiza mambo ambayo sheria inataka, je, kutokutahiriwa kwao hakutahesabiwa kuwa sawa na kutahiriwa?
Ekegusii: Karabe ere oyotaarogeti okobwata amachiiko, Inee, ogotaaroka kwaye tigokobarwa ng’a kwabeire okwaroka?

English: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
Kiswahili: Ndipo wale ambao hawakutahiriwa kimwili lakini wanaitii sheria watawahukumu ninyi, ambao ingawa mmetahiriwa na kuijua sana sheria ya Mungu iliyoandikwa, lakini mwaivunja.
Ekegusii: Ere oyotaarogeti ase omobere, onye obwatete amachiiko, Inee, tagokonachera ekiina aye, oyore namachiiko na okwaroka, naende osaririe amachiiko?

English: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mtu si Myahudi kwa vile alivyo kwa nje, wala tohara ya kweli si kitu cha nje au cha kimwili.
Ekegusii: Inaki ere oyore Omoyahudi ase isiko oka, tari Omoyahudi bw’ekeene, gose okwaroka koria gokorire isiko ase omobere, tikori okwaroka gw’ekeene.

English: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu ni Myahudi alivyo ndani, nayo tohara ya kweli ni jambo la moyoni, ni la Roho, wala si la sheria iliyoandikwa. Mtu wa namna hiyo hapokei sifa kutoka kwa wanadamu bali kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende ere n’Omoyahudi bw’ekeene oyore Omoyahudi o ime, na okwaroka gw’ekeene nogw’enkoro. Eye nemeremo y’Omoika, teri ey’amariiko. Ogotogigwa kwaye tikorueti ase Mwanyabaanto, korende nase Nyasae.

English: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
Kiswahili: Basi kuna faida gani kuwa Myahudi? Au kuna thamani gani katika tohara?
Ekegusii: Gaki rende, Omoyahudi inki abuete abande? Na okwaroka inki kogwenerete?

English: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.
Kiswahili: Kuna faida kubwa kwa kila namna! Kwanza kabisa, Wayahudi wamekabidhiwa lile Neno halisi la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nkogwenerete mono ase kera enchera. Ritang’ani, Abayahudi mbegenetwe konyora ring’ana ria Nyasae.

English: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
Kiswahili: Ingekuwaje kama wengine hawakuwa na imani? Je, kutokuamini kwao kungebatilisha uaminifu wa Mungu?
Ekegusii: Inki rende onye abande tibari abegenwa? Inee! Ogotegenwa kwabo nakonyaare gokora obwegenwa bwa Nyasae bobe bosa?

English: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”
Kiswahili: La hasha! Mungu na aonekane mwenye haki, na kila mwanadamu kuwa mwongo, kama ilivyoandikwa: “Ili uthibitike kuwa wa kweli unaponena, na ukashinde utoapo hukumu.”
Ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Goika Nyasae amanyekane ng’a nomonyene ekeene, nonya ’nkera omonto ore omorimo, buna eriikire, “Erinde omanyekane ng’a mboronge ore ase amang’ana ao, na obue ekero ogosoa ase ekiina.”

English: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa uovu wetu unathibitisha haki ya Mungu waziwazi, tuseme nini basi? Je, Mungu kuileta ghadhabu yake juu yetu ni kwamba yeye si mwenye haki? (Nanena kibinadamu.)
Ekegusii: Korende ker’abe ng’a obobe bwaito bokoorokia oboronge bwa Nyasae, inki torateebe rende? Nyasae noy’otari omooronge ekero akorenta endamwamu? (Nakwanire buna Mwanyabaanto).

English: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
Kiswahili: La hasha! Kama hivyo ndivyo ilivyo, Mungu angehukumuje ulimwengu?
Ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Onye nabo, inaki rende Nyasae aranyare kogaambia ense?

English: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
Kiswahili: Mtu aweza kuuliza, “Kama uongo wangu unasaidia kuonyesha kweli ya Mungu na kuzidisha utukufu wake, kwa nini basi mimi nahukumiwa kuwa mwenye dhambi?”
Ekegusii: Korende onye oboene obonge bwa Nyasae bwamentekire ase obonene bwaye ase engencho y’oborimo bwane, nase ki inche nonya mbono nkona‐kogambigwa buna omonyene ebibe?

English: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
Kiswahili: Nasi kwa nini tusiseme, kama wengine wanavyotusingizia kuwa tunasema, “Tutende maovu ili mema yapate kuja?” Wao wanastahili hukumu yao.
Ekegusii: Inaki rende totagokora obobe, erinde obuya boche? Buna abande bagoteeba ase ogotoitania. Okogambigwa kwabo nigo kore boronge.

English: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.
Kiswahili: Tusemeje basi? Je, sisi ni bora kuwaliko wao? La hasha! Kwa maana tumekwisha kuhakikisha kwa vyovyote kwamba Wayahudi na watu wa Mataifa wote wako chini ya nguvu ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Ninki rende? Intwe Abayahudi n’abaya tore kobua abande? Yaya, nonya ng’ake! Inaki nasoereire Abayahudi amo n’Abagiriki ng’a bonsi nigo bare inse y’okobua kw’ebibe;

English: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Hakuna mwenye haki, hakuna hata mmoja.
Ekegusii: buna eriikire ng’a, “Onde tari omonyene oboronge, nonya noyomo;

English: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mmoja mwenye ufahamu, hakuna hata mmoja amtafutaye Mungu.
Ekegusii: onde tari okomanya, onde tari okorigia Nyasae.

English: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
Kiswahili: Wote wamepotoka, wote wameoza pamoja; hakuna atendaye mema, naam, hakuna hata mmoja.”
Ekegusii: Bonsi bachiire bogeeka korwa ase Nyasae, bonsi babeire bosa; onde tari oy’ogokora amaya, nonya n’oyomo.

English: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
Kiswahili: “Makoo yao ni makaburi wazi; kwa ndimi zao wao hufanya udanganyifu.” “Sumu ya nyoka iko midomoni mwao.”
Ekegusii: Emioyo yabo noboina bwasie, ase emenwa yabo nigo bagokwana obong’ainereria, obosongo bwe ching’iti nigo bore ase ebikoba bi’emenwa yabo.

English: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
Kiswahili: “Vinywa vyao vimejaa laana na uchungu.”
Ekegusii: Emenwa yabo yaichoirwe nokoragereria na obororo,

English: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.
Kiswahili: “Miguu yao ina haraka kumwaga damu;
Ekegusii: amagoro abo nigo are amaango ase ogoitera amanyinga,

English: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
Kiswahili: maangamizi na taabu viko katika njia zao,
Ekegusii: obosareku na emechando nigo bire ase chinchera chiabo.

English: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”
Kiswahili: wala njia ya amani hawaijui.”
Ekegusii: Enchera y’omorembe tibayemanyeti.

English: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
Kiswahili: “Hakuna hofu ya Mungu machoni pao.”
Ekegusii: Okomoiroka Nyasae tikori ase amaiso abo.”

English: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
Kiswahili: Basi tunajua ya kwamba chochote sheria inachosema, inawaambia wale walio chini ya sheria ili kila kinywa kinyamazishwe na ulimwengu wote uwajibike kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a amang’ana onsi agokwanwa n’amachiiko nigo agokwanwa ase baria bare inse y’amachiiko, erinde kera omonwa osiekwe, na ense yonsi ebekwe inse ase ekiina kia Nyasae.

English: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hakuna binadamu hata mmoja atakayehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu kwa matendo ya sheria, kwa maana sheria hutufanya tuitambue dhambi.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase ogokora kw’amachiiko onde tari ase Mwanyabaanto oranyare konyora oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ekiagera amachiiko n’aro akorenta okomanya ebibe.

English: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa, haki itokayo kwa Mungu imedhihirishwa pasipo sheria, ambayo Sheria na Manabii wanaishuhudia.
Ekegusii: Korende bono oboronge bwa Nyasae bwaorokigwe machiiko ataiyo, obwaberetwe kirori namachiiko na ababani,

English: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
Kiswahili: Haki hii itokayo kwa Mungu hupatikana kwa Yesu Kristo kwa wote wamwaminio. Kwa maana hapo hakuna tofauti,
Ekegusii: engencho yaye oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae obo bogocha ase enchera y’okomwegena Yeso Kristo ase bonsi abegenete. Inaki gwatananekana tikori,

English: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa wote wametenda dhambi na kupungukiwa na utukufu wa Mungu,
Ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe, na baremeirwe n’obonene bwa Nyasae;

English: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: wanahesabiwa haki bure kwa neema yake kwa njia ya ukombozi ulio katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: baeirwe oboronge buna ekeegwa ase obuya bwaye, ase enchera y’okoboorigwa kore ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye Mungu alimtoa awe dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa njia ya imani katika damu yake. Alifanya hivi ili kuonyesha haki yake, kwa sababu kwa ustahimili wake aliziachilia zile dhambi zilizotangulia kufanywa.
Ekegusii: Ere Nyasae omobekire koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase amanyinga aye, erinde tomonyoore ase enchera y’okwegena. Igo Nyasae oorokirie oboronge bwaye, ekiagera ase okoremereria kwaye atigete ebibe biria biatang’anete.

English: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
Kiswahili: Alifanya hivyo ili kuonyesha haki yake wakati huu, ili yeye awe mwenye haki na mwenye kumhesabia haki yule anayemwamini Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ekero ekeiga oorokirie ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge, naende nere okomoa oboronge oyo okomwegena Yeso.

English: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
Kiswahili: Basi, kujivuna kuko wapi? Kumewekwa mbali. Kwa sheria gani? Je, ni kwa ile ya matendo? La hasha, bali kwa ile sheria ya imani.
Ekegusii: Ng’ai rende ogwetogia gwaito kore? Kende tikeri. Ase ogochika ki? Ase ogochika kw’ogokora? Yaya, korende ase ogochika gw’okwegena.

English: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana twaona kwamba mwanadamu huhesabiwa haki kwa njia ya imani wala si kwa matendo ya sheria.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, tokobara ng’a omonto nigo akoegwa oboronge ase okwegena kore ao nogokora kw’amachiiko.

English: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
Kiswahili: Je, Mungu ni Mungu wa Wayahudi peke yao? Je, yeye si Mungu wa watu wa Mataifa pia? Naam, yeye ni Mungu wa watu wa Mataifa pia.
Ekegusii: Gose Nyasae nigo are Nyasae bw’Abayahudi boka? Tari Nyasae bw’Ebisaku boigo? Ee, ere ’Nyasae bw’Ebisaku boigo.

English: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa kuwa tuna Mungu mmoja tu, atawahesabia haki wale waliotahiriwa kwa imani na wale wasiotahiriwa kwa imani iyo hiyo.
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae noyomo, oranyare koa Abayahudi oboronge ase okwegena, na abanto b’ebisaku ase enchera y’okwegena.

English: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
Kiswahili: Je, basi ni kwamba tunaibatilisha sheria kwa imani hii? La, hasha! Badala yake tunaithibitisha sheria.
Ekegusii: Inee! Ntwaonchoire amachiiko abe bosa ase okwegena okwo? Yaya, taibo! Nigo togwanchera amachiiko.

English: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi, kuhusu Abrahamu baba yetu kwa jinsi ya mwili: yeye alipataje kujua jambo hili?
Ekegusii: Inki rende toratebe? Aburaamu sokoro yaito bw’ororeria inki anyorete?

English: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ikiwa Abrahamu alihesabiwa haki kwa matendo, basi, anacho kitu cha kujivunia, lakini si mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera onye Aburaamu oetwe oboronge ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye, nare neki agwetogeria, korende tari ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Maandiko yasemaje? “Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu na ikahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki.”
Ekegusii: Ninki amariiko agoteeba? “Aburaamu nigo amwegenete Nyasae, na ase engencho eyio akabarerwa oboronge.”

English: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
Kiswahili: Basi mtu afanyapo kazi, mshahara wake hauhesabiwi kwake kuwa ni zawadi, bali ni haki yake anayostahili.
Ekegusii: Korende ase omonto oy’ogokora emeremo, eng’eria yaye teri kobarwa buna nobuya, korende nigo ekoba ogoakanwa ase emeremo yaye.

English: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa mtu ambaye hafanyi kazi na anamtumaini Mungu, yeye ambaye huwahesabia waovu haki, imani yake inahesabiwa kuwa haki.
Ekegusii: Ase omonto otari gosemeria ogokora kw’emeremo yaye, korende nigo egenete ere oria okoa abanyabibe oboronge, okwegena kwaye omonto oyio kwamobarire ng’a n’are noboronge.

English: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:
Kiswahili: Daudi pia alisema vivyo hivyo aliponena juu ya baraka za mtu ambaye Mungu humhesabia haki pasipo matendo:
Ekegusii: Naboigo Daudi agoteeba, ng’a nasesenirie omonto oria ere Nyasae abarire koba noboronge atari nogokora kw’amachiiko,

English: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
Kiswahili: “Wamebarikiwa wale ambao wamesamehewa makosa yao, ambao dhambi zao zimefunikwa.
Ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abaabeirwe ebibe biabo, abwo ebibe biabo biatubirwe.

English: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
Kiswahili: Heri mtu yule Bwana hamhesabii dhambi zake.”
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto ori’Omonene atabarereti ebibe biaye.”

English: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
Kiswahili: Je, huku kubarikiwa ni kwa wale waliotahiriwa peke yao, au pia na kwa wale wasiotahiriwa? Tunasema, “Imani ya Abrahamu ilihesabiwa kwake kuwa haki.”
Ekegusii: Inee! Ogosesenigwa oko nigo kore ase abwo baarogete, gose nase abwo batarogeti boigo? Nigo togoteeba, ng’a Aburaamu ase okwegena kwaye akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge.

English: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
Kiswahili: Je, ni lini basi ilipohesabiwa kwake kuwa haki? Je, ilikuwa kabla au baada ya kutahiriwa kwake? Haikuwa baada, ila kabla hajatahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Indi abareretwe ayio? Nekero konya arokire gose nekero konya ataraaroka? Tari ekero konya arokire, korende nekero konya ataraaroka.

English: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
Kiswahili: Alipewa ishara ya tohara kuwa muhuri wa haki aliyokuwa nayo kwa imani hata alipokuwa bado hajatahiriwa. Kusudi lilikuwa kumfanya baba wa wote wale waaminio pasipo kutahiriwa na ambao wamehesabiwa haki.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo anyorete ekiorokererio eke gi’okwaroka buna ekemanyererio ki’oboronge bw’okwegena arenge naborobwo rigoro ataraaroka, anyare koba ise o bonsi abegenete, nonya tibaarogeti, erinde baabarerwe oboronge.

English: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
