Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo awe baba wa wale waliotahiriwa ambao si kwamba wametahiriwa tu, bali pia wanafuata mfano wa imani ambayo Baba yetu Abrahamu alikuwa nayo kabla ya kutahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo akaba ise bw’abaarogete, tari ng’a baarogete rioka, korende boigo abagotunyana chimbaratero chi’okwegena kwaye sokoro yaito Aburaamu, oko arenge nakorokwo ekero konya ataraaroka.

English: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ile ahadi kwamba angeurithi ulimwengu haikuja kwa Abrahamu au kwa wazao wake kwa njia ya sheria bali kwa njia ya haki ipatikanayo kwa imani.
Ekegusii: Inaki eira eria Aburaamu aetwe amo noroiboro rw’aye ng’a naire omwando bw’ense, tiyarwete ase amachiiko korende ase oboronge obwo anyorete ase okwegena.

English: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ikiwa wale waishio kwa sheria ndio warithi, imani haina thamani na ahadi haifai kitu,
Ekegusii: Inaki onye baria b’amachiiko mbarabwo abanyamwando, rirorio okwegena kwabeire okwa bosa, na eira yabeire teri gento.

English: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu sheria huleta ghadhabu. Mahali ambapo hakuna sheria hakuna makosa.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ogochika nakwo gokorenta endamwamu; na aase ogochika gotari, komocha tikoiyo.

English: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ahadi huja kwa njia ya imani, ili iwe ni kwa neema, na itolewe kwa wazao wa Abrahamu, si kwa wale walio wa sheria peke yao, bali pia kwa wale walio wa imani ya Abrahamu. Yeye ndiye baba yetu sisi sote.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio eira eye nigo yanyoretwe ase okwegena, ebe ase enchera y’amaabera, erinde enyare koba eng’ikeranu ase oroiboro rwaye rwonsi, tari ase baria b’amachiiko boka korende nase baria bare nokwegena buna okwa Aburaamu. Ere nere tata oito intwe twensi,

English: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Nimekufanya wewe kuwa baba wa mataifa mengi.” Yeye ni baba yetu mbele za Mungu, ambaye yeye alimwamini, yule Mungu anaye fufua waliokufa, na kuvitaja vile vitu ambavyo haviko kana kwamba vimekwisha kuwako.
Ekegusii: buna eriikire ng’a, “Nakobekire obe ise bw’ebisaku ebinge”. Eira eye nigo yaikeranire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ere oyo Aburaamu egenete, Nyasae oyokobokia abakuure, naende bwatora ebinto bitaiyo buna mbireo.

English: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
Kiswahili: Akitarajia yasiyoweza kutarajiwa, Abrahamu akaamini, akawa baba wa mataifa mengi, kama alivyoahidiwa kwamba, “Uzao wako utakuwa mwingi mno.”
Ekegusii: Ere akeegena ase ogosemeria ase ay’atanyare gosemerigwa, erinde abe ise bw’ebisaku ebinge, buna ateebetigwe, “Naboigo oroiboro rwao rorabe.”

English: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu hakuwa dhaifu katika imani hata alipofikiri juu ya mwili wake, ambao ulikuwa kama uliokufa, kwani umri wake ulikuwa unakaribia miaka mia moja, au alipofikiri juu ya ufu wa tumbo la Sara.
Ekegusii: Tabeete omworo ase okwegena, ekero aroche ng’a omobere oye obeire ang’e nogokwa, ekiagera konya okoorire emiaka koreng’ana rigana erimo, na enda ya Sara egombaete;

English: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
Kiswahili: Lakini Abrahamu hakusitasita kwa kutokuamini ahadi ya Mungu, bali alitiwa nguvu katika imani yake na kumpa Mungu utukufu,
Ekegusii: gose tabeete na tang’u‐tang’u chinde ase eira eria ya Nyasae ase ogotegena, korende nigo abegetwe chinguru ase okwegena kwaye, akamotogia Nyasae.

English: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
Kiswahili: akiwa na hakika kabisa kwamba Mungu alikuwa na uwezo wa kutimiza lile aliloahidi.
Ekegusii: Akamanya boronge ng’a Nyasae nanyare gokora aria arierete eira.

English: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
Kiswahili: Hii ndio sababu, “ilihesabiwa kwake kuwa haki.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ase okwegena kwaye “akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge.”

English: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
Kiswahili: Maneno haya “ilihesabiwa kwake kuwa haki,” hayakuandikwa kwa ajili yake peke yake,
Ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aya “akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge” tarigetwe ase engencho yaye bweka,

English: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
Kiswahili: bali kwa ajili yetu sisi pia ambao Mungu atatupa haki, sisi tunaomwamini yeye aliyemfufua Yesu Bwana wetu kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: korende nase engencho yaito boigo. Nonya nintwe ntoche kobarerwa boigo, intwe abatwamwegenire ere oyomobogetie Yeso, Omonene oito, korwa ase abakuure,

English: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
Kiswahili: Alitolewa afe kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, naye alifufuliwa kutoka mauti ili tuhesabiwe haki.
Ekegusii: oyoruetwe ase ogokwa ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, na akabokigwa ekiagera otorenteire oboronge.

English: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa tumekwisha kuhesabiwa haki kwa imani, tuna amani na Mungu kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo,
Ekegusii: Ase igo ekero twaeirwe oboronge ase okwegena, ntore nomorembe na Nyasae goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
Kiswahili: ambaye kwa kupitia kwake tumepata kwa njia ya imani kuifikia neema hii ambayo ndani yake sasa tunasimama, nasi twafurahia katika tumaini letu la kushiriki utukufu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Goetera ase are twaigoreirwe enchera ase okwegena goikera ase obuya obo toteneine ime yaye, naende nigo tokogoka ase ogosemeria kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.

English: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
Kiswahili: Si hivyo tu, bali twafurahi pia katika mateso, kwa sababu tunajua kuwa mateso huleta saburi,
Ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende nigo tokogoka nonya nase emechando yaito, ekiagera ntomanyete ng’a emechando nigo ekorenta oboremereria;

English: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
Kiswahili: nayo saburi huleta uthabiti wa moyo, na uthabiti wa moyo huleta tumaini,
Ekegusii: na oboremereria nigo bokorenta oboremu bw’omoyo, na oboremu bw’omoyo nigo bokorenta ogosemeria.

English: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
Kiswahili: wala tumaini halitukatishi tamaa, kwa sababu Mungu amekwisha kumimina pendo lake mioyoni mwetu kwa njia ya Roho Mtakatifu ambaye ametupatia.
Ekegusii: Na ogosemeria tikori gotorentera obosooku, ekiagera obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaichorigwe ase chinkoro chiaito n’Omoika Omochenu, oyo twaetwe.

English: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hata tulipokuwa dhaifu, wakati ulipowadia, Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yetu sisi wenye dhambi.
Ekegusii: Amaene ekero totarenge ne chinguru, ekero engaki yaigete, Kristo agakwa ase engencho y’abanyabibe.

English: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.
Kiswahili: Hakika, ni vigumu mtu yeyote kufa kwa ajili ya mwenye haki, ingawa inawezekana mtu akathubutu kufa kwa ajili ya mtu mwema.
Ekegusii: Inaki naakong’u omonto gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omonyene oboronge, korende nenyarekane omonto koremereria gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omuya.

English: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu anaudhihirisha upendo wake kwetu kwamba: Tulipokuwa tungali wenye dhambi, Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae oorokirie obwanchani bwaye ase tore ase ogotoma Kristo gokwa ase engencho yaito, ekero twarenge abanyene ebibe.

English: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
Kiswahili: Basi, kwa kuwa sasa tumehesabiwa haki kwa damu yake, si zaidi sana tutaokolewa kutoka ghadhabu ya Mungu kupitia kwake!
Ekegusii: Naboigo kobua mono, gatwaeirwe oboronge ase amanyinga aye, ere natotoorie korwa ase endamwamu ya Nyasae.

English: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama tulipokuwa adui wa Mungu tulipatanishwa naye kwa njia ya kifo cha Mwanawe, si zaidi sana tukiisha kupatanishwa, tutaokolewa kwa uzima wake.
Ekegusii: Inaki ekero twarenge ababisa ba Nyasae, tokabwatanigwa nere ase amakweri y’Omwana oye. Kobua mono, magega gatwabwatanigwe natotoorigwe ase obogima bwaye;

English: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
Kiswahili: Lakini zaidi ya hayo, pia tunafurahi katika Mungu kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, ambaye kupitia kwake tumepata upatanisho.
Ekegusii: gose tari igo rioka, korende nigo tokogoka ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo ere ase are twanyorire okobwatanigwa.

English: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kama vile dhambi ilivyoingia ulimwenguni kupitia kwa mtu mmoja, na kupitia dhambi hii mauti ikawafikia watu wote, kwa sababu wote wamefanya dhambi:
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna ase engencho y’omonto oyomo ebibe bigasoa ase ense, na ase engencho y’ebibe amakweri, naboigo amakweri agaikera abanto bonsi, ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe.

English: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
Kiswahili: kwa maana kabla sheria haijatolewa, dhambi ilikuwepo ulimwenguni. Lakini dhambi haihesabiwi wakati hakuna sheria.
Ekegusii: Inaki ebibe nao biarenge ase ense amachiiko atarabekwa, korende ebibe tibikobarwa amachiiko ataiyo.

English: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, tangu wakati wa Adamu hadi wakati wa Mose, mauti ilitawala watu wote, hata wale ambao hawakutenda dhambi kwa kuvunja amri, kama alivyofanya Adamu, ambaye alikuwa mfano wa yule atakayekuja.
Ekegusii: Korende amakweri nigo agaambete korwa Adamu goika Musa, nonya niigoro y’abwo batakorete ebibe koreng’ana nogosaria kw’Adamu, oyorenge omogwekano bw’oyio ogochi‐gocha.

English: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
Kiswahili: Lakini ile karama iliyotolewa haikuwa kama lile kosa. Kwa maana ikiwa watu wengi walikufa kwa sababu ya kosa la mtu mmoja, zaidi sana neema ya Mungu na ile karama iliyokuja kwa neema ya mtu mmoja, yaani, Yesu Kristo, imezidi kuwa nyingi kwa ajili ya wengi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera tikeri buna ogosaria koria. Inaki ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakwa, korende amaabera a Nyasae na ekeegwa eke ki’amaabera biamentekire kobua mono ase abange ase omonto oyomo Yeso Kristo.

English: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.
Kiswahili: Tena, ile karama ya Mungu si kama matokeo ya ile dhambi. Hukumu ilikuja kwa njia ya mtu mmoja, ikaleta adhabu, bali karama ya neema ya Mungu ilikuja kwa njia ya makosa mengi, ikaleta kuhesabiwa haki.
Ekegusii: Ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera tikeri buna ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo, ekiagera ekiina keria nigo giachete ase enchera y’ogosaria okomo, gekarenta okogambigwa, korende ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera kegaacha ase engencho y’ogosaria okonge, gekarenta oboronge.

English: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ikiwa kutokana na kosa la mtu mmoja, mauti ilitawala kupitia huyo mtu mmoja, zaidi sana wale wanaopokea wingi wa neema ya Mungu na karama yake ya kuhesabiwa haki, watatawala katika uzima kwa njia ya huyo mtu mmoja, yaani, Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Onye ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo amakweri agaambete ase engencho y’omonto oria oyomo, kobua mono abwo banyorire amaabera amange na ekeegwa ki’oboronge nabagaambe ase obogima goetera ase omonto oyomo, Yeso Kristo.

English: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kama vile kosa la mtu mmoja lilivyoleta adhabu kwa watu wote, vivyo hivyo pia kwa tendo la haki la mtu mmoja lilileta kuhesabiwa haki ambako huleta uzima kwa wote.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, buna ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo abanto bonsi bakanacherwa ekiina, ee, naboigo ase ogokora kw’oboronge kw’omonto oyomo, abanto bonsi bakaegwa oboronge na obogima.

English: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile kwa kutokutii kwa yule mtu mmoja wengi walifanywa wenye dhambi, vivyo hivyo kwa kutii kwa mtu mmoja wengi watafanywa wenye haki.
Ekegusii: Inaki buna ase ogotaigwera kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakorwa koba abanyene ebibe, naboigo ase okogwa kw’omonto oyomo abange nabakorwe koba abanyene oboronge.

English: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, sheria ilikuja, ili uvunjaji wa sheria uongezeke. Lakini dhambi ilipoongezeka, neema iliongezeka zaidi,
Ekegusii: Amachiiko agasoa, erinde ogosaria kobe okonene mono. Korende aase ebibe biamentegete, amaabera akamenteka akaba amange kobua,

English: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba kama vile dhambi ilivyotawala kwa njia ya mauti, vivyo hivyo neema iweze kutawala kwa njia ya kuhesabiwa haki hata kuleta uzima wa milele katika Yesu Kristo Bwana wetu.
Ekegusii: erinde, buna ebibe biagaambete ase amakweri, naboigo ase enchera y’oboronge amaabera agaambe goika obogima bwa kare na kare goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito.

English: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi? Je, tuendelee kutenda dhambi ili neema ipate kuongezeka?
Ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Togenderere ase ebibe, erinde amaabera amenteke abe amange kobua?

English: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
Kiswahili: La hasha! Sisi tulioifia dhambi, tutawezaje kuendelea kuishi tena katika dhambi?
Ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Intwe abatwakuure korwa ase ebibe, inaki toranyare komenya ase ebibe naende?

English: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
Kiswahili: Au hamjui ya kuwa sisi sote tuliobatizwa katika Kristo Yesu tulibatizwa katika mauti yake?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a intwe twensi abatwabatisetwe ase Kristo Yeso nigo twabatisetwe ase amakweri aye?

English: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tulizikwa pamoja naye kwa njia ya ubatizo katika mauti, ili kama vile Kristo alivyofufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu kwa utukufu wa Baba, vivyo hivyo sisi nasi pia tupate kuenenda katika upya wa uzima.
Ekegusii: Naboigo twatindegetwe amo nere ase enchera y’ebatiso ase amakweri, erinde buna Kristo abogetigwe korwa ase abakuure ase obonene bwa Ise, naboigo naintwe, totaare ase obogima oboyia.

English: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ikiwa tumeungana naye katika mauti yake, bila shaka tutaungana naye katika ufufuo wake.
Ekegusii: Inaki onye twabwatanire nere ase amakweri buna ayaye, naboigo torabwatane nere ase okobokigwa buna ok’waye.

English: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana twajua kwamba utu wetu wa kale ulisulubiwa pamoja naye ili ule mwili wa dhambi upate kuangamizwa, nasi tusiendelee kuwa tena watumwa wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a obo Mwanyabaanto bwaito bwa kare nigo bwabambetwe amo nere, erinde omobere bw’ebibe osirigwe, titoba abasomba b’ebibe naende.

English: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mtu yeyote aliyekufa amehesabiwa haki mbali na dhambi.
Ekegusii: Inaki ere oy okuure osiboirwe korwa ase ebibe.

English: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa tulikufa pamoja na Kristo, tunaamini kwamba pia tutaishi pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Korende onye twakwete amo na Kristo, twegenire ng’a inatobe moyo amo nere.

English: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tunajua kwamba Kristo, kwa sababu alifufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, hawezi kufa tena; mauti haina tena mamlaka juu yake.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Kristo oyobogetigwe korwa ase abakuure tagokwa naende; amakweri takomogaambera naende.

English: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
Kiswahili: Kifo alichokufa, aliifia dhambi mara moja tu, lakini uzima alio nao anamwishia Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase ogokwa koria akwete nigo akwerete ebibe ara rimo rioka, korende obogima boria are nabwo nigo are nabwo ase Nyasae.

English: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, jihesabuni wafu katika dhambi lakini mlio hai kwa Mungu katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe mwebare ng’a mwabeire abakuure ase ebibe, korende mwabeire moyo ase Nyasae ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, msiruhusu dhambi itawale ndani ya miili yenu, ipatikanayo na kufa, ili kuwafanya mzitii tamaa mbaya.
Ekegusii: Bono timotiga ebibe bigaambe ime ase emebere yaino ey’ekonyorekana n’amakweri, na timobaisa koigwera okogania kwabo okobe.

English: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
Kiswahili: Wala msivitoe viungo vya miili yenu vitumike kama vyombo vya uovu vya kutenda dhambi, bali jitoeni kwa Mungu, kama watu waliotolewa kutoka mautini kuingia uzimani. Nanyi vitoeni viungo vya miili yenu kwake kama vyombo vya haki.
Ekegusii: Timobaisa korua ebiimo biaino bikore ebibe buna ebikorero bi’obobe, korende mwerue abanyene ase Nyasae buna abanto barusetigwe korwa ase ogokwa na babekirwe ase obogima, na ebiimo biaino ase Nyasae bibe ebikorero bi’oboronge.

English: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana dhambi haitakuwa na mamlaka juu yenu, kwa sababu hampo chini ya sheria, bali chini ya neema.
Ekegusii: Inaki ebibe tibikobaagaambera inwe, ekiagera timori inse y’amachiiko korende inse y’amaabera.

English: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!
Kiswahili: Ni nini basi? Je, tutende dhambi kwa kuwa hatuko chini ya sheria bali chini ya neema? La, hasha!
Ekegusii: Ninki rende? Tokore ebibe ekiagera totari inse y’amachiiko korende inse y’amaabera? Yaya taibo!

English: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
Kiswahili: Je, hamjui kwamba mnapojitoa kwa mtu yeyote kama watumwa watiifu, ninyi ni watumwa wa yule mnayemtii, aidha watumwa wa dhambi, ambayo matokeo yake ni mauti, au watumwa wa utii ambao matokeo yake ni haki?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a onye mwerure ase omonto onde koba abasomba baye na komoigwera, nigo more abasomba baye ere oria moigwerete, onye n’obosomba bw’ebibe obokoraa gochia ase amakweri, gose obosomba bw’okoigwera obokoraa gochia ase oboronge?

English: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu ashukuriwe kwa kuwa ninyi ambao kwanza mlikuwa watumwa wa dhambi, mmekuwa watii kutoka moyoni kwa mafundisho mliyopewa.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera inwe, abamwarenge abasomba b’ebibe, mwabeire abaigweri ase chinkoro chiaino ase okworokereria koria mwaetwe,

English: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Nanyi, mkiisha kuwekwa huru mbali na dhambi, mmekuwa watumwa wa haki.
Ekegusii: na ekero mwasiboretwe korwa ase ebibe mogakorwa koba abasomba b’oboronge.

English: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
Kiswahili: Ninasema kwa namna ya kibinadamu kwa sababu ya udhaifu wenu wa hali ya asili. Kama vile mlivyokuwa mkivitoa viungo vya miili yenu kama watumwa wa mambo machafu na uovu uliokuwa ukiongezeka zaidi, hivyo sasa vitoeni viungo vyenu kama watumwa wa haki inayowaelekeza mpate kutakaswa.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ase engencho y’oboreu bwaino bwa Mwanyabaanto, Inaki koreng’ana buna inwe ritang’ani mwaruete ebiimo biaino bibe ebisomba bi’obonyaka na ase ogosaria okonene mono, naboigo na bono karue ebiimo biaino bikorere oboronge, monyare gokorwa koba abachenu.

English: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
Kiswahili: Mlipokuwa watumwa wa dhambi, mlikuwa hamtawaliwi na haki.
Ekegusii: Inaki ekero mwarenge abasomba b’ebibe nigo mwarenge abasibore korwa ase oboronge.

English: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
Kiswahili: Lakini mlipata faida gani kwa mambo hayo ambayo sasa mnayaonea aibu? Mwisho wa mambo hayo ni mauti.
Ekegusii: Nkwama ki rende mwanyorete korwa ase ebinto biria bikobarentera obosooku bono? Inaki omoerio bw’ebinto ebi n’amakweri.

English: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa mmewekwa huru mbali na dhambi na mmekuwa watumwa wa Mungu, faida mnayopata ni utakatifu, ambao mwisho wake ni uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Korende bono ekero mwasiboirwe korwa ase ebibe na gokorwa koba abasomba ba Nyasae, okwama kwaino more nakwo noko, ng’a mokorwe koba abachenu, na omoerio oye nobogima bwa kare na kare.

English: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mshahara wa dhambi ni mauti, bali karama ya Mungu ni uzima wa milele katika Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu.
Ekegusii: Inaki eng’eria y’ebibe n’amakweri, korende ekeegwa kia Nyasae nobogima bwa kare na kare ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.

English: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu (sasa ninasema na wale wanaoijua sheria), je, hamjui ya kwamba sheria ina mamlaka tu juu ya mtu wakati akiwa hai?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti, baminto (inche nigo ngokwana nabwo bamanyete amachiiko) ng’a amachiiko nigo akogaambera omonto ekero are moyo?

English: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
Kiswahili: Kwa mfano, mwanamke aliyeolewa amefungwa kwa mumewe wakati akiwa hai, lakini yule mume akifa, yule mwanamke amefunguliwa kutoka sheria ya ndoa.
Ekegusii: Inaki omokungu onyuomire igo asibire n’amachiiko ase omosacha oye, ekero ere are moyo, korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko aria amosibete ase omosacha oria.

English: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, kama huyo mwanamke ataolewa na mwanaume mwingine wakati mumewe akiwa bado yuko hai, ataitwa mzinzi. Lakini kama mumewe akifa, mwanamke huyo hafungwi tena na sheria ya ndoa, naye akiolewa na mtu mwingine haitwi mzinzi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ekero omosacha oye are moyo, aise koba nomosaacha onde nigo akorokwa omotomani; korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko ayio. Naisa konyuomwa nomosaacha onde, takorokwa omotomani.

English: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, ndugu zangu, ninyi mmeifia sheria kwa njia ya mwili wa Kristo, ili mweze kuwa mali ya mwingine, yeye ambaye alifufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, ili tupate kuzaa matunda kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, nainwe mwakwereire amachiiko ase enchera y’omobere o Kristo, erinde monyare koba ab’omoao, abaye ere oy’obogetigwe korwa ase abakuure, erinde tomwamere Nyasae okwama.

English: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tulipokuwa tunatawaliwa na asili ya dhambi, tamaa za dhambi zilizochochewa na sheria zilikuwa zikitenda kazi katika miili yetu, hivyo tulizaa matunda ya mauti.
Ekegusii: Inaki ekero twarenge ime y’engencho yaito y’ebibe okogania gwaito kw’ebibe gokabooka ase engencho y’amachiiko, kogakora emeremo ase ebiimo biaito goika tokaamera amakweri okwama.

English: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa, kwa kufia kile kilichokuwa kimetufunga kwanza, tumewekwa huru kutokana na sheria ili tutumike katika njia mpya ya Roho, wala si katika njia ya zamani ya sheria iliyoandikwa.
Ekegusii: Korende bono twasiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko, twakwereire ay’atosibete, erinde tonyare gokorera ase obogima oboyia bw’Omoika, tari inse y’amachiiko a kare ayariikire.

English: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi? Kwamba sheria ni dhambi? La, hasha! Lakini, isingekuwa kwa sababu ya sheria, nisingalijua dhambi. Nisingalijua kutamani ni nini kama sheria haikusema, “Usitamani.”
Ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Amachiiko n’ebibe? Yaya, taibo! Korende tinare komanya ebibe onye amachiiko atarengeo; inaki tinare komanya okogania okobe, onye ogochika gotagoteeba, “Toba nokogania okobe.”

English: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
Kiswahili: Lakini dhambi kwa kupata nafasi katika amri, hii ikazaa ndani yangu kila aina ya tamaa. Kwa maana pasipo sheria, dhambi imekufa.
Ekegusii: Korende ebibe bikanyora ribaga ase ogochika koria, bikabokia ime ase ’nde chingencho chionsi chi’okogania okobe. Ase amachiiko atari, rirorio ebibe mbikwete.

English: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.
Kiswahili: Wakati fulani nilikuwa hai pasipo sheria, lakini amri ilipokuja, dhambi ikawa hai, nami nikafa.
Ekegusii: Inche iga narenge moyo agwo ritang’ani ekero ntarenge n’amachiiko, korende ekero ogochika koria gwachete, ebibe bikaboka, na inche ’ngakwa.

English: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;
Kiswahili: Nikaona kwamba ile amri iliyokusudiwa kuleta uzima, ilileta mauti.
Ekegusii: Ogochika koria gw’okong’a obogima, gokarorekana gokondetera amakweri.

English: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana dhambi kwa kupata nafasi katika amri, ilinidanganya, na kupitia katika hiyo amri, ikaniua.
Ekegusii: Inaki ebibe bikanyora ribaga ase ogochika koria, bikang’aina, na ase korokwo bikang’ita.

English: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, sheria yenyewe ni takatifu, na amri ni takatifu na ya haki, tena ni njema.
Ekegusii: Naboigo amachiiko namachenu, na ogochika nogochenu, na okwa boronge, na okuya.

English: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.
Kiswahili: Je, kile kilicho chema basi kilikuwa mauti kwangu? La, hasha! Lakini ili dhambi itambuliwe kuwa ni dhambi, ilileta mauti ndani yangu kupitia kile kilichokuwa chema, ili kwa njia ya amri dhambi izidi kuwa mbaya kupita kiasi.
Ekegusii: Bono inee, riria erire rigiya ndiabeire amakweri ase ’nde? Yaya, taibo! Ebibe bikang’ita ase enchera y’erire rigiya, erio ebibe birorekane ng’a nebibe, erinde ase ogochika koria ebibe bimenteke koba bitari nekerengo.

English: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tunajua kwamba sheria ni ya kiroho, lakini mimi ni wa kimwili nikiwa nimeuzwa kwenye utumwa wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Inaki twamanyire ng’a amachiiko nay’Omoika, korende inche n’omonto bw’engencho y’ebibe; nigo naonetigwe inse ase obosomba bw’ebibe.

English: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
Kiswahili: Sielewi nitendalo, kwa maana lile ninalotaka kulitenda, silitendi, lakini ninatenda lile ninalolichukia.
Ekegusii: Inaki timanyeti aya ngokora, ekiagera aya nyanchete, tindi koyakora, korende aya ngechete naro ngokora.

English: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
Kiswahili: Basi kama ninatenda lile nisilotaka kutenda, ni kwamba ninakubali kuwa sheria ni njema.
Ekegusii: Korende onye ngokora aya ntancheti, rirorio nanchire ng’a amachiiko n’amaya.

English: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
Kiswahili: Lakini, kwa kweli si mimi tena nitendaye lile nisilotaka bali ni ile dhambi ikaayo ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono tari inche nkoyakora, korende n’ebibe biria bimenyete ime ase ’nde.

English: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninafahamu kwamba hakuna jema lolote likaalo ndani yangu, yaani, katika asili yangu ya dhambi. Kwa kuwa nina shauku ya kutenda lililo jema, lakini siwezi kulitenda.
Ekegusii: Inaki namanyire ng’a ime ase ’nde, ase engencho y’ane y’obobe, kende kiya tikeiyo; okorigia kw’ogokora okuya nkoreo, korende tinkonyara kogokora.

English: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
Kiswahili: Sitendi lile jema nitakalo kutenda, bali lile baya nisilolitaka, ndilo nitendalo.
Ekegusii: Inaki keria kere ekiya nyanchete, tindi kogekora, korende keria kere ekebe ntancheti, nakio ngokora.

English: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
Kiswahili: Basi kama ninatenda lile nisilotaka kutenda, si mimi tena nifanyaye hivyo, bali ni ile dhambi ikaayo ndani yangu.
Ekegusii: Onye ngokora keria ntancheti, bono tari inche nkogekora, korende n’ebibe biria bimenyete ime ase ’nde.

English: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
Kiswahili: Hivyo naiona sheria ikitenda kazi. Ninapotaka kutenda jema, jambo baya liko papo hapo.
Ekegusii: Narorire ogochika oko, ng’a kondigetie gokora ekere ekiya, ekere ekebe nigo kenyesungetie.

English: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana katika utu wangu wa ndani naifurahia sheria ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inaki nigo ngosasoka mono ase omoyo one ase engencho y’amachiiko a Nyasae,

English: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninaona kuna sheria nyingine inayotenda kazi katika viungo vya mwili wangu inayopigana vita dhidi ya ile sheria ya akili yangu. Sheria hii inanifanya mateka wa ile sheria ya dhambi inayofanya kazi katika viungo vya mwili wangu.
Ekegusii: korende ase ebiimo biane narorire ogochika konde nkoreo, gokorwana esegi n’ogochika gw’okomanya kw’ane na kogonkora koba omosakorwa bw’ogochika koria kw’ebibe kore ase ebiimo biane.

English: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
Kiswahili: Ole wangu mimi maskini! Ni nani atakayeniokoa na mwili huu wa mauti?
Ekegusii: Obobe nobwane inche Mwanyabaanto! Ning’o oransibore korwa ase omobere oyo bw’amakweri?

English: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.
Kiswahili: Ashukuriwe Mungu kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo Bwana wetu! Hivyo basi, mimi mwenyewe kwa akili zangu ni mtumwa wa sheria ya Mungu, lakini katika asili ya dhambi ni mtumwa wa sheria ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase Yeso Kristo Omonene oito! Inaki inche omonyene ase okomanya kw’ane nigo ngokorera amachiiko a Nyasae, korende ase engencho y’obobe bwane nigo ngokorera amachiiko y’ebibe.

English: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, sasa hakuna hukumu ya adhabu kwa wale walio ndani ya Kristo Yesu, wale ambao hawaenendi kwa kuufuata mwili bali kwa kufuata Roho.
Ekegusii: Na bono kogaambigwa tikori ase abwo bare ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu sheria ya Roho wa uzima katika Kristo Yesu imeniweka huru mbali na sheria ya dhambi na mauti.
Ekegusii: Inaki ogochika kw’Omoika bw’obogima boria bore ime ase Kristo Yeso gwansiboire korwa ase ogochika kw’ebibe na amakweri.

English: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kile ambacho sheria haikuwa na uwezo wa kufanya, kwa vile ilivyokuwa dhaifu katika mwili, Mungu kwa kumtuma Mwanawe mwenyewe kwa mfano wa mwanadamu mwenye mwili ulio wa dhambi na kwa ajili ya dhambi, yeye aliihukumu dhambi katika mwili,
Ekegusii: Inaki aria amachiiko atare konyara gokora, ekiagera nigo arenge amareu ase engencho y’ebibe bi’emebere ya Mwanyabaanto, Nyasae agakora ase ogotoma Omwana oye omonyene ase omogwekano bw’engencho yaito y’ebibe, na ase engencho y’ebibe, akagaambia ebibe ase omobere oye o Mwanyabaanto,

English: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba haki ipatikanayo kwa sheria itimizwe ndani yetu sisi, ambao hatuenendi kwa kuufuata mwili bali kwa kufuata Roho.
Ekegusii: erinde ekerigirie ime ase amachiiko geikeranigwe ime yaito, aba totari gotunyana chingencho chiaito chi’ebibe, korende chingencho chi’Omoika.

English: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wale wanaoishi kwa kuufuata mwili huziweka nia zao katika vitu vya mwili, lakini wale wanaoishi kwa kufuata Roho, huziweka nia zao katika mambo ya Roho.
Ekegusii: Baria bagotunyana chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’ebibe, korende baria bagotunyana chingencho chi’Omoika nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’Omoika.

English: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kuwa na nia ya mwili ni mauti, bali kuwa na nia inayoongozwa na Roho ni uzima na amani.
Ekegusii: Inaki okorengereria kw’engencho y’ebibe n’amakweri, korende okorengereria kw’engencho y’Omoika nobogima na omorembe.

English: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ile nia ya mwili ni uadui na Mungu, kwa maana haiitii sheria ya Mungu, wala haiwezi kuitii.
Ekegusii: Inaki okorengereria koria kw’engencho y’ebibe nobobisa igoro ase Nyasae, ekiagera tikori gwancha koigwera amachiiko a Nyasae, gose tikori koyaigwera nonya ng’ake.

English: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaotawaliwa na mwili, hawawezi kumpendeza Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abagotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe tibakonyara kogwenera Nyasae.

English: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi, hamtawaliwi na mwili, bali na Roho, ikiwa Roho wa Mungu anakaa ndani yenu. Mtu yeyote ambaye hana Roho wa Kristo, yeye si wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Onye Omoika o Nyasae kamenyete ime yaino, rirorio timori gotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe, korende chingencho chi’Omoika. Onde bwensi otari n’Omoika o Kristo, oyio tari omonto oye.

English: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama Kristo anakaa ndani yenu, miili yenu imekufa kwa sababu ya dhambi, lakini roho zenu zi hai kwa sababu ya haki.
Ekegusii: Na Kristo kar’abe ime yaino, nonya emebere yaino ekwete ase engencho y’ebibe, emeika yaino moyo ere ase engencho y’oboronge obo mwanyorete.

English: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
Kiswahili: Nanyi ikiwa Roho wa Mungu aliyemfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu anakaa ndani yenu, yeye aliyemfufua Kristo Yesu kutoka kwa wafu ataihuisha pia miili yenu ambayo hufa, kwa njia ya Roho wake akaaye ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: Korende onye Omoika oye ere oyobogetie Yeso korwa ase abakuure omenyete ime yaino, ere oyobogetie Kristo Yeso korwa ase abakuure nabookie na emebere yaino eranyorekane n’amakweri, ase engencho y’Omoika oy’omenyete ime yaino.

English: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, sisi tu wadeni, si wa mwili, ili tuishi kwa kuufuata mwili,
Ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, igo tore abasiira, korende tari ase chingencho chiaito chi’ebibe, ase ogotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe,

English: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
Kiswahili: kwa maana mkiishi kwa kuufuata mwili, mtakufa, lakini kama mkiyaua matendo ya mwili kwa Roho, mtaishi.
Ekegusii: inaki komoratunyane chingencho chi’ebibe, nigo morakwe, korende komoraite ogokora kw’omobere ase chinguru chi’Omoika, inamobe moyo.

English: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wote wanaoongozwa na Roho wa Mungu, hao ndio watoto wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inaki bonsi abakoraagwa n’Omoika o Nyasae, abwo nabwo abana ba Nyasae.

English: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hamkupokea roho ya utumwa iwaleteayo tena hofu, bali mlipokea roho ya kufanywa wana, ambaye kwa yeye twalia, “Abba, yaani, Baba,”
Ekegusii: Inaki timwanyorete omoika oyo obakorire koba abasomba na korenta obwoba, korende nigo mwanyorete Omoika oyo obakorire koba abana ba Nyasae. Igo torera, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata!”

English: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
Kiswahili: Roho mwenyewe hushuhudia pamoja na roho zetu ya kwamba sisi tu watoto wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omoika omonyene obeire kirori amo n’emeika yaito, ng’a intwe nabana ba Nyasae.

English: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, ikiwa sisi ni watoto, basi tu warithi, warithi wa Mungu, warithio pamoja na Kristo, naam, tukiteswa pamoja naye tupate pia kutukuzwa pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Onye tore abana, naboigo tore abanyamwando, abanyamwando ba Nyasae, abaraire omwando amo na Kristo, gatorachandwe amo nere, erinde tonyore obonene amo nere.

English: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
Kiswahili: Nayahesabu mateso yetu ya wakati huu kuwa si kitu kulinganisha na utukufu utakaodhihirishwa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Nabarire emechando y’ekero kia bono, ng’a teri gento onye ekoreng’anigwa nobonene boria bogocha koorokigwa ase tore.

English: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana viumbe vyote vinangoja kwa shauku kudhihirishwa kwa watoto wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabo ebitongwa bionsi nigo biganyete n’okogania okonene mono ase rituko riria Abana ba Nyasae bagocha koorokigwa.

English: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa viumbe vyote viliwekwa chini ya ubatili, si kwa chaguo lao, bali kwa mapenzi yake yeye aliyevitiisha katika tumaini,
Ekegusii: Inaki ebitongwa bionsi nigo biabegetwe inse y’engencho ya bosa, tari ase ogwancha kwabo, korende ase ogwancha kwaye ere oyobibegete ase ogosemeria,

English: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba viumbe vyote vipate kuwekwa huru kutoka kwa utumwa wa kuharibika na kupewa uhuru wa utukufu wa watoto wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera ebitongwa ebinyene nabisiborwe korwa ase obosibwa bwabo bw’ogosareka, bisoe ime ase ogosiborwa kw’obonene bw’abaana ba Nyasae.

English: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana twajua ya kuwa hata sasa viumbe vyote vimekuwa vikilia kwa maumivu kama utungu wa mwanamke wakati wa kuzaa.
Ekegusii: Inaki twamanyire ng’a ebitongwa bionsi nigo bire n’ogwechanda, naende nigo bire n’obororo nonya ngoika bono,

English: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
Kiswahili: Wala si hivyo viumbe peke yao, bali hata sisi ambao ndio matunda ya kwanza ya Roho, kwa ndani tunalia kwa uchungu tukisubiri kwa shauku kufanywa wana wa Mungu, yaani, ukombozi wa miili yetu.
Ekegusii: gose tari igo rioka, korende nonya nintwe abanyene abatore nogotongorwa kw’Omoika, nigo togwechaanda ase emioyo yaito, gatoganyete gokorwa koba abana ba Nyasae, engencho yaye okoboorigwa kw’emebere yaito.

English: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tuliokolewa kwa tumaini hili. Lakini kama kinachotumainiwa kikionekana hakiwi tumaini tena. Je, kuna mtu anayetumaini kupata kitu alicho nacho tayari?
Ekegusii: Inaki nigo twatooretigwe ase ogosemeria. Korende egento keria gesemeirie gokiarorekanire, rirorio gosemeria tikori. Inaki ning’o orasemerie eki aroche?

English: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
Kiswahili: Lakini tunapotumaini kupata kitu ambacho hatuna, basi twakingojea kwa saburi.
Ekegusii: Korende gatorasemerie egento totarakerora, nigo togokeganya ase oboremereria.

English: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, Roho hutusaidia katika udhaifu wetu, kwa sababu hatujui kuomba ipasavyo. Lakini Roho mwenyewe hutuombea kwa uchungu usioweza kutamkwa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo n’Omoika nere nigo ogotokoonya ase oboreu bwaito. Inaki titomanyeti gosaba buna etogwenerete, korende Omoika omonyene nigo agotosabera ase ogwechanda gotanyare gokwanwa.

English: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
Kiswahili: Naye Mungu aichunguzaye mioyo, anaijua nia ya Roho, kwa sababu Roho huwaombea watakatifu sawasawa na mapenzi ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Na ere oyokoriga‐rigia chinkoro chi’ abanto, namanyete okorengereria kw’Omoika, ekiagera Omoika oyo nigo ogosabera abachenu buna Nyasae anchete.

English: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
Kiswahili: Nasi tunajua ya kuwa katika mambo yote Mungu hutenda kazi pamoja na wote wampendao, katika kuwapatia mema, yaani, wale walioitwa kwa kusudi lake.
Ekegusii: Na twamanyire ng’a Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana onsi amo na baria bamwanchete, erio abanyorere amaya, baria barangerigwe ase omooroberio oye.

English: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
Kiswahili: Maana wale Mungu aliowajua tangu mwanzo, pia aliwachagua tangu mwanzo, wapate kufanana na mfano wa Mwanawe, ili yeye awe mzaliwa wa kwanza miongoni mwa ndugu wengi.
Ekegusii: Inaki baria amanyete korwa kare akabachoora korwa kare, bareng’anigwe n’omogwekano bw’Omwana oye, erinde ere abe omotangi bw’abamwabo abange.

English: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
Kiswahili: Nao wale Mungu aliotangulia kuwachagua, akawaita, wale aliowaita pia akawahesabia haki, nao wale aliowahesabia haki, pia akawatukuza.
Ekegusii: Na baria achorete korwa kare, abwo akabarangeria boigo; na baria arangeretie, abwo akabaa oboronge boigo; na baria aete oboronge akabaa obonene boigo.

English: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi kuhusu haya? Ikiwa Mungu yuko upande wetu, ni nani awezaye kuwa kinyume chetu?
Ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe ase ayio? Onye Nyasae ore ensemo yaito, ning’o oranyare gotobua?

English: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Mungu hakumhurumia Mwanawe, bali alimtoa kwa ajili yetu sote, atakosaje basi kutupatia vitu vyote kwa ukarimu pamoja naye?
Ekegusii: Ere otarorerete Omwana oye amaabera, korende akamorua ase engencho yaito intwe twensi, inaki aramoche gotoa ebinto bionsi amo nere?

English: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
Kiswahili: Ni nani atakayewashtaki wale ambao Mungu amewateua? Ni Mungu mwenyewe ndiye mwenye kuwahesabia haki.
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare gosoera abachoore ba Nyasae? Nyasae nere okobaa oboronge.

English: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
Kiswahili: Ni nani basi atakayewahukumia adhabu? Kristo Yesu aliyekufa, naam, zaidi ya hayo, aliyefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, yuko mkono wa kuume wa Mungu, naye pia anatuombea.
Ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobanachera ekiina? Kristo Yeso nere okwete, ee, na kobua ase aya obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure; ere nigo are ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae, naende nere ogotosabera.

English: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
Kiswahili: Ni nani atakayetutenga na upendo wa Kristo? Je, ni shida au taabu au mateso au njaa au uchi au hatari au upanga?
Ekegusii: Ning’o oratwatanane korwa ase obwanchani bwa Kristo? Inee! Nogochandwa, gose nobororo, gose nokorosigwa, gose nenchara, gose ngesobono, gose n’obobe, gose n’omoro?

English: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Kwa ajili yako tunauawa mchana kutwa; tumehesabiwa kama kondoo wa kuchinjwa.”
Ekegusii: Buna eriikire, “Ase engencho yao nigo togoitwa omobaso boira; twabarirwe koba buna ching’ondi chigocha konyenywa.”

English: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
Kiswahili: Lakini katika mambo haya yote tunashinda, naam na zaidi ya kushinda, kwa yeye aliyetupenda.
Ekegusii: Korende ase amang’ana aya onsi twabeire ababui, na goetania ababui, goetera ase are oyotwanchete.

English: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nimekwisha kujua kwa hakika ya kuwa sio mauti, wala uzima, wala malaika, wala wenye mamlaka, wala yaliyopo, wala yatakayokuja, wala wenye uwezo,
Ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene bw’okomanya, ng’a nonya namakweri, nonya nobogima, nonya nabamalaika, nonya nabare ne chinguru, nonya n’ebinto ebireo, nonya nebi gochi‐gocha, nonya n’okobua,

English: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Kiswahili: wala yaliyo juu, wala yaliyo chini, wala kiumbe kingine chochote zitaweza kututenga na upendo wa Mungu ulio katika Kristo Yesu, Bwana wetu.
Ekegusii: nonya nayare igoro, nonya nayare inse, nonya negetongwa kende gionsi, tibikonyara gotwatanana korwa ase obwanchani bwa Nyasae obore ime ase Kristo Yeso Omonene oito.

English: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
Kiswahili: Ninasema kweli katika Kristo, wala sisemi uongo, dhamiri yangu inanishuhudia katika Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana ekeene ase Kristo, tindi goteeba oborimo. Okomanya gw’enkoro y’ane ime, gokwamorekirwe n’Omoika Omochenu, kwambereire kirori,

English: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
Kiswahili: Nina huzuni kuu na uchungu usiokoma moyoni mwangu.
Ekegusii: ng’a ninde nobororo obonge na ogwechanda kogendererete ase enkoro y’ane.

English: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ningetamani hata mimi nilaaniwe na kutengwa na Kristo kwa ajili ya ndugu zangu hasa, wale walio wa kabila langu kwa jinsi ya mwili,
Ekegusii: Inaki nanga naganetie ng’a ndagererigwe inche omonyene na gwatananwa korwa ase Kristo ase engencho y’abaminto abare b’eamate y’ane ase egesaku giaito.

English: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
Kiswahili: yaani, watu wa Israeli, ambao ndio wenye kule kufanywa wana, ule utukufu wa Mungu, yale maagano, kule kupokea sheria, ibada ya kwenye Hekalu na zile ahadi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo n’Abaisraeli, bakorirwe koba Abana ba Nyasae, barorire, obonene, bancheirwe okobwatana, baeirwe amachiiko ne ribaga ri’ogosasiima Nyasae, baeirwe ne chiira chiaye.

English: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Wao ni wa uzao wa mababa wakuu wa kwanza, ambao kutoka kwao Kristo alikuja kwa jinsi ya mwili kama mwanadamu, yeye ambaye ni Mungu aliye juu ya vyote, mwenye kuhimidiwa milele! Amen.
Ekegusii: Inaki abagaaka baito ba kare nabaabo, na korwa ase bare Kristo nao aiboretwe buna Mwanyabaanto; ere nigo are Nyasae igoro ase ebinto bionsi, oy’orabakwe goika kare na kare. Amina.

English: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba Neno la Mungu limeshindwa. Kwa maana si kila Mwisraeli ambaye ni wa uzao utokanao na Israeli ni Mwisraeli halisi.
Ekegusii: Tari ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae ndiasinyire goikeranigwa. Inaki tari bonsi abare b’egesaku ki’Abaisraeli bare Abaisraeli b’ekeene;

English: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”
Kiswahili: Wala hawakuwi wazao wa Abrahamu kwa sababu wao ni watoto wake, lakini: “Uzao wako utahesabiwa kupitia kwake Isaki.”
Ekegusii: gose tari bonsi bare abana ba Aburaamu ekiagera baruete ase oroiboro rw’aye, otatiga, “Ase Isaka oroiboro rwao narwatorwe.”

English: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.
Kiswahili: Hii ina maana kwamba, si watoto waliozaliwa kimwili walio watoto wa Mungu, bali ni watoto wa ahadi wanaohesabiwa kuwa uzao wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Engencho yaye, tari abana b’ororeria bare Abana ba Nyasae, korende n’abana b’eira bakobarwa ng’a noroiboro rw’aye.

English: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ahadi yenyewe ilisema, “Nitakurudia tena wakati kama huu, naye Sara atapata mtoto wa kiume.”
Ekegusii: Inaki ring’ana ri’eira neri, “Ekero kenga buna eke ninchiche, inyore ng’a Sara onyorire omwana omoisia.”

English: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.
Kiswahili: Wala si hivyo tu, bali pia watoto aliowazaa Rebeka walikuwa na baba huyo huyo mmoja, yaani, baba yetu Isaki.
Ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende Rebeka nere nabogoretie oborito ase omosacha oyomo, nere Isaka sokoro yaito.

English: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,
Kiswahili: Lakini, hata kabla hao mapacha hawajazaliwa au kufanya jambo lolote jema au baya, ili kwamba kusudi la Mungu la kuchagua lipate kusimama,
Ekegusii: Inaki ekero abana baria konya bataraiborwa na batarakora amaya gose amabe, ng’ina nigo atebetigwe, “Oyo omonene namokorere oyio omoke.” Igo omoroberio o Nyasae bw’ogochoora goika ogenderere, tari ase engencho y’ogokora kw’ abanto, korende ase okorangeria kwaye.

English: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
Kiswahili: si kwa matendo, bali kwa yeye mwenye kuita, Rebeka aliambiwa, “Yule mkubwa atamtumikia yule mdogo.”
Ekegusii: Inaki nigo eriikire, “Namwanchete Yakobo, korende nkamogeecha Esau.”

English: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
Kiswahili: Kama vile ilivyoandikwa, “Nimempenda Yakobo, lakini nimemchukia Esau.”
Ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Ogotaba boronge nkore ase Nyasae? Yaya, taibo!

English: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi? Je, Mungu ni dhalimu? La, hasha!
Ekegusii: Inaki nigo atebeetie Musa, “Nimororere amaabera ere oyo ndarorere amaabera, na nimororere amabeebe ere oyo ’ndarorere amabeebe.”

English: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu alimwambia Mose, “Nitamrehemu yeye nimrehemuye, na pia nitamhurumia yeye nimhurumiaye.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, tari ng’a nigo ere ase ogwancha kw’omonto, gose nokw’oria ogokora omokia, korende nokw’oria okororera amaabera, nere Nyasae.

English: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo haitegemei kutaka kwa mwanadamu au jitihada, bali hutegemea huruma ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inaki amariiko nigo agoteeba ase Farao, “Nigo nagotenenetie, erinde nyorokie okobua kw’ane ase ore, na erieta riane nario rirararigwe ase ense yonsi.”

English: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Maandiko yamwambia Farao, “Nilikuinua kwa kusudi hili hasa, ili nipate kuonyesha uweza wangu juu yako, na ili Jina langu lipate kutangazwa duniani yote.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo, oyo arigetie kororera amaabera, nigo akomoororera amaabera, na oyo arigetie gokora abe omokong’u ase enkoro yaye, nigo akomokora abe omokong’u.

English: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo basi, Mungu humhurumia yeye atakaye kumhurumia na humfanya mgumu yeye atakaye kumfanya mgumu.
Ekegusii: Aande gose nonteebie, “Nase ki nonya mbono Nyasae akonyora okomocha ase Mwanyabaanto? Inaki ning’o oranyare koamereria okorigia kwaye?”

English: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
Kiswahili: Basi mtaniambia, “Kama ni hivyo, kwa nini basi bado Mungu anatulaumu? Kwa maana ni nani awezaye kupinga mapenzi yake?”
Ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto, aye naye ng’o okoiraneria Nyasae? Inee! Egento getongire nakemoteebie oyogetongete, “Ninki gwankorerete iga?”

English: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
Kiswahili: Lakini, ewe mwanadamu, u nani wewe ushindane na Mungu? “Je, kilichoumbwa chaweza kumwambia yeye aliyekiumba, ‘Kwa nini umeniumba hivi?’ ”
Ekegusii: Gose omokori chinyongo tari n’okobua igoro ase esike, ase ribomba ri’esike gokora egento ekemo eki’ogosikwa, na ekende kebe getari nogosikwa?

English: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
Kiswahili: Je, mfinyanzi hana haki ya kufinyanga kutoka bonge moja vyombo vya udongo, vingine kwa matumizi ya heshima na vingine kwa matumizi ya kawaida?
Ekegusii: Inaki rende onye Nyasae okorigia koorokia endamwamu yaye, na komanyia abanto okobua kwaye, na ase oboremereria obonge akabogorerania n’ebinto biria bi’endamwamu biakorirwe ase ogosareka,

English: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
Kiswahili: Iweje basi, kama Mungu kwa kutaka kuonyesha ghadhabu yake na kufanya uweza wake ujulikane, amevumilia kwa uvumilivu mwingi vile vyombo vya ghadhabu vilivyoandaliwa kwa uharibifu?
Ekegusii: erinde aorokie obonda bw’obonene bwaye, ase ebinto biria bi’amaabera ebiaroisetie korwa kare binyore obonene?

English: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—
Kiswahili: Iweje basi, kama yeye alitenda hivi ili kufanya wingi wa utukufu wake ujulikane kwa vile vyombo vya rehema yake, alivyotangulia kuvitengeneza kwa ajili ya utukufu wake,
Ekegusii: Abwo nintwe, twarangeretigwe nere, tari korwa ase Abayahudi boka, korende nonya nkorwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku boigo.

English: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
Kiswahili: yaani pamoja na sisi, ambao pia alituita, si kutoka kwa Wayahudi peke yao, bali pia kutoka kwa watu wa Mataifa?
Ekegusii: Naboigo akwanete ase egetabu ya Hosea, “Abanto baria batarenge abanto baane, nimbaroke abanto baane; na oyotarenge omwanchwa one, nimoroke omwanchwa one.”

English: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”
Kiswahili: Kama vile Mungu asemavyo katika Hosea: “Nitawaita ‘watu wangu’ wale ambao si watu wangu; nami nitamwita ‘mpenzi wangu’ yeye ambaye si mpenzi wangu,”
Ekegusii: “N’abe aase aria barabwo bateebetigwe: Inwe timori abanto baane, abwo inabarokwe abana ba Nyasae ore moyo.”

English: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”
Kiswahili: tena, “Itakuwa hasa mahali pale walipoambiwa, ‘Ninyi si watu wangu,’ wao wataitwa ‘wana wa Mungu aliye hai.’ ”
Ekegusii: Isaya nere ogoaka eriogi riaye igoro y’Abaisraeli, ogoteeba, “Omobaro bw’Abaisraeli n’oba buna omokenye ore nyancha, abatigari nabwo boka barache gotoorigwa;

English: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
Kiswahili: Isaya anapiga kelele kuhusu Israeli: “Ingawa idadi ya wana wa Israeli ni wengi kama mchanga wa pwani, ni mabaki yao tu watakaookolewa.
Ekegusii: inaki Omonene n’ache ase ense agaambe ekiina, akenache na kogekoora.”

English: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ataitekeleza hukumu yake duniani kwa haraka na kwa ukamilifu.”
Ekegusii: Naende buna Isaya atang’anete gokwana. “Onye Omonene bw’Emeganda atatotigerete oroiboro, nanga nigo twabeete buna Sodomu, na koreng’anigwa na Gomora.”

English: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
Kiswahili: Ni kama vile alivyotabiri Isaya akisema: “Kama Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asingelituachia uzao, tungelikuwa kama Sodoma, tungelifanana na Gomora.”
Ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku, abatarenge korigia oboronge ’mbanyorete oboronge boria bw’okwegena;

English: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tuseme nini basi? Kwamba watu wa Mataifa ambao hawakutafuta haki, wamepata haki ile iliyo kwa njia ya imani.
Ekegusii: korende Abaisraeli abare korigia oboronge bokorwa ase amachiiko, tibaikerete oboronge boria.

English: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Lakini Israeli, ambao walijitahidi kupata haki kwa njia ya sheria, hawakuipata.
Ekegusii: Nase ki? Ekiagera tibarenge koborigia ase enchera y’okwegena, korende nase enchera y’ogokora, bakagochwa igoro ase rigena riria rikogocha;

English: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
Kiswahili: Kwa nini? Kwa sababu hawakuitafuta kwa njia ya imani bali kwa njia ya matendo. Wakajikwaa kwenye lile “jiwe la kukwaza.”
Ekegusii: buna eriikire, “Rigereria, nabekire ase Sayoni rigena riragoche abanto, na egetare kerabaiyerie inse, na onde bwensi oramwegene takorora obosooku.”

English: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, shauku ya moyo wangu na maombi yangu kwa Mungu ni kwa ajili ya Waisraeli, kwamba waokolewe.
Ekegusii: Baminto okogania gw’enkoro y’ane na ogosaba kw’ane ase Nyasae ase engencho y’Abaisraeli nakwo oko, ng’a batoorigwe.

English: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninaweza nikashuhudia wazi kwamba wao wana juhudi kubwa kwa ajili ya Mungu, lakini juhudi yao haina maarifa.
Ekegusii: Inaki nababereire kirori, ng’a ’mbare n’omokia ase Nyasae, korende ase omokia obo tibari nobong’ani.

English: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hawakuijua haki itokayo kwa Mungu, wakatafuta kuweka haki yao wenyewe, hawakujitia chini ya haki ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inaki kobar’abe tibamanyeti oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae, naende bakorigia goikerania oboronge bwabo abanyene, igo tibebegeti inse ase oboronge bwa Nyasae.

English: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Kristo ni ukomo wa sheria ili kuwe na haki kwa kila mtu aaminiye.
Ekegusii: Inaki Kristo nere ore omoerio bw’amachiiko, erinde onde bwensi oyoramwegene anyore oboronge.

English: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
Kiswahili: Mose anaandika kuhusu haki ile itokanayo na sheria, kwamba, “Mtu atendaye matendo hayo ataishi kwa hayo.”
Ekegusii: Inaki Musa nigo ariigete igoro y’oboronge obo bokorua ase amachiiko, ng’a omonto oy’orakore aya nabe n’obogima ase aya.

English: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);
Kiswahili: Lakini ile haki itokanayo na imani husema hivi: “Usiseme moyoni mwako, ‘Ni nani atakayepanda mbinguni?’ ” (yaani ili kumleta Kristo chini)
Ekegusii: Korende oboronge boria bokonyorekana ase okwegena nigo bogoteeba iga: Toteeba ase enkoro yao ime, “Ning’o oragende gochia igoro” (engencho yaye nokorenta Kristo inse aa);

English: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”
Kiswahili: “au ‘Ni nani atashuka kwenda kuzimu?’ ” (yaani ili kumleta Kristo kutoka kwa wafu.)
Ekegusii: gose, “Ning’o oranyare kogenda aike inse ase eora y’abakuure?” (Engencho yaye nokorenta Kristo igoro korwa ase abakuure).

English: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:
Kiswahili: Lakini andiko lasemaje? “Lile neno liko karibu nawe, liko kinywani mwako na moyoni mwako,” yaani, lile neno la imani tunalolihubiri.
Ekegusii: Korende, inaki bogoteeba? Ring’ana riria nigo rire ang’e naye, ase omonwa oo, na ime ase enkoro yao (eri n’ering’ana ri’okwegena, riria tokorandia).

English: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu kama ukikiri kwa kinywa chako kwamba “Yesu ni Bwana,” na kuamini moyoni mwako kwamba Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, utaokoka.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera koraorokie nomonwa oo, ng’a Yeso nere Omonene, na kwegena ime ase enkoro yao ng’a Nyasae namobogetie korwa ase abakuure, notoorigwe.

English: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa moyo mtu huamini na hivyo kuhesabiwa haki, tena kwa kinywa mtu hukiri na hivyo kupata wokovu.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase enkoro omonto nigo akwegena, erio onyora oboronge; na ase omonwa oorokia, erio onyora ogotooreka.

English: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
Kiswahili: Kama yasemavyo Maandiko, “Yeyote amwaminiye hataaibika kamwe.”
Ekegusii: Amariiko nigo agoteeba, “Onde bwensi oramwegene takorora obosooku.”

English: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hakuna tofauti kati ya Myahudi na Myunani, yeye ni Bwana wa wote, mwenye utajiri kwa wote wamwitao.
Ekegusii: Inaki gwatananeka tikori ase Abayahudi na Abagiriki, ekiagera ase Abayahudi na Abagiriki, ekiagera Omonene nigo are Omonene o bonsi, na obonda bwaye nigo akoa abanto bonsi abakomorangeria.

English: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, “Kila mtu atakayeliitia Jina la Bwana, ataokolewa.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera, “Onde bwensi orarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe.”

English: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
Kiswahili: Lakini watamwitaje yeye ambaye hawajamwamini? Nao watawezaje kumwamini yeye ambaye hawajamsikia? Tena watamsikiaje bila mtu kuwahubiria?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inaki baramorangerie ere bataramwegena? Naende inaki baramwegene oyo batana koigwa amang’ana igoro yaye? Naende inaki baraigwe batari nomorandia?

English: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
Kiswahili: Nao watahubirije wasipopelekwa? Kama ilivyoandikwa, “Tazama jinsi ilivyo mizuri miguu yao wale wanaohubiri habari njema!”
Ekegusii: Naende inaki bararandie batatomiri? Buna eriikire, “Inaki amagoro abo are amaseera, baria bakorandia amang’ana amaya!”

English: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
Kiswahili: Lakini si wote waliotii Habari Njema. Kwa maana Isaya asema, “Bwana, ni nani aliyeamini ujumbe wetu?”
Ekegusii: Korende tari bonsi baigwerete enchiri. Inaki Isaya nigo agoteeba, “Omonene, ning’o bwegenire aya aigure korwa ase tore?”

English: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
Kiswahili: Basi, imani chanzo chake ni kusikia, na kusikia huja kwa neno la Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, okwegena nigo kogoocha ase enchera y’okoigwa, na aya tokoigwa nigo agoocha korwa ase ring’ana ria Kristo.

English: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
Kiswahili: Lakini nauliza: Je, wao hawakusikia? Naam, wamesikia, kwa maana: “Sauti yao imeenea duniani pote, nayo maneno yao yameenea hadi miisho ya ulimwengu.”
Ekegusii: Korende nkoboria ’nde: Inee! Barabwo tibaigwete? Ee, mbaigwete, “Egeturi kieriogi riabo giesiareire ase ense engima, na amang’ana abo aikire chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense aase abanto bamenyete.”

English: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”
Kiswahili: Nami nauliza tena: Je, Waisraeli hawakuelewa? Kwanza, Mose asema, “Nitawafanya mwe na wivu kwa watu wale ambao si taifa. Nitawakasirisha kwa taifa lile lisilo na ufahamu.”
Ekegusii: Naende nkoboria ’nde: Inee! Abaisraeli tibamanyete? Agwo ritang’ani Musa nigo agoteeba, “Nimbakore mobe ne ribero ase abanto batari egesaku, ase egesaku kere ekeriri nigo ndababeeyie.”

English: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
Kiswahili: Naye Isaya kwa ujasiri mwingi anasema, “Nimeonekana na watu wale ambao hawakunitafuta. Nilijifunua kwa watu wale ambao hawakunitafuta.”
Ekegusii: Na Isaya n’are noboremu bw’ogoteeba, “Nigo nanyorekanete n’abaatare kondigia; nkeorokia ase abataare kong’itaa.”

English: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kuhusu Israeli anasema, “Mchana kutwa nimewanyooshea watu wakaidi na wasiotii mikono yangu.”
Ekegusii: Korende ase Abaisraeli nigo agoteeba, “Omobaso boira nigo n’are kobaramborera amaboko aane abanto batari abaigweri korende abaamereria.”

English: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
Kiswahili: Basi nauliza: Je, Mungu amewakataa watu wake? La, hasha! Mimi mwenyewe ni Mwisraeli, tena uzao wa Abrahamu kutoka kabila la Benyamini.
Ekegusii: Ase igo nkoboria ’nde: Inee! Nyasae nigo angete abanto baye? Yaya, taibo! Inche omonyene n’Omoisraeli inde, oyomo bw’oroiboro rwa Aburaamu, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini.

English: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
Kiswahili: Mungu hajawakataa watu wake, ambao yeye aliwajua tangu mwanzo. Je, hamjui yale Maandiko yasemayo kuhusu Eliya, jinsi alivyomlalamikia Mungu kuhusu Israeli?
Ekegusii: Nyasae tangeti abanto baye baria amanyete korwa kare. Gose timomanyeti aya amariiko agoteeba igoro y’Elija, buna akweng’ereria ase Nyasae igoro y’Abaisraeli?

English: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
Kiswahili: Alisema, “Bwana, wamewaua manabii wako na kuzibomoa madhabahu zako, nimebaki mimi peke yangu, nao wanataka kuniua?”
Ekegusii: “Omonene, baitire ababani bao, batagoire egesasiimero kiao, ninche bweka natigaire, na barabwo nkorigia bare obogima bwane babosirie.”

English: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
Kiswahili: Je, Mungu alimjibuje? “Nimejibakizia watu elfu saba ambao hawajapiga magoti kumwabudu Baali.”
Ekegusii: Korende okoiraneria kwa Nyasae inaki gokomoteebia? “Ninde nabaanto chilifu isano na ibere batabegete amaru inse ase Baali.”

English: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo pia, sasa wapo mabaki waliochaguliwa kwa neema ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabo ekero kia bono ’mbare abatigari abachoorirwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae.

English: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa wamechaguliwa kwa neema, si tena kwa msingi wa matendo. Kama ingekuwa kwa matendo, neema isingekuwa neema tena.
Ekegusii: Korende onye nase obuya, rirorio tibokoba ase ogokora, onye taibo, obuya tibokoba obuya.

English: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
Kiswahili: Tuseme nini basi? Kile kitu ambacho Israeli alikitafuta kwa bidii hakukipata. Lakini waliochaguliwa walikipata. Waliobaki walifanywa wagumu,
Ekegusii: Inaki rende abeire? Egento keria Abaisraeli baare korigia tibakenyorete, Baria bachoretwe, mbarabwo bakenyorete, korende abatigarete bagakorwa koba abakong’u ase chinkoro chiabo,

English: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
Kiswahili: kama ilivyoandikwa: “Mungu aliwapa bumbuazi la mioyo, macho ili wasiweze kuona, na masikio ili wasiweze kusikia, hadi leo.”
Ekegusii: buna eriikire, “Nyasae akabaa omoika bwe chitoro, na amaiso atanyare korora, na amato atanyare koigwa, goika reero iga.”

English: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
Kiswahili: Naye Daudi anasema: “Karamu zao na ziwe tanzi na mtego wa kuwanasa, kitu cha kuwakwaza waanguke, na adhabu kwao.
Ekegusii: Na Daudi nigo agoteeba, “Tiga endagera yabo ebe egesugunia na oboreba, na egento gekobagocha, na ogoakanwa kwabo.

English: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”
Kiswahili: Macho yao yatiwe giza ili wasiweze kuona, nayo migongo yao iinamishwe daima.”
Ekegusii: Tiga amaiso abo abekwe omosunte tibarora. Obakumbe emegongo yabo botambe!”

English: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nauliza tena: Je, Waisraeli walijikwaa ili waanguke na kuangamia kabisa? La, hasha! Lakini kwa sababu ya makosa yao, wokovu umewafikia watu wa Mataifa, ili kuwafanya Waisraeli waone wivu.
Ekegusii: Bono nkoboria nde, “Inee! Nigo bagochirwe goika baguure kegima?” Yaya, taibo! Korende ase ogosaria kwabo ogotooreka gwaikeire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde Abaisraeli bakorwe babe ne ribero.

English: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa kukosa kwao kumekuwa utajiri mkubwa kwa ulimwengu, tena kama kuangamia kwao kumeleta utajiri kwa watu wa Mataifa, kurudishwa kwao kutaleta utajiri mkuu zaidi.
Ekegusii: Bono onye ogosaria kwabo kwaeire abanto b’ense eye obonda, na onye okobugwa kwabo kwaeire abanto b’Ebisaku obonda, Inee, tari kobua mono oboikeranu bwabo?

English: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,
Kiswahili: Sasa ninasema nanyi watu wa Mataifa. Maadamu mimi ni mtume kwa watu wa Mataifa, naitukuza huduma yangu
Ekegusii: Bono ’ngokwana nde nainwe abanto b’Ebisaku. Koreng’ana buna inde omotomwa bw’ abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarire ng’a obosomba bwane n’egento ekenene,

English: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
Kiswahili: ili kuwafanya watu wangu waone wivu na hivyo kuwaokoa baadhi yao.
Ekegusii: erinde inyare kobeeka abare amanyinga ayamo nainche ribero, na gotooria abande babo.

English: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ikiwa kukataliwa kwao ni kupatanishwa kwa ulimwengu, kukubaliwa kwao si kutakuwa ni uhai baada ya kufa?
Ekegusii: Inaki onye okwangwa kwabo gokorenta okobwatania ase ense, Inee, ogwancherwa kwabo inki koraarente? Nigo gokorenta obogima ribaga ri’ogokwa.

English: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu ya donge la unga uliotolewa kuwa limbuko ni mtakatifu, basi unga wote ni mtakatifu, nalo shina kama ni takatifu, vivyo hivyo na matawi nayo.
Ekegusii: Naende onye ensemo ye ritang’ani ye ribomba ri’obosie ere enchenu, naboigo ne ribomba rionsi rire; na onye ritina rire richenu, naboigo ne chinsagia chire.

English: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,
Kiswahili: Lakini kama baadhi ya matawi yalikatwa, nawe chipukizi la mzeituni mwitu ukapandikizwa mahali pao ili kushiriki unono pamoja na matawi mengine kutoka shina la mzeituni,
Ekegusii: Korende onye chinsagia chinde chiabunekire, na aye oyokwarwete ase omozeituni bw’orosana gwachomirwe ase ribaga riabo, okaba oyomo bwe ritina ri’omozeituni, na konyora obonoru bwaye,

English: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
Kiswahili: basi usijivune juu ya hayo matawi. Kama ukijivuna, kumbuka jambo hili: si wewe unayelishikilia shina, bali ni shina linalokushikilia wewe.
Ekegusii: tibwetogia igoro ase chinsagia chiria. Onye kogwetogia, inyora ng’a tari aye oimogetie ritina, korende neritina rikoimogetie aye.

English: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”
Kiswahili: Basi utasema, “Matawi yale yalikatwa ili nipate kupandikizwa katika hilo shina.”
Ekegusii: Bono noteebe, “Chinsagia nigo chiabunegete, erinde nchomwe aroro.”

English: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
Kiswahili: Hii ni kweli. Matawi hayo yalikatwa kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwake, lakini wewe umesimama tu kwa sababu ya imani. Kwa hiyo usijivune, bali simama kwa kuogopa.
Ekegusii: Ee, ayio namaene. Barabwo mbabunegete ase ogot’egena kwabo, korende aye nigo oteneine ase okwegena kwao. Ase igo toenena, korende oiroke.

English: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
