Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama Mungu hakuyahurumia matawi ya asili, wala hatakuhurumia wewe.
Ekegusii: Inaki onye Nyasae tarorerete chinsagia chi’omote omonyene amaabera, nonya naye tagokororera amaabera.

English: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
Kiswahili: Angalia basi wema na ukali wa Mungu: Kwa wale walioanguka, ukali, bali kwako wewe wema wa Mungu, kama utadumu katika wema wake. La sivyo, nawe utakatiliwa mbali.
Ekegusii: Inyora obuya na obotindi bwa Nyasae, obotindi ase baria baguure; korende ase ore obuya bwa Nyasae, korabeere ase obuya bwaye. Onye taibo, naye boigo nonachwe korwa aroro.

English: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
Kiswahili: Wao nao wasipodumu katika kutokuamini kwao, watapandikizwa tena kwenye shina, kwa maana Mungu anao uwezo wa kuwapandikiza tena kwenye hilo shina.
Ekegusii: Nonya nabwo bande, onye tibakogenderera ase ogot’egena kwabo, rirorio nabachomwe, ekiagera Nyasae n’are n’okobua kobachoma naende.

English: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa wewe ulikatwa kutoka kile ambacho kwa asili ni mzeituni mwitu na kupandikizwa kinyume cha asili kwenye mzeituni uliopandwa, si rahisi zaidi matawi haya ya asili kupandikizwa tena kwenye shina lake la mzeituni!
Ekegusii: Inaki onye aye kwanachetwe korwa ase omozeituni bw’orosana, ogachomwa ase ogochomwa gotanaretwe bo, ase omozeituni oy’osimekire, tari kobua mono chinsagia chie ritina rinyene chichomwe ase omozeituni obo omonyene.

English: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, ili msije mkajidai kuwa wenye hekima kuliko mlivyo, nataka mfahamu siri hii: Ugumu umewapata Israeli kwa sehemu hadi idadi ya watu wa Mataifa watakaoingia itimie.
Ekegusii: Inaki baminto, timwerora ng’a nigo more abanyene obong’aini; nindigetie momanye obobisi obo. Obokong’u bwanyorire abande b’Abaisraeli, goika ogoikerana kw’Ebisaku goike.

English: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
Kiswahili: Hivyo Israeli wote wataokolewa. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Mkombozi atakuja kutoka Sayuni; ataondoa kutokumcha Mungu katika Yakobo.
Ekegusii: Na igo Abaisraeli bonsi inabatoorigwe, buna eriikire, “Ere Omosibori naache korwa Sayoni. Narusie obobe bore ase Yakobo;

English: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo agano langu nao nitakapoziondoa dhambi zao.”
Ekegusii: na oko nakwo okobwatana kw’ane nabarabwo, ekero ’ndaache kobaruseria ebibe biabo.”

English: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya Injili, wao ni adui wa Mungu kwa ajili yenu, lakini kuhusu kule kuteuliwa kwao ni wapendwa, kwa ajili ya mababa zao wa zamani,
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase amanag’ana y’enchiri babeire ababisa ba Nyasae ase engencho yaino; korende ase ogochoorwa babeire abanchwa ase engencho ye chisokoro chiabo.

English: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
Kiswahili: kwa maana akishawapa watu karama, Mungu haziondoi, wala wito wake.
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae tari gweiteria ebiegwa biaye na okorangeria kwaye.

English: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
Kiswahili: Kama vile ninyi wakati fulani mlivyokuwa waasi kwa Mungu lakini sasa mmepata rehema kwa sababu ya kutokutii kwao,
Ekegusii: Inaki buna inwe kare motarenge koigwera Nyasae, korende bono mwanyorire amaabera ase engencho y’ogotaigwera kwabo,

English: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
Kiswahili: hivyo nao Waisraeli wamekuwa waasi ili kwamba wao nao sasa waweze kupata rehema kwa ajili ya rehema za Mungu kwenu.
Ekegusii: naboigo na barabwo bono bataigwereti, erinde ase amaabera aya mwanyorire inwe, nabarabwo boigo banyore amaabera.

English: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu amewafunga wanadamu wote kwenye kuasi ili apate kuwarehemu wote.
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae osibire bonsi ase ogotaigwera, erinde aborokie bonsi amaabera.

English: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi kilivyo kina cha utajiri wa hekima na maarifa ya Mungu! Tazama jinsi ambavyo hukumu zake hazichunguziki, na ambavyo njia zake zisivyotafutikana!
Ekegusii: Aa! Obonge bw’obonda, na obong’aini, ne chisemi bire ase Nyasae! Tibikorengeka. Ebiina biaye tibikomanyekana ne chinchera chiaye tichikoriigeka!

English: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
Kiswahili: “Ni nani aliyeyafahamu mawazo ya Bwana? Au ni nani ambaye amekuwa mshauri wake?”
Ekegusii: “Inaki ning’o omanyete ebirengererio bia Omonene? Gose ning’o okomotebereria buna agwenerete agaambe?

English: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
Kiswahili: “Au ni nani aliyempa chochote ili arudishiwe?”
Ekegusii: Gose ning’o omoete ekeegwa ritang’ani, erinde akeiranerigwe?”

English: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana vitu vyote vyatoka kwake, viko kwake na kwa ajili yake. Utukufu ni wake milele! Amen.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa ase are, nigo bire ase okobua kwaye, naende nigo biteneine ase are. Ogotogigwa nokwaye goika kare na kare. Amina.

English: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, nawasihi kwa rehema zake Mungu, itoeni miili yenu iwe dhabihu iliyo hai, takatifu na inayompendeza Mungu, hii ndiyo ibada yenu yenye maana.
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, nabasoroire mono ase amaabera a Nyasae, morue emebere yaino ebe ekeng’wanso kere moyo, egechenu, ekeranyare gwanchwa na Nyasae, nakio ogosasiima kwaino gw’ekeene.

English: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
Kiswahili: Msifuatishe tena mfano wa ulimwengu huu, bali mgeuzwe kwa kufanywa upya nia zenu. Ndipo mtaweza kuonja na kuhakikisha ni nini mapenzi ya Mungu yaliyo mema, yanayopendeza machoni pake na ukamilifu.
Ekegusii: Gose timwereng’ania ne chingencho chi’ense eye; korende moonchorwe, mokorwe koba abayia ase emioyo yaino, monyare korigia na komanya boronge ogwancha kwa Nyasae, na erire rigiya, na eriranchwe, na oboikeranu.

English: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya neema niliyopewa nawaambia kila mmoja miongoni mwenu, asijidhanie kuwa bora kuliko impasavyo, bali afikiri kwa busara kwa kulingana na kipimo cha imani Mungu aliyompa.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase obuya naetwe nigo ngoteebia kera omonto oyore ase more, tabaisa kweenenia ere omonyene ase ebirengererio biaye kobua buna emogwenerete korengereria; korende abe n’ebirengererio ebironge koreng’ana buna Nyasae aeire kera omonto ekerengo gi’okwegena.

English: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
Kiswahili: Kama vile katika mwili mmoja tulivyo na viungo vingi, navyo viungo vyote havina kazi moja,
Ekegusii: Inaki buna ase omobere tore nebiimo ebinge, na birobio tibiri gokora omoremo oyomo;

English: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,
Kiswahili: vivyo hivyo na sisi tulio wengi, tu mwili mmoja katika Kristo, nasi kila mmoja ni kiungo cha mwenzake.
Ekegusii: naboigo naintwe, nonya tore abange, nigo tore omobere oyomo ase Kristo, na intwe twensi nigo tore buna ebiimo kera oyomo ase oy’omwabo.

English: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
Kiswahili: Tuna karama zilizotofautiana kila mmoja kutokana na neema tuliyopewa. Kama ni unabii na tutoe unabii kwa kadiri ya imani.
Ekegusii: Nigo tore nebiegwa ao ao koreng’ana n’obuya twaeirwe; onye n’obobani tobane koreng’ana n’okwegena gwaito;

English: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;
Kiswahili: Kama ni kuhudumu na tuhudumu, mwenye kufundisha na afundishe,
Ekegusii: onye n’ogokorera, tobeo ase ogokorera gwaito; oyo okworokereria abe ase okworokereria kwaye;

English: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
Kiswahili: kama ni kutia moyo na atie moyo, kama ni kuchangia kwa ajili ya mahitaji ya wengine na atoe kwa ukarimu, kama ni uongozi na aongoze kwa bidii, kama ni kuhurumia wengine na afanye hivyo kwa furaha.
Ekegusii: oyo okoremia abe ase okoremia kwaye; oyo okorua arue ase omoyo omorabu; oyo ogotenenera atenenere ase omokia; oyo okororera amaabera arorere amaabera n’omogooko.

English: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
Kiswahili: Upendo lazima usiwe na unafiki. Chukieni lililo ovu, shikamaneni na lililo jema.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bobe botari n’obong’ainereria. Gecha erire riibe, bwatana n’erire rigiya.

English: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
Kiswahili: Pendaneni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa upendo wa ndugu. Waheshimuni na kuwatanguliza wengine.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bw’obomino bobe ase egati yaino; mobe ab’eritang’ani kworokia abamino amasikani.

English: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
Kiswahili: Msiwe wavivu, bali mwe na bidii katika roho mkimtumikia Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase omokia oino timoba aboro; mobe n’Omoika ogwoka, mogokorera Omonene.

English: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
Kiswahili: Kuweni na furaha katika tumaini, katika dhiki kuweni na saburi, dumuni katika maombi.
Ekegusii: Mogoke ase ogosemeria, moremererie ase emechando, mogenderere n’ogosaba.

English: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.
Kiswahili: Changieni katika mahitaji ya watakatifu, wakaribisheni wageni.
Ekegusii: Mobe ang’e gokoonya abachenu ase okoremerwa kwabo, mobe abanyamokia ase okoroisia abageni.

English: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
Kiswahili: Wabarikini wale wanaowatesa, barikini wala msilaani.
Ekegusii: Mosesenie abwo bakobachaanda; basesenie, timobaragereria.

English: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
Kiswahili: Furahini pamoja na wenye kufurahi, lieni pamoja na wale waliao.
Ekegusii: Goka amo nabwo bakogoka; rera amo nabwo bakorera.

English: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
Kiswahili: Kaeni kwa amani ninyi kwa ninyi. Msijivune, bali mwe tayari kushirikiana na wanyonge. Wala msiwe watu wenye kujivuna kwamba mnajua kila kitu.
Ekegusii: Mobe n’omoyo oyomo inwe ase inwe. Timorengereria ayare amanene, korende mosange n’abare n’oboitongo. Timoba abanto bakoenenera obong’aini.

English: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
Kiswahili: Msimlipe mtu yeyote ovu kwa ovu. Jitahidini ili mtende yaliyo mema machoni pa watu wote.
Ekegusii: Timoakana omonto obobe ase obobe, tang’ania ayare amaya ase amasio y’ abanto bonsi.

English: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
Kiswahili: Kama ikiwezekana, kwa upande wenu kaeni kwa amani na watu wote.
Ekegusii: Keranyarekane ase ensemo yaino, mobe n’omorembe n’abanto bonsi.

English: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
Kiswahili: Wapendwa, msilipize kisasi, bali ipisheni ghadhabu ya Mungu, maana imeandikwa: “Ni juu yangu kulipiza kisasi, nitalipiza,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanchwa, timorigia kweruseria egesiomba, tiga ribaga ase endamwamu ya Nyasae, ekiagera neriikire, “Omonene oteebire: Egesiomba n’ekiane; inche ning’akane.”

English: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
Kiswahili: Badala yake: “Kama adui yako ana njaa, mlishe; kama ana kiu, mpe kinywaji. Kwa kufanya hivyo, unaweka makaa ya moto yanayowaka kichwani pake.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo, “Omobisa oo karabe nenchara, moragerie, kar’abe n’erang’o, moe anywe, ekiagera korakore ayio, nomobekere amakara y’omorero ase omotwe oye.”

English: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
Kiswahili: Usishindwe na ubaya, bali uushinde ubaya kwa wema.
Ekegusii: Tobugwa n’obobe, korende obue obobe ase obuya.

English: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu na atii mamlaka inayotawala, kwa maana hakuna mamlaka isiyotoka kwa Mungu, nazo mamlaka zilizopo zimewekwa na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Tiga kera omonto abe omoigweri ase abare n’okobua, ekiagera okobua konde tikori gotarueti ase Nyasae, na koria koreo nokobekire na Nyasae.

English: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo yeye anayeasi dhidi ya mamlaka inayotawala anaasi dhidi ya kile kilichowekwa na Mungu, nao wale wafanyao hivyo watajiletea hukumu juu yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naboigo oy’otari koigwera oyore n’okobua, nigo akoamererania naya Nyasae achiikire; na barabwo abakoamererania inabenyorere ekiina.

English: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa watawala hawawatishi watu wale wanaotenda mema bali wale wanaotenda mabaya. Je, wataka usimwogope mwenye mamlaka? Basi tenda lile lililo jema naye atakusifu.
Ekegusii: Inaki abakogaamba tibari kogosa abanto ase engencho y’ogokora okuya, korende nase engencho y’ogokora okobe. Inee! Torigeti komoiroka oyore n’okobua? Kora ayare amaya, na aye nonyore ogotogigwa ase amaya aria.

English: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mwenye mamlaka ni mtumishi wa Mungu kwa ajili ya mema. Lakini kama ukitenda mabaya, basi ogopa, kwa kuwa hauinui upanga bila sababu. Yeye ni mtumishi wa Mungu, mjumbe wa Mungu wa kutekeleza adhabu juu ya watenda mabaya.
Ekegusii: Inaki oyore n’okobua, ere n’omokoreri o Nyasae ase ogokonyorera amaya. Korende korakore amabe nekogwenerete oiroke; inaki ere tabogoreti omoro bosa, ekiagera n’omokoreri o Nyasae ase ogoakana egesiomba ase omokori amabe na komoa egesusuro.

English: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ni lazima kutii wenye mamlaka, si kwa sababu ya kuogopa adhabu iwezayo kutolewa, bali pia kwa ajili ya dhamiri.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio negwenerete kera oyomo aigwere, tari ase engencho y ’endamwamu ya Nyasae yoka, korende aigwere boigo, erinde enkoro yaye temogaambia.

English: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii mnalipa kodi, kwa maana watawala ni watumishi wa Mungu, ambao hutumia muda wao wote kutawala.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio naende nakio mokoruera ebango, ekiagera abare n’okobua nigo bare abakoreri ba Nyasae, ase ogokora emeremo eyio eyio.

English: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
Kiswahili: Mlipeni kila mtu kile mnachodaiwa. Kama mnadaiwa kodi lipeni kodi, kama ni ushuru, lipeni ushuru, astahiliye hofu, mhofu, astahiliye heshima, mheshimu.
Ekegusii: Bae bonsi ebiaboronge biabo: omonto bw’ebango, ebango; na omonto bw’ogochooga, ogochooga; oyogwenerete koirokwa, tiga airokwe; na oyogwenerete gosikwa, tiga asikwe.

English: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
Kiswahili: Msidaiwe kitu na mtu yeyote, isipokuwa kupendana, kwa maana yeye ampendaye mwenzake, ameitimiza sheria.
Ekegusii: Timoba n’esira ase onde bwensi otatiga ogwanchana, ekiagera oy’omwanchete omogisangio oye oikeranirie amachiiko.

English: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa amri hizi zisemazo, “Usizini,” “Usiue,” “Usiibe,” “Usitamani,” na amri nyingine zote, zinajumlishwa katika amri hii moja: “Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.”
Ekegusii: Inaki amachiiko aya, “Totomana, Toita, Toiba, Toba nokogania okobe”, na gakorabeo gochiika konde gwonsi, kwabeekeraniigwe amo ase ring’ana eri, “Ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”

English: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
Kiswahili: Upendo haumfanyii jirani jambo baya. Kwa hiyo upendo ndio utimilifu wa sheria.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani tibogokorera omogisangio oo bobe; naboigo, obwanchani nabwo bogoikerania amachiiko.

English: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.
Kiswahili: Nanyi fanyeni hivi, mkiutambua wakati tulio nao. Saa ya kuamka kutoka usingizini imewadia, kwa maana sasa wokovu wetu umekaribia zaidi kuliko hapo kwanza tulipoamini.
Ekegusii: Kora ayio, ekiagera mwamanyire ng’a amatuko aikire, na engaki yaino y’okoboka korwa ase chitoro yabeire ang’e. Inaki bono ogotooreka nigo kore ang’e naintwe kobua ekero keria twachaagete kwegena.

English: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
Kiswahili: Usiku umeendelea sana, mapambazuko yamekaribia. Kwa hiyo tuyaweke kando matendo ya giza na tuvae silaha za nuru.
Ekegusii: Obotuko bwaisire koera, omobaso obeire ang’e. Torusie ogokora kw’omosunte; tweboyie ebirwanero bi’omobaso.

English: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.
Kiswahili: Basi na tuenende kwa adabu kama inavyopasa wakati wa mchana, si kwa kufanya karamu za ulafi na ulevi, si kwa ufisadi na uasherati, si kwa ugomvi na wivu.
Ekegusii: Totaare buna egwenerete ase omobaso; tari ase okoria bobe na gotinda, tari ase obotomani na ase obonyaka, tari ase eriomana ne ribero.

English: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
Kiswahili: Bali jivikeni Bwana Yesu Kristo, wala msifikiri jinsi mtakavyotimiza tamaa za miili yenu yenye asili ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Korende mweboyie Omonene Yeso Kristo, timoa omobere ribaga goikerania okogania kwaye kw’ebibe.

English: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
Kiswahili: Mkaribisheni yeye ambaye imani yake ni dhaifu, lakini si kwa kugombana na kubishana juu ya mawazo yake.
Ekegusii: Moroisie ere oy’otari na nguru ase okwegena, motari koamererania.

English: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja imani yake inamruhusu kula kila kitu, lakini mwingine ambaye imani yake ni dhaifu, hula mboga tu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bwegenete ng’a nanyare koria bionsi, korende ere oy’otari na nguru nigo akoria chinyeni.

English: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
Kiswahili: Yeye alaye kila kitu asimdharau yeye asiyekula. Wala yeye asiyekula kila kitu asimhukumu yule alaye kila kitu, kwa maana Mungu amemkubali.
Ekegusii: Oyokoria tachaaya oria otari koria, na oria otari koria tagaambia oria okoria, ekiagera Nyasae omwancheire.

English: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
Kiswahili: Wewe ni nani hata umhukumu mtumishi wa mtu mwingine? Kwa bwana wake tu anasimama au kuanguka. Naye atasimama kwa sababu Bwana anaweza kumsimamisha.
Ekegusii: Aye naye ning’o okogaambia omosomba bw’omonto onde? Ase omonene oye omonyene nigo ateneine gose nigo akogwa. Ee, natenene, ekiagera Omonene nere ore n’okobua gw’okomotenenia.

English: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
Kiswahili: Mtu mmoja anaitukuza siku fulani kuwa ni bora kuliko nyingine, na mwingine anaona kuwa siku zote ni sawa. Basi kila mmoja awe na hakika na yale anayoamini.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo narengereretie ng’a rituko erimo nerinene kobua erinde, na oyonde arora ng’a amatuko onsi nigo areng’aine. Tiga kera omonto aisaneke ase aya amanyete omonyene.

English: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
Kiswahili: Yeye anayehesabu siku moja kuwa takatifu kuliko nyingine, hufanya hivyo kwa kumheshimu Bwana. Naye alaye nyama hula kwa Bwana, kwa maana humshukuru Mungu, naye akataaye kula nyama hufanya hivyo kwa Bwana na humshukuru Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ere oyokorenda rituko, nigo akorirenda ase Omonene, na ere oyokoria, nigo akoria ase Omonene, ekiagera nigo agoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono; ere oy’otari koria, nigo agokora bo ase Omonene, na aakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono.

English: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hakuna hata mmoja wetu anayeishi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, wala hakuna hata mmoja wetu afaye kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera onde tari ase egati yaito ore moyo ase engencho yaye omonyene; na onde tari ogokwa ase engencho yaye omonyene.

English: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
Kiswahili: Kama tunaishi, tunaishi kwa Bwana, nasi pia tukifa tunakufa kwa Bwana. Kwa hiyo basi, kama tukiishi au kama tukifa, sisi ni mali ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inaki onye tore moyo, nigo tore moyo ase Omonene; gose gatorakwe, nigo torakwe ase Omonene. Naboigo, onye tore moyo, gose gatorakwe, nigo tore aba Omonene.

English: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
Kiswahili: Kwani kwa sababu hii hasa, Kristo alikufa na akawa hai tena kusudi apate kuwa Bwana wa wote, yaani, waliokufa na walio hai.
Ekegusii: Inaki Kristo nigo akwete, naende akaba moyo, erinde abe Omonene ase abare moyo na ase abakuure boigo.

English: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa nini wewe wamhukumu ndugu yako? Au kwa nini wewe unamdharau ndugu yako? Kwa kuwa sote tutasimama mbele ya kiti cha Mungu cha hukumu.
Ekegusii: Korende aye, nase ki okogaambia oy’omino? Gose aye, nase ki ogochaaya oy’omino? Inaki intwe twensi inatoche gotenena bosio bw’ekerogo gi’ekina kia Nyasae.

English: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa imeandikwa: “ ‘Kama vile niishivyo,’ asema Bwana, ‘kila goti litapigwa mbele zangu, na kila ulimi utakiri kwa Mungu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Inaki neriikire, “Omonene oteebire: Amaene buna inde moyo, kera riiru inaribekwe inse ase obosio bwane, na kera oromeme ’naromobeere Nyasae kirori.”

English: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi kila mmoja wetu atatoa habari zake mwenyewe kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, kera omonto ore ase egati yaito naache gwekwanera ere omonyene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tusiendelee kuhukumiana: Badala yake mtu asiweke kamwe kikwazo au kizuizi katika njia ya ndugu mwingine.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, titoba nkona‐kogaambania tore, korende anga mbuya kobua togaambe ng’a onde tabeekera oy’omwabo egento gekomogocha gose gekomotanga.

English: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
Kiswahili: Ninajua tena nimehakikishiwa sana katika Bwana Yesu kwamba hakuna kitu chochote ambacho ni najisi kwa asili yake. Lakini kama mtu anakiona kitu kuwa ni najisi, basi kwake huyo kitu hicho ni najisi.
Ekegusii: Namanyire, naende naenekirie ase Omonene Yeso, ng’a gento kende tikeri ekebe ekenyene, korende nigo kere ekebe ase oyo okeroche ng’a negento ekebe.

English: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
Kiswahili: Kama ndugu yako anahuzunishwa kwa sababu ya kile unachokula, basi huenendi tena katika upendo. Usiruhusu kile unachokula kiwe sababu ya kumwangamiza ndugu yako ambaye Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Onye oy’omino okoba n’ogwechanda ase engencho y’endagera okoria aye, gwatigire gotaara ase obwanchani. Ase engencho y’endagera yao tomobeyia omonto oria, ere Kristo akwete ase engencho yaye.

English: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
Kiswahili: Usiruhusu kile ambacho unakiona kuwa chema kisemwe kuwa ni kiovu.
Ekegusii: Timotiga ayare amaya ase more atorwe ng’a n’amabe.

English: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu si kula na kunywa, bali ni haki, amani na furaha katika Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Inaki oborwoti bwa Nyasae tari okoria na okonywa, korende oboronge, na omorembe, na omogooko bikorwa ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu mtu yeyote anayemtumikia Kristo kwa jinsi hii, anampendeza Mungu na kukubaliwa na wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Ere oy’ogokorera Kristo ase amang’ana aya onsi nigo akogwenera Nyasae, naende nigo agwancherwa na Mwanyabaanto.

English: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo na tufanye bidii kutafuta yale yaletayo amani na kujengana sisi kwa sisi.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, tiga torigie chingencho chi’omorembe ne chingencho chigwenerete ase okoagachana.

English: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
Kiswahili: Usiiharibu kazi ya Mungu kwa ajili ya chakula. Hakika vyakula vyote ni safi, lakini ni kosa kula kitu chochote kinachomsababisha ndugu yako ajikwae.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’endagera tosaria emeremo ya Nyasae. Bionsi nebichenu; korende ’mbobe omonto oragere abande bagochwe ase engencho y’ebiakoria.

English: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
Kiswahili: Ni afadhali kutokula nyama wala kunywa divai au kufanya jambo lingine lolote litakalomsababisha ndugu yako ajikwae.
Ekegusii: Mbuya gotaria enyama, nonya ’nkonywa edivai, gose gokora gento kende gionsi keragoche oy’omino.

English: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
Kiswahili: Je, wewe unayo imani? Ile imani uliyo nayo, uwe nayo nafsini mwako mbele za Mungu. Heri mtu yule asiye na sababu ya kujihukumu nafsi yake kwa ajili ya kile anachokifanya.
Ekegusii: Okwegena okwo ore nakwo, obe nakorokwo ase egati yao na Nyasae. Nasesenirie omonto oria otenachereti ekiina ase ring’ana riria anchete.

English: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mtu ana shaka kuhusu kile anachokula, amehukumiwa, kwa sababu hakula kwa imani. Kwa kuwa chochote kinachofanywa pasipo imani ni dhambi.
Ekegusii: Korende oyore ne chitang’u‐tang’u onye okoria, onacheirwe ekiina, ekiagera tarieti ase okwegena; na ogokora konde gwonsi gotarueti ase okwegena nebibe.

English: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
Kiswahili: Sisi tulio na nguvu, hatuna budi kuchukuliana na kushindwa kwa wale walio dhaifu wala si kujipendeza nafsi zetu wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Intwe abatore ne chinguru netogwenerete kobogoria oboreu bw’abatari ne chinguru, tetogwenereti kwegwenera intwe abanyene.

English: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja wetu inampasa kumpendeza jirani yake kwa mambo mema, ili kumjenga katika imani.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto ore ase egati yaito tiga agwenere omogisangio oye, anyore obuya, erinde tonyare koagachana,

English: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hata Kristo hakujipendeza mwenyewe, bali kama ilivyoandikwa: “Matukano yao wale wanaokutukana wewe yalinipata mimi.”
Ekegusii: Inaki Kristo tegwenerete ere omonyene; korende buna eriikire, “Emerumi yabo bakoramete nigo yangwerete inche.”

English: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila kitu kilichoandikwa zamani, kiliandikwa kutufundisha, ili kwamba kwa saburi na faraja tunayopata katika Maandiko tuwe na tumaini.
Ekegusii: Inaki onsi ayatang’anete koriikwa korwa kare nigo arigetwe ase ogotworokereria intwe, erinde ase oboremereria na ase okoremigwa tokonyora korwa ase amariiko, tonyare koba nogosemeria.

English: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: Mungu atoaye saburi na faraja, awajalie ninyi roho ya umoja miongoni mwenu mnapomfuata Kristo Yesu,
Ekegusii: Na Nyasae bw’oboremereria na bw’okoremia abakoonye mobe n’omoyo oyomo inwe ase inwe ase omogwekano o Kristo Yeso;

English: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: ili kwa moyo mmoja mpate kumtukuza Mungu aliye Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: erio ase omoyo oyomo monyare komobaka Nyasae Tata n’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
Kiswahili: Karibishaneni ninyi kwa ninyi kama Kristo alivyowakaribisha ninyi ili kumletea Mungu utukufu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo moroisanie buna Kristo nere abaroisetie inwe, erinde Nyasae abaakwe.

English: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nawaambia kwamba, Kristo amekuwa mtumishi kwa wale waliotahiriwa ili kuonyesha kweli ya Mungu na kuthibitisha zile ahadi walizopewa baba zetu wa zamani,
Ekegusii: Inaki nabateebirie inwe, ng’a Kristo akaba omosomba bw’abaarogete ase okoorokia ng’a Nyasae noyo bw’ekeene, erinde aikeranie chiira echi abagaaka baito ba kare baetwe.

English: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”
Kiswahili: pia ili watu wa Mataifa wamtukuze Mungu kwa rehema zake. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Kwa hiyo nitakutukuza katikati ya watu wa Mataifa; nitaliimbia sifa jina lako.”
Ekegusii: Naende abanto b’Ebisaku bamobake Nyasae ase engencho y’amaabera aye, buna eriikire, “Ase engencho eye ningotogie ase egati y’ abanto b’Ebisaku, ninterere erieta riao ase okoritogia.”

English: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
Kiswahili: Tena yasema, “Enyi watu wa Mataifa, furahini pamoja na watu wa Mungu.”
Ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteeba, “Abanto b’Ebisaku, goka amo n’abanto ba n’Omonene.”

English: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
Kiswahili: Tena, “Msifuni Bwana, ninyi watu wa Mataifa wote, na kumwimbia sifa, enyi watu wote.”
Ekegusii: Naende, “Abanto b’Ebisaku bionsi, motogie Omonene; abanto bonsi bamobaake!”

English: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”
Kiswahili: Tena Isaya anasema, “Shina la Yese litachipuka, yeye atakayeinuka ili kutawala juu ya mataifa. Watu wa Mataifa watamtumaini.”
Ekegusii: Naende Isaya nigo agokwana, “Ritina ria Yese inariiche, ere naoroke kogaambera abanto b’Ebisaku; nere abanto b’Ebisaku barasemerie.”

English: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Mungu wa tumaini awajaze ninyi furaha yote na amani katika kumwamini, ili mpate kujawa na tumaini tele kwa nguvu ya Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo Nyasae bw’ogosemerigwa abaichorie n’omogooko bwonsi na omorembe ase okwegena, monyare komenta mono ase ogosemeria ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu.

English: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, mimi mwenyewe ninasadiki kwamba mmejaa wema na ufahamu wote, tena mnaweza kufundishana ninyi kwa ninyi.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, inche omonyene naenekerigwe igoro yaino ng’a mwaichoirwe n’amaya, naende mwaichoirwe ne chisemi chionsi, na monyare kworokererania.

English: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
Kiswahili: Nimewaandikia kwa ujasiri vipengele kadha wa kadha katika waraka huu kama kuwakumbusha tena kwa habari ya ile neema Mungu aliyonipa,
Ekegusii: Korende nabariikeire ase oboremu kobua ase chinsemo chinde chie riirube eri, nkobainyoria ase obuya boria naetwe na Nyasae,

English: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: ili kuwa mhudumu wa Kristo Yesu kwa watu wa Mataifa nikiwa na huduma ya kikuhani ya kutangaza Injili ya Mungu, ili watu wa Mataifa wapate kuwa dhabihu inayokubaliwa na Mungu, iliyotakaswa na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: erinde imbe omosomba o Kristo Yeso ase ogokorera abanto b’Ebisaku, emeremo y’obokuani ase okorandia enchiri ya Nyasae, erinde ekeng’wanso kiabo giancherwe, gechenwe n’Omoika Omochenu.

English: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ninajisifu katika Kristo Yesu, kwenye utumishi wangu kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Bono ninde n’engencho y’okweenenia ime ya Kristo Yeso ase emeremo y’ane ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sitathubutu kusema kitu chochote zaidi ya kile ambacho Kristo amefanya kwa kunitumia mimi katika kuwaongoza watu wa Mataifa wamtii Mungu kwa yale niliyosema na kufanya,
Ekegusii: Inaki tinkonyara gwatora ring’ana rinde otatiga eri Kristo akorete goetera ase emeremo y’ane, erinde abanto b’Ebisaku banyare koigwera ase engencho ye ring’ana na ogokora,

English: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
Kiswahili: kwa nguvu za ishara na miujiza, kwa uweza wa Roho wa Mungu, hivyo kuanzia Yerusalemu hadi maeneo yote ya kandokando yake mpaka Iliriko, nimekwisha kuihubiri Injili ya Kristo kwa ukamilifu.
Ekegusii: ase chinguru chi’ebikone na amakumia, ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu. Naikire korandia enchiri ya Kristo ase Yerusalemu ne chinsemo chionsi chietanaine goika Iluriko.

English: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ni nia yangu kuhubiri Habari Njema, si pale ambapo Kristo amekwisha kujulikana, ili nisije nikajenga juu ya msingi wa mtu mwingine.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nakorete omokia one korandia enchiri, korende tari aase erieta ria Kristo riaikire koigugwa, erinde timbaisa koagacha ase oboroso bw’omonto onde,

English: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama ilivyoandikwa: “Wale ambao hawajahubiriwa habari zake wataona, nao wale ambao hawajazisikia watafahamu.”
Ekegusii: korende, buna eriikire, “Baria batana goteebigwa amang’ana igoro yaye, inabarore, na baria batana koyaigwa, inabamanye.”

English: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu nimezuiliwa mara nyingi nisiweze kuja kwenu.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio kiagerete ingatangwa ebiro ebinge tinaacha ase more.

English: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa hakuna nafasi zaidi kwa ajili yangu katika sehemu hii, ninatamani kuja kwenu kama ambavyo nimekuwa na shauku kwa miaka mingi.
Ekegusii: Korende bono tindi ne ribaga rinde ri’ogokora emeremo ase chinsemo echi, naende korwa emiaka emenge inarenge namaiga gocha ase more.

English: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
Kiswahili: Nimekusudia kufanya hivyo nitakapokuwa njiani kwenda Hispania. Natarajia kuwaona katika safari yangu na kusafirishwa nanyi mpaka huko, baada ya kufurahia ushirika wenu kwa kitambo kidogo.
Ekegusii: Ekero nkogenda gochia Hispania ninganetie ng’etere seino, ’mbarore. Na magega konabeire amo nainwe ase ogokonyana ase ekero egeke, namonkoobe.

English: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
Kiswahili: Sasa, niko njiani kuelekea Yerusalemu kwa ajili ya kuwahudumia watakatifu huko.
Ekegusii: Na bono ningende Yerusalemu, imbe ingokorera abachenu.

English: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa imewapendeza watu wa Makedonia na Akaya kufanya changizo kwa ajili ya maskini walioko miongoni mwa watakatifu huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Inaki agweneire abanto ba Makedonia na Akaya gosangereria ebiegwa bi’ogokonya abachenu ba Yerusalemu, baria bare abataka.

English: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.
Kiswahili: Imewapendeza kufanya hivyo, naam, kwani ni wadeni wao. Kwa maana ikiwa watu wa Mataifa wameshiriki baraka za rohoni za Wayahudi, wao ni wadeni wa Wayahudi, ili Wayahudi nao washiriki baraka zao za mambo ya mwilini.
Ekegusii: Ee, amaene, abagweneire gokora bo, naende nabasiira babo bare, ekiagera onye abanto b’Ebisaku babwatanire nabarabwo ase ogosesenigwa kwabo kw’omoika, igo nebagwenerete bakorere abachenu baria ase ebinto birabakonye ase obogima obo.

English: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo baada ya kukamilisha kazi hii na kuhakikisha kuwa wamepokea kila kitu kilichokusanywa, nitapitia kwenu nikiwa njiani kwenda Hispania.
Ekegusii: Naboigo kondaikeranie ring’ana eri na kobaa ebiegwa ebi biasangererigwe, ekero nabibekire ekemanyererio, ning’etere seino konde orogendo rw’ane gochia Hispania.

English: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
Kiswahili: Ninajua kwamba nitakapokuja kwenu, nitakuja na wingi wa baraka za Kristo.
Ekegusii: Na inche namanyire ng’a kondache ase more, ninchiche nogoichorwa kw’ogosesenigwa gwa Kristo.

English: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
Kiswahili: Basi, ndugu zangu, nawasihi kwa Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo na kwa upendo wa Roho Mtakatifu, kujiunga nami katika taabu zangu mkiniombea kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabasoroire baminto ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo na ase obwanchani bw’Omoika Omochenu, mobe n’omokia amo nainche ase ogosaba kwaino ase engencho y’ane ase obosio bwa Nyasae;

English: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
Kiswahili: Ombeni ili nipate kuokolewa mikononi mwa wale wasioamini walioko Uyahudi, na kwamba utumishi wangu upate kukubaliwa na watakatifu wa huko Yerusalemu,
Ekegusii: erinde nsiborwe korwa ase baria bategeneti ase Boyahudi, naende emeremo imbwate aaria Yerusalemu yancheirwe n’abachenu.

English: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
Kiswahili: ili kwa mapenzi ya Mungu niweze kuja kwenu kwa furaha, nami niburudishwe pamoja nanyi.
Ekegusii: Igo niny’are gocha ase more n’omogooko, Nyasae karanche, na konyora ogotimoka amo nainwe.

English: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
Kiswahili: Mungu wa amani na awe pamoja nanyi nyote. Amen.
Ekegusii: Nyasae bw’omorembe abe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.

English: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
Kiswahili: Napenda kumtambulisha kwenu dada yetu Foibe, mtumishi katika kanisa la Kenkrea.
Ekegusii: Nabekire oyominto Febe ase amaboko aino. Ere nomosubati omokoreri ore ase ekanisa gia Kenkrea.

English: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
Kiswahili: Naomba mpokeeni katika Bwana ipasavyo watakatifu na kumpa msaada wowote atakaohitaji kutoka kwenu, kwa maana yeye amekuwa msaada kwa watu wengi, mimi nikiwa miongoni mwao.
Ekegusii: Momooroisie ase Omonene, buna egwenerete abachenu, momokonye ase ring’ana rinde rionsi araganie ase more, ekiagera ere obeire ogokonya abanto abange, nonya ninche omonyene nankonyete.

English: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni Prisila na Akila, watumishi wenzangu katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Priskila na Akwila, abakori emeremo amo nainche ase Kristo Yeso,

English: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Wao walihatarisha maisha yao kwa ajili yangu; wala si mimi tu ninayewashukuru bali pia makanisa yote ya watu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: ababete ang’e korua obogima bwabo ase engencho y’ane. Nabaakeire ng’a mbuya mono, gose tari inche bweka, korende nonya n’Ebirisia bionsi bi’abaanto b’Ebisaku.

English: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
Kiswahili: Lisalimuni pia kanisa linalokutana nyumbani mwao. Msalimuni rafiki yangu mpendwa Epaineto, aliyekuwa mtu wa kwanza kumwamini Kristo huko Asia.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie boigo ekanisa kere ase enyomba yabo. Nkwanerie Epaineto omwanchwa one, nere orenge bw’eritang’ani ase Asia koonchoka ase Kristo.

English: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
Kiswahili: Msalimuni Maria, aliyefanya kazi kwa bidii kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Mariamu oyokorete emeremo emekong’u ase egati yaino.

English: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni Androniko na Yunia, jamaa zangu ambao wamekuwa gerezani pamoja nami. Wao ni maarufu miongoni mwa mitume, nao walikuwa katika Kristo kabla yangu.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Androniko na Yunia, abaamate baane, abasibetwe ano nainche, abatomwa bagwatorwa ng’a nabaya; barabwo nigo bantang’anerete koba ime ase Kristo.

English: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Msalimuni Ampliato, yeye nimpendaye katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Ampiliato, omwanchwa one ase Omonene.

English: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
Kiswahili: Msalimuni Urbano, mtendakazi mwenzetu katika Kristo, pamoja na rafiki yangu mpendwa Stakisi.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Urubano omokori emeremo amo nainche ase Kristo, na Staku omwanchwa one.

English: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
Kiswahili: Msalimuni Apele aliyejaribiwa na akaithibitisha imani yake katika Kristo. Wasalimuni wote walio nyumbani mwa Aristobulo.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Apele oyo bwancheretwe ase Kristo. Nkwanerie abanto b’enyomba y’Aristobulu.

English: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Msalimuni ndugu yangu Herodioni. Wasalimuni wote walio nyumbani mwa Narkisi walio katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Herodioni, omoamate one. Nkwanerie abanto b’enyomba ya Narikiso bare ase Omonene.

English: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni Trifaina na Trifosa, wale wanawake wanaofanya kazi kwa bidii katika Bwana. Msalimuni rafiki yangu mpendwa Persisi, mwanamke mwingine aliyefanya kazi kwa bidii katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Turufena na Turufosa, abakori emeremo ase Omonene. Nkwanerie Perisi omwanchwa, oyokorire omokia mono ase Omonene.

English: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
Kiswahili: Msalimuni Rufo, mteule katika Bwana, pamoja na mama yake, ambaye amekuwa mama kwangu pia.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Rufo omochorwa Omonene, na ng’ina ore buna baba ase ’nde.

English: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni Asinkrito, Flegoni, Herme, Patroba, Herma na ndugu wote walio pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Asunkrito, Felegoni, Herme, Patiroba, Herama na abaminto abare amo nabarabwo.

English: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni Filologo, Yulia, Nerea na dada yake, na Olimpa na watakatifu wote walio pamoja nao.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie Fililogo, Yuli, Nereu na mosubati omwabo, Olimpa na abachenu bonsi abare amo n’abarabwo.

English: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
Kiswahili: Salimianeni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa busu takatifu. Makanisa yote ya Kristo yanawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Kwanania inwe ase inwe ase okonyunyuntana. Chikanisa chionsi chia Kristo chiabakwanirie.

English: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, nawasihi mjihadhari na kujiepusha na wale watu waletao matengano na kuweka vikwazo mbele yenu dhidi ya mafundisho mliyojifunza.
Ekegusii: Nabasoroire baminto, morigererie baria bakorenta ogwatananekana ne chingencho chikogera abanto bagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, chire mamincha y’okworokererigwa mworokereretigwe; mweatanane korwa ase barabwo.

English: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana watu kama hao hawamtumikii Bwana Kristo, bali wanatumikia tamaa zao wenyewe. Kwa kutumia maneno laini na ya kubembeleza, hupotosha mioyo ya watu wajinga.
Ekegusii: Inaki abanto banga buna abwo tibari gokorera Omonene oito Kristo, korende nechinda chiabo bagokorera abanyene; na ase amang’ana amororo na ay’okwegwenia bang’aina emioyo y’ abanto batetenenereti ase ebirengererio biabo.

English: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu amesikia juu ya utii wenu, nami nimejawa na furaha tele kwa ajili yenu. Lakini nataka mwe na hekima katika mambo mema na bila hatia katika mambo maovu.
Ekegusii: Inaki oboigweri bwaino bwamanyekanire ase abanto bonsi. Naboigo nagokire ase engencho yaino, korende nindigetie mobe abang’aini ase amang’ana amaya, na abariri ase amang’ana amabe.

English: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
Kiswahili: Mungu wa amani atamponda Shetani chini ya miguu yenu upesi. Neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu iwe nanyi. Amen.
Ekegusii: Nyasae bw’omorembe namionogorere Saitani inse y’amagoro aino bwango. Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.

English: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
Kiswahili: Timotheo, mtendakazi mwenzangu anawasalimu. Vivyo hivyo Lukio, Yasoni, na Sosipatro, ndugu zangu.
Ekegusii: Timotheo, omokori emeremo amo nainche, obakwanirie; naboigo Lukio, na Yasoni, na Sosipateri, abaamate bane, baabakwanirie.

English: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Mimi, Tertio, niliye mwandishi wa waraka huu, nawasalimu katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inche Teretio, omoriki bwe riirube eri, nabakwanirie ase Omonene.

English: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
Kiswahili: Gayo, ambaye ni mwenyeji wangu na wa kanisa lote, anawasalimu. Erasto, mweka hazina wa mji huu, pamoja na Kwarto ndugu yetu pia wanawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Gayo, oyokondoisia inche na ekanisa engima, baabakwanirie. Erasto, omogachi bwe chitaabu, chi’omochie, na Kwarito oyominto, baabakwanirie.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
Kiswahili: Neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja nanyi nyote. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.

English: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
Kiswahili: Paulo, niliyeitwa kwa mapenzi ya Mungu kuwa mtume wa Kristo Yesu, na Sosthene ndugu yetu.
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo narangeretigwe koba omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae. Inche amo noyominto Sostene

English: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
Kiswahili: Kwa kanisa la Mungu lililoko Korintho, kwa wale waliotakaswa katika Kristo Yesu na walioitwa kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na wale wote ambao kila mahali wanaliitia Jina la Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu, aliye Bwana wao na wetu pia:
Ekegusii: nkobariikera tore inwe abekanisa ya Nyasae ere ase Korinto, inwe abamwachenirwe ase Kristo Yeso, abamwarangerigwe koba abachenu amo na bonsi abakorangeria erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo kera aase, nere Omonene obo na oyoito.

English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
Ekegusii: Obuya na omorembe bibe ase more, ebio bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: Ninamshukuru Mungu siku zote kwa ajili yenu kwa sababu ya neema yake mliyopewa katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo nkomoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino, ase engencho y’obuya bwaye obwo mwaetwe ase Kristo Yeso.

English: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa katika Kristo mmetajirishwa kwa kila hali, katika kusema kwenu na katika maarifa yenu yote,
Ekegusii: Ase kera enchera mogatenenkigwa ime asare ase chinkwana chionsi, ne chisemi chionsi,

English: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ushuhuda wetu kumhusu Kristo ulithibitishwa ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: buna oborori bwa Kristo bwabekirwe chinguru ase egati yaino.

English: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hamkupungukiwa na karama yoyote ya kiroho wakati mnangoja kwa shauku kudhihirishwa kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Na bono timoremeiri keegwa kende gionsi, komoganyete okoorokigwa kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Atawafanya imara mpaka mwisho, ili msiwe na hatia siku ile ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Nere orabakong’ie goika omoerio, erinde timocha koba nokomocha ase rituko riria ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
Kiswahili: Mungu ambaye mmeitwa naye ili mwe na ushirika na Mwanawe Yesu Kristo, Bwana wetu ni mwaminifu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nomwegenwa, oyobarangeirie mosoe ase obomo bw’Omwana oye, Yeso Kristo Omonene oito.

English: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
Kiswahili: Nawasihi ndugu zangu, katika Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, kwamba mpatane nia zenu ninyi kwa ninyi, ili pasiwepo na matengano katikati yenu na kwamba mwe na umoja kikamilifu katika nia na katika kusudi.
Ekegusii: Nabasoroire inwe, baminto, ase erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, mokwane mwensi ayamo, erinde ogwatananeka tikoba ase more; korende mobe nokobwatana ase ebirengererio ebimo na okogamba okomo.

English: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, nimepata habari kutoka kwa baadhi ya watu wa nyumbani mwa Kloe kwamba kuna magomvi katikati yenu.
Ekegusii: Naki baminto, nateebigwe nabaanto ba nyomba mwa Kiloe, ng’a eriomana ndire ase egati yaino.

English: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”
Kiswahili: Maana yangu ni kwamba: Mmoja wenu husema, “Mimi ni wa Paulo”; mwingine, “Mimi ni wa Apolo”; mwingine, “Mimi ni wa Kefa,” na mwingine, “Mimi ni wa Kristo.”
Ekegusii: Engencho yagera nakwana bo neye, ng’a oyomo ore ase egati yaino nigo agoteeba, “Inche noyo o Paulo,” na oyonde, “Inche noyo bw’Apolo,” na oyonde, “Inche noyo o Kefa,” na oyonde, “Inche noyo o Kristo.”

English: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
Kiswahili: Je, Kristo amegawanyika? Je, Paulo ndiye alisulubishwa kwa ajili yenu? Je, mlibatizwa kwa jina la Paulo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Kristo naatananekire? Gose Paulo nere obambetwe ase engencho yaino? Gose igo mwabatisetwe koba aborokigwa ba Paulo?

English: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
Kiswahili: Nashukuru kwamba sikumbatiza mtu yeyote isipokuwa Krispo na Gayo.
Ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, ase engencho ntabatisete monto onde, ase more otatiga Krispo na Gayo,

English: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo hakuna mtu yeyote anayeweza kusema kwamba alibatizwa kwa jina langu.
Ekegusii: erinde onde tacha goteeba ng’a mwabatisetwe ase erieta riane.

English: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
Kiswahili: (Naam, niliwabatiza pia watu wa nyumbani mwa Stefana. Lakini zaidi ya hao sijui kama nilimbatiza mtu mwingine yeyote.)
Ekegusii: (Naende nkabatisa abanto ba nyomba mwa Stefana. Kobua ase abwo, tinkomanya gose nabatisete monto onde.)

English: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Kristo hakunituma ili kubatiza bali kuhubiri Injili; sio kwa maneno ya hekima ya kibinadamu, ili msalaba wa Kristo usije ukakosa nguvu yake.
Ekegusii: Naki Kristo tantomete ng’a mbatise, korende ndandie enchiri, tari ase obong’aini bw’amang’ana, erinde ogokwa kwa Yeso Kristo ase omosalaba tikourwa chinguru chiaye.

English: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ujumbe wa msalaba kwa wale wanaopotea ni upuzi, lakini kwetu sisi tunaookolewa ni nguvu ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ri’ogokwa kwa Yeso ase omosalaba noboriri ase abwo bagosira, korende ase tore intwe abatwabeire togotoorigwa nigo rire chinguru chia Nyasae.

English: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa: “Nitaiharibu hekima ya wenye hekima, na kubatilisha akili ya wenye akili.”
Ekegusii: Naki neriikire, “Ninsarie obong’aini bw’abang’aini, na okomanya kw’abamanyi ninkwange.”

English: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
Kiswahili: Yuko wapi mwenye hekima? Yuko wapi msomi? Yuko wapi mwanafalsafa wa nyakati hizi? Je, Mungu hakufanya hekima ya ulimwengu huu kuwa upumbavu?
Ekegusii: Ng’ai are omong’aini? Ng’ai are omworokia bw’amariiko? Ng’ai are oyokoamererania namang’ana ’ense eye? Inee! Nyasae takorete obong’aini bw’ense eye koba oboriri?

English: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa katika hekima ya Mungu, ulimwengu kwa hekima yake haukumjua yeye, ilimpendeza Mungu kuwaokoa wale walioamini kwa upuzi wa lile neno lililohubiriwa.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ase obong’aini bwaye Nyasae akaroberia, ng’a ense tekonyara komomanya ase enchera y’obong’aini, agancha kobatooria abamwegenete ase oboriri bw’ering’ana riria rikorandigwa.

English: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
Kiswahili: Wayahudi wanadai ishara za miujiza na Wayunani wanatafuta hekima.
Ekegusii: Abayahudi nigo bakonakoboria barore ebikone, na Abagiriki bakorigia obong’aini,

English: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi tunamhubiri Kristo aliyesulubiwa: yeye kwa Wayahudi ni kikwazo na kwa Wayunani ni upuzi.
Ekegusii: korende intwe nigo tokomorandia Kristo oyobambetwe, ase Abayahudi nekegocha, na ase abanto b’Ebisaku noboriri.

English: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa wale ambao Mungu amewaita, Wayahudi na pia Wayunani, Kristo ndiye nguvu ya Mungu na pia hekima ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende ase abwo barangeretigwe, Abayahudi na Abagiriki bonsi, Kristo nere chinguru chia Nyasae, na obong’aini bwa Nyasae.

English: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana upumbavu wa Mungu una hekima zaidi kuliko hekima ya wanadamu, nao udhaifu wa Mungu una nguvu kuliko nguvu ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera oboriri bwa Nyasae mbore nobong’aini kobua obongaini bwa Mwanyabaanto, na oboreu bwa Nyasae mbore ne chinguru kobua echia Mwanyabaanto.

English: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, kumbukeni mlivyokuwa mlipoitwa. Kwa kipimo cha kibinadamu, si wengi wenu mliokuwa na hekima. Si wengi mliokuwa na ushawishi, si wengi mliozaliwa katika jamaa zenye vyeo.
Ekegusii: Naki baminto, rengereria nabaanto b’engencho ki more aba Nyasae arangeirie; tari abange ase more bare nobong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto, tari abange bare ne chinguru, tari abange baiboretwe nobonene.

English: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu alivichagua vitu vipumbavu vya ulimwengu ili awaaibishe wenye hekima, Mungu alivichagua vitu dhaifu vya ulimwengu ili awaaibishe wenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agachora ayare amariri ase ense, erinde asookie abare nobong’aini; naende Nyasae agachora ayare amareu ase ense, erinde abasookie abare ne chinguru.

English: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,
Kiswahili: Alivichagua vitu vya chini na vinavyodharauliwa vya dunia hii, vitu ambavyo haviko, ili avibatilishe vile vilivyoko,
Ekegusii: Nyasae agachora ayare amasinini ase ense na ayachayire, nonya n’ebinto bire bosa, erinde akeyie biria bire nengencho, bibe bosa.

English: that no flesh should boast before God.
Kiswahili: ili mtu yeyote asijisifu mbele zake.
Ekegusii: Erio ase obosio bwa Nyasae onde tari ase Mwanyabaanto oretogie.

English: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
Kiswahili: Bali kwa yeye ninyi mmepata kuwa katika Kristo Yesu, aliyefanyika kwetu hekima itokayo kwa Mungu, yaani haki, na utakatifu na ukombozi.
Ekegusii: Korende nogokora kwa Nyasae, ng’a inwe imore ime ase Kristo Yeso, oyo Nyasae akorete koba obong’aini bwaito na oboronge bwaito, naende ogochenwa gwaito na okoboorigwa gwaito.

English: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
Kiswahili: Hivyo, kama ilivyoandikwa: “Yeye ajisifuye na ajisifu katika Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo buna eriikire, “Ere oyogwetogia, tiga etogie ase keria Omonene akorire.”

English: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu nilipokuja kwenu, sikuja na maneno ya ushawishi wala hekima ya hali ya juu nilipowahubiria siri ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inche, ekero nachete ase more, baminto, tinachete kobaranderia oborori bwa Nyasae ase enchera y’obuya bwe chinkwana, gose ase obong’aini.

English: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa niliamua kutokujua kitu chochote wakati nikiwa nanyi isipokuwa Yesu Kristo aliyesulubiwa.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo narengereretie ng’a timanya ing’ana rinde rionsi ase more otatiga igoro ya Yeso Kristo, kobua mono okobambwa kwaye ase omosalaba.

English: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
Kiswahili: Mimi nilikuja kwenu nikiwa dhaifu na mwenye hofu na kwa kutetemeka sana.
Ekegusii: Na inche nigo narenge amo nainwe ase oboreu na okoiroka, na okoiguswa.

English: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
Kiswahili: Kuhubiri kwangu na ujumbe wangu haukuwa kwa hekima na maneno ya ushawishi bali kwa madhihirisho ya nguvu za Roho
Ekegusii: Enkwana yane na okorandia kwane tibiarenge amang’ana ay’okoebereria obong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto, korende ase ekiorokererio ki’Omoika ne chinguru,

English: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
Kiswahili: ili imani yenu isiwe imejengwa katika hekima ya wanadamu bali katika nguvu za Mungu.
Ekegusii: erinde okwegena kwaino tikoba ase obong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto korende ase chinguru chia Nyasae.

English: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.
Kiswahili: Lakini miongoni mwa watu waliokomaa twanena hekima, wala si hekima ya ulimwengu huu au ya watawala wa dunia hii wanaobatilika.
Ekegusii: Korende obong’aini mbore togoteeba ase egati y’abaikeranu, na borobwo tibori obong’aini bw’ense eye, gose obw’abagaambi b’ense eye abagendererete gochia gosira,

English: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,
Kiswahili: Sisi tunanena hekima ya Mungu ambayo ni siri, tena iliyofichika, ambayo Mungu aliikusudia kabla ya ulimwengu kuwepo, kwa ajili ya utukufu wetu.
Ekegusii: korende nigo togokwana obong’aini bw’obobisi bwa Nyasae, obwo bwabisetwe, obwo Nyasae aroberetie korwa omochakano, erinde toegwe bobe obonene bwaito.

English: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
Kiswahili: Hakuna hata mtawala mmoja wa nyakati hizi aliyeelewa jambo hili. Kwa maana kama wangelielewa, wasingemsulubisha Bwana wa utukufu.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi b’ense eye tibabomanyete, nonya noyomo obo; naki onye mbabomanyete, anga tibaabambete Omonene bw’obonene;

English: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini ni kama ilivyoandikwa: “Hakuna jicho limepata kuona, wala sikio limepata kusikia, wala hayakuingia moyoni wowote, yale Mungu amewaandalia wale wampendao”:
Ekegusii: korende buna eriikire, “Aya eriso ritaroche, gose ogoto gotaigwete, gose aya atarengereirie ase enkoro y’omonto, ayio Nyasae aroiseretie abamwanchete.”

English: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
Kiswahili: Lakini mambo haya Mungu ametufunulia kwa Roho wake. Roho huchunguza kila kitu, hata mambo ya ndani sana ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae otoyaorokeirie ase Omoika oye, naki Omoika nigo okorigia onsi, nonya nobobisi bwa Nyasae.

English: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni nani anayejua mawazo ya mtu isipokuwa roho iliyo ndani ya huyo mtu? Vivyo hivyo hakuna mtu ajuaye mawazo ya Mungu isipokuwa Roho wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki ning’o ore ase Mwanyabaanto omanyete ebirengererio bi’omonto, otatiga omoika bw’omonto ore ime yaye? Naboigo nonde tari omanyete ebirengererio bia Nyasae otatiga Omoika o Nyasae.

English: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.
Kiswahili: Basi hatukupokea roho ya dunia bali Roho atokaye kwa Mungu, ili tuweze kuelewa kile kipawa ambacho Mungu ametupatia bure.
Ekegusii: Na intwe titwanyorete omoika bw’ense eye, korende Omoika orwete ase Nyasae, erinde tonyare komanya ebiegwa ebitwaeirwe na Nyasae.

English: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo tusemayo, si kwa maneno tuliyofundishwa kwa hekima ya wanadamu bali kwa maneno tuliyofundishwa na Roho, tukifafanua kweli za kiroho kwa maneno ya kiroho.
Ekegusii: Naro nigo tokoyakwana, tari ase amang’ana tworokererigwe ne chisemi chia Mwanyabaanto, korende aya tworokererigwe n’Omoika; igo togokwana amang’ana ’Omoika ase abare n’Omoika.

English: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
Kiswahili: Mtu ambaye hana Roho hawezi kupokea mambo yatokayo kwa Roho wa Mungu, kwa kuwa ni upuzi kwake, naye hawezi kuyaelewa kwa sababu hayo yanaeleweka tu kwa upambanuzi wa rohoni.
Ekegusii: Nabo Mwanyabaanto ore ne chingencho chia kare, takonyora ebiegwa bi’Omoika o Nyasae, naki asare ere ebi nebiriri, gose takonyara kobimanya, ekiagera nigo bikomanyekana ase chinguru chi’Omoika.

English: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.
Kiswahili: Mtu wa kiroho hubainisha mambo yote, lakini yeye mwenyewe habainishwi na mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Omonto ore n’Omoika nigo akomanya onsi, korende ere takomanyigwa na monto onde.

English: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
Kiswahili: “Kwa maana ni nani aliyefahamu mawazo ya Bwana ili apate kumfundisha?” Lakini sisi tunayo mawazo ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: “Naki ning’o omanyete ebirengererio bi’Omonene, erinde amworokererie?” Korende intwe ntore nebirengererio bia Kristo.

English: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, mimi sikuweza kusema nanyi kama watu wa kiroho, bali kama watu wa mwilini, kama watoto wachanga katika Kristo.
Ekegusii: Na inche, baminto, tinare konyara gokwana nainwe buna nabaanto bare n’Omoika, korende buna abanto b’engencho ya kare, buna abana ebing’werere ase Kristo.

English: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
Kiswahili: Naliwanywesha maziwa, wala si chakula kigumu, kwa kuwa hamkuwa tayari kwa hicho chakula. Naam, hata sasa hamko tayari.
Ekegusii: Nabasiibirie amabeere, timbaragereti endagera; ekiagera konya timoraisana; ee, nonya mbono timoraisana,

English: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?
Kiswahili: Ninyi bado ni watu wa mwilini. Kwa kuwa bado kuna wivu na magombano miongoni mwenu, je, ninyi si watu wa mwilini? Je, si mwaendelea kama watu wa kawaida?
Ekegusii: ekiagera nonya mbono nigo more abanto b’engencho y’ebibe. Naki onye more ne ribero na eriomana ase egati yaino, Inee, timori abanto b’engencho y’ebibe, naende nigo mogendererete buna banto bande bonsi?

English: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mmoja anaposema, “Mimi ni wa Paulo,” na mwingine, “Mimi ni wa Apolo,” je, ninyi si wanadamu wa kawaida?
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ekero omonto oyomo akobora, “Inche noyo o Paulo,” na oyonde, “Inche noyo bw’Apolo.” Inee, inwe timori Mwanyabaanto?

English: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?
Kiswahili: Kwani, Apolo ni nani? Naye Paulo ni nani? Ni watumishi tu ambao kupitia wao mliamini, kama vile Bwana alivyompa kila mtu huduma yake.
Ekegusii: Gaki Apolo inki aisaine? Na Paulo inki aisaine? Intwe nabakori emeremo, ababorokereirie komwegena Omonene, kera oyomo buna Omonene amoeire.

English: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
Kiswahili: Mimi nilipanda mbegu, Apolo akatia maji, lakini Mungu ndiye aliikuza.
Ekegusii: Inche ngasimeka, Apolo akabeeka amaache, korende Nyasae nere ogokinia.

English: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
Kiswahili: Hivyo mwenye kupanda na mwenye kutia maji si kitu, bali Mungu peke yake ambaye huifanya ikue.
Ekegusii: Onye nabo, oyogosimeka tai gento, nonya noyokobeeka amaache, korende Nyasae bweka oyogokinia.

English: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
Kiswahili: Apandaye mbegu ana lengo sawa na yule atiaye maji na kila mmoja atalipwa kulingana na kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Naboigo oyogosimeka, na oyokobeeka amaache nigo bareng’anetie; na kera omonto nanyore eng’eria yaye koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere.

English: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa sisi tu watendakazi pamoja na Mungu. Ninyi ni shamba la Mungu, jengo la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe nabakori emeremo amo na Nyasae; inwe nomogondo o Nyasae, na oboagacho bwa Nyasae.

English: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.
Kiswahili: Kwa neema Mungu aliyonipa, niliweka msingi kama mjenzi stadi na mtu mwingine anajenga juu yake. Lakini kila mmoja inampasa awe mwangalifu jinsi anavyojenga.
Ekegusii: Koreng’ana nobuya bwa Nyasae naetwe inche, buna omonene bw’abaagachi, oyore ne chisemi, nabekire oboroso, na omonto onde nkoagacha are igoro yaye. Korende kera omonto tiga arigererie buna akoagacha igoro yaye.

English: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kuweka msingi mwingine wowote isipokuwa ule uliokwisha kuwekwa, ambao ni Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki boroso bonde tibori omonto aranyare kobeeka, otatiga boria bwaikire kobekwa, nabwo Yeso Kristo.

English: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akijenga juu ya msingi huu kwa kutumia dhahabu, fedha, vito vya thamani, miti, majani au nyasi,
Ekegusii: Korende omonto karaagache igoro ase oboroso obwo netaabu, gose efeta, gose amagena e rigori rinene, gose emete, gose obonyansi, gose chinsiaga,

English: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.
Kiswahili: kazi yake itaonekana ilivyo, kwa kuwa Siku ile itaidhihirisha. Itadhihirishwa kwa moto, nao moto utapima ubora wa kazi ya kila mtu.
Ekegusii: emeremo ya kera omonto ing’a eorokigwe maiso marore. Naki Rituko erio inariyeorokie, ekiagera narioroke nomorero; na omorero oyio noteeme emeremo ya kera omonto ng’a naki ere.

English: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
Kiswahili: Kama kile alichojenga kitabaki, atapokea thawabu yake.
Ekegusii: Emeremo y’omonto aagachete igoro ase oboroso kerabue, omonto oyio nanyore eng’eria.

English: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
Kiswahili: Kama kazi kitateketea, atapata hasara, ila yeye mwenyewe ataokolewa, lakini tu kama mtu aliyenusurika kwenye moto.
Ekegusii: Emeremo y’omonto kerayie, takonyora eng’eria, korende ere omonyene natoorigwe, korende buna oyo ogotaborigwa korwa ase omorero.

English: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
Kiswahili: Je, hamjui ya kwamba ninyi wenyewe ni hekalu la Mungu na kwamba Roho wa Mungu anakaa ndani yenu?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a inwe ne Hekalu ya Nyasae, na Omoika o Nyasae nigo amenyete ime yaino?

English: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akiliharibu hekalu la Mungu, Mungu atamwangamiza; kwa maana hekalu la Mungu ni takatifu, na ninyi ndiyo hilo hekalu.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto ogosaria Hekalu ya Nyasae, Nyasae nasarie omonto oyio; naki Hekalu ya Nyasae nenchenu, nero ninwe.

English: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.
Kiswahili: Msijidanganye. Kama mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu akidhani kuwa ana hekima kwa viwango vya dunia hii, inampasa awe mjinga ili apate kuwa na hekima.
Ekegusii: Omonto tabaisa kweng’aina ere omonyene. Onye omonto ase egati yaino bwerorire ng’a nomonyasemi are ase ense eye, tiga ekore omoriri, erinde anyare koba omonyasemi.

English: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hekima ya ulimwengu huu ni upuzi mbele za Mungu. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Mungu huwanasa wenye hekima katika hila yao,”
Ekegusii: Naki obong’aini bw’ense eye noboriri ase Nyasae, ekiagera neriikire, “Nyasae nigo akobwata abare nobong’aini ase obong’ainereria bwabo”,

English: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”
Kiswahili: tena, “Bwana anajua kwamba mawazo ya wenye hekima ni ubatili.”
Ekegusii: naende, “Omonene nigo amanyete okorengereria kw’abare nobong’aini ng’a nokwa bosa.”

English: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, mtu asijivune kuhusu wanadamu! Vitu vyote ni vyenu,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto tetogia ase Mwanyabaanto. Naki bionsi nebiaino;

English: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,
Kiswahili: ikiwa ni Paulo au Apolo au Kefa au dunia au uzima au mauti, au wakati uliopo au wakati ujao, haya yote ni yenu
Ekegusii: onye Paulo, gose Apolo, gose Kefa, gose ense, gose obogima, gose amakweri, gose biria bire bono, gose ebio birache koba; bionsi nebiaino;

English: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
Kiswahili: na ninyi ni wa Kristo, naye Kristo ni wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: na inwe naba Kristo, na Kristo noyo o Nyasae.

English: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.
Kiswahili: Basi, watu na watuhesabu sisi kuwa tu watumishi wa Kristo na mawakili wa siri za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omonto natobare iga, ng’a nabasomba ba Kristo tore, na abarendi b’obobisi bwa Nyasae.

English: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
Kiswahili: Tena, litakiwalo ni mawakili waonekane kuwa waaminifu.
Ekegusii: Agwo naende ayarigirie ase abarendi naro aya: banyorekane ng’a nabegenwa bare.

English: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwangu mimi ni jambo dogo sana kwamba nihukumiwe na ninyi au na mahakama yoyote ya kibinadamu. Naam, hata mimi mwenyewe sijihukumu.
Ekegusii: Asende inche, tai gento ngambigwe nainwe, gose na kegambero kende gionsi kia Mwanyabaanto. Nonya ninche omonyene tinkwegambia.

English: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
Kiswahili: Dhamiri yangu ni safi, lakini hilo halinihesabii kuwa asiye na hatia. Bwana ndiye anihukumuye.
Ekegusii: Naki timanyeti engencho y’ogwesoera inche omonyene, korende timbareiri oboronge ase engencho y’ayio. Omonene nere orangambie.

English: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo msihukumu jambo lolote kabla ya wakati wake. Ngojeni mpaka Bwana atakapokuja. Yeye atayaleta nuruni mambo yale yaliyofichwa gizani, na kuweka wazi nia za mioyo ya wanadamu. Wakati huo kila mmoja atapokea sifa anayostahili kutoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio timogamba ing’ana rinde rionsi engaki etaraika, ekero Omonene ataracha; nere orabaorokerie ayabisegete ase omosunte, na koorokia amang’ana are ase chinkoro ime. Erio nario kera omonto aranyore ogotogigwa kwaye korwa ase Nyasae.
