English: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.
Kiswahili: Basi ndugu zangu, mambo haya nimeyafanya kwangu binafsi na Apolo kwa faida yenu, ili mweze kujifunza kutoka kwetu maana ya ule usemi usemao, “Msivuke zaidi ya yale yaliyoandikwa.” Hivyo hamtajivunia mtu fulani na kumdharau mwingine.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya, baminto, nayakwanire igoro yane na igoro y’Apolo ase engencho yaino, erinde ase amang’ana aito monyare kweorokereria timotamboka ase amang’ana ariikire. Omonto taenena ase oyomo mamincha y’oria onde.

English: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni nani aliyewafanya kuwa tofauti na wengine? Ni nini mlicho nacho ambacho hamkupokea? Nanyi kama mlipokea, kwa nini mnajivuna kama vile hamkupokea?
Ekegusii: Naki ning’o ogwatananire aye noyonde? Inki ore nakio otanyoreti buna ekeegwa? Onye gwakenyorire buna ekeegwa, inki rende ogwetogeria buna tikiarenge ekeegwa?

English: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!
Kiswahili: Sasa tayari mnayo yale yote mnayohitaji! Tayari mmekwisha kuwa matajiri! Mmekuwa wafalme, tena bila sisi! Laiti mngekuwa wafalme kweli ili na sisi tupate kuwa wafalme pamoja nanyi!
Ekegusii: Mwaikire koigota! Mwaikire konyora obotenenku! Mwanyorire oborwoti intwe totaiyo! Anga mbuya onye mwagambete, erinde naintwe togambe amo nainwe!

English: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninaona kwamba Mungu ametuweka sisi mitume katika nafasi ya mwisho kabisa, kama watu waliohukumiwa kufa kwenye uwanja wa tamasha, kwa sababu tumefanywa kuwa maonyesho kwa ulimwengu wote, kwa malaika na kwa wanadamu pia.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo ndoche ng’a Nyasae otobekire intwe abatomwa tobe ab’omoerio ase bonsi, buna abanto bagambetigwe ng’a baitwe, ekiagera twabeire ekiorokererio ki’ogosekererwa ase ense, na ase abamalaika, na ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya Kristo sisi ni wajinga, lakini ninyi mna hekima sana ndani ya Kristo. Sisi tu dhaifu, lakini ninyi mna nguvu. Tunadharauliwa, lakini ninyi mnaheshimiwa.
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore abariri ase engencho ya Kristo, korende inwe nigo more abang’aini ase Kristo. Intwe nigo tore abareu, korende inwe nigo more ne chinguru. Inwe nigo mosikire, korende intwe tochayire.

English: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
Kiswahili: Mpaka saa hii tuna njaa na kiu, tu uchi, tumepigwa na hatuna makao.
Ekegusii: Nonya ngoika egeka eke kia bono ntore nenchara na erang’o, naende nigo tore gesobono; iga togoakwa chinkundi titori nobomenyo,

English: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
Kiswahili: Tunafanya kazi kwa bidii kwa mikono yetu wenyewe. Tunapolaaniwa, tunabariki, tunapoteswa, tunastahimili,
Ekegusii: naende nigo togochandeka gatogokora emeremo namaboko aito abanyene. Ekero tokoramwa, twasesenia; ekero togochandwa, twaremereria;

English: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
Kiswahili: tunaposingiziwa, tunajibu kwa upole. Mpaka sasa tumekuwa kama takataka ya dunia na uchafu wa ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: ekero togokwanwa bobe, intwe twaebereria. Twakorirwe buna eogoto y’ense na eubi y’ebinto bionsi goika bono.

English: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
Kiswahili: Siwaandikii mambo haya ili kuwaaibisha, bali ili kuwaonya, kama wanangu wapendwa.
Ekegusii: Tinyarigeti aya ase okobasookia, korende nkobakuurera buna abana nyanchete.

English: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.
Kiswahili: Hata kama mnao walimu 10,000 katika Kristo, lakini hamna baba wengi. Mimi nilikuwa baba yenu katika Kristo Yesu kwa kuwaletea Injili.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya more nabateebereria chilifu ikomi ase Kristo, timori nabaiso abange. Naki ase Kristo Yeso nabeire buna iso, obaiboire ase enchiri.

English: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.
Kiswahili: Basi nawasihi igeni mfano wangu.
Ekegusii: Gaki nabasoroire, mobe abegi baane.

English: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii ninamtuma Timotheo, mwanangu mpendwa na mwaminifu katika Bwana. Yeye atawakumbusha kuhusu njia za maisha yangu katika Kristo Yesu, ambayo yanakubaliana na mafundisho yangu ninayofundisha katika kila kanisa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio natomire Timotheo ase more, oyore omwana one omwanchwa, na omwegenwa ase Omonene. Nere orabainyorie buna chingencho chiane chire ase Kristo, buna nkoborokereria kera aase ase kera ekanisa,

English: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
Kiswahili: Baadhi yenu mmekuwa na jeuri mkidhani kuwa sitafika kwenu.
Ekegusii: Abande ase more baenenire ekiagera bakagire ng’a tindi gocha ase more.

English: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama Bwana akipenda, nitafika kwenu mapema, nami nitapenda kujua, si tu kile wanachosema hawa watu jeuri, bali pia kujua nguvu yao.
Ekegusii: Korende ninchiche ase more bwango, Omonene karanche, na inche nimanye chinguru chiabo abwo bakoenena, gose tari ogokwana kwabo.

English: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Ufalme wa Mungu si maneno matupu tu bali ni nguvu.
Ekegusii: Naki oborwoti bwa Nyasae tibori ase ogokwana, korende ase chinguru.

English: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
Kiswahili: Ninyi amueni. Je, nije kwenu na fimbo, au nije kwa upendo na kwa roho ya upole?
Ekegusii: Naki morigetie? Inchiche ase more nenyimbo gose nobwanchani ase omoika bw’obwororo?

English: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.
Kiswahili: Yamkini habari imeenea ya kuwa miongoni mwenu kuna uzinzi ambao haujatokea hata miongoni mwa watu wasiomjua Mungu: Kwamba mtu anaishi na mke wa baba yake.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana akwanirwe kera aase ng’a obotomani mbore ase egati yaino, naende obotomani buna obwo tibwana kororekana nonya nase abanto b’Ebisaku, ng’a oyomo oino namenyaine na moga ise,

English: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mwajivuna! Je, haiwapasi kuhuzunika na kumtenga na ushirika wenu mtu huyo aliyefanya mambo hayo?
Ekegusii: Inwe mwaenenire! Inee! Timogwenereti goichana? Tiga oyo okorire ayio arusigwe korwa ase more.

English: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.
Kiswahili: Hata kama siko pamoja nanyi katika mwili, niko nanyi katika roho. Nami nimekwisha kumhukumu mtu huyo aliyetenda jambo hili, kama vile ningekuwepo.
Ekegusii: Korende nonya tindi agwo ase omobere, nao inde agwo ase omoika. Naikire kogambia ere oyokorire ring’ana erio, buna nao narenge.

English: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: Mnapokutana katika Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu nami nikiwepo pamoja nanyi katika roho na uweza wa Bwana Yesu ukiwepo,
Ekegusii: Ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso, inwe ekero morasangererekane, na omoika one nao ore amo nokobua kw’Omonene oito Yeso,

English: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
Kiswahili: mkabidhini mtu huyu kwa Shetani, ili mwili wake uharibiwe, ili roho yake iokolewe katika siku ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: mogwenerete koa Saitani omonto oyio, omobere oye osarigwe, erinde omoika oye oche gotoorigwa ase rituko ri’Omonene Yeso.

English: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
Kiswahili: Majivuno yenu si mazuri. Je, hamjui ya kwamba chachu kidogo huchachusha donge zima la unga?
Ekegusii: Ogwetogia kwaino tikori okuya. Timomanyeti ng’a ememera emeke nigo ekobotia ribomba rigima?

English: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.
Kiswahili: Ondoeni chachu ya kale ili mpate kuwa donge jipya lisilotiwa chachu, kama vile mlivyo. Kwa maana Kristo, Mwana-Kondoo wetu wa Pasaka amekwisha tolewa kuwa dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Rusia kegima ememera eria ya kare, erinde mobe ribomba riyia, buna more motabekiri memera. Naki Emanwa yaito y’Eng’ondi y’Epasaka yaikire koruegwa ekeng’wanso, nere Kristo.

English: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, tusiiadhimishe sikukuu hii, kwa chachu ya zamani, chachu ya nia mbaya na uovu, bali kwa mkate usiotiwa chachu, ndio weupe wa moyo na kweli.
Ekegusii: Gaki tobe nomoyega, tari ase ememera ya kare, gose ase ememera y’ogosaria na ey’obobe, korende ase omogati otabekiri memera, nabwo oborabu bw’omoyo na ekeene.

English: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;
Kiswahili: Niliwaandikia katika waraka wangu kuwa msishirikiane na wazinzi.
Ekegusii: Nabariikerete ase riruube riane, ng’a timosang’anana nabatomani.

English: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.
Kiswahili: Sina maana kwamba msishirikiane na wazinzi wa ulimwengu huu, au wenye tamaa mbaya, wanyangʼanyi au waabudu sanamu. Kwa kufanya hivyo ingewalazimu mtoke ulimwenguni humu.
Ekegusii: Tintebeti ng’a timosang’anana nabatomani b’ense eye, gose abegimeria, gose abauri, gose abagosaba emegwekano y’ogosasimwa; onye nabo anga mwarua ase ense.

English: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa nawaandikia kwamba msishirikiane na mtu yeyote anayejiita ndugu, hali akiwa ni mzinzi, au mwenye tamaa mbaya, mwabudu sanamu au msingiziaji, mlevi au mdhalimu. Mtu kama huyo hata msile naye.
Ekegusii: Korende bono nabarikeire ng’a timosang’anana nomonto okorokwa oyomino, karabe omotomani, gose oyokwegimeria, gose oyogosaba emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, gose omorami, gose oyogotinda, gose omouri, omonto onga buna oyio, timwancha nonya nkoria nere.

English: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?
Kiswahili: Yanihusu nini kuwahukumu wale watu walio nje ya kanisa? Je, si mnapaswa kuwahukumu hao walio ndani?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ninche ngwenerete kogambia abare isiko? Na inwe timogwenereti kogambia abare ekanisa ime?

English: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”
Kiswahili: Mungu atawahukumu hao walio nje. “Ninyi mwondoeni huyo mtu mwovu miongoni mwenu.”
Ekegusii: Korende abwo bare isiko, Nyasae nabagaambie, “Seria omonto oyio omobe arue ase more.”

English: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote wa kwenu ana ugomvi na mwenzake, anathubutuje kuupeleka kwa wasiomcha Mungu ili kuamuliwa badala ya kuupeleka kwa watakatifu?
Ekegusii: Omonto onde oino karabe ne ring’ana ase oyomwabo, Inee, nare noboremu amosoere ase abwo batari abaronge? Inki rende atari komosoera ase obosio bw’abachenu?

English: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
Kiswahili: Je, hamjui kwamba watakatifu watauhukumu ulimwengu? Nanyi kama mtauhukumu ulimwengu, je, hamwezi kuamua mambo madogo madogo?
Ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a abachenu inabagaambie ense? Na onye ense egocha kogambigwa nainwe, Inee, timoisaini kogamba ebiina ebire ebike?

English: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
Kiswahili: Hamjui kwamba tutawahukumu malaika? Je, si zaidi mambo ya maisha haya?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a ntogambie abamalaika? Tari kobua mono amang’ana ’obogima obo?

English: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kama kuna ugomvi miongoni mwenu kuhusu mambo kama haya, chagueni kuwa waamuzi, watu ambao wanaonekana hata sio wa heshima katika kanisa.
Ekegusii: Gaki komorabe mogosoerana ase amang’ana buna ayio, naki rende mokoyarenta ase abwo batabariri buna ngento ase ekanisa?

English: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?
Kiswahili: Nasema hivi ili mwone aibu. Je, inawezekana kuwa miongoni mwenu hakuna mtu mwenye hekima ya kutosha kuamua ugomvi kati ya waaminio?
Ekegusii: Nateebire aya ase okobasookia. Inee! Onde tari ase egati yaino ore ne chisemi chiisaine oranyare konacha amang’ana are ase egati y’abamwabo?

English: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!
Kiswahili: Badala yake ndugu mmoja anampeleka mwenzake mahakamani, tena mbele ya watu wasioamini!
Ekegusii: Korende oyomwabo nigo agosoera oyomwabo, na ayio nase obosio bw’abwo bategeneti.

English: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
Kiswahili: Huko kuwa na mashtaka miongoni mwenu ina maana kwamba tayari ni kushindwa kabisa. Kwa nini msikubali kutendewa mabaya? Kwa nini msikubali kunyangʼanywa?
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya ng’a ngosoerana more inwe ase inwe nigo are ase okobugwa kwaino. Inki motanchereti gokorerwa bobe? Inki motanchereti kourwa ebi mobwate?

English: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, ninyi wenyewe mwadanganya na kutenda mabaya, tena mwawatendea ndugu zenu.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe abanyene mwakoreire abanto bobe, na kobaura ebi babwate, ee nonya nase abamino.

English: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,
Kiswahili: Je, hamjui kwamba wasio haki hawataurithi Ufalme wa Mungu? Msidanganyike: Waasherati, wala waabudu sanamu, wala wazinzi, wala wahanithi, wala walawiti,
Ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a abatari noboronge tibakoira omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae? Timong’aineka; abanyaka tibakoira omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, nonya nabasasimi emegwekano, gose abatomani, gose abakwerua ase okogania kw’omobere, gose abasacha abagwesaria nabasaacha,

English: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
Kiswahili: wala wezi, wala wenye tamaa mbaya, wala walevi, wala wanaodhihaki, wala wanyangʼanyi hawataurithi Ufalme wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: gose abaibi, gose abegimeria, gose abagotinda, gose abarami, gose abauri.

English: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.
Kiswahili: Baadhi yenu mlikuwa kama hao. Lakini mlioshwa, mlitakaswa, mlihesabiwa haki kwa jina la Bwana Yesu Kristo na katika Roho wa Mungu wetu.
Ekegusii: Abande ase more nigo mwarenge abanto buna aba, korende mogasibigwa na mogachenwa, mwanyorire oboronge ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso Kristo, na ase Omoika o Nyasae oito.

English: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
Kiswahili: “Vitu vyote ni halali kwangu”: lakini si vitu vyote vyenye faida. “Vitu vyote ni halali kwangu”: lakini sitatawaliwa na kitu chochote.
Ekegusii: “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi birankonye. “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tingwancha koba omosomba o gento kende gionsi.

English: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
Kiswahili: “Chakula ni cha tumbo, na tumbo ni la chakula”: lakini Mungu ataviangamiza vyote viwili. Mwili haukuumbwa kwa ajili ya zinaa bali kwa ajili ya Bwana na Bwana kwa ajili ya mwili.
Ekegusii: “Endagera ney’enda na enda ney’endagera”, korende Nyasae nasarie bionsi bibere, enda na endagera. Omobere tori ase obotomani, korende nase Omonene, n’Omonene ase omobere.

English: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.
Kiswahili: Naye Mungu aliyemfufua Bwana kutoka kwa wafu atatufufua sisi pia kwa uweza wake.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nabogetie Omonene, naintwe natobokie ase okobua kwaye.

English: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!
Kiswahili: Je, hamjui kwamba miili yenu ni viungo vya Kristo mwenyewe? Je, nichukue viungo vya mwili wa Kristo na kuviunganisha na mwili wa kahaba? La hasha!
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a emebere yaino nebiimo bia Kristo? Inee! Nimbogorie ebiimo bia Kristo na kobikora bibe ebiimo bi’omokuungu omotayayi? Yaya, nonya ng’ake!

English: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”
Kiswahili: Hamjui kwamba aliyeungwa na kahaba anakuwa mwili mmoja naye? Kwa kuwa imenenwa, “Hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.”
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a ere oyobwatanigwe nomokuungu omotayayi obeire omobere oyomo nere? Naki buna eriikire, “Baria babere nababe omobere oyomo.”

English: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu aliyeungwa na Bwana anakuwa roho moja naye.
Ekegusii: Korende ere oyobwatanigwe n’Omonene igo obeire omoika oyomo nere.

English: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
Kiswahili: Ikimbieni zinaa. Dhambi zingine zote atendazo mtu ziko nje ya mwili wake, lakini yeye aziniye hutenda dhambi ndani ya mwili wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Tama obotomani! Kera ebibe binde bigokorwa na Mwanyabaanto nigo bire isiko y’omobere; korende ere oyogokora obotomani igo okorire ebibe ase omobere oye omonyene.

English: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
Kiswahili: Je, hamjui ya kwamba miili yenu ni hekalu la Roho Mtakatifu akaaye ndani yenu, ambaye mmepewa na Mungu? Ninyi si mali yenu wenyewe,
Ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a emebere yaino ne Hekalu y’Omoika Omochenu ore ime yaino, oyo mwaeirwe na Nyasae? Na inwe timori abaino abanyene,

English: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
Kiswahili: kwa maana mmenunuliwa kwa gharama. Kwa hiyo mtukuzeni Mungu katika miili yenu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera mwagoretwe ase rigori rinene. Ase ayio, motogie Nyasae ase emebere yaino.

English: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
Kiswahili: Basi kuhusu mambo yale mliyoyaandika: Ni vyema mwanaume asimguse mwanamke.
Ekegusii: Gaki ase amang’ana aya mwandikerete, mbuya omosacha takuna omokungu.

English: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
Kiswahili: Lakini ili kuepuka zinaa, kila mwanaume na awe na mke wake mwenyewe na kila mwanamke awe na mume wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’amateemwa ay’ogokora obotomani kera omosacha abe na mokaye omonyene, na kera omokungu abe nomosaacha oye omonyene.

English: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.
Kiswahili: Mume atimize wajibu wake wa ndoa kwa mkewe, naye vivyo hivyo mke kwa mumewe.
Ekegusii: Omosacha ae omokungu oye ekemogwenerete; naboigo nomokuungu ae omosacha oye ekemogwenerete.

English: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke hana mamlaka juu ya mwili wake bali mumewe, wala mume hana mamlaka juu ya mwili wake bali mkewe.
Ekegusii: Omokungu tari nokobua igoro ase omobere oye, korende nomosaacha oye; naboigo nomosaacha tari nokobua igoro ase omobere oye, korende nomokuungu oye.

English: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
Kiswahili: Msinyimane, isipokuwa mmekubaliana kufanya hivyo kwa muda fulani ili mweze kujitoa kwa maombi, kisha mrudiane tena ili Shetani asije akapata nafasi ya kuwajaribu kwa sababu ya kutokuwa na kiasi.
Ekegusii: Timorinana otatiga mwancheranire ase egeka egeke, erinde monyare kwerua ase ogosaba; naende mobe amo, Saitani tacha kobateema ekiagera motanyare gwetanga.

English: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.
Kiswahili: Nasema haya kama ushauri na si amri.
Ekegusii: Aya nigo nkobateebia buna ndoche; tindi korua ogochika.

English: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
Kiswahili: Laiti watu wangekuwa kama mimi nilivyo. Lakini kila mtu amepewa kipawa chake kutoka kwa Mungu, mmoja ana kipawa cha namna hii na mwingine ana cha namna ile.
Ekegusii: Ayanyanchete naro aya, ng’a abanto bonsi babe buna inche omonyene inde. Korende kera omonto nare nekeegwa kiaye omonyene gekorwa ase Nyasae, oyomo iga, na oyonde iga.

English: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.
Kiswahili: Kwa wale wasiooa na kwa wajane, nasema hivi, ingekuwa vizuri wasioe.
Ekegusii: Bono nkobateebia nde baria bataranyuoma, na ababoraka, mbuya babe buna inche inde.

English: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hawawezi kujizuia, basi waoe na kuolewa, kwa maana ni afadhali kuoa au kuolewa kuliko kuwaka tamaa.
Ekegusii: Korende onye tibakonyara gwetanga, tiga banyuome, ekiagera mbuya konyuoma kobua gosambwa nokogania.

English: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
Kiswahili: Kwa wale waliooana nawapa amri (si mimi ila ni Bwana): Mke asitengane na mumewe.
Ekegusii: Korende baria baikire konyuomana nabachiikire, gose tari inche, korende Omonene, ng’a omokungu tatiga omosacha oye,

English: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.
Kiswahili: Lakini akitengana, ni lazima akae bila kuolewa, ama sivyo apatane tena na mumewe. Wala mume asimpe mkewe talaka.
Ekegusii: (korende, karabe otiganire nere, atige tanyuomwa gose abwatane nomosaacha oye naende), na omosacha tatiga mokaye.

English: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa wengine nasema (si Bwana ila ni mimi): Kama ndugu ana mke asiyeamini, naye huyo mke anakubali kuishi pamoja naye, basi asimwache.
Ekegusii: Abwo bande nkobateebia inche, gose tari Omonene, ng’a onye onde ominto ore nomokuungu otegeneti na omokungu oyio bwanchire komenya nere, tamotiga.

English: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
Kiswahili: Naye mwanamke aaminiye kama ameolewa na mwanaume asiyeamini na huyo mume anakubali kuishi naye, basi huyo mwanamke asimwache.
Ekegusii: Na omokungu ore nomosaacha otegeneti, na omosacha oyo bwanchire komenya nere, tamotiga.

English: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana huyo mume asiyeamini anatakaswa kupitia mkewe, naye mke asiyeamini anatakaswa kupitia mumewe anayeamini. Kama isingalikuwa hivyo watoto wenu wangalikuwa si safi, lakini ilivyo sasa wao ni watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naki omosacha oria otegeneti ochenirwe ase engencho ya mokaye, na omokungu oria otegeneti ochenirwe ase engencho y’omosaacha oye. Onye taibo, abana baino anga tibaaba abachenu; korende buna ere bono, babeire abachenu.

English: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama yule asiyeamini akijitenga, basi afanye hivyo. Katika hali kama hiyo mwanamke au mwanaume aaminiye hafungwi, kwa sababu Mungu ametuita tuishi kwa amani.
Ekegusii: Korende oria otegeneti karaganie gotigana, tiga atigane. Oyominto omosacha gose oyominto omokungu tasibiri ase amang’ana buna ayio, korende Nyasae obarangeirie ase omorembe.

English: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
Kiswahili: Wewe mke, unajuaje kama utamwokoa mumeo? Au wewe mume unajuaje kama utamwokoa mkeo?
Ekegusii: Aye omokungu, ng’ai oramanyere gose notoorie omosacha oo? Gose aye omosacha, ng’ai oramanyere gose notoorie omokungu oo?

English: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila mtu na aishi maisha aliyopangiwa na Bwana, yale Mungu aliyomwitia. Hii ni sheria ninayoiweka kwa makanisa yote.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto agenderere ase obogima obw’Omonene amogabeire na ase obwo Nyasae amorangereirie. Naboigo nachigete ase chikanisa chionsi.

English: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
Kiswahili: Je, mtu alikuwa tayari ametahiriwa alipoitwa? Asijifanye asiyetahiriwa. Je, mtu alikuwa hajatahiriwa alipoitwa? Asitahiriwe.
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orangerigwe na Nyasae ekero aikire kwaroka, tekora buna tarogeti, na monto onde bwensi orangerigwe otarogeti, taroka.

English: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.
Kiswahili: Kutahiriwa si kitu, na kutokutahiriwa si kitu. Lakini kuzitii amri za Mungu ndilo jambo muhimu.
Ekegusii: Okwaroka tai gento, na ogotaroka tai gento, korende nokobwata amachiiko a Nyasae.

English: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.
Kiswahili: Basi kila mmoja wenu na abaki katika hali aliyoitwa nayo.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto tiga abe buna arenge ekero arangeretigwe.

English: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
Kiswahili: Je, wewe ulipoitwa ulikuwa mtumwa? Jambo hilo lisikusumbue. Ingawaje unaweza kupata uhuru, tumia nafasi uliyo nayo sasa kuliko wakati mwingine wowote.
Ekegusii: Inee! Igo kwarangeretigwe kore omosomba? Torora ng’a mbobe; korende koranyare gosiborwa, mbuya obe bo.

English: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeyote aliyeitwa katika Bwana akiwa mtumwa yeye ni mtu huru kwa Bwana, kama vile yeyote aliyekuwa huru alipoitwa yeye ni mtumwa wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki oyorangeretigwe ase Omonene kare omosomba, nomosibore ase Omonene. Naboigo noyorangeretigwe osiboire, nomosomba o Kristo.

English: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
Kiswahili: Mlinunuliwa kwa gharama; msiwe watumwa wa wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Mokagorwa ase rigori, timoba abasomba b’abaanto.

English: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, kama kila mtu alivyoitwa, akae katika wito wake alioitiwa na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto, baminto, buna arenge ekero arangeretigwe, tiga aikaranse boigo ase Nyasae.

English: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
Kiswahili: Basi, kuhusu wale walio bikira, mimi sina amri kutoka kwa Bwana, lakini mimi natoa shauri kama mtu ambaye ni mwaminifu kwa rehema za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ’abaiseke abekungi, tindi nogochika korwa ase Omonene, korende nabateebirie buna ndoche inche, buna oyonyorire amaabera korwa ase Omonene koba omwegenwa.

English: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya shida iliyoko kwa sasa, naona ni vyema mkibaki kama mlivyo.
Ekegusii: Narorire ng’a ring’ana eri nerigiya ase engencho y’emechando eye tore nero, ng’a mbuya omonto abe buna are.

English: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.
Kiswahili: Je, umeolewa? Basi usitake talaka. Je, hujaoa? Usitafute mke.
Ekegusii: Inee! Gwasibirwe ase omokungu? Torigia gosiborwa. Nosiboire? Torigia omokungu.

English: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama ukioa, hujatenda dhambi; na kama bikira akiolewa, hajatenda dhambi. Lakini wale wanaooa watakabiliana na matatizo mengi katika maisha haya, nami nataka kuwazuilia hayo.
Ekegusii: Korende koranyuome, tari ebibe gwakora; na omoiseke omwekungi karanyuomwe, tari ebibe akora. Korende abanto abwo nababe nemechando y’ense eye, na inche ninyanchete ng’a timosoa ase emechando eyio.

English: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu zangu, nina maana kwamba muda uliobaki ni mfupi. Tangu sasa wale waliooa waishi kama wasio na wake;
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, nigo ngoteeba iga: Ekero getigarete negeke; gaki korwa bono baria bare nabakungu, tiga babe buna tibaabwati;

English: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;
Kiswahili: nao wanaoomboleza, kama ambao hawaombolezi; wenye furaha kama wasiokuwa nayo; wale wanaonunua, kama vile vitu walivyonunua si mali yao;
Ekegusii: na baria bakorera babe buna tibari korera; na baria bagogete babe buna tibagogeti: na baria bakogora babe buna tibari na gento;

English: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
Kiswahili: nao wale wanaoshughulika na vitu vya dunia hii, kama ambao hawahusiki navyo. Kwa maana dunia hii kama tunavyoiona sasa inapita.
Ekegusii: na baria bagokorera ense eye babe buna tibari koyekorera, ekiagera ense buna ere bono ngoeta ere.

English: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
Kiswahili: Ningetaka msiwe na masumbufu. Mwanaume ambaye hajaoa anajishughulisha na mambo ya Bwana, jinsi ya kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende nindigetie ng’a timoba nogwechanda. Oyotaranyuoma nigo arengereretie amang’ana ’Omonene, buna aragwenere Omonene:

English: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwanaume aliyeoa anajishughulisha na mambo ya dunia, jinsi ya kumfurahisha mkewe,
Ekegusii: korende oyonyuomire nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’ense eye, buna aragwenere mokaye;

English: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
Kiswahili: na mawazo yake yamegawanyika. Mwanamke asiyeolewa hujishughulisha na mambo ya Bwana: lengo lake ni awe mtakatifu kimwili na kiroho. Lakini yule aliyeolewa hujishughulisha na mambo ya dunia, jinsi atakavyoweza kumfurahisha mumewe.
Ekegusii: igo obeire nogwatananekana. Omoiseke omwekungi nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’Omonene, buna aranyare koba omochenu ase omobere na ase omoika, korende oyonyuomirwe nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’ense, buna aragwenere omosacha oye.

English: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.
Kiswahili: Ninasema haya kwa faida yenu wenyewe, sio ili kuwawekea vizuizi bali mpate kuishi kwa jinsi ilivyo vyema bila kuvutwa pengine katika kujitoa kwenu kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nateebire aya ase okobakonya; tari ng’a nkobabeekera nde egetango, korende ase engencho y’ayio abagwenerete, erinde monyare gokorera Omonene motang’usiri namang’ana ande.

English: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote anadhani kwamba hamtendei ilivyo sawa mwanamwali ambaye amemposa, naye akiwa umri wake unazidi kuendelea na mtu huyo anajisikia kwamba inampasa kuoa, afanye kama atakavyo. Yeye hatendi dhambi. Yawapasa waoane.
Ekegusii: Korende monto onde bwensi kararore ng’a takorereti omoiseke oye omwekungi ayamogwenerete, na onye omoiseke oyio oeteire obuya bw’obosae bwaye, onye negwenerete, tiga omonto oyio akore buna arigetie; tari ebibe akora, amotige anyuomwe.

English: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwanaume ambaye ameamua moyoni mwake kutooa bila kulazimishwa na mtu yeyote, bali anaweza kuzitawala tamaa zake kutomwoa huyo mwanamwali, basi anafanya ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Korende oyotenenire noboremu ase enkoro yaye, na tari nokorigia, korende anyare kogambera okogania kwaye, naende orengereirie enkoro yaye ime amotige buna omoiseke oye omwekungi, nakore buya.

English: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, mwanaume amwoaye mwanamwali afanya vyema, lakini yeye asiyemwoa afanya vyema zaidi.
Ekegusii: Gaki oyoranyuome omoiseke omwekungi nakore buya; na oyotamonyuome okorire buya kobua.

English: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke aliyeolewa amefungwa na sheria maadamu mumewe yu hai. Lakini mumewe akifa, basi mwanamke huyo yuko huru kuolewa na mume mwingine ampendaye, lakini lazima awe katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omokungu nigo asibire ase omosacha oye ekero omosacha oye are moyo, korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe; nanyare konyuomwa na monto onde bwensi oyo aranche, korende nase Omonene oka.

English: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa maoni yangu, angekuwa na furaha zaidi akibaki alivyo. Nami nadhani pia nina Roho wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende anga mbuya kobua karabe buna are. Nigo ndoche inche; na inche narengereirie ng’a ninde n’Omoika o Nyasae.

English: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
Kiswahili: Sasa kuhusu chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu, tunajua kwamba “sisi sote tuna ujuzi.” Lakini ujuzi hujivuna, bali upendo hujenga.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ’ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng’a “intwe twensi ntore ne chisemi.” “Chisemi” nigo chikorenta oboenenu, korende obwanchani nigo bokoagacha.

English: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote anayedhani kwamba anajua kitu, bado hajui kama impasavyo kujua.
Ekegusii: Omonto karekage ng’a namanyete ring’ana rinde rionsi, oyio taramanya nonya mbono buna emogwenerete amanye.

English: But anyone who loves God is known by him.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu ampendaye Mungu, hujulikana naye Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende omonto kamwanchete Nyasae, oyio omanyirwe nere.

English: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, kuhusu kula chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu: Tunajua kwamba “Sanamu si kitu chochote kabisa duniani,” na kwamba “Kuna Mungu mmoja tu.”
Ekegusii: Gaki ase amang’ana ay’okoria ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng’a “omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa tai gento ase ense”, ekiagera twamanyire ng’a “Nyasae onde tari aande, otatiga oyomo bweka.”

English: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hata kama wapo hao wanaoitwa miungu, kama wakiwa mbinguni au duniani (kama ilivyo kweli wapo “miungu” wengi na “mabwana” wengi),
Ekegusii: Gaki, nonya chire echinde chikorokwa chinyasae igoro gose ense (buna chire “chinyasae” chinyinge, na “abanene” abange)

English: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.
Kiswahili: kwetu sisi yuko Mungu mmoja, aliye Baba, ambaye vitu vyote vyatoka kwake na kwa ajili yake sisi twaishi; na kuna Bwana mmoja tu, Yesu Kristo, ambaye kwa yeye vitu vyote vimekuwepo na kwa yeye tunaishi.
Ekegusii: korende ase tore intwe Nyasae noyomo bweka, oyore Tata, na ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa asare, na intwe nigo tore moyo asare. Naende nare Omonene oyomo, nere Yeso Kristo, na ebinto bionsi nere obitongete, naboigo naintwe nere ototongete.

English: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
Kiswahili: Lakini si wote wanaojua jambo hili. Baadhi ya watu bado wamezoea sanamu kuwa halisi hivi kwamba wanapokula chakula kama hicho wanadhani kimetolewa sadaka kwa sanamu na kwa kuwa dhamiri zao ni dhaifu, dhamiri yao inanajisika.
Ekegusii: Korende obong’aini obo tibori ime ase abanto bonsi. Abande, ekiagera bakwenaria emegwekano y’ogosasimwa goika bono, bakoria endagera buna egento kiarurwe ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, na ekiagera chinkoro chiabo chikobugwa bwango, nigo chikobekwa ogotacheneka.

English: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.
Kiswahili: Lakini chakula hakituleti karibu na Mungu, wala hatupotezi chochote tusipokula, wala hatuongezi chochote kama tukila.
Ekegusii: Korende endagera tegotorenta ang’e ase Nyasae. Totarieti, titogosiria gento, na toisa koria, tegotomenta gento.

English: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.
Kiswahili: Lakini angalieni jinsi mnavyotumia uhuru wenu usije ukawa kikwazo kwao walio dhaifu.
Ekegusii: Korende rigereria ng’a obosibore boria bwaino tibocha kobagocha baria bare abareu.

English: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama mtu yeyote mwenye dhamiri dhaifu akiwaona ninyi wenye ujuzi huu mkila katika hekalu la sanamu, je, si atatiwa moyo kula chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu?
Ekegusii: Naki omonto karakorore aye, omonto ore nobong’aini, goikaransete ase endagera ime ase Hekalu y’emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, Inee, onye enkoro yaye ekobugwa bwango, takonyora oboremu goika arie ebinto bikoruegwa ebingwanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa?

English: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hiyo, huyo ndugu mwenye dhamiri dhaifu, ambaye Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yake, ataangamia kwa sababu ya ujuzi wenu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo oria omoreu nigo agosirigwa ase engencho y’obong’aini bwao, nere oyominto Kristo akwete ase engencho yaye.

English: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
Kiswahili: Mnapotenda dhambi dhidi ya ndugu zenu kwa njia hii na kujeruhi dhamiri zao zilizo dhaifu, mnamkosea Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, komorakorere abamino ebibe na goichania chinkoro chiria chikobugwa bwango, igo mwakoreire Kristo ebibe.

English: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kama kile ninachokula kitamfanya ndugu yangu aanguke katika dhambi, sitakula nyama kamwe, nisije nikamfanya ndugu yangu aanguke.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, endagera keragere oyominto agwe, rirorio tinkoria enyama nonya ng’ake, timbaisa kogera oyominto agwe.

English: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?
Kiswahili: Je, mimi si huru? Je, mimi si mtume? Je, mimi sikumwona Yesu, Bwana wetu? Je, ninyi si matunda ya kazi yangu katika Bwana?
Ekegusii: Inee! Inche tindi omosibore? Inche tindi omotomwa? Tinaroche Yeso, Omonene oito? Inwe timori okwama kw’emeremo yane ase Omonene?

English: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Hata kama mimi si mtume kwa wengine, hakika mimi ni mtume kwenu, kwa maana ninyi ni mhuri wa utume wangu katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naki onye inche tindi omotomwa ase abande, korende nomotomwa inde ase more inwe. Inwe nigo more ekemanyererio ki’obotomwa bwane ase Omonene.

English: My defense to those who examine me is this:
Kiswahili: Huu ndio utetezi wangu kwa hao wanaokaa kunihukumu.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo okoiraneria kwane ase baria bakomboria.

English: Have we no right to eat and to drink?
Kiswahili: Je, hatuna haki ya kula na kunywa?
Ekegusii: Inee! Titori ne ribaga ri’okoria na konywa?

English: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?
Kiswahili: Je, hatuna haki ya kusafiri na mke anayeamini, kama wanavyofanya mitume wengine na ndugu zake Bwana na Kefa?
Ekegusii: Titori ne ribaga koira amo naintwe omokungu ore oyominto ase okwegena buna abatomwa bande, na abamwabo Omonene, na Kefa bakorete?

English: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?
Kiswahili: Au ni mimi na Barnaba tu inatubidi kufanya kazi ili tuweze kupata mahitaji yetu?
Ekegusii: Gose ninche bweka na Barnaba totari ne ribaga ri’ogotiga emeremo ya kera rituko?

English: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?
Kiswahili: Ni askari yupi aendaye vitani kwa gharama zake mwenyewe? Ni nani apandaye shamba la mizabibu na asile matunda yake? Ni nani achungaye kundi na asipate maziwa yake.
Ekegusii: Morwani ki okogenda ase esegi kero kende gionsi na kweakanera ere omonyene? Moremi ki otakoria amasabibu ’omogondo oye bw’emesabibu? Gose ning’o okorisia riicho, otakonywa amabeere aye?

English: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?
Kiswahili: Je, nasema mambo haya katika mtazamo wa kibinadamu tu? Je, sheria haisemi vivyo hivyo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ngokwana aya buna Mwanyabaanto? Gose amachiiko tari goteeba boigo?

English: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa katika Sheria ya Mose: “Usimfunge maksai kinywa apurapo nafaka.” Je, Mungu hapa anahusika na ngʼombe?
Ekegusii: Naki ase amachiiko a Musa nigo ariikire, “Tobaisa kobekera entang’ana ekeokio ekero ekoora endagera.” Inee! Nyasae narengereretie amang’ana e chintang’ana?

English: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.
Kiswahili: Je, Mungu hasemi haya hasa kwa ajili yetu? Hakika yameandikwa kwa ajili yetu, kwa sababu mtu anapolima na mpuraji akapura nafaka, wote wanapaswa kufanya hivyo wakiwa na tumaini la kushiriki mavuno.
Ekegusii: Inee! Tateebete ayio ase engencho yaito yoka? Ee, nigo ariikire ase engencho yaito; ekiagera oyokorema nagwenerete korema ase ogosemeria, na ere oyokoora nigo akoora ase ogosemeria konyora ensemo yaye y’endagera.

English: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?
Kiswahili: Je, ikiwa sisi tulipanda mbegu ya kiroho miongoni mwenu, itakuwa ni jambo kubwa iwapo tutavuna vitu vya mwili kutoka kwenu?
Ekegusii: Onye intwe twabasimekeire ebinto bi’omoika, Inee, nering’ana rinene gatoragese ebinto biaino bi’ogokonya ase obogima bw’ense eye?

English: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.
Kiswahili: Kama wengine wana haki ya kupata msaada kutoka kwenu, isingepasa tuwe na haki hiyo hata zaidi? Lakini sisi hatukutumia haki hii. Kinyume chake, tunavumilia kila kitu ili tusije tukazuia Injili ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Onye abande banyorire ensemo ebatungetie korwa ase more, Inee, intwe titokoyenyora kobua mono? Korende titorakorera oboronge obo; korende nigo tokoremereria amang’ana onsi, titobaisa gotanga enchiri ya Kristo.

English: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?
Kiswahili: Je, hamjui kwamba, watu wafanyao kazi hekaluni hupata chakula chao kutoka hekaluni, nao wale wahudumiao madhabahuni hushiriki kile kitolewacho madhabahuni?
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a baria bagokora emeremo ase Hekalu nigo bakoria endagera korwa ase Hekalu, na baria bagokorera ase egesasiimero mbare nensemo yabo ase ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso?

English: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, Bwana ameamuru kwamba wale wanaohubiri Injili wapate riziki yao kutokana na Injili.
Ekegusii: Na Omonene naboigo ochikiire ng’a baria bakorandia enchiri banyore ebibagwenerete korwa ase enchiri.

English: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.
Kiswahili: Lakini sijatumia hata mojawapo ya haki hizi. Nami siandiki haya nikitumaini kwamba mtanifanyia mambo hayo. Heri nife kuliko mtu yeyote kuninyima huku kujisifu kwangu.
Ekegusii: Korende tindakorera amang’ana aya nonya ndimo. Gose tinyarigeti aya erinde abe boigo ase ’nde; naki mbuya ninkwa kobua omonto onde bwensi kong’ura ogwetogia kwane.

English: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninapohubiri Injili siwezi kujisifu maana ninalazimika kuhubiri. Ole wangu nisipoihubiri Injili!
Ekegusii: Naki onye nkorandia enchiri, tindi neri ingwetogeria, ekiagera okobetererigwa kwabekirwe ase ’nde. Obobe nobwane ntarandeti enchiri!

English: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
Kiswahili: Nikihubiri kwa hiari, ninayo thawabu. Lakini kama si kwa hiari, basi ninachofanya ni kutekeleza tu uwakili niliowekewa.
Ekegusii: Naki onye ngokora emeremo eye ase ogwancha kwane, ninde neng’eria; korende onye tari ase ogwancha kwane, nonya nabo negenirwe noborendi.

English: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.
Kiswahili: Basi je, thawabu yangu ni nini? Thawabu yangu ni hii: Ya kwamba katika kuhubiri Injili niitoe bila gharama, bila kutumia kwa utimilifu uwezo wangu nilio nao katika Injili.
Ekegusii: Gaki eng’eria yane ninki? Neye, ng’a ndandie enchiri ya Kristo ntari konyora ebintungetie, na tinsaba ebiaboronge biane ase okorandia enchiri.

English: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
Kiswahili: Ingawa mimi ni huru, wala si mtumwa wa mtu yeyote, nimejifanya kuwa mtumwa wa kila mtu, ili niweze kuwavuta wengi kadri iwezekanavyo.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya inde nobosibore korwa ase abanto bonsi, nekorire omosomba o bonsi, erinde ndete abanto abange kobua.

English: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;
Kiswahili: Kwa Wayahudi, nilikuwa kama Myahudi, ili niwapate Wayahudi. Kwa watu wale walio chini ya sheria, nilikuwa kama aliye chini ya sheria (ingawa mimi siko chini ya sheria), ili niweze kuwapata wale walio chini ya sheria.
Ekegusii: Ase Abayahudi nkaba buna Omoyahudi, erinde mbarente Abayahudi; ase baria bare inse y’amachiiko nkaba buna oyore inse y’amachiiko (nonya inche omonyene tindi inse y’amachiiko) erinde mbarente baria bare inse y’amachiiko.

English: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.
Kiswahili: Kwa watu wasio na sheria nilikuwa kama asiye na sheria (ingawa siko huru mbali na sheria ya Mungu, bali niko chini ya sheria ya Kristo), ili niweze kuwapata wale wasio na sheria.
Ekegusii: Ase baria batari namachiiko nkaba buna oyo otari namachiiko (tari buna tindi namachiiko ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende nigo inde inse y’amachiiko a Kristo) erinde mbarente baria batari namachiiko.

English: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
Kiswahili: Kwa walio dhaifu nilikuwa dhaifu, ili niweze kuwapata walio dhaifu. Nimekuwa mtu wa hali zote kwa watu wote ili kwa njia yoyote niweze kuwaokoa baadhi yao.
Ekegusii: Ase abare abareu nkaba omoreu, erinde mbarente abareu. Igo nkaba n’echingencho chionsi ase abanto bonsi, erinde inyare kobatooria abanto ase chinchera chionsi.

English: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.
Kiswahili: Nafanya haya yote kwa ajili ya Injili, ili nipate kushiriki baraka zake.
Ekegusii: Na inche nigo ngokora aya onsi ase engencho y’enchiri, erinde inyare koba oyomo obo bw’abakonyora ogosesenigwa kwaye.

English: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.
Kiswahili: Je, hamjui kwamba katika mashindano ya mbio wote wanaoshindana hukimbia, lakini ni mmoja wao tu apewaye tuzo? Kwa hiyo kimbieni katika mashindano kwa jinsi ambavyo mtapata tuzo.
Ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a abwo bakoamererania ase okominyoka chimbero, nigo bakominyoka bonsi, korende noyomo bweka okonyora eng’eria? Minyoka boigo, erinde moyenyore.

English: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja anayeshiriki katika mashindano hufanya mazoezi makali. Wao hufanya hivyo ili wapokee taji isiyodumu, lakini sisi tunafanya hivyo ili kupata taji idumuyo milele.
Ekegusii: Na kera oyokoamererania ase chigosori nigo agwetanga ase onsi. Na abwo nigo bagokora bo, erinde banyore egutwa egosareka, korende intwe tonyore eye etagosareka.

English: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mimi sikimbii kama mtu akimbiaye bila lengo, sipigani kama mtu anayepiga hewa,
Ekegusii: Nonya ninche nkominyoka nde chimbero ntari gotiting’ara; naboigo inkorwanera chinkundi, tari buna oyokorwana nembeo.

English: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.
Kiswahili: la, bali nautesa mwili wangu na kuutumikisha ili nikiisha kuwahubiria wengine, mimi nisiwe mtu wa kukataliwa.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo ngochanda omobere one na koyokoria buna omosomba, erinde konarandeirie abande, inche timba omonto ogocha kwangwa.

English: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, sitaki mkose kufahamu ukweli huu kwamba baba zetu walikuwa wote chini ya wingu na kwamba wote walipita katikati ya bahari.
Ekegusii: Baminto, tindigeti momoche komanya ng’a chisokoro chiaito chionsi nigo chiarenge inse ye riire. Barabwo bonsi bagaeta egati y’enyancha;

English: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
Kiswahili: Wote wakabatizwa kuwa wa Mose ndani ya lile wingu na ndani ya ile bahari.
Ekegusii: bonsi bakabatiswa ase Musa ime ase riire na ime ase enyancha.

English: and all ate the same spiritual food;
Kiswahili: Wote walikula chakula kile kile cha roho,
Ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria endagera eria eria y’omoika.

English: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
Kiswahili: na wote wakanywa kile kile kinywaji cha roho, kwa maana walikunywa kutoka ule mwamba wa roho uliofuatana nao, nao ule mwamba ulikuwa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Bonsi bakanywa ekenyugwa keria keria ki’omoika, ekiagera banywete korwa ase egetare ki’omoika kiabatunyanete; na egetare keria nakio Kristo.

English: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu hakupendezwa na wengi wao, kwa hiyo miili yao ilitapakaa jangwani.
Ekegusii: Korende abange babo Nyasae tagweneretwe nabarabwo, nakio kiagerete emebere yabo ekwete yasiareretwe ase erooro.

English: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
Kiswahili: Basi mambo haya yalitokea kama mifano ili kutuzuia tusiweke mioyo yetu katika mambo maovu kama wao walivyofanya.
Ekegusii: Ebi igo biarenge ebiorokererio bi’ogotokuurera, erinde intwe titoba abanto bakogania amabe, buna baria baganetie.

English: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”
Kiswahili: Msiwe waabudu sanamu, kama baadhi yao walivyokuwa, kama ilivyoandikwa, “Watu waliketi chini kula na kunywa, kisha wakainuka kucheza na kufanya sherehe za kipagani.”
Ekegusii: Gose timoba abasasimi emegwekano buna abande babo barenge; buna eriikire, “Abanto nigo baikaransete koria na konywa, bagatenena gotenga.”

English: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.
Kiswahili: Wala tusifanye uzinzi kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakafa watu 23,000 kwa siku moja.
Ekegusii: Gose titokora obotomani buna abande babo bakorete, na abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na isato bagakwa ase rituko erimo.

English: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
Kiswahili: Wala tusimjaribu Kristo, kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakafa kwa kuumwa na nyoka.
Ekegusii: Gose titoteema Omonene, buna abande babo bakorete, bagasirigwa ne ching’iti.

English: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
Kiswahili: Msinungʼunike kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakaangamizwa na mharabu.
Ekegusii: Gose timwemurungania buna abande babo bemurunganetie bagasirigwa noria Omosiria.

English: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
Kiswahili: Mambo haya yote yaliwapata wao ili yawe mifano kwa wengine, nayo yaliandikwa ili yatuonye sisi ambao mwisho wa nyakati umetufikia.
Ekegusii: Aya agakoreka ase bare buna ekiorokererio, akarikwa ase ogotokuurera intwe abatogocherwa nomoerio bw’ense.

English: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, yeye ajidhaniaye amesimama, aangalie asianguke.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio oyogwekaga ng’a nateneine erende tagwa.

English: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
Kiswahili: Hakuna jaribu lolote lililowapata ambalo si la kawaida kwa wanadamu. Naye Mungu ni mwaminifu; hataruhusu mjaribiwe kupita mnavyoweza. Lakini mnapojaribiwa atawapa njia ya kutokea ili mweze kustahimili.
Ekegusii: Ogoteemwa tikwabanyorete inwe, otatiga okore kw’engencho ya Mwanyabaanto. Nyasae nomwegenwa, takobatiga moteemwe goetania buna chinguru chiaino ching’ana, korende amo nogoteemwa nakore egesieri mogosokera, erinde monyare gokoremereria.

English: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo wapenzi wangu, zikimbieni ibada za sanamu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, abanchwa baane, tama, timobaisa gosasiima emegwekano.

English: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
Kiswahili: Nasema watu wenye ufahamu, amueni wenyewe kuhusu haya niyasemayo.
Ekegusii: Igo ngokwana ase more buna ase abanto bare nobong’aini; morenge aya ngokwana.

English: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?
Kiswahili: Je, kikombe cha baraka ambacho tunakibariki, si ushirika katika damu ya Kristo? Mkate tuumegao, si ushirika wa mwili wa Kristo?
Ekegusii: Egekombe keria ki’ogosesenigwa togosesenia, Inee, tikeri okobwatana namanyinga a Kristo? Omogati oria togosamunyora, tori okobwatana nomobere o Kristo?

English: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mkate ni mmoja, sisi tulio wengi tu mwili mmoja, kwa kuwa wote twashiriki mkate mmoja.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera omogati noyomo, intwe abatore abange nigo tore omobere oyomo; naki intwe twensi nigo tokonyora ensemo yaito y’omogati oria oyomo.

English: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
Kiswahili: Waangalieni watu wa Israeli: Je, wale wote walao dhabihu si ni wale watendao kazi madhabahuni?
Ekegusii: Rigereria chingencho chi’Abaisraeli; abwo bakoria ebing’wanso ebio, Inee, tibari kobwatana negesasiimero?

English: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
Kiswahili: Je, nina maana kwamba kafara iliyotolewa kwa sanamu ni kitu chenye maana yoyote? Au kwamba sanamu ni kitu chenye maana yoyote?
Ekegusii: Ninki ngokwana? Ng’a keria gekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa negento? Gose omogwekano oria negento?

English: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.
Kiswahili: La hasha! Lakini kafara za watu wasiomjua Mungu hutolewa kwa mashetani, wala si kwa Mungu. Nami sitaki ninyi mwe na ushirika na mashetani.
Ekegusii: Taibo, korende ebinto biria abanto b’Ebisaku bakorua buna ebing’wanso nigo bakoruera ebirecha, gose tari Nyasae. Inche tinyancheti inwe mobwatane nebirecha.

English: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.
Kiswahili: Hamwezi kunywa katika kikombe cha Bwana na cha mashetani pia. Hamwezi kuwa na sehemu katika meza ya Bwana na katika meza ya mashetani pia.
Ekegusii: Timokonyara konywera egekombe ki’Omonene na egekombe ki’ebirecha. Timokonyara kobwatana nemesa y’Omonene na emesa y’ebirecha.

English: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
Kiswahili: Je, tunataka kuamsha wivu wa Bwana? Je, sisi tuna nguvu kuliko yeye?
Ekegusii: Inee! Igo tokogera Omonene abe ne ribero? Gose ntore ne chinguru kobua ere?

English: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.
Kiswahili: “Vitu vyote ni halali,” lakini si vitu vyote vilivyo na faida. “Vitu vyote ni halali,” lakini si vyote vinavyojenga.
Ekegusii: “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi birankonye. “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi bikoagacha.

English: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asitafute yaliyo yake mwenyewe, bali kila mtu atafute yale yanayowafaa wengine.
Ekegusii: Omonto terigeria kwenyorera ebiya, korende arigerie omogisangio oye ebiya.

English: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,
Kiswahili: Kuleni chochote kinachouzwa sokoni, bila kuuliza swali lolote kwa ajili ya dhamiri.
Ekegusii: Karie kera egento egekoonigwa ase echiiro, timona koboraboria. Timotiga chinkoro chiaino chichandeke.

English: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, “Dunia na vyote vilivyomo ni mali ya Bwana.”
Ekegusii: “Naki ense ney’Omonene, amo na bionsi ebireo.”

English: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.
Kiswahili: Kama ukikaribishwa chakula na mtu asiyeamini nawe ukikubali kwenda, kula kila kitu kitakachowekwa mbele yako bila kuuliza maswali kwa ajili ya dhamiri.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto otari nokwegena okobarangeria inwe ase endagera, na inwe morigetie kogendao; karie kera egento kerabeekwe ase amasio aino, timona kobora‐boria. Timotiga chinkoro chiaino chichandeke.

English: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mtu yeyote akikuambia, “Hiki kimetolewa kafara kwa sanamu,” basi usikile kwa ajili ya huyo aliyekuambia na kwa ajili ya dhamiri.
Ekegusii: (Korende omonto karabateebie, “Egento ekio kiarurwe ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa”, timoria ase engencho yaye ere ayaborokia, na ase enkoro yaye, erinde techandeka.

English: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
Kiswahili: Nina maana dhamiri ya huyo aliyekuambia, wala si kwa ajili ya dhamiri yako. Lakini kwa nini uhuru wangu uhukumiwe na dhamiri ya mtu mwingine?
Ekegusii: Natebiire “enkoro techandeka”, tari eyao, korende eyaye oria onde.) Nase ki obosibore bwane bokogambigwa nenkoro y’omonto onde omoao?

English: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?
Kiswahili: Kama nikila kwa shukrani, kwa nini nashutumiwa kwa kile ambacho kwa hicho ninamshukuru Mungu?
Ekegusii: Kondarie ensemo yane ase ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, nase ki nkoramwa ase egento nasabeire?

English: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
Kiswahili: Basi, lolote mfanyalo, kama ni kula au kunywa, fanyeni yote kwa utukufu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Gaki komokoria, gose mokonywa gose mogokora ing’ana rinde rionsi, kora onsi ase obonene bwa Nyasae.

English: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
Kiswahili: Msiwe kikwazo kwa mtu yeyote, wawe Wayahudi au Wayunani, au kwa kanisa la Mungu,
Ekegusii: Timogocha Abayahudi gose Abagiriki, gose ekanisa ya Nyasae.

English: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
Kiswahili: kama hata mimi ninavyojaribu kumpendeza kila mtu kwa kila namna. Kwa maana sitafuti mema kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe bali kwa ajili ya wengi, ili waweze kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: Mobe buna inche; nkogwenera abanto bonsi ase chinchera chionsi. Tinkorigia kwegwenera inche omonyene, korende ngwenere abwo bare abange, erinde banyare gotoorigwa.

English: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
Kiswahili: Igeni mfano wangu, kama ninavyouiga mfano wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Mobe abegi baane, buna inche inde omwegi o Kristo.

English: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
Kiswahili: Ninawasifu kwa kuwa mnanikumbuka katika kila jambo na kwa kushika mafundisho niliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Nabatogirie baminto, ekiagera mwang’inyoire ase amang’ana onsi, na inwe mwabwatire chingencho echi nabaete koreng’ana buna nabachiete.

English: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
Kiswahili: Napenda mfahamu kwamba kichwa cha kila mwanaume ni Kristo, na kichwa cha mwanamke ni mwanaume, nacho kichwa cha Kristo ni Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende nindigetie momanye ng’a Kristo nere omotwe o kera omosacha; na omosacha nere omotwe bw’omokuungu; na Nyasae nere omotwe o Kristo.

English: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
Kiswahili: Kila mwanaume anayeomba au kutoa unabii akiwa amefunika kichwa chake, anakiaibisha kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Kera omosacha kagosaba gose gakobana, na ere nare negento atubete omotwe oye, igo tasigeti omotwe oye.

English: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.
Kiswahili: Naye kila mwanamke anayeomba au kutoa unabii pasipo kufunika kichwa chake, anakiaibisha kichwa chake, kwani ni sawa na yeye aliyenyoa nywele.
Ekegusii: Korende kera omokungu kagosaba gose kobana na taboeti omotwe oye, igo tasigeti omotwe oye, nigo areng’aine nere oyogingerete etukia yaye.

English: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.
Kiswahili: Kama mwanamke hatajifunika kichwa chake, basi inampasa kunyoa nywele zake. Lakini kama ni aibu kwa mwanamke kukata au kunyoa nywele zake, basi afunike kichwa chake.
Ekegusii: Naki onye omokungu tarigeti kweboa, tiga agingire etukia yaye; korende onye nobosooku ase omokungu konachwa etukia yaye gose kogingirwa tiga eboe.

English: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.
Kiswahili: Haimpasi mwanaume kufunika kichwa chake kwa kuwa yeye ni mfano wa Mungu na utukufu wa Mungu, lakini mwanamke ni utukufu wa mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Naki tegwenereti omosacha gotuba omotwe oye, ekiagera nomogwekano bw’obonene bwa Nyasae; korende omokungu nobonene bw’omosaacha.

English: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mwanaume hakutoka kwa mwanamke, bali mwanamke alitoka kwa mwanaume.
Ekegusii: (Naki omosacha tarwete ase omokungu, korende nomokuungu orwete ase omosacha.

English: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.
Kiswahili: Wala mwanaume hakuumbwa kwa ajili ya mwanamke, bali mwanamke kwa ajili ya mwanaume.
Ekegusii: Gose omosacha tatongetwe ase engencho y’omokuungu, korende nomokuungu ase engencho y’omosaacha.)

English: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii na kwa sababu ya malaika, inampasa mwanamke awe na ishara ya mamlaka juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio negwenerete omokungu abe nekemanyererio gi’okobua ase omotwe oye ase engencho y’abamalaika.

English: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Lakini katika Bwana, mwanamke hajitegemei pasipo mwanaume na mwanaume hajitegemei pasipo mwanamke.
Ekegusii: (Korende ase Omonene omokungu takoba omosacha ataiyo, gose omosacha takoba omokungu ataiyo.

English: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mwanamke alivyoumbwa kutoka kwa mwanaume, vivyo hivyo mwanaume huzaliwa na mwanamke. Lakini vitu vyote vyatoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki buna omokungu arwete ase omosacha, naboigo na omosacha nere akoiborwa nomokuungu, korende bionsi nigo bikorua ase Nyasae.)

English: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?
Kiswahili: Hukumuni ninyi wenyewe: Je, inafaa kwa mwanamke kumwomba Mungu bila kufunika kichwa chake?
Ekegusii: Egambie inwe abanyene. Inee! Mboronge omokungu asabe Nyasae atatubeti omotwe oye?

English: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
Kiswahili: Je, maumbile ya asili hayatufundishi kuwa ni aibu kwa mwanaume kuwa na nywele ndefu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Engencho ya Mwanyabaanto teri kworokereria ng’a onye omosacha okoba netukia entambe nigo ere obosooku asare,

English: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwanamke akiwa na nywele ndefu ni utukufu kwake? Kwa maana mwanamke amepewa nywele ndefu ili kumfunika.
Ekegusii: korende onye omokungu okoba netukia entambe nigo ere obonene bwaye? Ekiagera oeirwe etukia eria ase ogwetuba.

English: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu anataka kubishana juu ya jambo hili, sisi wala makanisa ya Mungu hatutambui desturi nyingine.
Ekegusii: Korende onye monto onde bwensi origetie korenta amang’ana ’okoamererania ase engencho eyio, intwe titori nengencho buna eyio, nonya ne chikanisa chia Nyasae.

English: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.
Kiswahili: Basi katika maagizo yafuatayo, siwezi kuwasifu, kwa sababu mkutanikapo si kwa ajili ya faida bali kwa hasara.
Ekegusii: Korende ase okobaa amachiiko akobwatia ayio tinkobatogia, ekiagera timori gosangererekana ase amaya korende ase ogosaria.

English: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
Kiswahili: Kwanza, mnapokutana kama kanisa, nasikia kwamba kuna mgawanyiko miongoni mwenu, nami kwa kiasi fulani nasadiki kuwa ndivyo ilivyo.
Ekegusii: Naki ritang’ani naigure ng’a ekero mogosangerereka ase ekanisa ogwatananekana nkore ase more. Ayande aya naigure negenire ng’a namaene.

English: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
Kiswahili: Bila shaka lazima pawe na tofauti miongoni mwenu ili kuonyesha ni nani anayekubaliwa na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki ogwatananekana nkogwenerete kobe ase egati yaino, erinde abwo bare abeekeene bamanyekane maiso marore ase more.

English: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
Kiswahili: Mkutanikapo pamoja si chakula cha Bwana mnachokula,
Ekegusii: Ekero mogosangererekana amo, timori koria endagera y’Omonene;

English: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa mnapokula, kila mmoja wenu anakula bila kuwangoja wengine. Mmoja hukaa njaa na mwingine analewa.
Ekegusii: naki kera oyomo nigo agotang’ana kobogoria endagera yaye ase okoria, oyomo nare nenchara, na oyonde otindete.

English: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
Kiswahili: Je, hamna nyumbani kwenu ambako mnaweza kula na kunywa? Au mnalidharau kanisa la Mungu na kuwadhalilisha wale wasio na kitu? Niwaambie nini? Je, niwasifu juu ya jambo hili? La, hasha!
Ekegusii: Inee! Timori ne chinyomba aase mokoragerera na konywera? Gose mwachayire ekanisa ya Nyasae na gosookia abwo batari na gento? Naki ndabateebie? Nimbatogie ase aya? Yaya, tinkobatogia.

English: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mimi nilipokea kutoka kwa Bwana yale niliyowapa ninyi, kwamba Bwana Yesu, usiku ule aliposalitiwa, alitwaa mkate,
Ekegusii: Naki inche nkanyora korwa ase Omonene aya nabaeire inwe, ng’a Omonene Yeso obotuko boria aruetwe akabogoria omogati,

English: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”
Kiswahili: naye akiisha kushukuru, akaumega, akasema, “Huu ndio mwili wangu, uliotolewa kwa ajili yenu. Fanyeni hivi kwa ukumbusho wangu.”
Ekegusii: gakoorire koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, akayosamunyora, akabora karie, “Oyo noro omobere one orurwe ase engencho yaino; kora iga ase okong’inyora inche.”

English: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo baada ya kula, akakitwaa kikombe, akisema, “Kikombe hiki ni agano jipya katika damu yangu. Fanyeni hivi kila mnywapo, kwa ukumbusho wangu.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo akabogoria egekombe magega y’okoria, akabora, “Egekombe eke nokobwatana okoyia ase amanyinga aane; kora iga kera ekero mogokenywera ase okong’inyora inche.”

English: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
Kiswahili: Maana kila mlapo mkate huu na kunywea kikombe hiki, mnatangaza mauti ya Bwana mpaka ajapo.
Ekegusii: Naki kera ekero mokoria omogati oyo na konywera egekombe eke, nigo mokoraria amakweri y’Omonene goika achiche.

English: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, mtu yeyote alaye mkate huo au kukinywea kikombe hicho cha Bwana isivyostahili, atakuwa na hatia ya dhambi juu ya mwili na damu ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Gaki kera oyokoria omogati oyo gose konywera egekombe eke ki’Omonene buna etagwenereti nabe nokomocha igoro y’omobere bw’Omonene na amanyinga aye.

English: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
Kiswahili: Inampasa mtu ajichunguze mwenyewe, kabla ya kula mkate na kukinywea kikombe.
Ekegusii: Tiga omonto erenge omonyene, erio arie omogati na konywera egekombe.

English: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mtu yeyote alaye na kunywa pasipo kuutambua mwili wa Bwana, hula na kunywa hukumu juu yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki oyokoria na konywa buna etagwenereti nigo akwegambia ere omonyene ase okoria na konywa, ase ogotatanana ng’a oria nomobere bw’Omonene.

English: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu wengi miongoni mwenu ni wagonjwa na dhaifu na wengine wenu hata wamekufa.
Ekegusii: Nakio gekogera abange ase more bare abareu na abarwaire, na abanto batari bake bakuure.

English: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama tungejichunguza wenyewe tusingehukumiwa.
Ekegusii: Korende gatoregambie buya intwe abanyene, anga titwagambigwa.

English: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
Kiswahili: Tunapohukumiwa na Bwana, tunaadibishwa ili tusije tukahukumiwa pamoja na ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Gatokogambigwa iga togosusurwa n’Omonene, titobaisa konacherwa ekiina amo nense.

English: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, mkutanikapo pamoja ili kula, mngojane.
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, komogosangererekana amo ase okoria, moganyane.

English: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akiwa na njaa, ale nyumbani kwake ili mkutanapo pamoja msije mkahukumiwa. Nami nitakapokuja nitawapa maelekezo zaidi.
Ekegusii: Omonto kare nenchara, tiga arie mwaye, timobaisa gosangererekana amo ase okonyora okogambigwa. Na aya atigaire ninyaroisie ekero ndache.

English: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
Kiswahili: Basi ndugu zangu, kuhusu karama za rohoni, sitaki mkose kufahamu.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana y’ebiegwa ebikorwa ase Omoika, baminto, tindigeti momoche komanya.

English: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
Kiswahili: Mnajua kwamba mlipokuwa watu wasiomjua Mungu, kwa njia moja au ingine mlishawishika na kupotoshwa mkielekezwa kwa sanamu zisizonena.
Ekegusii: Mwamanyire ng’a ekero mwarenge ab’Ebisaku nigo mware koirwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, eyio etarenge gokwana, buna mware gotang’anwa.

English: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nawaambieni ya kuwa hakuna mtu anayeongozwa na Roho wa Mungu anayeweza kusema, “Yesu na alaaniwe.” Pia hakuna mtu awezaye kusema, “Yesu ni Bwana,” isipokuwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nindigetie kobamanyia, ng’a monto onde tari oyogokwana ase Omoika o Nyasae ogoteeba ng’a, “Yeso oragererigwe!” Gose onde takonyara goteeba, “Yeso n’Omonene”, otatiga ase Omoika Omochenu.

English: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kuna aina mbalimbali za karama, lakini Roho ni yule yule.
Ekegusii: Bono mbireo ebiegwa ao ao, korende Omoika noro oria oyomo.

English: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
Kiswahili: Kuna huduma za aina mbalimbali, lakini Bwana ni yule yule.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nkore ogokora ao ao, korende Omonene nere oria oyomo.

English: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.
Kiswahili: Kisha kuna tofauti za kutenda kazi, lakini ni Mungu yule yule atendaye kazi zote kwa watu wote.
Ekegusii: Naende nkore ogokora kw’emeremo ase chinchera ao ao, korende Nyasae nere oria oria ogokora emeremo yonsi ase bonsi.

English: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
Kiswahili: Basi kila mmoja hupewa ufunuo wa Roho kwa faida ya wote.
Ekegusii: Korende kera oyomo oeirwe okomaanorerwa kw’Omoika, erinde bonsi bakonywe.

English: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
Kiswahili: Maana mtu mmoja kwa Roho hupewa neno la hekima na mwingine neno la maarifa kwa Roho huyo huyo.
Ekegusii: Naki omonto oyomo ase Omoika aegwa ogokwana kw’obong’aini, na oyonde ring’ana ri’okomanya ase Omoika oria oyomo.

English: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,
