Kiswahili: Mtu mwingine imani kwa huyo Roho na mwingine karama za kuponya kwa huyo Roho mmoja.
Ekegusii: Oyonde aegwa okwegena ase Omoika oria oria, na oyonde aegwa ekeegwa gi’okogwenia ase Omoika oria oria.

English: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.
Kiswahili: Kwa mwingine matendo ya miujiza, kwa mwingine unabii kwa mwingine kupambanua roho, kwa mwingine aina mbalimbali za lugha, na kwa mwingine bado, tafsiri za lugha.
Ekegusii: Oyonde aegwa gokora emeremo y’ebikone bie chinguru, na oyonde obobani, na oyonde okomanya kw’ogwatanana emeika, na oyonde ogokwana kw’emenwa ao ao, na oyonde okoonchora emenwa.

English: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
Kiswahili: Haya yote hufanywa na huyo huyo Roho mmoja, Roho naye humgawia kila mtu, kama apendavyo.
Ekegusii: Korende ebiegwa ebi bionsi nigo bikorwa ase Omoika oyo oyomo, oria oria okogabera kera oyomo buna bwanchete.

English: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mwili ulivyo mmoja nao una viungo vingi, navyo viungo vyote vya mwili ingawa ni vingi, ni mwili mmoja, vivyo hivyo na Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki buna omobere ore oyomo, oro nore nebiimo ebinge, na ebiimo bionsi bi’omobere oria, nonya bire ebinge, nigo bire omobere oyomo; naboigo na Kristo are.

English: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana katika Roho mmoja wote tulibatizwa katika mwili mmoja, kama ni Wayahudi au Wayunani, kama ni watumwa au watu huru, nasi sote tulinyweshwa Roho mmoja.
Ekegusii: Naki ase Omoika oyomo intwe twensi tokabatiswa, tokaba omobere oyomo, nonya tore Abayahudi, gose tore Abagiriki, onye tore abasomba, gose tore abasibore; intwe twensi nigo twanyoisetigwe Omoika oyomo.

English: For the body is not one member, but many.
Kiswahili: Basi mwili si kiungo kimoja, bali ni viungo vingi.
Ekegusii: Naki omobere tori nekiimo ekemo, korende nebinge.

English: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
Kiswahili: Kama mguu ungesema, “Kwa kuwa mimi si mkono basi mimi si wa mwili,” hiyo isingefanya huo mguu usiwe sehemu ya mwili.
Ekegusii: Onye okogoro kogoteeba, “Ekiagera inche tindi okoboko, tindi oyo bw’omobere”, Inee, igo tikori okw’omobere ase engencho eyio?

English: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
Kiswahili: Na kama sikio lingesema, “Kwa kuwa mimi si jicho, basi mimi si wa mwili,” hiyo isingefanya hilo sikio lisiwe sehemu ya mwili.
Ekegusii: Na onye ogoto kogoteeba, “Ekiagera inche tindi eriso, inche tindi oyo bw’omobere”, Inee, igo tikori okw’omobere ase engencho eyio?

English: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
Kiswahili: Kama mwili wote ungelikuwa jicho, kusikia kungekuwa wapi? Au kama mwili wote ungelikuwa sikio, kunusa kungekuwa wapi?
Ekegusii: Onye omobere bwonsi oba eriso, anga okoigwa ng’ai kore? Onye bwonsi nogoto, anga okonyonka ng’ai kore?

English: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama ilivyo, Mungu ameweka viungo katika mwili, kila kimoja kama alivyopenda.
Ekegusii: Korende bono Nyasae obekire ebiimo, kera ekemo ase omobere buna arigetie.

English: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
Kiswahili: Kama vyote vingekuwa kiungo kimoja, mwili ungekuwa wapi?
Ekegusii: Korende onye bionsi biba ekiimo ekemo, anga omobere ng’ai ore?

English: But now they are many members, but one body.
Kiswahili: Kama ulivyo, una viungo vingi, lakini mwili ni mmoja.
Ekegusii: Bono ebiimo nebinge bire, korende omobere noyomo.

English: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
Kiswahili: Jicho haliwezi kuuambia mkono, “Sina haja nawe!” Wala kichwa hakiwezi kuiambia miguu, “Sina haja na ninyi!”
Ekegusii: Eriso tirikonyara goteebia okoboko, “Tinkoganeti”, gose omotwe tokonyara goteebia amagoro, “Timbaganeti.”

English: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
Kiswahili: Lakini badala yake, vile viungo vya mwili vinavyoonekana kuwa dhaifu, ndivyo ambavyo ni vya muhimu sana.
Ekegusii: Korende kobua mono, ebiimo biria bi’omobere bigokagerwa ng’a tibiri ne chinguru, nigo biganeirie kobua.

English: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,
Kiswahili: Navyo vile viungo tunavyoviona havina heshima, ndivyo tunavipa heshima maalum. Vile viungo vya mwili ambavyo havina uzuri, tunavipa heshima ya pekee;
Ekegusii: Na ebiimo biria bi’omobere bigokagerwa ng’a tibiri nogosika twabieire ogosika kobua; na ebiimo biaito bitari nobuya, nigo tokobiboyia buya kobua,

English: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
Kiswahili: wakati vile viungo vyenye uzuri havihitaji utunzaji wa pekee. Lakini Mungu ameviweka pamoja viungo vya mwili na akavipa heshima zaidi vile vilivyopungukiwa,
Ekegusii: naki ebiimo biaito bire nobuya tibiganeti ayio. Korende Nyasae obwatanirie omobere, na ekiimo keria keremeire ogosika okeire ogosika kobua,

English: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
Kiswahili: ili pasiwe na mafarakano katika mwili, bali viungo vyote vihudumiane kwa usawa kila kimoja na mwenzake.
Ekegusii: erinde tikoba ogwatananekana ase omobere, korende ebiimo birendane.

English: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
Kiswahili: Kama kiungo kimoja kikiumia, viungo vyote huumia pamoja nacho, kama kiungo kimoja kikipewa heshima, viungo vyote hufurahi pamoja nacho.
Ekegusii: Onye ekiimo ekemo gechandegete, ebiimo bionsi nigo bichandegete nabirobio; onye ekiimo ekemo kegotogigwa, ebiimo bionsi nigo bikogoka amo.

English: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
Kiswahili: Sasa ninyi ni mwili wa Kristo na kila mmoja wenu ni sehemu ya huo mwili.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo more omobere o Kristo na ebiimo bi’omobere oyio, kera ekemo aase aye.

English: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
Kiswahili: Mungu ameweka katika kanisa, kwanza mitume, pili manabii, tatu walimu, kisha watenda miujiza, pia karama za kuponya, karama za kusaidiana, karama za uongozi, aina mbalimbali za lugha.
Ekegusii: Na Nyasae obekire ase ekanisa ritang’ani abatomwa, eria kabere ababani, eria gatato aborokia. Naende akabeeka abakori emeremo y’ebikone bie chinguru, abanyorire ebiegwa bi’okogwenia amarwaire, abakoonyi, abaagambi, naende abagokwana emenwa ao ao.

English: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
Kiswahili: Je, wote ni mitume? Je, wote ni manabii? Je, wote ni walimu? Je, wote wanatenda miujiza?
Ekegusii: Inee! Bonsi nabatomwa? Bonsi nababani? Bonsi naborokia? Bonsi ngokora bare ebikone bie chinguru?

English: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
Kiswahili: Je, wote wana karama ya kuponya? Je, wote hunena kwa lugha mpya? Je, wote wanatafsiri?
Ekegusii: Bonsi mbare nebiegwa bi’okogwenia abarwaire? Bonsi ngokwana bare emenwa ao ao? Bonsi nkoonchora bare?

English: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
Kiswahili: Basi tamanini sana karama zilizo kuu. Nami nitawaonyesha njia iliyo bora zaidi.
Ekegusii: Rigia mono ebiegwa ebiya kobua. Naende nimborokie enchera ere engiya mono.

English: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
Kiswahili: Hata kama nitasema kwa lugha za wanadamu na za malaika, kama sina upendo, nimekuwa kengele inayolialia au toazi livumalo.
Ekegusii: Ninsa gokwana ase emenwa ya Mwanyabaanto na ey’abamalaika, onye tindi nobwanchani, nabeire buna etai ekwoga gose endege ekobuga.

English: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
Kiswahili: Ningekuwa na karama ya unabii na kujua siri zote na maarifa yote, hata kama nina imani kiasi cha kuweza kuhamisha milima, kama sina upendo, mimi si kitu.
Ekegusii: Naende ninsa koba nekeegwa gi’okobana, na komanya obobisi bwonsi, ne chisemi chionsi; nimba nokwegena gwonsi oko koranyare kong’anyia ebitunwa, korende onye tindi nobwanchani, inche tindi gento.

English: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
Kiswahili: Kama nikitoa mali yote niliyo nayo na kama nikijitolea mwili wangu uchomwe moto, kama sina upendo, hainifaidi kitu.
Ekegusii: Naende ningabera abataka ebinto biane bionsi, naende nindua omobere one oyie ase omorero, onye tindi nobwanchani, ayio takongwenera gento.

English: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
Kiswahili: Upendo huvumilia, upendo hufadhili, upendo hauoni wivu, hauna majivuno, hauna kiburi.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani nigo bokoremereria, naende nigo bokoba nobwororo. Obwanchani tibori koba ne ribero, tibori koenena, tibori gwetogia,

English: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
Kiswahili: Haukosi kuwa na adabu, hautafuti mambo yake, haukasiriki upesi, hauweki kumbukumbu ya mabaya.
Ekegusii: tibokomocha koba nogosika, tibokorigia ayare ayaye, tibori kobeeigwa, tibori kobara amabe;

English: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
Kiswahili: Upendo haufurahii mabaya bali hufurahi pamoja na kweli.
Ekegusii: tibokogokera obobe, korende bogokera ekeene.

English: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
Kiswahili: Upendo huvumilia yote, huamini yote, hutumaini yote, hustahimili yote.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani nigo bokoremereria onsi, bwegeena onsi, bosemeria onsi, bobogoria onsi.

English: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
Kiswahili: Upendo haushindwi kamwe. Lakini ukiwepo unabii, utakoma; zikiwepo lugha, zitakoma; yakiwepo maarifa, yatapita.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani tibori nomoerio; korende koborabeo obobani, nabosire; kerabe emenwa, neere; gochirabe chisemi, nachisire.

English: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tunafahamu kwa sehemu na tunatoa unabii kwa sehemu.
Ekegusii: Naki okomanya gwaito tikori okw’oboikeranu, na obobani bwaito tibori obw’oboikeranu;

English: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
Kiswahili: Lakini ukamilifu ukija, yale yasiyo kamili hutoweka.
Ekegusii: korende ekero oboikeranu bogocha, egetaikeraneti nagesire.

English: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
Kiswahili: Nilipokuwa mtoto, nilisema kama mtoto, niliwaza kama mtoto, nilifikiri kama mtoto. Nilipokuwa mtu mzima niliacha mambo ya kitoto.
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge omwana, nigo narenge gokwana buna omwana, nigo narenge korengereria buna omwana, naende nigo narenge komanya buna omwana; konabeire omonto omonene natigire amang’ana y’obwana.

English: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sasa tunaona taswira kama kwa kioo, lakini wakati huo tutaona wazi. Sasa nafahamu kwa sehemu, wakati huo nitafahamu kikamilifu, kama vile mimi ninavyofahamika kikamilifu.
Ekegusii: Naki ekero kia bono nigo tokorora buna ase ekerore buna orotutu; korende ekero keria ntorore obosio ase obosio. Ekero kia bono namanyire ase ensemo; ekero keria nimanye onsi, buna inche imanyekanete kegima.

English: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
Kiswahili: Basi sasa, yanadumu mambo haya matatu: Imani, tumaini na upendo. Lakini lililo kuu miongoni mwa haya matatu ni upendo.
Ekegusii: Gaki bono biatigaire okwegena, na ogosemeria, na obwanchani, aya atato; erire rinene ase aya nobwanchani.

English: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
Kiswahili: Fuateni upendo na kutaka sana karama za roho, hasa karama ya unabii.
Ekegusii: Rigia obwanchani, teema mono konyora ebiegwa bi’Omoika; kobua mono ase ebi, monyare kobana.

English: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mtu yeyote anayesema kwa lugha, hasemi na wanadamu bali anasema na Mungu. Kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote anayemwelewa, kwani anasema mambo ya siri kwa roho.
Ekegusii: Naki oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti, tari gokwana nabaanto, korende na Nyasae, ekiagera onde tari okomoigwa, korende nigo agokwana amang’ana abobisi ase Omoika.

English: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.
Kiswahili: Lakini anayetoa unabii anasema na watu akiwajenga, kuwatia moyo na kuwafariji.
Ekegusii: Korende ere oyokobana, nigo agokwana ase abanto amang’ana ay’okobaagacha, na kobaremia, na kobabeeka chinguru.

English: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
Kiswahili: Anenaye kwa lugha hujijenga mwenyewe, bali atoaye unabii hulijenga kanisa.
Ekegusii: Oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti nigo akweagacha ere omonyene; korende oyokobana nigo akoagacha ekanisa.

English: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.
Kiswahili: Ningependa kila mmoja wenu anene kwa lugha lakini ningependa zaidi nyote mtoe unabii. Kwa kuwa yeye atoaye unabii ni mkuu kuliko anenaye kwa lugha, isipokuwa atafsiri, ili kanisa lipate kujengwa.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo ndigetie inwe mwensi mokwane ase emenwa, korende kobua mono ng’a monyare kobana. Ere oyokobana nomonene kobua oyogokwana ase emenwa, otatiga omonto aonchore, erinde ekanisa eagachwe.

English: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
Kiswahili: Sasa ndugu zangu, kama nikija kwenu nikasema kwa lugha mpya nitawafaidia nini kama sikuwaletea ufunuo au neno la maarifa au unabii au mafundisho?
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, kondache ase more na gokwana ase emenwa, inki ndabagwenere, onye aya ngokwana takoba amang’ana ’okomaanorerwa gose obong’aini, gose obobani, gose okworokereria?

English: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
Kiswahili: Hata vitu visivyo na uhai vitoapo sauti, kama vile filimbi au kinubi, mtu atajuaje ni wimbo gani unaoimbwa kusipokuwa na tofauti ya upigaji?
Ekegusii: Nonya n’ebinto bitari nobogima, buna ekeroria, gose obokano, onye tibikorua eriogi rire nogwatananekana, naki eramanyekane ngotera ki gokobugigwa ase ekeroria gose obokano?

English: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?
Kiswahili: Tena kama tarumbeta haitoi sauti inayoeleweka, ni nani atakayejiandaa kwa ajili ya vita?
Ekegusii: Naende onye egetureeri gekobugigwa na gosokia egeturi getamanyekaneti, ning’o orabe ang’e ase esegi?

English: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo na ninyi, kama mkinena maneno yasiyoeleweka katika akili, mtu atajuaje mnalosema? Kwa maana mtakuwa mnasema hewani tu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe motakwaneti ring’ana rikoigweka, ring’ana riria rigokwanwa, naki riramanyekane? Naki igo morakwane ase embeo bosa.

English: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.
Kiswahili: Bila shaka ziko sauti nyingi ulimwenguni, wala hakuna isiyo na maana.
Ekegusii: Inyora ng’a nere emenwa ere ne chingencho chinyinge ase ense, gose onde tari nonya noyomo, otari nengencho yaye.

English: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.
Kiswahili: Basi kama sielewi maana ya hiyo sauti, nitakuwa mgeni kwa yule msemaji, naye atakuwa mgeni kwangu.
Ekegusii: Onye tinkomanya engencho y’omonwa oria, nimbe buna omogeni asare ere oyogokwana, na ere nabe buna omogeni ase ’nde.

English: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo na ninyi. Kwa kuwa mnatamani kuwa na karama za rohoni, jitahidini kuzidi sana katika karama kwa ajili ya kulijenga kanisa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe, ekiagera morigetie mono koba abanto bare nebiegwa bi’Omoika, rigia mono momente koba nabio, erinde moagache ekanisa.

English: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, yeye anenaye kwa lugha na aombe kwamba apate kutafsiri kile anachonena.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ere oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti tiga asabe aegwe ekeegwa gi’okoonchora.

English: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nikiomba kwa lugha, roho yangu inaomba, lakini akili yangu haina matunda.
Ekegusii: Naki kondasabe ase omonwa otamanyekaneti omoika one nigo ogosaba, korende obong’aini bwane tibori kwama.

English: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
Kiswahili: Nifanyeje basi? Nitaomba kwa roho, na pia nitaomba kwa akili yangu. Nitaimba kwa roho na nitaimba kwa akili yangu pia.
Ekegusii: Inki rende ekio? Nindigetie nsabe ase omoika, naende nindigetie nsabe ase obong’aini. Nindigetie ntere ase omoika, naende nindigetie ntere ase obong’aini.

English: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unabariki kwa roho, mtu mwingine atakayejikuta miongoni mwa hao wasiojua, atawezaje kusema “Amen” katika kushukuru kwako, wakati haelewi unachosema?
Ekegusii: Aande onye aye ogotogia Nyasae ase omoika, nere oyoikaransete otamanyeti, naki araitabe “Amina” ase ogoaka kwao ng’a mbuya mono, na ere tamanyeti aya ogokwana?

English: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.
Kiswahili: Mnaweza kuwa mnatoa shukrani kweli, sawa, lakini huyo mtu mwingine hajengeki.
Ekegusii: Naki nekeene, aye gwatogirie buya, korende oria oyonde taagachiri.

English: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.
Kiswahili: Namshukuru Mungu kwamba mimi nanena kwa lugha kuliko ninyi nyote.
Ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ngokwana ase emenwa kobua inwe mwensi;

English: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.
Kiswahili: Lakini ndani ya kanisa ni afadhali niseme maneno matano ya kueleweka ili niwafundishe wengine kuliko kusema maneno 10,000 kwa lugha.
Ekegusii: korende nanchire gokwana amang’ana atano ase ekanisa ase obong’aini bwane, inyare kworokereria abande, kobua gokwana amang’ana chilifu ikomi ase emenwa etamanyekaneti.

English: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, msiwe kama watoto katika kufikiri kwenu, afadhali kuhusu uovu mwe kama watoto wachanga, lakini katika kufikiri kwenu, mwe watu wazima.
Ekegusii: Baminto, timoba buna abana abake ase ebirengererio biaino; ase obobe mobe abana ebing’werere, korende ase okomanya kwaino mobe abanto abanene.

English: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”
Kiswahili: Katika Sheria imeandikwa kwamba: “Kupitia kwa watu wenye lugha ngʼeni na kupitia midomo ya wageni, nitasema na watu hawa, lakini hata hivyo hawatanisikiliza,” asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase amachiiko nigo ariikire, “Omonene oteebire: Ase abanto b’emenwa etamanyekaneti, na ase ebikoba bi’emenwa y’abageni ninkwane nabaanto aba. Nonya nabo tibakonyigwera.”

English: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.
Kiswahili: Basi kunena kwa lugha ni ishara, si kwa watu waaminio, bali kwa wasioamini, wakati unabii si kwa ajili ya wasioamini, bali kwa ajili ya waaminio.
Ekegusii: Gaki emenwa eyio nekemanyererio, tari ase abegenete, korende ase abategeneti. Korende obobani nekemanyererio, tari ase abategeneti, korende ase abegenete.

English: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kama kanisa lote likikutana na kila mmoja akanena kwa lugha, kisha wakaingia wageni wasioelewa wasioamini, je, hawatasema kwamba wote mna wazimu?
Ekegusii: Gaki onye ekanisa yonsi, egosangererekana amo, na mwensi mogokwana ase emenwa, erio abanto ba isiko bagocha, gose abategeneti, Inee, tibagoteeba ng’a nigo more chibarimo?

English: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mtu asiyeamini au asiyeelewa akiingia wakati kila mtu anatoa unabii, ataaminishwa na watu wote kuwa yeye ni mwenye dhambi na kuhukumiwa na wote,
Ekegusii: Korende onye bonsi bakobana, omonto otegeneti ogocha, gose omonto o isiko, orokigwe na bonsi ng’a nomomochi are, agambigwe na bonsi;

English: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
Kiswahili: nazo siri za moyo wake zitawekwa wazi. Kwa hiyo ataanguka chini na kumwabudu Mungu akikiri, “Kweli Mungu yuko katikati yenu!”
Ekegusii: naboigo obobisi bw’enkoro yaye bobe maiso marore; na igo aragwe maumama, na gosasiima Nyasae, atore ng’a ekeene Nyasae nigo are ase egati yaino.

English: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.
Kiswahili: Basi tuseme nini ndugu zangu? Mnapokutana pamoja, kila mmoja ana wimbo, au neno la mafundisho, au ufunuo, lugha mpya au atatafsiri. Mambo yote yatendeke kwa ajili ya kulijenga kanisa.
Ekegusii: Naki rende baminto? Komogosangererekana amo, kera oyomo nare nogoteera, gose okworokereria, gose okomaanorerwa, gose gokwana ase omonwa, gose koonchora, amang’ana onsi tiga akoreke ase okoagacha ekanisa.

English: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akinena kwa lugha, basi waseme watu wawili au watatu si zaidi, mmoja baada ya mwingine na lazima awepo mtu wa kutafsiri.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto ogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti, bakwane babere gose batato boka, korende kera omonto ase ribaga riaye, na oyomo aonchore.

English: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hakuna mtu wa kutafsiri, hao watu na wanyamaze kimya kanisani na wanene na nafsi zao wenyewe na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende onye oyokoonchora taiyo, tiga oyogokwana ase omonwa akire ase ekanisa, ekwanere bweka omonyene naende akwane na Nyasae.

English: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.
Kiswahili: Manabii wawili au watatu wanene na wengine wapime yale yasemwayo.
Ekegusii: Abaabani bakwane babere gose batato, na abande barenge amang’ana aya bakwana.

English: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote aliyeketi karibu, akipata ufunuo, basi yule wa kwanza na anyamaze.
Ekegusii: Korende oyonde oikaransete karaigorerwe ring’ana, oria bw’eritang’ani tiga akire.

English: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wote mnaweza kutoa unabii, mmoja baada ya mwingine, ili kila mtu apate kufundishwa na kutiwa moyo.
Ekegusii: Naki inwe mwensi namonyare kobana oyomo ase oyomo, erinde bonsi banyare kweorokereria, na bonsi baremigwe.

English: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,
Kiswahili: Roho za manabii huwatii manabii.
Ekegusii: Emeika y’ababani nigo ekoigwera ababani.

English: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu si Mungu wa machafuko bali ni Mungu wa amani. Kama ilivyo katika makusanyiko yote ya watakatifu,
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tari Nyasae bw’eburuburu, korende oyo bw’omorembe. Buna ere ase chikanisa chionsi chi’abachenu,

English: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,
Kiswahili: wanawake wanapaswa kuwa kimya kanisani. Hawaruhusiwi kusema, bali wanyenyekee kama sheria isemavyo.
Ekegusii: abakungu bakire ase chikanisa. Naki tibari ne ribaga ri’ogokwana, korende baigwere buna amachiiko agoteeba.

English: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”
Kiswahili: Kama wakitaka kuuliza kuhusu jambo lolote, wawaulize waume zao nyumbani. Kwa maana ni aibu kwa mwanamke kuzungumza kanisani.
Ekegusii: Onye barigetie kweorokereria ring’ana, tiga baborie abasacha babo inka. Naki nobosooku omokungu gokwana ase ekanisa.

English: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?
Kiswahili: Je, neno la Mungu lilianzia kwenu? Au ni ninyi tu ambao neno la Mungu limewafikia?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ring’ana ria Nyasae nasemore riarwete, gose ninwe mweka riaikerete?

English: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akidhani kwamba yeye ni nabii, au ana karama za rohoni, basi na akubali kwamba haya ninayoandika ni maagizo kutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Omonto karerore ng’a nomobani are, gose noyo bw’Omoika, tiga amanye ng’a aya nabarikeire namachiiko ’Omonene.

English: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akipuuza jambo hili yeye mwenyewe atapuuzwa.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto tarigeti koyamanya, tiga abe omoriri.

English: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, takeni sana kutoa unabii na msikataze watu kusema kwa lugha.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio baminto, rigia mono okobana, gose timokana ogokwana kw’emenwa.

English: Let all things be done decently and in order.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila kitu kitendeke kwa heshima na kwa utaratibu.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi akoreke ase obuya na ase omooroberio.

English: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
Kiswahili: Basi ndugu zangu nataka niwakumbushe kuhusu Injili niliyowahubiria, mkaipokea na ambayo katika hiyo mmesimama.
Ekegusii: Bono baminto, nkobainyoria nde enchiri eyio nabaranderetie; nero mwanyorete, na ase eyio nao moteneine,

English: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
Kiswahili: Kwa Injili hii mnaokolewa mkishikilia kwa uthabiti neno nililowahubiria ninyi. La sivyo, mmeamini katika ubatili.
Ekegusii: na ase eyio mwatoorigwe, onye mwabwatire mono amang’ana nabaranderetie. Onye taibo, rirorio nigo mwegenete bosa.

English: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yale niliyopokea ndiyo niliyowapa ninyi, kama yenye umuhimu wa kwanza: Kwamba Kristo alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, kama yasemavyo Maandiko,
Ekegusii: Naki ritang’ani nabarenterete amang’ana aya nanyorete inche omonyene, ng’a Kristo nigo akwete ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, buna amariiko agoteeba;

English: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
Kiswahili: ya kuwa alizikwa na alifufuliwa siku ya tatu, kama yasemavyo Maandiko,
Ekegusii: naende agatindekwa, erio akaboka rituko ria gatato, buna amariiko agoteeba;

English: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
Kiswahili: na kwamba alimtokea Kefa, kisha akawatokea wale kumi na wawili.
Ekegusii: naende akaorokera Kefa; naende na baria ikomi na babere.

English: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
Kiswahili: Baadaye akawatokea wale ndugu waumini zaidi ya 500 kwa pamoja, ambao wengi wao bado wako hai, ingawa wengine wamelala.
Ekegusii: Magega akaorokera abaminto goetania amagana atano amo. Abange ase abwo moyo bare nonya mbono, abande bakuure.

English: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,
Kiswahili: Ndipo akamtokea Yakobo na kisha mitume wote.
Ekegusii: Magega y’ayio akaorokera Yakobo, erio abatomwa bonsi.

English: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
Kiswahili: Mwisho wa wote, akanitokea mimi pia, ambaye ni kama aliyezaliwa si kwa wakati wake.
Ekegusii: Na omoerio akang’orokera nainche. Inche nigo inde buna oyoiboretwe ase ekero getare boronge.

English: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mimi ndiye mdogo kuliko mitume wote, nisiyestahili kuitwa mtume, kwa sababu nililitesa kanisa la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki inche nomoke ase abatomwa, ntagwenereti korokwa omotomwa, ekiagera nachandete ekanisa ya Nyasae.

English: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa neema ya Mungu nimekuwa hivi nilivyo na neema yake kwangu haikuwa kitu bure. Bali nilizidi sana kufanya kazi kuliko mitume wote, lakini haikuwa mimi, bali ni ile neema ya Mungu iliyokuwa pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Korende ase obuya bwa Nyasae nabeire buna inde; na obuya bwaye bore ase ’nde tibwarenge bosa. Korende kobua mono nakorire emeremo goetania bonsi, gose tari inche, korende obuya bwa Nyasae obore amo nainche.

English: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, kama ilikuwa mimi au wao, hili ndilo tunalohubiri, na hili ndilo mliloamini.
Ekegusii: Gaki onye ninche, gose mbaria, naboigo tokorandia, naboigo mwegenete.

English: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
Kiswahili: Basi kama tumehubiri ya kwamba Kristo alifufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, mbona baadhi yenu mnasema hakuna ufufuo wa wafu?
Ekegusii: Bono onye Kristo orandiigwe ase more buna nabogetigwe korwa ase abakuure, naki rende abande ase more bagoteeba ng’a kobokigwa kw’abakuure tikori?

English: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, basi hata Kristo hakufufuliwa.
Ekegusii: Korende onye okobokigwa kw’abakuure tikori, rirorio Kristo nere tabogetigwe.

English: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.
Kiswahili: Tena ikiwa Kristo hakufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, kuhubiri kwetu kumekuwa ni bure na imani yenu ni batili.
Ekegusii: Naende onye Kristo tabogetigwe, rirorio okorandia gwaito nokwa bosa, na okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa.

English: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, twaonekana kuwa mashahidi wa uongo kuhusu Mungu, kwa sababu tumeshuhudia kumhusu Mungu kwamba alimfufua Kristo kutoka kwa wafu, lakini hilo haliwezi kuwa kweli kama wafu hawafufuliwi.
Ekegusii: Ee, naintwe rirorio twarorekanire koba birori b’oborimo ba Nyasae, ekiagera twateebete ng’a Nyasae nigo abogetie Kristo, oyo rirorio tamobogetie, onye abakuure tibakobokigwa.

English: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama wafu hawafufuliwi, basi hata Kristo hajafufuka.
Ekegusii: Naki onye abakuure tibakobokigwa, rirorio Kristo nere tabogetigwe.

English: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
Kiswahili: Tena kama Kristo hajafufuliwa, imani yenu ni batili; nanyi bado mko katika dhambi zenu.
Ekegusii: Na onye Kristo tabogetigwe, okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa; nigo more nonya mbono ase ebibe biaino.

English: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, wote waliolala katika Kristo wamepotea.
Ekegusii: Naende nabwo bakwete ase Kristo basirire.

English: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa tumaini letu ndani ya Kristo ni kwa ajili ya maisha haya tu, sisi tunastahili kuhurumiwa kuliko watu wote.
Ekegusii: Onye nase obogima obo bwoka tosemeretie Kristo, rirorio intwe nabataka tore kobua abanto bonsi.

English: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.
Kiswahili: Lakini kweli Kristo amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, tunda la kwanza la wale wote waliolala.
Ekegusii: Korende bono nekeene ng’a Kristo obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure buna ogotongorwa kw’abakuure.

English: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile mauti ilivyokuja kwa njia ya mtu mmoja, vivyo hivyo, ufufuo wa wafu umekuja kwa njia ya mtu mmoja.
Ekegusii: Naki buna amakweri arentetwe nomonto, naboigo nokobokigwa kw’abakuure kwarentirwe nomonto.

English: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama vile katika Adamu watu wote wanakufa, vivyo hivyo katika Kristo wote watafanywa hai.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera buna ase Adamu bonsi bagokwa, naboigo nase Kristo bonsi nababe moyo,

English: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila mmoja kwa wakati wake: Kristo, tunda la kwanza kisha, wale walio wake, wakati atakapokuja.
Ekegusii: korende kera oyomo aase aye; Kristo agatongora, naende ekero arachiche, abare abaye nababe moyo.

English: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
Kiswahili: Ndipo mwisho utafika, wakati atakapomkabidhi Mungu Baba ufalme, akiisha angamiza kila utawala na kila mamlaka na nguvu.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo omoerio ochiche, ekero arae Nyasae Tata oborwoti, magega gasaririe kera obogambi na kera okobua ne chinguru.

English: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana lazima Kristo atawale mpaka awe amewaweka adui zake wote chini ya miguu yake.
Ekegusii: Naki negwenerete ere agambe, goika abeeke ababisa bonsi inse ase amagoro aye.

English: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.
Kiswahili: Adui wa mwisho atakayeangamizwa ni mauti.
Ekegusii: Omobisa bw’omoerio orasirigwe namakweri.

English: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu “ameweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu yake.” Lakini isemapo kwamba “vitu vyote” vimewekwa chini yake, ni wazi kwamba Mungu aliyetiisha vitu vyote chini ya Kristo hayumo miongoni mwa hivyo vilivyotiishwa.
Ekegusii: “Naki Nyasae obekire ebinto bionsi inse ase amagoro aye.” Korende ekero agoteeba, “Bionsi biabekirwe inse asare”, nigo amanyekanete ng’a Nyasae, oyobegete ebinto bionsi inse asare, tabariri ase ebinto ebio.

English: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
Kiswahili: Atakapokuwa amekwisha kuyafanya haya, ndipo Mwana mwenyewe atatiishwa chini yake yeye aliyetiisha vitu vyote, ili Mungu awe yote katika yote.
Ekegusii: Gaki ebinto bionsi kobiabekirwe inse asare, erio agwo Omwana omonyene nere nabekwe inse ase Nyasae, oyo obegete ebinto bionsi inse asare, erinde Nyasae abe nokobua ase bionsi.

English: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?
Kiswahili: Basi kama hakuna ufufuo, watafanyaje wale wabatizwao kwa ajili ya wafu? Kama wafu hawafufuliwi kamwe, mbona watu wanabatizwa kwa ajili yao?
Ekegusii: Inee! Aba bakobatiswa ase engencho y’abakuure, naki rende bagokora? Onye abakuure tibakoboka nonya ng’ake, nase ki bakobatiswa ase engencho yabo?

English: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
Kiswahili: Nasi kwa upande wetu kwa nini tunajihatarisha kila saa?
Ekegusii: Nase ki tore nemechando kera engaki?

English: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
Kiswahili: Kama majivuno yangu kwa ajili yenu katika Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu ni kweli, ndugu zangu, ninakufa kila siku.
Ekegusii: Ekeene baminto, ase ogwetogia kwane inde nakwo ase more ase Kristo Yeso Omonene oito, nigo ngokwa kera rituko.

English: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
Kiswahili: Kama kwa sababu za kibinadamu tu nilipigana na wanyama wakali huko Efeso, ningekuwa nimepata faida gani? Kama wafu hawafufuliwi, “Tuleni na kunywa, kwa kuwa kesho tutakufa.”
Ekegusii: Onye, nase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, nkarwana ne ching’iti chintindi aaria Efeso, inki erangwenere? Onye abakuure tibakoboka, “Tiga torie na konywa, ekiagera ankio natokwe.”

English: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
Kiswahili: Msidanganyike: “Ushirika na watu wabaya huharibu tabia njema.”
Ekegusii: Timong’aineka! Egosori embe nigo egosaria chingencho chingiya.

English: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
Kiswahili: Zindukeni mwe na akili kama iwapasavyo, wala msitende dhambi tena; kwa maana watu wengine hawamjui Mungu. Nasema mambo haya ili mwone aibu.
Ekegusii: Boka buna egwenerete ase oboronge, timokora ebibe naende. Naki abande tibamomanyeti Nyasae. Natebiire aya ase okobasookia.

English: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu anaweza kuuliza, “Wafu wafufuliwaje? Watakuwa na mwili wa namna gani?”
Ekegusii: Korende omonto naborie, “Naki abakuure baraboke? Naende mobere ki barache noro?”

English: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.
Kiswahili: Ninyi wapumbavu kiasi gani? Mpandacho hakiwi hai kama hakikufa.
Ekegusii: Omoriri oyo, eke ogosimeka aye, tikeri komera getakweti.

English: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
Kiswahili: Mpandapo, hampandi mwili ule utakao kuwa, bali mwapanda mbegu tu, pengine ya ngano au ya kitu kingine.
Ekegusii: Neke ogosimeka, tori gosimeka egento keria kegocha koba, korende embusuro yoka; onye nengano gose mbusuro ende yonsi.

English: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu huipa mbegu umbo kama alivyokusudia mwenyewe na kila aina ya mbegu huipa umbo lake.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae ayea ekieni buna anchete, na kera embusuro ayea ekieni kiaye.

English: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nyama zote si za aina moja. Binadamu wana nyama ya aina moja, wanyama wana aina nyingine, kadhalika ndege na samaki wana nyama tofauti.
Ekegusii: Chinyama chionsi tichiri echimo; korende echinde nechia Mwanyabaanto, echinde nechie ching’iti, echinde nechie chinyoni, na echinde nechie chinswe.

English: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.
Kiswahili: Pia kuna miili ya mbinguni na miili ya duniani, lakini fahari wa ile miili ya mbinguni ni wa aina moja na fahari wa ile miili ya duniani ni wa aina nyingine.
Ekegusii: Naende mbire igoro ebitongwa bitongire, na mbire ase ense ebitongwa bitongire, korende obonene bw’ebia igoro nigo bore ao, na obonene bw’ebia nse nigo bore ao.

English: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
Kiswahili: Jua lina fahari ya aina moja, mwezi nao una fahari yake na nyota pia, nazo nyota hutofautiana katika fahari.
Ekegusii: Obonene bw’erioba nigo bore ao, na obonene bw’omotienyi nigo bore ao, na obonene bwe ching’enang’eni nigo bore ao, naende ogwatananekana nkore ase egati ye ching’enang’eni chinyene ase obonene.

English: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa ufufuo wa wafu. Ule mwili wa kuharibika uliopandwa, utafufuliwa usioharibika,
Ekegusii: Naboigo nokobokigwa kw’abakuure. Osimekwa ase ogosareka, obokigwa ase ogotasareka.

English: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
Kiswahili: unapandwa katika aibu, unafufuliwa katika utukufu, unapandwa katika udhaifu, unafufuliwa katika nguvu,
Ekegusii: Osimekwa ase obosooku, obokigwa ase obonene; osimekwa ase oboreu, obokigwa ase chinguru.

English: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.
Kiswahili: unapandwa mwili wa asili, unafufuliwa mwili wa kiroho. Kama kuna mwili wa asili, basi kuna mwili wa kiroho pia.
Ekegusii: Omobere o Mwanyabaanto osimekwa, korende omobere bw’omoika obokigwa. Onye omobere o Mwanyabaanto oreo, naboigo noyo bw’omoika noreo.

English: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo imeandikwa, “Mtu wa kwanza Adamu alifanyika kiumbe hai”; Adamu wa mwisho, yeye ni roho iletayo uzima.
Ekegusii: Naboigo eriikire, “Omonto bw’eritang’ani Adamu akaba omonto ore moyo”, Adamu bw’omoerio akaba omoika bw’okoa obogima.

English: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.
Kiswahili: Lakini si ule wa kiroho uliotangulia, bali ni ule wa asili, kisha ule wa kiroho.
Ekegusii: Korende oria orenge bw’omoika, tari oro orenge bw’eritang’ani, korende noria bw’omobere o Mwanyabaanto orenge bw’eritang’ani; magega y’ayio oria bw’omoika.

English: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.
Kiswahili: Mtu wa kwanza aliumbwa kwa mavumbi ya ardhini, mtu wa pili alitoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Omonto bw’eritang’ani akarwa inse, agatongwa korwa ase amaroba; omonto o kabere akarwa igoro.

English: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
Kiswahili: Kama vile alivyokuwa yule wa ardhini, ndivyo walivyo wale walio wa ardhini; na kwa vile alivyo mtu yule aliyetoka mbinguni, ndivyo walivyo wale walio wa mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Buna omonto oyo bw’amaroba arenge, naboigo nab’amaroba bare; na buna omonto o igoro are, naboigo naba igoro bare.

English: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
Kiswahili: Kama vile tulivyochukua mfano wa mtu wa ardhini, ndivyo tutakavyochukua mfano wa yule mtu aliyetoka mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Na buna tobogoretie ekieni ki’oria bw’amaroba, naboigo torabogorie ekieni ki’oria o igoro.

English: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu nisemalo ni hili: nyama na damu haviwezi kuurithi ufalme wa Mungu, wala kuharibika kurithi kutokuharibika.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, aya nkobateebia naya, ng’a omobere na amanyinga tibikonyora omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae; gose ogosareka tigokonyora omwando bw’ogotasareka.

English: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni, nawaambia siri: Sote hatutalala, lakini sote tutabadilishwa
Ekegusii: Rigereria, aya nkobateebia nobobisi. Titogokwa intwe twensi, korende twensi natoonchorwe,

English: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
Kiswahili: ghafula, kufumba na kufumbua, parapanda ya mwisho itakapolia. Kwa kuwa parapanda italia, nao wafu watafufuliwa na miili isiyoharibika, nasi tutabadilishwa.
Ekegusii: ase ekero egesinini, okomiamia na okoramokia, ekero ki’egetureeri ki’omoerio. Naki egetureeri nakebuge, na abakuure nababokigwe, tibaaba nogosareka, na intwe natoonchorwe.

English: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mwili huu wa kuharibika lazima uvae kutokuharibika, nao huu wa kufa lazima uvae kutokufa.
Ekegusii: Naki ogosareka kwagweneire koboigwe ogotasareka, na ogokwa koboigwe ogotakwa.

English: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, mwili huu wa kuharibika utakapovaa kutokuharibika, nao huu mwili wa kufa utakapovaa kutokufa, ndipo lile neno lililoandikwa litakapotimia: “Mauti imemezwa kwa kushinda.”
Ekegusii: Ekero oyo bw’ogosareka oranyore ogotasareka, na oyo bw’ogokwa oranyore ogotakwa; erio naribe ring’ana riria ririikire, “Amakweri amerirwe ase okobua.”

English: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
Kiswahili: “Kuko wapi, ee mauti, kushinda kwako? Uko wapi, ee mauti, uchungu wako?”
Ekegusii: “Amakweri, ng’ai okobua kwao kore? Amakweri, ng’ai obororo bwao bore?”

English: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
Kiswahili: Uchungu wa mauti ni dhambi na nguvu ya dhambi ni sheria.
Ekegusii: Obororo bw’amakweri nebibe, ne chinguru chi’ebibe namachiiko.

English: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Lakini ashukuriwe Mungu, yeye atupaye ushindi kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende mbuya mono ase Nyasae, ere oyogotoa okobua goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu wapenzi, simameni imara, msitikisike, mzidi sana katika kuitenda kazi ya Bwana, kwa maana mnajua ya kuwa, kazi yenu katika Bwana si bure.
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, abanchwa, mobe ne chinguru, motari gotengechigwa, momente mono gokora emeremo y’Omonene ase amatuko onsi, momanye ng’a emeremo yaino ase Omonene teri bosa.

English: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
Kiswahili: Basi kuhusu changizo kwa ajili ya watakatifu: Kama nilivyoyaagiza makanisa ya Galatia, fanyeni vivyo hivyo.
Ekegusii: Bono ase amang’ana y’ogosangererigwa kw’ebiegwa ase abachenu, buna nachiigete abanto be chikanisa chia Galatia, nainwe mokore boigo.

English: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kwanza ya kila juma, kila mmoja wenu atenge kiasi cha fedha, kulingana na mapato yake na fedha hizo aziweke akiba, ili nitakapokuja pasiwe na lazima ya kufanya mchango.
Ekegusii: Ase kera rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, kera oyomo ase more abe okogaacha mwaye ensemo ase eki anyorire, koreng’ana buna aranyare, erinde ebiegwa tibisangererigwa ekero nachire.

English: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nitakapowasili, nitawapa wale mtakaowachagua barua za kuwatambulisha, ili kuwatuma wapeleke zawadi zenu huko Yerusalemu.
Ekegusii: Inche kondaike nimbatome ne riruube aba morachore, baire ebiegwa biaino goika Yerusalemu.

English: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
Kiswahili: Kama ikionekana ni vyema na mimi niende, basi hao watu watafuatana nami.
Ekegusii: Onye ngwenerete ngende inche, rirorio nabagende amo nainche.

English: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kupitia Makedonia nitakuja kwenu, maana ninakusudia kupitia Makedonia.
Ekegusii: Korende ninchiche ase more, magega konaetire egati ya Makedonia, ekiagera nindengereretie goeta egati ya Makedonia.

English: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
Kiswahili: Huenda nitakaa nanyi kwa muda, au hata kukaa nanyi kipindi chote cha baridi, ili mweze kunisaidia katika safari yangu, popote niendapo.
Ekegusii: Aande gose nimenye amo nainwe, gose nimenye seino ekero gi’etoigo, monyare gonkooba ekero kende gionsi aase ndigetie kogenda.

English: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sitaki niwaone sasa na kupita tu; natarajia kuwa nanyi kwa muda wa kutosha, kama Bwana akipenda.
Ekegusii: Naki tindigeti kororana nainwe ase ogoeta gwoka, ekiagera ninganetie komenya seino egeka getari geke, Omonene karanche.

English: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
Kiswahili: Lakini nitakaa Efeso mpaka wakati wa Pentekoste,
Ekegusii: Bono nimenye ase Efeso goika rituko rinene ria Pentekosti;

English: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
Kiswahili: kwa maana mlango mkubwa umefunguliwa kwangu kufanya kazi yenye matunda, nako huko kuna adui wengi wanaonipinga.
Ekegusii: naki naigoreirwe egesieri ekegare keraarente okwama, korende abange mbareo bakong’amereria.

English: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Timotheo atakuja kwenu, hakikisheni kwamba hana hofu yoyote akiwa nanyi, kwa sababu anafanya kazi ya Bwana, kama mimi nifanyavyo.
Ekegusii: Ekero Timotheo arache, rigereria ng’a amenye amo nainwe atari nobwoba, ekiagera nigo agokora emeremo y’Omonene buna inche.

English: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
Kiswahili: Basi asiwepo mtu atakayekataa kumpokea. Msafirisheni kwa amani ili aweze kunijia tena. Namtarajia pamoja na ndugu.
Ekegusii: Gaki monto onde tamochaya, korende momokoobe ase omorembe, erinde airane ase ’nde, ekiagera nimoganyete amo nabaminto.

English: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa habari za ndugu yetu Apolo, nimemsihi kwa bidii aje kwenu pamoja na hao ndugu. Ingawa alikuwa hapendi kabisa kuja sasa, lakini atakuja apatapo nafasi.
Ekegusii: Korende ase amang’ana ’Apolo oyominto, nigo namosorora mono achiche ase more amo nabwo baminto bande, korende ere tarigeti gocha bono. Nachiche karanyore ribaga.

English: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
Kiswahili: Kesheni, simameni imara katika imani, fanyeni kiume, kuweni mashujaa kuweni hodari.
Ekegusii: Renda, motenene bokong’u ase okwegena kwaino, mobe abasacha, mobe ne chinguru.

English: Let all that you do be done in love.
Kiswahili: Fanyeni kila kitu katika upendo.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aino onsi akoreke ase obwanchani.

English: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnajua kwamba watu wa nyumbani mwa Stefana ndio waliokuwa wa kwanza kuamini katika Akaya, nao wamejitoa kwa ajili ya kuwahudumia watakatifu. Ndugu nawasihi,
Ekegusii: Bono baminto, mwamanyire ng’a abanto ba nyomba mwa Stefana nigo barenge ab’eritang’ani koonchoka agwo Akaya; na barabwo bebekire ase emeremo y’ogokorera abachenu.

English: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
Kiswahili: mjitie katika kuwahudumia watu kama hawa na kila mmoja aingiaye kwenye kazi na kuifanya kwa bidii.
Ekegusii: Nabasoroire baigwere abanto buna aba, na kera omonto oyogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo ase ogwechanda.

English: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
Kiswahili: Nilifurahi wakati Stefana, Fortunato na Akaiko walipofika, kwa sababu wamenipatia yale niliyopungukiwa kutoka kwenu.
Ekegusii: Inche nagokire ase ogocha gwa Stefana na Fortunato, na Akaiko, ekiagera bamentete amange aya naremeire korwa ase more.

English: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa waliiburudisha roho yangu na zenu pia. Watu kama hawa wanastahili kutambuliwa.
Ekegusii: Naki mbansasogetie ase omoika one, na emeika yaino yonsi. Gaki bainyore mono abanto buna abwo.

English: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
Kiswahili: Makanisa ya Asia yanawasalimu. Akila na Prisila, pamoja na kanisa lililoko nyumbani kwao wanawasalimu sana katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abanto be chikanisa chi’Asia baabakwanirie. Akwila na Priskila baabakwanirie mono ase Omonene, amo n’ekanisa ere ime ase enyomba yabo.

English: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
Kiswahili: Ndugu wote walioko hapa wanawasalimu. Salimianeni kwa busu takatifu.
Ekegusii: Abaminto bonsi baabakwanirie. Kwanania na konyunyuntana ase obochenu.

English: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
Kiswahili: Mimi, Paulo, naandika salamu hizi kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane inche Paulo ase okoboko kwane omonyene.

English: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote hampendi Bwana Yesu Kristo, na alaaniwe. Bwana wetu, njoo.
Ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi otamwancheti Omonene nabe oragererigwe. Inchuo, Omonene oito!

English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
Kiswahili: Neema ya Bwana Yesu iwe nanyi.
Ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yeso bobe amo nainwe.

English: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
Kiswahili: Upendo wangu uwe nanyi nyote katika Kristo Yesu. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bwane bobe amo nainwe mwensi ase Kristo Yeso. Amina.

English: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
Kiswahili: Barua hii ni kutoka kwangu mimi Paulo, mtume wa Kristo Yesu kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, na Timotheo ndugu yetu, Kwa kanisa la Mungu lililoko Korintho, pamoja na watakatifu wote walioko Akaya yote:
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, amo noyominto Timotheo nkobariikera tore inwe abekanisa ya Nyasae ere ase Korinto amo n’abanto bonsi ba Nyasae abare ase ense yonsi y’Akaya.

English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
Kiswahili: Ahimidiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, Baba wa huruma na Mungu wa faraja yote.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, Tata Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Tata bw’amaabera, Nyasae bw’okoremia gwonsi, atogigwe.

English: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
Kiswahili: Yeye hutufariji katika taabu zetu, ili tuweze kuwafariji walio katika taabu yoyote kwa faraja ambayo sisi wenyewe tumepokea kutoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agotoremia ase emechando yaito yonsi, erinde naintwe tonyare koremia baria bare ase emechando ende yonsi, ase okoremia okwo twaremigwe intwe abanyene na Nyasae.

English: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mateso ya Kristo yanavyozidi ndani ya maisha yetu, hivyo ndivyo faraja yetu inavyofurika kwa njia ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki buna emechando ya Kristo yatobucheire, naboigo okoremigwa gwaito gwatobucheire ase enchera ya Kristo.

English: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
Kiswahili: Kama tunataabika, ni kwa ajili ya faraja na wokovu wenu; kama tukifarijiwa, ni kwa ajili ya faraja yenu, iwaleteayo saburi ya mateso yale yale yanayotupata.
Ekegusii: Korende onye intwe tore ase emechando, nigo ere ase okobanyorera inwe okoremigwa na ogotooreka, na onye intwe tokoremigwa, nigo ere ase okobanyorera inwe okoremigwa, erinde monyore chinguru na okoremereria gw’okobogoria emechando eria eria tobabogoreretie intwe.

English: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
Kiswahili: Nalo tumaini letu kwenu ni thabiti, kwa sababu tunajua kwamba kama vile mnavyoshiriki mateso yetu, ndivyo pia mnavyoshiriki katika faraja yetu.
Ekegusii: Na ogosemeria gwaito ase engencho yaino nigo goteneine bokong’u, ekiagera twamanyire ng’a buna more ababwatani b’emechando eria, naboigo morabe ababwatani ase okoremigwa koria.

English: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
Kiswahili: Ndugu wapendwa, hatutaki mkose kujua kuhusu zile taabu tulizopata huko Asia. Kwa maana tulilemewa na mizigo sana, kiasi cha kushindwa kuvumilia, hata tulikata tamaa ya kuishi.
Ekegusii: Naki baminto, nigo twanchete momanye amang’ana ’emechando eria yatonyorete Asia. Chigurube chiria nigo chiaetanetie chinguru chiaito, goika tokerusia moyo koba moyo.

English: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
Kiswahili: Kwa kweli, mioyoni mwetu tulihisi tumekabiliwa na hukumu ya kifo, ili tusijitegemee sisi wenyewe bali tumtegemee Mungu afufuaye wafu.
Ekegusii: Ee, intwe abanyene nigo twarenge nekina ki’amakweri ase emioyo yaito, erinde titwesemeria intwe abanyene, korende tosemerie Nyasae oyokobokia abakuure;

English: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,
Kiswahili: Yeye aliyetuokoa kwenye hatari kubwa ya kifo na atatuokoa tena. Kwake yeye tumeweka tumaini letu kwamba ataendelea kutuokoa.
Ekegusii: oyototooretie korwa ase amakweri amanene buna aria, naende natotoorie ase ekero kegochi‐gocha. Ere ntomosemeretie ng’a nagenderere gototooria,

English: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
Kiswahili: Kama vile mlivyoungana kusaidiana nasi katika maombi, hivyo wengi watatoa shukrani kwa niaba yetu kwa ajili ya baraka za neema tulizopata kwa majibu ya maombi ya wengi.
Ekegusii: ekero inwe boigo mogotokonya amo ase ogotosabera. Ase igo, abanto abange baakere Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaito, ase obuya obo twaeirwe, ekiagera abange bagotosabera.

English: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
Kiswahili: Basi haya ndiyo majivuno yetu: Dhamiri yetu inatushuhudia kwamba tumeenenda katika ulimwengu na hasa katika uhusiano wetu na ninyi, katika utakatifu na uaminifu utokao kwa Mungu. Hatukufanya hivyo kwa hekima ya kidunia bali kwa neema ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki ogwetogia gwaito nakwo oko, ng’a chinkoro chiaito ime nigo chigotworokia, ng’a ase obogima bwaito ase ense eye na mono kobua ase egati yaino, nigo tware kogamberwa nobochenu na oborabu bw’omoyo bokorwa ase Nyasae, tari ase obong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto, korende ase obuya bwa Nyasae.

English: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hatuwaandikii mambo ambayo hamwezi kusoma au kuyaelewa. Natumaini kwamba,
Ekegusii: Naki titobarikereti inwe kende, otatiga ring’ana eri rioka moranyare gosoma na komanya. Na inche nasemeirie ng’a omoerio namonyare korimanya,

English: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
Kiswahili: kama vile mlivyotuelewa kwa sehemu, mtakuja kuelewa kwa ukamilifu ili mweze kujivuna kwa ajili yetu, kama na sisi tutakavyojivuna kwa ajili yenu katika siku ya Bwana Yesu.
Ekegusii: buna motomanyete ensemo, ng’a intwe nigo tore ogwetogia kwaino, buna inwe more ase tore ase rituko riria ri’Omonene Yeso.

English: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nilikuwa na uhakika wa mambo haya, nilitaka nije kwenu kwanza, ili mpate faida mara mbili.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera narenge nobomaene obo nkarigia gocha ase more agwo ritang’ani, erinde monyore ogosesenigwa ara kabere.

English: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.
Kiswahili: Nilipanga kuwatembelea nikiwa safarini kwenda Makedonia na kurudi tena kwenu nikitoka Makedonia, ili mnisafirishe katika safari yangu ya kwenda Uyahudi.
Ekegusii: Ninganetie goetera seino ekero nkogenda Makedonia, naende nkorwa Makedonia ning’iranere seino, erinde monkoobe ase orogendo rwane gochia Boyahudi.

English: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”
Kiswahili: Nilipopanga jambo hili, je, nilikuwa kigeugeu? Au ninafanya mipango yangu kwa hali ya mwili, ili niseme, “Ndiyo, ndiyo” na “Siyo, siyo” wakati huo huo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ekero narengereretie gokora aya, inarenge ne chitang’u‐tang’u koroisia emeroberio yane? Gose nigo nayeroisetie buna omonto bw’ense ore ang’e goteeba, “Ee, ee”, na, “Yaya, Yaya” ase chingaki echimo?

English: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”
Kiswahili: Hakika kama Mungu alivyo mwaminifu, maneno yetu kwenu hayajawa “Ndiyo na Siyo.”
Ekegusii: Korende buna Nyasae are omwegenwa, ring’ana riaito ase more tiriarenge “Ee” na “Yaya.”

English: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Yesu Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu, ambaye tulimhubiri kwenu: Mimi, Silvano na Timotheo, hakuwa “Ndiyo” na “Siyo,” bali kwake yeye siku zote ni “Ndiyo.”
Ekegusii: Naki Omwana o Nyasae, Yeso Kristo, oyo inche na Silivano, na Timotheo, twarandetie ase egati yaino tabeete “Ee” na “Yaya”, korende asare “Ee” nero ereo botambe.

English: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ahadi zote za Mungu zilizo katika Kristo ni “Ndiyo.” Kwa sababu hii ni kwake yeye tunasema “Amen” kwa utukufu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki chiira chionsi chia Nyasae nigo chire “Ee” ime asare; nakio gekogera togokwana “Amina” ase Yeso Kristo ase okoa Nyasae obonene.

English: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,
Kiswahili: Basi ni Mungu atufanyaye sisi pamoja nanyi kusimama imara katika Kristo. Ametutia mafuta
Ekegusii: Gaki Nyasae oyotokong’irie amo nainwe ase Kristo; nere otochorete,

English: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
Kiswahili: kwa kututia muhuri wake na kutupa Roho wake mioyoni mwetu kuwa rehani kwa ajili ya kututhibitishia kile kijacho.
Ekegusii: naende agatobeeka ekemanyererio kiaye, agatoa Omoika oye ase chinkoro chiaito okaba intenenera.

English: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.
Kiswahili: Mungu ni shahidi wangu kwamba ilikuwa ni kwa ajili ya kuwahurumia ninyi sikurudi Korintho.
Ekegusii: Korende inche nigo nkorigia Nyasae ambere kirori, ng’a ase okobarorera inwe amaabera tindagenda Korinto.

English: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba tunatawala imani yenu, bali twatenda kazi pamoja nanyi kwa ajili ya furaha yenu, kwa sababu ni kwa imani mwasimama imara.
Ekegusii: Tari ng’a nkogambera tore okwegena kwaino; korende nigo togokora emeremo amo nainwe ase omogooko oino, ekiagera moteneine bokong’u ase okwegena.

English: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nilikusudia moyoni mwangu nisifanye ziara nyingine yenye kuwaumiza ninyi.
Ekegusii: Korende nkarengereria ase omoyo one, ng’a tingocha seino naende ase okobaichania.

English: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama nikiwahuzunisha ninyi, ni nani aliyebaki wa kunifurahisha isipokuwa ninyi ambao nimewahuzunisha?
Ekegusii: Naki onye inche nkobaichania, gaki ning’o orangokie, otatiga oria naichanirie?

English: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.
Kiswahili: Niliandika hivyo kama nilivyofanya, ili nikija nisihuzunishwe na wale watu ambao wangenifanya nifurahi. Nina uhakika na ninyi nyote, kwamba wote mngeshiriki furaha yangu.
Ekegusii: Inche nigo nabaiikerete ring’ana eri, erinde ngocha ting’ichanigwa na baria bagwenerete kongokia, naki ninsemeretie igoro yaino inwe mwensi, ng’a omogooko one noro oyoino mwensi.

English: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana niliwaandikia kutokana na dhiki kubwa na kutaabika sana kwa moyo wangu tena kwa machozi mengi, shabaha yangu si ili niwasababishe mhuzunike bali kuwaonyesha kina cha upendo wangu kwenu.
Ekegusii: Naki ase emechando emenge na ase obororo bw’enkoro, naende ase amariga amange nigo nabarikerete, tari ng’a moichanigwe, korende monyare komanya obwanchani bwane obonge inde nabwo ase more.

English: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mtu yeyote amesababisha huzuni, kwa kiasi fulani hakunihuzunisha mimi kama vile alivyowahuzunisha ninyi nyote, ili nisiwe mkali kupita kiasi.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omonto orentire ogoichania, tang’ichaneti inche bweka, korende ase ensemo obaichanirie nainwe mwensi. Ase ogokwana igo, tinkoyakong’ia mono.

English: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;
Kiswahili: Adhabu hii aliyopewa na wengi inamtosha.
Ekegusii: Egesusuro eke omonto onga buna oyio aetwe nabange, nakio kiamoisanete.

English: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.
Kiswahili: Basi sasa badala yake, inawapasa kumsamehe na kumfariji, ili asigubikwe na huzuni kupita kiasi.
Ekegusii: Ribaga ri’aya mbuya mwabere omonto buna oyio na komoremia, tabaisa kobugwa nogoichana, erinde erusie moyo.

English: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, nawasihi, mpate kuuthibitisha tena upendo wenu kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nabasoroire momworokie obwanchani bwaino.

English: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
Kiswahili: Sababu ya kuwaandikia ni kuona kama mngeweza kushinda hilo jaribio na kutii katika kila jambo.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio kiagerete nkabariikera, erinde mbateeme na komanya gose mwabeire abaigweri ase amang’ana onsi.

English: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
Kiswahili: Kama ninyi mkimsamehe mtu yeyote, mimi pia nimemsamehe. Kile nilichosamehe, kama kulikuwa na kitu chochote cha kusamehe, nimekwisha kusamehe mbele ya Kristo kwa ajili yenu,
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi morabere inwe, nainche nimwabere. Ekero nabeire omonto, onye namwabeire egento igo namwabeire ase engencho yaino ase obosio bwa Kristo,

English: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
Kiswahili: ili Shetani asitushinde. Kwa maana hatuachi kuzijua hila zake.
Ekegusii: Saitani tabaisa gotobua; naki intwe titokomocha komanya obong’ainereria bwaye.

English: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
Kiswahili: Basi nilipofika Troa kuhubiri Injili ya Kristo na kukuta kwamba Bwana alikuwa amenifungulia mlango,
Ekegusii: Gaki ekero naigete Teroa ase engencho y’okorandia enchiri ya Kristo, nkaigorerwa egesieri n’Omonene,

English: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.
Kiswahili: bado nilikuwa sina utulivu akilini mwangu kwa sababu sikumkuta ndugu yangu Tito huko. Hivyo niliagana nao nikaenda Makedonia.
Ekegusii: korende tinanyora ogotimoka ase omoyo one, ekiagera ntanyorete oyominto Tito aroro. Erio nkabateebia ng’a batigare buya, nkaimoka nkagenda Makedonia.

English: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu ashukuriwe, yeye ambaye siku zote hutufanya tuandamane kwa ushindi tukiwa ndani ya Kristo. Naye kupitia kwetu hueneza kila mahali harufu nzuri ya kumjua yeye.
Ekegusii: Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, ere oyogotoraa ase okobua okonene botambe ase Kristo, naende oyogosokia rimisu rigiya goetera ase tore, erinde bamomanye kera aase.

English: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sisi kwa Mungu ni harufu nzuri ya manukato ya Kristo miongoni mwa wale wanaookolewa na kwa wale wanaopotea.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe nigo tore ogotioka okuya gwa Kristo ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ase abwo bagotoorigwa, na ase abwo bagosira;

English: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
Kiswahili: Kwa wale wanaopotea, sisi ni harufu ya mauti iletayo mauti; lakini kwa wale wanaookolewa, sisi ni harufu nzuri iletayo uzima. Ni nani awezaye mambo hayo?
Ekegusii: ase abwo bagosira ogotioka kw’amakweri gokorenta amakweri; ase abwo bagotoorigwa ogotioka kw’obogima gokorenta obogima. Ning’o oraisane ase amang’ana aya?

English: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
Kiswahili: Tofauti na watu wengine wengi, sisi hatufanyi biashara na Neno la Mungu kwa ajili ya kupata faida. Kinyume chake, katika Kristo tunalisema Neno la Mungu kwa unyoofu, kama watu tuliotumwa kutoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe titori buna abange abagokora okoonchorana okobe ase ring’ana ria Nyasae; korende buna abanto bagokwana ase oborabu bw’omoyo, buna abanto batomirwe na Nyasae. Ase obosio bwa Nyasae, nigo togokwana, tore ime ase Kristo.

English: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
Kiswahili: Je, tunaanza tena kujisifu wenyewe? Au tunahitaji kupata barua za utambulisho kwenu au kutoka kwenu, kama watu wengine?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ntwachakire naende gwetogia intwe abanyene? Gose intwe ntogwenerete, buna abande, konyora amarube are nogotogigwa gocha ase more, gose ayakorwa ase more?

English: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
Kiswahili: Ninyi wenyewe ndio barua yetu iliyoandikwa katika mioyo yetu, inayojulikana na kusomwa na kila mtu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanyene neriruube riaito ririikire ase chinkoro chiaito, rimanyekanete na gosomwa nabaanto bonsi.

English: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mwadhihirisha wazi kwamba ninyi ni barua itokayo kwa Kristo, matokeo ya huduma yetu, ambayo haikuandikwa kwa wino bali kwa Roho wa Mungu aliye hai, si katika vibao vya mawe, bali katika vibao ambavyo ni mioyo ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Igo momanyekanete buya ng’a mwabeire riruube ria Kristo, erire emeremo y’ogokora gwaito, ririikire tari ase egwino, korende nase Omoika o Nyasae ore moyo; tari ase chibao chi’amagena, korende ase chibao chie chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto.

English: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo tumaini tulilo nalo mbele za Mungu kwa njia ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Okwo nakwo ogosemeria tore nakwo ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase Kristo;

English: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,
Kiswahili: Si kwamba sisi tunafikiri kuwa tunaweza kufanya jambo lolote wenyewe, lakini nguvu yetu inatoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: tari ng’a ntwoisanerete intwe abanyene korengereria ring’ana rinde rionsi rikorwa ase tore abanyene, korende ogoisanera gwaito nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae,

English: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
Kiswahili: Ndiye alituwezesha sisi kuwa wahudumu wa Agano Jipya: si wa andiko, bali wa Roho; kwa kuwa andiko huua bali Roho hutia uzima.
Ekegusii: oyotoisaneirie koba abasomba b’okobwatana okoyia; tari ase ririiko, korende ase Omoika. Naki ririiko nigo rigoita, korende Omoika orua obogima.

English: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa ile huduma iliyoleta mauti, iliyoandikwa kwa herufi juu ya jiwe ilikuja kwa utukufu, hata Waisraeli wakawa hawawezi kuutazama uso wa Mose kwa sababu ya ule utukufu wake ingawa ulikuwa ni wa kufifia,
Ekegusii: Bono onye ogokora kw’amakweri kore ase amariiko, ayariikire chinuguta na komang’erwa ase amagena, gwachete ase obonene, goika Abaisraeli tibanyara korigereria obosio bwa Musa, ase engencho y’obonene bw’obosio bwaye; na obonene obwo bogaeta,

English: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?
Kiswahili: je, huduma ya Roho haitakuwa na utukufu zaidi?
Ekegusii: Inee, ogokora kw’Omoika tigokoba nobonene goetania boria?

English: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa huduma ile inayowahukumu wanadamu ina utukufu, je, ile huduma iletayo haki haitakuwa ya utukufu zaidi?
Ekegusii: Naki onye ogokora gw’ekiina kwarenge nobonene, igo ogokora kw’oboronge nkore nobonene kobua mono.

English: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kile kilichokuwa na utukufu sasa hakina utukufu ukilinganisha na huu utukufu unaozidi wa Agano Jipya.
Ekegusii: Naki keria kiarenge nobonene tikegwatorwa bono ng’a nkere nobonene ase engencho y’obonene boria bore obonene kobua.

English: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kile kilichokuwa kinafifia kilikuja kwa utukufu, je, si zaidi utukufu wa kile kinachodumu?
Ekegusii: Ekiagera onye boria bwaetete bwarenge nobonene bwaye, boria boreo botambe mbore nobonene kobua mono.

English: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa tunalo tumaini hili, tuna ujasiri sana.
Ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera tore nogosemeria kore buna oko, iga tore noboremu obonge gatogokwana.

English: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.
Kiswahili: Sisi si kama Mose, ambaye ilimpasa kuweka utaji ili kufunika uso wake ili Waisraeli wasiuone ule mngʼao uliokuwa juu yake hadi ulipofifia na hatimaye kutoweka.
Ekegusii: Titogokora buna Musa oyotubete obosio bwaye, erinde Abaisraeli tibanyara korigereria mono omoerio bw’obonene boria bwarenge goeta.

English: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.
Kiswahili: Lakini akili zao zilipumbazwa, kwa maana mpaka leo utaji ule ule hufunika wakati Agano la Kale linasomwa. Huo utaji haujaondolewa, kwa maana ni katika Kristo peke yake unaondolewa.
Ekegusii: Korende ebirengererio biabo bigakong’igwa. Naki nonya ngoika rituko ria reero, ekero amariiko y’okobwatana ogokoro agosomwa, egietubo ekio ekio keba tigekorusigwa, ekiagera ase Kristo bweka kiarusigwe.

English: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
Kiswahili: Hata leo Sheria ya Mose inaposomwa, utaji hufunika mioyo yao.
Ekegusii: Nonya ndero ekero amachiiko a Musa agosomwa, egietubo keria ngetubete ase chinkoro chiabo.

English: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
Kiswahili: Lakini wakati wowote mtu anapomgeukia Bwana, utaji unaondolewa.
