Ekegusii: Korende ekero omonto akoonchokera Omonene egietubo keria nigo gekorusigwa.

English: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
Kiswahili: Basi Bwana ndiye Roho. Mahali alipo Roho wa Bwana hapo pana uhuru.
Ekegusii: Bono Omonene nere Omoika; na aase Omoika bw’Omonene ore, agwo nao obosibore bore.

English: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Nasi sote, tukiwa na nyuso zisizotiwa utaji tunadhihirisha utukufu wa Bwana, kama kwenye kioo. Nasi tunabadilishwa ili tufanane naye, toka utukufu hadi utukufu mkuu zaidi, utokao kwa Bwana, ambaye ndiye Roho.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe twensi abatokorigereria obonene bw’Omonene namaiso atatubiri, nigo tokorora buna ase ekerore obonene obwo. Nigo tokoonchorwa koba buna omogwekano oye, na kogenda korwa ase obonene goika ase obonene. Aya nigo agokorwa n’Omonene oyore Omoika.

English: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa tuna huduma hii kwa rehema za Mungu, hatukati tamaa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera tore nobosomba obo koreng’ana namaabera a Nyasae aya twanyorire, titokwa emioyo.

English: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
Kiswahili: Tumekataa mambo ya siri na ya aibu, wala hatufuati njia za udanganyifu, tukichanganya Neno la Mungu na uongo. Kinyume cha hayo, tunadhihirisha kweli waziwazi na kujitambulisha wenyewe kwenye dhamiri ya kila mtu mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Twangire amang’ana y’obosooku ayabisegete, gose titori gotaara ase obong’ainereria, gose gokorera ring’ana ria Nyasae noborimo. Korende ase okoorokia ayare ay’ekeene tweorokirie ase abanto bonsi ase okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime, ng’a ntore nekeene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,
Kiswahili: Hata nayo Injili yetu kama imetiwa utaji, ni kwa wale tu wanaopotea.
Ekegusii: Korende onye enchiri yaito yabisekanete, nigo yabisekanete ase abwo bagosira.

English: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari yao, mungu wa dunia hii amepofusha akili za wasioamini, ili wasione nuru ya Injili ya utukufu wa Kristo, aliye sura ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio enyasae y’ense eye yaukoirie ebirengererio bi’abwo bategeneti, erinde omobaso bw’enchiri y’obonene bwa Kristo, oyore ekieni kia Nyasae, tobaikera.

English: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hatujihubiri sisi wenyewe ila tunamhubiri Yesu Kristo kuwa ni Bwana na sisi ni watumishi wenu kwa ajili ya Yesu.
Ekegusii: Naki titori kwerandia intwe abanyene, korende Kristo Yeso buna Omonene, na intwe abanyene buna abasomba baino ase engencho ya Yeso.

English: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu, yeye aliyesema, “Nuru na ingʼae gizani,” ameifanya nuru yake ingʼae mioyoni mwetu ili kutupatia nuru ya maarifa ya utukufu wa Mungu katika uso wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae oyoteebete, “Omobaso nobare korwa ase omosunte”, nere obarire ase chinkoro chiaito ime, atoe omobaso bwe chisemi chi’obonene bwa Nyasae ase obosio bwa Kristo.

English: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.
Kiswahili: Lakini tunayo hazina hii katika vyombo vya udongo, ili ijulikane wazi kwamba uwezo huu wa ajabu unatoka kwa Mungu wala si kwetu.
Ekegusii: Korende ntore nobotenenku obo ime ase ebibekerero bi’amaroba, erinde aorokigwe ng’a okobua okonene gwe chinguru nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae, gose tikori korwa ase tore intwe abanyene.

English: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
Kiswahili: Twataabika kila upande lakini hatuangamizwi; twaona wasiwasi lakini hatukati tamaa;
Ekegusii: Korwa ase chinsemo chionsi nigo tokomigwa, korende titori komigeka; iga togoichanigwa, korende titogokwa emioyo,

English: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
Kiswahili: twateswa lakini hatuachwi; twatupwa chini lakini hatupondwi.
Ekegusii: iga togochandwa, korende titori gotigwa; iga togoakwa inse, korende titori gosirigwa.

English: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
Kiswahili: Siku zote twachukua katika mwili kufa kwake Yesu ili kwamba uzima wa Yesu uweze kudhihirika katika miili yetu.
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo tokobogoria ase emebere yaito ogokwa kwa Yeso, erinde obogima bwa Yeso naborobwo boorokigwe ase emebere yaito.

English: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sisi tulio hai siku zote tumetolewa tufe kwa ajili ya Yesu, ili kwamba uzima wake upate kudhihirishwa katika mwili wetu upatikanao na mauti.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe ekero tore moyo, amatuko onsi nigo tokoruegwa tokwe ase engencho ya Yeso, erinde obogima bwa Yeso boorokigwe ase emebere yaito eyekonyorwa namakweri.

English: So then death works in us, but life in you.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, mauti inatenda kazi ndani yetu, bali uzima unatenda kazi ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: Gaki amakweri nigo agokora emeremo ime yaito, korende obogima ime yaino.

English: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,
Kiswahili: Imeandikwa, “Niliamini, kwa hiyo nimesema.” Kwa roho yule yule wa imani pia tuliamini na hivyo tunasema,
Ekegusii: Naboigo naintwe, ekiagera tore n’Omoika oria oria bw’okwegena buna eriikire, “Negenete, na ase engencho eyio ngakwana”, igo twegenire, na ase engencho eyio nigo togokwana.

English: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu tunajua kwamba yeye aliyemfufua Bwana Yesu kutoka kwa wafu, atatufufua sisi pia pamoja na Yesu na kutuleta sisi pamoja nanyi mbele zake.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a ere oyobogetie Omonene Yeso natobokie naintwe amo na Yeso, na atorente amo nainwe ase obosio bwaye.

English: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
Kiswahili: Haya yote ni kwa faida yenu, ili kwamba neema ile inavyowafikia watu wengi zaidi na zaidi, ipate kusababisha shukrani nyingi kwa utukufu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki amang’ana onsi nigo agokorwa ase engencho yaino, erinde obuya obwo bomentwe ase abwo abange, ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono komentwe, na Nyasae abakwe.

English: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, hatukati tamaa. Ingawa utu wetu wa nje unachakaa, utu wetu wa ndani unafanywa upya siku kwa siku.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, titogokwa emioyo; korende nonya omonto oito o isiko ogosarigwa, omonto oito o ime akorwe omoyia rituko ase rituko.

English: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana dhiki yetu nyepesi iliyo ya kitambo inatutayarisha kwa ajili ya utukufu wa milele unaozidi kuwa mwingi kupita kiasi,
Ekegusii: Naki emechando yaito eyere y’ekero egeke gioka nemegusu, egotoroiseria obonene bwa kare na kare obore obonge mono kobua.

English: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu hatuangalii yale yanayoweza kuonekana bali yale yasiyoweza kuonekana. Kwa maana yale yanayoweza kuonekana ni ya kitambo tu, bali yale yasiyoweza kuonekana ni ya milele.
Ekegusii: Titorigereria ebinto ebikororekana, korende ebitakororekana; naki ebikororekana nebi’ekero egeke gioka, korende ebitakororekana nebia kare na kare.

English: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana twajua kama hema yetu ya dunia tunayoishi ikiharibiwa, tunalo jengo kutoka kwa Mungu, nyumba iliyo ya milele kule mbinguni, isiyojengwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Naki twamanyire ng’a enyomba yaito ere buna eema eyere ey’ense eye, ekero erasarigwe ntore noboagacho borwete ase Nyasae, enyomba etaagachiri namaboko, eyere igoro kare na kare.

English: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
Kiswahili: Katika hema hii twalia kwa uchungu, tukitamani kuvikwa makao yetu ya mbinguni,
Ekegusii: Naki intwe ase enyomba eye iga togwechanda, ntore namaiga koboyigwa obomenyo bwaito aaria igoro.

English: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa tukiisha kuvikwa hatutaonekana tena kuwa uchi.
Ekegusii: Ekero twaboyigwe titokororekana tore getirianda.

English: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tukiwa bado katika hema hii twalia kwa uchungu na kulemewa, kwa sababu hatutaki kuvuliwa bali kuvikwa makao yetu ya mbinguni ili kwamba kile kipatikanacho na mauti kimezwe na uzima.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe, abatore ase enyomba eye ere buna eema, nigo togwechanda, toritoerwa, tari ng’a igo torigetie korusigwa ase enyomba eye, korende ntorigetie okoboyigwa konde, erinde egekonyorekana namakweri kemerwe nobogima.

English: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Basi Mungu ndiye alitufanya kwa ajili ya jambo lilo hilo naye ametupa Roho Mtakatifu kuwa amana, akituhakikishia ahadi ya kile kijacho.
Ekegusii: Gaki ere oyotoroisetie ase amang’ana aya nere Nyasae, oyotoete Omoika buna ekebwaterero giantenenera.

English: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo siku zote tunalo tumaini, hata ingawa tunajua kwamba wakati tukiwa katika mwili huu, tuko mbali na Bwana,
Ekegusii: Gaki amatuko onsi nigo tore nomoyo bw’oboremu, naende twamanyire ng’a ekero tore aa ase omobere nigo tomenyete aare korwa ase Omonene,

English: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
Kiswahili: kwa maana twaenenda kwa imani wala si kwa kuona.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo togotaara ase okwegena, tari ase okorora.

English: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
Kiswahili: Naam, tunalo tumaini na ingekuwa bora zaidi kuuacha mwili huu na kwenda kukaa na Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ntore nomoyo bw’oboremu, na twarorire buya kobua korua ase omobere na komenya amo n’Omonene.

English: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kama tuko katika mwili huu au tuko mbali nao, lengo letu ni kumpendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye tore aa, gose onye titori aa, nigo okogania gwaito kore ng’a tomogwenere ere.

English: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa sisi sote tutasimama mbele ya kiti cha hukumu cha Kristo, ili kila mmoja apate kulipwa kwa ajili ya yale ambayo yametendwa katika mwili wake, yakiwa mema au mabaya.
Ekegusii: Naki netogwenerete intwe twensi koorokigwa ase obosio bw’ekerogo gi’ekina gia Kristo; erio kera omonto anyore koreng’ana buna are gokora ase omobere, onye bire ebiya gose onye bire ebibe.

English: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.
Kiswahili: Basi, kwa kuwa tunajua kumcha Bwana, tunajitahidi kuwavuta wengine. Lakini Mungu anatufahamu dhahiri, nami natumaini kwamba tu dhahiri katika dhamiri zenu pia.
Ekegusii: Nabo gatwamanyire komoiroka Omonene, twateemire kong’usa abanto; korende twamanyekanire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na inche nasemeirie ng’a twamanyekanire ase okomanya gwe chinkoro chiaino ime boigo.

English: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.
Kiswahili: Sio kwamba tunajaribu kujistahilisha kwenu tena, lakini tunataka kuwapa nafasi ili mwone fahari juu yetu mweze kuwajibu hao wanaoona fahari juu ya mambo yanayoonekana badala ya mambo yaliyo moyoni.
Ekegusii: Titogwetogia intwe abanyene ase obosio bwaino naende, korende twabaeire ribaga ri’ogwetogia ase engencho yaito erinde monyare koba nokoiraneria ase abagwetogia ase amang’ana a isiko oka, gose tari ase amang’ana y’enkoro ime.

English: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
Kiswahili: Kama tumerukwa na akili, ni kwa ajili ya Mungu; kama tuna akili timamu, ni kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naki onye twasirerigwe nobong’aini bwaito, ayio nigo are ase Nyasae; gose onye tore nobong’aini bwaito, ayio nigo are ase engencho yaino.

English: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa upendo wa Kristo unatutia nguvu, kwa sababu tunasadiki kuwa mmoja alikufa kwa ajili ya wote, kwa hiyo wote walikufa.
Ekegusii: Naki obwanchani bwa Kristo nigo bogotobetereria, ekiagera twamanyire ekeene ng’a onye oyomo okuure ase engencho ya bonsi, nabo bonsi bakuure.

English: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.
Kiswahili: Naye alikufa kwa ajili ya watu wote, ili kwamba wote wanaoishi wasiishi tena kwa ajili ya nafsi zao wenyewe, bali kwa ajili yake yeye aliyekufa na kufufuliwa tena kwa ajili yao.
Ekegusii: Ere agakwa ase engencho ya bonsi, erio abare moyo tibaaba moyo ase engencho yabo boka abanyene, korende nase engencho yaye ere oyokwete, naende akaboka ase engencho yabo.

English: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
Kiswahili: Hivyo tangu sasa hatumwangalii mtu yeyote kwa mtazamo wa kibinadamu. Ingawa wakati fulani tulimwangalia Kristo kwa namna ya kibinadamu, hatumwangalii tena hivyo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa bono intwe titomanyeti monto onde koreng’ana buna Mwanyabaanto bamomanyete; nonya intwe twamomanyete Kristo ritang’ani buna Mwanyabaanto bamomanyete, korende bono titokomomanya buna igo.

English: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kama mtu akiwa ndani ya Kristo, amekuwa kiumbe kipya; ya kale yamepita, tazama, yamekuwa mapya.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, omonto karabe ime ya Kristo nigo are egetongwa ekeyia; ebia kare biaetire, rora bionsi biabeire ebiyia.

English: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;
Kiswahili: Haya yote yanatokana na Mungu, ambaye ametupatanisha sisi na nafsi yake kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo na kutupata sisi huduma ya upatanisho:
Ekegusii: Korende bionsi nigo bikorwa ase Nyasae, oyotobwatanirie intwe amo nere omonyene ase Kristo, nere otoeire obosomba bw’okobwatanigwa,

English: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
Kiswahili: Kwamba Mungu alikuwa ndani ya Kristo akiupatanisha ulimwengu na nafsi yake mwenyewe, akiwa hawahesabii watu dhambi zao. Naye ametukabidhi sisi ujumbe huu wa upatanisho.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nigo arenge ime ya Kristo, akabwatania ense amo nere omonyene, tabaabarera ogosaria kwabo; ere obekire ase tore ring’ana ri’okobwatanigwa.

English: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo sisi ni mabalozi wa Kristo, kana kwamba Mungu anawasihi kupitia kwa vinywa vyetu. Nasi twawaomba sana ninyi kwa niaba ya Kristo, mpatanishwe na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nabo tore abatomire na Kristo; Nyasae nigo akobasorora inwe goetera ase emenwa yaito. Twabasoroire ase engencho ya Kristo: Mobwatanigwe na Nyasae.

English: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu alimfanya yeye asiyekuwa na dhambi kuwa dhambi kwa ajili yetu, ili sisi tupate kufanywa haki ya Mungu kwake yeye.
Ekegusii: Nyasae omokorire ere, oyotamanyeti ebibe, koba ebibe ase engencho yaito, erio asare intwe tobe noboronge ase Nyasae.

English: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.
Kiswahili: Kama watendakazi pamoja na Mungu, tunawasihi msipokee neema ya Mungu bure.
Ekegusii: Na intwe gatogokora emeremo amo nere, twabasoroire timonyora obuya bwa Nyasae bosa.

English: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana asema: “Wakati wangu uliokubalika nilikusikia, siku ya wokovu nilikusaidia.” Tazama, wakati uliokubalika ndio huu, siku ya wokovu ndiyo sasa.
Ekegusii: Naki igo agoteeba, “Ase engaki yancheire nakoiraneretie ogosaba kwao, rituko ri’ogotooreka nagokonyete.” Rora, bono nario engaki y’ogwancherwa; rora, bono nario rituko ri’ogotooreka.

English: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
Kiswahili: Hatuweki kitu cha kukwaza katika njia ya mtu yeyote, ili huduma yetu isionekane kuwa na lawama.
Ekegusii: Titobeka ekegocha ase onde bwensi, erinde obosomba bwaito bobaise gokwanwa bobe,

English: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
Kiswahili: Bali kama watumishi wa Mungu tuonyeshe kwa kila njia: katika saburi nyingi; katika dhiki, katika misiba, na katika shida;
Ekegusii: korende ase kera ring’ana twenyorere ogotogigwa okuya buna abasomba ba Nyasae, ase okoganya okonge, ase emechando, ase obokong’u, ase ogochandwa,

English: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,
Kiswahili: katika kupigwa, katika kufungwa gerezani na katika ghasia; katika kazi ngumu, katika kukesha na katika kufunga;
Ekegusii: ase ogoakwa, ase ogosibwa, ase ogokorerwa rirorooche, ase emeremo, ase okorenda, ase enchara,

English: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
Kiswahili: katika utakatifu, katika ufahamu, katika uvumilivu, na katika utu wema; katika Roho Mtakatifu na upendo wa kweli;
Ekegusii: ase obochenu, ase okomanya, ase oboremereria, ase obwororo, ase Omoika Omochenu, ase obwanchani botari nobong’ainereria,

English: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
Kiswahili: katika maneno ya kweli na katika nguvu za Mungu, kwa silaha za haki za mkono wa kuume na za mkono wa kushoto;
Ekegusii: ase amang’ana y’ekeene, ase chinguru chia Nyasae. Nigo tore nebirwanero bi’oboronge ase okoboko gw’okorio na ase okoboko gw’okobee.

English: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,
Kiswahili: katika utukufu na katika kudharauliwa; katika sifa mbaya na katika sifa nzuri; tukiwa kama wadanganyaji, lakini tukiwa wakweli;
Ekegusii: Twanyorire ogosikwa na ogotasikwa; togokwanwa bobe na togokwanwa buya. Twakorirwe buna abanto abang’ainereria, korende nabaanto b’ekeene tore,

English: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,
Kiswahili: tukiwa maarufu, lakini tukihesabiwa kama tusiojulikana; tukiwa kama wanaokufa, lakini tunaishi; tukipigwa, lakini hatuuawi;
Ekegusii: buna abatamanyekaneti, korende nigo tomanyekanete buya; buna abagokwa, na rora moyo tore. Twasusuirwe, korende titoitiri;

English: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.
Kiswahili: tukiwa kama wenye huzuni, lakini siku zote tukifurahi; tukionekana maskini, lakini tukitajirisha wengi; tukiwa kama wasio na kitu, lakini tuna vitu vyote.
Ekegusii: twaichanigwe, korende amatuko onsi nigo tore nomogooko; tore abataka, korende twabatenenkirie abange, titori na gento, nonya nabo ntore n’ebinto bionsi.

English: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
Kiswahili: Tumesema nanyi wazi, enyi Wakorintho na kuwafungulieni mioyo yetu wazi kabisa.
Ekegusii: Twakwanire maiso marore nainwe, Abakorinto; twaigoire chinkoro chiaito ase more.

English: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
Kiswahili: Sisi hatujizuii kuwapenda, bali ninyi mmeuzuia upendo wenu kwetu.
Ekegusii: Titosiegeti chinkoro chiaito ase more, korende inwe nigo mosiegete echiaino ase tore.

English: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.
Kiswahili: Sasa nasema, kama na watoto wangu: Ninyi pia ifungueni mioyo yenu kabisa.
Ekegusii: Bono nigo ngokwana nainwe buna nabana baane more. Buna twabakoreire, nainwe motokorere bo, mogareyie chinkoro chiaino.

English: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
Kiswahili: Msifungiwe nira pamoja na watu wasioamini, kwa jinsi isivyo sawasawa, kwa maana pana uhusiano gani kati ya haki na uovu? Au kuna ushirika gani kati ya nuru na giza?
Ekegusii: Timosiberanigwa rikorogoto amo nabategeneti. Naki nkobwatana ki kore ase egati y’oboronge na ogosaria? Gose ngosanga ki kore ase egati y’omobaso na omosunte?

English: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?
Kiswahili: Kuna mapatano gani kati ya Kristo na Beliari? Yeye aaminiye ana sehemu gani na yeye asiyeamini?
Ekegusii: Naende nkobwatana ki kore ase egati ya Kristo na Beliali? Gose oyobwegenete, insemo ki abwate amo noyotegeneti?

English: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”
Kiswahili: Kuna mapatano gani kati ya Hekalu la Mungu na sanamu? Kwa kuwa sisi tu Hekalu la Mungu aliye hai. Kama Mungu alivyosema: “Nitakaa pamoja nao na kutembea katikati yao, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao, nao watakuwa watu wangu.”
Ekegusii: Naende ngosanga ki kore ase egati ye Hekalu ya Nyasae na emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa? Naki intwe ne Hekalu ya Nyasae ore moyo, buna Nyasae ateebete, “Nimenye ime yabo, na ase egati yabo nintaare, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo nababe abanto baane.

English: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
Kiswahili: “Kwa hiyo tokeni miongoni mwao, mkatengwe nao, asema Bwana. Msiguse kitu chochote kilicho najisi, nami nitawakaribisha.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna Omonene agoteeba: Soka korwa ase bare, mweatanane, gose timokuna egento getachenegeti, na inche nimbaroisie.

English: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
Kiswahili: “Mimi nitakuwa Baba kwenu, nanyi mtakuwa wanangu na binti zangu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”
Ekegusii: Nimbe Iso oino, na inwe mobe abana baane, abamura na abaiseke. Nab’Omonene Omobui oteebire.”

English: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
Kiswahili: Wapenzi, kwa kuwa tunazo ahadi hizi, basi na tujitakase nafsi zetu kutokana na kila kitu kitiacho mwili na roho unajisi, tukitimiza utakatifu kwa kumcha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abanchani baane, ekiagera tore ne chiira echio, twesibie intwe abanyene ogotacheneka kw’omobere na omoika, erio toikeranie obochenu ase okomoiroka Nyasae.

English: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
Kiswahili: Tupatieni nafasi mioyoni mwenu. Hatujamkosea mtu yeyote, hatujampotosha mtu yeyote, wala hatujamdhulumu mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Toigorere chinkoro chiaino; titokorereti monto onde bobe, titosareti monto, titorieti monto kiaboama.

English: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
Kiswahili: Sisemi haya ili kuwahukumu, kwa kuwa nilisema mwanzo, kwamba ninyi mko mioyoni mwetu hata kwa kufa pamoja au kuishi pamoja.
Ekegusii: Tintebeti ring’ana eri erinde mbagambie inwe, ekiagera ritang’ani konya nabateebirie ng’a inwe nigo more ne ribaga ase chinkoro chiaito, ase ogokwa na okoba moyo amo.

English: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
Kiswahili: Mara nyingi najivuna kwa ajili yenu; naona fahari juu yenu. Nimejawa na faraja. Nina furaha kupita kiasi katika mateso yetu yote.
Ekegusii: Ninde noboremu obonge kongokwana nainwe; ogwetogia kwane igoro ase more nokonge; naichoirwe nokoremigwa. Ase ogochandwa gwaito gwonsi naichoirwe nomogooko omonge mono.

English: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hata tulipoingia Makedonia, miili yetu haikuwa na raha. Tulisumbuliwa kila upande, kwa nje kulikuwa na mapigano na mioyoni mwetu tulikuwa na hofu.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya nekero twaigete Makedonia, emebere yaito tiyanyorete ogotimoka, korende togaachandwa chinsemo chionsi; isiko ekaba esegi, na ime bokaba obwoba.

English: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
Kiswahili: Bali Mungu, yeye awafarijie wenye huzuni, alitufariji kwa kufika kwake Tito.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae, oyokoremia abaichanete, agatoremia ase ogocha gwa Tito,

English: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.
Kiswahili: Lakini si kule kuja kwa Tito tu, bali pia kwa faraja mliyompa. Alitueleza jinsi mlivyonionea shauku, huzuni yenu kubwa na juhudi yenu kwa ajili yangu, ili kwamba furaha yangu ipate kuwa kubwa kuliko wakati wowote.
Ekegusii: gose tari ase ogocha kwaye gwoka, korende nonya nase okoremigwa koria aremetigwe nainwe. Agatoteebia amang’ana y’amaiga aino, na okweng’ereria kwaino, na omokia oino ase ’nde, goika nkamenta kogoka.

English: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.
Kiswahili: Hata kama niliwahuzunisha kwa barua yangu, sijutii. Ingawa nilijuta kwa muda mfupi, kwa kuwa najua kwamba barua yangu iliwaumiza, lakini ni kwa kitambo tu,
Ekegusii: Naki nonya nabaichanetie ase riruube riria tinkweitia (nonya neitetie ritang’ani), ekiagera narorire ng’a riruube riria ndiabaichanetie, korende nase ekero egeke gioka.

English: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.
Kiswahili: lakini sasa nina furaha, si kwa sababu mlihuzunika, bali kwa kuwa huzuni hiyo iliwafanya mtubu. Kwa maana mlihuzunishwa kama Mungu alivyokusudia watu wahuzunike na hivyo sisi hatukuwadhuru kwa njia yoyote.
Ekegusii: Bono nagokire, tari ekiagera mwaichanetigwe, korende ekiagera mwaichanetigwe goika mokaonchoka, ekiagera nigo mwaichanetigwe ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, erinde timonyara gosira ase ogokora gwaito.

English: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana huzuni ya kimungu huleta toba iletayo wokovu na wala haina majuto. Lakini huzuni ya kidunia husababisha mauti.
Ekegusii: Naki ogoichanigwa okore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae nigo gokorenta okoonchoka gokoraa gochia ase ogotooreka, gotari na kweitia; korende ogoichanigwa gw’ense nigo gokorenta amakweri.

English: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.
Kiswahili: Tazameni jinsi huzuni hii ya kimungu ilivyoleta faida ndani yenu: bidii mliyo nayo, juhudi mliyofanya kujitetea, uchungu wenu, hofu yenu, upendo wenu, shauku yenu na jinsi mlivyokuwa tayari kutoa adhabu inayostahili. Kwa kila njia mmejithibitisha kuwa safi katika jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Rora buna ogoichanigwa okwo kore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae kwabarenteire omokia, na ogwekengera, na okobea, okoiroka na amaiga amange, ogwetigana na egesiomba! Ase kera enchera mweorokererie koba motari na komocha ase ring’ana erio.

English: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ingawa niliwaandikia, haikuwa kwa sababu ya huyo aliyekosa au huyo aliyekosewa. Lakini nilitaka ninyi wenyewe mwone, mbele za Mungu, jinsi mlivyojitoa kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Nabo, nonya nabariikerete, tindigeti ase engencho yaye ere oyokorete bobe, gose tari ase engencho yaye ere oyokoreretwe bobe, korende ogwetigana kwaino ase tore konyare koorokigwa ase more ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya haya tumefarijika. Zaidi ya kule sisi kutiwa moyo, tulifurahi sana kumwona Tito alivyo na furaha, kwa sababu roho yake imeburudishwa na ninyi nyote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio twaremiigwe. Na kobua ase okoremigwa okwo tokagookera mono omogooko o Tito, ekiagera omoyo oye otimokigwe nainwe mwensi.

English: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
Kiswahili: Nilikuwa nimewasifu ninyi kwake, nanyi hamkuniaibisha. Lakini kila kitu tulichowaambia ninyi, kilikuwa kweli, hivyo kule kujisifu kwetu kwa Tito kuwahusu ninyi kumethibitishwa kuwa kweli pia.
Ekegusii: Naki onye ngwetogia asare ase engencho yaino, tinasoogetigwe; korende buna twabateebeetie amang’ana onsi ase ekeene, naboigo nogwetogia gwaito ase obosio bwa Tito nigo kwarenge ogw’ekeene.

English: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.
Kiswahili: Upendo wake kwenu unaongezeka sana anapokumbuka jinsi mlivyokuwa watiifu, na kumpokea kwa hofu na kutetemeka.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani bwaye bw’omoyo ase more bwamentekanire, ekero akoinyora okoigwera kwaino inwe mwensi, na buna mwamoroisetie ase okoiroka na okoiguswa.

English: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
Kiswahili: Nafurahi kwamba ninaweza kuwatumaini ninyi kabisa.
Ekegusii: Nagokire, ekiagera ase kera ring’ana ninde nomoyo bw’oboremu ase engencho yaino.

English: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
Kiswahili: Basi sasa ndugu, nataka ninyi mjue kuhusu ile neema ambayo Mungu amewapa makanisa ya Makedonia.
Ekegusii: Bono nkobamanyia tore inwe abaminto amang’ana y’obuya bwa Nyasae, obo chikanisa chia Makedonia chiaetwe.

English: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.
Kiswahili: Pamoja na majaribu makali na taabu walizopata, furaha waliyokuwa nayo ilikuwa kubwa, ingawa walikuwa maskini kupindukia, kwa upande wao walifurika kwa wingi wa ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Naki baria bateemetwe nemechando emenge. Nonya barenge abataka mono, omogooko obo omonge okagera bakamenta okorua kwabo.

English: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana nashuhudia kwamba wao walitoa kwa kadiri wawezavyo, hata na zaidi ya uwezo wao, kwa hiari yao wenyewe,
Ekegusii: Naki nababereire kirori ng’a nigo baruete ase omoyo bw’ogwancha, ase okonyara kwabo, na goetania okonyara kwabo.

English: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.
Kiswahili: wakitusihi kwa bidii wapewe fursa ya kushiriki katika huduma hii ya kuwasaidia watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagatosaba na gotosorora mono tobae ribaga babwatane naintwe ase ogokorera abachenu.

English: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
Kiswahili: Wala hawakufanya tulivyotazamia, bali walijitoa wao wenyewe kwa Bwana kwanza na ndipo wakajitoa kwa ajili yetu, kufuatana na mapenzi ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naende bagakora buna totasemeretie; ritang’ani bakerua abanyene ase Omonene, erio ase tore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae.

English: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tulimsihi Tito, kwa kuwa ndiye alianzisha jambo hili, akamilishe tendo hili la neema kwa upande wenu.
Ekegusii: Togasorora Tito aikeranie emeremo y’obuya obo buna ayechagete ase egati yaino.

English: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama vile mlivyo mbele sana katika yote: Katika imani, katika usemi, katika maarifa, katika uaminifu wote na katika upendo wenu kwetu sisi, vivyo hivyo tunataka pia mzidi katika neema hii ya kutoa.
Ekegusii: Korende buna more nobonge bw’ebinto bionsi: okwegena, na ogokwana, na obong’aini, na omokia bwonsi, na obwanchani bwaino ase tore buna tobanchete inwe, nabo mobe nobonge bw’obuya obo bwonsi.

English: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
Kiswahili: Siwaamrishi, lakini nataka kujaribu unyofu wa upendo wenu kwa kuulinganisha na bidii ya wengine.
Ekegusii: Tinkwaneti aya ase okobachiika, korende ase omokia bw’abaanto bande nteeme ekeene ki’obwanchani bwaino.

English: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mnajua neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, kwamba ingawa alikuwa tajiri, kwa ajili yenu alikubali kuwa maskini, ili kwa umaskini wake ninyi mpate kuwa matajiri.
Ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo buna ekorete omotaka ase engencho yaino, nonya orenge omonda, erinde inwe monyare koba abanda ase obotaka bwaye.

English: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wangu kuhusu lile lililo bora kwenu juu ya jambo hili ni huu: Mwaka uliopita ninyi mlikuwa wa kwanza si tu kutoa lakini pia mlikuwa na shauku ya kufanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Na inche ase ring’ana eri nabaeire ay’ogosemia kwane, mbuya ase more mokoore emeremo eyio eyio mwarenge abachaki koyekora omwaka oeta. Timware koyekora rioka, korende boigo mware nokogania gw’okoyekora.

English: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.
Kiswahili: Sasa ikamilisheni kazi hii kwa shauku kama mlivyoanza, jitoleeni kulingana na uwezo wenu.
Ekegusii: Bono moikeranie ogokora okwo, erinde buna mwarenge nokogania koroisia omooroberio, naboigo mobe ang’e koyoikerania ase ebi more nabio.

English: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama nia ya kutoa ipo, kitolewacho kinakubalika kulingana na kile mtu alicho nacho, wala si kwa kile ambacho hana.
Ekegusii: Naki aase ogwancha kore, iga bigwancherwa koreng’ana nebi omonto are nabio, tari ase ebi atabwati.

English: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,
Kiswahili: Nia yetu si kwamba wengine wasaidike wakati ninyi mnateseka, bali pawe na uwiano.
Ekegusii: Naki tindi goteeba aya, erinde abande baabatigere na inwe moritoerwe, korende amang’ana abe areng’aine.

English: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.
Kiswahili: Kwa wakati huu, wingi wa vitu mlivyo navyo usaidie kutosheleza mahitaji yao, ili wakati wao watakapokuwa na wingi wa vitu, nao wapate kutosheleza mahitaji yenu.
Ekegusii: Ekero eke kia bono obonge bwaino bobakonye ase okoremerwa kwabo; ekero kende obonge bwabo bobakonye inwe ase okoremerwa kwaino; erio amang’ana abe areng’aine. Esemba engencho yaye omogisangio

English: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo patakuwa na usawa, kama ilivyoandikwa: “Aliyekusanya zaidi hakuwa na ziada, wala aliyekusanya kidogo hakupungukiwa.”
Ekegusii: Buna eriikire, “Oyosangereretie ebinge tamenteiri, nere oyosangereretie ebike taremeiri.”

English: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
Kiswahili: Ninamshukuru Mungu ambaye amemtia Tito moyo wa kuwajali ninyi kama mimi ninavyowajali.
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, oyobekire enkoro ya Tito omokia gocha ase more.

English: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba Tito amekubali tu ombi letu, bali anakuja kwenu akiwa na shauku kuliko wakati mwingine, tena kwa hiari yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki igo abwatete ogosorora gwaito; kobua ayio, ere akamenta koba nomokia gocha ase more ase ogwancha kwaye omonyene.

English: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.
Kiswahili: Nasi tunamtuma pamoja naye ndugu ambaye anasifiwa na makanisa yote kwa huduma yake ya kuhubiri Injili.
Ekegusii: Amo nere twatomire oyominto oria omanyekanete ase chikanisa chionsi ase okorandia kwaye kw’amang’ana amaya.

English: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, alichaguliwa na makanisa ili asafiri pamoja nasi tulipokuwa tunapeleka matoleo ya ukarimu, kwa ajili ya utukufu wa Bwana mwenyewe, na ili kuonyesha hisani yetu kuwasaidia.
Ekegusii: Gose tari ase ayio oka, korende nigo achoretwe ne chikanisa agende amo naintwe ase emeremo eye y’obuya obo togokora ase obonene bw’Omonene, na koorokia ng’a intwe nigo tore ang’e kobakorera.

English: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
Kiswahili: Tunataka kuepuka lawama yoyote kuhusu jinsi tunavyosimamia matoleo haya ya ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Twerende ne ring’ana eri, omonto tacha gotokwana bobe ase amang’ana y’ekeegwa eke tokogaba intwe.

English: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tunakusudia kufanya kile kilicho haki si machoni mwa Bwana peke yake, bali pia machoni mwa watu wengine.
Ekegusii: Gatoraganie korengereria ayare amaya, tari ase obosio bw’Omonene bweka, korende nonya nase obosio bwa Mwanyabaanto.

English: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.
Kiswahili: Pamoja nao, tunamtuma ndugu yetu ambaye mara kwa mara ametuthibitishia kwa njia nyingi kwamba ana shauku, naam, zaidi sana sasa kwa sababu analo tumaini kuu kwenu.
Ekegusii: Amo nabarabwo twatomire oyominto oyotwarorire ara aange ase amang’ana amange ng’a nare nomokia, na bono nare nomokia kobua, ekiagera ase ogosemeria are nakorokwo ase more.

English: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya Tito, yeye ni mwenzangu na mtendakazi pamoja nami miongoni mwenu. Kwa habari za ndugu zetu, wao ni wawakilishi wa makanisa, na utukufu kwa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Nabo omonto karaganie komanya amang’ana igoro ya Tito; ere nesemba yane, naende nomokori emeremo amo nainche ase okobakorera inwe; naende karaganie komanya amang’ana igoro y’abaminto barabwo nabatomwa be chikanisa, naende obonene bwa Kristo.

English: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo waonyesheni wazi hawa ndugu uthibitisho wa upendo wenu na sababu inayotufanya tujivune kwa ajili yenu, mbele ya makanisa, ili yapate kuona.
Ekegusii: Nabo moorokie ase obosio bwe chikanisa obwanchani bwaino, na ogwetogia gwaito ase engencho yaino ase bare.

English: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,
Kiswahili: Hakuna haja yangu kuwaandikia kuhusu huduma hii itolewayo kwa ajili ya watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana y’ogokorera abachenu, tindi nengencho y’okobariikera.

English: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ninajua mlivyo na shauku ya kusaidia, nami nimekuwa nikijivuna kwa ajili ya jambo hilo kwa watu wa Makedonia, nikiwaambia kuwa ninyi wa Akaya mmekuwa tayari kutoa tangu mwaka jana na shauku yenu imewachochea wengi wao katika kutoa.
Ekegusii: Naki namanyire okwebeka ang’e kwaino, okwo netogeretie ase Abamakedonia, ngoteeba ng’a abanto b’Akaya nigo bebegete ang’e korwa omwaka oeta, na omokia oino osukirie abange ase bare.

English: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa nawatuma hawa ndugu ili kujivuna kwetu kuhusu mchango wenu kusiwe maneno matupu, bali mpate kuwa tayari kama nilivyosema mngekuwa tayari.
Ekegusii: Korende natomire abwo baminto, erinde ogwetogia gwaito igoro yaino tikobaisa koba okwa bosa ase ring’ana eri, erinde monyare kwebeka ang’e buna nateebete.

English: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama nikija na Mmakedonia yeyote na kuwakuta hamjawa tayari, tutaona aibu kusema chochote juu yenu katika matoleo.
Ekegusii: Onye Abamakedonia bande bagocha amo nainche na tobanyore timorebeka ang’e, titocha gosooka, ekero tobasemeretie inwe. Titokwana igoro y’obosooku bwaino.

English: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo niliona ni muhimu niwahimize hawa ndugu watangulie kuja huko kwenu kabla yangu, wafanye mipango ya hayo matoleo ya ukarimu mliyokuwa mmeahidi, ili yawe tayari kama matoleo ya hiari wala si kama ya kutozwa kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Nabo narorire ng’a ningwenerete ntebie abaminto aba bantang’ane gocha ase more, na koroisia bwango ekeegwa kiaino keria mwarierete eira y’okorua korwa kare, erinde kenyare koba ang’e, buna ekeegwa, gose tari buna egento gekorugwa ase obong’iti.

English: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni kwamba: Yeyote apandaye kwa uchache pia atavuna kwa uchache, naye apandaye kwa ukarimu pia atavuna kwa ukarimu.
Ekegusii: Korende inyora aya, oyogosimeka ebike nigo akogesa ebike; oyogosimeka ebinge nigo akogesa ebinge.

English: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu atoe kama anavyokusudia moyoni mwake, si kwa uchoyo au kwa kulazimishwa, kwa maana Mungu humpenda yeye atoaye kwa moyo mkunjufu.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto tiga arue buna arengereretie ase enkoro yaye, tari ase ogoichana, gose tari ase okobetererigwa, ekiagera Nyasae bwanchire ere oyokorua nomogooko.

English: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
Kiswahili: Naye Mungu aweza kuwapa kila baraka kwa wingi, ili katika mambo yote kila wakati, mwe na kila kitu mnachohitaji, ili mweze kushiriki kwa wingi katika kila kazi njema.
Ekegusii: Na Nyasae nanyare kobaichoria nobuya bwonsi ase obonge, erinde monyare koba nogoisaneka gwonsi ase ebinto bionsi, monyare komenta mono ase ogokora okuya,

English: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Ametawanya vipawa vyake kwa ukarimu akawapa maskini; haki yake hudumu milele.”
Ekegusii: buna eriikire, “Osiareire ebiegwa biaye, obieire abataka, oboronge bwaye nigo boikaransete goika kare na kare.”

English: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
Kiswahili: Yeye ampaye mpanzi mbegu kwa ajili ya kupanda na mkate kuwa chakula, atawapa na kuzizidisha mbegu zenu za kupanda na kuongeza mavuno ya haki yenu.
Ekegusii: Nere oyokorua chimbusuro na koa oyo okobusura, naende arua omogati ase okoria, nabae inwe chimbusuro, naende nachibuchie, ere nabamenteranie okwama kw’oboronge bwaino.

English: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.
Kiswahili: Mtatajirishwa kwa kila namna ili mpate kuwa wakarimu kila wakati, na kupitia kwetu, ukarimu wenu utamletea Mungu shukrani.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera mwatenenkigwe ase ebinto bionsi monyare koba nokorua gwonsi gokogera Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono goetera ase emeremo yaito.

English: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,
Kiswahili: Huduma hii mnayofanya si tu kwa ajili ya kukidhi mahitaji ya watakatifu, bali huzidi sana kwa shukrani nyingi apewazo Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki emeremo y’ogokora oko teri goisanera abachenu okoremerwa kwabo gwoka, korende yamentekire mono egere Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono ara aange.

English: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya huduma ambayo mmejithibitisha wenyewe, watu watamtukuza Mungu kwa ajili ya utiifu ufuatanao na ukiri wenu wa Injili ya Kristo, na kwa ukarimu wenu wa kushiriki pamoja nao na pia wengine wote.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera mwaorokirie ng’a namotenene ase okorua okwo, abanto inabamotogie Nyasae ase okoigwera kwaino ase ogwatora enchiri ya Kristo, na ase okorua kwaino mwakoreire barabwo na abanto bonsi.

English: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.
Kiswahili: Nao katika maombi yao kwenu mioyo yao itawaonea shauku kwa sababu ya neema ipitayo kiasi mliyopewa na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Na barabwo abanyene, kobakobasabera inwe, bare namaiga amange ase more, ekiagera ase obuya boria bwa Nyasae obwo bwamentekire mono ime ase more.

English: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
Kiswahili: Ashukuriwe Mungu kwa karama yake isiyoelezeka.
Ekegusii: Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’ekeegwa kiaye, totanyare kogiatora buna egwenerete!

English: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
Kiswahili: Basi, mimi Paulo ninawasihi kwa unyenyekevu na upole wa Kristo, mimi niliye “mwoga” ninapokuwa pamoja nanyi ana kwa ana, lakini mwenye ujasiri nikiwa mbali nanyi!
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo omonyene nabasoroire ase obwororo na oboitongo bwa Kristo, inche nigo inde omoitongo konde amo nainwe, korende ntari aroro ninde noboremu ase more.

English: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.
Kiswahili: Nawaomba nitakapokuja kwenu nisiwe na ujasiri dhidi ya watu fulani, kama ninavyotazamia kwa wale wanaodhani kwamba tunaishi kwa kufuata namna ya ulimwengu huu.
Ekegusii: Ee, nabasabire ng’a kondeo timba omokong’u ase ogokwana noboremu, ekiagera nebarire koba noboremu igoro ase baria bakagete ng’a intwe nigo togotaara ase engencho y’okogania kw’omobere.

English: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;
Kiswahili: Ingawa tunaishi duniani, hatupigani vita kama ulimwengu ufanyavyo.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya tomenyete ase ense eye, titori korwana esegi y’okogania gw’ense eye.

English: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
Kiswahili: Silaha za vita vyetu si za mwili, bali zina uwezo katika Mungu hata kuangusha ngome,
Ekegusii: Naki ebirwanero biaito bi’eseegi tibiri ebia Mwanyabaanto, korende mbire nokobua kwa Nyasae koiyeria chindwaki.

English: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
Kiswahili: tukiangusha mawazo na kila kitu kilichoinuka, kijiinuacho juu ya elimu ya Mungu, na tukiteka nyara kila fikira ipate kumtii Kristo,
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo tokoiyeria ebirengererio na kera egetango kieimokereretie igoro kegotanga Nyasae tamanywa, na gosiba kera ekerengererio kenyare koigwera Kristo;

English: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
Kiswahili: tena tukiwa tayari kuadhibu kila tendo la kutotii, kutii kwenu kutakapokamilika.
Ekegusii: gatorabe ang’e korua egesusuro ase ogotaigwera gwonsi, ekero okoigwera kwaino gwaikeranire.

English: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.
Kiswahili: Angalieni yale yaliyo machoni penu. Kama mtu yeyote anaamini kuwa yeye ni mali ya Kristo, basi kumbuka kuwa kama ulivyo wa Kristo, vivyo hivyo na sisi ndivyo tulivyo.
Ekegusii: Morigererie ayare ase amasio aino. Onye omonto ore nobomaene ase enkoro yaye ng’a ere nomonto o Kristo, tiga arengererie omonyene, ng’a buna ere are omonto o Kristo, naboigo naintwe tore abanto ba Kristo.

English: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,
Kiswahili: Basi hata kama nikijisifu zaidi kidogo kuhusu mamlaka tuliyo nayo, ambayo Bwana alitupa ili kuwajenga wala si kuwabomoa, mimi sitaionea haya.
Ekegusii: Naki ninsa gwetogia kobua ake ase engencho y’okobua gwaito okwo twaeirwe n’Omonene, tonyare kobaagacha inwe, gose tari okobaiyeria, tinkobekwa ase obosooku.

English: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.
Kiswahili: Sitaki nionekane kama ninayejaribu kuwatisha kwa nyaraka zangu.
Ekegusii: Tindigeti gocha kororekana buna iga ndigetie koboboyia ase amarube aane.

English: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wanasema, “Nyaraka zake ni nzito na zenye nguvu, lakini ana kwa ana ni dhaifu na kuzungumza kwake ni kwa kudharauliwa.”
Ekegusii: Naki barabwo bateba, “Amarube aye namarito, naende nigo are amakong’u, korende ekero are amo naintwe ere omonyene nigo are omoreu, na amang’ana aye tari gento.”

English: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
Kiswahili: Watu kama hao wajue ya kuwa, yale tusemayo kwa barua tukiwa hatupo pamoja nanyi, ndivyo tulivyo na ndivyo tutakavyofanya tutakapokuwa pamoja nanyi.
Ekegusii: Tiga abanto banga buna abwo bamanye, ng’a buna tokoriika ase amarube aito ekero totari aroro, naboigo togokora gatoreo.

English: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
Kiswahili: Hatuthubutu kujiweka kwenye kundi moja au kujilinganisha na hao wanaojitukuza wenyewe kuwa wao ni wa maana sana. Wanapojipima na kujilinganisha wenyewe kwa wenyewe, wanaonyesha ya kuwa hawana busara.
Ekegusii: Gaki titori noboremu kwebara amo nabarabwo abare gwetogia abanyene, gose kwereng’ania nabarabwo. Korende barabwo, ekero bakwerenga abanyene barabwo ase barabwo, na kwereng’ania barabwo ase barabwo, tibari nobong’aini.

English: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi hatujajivuna kupita kiasi, bali majivuno yetu yatakuwa katika mipaka ile Mungu aliyotuwekea, mipaka ambayo inawafikia hata ninyi.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe titogwetogia kobua ekerengo giaito, korende ase ekerengo twagabeirwe na Nyasae, nonya nokobaikera inwe.

English: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hatukuwa tunavuka mipaka katika kujisifu kwetu, kama vile ambavyo ingekuwa kama hatukuwa tumekuja kwenu. Kwa maana sisi ndio tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuja kwenu na Injili ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki titori gwekinia intwe abanyene goetania ekerengo giaito buna ntotari kobaikera inwe. Naki intwe nabatang’ani tore b’okobarentera inwe enchiri ya Kristo.

English: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,
Kiswahili: Wala hatuvuki mipaka kwa kujisifu kwetu kwa ajili ya kazi iliyofanywa na watu wengine. Tumaini letu ni kwamba imani yenu inavyozidi kukua, eneo letu la utendaji miongoni mwenu litapanuka zaidi,
Ekegusii: Titori gwetogia kobua ekerengo ase emeremo y’abanto bande; korende ogosemeria gwaito nigo kore ng’a koreng’ana buna okwegena kwaino gokomenteka, na emeremo yaito ase more ementeke.

English: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.
Kiswahili: ili tuweze kuhubiri Injili sehemu zilizo mbali na maeneo yenu. Kwa maana hatutaki kujisifu kwa ajili ya kazi ambayo imekwisha kufanyika tayari katika eneo la mtu mwingine.
Ekegusii: Erio tonyare korandia enchiri ase chinse chire ng’umbu yaino, titwetogia ase emeremo yakorirwe ase ensemo y’omonto onde.

English: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
Kiswahili: Lakini, “Yeye ajisifuye na ajisifu katika Bwana.”
Ekegusii: “Korende ere oyogwetogia tiga etogie ase Omonene.”

English: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana si yeye ajisifuye mwenyewe akubaliwaye, bali yeye ambaye Bwana humsifu.
Ekegusii: Naki omonto bwancheirwe tari ere ogwetogia omonyene, korende noyo ogotogigwa n’Omonene.

English: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
Kiswahili: Laiti mngenivumilia kidogo katika upumbavu wangu! Naam, nivumilieni kidogo.
Ekegusii: Anga yaba buya onye mwandemereria ake ase oboriri bwane. Ee, namanyire ng’a mondemererie.

English: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
Kiswahili: Ninawaonea wivu, wivu wa Kimungu, kwa kuwa mimi niliwaposea mume mmoja, ili niwalete kwa Kristo kama mabikira safi.
Ekegusii: Naki nabaroreire ribero, na eri neribero ria Nyasae; naki nabariereire boko ase omosacha oyomo, erinde nyare kobarenta buna omoiseke omwekungi omochenu ase Kristo.

English: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
Kiswahili: Lakini nina hofu kuwa, kama vile Eva alivyodanganywa kwa ujanja wa yule nyoka, mawazo yenu yasije yakapotoshwa, mkauacha unyofu na usafi wa upendo wenu kwa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende nairokire ng’a buna eng’iti eria, ase obong’ainereria bwaye, yang’ainete Hawa, naboigo ebirengererio biaino birasareke, na mobaise gotiga obwegenwa bwaino bw’ekeene more nabwo ase Kristo.

English: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu kama mtu akija na kuwahubiria Yesu mwingine ambaye si yule tuliyemhubiri, au kama mkipokea roho mwingine ambaye si yule mliyempokea, au Injili tofauti na ile mliyoikubali, ninyi mnaitii kwa urahisi.
Ekegusii: Naki onye omonto ogocha okorandia Yeso onde omoao, otatiga oyo twarandetie intwe, gose mwanche omoika onde omoao oyomotanyorete, gose enchiri ende eng’ao eyemotanchete, igo moremereretie buya nayio.

English: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
Kiswahili: Lakini sidhani ya kuwa mimi ni dhalili sana kuliko hao “mitume wakuu.”
Ekegusii: Naki igo nkagete ng’a inche tindemeiri gento eki abatomwa baria abanene bare nakio.

English: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
Kiswahili: Inawezekana mimi nikawa si mnenaji hodari, lakini ni hodari katika elimu. Jambo hili tumelifanya liwe dhahiri kwenu kwa njia zote.
Ekegusii: Nonya timanyeti gokwana buya, korende obong’aini nimbwate, na ase kera enchera twaorokirie amang’ana onsi ase more.

English: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
Kiswahili: Je, nilitenda dhambi kwa kujishusha ili kuwainua ninyi kwa kuwahubiria Injili ya Mungu pasipo malipo?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nebibe nakorire ase okweirania inse, erio mokiinigwe, ekiagera nabarandeirie enchiri ya Nyasae ntari neng’eria?

English: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.
Kiswahili: Niliyanyangʼanya makanisa mengine kwa kupokea misaada kutoka kwao ili niweze kuwahudumia ninyi.
Ekegusii: Naurire abanto be chikanisa chinde enibo yabo ase okorusia eng’eria yane ase bare, erinde mbakorere inwe.

English: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.
Kiswahili: Nami nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi, nikipungukiwa na chochote, sikuwa mzigo kwa mtu yeyote, kwa maana ndugu waliotoka Makedonia walinipatia mahitaji yangu. Kwa hiyo nilijizuia kuwa mzigo kwenu kwa njia yoyote, nami nitaendelea kujizuia.
Ekegusii: Inche ekero narenge amo nainwe ekero naremeretwe, timorarereti monto onde, ekiagera abaminto bagachia gocha korwa Makedonia bagankonya ase okoremerwa kwane. Ase amang’ana onsi nkerenda inche omonyene timbaraarereria nonya ng’ake, naende ningenderere gokora bo.

English: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
Kiswahili: Kwa hakika kama vile kweli ya Kristo ilivyo ndani yangu, hakuna mtu yeyote katika Akaya nzima atakayenizuia kujivunia jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Naende buna ekeene gia Kristo kere ime ase ’nde, omonto tari oranyare gontanga ase ogwetogia okwo ase chinsemo chi’Akaya.

English: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini? Je, ni kwa sababu siwapendi? Mungu anajua ya kuwa nawapenda!
Ekegusii: Nase ki? Ekiagera ntabancheti inwe? Nyasae namanyete ng’a nimbanchete!

English: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.
Kiswahili: Nami nitaendelea kufanya lile ninalofanya sasa ili nisiwape nafasi wale ambao wanatafuta nafasi ya kuhesabiwa kuwa sawa na sisi katika mambo wanayojisifia.
Ekegusii: Korende eri ngokora, ningenderere korikora, erinde mbatange abakorigia ribaga tibanyora ribaga ri’ogwetogia barorekane koba buna intwe tore.

English: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
Kiswahili: Watu kama hao ni mitume wa uongo, ni wafanyakazi wadanganyifu, wanaojigeuza waonekane kama mitume wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki abwo nabatomwa b’oborimo, bagokora emeremo ase obong’ainereria, bakweonchora babe omogwekano bw’abatomwa ba Kristo.

English: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
Kiswahili: Wala hii si ajabu, kwa kuwa hata Shetani mwenyewe hujigeuza aonekane kama malaika wa nuru.
Ekegusii: Nabo tari ogokumia, ekiagera Saitani omonyene nigo akweonchora bwekora buna omomalaika bw’omobaso.

English: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo basi si ajabu, kama watumishi wa Shetani nao hujigeuza ili waonekane kama watumishi wa haki. Mwisho wao utakuwa sawa na matendo yao yanavyostahili.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio tari ring’ana rigeni ng’a abasomba baye nabarabwo bakweonchora bekora buna abasomba b’oboronge. Omoerio obo nobe koreng’ana nemeremo yabo.

English: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
Kiswahili: Nasema tena, mtu yeyote asidhani kwamba mimi ni mjinga. Lakini hata kama mkinidhania hivyo, basi nipokeeni kama mjinga ili nipate kujisifu kidogo.
Ekegusii: Nakwanire naende, omonto takaga ng’a inche nomoriri inde; korende namonkagera bo, monyanche buna omonto omoriri, erinde nainche boigo ninyare gwetogia ake.

English: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
Kiswahili: Ninayosema kuhusiana na huku kujisifu kwa kujiamini, sisemi kama vile ambavyo Bwana angesema, bali kama mjinga.
Ekegusii: (Eri ngokwana tindi korikwana ase okobua kw’Omonene, korende buna omoriri ase oboremu obo bw’ogwetogia

English: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wengi wanajisifu kama vile ulimwengu ufanyavyo, mimi nami nitajisifu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera abange bagwetogia ase engencho yabo abanyene, na inche boigo ninyetogie).

English: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mwachukuliana na wajinga kwa sababu mna hekima sana!
Ekegusii: Inwe, ekiagera more nobong’aini, nigo mokoremereria nabariri ase omogooko.

English: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.
Kiswahili: Kweli ni kwamba mnachukuliana na mtu akiwatia utumwani au akiwatumia kwa ajili ya kupata faida au akiwanyangʼanya au akijitukuza mwenyewe au akiwadanganya.
Ekegusii: Naki iga mokoremereria nomonto, karabakore mobe abasomba, kararie ebiaino, abasakore, kareimokererie igoro, karabaake inwe ase obosio.

English: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
Kiswahili: Kwa aibu inanipasa niseme kwamba sisi tulikuwa dhaifu sana kwa jambo hilo! Lakini chochote ambacho mtu mwingine yeyote angethubutu kujisifia, nanena kama mjinga, nami nathubutu kujisifu juu ya hilo.
Ekegusii: Ase obosooku bwane nigo ngokwana ng’a nigo twarenge abareu ase ogokora amang’ana aya. Korende onye omonto ore noboremu bw’ogwetogia ase rinde rionsi (nakwanire ase oboriri), na inche ninde noboremu boigo bw’ogwetogia.

English: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
Kiswahili: Je, wao ni Waebrania? Mimi pia ni Mwebrania. Je, wao ni Waisraeli? Mimi pia ni Mwisraeli. Je, wao ni wazao wa Abrahamu? Mimi pia ni mzao wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Barabwo n’Abaiberania? Nainche boigo. Barabwo n’Abaisraeli? Nainche boigo. Barabwo noroiboro rwa Aburaamu? Nainche boigo.

English: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.
Kiswahili: Je, wao ni watumishi wa Kristo? (Nanena kiwazimu.) Mimi ni zaidi yao. Nimefanya kazi kwa bidii kuwaliko wao, nimefungwa gerezani mara kwa mara, nimechapwa mijeledi sana, na nimekabiliwa na mauti mara nyingi.
Ekegusii: Inee! Barabwo nabasomba ba Kristo? (Bono nigo ngokwana buna ebarimo). Inche mbuya kobua; ase emeremo kobua mono, ase ogosibwa kobua mono, ase ogoakwa goetania ekerengo, ang’e namakweri ebiro ebinge.

English: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.
Kiswahili: Mara tano nimechapwa na Wayahudi viboko arobaini kasoro kimoja.
Ekegusii: Ase Abayahudi ara gatano nkanyora ogoakwa emerongo ene otatiga okomo.

English: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
Kiswahili: Mara tatu nilichapwa kwa fimbo, mara moja nilipigwa kwa mawe, mara tatu nimevunjikiwa na meli, nimekaa kilindini usiku kucha na mchana kutwa,
Ekegusii: Ara gatato ngaakwa chinyimbo, erimo ngaakwa amagena. Ara gatato ngasarekerwa nemeeri, obotuko obomo na omobaso oyomo ngaikaransa igoro y’endiba;

English: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
Kiswahili: katika safari za mara kwa mara. Nimekabiliwa na hatari za kwenye mito, hatari za wanyangʼanyi, hatari kutoka kwa watu wangu mwenyewe, hatari kutoka kwa watu wa Mataifa; hatari mijini, hatari nyikani, hatari baharini; na hatari kutoka kwa ndugu wa uongo.
Ekegusii: nkaba ase orogendo ekero ase ekero, ase emechando ye chindooche, ase ogochandwa nabauri, ase ogochandwa neamate yane, ase ogochandwa nabaanto b’Ebisaku, ase emechando emechie ime, ase emechando y’erooro, ase emechando y’enyancha, ase ogochandwa nabaminto b’oborimo;

English: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa katika kazi ngumu na taabu, katika kukesha mara nyingi; ninajua kukaa njaa na kuona kiu; nimefunga kula chakula mara nyingi; nimehisi baridi na kuwa uchi.
Ekegusii: ase emeremo na obokong’u, ase okogeesa ara aange, ase enchara na erang’o, ase ogotanyora endagera ara aange, ase embeo na ase okoba getirianda.

English: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo yote, nakabiliwa na mzigo wa wajibu wangu kwa makanisa yote.
Ekegusii: Kobua ase amang’ana onsi ayare korwa isiko naro okorigereria gwe chikanisa chionsi, ayare gonchichera kera rituko.

English: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
Kiswahili: Je, ni nani aliye mdhaifu, nami nisijisikie mdhaifu? Je, nani aliyekwazwa, nami nisiudhike?
Ekegusii: Ning’o ore omoreu, na inche timba omoreu? Ning’o ogerire ogwe, na inche tingechigwa?

English: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
Kiswahili: Kama ni lazima nijisifu, basi nitajisifia yale mambo yanayoonyesha udhaifu wangu.
Ekegusii: Onye ngwenerete gwetogia, ninyetogerie amang’ana ’oboreu bwane.

English: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
Kiswahili: Mungu na Baba wa Bwana Yesu, yeye ambaye anahimidiwa milele, anajua ya kuwa mimi sisemi uongo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene Yeso, oyorabakwe goika kare na kare, omanyire ng’a tindi gokwana oborimo.

English: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
Kiswahili: Huko Dameski, mtawala aliyekuwa chini ya Mfalme Areta aliulinda mji wa Dameski ili kunikamata.
Ekegusii: Ekero narenge aaria Damesiki gabana, oyorenge inse y’omorwoti Areta, nigo arendete omochie o Damesiki, erio ambwate.

English: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
Kiswahili: Lakini nilishushwa kwa kapu kubwa kupitia katika dirisha ukutani, nikatoroka kutoka mikononi mwake.
Ekegusii: Korende nkabekwa ase egetonga ime, ngaikerigwa ase ekebao ase orwaki, ngatooreka korwa ase amaboko aye.

English: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Yanipasa nijisifu, ingawa haifaidi kitu. Nitaenda kwenye maono na ufunuo kutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ningwenerete gwetogia, nonya tigokongwenera gento; korende bono ninkwane igoro y’amaroro na okomaanorerwa bikorwa ase Omonene.

English: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.
Kiswahili: Namjua mtu mmoja katika Kristo ambaye miaka kumi na minne iliyopita alichukuliwa juu hadi mbingu ya tatu. Kama ni katika mwili au nje ya mwili, sijui, Mungu ajua.
Ekegusii: Namanyire omonto oyomo ase Kristo, yaetire emiaka ikomi na ene, omonto oyio akabogorigwa gochia igoro ya gatato, (onye orenge ase omobere tinkomanya, onye orenge isiko y’omobere tinkomanya, Nyasae nere omanyete).

English: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
Kiswahili: Nami najua ya kwamba mtu huyu, kwamba ni katika mwili au nje ya mwili mimi sijui, lakini Mungu ajua,
Ekegusii: Na inche namanyire omonto oyio, (onye orenge ase omobere tinkomanya, onye orenge isiko y’omobere tinkomanya, Nyasae nere omanyete);

English: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
Kiswahili: alinyakuliwa hadi Paradiso. Huko alisikia mambo yasiyoelezeka, mambo ambayo binadamu hana ruhusa ya kuyasimulia.
Ekegusii: igo abogoretigwe goika Paradiso ya Nyasae, akaigwa amang’ana atagwatoreka, ayatagwenerete Mwanyabaanto ayakwane.

English: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
Kiswahili: Nitajisifu kwa ajili ya mtu kama huyo, lakini sitajisifu kuhusu mimi mwenyewe ila mimi nitajisifia udhaifu wangu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omonto oyio ninyetogie; korende ase engencho yane tingwetogia, otatiga ase oboreu bwane.

English: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.
Kiswahili: Hata kama ningependa kujisifu, sitakuwa mjinga, kwa maana nitakuwa nasema kweli. Lakini najizuia, ili mtu yeyote asije akaniona mimi kuwa bora zaidi kuliko ninavyoonekana katika yale ninayotenda na kusema.
Ekegusii: Naki onye ndigetie gwetogia anga tinaba omoriri, ekiagera nintebe ekeene. Korende ninyetange, omonto tambarera kobua aya aroche ase ’nde, gose koyaigwa korwa ase ’nde.

English: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
Kiswahili: Ili kunizuia nisijivune kwa sababu ya ufunuo huu mkuu, nilipewa mwiba katika mwili wangu, mjumbe wa Shetani, ili anitese.
Ekegusii: Erinde timbaisa gocha koenena goetania ekerengo, ekiagera ase obonge bw’okomaanorerwa okwo, nkaegwa riigwa rimbetete ase omobere, omotomwa o Saitani, ang’ake, timbaisa gocha koenena goetania ekerengo.

English: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya jambo hili nilimsihi Bwana mara tatu aniondolee mwiba huu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’egento eke ngasaba Omonene ara gatato kendue.

English: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
Kiswahili: Lakini aliniambia, “Neema yangu inakutosha, kwa kuwa uweza wangu hukamilika katika udhaifu.” Kwa hiyo nitajisifu kwa furaha zaidi kuhusu udhaifu wangu, ili uweza wa Kristo ukae juu yangu.
Ekegusii: Korende aganteebia, “Obuya bwane bwagoisanire, ekiagera chinguru chiane chiaikeranirie ase oboreu.” Nabo ninyetogerie amareu aane ase omogooko, erio chinguru chia Kristo chiikaranse igoro ase ’nde.

English: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu, kwa ajili ya Kristo, nafurahia udhaifu, katika kutukanwa, katika taabu, katika mateso na katika shida, kwa maana ninapokuwa dhaifu, ndipo nina nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho ya Kristo nagweneirwe namareu, na ogochaaywa, na obokong’u, na okorosigwa, na emechando yonsi; ekero inde omoreu, erio nario inde ne chinguru.

English: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa mjinga, lakini ninyi mmenilazimisha niwe hivyo. Kwa kuwa ilinipasa kusifiwa na ninyi, kwa sababu mimi si dhalili kuliko wale “mitume walio bora,” ingawa mimi si kitu.
Ekegusii: Nabeire omoriri, korende inwe mwambetereirie koba bo. Inche ningwenerete ntogigwe nainwe, ekiagera tindemeiri gento eki abatomwa baria abanene baare nakio, nonya tindi gento.

English: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
Kiswahili: Mambo yanayomtambulisha mtume wa kweli, yaani, ishara, miujiza na maajabu, yalifanywa miongoni mwenu kwa saburi nyingi.
Ekegusii: Ekeene ebimanyererio bi’omotomwa bw’ekeene nigo biaorogetigwe egati yaino ase oboremereria bwonsi ase ebikone, na amakumia, na ogokora gwe chinguru.

English: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
Kiswahili: Je, ninyi ni kitu gani mlichopungukiwa kuliko makanisa mengine, ila tu kwamba mimi sikuwa mzigo kwenu? Nisameheni kwa kosa hili!
Ekegusii: Naki ngento ki moremeire kobua chikanisa chinde, otatiga inche timbaraarereti? Monyabere okomocha okwo!

English: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
Kiswahili: Sasa niko tayari kuja kwenu kwa mara hii ya tatu, nami sitawalemea, kwa sababu sitahitaji chochote chenu, ila ninawahitaji ninyi, kwa kuwa hata hivyo watoto hawaweki akiba kwa ajili ya wazazi wao, bali wazazi huweka akiba kwa ajili ya watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Rora, ekero eke nekia gatato inche nabeire ang’e gocha ase more. Tinkobaraarereria, naki tindi korigia ebinto biaino, korende inwe abanyene, ekiagera abana tibagwenereti kobagachera abaibori enibo, korende abaibori bagachere abana.

English: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
Kiswahili: Hivyo nitafurahi kutumia kila kitu nilicho nacho kwa ajili yenu, hata mwili wangu pia. Hata ingawa inaonekana ninavyozidi kuwapenda, ndivyo upendo wenu kwangu unavyopungua.
Ekegusii: Ase omogooko omonge ninyebeke, naende ninyerue ase engencho y’emioyo yaino. Onye nkomenta kobancha mono, Inee, ningwenerete koremerwa obwanchani?

English: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.
Kiswahili: Iwe iwavyo, kwa vyovyote vile mimi sikuwalemea. Lakini kwa mimi kuwa mwerevu naliwapata.
Ekegusii: Korende abe bo, inche timbaraarereti, korende ekiagera inde omong’aini nkabanyora ase obong’ainereria.

English: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?
Kiswahili: Je, nilijipatia faida kwa kumtumia mtu yeyote niliyemtuma kwenu?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nabaurete gento goetera ase onde bwensi natomete ase more?

English: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
Kiswahili: Nilimshawishi Tito aje kwenu, nami nilimtuma pamoja na ndugu yetu. Je, Tito aliwatumia ninyi ili kujipatia faida? Je, hatuenendi kwa roho moja, na hatuchukui hatua zile zile?
Ekegusii: Ngasorora Tito agende; ngatoma oyominto oria amo nere. Inee! Tito nabaurete gento? Titwagendete ase Omoika oria oria? Titwataarete ase chimbaratero chiria chiria?

English: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
Kiswahili: Je, mmekuwa mkifikiri kwamba sisi tunajaribu kujitetea mbele yenu? Sisi tumekuwa tukinena mbele za Mungu kama wale walio katika Kristo. Na chochote tufanyacho, ndugu wapendwa, ni kwa ajili ya kuwatia nguvu.
Ekegusii: Inee! Mokagete ng’a iga togwekengera ase more naende? Ase obosio bwa Nyasae nigo togokwana ase Kristo. Na aya onsi akorirwe ase okobaagacha inwe abanchwa.

English: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nina hofu ya kwamba nitakapokuja naweza kuwakuta nisivyotaka, nanyi mkanikuta msivyotaka. Nina hofu kwamba panaweza kuwa na ugomvi, wivu, ghadhabu, fitina, masingizio, masengenyo, majivuno na machafuko.
Ekegusii: Naki nairokire, ng’a inse gocha timbanyora buna ndigetie kobanyora; naende ndorekane ase more, tari buna morigetie inwe. Aande gose mbanyore more neriomana, ne ribero, na endamwamu, na okweancha, na ogoitania, na okogenkana, na oboenenu, ne rirorooche.

English: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.
Kiswahili: Nina hofu kwamba nitakapokuja tena kwenu, Mungu wangu atanidhili mbele yenu, nami nitasikitishwa na wengi waliotenda dhambi mbeleni, na wala hawajatubu kwa uchafu wao, uasherati, na ufisadi walioushiriki.
Ekegusii: Naende nairokire, ng’a inse gocha naende, Nyasae one nankeyie inse ase more, nimbaichanere mono ase abwo bamochete kare, abataonchogete korwa ase eubi, na obotomani, na obonyaka obwo bare kwenaria.
