English: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo mara ya tatu mimi kuja kwenu. “Shtaka lolote lazima lithibitishwe na mashahidi wawili au watatu.”
Ekegusii: Ekero eke nekia gatato ngocha ase more. Ase emenwa y’abarori babere gose batato kera ring’ana nariikeranigwe.

English: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,
Kiswahili: Nimekwisha kuwaonya nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi mara ya pili. Sasa narudia wakati sipo, kwamba nikija tena sitawahurumia wale waliokuwa wametenda dhambi hapo awali na wengine wote,
Ekegusii: Natang’anete kobamanyia, ekero narenge seino eria kabere, naboigo bono ntaracha natang’anire komanyia abwo bakorete ebibe kare, na abande bonsi, ng’a tinkobaabera,

English: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa mnadai uthibitisho kwamba Kristo anazungumza kwa kunitumia mimi. Yeye si dhaifu katika kushughulika nanyi, bali ana nguvu kati yenu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera morigetie ekiorokererio gia Kristo ng’a ere nigo agokwana ime yaino. Ere tari omoreu ase more, korende nare ne chinguru ime ase more.

English: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa alisulubiwa katika udhaifu, lakini anaishi kwa nguvu za Mungu. Vivyo hivyo, sisi tu dhaifu kupitia kwake, lakini katika kuwashughulikia ninyi tutaishi pamoja naye kwa nguvu za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki igo abambetwe ase oboreu, korende moyo are ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Naki intwe nigo tore abareu asare; korende natobe moyo amo nere ase okobua kwa Nyasae gocha ase more.

English: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
Kiswahili: Jichunguzeni wenyewe mwone kama mnaishi katika imani. Jipimeni wenyewe. Je, hamtambui ya kuwa Yesu Kristo yumo ndani yenu? Kama sivyo, basi, mmeshindwa kufikia kipimo hicho!
Ekegusii: Erenge inwe abanyene emioyo yaino gose more ase okwegena; eteeme inwe abanyene. Gose timwemanyeti ng’a Yeso Kristo nare ime ase more? Onye taibo, rirorio mwangirwe!

English: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
Kiswahili: Natumaini mtaona kuwa sisi hatukushindwa.
Ekegusii: Korende nasemeirie ng’a namomanye ng’a intwe titwangiri.

English: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.
Kiswahili: Lakini tunamwomba Mungu msije mkatenda kosa lolote, si ili sisi tuonekane kuwa tumeshinda hilo jaribio, bali ili ninyi mtende lililo haki, hata kama tutaonekana kuwa tumeshindwa.
Ekegusii: Korende twasabire Nyasae, timokora rinde rire riibe, tari ng’a intwe tororekane twancheirwe, korende inwe mokore erire rigiya, natoisa koba intwe buna abangirwe.

English: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hatuwezi kufanya lolote kinyume na kweli, bali kuithibitisha kweli tu.
Ekegusii: Naki titokonyara gokora ring’ana mamincha y’ekeene, korende ase ekeene.

English: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.
Kiswahili: Tunafurahi wakati wowote sisi tunapokuwa dhaifu, lakini ninyi mkawa na nguvu. Nayo maombi yetu ni kwamba mpate kuwa wakamilifu.
Ekegusii: Naki twagokire ekero intwe tore abareu, na inwe more ne chinguru. Eri twasabire neri, ng’a moikeranigwe.

English: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu nawaandikia mambo haya wakati sipo, ili nikija nisiwe mkali katika kutumia mamlaka yangu, mamlaka Bwana aliyonipa ya kuwajenga ninyi wala si ya kuwabomoa.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nariikire aya ekero ntari agwo, erinde nkoba agwo tinkorera obotindi ase ekerengo gi’okobua koria naetwe n’Omonene ase okobaagacha, gose tari ase okobatagora.

English: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, kwaherini. Kuweni wakamilifu, mkafarijike, kuweni wa nia moja, kaeni kwa amani. Naye Mungu wa upendo na amani atakuwa pamoja nanyi.
Ekegusii: Omoerio, abaminto, motigare buya. Mobe abaikeranu, moremigwe, mobe nomoyo oyomo, momenye ase omorembe. Na Nyasae bw’obwanchani na bw’omorembe abe amo nainwe.

English: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
Kiswahili: Salimianeni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa busu takatifu.
Ekegusii: Kwanania ase okonyunyuntana ase obochenu. Abachenu bonsi baabakwanirie.

English: All the saints greet you.
Kiswahili: Watakatifu wote wanawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yeso Kristo, na obwanchani bwa Nyasae na okobwatana kw’Omoika Omochenu bibe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
Kiswahili: Paulo mtume: si mtume wa wanadamu wala aliyetumwa na mwanadamu, bali na Yesu Kristo na Mungu Baba aliyemfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu;
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo, ere oyio okorangerigwa koba omotomwa tikwarenge korwa ase Mwanyabaanto gose goetera ase omonto, korende goetera ase Yeso Kristo, na Nyasae Tata oyomobogetie korwa ase abakuure.

English: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
Kiswahili: na ndugu wote walio pamoja nami: Kwa makanisa ya Galatia:
Ekegusii: Abaminto bonsi abare amo nainche aiga, twabakwanirie inwe abanto be chikanisa chia Galatia:

English: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: Neema iwe nanyi na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo,
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo,

English: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
Kiswahili: aliyejitoa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu ili apate kutuokoa katika ulimwengu huu wa sasa ulio mbaya, sawasawa na mapenzi yake yeye aliye Mungu na Baba yetu.
Ekegusii: Akerua ere omonyene ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, erinde atotoorie korwa ase ekegori eke ekebe kia bono, koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae Tata oito.

English: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Utukufu una yeye milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obonene bobe ase Nyasae kare na kare. Amina.

English: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
Kiswahili: Nashangaa kwamba mnamwacha upesi hivyo yeye aliyewaita kwa neema ya Kristo na kuifuata Injili nyingine,
Ekegusii: Nakumirie ase more inwe! Ekiagera mokomotiga iga bwango ere oyobarangeretie ase obuya bwa Kristo, na koonchokera enchiri ende eng’ao.

English: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
Kiswahili: ambayo kwa kweli si Injili kamwe, ila kwa dhahiri kuna watu wanaowachanganya na wanaotaka kuipotosha Injili ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase ekeene “enchiri ende eng’ao” teiyo, korende nigo nkoyakwana aya ase engencho mbareo abanto bande bakobaotorana na korigia koonchorana enchiri ya Kristo.

English: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata ikiwa sisi au malaika atokaye mbinguni akihubiri Injili nyingine tofauti na ile tuliyowahubiria sisi, basi mtu huyo alaaniwe milele!
Ekegusii: Korende neisa koba nintwe, gose omomalaika korwa igoro, okobaranderia enchiri ende eng’ao, otatiga eria twabaranderetie, tiga omonto oyio aragererigwe goika obosiru!

English: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
Kiswahili: Kama vile tulivyokwisha kusema kabla, sasa nasema tena, ikiwa mtu yeyote atawahubiria Injili kinyume na ile mliyoipokea na alaaniwe milele!
Ekegusii: Buna konya twakwanire ritang’ani, bono ninkwane naende: Onye omonto okobaranderia enchiri ende eng’ao, otatiga eria mwaitaberete, oyio tiga aragererigwe goika obosiru!

English: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
Kiswahili: Je, sasa mimi ninatafuta kukubaliwa na wanadamu au kukubaliwa na Mungu? Au nataka kuwapendeza wanadamu? Kama ningekuwa bado najaribu kuwapendeza wanadamu, nisingekuwa mtumishi wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Bono inee! Nigo eraise koigwekana gose buna inche nigo nkorigia ogwancherwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto? Tari boigo! Keria indigetie inche nokogwenera korwa ase Nyasae! Gose, inche nigo nkorigia ogwancherwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto? Onye nabeete nkogwenera Mwanyabaanto goika bono, anga inche tinabeete omosomba o Kristo.

English: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, nataka mjue kwamba Injili niliyowahubiria haikutokana na wanadamu.
Ekegusii: Naki nimbamanyie inwe abaminto, ng’a enchiri eye nabaranderetie tiyarwete ase Mwanyabaanto.

English: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mimi sikuipokea hiyo Injili kutoka kwa mwanadamu, wala sikufundishwa na mtu, bali niliipata kwa ufunuo kutoka kwa Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki tinayenyorete korwa ase Mwanyabaanto onde, gose tinorokereretigwe na monto onde bwensi, korende ere Yeso Kristo bweka, ere omonyene akang’a inche okomaanorerwa korwa asaare ere.

English: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mmekwisha kusikia juu ya maisha yangu ya zamani nilipokuwa katika dini ya Kiyahudi, jinsi nilivyolitesa kanisa la Mungu kwa nguvu na kujaribu kuliangamiza.
Ekegusii: Naki mwatebetigwe amang’ana y’orogendo rwane ase amatuko aetire ase edini y’Abayahudi buna inche nachandete ekanisa ya Nyasae goetania ekerengo, na buna nateemete koyesaria.

English: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
Kiswahili: Nami niliendelea sana katika dini ya Kiyahudi kuliko Wayahudi wengi wa rika yangu maana nilijitahidi sana katika desturi za baba zangu.
Ekegusii: Na inche kobua abange abarenge b’ekiare kiane ase egesaku kiane natang’anete ase edini y’Abayahudi, ngakora omokia mono ase okobwata chingencho chie chisokoro chiane.

English: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,
Kiswahili: Lakini ilipompendeza Mungu, aliyenitenga tangu tumboni mwa mama yangu na kuniita kwa neema yake,
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae ase obuya bwaye aganchora inche ekero konya intaraiborwa korwa ase enda ya baba na akandangeria erio imokorere. Naende ekero aetetie ayio,

English: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
Kiswahili: alimdhihirisha Mwanawe kwangu, ili nipate kumhubiri miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa. Mimi sikushauriana na mwanadamu yeyote,
Ekegusii: agancha koorokia Omwana oye ime ase ’nde erinde, indandie Amang’ana Amaya ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku. Erio tinarigia konyota obosemia korwa ase Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi;

English: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
Kiswahili: wala sikupanda kwenda Yerusalemu kuwaona hao waliokuwa mitume kabla yangu, bali nilikwenda mara moja Arabuni na kisha nikarudi Dameski.
Ekegusii: gose tinatiirete kogenda Yerusalemu ase abwo barenge abatomwa b’eritang’ani ase ’nde. Korende erio kegima nkagenda Arabia, naende nkairana goika Damesiki.

English: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
Kiswahili: Kisha baada ya miaka mitatu nilipanda kwenda Yerusalemu kuonana na Kefa na nilikaa naye siku kumi na tano.
Ekegusii: Erio magega y’emiaka etato koyaetire, ngatiira kogenda Yerusalemu gokwania Petero, nkamenya amo nere ase chichuma ibere.

English: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.
Kiswahili: Lakini sikumwona mtume mwingine yeyote isipokuwa Yakobo, ndugu yake Bwana.
Ekegusii: Korende tinaroche motomwa onde otatiga Yakobo, momura omwabo Omonene.

English: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
Kiswahili: Nawahakikishia mbele za Mungu kuwa ninayowaandikia si uongo.
Ekegusii: Ayio nkobariikera, nekeene. Nyasae namanyete buna tindi kongainereria!

English: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
Kiswahili: Baadaye nilikwenda sehemu za Syria na Kilikia.
Ekegusii: Erio magega nkagenda chinsemo chia Siiria na Kilikia.

English: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
Kiswahili: Lakini mimi binafsi sikujulikana kwa makanisa ya huko Uyahudi yaliyo katika Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio, inche omonyene tinamanyekanete nonde ase ababwatani be chikanisa chiare Boyahudi.

English: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
Kiswahili: Wao walisikia habari tu kwamba, “Mtu yule ambaye hapo kwanza alikuwa akitutesa sasa anahubiri imani ile ile aliyokuwa akijaribu kuiangamiza.”
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo nigo bamanyete okaoka aria bare koigwa korwa ase abande ng’a, “Ere oyotochandete ritang’ani, bono nkorandia are okwegena koria aare gosaria agwo ritang’ani.”

English: So they glorified God in me.
Kiswahili: Nao wakamtukuza Mungu kwa sababu yangu.
Ekegusii: Bagatogia Nyasae ase engencho yane.

English: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
Kiswahili: Kisha, baada ya miaka kumi na minne, nilipanda tena kwenda Yerusalemu pamoja na Barnaba, nikamchukua na Tito ili awe pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Magega y’emiaka ikomi na ene ngatiira naende kogenda Yerusalemu amo na Barnaba, nkairana Tito agende amo nainche.

English: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
Kiswahili: Nilikwenda kwa sababu nilikuwa nimefunuliwa na Mungu, ili nikawaeleze kwa faragha wale walioonekana kuwa viongozi, ile Injili ninayoihubiri kwa watu wa Mataifa. Nilifanya hivyo kwa kuhofia kwamba nisije nikawa nilikuwa ninakimbia au nilikimbia bure.
Ekegusii: Na inche ngatiira ekiagera namaanoreretwe na Nyasae buna ngende; ase obobisi nkabateebia abarai enchiri eria nkorandia ase abanto b’Ebisaku. Inche tinarigetie emeremo yane emekoro gose emeyia ebe bosa.

English: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata Tito ambaye alikuwa Myunani, hakulazimika kutahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Korende Tito oyorenge amo nainche, nonya orenge Omogiriki, tabetereretigwe kwarokigwa.

English: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu ya ndugu wa uongo ambao walijiingiza kwa siri katikati yetu ili kupeleleza uhuru wetu tulio nao katika Kristo Yesu, wapate kututia utumwani,
Ekegusii: Aya nigo aganetigwe nabaminto buna akoreke. Abaminto b’oborimo, abasoetigwe bobisi, banyare kounenkia obosibore bwaito tore nabwo ime ase Kristo Yeso, erinde batobeke ase obosibwa.

English: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
Kiswahili: hatukukubaliana nao hata dakika moja, ili kwamba ukweli wa Injili ubaki nanyi.
Ekegusii: Korende erinde ekeene gi’enchiri kegenderere amo nainwe titwebegete inse ase bare nonya nensa eyemo.

English: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya wale waliokuwa wakubaliwe kuwa viongozi (kwangu mimi sikujali vyeo vyao, maana Mungu hana upendeleo), wale watu hawakuniongezea chochote.
Ekegusii: Korende abwo baabarire ng’a nabanene bare (tari gento ase ’nde nonya barenge nobonene bore naki; Nyasae tari nogwanchereria ase Mwanyabaanto), nakwanire ng’a abwo baabarire ng’a nabanene bare tibamentereti gento ase ’nde.

English: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—
Kiswahili: Badala yake walitambua kwamba nilikuwa nimekabidhiwa kazi ya kuhubiri Injili kwa watu wa Mataifa, kama vile Petro alivyokabidhiwa kuhubiri Injili kwa Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Korende bakarora ekeene, ng’a inche negenirwe koranderia abatarogeti enchiri, buna Petero egenetwe koyeranderia baria baarogete.

English: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, Mungu aliyekuwa akitenda kazi katika huduma ya Petro kama mtume kwa Wayahudi, ndiye pia aliyekuwa anatenda kazi katika huduma yangu kama mtume kwa watu wa Mataifa.
Ekegusii: (Naki ere oyoete Petero chinguru koba omotomwa bw’abaarogete, nere ong’ete inche chinguru koba omotomwa bw’abaanto b’Ebisaku.)

English: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
Kiswahili: Basi, Yakobo, Kefa na Yohana, walioonekana kama nguzo za kanisa, walitupa mkono wa shirika, mimi na Barnaba walipotambua ile neema niliyopewa. Wakakubali kwamba sisi twende kwa watu wa Mataifa na wao waende kwa Wayahudi.
Ekegusii: Naende ekero bachia komanya obuya boria naeirwe, Yakobo na Kefa, na Yohana, abasikire bare buna chisiiro, bagatoa inche na Barnaba okoboko gw’okorio gw’okobwatana, erinde intwe togende ase abanto b’Ebisaku, na barabwo bagende ase abanto b’okwaroka.

English: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
Kiswahili: Walichotuomba ni kwamba tuendelee kuwakumbuka maskini, jambo ambalo ndilo nililokuwa na shauku ya kulifanya.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana erimo barigetie tokore nario eri, ng’a toinyore abataka, ne ring’ana erio nigo narenge nomokia korikora.

English: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
Kiswahili: Lakini Petro alipofika Antiokia, mimi nilimpinga ana kwa ana kwa sababu alikuwa amekosea kwa wazi.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Kefa achete Antiokia, nkaamererania nere obosio ase obosio, ekiagera konya oikire kogambigwa.

English: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
Kiswahili: Kabla baadhi ya watu waliotoka kwa Yakobo hawajafika, alikuwa akila pamoja na watu wa Mataifa. Lakini hao watu walipofika alianza kujiondoa na kujitenga na watu wa Mataifa kwa sababu aliwaogopa wale wa kundi la tohara.
Ekegusii: Naki konya bataracha abanto baria barwete ase Yakobo, nigo arenge koragera amo nabaanto b’Ebisaku; korende ekero bachete akairana magega, ageatanana, akairoka abaarogete.

English: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
Kiswahili: Pia Wayahudi wengine waliungana naye katika unafiki huu, hata Barnaba naye akapotoshwa na unafiki wao.
Ekegusii: Agwo amo nere Abayahudi bande bagakora obong’ainereria boria, erinde nonya Barnaba agasirigwa nobong’ainereria bwabo.

English: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
Kiswahili: Nilipoona kwamba hawatendi sawasawa na kweli ya Injili, nilimwambia Petro mbele ya wote, “Wewe ni Myahudi, nawe unaishi kama mtu wa Mataifa na wala si kama Myahudi. Imekuwaje basi, mnawalazimisha watu wa Mataifa kufuata desturi za Kiyahudi?
Ekegusii: Korende ekero nachia korora ng’a ogokora kwabo tikware okwaboronge ase ekeene gi’enchiri, ngateebia Kefa ase amasio y’abaanto bonsi, “Onye aye, oyore Omoyahudi, gokobwatia chingencho chi’abaanto b’Ebisaku, gose tari echi’Abayahudi, naki rende oranyare kobetereria abanto b’Ebisaku babwatie chingencho chi’Abayahudi?”

English: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,
Kiswahili: “Sisi wenyewe ni Wayahudi kwa kuzaliwa na si watu wenye dhambi kama watu wa Mataifa,
Ekegusii: Intwe n’Abayahudi ase okoiborwa gwaito, gose tari abanyene ebibe b’Ebisaku,

English: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
Kiswahili: bado tunajua ya kwamba mtu hahesabiwi haki kwa matendo ya sheria bali kwa njia ya imani katika Yesu Kristo. Hivyo sisi pia, tumemwamini Kristo Yesu ili tupate kuhesabiwa haki kwa njia ya imani katika Kristo, wala si kwa matendo ya sheria, kwa sababu kwa kushika sheria hakuna hata mtu mmoja atakayehesabiwa haki.
Ekegusii: korende ntomanyete ng’a omonto takonyora oboronge ase ogokora kw’amachiiko, korende ase okomwegena Kristo Yeso. Nonya nintwe twamwegenire Kristo Yeso, erinde tonyore oboronge ase okomwegena Kristo, tari ase ogokora kw’amachiiko, ekiagera ase ogokora kw’amachiiko onde tari ase Mwanyabaanto oranyare konyora oboronge.

English: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
Kiswahili: “Lakini tukitafuta kuhesabiwa haki katika Kristo, inakuwa dhahiri kwamba sisi ni wenye dhambi. Je, ina maana kwamba Kristo amekuwa mtumishi wa dhambi? La hasha!
Ekegusii: Korende onye intwe abanyene nigo twarenge korigia konyora oboronge ase Kristo, naende twanyoretwe tore abanyene ebibe, Inee, Kristo nabeire omosomba bw’ebibe? Yaya, taibo!

English: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mimi ninajenga tena kile ambacho nimekwisha kukibomoa, basi ninaonyesha kwamba mimi ni mkosaji.
Ekegusii: Korende kondaagache naende aria natagorete, neorokirie inche omonyene ng’a nomomochi inde.

English: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mimi kwa njia ya sheria, nimeifia sheria ili nipate kuishi kwa ajili ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki inche goetera ase amachiiko nakwereire amachiiko, erinde imbe moyo ase Nyasae. Nabambirwe na Kristo ase omosalaba,

English: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
Kiswahili: Nimesulubiwa pamoja na Kristo, wala si mimi tena ninayeishi, bali Kristo ndiye aishiye ndani yangu. Uhai nilio nao sasa katika mwili, ninaishi kwa imani ya Mwana wa Mungu, aliyenipenda na kujitoa kwa ajili yangu.
Ekegusii: gose bono tari inche inde moyo, korende Kristo nigo are moyo ime ase ’nde; na obogima inde naborobwo bono ase omobere, nigo inde naborobwo ase okomwegena Omwana o Nyasae, oyonyanchete, naende bweruete omonyene ase engencho yane.

English: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
Kiswahili: Siibatilishi neema ya Mungu, kwa maana kama haki ingeweza kupatikana kwa njia ya sheria, basi Kristo alikufa bure!”
Ekegusii: Tinkwanga obuya bwa Nyasae, ekiagera onye oboronge bokonyorekana ase amachiiko, rirorio Kristo nigo akwete bosa.

English: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
Kiswahili: Ninyi Wagalatia wajinga! Ni nani aliyewaroga? Yesu Kristo aliwekwa wazi mbele yenu kwamba amesulubiwa.
Ekegusii: Inwe Abagalatia abariri! Ning’o obaarogete inwe? Amang’ana igoro y’okobambwa kwa Yeso Kristo nigo aorogetigwe ase more maiso marore.

English: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
Kiswahili: Nataka nijifunze neno moja kutoka kwenu: Je, mlipokea Roho wa Mungu kwa kushika sheria, au kwa kuyaamini yale mliyosikia?
Ekegusii: Tiga mbaborie ring’ana eri rioka: Igo mwanyorete Omoika ase ogokora kw’amachiiko, gose ase okwegena goetera ase okoigwa?

English: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
Kiswahili: Je, ninyi ni wajinga kiasi hicho? Baada ya kuanza kwa Roho, je, sasa mwataka kumalizia katika mwili?
Ekegusii: Nabo more abariri buna iga? Mogachaaka ase Omoika, na bono morigetie goikeranigwa ase chingencho chiaino abanyene?

English: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
Kiswahili: Je, mlipata mateso kiasi hicho bure? Ni kama kweli yalikuwa bure!
Ekegusii: Inee! Igo mwanarete emechando emenge enga buna eye bosa? Aande gose tiyarenge bosa.

English: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
Kiswahili: Je, Mungu huwapa Roho wake na kufanya miujiza katikati yenu kwa sababu mnatii sheria, au kwa sababu mnaamini kile mlichosikia?
Ekegusii: Ere oyokobaa inwe Omoika na gokora ebikone bie chinguru egati yaino, Inee, igo agokora ayio ase ogokora kw’amachiiko gose ase okwegena goetera ase okoigwa?

English: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
Kiswahili: Kama vile “Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu na ikahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki.”
Ekegusii: Nabo “Aburaamu nigo amwegenete Nyasae, na ase engencho eyio akabarwa koba omonyene oboronge.”

English: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.
Kiswahili: Fahamuni basi kwamba wale walio na imani, hao ndio watoto wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Gaki manya iga, ng’a baria bare nokwegena, abwo nabwo bare abana ba Aburaamu.

English: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
Kiswahili: Maandiko yakitabiri kwamba Mungu angewahesabia haki watu wa Mataifa kwa imani, alitangulia kumtangazia Abrahamu Injili akisema kwamba, “Kwa kupitia kwako mataifa yote yatabarikiwa.”
Ekegusii: Korende ayio amariiko aroche korwa kare, ng’a Nyasae nae abanto b’Ebisaku oboronge ase okwegena. Ase ayio akaranderia Aburaamu enchiri kare, akabora, “Asore aye abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabasesenigwe.”

English: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, wale wote wanaoamini wanabarikiwa pamoja na Abrahamu, mtu wa imani.
Ekegusii: Naboigo abwo bare nokwegena mbasesenirie amo na Aburaamu oyorenge omwegeni.

English: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wote wanaotumainia matendo ya sheria wako chini ya laana, kwa kuwa imeandikwa, “Alaaniwe kila mtu asiyeshikilia kutii mambo yote yaliyoandikwa katika Kitabu cha Sheria.”
Ekegusii: Naki baria bonsi basemeretie ogokora kw’amachiiko, nigo bare inse y’okoragererigwa, ekiagera neriikire, “Kera omonto oyotari kobwata onsi ayarikire ase egetabu y’amachiiko na koyakora oragererigwe.”

English: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
Kiswahili: Basi ni dhahiri kwamba hakuna mtu anayehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu kwa kushikilia sheria, kwa maana, “Mwenye haki ataishi kwa imani.”
Ekegusii: Bono nigo are maiso marore, ng’a onde tari oranyore oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase amachiiko; ekiagera nigo ariikire, “Omonyene oboronge nabe moyo ase okwegena.”

English: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
Kiswahili: Lakini sheria haitegemei imani. Kinyume chake, “Mtu atendaye matendo hayo ataishi kwa hayo.”
Ekegusii: Amachiiko nigo are ao ase okwegena, ekiagera nigo ariikire, “Omonto oyorakore ayio nabe moyo ase aro.”

English: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
Kiswahili: Kristo alitukomboa kutoka laana ya sheria kwa kufanyika laana kwa ajili yetu, kwa maana imeandikwa, “Amelaaniwa yeye aangikwaye juu ya mti.”
Ekegusii: Kristo natobooretie korwa ase okoragererigwa kw’amachiiko, ekero akoretwe koba okoragererigwa ase engencho yaito, ekiagera neriikire, “Kera omonto oyobambirwe igoro ase omote nigo are inse y’okoragererigwa kwa Nyasae.”

English: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
Kiswahili: Alitukomboa ili kwamba baraka aliyopewa Abrahamu ipate kuwafikia watu wa Mataifa kwa njia ya Kristo Yesu, ili kwa imani tupate kupokea ile ahadi ya Roho.
Ekegusii: Igo ogosesenigwa okwo Aburaamu anyorete goikera abanto b’Ebisaku goetera ase Kristo Yeso, erinde tonyare konyora Omoika ase enchera y’okwegena, buna twarieretwe eira.

English: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, nataka nitoe mfano kutoka maisha ya kila siku. Kama vile hakuna mtu awezaye kutangua au kuongeza kitu katika agano la mtu ambalo limekwisha kuthibitishwa, vivyo hivyo kwa hali kama hii.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, ngokwana ’nde ase omobwekano bw’amang’ana a kera rituko. Ekero okoriera kw’omwando bw’omonto kogoikerana, onde tari oranyaare gokoonchora gose komenta ring’ana.

English: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.
Kiswahili: Ahadi zilinenwa kwa Abrahamu na kwa mzao wake. Maandiko hayasemi “kwa wazao,” likimaanisha watu wengi, bali “kwa mzao wako,” yaani mtu mmoja, ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: Chiira chiria chiarieretwe Aburaamu na omoiborwa oye. Biblia teri gokwana amang’ana aya, “Ase oroiboro” buna nase abange; korende eira iga erengete ase oyomo, “Ase omoiborwa oo”, nere Kristo.

English: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
Kiswahili: Ninachotaka kusema ni kwamba, sheria, ambayo ilitolewa miaka 430 baadaye, haitangui Agano lililothibitishwa na Mungu ili kuibatilisha ahadi ile.
Ekegusii: Aya ngokwana naya: Okobwatana koria gwakoretwe ritang’ani na Nyasae; na amachiiko aria akarentwa magega y’emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etato, tagosaria okobwatana koria, erinde eira eria ebe eya bosa.

English: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama urithi hupatikana kwa sheria, basi hautegemei tena ahadi, lakini Mungu kwa neema yake alimpa Abrahamu urithi kwa njia ya ahadi.
Ekegusii: Naki omwando korabe ase amachiiko, tokoba naende ase eira; korende Nyasae akayoa Aburaamu ase eira.

English: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini basi iwepo sheria? Sheria iliwekwa kwa sababu ya makosa mpaka atakapokuja yule Mzao wa Abrahamu, ambaye alitajwa katika ile ahadi. Sheria iliamriwa na malaika kwa mkono wa mpatanishi.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko rende, inki agwenerete? Akamentwa ase engencho y’amamocho, goika omoiborwa oria orieretwe eira anyare gocha. Amachiiko aria nigo aruetwe goetera ase abamalaika ase okoboko kw’omobwatania.

English: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.
Kiswahili: Basi mpatanishi huhusisha zaidi ya upande mmoja, lakini Mungu ni mmoja.
Ekegusii: Oyore omobwatania tari omobwatania ase oyomo, korende Nyasae noyomo.

English: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
Kiswahili: Je basi, sheria inapingana na ahadi za Mungu? La hasha! Kwa maana kama sheria iliyotolewa ingeweza kuwapa watu uzima, basi haki ingepatikana kwa njia ya sheria.
Ekegusii: Inee! Amachiiko nigo are mamincha yechiira chia Nyasae? Yaya, taibo! Naki onye amachiiko aruetwe ayaranyare koa abanto obogima, anga oboronge nigo bwanyorekanete ase amachiiko.

English: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
Kiswahili: Lakini Maandiko yamefanya vitu vyote vifungwe chini ya nguvu ya dhambi, ili yale yaliyoahidiwa kwa njia ya imani katika Yesu Kristo yapate kupewa wale wanaoamini.
Ekegusii: Korende amariiko asiekeire bonsi inse y’okobua kw’ebibe, erinde abegenire baegwe ayio ariereretwe eira ase enchera y’okomwegena Yeso o Kristo.

English: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
Kiswahili: Kabla imani hii haijaja tulikuwa tumewekwa chini ya sheria, tumefungwa mpaka ile imani ifunuliwe.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero okwegena gotaracha, nigo twabwatire inse y’amachiiko, twasibire goika okwegena goche koorokigwa.

English: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, sheria ilikuwa kiongozi kutufikisha kwa Kristo, ili tupate kuhesabiwa haki kwa imani.
Ekegusii: Naboigo amachiiko abeire omotebereria oito agotoira goika ase Kristo, erinde tonyore oboronge ase okwegena.

English: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa ile imani imekuja, hatusimamiwi tena na sheria.
Ekegusii: Korende bono okwegena kogwachire, titori naende inse y’omotebereria.

English: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninyi nyote mmekuwa watoto wa Mungu katika Kristo Yesu kwa njia ya imani.
Ekegusii: Naki ime ase Kristo Yeso inwe mwensi mwabeire abana ba Nyasae ase enchera y’okwegena.

English: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wote mliobatizwa ndani ya Kristo, mmemvaa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe mwensi, abamwabatisetwe ase Kristo, mwamweboire Kristo.

English: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Wala hakuna tena Myahudi au Myunani, mtumwa au mtu huru, mwanaume wala mwanamke, maana nyote mmekuwa wamoja ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Aiga tari Omoyahudi gose Omogiriki, tari omosomba gose omosibore, tari omosacha gose omokungu, ekiagera inwe mwensi nigo more oyomo ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mkiwa ni mali ya Kristo, basi ninyi ni wa uzao wa Abrahamu na warithi sawasawa na ile ahadi.
Ekegusii: Naki onye inwe naba Kristo, rirorio mwabeire oroiboro rwa Aburaamu, na abanyamwando ase eira.

English: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,
Kiswahili: Lile nisemalo ni kwamba wakati wote mrithi bado ni mtoto, hana tofauti na mtumwa, ingawa ndiye mmiliki wa mali yote.
Ekegusii: Korende nigo ngokwana ng’a omonyamwando, ekero are omwana, tari nogwatananeka nomosomba, nonya ore omonyene enibo yonsi.

English: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
Kiswahili: Yeye huwa yuko chini ya uangalizi wa walezi na wadhamini mpaka ufike wakati uliowekwa na baba yake.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo are inse y’abareri na abarendi goika engaki eria yachigetwe na ise eike.

English: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo na sisi, tulipokuwa bado watoto wadogo, tulikuwa utumwani chini ya taratibu za kawaida za ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Nabo naintwe, ekero twarenge abana, nigo twarenge abasomba inse y’amorokererio aye ritang’ani y’ense.

English: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
Kiswahili: Lakini ulipowadia utimilifu wa wakati, Mungu alimtuma Mwanawe, ambaye alizaliwa na mwanamke, akazaliwa chini ya sheria,
Ekegusii: Korende ekero engaki yaigete, Nyasae agatoma Omwana oye; ere akaiborwa nomokuungu, akaiborerwa inse y’amachiiko,

English: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.
Kiswahili: kusudi awakomboe wale waliokuwa chini ya sheria, ili tupate kupokea zile haki kamili za kufanywa watoto wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: erinde ababoorie baria barenge inse y’amachiiko, erinde tonyare gokorwa koba abana baye.

English: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ninyi ni watoto wa Mungu, Mungu amemtuma Roho wa Mwanawe mioyoni mwetu, anayelia, “Abba, Baba.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe more abana baye, Nyasae agatoma Omoika bw’Omwana oye ase chinkoro chiaito, okorera, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata!”

English: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, wewe si mtumwa tena, bali ni mtoto, kwa kuwa wewe ni mtoto, Mungu amekufanya wewe pia kuwa mrithi kwa kupitia Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, aye tori omosomba naende, korende Nyasae ogokorire koba omwana oye; na onye kwabeire omwana, naboigo kwabeire omonyamwando.

English: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.
Kiswahili: Zamani, mlipokuwa hammjui Mungu, mlikuwa watumwa wa viumbe ambavyo kwa asili si Mungu.
Ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani, ekero motamomanyete Nyasae, inwe nigo mwarenge abasomba ase chinyasae chitare chinyasae bori.

English: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa mmemjua Mungu, au zaidi mmejulikana na Mungu, inakuwaje mnarejea tena katika zile kanuni za kwanza zenye udhaifu na upungufu? Mnataka ziwafanye tena watumwa?
Ekegusii: Korende bono, komwaikire komomanya Nyasae, gose kobua, mwamanyekanire na Nyasae, nase ki rende mokoiranera amorokererio aye ritang’ani, ayare amoro na amataka? Nase ki morigetie koyakorera naende?

English: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
Kiswahili: Mnaadhimisha siku maalum, miezi, nyakati na miaka!
Ekegusii: Nigo mokorenda mono amatuko, na emetienyi, na ebiro, na emiaka.

English: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
Kiswahili: Nina hofu juu yenu, kwamba kazi niliyofanya kwa ajili yenu inaweza kuwa nimejitaabisha bure.
Ekegusii: Noboire ng’a nigo nerosirie bosa ase engencho yaino.

English: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, nawasihi mwe kama mimi, kwa sababu mimi nimekuwa kama ninyi. Hamkunitendea jambo lolote baya.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, nabasoroire, mobe buna inche inde, ekiagera inche nigo nabeire buna inwe. Timwankorerete bobe bonde.

English: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mwajua kwamba ni kwa ajili ya udhaifu wangu niliwahubiria Injili.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwamanyire ng’a inabaranderetie enchiri ritang’ani ase engencho y’oboreu bw’omobere one.

English: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Ingawa hali yangu iliwatia majaribuni, hamkunidharau wala kunidhihaki, bali mlinikaribisha kama malaika wa Mungu, kama vile Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Nonya oboreu boria bwarenge ogoteemwa ase more timwanchayete gose timwanyangete, korende mokandoisia buna omomalaika o Nyasae ee, buna Kristo Yeso omonyene.

English: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
Kiswahili: Ile hali ya furaha mliyokuwa nayo imekwenda wapi? Naweza kushuhudia kwamba, kama ingewezekana mngengʼoa macho yenu na kunipa mimi.
Ekegusii: Ng’ai rende omogooko oino ore? Naki nababereire kirori, ng’a onye yanyarekana, anga mwanduseria amaiso aino mong’e.

English: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
Kiswahili: Je, sasa nimekuwa adui yenu kwa kuwaambia kweli?
Ekegusii: Inee! Nabeire omobisa oino, ekiagera nabateebirie ayare ay’ekeene?

English: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
Kiswahili: Hao wana shauku ya kuwapata lakini si kwa kusudi zuri. Wanachotaka ni kuwatenga mbali nasi, ili ninyi mpate kuwaonea wao shauku.
Ekegusii: Baria bande mbare nomokia ase more, korende tari ase enchera ere engiya; mbarigetie kobasiekera isiko, erinde monyare gokora omokia kobakorera.

English: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
Kiswahili: Ni vizuri wakati wote kuwa na shauku kwa ajili ya kusudi zuri, si wakati nikiwa pamoja nanyi tu.
Ekegusii: Korende mbuya botambe korigia omokia ase ring’ana rire rigiya, na tari ekero inde amo nainwe rioka.

English: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
Kiswahili: Watoto wangu wapendwa, ambao kwa mara nyingine ninawaonea utungu, ninatamani kwamba Kristo aumbike ndani yenu.
Ekegusii: Abana baane abake, ninde nokoromwa gw’okobina gw’okobaibora naende, goika Kristo arorekane ime yaino.

English: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
Kiswahili: Natamani kama ningekuwa pamoja nanyi sasa, pengine ningebadilisha sauti yangu. Kwa maana nina wasiwasi kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Ee, anga nancha koba amo nainwe bono, na koonchora eriogi riane, ekiagera timanyeti inki ngokora ase more.

English: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
Kiswahili: Niambieni, ninyi mnaotaka kuwa chini ya sheria, je, hamjui sheria inavyosema?
Ekegusii: Nteebie, inwe abamorigetie koba inse y’amachiiko, Inee, timori koigwera amachiiko?

English: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa kwamba Abrahamu alikuwa na wana wawili, mmoja wa mwanamke mtumwa na wa pili wa mwanamke huru.
Ekegusii: Naki neriikire, ng’a Aburaamu nigo arenge nabana babere abamura, oyomo bw’omokuungu omosomba, na oyomo bw’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.

English: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
Kiswahili: Lakini, mtoto wa mwanamke mtumwa alizaliwa kwa mapenzi ya mwili, na yule mwingine wa mwanamke huru alizaliwa kutokana na ahadi ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende omwana oria bw’omokuungu omosomba akaiborwa buna monto onde bwensi; na oria bw’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba, akaiborwa ase eira.

English: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
Kiswahili: Mambo haya yanaweza kuchukuliwa kama mfano. Kwa maana hao wanawake wawili ni mfano wa maagano mawili: Agano la kwanza, ni lile lililofanyika katika Mlima Sinai, lizaalo watoto wa utumwa. Hili ndilo huyo Hagari.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo agokwanwa buna omoreng’anio. Abakungu aba nabwo amabwatano abere. Okomo nigo gokorwa egetunwa Sinai, gokoibora abana ase obosomba; nere Hagari.

English: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
Kiswahili: Basi Hagari anawakilisha Mlima Sinai ulioko Arabuni, na unafanana na Yerusalemu ya sasa ambayo iko utumwani pamoja na watoto wake.
Ekegusii: Naki Hagari, engencho yaye egetunwa Sinai ekere Arabia, kegwekanirie na Yerusalemu ya bono, ekiagera nigo are ase obosomba amo nabana baye.

English: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
Kiswahili: Lakini Yerusalemu wa juu ni huru, nayo ndiye mama yetu.
Ekegusii: Korende Yerusalemu ya igoro nomochie omosibore, noro baba oito.

English: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa: “Furahi, ewe mwanamke tasa, wewe usiyezaa; paza sauti, na kuimba kwa furaha, wewe usiyepatwa na utungu wa kuzaa; kwa maana watoto wa mwanamke aliyeachwa ukiwa ni wengi kuliko wa mwanamke mwenye mume.”
Ekegusii: Naki neriikire, “Aye ore omogomba, otari koibora, goka! Aye otari nokobina ase okoibora, aka eriogi, orere nomogooko, ekiagera abana baye oria otigetwe nigo bare abange kobua abaye oyore nomosaacha.”

English: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
Kiswahili: Basi, sisi ndugu zangu, ni kama Isaki, tu watoto wa ahadi.
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe nigo more abana b’eira buna Isaka.

English: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
Kiswahili: Lakini, kama vile ilivyokuwa siku zile yule aliyezaliwa kwa mwili alivyomchokoza yule aliyezaliwa kwa Roho, ndivyo ilivyo hata sasa.
Ekegusii: Korende buna ase ekero keria oria oiboretwe koreng’ana buna onde bwensi nigo amochandete oria oiboretwe ase engencho y’Omoika, naboigo nonya ngoika bono.

English: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
Kiswahili: Lakini Maandiko yasemaje? “Mwondoe mwanamke mtumwa pamoja na mwanawe, kwa sababu mwana wa mwanamke mtumwa kamwe hatarithi pamoja na mwana wa aliye huru.”
Ekegusii: Korende amariiko naki agoteeba? Igo agoteeba, “Seria omosomba oria amo nomwana oye, ekiagera omwana bw’omokuungu omosomba takonyora omwando nonya ng’ake amo nomwana bw’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.”

English: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, sisi si watoto wa mwanamke mtumwa, bali wa yule aliye huru.
Ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, intwe titori abana b’omokuungu omosomba, korende nabana b’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.

English: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
Kiswahili: Kristo alitupa uhuru, akataka tubaki huru. Hivyo simameni imara wala msikubali tena kulemewa na kongwa la utumwa.
Ekegusii: Kristo agatosibora, erinde tomenye ase obosibore; gaki tenena bokong’u, timobwatwa naende ase obosibwa bw’obosomba.

English: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
Kiswahili: Sikilizeni! Mimi, Paulo, nawaambieni kwamba kama mkikubali kutahiriwa, basi Kristo hatawafaidia chochote.
Ekegusii: Igwa, inche Paulo nkobateebia nde inwe, ng’a moise kwarokigwa, rirorio Kristo takoba nengencho ende ase more.

English: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
Kiswahili: Namshuhudia tena kila mtu anayekubali kutahiriwa kwamba inampasa kushika sheria yote.
Ekegusii: Naende ngoteebia nde kera omonto oyokwarokigwa, ng’a rirorio osibirwe ase ogoikerania amachiiko onsi.

English: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mnaotafuta kuhesabiwa haki kwa njia ya sheria mmetengwa na Kristo, mko mbali na neema ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mwatananirwe korwa ase Kristo, inwe abamorigetie konyora oboronge korwa ase amachiiko, mwagure korwa ase obuya.

English: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kwa njia ya Roho kwa imani, tunangojea kwa shauku tumaini la haki.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe ase Omoika ntoganyete oboronge boria tosemeretie ase enchera y’okwegena.

English: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ndani ya Kristo Yesu, kutahiriwa au kutokutahiriwa hakuleti tofauti, bali lililo muhimu ni imani itendayo kazi kwa njia ya upendo.
Ekegusii: Naki ase Kristo Yeso okwaroka tikogokonyorera kende, gose ogotaroka, korende okwegena okwo nakwo kogokora emeremo ase obwanchani.

English: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
Kiswahili: Mlikuwa mkipiga mbio vizuri. Ni nani aliyewazuia msiitii kweli?
Ekegusii: Nigo mwarenge kominyoka buya; ning’o obatangete timoigwera ekeene?

English: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
Kiswahili: Ushawishi wa namna hiyo haukutokana na yule anayewaita.
Ekegusii: Okoebereria okwo tikwarwete asare ere oyobarangeretie inwe.

English: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
Kiswahili: “Chachu kidogo huchachua donge zima.”
Ekegusii: Ememera emeke nigo ekobotia ribomba rigima.

English: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
Kiswahili: Nina hakika katika Bwana kwamba hamtakuwa na msimamo mwingine. Mtu anayewachanganya anastahili adhabu, hata awe nani.
Ekegusii: Ase Omonene ninde nogosemeria ase more ng’a timokoba nebirengererio binde ebiao, korende ere oyokobachanda nabogorie okogambigwa kwaye, naba onde bwensi.

English: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu zangu, kama mimi bado ninahubiri kuhusu kutahiriwa, kwa nini bado ninateswa? Katika hiyo hali basi, kwazo la msalaba limeondolewa.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, onye inche ngendererete nonya mbono koraria amang’ana y’okwaroka, nase ki rende nkona‐gochandwa? Igo ekegocha ki’omosalaba kiarusigwe.

English: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
Kiswahili: Laiti hao wanaowavuruga wangejihasi wao wenyewe!
Ekegusii: Anga nancha ng’a abwo bakobachanda begombayie abanyene.

English: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, ninyi mliitwa ili mwe huru, hivyo msitumie uhuru wenu kama fursa ya kufuata tamaa za mwili, bali tumikianeni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa upendo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abaminto, nigo mwarangeretigwe monyore obosibore; korende ogosiborwa kwaino tikoba ogw’okobwatia chingencho chiaino chi’ebibe, mbuya mokorerane inwe ase inwe ase obwanchani.

English: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sheria yote hukamilika katika amri moja: “Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.”
Ekegusii: Naki amachiiko onsi aikeranigwe ase ring’ana erimo, na rirorio nario eri, “Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”

English: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
Kiswahili: Kama mkiumana na kutafunana, angalieni, msije mkaangamizana.
Ekegusii: Korende kerabe mokoromana na koriana, rigereria timocha gosirania inwe ase inwe.

English: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo nasema, enendeni kwa Roho, wala hamtazitimiza kamwe tamaa za mwili.
Ekegusii: Gaki nigo nkobateebia, mogenderere ase Omoika na timogoikerania okogania gwe chingencho chiaino chi’ebibe.

English: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mwili hutamani yale yaliyo kinyume na Roho, naye Roho hutamani yale yaliyo kinyume na mwili. Roho na mwili hupingana na kwa sababu hiyo hamwezi kufanya mnayotaka.
Ekegusii: Naki okogania gwe chingencho chi’ebibe nigo gokoamererania n’Omoika na okogania kw’Omoika nigo gokoamererania ne chingencho chi’ebibe; naki ebi iga bikorwana goika timokonyara gokora ayamorigetie gokora.

English: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mkiongozwa na Roho, hamko chini ya sheria.
Ekegusii: Korende komokoraagwa n’Omoika, rirorio timori inse y’amachiiko.

English: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
Kiswahili: Basi matendo ya mwili ni dhahiri nayo ni haya: Uasherati, uchafu, ufisadi,
Ekegusii: Ogokora gwe chingencho chi’ebibe nigo kore maiso marore na korokwo nobotomani, eubi, obonyaka,

English: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
Kiswahili: kuabudu sanamu, uchawi, uadui, ugomvi, wivu, hasira, fitina, faraka, uzushi,
Ekegusii: ogosasiima emegwekano, oborogi, obobisa, eriomana, ribero, endamwamu, obong’iti, okwerusanania, ogweatanana,

English: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.
Kiswahili: husuda, ulevi, ulafi na mambo mengine yanayofanana na hayo. Nawaonya, kama nilivyokwisha kuwaonya kabla, kwamba watu watendao mambo kama hayo, hawataurithi Ufalme wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: emoko, oboiti, ogotinda, chigosori chimbe, na amang’ana ande buna ayio. Nabakuureire buna narenge kobakuurera ritang’ani, ng’a abwo bagokora amang’ana anga buna ayio, tibakonyora omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

English: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
Kiswahili: Lakini tunda la Roho ni upendo, furaha, amani, uvumilivu, utu wema, fadhili, uaminifu,
Ekegusii: Korende okwama kw’Omoika nobwanchani, omogooko, omorembe, oboremereria, obwororo, obuya, obwegenwa,

English: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
Kiswahili: upole na kiasi. Katika mambo kama haya hakuna sheria.
Ekegusii: oboitongo, okwerita ase onsi; machiko ande tari arange amang’ana buna ayio.

English: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
Kiswahili: Wote walio wa Kristo Yesu wameusulubisha mwili na shauku zake pamoja na tamaa zake.
Ekegusii: Abwo bare abakristo Yeso baabambire chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe amo nokogania okobe na okorengereria kwabo.

English: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tunaishi kwa Roho, basi, tuenende kwa Roho.
Ekegusii: Onye intwe twabeire moyo ase Omoika, togenderere boigo ase Omoika.

English: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
Kiswahili: Tusijisifu bure, tukichokozana na kuoneana wivu.
Ekegusii: Titoba nokogania kw’ogwetogia abanyene, titochegania, gose koba nemoko intwe ase intwe.

English: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, ikiwa mtu ameghafilika akatenda dhambi, basi ninyi mlio wa rohoni, mrejesheni upya mtu huyo kwa roho ya upole. Lakini jihadharini, ili ninyi wenyewe msije mkajaribiwa.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, onye omonto obuirwe nokomocha konde, inwe abamore ab’Omoika nebagwenerete koirania omonto oyio ase omoika bw’obwororo. Erigererie aye omonyene, tobaisa goteemwa.

English: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
Kiswahili: Chukulianeni mizigo ninyi kwa ninyi, nanyi kwa njia hii mtatimiza sheria ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Bogorerania chigurube inwe ase inwe, nario moraikeranie amachiiko a Kristo.

English: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote akijiona kuwa yeye ni bora na kumbe sivyo, basi mtu huyo anajidanganya mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki omonto karekage ng’a ere naisaine, ere taisaini kende; igo akweng’aina ere omonyene.

English: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila mtu na aipime kazi yake mwenyewe, ndipo aweze kujisifu, bila kujilinganisha na mtu mwingine.
Ekegusii: Korende kera omonto arenge emeremo yaye omonyene. Onye ore nengencho y’ogwetogia, tiga ayietogerie bweka omonyene, na tereng’ania nomogisangio oye.

English: For each man will bear his own burden.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kila mtu atauchukua mzigo wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki kera omonto nebogorererie egurube yaye omonyene.

English: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
Kiswahili: Basi, yeye afundishwaye katika neno na amshirikishe mwalimu wake mema yote.
Ekegusii: Korende ere oyokworokererigwa ring’ana, abwatane nere oyokomworokereria ase ebinto ebiya bionsi.

English: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
Kiswahili: Msidanganyike, Mungu hadhihakiwi. Kwa kuwa kile apandacho mtu ndicho atakachovuna.
Ekegusii: Timong’aineka; Nyasae tagokorerwa echeche. Naki kende gionsi omonto agosimeka, nakio arache kogesa.

English: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
Kiswahili: Apandaye kwa mwili, katika mwili wake atavuna uharibifu, lakini yeye apandaye katika Roho, katika Roho atavuna uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyogosimeka ase chingencho chiaye chi’ebibe nache kogesa ogosareka korwa ase chingencho chiaye chi’ebibe, korende ere oyogosimeka ase Omoika nache kogesa obogima bwa kare na kare korwa ase Omoika.

English: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
Kiswahili: Hivyo, tusichoke katika kutenda mema, kwa kuwa tutavuna kwa wakati wake tusipokata tamaa.
Ekegusii: Titorosa gokora amaya, ekiagera natogese ekero engaki eraike, totakweti emioyo.

English: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kadiri tupatavyo nafasi na tuwatendee watu wote mema, hasa wale wa jamaa ya waaminio.
Ekegusii: Nabo gatorabe ne ribaga tokorere abanto bonsi amaya, korende kobua mono abwo bare ab’okwegena.

English: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
Kiswahili: Angalieni herufi kubwa nitumiazo ninapowaandikia kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe!
Ekegusii: Rigereria, buna chinuguta chire chinene echi nabariikeire nokoboko kwane omonyene.

English: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaotaka kuonekana wazuri kwa mambo ya mwili wanataka wawalazimishe kutahiriwa. Sababu pekee ya kufanya hivyo ni kuepuka kuteswa kwa ajili ya msalaba wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Bonsi abwo barigetie kororekana buya ase emebere yabo, abwo nabwo bakobabetereria ng’a mwarokigwe, erinde tibachandwa ase engencho y’omosalaba o Kristo.

English: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.
Kiswahili: Hata wale waliotahiriwa wenyewe hawaitii sheria, lakini wanataka ninyi mtahiriwe ili wapate kujivuna kwa habari ya miili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya mbarabwo abanyene abaarogete tibabwateti amachiiko, korende mbarigetie inwe mwarokigwe, erinde banyare gwetogeria emebere yaino.

English: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
Kiswahili: Mungu apishie mbali nisije nikajivunia kitu chochote isipokuwa msalaba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, ambaye kwa yeye ulimwengu umesulubiwa kwangu, nami nimesulubiwa kwa ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Ogwetogia kobe are nainche, otatiga inyetogerie omosalaba Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, ase oro ense yabambirwe ase ’nde, na inche ase ense.

English: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana katika Kristo Yesu, kutahiriwa au kutokutahiriwa si kitu, bali kule kuwa kiumbe kipya ni kila kitu!
Ekegusii: Naki okwaroka tai gento, gose ogotaroka tai gento, korende negento koba egetongwa ekeyia.

English: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
Kiswahili: Amani na rehema viwe na wote wanaofuata kanuni hii, na juu ya Israeli wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Omorembe na amaabera bibe amo na bonsi abaragenderere ase ogochika oko, na amo n’Abaisraeli ba Nyasae.

English: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, tangu sasa mtu yeyote asinitaabishe, kwa maana nachukua katika mwili wangu chapa zake Yesu.
Ekegusii: Korwa bono monto onde tanchanda; naki nabogoirie ekemanyererio kia Yeso ase omobere one.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja na roho zenu. Amen.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, obuya bw’omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nemioyo yaino. Amina.

English: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
Kiswahili: Paulo, mtume wa Kristo Yesu, kwa mapenzi ya Mungu: Kwa watakatifu walioko Efeso, walio waaminifu katika Kristo Yesu:
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, nkobariikera nde inwe abachenu abamomenyete Efeso, abeegeni ba Kristo Yeso:

English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
Kiswahili: Ahimidiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, aliyetubariki sisi kwa baraka zote za rohoni, katika ulimwengu wa roho ndani ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, atogigwe, ere oyotosesenetie ase Kristo nogosesenigwa gwonsi kw’omoika aase aaria igoro,

English: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana alituchagua katika yeye kabla ya kuumbwa ulimwengu ili tuwe watakatifu na bila lawama mbele zake. Kwa upendo
Ekegusii: buna atochoorete ase ere ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, erinde tobe abachenu, totari na komocha ase obosio bwaye.

English: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
Kiswahili: alitangulia kutuchagua tuwe wanawe kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo kwa furaha yake na mapenzi yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase obwanchani bwaye Nyasae atochorete korwa kare, erinde tokorwe koba abana baye ase enchera ya Yeso Kristo, koreng’ana nokogania kw’ogwancha kwaye,

English: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tunamsifu Mungu kwa huruma zake kuu alizotumiminia sisi katika Mwanawe Mpendwa.
Ekegusii: erinde obonene bw’obuya bwaye botogigwe, obo atoeire buna ekeegwa ase Omwanchwa oye.

English: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
Kiswahili: Ndani yake tunao ukombozi kwa njia ya damu yake, yaani, msamaha wa dhambi, sawasawa na wingi wa neema yake
Ekegusii: Ase are ere ntore nokoboorigwa ase amanyinga aye, na okwaberwa kw’ebibe biaito ase obonge bw’obuya bwaye,

English: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
Kiswahili: aliyotumiminia kwa wingi, kwa hekima yote na maarifa yote.
Ekegusii: obo ere akabomenta ase tore ase chiseemi na obong’aini bwonsi.

English: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
Kiswahili: Naye alitujulisha siri ya mapenzi yake sawasawa na uradhi wa mapenzi yake, ambayo alikusudia katika Kristo,
Ekegusii: Nyasae agatomanyia obobisi bw’ogwancha kwaye, koreng’ana nokogania kwaye buna aroberetie ase Kristo,

English: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.
Kiswahili: ili yapate kutimizwa wakati mkamilifu utakapowadia, yaani, kuvitia vitu vyote vya mbinguni na vya duniani pamoja, chini ya kiongozi mmoja, ndiye Kristo.
Ekegusii: ng’a ase ekero ki’ogoikeranigwa kw’engaaki nabeekeranie ebinto bionsi bibe n’obomo ase Kristo, ebinto bire igoro, na ebire ase ense, ase ere oyio.

English: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,
Kiswahili: Katika Kristo sisi nasi tumepata urithi, tukisha kuchaguliwa sawasawa na kusudi la Mungu, yeye ambaye hufanya mambo yote kulingana na kusudi la mapenzi yake,
Ekegusii: Ime yaye twanyorire omwando, koreng’ana buna twachooretwe korwa kare ase okorigia kwaye ere oy’okorete onsi koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye,

English: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba, sisi tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuweka tumaini katika Kristo, tupate kuishi kwa sifa ya utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: erinde intwe abatwatang’anete komosemeria Kristo togere obonene bwaye botogigwe.

English: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
Kiswahili: Ninyi pia mliingia ndani ya Kristo mliposikia Neno la kweli, Injili ya wokovu wenu. Mkiisha kuamini, ndani yake mlitiwa muhuri, yaani, Roho Mtakatifu mliyeahidiwa,
Ekegusii: Ase ere oyio, inwe abamwaigure ring’ana ri’ekeene, enchiri y’ogotooreka kwaino, na komwaikire komwegena ere, mokabekwa ekemanyererio n’Omoika Omochenu, oria mwarieretwe eira.

English: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
Kiswahili: yeye ambaye ni amana yetu akituhakikishia urithi wetu hadi ukombozi wa wale walio milki ya Mungu kwa sifa ya utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: Oyo nere ore intenenera ase omwando oito, goika okoboorigwa kw’abare aba Nyasae, ase ogotogigwa kw’obonene bwaye.

English: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, tangu niliposikia juu ya imani yenu katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wenu kwa watakatifu wote,
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ekero naigwete amang’ana y’okwegena kwaino more nakorokwo ase Omonene Yeso, na obwanchani bwaino ase abachenu bonsi,

English: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
Kiswahili: sijaacha kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu, nikiwakumbuka katika maombi yangu.
Ekegusii: tintigeti koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino, na kobainyora ase ogosaba kw’ane.

English: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,
Kiswahili: Nazidi kumwomba Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, Baba wa utukufu, awajalieni ninyi roho ya hekima na ya ufunuo, ili mpate kumjua zaidi.
Ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a Nyasae Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Tata Obonene, abae omoika bw’obong’aini na bw’okomaanorerwa, erinde momomanye;

English: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
Kiswahili: Ninaomba pia kwamba macho ya mioyo yenu yatiwe nuru ili mpate kujua tumaini mliloitiwa, utajiri wa urithi wa utukufu wake kwa watakatifu
Ekegusii: naende ng’a amaiso ye chinkoro chiaino abekwe omobaso, erinde momanye ogosemeria koria abarangereretie monyore, na komanya obonda bw’obonene bw’omwando oye buna bore, obo abachenu baeirwe.

English: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
Kiswahili: na uweza wake mkuu usiolinganishwa kwa ajili yetu sisi tuaminio. Uweza huo unaofanya kazi ndani yetu, ni sawa na ile nguvu kuu mno
Ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a momanye obonene bw’okobua kwaye botari nekerengo, obo bwatoikeire intwe abatwegenire koreng’ana nogokora gw’okobua kwaye okonene.

English: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
Kiswahili: aliyoitumia katika Kristo alipomfufua kutoka kwa wafu, na akamketisha mkono wake wa kuume huko mbinguni,
Ekegusii: Ere nigo akorete emeremo eyio ase Kristo ekero amoboogetie korwa ase abakuure, akamoikaransia ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio aaria igoro,

English: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
Kiswahili: juu sana kuliko falme zote na mamlaka, enzi na milki, na juu ya kila jina litajwalo, si katika ulimwengu huu tu, bali katika ule ujao pia.
Ekegusii: igoro mono kobua okogaamba gwonsi, na okobua, ne chinguru, na oborwoti, na igoro ya kera erieta rigwatorwa, tari ase ense eye yoka, korende neria egochia‐gocha boigo.

English: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
Kiswahili: Naye Mungu ameweka vitu vyote viwe chini ya miguu yake na amemfanya yeye awe kichwa cha vitu vyote kwa ajili ya Kanisa,
Ekegusii: Naende akabeeka ebinto bionsi inse y’amagoro aye, akamobeka abe omotwe igoro y’ebinto bionsi ase ekanisa,

English: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
Kiswahili: ambalo ndilo mwili wake, ukamilifu wake yeye aliye yote katika yote.
Ekegusii: eyio ere omobere oye, ogoikerania kwaye ere oyogoikerania ebinto bionsi ase bonsi.

English: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,
Kiswahili: Kwa habari zenu, mlikuwa wafu katika makosa na dhambi zenu,
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwareenge mokwete ase ogosaria kwaino, na ebibe biaino.

English: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.
Kiswahili: ambazo mlizitenda mlipofuatisha namna ya ulimwengu huu na za yule mtawala wa ufalme wa anga, yule roho atendaye kazi sasa ndani ya wale wasiotii.
Ekegusii: Ime ase ebio nigo mwabigendererete kare ase ogotunyana chingeencho chi’ense eye, na gotunyana omogambi bw’okobua kwa igoro gati, oyore omoika oria ogokora emeremo ase abanto bataigwereti Nyasae.

English: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.
Kiswahili: Sisi sote pia tuliishi katikati yao hapo zamani, tukitimiza tamaa za asili yetu ya dhambi na kufuata tamaa zake na mawazo yake. Nasi kwa asili tulikuwa wana wa ghadhabu, kama mtu mwingine yeyote.
Ekegusii: Naboigo naintwe twensi twagendete agwo kare ase okogania gwe chingeencho chiaito chimbe, togaikerania okogania kw’emebere yaito, na ebirengererio biaito, tokaba ase chingeencho chiaito; abanto abaragwe ase endamwamu ya Nyasae buna abwo bande.

English: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu kwa upendo wake mwingi kwetu sisi, ambaye ni mwingi wa rehema,
Ekegusii: Korende Nyasae, oyore n’obonge bw’amaabera, ase obwanchani bwaye obonene atwanchete,

English: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
Kiswahili: hata tulipokuwa wafu kwa ajili ya makosa yetu, alitufanya tuwe hai pamoja na Kristo Yesu, yaani, mmeokolewa kwa neema.
Ekegusii: nonya n’ekero keria twareenge tokwete ase ogosaria gwaito, agatoa obogima amo na Kristo; inaki mwatoorigwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae.

English: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: Mungu alitufufua pamoja na Kristo na kutuketisha pamoja naye katika ulimwengu wa roho katika Kristo Yesu,
Ekegusii: Naende agatobookia amo nere, agatoikaransia amo nere aaria igoro ase Kristo Yeso,

English: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
Kiswahili: ili katika ule ulimwengu ujao apate kuonyesha wingi wa neema yake isiyopimika, iliyodhihirishwa kwetu kwa wema wake ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: erinde ase ebiro biraache naorokie obonda bw’obuya bwaye, obo boetete ekerengo, ase obwororo ase tore ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mmeokolewa kwa neema, kwa njia ya imani, wala si kwa matendo yenu mema. Hii ni zawadi kutoka kwa Mungu,
Ekegusii: Inaki mwatoorigwe ase obuya, ase enchera y’okwegena; ayio tarwete ase more abanyene, korende nekeegwa kia Nyasae;

English: not of works, that no one would boast.
Kiswahili: si kwa matendo, ili mtu yeyote asije akajisifu.
Ekegusii: gose tari ase ogokora, monto onde taacha gwetogia.

English: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sisi ni kazi ya mikono ya Mungu, tulioumbwa katika Kristo Yesu, ili tupate kutenda matendo mema, ambayo Mungu alitangulia kuyaandaa tupate kuishi katika hayo.
Ekegusii: Inaki nigo tore emeremo y’amaboko aye, togatongwa ase Kristo Yeso, erinde tokore ogokora okuya okwo Nyasae aroisetie ritang’ani, erio totaare ime ase okwo.

English: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kumbukeni kwamba ninyi ambao hapo awali mlikuwa watu wa Mataifa kwa kuzaliwa na kuitwa “wasiotahiriwa” na wale wanaojiita “waliotahiriwa” (yaani tohara ifanyikayo katika mwili kwa mikono ya wanadamu),
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inyora buna mwareenge kare. Inwe abanto b’Ebisaku ase chingeencho chi’omobere mware korokwa abanto batarogeti na baria bakwaroka ase okwaroka kw’omobere kogokorwa n’amaboko.

English: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
Kiswahili: kumbukeni kwamba wakati ule mlikuwa mbali na Kristo, mkiwa mmetengwa kutoka jumuiya ya Israeli, na mkiwa wageni katika yale maagano ya ahadi, nanyi mkiwa hamna tumaini wala Mungu duniani.
Ekegusii: Inyora ng’a engaki eria timwareenge na Kristo, nigo mwatananekanete korwa ase obobiare bw’Abaisraeli, abageni b’okobwatana kw’eira, motareenge na gosemeria konde, na motareenge na gosemeria na Nyasae ase ense.

English: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa katika Kristo Yesu, ninyi ambao hapo kwanza mlikuwa mbali na Mungu, sasa mmeletwa karibu kwa njia ya damu ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende bono, ase Kristo Yeso, inwe abamwareenge are agwo ritang’ani, mwarentirwe ang’e n’amanyinga a Kristo.

English: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeye mwenyewe ndiye amani yetu, aliyetufanya sisi tuliokuwa wawili, yaani, Wayahudi na watu wa Mataifa, tuwe wamoja kwa kuvunja kizuizi na kubomoa ule ukuta wa uadui uliokuwa kati yetu,
Ekegusii: Inaki Kristo nomorembe oito, otokorete intwe, Abayahudi n’Abagiliki, koba oyomo, goetera ase omobere oye agatagora etoto eria yatwatananete, engencho yaye obobisa.

English: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,
Kiswahili: kwa kuibatilisha ile sheria pamoja na amri zake na maagizo yake alipoutoa mwili wake, ili apate kufanya ndani yake mtu mmoja mpya badala ya hao wawili, hivyo akifanya amani,
Ekegusii: Ere agasiria richiiko ri’Abayahudi n’emeroberio y’amachiiko, erinde ase ere omonyene atonge omonto oyomo omoyia korwa ase baria babere, igo agakora omorembe,

English: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.
Kiswahili: naye katika mwili huu mmoja awapatanishe wote wawili na Mungu kupitia msalaba, ili kwa huo msalaba akaangamiza uadui wao.
Ekegusii: na kobwatania baria babere na Nyasae ase omobere oyoomo, ase omosalaba, aase aiterete obobisa boria.

English: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
Kiswahili: Alikuja na kuhubiri amani kwenu ninyi mliokuwa mbali na pia akahubiri amani kwao waliokuwa karibu.
Ekegusii: Kristo agacha korandia omorembe ase abanto b’ebisaku abwo mwareenge are, na ase Abayahudi abwo bareenge ang’e.

English: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa kupitia kwake, sisi sote tunaweza kumkaribia Baba katika Roho mmoja.
Ekegusii: Inaki goeteera ase Kristo intwe twensi Abayahudi amo n’abanto b’ebisaku twanyorire enchera y’okomoika ang’e na Tata, ase Omoika oyomo.

English: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, ninyi sasa si wageni tena wala wapitaji, bali mmekuwa wenyeji pamoja na watakatifu na pia jamaa wa nyumbani mwake Mungu.
Ekegusii: Gaki korwa bono inwe abanto b’ebisaku timori abamenyi gose abaeti, korende mwabeire ababiare amo n’abachenu, abanto b’enyomba ya Nyasae,

English: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
Kiswahili: Mmejengwa juu ya msingi wa mitume na manabii, naye Kristo Yesu mwenyewe ndiye jiwe kuu la pembeni.
Ekegusii: mwagaachirwe igoro y’oboroso bw’abatomwa na ababani, na Kristo Yeso omonyene nere rigena rinene ri’ekoona.

English: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;
Kiswahili: Ndani yake jengo lote limeshikamanishwa pamoja na kusimamishwa ili kuwa Hekalu takatifu katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase are ere oboagacho bwonsi bwabwataniigwe amo, na gokiina, bobe Hekalu Enchenu ase Omonene.

English: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Katika yeye ninyi nanyi mnajengwa pamoja ili mpate kuwa makao ambayo Mungu anaishi ndani yake kwa njia ya Roho wake.
Ekegusii: Asere inwe boigo mw’agaachirwe amo, mobe obomenyo bwa Nyasae, ase Omoika.

English: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,
