Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, mimi Paulo, mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu kwa ajili yenu ninyi watu wa Mataifa:
Ekegusii: Inaki ase ayio inche Paulo nabeire omosibwa o Kristo Yeso ase engencho yaino, inwe abanto b’Ebisaku.

English: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,
Kiswahili: Kwa hakika mmekwisha kusikia kuhusu ile huduma ya neema ya Mungu niliyopewa kwa ajili yenu,
Ekegusii: Ase ekeene mwaigure amang’ana y’oborendi bw’obuya bwa Nyasae, obo naetwe ase engencho yaino.

English: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,
Kiswahili: yaani, ile siri iliodhihirishwa kwangu kwa njia ya ufunuo, kama nilivyotangulia kuandika kwa kifupi.
Ekegusii: Ase okomaanorerwa nateebetigwe obobisi boria buna nabariikera reero iga ase amang’ana amake.

English: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,
Kiswahili: Kwa kusoma haya, basi mtaweza kuelewa ufahamu wangu katika siri ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero morayasome, inamonyaare korora okomanya kw’ane kw’obobisi bwa Kristo.

English: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,
Kiswahili: Siri hii haikudhihirishwa kwa wanadamu katika vizazi vingine kama vile sasa ilivyodhihirishwa na Roho kwa mitume na manabii watakatifu wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Obobisi obo Nyasae tamanyetie Mwanyabaanto ase ebigori binde buna bono ase Omoika abaigoreire abatomwa baye abachenu na ababani.

English: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,
Kiswahili: Siri hii ni kwamba, kwa njia ya Injili, watu wa Mataifa ni warithi pamoja na Israeli, viungo vya mwili mmoja na washiriki pamoja wa ahadi katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Obobisi boria nobo, ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku babeire abanyamwando amo naintwe, ebiimo bi’omobere oyomo, na ababwatani amo naintwe ase eira ere ase Kristo Yeso ase enchera y’enchiri.

English: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa mtumishi wa Injili hii kwa kipawa cha neema ya Mungu niliyopewa kwa nguvu yake itendayo kazi.
Ekegusii: Nabo ’ngakorwa koba omosomba bw’enchiri eye koreng’ana nekeegwa ki’obuya bwa Nyasae obo naetwe ase ogokora gw’okobua kwaye.

English: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
Kiswahili: Ingawa mimi ni mdogo kuliko aliye mdogo kabisa miongoni mwa watakatifu wote, nilipewa neema hii: ili niwahubirie watu wa Mataifa kuhusu utajiri usiopimika ulio ndani ya Kristo,
Ekegusii: Inche inde omoke kobua abachenu bonsi; nonya nabo ’nkaegwa obuya bw’okoranderia abanto b’Ebisaku obonda bwa Kristo, obo botari korengeka.

English: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: na kuweka wazi kwa kila mtu siri hii iliyokuwa imefichwa tangu zamani katika Mungu, aliyeumba vitu vyote.
Ekegusii: Nkaegwa kobaorokereria abanto bonsi barore omooroberio bw’obobisi boria bwabisetwe korwa kare ase Nyasae, oyotongete ebinto bionsi;

English: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
Kiswahili: Ili sasa kwa njia ya Kanisa, hekima yote ya Mungu ipate kujulikana kwa watawala na wenye mamlaka katika ulimwengu wa roho,
Ekegusii: erinde bono, ase enchera y’ekanisa, obong’aini bwa Nyasae, obore ne chingeencho chinyinge, bomanyekane n’abagaambi na abare nokobua kwa igoro.

English: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Kiswahili: sawasawa na kusudi lake la milele katika Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu.
Ekegusii: Nabo kwareenge okorigia kwaye gwa kare na kare, okwo aikeranetie ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.

English: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
Kiswahili: Ndani yake na kwa njia ya imani katika yeye twaweza kumkaribia Mungu kwa uhuru na kwa ujasiri.
Ekegusii: Asere ntore noboremu na ogosemeria kw’ogosoa ase enchera y’okomwegena.

English: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, nawaomba msikate tamaa kwa sababu ya mateso yangu kwa ajili yenu, hayo ni utukufu wenu.
Ekegusii: Gaki nabasabire, timokwa emioyo ase engencho y’ogochaandwa kw’ane inde nakwo ase engencho yaino, okore obonene bwaino.

English: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii nampigia Baba magoti,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio namobekeire amaru aane inse Tata,

English: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
Kiswahili: ambaye ubaba wote wa kila jamaa za mbinguni na za duniani unatokana naye.
Ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi abakorwa ase Tata, abare igoro na abare ase ense, nigo bakorokwa ase erieta riaye.

English: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,
Kiswahili: Namwomba Mungu awaimarishe kwa kuwatia nguvu mioyo yenu kwa njia ya Roho wake kwa kadiri ya utajiri wa utukufu wake,
Ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a koreng’ana nobonda bw’obonene bwaye, abanchere momentwe chinguru ase okobua goeteera ase Omoika oye ase omonto o ime;

English: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
Kiswahili: ili kwamba, Kristo apate kukaa mioyoni mwenu kwa njia ya imani. Nami ninaomba kwamba ninyi mkiwa wenye mizizi tena imara katika msingi wa upendo,
Ekegusii: na Kristo amenye ase chinkoro chiaino komwamwegenire. Nasabire ng’a inwe komor’abe n’emeri na oboroso ase obwanchani,

English: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,
Kiswahili: mwe na uwezo wa kufahamu pamoja na watakatifu wote jinsi ulivyo upana, urefu, kimo na kina upendo wa Kristo,
Ekegusii: monyaare koba ne chinguru ase okomanya amo nabachenu bonsi obogare na obotambe, na gochia igoro, na gochia inse,

English: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
Kiswahili: na kujua upendo huu unaopita fahamu, ili mpate kujazwa na kufikia kipimo cha ukamilifu wote wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: na komanya obwanchani bwa Kristo oboetete okomanya, erinde monyaare goichorigwa ogoichorwa gwonsi kwa Nyasae.

English: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
Kiswahili: Basi kwa yeye awezaye kutenda mambo ya ajabu yasiyopimika kuliko yote tuyaombayo au tuyawazayo, kwa kadiri ya uweza wake ule utendao kazi ndani yetu,
Ekegusii: Gaki, ase are ere oyoranyaare gokora goetania mono kobua aya togosaba gose aya tokorengereria, koreng’ana ne chinguru chigokora emeremo ime ase tore,

English: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
Kiswahili: yeye atukuzwe katika kanisa na katika Kristo Yesu kwa vizazi vyote, milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: ase are ere obonene ase ekanisa na ase Kristo Yeso goika ebigori bionsi kare na kare. Amina.

English: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
Kiswahili: Basi, mimi niliye mfungwa wa Bwana, nawasihi mwenende kama inavyostahili wito wenu mlioitiwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche omosibwa ase engencho y’Omonene nabasoroire mogenderere buna egwenerete okorangerigwa kwaino mwarangereretigwe

English: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
Kiswahili: Kwa unyenyekevu wote na upole, mkiwa wavumilivu, mkichukuliana kwa upendo.
Ekegusii: ase obokanyeku bwonsi na obwororo, na ase oboremereria mokobogorerania ase obwanchani.

English: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
Kiswahili: Jitahidini kudumisha umoja wa Roho katika kifungo cha amani.
Ekegusii: Mokore omokia konyora obomo bw’Omoika ase egesibo ki’omorembe.

English: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
Kiswahili: Kuna mwili mmoja na Roho mmoja, kama vile mlivyoitwa katika tumaini moja.
Ekegusii: Omobere n’oyoomo, na Omoika n’oyoomo, buna mwarangeretigwe ase ogosemeria okomo gw’okorangerigwa kwaino.

English: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
Kiswahili: Tena kuna Bwana mmoja, imani moja, ubatizo mmoja,
Ekegusii: Omonene oyomo, okwegena okomo, ebatiso eyemo,

English: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
Kiswahili: Mungu mmoja ambaye ni Baba wa wote, aliye juu ya yote, katika yote na ndani ya yote.
Ekegusii: Nyasae oyomo, ore Tata o bonsi, ere ore igoro ase bonsi, goetera ase bonsi, na ime ase bonsi.

English: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila mmoja wetu amepewa neema kwa kadiri ya kipimo cha kipawa cha Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende kera oyomo oito naetwe obuya koreng’ana n’ekerengo gi’ekeegwa gia Kristo.

English: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo husema: “Alipopaa juu zaidi, aliteka mateka, akawapa wanadamu vipawa.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo agoteeba. “Ekero ageendete igoro, akaira abasakore, akaa Mwanyabaanto ebiegwa.”

English: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
Kiswahili: (Asemapo “alipaa juu,” maana yake nini isipokuwa ni kusema pia kwamba Kristo alishuka pande za chini sana za dunia?
Ekegusii: (Gaki, ring’ana eri, “Ageendete igoro”, engencho yaye inki otatiga naboigo aigete nonya ngoika ensemo yainse y’ense?

English: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliyeshuka ndiye alipaa juu zaidi kupita mbingu zote, ili apate kuujaza ulimwengu wote.)
Ekegusii: Oyoigete nere oyio ogendete boigo igoro ya igoro, erinde ebinto bionsi biichorwe nere.)

English: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
Kiswahili: Ndiye aliweka wengine kuwa mitume, wengine kuwa manabii, wengine kuwa wainjilisti, wengine kuwa wachungaji na walimu,
Ekegusii: Ere akarua abande babe abatomwa, na abande ababani, na abande abarandia, na abande abarisia, na abande aboorokia.

English: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
Kiswahili: kwa kusudi la kuwakamilisha watakatifu kwa ajili ya kazi za huduma, ili kwamba mwili wa Kristo upate kujengwa
Ekegusii: Agakora bo ase ogoikerania abachenu ase emeremo y’obosomba, goika omobere o Kristo oagachwe.

English: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,
Kiswahili: mpaka sote tutakapoufikia umoja katika imani na katika kumjua sana Mwana wa Mungu na kuwa watu wazima kwa kufikia kimo cha ukamilifu wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Nabo goika intwe twensi tonyaare goikera obomo bw’okwegena, na komanya mono Omwana o Nyasae, na koba omonto omoikeranu, goika ekerengo ki’ogokiina kw’ogoichorwa gwa Kristo;

English: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
Kiswahili: Ili tusiwe tena watoto wachanga, tukitupwatupwa huku na huku na kuchukuliwa na kila upepo wa mafundisho kwa hila za watu, kwa ujanja, kwa kufuata njia zao za udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: erinde titoba naende abana ebing’werere, bagotumatumigwa aaria na aaria, na koirurukigwa ase kera embeo y’okworokereria, ase obong’ainereria bw’abaanto, ekero bakobang’aina kobwatia chiinchera chi’okobasiria.

English: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,
Kiswahili: Badala yake, tukiambiana kweli kwa upendo, katika mambo yote tukue, hata tumfikie yeye aliye kichwa, yaani, Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende tokwane ekeene ase obwanchani, tokiine goika toikere Kristo ase chiinchera chionsi; nere ore omotwe.

English: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwake, mwili wote ukiwa umeungamanishwa na kushikamanishwa pamoja kwa msaada wa kila kiungo, hukua na kujijenga wenyewe katika upendo, wakati kila kiungo kinafanya kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Ase are ere omobere bwonsi onyare gokiina ogokiina kw’omobere na kweagaacha omonyene ase obwanchani, korasang’ananigwe na kobwatanigwa ase ogokoonywa gwa kera ekiimo koreng’ana n’emeremo ya kera ensemo.

English: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
Kiswahili: Hivyo nawaambia hivi, nami nasisitiza katika Bwana kwamba, msiishi tena kama watu wa Mataifa waishivyo, katika ubatili wa mawazo yao.
Ekegusii: Bono ’ngokwana nde ring’ana eri, na koba kirori ase Omonene; korwa bono timogeenda buna abanto b’Ebisaku bakogeenda ase ebirengorerio biabo bitari nengeencho.

English: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.
Kiswahili: Watu hao akili zao zimetiwa giza na wametengwa mbali na uzima wa Mungu kwa sababu ya ujinga wao kutokana na ugumu wa mioyo yao.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini bwabo bwabekirwe omosunte, barusananiigwe korwa ase obogima bwa Nyasae ekiagera ase ogotamanya koria kore ime ase bare ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiabo.

English: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
Kiswahili: Wakiisha kufa ganzi, wamejitia katika mambo ya ufisadi na kupendelea kila aina ya uchafu, wakiendelea kutamani zaidi.
Ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo chiabeire n’amagandi, bebeekire ase chingeencho chiimbe chi’omobere, erio ase obwegimeria banyaare gokora kera engencho y’eubi.

English: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi, hivyo sivyo mlivyojifunza Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe timworokereretigwe komomanya Kristo ase enchera eyio.

English: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
Kiswahili: Kama hivyo ndivyo ilivyo, ninyi mmemsikia, tena mmefundishwa naye, vile kweli ilivyo katika Yesu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mwamoigwete na kworokererigwa nere, buna ekeene kere ime ase Yeso.

English: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
Kiswahili: Mlifundishwa kuuvua mwenendo wenu wa zamani, utu wenu wa kale, ulioharibiwa na tamaa zake za udanganyifu,
Ekegusii: Rusia chingeencho chiaino chi’eritang’ani chi’oboMwanyabaanto bwa kare, obwasariigwe ase okobwatia okogania kw’obong’ainereria;

English: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
Kiswahili: ili mfanywe upya roho na nia zenu,
Ekegusii: mokorwe abayia ase emeika na ebirengererio biaino,

English: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
Kiswahili: mkajivike utu mpya, ulioumbwa sawasawa na mfano wa Mungu katika haki yote na utakatifu.
Ekegusii: mweboyie omonto omoyia, oyotongetwe ase omogwekano o Nyasae ase oboronge na obochenu bw’ekeene.

English: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo kila mmoja wenu avue uongo na kuambiana kweli mtu na jirani yake, kwa maana sisi sote tu viungo vya mwili mmoja.
Ekegusii: Gaki aboria oborimo, mokw’ane ekeene kera omonto nomogisangio oye, inaki nigo tore ebiimo ebimo intwe ase intwe.

English: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
Kiswahili: Mkikasirika, msitende dhambi, wala jua lisichwe mkiwa bado mmekasirika,
Ekegusii: Mobee, korende timokora ebibe; erioba tiriigwa na inwe more n’endamwamu,

English: and don’t give place to the devil.
Kiswahili: wala msimpe ibilisi nafasi.
Ekegusii: gose timoa Saitani ribaga.

English: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye amekuwa akiiba, asiibe tena, lakini lazima ajishughulishe, afanye kitu kifaacho kwa mikono yake mwenyewe, ili awe na kitu cha kuwagawia wahitaji.
Ekegusii: Omoibi taiba naende; mbuya akore emeremo ase omokia namaboko aye na gokora ayare amaya, erinde abe negento akomwatanera oyoremeire.

English: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
Kiswahili: Maneno mabaya yasitoke vinywani mwenu, bali yale yafaayo kwa ajili ya kuwajenga wengine kulingana na mahitaji yao, ili yawafae wale wasikiao.
Ekegusii: Ogokwana okobe tikorua ase emenwa yaino, korende okore okuya na okoranyaare kobaa obuya abwo bagokoigwa na koagaacha abaganeirie koagaachwa.

English: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
Kiswahili: Wala msimhuzunishe Roho Mtakatifu wa Mungu, ambaye kwake mlitiwa muhuri kwa ajili ya siku ya ukombozi.
Ekegusii: Gose timoichania Omoika Omochenu o Nyasae, ase are ere oyomwabegetwe ekemanyererio goika rituko ri’okoboorigwa.

English: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
Kiswahili: Ondoeni kabisa uchungu, ghadhabu, hasira, makelele na masingizio pamoja na kila aina ya uovu.
Ekegusii: Obororo bwonsi, na endamwamu, na okobea, na eriomana, na emerumi birusigwe ase more, amo n’obobe bwonsi.

English: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
Kiswahili: Kuweni wafadhili na wenye kuhurumiana ninyi kwa ninyi, mkisameheana, kama vile naye Mungu katika Kristo alivyowasamehe ninyi.
Ekegusii: Mobe nobwororo inwe ase inwe, mororerane amabeebe, na kwaberana inwe ase inwe, buna Nyasae ase Kristo abaaberete inwe.

English: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, mfuateni Mungu kama watoto wapendwao,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, mobe abegi ba Nyasae, buna abana abanchwa;

English: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
Kiswahili: mkiishi maisha ya upendo, kama vile Kristo alivyotupenda sisi akajitoa kwa ajili yetu kuwa sadaka yenye harufu nzuri na dhabihu kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: mogeende ase obwanchani, buna Kristo atwanchete intwe, naende akerua ere omonyene ase engencho yaito, akaba esadaka na ekeng’wanso, bire ogotioka okuya ase Nyasae.

English: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
Kiswahili: Lakini uasherati, usitajwe miongoni mwenu, wala uchafu wa aina yoyote, wala tamaa, kwa sababu mambo haya hayastahili miongoni mwa watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Korende, buna egwenerete abachenu, obotomani na eubi yonsi, gose obwegimeria, tibiatorwa ase egati yaino nonya ng’ake.

English: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
Kiswahili: Wala pasiwepo mazungumzo machafu ya aibu, au maneno ya upuzi au mzaha, ambayo hayafai, badala yake mshukuruni Mungu.
Ekegusii: Motige kegima amang’ana amabe, gose ay’oboriri, gose obosekereria, aya’atagwenereti; korende mbuya kobua koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

English: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya mambo haya mjue hakika kwamba: Msherati, wala mtu mwovu, wala mwenye tamaa mbaya, mtu kama huyo ni mwabudu sanamu, kamwe hataurithi Ufalme wa Kristo na wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inaki ring’ana eri mwarimanyire kegima, ng’a omotomani, gose oyo otachenegeti, gose omonto omwegimeria (engencho yaye omosasiimi emegwekano) takonyora omwando ase oborwoti bwa Kristo na Nyasae.

English: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote na asiwadanganye kwa maneno matupu, kwa kuwa hasira ya Mungu huwaka kwa sababu ya mambo kama haya juu ya wale wasiomtii.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tabang’aina ase amang’ana atari nengeencho, ekiagera ase aya endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo ekobaachera abanto b’ogotaigwera.

English: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, msishirikiane nao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, timosaanga nabarabwo.

English: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana zamani ninyi mlikuwa giza, lakini sasa ninyi ni nuru katika Bwana. Enendeni kama watoto wa nuru
Ekegusii: Inaki kare nigo mwareenge omosunte, korende bono mwabeire omobaso ase Omonene. Mogeenderere buna abana b’omobaso

English: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
Kiswahili: (kwa kuwa tunda la nuru hupatikana katika wema wote, haki na kweli),
Ekegusii: (inaki okwama kw’omobaso nigo gokonyorekana ase obuya bwonsi, na ase oboronge, na ase ekeene).

English: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
Kiswahili: nanyi tafuteni yale yanayompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Teema mono komanya ekeragwenere Omonene.

English: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
Kiswahili: Msishiriki matendo ya giza yasiyofaa, bali yafichueni.
Ekegusii: Timosaanga n’ogokora kw’omosuunte ogotakwama, korende ribaga ri’ayio mokoorokie,

English: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni aibu hata kutaja mambo yale ambayo wasiotii wanayafanya sirini.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nobosooku nonya nogokwana amang’ana ayio agokorwa nabarabwo bobisi.

English: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila kitu kilichowekwa nuruni, huonekana,
Ekegusii: Korende onsi ayaorokigwe nomobaso nigo are maiso marore, ekiagera kera egento ekere maiso marore nigo kere omobaso.

English: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa nuru ndiyo hufanya kila kitu kionekane. Hii ndiyo sababu imesemekana: “Amka, wewe uliyelala, ufufuke kutoka kwa wafu, naye Kristo atakuangazia.”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio oteebire, “Booka aye osundogete, booka korwa ase abakuure, na Kristo nakobarerie.”

English: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo angalieni sana jinsi mnavyoenenda, si kama watu wasio na hekima, bali kama wenye hekima,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, rigereria mono buna mogotaara, tari buna abanto batari n’obong’aini, korende buna abare n’obong’aini.

English: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Kiswahili: mkiukomboa wakati, kwa sababu nyakati hizi ni za uovu.
Ekegusii: Renda engaki yaino, ekiagera amatuko aya namabe.

English: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo msiwe wajinga, bali mpate kujua nini mapenzi ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, timoba abariri, korende mobe abanto bakomanya buna ogwancha kw’Omonene kore.

English: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
Kiswahili: Pia msilewe kwa mvinyo, ambamo ndani yake mna upotovu, bali mjazwe Roho.
Ekegusii: Naende timotinda ase edivai, ekiagera ase eyio inamoirwe ase obonyaka, korende moichorwe n’Omoika.

English: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
Kiswahili: Msemezane ninyi kwa ninyi kwa zaburi, nyimbo na tenzi za rohoni, mkimwimbia na kumsifu Bwana mioyoni mwenu,
Ekegusii: Motebereranie ase chizaburi, na amateera, ne chingero chi’omoika; moteere na kobugia amariogi ase Omonene ase chinkoro chiaino,

English: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;
Kiswahili: siku zote mkimshukuru Mungu Baba kwa kila jambo katika Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: mokomoakera Nyasae Tata ng’a mbuya mono amatuko onsi, ase amang’ana onsi, ase erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
Kiswahili: Nyenyekeaneni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa heshima kwa ajili ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Mosikane inwe ase inwe ase okomoiroka Kristo.

English: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Ninyi wake, watiini waume zenu kama kumtii Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino buna mokoigwera Omonene.

English: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mume ni kichwa cha mkewe kama vile Kristo alivyo kichwa cha Kanisa, ambalo ni mwili wake, naye Kristo ni Mwokozi wake.
Ekegusii: Inaki omosacha nomotwe bw’omokuungu, buna Kristo are omotwe bw’ekanisa; ere omonyene n’Omotooria bw’omobere oye, engencho yaye ekanisa.

English: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
Kiswahili: Basi, kama vile Kanisa linavyomtii Kristo, vivyo hivyo na wake nao imewapasa kuwatii waume zao kwa kila jambo.
Ekegusii: Korende buna ekanisa eigwerete Kristo, naboigo nabakungu baigwere abasacha babo ase kera ring’ana.

English: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,
Kiswahili: Ninyi waume, wapendeni wake zenu, kama vile Kristo alivyolipenda Kanisa akajitoa kwa ajili yake
Ekegusii: Na inwe abasacha, mwanche abakungu baino, buna Kristo anchete ekanisa, naende akerua omonyene ase engencho y’ero,

English: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
Kiswahili: kusudi alifanye takatifu, akilitakasa kwa kuliosha kwa maji katika Neno lake,
Ekegusii: erio anyare koyechena ase okoyesibia ase amaache na ase ring’ana,

English: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
Kiswahili: apate kujiletea Kanisa tukufu lisilo na doa wala kunyanzi au waa lolote, bali takatifu na lisilo na hatia.
Ekegusii: erinde anyare kwenyorera ekanisa y’obonene, etari na kemoa gose omonia, gose rinde rionsi buna aya, korende ebe enchenu etari na kemoa.

English: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo imewapasa waume kuwapenda wake zao kama miili yao wenyewe. Ampendaye mkewe hujipenda mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naboigo egwenerete abasacha banche abakungu babo buna emebere yabo abanyene. Oyobwanchete mok’aye bweanchire ere omonyene.

English: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu anayeuchukia mwili wake mwenyewe, bali huulisha na kuutunza vizuri, kama Kristo anavyolitunza Kanisa lake.
Ekegusii: Inaki omonto taiyo ogeechete omobere oye omonyene, korende nigo akoyorageria na koyorenda, buna Kristo akorageria ekanisa,

English: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
Kiswahili: Sisi tu viungo vya mwili wake.
Ekegusii: ekiagera nigo tore ebiimo bi’omobere oye.

English: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”
Kiswahili: “Kwa sababu hii, mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake, naye ataambatana na mkewe, na hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.”
Ekegusii: Nigo eriikire, “Ase engencho eyio, omonto natige ise na ng’ina abwatane na mok’aye, na abwo babere inababe omobere oyoomo.”

English: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.
Kiswahili: Siri hii ni kubwa, bali mimi nanena kuhusu Kristo na Kanisa.
Ekegusii: Obo nobobisi obonene; korende ngokwana nde amang’ana a Kristo na ekanisa.

English: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kila mmoja wenu ampende mkewe kama anavyoipenda nafsi yake mwenyewe, naye mke lazima amheshimu mumewe.
Ekegusii: Korende kera omonto anche mok’aye buna eanchete ere omonyene; na omokungu tamocha gosika omosacha oye.

English: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
Kiswahili: Enyi watoto, watiini wazazi wenu katika Bwana, kwa kuwa hili ni jema.
Ekegusii: Inwe abana, moigwere abaibori baino ase Omonene, ekiagera obo nabwo oboronge.

English: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
Kiswahili: “Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,” hii ndio amri ya kwanza yenye ahadi,
Ekegusii: “Sika iso na nyoko” (ogochika oko nakwo ogochika kw’eritang’ani kore neira),

English: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
Kiswahili: “upate baraka na uishi siku nyingi duniani.”
Ekegusii: “erinde ebe buya ase ore, nario oramenye amatuko amange ase ense.”

English: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Ninyi akina baba, msiwachokoze watoto wenu, bali waleeni kwa nidhamu na mafundisho ya Bwana.
Ekegusii: Na inwe abaise, timochegia abana baino baabaise kobeeigwa, korende mobarere ase amasikani na ase okworokereria kw’Omonene.

English: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,
Kiswahili: Ninyi watumwa, watiini hao walio mabwana zenu hapa duniani kwa heshima na kwa kutetemeka na kwa moyo mmoja, kama vile mnavyomtii Kristo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase ense eye buna mokoigwera Kristo, ase obwoba na okoiguswa, na ase oboitongo bw’enkoro,

English: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
Kiswahili: Watiini, si tu wakati wakiwaona ili mpate upendeleo wao, bali mtumike kama watumwa wa Kristo, mkifanya mapenzi ya Mungu kwa moyo.
Ekegusii: gose tari ase obosomba bw’okwegwenia ase amaiso ya Mwanyabaanto, korende buna abasomba ba Kristo, mogokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase chinkoro chiaino;

English: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,
Kiswahili: Tumikeni kwa moyo wote, kama vile mnamtumikia Bwana na si wanadamu.
Ekegusii: ase omoyo omuya mogokorera Omonene, gose tari Mwanyabaanto.

English: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
Kiswahili: Mkijua kwamba Bwana atampa kila mtu thawabu kwa lolote jema alilotenda, kama yeye ni mtumwa au ni mtu huru.
Ekegusii: Naende momanye ng’a ring’ana rigiya omonto agokora, naegwe erio erio n’Omonene, k’arabe omosomba, gose omosibore.

English: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mabwana, watendeeni watumwa wenu kwa jinsi iyo hiyo. Msiwatishe, kwa kuwa mnajua ya kwamba yeye aliye Bwana wenu na Bwana wao yuko mbinguni, naye hana upendeleo.
Ekegusii: Na inwe abanene, bakorere ayio ayio, motige kobairokia. Momanye ng’a ere oyore Omonene obo, nere oyoino ore igoro, na ase are gwanchereria tikoiyo.

English: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, mzidi kuwa hodari katika Bwana na katika uweza wa nguvu zake.
Ekegusii: Omoerio, motenene bokong’u ase Omonene, na ase chinguru chi’okobua kwaye.

English: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
Kiswahili: Vaeni silaha zote za Mungu ili kwamba mweze kuzipinga hila za ibilisi.
Ekegusii: Eboyie ebirwanero bionsi bia Nyasae, erinde monyaare gotenena korwania obong’ainereria bwa Saitani.

English: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kushindana kwetu si juu ya nyama na damu, bali dhidi ya falme, mamlaka, dhidi ya wakuu wa giza na majeshi ya pepo wabaya katika ulimwengu wa roho.
Ekegusii: Inaki okoamererania gwaito tikori ase abare n’amanyinga ne chinyama, korende igoro y’abagaambi na abare nokobua, igoro y’abanene b’omosuunte bw’ense eye, na igoro y’emegaanda y’ebirecha ebibe bire igoro.

English: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo vaeni silaha zote za Mungu ili mweze kushindana siku ya uovu itakapokuja nanyi mkiisha kufanya yote, simameni imara.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, bogoria ebirwanero bionsi bia Nyasae, erinde monyaare koamererania ase rituko ri’obobe, na komwaikeranirie onsi, motenene.

English: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo simameni imara mkiwa mmejifunga kweli kiunoni na kuvaa dirii ya haki kifuani,
Ekegusii: Tenena gaaki, mweboyie ebinema biaino nekeene, na kobeeka oboronge buna engobo y’ekioma ase ebikuba biaino,

English: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,
Kiswahili: nayo miguu yenu ifungiwe utayari tuupatao kwa Injili ya amani.
Ekegusii: na gosiberwa amagoro aino engencho y’okoba ang’e eyio twanyorire ase enchiri y’omorembe.

English: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya haya yote, twaeni ngao ya imani, ambayo kwa hiyo mtaweza kuizima mishale yote yenye moto ya yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: Kobua onsi bogoria enguba y’okwegena, ase eyio namonyaare korimia emegwe yonsi y’omorero y’oria omobe.

English: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
Kiswahili: Vaeni chapeo ya wokovu na mchukue upanga wa Roho, ambao ni Neno la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naende bogoria ekegogwa gi’ekioma ki’ogotooreka, na omoro bw’Omoika, n’oro ring’ana ria Nyasae.

English: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.
Kiswahili: Mkiomba kwa Roho siku zote katika sala zote na maombi, mkikesha kila wakati mkiwaombea watakatifu wote.
Ekegusii: Mosabe botambe ase Omoika ase ogosaba gwonsi na ase okoboria kw’ogosorora, na gotagesia ase kera ring’ana. Mogenderere gosabera abachenu bonsi.

English: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,
Kiswahili: Niombeeni na mimi pia, ili kila nifunguapo kinywa changu, nipewe maneno ya kusema, niweze kutangaza siri ya Injili kwa ujasiri,
Ekegusii: Monsabere nainche, ng’egwe amang’ana ase ogokwana n’oboremu, erinde ndandie obobisi bw’enchiri.

English: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
Kiswahili: ambayo mimi ni balozi wake katika vifungo. Ombeni ili nipate kuhubiri kwa ujasiri kama inipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo inde oyo otometwe nsibire ebinyuri, inyore oboremu bw’ogokwana amang’ana buna ngwenerete gokwana.

English: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
Kiswahili: Tikiko, aliye ndugu mpendwa na mtumishi mwaminifu katika Bwana, atawaambia kila kitu, ili pia mpate kujua hali yangu na kile ninachofanya sasa.
Ekegusii: Erinde monyaare komanya buna inche inde, naende ninki ngokora, Tukiko, oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa ase Omonene, nabateebie amang’ana onsi.

English: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
Kiswahili: Ninamtuma kwenu kwa ajili ya kusudi hili hasa, ili mpate kujua hali yetu, na awatie moyo.
Ekegusii: Namotomire ase more ase engencho eyio eyio, erinde monyaare komanya buna tore; na ere naremie chinkoro chiaino.

English: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Amani iwe kwa ndugu, na pendo pamoja na imani kutoka kwa Mungu Baba na Bwana Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Omorembe obe ase abaminto, na obwanchani amo nokwegena bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
Kiswahili: Neema iwe na wote wampendao Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo kwa upendo wa dhati. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe amo na bonsi abamwanchete Omonene oito Yeso Kristo n’obwanchani botari gosareka.

English: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
Kiswahili: Waraka wa Paulo na Timotheo, watumishi wa Kristo Yesu: Kwa watakatifu wote katika Kristo Yesu walioko Filipi, pamoja na waangalizi na mashemasi:
Ekegusii: Korwa ase inche Paulo na Timotheo, abasomba ba Kristo Yeso, gochia ase abanto bonsi ba Nyasae abamomenyete Filipi aba mwabwatanigwe na Kristo Yeso, amo nabatang’ani na abakoonyi ase ekanisa.

English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more n’omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Nyasae Yeso Kristo.

English: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
Kiswahili: Ninamshukuru Mungu wangu kila niwakumbukapo ninyi.
Ekegusii: Igo nkomoakera Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono chingaki chionsi nkobainyora,

English: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
Kiswahili: Katika maombi yangu yote daima nimekuwa nikiwaombea ninyi nyote kwa furaha,
Ekegusii: ekiagera botambe ase ogosaba kwane nigo nkobasabera inwe mwensi nomogooko,

English: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ya kushiriki kwenu katika kueneza Injili, tangu siku ya kwanza hadi leo.
Ekegusii: ase engencho y’okobwaterana kwaino ase enchiri korwa rituko rie ritang’ani goika reero iga.

English: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Nina hakika kwamba yeye aliyeianza kazi njema mioyoni mwenu, ataiendeleza na kuikamilisha hata siku ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene, ng’a Nyasae oyochagete emeremo emiya ase emioyo yaino ime nayeikeranie goika rituko riria ria Kristo Yeso.

English: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
Kiswahili: Ni haki na ni wajibu wangu kufikiri hivi juu yenu nyote, kwa sababu ninyi mko moyoni mwangu. Ikiwa nimefungwa au nikiwa ninaitetea na kuithibitisha Injili, ninyi nyote mnashiriki neema ya Mungu pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Igo bore boronge ase ’nde korengereria aya igoro ase more mwensi, ekiagera nababogoirie inwe ase enkoro yane ime. Naki ase ogosibwa kwane na ase emeremo y’okorwanerera enchiri na koyeorokia ng’a ero nechinguru, na inwe mwensi mwabwatanire nainche ase obuya obo naeirwe.

English: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Mungu ni shahidi wangu jinsi ninavyowaonea shauku ninyi nyote kwa huruma ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nere kirori one, buna ’nde namaiga ase more mwensi nobwanchani bokorwa ase Kristo Yeso.

English: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
Kiswahili: Haya ndiyo maombi yangu: kwamba upendo wenu uongezeke zaidi na zaidi katika maarifa na ufahamu wote,
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosaba kwane, ng’a obwanchani bwaino bomenteke, bobe obonge mono ase okomanya kw’ogwatanana gwonsi,

English: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
Kiswahili: ili mpate kutambua yale yaliyo mema, mkawe safi, wasio na hatia hadi siku ya Kristo,
Ekegusii: erinde monyare komanya ayare amaya, naende mobe n’chinkoro chindemu, motari na komocha ase rituko ria Kristo.

English: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
Kiswahili: mkiwa mmejawa na matunda ya haki yapatikanayo kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo, kwa utukufu na sifa za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mwaichoirwe n’okwama kw’oboronge ase enchera ya Yeso Kristo, ase obonene na ogotogigwa kwa Nyasae.

English: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
Kiswahili: Basi, ndugu zangu, nataka mjue kwamba mambo yale yaliyonipata kwa kweli yamesaidia sana kueneza Injili.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, nimbamanyie ng’a amang’ana aria onsi anyorete, abeire ase okogendereria gw’enchiri.

English: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,
Kiswahili: Matokeo yake ni kwamba imejulikana wazi kwa walinzi wote wa jumba la kifalme na kwa wengine wote kuwa nimefungwa kwa ajili ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase igo amanyekanire ase abarendi bonsi b’omorwoti, na ase abande bonsi ng’a nasibirwe ase engencho ya Kristo.

English: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya vifungo vyangu, ndugu wengi katika Bwana wametiwa moyo kuhubiri neno la Mungu kwa ujasiri zaidi na bila woga.
Ekegusii: Na abange ase abaminto abare ase Omonene Nyasae babeire n’okoremigwa ase engencho y’ogosibwa kwane, bamentekanire n’oboremu gokwana ring’ana ria Nyasae batari nobwoba.

English: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
Kiswahili: Ni kweli kwamba wengine wanamhubiri Kristo kutokana na wivu na kwa kutaka kushindana, lakini wengine wanamhubiri Kristo kwa nia njema.
Ekegusii: Abande nigo bakorandia Kristo bare n’emoko n’eriomana, korende abande ase omoyo omuya,

English: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
Kiswahili: Hawa wa mwisho wanamhubiri Kristo kwa moyo wa upendo, wakifahamu kwamba nimo humu gerezani kwa ajili ya kuitetea Injili.
Ekegusii: abwo ase obwanchani, bamanyete ng’a nabekirwe ase okorwanerera enchiri.

English: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
Kiswahili: Hao wa kwanza wanamtangaza Kristo kutokana na tamaa zao wenyewe wala si kwa moyo mweupe, bali wanakusudia kuongeza mateso yangu katika huku kufungwa kwangu.
Ekegusii: Aba bakoraria Kristo ase esuugu gose tari ase omoyo omorabu, bakorengereria komenta obororo bwane ase ogosibwa kwane.

English: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
Kiswahili: Lakini inadhuru nini? Jambo la muhimu ni kwamba kwa kila njia, ikiwa ni kwa nia mbaya au njema, Kristo anahubiriwa. Nami kwa ajili ya jambo hilo ninafurahi. Naam, nami nitaendelea kufurahi,
Ekegusii: Inki rende? Nonya nabo, ase kera enchera Kristo nigo arararigwe, ase obong’ainereria gose ase ekeene, na ase ayio nagokire.

English: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: kwa maana ninajua kwamba kwa maombi yenu na kwa msaada unaotolewa na Roho wa Yesu Kristo, yale yaliyonipata mimi yatageuka kuwa wokovu wangu.
Ekegusii: Ee, ningooke, ekiagera namanyire ng’a aya nang’onchokere koba ase ogotooreka kwane, goetera ase ogosaba kwaino na ase ogokonya kw’Omoika o Yeso Kristo.

English: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
Kiswahili: Ninatarajia kwa shauku kubwa na kutumaini kwamba sitaaibika kwa njia yoyote, bali nitakuwa na ujasiri wa kutosha ili sasa kama wakati mwingine wowote, Kristo atukuzwe katika mwili wangu, ikiwa ni kwa kuishi au kwa kufa.
Ekegusii: Ninde nokoganyererera okonene n’ogosemeria ng’a tingosookigwa ase enchera ende yonsi, korende ase oboremu bwane bwonsi, bono buna botambe, Kristo naegwe ogosika ase omobere one, keraabe ase obogima gose ase ogokwa.

English: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwangu mimi, kuishi ni Kristo, na kufa ni faida.
Ekegusii: Naki ase ’nde inche, okoba moyo n’Kristo, na ogokwa nokonyora amange.

English: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
Kiswahili: Kama nitaendelea kuishi katika mwili, kwangu hili ni kwa ajili ya matunda ya kazi. Lakini sijui nichague lipi? Mimi sijui!
Ekegusii: Korende onye nkoba moyo ase omobere, aya nigo akondetera okwama kw’emeremo yane; gaki eri ndigetie gochora, tindimanyeti.

English: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
Kiswahili: Ninavutwa kati ya mambo mawili: Ninatamani kuondoka nikakae pamoja na Kristo, jambo hilo ni bora zaidi.
Ekegusii: Nimigire mono ase egati y’amang’ana aya abere. Okogania kwane nigo kore ng’a ngende komenya amo na Kristo; ekiagera aya namaya kobua.

English: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu yenu ni muhimu zaidi mimi nikiendelea kuishi katika mwili.
Ekegusii: Korende gotigara ase omobere nkogwenerete kobua ase engencho yaino.

English: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa nina matumaini haya, ninajua kwamba nitaendelea kuwepo na kuwa pamoja nanyi nyote, ili mpate kukua na kuwa na furaha katika imani.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera inde nobomaene ase aya, namanyire ng’a nintigare na kogenderera amo nainwe mwensi, na inwe momenteke na kogoka ase okwegena,

English: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
Kiswahili: Ili kwamba furaha yenu iwe nyingi katika Kristo Yesu kwa ajili yangu kwa kule kuja kwangu kwenu tena.
Ekegusii: erinde ogwetogia kwaino ase engencho yane konyare komenteka ase Kristo Yeso, ase engencho y’okoba kwane amo nainwe naende.

English: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
Kiswahili: Lakini lolote litakalotukia, mwenende kama ipasavyo Injili ya Kristo, ili kwamba nikija na kuwaona au ikiwa sipo, nipate kusikia haya juu yenu: Kuwa mnasimama imara katika roho moja, mkiishindania imani ya Injili kwa umoja,
Ekegusii: Korende orogendo rwaino robe buna egwenerete enchiri ya Kristo, erinde onye ngocha kobarora inwe, gose tinkobao, nyigwe amang’ana aino ng’a moteneine bokong’u ase omoika oyomo, na ase omoyo oyomo mokorwanerera okwegena more nakwo ase enchiri amo.

English: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
Kiswahili: wala msitishwe na wale wanaowapinga. Hii ni ishara kwao kuwa wataangamia, lakini ninyi mtaokolewa, na hii ni kazi ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Timoiroka abwo bakobaengereria ase ing’ana rinde rionsi. Eke nekemanyererio ase ogosira kwabo, korende ase more inwe nekemanyererio ki’ogotooreka. Eke nigo gekorwa ase Nyasae.

English: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mmepewa kwa ajili ya Kristo, si kumwamini tu, bali pia kuteswa kwa ajili yake,
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ase engencho ya Kristo mwaeirwe, tari okomwegena gwoka korende nogochandwa boigo ase engencho yaye.

English: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa mnashiriki mashindano yale yale mliyoyaona nikiwa nayo na ambayo hata sasa mnasikia kuwa bado ninayo.
Ekegusii: Na inwe nabo more nokorwanerera koria koria mwaroche ase ’nde, na koigwa ng’a ninde nakwo goika bono.

English: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
Kiswahili: Kama kukiwa na jambo lolote la kutia moyo katika kuunganishwa na Kristo, kukiwa faraja yoyote katika upendo wake, kukiwa na ushirika wowote na Roho, kukiwa na wema wowote na huruma,
Ekegusii: Obogima bwaino ime ya Kristo nigo bokobaa chinguru, n’obwanchani bwaye bwabaremia. Okobwatana kw’Omoika, karabe amaabera ande onsi na amabeebe,

English: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
Kiswahili: basi ikamilisheni furaha yangu kwa kuwa na nia moja, mkiwa na upendo huo moja, mkiwa wa roho na kusudi moja.
Ekegusii: ikerania omogooko one ase okoba nokorengereria okwo okwo na obwanchani obomo; mobe nomoyo oyomo, na okorengereria okomo.

English: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
Kiswahili: Msitende jambo lolote kwa nia ya kujitukuza wala kujivuna, bali kwa unyenyekevu kila mtu amhesabu mwingine bora kuliko nafsi yake.
Ekegusii: Timokora ing’ana rinde rionsi ase okwegwenera na ase okweenenia, korende ase oboitongo kera omonto abare abande ng’a nabaya kobua ere omonyene.

English: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja wenu asiangalie faida yake mwenyewe tu, bali pia ajishughulishe kwa faida ya wengine.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto tarigereria ebinto biaye omonyene, korende arigererie ebinto bi’abaanto bande.

English: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: Kuweni na nia ile ile aliyokuwa nayo Kristo Yesu:
Ekegusii: Naki mobe nebirengererio ebio ebio ime yaino buna ebio biarenge ime ya Kristo Yeso.

English: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
Kiswahili: Yeye, ingawa alikuwa na asili ya Mungu hasa, hakuona kule kuwa sawa na Mungu kuwa kitu cha kushikilia,
Ekegusii: Ere omochakano nigo arenge oyomo na Nyasae, na tabarete ng’a okoba koreng’ana buna Nyasae negento gi’okobwaterera,

English: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
Kiswahili: bali alijifanya si kitu, akachukua hali hasa na mtumwa, naye akazaliwa katika umbo la mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: korende agekora buna tarenge nobonene, akaimokia ekieni ki’omosomba, akaba omogwekano o Mwanyabaanto.

English: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
Kiswahili: Naye akiwa na umbo la mwanadamu, alijinyenyekeza, akatii hata mauti: naam, mauti ya msalaba!
Ekegusii: Naende agachia kororekana ore buna Mwanyabaanto omonyene, agekeyia, akaba omoigweri goika ogokwa, na korokwo nogokwa igoro ase omosalaba.

English: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, Mungu alimtukuza juu sana, na kumpa Jina lililo kuu kuliko kila jina,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akamoimokereria igoro mono, akamoa erieta erio ribuete amarieta onsi,

English: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
Kiswahili: ili kwa Jina la Yesu, kila goti lipigwe, la vitu vya mbinguni, na vya duniani, na vya chini ya nchi,
Ekegusii: erinde ase erieta ria Yeso kera riiru riringwe, ri’abwo bare igoro, na ase ense, na inse y’ense,

English: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
Kiswahili: na kila ulimi ukiri ya kwamba Yesu Kristo ni Bwana, kwa utukufu wa Mungu Baba.
Ekegusii: na kera oromeme narobe kirori ng’a Yeso Kristo n’Omonene, ase obonene bwa Nyasae Tata.

English: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, wapenzi wangu, kama vile ambavyo mmekuwa mkitii siku zote, si tu wakati nikiwa pamoja nanyi, bali sasa zaidi sana nisipokuwepo, utimizeni wokovu wenu kwa kuogopa na kutetemeka,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanchwa baane, buna moigwerete botambe, tari ekero indeo rioka, korende kobua mono ekero ntaiyo, korera ogotooreka kwaino abanyene ase okwoboa na okoiguswa,

English: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
Kiswahili: kwa maana Mungu ndiye atendaye kazi ndani yenu, kutaka kwenu na kutenda kwenu kwa kulitimiza kusudi lake jema.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nere ogokora emeremo ime yaino ase okorigia, naende ase ogokora ogwancha kwaye okuya.

English: Do all things without complaining and arguing,
Kiswahili: Fanyeni mambo yote bila kunungʼunika wala kushindana,
Ekegusii: Mokore amang’ana onsi motari nokwemurungania na okoborania,

English: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
Kiswahili: ili msiwe na lawama wala hatia, bali mwe wana wa Mungu wasio na kasoro katika kizazi chenye ukaidi na kilichopotoka, ambacho ndani yake ninyi mnangʼaa kama mianga ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: erinde monyare koba abatari na komocha, abachenu, abana ba Nyasae, motari na bobe egati y’ekegori eke ekebe kere bogeka. Ase egati y’abwo mobare buna emebaso ase ense.

English: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
Kiswahili: Mkilishika neno la uzima, ili nipate kuona fahari siku ya Kristo kwamba sikupiga mbio wala kujitaabisha bure.
Ekegusii: Bwata ring’ana ri’obogima, erinde inyore engencho y’ogwetogia ase rituko riria ria Kristo, ng’a tinaminyogete bosa, gose tinakorete emeremo bosa.

English: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata kama nikimiminwa kama sadaka ya kinywaji kwenye dhabihu na huduma itokayo katika imani yenu, mimi ninafurahi na kushangilia pamoja nanyi nyote.
Ekegusii: Ee, kondaumorwe igoro y’ekeng’wanso na ogokora gw’okwegena kwaino, nagokire; ee, nagokire amo nainwe mwensi.

English: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, ninyi nanyi imewapasa kufurahi na kushangilia pamoja nami.
Ekegusii: Nainwe boigo, goka, ee, goka amo nainche.

English: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
Kiswahili: Natumaini katika Bwana Yesu kumtuma Timotheo hivi karibuni aje kwenu, ili nipate kufarijika moyo nitakapopata habari zenu.
Ekegusii: Korende nasemeirie ase Omonene Yeso gotoma Timotheo achiche bwango ase more, erinde inche ndemigwe, kondamanye buna more.

English: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
Kiswahili: Sina mtu mwingine kama yeye, ambaye ataangalia hali yenu kwa halisi.
Ekegusii: Naki tindi na monto onde ore nomoyo oyomo nainche, oyoranyare gochandekera chingencho chiaino,

English: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila mmoja anajishughulisha zaidi na mambo yake mwenyewe wala si yale ya Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi nigo bakorigia ebinto biabo abanyene, gose tari ebia Kristo Yeso.

English: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi Timotheo alivyojithibitisha mwenyewe, kwa maana ametumika pamoja nami kwa kazi ya Injili, kama vile mwana kwa baba yake.
Ekegusii: Korende momanyete Timotheo na ogokora kwaye, buna akorerete enchiri amo nainche. Igo are koreng’ana buna omwana okomokorera ise.

English: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ninatumaini kumtuma kwenu upesi mara nitakapojua mambo yangu yatakavyokuwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio ninganetie komotoma ase obwango ekero ndamanye buna amang’ana arabe ase ’nde.

English: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
Kiswahili: Nami mwenyewe ninatumaini katika Bwana kwamba nitakuja kwenu hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Na inche nasemeirie ase Omonene ng’a inche omonyene boigo ninchiche bwango.

English: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,
Kiswahili: Lakini nadhani ni muhimu kumtuma tena kwenu Epafrodito, ndugu yangu na mtendakazi pamoja nami, aliye askari mwenzangu, ambaye pia ni mjumbe wenu mliyemtuma ili ashughulike na mahitaji yangu.
Ekegusii: Korende nkarora ng’a ningwenerete gotoma Epafrodito oyominto, omokori emeremo amo nainche, omorwani amo nainche, oyo mwatomire gonkorera ase okoremerwa kwane.

English: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana amekuwa akiwaonea sana shauku ninyi nyote, akiwa na wasiwasi kwa kuwa mlisikia kwamba alikuwa mgonjwa.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge namaiga ase more mwensi, naende agaichana mono, ekiagera mwaigwete ng’a nigo arenge omorwaire.

English: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
Kiswahili: Kweli alikuwa mgonjwa, tena karibu ya kufa. Lakini Mungu alimhurumia, wala si yeye tu, bali hata na mimi alinihurumia, nisipatwe na huzuni juu ya huzuni.
Ekegusii: Ere nomorwaire arenge ekeene, ang’e nogokwa, korende Nyasae akamororera amaabera, gose tari ere bweka, korende nonya ninche boigo, timba nomoichano igoro ase omoichano.

English: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mimi ninafanya bidii kumtuma kwenu ili mtakapomwona kwa mara nyingine, mpate kufurahi, nami wasiwasi wangu upungue.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nakorire omokia mono komotoma, erinde ekero moramorore naende, monyare kogoka, na inche nkeeanerigwe omoichano one.

English: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mpokeeni katika Bwana kwa furaha kubwa, nanyi wapeni heshima watu kama hawa,
Ekegusii: Momooroisie gaki ase Omonene ase omogooko bwonsi. Mosike abanto banga buna oyio,

English: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu alikaribia kufa kwa ajili ya kazi ya Kristo, akihatarisha maisha yake ili aweze kunihudumia vile ninyi hamkuweza.
Ekegusii: ekiagera ase engencho y’emeremo ya Kristo akaba ang’e ase ogokwa, tarendete obogima bwaye ase ogoisanera ayaremete ase ogokora kwaino ase ’nde.

English: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, furahini katika Bwana! Mimi kuwaandikia mambo yale yale hakuniudhi, kwa maana ni kinga kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Omoerio baminto, goka ase Omonene! Kobariikera inwe amang’ana aria aria tandoseti inche, korende ase more nigo arabe obokonyi.

English: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
Kiswahili: Jihadharini na mbwa, wale watenda maovu, jihadharini na wale wajikatao miili yao, wasemao ili kuokoka ni lazima kutahiriwa.
Ekegusii: Mwerende korwa ase chisese, mwerende na korwa ase abwo bagokora amabe, mwerende nabwo bakwenachanacha!

English: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sisi ndio tulio tohara, sisi tumwabuduo Mungu katika Roho, tunaona fahari katika Kristo Yesu, ambao hatuweki tumaini letu katika mwili,
Ekegusii: Naki intwe naba twarogete, abatogosasiima Nyasae ase Omoika oye, na gwetogia ase Kristo Yeso, na titosemereti ebia omobere.

English: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
Kiswahili: ingawa mimi mwenyewe ninazo sababu za kuutumainia mwili. Kama mtu yeyote akidhani anazo sababu za kuutumainia mwili, mimi zaidi.
Ekegusii: Nonya ninche ase ensemo yane ninyare gosemeria ebia omobere. Onye omonto onde okorora ng’a nare nengencho y’ogosemeria ebia omobere, inche nkobua,

English: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
Kiswahili: Nilitahiriwa siku ya nane, mimi ni Mwisraeli wa kabila la Benyamini, Mwebrania wa Waebrania. Kwa habari ya sheria, ni Farisayo,
Ekegusii: ekiagera narogete ase rituko ria gatano na gatato, naende noyomo bw’Abaisraeli inde, oyo bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini, Omoiberania oiboretwe n’Abaiberania, na ase ogotunyana amachiiko n’Omofarisai inde.

English: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
Kiswahili: kwa habari ya juhudi, nilikuwa nalitesa kanisa, kuhusu haki ipatikanayo kwa sheria, mimi nilikuwa sina hatia.
Ekegusii: Nkaba nomokia bw’ogochanda ekanisa, na ase amang’ana ’oboronge bokonyorekana ase amachiiko tinarenge na komocha.

English: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
Kiswahili: Lakini mambo yale yaliyokuwa faida kwangu, sasa nayahesabu kuwa hasara kwa ajili ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aria arenge okonyora ase ’nde nayabarire koba bosa ase engencho ya Kristo.

English: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, nayahesabu mambo yote kuwa hasara tupu nikiyalinganisha na faida kubwa ipitayo kiasi cha kumjua Kristo Yesu Bwana wangu, ambaye kwa ajili yake nimepata hasara ya mambo yote, nikiyahesabu kuwa kama mavi ili nimpate Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ee, nabarire onsi, ng’a abeire bosa ase engencho y’obuya botari nekerengo, engencho yaye okomomanya Kristo Yese Omonene one. Ase engencho yaye natigire ebinto bionsi, na kobibara buna eubi, erinde imonyore Kristo,

English: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,
Kiswahili: Nami nionekane mbele zake bila kuwa na haki yangu mwenyewe ipatikanayo kwa sheria, bali ile ipatikanayo kwa imani katika Kristo, haki ile itokayo kwa Mungu kwa njia ya imani.
Ekegusii: naende ndorekane ime asare. Tinkoba noboronge bwane boria bokonyorekana ase amachiiko korende boria bokonyorekana ase okomwegena Kristo, oboronge boria bokorwa ase Nyasae, bokonyorekana ase okomwegena.

English: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
Kiswahili: Nataka nimjue Kristo na uweza wa kufufuka kwake na ushirika wa mateso yake, ili nifanane naye katika mauti yake,
Ekegusii: Nindigetie komomanya Kristo ne chinguru chi’okobokigwa kwaye, inyare kobwatana nogochandwa kwaye, ngwekanigwe nere ase ogokwa kwaye;

English: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
Kiswahili: ili kwa njia yoyote niweze kufikia ufufuo wa wafu.
Ekegusii: erinde inyore ase enchera ende yonsi goikera okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure.

English: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba nimekwisha kufikia, au kwamba nimekwisha kuwa mkamilifu, la hasha! Bali nakaza mwendo ili nipate kile ambacho kwa ajili yake, nimeshikwa na Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Tari ng’a naikire konyora aya, gose naikire koba omoikeranu, korende nakong’irie orogendo inyabwate, ekiagera nabwatirwe na Kristo Yeso.

English: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, sijihesabu kuwa nimekwisha kushika. Lakini ninafanya jambo moja: Ninasahau mambo yale yaliyopita, nakaza mwendo kufikia yale yaliyo mbele.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, tinyekageti inche omonyene ng’a naikire koyabwata; korende ninkore egento ekemo gioka: kweba ayare magega, ndambaarie ayare bosio.

English: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Nakaza mwendo nifikie ile alama ya ushindi iliyowekwa ili nipate tuzo ya mwito mkuu wa Mungu ambao nimeitiwa huko juu mbinguni katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Nakong’irie orogendo gochia aase ngokoorera, ng’ikere eng’eria y’okorangerigwa kwa igoro kwa Nyasae goetera ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
Kiswahili: Hivyo sisi sote tuliokuwa kiroho tuwaze jambo hili, hata mkiwaza mengine katika jambo lolote, Mungu ataliweka wazi hilo nalo.
Ekegusii: Gaki intwe abatore abaikeranu torengererie ayio. Komorabe mokorengereria ayande, ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, Nyasae nabamaanorere ayio naro.

English: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
Kiswahili: Lakini na tushike sana lile ambalo tumekwisha kulifikia.
Ekegusii: Korende togenderere ase ayio ayio twaigete konyora.

English: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, kwa pamoja fuateni mfano wangu na kuwatazama wale wanaofuata kielelezo tulichowawekea.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, mobe abeegi baane, morigererie abwo bakogenda ase ogotunyana omogwekano oria oria twabaete.

English: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kama nilivyokwisha kuwaambia mara nyingi kabla, nami sasa nasema tena hata kwa machozi, watu wengi wanaishi kama adui wa msalaba wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki abange nigo bakogenderera bare ababisa b’omosalaba o Kristo. Nabatebirie amang’ana abo ara aange, nonya mbono nigo nkobateebia aya ase amariga.

English: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
Kiswahili: Mwisho wa watu hao ni maangamizi, Mungu wao ni tumbo, na utukufu wao ni aibu, na mawazo yao yamo katika mambo ya dunia.
Ekegusii: Omoerio obo nogosareka, enyasae yabo nenda, obonene bwabo nigo bore ase obosooku bwabo, bakorengereria amang’ana ’ense.

English: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: Lakini uenyeji wetu uko mbinguni. Nasi tunamngoja kwa shauku Mwokozi kutoka huko, yaani, Bwana Yesu Kristo,
Ekegusii: Naki obobiare bwaito igoro, bore. Korwa agwo naende ntoganyete, Omotooria, Omonene Yeso Kristo,

English: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
Kiswahili: atakayeubadili mwili wetu wa unyonge, ili upate kufanana na mwili wake wa utukufu, kwa uweza ule ambao kwa huo aweza hata kuvitiisha vitu vyote chini yake.
Ekegusii: oyoranyare koonchora emebere yaito y’obosareku enyare kogwekana nomobere oye bw’obonene, koreng’ana nokobua kwaye ase okwo aranyare kobeeka ebinto bionsi inse asare.

English: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, ninaowapenda na ambao ninawaonea shauku, ninyi mlio furaha yangu na taji yangu, hivi ndivyo iwapasavyo kusimama imara katika Bwana, ninyi wapenzi wangu.
Ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe abanyanchete, abwo amaiga andiereire, omogooko one na egutwa yane, tenena bokong’u ase Omonene, abanchi baane.

English: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Nawasihi Euodia na Sintike wawe na nia moja katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Namosoroire Ewodia, namosoroire na Sintike babe nomoyo oyomo ase Omonene.

English: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
Kiswahili: Naam, nakusihi wewe pia, mwenzangu mwaminifu, uwasaidie hawa wanawake, kwa sababu walijitaabisha katika kazi ya Injili pamoja nami bega kwa bega, wakiwa pamoja na Klementi na watendakazi wenzangu ambao majina yao yameandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima.
Ekegusii: Ee, naye bo, omosaiga bw’ekeene, nakoboririe okonye abakungu abwo bakorete emeremo y’enchiri amo nainche, na Klementi nere, na baria bande bakorete emeremo amo nainche, abwo amarieta abo are ime ase egetabu y’obogima.

English: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
Kiswahili: Furahini katika Bwana siku zote, tena nasema furahini!
Ekegusii: Goka ase Omonene amatuko onsi; naende natebiire: Goka!

English: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
Kiswahili: Upole wenu na ujulikane na watu wote. Bwana yu karibu.
Ekegusii: Obwororo bwaino bomanyekane ase abanto bonsi. Omonene ng’ang’e are.

English: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
Kiswahili: Msijisumbue kwa jambo lolote, bali katika kila jambo kwa kuomba na kusihi pamoja na kushukuru, haja zenu na zijulikane na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Timwechandera ing’ana rinde rionsi; korende ase kera ring’ana ase ogosaba na ogosorora amo nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, okorigia kwaino komanyekane ase Nyasae.

English: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Nayo amani ya Mungu, inayopita fahamu zote, itailinda mioyo yenu na nia zenu katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Na omorembe o Nyasae, oyobuete okomanya gwonsi, korende chinkoro chiaino na ebirengererio biaino ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, mambo yote yaliyo ya kweli, yoyote yaliyo na sifa njema, yoyote yaliyo ya haki, yoyote yaliyo safi, yoyote ya kupendeza, yoyote yenye staha, ukiwepo uzuri wowote, pakiwepo chochote kinachostahili kusifiwa, tafakarini mambo hayo.
Ekegusii: Omoerio baminto, onsi ayare ay’ekeene, onsi ayare ay’ogosika, onsi ayare ay’oboronge, onsi ayare ay’oborabu, onsi ayagwenerete gwanchwa, onsi ayagokwanwa buya; koborabeo obuya bonde bwonsi, gose ogotogigwa, aya onsi yarengererie.

English: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
Kiswahili: Mambo yote mliyojifunza au kuyapokea au kuyasikia kutoka kwangu, au kuyaona kwangu, yatendeni hayo. Naye Mungu wa amani atakuwa pamoja nanyi.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aya mweorokereretie na koyanyora, na koyaigwa, na koyarora korwa ase ’nde, moyakore, na Nyasae bw’omorembe nabe amo nainwe.

English: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
Kiswahili: Nina furaha kubwa katika Bwana kwamba hatimaye mmeanza upya kushughulika tena na maisha yangu. Kweli mmekuwa mkinifikiria lakini mlikuwa hamjapata nafasi ya kufanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Nagokire mono ase Omonene, ekiagera bono ase omoerio mwairanire ase ebirengererio biaino igoro y’okoremerwa kwane; nabo mwarenge kondengereria ritang’ani, korende timwanyora ribaga.

English: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
Kiswahili: Sisemi hivyo kwa vile nina mahitaji, la! Kwa maana nimejifunza kuridhika katika hali yoyote.
Ekegusii: Tari ng’a ngokwana aya ekiagera inde nokoremerwa, naki neorokereirie goisaneka ase engencho ende yonsi inde nero.

English: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
Kiswahili: Ninajua kupungukiwa, pia ninajua kuwa na vingi. Nimejifunza siri ya kuridhika katika kila hali, wakati wa kushiba na wakati wa kuona njaa, wakati wa kuwa na vingi na wakati wa kupungukiwa.
Ekegusii: Namanyire ogokeeigwa, naende namanyire okomenteka; ase engencho yonsi, na ase amang’ana onsi neorokereirie, okoigota na koigwa enchara, okomenteka na okoremerwa.

English: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
Kiswahili: Naweza kuyafanya mambo yote katika yeye anitiaye nguvu.
Ekegusii: Ninyare gokora amang’ana onsi asere oyokombeka chinguru.

English: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
Kiswahili: Lakini, mlifanya vyema kushiriki nami katika taabu zangu.
Ekegusii: Korende mwakorete buya mokabwatana nainche ase emechando yane.

English: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, ninyi Wafilipi mnajua kwamba siku za kwanza nilipoanza kuhubiri Injili, nilipoondoka Makedonia, hakuna kanisa jingine lililoshiriki nami katika masuala ya kutoa na kupokea isipokuwa ninyi.
Ekegusii: Na inwe Abafilipi abanyene mwamanyire ng’a ase omochakano bw’enchiri, ekero naruete Makedonia, ekanisa ende tiyarenge yabwatanete nainche ase amang’ana ’okorua na okonyora, otatiga inwe mweka.

English: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hata nilipokuwa huko Thesalonike, mliniletea msaada kwa ajili ya mahitaji yangu zaidi ya mara moja.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya nase Tesaloniki mwandeterete ogokonywa ase okoremerwa kwane ara kabere, tari rimo rioka.

English: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
Kiswahili: Si kwamba natafuta sana yale matoleo, bali natafuta sana ile faida itakayozidi sana kwa upande wenu.
Ekegusii: Tari ng’a nindigetie ekeegwa keria, korende nigo ndigetie okwama koria gokomenteka koba okonge ase more.

English: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
Kiswahili: Nimelipwa kikamilifu hata na zaidi; nimetoshelezwa kabisa sasa, kwa kuwa nimepokea kutoka kwa Epafrodito vile vitu mlivyonitumia, sadaka yenye harufu nzuri, dhabihu inayokubalika na ya kumpendeza Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende ninde n’ebinto bionsi, na kobua; naende naichoirwe, ekiagera nanyorire ase okoboko kwa Epafrodito ebiegwa biaruete ase more, bire ogotioka okuya, ekeng’wanso giancheirwe, kegwenerete Nyasae.

English: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Naye Mungu wangu atawajaza ninyi na kila mnachohitaji kwa kadiri ya utajiri wake katika utukufu ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Na Nyasae one nabaichorerie kera ekimoganetie ase ekerengo ki’obonda bwaye ase obonene ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
Kiswahili: Mungu wetu aliye Baba yetu apewe utukufu milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: Bono Nyasae, Tata oito, abakwe kare na kare. Amina.

English: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
Kiswahili: Msalimuni kila mtakatifu katika Kristo Yesu. Ndugu walioko pamoja nami wanawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Monkwanerie kera omochenu ase Kristo Yeso. Abaminto abare amo nainche baabakwanirie.

English: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
Kiswahili: Watakatifu wote wanawasalimu, hasa wale watu wa nyumbani mwa Kaisari.
Ekegusii: Abachenu bonsi baabakwanirie, mono kobua abwo bare b’enyomba y’omorwoti omonene.

English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Kiswahili: Neema ya Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja na roho zenu. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.

English: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
Kiswahili: Paulo, mtume wa Kristo Yesu, kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, na Timotheo ndugu yetu:
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Paulo oyio goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae ore omotomwa o Kristo Yeso, na korwa ase oyominto Timotheo —

English: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa ndugu watakatifu na waaminifu katika Kristo, waishio Kolosai: Neema na amani zitokazo kwa Mungu Baba yetu ziwe nanyi.
Ekegusii: gochia ase abanto ba Nyasae abwo bamenyete Kolosai abwo bare abaminto abageni ase Kristo. Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito.

English: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
Kiswahili: Siku zote tunamshukuru Mungu, Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, tunapowaombea ninyi,
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo togoakera Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, ng’a mbuya mono, ekero tokobasabera inwe,

English: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
Kiswahili: kwa sababu tumesikia kuhusu imani yenu katika Kristo Yesu, na upendo wenu mlio nao kwa watakatifu wote:
Ekegusii: ekiagera twaigure buna momwegenete Kristo Yeso, naende buna mwanchete abachenu bonsi,

English: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News
Kiswahili: imani na upendo ule utokao katika tumaini mlilowekewa akiba mbinguni, na ambalo mmesikia habari zake katika neno la kweli, yaani, ile Injili
Ekegusii: Ekero ring’ana ri’ekeene, amang’ana amaya achete ase more ritang’ani, nigo mwaigwete igoro y’ogosemeria kwarenge oo. Ase igo okwegena n’obwanchani bwaino nigo bire ase keria mosemeretie, ekio kegachire buya ase engencho yaino aria igoro.

English: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
Kiswahili: iliyowafikia ninyi. Duniani kote Injili hii inazaa matunda na kuenea kama ilivyokuwa kwenu tangu siku ile mlipoisikia na kuielewa neema ya Mungu katika kweli yote.
Ekegusii: Echili nigo ekorenta ogosesenigwa na nigo agendererete koranda ense yonsi, buna koreng’ana yabeire ase more korwa rituko riria inwe mwaigwete igoro yobuya bwa Nyasae na mokabwenekia buna bore.

English: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
