Kiswahili: Mlijifunza habari zake kutoka kwa Epafra, mtumishi mwenzetu mpendwa, yeye aliye mhudumu mwaminifu wa Kristo kwa ajili yenu,
Ekegusii: Nigo mwaorokereretigwe igoro yobuya bwa Nyasae na Epafara, omosomba omogisangio oito omwanchwa, oyore omosomba omwegenwa ase Kristo ase engencho yaino.

English: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
Kiswahili: ambaye pia ametuambia kuhusu upendo wenu katika Roho.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo atworogetie obwanchani bwaino ase Omoika.

English: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, tangu siku ile tuliposikia habari zenu, hatujakoma kuomba kwa ajili yenu na kumsihi Mungu awajaze ninyi maarifa ya mapenzi yake katika hekima yote ya kiroho na ufahamu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa rituko riria twaigwete amang’ana ayio, titwatigete kobasabera inwe. Igo twasabete ng’a moichorwe ne chisemi chi’ogwancha kwaye ase obong’aini bwonsi na okomanya gwonsi kw’omoika.

English: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
Kiswahili: Nasi tunaomba haya ili mpate kuishi maisha yanayostahili mbele za Bwana, na mpate kumpendeza kwa kila namna: mkizaa matunda kwa kila kazi njema, mkikua katika kumjua Mungu,
Ekegusii: Mogenderere buna ebagwenerete ase Omonene, momogwenere kegima. Amagima aino ame okwama okuya, momenteke ase okomomanya Nyasae.

English: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
Kiswahili: mkiwa mmetiwa nguvu kwa uwezo wote kwa kadiri ya nguvu yake yenye utukufu, ili mpate kuwa na wingi wa saburi na uvumilivu. Nanyi kwa furaha
Ekegusii: Na inwe mobekwe chinguru ase okobua gwonsi, koreng’ana ne chinguru chi’obonene bwaye ase okoganya na oboremereria bwonsi amo nomogooko,

English: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
Kiswahili: mkimshukuru Baba, ambaye amewastahilisha kushiriki katika urithi wa watakatifu katika ufalme wa nuru.
Ekegusii: mokomoakera Tata ng’a mbuya mono, oyobaikeranetie mobe ababwatani b’omwando bw’abachenu ase omobaso.

English: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ametuokoa kutoka ufalme wa giza na kutuingiza katika ufalme wa Mwana wake mpendwa,
Ekegusii: Nere otosiborete korwa ase okobua kw’omosunte na agatong’anyia na gotosoyia ase oborwoti bw’Omwana oye omwanchwa.

English: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
Kiswahili: ambaye katika yeye tunao ukombozi, yaani msamaha wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Goetera ase are twasiboirwe, engencho yaye ebibe biaito biabeirwe.

English: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni mfano wa Mungu asiyeonekana, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa viumbe vyote.
Ekegusii: Kristo nomogwekano o Nyasae oyotari kororekana, omoiborwa bw’eritang’ani bw’ebitongwa bionsi.

English: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
Kiswahili: Kwake yeye vitu vyote vilivyoko mbinguni na juu ya nchi viliumbwa: vitu vinavyoonekana na visivyoonekana, viwe ni viti vya enzi au falme, au wenye mamlaka au watawala; vitu vyote viliumbwa na yeye na kwa ajili yake.
Ekegusii: Ime yaye ebinto bionsi bigatongwa, ebire igoro na ebire ase ense, ebikororekana na ebitakororekana, onye nebirogo bi’obogambi, gose amarwoti, gose abagaambi, gose abare nokobua; Nyasae agatonga ense yonsi goetera asare na ase engencho yaye.

English: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
Kiswahili: Yeye alikuwepo kabla ya vitu vyote, na katika yeye vitu vyote vinashikamana pamoja.
Ekegusii: Kristo nao arenge ritang’ani ri’ebinto bionsi, na ebinto bionsi biabwatanigwe ime asare.

English: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye kichwa cha mwili, yaani kanisa, naye ndiye mwanzo na mzaliwa wa kwanza kutoka kwa wafu, ili yeye awe mkuu katika vitu vyote.
Ekegusii: Ere nomotwe bw’omobere, engencho yaye ekanisa; naende ere nomochakano na omoiborwa bw’eritang’ani korwa ase abakuure, erinde ere bweka abe omotang’ani ase bonsi.

English: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ilimpendeza Mungu kwamba utimilifu wake wote ukae ndani yake,
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae agancha ng’a oboikeranu bwaye bwonsi bomenye ime asare.

English: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
Kiswahili: na kwa njia yake aweze kuvipatanisha vitu vyote na yeye mwenyewe, viwe ni vitu vilivyo duniani au vilivyo mbinguni, kwa kufanya amani kwa damu yake, iliyomwagika msalabani.
Ekegusii: Goetera asare Nyasae agancha kobwatania ebinto bionsi amo nere omonyene, ebinto ebire ase ense na ebire igoro, gakorire omorembe ase amanyinga ayaitegete ase omosalaba oye.

English: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
Kiswahili: Hapo kwanza mlikuwa mmetengana na Mungu, na mlikuwa adui zake katika nia zenu kwa sababu ya mienendo yenu mibaya.
Ekegusii: Na inwe agwo ritang’ani nigo mwarenge mwatananire korwa ase Nyasae, mwarenge nobobisa ase ebirengererio biaino ase ogokora kwaino okobe.

English: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa Mungu amewapatanisha ninyi kwa njia ya mwili wa Kristo kupitia mauti, ili awalete mbele zake mkiwa watakatifu, bila dosari wala lawama,
Ekegusii: Korende bono Nyasae obabwatanirie inwe amo nere omonyene ase ogokwa kw’omwana oye ase omobere oye bw’echinyama, Nyasae obakorire abasani baye erio abarente ase obosio bwaye, more abachenu, motari na komocha gose na bobe bonde,

English: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
Kiswahili: ikiwa mnaendelea katika imani yenu mkiwa imara na thabiti, pasipo kuliacha tumaini lililoahidiwa katika Injili. Hii ndiyo ile Injili mliyoisikia, ambayo imehubiriwa kwa kila kiumbe chini ya mbingu, na ambayo mimi Paulo nimekuwa mtumwa wake.
Ekegusii: goika mogenderere ase okwegena, mwabekirwe ase oboroso obokong’u, nainde timwancha inwe konyegerigwa korwa ase ogosemeria koria mwanyorete ekero mwaigwete enchiri eye. Ngoetera ase enchiri eye inche Paulo nkabekwa nkaba omosomba oye-Echili eye eyio yarandigwe ase ebitongwa bionsi ase ense.

English: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,
Kiswahili: Sasa nafurahia kule kuteseka kwangu kwa ajili yenu, na katika mwili wangu ninatimiliza yale yaliyopungua katika mateso ya Kristo kwa ajili ya mwili wake, ambao ni kanisa.
Ekegusii: Bono nagokeire ogochandwa kwane inde nakorokwo ase engencho yaino; naende ase omobere one nkoyaikerania nde aria aremete ase ogochandwa gwa Kristo ase engencho y’omobere oye, engencho yaye ekanisa.

English: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
Kiswahili: Mimi nimekuwa mtumishi wa kanisa kwa wajibu alionipa Mungu ili kuwaletea ninyi Neno la Mungu kwa ukamilifu:
Ekegusii: Inche nabeire omosomba bw’ekanisa yaye ase oborendi obo naetwe na Nyasae ase engencho yaino ase okobaranderia inwe ring’ana rionsi ria Nyasae.

English: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
Kiswahili: Hii ni siri iliyokuwa imefichika tangu zamani na kwa vizazi vingi, lakini sasa imefunuliwa kwa watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Obobisi boria bwabisetwe korwa kare ase ebigori ebinge, korende bono bwaorokigwe ase abachenu baye.

English: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
Kiswahili: Kwao, Mungu amechagua kujulisha miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa utukufu wa utajiri wa siri hii, ambayo ni Kristo ndani yenu, tumaini la utukufu.
Ekegusii: Nyasae agancha koorokia ase bare obobisi boria bore obonene na obw’obonda ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku. Obobisi boria nabwo obo, ng’a Kristo nigo are ime yaino, ayio naro ogosemeria kw’obonene.

English: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye tunayemtangaza, tukimwonya kila mtu na kumfundisha kila mtu kwa hekima yote ili tuweze kumleta kila mmoja akiwa amekamilika katika Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nigo tokorandia Kristo ase abanto bonsi; nigo tokobakurera na kobaorokereria bonsi ase obong’aini bwonsi, erio tonyare korenta kera oyomo ase obosio bwa Nyasae abe oikeranire ase okobwatana na Kristo.

English: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya jambo hili, ninajitaabisha, nikijitahidi kwa kadiri ya nguvu zake ambazo hutenda kazi ndani yangu kwa uweza mwingi.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio inche nigo ngokora emeremo na ngokora omokia ase chinguru chiaye chinene, echigokora emeremo ime ase ’nde.

English: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
Kiswahili: Nataka mjue jinsi ninavyojitaabisha kwa ajili yenu na kwa ajili ya wale walioko Laodikia, na pia kwa ajili ya wote ambao hawajapata kuniona mimi binafsi.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkobamanyia igoro y’omokia inde noro ase engencho yaino, boigo na ase abanto bare Laodikia na baria bonsi batarandora obosio bwane,

English: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
Kiswahili: Kusudi langu ni watiwe moyo na kuunganishwa katika upendo, ili wapate ule utajiri wa ufahamu mkamilifu, ili waijue siri ya Mungu, yaani, Kristo mwenyewe,
Ekegusii: nigo ngokora aya onsi erinde baremigwe ase chinkoro chiabo, kobarabwatanigwe ase obwanchani, banyore obonda bwonsi ase okomanya gwonsi gw’ekeene. Ase engencho eyio banyare komanya obobisi bwa Nyasae engencho yaye Kristo.

English: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
Kiswahili: ambaye ndani yake kumefichwa hazina zote za hekima na maarifa.
Ekegusii: Nere ekeigorero ase chinibo chionsi chi’obong’aini na echie chisemi chibisire.

English: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
Kiswahili: Nawaambia mambo haya ili mtu yeyote asiwadanganye kwa maneno ya kuwashawishi.
Ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana ring’ana eri, ng’a monto onde tacha kobang’aina ase amang’ana okoebereria neisa koba nigo bare abaya.

English: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ingawa mimi siko pamoja nanyi kimwili, lakini niko pamoja nanyi kiroho, nami nafurahi kuuona utaratibu wenu na jinsi uthabiti wa imani yenu katika Kristo ulivyo.
Ekegusii: Naki nonya tindi nainwe ase omobere, nigo inde amo nainwe ase omoika. Nigo nkogoka ekero nkorora omoroberio oino omuya, na ogwetenenera gw’okwegena kwaino ase Kristo.

English: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, kama vile mlivyompokea Kristo Yesu kuwa Bwana, endeleeni kukaa ndani yake,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna mwamoitabire Kristo Yeso buna Omonene, naboigo mogenderere komenya ase okobwatana nere.

English: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
Kiswahili: mkiwa na mizizi, na mmejengwa ndani yake, mkiimarishwa katika imani kama mlivyofundishwa, na kufurika kwa wingi wa shukrani.
Ekegusii: Simeka emeri yaino ime ase are, agacha amagima aiono ase are, mokong’igwe ase okwegena buna mworokereretigwe. Na momenteke ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

English: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.
Kiswahili: Angalieni mtu yeyote asiwafanye ninyi mateka kwa elimu batili na madanganyo matupu yanayotegemea mapokeo ya wanadamu na mafundisho ya ulimwengu badala ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Rigereria monto onde tabaisa kobakora abasakore ase chisemi chiaye chi’oborimo, echio chikorwa ase amorokererio a mwanyabaanto na obong’ainereria bwa bosa na korwa ase emeika y’ense, gose tari buna aya Kristo.

English: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
Kiswahili: Maana ukamilifu wote wa Uungu umo ndani ya Kristo katika umbile la mwili wa kibinadamu,
Ekegusii: Naki ime yaye nao oboikeranu bwonsi bw’obonyasae bomenyete ase ekieni ki’omobere.

English: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
Kiswahili: nanyi mmepewa ukamilifu ndani ya Kristo, ambaye ndiye mkuu juu ya kila enzi na kila mamlaka.
Ekegusii: Na inwe mwaerwe obogima ime yaye, ere oyore omotwe bw’abagaambi na obwa bonsi abare nokobua.

English: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
Kiswahili: Katika Kristo pia mlitahiriwa kwa kutengwa mbali na asili ya dhambi, si kwa tohara inayofanywa kwa mikono ya wanadamu, bali kwa ile tohara iliyofanywa na Kristo,
Ekegusii: Ase okobwatanigwa na Kristo boigo mwarokigwe okwaroka gotakoriri namaboko, korende ase okwaroka gokorire na Kristo okwo kogotokora abasibore korwa ase chinguru chi’ebibe.

English: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
Kiswahili: mkiwa mmezikwa pamoja naye katika ubatizo, na kufufuliwa pamoja naye kwa njia ya imani yenu katika uweza wa Mungu, aliyemfufua kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ekero mwabatisetwe nigo mwatindegetwe amo na Kristo, na ase ebatiso boigo mokabokigwa na Yeso goetera ase okwegena kwaino ase chinguru chia Nyasae oyomobogetie korwa ase abakuure.

English: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
Kiswahili: Mlipokuwa wafu katika dhambi zenu na kutokutahiriwa katika asili yenu ya dhambi, Mungu aliwafanya mwe hai pamoja na Kristo. Alitusamehe dhambi zetu zote,
Ekegusii: Na inwe abamwarenge mokwete ase ogosaria kwaino na ase ogotaroka kw’emebere yaino, Nyasae akabakora koba moyo amo nere, gaikire kobaabera ogosaria gwonsi.

English: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
Kiswahili: akiisha kuifuta ile hati yenye mashtaka yaliyokuwa yanatukabili, pamoja na maagizo yake. Aliiondoa isiwepo tena, akiigongomea kwenye msalaba wake.
Ekegusii: Ere agatinyia ririiko riria riarigetwe ase amachiiko, riare gotosoera, eriarenge nobobisa ase tore; akaritigeria ensemo, akariakerania ase omosalaba.

English: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
Kiswahili: Mungu akiisha kuzivua enzi na mamlaka, alizifanya kuwa kitu cha fedheha hadharani kwa kuziburura kwa ujasiri, akizishinda katika msalaba wa Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ekero aurire abagaambi na abare nokobua ebirwanero biabo, akabasookia maiso marore, agachenga igoro ase bare ase omosalaba oria.

English: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo mtu asiwahukumu ninyi kuhusu vyakula au vinywaji, au kuhusu kuadhimisha sikukuu za dini, au Sikukuu za Mwezi Mwandamo au siku ya Sabato.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, timwancha koegwa ogochika inwe ase engencho y’ebimokoria gose ebimokonywa, gose ase engencho ye Rituko Rinene, gose okooroka kw’omotienyi, gose Esabato.

English: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
Kiswahili: Hizi zilikuwa kivuli cha mambo ambayo yangekuja, lakini ile iliyo halisi imo ndani ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nekiriri ki’amang’ana agochi‐gocha, korende omoikerania omonyene nere Kristo.

English: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asiwaondolee thawabu yenu kwa kusisitiza kunyenyekea kwake na kuabudu malaika. Mtu kama huyo hudumu katika maono yake, akijivuna bila sababu katika mawazo ya kibinadamu.
Ekegusii: Timoa monto onde ribaga ri’okobaura inwe ekeegwa kiaino ase okorigia kwaye ase okweororobia na ase ogosasiima abamalaika, na kwebeka ase amaroro aya arorire, na koenena bosa ase ebirengererio biaye bi’obobe,

English: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
Kiswahili: Yeye amepoteza ushirikiano na Kichwa, ambaye kutoka kwake mwili wote unalishwa na kushikamanishwa pamoja kwa viungo na mishipa, nao hukua kwa ukuaji utokao kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: na tabwataini nere oyore Omotwe. Korwa asere omobere bwonsi nigo ogokina ase ogokina gokorwa ase Nyasae, ase okonyora chinguru na kobwatanigwa ase chinengo na emeki.

English: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mlikufa pamoja na Kristo, mkayaacha yale mafundisho ya msingi ya ulimwengu huu, kwa nini bado mnaishi kama ninyi ni wa ulimwengu? Kwa nini mnajitia chini ya amri:
Ekegusii: Gaki, onye mwakuure amo na Kristo, mwatigire amorokererio aye ritang’ani ay’ense, nase ki rende mogendererete buna nab’ense more? Nase ki naende mokoigwera amachiiko buna ayio:

English: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
Kiswahili: “Msishike! Msionje! Msiguse!”?
Ekegusii: “Timokuna, Timoigwa, Timobwata”,

English: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
Kiswahili: Haya yote mwisho wake ni kuharibika yanapotumiwa, kwa sababu msingi wake ni katika maagizo na mafundisho ya wanadamu.
Ekegusii: koreng’ana buna Mwanyabaanto bakoyanyora ase amachiiko na amorokererio abo? (Amang’ana ayio onsi nigo agosareka ekero agokorerwa.)

English: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
Kiswahili: Kwa kweli amri kama hizo huonekana kama zina hekima, katika namna za ibada walizojitungia wenyewe, na unyenyekevu wa uongo na kuutawala mwili kwa ukali, lakini hayafai kitu katika kuzuia tamaa za mwili.
Ekegusii: Ayio nigo akororekana ng’a nay’obong’aini ase ogosasiima na okweororobia na goaka omobere, korende taisaneti gento kende ase ogotanga okogania gwe chingencho chi’obobe.

English: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
Kiswahili: Basi, kwa kuwa mmefufuliwa pamoja na Kristo, yatafuteni yaliyo juu, Kristo alikoketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mwabokigwe ase obogima amo na Kristo, ase igo beka chinkoro chiaino ase ebinto bire igoro, aase Kristo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.

English: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
Kiswahili: Yafikirini mambo yaliyo juu, wala si ya duniani.
Ekegusii: Rengereria ayare igoro, gose tari ayare ase ense.

English: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninyi mlikufa, nao uhai wenu sasa umefichwa pamoja na Kristo katika Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki inwe mwakuure, na obogima bwaino nigo bobisire amo na Kristo ase Nyasae.

English: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
Kiswahili: Wakati Kristo, aliye uzima wenu, atakapotokea, ndipo nanyi mtakapotokea pamoja naye katika utukufu.
Ekegusii: Obogima bwaino nigo bore Kristo na ekero ararorekane, erio nario nainwe morarorekane amo nere ase obonene.

English: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ueni kabisa chochote kilicho ndani yenu cha asili ya kidunia: yaani uasherati, uchafu, tamaa mbaya, mawazo mabaya na ulafi, ambayo ndiyo ibada ya sanamu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo moite kende gionsi ekio kere ime yaino ekio kere egi’ense: obotomani, eubi, okorengereria okobe, okogania okobe, na obwegimeria, engencho yaye ogosasiima emegwekano.

English: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya mambo haya, ghadhabu ya Mungu inakuja.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho yayio endamwamu ya Nyasae nebachere abanto batarikomoigwera.

English: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,
Kiswahili: Ninyi pia zamani mlienenda katika mambo haya mlipoishi maisha hayo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio nainwe nabo mware gotaara kare, ekero mwagamberetwe naro.

English: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa yawekeni mbali nanyi mambo kama haya yote: yaani hasira, ghadhabu, uovu, masingizio na lugha chafu kutoka midomoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Korende bono mobeke aare aya onsi: endamwamu, okobea, obobe, okorama, na ogokwana okobe gokorwa ase emenwa yaino.

English: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
Kiswahili: Msiambiane uongo, kwa maana mmevua kabisa utu wenu wa kale pamoja na matendo yake,
Ekegusii: Timotebania oborimo, inwe abamwarusirie oboMwanyabaanto bwa kare amo nogokora kwaye,

English: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
Kiswahili: nanyi mmevaa utu mpya, unaofanywa upya katika ufahamu sawasawa na mfano wa Muumba wake.
Ekegusii: mwamweboyirie omonto omoyia, oyo Nyasae akorire omoyia ase okomanya gwonsi ase omogwekano oye erio momanye Nyasae ase oboikeranu.

English: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
Kiswahili: Hapa hakuna Myunani wala Myahudi, aliyetahiriwa wala asiyetahiriwa, asiyestaarabika wala aliyestaarabika, mtumwa wala mtu huru, bali Kristo ni yote, na ndani ya wote.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio goatananeka tigokoba gati yomogiriki nomoyahudi, oyobwarogete gose oyotarogeti, oyotari Omogiriki gose oyore Omosikuti, omosomba gose omosibore, korende Kristo nere onsi, na ase bonsi.

English: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa ninyi mmekuwa wateule wa Mungu, watakatifu wapendwao sana, jivikeni moyo wa huruma, utu wema, unyenyekevu, upole na uvumilivu.
Ekegusii: Inwe n’abanto ba Nyasae; ere nigo abanchete na akabachora koba abaye. Ase igo mweboyie amabeebe, obuya, obokanyeku, obwororo, oboremereria.

English: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
Kiswahili: Vumilianeni na kusameheana mtu akiwa na lalamiko lolote dhidi ya mwenzake. Sameheaneni kama vile Bwana alivyowasamehe ninyi.
Ekegusii: Bogorerania inwe ase inwe, na onye omonto ore ne ring’ana igoro ase omonto onde, mwaberane: buna Omonene abaaberete inwe, nainwe mwaberane bo.

English: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya maadili haya yote jivikeni upendo, ambao ndio unaofunga kila kitu pamoja katika umoja mkamilifu.
Ekegusii: Kobua aya onsi, mweboyie obwanchani, nabwo egesibo gekobwatania kera egento ase oboikeranu bw’obuya.

English: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
Kiswahili: Amani ya Kristo na itawale mioyoni mwenu, kwa kuwa ninyi kama viungo vya mwili mmoja mmeitiwa amani. Tena kuweni watu wa shukrani.
Ekegusii: Tiga omorembe o Kristo ogambere chinkoro chiaino, noro mwarangererigwe ase omobere oyomo, na mobe abakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

English: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
Kiswahili: Neno la Kristo na likae kwa wingi ndani yenu, mkifundishana na kuonyana katika hekima yote, mkimwimbia Mungu zaburi, nyimbo na tenzi za rohoni, huku mkiwa na shukrani mioyoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ria Kristo rimenye ase obonge ime yaino, mobe mokworokererania na gotebererania ase obong’aini bwonsi, mogoteera ase chizaburi, na amatera, ne chingero chi’omoika, ase ogoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase chinkoro chiaino ime.

English: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
Kiswahili: Lolote mfanyalo, ikiwa ni kwa neno au kwa tendo, fanyeni yote katika jina la Bwana Yesu, mkimshukuru Mungu Baba katika yeye.
Ekegusii: Na kera eki mogokora, ase amang’ana gose ase ogokora, mokore kera egento ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso, mokomoakera Nyasae Tata ng’a mbuya mono goetera asare.

English: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Ninyi wake, watiini waume zenu, kama inavyostahili katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino, buna egwenerete ase Omonene.

English: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
Kiswahili: Ninyi waume, wapendeni wake zenu, wala msiwe na uchungu dhidi yao.
Ekegusii: Na inwe abasacha, mwanche abakungu baino, timoba nobororo ase bare.

English: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
Kiswahili: Enyi watoto, watiini wazazi wenu katika mambo yote, kwa maana hivi ndivyo inavyompendeza Bwana.
Ekegusii: Na inwe abana, moigwere abaibori baino ase amang’ana onsi, ekiagera ring’ana eri nigo rikogwenera Omonene.

English: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
Kiswahili: Ninyi akina baba, msiwachokoze watoto wenu, wasije wakakata tamaa.
Ekegusii: Na inwe abaibori, timochegia abana baino, baabaise gokwa emioyo.

English: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
Kiswahili: Ninyi watumwa, watiini mabwana zenu wa hapa duniani katika mambo yote. Fanyeni hivyo si wakiwepo tu, wala si kwa kutafuta upendeleo wao, bali kwa moyo mnyofu na kumcha Bwana.
Ekegusii: Nainwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase ense eye ase amang’ana onsi, tari rioka ekero babaroche erio konyora ogwancherwa ase bare; korende kora igo ase enkoro endonge, mokomoiroka Omonene.

English: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
Kiswahili: Lolote mfanyalo, fanyeni kwa moyo kama watu wanaomtumikia Bwana, na si wanadamu,
Ekegusii: Rinde rionsi mogokora rikore ase enkoro y’omogooko, buna mogokorera Omonene, gose tari Mwanyabaanto,

English: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa mnajua kwamba mtapokea urithi wenu kutoka kwa Bwana ukiwa thawabu yenu. Ni Bwana Yesu Kristo mnayemtumikia.
Ekegusii: inyora ng’a Omonene nabae eng’eria eyio agacherete abanto baye. Ekiagera Kristo nere Omonene togwenerete gokorera.

English: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
Kiswahili: Yeyote atendaye mabaya atalipwa kwa ajili ya mabaya yake, wala hakuna upendeleo.
Ekegusii: Naki oyorakore bobe, nigo araakanwe obobe bwaye obo akorire, na gwanchereria tikoiyo.

English: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
Kiswahili: Ninyi mabwana, watendeeni watumwa wenu yaliyo haki na yanayostahili, mkitambua ya kwamba ninyi pia mnaye Bwana mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Inwe abanene, kae abasomba baino ekere kia boronge, mokomanya ng’a nainwe more n’Omonene igoro.

English: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
Kiswahili: Dumuni sana katika maombi, mkikesha katika hayo pamoja na kushukuru.
Ekegusii: Mogenderere nogosaba, morende ase korokwo, na koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono;

English: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
Kiswahili: Pia tuombeeni na sisi ili Mungu atufungulie mlango wa kunena, ili tupate kuitangaza siri ya Kristo, ambayo kwa ajili yake pia mimi nimefungwa.
Ekegusii: na gotosabera intwe boigo, erinde Nyasae atoigorere egesieri ase ring’ana riaye, erio tokwane obobisi bwa Kristo, naki nase engencho y’ayio nasibirwe.

English: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
Kiswahili: Ombeni ili nipate kuitangaza Injili kwa udhahiri kama ipasavyo kunena.
Ekegusii: Mosabe ng’a mboorokie buna ngwenerete koboorokia.

English: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
Kiswahili: Enendeni kwa hekima mbele yao walio nje, mkiukomboa wakati.
Ekegusii: Mogenderere ase obong’aini ase amasio ’abaanto abare isiko, na renda engaki yaino.

English: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
Kiswahili: Maneno yenu yawe yamejaa neema siku zote, yanayofaa, ili mjue jinsi iwapasavyo na inavyofaa kumjibu kila mtu.
Ekegusii: Botambe chinkwana chiaino chibe chinyororo, chinywere buna omonyoo, erinde momanye buna mogwenerete koiraneria kera omonto.

English: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Tikiko atawaambia habari zangu zote. Yeye ni ndugu mpendwa, mtendakazi mwaminifu na mtumishi mwenzangu katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Tukiko oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa, omosomba amo nainche ase Omonene, nabamanyie amang’ana aane onsi.

English: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
Kiswahili: Nimemtuma kwenu kwa madhumuni haya ili mpate kufahamu hali yetu, na pia awatie moyo.
Ekegusii: Namotomire ere ase more ase engencho eyio eyio, erinde momanye amang’ana aito, naende ere naremie chinkoro chiaino.

English: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
Kiswahili: Anakuja pamoja na Onesimo, ndugu yetu mpendwa na mwaminifu, ambaye ni mmoja wenu. Watawaambia mambo yote yanayotendeka hapa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Amo nere natomire Onesimo, oyominto omwegenwa, omwanchwa, oyore oyomo oino. Barabwo nabaabamanyie onsi ayare aiga ase tore.

English: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
Kiswahili: Aristarko aliye mfungwa pamoja nami anawasalimu, vivyo hivyo Marko, binamu yake Barnaba. (Mmeshapata maagizo yanayomhusu; akija kwenu, mpokeeni.)
Ekegusii: Aristariko, oyosibetwe amo nainche, obakwanirie, na Mariko, omwana oisemoke Barnaba (mwanyorire ogotebererigwa igoro yaye; karaike seino momooroisie).

English: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
Kiswahili: Yesu, yeye aitwaye Yusto, pia anawasalimu. Hawa peke yao ndio Wayahudi miongoni mwa watendakazi wenzangu kwa ajili ya Ufalme wa Mungu, nao wamekuwa faraja kwangu.
Ekegusii: Naende Yeso, oyokorokwa Yusto, obakwanirie. Abwo nabwo boka ase abaarogete bare abakori emeremo amo nainche ase engencho y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae; na barabwo nigo barenge kondemia.

English: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
Kiswahili: Epafra, ambaye ni mmoja wenu na mtumishi wa Kristo Yesu, anawasalimu. Yeye siku zote anawaombea kwa bidii kwamba msimame imara katika mapenzi yote ya Mungu, mkiwa wakamilifu na thabiti.
Ekegusii: Epafara oyore oyomo oino, omosomba o Kristo Yeso, obakwanirie. Ere okorire omokia ase okobainyora ase ogosaba kwaye, erinde monyare gotenena more abaikeranu, abamanyete mono ogwancha gwonsi kwa Nyasae.

English: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
Kiswahili: Ninashuhudia kumhusu kwamba anafanya kazi kwa bidii kwa ajili yenu, na kwa ajili ya ndugu wa Laodikia na wale wa Hierapoli.
Ekegusii: Naki namobereire kirori, ng’a nare nomokia omonge mono ase engencho yaino, na ase engencho y’abwo bare Laodikia na Hieropoli.

English: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
Kiswahili: Rafiki yetu mpenzi Luka yule tabibu, pamoja na Dema, wanawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Luka, oria omogwenia omwanchwa, na Dema babakwanirie.

English: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni ndugu wote wa Laodikia, na pia Nimfa, pamoja na kanisa linalokutana katika nyumba yake.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie abaminto abare Laodikia, na Nimfa, na ekanisa ere ase enyomba yaye.

English: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
Kiswahili: Baada ya barua hii kusomwa kwenu, hakikisheni kwamba inasomwa pia katika kanisa la Walaodikia. Nanyi pia msome barua inayotoka Laodikia.
Ekegusii: Riruube eri karirasomwe ase more, tiga risomwe naende ase ekanisa ya Laodikia; na riria rikorwa Laodikia risomwe ase more boigo.

English: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
Kiswahili: Mwambieni Arkipo hivi: “Hakikisha kuwa unakamilisha ile huduma uliyopokea katika Bwana.”
Ekegusii: Moteebie Arikipo arigererie mono obosomba boria aetwe korwa ase Omonene, erinde aboikeranie.

English: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
Kiswahili: Mimi, Paulo, naandika salamu hizi kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe. Kumbukeni minyororo yangu. Neema iwe nanyi. Amen.
Ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane, inche Paulo, ase okoboko kwane omonyene. Moinyore ebisibo biane. Obuya bobe amo nainwe.

English: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Paulo, Silvano na Timotheo: Kwa kanisa la Wathesalonike, ninyi mlio ndani ya Mungu Baba yetu na ndani ya Bwana Yesu Kristo: Neema iwe kwenu na amani.
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo amo na Silivano na Timotheo nkobariikera tore inwe abekanisa y’Abatesaloniki, abamore ase Nyasae Tata na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe.

English: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
Kiswahili: Siku zote tunamshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu ninyi nyote, tukiwataja kwenye maombi yetu daima.
Ekegusii: Botambe nigo togoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino mwensi, na kobaatora ase ogosaba gwaito.

English: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
Kiswahili: Tunaikumbuka daima kazi yenu ya imani mbele za Mungu aliye Baba yetu, taabu yenu katika upendo na saburi yenu ya tumaini katika Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Na intwe ase obosio bwa Nyasae Tata oito titori gotiga koinyora emeremo yaino ase okwegena, na ogwechanda kwaino ase obwanchani, na oboremereria bwaino ase okomosemeri ’Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zetu mpendwao na Mungu, kwa kuwa tunajua kwamba Mungu amewachagua,
Ekegusii: Naki abaminto, abamwanchire na Nyasae, twamanyire ng’a ere obachorire.

English: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ujumbe wetu wa Injili haukuja kwenu kwa maneno matupu bali pia ulidhihirishwa katika nguvu na katika Roho Mtakatifu, tena ukiwa na uthibitisho kamili, kama vile ninyi wenyewe mnavyojua jinsi tulivyoenenda katikati yenu kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe titwabarenterete enchiri yaito ase amang’ana oka, korende boigo nase chinguru, na ase Omoika Omochenu, na ase okobaraa gochia ase obomaene oboikeranu. Na inwe momanyete chingencho chiaito buna twarenge ase egati yaino ase engencho yaino.

English: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
Kiswahili: Nanyi mkawa wafuasi wetu na wa Bwana, ingawa mlipata mateso mengi, mlilipokea lile Neno kwa furaha katika Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Inwe mokaba abegi baito, na ab’Omonene, na nonya mwachandegete mono, mwanyorete ring’ana amo nomogooko okorwa ase Omoika Omochenu,

English: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
Kiswahili: Hivyo ninyi mkawa kielelezo kwa waumini wote katika Makedonia na Akaya.
Ekegusii: na igo mokaba ekiorokererio ekiya ase abegeni bonsi ba Makedonia na Akaya.

English: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kutoka kwenu neno la Bwana limesikika, si katika Makedonia na Akaya tu, bali pia imani yenu katika Mungu imejulikana kila mahali kiasi kwamba hatuna haja ya kusema lolote kwa habari yake.
Ekegusii: Naki korwa ase more ring’ana ri’Omonene riaigurwe, tari ase Makedonia na Akaya oka, korende amang’ana akumire kera aase, ng’a imomwegenete Nyasae. Ase igo titogwenereti gokwana ring’ana rinde rionsi.

English: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana watu wa maeneo hayo wenyewe wanaeleza jinsi mlivyotupokea na jinsi mlivyomgeukia Mungu mkaacha sanamu, ili kumtumikia Mungu aliye hai na wa kweli
Ekegusii: Naki barabwo abanyene baorokirie amang’ana igoro yaito, buna twasoete ase egati yaino, na buna inwe mwaonchokerete Nyasae korwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, erinde mokorere Nyasae ore moyo, oyo bw’ekeene,

English: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
Kiswahili: na ili kumngojea Mwanawe kutoka mbinguni, ambaye Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu: yaani, Yesu, yeye aliyetuokoa kutoka ghadhabu inayokuja.
Ekegusii: na moganye Omwana oye korwa igoro, oyio ere abogetie korwa ase abakuure, nere Yeso, oyototooretie korwa ase endamwamu egochi‐gocha.

English: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, kwa kuwa ninyi wenyewe mnajua ya kwamba kuja kwetu kwenu hakukuwa bure,
Ekegusii: Abaminto, inwe abanyene mwamanyire ng’a ogosoa gwaito ase egati yaino tikwabeete okwa bosa.

English: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
Kiswahili: kama vile mjuavyo, tulikuwa tumeteswa na kutukanwa huko Filipi, lakini hata hivyo, kwa msaada wa Mungu wetu, tulikuwa na ujasiri wa kuwaambia Injili ya Mungu ingawa kulikuwa na upinzani mkubwa.
Ekegusii: Korende, buna momanyete, gatwaikire gochandwa na gochaywa ritang’ani ase Filipi, tokaremigwa na Nyasae oito gokwana enchiri ya Nyasae ase more, ase okoumerana nokoamererania okonene mono.

English: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana himizo letu halikutokana na hila wala nia mbaya au udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Naki ogosorora gwaito tikori ogw’okobasiria, gose ogw’okobabeka ase eubi, gose ogw’okobang’aina,

English: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.
Kiswahili: Kinyume chake, tulinena kama watu tuliokubaliwa na Mungu tukakabidhiwa Injili. Sisi hatujaribu kuwapendeza wanadamu bali kumpendeza Mungu, yeye ayachunguzaye mawazo ya ndani sana ya mioyo yetu.
Ekegusii: korende buna twancheirwe na Nyasae koba abatwegenirwe koegwa enchiri, nabo togokwana, tari ase okogwenera abanto, korende ase okogwenera Nyasae, oyokorenga chinkoro chiaito.

English: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),
Kiswahili: Kama mjuavyo, hatukuja kwenu kwa maneno ya kujipendekeza au maneno yasiyo ya kweli ili kuficha tamaa mbaya: Mungu ndiye shahidi yetu.
Ekegusii: Naki titwarenge namang’ana ay’okogwenera abanto, buna mwamanyire, gose ay’okobiserera obwegimeria. Nyasae nere kirori.

English: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
Kiswahili: Wala hatukuwa tunatafuta sifa kutoka kwa wanadamu, wala kutoka kwenu au kwa mtu mwingine awaye yote. Kama mitume wa Kristo tungaliweza kuwa mzigo kwenu,
Ekegusii: Titwarigetie ogotogigwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto, nonya nkorwa ase more, gose korwa ase abanto bande.

English: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
Kiswahili: lakini tulikuwa wapole katikati yenu, kama mama anayewatunza watoto wake wadogo.
Ekegusii: Buna abatomwa ba Kristo anga ntwabaritoerete, korende nigo tware abororo ase egati yaino, buna omokungu akorera abana baye.

English: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
Kiswahili: Tuliwapenda sana kiasi kwamba tulifurahia kushirikiana nanyi, si Injili ya Mungu tu, bali hata maisha yetu, kwa sababu mlikuwa wa thamani mno kwetu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo naintwe tware namaiga amange ase more, tokaba nomogooko kobaa inwe, tari enchiri ya Nyasae yoka, korende nonya nobogima bwaito, ekiagera mwabeire abanchi baito.

English: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zetu, mnakumbuka juhudi yetu na taabu yetu. Tulifanya kazi usiku na mchana, ili tusimlemee mtu yeyote wa kwenu wakati tulipokuwa tunawahubiria Injili ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki baminto, moinyorete emeremo yaito na obokong’u bwaito, ng’a ekero twabaranderetie enchiri ya Nyasae, tware gokora emeremo obotuko na omobaso, erinde titocha komoraarereria onde oino.

English: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
Kiswahili: Ninyi wenyewe ni mashahidi na Mungu pia, jinsi tulivyokuwa watakatifu, wenye haki na wasio na lawama miongoni mwenu ninyi mlioamini.
Ekegusii: Inwe mbirori, na Nyasae boigo, buna okogenderera gwaito kwarenge ase egati yaino, inwe abamwegenire, buna tware nobochenu na oboronge, na titware na komocha.

English: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
Kiswahili: Maana mnajua kwamba tuliwatendea kila mmoja wenu kama vile baba awatendeavyo watoto wake.
Ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire buna tware gosemia kera oyomo oino buna ise agosemia abana baye, na tokabaremia, na kobasorora, na kobakuurera,

English: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
Kiswahili: Tuliwatia moyo, tuliwafariji na kuwahimiza kuishi maisha yampendezayo Mungu, anayewaita katika Ufalme na utukufu wake.
Ekegusii: erinde mogenderere buna ebagwenerete ase Nyasae, oyokobarangeria mosoe ase oborwoti bwaye, na ase obonene bwaye.

English: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.
Kiswahili: Nasi pia tunamshukuru Mungu bila kukoma kwa sababu mlipolipokea neno la Mungu mlilosikia kutoka kwetu, hamkulipokea kama neno la wanadamu, bali mlilipokea kama lilivyo hasa, neno la Mungu, litendalo kazi ndani yenu ninyi mnaoamini.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo togoakera Nyasae, ng’a mbuya mono, totari gotiga, ng’a ekero mwanyorete ring’ana ria Nyasae, eri mwaigwete korwa ase tore, nigo mwarianchete, tari buna ring’ana ria Mwanyabaanto, korende buna rire ekeene ekeene, ring’ana ria Nyasae, erigokora emeremo ime yaino, inwe abamwegenire.

English: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ninyi ndugu zetu, mlifanyika wafuasi wa makanisa ya Mungu yaliyoko ndani ya Kristo Yesu katika Uyahudi. Mlipata mateso yale yale kutoka kwa watu wenu wenyewe kama vile makanisa hayo yalivyoteswa na Wayahudi,
Ekegusii: Naki baminto, inwe nigo mwarenge ababwatani be chikanisa chia Nyasae ase Kristo Yeso, echire ase ense ya Boyahudi, ekiagera nigo mwanyorete emechaando eria eria korwa ase abanto b’egesaku kiaino, buna baria banyorete korwa ase Abayahudi,

English: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,
Kiswahili: wale waliomuua Bwana Yesu na manabii, nasi wakatufukuza pia. Watu hao walimchukiza Mungu na tena ni adui wa watu wote,
Ekegusii: abaitete Omonene Yeso na ababani, na intwe bagatoseria. Barabwo tibagwenera Nyasae, naende nigo bare mamincha ase abanto bonsi.

English: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.
Kiswahili: wakijitahidi kutuzuia tusizungumze na watu wa Mataifa ili kwamba wapate kuokolewa. Kwa njia hii wanazidi kujilundikia dhambi zao hadi kikomo. Lakini hatimaye ghadhabu ya Mungu imewafikia.
Ekegusii: Abwo bagatotanga titokwana nabaanto b’Ebisaku amang’ana ayaranyare kobarentera ogotooreka. Ase enchera eyio baikeranie botambe ekerengo ki’ebibe biabo. Korende endamwamu ya Nyasae yabaikeire omoerio.

English: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu zetu, tulipotenganishwa nanyi kwa kitambo kidogo (ingawa kutengana huko kulikuwa kwa mwili tu, si kwa moyo), tulizidi kuwa na shauku kubwa kuwaona uso kwa uso.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe, baminto, gatoraatananekane korwa ase more ase ekero egeke (ase obosio gose tari ase enkoro) tokarengereria mono kobua nokogania okonene kororana nainwe amasio ase amasio.

English: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
Kiswahili: Maana tulitaka kuja kwenu, hasa mimi Paulo, nilitaka kuja tena na tena, lakini Shetani akatuzuia.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ntwaganetie gocha ase more (inche Paulo nonya ng’ara kabere) korende Saitani agatotanga.

English: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
Kiswahili: Kwa maana tumaini letu ni nini, au furaha yetu au taji yetu ya kujisifia mbele za Bwana Yesu Kristo wakati wa kuja kwake? Je, si ni ninyi?
Ekegusii: Ogosemeria gwaito ninki, gose omogooko oito, gose egutwa yaito eragere twetogie ase obosio bw’Omonene oito Yeso ekero ki’ogocha kwaye? Inee! Tari inwe?

English: For you are our glory and our joy.
Kiswahili: Naam, ninyi ndio fahari yetu na furaha yetu.
Ekegusii: Ee, inwe nobonene bwaito, na omogooko oito.

English: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo tulipokuwa hatuwezi kuvumilia zaidi, tuliamua tubaki Athene peke yetu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero totanyarete koremereria kobua, togancha gotigara Atene intwe tweka.

English: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,
Kiswahili: Tukamtuma Timotheo ambaye ni ndugu yetu na mtumishi mwenzetu wa Mungu katika kuieneza Injili ya Kristo, aje kuwaimarisha na kuwatia moyo katika imani yenu,
Ekegusii: Togatoma Timotheo oyominto, omokori emeremo amo na Nyasae ase okorandia enchiri ya Kristo, erinde abakong’ie na kobaremia ase okwegena kwaino,

English: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
Kiswahili: ili mtu yeyote asifadhaishwe na mateso haya. Mnajua vyema kwamba tumewekewa hayo mateso.
Ekegusii: erio tatigerigwa nemechando eye. Naki inwe abanyene ’momanyete ng’a ase ayio nero torageire.

English: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.
Kiswahili: Kwa kweli, tulipokuwa pamoja nanyi tuliwaambia mara kwa mara kwamba tutateswa na imekuwa hivyo kama mjuavyo.
Ekegusii: Naki ekero twarenge amo nainwe ntwatang’anete kobateebia ng’a ntonyore emechando, buna yabeete agwo, na inwe moyemanyete.

English: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii nilipokuwa siwezi kuvumilia zaidi, nilimtuma mtu ili nipate habari za imani yenu. Niliogopa kwamba kwa njia fulani yule mjaribu asiwe amewajaribu, nasi tukawa tumejitaabisha bure.
Ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio, ekero ntanyarete koremereria kobua, ngatoma Timotheo, erinde inyare komanya okwegena kwaino. Noboire ng’a omoteemi oria obateemire inwe na emeremo yaito ebe eya bosa.

English: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa Timotheo ndiyo tu amerejea kwetu kutoka kwenu na ameleta habari njema kuhusu imani yenu na upendo wenu. Ametuambia kwamba siku zote mnatukumbuka kwa wema na kwamba mna shauku ya kutuona kama vile sisi tulivyo na shauku ya kuwaona ninyi.
Ekegusii: Korende bono ekero Timotheo achete ase tore korwa seino agatorentera amang’ana amaya igoro y’okwegena kwaino na obwanchani bwaino, na buna motoinyorete buya botambe. Naende agatoteebia ng’a more namaiga gotorora intwe, buna naintwe tore namaiga kobarora inwe.

English: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zetu, katika dhiki na mateso yetu yote tumefarijika kwa sababu ya imani yenu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, baminto, ase obokong’u bwaito, na emechando yaito, tokaremigwa ase okwegena kwaino.

English: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Sasa kwa kuwa hakika tunaishi, kwa kuwa ninyi mmesimama imara katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naki bono nigo torabe moyo, komorabe moteneine bokong’u ase Omonene.

English: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,
Kiswahili: Je, tutawezaje kumshukuru Mungu kiasi cha kutosha kwa ajili yenu, kutokana na furaha tuliyo nayo mbele za Mungu wetu kwa sababu yenu?
Ekegusii: Nase nchera ki toranyare koiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino, ase omogooko bwonsi oyotokoigwa ase engencho yaino ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito?

English: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
Kiswahili: Usiku na mchana tunaomba kwa bidii ili tupate kuwaona tena na kujaza kile kilichopungua katika imani yenu.
Ekegusii: Obotuko na omobaso nigo tokona‐gosaba ng’a tororane nainwe amasio ase amasio, na koroisia ekebaremete ase okwegena kwaino.

English: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
Kiswahili: Basi Mungu wetu na Baba yetu mwenyewe na Bwana wetu Yesu atengeneze njia ya sisi kuja kwenu.
Ekegusii: Bono Nyasae Tata oito omonyene, n’Omonene oito Yeso atotang’ane ase enchera yaito, toike seino.

English: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
Kiswahili: Bwana na auongeze upendo wenu na kuuzidisha kati yenu na kwa wengine wote, kama vile tulivyo na upendo mwingi kwenu.
Ekegusii: Omonene abakore momenteke na gokiina ase ogwanchana inwe ase inwe, na ase ogwancha abanto bonsi, buna intwe tobanchete inwe.

English: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
Kiswahili: Tunamwomba Mungu aimarishe mioyo yenu ili msiwe na lawama katika utakatifu mbele za Mungu wetu aliye Baba yetu wakati wa kuja kwake Bwana Yesu pamoja na watakatifu wote.
Ekegusii: Ase igo anyare gokong’ia chinkoro chiaino chibe chitari na komocha, ase obochenu ase obosio bwa Nyasae, Tata oito ekero ki’ogocha kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo amo nabachenu baaye bonsi.

English: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, ndugu, tuliwaomba na kuwasihi katika Bwana Yesu kwamba, kama mlivyojifunza kutoka kwetu jinsi iwapasavyo kuishi ili kumpendeza Mungu, kama vile mnavyoishi, imewapasa mzidi sana kufanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Omoerio, baminto, twababoririe na kobasorora ase Omonene Yeso ng’a buna mweorokereretie korwa ase tore nebagwenerete mogenderere kogwenera Nyasae. Buna inwe mogendererete, kora igo na komenteka.

English: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mnajua ni maagizo gani tuliyowapa kwa mamlaka ya Bwana Yesu.
Ekegusii: Naki momanyete amachiiko ki twabaete korwa ase Omonene Yeso.

English: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,
Kiswahili: Mapenzi ya Mungu ni kwamba ninyi mtakaswe, ili kwamba mjiepushe na zinaa,
Ekegusii: Naki oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ng’a mobe abachenu, na mweatanane korwa ase obotomani.

English: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,
Kiswahili: ili kwamba kila mmoja wenu ajifunze kuutawala mwili wake mwenyewe katika utakatifu na heshima,
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino amanye buna akogambera omobere oye omonyene ase obochenu na ogosika,

English: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,
Kiswahili: si kwa tamaa mbaya kama watu wa Mataifa wasiomjua Mungu.
Ekegusii: tari ase okogania okobe buna abanto b’Ebisaku abatamomanyeti Nyasae.

English: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
Kiswahili: Katika jambo hili mtu asimkosee ndugu yake wala kumlaghai. Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mlipiza kisasi katika mambo haya yote, kama vile tulivyokwisha kuwaambia mapema na kuwaonya vikali.
Ekegusii: Bono onde tamochera oyomwabo na komong’aina ase ring’ana eri, ekiagera Omonene nere okorusia egesiomba ase aya onsi, buna twabamanyetie ritang’ani na kobakuurera bokong’u.

English: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu hakutuitia uchafu, bali utakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tatorangereti tobe ase ogotacheneka, korende ase obochenu.

English: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, mtu yeyote anayekataa mafundisho haya hamkatai mwanadamu, bali anamkataa Mungu anayewapa ninyi Roho wake Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ere oyobwangire aya, tangeti Mwanyabaanto, korende Nyasae, oyokobaa inwe Omoika oye Omochenu.

English: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,
Kiswahili: Sasa kuhusu upendo wa ndugu hamna haja mtu yeyote kuwaandikia, kwa maana ninyi wenyewe mmefundishwa na Mungu kupendana.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana y’obwanchani bw’obomino, tari nengencho ase more ng’a mbariikere, ekiagera inwe abanyene mworokererigwe na Nyasae, ng’a mwanchane inwe ase inwe.

English: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;
Kiswahili: Nanyi kwa kweli mnawapenda ndugu wote katika Makedonia nzima. Lakini ndugu, tunawasihi mzidi sana kuwapenda.
Ekegusii: Naki ekeene, nigo mwanchete abamino bonsi abare Makedonia yonsi. Korende twabasoroire, baminto, momente ayio mono kobua.

English: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,
Kiswahili: Jitahidini kuishi maisha ya utulivu, kila mtu akijishughulisha na mambo yake mwenyewe na kufanya kazi kwa mikono yake, kama vile tulivyowaagiza,
Ekegusii: Naende kora omokia komenya ase obotoereru, na kwenaria ogokora kwaino, na gokora emeremo namaboko aino, buna twabachiigete.

English: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
Kiswahili: ili maisha yenu ya kila siku yajipatie heshima kutoka kwa watu walio nje, ili msimtegemee mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Mogenderere buya, erinde monyore ogosika korwa ase abwo bare isiko, na timoba abamosemeretie gento korwa ase onde.

English: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
Kiswahili: Lakini ndugu, hatutaki mkose kujua kuhusu wale waliolala mauti, ili msihuzunike kama watu wengine wasiokuwa na tumaini.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, titorigeti ng’a timomanya amang’ana igoro y’abwo bararire, mobaise goichanigwa buna abande abatari nogosemeria.

English: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tunaamini kwamba Yesu alikufa na kufufuka, na kwa hivyo, Mungu kwa njia ya Yesu atawafufua pamoja naye wale waliolala mautini ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Naki onye twegenire ng’a Yeso nakwete, naende akaboka, naboigo nabwo bararire ase Yeso, Nyasae nabarente amo nere.

English: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na neno la Bwana mwenyewe, tunawaambia kwamba sisi ambao bado tuko hai, tuliobaki hadi kuja kwake Bwana, hakika hatutawatangulia waliolala mauti.
Ekegusii: Naki aya twabatebirie ase ring’ana ri’Omonene, ng’a intwe abatore moyo, abatwatigaire goika ekero ki’ogocha kw’Omonene, titogotang’anera abwo baikire korara,

English: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Bwana mwenyewe atashuka kutoka mbinguni, akitoa amri kwa sauti kuu, pamoja na sauti ya malaika mkuu, na sauti ya tarumbeta ya Mungu. Nao waliokufa wakiwa katika Kristo watafufuka kwanza.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene omonyene naike korwa igoro neriogi rie ring’ana ri’ogochika amo neriogi ri’omomalaika omonene, na egeturi ki’egetureeri kia Nyasae. Na abwo bakwete ase Kristo nababooke ritang’ani.

English: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.
Kiswahili: Baada ya hilo sisi tulio hai, tuliosalia, tutanyakuliwa pamoja nao katika mawingu ili kumlaki Bwana hewani, hivyo tutakuwa pamoja na Bwana milele.
Ekegusii: Erio magega y’ayio intwe, abatore moyo, abatwatigaire, inatobogorigwe amo nabarabwo gochia ase amare, erio torototere Omonene igoro gati. Nabo inatobe amo n’Omonene botambe.

English: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo farijianeni kwa maneno haya.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, remania inwe ase inwe ase amang’ana aya.

English: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
Kiswahili: Basi, ndugu, kwa habari ya nyakati na majira hatuna haja ya kuwaandikia,
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ebiro ne chingaki, baminto, tari nengencho ase more ng’a mbariikere.

English: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa mnajua vyema kwamba siku ya Bwana itakuja kama mwizi ajapo usiku.
Ekegusii: Naki inwe abanyene mwamanyire buya kegima, ng’a rituko ri’Omonene nigo rirache buna omoibi agocha botuko.

English: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.
Kiswahili: Wakati watu wanaposema, “Kuna amani na salama,” maangamizi huwajia ghafula, kama vile utungu umjiavyo mwanamke mwenye mimba; nao hakika hawatatoroka.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto bagoteeba, “Ntore nomorembe na obotoereru”, erio nario ogosareka gokobaachera mobosokano buna obororo bw’okobina bokomoochera oyore morito, na tibakonyara gwetooria.

English: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
Kiswahili: Bali ninyi, ndugu, hampo gizani hata siku ile iwakute ghafula kama mwizi.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, timori ase omosunte, goika rituko riria riche kobanyoora mobosokano buna omoibi,

English: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
Kiswahili: Ninyi nyote ni wana wa nuru na wana wa mchana. Sisi si wana wa giza wala wa usiku.
Ekegusii: ekiagera inwe mwensi nabana b’oborabu, na abana b’omobaso. Intwe titori abobotuko, gose ab’omosunte.

English: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo basi, tusilale kama watu wengine walalavyo, bali tukeshe na kuwa na kiasi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio titoraara chitoro buna abande bagokora, korende torende na kweriita.

English: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa wote walalao hulala usiku na wale walewao hulewa usiku.
Ekegusii: Naki abwo bakorara chitoro nigo bakorara botuko, na abwo bagotinda nigo bagotinda botuko.

English: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa kuwa sisi ni wana wa mchana, basi tuwe na kiasi, tukijivika imani na upendo kama dirii kifuani na tumaini letu la wokovu kama chapeo.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe abatore ab’omobaso, tobe aberiiti, na tweboyie okwegena na obwanchani buna engobo y’ekioma ase ebikuba biaito, na ogosemeria kw’ogotooreka buna ekegogwa giaito gi’ekioma.

English: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Mungu hakutuita ili tupate ghadhabu bali tupate wokovu kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae tatoragerete endamwamu, korende agatoragera tonyore ogotooreka goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo,

English: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
Kiswahili: Yeye alikufa kwa ajili yetu ili hata kama tuko macho au tumelala, tupate kuishi pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: oyokwete ase engencho yaito, erinde tobe moyo amo nere, kerabe tokorenda, gose tokorara chitoro.

English: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo farijianeni na kujengana, kama vile mnavyofanya sasa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, remania inwe ase inwe, na koagachana, kera omonto noyomwabo, buna mogokora.

English: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
Kiswahili: Sasa tunawaomba, ndugu, waheshimuni wale wanaofanya kazi kwa bidii miongoni mwenu, wale ambao wana mamlaka juu yenu katika Bwana na ambao wanawaonya.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, twabasoroire inwe, mosike abwo bagokora emeremo emekong’u ase egati yaino, abwo bakobaraa ase Omonene na kobakuurera.

English: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
Kiswahili: Waheshimuni sana katika upendo kwa ajili ya kazi zao. Ishini kwa amani ninyi kwa ninyi.
Ekegusii: Mobasike mono ase obwanchani, ase engencho y ’emeremo yabo. Mobe nomorembe inwe ase inwe.

English: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
Kiswahili: Nasi twawasihi, ndugu, waonyeni walio wavivu, watieni moyo waoga, wasaidieni wanyonge na kuwavumilia watu wote.
Ekegusii: Twabasoroire, baminto, mokuurere abwo bare aboro, moremie abwo berusirie moyo, mokonye abwo bare abareu, remereria nabaanto bonsi.

English: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
Kiswahili: Angalieni kuwa mtu asimlipe mwenzake maovu kwa maovu, bali siku zote tafuteni kutendeana mema ninyi kwa ninyi na kwa watu wote.
Ekegusii: Rigereria ng’a onde taakana oyomwabo obobe ase obobe, korende botambe morigie gokorerana ayare amaya inwe ase inwe, na ase abanto bonsi.

English: Always rejoice.
Kiswahili: Furahini siku zote;
Ekegusii: Goka botambe!

English: Pray without ceasing.
Kiswahili: ombeni bila kukoma;
Ekegusii: Saba motari gotiga!

English: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
Kiswahili: shukuruni kwa kila jambo, kwa maana haya ndiyo mapenzi ya Mungu kwa ajili yenu katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase amang’ana onsi! Naki oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase more ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Don’t quench the Spirit.
Kiswahili: Msiuzime moto wa Roho Mtakatifu;
Ekegusii: Timorimia Omoika!

English: Don’t despise prophecies.
Kiswahili: msiyadharau maneno ya unabii.
Ekegusii: Timochaaya obobani,

English: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
Kiswahili: Jaribuni kila kitu. Yashikeni yaliyo mema.
Ekegusii: korende teema kera egento, bwata ekere ekiya,

English: Abstain from every form of evil.
Kiswahili: Jiepusheni na uovu wa kila namna.
Ekegusii: na eatanane korwa ase obobe bwa kera engencho.

English: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Mungu mwenyewe, Mungu wa amani, awatakase ninyi kabisa. Nanyi mhifadhiwe roho zenu, nafsi zenu na miili yenu, bila kuwa na lawama katika Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Nyasae omonyene omorembe abachene kegima, na inwe abanyene morendwe ase emeika, na emioyo, na emebere, na mobe motari na komocha ekero ki’ogocha kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
Kiswahili: Yeye aliyewaita ni mwaminifu naye atafanya hayo.
Ekegusii: Ere oyobarangeirie nomwegenwa, nakore ayio.

English: Brothers, pray for us.
Kiswahili: Ndugu, tuombeeni.
Ekegusii: Baminto, motosabere!

English: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni ndugu wote kwa busu takatifu.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie abaminto bonsi ase okobanyunyunta ase obochenu.

English: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
Kiswahili: Nawaagizeni mbele za Bwana mhakikishe kuwa ndugu wote wanasomewa barua hii.
Ekegusii: Nabatianirie ase Omonene, ng’a riruube eri risomwe ase abaminto bonsi.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
Kiswahili: Neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obuya bwo Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.

English: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
Kiswahili: Paulo, Silvano na Timotheo: Kwa kanisa la Wathesalonike mlio katika Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu Kristo:
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Paulo amo na Silivano na Timotheo gochia ase abanto b’ekanisa y’Atesaloniki, abamore ase Nyasae Tata oito n’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo:

English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba na Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,
Kiswahili: Ndugu, imetubidi kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu siku zote, kama ulivyo wajibu wetu, kwa sababu imani yenu inakua zaidi na zaidi na upendo wa kila mmoja wenu alio nao kwa mwenzake unazidi kuongezeka.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, netogwenerete komoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono botambe ase engencho yaino, buna ere boronge, ekiagera okwegena kwaino gwakiinire mono, na obwanchani bwa kera oyomo oino ase oyonde nigo bogendererete komentekana.

English: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
Kiswahili: Ndiyo sababu miongoni mwa makanisa ya Mungu, tunajivuna kuhusu saburi yenu na imani mliyo nayo katika mateso yote na dhiki mnazostahimili.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, na intwe abanyene nigo togwetogia ase engencho yaino ase chikanisa chia Nyasae, ase engencho y’oboremereria bwaino, na okwegena more nakwo ase ogochandwa kwaino gwonsi, na emechando eye moremereretie.

English: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.
Kiswahili: Haya yote ni uthibitisho kwamba hukumu ya Mungu ni ya haki, na kwa sababu hiyo ninyi mtahesabiwa kwamba mnastahili kuwa wa Ufalme wa Mungu, mnaoteswa kwa ajili wake.
Ekegusii: Eke nakio ekiorokererio, ng’a ekiina kia Nyasae mboronge kere. Erio mobarwe koba abamwagweneire oborwoti bwa Nyasae, ekiagera ase engencho y’obwo mwachandirwe.

English: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
Kiswahili: Mungu ni mwenye haki: yeye atawalipa mateso wale wawatesao ninyi
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae ororire boronge kobaakana emechando baria bakobachanda inwe,

English: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
Kiswahili: na kuwapa ninyi mnaoteseka raha pamoja na sisi, wakati Bwana Yesu atakapodhihirishwa kutoka mbinguni katika mwali wa moto pamoja na malaika wake wenye nguvu.
Ekegusii: na kobaa inwe abamwachandirwe ogotimokigwa amo naintwe. Aya nigo arakoreke ekero Omonene Yeso agocha koorokigwa korwa igoro amo nabamalaika n’okobua kwaye ase ekebemberi ki’omorero,

English: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
Kiswahili: Atawaadhibu wale wasiomjua Mungu na ambao hawakuitii Injili ya Bwana wetu Yesu.
Ekegusii: na kobaakana egesiomba abwo batamomanyeti Nyasae, na bataigwereti enchiri y’Omonene oito Yeso.

English: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
Kiswahili: Wataadhibiwa kwa uangamivu wa milele na kutengwa na uso wa Bwana na utukufu wa uweza wake,
Ekegusii: Barabwo nabanyore egesusuro ki’ogosareka, naende nabaatananwe korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene kare na kare, na korwa ase obonene bw’okobua kwaye,

English: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
Kiswahili: siku hiyo atakapokuja kutukuzwa katika watakatifu wake na kustaajabiwa miongoni mwa wote walioamini. Ninyi pia mtakuwa miongoni mwa hawa kwa sababu mliamini ushuhuda wetu kwenu.
Ekegusii: ekero arache ase rituko riria, erinde atogigwe ase egati y’abachenu baye, na gokumigwa ase egati ya bonsi abamwegenire, ekiagera mwegenire oborori bwaito obo twabarenteire.

English: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, tunawaombea ninyi bila kukoma, ili Mungu apate kuwahesabu kuwa mnastahili wito wake na kwamba kwa uwezo wake apate kutimiza kila kusudi lenu jema na kila tendo linaloongozwa na imani yenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo tokobasabera botambe, erio Nyasae oito ababare ng’a mwagweneire okorangeria kwaye. Ere aikeranie kera okogania kw’obuya, na kera emeremo y’okwegena, ase okobua kwaye,

English: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Tunaomba hivi ili Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu lipate kutukuzwa ndani yenu, nanyi ndani yake, kulingana na neema ya Mungu wetu na Bwana Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: erinde erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso ritogigwe ime yaino, na inwe ime yaye, koreng’ana nobuya bwa Nyasae oito, na Omonene Yeso Kristo.

English: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you
Kiswahili: Ndugu, kuhusu kuja kwake Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo na kukusanyika kwetu pamoja mbele zake, tunawasihi,
Ekegusii: Bono baminto, ase amang’ana y’ogocha kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, na ogosangererekana gwaito ase obosio bwaye, twababoririe,

English: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
Kiswahili: msiyumbishwe kwa urahisi wala msitiwe wasiwasi na roho wala neno au barua inayosemekana kuwa imetoka kwetu, isemayo kwamba siku ya Bwana imekwisha kuwako.
Ekegusii: timotengechigwa bwango na gotiga ebirengererio biaino, gose timoichanigwa na moika onde, gose namang’ana, gose ne riruube rigokagwa ng’a nkorwa ase tore riarure, erigoteeba ng’a rituko ri’Omonene riaikire kobao.

English: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote na asiwadanganye kwa namna yoyote kwa maana siku ile haitakuja mpaka uasi utokee kwanza, na yule mtu wa kuasi adhihirishwe, yule ambaye amehukumiwa kuangamizwa kabisa.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tabang’aina ase enchera ende yonsi, ekiagera rituko riria tirigocha ogwatananekana na ogotaigwera gotaracha, na omosaria bw’amachiiko, omwana bw’obosiru, aorokigwe.

English: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
Kiswahili: Yeye atapingana na kujitukuza juu ya kila kitu kiitwacho Mungu au kinachoabudiwa, ili kujiweka juu katika Hekalu la Mungu, akijitangaza mwenyewe kuwa ndiye Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ere nomoengereria, omweimokereria igoro omonyene, igoro ya kera egekorokwa Nyasae, na ekegosasimwa. Naende nigo agoikaransa ase Hekalu ya Nyasae, okweraria omonyene ng’a nere Nyasae.

English: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?
Kiswahili: Je, hamkumbuki ya kwamba nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi niliwaambia mambo haya?
Ekegusii: Inee! Timware koinyora ng’a ekero narenge amo nainwe inabateebeetie ayio?

English: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
Kiswahili: Nanyi sasa mnajua kinachomzuia, ili apate kudhihirishwa wakati wake utakapowadia.
Ekegusii: Na bono, erimotangete morimanyete, erio ekero engaki yaye eraike anyare koorokigwa.

English: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
Kiswahili: Maana ile nguvu ya siri ya uasi tayari inatenda kazi, lakini yule anayeizuia ataendelea kufanya hivyo mpaka atakapoondolewa.
Ekegusii: Naki obobisi boria bw’ogosaria amachiiko bwachaakire gokora emeremo bono, na oria ore kobotanga bono goika arusigweo.

English: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
Kiswahili: Hapo ndipo yule mwasi atafunuliwa, ambaye Bwana Yesu atamteketeza kwa pumzi ya kinywa chake na kumwangamiza kabisa kwa utukufu wa kuja kwake.
Ekegusii: Erio agwo omosaria oria bw’amachiiko aorokigwe, n’Omonene Yeso namoite n’Omoika bw’omonwa oye, na komosiria ase amasase ’okoorokigwa kwaye.

English: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
Kiswahili: Kuja kwa yule mwasi kutaonekana kana kwamba ni kutenda kazi kwake Shetani ambaye hutumia nguvu zote, ishara, maajabu ya uongo,
Ekegusii: Ogocha kw’omosaria oria nigo kore ogokora gwa Saitani, naende nkobe nokobua gwonsi, na ebikone, na amakumia y’oborimo,

English: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
Kiswahili: na kila aina ya uovu kwa wale wanaoangamia kwa sababu walikataa kuipenda kweli wapate kuokolewa.
Ekegusii: na ase obong’ainereria bwonsi bw’ogotaba boronge ase abwo bagosira, ekiagera bangete konyora ekeene, na kogiancha erinde banyare gotoorigwa.

English: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, Mungu ameruhusu watawaliwe na nguvu ya udanganyifu, ili waendelee kuamini uongo,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae nabatomere obotantanu bw’echinguru, abakore begene ayare ay’oborimo,

English: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
Kiswahili: na wahukumiwe wote ambao hawakuiamini ile kweli, bali wamefurahia uovu.
Ekegusii: erinde bagambigwe bonsi abwo bateegenete ekeene, korende baare kwegokia ase ayatari ay’oboronge.

English: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
Kiswahili: Lakini imetupasa sisi kumshukuru Mungu daima kwa ajili yenu, ndugu mpendwao na Bwana, kwa sababu Mungu aliwachagua ninyi tangu mwanzo ili mwokolewe kwa kutakaswa na Roho kwa kuiamini kweli.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, netogwenerete koiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono botambe ase engencho yaino, inwe abamwanchire n’Omonene, ekiagera Nyasae abachorete korwa omochakano, erinde monyore ogotooreka ase ogochenwa kogokorwa n’Omoika, na kwegena ekeene.

English: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa kusudi hili Mungu aliwaita kwa njia ya kuhubiri kwetu Injili, ili mpate kushiriki katika utukufu wa Bwana Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ase aya naro abarangereretie inwe goetera ase enchiri eye twabaranderetie, erinde monyore obonene bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
Kiswahili: Hivyo basi, ndugu wapendwa, simameni imara na myashike sana yale mafundisho tuliyowapa ikiwa ni kwa maneno ya kinywa au kwa barua.
