Ekegusii: Ase igo baminto, tenena bokong’u, na mobwate chingencho echio twaborokereretie, onye nase amang’ana y’emenwa yaito, gose nase riruube riaito.

English: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
Kiswahili: Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo mwenyewe na Mungu Baba yetu, aliyetupenda na kwa neema yake akatupatia faraja ya milele na tumaini jema,
Ekegusii: Bono Omonene oito Yeso Kristo omonyene, na Nyasae Tata oito, oyotwanchete na otoete okoremia gwa kare na kare, na ogosemeria okuya ase obuya bwaye,

English: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
Kiswahili: awafariji mioyo yenu na kuwaimarisha katika kila neno na tendo jema.
Ekegusii: aremie chinkoro chiaino, na abakong’ie mokore ayare boronge ase kera ogokora okuya, na amang’ana amaya.

English: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, ndugu, tuombeeni ili Neno la Bwana lipate kuenea kwa haraka na kuheshimiwa kila mahali, kama vile ilivyokuwa kwenu.
Ekegusii: Omoerio, baminto, tosabere erinde ring’ana ri’Omonene rirande na gotogigwa buna riakorire ase egati yaino,

English: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
Kiswahili: Ombeni pia ili tupate kuokolewa kutokana na watu waovu na wabaya, kwa maana si wote wanaoamini.
Ekegusii: ng’a totoorigwe korwa ase abanto batari abaronge, na abare ababe, ekiagera tai bonsi bare nokwegena.

English: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana ni mwaminifu, naye atawaimarisha ninyi na kuwalinda kutokana na yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene nomwegenwa, nere orababeeke chinguru na kobarenda korwa ase oria omobe.

English: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
Kiswahili: Nasi tuna tumaini katika Bwana ya kuwa mnafanya na mtaendelea kufanya yale tuliyowaagiza.
Ekegusii: Ase Omonene ntore nogosemeria igoro yaino, ng’a ngokora more ayatwabachiigete, naende mogenderere koyakora.

English: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.
Kiswahili: Bwana aiongoze mioyo yenu katika upendo wa Mungu na katika saburi ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Omonene atang’ane chinkoro chiaino, erinde momanye obwanchani bwa Nyasae, na oboremereria bwa Kristo.

English: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.
Kiswahili: Ndugu, tunawaagiza katika Jina la Bwana Yesu Kristo, jitengeni na kila ndugu ambaye ni mvivu na ambaye haishi kufuatana na maagizo tuliyowapa.
Ekegusii: Bono baminto, twabachikiire ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso Kristo, mweatanane korwa ase oyomino oyore omworo, oyotabwateti chingencho echio mweorokereretie korwa ase tore.

English: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
Kiswahili: Maana ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi iwapasavyo kufuata mfano wetu. Sisi hatukuwa wavivu tulipokuwa pamoja nanyi,
Ekegusii: Naki inwe abanyene momanyete buna ebagwenerete motwege; titwabeete aboro ekero twarenge amo nainwe,

English: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.
Kiswahili: wala hatukula chakula cha mtu yeyote pasipo kukilipia. Badala yake tulifanya kazi kwa bidii usiku na mchana, ili tusimlemee mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: gose titwariete endagera ya monto onde bwensi bosa, totaakaneti, korende nase obokong’u amo nogwechanda togakora emeremo obotuko na omobaso, erinde titoraarereria monto onde oino.

English: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
Kiswahili: Tulifanya hivi, si kwa sababu hatukuwa na haki ya kupata msaada kama huo, bali ndio sisi wenyewe tuwe kielelezo.
Ekegusii: Tari ng’a eyio tiyatotungetie, korende igo twekorete abanyene koba ekiorokererio ekiya ase more, erinde motwege.

English: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hata tulipokuwa pamoja nanyi, tuliwapa amri kwamba: “Mtu yeyote asiyetaka kufanya kazi, hata kula asile.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera nonya nekero keria twarenge amo nainwe ntwabachiigete ring’ana eri, ng’a onye omonto tarigeti gokora emeremo, taegwa endagera.

English: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tunasikia kwamba baadhi ya watu miongoni mwenu ni wavivu. Hawafanyi kazi bali hujishughulisha na mambo ya wengine.
Ekegusii: Naki twaigure ng’a mbare abanto ase more bare aboro, batari gokora emeremo, korende nigo bakona‐gotuka amang’ana y’abaanto bande.

English: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
Kiswahili: Basi watu kama hao tunawaagiza na kuwahimiza katika Bwana Yesu Kristo, kwamba wafanye kazi kwa utulivu kwa ajili ya chakula chao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Nabo abanto banga buna abwo twabachikiire na kobasorora ase Omonene Yeso Kristo, ng’a bakore emeremo ase obotoereru, na koria endagera yabo abanyene.

English: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande wenu, ndugu, ninyi kamwe msichoke katika kutenda mema.
Ekegusii: Korende baminto, timorosa gokora amaya.

English: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu yeyote hayatii maagizo yetu yaliyoko katika barua hii, mwangalieni sana mtu huyo. Msishirikiane naye, ili apate kuona aibu.
Ekegusii: Onye monto onde bwensi okwanga koigwera ring’ana eri tokwanete ase riruube eri, erusananie korwa ase omonto oyio, na timosanga nere; tiga arore obosooku.

English: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
Kiswahili: Lakini msimhesabu kuwa adui, bali mwonyeni kama ndugu.
Ekegusii: Timomobara buna omobisa, korende momokuurere buna oyomino.

English: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
Kiswahili: Basi, Bwana wa amani mwenyewe awapeni amani nyakati zote na kwa kila njia. Bwana awe nanyi nyote.
Ekegusii: Bono Omonene bw’omorembe omonyene abae omorembe ase chingaki chionsi, na ase chinchera chionsi. Omonene abe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.
Kiswahili: Mimi, Paulo, ninaandika salamu hizi kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe. Hii ndio alama ya utambulisho katika barua zangu zote. Hivi ndivyo niandikavyo.
Ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane inche Paulo ase okoboko kwane omonyene. Eke nakio ekemanyerio ase kera riruube riane; naboigo nkoriika.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Kiswahili: Neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi nyote. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,
Kiswahili: Paulo, mtume wa Kristo Yesu kwa amri ya Mungu Mwokozi wetu na ya Kristo Yesu tumaini letu.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogochika kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito, na Kristo Yeso, ogosemeria gwaito,

English: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
Kiswahili: Kwa Timotheo, mwanangu halisi katika imani: Neema, rehema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba na kwa Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu.
Ekegusii: gochia ase aye Timotheo, omwana one bori ase okwegena: Obuya na amaabera, na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.

English: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
Kiswahili: Kama nilivyokusihi wakati nilipokwenda Makedonia, endelea kubaki Efeso, ili kwamba upate kuwaagiza watu wasiendelee kufundisha mafundisho ya uongo
Ekegusii: Buna nakoboretie ekero nare kogenda Makedonia, otigare Efeso, erinde okanie abande tiborokereria okworokereria konde okoao,

English: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.
Kiswahili: wala wasitoe muda wao kwa hadithi za kubuniwa na orodha za majina ya vizazi visivyo na mwisho, ambazo huchochea mabishano badala ya mpango wa Mungu utokanao na imani.
Ekegusii: gose tibategerera emegano ao ao, gose ebinimboria bie chisokoro bitakoera. Ayio onsi nigo akorenta okoamererania, gose tari goikerania emeroberio ya Nyasae eyio emanyekanete ase okwegena.

English: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,
Kiswahili: Kusudi la maagizo haya ni upendo utokao katika moyo safi, dhamiri njema na imani ya kweli.
Ekegusii: Bono ekerenga ki’ogochika oko nakio eke, ng’a babe nobwanehani bokorwa ase chinkoro chindabu, ne chinkoro chitari kobagaambia, na okwegena gotari nobong’ainereria.

English: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,
Kiswahili: Watu wengine wamepotoka kutoka haya na kugeukia majadiliano yasiyo na maana kwa kuwa,
Ekegusii: Abande bamochete ayio, batantanire na koonchokera ogokwana kwa bosa.

English: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.
Kiswahili: wanataka kuwa walimu wa sheria, lakini hawajui mambo yale wanayosema wala hayo wanayoyatumainia kwa uthabiti.
Ekegusii: Naende nigo banchete koba aborokia b’amachiiko, korende tibamanyeti ayabagokwana, gose amang’ana aria bakomigereria ne chinguru.

English: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,
Kiswahili: Tunajua kwamba sheria ni njema ikiwa inatumika kwa halali kama ilivyokusudiwa.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a amachiiko namaya, onye omonto okoyakorera buna agwenerete gokorerwa,

English: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
Kiswahili: Lakini tunajua ya kuwa sheria si kwa ajili ya wenye haki, bali kwa ajili ya wavunja sheria na waasi, kwa ajili ya wasiomcha Mungu na wenye dhambi, wasio watakatifu na wanaokufuru; kwa wale wawauao baba zao au mama zao, kwa wauaji,
Ekegusii: na omanyete ng’a amachiiko tabekiri ase omonto omooronge. Korende nigo abekire ase abasaria ba amachiiko, na abatari koigwera, ase abatari aba Nyasae, na abanyabibe, ase abatari abachenu, baria bare b’ense eye, ase abaiti abaise gose abang’ina, na abaiti bande,

English: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,
Kiswahili: kwa wazinzi na wahanithi, kwa wale wauzao watu, na kwa waongo na waapao kwa uongo, na kwa chochote kingine kilicho kinyume na mafundisho ya kweli,
Ekegusii: ase abatomani, na abasacha abagwesaria ase abasacha, ase abakoiba abanto na kobaonia, ase abanyaborimo, na abakoria chimuma chi’oborimo. Na korir’abe ing’ana rinde rionsi ritabwataini nokworokereria kw’obogima,

English: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
Kiswahili: ambayo yanakubaliana na Injili ya utukufu wa Mungu anayehimidiwa, ambayo mimi nimewekewa amana.
Ekegusii: koreng’ana nenchiri y’obonene bwa Nyasae, oyore ogosesenigwa okonene, eye inche negenirwe koyeraria.

English: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,
Kiswahili: Namshukuru Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu, aliyenitia nguvu, kwa sababu aliniona mwaminifu, akaniteua kwa kazi yake.
Ekegusii: Namoakeire Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito, oyombeegete chinguru, ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera andoche ng’a nigo inde omwegenwa. Akambeeka ase obosomba bwaye,

English: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
Kiswahili: Ingawa wakati fulani nilikuwa mwenye kukufuru, mtesaji na mwenye jeuri, lakini nilipata rehema kwa sababu nilitenda hivyo kwa kutojua na kutoamini kwangu.
Ekegusii: nonya ritang’ani nareenge komorama na komochaanda, naboigo, nareenge omochege. Korende ere akandorera amaabera, ekiagera nakorete bo ase ogotamanya, na ase ogotegena,

English: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Neema ya Bwana wetu ilimiminwa juu yangu kwa wingi, ikiambatana na imani na upendo ulio katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: na obuya bwo Omonene oito bwamentekanire mono amo nokwegena na obwanchani ebire ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
Kiswahili: Msemo huu ni wa kweli na unaostahili kukubalika, usemao kwamba: Kristo Yesu alikuja ulimwenguni kuokoa wenye dhambi, ambao mimi ndiye niliye mbaya kuliko wote.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene, rigwenerete gwancherwa kegima, ng’a Kristo Yeso nigo achete ase ense gotooria abanyene ebibe, na ase abwo inche noyo bw’eritang’ani.

English: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu hiyo nilipata rehema, ili katika mimi, niliyekuwa mwenye dhambi kuliko wote, Kristo Yesu apate kuonyesha uvumilivu wake usio na kikomo, ili niwe kielelezo kwa wale watakaomwamini na wapate uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Korende nkanyora amaabera ase engencho eyio, ng’a ase ’nde inche ritang’ani Yeso Kristo aorokie oboremereria bwaye bwonsi, erio imbe ekiorokererio ase abwo baraache komwegena ase okonyora obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Basi Mfalme wa milele, asiye na mwisho, asiyeonekana, aliye Mungu pekee, apewe heshima na utukufu milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: Ase Omorwoti o kare na kare, oyotakonyorekana nogosareka, oyotakororekana, nere Nyasae bweka, ase are ere ogosika na obonene kare na kare. Amina.

English: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,
Kiswahili: Mwanangu Timotheo, ninakupa agizo hili, kwa kadiri ya maneno ya unabii yaliyosemwa kukuhusu, ili kwa kuyafuata upate kupigana vita vizuri,
Ekegusii: Timotheo, omwana one, ogochika oko nakoeire, koreng’ana namang’ana y’obobani akwanetwe igoro yao, erinde ase ayio orwane esegi ere engiya.

English: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
Kiswahili: ukiishikilia imani na dhamiri njema, ambazo wengine wamevikataa, na hivyo wakaangamia kwa habari ya imani yao.
Ekegusii: Obe nokwegena na enkoro etari gokogaambia, ebio abande babisereirie are, na ase amang’ana y’okwegena basirire.

English: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwao wako Himenayo na Aleksanda, ambao nimemkabidhi Shetani ili wafundishwe wasije wakakufuru.
Ekegusii: Ase abwo mbareo Humenayo na Alekisanda, abwo nabaeire Saitani, erinde borokererigwe tibarama Nyasae.

English: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,
Kiswahili: Awali ya yote, nasihi kwamba dua, sala, maombezi na shukrani zifanyike kwa ajili ya watu wote:
Ekegusii: Gaaki, ritang’ani ase amang’ana onsi nabasoroire ng’a okoboria, na ogosaba, na okogaramera amo nokoiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, bikoreke ase engencho y’abanto bonsi,

English: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
Kiswahili: kwa ajili ya wafalme na wale wote wenye mamlaka, ili tupate kuishi kwa amani na utulivu, katika uchaji wote wa Mungu na utakatifu.
Ekegusii: ase engencho y’abarwoti, na bonsi abaeire okobua, erinde tonyaare koba nobogima bw’oboitongo na obw’omorembe, na ase amang’ana onsi koba ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, na echi’ogosikana.

English: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
Kiswahili: Jambo hili ni jema, tena linapendeza machoni pa Mungu Mwokozi wetu,
Ekegusii: Eri nerigiya, naende ndiancheire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito,

English: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
Kiswahili: anayetaka watu wote waokolewe na wafikie kuijua kweli.
Ekegusii: oyorigetie abanto bonsi batoorigwe, banyaare komanya onsi ayare ay’ekeene.

English: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kuna Mungu mmoja na mpatanishi mmoja kati ya Mungu na wanadamu, yaani mwanadamu Kristo Yesu,
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae noyoomo, na omobwatania gati ya Nyasae na Mwanyabaanto noyoomo, omonto oria Kristo Yeso

English: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,
Kiswahili: aliyejitoa mwenyewe kuwa fidia kwa ajili ya wanadamu wote: jambo hili lilishuhudiwa kwa wakati wake ufaao.
Ekegusii: ere oyobweruete omonyene koba embooria ase engencho ya bonsi. Igoro y’ayio oborori borentwe ekero engaki yaye eraike.

English: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
Kiswahili: Nami kwa kusudi hili nimewekwa niwe mhubiri na mtume (nasema kweli katika Kristo wala sisemi uongo), mwalimu wa watu wa Mataifa katika imani na kweli.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio nkaragwa imbe omworokia, na omotomwa, erinde inyorokie abanto b’Ebisaku amang’ana y’okwegena na ekeene; nigo ngokwana ekeene, tindi gokwana oborimo.

English: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
Kiswahili: Nataka kila mahali wanaume wasali wakiinua mikono mitakatifu pasipo hasira wala kugombana.
Ekegusii: Nigo nganetie abasacha basabe kera aase, bakoimokia amaboko amachenu, batari nendamwamu, gose na tang’u‐tang’u.

English: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo nataka wanawake wajipambe kwa adabu na kwa heshima katika mavazi yanayostahili, si kwa kusuka nywele, kuvalia dhahabu, lulu au mavazi ya gharama kubwa,
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabakungu beboyie chianga chi’ogosika, babe aberiiti na abaya, tari abakomina chituukia, gose kobeeka etaabu ne chiruuru, gose chianga chie rigori rinene,

English: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.
Kiswahili: bali kwa matendo mazuri kama iwapasavyo wanawake wanaokiri kuwa wanamcha Mungu.
Ekegusii: korende bakore ogokora okuya, buna egwenerete abakungu abakoorokia ng’a mbare ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae.

English: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke na ajifunze kwa utulivu na kwa utiifu wote.
Ekegusii: Tiga omokungu eorokererie ase ogokira, na ase ogosika gwonsi.

English: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
Kiswahili: Simpi mwanamke ruhusa ya kufundisha au kuwa na mamlaka juu ya mwanaume. Mwanamke inampasa kukaa kimya.
Ekegusii: Ting’eti omokungu ribaga ri’okworokereria, gose kogaambera omosacha, korende nemogwenerete akire,

English: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Adamu aliumbwa kwanza, kisha Eva.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Adamu nere otongetwe ritang’ani, na magega yaye Hawa.

English: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
Kiswahili: Wala si Adamu aliyedanganywa, bali ni mwanamke aliyedanganywa akawa mkosaji.
Ekegusii: Na Adamu tang’ainetwe, korende nomokuungu ong’ainetwe, na igo akaba omomochi.

English: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwanamke ataokolewa kwa kuzaa kwake, kama wakiendelea kudumu katika imani, upendo na utakatifu, pamoja na kuwa na kiasi.
Ekegusii: Korende omokungu natoorigwe goetera ase okoibora abana onye okogeenderera ase okwegena, na obwanchani, na obochenu amo nobweriiti.

English: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.
Kiswahili: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa, kwamba mtu akitamani kazi ya uangalizi, atamani kazi nzuri.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene, onye omonto origetie koba omotang’ani bw’ekanisa, igo aganetie emeremo emiya.

English: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;
Kiswahili: Basi, imempasa mwangalizi awe mtu asiye na lawama, mume wa mke mmoja, mwenye kiasi, anayejitawala, anayeheshimika, mkarimu, ajuaye kufundisha,
Ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’ekanisa nemogwenerete abe omonto otari gokwanwa bobe, omonto ore nomokuungu oyomo, omweriiti, na omwechiiki omwegaamberi ase onsi, abe, omooroisia abageni, na oy’omanyete kworokereria buya,

English: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
Kiswahili: asiwe mlevi, wala mkali bali awe mpole, asiwe mgomvi wala mpenda fedha.
Ekegusii: tari omonto onarete edivai, gose omonto bwanchete goaka abanto, abe omonto omoremereria, otari gwancha eriomana, gose otari omwegimeria.

English: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
Kiswahili: Lazima aweze kuisimamia nyumba yake mwenyewe vizuri na kuhakikisha kwamba watoto wake wanamtii na kuwa na heshima kwa kila njia.
Ekegusii: Naende nemogwenerete abe omonto omanyete kogambera enyomba yaye omonyene buya, na kworokereria abana baye baigwere ase ogosika gwonsi,

English: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)
Kiswahili: (Kwa maana kama mtu hajui jinsi ya kusimamia nyumba yake mwenyewe, atawezaje kuliangalia kanisa la Mungu?)
Ekegusii: ekiagera onye omonto tamanyeti gotenenera enyomba yaye omonyene, inaki aranyare korenda ekanisa ya Nyasae?

English: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
Kiswahili: Asiwe mtu aliyeokoka karibuni asije akajivuna na kuangukia kwenye hukumu ile ile ya ibilisi.
Ekegusii: Ere taaba omonto oonchoka reero iga, abaise goocha koenena na kogwa ase okogaambigwa gwa Saitani.

English: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
Kiswahili: Inampasa pia awe na sifa njema kwa watu walio nje, ili asije akalaumiwa na kuanguka kwenye mtego wa ibilisi.
Ekegusii: Nagwenerete gwatorwa ng’a nomuya nabaanto bare isiko, erinde tabaisa kogwa ase ogosoerwa, na ase omoeto o Saitani.

English: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, mashemasi nao wawe watu wanaostahili heshima, wasiwe wenye kauli mbili au wenye kujifurahisha kwa mvinyo, wala wanaotamani faida isiyo halali.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabakoonyi b’ekanisa babe abanto bateneneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, batari nemenwa ebere, abanto batari konywa edivai enyinge, abanto batari gwancha okonyora kw’oborianania.

English: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
Kiswahili: Inawapasa kushikamana sana na ile siri ya imani kwa dhamiri safi.
Ekegusii: Mbagwenerete babwate obobisi bw’okwegena ase chinkoro chitakobagaambia.

English: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
Kiswahili: Ni lazima wapimwe kwanza; kisha kama hakuna neno dhidi yao, basi na waruhusiwe kuhudumu kama mashemasi.
Ekegusii: Barabwo boigo barengwe ritang’ani: onye bakonyorekana ng’a tibari ne chingeencho chimbe, erio baegwe emeremo y’obokonyi ase ekanisa.

English: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, wake zao wawe wanawake wanaostahili heshima, wasio wasingiziaji, bali wawe na kiasi na waaminifu katika kila jambo.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nabakungu babo bateneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, tari abang’achi, babe aberiiti na abegenwa ase amang’ana onsi.

English: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
Kiswahili: Shemasi awe mume wa mke mmoja na inampasa aweze kusimamia watoto wake na watu wa nyumbani mwake vyema.
Ekegusii: Omokonyi bw’ekanisa abe omonto ore nomokuungu oyomo, omanyete kogaambera abana baye buya, nenyomba yaye omonyene.

English: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Wale ambao wamehudumu vyema katika huduma ya ushemasi hujipatia msimamo bora na ujasiri mkubwa katika imani yao ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Inaki abwo bagokora emeremo yabo y’obokonyi buya benyoreire amasikani na oboremu obonge ase okwegena kore ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,
Kiswahili: Ingawa ninatarajia kuja kwako hivi karibuni, ninakuandikia maagizo haya sasa ili kwamba,
Ekegusii: Nigo nakoriikeire amang’ana aya, inde nogosemeria ng’a ninchiche ase ore bwango.

English: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
Kiswahili: kama nikikawia, utajua jinsi iwapasavyo watu kuenenda katika nyumba ya Mungu, ambayo ndiyo kanisa la Mungu aliye hai, lililo nguzo na msingi wa kweli.
Ekegusii: Korende inse goteebana, erio omanye buna abanto bagwenerete kogeenderera ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ey’ere ekanisa ya Nyasae ore moyo, naende ere esiiro na oboroso ebire bi’ekeene.

English: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.
Kiswahili: Bila shaka yoyote, siri ya utauwa ni kubwa: Alidhihirishwa katika mwili wa kibinadamu, akathibitishwa kuwa na haki katika Roho, akaonekana na malaika, akahubiriwa miongoni mwa mataifa, akaaminiwa ulimwenguni, akachukuliwa juu katika utukufu.
Ekegusii: Naende ne ring’ana ritari koamereranigwa, ng’a obobisi bwe chingencho chi’obonyasae nobonene: Ere oyoorogetigwe ase omobere o Mwanyabaanto, akaorokigwa n’Omoika koba omonyene oboronge, akarorwa nabamalaika, akarandigwa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, akegenwa ase ense, naende akabogorigwa gochia igoro.

English: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,
Kiswahili: Roho asema waziwazi kwamba katika siku za mwisho baadhi ya watu wataiacha imani na kufuata roho zidanganyazo na mafundisho ya mashetani.
Ekegusii: Omoika okwanire ase amang’ana akoigweka boronge, ng’a ase ekero ki’omoerio abanto bande mbeatanane korwa ase okwegena ase okoigwera emeika y’obong’ainereria na amorokererio y’ebirecha,

English: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
Kiswahili: Mafundisho kama hayo huja kupitia kwa waongo ambao ni wanafiki, hali dhamiri zao zikiungua kwa kuchomwa moto.
Ekegusii: ase obong’ainereria bw’abaanto abanyaborimo, abwo chinkoro chiabo chiasambirwe, chitari koigwa kende.

English: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
Kiswahili: Wao huwakataza watu wasioe na kuwaagiza wajiepushe na vyakula fulani, ambavyo Mungu aliviumba ili vipokewe kwa shukrani na wale wanaoamini na kuijua kweli.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagokaania abanto ng’a tibanyuomana, naende tibaria endagera eye Nyasae atongete, erinde baria begenire, na baikire komanya ekeene, bayenyore ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

English: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila kitu alichokiumba Mungu ni chema, wala hakuna kitu chochote cha kukataliwa kama kikipokewa kwa shukrani,
Ekegusii: Kera egento egiatongetwe na Nyasae nekiya na tikegwenereti kwangwa, korende, nkegwenerete konyorwa amo nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono,

English: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu kimetakaswa kwa neno la Mungu na kwa kuomba.
Ekegusii: ekiagera giachenirwe ne ring’ana ria Nyasae na ogosaba.

English: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.
Kiswahili: Kama ukiwakumbusha ndugu mambo haya, utakuwa mtumishi mwema wa Kristo Yesu, uliyelelewa katika kweli ya imani na yale mafundisho mazuri uliyoyafuata.
Ekegusii: Koroorokererie abaminto ayio, nobe omosomba omuya o Kristo Yeso, obe oyokwerageria namang’ana y’okwegena na okworokererigwa okuya koria gwatunyanete.

English: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
Kiswahili: Usijishughulishe kamwe na hadithi za kipagani na masimulizi ya uongo ya wanawake wazee; badala yake, jizoeze kuwa mtauwa.
Ekegusii: Korende bwange emegano etari ne chingencho chi’obonyasae eyio yanchire nabakungu abagotu. Bwenarie aye omonyene chingeencho chi’obonyasae.

English: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mazoezi ya mwili yana faida kwa sehemu, lakini utauwa una faida katika mambo yote, yaani, unayo ahadi ya uzima wa sasa na ya ule ujao.
Ekegusii: Inaki okwenaria kw’omobere nokonyora ogoke, korende okwenaria gwe chingencho chi’obonyasae nokonyora ase amang’ana onsi, ekiagera nkore neira ase obogima bwa bono, na ase boria bogochia‐gocha.

English: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.
Kiswahili: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa tena lastahili kukubaliwa kabisa,
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene, rigwenerete gwancherwa kegima.

English: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
Kiswahili: (nasi kwa ajili ya hili tunajitaabisha na kujitahidi), kwamba tumeweka tumaini letu kwa Mungu aliye hai, ambaye ni Mwokozi wa watu wote, hasa wale waaminio.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase ring’ana erio nigo togokora emeremo ase ogwechaanda, ekiagera tomoseemeretie Nyasae ore moyo, ere oyore Omotooria bw’abaanto bonsi, mono abwo begenire.

English: Command and teach these things.
Kiswahili: Mambo haya yaagize na kuyafundisha.
Ekegusii: Obachiike na koboorokereria amang’ana ayio.

English: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asikudharau kwa kuwa wewe ni kijana, bali uwe kielelezo kizuri kwa waumini katika usemi, mwenendo, upendo, imani na usafi.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tagochaaya ekiagera ore omosae, korende obe ekiorokererio ekiya ase abwo begenire, ase ogokwana, na ase orogeendo, naende ase obwanchani, na okwegena, na obochenu.

English: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
Kiswahili: Fanya bidii kusoma Maandiko hadharani, kuhubiri na kufundisha, mpaka nitakapokuja.
Ekegusii: Goika nchiche, kora omokia ase ogosomera abanto amariiko, na gokuurera, na kworokereria.

English: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
Kiswahili: Usiache kutumia kipawa kilicho ndani yako, ambacho ulipewa kwa neno la unabii wakati wazee walikuwekea mikono.
Ekegusii: Totiga gokorera ekeegwa keria kwaetwe ase enchera y’obobani, ekero ekeombe ki’abagaaka giakobeekerete amaboko.

English: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
Kiswahili: Uwe na bidii katika mambo haya; ujitolee kwa ajili ya mambo haya kikamilifu, ili kila mtu aone kuendelea kwako.
Ekegusii: Orengererie ayio, bwerue kegima ase ayio, erio okogeenderera kwao kobe maiso marore ase abanto bonsi.

English: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
Kiswahili: Jilinde sana nafsi yako na mafundisho yako. Dumu katika hayo, kwa maana kwa kufanya hivyo, utajiokoa wewe mwenyewe pamoja na wale wanaokusikia.
Ekegusii: Bwerende aye omonyene na okworokereria kwao, ogeenderere ase ayio, ekiagera korakore igo mbwetoorie aye omonyene amo n’abwo bakogotegerera.

English: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
Kiswahili: Usimkemee mzee kwa ukali bali umshawishi kama vile angekuwa ni baba yako. Uwatendee vijana kama vile ndugu zako;
Ekegusii: Totogonyera omogaka, korende omosorore buna iso, abamura abake buna bamura bamino,

English: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
Kiswahili: nao wanawake wazee uwatendee kama mama zako, na wanawake vijana kama dada zako, katika usafi wote.
Ekegusii: abakungu abagotu buna abaanyoko, na abakungu abasubati buna basubati bamino, ase obochenu bwonsi.

English: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
Kiswahili: Waheshimu wanawake wajane ambao ni wajane kweli kweli.
Ekegusii: Osike abatakanwa abare abataakanwa bori.

English: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
Kiswahili: Kama mjane ana watoto ama wajukuu, hawa inawapasa awali ya yote wajifunze kutimiza wajibu wao wa kumcha Mungu katika matendo kwa kuwatunza wale wa jamaa zao wenyewe, na hivyo wawarudishie wema waliowatendea wazazi wao, kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo impendezavyo Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omotakaanwa ore nabana gose abaachokoro, tiga beorokererie ritang’ani ayabagwenerete bakorere abamwabo abanyene, na koiraneria abaibori babo ng’a mbuya mono ase ebi banyorire, ekiagera ring’ana eri ndiancheire ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
Kiswahili: Mwanamke ambaye ni mjane kweli kweli, yaani, yeye aliyebaki peke yake huweka tumaini lake kwa Mungu naye hudumu katika maombi usiku na mchana akimwomba Mungu ili amsaidie.
Ekegusii: Oyore omotaakanwa bori, na otigire bweka, oyo nigo amosemeretie Nyasae, na kogeenderera ase okoboria na ogosaba obotuko na omobaso.

English: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
Kiswahili: Lakini mjane aishiye kwa anasa amekufa, ingawa anaishi.
Ekegusii: Korende ere, oy’otari gwetanga ase okogania kwaye, okuure nonya ore moyo.

English: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.
Kiswahili: Wape watu maagizo haya pia, ili asiwepo yeyote wa kulaumiwa.
Ekegusii: Obachiike ayio, erinde babe batari na komocha.

English: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu hawatunzi wale wa jamaa yake, hasa wale wa nyumbani mwake mwenyewe, ameikana imani, tena ni mbaya kuliko yeye asiyeamini.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto takoreenda abare abamwabo, mono baria be enyomba yaye, okaanire okwegena, naende nomobe kobua oy’otegeneti.

English: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
Kiswahili: Mjane yeyote asiwekwe kwenye orodha ya wajane isipokuwa awe ametimiza umri wa miaka sitini, na ambaye alikuwa mke wa mume mmoja,
Ekegusii: Omotakaanwa anyare koriikwa onye okoorire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, naende onye orenge omokungu bw’omosaacha oyoomo.

English: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.
Kiswahili: awe ameshuhudiwa kwa matendo yake mema, aliyewalea watoto wake vizuri, aliye mkarimu, aliyewanawisha watakatifu miguu, aliyewasaidia wenye shida na aliyejitolea kwa ajili ya matendo mema ya kila namna.
Ekegusii: Nemogwenerete gwatorwa ng’a nare nogokora okuya, buna oyo okinirie abana, oroisirie abageni, osibirie abachenu amagoro, okoonyire abachaandegete, na bweruete omonyene ase kera ogokora okuya.

English: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa habari za wajane vijana usiwaweke kwenye orodha hiyo, maana tamaa zao za kimaumbile zikizidi kule kujitoa kwao kwa Kristo, watataka kuolewa tena.
Ekegusii: Korende toriika abatakanwa batari nemiaka emenge, ekiagera ekero baranyore ebirengererio ebire ao na Kristo, nigo baraganie konyuomwa.

English: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
Kiswahili: Nao kwa njia hiyo watajiletea hukumu kwa kukiuka ahadi yao ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nabagaambigwe, ekiagera baatigire eira yabo ye ritang’ani.

English: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, wajane kama hao huwa na tabia ya uvivu wakizurura nyumba kwa nyumba, wala hawawi wavivu tu, bali pia huwa wasengenyaji, wajiingizao katika mambo yasiyowahusu na kusema mambo yasiyowapasa kusema.
Ekegusii: Amo nayio beorokereirie koba aboro, bagoetanana enyomba ase enyomba; tibari aboro rioka, korende nabatora‐toria, bakwerosia namang’ana y’abanto bande, bagokwana amang’ana atagwenereti.

English: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nawashauri wajane vijana waolewe, wazae watoto na wasimamie nyumba zao, wasije wakampa adui nafasi ya kutushutumu.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, nanchire abatakanwa batari nemiaka emenge banyuomwe, baibore abana, barende chiinka chiabo, na tibaa moengereria onde ribaga ri’ogokwana bobe igoro ase tore.

English: For already some have turned away after Satan.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kwa kweli wajane wengine wamepotoka ili kumfuata Shetani.
Ekegusii: Inaki abaande bairanire magega, na gotunyana Saitani.

English: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mwanamke yeyote aaminiye ana wajane katika jamaa yake, inampasa awasaidie wala si kuwaacha wakililemea kanisa, ili kanisa liweze kuwasaidia wale ambao ni wajane kweli kweli.
Ekegusii: Onye omosacha gose omokungu, oyobwegenete, ore nabatakaanwa bamwabo, tiga abakoonye, ekanisa terarerigwa, erinde ebakonye baria bare abatakanwa bori.

English: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
Kiswahili: Wazee wa kanisa wanaoongoza shughuli za kanisa vizuri wanastahili heshima mara mbili, hasa wale ambao kazi yao ni kuhubiri na kufundisha.
Ekegusii: Abagaaka abakogaamba buya baabarerwe ng’a mbagwenerete amasikani ara kabere, kobua mono abwo bagokora emeremo y’okorandia na kworokereria.

English: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Maandiko husema, “Usimfunge maksai kinywa apurapo nafaka,” tena, “Mfanyakazi anastahili mshahara wake.”
Ekegusii: Inaki amariiko nigo agoteeba, “Tobaisa kobekera entang’ana ekeokio ekero ekoora endaagera”, na “Omokori emeremo nagwenerete koegwa eng’eria yaye.”

English: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.
Kiswahili: Usiendekeze mashtaka dhidi ya mzee isipokuwa yawe yameletwa na mashahidi wawili au watatu.
Ekegusii: Tibwancha ogosoerwa igoro y’omogaka otatiga, ase amang’ana y’abarori babere gose batato.

English: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
Kiswahili: Wale wanaodumu katika dhambi uwakemee hadharani, ili wengine wapate kuogopa.
Ekegusii: Abwo bagokora ebibe, obatogonyere ase amasio y’abanto bonsi, erinde abaande bairoke.

English: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
Kiswahili: Ninakuagiza mbele za Mungu na mbele za Kristo Yesu na mbele za malaika wateule, shika maagizo haya pasipo ubaguzi wala upendeleo.
Ekegusii: Nagochiikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na obwa Kristo Yeso, na obw’abamalaika abachoore, obwate amang’ana ayio, na tonacha ring’ana ritang’ani otaramanya buna rire; tokora ing’ana rinde rionsi ase ogwanchereria.

English: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
Kiswahili: Usiwe na haraka kumwekea mtu mikono wala usishiriki dhambi za watu wengine. Jilinde nafsi yako uwe safi.
Ekegusii: Tobekera omonto amaboko bwango, gose tosanga nebibe bi’abaanto bande. Bwerende aye omonyene, obe omochenu.

English: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
Kiswahili: Acha kunywa maji peke yake, tumia divai kidogo kwa sababu ya tumbo lako na maumivu yako ya mara kwa mara.
Ekegusii: Korwa bono tonywa amaache oka, korende onywe edivai nke, ase engencho y’enda yao na amarwaire agokonyora ekero ase ekero.

English: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.
Kiswahili: Dhambi za watu wengine ni dhahiri nazo zinawatangulia kwenda hukumuni; na dhambi za watu wengine zinawafuata nyuma yao.
Ekegusii: Ebibe bi’abaanto baande nigo bire maiso marore, biatang’anire gochia ase ekiina, korende ebi’abaande nigo bikobatunyana korwa magega.

English: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, matendo mema yako dhahiri, na hata yale ambayo si mema hayawezi kufichika.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, ogokora okuya nigo kore maiso marore, na koria gotari maiso marore tigokogenderera kobisekana.

English: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.
Kiswahili: Wale wote walio chini ya kongwa la utumwa inawapasa kuwahesabu mabwana zao kuwa wanastahili heshima yote, ili jina la Mungu lisitukanwe wala mafundisho yetu.
Ekegusii: Bonsi abare inse y’obosibwa bw’obosomba baabare abanene babo ng’a mbagwenerete ogosika gwonsi, erinde erieta ria Nyasae tiriramwa, gose okworokereria gwaito.

English: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.
Kiswahili: Wale watumwa ambao wana mabwana waaminio, haiwapasi kupunguza heshima yao kwa sababu wao ni ndugu. Badala yake, wawatumikie hata vizuri zaidi, kwa sababu wale wanaonufaika na huduma yao ni waaminio, ambao ni wapenzi wao. Fundisha mambo haya na uwahimize kuyafuata.
Ekegusii: Na baria bare nabanene abegeni tibaabachaaya ekiagera nabamwabo bare, korende baabakorere buya kobua, ekiagera abwo bakoreirwe emeremo emiya nigo bare abegeni na abanchwa. Bworokererie amang’ana aya, na gokuurera.

English: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu yeyote atafundisha mafundisho mapotovu wala hakubaliani na mafundisho manyofu ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo na yale ya utauwa,
Ekegusii: Onye omonto okworokereria konde okoao, na tabwataini namang’ana a Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, ayare y’obogima, na okworokereria kobwataine ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae,

English: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,
Kiswahili: huyo amejivuna wala hajui kitu chochote. Yeye amejaa tamaa ya mabishano na ugomvi kuhusu maneno ambavyo matokeo yake ni wivu na mapigano, maneno ya ukorofi, shuku mbaya,
Ekegusii: ere oenenire, na tamanyeti ing’ana rinde rionsi. Ere nigo are omonto ore noborwaire bw’omoyo ase amaborio na okoamererania kw’amang’ana. Ase amang’ana aya nigo bikorwao emoko, na eriomana, na oborami, na ogokagera okobe,

English: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
Kiswahili: na kuzozana kusikokoma kati ya watu walioharibika akili zao, walioikosa kweli, na ambao hudhani kwamba utauwa ni njia ya kupata faida.
Ekegusii: na okoamererania gotari konucha ase egati y’abanto abasarekire ase ebirengererio biabo, na baurirwe ekeene. Baria bagokaga ng’a okoba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae nenchera y’okonyora.

English: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
Kiswahili: Lakini utauwa na kuridhika ni faida kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, okoba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae amo nogoisaneka nokonyora okonene,

English: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hatukuja humu duniani na kitu chochote, wala hatuwezi kutoka humu na kitu.
Ekegusii: inaki titwachete na gento ase ense, naende titokoira gento korwa ase ense.

English: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama tuna chakula na mavazi, tutaridhika navyo.
Ekegusii: Gaaki, onye tore nendagera ne chianga, inatoisaneke n’ebinto ebio.

English: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.
Kiswahili: Lakini wale watu wanaotamani kuwa na mali kwa haraka huanguka kwenye majaribu, na wamenaswa na tamaa nyingi za kipumbavu zenye kudhuru, zinazowazamisha watu katika uharibifu na maangamizi.
Ekegusii: Korende abwo barigetie koba abanda nigo bakogwa ase ogoteemwa na omoeto, na okogania okonge gotari nengeencho, kore okw’ogosaria, okwo gokorimeria Mwanyabaanto bachie gosira na gosareka.

English: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kupenda fedha ndiyo shina moja la maovu ya kila namna. Baadhi ya watu wakitamani fedha, wameiacha imani na kujichoma wenyewe kwa maumivu mengi.
Ekegusii: Inaki omochakano bw’amabe onsi nogwancha chibeesa. Abaande kobakogania ayio, nigo bakweatanana korwa ase okwegena, na kwebeeka abanyene ase obororo obonge.

English: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe, mtu wa Mungu, yakimbie mambo haya yote. Fuata haki, utauwa, imani, upendo, saburi na upole.
Ekegusii: Korende aye, omonto o Nyasae, tama ayio onsi, rigia oboronge, ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, na okwegena, na obwanchani, na oboremereria na obwororo.

English: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
Kiswahili: Pigana vile vita vizuri vya imani. Shika uzima wa milele ambao ndio ulioitiwa ulipokiri ule ukiri mzuri mbele ya mashahidi wengi.
Ekegusii: Rwana esegi ere engiya y’okwegena, bwata obogima bwa kare na kare, obo kwarangereretigwe konyora, na kwaorogetie ase okoorokia okuya ase obosio bw’abarori abange.

English: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,
Kiswahili: Nakuagiza mbele za Mungu avipaye vitu vyote uhai, na mbele za Kristo Yesu ambaye alipokuwa anashuhudia mbele ya Pontio Pilato alikiri ukiri mzuri,
Ekegusii: Nagochiikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, oyokoa ebinto bionsi obogima, na ase Kristo Yeso, oyoruete oborori obuya ase Pontio Pilato,

English: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: uishike amri hii bila dosari wala lawama mpaka kuja kwake Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo,
Ekegusii: ng’a obwate ogochika oko, obe oy’otari na kemoa, gose na komocha, goika Omonene oito Yeso Kristo aorokigwe.

English: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.
Kiswahili: ambaye Mungu atamleta kwa wakati wake mwenyewe: yeye ahimidiwaye, aliye peke yake Mtawala, Mfalme wa wafalme, na Bwana wa mabwana,
Ekegusii: Oyosesenirie, oyore nokobua ere bweka, Omorwoti bw’abarwoti, Omonene bw’abanene, oraache gotworokia okoorokigwa okwo ase ekero kiaye.

English: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
Kiswahili: yeye peke yake ambaye hapatikani na mauti, na anakaa katika nuru isiyoweza kukaribiwa, ambaye hakuna mwanadamu aliyemwona wala awezaye kumwona. Heshima na uweza una yeye milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: Nere bweka otari konyorekana namakweri, nigo amenyete ase omobaso otanyaare goikwa ang’e, na onde tari ase Mwanyabaanto omorooche gose oranyare komorora. Asare ere ogosika na okobua kare na kare. Amina.

English: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;
Kiswahili: Waagize wale ambao ni matajiri wa ulimwengu huu waache kujivuna, wala wasiweke tumaini lao katika mali ambayo si ya hakika, bali waweke tumaini lao katika Mungu ambaye hutupatia vitu vyote kwa wingi ili tuvifurahie.
Ekegusii: Obachiike abwo bare abanda ase ense eye ya bono tibaenena, gose gosemeria obonda boria bogosira, korende bamosemerie Nyasae, oyogotoa ebinto bionsi ase obonge, tobikorere ase omogooko.

English: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
Kiswahili: Waagize watende mema, wawe matajiri katika matendo mema, pia wawe wakarimu na walio tayari kushiriki mali zao na wengine.
Ekegusii: Obachiike naende bakore amaya, babe abanda ase ogokora okuya, babe ang’e korua chinibo chiabo, na gwatanera abaande ase emioyo emiya,

English: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii watajiwekea hazina kama msingi kwa ajili ya wakati ujao na hivyo watajipatia uzima, yaani, ule uzima ambao ni wa kweli.
Ekegusii: beagacheire abanyene oboroso obuya ase ekero kegochia-gocha erinde babwate obogima obore obogima bw’ekeene.

English: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,
Kiswahili: Timotheo, linda kile kilichowekwa amana kwako. Epuka majadiliano yasiyo ya utauwa na mabishano ambayo kwa uongo huitwa elimu,
Ekegusii: Aye Timotheo, renda aya abekirwe ase ore. Bweatanane korwa ase amang’ana atari ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, na korwa ase okoamererania ase aya akorokwa chisemi, korende nay’oborimo.

English: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
Kiswahili: ambayo wengine kwa kujidai kuwa nayo wameiacha imani. Neema iwe nanyi. Amen.
Ekegusii: Inaki abaande babwatirie ayio, na basirire korwa ase okwegena. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
Kiswahili: Paulo mtume wa Kristo Yesu kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, kulingana na ile ahadi ya uzima uliomo ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ase engencho y’eira y’obogima bore ase Kristo Yeso,

English: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
Kiswahili: Kwa Timotheo, mwanangu mpendwa: Neema, rehema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba, na kwa Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu.
Ekegusii: gocha ase Timotheo, omwana one omwanchwa: Obuya na amaabera, na omorembe, bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.

English: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
Kiswahili: Ninamshukuru Mungu, ninayemtumikia kwa dhamiri safi, kama walivyofanya baba zangu, ninapokukumbuka usiku na mchana katika maombi yangu.
Ekegusii: Nigo nkomoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, oyo ngokorera nenkoro etari kongaambia, buna chisokoro chiane chiare gokora, nigo ngokoinyora botambe ase ogosaba kw’ane obotuko na omobaso.

English: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
Kiswahili: Nikiyakumbuka machozi yako, ninatamani sana kukuona ili nipate kujawa na furaha.
Ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora amariga ao nigo nkoba namaiga gokorora, erinde ing’ichorwe nomogooko.

English: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
Kiswahili: Nimekuwa nikiikumbuka imani yako ya kweli, waliokuwa nayo bibi yako Loisi na mama yako Eunike na ambayo mimi ninasadiki sasa wewe pia unayo.
Ekegusii: Ning’inyorete okwegena ore nakorokwo, gotari nobong’ainereria, okwo kwareenge ritang’ani ase nyagokoro Lois na ase nyoko Yunuke, na inche ninde nobomaene ng’a naye nokobwate boigo.

English: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii nakukumbusha uchochee ile karama ya Mungu, iliyowekwa ndani yako nilipokuwekea mikono yangu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ngokoinyoria, oigererie ekeegwa ekiaruure ase Nyasae, ekere ime yao, ekio kwaetwe ekero nakobeekerete amaboko aane,

English: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
Kiswahili: Maana Mungu hakutupa roho ya woga, bali roho ya nguvu, ya upendo na ya moyo wa kiasi.
Ekegusii: ekiagera omoika twaetwe na Nyasae tari oyo bw’obwoba, korende oyo bw’echinguru na obwanchani, na omoika bw’okwerenga intwe abanyene.

English: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo usione haya kushuhudia kuhusu Bwana wetu, wala usinionee haya mimi niliye mfungwa kwa ajili yake. Bali uishiriki pamoja nami taabu ya Injili, kwa kadiri ya nguvu ya Mungu,
Ekegusii: Gaaki, torora obosooku kobeera Omonene oito kirori, gose tondorera inche, omosibwa oye, obosooku, korende nonya naye oremererie emechando ase engencho y’enchiri, ase okobua kwa Nyasae,

English: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
Kiswahili: ambaye alituokoa na kutuita katika mwito mtakatifu: si kwa kadiri ya matendo yetu mema bali kwa sababu ya kusudi lake mwenyewe na neema yake. Neema hii tulipewa katika Kristo Yesu tangu milele.
Ekegusii: oyototooretie na agatorangeria ase okorangeria ogochenu, tari ase engencho y’ogokora gwaito korende koreng’ana nokorigia kwaye omonyene, na obuya bwaye. Obuya obo twaetwe ase Kristo Yeso korwa agwo kare

English: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
Kiswahili: Lakini sasa imefunuliwa kwa kudhihirishwa kwake Mwokozi wetu, Kristo Yesu, ambaye amebatilisha mauti na kuleta uzima na kutokufa kwa njia ya Injili.
Ekegusii: bwaorokigwe bono ase okoorokigwa kw’Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso. Ere agasiria chinguru chi’amakweri, na akarenta obogima na ogotasareka goetera ase enchiri.

English: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
Kiswahili: Nami nimewekwa kuwa mhubiri, mtume na mwalimu wa Injili hii.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase enchiri eye nkaragwa koba omoraria, na omotomwa, na omworokia.

English: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu ninateseka namna hii, lakini sioni haya kwa maana ninamjua yeye niliyemwamini, na kusadiki ya kuwa anaweza kukilinda kile nilichokiweka amana kwake hadi siku ile.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nanyoorire emechando eye. Korende tinkorora obosooku, inaki nimomanyete ere oyonyegenete, naende ninde nobomaene ng’a goika Rituko riria ere nanyare korenda keria angacherete.

English: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Shika kwa uthabiti kielelezo cha mafundisho yenye uzima yale uliyoyasikia kwangu, pamoja na imani na upendo katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Bwatia amang’ana ayare ay’obogima, ayakwaigwete korwa ase ’nde, abe ekiorokererio ogotunyana ase okwegena na obwanchani bire ase Kristo Yeso.

English: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
Kiswahili: Ilinde ile amana uliyokabidhiwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu akaaye ndani yetu.
Ekegusii: Renda keria ekiya kwaetwe, okegache, okerende ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu, oyomenyete ime yaito.

English: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
Kiswahili: Unajua ya kuwa watu wote katika Asia wameniacha, miongoni mwao wamo Filego na Hermogene.
Ekegusii: Kwamanyire ng’a bonsi abare Asia bantigire, na ase abwo mbareo Figelo na Hermogene.

English: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
Kiswahili: Bwana akawahurumie watu wa nyumbani mwa Onesiforo, kwa sababu aliniburudisha mara kwa mara wala hakuionea aibu minyororo yangu.
Ekegusii: Omonene abarorere amaabera abwo bare ab’enyomba y’Onesiforo, ekiagera ekero ase ekero nigo are gontimokia, gose t’are korora obosooku ase engencho y’obosibwa bwane.

English: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me
Kiswahili: Badala yake, alipokuwa Rumi, alinitafuta kwa bidii mpaka akanipata.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero aigete Rumi akandigia nomokia, akanyoora.

English: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.
Kiswahili: Bwana na amjalie kupata rehema zake siku ile! Nawe unajua vyema jinsi alivyonisaidia huko Efeso.
Ekegusii: Omonene namwanchere anyoore amaabera korwa ase Omonene Rituko riria. Aye kwamanyire buya buna are gokora emeremo emenge aria Efeso.

English: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Basi, wewe mwanangu, uwe hodari katika neema iliyo ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Gaaki, aye omwana one, obe ne chinguru ase obuya bore ime ase Kristo Yeso.

English: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
Kiswahili: Nayo mambo yale uliyonisikia nikiyasema mbele ya mashahidi wengi, uwakabidhi watu waaminifu watakaoweza kuwafundisha watu wengine vilevile.
Ekegusii: Na ayakwaigwete korwa ase ’nde ase amasio y’abarori abange oyabeeke ase abanto abegenwa, abaranyare kworokereria abaande boigo.

English: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Vumilia taabu pamoja nasi kama askari mwema wa Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Nonya naye oremererie emechando buna omorwani omuya o Kristo Yeso.

English: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
Kiswahili: Hakuna askari yeyote ambaye akiwa vitani hujishughulisha na mambo ya kawaida ya maisha haya kwa sababu nia yake ni kumpendeza yule aliyemwandika awe askari.
Ekegusii: Morwani onde tari, oyokogeenda ase esegi, orebeke ase amang’ana ande onsi y’ense eye, erinde amogwenere ere oyomoriigete.

English: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, yeye ashindanaye katika michezo hawezi kupewa tuzo ya ushindi asiposhindana kulingana na kanuni za mashindano.
Ekegusii: Omoamereria bwe chigosori takoegwa egutwa y’obobui ataamereraneti koreng’ana namachiiko.

English: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
Kiswahili: Mkulima mwenye bidii ya kazi ndiye anayestahili kuwa wa kwanza kupata fungu la mavuno.
Ekegusii: Omoremi oyobwechandeire emeremo, ere nemogwenerete abe oyo bw’eritang’ani konyora ensemo y’okwama.

English: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
Kiswahili: Fikiri sana kuhusu haya nisemayo, kwa maana Bwana atakupa ufahamu katika mambo hayo yote.
Ekegusii: Rengereria mono ayio ngokwana, ekiagera Omonene nakoe okomanya ase amang’ana onsi.

English: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,
Kiswahili: Mkumbuke Yesu Kristo, aliyefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, yeye aliye wa uzao wa Daudi. Hii ndiyo Injili yangu,
Ekegusii: Moinyore Yeso Kristo, oy’oboogete korwa ase abakuure, oyo bw’ororeria rwa Daudi, koreng’ana nenchiri eye nkorandia inche.

English: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
Kiswahili: ambayo kwayo ninateseka hata kufikia hatua ya kufungwa minyororo kama mhalifu. Lakini neno la Mungu halifungwi.
Ekegusii: Ase enchiri eyio ngachaandwa goika ngasibwa ne chingataare buna omokori amabe. Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae tirikobeegeka chingataare.

English: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ninavumilia mambo yote kwa ajili ya wateule wa Mungu, kusudi wao nao wapate wokovu ulio katika Kristo Yesu, pamoja na utukufu wa milele.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio naremereirie onsi ase engencho y’abachoore, erinde nabarabwo banyoore ogotooreka kore ase Kristo Yeso amo nobonene bwa kare na kare.

English: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.
Kiswahili: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa: Kwa maana kama tumekufa pamoja naye, tutaishi pia pamoja naye.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene: Onye twakwete amo nere, inatobe moyo amo nere boigo.

English: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
Kiswahili: Kama tukistahimili, pia tutatawala pamoja naye. Kama tukimkana yeye, naye atatukana sisi.
Ekegusii: Onye tokoremereria, rirorio natogaambe amo nere boigo; onye tokomokaana, nere natokaane boigo;

English: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”
Kiswahili: Kama tusipoamini, yeye hudumu kuwa mwaminifu, kwa maana hawezi kujikana mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: onye titori abegenwa, ere nigo are omwegenwa, ekiagera takonyara gwekaana ere omonyene.

English: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
Kiswahili: Endelea kuwakumbusha mambo haya ukiwaonya mbele za Bwana waache kushindana kwa maneno ambayo hayana faida yoyote bali huwaangamiza tu wale wanaoyasikia.
Ekegusii: Obainyorie ayio, na kobakuurera ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tibaaba nokoamererania ase amang’ana, okwo gotanyaare gokoonya kende, korende nigo gokobasiria abagokoigwa.

English: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
Kiswahili: Jitahidi kujionyesha kwa Mungu kuwa umekubaliwa naye, mtendakazi asiye na sababu ya kuona aibu, ukilitumia kwa usahihi neno la kweli.
Ekegusii: Kora buna oranyaare kweorokia ase obosio bwa Nyasae buna oyobwancheirwe nere, buna omokori emeremo oyotagwenereti gosookigwa, ogwatanana boronge ring’ana ri’ekeene.

English: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
Kiswahili: Jiepushe na maneno mabaya, yasiyo na maana, yasiyo ya utauwa, kwa maana hayo huzidi kuwatosa watu katika kukosa heshima kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Bweatanane korwa ase amang’ana atari y’obonyasae, na atari nengeencho. Inaki ase ayio abanto nigo barageenderere komenteka ase chingeencho chitari chi’obonyasae.

English: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
Kiswahili: Mafundisho yao yataenea kama kidonda kisichopona. Miongoni mwao wamo Himenayo na Fileto
Ekegusii: Amang’ana abo nigo akoria buna rikwege ri’esiria. Ase abwo mbareo Himenayo na Fileto.

English: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
Kiswahili: ambao wameiacha kweli, wakisema kwamba ufufuo wa wafu umekwisha kuwako, nao huharibu imani ya baadhi ya watu.
Ekegusii: Abwo basireriigwe korwa ase ekeene, bagoteeba ng’a okobokigwa gwaikire kobao, na igo bakoonchorana okwegena kw’abaanto baande.

English: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
Kiswahili: Lakini msingi wa Mungu ulio imara umesimama, ukiwa na muhuri wenye maandishi haya: “Bwana anawajua walio wake”; tena, “Kila alitajaye jina la Bwana, na auache uovu.”
Ekegusii: Korende oboroso obo Nyasae abeegete bore ne chinguru, boteneine boronge, bore nekemanyererio eke: “Omonene namanyete abare abaye”, naende, “Kera oyogwatora erieta ri’Omonene, tiga eatanane korwa ase obobe.”

English: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.
Kiswahili: Katika nyumba kubwa si kwamba kuna vyombo vya dhahabu na fedha tu, bali pia vimo vyombo vya miti na vya udongo; vingine kwa matumizi maalum, na vingine kwa matumizi ya kawaida.
Ekegusii: Ase enyomba enene tibirio ebinto bie chitaabu na ebie chifeta bioka, korende mbireo ebinto bi’emete na ebi’amaroba boigo; ebinde nebi’ogosika, na ebinde tibiri ebi’ogosika.

English: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.
Kiswahili: Basi ikiwa mtu amejitakasa na kujitenga na hayo niliyoyataja, atakuwa chombo maalum, kilichotengwa na ambacho kinamfaa mwenye nyumba, kimeandaliwa tayari kwa kila kazi njema.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye omonto origetie gwesibia ere omonyene ase ogweatanana korwa ase ebinto buna ebio, nabe egento ki’ogosika, giancheirwe, keragwenere Omonene, kiaroisiigwe ase kera emeremo emiya.

English: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
Kiswahili: Zikimbie tamaa mbaya za ujana, ufuate haki, imani, upendo na amani pamoja na wale wamwitao Bwana kwa moyo safi.
Ekegusii: Tama okogania okobe kw’obosae, rigia oboronge, na okwegena, na obwanchani, na omorembe, amo nabwo bakomorangeri’Omonene ase chinkoro chindabu.

English: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.
Kiswahili: Jiepushe na mabishano ya kipumbavu na yasiyo na maana, kwa kuwa wajua ya kwamba hayo huzaa magomvi.
Ekegusii: Korende bwange amaborio y’oboriri atari aye chiseemi. Kwamanyire ng’a ayio nigo ararente eriomana.

English: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
Kiswahili: Tena haimpasi mtumishi wa Bwana kuwa mgomvi, bali inampasa awe mwema kwa kila mtu, awezaye kufundisha, tena mvumilivu.
Ekegusii: Naende tegwenereti omosomba Omonene koba omonyariomana, korende abe omwororo ase abanto bonsi, abe oy’omanyete kworokereria buya, na abe omoremereria,

English: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,
Kiswahili: Inampasa kuwaonya kwa upole wale wanaopingana naye, kwa matumaini kwamba Mungu atawajalia kutubu na kuijua kweli,
Ekegusii: oyorabateebererie ase obwororo abwo bakoamererania nere. Aande Nyasae nabaonchore, erinde bamanye ekeene gionsi,

English: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.
Kiswahili: ili fahamu zao ziwarudie tena, nao waponyoke katika mtego wa ibilisi ambaye amewateka wapate kufanya mapenzi yake.
Ekegusii: erio banyare gotaboboka na korua ase omoeto o Saitani kobasakoirwe nere goika bakore ogwancha kwaye.

English: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.
Kiswahili: Lakini yakupasa ufahamu jambo hili, kwamba siku za mwisho kutakuwa na nyakati za hatari.
Ekegusii: Gaaki, manya ring’ana eri, ng’a ase amatuko y’omoerio inachibe chingaki chi’obokong’u.

English: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana watu watakuwa wenye kujipenda wenyewe, wenye kupenda fedha, wenye kujisifu, wenye kiburi, wenye kumkufuru Mungu, wasiotii wazazi wao, wasio na shukrani, wasio watakatifu,
Ekegusii: Inaki abanto inababe bakweancha barabwo abanyene, abanchete chitaabu, abetogia, abaenenu, abarami, abatari koigwera abaibori babo, abatari koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, abatari abachenu,

English: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,
Kiswahili: wasio na upendo, wasiopenda kupatanishwa, wasingiziaji, wasiozuia tamaa zao, wakatili, wasiopenda mema,
Ekegusii: abatancheti abanto baande, abatarigeti kobwatana, abang’aachi, abatari gwetanga ase rinde rionsi, abatiindi, abageechete ayare amaya,

English: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
Kiswahili: wasaliti, wakaidi, waliojaa majivuno, wapendao anasa zaidi kuliko kumpenda Mungu:
Ekegusii: abarua abaande, abatancheti gokanigwa, abamwenu, abanchete kwegokia kobua komwancha Nyasae,

English: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
Kiswahili: wakiwa na mfano wa utauwa kwa nje, lakini wakizikana nguvu za Mungu. Jiepushe na watu wa namna hiyo.
Ekegusii: abakororekana ng’a mbare ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, korende bakaana okobua gwe chingeencho echio. Bweatanane korwa ase abwo.

English: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
Kiswahili: Miongoni mwao wamo wale wajiingizao katika nyumba za watu na kuwachukua mateka wanawake wajinga, waliolemewa na dhambi zao na kuyumbishwa na aina zote za tamaa mbaya.
Ekegusii: Inaki ase egati yabo mbareo abagwesoyia ase chinyomba chi’abaanto gosakora abakungu aboro, abare ne chigurube chi’ebibe, na koraagwa nokogania okobe gwe chingeencho ao ao.

English: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
Kiswahili: Wakijifunza siku zote lakini kamwe wasiweze kufikia ujuzi wa kweli.
Ekegusii: Abakungu abwo nigo bakweorokereria botaambe, korende tibakonyara goikera chiseemi chi’ekeene.

English: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
Kiswahili: Kama vile Yane na Yambre walivyopingana na Mose, vivyo hivyo watu hawa hupingana na ile kweli. Hawa ni watu wenye akili zilizopotoka, ambao wamekataliwa kwa mambo ya imani.
Ekegusii: Naboigo buna Yane na Yambare baengereranetie na Musa, na aba nabo bakoengererania nekeene. Ebirengererio biabo biasarekire, na okwegena kwabo kwangirwe,

English: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.
Kiswahili: Lakini hawataendelea sana, kwa sababu upumbavu wao utakuwa dhahiri kwa watu wote, kama ulivyokuwa dhahiri upumbavu wa hao watu wawili.
Ekegusii: korende tibakogeenderera mono, ekiagera oboriri bwabo naboorokigwe maiso marore ase abanto bonsi, buna yabeete ase baria babere.

English: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
Kiswahili: Lakini wewe umeyajua mafundisho yangu, mwenendo, makusudi, imani, uvumilivu, upendo, ustahimilivu,
Ekegusii: Korende aye kwabwatire okworokereria kw’ane, na orogeendo rw’ane, na okorigia kw’ane ase obogima obo, na okwegena kw’ane, na oboremereria bwane, na obwanchani bwane, na okoganya kw’ane,

English: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
Kiswahili: mateso na taabu, yaani mambo yote yaliyonipata huko Antiokia, Ikonio na Listra, mateso yote niliyostahimili, lakini Bwana aliniokoa katika hayo yote.
Ekegusii: na ogochaandwa kw’ane, na ogochaandeka kw’ane, okwo nanyorete ase Antiokia na Ikonio, na Listra. Nogochaandwa kore inaki naremereretie! Na korwa ase ayio onsi Omonene agantooria.

English: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
Kiswahili: Naam, yeyote anayetaka kuishi maisha ya utauwa ndani ya Kristo Yesu atateswa.
Ekegusii: Ekeene, aba bonsi baganetie koba ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae ase Kristo Yeso inabachaandwe.

English: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu waovu na wadanganyaji watazidi kuwa waovu, wakidanganya na kudanganyika.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto ababe na abang’ainereria mbamentekane kobua ase obobe, bakong’aina na kong’aineka.

English: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
Kiswahili: Bali wewe, udumu katika yale uliyojifunza na kuyaamini kwa uthabiti, ukitambua ya kuwa ulijifunza hayo kutoka kwa nani,
Ekegusii: Korende aye, ogenderere ase ayakworokereretigwe na koyaenekia, gokomanya ng’a nkorwa ase ng’o kweorokereretie.

English: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: na jinsi ambavyo tangu utoto umeyajua Maandiko matakatifu, ambayo yanaweza kukuhekimisha upate wokovu kwa njia ya imani katika Kristo Yesu.
Ekegusii: Inaki korwa obwana bwao nomanyete amariiko amaachenu, ayaraanyare gokong’ainiyia goika onyore ogotooreka ase okwegena kore ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
Kiswahili: Kila Andiko limevuviwa na Mungu na lafaa kwa mafundisho, kwa kuwaonya watu makosa yao, kwa kuwaongoza na kwa kuwafundisha katika haki,
Ekegusii: Kera ririiko riutire n’Omoika o Nyasae, nario riranyare gotworokereria, na gotokuurera, na gotorongeyia, na gototang’ana ase oboronge,

English: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
Kiswahili: ili mtu wa Mungu awe amekamilishwa, apate kutenda kila kazi njema.
Ekegusii: erinde omonto o Nyasae abe oikeranigwe, oisanerigwe, anyare gokora kera ogokora okuya.

English: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
Kiswahili: Nakuagiza mbele za Mungu na mbele za Kristo Yesu, atakayewahukumu watu walio hai na waliokufa wakati wa kuja kwake na ufalme wake, kwamba:
Ekegusii: Nagochiikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na obwa Kristo Yeso, oyoraache kogaambia abare moyo na abakuure, na ase okooroka kwaye, na oborwoti bwaye.

English: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
Kiswahili: Hubiri Neno; kuwa tayari wakati ufaao na wakati usiofaa; karipia, kemea na utie moyo kwa uvumilivu wote na kwa mafundisho mazuri.
Ekegusii: Randia Ring’ana ria Nyasae, kora omokia ase engaki ekogwenerete, na ase eyetakogwenereti, kuurera na togonyera, na gosorora ase oboremereria bwonsi, na ase okworokereria.

English: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,
Kiswahili: Maana wakati utakuja watu watakapokataa kuyakubali mafundisho yenye uzima. Badala yake, ili kutimiza tamaa zao wenyewe, watajikusanyia idadi kubwa ya walimu wapate kuwaambia yale ambayo masikio yao yanayowasha yanatamani kuyasikia.
Ekegusii: Na engaki neche, ekero abanto barange okworokereria kw’obogima, na ase okogania kwabo okobe benyorere aborokia abange mono, ekiagera amato abo are nebiagaso.

English: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
Kiswahili: Watakataa kusikiliza kweli na kuzigeukia hadithi za uongo.
Ekegusii: Barabwo mbeatanane korwa ase okoigwa ayare ay’ekeene, na koonchokera emegano ao ao.

English: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari yako wewe, vumilia mateso, fanya kazi ya mhubiri wa Injili, timiza wajibu wote wa huduma yako.
Ekegusii: Korende aye, bweriite ase amang’ana onsi, oremererie emechando, kora emeremo y’oborandia, ikerania ogokora kw’obosomba bwao.

English: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mimi sasa ni tayari kumiminwa kama sadaka ya kinywaji, nayo saa yangu ya kuondoka imetimia.
Ekegusii: Inaki inche bono naikire koumorwa buna okoruegwa gw’ekenyuugwa na engaki y’ane y’ogokwa yaikire.

English: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
Kiswahili: Nimevipiga vita vizuri, mashindano nimeyamaliza, imani nimeilinda.
Ekegusii: Narwanire esegi ere engiya, nakoorire orogeendo, narendire okwegena.

English: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
Kiswahili: Sasa nimewekewa taji ya haki ambayo Bwana, mwamuzi wa haki, atanitunukia siku ile: wala si mimi tu, bali pia wote ambao wamengoja kwa shauku kudhihirishwa kwake.
Ekegusii: Magega ase aya nagacheirwe egutwa y’oboronge, eye Omonene, omogambi bw’oboronge, arang’e ase Rituko riria gose tari inche bweka arae, korende nabaanto bonsi abanchete okoorokigwa kwaye.

English: Be diligent to come to me soon,
Kiswahili: Jitahidi kuja kwangu upesi
Ekegusii: Teema buna oranyare gocha ase ’nde bwango.

English: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu Dema, kwa kuupenda ulimwengu, ameniacha na amekwenda Thesalonike. Kreske amekwenda Galatia na Tito amekwenda Dalmatia.
Ekegusii: Inaki Dema ontigire, na gwancha ense eye ya bono; ochiire Tesaloniki. Keresike ochiire Galatia na Tito Dalamatia.

English: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
Kiswahili: Ni Luka peke yake aliye hapa pamoja nami. Mtafute Marko uje naye kwa sababu ananifaa sana katika huduma yangu.
Ekegusii: Luka bweka ore aiga amo nainche. Orentane Mariko, moche komo, ekiagera ere nigo aranyare gonkoonya mono.

English: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
Kiswahili: Nimemtuma Tikiko huko Efeso.
Ekegusii: Namotomire Tukiko Efeso.
