English: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
Kiswahili: Utakapokuja, niletee lile joho nililoliacha kwa Karpo huko Troa na vile vitabu vyangu, hasa vile vya ngozi.
Ekegusii: Ekero orache ondentanerie egetambaa gi’okwambara, eke natigerete Karipo aria Teroa. Naboigo kogocha ondentanerie chibuku, na kobua mono chiria chi’amasankwa.

English: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
Kiswahili: Aleksanda yule mfua chuma alinitendea ubaya mkubwa. Bwana atamlipa kwa ajili ya yale aliyotenda.
Ekegusii: Alekisanda, omoturi bwe chitaai, agankorera amabe amange. Omonene namoakane koreng’ana nogokora kwaye.

English: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.
Kiswahili: Wewe pia ujihadhari naye kwa sababu aliyapinga sana maneno yetu.
Ekegusii: Aye bwerende korwa ase are, ekiagera nigo aengereretie okworokereria gwaito.

English: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
Kiswahili: Katika utetezi wangu wa mara ya kwanza, hakuna hata mmoja aliyeniunga mkono, bali kila mmoja aliniacha. Namwomba Mungu wasihesabiwe hatia kwa jambo hilo.
Ekegusii: Ase ogwekengera kw’ane kw’eritang’ani onde tarenge otenenete amo nainche, korende bonsi bagantiga. Nasabire ng’a tibaabarerwa ebibe ase ring’ana erio.

English: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
Kiswahili: Lakini Bwana alisimama upande wangu akanitia nguvu, ili kupitia kwangu lile Neno lihubiriwe kwa ukamilifu, watu wote Mataifa wapate kulisikia. Mimi niliokolewa kutoka kinywa cha simba.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene agatenena amo nainche, akambeeka chinguru, erinde goetera ase ’nde okoraria kwe ring’ana goikeranigwe goika abanto bonsi b’Ebisaku bakoigwe. Na inche nigo natooretigwe korwa ase omonwa bw’endo.

English: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Bwana ataniokoa katika kila shambulio baya na kunileta salama katika Ufalme wake wa mbinguni. Atukuzwe yeye milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: Omonene nansibore korwa ase amabe onsi, na antoorie goika nsoe ase oborwoti bwa igoro. Ogotogigwa nokwaye kare na kare. Amina.

English: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
Kiswahili: Wasalimu Prisila na Akila, na wote wa nyumbani kwa Onesiforo.
Ekegusii: Nkw’anerie Priska na Akwila, na abanto b’enyomba y’Onesiforo.

English: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
Kiswahili: Erasto alibaki Korintho. Nami nikamwacha Trofimo huko Mileto akiwa mgonjwa.
Ekegusii: Erasto nigo atigarete Korinto, korende Torofimo nkamotiga Mileto orwarete.

English: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
Kiswahili: Jitahidi ufike huku kabla ya majira ya baridi. Eubulo anakusalimu, vivyo hivyo Pude, Lino, Klaudia na ndugu wote.
Ekegusii: Teema buna oranyaare gocha ritang’ani etoigo etaracha. Eubulu ogokwanirie, naboigo Pudente na Lino, na Klaudia, na abaminto bonsi.

English: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
Kiswahili: Bwana awe pamoja na roho yako. Neema iwe pamoja nanyi. Amen.
Ekegusii: Omonene abe amo n’omoyo oo. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
Kiswahili: Paulo, mtumishi wa Mungu na mtume wa Yesu Kristo kwa ajili ya imani ya wateule wa Mungu na kuijua kweli iletayo utauwa:
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo nomosomba o Nyasae, na omotomwa o Yeso Kristo. Inche nigo narangeretigwe naboigo gotomwa ogokonya okwegena kw’abachoore ba Nyasae, erinde baike ase ayare ay’ekeene, ayio akworokererigwa ase okwegena gwaito,

English: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
Kiswahili: imani na ujuzi ulioko katika tumaini la uzima wa milele, ambao Mungu, asiyesema uongo, aliahidi hata kabla ya kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu,
Ekegusii: ekio keigekire ase ogosemeria kw’obogima bwa kare na kare. Obogima obo Nyasae ariete eira korwa kare na kare.

English: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
Kiswahili: naye kwa wakati wake aliouweka alilidhihirisha neno lake kwa njia ya mahubiri ambayo mimi nimewekewa amana kwa amri ya Mungu Mwokozi wetu:
Ekegusii: Na ekero engaki yaye yaigete akabomaanora ase ring’ana riaye, eri inche negenirwe korandia ase ogochika kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito.

English: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
Kiswahili: Kwa Tito, mwanangu hasa katika imani tunayoshiriki sote: Neema iwe kwako na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba na kwa Kristo Yesu Mwokozi wetu.
Ekegusii: Ngokoriikera nde aye Tito, omwana one bori ase okwegena tosangete naye: Obuya na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omotooria oito.

English: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
Kiswahili: Sababu ya mimi kukuacha huko Krete ni ili uweke utaratibu mambo yale yaliyosalia na kuwaweka wazee wa kanisa katika kila mji, kama nilivyokuagiza.
Ekegusii: Nkagotiga Kirete, erinde oroisie aria aganetie gokorwa erio ochore abagaaka ime ase kera omochie. Inyora buna nagochigeete.

English: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
Kiswahili: Mzee wa kanisa asiwe na lawama, awe mume wa mke mmoja, mtu ambaye watoto wake ni waaminio na wala hawashtakiwi kwa ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Omogaka goika abe omoikeranu; abe ore n’omokuungu oyomo, na ore nabana begenete, batari gosoerwa ng’a nabanyaka bare, gose abatari koigwera.

English: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa mwangalizi, kama wakili wa Mungu, imempasa kuwa mtu asiye na lawama, asiwe mwenye majivuno au mwepesi wa hasira, wala mlevi, wala asiwe mtu mwenye tamaa ya mapato yasiyo ya halali.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho omotang’ani bw’ekanisa agotenera ebire ebia Nyasae, ere abe omoikeranu. Ere taaba omonto omoenenu, gose omwango bw’okobea, gose oy’ogotinda, gose omonto bwanchete goaka abanto, gose rinyandambe ase okonyora chitaabu.

English: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
Kiswahili: Bali awe mkarimu, anayependa mema, mwenye kiasi, mwenye haki, mwadilifu, mnyofu, mtakatifu na mwenye kuitawala nafsi yake.
Ekegusii: Korende abe omooroisia abageni, oyobwanchete amaya, oyobwerendete ase onsi, omooronge, omochenu, na oy’omanyete kweriita ase onsi.

English: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
Kiswahili: Inampasa alishike kwa uthabiti lile neno la imani kama lilivyofundishwa, kusudi aweze kuwaonya wengine kwa mafundisho manyofu na kuwakanusha wale wanaopingana nayo.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo emogwenerete abwate ring’ana ri’ekeene buna riorokereretigwe, erinde anyare koremia abanto ase okworokereria gw’ekeene, na korongeyia abakoengererania nario.

English: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wako wengi wasiotii, wenye maneno yasiyo na maana, hasa wale wa kikundi cha tohara.
Ekegusii: Inaki mbare abange, mono korwa ase Abayahudi baria baonchokire batari koigwera, abagokwana amang’ana atari nengeencho, abakong’aina abande ase ayio.

English: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
Kiswahili: Hao ni lazima wanyamazishwe, kwa sababu wanaharibu watu wa nyumba nzima wakifundisha mambo yasiyowapasa kufundisha. Wanafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya kujipatia mapato ya udanganyifu.
Ekegusii: Abwo mbagwenerete bakirigwe, ekiagera nkoonchorana bare abanto b’echinyomba chingima ase okworokereria aya’atagwenereti, naende ase obosooku, barabwo nigo bakorigia kwenyorera chitaabu.

English: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
Kiswahili: Hata mmojawapo wa manabii wao mwenyewe amesema, “Wakrete ni waongo siku zote, wanyama wabaya, walafi, wavivu.”
Ekegusii: Omonto oyomo obo Omokirete, omobani obo abanyene, oteebire, “Abanto ba Kirete nabanyaborimo botambe, ne ching’iti chintindi chi’orosana, abaribobe aboro.”

English: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
Kiswahili: Ushuhuda huu ni kweli. Kwa hiyo, uwakemee kwa ukali wapate kuwa wazima katika imani,
Ekegusii: Ase igo nekogwenerete kobatogonyera bokong’u erio batware okwegena kore buya.

English: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
Kiswahili: ili wasiendelee kuangalia hadithi za Kiyahudi au maagizo ya wale watu wanaoikataa kweli.
Ekegusii: Naende totwara ribaga ri’ogotegerera emegano y’Abayahudi, gose amachiiko y’abanto abwo bakwanga ekeene.

English: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
Kiswahili: Kwa wale walio safi, kila kitu ni safi kwao. Lakini kwa wale waliopotoka na wasioamini, hakuna chochote kilicho safi. Kwa kweli nia zao na dhamiri zao zimepotoka.
Ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi nebichenu ase abwo bare abachenu, korende tikeri ekere egechenu ase abwo batachenegeti na abategeneti, ekiagera ebirengererio biabo na okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime biabeire ebitachenegeti.

English: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
Kiswahili: Wanadai kumjua Mungu, lakini kwa matendo yao wanamkana. Hao watu ni chukizo, wasiotii, wasiofaa kwa jambo lolote jema.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba ng’a mbamomanyete Nyasae, korende ase ogokora kwabo bagekaana. Nigo bare abokogeechia, abatari koigwera, na ase ayio tibakonyaara gokora ogokora konde gwonsi okuya.

English: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
Kiswahili: Inakupasa kufundisha itikadi sahihi.
Ekegusii: Korende aye, nekobetereretie gokwana amang’ana agwenerete okworokereria gw’okwegena.

English: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
Kiswahili: Wafundishe wazee kuwa na kiasi, wastahivu, wenye busara na wanyofu katika imani, upendo na saburi.
Ekegusii: Oorokererie abagaaka babe aberiiti, abare n’ogosika, aberendete ase onsi, babe abagima ase okwegena, ase obwanchani, na ase oboremereria.

English: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, wafundishe wanawake wazee kuwa na mwenendo wa utakatifu, wala wasiwe wasingiziaji au walevi, bali wafundishe yale yaliyo mema,
Ekegusii: Naboigo oorokererie abakungu abagotu babe norogendo rw’obochenu, tibaaba abang’aachi, gose abasomba gochia ase edivai. Yababetereirie barabwo babe aborokia b’ayare amaya,

English: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
Kiswahili: ili waweze kuwafundisha wanawake vijana kuwa na kiasi, wawapende waume zao na kuwapenda watoto wao,
Ekegusii: erinde borokererie abakungu abake banche abasacha babo, na abana babo.

English: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
Kiswahili: wawe waaminifu, watakatifu, wakitunza vyema nyumba zao, wema, watiifu kwa waume zao, ili mtu yeyote asije akalikufuru neno la Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naende babe aberendete ase onsi, abachenu, abagokora emeremo ase chinka chiabo, abaya, abaigwerete abasacha babo abanyene, erinde ring’ana ria Nyasae tiriramwa nonde bwensi.

English: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, himiza vijana wawe na kiasi.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, obasorore abamura babe aberiti ase onsi.

English: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
Kiswahili: Katika kila jambo uwe kielelezo kwa kutenda mema. Katika mafundisho yako uonyeshe uadilifu, utaratibu,
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana onsi, aye omonyene bweorokie koba ekiorokererio ki’ogokora okuya. Okwane ayare ekeene na kworokereria nokwerwa gwonsi.

English: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
Kiswahili: na usemi sahihi usio na lawama, ili wanaokupinga watahayari, wakose neno lolote baya la kusema juu yetu.
Ekegusii: Ogokwana kwao kobe ogoikeranu, okwo gotanyaare gosoerwa, erinde omoengereria onde bwensi asooke, taaba ne ring’ana riibe agokwana igoro yaito.

English: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watumwa kuwatii mabwana zao katika kila jambo, wakijitahidi kuwapendeza wala wasijibizane nao,
Ekegusii: Abasomba mbagwenerete baigwere naboigo kobagokia abanene babo ase amang’ana onsi, na tibaaba abakobairaneria bobe,

English: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
Kiswahili: wala wasiwaibie, bali waonyeshe kuwa wanaweza kuaminika kabisa, ili kwa kila namna wayafanye mafundisho ya Mungu Mwokozi wetu yawe ya kuvutia.
Ekegusii: tibaaba abakobaibera. Korende babaorokie obwegenwa obuya ase onsi, erinde ase amang’ana onsi yogokora kwabo abe ekiorokererio ekiya gi’okworokereria kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito.

English: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana neema ya Mungu ambayo inawaokoa wanadamu wote imefunuliwa.
Ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae oorokriie obuya bwaye ase ogotooreka ase Mwanyabaanto bonsi.

English: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
Kiswahili: Nayo yatufundisha kukataa ubaya na tamaa za kidunia, ili tupate kuishi maisha ya kiasi, ya haki na ya utaua katika ulimwengu huu wa sasa,
Ekegusii: Obo nigo bogotworokereria okwanga amang’ana atari y’obonyasae ase obomenyo bwaito, na okogania okobe gw’ense eye, erinde tonyaare kwerenda ase onsi, na koba noboronge amo ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae ime ase ense eye,

English: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: huku tukilitazamia tumaini lenye baraka na ufunuo wa utukufu wa Mungu wetu Mkuu, aliye Mwokozi wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: gatoganyete ogoikeranigwa ogosemeria kwe Rituko Risesenirie, na okooroka kw’obonene bwa Nyasae omonene, na Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso,

English: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
Kiswahili: Ndiye alijitoa nafsi yake kwa ajili yetu, ili atukomboe kutoka uovu wote na kujisafishia watu kuwa mali yake Mwenyewe, yaani, wale walio na juhudi katika kutenda mema.
Ekegusii: Ere omonyene oyobweruete ase engencho yaito, erinde atoboorie korwa ase ogosaria gwonsi, naboigo gotosibia ere omonyene abanto babe abaye, bare nomokia ase ogokora okuya.

English: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
Kiswahili: Basi wewe fundisha mambo haya. Onya na kukaripia kwa mamlaka yote. Mtu yeyote asikudharau.
Ekegusii: Kwana amang’ana aya, ase okobua gwonsi ore nakwo, kuurera, na gotogonyera abategereri bao. Tibwanchera omonto onde bwensi agochaaye.

English: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
Kiswahili: Wakumbushe watu kuwanyenyekea watawala na kuwatii wenye mamlaka, wawe tayari kutenda kila lililo jema.
Ekegusii: Oinyorie abanto bao bekeyie ase abagaambi, na ase abare nokobua, naende babe abaigweri, ase kera enchera bebeke ang’e gokora ogokora okuya.

English: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
Kiswahili: Wasimnenee mtu yeyote mabaya, wasiwe wagomvi, bali wawe wapole, wakionyesha unyenyekevu kwa watu wote.
Ekegusii: Obateebie tibakwana bobe igoro ya monto onde bwensi, korende barabwo babe abanto b’omorembe n’obosaani, babe abaremereria naende abakoorokia obwororo ase abanto bonsi.

English: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
Kiswahili: Maana sisi wenyewe wakati fulani tulikuwa wajinga, wasiotii, tukiwa watumwa wa tamaa mbaya na anasa za kila aina. Tuliishi katika uovu na wivu, tukichukiwa na kuchukiana sisi kwa sisi.
Ekegusii: Inaki agwo ritang’ani naintwe nigo twarenge abariri, abaenenu, na abang’ainegete. Nigo twarenge abosomba b’okogania okobe gwe chingeencho ao ao ase okwegokia. Tokamenya ase obobe n’emoko, tokogeechigwa na kogeechana.

English: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
Kiswahili: Lakini wema na upendo wa Mungu Mwokozi wetu ulipofunuliwa,
Ekegusii: Korende ekero oboitongo na obwanchani bwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito bwaorogetigwe,

English: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
Kiswahili: alituokoa, si kwa sababu ya matendo ya haki tuliyotenda, bali kwa sababu ya rehema zake. Alituokoa kwa kutuosha kwa kuzaliwa mara ya pili na kwa kufanywa wapya kwa njia ya Roho Mtakatifu,
Ekegusii: ere agatotooria, tari ase ogokora kw’oboronge twakorete intwe, korende ase amaabera aye ere omonyene ogosibigwa goetera ase Omoika Omochenu oyio ogotoa okoiborwa okoyia, na obogima oboyia.

English: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
Kiswahili: ambaye Mungu alitumiminia kwa wingi kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo Mwokozi wetu,
Ekegusii: Oyo atoitererete Omoika Omochenu ase obonge goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omotooria oito,

English: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
Kiswahili: ili kwamba, tukiisha kuhesabiwa haki kwa neema yake, tupate kuwa warithi tukiwa na tumaini la uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: erinde obuya bwaye, tonyore oboronge ase ere Nyasae Omobui erio, tonyaare koba abanyamwando b’obogima bwa kare na kare, obwo tosemeretie.

English: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
Kiswahili: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa. Nami nataka uyasisitize mambo haya, ili wale ambao wamemwamini Mungu wapate kuwa waangalifu kujitoa kwa ajili ya kutenda mema wakati wote. Mambo haya ni mazuri tena ya manufaa kwa kila mtu.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene. Igoro y’amang’ana ayio nindigetie oyakwane ne chinguru, erinde abwo bamwegenete Nyasae banyaare kwerua ase ogokora okuya. Amang’ana aya namaya, naende nanyare gokoonya abanto bonsi.

English: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
Kiswahili: Lakini jiepushe na maswali ya kipuzi, mambo ya koo, mabishano na ugomvi kuhusu sheria, kwa sababu hayana faida, tena ni ubatili.
Ekegusii: Korende aye, bweatanane korwa ase amaborio y’oboriri, n’omoroberio omotambe bwe chinderia chi’echisokoro, na eriomana, na okoamererania igoro y’amachiiko, ekiagera tibigokoonya kende, naende tibiri nengeencho.

English: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
Kiswahili: Mtu anayesababisha mafarakano, mwonye mara ya kwanza, kisha mwonye mara ya pili. Baada ya hapo, usihusike naye tena.
Ekegusii: Omoe omonto oraarente okweatanana ogokuurera goika kabere, korwa agwo, aye tobaisa koba n’ering’ana rinde asare ere.

English: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa unajua kwamba mtu kama huyo amepotoka na tena ni mwenye dhambi. Yeye amejihukumu mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Nomanyete buna omonto onga buna oyio nomosareku, naende ebibe biaye biamwatananire, nere omonyene bwegaambirie.

English: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
Kiswahili: Mara nitakapomtuma Artema au Tikiko kwako, jitahidi kuja unione huko Nikopoli, kwa sababu nimeamua kukaa huko wakati wa majira ya baridi.
Ekegusii: Kondatome Artemas gose Tukiko gocha ase ore, teema buna oranyaare gocha ase ’nde aria Nikopoli bwango, inaki nindengereretie komenya aroro ekero gi’etoigo.

English: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
Kiswahili: Fanya kila uwezalo uwasafirishe Zena yule mwanasheria na Apolo na uhakikishe kwamba wana kila kitu wanachohitaji katika safari yao.
Ekegusii: Kora omokia gokoonya Zena, omonogeri bw’amachiiko, na Apolo, ekero okobatoma ase orogeendo rw’abo, na origererie buya ng’a ’mbabwate kera ekemo keria baganetie.

English: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
Kiswahili: Watu wetu hawana budi kujifunza kutenda mema, ili waweze kuyakimu mahitaji ya kila siku, wasije wakaishi maisha yasiyokuwa na matunda.
Ekegusii: Na abanto baito tiga beorokererie kwerua ase ogokora okuya, na gokoonya aase oboremerwa bore ase ekeene, erinde tibaaba abataisaini kende gionsi.

English: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
Kiswahili: Wote walio pamoja nami wanakusalimu. Wasalimu wale wanaotupenda katika imani. Neema iwe nanyi nyote. Amen.
Ekegusii: Aba bonsi bare amo nainche bagokwanirie. Tokwanerie baria abasani baito ase okwegena. Obuya bwa Nyasae Omobui bobe ase more mwensi. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
Kiswahili: Paulo, mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu, pamoja na Timotheo ndugu yetu: Kwa Filemoni rafiki yetu mpendwa na mtendakazi mwenzetu,
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omosibwa ase engencho ya Kristo Yeso, boigo korwa ase oyominto Timotheo ase Filemoni, omwanchwa oito, omokori emeremo amo naintwe.

English: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
Kiswahili: kwa dada yetu mpendwa Afia, kwa Arkipo askari mwenzetu na kwa kanisa lile likutanalo nyumbani mwako:
Ekegusii: Na abanto b’ekanisa ekoumerana ase enyomba yao, naboigo Apia, mosubati ominto, na Arikipo, omorwani ore amo naintwe.

English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Neema iwe nanyi na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae tata oito na Omonene Yeso Kristo abae obuya na omorembe.

English: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
Kiswahili: Siku zote ninamshukuru Mungu ninapokukumbuka katika maombi yangu,
Ekegusii: Oyominto Filemoni, ase ogosaba kwane botambe nigo ngoakera Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono ekero ngokoinyora.

English: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ninasikia juu ya imani yako katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wako kwa watakatifu wote.
Ekegusii: Ayio nase engencho nkoigwa amang’ana igoro y’obwanchani bwao ase abanto bonsi b’Omonene, na okwegena kwao obwate ase Omonene Yeso.

English: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
Kiswahili: Naomba utiwe nguvu katika kuishuhudia imani yako, ili upate kuwa na ufahamu mkamilifu juu ya kila kitu chema tulicho nacho ndani ya Kristo.
Ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a okobwatana gw’okwegena tore nakorokwo gokore emeremo, erinde omanye mono kobua kera egento ogosesenigwa kore ase tore intwe ase okobwatana na Kristo.

English: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
Kiswahili: Upendo wako umenifurahisha mno na kunitia moyo, kwa sababu wewe ndugu, umeiburudisha mioyo ya watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naki oyominto, nigo nabeete nomogooko omonge na okoremigwa ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao! Chinkoro chi’abaanto b’Omonene bonsi chiasasokire.

English: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ingawa katika Kristo ningeweza kuwa na ujasiri na kukuagiza yale yakupasayo kutenda,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ninde noboremu obonge buna momura omino ase Kristo kogochika eri ogwenerete okore.

English: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: lakini ninakuomba kwa upendo, mimi Paulo, mzee na pia sasa nikiwa mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu,
Ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’obwanchani bwane ase ore, nanchire kobua kogosorora, buna inche Paulo inde omotomwa, naende inde omosibwa o Kristo Yeso.

English: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
Kiswahili: nakuomba kwa ajili ya mwanangu Onesimo, aliyefanyika mwanangu nilipokuwa kwenye minyororo.
Ekegusii: Nagosoroire ase ribaga riaye omwana one ase Kristo, Onesimo oyio ekero nare ase egesibo kiane, obete omwana one kemoika.

English: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
Kiswahili: Mwanzoni alikuwa hakufai, lakini sasa anakufaa sana wewe na mimi pia.
Ekegusii: Agwo kare tarenge taisainegento kende ase ore, korende bono obeire oyo bw’engeencho mono ase ore nainche boigo.

English: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
Kiswahili: Namtuma kwako, yeye aliye moyo wangu hasa.
Ekegusii: Ere namotomire gocha ase ore, na nigo enga buna nigo abogoretie enkoro yane.

English: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
Kiswahili: Ningependa nikae naye ili ashike nafasi yako ya kunisaidia wakati huu nikiwa kifungoni kwa ajili ya Injili.
Ekegusii: Naki inche nigo narenge kogania abeere aiga amo nainche ase nsibire ase engencho y’enchiri, erinde anyare gonkorera ribaga riao.

English: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
Kiswahili: Lakini sikutaka kufanya lolote bila idhini yako, ili wema wowote uufanyao usiwe wa lazima, bali wa hiari.
Ekegusii: Korende tindigeti okore ing’ana rinde rionsi ase ogokobetereria erio aye onkoonye, korende erio ebe ase ogwancha kwao aye omonyene. Inche tinkonyara gokora ing’ana rinde rionsi otatiga aye gwancheranire narirorio.

English: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
Kiswahili: Huenda sababu ya yeye kutengwa nawe kwa kitambo kidogo ni ili uwe naye daima.
Ekegusii: Aande nakio kiagerete Onesimo agaatananwa korwa ase ore ase ekero egeke, erinde airane koba ase ore ase ebiro bionsi.

English: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Si kama mtumwa, bali bora kuliko mtumwa, kama ndugu mpendwa. Yeye ni mpendwa sana kwangu na hata kwako zaidi, yeye kama mwanadamu na kama ndugu katika Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naende ere bono tari buna omosomba, korende goetania omosomba; buna oyominto omwanchwa, ase Kristo. Asende mono, na ase ore mono kobua, buna omosomba, naende buna oyominto ase Omonene!

English: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kama unanihesabu mimi kuwa mshirika wako, mkaribishe kama vile ungenikaribisha mimi mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Gaki, onye kondengereretie inche buna omobwatani oo, omooroisie koreng’ana buna kware kondoisia inche.

English: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
Kiswahili: Kama amekukosea lolote au kama unamdai chochote, nidai mimi.
Ekegusii: Onye okomocheire ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, gose okoriete esira, oyeborie goetera ase ’nde.

English: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
Kiswahili: Ni mimi Paulo, ninayeandika waraka huu kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe. Nitakulipa. Sitaji kwamba nakudai hata nafsi yako.
Ekegusii: Inche Paulo nariikire aya nokoboko kwane omonyene, ning’akane. Amaene, ninyare kogoteebia, ng’a nore nesira ase ’nde, ase obogima bwao aye omonyene.

English: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
Kiswahili: Ndugu yangu, natamani nipate faida kwako katika Bwana, uuburudishe moyo wangu katika Kristo.
Ekegusii: Ee, oyominto, ninganetie obokonyi bokorwa ase ore, ekiagera noyo bw’Omonene ore. Buna oyominto ase Kristo, ong’e omoyo!

English: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
Kiswahili: Nikiwa na hakika ya utii wako, nakuandikia, nikijua kwamba utafanya hata zaidi ya yale ninayokuomba.
Ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene aiga buna ngokoriikera aya, ng’a nokore buna nagosabire ekiagera nomoigweri ore, naende ase ayio nimanyete ng’a nokore goetania.

English: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
Kiswahili: Jambo moja zaidi: Niandalie chumba cha wageni, kwa kuwa nataraji kurudishwa kwenu kama jibu la maombi yenu.
Ekegusii: Amo nayio, ondoiserie aase ngocha komenya, naki ninsemeretie ng’a Omonene Nyasae nayairanerie goetera ase ogosaba kwaino mwensi erio imbe nainwe.

English: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
Kiswahili: Epafra, aliye mfungwa mwenzangu katika Kristo Yesu, anakusalimu.
Ekegusii: Epafara, oyosibire amo nainche ase engencho ya Kristo Yeso, ogokwanirie.

English: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo Marko, Aristarko, Dema na Luka, watendakazi wenzangu wanakusalimu.
Ekegusii: Boigo Mariko na Aristariko, na Dema, na Luka.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
Kiswahili: Neema ya Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja na roho zenu. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

English: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
Kiswahili: Zamani Mungu alisema na baba zetu kwa njia ya manabii mara nyingi na kwa njia mbalimbali,
Ekegusii: Agwo kare, Nyasae nigo are gokwana n’echisokoro chiaito ebiro ebinge ne chinchera chinyinge goetera ase ababani,

English: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.
Kiswahili: lakini katika siku hizi za mwisho anasema nasi kwa njia ya Mwanawe, ambaye amemweka kuwa mrithi wa vitu vyote, na ambaye kupitia kwake aliuumba ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: korende ase amatuko aya y’omoerio okwanire naintwe goetera ase Omwana oye. Ere oyo Nyasae aragete koba omonyamwando bw’ebinto bionsi, na goetera asare agatonga ense.

English: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,
Kiswahili: Mwana ni mngʼao wa utukufu wa Mungu na mfano halisi wa nafsi yake, akivihifadhi vitu vyote kwa neno lake lenye uweza. Akiisha kufanya utakaso kwa ajili ya dhambi, aliketi mkono wa kuume wa Aliye Mkuu huko mbinguni.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo agotobareria obonene bwa Nyasae, na buna Nyasae are, nere naboigo are, naende nigo akobogoria ebinto bionsi ne ring’ana riaye ri’okobua. Gaikire gokora ogosibigwa kw’ebibe, agaikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Obonene igoro.

English: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo alifanyika bora kuliko malaika, kama jina alilorithi lilivyo bora kuliko lao.
Ekegusii: Omwana agakorwa koba omonene kobua abamalaika, buna erieta eri anyorete ri’omwando rire rinene kobua ayabo.

English: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni malaika yupi ambaye wakati wowote Mungu alipata kumwambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu; leo mimi nimekuzaa?” Au tena, “Mimi nitakuwa Baba yake, naye atakuwa Mwanangu?”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae tatebetie momalaika onde bwensi, “Aye, naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire”? Gose naende, “Inche nimbe asare ise, nere ase ’nde nabe Omwana one”?

English: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”
Kiswahili: Tena, Mungu amletapo mzaliwa wake wa kwanza ulimwenguni, anasema, “Malaika wote wa Mungu na wamsujudu.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Nyasae arenge ange gotoma Omwana oye omotangi gocha ase ense, nigo atebete: “Abamalaika bonsi ba Nyasae goika bamosasime.”

English: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”
Kiswahili: Anenapo kuhusu malaika asema, “Huwafanya malaika wake kuwa pepo, watumishi wake kuwa miali ya moto.”
Ekegusii: Korende igoro y’abamalaika Nyasae nigo agoteeba, “Nyasae nigo agokora Abamalaika baye koba chimbeo, na abasomba baye koba ebibemberi b’omorero.”

English: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa habari za Mwana asema, “Kiti chako cha enzi, Ee Mungu, kitadumu milele na milele, nayo haki itakuwa fimbo ya utawala ya ufalme wako.
Ekegusii: Korende igoro y’Omwana Nyasae agateeba, “Oboruoti bwao aye Nyasae, mbobeo kare na kare, nigo okogambera abanto bao ase oboronge.

English: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”
Kiswahili: Umependa haki na kuchukia uovu; kwa hiyo Mungu, Mungu wako, amekuweka juu ya wenzako kwa kukupaka mafuta ya furaha.”
Ekegusii: Nigo bwanchete oboronge, na kogechete ogosaria; ase ayio, Nyasae, oyore Nyasae oo, ogoakire amaguta, okorenteire omogooko kobua oyo bw’abande bamino.”

English: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.
Kiswahili: Pia asema, “Hapo mwanzo, Ee Bwana, uliweka misingi ya dunia, nazo mbingu ni kazi ya mikono yako.
Ekegusii: Naende agateeba. “Naye Omonene, kwabegete oboroso bw’ense korwa omochakano, na igoro chionsi nemeremo y’amaboko ao.

English: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.
Kiswahili: Hizo zitatoweka, lakini wewe utadumu; zote zitachakaa kama vazi.
Ekegusii: Ebio inabisire, korende aye nigo oragenderere kobao, birobio inabigote buna chianga,

English: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
Kiswahili: Utazikungʼutakungʼuta kama joho, nazo zitachakaa kama vazi. Lakini wewe hubadiliki, nayo miaka yako haikomi kamwe.”
Ekegusii: nobiringe buna egetambaa gi’okwambara, na birobio nabionchoke buna chianga. Korende aye naye oria oria ore buna kwarenge, na obogima bwao tibokoba nomoerio.”

English: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”
Kiswahili: Je, ni kwa malaika yupi ambaye Mungu amepata kumwambia wakati wowote, “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako”?
Ekegusii: Nyasae tatebeti onde ase abamalaika baye: “Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika mbabeeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao”?

English: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
Kiswahili: Je, malaika wote si roho watumikao, waliotumwa kuwahudumia wale watakaourithi wokovu?
Ekegusii: Abamalaika ngento ki gotatiga emeika y’ogokorera Nyasae, batomire gokorera baria barache konyora omwando bw’ogotooreka?

English: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, imetupasa kuwa waangalifu sana kuhusu kile tulichosikia, ili tusije tukakiacha.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, netogwenerete gotegerera mono kobua na kobwata ayatwaigure, titocha gosira.

English: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kama ujumbe ulionenwa na malaika ulikuwa imara, na kila uasi na kutokutii kulipata adhabu ya haki,
Ekegusii: Ring’ana riria riakwanetwe gochia ase Chisokoro chiaito nabamalaika nigo riarenge eri’ekeene, na kera oyotaribwatetie gose korigwera nigo anyorete egesusuro keria kiamobwenerete.

English: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,
Kiswahili: je, sisi tutapaje kupona kama tusipojali wokovu mkuu namna hii? Wokovu huu, ambao mwanzo ulitangazwa na Bwana, ulithibitishwa kwetu na wale waliomsikia.
Ekegusii: Inee, naki intwe toranyare gwetooria onye twangire ogotooreka okonene buna oko? Ritang’ani Omonene naraaretie ogotooreka oko, naende baria bamoigwete batoenekeirie buna n’eriekeene.

English: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?
Kiswahili: Pia Mungu aliushuhudia kwa ishara, maajabu na kwa miujiza mbalimbali, na karama za Roho Mtakatifu alizozigawa kulingana na mapenzi yake.
Ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamenta oborori bwaye nebimanyererio, na amakumia, na ebikone bie chinguru ao ao amo na kogabera abanto ebiegwa bi’Omoika Omochenu koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye.

English: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.
Kiswahili: Mungu hakuuweka ulimwengu ujao ambao tunanena habari zake chini ya malaika.
Ekegusii: Naki tari inse y’abamalaika Nyasae abegete Ense eria egochi‐gocha, eyio togokwana.

English: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
Kiswahili: Lakini kuna mahali mtu fulani ameshuhudia akisema: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani hata unamfikiria, binadamu ni nani hata unamjali?
Ekegusii: Korende nigo egotebekana aase gete ase amariiko: “Mwanyabaanto inki aisaine aye Nyasae ogendererete komorengereria? Mwanyabaanto inki aisaine aye okomorenda?

English: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.
Kiswahili: Umemfanya chini kidogo kuliko malaika; ukamvika taji ya utukufu na heshima,
Ekegusii: Kwamokorire omoke kobua abamalaika ase ekero egeke, kwamobekeire egutwa y’obonene na amasikani.

English: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.
Kiswahili: nawe umeweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu yake.” Kwa kuweka vitu vyote chini yake, Mungu hakuacha kitu chochote ambacho hakukiweka chini ya mwanadamu. Lakini kwa sasa, hatuoni kwamba kila kitu kiko chini yake.
Ekegusii: Okabakora koba abateneneri igoro ase ebinto bionsi.” Naki ase okobeeka ebinto bionsi inse yaye tatigete gento kende atabegete inse yaye. Korende goika bono titorarora ere okogambera ebinto bionsi bibekire inse yaye.

English: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.
Kiswahili: Lakini twamwona Yesu, aliyefanywa chini kidogo kuliko malaika, sasa akiwa amevikwa taji ya utukufu na heshima kwa sababu alistahimili mauti, ili kwamba kwa neema ya Mungu apate kuonja mauti kwa ajili ya kila mtu.
Ekegusii: Korende twarorire Yeso oyio ase ekero egeke okoretwe koba omoke kobua abamalaika, erio goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae akwe ase engencho ya kera omonto. Bono nigo tokomorora obekeirwe egutwa y’obonene na amasikani ase engencho y’ogochandwa kwaye kw’amakweri.

English: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
Kiswahili: Ili kuwaleta wana wengi katika utukufu, ilifaa kwamba Mungu, ambaye ni kwa ajili yake na kupitia kwake kila kitu kimekuwepo, amkamilishe mwanzilishi wa wokovu wao kwa njia ya mateso.
Ekegusii: Naki ase engencho ya Nyasae, na ase okobua kwaye, ebinto bionsi mbireo. Ase ayio yamogwenerete ere goikerania Omochaki bw’ogotooreka gwaito goetera ase emechando, erio aire abana abange ase obonene. Ekiagera Yeso nere okoraa gochia ogotoreka

English: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
Kiswahili: Yeye awafanyaye watu kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na hao ambao hufanywa watakatifu, wote hutoka katika jamaa moja. Hivyo Yesu haoni aibu kuwaita ndugu zake.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyogochena amo nabwo bagochenwa nigo babwate ise oyomo. Nakio gekogera Yeso atari korora obosoku kobaroka abamwabo.

English: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”
Kiswahili: Yeye husema, “Nitalitangaza jina lako kwa ndugu zangu; mbele ya kusanyiko nitaimba sifa zako.”
Ekegusii: Agateebia Nyasae, “Nindarie erieta riao ase abaminto, ase egati y’omosangererekano ningotogie ase ogoteera.”

English: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
Kiswahili: Tena, “Nitaweka tumaini langu kwake.” Tena anasema, “Niko hapa, pamoja na watoto ambao Mungu amenipa.”
Ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteeba, “Nimosemerie Nyasae.” Naende oteeba, “Rora, inche nao inde aiga amo nabana baria naetwe na Nyasae.”

English: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
Kiswahili: Basi kwa kuwa watoto wana nyama na damu, yeye pia alishiriki katika ubinadamu wao, ili kwa kifo chake, apate kumwangamiza huyo mwenye nguvu za mauti, yaani ibilisi,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera abana buna akobaroka babwataine ase amanyinga ne chinyama, Yeso naboigo abwataine nayio ayio, erio ase enchera y’amakweri asirie ere oyore nokobua igoro y’amakweri, engencho yaye Saitani,

English: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
Kiswahili: na kuwaweka huru wale waliokuwa utumwani maisha yao yote kwa sababu ya kuogopa mauti.
Ekegusii: naende ase enchera eyio asibore abwo bonsi barenge abasomba ase obogima bwabo bwonsi, ekiagera bairogete amakweri.

English: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ni dhahiri kwamba hakuja kusaidia malaika, bali uzao wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Naki ayio namaene, ere tagwechandera abamalaika, korende nigo agwechandera oroiboro rwa Aburaamu.

English: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii ilibidi afanane na ndugu zake kwa kila hali, ili apate kuwa Kuhani Mkuu mwenye huruma na mwaminifu katika kumtumikia Mungu, ili pia apate kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, yamogwenerete abe buna abamwabo ase amang’ana onsi, erinde anyare koba Omokuani omonene, Omonyene amaabera, na omwegenwa ase ogokorera Nyasae, na koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe bia Mwanyabaanto.

English: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa yeye mwenyewe aliteswa alipojaribiwa, aweza kuwasaidia wale wanaojaribiwa.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera ere omonyene achandetwe na goteemwa, nanyare gokonya abwo bagoteemwa.

English: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu watakatifu, mnaoshiriki mwito wa mbinguni, mtafakarini Yesu, mtume na Kuhani Mkuu wa ukiri wetu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abaminto abachenu, ababwatani b’okorangerigwa gokorwa igoro, morengererie mono Yeso omotomwa na Omokuani Omonene bw’okoorokia gwaito.

English: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.
Kiswahili: Alikuwa mwaminifu kwa yeye aliyemweka, kama vile Mose alivyokuwa mwaminifu katika nyumba yote ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omwegenwa asare ere oyomochorete, buna Musa boigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae.

English: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
Kiswahili: Yesu ameonekana anastahili heshima kubwa kuliko Mose, kama vile mjenzi wa nyumba alivyo wa heshima kubwa kuliko nyumba yenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki Yeso nigo abarirwe ng’a nemogwenerete abe nobonene mono kobua Musa, buna omoagachi enyomba are nogosikwa kobua enyomba enyene.

English: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa kila nyumba hujengwa na mtu fulani, lakini Mungu ni mjenzi wa kila kitu.
Ekegusii: (Kera enyomba nigo ekoagachwa nomonto, korende Nyasae nere omoagachi bw’ebinto bionsi.)

English: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
Kiswahili: Basi Mose kama mtumishi alikuwa mwaminifu katika nyumba yote ya Mungu, akishuhudia kwa yale ambayo yangetamkwa baadaye.
Ekegusii: Na Musa nigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae buna omokoreri, erinde abe kirori ase amang’ana arache gokwanwa,

English: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
Kiswahili: Lakini Kristo ni mwaminifu kama Mwana katika nyumba ya Mungu. Sisi ndio nyumba yake, kama tutashikilia sana ujasiri wetu na tumaini tunalojivunia.
Ekegusii: korende Kristo nigo are omwegenwa buna Omwana igoro ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Intwe nenyomba yaye gatorabwate bokong’u oboremu na ogwetogia kw’ogosemeria goika omoerio.

English: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kama Roho Mtakatifu asemavyo: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna Omoika Omochenu ogokwana, “Reero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye,

English: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
Kiswahili: msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu, kama mlivyofanya katika uasi, wakati ule wa kujaribiwa jangwani,
Ekegusii: timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino, buna ekero keria gi’okogechia, ase rituko riria ri’ogoteemwa agwo ase erooro.

English: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
Kiswahili: ambapo baba zenu walinijaribu na kunipima ingawa kwa miaka arobaini walikuwa wameyaona matendo yangu.
Ekegusii: Agwo chisokoro chiaino nchianteemete ase okondenga, naende nchiaroche ogokora kwane ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.

English: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
Kiswahili: Hiyo ndiyo sababu nilikasirikia kizazi kile, nami nikasema, ‘Siku zote mioyo yao imepotoka, nao hawajazijua njia zangu.’
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nkagechigwa nekegori keria, ngateba: Botambe abanto aba nigo basirete ase chinkoro chiabo, ne chinchera chiane tibachimanyeti,

English: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
Kiswahili: Hivyo nikatangaza kwa kiapo katika hasira yangu, ‘Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.’ ”
Ekegusii: buna natianire ase endamwamu yane: Tibagosoa ense eria ase nare gocha kobaa ogotimoka.”

English: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, angalieni, asiwepo miongoni mwenu mtu mwenye moyo mwovu usioamini, unaojitenga na Mungu aliye hai.
Ekegusii: Rigereria baminto, taba onde omo oino oyore nenkoro embe y’ogotegena, abaise kweatanana korwa ase Nyasae ore moyo.

English: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtiane moyo mtu na mwenzake kila siku, maadamu iitwapo Leo, ili asiwepo hata mmoja wenu mwenye kufanywa mgumu kwa udanganyifu wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Korende moremanie inwe ase inwe kera rituko, ekero gekorokwa ekia Reero, erinde ase, more onde takorwa koba omokong’u ase obong’ainereria bw’ebibe.

English: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tumekuwa washiriki wa Kristo, kama tukishikamana tu kwa uthabiti na tumaini letu la kwanza hadi mwisho.
Ekegusii: Naki twabeire ababwatani na Kristo, gatorabwate bokong’u ogosemeria gwaito kw’eritang’ani goika omoerio.

English: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyonenwa: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake, msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu kama mlivyofanya wakati wa kuasi.”
Ekegusii: Agwo igo egokwanwa, “Reero, komoraigwe eriogi ria Nyasae, timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino’ buna ekero keria gi’okogechia.”

English: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?
Kiswahili: Basi ni nani waliosikia lakini bado wakaasi? Je, si wale wote waliotoka Misri wakiongozwa na Mose?
Ekegusii: Naki mbarabi baria bamogechetie ekero baigwete? Tari baria bonsi barwete Misiri, baare koraagwa na Musa?

English: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
Kiswahili: Lakini ni nani aliowakasirikia miaka arobaini? Je, si wale waliofanya dhambi ambao miili yao ilianguka jangwani?
Ekegusii: Naende mbarabi abwo ere agechetigwe nabarabwo ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene? Tari baria bakorete ebibe, abwo emebere yabo yagwete ase erooro?

English: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
Kiswahili: Ni nani hao ambao Mungu aliapa kuwa kamwe hawataingia rahani mwake isipokuwa ni wale waliokataa kutii?
Ekegusii: Naende nase barabi atianete ng’a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye? Tari ase baria bangete koigwera?

English: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.
Kiswahili: Hivyo tunaona kwamba hawakuweza kuingia kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwao.
Ekegusii: Na igo twarorire ng’a tibanyarete gosoa ase ense eria ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo.

English: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa bado ahadi ya kuingia rahani iko wazi, tujihadhari ili hata mmoja wenu asije akaikosa.
Ekegusii: Gaki, onye eira eria y’ogosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye ereo, tiga toiroke ng’a onde omo oino tabaisa konyorekana ng’a omochire gokonyora.

English: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana sisi pia tumesikia Injili iliyohubiriwa kwetu, kama nao walivyosikia; lakini ujumbe ule waliousikia haukuwa na maana kwao, kwa sababu wale waliousikia hawakuuchanganya na imani.
Ekegusii: Naki ekeene, intwe twaranderigwe amang’ana amaya buna barabwo. Korende ring’ana riria baigwete tiriabakonyete, ekiagera ekero baare koriigwa tiriasang’ananete nabarabwo ase okwegena.

English: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
Kiswahili: Sasa sisi ambao tumeamini tunaingia katika ile raha, kama vile Mungu alivyosema, “Kwa hiyo nikaapa katika hasira yangu, ‘Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.’ ” Lakini kazi yake ilikamilika tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe, abatwegenire, nigo torasoe ase ogotimoka okwo agoteeba, “Buna natianire ase endamwamu yane, Tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane nonya ng’ake”, nonya emeremo yaye yaerete korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe.

English: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mahali fulani amezungumza kuhusu siku ya saba, akisema: “Katika siku ya saba Mungu alipumzika kutoka kazi zake zote.”
Ekegusii: Naki nigo ateebete aase gete igoro ye rituko ria gatano na kabere, “Nyasae nigo atimogete rituko ria gatano na kabere, agatiga emeremo yaye yonsi.”

English: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
Kiswahili: Tena hapo juu asema, “Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.”
Ekegusii: Naende aiga nigo agoteeba, “Tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane nonya ng’ake.”

English: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo inabaki kuwa wazi kwa wengine kuingia, nao wale wa kwanza waliopokea Injili walishindwa kuingia kwa sababu ya kutokutii.
Ekegusii: Gaki, ase ayio ring’ana ndireo, ng’a mbare abanto barache gosoa. Abwo baranderetigwe amang’ana amaya ritang’ani bakamocha gosoa ase engencho y’ogotaigwera kwabo.

English: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu ameweka siku nyingine, akaiita Leo, akisema kwa kinywa cha Daudi baadaye sana, kwa maneno yaliyotangulia kunenwa: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake, msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu.”
Ekegusii: Naende obekire rituko gete, neri nario ria Reero. Aya nigo akwanete goetera ase Daudi magega y’engaki entambe, buna konya aikire gokwana, “Reero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye, timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino.”

English: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama Yoshua alikuwa amewapa raha, Mungu hangesema tena baadaye kuhusu siku nyingine.
Ekegusii: Naki onye Yoshua nabaete ogotimoka, anga Nyasae magega yaye tare gokwana igoro ye rituko rinde.

English: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo basi, imebaki raha ya Sabato kwa ajili ya watu wa Mungu;
Ekegusii: Ase igo, ogotimoka gw’esabato gwatigaire ase abanto ba Nyasae.

English: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa kila mmoja aingiaye katika raha ya Mungu pia hupumzika kutoka kazi zake mwenyewe, kama vile Mungu alivyopumzika kutoka kazi zake.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyosoire ase ogotimoka kwa Nyasae, ere omonyene otimokire korwa ase emeremo yaye, buna Nyasae atimogete korwa ase eyaye.

English: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
Kiswahili: Basi, na tufanye bidii kuingia katika raha hiyo, ili kwamba asiwepo yeyote atakayeanguka kwa kufuata mfano wao wa kutokutii.
Ekegusii: Gaki, tokore omokia gosoa ase ogotimoka koria, erinde onde tacha kogwa ase ogotaigwera kogwekaine koria koria.

English: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Neno la Mungu li hai tena lina nguvu. Lina makali kuliko upanga wowote wenye makali kuwili, hivyo linachoma hata kuzigawanya nafsi na roho, viungo na mafuta yaliyo ndani yake; tena li jepesi kuyatambua mawazo na makusudi ya moyo.
Ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rire moyo, naende ndire ne chinguru, nigo rire nobwoge kobua omoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere. Nigo rikobeta ime na gwatanana omoyo na omoika, chinengo na emeseto, naende ndinyare komanya ebirengererio na okogania bire ime ase enkoro.

English: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
Kiswahili: Wala hakuna kiumbe chochote kilichofichika machoni pa Mungu. Kila kitu kimefunuliwa na kiko wazi machoni pake yeye ambaye kwake ni lazima tutatoa hesabu.
Ekegusii: Naki getongwa kende tikeri getari maiso marore asare, korende ebinto bionsi nigo bire aarabu naende bimaanoire ase amaiso aye, ere oyo torache koa omobaro.

English: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tunaye Kuhani Mkuu kuliko wote ambaye ameingia mbinguni, Yesu Mwana wa Mungu, basi na tushikamane sana kwa uthabiti na ule ukiri wa imani yetu.
Ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera tore n’Omokuani Omonene mono, oyosoete igoro, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae, tobwate mono okoorokia gwaito.

English: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hatuna Kuhani Mkuu asiyeweza kuchukuliana na sisi katika udhaifu wetu, lakini tunaye mmoja ambaye alijaribiwa kwa kila namna, kama vile sisi tujaribiwavyo: lakini yeye hakutenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Naki titori n’Omokuani Omonene oyotanyare gotobogoreria oboreu bwaito, korende oyoteemetwe koreng’ana buna intwe ase amang’ana onsi, atakoreti ebibe.

English: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
Kiswahili: Basi na tukikaribie kiti cha rehema kwa ujasiri, ili tupewe rehema na kupata neema ya kutusaidia wakati wa mahitaji.
Ekegusii: Gaki, toike ang’e ase ekerogo ki’obonene aase obuya bore, erinde tonyore amaabera na obuya bw’ogotokonya ase engaki y’okoremerwa.

English: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila kuhani mkuu anayechaguliwa miongoni mwa wanadamu anawekwa kuwawakilisha kwa mambo yanayomhusu Mungu, ili apate kutoa matoleo na dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Naki kera Omokuani Omonene ore gochorwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto nigo are kobekwa ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, kobatenenera ase ogokorera Nyasae, arue ebiegwa na ebing’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.

English: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa yeye mwenyewe ni dhaifu, aweza kuwachukulia kwa upole wale wasiojua na kupotoka.
Ekegusii: Na ere oranyare kobabogoreria ase obwororo abwo batamanyeti gento na batantanire, ekiagera nere omonyene nigo abuire noboreu.

English: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu inampasa kutoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake mwenyewe na vivyo hivyo kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio yamogwenerete arue ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe biaye ere omonyene, buna are korua ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abaanto.

English: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
Kiswahili: Hakuna anayejitwalia heshima hii mwenyewe; ni lazima aitwe na Mungu, kama vile Aroni alivyoitwa.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tari bwenyoreire amasikani ayio ere omonyene, korende abe orangerigwe na Nyasae, buna Aroni arangeretigwe.

English: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”
Kiswahili: Pia Kristo hakujitwalia utukufu yeye mwenyewe wa kuwa Kuhani Mkuu, bali Mungu alimwambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu; leo mimi nimekuzaa.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo na Kristo, ere teimokereretie igoro ere omonyene koba Omokuani Omonene, korende nigo abegetwe nere oyomotebetie, “Aye naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire.”

English: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
Kiswahili: Pia mahali pengine asema, “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo akwanete aase aande, “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”

English: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
Kiswahili: Katika siku za maisha ya Yesu hapa duniani, alimtolea maombi na dua pamoja na kulia sana na machozi, yeye awezaye kumwokoa na mauti, naye Mungu akamsikia kwa sababu ya kutii kwake kwa unyenyekevu.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, ekero arenge ase omobere o Mwanyabaanto, Yeso agasaba na gosorora amo nokorera okonene, na amariga, asere oyorenge nokobua gw’okomotooria korwa ase amakweri, na akaigugwa ekiagera asigete Nyasae.

English: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
Kiswahili: Ingawa alikuwa Mwana, alijifunza utiifu kutokana na mateso aliyoyapata,
Ekegusii: Nonya orenge Omwana akeorokereria okoigwera ase emechando eyio yamonyorete,

English: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
Kiswahili: na akiisha kukamilishwa, akawa chanzo cha wokovu wa milele kwa wote wanaomtii.
Ekegusii: na gaikeranigwe akaba engencho y’ogotooreka gwa kare na kare ase abanto bonsi abamoigwerete,

English: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
Kiswahili: Naye amewekwa na Mungu kuwa Kuhani Mkuu kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.
Ekegusii: bwatoirwe na Nyasae ng’a n’Omokuani Omonene, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.

English: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
Kiswahili: Tunayo mengi ya kusema kuhusu habari ya ukuhani huu, lakini ni vigumu kuyaeleza, kwa sababu ninyi ni wazito wa kuelewa.
Ekegusii: Igoro yaye ntore namang’ana amange tware gokwana korende naakong’u koyorokereria, ekiagera mwabeire aboro ase okoigwa.

English: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.
Kiswahili: Kwa hakika, ingawa mpaka wakati huu ingewapasa kuwa walimu, bado mnahitaji mtu wa kuwafundisha tena hatua za awali za kweli ya Neno la Mungu. Mnahitaji maziwa, wala si chakula kigumu!
Ekegusii: Naki ekeene, inwe anga mwabeire aborokia, ekiagera ebiro ebinge biaetire, korende nebagwenerete oyonde aborokererie amorokererio e ritang’ani ay’amang’ana a Nyasae. Inwe nebagwenerete moegwe amabeere, gose tari endagera enkong’u.

English: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana yeyote aishiye kwa kunywa maziwa bado yeye ni mtoto mchanga, hana ujuzi katika mafundisho kuhusu neno la haki.
Ekegusii: Naki oyokonyora amabeere oka tamanyeti mono ring’ana ri’oboronge, ekiagera nomwana omoke.

English: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
Kiswahili: Lakini chakula kigumu ni kwa ajili ya watu wazima, ambao kwa kujizoeza wamejifunza kupambanua kati ya mema na mabaya.
Ekegusii: Korende endagera enkong’u ney’abaanto abanene, ekiagera barabwo mbanaretie ebirengererio biabo, na igo mbamanye ogwatanana amaya na amabe.

English: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, tukiachana na mafundisho yale ya awali kuhusu Kristo na tukisonga mbele ili tufikie utimilifu, sio kuweka tena msingi wa mafundisho ya kuzitubia kazi zisizo na uhai na imani katika Mungu,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, totige okworokereria kw’eritang’ani gwa Kristo, togenderere toikere oboikeranu. Titobeka naende oboroso bw’okoonchoka korwa ase ogokora gotari nobogima, na obw’okomwegena Nyasae,

English: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
Kiswahili: mafundisho kuhusu aina za ubatizo, kuwekea watu mikono, ufufuo wa wafu, na hukumu ya milele.
Ekegusii: na okworokereria gwe chibatiso, na okobekerwa kw’amaboko, na okobokigwa kw’abakuure, na okogambigwa gwa kare na kare.

English: This will we do, if God permits.
Kiswahili: Mungu akitujalia tutafanya hivyo.
Ekegusii: Natokore ayio, Nyasae karatwanchere.

English: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ni vigumu kwa wale ambao wakati fulani walishapata nuru, ambao walishaonja kipawa cha mbinguni, ambao wamekwisha kushiriki katika Roho Mtakatifu,
Ekegusii: Abwo baikire konyora omobaso, na koigwa ekeegwa gekorwa igoro, na babeire ababwatani b’Omoika Omochenu,

English: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
Kiswahili: ambao wameonja uzuri wa Neno la Mungu na nguvu za wakati ujao,
Ekegusii: na koigwa obuya bw’ering’ana ria Nyasae amo nogokora gwe chinguru gw’ekero kegochi‐gocha,

English: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
Kiswahili: kisha wakianguka, kuwarejesha tena katika toba. Kwa kuwa wanamsulubisha Mwana wa Mungu mara ya pili na kumdhalilisha hadharani, nayo ikawa hasara kwao.
Ekegusii: na magega y’ayio kobeatananire, tekonyarekana abwo bakorwe abayia naende ase okoonchorwa, ekiagera bamobambire naende Omwana o Nyasae barabwo abanyene, na komosookia maiso marore.

English: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;
Kiswahili: Ardhi ile ipokeayo mvua inyeshayo juu yake mara kwa mara hutoa mazao yanayowanufaisha wale ambao kwa ajili yao yalimwa, nayo nchi hiyo hupokea baraka kutoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki omogondo oyokonywa embura egotwa engaki ase engaki, na gokinia chinyeni, chigokonya abwo bakoyorema, nigo okonyora ogosesenigwa gokorwa ase Nyasae.

English: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
Kiswahili: Lakini ardhi ikizaa miiba na mibaruti, haina thamani na iko hatarini ya kulaaniwa. Mwisho wake ni kuchomwa moto.
Ekegusii: Korende korakinie amagwa na amageri, nigo oraangwe na koba ang’e nokorangererigwa, na omoerio oye nogosambwa.

English: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.
Kiswahili: Ingawa tunasema hivi, ndugu zangu wapendwa, kwa upande wenu tuna hakika ya mambo mema zaidi, mambo yale yahusuyo wokovu.
Ekegusii: Korende abanchani, nonya togokwana ayio, ntore nobomaene igoro yaino, ng’a mwanyorire amang’ana amaya kobua, ayakorenta ogotooreka.

English: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
Kiswahili: Mungu si mdhalimu: yeye hataisahau kazi yenu na upendo ule mlioonyesha kwa ajili yake katika kuwahudumia watakatifu na hata sasa mnaendelea kuwahudumia.
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tari buna oyotari omooronge, goika ebe emeremo yaino, na obwachani boria mwaorogetie ase engencho y’erieta riaye ekero mwakorerete abachenu, na nonya mbono nkobakorera more.

English: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
Kiswahili: Nasi twataka kila mmoja wenu aonyeshe bidii iyo hiyo ili mpate kujua uhakika kamili wa lile tumaini mpaka mwisho,
Ekegusii: Na intwe ntoganetie mono kera oyomo oino aorokie omokia oria goika omoerio, na igo amanye obomaene oboikeranu bw’ogosemeria kwaino.

English: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
Kiswahili: ili msije mkawa wavivu, bali mpate kuwaiga wale ambao kwa imani na saburi hurithi zile ahadi.
Ekegusii: Timoba aboro, korende mobe abegi b’abaraire ayabarieretwe chiira, buna omwando, goetera ase okwegena na oboremereria.

English: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
Kiswahili: Mungu alipompa Abrahamu ahadi yake, kwa kuwa hakuwepo mwingine aliyekuwa mkuu kuliko yeye ambaye angeweza kuapa kwa jina lake, aliapa kwa nafsi yake,
Ekegusii: Naki ekero Nyasae arierete Aburaamu eira agatiana; na ekiagera atarenge nonde omonene komobua asare ere aranyare gotiana, agetiania ere omonyene,

English: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”
Kiswahili: akisema, “Hakika nitakubariki na kukupa wazao wengi.”
Ekegusii: agateeba, “Ekeene, ogosesenia ningosesenie, na okomenta ninkomentekie.”

English: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu naye, baada ya kungoja kwa saburi, alipokea kile kilichoahidiwa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo ase okoremereria Aburaamu akanyora ayarieretwe eira.

English: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
Kiswahili: Wanadamu huapa kwa yeye aliye mkuu kuwaliko, nacho kiapo hicho huthibitisha kile kilichosemwa na hivyo humaliza mabishano yote.
Ekegusii: Naki abanto nigo bagotiana ase oyore omonene kobabua, na omoerio bw’okoamererania nemuma egokoora.

English: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,
Kiswahili: Mungu alipotaka kuonyesha kwa udhahiri zaidi ile asili ya kutokubadilika kwa ahadi yake kwa warithi wa ahadi, aliithitibisha kwa kiapo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero Nyasae arigetie koborokia mono kegima abaraire omwando oria abarierete eira buna atanyare koonchora ayaroberetie, akabeeka emuma gati.

English: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
Kiswahili: Mungu alifanya hivyo ili kwa vitu viwili visivyobadilika, yaani ahadi yake na kiapo chake, ambavyo kwavyo Mungu hawezi kusema uongo, sisi ambao tumemkimbilia ili tulishike lile tumaini lililowekwa mbele yetu tuwe na faraja thabiti.
Ekegusii: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong’u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.

English: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
Kiswahili: Tunalo tumaini hili kama nanga ya roho iliyo imara na thabiti. Tumaini hili huingia katika sehemu takatifu iliyopo nyuma ya pazia,
Ekegusii: Ogosemeria okwo tore nakorokwo buna ekeroochi ki’omoyo, okore ne chinguru, na gotari koonchoka, kogosoa aase are ime moino y’etoto.

English: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
Kiswahili: mahali ambapo Yesu mtangulizi wetu aliingia kwa niaba yetu. Yeye amekuwa Kuhani Mkuu milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.
Ekegusii: Aase aria Yeso asoete buna omotang’ani oito, na ase engencho yaito, ekero abeire Omokuani Omonene o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.

English: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa huyu Melkizedeki alikuwa mfalme wa Salemu na kuhani wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana. Alipokutana na Abrahamu akirudi kutoka kuwashinda hao wafalme, Melkizedeki alimbariki,
Ekegusii: Naki Melkizedeki oyio nigo arenge omorwoti o Salemu, Omokuani o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono. Ekero Aburaamu are koirana korwa ase ogoita abarwoti, Melkizedeki akaumerana nere, akamosesenia.

English: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,
Kiswahili: naye Abrahamu alimpa sehemu ya kumi ya kila kitu. Kwanza, jina hilo Melkizedeki maana yake ni “mfalme wa haki.” Na pia “mfalme wa Salemu” maana yake ni “mfalme wa amani.”
Ekegusii: Na Aburaamu akamwatanera ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto bionsi. Ritang’ani engencho y’erieta ria Melkizedeki nigo ere iga: “Omorwoti bw’oboronge”, naende nigo are omorwoti o Salemu, engencho yaye: “Omorwoti bw’omorembe”.

English: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
Kiswahili: Hana Baba wala mama, hana ukoo, hana mwanzo wala mwisho wa siku zake. Kama Mwana wa Mungu, yeye adumu akiwa kuhani milele.
Ekegusii: Ere tarenge na ise, gose na ng’ina, gose ne chisokoro chiaye; tarenge nomochakano bw’amatuko aye, gose nomoerio bw’obogima bwaye, korende ogwekanigwe n’Omwana o Nyasae. Igo agendererete koba Omokuani o kare na kare.

English: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
Kiswahili: Tazama jinsi alivyokuwa mkuu: Hata Abrahamu, baba yetu mkuu, alimpa sehemu ya kumi ya nyara zake.
Ekegusii: Gaki, rigereria buna omonto oyo arenge omonene! Aburaamu, omogaka oito o kare, akamoa ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto asakorete korwa ase esegi.

English: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,
Kiswahili: Basi sheria inawaagiza wana wa Lawi ambao hufanyika makuhani kupokea sehemu ya kumi kutoka kwa watu ambao ni ndugu zao, ingawa ndugu zao ni wazao wa Abrahamu.
Ekegusii: Na ase abana b’ororeria rwa Lawi, baria baare konyora obokuani, mbaare nogochika korwa ase amachiiko koira ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase abanto bamwabo, nonya barabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Aburaamu.

English: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
Kiswahili: Huyu Melkizedeki, ingawa hakufuatia ukoo wake kutoka kwa Lawi, lakini alipokea sehemu ya kumi kutoka kwa Abrahamu na kumbariki yeye aliyekuwa na zile ahadi.
Ekegusii: Korende Melkizedeki, nonya tarenge bw’ororeria rwabo, akaira ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Aburaamu, na akamosesenia ere oyorenge ne chiira.

English: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.
Kiswahili: Wala hakuna shaka kwamba mdogo hubarikiwa na aliye mkuu kumliko yeye.
Ekegusii: Okoamererania tikoiyo nonya ng’ake ng’a oria omoke osesenigwa noria omonene.

English: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
Kiswahili: Kwa upande mmoja, sehemu ya kumi hupokelewa na wale ambao hupatikana na kufa; lakini kwa upande mwingine hupokelewa na yeye ambaye hushuhudiwa kuwa yu hai.
Ekegusii: Na ase ororeria rwa Lawi Mwanyabaanto, abakonyorekana namakweri, nkonyora bare ensemo ya ikomi, korende aiga ere oyogwatorwa ng’a moyo are nkoyenyora are.

English: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,
Kiswahili: Mtu anaweza hata kusema kwamba Lawi, ambaye hupokea sehemu ya kumi, alitoa hiyo sehemu ya kumi kupitia kwa Abrahamu,
Ekegusii: Igo nenyare gotebwa, ng’a goetera ase Aburaamu nonya Lawi, oyore konyora ensemo ya ikomi, nere naruete ensemo ya ikomi,

English: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu Melkizedeki alipokutana na Abrahamu, Lawi alikuwa bado katika viuno vya baba yake wa zamani.
Ekegusii: ekiagera arenge ase ekebono gia sokororia yaye, ekero Melkizedeki aumeranete na Aburaamu.

English: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
Kiswahili: Kama ukamilifu ungeweza kupatikana kwa njia ya ukuhani wa Walawi (kwa kuwa katika msingi huo, sheria ilitolewa kwa watu), kwa nini basi imekuwepo haja ya kuja kuhani mwingine: kuhani kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki, wala si kwa mfano wa Aroni?
Ekegusii: Gaki, onye oboikeranu bware konyorekana ase obokuani bwa Lawi, naki ase obwo abanto banyorete amachiiko, inki kiagerete Omokuani onde abekwe, oyore koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki, na tatoretwe koreng’ana buna Aroni?

English: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa yanapotokea mabadiliko ya ukuhani, pia lazima yawepo mabadiliko ya sheria.
Ekegusii: Naki obokuani koboraonchorwe, goika okoonchorwa kw’amachiiko boigo kobeo.

English: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
Kiswahili: Yeye ambaye mambo haya yanasemwa alikuwa wa kabila lingine, na hakuna mtu wa kabila hilo aliyewahi kuhudumu katika madhabahu.
Ekegusii: Naki omonene oito, amang’ana aya akwanetwe igoro yaye, nigo arenge bw’ororeria ronde oroao, na onde tarenge korwa ase ororeria orwo ore gokorera ase egesasiimero.

English: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni dhahiri kwamba Bwana wetu alitoka katika uzao wa Yuda, tena kuhusu kabila hilo Mose hakusema lolote kwa habari za makuhani.
Ekegusii: Naki igo are maiso marore ng’a ere nigo arwete ase ororeria rwa Yuda. Na ekero Musa akwanete igoro y’ororeria orwo takwanete ing’ana rinde igoro y’abakuani.

English: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
Kiswahili: Tena hayo tuliyosema yako wazi zaidi kama akitokea kuhani mwingine kama Melkizedeki,
Ekegusii: Kerabe Omokuani onde oorokire oyore koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki amang’ana ayio nigo are maiso marore mono kobua.

English: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;
Kiswahili: yeye ambaye amefanyika kuhani si kwa misingi ya sheria kama ilivyokuwa kwa baba zake, bali kwa misingi ya uwezo wa uzima usioharibika.
Ekegusii: Ere igo obeire Omokuani, tari ase ogochika kw’omooroberio bw’ogotunyana ororeria, korende nase chinguru chi’obogima botari nomoerio.

English: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeshuhudiwa kwamba: “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”
Ekegusii: Naki obereirwe kirori ng’a. “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”

English: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
Kiswahili: Kwa upande mmoja, ile amri ya mwanzo isiyofaa na dhaifu imebatilishwa
Ekegusii: Naki chinguru chi’ogochika koria kw’eritang’ani nigo chiasiretigwe ase engencho y’oboreu bwaye na ogotaisanera kwaye.
