English: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
Kiswahili: (kwa maana sheria haikufanya kitu chochote kuwa kikamilifu). Kwa upande mwingine, tumeletewa tumaini lililo bora zaidi ambalo linatuleta karibu na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki rinde tiriri riaikeranetigwe namachiiko. Ribaga ri’ayio ogosemeria okore okuya mono kobua gokarentwa, na ase okwo twamoikire Nyasae ang’e.

English: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath
Kiswahili: Nalo tumaini hilo halikutolewa pasipo kiapo! Wengine walikuwa makuhani pasipo kiapo chochote,
Ekegusii: Kobua mono obokuani obo tibwarenge gokoreka botari nemuma.

English: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”
Kiswahili: lakini Yesu alifanywa kuhani kwa kiapo wakati Mungu alimwambia: “Bwana ameapa naye hatabadilisha mawazo yake: ‘Wewe ni kuhani milele.’ ”
Ekegusii: Naki abwo baare kobekwa ase obokuani tibare kobekwa amo nemuma, korende Yeso akabonyora amo nemuma goetera asare oyo omotebetie, “Omonene otianire, gose takoonchora ebirengererio biaye, Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare.”

English: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya kiapo hiki, Yesu amekuwa mdhamini wa agano lililo bora zaidi.
Ekegusii: Gaki, ase ekerengo eke Yeso obeire oyo bw’obomaene bw’okobwatana kore okuya kobua.

English: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
Kiswahili: Basi pamekuwepo na makuhani wengi wa aina hiyo, kwa kuwa kifo kiliwazuia kuendelea na huduma yao ya ukuhani.
Ekegusii: Baria barenge abakuani b’eritang’ani barenge abange, ekiagera batangetwe namakweri, tibagendererete,

English: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa sababu Yesu anaishi milele, anao ukuhani wa kudumu.
Ekegusii: korende ere, ekiagera agendererete kare na kare, nare nobokuani botari koonchoka.

English: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo anaweza kuwaokoa kabisa wale wanaomjia Mungu kupitia kwake, kwa sababu yeye adumu daima kuomba kwa ajili yao.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, nare nokobua gw’okobatooria kegima abwo bagocha ase Nyasae goetera asare, ekiagera nigo are moyo botambe ase okobasabera.

English: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa ilitupasa tuwe na Kuhani Mkuu wa namna hii, yaani, aliye mtakatifu, asiye na lawama, asiye na dosari, aliyetengwa na wenye dhambi na kuinuliwa juu ya mbingu.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo etogwenerete intwe tobe n’Omokuani Omonene buna oyo, oyore omochenu, otari na komocha, otari na kemoa, bwatananetwe korwa ase abanyene ebibe, oimokereretigwe igoro ya igoro.

English: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
Kiswahili: Yeye hahitaji kutoa dhabihu siku kwa siku kwa ajili ya dhambi, kwanza kwa ajili ya dhambi zake mwenyewe, kisha kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu kama wale makuhani wakuu wengine. Yeye alitoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao mara moja tu, alipojitoa mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ere tagwenerete korua ebing’wanso kera rituko, buna abakuani bande abanene, ritang’ani ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene, naende ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abaanto, ekiagera ayio nigo ayakorete ara rimo rioka ekero eruete ere omonyene.

English: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa sheria huwaweka makuhani wakuu watu ambao ni dhaifu; lakini lile neno la kiapo, lililokuja baada ya sheria, lilimweka Mwana, ambaye amefanywa kuwa mkamilifu milele.
Ekegusii: Naki amachiiko nigo are kobeeka abanto abare noboreu babe abakuani abanene, korende ring’ana ri’emuma, eriachete magega y’amachiiko, riabekire Omwana, oyoikeranetigwe kare na kare.

English: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
Kiswahili: Basi jambo tunalotaka kulisema ni hili: Tunaye Kuhani Mkuu ambaye ameketi mkono wa kuume wa kiti cha enzi cha Aliye Mkuu mbinguni,
Ekegusii: Gaki, ring’ana rinene ri’ayio togokwana nario eri: Ntore n’Omokuani Omonene buna iga, oikaransete ensemo ya borio y’ekerogo ki’Obonene aria igoro,

English: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.
Kiswahili: yeye ahudumuye katika patakatifu, hema la kweli lililowekwa na Bwana, wala si na mwanadamu.
Ekegusii: omokoreri bw’aase aachenu na obw’Eema y’ekeene, eye Omonene aagachete, gose tari Mwanyabaanto.

English: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
Kiswahili: Kila kuhani mkuu huwekwa ili atoe sadaka na dhabihu. Vivyo hivyo, ilikuwa jambo muhimu kwa huyu Kuhani naye awe na kitu cha kutoa.
Ekegusii: Naki kera Omokuani omonene nigo are kobekwa ase okorua ebiegwa na ebing’wanso. Ase ayio yamogwenerete Omokuani oyo boigo abe negento akorua.

English: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,
Kiswahili: Kama angekuwa duniani, hangekuwa kuhani, kwa sababu tayari wapo watu watoao sadaka kama ilivyoelekezwa na sheria.
Ekegusii: Onye nabeete ase ense, anga tabeti Omokuani, ekiagera mbareo abare korua ebiegwa buna amachiiko achigete.

English: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”
Kiswahili: Wanahudumu katika patakatifu palipo mfano na kivuli cha mambo ya mbinguni. Hii ndiyo sababu Mose alionywa alipokaribia kujenga hema, akiambiwa: “Hakikisha kuwa unavitengeneza vitu vyote kwa mfano ulioonyeshwa kule mlimani.”
Ekegusii: Abwo baare gokorera ayare omogwekano bw’amang’ana are igoro, na ekiriri ki’ayio. Naki ekero Musa arenge koroisia Eema eria, Nyasae akamoteebia, “Rigereria, okore ebinto bionsi ase omogwekano bw’oria kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.”

English: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.
Kiswahili: Lakini huduma aliyopewa Yesu ni bora zaidi kuliko yao, kama vile agano ambalo yeye ni mpatanishi wake lilivyo bora zaidi kuliko lile la zamani, nalo limewekwa misingi wa ahadi zilizo bora zaidi.
Ekegusii: Korende bono Kristo onyorire obokuani bore obuya kobua, koreng’ana buna ere are omobwatania bw’okobwatana okuya kobua, okwo kwagachetwe ase chiira chingiya kobua.

English: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama hapakuwa na kasoro katika lile agano la kwanza, pasingekuwa na haja ya kutafuta nafasi kwa ajili ya jingine.
Ekegusii: Naki onye okobwatana koria kw’eritang’ani kwarenge tikori na komocha, anga ribaga tiriarigetigwe ase koria gwa kabere.

English: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;
Kiswahili: Lakini Mungu aliona kosa kwa watu, naye akasema: “Siku zinakuja, asema Bwana, nitakapofanya agano jipya na nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda.
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nigo akonyora okomocha ime yabo ekero agoteeba “Omonene oteebire iga: Rora, amatuko ngocha are ekero ndakorere abanto b’enyomba ya Israeli na ab’enyomba ya Yuda okobwatana okoyia.

English: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.
Kiswahili: Agano langu halitakuwa kama lile nililofanya na baba zao nilipowashika mkono kuwaongoza watoke nchi ya Misri, kwa sababu hawakuendelea kuwa waaminifu katika agano langu, nami nikawaacha, asema Bwana.
Ekegusii: Okobwatana oko tigokoba buna koria nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo, ase rituko riria nababwatete amaboko abo ase okobarusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ekiagera tibagendererete ase okobwatana kwane, inche tinabechanderete, Omonene oteebire.

English: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo agano nitakalofanya na nyumba ya Israeli baada ya siku zile, asema Bwana. Nitaziweka sheria zangu katika nia zao na kuziandika mioyoni mwao. Nitakuwa Mungu wao, nao watakuwa watu wangu.
Ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Oko nakwo okobwatana ndakore n’Abaisraeli magega y’amatuko aria: Nimbeke amachiiko aane ase ebirengererio biabo, ninyarike ase chinkoro chiabo ime; inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto baane.

English: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
Kiswahili: Mtu hatamfundisha tena jirani yake, wala mtu kumfundisha ndugu yake akisema, ‘Mjue Bwana,’ kwa sababu wote watanijua mimi, tangu aliye mdogo kabisa kwao, hadi aliye mkuu sana.
Ekegusii: Barabwo tibakworokererania kera omonto nomogisangio oye, gose kera omonto noyomwabo, ogoteeba: Momanye omonene, ekiagera bonsi pi mbamanye inche, korwa omoke mono goika omonene mono.

English: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu nitasamehe uovu wao, wala sitazikumbuka dhambi zao tena!”
Ekegusii: Naki nimbaabere obobe bwabo, na ebibe biabo tinkobiinyora naende.”

English: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuliita agano hili “jipya,” Mungu amefanya lile agano la kwanza kuwa kuukuu; nacho kitu kinachoanza kuchakaa na kuwa kikuukuu kiko karibu kutoweka.
Ekegusii: Ase ogokwana igoro y’okobwatana okoyia nigo akorire koria kw’eritang’ani kobe ogokoro, na koria kwabeire ogokoro na kogota, ng’ang’e kore gosira.

English: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.
Kiswahili: Basi agano lile la kwanza lilikuwa na kanuni zake za kuabudu na pia patakatifu pake pa kidunia.
Ekegusii: Gaki, nonya okobwatana kw’eritang’ani kwarenge nemeroberio ase okomosasiima Nyasae, naende kwarenge nase aachenu ase ense eye.

English: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.
Kiswahili: Hema ilitengenezwa. Katika sehemu yake ya kwanza kulikuwa na kinara cha taa, meza na mikate iliyowekwa wakfu; hii sehemu iliitwa Mahali Patakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naki eema eria ye ritang’ani yaroisetigwe. Ime ase eema eria mbiarengeo ekebekerero gie chitaaya, na emesa amo nemegati yarenge koruegwa ase Nyasae. Aase aria are korokwa Aase Aachenu.

English: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,
Kiswahili: Nyuma ya pazia la pili, palikuwa na sehemu iliyoitwa Patakatifu pa Patakatifu,
Ekegusii: Na moino y’etoto eria ya kabere yarengeo eema ende yare korokwa Aase Aachenu Mono.

English: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
Kiswahili: ambapo palikuwa na yale madhabahu ya dhahabu ya kufukizia uvumba, na lile Sanduku la Agano lililofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Sanduku hili lilikuwa na gudulia la dhahabu lenye mana, ile fimbo ya Aroni iliyochipuka, na vile vibao vya mawe vya Agano.
Ekegusii: Ime aroro mbiarengeo egesasiimero gi’etaabu ki’ogosambera ubani, na esanduki y’okobwatana yaoomire netaabu chinsemo chionsi. Ime ase esanduki eria mbiarengeo: Egetaabo gi’etaabu aase biabegetwe endagera yare korokwa mana, na enyimbo ya Aroni yasebogete, ne chibao chi’amagena aase amang’ana okobwatana kw’ogotianania ariikire.

English: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.
Kiswahili: Juu ya lile Sanduku kulikuwa na makerubi ya Utukufu yakitilia kivuli kile kifuniko ambacho ndicho kiti cha rehema. Lakini hatuwezi kueleza vitu hivi kwa undani sasa.
Ekegusii: Igoro yaye yarengeo emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba y’obonene yare kobekera egeikaransero ki’amaabera ekiriri. Bono titokonyara goteeba amang’ana ’ebinto ebi ekemo ekemo.

English: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,
Kiswahili: Basi vitu hivi vilipokuwa vimepangwa, makuhani waliingia daima katika sehemu ya kwanza ya hema ili kufanya taratibu zao za ibada.
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebi kobiaroisigwe igo, abakuani baare gosoa ase Eema ye ritang’ani ase amatuko onsi na goikerania obokoreri bwabo,

English: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.
Kiswahili: Lakini ni kuhani mkuu peke yake aliyeingia ndani ya sehemu ya pili ya hema. Tena hii ilikuwa mara moja tu kwa mwaka, na hakuingia kamwe bila damu, ambayo alitoa kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu walizotenda bila kukusudia.
Ekegusii: korende Eema ya kabere Omokuani Omonene ore gosoa bweka ara rimo kera omwaka, na tare konyara gosoa atari namanyinga, ayare korua ase engencho yaye ere omonyene na ase engencho y’amamocho ’abaanto.

English: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii, Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa anaonyesha kwamba, maadamu ile hema ya kwanza ilikuwa bado imesimama, njia ya kuingia Patakatifu pa Patakafifu ilikuwa bado haijafunguliwa.
Ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu nigo okworokereria ring’ana eri, ng’a enchera y’ogosoa Aase Aachenu konya teraorokigwa ekero Eema ye ritang’ani ereo eteneine.

English: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,
Kiswahili: Huu ulikuwa mfano kwa ajili ya wakati wa sasa, kuonyesha kwamba sadaka na dhabihu zilizokuwa zikitolewa hazikuweza kusafisha dhamiri ya mtu anayeabudu.
Ekegusii: Eyio nekiorokererio ase engaki eye ya bono, ekero ebiegwa na ebing’wanso bikorugwa, ebitanyare komoikerania oyokobirua erinde enkoro yaye temogambia.

English: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
Kiswahili: Lakini hizi zilishughulika tu na vyakula na vinywaji, pamoja na taratibu mbalimbali za kunawa kwa nje, kanuni kwa ajili ya mwili zilizowekwa hadi wakati utimie wa matengenezo mapya.
Ekegusii: Ebinto ebi nigo biare ase okoria na okonywa, na ogosibigwa ao ao, amachiiko ase omobere ayabekire goika engaki y’okoroisigwa okoyia eike.

English: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
Kiswahili: Kristo alipokuja akiwa Kuhani Mkuu wa mambo mema ambayo tayari yameshawasili, alipitia kwenye hema iliyo kuu zaidi na bora zaidi, ambayo haikutengenezwa kwa mikono ya binadamu, hii ni kusema, ambayo si sehemu ya uumbaji huu.
Ekegusii: Korende Kristo oikire gocha, oyore Omokuani Omonene bw’amang’ana amaya agochi‐gocha. Agaeta ase eema ere enene na eng’ikeranu kobua, etakoretwe namaboko, engencho yaye etari egetongwa gi’ense eye.

English: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.
Kiswahili: Hakuingia kwa njia ya damu ya mbuzi na ya ndama; lakini aliingia Patakatifu pa Patakatifu mara moja tu kwa damu yake mwenyewe, akiisha kupata ukombozi wa milele.
Ekegusii: Ere tasoete namanyinga e chimbori na eye chimori, korende namanyinga aye omonyene, agasoa ara rimo rioka Aase Aachenu, na agatonyorera okoboorigwa gwa kare na kare.

English: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,
Kiswahili: Damu ya mbuzi na ya mafahali, na majivu ya mitamba walivyonyunyiziwa wale waliokuwa najisi kwa taratibu za kiibada viliwatakasa, hata kuwaondolea uchafu wa nje.
Ekegusii: Naki onye amanyinga e chimbori na aye chieri, ne ribu ri’amatororo biare konyororokerigwa ase abatachenegeti mbinyare gochena ase ogosibigwa kw’omobere,

English: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
Kiswahili: Basi ni zaidi aje damu ya Kristo, ambaye kwa Roho wa milele alijitoa nafsi yake kwa Mungu kuwa sadaka isiyo na waa, itatusafisha dhamiri zetu kutokana na matendo yaletayo mauti, ili tupate kumtumikia Mungu aliye hai!
Ekegusii: tari mono kobua amanyinga a Kristo, ere ase Omoika o kare na kare akerua ere omonyene ase Nyasae koba ekeng’wanso getari na komocha, anyare gochena okomanya gwe chinkoro chiaito ime korwa ase emeremo ekwete, erinde tokorere Nyasae ore moyo?

English: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii Kristo ni mpatanishi wa agano jipya, ili kwamba wale walioitwa waweze kupokea ile ahadi ya urithi wa milele: kwa vile yeye alikufa awe ukombozi wao kutoka kwa dhambi walizozitenda chini ya agano la kwanza.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho eye ere nomobwatania bw’okobwatana okoyia, erinde abwo barangerigwe banyore omwando oria o kare na kare, oyo barieretwe eira, ekiagera amakweri aikire gokoreka ase okobabooria barabwo korwa ase ogosaria koria bakorete ase okobwatana kw’eritang’ani.

English: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya wosia, ni muhimu kuthibitisha kifo cha yule aliyeutoa,
Ekegusii: Naki aase okoriera kw’omwando kore, goika amakweri aye, oyoriete, abeo.

English: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu wosia huwa na nguvu tu wakati mtu ameshakufa; kamwe hauwezi kutumika wakati yule aliyeuandika bado yuko hai.
Ekegusii: Naki okoriera kw’omwando nigo kogoikeranigwa ekero ki’amakweri, ekiagera onye oria oyoriete ore moyo, rirorio tikori na nguru.

English: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu hata lile agano la kwanza halikuweza kutekelezwa pasipo damu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, okobwatana koria kw’eritang’ani tigwachagete gotare namanyinga,

English: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
Kiswahili: Mose alipotangaza kila amri kwa watu wote, alichukua damu ya ndama na ya mbuzi, pamoja na maji, sufu nyekundu na matawi ya mti wa hisopo, akanyunyizia kile kitabu na watu wote.
Ekegusii: naki ekero kera richiko riaikire gokwanwa na Musa ase abanto bonsi, buna yachigetwe ase amachiiko, akabogoria amanyinga e chimori na aye chimbori amo namaache na amarionya amabariri, ne chinsagia chia hisopo, akanyororokeria egetabu enyene, na abanto bonsi,

English: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”
Kiswahili: Alisema, “Hii ndiyo damu ya agano, ambalo Mungu amewaamuru kulitii.”
Ekegusii: ogoteeba, “Aya namanyinga ’okobwatana oko Nyasae abachikerete inwe.”

English: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo alinyunyizia damu hiyo kwenye ile hema pamoja na kila kifaa kilichotumika ndani yake kwa taratibu za ibada.
Ekegusii: Eema amo n’ebinto bionsi biare gokorerwa ase ogosasiima naboigo are kobinyororokereria amanyinga.

English: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
Kiswahili: Kwa kweli sheria hudai kwamba, karibu kila kitu kitakaswe kwa damu, wala pasipo kumwaga damu, hakuna msamaha wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Amachiiko nigo are goteeba ng’a ang’e ebinto bionsi bichenwe namanyinga, na amanyinga ataiteiri, okwaberwa kw’ebibe tigokobao.

English: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ilikuwa muhimu kwa nakala za vitu vile vya mbinguni vitakaswe kwa dhabihu hizi, lakini vitu halisi vya mbinguni vilihitaji dhabihu bora kuliko hizi.
Ekegusii: Gaki, yagwenerete emegwekano y’ebinto bire igoro bichenwe ase ebing’wanso buna ebio, korende ebinto bia igoro ebinyene bichenwe nebing’wanso bire ebiya kobua ebi.

English: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana Kristo hakuingia kwenye patakatifu palipofanywa kwa mikono ya mwanadamu, ambao ni mfano wa kile kilicho halisi. Yeye aliingia mbinguni penyewe, ili sasa aonekane mbele za Mungu kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Naki Kristo tasoete Aase Aachenu akoretwe namaboko, naro omogwekano bw’Aachenu a ekeene, korende agasoa igoro aanyene, na bono nao akororekana ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase engencho yaito intwe.

English: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,
Kiswahili: Wala hakuingia mbinguni ili apate kujitoa mwenyewe mara kwa mara, kama vile kuhani mkuu aingiavyo Patakatifu pa Patakatifu kila mwaka kwa damu ambayo si yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ere terua omonyene ekero ase ekero, buna Omokuani omonene are gosoa Aase Aachenu kera omwaka amo namanyinga atari ayaye.

English: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
Kiswahili: Ingekuwa hivyo, ingempasa Kristo kuteswa mara nyingi tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu. Lakini sasa ametokea mara moja tu katika mwisho wa nyakati aiondoe dhambi kwa kujitoa mwenyewe kuwa dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Onye nabo, anga yamogwenerete achandwe ekero ase ekero korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe. Korende bono, ase amatuko ’omoerio bw’ense akaoroka ara rimo rioka ase okorusia ebibe ase okong’wanswa kwaye ere omonyene.

English: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
Kiswahili: Kama vile mwanadamu alivyowekewa kufa mara moja tu na baada ya kufa akabili hukumu,
Ekegusii: Buna abanto bagacheirwe ogokwa ara rimo, na magega y’ogokwa ekiina,

English: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.
Kiswahili: vivyo hivyo Kristo alitolewa mara moja tu kuwa dhabihu ili azichukue dhambi za watu wengi. Naye atakuja mara ya pili, sio kuchukua dhambi, bali kuwaletea wokovu wale wanaomngoja kwa shauku.
Ekegusii: naboigo Kristo nere, gakoorire koruegwa abe ekeng’wanso ara rimo ase okorusia ebibe bi’abaanto abange, narorekane eria kabere, tari ase okobogoria ebibe, korende ase okonyorera abamoganyete ogotooreka.

English: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.
Kiswahili: Sheria ni kivuli tu cha mambo mema yajayo, wala si uhalisi wa mambo yenyewe. Kwa sababu hii, haiwezekani kamwe kwa njia ya dhabihu zitolewazo mwaka hadi mwaka kuwakamilisha wale wanaokaribia ili kuabudu.
Ekegusii: Naki ayare ime y’amachiiko nekiriri gioka ki’amang’ana agochi‐gocha, gose tari ekieni ekenyene. Ase ayio, ebing’wanso biria biria biare koruegwa kera omwaka botambe tibiarenge konyara kobaikerania abwo baare kobirua.

English: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
Kiswahili: Kama dhabihu hizo zingeweza kuwakamilisha, hazingeendelea kutolewa tena. Kwa kuwa hao waabuduo wangekuwa wametakaswa mara moja tu, wala wasingejiona tena kuwa na dhambi.
Ekegusii: Onye mbianyarete, Inee, anga tibiatigetwe, tibikoruegwa? Naki onye abwo baare kobirua bakoorire gochenwa ara rimo, anga tibare kwerora ng’a mbare nebibe naende.

English: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
Kiswahili: Lakini zile dhabihu zilikuwa ukumbusho wa dhambi kila mwaka,
Ekegusii: Korende ebing’wanso ebio nigo bikobainyoria igoro y’ebibe kera omwaka.

English: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu haiwezekani damu ya mafahali na mbuzi kuondoa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Naki amanyinga e chieeri na aye chimbori takonyara korusia ebibe.

English: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, Kristo alipokuja duniani, alisema: “Dhabihu na sadaka hukuzitaka, bali mwili uliniandalia;
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Kristo kagosoa ase ense nigo agoteeba, “Ebing’wanso na ebiruegwa tikwabiganetie, korende omobere kwandoiseirie.

English: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.
Kiswahili: sadaka za kuteketezwa na za dhambi hukupendezwa nazo.
Ekegusii: Ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, tikwagogetigwe nabirobio.

English: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”
Kiswahili: Ndipo niliposema, ‘Mimi hapa, nimekuja, imeandikwa kunihusu katika kitabu: Nimekuja kuyafanya mapenzi yako, Ee Mungu.’ ”
Ekegusii: Erio ngakwana: Nachire gokora ogwancha kwao, Nyasae, buna eriikire igoro yane ase egetabu.”

English: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),
Kiswahili: Kwanza alisema, “Dhabihu na sadaka, sadaka za kuteketezwa na za dhambi hukuzitaka, wala hukupendezwa nazo” (ingawa sheria iliagiza zitolewe).
Ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani nigo agoteeba, “Ebing’wanso, na ebirugwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe tikwabiganetie, gose tikwagogetigwe nabirobio”, nonya birobio biare korentwa buna amachiiko are goteeba.

English: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,
Kiswahili: Kisha akasema “Mimi hapa, nimekuja kuyafanya mapenzi yako.” Aondoa lile Agano la kwanza ili kuimarisha la pili.
Ekegusii: Erio akabora, “Rora, nachire gokora ogwancha kwao.” Igo akarusia ebie ritang’ani, erinde abeeke egia kabere.

English: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
Kiswahili: Katika mapenzi hayo sisi tumetakaswa na kufanywa watakatifu kwa njia ya sadaka ya mwili wa Yesu Kristo alioutoa mara moja tu.
Ekegusii: Ase ogwancha okwo twanyorire ogochenwa ase okoruegwa kw’omobere o Yeso Kristo ara rimo rioka.

English: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,
Kiswahili: Kila kuhani husimama siku kwa siku akifanya huduma yake ya ibada, na kutoa tena na tena dhabihu zile zile ambazo haziwezi kamwe kuondoa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Kera Omokuani nigo are gotenena rituko ase rituko ase obokoreri bwaye na korua ebing’wanso biria, na birobio tibiare konyara korusia ebibe nonya ng’ake.

English: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,
Kiswahili: Lakini huyu kuhani akiisha kutoa dhabihu moja kwa ajili ya dhambi kwa wakati wote, aliketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende ekero Kristo aruete ekeng’wanso ekemo gioka ase ebibe kerabe goika kare na kare, nigo aikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.

English: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.
Kiswahili: Tangu wakati huo anangoja mpaka adui zake wawekwe chini ya miguu yake,
Ekegusii: Erio oganyete goika ababisa baye babekwe inse y’amagoro aye.

English: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu kwa dhabihu moja amewafanya kuwa wakamilifu milele wale wote wanaotakaswa.
Ekegusii: Naki ase okoruegwa okomo obaikeranirie ase amatuko onsi abwo bachenirwe.

English: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,
Kiswahili: Pia Roho Mtakatifu anatushuhudia kuhusu jambo hili. Kwanza anasema:
Ekegusii: Naki Omoika Omochenu noro otobereire kirori. Naki ritang’ani nigo agoteeba iga:

English: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,
Kiswahili: “Hili ndilo Agano nitakalofanya nao baada ya siku hizo, asema Bwana. Nitaziweka sheria zangu mioyoni mwao, na kuziandika katika nia zao.”
Ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okobwatana ndache kobwatana nabarabwo magega y’amatuko ayio, Omonene oteebire: Nimbeke amachiiko aane ase chinkoro chiabo ime, ninyarike ase ebirengererio biabo.”

English: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
Kiswahili: Kisha aongeza kusema: “Dhambi zao na kutokutii kwao sitakumbuka tena.”
Ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteeba, “Ebibe biabo, na ogosaria kwabo tinkobiinyora naende nonya ng’ake.”

English: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
Kiswahili: Basi haya yakiisha kusamehewa, hakuna tena dhabihu yoyote inayotolewa kwa ajili ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Gaki, okorusigwa kw’ebibe gokorabeo, rirorio ekerugwa ase engencho y’ebibe tigekobao naende.

English: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, kwa kuwa tunao ujasiri wa kupaingia Patakatifu pa Patakatifu kwa damu ya Yesu,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, baminto, ntore noboremu bw’ogosoa Aase Aachenu goetera ase amanyinga a Yeso,

English: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
Kiswahili: kwa njia mpya iliyo hai tuliyofunguliwa kwa ajili yetu kupitia kwenye lile pazia, yaani, mwili wake,
Ekegusii: ase enchera enyia ere moyo, eye atoigorerete, egoetera ase etoto, engencho yaye omobere oye.

English: and having a great priest over God’s house,
Kiswahili: basi kwa kuwa tunaye Kuhani Mkuu juu ya nyumba ya Mungu,
Ekegusii: Naende ntore n’Omokuani Omonene igoro y’enyomba ya Nyasae.

English: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,
Kiswahili: sisi na tumkaribie Mungu kwa moyo mnyofu kwa imani timilifu, mioyo yetu ikiwa imenyunyizwa damu ya Kristo na kuwa safi kutokana na dhamiri mbaya nayo miili yetu ikiwa imeoshwa kwa maji safi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, toike ang’e ne chinkoro chire nekeene, tobe nobomaene oboikeranu ase okwegena, ne chinkoro chiaito chianyororokerigwe oborabu, tichigotogambia, twasibiigwe ase emebere yaito namaache amaya.

English: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
Kiswahili: Tushike kwa uthabiti lile tumaini la ukiri wetu bila kuyumbayumba, kwa maana yeye aliyeahidi ni mwaminifu.
Ekegusii: Tiga tobwate mono okoorokia kw’ogosemeria gwaito, totari konyegerigwa; ekiagera ere oyoriete eira nomwegenwa.

English: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,
Kiswahili: Tuangaliane na kuhimizana sisi kwa sisi katika upendo na katika kutenda mema.
Ekegusii: Naende twechanderane intwe ase intwe, na kobeekana chinguru ase obwanchani, na ase ogokora okuya.

English: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
Kiswahili: Wala tusiache kukutana pamoja, kama wengine walivyo na desturi, bali tuhimizane sisi kwa sisi kadiri tuonavyo Siku ile inakaribia.
Ekegusii: Titotiga gosangererekana amo, buna engencho y’abande ere, korende toremanie intwe ase intwe, kobua mono ekiagera morooche ng’a Rituko riria riaikire ang’e.

English: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
Kiswahili: Kama tukiendelea kutenda dhambi kwa makusudi baada ya kupokea ufahamu wa ile kweli, haibaki tena dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi.
Ekegusii: Naki onye togokora ebibe moeneno magega gotwaikire komanya ekeene, keng’wanso kende tikeri ase engencho y’ebibe.

English: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
Kiswahili: Lakini kinachobaki ni kungoja kwa hofu hukumu ya moto uwakao, utakaowaangamiza adui za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende eke totigaretie nobwoba bw’okoganya ekiina, na omorero omotindi ogwoka, ogocha gosiria abwo bakoengereria.

English: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
Kiswahili: Yeyote aliyeikataa sheria ya Mose alikufa pasipo huruma kwa ushahidi wa watu wawili au watatu.
Ekegusii: Omonto oyorenge gochaaya amachiiko a Musa nigo arenge goitwa okwa, atari konyora amaabera, ase okoberwa kirori nabaanto babere gose batato.

English: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
Kiswahili: Je, mnadhani ni adhabu kali kiasi gani anayostahili kupewa mtu aliyemkanyaga Mwana wa Mungu chini ya nyayo zake, yeye aliyeifanya damu ya Agano iliyomtakasa kuwa kitu najisi na kumtendea maovu Roho wa neema?
Ekegusii: Inee! Naki morooche? Omonto oria otanchete Omwana o Nyasae, na kobara amanyinga y’okobwatana, achenetwe naro, koba egento kia bosa, oria okoreire Omoika bw’amaabera obogeechi, tiyamogwenerete ere anyore egesusuro ekenene kobua?

English: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tunamjua yeye aliyesema, “Ni juu yangu kulipiza kisasi; nitalipiza.” Tena asema, “Bwana atawahukumu watu wake.”
Ekegusii: Naki ntomanyete ere oyokwanete, “Egesiomba nekiane, inche ning’akane,” naende, “Omonene nere oragambie abanto baye.”

English: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
Kiswahili: Ni jambo la kutisha kuanguka mikononi mwa Mungu aliye hai.
Ekegusii: Okogwa ase amaboko a Nyasae ore moyo, eri nering’ana ri’okoondokia.

English: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
Kiswahili: Kumbukeni siku zile za kwanza, ambazo mkiisha kutiwa nuru mlistahimili mashindano makali ya maumivu.
Ekegusii: Korende moinyore amatuko e ritang’ani, magega komwabarerigwe omobaso igo mwaremereretie okoamererania okonene kw’ogochandwa.

English: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
Kiswahili: Wakati mwingine mlitukanwa na kuteswa hadharani; wakati mwingine mlikuwa radhi kuungana na wale waliofanyiwa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Engaki ende mokarorerigwa ase okoramwa na ogochandwa maiso marore, na engaki ende mokabwatana nabwo bakoreretwe ayio.

English: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
Kiswahili: Mliwahurumia wale waliokuwa kifungoni, mkikubali kwa furaha kunyangʼanywa mali zenu kwa maana mlijua kwamba mnayo mali iliyo bora zaidi idumuyo.
Ekegusii: Naki mwabarorerete amaabera baria barenge ase ebisibo, mogancha nomogooko kourwa chinibo chiaino, ekiagera mwamanyete ng’a inwe abanyene more nenibo eyere engiya kobua, erabeo kare na kare.

English: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo msiutupe ujasiri wenu, kwa maana una thawabu kubwa mno.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, timotuguta oboremu bwaino, ekiagera mbore neng’eria enene.

English: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
Kiswahili: Inawapasa kuvumilia ili mkiisha kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu mpate kile alichoahidi.
Ekegusii: Naki iigo ebagwenerete mobe noboremereria, erinde komwaikire gokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae monyore aya mwarieretwe eira.

English: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa bado kitambo kidogo tu, “Yeye ajaye atakuja wala hatakawia.
Ekegusii: “Naki nkere ekero egeke mono, ere oyore gocha nachiche, gose tagotebana gocha,

English: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mwenye haki wangu ataishi kwa imani. Naye kama akisitasita, sina furaha naye.”
Ekegusii: korende omonyene oboronge one nabe moyo ase okwegena, na, karasukwane, omoyo one tokogokigwa nere.”

English: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
Kiswahili: Lakini sisi hatumo miongoni mwa hao wanaositasita na kuangamia, bali tuko miongoni mwa hao wenye imani na hivyo tunaokolewa.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe titori ase abwo bagosukwana na gosira, korende ase abwo bare nokwegena ase okoegera emioyo yaito.

English: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
Kiswahili: Basi imani ni kuwa na hakika ya mambo yatarajiwayo, na udhahiri wa mambo yasiyoonekana.
Ekegusii: Gaki, okwegena nakwo okoba nobomaene ase amang’ana ayio asemeirie, nonya nekeene ki’ayio atari kororekana.

English: For by this, the elders obtained approval.
Kiswahili: Maana baba zetu wa kale walipongezwa kwa haya.
Ekegusii: Naki ase okwo abagaaka abakoro mbaberetwe kirori.

English: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani tunafahamu kwamba ulimwengu uliumbwa kwa neno la Mungu, vitu vyote vinavyoonekana havikuumbwa kutoka kwa vitu vinavyoonekana.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena twamanyire ng’a ense nigo yatongetwe ase chinguru chi’ering’ana ria Nyasae, na igo ebinto bikororekana tibiakoretwe n’ebinto bire maiso marore.

English: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Abeli alimtolea Mungu dhabihu bora zaidi kuliko Kaini. Kwa imani alishuhudiwa kuwa mwenye haki, Mungu mwenyewe akazishuhudia sadaka zake. Kwa imani bado ananena ingawa amekufa.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Abeli akaa Nyasae ekeng’wanso ekere ekiya kobua egia Kaini. Ase okwo akaberwa kirori ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge. Nyasae akamobera kirori ase ogwancha ebiegwa biaye. Abeli okuure, korende ase okwegena ngokwana are nonya ngoika bono.

English: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Enoki alitwaliwa kutoka maisha haya, kiasi kwamba hakuonja mauti. Hakuonekana, kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa amemchukua. Kwa kuwa kabla hajatwaliwa alikuwa ameshuhudiwa kuwa ni mtu aliyempendeza Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Enoku akang’anyigwa, tacha korora amakweri. Tarorekanete, ekiagera Nyasae namong’anyetie. Naki ritang’ani atarang’anyigwa konya obereirwe kirori ng’a namogwenerete Nyasae.

English: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
Kiswahili: Lakini pasipo imani haiwezekani kumpendeza Mungu, kwa maana yeyote anayemjia Mungu lazima aamini kwamba yeye yuko na ya kuwa huwapa thawabu wale wamtafutao kwa bidii.
Ekegusii: Korende omonto atari nokwegena takonyara komogwenera Nyasae. Naki oyogocha asare nagwenerete gwancha ng’a nareo, naende nigo akobaa eng’eria baria bakomorigia.

English: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani, Noa alipoonywa na Mungu kuhusu mambo ambayo hayajaonekana bado, kwa kumcha Mungu alitengeneza safina ili kuokoa jamaa yake. Kwa imani yake aliuhukumu ulimwengu na akawa mrithi wa haki ipatikanayo kwa imani.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Nuhu, gaikire g okuurerwa na Nyasae ase amang’ana atararorekana, ase okoba namasikani amaya asare akaroisia obwato, erinde atoorie abanto b’enyomba yaye. Ase ayio, akagambia ense ekiina, na akaba omonyamwando bw’oboronge bokonyorekana ase okwegena.

English: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Abrahamu, alipoitwa aende mahali ambapo Mungu angempa baadaye kuwa urithi, alitii na akaenda, ingawa hakujua anakokwenda.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Aburaamu akaigwera Nyasae ekero arangeretigwe kogenda goika aase aria achiete konyora abe omwando oye, akaimoka akagenda, tamanya aase agochia.

English: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani alifanya maskani yake katika nchi ya ahadi kama mgeni katika nchi ya kigeni; aliishi katika mahema, kama Isaki na Yakobo walivyofanya, waliokuwa pia warithi pamoja naye wa ahadi ile ile.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena akamenya ase ense eria engeni arieretwe eira, akamenya buna omomenyi ase chiema amo na Isaka na Yakobo, abarenge abanyamwando amo nere ase eira eria eria.

English: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana alikuwa akiutazamia mji wenye misingi ya kudumu ambao mwenye kuubuni na kuujenga ni Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki igo aganyete omochie ore namaroso, oyo Nyasae aroseti na koagacha.

English: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Abrahamu, ingawa alikuwa mzee wa umri, naye Sara mwenyewe aliyekuwa tasa, alipokea uwezo wa kuwa baba kwa sababu alimhesabu Mungu aliyemwahidi kuwa mwaminifu na kwamba angetimiza ahadi yake.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Sara omonyene akanyora chinguru koba morito, nonya konya oeteire emiaka yaye, ekiagera amorooche ere oyomorierete eira, ng’a nomwegenwa are.

English: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
Kiswahili: Hivyo kutokana na huyu huyu ambaye alikuwa sawa na mfu, wakazaliwa wazao wengi kama nyota za mbinguni na kama mchanga wa pwani usiohesabika.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa ase omonto oria oyomo, nonya konya obeire buna oyokuure, abanto bakaiborwa abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, na buna omokenye ore ase engegu y’enyancha, otanyare kobareka.

English: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
Kiswahili: Watu hawa wote wakafa katika imani bila kuzipokea zile ahadi, lakini waliziona kwa mbali na kuzishangilia. Nao walikubali kwamba walikuwa wageni na wasiokuwa na maskani hapa duniani.
Ekegusii: Aba bonsi bagakwa bare nokwegena, bataranyora ayabarieretwe eira, korende bakayarora korwa are, na koyakwania, bakaorokia ng’a nigo bare abamenyi na abaeti ase ense.

English: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
Kiswahili: Watu wasemao mambo kama haya, wanaonyesha wazi kwamba wanatafuta nchi yao wenyewe.
Ekegusii: Naki abagokwana amang’ana buna ayio nkoorokia bare maiso marore, ng’a nkorigia bare ense yabo abanyene.

English: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
Kiswahili: Kwa kweli kama wangekuwa wanafikiri kuhusu nchi waliyoiacha, wangalipata nafasi ya kurudi huko.
Ekegusii: Onye barabwo mbainyorete ense eria ase baruete, anga mbanyorete ribaga koirana aroro.

English: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
Kiswahili: Lakini badala yake walitamani nchi iliyo bora zaidi, yaani nchi ya mbinguni. Kwa hiyo Mungu haoni aibu kuitwa Mungu wao, kwa kuwa amekwisha kuandaa mji kwa ajili yao.
Ekegusii: Korende bono mbaganetie ense ere engiya kobua, engencho yaye ense ya igoro. Ase ayio Nyasae takorora obosooku korokwa Nyasae obo, ekiagera obaroiseirie omochie.

English: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Abrahamu, alipojaribiwa na Mungu, alimtoa Isaki kuwa dhabihu. Yeye aliyekuwa amezipokea ahadi za Mungu alikuwa tayari kumtoa mwanawe, aliyekuwa mwanawe pekee awe dhabihu.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Aburaamu, gachia goteemwa, akarua Isaka abe ekeng’wanso. Nere oyorieretwe chiira akarua omwana oye omomoima.

English: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”
Kiswahili: Ingawa Mungu alikuwa amemwambia Abrahamu, “Uzao wako utahesabiwa kupitia kwa Isaki,”
Ekegusii: Ere nateebetigwe, “Ase Isaka oroiboro rwao narwatorwe.”

English: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
Kiswahili: Abrahamu alihesabu kuwa Mungu angaliweza kumfufua Isaki kutoka kwa wafu. Na kwa kusema kwa mfano, alimpata tena Isaki kutoka kwa wafu.
Ekegusii: Akarengereria ng’a Nyasae nanyare komobokia korwa ase abakuure. Ase ayio akamonyora agwo agwo, buna omogwekano.

English: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Isaki alimbariki Yakobo na Esau kuhusu maisha yao ya baadaye.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Isaka agasesenia Yakobo na Esau ase amang’ana agochi‐gocha.

English: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Yakobo alipokuwa anakufa, alimbariki kila mmoja wa mtoto wa Yosefu, akamwabudu Mungu akiwa ameegemea juu ya kichwa cha fimbo yake.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Yakobo, ekero arenge ang’e nogokwa, agasesenia kera oyomo bw’abana ba Yusufu, agasasiima bwesiirerete enyimbo yaye.

English: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani, Yosefu alipokaribia mwisho wa maisha yake, alinena habari za kutoka kwa wana wa Israeli huko Misri na akatoa maagizo kuhusu mifupa yake.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Yusufu, ekero abeire ang’e nomoerio bw’obogima bwaye, agakwana igoro y’okong’anyigwa kw’Abaisraeli, akabachikera amang’ana igoro y’amauga aye.

English: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani, wazazi wa Mose walimficha kwa miezi mitatu baada ya kuzaliwa, kwa sababu waliona kuwa si mtoto wa kawaida, wala hawakuiogopa amri ya mfalme.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Musa, ekero aiboretwe, akabiswa ase engaki y’emetienyi etato nabaibori baye, ekiagera baroche ng’a nomwana omuya, gose tibairogete ogochika kw’omorwoti.

English: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
Kiswahili: Kwa imani, Mose alipokuwa mtu mzima, alikataa kuitwa mwana wa binti Farao.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Musa, kabeire omonto omonene, akaanga tarokwa omwana bw’omoiseke o Farao,

English: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,
Kiswahili: Akachagua kupata mateso pamoja na watu wa Mungu kuliko kujifurahisha kwa anasa za dhambi kwa kitambo kidogo tu.
Ekegusii: agachoora ng’a mbuya konyora emechando amo nabaanto ba Nyasae kobua kwegokia ase ebibe ase ekero egeke.

English: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
Kiswahili: Aliona kushutumiwa kwa ajili ya Kristo ni utajiri mkubwa zaidi kuliko hazina za Misri, maana alikuwa anatazamia kupata thawabu baadaye.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo abarete ogochaaywa ase engencho ya Kristo ng’a nobonda kobua chiniibo chia Misiri, ekiagera arigereretie eng’eria ere bosio.

English: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani Mose aliondoka Misri bila kuogopa ghadhabu ya mfalme. Alivumilia kwa sababu alimwona yeye asiyeonekana kwa macho.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena akarua Misiri, tairoka endamwamu y’omorwoti, ekiagera aremereretie buna oyororire ere oyotari kororekana.

English: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani akaadhimisha Pasaka na kunyunyiza damu, ili yule mwenye kuwaangamiza wazaliwa wa kwanza asiwaguse wazaliwa wa Israeli.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena akaroisia Epasaka na kogindia amanyinga, erinde oyoraache goita abana abatangi tabakuna, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.

English: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani, watu walivuka Bahari ya Shamu kama vile juu ya nchi kavu; lakini Wamisri walipojaribu kufanya hivyo, walitoswa ndani ya maji.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’Enyancha Embariri buna ase ense enyomo. Korende Abamisiri barabwo bagachia goteema gokora bo, bakamerwa nenyancha.

English: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani kuta za Yeriko zilianguka, baada ya watu kuzizunguka kwa siku saba.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena chindwaki chia Yeriko chikagwa gachiaetananirwe ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

English: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
Kiswahili: Kwa imani, Rahabu, yule kahaba, hakuangamizwa pamoja na wale waliomwasi Mungu, kwa kuwa aliwakaribisha wale wapelelezi.
Ekegusii: Ase okwegena Rahabu, oria omotayayi, taitetwe amo nabwo bataigwerete, ekiagera aroisetie abanto baria chirooti nomorembe.

English: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—
Kiswahili: Basi niseme nini zaidi? Sina wakati wa kusema habari za Gideoni, Baraka, Samsoni, Yeftha, Daudi, Samweli na manabii,
Ekegusii: Naende inki ndakwane? Naki engaki tekong’isana gokwana igoro ya Gidioni, na Baraki, na Samusoni, na Yefita, na Daudi, na Samweli, na ababani.

English: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
Kiswahili: ambao kwa imani walishinda milki za wafalme, walitekeleza haki, na wakapokea ahadi za Mungu; walifunga vinywa vya simba,
Ekegusii: Abwo ase okwegena bakabua amarwoti, bagakora oboronge, bakanyoora ayabarieretwe chiira, bagasieka emenwa ye chindo.

English: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
Kiswahili: wakazima makali ya miali ya moto, na wakaepuka kuuawa kwa upanga; udhaifu wao uligeuka kuwa nguvu; pia walikuwa hodari vitani na kuyafukuza majeshi ya wageni.
Ekegusii: Naende barabwo bakarimia chinguru chi’omorero, bagetooria korwa ase obwoge bw’omoro, bakabeekwa chinguru magega y’oboreu bwabo, bakaba abakong’u ase esegi, bagaseria emeganda y’abarwani y’ababisa.

English: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
Kiswahili: Wanawake walipokea watu wao waliokuwa wamekufa, wakafufuliwa. Lakini wengine waliteswa, nao wakakataa kufunguliwa, ili wapate ufufuo ulio bora zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abakungu bakanyora naende abakwete babo ase okobokigwa. Abande bagaitwa bobe goika bagakwa, tibancha gosiborwa, erinde banyore okobokigwa okore okuya kobua.

English: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
Kiswahili: Wengine walidhihakiwa na kupigwa, hata walifungwa minyororo na kutiwa gerezani.
Ekegusii: Abande bagachandeka ase ogochecherigwa na goakwa chinkini, naende bagasibwa nebinyuri na kobekwa chichela ime.

English: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—
Kiswahili: Walipigwa kwa mawe; walipasuliwa vipande viwili kwa msumeno; waliuawa kwa upanga. Walizungukazunguka wakiwa wamevaa ngozi za kondoo na mbuzi, wakiwa maskini, wakiteswa na kutendwa mabaya,
Ekegusii: Bagaakwa amagena, bagateemwa, bakanachwa ne chinseke, bagaitwa nemeyio ya birende. Naende bagaetanana beboetie chingobo chi’eching’ondi na echie chimbori, bakaba abaremerwa, bagachandwa na gokorwa bobe,

English: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
Kiswahili: watu ambao ulimwengu haukustahili kuwa nao. Walizunguka majangwani na milimani, katika mapango na katika mahandaki ardhini.
Ekegusii: abanto ense etagwenere koba nabarabwo. Barabwo nigo barenge goetanana ase chirooro na ase ebitunwa, ase amabwago na amakuruma.

English: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
Kiswahili: Hawa wote walishuhudiwa vyema kwa sababu ya imani yao, lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyepokea yale yaliyoahidiwa.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi babereirwe kirori goetera ase okwegena kwabo, korende tibanyora ayabarieretwe eira,

English: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu alikuwa ametangulia kutuwekea kitu kilicho bora zaidi ili wao wasikamilishwe pasipo sisi.
Ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae natang’anete gotogachera intwe egento kere ekiya kobua, naki barabwo tibaikeranetigwe intwe totaiyo.

English: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, kwa kuwa tumezungukwa na wingu kubwa namna hii la mashahidi, basi na tuweke kando kila kitu kinachotuzuia na ile dhambi inayotuzinga kwa urahisi, nasi tupige mbio kwa saburi katika yale mashindano yaliyowekwa kwa ajili yetu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera intwe tore nabarori abange buna igo, batoetanaine buna riire, totugute are kera egurube, na ebibe biria bitobwatete. Tominyoke noboremereria ase okoamererania koria kobekire bosio bwaito,

English: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
Kiswahili: Basi na tumtazame sana Yesu mwanzilishi na mkamilishaji wa imani yetu, yeye ambaye kwa ajili ya furaha iliyowekwa mbele yake alistahimili msalaba, bila kujali aibu ya huo msalaba, naye ameketi mkono wa kuume wa kiti cha enzi cha Mungu.
Ekegusii: na korigereria Yeso, omochaki na omoikerania bw’okwegena gwaito. Ribaga ri’omogooko oyobegetwe bosio bwaye, akaremereria omosalaba na gochaaya obosooku, ere nigo aikaransete ensemo ya borio y’ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae.

English: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
Kiswahili: Mtafakarini sana yeye aliyestahimili upinzani mkuu namna hii kutoka kwa watu wenye dhambi, ili kwamba msije mkachoka na kukata tamaa.
Ekegusii: Gaki, morengererie mono ere oyoremereretie oboengereria buna obwo bokorwa ase abanyene ebibe igoro yaye ere omonyene, timocha kwebutokania na gokwa emioyo yaino.

English: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
Kiswahili: Katika kushindana kwenu dhidi ya dhambi, bado hamjapigana kiasi cha kumwaga damu yenu.
Ekegusii: Timorarwana esegi goika mwaiteire amanyinga aino ase okoamererania nebibe,

English: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
Kiswahili: Nanyi mmesahau yale maneno ya kuwaonya yanayowataja ninyi kuwa wana, yakisema: “Mwanangu, usidharau adhabu ya Bwana, wala usikate tamaa akikukemea,
Ekegusii: naende mwebire ogosorora koria kogokwana nainwe buna abana, “Omwana one, tochaya ogoakwa kw’Omonene kw’ogokorongeyia, gose tokwa omoyo karakoe egesusuro.

English: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
Kiswahili: kwa sababu Bwana huwaadibisha wale awapendao, na humwadhibu kila mmoja anayemkubali kuwa mwana.”
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyo Omonene anchete nigo akomoorongeyia, na kong’wania bororo omwana oyo obeire oyoye.”

English: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
Kiswahili: Vumilieni taabu kwa ajili ya kufunzwa adabu. Mungu anawatendea ninyi kama watoto wake, kwa maana ni mtoto yupi asiyeadibishwa na mzazi wake?
Ekegusii: Ekero mokorongeigwa moremererie Nyasae nigo akobakorera buna abana baye. Naki, mwana ki otari korongeigwa na ise?

English: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
Kiswahili: Kama hakuna kuadibishwa (ambalo ni fungu la watoto wote), basi ninyi ni watoto wa haramu wala si watoto halali.
Ekegusii: Korende onye mokoba motari nokorongeigwa oko bonsi babwataine nakorokwo, rirorio nigo more abana ebimeru gose tari abana ba boronge.

English: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?
Kiswahili: Tena, sisi sote tunao baba wa kimwili, waliotuadibisha nasi tukawaheshimu kwa ajili ya hilo. Je, si inatupasa kujinyenyekeza zaidi kwa Baba wa roho zetu ili tuishi?
Ekegusii: Amo nayio ntwarenge nabatata baito b’ense eye, baare gotorongeyia, na barabwo ntwabasigete. Inee! Tari buya mono kobua kwebeka inse ya Tata bw’emeika yaito, na koba moyo?

English: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
Kiswahili: Baba zetu walituadibisha kwa kitambo kidogo kama wao wenyewe walivyoona vyema, lakini Mungu hutuadibisha kwa faida yetu ili tupate kushiriki utakatifu wake.
Ekegusii: Naki ekeene, abatata baito b’ense nigo batorongeetie ase amatuko amake buna baroche buya, korende ere nigo agotorongeyia ase ogotokonya, erinde tobe ababwatani b’obochenu bwaye.

English: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
Kiswahili: Kuadibishwa wakati wowote hakuonekani kuwa kitu cha kufurahisha bali chenye maumivu kinapotekelezwa. Lakini baadaye huzaa matunda ya haki na amani kwa wale waliofunzwa nayo.
Ekegusii: Kera okorongeigwa ase engaki yaye gokororekana ng’a tikori egento ki’omogooko, korende neki’omoichano. Korende magega yaye abakonarire banyore okwama kw’omorembe na okw’oboronge.

English: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, itieni nguvu mikono yenu iliyo dhaifu na magoti yenu yaliyolegea.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, mobeke chinguru amaboko ayio ororobire, na amaru ayagataire.

English: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
Kiswahili: Sawazisheni mapito ya miguu yenu, ili kitu kilicho kiwete kisidhoofishwe bali kiponywe.
Ekegusii: Mokorere amagoro aino chinchera chindonge, erinde ekere ekerema tikeotoranwa, korende kobua mono kegwenigwe.

English: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
Kiswahili: Tafuteni kwa bidii kuwa na amani na watu wote na huo utakatifu, ambao bila kuwa nao hakuna mtu atakayemwona Bwana.
Ekegusii: Kora omokia koba nomorembe nabaanto bonsi, na rigia obochenu, ekiagera onde tari orarore Omonene, atari naborobwo.

English: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,
Kiswahili: Angalieni sana mtu yeyote asiikose neema ya Mungu na kwamba shina la uchungu lisije likachipuka na kuwasumbua na watu wengi wakatiwa unajisi kwa hilo.
Ekegusii: Morigererie mono ng’a onde taremerwa obuya bwa Nyasae, “omori bw’obororo” tocha gokumbaria na kobachanda, na abanto abange batambokerigwe ogotacheneka ase oyio.

English: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
Kiswahili: Angalieni miongoni mwenu asiwepo mwasherati au mtu asiyemcha Mungu kama Esau, ambaye kwa ajili ya mlo mmoja aliuza haki ya uzaliwa wake wa kwanza.
Ekegusii: Morigererie ng’a onde taba omotomani, gose oyotamosigeti Nyasae, buna Esau, oyoonetie omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi ase endagera eyemo.

English: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
Kiswahili: Baadaye kama mnavyofahamu, alipotaka kurithi ile baraka, alikataliwa, maana hakupata nafasi ya kutubu, ingawa aliitafuta kwa machozi.
Ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire buya ng’a ekero achiete korigia omwando bw’ogosesenigwa korwa magega, agakanigwa, naki tanyora ribaga ri’okoonchoka nonya oririgetie mono namariga.

English: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
Kiswahili: Hamjaufikia mlima ule uwezao kuguswa na ambao unawaka moto; wala kwenye giza, utusitusi na dhoruba;
Ekegusii: Naki timoraika ase egetunwa keranyare gokunwa, kegwoka omorero, gose omosunte, ne riire rimwamu, na ekembobe,

English: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
Kiswahili: kwenye mlio wa tarumbeta, au kwenye sauti isemayo maneno ya kutisha kiasi ambacho wale walioisikia waliomba wasiambiwe neno jingine zaidi,
Ekegusii: na egeturi ki’egetureeri, na eriogi ri’amang’ana. Abwo bayaigwete bagasorora tibateebigwa ing’ana rinde naende.

English: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu hawangeweza kustahimili neno lile lililoamriwa: “Hata kama mnyama atagusa mlima huu, atapigwa mawe.”
Ekegusii: Naki tibanyarete koremereria ring’ana riria riachiigetwe, “Nonya neng’iti eise gokuna egetunwa nabo eraakwe amagena.”

English: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
Kiswahili: Waliyoyaona yalikuwa ya kutisha kiasi kwamba Mose alisema, “Ninatetemeka kwa hofu.”
Ekegusii: Aya arorekanete igo arenge ay’okwoboyia, goika Musa agateeba, “Nabwatirwe nomoondoko na okoiguswa.”

English: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi mmekuja Mlima Sayuni, Yerusalemu ya mbinguni, mji wa Mungu aliye hai. Mmekuja penye kusanyiko kubwa la malaika maelfu kwa maelfu wasiohesabika wanaoshangilia,
Ekegusii: Korende inwe mwaikire egetunwa gekorokwa Sayoni, na omochie o Nyasae ore moyo, Yerusalemu ya igoro, na abamalaika abange batari kobareka,

English: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
Kiswahili: kwenye kanisa la wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Mungu, ambao majina yao yameandikwa mbinguni. Mmekuja kwa Mungu, mhukumu wa watu wote, kwenye roho za wenye haki waliokamilishwa,
Ekegusii: na omosangererekano bw’omoyega, na omosangererekano bw’abaiborwa b’eritang’ani, abwo amarieta abo ariikire igoro, na Nyasae oyore omogambi bw’abaanto bonsi, na emeika y’abanto abanyene oboronge abaikeraniigwe,

English: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
Kiswahili: kwa Yesu mpatanishi wa agano jipya, na kwa damu iliyonyunyizwa, ile inenayo mambo mema kuliko damu ya Abeli.
Ekegusii: na Yeso oyore omobwatania bw’okobwatana okoyia, na amanyinga akonyororokerigwa ayagokwana buya kobua aria ay’Abeli.

English: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
Kiswahili: Angalieni, msije mkamkataa yeye anenaye. Ikiwa wao hawakuepuka adhabu walipomkataa yeye aliyewaonya hapa duniani, sisi je, tutaokokaje tusipomsikiliza yeye anayetuonya kutoka mbinguni?
Ekegusii: Rigereria, timomwanga ere oyogokwana. Naki onye baria tibetooretie baria bamwangete ere oyobakuurerete ase ense, kobua mono intwe titogwetooria onye tokomwanga ere oyogotokuurera korwa igoro.

English: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
Kiswahili: Wakati ule sauti yake ilitetemesha dunia, lakini sasa ameahidi, “Kwa mara moja tena nitatetemesha si nchi tu bali na mbingu pia.”
Ekegusii: Na eriogi riaye ndiatengechetie ense ekero keria, korende bono oriire eira, ogoteeba, “Ara rimo naende nintengechie ense, gose tari ense yoka, korende na igoro boigo.”

English: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
Kiswahili: Maneno haya “kwa mara moja tena” yanaonyesha kuondoshwa kwa vile vitu vinavyoweza kutetemeshwa, yaani vile vitu vilivyoumbwa, kwa kusudi vile tu visivyoweza kutetemeshwa vibaki.
Ekegusii: Korende ring’ana eri, “Ara rimo naende”, nigo rikoorokia, ng’a ebinto biria bigotengechigwa nigo birang’anyigwe ekiagera biatongetwe, erinde ebitanyare gotengechigwa bibeo.

English: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa tunapokea ufalme ambao hauwezi kutetemeshwa, basi na tuwe na shukrani, na hivyo tumwabudu Mungu kwa namna inayompendeza, kwa unyenyekevu na uchaji,
Ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera twanyorire oborwoti obotanyare gotengechigwa, tiga toiranerie ng’a mbuya mono na komokorera Nyasae ase okomogokia amo namasikani na okoiroka.

English: for our God is a consuming fire.
Kiswahili: kwa kuwa “Mungu wetu ni moto ulao.”
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae oito nomorero okoria na gosiria.

English: Let brotherly love continue.
Kiswahili: Endeleeni kupendana kama ndugu.
Ekegusii: Mogenderere nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.

English: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
Kiswahili: Msisahau kuwakaribisha wageni, kwa kuwa kwa kufanya hivyo, watu wengine waliwakaribisha malaika pasipo kujua.
Ekegusii: Timweba koroisia abageni, naki ase enchera eye abande mbaroisetie abamalaika, batamanyete.

English: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
Kiswahili: Wakumbukeni wale waliofungwa gerezani kana kwamba ninyi mmefungwa pamoja nao. Pia wakumbukeni wale wanaotendewa vibaya, kana kwamba ni ninyi wenyewe mnateswa.
Ekegusii: Inyora abwo basibire ase echela, buna nainwe mosibire amo nabarabwo, naende barabwo mbakoreretwe bobe, ekiagera naboigo nainwe more nomobere.

English: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
Kiswahili: Ndoa na iheshimiwe na watu wote, nayo malazi yawe safi, kwa kuwa Mungu atawahukumu wazinzi na waasherati wote.
Ekegusii: Okonyuomana gosikwe nabaanto bonsi, na ebiraarero bibe bitari nobosooku, naki abanyaka na abatomani Nyasae nabagaambie ekiina.

English: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
Kiswahili: Yalindeni maisha yenu msiwe na tabia ya kupenda fedha, bali mridhike na vile mlivyo navyo, kwa sababu Mungu amesema, “Kamwe sitakuacha, wala sitakupungukia.”
Ekegusii: Timoba abanchi chitaabu, moisaneke nebi more nabio, ekiagera ere omonyene oteebire, “Tinkogotiga nonya ng’ake, gose tingokoremera.”

English: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo tunaweza kusema kwa ujasiri, “Bwana ni msaada wangu; sitaogopa. Mwanadamu anaweza kunitenda nini?”
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ntonyare goteeba noboremu, “Omonene nere omokonyi one, tinkwoboa. Mwanyabaanto, inki arankorere?”

English: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
Kiswahili: Wakumbukeni viongozi wenu, wale waliowaambia neno la Mungu. Angalieni matokeo ya mwenendo wa maisha yao mkaiige imani yao.
Ekegusii: Inyora abwo baare kobatang’ana, abaabateebetie ring’ana ria Nyasae. Naende morengererie mono omoerio bw’obogima bwabo, mobe abegi b’okwegena kwabo.

English: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
Kiswahili: Yesu Kristo ni yeye yule jana, leo na hata milele.
Ekegusii: Yeso Kristo buna arenge igoro, na buna are reero, nabo arabe goika kare na kare.

English: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
Kiswahili: Msichukuliwe na kila aina ya mafundisho ya kigeni. Ni vyema mioyo yenu iimarishwe kwa neema, wala si kwa sheria kuhusu utaratibu wa vyakula, ambavyo havina faida kwa wale wanaozishika hizo sheria.
Ekegusii: Timoirwa bogeka namorokererio ao ao, ayare ay’ekegeni, ekiagera mbuya chinkoro chibekwe chinguru ase obuya, gose tari ase emeroberio y’okoria endagera ase eyio barabwo bagendererete neyio tibanyora gokonywa konde.

English: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
Kiswahili: Sisi tunayo madhabahu ambayo wale wanaohudumu katika hema hawana haki ya kula vile vitu vilivyowekwa juu yake.
Ekegusii: Ntore negesasiimero aase baria bagokorera Eema batari ne ribaga koria ebinto bikoruegwa aroro.

English: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
Kiswahili: Kuhani mkuu huchukua damu ya wanyama na kuiingiza Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, kama sadaka ya dhambi, lakini miili ya hao wanyama huteketezwa nje ya kambi.
Ekegusii: Naki emebere ye ching’iti chiria amanyinga abo are korentwa ime Aase Aachenu n’Omokuani omonene ase engencho y’ebibe, nigo yare gosamberwa isiko y’omochie.

English: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, Yesu naye aliteswa nje ya lango la mji ili awatakase watu kwa damu yake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, Yeso nere agachanderwa isiko y’egeita, erinde achene abanto namanyinga aye ere omonyene.

English: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, basi na tumwendee nje ya kambi, tukiichukua aibu aliyobeba.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, togende asare isiko y’omochie, tobwatane nere ase okoramwa kwaye,

English: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hapa hatuna mji udumuo, bali tunautafuta ule ujao.
Ekegusii: ekiagera aiga titori nomochie oragenderere, korende nigo tokorigia oria orache gocha.

English: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
Kiswahili: Basi kwa njia ya Yesu, tuzidi kumtolea Mungu dhabihu ya sifa, yaani matunda ya midomo inayolikiri Jina lake.
Ekegusii: Gaki, goetera asare togenderere koa Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okomotogia, engencho yaye okwama kw’emenwa yaito eyekoorokia erieta riaye.

English: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
Kiswahili: Na msiache kutenda mema na kushirikiana vile vitu mlivyo navyo, kwa kuwa dhabihu kama hizo ndizo zinazompendeza Mungu.
Ekegusii: Timweba gokora amaya, na gosanga nabande, naki ebing’wanso binga buna ebi nabio bikomogwenera Nyasae.

English: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
Kiswahili: Watiini viongozi wenu na kujinyenyekeza chini ya mamlaka yao. Kwa maana wao wanakesha kwa ajili yenu kama watu watakaopaswa kutoa hesabu. Watiini ili wafanye kazi yao kwa furaha, wala si kama mzigo, maana hiyo haitakuwa na faida kwenu.
Ekegusii: Moigwere abwo bakobatang’ana, na mobasike, ekiagera barabwo nigo barendete emioyo yaino buna abanto barache korua omobaro, erinde banyare gokora ayio ase omogooko. Onye bagocha koyakora ase okweumia anga taba na gokonywa konde ase more.

English: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
Kiswahili: Tuombeeni. Tuna hakika kuwa tunayo dhamiri safi na shauku ya kuishi kwa uadilifu kwa kila njia.
Ekegusii: Tosabere, naki ntore nobomaene ng’a chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, ntorigetie koba norogendo oruya ase amang’ana onsi.

English: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
Kiswahili: Ninawasihi zaidi mniombee ili nipate kurudishwa kwenu upesi.
Ekegusii: Na inche nabasoroire mono kobua gokora ayio, erinde ng’iranigwe ase more bwango.

English: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
Kiswahili: Basi Mungu wa amani, ambaye kwa damu ya Agano la milele alimleta tena kutoka kwa wafu Bwana wetu Yesu, yule Mchungaji Mkuu wa kondoo,
Ekegusii: Bono Nyasae bw’omorembe oyomorentete naende korwa ase amakweri Omonene oito Yeso, oyore omorisia omonene bwe ching’ondi goetera ase amanyinga y’okobwatana gwa kare na kare,

English: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
Kiswahili: awafanye ninyi wakamilifu mkiwa mmekamilishwa katika kila jambo jema ili mpate kutenda mapenzi yake, naye atende ndani yetu kile kinachompendeza machoni Pake, kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo, ambaye utukufu una yeye milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: ere abakore mobe abaikeranu ase kera ogokora okuya, monyare gokora obwanchani bwaye, naende akore ime yaino ayagwenerete ase obosio bwaye goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene bwa kare na kare. Amina.

English: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, nawasihi mchukuliane na maneno yangu ya maonyo, kwa kuwa nimewaandikia waraka mfupi tu.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, nababoririe, moremererie ring’ana eri ri’ogosorora, ekiagera nabarikeire ase amang’ana amake.

English: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
Kiswahili: Nataka ninyi mjue kwamba ndugu yetu Timotheo amefunguliwa kutoka gerezani. Akifika mapema, nitakuja pamoja naye kuwaona.
Ekegusii: Manya ng’a oyominto Timotheo oikire gosiborwa. Amo nere ntoche kobarora karache bwango.

English: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
Kiswahili: Wasalimuni viongozi wenu wote na watakatifu wote. Wale wa kutoka Italia wanawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Nkwanerie abwo bonsi bakobatang’ana, na abachenu bonsi. Abwo baruete Italia baabakwanirie.

English: Grace be with you all. Amen.
Kiswahili: Neema iwe nanyi nyote. Amen.
Ekegusii: Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.

English: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
Kiswahili: Yakobo, mtumwa wa Mungu na wa Bwana Yesu Kristo: Kwa makabila kumi na mawili yaliyotawanyika ulimwenguni: Salamu.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Yakobo, omosomba o Nyasae na Omonene Yeso Kristo, nabakwanirie inwe abanto ba Nyasae, abamwatananekire gochia chinse chire ao ao.

English: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, hesabuni kuwa ni furaha tupu mnapopatwa na majaribu mbalimbali,
Ekegusii: Abaminto, bara ng’a nomogooko bwoka komorasoe ase amateemwa are ao ao,

English: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu mnajua ya kuwa kujaribiwa kwa imani yenu huleta saburi.
Ekegusii: ekiagera momanyete ng’a ekero okwegena kwaino kogoteemwa nigo mokweorokereria oboremereria.

English: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
Kiswahili: Saburi na iwe na kazi timilifu, ili mpate kuwa wakamilifu, mmekamilishwa, bila kupungukiwa na kitu chochote.
Ekegusii: Tiga oboremereria obwo bobe nemeremo emeikeranu, erinde monyare koba abaikeranu, na abagima, motaremeiri na ing’ana rinde rionsi.

English: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu amepungukiwa na hekima na amwombe Mungu, yeye awapaye watu wote kwa ukarimu wala hana kinyongo, naye atapewa.
Ekegusii: Korende onye monto onde oino oremeire obong’aini, tiga asabe Nyasae, ere nabomoe, ekiagera nigo akoa abanto bonsi ase obonge, gose tari gotogonyera onde.

English: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
Kiswahili: Lakini anapoomba, lazima aamini wala asiwe na shaka, kwa sababu mtu aliye na shaka ni kama wimbi la bahari, lililochukuliwa na upepo na kutupwa huku na huku.
Ekegusii: Korende oyogosaba, tiga asabe ase okwegena, taba na tang’u‐tang’u, ekiagera oyore ne chitang’u‐tang’u nigo are buna emerindo y’enyancha ekona‐koirwa nomwaga gochia aaria na aaria.
