English: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
Kiswahili: Mtu kama huyo asidhani ya kuwa atapata kitu chochote kutoka kwa Bwana.
Ekegusii: Naki omonto oria takaga ng’a nanyore egento korwa ase Omonene;

English: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni mtu mwenye nia mbili, mwenye kusitasita katika njia zake zote.
Ekegusii: ere nigo are nemioyo ebere, na gotiting’ara ase chinchera chiaye chionsi.

English: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
Kiswahili: Ndugu asiye na cheo kikubwa yampasa ajivunie hali hiyo maana ametukuzwa.
Ekegusii: Korende abakristo abare abataka bagoke, ekiagera Nyasae abaimokereirie igoro,

English: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye aliye tajiri afurahi kwa kuwa ameshushwa, kwa sababu atatoweka kama ua la shambani.
Ekegusii: na abakristo abanda, nabarabwo bagoke kobairanigwe inse, ekiagera nigo barasire buna egesicha ki’obonyansi.

English: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana jua kali lenye kuchoma huchomoza na kuliunguza, likayakausha majani, na ua lake likapukutika, nao uzuri wake huharibika. Vivyo hivyo tajiri naye atanyauka akiwa anaendelea na shughuli zake.
Ekegusii: Naki erioba korikooroka nomobaso omoororo, nigo rigosamba na kwomia obonyansi. Egesicha ki’obonyansi kiaroroka, na obuya bw’ekieni kiaye bwasira. Naboigo nomonda nere arasire kagendererete kwerigeria.

English: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
Kiswahili: Heri mtu anayevumilia wakati wa majaribu, kwa sababu akiisha kushinda hilo jaribio atapewa taji la uzima Mungu alilowaahidia wale wampendao.
Ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria oremereretie ogoteemwa, ekiagera ekero aikire gwancherwa nanyore obogima buna egutwa y’obobui, obogima obwo Nyasae abarierete eira abwo bamwanchete.

English: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
Kiswahili: Mtu anapojaribiwa asiseme, “Ninajaribiwa na Mungu.” Kwa maana Mungu hawezi kujaribiwa na maovu wala yeye hamjaribu mtu yeyote.
Ekegusii: Omonto karateemwe, tateeba “Nateemirwe na Nyasae” ekiagera Nyasae tagoteemwa namabe, gose tagoteema omonto.

English: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila mtu hujaribiwa wakati anapovutwa na kudanganywa na tamaa zake mwenyewe zilizo mbaya.
Ekegusii: Korende kera omonto nigo agoteemwa ekero akong’uswa na kong’ainwa nokogania kwaye omonyene.

English: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
Kiswahili: Basi ile tamaa mbaya ikishachukua mimba, huzaa dhambi, nayo ile dhambi ikikomaa, huzaa mauti.
Ekegusii: Na okogania koria okobe gokwabogoirie oborito kwaibora ebibe, na ebibe biria kobiakiinire, biarenta amakweri.

English: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu wapendwa, msidanganyike.
Ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, timong’aineka.

English: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
Kiswahili: Kila kitolewacho kilicho chema na kilicho kamili, hutoka juu, na hushuka kutoka kwa Baba wa mianga, ambaye kwake hakuna kubadilika, wala kivuli cha kugeukageuka.
Ekegusii: Kera ekerugwa ekiya, na kera ekeegwa geikeranete nigo gekorwa ase Ise bw’emebaso. Asare koonchoka tikoiyo, gose ekiriri kende gekooncha‐onchoka.

English: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
Kiswahili: Kwa mapenzi yake mwenyewe alituzaa kwa neno la kweli, kusudi tuwe kama mazao ya kwanza katika viumbe vyake vyote.
Ekegusii: Ase ogwancha kwaye ere omonyene agatoibora ase ring’ana riaye ri’ekeene, erinde tobe buna ogotongorwa konde kw’ebitongwa biaye.

English: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu wapendwa, fahamuni jambo hili: Kila mtu awe mwepesi wa kusikiliza, lakini asiwe mwepesi wa kusema wala wa kukasirika.
Ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, momanye ring’ana eri: Kera omonto abe omwango ase okoigwa, korende abe bwe ng’ora ase ogokwana, na bwe ng’ora ase okoba nendamwamu,

English: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana hasira ya mwanadamu haitendi haki ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera endamwamu ya Mwanyabaanto teri gokora ayare boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ondoleeni mbali uchafu wote na uovu ambao umezidi kuwa mwingi, mkalipokee kwa unyenyekevu lile Neno lililopandwa ndani yenu ambalo laweza kuokoa nafsi zenu.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, beka aare ogotacheneka gwonsi, na obonge bw’amabe, na ase obwororo mwanche ring’ana erio riasimekirwe ime yaino, eriranyare kobatooria.

English: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
Kiswahili: Basi kuweni watendaji wa Neno wala msiwe wasikiaji tu, huku mkijidanganya nafsi zenu.
Ekegusii: Timweng’aina inwe abanyene ase okoigwa ring’ana riaye rioka, korende ribeeke ase ebikorwa.

English: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama mtu ni msikiaji tu wa Neno wala hatendi kile linachosema, yeye ni kama mtu ajitazamaye uso wake kwenye kioo
Ekegusii: Naki omonto karabe omotegereri bw’ering’ana, gose tari omorikori, oyio nigo anga buna omonto oyokwerigereria obosio bwaye omonyene ase ekerore.

English: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
Kiswahili: na baada ya kujiona alivyo, huenda zake na mara husahau jinsi alivyo.
Ekegusii: Igo akwerigereria, naende ogenda ase agochia, erio kegima bweba buna erora arenge.

English: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye anayeangalia kwa bidii katika sheria kamilifu, ile iletayo uhuru, naye akaendelea kufanya hivyo bila kusahau alichosikia, bali akalitenda, atabarikiwa katika kile anachofanya.
Ekegusii: Korende oyorigereretie amachiiko amaikeranu ay’obosibore, na goikaransa aroro, na taba oyokoigwa na kweba, korende abe omokori okoyakora, oyio nabe oyosesenirie ase ogokora kwaye.

English: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akidhani ya kuwa anayo dini lakini hauzuii ulimi wake kwa hatamu, hujidanganya moyoni mwake, wala dini yake mtu huyo haifai kitu.
Ekegusii: Omonto karekage ng’a nkomokorera are Nyasae, na ere tagambereti oromeme rwaye, korende nenkoro yaye akong’aina, igo okomokorera Nyasae kwaye nigo kore okwa bosa.

English: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
Kiswahili: Dini iliyo safi, isiyo na uchafu, inayokubalika mbele za Mungu Baba yetu, ndiyo hii: Kuwasaidia yatima na wajane katika dhiki zao na kujilinda usitiwe madoa na dunia.
Ekegusii: Okomokorera Nyasae okore ogochenu, gotari na komocha ase obosio bwa Nyasae Tata noko: Gochia korora chintakana na ababoraka ase obokong’u bwabo, na kwerenda ere omonyene, na igo taba na kemoa gi’ense.

English: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, kama waaminio katika imani ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, Bwana wa utukufu, msiwe na upendeleo kwa watu.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, komorabe mwegeenete Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Omonene bw’obonene, timoba mogwanchereria abanto.

English: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kama akija mtu katika kusanyiko lenu akiwa amevaa pete ya dhahabu na mavazi mazuri, pia akaingia mtu maskini mwenye mavazi yaliyochakaa,
Ekegusii: Naki karasoe ase omosangererekano oino omonto obegete ebonyi y’etaabu ase ekiara kiaye, na bweboetie chianga chingiya, naende omonto onde asoe, oyore omotaka na bweboetie chianga chire ne riko,

English: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”
Kiswahili: nanyi mkampa heshima yule aliyevaa mavazi mazuri na kumwambia, “Keti hapa mahali pazuri,” lakini yule maskini mkamwambia, “Wewe simama pale,” au “Keti hapa sakafuni karibu na miguu yangu,”
Ekegusii: na inwe mwasika oria bweboetie chianga chingiya, na komoteebia “Ikaransa aye aiga aase aagiya” na goteebia oria omotaka, “Tenena aaria”, gose, “Ikaransa inse aa ase amagoro aane”,

English: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
Kiswahili: je, hamjawabagua na kuwa mahakimu mioyoni mwenu mkihukumu kwa mawazo yenu maovu?
Ekegusii: Inee, timokoreti ogwatananeka ase egati yaino inwe abanyene, na mwabeire abagaambi, more nebirengererio ebibe?

English: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, sikilizeni: Je, Mungu hakuwachagua wale walio maskini machoni pa ulimwengu kuwa matajiri katika imani na kuurithi Ufalme aliowaahidi wale wampendao?
Ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, tegerera! Inee! Nyasae tachorete abataka b’ense eye babe abanda ase okwegena, naende babe abanyamwando b’oborwoti obo abarierete eira, abwo bamwanchete?

English: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi mmemdharau yule aliye maskini. Je, hao matajiri si ndio wanaowadhulumu na kuwaburuta mahakamani?
Ekegusii: Korende inwe mwachayire oria omotaka. Inee! Baria abanda, tari barabwo baabaregete inwe, na kobakurura gochia ase ebigambero?

English: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
Kiswahili: Je, si wao wanaolikufuru Jina lile lililo bora sana mliloitiwa?
Ekegusii: Tari barabwo abwo bakorama erieta erio rigiya mwarokirwe inwe?

English: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
Kiswahili: Kama kweli mnaitimiza ile sheria ya kifalme inayopatikana katika Maandiko isemayo, “Mpende jirani yako kama unavyoipenda nafsi yako,” mnafanya vyema.
Ekegusii: Komoraikeranie ogochika gokorwa ase oborwoti buna koriikire ase amariiko, “Ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete”.

English: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama mnakuwa na upendeleo kwa watu, mnatenda dhambi, na sheria inawahukumu kuwa ninyi ni wakosaji.
Ekegusii: Korende onye more mogwanchereria abanto, mwakorire ebibe, na mwaenekigwe namachiiko ng’a nabasaria more.

English: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mtu yeyote anayeishika sheria yote lakini akajikwaa katika kipengele kimoja tu, ana hatia ya kuivunja sheria yote.
Ekegusii: Naki monto onde bwensi obwatete amachiiko onsi, korende asarie erimo rioka, obeire omomochi ase onsi.

English: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu yeye aliyesema, “Usizini,” alisema pia, “Usiue.” Basi kama huzini lakini unaua, umekuwa mvunjaji wa sheria.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyotebete, “Totomana”, nere boigo agateeba, “Toita”. Gaki, onye totomaneti, korende gwaitire, igo kwabeire omosaria amachiiko.

English: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.
Kiswahili: Hivyo semeni na kutenda kama watu watakaohukumiwa kwa sheria ile iletayo uhuru.
Ekegusii: Kwana bo, na kora boigo, buna abanto barache kogambigwa ase amachiiko obosibore.

English: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hukumu bila huruma itatolewa kwa mtu yeyote asiyekuwa na huruma. Huruma huishinda hukumu.
Ekegusii: Naki ekiina tikeri namaabera asere oyotari namaabera. Amaabera nigo agochenga igoro y’ekina.

English: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, yafaa nini ikiwa mtu atadai kuwa anayo imani lakini hana matendo? Je, imani kama hiyo yaweza kumwokoa?
Ekegusii: Abaminto, ngokonywa ki omonto aranyore onye ogoteeba ng’a nare nokwegena, na ere tari nogokora? Inee! Okwegena koria nkonyare komotooria?

English: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
Kiswahili: Ikiwa ndugu yako au dada hana mavazi wala chakula,
Ekegusii: Onye oyomino, omosacha gose omokungu, ore bosa, na oremeire endagera ya kera rituko,

English: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
Kiswahili: mmoja wenu akamwambia, “Enenda zako kwa amani, ukaote moto na kushiba,” pasipo kumpatia yale mahitaji ya mwili aliyopungukiwa, yafaa nini?
Ekegusii: na omonto onde oino amoteebie, “Genda nomorembe, bwote omorero, oigote”, korende tamoa ebiaganetie ase omobere oye, naki aramokonye?

English: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, imani peke yake kama haikuambatana na matendo, imekufa.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nokwegena gwoka gotari nogokora, nigo gokwete.

English: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu mwingine atasema, “Wewe unayo imani; mimi ninayo matendo.” Nionyeshe imani yako pasipo matendo nami nitakuonyesha imani yangu kwa matendo.
Ekegusii: Aande gose omonto nateebe, “Aye nore nokwegena, na inche ninde nogokora.” Nimoiranerie, “Nyorokia okwegena kwao gotari nogokora, na inche nkworokie okwegena kwane ase ogokora kwane.”

English: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.
Kiswahili: Unaamini kwamba kuna Mungu mmoja. Vyema! Hata mashetani yanaamini hivyo na kutetemeka.
Ekegusii: Aye mbwegenete ng’a Nyasae noyomo; gwakorire buya. Nonya nebirecha mbiegeneete boigo na koiguswa.

English: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
Kiswahili: Ewe mpumbavu! Je, wataka kujua kwamba imani bila matendo haifai kitu?
Ekegusii: Korende aye, omoriri, norigetie komanya ng’a okwegena gotari nogokora nigo kore bosa?

English: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
Kiswahili: Je, Abrahamu baba yetu hakuhesabiwa haki kwa kile alichotenda, alipomtoa mwanawe Isaki madhabahuni?
Ekegusii: Inee! Sokoro yaito Aburaamu taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aruete Isaka, omwana oye, igoro ase egesasiimero?

English: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.
Kiswahili: Unaona jinsi ambavyo imani yake na matendo yake vilikuwa vinatenda kazi pamoja, nayo imani yake ikakamilishwa na kile alichotenda.
Ekegusii: Kwarorire ng’a okwegena kwaye amo nogokora mbiakorete emeremo, na okwegena koria kogaikeranigwa ase ogokora.

English: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hiyo yakatimizwa yale Maandiko yasemayo, “Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu na ikahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki,” naye akaitwa rafiki wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Amariko agaikeranigwa, aria agoteeba, “Aburaamu nigo amwegeenete Nyasae, na ase engencho eyio akabarwa koba omonyene oboronge.” Igo akarokwa omosani o Nyasae.

English: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.
Kiswahili: Mnaona ya kwamba mtu huhesabiwa haki kwa yale anayotenda wala si kwa imani peke yake.
Ekegusii: Mwarorire ng’a Mwanyabaanto nigo akoegwa oboronge ase ogokora, gose tari ase okwegena gwoka.

English: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, hata Rahabu, yule kahaba, hakuhesabiwa haki kwa yale aliyotenda alipowapokea wale wapelelezi na kuwaambia waende njia nyingine?
Ekegusii: Naboigo na Rahabu, oria omotayayi, Inee, taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aroisetie baria batometwe, akabasokia isiko ase enchera ende eng’ao?

English: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
Kiswahili: Kama vile ambavyo mwili pasipo roho umekufa, kadhalika nayo imani pasipo matendo imekufa.
Ekegusii: Naki buna omobere otari n’Omoika nigo okwete, naboigo nokwegena gotari nogokora nigo gokwete.

English: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, msiwe walimu wengi, kwa maana mnafahamu kwamba sisi tufundishao tutahukumiwa vikali zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, tegwenereti abange ase more babe aborokia, ekiagera momanyete ng’a intwe aborokia inatogambigwe ekiina egekong’u kobua.

English: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.
Kiswahili: Sisi sote tunajikwaa katika mambo mengi. Ikiwa mtu yeyote hakosei kamwe katika yale anayosema, yeye ni mkamilifu, naye anaweza kuuzuia pia na mwili wake wote.
Ekegusii: Naki intwe twensi nigo tokomocha ase chinchera chinyinge. Onye omonto takomocha ase ogokwana, oyio nomonto omoikeranu, oranyare kogambera omobere oye bwonsi boigo.

English: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
Kiswahili: Tunapotia lijamu kwenye vinywa vya farasi ili kuwafanya watutii, tunaweza kuigeuza miili yao yote.
Ekegusii: Onye tokobekera chibarasi ebinto emenwa, ebi’ogochiraa, erinde chitoigwere, nigo tokoraa emebere yabo yonsi.

English: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
Kiswahili: Au angalia pia meli, ingawa ni kubwa sana, nazo huchukuliwa na upepo mkali, lakini hugeuzwa kwa usukani mdogo sana, kokote anakotaka nahodha.
Ekegusii: Morigererie chimeeri boigo, nonya chire chinene mono, na chikoirwa nomwaga omotindi, nigo chikoonchorwa nekeonchori egeke mono, aande onsi omogendia aganetie kogenda.

English: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo ulimi ni kiungo kidogo sana katika mwili, lakini hujivuna majivuno makuu. Fikirini jinsi moto mdogo unavyoweza kuteketeza msitu mkubwa!
Ekegusii: Naboigo na oromeme nekiimo egeke, na rororwo nigo rokweenenia ase amang’ana amanene. Rigereria buna ensase enke egosamba rinani rinene mono.

English: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
Kiswahili: Ulimi pia ni moto, ndio ulimwengu wa uovu kati ya viungo vya mwili. Ulimi huutia mwili wote wa mtu unajisi na kuuwasha moto mfumo mzima wa maisha yake, nao wenyewe huchomwa moto wa jehanamu.
Ekegusii: Oromeme narwo omorero, na ense y’obobe. Ase ebiimo biaito bionsi oromeme narwo rokobeeka omobere bwonsi ebimoa, na gotongia omorero egesingo ki’obogima bwaito, na orwo oronyene nigo rwatongetwe nomorero o kare na kare.

English: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila aina ya wanyama, ndege, wanyama watambaao na viumbe vya baharini vinafugika na vimefugwa na binadamu,
Ekegusii: Naki kera egesaku gie ching’iti, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chigwekurura, na ebitongwa ebire amaache ime, nigo bitugire, na birobio nigo bitugire na Mwanyabaanto.

English: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
Kiswahili: lakini hakuna mtu awezaye kuufuga ulimi. Ni uovu usiotulia, umejaa sumu iletayo mauti.
Ekegusii: Korende oromeme, onde tari ase Mwanyabaanto oranyare korotuga. Rororwo nobobe, rotari kogamberwa, roichire nobosongo bokorenta amakweri.

English: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa ulimi tunamhimidi Bwana, yaani Baba yetu, na kwa huo twawalaani watu walioumbwa kwa mfano wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase orwo twatogia Omonene Tata, na ase orwo twaragereria Mwanyabaanto abatongetwe ase omogwekano o Nyasae.

English: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
Kiswahili: Katika kinywa kile kile hutoka baraka na laana. Ndugu zangu, haistahili kuwa hivyo.
Ekegusii: Omonwa oria oria orua ogosesenia na okoragereria. Abaminto, amang’ana aya tagwenereti koba bo.

English: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
Kiswahili: Je, chemchemi yaweza kutoa katika tundu moja maji matamu na maji ya chumvi?
Ekegusii: Inee! Ensoko nenyare ase entuboka eyemo korenta amaache amaya, na amaache amaroro?

English: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
Kiswahili: Je, ndugu zangu, mtini waweza kuzaa zeituni, au mzabibu kuzaa tini? Wala chemchemi ya maji ya chumvi haiwezi kutoa maji matamu.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, Inee, omoko nonyare kwama amazeituni, gose omosabibu bwame amako? Naboigo nensoko y’amaache are n’omonyoo tekonyara korenta amaache atari nomoonyo.

English: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
Kiswahili: Ni nani aliye na hekima na ufahamu miongoni mwenu? Basi na aionyeshe hiyo kwa maisha yake mema na kwa matendo yake yaliyotendwa kwa unyenyekevu utokanao na hekima.
Ekegusii: Mbarabi ase more bare nobong’aini na obomanyi? Barobwo baorokie ogokora kwabo ase orogendo rwabo oruya, ase obwororo bokorwa ase obong’aini.

English: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
Kiswahili: Lakini ikiwa mna wivu na ni wenye chuki na ugomvi mioyoni mwenu, msijisifu kwa ajili ya hayo wala msiikatae kweli.
Ekegusii: Korende onye more ne ribero rire nobororo, na okweancha ase chinkoro chiaino ime, timwetogia na gokwana oborimo igoro y’ekeene.

English: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
Kiswahili: Hekima ya namna hiyo haishuki kutoka mbinguni, bali ni ya kidunia, isiyo ya kiroho, na ya kishetani.
Ekegusii: Obong’aini obo tari boria bogocha korwa igoro, korende nobw’ense, na obwe chingencho chia Mwanyabaanto, na saitani,

English: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana panapokuwa na wivu na ubinafsi, ndipo penye machafuko na uovu wa kila namna.
Ekegusii: ekiagera agwo ase ribero rire, na okweancha, agwo moroberio toiyo, korende kera ogokora okobe.

English: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
Kiswahili: Lakini hekima itokayo mbinguni kwanza ni safi, kisha inapenda amani, tena ni ya upole, iliyo tayari kusikiliza wengine kwa unyenyekevu, iliyojaa huruma na matunda mema, isiyopendelea mtu, tena isiyokuwa na unafiki.
Ekegusii: Korende obong’aini bokorwa igoro ritang’ani nigo bore obochenu, naende obw’omorembe, na obwororo, na obokanyeku. Igo boichire namaabera na okwama okuya, botari na gosiereria gose na bong’ainereria.

English: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
Kiswahili: Mavuno ya haki hupandwa katika amani na wale wafanyao amani.
Ekegusii: Okwama kw’oboronge nigo kogosimekwa ase omorembe na baria bagokora omorembe.

English: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
Kiswahili: Ni kitu gani kinachosababisha mapigano na ugomvi miongoni mwenu? Je, haya hayatokani na tamaa zenu zinazoshindana ndani yenu?
Ekegusii: Eseegi na okorwana ebire ase egati yaino, ng’ai bikorwa? Inee! Tibiri korwa agwo ase okogania kwaino okobe, ogokorwana nebiimo biaino?

English: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
Kiswahili: Mnatamani lakini hampati, kwa hiyo mwaua. Mwatamani kupata lakini hampati vile mnavyotaka, kwa hiyo mnajitia katika magomvi na mapigano. Mmepungukiwa kwa sababu hammwombi Mungu.
Ekegusii: Nigo mokogania, korende timori na gento; moita na koba ne ribero, korende timokonyora gento. Nigo mogokora esegi na korwana, korende timori na gento, ekiagera timori gosaba.

English: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
Kiswahili: Mnapoomba hampati kwa sababu mnaomba kwa nia mbaya, ili mpate kuvitumia hivyo mtakavyopata kwa tamaa zenu.
Ekegusii: Ngosaba more, ko timori koegwa, ekiagera nigo mogosaba bobe. Ayio mogosaba nigo moganetie gokorera ase okogania kwaino okobe.

English: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
Kiswahili: Ninyi wanaume na wanawake wazinzi, hamjui ya kwamba urafiki na dunia ni uadui na Mungu? Kwa hiyo mtu yeyote anayetaka kuwa rafiki wa dunia hufanyika adui wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamotari abegenwa, timomanyeti ng’a obosani bw’ense nobobisa ase Nyasae? Gaki, oyorigetie koba omosani bw’ense bwekorire koba omobisa o Nyasae.

English: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
Kiswahili: Au mwadhani kwamba Andiko lasema bure kuwa huyo Roho ambaye Mungu amemweka ndani yetu hututamani kiasi cha kuona wivu?
Ekegusii: Gose nigo mokagete ng’a namang’ana abosa, ekero amariiko agoteeba iga, “Omoika oyomenyete ime yaito nigo okogania ore ne risemi.”

English: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Kiswahili: Lakini yeye hutupatia neema zaidi. Hii ndiyo sababu Andiko husema: “Mungu huwapinga wenye kiburi, lakini huwapa wanyenyekevu neema.”
Ekegusii: Korende obuya obo, ere atoeire, nobonge kobua. Naki amariiko nigo agoteeba, “Nyasae nigo akwanga abare abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya.”

English: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Kiswahili: Basi mtiini Mungu. Mpingeni ibilisi, naye atawakimbia.
Ekegusii: Gaki, mwebeke inse ase Nyasae; korende mwange Saitani, na ere nabatame.

English: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Kiswahili: Mkaribieni Mungu, naye atawakaribia ninyi. Itakaseni mikono yenu ninyi wenye dhambi, na kuisafisha mioyo yenu ninyi wenye nia mbili.
Ekegusii: Moike Nyasae ang’e, na ere nabaike ang’e inwe. Inwe abanyene ebibe, mochene amaboko aino; inwe abanyene emioyo ebere, mochene chinkoro chiaino.

English: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
Kiswahili: Huzunikeni, ombolezeni na kulia. Kicheko chenu na kigeuzwe kuwa kuomboleza, na furaha yenu kuwa huzuni.
Ekegusii: Eichanie na kweng’ereria, na korera. Ogoseka kwaino koonchorwe kobe okweng’ereria, na omogooko oino obe omoichano.

English: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
Kiswahili: Jinyenyekezeni mbele za Bwana, naye atawainua.
Ekegusii: Mwekeyie ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ere nabaimokererie igoro.

English: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
Kiswahili: Ndugu, msineneane mabaya ninyi kwa ninyi. Mtu yeyote anayesema mabaya dhidi ya ndugu yake au kumhukumu anasema dhidi ya sheria na kuihukumu. Unapoihukumu sheria, basi huishiki sheria bali umekuwa hakimu wa kuihukumu hiyo sheria.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, timong’achana. Oyokong’acha oyomwabo, gose komogambia nigo akong’acha amachiiko na koyagambia, korende onye gokogambia amachiiko, rirorio tori omokori amachiiko, korende omogambia amachiiko.

English: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
Kiswahili: Yuko Mtoa sheria mmoja tu na yeye peke yake ndiye Hakimu, ndiye awezaye kuokoa au kuangamiza. Lakini wewe ni nani hata umhukumu jirani yako?
Ekegusii: Omorua amachiiko na omogambia noyomo bweka, nere oranyare gotooria na gosiria. Korende aye naye ng’o okogambia omogisangio oo?

English: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
Kiswahili: Basi sikilizeni ninyi msemao, “Leo au kesho tutakwenda katika mji huu ama ule tukae humo mwaka mmoja, tufanye biashara na kupata faida.”
Ekegusii: Igwa bono inwe abamogoteeba, “Reero gose ankio inatogende omochie gete, na tobeere aroro omwaka omogima na kogora, na koonia, na konyora ebitoki.”

English: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
Kiswahili: Lakini hamjui hata litakalotukia kesho. Maisha yenu ni nini? Ninyi ni ukungu ambao huonekana kwa kitambo kidogo kisha hutoweka.
Ekegusii: Inwe timomanyeti ayarache abe ankio. Obogima bwaino ninki? Naki inwe neritaturi, rikororekana ase egeka egeke, naende riasira.

English: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
Kiswahili: Badala yake, inawapasa kusema, “Kama Bwana akipenda, tutaishi na kufanya hili ama lile.”
Ekegusii: Ayamogwenerete goteeba naya, “Omonene karanche, natobe moyo, naende tokore iga gose iga”.

English: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
Kiswahili: Kama ilivyo sasa, mnajisifu na kujigamba. Kujisifu kwa namna hiyo ni uovu.
Ekegusii: Korende bono iga mogwetogia ase oboenenu bwaino. Ogwetogia gwonsi konga buna okwo nokobe.

English: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
Kiswahili: Basi mtu yeyote anayejua jema limpasalo kutenda, lakini asilitende, mtu huyo anatenda dhambi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, oyomanyete gokora amaya, ko tayakora, asare ere nebibe.

English: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
Kiswahili: Basi sikilizeni, ninyi matajiri, lieni na kuomboleza kwa ajili ya hali mbaya sana inayowajia.
Ekegusii: Igwa bono, abamore abanda, rera na goaka egeturi ase engencho y’emechando yaino eyekobacheera.

English: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
Kiswahili: Utajiri wenu umeoza na mavazi yenu yameliwa na nondo.
Ekegusii: Chinibo chiaino chiagundire, ne chianga chiaino chiarirwe nebigwankwa.

English: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.
Kiswahili: Dhahabu yenu na fedha yenu vimeliwa na kutu. Kutu yake itashuhudia dhidi yenu nayo itaila miili yenu kama vile moto. Mmejiwekea hazina kwa ajili ya siku za mwisho.
Ekegusii: Chitaabu ne chifeta chiaino chiasoirwe noboboosu, na oboboosu obwo bwabeire kirori igoro yaino, na borobwo naborie emebere yaino buna omorero okoria. Mwegacheire emonga amatuko aya ay’omoerio.

English: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
Kiswahili: Angalieni! Ule ujira wa vibarua waliolima mashamba yenu mliouzuia kwa hila unapiga kelele dhidi yenu na vilio vya wavunaji vimefika masikioni mwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.
Ekegusii: Rigereria, mwabarinire abakoreri, abagesire emegondo yaino, eng’eria yabo. Bono eng’eria eria ekorera, na okorera kw’abagesi baria gwaikire ase amato ’Omonene bw’Emeganda.

English: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
Kiswahili: Mmeishi duniani kwa anasa na kwa starehe, mmejinenepesha tayari kwa siku ya kuchinjwa.
Ekegusii: Igo momenyete ase ense eye ase okwegokia, na timwetangeti ase okogania kwaino. Mwenoririe ase chinkoro chiaino goika rituko ri’okonyenya.

English: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
Kiswahili: Mmewahukumu na kuwaua watu wenye haki, waliokuwa hawapingani nanyi.
Ekegusii: Mwagambirie omonyene oboronge na komoita, na ere tabaamerereti inwe.

English: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, vumilieni hadi kuja kwake Bwana. Angalieni jinsi mkulima angojavyo ardhi itoe mavuno yake yaliyo ya thamani na jinsi anavyovumilia kwa ajili ya kupata mvua za kwanza na za mwisho.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, baminto, remereria goika Omonene achiche. Rigereria, omoremi nigo akoganya okwama kw’omogondo okore ne rigori. Igo akoremereria ase ayio, goika anyore embura ye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.

English: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
Kiswahili: Ninyi nanyi vumilieni, tena simameni imara, kwa sababu kuja kwa Bwana kumekaribia.
Ekegusii: Naboigo, nainwe remereria, kong’ia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ogocha kw’Omonene kwabeire ang’e.

English: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, msinungʼunikiane msije mkahukumiwa. Hakimu amesimama mlangoni!
Ekegusii: Abaminto, timwemurunganerania, timocha kogambigwa. Rigereria, Omogambi nigo ateneine gesieri.

English: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, waangalieni manabii walionena kwa Jina la Bwana, ili kuwa mfano wa uvumilivu katika kukabiliana na mateso.
Ekegusii: Abaminto, bwatia ababani baria bakwanete ase erieta ri’Omonene, babe ekiorokererio gi’okobogoria obokong’u, na eki’oboremereria.

English: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
Kiswahili: Kama mnavyojua, tunawahesabu kuwa wabarikiwa wale waliovumilia. Mmesikia habari za uvumilivu wake Ayubu na mmeona kile ambacho hatimaye Bwana alimtendea. Bwana ni mwingi wa huruma, na amejaa rehema.
Ekegusii: Rigereria, abwo baremereretie twabaabarire ng’a mbasesenirie. Mwaigwete amang’ana ’Ayubu buna aremereretie, na buna Omonene amokorerete ase omoerio. Naki Omonene nomonyene amabeebe amange na amaabera.

English: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya yote, ndugu zangu, msiape, iwe kwa mbingu au kwa dunia, au kwa kitu kingine chochote. “Ndiyo” yenu na iwe ndiyo, na “Hapana” yenu iwe hapana, la sivyo mtahukumiwa.
Ekegusii: Korende abaminto, kobua ase onsi timotiana, ase igoro, gose ase ense, gose koria muma ende yonsi, korende “ee” yaino ebe “ee”, na “yaya” yaino ebe “yaya”, timocha kobekwa inse y’okogambigwa.

English: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
Kiswahili: Je, mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu amepatwa na taabu? Basi inampasa aombe. Je, kuna yeyote mwenye furaha? Basi na aimbe nyimbo za kusifu.
Ekegusii: Omonto onde oino karanyorekane nemechando, tiga asabe. Onde omo oino, onye ore nomoyo bw’ogosasoka, tiga atogie ase ogoteera.

English: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;
Kiswahili: Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu aliye mgonjwa? Basi inampasa awaite wazee wa kanisa wamwombee na kumpaka mafuta kwa Jina la Bwana.
Ekegusii: Onye omonto onde oino obeire omorwaire, tiga arangerie abagaaka b’ekanisa bamosabere na bamoake amaguta ase erieta ri’Omonene.

English: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
Kiswahili: Kule kuomba kwa imani kutamwokoa huyo mgonjwa, naye Bwana atamwinua na kama ametenda dhambi, atasamehewa.
Ekegusii: Na ogosaba koria gw’okwegena nagotoorie omorwaire oria, n’Omonene namogwenie. Onye omonto oria okorire ebibe naaberwe.

English: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo ungamianeni dhambi zenu ninyi kwa ninyi na kuombeana ili mpate kuponywa. Maombi ya mwenye haki yana nguvu tena yanafaa sana.
Ekegusii: Orokerania ebibe biaino inwe ase inwe, na gosaberana, monyore okogwenigwa. Ogosaba kw’omonyene oboronge nigo kore nengencho enene mono gokorasabwe nomokia.

English: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
Kiswahili: Eliya alikuwa mwanadamu kama sisi. Akaomba kwa bidii kwamba mvua isinyeshe, nayo haikunyesha juu ya nchi kwa muda wa miaka mitatu na miezi sita.
Ekegusii: Elija nigo arenge omonto bwe chingencho echimo naintwe, agasaba nomokia ng’a embura tetwa. Na embura tiyatwa igoro ase ense ase engaki y’emiaka etato na emetienyi etano nomo.

English: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
Kiswahili: Kisha akaomba tena, nazo mbingu zikatoa mvua nayo ardhi ikatoa mazao yake.
Ekegusii: Agasaba naende, igoro ekarenta embura, na ense ekama okwama kwaye.

English: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, yeyote miongoni mwenu akipotoka na kuicha kweli, naye akarejezwa na mtu mwingine,
Ekegusii: Abaminto, onye omonto onde oino oteanire korwa ase ekeene, na monto onde amoiranie,

English: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
Kiswahili: hamna budi kujua kwamba yeyote amrejezaye mwenye dhambi kutoka upotovu wake, ataiokoa roho ya huyo mwenye dhambi kutoka mauti na kusitiri wingi wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: tiga ere amanye ng’a oyokoirania omonyene ebibe korwa ase enchera y’ogosira, ere natoorie omoyo oye korwa ase amakweri na atube obonge bw’ebibe.

English: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
Kiswahili: Petro, mtume wa Yesu Kristo: Kwa wateule wa Mungu, wageni katika ulimwengu, waliotawanyika kote katika Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia na Bithinia.
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Petero, omotomwa o Yeso Kristo, gochia ase abachore ba Nyasae, abamwatananekire gochia komenya buna abamenyi ase Ponto, na Galatia, na Kapadokia, na Asia, na Bitinia.

English: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
Kiswahili: Ni ninyi ambao mlichaguliwa tangu mwanzo na Mungu Baba kulingana na alivyotangulia kuwajua, kupitia kwa kazi ya utakaso wa Roho, katika utiifu kwa Yesu Kristo na kunyunyiziwa damu yake: Neema na amani ziwe kwenu kwa wingi.
Ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwachoretwe koreng’ana buna Nyasae Tata amanyete korwa kare, na mogachenwa n’Omoika, monyare koigwera Yeso Kristo, na konyororokerigwa namanyinga aye. Obuya na omorembe bimenteke ase oboikeranu bwonsi.

English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
Kiswahili: Ahimidiwe Mungu, Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo! Kwa rehema zake kuu ametuzaa sisi mara ya pili katika tumaini lenye uzima kupitia kwa kufufuka kwa Yesu Kristo kutoka kwa wafu,
Ekegusii: Abakwe Nyasae, ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo! Ase amaabera aye amange atoiboire eria kabere, erinde tonyore ogosemeria kore moyo goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo korwa ase abakuure,

English: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
Kiswahili: ili tuupate urithi usioharibika, usio na uchafu, ule usionyauka: uliotunzwa mbinguni kwa ajili yenu,
Ekegusii: ase igo intwe ntonyore omwando oyio Nyasae agacherete abanto baye aaria igoro. Omwando oyio otagosareka, otari na komocha, otari gosiria obonene bwaye,

English: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
Kiswahili: ninyi ambao mnalindwa na nguvu za Mungu kwa njia ya imani, hadi uje ule wokovu ulio tayari kufunuliwa nyakati za mwisho.
Ekegusii: inwe abamorendire nokobua kwa Nyasae ase enchera y’okwegena, monyore ogotooreka kore ang’e koorokigwa ase ekero ki’omoerio.

English: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
Kiswahili: Katika hili mnafurahi sana, ingawa sasa kwa kitambo kidogo mmehuzunishwa kwa majaribu ya namna nyingi.
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio monyare kogoka mono, nonya mbono ase ekero egeke inamochandeke ase amateemwa a kera engencho, onye egwenerete.

English: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
Kiswahili: Haya yamewajia ili kwamba imani yenu, iliyo ya thamani kuliko dhahabu ipoteayo, ingawa hujaribiwa kwa moto, ionekane kuwa halisi na imalizie katika sifa, utukufu na heshima wakati Yesu Kristo atadhihirishwa.
Ekegusii: Igo okwegena kwaino, gakoratenene ase ogoteemwa, kore kwe rigori rinene kobua etaabu egosira (nonya egoteemwa ase omorero) naende konyorekane kogwenerete ogotogigwa, na obonene, na ogosikwa ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.

English: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
Kiswahili: Ingawa hamjamwona, mnampenda; tena ingawa sasa hammwoni, mnamwamini na kujawa na furaha isiyoneneka yenye utukufu usioelezeka.
Ekegusii: Ere oyo mwamwanchire, nonya timomoorochi, mwamwegenire, nonya timoramorora, na igo moragoke ase omogooko otari gotebeka oichire nobonene,

English: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
Kiswahili: Maana mnaupokea wokovu wa roho zenu, ambao ndio lengo la imani yenu.
Ekegusii: ekero moranyore oboikeranu bw’okwegena kwaino, engencho yaye ogotooreka kw’emioyo yaino.

English: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
Kiswahili: Kwa habari ya wokovu huu, wale manabii waliosema kuhusu neema ambayo ingewajia ninyi, walitafuta kwa bidii na kwa uangalifu mkubwa,
Ekegusii: Igoro ase amang’ana ogotooreka okwo ababani, baria baabaanete obuya obo borache kobacheera, bakariga‐rigia na kounenkia.

English: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.
Kiswahili: wakijaribu kujua ni wakati upi na katika mazingira gani ambayo Roho wa Kristo aliyekuwa ndani yao alionyesha, alipotabiri kuhusu mateso ya Kristo na utukufu ule ambao ungefuata.
Ekegusii: Bakarigia nkero ki, naende nkero kenga buna kere ki, Omoika o Kristo, oyorenge ime yabo, oorogetie, ekero otang’anete koba kirori igoro y’ogochandwa gwa Kristo, na obonene obwo borache koba magega y’ayio.

English: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
Kiswahili: Walidhihirishiwa kwamba walikuwa hawajihudumii wao wenyewe, bali waliwahudumia ninyi, waliponena kuhusu mambo hayo, ambayo sasa yamehubiriwa kwenu na wale waliowahubiria ninyi Injili kwa Roho Mtakatifu aliyetumwa kutoka mbinguni. Hata malaika wanatamani kuyafahamu mambo haya.
Ekegusii: Nyasae nigo abamaanorerete ng’a baabakorere inwe ase amang’ana ayio, gose tari barabwo abanyene. Ayio bono araaretigwe ase more nabaria baabaranderetie inwe enchiri ase Omoika Omochenu, oyotometwe korwa igoro. Amang’ana ayio abamalaika bare namaiga kona‐koyasiomeria.

English: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, tayarisheni nia zenu kwa kazi; mwe na kiasi, mkitumainia kikamilifu ile neema mtakayopewa Yesu Kristo atakapodhihirishwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, eboyie bokong’u ebinema bi’ebirengererio biaino, mobe aberiti, mobe nogosemeria ogoikeranu ase obuya boria moraarenterwe ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.

English: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
Kiswahili: Kama watoto watiifu, msifuate tamaa zenu mbaya wakati mlipoishi kwa ujinga.
Ekegusii: Buna abana ba Nyasae abaigweri timwereng’ania nokogania kwaino okobe kw’eritang’ani, ekero mware motamanyete gento,

English: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
Kiswahili: Bali kama yeye aliyewaita alivyo mtakatifu, nanyi kuweni watakatifu katika mwenendo wenu wote.
Ekegusii: korende buna ere, oyobarangeirie, are omochenu, naboigo nainwe mobe abachenu ase orogendo rwaino rwonsi,

English: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa: “Kuweni watakatifu, kwa kuwa mimi ni mtakatifu.”
Ekegusii: amariiko nigo agoteeba, mobe abachenu ekiagera inche nomochenu.

English: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu mnamwita Baba ahukumuye kila mtu kulingana na matendo yake pasipo upendeleo, enendeni kwa hofu ya kumcha Mungu wakati wenu wa kukaa hapa duniani kama wageni.
Ekegusii: Onye mokomooroka Tata, ere oyoragambie kera omonto koreng’ana nogokora kwaye atari nogwanchereria, mogenderere nokoiroka ase ekero kiaino gi’okomenya aiga buna abaeti.

English: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mnafahamu kwamba mlikombolewa kutoka mwenendo wenu usiofaa ambao mliurithi kutoka kwa baba zenu, si kwa vitu viharibikavyo kama fedha na dhahabu,
Ekegusii: Momanye ng’a nigo mwaboorigwe korwa ase orogendo rwaino rotagwenereti, orwo mwanyorete korwa ase chisokoro chiaino, tari ase ebinto bigosareka, buna chifeta gose chitaabu,

English: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
Kiswahili: bali kwa damu ya thamani ya Kristo, yule Mwana-Kondoo asiye na dosari wala doa.
Ekegusii: korende ase amanyinga e rigori rinene, buna ay’emanwa y’eng’ondi etari na komocha, gose na kemoa, engencho yaye amanyinga a Kristo.

English: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
Kiswahili: Yeye alichaguliwa kabla ya kuwekwa kwa misingi ya ulimwengu, lakini akadhihirishwa katika siku hizi za mwisho kwa ajili yenu.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo achoretwe na Nyasae korwa kare, ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, korende oorokigwe ase amatuko aya ay’omoerio ase engencho yaino.

English: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
Kiswahili: Kupitia kwake mmemwamini Mungu, aliyemfufua kutoka kwa wafu na akampa utukufu, ili imani yenu na tumaini lenu ziwe kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Goetera asare ere mwamwegenire Nyasae, oyomobogetie korwa ase abakuure na akamoa obonene, erinde okwegena kwaino na ogosemeria kwaino kobe ase Nyasae.

English: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
Kiswahili: Basi kwa kuwa mmejitakasa nafsi zenu kwa kuitii ile kweli hata mkawa na upendo wa ndugu usio na unafiki, basi pendaneni kwa dhati kutoka moyoni.
Ekegusii: Komwaikire gwechena emioyo yaino ase okoigwera ekeene, goikera obwanchani bw’abamino botari nobong’ainereria, gaki bono mogenderere nobwanchani inwe ase inwe bokorwa ase enkoro y’ekeene,

English: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mmezaliwa upya, si kwa mbegu ile iharibikayo, bali kwa ile isiyoharibika, kupitia kwa neno la Mungu lililo hai na linalodumu milele.
Ekegusii: ekiagera mwaiboirwe eria kabere, tari ase embusuro egosareka, korende ase eyetari gosareka, goetera ase ring’ana ria Nyasae rinyene obogima, erikobao goika kare na kare.

English: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;
Kiswahili: Maana, “Wanadamu wote ni kama majani, nao utukufu wao ni kama maua ya kondeni; majani hunyauka na maua huanguka,
Ekegusii: Naki igo eriikire, “Mwanyabaanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, na obonene bwabo nigo bonga buna ebisicha bire mogondo. Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo,

English: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
Kiswahili: lakini neno la Bwana ladumu milele.” Hili ndilo neno lililohubiriwa kwenu.
Ekegusii: korende ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.” Ne ring’ana eri nario enchiri eye mwaranderetigwe.

English: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, wekeni mbali nanyi uovu wote na udanganyifu wote, unafiki, wivu na masingizio ya kila namna.
Ekegusii: Gaki, beka are obobe bwonsi, na obong’ainereria bwonsi, na oborianania, na emoko, na oboitania bwonsi.

English: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,
Kiswahili: Kama watoto wachanga, waliozaliwa sasa, yatamanini maziwa ya kiroho yasiyochanganywa na kitu kingine chochote, ili kwa hayo mpate kukua katika wokovu,
Ekegusii: Buna abana ebing’werere baiborwa reero iga, moganie amabeere ’ekeene ay’omoika, erinde monyare gokina ase aro, na goikera ogotooreka,

English: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
Kiswahili: ikiwa kweli mmeonja ya kwamba Bwana ni mwema.
Ekegusii: Buna amariiko agokwana mwateemire Omonene ng’a nomuya.

English: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
Kiswahili: Mnapokuja kwake, yeye aliye Jiwe lililo hai, lililokataliwa na wanadamu bali kwa Mungu ni teule na la thamani kwake,
Ekegusii: Mochiere ere, oyore rigena rire moyo, riangetwe na Mwanyabaanto, korende ase obosio bwa Nyasae nerichore, rire rie rigori rinene.

English: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: ninyi nanyi, kama mawe yaliyo hai, mnajengwa kuwa nyumba ya kiroho, ili mpate kuwa ukuhani mtakatifu, mkitoa dhabihu za kiroho zinazokubaliwa na Mungu kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Inwe abamore buna amagena are moyo moagachwe, mobe enyomba y’Omoika mobe abakuani abachenu, morue ebing’wanso bi’omoika ebirancherwe ase Nyasae goetera ase Yeso Kristo.

English: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa katika Maandiko: “Tazama, naweka katika Sayuni, jiwe la pembeni teule lenye thamani, na yeyote atakayemwamini hataaibika kamwe.”
Ekegusii: Ekiagera eriikire ase amariiko, “Rigereria, nabekire ase Sayoni rigena richore, rigena rinene ri’ekoona, naende nigo rire rie rigori rinene, na onde bwensi oyoramwegene takorora obosooku.”

English: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
Kiswahili: Kwenu ninyi mnaoamini, jiwe hili ni la thamani. Lakini kwao wasioamini, “Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni,”
Ekegusii: Naki ogosika oko nokwaino, inwe abamwegenire. Korende ase abwo bategeneti nigo eriikire, “Rigena erio abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona,”

English: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
Kiswahili: tena, “Jiwe lenye kuwafanya watu wajikwae, na mwamba wa kuwaangusha.” Wanajikwaa kwa sababu hawakulitii lile neno, kama walivyowekewa tangu zamani.
Ekegusii: Amariko and nigo agokwana, “Eri nario rigena eriragere bagwe, egetare kerabaiyerie bonsi.” Nigo bakwegocha ase ring’ana, ekiagera tibari koriigwera. Naki naro ayio barageretwe.

English: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi ni taifa teule, ukuhani wa kifalme, taifa takatifu, watu walio milki ya Mungu, mlioitwa ili kutangaza sifa zake yeye aliyewaita kutoka gizani mkaingie katika nuru yake ya ajabu.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe nababiare abachore, abakuani b’omorwoti, egesaku egechenu, abanto ba Nyasae omonyene, monyare koraria ogokora kwaye kw’obonene, oyobarangeretie korwa ase omosunte, gochia ase omobaso oye bw’ogokumia.

English: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
Kiswahili: Mwanzo ninyi mlikuwa si taifa, lakini sasa ninyi ni taifa la Mungu. Mwanzo mlikuwa hamjapata rehema, lakini sasa mmepata rehema.
Ekegusii: Inwe agwo kare timwarenge abanto ba Nyasae, korende bono mwabeire abanto baye; ritang’ani timwanyorete amaabera, korende bono mwanyorire amaabera.

English: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
Kiswahili: Wapenzi, ninawasihi, mkiwa kama wageni na wapitaji hapa ulimwenguni, epukeni tamaa mbaya za mwili ambazo hupigana vita na roho zenu.
Ekegusii: Abanchani, nabasoroire inwe, ekiagera more abaeti ase ense engeni eatanane korwa ase okogania okobe kw’omobere okwo gokorwana nomoyo.

English: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.
Kiswahili: Kuweni na mwenendo mzuri mbele ya watu wasiomjua Mungu, ili kama wanawasingizia kuwa watenda mabaya, wayaone matendo yenu mema nao wamtukuze Mungu siku atakapokuja kwetu.
Ekegusii: Mobe norogendo oruya ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde nonya bakobang’acha ng’a nabakori amabe more, banyare korora ogokora kwaino okuya na gotogia Nyasae rituko riria agocha kobacheera.

English: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili ya Bwana, tiini kila mamlaka iliyowekwa na wanadamu: Kwa mfalme kwani ndiye aliye na mamlaka ya juu zaidi,
Ekegusii: Ase engencho y’Omonene mwebeke inse ya kera ekegochikwa na Mwanyabaanto, onye nomorwoti oyore omonene,

English: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
Kiswahili: au kwa maafisa aliowaweka, kwa kuwa mfalme amewatuma ili kuwaadhibu wale wanaokosa, na kuwapongeza wale watendao mema.
Ekegusii: gose abagabana, abatomirwe nere, erinde bae abakori amabe egesusuro, na gotogia abakori amaya,

English: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni mapenzi ya Mungu kwamba kwa kutenda mema mnyamazishe maneno ya kijinga ya watu wapumbavu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ng’a ase ogokora kwaino okuya mokirie abanto abariri ase ogotamanya kwabo.

English: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
Kiswahili: Ishini kama watu huru, lakini msitumie uhuru wenu kama kisingizio cha kutenda uovu, bali ishini kama watumishi wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mobe abanto abasibore, korende timokorera obosibore bwaino ase okobiserera obobe, korende mobe norogendo rogwenerete abasomba ba Nyasae.

English: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
Kiswahili: Mheshimuni kila mtu ipasavyo: Wapendeni jamaa ya ndugu waumini, mcheni Mungu, mpeni heshima mfalme.
Ekegusii: Mosike abanto bonsi. Mwanche abamino. Moiroke Nyasae. Mosike omorwoti.

English: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
Kiswahili: Ninyi watumwa, watiini mabwana zenu kwa heshima yote, si wale mabwana walio wema na wapole peke yao, bali pia wale walio wakali.
Ekegusii: Inwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase okoiroka gwonsi, tari abwo boka abare abaya gose abororo, korende na abwo bare abatindi boigo.

English: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni jambo la sifa kama mtu akivumilia anapoteswa kwa uonevu kwa ajili ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki aya namaya mono omonto karaaremererie ogoichana ase okoinyora Nyasae, na kobogoria ogochandwa gotari kwa boronge.

English: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
Kiswahili: Kwani ni faida gani kwa mtu kustahimili anapopigwa kwa sababu ya makosa yake? Lakini kama mkiteswa kwa sababu ya kutenda mema, nanyi mkastahimili, hili ni jambo la kusifiwa mbele za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Naki ngotogigwa ki more nakwo komoraaremererie ase ogoakwa chinkundi ekero mogokora ebibe? Korende komoraaremererie ogochandwa ekero mogokora amaya, oko nakwo ogwancherwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
Kiswahili: Ninyi mliitwa kwa ajili ya haya, kwa sababu Kristo naye aliteswa kwa ajili yenu, akiwaachia kielelezo, ili mzifuate nyayo zake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio naro mwarangereretigwe, ekiagera Kristo nere nigo achandetwe ase engencho yaino, obatigeire ekiorokererio, erinde mobwatie chimbaratero chiaye.

English: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
Kiswahili: “Yeye hakutenda dhambi, wala hila haikuonekana kinywani mwake.”
Ekegusii: Ere takorete ebibe, gose obong’ainereria tibwaruete ase omonwa oye.

English: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
Kiswahili: Yeye alipotukanwa, hakurudisha matukano; alipoteswa, hakutishia, bali alijikabidhi kwa yeye ahukumuye kwa haki.
Ekegusii: Ere ekero arenge koramwa tairaneretie okoramwa okwo, ekero arenge gochandwa tatogonyete, korende akebeka asare ere oyokogamba ase oboronge.

English: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
Kiswahili: Yeye mwenyewe alizichukua dhambi zetu katika mwili wake juu ya mti, ili tufe kwa mambo ya dhambi, bali tupate kuishi katika haki. Kwa kupigwa kwake, ninyi mmeponywa.
Ekegusii: Ere omonyene akabogoria ebibe biaito ase omobere oye igoro ase omote, erinde intwe tokwe korwa ase amang’ana ’ebibe, tobe moyo ase amang’ana ’oboronge. Ase amaote aye inwe mwagwenigwe.

English: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana mlikuwa mmepotea kama kondoo, lakini sasa mmerudi kwa Mchungaji na Mwangalizi wa roho zenu.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo mware buna ching’ondi chiasirire, korende bono mwairanire ase Omorisia na Omorendi bw’emioyo yaino.

English: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,
Kiswahili: Kadhalika enyi wake, watiini waume zenu, ili kama kunao wasioamini lile neno, wapate kuvutwa na mwenendo wa wake zao pasipo neno,
Ekegusii: Naboigo, inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino, erinde onye abande bare aroro, abategeneti ring’ana, bang’uswe ase orogendo rw’abakungu babo, batatebiri ring’ana,

English: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
Kiswahili: kwa kuuona utakatifu na uchaji wa Mungu katika maisha yenu.
Ekegusii: kobakorora orogendo rwaino oruya rore nokoiroka.

English: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
Kiswahili: Kujipamba kwenu kusiwe kwa nje tu, kama vile kusuka nywele, kuvalia vitu vilivyofanyizwa kwa dhahabu na kwa mavazi.
Ekegusii: Ogwechabera kwaino tikoba ogwa isiko ase okomina chitukia, na kobeeka ebigera bie chitaabu, gose chianga chinterere,

English: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
Kiswahili: Badala yake, kujipamba kwenu kuwe katika utu wenu wa moyoni, yaani uzuri usioharibika wa roho ya upole na utulivu, ambayo ni ya thamani sana machoni pa Mungu.
Ekegusii: korende kobe ogw’enkoro y’omonto o ime otari kororekana, ogwechabera okwo gotari gosareka, ase omoika bw’obwororo na obokanyeku. Oko nakwo kore kwe rigori rinene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

English: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo walivyokuwa wakijipamba wanawake watakatifu wa zamani, waliomtumaini Mungu. Wao walikuwa ni watiifu kwa waume zao,
Ekegusii: Naki oko nakwo kware ogwechabera kw’abakungu abachenu ba kare, abamosemeretie Nyasae, abwo baigwerete abasacha babo,

English: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.
Kiswahili: kama Sara alivyomtii mumewe Abrahamu, hata akamwita bwana. Ninyi ni watoto wa Sara kama mkitenda yaliyo mema, bila kuogopa jambo lolote.
Ekegusii: buna Sara aigwerete Aburaamu, akamoroka omonene. Na inwe bono mwabeire abana baye komorakore amaya, gose timokwoboigwa ase kogoswa konde gwonsi.

English: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo ninyi waume, kaeni na wake zenu kwa akili, nanyi wapeni heshima mkitambua ya kuwa wao ni wenzi walio dhaifu, na kama warithi pamoja nanyi wa kipawa cha neema cha uzima, ili kusiwepo na chochote cha kuzuia maombi yenu.
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe abasacha, momenye nabakungu baino ase chisemi. Moe omokungu ogosika buna oyo otari ne chinguru, ekiagera nigo more abanyamwando amo ase okonyora obuya obokorenta obogima. Erio ogosaba kwaino tigotangwa.

English: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
Kiswahili: Hatimaye, ninyi nyote kuweni na nia moja, wenye kuhurumiana, mkipendana kama ndugu, na mwe wasikitivu na wanyenyekevu.
Ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’omoerio neri: Mobe nomoyo oyomo, mobogoreranie, mwanchane buna abamino, mororerane amabeebe, mobe nomoyo bw’obokanyeku.

English: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
Kiswahili: Msilipe ovu kwa ovu, au jeuri kwa jeuri, bali barikini, kwa maana hili ndilo mliloitiwa ili mpate kurithi baraka.
Ekegusii: Timoakanana amabe ase amabe, gose okorama ase okorama, korende ribaga ri’ayio mobe abamogosesenania, ekiagera ayio naro mwarangererigwe, ng’a monyore omwando bw’ogosesenigwa.

English: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, “Yeyote apendaye uzima na kuona siku njema, basi auzuie ulimi wake usinene mabaya, na midomo yake isiseme hila.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo eriikire “Oyorigetie gwancha obogima na korora amatuko amaya, tiga atange oromeme rwaye tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biaye tibikwana obong’ainereria.

English: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
Kiswahili: Mtu huyo lazima aache uovu, akatende mema; lazima aitafute amani na kuifuatilia sana.
Ekegusii: Tiga atige amabe, akore amaya, arigie omorembe na koyotunyana mono.

English: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
Kiswahili: Kwa maana macho ya Bwana huwaelekea wenye haki, na masikio yake yako makini kusikiliza maombi yao. Bali uso wa Bwana uko kinyume na watendao maovu.”
Ekegusii: Naki amaiso Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ogosaba kwabo. Korende obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore igoro ase abwo bagokora amabe.”

English: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
Kiswahili: Basi, ni nani atakayewadhuru mkiwa wenye juhudi katika kutenda mema?
Ekegusii: Ning’o orabakorere amabe, komorabe nomokia ase ayare amaya?

English: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
Kiswahili: Lakini mmebarikiwa hata kama ikiwalazimu kuteseka kwa ajili ya haki. “Msiogope vitisho vyao, wala msiwe na wasiwasi.”
Ekegusii: Korende onye mogochandwa ase engencho y’oboronge, more negesio. Timoiroka okoirokia kwabo, gose timoichana.

English: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
Kiswahili: Bali mtakaseni Kristo kuwa Bwana mioyoni mwenu. Siku zote mwe tayari kumjibu mtu yeyote atakayewauliza kuhusu sababu ya tumaini lililomo ndani yenu. Lakini fanyeni hivyo kwa upole na kwa heshima,
Ekegusii: Tiga Omonene Kristo acheneke ase chinkoro chiaino ime. Botambe mobe ang’e koiraneria kera omonto oyokobaboria amang’ana ogosemeria okore ime yaino, korende kora ayio ase obwororo na ase okoiroka.

English: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
Kiswahili: mkizitunza dhamiri zenu ziwe safi, ili wale wasemao mabaya dhidi ya mwenendo wenu mzuri katika Kristo waaibike kwa ajili ya masingizio yao.
Ekegusii: Na inwe renda chinkoro chiaino tichibagambia, erinde ekero mogokwanwa bobe, abwo bakobarama ase orogendo rwaino oruya ase Kristo, basookigwe.

English: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana ni afadhali kupata mateso kwa ajili ya kutenda mema, kama kuteseka huko ndiyo mapenzi ya Mungu, kuliko kuteseka kwa kutenda maovu.
Ekegusii: Naki mbuya gochandwa ase ogokora amaya kobua gochandwa ase ogokora amabe, onye gokoba ogwancha kwa Nyasae.

English: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa Kristo naye aliteswa mara moja tu kwa ajili ya dhambi, mwenye haki kwa ajili ya wasio haki, ili awalete ninyi kwa Mungu. Mwili wake ukauawa, lakini akafanywa hai katika Roho.
Ekegusii: Ekiagera Kristo nere agakwa ara rimo ase engencho y’ebibe. Ere oyorenge omonyene oboronge agachandwa ase engencho y’abatari abaronge, erinde atorente ase Nyasae. Omobere oye ogaitwa, korende omoika oye ogakorwa koba moyo.

English: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
Kiswahili: Baada ya kufanywa hai, alikwenda na kuzihubiria roho zilizokuwa kifungoni:
Ekegusii: Ase omoika oyo agachiera emeika eria yarenge ase obosibwa, akayeranderia.

English: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
Kiswahili: roho hizo ambazo zamani hazikutii, wakati ule uvumilivu wa Mungu ulipokuwa ukingoja katika siku za Noa, wakati wa kujenga safina, ambamo watu wachache tu, yaani watu wanane, waliokolewa ili wasiangamie kwa gharika.
Ekegusii: Emeika eyio ney’abwo bataigwerete agwo kare, ekero Nyasae aganyete ase oboremereria ase amatuko aria Nuhu are koroisia obwato. Ime ase abwo abanto abake, engencho yaye abanto batano na batato, batooregete goetera ase amache.

English: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
Kiswahili: Nayo maji hayo ni kielelezo cha ubatizo ambao sasa unawaokoa ninyi pia: si kwa kuondoa uchafu kwenye mwili, bali kama ahadi ya dhamiri safi kwa Mungu, kwa njia ya ufufuo wa Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’amang’ana aya nebatiso, eyekobatooria inwe bono, tari ase okobeeka aare riko ri’omobere, korende ase okoiraneria Nyasae enkoro etari kobagambia, goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo,

English: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
Kiswahili: Yeye ameingia mbinguni na amekaa mkono wa kuume wa Mungu; nao malaika, mamlaka na nguvu zote wametiishwa chini yake.
Ekegusii: oyosoete igoro, na bono nao are ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae. Abamalaika, na okobua, ne chinguru nigo bibekire inse yaye.

English: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa Kristo aliteswa katika mwili wake, ninyi nanyi jivikeni nia iyo hiyo kwa maana mtu aliyekwisha kuteswa katika mwili ameachana na dhambi.
Ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera Kristo achandetwe ase omobere, nainwe boigo eboyie ebirwanero bi’ebirengererio ebio ebio, ekiagera ere oyochandetwe ase omobere bweatananire korwa ase ebibe.

English: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo, haishi maisha yake yaliyobaki ya kuishi hapa duniani kwa tamaa mbaya za wanadamu, bali anaishi kwa mapenzi ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korwa bono ase amatuko aya atigarete more moyo, timogenderera koreng’ana nokogania okobe kwa Mwanyabaanto, korende koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae.

English: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
Kiswahili: Maana wakati uliopita mmekwisha kutumia muda wa kutosha katika maisha yenu mkifanya yale ambayo wapagani hupenda kutenda: wakiishi katika uasherati, tamaa mbaya, ulevi, karamu za ulafi, vileo, ngoma mbaya, na ibada chukizo za sanamu.
Ekegusii: Naki engaki yaino eye yaetire yaisanire ase ogokora aya abanto b’Ebisaku banchete gokora. Igo mwagendererete ase obonyaka, na okogania okobe, na okonywa, na emeyega y’okoria bobe na gotinda, na mware gosasiima emegwekano, ogosasiima gotarenge okoronge.

English: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.
Kiswahili: Wao hushangaa kwamba ninyi hamjiingizi pamoja nao katika huo wingi wa maisha ya ufisadi, nao huwatukana ninyi.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, barabwo nigo bakorora ng’a nay’ogokumia, ekiagera inwe motari koayerera amo nabarabwo gochia ase obonyaka botari nekerengo, na nigo bakobarama.

English: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
Kiswahili: Lakini itawapasa wao kutoa hesabu mbele zake yeye aliye tayari kuwahukumu walio hai na waliokufa.
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo nigo barache korua omobaro asare ere oyore ang’e kogambia abare moyo na abakuure.

English: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hii ndiyo sababu Injili ilihubiriwa hata kwa wale waliokufa, ili wahukumiwe sawasawa na wanadamu wengine katika mwili, lakini katika roho waishi kulingana na Mungu aishivyo.
Ekegusii: Nakio kiagerete abakuure bakaranderigwa enchiri, erinde bagambigwe ase omobere koreng’ana buna Mwanyabaanto bakogambigwa, na babe moyo ase omoika, koreng’ana buna Nyasae are moyo.

English: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
Kiswahili: Mwisho wa mambo yote umekaribia. Kwa hiyo kuweni na akili tulivu na kiasi, mkikesha katika kuomba.
Ekegusii: Bono omoerio bw’amang’ana onsi oikire ang’e. Ase ayio, mobe nobong’aini na kwerita ase ogosaba.

English: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya yote, dumuni katika upendo kwa maana upendo husitiri wingi wa dhambi.
Ekegusii: Kobua ase onsi mobe nomokia ase ogwanchana, ekiagera obwanchani nigo bogotuba obonge bw’ebibe.

English: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
Kiswahili: Kuweni wakarimu kila mtu na mwenzake pasipo manungʼuniko.
Ekegusii: Mobe abamokoroisania inwe ase inwe motari kwemurungania.

English: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja na atumie kipawa chochote alichopewa kuwahudumia wengine, kama mawakili waaminifu wa neema mbalimbali za Mungu.
Ekegusii: Mokorerane inwe ase inwe, kera oyomo nekeegwa eke anyorete, buna abarendi abaya b’obuya bwa Nyasae, obore ne chingencho chinyinge.

English: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Yeyote asemaye hana budi kusema kama mtu asemaye maneno ya Mungu mwenyewe. Yeyote ahudumuye hana budi kuhudumu kwa nguvu zile anazopewa na Mungu, ili Mungu apate kutukuzwa katika mambo yote kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo. Utukufu na uweza una yeye milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: Omonto karakwane, tiga akwane amang’ana a Nyasae. Omonto karabe omokoreri, tiga akorere ne chinguru echio Nyasae amoeire, erinde Nyasae atogigwe ase amang’ana onsi goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene na okobua kare na kare. Amina.

English: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
Kiswahili: Wapenzi, msione ajabu kwa yale mateso yanayotukia miongoni mwenu, kana kwamba ni kitu kigeni kinachowapata.
Ekegusii: Abanchani, timokumia ase obokong’u obore buna omorero, obwo bwabaikeire ase okobateema, buna namang’ana amageni abanyorire.

English: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
Kiswahili: Bali furahini kuwa mnashiriki katika mateso ya Kristo, ili mpate kufurahi zaidi wakati utukufu wake utakapofunuliwa.
Ekegusii: Korende ekiagera mwabwatanire nemechando ya Kristo, goka, erinde ase okomaanorwa kw’obonene bwaye monyare kogoka boigo, na gochenga.

English: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
Kiswahili: Kama mkitukanwa kwa ajili ya jina la Kristo, mmebarikiwa, kwa sababu Roho wa utukufu na wa Mungu anakaa juu yenu.
Ekegusii: Komorachaywe ase engencho y’erieta ria Kristo, imosesenirie ekiagera Omoika bw’obonene noyo o Nyasae nigo oikaransete igoro yaino.

English: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
Kiswahili: Lakini asiwepo mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu anayeteswa kwa kuwa ni muuaji, au mwizi, au mhalifu wa aina yoyote, au anayejishughulisha na mambo ya watu wengine.
Ekegusii: Korende onde omo oino taba omoiti, gose omoibi, gose omokori amabe, gose oyokwerosia ase amang’ana ’abaanto bande, erinde abaise gochandwa.

English: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
Kiswahili: Lakini kama ukiteseka kwa kuwa Mkristo, usihesabu jambo hilo kuwa ni aibu, bali mtukuze Mungu kwa sababu umeitwa kwa jina hilo.
Ekegusii: Korende onye omonto ogochandwa ekiagera are Omokristo tarora obosooku, korende atogie Nyasae ase erieta eri.

English: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wakati umewadia wa hukumu kuanzia katika nyumba ya Mungu. Basi kama ikianzia kwetu sisi, mwisho wa hao wasiotii Injili ya Mungu utakuwaje?
Ekegusii: Naki engaki yaikire ekiina gechakere ase enyomba ya Nyasae na gakerachake ase tore, omoerio obo abwo bataigwereti enchiri ya Nyasae, naki orabe?

English: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
Kiswahili: Basi, “Ikiwa ni vigumu kwa mwenye haki kuokoka, itakuwaje kwa mtu asiyemcha Mungu na mwenye dhambi?”
Ekegusii: Na, buna eriikire, “Onye ekoba aakong’u omonyene oboronge gotooreka, oria otamoirogeti Nyasae na omonyene ebibe, naki rende kerabe asare?”

English: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, wale wanaoteswa kulingana na mapenzi ya Mungu, wajikabidhi kwa Muumba wao aliye mwaminifu, huku wakizidi kutenda mema.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abwo bagochandwa koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae, tiga bakore amaya na babeeke emioyo yabo asare ere oyore Omotongi omwegenwa.

English: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
Kiswahili: Kwa wazee waliomo miongoni mwenu, nawasihi mimi nikiwa mzee mwenzenu, shahidi wa mateso ya Kristo, na mshiriki katika utukufu utakaofunuliwa:
Ekegusii: Nasoroire abagaaka abare ase egati yaino, inche buna omogaka omogisangio obo, na kirori bw’ogochandwa gwa Kristo, na omobwatani bw’obonene boria borache koorokigwa:

English: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
Kiswahili: lichungeni kundi la Mungu mlilokabidhiwa, mkitumika kama waangalizi, si kwa kulazimishwa bali kwa hiari, kama Mungu anavyowataka mwe; si kwa tamaa ya fedha, bali mlio na bidii katika kutumika.
Ekegusii: Risia riicho ria Nyasae eriabekirwe ase more, tari ase okobetererigwa korende ase ogwancha buna Nyasae anchete, tari ase okonyora kw’oborianania, korende ase omoyo bw’okwerwa.
