English: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
Kiswahili: Msijifanye mabwana juu ya wale walio chini ya uangalizi wenu, bali kuweni vielelezo kwa hilo kundi.
Ekegusii: Timoba abagwekora abanene igoro ase abwo mwaeirwe, korende mobe ekiorokererio ekiya ase riicho riria.

English: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
Kiswahili: Naye Mchungaji Mkuu atakapodhihirishwa, mtapokea taji ya utukufu isiyoharibika.
Ekegusii: Na Omorisia omonene karaoroke namonyore egutwa y’obonene etari gosareka.

English: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Kiswahili: Vivyo hivyo, ninyi mlio vijana watiini wazee. Nanyi nyote imewapasa kujivika unyenyekevu kila mtu kwa mwenzake, kwa kuwa, “Mungu huwapinga wenye kiburi, lakini huwapa wanyenyekevu neema.”
Ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe abamore abake, mwebeke inse ase abagaaka. Na inwe mwensi eboyie oboitongo buna orokini, monyare gokorerana, ekiagera nigo eriikire, “Nyasae nigo akwanga abare abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya.”

English: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
Kiswahili: Basi, nyenyekeeni chini ya mkono wa Mungu ulio hodari, ili awakweze kwa wakati wake.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekeyie inse y’okoboko kwa Nyasae okore nokobua, erinde ere abaimokererie igoro ase ekero kiaye.

English: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
Kiswahili: Mtwikeni yeye fadhaa zenu zote, kwa maana yeye hujishughulisha sana na mambo yenu.
Ekegusii: Motweke ogwechanda kwaino gwonsi, ekiagera ere nigo agwechanda mono ase engencho yaino.

English: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
Kiswahili: Mwe na kiasi na kukesha, maana adui yenu ibilisi huzungukazunguka kama simba angurumaye akitafuta mtu ili apate kummeza.
Ekegusii: Mobe aberiti na korenda! Naki omosoeri oino Saitani nigo agoetanana na koruma buna endo ekoruma, ekorigia omonto erie.

English: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
Kiswahili: Mpingeni, mkiwa thabiti katika imani, mkijua ya kwamba mateso kama hayo yanawapata ndugu zenu pote duniani.
Ekegusii: Mwange ere, na motenene bokong’u ase okwegena, momanye ng’a ogochandwa okwo okwo gwaikeranigwe ase abamino abare ase ense engima.

English: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
Kiswahili: Nanyi mkiisha kuteswa kwa kitambo kidogo, Mungu wa neema yote, aliyewaita kuingia katika utukufu wake wa milele ndani ya Kristo, yeye mwenyewe atawarejesha na kuwatia nguvu, akiwaimarisha na kuwathibitisha.
Ekegusii: Na Nyasae bw’obuya bwonsi, oyo obarangeirie mosoe ase obonene bwaye bwa kare na kare ase Kristo, komwaikire gochandwa ase ekero egeke, ere omonyene nabaroisie, na abakong’ie, ababeeke chinguru na kobabeeka ase oboroso obuya.

English: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Uweza una yeye milele na milele. Amen.
Ekegusii: Okobua nokwaye goika kare na kare. Amina.

English: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
Kiswahili: Kwa msaada wa Silvano, ambaye ninamhesabu kuwa ndugu mwaminifu, nimewaandikia waraka huu mfupi ili kuwatia moyo, na kushuhudia kwamba hii ni neema halisi ya Mungu. Simameni imara katika neema hiyo.
Ekegusii: Ase okoboko gwa Silivano, oyominto omwegenwa buna ndoche, nabarikeire ase amang’ana amake, kobasorora na koorokia ng’a obo nabwo obuya bw’ekeene bwa Nyasae. Tenena bokong’u ase obwo.

English: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
Kiswahili: Kanisa lililoko Babeli, lililochaguliwa pamoja nanyi, wanawasalimu; vivyo hivyo mwanangu Marko anawasalimu.
Ekegusii: Ekanisa ya Babiloni eyachorirwe amo nainwe yabakwanirie. Nonya Mariko, omwana one, obakwanirie.

English: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
Kiswahili: Salimianeni kwa busu la upendo. Amani iwe nanyi nyote mlio katika Kristo.
Ekegusii: Kwanania ase okonyunyuntana ase obwanchani. Omorembe obe amo nainwe mwensi, abamore ase Kristo Yeso.

English: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
Kiswahili: Simoni Petro, mtumishi na mtume wa Yesu Kristo: Kwa wale ambao kwa njia ya haki ya Mungu na Mwokozi wetu Yesu Kristo mmepokea imani iliyo na thamani kama yetu:
Ekegusii: Korwa ase Simioni Petero, omosomba na omotomwa o Yeso Kristo, gocha ase baria abamwanyorire okwegena okomo naintwe, okore kwe rigori rinene, goetera ase oboronge bwa Nyasae na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo.

English: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
Kiswahili: Neema na amani iwe kwenu kwa wingi katika kumjua Mungu na Yesu Bwana wetu.
Ekegusii: Obuya na omorembe bimenteke ase more ase okomomanya Nyasae na Yeso, Omonene oito.

English: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
Kiswahili: Uweza wake wa uungu umetupatia mambo yote tunayohitaji kwa ajili ya uzima na uchaji wa Mungu, kwa kumjua yeye aliyetuita kwa utukufu wake na wema wake mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Okobua kw’obonyasae bwaye gwatoeire ebinto bionsi ebire nobogima na ebie chingencho chi’obonyasae ase okomomanya ere oyotorangeretie ase obonene bwaye obonyene, na okobua kwaye.

English: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hiyo, ametukirimia ahadi zake kuu na za thamani kupitia mambo haya, ili kupitia hayo mpate kuwa washiriki wa asili ya uungu, na kuokoka kutoka upotovu ulioko duniani unaosababishwa na tamaa mbaya.
Ekegusii: Ase ebinto ebio otoeire chiira chinene mono, echie rigori rinene, erinde ase echio monyare koba ababwatani be chingencho chia Nyasae, na gotama ogosaria gw’okogania okobe kore ase ense eye.

English: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii hasa, jitahidini sana katika imani yenu kuongeza wema; na katika wema, maarifa;
Ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio eyio kora omokia mono, erinde ase okwegena kwaino momente obuya, na ase obuya chisemi,

English: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;
Kiswahili: katika maarifa, kiasi; katika kiasi, saburi; katika saburi, utauwa;
Ekegusii: na ase chisemi obweriti, na ase obweriti oboremereria, na ase oboremereria chingencho chi’obonyasae,

English: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
Kiswahili: katika utauwa, upendano wa ndugu; na katika upendano wa ndugu, upendo.
Ekegusii: na ase chingencho chi’obonyasae obwanchani bw’obomino, na ase obwanchani bw’obomino mwanche bonsi.

English: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana haya yakiwa ndani yenu kwa wingi na kuzidi kuongezeka, yanawasaidia msikose bidii wala kutozaa matunda katika kumjua Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki amang’ana aya karabe ime yaino na komenteka, nabakore timoba aboro gose abanto motari nokwama, ase okomomanya Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

English: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu yeyote asipokuwa na mambo haya haoni mbali, na ni kipofu, naye amesahau kule kutakaswa kutoka dhambi zake za zamani.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyotari namang’ana ayio nomouko, takonyara korora amang’ana are bosio, na bwebire ogosibigwa kw’ebibe biaye bia kare.

English: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, fanyeni bidii zaidi kuuthibitisha wito wenu na uteule wenu. Kwa maana mkifanya hivyo, hamtajikwaa kamwe,
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, abaminto, kora omokia kobua gokora okorangerigwa kwaino na ogochorwa kwaino kobe goteneine bokong’u, naki komorakore ayio, timokogwa nonya ng’ake.

English: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: na mtajaliwa kwa ukarimu mwingi kuingia katika ufalme wa milele wa Bwana na Mwokozi wetu Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo moraegwe ribaga rinene mono ri’ogosoa ase oborwoti bwa kare na kare Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo.

English: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nitawakumbusha mambo haya siku zote, hata ingawa mnayajua na mmethibitishwa katika kweli mliyo nayo.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, tinkomocha kobainyoria amang’ana ayio botambe, nonya moyamanyete na mwabekirwe chinguru ase ekeene ekio mwanyorire.

English: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
Kiswahili: Naona ni vyema kuwakumbusha mambo haya wakati wote niwapo katika hema hili ambalo ni mwili wangu,
Ekegusii: Inche narorire ng’a mboronge kobatura ase okobainyoria ayio ekero imenyete ase obomenyo obo bw’omobere.

English: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
Kiswahili: kwa sababu najua ya kwamba hivi karibuni nitaliweka kando, kama vile Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo alivyoliweka wazi kwangu.
Ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a amatuko ng’ang’e are ndarue ase obomenyo obo. Aya naro Omonene oito Yeso Kristo anyorogetie.

English: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
Kiswahili: Nami nitafanya kila juhudi kuona kwamba baada ya kuondoka kwangu mtaweza kuyakumbuka mambo haya siku zote.
Ekegusii: Na inche ninkore omokia ng’a botambe magega y’ogokwa kwane monyare koinyora amang’ana aya.

English: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
Kiswahili: Tulipowafahamisha juu ya uweza na kuja kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, hatukufuata hadithi zilizotungwa kwa werevu, bali tulishuhudia kwa macho yetu ukuu wake.
Ekegusii: Naki titokobwatia emegano yarengereretigwe ne chisemi chi’obong’ainereria, ekero twabamanyetie okobua kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo na ogocha kwaye, korende intwe abanyene nigo twarenge abarori b’obonene bwaye.

English: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
Kiswahili: Alipewa heshima na utukufu kutoka kwa Mungu Baba, sauti ilipomjia katika Utukufu Mkuu, ikisema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa. Ninapendezwa naye sana.”
Ekegusii: Naki ere nigo anyorete ogosikwa na obonene korwa ase Nyasae Tata, na eriogi riachete asare korwa ase obonene bw’Obonene, rigoteeba, “Oyo nere Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere.”

English: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
Kiswahili: Sisi wenyewe tuliisikia sauti hii ambayo ilitoka mbinguni, wakati tulipokuwa pamoja naye kwenye ule mlima mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Na eriogi eri nario twaigwete rikorwa igoro, ekero twarenge amo nere ase egetunwa egechenu.

English: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,
Kiswahili: Nasi tunalo pia neno la hakika zaidi la unabii, ambalo mtafanya vyema mkiliangalia kwa bidii, kama vile nuru inavyongʼaa gizani, hadi kupambazuka na nyota ya asubuhi izuke mioyoni mwenu.
Ekegusii: Intwe ntore ne ring’ana riria ri’obobani riteneine bokong’u kobua, na inwe inamokore buya komorategerere na koribwata buna etaya ekomoreka aase omosunte ore, goika ekero bogokia, na eng’enang’eni ya mambia eoroke ase chinkoro chiaino ime.

English: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya yote, yawapasa mjue kwamba hakuna unabii katika Maandiko uliofasiriwa kama alivyopenda nabii mwenyewe.
Ekegusii: Ritang’ani momanye ring’ana eri, ng’a obobani bonde tibori ime ase amariiko bwaorogetigwe koreng’ana buna omonto anchete omonyene,

English: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana unabii haukuja kamwe kwa mapenzi ya mwanadamu, bali watu walinena yaliyotoka kwa Mungu wakiongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: ekiagera obobani tibwarentetwe engaki ende yonsi ase ogwancha kwa Mwanyabaanto, korende abanto abachenu ba Nyasae nigo baare gokwana batang’anire n’Omoika Omochenu.

English: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.
Kiswahili: Lakini pia waliinuka manabii wa uongo miongoni mwa watu, kama vile watakavyokuwako walimu wa uongo miongoni mwenu. Wataingiza mafundisho yasiyopatana na kweli kwa siri, hata kumkana Bwana wa pekee aliyewanunua, na hivyo kujiletea wenyewe maangamizi ya haraka.
Ekegusii: Korende ababani b’oborimo mbaorogete ase egati y’abanto, buna aborokia b’oborimo barache kooroka ase egati yaino. Abwo barache gosoyia amorokererio ogosareka bobisi, na bagokana Omonene oyo obagorete, bakwerentera ogosareka gotari goteebana.

English: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, wengi watafuata njia zao za ufisadi, na kwa ajili yao njia ya kweli itatukanwa.
Ekegusii: Abange nabatunyane ogokora kwabo kw’obonyaka, na ase engencho y’abwo enchera y’ekeene neramwe.

English: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.
Kiswahili: Nao katika tamaa zao mbaya, walimu hawa watajipatia faida kwenu kwa hadithi walizotunga wenyewe. Lakini hukumu imekwisha kutangazwa dhidi yao tangu zamani, wala uangamivu wao haujalala usingizi.
Ekegusii: Ase obwegimeria na amang’ana ’obong’ainereria nabenyorere abanyene ebitoki korwa ase more. Korende ekiina kiabo, egiachikiire korwa kare, tikegoteebana, gose ogosira kwabo tigokorara.

English: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana, kama Mungu hakuwasamehe malaika walipotenda dhambi, bali aliwatupa kuzimu katika vifungo vya giza wakae humo mpaka ije hukumu;
Ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tabarorerete amaabera abamalaika baria bakorete ebibe, korende akabaruta ase omorero o kare na kare aase barendire goika ekiina geche.

English: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,
Kiswahili: kama hakuusamehe ulimwengu wa kale alipoleta gharika juu ya watu wale wasiomcha Mungu, bali akamhifadhi Noa, mhubiri wa haki, pamoja na watu wengine saba;
Ekegusii: Tabarorerete amaabera abanto ab’ense eria ya kare, korende akarenda Nuhu, oyorenge omoraria bw’oboronge, amo nabaanto bande batano na babere, ekero arentete etoigo igoro ase ense y’abanto abatamoirogete Nyasae.

English: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,
Kiswahili: kama aliihukumu miji ya Sodoma na Gomora kwa kuiteketeza kwa moto ikawa majivu, na kuifanya kuwa kielelezo kwa yale yatakayowapata wale wasiomcha Mungu;
Ekegusii: Ase ogosamba emechie eria yare korokwa Sodomu na Gomora ekaba ribu, akayegambia esarigwe, akayekora ekaba ekiorokererio ki’ogokuurera abanto abatarengereretie komoiroka Nyasae.

English: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
Kiswahili: na kama alimwokoa Loti, mtu mwenye haki, ambaye alihuzunishwa na maisha machafu ya watu wapotovu
Ekegusii: Korende agatooria Loti, omonyene oboronge, oyorenge goichanigwa ase orogendo rw’obonyaka rwa baria abasaria amachiiko.

English: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),
Kiswahili: (kwa sababu yale matendo mapotovu aliyoyaona na kuyasikia huyo mtu mwenye haki alipoishi miongoni mwao yalimhuzunisha siku baada ya siku):
Ekegusii: Omonto oyo omonyene oboronge, oyomenyete ase egati yabo, nigo arenge gwechanda ase omoyo oye omooronge rituko ase rituko ase aya onsi arenge korora na koigwa ase ogokora kwabo kw’ogosaria amachiiko.

English: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
Kiswahili: ikiwa hivyo ndivyo, basi Bwana anajua jinsi ya kuwaokoa wamchao Mungu kutoka majaribu, na kuwaweka waasi katika adhabu hadi siku ya hukumu.
Ekegusii: Omonene nanyare kobatooria abwo bamoirogete korwa ase ogoteemwa, na kogaacha abatari noboronge inse y’egesusuro goika rituko ri’ekiina,

English: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,
Kiswahili: Hii ni hakika hasa kwa wale wanaofuata tamaa mbaya za mwili na kudharau mamlaka. Kwa ushupavu na kwa kiburi, watu hawa hawaogopi kunena mabaya dhidi ya viumbe vya mbinguni.
Ekegusii: na kobua mono baria bakobwatia okogania okobe kw’omobere na gochaaya okobua. Barabwo nigo bare abeanchi, bare noboremu, na tibari koiguswa ase okorama abwo b’obonene.

English: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
Kiswahili: Lakini hata malaika, ingawa wana nguvu na uwezo zaidi, hawaleti mashtaka mabaya dhidi ya viumbe kama hao mbele za Bwana.
Ekegusii: Abamalaika, nonya bare abanene kobua ase chinguru na okobua, tibakorenta ekiina gi’okorama barabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

English: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,
Kiswahili: Lakini watu hawa hukufuru katika mambo wasiyoyafahamu. Wao ni kama wanyama wasio na akili, viumbe wanaotawaliwa na hisia za mwili, waliozaliwa ili wakamatwe na kuchinjwa. Hawa nao kama wanyama wataangamizwa pia.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo nigo banga buna ching’iti chiatongetwe chitari nobong’aini, chiaiboretwe ase okobwatwa na gosirigwa. Barabwo nigo bakorama ase amang’ana batamanyeti. Ase ayio inabasirigwe ase ogosirigwa kwabo abanyene.

English: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;
Kiswahili: Watalipwa madhara kwa ajili ya madhara waliyowatendea wengine. Huhesabu kuwa ni fahari kufanya karamu za ulevi na ulafi mchana peupe. Wao ni mawaa na dosari, wakijifurahisha katika anasa zao wanaposhiriki katika karamu zenu.
Ekegusii: Bakonyorwa nobobe buna eng’eria y’ogokora okobe. Barabwo nigo bagokaga ng’a ogotinda na okwegokia ekero kia mobaso nobwansu. Babeire ebimoa bi’obosooku na amamocho, bakwegokia ase obong’ainereria bwabo kobagokora emeyega amo nainwe.

English: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!
Kiswahili: Wakiwa na macho yaliyojaa uzinzi, kamwe hawaachi kutenda dhambi. Huwashawishi wale wasio imara. Wao ni hodari kwa kutamani; ni wana wa laana!
Ekegusii: Amaiso abo nigo aichire nobotomani, na tibagotiga gokora ebibe. Nigo bakogenka abare nemioyo etari ne chinguru, na bare ne chinkoro chianarigwe ase obwegimeria. Barabwo nigo bare abanto baragereretigwe.

English: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;
Kiswahili: Wameiacha njia iliyonyooka, wakapotoka na kuifuata njia ya Balaamu mwana wa Beori aliyependa mshahara wa uovu.
Ekegusii: Basirire ekiagera batigire enchera erambogete na kobwatia enchera ya Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, oyobwanchete eng’eria y’ogokora okobe.

English: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa ajili ya uovu wake, alikemewa na punda, mnyama asiyejua kusema, akaongea akitumia sauti ya mwanadamu na kuzuia wazimu wa huyo nabii.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo atogonyeretwe ase ogosaria kwaye omonyene, ekero etigere etari gokwana egakwana ase eriogi ria Mwanyabaanto, egatanga obobarimo bw’omobani oria.

English: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
Kiswahili: Watu hawa ni chemchemi zisizo na maji, na ukungu upeperushwao na tufani. Giza nene limewekwa tayari kwa ajili yao.
Ekegusii: Abanto aba nechinsoko chitari namaache na amare akoirwa nomwaga, bagacheirwe obomwamu bw’omosunte.

English: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wao hunena maneno makuu mno ya kiburi cha bure, na kwa kuvutia tamaa mbaya za asili ya mwili, huwashawishi watu ambao ndipo tu wamejiondoa miongoni mwa wale wanaoishi katika ufisadi.
Ekegusii: Nigo bagokwana amang’ana oboenenu atari nengencho, na ase okogania okobe kw’omobere na obonyaka bakogenka abwo bachakire gotama baria bagendererete gochia gosira.

English: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.
Kiswahili: Huwaahidi uhuru hao waliowanasa, wakati wao wenyewe ni watumwa wa ufisadi: kwa maana mtu ni mtumwa wa kitu chochote kinachomtawala.
Ekegusii: Bakobariera eira y’obosibore, korende barabwo abanyene nigo bare abasomba b’ogosareka. Naki omonto kabuirwe nomonto onde nigo akoba omosomba bw’omonto oria.

English: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
Kiswahili: Kama wameukimbia upotovu wa dunia kwa kumjua Bwana wetu na Mwokozi Yesu Kristo, kisha wakanaswa tena humo na kushindwa, hali yao ya mwisho ni mbaya zaidi kuliko ile ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Naki baria baikire gotama ogotacheneka gw’ense ase okomomanya Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo, korende kobakobwatwa naende na kobugwa nero, okoba kwabo kw’omoerio nkobe okobe kobua koria kw’eritang’ani.

English: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
Kiswahili: Ingelikuwa afadhali kwao kama wasingeliijua kamwe njia ya haki, kuliko kuijua kisha wakaiacha ile amri takatifu waliyokabidhiwa.
Ekegusii: Naki anga nigo yabeete buya onye tibamanyete enchera y’oboronge, kobua koyemanya naende koirana magega korwa ase ogochika ogochenu okwo baetwe.

English: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
Kiswahili: Imetukia kwao sawasawa na ile mithali ya kweli isemayo: “Mbwa huyarudia matapiko yake mwenyewe,” tena, “Nguruwe aliyeoshwa hurudi kugaagaa matopeni.”
Ekegusii: Barabwo omoreng’anio oria bw’ekeene obaikeire, oria ogoteeba, “Esese yairaneire amaroki aye enyene,” na “Embeche eyasibigwe ekwegara‐garia ase etintira ime.”

English: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you
Kiswahili: Wapenzi, huu ndio waraka wangu wa pili ninaowaandikia. Katika nyaraka hizi mbili ninajaribu kuziamsha nia zenu safi kwa mawazo makamilifu.
Ekegusii: Abanchani, riruube eri neria kabere nabarikeire inwe. Ase onsi abere nabokirie ebirengererio biaino ebiya ase okobainyoria,

English: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,
Kiswahili: Nataka ninyi mkumbuke maneno yaliyosemwa zamani na manabii watakatifu na ile amri ya Bwana na Mwokozi mliyopewa kupitia kwa mitume wenu.
Ekegusii: monyare koinyora amang’ana aria akwanetwe kare nababani abachenu, na ogochika kw’Omonene na Omotooria abarenterete goetera ase abatomwa baino.

English: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
Kiswahili: Kwanza kabisa, ni lazima mfahamu ya kwamba siku za mwisho watakuja watu wenye dhihaka, wakidhihaki na kuzifuata tamaa zao mbaya.
Ekegusii: Ritang’ani momanye ring’ana eri, ng’a ase amatuko omoerio abanto abanyacheche b’ogosekereria inabache, baria bagotunyana okogania kwabo abanyene,

English: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”
Kiswahili: Watasema, “Iko wapi ile ahadi ya kuja kwake? Tangu baba zetu walipofariki, kila kitu kinaendelea kama kilivyokuwa tangu mwanzo wa kuumbwa.”
Ekegusii: bagoteeba, “Ng’ai bore oboikeranu bw’eira eria y’ogocha kwaye? Naki korwa agwo chisokoro chiaito chiaraarete ebinto bionsi nabo bigendererete engencho eyio eyio, buna biarenge korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa.”

English: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,
Kiswahili: Lakini wao kwa makusudi hupuuza ukweli huu, ya kwamba kwa neno la Mungu mbingu zilikuwepo tangu zamani, nayo dunia ilifanyizwa kutoka ndani ya maji na kwa maji.
Ekegusii: Naki nigo bamiametie amaiso abo tibarora ng’a igoro nao yarenge korwa kare, na ense egatongwa korwa ase amaache, na goetera ase amaache, ase chinguru chi’ering’ana ria Nyasae.

English: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.
Kiswahili: Ulimwengu wa wakati ule uligharikishwa kwa hayo maji na kuangamizwa.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio, ense eria y’ekero keria egasira ase etoigo ime.

English: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
Kiswahili: Lakini kwa neno lilo hilo, mbingu za sasa na dunia zimewekwa akiba kwa ajili ya moto, zikihifadhiwa hadi siku ile ya hukumu na ya kuangamizwa kwa watu wasiomcha Mungu.
Ekegusii: Korende igoro ya bono amo na ense eye biagacheirwe omorero ase ring’ana erio erio, birendwe goika rituko ri’ogosirigwa kw’abaanto abatamoirogeti Nyasae.

English: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
Kiswahili: Lakini wapenzi, msisahau neno hili: kwamba kwa Bwana, siku moja ni kama miaka elfu, na miaka elfu ni kama siku moja.
Ekegusii: Korende abanchani, timweba ring’ana eri, ng’a ase Omonene rituko erimo nigo rire buna emiaka elifu, na emiaka elifu buna rituko erimo.

English: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
Kiswahili: Bwana hakawii kuitimiza ahadi yake, kama watu wengine wanavyokudhani kukawia. Badala yake, yeye anawavumilia ninyi, maana hataki mtu yeyote aangamie, bali kila mtu afikilie toba.
Ekegusii: Omonene tagoteebana goikerania, eira yaye, buna abande bakagete ng’a otebanire, korende nigo aremereretie ase engencho yaino, tancheti monto onde bwensi asire, korende bonsi baikere okoonchoka.

English: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.
Kiswahili: Lakini siku ya Bwana itakuja kama mwizi. Ndipo mbingu zitatoweka kwa kishindo kikuu; navyo vitu vya asili vitateketezwa kwa moto, nayo dunia na kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake kitaunguzwa.
Ekegusii: Korende rituko ri’Omonene nigo rirache buna omoibi agoocha. Ase rituko erio igoro neruo negeturi ekenene, na ebitongwa bia igoro inabisire nomorero ogotetenya, na ense na ebinto ebire aroro inabiyie.

English: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa vitu vyote vitaharibiwa namna hii, je, ninyi imewapasa kuwa watu wa namna gani? Inawapasa kuishi maisha matakatifu na ya kumcha Mungu,
Ekegusii: Naboigo, ekiagera ebinto ebi bionsi nabisire, nebagwenerete inwe mobe abanto b’orogendo oroochenu na abe chingencho chi’obonyasae.

English: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
Kiswahili: mkingojea na kuhimiza kuja kwa hiyo siku ya Mungu. Siku hiyo italeta mbingu kuchomwa moto na kutoweka, na vitu vya asili vitayeyuka kwa moto.
Ekegusii: Nebagwenerete gotengera na koayereria rituko ria Nyasae riiche bwango. Ase rituko riria igoro nesirigwe na koyia, na ebitongwa bia igoro inabinyititoke nomorero omonene.

English: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
Kiswahili: Lakini kufuatana na ahadi yake, sisi tunatazamia mbingu mpya na dunia mpya, ambayo haki hukaa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Korende buna atorierete eira ntotengerete igoro enyia na ense enyia, ase ebio oboronge mboreo ime yabo.

English: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu hii, wapenzi, kwa kuwa mnatazamia mambo haya, fanyeni bidii ili awakute katika amani, bila mawaa wala dosari.
Ekegusii: Ase ayio abanchani, ekiagera motengerete ebio, kora omokia, erio moche kororekana asare more nomorembe, motari na kemoa gose na komocha.

English: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
Kiswahili: Hesabuni uvumilivu wa Bwana kuwa ni wokovu, kama vile ndugu yetu mpenzi Paulo alivyowaandikia kwa hekima ile aliyopewa na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Na bara okoremereria kw’Omonene oito ng’a nogotooreka. Naboigo noyominto omwanchwa, Paulo, abarikerete koreng’ana nobong’aini aetwe.

English: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
Kiswahili: Huandika vivyo hivyo katika nyaraka zake zote, akizungumzia ndani yake mambo haya. Katika nyaraka zake kuna mambo mengine ambayo ni vigumu kuyaelewa, ambayo watu wajinga na wasio thabiti huyapotosha kwa maangamizi yao wenyewe, kama wapotoshavyo pia Maandiko mengine.
Ekegusii: Igoro y’amang’ana ayio ariikire ase amarube aye onsi. Imeo nare amang’ana ande ayare amakong’u koyamanya, ayio abanto batorokereretigwe buya na batateneini bokong’u bakoonchorana, buna bakoonchorana amariiko ande, na igo bakwerentera ogosira.

English: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
Kiswahili: Basi, ninyi wapenzi, kwa kuwa mmekwisha kujua mambo haya, jilindeni msije mkachukuliwa na kosa la watu hao waasi na kuanguka kutoka kwenye uthabiti wenu.
Ekegusii: Gaki, abanchani, komwatang’anire komanya aya, erende timobaisa gotantanigwa nogosira kw’abwo bagosaria amachiiko, na igo mobaise kogwa korwa ase ogwetenenera kwaino.

English: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Bali kueni katika neema na katika kumjua Bwana na Mwokozi wetu Yesu Kristo. Utukufu una yeye sasa na milele! Amen.
Ekegusii: Korende mokine ase obuya na ase okomomanya Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo. Obonene nobwaye bono na goika kare na kare. Amina.

English: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
Kiswahili: Tunawajulisha lile lililokuwepo tangu mwanzo, lile tulilosikia, ambalo tumeliona kwa macho yetu, ambalo tumelitazama na kuligusa kwa mikono yetu, kuhusu Neno la uzima.
Ekegusii: Nigo tokobarikera igoro y’ering’ana ri’obogima, erio riarengeo korwa omochakano, eri twaigwete, eri twaroche namaiso aito, eri twarigereretie, nonya namaboko aito akaribwata.

English: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
Kiswahili: Uzima huo ulidhihirishwa; nasi tumeuona na kuushuhudia, nasi twawatangazia uzima wa milele, ambao ulikuwa pamoja na Baba, nao ukadhihirishwa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Obogima obwo bokaorokigwa, na intwe tokaborora na kobobera kirori; na intwe igo tokabaraareria inwe obogima obwo bwa kare na kare, obwo bwarenge ase Tata na koorokigwa ase tore.

English: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
Kiswahili: Twawatangazia lile tuliloliona na kulisikia, ili nanyi mwe na ushirika nasi. Na ushirika wetu hasa ni pamoja na Baba na Mwanawe, Yesu Kristo.
Ekegusii: Eri twarorire na koigwa, eri naboigo tokobaraareria inwe, erinde nainwe monyare kobwatana naintwe. Okobwatana gwaito nigo kore amo na Tata na Omwana oye Yeso Kristo.

English: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
Kiswahili: Tunaandika mambo haya ili furaha yetu ipate kuwa timilifu.
Ekegusii: Nkobariikera tore aya, erinde omogooko oito oikeranigwe.

English: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio ujumbe tuliosikia kutoka kwake na kuwatangazia ninyi: kwamba Mungu ni nuru na ndani yake hamna giza lolote.
Ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana twaigwete korwa asare, na tokobaraareria inwe, ng’a Nyasae nomobaso, gose mosunte onde bwonsi tori ime asare.

English: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
Kiswahili: Kama tukisema kwamba twashirikiana naye huku tukienenda gizani, twasema uongo, wala hatutendi lililo kweli.
Ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng’a twabwatanire nere, naende togendererete ase omosunte, igo twatebiire oborimo, gose ayare ay’ekeene titori koyakora.

English: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
Kiswahili: Lakini tukienenda nuruni, kama yeye alivyo nuruni, twashirikiana sisi kwa sisi na damu yake Yesu, Mwana wake, yatusafisha dhambi yote.
Ekegusii: Korende onye tokogenda ase omobaso, buna ere are ase omobaso, rirorio twabwatanire intwe ase intwe, na amanyinga a Yeso, Omwana oye, nigo agotosibia ebibe biaito bionsi.

English: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
Kiswahili: Kama tukisema kwamba hatuna dhambi, twajidanganya wenyewe wala kweli haimo ndani yetu.
Ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng’a titori na bibe, iga tokweng’aina, gose ekeene tikeri ime yaito.

English: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Kiswahili: Kama tukiziungama dhambi zetu, yeye ni mwaminifu na wa haki, atatusamehe dhambi zetu na kutusafisha kutoka kwenye udhalimu wote.
Ekegusii: Gatorabiorokie ebibe biaito, ere nomwegenwa na omonyene oboronge, natwabere ebibe biaito, na atosibie korwa ase ogotaba boronge gwonsi.

English: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
Kiswahili: Kama tukisema hatukutenda dhambi, twamfanya yeye kuwa mwongo na neno lake halimo ndani yetu.
Ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng’a titokoreti ebibe, twakorire Nyasae koba omonyaborimo, gose ring’ana riaye tiriri ime yaito.

English: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
Kiswahili: Watoto wangu wapendwa, nawaandikia haya ili msitende dhambi. Lakini kama mtu yeyote akitenda dhambi, tunaye Mwombezi kwa Baba: ndiye Yesu Kristo, Mwenye Haki.
Ekegusii: Abana baane abake, nkobariikera nde aya, erinde timokora ebibe. Korende onye omonto okorire ebibe, ntore n’Omosaberi ase Tata, nere Yeso Kristo, Omonyene Oboronge.

English: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
Kiswahili: Yeye ndiye dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, wala si kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu tu, bali pia kwa ajili ya dhambi za ulimwengu wote.
Ekegusii: Ere nekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito, gose tari ase ebibe biaito bioka, korende nase ebibe bi’ense yonsi.

English: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
Kiswahili: Basi katika hili twajua ya kuwa tumemjua, tukizishika amri zake.
Ekegusii: Onye tobwatete amachiiko aye, ntore nobomaene ng’a ntomomanyete.

English: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asemaye kuwa, “Ninamjua,” lakini hazishiki amri zake, ni mwongo, wala ndani ya mtu huyo hamna kweli.
Ekegusii: Ere oyogoteeba, “Nimomanyete,” na tabwateti amachiiko aye, oyio nomonyaborimo, gose ekeene tikeri ime yaye.

English: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
Kiswahili: Lakini mtu yeyote anayelitii neno lake, upendo wa Mungu umekamilika ndani yake kweli kweli. Katika hili twajua kuwa tumo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Korende ere oyobwatete ring’ana riaye, ime ase oyio obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaikeranigwe ekeene ekeene. Ase eri ntore nobomaene ng’a nigo tore ime asare:

English: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayesema anakaa ndani yake hana budi kuenenda kama Yesu alivyoenenda.
Ekegusii: Ere oyogoteeba ng’a nigo amenyete ime asare, nagwenerete kogenda ere omonyene buna Yeso arenge kogenda.

English: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
Kiswahili: Wapendwa, siwaandikii ninyi amri mpya bali ile ya zamani, ambayo mmekuwa nayo tangu mwanzo. Amri hii ya zamani ni lile neno mlilosikia.
Ekegusii: Abanchani, timbarikereti ogochika okoyia, korende nkoria gwa kare mwarenge na korokwo korwa ritang’ani. Na ogochika koria gwa kare nakwo ring’ana riria mwaigwete.

English: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
Kiswahili: Lakini nawaandikia amri mpya, yaani, lile neno lililo kweli ndani yake na ndani yenu, kwa sababu giza linapita na ile nuru ya kweli tayari inangʼaa.
Ekegusii: Naende nkobariikera nde ogochika okoyia, okore ogw’ekeene ime yaye, na ime yaino, ekiagera omosunte ngoeta ore, na omobaso bw’ekeene oikire kobara.

English: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayesema yumo nuruni lakini anamchukia ndugu yake bado yuko gizani.
Ekegusii: Ere oyogoteeba ng’a nigo are ase omobaso ime, naende ogechete oyomwabo, nigo are ase omosunte ime nonya mbono,

English: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
Kiswahili: Yeye ampendaye ndugu yake anakaa nuruni, wala hakuna kitu chochote ndani yake cha kumkwaza.
Ekegusii: na ere oyobwanchete oyomwabo nigo amenyete ase omobaso, na ime asare gento tikeiyo keragere agochwe.

English: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
Kiswahili: Lakini yeyote amchukiaye ndugu yake, yuko gizani na anaenenda gizani, wala hajui anakokwenda, kwa sababu giza limempofusha macho.
Ekegusii: Korende ere oyogechete oyomwabo nigo are ase omosunte ime, naende nigo akogenda ase omosunte, na tamanyeti nonya nase agochia, ekiagera omosunte omoukoirie amaiso aye.

English: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
Kiswahili: Nawaandikia ninyi, watoto wadogo, kwa sababu dhambi zenu zimesamehewa kwa ajili ya Jina lake.
Ekegusii: Nkobariikera nde inwe, abana baane, ekiagera ebibe biaino biaabeirwe ase engencho y’erieta riaye.

English: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
Kiswahili: Nawaandikia ninyi, akina baba, kwa sababu mmemjua yeye aliye tangu mwanzo. Nawaandikia ninyi vijana kwa sababu mmemshinda yule mwovu. Nawaandikia ninyi watoto wadogo, kwa sababu mmemjua Baba.
Ekegusii: Nkobariikera nde inwe abaise, ekiagera momomanyete ere oyorengeo korwa omochakano. Nkobariikera nde inwe, abamura, ekiagera mwamobuire oria omobe. Nabarikerete inwe, abana abake, ekiagera momomanyete Tata.

English: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
Kiswahili: Nawaandikia ninyi akina baba, kwa sababu mmemjua yeye aliye tangu mwanzo. Nawaandikia ninyi vijana, kwa sababu mna nguvu, na neno la Mungu linakaa ndani yenu, nanyi mmemshinda yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: Nabarikerete inwe, abana bane, ekiagera momomanyete tata. Nabarikeire inwe aba Tata ekiagera momomanyete ere oyonge oo korwa omochakano. Nabarikerete inwe, abamura, ekiagera more ne chinguru, ne ring’ana ria Nyasae ndire ime yaino, na mwabuire oria omobe.

English: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
Kiswahili: Msiupende ulimwengu wala mambo yaliyo ulimwenguni. Kama mtu yeyote akiupenda ulimwengu, upendo wa Baba haumo ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Timwancha ense eye, nonya n’ebinto bire ase ense. Omonto karanche ense eye, obwanchani bwa Tata tibori ime yaye.

English: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila kitu kilichomo ulimwenguni, yaani tamaa ya mwili, tamaa ya macho na kiburi cha uzima, havitokani na Baba bali hutokana na ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Naki bionsi ebire ase ense eye, okogania okobe kw’omobere, na okogania okobe kw’amaiso, na oboenenu bw’obogima obo, tibiri korua ase Tata, korende nigo bikorua ase ense.

English: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
Kiswahili: Nao ulimwengu unapita, pamoja na tamaa zake, bali yeye afanyaye mapenzi ya Mungu adumu milele.
Ekegusii: Na ense eye nigo egoeta, na okogania kwaye, korende ere oyogokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae nigo akoba moyo goika kare na kare.

English: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
Kiswahili: Watoto wadogo, huu ni wakati wa mwisho! Kama mlivyosikia kwamba mpinga Kristo anakuja, hivyo basi wapinga Kristo wengi wamekwisha kuja. Kutokana na hili twajua kwamba huu ni wakati wa mwisho.
Ekegusii: Abana baane abake, engaki eye ney’omoerio. Na buna mwaigwete ng’a omobisa o Kristo ngocha are, nonya mbono ababisa ba Kristo nabange baimokire. Ase ayio twamanyire ng’a engaki eye ney’omoerio.

English: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
Kiswahili: Walitoka kwetu, lakini hawakuwa wa kwetu hasa. Kwa maana kama wangelikuwa wa kwetu, wangelikaa pamoja nasi, lakini kutoka kwao kulionyesha kwamba hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyekuwa wa kwetu.
Ekegusii: Abwo basokire korwa ase tore, korende tibarenge abaito. Naki onye nabaito baare, anga mbabete amo naintwe. Korende barureo, erinde emanyekane ng’a tari bonsi barenge abaito.

English: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
Kiswahili: Lakini ninyi mmetiwa mafuta na yeye Aliye Mtakatifu, nanyi nyote mnaijua kweli.
Ekegusii: Na inwe mwaakirwe amaguta nere oyore Omochenu, na mwamanyire onsi.

English: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
Kiswahili: Siwaandikii kwa sababu hamuijui kweli, bali kwa sababu mnaijua, nanyi mnajua hakuna uongo utokao katika kweli.
Ekegusii: Tinabarikerete inwe, ekiagera motamanyeti ekeene, korende nekiagera mokemanyete, naende momanyete ng’a borimo bonde tibori bokorwa ase ekeene.

English: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
Kiswahili: Je, mwongo ni nani? Mwongo ni mtu yule asemaye kwamba Yesu si Kristo. Mtu wa namna hiyo ndiye mpinga Kristo, yaani, yeye humkana Baba na Mwana.
Ekegusii: Ning’o ore omonyaborimo otatiga ere oyogokaana ng’a Yeso tari ere Kristo? Oyogokaana Ise na Omwana, oyio nere omobisa o Kristo.

English: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yeyote amkanaye Mwana aliye na Baba. Yeyote anayemkubali Mwana anaye na Baba pia.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogokana Omwana tari na Ise. Ere oyokomobera Omwana kirori nigo are na Ise boigo.

English: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
Kiswahili: Hakikisheni kwamba lile mlilosikia tangu mwanzo linakaa ndani yenu. Kama lile mlilosikia tangu mwanzo linakaa ndani yenu, ninyi nanyi mtakaa ndani ya Mwana na ndani ya Baba.
Ekegusii: Amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, tiga aikaranse ime yaino. Onye amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani aikaransete ime yaino, erio nainwe namomenye ime ase Omwana, na ime ase Ise.

English: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo ahadi yake kwetu, yaani, uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Eye nero eira atorierete intwe, ng’a tonyore obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
Kiswahili: Nawaandikia mambo haya kuhusu wale watu ambao wanajaribu kuwapotosha.
Ekegusii: Nabarikeire amang’ana aya igoro y’abwo bakorigia kobasiria.

English: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
Kiswahili: Nanyi, upako mlioupata kutoka kwake unakaa ndani yenu, wala ninyi hamna haja ya mtu yeyote kuwafundisha. Lakini kama vile upako wake unavyowafundisha kuhusu mambo yote nayo ni kweli wala si uongo, basi kama ulivyowafundisha kaeni ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Korende ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorete korwa ase Kristo nigo goikaransete ime yaino, na inwe timogwenereti monto onde aborokererie, ekiagera ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorire nkoborokererie amang’ana onsi, naende kore ogw’ekeene, gose tari oborimo. Na buna aborokereretie, menya ime ya Kristo.

English: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
Kiswahili: Sasa basi, watoto wapendwa, kaeni ndani yake, ili atakapofunuliwa, tuwe na ujasiri, wala tusiaibike mbele zake wakati wa kuja kwake.
Ekegusii: Na bono inwe abana baane, menya ime asare, erinde ekero akoorokigwa tobe noboremu, titoba nobosooku ase obosio bwaye ekero arachiche.

English: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
Kiswahili: Kama mkijua kuwa yeye ni mwenye haki, mwajua kwamba kila atendaye haki amezaliwa naye.
Ekegusii: Onye mwamanyire ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge, naboigo mobe nobomaene ng’a kera oyogokora boronge, oyio oiboirwe nere.

English: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
Kiswahili: Tazameni ni pendo kuu namna gani alilotupa Baba, kwamba sisi tuitwe wana wa Mungu! Na ndivyo tulivyo. Kwa sababu hii ulimwengu haututambui, kwa kuwa haukumtambua yeye.
Ekegusii: Rora, nobwanchani bore naki, obwo Tata atoeire, ng’a torokwe abana ba Nyasae, na naboigo tore! Naki ekegerete ense etatomanyeti neke, ng’a temomanyeti Nyasae.

English: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
Kiswahili: Wapendwa, sasa tu wana wa Mungu, lakini bado haijadhihirika tutakavyokuwa, lakini twajua ya kwamba yeye atakapodhihirishwa, tutafanana naye, kwa maana tutamwona kama alivyo.
Ekegusii: Abanchani, bono nabana ba Nyasae tore, korende teraorokigwa buna torache koba. Naki twamanyire ng’a ekero araorokigwe ntogwekane nere, ekiagera natomoorore buna are.

English: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
Kiswahili: Kila mmoja mwenye matumaini haya ndani yake hujitakasa, kama vile yeye alivyo mtakatifu.
Ekegusii: Na monto onde bwensi omosemeretie nigo agwechena buna Kristo are omochenu.

English: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu atendaye dhambi afanya uasi, kwa kuwa dhambi ni uasi.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogokora ebibe, nigo agosaria amachiiko, ekiagera ebibe nogosaria kw’amachiiko.

English: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
Kiswahili: Lakini mwajua ya kuwa yeye alidhihirishwa ili aziondoe dhambi, wala ndani yake hamna dhambi.
Ekegusii: Na inwe mwamanyire ng’a Kristo nigo aorogetigwe erinde arusie ebibe biaito, na bibe tibiri ime yaye.

English: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu akaaye ndani yake hatendi dhambi. Kila mtu atendaye dhambi hakumwona yeye wala hakumtambua.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi omenyete ime asare tagokora ebibe; onde bwensi ogokora ebibe tamorochi, nonya nkomomanya tamomanyeti.

English: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
Kiswahili: Watoto wapendwa, mtu yeyote asiwadanganye. Kila mtu atendaye haki ana haki, kama yeye alivyo na haki.
Ekegusii: Abana baane, monto onde tabaisa kobang’aina. Ere oyogokora oboronge nigo are omonyene oboronge, buna Kristo are omonyene oboronge.

English: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
Kiswahili: Yeye atendaye dhambi ni wa ibilisi, kwa sababu ibilisi amekuwa akitenda dhambi tangu mwanzo. Kwa kusudi hili Mwana wa Mungu alidhihirishwa, ili aziangamize kazi za ibilisi.
Ekegusii: Ere oyogokora ebibe noyo o Saitani, ekiagera Saitani nigo akorete ebibe korwa omochakano. Ekiagerete Omwana o Nyasae akaorokigwa neke, ng’a asarie emeremo ya Saitani.

English: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
Kiswahili: Yeyote aliyezaliwa na Mungu hatendi dhambi, kwa sababu uzao wa Mungu wakaa ndani yake, wala hawezi kutenda dhambi kwa sababu amezaliwa na Mungu.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto oiboirwe na Nyasae tagokora ebibe, ekiagera oroiboro rwa Nyasae ndotigarete ime yaye, gose takonyara gokora ebibe, ekiagera oiboirwe na Nyasae.

English: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
Kiswahili: Kwa jinsi hii tunaweza kujua dhahiri watoto wa Mungu na pia watoto wa ibilisi. Yeyote asiyetenda haki hatokani na Mungu, wala yeye asiyempenda ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Ase eri abana ba Nyasae nigo bare maiso marore, na abana ba Saitani boigo: Onde bwensi otari gokora boronge tarueti ase Nyasae, nonya noyo otancheti oyomwabo.

English: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo neno mlilolisikia tangu mwanzo: Kwamba imetupasa tupendane sisi kwa sisi.
Ekegusii: Naki aya naro amang’ana mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, ng’a twanchane intwe ase intwe.

English: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
Kiswahili: Msiwe kama Kaini aliyekuwa wa yule mwovu akamuua ndugu yake. Basi kwa nini alimuua? Ni kwa sababu matendo yake Kaini yalikuwa mabaya na ya ndugu yake yalikuwa ya haki.
Ekegusii: Titoba buna Kaini, oyorenge bw’oria omobe, agaita oyomwabo. Ere nigo amoitete ase ki? Kaini nigo aitete oyomwabo ekiagera ogokora kwaye kwarenge okobe, na okw’oyomwabo nigo kwarenge okwa boronge.

English: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
Kiswahili: Ndugu zangu, ninyi msistaajabu kama ulimwengu ukiwachukia.
Ekegusii: Timokumia, baminto, onye abanto b’ense bakobagecha.

English: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
Kiswahili: Sisi tunajua ya kwamba tumepita mautini kuingia uzimani, kwa sababu tunawapenda ndugu. Kila asiyempenda ndugu yake akaa mautini.
Ekegusii: Intwe twamanyire ng’a twaetire korwa ase amakweri, twasoire ase obogima, ekiagera twanchire abaminto. Oyotancheti nigo amenyete ase amakweri.

English: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
Kiswahili: Yeyote amchukiaye ndugu yake ni muuaji, nanyi mwajua ya kwamba muuaji hana uzima wa milele ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogechete oyomwabo oyio nomoiti, na inwe momanyete ng’a omoiti tari nobogima bwa kare na kare ime yaye.

English: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
Kiswahili: Kwa namna hii twaweza kulijua pendo la Mungu: Kwa sababu Yesu Kristo aliutoa uhai wake kwa ajili yetu. Nasi imetupasa kuutoa uhai kwa ajili ya hao ndugu.
Ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire obwanchani: Kristo nigo aruete obogima bwaye ase engencho yaito. Naboigo naintwe ntogwenerete korua obogima bwaito ase engencho y’abaminto.

English: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu anavyo vitu vya ulimwengu huu na akamwona ndugu yake ni mhitaji lakini asimhurumie, upendo wa Mungu wakaaje ndani ya mtu huyo?
Ekegusii: Korende oyore n’ebinto bi’ense, na arore oyomwabo oremeire, gotamororera amaabera, Inee, naki obwanchani bwa Nyasae borabe ime asare oyio?

English: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
Kiswahili: Watoto wapendwa, tusipende kwa maneno au kwa ulimi bali kwa tendo na kweli.
Ekegusii: Abana baane, titwancha ase amang’ana gose ase ogokwana, korende ase ogokora, na ase ekeene.

English: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
Kiswahili: Basi hivi ndivyo tutakavyoweza kujua ya kuwa sisi tu wa kweli na hivyo twaithibitisha mioyo yetu mbele za Mungu
Ekegusii: Ase eri natomanye ng’a nigo tore ab’ekeene, na ase obosio bwaye natoremie chinkoro chiaito.

English: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
Kiswahili: kila mara mioyo yetu inapotuhukumu. Kwa maana Mungu ni mkuu kuliko mioyo yetu, naye anajua kila kitu.
Ekegusii: Onye chinkoro chiaito chigotogambia, Nyasae nomonene kobua chinkoro chiaito, na ere nigo amanyete onsi.

English: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
Kiswahili: Wapendwa, kama mioyo yetu haituhukumu, tunao ujasiri mbele za Mungu,
Ekegusii: Abanchani, onye chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, rirorio ntore noboremu ase obosio bwa Nyasae,

English: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
Kiswahili: lolote tuombalo, twalipokea kutoka kwake, kwa sababu tumezitii amri zake na kutenda yale yanayompendeza.
Ekegusii: na rinde rionsi togosaba nigo tokorinyora korwa asare, ekiagera ntobwatete amachiiko aye, naende igo tokoyakora ayakomogwenera.

English: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo amri yake: kwamba tuliamini Jina la Mwanawe, Yesu Kristo, na kupendana sisi kwa sisi kama yeye alivyotuamuru.
Ekegusii: Na oko nakwo ogochika kwaye, ng’a toriegene erieta ri’Omwana oye Yeso Kristo, na gwanchana intwe ase intwe buna atochiikerete.

English: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
Kiswahili: Wale wote wanaozishika amri zake hukaa ndani yake na yeye ndani yao. Hivi ndivyo tunavyojua kwamba anakaa ndani yetu. Nasi twajua hili kwa njia ya Roho yule aliyetupa.
Ekegusii: Na bonsi ababwatete amachiiko aye nigo bamenyete ime asare na ere ime ase bare. Na igo twamanyire ng’a ere nigo amenyete ime ase tore, twayamanyire korwa ase Omoika oria atoeire.

English: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
Kiswahili: Wapendwa, msiamini kila roho, bali zijaribuni hizo roho mwone kama zimetoka kwa Mungu, kwa sababu manabii wengi wa uongo wametokea ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: Abanchani, timwegena kera omoika, moteeme emeika onye neya Nyasae, ekiagera ababani b’oborimo abange basokire gochia ase ense.

English: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo mnavyoweza kutambua Roho wa Mungu: Kila roho inayokubali kwamba Yesu Kristo amekuja katika mwili yatoka kwa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ase eri nario moramanye Omoika o Nyasae: Kera omoika oyokoorokia Yeso Kristo, ng’a ochire ase omobere, oyio noyo o Nyasae,

English: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
Kiswahili: Lakini kila roho ambayo haimkubali Yesu haitoki kwa Mungu. Hii ndiyo roho ya mpinga Kristo, ambayo mmesikia kwamba inakuja na sasa tayari iko ulimwenguni.
Ekegusii: korende kera omoika otakoorokia Yeso igo, oyio tori oyo o Nyasae. Oyio noro omoika bw’omobisa o Kristo; oyio mwaigure ng’a ngocha are, na bono oikire gocha ase ense ime.

English: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
Kiswahili: Watoto wapendwa, ninyi mmetokana na Mungu, nanyi mmewashinda kwa sababu yeye aliye ndani yenu ni mkuu kuliko yeye aliye katika ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Abana baane, inwe naba Nyasae more, naende mwabuire baria, ekiagera ere oyore ime ase more nomonene kobua ere oyore ime ase ense.

English: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
Kiswahili: Wao wanatokana na ulimwengu na kwa hiyo hunena yaliyo ya ulimwengu, hivyo ulimwengu huwasikiliza.
Ekegusii: Abwo nab’ense bare. Ase ayio, ayabagokwana nay’ense, na ense igo ekobaigwa.

English: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
Kiswahili: Sisi twatokana na Mungu na yeyote anayemjua Mungu hutusikiliza, lakini asiyetokana na Mungu hatusikilizi. Hivi ndivyo tunavyoweza kutambua Roho wa Kweli na roho ya upotovu.
Ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore aba Nyasae. Ere oyomanyete Nyasae nigo agotoigwa, na ere oyotari o Nyasae tagotoigwa. Ase eri twamanyire gwatanana Omoika bw’ekeene, na omoika bw’ogosira.

English: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
Kiswahili: Wapendwa, tupendane, kwa kuwa pendo latoka kwa Mungu. Kila apendaye amezaliwa na Mungu, naye anamjua Mungu.
Ekegusii: Abanchani, twanchane, ekiagera obwanchani nigo bokorwa ase Nyasae, na kera oyobwanchire oiboirwe na Nyasae, naende namomanyete Nyasae.

English: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
Kiswahili: Yeye asiyependa hamjui Mungu, kwa sababu Mungu ni pendo.
Ekegusii: Oyotancheti, tamomanyeti Nyasae, ekiagera Nyasae nobwanchani.

English: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo Mungu alivyoonyesha pendo lake kwetu: Mungu alimtuma Mwanawe wa pekee ulimwenguni, ili tupate uzima kupitia kwake.
Ekegusii: Ase eri obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwarorekanire ase tore: Nyasae otomire Omwana oye omomoima ase ense, erinde tonyore obogima asare.

English: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo pendo: si kwamba tulimpenda Mungu, bali yeye alitupenda, akamtuma Mwanawe, ili yeye awe dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu.
Ekegusii: Obo nabwo obwanchani, tari ng’a nintwe twamwanchete Nyasae, korende nere otwanchete intwe, agatoma Omwana oye koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito.

English: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
Kiswahili: Marafiki wapendwa, kama Mungu alivyotupenda sisi, imetupasa na sisi kupendana.
Ekegusii: Abanchani, onye Nyasae otwanchete igo, netogwenerete naintwe boigo gwanchana intwe ase intwe.

English: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Mungu wakati wowote. Lakini tukipendana, Mungu anakaa ndani yetu, na pendo lake limekamilika ndani yetu.
Ekegusii: Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi. Gatoranchane intwe ase intwe, Nyasae nigo amenyete ime ase tore, na obwanchani bwaye bwaikeranigwe ime yaito.

English: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
Kiswahili: Tunajua kwamba twakaa ndani yake na yeye ndani yetu, kwa sababu ametupa sisi sehemu ya Roho wake.
Ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire ng’a ntomenyete ime asare, nere ime ase tore: Ere otoeire Omoika oye.

English: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
Kiswahili: Nasi tumeona na kushuhudia kwamba Baba amemtuma Mwanawe ili awe Mwokozi wa ulimwengu.
Ekegusii: Na intwe twarorire, naende twabeire birori ng’a Ise otomire Omwana oye koba Omotooria bw’ense.

English: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
Kiswahili: Kila akiriye kwamba Yesu ni Mwana wa Mungu, basi Mungu hukaa ndani yake, naye ndani ya Mungu.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi okoorokia ng’a Yeso n’Omwana o Nyasae, Nyasae nigo amenyete ime asare, na ere ime ase Nyasae.

English: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
Kiswahili: Hivyo nasi twajua na kulitumainia pendo la Mungu alilo nalo kwa ajili yetu. Mungu ni Upendo. Kila akaaye katika upendo hukaa ndani ya Mungu na Mungu hukaa ndani yake.
Ekegusii: Na intwe twamanyire obwanchani obo Nyasae are naborobwo ase tore, na kobwegena. Nyasae nobwanchani, na ere oyomenyete ase obwanchani nigo amenyete ime ase Nyasae, na Nyasae ime asare.

English: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
Kiswahili: Kwa njia hii, pendo hukamilishwa miongoni mwetu ili tupate kuwa na ujasiri katika siku ya hukumu, kwa sababu kama alivyo ndivyo tulivyo sisi katika ulimwengu huu.
Ekegusii: Ase eri obwanchani bwaikeranigwe ime yaito, erinde tobe noboremu ase rituko ri’ekiina, ekiagera buna ere are, naboigo naintwe tore ase ense eye.

English: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
Kiswahili: Katika pendo hakuna hofu. Lakini pendo lililo kamili huitupa nje hofu, kwa sababu hofu inahusika na adhabu. Kila mwenye hofu hakukamilika katika pendo.
Ekegusii: Obwanchani tibori nobwoba, korende obwanchani oboikeranu nigo bogoseria obwoba gochia isiko. Naki obwoba mbore negesusuro, na oyore nobwoba taikeraniri ase obwanchani.

English: We love him, because he first loved us.
Kiswahili: Twampenda yeye kwa sababu yeye alitupenda kwanza.
Ekegusii: Intwe twanchire, ekiagera ere natwanchete intwe ritang’ani.

English: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtu atasema, “Nampenda Mungu,” lakini anamchukia ndugu yake, yeye ni mwongo. Kwa maana kila mtu asiyempenda ndugu yake ambaye anamwona, atampendaje Mungu asiyemuona?
Ekegusii: Omonto karatebe, “Nimwanchete Nyasae,” naende ogechete oyomwabo, oyio nomonyaborimo. Ere oyotamwancheti oyomwabo oyio aroche, takonyara komwancha Nyasae oyio atarochi.

English: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
Kiswahili: Naye ametupa amri hii: Yeyote anayempenda Mungu lazima pia ampende ndugu yake.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika twaeirwe nere: Ere oyomwanchete Nyasae anche noyomwabo boigo.

English: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu anayeamini kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo amezaliwa na Mungu, na yeyote ampendaye Baba humpenda pia mtoto aliyezaliwa naye.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto oyobwegenete ng’a Yeso nere Kristo oiboirwe na Nyasae, na kera oyoramwanche omoibori, omwanchire na oyoiboirwe nere.

English: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
Kiswahili: Hivi ndivyo tunavyojua kwamba tunawapenda watoto wa Mungu, kwa kumpenda Mungu na kuzitii amri zake.
Ekegusii: Ase ring’ana eri twamanyire ng’a twabanchire abana ba Nyasae ekero twamwanchire Nyasae, na kobwata amachiiko aye.

English: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
Kiswahili: Huku ndiko kumpenda Mungu, yaani, kuzitii amri zake. Nazo amri zake si nzito.
Ekegusii: Naki okomwancha Nyasae nario okobwata amachiiko aye, na amachiiko aye tari amarito.

English: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
Kiswahili: Kwa maana kila aliyezaliwa na Mungu huushinda ulimwengu. Huku ndiko kushinda kuushindako ulimwengu, yaani, hiyo imani yetu.
Ekegusii: Kera oyoiboirwe na Nyasae nigo akobua ense, na oko nakwo okobua korabue ense, okwegena gwaito.

English: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
Kiswahili: Ni nani yule aushindaye ulimwengu? Ni yule tu aaminiye kwamba Yesu ni Mwana wa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Oyorabue ense ning’o, otatiga ere oyobwegenire ng’a Yeso n’Omwana o Nyasae?

English: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
Kiswahili: Huyu ndiye alikuja kwa maji na damu, yaani, Yesu Kristo. Hakuja kwa maji peke yake, bali kwa maji na damu. Naye Roho ndiye ashuhudiaye, kwa sababu Roho ndiye kweli.
Ekegusii: Yeso Kristo, nere oyo ochete ase amaache na amanyinga, tari ase amaache oka, korende ase amaache na amanyinga.

English: For there are three who testify:
Kiswahili: Kwa maana wako watatu washuhudiao mbinguni: hao ni Baba, Neno na Roho Mtakatifu. Hawa watatu ni umoja.
Ekegusii: Na Omoika noro obeire kirori, ekiagera Omoika noro ekeene.

English: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
Kiswahili: Pia wako mashahidi watatu duniani: Roho, Maji na Damu; hawa watatu wanakubaliana katika umoja.
Ekegusii: Mbire birori bitato: Omoika, na amaache, na amanyinga, na ebi bitato nigo bikorua oborori obomo.

English: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
Kiswahili: Kama tunaukubali ushuhuda wa wanadamu, basi ushuhuda wa Mungu ni mkuu zaidi, kwa kuwa huu ndio ushuhuda wa Mungu kwamba amemshuhudia Mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Onye togwancha oborori bwa Mwanyabaanto, oborori bwa Nyasae nobonene kobua, na oborori bwa Nyasae nobo, ng’a oikire kobeera Omwana oye kirori.

English: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu amwaminiye Mwana wa Mungu anao huu ushuhuda moyoni mwake. Kila mtu asiyemwamini Mungu amemfanya yeye kuwa mwongo, kwa sababu hakuamini ushuhuda Mungu alioutoa kuhusu Mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Ere oyomwegenire Omwana o Nyasae nare noborori obwo ime yaye. Ere oyotamwegeneti Nyasae omokorire koba omonyaborimo, ekiagera tegeneti oborori boria Nyasae aorokirie igoro y’Omwana oye.

English: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio ushuhuda: kwamba Mungu ametupa uzima wa milele, nao huo uzima umo katika Mwanawe.
Ekegusii: Naki obo nabwo oborori, ng’a Nyasae otoeire obogima bwa kare na kare, na obogima obo nigo bore ime ase Omwana oye.

English: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
Kiswahili: Aliye naye Mwana wa Mungu anao uzima, yeye asiye na Mwana wa Mungu hana uzima.
Ekegusii: Ere oyore n’Omwana, nare nobogima; ere oyotari n’Omwana o Nyasae, tari nobogima.

English: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
Kiswahili: Nawaandikia mambo haya ninyi mnaoliamini Jina la Mwana wa Mungu ili mpate kujua ya kuwa mnao uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Nabarikeire inwe amang’ana aya, erinde momanye ng’a more nobogima bwa kare na kare, inwe abwo mwariegenire erieta ri’Omwana o Nyasae.

English: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
Kiswahili: Huu ndio ujasiri tulio nao tunapomkaribia Mungu, kwamba kama tukiomba kitu sawasawa na mapenzi yake, atusikia.
Ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosemeria tore nakwo asare, ng’a gatoramosabe gento kende gionsi koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye, nigo aratoigwe.

English: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
Kiswahili: Nasi kama tunajua atusikia, lolote tuombalo, tunajua ya kwamba tumekwisha kupata zile haja tulizomwomba.
Ekegusii: Na gatomanyete ng’a nigo agotoigwa ase kende gionsi togosaba, twamanyire ng’a twanyorire keria twasabire korwa asare.

English: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
Kiswahili: Kama mtu akimwona ndugu yake akitenda dhambi isiyo ya mauti, inampasa aombe, naye Mungu atampa uzima mtu huyo. Ninamaanisha wale ambao dhambi yao si ya mauti. Iko dhambi ya mauti, sisemi kwamba utaomba kwa ajili ya hiyo.
Ekegusii: Omonto kararore oyomwabo ogokora ebibe bitari bi’amakweri, amosabere, na Nyasae namoe obogima; aya nase abwo bagokora ebibe bitari bi’amakweri. Mbireo ebibe bi’amakweri; tintebeti ng’a asabe ase engencho y’ebio.

English: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
Kiswahili: Jambo lolote lisilo la haki ni dhambi, lakini iko dhambi isiyo ya mauti.
Ekegusii: Bionsi ebitari ebiaboronge nebibe, korende mbireo ebibe bitari ebi’amakweri.

English: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
Kiswahili: Tunajua ya kuwa yeye aliyezaliwa na Mungu hatendi dhambi, bali aliyezaliwa na Mungu hujilinda, wala yule mwovu hawezi kumdhuru.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a kera omonto oiboirwe na Nyasae tagokora ebibe, korende oyoiboirwe na Nyasae nigo akwerenda, na oria omobe takomokuna.

English: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
Kiswahili: Sisi twajua kuwa tu watoto wa Mungu na ya kwamba ulimwengu wote uko chini ya utawala wa yule mwovu.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a nigo tore aba Nyasae, na ense yonsi nigo ere inse y’okobua kw’oria omobe.

English: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
Kiswahili: Nasi pia twajua ya kwamba Mwana wa Mungu amekuja, naye ametupa sisi ufahamu ili tupate kumjua yeye aliye Kweli. Nasi tumo ndani yake yeye aliye Kweli, yaani, ndani ya Yesu Kristo Mwanawe. Yeye ndiye Mungu wa kweli na uzima wa milele.
Ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Omwana o Nyasae oikire gocha, na ere otoeire ebirengererio bi’okomanya ere oyore bw’ekeene. Na intwe nigo tore ime asare ere oyore bw’ekeene, ime ase Omwana oye Yeso Kristo. Oyio nere ore Nyasae bw’ekeene, naende obogima bwa kare na kare.

English: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
Kiswahili: Watoto wapendwa, jilindeni nafsi zenu kutokana na sanamu. Amen.
Ekegusii: Abana baane, erende inwe abanyene korwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa.

English: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
Kiswahili: Mzee: Kwa bibi mteule na watoto wake, niwapendao katika kweli, wala si mimi tu, bali na wale wote waijuayo kweli:
Ekegusii: Korwa ase omogaka gochia ase omokungu omochore amo nabana bao, inwe abwo nyanchete ase ekeene. Tari inche bweka mbanchete, korende nabaria bonsi abamanyete ekeene.

English: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
Kiswahili: kwa sababu ya ile kweli ikaayo ndani yetu na ambayo itaendelea kukaa nasi milele:
Ekegusii: Twabanchire ase engencho y’ekeene eke geikaransete ime yaito, kerokio inakebe amo naintwe goika kare na kare.

English: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
Kiswahili: Neema, rehema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba na kwa Yesu Kristo, Mwanawe Baba, itakuwa pamoja nasi katika kweli na upendo.
Ekegusii: Obuya, na amaabera, na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata na ase Yeso Kristo, Omwana o Tata, nigo birabe amo naintwe ase ekeene na ase obwanchani.

English: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
Kiswahili: Imenipa furaha kuu kuona baadhi ya watoto wako wanaenenda katika kweli, kama vile Baba alivyotuagiza.
Ekegusii: Nagookire mono ekiagera narorire abande ase abana bao bagendererete ase ekeene, buna Tata atochikerete.

English: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
Kiswahili: Sasa, bibi mpendwa, si kwamba ninakuandikia amri mpya, bali ile tuliyokuwa nayo tangu mwanzo. Tupendane kila mmoja na mwenzake.
Ekegusii: Na bono, omokungu, nakoboririe ng’a twanchane intwe ase intwe. Tari ng’a nogochika okoyia ngokoriikera, korende nkoria twarenge nakorokwo korwa ritang’ani.

English: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
Kiswahili: Hili ndilo pendo, kwamba tuenende sawasawa na amri zake. Hii ndiyo amri yake kama vile mlivyosikia tangu mwanzo, kwamba mwenende katika upendo.
Ekegusii: Obo nabwo obwanchani ng’a togenderere ase amachiiko aye. Oko nakwo ogochika koria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, ng’a mogenderere ase obwanchani.

English: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
Kiswahili: Wadanganyifu wengi, wasiokubali kwamba Yesu Kristo amekuja katika mwili, wametokea ulimwenguni. Mtu wa namna hiyo ni mdanganyifu na mpinga Kristo.
Ekegusii: Naki abang’ainereria abange baasokire gochia ase ense, abatari koorokia Yeso Kristo ng’a ochire ase omobere. Oyore buna abwo, nere oria omong’ainereria, naende nomobisa o Kristo.

English: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
Kiswahili: Jihadharini msije mkapoteza kile mlichokitenda, bali mpate kupewa thawabu kamilifu.
Ekegusii: Erigererie inwe abanyene timosiria aya twabarenteire, korende monyoore eng’eria eng’ikeranu.

English: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote asiyedumu katika mafundisho ya Kristo, bali akayaacha, yeye hana Mungu. Yeyote anayedumu katika mafundisho ana Baba na Mwana pia.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oragenderere goetania, na tari gotenena ase okworokereria gwa Kristo, oyio tari na Nyasae. Ere oyogotenena ase okworokereria okwo, oyio nigo are nabwo babere, Ise na Omwana.

English: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
Kiswahili: Msimpokee mtu yeyote anayewajia ambaye hawaletei mafundisho haya, wala msimkaribishe nyumbani mwenu.
Ekegusii: Omonto karache ase more, na ere tarenteti okworokereria okwo, timomooroisia ase enyomba yaino, gose timomokwania.

English: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
Kiswahili: Yeyote amkaribishaye mtu wa namna hiyo anashiriki katika matendo maovu ya mtu huyo.
Ekegusii: Naki ere oyoramokwanie igo obwatanire nemeremo yaye emebe.

English: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
Kiswahili: Ninayo mengi ya kuwaandikia, lakini sitaki kutumia karatasi na wino. Badala yake, nataraji kuja kwenu na kuongea nanyi ana kwa ana, ili furaha yetu ipate kuwa timilifu.
Ekegusii: Nonya mbwate amang’ana amange nanga nabariikera, tindigeti koyarika ase ekaratasi na egwino, korende ninsemeretie gocha ase more gokwana nainwe obosio ase obosio, erinde omogooko oito oikeranigwe.
